author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace ~

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ॥ ਜਪੁ ॥
transliteration: || jap ||
english: Chant And Meditate:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਚੁ ॥
transliteration: aad sach jugaad sach ||
english: True In The Primal Beginning. True Throughout The Ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hai bhee sach naanak hosee bhee sach ||1||
english: True Here And Now. O Nanak, Forever And Ever True. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਚੈ ਸੋਚਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸੋਚੀ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sochai soch na hovaee je sochee lakh vaar ||
english: By thinking, He cannot be reduced to thought, even by thinking hundreds of thousands of times.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੁਪ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਲਾਇ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: chupai chup na hovaee je laai rahaa liv taar ||
english: By remaining silent, inner silence is not obtained, even by remaining lovingly absorbed deep within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੀ ਜੇ ਬੰਨਾ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਭਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bhukhiaa bhukh na utaree je ba(n)naa pureeaa bhaar ||
english: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased, even by piling up loads of worldly goods.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਤ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: sahas siaanapaa lakh hohi ta ik na chalai naal ||
english: Hundreds of thousands of clever tricks, but not even one of them will go along with you in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਵ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਿਵ ਕੂੜੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: kiv sachiaaraa hoeeai kiv kooRai tutai paal ||
english: So how can you become truthful? And how can the veil of illusion be torn away?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hukam rajaaee chalanaa naanak likhiaa naal ||1||
english: O Nanak, it is written that you shall obey the Hukam of His Command, and walk in the Way of His Will. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਕਾਰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hukamee hovan aakaar hukam na kahiaa jaaee ||
english: By His Command, bodies are created; His Command cannot be described.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: hukamee hovan jee hukam milai vadiaaee ||
english: By His Command, souls come into being; by His Command, glory and greatness are obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
transliteration: hukamee utam neech hukam likh dukh sukh paaeeahi ||
english: By His Command, some are high and some are low; by His Written Command, pain and pleasure are obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਇਕਿ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa hukamee bakhasees ik hukamee sadaa bhavaaeeahi ||
english: Some, by His Command, are blessed and forgiven; others, by His Command, wander aimlessly forever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: hukamai a(n)dar sabh ko baahar hukam na koi ||
english: Everyone is subject to His Command; no one is beyond His Command.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak hukamai je bujhai ta haumai kahai na koi ||2||
english: O Nanak, one who understands His Command, does not speak in ego. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: gaavai ko taan hovai kisai taan ||
english: Some sing of His Power-who has that Power?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: gaavai ko daat jaanai neesaan ||
english: Some sing of His Gifts, and know His Sign and Insignia.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਗੁਣ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: gaavai ko gun vadiaaeeaa chaar ||
english: Some sing of His Glorious Virtues, Greatness and Beauty.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵਿਖਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gaavai ko vidiaa vikham veechaar ||
english: Some sing of knowledge obtained of Him, through difficult philosophical studies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
transliteration: gaavai ko saaj kare tan kheh ||
english: Some sing that He fashions the body, and then again reduces it to dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜੀਅ ਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: gaavai ko jee lai phir deh ||
english: Some sing that He takes life away, and then again restores it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gaavai ko jaapai disai door ||
english: Some sing that He seems so very far away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਾਦਰਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gaavai ko vekhai haadaraa hadoor ||
english: Some sing that He watches over us, face to face, ever-present.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨਾ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਿ ॥
transliteration: kathanaa kathee na aavai tot ||
english: There is no shortage of those who preach and teach.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਕਥੀ ਕੋਟੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
transliteration: kath kath kathee kotee kot kot ||
english: Millions upon millions offer millions of sermons and stories.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਦਾ ਦੇ ਲੈਦੇ ਥਕਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: dedaa de laide thak paahi ||
english: The Great Giver keeps on giving, while those who receive grow weary of receiving.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਾ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਖਾਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jugaa juga(n)tar khaahee khaahi ||
english: Throughout the ages, consumers consume.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: hukamee hukam chalaae raahu ||
english: The Commander, by His Command, leads us to walk on the Path.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak vigasai veparavaahu ||3||
english: O Nanak, He blossoms forth, Carefree and Untroubled. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਇ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahib saach naai bhaakhiaa bhaau apaar ||
english: True is the Master, True is His Name-speak it with infinite love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aakhahi ma(n)gahi dehi dehi daat kare daataar ||
english: People beg and pray, "Give to us, give to us", and the Great Giver gives His Gifts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫੇਰਿ ਕਿ ਅਗੈ ਰਖੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pher k agai rakheeai jit disai darabaar ||
english: So what offering can we place before Him, by which we might see the Darbaar of His Court?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹੌ ਕਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: muhau k bolan boleeai jit sun dhare piaar ||
english: What words can we speak to evoke His Love?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit velaa sach naau vadiaaee veechaar ||
english: In the Amrit Vaylaa, the ambrosial hours before dawn, chant the True Name, and contemplate His Glorious Greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਵੈ ਕਪੜਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੋਖੁ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: karamee aavai kapaRaa nadaree mokh duaar ||
english: By the karma of past actions, the robe of this physical body is obtained. By His Grace, the Gate of Liberation is found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak evai jaaneeai sabh aape sachiaar ||4||
english: O Nanak, know this well: the True One Himself is All. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਾਪਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕੀਤਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: thaapiaa na jaai keetaa na hoi ||
english: He cannot be established, He cannot be created.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape aap nira(n)jan soi ||
english: He Himself is Immaculate and Pure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jin seviaa tin paaiaa maan ||
english: Those who serve Him are honored.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak gaaveeai gunee nidhaan ||
english: O Nanak, sing of the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੀਐ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gaaveeai suneeai man rakheeai bhaau ||
english: Sing, and listen, and let your mind be filled with love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh parahar sukh ghar lai jaai ||
english: Your pain shall be sent far away, and peace shall come to your home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਦੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naada(n) guramukh veda(n) guramukh rahiaa samaaee ||
english: The Guru's Word is the Sound-current of the Naad; the Guru's Word is the Wisdom of the Vedas; the Guru's Word is all-pervading.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਈਸਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬਤੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur eesar gur gorakh baramaa gur paarabatee maaee ||
english: The Guru is Shiva, the Guru is Vishnu and Brahma; the Guru is Paarvati and Lakhshmi.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹਉ ਜਾਣਾ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: je hau jaanaa aakhaa naahee kahanaa kathan na jaaee ||
english: Even knowing God, I cannot describe Him; He cannot be described in words.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਾ ਇਕ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guraa ik dehi bujhaaee ||
english: The Guru has given me this one understanding:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa ik daataa so mai visar na jaaee ||5||
english: there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਕਿ ਨਾਇ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: teerath naavaa je tis bhaavaa vin bhaane k naai karee ||
english: If I am pleasing to Him, then that is my pilgrimage and cleansing bath. Without pleasing Him, what good are ritual cleansings?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਰਠਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਵੇਖਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਈ ॥
transliteration: jetee sirath upaaee vekhaa vin karamaa k milai laee ||
english: I gaze upon all the created beings: without the karma of good actions, what are they given to receive?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਜੇ ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
transliteration: mat vich ratan javaahar maanik je ik gur kee sikh sunee ||
english: Within the mind are gems, jewels and rubies, if you listen to the Guru's Teachings, even once.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਾ ਇਕ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guraa ik dehi bujhaaee ||
english: The Guru has given me this one understanding:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa ik daataa so mai visar na jaaee ||6||
english: there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਆਰਜਾ ਹੋਰ ਦਸੂਣੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: je jug chaare aarajaa hor dasoonee hoi ||
english: Even if you could live throughout the four ages, or even ten times more,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਵਾ ਖੰਡਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: navaa kha(n)daa vich jaaneeai naal chalai sabh koi ||
english: and even if you were known throughout the nine continents and followed by all,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਗਾ ਨਾਉ ਰਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)gaa naau rakhaai kai jas keerat jag lei ||
english: with a good name and reputation, with praise and fame throughout the world-

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤ ਵਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: je tis nadar na aavaee ta vaat na puchhai ke ||
english: still, if the Lord does not bless you with His Glance of Grace, then who cares? What is the use?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਸੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
transliteration: keetaa a(n)dar keet kar dosee dos dhare ||
english: Among worms, you would be considered a lowly worm, and even contemptible sinners would hold you in contempt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਦੇ ॥
transliteration: naanak niragun gun kare gunava(n)tiaa gun de ||
english: O Nanak, God blesses the unworthy with virtue, and bestows virtue on the virtuous.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਜਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tehaa koi na sujhaee j tis gun koi kare ||7||
english: No one can even imagine anyone who can bestow virtue upon Him. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਿਧ ਪੀਰ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: suniai sidh peer sur naath ||
english: Listening-the Siddhas, the spiritual teachers, the heroic warriors, the yogic masters.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਧਰਤਿ ਧਵਲ ਆਕਾਸ ॥
transliteration: suniai dharat dhaval aakaas ||
english: Listening-the earth, its support and the Akaashic ethers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: suniai deep lo paataal ||
english: Listening-the oceans, the lands of the world and the nether regions of the underworld.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: suniai pohi na sakai kaal ||
english: Listening-Death cannot even touch you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak bhagataa sadaa vigaas ||
english: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੮॥
transliteration: suniai dookh paap kaa naas ||8||
english: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਇੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: suniai eesar baramaa i(n)d ||
english: Listening-Shiva, Brahma and Indra.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣ ਮੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: suniai mukh saalaahan ma(n)d ||
english: Listening-even foul-mouthed people praise Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੇਦ ॥
transliteration: suniai jog jugat tan bhed ||
english: Listening-the technology of Yoga and the secrets of the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਵੇਦ ॥
transliteration: suniai saasat simrit ved ||
english: Listening-the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak bhagataa sadaa vigaas ||
english: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੯॥
transliteration: suniai dookh paap kaa naas ||9||
english: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: suniai sat sa(n)tokh giaan ||
english: Listening-truth, contentment and spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਕਾ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: suniai athasath kaa isanaan ||
english: Listening-take your cleansing bath at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: suniai paR paR paavahi maan ||
english: Listening-reading and reciting, honor is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: suniai laagai sahaj dhiaan ||
english: Listening-intuitively grasp the essence of meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak bhagataa sadaa vigaas ||
english: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: suniai dookh paap kaa naas ||10||
english: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਰਾ ਗੁਣਾ ਕੇ ਗਾਹ ॥
transliteration: suniai saraa gunaa ke gaah ||
english: Listening-dive deep into the ocean of virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸੇਖ ਪੀਰ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥
transliteration: suniai sekh peer paatisaah ||
english: Listening-the Shaykhs, religious scholars, spiritual teachers and emperors.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਅੰਧੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: suniai a(n)dhe paavahi raahu ||
english: Listening-even the blind find the Path.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਹਾਥ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: suniai haath hovai asagaahu ||
english: Listening-the Unreachable comes within your grasp.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak bhagataa sadaa vigaas ||
english: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: suniai dookh paap kaa naas ||11||
english: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੇ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)ne kee gat kahee na jaai ||
english: The state of the faithful cannot be described.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je ko kahai pichhai pachhutaai ||
english: One who tries to describe this shall regret the attempt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਗਦਿ ਕਲਮ ਨ ਲਿਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kaagad kalam na likhanahaar ||
english: No paper, no pen, no scribe

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੇ ਕਾ ਬਹਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)ne kaa bahi karan veechaar ||
english: can record the state of the faithful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa naam nira(n)jan hoi ||
english: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||12||
english: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)nai surat hovai man budh ||
english: The faithful have intuitive awareness and intelligence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੈ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਣ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)nai sagal bhavan kee sudh ||
english: The faithful know about all worlds and realms.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਨਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)nai muhi chotaa naa khaai ||
english: The faithful shall never be struck across the face.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੈ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)nai jam kai saath na jaai ||
english: The faithful do not have to go with the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa naam nira(n)jan hoi ||
english: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||13||
english: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)nai maarag thaak na paai ||
english: The path of the faithful shall never be blocked.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੈ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)nai pat siu paragat jaai ||
english: The faithful shall depart with honor and fame.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੈ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਪੰਥੁ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)nai mag na chalai pa(n)th ||
english: The faithful do not follow empty religious rituals.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੈ ਧਰਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)nai dharam setee sanaba(n)dh ||
english: The faithful are firmly bound to the Dharma.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa naam nira(n)jan hoi ||
english: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||14||
english: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖੁ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)nai paavahi mokh duaar ||
english: The faithful find the Door of Liberation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)nai paravaarai saadhaar ||
english: The faithful uplift and redeem their family and relations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੈ ਤਰੈ ਤਾਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)nai tarai taare gur sikh ||
english: The faithful are saved, and carried across with the Sikhs of the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵਹਿ ਨ ਭਿਖ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)nai naanak bhavahi na bhikh ||
english: The faithful, O Nanak, do not wander around begging.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa naam nira(n)jan hoi ||
english: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||15||
english: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਣ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch paravaan pa(n)ch paradhaan ||
english: The chosen ones, the self-elect, are accepted and approved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)che paavahi daragahi maan ||
english: The chosen ones are honored in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚੇ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਰਾਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)che sohahi dar raajaan ||
english: The chosen ones look beautiful in the courts of kings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)chaa kaa gur ek dhiaan ||
english: The chosen ones meditate single-mindedly on the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: je ko kahai karai veechaar ||
english: No matter how much anyone tries to explain and describe them,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੇ ਕੈ ਕਰਣੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: karate kai karanai naahee sumaar ||
english: the actions of the Creator cannot be counted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੌਲੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਾ ਪੂਤੁ ॥
transliteration: dhaul dharam daiaa kaa poot ||
english: The mythical bull is Dharma, the son of compassion;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tokh thaap rakhiaa jin soot ||
english: this is what patiently holds the earth in its place.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬੁਝੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: je ko bujhai hovai sachiaar ||
english: One who understands this becomes truthful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਵਲੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਕੇਤਾ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dhavalai upar ketaa bhaar ||
english: What a great load there is on the bull!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਪਰੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dharatee hor parai hor hor ||
english: So many worlds beyond this world-so very many!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਭਾਰੁ ਤਲੈ ਕਵਣੁ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tis te bhaar talai kavan jor ||
english: What power holds them, and supports their weight?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜਾਤਿ ਰੰਗਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਵ ॥
transliteration: jee jaat ra(n)gaa ke naav ||
english: The names and the colors of the assorted species of beings

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਵੁੜੀ ਕਲਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa likhiaa vuRee kalaam ||
english: were all inscribed by the Ever-flowing Pen of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ehu lekhaa likh jaanai koi ||
english: Who knows how to write this account?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕੇਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: lekhaa likhiaa ketaa hoi ||
english: Just imagine what a huge scroll it would take!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਸੁਆਲਿਹੁ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: ketaa taan suaalihu roop ||
english: What power! What fascinating beauty!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੌਣੁ ਕੂਤੁ ॥
transliteration: ketee daat jaanai kaun koot ||
english: And what gifts! Who can know their extent?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਪਸਾਉ ਏਕੋ ਕਵਾਉ ॥
transliteration: keetaa pasaau eko kavaau ||
english: You created the vast expanse of the Universe with One Word!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥
transliteration: tis te hoe lakh dareeaau ||
english: Hundreds of thousands of rivers began to flow.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਣ ਕਹਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kudarat kavan kahaa veechaar ||
english: How can Your Creative Potency be described?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ਏਕ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: vaariaa na jaavaa ek vaar ||
english: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai saaee bhalee kaar ||
english: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: too sadaa salaamat nira(n)kaar ||16||
english: You, Eternal and Formless One! ||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਜਪ ਅਸੰਖ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh jap asa(n)kh bhaau ||
english: Countless meditations, countless loves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਸੰਖ ਤਪ ਤਾਉ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh poojaa asa(n)kh tap taau ||
english: Countless worship services, countless austere disciplines.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਗਰੰਥ ਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਦ ਪਾਠ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh gara(n)th mukh ved paath ||
english: Countless scriptures, and ritual recitations of the Vedas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਜੋਗ ਮਨਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਉਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh jog man rahahi udaas ||
english: Countless Yogis, whose minds remain detached from the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਭਗਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh bhagat gun giaan veechaar ||
english: Countless devotees contemplate the Wisdom and Virtues of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਸਤੀ ਅਸੰਖ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh satee asa(n)kh daataar ||
english: Countless the holy, countless the givers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਸੂਰ ਮੁਹ ਭਖ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh soor muh bhakh saar ||
english: Countless heroic spiritual warriors, who bear the brunt of the attack in battle (who with their mouths eat steel).

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਮੋਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh mon liv laai taar ||
english: Countless silent sages, vibrating the String of His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਣ ਕਹਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kudarat kavan kahaa veechaar ||
english: How can Your Creative Potency be described?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ਏਕ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: vaariaa na jaavaa ek vaar ||
english: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai saaee bhalee kaar ||
english: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: too sadaa salaamat nira(n)kaar ||17||
english: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||17||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਘੋਰ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh moorakh a(n)dh ghor ||
english: Countless fools, blinded by ignorance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਚੋਰ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh chor haraamakhor ||
english: Countless thieves and embezzlers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਅਮਰ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੋਰ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh amar kar jaahi jor ||
english: Countless impose their will by force.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਗਲਵਢ ਹਤਿਆ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh galavadh hatiaa kamaahi ||
english: Countless cut-throats and ruthless killers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh paapee paap kar jaahi ||
english: Countless sinners who keep on sinning.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੇ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh kooRiaar kooRe phiraahi ||
english: Countless liars, wandering lost in their lies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਮਲੇਛ ਮਲੁ ਭਖਿ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh malechh mal bhakh khaahi ||
english: Countless wretches, eating filth as their ration.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh ni(n)dak sir karahi bhaar ||
english: Countless slanderers, carrying the weight of their stupid mistakes on their heads.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak neech kahai veechaar ||
english: Nanak describes the state of the lowly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ਏਕ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: vaariaa na jaavaa ek vaar ||
english: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai saaee bhalee kaar ||
english: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: too sadaa salaamat nira(n)kaar ||18||
english: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||18||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਨਾਵ ਅਸੰਖ ਥਾਵ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh naav asa(n)kh thaav ||
english: Countless names, countless places.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਸੰਖ ਲੋਅ ॥
transliteration: aga(n)m aga(n)m asa(n)kh lo ||
english: Inaccessible, unapproachable, countless celestial realms.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh kahahi sir bhaar hoi ||
english: Even to call them countless is to carry the weight on your head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖਰੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
transliteration: akharee naam akharee saalaah ||
english: From the Word, comes the Naam; from the Word, comes Your Praise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖਰੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੀਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹ ॥
transliteration: akharee giaan geet gun gaah ||
english: From the Word, comes spiritual wisdom, singing the Songs of Your Glory.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖਰੀ ਲਿਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: akharee likhan bolan baan ||
english: From the Word, come the written and spoken words and hymns.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖਰਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਖਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: akharaa sir sa(n)jog vakhaan ||
english: From the Word, comes destiny, written on one's forehead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jin ehi likhe tis sir naahi ||
english: But the One who wrote these Words of Destiny-no words are written on His Forehead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਵ ਫੁਰਮਾਏ ਤਿਵ ਤਿਵ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jiv phuramaae tiv tiv paahi ||
english: As He ordains, so do we receive.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਤਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jetaa keetaa tetaa naau ||
english: The created universe is the manifestation of Your Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai naahee ko thaau ||
english: Without Your Name, there is no place at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਣ ਕਹਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kudarat kavan kahaa veechaar ||
english: How can I describe Your Creative Power?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ਏਕ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: vaariaa na jaavaa ek vaar ||
english: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai saaee bhalee kaar ||
english: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: too sadaa salaamat nira(n)kaar ||19||
english: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||19||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰੀਐ ਹਥੁ ਪੈਰੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: bhareeai hath pair tan deh ||
english: When the hands and the feet and the body are dirty,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਧੋਤੈ ਉਤਰਸੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
transliteration: paanee dhotai utaras kheh ||
english: water can wash away the dirt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਤ ਪਲੀਤੀ ਕਪੜੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: moot paleetee kapaR hoi ||
english: When the clothes are soiled and stained by urine,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇ ਸਾਬੂਣੁ ਲਈਐ ਓਹੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: de saaboon laeeai ohu dhoi ||
english: soap can wash them clean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰੀਐ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: bhareeai mat paapaa kai sa(n)g ||
english: But when the intellect is stained and polluted by sin,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਧੋਪੈ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: ohu dhopai naavai kai ra(n)g ||
english: it can only be cleansed by the Love of the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਆਖਣੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: pu(n)nee paapee aakhan naahi ||
english: Virtue and vice do not come by mere words;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kar kar karanaa likh lai jaahu ||
english: actions repeated, over and over again, are engraved on the soul.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aape beej aape hee khaahu ||
english: You shall harvest what you plant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਆਵਹੁ ਜਾਹੁ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak hukamee aavahu jaahu ||20||
english: O Nanak, by the Hukam of God's Command, we come and go in reincarnation. ||20||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਤਪੁ ਦਇਆ ਦਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: teerath tap daiaa dat daan ||
english: Pilgrimages, austere discipline, compassion and charity

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: je ko paavai til kaa maan ||
english: these, by themselves, bring only an iota of merit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: suniaa ma(n)niaa man keetaa bhaau ||
english: Listening and believing with love and humility in your mind,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਮਲਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)taragat teerath mal naau ||
english: cleanse yourself with the Name, at the sacred shrine deep within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh gun tere mai naahee koi ||
english: All virtues are Yours, Lord, I have none at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vin gun keete bhagat na hoi ||
english: Without virtue, there is no devotional worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਅਸਤਿ ਆਥਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਬਰਮਾਉ ॥
transliteration: suasat aath baanee baramaau ||
english: I bow to the Lord of the World, to His Word, to Brahma the Creator.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਣੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sat suhaan sadaa man chaau ||
english: He is Beautiful, True and Eternally Joyful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਕਵਣ ਥਿਤਿ ਕਵਣੁ ਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kavan s velaa vakhat kavan kavan thit kavan vaar ||
english: What was that time, and what was that moment? What was that day, and what was that date?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਵਣਿ ਸਿ ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kavan s rutee maahu kavan jit hoaa aakaar ||
english: What was that season, and what was that month, when the Universe was created?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਲ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਪੰਡਤੀ ਜਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: vel na paaeeaa pa(n)datee j hovai lekh puraan ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, cannot find that time, even if it is written in the Puraanas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਖਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਾਦੀਆ ਜਿ ਲਿਖਨਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: vakhat na paaio kaadeeaa j likhan lekh kuraan ||
english: That time is not known to the Qazis, who study the Koran.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਿਤਿ ਵਾਰੁ ਨਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੁਤਿ ਮਾਹੁ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: thit vaar naa jogee jaanai rut maahu naa koee ||
english: The day and the date are not known to the Yogis, nor is the month or the season.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਿਰਠੀ ਕਉ ਸਾਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa karataa sirathee kau saaje aape jaanai soee ||
english: The Creator who created this creation-only He Himself knows.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਵ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਾ ਕਿਵ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਵਰਨੀ ਕਿਵ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kiv kar aakhaa kiv saalaahee kiu varanee kiv jaanaa ||
english: How can we speak of Him? How can we praise Him? How can we describe Him? How can we know Him?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਇਕ ਦੂ ਇਕੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
transliteration: naanak aakhan sabh ko aakhai ik doo ik siaanaa ||
english: O Nanak, everyone speaks of Him, each one wiser than the rest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਡੀ ਨਾਈ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: vadaa saahib vadee naaee keetaa jaa kaa hovai ||
english: Great is the Master, Great is His Name. Whatever happens is according to His Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਪੌ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਨ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak je ko aapau jaanai agai gaiaa na sohai ||21||
english: O Nanak, one who claims to know everything shall not be decorated in the world hereafter. ||21||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਲਖ ਆਗਾਸਾ ਆਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: paataalaa paataal lakh aagaasaa aagaas ||
english: There are nether worlds beneath nether worlds, and hundreds of thousands of heavenly worlds above.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓੜਕ ਓੜਕ ਭਾਲਿ ਥਕੇ ਵੇਦ ਕਹਨਿ ਇਕ ਵਾਤ ॥
transliteration: oRak oRak bhaal thake ved kahan ik vaat ||
english: The Vedas say that you can search and search for them all, until you grow weary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਕਹਨਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਅਸੁਲੂ ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
transliteration: sahas athaarah kahan katebaa asuloo ik dhaat ||
english: The scriptures say that there are 18,000 worlds, but in reality, there is only One Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਲੇਖੈ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: lekhaa hoi ta likheeai lekhai hoi vinaas ||
english: If you try to write an account of this, you will surely finish yourself before you finish writing it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੁ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak vadaa aakheeai aape jaanai aap ||22||
english: O Nanak, call Him Great! He Himself knows Himself. ||22||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਏਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: saalaahee saalaahi etee surat na paaeeaa ||
english: The praisers praise the Lord, but they do not obtain intuitive understanding

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦੀਆ ਅਤੈ ਵਾਹ ਪਵਹਿ ਸਮੁੰਦਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ॥
transliteration: nadeeaa atai vaah pavahi samu(n)d na jaaneeahi ||
english: the streams and rivers flowing into the ocean do not know its vastness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਹ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਗਿਰਹਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
transliteration: samu(n)d saah sulataan girahaa setee maal dhan ||
english: Even kings and emperors, with mountains of property and oceans of wealth

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀੜੀ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਨੀ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰਹਿ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: keeRee tul na hovanee je tis manahu na veesarahi ||23||
english: -these are not even equal to an ant, who does not forget God. ||23||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t na siphatee kahan na a(n)t ||
english: Endless are His Praises, endless are those who speak them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਦੇਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t na karanai den na a(n)t ||
english: Endless are His Actions, endless are His Gifts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਵੇਖਣਿ ਸੁਣਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t na vekhan sunan na a(n)t ||
english: Endless is His Vision, endless is His Hearing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t na jaapai kiaa man ma(n)t ||
english: His limits cannot be perceived. What is the Mystery of His Mind?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t na jaapai keetaa aakaar ||
english: The limits of the created universe cannot be perceived.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t na jaapai paaraavaar ||
english: Its limits here and beyond cannot be perceived.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaaran kete bilalaahi ||
english: Many struggle to know His limits,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: taa ke a(n)t na paae jaahi ||
english: but His limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ehu a(n)t na jaanai koi ||
english: No one can know these limits.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bahutaa kaheeai bahutaa hoi ||
english: The more you say about them, the more there still remains to be said.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਊਚਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vadaa saahib oochaa thaau ||
english: Great is the Master, High is His Heavenly Home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਊਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ooche upar oochaa naau ||
english: Highest of the High, above all is His Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਵਡੁ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: evad oochaa hovai koi ||
english: Only one as Great and as High as God

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਊਚੇ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis ooche kau jaanai soi ||
english: can know His Lofty and Exalted State.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: jevad aap jaanai aap aap ||
english: Only He Himself is that Great. He Himself knows Himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree karamee daat ||24||
english: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, He bestows His Blessings. ||24||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bahutaa karam likhiaa naa jaai ||
english: His Blessings are so abundant that there can be no written account of them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vadaa daataa til na tamaai ||
english: The Great Giver does not hold back anything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਜੋਧ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kete ma(n)gahi jodh apaar ||
english: There are so many great, heroic warriors begging at the Door of the Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤਿਆ ਗਣਤ ਨਹੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ketiaa ganat nahee veechaar ||
english: So many contemplate and dwell upon Him, that they cannot be counted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਖਪਿ ਤੁਟਹਿ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kete khap tutahi vekaar ||
english: So many waste away to death engaged in corruption.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਮੁਕਰੁ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kete lai lai mukar paahi ||
english: So many take and take again, and then deny receiving.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਖਾਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kete moorakh khaahee khaahi ||
english: So many foolish consumers keep on consuming.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤਿਆ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸਦ ਮਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ketiaa dookh bhookh sad maar ||
english: So many endure distress, deprivation and constant abuse.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹਿ ਭਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ehi bh daat teree daataar ||
english: Even these are Your Gifts, O Great Giver!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਦਿ ਖਲਾਸੀ ਭਾਣੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)d khalaasee bhaanai hoi ||
english: Liberation from bondage comes only by Your Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: hor aakh na sakai koi ||
english: No one else has any say in this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਖਾਇਕੁ ਆਖਣਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je ko khaaik aakhan paai ||
english: If some fool should presume to say that he does,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇਤੀਆ ਮੁਹਿ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ohu jaanai jeteeaa muhi khaai ||
english: he shall learn, and feel the effects of his folly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aape jaanai aape dei ||
english: He Himself knows, He Himself gives.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਸਿ ਭਿ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aakhahi s bh keee kei ||
english: Few, very few are those who acknowledge this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
transliteration: jis no bakhase siphat saalaah ||
english: One who is blessed to sing the Praises of the Lord,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak paatisaahee paatisaahu ||25||
english: O Nanak, is the king of kings. ||25||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲ ਗੁਣ ਅਮੁਲ ਵਾਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: amul gun amul vaapaar ||
english: Priceless are His Virtues, Priceless are His Dealings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਅਮੁਲ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: amul vaapaareee amul bha(n)daar ||
english: Priceless are His Dealers, Priceless are His Treasures.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲ ਆਵਹਿ ਅਮੁਲ ਲੈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: amul aavahi amul lai jaahi ||
english: Priceless are those who come to Him, Priceless are those who buy from Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲ ਭਾਇ ਅਮੁਲਾ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: amul bhaai amulaa samaahi ||
english: Priceless is Love for Him, Priceless is absorption into Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: amul dharam amul deebaan ||
english: Priceless is the Divine Law of Dharma, Priceless is the Divine Court of Justice.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਤੁਲੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: amul tul amul paravaan ||
english: Priceless are the scales, priceless are the weights.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: amul bakhasees amul neesaan ||
english: Priceless are His Blessings, Priceless is His Banner and Insignia.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: amul karam amul phuramaan ||
english: Priceless is His Mercy, Priceless is His Royal Command.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲੋ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਆਖਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: amulo amul aakhiaa na jaai ||
english: Priceless, O Priceless beyond expression!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aakh aakh rahe liv laai ||
english: Speak of Him continually, and remain absorbed in His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਵੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
transliteration: aakhahi ved paath puraan ||
english: The Vedas and the Puraanas speak.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਪੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਖਿਆਣ ॥
transliteration: aakhahi paRe karahi vakhiaan ||
english: The scholars speak and lecture.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਬਰਮੇ ਆਖਹਿ ਇੰਦ ॥
transliteration: aakhahi barame aakhahi i(n)d ||
english: Brahma speaks, Indra speaks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਗੋਪੀ ਤੈ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: aakhahi gopee tai govi(n)d ||
english: The Gopis and Krishna speak.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਈਸਰ ਆਖਹਿ ਸਿਧ ॥
transliteration: aakhahi eesar aakhahi sidh ||
english: Shiva speaks, the Siddhas speak.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਬੁਧ ॥
transliteration: aakhahi kete keete budh ||
english: The many created Buddhas speak.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਦਾਨਵ ਆਖਹਿ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: aakhahi daanav aakhahi dev ||
english: The demons speak, the demi-gods speak.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: aakhahi sur nar mun jan sev ||
english: The spiritual warriors, the heavenly beings, the silent sages, the humble and serviceful speak.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਆਖਹਿ ਆਖਣਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kete aakhahi aakhan paahi ||
english: Many speak and try to describe Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kete kahi kahi uth uth jaahi ||
english: Many have spoken of Him over and over again, and have then arisen and departed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ete keete hor karehi ||
english: If He were to create as many again as there already are,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
transliteration: taa aakh na sakahi keee kei ||
english: even then, they could not describe Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jevad bhaavai tevad hoi ||
english: He is as Great as He wishes to be.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak jaanai saachaa soi ||
english: O Nanak, the True Lord knows.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਬੋਲੁਵਿਗਾੜੁ ॥
transliteration: je ko aakhai boluvigaaR ||
english: If anyone presumes to describe God,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: taa likheeai sir gaavaaraa gaavaar ||26||
english: he shall be known as the greatest fool of fools! ||26||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: so dar kehaa so ghar kehaa jit bahi sarab samaale ||
english: Where is that Gate, and where is that Dwelling, in which You sit and take care of all?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: vaaje naad anek asa(n)khaa kete vaavanahaare ||
english: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, and countless musicians play on all sorts of instruments there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kete raag paree siu kaheean kete gaavanahaare ||
english: So many Ragas, so many musicians singing there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਹਨੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi tuhano paun paanee baisa(n)tar gaavai raajaa dharam duaare ||
english: The praanic wind, water and fire sing; the Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi chit gupat likh jaanahi likh likh dharam veechaare ||
english: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who record actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who judges this record sing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi eesar baramaa devee sohan sadaa savaare ||
english: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned, sing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਇੰਦ ਇਦਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi i(n)d idaasan baithe devatiaa dar naale ||
english: Indra, seated upon His Throne, sings with the deities at Your Door.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi sidh samaadhee a(n)dar gaavan saadh vichaare ||
english: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing; the Saadhus sing in contemplation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan jatee satee sa(n)tokhee gaavahi veer karaare ||
english: The celibates, the fanatics, the peacefully accepting and the fearless warriors sing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਨਿ ਰਖੀਸਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan pa(n)dit paRan rakheesar jug jug vedaa naale ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗਾ ਮਛ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi mohaneeaa man mohan suragaa machh paiaale ||
english: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in this world, in paradise, and in the underworld of the subconscious sing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan ratan upaae tere athasath teerath naale ||
english: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage sing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi jodh mahaabal sooraa gaavahi khaanee chaare ||
english: The brave and mighty warriors sing; the spiritual heroes and the four sources of creation sing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਵਰਭੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi kha(n)d ma(n)dal varabha(n)daa kar kar rakhe dhaare ||
english: The planets, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: seee tudhuno gaavahi jo tudh bhaavan rate tere bhagat rasaale ||
english: They alone sing, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with the Nectar of Your Essence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hor kete gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa veechaare ||
english: So many others sing, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I consider them all?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: soee soee sadaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naaee ||
english: That True Lord is True, Forever True, and True is His Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hai bhee hosee jaai na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaaee ||
english: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He has created departs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)gee ra(n)gee bhaatee kar kar jinasee maaiaa jin upaaee ||
english: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kar kar vekhai keetaa aapanaa jiv tis dee vadiaaee ||
english: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karasee hukam na karanaa jaaee ||
english: He does whatever He pleases. No order can be issued to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: so paatisaahu saahaa paatisaahib naanak rahan rajaaee ||27||
english: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||27||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਦਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)daa sa(n)tokh saram pat jholee dhiaan kee karahi bibhoot ||
english: Make contentment your ear-rings, humility your begging bowl, and meditation the ashes you apply to your body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: khi(n)thaa kaal kuaaree kaaiaa jugat da(n)daa parateet ||
english: Let the remembrance of death be the patched coat you wear, let the purity of virginity be your way in the world, and let faith in the Lord be your walking stick.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਈ ਪੰਥੀ ਸਗਲ ਜਮਾਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਤੈ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: aaee pa(n)thee sagal jamaatee man jeetai jag jeet ||
english: See the brotherhood of all mankind as the highest order of Yogis; conquer your own mind, and conquer the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: aades tisai aades ||
english: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: aad aneel anaad anaahat jug jug eko ves ||28||
english: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||28||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦਇਆ ਭੰਡਾਰਣਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਾਦ ॥
transliteration: bhugat giaan daiaa bha(n)daaran ghat ghat vaajahi naad ||
english: Let spiritual wisdom be your food, and compassion your attendant. The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates in each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਾਦ ॥
transliteration: aap naath naathee sabh jaa kee ridh sidh avaraa saad ||
english: He Himself is the Supreme Master of all; wealth and miraculous spiritual powers, and all other external tastes and pleasures, are all like beads on a string.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਦੁਇ ਕਾਰ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਲੇਖੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਭਾਗ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)jog vijog dui kaar chalaavahi lekhe aavahi bhaag ||
english: Union with Him, and separation from Him, come by His Will. We come to receive what is written in our destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: aades tisai aades ||
english: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: aad aneel anaad anaahat jug jug eko ves ||29||
english: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||29||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਮਾਈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਿਆਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: ekaa maaee jugat viaaee tin chele paravaan ||
english: The One Divine Mother conceived and gave birth to the three deities.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਲਾਏ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: ik sa(n)saaree ik bha(n)daaree ik laae deebaan ||
english: One, the Creator of the World; One, the Sustainer; and One, the Destroyer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਜਿਵ ਹੋਵੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jiv tis bhaavai tivai chalaavai jiv hovai phuramaan ||
english: He makes things happen according to the Pleasure of His Will. Such is His Celestial Order.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਓਨਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: ohu vekhai onaa nadar na aavai bahutaa ehu vidaan ||
english: He watches over all, but none see Him. How wonderful this is!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: aades tisai aades ||
english: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: aad aneel anaad anaahat jug jug eko ves ||30||
english: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||30||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਣੁ ਲੋਇ ਲੋਇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aasan loi loi bha(n)daar ||
english: On world after world are His Seats of Authority and His Storehouses.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh paaiaa s ekaa vaar ||
english: Whatever was put into them, was put there once and for all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kar kar vekhai sirajanahaar ||
english: Having created the creation, the Creator Lord watches over it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naanak sache kee saachee kaar ||
english: O Nanak, True is the Creation of the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: aades tisai aades ||
english: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: aad aneel anaad anaahat jug jug eko ves ||31||
english: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||31||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਜੀਭੌ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਲਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਲਖ ਵੀਸ ॥
transliteration: ik doo jeebhau lakh hohi lakh hovahi lakh vees ||
english: If I had 100,000 tongues, and these were then multiplied twenty times more, with each tongue,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖੁ ਲਖੁ ਗੇੜਾ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
transliteration: lakh lakh geRaa aakheeahi ek naam jagadees ||
english: I would repeat, hundreds of thousands of times, the Name of the One, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੜੀਆ ਚੜੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਇਕੀਸ ॥
transliteration: et raahi pat pavaReeaa chaReeai hoi ikees ||
english: Along this path to our Husband Lord, we climb the steps of the ladder, and come to merge with Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਆਕਾਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਟਾ ਆਈ ਰੀਸ ॥
transliteration: sun galaa aakaas kee keetaa aaee rees ||
english: Hearing of the etheric realms, even worms long to come back home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੈ ਠੀਸ ॥੩੨॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai kooRee kooRai thees ||32||
english: O Nanak, by His Grace He is obtained. False are the boastings of the false. ||32||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਚੁਪੈ ਨਹ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aakhan jor chupai nah jor ||
english: No power to speak, no power to keep silent.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਦੇਣਿ ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jor na ma(n)gan den na jor ||
english: No power to beg, no power to give.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਨਹ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jor na jeevan maran nah jor ||
english: No power to live, no power to die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਜਿ ਮਾਲਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jor na raaj maal man sor ||
english: No power to rule, with wealth and occult mental powers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jor na suratee giaan veechaar ||
english: No power to gain intuitive understanding, spiritual wisdom and meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਜੁਗਤੀ ਛੁਟੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jor na jugatee chhutai sa(n)saar ||
english: No power to find the way to escape from the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis hath jor kar vekhai soi ||
english: He alone has the Power in His Hands. He watches over all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੩॥
transliteration: naanak utam neech na koi ||33||
english: O Nanak, no one is high or low. ||33||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੀ ਰੁਤੀ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: raatee rutee thitee vaar ||
english: Nights, days, weeks and seasons;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: pavan paanee aganee paataal ||
english: wind, water, fire and the nether regions

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਥਾਪਿ ਰਖੀ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ॥
transliteration: tis vich dharatee thaap rakhee dharam saal ||
english: in the midst of these, He established the earth as a home for Dharma.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: tis vich jee jugat ke ra(n)g ||
english: Upon it, He placed the various species of beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
transliteration: tin ke naam anek ana(n)t ||
english: Their names are uncounted and endless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: karamee karamee hoi veechaar ||
english: By their deeds and their actions, they shall be judged.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਚਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sachaa aap sachaa darabaar ||
english: God Himself is True, and True is His Court.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: tithai sohan pa(n)ch paravaan ||
english: There, in perfect grace and ease, sit the self-elect, the self-realized Saints.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: nadaree karam pavai neesaan ||
english: They receive the Mark of Grace from the Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਚ ਪਕਾਈ ਓਥੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kach pakaaee othai paai ||
english: The ripe and the unripe, the good and the bad, shall there be judged.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩੪॥
transliteration: naanak gaiaa jaapai jaai ||34||
english: O Nanak, when you go home, you will see this. ||34||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਖੰਡ ਕਾ ਏਹੋ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: dharam kha(n)d kaa eho dharam ||
english: This is righteous living in the realm of Dharma.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੰਡ ਕਾ ਆਖਹੁ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: giaan kha(n)d kaa aakhahu karam ||
english: And now we speak of the realm of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਪਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਵੈਸੰਤਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕਾਨ ਮਹੇਸ ॥
transliteration: kete pavan paanee vaisa(n)tar kete kaan mahes ||
english: So many winds, waters and fires; so many Krishnas and Shivas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਬਰਮੇ ਘਾੜਤਿ ਘੜੀਅਹਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇ ਵੇਸ ॥
transliteration: kete barame ghaaRat ghaReeahi roop ra(n)g ke ves ||
english: So many Brahmas, fashioning forms of great beauty, adorned and dressed in many colors.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮੀ ਮੇਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਧੂ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
transliteration: keteeaa karam bhoomee mer kete kete dhoo upades ||
english: So many worlds and lands for working out karma. So very many lessons to be learned!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਡਲ ਦੇਸ ॥
transliteration: kete i(n)d cha(n)d soor kete kete ma(n)dal des ||
english: So many Indras, so many moons and suns, so many worlds and lands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਨਾਥ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵੀ ਵੇਸ ॥
transliteration: kete sidh budh naath kete kete devee ves ||
english: So many Siddhas and Buddhas, so many Yogic masters. So many goddesses of various kinds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਰਤਨ ਸਮੁੰਦ ॥
transliteration: kete dev daanav mun kete kete ratan samu(n)d ||
english: So many demi-gods and demons, so many silent sages. So many oceans of jewels.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ਕੇਤੀਆ ਬਾਣੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਾਤ ਨਰਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: keteeaa khaanee keteeaa baanee kete paat nari(n)d ||
english: So many ways of life, so many languages. So many dynasties of rulers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੇਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥੩੫॥
transliteration: keteeaa suratee sevak kete naanak a(n)t na a(n)t ||35||
english: So many intuitive people, so many selfless servants. O Nanak, His limit has no limit! ||35||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਚੰਡੁ ॥
transliteration: giaan kha(n)d mahi giaan paracha(n)d ||
english: In the realm of wisdom, spiritual wisdom reigns supreme.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਨਾਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕੋਡ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: tithai naad binod kod ana(n)d ||
english: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, amidst the sounds and the sights of bliss.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਮ ਖੰਡ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: saram kha(n)d kee baanee roop ||
english: In the realm of humility, the Word is Beauty.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਘਾੜਤਿ ਘੜੀਐ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: tithai ghaaRat ghaReeai bahut anoop ||
english: Forms of incomparable beauty are fashioned there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀਆ ਗਲਾ ਕਥੀਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: taa keeaa galaa katheeaa naa jaahi ||
english: These things cannot be described.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je ko kahai pichhai pachhutaai ||
english: One who tries to speak of these shall regret the attempt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
transliteration: tithai ghaReeai surat mat man budh ||
english: The intuitive consciousness, intellect and understanding of the mind are shaped there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਾ ਸਿਧਾ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥੩੬॥
transliteration: tithai ghaReeai suraa sidhaa kee sudh ||36||
english: The consciousness of the spiritual warriors and the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, are shaped there. ||36||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਖੰਡ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: karam kha(n)d kee baanee jor ||
english: In the realm of karma, the Word is Power.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tithai hor na koee hor ||
english: No one else dwells there,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰ ॥
transliteration: tithai jodh mahaabal soor ||
english: except the warriors of great power, the spiritual heroes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰ ॥
transliteration: tin mahi raam rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: They are totally fulfilled, imbued with the Lord's Essence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਸੀਤੋ ਸੀਤਾ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tithai seeto seetaa mahimaa maahi ||
english: Myriads of Sitas are there, cool and calm in their majestic glory.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਕਥਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: taa ke roop na kathane jaahi ||
english: Their beauty cannot be described.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਠਾਗੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naa ohi marahi na thaage jaahi ||
english: Neither death nor deception comes to those,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jin kai raam vasai man maahi ||
english: within whose minds the Lord abides.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਭਗਤ ਵਸਹਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਅ ॥
transliteration: tithai bhagat vasahi ke lo ||
english: The devotees of many worlds dwell there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: karahi ana(n)d sachaa man soi ||
english: They celebrate; their minds are imbued with the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਖੰਡਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sach kha(n)d vasai nira(n)kaar ||
english: In the realm of Truth, the Formless Lord abides.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kar kar vekhai nadar nihaal ||
english: Having created the creation, He watches over it. By His Glance of Grace, He bestows happiness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਵਰਭੰਡ ॥
transliteration: tithai kha(n)d ma(n)dal varabha(n)d ||
english: There are planets, solar systems and galaxies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਥੈ ਤ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤ ॥
transliteration: je ko kathai ta a(n)t na a(n)t ||
english: If one speaks of them, there is no limit, no end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਲੋਅ ਲੋਅ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tithai lo lo aakaar ||
english: There are worlds upon worlds of His Creation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਵ ਜਿਵ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਵ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jiv jiv hukam tivai tiv kaar ||
english: As He commands, so they exist.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: vekhai vigasai kar veechaar ||
english: He watches over all, and contemplating the creation, He rejoices.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਥਨਾ ਕਰੜਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੩੭॥
transliteration: naanak kathanaa karaRaa saar ||37||
english: O Nanak, to describe this is as hard as steel! ||37||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਪਾਹਾਰਾ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਸੁਨਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jat paahaaraa dheeraj suniaar ||
english: Let self-control be the furnace, and patience the goldsmith.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਰਣਿ ਮਤਿ ਵੇਦੁ ਹਥੀਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aharan mat ved hatheeaar ||
english: Let understanding be the anvil, and spiritual wisdom the tools.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਖਲਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਪ ਤਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhau khalaa agan tap taau ||
english: With the Fear of God as the bellows, fan the flames of tapa, the body's inner heat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਭਾਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਢਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: bhaa(n)daa bhaau a(n)mrit tit dhaal ||
english: In the crucible of love, melt the Nectar of the Name,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘੜੀਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਟਕਸਾਲ ॥
transliteration: ghaReeai sabad sachee takasaal ||
english: and mint the True Coin of the Shabad, the Word of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jin kau nadar karam tin kaar ||
english: Such is the karma of those upon whom He has cast His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੩੮॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree nadar nihaal ||38||
english: O Nanak, the Merciful Lord, by His Grace, uplifts and exalts them. ||38||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਵਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
transliteration: pavan guroo paanee pitaa maataa dharat mahat ||
english: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਵਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
transliteration: divas raat dui daaee daaiaa khelai sagal jagat ||
english: Day and night are the two nurses, in whose lap all the world is at play.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਵਾਚੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)giaaeeaa buriaaeeaa vaachai dharam hadoor ||
english: Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord of Dharma.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: karamee aapo aapanee ke neRai ke door ||
english: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਏ ਮਸਕਤਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee naam dhiaaiaa gae masakat ghaal ||
english: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed after having worked by the sweat of their brows

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਕੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak te mukh ujale ketee chhutee naal ||1||
english: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many are saved along with them! ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: so dar raag aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: So Dar ~ That Door. Raag Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: so dar teraa kehaa so ghar kehaa jit bahi sarab samaale ||
english: Where is That Door of Yours, and where is That Home, in which You sit and take care of all?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: vaaje tere naad anek asa(n)khaa kete tere vaavanahaare ||
english: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there for You, and countless musicians play all sorts of instruments there for You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kete tere raag paree siu kaheeahi kete tere gaavanahaare ||
english: There are so many Ragas and musical harmonies to You; so many minstrels sing hymns of You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan tudhano pavan paanee baisa(n)tar gaavai raajaa dharam duaare ||
english: Wind, water and fire sing of You. The Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan tudhano chit gupat likh jaanan likh likh dharam beechaare ||
english: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who keep the record of actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who reads this record, sing of You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan tudhano eesar brahamaa devee sohan tere sadaa savaare ||
english: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned by You, sing of You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan tudhano i(n)dr i(n)draasan baithe devatiaa dar naale ||
english: Indra, seated on His Throne, sings of You, with the deities at Your Door.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਾਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan tudhano sidh samaadhee a(n)dar gaavan tudhano saadh beechaare ||
english: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing of You; the Saadhus sing of You in contemplation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan tudhano jatee satee sa(n)tokhee gaavan tudhano veer karaare ||
english: The celibates, the fanatics, and the peacefully accepting sing of You; the fearless warriors sing of You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਨਿ ਰਖੀਸੁਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan tudhano pa(n)dit paRan rakheesur jug jug vedaa naale ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing of You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan tudhano mohaneeaa man mohan surag machh paiaale ||
english: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in paradise, in this world, and in the underworld of the subconscious, sing of You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan tudhano ratan upaae tere athasath teerath naale ||
english: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, sing of You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan tudhano jodh mahaabal sooraa gaavan tudhano khaanee chaare ||
english: The brave and mighty warriors sing of You. The spiritual heroes and the four sources of creation sing of You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan tudhano kha(n)d ma(n)dal brahama(n)daa kar kar rakhe tere dhaare ||
english: The worlds, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing of You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: seee tudhano gaavan jo tudh bhaavan rate tere bhagat rasaale ||
english: They alone sing of You, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with Your Sublime Essence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hor kete tudhano gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa beechaare ||
english: So many others sing of You, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I think of them all?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: soee soee sadaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naaee ||
english: That True Lord is True, forever True, and True is His Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hai bhee hosee jaai na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaaee ||
english: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He has created departs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)gee ra(n)gee bhaatee kar kar jinasee maaiaa jin upaaee ||
english: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kar kar dekhai keetaa aapanaa jiu tis dee vadiaaee ||
english: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karasee phir hukam na karanaa jaaee ||
english: He does whatever He pleases. No one can issue any order to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਤਿਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so paatisaahu saahaa patisaahib naanak rahan rajaaee ||1||
english: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sun vadaa aakhai sabh koi ||
english: Hearing of His Greatness, everyone calls Him Great.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਡੀਠਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kevad vadaa deethaa hoi ||
english: But just how Great His Greatness is-this is known only to those who have seen Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: keemat paai na kahiaa jaai ||
english: His Value cannot be estimated; He cannot be described.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਣੈ ਵਾਲੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahanai vaale tere rahe samaai ||1||
english: Those who describe You, Lord, remain immersed and absorbed in You. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: vade mere saahibaa gahir ga(n)bheeraa gunee gaheeraa ||
english: O my Great Lord and Master of Unfathomable Depth, You are the Ocean of Excellence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਤਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਚੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: koi na jaanai teraa ketaa kevad cheeraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: No one knows the extent or the vastness of Your Expanse. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh suratee mil surat kamaaee ||
english: All the intuitives met and practiced intuitive meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh keemat mil keemat paaee ||
english: All the appraisers met and made the appraisal.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: giaanee dhiaanee gur gurahaaee ||
english: The spiritual teachers, the teachers of meditation, and the teachers of teachers

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahan na jaaee teree til vadiaaee ||2||
english: -they cannot describe even an iota of Your Greatness. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh sat sabh tap sabh cha(n)giaaeeaa ||
english: All Truth, all austere discipline, all goodness,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧਾ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
transliteration: sidhaa purakhaa keeaa vadiaaeeaa ||
english: all the great miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਧੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh vin sidhee kinai na paaeeaa ||
english: without You, no one has attained such powers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਈਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karam milai naahee thaak rahaaeeaa ||3||
english: They are received only by Your Grace. No one can block them or stop their flow. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
