transliteration: aakhan vaalaa kiaa vechaaraa ||
english: What can the poor helpless creatures do?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: siphatee bhare tere bha(n)daaraa ||
english: Your Praises are overflowing with Your Treasures.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis too dehi tisai kiaa chaaraa ||
english: Those, unto whom You give-how can they think of any other?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sach savaaranahaaraa ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, the True One embellishes and exalts. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aakhaa jeevaa visarai mar jaau ||
english: Chanting it, I live; forgetting it, I die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aakhan aukhaa saachaa naau ||
english: It is so difficult to chant the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਭੂਖ ॥
transliteration: saache naam kee laagai bhookh ||
english: If someone feels hunger for the True Name,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਤੁ ਭੂਖੈ ਖਾਇ ਚਲੀਅਹਿ ਦੂਖ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ut bhookhai khaai chaleeahi dookh ||1||
english: that hunger shall consume his pain. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: so kiu visarai meree maai ||
english: How can I forget Him, O my mother?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahib saachai naai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: True is the Master, True is His Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: saache naam kee til vadiaaee ||
english: Trying to describe even an iota of the Greatness of the True Name,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਿ ਥਕੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aakh thake keemat nahee paaee ||
english: people have grown weary, but they have not been able to evaluate it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਆਖਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: je sabh mil kai aakhan paahi ||
english: Even if everyone were to gather together and speak of Him,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vadaa na hovai ghaat na jaai ||2||
english: He would not become any greater or any lesser. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: naa ohu marai na hovai sog ||
english: That Lord does not die; there is no reason to mourn.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: dedaa rahai na chookai bhog ||
english: He continues to give, and His Provisions never run short.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣੁ ਏਹੋ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gun eho hor naahee koi ||
english: This Virtue is His alone; there is no other like Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naa ko hoaa naa ko hoi ||3||
english: There never has been, and there never will be. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਆਪਿ ਤੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jevad aap tevad teree daat ||
english: As Great as You Yourself are, O Lord, so Great are Your Gifts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕੀਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jin din kar kai keetee raat ||
english: The One who created the day also created the night.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਕਮਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: khasam visaarahi te kamajaat ||
english: Those who forget their Lord and Master are vile and despicable.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਨਾਤਿ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naavai baajh sanaat ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, they are wretched outcasts. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag goojaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Raag Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਪੁਰਖਾ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: har ke jan satigur satapurakhaa binau karau gur paas ||
english: O humble servant of the Lord, O True Guru, O True Primal Being: I offer my humble prayer to You, O Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਿਰਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ham keere kiram satigur saranaaee kar daiaa naam paragaas ||1||
english: I am a mere insect, a worm. O True Guru, I seek Your Sanctuary. Please be merciful, and bless me with the Light of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: mere meet guradev mo kau raam naam paragaas ||
english: O my Best Friend, O Divine Guru, please enlighten me with the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਮਰੀ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramat naam meraa praan sakhaaee har keerat hamaree raharaas ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is my breath of life. The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is my life's occupation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: har jan ke vad bhaag vadere jin har har saradhaa har piaas ||
english: The servants of the Lord have the greatest good fortune; they have faith in the Lord, and a longing for the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har har naam milai tripataasahi mil sa(n)gat gun paragaas ||2||
english: Obtaining the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are satisfied; joining the Sangat, the Blessed Congregation, their virtues shine forth. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਜਮ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jin har har har ras naam na paaiaa te bhaagaheen jam paas ||
english: Those who have not obtained the Sublime Essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, are most unfortunate; they are led away by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਏ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵੇ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo satigur saran sa(n)gat nahee aae dhrig jeeve dhrig jeevaas ||3||
english: Those who have not sought the Sanctuary of the True Guru and the Sangat, the Holy Congregation-cursed are their lives, and cursed are their hopes of life. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jin har jan satigur sa(n)gat paaee tin dhur masatak likhiaa likhaas ||
english: Those humble servants of the Lord who have attained the Company of the True Guru, have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed on their foreheads.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n satasa(n)gat jit har ras paaiaa mil jan naanak naam paragaas ||4||4||
english: Blessed, blessed is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the Lord's Essence is obtained. Meeting with His humble servant, O Nanak, the Light of the Naam shines forth. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਜਾ ਆਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kaahe re man chitavahi udam jaa aahar har jeeu pariaa ||
english: Why, O mind, do you plot and plan, when the Dear Lord Himself provides for your care?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੈਲ ਪਥਰ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sail pathar mahi ja(n)t upaae taa kaa rijak aagai kar dhariaa ||1||
english: From rocks and stones He created living beings; He places their nourishment before them. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mere maadhau jee satasa(n)gat mile s tariaa ||
english: O my Dear Lord of souls, one who joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is saved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਹਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paaiaa sooke kaasat hariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is obtained, and the dry wood blossoms forth again in lush greenery. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਨਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: janan pitaa lok sut banitaa koi na kis kee dhariaa ||
english: Mothers, fathers, friends, children and spouses-no one is the support of anyone else.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਭਉ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sir sir rijak sa(n)baahe thaakur kaahe man bhau kariaa ||2||
english: For each and every person, our Lord and Master provides sustenance. Why are you so afraid, O mind? ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਊਡੇ ਊਡਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੈ ਕੋਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਬਚਰੇ ਛਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: oode ood aavai sai kosaa tis paachhai bachare chhariaa ||
english: The flamingoes fly hundreds of miles, leaving their young ones behind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਵਣੁ ਖਲਾਵੈ ਕਵਣੁ ਚੁਗਾਵੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tin kavan khalaavai kavan chugaavai man mahi simaran kariaa ||3||
english: Who feeds them, and who teaches them to feed themselves? Have you ever thought of this in your mind? ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh nidhaan das asat sidhaan thaakur kar tal dhariaa ||
english: All the nine treasures, and the eighteen supernatural powers are held by our Lord and Master in the Palm of His Hand.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak bal bal sad bal jaaeeai teraa a(n)t na paaraavariaa ||4||5||
english: Servant Nanak is devoted, dedicated, forever a sacrifice to You, Lord. Your Expanse has no limit, no boundary. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 4 so purakh ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, So Purakh ~ That Primal Being:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: so purakh nira(n)jan har purakh nira(n)jan har agamaa agam apaaraa ||
english: That Primal Being is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord, the Primal Being, is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord is Inaccessible, Unreachable and Unrivalled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh dhiaavahi sabh dhiaavahi tudh jee har sache sirajanahaaraa ||
english: All meditate, all meditate on You, Dear Lord, O True Creator Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh jee tumaare jee too(n) jeeaa kaa daataaraa ||
english: All living beings are Yours-You are the Giver of all souls.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har dhiaavahu sa(n)tahu jee sabh dookh visaaranahaaraa ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He is the Dispeller of all sorrow.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੀ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har aape thaakur har aape sevak jee kiaa naanak ja(n)t vichaaraa ||1||
english: The Lord Himself is the Master, the Lord Himself is the Servant. O Nanak, the poor beings are wretched and miserable! ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) ghat ghat a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar jee har eko purakh samaanaa ||
english: You are constant in each and every heart, and in all things. O Dear Lord, you are the One.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ik daate ik bhekhaaree jee sabh tere choj vidaanaa ||
english: Some are givers, and some are beggars. This is all Your Wondrous Play.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਜੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape daataa aape bhugataa jee hau tudh bin avar na jaanaa ||
english: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. I know no other than You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) paarabraham bea(n)t bea(n)t jee tere kiaa gun aakh vakhaanaa ||
english: You are the Supreme Lord God, Limitless and Infinite. What Virtues of Yours can I speak of and describe?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo sevahi jo sevahi tudh jee jan naanak tin kurabaanaa ||2||
english: Unto those who serve You, unto those who serve You, Dear Lord, servant Nanak is a sacrifice. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: har dhiaavahi har dhiaavahi tudh jee se jan jug mahi sukhavaasee ||
english: Those who meditate on You, Lord, those who meditate on You-those humble beings dwell in peace in this world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀ ਤਿਨ ਤੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: se mukat se mukat bhae jin har dhiaaiaa jee tin tootee jam kee phaasee ||
english: They are liberated, they are liberated-those who meditate on the Lord. For them, the noose of death is cut away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jin nirabhau jin har nirabhau dhiaaiaa jee tin kaa bhau sabh gavaasee ||
english: Those who meditate on the Fearless One, on the Fearless Lord-all their fears are dispelled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਸਮਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jin seviaa jin seviaa meraa har jee te har har roop samaasee ||
english: Those who serve, those who serve my Dear Lord, are absorbed into the Being of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: se dha(n)n se dha(n)n jin har dhiaaiaa jee jan naanak tin bal jaasee ||3||
english: Blessed are they, blessed are they, who meditate on their Dear Lord. Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਜੀ ਭਰੇ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: teree bhagat teree bhagat bha(n)daar jee bhare bia(n)t bea(n)taa ||
english: Devotion to You, devotion to You, is a treasure overflowing, infinite and beyond measure.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tere bhagat tere bhagat salaahan tudh jee har anik anek ana(n)taa ||
english: Your devotees, Your devotees praise You, Dear Lord, in many and various and countless ways.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: teree anik teree anik karahi har poojaa jee tap taapahi japahi bea(n)taa ||
english: For You, many, for You, so very many perform worship services, O Dear Infinite Lord; they practice disciplined meditation and chant endlessly.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਪੜਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tere anek tere anek paRahi bahu simrit saasat jee kar kiriaa khat karam kara(n)taa ||
english: For You, many, for You, so very many read the various Simritees and Shaastras. They perform rituals and religious rites.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਭਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: se bhagat se bhagat bhale jan naanak jee jo bhaavahi mere har bhagava(n)taa ||4||
english: Those devotees, those devotees are sublime, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing to my Dear Lord God. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aad purakh apara(n)par karataa jee tudh jevad avar na koee ||
english: You are the Primal Being, the Most Wonderful Creator. There is no other as Great as You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) jug jug eko sadaa sadaa too(n) eko jee too(n) nihachal karataa soee ||
english: Age after age, You are the One. Forever and ever, You are the One. You never change, O Creator Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape bhaavai soee varatai jee too(n) aape karahi s hoee ||
english: Everything happens according to Your Will. You Yourself accomplish all that occurs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape srisat sabh upaaee jee tudh aape siraj sabh goee ||
english: You Yourself created the entire universe, and having fashioned it, You Yourself shall destroy it all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੋਈ ॥੫॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak gun gaavai karate ke jee jo sabhasai kaa jaanoee ||5||1||
english: Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Dear Creator, the Knower of all. ||5||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) karataa sachiaar maidaa saa(n)ee ||
english: You are the True Creator, my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥੀਸੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo tau bhaavai soee theesee jo too(n) dehi soee hau paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. As You give, so do we receive. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh teree too(n) sabhanee dhiaaiaa ||
english: All belong to You, all meditate on you.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis no kripaa karahi tin naam ratan paaiaa ||
english: Those who are blessed with Your Mercy obtain the Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਧਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh laadhaa manamukh gavaaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukhs obtain it, and the self-willed manmukhs lose it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tudh aap vichhoRiaa aap milaaiaa ||1||
english: You Yourself separate them from Yourself, and You Yourself reunite with them again. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: too(n) dareeaau sabh tujh hee maahi ||
english: You are the River of Life; all are within You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin doojaa koee naahi ||
english: There is no one except You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh teraa khel ||
english: All living beings are Your playthings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vijog mil vichhuRiaa sa(n)jogee mel ||2||
english: The separated ones meet, and by great good fortune, those suffering in separation are reunited once again. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jis no too jaanaaihi soee jan jaanai ||
english: They alone understand, whom You inspire to understand;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: har gun sad hee aakh vakhaanai ||
english: they continually chant and repeat the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin har seviaa tin sukh paaiaa ||
english: Those who serve You find peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sahaje hee har naam samaaiaa ||3||
english: They are intuitively absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: too aape karataa teraa keeaa sabh hoi ||
english: You Yourself are the Creator. Everything that happens is by Your Doing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tudh bin doojaa avar na koi ||
english: There is no one except You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: too kar kar vekhahi jaanahi soi ||
english: You created the creation; You behold it and understand it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak guramukh paragat hoi ||4||2||
english: O servant Nanak, the Lord is revealed through the Gurmukh, the Living Expression of the Guru's Word. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਰਵਰੜੈ ਭਈਲੇ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tit saravaraRai bhaeele nivaasaa paanee paavak tinahi keeaa ||
english: In that pool, people have made their homes, but the water there is as hot as fire!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਕਜੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਡੂਬੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pa(n)kaj moh pag nahee chaalai ham dekhaa tah doobeeale ||1||
english: In the swamp of emotional attachment, their feet cannot move. I have seen them drowning there. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man ek na chetas mooR manaa ||
english: In your mind, you do not remember the One Lord-you fool!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bisarat tere gun galiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You have forgotten the Lord; your virtues shall wither away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naa hau jatee satee nahee paRiaa moorakh mugadhaa janam bhaiaa ||
english: I am not celibate, nor truthful, nor scholarly. I was born foolish and ignorant into this world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak tin kee saranaa jin too naahee veesariaa ||2||3||
english: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who have not forgotten You, O Lord! ||2||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹੁਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaee paraapat maanukh dehureeaa ||
english: This human body has been given to you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d milan kee ih teree bareeaa ||
english: This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: avar kaaj terai kitai na kaam ||
english: Nothing else will work.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਜੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)gat bhaj keval naam ||1||
english: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; vibrate and meditate on the Jewel of the Naam. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰੰਜਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਨ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: sara(n)jaam laag bhavajal taran kai ||
english: Make every effort to cross over this terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam brithaa jaat ra(n)g maaiaa kai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are squandering this life uselessly in the love of Maya. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam dharam na kamaaiaa ||
english: I have not practiced meditation, self-discipline, self-restraint or righteous living.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sevaa saadh na jaaniaa har raaiaa ||
english: I have not served the Holy; I have not acknowledged the Lord, my King.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ham neech kara(n)maa ||
english: Says Nanak, my actions are contemptible!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਮਾ ॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: saran pare kee raakhahu saramaa ||2||4||
english: O Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, preserve my honor! ||2||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਦੀਪਕੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sohilaa raag gauRee deepakee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Sohilaa ~ The Song Of Praise. Raag Gauree Deepakee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: jai ghar keerat aakheeai karate kaa hoi beechaaro ||
english: In that house where the Praises of the Creator are chanted and contemplated

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਿਵਰਿਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tit ghar gaavahu sohilaa sivarihu sirajanahaaro ||1||
english: -in that house, sing Songs of Praise; meditate and remember the Creator Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ॥
transliteration: tum gaavahu mere nirabhau kaa sohilaa ||
english: Sing the Songs of Praise of my Fearless Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jit sohilai sadaa sukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to that Song of Praise which brings eternal peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਦੇਖੈਗਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: nit nit jeeaRe samaaleean dekhaigaa devanahaar ||
english: Day after day, He cares for His beings; the Great Giver watches over all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਤੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tere daanai keemat naa pavai tis daate kavan sumaar ||2||
english: Your Gifts cannot be appraised; how can anyone compare to the Giver? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਬਤਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)bat saahaa likhiaa mil kar paavahu tel ||
english: The day of my wedding is pre-ordained. Come, gather together and pour the oil over the threshold.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਜਣ ਅਸੀਸੜੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dehu sajan aseesaReeaa jiu hovai saahib siu mel ||3||
english: My friends, give me your blessings, that I may merge with my Lord and Master. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹੋ ਪਾਹੁਚਾ ਸਦੜੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: ghar ghar eho paahuchaa sadaRe nit pava(n)n ||
english: Unto each and every home, into each and every heart, this summons is sent out; the call comes each and every day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦਣਹਾਰਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਦਿਹ ਆਵੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: sadanahaaraa simareeai naanak se dih aava(n)n ||4||1||
english: Remember in meditation the One who summons us; O Nanak, that day is drawing near! ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਘਰ ਛਿਅ ਗੁਰ ਛਿਅ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
transliteration: chhi ghar chhi gur chhi upades ||
english: There are six schools of philosophy, six teachers, and six sets of teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur gur eko ves anek ||1||
english: But the Teacher of teachers is the One, who appears in so many forms. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: baabaa jai ghar karate keerat hoi ||
english: O Baba: that system in which the Praises of the Creator are sung

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਤੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: so ghar raakh vadaaee toi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: -follow that system; in it rests true greatness. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸੁਏ ਚਸਿਆ ਘੜੀਆ ਪਹਰਾ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
transliteration: visue chasiaa ghaReeaa paharaa thitee vaaree maahu hoaa ||
english: The seconds, minutes and hours, days, weeks and months,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਵੇਸ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: sooraj eko rut anek || naanak karate ke kete ves ||2||2||
english: And the various seasons originate from the one sun; O Nanak, in just the same way, the many forms originate from the Creator. ||2||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raag Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਗਨ ਮੈ ਥਾਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਕ ਬਨੇ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਨਕ ਮੋਤੀ ॥
transliteration: gagan mai thaal rav cha(n)d deepak bane taarikaa ma(n)dal janak motee ||
english: Upon that cosmic plate of the sky, the sun and the moon are the lamps. The stars and their orbs are the studded pearls.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੂਪੁ ਮਲਆਨਲੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਚਵਰੋ ਕਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬਨਰਾਇ ਫੂਲੰਤ ਜੋਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhoop malaaanalo pavan chavaro kare sagal banaraai phoola(n)t jotee ||1||
english: The fragrance of sandalwood in the air is the temple incense, and the wind is the fan. All the plants of the world are the altar flowers in offering to You, O Luminous Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੈਸੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: kaisee aaratee hoi || bhav kha(n)danaa teree aaratee ||
english: What a beautiful Aartee, lamp-lit worship service this is! O Destroyer of Fear, this is Your Ceremony of Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਤਾ ਸਬਦ ਵਾਜੰਤ ਭੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anahataa sabad vaaja(n)t bheree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad is the vibration of the temple drums. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਨੈਨ ਨਨ ਨੈਨ ਹਹਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਉ ਸਹਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਨਾ ਏਕ ਤੋੁਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sahas tav nain nan nain hahi tohi kau sahas moorat nanaa ek touhee ||
english: You have thousands of eyes, and yet You have no eyes. You have thousands of forms, and yet You do not have even one.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਪਦ ਬਿਮਲ ਨਨ ਏਕ ਪਦ ਗੰਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਗੰਧ ਇਵ ਚਲਤ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sahas pad bimal nan ek pad ga(n)dh bin sahas tav ga(n)dh iv chalat mohee ||2||
english: You have thousands of Lotus Feet, and yet You do not have even one foot. You have no nose, but you have thousands of noses. This Play of Yours entrances me. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi jot jot hai soi ||
english: Amongst all is the Light-You are that Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis dai chaanan sabh mahi chaanan hoi ||
english: By this Illumination, that Light is radiant within all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur saakhee jot paragat hoi ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Light shines forth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai s aaratee hoi ||3||
english: That which is pleasing to Him is the lamp-lit worship service. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਲੋਭਿਤ ਮਨੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੋੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਹੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: har charan kaval makara(n)d lobhit mano anadinou mohi aahee piaasaa ||
english: My mind is enticed by the honey-sweet Lotus Feet of the Lord. Day and night, I thirst for them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: kripaa jal dehi naanak saari(n)g kau hoi jaa te terai naai vaasaa ||4||3||
english: Bestow the Water of Your Mercy upon Nanak, the thirsty song-bird, so that he may come to dwell in Your Name. ||4||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: kaam karodh nagar bahu bhariaa mil saadhoo kha(n)dal kha(n)daa he ||
english: The body-village is filled to overflowing with anger and sexual desire; these were broken into bits when I met with the Holy Saint.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poorab likhat likhe gur paaiaa man har liv ma(n)dal ma(n)daa he ||1||
english: By pre-ordained destiny, I have met with the Guru. I have entered into the realm of the Lord's Love. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: kar saadhoo a(n)julee pun vadaa he ||
english: Greet the Holy Saint with your palms pressed together; this is an act of great merit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar da(n)daut pun vadaa he ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Bow down before Him; this is a virtuous action indeed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: saakat har ras saad na jaaniaa tin a(n)tar haumai ka(n)daa he ||
english: The wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not know the Taste of the Lord's Sublime Essence. The thorn of egotism is embedded deep within them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu jiu chalahi chubhai dukh paavahi jamakaal sahahi sir da(n)daa he ||2||
english: The more they walk away, the deeper it pierces them, and the more they suffer in pain, until finally, the Messenger of Death smashes his club against their heads. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: har jan har har naam samaane dukh janam maran bhav kha(n)daa he ||
english: The humble servants of the Lord are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The pain of birth and the fear of death are eradicated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: abinaasee purakh paaiaa paramesar bahu sobh kha(n)d brahama(n)daa he ||3||
english: They have found the Imperishable Supreme Being, the Transcendent Lord God, and they receive great honor throughout all the worlds and realms. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: ham gareeb masakeen prabh tere har raakh raakh vad vadaa he ||
english: I am poor and meek, God, but I belong to You! Save me-please save me, O Greatest of the Great!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam adhaar tek hai har naame hee sukh ma(n)daa he ||4||4||
english: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee poorabee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: karau bena(n)tee sunahu mere meetaa sa(n)t tahal kee belaa ||
english: Listen, my friends, I beg of you: now is the time to serve the Saints!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਆਗੈ ਬਸਨੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: eehaa khaat chalahu har laahaa aagai basan suhelaa ||1||
english: In this world, earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and hereafter, you shall dwell in peace. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: audh ghatai dinas rainaare ||
english: This life is diminishing, day and night.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man gur mil kaaj savaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਸੰਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ihu sa(n)saar bikaar sa(n)se mahi tario braham giaanee ||
english: This world is engrossed in corruption and cynicism. Only those who know God are saved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਪੀਆਵੈ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jisahi jagaai peeaavai ihu ras akath kathaa tin jaanee ||2||
english: Only those who are awakened by the Lord to drink in this Sublime Essence, come to know the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਏ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਹਾਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau aae soee bihaajhahu har gur te manahi baseraa ||
english: Purchase only that for which you have come into the world, and through the Guru, the Lord shall dwell within your mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nij ghar mahal paavahu sukh sahaje bahur na hoigo pheraa ||3||
english: Within the home of your own inner being, you shall obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence with intuitive ease. You shall not be consigned again to the wheel of reincarnation. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee purakh bidhaate saradhaa man kee poore ||
english: O Inner-knower, Searcher of Hearts, O Primal Being, Architect of Destiny: please fulfill this yearning of my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak daas ihai sukh maagai mo kau kar sa(n)tan kee dhoore ||4||5||
english: Nanak, Your slave, begs for this happiness: let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag sireeraag mahalaa pahilaa 1 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Siree Raag, First Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਤੀ ਤ ਮੰਦਰ ਊਸਰਹਿ ਰਤਨੀ ਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: motee ta ma(n)dar oosarahi ratanee ta hohi jaRaau ||
english: If I had a palace made of pearls, inlaid with jewels,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਸਤੂਰਿ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਅਗਰਿ ਚੰਦਨਿ ਲੀਪਿ ਆਵੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kasatoor ku(n)goo agar cha(n)dan leep aavai chaau ||
english: scented with musk, saffron and sandalwood, a sheer delight to behold

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mat dekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau ||1||
english: -seeing this, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bin jeeu jal bal jaau ||
english: Without the Lord, my soul is scorched and burnt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mai aapanaa gur poochh dekhiaa avar naahee thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I consulted my Guru, and now I see that there is no other place at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਤ ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਤੀ ਪਲਘਿ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dharatee ta heere laal jaRatee palagh laal jaRaau ||
english: If the floor of this palace was a mosaic of diamonds and rubies, and if my bed was encased with rubies,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਣੀ ਸੋਹੈ ਕਰੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mohanee mukh manee sohai kare ra(n)g pasaau ||
english: and if heavenly beauties, their faces adorned with emeralds, tried to entice me with sensual gestures of love

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mat dekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau ||2||
english: -seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਲਾਈ ਰਿਧਿ ਆਖਾ ਆਉ ॥
transliteration: sidh hovaa sidh laaee ridh aakhaa aau ||
english: If I were to become a Siddha, and work miracles, summon wealth

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਸਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gupat paragat hoi baisaa lok raakhai bhaau ||
english: and become invisible and visible at will, so that people would hold me in awe

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mat dekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau ||3||
english: -seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਸਕਰ ਤਖਤਿ ਰਾਖਾ ਪਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sulataan hovaa mel lasakar takhat raakhaa paau ||
english: If I were to become an emperor and raise a huge army, and sit on a throne,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹਾਸਲੁ ਕਰੀ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਭ ਵਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hukam haasal karee baithaa naanakaa sabh vaau ||
english: issuing commands and collecting taxes-O Nanak, all of this could pass away like a puff of wind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: mat dekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau ||4||1||
english: Seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਪਵਣੁ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਅਪਿਆਉ ॥
transliteration: kot kotee meree aarajaa pavan peean apiaau ||
english: If I could live for millions and millions of years, and if the air was my food and drink,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਗੁਫੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸਉਣ ਨ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)d sooraj dui guphai na dekhaa supanai saun na thaau ||
english: and if I lived in a cave and never saw either the sun or the moon, and if I never slept, even in dreams

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevad aakhaa naau ||1||
english: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saachaa nira(n)kaar nij thaai ||
english: The True Lord, the Formless One, is Himself in His Own Place.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਣਾ ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sun sun aakhan aakhanaa je bhaavai kare tamaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have heard, over and over again, and so I tell the tale; as it pleases You, Lord, please instill within me the yearning for You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਸਾ ਕਟੀਆ ਵਾਰ ਵਾਰ ਪੀਸਣਿ ਪੀਸਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kusaa kateeaa vaar vaar peesan peesaa paai ||
english: If I was slashed and cut into pieces, over and over again, and put into the mill and ground into flour,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਲੀਆ ਭਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: agee setee jaaleeaa bhasam setee ral jaau ||
english: burnt by fire and mixed with ashes

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevad aakhaa naau ||2||
english: -even then, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜੇ ਭਵਾ ਸੈ ਅਸਮਾਨੀ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)khee hoi kai je bhavaa sai asamaanee jaau ||
english: If I was a bird, soaring and flying through hundreds of heavens,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਵਊ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੀਆ ਨ ਖਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nadaree kisai na aavaoo naa kichh peeaa na khaau ||
english: and if I was invisible, neither eating nor drinking anything

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevad aakhaa naau ||3||
english: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਗਦ ਲਖ ਮਣਾ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naanak kaagad lakh manaa paR paR keechai bhaau ||
english: O Nanak, if I had hundreds of thousands of stacks of paper, and if I were to read and recite and embrace love for the Lord,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਸੂ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਚਲਾਉ ॥
transliteration: masoo tot na aavaee lekhan paun chalaau ||
english: and if ink were never to fail me, and if my pen were able to move like the wind

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevad aakhaa naau ||4||2||
english: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਲੇਖੈ ਖਾਣਾ ਖਾਉ ॥
transliteration: lekhai bolan bolanaa lekhai khaanaa khaau ||
english: As it is pre-ordained, people speak their words. As it is pre-ordained, they consume their food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਵਾਟ ਚਲਾਈਆ ਲੇਖੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖਾਉ ॥
transliteration: lekhai vaat chalaaeeaa lekhai sun vekhaau ||
english: As it is pre-ordained, they walk along the way. As it is pre-ordained, they see and hear.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਹ ਲਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਪੜੇ ਕਿ ਪੁਛਣ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lekhai saah lavaaeeahi paRe k puchhan jaau ||1||
english: As it is pre-ordained, they draw their breath. Why should I go and ask the scholars about this? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਚਨਾ ਧੋਹੁ ॥
transliteration: baabaa maaiaa rachanaa dhohu ||
english: O Baba, the splendor of Maya is deceptive.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਏਹ ਨ ਓਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhai naam visaariaa naa tis eh na ohu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The blind man has forgotten the Name; he is in limbo, neither here nor there. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਏਥੈ ਖਾਜੈ ਕਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jeevan maranaa jaai kai ethai khaajai kaal ||
english: Life and death come to all who are born. Everything here gets devoured by Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਚਲਿਓ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jithai bahi samajhaaeeai tithai koi na chalio naal ||
english: He sits and examines the accounts, there where no one goes along with anyone.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਨਹਿ ਪੰਡ ਪਰਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: rovan vaale jetaRe sabh ba(n)nahi pa(n)d paraal ||2||
english: Those who weep and wail might just as well all tie bundles of straw. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਨ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko aakhai bahut bahut ghat na aakhai koi ||
english: Everyone says that God is the Greatest of the Great. No one calls Him any less.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: keemat kinai na paaeeaa kahan na vadaa hoi ||
english: No one can estimate His Worth. By speaking of Him, His Greatness is not increased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਰਿ ਜੀਆ ਕੇਤੇ ਲੋਅ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saachaa saahab ek too hor jeeaa kete lo ||3||
english: You are the One True Lord and Master of all the other beings, of so many worlds. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੀਚਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਨੀਚੀ ਹੂ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਚੁ ॥
transliteration: neechaa a(n)dar neech jaat neechee hoo at neech ||
english: Nanak seeks the company of the lowest of the low class, the very lowest of the low.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਵਡਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਰੀਸ ॥
transliteration: naanak tin kai sa(n)g saath vadiaa siu kiaa rees ||
english: Why should he try to compete with the great?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਨੀਚ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਤਿਥੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: jithai neech samaaleean tithai nadar teree bakhasees ||4||3||
english: In that place where the lowly are cared for-there, the Blessings of Your Glance of Grace rain down. ||4||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਕੁਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਚੂਹੜਾ ਠਗਿ ਖਾਧਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: lab kutaa kooR choohaRaa thag khaadhaa muradaar ||
english: Greed is a dog; falsehood is a filthy street-sweeper. Cheating is eating a rotting carcass.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰ ਮਲੁ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਧੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: par ni(n)daa par mal mukh sudhee agan krodh cha(n)daal ||
english: Slandering others is putting the filth of others into your own mouth. The fire of anger is the outcaste who burns dead bodies at the crematorium.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਆਪੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਏ ਕਰਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ras kas aap salaahanaa e karam mere karataar ||1||
english: I am caught in these tastes and flavors, and in self-conceited praise. These are my actions, O my Creator! ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: baabaa boleeai pat hoi ||
english: O Baba, speak only that which will bring you honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨੀਚ ਕਰਮ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ootam se dar ootam kaheeahi neech karam bahi roi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They alone are good, who are judged good at the Lord's Door. Those with bad karma can only sit and weep. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਰੁਪਾ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਰਮਲ ਕੀ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: ras suinaa ras rupaa kaaman ras paramal kee vaas ||
english: The pleasures of gold and silver, the pleasures of women, the pleasure of the fragrance of sandalwood,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਰਸੁ ਸੇਜਾ ਮੰਦਰ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਸੁ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: ras ghoRe ras sejaa ma(n)dar ras meethaa ras maas ||
english: the pleasure of horses, the pleasure of a soft bed in a palace, the pleasure of sweet treats and the pleasure of hearty meals

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਰਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਕੇ ਕੈ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ete ras sareer ke kai ghat naam nivaas ||2||
english: -these pleasures of the human body are so numerous; how can the Naam, the Name of the Lord, find its dwelling in the heart? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਬੋਲਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jit boliai pat paaeeai so boliaa paravaan ||
english: Those words are acceptable, which, when spoken, bring honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਿ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਅਜਾਣ ॥
transliteration: phikaa bol viguchanaa sun moorakh man ajaan ||
english: Harsh words bring only grief. Listen, O foolish and ignorant mind!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਿ ਕਹਣ ਵਖਾਣ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavahi se bhale hor k kahan vakhaan ||3||
english: Those who are pleasing to Him are good. What else is there to be said? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tin mat tin pat tin dhan palai jin hiradai rahiaa samaai ||
english: Wisdom, honor and wealth are in the laps of those whose hearts remain permeated with the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਅਵਰ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tin kaa kiaa saalaahanaa avar suaaliu kaai ||
english: What praise can be offered to them? What other adornments can be bestowed upon them?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਦਾਨਿ ਨ ਨਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree baahare raachahi daan na naai ||4||4||
english: O Nanak, those who lack the Lord's Glance of Grace cherish neither charity nor the Lord's Name. ||4||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮਲੁ ਗਲੋਲਾ ਕੂੜ ਕਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: amal galolaa kooR kaa ditaa devanahaar ||
english: The Great Giver has given the intoxicating drug of falsehood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤੀ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਖੁਸੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: matee maran visaariaa khusee keetee din chaar ||
english: The people are intoxicated; they have forgotten death, and they have fun for a few days.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸੋਫੀਆ ਰਾਖਣ ਕਉ ਦਰਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sach miliaa tin sopheeaa raakhan kau daravaar ||1||
english: Those who do not use intoxicants are true; they dwell in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak saache kau sach jaan ||
english: O Nanak, know the True Lord as True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit seviai sukh paaeeai teree daragah chalai maan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Serving Him, peace is obtained; you shall go to His Court with honor. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਰਾ ਗੁੜ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sach saraa guR baaharaa jis vich sachaa naau ||
english: The Wine of Truth is not fermented from molasses. The True Name is contained within it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਹਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sunahi vakhaanahi jetaRe hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who hear and chant the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਖੀਵਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa man kheevaa jaaneeai jaa mahalee paae thaau ||2||
english: Only one who obtains a room in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is deemed to be truly intoxicated. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਨੀਰੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਸਤੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਤਨਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: naau neer cha(n)giaaeeaa sat paramal tan vaas ||
english: Bathe in the waters of Goodness and apply the scented oil of Truth to your body,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਜਲਾ ਲਖ ਦਾਤੀ ਇਕ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: taa mukh hovai ujalaa lakh daatee ik daat ||
english: and your face shall become radiant. This is the gift of 100,000 gifts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਹਿ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਜਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dookh tisai pahi aakheeahi sookh jisai hee paas ||3||
english: Tell your troubles to the One who is the Source of all comfort. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ॥
transliteration: so kiu manahu visaareeai jaa ke jee paraan ||
english: How can you forget the One who created your soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: tis vin sabh apavitr hai jetaa painan khaan ||
english: Without Him, all that we wear and eat is impure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿ ਗਲਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: hor galaa(n) sabh kooReeaa tudh bhaavai paravaan ||4||5||
english: Everything else is false. Whatever pleases Your Will is acceptable. ||4||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahal 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਲਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਘਸਿ ਮਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਤਿ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jaal mohu ghas mas kar mat kaagad kar saar ||
english: Burn emotional attachment, and grind it into ink. Transform your intelligence into the purest of paper.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਕਲਮ ਕਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhaau kalam kar chit lekhaaree gur puchh likh beechaar ||
english: Make the love of the Lord your pen, and let your consciousness be the scribe. Then, seek the Guru's Instructions, and record these deliberations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਲਿਖੁ ਲਿਖੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: likh naam saalaah likh likh a(n)t na paaraavaar ||1||
english: Write the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; write over and over again that He has no end or limitation. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਏਹੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: baabaa ehu lekhaa likh jaan ||
english: O Baba, write such an account,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeai tithai hoi sachaa neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: that when it is asked for, it will bring the Mark of Truth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਸਦ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਸਦ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jithai milahi vadiaaeeaa sad khuseeaa sad chaau ||
english: There, where greatness, eternal peace and everlasting joy are bestowed,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਟਿਕੇ ਨਿਕਲਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tin mukh tike nikalahi jin man sachaa naau ||
english: the faces of those whose minds are attuned to the True Name are anointed with the Mark of Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਲੀ ਵਾਉ ਦੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karam milai taa paaeeai naahee galee vaau duaau ||2||
english: If one receives God's Grace, then such honors are received, and not by mere words. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਵ ਸਲਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ik aavahi ik jaahi uth rakheeahi naav salaar ||
english: Some come, and some arise and depart. They give themselves lofty names.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਵਡੇ ਦਰਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ik upaae ma(n)gate ikanaa vade daravaar ||
english: Some are born beggars, and some hold vast courts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: agai gaiaa jaaneeai vin naavai vekaar ||3||
english: Going to the world hereafter, everyone shall realize that without the Name, it is all useless. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਛਿਜੈ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: bhai terai dar agalaa khap khap chhijai deh ||
english: I am terrified by the Fear of You, God. Bothered and bewildered, my body is wasting away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵ ਜਿਨਾ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਹੋਦੇ ਡਿਠੇ ਖੇਹ ॥
transliteration: naav jinaa sulataan khaan hode dithe kheh ||
english: Those who are known as sultans and emperors shall be reduced to dust in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੇ ਤੁਟੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak uthee chaliaa sabh kooRe tute neh ||4||6||
english: O Nanak, arising and departing, all false attachments are cut away. ||4||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਮਿਠੇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਾਲੋਣੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh ras mithe ma(n)niai suniai saalone ||
english: Believing, all tastes are sweet. Hearing, the salty flavors are tasted;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਟ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਮਾਰਣ ਨਾਦ ਕੀਏ ॥
transliteration: khat turasee mukh bolanaa maaran naad keee ||
english: chanting with one's mouth, the spicy flavors are savored. All these spices have been made from the Sound-current of the Naad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਉ ਏਕੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chhateeh a(n)mrit bhaau ek jaa kau nadar karei ||1||
english: The thirty-six flavors of ambrosial nectar are in the Love of the One Lord; they are tasted only by one who is blessed by His Glance of Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: baabaa hor khaanaa khusee khuaar ||
english: O Baba, the pleasures of other foods are false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit khaadhai tan peeReeai man mahi chalahi vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Eating them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਸੁਪੇਦੀ ਸਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: rataa painan man rataa supedee sat daan ||
english: My mind is imbued with the Lord's Love; it is dyed a deep crimson. Truth and charity are my white clothes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੀਲੀ ਸਿਆਹੀ ਕਦਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਹਿਰਣੁ ਪੈਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: neelee siaahee kadaa karanee pahiran pair dhiaan ||
english: Erasing the blackness of sin is my wearing of blue clothes, and meditation on the Lord's Lotus Feet is my robe of honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਮਰਬੰਦੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kamaraba(n)d sa(n)tokh kaa dhan joban teraa naam ||2||
english: Contentment is my cummerbund, Your Name is my wealth and youth. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: baabaa hor painan khusee khuaar ||
english: O Baba, the pleasures of other clothes are false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit paidhai tan peeReeai man mahi chalahi vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Wearing them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘੋੜੇ ਪਾਖਰ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਸਾਖਤਿ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਾਟ ॥
transliteration: ghoRe paakhar suine saakhat boojhan teree vaat ||
english: The understanding of Your Way, Lord, is horses, saddles and bags of gold for me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਰਕਸ ਤੀਰ ਕਮਾਣ ਸਾਂਗ ਤੇਗਬੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
transliteration: tarakas teer kamaan saa(n)g tegaba(n)d gun dhaat ||
english: The pursuit of virtue is my bow and arrow, my quiver, sword and scabbard.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਜਾ ਨੇਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vaajaa nejaa pat siu paragat karam teraa meree jaat ||3||
english: To be distinguished with honor is my drum and banner. Your Mercy is my social status. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਚੜਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: baabaa hor chaRanaa khusee khuaar ||
english: O Baba, the pleasures of other rides are false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਚੜਿਐ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit chaRiai tan peeReeai man mahi chalahi vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By such rides, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਖੁਸੀ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ghar ma(n)dar khusee naam kee nadar teree paravaar ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the pleasure of houses and mansions. Your Glance of Grace is my family, Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਆਖਣੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hukam soee tudh bhaavasee hor aakhan bahut apaar ||
english: The Hukam of Your Command is the pleasure of Your Will, Lord. To say anything else is far beyond anyone's reach.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak sachaa paatisaahu poochh na kare beechaar ||4||
english: O Nanak, the True King does not seek advice from anyone else in His decisions. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਉਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: baabaa hor saunaa khusee khuaar ||
english: O Baba, the pleasure of other sleep is false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਤੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: jit sutai tan peeReeai man mahi chalahi vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||4||7||
english: By such sleep, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||4||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਗੂ ਕੀ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਲਲਿਤਾ ਅਗਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: ku(n)goo kee kaa(n)iaa ratanaa kee lalitaa agar vaas tan saas ||
english: With the body of saffron, and the tongue a jewel, and the breath of the body pure fragrant incense;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਟਿਕਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: athasath teerath kaa mukh tikaa tit ghat mat vigaas ||
english: with the face anointed at the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, and the heart illuminated with wisdom

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਤੁ ਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ot matee saalaahanaa sach naam gunataas ||1||
english: -with that wisdom, chant the Praises of the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਰ ਹੋਰ ॥
transliteration: baabaa hor mat hor hor ||
english: O Baba, other wisdom is useless and irrelevant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵੇਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: je sau ver kamaaeeai kooRai kooRaa jor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If falsehood is practiced a hundred times, it is still false in its effects. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜ ਲਗੈ ਪੀਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pooj lagai peer aakheeai sabh milai sa(n)saar ||
english: You may be worshipped and adored as a Pir (a spiritual teacher); you may be welcomed by all the world;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਸਦਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਧੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naau sadaae aapanaa hovai sidh sumaar ||
english: you may adopt a lofty name, and be known to have supernatural spiritual powers

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭਾ ਪੂਜ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa pat lekhai naa pavai sabhaa pooj khuaar ||2||
english: -even so, if you are not accepted in the Court of the Lord, then all this adoration is false. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jin kau satigur thaapiaa tin met na sakai koi ||
english: No one can overthrow those who have been established by the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: onaa a(n)dar naam nidhaan hai naamo paragat hoi ||
english: The Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within them, and through the Naam, they are radiant and famous.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਅਖੰਡੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naau poojeeai naau ma(n)neeai akha(n)d sadaa sach soi ||3||
english: They worship the Naam, and they believe in the Naam. The True One is forever Intact and Unbroken. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: khehoo kheh ralaaeeai taa jeeu kehaa hoi ||
english: When the body mingles with dust, what happens to the soul?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaleeaa sabh siaanapaa uthee chaliaa roi ||
english: All clever tricks are burnt away, and you shall depart crying.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਦਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak naam visaariai dar gaiaa kiaa hoi ||4||8||
english: O Nanak, those who forget the Naam-what will happen when they go to the Court of the Lord? ||4||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਥਰੈ ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਝੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gunava(n)tee gun veetharai augunava(n)tee jhoor ||
english: The virtuous wife exudes virtue; the unvirtuous suffer in misery.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਕੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: je loRahi var kaamanee nah mileeai pir koor ||
english: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul-bride, you must know that He is not met by falsehood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਨਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naa beRee naa tulahaRaa naa paaeeai pir door ||1||
english: No boat or raft can take you to Him. Your Husband Lord is far away. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਅਡੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: mere thaakur poorai takhat adol ||
english: My Lord and Master is Perfect; His Throne is Eternal and Immovable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh pooraa je kare paaeeai saach atol ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who attains perfection as Gurmukh, obtains the Immeasurable True Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲ ॥
transliteration: prabh harima(n)dar sohanaa tis mahi maanak laal ||
english: The Palace of the Lord God is so beautiful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟ ਰੀਸਾਲ ॥
transliteration: motee heeraa niramalaa ka(n)chan kot reesaal ||
english: Within it, there are gems, rubies, pearls and flawless diamonds. A fortress of gold surrounds this Source of Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਗੜਿ ਕਿਉ ਚੜਉ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin pauRee gaR kiu chaRau gur har dhiaan nihaal ||2||
english: How can I climb up to the Fortress without a ladder? By meditating on the Lord, through the Guru, I am blessed and exalted. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur pauRee beRee guroo gur tulahaa har naau ||
english: The Guru is the Ladder, the Guru is the Boat, and the Guru is the Raft to take me to the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥
transliteration: gur sar saagar bohitho gur teerath dareeaau ||
english: The Guru is the Boat to carry me across the world-ocean; the Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Holy River.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਊਜਲੀ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਣ ਜਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je tis bhaavai oojalee sat sar naavan jaau ||3||
english: If it pleases Him, I bathe in the Pool of Truth, and become radiant and pure. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੋ ਪੂਰੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
transliteration: pooro pooro aakheeai poorai takhat nivaas ||
english: He is called the Most Perfect of the Perfect. He sits upon His Perfect Throne.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥
transliteration: poorai thaan suhaavanai poorai aas niraas ||
english: He looks so Beautiful in His Perfect Place. He fulfills the hopes of the hopeless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਉ ਘਾਟੈ ਗੁਣ ਤਾਸ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak pooraa je milai kiu ghaatai gun taas ||4||9||
english: O Nanak, if one obtains the Perfect Lord, how can his virtues decrease? ||4||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਭੈਣੇ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: aavahu bhaine gal milah a(n)k sahelaReeaah ||
english: Come, my dear sisters and spiritual companions; hug me close in your embrace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਕੰਤ ਕੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: mil kai karah kahaaneeaa sa(n)mrath ka(n)t keeaah ||
english: Let's join together, and tell stories of our All-powerful Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਅਸਾਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saache saahib sabh gun augan sabh asaah ||1||
english: All Virtues are in our True Lord and Master; we are utterly without virtue. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
transliteration: karataa sabh ko terai jor ||
english: O Creator Lord, all are in Your Power.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ek sabad beechaareeai jaa too taa kiaa hor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I dwell upon the One Word of the Shabad. You are mine-what else do I need? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਸੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਕਿਨੀ ਗੁਣਂੀ ॥
transliteration: jaai puchhahu sohaaganee tusee raaviaa kinee guna(n)ee ||
english: Go, and ask the happy soul-brides, "By what virtuous qualities do you enjoy your Husband Lord?"

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaj sa(n)tokh seegaareeaa mithaa bolanee ||
english: "We are adorned with intuitive ease, contentment and sweet words.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pir reesaaloo taa milai jaa gur kaa sabad sunee ||2||
english: We meet with our Beloved, the Source of Joy, when we listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad." ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: keteeaa tereeaa kudaratee kevad teree daat ||
english: You have so many Creative Powers, Lord; Your Bountiful Blessings are so Great.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kete tere jee ja(n)t siphat karahi din raat ||
english: So many of Your beings and creatures praise You day and night.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kete tere roop ra(n)g kete jaat ajaat ||3||
english: You have so many forms and colors, so many classes, high and low. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sach milai sach oopajai sach mahi saach samaai ||
english: Meeting the True One, Truth wells up. The truthful are absorbed into the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਊਗਵੈ ਗੁਰਬਚਨੀ ਭਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: surat hovai pat oogavai gurabachanee bhau khaai ||
english: Intuitive understanding is obtained and one is welcomed with honor, through the Guru's Word, filled with the Fear of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak sachaa paatisaahu aape lae milaai ||4||10||
english: O Nanak, the True King absorbs us into Himself. ||4||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਲੀ ਸਰੀ ਜਿ ਉਬਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੁਈ ਘਰਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: bhalee saree j ubaree haumai muee gharaahu ||
english: It all worked out-I was saved, and the egotism within my heart was subdued.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਤ ਲਗੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: doot lage phir chaakaree satigur kaa vesaahu ||
english: The evil energies have been made to serve me, since I placed my faith in the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਪ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kalap tiaagee baad hai sachaa veparavaahu ||1||
english: I have renounced my useless schemes, by the Grace of the True, Carefree Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man re sach milai bhau jaai ||
english: O mind, meeting with the True One, fear departs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਿਉ ਥੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhai bin nirabhau kiu theeai guramukh sabad samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Fear of God, how can anyone become fearless? Become Gurmukh, and immerse yourself in the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਖਣਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ketaa aakhan aakheeai aakhan tot na hoi ||
english: How can we describe Him with words? There is no end to the descriptions of Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)gan vaale ketaRe daataa eko soi ||
english: There are so many beggars, but He is the only Giver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis ke jee paraan hai man vasiai sukh hoi ||2||
english: He is the Giver of the soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life; when He dwells within the mind, there is peace. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਬਾਜੀ ਬਨੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jag supanaa baajee banee khin mahi khel khelaai ||
english: The world is a drama, staged in a dream. In a moment, the play is played out.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਸੇ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)jogee mil ekase vijogee uth jaai ||
english: Some attain union with the Lord, while others depart in separation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaanaa so theeai avar na karanaa jaai ||3||
english: Whatever pleases Him comes to pass; nothing else can be done. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh vasat vesaaheeai sach vakhar sach raas ||
english: The Gurmukhs purchase the Genuine Article. The True Merchandise is purchased with the True Capital.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee sach vana(n)jiaa gur poore saabaas ||
english: Those who purchase this True Merchandise through the Perfect Guru are blessed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak vasat pachhaanasee sach saudaa jis paas ||4||11||
english: O Nanak, one who stocks this True Merchandise shall recognize and realize the Genuine Article. ||4||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahal 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਾਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਉ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhaat milai phun dhaat kau siphatee siphat samaai ||
english: As metal merges with metal, those who chant the Praises of the Lord are absorbed into the Praiseworthy Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੁ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ਗਹਬਰਾ ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: laal gulaal gahabaraa sachaa ra(n)g chaRaau ||
english: Like the poppies, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of Truthfulness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sach milai sa(n)tokheeaa har jap ekai bhaai ||1||
english: Those contented souls who meditate on the Lord with single-minded love, meet the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re sa(n)t janaa kee ren ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, become the dust of the feet of the humble Saints.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਧੇਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa gur paaeeai mukat padaarath dhen ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, the Guru is found. He is the Treasure of Liberation, the Source of all good fortune. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਚਉ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: oochau thaan suhaavanaa oopar mahal muraar ||
english: Upon that Highest Plane of Sublime Beauty, stands the Mansion of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਦੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sach karanee de paaeeai dar ghar mahal piaar ||
english: By true actions, this human body is obtained, and the door within ourselves which leads to the Mansion of the Beloved, is found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh man samajhaaeeai aatam raam beechaar ||2||
english: The Gurmukhs train their minds to contemplate the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈਅਹਿ ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tribidh karam kamaaeeahi aas a(n)desaa hoi ||
english: By actions committed under the influence of the three qualities, hope and anxiety are produced.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੁਟਸੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kiu gur bin trikutee chhutasee sahaj miliai sukh hoi ||
english: Without the Guru, how can anyone be released from these three qualities? Through intuitive wisdom, we meet with Him and find peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nij ghar mahal pachhaaneeai nadar kare mal dhoi ||3||
english: Within the home of the self, the Mansion of His Presence is realized when He bestows His Glance of Grace and washes away our pollution. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: bin gur mail na utarai bin har kiu ghar vaas ||
english: Without the Guru, this pollution is not removed. Without the Lord, how can there be any homecoming?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: eko sabad veechaareeai avar tiaagai aas ||
english: Contemplate the One Word of the Shabad, and abandon other hopes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak dekh dikhaaeeai hau sad balihaarai jaas ||4||12||
english: O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to the one who beholds, and inspires others to behold Him. ||4||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhrig jeevan dohaaganee muthee doojai bhaai ||
english: The life of the discarded bride is cursed. She is deceived by the love of duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਕੰਧ ਜਿਉ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਿਰਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kalar keree ka(n)dh jiu ahinis kir dhahi paai ||
english: Like a wall of sand, day and night, she crumbles, and eventually, she breaks down altogether.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin sabadai sukh naa theeai pir bin dookh na jaai ||1||
english: Without the Word of the Shabad, peace does not come. Without her Husband Lord, her suffering does not end. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dhe pir bin kiaa seegaar ||
