english: O soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dar ghar dhoee na lahai daragah jhooth khuaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In this world, you shall not find any shelter; in the world hereafter, being false, you shall suffer. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਈ ਸਚਾ ਵਡ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aap sujaan na bhulaee sachaa vad kirasaan ||
english: The True Lord Himself knows all; He makes no mistakes. He is the Great Farmer of the Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: pahilaa dharatee saadh kai sach naam de daan ||
english: First, He prepares the ground, and then He plants the Seed of the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nau nidh upajai naam ek karam pavai neesaan ||2||
english: The nine treasures are produced from Name of the One Lord. By His Grace, we obtain His Banner and Insignia. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kau jaan na jaanaee kiaa tis chaj achaar ||
english: Some are very knowledgeable, but if they do not know the Guru, then what is the use of their lives?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhulai naam visaariaa manamukh a(n)dh gubaar ||
english: The blind have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The self-willed manmukhs are in utter darkness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aavan jaan na chukaee mar janamai hoi khuaar ||3||
english: Their comings and goings in reincarnation do not end; through death and rebirth, they are wasting away. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਣਾਇਆ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਮਾਂਗ ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)dan mol anaaiaa ku(n)goo maa(n)g sa(n)dhoor ||
english: The bride may buy sandalwood oil and perfumes, and apply them in great quantities to her hair;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਪਾਨਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਪੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: choaa cha(n)dan bahu ghanaa paanaa naal kapoor ||
english: she may sweeten her breath with betel leaf and camphor,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤ ਸਭਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: je dhan ka(n)t na bhaavaee ta sabh ada(n)bar kooR ||4||
english: but if this bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord, then all these trappings are false. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਬਾਦਿ ਹਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sabh ras bhogan baad hahi sabh seegaar vikaar ||
english: Her enjoyment of all pleasures is futile, and all her decorations are corrupt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੇਦੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jab lag sabad na bhedeeai kiu sohai guraduaar ||
english: Until she has been pierced through with the Shabad, how can she look beautiful at Guru's Gate?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak dha(n)n suhaaganee jin sah naal piaar ||5||13||
english: O Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband Lord. ||5||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਞੀ ਦੇਹ ਡਰਾਵਣੀ ਜਾ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: su(n)njee deh daraavanee jaa jeeu vichahu jaai ||
english: The empty body is dreadful, when the soul goes out from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਦੀ ਵਿਝਵੀ ਧੂਉ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaahi bala(n)dee vijhavee dhoou na nikasio kaai ||
english: The burning fire of life is extinguished, and the smoke of the breath no longer emerges.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚੇ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਭਰੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pa(n)che ru(n)ne dukh bhare binase doojai bhaai ||1||
english: The five relatives (the senses) weep and wail painfully, and waste away through the love of duality. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂੜੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: mooRe raam japahu gun saar ||
english: You fool: chant the Name of the Lord, and preserve your virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਸਭ ਮੁਠੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa mohanee sabh muthee aha(n)kaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Egotism and possessiveness are very enticing; egotistical pride has plundered everyone. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa doojee kaarai lag ||
english: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are attached to affairs of duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa laage pach mue a(n)tar trisanaa ag ||
english: Attached to duality, they putrefy and die; they are filled with the fire of desire within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਠਗਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare hor muthee dha(n)dhai thag ||2||
english: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; all others are cheated and plundered by deceitful worldly affairs. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਈ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਆ ਵੈਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ॥
transliteration: muee pareet piaar gaiaa muaa vair virodh ||
english: Love dies, and affection vanishes. Hatred and alienation die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਥਕਾ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa thakaa hau muee mamataa maaiaa krodh ||
english: Entanglements end, and egotism dies, along with attachment to Maya, possessiveness and anger.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰੋਧੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karam milai sach paaeeai guramukh sadaa nirodh ||3||
english: Those who receive His Mercy obtain the True One. The Gurmukhs dwell forever in balanced restraint. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sachee kaarai sach milai guramat palai paai ||
english: By true actions, the True Lord is met, and the Guru's Teachings are found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: so nar ja(n)mai naa marai naa aavai naa jaai ||
english: Then, they are not subject to birth and death; they do not come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੋ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak dar paradhaan so daragahi paidhaa jaai ||4||14||
english: O Nanak, they are respected at the Lord's Gate; they are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahal 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tan jal bal maatee bhaiaa man maaiaa mohi manoor ||
english: The body is burnt to ashes; by its love of Maya, the mind is rusted through.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਾਗੂ ਭਏ ਕੂਰਿ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਤੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: augan phir laagoo bhae koor vajaavai toor ||
english: Demerits become one's enemies, and falsehood blows the bugle of attack.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin sabadai bharamaaeeai dubidhaa dobe poor ||1||
english: Without the Word of the Shabad, people wander lost in reincarnation. Through the love of duality, multitudes have been drowned. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man re sabad tarahu chit laai ||
english: O mind, swim across, by focusing your consciousness on the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin guramukh naam na boojhiaa mar janamai aavai jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who do not become Gurmukh do not understand the Naam; they die, and continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan soochaa so aakheeai jis mahi saachaa naau ||
english: That body is said to be pure, in which the True Name abides.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: bhai sach raatee dehuree jihavaa sach suaau ||
english: One whose body is imbued with the Fear of the True One, and whose tongue savors Truthfulness,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sachee nadar nihaaleeai bahuR na paavai taau ||2||
english: is brought to ecstasy by the True Lord's Glance of Grace. That person does not have to go through the fire of the womb again. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਵਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਪਵਨੈ ਤੇ ਜਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saache te pavanaa bhaiaa pavanai te jal hoi ||
english: From the True Lord came the air, and from the air came water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jal te tribhavan saajiaa ghat ghat jot samoi ||
english: From water, He created the three worlds; in each and every heart He has infused His Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: niramal mailaa naa theeai sabad rate pat hoi ||3||
english: The Immaculate Lord does not become polluted. Attuned to the Shabad, honor is obtained. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ihu man saach sa(n)tokhiaa nadar kare tis maahi ||
english: One whose mind is contented with Truthfulness, is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਸਚਿ ਭੈ ਰਤੇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch bhoot sach bhai rate jot sachee man maahi ||
english: The body of the five elements is dyed in the Fear of the True One; the mind is filled with the True Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਗਣ ਵੀਸਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak augan veesare gur raakhe pat taahi ||4||15||
english: O Nanak, your demerits shall be forgotten; the Guru shall preserve your honor. ||4||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇੜੀ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਤਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak beRee sach kee tareeai gur veechaar ||
english: O Nanak, the Boat of Truth will ferry you across; contemplate the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਵਹੀ ਪੂਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ik aavahi ik jaavahee poor bhare aha(n)kaar ||
english: Some come, and some go; they are totally filled with egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਮਤੀ ਬੂਡੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁ ਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: manahath matee boodeeai guramukh sach s taar ||1||
english: Through stubborn-mindedness, the intellect is drowned; one who becomes Gurmukh and truthful is saved. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur bin kiu tareeai sukh hoi ||
english: Without the Guru, how can anyone swim across to find peace?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakh too mai avar na doojaa koi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As it pleases You, Lord, You save me. There is no other for me at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਦੇਖਉ ਡਉ ਜਲੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਹਰਿਓ ਅੰਗੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aagai dekhau dau jalai paachhai hario a(n)goor ||
english: In front of me, I see the jungle burning; behind me, I see green plants sprouting.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਚੁ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jis te upajai tis te binasai ghat ghat sach bharapoor ||
english: We shall merge into the One from whom we came. The True One is pervading each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape mel milaavahee saachai mahal hadoor ||2||
english: He Himself unites us in Union with Himself; the True Mansion of His Presence is close at hand. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੇਉ ॥
transliteration: saahi saahi tujh sa(n)malaa kade na visaareu ||
english: With each and every breath, I dwell upon You; I shall never forget You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੇਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu jiu saahab man vasai guramukh a(n)mrit peu ||
english: The more the Lord and Master dwells within the mind, the more the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਮੇਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man tan teraa too dhanee garab nivaar sameu ||3||
english: Mind and body are Yours; You are my Master. Please rid me of my pride, and let me merge with You. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jin ehu jagat upaaiaa tribhavan kar aakaar ||
english: The One who formed this universe created the creation of the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh chaanan jaaneeai manamukh mugadh gubaar ||
english: The Gurmukh knows the Divine Light, while the foolish self-willed manmukh gropes around in the darkness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ghat ghat jot nira(n)taree boojhai guramat saar ||4||
english: One who sees that Light within each and every heart understands the Essence of the Guru's Teachings. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੀਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jinee jaaniaa tin keechai saabaas ||
english: Those who understand are Gurmukh; recognize and applaud them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: sache setee ral mile sache gun paragaas ||
english: They meet and merge with the True One. They become the Radiant Manifestation of the Excellence of the True One.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੫॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak naam sa(n)tokheeaa jeeu pi(n)d prabh paas ||5||16||
english: O Nanak, they are contented with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. They offer their bodies and souls to God. ||5||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਮਿਲੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਏਹ ॥
transliteration: sun man mitr piaariaa mil velaa hai eh ||
english: Listen, O my mind, my friend, my darling: now is the time to meet the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: jab lag joban saas hai tab lag ihu tan deh ||
english: As long as there is youth and breath, give this body to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin gun kaam na aavaee dhahi dheree tan kheh ||1||
english: Without virtue, it is useless; the body shall crumble into a pile of dust. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mere man lai laahaa ghar jaahi ||
english: O my mind, earn the profit, before you return home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam salaaheeai haumai nivaree bhaahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the fire of egotism is extinguished. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੰਢਣੁ ਗੰਢੀਐ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sun sun ga(n)dhan ga(n)dheeai likh paR bujhahi bhaar ||
english: Again and again, we hear and tell stories; we read and write and understand loads of knowledge,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa ahinis agalee haumai rog vikaar ||
english: but still, desires increase day and night, and the disease of egotism fills us with corruption.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਤੋਲਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ohu veparavaahu atolavaa guramat keemat saar ||2||
english: That Carefree Lord cannot be appraised; His Real Value is known only through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਲਖ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: lakh siaanap je karee lakh siu preet milaap ||
english: Even if someone has hundreds of thousands of clever mental tricks, and the love and company of hundreds of thousands of people

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: bin sa(n)gat saadh na dhraapeeaa bin naavai dookh sa(n)taap ||
english: still, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he will not feel satisfied. Without the Name, all suffer in sorrow.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har jap jeeare chhuteeai guramukh cheenai aap ||3||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, O my soul, you shall be emancipated; as Gurmukh, you shall come to understand your own self. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: tan man gur pahi vechiaa man deeaa sir naal ||
english: I have sold my body and mind to the Guru, and I have given my mind and head as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: tribhavan khoj dha(n)dholiaa guramukh khoj nihaal ||
english: I was seeking and searching for Him throughout the three worlds; then, as Gurmukh, I sought and found Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੭॥
transliteration: satagur mel milaaiaa naanak so prabh naal ||4||17||
english: The True Guru has united me in Union, O Nanak, with that God. ||4||17||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੈ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: maranai kee chi(n)taa nahee jeevan kee nahee aas ||
english: I have no anxiety about dying, and no hope of living.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ॥
transliteration: too sarab jeeaa pratipaalahee lekhai saas giraas ||
english: You are the Cherisher of all beings; You keep the account of our breaths and morsels of food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੂ ਵਸਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tar guramukh too vasahi jiu bhaavai tiu nirajaas ||1||
english: You abide within the Gurmukh. As it pleases You, You decide our allotment. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jeeare raam japat man maan ||
english: O my soul, chant the Name of the Lord; the mind will be pleased and appeased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਜਲਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar laagee jal bujhee paaiaa guramukh giaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The raging fire within is extinguished; the Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੰਕ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kee gat jaaneeai gur mileeai sa(n)k utaar ||
english: Know the state of your inner being; meet with the Guru and get rid of your skepticism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਇਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: muiaa jit ghar jaaeeai tit jeevadiaa mar maar ||
english: To reach your True Home after you die, you must conquer death while you are still alive.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anahad sabad suhaavane paaeeai gur veechaar ||2||
english: The beautiful, Unstruck Sound of the Shabad is obtained, contemplating the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: anahad baanee paaeeai tah haumai hoi binaas ||
english: The Unstruck Melody of Gurbani is obtained, and egotism is eliminated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: satagur seve aapanaa hau sad kurabaanai taas ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੜਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਈਐ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khaR daragah painaaeeai mukh har naam nivaas ||3||
english: They are dressed in robes of honor in the Court of the Lord; the Name of the Lord is on their lips. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah rav rahe siv sakatee kaa mel ||
english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord pervading there, in the union of Shiva and Shakti, of consciousness and matter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਬੰਧੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਿ ਸੋ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
transliteration: trihu gun ba(n)dhee dehuree jo aaiaa jag so khel ||
english: The three qualities hold the body in bondage; whoever comes into the world is subject to their play.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਨ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: vijogee dukh vichhuRe manamukh lahahi na mel ||4||
english: Those who separate themselves from the Lord wander lost in misery. The self-willed manmukhs do not attain union with Him. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚ ਭੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man bairaagee ghar vasai sach bhai raataa hoi ||
english: If the mind becomes balanced and detached, and comes to dwell in its own true home, imbued with the Fear of God,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਹਾਰਸੁ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: giaan mahaaras bhogavai baahuR bhookh na hoi ||
english: then it enjoys the essence of supreme spiritual wisdom; it shall never feel hunger again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak ihu man maar mil bhee phir dukh na hoi ||5||18||
english: O Nanak, conquer and subdue this mind; meet with the Lord, and you shall never again suffer in pain. ||5||18||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਲੋਭੇ ਲਗਾ ਲੋੁਭਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ehu mano moorakh lobheeaa lobhe lagaa loubhaan ||
english: This foolish mind is greedy; through greed, it becomes even more attached to greed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਕਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sabad na bheejai saakataa duramat aavan jaan ||
english: The evil-minded shaaktas, the faithless cynics, are not attuned to the Shabad; they come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhoo satagur je milai taa paaeeai gunee nidhaan ||1||
english: One who meets with the Holy True Guru finds the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: man re haumai chhod gumaan ||
english: O mind, renounce your egotistical pride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har gur saravar sev too paavahi daragah maan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Serve the Lord, the Guru, the Sacred Pool, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: raam naam jap dinas raat guramukh har dhan jaan ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord day and night; become Gurmukh, and know the Wealth of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh sukh har ras bhogane sa(n)t sabhaa mil giaan ||
english: All comforts and peace, and the Essence of the Lord, are enjoyed by acquiring spiritual wisdom in the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nit ahinis har prabh seviaa satagur deeaa naam ||2||
english: Day and night, continually serve the Lord God; the True Guru has given the Naam. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂਕਰ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kookar kooR kamaaeeai gur ni(n)daa pachai pachaan ||
english: Those who practice falsehood are dogs; those who slander the Guru shall burn in their own fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਖੁਲਹਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: bharame bhoolaa dukh ghano jam maar karai khulahaan ||
english: They wander lost and confused, deceived by doubt, suffering in terrible pain. The Messenger of Death shall beat them to a pulp.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਭਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: manamukh sukh na paaeeai guramukh sukh subhaan ||3||
english: The self-willed manmukhs find no peace, while the Gurmukhs are wondrously joyful. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aithai dha(n)dh pitaaeeai sach likhat paravaan ||
english: In this world, people are engrossed in false pursuits, but in the world hereafter, only the account of your true actions is accepted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: har sajan gur sevadaa gur karanee paradhaan ||
english: The Guru serves the Lord, His Intimate Friend. The Guru's actions are supremely exalted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਚੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai karam sachai neesaan ||4||19||
english: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the True Lord shall bless you with His Mark of Grace. ||4||19||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik til piaaraa veesarai rog vadaa man maahi ||
english: Forgetting the Beloved, even for a moment, the mind is afflicted with terrible diseases.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kiu daragah pat paaeeai jaa har na vasai man maahi ||
english: How can honor be attained in His Court, if the Lord does not dwell in the mind?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur miliai sukh paaeeai agan marai gun maahi ||1||
english: Meeting with the Guru, peace is found. The fire is extinguished in His Glorious Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man re ahinis har gun saar ||
english: O mind, enshrine the Praises of the Lord, day and night.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin khin pal naam na veesarai te jan virale sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who does not forget the Naam, for a moment or even an instant-how rare is such a person in this world! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jotee jot milaaeeai suratee surat sa(n)jog ||
english: When one's light merges into the Light, and one's intuitive consciousness is joined with the Intuitive Consciousness,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਤੁ ਗਏ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: hi(n)saa haumai gat gae naahee sahasaa sog ||
english: then one's cruel and violent instincts and egotism depart, and skepticism and sorrow are taken away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh jis har man vasai tis mele gur sa(n)jog ||2||
english: The Lord abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, who merges in the Lord's Union, through the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kaaman je karee bhoge bhoganahaar ||
english: If I surrender my body like a bride, the Enjoyer will enjoy me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tis siu nehu na keejaee jo deesai chalanahaar ||
english: Do not make love with one who is just a passing show.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh ravahi sohaaganee so prabh sej bhataar ||3||
english: The Gurmukh is ravished like the pure and happy bride on the Bed of God, her Husband. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਮਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chaare agan nivaar mar guramukh har jal paai ||
english: The Gurmukh puts out the four fires, with the Water of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kamal pragaasiaa a(n)mrit bhariaa aghaai ||
english: The lotus blossoms deep within the heart, and filled with Ambrosial Nectar, one is satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak satagur meet kar sach paavahi daragah jaai ||4||20||
english: O Nanak, make the True Guru your friend; going to His Court, you shall obtain the True Lord. ||4||20||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ॥
transliteration: har har japahu piaariaa guramat le har bol ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O my beloved; follow the Guru's Teachings, and speak of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸਚ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
transliteration: man sach kasavatee laaeeai tuleeai poorai tol ||
english: Apply the Touchstone of Truth to your mind, and see if it comes up to its full weight.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: keemat kinai na paaeeai rid maanak mol amol ||1||
english: No one has found the worth of the ruby of the heart; its value cannot be estimated. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re har heeraa gur maahi ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, the Diamond of the Lord is within the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat satagur paaeeai ahinis sabad salaahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Day and night, praise the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: sach vakhar dhan raas lai paaeeai gur paragaas ||
english: The True Merchandise, Wealth and Capital are obtained through the Radiant Light of the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਲਿ ਪਾਇਐ ਤਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jiu agan marai jal paaiai tiu trisanaa daasan daas ||
english: Just as fire is extinguished by pouring on water, desire becomes the slave of the Lord's slaves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਇਉ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ਤਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jam ja(n)daar na lagaee iu bhaujal tarai taraas ||2||
english: The Messenger of Death will not touch you; in this way, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, carrying others across with you. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh kooR na bhaavaee sach rate sach bhaai ||
english: The Gurmukhs do not like falsehood. They are imbued with Truth; they love only Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਂਇ ॥
transliteration: saakat sach na bhaavaee kooRai kooRee paa(n)i ||
english: The shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth; false are the foundations of the false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਐ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sach rate gur meliai sache sach samaai ||3||
english: Imbued with Truth, you shall meet the Guru. The true ones are absorbed into the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man mahi maanak laal naam ratan padaarath heer ||
english: Within the mind are emeralds and rubies, the Jewel of the Naam, treasures and diamonds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sach vakhar dhan naam hai ghat ghat gahir ga(n)bheer ||
english: The Naam is the True Merchandise and Wealth; in each and every heart, His Presence is deep and profound.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh paaeeai daiaa kare har heer ||4||21||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Diamond of the Lord, by His Kindness and Compassion. ||4||21||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਵਿਝਵੈ ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: bharame bhaahi na vijhavai je bhavai disa(n)tar des ||
english: The fire of doubt is not extinguished, even by wandering through foreign lands and countries.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar mail na utarai dhrig jeevan dhrig ves ||
english: If inner filth is not removed, one's life is cursed, and one's clothes are cursed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hor kitai bhagat na hovaee bin satigur ke upades ||1||
english: There is no other way to perform devotional worship, except through the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man re guramukh agan nivaar ||
english: O mind, become Gurmukh, and extinguish the fire within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa kahiaa man vasai haumai trisanaa maar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Let the Words of the Guru abide within your mind; let egotism and desires die. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man maanak niramol hai raam naam pat paai ||
english: The jewel of the mind is priceless; through the Name of the Lord, honor is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat har paaeeai guramukh har liv laai ||
english: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and find the Lord. The Gurmukh embraces love for the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap gaiaa sukh paaiaa mil salalai salal samaai ||2||
english: Give up your selfishness, and you shall find peace; like water mingling with water, you shall merge in absorption. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੁ ਅਉਗੁਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jin har har naam na chetio s augun aavai jaai ||
english: Those who have not contemplated the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are unworthy; they come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸੁ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis satagur purakh na bhetio s bhaujal pachai pachaai ||
english: One who has not met with the True Guru, the Primal Being, is bothered and bewildered in the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਇਉ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ihu maanak jeeu niramol hai iu kaudee badalai jaai ||3||
english: This jewel of the soul is priceless, and yet it is being squandered like this, in exchange for a mere shell. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਣ ॥
transliteration: ji(n)naa satagur ras milai se poore purakh sujaan ||
english: Those who joyfully meet with the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and wise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: gur mil bhaujal la(n)gheeai daragah pat paravaan ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. In the Court of the Lord, they are honored and approved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak te mukh ujale dhun upajai sabad neesaan ||4||22||
english: O Nanak, their faces are radiant; the Music of the Shabad, the Word of God, wells up within them. ||4||22||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਹੋ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: vanaj karahu vanajaariho vakhar lehu samaal ||
english: Make your deals, dealers, and take care of your merchandise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੀਐ ਜੈਸੀ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: taisee vasat visaaheeai jaisee nibahai naal ||
english: Buy that object which will go along with you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਲੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: agai saahu sujaan hai laisee vasat samaal ||1||
english: In the next world, the All-knowing Merchant will take this object and care for it. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re raam kahahu chit laai ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Lord's Name, and focus your consciousness on Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਲਹੁ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jas vakhar lai chalahu sahu dekhai pateeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Take the Merchandise of the Lord's Praises with you. Your Husband Lord shall see this and approve. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jinaa raas na sach hai kiu tinaa sukh hoi ||
english: Those who do not have the Assets of Truth-how can they find peace?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੈ ਵਣਜਿ ਵਣੰਜਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਟਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: khotai vanaj vana(n)jiai man tan khotaa hoi ||
english: By dealing their deals of falsehood, their minds and bodies become false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਨਿਤ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: phaahee phaathe mirag jiu dookh ghano nit roi ||2||
english: Like the deer caught in the trap, they suffer in terrible agony; they continually cry out in pain. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਪੋਤੈ ਨਾ ਪਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: khote potai naa pavahi tin har gur daras na hoi ||
english: The counterfeit coins are not put into the Treasury; they do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord-Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਖੋਟਿ ਨ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: khote jaat na pat hai khot na seejhas koi ||
english: The false ones have no social status or honor. No one succeeds through falsehood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khote khot kamaavanaa aai gaiaa pat khoi ||3||
english: Practicing falsehood again and again, people come and go in reincarnation, and forfeit their honor. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
transliteration: naanak man samajhaaeeai gur kai sabad saalaah ||
english: O Nanak, instruct your mind through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and praise the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਭਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥
transliteration: raam naam ra(n)g ratiaa bhaar na bharam tinaah ||
english: Those who are imbued with the love of the Name of the Lord are not loaded down by doubt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੪॥੨੩॥
transliteration: har jap laahaa agalaa nirabhau har man maah ||4||23||
english: Those who chant the Name of the Lord earn great profits; the Fearless Lord abides within their minds. ||4||23||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਫੁਲੜਾ ਨਾਠੀਅੜੇ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dhan joban ar phulaRaa naatheeaRe din chaar ||
english: Wealth, the beauty of youth and flowers are guests for only a few days.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਬਣਿ ਕੇਰੇ ਪਤ ਜਿਉ ਢਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਜੁੰਮਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paban kere pat jiu dhal dhul ju(n)manahaar ||1||
english: Like the leaves of the water-lily, they wither and fade and finally die. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਨਉ ਹੁਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g maan lai piaariaa jaa joban nau hulaa ||
english: Be happy, dear beloved, as long as your youth is fresh and delightful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਥਕੇ ਭਇਆ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਚੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: din thoRaRe thake bhaiaa puraanaa cholaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: But your days are few-you have grown weary, and now your body has grown old. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਜਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਜਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਜੀਰਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: sajan mere ra(n)gule jaai sute jeeraan ||
english: My playful friends have gone to sleep in the graveyard.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੰ ਭੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਡੁਮਣੀ ਰੋਵਾ ਝੀਣੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ha(n) bhee va(n)njaa dumanee rovaa jheenee baan ||2||
english: In my double-mindedness, I shall have to go as well. I cry in a feeble voice. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀ ਨ ਸੁਣੇਹੀ ਗੋਰੀਏ ਆਪਣ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kee na sunehee goreee aapan ka(n)nee soi ||
english: Haven't you heard the call from beyond, O beautiful soul-bride?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਗੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਨ ਪੇਈਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: lagee aavahi saahurai nit na peeeaa hoi ||3||
english: You must go to your in-laws; you cannot stay with your parents forever. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਤੀ ਪੇਈਐ ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਰਤੀ ਸੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak sutee peeeai jaan viratee sa(n)n ||
english: O Nanak, know that she who sleeps in her parents' home is plundered in broad daylight.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਾ ਗਵਾਈ ਗੰਠੜੀ ਅਵਗਣ ਚਲੀ ਬੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੨੪॥
transliteration: gunaa gavaaee ga(n)thaRee avagan chalee ba(n)n ||4||24||
english: She has lost her bouquet of merits; gathering one of demerits, she departs. ||4||24||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar doojaa 2 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape raseeaa aap ras aape raavanahaar ||
english: He Himself is the Enjoyer, and He Himself is the Enjoyment. He Himself is the Ravisher of all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੋਲੜਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape hovai cholaRaa aape sej bhataar ||1||
english: He Himself is the Bride in her dress, He Himself is the Bridegroom on the bed. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g rataa meraa saahib rav rahiaa bharapoor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My Lord and Master is imbued with love; He is totally permeating and pervading all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਛੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: aape maachhee machhulee aape paanee jaal ||
english: He Himself is the fisherman and the fish; He Himself is the water and the net.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲ ਮਣਕੜਾ ਆਪੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape jaal manakaRaa aape a(n)dar laal ||2||
english: He Himself is the sinker, and He Himself is the bait. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: aape bahu bidh ra(n)gulaa sakheee meraa laal ||
english: He Himself loves in so many ways. O sister soul-brides, He is my Beloved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਦੇਖੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nit ravai sohaaganee dekh hamaaraa haal ||3||
english: He continually ravishes and enjoys the happy soul-brides; just look at the plight I am in without Him! ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਤੂ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਤੂ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
transliteration: pranavai naanak benatee too saravar too ha(n)s ||
english: Prays Nanak, please hear my prayer: You are the pool, and You are the soul-swan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਉਲੁ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਕਵੀਆ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥
transliteration: kaul too hai kaveeaa too hai aape vekh vigas ||4||25||
english: You are the lotus flower of the day and You are the water-lily of the night. You Yourself behold them, and blossom forth in bliss. ||4||25||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਬੀਜੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਰੋ ਸਲਿਲ ਆਪਾਉ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ihu tan dharatee beej karamaa karo salil aapaau saari(n)gapaanee ||
english: Make this body the field, and plant the seed of good actions. Water it with the Name of the Lord, who holds all the world in His Hands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਇਉ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man kirasaan har ridai ja(n)maai lai iu paavas pad nirabaanee ||1||
english: Let your mind be the farmer; the Lord shall sprout in your heart, and you shall attain the state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kaahe garabas mooRe maaiaa ||
english: You fool! Why are you so proud of Maya?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤੋ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਤਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pit suto sagal kaalatr maataa tere hohi na a(n)t sakhaaiaa || rahaau ||
english: Father, children, spouse, mother and all relatives-they shall not be your helpers in the end. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੁਸਟ ਕਿਰਖਾ ਕਰੇ ਇਨ ਤਜਿ ਆਤਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: bikhai bikaar dusat kirakhaa kare in taj aatamai hoi dhiaaee ||
english: So weed out evil, wickedness and corruption; leave these behind, and let your soul meditate on God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਜਬ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮਧੁ ਆਸ੍ਰਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam hohi jab raakhe kamal bigasai madh aasramaaee ||2||
english: When chanting, austere meditation and self-discipline become your protectors, then the lotus blossoms forth, and the honey trickles out. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੀਸ ਸਪਤਾਹਰੋ ਬਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤੀਨਿ ਖੋੜਾ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: bees sapataaharo baasaro sa(n)grahai teen khoRaa nit kaal saarai ||
english: Bring the twenty-seven elements of the body under your control, and throughout the three stages of life, remember death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਠਾਰ ਮੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਚੀਨੈ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਵ ਏਕੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥੨੬॥
transliteration: das athaar mai apara(n)paro cheenai kahai naanak iv ek taarai ||3||26||
english: See the Infinite Lord in the ten directions, and in all the variety of nature. Says Nanak, in this way, the One Lord shall carry you across. ||3||26||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਬੀਜੁ ਸਬਦੋ ਕਰਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਆਬ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: amal kar dharatee beej sabado kar sach kee aab nit dehi paanee ||
english: Make good deeds the soil, and let the Word of the Shabad be the seed; irrigate it continually with the water of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਈਮਾਨੁ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਭਿਸਤੁ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਏਵ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hoi kirasaan eemaan ja(n)maai lai bhisat dojak mooRe ev jaanee ||1||
english: Become such a farmer, and faith will sprout. This brings knowledge of heaven and hell, you fool! ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਜਾਣ ਸਹਿ ਗਲੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mat jaan sahi galee paaiaa ||
english: Do not think that your Husband Lord can be obtained by mere words.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲ ਕੈ ਮਾਣੈ ਰੂਪ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਇਤੁ ਬਿਧੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maal kai maanai roop kee sobhaa it bidhee janam gavaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are wasting this life in the pride of wealth and the splendor of beauty. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਬ ਤਨਿ ਚਿਕੜੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੀਡਕੋ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aib tan chikaRo ihu man meedako kamal kee saar nahee mool paaee ||
english: The defect of the body which leads to sin is the mud puddle, and this mind is the frog, which does not appreciate the lotus flower at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਉਰੁ ਉਸਤਾਦੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਉ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾ ਨਹ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhaur usataad nit bhaakhiaa bole kiu boojhai jaa nah bujhaaee ||2||
english: The bumble bee is the teacher who continually teaches the lesson. But how can one understand, unless one is made to understand? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਪਉਣ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aakhan sunanaa paun kee baanee ihu man rataa maaiaa ||
english: This speaking and listening is like the song of the wind, for those whose minds are colored by the love of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਦਿਲਹਿ ਪਸਿੰਦੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khasam kee nadar dilahi pasi(n)de jinee kar ek dhiaaiaa ||3||
english: The Grace of the Master is bestowed upon those who meditate on Him alone. They are pleasing to His Heart. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਹ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਪੰਜ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾਉ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ਮਤੁ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: teeh kar rakhe pa(n)j kar saathee naau saitaan mat kat jaaee ||
english: You may observe the thirty fasts, and say the five prayers each day, but 'Satan' can undo them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਪੈ ਚਲਣਾ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਤ ਕੂ ਸੰਜਿਆਹੀ ॥੪॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak aakhai raahi pai chalanaa maal dhan kit koo sa(n)jiaahee ||4||27||
english: Says Nanak, you will have to walk on the Path of Death, so why do you bother to collect wealth and property? ||4||27||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 4 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਮਉਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: soee maulaa jin jag mauliaa hariaa keeaa sa(n)saaro ||
english: He is the Master who has made the world bloom; He makes the Universe blossom forth, fresh and green.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਬ ਖਾਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਹਾਈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aab khaak jin ba(n)dh rahaaee dha(n)n sirajanahaaro ||1||
english: He holds the water and the land in bondage. Hail to the Creator Lord! ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣਾ ਮੁਲਾ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: maranaa mulaa maranaa ||
english: Death, O Mullah-death will come,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਹੁ ਡਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhee karataarahu daranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: so live in the Fear of God the Creator. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੁਲਾ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਕਾਜੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: taa too mulaa taa too kaajee jaanahi naam khudaaee ||
english: You are a Mullah, and you are a Qazi, only when you know the Naam, the Name of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: je bahuteraa paRiaa hovahi ko rahai na bhareeai paaee ||2||
english: You may be very educated, but no one can remain when the measure of life is full. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕਾਜੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: soee kaajee jin aap tajiaa ik naam keeaa aadhaaro ||
english: He alone is a Qazi, who renounces selfishness and conceit, and makes the One Name his Support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hai bhee hosee jaai na jaasee sachaa sirajanahaaro ||3||
english: The True Creator Lord is, and shall always be. He was not born; He shall not die. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਜ ਵਖਤ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਹਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)j vakhat nivaaj gujaarahi paRahi kateb kuraanaa ||
english: You may chant your prayers five times each day; you may read the Bible and the Koran.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਗੋਰ ਸਦੇਈ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੀਣਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨੮॥
transliteration: naanak aakhai gor sadeee rahio peenaa khaanaa ||4||28||
english: Says Nanak, the grave is calling you, and now your food and drink are finished. ||4||28||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 4 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਸੁਆਨੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: ek suaan dui suaanee naal ||
english: The dogs of greed are with me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਲਕੇ ਭਉਕਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਬਇਆਲਿ ॥
transliteration: bhalake bhaukahi sadaa baiaal ||
english: In the early morning, they continually bark at the wind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਛੁਰਾ ਮੁਠਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kooR chhuraa muthaa muradaar ||
english: Falsehood is my dagger; through deception, I eat the carcasses of the dead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhaanak roop rahaa karataar ||1||
english: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪਤਿ ਕੀ ਪੰਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: mai pat kee pa(n)d na karanee kee kaar ||
english: I have not followed good advice, nor have I done good deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਿਗੜੈ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
transliteration: hau bigaRai roop rahaa bikaraal ||
english: I am deformed and horribly disfigured.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: teraa ek naam taare sa(n)saar ||
english: Your Name alone, Lord, saves the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਆਸ ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mai ehaa aas eho aadhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This is my hope; this is my support. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਆਖਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: mukh ni(n)daa aakhaa din raat ||
english: With my mouth I speak slander, day and night.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਘਰੁ ਜੋਹੀ ਨੀਚ ਸਨਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: par ghar johee neech sanaat ||
english: I spy on the houses of others-I am such a wretched low-life!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh tan vasahi cha(n)daal ||
english: Unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger dwell in my body, like the outcasts who cremate the dead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhaanak roop rahaa karataar ||2||
english: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਾਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਲੂਕੀ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: phaahee surat malookee ves ||
english: I make plans to trap others, although I appear gentle.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਠਗਵਾੜਾ ਠਗੀ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: hau thagavaaRaa thagee des ||
english: I am a robber-I rob the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਰਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kharaa siaanaa bahutaa bhaar ||
english: I am very clever-I carry loads of sin.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhaanak roop rahaa karataar ||3||
english: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mai keetaa na jaataa haraamakhor ||
english: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; I take from others and exploit them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਾ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਚੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hau kiaa muhu desaa dusat chor ||
english: What face shall I show You, Lord? I am a sneak and a thief.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak neech kahai beechaar ||
english: Nanak describes the state of the lowly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੪॥੨੯॥
transliteration: dhaanak roop rahaa karataar ||4||29||
english: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||4||29||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 4 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਹੈ ਜੀਅ ॥
transliteration: ekaa surat jete hai jee ||
english: There is one awareness among all created beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੀਅ ॥
transliteration: surat vihoonaa koi na kee ||
english: None have been created without this awareness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jehee surat tehaa tin raahu ||
english: As is their awareness, so is their way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਇਕੋ ਆਵਹੁ ਜਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lekhaa iko aavahu jaahu ||1||
english: According to the account of our actions, we come and go in reincarnation. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਜੀਅ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaahe jee karahi chaturaaee ||
english: Why, O soul, do you try such clever tricks?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਵੈ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: levai devai dhil na paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Taking away and giving back, God does not delay. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tere jee jeeaa kaa tohi ||
english: All beings belong to You; all beings are Yours. O Lord and Master,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤ ਕਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਆਵਹਿ ਰੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kit kau saahib aavahi rohi ||
english: how can You become angry with them?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਆਵਹਿ ਰੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: je too saahib aavahi rohi ||
english: Even if You, O Lord and Master, become angry with them,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਓਨਾ ਕਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਓਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too onaa kaa tere ohi ||2||
english: still, You are theirs, and they are Yours. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੀ ਬੋਲਵਿਗਾੜ ਵਿਗਾੜਹ ਬੋਲ ॥
transliteration: asee bolavigaaR vigaaRah bol ||
english: We are foul-mouthed; we spoil everything with our foul words.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੋਲਹਿ ਤੋਲ ॥
transliteration: too nadaree a(n)dar tolahi tol ||
english: You weigh us in the balance of Your Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਤਹ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jah karanee tah pooree mat ||
english: When one's actions are right, the understanding is perfect.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karanee baajhahu ghate ghat ||3||
english: Without good deeds, it becomes more and more deficient. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak giaanee kaisaa hoi ||
english: Prays Nanak, what is the nature of the spiritual people?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aap pachhaanai boojhai soi ||
english: They are self-realized; they understand God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad kare beechaar ||
english: By Guru's Grace, they contemplate Him;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੩੦॥
transliteration: so giaanee daragah paravaan ||4||30||
english: such spiritual people are honored in His Court. ||4||30||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 4 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਮੈ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਲਹਾ ॥
transliteration: too dareeaau daanaa beenaa mai machhulee kaise a(n)t lahaa ||
english: You are the River, All-knowing and All-seeing. I am just a fish-how can I find Your limit?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jah jah dekhaa tah tah too hai tujh te nikasee phoot maraa ||1||
english: Wherever I look, You are there. Outside of You, I would burst and die. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: na jaanaa meu na jaanaa jaalee ||
english: I do not know of the fisherman, and I do not know of the net.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa dukh laagai taa tujhai samaalee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: But when the pain comes, then I call upon You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: too bharapoor jaaniaa mai door ||
english: You are present everywhere. I had thought that You were far away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੀ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jo kachh karee s terai hadoor ||
english: Whatever I do, I do in Your Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਹਉ ਮੁਕਰਿ ਪਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too dekhahi hau mukar paau ||
english: You see all my actions, and yet I deny them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: terai ka(n)m na terai naai ||2||
english: I have not worked for You, or Your Name. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਹਉ ਖਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jetaa dehi tetaa hau khaau ||
english: Whatever You give me, that is what I eat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆ ਦਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: biaa dar naahee kai dar jaau ||
english: There is no other door-unto which door should I go?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak ek kahai aradaas ||
english: Nanak offers this one prayer:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh terai paas ||3||
english: this body and soul are totally Yours. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪੇ ਮੰਝਿ ਮਿਆਨੋੁ ॥
transliteration: aape neRai door aape hee aape ma(n)jh miaanou ||
english: He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away; He Himself is in-between.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਹਾਨੋੁ ॥
transliteration: aape vekhai sune aape hee kudarat kare jahaanou ||
english: He Himself beholds, and He Himself listens. By His Creative Power, He created the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਨੋੁ ॥੪॥੩੧॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa hukam soee paravaanou ||4||31||
english: Whatever pleases Him, O Nanak-that Command is acceptable. ||4||31||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 4 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: keetaa kahaa kare man maan ||
english: Why should the created beings feel pride in their minds?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੇ ਕੈ ਹਥਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: devanahaare kai hath daan ||
english: The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaavai dei na deee soi ||
english: As it pleases Him, He may give, or not give.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤੇ ਕੈ ਕਹਿਐ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: keete kai kahiai kiaa hoi ||1||
english: What can be done by the order of the created beings? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ॥
transliteration: aape sach bhaavai tis sach ||
english: He Himself is True; Truth is pleasing to His Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਕਚਾ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhaa kachaa kach nikach ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The spiritually blind are unripe and imperfect, inferior and worthless. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੁਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਆਰਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa ke rukh birakh aaraau ||
english: The One who owns the trees of the forest and the plants of the garden

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਧਾਤੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jehee dhaat tehaa tin naau ||
english: according to their nature, He gives them all their names.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫੁਲੁ ਭਾਉ ਫਲੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: phul bhaau phal likhiaa paai ||
english: The Flower and the Fruit of the Lord's Love are obtained by pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap beej aape hee khaai ||2||
english: As we plant, so we harvest and eat. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਚੀ ਕੰਧ ਕਚਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਜੁ ॥
transliteration: kachee ka(n)dh kachaa vich raaj ||
english: The wall of the body is temporary, as is the soul-mason within it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਫਿਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: mat aloonee phikaa saad ||
english: The flavor of the intellect is bland and insipid without the Salt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਣੇ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak aane aavai raas ||
english: O Nanak, as He wills, He makes things right.

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: vin naavai naahee saabaas ||3||32||
english: Without the Name, no one is approved. ||3||32||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fifth House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਛਲ ਛਲਾਈ ਨਹ ਛਲੈ ਨਹ ਘਾਉ ਕਟਾਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ॥
transliteration: achhal chhalaaee nah chhalai nah ghaau kataaraa kar sakai ||
english: The Undeceiveable is not deceived by deception. He cannot be wounded by any dagger.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਇਸੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਟਲ ਪਲੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu saahib raakhai tiu rahai is lobhee kaa jeeu tal palai ||1||
english: As our Lord and Master keeps us, so do we exist. The soul of this greedy person is tossed this way and that. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਤੇਲ ਦੀਵਾ ਕਿਉ ਜਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin tel deevaa kiu jalai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the oil, how can the lamp be lit? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: pothee puraan kamaaeeai ||
english: Let the reading of your prayer book be the oil,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਵਟੀ ਇਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: bhau vatee it tan paaeeai ||
english: And let the Fear of God be the wick for the lamp of this body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਆਣਿ ਜਲਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sach boojhan aan jalaaeeai ||2||
english: Light this lamp with the understanding of Truth. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੀਵਾ ਇਉ ਜਲੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu tel deevaa iu jalai ||
english: Use this oil to light this lamp.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤਉ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar chaanan saahib tau milai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Light it, and meet your Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: it tan laagai baaneeaa ||
english: This body is softened with the Word of the Guru's Bani;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sukh hovai sev kamaaneeaa ||
english: you shall find peace, doing seva (selfless service).

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh duneeaa aavan jaaneeaa ||3||
english: All the world continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: vich duneeaa sev kamaaeeai ||
english: In the midst of this world, do seva,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: taa daragah baisan paaeeai ||
english: and you shall be given a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੩੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak baah ludaaeeai ||4||33||
english: Says Nanak, swing your arms in joy! ||4||33||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hau satigur sevee aapanaa ik man ik chit bhaai ||
english: I serve my True Guru with single-minded devotion, and lovingly focus my consciousness on Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur man kaamanaa teerath hai jis no dei bujhaai ||
english: The True Guru is the mind's desire and the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, for those unto whom He has given this understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਾ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man chi(n)diaa var paavanaa jo ichhai so phal paai ||
english: The blessings of the wishes of the mind are obtained, and the fruits of one's desires.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naau dhiaaeeai naau ma(n)geeai naame sahaj samaai ||1||
english: Meditate on the Name, worship the Name, and through the Name, you shall be absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man mere har ras chaakh tikh jaai ||
english: O my mind, drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and your thirst shall be quenched.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jinee guramukh chaakhiaa sahaje rahe samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those Gurmukhs who have tasted it remain intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jinee satigur seviaa tinee paaiaa naam nidhaan ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Treasure of the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar har ras rav rahiaa chookaa man abhimaan ||
english: Deep within, they are drenched with the Essence of the Lord, and the egotistical pride of the mind is subdued.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: hiradai kamal pragaasiaa laagaa sahaj dhiaan ||
english: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and they intuitively center themselves in meditation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man niramal har rav rahiaa paaiaa daragahi maan ||2||
english: Their minds become pure, and they remain immersed in the Lord; they are honored in His Court. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevan aapanaa te virale sa(n)saar ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru in this world are very rare.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa maar kai har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
english: Those who keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts subdue egotism and possessiveness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hau tin kai balihaaranai jinaa naame lagaa piaar ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who are in love with the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: seee sukheee chahu jugee jinaa naam akhut apaar ||3||
english: Those who attain the Inexhaustible Name of the Infinite Lord remain happy throughout the four ages. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: gur miliai naam paaeeai chookai moh piaas ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, the Naam is obtained, and the thirst of emotional attachment departs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: har setee man rav rahiaa ghar hee maahi udaas ||
english: When the mind is permeated with the Lord, one remains detached within the home of the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jinaa har kaa saad aaiaa hau tin balihaarai jaas ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who enjoy the Sublime Taste of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai sach naam gunataas ||4||1||34||
english: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence, is obtained. ||4||1||34||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bahu bhekh kar bharamaaeeai man hiradai kapat kamaai ||
english: People wear all sorts of costumes and wander all around, but in their hearts and minds, they practice deception.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਮਰਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kaa mahal na paavaee mar visataa maahi samaai ||1||
english: They do not attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and after death, they sink into manure. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: man re grih hee maahi udaas ||
english: O mind, remain detached in the midst of your household.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sach sa(n)jam karanee so kare guramukh hoi paragaas ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Practicing truth, self-discipline and good deeds, the Gurmukh is enlightened. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad man jeetiaa gat mukat gharai mahi paai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind is conquered, and one attains the State of Liberation in one's own home.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har kaa naam dhiaaeeai satasa(n)gat mel milaai ||2||
english: So meditate on the Name of the Lord; join and merge with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: je lakh isatareeaa bhog karahi nav kha(n)d raaj kamaahi ||
english: You may enjoy the pleasures of hundreds of thousands of women, and rule the nine continents of the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin satagur sukh na paavaee phir phir jonee paahi ||3||
english: But without the True Guru, you will not find peace; you will be reincarnated over and over again. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਹਿਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har haar ka(n)th jinee pahiriaa gur charanee chit laai ||
english: Those who wear the Necklace of the Lord around their necks, and focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਓਨਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tinaa pichhai ridh sidh phirai onaa til na tamaai ||4||
english: -wealth and supernatural spiritual powers follow them, but they do not care for such things at all. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo prabh bhaavai so theeai avar na karanaa jaai ||
english: Whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. Nothing else can be done.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥੩੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak jeevai naam lai har devahu sahaj subhaai ||5||2||35||
english: Servant Nanak lives by chanting the Naam. O Lord, please give it to me, in Your Natural Way. ||5||2||35||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis hee kee sirakaar hai tis hee kaa sabh koi ||
english: Everyone belongs to the One who rules the Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh kaar kamaavanee sach ghat paragat hoi ||
english: The Gurmukh practices good deeds, and the truth is revealed in the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar jis kai sach vasai sache sachee soi ||
english: True is the reputation of the true, within whom truth abides.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sach mile se na vichhuRahi tin nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||1||
english: Those who meet the True Lord are not separated again; they come to dwell in the home of the self deep within. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mere raam mai har bin avar na koi ||
english: O my Lord! Without the Lord, I have no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satagur sach prabh niramalaa sabad milaavaa hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru leads us to meet the Immaculate True God through the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad milai so mil rahai jis nau aape lae milaai ||
english: One whom the Lord merges into Himself is merged in the Shabad, and remains so merged.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕੋ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai ko naa milai phir phir aavai jaai ||
english: No one merges with Him through the love of duality; over and over again, they come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਏਕੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi ik varatadaa eko rahiaa samaai ||
english: The One Lord permeates all. The One Lord is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis nau aap daiaal hoi so guramukh naam samaai ||2||
english: That Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord shows His Kindness, is absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਵਾਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit jotakee vaad karahi beechaar ||
english: After all their reading, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers argue and debate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਭਵੀ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mat budh bhavee na bujhaee a(n)tar lobh vikaar ||
english: Their intellect and understanding are perverted; they just don't understand. They are filled with greed and corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh bharamade bhram bhram hoi khuaar ||
english: Through 8.4 million incarnations they wander lost and confused; through all their wandering and roaming, they are ruined.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa koi na metanahaar ||3||
english: They act according to their pre-ordained destiny, which no one can erase. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satagur kee sevaa gaakhaRee sir deejai aap gavaai ||
english: It is very difficult to serve the True Guru. Surrender your head; give up your selfishness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad milahi taa har milai sevaa pavai sabh thaai ||
english: Realizing the Shabad, one meets with the Lord, and all one's service is accepted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paaras parasiai paaras hoi jotee jot samaai ||
english: By personally experiencing the Personality of the Guru, one's own personality is uplifted, and one's light merges into the Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin satagur miliaa aai ||4||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny come to meet the True Guru. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਭੁਖਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਮਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਤ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: man bhukhaa bhukhaa mat karahi mat too karahi pookaar ||
english: O mind, don't cry out that you are hungry, always hungry; stop complaining.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰੀ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jin siree sabhasai dei adhaar ||
english: The One who created the 8.4 million species of beings gives sustenance to all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau sadaa daiaal hai sabhanaa karadaa saar ||
english: The Fearless Lord is forever Merciful; He takes care of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੩॥੩੬॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh bujheeai paaeeai mokh duaar ||5||3||36||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands, and finds the Door of Liberation. ||5||3||36||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jinee sun kai ma(n)niaa tinaa nij ghar vaas ||
english: Those who hear and believe, find the home of the self deep within.

author: Guru Amardas
