gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: guramatee saalaahi sach har paaiaa gunataas ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, they praise the True Lord; they find the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sabad rate se niramale hau sad balihaarai jaas ||
english: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, they are immaculate and pure. I am forever a sacrifice to them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਹੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hiradai jin kai har vasai tit ghat hai paragaas ||1||
english: Those people, within whose hearts the Lord abides, are radiant and enlightened. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: man mere har har niramal dhiaai ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Immaculate Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhur masatak jin kau likhiaa se guramukh rahe liv laai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those whose have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads-those Gurmukhs remain absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)tahu dekhahu nadar kar nikat vasai bharapoor ||
english: O Saints, see clearly that the Lord is near at hand; He is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramat jinee pachhaaniaa se dekhahi sadaa hadoor ||
english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings realize Him, and see Him Ever-present.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jin gun tin sad man vasai augunava(n)tiaa door ||
english: He dwells forever in the minds of the virtuous. He is far removed from those worthless people who lack virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗੁਣ ਤੈ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਦੇ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: manamukh gun tai baahare bin naavai marade jhoor ||2||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are totally without virtue. Without the Name, they die in frustration. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jin sabad guroo sun ma(n)niaa tin man dhiaaiaa har soi ||
english: Those who hear and believe in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, meditate on the Lord in their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhagatee ratiaa man tan niramal hoi ||
english: Night and day, they are steeped in devotion; their minds and bodies become pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kooRaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kaa binas jaai dukh roi ||
english: The color of the world is false and weak; when it washes away, people cry out in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis a(n)dar naam pragaas hai ohu sadaa sadaa thir hoi ||3||
english: Those who have the Radiant Light of the Naam within, become steady and stable, forever and ever. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu janam padaarath paai kai har naam na chetai liv laai ||
english: The blessing of this human life has been obtained, but still, people do not lovingly focus their thoughts on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਗਿ ਖਿਸਿਐ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਹੀ ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pag khisiai rahanaa nahee aagai thaur na paai ||
english: Their feet slip, and they cannot stay here any longer. And in the next world, they find no place of rest at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: oh velaa hath na aavaee a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaai ||
english: This opportunity shall not come again. In the end, they depart, regretting and repenting.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jis nadar kare so ubarai har setee liv laai ||4||
english: Those whom the Lord blesses with His Glance of Grace are saved; they are lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਾ ਦੇਖੀ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dekhaa dekhee sabh kare manamukh boojh na paai ||
english: They all show off and pretend, but the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਸੇਵ ਪਈ ਤਿਨ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jin guramukh hiradaa sudh hai sev paee tin thaai ||
english: Those Gurmukhs who are pure of heart-their service is accepted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavahi har nit paRahi har gun gaai samaai ||
english: They sing the Glorious Praise of the Lord; they read about the Lord each day. Singing the Praise of the Lord, they merge in absorption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੫॥੪॥੩੭॥
transliteration: naanak tin kee baanee sadaa sach hai j naam rahe liv laai ||5||4||37||
english: O Nanak, the words of those who are lovingly attuned to the Naam are true forever. ||5||4||37||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee ik man naam dhiaaiaa guramatee veechaar ||
english: Those who meditate single-mindedly on the Naam, and contemplate the Teachings of the Guru

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tin ke mukh sad ujale tit sachai darabaar ||
english: -their faces are forever radiant in the Court of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: oi a(n)mrit peevahi sadaa sadaa sachai naam piaar ||1||
english: They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar forever and ever, and they love the True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re guramukh sadaa pat hoi ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, the Gurmukhs are honored forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har sadaa dhiaaeeai mal haumai kadhai dhoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har, and they wash off the filth of egotism. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh naam na jaananee vin naavai pat jaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Naam. Without the Name, they lose their honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabadai saad na aaio laage doojai bhaai ||
english: They do not savor the Taste of the Shabad; they are attached to the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਪਵਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਸੇ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: visataa ke keeRe pavahi vich visataa se visataa maahi samaai ||2||
english: They are worms in the filth of manure. They fall into manure, and into manure they are absorbed. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tin kaa janam saphal hai jo chalahi satagur bhaai ||
english: Fruitful are the lives of those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kul udhaarahi aapanaa dha(n)n janedee maai ||
english: Their families are saved; blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har naam dhiaaeeai jis nau kirapaa kare rajaai ||3||
english: By His Will He grants His Grace; those who are so blessed, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jinee guramukh naam dhiaaiaa vichahu aap gavaai ||
english: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; they eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: oi a(n)darahu baaharahu niramale sache sach samaai ||
english: They are pure, inwardly and outwardly; they merge into the Truest of the True.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੮॥
transliteration: naanak aae se paravaan hahi jin guramatee har dhiaai ||4||5||38||
english: O Nanak, blessed is the coming of those who follow the Guru's Teachings and meditate on the Lord. ||4||5||38||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har bhagataa har dhan raas hai gur poochh karahi vaapaar ||
english: The devotees of the Lord have the Wealth and Capital of the Lord; with Guru's Advice, they carry on their trade.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har naam salaahan sadaa sadaa vakhar har naam adhaar ||
english: They praise the Name of the Lord forever and ever. The Name of the Lord is their Merchandise and Support.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਅਤੁਟੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur poorai har naam driRaaiaa har bhagataa atut bha(n)daar ||1||
english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord into the Lord's devotees; it is an Inexhaustible Treasure. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re is man kau samajhaai ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, instruct your minds in this way.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: e man aalas kiaa karahi guramukh naam dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O mind, why are you so lazy? Become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Naam. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har bhagat har kaa piaar hai je guramukh kare beechaar ||
english: Devotion to the Lord is love for the Lord. The Gurmukh reflects deeply and contemplates.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬੋਲੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d bhagat na hovaee dubidhaa bol khuaar ||
english: Hypocrisy is not devotion-speaking words of duality leads only to misery.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so jan ralaaiaa naa ralai jis a(n)tar bibek beechaar ||2||
english: Those humble beings who are filled with keen understanding and meditative contemplation-even though they intermingle with others, they remain distinct. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: so sevak har aakheeai jo har raakhai ur dhaar ||
english: Those who keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts are said to be the servants of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man tan saupe aagai dhare haumai vichahu maar ||
english: Placing mind and body in offering before the Lord, they conquer and eradicate egotism from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhan guramukh so paravaan hai j kade na aavai haar ||3||
english: Blessed and acclaimed is that Gurmukh, who shall never be defeated. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: karam milai taa paaeeai vin karamai paaiaa na jaai ||
english: Those who receive His Grace find Him. Without His Grace, He cannot be found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh tarasade jis mele so milai har aai ||
english: The 8.4 million species of beings all yearn for the Lord. Those whom He unites, come to be united with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੬॥੩੯॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh har paaiaa sadaa har naam samaai ||4||6||39||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord, and remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||4||6||39||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar har naam hai guramukh paaiaa jaai ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the Ocean of Peace; the Gurmukhs obtain it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin naam dhiaaeeai sahaje naam samaai ||
english: Meditating on the Naam, night and day, they are easily and intuitively absorbed in the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਰਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)dar rachai har sach siu rasanaa har gun gaai ||1||
english: Their inner beings are immersed in the True Lord; they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re jag dukheeaa doojai bhaai ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, the world is in misery, engrossed in the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur saranaaee sukh lahahi anadin naam dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the Sanctuary of the Guru, peace is found, meditating on the Naam night and day. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: saache mail na laagaee man niramal har dhiaai ||
english: The truthful ones are not stained by filth. Meditating on the Lord, their minds remain pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sabad pachhaaneeai har a(n)mrit naam samaai ||
english: The Gurmukhs realize the Word of the Shabad; they are immersed in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur giaan pracha(n)d balaaiaa agiaan a(n)dheraa jaai ||2||
english: The Guru has lit the brilliant light of spiritual wisdom, and the darkness of ignorance has been dispelled. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh maile mal bhare haumai trisanaa vikaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are polluted. They are filled with the pollution of egotism, wickedness and desire.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai mail na utarai mar ja(n)mahi hoi khuaar ||
english: Without the Shabad, this pollution is not washed off; through the cycle of death and rebirth, they waste away in misery.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਲਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhaatur baajee palach rahe naa uravaar na paar ||3||
english: Engrossed in this transitory drama, they are not at home in either this world or the next. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jap tap sa(n)jamee har kai naam piaar ||
english: For the Gurmukh, the love of the Name of the Lord is chanting, deep meditation and self-discipline.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sadaa dhiaaeeai ek naam karataar ||
english: The Gurmukh meditates forever on the Name of the One Creator Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeeai sabhanaa jeeaa kaa aadhaar ||4||7||40||
english: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Support of all beings. ||4||7||40||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sreeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mohi viaapiaa bairaag udaasee na hoi ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment; they are not balanced or detached.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad na cheenai sadaa dukh har daragahi pat khoi ||
english: They do not comprehend the Word of the Shabad. They suffer in pain forever, and lose their honor in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਈਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haumai guramukh khoeeai naam rate sukh hoi ||1||
english: The Gurmukhs shed their ego; attuned to the Naam, they find peace. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man ahinis poor rahee nit aasaa ||
english: O my mind, day and night, you are always full of wishful hopes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰਜਲੈ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satagur sev mohu parajalai ghar hee maahi udaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Serve the True Guru, and your emotional attachment shall be totally burnt away; remain detached within the home of your heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh karam kamaavai bigasai har bairaag ana(n)d ||
english: The Gurmukhs do good deeds and blossom forth; balanced and detached in the Lord, they are in ecstasy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਚੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: ahinis bhagat kare din raatee haumai maar nicha(n)d ||
english: Night and day, they perform devotional worship, day and night; subduing their ego, they are carefree.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag satasa(n)gat paaee har paaiaa sahaj ana(n)d ||2||
english: By great good fortune, I found the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; I have found the Lord, with intuitive ease and ecstasy. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: so saadhoo bairaagee soee hiradai naam vasaae ||
english: That person is a Holy Saadhu, and a renouncer of the world, whose heart is filled with the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਮੂਲੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar laag na taamas moole vichahu aap gavaae ||
english: His inner being is not touched by anger or dark energies at all; he has lost his selfishness and conceit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਅਘਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan sataguroo dikhaaliaa har ras peeaa aghaae ||3||
english: The True Guru has revealed to him the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and is satisfied. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: jin kinai paaiaa saadhasa(n)gatee poorai bhaag bairaag ||
english: Whoever has found it, has done so in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Through perfect good fortune, such balanced detachment is attained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh phirahi na jaanahi satagur haumai a(n)dar laag ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs wander around lost, but they do not know the True Guru. They are inwardly attached to egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਕੇਹੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੧॥
transliteration: naanak sabad rate har naam ra(n)gaae bin bhai kehee laag ||4||8||41||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Shabad are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Name. Without the Fear of God, how can they retain this Color? ||4||8||41||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ghar hee saudaa paaeeai a(n)tar sabh vath hoi ||
english: Within the home of your own inner being, the merchandise is obtained. All commodities are within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: khin khin naam samaaleeai guramukh paavai koi ||
english: Each and every moment, dwell on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukhs obtain it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan akhut hai vadabhaag paraapat hoi ||1||
english: The Treasure of the Naam is inexhaustible. By great good fortune, it is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mere man taj ni(n)daa haumai aha(n)kaar ||
english: O my mind, give up slander, egotism and arrogance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu sadaa dhiaai too guramukh eka(n)kaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Become Gurmukh, and meditate forever on the Dear Lord, the One and Only Creator. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukhaa ke mukh ujale gurasabadee beechaar ||
english: The faces of the Gurmukhs are radiant and bright; they reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: halat palat sukh paaide jap jap ridai muraar ||
english: They obtain peace in this world and the next, chanting and meditating within their hearts on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghar hee vich mahal paaiaa gurasabadee veechaar ||2||
english: Within the home of their own inner being, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, reflecting on the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫੇਰਹਿ ਮਥੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: satagur te jo muh pherahi mathe tin kaale ||
english: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru shall have their faces blackened.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਜੋਹੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: anadin dukh kamaavade nit johe jam jaale ||
english: Night and day, they suffer in pain; they see the noose of Death always hovering above them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਨੀ ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਪਰਜਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: supanai sukh na dekhanee bahu chi(n)taa parajaale ||3||
english: Even in their dreams, they find no peace; they are consumed by the fires of intense anxiety. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa kaa daataa ek hai aape bakhas karei ||
english: The One Lord is the Giver of all; He Himself bestows all blessings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਵਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: kahanaa kichhoo na jaavaee jis bhaavai tis dei ||
english: No one else has any say in this; He gives just as He pleases.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੪੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh paaeeai aape jaanai soi ||4||9||42||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs obtain Him; He Himself knows Himself. ||4||9||42||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib seveeai sach vadiaaee dei ||
english: Serve your True Lord and Master, and you shall be blessed with true greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee man vasai haumai door karei ||
english: By Guru's Grace, He abides in the mind, and egotism is driven out.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਤਾ ਰਹੈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ihu man dhaavat taa rahai jaa aape nadar karei ||1||
english: This wandering mind comes to rest, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re guramukh har naam dhiaai ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan sad man vasai mahalee paavai thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Treasure of the Naam abides forever within the mind, and one's place of rest is found in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਨਉ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: manamukh man tan a(n)dh hai tis nau thaur na thaau ||
english: The minds and bodies of the self-willed manmukhs are filled with darkness; they find no shelter, no place of rest.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਉਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈਂ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bahu jonee bhaudaa phirai jiu su(n)njai(n) ghar kaau ||
english: Through countless incarnations they wander lost, like crows in a deserted house.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramatee ghat chaananaa sabad milai har naau ||2||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the heart is illuminated. Through the Shabad, the Name of the Lord is received. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: trai gun bikhiaa a(n)dh hai maaiaa moh gubaar ||
english: In the corruption of the three qualities, there is blindness; in attachment to Maya, there is darkness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੀ ਅਨ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਪੜਿ ਵੇਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: lobhee an kau sevade paR vedaa karai pookaar ||
english: The greedy people serve others, instead of the Lord, although they loudly announce their reading of scriptures.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bikhiaa a(n)dar pach mue naa uravaar na paar ||3||
english: They are burnt to death by their own corruption; they are not at home, on either this shore or the one beyond. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi visaariaa jagat pitaa pratipaal ||
english: In attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Father, the Cherisher of the World.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਬਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: baajhahu guroo achet hai sabh badhee jamakaal ||
english: Without the Guru, all are unconscious; they are held in bondage by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੩॥
transliteration: naanak guramat ubare sachaa naam samaal ||4||10||43||
english: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be saved, contemplating the True Name. ||4||10||43||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਉਥਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: trai gun maaiaa mohu hai guramukh chauthaa pad paai ||
english: The three qualities hold people in attachment to Maya. The Gurmukh attains the fourth state of higher consciousness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa melaaian har naam vasiaa man aai ||
english: Granting His Grace, God unites us with Himself. The Name of the Lord comes to abide within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੋਤੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: potai jin kai pu(n)n hai tin satasa(n)gat melaai ||1||
english: Those who have the treasure of goodness join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re guramat saach rahaau ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, follow the Guru's Teachings and dwell in truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saacho saach kamaavanaa saachai sabad milaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Practice truth, and only truth, and merge in the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jinee naam pachhaaniaa tin vitahu bal jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who recognize the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਾ ਚਲਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aap chhod charanee lagaa chalaa tin kai bhaai ||
english: Renouncing selfishness, I fall at their feet, and walk in harmony with His Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: laahaa har har naam milai sahaje naam samaai ||2||
english: Earning the Profit of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am intuitively absorbed in the Naam. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur mahal na paaeeai naam na paraapat hoi ||
english: Without the Guru, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not found, and the Naam is not obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਦੂ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa satagur loR lahu jidoo paaeeai sach soi ||
english: Seek and find such a True Guru, who shall lead you to the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: asur sa(n)ghaarai sukh vasai jo tis bhaavai s hoi ||3||
english: Destroy your evil passions, and you shall dwell in peace. Whatever pleases the Lord comes to pass. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jehaa satagur kar jaaniaa teho jehaa sukh hoi ||
english: As one knows the True Guru, so is the peace obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ehu sahasaa moole naahee bhaau laae jan koi ||
english: There is no doubt at all about this, but those who love Him are very rare.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਮੂਰਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੪੪॥
transliteration: naanak ek jot dui mooratee sabad milaavaa hoi ||4||11||44||
english: O Nanak, the One Light has two forms; through the Shabad, union is attained. ||4||11||44||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਾਣੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit chhod bikhiaa lobhaane sevaa karahi vidaanee ||
english: Discarding the Ambrosial Nectar, they greedily grab the poison; they serve others, instead of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa dharam gavaavahi boojhahi naahee anadin dukh vihaanee ||
english: They lose their faith, they have no understanding; night and day, they suffer in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਹੀ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dh na chetahee doob mue bin paanee ||1||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not even think of the Lord; they are drowned to death without water. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਭਜਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man re sadaa bhajahu har saranaaee ||
english: O mind, vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord; seek the Protection of His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad a(n)tar vasai taa har visar na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides deep within, then you shall not forget the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ihu sareer maaiaa kaa putalaa vich haumai dusatee paaee ||
english: This body is the puppet of Maya. The evil of egotism is within it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa ja(n)man maranaa manamukh pat gavaaee ||
english: Coming and going through birth and death, the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satagur sev sadaa sukh paaiaa jotee jot milaaee ||2||
english: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained, and one's light merges into the Light. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satagur kee sevaa at sukhaalee jo ichhe so phal paae ||
english: Serving the True Guru brings a deep and profound peace, and one's desires are fulfilled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਤਪੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jat sat tap pavit sareeraa har har ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: Abstinence, truthfulness and self-discipline are obtained, and the body is purified; the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahai din raatee mil preetam sukh paae ||3||
english: Such a person remains blissful forever, day and night. Meeting the Beloved, peace is found. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo satagur kee saranaagatee hau tin kai bal jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dar sachai sachee vadiaaee sahaje sach samaau ||
english: In the Court of the True One, they are blessed with true greatness; they are intuitively absorbed into the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੪੫॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai guramukh mel milaau ||4||12||45||
english: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace He is found; the Gurmukh is united in His Union. ||4||12||45||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਜਿਉ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh karam kamaavane jiu dohaagan tan seegaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukh performs religious rituals, like the unwanted bride decorating her body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sejai ka(n)t na aavaee nit nit hoi khuaar ||
english: Her Husband Lord does not come to her bed; day after day, she grows more and more miserable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਨਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pir kaa mahal na paavaee naa deesai ghar baar ||1||
english: She does not attain the Mansion of His Presence; she does not find the door to His House. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re ik man naam dhiaai ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, meditate on the Naam with one-pointed mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa sa(n)gat mil rahai jap raam naam sukh paai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Remain united with the Society of the Saints; chant the Name of the Lord, and find peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sadaa sohaaganee pir raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
english: The Gurmukh is the happy and pure soul-bride forever. She keeps her Husband Lord enshrined within her heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mithaa bolahi niv chalahi sejai ravai bhataar ||
english: Her speech is sweet, and her way of life is humble. She enjoys the Bed of her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਹੇਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sobhaava(n)tee sohaaganee jin gur kaa het apaar ||2||
english: The happy and pure soul-bride is noble; she has infinite love for the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਭਾਗੈ ਕਾ ਉਦਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag satagur milai jaa bhaagai kaa udau hoi ||
english: By perfect good fortune, one meets the True Guru, when one's destiny is awakened.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarahu dukh bhram kateeai sukh paraapat hoi ||
english: Suffering and doubt are cut out from within, and peace is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kai bhaanai jo chalai dukh na paavai koi ||3||
english: One who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will shall not suffer in pain. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur ke bhaane vich a(n)mrit hai sahaje paavai koi ||
english: The Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar, is in the Guru's Will. With intuitive ease, it is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jinaa paraapat tin peeaa haumai vichahu khoi ||
english: Those who are destined to have it, drink it in; their egotism is eradicated from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੪੬॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh naam dhiaaeeai sach milaavaa hoi ||4||13||46||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and is united with the True Lord. ||4||13||46||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਗੈ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa pir jaanai aapanaa tan man agai dharei ||
english: If you know that He is your Husband Lord, offer your body and mind to Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੀਆ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: sohaaganee karam kamaavadeeaa seee karam karei ||
english: Behave like the happy and pure soul-bride.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sahaje saach milaavaRaa saach vadaaee dei ||1||
english: With intuitive ease, you shall merge with the True Lord, and He shall bless you with true greatness. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re gur bin bhagat na hoi ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin gur bhagat na paaeeai je lochai sabh koi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Guru, devotion is not obtained, even though everyone may long for it. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh pher paiaa kaaman doojai bhaai ||
english: The soul-bride in love with duality goes around the wheel of reincarnation, through 8.4 million incarnations.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur need na aavaee dukhee rain vihaai ||
english: Without the Guru, she finds no sleep, and she passes her life-night in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin sabadai pir na paaeeai birathaa janam gavaai ||2||
english: Without the Shabad, she does not find her Husband Lord, and her life wastes away in vain. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ ਨਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: hau hau karatee jag phiree naa dhan sa(n)pai naal ||
english: Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, she wanders around the world, but her wealth and property will not go with her.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਸਭ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhee naam na chetaee sabh baadhee jamakaal ||
english: The spiritually blind do not even think of the Naam; they are all bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satagur miliai dhan paaiaa har naamaa ridai samaal ||3||
english: Meeting the True Guru, the wealth is obtained, contemplating the Name of the Lord in the heart. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naam rate se niramale gur kai sahaj subhaai ||
english: Those who are attuned to the Naam are immaculate and pure; through the Guru, they obtain intuitive peace and poise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan raataa ra(n)g siu rasanaa rasan rasaai ||
english: Their minds and bodies are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Love, and their tongues savor His Sublime Essence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੪੭॥
transliteration: naanak ra(n)g na utarai jo har dhur chhodiaa laai ||4||14||47||
english: O Nanak, that Primal Color which the Lord has applied, shall never fade away. ||4||14||47||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh kripaa kare bhagat keejai bin gur bhagat na hoee ||
english: By His Grace one becomes Gurmukh, worshipping the Lord with devotion. Without the Guru there is no devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aapai aap milaae boojhai taa niramal hovai soee ||
english: Those whom He unites with Himself, understand and become pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har jeeu saachaa saachee baanee sabad milaavaa hoee ||1||
english: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Shabad, we merge with Him. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re bhagatiheen kaahe jag aaiaa ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny: those who lack devotion-why have they even bothered to come into the world?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kee sev na keenee birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They do not serve the Perfect Guru; they waste away their lives in vain. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape jagajeevan sukhadaataa aape bakhas milaae ||
english: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver of Peace. He Himself forgives, and unites with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਏ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t e kiaa vechaare kiaa ko aakh sunaae ||
english: So what about all these poor beings and creatures? What can anyone say?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh aape dei vadaaee aape sev karaae ||2||
english: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glory. He Himself enjoins us to His Service. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dekh kuta(n)b mohi lobhaanaa chaladiaa naal na jaaee ||
english: Gazing upon their families, people are lured and trapped by emotional attachment, but none will go along with them in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satagur sev gun nidhaan paaiaa tis dee keem na paaee ||
english: Serving the True Guru, one finds the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence. His Value cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਖਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har prabh sakhaa meet prabh meraa a(n)te hoi sakhaaee ||3||
english: The Lord God is my Friend and Companion. God shall be my Helper and Support in the end. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aapanai man chit kahai kahaae bin gur aap na jaaee ||
english: Within your conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru, selfishness is not removed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu daataa bhagat vachhal hai kar kirapaa ma(n)n vasaaee ||
english: The Dear Lord is the Giver, the Lover of His devotees. By His Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੪੮॥
transliteration: naanak sobhaa surat dei prabh aape guramukh de vadiaaee ||4||15||48||
english: O Nanak, by His Grace, He bestows enlightened awareness; God Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness. ||4||15||48||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਜਨਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਇਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: dhan jananee jin jaaiaa dha(n)n pitaa paradhaan ||
english: Blessed is the mother who gave birth; blessed and respected is the father of one who serves the True Guru and finds peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: satagur sev sukh paaiaa vichahu gaiaa gumaan ||
english: His arrogant pride is banished from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਖੜੇ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dar sevan sa(n)t jan khaRe paain gunee nidhaan ||1||
english: Standing at the Lord's Door, the humble Saints serve Him; they find the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man gur mukh dhiaai har soi ||
english: O my mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad man vasai man tan niramal hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and the body and mind become pure. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa ghar aaiaa aape miliaa aai ||
english: By His Grace, He has come into my home; He Himself has come to meet me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਰੰਗੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee saalaaheeai ra(n)ge sahaj subhaai ||
english: Singing His Praises through the Shabads of the Guru, we are dyed in His Color with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sachai sach samaaiaa mil rahai na vichhuR jaai ||2||
english: Becoming truthful, we merge with the True One; remaining blended with Him, we shall never be separated again. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karanaa s kar rahiaa avar na karanaa jaai ||
english: Whatever is to be done, the Lord is doing. No one else can do anything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chiree vichhu(n)ne melian satagur pa(n)nai paai ||
english: Those separated from Him for so long are reunited with Him once again by the True Guru, who takes them into His Own Account.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਸੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape kaar karaaisee avar na karanaa jaai ||3||
english: He Himself assigns all to their tasks; nothing else can be done. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: man tan rataa ra(n)g siu haumai taj vikaar ||
english: One whose mind and body are imbued with the Lord's Love gives up egotism and corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ahinis hiradai rav rahai nirabhau naam nira(n)kaar ||
english: Day and night, the Name of the One Lord, the Fearless and Formless One, dwells within the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੪੯॥
transliteration: naanak aap milaaian poorai sabad apaar ||4||16||49||
english: O Nanak, He blends us with Himself, through the Perfect, Infinite Word of His Shabad. ||4||16||49||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: govid gunee nidhaan hai a(n)t na paaiaa jaai ||
english: The Lord of the Universe is the Treasure of Excellence; His limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kathanee badanee na paaeeai haumai vichahu jaai ||
english: He is not obtained by mouthing mere words, but by rooting out ego from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦ ਭੈ ਰਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satagur miliai sad bhai rachai aap vasai man aai ||1||
english: Meeting the True Guru, one is permeated forever with the Fear of God, who Himself comes to dwell within the mind. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re guramukh boojhai koi ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, one who becomes Gurmukh and understands this is very rare.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin boojhe karam kamaavane janam padaarath khoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: To act without understanding is to lose the treasure of this human life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਾਖੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jinee chaakhiaa tinee saad paaiaa bin chaakhe bharam bhulaai ||
english: Those who have tasted it, enjoy its flavor; without tasting it, they wander in doubt, lost and deceived.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit saachaa naam hai kahanaa kachhoo na jaai ||
english: The True Name is the Ambrosial Nectar; no one can describe it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਤ ਹੂ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: peevat hoo paravaan bhaiaa poorai sabad samaai ||2||
english: Drinking it in, one becomes honorable, absorbed in the Perfect Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape dei ta paaeeai hor karanaa kichhoo na jaai ||
english: He Himself gives, and then we receive. Nothing else can be done.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੈ ਹਥਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: devan vaale kai hath daat hai guroo duaarai paai ||
english: The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver. At the Guru's Door, in the Gurdwara, it is received.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਹੋਆ ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jehaa keeton tehaa hoaa jehe karam kamaai ||3||
english: Whatever He does, comes to pass. All act according to His Will. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jat sat sa(n)jam naam hai vin naavai niramal na hoi ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is abstinence, truthfulness, and self-restraint. Without the Name, no one becomes pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag naam man vasai sabad milaavaa hoi ||
english: Through perfect good fortune, the Naam comes to abide within the mind. Through the Shabad, we merge into Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੫੦॥
transliteration: naanak sahaje hee ra(n)g varatadaa har gun paavai soi ||4||17||50||
english: O Nanak, one who lives in intuitive peace and poise, imbued with the Lord's Love, obtains the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||17||50||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਸਾਧੈ ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਕਰੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaa(n)iaa saadhai uradh tap karai vichahu haumai na jaai ||
english: You may torment your body with extremes of self-discipline, practice intensive meditation and hang upside-down, but your ego will not be eliminated from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਕਰਮ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: adhiaatam karam je kare naam na kab hee paai ||
english: You may perform religious rituals, and still never obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad jeevat marai har naam vasai man aai ||1||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remain dead while yet alive, and the Name of the Lord shall come to dwell within the mind. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਜੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sun man mere bhaj satagur saranaa ||
english: Listen, O my mind: hurry to the Protection of the Guru's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee chhuteeai bikh bhavajal sabad gur taranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace you shall be saved. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean of poison. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: trai gun sabhaa dhaat hai doojaa bhaau vikaar ||
english: Everything under the influence of the three qualities shall perish; the love of duality is corrupting.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਪੜੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਾਧਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit paRai ba(n)dhan moh baadhaa nah boojhai bikhiaa piaar ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read the scriptures, but they are trapped in the bondage of emotional attachment. In love with evil, they do not understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satagur miliai trikutee chhootai chauthai pad mukat duaar ||2||
english: Meeting the Guru, the bondage of the three qualities is cut away, and in the fourth state, the Door of Liberation is attained. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur te maarag paaeeai chookai mohu gubaar ||
english: Through the Guru, the Path is found, and the darkness of emotional attachment is dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਉਧਰੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabad marai taa udharai paae mokh duaar ||
english: If one dies through the Shabad, then salvation is obtained, and one finds the Door of Liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee mil rahai sach naam karataar ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, one remains blended with the True Name of the Creator. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਤਿ ਸਬਲ ਹੈ ਛਡੇ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu manooaa at sabal hai chhade na kitai upaai ||
english: This mind is very powerful; we cannot escape it just by trying.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai dukh laaidaa bahutee dei sajaai ||
english: In the love of duality, people suffer in pain, condemned to terrible punishment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੫੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam lage se ubare haumai sabad gavaai ||4||18||51||
english: O Nanak, those who are attached to the Naam are saved; through the Shabad, their ego is banished. ||4||18||51||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa kare gur paaeeai har naamo dei driRaai ||
english: By His Grace, the Guru is found, and the Name of the Lord is implanted within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur kinai na paaio birathaa janam gavaai ||
english: Without the Guru, no one has obtained it; they waste away their lives in vain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: manamukh karam kamaavane daragah milai sajaai ||1||
english: The self-willed manmukhs create karma, and in the Court of the Lord, they receive their punishment. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man re doojaa bhaau chukaai ||
english: O mind, give up the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar terai har vasai gur sevaa sukh paai || rahaau ||
english: The Lord dwells within you; serving the Guru, you shall find peace. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sach baanee sach sabad hai jaa sach dhare piaar ||
english: When you love the Truth, your words are true; they reflect the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam man vasai haumai krodh nivaar ||
english: The Name of the Lord dwells within the mind; egotism and anger are wiped away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man niramal naam dhiaaeeai taa paae mokh duaar ||2||
english: Meditating on the Naam with a pure mind, the Door of Liberation is found. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਦਾ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai vich jag binasadaa mar ja(n)mai aavai jaai ||
english: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. It dies and is re-born; it continues coming and going in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sabad na jaananee jaasan pat gavaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not recognize the Shabad; they forfeit their honor, and depart in disgrace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur sevaa naau paaeeai sache rahai samaai ||3||
english: Serving the Guru, the Name is obtained, and one remains absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad ma(n)niai gur paaeeai vichahu aap gavaai ||
english: With faith in the Shabad, the Guru is found, and selfishness is eradicated from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat kare sadaa saache kee liv laai ||
english: Night and day, worship the True Lord with devotion and love forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੫੨॥
transliteration: naam padaarath man vasiaa naanak sahaj samaai ||4||19||52||
english: The Treasure of the Naam abides in the mind; O Nanak, in the poise of perfect balance, merge into the Lord. ||4||19||52||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee purakhee satagur na sevio se dukheee jug chaar ||
english: Those who do not serve the True Guru shall be miserable throughout the four ages.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ghar hodaa purakh na pachhaaniaa abhimaan muthe aha(n)kaar ||
english: The Primal Being is within their own home, but they do not recognize Him. They are plundered by their egotistical pride and arrogance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਫਿਟਕਿਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sataguroo kiaa phitakiaa ma(n)g thake sa(n)saar ||
english: Cursed by the True Guru, they wander around the world begging, until they are exhausted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sachaa sabad na sevio sabh kaaj savaaranahaar ||1||
english: They do not serve the True Word of the Shabad, which is the solution to all of their problems. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man mere sadaa har vekh hadoor ||
english: O my mind, see the Lord ever close at hand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh paraharai sabad rahiaa bharapoor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He shall remove the pains of death and rebirth; the Word of the Shabad shall fill you to overflowing. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sach salaahan se sache sachaa naam adhaar ||
english: Those who praise the True One are true; the True Name is their Support.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sachee kaar kamaavanee sache naal piaar ||
english: They act truthfully, in love with the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahu varatadaa koi na metanahaar ||
english: The True King has written His Order, which no one can erase.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: manamukh mahal na paainee kooR muthe kooRiaar ||2||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. The false are plundered by falsehood. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: haumai karataa jag muaa gur bin ghor a(n)dhaar ||
english: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. Without the Guru, there is utter darkness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi visaariaa sukhadaataa daataar ||
english: In emotional attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Great Giver, the Giver of Peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satagur sevahi taa ubarahi sach rakhahi ur dhaar ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru are saved; they keep the True One enshrined in their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kirapaa te har paaeeai sach sabad veechaar ||3||
english: By His Grace, we find the Lord, and reflect on the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: satagur sev man niramalaa haumai taj vikaar ||
english: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate and pure; egotism and corruption are discarded.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aap chhod jeevat marai gur kai sabad veechaar ||
english: So abandon your selfishness, and remain dead while yet alive. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa dhaavat rahi gae laagaa saach piaar ||
english: The pursuit of worldly affairs comes to an end, when you embrace love for the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sach rate mukh ujale tit saachai darabaar ||4||
english: Those who are attuned to Truth-their faces are radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satagur purakh na ma(n)nio sabad na lago piaar ||
english: Those who do not have faith in the Primal Being, the True Guru, and who do not enshrine love for the Shabad

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: isanaan daan jetaa karahi doojai bhaai khuaar ||
english: they take their cleansing baths, and give to charity again and again, but they are ultimately consumed by their love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu aapanee kripaa kare taa laagai naam piaar ||
english: When the Dear Lord Himself grants His Grace, they are inspired to love the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੫॥੨੦॥੫੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam samaal too gur kai het apaar ||5||20||53||
english: O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, through the Infinite Love of the Guru. ||5||20||53||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਸੇਵੀ ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੀ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kis hau sevee kiaa jap karee satagur poochhau jaai ||
english: Whom shall I serve? What shall I chant? I will go and ask the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satagur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)n laee vichahu aap gavaai ||
english: I will accept the Will of the True Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: ehaa sevaa chaakaree naam vasai man aai ||
english: By this work and service, the Naam shall come to dwell within my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naamai hee te sukh paaeeai sachai sabad suhaai ||1||
english: Through the Naam, peace is obtained; I am adorned and embellished by the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ॥
transliteration: man mere anadin jaag har chet ||
english: O my mind, remain awake and aware night and day, and think of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੈ ਕੂੰਜ ਪੜੈਗੀ ਖੇਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aapanee khetee rakh lai koo(n)j paRaigee khet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Protect your crops, or else the birds shall descend on your farm. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man keeaa ichhaa pooreeaa sabad rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: The desires of the mind are fulfilled, when one is filled to overflowing with the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhai bhaai bhagat karahi din raatee har jeeu vekhai sadaa hadoor ||
english: One who fears, loves, and is devoted to the Dear Lord day and night, sees Him always close at hand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad sadaa man raataa bhram gaiaa sareerahu door ||
english: Doubt runs far away from the bodies of those, whose minds remain forever attuned to the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: niramal saahib paaiaa saachaa gunee gaheer ||2||
english: The Immaculate Lord and Master is found. He is True; He is the Ocean of Excellence. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸੂਤੇ ਗਏ ਮੁਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo jaage se ubare soote gae muhaai ||
english: Those who remain awake and aware are saved, while those who sleep are plundered.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਓ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sachaa sabad na pachhaanio supanaa gaiaa vihaai ||
english: They do not recognize the True Word of the Shabad, and like a dream, their lives fade away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਞੇ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: su(n)nje ghar kaa paahunaa jiu aaiaa tiu jaai ||
english: Like guests in a deserted house, they leave just exactly as they have come.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: manamukh janam birathaa gaiaa kiaa muhu desee jaai ||3||
english: The life of the self-willed manmukh passes uselessly. What face will he show when he passes beyond? ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap hai haumai vich kahan na jaai ||
english: God Himself is everything; those who are in their ego cannot even speak of this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad pachhaaneeai dukh haumai vichahu gavaai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized, and the pain of egotism is eradicated from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satagur sevan aapanaa hau tin kai laagau paai ||
english: I fall at the feet of those who serve their True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਹਹਿ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੫੪॥
transliteration: naanak dar sachai sachiaar hahi hau tin balihaarai jaau ||4||21||54||
english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who are found to be true in the True Court. ||4||21||54||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਤਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: je velaa vakhat veechaareeai taa kit velaa bhagat hoi ||
english: Consider the time and the moment-when should we worship the Lord?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin naame ratiaa sache sachee soi ||
english: Night and day, one who is attuned to the Name of the True Lord is true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ik til piaaraa visarai bhagat kinehee hoi ||
english: If someone forgets the Beloved Lord, even for an instant, what sort of devotion is that?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਚ ਸਿਉ ਸਾਸੁ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man tan seetal saach siu saas na birathaa koi ||1||
english: One whose mind and body are cooled and soothed by the True Lord-no breath of his is wasted. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man har kaa naam dhiaai ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saachee bhagat taa theeai jaa har vasai man aai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: True devotional worship is performed when the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sahaje khetee raaheeai sach naam beej paai ||
english: With intuitive ease, cultivate your farm, and plant the Seed of the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖੇਤੀ ਜੰਮੀ ਅਗਲੀ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਜਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khetee ja(n)mee agalee manooaa rajaa sahaj subhaai ||
english: The seedlings have sprouted luxuriantly, and with intuitive ease, the mind is satisfied.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad a(n)mrit hai jit peetai tikh jaai ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, thirst is quenched.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ihu man saachaa sach rataa sache rahiaa samaai ||2||
english: This true mind is attuned to Truth, and it remains permeated with the True One. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aakhan vekhan bolanaa sabade rahiaa samaai ||
english: In speaking, in seeing and in words, remain immersed in the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਵਜੀ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baanee vajee chahu jugee sacho sach sunaai ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Bani vibrates throughout the four ages. As Truth, it teaches Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਲਇਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai meraa rahi gaiaa sachai laiaa milaai ||
english: Egotism and possessiveness are eliminated, and the True One absorbs them into Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tin kau mahal hadoor hai jo sach rahe liv laai ||3||
english: Those who remain lovingly absorbed in the True One see the Mansion of His Presence close at hand. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: nadaree naam dhiaaeeai vin karamaa paaiaa na jaai ||
english: By His Grace, we meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Without His Mercy, it cannot be obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਹੈ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag satasa(n)gat lahai satagur bhetai jis aai ||
english: Through perfect good destiny, one finds the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and one comes to meet the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin naame ratiaa dukh bikhiaa vichahu jaai ||
english: Night and day, remain attuned to the Naam, and the pain of corruption shall be dispelled from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੫੫॥
transliteration: naanak sabad milaavaRaa naame naam samaai ||4||22||55||
english: O Nanak, merging with the Shabad through the Name, one is immersed in the Name. ||4||22||55||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa bhau tin paaion jin gur kaa sabad beechaar ||
english: Those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad are filled with the Fear of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gatee sadaa mil rahe sache ke gun saar ||
english: They remain forever merged with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; they dwell upon the Glories of the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa mail chukaaeean har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
english: They cast off the filth of their mental duality, and they keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sachee baanee sach man sache naal piaar ||1||
english: True is their speech, and true are their minds. They are in love with the True One. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: man mere haumai mail bhar naal ||
english: O my mind, you are filled with the filth of egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har niramal sadaa sohanaa sabad savaaranahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Immaculate Lord is eternally Beautiful. We are adorned with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad man mohiaa prabh aape lae milaai ||
english: God joins to Himself those whose minds are fascinated with the True Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin naame ratiaa jotee jot samaai ||
english: Night and day, they are attuned to the Naam, and their light is absorbed into the Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਹੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jotee hoo prabh jaapadaa bin satagur boojh na paai ||
english: Through His Light, God is revealed. Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa satagur bhetiaa tin aai ||2||
english: The True Guru comes to meet those who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਡੁਮਣੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai sabh dumanee doojai bhaai khuaai ||
english: Without the Name, all are miserable. In the love of duality, they are ruined.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tis bin ghaRee na jeevadee dukhee rain vihaai ||
english: Without Him, I cannot survive even for an instant, and my life-night passes in anguish.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bharam bhulaanaa a(n)dhulaa phir phir aavai jaai ||
english: Wandering in doubt, the spiritually blind come and go in reincarnation, over and over again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nadar kare prabh aapanee aape lae milaai ||3||
english: When God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, He blends us into Himself. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਕਰਿ ਪਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh sunadaa vekhadaa kiu mukar paiaa jaai ||
english: He hears and sees everything. How can anyone deny Him?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੋ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paapo paap kamaavade paape pachahi pachaai ||
english: Those who sin again and again, shall rot and die in sin.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: so prabh nadar na aavaee manamukh boojh na paai ||
english: God's Glance of Grace does not come to them; those self-willed manmukhs do not obtain understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੫੬॥
transliteration: jis vekhaale soee vekhai naanak guramukh paai ||4||23||56||
english: They alone see the Lord, unto whom He reveals Himself. O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find Him. ||4||23||56||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sreeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀੜ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur rog na tutaee haumai peeR na jaai ||
english: Without the Guru, the disease is not cured, and the pain of egotism is not removed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee man vasai naame rahai samaai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, He dwells in the mind, and one remains immersed in His Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gurasabadee har paaeeai bin sabadai bharam bhulaai ||1||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found; without the Shabad, people wander, deceived by doubt. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man re nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||
english: O mind, dwell in the balanced state of your own inner being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam saalaahi too phir aavan jaan na hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Praise the Lord's Name, and you shall no longer come and go in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har iko daataa varatadaa doojaa avar na koi ||
english: The One Lord alone is the Giver, pervading everywhere. There is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad saalaahee man vasai sahaje hee sukh hoi ||
english: Praise the Word of the Shabad, and He shall come to dwell in your mind; you shall be blessed with intuitive peace and poise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh nadaree a(n)dar vekhadaa jai bhaavai tai dei ||2||
english: Everything is within the Lord's Glance of Grace. As He wishes, He gives. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਭਾ ਗਣਤ ਹੈ ਗਣਤੈ ਨਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai sabhaa ganat hai ganatai nau sukh naahi ||
english: In egotism, all must account for their actions. In this accounting, there is no peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bikh kee kaar kamaavanee bikh hee maahi samaahi ||
english: Acting in evil and corruption, people are immersed in corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin naavai thaur na paainee jamapur dookh sahaahi ||3||
english: Without the Name, they find no place of rest. In the City of Death, they suffer in agony. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
