gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis daa tisai daa aadhaar ||
english: Body and soul all belong to Him; He is the Support of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee bujheeai taa paae mokh duaar ||
english: By Guru's Grace, understanding comes, and then the Door of Liberation is found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੫੭॥
transliteration: naanak naam salaahi too(n) a(n)t na paaraavaar ||4||24||57||
english: O Nanak, sing the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He has no end or limitation. ||4||24||57||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tinaa ana(n)d sadaa sukh hai jinaa sach naam aadhaar ||
english: Those who have the Support of the True Name are in ecstasy and peace forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee sach paaiaa dookh nivaaranahaar ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they obtain the True One, the Destroyer of pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa saache gun gaavahi saachai naai piaar ||
english: Forever and ever, they sing the Glorious Praises of the True One; they love the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਦਿਤੋਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kirapaa kar kai aapanee diton bhagat bha(n)daar ||1||
english: When the Lord Himself grants His Grace, He bestows the treasure of devotion. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man re sadaa ana(n)d gun gaai ||
english: O mind, sing His Glorious Praises, and be in ecstasy forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sachee baanee har paaeeai har siu rahai samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the True Word of His Bani, the Lord is obtained, and one remains immersed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਰਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sachee bhagatee man laal theeaa rataa sahaj subhaai ||
english: In true devotion, the mind is dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love, with intuitive peace and poise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee man mohiaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaai ||
english: The mind is fascinated by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, which cannot be described.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa ratee sabad sachai a(n)mrit peevai ras gun gaai ||
english: The tongue imbued with the True Word of the Shabad drinks in the Amrit with delight, singing His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh ehu ra(n)g paaeeai jis no kirapaa kare rajaai ||2||
english: The Gurmukh obtains this love, when the Lord, in His Will, grants His Grace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saa ihu sa(n)saar hai sutiaa rain vihaai ||
english: This world is an illusion; people pass their life-nights sleeping.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਢਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik aapanai bhaanai kadh laian aape laion milaai ||
english: By the Pleasure of His Will, He lifts some out, and unites them with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape hee aap man vasiaa maaiaa mohu chukaai ||
english: He Himself abides in the mind, and drives out attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap vadaaee diteean guramukh dei bujhaai ||3||
english: He Himself bestows glorious greatness; He inspires the Gurmukh to understand. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਲਏ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa kaa daataa ek hai bhuliaa lae samajhaai ||
english: The One Lord is the Giver of all. He corrects those who make mistakes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਛਡਿਅਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik aape aap khuaaian doojai chhadian laai ||
english: He Himself has deceived some, and attached them to duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramatee har paaeeai jotee jot milaai ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is found, and one's light merges into the Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੫੮॥
transliteration: anadin naame ratiaa naanak naam samaai ||4||25||58||
english: Attuned to the Name of the Lord night and day, O Nanak, you shall be absorbed into the Name. ||4||25||58||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: gunava(n)tee sach paaiaa trisanaa taj vikaar ||
english: The virtuous obtain Truth; they give up their desires for evil and corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee man ra(n)giaa rasanaa prem piaar ||
english: Their minds are imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Love of their Beloved is on their tongues.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur kinai na paaio kar vekhahu man veechaar ||
english: Without the True Guru, no one has found Him; reflect upon this in your mind and see.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: manamukh mail na utarai jichar gur sabad na kare piaar ||1||
english: The filth of the self-willed manmukhs is not washed off; they have no love for the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੁ ॥
transliteration: man mere satigur kai bhaanai chal ||
english: O my mind, walk in harmony with the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਹਿ ਮਹਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nij ghar vasahi a(n)mrit peevahi taa sukh lahahi mahal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Dwell within the home of your own inner being, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar; you shall attain the Peace of the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: augunava(n)tee gun ko nahee bahan na milai hadoor ||
english: The unvirtuous have no merit; they are not allowed to sit in His Presence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sabad na jaanaee avagan so prabh door ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Shabad; those without virtue are far removed from God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee sach pachhaaniaa sach rate bharapoor ||
english: Those who recognize the True One are permeated and attuned to Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gurasabadee man bedhiaa prabh miliaa aap hadoor ||2||
english: Their minds are pierced through by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and God Himself ushers them into His Presence. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗਣਿ ਰੰਗਿਓਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape ra(n)gan ra(n)gion sabade laion milaai ||
english: He Himself dyes us in the Color of His Love; through the Word of His Shabad, He unites us with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sachaa ra(n)g na utarai jo sach rate liv laai ||
english: This True Color shall not fade away, for those who are attuned to His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa bhav thake manamukh boojh na paai ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs grow weary of wandering around in all four directions, but they do not understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis satigur mele so milai sachai sabad samaai ||3||
english: One who is united with the True Guru, meets and merges in the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਘਣੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mitr ghanere kar thakee meraa dukh kaatai koi ||
english: I have grown weary of making so many friends, hoping that someone might be able to end my suffering.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mil preetam dukh katiaa sabad milaavaa hoi ||
english: Meeting with my Beloved, my suffering has ended; I have attained Union with the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਟਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sach khatanaa sach raas hai sache sachee soi ||
english: Earning Truth, and accumulating the Wealth of Truth, the truthful person gains a reputation of Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੫੯॥
transliteration: sach mile se na vichhuRahi naanak guramukh hoi ||4||26||59||
english: Meeting with the True One, O Nanak, the Gurmukh shall not be separated from Him again. ||4||26||59||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape kaaran karataa kare srisat dekhai aap upaai ||
english: The Creator Himself created the Creation; He produced the Universe, and He Himself watches over it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਏਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh eko ik varatadaa alakh na lakhiaa jaai ||
english: The One and Only Lord is pervading and permeating all. The Unseen cannot be seen.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape prabhoo daiaal hai aape dei bujhaai ||
english: God Himself is Merciful; He Himself bestows understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramatee sad man vasiaa sach rahe liv laai ||1||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the True One dwells forever in the mind of those who remain lovingly attached to Him. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man mere gur kee ma(n)n lai rajaai ||
english: O my mind, surrender to the Guru's Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਥੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man tan seetal sabh theeai naam vasai man aai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Mind and body are totally cooled and soothed, and the Naam comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: jin kar kaaran dhaariaa soee saar karei ||
english: Having created the creation, He supports it and takes care of it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad pachhaaneeai jaa aape nadar karei ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is realized, when He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: se jan sabade sohane tit sachai darabaar ||
english: Those who are beautifully adorned with the Shabad in the Court of the True Lord

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh sachai sabad rate aap mele karataar ||2||
english: -those Gurmukhs are attuned to the True Word of the Shabad; the Creator unites them with Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramatee sach salaahanaa jis daa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, praise the True One, who has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat aape hukam vasai hukame kare beechaar ||
english: He dwells in each and every heart, by the Hukam of His Command; by His Hukam, we contemplate Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee saalaaheeai haumai vichahu khoi ||
english: So praise Him through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and drive out egotism from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਰੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saa dhan naavai baaharee avaganava(n)tee roi ||3||
english: That soul-bride who lacks the Lord's Name acts without virtue, and so she grieves. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਲਗਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sach salaahee sach lagaa sachai naai tripat hoi ||
english: Praising the True One, attached to the True One, I am satisfied with the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਾ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਢਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gun veechaaree gun sa(n)grahaa avagun kadhaa dhoi ||
english: Contemplating His Virtues, I accumulate virtue and merit; I wash myself clean of demerits.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape mel milaaidaa phir vechhoRaa na hoi ||
english: He Himself unites us in His Union; there is no more separation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਦੂ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੬੦॥
transliteration: naanak gur saalaahee aapanaa jidoo paaee prabh soi ||4||27||60||
english: O Nanak, I sing the Praises of my Guru; through Him, I find that God. ||4||27||60||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਾਮ ਗਹੇਲੀਏ ਕਿਆ ਚਲਹਿ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sun sun kaam gaheleee kiaa chalahi baah ludaai ||
english: Listen, listen, O soul-bride: you are overtaken by sexual desire-why do you walk like that, swinging your arms in joy?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa pir na pachhaanahee kiaa muhu desahi jaai ||
english: You do not recognize your own Husband Lord! When you go to Him, what face will you show Him?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖਂੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jinee sakha(n)ee ka(n)t pachhaaniaa hau tin kai laagau paai ||
english: I touch the feet of my sister soul-brides who have known their Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਥੀ ਰਹਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin hee jaisee thee rahaa satasa(n)gat mel milaai ||1||
english: If only I could be like them! Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I am united in His Union. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dhe kooR muthee kooRiaar ||
english: O woman, the false ones are being cheated by falsehood.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pir prabh saachaa sohanaa paaeeai gur beechaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God is your Husband; He is Handsome and True. He is obtained by reflecting upon the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਉ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh ka(n)t na pachhaanaee tin kiu rain vihaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not recognize their Husband Lord; how will they spend their life-night?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬਿ ਅਟੀਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: garab ateeaa trisanaa jalahi dukh paavahi doojai bhaai ||
english: Filled with arrogance, they burn with desire; they suffer in the pain of the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad rateeaa sohaaganee tin vichahu haumai jaai ||
english: The happy soul-brides are attuned to the Shabad; their egotism is eliminated from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa pir raavahi aapanaa tinaa sukhe sukh vihaai ||2||
english: They enjoy their Husband Lord forever, and their life-night passes in the most blissful peace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਪਿਰ ਮੁਤੀਆ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: giaan vihoonee pir muteeaa piram na paaiaa jaai ||
english: She is utterly lacking in spiritual wisdom; she is abandoned by her Husband Lord. She cannot obtain His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: agiaan matee a(n)dher hai bin pir dekhe bhukh na jaai ||
english: In the darkness of intellectual ignorance, she cannot see her Husband, and her hunger does not depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aavahu milahu saheleeho mai pir dehu milaai ||
english: Come and meet with me, my sister soul-brides, and unite me with my Husband.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag satigur milai pir paaiaa sach samaai ||3||
english: She who meets the True Guru, by perfect good fortune, finds her Husband; she is absorbed in the True One. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਹੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: se saheeaa sohaaganee jin kau nadar karei ||
english: Those upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace become His happy soul-brides.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: khasam pachhaanahi aapanaa tan man aagai dei ||
english: One who recognizes her Lord and Master places her body and mind in offering before Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: ghar var paaiaa aapanaa haumai door karei ||
english: Within her own home, she finds her Husband Lord; her egotism is dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੬੧॥
transliteration: naanak sobhaava(n)teeaa sohaaganee anadin bhagat karei ||4||28||61||
english: O Nanak, the happy soul-brides are embellished and exalted; night and day they are absorbed in devotional worship. ||4||28||61||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik pir raavahi aapanaa hau kai dar poochhau jaai ||
english: Some enjoy their Husband Lord; unto whose door should I go to ask for Him?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevee bhaau kar mai pir dehu milaai ||
english: I serve my True Guru with love, that He may lead me to Union with my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh upaae aape vekhai kis neRai kis door ||
english: He created all, and He Himself watches over us. Some are close to Him, and some are far away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin pir sa(n)ge jaaniaa pir raave sadaa hadoor ||1||
english: She who knows her Husband Lord to be always with her, enjoys His Constant Presence. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਤੂ ਚਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dhe too chal gur kai bhaai ||
english: O woman, you must walk in harmony with the Guru's Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anadin raavahi pir aapanaa sahaje sach samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Night and day, you shall enjoy your Husband, and you shall intuitively merge into the True One. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabad rateeaa sohaaganee sachai sabad seegaar ||
english: Attuned to the Shabad, the happy soul-brides are adorned with the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har var paain ghar aapanai gur kai het piaar ||
english: Within their own home, they obtain the Lord as their Husband, with love for the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sej suhaavee har ra(n)g ravai bhagat bhare bha(n)daar ||
english: Upon her beautiful and cozy bed, she enjoys the Love of her Lord. She is overflowing with the treasure of devotion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so prabh preetam man vasai j sabhasai dei adhaar ||2||
english: That Beloved God abides in her mind; He gives His Support to all. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pir saalaahan aapanaa tin kai hau sad balihaarai jaau ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who praise their Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇਈ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan arapee sir deee tin kai laagaa paai ||
english: I dedicate my mind and body to them, and give my head as well; I fall at their feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jinee ik pachhaaniaa doojaa bhaau chukaai ||
english: Those who recognize the One renounce the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥੨੯॥੬੨॥
transliteration: guramukh naam pachhaaneeai naanak sach samaai ||3||29||62||
english: The Gurmukh recognizes the Naam, O Nanak, and is absorbed into the True One. ||3||29||62||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
transliteration: har jee sachaa sach too sabh kichh terai cheerai ||
english: O Dear Lord, You are the Truest of the True. All things are in Your Power.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਫਿਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੀਰੈ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh tarasade phire bin gur bhete peerai ||
english: The 8.4 million species of beings wander around searching for You, but without the Guru, they do not find You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸੂਖ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੀਰੈ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu bakhase bakhas lae sookh sadaa sareerai ||
english: When the Dear Lord grants His Forgiveness, this human body finds lasting peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sev karee sach gahir ga(n)bheerai ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, I serve the True One, who is Immeasurably Deep and Profound. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man mere naam rate sukh hoi ||
english: O my mind, attuned to the Naam, you shall find peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramatee naam salaaheeai doojaa avar na koi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and praise the Naam; there is no other at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dharam raai no hukam hai bahi sachaa dharam beechaar ||
english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma, by the Hukam of God's Command, sits and administers True Justice.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਆਤਮਾ ਓਹੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai dusat aatamaa ohu teree sarakaar ||
english: Those evil souls, ensnared by the love of duality, are subject to Your Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਆਤਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਤਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: adhiaatamee har gun taas man japahi ek muraar ||
english: The souls on their spiritual journey chant and meditate within their minds on the One Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਰੈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin kee sevaa dharam raai karai dha(n)n savaaranahaar ||2||
english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma serves them; blessed is the Lord who adorns them. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਨਹਿ ਤਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: man ke bikaar manahi tajai man chookai mohu abhimaan ||
english: One who eliminates mental wickedness from within the mind, and casts out emotional attachment and egotistical pride,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aatam raam pachhaaniaa sahaje naam samaan ||
english: comes to recognize the All-pervading Soul, and is intuitively absorbed into the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur mukat na paaeeai manamukh phirai divaan ||
english: Without the True Guru, the self-willed manmukhs do not find liberation; they wander around like lunatics.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabad na cheenai kathanee badanee kare bikhiaa maahi samaan ||3||
english: They do not contemplate the Shabad; engrossed in corruption, they utter only empty words. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap hai doojaa avar na koi ||
english: He Himself is everything; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jiu bolaae tiu boleeai jaa aap bulaae soi ||
english: I speak just as He makes me speak, when He Himself makes me speak.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh baanee braham hai sabad milaavaa hoi ||
english: The Word of the Gurmukh is God Himself. Through the Shabad, we merge in Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam samaal too jit seviai sukh hoi ||4||30||63||
english: O Nanak, remember the Naam; serving Him, peace is obtained. ||4||30||63||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jag haumai mail dukh paaiaa mal laagee doojai bhaai ||
english: The world is polluted with the filth of egotism, suffering in pain. This filth sticks to them because of their love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਧੋਤੀ ਕਿਵੈ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mal haumai dhotee kivai na utarai je sau teerath naai ||
english: This filth of egotism cannot be washed away, even by taking cleansing baths at hundreds of sacred shrines.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦੂਣੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: bahu bidh karam kamaavade doonee mal laagee aai ||
english: Performing all sorts of rituals, people are smeared with twice as much filth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paRiai mail na utarai poochhahu giaaneeaa jaai ||1||
english: This filth is not removed by studying. Go ahead, and ask the wise ones. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man mere gur saran aavai taa niramal hoi ||
english: O my mind, coming to the Sanctuary of the Guru, you shall become immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਸਕੀ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: manamukh har har kar thake mail na sakee dhoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs have grown weary of chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, but their filth cannot be removed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man mailai bhagat na hovaee naam na paaiaa jaai ||
english: With a polluted mind, devotional service cannot be performed, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, cannot be obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ ਮੈਲੇ ਮੁਏ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh maile maile mue jaasan pat gavaai ||
english: The filthy, self-willed manmukhs die in filth, and they depart in disgrace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee man vasai mal haumai jaai samaai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to abide in the mind, and the filth of egotism is dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧੇਰੈ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਬਾਲੀਐ ਤਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu a(n)dherai deepak baaleeai tiu gur giaan agiaan tajaai ||2||
english: Like a lamp lit in the darkness, the spiritual wisdom of the Guru dispels ignorance. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕੀਆ ਹਮ ਕਰਹਗੇ ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ham keeaa ham karahage ham moorakh gaavaar ||
english: "I have done this, and I will do that" - I am an idiotic fool for saying this!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੈ ਵਾਲਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: karanai vaalaa visariaa doojai bhaai piaar ||
english: I have forgotten the Doer of all; I am caught in the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਭਿ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa jevad dukh nahee sabh bhav thake sa(n)saar ||
english: There is no pain as great as the pain of Maya; it drives people to wander all around the world, until they become exhausted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramatee sukh paaeeai sach naam ur dhaar ||3||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, peace is found, with the True Name enshrined in the heart. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis no mele so milai hau tis balihaarai jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who meet and merge with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: e man bhagatee ratiaa sach baanee nij thaau ||
english: This mind is attuned to devotional worship; through the True Word of Gurbani, it finds its own home.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਚੇ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man rate jihavaa ratee har gun sache gaau ||
english: With the mind so imbued, and the tongue imbued as well, sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੬੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai sache maahi samaau ||4||31||64||
english: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; immerse yourself in the True One. ||4||31||64||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਲਾ ਕਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: mai man tan birahu at agalaa kiu preetam milai ghar aai ||
english: Within my mind and body is the intense pain of separation; how can my Beloved come to meet me in my home?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਦੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੇਖਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa dekhaa prabh aapanaa prabh dekhiai dukh jaai ||
english: When I see my God, seeing God Himself, my pain is taken away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਾ ਤਿਨ ਸਜਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaai puchhaa tin sajanaa prabh kit bidh milai milaai ||1||
english: I go and ask my friends, "How can I meet and merge with God?" ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mere satiguraa mai tujh bin avar na koi ||
english: O my True Guru, without You I have no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham moorakh mugadh saranaagatee kar kirapaa mele har soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am foolish and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary. Please be Merciful and unite me with the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur daataa har naam kaa prabh aap milaavai soi ||
english: The True Guru is the Giver of the Name of the Lord. God Himself causes us to meet Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur har prabh bujhiaa gur jevad avar na koi ||
english: The True Guru understands the Lord God. There is no other as Great as the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hau gur saranaaee dhahi pavaa kar daiaa mele prabh soi ||2||
english: I have come and collapsed in the Guru's Sanctuary. In His Kindness, He has united me with God. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਥਕੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: manahath kinai na paaiaa kar upaav thake sabh koi ||
english: No one has found Him by stubborn-mindedness. All have grown weary of the effort.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sahas siaanap kar rahe man korai ra(n)g na hoi ||
english: Thousands of clever mental tricks have been tried, but still, the raw and undisciplined mind does not absorb the Color of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਖਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kooR kapat kinai na paaio jo beejai khaavai soi ||3||
english: By falsehood and deception, none have found Him. Whatever you plant, you shall eat. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa teree aas prabh sabh jee tere too(n) raas ||
english: O God, You are the Hope of all. All beings are Yours; You are the Wealth of all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਦਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh tudhahu khaalee ko nahee dar guramukhaa no saabaas ||
english: O God, none return from You empty-handed; at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are praised and acclaimed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਕਢਿ ਲੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੬੫॥
transliteration: bikh bhaujal dubade kadh lai jan naanak kee aradaas ||4||1||65||
english: In the terrifying world-ocean of poison, people are drowning-please lift them up and save them! This is servant Nanak's humble prayer. ||4||1||65||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: naam milai man tripateeai bin naamai dhrig jeevaas ||
english: Receiving the Naam, the mind is satisfied; without the Naam, life is cursed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: koee guramukh sajan je milai mai dase prabh gunataas ||
english: If I meet the Gurmukh, my Spiritual Friend, he will show me God, the Treasure of Excellence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਮੈ ਨਾਮ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hau tis vitahu chau kha(n)neeai mai naam kare paragaas ||1||
english: I am every bit a sacrifice to one who reveals to me the Naam. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: mere preetamaa hau jeevaa naam dhiaai ||
english: O my Beloved, I live by meditating on Your Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai jeevan naa theeai mere satigur naam driRaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without Your Name, my life does not even exist. My True Guru has implanted the Naam within me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: naam amolak ratan hai poore satigur paas ||
english: The Naam is a Priceless Jewel; it is with the Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੈ ਲਗਿਆ ਕਢਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevai lagiaa kadh ratan devai paragaas ||
english: When one is enjoined to serve the True Guru, He brings out this Jewel and bestows this enlightenment.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਜੋ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dha(n)n vadabhaagee vadabhaageeaa jo aai mile gur paas ||2||
english: Blessed, and most fortunate of the very fortunate, are those who come to meet the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਵਸਿ ਕਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jinaa satigur purakh na bhetio se bhaagaheen vas kaal ||
english: Those who have not met the Primal Being, the True Guru, are most unfortunate, and are subject to death.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
transliteration: oi phir phir jon bhavaaeeahi vich visataa kar vikaraal ||
english: They wander in reincarnation over and over again, as the most disgusting maggots in manure.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ਦੁਆਸਿ ਨ ਭਿਟੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥੩॥
transliteration: onaa paas duaas na bhiteeai jin a(n)tar krodh cha(n)daal ||3||
english: Do not meet with, or even approach those people, whose hearts are filled with horrible anger. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh a(n)mrit sar vadabhaagee naavahi aai ||
english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is the Pool of Ambrosial Nectar. The very fortunate ones come to bathe in it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: un janam janam kee mail utarai niramal naam driRaai ||
english: The filth of many incarnations is washed away, and the Immaculate Naam is implanted within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੬੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak utam pad paaiaa satigur kee liv laai ||4||2||66||
english: Servant Nanak has obtained the most exalted state, lovingly attuned to the True Guru. ||4||2||66||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਥਰਾ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavaa gun vitharaa gun bolee meree maai ||
english: I sing His Glories, I describe His Glories, I speak of His Glories, O my mother.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਜਣ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sajan gunakaareeaa mil sajan har gun gaai ||
english: The Gurmukhs, my spiritual friends, bestow virtue. Meeting with my spiritual friends, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: heerai heer mil bedhiaa ra(n)g chaloolai naai ||1||
english: The Diamond of the Guru has pierced the diamond of my mind, which is now dyed in the deep crimson color of the Name. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mere govi(n)daa gun gaavaa tripat man hoi ||
english: O my Lord of the Universe, singing Your Glorious Praises, my mind is satisfied.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar piaas har naam kee gur tus milaavai soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Within me is the thirst for the Lord's Name; may the Guru, in His Pleasure, grant it to me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man ra(n)gahu vadabhaageeho gur tuthaa kare pasaau ||
english: Let your minds be imbued with His Love, O blessed and fortunate ones. By His Pleasure, the Guru bestows His Gifts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur naam driRaae ra(n)g siu hau satigur kai bal jaau ||
english: The Guru has lovingly implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin satigur har naam na labhaee lakh kotee karam kamaau ||2||
english: Without the True Guru, the Name of the Lord is not found, even though people may perform hundreds of thousands, even millions of rituals. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: bin bhaagaa satigur naa milai ghar baithiaa nikat nit paas ||
english: Without destiny, the True Guru is not found, even though He sits within the home of our own inner being, always near and close at hand.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਈਆਸਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar agiaan dukh bharam hai vich paRadaa door paeeaas ||
english: There is ignorance within, and the pain of doubt, like a separating screen.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲੋਹੁ ਬੂਡਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin satigur bhete ka(n)chan naa theeai manamukh lohu boodaa beRee paas ||3||
english: Without meeting with the True Guru, no one is transformed into gold. The self-willed manmukh sinks like iron, while the boat is very close. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur bohith har naav hai kit bidh chaRiaa jaai ||
english: The Boat of the True Guru is the Name of the Lord. How can we climb on board?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai jo chalai vich bohith baithaa aai ||
english: One who walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will comes to sit in this Boat.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੬੭॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n vadabhaagee naanakaa jinaa satigur lae milaai ||4||3||67||
english: Blessed, blessed are those very fortunate ones, O Nanak, who are united with the Lord through the True Guru. ||4||3||67||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਨਿਤ ਖੜੀ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਸੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau pa(n)th dasaaee nit khaRee koee prabh dase tin jaau ||
english: I stand by the wayside and ask the Way. If only someone would show me the Way to God-I would go with him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਫਿਰਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jinee meraa piaaraa raaviaa tin peechhai laag phiraau ||
english: I follow in the footsteps of those who enjoy the Love of my Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਮਿੰਨਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਦੜੀ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar mi(n)nat kar jodaRee mai prabh milanai kaa chaau ||1||
english: I beg of them, I implore them; I have such a yearning to meet God! ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਜਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mere bhaaee janaa koee mo kau har prabh mel milaai ||
english: O my Siblings of Destiny, please unite me in Union with my Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau satigur vitahu vaariaa jin har prabh deeaa dikhaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has shown me the Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: hoi nimaanee dhahi pavaa poore satigur paas ||
english: In deep humility, I fall at the Feet of the Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: nimaaniaa gur maan hai gur satigur kare saabaas ||
english: The Guru is the Honor of the dishonored. The Guru, the True Guru, brings approval and applause.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜਊ ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hau gur saalaahi na rajaoo mai mele har prabh paas ||2||
english: I am never tired of praising the Guru, who unites me with the Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur no sabh ko lochadaa jetaa jagat sabh koi ||
english: Everyone, all over the world, longs for the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin bhaagaa darasan naa theeai bhaagaheen bahi roi ||
english: Without the good fortune of destiny, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is not obtained. The unfortunate ones just sit and cry.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥੀਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo har prabh bhaanaa so theeaa dhur likhiaa na metai koi ||3||
english: All things happen according to the Will of the Lord God. No one can erase the pre-ordained Writ of Destiny. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape satigur aap har aape mel milaai ||
english: He Himself is the True Guru; He Himself is the Lord. He Himself unites in His Union.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੀਛੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aap daiaa kar melasee gur satigur peechhai paai ||
english: In His Kindness, He unites us with Himself, as we follow the Guru, the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੬੮॥
transliteration: sabh jagajeevan jag aap hai naanak jal jalahi samaai ||4||4||68||
english: Over all the world, He is the Life of the World, O Nanak, like water mingled with water. ||4||4||68||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਲਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ras a(n)mrit naam ras at bhalaa kit bidh milai ras khaai ||
english: The Essence of the Ambrosial Naam is the most sublime essence; how can I get to taste this essence?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਸਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jaai puchhahu sohaaganee tusaa kiu kar miliaa prabh aai ||
english: I go and ask the happy soul-brides, "How did you come to meet God?"

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਨ ਬੋਲਨੀ ਹਉ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਾ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: oi veparavaah na bolanee hau mal mal dhovaa tin paai ||1||
english: They are care-free and do not speak; I massage and wash their feet. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਜਣ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re mil sajan har gun saar ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, meet with your spiritual friend, and dwell upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਜਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਢੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sajan satigur purakh hai dukh kadhai haumai maar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is your Friend, who shall drive out pain and subdue your ego. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਦਇਆ ਪਈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukheeaa sohaaganee tin daiaa paee man aai ||
english: The Gurmukhs are the happy soul-brides; their minds are filled with kindness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਚਨੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur vachan rata(n)n hai jo ma(n)ne s har ras khaai ||
english: The Word of the True Guru is the Jewel. One who believes in it tastes the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਧਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: se vadabhaagee vad jaaneeahi jin har ras khaadhaa gur bhaai ||2||
english: Those who partake of the Lord's Sublime Essence, through the Guru's Love, are known as great and very fortunate. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਵਣਿ ਤਿਣਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਨਹੀ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu har ras van tin sabhat hai bhaagaheen nahee khaai ||
english: This Sublime Essence of the Lord is in the forests, in the fields and everywhere, but the unfortunate ones do not taste it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਲੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur palai naa pavai manamukh rahe bilalaai ||
english: Without the True Guru, it is not obtained. The self-willed manmukhs continue to cry in misery.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਨਾ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: oi satigur aagai naa nivahi onaa a(n)tar krodh balaai ||3||
english: They do not bow before the True Guru; the demon of anger is within them. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har har har ras aap hai aape har ras hoi ||
english: The Lord Himself, Har, Har, Har, is the Sublime Essence. The Lord Himself is the Essence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aap daiaa kar devasee guramukh a(n)mrit choi ||
english: In His Kindness, He blesses the Gurmukh with it; the Ambrosial Nectar of this Amrit trickles down.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੫॥੬੯॥
transliteration: sabh tan man hariaa hoiaa naanak har vasiaa man soi ||4||5||69||
english: Then, the body and mind totally blossom forth and flourish; O Nanak, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||4||5||69||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਚੜੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਥਵੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dinas chaRai phir aathavai rain sabaaee jaai ||
english: The day dawns, and then it ends, and the night passes away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਨਰੁ ਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਨਿਤਿ ਮੂਸਾ ਲਾਜੁ ਟੁਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aav ghatai nar naa bujhai nit moosaa laaj tukaai ||
english: Man's life is diminishing, but he does not understand. Each day, the mouse of death is gnawing away at the rope of life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲਗਿ ਮਾਖੀ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guR mithaa maaiaa pasariaa manamukh lag maakhee pachai pachaai ||1||
english: Maya spreads out like sweet molasses; the self-willed manmukh is stuck like a fly, rotting away. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੈ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re mai meet sakhaa prabh soi ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, God is my Friend and Companion.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: put kalat mohu bikh hai a(n)t belee koi na hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Emotional attachment to children and spouse is poison; in the end, no one will go along with you as your helper. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਬਰੇ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੇ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramat har liv ubare alipat rahe saranaai ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, some embrace love for the Lord, and are saved. They remain detached and unaffected, and they find the Sanctuary of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਨੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੀਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: onee chalan sadaa nihaaliaa har kharach leeaa pat paai ||
english: They keep death constantly before their eyes; they gather the Provisions of the Lord's Name, and receive honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh daragah ma(n)neeahi har aap lae gal laai ||2||
english: The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord. The Lord Himself takes them in His Loving Embrace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪੰਥੁ ਪਰਗਟਾ ਦਰਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukhaa no pa(n)th paragataa dar thaak na koee paai ||
english: For the Gurmukhs, the Way is obvious. At the Lord's Door, they face no obstructions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har naam salaahan naam man naam rahan liv laai ||
english: They praise the Lord's Name, they keep the Naam in their minds, and they remain attached to the Love of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਦਰਿ ਵਜਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anahad dhunee dar vajade dar sachai sobhaa paai ||3||
english: The Unstruck Celestial Music vibrates for them at the Lord's Door, and they are honored at the True Door. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee guramukh naam salaahiaa tinaa sabh ko kahai saabaas ||
english: Those Gurmukhs who praise the Naam are applauded by everyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: tin kee sa(n)gat dehi prabh mai jaachik kee aradaas ||
english: Grant me their company, God-I am a beggar; this is my prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੩੧॥੬॥੭੦॥
transliteration: naanak bhaag vade tinaa guramukhaa jin a(n)tar naam paragaas ||4||33||31||6||70||
english: O Nanak, great is the good fortune of those Gurmukhs, who are filled with the Light of the Naam within. ||4||33||31||6||70||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਰਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kiaa too rataa dekh kai putr kalatr seegaar ||
english: Why are you so thrilled by the sight of your son and your beautifully decorated wife?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ras bhogahi khuseeaa karahi maanahi ra(n)g apaar ||
english: You enjoy tasty delicacies, you have lots of fun, and you indulge in endless pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸੀ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bahut karahi phuramaaisee varatahi hoi aphaar ||
english: You give all sorts of commands, and you act so superior.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karataa chit na aavaee manamukh a(n)dh gavaar ||1||
english: The Creator does not come into the mind of the blind, idiotic, self-willed manmukh. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man sukhadaataa har soi ||
english: O my mind, the Lord is the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeeai karam paraapat hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, He is found. By His Mercy, He is obtained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਪੜਿ ਭੋਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਆ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: kapaR bhog lapataaiaa suinaa rupaa khaak ||
english: People are entangled in the enjoyment of fine clothes, but gold and silver are only dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੇ ਕੀਏ ਰਥ ਅਥਾਕ ॥
transliteration: haivar gaivar bahu ra(n)ge keee rath athaak ||
english: They acquire beautiful horses and elephants, and ornate carriages of many kinds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਸਭ ਸਾਕ ॥
transliteration: kis hee chit na paavahee bisariaa sabh saak ||
english: They think of nothing else, and they forget all their relatives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਪਾਕ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sirajanahaar bhulaaiaa vin naavai naapaak ||2||
english: They ignore their Creator; without the Name, they are impure. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੈਦਾ ਬਦ ਦੁਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਕਤ ॥
transliteration: laidaa bad duaai too(n) maaiaa karahi ikat ||
english: Gathering the wealth of Maya, you earn an evil reputation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ਸੋ ਸਣੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਅਨਿਤ ॥
transliteration: jis no too(n) pateeaaidaa so san tujhai anit ||
english: Those whom you work to please shall pass away along with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)kaar karahi aha(n)kaareeaa viaapiaa man kee mat ||
english: The egotistical are engrossed in egotism, ensnared by the intellect of the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tin prabh aap bhulaaiaa naa tis jaat na pat ||3||
english: One who is deceived by God Himself, has no position and no honor. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਇਕੋ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh milaaiaa iko sajan soi ||
english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has led me to meet the One, my only Friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਣਸ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har jan kaa raakhaa ek hai kiaa maanas haumai roi ||
english: The One is the Saving Grace of His humble servant. Why should the proud cry out in ego?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo har jan bhaavai so kare dar pher na paavai koi ||
english: As the servant of the Lord wills, so does the Lord act. At the Lord's Door, none of his requests are denied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੭੧॥
transliteration: naanak rataa ra(n)g har sabh jag mahi chaanan hoi ||4||1||71||
english: Nanak is attuned to the Love of the Lord, whose Light pervades the entire Universe. ||4||1||71||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਲਾਸੁ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਘਣਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਭੂਲਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ॥
transliteration: man bilaas bahu ra(n)g ghanaa drisat bhool khuseeaa ||
english: With the mind caught up in playful pleasures, involved in all sorts of amusements and sights that stagger the eyes, people are led astray.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਤ੍ਰਧਾਰ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਸੇ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chhatradhaar baadisaaheeaa vich sahase pareeaa ||1||
english: The emperors sitting on their thrones are consumed by anxiety. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re sukh saadhasa(n)g paaiaa ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, peace is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: likhiaa lekh tin purakh bidhaatai dukh sahasaa mit gaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If the Supreme Lord, the Architect of Destiny, writes such an order, then anguish and anxiety are erased. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਾ ਤੇਤੇ ਭਵਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jete thaan thana(n)taraa tete bhav aaiaa ||
english: There are so many places-I have wandered through them all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਾਤੀ ਵਡ ਭੂਮੀਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhan paatee vad bhoomeeaa meree meree kar pariaa ||2||
english: The masters of wealth and the great land-lords have fallen, crying out, "This is mine! This is mine!" ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਫਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hukam chalaae nisa(n)g hoi varatai aphariaa ||
english: They issue their commands fearlessly, and act in pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਖਾਕੁ ਰਲਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh ko vasagat kar laion bin naavai khaak raliaa ||3||
english: They subdue all under their command, but without the Name, they are reduced to dust. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦਰਿ ਖਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kot tetees sevakaa sidh saadhik dar khariaa ||
english: Even those who are served by the 33 million angelic beings, at whose door the Siddhas and the Saadhus stand,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਰੰਬਾਰੀ ਵਡ ਸਾਹਬੀ ਸਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਪਨੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੭੨॥
transliteration: gira(n)baaree vad saahabee sabh naanak supan theeaa ||4||2||72||
english: who live in wondrous affluence and rule over mountains, oceans and vast dominions-O Nanak, in the end, all this vanishes like a dream! ||4||2||72||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਪਪੋਲੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਬੁਝੇ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: bhalake uth papoleeai vin bujhe mugadh ajaan ||
english: Arising each day, you cherish your body, but you are idiotic, ignorant and without understanding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਛੁਟੈਗੀ ਬੇਬਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: so prabh chit na aaio chhutaigee bebaan ||
english: You are not conscious of God, and your body shall be cast into the wilderness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur setee chit laai sadaa sadaa ra(n)g maan ||1||
english: Focus your consciousness on the True Guru; you shall enjoy bliss forever and ever. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈਣਿ ॥
transliteration: praanee too(n) aaiaa laahaa lain ||
english: O mortal, you came here to earn a profit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਗਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਕੁਫਕੜੇ ਸਭ ਮੁਕਦੀ ਚਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: lagaa kit kuphakaRe sabh mukadee chalee rain ||1|| rahaau ||
english: What useless activities are you attached to? Your life-night is coming to its end. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਮ ਕਰੇ ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀਆ ਦਿਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: kudam kare pas pa(n)kheeaa disai naahee kaal ||
english: The animals and the birds frolic and play-they do not see death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਤੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਮਨੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਫਾਥਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: otai saath manukh hai phaathaa maaiaa jaal ||
english: Mankind is also with them, trapped in the net of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਭਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਜਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mukate seee bhaaleeahi j sachaa naam samaal ||2||
english: Those who always remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are considered to be liberated. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਘਰੁ ਛਡਿ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ ਸੋ ਲਗਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jo ghar chhad gavaavanaa so lagaa man maahi ||
english: That dwelling which you will have to abandon and vacate-you are attached to it in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਰਤਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jithai jaai tudh varatanaa tis kee chi(n)taa naahi ||
english: And that place where you must go to dwell-you have no regard for it at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਾਥੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਿਕਲੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: phaathe seee nikale j gur kee pairee paahi ||3||
english: Those who fall at the Feet of the Guru are released from this bondage. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਰਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: koee rakh na sakaee doojaa ko na dikhaai ||
english: No one else can save you-don't look for anyone else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲਿ ਕੈ ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa bhaal kai aai paiaa saranaai ||
english: I have searched in all four directions; I have come to find His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਲਇਆ ਕਢਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭੩॥
transliteration: naanak sachai paatisaahi dubadaa laiaa kadhaai ||4||3||73||
english: O Nanak, the True King has pulled me out and saved me from drowning! ||4||3||73||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ghaRee muhat kaa paahunaa kaaj savaaranahaar ||
english: For a brief moment, man is a guest of the Lord; he tries to resolve his affairs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਸਮਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa kaam viaapiaa samajhai naahee gaavaar ||
english: Engrossed in Maya and sexual desire, the fool does not understand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਠਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਆ ਪਰਿਆ ਵਸਿ ਜੰਦਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: uth chaliaa pachhutaaiaa pariaa vas ja(n)daar ||1||
english: He arises and departs with regret, and falls into the clutches of the Messenger of Death. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਤੂੰ ਬੈਠਾ ਕੰਧੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe too(n) baithaa ka(n)dhee paahi ||
english: You are sitting on the collapsing riverbank-are you blind?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੀ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: je hovee poorab likhiaa taa gur kaa bachan kamaahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If you are so pre-destined, then act according to the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਹ ਡਡੁਰੀ ਪਕੀ ਵਢਣਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: haree naahee nah daduree pakee vadhanahaar ||
english: The Reaper does not look upon any as unripe, half-ripe or fully ripe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਲੈ ਦਾਤ ਪਹੁਤਿਆ ਲਾਵੇ ਕਰਿ ਤਈਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: lai lai daat pahutiaa laave kar taeeaar ||
english: Picking up and wielding their sickles, the harvesters arrive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਹੋਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਿਰਸਾਣ ਦਾ ਤਾ ਲੁਣਿ ਮਿਣਿਆ ਖੇਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa hoaa hukam kirasaan daa taa lun miniaa khetaar ||2||
english: When the landlord gives the order, they cut and measure the crop. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਪਹਰੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਗਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pahilaa pahar dha(n)dhai gaiaa doojai bhar soiaa ||
english: The first watch of the night passes away in worthless affairs, and the second passes in deep sleep.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਜੈ ਝਾਖ ਝਖਾਇਆ ਚਉਥੈ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: teejai jhaakh jhakhaaiaa chauthai bhor bhaiaa ||
english: In the third, they babble nonsense, and when the fourth watch comes, the day of death has arrived.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਦ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kad hee chit na aaio jin jeeu pi(n)d deeaa ||3||
english: The thought of the One who bestows body and soul never enters the mind. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਕੀਆ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kau vaariaa jeeu keeaa kurabaan ||
english: I am devoted to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I sacrifice my soul to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jis te sojhee man paee miliaa purakh sujaan ||
english: Through them, understanding has entered my mind, and I have met the All-knowing Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਡਿਠਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੭੪॥
transliteration: naanak dithaa sadaa naal har a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||4||4||74||
english: Nanak sees the Lord always with him-the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||4||74||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਵਿਸਰਨੁ ਇਕੋ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabhe galaa visaran iko visar na jaau ||
english: Let me forget everything, but let me not forget the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਲਾਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa sabh jalaai kai gur naam deeaa sach suaau ||
english: All my evil pursuits have been burnt away; the Guru has blessed me with the Naam, the true object of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਸਭੇ ਲਾਹਿ ਕੈ ਇਕਾ ਆਸ ਕਮਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aasaa sabhe laahi kai ikaa aas kamaau ||
english: Give up all other hopes, and rely on the One Hope.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅਗੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jinee satigur seviaa tin agai miliaa thaau ||1||
english: Those who serve the True Guru receive a place in the world hereafter. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: man mere karate no saalaahi ||
english: O my mind, praise the Creator.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਛਡਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabhe chhad siaanapaa gur kee pairee paahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Give up all your clever tricks, and fall at the Feet of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਜੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh bhukh nah viaapaee je sukhadaataa man hoi ||
english: Pain and hunger shall not oppress you, if the Giver of Peace comes into your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਛਿਜੀਐ ਜਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kit hee ka(n)m na chhijeeai jaa hiradai sachaa soi ||
english: No undertaking shall fail, when the True Lord is always in your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਖਹਿ ਹਥ ਦੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis too(n) rakhahi hath de tis maar na sakai koi ||
english: No one can kill that one unto whom You, Lord, give Your Hand and protect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sukhadaataa gur seveeai sabh avagan kadhai dhoi ||2||
english: Serve the Guru, the Giver of Peace; He shall remove and wash off all your faults. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਲਾਈਆਂ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sevaa ma(n)gai sevako laaeeaa(n) apunee sev ||
english: Your servant begs to serve those who are enjoined to Your service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਸਕਤੇ ਤੂਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g masakate toothai paavaa dev ||
english: The opportunity to work hard serving the Saadh Sangat is obtained, when the Divine Lord is pleased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh vasagat saahibai aape karan karev ||
english: Everything is in the Hands of our Lord and Master; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੇਵ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur kai balihaaranai manasaa sabh poorev ||3||
english: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who fulfills all hopes and desires. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੋ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਜਣੋ ਇਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: iko disai sajano iko bhaaee meet ||
english: The One appears to be my Companion; the One is my Brother and Friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਸਾਮਗਰੀ ਇਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਹੈ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ikasai dee saamagaree ikasai dee hai reet ||
english: The elements and the components are all made by the One; they are held in their order by the One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: ikas siu man maaniaa taa hoaa nihachal cheet ||
english: When the mind accepts, and is satisfied with the One, then the consciousness becomes steady and stable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਟੇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਤੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੭੫॥
transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa tek naanak sach keet ||4||5||75||
english: Then, one's food is the True Name, one's garments are the True Name, and one's Support, O Nanak, is the True Name. ||4||5||75||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਜੇ ਆਵੈ ਇਕੁ ਹਥਿ ॥
transliteration: sabhe thok paraapate je aavai ik hath ||
english: All things are received if the One is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਥਿ ॥
transliteration: janam padaarath saphal hai je sachaa sabad kath ||
english: The precious gift of this human life becomes fruitful when one chants the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਥਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur te mahal paraapate jis likhiaa hovai math ||1||
english: One who has such destiny written on his forehead enters the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, through the Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man ekas siu chit laai ||
english: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭ ਧੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ekas bin sabh dha(n)dh hai sabh mithiaa mohu maai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the One, all entanglements are worthless; emotional attachment to Maya is totally false. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: lakh khuseeaa paatisaaheeaa je satigur nadar karei ||
english: Hundreds of thousands of princely pleasures are enjoyed, if the True Guru bestows His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: nimakh ek har naam dei meraa man tan seetal hoi ||
english: If He bestows the Name of the Lord, for even a moment, my mind and body are cooled and soothed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis kau poorab likhiaa tin satigur charan gahe ||2||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny hold tight to the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਸਫਲਾ ਘੜੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saphal moorat saphalaa ghaRee jit sache naal piaar ||
english: Fruitful is that moment, and fruitful is that time, when one is in love with the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dookh sa(n)taap na lagaee jis har kaa naam adhaar ||
english: Suffering and sorrow do not touch those who have the Support of the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਉਤਰਿਆ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: baah pakaR gur kaadhiaa soee utariaa paar ||3||
english: Grasping him by the arm, the Guru lifts them up and out, and carries them across to the other side. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ॥
transliteration: thaan suhaavaa pavit hai jithai sa(n)t sabhaa ||
english: Embellished and immaculate is that place where the Saints gather together.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਢੋਈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਭਾ ॥
transliteration: dhoee tis hee no milai jin pooraa guroo labhaa ||
english: He alone finds shelter, who has met the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਧਾ ਘਰੁ ਤਹਾਂ ਜਿਥੈ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੭੬॥
transliteration: naanak badhaa ghar tahaa(n) jithai mirat na janam jaraa ||4||6||76||
english: Nanak builds his house upon that site where there is no death, no birth, and no old age. ||4||6||76||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sreeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾਂ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: soee dhiaaeeai jeeaRe sir saahaa(n) paatisaahu ||
english: Meditate on Him, O my soul; He is the Supreme Lord over kings and emperors.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਮਨ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: tis hee kee kar aas man jis kaa sabhas vesaahu ||
english: Place the hopes of your mind in the One, in whom all have faith.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਪਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh siaanapaa chhad kai gur kee charanee paahu ||1||
english: Give up all your clever tricks, and grasp the Feet of the Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man mere sukh sahaj setee jap naau ||
english: O my mind, chant the Name with intuitive peace and poise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਇੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar prabh dhiaai too(n) gun goi(n)d nit gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on God. Constantly sing the Glories of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੁ ਮਨਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis kee saranee par manaa jis jevad avar na koi ||
english: Seek His Shelter, O my mind; there is no other as Great as He.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat sukh hoi ghanaa dukh darad na moole hoi ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, a profound peace is obtained. Pain and suffering will not touch you at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa kar chaakaree prabh saahib sachaa soi ||2||
english: Forever and ever, work for God; He is our True Lord and Master. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat hoi niramalaa kateeai jam kee phaas ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall become absolutely pure, and the noose of death shall be cut away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: sukhadaataa bhai bha(n)jano tis aagai kar aradaas ||
english: So offer your prayers to Him, the Giver of Peace, the Destroyer of fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਤਾਂ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mihar kare jis miharavaan taa(n) kaaraj aavai raas ||3||
english: Showing His Mercy, the Merciful Master shall resolve your affairs. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bahuto bahut vakhaaneeai oocho oochaa thaau ||
english: The Lord is said to be the Greatest of the Great; His Kingdom is the Highest of the High.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾਉ ॥
transliteration: varanaa chihanaa baaharaa keemat kahi na sakaau ||
english: He has no color or mark; His Value cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਅਪੁਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੭੭॥
transliteration: naanak kau prabh maiaa kar sach devahu apunaa naau ||4||7||77||
english: Please show Mercy to Nanak, God, and bless him with Your True Name. ||4||7||77||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sreeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naam dhiaae so sukhee tis mukh oojal hoi ||
english: One who meditates on the Naam is at peace; his face is radiant and bright.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: poore gur te paaeeai paragat sabhanee loi ||
english: Obtaining it from the Perfect Guru, he is honored all over the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kai ghar vasai eko sachaa soi ||1||
english: In the Company of the Holy, the One True Lord comes to abide within the home of the self. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man har har naam dhiaai ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਹਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਗੈ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam sahaaee sadaa sa(n)g aagai lae chhadaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Naam is your Companion; it shall always be with you. It shall save you in the world hereafter. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਕਵਨੈ ਆਵਹਿ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
transliteration: duneeaa keeaa vadiaaeeaa kavanai aavahi kaam ||
english: What good is worldly greatness?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਜਾਤੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa kaa ra(n)g sabh phikaa jaato binas nidaan ||
english: All the pleasures of Maya are tasteless and insipid. In the end, they shall all fade away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa kai hiradai har vasai so pooraa paradhaan ||2||
english: Perfectly fulfilled and supremely acclaimed is the one, in whose heart the Lord abides. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਹੋਹੁ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo kee hohu renukaa apanaa aap tiaag ||
english: Become the dust of the Saints; renounce your selfishness and conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਪਾਵ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲ ਛਡਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: upaav siaanap sagal chhad gur kee charanee laag ||
english: Give up all your schemes and your clever mental tricks, and fall at the Feet of the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tisahi paraapat ratan hoi jis masatak hovai bhaag ||3||
english: He alone receives the Jewel, upon whose forehead such wondrous destiny is written. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: tisai paraapat bhaaeeho jis devai prabh aap ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, it is received only when God Himself bestows it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee sevaa so kare jis binasai haumai taap ||
english: People serve the True Guru only when the fever of egotism has been eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
