gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੪॥੮॥੭੮॥
transliteration: naanak kau gur bhetiaa binase sagal sa(n)taap ||4||8||78||
english: Nanak has met the Guru; all his sufferings have come to an end. ||4||8||78||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਇਕੋ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ik pachhaanoo jee kaa iko rakhanahaar ||
english: The One is the Knower of all beings; He alone is our Savior.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਰਾ ਇਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ikas kaa man aasaraa iko praan adhaar ||
english: The One is the Support of the mind; the One is the Support of the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis saranaaee sadaa sukh paarabraham karataar ||1||
english: In His Sanctuary there is eternal peace. He is the Supreme Lord God, the Creator. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
transliteration: man mere sagal upaav tiaag ||
english: O my mind, give up all these efforts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨਿਤ ਇਕਸੁ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadh nit ikas kee liv laag ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Dwell upon the Perfect Guru each day, and attach yourself to the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: iko bhaaee mit ik iko maat pitaa ||
english: The One is my Brother, the One is my Friend. The One is my Mother and Father.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ikas kee man tek hai jin jeeu pi(n)d ditaa ||
english: The One is the Support of the mind; He has given us body and soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so prabh manahu na visarai jin sabh kichh vas keetaa ||2||
english: May I never forget God from my mind; He holds all in the Power of His Hands. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: ghar iko baahar iko thaan thana(n)tar aap ||
english: The One is within the home of the self, and the One is outside as well. He Himself is in all places and interspaces.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh jin keee aath pahar tis jaap ||
english: Meditate twenty-four hours a day on the One who created all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ikas setee ratiaa na hovee sog sa(n)taap ||3||
english: Attuned to the Love of the One, there is no sorrow or suffering. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh ek hai doojaa naahee koi ||
english: There is only the One Supreme Lord God; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis kaa jo tis bhaavai s hoi ||
english: Soul and body all belong to Him; whatever pleases His Will comes to pass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਭਇਆ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੭੯॥
transliteration: gur poorai pooraa bhaiaa jap naanak sachaa soi ||4||9||79||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, one becomes perfect; O Nanak, meditate on the True One. ||4||9||79||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jinaa satigur siu chit laaiaa se poore paradhaan ||
english: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and famous.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jin kau aap daiaal hoi tin upajai man giaan ||
english: Spiritual wisdom wells up in the minds of those unto whom the Lord Himself shows Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin kau masatak likhiaa tin paaiaa har naam ||1||
english: Those who have such destiny written upon their foreheads obtain the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: man mere eko naam dhiaai ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa sukh oopajahi daragah paidhaa jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The happiness of all happiness shall well up, and in the Court of the Lord, you shall be dressed in robes of honor. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: janam maran kaa bhau gaiaa bhaau bhagat gopaal ||
english: The fear of death and rebirth is removed by performing loving devotional service to the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat niramalaa aap kare pratipaal ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one becomes immaculate and pure; the Lord Himself takes care of such a one.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: janam maran kee mal kateeai gur darasan dekh nihaal ||2||
english: The filth of birth and death is washed away, and one is uplifted, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa paarabraham prabh soi ||
english: The Supreme Lord God is pervading all places and interspaces.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa daataa ek hai doojaa naahee koi ||
english: The One is the Giver of all-there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis saranaaee chhuteeai keetaa loRe s hoi ||3||
english: In His Sanctuary, one is saved. Whatever He wishes, comes to pass. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jin man vasiaa paarabraham se poore paradhaan ||
english: Perfectly fulfilled and famous are those, in whose minds the Supreme Lord God abides.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
transliteration: tin kee sobhaa niramalee paragat bhaee jahaan ||
english: Their reputation is spotless and pure; they are famous all over the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੮੦॥
transliteration: jinee meraa prabh dhiaaiaa naanak tin kurabaan ||4||10||80||
english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on my God. ||4||10||80||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: mil satigur sabh dukh gaiaa har sukh vasiaa man aai ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, all my sufferings have ended, and the Peace of the Lord has come to dwell within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀਆ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar jot pragaaseeaa ekas siu liv laai ||
english: The Divine Light illuminates my inner being, and I am lovingly absorbed in the One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhoo mukh oojalaa poorab likhiaa paai ||
english: Meeting with the Holy Saint, my face is radiant; I have realized my pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਣੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gun govi(n)d nit gaavane niramal saachai naai ||1||
english: I constantly sing the Glories of the Lord of the Universe. Through the True Name, I have become spotlessly pure. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man gurasabadee sukh hoi ||
english: O my mind, you shall find peace through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kee chaakaree birathaa jaai na koi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Working for the Perfect Guru, no one goes away empty-handed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾਂ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: man keeaa ichhaa(n) pooreeaa paaiaa naam nidhaan ||
english: The desires of the mind are fulfilled, when the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee sadaa sa(n)g karanaihaar pachhaan ||
english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is always with you; recognize Him as the Creator.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee mukh oojalaa jap naam daan isanaan ||
english: By Guru's Grace, your face shall be radiant. Chanting the Naam, you shall receive the benefits of giving charity and taking cleansing baths.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਤਜਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh binasiaa tajiaa sabh abhimaan ||2||
english: Sexual desire, anger and greed are eliminated, and all egotistical pride is abandoned. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: paaiaa laahaa laabh naam pooran hoe kaam ||
english: The Profit of the Naam is obtained, and all affairs are brought to fruition.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਦੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh meliaa deeaa apanaa naam ||
english: In His Mercy, God unites us with Himself, and He blesses us with the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa rahi gaiaa aap hoaa miharavaan ||
english: My comings and goings in reincarnation have come to an end; He Himself has bestowed His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sach mahal ghar paaiaa gur kaa sabad pachhaan ||3||
english: I have obtained my home in the True Mansion of His Presence, realizing the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਦਾ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kau raakhadaa aapanee kirapaa dhaar ||
english: His humble devotees are protected and saved; He Himself showers His Blessings upon us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: halat palat mukh oojale saache ke gun saar ||
english: In this world and in the world hereafter, radiant are the faces of those who cherish and enshrine the Glories of the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਦੇ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar gun saarade rate ra(n)g apaar ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, they lovingly dwell upon His Glories; they are imbued with His Infinite Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੮੧॥
transliteration: paarabraham sukh saagaro naanak sad balihaar ||4||11||81||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Supreme Lord God, the Ocean of Peace. ||4||11||81||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: pooraa satigur je milai paaeeai sabad nidhaan ||
english: If we meet the Perfect True Guru, we obtain the Treasure of the Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee japeeai a(n)mrit naam ||
english: Please grant Your Grace, God, that we may meditate on Your Ambrosial Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh kaateeai laagai sahaj dhiaan ||1||
english: The pains of birth and death are taken away; we are intuitively centered on His Meditation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man prabh saranaaee paai ||
english: O my mind, seek the Sanctuary of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bin doojaa ko nahee eko naam dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Lord, there is no other at all. Meditate on the One and only Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: keemat kahan na jaaeeai saagar gunee athaahu ||
english: His Value cannot be estimated; He is the Vast Ocean of Excellence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee mil sa(n)gatee sachaa sabad visaahu ||
english: O most fortunate ones, join the Sangat, the Blessed Congregation; purchase the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kar sevaa sukh saagarai sir saahaa paatisaahu ||2||
english: Serve the Lord, the Ocean of Peace, the Supreme Lord over kings and emperors. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal kaa aasaraa doojaa naahee thaau ||
english: I take the Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet; there is no other place of rest for me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਤਾਣਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mai dhar teree paarabraham terai taan rahaau ||
english: I lean upon You as my Support, O Supreme Lord God. I exist only by Your Power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nimaaniaa prabh maan too(n) terai sa(n)g samaau ||3||
english: O God, You are the Honor of the dishonored. I seek to merge with You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: har japeeai aaraadheeai aath pahar govi(n)d ||
english: Chant the Lord's Name and contemplate the Lord of the World, twenty-four hours a day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jee praan tan dhan rakhe kar kirapaa raakhee ji(n)d ||
english: He preserves our soul, our breath of life, body and wealth. By His Grace, He protects our soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੋਖ ਉਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੮੨॥
transliteration: naanak sagale dokh utaarian prabh paarabraham bakhasi(n)d ||4||12||82||
english: O Nanak, all pain has been washed away, by the Supreme Lord God, the Forgiver. ||4||12||82||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: preet lagee tis sach siu marai na aavai jaai ||
english: I have fallen in love with the True Lord. He does not die, He does not come and go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਵੇਛੋੜਿਆ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naa vechhoRiaa vichhuRai sabh mahi rahiaa samaai ||
english: In separation, He is not separated from us; He is pervading and permeating amongst all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਸਤ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: deen darad dukh bha(n)janaa sevak kai sat bhaai ||
english: He is the Destroyer of the pain and suffering of the meek. He bears True Love for His servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: acharaj roop nira(n)jano gur melaaiaa maai ||1||
english: Wondrous is the Form of the Immaculate One. Through the Guru, I have met Him, O my mother! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re meet karahu prabh soi ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, make God your Friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa moh pareet dhrig sukhee na deesai koi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Cursed is emotional attachment and love of Maya; no one is seen to be at peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੀਲਵੰਤੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: daanaa daataa seelava(n)t niramal roop apaar ||
english: God is Wise, Giving, Tender-hearted, Pure, Beautiful and Infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਊਚਾ ਵਡਾ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sakhaa sahaaee at vadaa oochaa vadaa apaar ||
english: He is our Companion and Helper, Supremely Great, Lofty and Utterly Infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲਕੁ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: baalak biradh na jaaneeai nihachal tis daravaar ||
english: He is not known as young or old; His Court is Steady and Stable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo ma(n)geeai soee paaeeai nidhaaraa aadhaar ||2||
english: Whatever we seek from Him, we receive. He is the Support of the unsupported. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਿਰਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jis pekhat kilavikh hirahi man tan hovai saa(n)t ||
english: Seeing Him, our evil inclinations vanish; mind and body become peaceful and tranquil.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਲਾਹਿ ਭਰਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ik man ek dhiaaeeai man kee laahi bharaa(n)t ||
english: With one-pointed mind, meditate on the One Lord, and the doubts of your mind will be dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan navatan sadaa pooran jaa kee daat ||
english: He is the Treasure of Excellence, the Ever-fresh Being. His Gift is Perfect and Complete.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਦਿਨੁ ਵਿਸਰਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa aaraadheeai din visarahu nahee raat ||3||
english: Forever and ever, worship and adore Him. Day and night, do not forget Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਖਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin kaa sakhaa govi(n)d ||
english: One whose destiny is so pre-ordained, obtains the Lord of the Universe as his Companion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਭੋ ਸਗਲ ਵਾਰੀਐ ਇਹ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: tan man dhan arapee sabho sagal vaareeai ih ji(n)d ||
english: I dedicate my body, mind, wealth and all to Him. I totally sacrifice my soul to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਸਦ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਰਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: dekhai sunai hadoor sad ghat ghat braham ravi(n)d ||
english: Seeing and hearing, He is always close at hand. In each and every heart, God is pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣਾ ਨੋ ਪਾਲਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੮੩॥
transliteration: akirataghanaa no paaladaa prabh naanak sad bakhasi(n)d ||4||13||83||
english: Even the ungrateful ones are cherished by God. O Nanak, He is forever the Forgiver. ||4||13||83||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਆ ਰਖਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man tan dhan jin prabh deeaa rakhiaa sahaj savaar ||
english: This mind, body and wealth were given by God, who naturally adorns us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sarab kalaa kar thaapiaa a(n)tar jot apaar ||
english: He has blessed us with all our energy, and infused His Infinite Light deep within us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa prabh simareeai a(n)tar rakh ur dhaar ||1||
english: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on God; keep Him enshrined in your heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man har bin avar na koi ||
english: O my mind, without the Lord, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh saranaaee sadaa rahu dookh na viaapai koi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Remain in God's Sanctuary forever, and no suffering shall afflict you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਮਾਣਕਾ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: ratan padaarath maanakaa suinaa rupaa khaak ||
english: Jewels, treasures, pearls, gold and silver-all these are just dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪਾ ਕੂੜੇ ਸਭੇ ਸਾਕ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa sut ba(n)dhapaa kooRe sabhe saak ||
english: Mother, father, children and relatives-all relations are false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਸੁ ਨਾਪਾਕ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin keetaa tisahi na jaanaee manamukh pas naapaak ||2||
english: The self-willed manmukh is an insulting beast; he does not acknowledge the One who created him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar rav rahiaa tis no jaanai door ||
english: The Lord is pervading within and beyond, and yet people think that He is far away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਗੀ ਰਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa laagee rach rahiaa a(n)tar haumai koor ||
english: They are engrossed in clinging desires; within their hearts there is ego and falsehood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਆਵਹਿ ਵੰਞਹਿ ਪੂਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhagatee naam vihooniaa aavahi va(n)njahi poor ||3||
english: Without devotion to the Naam, crowds of people come and go. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ॥
transliteration: raakh lehu prabh karanahaar jee ja(n)t kar daiaa ||
english: Please preserve Your beings and creatures, God; O Creator Lord, please be merciful!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਜਮ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bin prabh koi na rakhanahaar mahaa bikat jam bhaiaa ||
english: Without God, there is no saving grace. The Messenger of Death is cruel and unfeeling.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰਉ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੮੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam na veesarau kar apunee har maiaa ||4||14||84||
english: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam! Please bless me with Your Mercy, Lord! ||4||14||84||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਜ ਰੂਪ ਮੈ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: meraa tan ar dhan meraa raaj roop mai des ||
english: "My body and my wealth; my ruling power, my beautiful form and country-mine!"

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਰੰਗ ਅਰੁ ਵੇਸ ॥
transliteration: sut daaraa banitaa anek bahut ra(n)g ar ves ||
english: You may have children, a wife and many mistresses; you may enjoy all sorts of pleasures and fine clothes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਵਸਈ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har naam ridai na vasaee kaaraj kitai na lekh ||1||
english: And yet, if the Name of the Lord does not abide within the heart, none of it has any use or value. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man har har naam dhiaai ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar sa(n)gat nit saadh kee gur charanee chit laai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Always keep the Company of the Holy, and focus your consciousness on the Feet of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan dhiaaeeai masatak hovai bhaag ||
english: Those who have such blessed destiny written on their foreheads meditate on the Treasure of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kaaraj sabh savaareeahi gur kee charanee laag ||
english: All their affairs are brought to fruition, holding onto the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: haumai rog bhram kateeai naa aavai naa jaag ||2||
english: The diseases of ego and doubt are cast out; they shall not come and go in reincarnation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੂ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar sa(n)gat too saadh kee athasath teerath naau ||
english: Let the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, be your cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: jeeu praan man tan hare saachaa ehu suaau ||
english: Your soul, breath of life, mind and body shall blossom forth in lush profusion; this is the true purpose of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aithai milahi vadaaeeaa daragahi paavahi thaau ||3||
english: In this world you shall be blessed with greatness, and in the Court of the Lord you shall find your place of rest. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: kare karaae aap prabh sabh kichh tis hee haath ||
english: God Himself acts, and causes others to act; everything is in His Hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਵਾਲਦਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: maar aape jeevaaladaa a(n)tar baahar saath ||
english: He Himself bestows life and death; He is with us, within and beyond.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੮੫॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee sarab ghataa ke naath ||4||15||85||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the Master of all hearts. ||4||15||85||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: saran pae prabh aapane gur hoaa kirapaal ||
english: The Guru is Merciful; we seek the Sanctuary of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਐ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
transliteration: satagur kai upadesiai binase sarab ja(n)jaal ||
english: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, all worldly entanglements are eliminated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਲਗਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)dar lagaa raam naam a(n)mrit nadar nihaal ||1||
english: The Name of the Lord is firmly implanted within my mind; through His Ambrosial Glance of Grace, I am exalted and enraptured. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man mere satigur sevaa saar ||
english: O my mind, serve the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kare daiaa prabh aapanee ik nimakh na manahu visaar || rahaau ||
english: God Himself grants His Grace; do not forget Him, even for an instant. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵੀਅਹਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਟਣਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: gun govi(n)d nit gaaveeahi avagun katanahaar ||
english: Continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Destroyer of demerits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਡਿਠੇ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bin har naam na sukh hoi kar dithe bisathaar ||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, there is no peace. Having tried all sorts of ostentatious displays, I have come to see this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sahaje siphatee ratiaa bhavajal utare paar ||2||
english: Intuitively imbued with His Praises, one is saved, crossing over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਲਖ ਸੰਜਮਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: teerath varat lakh sa(n)jamaa paaeeai saadhoo dhoor ||
english: The merits of pilgrimages, fasts and hundreds of thousands of techniques of austere self-discipline are found in the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੂਕਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਜਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: look kamaavai kis te jaa vekhai sadaa hadoor ||
english: From whom are you trying to hide your actions? God sees all;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa prabh meraa bharapoor ||3||
english: He is Ever-present. My God is totally pervading all places and interspaces. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sach paatisaahee amar sach sache sachaa thaan ||
english: True is His Empire, and True is His Command. True is His Seat of True Authority.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਧਾਰੀਅਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਿਰਜਿਓਨੁ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sachee kudarat dhaareean sach sirajion jahaan ||
english: True is the Creative Power which He has created. True is the world which He has fashioned.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੮੬॥
transliteration: naanak japeeai sach naam hau sadaa sadaa kurabaan ||4||16||86||
english: O Nanak, chant the True Name; I am forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||16||86||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਣਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ॥
transliteration: udam kar har jaapanaa vadabhaagee dhan khaat ||
english: Make the effort, and chant the Lord's Name. O very fortunate ones, earn this wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣਾ ਮਲੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਟਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g har simaranaa mal janam janam kee kaat ||1||
english: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and wash off the filth of countless incarnations. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: man mere raam naam jap jaap ||
english: O my mind, chant and meditate on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਭੁੰਚਿ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man ichhe phal bhu(n)ch too sabh chookai sog sa(n)taap || rahaau ||
english: Enjoy the fruits of your mind's desires; all suffering and sorrow shall depart. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤਨੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jis kaaran tan dhaariaa so prabh dithaa naal ||
english: For His sake, you assumed this body; see God always with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooriaa prabh aapanee nadar nihaal ||2||
english: God is pervading the water, the land and the sky; He sees all with His Glance of Grace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: man tan niramal hoiaa laagee saach pareet ||
english: The mind and body become spotlessly pure, enshrining love for the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਭਜੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: charan bhaje paarabraham ke sabh jap tap tin hee keet ||3||
english: One who dwells upon the Feet of the Supreme Lord God has truly performed all meditations and austerities. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਿਕਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ratan javehar maanikaa a(n)mrit har kaa naau ||
english: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is a Gem, a Jewel, a Pearl.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਸ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੮੭॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ras jan naanak har gun gaau ||4||17||87||
english: The essence of intuitive peace and bliss is obtained, O servant Nanak, by singing the Glories of God. ||4||17||87||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸਾਸਤੁ ਸਉਣੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: soee saasat saun soi jit japeeai har naau ||
english: That is the essence of the scriptures, and that is a good omen, by which one comes to chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal gur dhan deeaa miliaa nithaave thaau ||
english: The Guru has given me the Wealth of the Lotus Feet of the Lord, and I, without shelter, have now obtained Shelter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saachee poo(n)jee sach sa(n)jamo aath pahar gun gaau ||
english: The True Capital, and the True Way of Life, comes by chanting His Glories, twenty-four hours a day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh bhetiaa maran na aavan jaau ||1||
english: Granting His Grace, God meets us, and we no longer die, or come or go in reincarnation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: mere man har bhaj sadaa ik ra(n)g ||
english: O my mind, vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord, with single-minded love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar rav rahiaa sadaa sahaaee sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is contained deep within each and every heart. He is always with you, as your Helper and Support. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਾ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: sukhaa kee mit kiaa ganee jaa simaree govi(n)d ||
english: How can I measure the happiness of meditating on the Lord of the Universe?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿਆ ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jin chaakhiaa se tripataasiaa uh ras jaanai ji(n)d ||
english: Those who taste it are satisfied and fulfilled; their souls know this Sublime Essence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa sa(n)gat man vasai prabh preetam bakhasi(n)d ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, God, the Beloved, the Forgiver, comes to dwell within the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਜ ਨਰਿੰਦੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin seviaa prabh aapanaa soee raaj nari(n)d ||2||
english: One who has served his God is the emperor of kings||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਸਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਣ ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ausar har jas gun raman jit kot majan isanaan ||
english: This is the time to speak and sing the Praise and the Glory of God, which brings the merit of millions of cleansing and purifying baths.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਗੁਣਵਤੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੁਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa ucharai gunavatee koi na pujai daan ||
english: The tongue which chants these Praises is worthy; there is no charity equal to this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: drisat dhaar man tan vasai daiaal purakh miharavaan ||
english: Blessing us with His Glance of Grace, the Kind and Compassionate, All-powerful Lord comes to dwell within the mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d dhan tis daa hau sadaa sadaa kurabaan ||3||
english: My soul, body and wealth are His. Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਜੋ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: miliaa kade na vichhuRai jo meliaa karataar ||
english: One whom the Creator Lord has met and joined to Himself shall never again be separated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਾ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਟਿਆ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: daasaa ke ba(n)dhan katiaa saachai sirajanahaar ||
english: The True Creator Lord breaks the bonds of His slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhoolaa maarag paaion gun avagun na beechaar ||
english: The doubter has been put back on the path; his merits and demerits have not been considered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਿ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੮੮॥
transliteration: naanak tis saranaagatee j sagal ghataa aadhaar ||4||18||88||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the One who is the Support of every heart. ||4||18||88||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa sachaa simareeai man tan niramal hoi ||
english: With your tongue, repeat the True Name, and your mind and body shall become pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਾਕ ਅਗਲੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa saak agale tis bin avar na koi ||
english: Your mother and father and all your relations-without Him, there are none at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mihar kare je aapanee chasaa na visarai soi ||1||
english: If God Himself bestows His Mercy, then He is not forgotten, even for an instant. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: man mere saachaa sev jichar saas ||
english: O my mind, serve the True One, as long as you have the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin sache sabh kooR hai a(n)te hoi binaas ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the True One, everything is false; in the end, all shall perish. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saahib meraa niramalaa tis bin rahan na jaai ||
english: My Lord and Master is Immaculate and Pure; without Him, I cannot even survive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: merai man tan bhukh at agalee koee aan milaavai maai ||
english: Within my mind and body, there is such a great hunger; if only someone would come and unite me with Him, O my mother!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੀਆ ਸਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa bhaaleeaa sah bin avar na jaai ||2||
english: I have searched the four corners of the world-without our Husband Lord, there is no other place of rest. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tis aagai aradaas kar jo mele karataar ||
english: Offer your prayers to Him, who shall unite you with the Creator.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur daataa naam kaa pooraa jis bha(n)daar ||
english: The True Guru is the Giver of the Naam; His Treasure is perfect and overflowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa saalaaheeai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||3||
english: Forever and ever, praise the One, who has no end or limitation. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਚਲਤ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
transliteration: paravadagaar saalaaheeai jis de chalat anek ||
english: Praise God, the Nurturer and Cherisher; His Wondrous Ways are unlimited.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਏਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa aaraadheeai ehaa mat visekh ||
english: Forever and ever, worship and adore Him; this is the most wonderful wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੮੯॥
transliteration: man tan mithaa tis lagai jis masatak naanak lekh ||4||19||89||
english: O Nanak, God's Flavor is sweet to the minds and bodies of those who have such blessed destiny written on their foreheads. ||4||19||89||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janahu mil bhaaeeho sachaa naam samaal ||
english: Meet with the humble Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, and contemplate the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੋਸਾ ਬੰਧਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: tosaa ba(n)dhahu jee kaa aithai othai naal ||
english: For the journey of the soul, gather those supplies which will go with you here and hereafter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: gur poore te paaeeai apanee nadar nihaal ||
english: These are obtained from the Perfect Guru, when God bestows His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karam paraapat tis hovai jis no hoi daiaal ||1||
english: Those unto whom He is Merciful, receive His Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man gur jevad avar na koi ||
english: O my mind, there is no other as great as the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੋ ਸੁਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: doojaa thaau na ko sujhai gur mele sach soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I cannot imagine any other place. The Guru leads me to meet the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sagal padaarath tis mile jin gur dithaa jaai ||
english: Those who go to see the Guru obtain all treasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਾ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur charanee jin man lagaa se vadabhaagee maai ||
english: Those whose minds are attached to the Guru's Feet are very fortunate, O my mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur daataa samarath gur gur sabh mahi rahiaa samaai ||
english: The Guru is the Giver, the Guru is All-powerful. The Guru is All-pervading, contained amongst all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਲਏ ਤਰਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur paramesar paarabraham gur dubadaa lae taraai ||2||
english: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God. The Guru lifts up and saves those who are drowning. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
transliteration: kit mukh gur saalaaheeai karan kaaran samarath ||
english: How shall I praise the Guru, the All-powerful Cause of causes?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਮਥੇ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਰਹੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਹਥੁ ॥
transliteration: se mathe nihachal rahe jin gur dhaariaa hath ||
english: Those, upon whose foreheads the Guru has placed His Hand, remain steady and stable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆਲਿਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਪਥੁ ॥
transliteration: gur a(n)mrit naam peeaaliaa janam maran kaa path ||
english: The Guru has led me to drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He has released me from the cycle of birth and death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਲਥੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur paramesar seviaa bhai bha(n)jan dukh lath ||3||
english: I serve the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, the Dispeller of fear; my suffering has been taken away. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਘਖੰਡੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur gahir gabheer hai sukh saagar aghakha(n)d ||
english: The True Guru is the Deep and Profound Ocean of Peace, the Destroyer of sin.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਡੰਡੁ ॥
transliteration: jin gur seviaa aapanaa jamadoot na laagai da(n)d ||
english: For those who serve their Guru, there is no punishment at the hands of the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਖੋਜਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੁ ॥
transliteration: gur naal tul na lagaee khoj dithaa brahama(n)d ||
english: There is none to compare with the Guru; I have searched and looked throughout the entire universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੰਡੁ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੯੦॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan satigur deeaa sukh naanak man mahi ma(n)d ||4||20||90||
english: The True Guru has bestowed the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. O Nanak, the mind is filled with peace. ||4||20||90||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਇਆ ਕਉੜਾ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: mithaa kar kai khaaiaa kauRaa upajiaa saad ||
english: People eat what they believe to be sweet, but it turns out to be bitter in taste.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਰਿਦ ਕੀਏ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਚਿਆ ਬਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee meet surid keee bikhiaa rachiaa baad ||
english: They attach their affections to brothers and friends, uselessly engrossed in corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa(n)de bilam na hovaee vin naavai bisamaad ||1||
english: They vanish without a moment's delay; without God's Name, they are stunned and amazed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: mere man satagur kee sevaa laag ||
english: O my mind, attach yourself to the service of the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਵਿਣਸਣਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai so vinasanaa man kee mat tiaag ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever is seen, shall pass away. Abandon the intellectualizations of your mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕੂਕਰੁ ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ਧਾਵੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jiu kookar harakaaiaa dhaavai dah dis jaai ||
english: Like the mad dog running around in all directions,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੀ ਜੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਭਖੁ ਅਭਖੁ ਸਭ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: lobhee ja(n)t na jaanaee bhakh abhakh sabh khaai ||
english: the greedy person, unaware, consumes everything, edible and non-edible alike.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਦਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaam krodh mad biaapiaa phir phir jonee paai ||2||
english: Engrossed in the intoxication of sexual desire and anger, people wander through reincarnation over and over again. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਚੋਗ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa jaal pasaariaa bheetar chog banaai ||
english: Maya has spread out her net, and in it, she has placed the bait.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਪੰਖੀ ਫਾਸਿਆ ਨਿਕਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa pa(n)khee phaasiaa nikas na paae maai ||
english: The bird of desire is caught, and cannot find any escape, O my mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin keetaa tisahi na jaanaee phir phir aavai jaai ||3||
english: One who does not know the Lord who created him, comes and goes in reincarnation over and over again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੀ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: anik prakaaree mohiaa bahu bidh ihu sa(n)saar ||
english: By various devices, and in so many ways, this world is enticed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਰਖੈ ਸੋ ਰਹੈ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jis no rakhai so rahai sa(n)mrith purakh apaar ||
english: They alone are saved, whom the All-powerful, Infinite Lord protects.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਧਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੯੧॥
transliteration: har jan har liv udhare naanak sad balihaar ||4||21||91||
english: The servants of the Lord are saved by the Love of the Lord. O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||21||91||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਇਲਿ ਆਇਆ ਗੋਇਲੀ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਡੰਫੁ ਪਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: goil aaiaa goilee kiaa tis da(n)ph pasaar ||
english: The herdsman comes to the pasture lands-what good are his ostentatious displays here?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਚਲਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮਲੁ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: muhalat pu(n)nee chalanaa too(n) sa(n)mal ghar baar ||1||
english: When your allotted time is up, you must go. Take care of your real hearth and home. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਮਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaau manaa satigur sev piaar ||
english: O mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and serve the True Guru with love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਥੋੜੜੀ ਬਾਤ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kiaa thoRaRee baat gumaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Why do you take pride in trivial matters? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰੈਣਿ ਪਰਾਹੁਣੇ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਸਹਿ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jaise rain paraahune uth chalasahi parabhaat ||
english: Like an overnight guest, you shall arise and depart in the morning.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਰਤਾ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਸਿਉ ਸਭ ਫੁਲਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਗਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kiaa too(n) rataa girasat siu sabh phulaa kee baagaat ||2||
english: Why are you so attached to your household? It is all like flowers in the garden. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੋੜਿ ॥
transliteration: meree meree kiaa karahi jin deeaa so prabh loR ||
english: Why do you say, "Mine, mine"? Look to God, who has given it to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਪਰ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਣਾ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sarapar uthee chalanaa chhad jaasee lakh karoR ||3||
english: It is certain that you must arise and depart, and leave behind your hundreds of thousands and millions. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਿਆ ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇਓਇ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh bhramatiaa dulabh janam paaioi ||
english: Through 8.4 million incarnations you have wandered, to obtain this rare and precious human life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜਾ ਆਇਓਇ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੯੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam samaal too(n) so din neRaa aaioi ||4||22||92||
english: O Nanak, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the day of departure is drawing near! ||4||22||92||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੀ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: tichar vasahi suhelaRee jichar saathee naal ||
english: As long as the soul-companion is with the body, it dwells in happiness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਸਾਥੀ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਧਨ ਖਾਕੂ ਰਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa saathee uthee chaliaa taa dhan khaakoo raal ||1||
english: But when the companion arises and departs, then the body-bride mingles with dust. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣੈ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man bairaag bhaiaa darasan dekhanai kaa chaau ||
english: My mind has become detached from the world; it longs to see the Vision of God's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s teraa thaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Blessed is Your Place. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜੀਉ ਸਭਿ ਕਹਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jichar vasiaa ka(n)t ghar jeeu jeeu sabh kahaat ||
english: As long as the soul-husband dwells in the body-house, everyone greets you with respect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਸੀ ਕੰਤੜਾ ਤਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa uthee chalasee ka(n)taRaa taa koi na puchhai teree baat ||2||
english: But when the soul-husband arises and departs, then no one cares for you at all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਸਹੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੁ ॥
transliteration: peeeaRai sahu sev too(n) saahuraRai sukh vas ||
english: In this world of your parents' home, serve your Husband Lord; in the world beyond, in your in-laws' home, you shall dwell in peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਦੁਖੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur mil chaj achaar sikh tudh kade na lagai dukh ||3||
english: Meeting with the Guru, be a sincere student of proper conduct, and suffering shall never touch you. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਵੰਞਣਾ ਸਭਿ ਮੁਕਲਾਵਣਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa saahurai va(n)njanaa sabh mukalaavanahaar ||
english: Everyone shall go to their Husband Lord. Everyone shall be given their ceremonial send-off after their marriage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੯੩॥
transliteration: naanak dha(n)n sohaaganee jin sah naal piaar ||4||23||93||
english: O Nanak, blessed are the happy soul-brides, who are in love with their Husband Lord. ||4||23||93||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 6 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਏਕੁ ਓਹੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran ek ohee jin keeaa aakaar ||
english: The One Lord is the Doer, the Cause of causes, who has created the creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tisahi dhiaavahu man mere sarab ko aadhaar ||1||
english: Meditate on the One, O my mind, who is the Support of all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan man mahi dhiaai ||
english: Meditate within your mind on the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chhod sagal siaanapaa saach sabad liv laai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Give up all your clever mental tricks, and lovingly attune yourself to the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਕਲੇਸੁ ਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh kales na bhau biaapai gur ma(n)tr hiradai hoi ||
english: Suffering, agony and fear do not cling to one whose heart is filled with the GurMantra.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kot jatanaa kar rahe gur bin tario na koi ||2||
english: Trying millions of things, people have grown weary, but without the Guru, none have been saved. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ ਪਾਪ ਸਗਲੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: dekh darasan man saadhaarai paap sagale jaahi ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, the mind is comforted and all sins depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hau tin kai balihaaranai j gur kee pairee paahi ||3||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who fall at the Feet of the Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat man vasai saach har kaa naau ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the True Name of the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਭਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੯੪॥
transliteration: se vadabhaagee naanakaa jinaa man ihu bhaau ||4||24||94||
english: Very fortunate are those, O Nanak, whose minds are filled with this love. ||4||24||94||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)ch har dhan pooj satigur chhod sagal vikaar ||
english: Gather in the Wealth of the Lord, worship the True Guru, and give up all your corrupt ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin too(n) saaj savaariaa har simar hoi udhaar ||1||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord who created and adorned you, and you shall be saved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jap man naam ek apaar ||
english: O mind, chant the Name of the One, the Unique and Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਦੀਆ ਰਿਦੇ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: praan man tan jinahi deeaa ride kaa aadhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He gave you the praanaa, the breath of life, and your mind and body. He is the Support of the heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar maate viaapiaa sa(n)saar ||
english: The world is drunk, engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pau sa(n)t saranee laag charanee mitai dookh a(n)dhaar ||2||
english: Seek the Sanctuary of the Saints, and fall at their feet; your suffering and darkness shall be removed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਏਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh daiaa kamaavai eh karanee saar ||
english: Practice truth, contentment and kindness; this is the most excellent way of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ਰੇਣਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap chhod sabh hoi renaa jis dei prabh nira(n)kaar ||3||
english: One who is so blessed by the Formless Lord God renounces selfishness, and becomes the dust of all. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai so sagal too(n)hai pasariaa paasaar ||
english: All that is seen is You, Lord, the expansion of the expanse.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੯੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur bharam kaatiaa sagal braham beechaar ||4||25||95||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has removed my doubts; I recognize God in all. ||4||25||95||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਧੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਗਲਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: dukrit sukrit ma(n)dhe sa(n)saar sagalaanaa ||
english: The whole world is engrossed in bad deeds and good deeds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: duhahoo(n) te rahat bhagat hai koee viralaa jaanaa ||1||
english: God's devotee is above both, but those who understand this are very rare. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਰਬੇ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: thaakur sarabe samaanaa ||
english: Our Lord and Master is all-pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਸੁਣਉ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kiaa kahau sunau suaamee too(n) vad purakh sujaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: What should I say, and what should I hear? O my Lord and Master, You are Great, All-powerful and All-knowing. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਮੰਧੇ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: maan abhimaan ma(n)dhe so sevak naahee ||
english: One who is influenced by praise and blame is not God's servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਤ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਮੰਧਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tat samadarasee sa(n)tahu koee kot ma(n)dhaahee ||2||
english: One who sees the essence of reality with impartial vision, O Saints, is very rare-one among millions. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kahan kahaavan ihu keerat karalaa ||
english: People talk on and on about Him; they consider this to be praise of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨ ਕਹਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kathan kahan te mukataa guramukh koee viralaa ||3||
english: But rare indeed is the Gurmukh, who is above this mere talk. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਅਵਿਗਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gat avigat kachh nadar na aaiaa ||
english: He is not concerned with deliverance or bondage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੯੬॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kee ren naanak daan paaiaa ||4||26||96||
english: Nanak has obtained the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||26||96||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 7 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਭਰੋਸੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੈ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: terai bharosai piaare mai laad ladaaiaa ||
english: Relying on Your Mercy, Dear Lord, I have cherished and loved you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਹਿ ਚੂਕਹਿ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhoolahi chookahi baarik too(n) har pitaa maaiaa ||1||
english: Like a foolish child, I have made mistakes. O Lord, You are my Father and Mother. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਕਹਨੁ ਕਹਾਵਨੁ ॥
transliteration: suhelaa kahan kahaavan ||
english: It is easy to speak and talk,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਭਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teraa bikham bhaavan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: but it is difficult to accept Your Will. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਜਾਨਉ ਆਪਾ ॥
transliteration: hau maan taan karau teraa hau jaanau aapaa ||
english: I stand tall; You are my Strength. I know that You are mine.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮਧਿ ਸਭਹਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜ ਬਾਪਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh hee madh sabhahi te baahar bemuhataaj baapaa ||2||
english: Inside of all, and outside of all, You are our Self-sufficient Father. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਹਉ ਜਾਨਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: pitaa hau jaanau naahee teree kavan jugataa ||
english: O Father, I do not know-how can I know Your Way?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਮਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan mukat sa(n)tahu meree raakhai mamataa ||3||
english: He frees us from bondage, O Saints, and saves us from possessiveness. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਹਿਓ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: bhae kirapaal thaakur rahio aavan jaanaa ||
english: Becoming Merciful, my Lord and Master has ended my comings and goings in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੯੭॥
transliteration: gur mil naanak paarabraham pachhaanaa ||4||27||97||
english: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak has recognized the Supreme Lord God. ||4||27||97||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਾਈਆ ਕਟਿਅੜਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil bhaaeeaa katiaRaa jamakaal ||
english: Meeting with the humble beings, O Siblings of Destiny, the Messenger of Death is conquered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਹੋਆ ਖਸਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib man vuthaa hoaa khasam daiaal ||
english: The True Lord and Master has come to dwell within my mind; my Lord and Master has become Merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pooraa satigur bhetiaa binasiaa sabh ja(n)jaal ||1||
english: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, all my worldly entanglements have ended. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: mere satiguraa hau tudh vitahu kurabaan ||
english: O my True Guru, I am a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਤੁਸਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tere darasan kau balihaaranai tus ditaa a(n)mrit naam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. By the Pleasure of Your Will, You have blessed me with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jin too(n) seviaa bhaau kar seee purakh sujaan ||
english: Those who have served You with love are truly wise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tinaa pichhai chhuteeai jin a(n)dar naam nidhaan ||
english: Those who have the Treasure of the Naam within emancipate others as well as themselves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਆਤਮ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur jevad daataa ko nahee jin ditaa aatam daan ||2||
english: There is no other Giver as great as the Guru, who has given the gift of the soul. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aae se paravaan hahi jin gur miliaa subhaai ||
english: Blessed and acclaimed is the coming of those who have met the Guru with loving faith.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sache setee ratiaa daragah baisan jaai ||
english: Attuned to the True One, you shall obtain a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੇ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karate hath vadiaaeeaa poorab likhiaa paai ||3||
english: Greatness is in the Hands of the Creator; it is obtained by pre-ordained destiny. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: sach karataa sach karanahaar sach saahib sach tek ||
english: True is the Creator, True is the Doer. True is our Lord and Master, and True is His Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸਚੋ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
transliteration: sacho sach vakhaaneeai sacho budh bibek ||
english: So speak the Truest of the True. Through the True One, an intuitive and discerning mind is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਏਕ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੯੮॥
transliteration: sarab nira(n)tar rav rahiaa jap naanak jeevai ek ||4||28||98||
english: Nanak lives by chanting and meditating on the One, who is pervading within and contained amongst all. ||4||28||98||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur paramesur poojeeai man tan laai piaar ||
english: Worship the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, with your mind and body attuned to love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur daataa jee kaa sabhasai dei adhaar ||
english: The True Guru is the Giver of the soul; He gives Support to all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਸਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur bachan kamaavane sachaa ehu veechaar ||
english: Act according to the Instructions of the True Guru; this is the true philosophy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin saadhoo sa(n)gat ratiaa maaiaa mohu sabh chhaar ||1||
english: Without being attuned to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all attachment to Maya is just dust. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: mere saajan har har naam samaal ||
english: O my friend, reflect upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat man vasai pooran hovai ghaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: . In the Saadh Sangat, He dwells within the mind, and one's works are brought to perfect fruition. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur samarath apaar gur vadabhaagee darasan hoi ||
english: The Guru is All-powerful, the Guru is Infinite. By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur agochar niramalaa gur jevad avar na koi ||
english: The Guru is Imperceptible, Immaculate and Pure. There is no other as great as the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur karataa gur karanahaar guramukh sachee soi ||
english: The Guru is the Creator, the Guru is the Doer. The Gurmukh obtains true glory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur te baahar kichh nahee gur keetaa loRe s hoi ||2||
english: Nothing is beyond the Guru; whatever He wishes comes to pass. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur teerath gur paarajaat gur manasaa pooranahaar ||
english: The Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur daataa har naam dei udharai sabh sa(n)saar ||
english: The Guru is the Fulfiller of the desires of the mind. The Guru is the Giver of the Name of the Lord, by which all the world is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur samarath gur nira(n)kaar gur oochaa agam apaar ||
english: The Guru is All-powerful, the Guru is Formless; the Guru is Lofty, Inaccessible and Infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੇ ਕਥਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kee mahimaa agam hai kiaa kathe kathanahaar ||3||
english: The Praise of the Guru is so sublime-what can any speaker say? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੜੇ ਫਲ ਮਨਿ ਬਾਛੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਤੜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jitaRe phal man baachheeahi titaRe satigur paas ||
english: All the rewards which the mind desires are with the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਪਾਵਣੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: poorab likhe paavane saach naam de raas ||
english: One whose destiny is so pre-ordained, obtains the Wealth of the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆਂ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur saranee aaiaa(n) baahuR nahee binaas ||
english: Entering the Sanctuary of the True Guru, you shall never die again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੯੯॥
transliteration: har naanak kade na visarau ehu jeeu pi(n)d teraa saas ||4||29||99||
english: Nanak: may I never forget You, Lord. This soul, body and breath are Yours. ||4||29||99||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janahu sun bhaaeeho chhootan saachai naai ||
english: O Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, listen: release comes only through the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਣੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan sarevane teerath har kaa naau ||
english: Worship the Feet of the Guru. Let the Name of the Lord be your sacred shrine of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮੰਨੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aagai daragahi ma(n)neeahi milai nithaave thaau ||1||
english: Hereafter, you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord; there, even the homeless find a home. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re saachee satigur sev ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, service to the True Guru alone is True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur tuthai paaeeai pooran alakh abhev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When the True Guru is pleased, we obtain the Perfect, Unseen, Unknowable Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur vitahu vaariaa jin ditaa sach naau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has bestowed the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anadin sach salaahanaa sache ke gun gaau ||
english: Night and day, I praise the True One; I sing the Glorious Praises of the True One.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sache sachaa naau ||2||
english: True is the food, and true are the clothes, of those who chant the True Name of the True One. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਫਲੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: saas giraas na visarai saphal moorat gur aap ||
english: With each breath and morsel of food, do not forget the Guru, the Embodiment of Fulfillment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: gur jevad avar na disaee aath pahar tis jaap ||
english: None is seen to be as great as the Guru. Meditate on Him twenty-four hours a day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa paaeeai sach naam gunataas ||3||
english: As He casts His Glance of Grace, we obtain the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur paramesar ek hai sabh mahi rahiaa samaai ||
english: The Guru and the Transcendent Lord are one and the same, pervading and permeating amongst all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa seee naam dhiaai ||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, meditate on the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੧੦੦॥
transliteration: naanak gur saranaagatee marai na aavai jaai ||4||30||100||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Guru, who does not die, or come and go in reincarnation. ||4||30||100||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 1 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਵਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਪੈ ਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aakh aakh man vaavanaa jiu jiu jaapai vaai ||
english: I speak and chant His Praises, vibrating the instrument of my mind. The more I know Him, the more I vibrate it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਾਇ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis no vaai sunaaeeai so kevad kit thaai ||
english: The One, unto whom we vibrate and sing-how great is He, and where is His Place?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aakhan vaale jetaRe sabh aakh rahe liv laai ||1||
english: Those who speak of Him and praise Him-they all continue speaking of Him with love. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਅਲਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: baabaa alahu agam apaar ||
english: O Baba, the Lord Allah is Inaccessible and Infinite.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਕੀ ਨਾਈ ਪਾਕ ਥਾਇ ਸਚਾ ਪਰਵਦਿਗਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paakee naaee paak thaai sachaa paravadigaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Sacred is His Name, and Sacred is His Place. He is the True Cherisher. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: teraa hukam na jaapee ketaRaa likh na jaanai koi ||
english: The extent of Your Command cannot be seen; no one knows how to write it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਸਾਇਰ ਮੇਲੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਪੁਜਾਵਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: je sau saair meleeahi til na pujaavahi roi ||
english: Even if a hundred poets met together, they could not describe even a tiny bit of it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: keemat kinai na paaeeaa sabh sun sun aakhahi soi ||2||
english: No one has found Your Value; they all merely write what they have heard again and again. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਪੈਕਾਮਰ ਸਾਲਕ ਸਾਦਕ ਸੁਹਦੇ ਅਉਰੁ ਸਹੀਦ ॥
transliteration: peer paikaamar saalak saadak suhade aur saheed ||
english: The Pirs, the Prophets, the spiritual teachers, the faithful, the innocents and the martyrs,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁਲਾ ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਰਸੀਦ ॥
transliteration: sekh masaaik kaajee mulaa dar daraves raseed ||
english: the Shaikhs, the mystics, the Qazis, the Mullahs and the Dervishes at His Door

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਰਕਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਅਗਲੀ ਪੜਦੇ ਰਹਨਿ ਦਰੂਦ ॥੩॥
transliteration: barakat tin kau agalee paRade rahan darood ||3||
english: -they are blessed all the more as they continue reading their prayers in praise to Him. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਸਾਜੇ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਢਾਹੇ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: puchh na saaje puchh na dhaahe puchh na devai lei ||
english: He seeks no advice when He builds; He seeks no advice when He destroys. He seeks no advice while giving or taking.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aapanee kudarat aape jaanai aape karan karei ||
english: He alone knows His Creative Power; He Himself does all deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sabhanaa vekhai nadar kar jai bhaavai tai dei ||4||
english: He beholds all in His Vision. He gives to those with whom He is pleased. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਾਵਾ ਨਾਵ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਵਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: thaavaa naav na jaaneeahi naavaa kevad naau ||
english: His Place and His Name are not known, no one knows how great is His Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਵਸੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸੋ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਹੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jithai vasai meraa paatisaahu so kevad hai thaau ||
english: How great is that place where my Sovereign Lord dwells?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਬੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਹਉ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਪੁਛਣਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: a(n)baR koi na sakaee hau kis no puchhan jaau ||5||
english: No one can reach it; whom shall I go and ask? ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਰਨਾ ਵਰਨ ਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਡਾ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: varanaa varan na bhaavanee je kisai vadaa karei ||
english: One class of people does not like the other, when one has been made great.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: vade hath vadiaaeeaa jai bhaavai tai dei ||
english: Greatness is only in His Great Hands; He gives to those with whom He is pleased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਆਪਣੈ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਢਿਲ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: hukam savaare aapanai chasaa na dhil karei ||6||
english: By the Hukam of His Command, He Himself regenerates, without a moment's delay. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੈਣੈ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko aakhai bahut bahut lainai kai veechaar ||
english: Everyone cries out, "More! More!", with the idea of receiving.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੁਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kevad daataa aakheeai de kai rahiaa sumaar ||
english: How great should we call the Giver? His Gifts are beyond estimation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗਹ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੭॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tot na aavaee tere jugah jugah bha(n)daar ||7||1||
english: O Nanak, there is no deficiency; Your Storehouses are filled to overflowing, age after age. ||7||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਆ ਸਗਲੀਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabhe ka(n)t maheleeaa sagaleeaa karahi seegaar ||
english: All are brides of the Husband Lord; all decorate themselves for Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਵਣਿ ਆਈਆ ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ganat ganaavan aaeeaa soohaa ves vikaar ||
english: But when the time comes to settle their accounts, their red robes are corrupt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਖੋਟਾ ਪਾਜੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d prem na paaeeai khotaa paaj khuaar ||1||
english: His Love is not obtained through hypocrisy. Her false coverings bring only ruin. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਇਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu iu pir raavai naar ||
english: In this way, the Dear Husband Lord ravishes and enjoys His bride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tudh bhaavan sohaaganee apanee kirapaa laihi savaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The happy soul-bride is pleasing to You, Lord; by Your Grace, You adorn her. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee seegaareeaa tan man pir kai paas ||
english: She is decorated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; her mind and body belong to her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਖੜੀ ਤਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: dui kar joR khaRee takai sach kahai aradaas ||
english: With her palms pressed together, she stands, waiting on Him, and offers her True prayers to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਿ ਰਤੀ ਸਚ ਭੈ ਵਸੀ ਭਾਇ ਰਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: laal ratee sach bhai vasee bhaai ratee ra(n)g raas ||2||
english: Dyed in the deep crimson of the Love of her Darling Lord, she dwells in the Fear of the True One. Imbued with His Love, she is dyed in the color of His Love. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੀ ਚੇਰੀ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ਲਾਲੀ ਮਾਨੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
