transliteration: pri kee cheree kaa(n)dheeai laalee maanai naau ||
english: She is said to be the hand-maiden of her Beloved Lord; His sweetheart surrenders to His Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saachee preet na tutaee saache mel milaau ||
english: True Love is never broken; she is united in Union with the True One.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਵੇਧਿਆ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabad ratee man vedhiaa hau sad balihaarai jaau ||3||
english: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, her mind is pierced through. I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰੰਡ ਨ ਬੈਸਈ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan ra(n)d na baisaee je satigur maahi samaai ||
english: That bride, who is absorbed into the True Guru, shall never become a widow.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਨਉਤਨੋ ਸਾਚਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pir reesaaloo nautano saachau marai na jaai ||
english: Her Husband Lord is Beautiful; His Body is forever fresh and new. The True One does not die, and shall not go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: nit ravai sohaaganee saachee nadar rajaai ||4||
english: He continually enjoys His happy soul-bride; He casts His Gracious Glance of Truth upon her, and she abides in His Will. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਧੜੀ ਧਨ ਮਾਡੀਐ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saach dhaRee dhan maadeeai kaapaR prem seegaar ||
english: The bride braids her hair with Truth; her clothes are decorated with His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਦਸਵਾ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)dan cheet vasaaiaa ma(n)dar dasavaa duaar ||
english: Like the essence of sandalwood, He permeates her consciousness, and the Temple of the Tenth Gate is opened.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: deepak sabad vigaasiaa raam naam ur haar ||5||
english: The lamp of the Shabad is lit, and the Name of the Lord is her necklace. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਣੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naaree a(n)dar sohanee masatak manee piaar ||
english: She is the most beautiful among women; upon her forehead she wears the Jewel of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sobhaa surat suhaavanee saachai prem apaar ||
english: Her glory and her wisdom are magnificent; her love for the Infinite Lord is True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bin pir purakh na jaanaee saache gur kai het piaar ||6||
english: Other than her Beloved Lord, she knows no man. She enshrines love for the True Guru. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਸੁਤੀਏ ਕਿਉ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: nis a(n)dhiaaree suteee kiu pir bin rain vihaai ||
english: Asleep in the darkness of the night, how shall she pass her life-night without her Husband?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਕੁ ਜਲਉ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਲੀਅਉ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)k jalau tan jaaleeau man dhan jal bal jaai ||
english: Her limbs shall burn, her body shall burn, and her mind and wealth shall burn as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਨ ਰਾਵੀਆ ਤਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jaa dhan ka(n)t na raaveeaa taa birathaa joban jaai ||7||
english: When the Husband does not enjoy His bride, then her youth passes away in vain. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੜੀ ਸੂਤੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sejai ka(n)t mahelaRee sootee boojh na paai ||
english: The Husband is on the Bed, but the bride is asleep, and so she does not come to know Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸੁਤੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਗਣਾ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hau sutee pir jaaganaa kis kau poochhau jaai ||
english: While I am asleep, my Husband Lord is awake. Where can I go for advice?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਭੈ ਵਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸਖਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur melee bhai vasee naanak prem sakhaai ||8||2||
english: The True Guru has led me to meet Him, and now I dwell in the Fear of God. O Nanak, His Love is always with me. ||8||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਆਪੇ ਕਥੈ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape gun aape kathai aape sun veechaar ||
english: O Lord, You are Your Own Glorious Praise. You Yourself speak it; You Yourself hear it and contemplate it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਖਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape ratan parakh too(n) aape mol apaar ||
english: You Yourself are the Jewel, and You are the Appraiser. You Yourself are of Infinite Value.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਉ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saachau maan mahat too(n) aape devanahaar ||1||
english: O True Lord, You are Honor and Glory; You Yourself are the Giver. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu too(n) karataa karataar ||
english: O Dear Lord, You are the Creator and the Cause.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakh too(n) har naam milai aachaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If it is Your Will, please save and protect me; please bless me with the lifestyle of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ॥
transliteration: aape heeraa niramalaa aape ra(n)g majeeth ||
english: You Yourself are the flawless diamond; You Yourself are the deep crimson color.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੋਤੀ ਊਜਲੋ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤ ਬਸੀਠੁ ॥
transliteration: aape motee oojalo aape bhagat baseeth ||
english: You Yourself are the perfect pearl; You Yourself are the devotee and the priest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਡੀਠੁ ਅਡੀਠੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad salaahanaa ghat ghat deeth adeeth ||2||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are praised. In each and every heart, the Unseen is seen. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape saagar bohithaa aape paar apaar ||
english: You Yourself are the ocean and the boat. You Yourself are this shore, and the one beyond.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਵਾਟ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਘਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saachee vaat sujaan too(n) sabad laghaavanahaar ||
english: O All-knowing Lord, You are the True Way. The Shabad is the Navigator to ferry us across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਡਰਿਆ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nidariaa dar jaaneeai baajh guroo gubaar ||3||
english: One who does not fear God shall live in fear; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੇਤੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: asathir karataa dekheeai hor ketee aavai jaai ||
english: The Creator alone is seen to be Eternal; all others come and go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਰ ਬੰਧੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape niramal ek too(n) hor ba(n)dhee dha(n)dhai paai ||
english: Only You, Lord, are Immaculate and Pure. All others are bound up in worldly pursuits.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare saache siu liv laai ||4||
english: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved. They are lovingly attuned to the True Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕਿ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu sabad pachhaaneeai saach rate gur vaak ||
english: Through the Shabad, they recognize the Dear Lord; through the Guru's Word, they are attuned to Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਓਤਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: tit tan mail na lagaee sach ghar jis otaak ||
english: Filth does not stick to the body of one who has secured a dwelling in his True Home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਕੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: nadar kare sach paaeeai bin naavai kiaa saak ||5||
english: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, we obtain the True Name. Without the Name, who are our relatives? ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee sach pachhaaniaa se sukheee jug chaar ||
english: Those who have realized the Truth are at peace throughout the four ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai trisanaa maar kai sach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||
english: Subduing their egotism and desires, they keep the True Name enshrined in their hearts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jag mahi laahaa ek naam paaeeai gur veechaar ||6||
english: In this world, the only real profit is the Name of the One Lord; it is earned by contemplating the Guru. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਉ ਵਖਰੁ ਲਾਦੀਐ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: saachau vakhar laadeeai laabh sadaa sach raas ||
english: Loading the Merchandise of the True Name, you shall gather in your profits forever with the Capital of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: saachee daragah baisaee bhagat sachee aradaas ||
english: In the Court of the True One, you shall sit in truthful devotion and prayer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: pat siu lekhaa nibaRai raam naam paragaas ||7||
english: Your account shall be settled with honor, in the Radiant Light of the Name of the Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਊਚਉ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਹਉ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: oochaa oochau aakheeai kahau na dekhiaa jaai ||
english: The Lord is said to be the Highest of the High; no one can perceive Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah ek too(n) satigur deeaa dikhaai ||
english: Wherever I look, I see only You. The True Guru has inspired me to see You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: jot nira(n)tar jaaneeai naanak sahaj subhaai ||8||3||
english: The Divine Light within is revealed, O Nanak, through this intuitive understanding. ||8||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਜਾਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸਰੁ ਖਾਰਾ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: machhulee jaal na jaaniaa sar khaaraa asagaahu ||
english: The fish did not notice the net in the deep and salty sea.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਸਿਆਣੀ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਤੋ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: at siaanee sohanee kiu keeto vesaahu ||
english: It was so clever and beautiful, but why was it so confident?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤੇ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਕੜੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਟਲੈ ਸਿਰਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: keete kaaran paakaRee kaal na talai siraahu ||1||
english: By its actions it was caught, and now death cannot be turned away from its head. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਇਉ ਸਿਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re iu sir jaanahu kaal ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, just like this, see death hovering over your own heads!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੀ ਤਿਉ ਮਾਣਸਾ ਪਵੈ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu machhee tiu maanasaa pavai achi(n)taa jaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: People are just like this fish; unaware, the noose of death descends upon them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧੋ ਕਾਲ ਕੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਲੁ ਅਫਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag baadho kaal ko bin gur kaal aphaar ||
english: The whole world is bound by death; without the Guru, death cannot be avoided.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sach rate se ubare dubidhaa chhod vikaar ||
english: Those who are attuned to Truth are saved; they renounce duality and corruption.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hau tin kai balihaaranai dar sachai sachiaar ||2||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who are found to be Truthful in the True Court. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੀਚਾਨੇ ਜਿਉ ਪੰਖੀਆ ਜਾਲੀ ਬਧਿਕ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: seechaane jiu pa(n)kheeaa jaalee badhik haath ||
english: Think of the hawk preying on the birds, and the net in the hands of the hunter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਚੋਗੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare hor phaathe chogai saath ||
english: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; the others are caught by the bait.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਸੁਟੀਅਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin naavai chun suteeahi koi na sa(n)gee saath ||3||
english: Without the Name, they are picked up and thrown away; they have no friends or companions. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sacho sachaa aakheeai sache sachaa thaan ||
english: God is said to be the Truest of the True; His Place is the Truest of the True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jinee sachaa ma(n)niaa tin man sach dhiaan ||
english: Those who obey the True One-their minds abide in true meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਚੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: man mukh sooche jaaneeahi guramukh jinaa giaan ||4||
english: Those who become Gurmukh, and obtain spiritual wisdom-their minds and mouths are known to be pure. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur agai aradaas kar saajan dei milaai ||
english: Offer your most sincere prayers to the True Guru, so that He may unite you with your Best Friend.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saajan miliai sukh paaiaa jamadoot mue bikh khaai ||
english: Meeting your Best Friend, you shall find peace; the Messenger of Death shall take poison and die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਉ ਵਸਾਂ ਨਾਉ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naavai a(n)dar hau vasaa(n) naau vasai man aai ||5||
english: I dwell deep within the Name; the Name has come to dwell within my mind. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baajh guroo gubaar hai bin sabadai boojh na paai ||
english: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness; without the Shabad, understanding is not obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramatee paragaas hoi sach rahai liv laai ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be enlightened; remain absorbed in the Love of the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸੰਚਰੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: tithai kaal na sa(n)charai jotee jot samaai ||6||
english: Death does not go there; your light shall merge with the Light. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: too(n)hai saajan too(n) sujaan too(n) aape melanahaar ||
english: You are my Best Friend; You are All-knowing. You are the One who unites us with Yourself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee saalaaheeai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we praise You; You have no end or limitation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਅਪੜੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tithai kaal na apaRai jithai gur kaa sabad apaar ||7||
english: Death does not reach that place, where the Infinite Word of the Guru's Shabad resounds. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਭੇ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: hukamee sabhe oopajahi hukamee kaar kamaahi ||
english: By the Hukam of His Command, all are created. By His Command, actions are performed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: hukamee kaalai vas hai hukamee saach samaahi ||
english: By His Command, all are subject to death; by His Command, they merge in Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਇਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੮॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaavai so theeai inaa ja(n)taa vas kichh naahi ||8||4||
english: O Nanak, whatever pleases His Will comes to pass. Nothing is in the hands of these beings. ||8||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਜੂਠੈ ਤਨਿ ਜੂਠਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man joothai tan jooth hai jihavaa joothee hoi ||
english: If the mind is polluted, then the body is polluted, and the tongue is polluted as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mukh jhoothai jhooth bolanaa kiu kar soochaa hoi ||
english: With false mouths, people speak falsehood. How can they be made pure?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਅਭ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਮਾਂਜੀਐ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin abh sabad na maa(n)jeeai saache te sach hoi ||1||
english: Without the Holy Water of the Shabad, they are not cleansed. From the True One alone comes Truth. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਗੁਣਹੀਣੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਕੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dhe gunaheenee sukh kehi ||
english: O soul-bride, without virtue, what happiness can there be?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਲੀਆ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਣਸੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨੇਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pir raleeaa ras maanasee saach sabad sukh nehi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Husband Lord enjoys her with pleasure and delight; she is at peace in the love of the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਧਨ ਵਾਂਢੀ ਝੂਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: pir paradesee je theeai dhan vaa(n)dhee jhoorei ||
english: When the Husband goes away, the bride suffers in the pain of separation,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲਿ ਥੋੜੈ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: jiu jal thoRai machhulee karan palaav karei ||
english: like the fish in shallow water, crying for mercy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pir bhaavai sukh paaeeai jaa aape nadar karei ||2||
english: As it pleases the Will of the Husband Lord, peace is obtained, when He Himself casts His Glance of Grace. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: pir saalaahee aapanaa sakhee sahelee naal ||
english: Praise your Husband Lord, together with your bridesmaids and friends.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਰਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: tan sohai man mohiaa ratee ra(n)g nihaal ||
english: The body is beautified, and the mind is fascinated. Imbued with His Love, we are enraptured.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabad savaaree sohanee pir raave gun naal ||3||
english: Adorned with the Shabad, the beautiful bride enjoys her Husband with virtue. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਖੋਟੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kaaman kaam na aavaee khotee avaganiaar ||
english: The soul-bride is of no use at all, if she is evil and without virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੇਈਐ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਝੂਠਿ ਜਲੀ ਵੇਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naa sukh peeeai saahurai jhooth jalee vekaar ||
english: She does not find peace in this world or the next; she burns in falsehood and corruption.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਵੰਞਣੁ ਡਾਖੜੋ ਛੋਡੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aavan va(n)njan daakhaRo chhodee ka(n)t visaar ||4||
english: Coming and going are very difficult for that bride who is abandoned and forgotten by her Husband Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮੁਤੀ ਸੋ ਕਿਤੁ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: pir kee naar suhaavanee mutee so kit saad ||
english: The beautiful soul-bride of the Husband Lord-by what sensual pleasures has she been doomed?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਬੋਲੇ ਫਾਦਿਲੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: pir kai kaam na aavaee bole phaadil baad ||
english: She is of no use to her Husband if she babbles in useless arguments.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ ਛੂਟੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: dar ghar dhoee naa lahai chhootee doojai saad ||5||
english: At the Door of His Home, she finds no shelter; she is discarded for seeking other pleasures. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵਾਚਹਿ ਪੋਥੀਆ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit vaachahi potheeaa naa boojhahi veechaar ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read their books, but they do not understand the real meaning.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਕਉ ਮਤੀ ਦੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: an kau matee de chalahi maaiaa kaa vaapaar ||
english: They give instructions to others, and then walk away, but they deal in Maya themselves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਝੂਠੀ ਜਗੁ ਭਵੈ ਰਹਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kathanee jhoothee jag bhavai rahanee sabad s saar ||6||
english: Speaking falsehood, they wander around the world, while those who remain true to the Shabad are excellent and exalted. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਬੇਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kete pa(n)dit jotakee bedaa karahi beechaar ||
english: There are so many Pandits and astrologers who ponder over the Vedas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਦਿ ਵਿਰੋਧਿ ਸਲਾਹਣੇ ਵਾਦੇ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: vaad virodh salaahane vaade aavan jaan ||
english: They glorify their disputes and arguments, and in these controversies they continue coming and going.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਛੁਟਸੀ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin gur karam na chhutasee kahi sun aakh vakhaan ||7||
english: Without the Guru, they are not released from their karma, although they speak and listen and preach and explain. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਮੈ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh gunava(n)tee aakheeahi mai gun naahee koi ||
english: They all call themselves virtuous, but I have no virtue at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har var naar suhaavanee mai bhaavai prabh soi ||
english: With the Lord as her Husband, the soul-bride is happy; I, too, love that God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਨਾ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak sabad milaavaRaa naa vechhoRaa hoi ||8||5||
english: O Nanak, through the Shabad, union is obtained; there is no more separation. ||8||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਧੀਐ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam saadheeai teerath keechai vaas ||
english: You may chant and meditate, practice austerities and self-restraint, and dwell at sacred shrines of pilgrimage;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਿਆ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: pu(n)n daan cha(n)giaaeeaa bin saache kiaa taas ||
english: you may give donations to charity, and perform good deeds, but without the True One, what is the use of it all?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਰਾਧੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਲੁਣੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਜਨਮੁ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jehaa raadhe tehaa lunai bin gun janam vinaas ||1||
english: As you plant, so shall you harvest. Without virtue, this human life passes away in vain. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਗੁਣ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dhe gun daasee sukh hoi ||
english: O young bride, be a slave to virtue, and you shall find peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avagan tiaag samaaeeai guramat pooraa soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Renouncing wrongful actions, following the Guru's Teachings, you shall be absorbed into the Perfect One. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ ਤਕੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: vin raasee vaapaareeaa take ku(n)daa chaar ||
english: Without capital, the trader looks around in all four directions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਵਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: mool na bujhai aapanaa vasat rahee ghar baar ||
english: He does not understand his own origins; the merchandise remains within the door of his own house.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਵਖਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vin vakhar dukh agalaa kooR muthee kooRiaar ||2||
english: Without this commodity, there is great pain. The false are ruined by falsehood. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਉਤਨਾ ਪਰਖੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: laahaa ahinis nautanaa parakhe ratan veechaar ||
english: One who contemplates and appraises this Jewel day and night reaps new profits.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: vasat lahai ghar aapanai chalai kaaraj saar ||
english: He finds the merchandise within his own home, and departs after arranging his affairs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vanajaariaa siu vanaj kar guramukh braham beechaar ||3||
english: So trade with the true traders, and as Gurmukh, contemplate God. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa(n) sa(n)gat paaeeai je mele melanahaar ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, He is found, if the Uniter unites us.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: miliaa hoi na vichhuRai jis a(n)tar jot apaar ||
english: One whose heart is filled with His Infinite Light meets with Him, and shall never again be separated from Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sachai aasan sach rahai sachai prem piaar ||4||
english: True is his position; he abides in Truth, with love and affection for the True One. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਸੁਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jinee aap pachhaaniaa ghar mahi mahal suthaai ||
english: One who understands himself finds the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within his own home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sache setee ratiaa sacho palai paai ||
english: Imbued with the True Lord, Truth is gathered in.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: tribhavan so prabh jaaneeai saacho saachai naai ||5||
english: God is known throughout the three worlds. True is the Name of the True One. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan kharee suhaavanee jin pir jaataa sa(n)g ||
english: The wife who knows that her Husband Lord is always with her is very beautiful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: mahalee mahal bulaaeeai so pir raave ra(n)g ||
english: The soul-bride is called to the Mansion of the His Presence, and her Husband Lord ravishes her with love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sach suhaagan saa bhalee pir mohee gun sa(n)g ||6||
english: The happy soul-bride is true and good; she is fascinated by the Glories of her Husband Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਥਲਿ ਚੜਾ ਥਲਿ ਚੜਿ ਡੂਗਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhoolee bhoolee thal chaRaa thal chaR doogar jaau ||
english: Wandering around and making mistakes, I climb the plateau; having climbed the plateau, I go up the mountain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ban mahi bhoolee je phiraa bin gur boojh na paau ||
english: But now I have lost my way, and I am wandering around in the forest; without the Guru, I do not understand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੂਲੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naavahu bhoolee je phiraa phir phir aavau jaau ||7||
english: If I wander around forgetting God's Name, I shall continue coming and going in reincarnation, over and over again. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਪਧਾਊਆ ਚਲੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: puchhahu jaai padhaaooaa chale chaakar hoi ||
english: Go and ask the travellers, how to walk on the Path as His slave.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਨੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: raajan jaanahi aapanaa dar ghar thaak na hoi ||
english: They know the Lord to be their King, and at the Door to His Home, their way is not blocked.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak eko rav rahiaa doojaa avar na koi ||8||6||
english: O Nanak, the One is pervading everywhere; there is no other at all. ||8||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur te niramal jaaneeai niramal deh sareer ||
english: Through the Guru, the Pure One is known, and the human body becomes pure as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਭ ਪੀਰ ॥
transliteration: niramal saacho man vasai so jaanai abh peer ||
english: The Pure, True Lord abides within the mind; He knows the pain of our hearts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਅਗਲੋ ਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਮ ਤੀਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sahajai te sukh agalo naa laagai jam teer ||1||
english: With intuitive ease, a great peace is found, and the arrow of death shall not strike you. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re mail naahee niramal jal naai ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, filth is washed away by bathing in the Pure Water of the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: niramal saachaa ek too hor mail bharee sabh jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You alone are Perfectly Pure, O True Lord; all other places are filled with filth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har kaa ma(n)dar sohanaa keeaa karanaihaar ||
english: The Temple of the Lord is beautiful; it was made by the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੀਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: rav sas deep anoop jot tribhavan jot apaar ||
english: The sun and the moon are lamps of incomparably beautiful light. Throughout the three worlds, the Infinite Light is pervading.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਾਟ ਪਟਣ ਗੜ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਵਾਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: haat patan gaR kothaRee sach saudaa vaapaar ||2||
english: In the shops of the city of the body, in the fortresses and in the huts, the True Merchandise is traded. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਦੇਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: giaan a(n)jan bhai bha(n)janaa dekh nira(n)jan bhaai ||
english: The ointment of spiritual wisdom is the destroyer of fear; through love, the Pure One is seen.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gupat pragat sabh jaaneeai je man raakhai thaai ||
english: The mysteries of the seen and the unseen are all known, if the mind is kept centered and balanced.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aisaa satigur je milai taa sahaje lae milaai ||3||
english: If one finds such a True Guru, the Lord is met with intuitive ease. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਪਰਖੇ ਹਿਤੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kas kasavatee laaeeai parakhe hit chit laai ||
english: He draws us to His Touchstone, to test our love and consciousness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਖਰੇ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khote thaur na paainee khare khajaanai paai ||
english: The counterfeit have no place there, but the genuine are placed in His Treasury.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਇਉ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aas a(n)desaa door kar iu mal jaai samaai ||4||
english: Let your hopes and anxieties depart; thus pollution is washed away. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਮਾਗੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sukh kau maagai sabh ko dukh na maagai koi ||
english: Everyone begs for happiness; no one asks for suffering.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੈ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sukhai kau dukh agalaa manamukh boojh na hoi ||
english: But in the wake of happiness, there comes great suffering. The self-willed manmukhs do not understand this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sukh dukh sam kar jaaneeahi sabad bhed sukh hoi ||5||
english: Those who see pain and pleasure as one and the same find peace; they are pierced through by the Shabad. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਵਾਚੀਐ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਆਸੁ ॥
transliteration: bed pukaare vaacheeai baanee braham biaas ||
english: The Vedas proclaim, and the words of Vyaasa tell us,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: mun jan sevak saadhikaa naam rate gunataas ||
english: that the silent sages, the servants of the Lord, and those who practice a life of spiritual discipline are attuned to the Naam, the Treasure of Excellence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਗਏ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sach rate se jin gae hau sad balihaarai jaas ||6||
english: Those who are attuned to the True Name win the game of life; I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: chahu jug maile mal bhare jin mukh naam na hoi ||
english: Those who do not have the Naam in their mouths are filled with pollution; they are filthy throughout the four ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagatee bhaai vihooniaa muhu kaalaa pat khoi ||
english: Without loving devotion to God, their faces are blackened, and their honor is lost.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa avagan muthee roi ||7||
english: Those who have forgotten the Naam are plundered by evil; they weep and wail in dismay. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਪਾਇਆ ਡਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat paaiaa dar kar milai milaai ||
english: I searched and searched, and found God. In the Fear of God, I have been united in His Union.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aap pachhaanai ghar vasai haumai trisanaa jaai ||
english: Through self-realization, people dwell within the home of their inner being; egotism and desire depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਊਜਲੇ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੮॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak niramal oojale jo raate har naai ||8||7||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Name of the Lord are immaculate and radiant. ||8||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: sun man bhoole baavare gur kee charanee laag ||
english: Listen, O deluded and demented mind: hold tight to the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਜਮੁ ਡਰਪੈ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: har jap naam dhiaai too jam darapai dukh bhaag ||
english: Chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; death will be afraid of you, and suffering shall depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dookh ghano dohaaganee kiu thir rahai suhaag ||1||
english: The deserted wife suffers terrible pain. How can her Husband Lord remain with her forever? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re avar naahee mai thaau ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, I have no other place to go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mai dhan naam nidhaan hai gur deeaa bal jaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru has given me the Treasure of the Wealth of the Naam; I am a sacrifice to Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramat pat saabaas tis tis kai sa(n)g milaau ||
english: The Guru's Teachings bring honor. Blessed is He-may I meet and be with Him!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਊ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tis bin ghaRee na jeevaoo bin naavai mar jaau ||
english: Without Him, I cannot live, even for a moment. Without His Name, I die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mai a(n)dhule naam na veesarai tek tikee ghar jaau ||2||
english: I am blind-may I never forget the Naam! Under His Protection, I shall reach my true home. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਚੇਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guroo jinaa kaa a(n)dhulaa chele naahee thaau ||
english: Those chaylaas, those devotees, whose spiritual teacher is blind, shall not find their place of rest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur naau na paaeeai bin naavai kiaa suaau ||
english: Without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained. Without the Name, what is the use of it all?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aai gaiaa pachhutaavanaa jiu su(n)njai ghar kaau ||3||
english: People come and go, regretting and repenting, like crows in a deserted house. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਿਉ ਕਲਰ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai dukh dehuree jiu kalar kee bheet ||
english: Without the Name, the body suffers in pain; it crumbles like a wall of sand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: tab lag mahal na paaeeai jab lag saach na cheet ||
english: As long as Truth does not enter into the consciousness, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਪੈ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਪਦੁ ਨੀਤਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sabad rapai ghar paaeeai nirabaanee pad neet ||4||
english: Attuned to the Shabad, we enter our home, and obtain the Eternal State of Nirvaanaa. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau gur poochhau aapane gur puchh kaar kamaau ||
english: I ask my Guru for His Advice, and I follow the Guru's Advice.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabad salaahee man vasai haumai dukh jal jaau ||
english: With the Shabads of Praise abiding in the mind, the pain of egotism is burnt away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sahaje hoi milaavaRaa saache saach milaau ||5||
english: We are intuitively united with Him, and we meet the Truest of the True. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabad rate se niramale taj kaam krodh aha(n)kaar ||
english: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are spotless and pure; they renounce sexual desire, anger, selfishness and conceit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naam salaahan sad sadaa har raakhahi ur dhaar ||
english: They sing the Praises of the Naam, forever and ever; they keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਸਭ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: so kiu manahu visaareeai sabh jeeaa kaa aadhaar ||6||
english: How could we ever forget Him from our minds? He is the Support of all beings. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sabad marai so mar rahai phir marai na doojee vaar ||
english: One who dies in the Shabad is beyond death, and shall never die again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabadai hee te paaeeai har naame lagai piaar ||
english: Through the Shabad, we find Him, and embrace love for the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin sabadai jag bhoolaa phirai mar janamai vaaro vaar ||7||
english: Without the Shabad, the world is deceived; it dies and is reborn, over and over again. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸਾਲਾਹੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਵਡਹੁ ਵਡੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh saalaahai aap kau vadahu vaderee hoi ||
english: All praise themselves, and call themselves the greatest of the great.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੀਐ ਕਹੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur bin aap na cheeneeai kahe sune kiaa hoi ||
english: Without the Guru, one's self cannot be known. By merely speaking and listening, what is accomplished?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak sabad pachhaaneeai haumai karai na koi ||8||8||
english: O Nanak, one who realizes the Shabad does not act in egotism. ||8||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਧਨ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਐ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin pir dhan seegaareeai joban baad khuaar ||
english: Without her Husband, the soul-bride's youth and ornaments are useless and wretched.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮਾਣੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੇਜੜੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਬਾਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naa maane sukh sejaRee bin pir baad seegaar ||
english: She does not enjoy the pleasure of His Bed; without her Husband, her ornaments are absurd.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਾ ਘਰਿ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dookh ghano dohaaganee naa ghar sej bhataar ||1||
english: The discarded bride suffers terrible pain; her Husband does not come to the bed of her home. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man re raam japahu sukh hoi ||
english: O mind, meditate on the Lord, and find peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin gur prem na paaeeai sabad milai ra(n)g hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Guru, love is not found. United with the Shabad, happiness is found. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa sukh paaeeai har var sahaj seegaar ||
english: Serving the Guru, she finds peace, and her Husband Lord adorns her with intuitive wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਮਾਣੇ ਪਿਰ ਸੇਜੜੀ ਗੂੜਾ ਹੇਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sach maane pir sejaRee gooRaa het piaar ||
english: Truly, she enjoys the Bed of her Husband, through her deep love and affection.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਗੁਣ ਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh jaan sinjaaneeai gur melee gun chaar ||2||
english: As Gurmukh, she comes to know Him. Meeting with the Guru, she maintains a virtuous lifestyle. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sach milahu var kaamanee pir mohee ra(n)g laai ||
english: Through Truth, meet your Husband Lord, O soul-bride. Enchanted by your Husband, enshrine love for Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan saach vigasiaa keemat kahan na jaai ||
english: Your mind and body shall blossom forth in Truth. The value of this cannot be described.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har var ghar sohaaganee niramal saachai naai ||3||
english: The soul-bride finds her Husband Lord in the home of her own being; she is purified by the True Name. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man mahi manooaa je marai taa pir raavai naar ||
english: If the mind within the mind dies, then the Husband ravishes and enjoys His bride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਤਾਗੈ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਲਿ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ikat taagai ral milai gal moteean kaa haar ||
english: They are woven into one texture, like pearls on a necklace around the neck.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa sukh oopajai guramukh naam adhaar ||4||
english: In the Society of the Saints, peace wells up; the Gurmukhs take the Support of the Naam. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਖਿਨਿ ਖਪੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi upajai khin khapai khin aavai khin jaai ||
english: In an instant, one is born, and in an instant, one dies. In an instant one comes, and in an instant one goes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad pachhaanai rav rahai naa tis kaal sa(n)taai ||
english: One who recognizes the Shabad merges into it, and is not afflicted by death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਕਥਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: saahib atul na toleeai kathan na paaiaa jaai ||5||
english: Our Lord and Master is Unweighable; He cannot be weighed. He cannot be found merely by talking. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਆਏ ਵਜਹੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaapaaree vanajaariaa aae vajahu likhaai ||
english: The merchants and the traders have come; their profits are pre-ordained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaar kamaavahi sach kee laahaa milai rajaai ||
english: Those who practice Truth reap the profits, abiding in the Will of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: poo(n)jee saachee gur milai naa tis til na tamaai ||6||
english: With the Merchandise of Truth, they meet the Guru, who does not have a trace of greed. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋੁਲਾਇਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਰਾਜੀ ਤੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh tol toulaaisee sach taraajee tol ||
english: As Gurmukh, they are weighed and measured, in the balance and the scales of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਠਾਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa mohanee gur thaakee sach bol ||
english: The enticements of hope and desire are quieted by the Guru, whose Word is True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤੁਲਾਏ ਤੋਲਸੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aap tulaae tolasee poore pooraa tol ||7||
english: He Himself weighs with the scale; perfect is the weighing of the Perfect One. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੈ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਨਾ ਪੜਿ ਪੁਸਤਕ ਭਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kathanai kahan na chhuteeai naa paR pusatak bhaar ||
english: No one is saved by mere talk and speech, nor by reading loads of books.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa soch na paaeeai bin har bhagat piaar ||
english: The body does not obtain purity without loving devotion to the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੮॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai mele gur karataar ||8||9||
english: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; the Guru shall unite us with the Creator. ||8||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਤਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur pooraa je milai paaeeai ratan beechaar ||
english: Meeting the Perfect True Guru, we find the jewel of meditative reflection.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man deejai gur aapane paaeeai sarab piaar ||
english: Surrendering our minds to our Guru, we find universal love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mukat padaarath paaeeai avagan metanahaar ||1||
english: We find the wealth of liberation, and our demerits are erased. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re gur bin giaan na hoi ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਛਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਨਾਰਦੈ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਆਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poochhahu brahame naaradai bed biaasai koi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Go and ask Brahma, Naarad and Vyaas, the writer of the Vedas. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan dhun jaaneeai akath kahaavai soi ||
english: Know that from the vibration of the Word, we obtain spiritual wisdom and meditation. Through it, we speak the Unspoken.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਛਾਵ ਘਣੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saphalio birakh hareeaavalaa chhaav ghaneree hoi ||
english: He is the fruit-bearing Tree, luxuriantly green with abundant shade.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: laal javehar maanakee gur bha(n)daarai soi ||2||
english: The rubies, jewels and emeralds are in the Guru's Treasury. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur bha(n)daarai paaeeai niramal naam piaar ||
english: From the Guru's Treasury, we receive the Love of the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੋ ਵਖਰੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saacho vakhar sa(n)cheeai poorai karam apaar ||
english: We gather in the True Merchandise, through the Perfect Grace of the Infinite.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਣੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sukhadaataa dukh metano satigur asur sa(n)ghaar ||3||
english: The True Guru is the Giver of peace, the Dispeller of pain, the Destroyer of demons. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਡਰਾਵਣੋ ਨਾ ਕੰਧੀ ਨਾ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhavajal bikham daraavano naa ka(n)dhee naa paar ||
english: The terrifying world-ocean is difficult and dreadful; there is no shore on this side or the one beyond.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਵੰਝੁ ਮਲਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naa beRee naa tulahaRaa naa tis va(n)jh malaar ||
english: There is no boat, no raft, no oars and no boatman.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੈ ਕਾ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: satigur bhai kaa bohithaa nadaree paar utaar ||4||
english: The True Guru is the only boat on this terrifying ocean. His Glance of Grace carries us across. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik til piaaraa visarai dukh laagai sukh jaai ||
english: If I forget my Beloved, even for an instant, suffering overtakes me and peace departs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਲਉ ਜਲਾਵਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੈ ਰਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa jalau jalaavanee naam na japai rasaai ||
english: Let that tongue be burnt in flames, which does not chant the Naam with love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲੋ ਜਮੁ ਪਕੜੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ghat binasai dukh agalo jam pakaRai pachhutaai ||5||
english: When the pitcher of the body bursts, there is terrible pain; those who are caught by the Minister of Death regret and repent. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਨ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: meree meree kar gae tan dhan kalat na saath ||
english: Crying out, "Mine! Mine!", they have departed, but their bodies, their wealth, and their wives did not go with them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਭੂਲੋ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਆਥਿ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai dhan baad hai bhoolo maarag aath ||
english: Without the Name, wealth is useless; deceived by wealth, they have lost their way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥੋ ਕਾਥਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saachau saahib seveeai guramukh akatho kaath ||6||
english: So serve the True Lord; become Gurmukh, and speak the Unspoken. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aavai jaai bhavaaeeai paiai kirat kamaai ||
english: Coming and going, people wander through reincarnation; they act according to their past actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਮੇਟੀਐ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa kiu meteeai likhiaa lekh rajaai ||
english: How can one's pre-ordained destiny be erased? It is written in accordance with the Lord's Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin har naam na chhuteeai guramat milai milaai ||7||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, no one can be saved. Through the Guru's Teachings, we are united in His Union. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tis bin meraa ko nahee jis kaa jeeu paraan ||
english: Without Him, I have no one to call my own. My soul and my breath of life belong to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਉ ਲੋਭੁ ਜਲਉ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa jal balau lobh jalau abhimaan ||
english: May my egotism and possessiveness be burnt to ashes, and my greed and egotistical pride consigned to the fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੮॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak sabad veechaareeai paaeeai gunee nidhaan ||8||10||
english: O Nanak, contemplating the Shabad, the Treasure of Excellence is obtained. ||8||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਜਲ ਕਮਲੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: re man aisee har siu preet kar jaisee jal kamalehi ||
english: O mind, love the Lord, as the lotus loves the water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਹਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਛਾੜੀਐ ਭੀ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਅਸਨੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: laharee naal pachhaaReeai bhee vigasai asanehi ||
english: Tossed about by the waves, it still blossoms with love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਰਣੁ ਤਿਨੇਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jal mahi jee upaai kai bin jal maran tinehi ||1||
english: In the water, the creatures are created; outside of the water they die. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: man re kiu chhootahi bin piaar ||
english: O mind, how can you be saved without love?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh a(n)tar rav rahiaa bakhase bhagat bha(n)daar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God permeates the inner beings of the Gurmukhs. They are blessed with the treasure of devotion. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰ ॥
transliteration: re man aisee har siu preet kar jaisee machhulee neer ||
english: O mind, love the Lord, as the fish loves the water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਅਧਿਕਉ ਤਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
transliteration: jiu adhikau tiu sukh ghano man tan saa(n)t sareer ||
english: The more the water, the more the happiness, and the greater the peace of mind and body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਭ ਪੀਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin jal ghaRee na jeevaee prabh jaanai abh peer ||2||
english: Without water, she cannot live, even for an instant. God knows the suffering of her mind. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੇਹ ॥
transliteration: re man aisee har siu preet kar jaisee chaatrik meh ||
english: O mind, love the Lord, as the song-bird loves the rain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰ ਭਰਿ ਥਲ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਕੇਹ ॥
transliteration: sar bhar thal hareeaavale ik boo(n)d na pavaee keh ||
english: The pools are overflowing with water, and the land is luxuriantly green, but what are they to her, if that single drop of rain does not fall into her mouth?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karam milai so paaeeai kirat paiaa sir deh ||3||
english: By His Grace, she receives it; otherwise, because of her past actions, she gives her head. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: re man aisee har siu preet kar jaisee jal dudh hoi ||
english: O mind, love the Lord, as the water loves the milk.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਟਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਖਵੈ ਦੁਧ ਕਉ ਖਪਣਿ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aavatan aape khavai dudh kau khapan na dei ||
english: The water, added to the milk, itself bears the heat, and prevents the milk from burning.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aape mel vichhu(n)niaa sach vadiaaee dei ||4||
english: God unites the separated ones with Himself again, and blesses them with true greatness. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰ ॥
transliteration: re man aisee har siu preet kar jaisee chakavee soor ||
english: O mind, love the Lord, as the chakvee duck loves the sun.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: khin pal need na sovaee jaanai door hajoor ||
english: She does not sleep, for an instant or a moment; the sun is so far away, but she thinks that it is near.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: manamukh sojhee naa pavai guramukh sadaa hajoor ||5||
english: Understanding does not come to the self-willed manmukh. But to the Gurmukh, the Lord is always close. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਵਣੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh ganat ganaavanee karataa kare s hoi ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs make their calculations and plans, but only the actions of the Creator come to pass.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: taa kee keemat naa pavai je lochai sabh koi ||
english: His Value cannot be estimated, even though everyone may wish to do so.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: guramat hoi ta paaeeai sach milai sukh hoi ||6||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, it is revealed. Meeting with the True One, peace is found. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sachaa nehu na tutaee je satigur bhetai soi ||
english: True love shall not be broken, if the True Guru is met.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: giaan padaarath paaeeai tribhavan sojhee hoi ||
english: Obtaining the wealth of spiritual wisdom, the understanding of the three worlds is acquired.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: niramal naam na veesarai je gun kaa gaahak hoi ||7||
english: So become a customer of merit, and do not forget the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੇਲਿ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਪੰਖਣੂੰ ਜੋ ਚੁਗਦੇ ਸਰ ਤਲਿ ॥
transliteration: khel gae se pa(n)khanoo(n) jo chugade sar tal ||
english: Those birds which peck at the shore of the pool have played and have departed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘੜੀ ਕਿ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲਿ ॥
transliteration: ghaRee k muhat k chalanaa khelan aj k kal ||
english: In a moment, in an instant, we too must depart. Our play is only for today or tomorrow.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਚਾ ਪਿੜੁ ਮਲਿ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jis too(n) melahi so milai jaai sachaa piR mal ||8||
english: But those whom You unite, Lord, are united with You; they obtain a seat in the Arena of Truth. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur preet na oopajai haumai mail na jaai ||
english: Without the Guru, love does not well up, and the filth of egotism does not depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹੰ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
transliteration: soha(n) aap pachhaaneeai sabad bhed pateeaai ||
english: One who recognizes within himself that, "He is me", and who is pierced through by the Shabad, is satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: guramukh aap pachhaaneeai avar k kare karaai ||9||
english: When one becomes Gurmukh and realizes his own self, what more is there left to do or have done? ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਲੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
transliteration: miliaa kaa kiaa meleeai sabad mile pateeaai ||
english: Why speak of union to those who are already united with the Lord? Receiving the Shabad, they are satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਵੀਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sojhee naa pavai veechhuR chotaa khaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not understand; separated from Him, they endure beatings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak dar ghar ek hai avar na doojee jaai ||10||11||
english: O Nanak, there is only the one door to His Home; there is no other place at all. ||10||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੁਲੈ ਭੁਲਾਈਐ ਭੂਲੀ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhulai bhulaaeeai bhoolee thaur na kaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, deluded and deceived. They find no place of rest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ਅੰਧੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur bin ko na dikhaavaee a(n)dhee aavai jaai ||
english: Without the Guru, no one is shown the Way. Like the blind, they continue coming and going.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਠਗਿਆ ਮੁਠਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: giaan padaarath khoiaa thagiaa muthaa jaai ||1||
english: Having lost the treasure of spiritual wisdom, they depart, defrauded and plundered. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baabaa maaiaa bharam bhulaai ||
english: O Baba, Maya deceives with its illusion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਾ ਪਿਰ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bharam bhulee dohaaganee naa pir a(n)k samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Deceived by doubt, the discarded bride is not received into the Lap of her Beloved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhoolee phirai disa(n)taree bhoolee grihu taj jaai ||
english: The deceived bride wanders around in foreign lands; she leaves, and abandons her own home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੀ ਡੂੰਗਰਿ ਥਲਿ ਚੜੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhoolee doo(n)gar thal chaRai bharamai man dolaai ||
english: Deceived, she climbs the plateaus and mountains; her mind wavers in doubt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਰਬਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhurahu vichhu(n)nee kiu milai garab muthee bilalaai ||2||
english: Separated from the Primal Being, how can she meet with Him again? Plundered by pride, she cries out and bewails. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: vichhuRiaa gur melasee har ras naam piaar ||
english: The Guru unites the separated ones with the Lord again, through the love of the Delicious Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਘਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saach sahaj sobhaa ghanee har gun naam adhaar ||
english: Through truth and intuitive poise, great honor is obtained, with the Support of the Naam and the Glory of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu rakh too(n) mai tujh bin kavan bhataar ||3||
english: As it pleases You, Lord, please save and protect me. Without You, O my Husband Lord, who else is there for me? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭੁਲੀਐ ਭੇਖੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: akhar paR paR bhuleeai bhekhee bahut abhimaan ||
english: Reading their books over and over again, people continue making mistakes; they are so proud of their religious robes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: teerath naataa kiaa kare man mahi mail gumaan ||
english: But what is the use of bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, when the filth of stubborn pride is within the mind?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur bin kin samajhaaeeai man raajaa sulataan ||4||
english: Other than the Guru, who can explain that within the mind is the Lord, the King, the Emperor? ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: prem padaarath paaeeai guramukh tat veechaar ||
english: The Treasure of the Lord's Love is obtained by the Gurmukh, who contemplates the essence of reality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan aap gavaaiaa gur kai sabad seegaar ||
english: The bride eradicates her selfishness, and adorns herself with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ghar hee so pir paaiaa gur kai het apaar ||5||
english: Within her own home, she finds her Husband, through infinite love for the Guru. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa chaakaree man niramal sukh hoi ||
english: Applying oneself to the service of the Guru, the mind is purified, and peace is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad man vasiaa haumai vichahu khoi ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and egotism is eliminated from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naam padaarath paaiaa laabh sadaa man hoi ||6||
english: The Treasure of the Naam is acquired, and the mind reaps the lasting profit. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਲਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: karam milai taa paaeeai aap na laiaa jaai ||
english: If He grants His Grace, then we obtain it. We cannot find it by our own efforts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kee charanee lag rahu vichahu aap gavaai ||
english: Remain attached to the Feet of the Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sache setee ratiaa sacho palai paai ||7||
english: Attuned to Truth, you shall obtain the True One. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੁਲਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhulan a(n)dar sabh ko abhul guroo karataar ||
english: Everyone makes mistakes; only the Guru and the Creator are infallible.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramat man samajhaaiaa laagaa tisai piaar ||
english: One who instructs his mind with the Guru's Teachings comes to embrace love for the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak saach na veesarai mele sabad apaar ||8||12||
english: O Nanak, do not forget the Truth; you shall receive the Infinite Word of the Shabad. ||8||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਘਰ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa maaiaa mohanee sut ba(n)dhap ghar naar ||
english: The enticing desire for Maya leads people to become emotionally attached to their children, relatives, households and spouses.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dhan joban jag thagiaa lab lobh aha(n)kaar ||
english: The world is deceived and plundered by riches, youth, greed and egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਸਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: moh thagaulee hau muee saa varatai sa(n)saar ||1||
english: The drug of emotional attachment has destroyed me, as it has destroyed the whole world. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mere preetamaa mai tujh bin avar na koi ||
english: O my Beloved, I have no one except You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mai tujh bin avar na bhaavaee too(n) bhaavahi sukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without You, nothing else pleases me. Loving You, I am at peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
transliteration: naam saalaahee ra(n)g siu gur kai sabad sa(n)tokh ||
english: I sing the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with love; I am content with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਕੂੜਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai so chalasee kooRaa mohu na vekh ||
english: Whatever is seen shall pass away. So do not be attached to this false show.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਊ ਆਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਚਲਦਾ ਸਾਥੁ ਦੇਖੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vaat vataaoo aaiaa nit chaladaa saath dekh ||2||
english: Like a traveller in his travels, you have come. Behold the caravan leaving each day. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aakhan aakhahi ketaRe gur bin boojh na hoi ||
english: Many preach sermons, but without the Guru, understanding is not obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਪੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naam vadaaee je milai sach rapai pat hoi ||
english: If someone receives the Glory of the Naam, he is attuned to truth and blessed with honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavahi se bhale khotaa kharaa na koi ||3||
english: Those who are pleasing to You are good; no one is counterfeit or genuine. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: gur saranaaee chhuteeai manamukh khotee raas ||
english: In the Guru's Sanctuary we are saved. The assets of the self-willed manmukhs are false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਕੀ ਘੜੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: asat dhaat paatisaah kee ghaReeai sabad vigaas ||
english: The eight metals of the King are made into coins by the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਪਵੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aape parakhe paarakhoo pavai khajaanai raas ||4||
english: The Assayer Himself assays them, and He places the genuine ones in His Treasury. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀ ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: teree keemat naa pavai sabh dithee thok vajaai ||
english: Your Value cannot be appraised; I have seen and tested everything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਣੈ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਸਚਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kahanai haath na labhaee sach tikai pat paai ||
english: By speaking, His Depth cannot be found. Abiding in truth, honor is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramat too(n) saalaahanaa hor keemat kahan na jaai ||5||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I praise You; otherwise, I cannot describe Your Value. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jit tan naam na bhaavaee tit tan haumai vaad ||
english: That body which does not appreciate the Naam-that body is infested with egotism and conflict.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: gur bin giaan na paaeeai bikhiaa doojaa saad ||
english: Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained; other tastes are poison.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੀਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bin gun kaam na aavaee maaiaa pheekaa saad ||6||
english: Without virtue, nothing is of any use. The taste of Maya is bland and insipid. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਆਸਾ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aasaa a(n)dar ja(n)miaa aasaa ras kas khaai ||
english: Through desire, people are cast into the womb and reborn. Through desire, they taste the sweet and sour flavors.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ba(n)dh chalaaeeai muhe muhi chotaa khaai ||
english: Bound by desire, they are led on, beaten and struck on their faces and mouths.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਬਧਾ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: avagan badhaa maareeai chhootai guramat naai ||7||
english: Bound and gagged and assaulted by evil, they are released only through the Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਥਾਈ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: sarabe thaaee ek too(n) jiu bhaavai tiu raakh ||
english: In all places, You are the One and Only. As it pleases You, Lord, please save and protect me!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਲੋ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: guramat saachaa man vasai naam bhalo pat saakh ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the True One abides within the mind. The Companionship of the Naam brings the most excellent honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੮॥
transliteration: haumai rog gavaaeeai sabad sachai sach bhaakh ||8||
english: Eradicate the disease of egotism, and chant the True Shabad, the Word of the True Lord. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਕਾਸੀ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aakaasee paataal too(n) tribhavan rahiaa samaai ||
english: You are pervading throughout the Akaashic Ethers, the nether regions and the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਉ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape bhagatee bhaau too(n) aape milahi milaai ||
english: You Yourself are bhakti, loving devotional worship. You Yourself unite us in Union with Yourself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੯॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai jiu bhaavai tivai rajaai ||9||13||
english: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam! As is Your Pleasure, so is Your Will. ||9||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਕਰੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raam naam man bedhiaa avar k karee veechaar ||
english: My mind is pierced through by the Name of the Lord. What else should I contemplate?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਤਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabad surat sukh oopajai prabh raatau sukh saar ||
english: Focusing your awareness on the Shabad, happiness wells up. Attuned to God, the most excellent peace is found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakh too(n) mai har naam adhaar ||1||
english: As it pleases You, please save me, Lord. The Name of the Lord is my Support. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man re saachee khasam rajaai ||
english: O mind, the Will of our Lord and Master is true.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin tan man saaj seegaariaa tis setee liv laai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Focus your love upon the One who created and adorned your body and mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਮੀਐ ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਤੋਲਿ ਕਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tan baisa(n)tar homeeai ik ratee tol kataai ||
english: If I cut my body into pieces, and burn them in the fire,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਧਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tan man samadhaa je karee anadin agan jalaai ||
english: and if I make my body and mind into firewood, and night and day burn them in the fire,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਈ ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har naamai tul na pujaee je lakh kotee karam kamaai ||2||
english: and if I perform hundreds of thousands and millions of religious rituals-still, all these are not equal to the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਰਧ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਟਾਈਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤੁ ਧਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aradh sareer kataaeeai sir karavat dharaai ||
english: If my body were cut in half, if a saw was put to my head,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਹੈਮੰਚਲਿ ਗਾਲੀਐ ਭੀ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tan haima(n)chal gaaleeai bhee man te rog na jaai ||
english: and if my body were frozen in the Himalayas-even then, my mind would not be free of disease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਈ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀ ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har naamai tul na pujaee sabh dithee thok vajaai ||3||
english: None of these are equal to the Name of the Lord. I have seen and tried and tested them all. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ ਕੋਟ ਦਤੁ ਕਰੀ ਬਹੁ ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)chan ke kot dat karee bahu haivar gaivar daan ||
english: If I made a donation of castles of gold, and gave lots of fine horses and wondrous elephants in charity,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਗਊਆ ਘਣੀ ਭੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: bhoom daan gaooaa ghanee bhee a(n)tar garab gumaan ||
english: and if I made donations of land and cows-even then, pride and ego would still be within me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: raam naam man bedhiaa gur deeaa sach daan ||4||
english: The Name of the Lord has pierced my mind; the Guru has given me this true gift. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠ ਬੁਧੀ ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕੇਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: manahath budhee keteeaa kete bed beechaar ||
english: There are so many stubborn-minded intelligent people, and so many who contemplate the Vedas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: kete ba(n)dhan jee ke guramukh mokh duaar ||
english: There are so many entanglements for the soul. Only as Gurmukh do we find the Gate of Liberation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਹੁ ਓਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਉਪਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sachahu orai sabh ko upar sach aachaar ||5||
english: Truth is higher than everything; but higher still is truthful living. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਊਚਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਨੀਚੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko oochaa aakheeai neech na deesai koi ||
english: Call everyone exalted; no one seems lowly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੈ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਸਾਜਿਐ ਇਕੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ikanai bhaa(n)de saajiai ik chaanan tihu loi ||
english: The One Lord has fashioned the vessels, and His One Light pervades the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਧੁਰਿ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: karam milai sach paaeeai dhur bakhas na metai koi ||6||
english: Receiving His Grace, we obtain Truth. No one can erase His Primal Blessing. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saadh milai saadhoo janai sa(n)tokh vasai gur bhaai ||
english: When one Holy person meets another Holy person, they abide in contentment, through the Love of the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: akath kathaa veechaareeai je satigur maahi samaai ||
english: They contemplate the Unspoken Speech, merging in absorption in the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: pee a(n)mrit sa(n)tokhiaa daragahi paidhaa jaai ||7||
english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, they are contented; they go to the Court of the Lord in robes of honor. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat vaajai ki(n)guree anadin sabad subhaai ||
english: In each and every heart the Music of the Lord's Flute vibrates, night and day, with sublime love for the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਉ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: virale kau sojhee paee guramukh man samajhaai ||
