english: Only those few who become Gurmukh understand this by instructing their minds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਛੂਟੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai chhootai sabad kamaai ||8||14||
english: O Nanak, do not forget the Naam. Practicing the Shabad you shall be saved. ||8||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤੇ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਧਉਲਹਰ ਬਗੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: chite disahi dhaulahar bage ba(n)k duaar ||
english: There are painted mansions to behold, white-washed, with beautiful doors;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਖੁਸੀ ਉਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kar man khusee usaariaa doojai het piaar ||
english: they were constructed to give pleasure to the mind, but this is only for the sake of the love of duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)dar khaalee prem bin dhahi dheree tan chhaar ||1||
english: The inner being is empty without love. The body shall crumble into a heap of ashes. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re tan dhan saath na hoi ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, this body and wealth shall not go along with you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam dhan niramalo gur daat kare prabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord's Name is the pure wealth; through the Guru, God bestows this gift. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਜੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raam naam dhan niramalo je devai devanahaar ||
english: The Lord's Name is the pure wealth; it is given only by the Giver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aagai poochh na hovaee jis belee gur karataar ||
english: One who has the Guru, the Creator, as his Friend, shall not be questioned hereafter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap chhadaae chhuteeai aape bakhasanahaar ||2||
english: He Himself delivers those who are delivered. He Himself is the Forgiver. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੇ ਧੀਆ ਪੂਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh jaanai aapane dheeaa poot sa(n)jog ||
english: The self-willed manmukh looks upon his daughters, sons and relatives as his own.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਲੇ ਹਰਖੁ ਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: naaree dekh vigaaseeahi naale harakh s sog ||
english: Gazing upon his wife, he is pleased. But along with happiness, they bring grief.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh sabad ra(n)gaavale ahinis har ras bhog ||3||
english: The Gurmukhs are attuned to the Word of the Shabad. Day and night, they enjoy the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤੁ ਚਲੈ ਵਿਤੁ ਜਾਵਣੋ ਸਾਕਤ ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chit chalai vit jaavano saakat dol dolaai ||
english: The consciousness of the wicked, faithless cynics wanders around in search of transitory wealth, unstable and distracted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸੁਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baahar dhoo(n)dh vigucheeai ghar mahi vasat suthaai ||
english: Searching outside of themselves, they are ruined; the object of their search is in that sacred place within the home of the heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: manamukh haumai kar musee guramukh palai paai ||4||
english: The self-willed manmukhs, in their ego, miss it; the Gurmukhs receive it in their laps. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿਆਰਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: saakat niraguniaariaa aapanaa mool pachhaan ||
english: You worthless, faithless cynic-recognize your own origin!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੋ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਸਿ ਪਿਰਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: rakat bi(n)d kaa ihu tano aganee paas piraan ||
english: This body is made of blood and semen. It shall be consigned to the fire in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਵਣੈ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: pavanai kai vas dehuree masatak sach neesaan ||5||
english: The body is under the power of the breath, according to the True Sign inscribed upon your forehead. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਮੁਆ ਨ ਲੋੜੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bahutaa jeevan ma(n)geeai muaa na loRai koi ||
english: Everyone begs for a long life-no one wishes to die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sukh jeevan tis aakheeai jis guramukh vasiaa soi ||
english: A life of peace and comfort comes to that Gurmukh, within whom God dwells.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naam vihoone kiaa ganee jis har gur daras na hoi ||6||
english: Without the Naam, what good those who do not have the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Lord and Guru? ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੁਲੀਐ ਜਬ ਲਗਿ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jiu supanai nis bhuleeai jab lag nidraa hoi ||
english: In their dreams at night, people wander around as long as they sleep;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੋਇ ॥
transliteration: iu sarapan kai vas jeeaRaa a(n)tar haumai doi ||
english: just so, they are under the power of the snake Maya, as long as their hearts are filled with ego and duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੋਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramat hoi veechaareeai supanaa ihu jag loi ||7||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, they come to understand and see that this world is just a dream. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਦੂਧੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: agan marai jal paaeeai jiu baarik doodhai maai ||
english: As thirst is quenched with water, and the baby is satisfied with mother's milk,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਸੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin jal kamal s naa theeai bin jal meen maraai ||
english: and as the lotus does not exist without water, and as the fish dies without water

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh har ras milai jeevaa har gun gaai ||8||15||
english: -O Nanak, so does the Gurmukh live, receiving the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||8||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡੂੰਗਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਡਰਾਵਣੋ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਡਰੀਆਸੁ ॥
transliteration: doo(n)gar dekh daraavano peeeaRai dareeaas ||
english: Beholding the terrifying mountain in this world of my father's home, I am terrified.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਚਉ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਗਾਖੜੋ ਨਾ ਪਉੜੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: oochau parabat gaakhaRo naa pauRee tit taas ||
english: It is so difficult to climb this high mountain; there is no ladder which reaches up there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਰੀਆਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh a(n)tar jaaniaa gur melee tareeaas ||1||
english: But as Gurmukh, I know that it is within my self; the Guru has brought me to Union, and so I cross over. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਡਰਾਂਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re bhavajal bikham daraa(n)u ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, the terrifying world-ocean is so difficult to cross-I am terrified!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pooraa satigur ras milai gur taare har naau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect True Guru, in His Pleasure, has met with me; the Guru has saved me, through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਲਾ ਚਲਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਜਾਣਾ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: chalaa chalaa je karee jaanaa chalanahaar ||
english: I may say, "I am going, I am going", but I know that, in the end, I must really go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਅਮਰੁ ਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jo aaiaa so chalasee amar s gur karataar ||
english: Whoever comes must also go. Only the Guru and the Creator are Eternal.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhee sachaa saalaahanaa sachai thaan piaar ||2||
english: So praise the True One continually, and love His Place of Truth. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਪਕੇ ਕੋਟ ਹਜਾਰ ॥
transliteration: dar ghar mahalaa sohane pake kot hajaar ||
english: Beautiful gates, houses and palaces, solidly built forts,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਪਾਖਰੇ ਲਸਕਰ ਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hasatee ghoRe paakhare lasakar lakh apaar ||
english: elephants, saddled horses, hundreds of thousands of uncounted armies

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਿਆ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਸਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kis hee naal na chaliaa khap khap mue asaar ||3||
english: -none of these will go along with anyone in the end, and yet, the fools bother themselves to exhaustion with these, and then die. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਮਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: suinaa rupaa sa(n)cheeai maal jaal ja(n)jaal ||
english: You may gather gold and sliver, but wealth is just a net of entanglement.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਦੋਹੀ ਫੇਰੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag mahi dohee phereeai bin naavai sir kaal ||
english: You may beat the drum and proclaim authority over the whole world, but without the Name, death hovers over your head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪੜੈ ਜੀਉ ਖੇਲਸੀ ਬਦਫੈਲੀ ਕਿਆ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: pi(n)d paRai jeeu khelasee badaphailee kiaa haal ||4||
english: When the body falls, the play of life is over; what shall be the condition of the evil-doers then? ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੀਐ ਨਾਰੀ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: putaa dekh vigaseeai naaree sej bhataar ||
english: The husband is delighted seeing his sons, and his wife upon his bed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: choaa cha(n)dan laaeeai kaapaR roop seegaar ||
english: He applies sandalwood and scented oils, and dresses himself in his beautiful clothes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਈਐ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੈ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: khehoo kheh ralaaeeai chhod chalai ghar baar ||5||
english: But dust shall mix with dust, and he shall depart, leaving hearth and home behind. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਰ ਮਲੂਕ ਕਹਾਈਐ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਉ ਕਿ ਖਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: mahar malook kahaaeeai raajaa raau k khaan ||
english: He may be called a chief, an emperor, a king, a governor or a lord;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਧਰੀ ਰਾਉ ਸਦਾਈਐ ਜਲਿ ਬਲੀਐ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: chaudharee raau sadaaeeai jal baleeai abhimaan ||
english: he may present himself as a leader or a chief, but this just burns him in the fire of egotistical pride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਡਵਿ ਦਧਾ ਕਾਨੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: manamukh naam visaariaa jiu dav dadhaa kaan ||6||
english: The self-willed manmukh has forgotten the Naam. He is like straw, burning in the forest fire. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਜਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai kar kar jaaisee jo aaiaa jag maahi ||
english: Whoever comes into the world and indulges in ego, must depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਜਲ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਸੁਆਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag kaajal kothaRee tan man deh suaahi ||
english: The whole world is a store-house of lamp-black; the body and mind are blackened with it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur raakhe se niramale sabad nivaaree bhaahi ||7||
english: Those who are saved by the Guru are immaculate and pure; through the Word of the Shabad, they extinguish the fire of desire. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak tareeai sach naam sir saahaa paatisaahu ||
english: O Nanak, they swim across with the True Name of the Lord, the King above the heads of kings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: mai har naam na veesarai har naam ratan vesaahu ||
english: May I never forget the Name of the Lord! I have purchased the Jewel of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੇ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
transliteration: manamukh bhaujal pach mue guramukh tare athaahu ||8||16||
english: The self-willed manmukhs putrefy and die in the terrifying world-ocean, while the Gurmukhs cross over the bottomless ocean. ||8||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਚਲਣੈ ਕੀ ਧੋਖ ॥
transliteration: mukaam kar ghar baisanaa nit chalanai kee dhokh ||
english: They have made this their resting place and they sit at home, but the urge to depart is always there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਲੋਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mukaam taa par jaaneeai jaa rahai nihachal lok ||1||
english: This would be known as a lasting place of rest, only if they were to remain stable and unchanging. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈਸਿ ਮੁਕਾਮੇ ॥
transliteration: duneeaa kais mukaame ||
english: What sort of a resting place is this world?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸਿਦਕੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਖਰਚੁ ਬਾਧਹੁ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar sidak karanee kharach baadhahu laag rahu naame ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Doing deeds of faith, pack up the supplies for your journey, and remain committed to the Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਤ ਆਸਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੈ ਮੁਲਾ ਬਹੈ ਮੁਕਾਮਿ ॥
transliteration: jogee ta aasan kar bahai mulaa bahai mukaam ||
english: The Yogis sit in their Yogic postures, and the Mullahs sit at their resting stations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਪੋਥੀਆ ਸਿਧ ਬਹਹਿ ਦੇਵ ਸਥਾਨਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit vakhaanahi potheeaa sidh bahahi dev sathaan ||2||
english: The Hindu Pandits recite from their books, and the Siddhas sit in the temples of their gods. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰ ਸਿਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਖ ਪੀਰ ਸਲਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sur sidh gan ga(n)dharab mun jan sekh peer salaar ||
english: The angels, Siddhas, worshippers of Shiva, heavenly musicians, silent sages, Saints, priests, preachers, spiritual teachers and commanders

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਕੂਚ ਕੂਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਅਵਰੇ ਭਿ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dar kooch koochaa kar gae avare bh chalanahaar ||3||
english: -each and every one has left, and all others shall depart as well. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਮਲੂਕ ਉਮਰੇ ਗਏ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੂਚੁ ॥
transliteration: sulataan khaan malook umare gae kar kar kooch ||
english: The sultans and kings, the rich and the mighty, have marched away in succession.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਦਿਲ ਸਮਝੁ ਤੂੰ ਭਿ ਪਹੂਚੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ghaRee muhat k chalanaa dil samajh too(n) bh pahooch ||4||
english: In a moment or two, we shall also depart. O my heart, understand that you must go as well! ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਾਹ ਮਾਹਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਤ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabadaah maahi vakhaaneeai viralaa ta boojhai koi ||
english: This is described in the Shabads; only a few understand this!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak vakhaanai benatee jal thal maheeal soi ||5||
english: Nanak offers this prayer to the One who pervades the water, the land and the air. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਲਾਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰੀਮੁ ॥
transliteration: alaahu alakh aga(n)m kaadar karanahaar kareem ||
english: He is Allah, the Unknowable, the Inaccessible, All-powerful and Merciful Creator.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣੀ ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਰਹੀਮੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sabh dunee aavan jaavanee mukaam ek raheem ||6||
english: All the world comes and goes-only the Merciful Lord is permanent. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਸਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: mukaam tis no aakheeai jis sis na hovee lekh ||
english: Call permanent only the One, who does not have destiny inscribed upon His Forehead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਚਲਸੀ ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਏਕੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: asamaan dharatee chalasee mukaam ohee ek ||7||
english: The sky and the earth shall pass away; He alone is permanent. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਰਵਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਸਸਿ ਚਲੈ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਲਖ ਪਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: din rav chalai nis sas chalai taarikaa lakh paloi ||
english: The day and the sun shall pass away; the night and the moon shall pass away; the hundreds of thousands of stars shall disappear.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਗੋਇ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
transliteration: mukaam ohee ek hai naanakaa sach bugoi ||8||17||
english: He alone is permanent; Nanak speaks the Truth. ||8||17||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਸਤਾਰਹ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mahale pahile sataarah asatapadeeaa ||
english: Seventeen Ashtpadheeyaa Of The First Mehl.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ghar 1 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh kripaa kare bhagat keejai bin gur bhagat na hoi ||
english: By God's Grace, the Gurmukh practices devotion; without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aapai aap milaae boojhai taa niramal hovai koi ||
english: One who merges his own self into Him understands, and so becomes pure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har jeeu sachaa sachee baanee sabad milaavaa hoi ||1||
english: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Word of the Shabad, Union with Him is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re bhagatiheen kaahe jag aaiaa ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, without devotion, why have people even come into the world?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kee sev na keenee birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They have not served the Perfect Guru; they have wasted their lives in vain. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape har jagajeevan daataa aape bakhas milaae ||
english: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver. He Himself forgives, and unites us with Himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਏ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t e kiaa vechaare kiaa ko aakh sunaae ||
english: What are these poor beings and creatures? What can they speak and say?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh aape de vadiaaee aape sev karaae ||2||
english: God Himself grants glory to the Gurmukhs; He joins them to His Service. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dekh kuta(n)b mohi lobhaanaa chaladiaa naal na jaaee ||
english: Beholding your family, you are lured away by emotional attachment, but when you leave, they will not go with you.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev gun nidhaan paaiaa tis kee keem na paaee ||
english: Serving the True Guru, I have found the Treasure of Excellence. Its value cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: prabh sakhaa har jeeu meraa a(n)te hoi sakhaaee ||3||
english: The Dear Lord God is my Best Friend. In the end, He shall be my Companion and Support. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: peeeaRai jagajeevan daataa manamukh pat gavaaee ||
english: In this world of my father's home, the Great Giver is the Life of the World. The self-willed manmukhs have lost their honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur ko mag na jaanai a(n)dhe thaur na kaaee ||
english: Without the True Guru, no one knows the Way. The blind find no place of rest.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਵਸਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har sukhadaataa man nahee vasiaa a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaaee ||4||
english: If the Lord, the Giver of Peace, does not dwell within the mind, then they shall depart with regret in the end. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: peeeaRai jagajeevan daataa guramat ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
english: In this world of my father's house, through the Guru's Teachings, I have cultivated within my mind the Great Giver, the Life of the World.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat karahi din raatee haumai mohu chukaaiaa ||
english: Night and day, performing devotional worship, day and night, ego and emotional attachment are removed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jis siu raataa taiso hovai sache sach samaaiaa ||5||
english: And then, attuned to Him, we become like Him, truly absorbed in the True One. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aape nadar kare bhaau laae gurasabadee beechaar ||
english: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He gives us His Love, and we contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur seviai sahaj oopajai haumai trisanaa maar ||
english: Serving the True Guru, intuitive peace wells up, and ego and desire die.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: har gunadaataa sad man vasai sach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||6||
english: The Lord, the Giver of Virtue, dwells forever within the minds of those who keep Truth enshrined within their hearts. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh meraa sadaa niramalaa man niramal paaiaa jaai ||
english: My God is forever Immaculate and Pure; with a pure mind, He can be found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan har man vasai haumai dukh sabh jaai ||
english: If the Treasure of the Name of the Lord abides within the mind, egotism and pain are totally eliminated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: satigur sabad sunaaiaa hau sad balihaarai jaau ||7||
english: The True Guru has instructed me in the Word of the Shabad. I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aapanai man chit kahai kahaae bin gur aap na jaaee ||
english: Within your own conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru, selfishness and conceit are not eradicated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu bhagat vachhal sukhadaataa kar kirapaa ma(n)n vasaaee ||
english: The Dear Lord is the Lover of His devotees, the Giver of Peace. By His Grace, He abides within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥੧॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak sobhaa surat dei prabh aape guramukh de vadiaaee ||8||1||18||
english: O Nanak, God blesses us with the sublime awakening of consciousness; He Himself grants glorious greatness to the Gurmukh. ||8||1||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਜਮਡੰਡੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਿਨ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai karam kamaavade jamada(n)d lagai tin aai ||
english: Those who go around acting in egotism are struck down by the Messenger of Death with his club.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: j satigur sevan se ubare har setee liv laai ||1||
english: Those who serve the True Guru are uplifted and saved, in love with the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: man re guramukh naam dhiaai ||
english: O mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhur poorab karatai likhiaa tinaa guramat naam samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who are so pre-destined by the Creator are absorbed into the Naam, through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vin satigur parateet na aavaee naam na laago bhaau ||
english: Without the True Guru, faith does not come, and love for the Naam is not embraced.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਸਵੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: supanai sukh na paavaee dukh mahi savai samaai ||2||
english: Even in dreams, they find no peace; they sleep immersed in pain. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je har har keechai bahut locheeai kirat na metiaa jaai ||
english: Even if you chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with great longing, your past actions are still not erased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਗਤੀ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਪਏ ਦਰਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har kaa bhaanaa bhagatee ma(n)niaa se bhagat pae dar thaai ||3||
english: The Lord's devotees surrender to His Will; those devotees are accepted at His Door. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਿੜਾਵੈ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur sabad diRaavai ra(n)g siu bin kirapaa laiaa na jaai ||
english: The Guru has lovingly implanted the Word of His Shabad within me. Without His Grace, it cannot be attained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨੀਰੀਐ ਭੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: je sau a(n)mrit neereeai bhee bikh phal laagai dhaai ||4||
english: Even if the poisonous plant is watered with ambrosial nectar a hundred times, it will still bear poisonous fruit. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: se jan sache niramale jin satigur naal piaar ||
english: Those humble beings who are in love with the True Guru are pure and true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: satigur kaa bhaanaa kamaavade bikh haumai taj vikaar ||5||
english: They act in harmony with the Will of the True Guru; they shed the poison of ego and corruption. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਧਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manahath kitai upaai na chhooteeai simrit saasatr sodhahu jaai ||
english: Acting in stubborn-mindedness, no one is saved; go and study the Simritees and the Shaastras.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)gat saadhoo ubare gur kaa sabad kamaai ||6||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and practicing the Shabads of the Guru, you shall be saved. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam nidhaan hai jis a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the Treasure, which has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਈ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਜਿਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramukh seee sohade jin kirapaa kare karataar ||7||
english: The Gurmukhs are beauteous; the Creator has blessed them with His Mercy. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak daataa ek hai doojaa aur na koi ||
english: O Nanak, the One Lord alone is the Giver; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੯॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeeai karam paraapat hoi ||8||2||19||
english: By Guru's Grace, He is obtained. By His Mercy, He is found. ||8||2||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਰਖਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਚੁਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)khee birakh suhaavaRaa sach chugai gur bhaai ||
english: The soul-bird in the beautiful tree of the body pecks at Truth, with love for the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਉਡੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har ras peevai sahaj rahai udai na aavai jaai ||
english: She drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and abides in intuitive ease; she does not fly around coming and going.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa paaiaa har har naam samaai ||1||
english: She obtains her home within her own heart; she is absorbed into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man re gur kee kaar kamaai ||
english: O mind, work to serve the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bhaanai je chalahi taa anadin raachahi har naai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If you walk in harmony with the Guru's Will, you shall remain immersed in the Lord's Name, night and day. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਰਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੇ ਊਡਹਿ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)khee birakh suhaavaRe oodahi chahu dis jaahi ||
english: The birds in the beautiful trees fly around in all four directions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਊਡਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇ ਨਿਤ ਦਾਝਹਿ ਤੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jetaa oodahi dukh ghane nit daajhahi tai bilalaahi ||
english: The more they fly around, the more they suffer; they burn and cry out in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin gur mahal na jaapaee naa a(n)mrit phal paahi ||2||
english: Without the Guru, they do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and they do not obtain the Ambrosial Fruit. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh braham hareeaavalaa saachai sahaj subhaai ||
english: The Gurmukh is like God's tree, always green, blessed with the Sublime Love of the True One, with intuitive peace and poise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਖਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saakhaa teen nivaareeaa ek sabad liv laai ||
english: He cuts off the three branches of the three qualities, and embraces love for the One Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਖਵਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit phal har ek hai aape dei khavaai ||3||
english: The Lord alone is the Ambrosial Fruit; He Himself gives it to us to eat. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਊਭੇ ਸੁਕਿ ਗਏ ਨਾ ਫਲੁ ਤਿੰਨਾ ਛਾਉ ॥
transliteration: manamukh oobhe suk gae naa phal ti(n)naa chhaau ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs stand there and dry up; they do not bear any fruit, and they do not provide any shade.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿੰਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ਨ ਬੈਸੀਐ ਓਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਨ ਗਿਰਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ti(n)naa paas na baiseeai onaa ghar na giraau ||
english: Don't even bother to sit near them-they have no home or village.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਤੈ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kateeahi tai nit jaaleeahi onaa sabad na naau ||4||
english: They are cut down and burnt each day; they have neither the Shabad, nor the Lord's Name. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hukame karam kamaavane paiai kirat phiraau ||
english: According to the Lord's Command, people perform their actions; they wander around, driven by the karma of their past actions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਾ ਜਹ ਭੇਜਹਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hukame darasan dekhanaa jah bhejahi tah jaau ||
english: By the Lord's Command, they behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Wherever He sends them, there they go.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: hukame har har man vasai hukame sach samaau ||5||
english: By His Command, the Lord, Har, Har, abides within our minds; by His Command we merge in Truth. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hukam na jaanahi bapuRe bhoole phirahi gavaar ||
english: The wretched fools do not know the Lord's Will; they wander around making mistakes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manahath karam kamaavade nit nit hohi khuaar ||
english: They go about their business stubborn-mindedly; they are disgraced forever and ever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: a(n)tar saa(n)t na aavaee naa sach lagai piaar ||6||
english: Inner peace does not come to them; they do not embrace love for the True Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ ਮੁਹ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukheeaa muh sohane gur kai het piaar ||
english: Beautiful are the faces of the Gurmukhs, who bear love and affection for the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: sachee bhagatee sach rate dar sachai sachiaar ||
english: Through true devotional worship, they are attuned to Truth; at the True Door, they are found to be true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਕਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aae se paravaan hai sabh kul kaa karahi udhaar ||7||
english: Blessed is their coming into being; they redeem all their ancestors. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh nadaree karam kamaavade nadaree baahar na koi ||
english: All do their deeds under the Lord's Glance of Grace; no one is beyond His Vision.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaisee nadar kar dekhai sachaa taisaa hee ko hoi ||
english: According to the Glance of Grace with which the True Lord beholds us, so do we become.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam vadaaeeaa karam paraapat hoi ||8||3||20||
english: O Nanak, the Glorious Greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is received only by His Mercy. ||8||3||20||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaaeeai manamukh boojh na paai ||
english: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sadaa mukh oojale har vasiaa man aai ||
english: The faces of the Gurmukhs are always radiant; the Lord has come to dwell within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sahaje hee sukh paaeeai sahaje rahai samaai ||1||
english: Through intuitive understanding they are at peace, and through intuitive understanding they remain absorbed in the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re daasan daasaa hoi ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, be the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa gur bhagat hai viralaa paae koi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Service to the Guru is worship of the Guru. How rare are those who obtain it! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa suhaag suhaaganee je chalahi satigur bhaai ||
english: The happy soul-bride is always with her Husband Lord, if she walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa pir nihachal paaeeai naa ohu marai na jaai ||
english: She attains her Eternal, Ever-stable Husband, who never dies or goes away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabad milee naa veechhuRai pir kai a(n)k samaai ||2||
english: United with the Word of the Shabad, she shall not be separated again. She is immersed in the Lap of her Beloved. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਜਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har niramal at oojalaa bin gur paaiaa na jaai ||
english: The Lord is Immaculate and Radiantly Bright; without the Guru, He cannot be found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜੈ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਈ ਭੇਖੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paath paRai naa boojhaee bhekhee bharam bhulaai ||
english: He cannot be understood by reading scriptures; the deceitful pretenders are deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramatee har sadaa paaiaa rasanaa har ras samaai ||3||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is always found, and the tongue is permeated with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu chukaaiaa guramatee sahaj subhaai ||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya is shed with intuitive ease, through the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਗਈ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai jag dukheeaa phirai manamukhaa no gaee khaai ||
english: Without the Shabad, the world wanders lost in pain. The self-willed manmukh is consumed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sabade naam dhiaaeeai sabade sach samaai ||4||
english: Through the Shabad, meditate on the Naam; through the Shabad, you shall merge in Truth. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਿਧ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa bhoole sidh phirahi samaadh na lagai subhaai ||
english: The Siddhas wander around, deluded by Maya; they are not absorbed in the Samaadhi of the Lord's Sublime Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨੇ ਲੋਅ ਵਿਆਪਤ ਹੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: teene lo viaapat hai adhik rahee lapataai ||
english: The three worlds are permeated by Maya; they are totally covered by it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bin gur mukat na paaeeai naa dubidhaa maaiaa jaai ||5||
english: Without the Guru, liberation is not attained, and the double-mindedness of Maya does not go away. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa kis no aakheeai kiaa maaiaa karam kamaai ||
english: What is called Maya? What does Maya do?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਬਧੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh ehu jeeu badh hai haumai karam kamaai ||
english: These beings are bound by pleasure and pain; they do their deeds in egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਨਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bin sabadai bharam na chookaee naa vichahu haumai jaai ||6||
english: Without the Shabad, doubt is not dispelled, and egotism is not eliminated from within. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin preetee bhagat na hovaee bin sabadai thaai na paai ||
english: Without love, there is no devotional worship. Without the Shabad, no one finds acceptance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabade haumai maareeai maaiaa kaa bhram jaai ||
english: Through the Shabad, egotism is conquered and subdued, and the illusion of Maya is dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naam padaarath paaeeai guramukh sahaj subhaai ||7||
english: The Gurmukh obtains the Treasure of the Naam with intuitive ease. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur gun na jaapanee bin gun bhagat na hoi ||
english: Without the Guru, one's virtues do not shine forth; without virtue, there is no devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal har man vasiaa sahaj miliaa prabh soi ||
english: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He abides within their minds. They meet that God with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੪॥੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak sabade har saalaaheeai karam paraapat hoi ||8||4||21||
english: O Nanak, through the Shabad, praise the Lord. By His Grace, He is obtained. ||8||4||21||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu merai prabh keenaa aape bharam bhulaae ||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya is created by my God; He Himself misleads us through illusion and doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh karam karahi nahee boojhahi birathaa janam gavaae ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs perform their actions, but they do not understand; they waste away their lives in vain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gurabaanee is jag mahi chaanan karam vasai man aae ||1||
english: Gurbani is the Light to illuminate this world; by His Grace, it comes to abide within the mind. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man re naam japahu sukh hoi ||
english: O mind, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and find peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa saalaaheeai sahaj milai prabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Praising the Perfect Guru, you shall easily meet with that God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bharam gaiaa bhau bhaagiaa har charanee chit laai ||
english: Doubt departs, and fear runs away, when you focus your consciousness on the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sabad kamaaeeai har vasai man aai ||
english: The Gurmukh practices the Shabad, and the Lord comes to dwell within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghar mahal sach samaaeeai jamakaal na sakai khaai ||2||
english: In the mansion of the home within the self, we merge in Truth, and the Messenger of Death cannot devour us. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਛੀਬਾ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਜੋੁਲਾਹਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naamaa chheebaa kabeer joulaahaa poore gur te gat paaee ||
english: Naam Dayv the printer, and Kabeer the weaver, obtained salvation through the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਬੇਤੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: braham ke bete sabad pachhaanahi haumai jaat gavaaee ||
english: Those who know God and recognize His Shabad lose their ego and class consciousness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sur nar tin kee baanee gaavahi koi na metai bhaaee ||3||
english: Their Banis are sung by the angelic beings, and no one can erase them, O Siblings of Destiny! ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੈਤ ਪੁਤੁ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਨ ਪੜੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: dait put karam dharam kichh sa(n)jam na paRai doojaa bhaau na jaanai ||
english: The demon's son Prahlaad had not read about religious rituals or ceremonies, austerity or self-discipline; he did not know the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhetiai niramal hoaa anadin naam vakhaanai ||
english: Upon meeting with the True Guru, he became pure; night and day, he chanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਪੜੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਬੂਝੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: eko paRai eko naau boojhai doojaa avar na jaanai ||4||
english: He read only of the One and he understood only the One Name; he knew no other at all. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਗੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: khat darasan jogee sa(n)niaasee bin gur bharam bhulaae ||
english: The followers of the six different life-styles and world-views, the Yogis and the Sanyaasees have gone astray in doubt without the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi taa gat mit paavahi har jeeu ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: If they serve the True Guru, they find the state of salvation; they enshrine the Dear Lord within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sachee baanee siu chit laagai aavan jaan rahaae ||5||
english: They focus their consciousness on the True Bani, and their comings and goings in reincarnation are over. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit paR paR vaad vakhaanahi bin gur bharam bhulaae ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and argue and stir up controversies, but without the Guru, they are deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh pher paiaa bin sabadai mukat na paae ||
english: They wander around the cycle of 8.4 million reincarnations; without the Shabad, they do not attain liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਨਾਉ ਚੇਤੈ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jaa naau chetai taa gat paae jaa satigur mel milaae ||6||
english: But when they remember the Name, then they attain the state of salvation, when the True Guru unites them in Union. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mahi naam har upajai jaa satigur milai subhaae ||
english: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Name of the Lord wells up, when the True Guru unites us in His Sublime Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ਚਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: man tan arapee aap gavaaee chalaa satigur bhaae ||
english: I offer my mind and body, and I renounce my selfishness and conceit; I walk in Harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sad balihaaree gur apune vitahu j har setee chit laae ||7||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, who has attached my consciousness to the Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜੋ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: so braahaman braham jo bi(n)de har setee ra(n)g raataa ||
english: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows the Lord Brahma, and is attuned to the Love of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh nikat vasai sabhanaa ghat a(n)tar guramukh viralai jaataa ||
english: God is close at hand; He dwells deep within the hearts of all. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, know Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੮॥੫॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee gur kai sabad pachhaataa ||8||5||22||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized. ||8||5||22||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੈ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਲੋਚਦੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sahajai no sabh lochadee bin gur paaiaa na jaai ||
english: Everyone longs to be centered and balanced, but without the Guru, no one can.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit jotakee thake bhekhee bharam bhulaai ||
english: The Pandits and the astrologers read and read until they grow weary, while the fanatics are deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur bhete sahaj paaiaa aapanee kirapaa kare rajaai ||1||
english: Meeting with the Guru, intuitive balance is obtained, when God, in His Will, grants His Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re gur bin sahaj na hoi ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, intuitive balance is not obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabadai hee te sahaj oopajai har paaiaa sach soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Word of the Shabad, intuitive peace and poise wells up, and that True Lord is obtained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਗਾਵਿਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: sahaje gaaviaa thaai pavai bin sahajai kathanee baad ||
english: That which is sung intuitively is acceptable; without this intuition, all chanting is useless.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: sahaje hee bhagat oopajai sahaj piaar bairaag ||
english: In the state of intuitive balance, devotion wells up. In intuitive balance, love is balanced and detached.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sahajai hee te sukh saat hoi bin sahajai jeevan baad ||2||
english: In the state of intuitive balance, peace and tranquility are produced. Without intuitive balance, life is useless. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sahaj saalaahee sadaa sadaa sahaj samaadh lagaai ||
english: In the state of intuitive balance, praise the Lord forever and ever. With intuitive ease, embrace Samaadhi.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਊਚਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sahaje hee gun oocharai bhagat kare liv laai ||
english: In the state of intuitive balance, chant His Glories, lovingly absorbed in devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabade hee har man vasai rasanaa har ras khaai ||3||
english: Through the Shabad, the Lord dwells within the mind, and the tongue tastes the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਵਿਡਾਰਿਆ ਸਚ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sahaje kaal vidaariaa sach saranaaee paai ||
english: In the poise of intuitive balance, death is destroyed, entering the Sanctuary of the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sahaje har naam man vasiaa sachee kaar kamaai ||
english: Intuitively balanced, the Name of the Lord dwells within the mind, practicing the lifestyle of Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: se vadabhaagee jinee paaiaa sahaje rahe samaai ||4||
english: Those who have found Him are very fortunate; they remain intuitively absorbed in Him. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa vich sahaj na oopajai maaiaa doojai bhaai ||
english: Within Maya, the poise of intuitive balance is not produced. Maya leads to the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲੈ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh karam kamaavane haumai jalai jalaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs perform religious rituals, but they are burnt down by their selfishness and conceit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maran na chookaee phir phir aavai jaai ||5||
english: Their births and deaths do not cease; over and over again, they come and go in reincarnation. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: trihu gunaa vich sahaj na paaeeai trai gun bharam bhulaai ||
english: In the three qualities, intuitive balance is not obtained; the three qualities lead to delusion and doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਘੁਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paReeai guneeai kiaa katheeai jaa mu(n)dhahu ghuthaa jaai ||
english: What is the point of reading, studying and debating, if one loses his roots?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: chauthe pad mahi sahaj hai guramukh palai paai ||6||
english: In the fourth state, there is intuitive balance; the Gurmukhs gather it in. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: niragun naam nidhaan hai sahaje sojhee hoi ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, is the treasure. Through intuitive balance, understanding is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gunava(n)tee saalaahiaa sache sachee soi ||
english: The virtuous praise the True One; their reputation is true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੁਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਸੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bhuliaa sahaj milaaisee sabad milaavaa hoi ||7||
english: The wayward are united with God through intuitive balance; through the Shabad, union is obtained. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin sahajai sabh a(n)dh hai maaiaa mohu gubaar ||
english: Without intuitive balance, all are blind. Emotional attachment to Maya is utter darkness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sahaje hee sojhee paee sachai sabad apaar ||
english: In intuitive balance, understanding of the True, Infinite Shabad is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੮॥
transliteration: aape bakhas milaaian poore gur karataar ||8||
english: Granting forgiveness, the Perfect Guru unites us with the Creator. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sahaje adisat pachhaaneeai nirabhau jot nira(n)kaar ||
english: In intuitive balance, the Unseen is recognized-the Fearless, Luminous, Formless Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa ik daataa jotee jot milaavanahaar ||
english: There is only the One Giver of all beings. He blends our light with His Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੯॥
transliteration: poorai sabad salaaheeai jis daa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||9||
english: So praise God through the Perfect Word of His Shabad; He has no end or limitation. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: giaaneeaa kaa dhan naam hai sahaj karahi vaapaar ||
english: Those who are wise take the Naam as their wealth; with intuitive ease, they trade with Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨਿ ਅਖੁਟ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: anadin laahaa har naam lain akhut bhare bha(n)daar ||
english: Night and day, they receive the Profit of the Lord's Name, which is an inexhaustible and over-flowing treasure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੀਏ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥੬॥੨੩॥
transliteration: naanak tot na aavaee deee devanahaar ||10||6||23||
english: O Nanak, when the Great Giver gives, nothing at all is lacking. ||10||6||23||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai pher na pavai janam maran dukh jaai ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, you shall not have to go through the cycle of reincarnation again; the pains of birth and death will be taken away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poorai sabad sabh sojhee hoee har naamai rahai samaai ||1||
english: Through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, all understanding is obtained; remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man mere satigur siu chit laai ||
english: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: niramal naam sad navatano aap vasai man aai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Immaculate Naam itself, ever-fresh, comes to abide within the mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu raakhahu apunee saranaaee jiu raakhahi tiu rahanaa ||
english: O Dear Lord, please protect and preserve me in Your Sanctuary. As You keep me, so do I remain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad jeevat marai guramukh bhavajal taranaa ||2||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Gurmukh remains dead while yet alive, and swims across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag naau paaeeai guramat sabad suhaaee ||
english: By great good fortune, the Name is obtained. Following the Guru's Teachings, through the Shabad, you shall be exalted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape man vasiaa prabh karataa sahaje rahiaa samaaee ||3||
english: God, the Creator Himself, dwells within the mind; remain absorbed in the state of intuitive balance. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa manamukh sabad na bhaavai ba(n)dhan ba(n)dh bhavaaiaa ||
english: Some are self-willed manmukhs; they do not love the Word of the Shabad. Bound in chains, they wander lost in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh phir phir aavai birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||4||
english: Through 8.4 million lifetimes, they wander over and over again; they waste away their lives in vain. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa man aana(n)d hai sachai sabad ra(n)g raate ||
english: In the minds of the devotees there is bliss; they are attuned to the Love of the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਤੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: anadin gun gaavahi sad niramal sahaje naam samaate ||5||
english: Night and day, they constantly sing the Glories of the Immaculate Lord; with intuitive ease, they are absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਭ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh a(n)mrit baanee bolahi sabh aatam raam pachhaanee ||
english: The Gurmukhs speak the Ambrosial Bani; they recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soul in all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: eko sevan ek araadhahi guramukh akath kahaanee ||6||
english: They serve the One; they worship and adore the One. The Gurmukhs speak the Unspoken Speech. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib seveeai guramukh vasai man aai ||
english: The Gurmukhs serve their True Lord and Master, who comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sadaa ra(n)g raate sach siu apunee kirapaa kare milaai ||7||
english: They are forever attuned to the Love of the True One, who bestows His Mercy and unites them with Himself. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਜਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae aape ikanaa sutiaa dei jagaai ||
english: He Himself does, and He Himself causes others to do; He wakes some from their sleep.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੭॥੨੪॥
transliteration: aape mel milaaidaa naanak sabad samaai ||8||7||24||
english: He Himself unites us in Union; Nanak is absorbed in the Shabad. ||8||7||24||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
transliteration: satigur seviai man niramalaa bhae pavit sareer ||
english: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate, and the body becomes pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man aana(n)d sadaa sukh paaiaa bhetiaa gahir ga(n)bheer ||
english: The mind obtains bliss and eternal peace, meeting with the Deep and Profound Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sachee sa(n)gat baisanaa sach naam man dheer ||1||
english: Sitting in the Sangat, the True Congregation, the mind is comforted and consoled by the True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: man re satigur sev nisa(n)g ||
english: O mind, serve the True Guru without hesitation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur seviai har man vasai lagai na mail pata(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Serving the True Guru, the Lord abides within the mind, and no trace of filth shall attach itself to you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad pat oopajai sache sachaa naau ||
english: From the True Word of the Shabad comes honor. True is the Name of the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jinee haumai maar pachhaaniaa hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who conquer their ego and recognize the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: manamukh sach na jaananee tin thaur na katahoo thaau ||2||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the True One; they find no shelter, and no place of rest anywhere. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sache hee vich vaas ||
english: Those who take the Truth as their food and the Truth as their clothing, have their home in the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sachaa saalaahanaa sachai sabad nivaas ||
english: They constantly praise the True One, and in the True Word of the Shabad they have their dwelling.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa guramatee nij ghar vaas ||3||
english: They recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soul in all, and through the Guru's Teachings they dwell in the home of their own inner self. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sach vekhan sach bolanaa tan man sachaa hoi ||
english: They see the Truth, and they speak the Truth; their bodies and minds are True.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sachee saakhee upades sach sache sachee soi ||
english: True are their teachings, and True are their instructions; True are the reputations of the true ones.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਚਲੇ ਰੋਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ji(n)nee sach visaariaa se dukheee chale roi ||4||
english: Those who have forgotten the True One are miserable-they depart weeping and wailing. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur jinee na sevio se kit aae sa(n)saar ||
english: Those who have not served the True Guru-why did they even bother to come into the world?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਸੁਣੈ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jam dar badhe maareeahi kook na sunai pookaar ||
english: They are bound and gagged and beaten at Death's door, but no one hears their shrieks and cries.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
transliteration: birathaa janam gavaaiaa mar ja(n)mahi vaaro vaar ||5||
english: They waste their lives uselessly; they die and are reincarnated over and over again. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ehu jag jalataa dekh kai bhaj pae satigur saranaa ||
english: Seeing this world on fire, I rushed to the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur sach diRaaiaa sadaa sach sa(n)jam rahanaa ||
english: The True Guru has implanted the Truth within me; I dwell steadfastly in Truth and self-restraint.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: satigur sachaa hai bohithaa sabade bhavajal taranaa ||6||
english: The True Guru is the Boat of Truth; in the Word of the Shabad, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh phirade rahe bin satigur mukat na hoee ||
english: People continue wandering through the cycle of 8.4 million incarnations; without the True Guru, liberation is not obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit monee thake doojai bhaai pat khoee ||
english: Reading and studying, the Pandits and the silent sages have grown weary, but attached to the love of duality, they have lost their honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: satigur sabad sunaaiaa bin sache avar na koee ||7||
english: The True Guru teaches the Word of the Shabad; without the True One, there is no other at all. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: jo sachai laae se sach lage nit sachee kaar kara(n)n ||
english: Those who are linked by the True One are linked to Truth. They always act in Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: tinaa nij ghar vaasaa paaiaa sachai mahal raha(n)n ||
english: They attain their dwelling in the home of their own inner being, and they abide in the Mansion of Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਚੰਨਿ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੮॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak bhagat sukheee sadaa sachai naam racha(n)n ||8||17||8||25||
english: O Nanak, the devotees are happy and peaceful forever. They are absorbed in the True Name. ||8||17||8||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਬਣੈ ਢੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau musakal at banai dhoee koi na dei ||
english: When you are confronted with terrible hardships, and no one offers you any support,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਗੂ ਹੋਏ ਦੁਸਮਨਾ ਸਾਕ ਭਿ ਭਜਿ ਖਲੇ ॥
transliteration: laagoo hoe dusamanaa saak bh bhaj khale ||
english: when your friends turn into enemies, and even your relatives have deserted you,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੋ ਭਜੈ ਆਸਰਾ ਚੁਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabho bhajai aasaraa chukai sabh asaraau ||
english: and when all support has given way, and all hope has been lost

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chit aavai os paarabraham lagai na tatee vaau ||1||
english: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, even the hot wind shall not touch you. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਿਤਾਣਿਆ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: saahib nitaaniaa kaa taan ||
english: Our Lord and Master is the Power of the powerless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aai na jaaee thir sadaa gurasabadee sach jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He does not come or go; He is Eternal and Permanent. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is known as True. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੁਬਲਾ ਨੰਗ ਭੁਖ ਕੀ ਪੀਰ ॥
transliteration: je ko hovai dubalaa na(n)g bhukh kee peer ||
english: If you are weakened by the pains of hunger and poverty,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਮੜਾ ਪਲੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਧੀਰ ॥
transliteration: damaRaa palai naa pavai naa ko devai dheer ||
english: with no money in your pockets, and no one will give you any comfort,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਾਜੁ ॥
transliteration: suaarath suaau na ko kare naa kichh hovai kaaj ||
english: and no one will satisfy your hopes and desires, and none of your works is accomplished

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਜੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chit aavai os paarabraham taa nihachal hovai raaj ||2||
english: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall obtain the eternal kingdom. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau chi(n)taa bahut bahut dehee viaapai rog ||
english: When you are plagued by great and excessive anxiety, and diseases of the body;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਸਤਿ ਕੁਟੰਬਿ ਪਲੇਟਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਹਰਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: grisat kuta(n)b paletiaa kade harakh kade sog ||
english: when you are wrapped up in the attachments of household and family, sometimes feeling joy, and then other times sorrow;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਕਾ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gaun kare chahu ku(n)t kaa ghaRee na baisan soi ||
english: when you are wandering around in all four directions, and you cannot sit or sleep even for a moment

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chit aavai os paarabraham tan man seetal hoi ||3||
english: -if you come to remember the Supreme Lord God, then your body and mind shall be cooled and soothed. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਲੋਭਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kaam karodh mohi vas keeaa kirapan lobh piaar ||
english: When you are under the power of sexual desire, anger and worldly attachment, or a greedy miser in love with your wealth;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਉਨਿ ਅਘ ਕੀਏ ਹੋਆ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: chaare kilavikh un agh keee hoaa asur sa(n)ghaar ||
english: if you have committed the four great sins and other mistakes; even if you are a murderous fiend

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੋਥੀ ਗੀਤ ਕਵਿਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕਰਨਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pothee geet kavit kichh kade na karan dhariaa ||
english: who has never taken the time to listen to sacred books, hymns and poetry

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: chit aavai os paarabraham taa nimakh simarat tariaa ||4||
english: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, and contemplate Him, even for a moment, you shall be saved. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਚਾਰਿ ਮੁਖਾਗਰ ਬਿਚਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saasat si(n)mrit bed chaar mukhaagar bichare ||
english: People may recite by heart the Shaastras, the Simritees and the four Vedas;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਪੇ ਤਪੀਸਰ ਜੋਗੀਆ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tape tapeesar jogeeaa teerath gavan kare ||
english: they may be ascetics, great, self-disciplined Yogis; they may visit sacred shrines of pilgrimage

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਗੁਣੇ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khat karamaa te dugune poojaa karataa naai ||
english: and perform the six ceremonial rituals, over and over again, performing worship services and ritual bathings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਗੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਾ ਸਰਪਰ ਨਰਕੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ra(n)g na lagee paarabraham taa sarapar narake jaai ||5||
english: Even so, if they have not embraced love for the Supreme Lord God, then they shall surely go to hell. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਕ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
transliteration: raaj milak sikadaareeaa ras bhogan bisathaar ||
english: You may possess empires, vast estates, authority over others, and the enjoyment of myriads of pleasures;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਗ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਚਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
transliteration: baag suhaave sohane chalai hukam aphaar ||
english: you may have delightful and beautiful gardens, and issue unquestioned commands;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧੀ ਚਾਇ ਲਗਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g tamaase bahu bidhee chaai lag rahiaa ||
english: you may have enjoyments and entertainments of all sorts and kinds, and continue to enjoy exciting pleasures

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਸਰਪ ਕੀ ਜੂਨਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: chit na aaio paarabraham taa sarap kee joon gaiaa ||6||
english: -and yet, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall be reincarnated as a snake. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਧਨਾਢਿ ਅਚਾਰਵੰਤੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bahut dhanaadh achaarava(n)t sobhaa niramal reet ||
english: You may possess vast riches, maintain virtuous conduct, have a spotless reputation and observe religious customs;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈਆ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa sut bhaaeeaa saajan sa(n)g pareet ||
english: you may have the loving affections of mother, father, children, siblings and friends;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਸਕਰ ਤਰਕਸਬੰਦ ਬੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਜੀਉ ਸਗਲੀ ਕੀਤ ॥
transliteration: lasakar tarakasaba(n)d ba(n)d jeeu jeeu sagalee keet ||
english: you may have armies well-equipped with weapons, and all may salute you with respect;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਖੜਿ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਦੀਤ ॥੭॥
transliteration: chit na aaio paarabraham taa khaR rasaatal deet ||7||
english: But still, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, then you shall be taken and consigned to the most hideous hell! ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾੜਾ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa rog na chhidr kichh naa kichh kaaRaa sog ||
english: You may have a body free of disease and deformity, and have no worries or grief at all;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਗੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: mirat na aavee chit tis ahinis bhogai bhog ||
english: you may be unmindful of death, and night and day revel in pleasures;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਜੀਇ ਨ ਸੰਕ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh keeton aapanaa jeei na sa(n)k dhariaa ||
english: you may take everything as your own, and have no fear in your mind at all;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਵਸਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: chit na aaio paarabraham jamaka(n)kar vas pariaa ||8||
english: but still, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall fall under the power of the Messenger of Death. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa kare jis paarabraham hovai saadhoo sa(n)g ||
english: The Supreme Lord showers His Mercy, and we find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਓਹੁ ਵਧਾਈਐ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu jiu ohu vadhaaeeai tiu tiu har siu ra(n)g ||
english: The more time we spend there, the more we come to love the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: duhaa siriaa kaa khasam aap avar na doojaa thaau ||
english: The Lord is the Master of both worlds; there is no other place of rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੯॥੧॥੨੬॥
transliteration: satigur tuthai paaiaa naanak sachaa naau ||9||1||26||
english: When the True Guru is pleased and satisfied, O Nanak, the True Name is obtained. ||9||1||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨਉ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਵਨ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jaanau nahee bhaavai kavan baataa ||
english: I do not know what pleases my Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਖੋਜਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man khoj maarag ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O mind, seek out the way! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: dhiaanee dhiaan laavahi ||
english: The meditatives practice meditation,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: giaanee giaan kamaavahi ||
english: and the wise practice spiritual wisdom,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh kin hee jaataa ||1||
english: but how rare are those who know God! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਉਤੀ ਰਹਤ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagautee rahat jugataa ||
english: The worshipper of Bhagaauti practices self-discipline,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹਤ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jogee kahat mukataa ||
english: the Yogi speaks of liberation,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਪਸੀ ਤਪਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tapasee tapahi raataa ||2||
english: and the ascetic is absorbed in asceticism. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਨੀ ਮੋਨਿਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: monee monidhaaree ||
english: The men of silence observe silence,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਨਿਆਸੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saniaasee brahamachaaree ||
english: the Sanyaasees observe celibacy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਾਸੀ ਉਦਾਸਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: udaasee udaas raataa ||3||
english: and the Udaasees abide in detachment. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਨਵੈ ਪਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagat navai parakaaraa ||
english: There are nine forms of devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਵੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit ved pukaaraa ||
english: The Pandits recite the Vedas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਸਤੀ ਗਿਰਸਤਿ ਧਰਮਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: girasatee girasat dharamaataa ||4||
english: The householders assert their faith in family life. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਸਬਦੀ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਵਧੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ik sabadee bahu roop avadhootaa ||
english: Those who utter only One Word, those who take many forms, the naked renunciates,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਪੜੀ ਕਉਤੇ ਜਾਗੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kaapaRee kaute jaagootaa ||
english: the wearers of patched coats, the magicians, those who remain always awake,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਤਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ik teerath naataa ||5||
english: and those who bathe at holy places of pilgrimage-||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਹਾਰ ਵਰਤੀ ਆਪਰਸਾ ॥
transliteration: nirahaar varatee aaparasaa ||
