english: Those who go without food, those who never touch others,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਲੂਕਿ ਨ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਦਰਸਾ ॥
transliteration: ik look na devahi darasaa ||
english: the hermits who never show themselves,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ik man hee giaataa ||6||
english: and those who are wise in their own minds-||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ghaat na kin hee kahaaiaa ||
english: Of these, no one admits to any deficiency;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਹਤੇ ਹੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh kahate hai paaiaa ||
english: all say that they have found the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਭਗਤਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jis mele so bhagataa ||7||
english: But he alone is a devotee, whom the Lord has united with Himself. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਉਕਤਿ ਉਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal ukat upaavaa ||
english: Abandoning all devices and contrivances,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: tiaagee saran paavaa ||
english: I have sought His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੮॥੨॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak gur charan paraataa ||8||2||27||
english: Nanak has fallen at the Feet of the Guru. ||8||2||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 3 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਗੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jogee a(n)dar jogeeaa ||
english: Among Yogis, You are the Yogi;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਭੋਗੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭੋਗੀਆ ॥
transliteration: too(n) bhogee a(n)dar bhogeeaa ||
english: among pleasure seekers, You are the Pleasure Seeker.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਮਛਿ ਪਇਆਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: teraa a(n)t na paaiaa surag machh paiaal jeeu ||1||
english: Your limits are not known to any of the beings in the heavens, in this world, or in the nether regions of the underworld. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵ ਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree hau vaaranai kurabaan tere naav no ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to Your Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh sa(n)saar upaaiaa ||
english: You created the world,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੇ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sire sir dha(n)dhe laaiaa ||
english: and assigned tasks to one and all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੇਖਹਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vekhahi keetaa aapanaa kar kudarat paasaa dhaal jeeu ||2||
english: You watch over Your Creation, and through Your All-powerful Creative Potency, You cast the dice. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਗਟਿ ਪਾਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਪਦਾ ॥
transliteration: paragat paahaarai jaapadaa ||
english: You are manifest in the Expanse of Your Workshop.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਪਰਤਾਪਦਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh naavai no parataapadaa ||
english: Everyone longs for Your Name,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਭ ਮੋਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur baajh na paaio sabh mohee maaiaa jaal jeeu ||3||
english: but without the Guru, no one finds You. All are enticed and trapped by Maya. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur kau bal jaaeeai ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jit miliai param gat paaeeai ||
english: Meeting Him, the supreme status is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਚਦੇ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sur nar mun jan lochade so satigur deeaa bujhaai jeeu ||4||
english: The angelic beings and the silent sages long for Him; the True Guru has given me this understanding. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈਸੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat kaisee jaaneeai ||
english: How is the Society of the Saints to be known?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jithai eko naam vakhaaneeai ||
english: There, the Name of the One Lord is chanted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: eko naam hukam hai naanak satigur deeaa bujhaai jeeu ||5||
english: The One Name is the Lord's Command; O Nanak, the True Guru has given me this understanding. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ihu jagat bharam bhulaaiaa ||
english: This world has been deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aapahu tudh khuaaiaa ||
english: You Yourself, Lord, have led it astray.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਲਗਾ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭਾਗ ਜਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: parataap lagaa dohaaganee bhaag jinaa ke naahi jeeu ||6||
english: The discarded soul-brides suffer in terrible agony; they have no luck at all. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਨੀਸਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: dohaaganee kiaa neesaaneeaa ||
english: What are the signs of the discarded brides?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮਹੁ ਘੁਥੀਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: khasamahu ghutheeaa phirahi nimaaneeaa ||
english: They miss their Husband Lord, and they wander around in dishonor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੇ ਵੇਸ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: maile ves tinaa kaamanee dukhee rain vihaai jeeu ||7||
english: The clothes of those brides are filthy-they pass their life-night in agony. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sohaaganee kiaa karam kamaaiaa ||
english: What actions have the happy soul-brides performed?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa phal paaiaa ||
english: They have obtained the fruit of their pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
transliteration: nadar kare kai aapanee aape lae milaai jeeu ||8||
english: Casting His Glance of Grace, the Lord unites them with Himself. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਨੋ ਮਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hukam jinaa no manaaiaa ||
english: Those, whom God causes to abide by His Will,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tin a(n)tar sabad vasaaiaa ||
english: have the Shabad of His Word abiding deep within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹੀਆ ਸੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥
transliteration: saheeaa se sohaaganee jin sah naal piaar jeeu ||9||
english: They are the true soul-brides, who embrace love for their Husband Lord. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਣੇ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jinaa bhaane kaa ras aaiaa ||
english: Those who take pleasure in God's Will

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tin vichahu bharam chukaaiaa ||
english: remove doubt from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਐਸਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak satigur aisaa jaaneeai jo sabhasai lae milaai jeeu ||10||
english: O Nanak, know Him as the True Guru, who unites all with the Lord. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai phal paaiaa ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, they receive the fruits of their destiny,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਅਹਕਰਣੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin vichahu ahakaran chukaaiaa ||
english: and egotism is driven out from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਭਾਗੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: duramat kaa dukh katiaa bhaag baithaa masatak aai jeeu ||11||
english: The pain of evil-mindedness is eliminated; good fortune comes and shines radiantly from their foreheads. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit teree baaneeaa ||
english: The Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: teriaa bhagataa ridai samaaneeaa ||
english: It permeates the hearts of Your devotees.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸੇਵਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿਐ ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: sukh sevaa a(n)dar rakhiai aapanee nadar karahi nisataar jeeu ||12||
english: Serving You, peace is obtained; granting Your Mercy, You bestow salvation. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliaa jaaneeai ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, one comes to know;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jit miliai naam vakhaaneeai ||
english: by this meeting, one comes to chant the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਭ ਥਕੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: satigur baajh na paaio sabh thakee karam kamaai jeeu ||13||
english: Without the True Guru, God is not found; all have grown weary of performing religious rituals. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hau satigur vitahu ghumaaiaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin bhram bhulaa maarag paaiaa ||
english: I was wandering in doubt, and He has set me on the right path.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਰਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: nadar kare je aapanee aape lae ralaai jeeu ||14||
english: If the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, He unites us with Himself. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sabhanaa maahi samaaiaa ||
english: You, Lord, are pervading in all,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tin karatai aap lukaaiaa ||
english: and yet, the Creator keeps Himself concealed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh paragat hoiaa jaa kau jot dharee karataar jeeu ||15||
english: O Nanak, the Creator is revealed to the Gurmukh, within whom He has infused His Light. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਖਸਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aape khasam nivaajiaa ||
english: The Master Himself bestows honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d de saajiaa ||
english: He creates and bestows body and soul.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੀਆ ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: aapane sevak kee paij rakheeaa dui kar masatak dhaar jeeu ||16||
english: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; He places both His Hands upon their foreheads. ||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਰਹੇ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh sa(n)jam rahe siaanapaa ||
english: All strict rituals are just clever contrivances.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh sabh kichh jaanadaa ||
english: My God knows everything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਓ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: pragat prataap varataaio sabh lok karai jaikaar jeeu ||17||
english: He has made His Glory manifest, and all people celebrate Him. ||17||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਨ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mere gun avagan na beechaariaa ||
english: He has not considered my merits and demerits;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh apanaa birad samaariaa ||
english: this is God's Own Nature.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਕੈ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: ka(n)th laai kai rakhion lagai na tatee vaau jeeu ||18||
english: Hugging me close in His Embrace, He protects me, and now, even the hot wind does not touch me. ||18||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mai man tan prabhoo dhiaaiaa ||
english: Within my mind and body, I meditate on God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਇ ਇਛਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jeei ichhiaRaa phal paaiaa ||
english: I have obtained the fruits of my soul's desire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: saah paatisaah sir khasam too(n) jap naanak jeevai naau jeeu ||19||
english: You are the Supreme Lord and Master, above the heads of kings. Nanak lives by chanting Your Name. ||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape aap upaaiaa ||
english: You Yourself created the Universe;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: doojaa khel kar dikhalaaiaa ||
english: You created the play of duality, and staged it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: sabh sacho sach varatadaa jis bhaavai tisai bujhaai jeeu ||20||
english: The Truest of the True is pervading everywhere; He instructs those with whom He is pleased. ||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee paaiaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have found God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tithai maaiaa mohu chukaaiaa ||
english: By His Grace, I have shed emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: kirapaa kar kai aapanee aape lae samaai jeeu ||21||
english: Showering His Mercy, He has blended me into Himself. ||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਪੀ ਨੈ ਗੋਆਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gopee nai goaaleeaa ||
english: You are the Gopis, the milk-maids of Krishna; You are the sacred river Jamunaa; You are Krishna, the herdsman.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape goi uthaaleeaa ||
english: You Yourself support the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਭੰਨਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: hukamee bhaa(n)de saajiaa too(n) aape bha(n)n savaar jeeu ||22||
english: By Your Command, human beings are fashioned. You Yourself embellish them, and then again destroy them. ||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin satigur siu chit laaiaa ||
english: Those who have focused their consciousness on the True Guru

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tinee doojaa bhaau chukaaiaa ||
english: have rid themselves of the love of duality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਆ ਓਇ ਚਲੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: niramal jot tin praaneeaa oi chale janam savaar jeeu ||23||
english: The light of those mortal beings is immaculate. They depart after redeeming their lives. ||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥
transliteration: tereeaa sadaa sadaa cha(n)giaaeeaa ||
english: I praise the Greatness of Your Goodness,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੈ ਵਡਿਆਈਆਂ ॥
transliteration: mai raat dihai vadiaaeeaa(n) ||
english: Forever and ever, night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਣਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੪॥੧॥
transliteration: anama(n)giaa daan devanaa kahu naanak sach samaal jeeu ||24||1||
english: You bestow Your Gifts, even if we do not ask for them. Says Nanak, contemplate the True Lord. ||24||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੈ ਪਾਇ ਮਨਾਈ ਸੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: pai paai manaaee soi jeeu ||
english: I fall at His Feet to please and appease Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh milaaiaa tis jevad avar na koi jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru has united me with the Lord, the Primal Being. There is no other as great as He. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਸਾਈ ਮਿਹੰਡਾ ਇਠੜਾ ॥
transliteration: gosaaee miha(n)daa ithaRaa ||
english: The Lord of the Universe is my Sweet Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ ਅਬੇ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਮਿਠੜਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)m abe thaavahu mithaRaa ||
english: He is sweeter than my mother or father.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈਣ ਭਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhain bhaaee sabh sajanaa tudh jehaa naahee koi jeeu ||1||
english: Among all sisters and brothers and friends, there is no one like You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: terai hukame saavan aaiaa ||
english: By Your Command, the month of Saawan has come.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਸਤ ਕਾ ਹਲੁ ਜੋਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mai sat kaa hal joaaiaa ||
english: I have hooked up the plow of Truth,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜਣ ਲਗਾ ਆਸ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਹਲ ਬਖਸ ਜਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naau beejan lagaa aas kar har bohal bakhas jamaai jeeu ||2||
english: and I plant the seed of the Name in hopes that the Lord, in His Generosity, will bestow a bountiful harvest. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਦਾ ॥
transliteration: hau gur mil ik pachhaanadaa ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, I recognize only the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਯਾ ਕਾਗਲੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਦਾ ॥
transliteration: duyaa kaagal chit na jaanadaa ||
english: In my consciousness, I do not know of any other account.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਤੈ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਂਵੈ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har ikatai kaarai laaion jiu bhaavai ti(n)vai nibaahi jeeu ||3||
english: The Lord has assigned one task to me; as it pleases Him, I perform it. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਸੀ ਭੋਗਿਹੁ ਭੁੰਚਹੁ ਭਾਈਹੋ ॥
transliteration: tusee bhogihu bhu(n)chahu bhaaeeho ||
english: Enjoy yourselves and eat, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਕਵਾਇ ਪੈਨਾਈਓ ॥
transliteration: gur deebaan kavaai painaaeeo ||
english: In the Guru's Court, He has blessed me with the Robe of Honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹੋਆ ਮਾਹਰੁ ਪਿੰਡ ਦਾ ਬੰਨਿ ਆਦੇ ਪੰਜਿ ਸਰੀਕ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: hau hoaa maahar pi(n)d daa ba(n)n aade pa(n)j sareek jeeu ||4||
english: I have become the Master of my body-village; I have taken the five rivals as prisoners. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਆਇਆ ਸਾਮੑੈ ਤਿਹੰਡੀਆ ॥
transliteration: hau aaiaa saamhai tiha(n)deeaa ||
english: I have come to Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਜਿ ਕਿਰਸਾਣ ਮੁਜੇਰੇ ਮਿਹਡਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)j kirasaan mujere mihadiaa ||
english: The five farm-hands have become my tenants;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਢਿ ਨ ਹੰਘਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਵੁਠਾ ਘੁਘਿ ਗਿਰਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ka(n)n koee kadh na ha(n)ghaee naanak vuthaa ghugh giraau jeeu ||5||
english: none dare to raise their heads against me. O Nanak, my village is populous and prosperous. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਘੁੰਮਾ ਜਾਵਦਾ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree ghu(n)maa jaavadaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਸਾਹਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: ik saahaa tudh dhiaaidaa ||
english: I meditate on You continually.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਜੜੁ ਥੇਹੁ ਵਸਾਇਓ ਹਉ ਤੁਧ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ujaR thehu vasaaio hau tudh vitahu kurabaan jeeu ||6||
english: The village was in ruins, but You have re-populated it. I am a sacrifice to You. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਠੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: har ithai nit dhiaaidaa ||
english: O Beloved Lord, I meditate on You continually;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੀ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: man chi(n)dee so phal paaidaa ||
english: I obtain the fruits of my mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਲਾਹੀਅਨੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sabhe kaaj savaarian laaheean man kee bhukh jeeu ||7||
english: All my affairs are arranged, and the hunger of my mind is appeased. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਛਡਿਆ ਸਭੋ ਧੰਧੜਾ ॥
transliteration: mai chhadiaa sabho dha(n)dhaRaa ||
english: I have forsaken all my entanglements;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਸਾਈ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਚੜਾ ॥
transliteration: gosaaee sevee sachaRaa ||
english: I serve the True Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੈ ਪਲੈ ਬਧਾ ਛਿਕਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
transliteration: nau nidh naam nidhaan har mai palai badhaa chhik jeeu ||8||
english: I have firmly attached the Name, the Home of the Nine Treasures to my robe. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mai sukhee hoo(n) sukh paaiaa ||
english: I have obtained the comfort of comforts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur a(n)tar sabad vasaaiaa ||
english: The Guru has implanted the Word of the Shabad deep within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਥੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥
transliteration: satigur purakh vikhaaliaa masatak dhar kai hath jeeu ||9||
english: The True Guru has shown me my Husband Lord; He has placed His Hand upon my forehead. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਬਧੀ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: mai badhee sach dharam saal hai ||
english: I have established the Temple of Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਲਹਦਾ ਭਾਲਿ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa lahadaa bhaal kai ||
english: I sought out the Guru's Sikhs, and brought them into it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੈਰ ਧੋਵਾ ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਗਾ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: pair dhovaa pakhaa pheradaa tis niv niv lagaa paai jeeu ||10||
english: I wash their feet, and wave the fan over them. Bowing low, I fall at their feet. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sun galaa gur pahi aaiaa ||
english: I heard of the Guru, and so I went to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naam daan isanaan diRaaiaa ||
english: He instilled within me the Naam, the goodness of charity and true cleansing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੈਸਾਰੜਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਚਾੜਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: sabh mukat hoaa saisaaraRaa naanak sachee beRee chaaR jeeu ||11||
english: All the world is liberated, O Nanak, by embarking upon the Boat of Truth. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh srisat seve din raat jeeu ||
english: The whole Universe serves You, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇ ਕੰਨੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: de ka(n)n sunahu aradaas jeeu ||
english: Please hear my prayer, O Dear Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀਆ ਤੁਸਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਛਡਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: thok vajaai sabh ditheeaa tus aape laian chhadaai jeeu ||12||
english: I have thoroughly tested and seen all-You alone, by Your Pleasure, can save us. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਣਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਣ ਦਾ ॥
transliteration: hun hukam hoaa miharavaan daa ||
english: Now, the Merciful Lord has issued His Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਰਞਾਣਦਾ ॥
transliteration: pai koi na kisai ranjaanadaa ||
english: Let no one chase after and attack anyone else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਵੁਠੀਆ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਲੇਮੀ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: sabh sukhaalee vutheeaa ihu hoaa halemee raaj jeeu ||13||
english: Let all abide in peace, under this Benevolent Rule. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝਿੰਮਿ ਝਿੰਮਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਰਸਦਾ ॥
transliteration: jhi(n)m jhi(n)m a(n)mrit varasadaa ||
english: Softly and gently, drop by drop, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਾਇਆ ਬੋਲੀ ਖਸਮ ਦਾ ॥
transliteration: bolaaiaa bolee khasam daa ||
english: I speak as my Lord and Master causes me to speak.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਥਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: bahu maan keeaa tudh upare too(n) aape paaihi thaai jeeu ||14||
english: I place all my faith in You; please accept me. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਦ ਤੇਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: teriaa bhagataa bhukh sad tereeaa ||
english: Your devotees are forever hungry for You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har lochaa pooran mereeaa ||
english: O Lord, please fulfill my desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਿਆ ਮੈ ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: dehu daras sukhadaatiaa mai gal vich laihu milaai jeeu ||15||
english: Grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Giver of Peace. Please, take me into Your Embrace. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh jevad avar na bhaaliaa ||
english: I have not found any other as Great as You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਪਇਆਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: too(n) deep lo paiaaliaa ||
english: You pervade the continents, the worlds and the nether regions;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: too(n) thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa naanak bhagataa sach adhaar jeeu ||16||
english: You are permeating all places and interspaces. Nanak: You are the True Support of Your devotees. ||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੋਸਾਈ ਦਾ ਪਹਿਲਵਾਨੜਾ ॥
transliteration: hau gosaaee daa pahilavaanaRaa ||
english: I am a wrestler; I belong to the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਉਚ ਦੁਮਾਲੜਾ ॥
transliteration: mai gur mil uch dumaalaRaa ||
english: I met with the Guru, and I have tied a tall, plumed turban.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ਛਿੰਝ ਇਕਠੀਆ ਦਯੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: sabh hoee chhi(n)jh ikatheeaa day baithaa vekhai aap jeeu ||17||
english: All have gathered to watch the wrestling match, and the Merciful Lord Himself is seated to behold it. ||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਤ ਵਜਨਿ ਟੰਮਕ ਭੇਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: vaat vajan ta(n)mak bhereeaa ||
english: The bugles play and the drums beat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲ ਲਥੇ ਲੈਦੇ ਫੇਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mal lathe laide phereeaa ||
english: The wrestlers enter the arena and circle around.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਤੇ ਪੰਜਿ ਜੁਆਨ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਥਾਪੀ ਦਿਤੀ ਕੰਡਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: nihate pa(n)j juaan mai gur thaapee ditee ka(n)d jeeu ||18||
english: I have thrown the five challengers to the ground, and the Guru has patted me on the back. ||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਇਕਠੇ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh ikathe hoi aaiaa ||
english: All have gathered together,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ghar jaasan vaat vataaiaa ||
english: but we shall return home by different routes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਗਏ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਚਲੇ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: guramukh laahaa lai gae manamukh chale mool gavaai jeeu ||19||
english: The Gurmukhs reap their profits and leave, while the self-willed manmukhs lose their investment and depart. ||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) varanaa chihanaa baaharaa ||
english: You are without color or mark.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har disahi haajar jaaharaa ||
english: The Lord is seen to be manifest and present.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: sun sun tujhai dhiaaide tere bhagat rate gunataas jeeu ||20||
english: Hearing of Your Glories again and again, Your devotees meditate on You; they are attuned to You, O Lord, Treasure of Excellence. ||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਦਯੈ ਸੇਵੜੀ ॥
transliteration: mai jug jug dayai sevaRee ||
english: Through age after age, I am the servant of the Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਟੀ ਮਿਹਡੀ ਜੇਵੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gur katee mihadee jevaRee ||
english: The Guru has cut away my bonds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਛਿੰਝ ਨ ਨਚਊ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਲਧਾ ਭਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੧॥੨॥੨੯॥
transliteration: hau baahuR chhi(n)jh na nachaoo naanak ausar ladhaa bhaal jeeu ||21||2||29||
english: I shall not have to dance in the wrestling arena of life again. Nanak has searched, and found this opportunity. ||21||2||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪਹਰੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 pahare ghar 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Pehray, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਇਆ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa hukam paiaa garabhaas ||
english: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you were cast into the womb, by the Lord's Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਖਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: uradh tap a(n)tar kare vanajaariaa mitraa khasam setee aradaas ||
english: Upside-down, within the womb, you performed penance, O my merchant friend, and you prayed to your Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਉਰਧ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: khasam setee aradaas vakhaanai uradh dhiaan liv laagaa ||
english: You uttered prayers to your Lord and Master, while upside-down, and you meditated on Him with deep love and affection.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮਰਜਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਕਲਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਨਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: naa marajaad aaiaa kal bheetar baahuR jaasee naagaa ||
english: You came into this Dark Age of Kali Yuga naked, and you shall depart again naked.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਕਲਮ ਵੁੜੀ ਹੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jaisee kalam vuRee hai masatak taisee jeeaRe paas ||
english: As God's Pen has written on your forehead, so it shall be with your soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਇਆ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai hukam paiaa garabhaas ||1||
english: Says Nanak, in the first watch of the night, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command, you enter into the womb. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: doojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa visar gaiaa dhiaan ||
english: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you have forgotten to meditate.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਥੋ ਹਥਿ ਨਚਾਈਐ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਸੁਦਾ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: hatho hath nachaaeeai vanajaariaa mitraa jiu jasudaa ghar kaan ||
english: From hand to hand, you are passed around, O my merchant friend, like Krishna in the house of Yashoda.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਥੋ ਹਥਿ ਨਚਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮਾਤ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hatho hath nachaaeeai praanee maat kahai sut meraa ||
english: From hand to hand, you are passed around, and your mother says, "This is my son."

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਮੂੜ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: chet achet mooR man mere a(n)t nahee kachh teraa ||
english: O, my thoughtless and foolish mind, think: In the end, nothing shall be yours.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jin rach rachiaa tisahi na jaanai man bheetar dhar giaan ||
english: You do not know the One who created the creation. Gather spiritual wisdom within your mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak praanee doojai paharai visar gaiaa dhiaan ||2||
english: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, you have forgotten to meditate. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa dhan joban siu chit ||
english: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your consciousness is focused on wealth and youth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹੀ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਧਾ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam na chetahee vanajaariaa mitraa badhaa chhutahi jit ||
english: You have not remembered the Name of the Lord, O my merchant friend, although it would release you from bondage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਬਿਕਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam na chetai praanee bikal bhaiaa sa(n)g maaiaa ||
english: You do not remember the Name of the Lord, and you become confused by Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਰਤਾ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮਤਾ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhan siu rataa joban mataa ahilaa janam gavaaiaa ||
english: Revelling in your riches and intoxicated with youth, you waste your life uselessly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਕੀਤੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਤੋ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: dharam setee vaapaar na keeto karam na keeto mit ||
english: You have not traded in righteousness and Dharma; you have not made good deeds your friends.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak teejai paharai praanee dhan joban siu chit ||3||
english: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, your mind is attached to wealth and youth. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਲਾਵੀ ਆਇਆ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa laavee aaiaa khet ||
english: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Grim Reaper comes to the field.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa jam pakaR chalaaiaa vanajaariaa mitraa kisai na miliaa bhet ||
english: When the Messenger of Death seizes and dispatches you, O my merchant friend, no one knows the mystery of where you have gone.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੇਤੁ ਚੇਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜਾ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhet chet har kisai na milio jaa jam pakaR chalaaiaa ||
english: So think of the Lord! No one knows this secret, of when the Messenger of Death will seize you and take you away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਰੁਦਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਦੋੁਆਲੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jhoothaa rudan hoaa douaalai khin mahi bhaiaa paraaiaa ||
english: All your weeping and wailing then is false. In an instant, you become a stranger.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇਆ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: saaee vasat paraapat hoee jis siu laaiaa het ||
english: You obtain exactly what you have longed for.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਲਾਵੀ ਲੁਣਿਆ ਖੇਤੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai laavee luniaa khet ||4||1||
english: Says Nanak, in the fourth watch of the night, O mortal, the Grim Reaper has harvested your field. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਾਲਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਚੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa baalak budh achet ||
english: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your innocent mind has a child-like understanding.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੀਰੁ ਪੀਐ ਖੇਲਾਈਐ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kheer peeai khelaaeeai vanajaariaa mitraa maat pitaa sut het ||
english: You drink milk, and you are fondled so gently, O my merchant friend.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਨੇਹੁ ਘਨੇਰਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa sut nehu ghaneraa maaiaa mohu sabaaee ||
english: The mother and father love their child so much, but in Maya, all are caught in emotional attachment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)jogee aaiaa kirat kamaaiaa karanee kaar karaaee ||
english: By the good fortune of good deeds done in the past, you have come, and now you perform actions to determine your future.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਬੂਡੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ॥
transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na hoee boodee doojai het ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not obtained, and you are drowned in the love of duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਛੂਟਹਿਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai chhootahigaa har chet ||1||
english: Says Nanak, in the first watch of the night, O mortal, you shall be saved by remembering the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮੈ ਮਤਿ ॥
transliteration: doojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa bhar joban mai mat ||
english: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you are intoxicated with the wine of youth and beauty.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ahinis kaam viaapiaa vanajaariaa mitraa a(n)dhule naam na chit ||
english: Day and night, you are engrossed in sexual desire, O my merchant friend, and your consciousness is blind to the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਮੀਠੇ ॥
transliteration: raam naam ghat a(n)tar naahee hor jaanai ras kas meethe ||
english: The Lord's Name is not within your heart, but all sorts of other tastes seem sweet to you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹੁਗੇ ਝੂਠੇ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan gun sa(n)jam naahee janam marahuge jhoothe ||
english: You have no wisdom at all, no meditation, no virtue or self-discipline; in falsehood, you are caught in the cycle of birth and death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: teerath varat such sa(n)jam naahee karam dharam nahee poojaa ||
english: Pilgrimages, fasts, purification and self-discipline are of no use, nor are rituals, religious ceremonies or empty worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak bhaai bhagat nisataaraa dubidhaa viaapai doojaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, emancipation comes only by loving devotional worship; through duality, people are engrossed in duality. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਰਿ ਹੰਸ ਉਲਥੜੇ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa sar ha(n)s ulathaRe aai ||
english: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the swans, the white hairs, come and land upon the pool of the head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਘਟੈ ਜਰੂਆ ਜਿਣੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: joban ghatai jarooaa jinai vanajaariaa mitraa aav ghatai din jaai ||
english: Youth wears itself out, and old age triumphs, O my merchant friend; as time passes, your days diminish.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਸੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਜਾ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal pachhutaasee a(n)dhule jaa jam pakaR chalaaiaa ||
english: At the last moment, you repent-you are so blind!-when the Messenger of Death seizes you and carries you away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh apunaa kar kar raakhiaa khin mahi bhaiaa paraaiaa ||
english: You kept all your things for yourself, but in an instant, they are all lost.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੁਧਿ ਵਿਸਰਜੀ ਗਈ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: budh visarajee gaee siaanap kar avagan pachhutaai ||
english: Your intellect left you, your wisdom departed, and now you repent for the evil deeds you committed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak praanee teejai paharai prabh chetahu liv laai ||3||
english: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the third watch of the night, let your consciousness be lovingly focused on God. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ॥
transliteration: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa biradh bhaiaa tan kheen ||
english: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your body grows old and weak.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਦੀਸਈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਣੈ ਨ ਵੈਣ ॥
transliteration: akhee a(n)dh na deesaee vanajaariaa mitraa ka(n)nee sunai na vain ||
english: Your eyes go blind, and cannot see, O my merchant friend, and your ears do not hear any words.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਜੀਭ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਹੇ ਪਰਾਕਉ ਤਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: akhee a(n)dh jeebh ras naahee rahe paraakau taanaa ||
english: Your eyes go blind, and your tongue is unable to taste; you live only with the help of others.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gun a(n)tar naahee kiu sukh paavai manamukh aavan jaanaa ||
english: With no virtue within, how can you find peace? The self-willed manmukh comes and goes in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੜੁ ਪਕੀ ਕੁੜਿ ਭਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਆਇ ਚਲੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: khaR pakee kuR bhajai binasai aai chalai kiaa maan ||
english: When the crop of life has matured, it bends, breaks and perishes; why take pride in that which comes and goes?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai guramukh sabad pachhaan ||4||
english: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, the Gurmukh recognizes the Word of the Shabad. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓੜਕੁ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਹਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਜਰੁ ਜਰਵਾਣਾ ਕੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: oRak aaiaa tin saahiaa vanajaariaa mitraa jar jaravaanaa ka(n)n ||
english: Your breath comes to its end, O my merchant friend, and your shoulders are weighed down by the tyrant of old age.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਅਵਗਣ ਖੜਸਨਿ ਬੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: ik ratee gun na samaaniaa vanajaariaa mitraa avagan khaRasan ba(n)n ||
english: Not one iota of virtue came into you, O my merchant friend; bound and gagged by evil, you are driven along.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਵੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gun sa(n)jam jaavai chot na khaavai naa tis ja(n)man maranaa ||
english: One who departs with virtue and self-discipline is not struck down, and is not consigned to the cycle of birth and death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kaal jaal jam johi na saakai bhaai bhagat bhai taranaa ||
english: The Messenger of Death and his trap cannot touch him; through loving devotional worship, he crosses over the ocean of fear.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: pat setee jaavai sahaj samaavai sagale dookh mitaavai ||
english: He departs with honor, and merges in intuitive peace and poise; all his pains depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak praanee guramukh chhootai saache te pat paavai ||5||2||
english: Says Nanak, when the mortal becomes Gurmukh, he is saved and honored by the True Lord. ||5||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਉਦਰ ਮੰਝਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa har paaiaa udar ma(n)jhaar ||
english: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord places you in the womb.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har dhiaavai har ucharai vanajaariaa mitraa har har naam samaar ||
english: You meditate on the Lord, and chant the Lord's Name, O my merchant friend. You contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har har naam jape aaraadhe vich aganee har jap jeeviaa ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and meditating on it within the fire of the womb, your life is sustained by dwelling on the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਰਸੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤ ਥੀਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: baahar janam bhaiaa mukh laagaa sarase pitaa maat theeviaa ||
english: You are born and you come out, and your mother and father are delighted to see your face.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jis kee vasat tis chetahu praanee kar hiradai guramukh beechaar ||
english: Remember the One, O mortal, to whom the child belongs. As Gurmukh, reflect upon Him within your heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai har japeeai kirapaa dhaar ||1||
english: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the first watch of the night, dwell upon the Lord, who shall shower you with His Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa man laagaa doojai bhaai ||
english: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the mind is attached to the love of duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਲੀਐ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਲੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: meraa meraa kar paaleeai vanajaariaa mitraa le maat pitaa gal laai ||
english: Mother and father hug you close in their embrace, claiming, "He is mine, he is mine"; so is the child brought up, O my merchant friend.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਗਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਖਟਿ ਖਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: laavai maat pitaa sadaa gal setee man jaanai khat khavaae ||
english: Your mother and father constantly hug you close in their embrace; in their minds, they believe that you will provide for them and support them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੂੜਾ ਦਿਤੇ ਨੋ ਲਪਟਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jo devai tisai na jaanai mooRaa dite no lapataae ||
english: The fool does not know the One who gives; instead, he clings to the gift.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: koee guramukh hovai s karai veechaar har dhiaavai man liv laai ||
english: Rare is the Gurmukh who reflects upon, meditates upon, and within his mind, is lovingly attached to the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak doojai paharai praanee tis kaal na kabahoo(n) khaai ||2||
english: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, O mortal, death never devours you. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਾ ਆਲਿ ਜੰਜਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa man lagaa aal ja(n)jaal ||
english: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your mind is entangled in worldly and household affairs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਵੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: dhan chitavai dhan sa(n)chavai vanajaariaa mitraa har naamaa har na samaal ||
english: You think of wealth, and gather wealth, O my merchant friend, but you do not contemplate the Lord or the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਜਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har naamaa har har kade na samaalai j hovai a(n)t sakhaaee ||
english: You never dwell upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, who will be your only Helper and Support in the end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਝੂਠੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ihu dhan sa(n)pai maaiaa jhoothee a(n)t chhod chaliaa pachhutaaee ||
english: This wealth, property and Maya are false. In the end, you must leave these, and depart in sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jis no kirapaa kare gur mele so har har naam samaal ||
english: Those whom the Lord, in His Mercy, unites with the Guru, reflect upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸੇ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak teejai paharai praanee se jaai mile har naal ||3||
english: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, O mortal, they go, and are united with the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਲਣ ਵੇਲਾ ਆਦੀ ॥
transliteration: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa har chalan velaa aadee ||
english: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord announces the time of departure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਭ ਚਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਦੀ ॥
transliteration: kar sevahu pooraa satiguroo vanajaariaa mitraa sabh chalee rain vihaadee ||
english: Serve the Perfect True Guru, O my merchant friend; your entire life-night is passing away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਢਿਲ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਕਰਿਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਹੋਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: har sevahu khin khin dhil mool na karihu jit asathir jug jug hovahu ||
english: Serve the Lord each and every instant-do not delay! You shall become eternal throughout the ages.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦ ਮਾਣਹੁ ਰਲੀਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਖੋਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: har setee sad maanahu raleeaa janam maran dukh khovahu ||
english: Enjoy ecstasy forever with the Lord, and do away with the pains of birth and death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਖਾਂਦੀ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur suaamee bhed na jaanahu jit mil har bhagat sukhaa(n)dee ||
english: Know that there is no difference between the Guru, the True Guru, and your Lord and Master. Meeting with Him, take pleasure in the Lord's devotional service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਸਫਲਿਓੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਦੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai saphaliou rain bhagataa dee ||4||1||3||
english: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, the life-night of the devotee is fruitful. ||4||1||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਧਰਿ ਪਾਇਤਾ ਉਦਰੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa dhar paaitaa udarai maahi ||
english: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord placed your soul in the womb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸੀ ਮਾਸੀ ਮਾਨਸੁ ਕੀਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: dasee maasee maanas keeaa vanajaariaa mitraa kar muhalat karam kamaahi ||
english: In the tenth month, you were made into a human being, O my merchant friend, and you were given your allotted time to perform good deeds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: muhalat kar deenee karam kamaane jaisaa likhat dhur paaiaa ||
english: You were given this time to perform good deeds, according to your pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਤਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੰਜੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut banitaa tin bheetar prabhoo sa(n)joiaa ||
english: God placed you with your mother, father, brothers, sons and wife.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਇਸੁ ਜੰਤੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: karam sukaram karaae aape is ja(n)tai vas kichh naahi ||
english: God Himself is the Cause of causes, good and bad-no one has control over these things.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਧਰਿ ਪਾਇਤਾ ਉਦਰੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai dhar paaitaa udarai maahi ||1||
english: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the first watch of the night, the soul is placed in the womb. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਭਰਿ ਜੁਆਨੀ ਲਹਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: doojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa bhar juaanee laharee dei ||
english: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the fullness of youth rises in you like waves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਾ ਅਹੰਮੇਇ ॥
transliteration: buraa bhalaa na pachhaanaee vanajaariaa mitraa man mataa aha(n)mei ||
english: You do not distinguish between good and evil, O my merchant friend-your mind is intoxicated with ego.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਆਗੈ ਪੰਥੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: buraa bhalaa na pachhaanai praanee aagai pa(n)th karaaraa ||
english: Mortal beings do not distinguish between good and evil, and the road ahead is treacherous.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pooraa satigur kabahoo(n) na seviaa sir thaadhe jam ja(n)daaraa ||
english: They never serve the Perfect True Guru, and the cruel tyrant Death stands over their heads.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਬ ਪਕਰਸਿ ਬਵਰੇ ਤਬ ਕਿਆ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: dharam raai jab pakaras bavare tab kiaa jabaab karei ||
english: When the Righteous Judge seizes you and interrogates you, O madman, what answer will you give him then?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak doojai paharai praanee bhar joban laharee dei ||2||
english: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, O mortal, the fullness of youth tosses you about like waves in the storm. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa bikh sa(n)chai a(n)dh agiaan ||
english: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the blind and ignorant person gathers poison.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰਿ ਕਲਤ੍ਰਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਲੋਭਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr mohi lapatiaa vanajaariaa mitraa a(n)tar lahar lobhaan ||
english: He is entangled in emotional attachment to his wife and sons, O my merchant friend, and deep within him, the waves of greed are rising up.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਲੋਭਾਨੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar lahar lobhaan paraanee so prabh chit na aavai ||
english: The waves of greed are rising up within him, and he does not remember God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਆ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat siu sa(n)g na keeaa bahu jonee dukh paavai ||
english: He does not join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and he suffers in terrible pain through countless incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sirajanahaar visaariaa suaamee ik nimakh na lago dhiaan ||
english: He has forgotten the Creator, his Lord and Master, and he does not meditate on Him, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੇ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak praanee teejai paharai bikh sa(n)che a(n)dh agiaan ||3||
english: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, the blind and ignorant person gathers poison. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa din neRai aaiaa soi ||
english: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, that day is drawing near.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam samaal too(n) vanajaariaa mitraa teraa daragah belee hoi ||
english: As Gurmukh, remember the Naam, O my merchant friend. It shall be your Friend in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਣੀ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam samaal paraanee a(n)te hoi sakhaaee ||
english: As Gurmukh, remember the Naam, O mortal; in the end, it shall be your only companion.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਝੂਠੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ihu mohu maaiaa terai sa(n)g na chaalai jhoothee preet lagaaee ||
english: This emotional attachment to Maya shall not go with you; it is false to fall in love with it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਗੁਦਰੀ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sagalee rain gudaree a(n)dhiaaree sev satigur chaanan hoi ||
english: The entire night of your life has passed away in darkness; but by serving the True Guru, the Divine Light shall dawn within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai din neRai aaiaa soi ||4||
english: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, that day is drawing near! ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੇ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: likhiaa aaiaa govi(n)d kaa vanajaariaa mitraa uth chale kamaanaa saath ||
english: Receiving the summons from the Lord of the Universe, O my merchant friend, you must arise and depart with the actions you have committed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਦੇਵਨੀ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਓਨੀ ਤਕੜੇ ਪਾਏ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: ik ratee bilam na devanee vanajaariaa mitraa onee takaRe paae haath ||
english: You are not allowed a moment's delay, O my merchant friend; the Messenger of Death seizes you with firm hands.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: likhiaa aaiaa pakaR chalaaiaa manamukh sadaa duhele ||
english: Receiving the summons, people are seized and dispatched. The self-willed manmukhs are miserable forever.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jinee pooraa satigur seviaa se daragah sadaa suhele ||
english: But those who serve the Perfect True Guru are forever happy in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋ ਬੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਖਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: karam dharatee sareer jug a(n)tar jo bovai so khaat ||
english: The body is the field of karma in this age; whatever you plant, you shall harvest.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਵਾਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਤਿ ॥੫॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bhagat sohahi daravaare manamukh sadaa bhavaat ||5||1||4||
english: Says Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in the Court of the Lord; the self-willed manmukhs wander forever in reincarnation. ||5||1||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 ghar 2 chha(n)t ||
english: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, Second House, Chhant:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਿਖੈ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dh iaanee peeeaRai kiu kar har darasan pikhai ||
english: How can the ignorant soul-bride obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, while she is in this world of her father's home?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕੰਮ ਸਿਖੈ ॥
transliteration: har har apanee kirapaa kare guramukh saahuraRai ka(n)m sikhai ||
english: When the Lord Himself grants His Grace, the Gurmukh learns the duties of her Husband's Celestial Home.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕੰਮ ਸਿਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: saahuraRai ka(n)m sikhai guramukh har har sadaa dhiaae ||
english: The Gurmukh learns the duties of her Husband's Celestial Home; she meditates forever on the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saheeaa vich phirai suhelee har daragah baah ludaae ||
english: She walks happily among her companions, and in the Lord's Court, she swings her arms joyfully.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਰਖੈ ॥
transliteration: lekhaa dharam raai kee baakee jap har har naam kirakhai ||
english: Her account is cleared by the Righteous Judge of Dharma, when she chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦਿਖੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mu(n)dh iaanee peeeaRai guramukh har darasan dikhai ||1||
english: The ignorant soul-bride becomes Gurmukh, and gains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, while she is still in her father's house. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵੀਆਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: veeaahu hoaa mere baabulaa guramukhe har paaiaa ||
english: My marriage has been performed, O my father. As Gurmukh, I have found the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: agiaan a(n)dheraa katiaa gur giaan pracha(n)d balaaiaa ||
english: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled. The Guru has revealed the blazing light of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: baliaa gur giaan a(n)dheraa binasiaa har ratan padaarath laadhaa ||
english: This spiritual wisdom given by the Guru shines forth, and the darkness has been dispelled. I have found the Priceless Jewel of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ ਆਪੁ ਆਪੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai rog gaiaa dukh laathaa aap aapai guramat khaadhaa ||
english: The sickness of my ego has been dispelled, and my pain is over and done. Through the Guru's Teachings, my identity has consumed my identical identity.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: akaal moorat var paaiaa abinaasee naa kade marai na jaaiaa ||
english: I have obtained my Husband Lord, the Akaal Moorat, the Undying Form. He is Imperishable; He shall never die, and He shall never ever leave.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵੀਆਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: veeaahu hoaa mere baabolaa guramukhe har paaiaa ||2||
english: My marriage has been performed, O my father. As Gurmukh, I have found the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੰਞ ਸੁਹੰਦੀ ॥
transliteration: har sat sate mere baabulaa har jan mil ja(n)nj suha(n)dee ||
english: The Lord is the Truest of the True, O my father. Meeting with the humble servants of the Lord, the marriage procession looks beautiful.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਖਰੀ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ ॥
transliteration: pevakaRai har jap suhelee vich saahuraRai kharee soha(n)dee ||
english: She who chants the Lord's Name is happy in this world of her father's home, and in the next world of her Husband Lord, she shall be very beautiful.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਰੀ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saahuraRai vich kharee soha(n)dee jin pevakaRai naam samaaliaa ||
english: In her Husband Lord's Celestial Home, she shall be most beautiful, if she has remembered the Naam in this world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh saphalio janam tinaa daa guramukh jinaa man jin paasaa dhaaliaa ||
english: Fruitful are the lives of those who, as Gurmukh, have conquered their minds-they have won the game of life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਨੰਦੀ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)t janaa mil kaaraj sohiaa var paaiaa purakh ana(n)dee ||
english: Joining with the humble Saints of the Lord, my actions bring prosperity, and I have obtained the Lord of Bliss as my Husband.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੰਞ ਸੋੁਹੰਦੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har sat sat mere baabolaa har jan mil ja(n)nj souha(n)dee ||3||
english: The Lord is the Truest of the True, O my father. Joining with the humble servants of the Lord, the marriage party has been embellished. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੈ ਦਾਜੋ ॥
transliteration: har prabh mere baabulaa har devahu daan mai daajo ||
english: O my father, give me the Name of the Lord God as my wedding gift and dowry.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਪੜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਵਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਾਜੋ ॥
transliteration: har kapaRo har sobhaa devahu jit savarai meraa kaajo ||
english: Give me the Lord as my wedding gown, and the Lord as my glory, to accomplish my works.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਾਜੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har har bhagatee kaaj suhelaa gur satigur daan divaaiaa ||
english: Through devotional worship to the Lord, this ceremony is made blissful and beautiful; the Guru, the True Guru, has given this gift.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡਿ ਵਰਭੰਡਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਈ ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਰਲੈ ਰਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)d varabha(n)d har sobhaa hoee ihu daan na ralai ralaaiaa ||
english: Across the continents, and throughout the Universe, the Lord's Glory is pervading. This gift is not diminished by being diffused among all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਾਜੁ ਜਿ ਰਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਹਿ ਸੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਚੁ ਪਾਜੋ ॥
transliteration: hor manamukh daaj j rakh dikhaalahi s kooR aha(n)kaar kach paajo ||
english: Any other dowry, which the self-willed manmukhs offer for show, is only false egotism and a worthless display.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੈ ਦਾਜੋ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har prabh mere baabulaa har devahu daan mai daajo ||4||
english: O my father, please give me the Name of the Lord God as my wedding gift and dowry. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ ਪਿਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਨ ਵੇਲ ਵਧੰਦੀ ॥
transliteration: har raam raam mere baabolaa pir mil dhan vel vadha(n)dee ||
english: The Lord, Raam, Raam, is All-pervading, O my father. Meeting her Husband Lord, the soul-bride blossoms forth like the flourishing vine.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੋ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੋ ਸਦ ਪੀੜੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਚਲੰਦੀ ॥
transliteration: har jugah jugo jug jugah jugo sad peeRee guroo chala(n)dee ||
english: In age after age, through all the ages, forever and ever, those who belong to the Guru's Family shall prosper and increase.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਪੀੜੀ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jug jug peeRee chalai satigur kee jinee guramukh naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: Age after age, the Family of the True Guru shall increase. As Gurmukh, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har purakh na kab hee binasai jaavai nit devai chaRai savaaiaa ||
english: The Almighty Lord never dies or goes away. Whatever He gives, keeps on increasing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)t sa(n)t har eko jap har har naam soha(n)dee ||
english: O Nanak, the One Lord is the Saint of Saints. Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the soul-bride is bountiful and beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਪਿਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਨ ਵੇਲ ਵਧੰਦੀ ॥੫॥੧॥
transliteration: har raam raam mere baabulaa pir mil dhan vel vadha(n)dee ||5||1||
english: The Lord, Raam, Raam, is All-pervading, O my father. Meeting her Husband Lord, the soul-bride blossoms forth like the flourishing vine. ||5||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ||
english: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: man piaariaa jeeu mitraa gobi(n)d naam samaale ||
english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, reflect upon the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: man piaariaa jee mitraa har nibahai terai naale ||
english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the Lord shall always be with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g sahaaee har naam dhiaaee birathaa koi na jaae ||
english: The Name of the Lord shall be with you as your Helper and Support. Meditate on Him-no one who does so shall ever return empty-handed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: man chi(n)de seee phal paavahi charan kamal chit laae ||
english: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires, by focusing your consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jal thal poor rahiaa banavaaree ghat ghat nadar nihaale ||
english: He is totally pervading the water and the land; He is the Lord of the World-forest. Behold Him in exaltation in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sikh dei man preetam saadhasa(n)g bhram jaale ||1||
english: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, in the Company of the Holy, burn away your doubts. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man piaariaa jee mitraa har bin jhooth pasaare ||
english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, without the Lord, all outward show is false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man piaariaa jeeu mitraa bikh saagar sa(n)saare ||
english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the world is an ocean of poison.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal kar bohith karate sahasaa dookh na biaapai ||
english: Let the Lord's Lotus Feet be your Boat, so that pain and skepticism shall not touch you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa bhetai vadabhaagee aath pahar prabh jaapai ||
english: Meeting with the Perfect Guru, by great good fortune, meditate on God twenty-four hours a day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aad jugaadee sevak suaamee bhagataa naam adhaare ||
english: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the Lord and Master of His servants. His Name is the Support of His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਝੂਠ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sikh dei man preetam bin har jhooth pasaare ||2||
english: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, without the Lord, all outward show is false. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਦੇ ਖੇਪ ਸਵਲੀ ॥
transliteration: man piaariaa jeeu mitraa har lade khep savalee ||
english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, load the profitable cargo of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਮਲੀ ॥
transliteration: man piaariaa jeeu mitraa har dar nihachal malee ||
english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, enter through the eternal Door of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵੇ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਆਸਣੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har dar seve alakh abheve nihachal aasan paaiaa ||
english: One who serves at the Door of the Imperceptible and Unfathomable Lord, obtains this eternal position.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tah janam na maran na aavan jaanaa sa(n)saa dookh mitaaiaa ||
english: There is no birth or death there, no coming or going; anguish and anxiety are ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤ ਕਾ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਫਾਰਿਆ ਜਮਦੂਤਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚਲੀ ॥
transliteration: chitr gupat kaa kaagad phaariaa jamadootaa kachhoo na chalee ||
english: The accounts of Chitr and Gupt, the recording scribes of the conscious and the subconscious are torn up, and the Messenger of Death cannot do anything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਲਦੇ ਖੇਪ ਸਵਲੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak sikh dei man preetam har lade khep savalee ||3||
english: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, load the profitable cargo of the Lord's Name. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੋ ॥
transliteration: man piaariaa jeeu mitraa kar sa(n)taa sa(n)g nivaaso ||
english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, abide in the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪਰਗਾਸੋ ॥
transliteration: man piaariaa jeeu mitraa har naam japat paragaaso ||
english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, chanting the Lord's Name, the Divine Light shines within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਇਛ ਸਗਲੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
transliteration: simar suaamee sukhah gaamee ichh sagalee pu(n)neeaa ||
english: Remember your Lord and Master, who is easily obtained, and all desires shall be fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਬੇ ਕਮਾਏ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: purabe kamaae sreera(n)g paae har mile chiree vichhu(n)niaa ||
english: By my past actions, I have found the Lord, the Greatest Lover. Separated from Him for so long, I am united with Him again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਰਬਤਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਬਿਸੁਆਸੋ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar sarabat raviaa man upajiaa bisuaaso ||
english: Inside and out, He is pervading everywhere. Faith in Him has welled up within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੋ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak sikh dei man preetam kar sa(n)taa sa(n)g nivaaso ||4||
english: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, let the Society of the Saints be your dwelling. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man piaariaa jeeu mitraa har prem bhagat man leenaa ||
english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, let your mind remain absorbed in loving devotion to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੀਵੇ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man piaariaa jeeu mitraa har jal mil jeeve meenaa ||
english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the fish of the mind lives only when it is immersed in the Water of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੀ ਆਘਾਨੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੇ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮਨ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
transliteration: har pee aaghaane a(n)mrit baane srab sukhaa man vuthe ||
english: Drinking in the Lord's Ambrosial Bani, the mind is satisfied, and all pleasures come to abide within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਪਾਏ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੇ ॥
transliteration: sreedhar paae ma(n)gal gaae ichh pu(n)nee satigur tuthe ||
english: Attaining the Lord of Excellence, I sing the Songs of Joy. The True Guru, becoming merciful, has fulfilled my desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੜਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਲਾਏ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਉ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: laR leene laae nau nidh paae naau sarabas thaakur deenaa ||
english: He has attached me to the hem of His robe, and I have obtained the nine treasures. My Lord and Master has bestowed His Name, which is everything to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਸਮਝਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੫॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sikh sa(n)t samajhaaee har prem bhagat man leenaa ||5||1||2||
english: Nanak instructs the Saints to teach, that the mind is imbued with loving devotion to the Lord. ||5||1||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗ ਕੇ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag ke chha(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Chhants Of Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
transliteration: dakhanaa ||
english: Dakhanaa:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਠ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਦੀਦਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hath majhaahoo maa piree pase kiu deedaar ||
english: My Beloved Husband Lord is deep within my heart. How can I see Him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਲਭਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t saranaaee labhane naanak praan adhaar ||1||
english: In the Sanctuary of the Saints, O Nanak, the Support of the breath of life is found. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਮਨਿ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu preet reet sa(n)tan man aavae jeeu ||
english: To love the Lotus Feet of the Lord-this way of life has come into the minds of His Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ਅਨੀਤਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਨਹ ਭਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: duteeaa bhaau bipareet aneet daasaa nah bhaavae jeeu ||
english: The love of duality, this evil practice, this bad habit, is not liked by the Lord's slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਾ ਨਹ ਭਾਵਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਾਵਏ ਇਕ ਖਿਨੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: daasaa nah bhaavae bin darasaavae ik khin dheeraj kiu karai ||
english: It is not pleasing to the Lord's slaves; without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, how can they find peace, even for a moment?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੀਨਾ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਜਿਉ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: naam bihoonaa tan man heenaa jal bin machhulee jiu marai ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the body and mind are empty; like fish out of water, they die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: mil mere piaare praan adhaare gun saadhasa(n)g mil gaavae ||
english: Please meet with me, O my Beloved-You are the Support of my breath of life. Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ke suaamee dhaar anugrahu man tan a(n)k samaavae ||1||
english: O Lord and Master of Nanak, please grant Your Grace, and permeate my body, mind and being. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
transliteration: dakhanaa ||
english: Dakhanaa:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹੰਦੜੋ ਹਭ ਠਾਇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਡੂਜੜੋ ॥
transliteration: soha(n)daRo habh thaai koi na disai doojaRo ||
english: He is Beautiful in all places; I do not see any other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੁਲੑੜੇ ਕਪਾਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khulhRe kapaat naanak satigur bhetate ||1||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, O Nanak, the doors are opened wide. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਪਾਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਆਧਾਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tere bachan anoop apaar sa(n)tan aadhaar baanee beechaareeai jeeu ||
english: Your Word is Incomparable and Infinite. I contemplate the Word of Your Bani, the Support of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਸੁਆਸ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: simarat saas giraas pooran bisuaas kiu manahu bisaareeai jeeu ||
english: I remember Him in meditation with every breath and morsel of food, with perfect faith. How could I forget Him from my mind?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬੇਸਾਰੀਐ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਟਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਣਵੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kiu manahu besaareeai nimakh nahee taareeai gunava(n)t praan hamaare ||
english: How could I forget Him from my mind, even for an instant? He is the Most Worthy; He is my very life!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man baa(n)chhat phal det hai suaamee jee kee birathaa saare ||
english: My Lord and Master is the Giver of the fruits of the mind's desires. He knows all the useless vanities and pains of the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਕੇ ਨਾਥੇ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੇ ਜਪਿ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: anaath ke naathe srab kai saathe jap jooai janam na haareeai ||
english: Meditating on the Patron of lost souls, the Companion of all, your life shall not be lost in the gamble.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)tee prabh pahi kripaa kar bhavajal taareeai ||2||
english: Nanak offers this prayer to God: Please shower me with Your Mercy, and carry me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
transliteration: dakhanaa ||
english: Dakhanaa:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੂੜੀ ਮਜਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਖੇ ਸਾਈ ਥੀਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: dhooRee majan saadh khe saaee theee kripaal ||
english: People bathe in the dust of the feet of the Saints, when the Lord becomes merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਧੇ ਹਭੇ ਥੋਕੜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲ ॥੧॥
