transliteration: ladhe habhe thokaRe naanak har dhan maal ||1||
english: I have obtained all things, O Nanak; the Lord is my Wealth and Property. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਧਾਮ ਭਗਤਹ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਆਸਾ ਲਗਿ ਜੀਵਤੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar suaamee dhaam bhagatah bisraam aasaa lag jeevate jeeu ||
english: My Lord and Master's Home is beautiful. It is the resting place of His devotees, who live in hopes of attaining it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨੇ ਗਲਤਾਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਤੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: man tane galataan simarat prabh naam har a(n)mrit peevate jeeu ||
english: Their minds and bodies are absorbed in meditation on the Name of God; they drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੀਵਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਵਤੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit har peevate sadaa thir theevate bikhai ban pheekaa jaaniaa ||
english: They drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, and become eternally stable. They know that the water of corruption is insipid and tasteless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bhae kirapaal gopaal prabh mere saadhasa(n)gat nidh maaniaa ||
english: When my God, the Lord of the Universe became merciful, I came to look upon the Saadh Sangat as the treasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬਸੋ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੀਵਤੇ ॥
transliteration: sarabaso sookh aana(n)d ghan piaare har ratan man a(n)tar seevate ||
english: All pleasures and supreme ecstasy, O my Beloved, come to those who sew the Jewel of the Lord into their minds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ik til nahee visarai praan aadhaaraa jap jap naanak jeevate ||3||
english: They do not forget, even for an instant, the Support of the breath of life. They live by constantly meditating on Him, O Nanak. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
transliteration: dakhanaa ||
english: Dakhanaa:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਕੀਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੂੰ ਮਿਲਿਓਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jo tau keene aapane tinaa koo(n) miliohi ||
english: O Lord, You meet and merge with those whom you have made Your Own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਮੋਹਿਓਹੁ ਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣਿਓਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape hee aap mohiohu jas naanak aap suniohi ||1||
english: You Yourself are entranced, O Nanak, hearing Your Own Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਰੀਝਾਇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: prem thagauree paai reejhaai gobi(n)d man mohiaa jeeu ||
english: Administering the intoxicating drug of love, I have won over the Lord of the Universe; I have fascinated His Mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕੰਠੇ ਲਗਿ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kai parasaad agaadh ka(n)the lag sohiaa jeeu ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, I am held in the loving embrace of the Unfathomable Lord, and I am entranced.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਿ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਖੵਣ ਕਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: har ka(n)th lag sohiaa dokh sabh johiaa bhagat lakhyn kar vas bhae ||
english: Held in the Lord's loving embrace, I look beautiful, and all my pains have been dispelled. By the loving worship of His devotees, the Lord has come under their power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਵੁਠੇ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਤੁਠੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ॥
transliteration: man sarab sukh vuthe govid tuthe janam maranaa sabh mit gae ||
english: All pleasures have come to dwell in the mind; the Lord of the Universe is pleased and appeased. Birth and death have been totally eliminated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਮੰਗਲੋ ਗਾਇਆ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਇਆ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਹੋਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sakhee ma(n)galo gaaiaa ichh pujaaiaa bahuR na maaiaa hohiaa ||
english: O my companions, sing the Songs of Joy. My desires have been fulfilled, and I shall never again be trapped or shaken by Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੋਹਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kar gahi leene naanak prabh piaare sa(n)saar saagar nahee pohiaa ||4||
english: Taking hold of my hand, O Nanak, my Beloved God will not let me be swallowed up by the world-ocean. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
transliteration: dakhanaa ||
english: Dakhanaa:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਦੋ ॥
transliteration: saaee naam amol keem na koee jaanado ||
english: The Master's Name is Priceless; no one knows its value.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਹਿ ਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਦੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jinaa bhaag mathaahi se naanak har ra(n)g maanado ||1||
english: Those who have good destiny recorded upon their foreheads, O Nanak, enjoy the Love of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੇ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਣਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਧੰਨੁ ਲਿਖਤਂੀ ਕੁਲੁ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kahate pavitr sunate sabh dha(n)n likhata(n)ee kul taariaa jeeu ||
english: Those who chant are sanctified. All those who listen are blessed, and those who write save their ancestors.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jin kau saadhoo sa(n)g naam har ra(n)g tinee braham beechaariaa jeeu ||
english: Those who join the Saadh Sangat are imbued with the Lord's Love; they reflect and meditate on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: braham beechaariaa janam savaariaa pooran kirapaa prabh karee ||
english: Contemplating God, their lives are reformed and redeemed; God has showered His Perfect Mercy upon them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੋ ਦੀਨੇ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਾ ਧਾਵੈ ਨਹ ਮਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kar gahi leene har jaso deene jon naa dhaavai nah maree ||
english: Taking them by the hand, the Lord has blessed them with His Praises. They no longer have to wander in reincarnation, and they never have to die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਰੇ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur daiaal kirapaal bhetat hare kaam krodh lobh maariaa ||
english: Through the Kind and Compassionate True Guru, I have met the Lord; I have conquered sexual desire, anger and greed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਕਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਕੈ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: kathan na jaai akath suaamee sadakai jaai naanak vaariaa ||5||1||3||
english: Our Indescribable Lord and Master cannot be described. Nanak is devoted, forever a sacrifice to Him. ||5||1||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 vanajaaraa ||
english: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, Vanajaaraa ~ The Merchant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har utam naam hai jin siriaa sabh koi jeeu ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Excellent and Sublime. He created everyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਅ ਸਭੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har jee sabhe pratipaaladaa ghat ghat ramaeeaa soi ||
english: The Lord cherishes all beings. He permeates each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: so har sadaa dhiaaeeai tis bin avar na koi ||
english: Meditate forever on that Lord. Without Him, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo mohi maaiaa chit laaide se chhod chale dukh roi ||
english: Those who focus their consciousness on emotional attachment to Maya must leave; they depart crying out in despair.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa har a(n)t sakhaaee hoi ||1||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, his only Companion in the end. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mai har bin avar na koi ||
english: I have none other than You, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har gur saranaaee paaeeai vanajaariaa mitraa vadabhaag paraapat hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the Guru's Sanctuary, the Lord is found, O my merchant friend; by great good fortune, He is obtained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa vin bhaaeeaa har kinai na paaiaa naau ||
english: Without the humble Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, no one has obtained the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਜਿਉ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਪੁਤੁ ਨਿਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vich haumai karam kamaavade jiu vesuaa put ninaau ||
english: Those who do their deeds in ego are like the prostitute's son, who has no name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਤਾ ਹੋਈਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pitaa jaat taa hoeeai gur tuthaa kare pasaau ||
english: The father's status is obtained only if the Guru is pleased and bestows His Favor.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee gur paaiaa har ahinis lagaa bhaau ||
english: By great good fortune, the Guru is found; embrace love for the Lord, day and night.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak braham pachhaaniaa har keerat karam kamaau ||2||
english: Servant Nanak has realized God; he sings the Lord's Praises through the actions he does. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man har har lagaa chaau ||
english: In my mind there is such a deep yearning for the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai naam driRaaiaa har miliaa har prabh naau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Naam within me; I have found the Lord through the Lord God's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jab lag joban saas hai tab lag naam dhiaai ||
english: As long as there is youth and health, meditate on the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਲਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chaladiaa naal har chalasee har a(n)te lae chhadaai ||
english: Along the way, the Lord shall go along with you, and in the end, He shall save you.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree tin kau jin har man vuthaa aai ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those, within whose minds the Lord has come to dwell.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jinee har har naam na chetio se a(n)t gae pachhutaai ||
english: Those who have not remembered the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, shall leave with regret in the end.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhur masatak har prabh likhiaa jan naanak naam dhiaai ||3||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads, O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man har har preet lagaai ||
english: O my mind, embrace love for the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee gur paaiaa gurasabadee paar laghaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By great good fortune, the Guru is found; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are carried across to the other side. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: har aape aap upaaidaa har aape devai lei ||
english: The Lord Himself creates, He Himself gives and takes away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: har aape bharam bhulaaidaa har aape hee mat dei ||
english: The Lord Himself leads us astray in doubt; the Lord Himself imparts understanding.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukhaa man paragaas hai se virale keee kei ||
english: The minds of the Gurmukhs are illuminated and enlightened; they are so very rare.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੇ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree tin kau jin har paaiaa guramate ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who find the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵੁਠੜਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak kamal paragaasiaa man har har vuthaRaa he ||4||
english: Servant Nanak's heart-lotus has blossomed forth, and the Lord, Har, Har, has come to dwell in the mind. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man har har japan kare ||
english: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ ਜਿੰਦੂ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har gur saranaaee bhaj pau ji(n)doo sabh kilavikh dukh parahare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Hurry to the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Guru, O my soul; all your sins shall be taken away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਤੁ ਭਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat ramaeeaa man vasai kiu paaeeai kit bhat ||
english: The All-pervading Lord dwells within each and every person's heart-how can He be obtained?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa satigur bheteeai har aai vasai man chit ||
english: By meeting the Perfect Guru, the True Guru, the Lord comes to dwell within the conscious mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ॥
transliteration: mai dhar naam adhaar hai har naamai te gat mat ||
english: The Naam is my Support and Sustenance. From the Lord's Name, I obtain salvation and understanding.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ॥
transliteration: mai har har naam visaahu hai har naame hee jat pat ||
english: My faith is in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The Lord's Name is my status and honor.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa ra(n)g rataRaa har ra(n)g rat ||5||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He is dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har dhiaavahu har prabh sat ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, the True Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸਭ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੇ ਉਤਪਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur bachanee har prabh jaaniaa sabh har prabh te utapat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Guru's Word, you shall come to know the Lord God. From the Lord God, everything was created. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa se aai mile gur paas ||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, come to the Guru and meet Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: sevak bhaai vanajaariaa mitraa gur har har naam pragaas ||
english: They love to serve, O my merchant friend, and through the Guru, they are illuminated by the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਣਜੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ ਜਿਨ ਵਖਰੁ ਲਦਿਅੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan vanaj vaapaareeaa jin vakhar ladiaRaa har raas ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the trade of those traders who have loaded the merchandise of the Wealth of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਦਰਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਸੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukhaa dar mukh ujale se aai mile har paas ||
english: The faces of the Gurmukhs are radiant in the Court of the Lord; they come to the Lord and merge with Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak gur tin paaiaa jinaa aap tuthaa gunataas ||6||
english: O servant Nanak, they alone find the Guru, with whom the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence, is pleased. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: har dhiaavahu saas giraas ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, with every breath and morsel of food.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man preet lagee tinaa guramukhaa har naam jinaa raharaas ||1|| rahaau ||1||
english: The Gurmukhs embrace the Love of the Lord in their minds; they are continually occupied with the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag kee vaar mahalaa 4 salokaa naal ||
english: Vaar Of Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, With Saloks:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raagaa vich sreeraag hai je sach dhare piaar ||
english: Among the ragas, Siree Raag is the best, if it inspires you to enshrine love for the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa har sach man vasai nihachal mat apaar ||
english: The True Lord comes to abide forever in the mind, and your understanding becomes steady and unequalled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ratan amolak paaiaa gur kaa sabad beechaar ||
english: The priceless jewel is obtained, by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਰੀਰ ਅਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa sachee man sachaa sachaa sareer akaar ||
english: The tongue becomes true, the mind becomes true, and the body becomes true as well.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sachai satigur seviai sadaa sach vaapaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, forever true are the dealings of those who serve the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਸਭ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: hor birahaa sabh dhaat hai jab lag saahib preet na hoi ||
english: All other loves are transitory, as long as people do not love their Lord and Master.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu man maaiaa mohiaa vekhan sunan na hoi ||
english: This mind is enticed by Maya-it cannot see or hear.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: sah dekhe bin preet na oopajai a(n)dhaa kiaa karei ||
english: Without seeing her Husband Lord, love does not well up; what can the blind person do?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਖੀ ਲੀਤੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਸਚਾ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jin akhee leeteeaa soee sachaa dei ||2||
english: O Nanak, the True One who takes away the eyes of spiritual wisdom-He alone can restore them. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har iko karataa ik iko deebaan har ||
english: The Lord alone is the One Creator; there is only the One Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਇਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har ikasai daa hai amar iko har chit dhar ||
english: The One Lord's Command is the One and Only-enshrine the One Lord in your consciousness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ਡਰੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har tis bin koee naahi dar bhram bhau door kar ||
english: Without that Lord, there is no other at all. Remove your fear, doubt and dread.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਖੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਘਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har tisai no saalaahi j tudh rakhai baahar ghar ||
english: Praise that Lord who protects you, inside your home, and outside as well.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਉ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har jis no hoi daiaal so har jap bhau bikham tar ||1||
english: When that Lord becomes merciful, and one comes to chant the Lord's Name, one swims across the ocean of fear. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਾਤੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੰਦੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: daatee saahib sa(n)deeaa kiaa chalai tis naal ||
english: The gifts belong to our Lord and Master; how can we compete with Him?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਜਾਗੰਦੇ ਨਾ ਲਹੰਨਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਉਠਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ik jaaga(n)de naa laha(n)n ikanaa sutiaa dei uthaal ||1||
english: Some remain awake and aware, and do not receive these gifts, while others are awakened from their sleep to be blessed. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਦਕੁ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਸਾਦਿਕਾ ਸਬਰੁ ਤੋਸਾ ਮਲਾਇਕਾਂ ॥
transliteration: sidak sabooree saadikaa sabar tosaa malaaikaa(n) ||
english: Faith, contentment and tolerance are the food and provisions of the angels.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਾਇਸਾ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਾਇਕਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: deedaar poore paaisaa thaau naahee khaaikaa ||2||
english: They obtain the Perfect Vision of the Lord, while those who gossip find no place of rest. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh aape tudh upaai kai aap kaarai laaee ||
english: You Yourself created all; You Yourself delegate the tasks.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਦਾ ਆਪਣੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape vekh vigasadaa aapanee vadiaaee ||
english: You Yourself are pleased, beholding Your Own Glorious Greatness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har tudhahu baahar kichh naahee too(n) sachaa saaee ||
english: O Lord, there is nothing at all beyond You. You are the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਹੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape aap varatadaa sabhanee hee thaaee ||
english: You Yourself are contained in all places.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਜੋ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har tisai dhiaavahu sa(n)t janahu jo lae chhadaaee ||2||
english: Meditate on that Lord, O Saints; He shall rescue and save you. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਫਕੜ ਜਾਤੀ ਫਕੜੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: phakaR jaatee phakaR naau ||
english: Pride in social status is empty; pride in personal glory is useless.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਇਕਾ ਛਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa jeeaa ikaa chhaau ||
english: The One Lord gives shade to all beings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹੁ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਭਲਾ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aapahu je ko bhalaa kahaae ||
english: You may call yourself good;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak taa par jaapai jaa pat lekhai paae ||1||
english: O Nanak, this will only be known when your honor is approved in God's Account. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਰਿ ਚਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jis piaare siu nehu tis aagai mar chaleeai ||
english: Die before the one whom you love;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਜੀਵਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhrig jeevan sa(n)saar taa kai paachhai jeevanaa ||2||
english: to live after he dies is to live a worthless life in this world. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਜੀਐ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਦੀਵੇ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape dharatee saajeeai cha(n)d sooraj dui deeve ||
english: You Yourself created the earth, and the two lamps of the sun and the moon.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਹਟ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਕਰੀਵੇ ॥
transliteration: das chaar hat tudh saajiaa vaapaar kareeve ||
english: You created the fourteen world-shops, in which Your Business is transacted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਦੇਇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਥੀਵੇ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa no har laabh dei jo guramukh theeve ||
english: The Lord bestows His Profits on those who become Gurmukh.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੇ ॥
transliteration: tin jamakaal na viaapaee jin sach a(n)mrit peeve ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not touch those who drink in the True Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟੇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਿਛੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛੁਟੀਵੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: oi aap chhute paravaar siu tin pichhai sabh jagat chhuteeve ||3||
english: They themselves are saved, along with their family, and all those who follow them are saved as well. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kudarat kar kai vasiaa soi ||
english: He created the Creative Power of the Universe, within which He dwells.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਖਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vakhat veechaare s ba(n)daa hoi ||
english: One who reflects upon his allotted span of life, becomes the slave of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kudarat hai keemat nahee paai ||
english: The value of the Creative Power of the Universe cannot be known.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਤ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa keemat paai ta kahee na jaai ||
english: Even if its value were known, it could not be described.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਰੈ ਸਰੀਅਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sarai sareeat karahi beechaar ||
english: Some think about religious rituals and regulations,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin boojhe kaise paavahi paar ||
english: but without understanding, how can they cross over to the other side?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਦਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਜਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਖਸੂਦੁ ॥
transliteration: sidak kar sijadaa man kar makhasood ||
english: Let sincere faith be your bowing in prayer, and let the conquest of your mind be your objective in life.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਧਿਰਿ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਿਹ ਧਿਰਿ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jih dhir dekhaa tih dhir maujood ||1||
english: Wherever I look, there I see God's Presence. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਭਾ ਏਵ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਨੇੜੈ ਨਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur sabhaa ev na paaeeai naa neRai naa door ||
english: The Society of the Guru is not obtained like this, by trying to be near or far away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਂ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak satigur taa(n) milai jaa man rahai hadoor ||2||
english: O Nanak, you shall meet the True Guru, if your mind remains in His Presence. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਸਪਤ ਸਾਗਰਾ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sapat deep sapat saagaraa nav kha(n)d chaar ved das asat puraanaa ||
english: The seven islands, seven seas, nine continents, four Vedas and eighteen Puraanas

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂੰ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: har sabhanaa vich too(n) varatadaa har sabhanaa bhaanaa ||
english: O Lord, You pervade and permeate all. Lord, everyone loves You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਰਗ ਪਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh tujhai dhiaavahi jee ja(n)t har saarag paanaa ||
english: All beings and creatures meditate on You, Lord. You hold the earth in Your Hands.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jo guramukh har aaraadhade tin hau kurabaanaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those Gurmukhs who worship and adore the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: too(n) aape aap varatadaa kar choj vidaanaa ||4||
english: You Yourself are All-pervading; You stage this wondrous drama! ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਉ ਮਸਾਜਨੀ ਕਿਆ ਸਦਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹੀ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kalau masaajanee kiaa sadaaeeai hiradai hee likh lehu ||
english: Why ask for a pen, and why ask for ink? Write within your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa saahib kai ra(n)g rahai kabahoo(n) na tootas nehu ||
english: Remain immersed forever in the Love of your Lord and Master, and your love for Him shall never break.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਉ ਮਸਾਜਨੀ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਭੀ ਨਾਲੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kalau masaajanee jaaisee likhiaa bhee naale jaai ||
english: Pen and ink shall pass away, along with what has been written.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਸਚੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sah preet na jaaisee jo dhur chhodee sachai paai ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Love of your Husband Lord shall never perish. The True Lord has bestowed it, as it was pre-ordained. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਉਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: nadaree aavadaa naal na chalaee vekhahu ko viupaai ||
english: That which is seen, shall not go along with you. What does it take to make you see this?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sach driRaaiaa sach rahahu liv laai ||
english: The True Guru has implanted the True Name within; remain lovingly absorbed in the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sabadee sach hai karamee palai paai ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Word of His Shabad is True. By His Grace, it is obtained. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)dar baahar ik too(n) too(n) jaanahi bhet ||
english: O Lord, You are inside and outside as well. You are the Knower of secrets.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕੀਚੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jo keechai so har jaanadaa mere man har chet ||
english: Whatever anyone does, the Lord knows. O my mind, think of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਡਰੈ ਜਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਦਾ ਧਰਮੀ ਵਿਗਸੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: so darai j paap kamaavadaa dharamee vigaset ||
english: The one who commits sins lives in fear, while the one who lives righteously rejoices.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਡਰੀਐ ਕੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sachaa aap niaau sach taa dareeai ket ||
english: O Lord, You Yourself are True, and True is Your Justice. Why should anyone be afraid?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਲੇਤੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jinaa naanak sach pachhaaniaa se sach ralet ||5||
english: O Nanak, those who recognize the True Lord are blended with the True One. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਮ ਜਲਉ ਸਣੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀਐ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਭੀ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kalam jalau san masavaaneeai kaagad bhee jal jaau ||
english: Burn the pen, and burn the ink; burn the paper as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: likhan vaalaa jal balau jin likhiaa doojaa bhaau ||
english: Burn the writer who writes in the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa avar na karanaa jaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, people do what is pre-ordained; they cannot do anything else. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਪੜਣਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hor kooR paRanaa kooR bolanaa maaiaa naal piaar ||
english: False is other reading, and false is other speaking, in the love of Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak vin naavai ko thir nahee paR paR hoi khuaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, nothing is permanent; those who read and read are ruined. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: har kee vadiaaee vadee hai har keeratan har kaa ||
english: Great is the Greatness of the Lord, and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਹੈ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: har kee vadiaaee vadee hai jaa niaau hai dharam kaa ||
english: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; His Justice is totally Righteous.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: har kee vadiaaee vadee hai jaa phal hai jee kaa ||
english: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; people receive the fruits of the soul.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਕਹਿਆ ਚੁਗਲ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: har kee vadiaaee vadee hai jaa na sunaee kahiaa chugal kaa ||
english: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; He does not hear the words of the back-biters.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਅਪੁਛਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਕਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: har kee vadiaaee vadee hai apuchhiaa daan devakaa ||6||
english: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; He gives His Gifts without being asked. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਸਭ ਮੁਈ ਸੰਪਉ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: hau hau karatee sabh muee sa(n)pau kisai na naal ||
english: Those who act in ego shall all die. Their worldly possessions shall not go along with them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਜੋਹੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai dukh paaiaa sabh johee jamakaal ||
english: Because of their love of duality, they suffer in pain. The Messenger of Death is watching all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh ubare saachaa naam samaal ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved, by contemplating the True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਲਂੀ ਅਸੀ ਚੰਗੀਆ ਆਚਾਰੀ ਬੁਰੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: gala(n)ee asee cha(n)geeaa aachaaree bureeaah ||
english: We are good at talking, but our actions are bad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹੁ ਕੁਸੁਧਾ ਕਾਲੀਆ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਚਿਟਵੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: manahu kusudhaa kaaleeaa baahar chitaveeaah ||
english: Mentally, we are impure and black, but outwardly, we appear white.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੀਸਾ ਕਰਿਹ ਤਿਨਾੜੀਆ ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਦਰੁ ਖੜੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: reesaa karih tinaaReeaa jo sevahi dar khaReeaah ||
english: We imitate those who stand and serve at the Lord's Door.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਲਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਰਤੀਆ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਰਲੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: naal khasamai rateeaa maanahi sukh raleeaah ||
english: They are attuned to the Love of their Husband Lord, and they experience the pleasure of His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਦੈ ਤਾਣਿ ਨਿਤਾਣੀਆ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਮਾਨਣੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: hodai taan nitaaneeaa rahahi nimaananeeaah ||
english: They remain powerless, even while they have power; they remain humble and meek.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਹ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak janam sakaarathaa je tin kai sa(n)g milaah ||2||
english: O Nanak, our lives become profitable if we associate with them. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਮੀਨਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape jal meenaa hai aape aape hee aap jaal ||
english: You Yourself are the water, You Yourself are the fish, and You Yourself are the net.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲੁ ਵਤਾਇਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੇਬਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape jaal vataaidaa aape vich sebaal ||
english: You Yourself cast the net, and You Yourself are the bait.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੈ ਹਥਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape kamal alipat hai sai hathaa vich gulaal ||
english: You Yourself are the lotus, unaffected and still brightly-colored in hundreds of feet of water.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਘੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਖਿਆਲੁ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape mukat karaaidaa ik nimakh ghaRee kar khiaal ||
english: You Yourself liberate those who think of You for even an instant.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har tudhahu baahar kichh nahee gurasabadee vekh nihaal ||7||
english: O Lord, nothing is beyond You. I am delighted to behold You, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hukam na jaanai bahutaa rovai ||
english: One who does not know the Hukam of the Lord's Command cries out in terrible pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧੋਖਾ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar dhokhaa need na sovai ||
english: She is filled with deception, and she cannot sleep in peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਧਨ ਖਸਮੈ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: je dhan khasamai chalai rajaaee ||
english: But if the soul-bride follows the Will of her Lord and Master,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dar ghar sobhaa mahal bulaaee ||
english: She shall be honored in her own home, and called to the Mansion of His Presence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naanak karamee ih mat paaee ||
english: O Nanak, by His Mercy, this understanding is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sach samaaee ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, she is absorbed into the True One. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਭੁਲੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh naam vihooniaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bhaa dekh na bhul ||
english: O self-willed manmukh, devoid of the Naam, do not be misled upon beholding the color of the safflower.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜਿਆ ਛੋਛਾ ਇਸ ਦਾ ਮੁਲੁ ॥
transliteration: is kaa ra(n)g din thoRiaa chhochhaa is daa mul ||
english: Its color lasts for only a few days-it is worthless!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: doojai lage pach mue moorakh a(n)dh gavaar ||
english: Attached to duality, the foolish, blind and stupid people waste away and die.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀਟ ਸੇ ਪਇ ਪਚਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bisataa a(n)dar keet se pai pachahi vaaro vaar ||
english: Like worms, they live in manure, and in it, they die over and over again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate se ra(n)gule gur kai sahaj subhaai ||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are dyed in the color of truth; they take on the intuitive peace and poise of the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhagatee ra(n)g na utarai sahaje rahai samaai ||2||
english: The color of devotional worship does not fade away; they remain intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਸਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sisat upaaee sabh tudh aape rijak sa(n)baahiaa ||
english: You created the entire universe, and You Yourself bring sustenance to it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਵਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਵਦੇ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਢਾਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ik val chhal kar kai khaavade muhahu kooR kusat tinee dhaahiaa ||
english: Some eat and survive by practicing fraud and deceit; from their mouths they drop falsehood and lies.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਓਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਓਇ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape bhaavai so karahi tudh otai ka(n)m oi laaiaa ||
english: As it pleases You, You assign them their tasks.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਓਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਅਤੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦੇਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa sach bujhaaion tinaa atut bha(n)daar devaaiaa ||
english: Some understand Truthfulness; they are given the inexhaustible treasure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਚੇਤਾ ਹਥ ਤਡਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: har chet khaahi tinaa saphal hai achetaa hath tadaaiaa ||8||
english: Those who eat by remembering the Lord are prosperous, while those who do not remember Him stretch out their hands in need. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬੇਦ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit bed vakhaanahi maaiaa moh suaai ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, constantly read and recite the Vedas, for the sake of the love of Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai har naam visaariaa man moorakh milai sajaai ||
english: In the love of duality, the foolish people have forgotten the Lord's Name; they shall receive their punishment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਜੋ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jin jeeu pi(n)d ditaa tis kabahoo(n) na chetai jo de(n)daa rijak sa(n)baahi ||
english: They never think of the One who gave them body and soul, who provides sustenance to all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਗਲਹੁ ਨ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jam kaa phaahaa galahu na kateeai phir phir aavai jaai ||
english: The noose of death shall not be cut away from their necks; they shall come and go in reincarnation over and over again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kichhoo na soojhai a(n)dhule poorab likhiaa kamaai ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand anything. They do what they are pre-ordained to do.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag satigur milai sukhadaataa naam vasai man aai ||
english: Through perfect destiny, they meet the True Guru, the Giver of peace, and the Naam comes to abide in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sukh maanahi sukh painanaa sukhe sukh vihaai ||
english: They enjoy peace, they wear peace, and they pass their lives in the peace of peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak so naau manahu na visaareeai jit dar sachai sobhaa paai ||1||
english: O Nanak, they do not forget the Naam from the mind; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev sukh paaiaa sach naam gunataas ||
english: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained. The True Name is the Treasure of Excellence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: guramatee aap pachhaaniaa raam naam paragaas ||
english: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and recognize your own self; the Divine Light of the Lord's Name shall shine within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: sacho sach kamaavanaa vadiaaee vade paas ||
english: The true ones practice Truth; greatness rests in the Great Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis kaa siphat kare aradaas ||
english: Body, soul and all things belong to the Lord-praise Him, and offer your prayers to Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad saalaahanaa sukhe sukh nivaas ||
english: Sing the Praises of the True Lord through the Word of His Shabad, and you shall abide in the peace of peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam manai maahi bin naavai dhrig jeevaas ||
english: You may practice chanting, penance and austere self-discipline within your mind, but without the Name, life is useless.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: guramatee naau paaeeai manamukh mohi vinaas ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Name is obtained, while the self-willed manmukh wastes away in emotional attachment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakh too(n) naanak teraa daas ||2||
english: Please protect me, by the Pleasure of Your Will. Nanak is Your slave. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਸੁ ਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko teraa too(n) sabhas daa too(n) sabhanaa raas ||
english: All are Yours, and You belong to all. You are the wealth of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh tudhai paasahu ma(n)gade nit kar aradaas ||
english: Everyone begs from You, and all offer prayers to You each day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਇਕਨਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jis too(n) dehi tis sabh kichh milai ikanaa door hai paas ||
english: Those, unto whom You give, receive everything. You are far away from some, and You are close to others.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਥਾਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: tudh baajhahu thaau ko naahee jis paasahu ma(n)geeai man vekhahu ko nirajaas ||
english: Without You, there is not even a place to stand begging. See this yourself and verify it in your mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੯॥
transliteration: sabh tudhai no saalaahade dar guramukhaa no paragaas ||9||
english: All praise You, O Lord; at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are enlightened. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਉਚਾ ਕੂਕਦਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit paR paR uchaa kookadaa maaiaa mohi piaar ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read, and shout out loud, but they are attached to the love of Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਈ ਮਨਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar braham na cheenaee man moorakh gaavaar ||
english: They do not recognize God within themselves-they are so foolish and ignorant!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਦਾ ਨਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai jagat parabodhadaa naa boojhai beechaar ||
english: In the love of duality, they try to teach the world, but they do not understand meditative contemplation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: birathaa janam gavaaiaa mar ja(n)mai vaaro vaar ||1||
english: They lose their lives uselessly; they die, only to be re-born, over and over again. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jinee satigur seviaa tinee naau paaiaa boojhahu kar beechaar ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Name. Reflect on this and understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sadaa saa(n)t sukh man vasai chookai kook pukaar ||
english: Eternal peace and joy abide in their minds; they abandon their cries and complaints.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਨੋ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aapai no aap khaai man niramal hovai gurasabadee veechaar ||
english: Their identity consumes their identical identity, and their minds become pure by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sabad rate se mukat hai har jeeu het piaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, attuned to the Shabad, they are liberated. They love their Beloved Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har kee sevaa saphal hai guramukh paavai thaai ||
english: Service to the Lord is fruitful; through it, the Gurmukh is honored and approved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jis har bhaavai tis gur milai so har naam dhiaai ||
english: That person, with whom the Lord is pleased, meets with the Guru, and meditates on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee har paaeeai har paar laghaai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found. The Lord carries us across.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manahath kinai na paaio puchhahu vedaa jaai ||
english: Through stubborn-mindedness, none have found Him; go and consult the Vedas on this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak har kee sevaa so kare jis lae har laai ||10||
english: O Nanak, he alone serves the Lord, whom the Lord attaches to Himself. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਵਰੀਆਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਅਹੰਕਰਣੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak so sooraa vareeaam jin vichahu dusat aha(n)karan maariaa ||
english: O Nanak, he is a brave warrior, who conquers and subdues his vicious inner ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam saalaahi janam savaariaa ||
english: Praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Gurmukhs redeem their lives.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aap hoaa sadaa mukat sabh kul nisataariaa ||
english: They themselves are liberated forever, and they save all their ancestors.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਨਿ ਸਚਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sohan sach duaar naam piaariaa ||
english: Those who love the Naam look beauteous at the Gate of Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਗਾੜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh marahi aha(n)kaar maran vigaaRiaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs die in egotism-even their death is painfully ugly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabho varatai hukam kiaa karahi vichaariaa ||
english: Everything happens according to the Lord's Will; what can the poor people do?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aapahu doojai lag khasam visaariaa ||
english: Attached to self-conceit and duality, they have forgotten their Lord and Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bin naavai sabh dukh sukh visaariaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, everything is painful, and happiness is forgotten. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai har naam diRaaiaa tin vichahu bharam chukaaiaa ||
english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me. It has dispelled my doubts from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਮਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: raam naam har keerat gaaee kar chaanan mag dikhaaiaa ||
english: I sing the Lord's Name and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; the Divine Light shines, and now I see the Way.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar ek liv laagee a(n)tar naam vasaaiaa ||
english: Conquering my ego, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord; the Naam has come to dwell within me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramatee jam johi na saakai saachai naam samaaiaa ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I cannot be touched by the Messenger of Death. I am absorbed in the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh aape aap varatai karataa jo bhaavai so naai laaiaa ||
english: The Creator Himself is All-pervading everywhere; He links those with whom He is pleased to His Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਤਾ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam lae taa jeevai bin naavai khin mar jaaiaa ||2||
english: Servant Nanak chants the Naam, and so he lives. Without the Name, he would die in an instant. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣ ਸਿਉ ਸੋ ਸਭਨੀ ਦੀਬਾਣੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jo miliaa har deebaan siu so sabhanee deebaanee miliaa ||
english: One who is accepted at the Court of the Lord shall be accepted in courts everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਸੁਰਖਰੂ ਉਸ ਕੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਸਭ ਪਾਪੀ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jithai ohu jaai tithai ohu surakharoo us kai muhi dithai sabh paapee tariaa ||
english: Wherever he goes, he is recognized as honorable. Seeing his face, all sinners are saved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਰਵਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: os a(n)tar naam nidhaan hai naamo paravariaa ||
english: Within him is the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Through the Naam, he is exalted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਨਾਇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naau poojeeai naau ma(n)neeai naai kilavikh sabh hiriaa ||
english: He worships the Name, and believes in the Name; the Name erases all his sinful mistakes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੇ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਗਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: jinee naam dhiaaiaa ik man ik chit se asathir jag rahiaa ||11||
english: Those who meditate on the Name, with one-pointed mind and focused consciousness, remain forever stable in the world. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aatamaa deu poojeeai gur kai sahaj subhaai ||
english: Worship the Divine, Supreme Soul, with the intuitive peace and poise of the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮੇ ਨੋ ਆਤਮੇ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aatame no aatame dee prateet hoi taa ghar hee parachaa paai ||
english: If the individual soul has faith in the Supreme Soul, then it shall obtain realization within its own home.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮਾ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਨ ਡੋਲਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aatamaa adol na dolaee gur kai bhaai subhaai ||
english: The soul becomes steady, and does not waver, by the natural inclination of the Guru's Loving Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur vin sahaj na aavaee lobh mail na vichahu jaai ||
english: Without the Guru, intuitive wisdom does not come, and the filth of greed does not depart from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khin pal har naam man vasai sabh athasath teerath naai ||
english: If the Lord's Name abides within the mind, for a moment, even for an instant, it is like bathing at all the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sache mail na lagaee mal laagai doojai bhaai ||
english: Filth does not stick to those who are true, but filth attaches itself to those who love duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੋਤੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhotee mool na utarai je athasath teerath naai ||
english: This filth cannot be washed off, even by bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh karam kare aha(n)kaaree sabh dukho dukh kamaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh does deeds in egotism; he earns only pain and more pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈਲਾ ਊਜਲੁ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak mailaa oojal taa theeai jaa satigur maahi samaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, the filthy ones become clean only when they meet and surrender to the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਕਦਹੁ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh lok samajhaaeeai kadahu samajhaaiaa jaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs may be taught, but how can they really be taught?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਰਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh ralaaiaa naa ralai paiai kirat phiraai ||
english: The manmukhs do not fit in at all. Because of their past actions, they are condemned to the cycle of reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਿਵ ਧਾਤੁ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: liv dhaat dui raah hai hukamee kaar kamaai ||
english: Loving attention to the Lord and attachment to Maya are the two separate ways; all act according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh aapanaa man maariaa sabad kasavatee laai ||
english: The Gurmukh has conquered his own mind, by applying the Touchstone of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਝਗੜਾ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਥ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man hee naal jhagaRaa man hee naal sath man hee ma(n)jh samaai ||
english: He fights with his mind, he settles with his mind, and he is at peace with his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man jo ichhe so lahai sachai sabad subhaai ||
english: All obtain the desires of their minds, through the Love of the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਭੁੰਚੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam sad bhu(n)cheeai guramukh kaar kamaai ||
english: They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam forever; this is how the Gurmukhs act.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਮਨੈ ਜਿ ਹੋਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਲੁਝਣਾ ਜਾਸੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vin manai j horee naal lujhanaa jaasee janam gavaai ||
english: Those who struggle with something other than their own mind, shall depart having wasted their lives.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukhee manahath haariaa kooR kusat kamaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs, through stubborn-mindedness and the practice of falsehood, lose the game of life.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee man jinai har setee liv laai ||
english: Those who conquer their own mind, by Guru's Grace, lovingly focus their attention on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh sach kamaavai manamukh aavai jaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs practice Truth, while the self-willed manmukhs continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਇਕ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t sunahu jan bhaaee har satigur kee ik saakhee ||
english: O Saints of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, listen, and hear the Lord's Teachings, through the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਲੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: jis dhur bhaag hovai mukh masatak tin jan lai hiradai raakhee ||
english: Those who have good destiny pre-ordained and inscribed on their foreheads, grasp it and keep it enshrined in the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ਸਰੇਸਟ ਊਤਮ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਚਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)mrit kathaa saresat ootam gur bachanee sahaje chaakhee ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, they intuitively taste the sublime, exquisite and ambrosial sermon of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਸੂਰਜ ਰੈਣਿ ਕਿਰਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: tah bhaiaa pragaas mitiaa a(n)dhiaaraa jiu sooraj rain kiraakhee ||
english: The Divine Light shines in their hearts, and like the sun which removes the darkness of night, it dispels the darkness of ignorance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੀ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: adisat agochar alakh nira(n)jan so dekhiaa guramukh aakhee ||12||
english: As Gurmukh, they behold with their eyes the Unseen, Imperceptible, Unknowable, Immaculate Lord. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve aapanaa so sir lekhai laai ||
english: Those who serve their True Guru are certified and accepted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਕੈ ਰਹਨਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vichahu aap gavaai kai rahan sach liv laai ||
english: They eradicate selfishness and conceit from within; they remain lovingly absorbed in the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਤਿਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur jinee na sevio tinaa birathaa janam gavaai ||
english: Those who do not serve the True Guru waste away their lives in vain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaavai so kare kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Lord does just as He pleases. No one has any say in this. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ਵੇੜਿਆ ਵੇਕਾਰਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man vekaaree veRiaa vekaaraa karam kamaai ||
english: With the mind encircled by wickedness and evil, people do evil deeds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਪੂਜਦੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai agiaanee poojade daragah milai sajaai ||
english: The ignorant worship the love of duality; in the Lord's Court they shall be punished.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਦੇਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aatam deu poojeeai bin satigur boojh na paai ||
english: So worship the Lord, the Light of the soul; without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam bhaanaa satiguroo kaa karamee palai paai ||
english: Meditation, penance and austere self-discipline are found by surrendering to the True Guru's Will. By His Grace this is received.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sevaa surat kamaavanee jo har bhaavai so thaai paai ||2||
english: O Nanak, serve with this intuitive awareness; only that which is pleasing to the Lord is approved. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere jit sadaa sukh hovai din raatee ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; it will bring you eternal peace, day and night.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere jit simarat sabh kilavikh paap lahaatee ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; meditating on it, all sins and misdeeds shall be erased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere jit daalad dukh bhukh sabh lahi jaatee ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; through it, all poverty, pain and hunger shall be removed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere mukh guramukh preet lagaatee ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; as Gurmukh, declare your love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਤੀ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jit mukh bhaag likhiaa dhur saachai har tit mukh naam japaatee ||13||
english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead by the True Lord, chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕੀਤੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur jinee na sevio sabad na keeto veechaar ||
english: Those who do not serve the True Guru, and who do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar giaan na aaio miratak hai sa(n)saar ||
english: -spiritual wisdom does not enter into their hearts; they are like dead bodies in the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh pher paiaa mar ja(n)mai hoi khuaar ||
english: They go through the cycle of 8.4 million reincarnations, and they are ruined through death and rebirth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee sevaa so kare jis no aap karaae soi ||
english: He alone serves the True Guru, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur vich naam nidhaan hai karam paraapat hoi ||
english: The Treasure of the Naam is within the True Guru; by His Grace, it is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੀ ਸਦਾ ਲਿਵ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sach rate gurasabad siu tin sachee sadaa liv hoi ||
english: Those who are truly attuned to the Word of the Guru's Shabad-their love is forever True.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jis no mele na vichhuRai sahaj samaavai soi ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who are united with Him shall not be separated again. They merge imperceptibly into God. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਜੋੁ ਭਗਵੰਤੈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: so bhagautee jou bhagava(n)tai jaanai ||
english: One who knows the Benevolent Lord God is the true devotee of Bhagaautee.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee aap pachhaanai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, he is self-realized.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat raakhai ikat ghar aanai ||
english: He restrains his wandering mind, and brings it back to its own home within the self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jeevat marai har naam vakhaanai ||
english: He remains dead while yet alive, and he chants the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਉਤਮੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa bhagautee utam hoi ||
english: Such a Bhagaautee is most exalted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sach samaavai soi ||2||
english: O Nanak, he merges into the True One. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kapat bhagautee kahaae ||
english: He is full of deceit, and yet he calls himself a devotee of Bhagaautee.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d paarabraham kade na paae ||
english: Through hypocrisy, he shall never attain the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: par ni(n)daa kare a(n)tar mal laae ||
english: He slanders others, and pollutes himself with his own filth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: baahar mal dhovai man kee jooth na jaae ||
english: Outwardly, he washes off the filth, but the impurity of his mind does not go away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਦੁ ਰਚਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat siu baad rachaae ||
english: He argues with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਰਚਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anadin dukheeaa doojai bhaai rachaae ||
english: Night and day, he suffers, engrossed in the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har naam na chetai bahu karam kamaae ||
english: He does not remember the Name of the Lord, but still, he performs all sorts of empty rituals.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa s metanaa na jaae ||
english: That which is pre-ordained cannot be erased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak bin satigur seve mokh na paae ||3||
english: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੇ ਕੜਿ ਨ ਸਵਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur jinee dhiaaiaa se kaR na savaahee ||
english: Those who meditate on the True Guru shall not be burnt to ashes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur jinee dhiaaiaa se tripat aghaahee ||
english: Those who meditate on the True Guru are satisfied and fulfilled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਡਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur jinee dhiaaiaa tin jam dar naahee ||
english: Those who meditate on the True Guru are not afraid of the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jin kau hoaa kripaal har se satigur pairee paahee ||
english: Those upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy, fall at the Feet of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: tin aithai othai mukh ujale har daragah paidhe jaahee ||14||
english: Here and hereafter, their faces are radiant; they go to the Lord's Court in robes of honor. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਾਂਈ ਨਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਡਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jo sir saa(n)ee naa nivai so sir deejai daar ||
english: Chop off that head which does not bow to the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਿੰਜਰ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੋ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jis pi(n)jar mahi birahaa nahee so pi(n)jar lai jaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, that human body, in which there is no pain of separation from the Lord-take that body and burn it. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਭੁਲੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਈਆਸੁ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dhahu bhulee naanakaa phir phir janam mueeaas ||
english: Forgetting the Primal Lord, O Nanak, people are born and die, over and over again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਸਤੂਰੀ ਕੈ ਭੋਲੜੈ ਗੰਦੇ ਡੁੰਮਿ ਪਈਆਸੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kasatooree kai bholaRai ga(n)de du(n)m paeeaas ||2||
english: Mistaking it for musk, they have fallen into the stinking pit of filth. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: so aisaa har naam dhiaaeeai man mere jo sabhanaa upar hukam chalaae ||
english: Meditate on that Name of the Lord, O my mind, whose Command rules over all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਅੰਤੀ ਅਉਸਰਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
transliteration: so aisaa har naam japeeai man mere jo a(n)tee ausar lae chhadaae ||
english: Chant that Name of the Lord, O my mind, which will save you at the very last moment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: so aisaa har naam japeeai man mere j man kee trisanaa sabh bhukh gavaae ||
english: Chant that Name of the Lord, O my mind, which shall drive out all hunger and desire from your mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: so guramukh naam japiaa vadabhaagee tin ni(n)dak dusat sabh pairee paae ||
english: Very fortunate and blessed is that Gurmukh who chants the Naam; it shall bring all slanderers and wicked enemies to fall at his feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇ ਵਡਾ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਅਗੈ ਆਣਿ ਨਿਵਾਏ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam araadh sabhanaa te vadaa sabh naavai agai aan nivaae ||15||
english: O Nanak, worship and adore the Naam, the Greatest Name of all, before which all come and bow. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ves kare kuroop kulakhanee man khotai kooRiaar ||
english: She may wear good clothes, but the bride is ugly and rude; her mind is false and impure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਨਾ ਚਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਗਾਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: pir kai bhaanai naa chalai hukam kare gaavaar ||
english: She does not walk in harmony with the Will of her Husband Lord. Instead, she foolishly gives Him orders.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bhaanai jo chalai sabh dukh nivaaranahaar ||
english: But she who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, shall be spared all pain and suffering.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: likhiaa met na sakeeai jo dhur likhiaa karataar ||
english: That destiny which was pre-ordained by the Creator cannot be erased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਕੰਤ ਕਉ ਸਬਦੇ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man tan saupe ka(n)t kau sabade dhare piaar ||
english: She must dedicate her mind and body to her Husband Lord, and enshrine love for the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai kinai na paaiaa dekhahu ridai beechaar ||
english: Without His Name, no one has found Him; see this and reflect upon it in your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਸੁਆਲਿਓ ਸੁਲਖਣੀ ਜਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saa suaalio sulakhanee j raavee sirajanahaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, she is beautiful and graceful; the Creator Lord ravishes and enjoys her. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu gubaar hai tis daa na disai uravaar na paar ||
english: Attachment to Maya is an ocean of darkness; neither this shore nor the one beyond can be seen.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਡੁਬੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh agiaanee mahaa dukh paaide dube har naam visaar ||
english: The ignorant, self-willed manmukhs suffer in terrible pain; they forget the Lord's Name and drown.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhalake uth bahu karam kamaavahi doojai bhaai piaar ||
english: They arise in the morning and perform all sorts of rituals, but they are caught in the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi aapanaa bhaujal utare paar ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh sach samaavahi sach naam ur dhaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs keep the True Name enshrined in their hearts; they are absorbed into the True One. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har jal thal maheeal bharapoor doojaa naahi koi ||
english: The Lord pervades and permeates the water, the land and the sky; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਸਭ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har aap bahi kare niaau kooRiaar sabh maar kadhoi ||
english: The Lord Himself sits upon His Throne and administers justice. He beats and drives out the false-hearted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਆਉ ਕੀਓਇ ॥
transliteration: sachiaaraa dei vadiaaee har dharam niaau keeoi ||
english: The Lord bestows glorious greatness upon those who are truthful. He administers righteous justice.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਗਰੀਬ ਅਨਾਥ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਓਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh har kee karahu usatat jin gareeb anaath raakh leeoi ||
english: So praise the Lord, everybody; He protects the poor and the lost souls.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਧਰਮੀਆ ਕਾ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੀਓਇ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: jaikaar keeo dharameeaa kaa paapee kau da(n)d deeoi ||16||
english: He honors the righteous and punishes the sinners. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਕੁਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mailee kaamanee kulakhanee kunaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukh, the foolish bride, is a filthy, rude and evil wife.
