author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pir chhodiaa ghar aapanaa par purakhai naal piaar ||
english: Forsaking her Husband Lord and leaving her own home, she gives her love to another.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਜਲਦੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa kade na chukaee jaladee kare pookaar ||
english: Her desires are never satisfied, and she burns and cries out in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਸੋਹਣੀ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਭਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bin naavai kuroop kusohanee parahar chhodee bhataar ||1||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, she is ugly and ungraceful. She is abandoned and left behind by her Husband Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabad ratee sohaaganee satigur kai bhaai piaar ||
english: The happy soul-bride is attuned to the Word of the Shabad; she is in love with the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa raave pir aapanaa sachai prem piaar ||
english: She continually enjoys and ravishes her Beloved, with true love and affection.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: at suaaliu su(n)daree sobhaava(n)tee naar ||
english: She is such a loveable, beautiful and noble woman.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੇਲੀ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam sohaaganee melee melanahaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, the happy soul-bride unites with the Lord of Union. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਕਾਢਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har teree sabh karahi usatat jin phaathe kaadhiaa ||
english: Lord, everyone sings Your Praises. You have freed us from bondage.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਪੈ ਤੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har tudhano karahi sabh namasakaar jin paapai te raakhiaa ||
english: Lord, everyone bows in reverence to You. You have saved us from our sinful ways.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਮਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਡਾਢੀ ਹੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਡਾਢਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har nimaaniaa too(n) maan har daadhee hoo(n) too(n) daadhiaa ||
english: Lord, You are the Honor of the dishonored. Lord, You are the Strongest of the strong.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਸਾਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har aha(n)kaareeaa maar nivaae manamukh mooR saadhiaa ||
english: The Lord beats down the egocentrics and corrects the foolish, self-willed manmukhs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗਰੀਬ ਅਨਾਥਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: har bhagataa dei vadiaaee gareeb anaathiaa ||17||
english: The Lord bestows glorious greatness on His devotees, the poor, and the lost souls. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai jo chalai tis vadiaaee vadee hoi ||
english: One who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru, obtains the greatest glory.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam utam man vasai met na sakai koi ||
english: The Exalted Name of the Lord abides in his mind, and no one can take it away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa kare jis aapanee tis karam paraapat hoi ||
english: That person, upon whom the Lord bestows His Grace, receives His Mercy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kaaran karate vas hai guramukh boojhai koi ||1||
english: O Nanak, creativity is under the control of the Creator; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize this! ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naanak har naam jinee aaraadhiaa anadin har liv taar ||
english: O Nanak, those who worship and adore the Lord's Name night and day, vibrate the String of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਦੀ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਤਿਨ ਅਗੈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa ba(n)dee khasam kee tin agai kamaavai kaar ||
english: Maya, the maid-servant of our Lord and Master, serves them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: poorai pooraa kar chhodiaa hukam savaaranahaar ||
english: The Perfect One has made them perfect; by the Hukam of His Command, they are embellished.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee jin bujhiaa tin paaiaa mokh duaar ||
english: By Guru's Grace, they understand Him, and they find the gate of salvation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh hukam na jaananee tin maare jam ja(n)daar ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Lord's Command; they are beaten down by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਤਰਿਆ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jinee araadhiaa tinee tariaa bhaujal sa(n)saar ||
english: But the Gurmukhs, who worship and adore the Lord, cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਗੁਣੀ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh augan gunee mitaaiaa gur aape bakhasanahaar ||2||
english: All their demerits are erased, and replaced with merits. The Guru Himself is their Forgiver. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ॥
transliteration: har kee bhagataa parateet har sabh kichh jaanadaa ||
english: The Lord's devotees have faith in Him. The Lord knows everything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: har jevad naahee koee jaan har dharam beechaaradaa ||
english: No one is as great a Knower as the Lord; the Lord administers righteous justice.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾੜਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਧਰਮਿ ਮਾਰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaRaa a(n)desaa kiu keejai jaa naahee adharam maaradaa ||
english: Why should we feel any burning anxiety, since the Lord does not punish without just cause?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਰੁ ਹਾਰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib sach niaau paapee nar haaradaa ||
english: True is the Master, and True is His Justice; only the sinners are defeated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਤਾਰਦਾ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: saalaahihu bhagatahu kar joR har bhagat jan taaradaa ||18||
english: O devotees, praise the Lord with your palms pressed together; the Lord saves His humble devotees. ||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aapane preetam mil rahaa a(n)tar rakhaa ur dhaar ||
english: Oh, if only I could meet my Beloved, and keep Him enshrined deep within my heart!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saalaahee so prabh sadaa sadaa gur kai het piaar ||
english: I praise that God forever and ever, through love and affection for the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸਾਈ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jis nadar kare tis mel lae saaee suhaagan naar ||1||
english: O Nanak, that one upon whom He bestows His Glance of Grace is united with Him; such a person is the true soul-bride of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te har paaeeai jaa kau nadar karei ||
english: Serving the Guru, the Lord is obtained, when He bestows His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਤੇ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਭਏ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maanas te devate bhae dhiaaiaa naam hare ||
english: They are transformed from humans into angels, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar milaaian gur kai sabad tare ||
english: They conquer their egotism and merge with the Lord; they are saved through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sahaj samaaian har aapanee kripaa kare ||2||
english: O Nanak, they merge imperceptibly into the Lord, who has bestowed His Favor upon them. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਖਾਲੀਅਨੁ ॥
transliteration: har aapanee bhagat karaai vadiaaee vekhaaleean ||
english: The Lord Himself inspires us to worship Him; He reveals His Glorious Greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਘਾਲੀਅਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aapanee aap kare parateet aape sev ghaaleean ||
english: He Himself inspires us to place our faith in Him. Thus He performs His Own Service.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰੀ ਬਹਾਲਿਅਨੁ ॥
transliteration: har bhagataa no dei ana(n)d thir gharee bahaalian ||
english: The Lord bestows bliss upon His devotees, and gives them a seat in the eternal home.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀਆ ਨੋ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰਿ ਚਾਲਿਅਨੁ ॥
transliteration: paapeeaa no na deee thir rahan chun narak ghor chaalian ||
english: He does not give the sinners any stability or place of rest; He consigns them to the depths of hell.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਗੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: har bhagataa no dei piaar kar a(n)g nisataarian ||19||
english: The Lord blesses His devotees with His Love; He sides with them and saves them. ||19||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਡੂਮਣੀ ਕੁਦਇਆ ਕਸਾਇਣਿ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਘਟ ਚੂਹੜੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਚੰਡਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: kubudh doomanee kudaiaa kasaain par ni(n)daa ghat choohaRee muthee krodh cha(n)daal ||
english: False-mindedness is the drummer-woman; cruelty is the butcheress; slander of others in one's heart is the cleaning-woman, and deceitful anger is the outcast-woman.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰੀ ਕਢੀ ਕਿਆ ਥੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਚਾਰੇ ਬੈਠੀਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: kaaree kadhee kiaa theeai jaa(n) chaare baitheeaa naal ||
english: What good are the ceremonial lines drawn around your kitchen, when these four are seated there with you?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰਾਂ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਨਾਉ ਜਪੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sach sa(n)jam karanee kaaraa(n) naavan naau japehee ||
english: Make Truth your self-discipline, and make good deeds the lines you draw; make chanting the Name your cleansing bath.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗੈ ਊਤਮ ਸੇਈ ਜਿ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਪੰਦਿ ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak agai ootam seee j paapaa(n) pa(n)d na dehee ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who do not walk in the ways of sin, shall be exalted in the world hereafter. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: kiaa ha(n)s kiaa bagulaa jaa kau nadar karei ||
english: Which is the swan, and which is the crane? It is only by His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਾਗਹੁ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa kaagahu ha(n)s karei ||2||
english: Whoever is pleasing to Him, O Nanak, is transformed from a crow into a swan. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ਕੰਮੁ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਆਖੀਐ ॥
transliteration: keetaa loReeai ka(n)m s har pahi aakheeai ||
english: Whatever work you wish to accomplish-tell it to the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kaaraj dei savaar satigur sach saakheeai ||
english: He will resolve your affairs; the True Guru gives His Guarantee of Truth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa sa(n)g nidhaan a(n)mrit chaakheeai ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, you shall taste the treasure of the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥
transliteration: bhai bha(n)jan miharavaan daas kee raakheeai ||
english: The Lord is the Merciful Destroyer of fear; He preserves and protects His slaves.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਲਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਖੀਐ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak har gun gaai alakh prabh laakheeai ||20||
english: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and see the Unseen Lord God. ||20||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis kaa sabhasai dei adhaar ||
english: Body and soul, all belong to Him. He gives His Support to all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh seveeai sadaa sadaa daataar ||
english: O Nanak, become Gurmukh and serve Him, who is forever and ever the Giver.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree tin kau jin dhiaaiaa har nira(n)kaar ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Formless Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ ਓਨਾ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: onaa ke mukh sad ujale onaa no sabh jagat kare namasakaar ||1||
english: Their faces are forever radiant, and the whole world bows in reverence to them. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਉਲਟੀ ਭਈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਖਰਚਿਉ ਖਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai ulatee bhaee nav nidh kharachiu khaau ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, I am totally transformed; I have obtained the nine treasures to use and consume.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਠਾਰਹ ਸਿਧੀ ਪਿਛੈ ਲਗੀਆ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: athaarah sidhee pichhai lageeaa phiran nij ghar vasai nij thaai ||
english: The Siddhis-the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers-follow in my footsteps; I dwell in my own home, within my own self.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਸਦ ਵਜਦੇ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anahad dhunee sad vajade unaman har liv laai ||
english: The Unstruck Melody constantly vibrates within; my mind is exalted and uplifted-I am lovingly absorbed in the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak har bhagat tinaa kai man vasai jin masatak likhiaa dhur paai ||2||
english: O Nanak, devotion to the Lord abides within the minds of those who have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hau dhaadhee har prabh khasam kaa har kai dar aaiaa ||
english: I am a minstrel of the Lord God, my Lord and Master; I have come to the Lord's Door.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਪੂਕਾਰ ਢਾਢੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)dar sunee pookaar dhaadhee mukh laaiaa ||
english: The Lord has heard my sad cries from within; He has called me, His minstrel, into His Presence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੁਛਿਆ ਢਾਢੀ ਸਦਿ ਕੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਅਰਥਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har puchhiaa dhaadhee sad kai kit arath too(n) aaiaa ||
english: The Lord called His minstrel in, and asked, "Why have you come here?"

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nit devahu daan daiaal prabh har naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: "O Merciful God, please grant me the gift of continual meditation on the Lord's Name."

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪੈਨਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
transliteration: har daatai har naam japaaiaa naanak painaaiaa ||21||1|| sudh
english: And so the Lord, the Great Giver, inspired Nanak to chant the Lord's Name, and blessed him with robes of honor. ||21||1||Sudh||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ॥ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag kabeer jeeu kaa || ek suaan kai ghar gaavanaa ||
english: Siree Raag, Kabeer Jee: To Be Sung To The Tune Of "Ayk Su-Aan" :

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਨੀ ਜਾਨਤ ਸੁਤੁ ਬਡਾ ਹੋਤੁ ਹੈ ਇਤਨਾ ਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨ ਅਵਧ ਘਟਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jananee jaanat sut badaa hot hai itanaa k na jaanai j din din avadh ghatat hai ||
english: The mother thinks that her son is growing up; she does not understand that, day by day, his life is diminishing.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਕਰਿ ਅਧਿਕ ਲਾਡੁ ਧਰਿ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਜਮਰਾਉ ਹਸੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mor mor kar adhik laad dhar pekhat hee jamaraau hasai ||1||
english: Calling him, "Mine, mine", she fondles him lovingly, while the Messenger of Death looks on and laughs. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਤੈਂ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aisaa tai(n) jag bharam laaiaa ||
english: You have misled the world so deeply in doubt.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੈਸੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਬ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaise boojhai jab mohiaa hai maaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How can people understand You, when they are entranced by Maya? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਇਤੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer chhod bikhiaa ras it sa(n)gat nihachau maranaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, give up the pleasures of corruption, or else you will surely die of them.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਮਈਆ ਜਪਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਅਨਤ ਜੀਵਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ramaeeaa japahu praanee anat jeevan baanee in bidh bhav saagar taranaa ||2||
english: Meditate on the Lord, O mortal being, through the Word of His Bani; you shall be blessed with eternal life. In this way, shall you cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) tis bhaavai taa laagai bhaau ||
english: As it pleases Him, people embrace love for the Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bharam bhulaavaa vichahu jaai ||
english: and doubt and delusion are dispelled from within.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਪਜੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: upajai sahaj giaan mat jaagai ||
english: Intuitive peace and poise well up within, and the intellect is awakened to spiritual wisdom.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur prasaad a(n)tar liv laagai ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, the inner being is touched by the Lord's Love. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: it sa(n)gat naahee maranaa ||
english: In this association, there is no death.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਮਿਲਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: hukam pachhaan taa khasamai milanaa ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||
english: Recognizing the Hukam of His Command, you shall meet with your Lord and Master. ||1||Second Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag trilochan kaa ||
english: Siree Raag, Trilochan:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਆਗਲੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਉ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu man aagalaRaa praanee jaraa maran bhau visar gaiaa ||
english: The mind is totally attached to Maya; the mortal has forgotten his fear of old age and death.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਗਸਹਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਜਿਉ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਕਪਟ ਨਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kuta(n)b dekh bigasahi kamalaa jiu par ghar johahi kapat naraa ||1||
english: Gazing upon his family, he blossoms forth like the lotus flower; the deceitful person watches and covets the homes of others. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੂੜਾ ਆਇਓਹਿ ਜਮਹਿ ਤਣਾ ॥
transliteration: dooRaa aaiohi jamahi tanaa ||
english: When the powerful Messenger of Death comes,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਆਗਲੜੈ ਮੈ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tin aagalaRai mai rahan na jaai ||
english: No one can stand against his awesome power.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਜਣੁ ਆਇ ਕਹੈ ॥
transliteration: koee koee saajan aai kahai ||
english: Rare, very rare, is that friend who comes and says,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਲੈ ਬਾਹੜੀ ਵਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mil mere beethulaa lai baahaRee valaai ||
english: "O my Beloved, take me into Your Embrace!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਮਈਆ ਮੈ ਲੇਹਿ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mil mere ramaeeaa mai lehi chhadaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O my Lord, please save me!" ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੋਗ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਪੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anik anik bhog raaj bisare praanee sa(n)saar saagar pai amar bhaiaa ||
english: Indulging in all sorts of princely pleasures, O mortal, you have forgotten God; you have fallen into the world-ocean, and you think that you have become immortal.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਠਾ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਆਲਸੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maaiaa moothaa chetas naahee janam gavaaio aalaseeaa ||2||
english: Cheated and plundered by Maya, you do not think of God, and you waste your life in laziness. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਮ ਘੋਰ ਪੰਥਿ ਚਾਲਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਤਹ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸੰ ॥
transliteration: bikham ghor pa(n)th chaalanaa praanee rav sas tah na pravesa(n) ||
english: The path you must walk is treacherous and terrifying, O mortal; neither the sun nor the moon shine there.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਬ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਂ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu tab bisar gaiaa jaa(n) tajeeale sa(n)saara(n) ||3||
english: Your emotional attachment to Maya will be forgotten, when you have to leave this world. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਪੇਖੀਅਲੇ ਧਰਮਰਾਓ ॥
transliteration: aaj merai man pragat bhaiaa hai pekheeale dharamaraao ||
english: Today, it became clear to my mind that the Righteous Judge of Dharma is watching us.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਕਰ ਦਲ ਕਰਨਿ ਮਹਾਬਲੀ ਤਿਨ ਆਗਲੜੈ ਮੈ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tah kar dal karan mahaabalee tin aagalaRai mai rahan na jaai ||4||
english: His messengers, with their awesome power, crush people between their hands; I cannot stand against them. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੂੰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਰਤੜਾ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਾ ॥
transliteration: je ko moo(n) upades karat hai taa van trin rataRaa naaraainaa ||
english: If someone is going to teach me something, let it be that the Lord is pervading the forests and fields.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਬਦਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੫॥੨॥
transliteration: ai jee too(n) aape sabh kichh jaanadaa badat trilochan raamaeeaa ||5||2||
english: O Dear Lord, You Yourself know everything; so prays Trilochan, Lord. ||5||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: sreeraag bhagat kabeer jeeu kaa ||
english: Siree Raag, Devotee Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡੀਆ ਅਬ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: acharaj ek sunahu re pa(n)deeaa ab kichh kahan na jaaee ||
english: Listen, O religious scholar: the One Lord alone is Wondrous; no one can describe Him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮੇਖੁਲੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sur nar gan ga(n)dhrab jin mohe tribhavan mekhulee laaee ||1||
english: He fascinates the angels, the celestial singers and the heavenly musicians; he has strung the three worlds upon His Thread. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਅਨਹਦ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: raajaa raam anahad ki(n)guree baajai ||
english: The Unstruck Melody of the Sovereign Lord's Harp vibrates;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਨਾਦ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee disat naad liv laagai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: by His Glance of Grace, we are lovingly attuned to the Sound-current of the Naad. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਾਠੀ ਗਗਨੁ ਸਿੰਙਿਆ ਅਰੁ ਚੁੰਙਿਆ ਕਨਕ ਕਲਸ ਇਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaathee gagan si(n)ngiaa ar chu(n)ngiaa kanak kalas ik paaiaa ||
english: The Tenth Gate of my crown chakra is the distilling fire, and the channels of the Ida and Pingala are the funnels, to pour in and empty out the golden vat.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਰਸਨ ਚੁਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis mahi dhaar chuai at niramal ras mahi rasan chuaaiaa ||2||
english: Into that vat, there trickles a gentle stream of the most sublime and pure essence of all distilled essences. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਜੁ ਬਾਤ ਅਨੂਪ ਬਨੀ ਹੈ ਪਵਨ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ek j baat anoop banee hai pavan piaalaa saajiaa ||
english: Something wonderful has happened-the breath has become the cup.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: teen bhavan mahi eko jogee kahahu kavan hai raajaa ||3||
english: In all the three worlds, such a Yogi is unique. What king can compare to him? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮ ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aise giaan pragatiaa purakhotam kahu kabeer ra(n)g raataa ||
english: This spiritual wisdom of God, the Supreme Soul, has illuminated my being. Says Kabeer, I am attuned to His Love.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਉਰ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: aur dunee sabh bharam bhulaanee man raam rasaain maataa ||4||3||
english: All the rest of the world is deluded by doubt, while my mind is intoxicated with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||4||3||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਬੇਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥ ਪਹਰਿਆ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sreeraag baanee bhagat benee jeeu kee || pahariaa kai ghar gaavanaa ||
english: Sree Raag, The Word Of Devotee Baynee Jee: To Be Sung To The Tune Of "Pehray":

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਜਬ ਆਛਤ ਉਰਧ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: re nar garabh ku(n)dal jab aachhat uradh dhiaan liv laagaa ||
english: O man, when you were coiled in the cradle of the womb, upside-down, you were absorbed in meditation.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਪਿੰਡਿ ਪਦ ਮਦ ਨਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਸੁ ਨਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: miratak pi(n)d pad mad naa ahinis ek agiaan s naagaa ||
english: You took no pride in your perishable body; night and day were all the same to you-you lived unknowing, in the silence of the void.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਦਿਨ ਸੰਮਲੁ ਕਸਟ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖ ਅਬ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: te din sa(n)mal kasat mahaa dukh ab chit adhik pasaariaa ||
english: Remember the terrible pain and suffering of those days, now that you have spread out the net of your consciousness far and wide.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਆਇਆ ਤਉ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: garabh chhod mrit ma(n)dal aaiaa tau narahar manahu bisaariaa ||1||
english: Leaving the womb, you entered this mortal world; you have forgotten the Lord from your mind. ||1||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿਗਾ ਮੂੜਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਕਵਨ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: phir pachhutaavahigaa mooRiaa too(n) kavan kumat bhram laagaa ||
english: Later, you will regret and repent-you fool! Why are you engrossed in evil-mindedness and skepticism?

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਚਰੈ ਅਨਰਾਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chet raam naahee jam pur jaahigaa jan bicharai anaraadhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Think of the Lord, or else you shall be led to the City of Death. Why are you wandering around, out of control? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਰਸ ਲਾਗਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: baal binod chi(n)d ras laagaa khin khin mohi biaapai ||
english: You play like a child, craving sweets; moment by moment, you become more entangled in emotional attachment.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਰਸੁ ਮਿਸੁ ਮੇਧੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਚਾਖੀ ਤਉ ਪੰਚ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: ras mis medh a(n)mrit bikh chaakhee tau pa(n)ch pragat sa(n)taapai ||
english: Tasting good and bad, you eat nectar and then poison, and then the five passions appear and torture you.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam chhod sukrit mat raam naam na araadhiaa ||
english: Abandoning meditation, penance and self-restraint, and the wisdom of good actions, you do not worship and adore the Lord's Name.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਉਛਲਿਆ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਾਲ ਮਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਤਉ ਆਨਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਗਲਿ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: uchhaliaa kaam kaal mat laagee tau aan sakat gal baa(n)dhiaa ||2||
english: You are overflowing with sexual desire, and your intellect is stained with darkness; you are held in the grip of Shakti's power. ||2||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਤਰੁਣ ਤੇਜੁ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਮੁਖੁ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਸਰੁ ਅਪਸਰੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tarun tej par tri mukh johahi sar apasar na pachhaaniaa ||
english: In the heat of youthful passion, you look with desire upon the faces of other men's wives; you do not distinguish between good and evil.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਉਨਮਤ ਕਾਮਿ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਭੂਲੈ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: unamat kaam mahaa bikh bhoolai paap pu(n)n na pachhaaniaa ||
english: Drunk with sexual desire and other great sins, you go astray, and do not distinguish between vice and virtue.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗਰਬਿਆ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੇ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sut sa(n)pat dekh ihu man garabiaa raam ridai te khoiaa ||
english: Gazing upon your children and your property, your mind is proud and arrogant; you cast out the Lord from your heart.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਮਰਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਲੇ ਤਉ ਭਗ ਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਵਿਗੋਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: avar marat maaiaa man tole tau bhag mukh janam vigoiaa ||3||
english: When others die, you measure your own wealth in your mind; you waste your life in the pleasures of the mouth and sexual organs. ||3||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਡਰ ਕੇਸ ਕੁਸਮ ਤੇ ਧਉਲੇ ਸਪਤ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: pu(n)dar kes kusam te dhaule sapat paataal kee baanee ||
english: Your hair is whiter than the jasmine flower, and your voice has grown feeble, as if it comes from the seventh underworld.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਲੋਚਨ ਸ੍ਰਮਹਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਨਾਠੀ ਤਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਪਵਸਿ ਮਾਧਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: lochan sramahi budh bal naathee taa kaam pavas maadhaanee ||
english: Your eyes water, and your intellect and strength have left you; but still, your sexual desire churns and drives you on.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਮਲੁ ਕੁਮਲਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: taa te bikhai bhaee mat paavas kaaiaa kamal kumalaanaa ||
english: And so, your intellect has dried up through corruption, and the lotus flower of your body has wilted and withered.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਤਿ ਬਾਣਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਤਉ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: avagat baan chhod mrit ma(n)dal tau paachhai pachhutaanaa ||4||
english: You have forsaken the Bani, the Word of the Immortal Lord, in this mortal world; in the end, you shall regret and repent. ||4||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕੁਟੀ ਦੇਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਾਨ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: nikutee deh dekh dhun upajai maan karat nahee boojhai ||
english: Gazing upon the tiny bodies of your children, love has welled up within your heart; you are proud of them, but you do not understand.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: laalach karai jeevan pad kaaran lochan kachhoo na soojhai ||
english: You long for the dignity of a long life, but your eyes can no longer see anything.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਥਾਕਾ ਤੇਜੁ ਉਡਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਂਗਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: thaakaa tej udiaa man pa(n)khee ghar aa(n)gan na sukhaaee ||
english: Your light has gone out, and the bird of your mind has flown away; you are no longer welcome in your own home and courtyard.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਬੇਣੀ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਮਰਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: benee kahai sunahu re bhagatahu maran mukat kin paaee ||5||
english: Says Baynee, listen, O devotee: who has ever attained liberation after such a death? ||5||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: sireeraag ||
english: Sree Raag:

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਤੋਹੀ ਮੋਹੀ ਮੋਹੀ ਤੋਹੀ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ॥
transliteration: tohee mohee mohee tohee a(n)tar kaisaa ||
english: You are me, and I am You-what is the difference between us?

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਕਨਕ ਕਟਿਕ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਜੈਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kanak katik jal tara(n)g jaisaa ||1||
english: We are like gold and the bracelet, or water and the waves. ||1||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਹਮ ਨ ਪਾਪ ਕਰੰਤਾ ਅਹੇ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jau pai ham na paap kara(n)taa ahe ana(n)taa ||
english: If I did not commit any sins, O Infinite Lord,

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਹੁੰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan naam kaise hu(n)taa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: how would You have acquired the name, 'Redeemer of sinners'? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਜੁ ਨਾਇਕ ਆਛਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: tumh j naaik aachhahu a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: You are my Master, the Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਨੀਜੈ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prabh te jan jaaneejai jan te suaamee ||2||
english: The servant is known by his God, and the Lord and Master is known by His servant. ||2||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਸਰੀਰੁ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਦੇਹੂ ॥
transliteration: sareer aaraadhai mo kau beechaar dehoo ||
english: Grant me the wisdom to worship and adore You with my body.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਮ ਦਲ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ਕੋਊ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ravidaas sam dal samajhaavai kooo ||3||
english: O Ravi Daas, one who understands that the Lord is equally in all, is very rare. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਝ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag maajh chaupade ghar 1 mahalaa 4 ||
english: Raag Maajh, Chau-Padhay, First House, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har har naam mai har man bhaaiaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee har naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: By great good fortune, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਲੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur poorai har naam sidh paaee ko viralaa guramat chalai jeeu ||1||
english: The Perfect Guru has attained spiritual perfection in the Name of the Lord. How rare are those who follow the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲਇਆ ਬੰਨਿ ਪਲੈ ॥
transliteration: mai har har kharach laiaa ba(n)n palai ||
english: I have loaded my pack with the provisions of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਖਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
transliteration: meraa praan sakhaaee sadaa naal chalai ||
english: The Companion of my breath of life shall always be with me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur poorai har naam diRaaiaa har nihachal har dhan palai jeeu ||2||
english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me. I have the Imperishable Treasure of the Lord in my lap. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har har sajan meraa preetam raaiaa ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is my Best Friend; He is my Beloved Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: koee aan milaavai mere praan jeevaaiaa ||
english: If only someone would come and introduce me to Him, the Rejuvenator of my breath of life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਮੈ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਹੇ ਵਹਿ ਚਲੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hau rahi na sakaa bin dekhe preetamaa mai neer vahe vahi chalai jeeu ||3||
english: I cannot survive without seeing my Beloved. My eyes are welling up with tears. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur mitr meraa baal sakhaaee ||
english: My Friend, the True Guru, has been my Best Friend since I was very young.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hau rahi na sakaa bin dekhe meree maaee ||
english: I cannot survive without seeing Him, O my mother!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: har jeeu kripaa karahu gur melahu jan naanak har dhan palai jeeu ||4||1||
english: O Dear Lord, please show Mercy to me, that I may meet the Guru. Servant Nanak gathers the Wealth of the Lord's Name in his lap. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: madhusoodan mere man tan praanaa ||
english: The Lord is my mind, body and breath of life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: hau har bin doojaa avar na jaanaa ||
english: I do not know any other than the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: koee sajan sa(n)t milai vadabhaagee mai har prabh piaaraa dasai jeeu ||1||
english: If only I could have the good fortune to meet some friendly Saint; he might show me the Way to my Beloved Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਜੀ ਭਾਲਿ ਭਾਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hau man tan khojee bhaal bhaalaaee ||
english: I have searched my mind and body, through and through.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kiu piaaraa preetam milai meree maaee ||
english: How can I meet my Darling Beloved, O my mother?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat khoj dasaaee vich sa(n)gat har prabh vasai jeeu ||2||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I ask about the Path to God. In that Congregation, the Lord God abides. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa piaaraa preetam satigur rakhavaalaa ||
english: My Darling Beloved True Guru is my Protector.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ham baarik deen karahu pratipaalaa ||
english: I am a helpless child-please cherish me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: meraa maat pitaa gur satigur pooraa gur jal mil kamal vigasai jeeu ||3||
english: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, is my Mother and Father. Obtaining the Water of the Guru, the lotus of my heart blossoms forth. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mai bin gur dekhe need na aavai ||
english: Without seeing my Guru, sleep does not come.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਨਿ ਵੇਦਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mere man tan vedan gur birahu lagaavai ||
english: My mind and body are afflicted with the pain of separation from the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: har har daiaa karahu gur melahu jan naanak gur mil rahasai jeeu ||4||2||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, show mercy to me, that I may meet my Guru. Meeting the Guru, servant Nanak blossoms forth. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har gun paReeai har gun guneeai ||
english: Read of the Lord's Glories and reflect upon the Lord's Glories.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har har naam kathaa nit suneeai ||
english: Listen continually to the Sermon of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਜਗੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat har gun gaae jag bhaujal dutar tareeai jeeu ||1||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, you shall cross over the treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aau sakhee har mel karehaa ||
english: Come, friends, let us meet our Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਾ ਮੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: mere preetam kaa mai dei sanehaa ||
english: Bring me a message from my Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਖਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਰਹਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: meraa mitr sakhaa so preetam bhaaee mai dase har narahareeai jeeu ||2||
english: He alone is a friend, companion, beloved and brother of mine, who shows me the way to the Lord, the Lord of all. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਬੇਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: meree bedan har gur pooraa jaanai ||
english: My illness is known only to the Lord and the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: hau rahi na sakaa bin naam vakhaane ||
english: I cannot continue living without chanting the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mai aukhadh ma(n)tr deejai gur poore mai har har naam udhareeai jeeu ||3||
english: So give me the medicine, the Mantra of the Perfect Guru. Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am saved. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ham chaatrik deen satigur saranaaee ||
english: I am just a poor song-bird, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har har naam boo(n)d mukh paaee ||
english: who has placed the Drop of Water, the Lord's Name, Har, Har, in my mouth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਹਮ ਜਲ ਕੇ ਮੀਨੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: har jalanidh ham jal ke meene jan naanak jal bin mareeai jeeu ||4||3||
english: The Lord is the Treasure of Water; I am just a fish in that water. Without this Water, servant Nanak would die. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har jan sa(n)t milahu mere bhaaee ||
english: O servants of the Lord, O Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny, let us join together!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਸਹੁ ਮੈ ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: meraa har prabh dasahu mai bhukh lagaaee ||
english: Show me the way to my Lord God-I am so hungry for Him!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: meree saradhaa poor jagajeevan daate mil har darasan man bheejai jeeu ||1||
english: Please reward my faith, O Life of the World, O Great Giver. Obtaining the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my mind is fulfilled. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: mil satasa(n)g bolee har baanee ||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I chant the Bani of the Lord's Word.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har har kathaa merai man bhaanee ||
english: The Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har har a(n)mrit har man bhaavai mil satigur a(n)mrit peejai jeeu ||2||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is so sweet to my mind. Meeting the True Guru, I drink in this Ambrosial Nectar. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee har sa(n)gat paavahi ||
english: By great good fortune, the Lord's Congregation is found,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bhaagaheen bhram chotaa khaavahi ||
english: while the unfortunate ones wander around in doubt, enduring painful beatings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin bhaagaa satasa(n)g na labhai bin sa(n)gat mail bhareejai jeeu ||3||
english: Without good fortune, the Sat Sangat is not found; without this Sangat, people are stained with filth and pollution. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mai aai milahu jagajeevan piaare ||
english: Come and meet me, O Life of the World, my Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam daiaa man dhaare ||
english: Please bless me with Your Mercy, and enshrine Your Name, Har, Har, within my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: guramat naam meethaa man bhaaiaa jan naanak naam man bheejai jeeu ||4||4||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Sweet Name has become pleasing to my mind. Servant Nanak's mind is drenched and delighted with the Naam. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har gur giaan har ras har paaiaa ||
english: Through the Guru, I have obtained the Lord's spiritual wisdom. I have obtained the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man har ra(n)g raataa har ras peeaaiaa ||
english: My mind is imbued with the Love of the Lord; I drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਟੁਲਿ ਟੁਲਿ ਪਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har naam mukh har har bolee man har ras tul tul paudaa jeeu ||1||
english: With my mouth, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; my mind is filled to overflowing with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੈ ਗਲਿ ਮੇਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: aavahu sa(n)t mai gal melaaeeai ||
english: Come, O Saints, and lead me to my Lord's Embrace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: mere preetam kee mai kathaa sunaaeeai ||
english: Recite to me the Sermon of my Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਚਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t milahu man devaa jo gurabaanee mukh chaudaa jeeu ||2||
english: I dedicate my mind to those Saints of the Lord, who chant the Word of the Guru's Bani with their mouths. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee har sa(n)t milaaiaa ||
english: By great good fortune, the Lord has led me to meet His Saint.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai har ras mukh paaiaa ||
english: The Perfect Guru has placed the Sublime Essence of the Lord into my mouth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੂਨੀ ਨਿਤਿ ਪਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhaagaheen satigur nahee paaiaa manamukh garabh joonee nit paudaa jeeu ||3||
english: The unfortunate ones do not find the True Guru; the self-willed manmukhs continually endure reincarnation through the womb. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aap daiaal daiaa prabh dhaaree ||
english: God, the Merciful, has Himself bestowed His Mercy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਭ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: mal haumai bikhiaa sabh nivaaree ||
english: He has totally removed the poisonous pollution of egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak hat patan vich kaa(n)iaa har lai(n)de guramukh saudaa jeeu ||4||5||
english: O Nanak, in the shops of the city of the human body, the Gurmukhs buy the merchandise of the Lord's Name. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: hau gun govi(n)d har naam dhiaaee ||
english: I meditate on the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)gat man naam vasaaee ||
english: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the Name comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਕੀਚੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har prabh agam agochar suaamee mil satigur har ras keechai jeeu ||1||
english: The Lord God is our Lord and Master, Inaccessible and Unfathomable. Meeting the True Guru, I enjoy the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan har jan jin har prabh jaataa ||
english: Blessed, blessed are the humble servants of the Lord, who know the Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਾ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jaai puchhaa jan har kee baataa ||
english: I go and ask those humble servants about the Mysteries of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਚੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paav malovaa mal mal dhovaa mil har jan har ras peechai jeeu ||2||
english: I wash and massage their feet; joining with the humble servants of the Lord, I drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur daatai naam diRaaiaa ||
english: The True Guru, the Giver, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee gur darasan paaiaa ||
english: By great good fortune, I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੋਲੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੀਚੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit ras sach a(n)mrit bolee gur poorai a(n)mrit leechai jeeu ||3||
english: The True Essence is Ambrosial Nectar; through the Ambrosial Words of the Perfect Guru, this Amrit is obtained. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: har satasa(n)gat sat purakh milaaeeai ||
english: O Lord, lead me to the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and the true beings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat har naam dhiaaeeai ||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਰੀਚੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak har kathaa sunee mukh bolee guramat har naam pareechai jeeu ||4||6||
english: O Nanak, I listen and chant the Lord's Sermon; through the Guru's Teachings, I am fulfilled by the Name of the Lord. ||4||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਭੈਣੇ ਤੁਸੀ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aavahu bhaine tusee milahu piaareeaa ||
english: Come, dear sisters-let us join together.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦਸੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jo meraa preetam dase tis kai hau vaareeaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the one who tells me of my Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੁਮਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat ladhaa har sajan hau satigur vitahu ghumaaeeaa jeeu ||1||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have found the Lord, my Best Friend. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: jah jah dekhaa tah tah suaamee ||
english: Wherever I look, there I see my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: too ghat ghat raviaa a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: You are permeating each and every heart, O Lord, Inner-knower, Searcher of Hearts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur poorai har naal dikhaaliaa hau satigur vitahu sad vaariaa jeeu ||2||
english: The Perfect Guru has shown me that the Lord is always with me. I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਮਾਟੀ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: eko pavan maatee sabh ekaa sabh ekaa jot sabaaeeaa ||
english: There is only one breath; all are made of the same clay; the light within all is the same.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਇਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਭਿਨਿ ਭਿਨਿ ਨ ਰਲਈ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਰਲਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh ikaa jot varatai bhin bhin na ralaee kisai dee ralaaeeaa ||
english: The One Light pervades all the many and various beings. This Light intermingles with them, but it is not diluted or obscured.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਇਕੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਤਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ik nadaree aaiaa hau satigur vitahu vataaiaa jeeu ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have come to see the One. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak bolai a(n)mrit baanee ||
english: Servant Nanak speaks the Ambrosial Bani of the Word.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa(n) kai man piaaree bhaanee ||
english: It is dear and pleasing to the minds of the GurSikhs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: upades kare gur satigur pooraa gur satigur paraupakaareeaa jeeu ||4||7||
english: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, shares the Teachings. The Guru, the True Guru, is Generous to all. ||4||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਮਹਲੇ ਚਉਥੇ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: sat chaupade mahale chauthe ke ||
english: Seven Chau-Padhay Of The Fourth Mehl. ||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 1 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: meraa man lochai gur darasan taaee ||
english: My mind longs for the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਪ ਕਰੇ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: bilap kare chaatrik kee niaaee ||
english: It cries out like the thirsty song-bird.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: trikhaa na utarai saa(n)t na aavai bin darasan sa(n)t piaare jeeu ||1||
english: My thirst is not quenched, and I can find no peace, without the Blessed Vision of the Beloved Saint. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau gholee jeeu ghol ghumaaee gur darasan sa(n)t piaare jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the Blessed Vision of the Beloved Saint Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਜੀਉ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: teraa mukh suhaavaa jeeu sahaj dhun baanee ||
english: Your Face is so Beautiful, and the Sound of Your Words imparts intuitive wisdom.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: chir hoaa dekhe saari(n)gapaanee ||
english: It is so long since this rainbird has had even a glimpse of water.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਜਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਜਣ ਮੀਤ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s des jahaa too(n) vasiaa mere sajan meet muraare jeeu ||2||
english: Blessed is that land where You dwell, O my Friend and Intimate Divine Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ ਹਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਜਣ ਮੀਤ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau gholee hau ghol ghumaaee gur sajan meet muraare jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice, I am forever a sacrifice, to my Friend and Intimate Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਮਿਲਤੇ ਤਾ ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ik ghaRee na milate taa kalijug hotaa ||
english: When I could not be with You for just one moment, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga dawned for me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਣਿ ਕਦਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: hun kad mileeai pri tudh bhagava(n)taa ||
english: When will I meet You, O my Beloved Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਨ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mohi rain na vihaavai need na aavai bin dekhe gur darabaare jeeu ||3||
english: I cannot endure the night, and sleep does not come, without the Sight of the Beloved Guru's Court. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau gholee jeeu ghol ghumaaee tis sache gur darabaare jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to that True Court of the Beloved Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaag hoaa gur sa(n)t milaaiaa ||
english: By good fortune, I have met the Saint Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh abinaasee ghar mahi paaiaa ||
english: I have found the Immortal Lord within the home of my own self.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀ ਪਲੁ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sev karee pal chasaa na vichhuRaa jan naanak daas tumaare jeeu ||4||
english: I will now serve You forever, and I shall never be separated from You, even for an instant. Servant Nanak is Your slave, O Beloved Master. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੧॥੮॥
transliteration: hau gholee jeeu ghol ghumaaee jan naanak daas tumaare jeeu || rahaau ||1||8||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice; servant Nanak is Your slave, Lord. ||Pause||1||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: saa rut suhaavee jit tudh samaalee ||
english: Sweet is that season when I remember You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕੰਮੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਘਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: so ka(n)m suhelaa jo teree ghaalee ||
english: Sublime is that work which is done for You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਰਿਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੂੰ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so ridaa suhelaa jit ridai too(n) vuthaa sabhanaa ke daataaraa jeeu ||1||
english: Blessed is that heart in which You dwell, O Giver of all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਝਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) saajhaa saahib baap hamaaraa ||
english: You are the Universal Father of all, O my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: nau nidh terai akhut bha(n)daaraa ||
english: Your nine treasures are an inexhaustible storehouse.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis too(n) dehi s tripat aghaavai soee bhagat tumaaraa jeeu ||2||
english: Those unto whom You give are satisfied and fulfilled; they become Your devotees, Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਸੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਬੈਠਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko aasai teree baithaa ||
english: All place their hopes in You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar too(n)hai vuthaa ||
english: You dwell deep within each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਸਾਝੀਵਾਲ ਸਦਾਇਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabhe saajheevaal sadaain too(n) kisai na disahi baaharaa jeeu ||3||
english: All share in Your Grace; none are beyond You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape guramukh mukat karaaihi ||
english: You Yourself liberate the Gurmukhs;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਭਵਾਇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape manamukh janam bhavaaihi ||
english: You Yourself consign the self-willed manmukhs to wander in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਦਸਾਹਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak daas terai balihaarai sabh teraa khel dasaaharaa jeeu ||4||2||9||
english: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to You; Your Entire Play is self-evident, Lord. ||4||2||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: anahad vaajai sahaj suhelaa ||
english: The Unstruck Melody resounds and resonates in peaceful ease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad ana(n)d kare sad kelaa ||
english: I rejoice in the eternal bliss of the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਆਸਣੁ ਊਚ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sahaj guphaa mahi taaRee laaee aasan ooch savaariaa jeeu ||1||
english: In the cave of intuitive wisdom I sit, absorbed in the silent trance of the Primal Void. I have obtained my seat in the heavens. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਘਿਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: phir ghir apune grih mahi aaiaa ||
english: After wandering through many other homes and houses, I have returned to my own home,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jo loReedaa soee paaiaa ||
english: and I have found what I was longing for.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹਿਆ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਨਭਉ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਿਖਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tripat aghaai rahiaa hai sa(n)tahu gur anabhau purakh dikhaariaa jeeu ||2||
english: I am satisfied and fulfilled; O Saints, the Guru has shown me the Fearless Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਾਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਲੋਗਾ ॥
transliteration: aape raajan aape logaa ||
english: He Himself is the King, and He Himself is the people.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗਾ ॥
transliteration: aap nirabaanee aape bhogaa ||
english: He Himself is in Nirvaanaa, and He Himself indulges in pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਈ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape takhat bahai sach niaaee sabh chookee kook pukaariaa jeeu ||3||
english: He Himself sits on the throne of true justice, answering the cries and prayers of all. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਡਿਠਾ ਮੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jehaa dithaa mai teho kahiaa ||
english: As I have seen Him, so have I described Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tis ras aaiaa jin bhed lahiaa ||
english: This Sublime Essence comes only to one who knows the Mystery of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੦॥
transliteration: jotee jot milee sukh paaiaa jan naanak ik pasaariaa jeeu ||4||3||10||
english: His light merges into the Light, and he finds peace. O servant Nanak, this is all the Extension of the One. ||4||3||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਿਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jit ghar pir sohaag banaaiaa ||
english: That house, in which the soul-bride has married her Husband Lord

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tit ghar sakheee ma(n)gal gaaiaa ||
english: in that house, O my companions, sing the songs of rejoicing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਤਿਤੈ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਜੋ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਸਿਗਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anad binod titai ghar sohahi jo dhan ka(n)t sigaaree jeeu ||1||
english: Joy and celebrations decorate that house, in which the Husband Lord has adorned His soul-bride. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਣਿ ॥
transliteration: saa gunava(n)tee saa vadabhaagan ||
english: She is virtuous, and she is very fortunate;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰਵੰਤੀ ਸੀਲਵੰਤਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ॥
transliteration: putrava(n)tee seelava(n)t sohaagan ||
english: she is blessed with sons and tender-hearted. The happy soul-bride is loved by her Husband.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪਵੰਤਿ ਸਾ ਸੁਘੜਿ ਬਿਚਖਣਿ ਜੋ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: roopava(n)t saa sughaR bichakhan jo dhan ka(n)t piaaree jeeu ||2||
english: She is beautiful, wise, and clever. That soul-bride is the beloved of her Husband Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਾਰਵੰਤਿ ਸਾਈ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: achaarava(n)t saaee paradhaane ||
english: She is well-mannered, noble and distinguished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਬਣੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh si(n)gaar bane tis giaane ||
english: She is decorated and adorned with wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੀ ਸਾ ਸਭਰਾਈ ਜੋ ਪਿਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saa kulava(n)tee saa sabharaaee jo pir kai ra(n)g savaaree jeeu ||3||
english: She is from a most respected family; she is the queen, adorned with the Love of her Husband Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mahimaa tis kee kahan na jaae ||
english: Her glory cannot be described;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਅੰਗਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jo pir mel laee a(n)g laae ||
english: she melts in the Embrace of her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਵਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਾਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: thir suhaag var agam agochar jan naanak prem saadhaaree jeeu ||4||4||11||
english: Her marriage is eternal; her Husband is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. O Servant Nanak, His Love is her only Support. ||4||4||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਦਰਸਨ ਚਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat darasan chaahe ||
english: I have searched and searched, seeking the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਨ ਬਨ ਅਵਗਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: bhaat bhaat ban ban avagaahe ||
english: I travelled through all sorts of woods and forests.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਜੀਉ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: niragun saragun har har meraa koee hai jeeu aan milaavai jeeu ||1||
english: My Lord, Har, Har, is both absolute and related, unmanifest and manifest; is there anyone who can come and unite me with Him? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤ ਬਿਚਰਤ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: khat saasat bicharat mukh giaanaa ||
english: People recite from memory the wisdom of the six schools of philosophy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: poojaa tilak teerath isanaanaa ||
english: they perform worship services, wear ceremonial religious marks on their foreheads, and take ritual cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਵਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਆਸਨ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nivalee karam aasan chauraaseeh in mahi saa(n)t na aavai jeeu ||2||
english: They perform the inner cleansing practice with water and adopt the eighty-four Yogic postures; but still, they find no peace in any of these. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਰਖ ਕੀਏ ਜਪ ਤਾਪਾ ॥
transliteration: anik barakh keee jap taapaa ||
english: They chant and meditate, practicing austere self-discipline for years and years;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਵਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਧਰਤੀ ਭਰਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gavan keeaa dharatee bharamaataa ||
english: they wander on journeys all over the earth;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ik khin hiradai saa(n)t na aavai jogee bahuR bahuR uth dhaavai jeeu ||3||
english: and yet, their hearts are not at peace, even for an instant. The Yogi rises up and goes out, over and over again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi saadh milaaiaa ||
english: By His Mercy, I have met the Holy Saint.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man tan seetal dheeraj paaiaa ||
english: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed; I have been blessed with patience and composure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਬਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨॥
transliteration: prabh abinaasee basiaa ghat bheetar har ma(n)gal naanak gaavai jeeu ||4||5||12||
english: The Immortal Lord God has come to dwell within my heart. Nanak sings the songs of joy to the Lord. ||4||5||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham apara(n)par devaa ||
english: The Supreme Lord God is Infinite and Divine;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar alakh abhevaa ||
english: He is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, Invisible and Inscrutable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: deen daiaal gopaal gobi(n)daa har dhiaavahu guramukh gaatee jeeu ||1||
english: Merciful to the meek, Sustainer of the World, Lord of the Universe-meditating on the Lord, the Gurmukhs find salvation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh madhusoodan nisataare ||
english: The Gurmukhs are emancipated by the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sa(n)gee krisan muraare ||
english: The Lord Krishna becomes the Gurmukh's Companion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਦਮੋਦਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਭਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: daiaal damodar guramukh paaeeai horat kitai na bhaatee jeeu ||2||
english: The Gurmukh finds the Merciful Lord. He is not found any other way. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਹਾਰੀ ਕੇਸਵ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਾ ॥
transliteration: nirahaaree kesav niravairaa ||
english: He does not need to eat; His Hair is Wondrous and Beautiful; He is free of hate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਪੈਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kot janaa jaa ke poojahi pairaa ||
english: Millions of people worship His Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਇਕਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh hiradai jaa kai har har soee bhagat ikaatee jeeu ||3||
english: He alone is a devotee, who becomes Gurmukh, whose heart is filled with the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸਨ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: amogh darasan bea(n)t apaaraa ||
english: Forever fruitful is the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; He is Infinite and Incomparable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: vad samarath sadaa daataaraa ||
english: He is Awesome and All-powerful; He is forever the Great Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਜਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੩॥
transliteration: guramukh naam japeeai tit tareeai gat naanak viralee jaatee jeeu ||4||6||13||
english: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall be carried across. O Nanak, rare are those who know this state! ||4||6||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿਆ ਕਰਣਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਲੈਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kahiaa karanaa ditaa lainaa ||
english: As You command, I obey; as You give, I receive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰੀਬਾ ਅਨਾਥਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gareebaa anaathaa teraa maanaa ||
english: You are the Pride of the meek and the poor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh kichh too(n)hai too(n)hai mere piaare teree kudarat kau bal jaaee jeeu ||1||
english: You are everything; You are my Beloved. I am a sacrifice to Your Creative Power. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਉਝੜ ਭਾਣੈ ਰਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai ujhaR bhaanai raahaa ||
english: By Your Will, we wander in the wilderness; by Your Will, we find the path.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai har gun guramukh gaavaahaa ||
english: By Your Will, we become Gurmukh and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਜੂਨੀ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhaanai bharam bhavai bahu joonee sabh kichh tisai rajaaee jeeu ||2||
english: By Your Will, we wander in doubt through countless lifetimes. Everything happens by Your Will. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
transliteration: naa ko moorakh naa ko siaanaa ||
english: No one is foolish, and no one is clever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: varatai sabh kichh teraa bhaanaa ||
english: Your Will determines everything;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: agam agochar bea(n)t athaahaa teree keemat kahan na jaaee jeeu ||3||
english: You are Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, Infinite and Unfathomable. Your Value cannot be expressed. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਕੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: khaak sa(n)tan kee dehu piaare ||
english: Please bless me with the dust of the Saints, O my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aai paiaa har terai duaarai ||
english: I have come and fallen at Your Door, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਮਨੁ ਆਘਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੪॥
transliteration: darasan pekhat man aaghaavai naanak milan subhaaee jeeu ||4||7||14||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my mind is fulfilled. O Nanak, with natural ease, I merge into Him. ||4||7||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਤਦੇ ਜਾ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dukh tade jaa visar jaavai ||
english: They forget the Lord, and they suffer in pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੁਖ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bhukh viaapai bahu bidh dhaavai ||
english: Afflicted with hunger, they run around in all directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: simarat naam sadaa suhelaa jis devai deen daiaalaa jeeu ||1||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, they are happy forever. The Lord, Merciful to the meek, bestows it upon them. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur meraa vad samarathaa ||
english: My True Guru is absolutely All-powerful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਇ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਥਾ ॥
transliteration: jeei samaalee taa sabh dukh lathaa ||
english: When I dwell upon Him in my soul, all my sorrows depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਈ ਹਉ ਪੀੜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chi(n)taa rog gaee hau peeRaa aap kare pratipaalaa jeeu ||2||
english: The sickness of anxiety and the disease of ego are cured; He Himself cherishes me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿਕ ਵਾਂਗੀ ਹਉ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: baarik vaa(n)gee hau sabh kichh ma(n)gaa ||
english: Like a child, I ask for everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: dede tot naahee prabh ra(n)gaa ||
english: God is Bountiful and Beautiful; He never comes up empty.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਾਈ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pairee pai pai bahut manaaee deen daiaal gopaalaa jeeu ||3||
english: Again and again, I fall at His Feet. He is Merciful to the meek, the Sustainer of the World. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur poore ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jin ba(n)dhan kaate sagale mere ||
english: who has shattered all my bonds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੫॥
transliteration: hiradai naam de niramal keee naanak ra(n)g rasaalaa jeeu ||4||8||15||
english: With the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in my heart, I have been purified. O Nanak, His Love has imbued me with nectar. ||4||8||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ॥
transliteration: laal gopaal daiaal ra(n)geele ||
english: O my Love, Sustainer of the World, Merciful, Loving Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: gahir ga(n)bheer bea(n)t govi(n)de ||
english: Profoundly Deep, Infinite Lord of the Universe,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਅਥਾਹ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ooch athaah bea(n)t suaamee simar simar hau jeevaa(n) jeeu ||1||
english: Highest of the High, Unfathomable, Infinite Lord and Master: continually remembering You in deep meditation, I live. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਮੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: dukh bha(n)jan nidhaan amole ||
english: O Destroyer of pain, Priceless Treasure,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਤੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau niravair athaah atole ||
english: Fearless, free of hate, Unfathomable, Immeasurable,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੰਭੌ ਮਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਠੰਢਾ ਥੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: akaal moorat ajoonee sa(n)bhau man simarat tha(n)dhaa theevaa(n) jeeu ||2||
english: of Undying Form, Unborn, Self-illumined: remembering You in meditation, my mind is filled with a deep and profound peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sa(n)gee har ra(n)g gopaalaa ||
english: The Joyous Lord, the Sustainer of the World, is my constant Companion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ooch neech kare pratipaalaa ||
english: He cherishes the high and the low.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਇਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam rasaain man tripataain guramukh a(n)mrit peevaa(n) jeeu ||3||
english: The Nectar of the Name satisfies my mind. As Gurmukh, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh piaare tudh dhiaaee ||
