english: In suffering and in comfort, I meditate on You, O Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: eh sumat guroo te paaee ||
english: I have obtained this sublime understanding from the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਧਰ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak kee dhar too(n)hai thaakur har ra(n)g paar pareevaa(n) jeeu ||4||9||16||
english: You are Nanak's Support, O my Lord and Master; through Your Love, I swim across to the other side. ||4||9||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s velaa jit mai satigur miliaa ||
english: Blessed is that time when I meet the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saphal darasan netr pekhat tariaa ||
english: Gazing upon the Fruitful Vision of His Darshan, I have been saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਮੂਰਤ ਚਸੇ ਪਲ ਘੜੀਆ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁ ਓਇ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dha(n)n moorat chase pal ghaReeaa dha(n)n s oi sa(n)jogaa jeeu ||1||
english: Blessed are the hours, the minutes and the seconds-blessed is that Union with Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
transliteration: udam karat man niramal hoaa ||
english: Making the effort, my mind has become pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਤ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har maarag chalat bhram sagalaa khoiaa ||
english: Walking on the Lord's Path, my doubts have all been cast out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan satiguroo sunaaiaa mit gae sagale rogaa jeeu ||2||
english: The True Guru has inspired me to hear the Treasure of the Naam; all my illness has been dispelled. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar teree baanee ||
english: The Word of Your Bani is inside and outside as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਥੀ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: tudh aap kathee tai aap vakhaanee ||
english: You Yourself chant it, and You Yourself speak it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kahiaa sabh eko eko avar na koee hoigaa jeeu ||3||
english: The Guru has said that He is One-All is the One. There shall never be any other. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪੀਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit ras har gur te peeaa ||
english: I drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Essence from the Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har painan naam bhojan theeaa ||
english: the Lord's Name has become my clothing and food.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਮਿ ਚੋਜ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਨੇ ਭੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naam ra(n)g naam choj tamaase naau naanak keene bhogaa jeeu ||4||10||17||
english: The Name is my delight, the Name is my play and entertainment. O Nanak, I have made the Name my enjoyment. ||4||10||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਇਕ ਮਾਂਗਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal sa(n)tan pahi vasat ik maa(n)gau ||
english: I beg of all the Saints: please, give me the merchandise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਉ ॥
transliteration: karau bina(n)tee maan tiaagau ||
english: I offer my prayers-I have forsaken my pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਲਖ ਵਰੀਆ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vaar vaar jaaee lakh vareeaa dehu sa(n)tan kee dhooraa jeeu ||1||
english: I am a sacrifice, hundreds of thousands of times a sacrifice, and I pray: please, give me the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: tum daate tum purakh bidhaate ||
english: You are the Giver, You are the Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: tum samarath sadaa sukhadaate ||
english: You are All-powerful, the Giver of Eternal Peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੋ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਵਰਸਾਵੈ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh ko tum hee te varasaavai ausar karahu hamaaraa pooraa jeeu ||2||
english: You bless everyone. Please bring my life to fulfillment. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਵਨ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: darasan terai bhavan puneetaa ||
english: The body-temple is sanctified by the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਗੜੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਹੀ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aatam gaR bikham tinaa hee jeetaa ||
english: and thus, the impregnable fort of the soul is conquered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tum daate tum purakh bidhaate tudh jevad avar na sooraa jeeu ||3||
english: You are the Giver, You are the Architect of Destiny. There is no other warrior as great as You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: ren sa(n)tan kee merai mukh laagee ||
english: I applied the dust of the feet of the Saints to my face.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਅਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: duramat binasee kubudh abhaagee ||
english: My evil-mindedness disappeared, along with my misfortune and false-mindedness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੮॥
transliteration: sach ghar bais rahe gun gaae naanak binase kooraa jeeu ||4||11||18||
english: I sit in the true home of my self; I sing His Glorious Praises. O Nanak, my falsehood has vanished! ||4||11||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਵਡ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: visar naahee evad daate ||
english: I shall never forget You-You are such a Great Giver!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa bhagatan sa(n)g raate ||
english: Please grant Your Grace, and imbue me with the love of devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਏਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dinas rain jiu tudh dhiaaee ehu daan mohi karanaa jeeu ||1||
english: If it pleases You, let me meditate on You day and night; please, grant me this gift! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਅੰਧੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maatee a(n)dhee surat samaaee ||
english: Into this blind clay, You have infused awareness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ਭਲੀਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh deeaa bhaleeaa jaaee ||
english: Everything, everywhere which You have given is good.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਚੋਜ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anad binod choj tamaase tudh bhaavai so honaa jeeu ||2||
english: Bliss, joyful celebrations, wondrous plays and entertainment-whatever pleases You, comes to pass. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੈਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jis daa ditaa sabh kichh lainaa ||
english: Everything we receive is a gift from Him

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: chhateeh a(n)mrit bhojan khaanaa ||
english: -the thirty-six delicious foods to eat,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਪਵਣਾ ਸਹਜ ਕੇਲ ਰੰਗ ਕਰਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sej sukhaalee seetal pavanaa sahaj kel ra(n)g karanaa jeeu ||3||
english: cozy beds, cooling breezes, peaceful joy and the experience of pleasure. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: saa budh deejai jit visarahi naahee ||
english: Give me that state of mind, by which I may not forget You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: saa mat deejai jit tudh dhiaaee ||
english: Give me that understanding, by which I may meditate on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੯॥
transliteration: saas saas tere gun gaavaa ot naanak gur charanaa jeeu ||4||12||19||
english: I sing Your Glorious Praises with each and every breath. Nanak takes the Support of the Guru's Feet. ||4||12||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: siphat saalaahan teraa hukam rajaaee ||
english: To praise You is to follow Your Command and Your Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: so giaan dhiaan jo tudh bhaaee ||
english: That which pleases You is spiritual wisdom and meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਜਪੁ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਪੂਰ ਗਿਆਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: soee jap jo prabh jeeu bhaavai bhaanai poor giaanaa jeeu ||1||
english: That which pleases God is chanting and meditation; to be in harmony with His Will is perfect spiritual wisdom. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam teraa soee gaavai ||
english: He alone sings Your Ambrosial Naam,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo saahib terai man bhaavai ||
english: Who is pleasing to Your Mind, O my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too(n) sa(n)tan kaa sa(n)t tumaare sa(n)t saahib man maanaa jeeu ||2||
english: You belong to the Saints, and the Saints belong to You. The minds of the Saints are attuned to You, O my Lord and Master. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sa(n)tan kee karahi pratipaalaa ||
english: You cherish and nurture the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਖੇਲਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t khelahi tum sa(n)g gopaalaa ||
english: The Saints play with You, O Sustainer of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਖਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੂ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: apune sa(n)t tudh khare piaare too sa(n)tan ke praanaa jeeu ||3||
english: Your Saints are very dear to You. You are the breath of life of the Saints. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: un sa(n)tan kai meraa man kurabaane ||
english: My mind is a sacrifice to those Saints who know You,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: jin too(n) jaataa jo tudh man bhaane ||
english: and are pleasing to Your Mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੦॥
transliteration: tin kai sa(n)g sadaa sukh paaiaa har ras naanak tripat aghaanaa jeeu ||4||13||20||
english: In their company I have found a lasting peace. Nanak is satisfied and fulfilled with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||4||13||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਹਮ ਮੀਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: too(n) jalanidh ham meen tumaare ||
english: You are the Ocean of Water, and I am Your fish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤਿਖਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: teraa naam boo(n)d ham chaatrik tikhahaare ||
english: Your Name is the drop of water, and I am a thirsty rainbird.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tumaree aas piaasaa tumaree tum hee sa(n)g man leenaa jeeu ||1||
english: You are my hope, and You are my thirst. My mind is absorbed in You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਪੀ ਖੀਰੁ ਅਘਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu baarik pee kheer aghaavai ||
english: Just as the baby is satisfied by drinking milk,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu niradhan dhan dekh sukh paavai ||
english: and the poor person is pleased by seeing wealth,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ ਜਲੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਠੰਢਾ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: trikhaava(n)t jal peevat tha(n)dhaa tiu har sa(n)g ihu man bheenaa jeeu ||2||
english: and the thirsty person is refreshed by drinking cool water, so is this mind drenched with delight in the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu a(n)dhiaarai deepak paragaasaa ||
english: Just as the darkness is lit up by the lamp,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਤਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: bharataa chitavat pooran aasaa ||
english: and the hopes of the wife are fulfilled by thinking about her husband,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mil preetam jiu hot ana(n)daa tiu har ra(n)g man ra(n)geenaa jeeu ||3||
english: and people are filled with bliss upon meeting their beloved, so is my mind imbued with the Lord's Love. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan mo kau har maarag paaiaa ||
english: The Saints have set me upon the Lord's Path.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਿਝਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saadh kripaal har sa(n)g gijhaaiaa ||
english: By the Grace of the Holy Saint, I have been attuned to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਮਰਾ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਚੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੨੧॥
transliteration: har hamaraa ham har ke daase naanak sabad guroo sach deenaa jeeu ||4||14||21||
english: The Lord is mine, and I am the slave of the Lord. O Nanak, the Guru has blessed me with the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||14||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam sadaa niramaleeaa ||
english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is eternally pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਡਾਰਨ ਹਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sukhadaaee dookh bidaaran hareeaa ||
english: The Lord is the Giver of Peace and the Dispeller of sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਸਾਦ ਚਖਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਮੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: avar saad chakh sagale dekhe man har ras sabh te meethaa jeeu ||1||
english: I have seen and tasted all other flavors, but to my mind, the Subtle Essence of the Lord is the sweetest of all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਪੀਵੈ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo jo peevai so tripataavai ||
english: Whoever drinks this in, is satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: amar hovai jo naam ras paavai ||
english: Whoever obtains the Sublime Essence of the Naam becomes immortal.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan tisahi paraapat jis sabad guroo man voothaa jeeu ||2||
english: The Treasure of the Naam is obtained by one whose mind is filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jin har ras paaiaa so tripat aghaanaa ||
english: One who obtains the Sublime Essence of the Lord is satisfied and fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਨਾਹਿ ਡੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jin har saad paaiaa so naahi dulaanaa ||
english: One who obtains this Flavor of the Lord does not waver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tisahi paraapat har har naamaa jis masatak bhaageethaa jeeu ||3||
english: One who has this destiny written on his forehead obtains the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਆਇਆ ਵਰਸਾਣੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har ikas hath aaiaa varasaane bahutere ||
english: The Lord has come into the hands of the One, the Guru, who has blessed so many with good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਘਣੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tis lag mukat bhae ghanere ||
english: Attached to Him, a great many have been liberated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਡੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naam nidhaanaa guramukh paaeeai kahu naanak viralee deethaa jeeu ||4||15||22||
english: The Gurmukh obtains the Treasure of the Naam; says Nanak, those who see the Lord are very rare. ||4||15||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: nidh sidh ridh har har har merai ||
english: My Lord, Har, Har, Har, is the nine treasures, the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, wealth and prosperity.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੈ ॥
transliteration: janam padaarath gahir ga(n)bheerai ||
english: He is the Deep and Profound Treasure of Life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: laakh kot khuseeaa ra(n)g raavai jo gur laagaa paaee jeeu ||1||
english: Hundreds of thousands, even millions of pleasures and delights are enjoyed by one who falls at the Guru's Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: darasan pekhat bhae puneetaa ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are sanctified,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal udhaare bhaaee meetaa ||
english: and all family and friends are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: agam agochar suaamee apunaa gur kirapaa te sach dhiaaee jeeu ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Inaccessible and Unfathomable True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau khojahi sarab upaae ||
english: The One, the Guru, who is sought by all-only a few,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee darasan ko viralaa paae ||
english: By great good fortune, receive His Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਥਾਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇਖਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ooch apaar agochar thaanaa ohu mahal guroo dekhaaee jeeu ||3||
english: His Place is lofty, infinite and unfathomable; the Guru has shown me that palace. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gahir ga(n)bheer a(n)mrit naam teraa ||
english: Your Ambrosial Name is deep and profound.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mukat bhaiaa jis ridai vaseraa ||
english: That person is liberated, in whose heart You dwell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੩॥
transliteration: gur ba(n)dhan tin ke sagale kaate jan naanak sahaj samaaee jeeu ||4||16||23||
english: The Guru cuts away all his bonds; O Servant Nanak, he is absorbed in the poise of intuitive peace. ||4||16||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh kirapaa te har har dhiaavau ||
english: By God's Grace, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: prabhoo daiaa te ma(n)gal gaavau ||
english: By God's Kindness, I sing the songs of joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਗਲ ਅਵਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: oothat baithat sovat jaagat har dhiaaeeai sagal avaradaa jeeu ||1||
english: While standing and sitting, while sleeping and while awake, meditate on the Lord, all your life. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: naam aukhadh mo kau saadhoo deeaa ||
english: The Holy Saint has given me the Medicine of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kilabikh kaate niramal theeaa ||
english: My sins have been cut out, and I have become pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਸਭ ਪੀਰਾ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਦਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anad bhaiaa nikasee sabh peeraa sagal binaase daradaa jeeu ||2||
english: I am filled with bliss, and all my pains have been taken away. All my suffering has been dispelled. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa a(n)g kare meraa piaaraa ||
english: One who has my Beloved on his side,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: so mukataa saagar sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Is liberated from the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਡਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sat kare jin guroo pachhaataa so kaahe kau daradaa jeeu ||3||
english: One who recognizes the Guru practices Truth; why should he be afraid? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jab te saadhoo sa(n)gat paae ||
english: Since I found the Company of the Holy and met the Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਉ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur bhetat hau gaee balaae ||
english: The demon of pride has departed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਢਾਕਿ ਲੀਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੜਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੨੪॥
transliteration: saas saas har gaavai naanak satigur dhaak leeaa meraa paRadaa jeeu ||4||17||24||
english: With each and every breath, Nanak sings the Lord's Praises. The True Guru has covered my sins. ||4||17||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ot pot sevak sa(n)g raataa ||
english: Through and through, the Lord is intermingled with His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh pratipaale sevak sukhadaataa ||
english: God, the Giver of Peace, cherishes His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਆਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paanee pakhaa peesau sevak kai thaakur hee kaa aahar jeeu ||1||
english: I carry the water, wave the fan, and grind the grain for the servant of my Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kaat silak prabh sevaa laaiaa ||
english: God has cut the noose from around my neck; He has placed me in His Service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hukam saahib kaa sevak man bhaaiaa ||
english: The Lord and Master's Command is pleasing to the mind of His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: soee kamaavai jo saahib bhaavai sevak a(n)tar baahar maahar jeeu ||2||
english: He does that which pleases his Lord and Master. Inwardly and outwardly, the servant knows his Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
transliteration: too(n) daanaa thaakur sabh bidh jaanahi ||
english: You are the All-knowing Lord and Master; You know all ways and means.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: thaakur ke sevak har ra(n)g maanahi ||
english: The servant of the Lord and Master enjoys the Love and Affection of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo kichh thaakur kaa so sevak kaa sevak thaakur hee sa(n)g jaahar jeeu ||3||
english: That which belongs to the Lord and Master, belongs to His servant. The servant becomes distinguished in association with his Lord and Master. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਜੋ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: apunai thaakur jo pahiraaiaa ||
english: He, whom the Lord and Master dresses in the robes of honor,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bahur na lekhaa puchh bulaaiaa ||
english: Is not called to answer for his account any longer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੋ ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰਾ ਗਉਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੨੫॥
transliteration: tis sevak kai naanak kurabaanee so gahir gabheeraa gauhar jeeu ||4||18||25||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice to that servant. He is the pearl of the deep and unfathomable Ocean of God. ||4||18||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh ghar mahi baahar naahee ||
english: Everything is within the home of the self; there is nothing beyond.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਟੋਲੈ ਸੋ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: baahar tolai so bharam bhulaahee ||
english: One who searches outside is deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee jinee a(n)tar paaiaa so a(n)tar baahar suhelaa jeeu ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, one who has found the Lord within is happy, inwardly and outwardly. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝਿਮਿ ਝਿਮਿ ਵਰਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jhim jhim varasai a(n)mrit dhaaraa ||
english: Slowly, gently, drop by drop, the stream of nectar trickles down within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man peevai sun sabad beechaaraa ||
english: The mind drinks it in, hearing and reflecting on the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anad binod kare din raatee sadaa sadaa har kelaa jeeu ||2||
english: It enjoys bliss and ecstasy day and night, and plays with the Lord forever and ever. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa vichhuRiaa miliaa ||
english: I have now been united with the Lord after having been separated and cut off from Him for so many lifetimes;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੂਕਾ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saadh kripaa te sookaa hariaa ||
english: by the Grace of the Holy Saint, the dried-up branches have blossomed forth again in their greenery.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਏ ਮੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sumat paae naam dhiaae guramukh hoe melaa jeeu ||3||
english: I have obtained this sublime understanding, and I meditate on the Naam; as Gurmukh, I have met the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗੁ ਜਿਉ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jal tara(n)g jiu jalahi samaaiaa ||
english: As the waves of water merge again with the water,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਜੋਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tiu jotee sa(n)g jot milaaiaa ||
english: so does my light merge again into the Light.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਟੇ ਕਿਵਾੜਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਜਉਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੨੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bhram kate kivaaRaa bahuR na hoeeai jaulaa jeeu ||4||19||26||
english: Says Nanak, the veil of illusion has been cut away, and I shall not go out wandering any more. ||4||19||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tis kurabaanee jin too(n) suniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who have heard of You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਭਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tis balihaaree jin rasanaa bhaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those whose tongues speak of You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vaar vaar jaaee tis vitahu jo man tan tudh aaraadhe jeeu ||1||
english: Again and again, I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on You with mind and body. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਲੀ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: tis charan pakhaalee jo terai maarag chaalai ||
english: I wash the feet of those who walk upon Your Path.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਆਲੈ ॥
transliteration: nain nihaalee tis purakh daiaalai ||
english: With my eyes, I long to behold those kind people.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man devaa tis apune saajan jin gur mil so prabh laadhe jeeu ||2||
english: I offer my mind to those friends, who have met the Guru and found God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: se vadabhaagee jin tum jaane ||
english: Very fortunate are those who know You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧੇ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh kai madhe alipat nirabaane ||
english: In the midst of all, they remain detached and balanced in Nirvaanaa.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਨਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਦੂਤ ਉਨਿ ਸਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g un bhaujal tariaa sagal doot un saadhe jeeu ||3||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and conquer all their evil passions. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tin kee saran pariaa man meraa ||
english: My mind has entered their Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਤਜਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maan taan taj mohu a(n)dheraa ||
english: I have renounced my pride in my own strength, and the darkness of emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naam daan deejai naanak kau tis prabh agam agaadhe jeeu ||4||20||27||
english: Please bless Nanak with the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable God. ||4||20||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਪੇਡੁ ਸਾਖ ਤੇਰੀ ਫੂਲੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) ped saakh teree phoolee ||
english: You are the tree; Your branches have blossomed forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸੂਖਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਅਸਥੂਲੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sookham hoaa asathoolee ||
english: From the very small and subtle, You have become huge and manifest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਤੂੰ ਫੇਨੁ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too(n) jalanidh too(n) phen budabudaa tudh bin avar na bhaaleeai jeeu ||1||
english: You are the Ocean of Water, and You are the foam and the bubbles on its surface. I cannot see any other except You, Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸੂਤੁ ਮਣੀਏ ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) soot maneee bhee too(n)hai ||
english: You are the thread, and You are also the beads.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਗੰਠੀ ਮੇਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) ga(n)thee mer sir too(n)hai ||
english: You are the knot, and You are the primary bead of the maalaa.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਦਿਖਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aad madh a(n)t prabh soee avar na koi dikhaaleeai jeeu ||2||
english: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, there is God. I cannot see any other except You, Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) niragun saragun sukhadaataa ||
english: You transcend all qualities, and You possess the supreme qualities. You are the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਰਸੀਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) nirabaan raseeaa ra(n)g raataa ||
english: You are detached in Nirvaanaa, and You are the Enjoyer, imbued with love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: apane karatab aape jaanahi aape tudh samaaleeai jeeu ||3||
english: You Yourself know Your Own Ways; You dwell upon Yourself. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: too(n) thaakur sevak phun aape ||
english: You are the Master, and then again, You are the servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: too(n) gupat paragat prabh aape ||
english: O God, You Yourself are the Manifest and the Unmanifest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਇਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੨੮॥
transliteration: naanak daas sadaa gun gaavai ik bhoree nadar nihaaleeai jeeu ||4||21||28||
english: Slave Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises forever. Please, just for a moment, bless him with Your Glance of Grace. ||4||21||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: saphal s baanee jit naam vakhaanee ||
english: Blessed are those words, by which the Naam is chanted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad kinai viralai jaanee ||
english: Rare are those who know this, by Guru's Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s velaa jit har gaavat sunanaa aae te paravaanaa jeeu ||1||
english: Blessed is that time when one sings and hears the Lord's Name. Blessed and approved is the coming of such a one. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: se netr paravaan jinee darasan pekhaa ||
english: Those eyes which behold the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan are approved and accepted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਕਰ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: se kar bhale jinee har jas lekhaa ||
english: Those hands which write the Praises of the Lord are good.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਚਰਣ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: se charan suhaave jo har maarag chale hau bal tin sa(n)g pachhaanaa jeeu ||2||
english: Those feet which walk in the Lord's Way are beautiful. I am a sacrifice to that Congregation in which the Lord is recognized. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sun saajan mere meet piaare ||
english: Listen, O my beloved friends and companions:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g khin maahi udhaare ||
english: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be saved in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਿ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kilavikh kaat hoaa man niramal mit gae aavan jaanaa jeeu ||3||
english: Your sins will be cut out; your mind will be immaculate and pure. Your comings and goings shall cease. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: dui kar joR ik binau kareejai ||
english: With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਪਥਰੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa dubadaa pathar leejai ||
english: please bless me with Your Mercy, and save this sinking stone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੨੯॥
transliteration: naanak kau prabh bhae kripaalaa prabh naanak man bhaanaa jeeu ||4||22||29||
english: God has become merciful to Nanak; God is pleasing to Nanak's mind. ||4||22||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee har har teree ||
english: The Word of Your Bani, Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sun sun hovai param gat meree ||
english: Hearing it again and again, I am elevated to the supreme heights.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jalan bujhee seetal hoi manooaa satigur kaa darasan paae jeeu ||1||
english: The burning within me has been extinguished, and my mind has been cooled and soothed, by the Blessed Vision of the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sookh bhaiaa dukh door paraanaa ||
english: Happiness is obtained, and sorrow runs far away,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t rasan har naam vakhaanaa ||
english: when the Saints chant the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jal thal neer bhare sar subhar birathaa koi na jaae jeeu ||2||
english: The sea, the dry land, and the lakes are filled with the Water of the Lord's Name; no place is left empty. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: daiaa dhaaree tin sirajanahaare ||
english: The Creator has showered His Kindness;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sagale pratipaare ||
english: He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: miharavaan kirapaal daiaalaa sagale tripat aghaae jeeu ||3||
english: He is Merciful, Kind and Compassionate. All are satisfied and fulfilled through Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: van trin tribhavan keeton hariaa ||
english: The woods, the meadows and the three worlds are rendered green.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣਹਾਰਿ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: karanahaar khin bheetar kariaa ||
english: The Doer of all did this in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੈ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੩੦॥
transliteration: guramukh naanak tisai araadhe man kee aas pujaae jeeu ||4||23||30||
english: As Gurmukh, Nanak meditates on the One who fulfills the desires of the mind. ||4||23||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) meraa pitaa too(n)hai meraa maataa ||
english: You are my Father, and You are my Mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) meraa ba(n)dhap too(n) meraa bhraataa ||
english: You are my Relative, and You are my Brother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too(n) meraa raakhaa sabhanee thaaee taa bhau kehaa kaaRaa jeeu ||1||
english: You are my Protector everywhere; why should I feel any fear or anxiety? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: tumaree kripaa te tudh pachhaanaa ||
english: By Your Grace, I recognize You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) meree ot too(n)hai meraa maanaa ||
english: You are my Shelter, and You are my Honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tujh bin doojaa avar na koee sabh teraa khel akhaaRaa jeeu ||2||
english: Without You, there is no other; the entire Universe is the Arena of Your Play. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh tudh upaae ||
english: You have created all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jit jit bhaanaa tit tit laae ||
english: As it pleases You, You assign tasks to one and all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਸਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh kichh keetaa teraa hovai naahee kichh asaaRaa jeeu ||3||
english: All things are Your Doing; we can do nothing ourselves. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naam dhiaai mahaa sukh paaiaa ||
english: Meditating on the Naam, I have found great peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaai meraa man seetalaaiaa ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my mind is cooled and soothed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤਾ ਬਿਖਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੧॥
transliteration: gur poorai vajee vaadhaaee naanak jitaa bikhaaRaa jeeu ||4||24||31||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, congratulations are pouring in-Nanak is victorious on the arduous battlefield of life! ||4||24||31||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jee praan prabh manahi adhaaraa ||
english: God is the Breath of Life of my soul, the Support of my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagat jeevahi gun gaai apaaraa ||
english: His devotees live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan a(n)mrit har naamaa har dhiaai dhiaai sukh paaiaa jeeu ||1||
english: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the Treasure of Excellence. Meditating, meditating on the Lord's Name, I have found peace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੋ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: manasaa dhaar jo ghar te aavai ||
english: One whose heart's desires lead him from his own home,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g janam maran mitaavai ||
english: To the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, shall be rid of the cycle of birth and death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੇਟਤ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aas manorath pooran hovai bhetat gur darasaaiaa jeeu ||2||
english: His hopes and desires are fulfilled, when he gains the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar kichh mit nahee jaanee ||
english: The limits of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord cannot be known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: saadhik sidh dhiaavahi giaanee ||
english: The seekers, the Siddhas, those beings of miraculous spiritual powers, and the spiritual teachers, all meditate on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੋਲਾਵਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khudee mitee chookaa bholaavaa gur man hee mahi pragataaiaa jeeu ||3||
english: Thus, their egos are erased, and their doubts are dispelled. The Guru has enlightened their minds. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: anad ma(n)gal kaliaan nidhaanaa ||
english: I chant the Name of the Lord, the Treasure of bliss,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj har naam vakhaanaa ||
english: Joy, salvation, intuitive peace and poise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੩੨॥
transliteration: hoi kripaal suaamee apanaa naau naanak ghar mahi aaiaa jeeu ||4||25||32||
english: When my Lord and Master blessed me with His Mercy, O Nanak, then His Name entered the home of my mind. ||4||25||32||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sun sun jeevaa soi tumaaree ||
english: Hearing of You, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) preetam thaakur at bhaaree ||
english: You are my Beloved, my Lord and Master, Utterly Great.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਟ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tumare karatab tum hee jaanahu tumaree ot goupaalaa jeeu ||1||
english: You alone know Your Ways; I grasp Your Support, Lord of the World. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavat man hariaa hovai ||
english: Singing Your Glorious Praises, my mind is rejuvenated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਤ ਮਲੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kathaa sunat mal sagalee khovai ||
english: Hearing Your Sermon, all filth is removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਜਪਉ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhetat sa(n)g saadh sa(n)tan kai sadaa japau daiaalaa jeeu ||2||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate forever on the Merciful Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh apunaa saas saas samaarau ||
english: I dwell on my God with each and every breath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰਉ ॥
transliteration: ih mat gur prasaad man dhaarau ||
english: This understanding has been implanted within my mind, by Guru's Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਸਰਬ ਮਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tumaree kripaa te hoi pragaasaa sarab maiaa pratipaalaa jeeu ||3||
english: By Your Grace, the Divine Light has dawned. The Merciful Lord cherishes everyone. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sat sat sat prabh soee ||
english: True, True, True is that God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa sad aape hoee ||
english: Forever, forever and ever, He Himself is.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਲਿਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੩੩॥
transliteration: chalit tumaare pragat piaare dekh naanak bhae nihaalaa jeeu ||4||26||33||
english: Your Playful Ways are revealed, O my Beloved. Beholding them, Nanak is enraptured. ||4||26||33||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਵਰਸਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਮੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: hukamee varasan laage mehaa ||
english: By His Command, the rain begins to fall.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: saajan sa(n)t mil naam japehaa ||
english: The Saints and friends have met to chant the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: seetal saa(n)t sahaj sukh paaiaa thaadh paaee prabh aape jeeu ||1||
english: Serene tranquility and peaceful ease have come; God Himself has brought a deep and profound peace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਹੁਤੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh bahuto bahut upaaiaa ||
english: God has produced everything in great abundance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਗਲ ਰਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh sagal rajaaiaa ||
english: Granting His Grace, God has satisfied all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: daat karahu mere daataaraa jee ja(n)t sabh dhraape jeeu ||2||
english: Bless us with Your Gifts, O my Great Giver. All beings and creatures are satisfied. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee naaee ||
english: True is the Master, and True is His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad tis sadaa dhiaaee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I meditate forever on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੋਹਾ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam maran bhai kaate mohaa binase sog sa(n)taape jeeu ||3||
english: The fear of birth and death has been dispelled; emotional attachment, sorrow and suffering have been erased. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: saas saas naanak saalaahe ||
english: With each and every breath, Nanak praises the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਫਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: simarat naam kaate sabh phaahe ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Name, all bonds are cut away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਕਰੀ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੩੪॥
transliteration: pooran aas karee khin bheetar har har har gun jaape jeeu ||4||27||34||
english: One's hopes are fulfilled in an instant, chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||27||34||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aau saajan sa(n)t meet piaare ||
english: Come, dear friends, Saints and companions:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਣ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mil gaavah gun agam apaare ||
english: let us join together and sing the Glorious Praises of the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੋ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gaavat sunat sabhe hee mukate so dhiaaeeai jin ham keee jeeu ||1||
english: Those who sing and hear these praises are liberated, so let us meditate on the One who created us. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh jaavahi ||
english: The sins of countless incarnations depart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: man chi(n)de seee phal paavahi ||
english: and we receive the fruits of the mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਭਸੁ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: simar saahib so sach suaamee rijak sabhas kau deee jeeu ||2||
english: So meditate on that Lord, our True Lord and Master, who gives sustenance to all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: naam japat sarab sukh paaeeai ||
english: Chanting the Naam, all pleasures are obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਭਉ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sabh bhau binasai har har dhiaaeeai ||
english: All fears are erased, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਗਿਰਾਮੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਥੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin seviaa so paaragiraamee kaaraj sagale theee jeeu ||3||
english: One who serves the Lord swims across to the other side, and all his affairs are resolved. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aai paiaa teree saranaaee ||
english: I have come to Your Sanctuary;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu laihi milaaee ||
english: if it pleases You, unite me with You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੩੫॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh bhagatee laavahu sach naanak a(n)mrit peee jeeu ||4||28||35||
english: Shower Your Mercy upon me, God; let me be committed to devotional worship. Nanak drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of Truth. ||4||28||35||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhae kripaal govi(n)d gusaaee ||
english: The Lord of the Universe, the Support of the earth, has become Merciful;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਘੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
transliteration: megh varasai sabhanee thaaee ||
english: the rain is falling everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: deen daiaal sadaa kirapaalaa thaadh paaee karataare jeeu ||1||
english: He is Merciful to the meek, always Kind and Gentle; the Creator has brought cooling relief. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: apune jee ja(n)t pratipaare ||
english: He cherishes all His beings and creatures,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਮਾਤਾ ਸੰਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jiu baarik maataa sa(n)maare ||
english: as the mother cares for her children.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੇਤ ਸਗਲ ਆਹਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dukh bha(n)jan sukh saagar suaamee det sagal aahaare jeeu ||2||
english: The Destroyer of pain, the Ocean of Peace, the Lord and Master gives sustenance to all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jal thal poor rahiaa miharavaanaa ||
english: The Merciful Lord is totally pervading and permeating the water and the land.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sad balihaar jaaeeai kurabaanaa ||
english: I am forever devoted, a sacrifice to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈ ਜਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: rain dinas tis sadaa dhiaaee j khin mahi sagal udhaare jeeu ||3||
english: Night and day, I always meditate on Him; in an instant, He saves all. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: raakh leee sagale prabh aape ||
english: God Himself protects all;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਤਰਿ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: utar gae sabh sog sa(n)taape ||
english: He drives out all sorrow and suffering.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੩੬॥
transliteration: naam japat man tan hareeaaval prabh naanak nadar nihaare jeeu ||4||29||36||
english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are rejuvenated. O Nanak, God has bestowed His Glance of Grace. ||4||29||36||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jithai naam japeeai prabh piaare ||
english: Where the Naam, the Name of God the Beloved is chanted

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਅਸਥਲ ਸੋਇਨ ਚਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: se asathal soin chaubaare ||
english: those barren places become mansions of gold.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਇਦਾ ਸੇਈ ਨਗਰ ਉਜਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jithai naam na japeeai mere goidaa seee nagar ujaaRee jeeu ||1||
english: Where the Naam, the Name of my Lord of the Universe is not chanted-those towns are like the barren wilderness. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੁਖੀ ਰੋਟੀ ਖਾਇ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: har rukhee rotee khaai samaale ||
english: One who meditates as he eats dry bread,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)tar baahar nadar nihaale ||
english: sees the Blessed Lord inwardly and outwardly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਇ ਖਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਬਦਫੈਲੀ ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਸੂ ਕੀ ਵਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khaai khaai kare badaphailee jaan visoo kee vaaRee jeeu ||2||
english: Know this well, that one who eats and eats while practicing evil, is like a field of poisonous plants. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa setee ra(n)g na laae ||
english: One who does not feel love for the Saints,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਿਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saakat sa(n)g vikaram kamaae ||
english: misbehaves in the company of the wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਖੋਈ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਜੜ ਅਪੁਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dulabh deh khoee agiaanee jaR apunee aap upaaRee jeeu ||3||
english: he wastes this human body, so difficult to obtain. In his ignorance, he tears up his own roots. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: teree saran mere deen daiaalaa ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar mere gur gopaalaa ||
english: Ocean of Peace, my Guru, Sustainer of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਮ ਅਸਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੩੭॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa naanak gun gaavai raakhahu saram asaaRee jeeu ||4||30||37||
english: Shower Your Mercy upon Nanak, that he may sing Your Glorious Praises; please, preserve my honor. ||4||30||37||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: charan thaakur ke ridai samaane ||
english: I cherish in my heart the Feet of my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਸਭ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਇਆਣੇ ॥
transliteration: kal kales sabh door paiaane ||
english: All my troubles and sufferings have run away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saa(n)t sookh sahaj dhun upajee saadhoo sa(n)g nivaasaa jeeu ||1||
english: The music of intuitive peace, poise and tranquility wells up within; I dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਮੂਲੇ ॥
transliteration: laagee preet na tootai moole ||
english: The bonds of love with the Lord are never broken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)tar baahar rahiaa bharapoore ||
english: The Lord is totally permeating and pervading inside and out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: simar simar simar gun gaavaa kaatee jam kee phaasaa jeeu ||2||
english: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, singing His Glorious Praises, the noose of death is cut away. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਰਖੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit varakhai anahad baanee ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar, the Unstruck Melody of Gurbani rains down continually;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar saa(n)t samaanee ||
english: deep within my mind and body, peace and tranquility have come.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tripat aghaai rahe jan tere satigur keeaa dilaasaa jeeu ||3||
english: Your humble servants remain satisfied and fulfilled, and the True Guru blesses them with encouragement and comfort. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa saa tis te phal paaiaa ||
english: We are His, and from Him, we receive our rewards.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh sa(n)g milaaiaa ||
english: Showering His Mercy upon us, God has united us with Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੩੮॥
transliteration: aavan jaan rahe vadabhaagee naanak pooran aasaa jeeu ||4||31||38||
english: Our comings and goings have ended, and through great good fortune, O Nanak, our hopes are fulfilled. ||4||31||38||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਹੁ ਪਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: meehu paiaa paramesar paaiaa ||
english: The rain has fallen; I have found the Transcendent Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh sukhee vasaaiaa ||
english: All beings and creatures dwell in peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਇਆ ਕਲੇਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gaiaa kales bhaiaa sukh saachaa har har naam samaalee jeeu ||1||
english: Suffering has been dispelled, and true happiness has dawned, as we meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jis ke se tin hee pratipaare ||
english: The One, to whom we belong, cherishes and nurtures us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh bhae rakhavaare ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has become our Protector.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਘਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sunee bena(n)tee thaakur merai pooran hoee ghaalee jeeu ||2||
english: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer; my efforts have been rewarded. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab jeeaa kau devanahaaraa ||
english: He is the Giver of all souls.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee nadar nihaaraa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, He blesses us with His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹੀਅਲ ਸਭਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਣੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal sabh tripataane saadhoo charan pakhaalee jeeu ||3||
english: The beings in the water, on the land and in the sky are all satisfied; I wash the Feet of the Holy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man kee ichh pujaavanahaaraa ||
english: He is the Fulfiller of the desires of the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa jaaee balihaaraa ||
english: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੩੯॥
transliteration: naanak daan keeaa dukh bha(n)jan rate ra(n)g rasaalee jeeu ||4||32||39||
english: O Nanak, the Destroyer of pain has given this Gift; I am imbued with the Love of the Delightful Lord. ||4||32||39||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਭੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan teraa dhan bhee teraa ||
english: Mind and body are Yours; all wealth is Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) thaakur suaamee prabh meraa ||
english: You are my God, my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh raas tumaaree teraa jor gopaalaa jeeu ||1||
english: Body and soul and all riches are Yours. Yours is the Power, O Lord of the World. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa too(n)hai sukhadaaee ||
english: Forever and ever, You are the Giver of Peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: niv niv laagaa teree paaee ||
english: I bow down and fall at Your Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaar kamaavaa je tudh bhaavaa jaa too(n) dehi daiaalaa jeeu ||2||
english: I act as it pleases You, as You cause me to act, Kind and Compassionate Dear Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਲਹਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh tum te lahanaa too(n) meraa gahanaa ||
english: O God, from You I receive; You are my decoration.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jo too(n) dehi soee sukh sahanaa ||
english: Whatever You give me, brings me happiness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਰਖਹਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jithai rakhahi baiku(n)th tithaaee too(n) sabhanaa ke pratipaalaa jeeu ||3||
english: Wherever You keep me, is heaven. You are the Cherisher of all. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: simar simar naanak sukh paaiaa ||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, Nanak has found peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar tere gun gaaiaa ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੪੦॥
transliteration: sagal manorath pooran hoe kade na hoi dukhaalaa jeeu ||4||33||40||
english: All my hopes and desires are fulfilled; I shall never again suffer sorrow. ||4||33||40||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਘੁ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh megh pathaaiaa ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has unleashed the rain clouds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਵਰਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal dah dis varasaaiaa ||
english: Over the sea and over the land-over all the earth's surface, in all directions, He has brought the rain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭਈ ਬੁਝੀ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saa(n)t bhaee bujhee sabh trisanaa anad bhaiaa sabh thaaee jeeu ||1||
english: Peace has come, and the thirst of all has been quenched; there is joy and ecstasy everywhere. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sukhadaataa dukh bha(n)janahaaraa ||
english: He is the Giver of Peace, the Destroyer of pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape bakhas kare jee saaraa ||
english: He gives and forgives all beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਪਇ ਪੈਰੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਮਨਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: apane keete no aap pratipaale pai pairee tisahi manaaee jeeu ||2||
english: He Himself nurtures and cherishes His Creation. I fall at His Feet and surrender to Him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee saran paiaa gat paaeeai ||
english: Seeking His Sanctuary, salvation is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: saas saas har naam dhiaaeeai ||
english: With each and every breath, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis bin hor na doojaa thaakur sabh tisai keeaa jaaee jeeu ||3||
english: Without Him, there is no other Lord and Master. All places belong to Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: teraa maan taan prabh teraa ||
english: Yours is the Honor, God, and Yours is the Power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sachaa saahib gunee gaheraa ||
english: You are the True Lord and Master, the Ocean of Excellence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੪੧॥
transliteration: naanak daas kahai bena(n)tee aath pahar tudh dhiaaee jeeu ||4||34||41||
english: Servant Nanak utters this prayer: may I meditate on You twenty-four hours a day. ||4||34||41||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਠੇ ॥
transliteration: sabhe sukh bhae prabh tuthe ||
english: All happiness comes, when God is pleased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
transliteration: gur poore ke charan man vuthe ||
english: The Feet of the Perfect Guru dwell in my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗੀ ਲਿਵ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਰਸੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sahaj samaadh lagee liv a(n)tar so ras soee jaanai jeeu ||1||
english: I am intuitively absorbed in the state of Samaadhi deep within. God alone knows this sweet pleasure. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar saahib meraa ||
english: My Lord and Master is Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar varatai neraa ||
english: Deep within each and every heart, He dwells near and close at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa alipat jeeaa kaa daataa ko viralaa aap pachhaanai jeeu ||2||
english: He is always detached; He is the Giver of souls. How rare is that person who understands his own self. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਕੀ ਏਹ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh milanai kee eh neesaanee ||
english: This is the sign of union with God:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਇਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: man iko sachaa hukam pachhaanee ||
english: in the mind, the Command of the True Lord is recognized.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਅਨਦੁ ਖਸਮ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sahaj sa(n)tokh sadaa tripataase anad khasam kai bhaanai jeeu ||3||
english: Intuitive peace and poise, contentment, enduring satisfaction and bliss come through the Pleasure of the Master's Will. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਥੀ ਦਿਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: hathee ditee prabh devanahaarai ||
english: God, the Great Giver, has given me His Hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਰੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: janam maran rog sabh nivaare ||
english: He has erased all the sickness of birth and death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੪੨॥
transliteration: naanak daas keee prabh apune har keeratan ra(n)g maane jeeu ||4||35||42||
english: O Nanak, those whom God has made His slaves, rejoice in the pleasure of singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||4||35||42||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਨੀ ਦਇਆ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: keenee daiaa gopaal gusaaee ||
english: The Life of the World, the Sustainer of the Earth, has showered His Mercy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਸੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan vase man maahee ||
english: the Guru's Feet have come to dwell within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeaa tin karatai dukh kaa deraa dhaahiaa jeeu ||1||
english: The Creator has made me His Own. He has destroyed the city of sorrow. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: man tan vasiaa sachaa soee ||
english: The True One abides within my mind and body;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੜਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bikhaRaa thaan na disai koee ||
english: no place seems difficult to me now.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਮਣ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣ ਹੋਏ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: doot dusaman sabh sajan hoe eko suaamee aahiaa jeeu ||2||
english: All the evil-doers and enemies have now become my friends. I long only for my Lord and Master. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh kare s aape aapai ||
english: Whatever He does, He does all by Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: budh siaanap kichhoo na jaapai ||
english: No one can know His Ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਲਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aapaniaa sa(n)taa no aap sahaaee prabh bharam bhulaavaa laahiaa jeeu ||3||
english: He Himself is the Helper and Support of His Saints. God has cast out my doubts and delusions. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal jan kaa aadhaaro ||
english: His Lotus Feet are the Support of His humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar raam naam vaapaaro ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, they deal in the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੬॥੪੩॥
transliteration: sahaj ana(n)d gaavahi gun govi(n)d prabh naanak sarab samaahiaa jeeu ||4||36||43||
english: In peace and pleasure, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. O Nanak, God is permeating everywhere. ||4||36||43||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: so sach ma(n)dar jit sach dhiaaeeai ||
english: True is that temple, within which one meditates on the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਰਿਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: so ridaa suhelaa jit har gun gaaeeai ||
english: Blessed is that heart, within which the Lord's Glorious Praises are sung.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saa dharat suhaavee jit vasahi har jan sache naam vitahu kurabaano jeeu ||1||
english: Beautiful is that land, where the Lord's humble servants dwell. I am a sacrifice to the True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sach vadaaee keem na paaee ||
english: The extent of the True Lord's Greatness cannot be known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਹਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kudarat karam na kahanaa jaaee ||
english: His Creative Power and His Bounties cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhiaai dhiaai jeevahi jan tere sach sabad man maano jeeu ||2||
english: Your humble servants live by meditating, meditating on You. Their minds treasure the True Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sach saalaahan vadabhaagee paaeeai ||
english: The Praises of the True One are obtained by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har gun gaaeeai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ra(n)g rate terai tudh bhaavahi sach naam neesaano jeeu ||3||
english: Those who are imbued with Your Love are pleasing to You. The True Name is their Banner and Insignia. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sache a(n)t na jaanai koee ||
english: No one knows the limits of the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar sachaa soee ||
english: In all places and interspaces, the True One is pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੪੪॥
transliteration: naanak sach dhiaaeeai sad hee a(n)tarajaamee jaano jeeu ||4||37||44||
english: O Nanak, meditate forever on the True One, the Searcher of hearts, the Knower of all. ||4||37||44||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: rain suhaavaRee dinas suhelaa ||
english: Beautiful is the night, and beautiful is the day,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jap a(n)mrit naam sa(n)tasa(n)g melaa ||
english: when one joins the Society of the Saints and chants the Ambrosial Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੜੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਲ ਵੰਞਹਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ghaRee moorat simarat pal va(n)njahi jeevan saphal tithaaee jeeu ||1||
english: If you remember the Lord in meditation for a moment, even for an instant, then your life will become fruitful and prosperous. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: simarat naam dokh sabh laathe ||
english: Remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all sinful mistakes are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar har prabh saathe ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, the Lord God is always with us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਉ ਭਰਮੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhai bhau bharam khoiaa gur poorai dekhaa sabhanee jaaee jeeu ||2||
english: Fear, dread and doubt have been dispelled by the Perfect Guru; now, I see God everywhere. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਵਡ ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh samarath vad ooch apaaraa ||
english: God is All-powerful, Vast, Lofty and Infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: nau nidh naam bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
english: The Naam is overflowing with the nine treasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aad a(n)t madh prabh soee doojaa lavai na laaee jeeu ||3||
english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, there is God. Nothing else even comes close to Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mere deen daiaalaa ||
english: Take pity on me, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jaachik jaachai saadh ravaalaa ||
english: I am a beggar, begging for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੮॥੪੫॥
transliteration: dehi daan naanak jan maagai sadaa sadaa har dhiaaee jeeu ||4||38||45||
english: Servant Nanak begs for this gift: let me meditate on the Lord, forever and ever. ||4||38||45||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਆਗੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aithai too(n)hai aagai aape ||
english: You are here, and You are hereafter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)tr sabh tere thaape ||
english: All beings and creatures were created by You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਤੇ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tudh bin avar na koee karate mai dhar ot tumaaree jeeu ||1||
english: Without You, there is no other, O Creator. You are my Support and my Protection. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa jap jap jeevai suaamee ||
english: The tongue lives by chanting and meditating on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: The Supreme Lord God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin seviaa tin hee sukh paaiaa so janam na jooai haaree jeeu ||2||
english: Those who serve the Lord find peace; they do not lose their lives in the gamble. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naam avakhadh jin jan terai paaiaa ||
english: Your humble servant, who obtains the Medicine of the Naam,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa rog gavaaiaa ||
english: is rid of the illnesses of countless lifetimes and incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਫਲ ਏਹਾ ਹੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har keeratan gaavahu din raatee saphal ehaa hai kaaree jeeu ||3||
english: So sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, day and night. This is the most fruitful occupation. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: drisat dhaar apanaa daas savaariaa ||
english: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He has adorned His slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar paarabraham namasakaariaa ||
english: Deep within each and every heart, the Supreme Lord is humbly worshipped.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੪੬॥
transliteration: ikas vin hor doojaa naahee baabaa naanak ih mat saaree jeeu ||4||39||46||
english: Without the One, there is no other at all. O Baba Nanak, this is the most excellent wisdom. ||4||39||46||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man tan rataa raam piaare ||
english: My mind and body are imbued with love for the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਅਪਨਾ ਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sarabas deejai apanaa vaare ||
english: I sacrifice everything for Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aath pahar govi(n)d gun gaaeeai bisar na koee saasaa jeeu ||1||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. Do not forget Him, for even one breath. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: soee saajan meet piaaraa ||
english: He is a companion, a friend, and a beloved of mine,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam saadhasa(n)g beechaaraa ||
english: who reflects upon the Lord's Name, in the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੀਜੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g tareejai saagar kateeai jam kee phaasaa jeeu ||2||
