english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, cross over the world-ocean, and the noose of death shall be cut away. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: chaar padaarath har kee sevaa ||
english: The four cardinal blessings are obtained by serving the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਜਪਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: paarajaat jap alakh abhevaa ||
english: The Elysian Tree, the source of all blessings, is meditation on the Unseen and Unknowable Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaam krodh kilabikh gur kaate pooran hoee aasaa jeeu ||3||
english: The Guru has cut out the sinful mistakes of sexual desire and anger, and my hopes have been fulfilled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਗ ਭਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: pooran bhaag bhae jis praanee ||
english: That mortal who is blessed by perfect destiny meets the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਰੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mile saara(n)gapaanee ||
english: The Sustainer of the Universe, in the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੪੭॥
transliteration: naanak naam vasiaa jis a(n)tar paravaan girasat udaasaa jeeu ||4||40||47||
english: O Nanak, if the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells within the mind, one is approved and accepted, whether he is a house-holder or a renunciate. ||4||40||47||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: simarat naam ridai sukh paaiaa ||
english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, my heart is filled with peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਂੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa bhagata(n)ee pragataaiaa ||
english: By His Grace, His devotees become famous and acclaimed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਆਲਸ ਰੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g mil har har japiaa binase aalas rogaa jeeu ||1||
english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; the disease of laziness has disappeared. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai grihi nav nidh har bhaaee ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, the nine treasures are found in the Home of the Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tis miliaa jis purab kamaaee ||
english: He comes to meet those who deserve it by their past actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan pooran paramesur prabh sabhanaa galaa jogaa jeeu ||2||
english: The Perfect Transcendent Lord is spiritual wisdom and meditation. God is All-powerful to do all things. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi thaap uthaapanahaaraa ||
english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਇਕੰਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aap ika(n)tee aap pasaaraa ||
english: He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the Many.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਡਿਠੇ ਲਹਨਿ ਵਿਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: lep nahee jagajeevan daate darasan dithe lahan vijogaa jeeu ||3||
english: Filth does not stick to the Giver, the Life of the World. Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, the pain of separation departs. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਾਇ ਸਭ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਤਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)chal laai sabh sisat taraaee ||
english: Holding on to the hem of His Robe, the entire Universe is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa naau aap japaaee ||
english: He Himself causes His Name to be chanted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੧॥੪੮॥
transliteration: gur bohith paaiaa kirapaa te naanak dhur sa(n)jogaa jeeu ||4||41||48||
english: The Boat of the Guru is found by His Grace; O Nanak, such blessed destiny is pre-ordained. ||4||41||48||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: soee karanaa j aap karaae ||
english: People do whatever the Lord inspires them to do.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਰਖੈ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jithai rakhai saa bhalee jaae ||
english: Wherever He keeps us is a good place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸੋ ਪਤਿਵੰਤਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: soee siaanaa so pativa(n)taa hukam lagai jis meethaa jeeu ||1||
english: That person is clever and honorable, unto whom the Hukam of the Lord's Command seems sweet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਪਰੋਈ ਇਕਤੁ ਧਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh paroee ikat dhaagai ||
english: Everything is strung upon the One String of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jis laai lae so charanee laagai ||
english: Those whom the Lord attaches, are attached to His Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਂਧ ਕਵਲੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: oo(n)dh kaval jis hoi pragaasaa tin sarab nira(n)jan deethaa jeeu ||2||
english: Those, whose inverted lotus of the crown chakra is illuminated, see the Immaculate Lord everywhere. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: teree mahimaa too(n)hai jaanahi ||
english: Only You Yourself know Your Glory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: apanaa aap too(n) aap pachhaanahi ||
english: You Yourself recognize Your Own Self.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਪੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree sa(n)tan tere jin kaam krodh lobh peethaa jeeu ||3||
english: I am a sacrifice to Your Saints, who have crushed their sexual desire, anger and greed. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ॥
transliteration: too(n) niravair sa(n)t tere niramal ||
english: You have no hatred or vengeance; Your Saints are immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਭ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਕਲਮਲ ॥
transliteration: jin dekhe sabh utarahi kalamal ||
english: Seeing them, all sins depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਧੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੨॥੪੯॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaai dhiaai jeevai binasiaa bhram bhau dheethaa jeeu ||4||42||49||
english: Nanak lives by meditating, meditating on the Naam. His stubborn doubt and fear have departed. ||4||42||49||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਂਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maa(n)jh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਮੰਗਣੁ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jhoothaa ma(n)gan je koee maagai ||
english: One who asks for a false gift,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਰਤੇ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: tis kau marate ghaRee na laagai ||
english: shall not take even an instant to die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paarabraham jo sad hee sevai so gur mil nihachal kahanaa ||1||
english: But one who continually serves the Supreme Lord God and meets the Guru, is said to be immortal. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: prem bhagat jis kai man laagee ||
english: One whose mind is dedicated to loving devotional worship

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਿਤਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavai anadin nit jaagee ||
english: sings His Glorious Praises night and day, and remains forever awake and aware.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਲੈ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਹਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: baah pakaR tis suaamee melai jis kai masatak lahanaa ||2||
english: Taking him by the hand, the Lord and Master merges into Himself that person, upon whose forehead such destiny is written. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal bhagataa(n) man vuthe ||
english: His Lotus Feet dwell in the minds of His devotees.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸਗਲੇ ਮੁਠੇ ॥
transliteration: vin paramesar sagale muthe ||
english: Without the Transcendent Lord, all are plundered.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਂਛਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa(n) kee dhooR nit baa(n)chhahi naam sache kaa gahanaa ||3||
english: I long for the dust of the feet of His humble servants. The Name of the True Lord is my decoration. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat har har gaaeeai ||
english: Standing up and sitting down, I sing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਵਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat var nihachal paaeeai ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, I obtain my Eternal Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਸਹਣਾ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੦॥
transliteration: naanak kau prabh hoi daiaalaa teraa keetaa sahanaa ||4||43||50||
english: God has become merciful to Nanak. I cheerfully accept Your Will. ||4||43||50||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਝ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag maajh asatapadeeaa mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Maajh, Ashtpadheeyaa: First Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabad ra(n)gaae hukam sabaae ||
english: By His Command, all are attuned to the Word of the Shabad,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sachee daragah mahal bulaae ||
english: and all are called to the Mansion of His Presence, the True Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sache deen daiaal mere saahibaa sache man pateeaavaniaa ||1||
english: O my True Lord and Master, Merciful to the meek, my mind is pleased and appeased by the Truth. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree sabad suhaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who are adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam sadaa sukhadaataa guramatee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever the Giver of Peace. Through the Guru's Teachings, it dwells in the mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naa ko meraa hau kis keraa ||
english: No one is mine, and I am no one else's.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saachaa thaakur tribhavan meraa ||
english: The True Lord and Master of the three worlds is mine.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਘਣੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: haumai kar kar jaai ghaneree kar avagan pachhotaavaniaa ||2||
english: Acting in egotism, so very many have died. After making mistakes, they later repent and regret. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: hukam pachhaanai s har gun vakhaanai ||
english: Those who recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad naam neesaanai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are glorified with the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਚੈ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabhanaa kaa dar lekhaa sachai chhootas naam suhaavaniaa ||3||
english: Everyone's account is kept in the True Court, and through the Beauty of the Naam, they are saved. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhoolaa thaur na paae ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded; they find no place of rest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧਾ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jam dar badhaa chotaa khaae ||
english: Bound and gagged at Death's Door, they are brutally beaten.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸਾਥੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bin naavai ko sa(n)g na saathee mukate naam dhiaavaniaa ||4||
english: Without the Name, there are no companions or friends. Liberation comes only by meditating on the Naam. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜੇ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saakat kooRe sach na bhaavai ||
english: The false shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਾਧਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa baadhaa aavai jaavai ||
english: Bound by duality, they come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: likhiaa lekh na metai koee guramukh mukat karaavaniaa ||5||
english: No one can erase pre-recorded destiny; the Gurmukhs are liberated. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਤੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: peeeaRai pir jaato naahee ||
english: In this world of her parents' house, the young bride did not know her Husband.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਧਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jhooth vichhu(n)nee rovai dhaahee ||
english: Through falsehood, she has been separated from Him, and she cries out in misery.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣਿ ਬਖਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: avagan muthee mahal na paae avagan gun bakhasaavaniaa ||6||
english: Defrauded by demerits, she does not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. But through virtuous actions, her demerits are forgiven. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: peeeaRai jin jaataa piaaraa ||
english: She, who knows her Beloved in her parents' house,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh boojhai tat beechaaraa ||
english: as Gurmukh, comes to understand the essence of reality; she contemplates her Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa thaak rahaae sachai naam samaavaniaa ||7||
english: Her comings and goings cease, and she is absorbed in the True Name. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh boojhai akath kahaavai ||
english: The Gurmukhs understand and describe the Indescribable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਾਚੋ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sache thaakur saacho bhaavai ||
english: True is our Lord and Master; He loves the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sach kahai bena(n)tee sach milai gun gaavaniaa ||8||1||
english: Nanak offers this true prayer: singing His Glorious Praises, I merge with the True One. ||8||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: karam hovai satiguroo milaae ||
english: By His Mercy, we meet the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sevaa surat sabad chit laae ||
english: Center your awareness on seva-selfless service-and focus your consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haumai maar sadaa sukh paaiaa maaiaa mohu chukaavaniaa ||1||
english: Subduing your ego, you shall find a lasting peace, and your emotional attachment to Maya will be dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree satigur kai balihaaraniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, I am totally devoted to the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੋਆ ਜੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramatee paragaas hoaa jee anadin har gun gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Divine Light has dawned; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਖੋਜੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tan man khoje taa naau paae ||
english: Search your body and mind, and find the Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat raakhai thaak rahaae ||
english: Restrain your wandering mind, and keep it in check.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kee baanee anadin gaavai sahaje bhagat karaavaniaa ||2||
english: Night and day, sing the Songs of the Guru's Bani; worship the Lord with intuitive devotion. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਸੰਖਾ ॥
transliteration: is kaaiaa a(n)dar vasat asa(n)khaa ||
english: Within this body are countless objects.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਵੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saach milai taa vekhaa ||
english: The Gurmukh attains Truth, and comes to see them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਦਸਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nau daravaaje dasavai mukataa anahad sabad vajaavaniaa ||3||
english: Beyond the nine gates, the Tenth Gate is found, and liberation is obtained. The Unstruck Melody of the Shabad vibrates. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee naaee ||
english: True is the Master, and True is His Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ma(n)n vasaaee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, He comes to dwell within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: anadin sadaa rahai ra(n)g raataa dar sachai sojhee paavaniaa ||4||
english: Night and day, remain attuned to the Lord's Love forever, and you shall obtain understanding in the True Court. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: paap pu(n)n kee saar na jaanee ||
english: Those who do not understand the nature of sin and virtue

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: doojai laagee bharam bhulaanee ||
english: are attached to duality; they wander around deluded.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: agiaanee a(n)dhaa mag na jaanai phir phir aavan jaavaniaa ||5||
english: The ignorant and blind people do not know the way; they come and go in reincarnation over and over again. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te sadaa sukh paaiaa ||
english: Serving the Guru, I have found eternal peace;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai meraa thaak rahaaiaa ||
english: my ego has been silenced and subdued.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gur saakhee mitiaa a(n)dhiaaraa bajar kapaat khulaavaniaa ||6||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the darkness has been dispelled, and the heavy doors have been opened. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
english: Subduing my ego, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur charanee sadaa chit laaiaa ||
english: I focus my consciousness on the Guru's Feet forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te man tan niramal niramal naam dhiaavaniaa ||7||
english: By Guru's Grace, my mind and body are immaculate and pure; I meditate on the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਧੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jeevan maranaa sabh tudhai taaee ||
english: From birth to death, everything is for You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jis bakhase tis de vadiaaee ||
english: You bestow greatness upon those whom You have forgiven.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaai sadaa too(n) ja(n)man maran savaaraniaa ||8||1||2||
english: O Nanak, meditating forever on the Naam, you shall be blessed in both birth and death. ||8||1||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh niramal agam apaaraa ||
english: My God is Immaculate, Inaccessible and Infinite.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਤਕੜੀ ਤੋਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bin takaRee tolai sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Without a scale, He weighs the universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai soee boojhai gun kahi gunee samaavaniaa ||1||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands. Chanting His Glorious Praises, he is absorbed into the Lord of Virtue. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those whose minds are filled with the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo sach laage se anadin jaage dar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who are committed to Truth remain awake and aware night and day. They are honored in the True Court. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣੈ ਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: aap sunai tai aape vekhai ||
english: He Himself hears, and He Himself sees.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: jis no nadar kare soee jan lekhai ||
english: Those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, become acceptable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape laai lae so laagai guramukh sach kamaavaniaa ||2||
english: They are attached, whom the Lord Himself attaches; as Gurmukh, they live the Truth. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਸੁ ਕਿਥੈ ਹਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis aap bhulaae s kithai hath paae ||
english: Those whom the Lord Himself misleads-whose hand can they take?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa s metanaa na jaae ||
english: That which is pre-ordained, cannot be erased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin satigur miliaa se vadabhaagee poorai karam milaavaniaa ||3||
english: Those who meet the True Guru are very fortunate and blessed; through perfect karma, He is met. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਧਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਤੀ ॥
transliteration: peeeaRai dhan anadin sutee ||
english: The young bride is fast asleep in her parents' home, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਤੀ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)t visaaree avagan mutee ||
english: She has forgotten her Husband Lord; because of her faults and demerits, she is abandoned.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: anadin sadaa phirai bilalaadee bin pir need na paavaniaa ||4||
english: She wanders around continually, crying out, night and day. Without her Husband Lord, she cannot get any sleep. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: peeeaRai sukhadaataa jaataa ||
english: In this world of her parents' home, she may come to know the Giver of peace,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar gur sabad pachhaataa ||
english: if she subdues her ego, and recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sej suhaavee sadaa pir raave sach seegaar banaavaniaa ||5||
english: Her bed is beautiful; she ravishes and enjoys her Husband Lord forever. She is adorned with the Decorations of Truth. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jee upaae ||
english: He created the 8.4 million species of beings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis no nadar kare tis guroo milaae ||
english: Those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, come to meet the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kilabikh kaat sadaa jan niramal dar sachai naam suhaavaniaa ||6||
english: Shedding their sins, His servants are forever pure; at the True Court, they are beautified by the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਨਿ ਦੀਐ ॥
transliteration: lekhaa maagai taa kin deeai ||
english: When they are called to settle their accounts, who will answer then?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਦੂਐ ਤੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sukh naahee phun dooai teeai ||
english: There shall be no peace then, from counting out by twos and threes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aape bakhas lae prabh saachaa aape bakhas milaavaniaa ||7||
english: The True Lord God Himself forgives, and having forgiven, He unites them with Himself. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aap kare tai aap karaae ||
english: He Himself does, and He Himself causes all to be done.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kai sabad milaae ||
english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, He is met.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee aape mel milaavaniaa ||8||2||3||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained. He Himself unites in His Union. ||8||2||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਪਰਛੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: iko aap phirai parachha(n)naa ||
english: The One Lord Himself moves about imperceptibly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖਾ ਤਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh vekhaa taa ihu man bhi(n)naa ||
english: As Gurmukh, I see Him, and then this mind is pleased and uplifted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਜਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਏਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: trisanaa taj sahaj sukh paaiaa eko ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1||
english: Renouncing desire, I have found intuitive peace and poise; I have enshrined the One within my mind. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree ikas siu chit laavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramatee man ikat ghar aaiaa sachai ra(n)g ra(n)gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, my mind has come to its only home; it is imbued with the True Color of the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਤੈਂ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ihu jag bhoolaa tai(n) aap bhulaaiaa ||
english: This world is deluded; You Yourself have deluded it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ik visaar doojai lobhaaiaa ||
english: Forgetting the One, it has become engrossed in duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anadin sadaa phirai bhram bhoolaa bin naavai dukh paavaniaa ||2||
english: Night and day, it wanders around endlessly, deluded by doubt; without the Name, it suffers in pain. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: jo ra(n)g raate karam bidhaate ||
english: Those who are attuned to the Love of the Lord, the Architect of Destiny

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te jug chaare jaate ||
english: by serving the Guru, they are known throughout the four ages.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis no aap dei vadiaaee har kai naam samaavaniaa ||3||
english: Those, upon whom the Lord bestows greatness, are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi har chetai naahee ||
english: Being in love with Maya, they do not think of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਬਧਾ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jamapur badhaa dukh sahaahee ||
english: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, they suffer in terrible pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਨਾ ਬੋਲਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਪਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: a(n)naa bolaa kichh nadar na aavai manamukh paap pachaavaniaa ||4||
english: Blind and deaf, they see nothing at all; the self-willed manmukhs rot away in sin. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ik ra(n)g raate jo tudh aap liv laae ||
english: Those, whom You attach to Your Love, are attuned to Your Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhaai bhagat terai man bhaae ||
english: Through loving devotional worship, they become pleasing to Your Mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਇਛਾ ਆਪਿ ਪੁਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: satigur sevan sadaa sukhadaataa sabh ichhaa aap pujaavaniaa ||5||
english: They serve the True Guru, the Giver of eternal peace, and all their desires are fulfilled. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu teree sadaa saranaaee ||
english: O Dear Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿਹਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: aape bakhasihi de vadiaaee ||
english: You Yourself forgive us, and bless us with Glorious Greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jamakaal tis neR na aavai jo har har naam dhiaavaniaa ||6||
english: The Messenger of Death does not draw near those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anadin raate jo har bhaae ||
english: Night and day, they are attuned to His Love; they are pleasing to the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: merai prabh mele mel milaae ||
english: My God merges with them, and unites them in Union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa sache teree saranaaee too(n) aape sach bujhaavaniaa ||7||
english: Forever and ever, O True Lord, I seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary; You Yourself inspire us to understand the Truth. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: jin sach jaataa se sach samaane ||
english: Those who know the Truth are absorbed in Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavahi sach vakhaane ||
english: They sing the Lord's Glorious Praises, and speak the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laavaniaa ||8||3||4||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam remain unattached and balanced; in the home of the inner self, they are absorbed in the primal trance of deep meditation. ||8||3||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੁ ਮੁਆ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: sabad marai s muaa jaapai ||
english: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad is truly dead.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਚਾਪੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: kaal na chaapai dukh na sa(n)taapai ||
english: Death does not crush him, and pain does not afflict him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jotee vich mil jot samaanee sun man sach samaavaniaa ||1||
english: His light merges and is absorbed into the Light, when he hears and merges in the Truth. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree har kai naai sobhaa paavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the Lord's Name, which brings us to glory.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev sach chit laaiaa guramatee sahaj samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who serves the True Guru, and focuses his consciousness on Truth, following the Guru's Teachings, is absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਚੀ ਕਚਾ ਚੀਰੁ ਹੰਢਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kachee kachaa cheer ha(n)dhaae ||
english: This human body is transitory, and transitory are the garments it wears.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: doojai laagee mahal na paae ||
english: Attached to duality, no one attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਦੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anadin jaladee phirai din raatee bin pir bahu dukh paavaniaa ||2||
english: Night and day, day and night, they burn. Without her Husband Lord, the soul-bride suffers in terrible pain. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dehee jaat na aagai jaae ||
english: Her body and her status shall not go with her to the world hereafter.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਛੁਟੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeai tithai chhutai sach kamaae ||
english: Where she is called to answer for her account, there, she shall be emancipated only by true actions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤੇ ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur sevan se dhanava(n)te aithai othai naam samaavaniaa ||3||
english: Those who serve the True Guru shall prosper; here and hereafter, they are absorbed in the Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhai bhaai seegaar banaae ||
english: She who adorns herself with the Love and the Fear of God,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee mahal ghar paae ||
english: by Guru's Grace, obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence as her home.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: anadin sadaa ravai din raatee majeethai ra(n)g banaavaniaa ||4||
english: Night and day, day and night, she constantly ravishes and enjoys her Beloved. She is dyed in the permanent color of His Love. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa pir vasai sadaa naale ||
english: The Husband Lord abides with everyone, always;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ko nadar nihaale ||
english: but how rare are those few who, by Guru's Grace, obtain His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: meraa prabh at oocho oochaa kar kirapaa aap milaavaniaa ||5||
english: My God is the Highest of the High; granting His Grace, He merges us into Himself. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸੁਤਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi ihu jag sutaa ||
english: This world is asleep in emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੁਤਾ ॥
transliteration: naam visaar a(n)t vigutaa ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, it ultimately comes to ruin.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਤਾ ਸੋ ਜਾਗਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jis te sutaa so jaagaae guramat sojhee paavaniaa ||6||
english: The One who put it to sleep shall also awaken it. Through the Guru's Teachings, understanding dawns. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਐ ਸੋ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: apiu peeai so bharam gavaae ||
english: One who drinks in this Nectar, shall have his delusions dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad mukat gat paae ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the state of liberation is attained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bhagatee rataa sadaa bairaagee aap maar milaavaniaa ||7||
english: One who is imbued with devotion to the Lord, remains always balanced and detached. Subduing selfishness and conceit, he is united with the Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aap upaae dha(n)dhai laae ||
english: He Himself creates, and He Himself assigns us to our tasks.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਪੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraasee rijak aap apaRaae ||
english: He Himself gives sustenance to the 8.4 million species of beings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaai sach raate jo tis bhaavai s kaar karaavaniaa ||8||4||5||
english: O Nanak, those who meditate on the Naam are atuned to Truth. They do that which is pleasing to His Will. ||8||4||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar heeraa laal banaaiaa ||
english: Diamonds and rubies are produced deep within the self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰਖਿ ਪਰਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad parakh parakhaaiaa ||
english: They are assayed and valued through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin sach palai sach vakhaanahi sach kasavatee laavaniaa ||1||
english: Those who have gathered Truth, speak Truth; they apply the Touch-stone of Truth. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree gur kee baanee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Word of the Guru's Bani within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan paaiaa jotee jot milaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the midst of the darkness of the world, they obtain the Immaculate One, and their light merges into the Light. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: is kaaiaa a(n)dar bahut pasaaraa ||
english: Within this body are countless vast vistas;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naam nira(n)jan at agam apaaraa ||
english: the Immaculate Naam is totally Inaccessible and Infinite.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai soee paae aape bakhas milaavaniaa ||2||
english: He alone becomes Gurmukh and obtains it, whom the Lord forgives, and unites with Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: meraa thaakur sach driRaae ||
english: My Lord and Master implants the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sach chit laae ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one's consciousness is attached to the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sacho sach varatai sabhanee thaaee sache sach samaavaniaa ||3||
english: The Truest of the True is pervading everywhere; the true ones merge in Truth. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: veparavaahu sach meraa piaaraa ||
english: The True Carefree Lord is my Beloved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kilavikh avagan kaatanahaaraa ||
english: He cuts out our sinful mistakes and evil actions;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: prem preet sadaa dhiaaeeai bhai bhaai bhagat driRaavaniaa ||4||
english: with love and affection, meditate forever on Him. He implants the Fear of God and loving devotional worship within us. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਜੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: teree bhagat sachee je sache bhaavai ||
english: Devotional worship is True, if it pleases the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aape dei na pachhotaavai ||
english: He Himself bestows it; He does not regret it later.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa eko daataa sabade maar jeevaavaniaa ||5||
english: He alone is the Giver of all beings. The Lord kills with the Word of His Shabad, and then revives. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: har tudh baajhahu mai koee naahee ||
english: Other than You, Lord, nothing is mine.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਸੇਵੀ ਤੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: har tudhai sevee tai tudh saalaahee ||
english: I serve You, Lord, and I praise You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aape mel laihu prabh saache poorai karam too(n) paavaniaa ||6||
english: You unite me with Yourself, O True God. Through perfect good karma You are obtained. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਤੁਧੈ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: mai hor na koee tudhai jehaa ||
english: For me, there is no other like You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: teree nadaree seejhas dehaa ||
english: By Your Glance of Grace, my body is blessed and sanctified.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: anadin saar samaal har raakhahi guramukh sahaj samaavaniaa ||7||
english: Night and day, the Lord takes care of us and protects us. The Gurmukhs are absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tudh jevad mai hor na koee ||
english: For me, there is no other as Great as You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਆਪੇ ਗੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape sirajee aape goee ||
english: You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਘੜਿ ਭੰਨਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੫॥੬॥
transliteration: too(n) aape hee ghaR bha(n)n savaarahi naanak naam suhaavaniaa ||8||5||6||
english: You Yourself create, destroy and adorn. O Nanak, we are adorned and embellished with the Naam. ||8||5||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh ghat aape bhoganahaaraa ||
english: He is the Enjoyer of all hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਲਖੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: alakh varatai agam apaaraa ||
english: The Invisible, Inaccessible and Infinite is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad meraa har prabh dhiaaeeai sahaje sach samaavaniaa ||1||
english: Meditating on my Lord God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am intuitively absorbed in the Truth. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree gurasabad ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who implant the Word of the Guru's Shabad in their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabad soojhai taa man siu loojhai manasaa maar samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When someone understands the Shabad, then he wrestles with his own mind; subduing his desires, he merges with the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਮੁਹਹਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch doot muhahi sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The five enemies are plundering the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhe sudh na saaraa ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand or appreciate this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s apanaa ghar raakhai pa(n)ch doot sabad pachaavaniaa ||2||
english: Those who become Gurmukh-their houses are protected. The five enemies are destroyed by the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: ik guramukh sadaa sachai ra(n)g raate ||
english: The Gurmukhs are forever imbued with love for the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: sahaje prabh sevahi anadin maate ||
english: They serve God with intuitive ease. Night and day, they are intoxicated with His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mil preetam sache gun gaavahi har dar sobhaa paavaniaa ||3||
english: Meeting with their Beloved, they sing the Glorious Praises of the True one; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਮ ਏਕੈ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ekam ekai aap upaaiaa ||
english: First, the One created Himself;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa doojaa tribidh maaiaa ||
english: second, the sense of duality; third, the three-phased Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਊਚੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: chauthee pauRee guramukh oochee sacho sach kamaavaniaa ||4||
english: The fourth state, the highest, is obtained by the Gurmukh, who practices Truth, and only Truth. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਜੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh hai sachaa je sache bhaavai ||
english: Everything which is pleasing to the True Lord is true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jin sach jaataa so sahaj samaavai ||
english: Those who know the Truth merge in intuitive peace and poise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramukh karanee sache sevahi saache jaai samaavaniaa ||5||
english: The life-style of the Gurmukh is to serve the True Lord. He goes and blends with the True Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਆ ॥
transliteration: sache baajhahu ko avar na dooaa ||
english: Without the True One, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਜਗੁ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੂਆ ॥
transliteration: doojai laag jag khap khap mooaa ||
english: Attached to duality, the world is distracted and distressed to death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s eko jaanai eko sev sukh paavaniaa ||6||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh knows only the One. Serving the One, peace is obtained. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh saran tumaaree ||
english: All beings and creatures are in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਕਚੀ ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aape dhar dekhahi kachee pakee saaree ||
english: You place the chessmen on the board; You see the imperfect and the perfect as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: anadin aape kaar karaae aape mel milaavaniaa ||7||
english: Night and day, You cause people to act; You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape melahi vekhahi hadoor ||
english: You Yourself unite, and You see Yourself close at hand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi aap rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: You Yourself are totally pervading amongst all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੬॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak aape aap varatai guramukh sojhee paavaniaa ||8||6||7||
english: O Nanak, God Himself is pervading and permeating everywhere; only the Gurmukhs understand this. ||8||6||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee gur kee meethee ||
english: The Nectar of the Guru's Bani is very sweet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralai kinai chakh deethee ||
english: Rare are the Gurmukhs who see and taste it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tar paragaas mahaa ras peevai dar sachai sabad vajaavaniaa ||1||
english: The Divine Light dawns within, and the supreme essence is found. In the True Court, the Word of the Shabad vibrates. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree gur charanee chit laavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur hai a(n)mrit sar saachaa man naavai mail chukaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru is the True Pool of Nectar; bathing in it, the mind is washed clean of all filth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਚੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: teraa sache kinai a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: Your limits, O True Lord, are not known to anyone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad kinai viralai chit laaiaa ||
english: Rare are those who, by Guru's Grace, focus their consciousness on You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tudh saalaahi na rajaa kabahoo(n) sache naavai kee bhukh laavaniaa ||2||
english: Praising You, I am never satisfied; such is the hunger I feel for the True Name. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
transliteration: eko vekhaa avar na beeaa ||
english: I see only the One, and no other.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee a(n)mrit peeaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad tikhaa nivaaree sahaje sookh samaavaniaa ||3||
english: My thirst is quenched by the Word of the Guru's Shabad; I am absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਲਰਿ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
transliteration: ratan padaarath palar tiaagai ||
english: The Priceless Jewel is discarded like straw;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhaa doojai bhaai laagai ||
english: the blind self-willed manmukhs are attached to the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jo beejai soee phal paae supanai sukh na paavaniaa ||4||
english: As they plant, so do they harvest. They shall not obtain peace, even in their dreams. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: apanee kirapaa kare soee jan paae ||
english: Those who are blessed with His Mercy find the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਭੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: anadin sadaa rahai bhai a(n)dar bhai maar bharam chukaavaniaa ||5||
english: Night and day, they remain in the Fear of God; conquering their fears, their doubts are dispelled. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bharam chukaaiaa sadaa sukh paaiaa ||
english: Dispelling their doubts, they find a lasting peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paaiaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is attained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਹਜੇ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: a(n)tar niramal niramal baanee har gun sahaje gaavaniaa ||6||
english: Deep within, they are pure, and their words are pure as well; intuitively, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: simrit saasat bed vakhaanai ||
english: They recite the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: bharame bhoolaa tat na jaanai ||
english: but deluded by doubt, they do not understand the essence of reality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve sukh na paae dukho dukh kamaavaniaa ||7||
english: Without serving the True Guru, they find no peace; they earn only pain and misery. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aap kare kis aakhai koee ||
english: The Lord Himself acts; unto whom should we complain?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aakhan jaaeeai je bhoolaa hoee ||
english: How can anyone complain that the Lord has made a mistake?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੭॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak aape kare karaae naame naam samaavaniaa ||8||7||8||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself does, and causes things to be done; chanting the Naam, we are absorbed in the Naam. ||8||7||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape ra(n)ge sahaj subhaae ||
english: He Himself imbues us with His Love, with effortless ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad har ra(n)g chaRaae ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are dyed in the color of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੀ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man tan rataa rasanaa ra(n)g chaloolee bhai bhaai ra(n)g chaRaavaniaa ||1||
english: This mind and body are so imbued, and this tongue is dyed in the deep crimson color of the poppy. Through the Love and the Fear of God, we are dyed in this color. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree nirabhau ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Fearless Lord within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te har nirabhau dhiaaiaa bikh bhaujal sabad taraavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Fearless Lord; the Shabad has carried me across the poisonous world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mugadh karahi chaturaaee ||
english: The idiotic self-willed manmukhs try to be clever,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਤਾ ਧੋਤਾ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naataa dhotaa thaai na paaee ||
english: but in spite of their bathing and washing, they shall not be acceptable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਆਇਆ ਤੇਹਾ ਜਾਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jehaa aaiaa tehaa jaasee kar avagan pachhotaavaniaa ||2||
english: As they came, so shall they go, regretting the mistakes they made. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhe kichhoo na soojhai ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand anything;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਆਏ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: maran likhaai aae nahee boojhai ||
english: death was pre-ordained for them when they came into the world, but they do not understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: manamukh karam kare nahee paae bin naavai janam gavaavaniaa ||3||
english: The self-willed manmukhs may practice religious rituals, but they do not obtain the Name; without the Name, they lose this life in vain. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sach karanee sabad hai saar ||
english: The practice of Truth is the essence of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: poorai gur paaeeai mokh duaar ||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, the gate of salvation is found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: anadin baanee sabad sunaae sach raate ra(n)g ra(n)gaavaniaa ||4||
english: So, night and day, listen to the Word of the Guru's Bani, and the Shabad. Let yourself be colored by this love. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa har ras raatee ra(n)g laae ||
english: The tongue, imbued with the Lord's Essence, delights in His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: man tan mohiaa sahaj subhaae ||
english: My mind and body are enticed by the Lord's Sublime Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sahaje preetam piaaraa paaiaa sahaje sahaj milaavaniaa ||5||
english: I have easily obtained my Darling Beloved; I am intuitively absorbed in celestial peace. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jis a(n)dar ra(n)g soee gun gaavai ||
english: Those who have the Lord's Love within, sing His Glorious Praises;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad sahaje sukh samaavai ||
english: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are intuitively absorbed in celestial peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree sadaa tin vitahu gur sevaa chit laavaniaa ||6||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who dedicate their consciousness to the Guru's Service. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: sachaa sacho sach pateejai ||
english: The True Lord is pleased with Truth, and only Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee a(n)dar bheejai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one's inner being is deeply imbued with His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਮਨਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bais suthaan har gun gaavahi aape kar sat manaavaniaa ||7||
english: Sitting in that blessed place, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, who Himself inspires us to accept His Truth. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis no nadar kare so paae ||
english: That one, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtains it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee haumai jaae ||
english: By Guru's Grace, egotism departs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੮॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar dar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||8||8||9||
english: O Nanak, that one, within whose mind the Name dwells, is honored in the True Court. ||8||8||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur seviai vadee vadiaaee ||
english: Serving the True Guru is the greatest greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: har jee achi(n)t vasai man aaee ||
english: The Dear Lord automatically comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਖਾ ਲਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har jeeu saphalio birakh hai a(n)mrit jin peetaa tis tikhaa lahaavaniaa ||1||
english: The Dear Lord is the fruit-bearing tree; drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, thirst is quenched. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree sach sa(n)gat mel milaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the one who leads me to join the True Congregation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har satasa(n)gat aape melai gurasabadee har gun gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord Himself unites me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevee sabad suhaaiaa ||
english: I serve the True Guru; the Word of His Shabad is beautiful.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
english: Through it, the Name of the Lord comes to dwell within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har niramal haumai mail gavaae dar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||2||
english: The Pure Lord removes the filth of egotism, and we are honored in the True Court. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur naam na paaiaa jaai ||
english: Without the Guru, the Naam cannot be obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik rahe bilalaai ||
english: The Siddhas and the seekers lack it; they weep and wail.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin gur seve sukh na hovee poorai bhaag gur paavaniaa ||3||
english: Without serving the True Guru, peace is not obtained; through perfect destiny, the Guru is found. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਰਸੀ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu man aarasee koee guramukh vekhai ||
english: This mind is a mirror; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, see themselves in it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਰਚਾ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
transliteration: morachaa na laagai jaa haumai sokhai ||
english: Rust does not stick to those who burn their ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: anahat baanee niramal sabad vajaae gurasabadee sach samaavaniaa ||4||
english: The Unstruck Melody of the Bani resounds through the Pure Word of the Shabad; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are absorbed into the True One. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਹੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur kihu na dekhiaa jaai ||
english: Without the True Guru, the Lord cannot be seen.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa kar aap ditaa dikhaai ||
english: Granting His Grace, He Himself has allowed me to see Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aape aap aap mil rahiaa sahaje sahaj samaavaniaa ||5||
english: All by Himself, He Himself is permeating and pervading; He is intuitively absorbed in celestial peace. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s ikas siu liv laae ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh embraces love for the One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: doojaa bharam gur sabad jalaae ||
english: Doubt and duality are burned away by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar vanaj kare vaapaaraa naam nidhaan sach paavaniaa ||6||
english: Within his body, he deals and trades, and obtains the Treasure of the True Name. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh karanee har keerat saar ||
english: The life-style of the Gurmukh is sublime; he sings the Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh paae mokh duaar ||
english: The Gurmukh finds the gate of salvation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: anadin ra(n)g rataa gun gaavai a(n)dar mahal bulaavaniaa ||7||
english: Night and day, he is imbued with the Lord's Love. He sings the Lord's Glorious Praises, and he is called to the Mansion of His Presence. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur daataa milai milaaiaa ||
english: The True Guru, the Giver, is met when the Lord leads us to meet Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag man sabad vasaaiaa ||
english: Through perfect destiny, the Shabad is enshrined in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੯॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee har sache ke gun gaavaniaa ||8||9||10||
english: O Nanak, the greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained by chanting the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||8||9||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਵੰਞਾਏ ਤਾ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aap va(n)njaae taa sabh kichh paae ||
english: Those who lose their own selves obtain everything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee sachee liv laae ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enshrine Love for the True one.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਘਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sach vana(n)jahi sach sa(n)gharahi sach vaapaar karaavaniaa ||1||
english: They trade in Truth, they gather in Truth, and they deal only in Truth. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree har gun anadin gaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau teraa too(n) thaakur meraa sabad vadiaaee devaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am Yours, You are my Lord and Master. You bestow greatness through the Word of Your Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: velaa vakhat sabh suhaaiaa ||
english: That time, that moment is totally beautiful,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jit sachaa mere man bhaaiaa ||
english: when the True One becomes pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sache seviai sach vadiaaee gur kirapaa te sach paavaniaa ||2||
english: Serving the True One, true greatness is obtained. By Guru's Grace, the True One is obtained. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhaau bhojan satigur tuthai paae ||
english: The food of spiritual love is obtained when the True Guru is pleased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਰਸੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: an ras chookai har ras ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: Other essences are forgotten, when the Lord's Essence comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sach sa(n)tokh sahaj sukh baanee poore gur te paavaniaa ||3||
english: Truth, contentment and intuitive peace and poise are obtained from the Bani, the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur na sevahi moorakh a(n)dh gavaaraa ||
english: The blind and ignorant fools do not serve the True Guru;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਓਇ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: phir oi kithahu paain mokh duaaraa ||
english: how will they find the gate of salvation?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mahi phir phir aavahi jam dar chotaa khaavaniaa ||4||
english: They die and die, over and over again, only to be reborn, over and over again. They are struck down at Death's Door. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sabadai saad jaanahi taa aap pachhaanahi ||
english: Those who know the essence of the Shabad, understand their own selves.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: niramal baanee sabad vakhaanahi ||
english: Immaculate is the speech of those who chant the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sache sev sadaa sukh paain nau nidh naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||5||
english: Serving the True One, they find a lasting peace; they enshrine the nine treasures of the Naam within their minds. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: so thaan suhaaiaa jo har man bhaaiaa ||
english: Beautiful is that place, which is pleasing to the Lord's Mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat bahi har gun gaaiaa ||
english: There, sitting in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: anadin har saalaahahi saachaa niramal naad vajaavaniaa ||6||
english: Night and day, the True One is praised; the Immaculate Sound-current of the Naad resounds there. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਖੋਟਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh khotee raas khotaa paasaaraa ||
english: The wealth of the self-willed manmukhs is false, and false is their ostentatious display.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kooR kamaavan dukh laagai bhaaraa ||
english: They practice falsehood, and suffer terrible pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bharame bhoole phiran din raatee mar janamahi janam gavaavaniaa ||7||
english: Deluded by doubt, they wander day and night; through birth and death, they lose their lives. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੈ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib mai at piaaraa ||
english: My True Lord and Master is very dear to me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kai sabad adhaaraa ||
english: The Shabad of the Perfect Guru is my Support.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੦॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee dukh sukh sam kar jaananiaa ||8||10||11||
english: O Nanak, one who obtains the Greatness of the Naam, looks upon pain and pleasure as one and the same. ||8||10||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: tereeaa khaanee tereeaa baanee ||
english: The four sources of creation are Yours; the spoken word is Yours.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai sabh bharam bhulaanee ||
english: Without the Name, all are deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te har naam paaiaa bin satigur koi na paavaniaa ||1||
english: Serving the Guru, the Lord's Name is obtained. Without the True Guru, no one can receive it. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree har setee chit laavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har sachaa gur bhagatee paaeeai sahaje ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through devotion to the Guru, the True One is found; He comes to abide in the mind, with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve taa sabh kichh paae ||
english: Serving the True Guru, all things are obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jehee manasaa kar laagai tehaa phal paae ||
english: As are the desires one harbors, so are the rewards one receives.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਥੂ ਕਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur daataa sabhanaa vathoo kaa poorai bhaag milaavaniaa ||2||
english: The True Guru is the Giver of all things; through perfect destiny, He is met. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਇਕੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: ihu man mailaa ik na dhiaae ||
english: This mind is filthy and polluted; it does not meditate on the One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar mail laagee bahu doojai bhaae ||
english: Deep within, it is soiled and stained by the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਭਵੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਵਧੇਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tat teerath disa(n)tar bhavai aha(n)kaaree hor vadherai haumai mal laavaniaa ||3||
english: The egotists may go on pilgrimages to holy rivers, sacred shrines and foreign lands, but they only gather more of the dirt of egotism. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve taa mal jaae ||
english: Serving the True Guru, filth and pollution are removed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jeevat marai har siu chit laae ||
english: Those who focus their consciousness on the Lord remain dead while yet alive.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har niramal sach mail na laagai sach laagai mail gavaavaniaa ||4||
english: The True Lord is Pure; no filth sticks to Him. Those who are attached to the True One have their filth washed away. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: baajh guroo hai a(n)dh gubaaraa ||
english: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: agiaanee a(n)dhaa a(n)dh a(n)dhaaraa ||
english: The ignorant ones are blind-there is only utter darkness for them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bisataa ke keeRe bisataa kamaavahi phir bisataa maahi pachaavaniaa ||5||
english: The maggots in manure do filthy deeds, and in filth they rot and putrefy. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mukate seve mukataa hovai ||
english: Serving the Lord of Liberation, liberation is achieved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa sabade khovai ||
english: The Word of the Shabad eradicates egotism and possessiveness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: anadin har jeeu sachaa sevee poorai bhaag gur paavaniaa ||6||
english: So serve the Dear True Lord, night and day. By perfect good destiny, the Guru is found. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape bakhase mel milaae ||
english: He Himself forgives and unites in His Union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: poore gur te naam nidh paae ||
english: From the Perfect Guru, the Treasure of the Naam is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sachai naam sadaa man sachaa sach seve dukh gavaavaniaa ||7||
english: By the True Name, the mind is made true forever. Serving the True Lord, sorrow is driven out. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa hajoor door na jaanahu ||
english: He is always close at hand-do not think that He is far away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee har a(n)tar pachhaanahu ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Lord deep within your own being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੧॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee poore gur te paavaniaa ||8||11||12||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, glorious greatness is received. Through the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained. ||8||11||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
transliteration: aithai saache s aagai saache ||
english: Those who are True here, are True hereafter as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਚੇ ॥
transliteration: man sachaa sachai sabad raache ||
english: That mind is true, which is attuned to the True Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sachaa sevahi sach kamaavahi sacho sach kamaavaniaa ||1||
english: They serve the True One, and practice Truth; they earn Truth, and only Truth. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree sachaa naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those whose minds are filled with the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sache sevahi sach samaavahi sache ke gun gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They serve the True One, and are absorbed into the True One, singing the Glorious Praises of the True One. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit paRahi saad na paavahi ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars read, but they do not taste the essence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਭਰਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
