transliteration: doojai bhaai maaiaa man bharamaavahi ||
english: In love with duality and Maya, their minds wander, unfocused.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਧਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi sabh sudh gavaaee kar avagan pachhotaavaniaa ||2||
english: The love of Maya has displaced all their understanding; making mistakes, they live in regret. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਤਤੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai taa tat paae ||
english: But if they should meet the True Guru, then they obtain the essence of reality;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: the Name of the Lord comes to dwell in their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabad marai man maarai apunaa mukatee kaa dar paavaniaa ||3||
english: Those who die in the Shabad and subdue their own minds, obtain the door of liberation. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kilavikh kaatai krodh nivaare ||
english: They erase their sins, and eliminate their anger;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad rakhai ur dhaare ||
english: they keep the Guru's Shabad clasped tightly to their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sach rate sadaa bairaagee haumai maar milaavaniaa ||4||
english: Those who are attuned to Truth, remain balanced and detached forever. Subduing their egotism, they are united with the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar ratan milai milaaiaa ||
english: Deep within the nucleus of the self is the jewel; we receive it only if the Lord inspires us to receive it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tribidh manasaa tribidh maaiaa ||
english: The mind is bound by the three dispositions-the three modes of Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit monee thake chauthe pad kee saar na paavaniaa ||5||
english: Reading and reciting, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages have grown weary, but they have not found the supreme essence of the fourth state. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape ra(n)ge ra(n)g chaRaae ||
english: The Lord Himself dyes us in the color of His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: se jan raate gur sabad ra(n)gaae ||
english: Only those who are steeped in the Word of the Guru's Shabad are so imbued with His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g chaRiaa at apaaraa har ras ras gun gaavaniaa ||6||
english: Imbued with the most beautiful color of the Lord's Love, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, with great pleasure and joy. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ridh sidh sach sa(n)jam soee ||
english: To the Gurmukh, the True Lord is wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and strict self-discipline.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh giaan naam mukat hoee ||
english: Through the spiritual wisdom of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Gurmukh is liberated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramukh kaar sach kamaavahi sache sach samaavaniaa ||7||
english: The Gurmukh practices Truth, and is absorbed in the Truest of the True. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh thaape thaap uthaape ||
english: The Gurmukh realizes that the Lord alone creates, and having created, He destroys.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jaat pat sabh aape ||
english: To the Gurmukh, the Lord Himself is social class, status and all honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੨॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh naam dhiaae naame naam samaavaniaa ||8||12||13||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; through the Naam, they merge in the Naam. ||8||12||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਉਤਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: utapat paralau sabade hovai ||
english: Creation and destruction happen through the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sabade hee phir opat hovai ||
english: Through the Shabad, creation happens again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh varatai sabh aape sachaa guramukh upaai samaavaniaa ||1||
english: The Gurmukh knows that the True Lord is all-pervading. The Gurmukh understands creation and merger. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree gur pooraa ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Perfect Guru within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur te saat bhagat kare din raatee gun kahi gunee samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: From the Guru comes peace and tranquility; worship Him with devotion, day and night. Chanting His Glorious Praises, merge into the Glorious Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh dharatee guramukh paanee ||
english: The Gurmukh sees the Lord on the earth, and the Gurmukh sees Him in the water.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਵਣੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh pavan baisa(n)tar khelai vidaanee ||
english: The Gurmukh sees Him in wind and fire; such is the wonder of His Play.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਿਗੁਰਾ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so niguraa jo mar mar ja(n)mai nigure aavan jaavaniaa ||2||
english: One who has no Guru, dies over and over again, only to be re-born. One who has no Guru continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਇਕੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tin karatai ik khel rachaaiaa ||
english: The One Creator has set this play in motion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਸਰੀਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa sareerai vich sabh kichh paaiaa ||
english: In the frame of the human body, He has placed all things.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਕੋਈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabad bhed koee mahal paae mahale mahal bulaavaniaa ||3||
english: Those few who are pierced through by the Word of the Shabad, obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. He calls them into His Wondrous Palace. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahu sache vanajaare ||
english: True is the Banker, and true are His traders.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sach vana(n)jahi gur het apaare ||
english: They purchase Truth, with infinite love for the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sach vihaajhahi sach kamaavahi sacho sach kamaavaniaa ||4||
english: They deal in Truth, and they practice Truth. They earn Truth, and only Truth. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਕੋ ਵਥੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bin raasee ko vath kiu paae ||
english: Without investment capital, how can anyone acquire merchandise?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhoole lok sabaae ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs have all gone astray.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਸਭ ਖਾਲੀ ਚਲੇ ਖਾਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bin raasee sabh khaalee chale khaalee jaai dukh paavaniaa ||5||
english: Without true wealth, everyone goes empty-handed; going empty-handed, they suffer in pain. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ik sach vana(n)jahi gur sabad piaare ||
english: Some deal in Truth, through love of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aap tarahi sagale kul taare ||
english: They save themselves, and save all their ancestors as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aae se paravaan hoe mil preetam sukh paavaniaa ||6||
english: Very auspicious is the coming of those who meet their Beloved and find peace. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਮੂੜਾ ਬਾਹਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar vasat mooRaa baahar bhaale ||
english: Deep within the self is the secret, but the fool looks for it outside.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhe phirahi betaale ||
english: The blind self-willed manmukhs wander around like demons;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਥਹੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jithai vath hovai tithahu koi na paavai manamukh bharam bhulaavaniaa ||7||
english: but where the secret is, there, they do not find it. The manmukhs are deluded by doubt. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape devai sabad bulaae ||
english: He Himself calls us, and bestows the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mahalee mahal sahaj sukh paae ||
english: The soul-bride finds intuitive peace and poise in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੩॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee aape sun sun dhiaavaniaa ||8||13||14||
english: O Nanak, she obtains the glorious greatness of the Naam; she hears it again and again, and she meditates on it. ||8||13||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur saachee sikh sunaaee ||
english: The True Guru has imparted the True Teachings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har chetahu a(n)t hoi sakhaaee ||
english: Think of the Lord, who shall be your Help and Support in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har agam agochar anaath ajonee satigur kai bhaai paavaniaa ||1||
english: The Lord is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. He has no master, and He is not born. He is obtained through love of the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree aap nivaaraniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who eliminate selfishness and conceit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aap gavaae taa har paae har siu sahaj samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They eradicate selfishness and conceit, and then find the Lord; they are intuitively immersed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa s karam kamaaiaa ||
english: According to their pre-ordained destiny, they act out their karma.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaiaa ||
english: Serving the True Guru, a lasting peace is found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin bhaagaa gur paaeeai naahee sabadai mel milaavaniaa ||2||
english: Without good fortune, the Guru is not found. Through the Word of the Shabad, they are united in the Lord's Union. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh alipat rahai sa(n)saare ||
english: The Gurmukhs remain unaffected in the midst of the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਤਕੀਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai takeeai naam adhaare ||
english: The Guru is their cushion, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is their Support.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਖਪਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh jor kare kiaa tis no aape khap dukh paavaniaa ||3||
english: Who can oppress the Gurmukh? One who tries shall perish, writhing in pain. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhe sudh na kaaee ||
english: The blind self-willed manmukhs have no understanding at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ਹੈ ਜਗਤ ਕਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aatam ghaatee hai jagat kasaaee ||
english: They are the assassins of the self, and the butchers of the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਭਾਰੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa kar kar bahu bhaar uthaavai bin majooree bhaar pahuchaavaniaa ||4||
english: By continually slandering others, they carry a terrible load, and they carry the loads of others for nothing. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਾੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: ihu jag vaaRee meraa prabh maalee ||
english: This world is a garden, and my Lord God is the Gardener.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: sadaa samaale ko naahee khaalee ||
english: He always takes care of it-nothing is exempt from His Care.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਪਾਏ ਤੇਹੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਾਸੂ ਵਾਸੁ ਜਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jehee vaasanaa paae tehee varatai vaasoo vaas janaavaniaa ||5||
english: As is the fragrance which He bestows, so is the fragrant flower known. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh rogee hai sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are sick and diseased in the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sukhadaataa visariaa agam apaaraa ||
english: They have forgotten the Giver of peace, the Unfathomable, the Infinite.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀਏ ਨਿਤਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: dukheee nit phirahi bilalaade bin gur saa(n)t na paavaniaa ||6||
english: These miserable people wander endlessly, crying out in pain; without the Guru, they find no peace. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jin keete soee bidh jaanai ||
english: The One who created them, knows their condition.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: aap kare taa hukam pachhaanai ||
english: And if He inspires them, then they realize the Hukam of His Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਤੇਹਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jehaa a(n)dar paae tehaa varatai aape baahar paavaniaa ||7||
english: Whatever He places within them, that is what prevails, and so they outwardly appear. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tis baajhahu sache mai hor na koee ||
english: I know of no other except the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jis laai lae so niramal hoee ||
english: Those, whom the Lord attaches to Himself, become pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੪॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghat a(n)tar jis devai so paavaniaa ||8||14||15||
english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the heart of those, unto whom He has given it. ||8||14||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: Enshrining the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, in the mind,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: haumai meraa sabh dukh gavaae ||
english: all the pains of egotism, selfishness and conceit are eliminated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee sadaa salaahe a(n)mrit a(n)mrit paavaniaa ||1||
english: By continually praising the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, I obtain the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree a(n)mrit baanee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Ambrosial Bani of the Word within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee ma(n)n vasaae a(n)mrit naam dhiaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Enshrining the Ambrosial Bani in their minds, they meditate on the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਵੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit bolai sadaa mukh vainee ||
english: Those who continually chant the Ambrosial Words of Nectar,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਪਰਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit vekhai parakhai sadaa nainee ||
english: See and behold this Amrit everywhere with their eyes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ਕਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਵਰਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਨਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit kathaa kahai sadaa din raatee avaraa aakh sunaavaniaa ||2||
english: They continually chant the Ambrosial Sermon day and night; chanting it, they cause others to hear it. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit ra(n)g rataa liv laae ||
english: Imbued with the Ambrosial Love of the Lord, they lovingly focus their attention on Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit gur parasaadee paae ||
english: By Guru's Grace, they receive this Amrit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit rasanaa bolai din raatee man tan a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||3||
english: They chant the Ambrosial Name with their tongues day and night; their minds and bodies are satisfied by this Amrit. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: so kichh karai j chit na hoee ||
english: That which God does is beyond anyone's consciousness;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tis daa hukam met na sakai koee ||
english: no one can erase the Hukam of His Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: hukame varatai a(n)mrit baanee hukame a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||4||
english: By His Command, the Ambrosial Bani of the Word prevails, and by His Command, we drink in the Amrit. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਜਬ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ajab ka(n)m karate har kere ||
english: The actions of the Creator Lord are marvellous and wonderful.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਫੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ihu man bhoolaa jaa(n)daa phere ||
english: This mind is deluded, and goes around the wheel of reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee siu chit laae a(n)mrit sabad vajaavaniaa ||5||
english: Those who focus their consciousness on the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, hear the vibrations of the Ambrosial Word of the Shabad. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: khote khare tudh aap upaae ||
english: You Yourself created the counterfeit and the genuine.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape parakhe lok sabaae ||
english: You Yourself appraise all people.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: khare parakh khajaanai paaihi khote bharam bhulaavaniaa ||6||
english: You appraise the true, and place them in Your Treasury; You consign the false to wander in delusion. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਾ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kiu kar vekhaa kiu saalaahee ||
english: How can I behold You? How can I praise You?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sabad salaahee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I praise You through the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਣੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tere bhaane vich a(n)mrit vasai too(n) bhaanai a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||7||
english: In Your Sweet Will, the Amrit is found; by Your Will, You inspire us to drink in this Amrit. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit sabad a(n)mrit har baanee ||
english: The Shabad is Amrit; the Lord's Bani is Amrit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur seviai ridai samaanee ||
english: Serving the True Guru, it permeates the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੫॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak a(n)mrit naam sadaa sukhadaataa pee a(n)mrit sabh bhukh lahi jaavaniaa ||8||15||16||
english: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Naam is forever the Giver of peace; drinking in this Amrit, all hunger is satisfied. ||8||15||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit varasai sahaj subhaae ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down, softly and gently.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralaa koee jan paae ||
english: How rare are those Gurmukhs who find it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit pee sadaa tripataase kar kirapaa trisanaa bujhaavaniaa ||1||
english: Those who drink it in are satisfied forever. Showering His Mercy upon them, the Lord quenches their thirst. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree guramukh a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those Gurmukhs who drink in this Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa ras chaakh sadaa rahai ra(n)g raatee sahaje har gun gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The tongue tastes the essence, and remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love, intuitively singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਜੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sahaj ko paae ||
english: By Guru's Grace, intuitive understanding is obtained;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa maare ikas siu liv laae ||
english: subduing the sense of duality, they are in love with the One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa har gun gaavai nadaree sach samaavaniaa ||2||
english: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, then they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; by His Grace, they merge in Truth. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa upar nadar prabh teree ||
english: Above all is Your Glance of Grace, O God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੈ ਥੋੜੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਹੈ ਘਣੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kisai thoRee kisai hai ghaneree ||
english: Upon some it is bestowed less, and upon others it is bestowed more.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tujh te baahar kichh na hovai guramukh sojhee paavaniaa ||3||
english: Without You, nothing happens at all; the Gurmukhs understand this. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh tat hai beechaaraa ||
english: The Gurmukhs contemplate the essence of reality;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit bhare tere bha(n)daaraa ||
english: Your Treasures are overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve koee na paavai gur kirapaa te paavaniaa ||4||
english: Without serving the True Guru, no one obtains it. It is obtained only by Guru's Grace. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevai so jan sohai ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru are beautiful.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam a(n)tar man mohai ||
english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, entices their inner minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit man tan baanee rataa a(n)mrit sahaj sunaavaniaa ||5||
english: Their minds and bodies are attuned to the Ambrosial Bani of the Word; this Ambrosial Nectar is intuitively heard. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhoolaa doojai bhaai khuaae ||
english: The deluded, self-willed manmukhs are ruined through the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ਮਰੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naam na levai marai bikh khaae ||
english: They do not chant the Naam, and they die, eating poison.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: anadin sadaa visataa mahi vaasaa bin sevaa janam gavaavaniaa ||6||
english: Night and day, they continually sit in manure. Without selfless service, their lives are wasted away. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit peevai jis no aap peeaae ||
english: They alone drink in this Amrit, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sahaj liv laae ||
english: By Guru's Grace, they intuitively enshrine love for the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: pooran poor rahiaa sabh aape guramat nadaree aavaniaa ||7||
english: The Perfect Lord is Himself perfectly pervading everywhere; through the Guru's Teachings, He is perceived. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape aap nira(n)jan soee ||
english: He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jin sirajee tin aape goee ||
english: He who has created, shall Himself destroy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੬॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak naam samaal sadaa too(n) sahaje sach samaavaniaa ||8||16||17||
english: O Nanak, remember the Naam forever, and you shall merge into the True One with intuitive ease. ||8||16||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: se sach laage jo tudh bhaae ||
english: Those who please You are linked to the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sach sevahi sahaj subhaae ||
english: They serve the True One forever, with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sachai sabad sachaa saalaahee sachai mel milaavaniaa ||1||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they praise the True One, and they merge in the merging of Truth. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree sach saalaahaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who praise the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sach dhiaain se sach raate sache sach samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who meditate on the True One are attuned to Truth; they are absorbed into the Truest of the True. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa sach sabhanee thaaee ||
english: The True One is everywhere, wherever I look.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ma(n)n vasaaee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I enshrine Him in my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tan sachaa rasanaa sach raatee sach sun aakh vakhaananiaa ||2||
english: True are the bodies of those whose tongues are attuned to Truth. They hear the Truth, and speak it with their mouths. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: manasaa maar sach samaanee ||
english: Subduing their desires, they merge with the True One;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਡੀਠੀ ਸਭ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: in man deethee sabh aavan jaanee ||
english: they see in their minds that everyone comes and goes in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur seve sadaa man nihachal nij ghar vaasaa paavaniaa ||3||
english: Serving the True Guru, they become stable forever, and they obtain their dwelling in the home of the self. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad ridai dikhaaiaa ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is seen within one's own heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabad jalaaiaa ||
english: Through the Shabad, I have burned my emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sacho sachaa vekh saalaahee gurasabadee sach paavaniaa ||4||
english: I gaze upon the Truest of the True, and I praise Him. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I obtain the True One. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: jo sach raate tin sachee liv laagee ||
english: Those who are attuned to Truth are blessed with the Love of the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: har naam samaalahi se vadabhaagee ||
english: Those who praise the Lord's Name are very fortunate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sachai sabad aap milaae satasa(n)gat sach gun gaavaniaa ||5||
english: Through the Word of His Shabad, the True One blends with Himself, those who join the True Congregation and sing the Glorious Praises of the True One. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਲੇਖੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: lekhaa paReeai je lekhe vich hovai ||
english: We could read the account of the Lord, if He were in any account.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ohu agam agochar sabad sudh hovai ||
english: He is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible; through the Shabad, understanding is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: anadin sach sabad saalaahee hor koi na keemat paavaniaa ||6||
english: Night and day, praise the True Word of the Shabad. There is no other way to know His Worth. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: paR paR thaake saa(n)t na aaee ||
english: People read and recite until they grow weary, but they do not find peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਾਲੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa jaale sudh na kaaee ||
english: Consumed by desire, they have no understanding at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bikh bihaajhahi bikh moh piaase kooR bol bikh khaavaniaa ||7||
english: They purchase poison, and they are thirsty with their fascination for poison. Telling lies, they eat poison. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee eko jaanaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I know the One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: doojaa maar man sach samaanaa ||
english: Subduing my sense of duality, my mind is absorbed into the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak eko naam varatai man a(n)tar gur parasaadee paavaniaa ||8||17||18||
english: O Nanak, the One Name is pervading deep within my mind; by Guru's Grace, I receive it. ||8||17||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਰਨ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: varan roop varatahi sabh tere ||
english: In all colors and forms, You are pervading.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਫੇਰ ਪਵਹਿ ਘਣੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mahi pher pavahi ghanere ||
english: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and make their rounds on the wheel of reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too(n) eko nihachal agam apaaraa guramatee boojh bujhaavaniaa ||1||
english: You alone are Eternal and Unchanging, Inaccessible and Infinite. Through the Guru's Teachings, understanding is imparted. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree raam naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਵਰਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tis roop na rekhiaa varan na koee guramatee aap bujhaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord has no form, features or color. Through the Guru's Teachings, He inspires us to understand Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh ekaa jot jaanai je koee ||
english: The One Light is all-pervading; only a few know this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur seviai paragat hoee ||
english: Serving the True Guru, this is revealed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gupat paragat varatai sabh thaaee jotee jot milaavaniaa ||2||
english: In the hidden and in the obvious, He is pervading all places. Our light merges into the Light. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tisanaa agan jalai sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The world is burning in the fire of desire,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: lobh abhimaan bahut aha(n)kaaraa ||
english: in greed, arrogance and excessive ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਏ ਅਪਣੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mar mar janamai pat gavaae apanee birathaa janam gavaavaniaa ||3||
english: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and lose their honor. They waste away their lives in vain. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad ko viralaa boojhai ||
english: Those who understand the Word of the Guru's Shabad are very rare.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: aap maare taa tribhavan soojhai ||
english: Those who subdue their egotism, come to know the three worlds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: phir ohu marai na maranaa hovai sahaje sach samaavaniaa ||4||
english: Then, they die, never to die again. They are intuitively absorbed in the True One. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mahi phir chit na laae ||
english: They do not focus their consciousness on Maya again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad sad rahai samaae ||
english: They remain absorbed forever in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sach salaahe sabh ghat a(n)tar sacho sach suhaavaniaa ||5||
english: They praise the True One, who is contained deep within all hearts. They are blessed and exalted by the Truest of the True. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sach saalaahee sadaa hajoore ||
english: Praise the True One, who is Ever-present.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad rahiaa bharapoore ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sach nadaree aavai sache hee sukh paavaniaa ||6||
english: By Guru's Grace, we come to behold the True One; from the True One, peace is obtained. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sach man a(n)dar rahiaa samaai ||
english: The True One permeates and pervades the mind within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sach nihachal aavai na jaai ||
english: The True One is Eternal and Unchanging; He does not come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sache laagai so man niramal guramatee sach samaavaniaa ||7||
english: Those who are attached to the True One are immaculate and pure. Through the Guru's Teachings, they merge in the True One. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sach saalaahee avar na koee ||
english: Praise the True One, and no other.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jit seviai sadaa sukh hoee ||
english: Serving Him, eternal peace is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੮॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate veechaaree sacho sach kamaavaniaa ||8||18||19||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, reflect deeply on the Truth; they practice only Truth. ||8||18||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: niramal sabad niramal hai baanee ||
english: The Word of the Shabad is Immaculate and Pure; the Bani of the Word is Pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: niramal jot sabh maahi samaanee ||
english: The Light which is pervading among all is Immaculate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: niramal baanee har saalaahee jap har niramal mail gavaavaniaa ||1||
english: So praise the Immaculate Word of the Lord's Bani; chanting the Immaculate Name of the Lord, all filth is washed away. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree sukhadaataa ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Giver of peace within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਬਦੋ ਸੁਣਿ ਤਿਸਾ ਮਿਟਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har niramal gur sabad salaahee sabado sun tisaa mitaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Praise the Immaculate Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Listen to the Shabad, and quench your thirst. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: niramal naam vasiaa man aae ||
english: When the Immaculate Naam comes to dwell in the mind,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: man tan niramal maaiaa mohu gavaae ||
english: the mind and body become Immaculate, and emotional attachment to Maya departs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: niramal gun gaavai nit saache ke niramal naad vajaavaniaa ||2||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate True Lord forever, and the Immaculate Sound-current of the Naad shall vibrate within. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: niramal a(n)mrit gur te paaiaa ||
english: The Immaculate Ambrosial Nectar is obtained from the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਮੁਆ ਤਿਥੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vichahu aap muaa tithai mohu na maaiaa ||
english: When selfishness and conceit are eradicated from within, then there is no attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: niramal giaan dhiaan at niramal niramal baanee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||3||
english: Immaculate is the spiritual wisdom, and utterly immaculate is the meditation, of those whose minds are filled with the Immaculate Bani of the Word. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo niramal seve s niramal hovai ||
english: One who serves the Immaculate Lord becomes immaculate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: haumai mail gurasabade dhovai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the filth of egotism is washed away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਵਾਜੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: niramal vaajai anahad dhun baanee dar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||4||
english: The Immaculate Bani and the Unstruck Melody of the Sound-current vibrate, and in the True Court, honor is obtained. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: niramal te sabh niramal hovai ||
english: Through the Immaculate Lord, all become immaculate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: niramal manooaa har sabad parovai ||
english: Immaculate is the mind which weaves the Word of the Lord's Shabad into itself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: niramal naam lage badabhaagee niramal naam suhaavaniaa ||5||
english: Blessed and very fortunate are those who are committed to the Immaculate Name; through the Immaculate Name, they are blessed and beautified. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜੋ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: so niramal jo sabade sohai ||
english: Immaculate is the one who is adorned with the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: niramal naam man tan mohai ||
english: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, entices the mind and body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sach naam mal kade na laagai mukh oojal sach karaavaniaa ||6||
english: No filth ever attaches itself to the True Name; one's face is made radiant by the True One. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man mailaa hai doojai bhaai ||
english: The mind is polluted by the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾ ਚਉਕਾ ਮੈਲੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mailaa chaukaa mailai thaai ||
english: Filthy is that kitchen, and filthy is that dwelling;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾ ਖਾਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: mailaa khaai phir mail vadhaae manamukh mail dukh paavaniaa ||7||
english: eating filth, the self-willed manmukhs become even more filthy. Because of their filth, they suffer in pain. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਭਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
transliteration: maile niramal sabh hukam sabaae ||
english: The filthy, and the immaculate as well, are all subject to the Hukam of God's Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: se niramal jo har saache bhaae ||
english: They alone are immaculate, who are pleasing to the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੯॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar guramukh mail chukaavaniaa ||8||19||20||
english: O Nanak, the Naam abides deep within the minds of the Gurmukhs, who are cleansed of all their filth. ||8||19||20||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਊਜਲ ਹੰਸਾ ॥
transliteration: govi(n)d oojal oojal ha(n)saa ||
english: The Lord of the Universe is radiant, and radiant are His soul-swans.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨਸਾ ॥
transliteration: man baanee niramal meree manasaa ||
english: Their minds and their speech are immaculate; they are my hope and ideal.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਊਜਲ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਅਤਿ ਊਜਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man oojal sadaa mukh sohahi at oojal naam dhiaavaniaa ||1||
english: Their minds are radiant, and their faces are always beautiful; they meditate on the most radiant Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree gobi(n)d gun gaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gobid gobid kahai din raatee gobid gun sabad sunaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: So chant Gobind, Gobind, the Lord of the Universe, day and night; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord Gobind, through the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gobid gaavahi sahaj subhaae ||
english: Sing of the Lord Gobind with intuitive ease,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਊਜਲ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bhai oojal haumai mal jaae ||
english: in the Fear of the Guru; you shall become radiant, and the filth of egotism shall depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahahi bhagat karahi din raatee sun gobid gun gaavaniaa ||2||
english: Remain in bliss forever, and perform devotional worship, day and night. Hear and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord Gobind. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਚੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manooaa naachai bhagat driRaae ||
english: Channel your dancing mind in devotional worship,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad manai man milaae ||
english: and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, merge your mind with the Supreme Mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਤਾਲੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਸਬਦੇ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sachaa taal poore maaiaa mohu chukaae sabade nirat karaavaniaa ||3||
english: Let your true and perfect tune be the subjugation of your love of Maya, and let yourself dance to the Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਕੂਕੇ ਤਨਹਿ ਪਛਾੜੇ ॥
transliteration: oochaa kooke tanahi pachhaaRe ||
english: People shout out loud and move their bodies,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜਮਕਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi johiaa jamakaale ||
english: but if they are emotionally attached to Maya, then the Messenger of Death shall hunt them down.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਇਸੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਨਚਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu is manahi nachaae a(n)tar kapat dukh paavaniaa ||4||
english: The love of Maya makes this mind dance, and the deceit within makes people suffer in pain. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat jaa aap karaae ||
english: When the Lord inspires one to become Gurmukh, and perform devotional worship,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tan man raataa sahaj subhaae ||
english: then his body and mind are attuned to His Love with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਵਜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: baanee vajai sabad vajaae guramukh bhagat thaai paavaniaa ||5||
english: The Word of His Bani vibrates, and the Word of His Shabad resounds, for the Gurmukh whose devotional worship is accepted. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਤਾਲ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bahu taal poore vaaje vajaae ||
english: One may beat upon and play all sorts of instruments,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਨ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naa ko sune na ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: but no one will listen, and no one will enshrine it in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਿੜ ਬੰਧਿ ਨਾਚੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: maaiaa kaaran piR ba(n)dh naachai doojai bhaai dukh paavaniaa ||6||
english: For the sake of Maya, they set the stage and dance, but they are in love with duality, and they obtain only sorrow. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jis a(n)tar preet lagai so mukataa ||
english: Those whose inner beings are attached to the Lord's Love are liberated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: i(n)dree vas sach sa(n)jam jugataa ||
english: They control their sexual desires, and their lifestyle is the self-discipline of Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad sadaa har dhiaae ehaa bhagat har bhaavaniaa ||7||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they meditate forever on the Lord. This devotional worship is pleasing to the Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat jug chaare hoee ||
english: To live as Gurmukh is devotional worship, throughout the four ages.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਤੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: horat bhagat na paae koee ||
english: This devotional worship is not obtained by any other means.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੦॥੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam gur bhagatee paaeeai gur charanee chit laavaniaa ||8||20||21||
english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained only through devotion to the Guru. So focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||8||20||21||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sachaa sevee sach saalaahee ||
english: Serve the True One, and praise the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sachai naai dukh kab hee naahee ||
english: With the True Name, pain shall never afflict you.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sukhadaataa sevan sukh paain guramat ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1||
english: Those who serve the Giver of peace find peace. They enshrine the Guru's Teachings within their minds. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree sukh sahaj samaadh lagaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who intuitively enter into the peace of Samaadhi.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo har sevahi se sadaa sohahi sobhaa surat suhaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who serve the Lord are always beautiful. The glory of their intuitive awareness is beautiful. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko teraa bhagat kahaae ||
english: All call themselves Your devotees,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: seee bhagat terai man bhaae ||
english: but they alone are Your devotees, who are pleasing to Your mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sach baanee tudhai saalaahan ra(n)g raate bhagat karaavaniaa ||2||
english: Through the True Word of Your Bani, they praise You; attuned to Your Love, they worship You with devotion. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko sache har jeeu teraa ||
english: All are Yours, O Dear True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh milai taa chookai pheraa ||
english: Meeting the Gurmukh, this cycle of reincarnation comes to an end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਇ ਰਚਾਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਜਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai taa naai rachaavahi too(n) aape naau japaavaniaa ||3||
english: When it pleases Your Will, then we merge in the Name. You Yourself inspire us to chant the Name. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramatee har ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I enshrine the Lord within my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: harakh sog sabh mohu gavaaiaa ||
english: Pleasure and pain, and all emotional attachments are gone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ikas siu liv laagee sad hee har naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||4||
english: I am lovingly centered on the One Lord forever. I enshrine the Lord's Name within my mind. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhagat ra(n)g raate sadaa terai chaae ||
english: Your devotees are attuned to Your Love; they are always joyful.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: nau nidh naam vasiaa man aae ||
english: The nine treasures of the Naam come to dwell within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag satigur paaiaa sabade mel milaavaniaa ||5||
english: By perfect destiny, they find the True Guru, and through the Word of the Shabad, they are united in the Lord's Union. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) daiaal sadaa sukhadaataa ||
english: You are Merciful, and always the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape melihi guramukh jaataa ||
english: You Yourself unite us; You are known only to the Gurmukhs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: too(n) aape devahi naam vadaaee naam rate sukh paavaniaa ||6||
english: You Yourself bestow the glorious greatness of the Naam; attuned to the Naam, we find peace. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa saache tudh saalaahee ||
english: Forever and ever, O True Lord, I praise You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jaataa doojaa ko naahee ||
english: As Gurmukh, I know no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਮਨਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ekas siu man rahiaa samaae man ma(n)niai manahi milaavaniaa ||7||
english: My mind remains immersed in the One Lord; my mind surrenders to Him, and in my mind I meet Him. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai so saalaahe ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh, praises the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: saache thaakur veparavaahe ||
english: Our True Lord and Master is Carefree.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੧॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar gurasabadee har melaavaniaa ||8||21||22||
english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the mind; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we merge with the Lord. ||8||21||22||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tere bhagat sohahi saachai darabaare ||
english: Your devotees look beautiful in the True Court.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad naam savaare ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are adorned with the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahahi din raatee gun kahi gunee samaavaniaa ||1||
english: They are forever in bliss, day and night; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, they merge with the Lord of Glory. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree naam sun ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who hear and enshrine the Naam within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu sachaa oocho oochaa haumai maar milaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Dear Lord, the True One, the Highest of the High, subdues their ego and blends them with Himself. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu saachaa saachee naaee ||
english: True is the Dear Lord, and True is His Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee kisai milaaee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, some merge with Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur sabad milahi se vichhuRahi naahee sahaje sach samaavaniaa ||2||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, those who merge with the Lord shall not be separated from Him again. They merge with intuitive ease into the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tujh te baahar kachhoo na hoi ||
english: There is nothing beyond You;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: too(n) kar kar vekhahi jaanahi soi ||
english: You are the One who does, sees, and knows.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa guramat aap milaavaniaa ||3||
english: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires others to act. Through the Guru's Teachings, He blends us into Himself. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaaman gunava(n)tee har paae ||
english: The virtuous soul-bride finds the Lord;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhai bhaai seegaar banaae ||
english: she decorates herself with the Love and the Fear of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਚ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sohaagan sach upades samaavaniaa ||4||
english: She who serves the True Guru is forever a happy soul-bride. She is absorbed in the true teachings. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਨਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabad visaaran tinaa thaur na thaau ||
english: Those who forget the Word of the Shabad have no home and no place of rest.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhram bhoole jiu su(n)njai ghar kaau ||
english: They are deluded by doubt, like a crow in a deserted house.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਵਾਏ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: halat palat tinee dovai gavaae dukhe dukh vihaavaniaa ||5||
english: They forfeit both this world and the next, and they pass their lives suffering in pain and misery. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਦਿਆ ਲਿਖਦਿਆ ਕਾਗਦ ਮਸੁ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: likhadiaa likhadiaa kaagad mas khoee ||
english: Writing on and on endlessly, they run out of paper and ink.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai sukh paae na koee ||
english: Through the love with duality, no one has found peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਤੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kooR likhahi tai kooR kamaavahi jal jaavahi kooR chit laavaniaa ||6||
english: They write falsehood, and they practice falsehood; they are burnt to ashes by focusing their consciousness on falsehood. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sacho sach likhahi veechaar ||
english: The Gurmukhs write and reflect on Truth, and only Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: se jan sache paavahi mokh duaar ||
english: The true ones find the gate of salvation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਲਮ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sach kaagad kalam masavaanee sach likh sach samaavaniaa ||7||
english: True is their paper, pen and ink; writing Truth, they are absorbed in the True One. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh a(n)tar baithaa vekhai ||
english: My God sits deep within the self; He watches over us.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee milai soee jan lekhai ||
english: Those who meet the Lord, by Guru's Grace, are acceptable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੨॥੨੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee poore gur te paavaniaa ||8||22||23||
english: O Nanak, glorious greatness is received through the Naam, which is obtained through the Perfect Guru. ||8||22||23||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aatam raam paragaas gur te hovai ||
english: The Divine Light of the Supreme Soul shines forth from the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: haumai mail laagee gurasabadee khovai ||
english: The filth stuck to the ego is removed through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man niramal anadin bhagatee raataa bhagat kare har paavaniaa ||1||
english: One who is imbued with devotional worship to the Lord night and day becomes pure. Worshipping the Lord, He is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree aap bhagat karan avaraa bhagat karaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who themselves worship the Lord, and inspire others to worship Him as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tinaa bhagat janaa kau sad namasakaar keejai jo anadin har gun gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I humbly bow to those devotees who chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa kaaran karaae ||
english: The Creator Lord Himself is the Doer of deeds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jit bhaavai tit kaarai laae ||
english: As He pleases, He applies us to our tasks.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag gur sevaa hovai gur sevaa te sukh paavaniaa ||2||
english: Through perfect destiny, we serve the Guru; serving the Guru, peace is found. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mar mar jeevai taa kichh paae ||
english: Those who die, and remain dead while yet alive, obtain it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: By Guru's Grace, they enshrine the Lord within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sadaa mukat har ma(n)n vasaae sahaje sahaj samaavaniaa ||3||
english: Enshrining the Lord within their minds, they are liberated forever. With intuitive ease, they merge into the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bahu karam kamaavai mukat na paae ||
english: They perform all sorts of rituals, but they do not obtain liberation through them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਸੰਤਰੁ ਭਵੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
transliteration: desa(n)tar bhavai doojai bhaai khuaae ||
english: They wander around the countryside, and in love with duality, they are ruined.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਕਪਟੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: birathaa janam gavaaiaa kapatee bin sabadai dukh paavaniaa ||4||
english: The deceitful lose their lives in vain; without the Word of the Shabad, they obtain only misery. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat raakhai thaak rahaae ||
english: Those who restrain their wandering mind, keeping it steady and stable,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee param pad paae ||
english: obtain the supreme status, by Guru's Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: satigur aape mel milaae mil preetam sukh paavaniaa ||5||
english: The True Guru Himself unites us in Union with the Lord. Meeting the Beloved, peace is obtained. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਕੂੜੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ik kooR laage kooRe phal paae ||
english: Some are stuck in falsehood, and false are the rewards they receive.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai birathaa janam gavaae ||
english: In love with duality, they waste away their lives in vain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aap dube sagale kul dobe kooR bol bikh khaavaniaa ||6||
english: They drown themselves, and drown their entire family; speaking lies, they eat poison. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: is tan mahi man ko guramukh dekhai ||
english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, look within their bodies, into their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
transliteration: bhaai bhagat jaa haumai sokhai ||
english: Through loving devotion, their ego evaporates.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੋਨਿਧਾਰੀ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik monidhaaree rahe liv laai tin bhee tan mahi man na dikhaavaniaa ||7||
english: The Siddhas, the seekers and the silent sages continually, lovingly focus their consciousness, but they have not seen the mind within the body. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aap karaae karataa soee ||
english: The Creator Himself inspires us to work;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਕੀਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: hor k kare keetai kiaa hoee ||
english: what can anyone else do? What can be done by our doing?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੩॥੨੪॥
transliteration: naanak jis naam devai so levai naamo ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||8||23||24||
english: O Nanak, the Lord bestows His Name; we receive it, and enshrine it within the mind. ||8||23||24||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: is guphaa mahi akhut bha(n)daaraa ||
english: Within this cave, there is an inexhaustible treasure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tis vich vasai har alakh apaaraa ||
english: Within this cave, the Invisible and Infinite Lord abides.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਵੰਞਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape gupat paragat hai aape gurasabadee aap va(n)njaavaniaa ||1||
english: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, selfishness and conceit are eliminated. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree a(n)mrit naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam mahaa ras meethaa guramatee a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The taste of the Ambrosial Naam is very sweet! Through the Guru's Teachings, drink in this Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar bajar kapaat khulaaiaa ||
english: Subduing egotism, the rigid doors are opened.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naam amolak gur parasaadee paaiaa ||
english: The Priceless Naam is obtained by Guru's Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin sabadai naam na paae koee gur kirapaa ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||2||
english: Without the Shabad, the Naam is not obtained. By Guru's Grace, it is implanted within the mind. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur giaan a(n)jan sach netree paaiaa ||
english: The Guru has applied the true ointment of spiritual wisdom to my eyes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar chaanan agiaan a(n)dher gavaaiaa ||
english: Deep within, the Divine Light has dawned, and the darkness of ignorance has been dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jotee jot milee man maaniaa har dar sobhaa paavaniaa ||3||
english: My light has merged into the Light; my mind has surrendered, and I am blessed with Glory in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਭਾਲਣਿ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sareerahu bhaalan ko baahar jaae ||
english: Those who look outside the body, searching for the Lord,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵੇਗਾਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naam na lahai bahut vegaar dukh paae ||
english: Shall not receive the Naam; they shall instead be forced to suffer the terrible pains of slavery.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਘਿਰਿ ਆਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhe soojhai naahee phir ghir aai guramukh vath paavaniaa ||4||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand; but when they return once again to their own home, then, as Gurmukh, they find the genuine article. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sachaa har paae ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the True Lord is found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: man tan vekhai haumai mail jaae ||
english: Within your mind and body, see the Lord, and the filth of egotism shall depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bais suthaan sad har gun gaavai sachai sabad samaavaniaa ||5||
english: Sitting in that place, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever, and be absorbed in the True Word of the Shabad. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਦਰ ਠਾਕੇ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nau dar thaake dhaavat rahaae ||
english: Those who close off the nine gates, and restrain the wandering mind,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਸਵੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dasavai nij ghar vaasaa paae ||
english: come to dwell in the Home of the Tenth Gate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: othai anahad sabad vajahi din raatee guramatee sabad sunaavaniaa ||6||
english: There, the Unstruck Melody of the Shabad vibrates day and night. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Shabad is heard. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਨੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai a(n)tar aaneraa ||
english: Without the Shabad, there is only darkness within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: na vasat lahai na chookai pheraa ||
english: The genuine article is not found, and the cycle of reincarnation does not end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਦਰੁ ਖੁਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: satigur hath ku(n)jee horat dar khulai naahee gur poorai bhaag milaavaniaa ||7||
english: The key is in the hands of the True Guru; no one else can open this door. By perfect destiny, He is met. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gupat paragat too(n) sabhanee thaaee ||
english: You are the hidden and the revealed in all places.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee mil sojhee paaee ||
english: Receiving Guru's Grace, this understanding is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੪॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam salaahi sadaa too(n) guramukh ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||8||24||25||
english: O Nanak, praise the Naam forever; as Gurmukh, enshrine it within the mind. ||8||24||25||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh milai milaae aape ||
english: The Gurmukhs meet the Lord, and inspire others to meet Him as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: kaal na johai dukh na sa(n)taape ||
english: Death does not see them, and pain does not afflict them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਭ ਤੋੜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haumai maar ba(n)dhan sabh toRai guramukh sabad suhaavaniaa ||1||
english: Subduing egotism, they break all their bonds; as Gurmukh, they are adorned with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree har har naam suhaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who look beautiful in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh gaavai guramukh naachai har setee chit laavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Gurmukhs sing, the Gurmukhs dance, and focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਮਰੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jeevai marai paravaan ||
english: The Gurmukhs are celebrated in life and death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਰਜਾ ਨ ਛੀਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aarajaa na chheejai sabad pachhaan ||
english: Their lives are not wasted; they realize the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh marai na kaal na khaae guramukh sach samaavaniaa ||2||
english: The Gurmukhs do not die; they are not consumed by death. The Gurmukhs are absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har dar sobhaa paae ||
english: The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh vichahu aap gavaae ||
english: The Gurmukhs eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap tarai kul sagale taare guramukh janam savaaraniaa ||3||
english: They save themselves, and save all their families and ancestors as well. The Gurmukhs redeem their lives. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh dukh kade na lagai sareer ||
english: The Gurmukhs never suffer bodily pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਪੀਰ ॥
transliteration: guramukh haumai chookai peer ||
english: The Gurmukhs have the pain of egotism taken away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramukh man niramal phir mail na laagai guramukh sahaj samaavaniaa ||4||
english: The minds of the Gurmukhs are immaculate and pure; no filth ever sticks to them again. The Gurmukhs merge in celestial peace. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam milai vadiaaee ||
english: The Gurmukhs obtain the Greatness of the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh gun gaavai sobhaa paaee ||
english: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and obtain honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahai din raatee guramukh sabad karaavaniaa ||5||
english: They remain in bliss forever, day and night. The Gurmukhs practice the Word of the Shabad. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh anadin sabade raataa ||
english: The Gurmukhs are attuned to the Shabad, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jug chaare hai jaataa ||
english: The Gurmukhs are known throughout the four ages.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: guramukh gun gaavai sadaa niramal sabade bhagat karaavaniaa ||6||
english: The Gurmukhs always sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate Lord. Through the Shabad, they practice devotional worship. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: baajh guroo hai a(n)dh a(n)dhaaraa ||
english: Without the Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਗਰਠੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jamakaal garathe karahi pukaaraa ||
english: Seized by the Messenger of Death, people cry out and scream.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: anadin rogee bisataa ke keeRe bisataa mahi dukh paavaniaa ||7||
english: Night and day, they are diseased, like maggots in manure, and in manure they endure agony. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh aape kare karaae ||
english: The Gurmukhs know that the Lord alone acts, and causes others to act.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hiradai vuthaa aap aae ||
