english: In the hearts of the Gurmukhs, the Lord Himself comes to dwell.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੫॥੨੬॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee poore gur te paavaniaa ||8||25||26||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained. It is received from the Perfect Guru. ||8||25||26||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ekaa jot jot hai sareeraa ||
english: The One Light is the light of all bodies.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad dikhaae satigur pooraa ||
english: The Perfect True Guru reveals it through the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਫਰਕੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape pharak keeton ghat a(n)tar aape banat banaavaniaa ||1||
english: He Himself instills the sense of separation within our hearts; He Himself created the Creation. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree har sache ke gun gaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੋ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: baajh guroo ko sahaj na paae guramukh sahaj samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Guru, no one obtains intuitive wisdom; the Gurmukh is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਹਿ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape sohahi aape jag mohahi ||
english: You Yourself are Beautiful, and You Yourself entice the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰੋਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape nadaree jagat parovahi ||
english: You Yourself, by Your Kind Mercy, weave the thread of the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too(n) aape dukh sukh devahi karate guramukh har dekhaavaniaa ||2||
english: You Yourself bestow pain and pleasure, O Creator. The Lord reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa kare karaae ||
english: The Creator Himself acts, and causes others to act.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape sabad gur ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: Through Him, the Word of the Guru's Shabad is enshrined within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabade upajai a(n)mrit baanee guramukh aakh sunaavaniaa ||3||
english: The Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani emanates from the Word of the Shabad. The Gurmukh speaks it and hears it. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa aape bhugataa ||
english: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੇ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan toRe sadaa hai mukataa ||
english: One who breaks out of bondage is liberated forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sadaa mukat aape hai sachaa aape alakh lakhaavaniaa ||4||
english: The True Lord is liberated forever. The Unseen Lord causes Himself to be seen. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape maaiaa aape chhaaiaa ||
english: He Himself is Maya, and He Himself is the Illusion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape mohu sabh jagat upaaiaa ||
english: He Himself has generated emotional attachment throughout the entire universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aape gunadaataa gun gaavai aape aakh sunaavaniaa ||5||
english: He Himself is the Giver of Virtue; He Himself sings the Lord's Glorious Praises. He chants them and causes them to be heard. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae aape ||
english: He Himself acts, and causes others to act.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aape thaap uthaape aape ||
english: He Himself establishes and disestablishes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: tujh te baahar kachhoo na hovai too(n) aape kaarai laavaniaa ||6||
english: Without You, nothing can be done. You Yourself have engaged all in their tasks. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape maare aap jeevaae ||
english: He Himself kills, and He Himself revives.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape mele mel milaae ||
english: He Himself unites us, and unites us in Union with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sevaa te sadaa sukh paaiaa guramukh sahaj samaavaniaa ||7||
english: Through selfless service, eternal peace is obtained. The Gurmukh is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਊਚਾ ਊਚੋ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape oochaa oocho hoee ||
english: He Himself is the Highest of the High.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ਸੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jis aap vikhaale s vekhai koee ||
english: How rare are those who behold Him. He causes Himself to be seen.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਖਾਲਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੬॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghat a(n)tar aape vekh vikhaalaniaa ||8||26||27||
english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the hearts of those who see the Lord themselves, and inspire others to see Him as well. ||8||26||27||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh bharapoor rahiaa sabh thaaee ||
english: My God is pervading and permeating all places.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ghar hee mahi paaee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have found Him within the home of my own heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਰੇਵੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa sarevee ik man dhiaaee guramukh sach samaavaniaa ||1||
english: I serve Him constantly, and I meditate on Him single-mindedly. As Gurmukh, I am absorbed in the True One. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree jagajeevan ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord, the Life of the World, within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jagajeevan nirabhau daataa guramat sahaj samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I merge with intuitive ease into the Lord, the Life of the World, the Fearless One, the Great Giver. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਉਲੁ ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ghar mahi dharatee dhaul paataalaa ||
english: Within the home of the self is the earth, its support and the nether regions of the underworld.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ghar hee mahi preetam sadaa hai baalaa ||
english: Within the home of the self is the Eternally Young Beloved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahai sukhadaataa guramat sahaj samaavaniaa ||2||
english: The Giver of peace is eternally blissful. Through the Guru's Teachings, we are absorbed in intuitive peace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar haumai meraa ||
english: When the body is filled with ego and selfishness,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maran na chookai pheraa ||
english: the cycle of birth and death does not end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s haumai maare sacho sach dhiaavaniaa ||3||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh subdues egotism, and meditates on the Truest of the True. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar paap pu(n)n dui bhaaee ||
english: Within this body are the two brothers, sin and virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: duhee mil kai srisat upaaee ||
english: When the two joined together, the Universe was produced.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੋਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: dovai maar jaai ikat ghar aavai guramat sahaj samaavaniaa ||4||
english: Subduing both, and entering into the Home of the One, through the Guru's Teachings, we are absorbed in intuitive peace. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਨੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ghar hee maahi doojai bhaai aneraa ||
english: Within the home of the self is the darkness of the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਛੋਡੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: chaanan hovai chhodai haumai meraa ||
english: When the Divine Light dawns, ego and selfishness are dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: paragat sabad hai sukhadaataa anadin naam dhiaavaniaa ||5||
english: The Giver of peace is revealed through the Shabad, meditating upon the Naam, night and day. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar jot paragat paasaaraa ||
english: Deep within the self is the Light of God; It radiates throughout the expanse of His creation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur saakhee mitiaa a(n)dhiaaraa ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kamal bigaas sadaa sukh paaiaa jotee jot milaavaniaa ||6||
english: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and eternal peace is obtained, as one's light merges into the Light. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar mahal ratanee bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
english: Within the mansion is the treasure house, overflowing with jewels.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh paae naam apaaraa ||
english: The Gurmukh obtains the Infinite Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੇ ਸਦਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramukh vanaje sadaa vaapaaree laahaa naam sad paavaniaa ||7||
english: The Gurmukh, the trader, always purchases the merchandise of the Naam, and always reaps profits. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵਥੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aape vath raakhai aape dei ||
english: The Lord Himself keeps this merchandise in stock, and He Himself distributes it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh vanajahi keee kei ||
english: Rare is that Gurmukh who trades in this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੭॥੨੮॥
transliteration: naanak jis nadar kare so paae kar kirapaa ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||8||27||28||
english: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtain it. Through His Mercy, it is enshrined in the mind. ||8||27||28||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har aape mele sev karaae ||
english: The Lord Himself leads us to merge with Him and serve Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad bhaau doojaa jaae ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the love of duality is eradicated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har niramal sadaa gunadaataa har gun mahi aap samaavaniaa ||1||
english: The Immaculate Lord is the Bestower of eternal virtue. The Lord Himself leads us to merge in His Virtuous Goodness. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree sach sachaa hiradai vasaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Truest of the True within their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sachaa naam sadaa hai niramal gurasabadee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Name is eternally pure and immaculate. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is enshrined within the mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aape gur daataa karam bidhaataa ||
english: The Guru Himself is the Giver, the Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sevak sevahi guramukh har jaataa ||
english: The Gurmukh, the humble servant who serves the Lord, comes to know Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam sadaa jan sohahi guramat har ras paavaniaa ||2||
english: Those humble beings look beautiful forever in the Ambrosial Naam. Through the Guru's Teachings, they receive the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: is guphaa mahi ik thaan suhaaiaa ||
english: Within the cave of this body, there is one beautiful place.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poorai gur haumai bharam chukaaiaa ||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, ego and doubt are dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anadin naam salaahan ra(n)g raate gur kirapaa te paavaniaa ||3||
english: Night and day, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; imbued with the Lord's Love, by Guru's Grace, you shall find Him. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad ihu guphaa veechaare ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, search this cave.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naam nira(n)jan a(n)tar vasai muraare ||
english: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har gun gaavai sabad suhaae mil preetam sukh paavaniaa ||4||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and decorate yourself with the Shabad. Meeting with your Beloved, you shall find peace. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jam jaagaatee doojai bhaai kar laae ||
english: The Messenger of Death imposes his tax on those who are attached to duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naavahu bhoole dei sajaae ||
english: He inflicts punishment on those who forget the Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਲੇਵੈ ਰਤੀਅਹੁ ਮਾਸਾ ਤੋਲ ਕਢਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ghaRee muhat kaa lekhaa levai rateeahu maasaa tol kadhaavaniaa ||5||
english: They are called to account for each instant and each moment. Every grain, every particle, is weighed and counted. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਚੇਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: peeeaRai pir chete naahee ||
english: One who does not remember her Husband Lord in this world is being cheated by duality;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਧਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: doojai muthee rovai dhaahee ||
english: She shall weep bitterly in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਰੀ ਕੁਆਲਿਓ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kharee kuaalio kuroop kulakhanee supanai pir nahee paavaniaa ||6||
english: She is from an evil family; she is ugly and vile. Even in her dreams, she does not meet her Husband Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: peeeaRai pir ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
english: She who enshrines her Husband Lord in her mind in this world

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poorai gur hadoor dikhaaiaa ||
english: His Presence is revealed to her by the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kaaman pir raakhiaa ka(n)th laai sabade pir raavai sej suhaavaniaa ||7||
english: That soul-bride keeps her Husband Lord clasped tightly to her heart, and through the Word of the Shabad, she enjoys her Husband Lord upon His Beautiful Bed. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਦਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape devai sad bulaae ||
english: The Lord Himself sends out the call, and He summons us to His Presence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa naau ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: He enshrines His Name within our minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੮॥੨੯॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee anadin sadaa gun gaavaniaa ||8||28||29||
english: O Nanak, one who receives the greatness of the Naam night and day, constantly sings His Glorious Praises. ||8||28||29||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਹੈ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: ootam janam suthaan hai vaasaa ||
english: Sublime is their birth, and the place where they dwell.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਘਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi ghar maahi udaasaa ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru remain detached in the home of their own being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g rahahi sadaa ra(n)g raate har ras man tripataavaniaa ||1||
english: They abide in the Lord's Love, and constantly imbued with His Love, their minds are satisfied and fulfilled with the Lord's Essence. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree paR bujh ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who read of the Lord, who understand and enshrine Him within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh paRahi har naam salaahahi dar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Gurmukhs read and praise the Lord's Name; they are honored in the True Court. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: alakh abheu har rahiaa samaae ||
english: The Unseen and Inscrutable Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਕਿਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: upaai na kitee paaiaa jaae ||
english: He cannot be obtained by any effort.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kirapaa kare taa satigur bhetai nadaree mel milaavaniaa ||2||
english: If the Lord grants His Grace, then we come to meet the True Guru. By His Kindness, we are united in His Union. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪੜੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai paRai nahee boojhai ||
english: One who reads, while attached to duality, does not understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: tribidh maaiaa kaaran loojhai ||
english: He yearns for the three-phased Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tribidh ba(n)dhan tootahi gurasabadee gurasabadee mukat karaavaniaa ||3||
english: The bonds of the three-phased Maya are broken by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Through the Guru's Shabad, liberation is achieved. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu man cha(n)chal vas na aavai ||
english: This unstable mind cannot be held steady.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa laagai dah dis dhaavai ||
english: Attached to duality, it wanders in the ten directions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bikh kaa keeRaa bikh mahi raataa bikh hee maahi pachaavaniaa ||4||
english: It is a poisonous worm, drenched with poison, and in poison it rots away. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hau hau kare tai aap janaae ||
english: Practicing egotism and selfishness, they try to impress others by showing off.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bahu karam karai kichh thaai na paae ||
english: They perform all sorts of rituals, but they gain no acceptance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: tujh te baahar kichhoo na hovai bakhase sabad suhaavaniaa ||5||
english: Without You, Lord, nothing happens at all. You forgive those who are adorned with the Word of Your Shabad. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਉਪਜੈ ਪਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: upajai pachai har boojhai naahee ||
english: They are born, and they die, but they do not understand the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: anadin doojai bhaai phiraahee ||
english: Night and day, they wander, in love with duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: manamukh janam gaiaa hai birathaa a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaavaniaa ||6||
english: The lives of the self-willed manmukhs are useless; in the end, they die, regretting and repenting. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਸਿਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pir parades sigaar banaae ||
english: The Husband is away, and the wife is getting dressed up.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੁ ਐਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dh aise karam kamaae ||
english: This is what the blind, self-willed manmukhs are doing.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਲਤਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: halat na sobhaa palat na dhoee birathaa janam gavaavaniaa ||7||
english: They are not honored in this world, and they shall find no shelter in the world hereafter. They are wasting their lives in vain. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam kinai viralai jaataa ||
english: How rare are those who know the Name of the Lord!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kai sabad pachhaataa ||
english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, the Lord is realized.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat kare din raatee sahaje hee sukh paavaniaa ||8||
english: Night and day, they perform the Lord's devotional service; day and night, they find intuitive peace. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi varatai eko soee ||
english: That One Lord is pervading in all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koee ||
english: Only a few, as Gurmukh, understand this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੯॥੨੯॥੩੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate jan sohahi kar kirapaa aap milaavaniaa ||9||29||30||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are beautiful. Granting His Grace, God unites them with Himself. ||9||29||30||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh paRahi pa(n)dit kahaavahi ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs read and recite; they are called Pandits-spiritual scholars.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai mahaa dukh paavahi ||
english: But they are in love with duality, and they suffer in terrible pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bikhiaa maate kichh soojhai naahee phir phir joonee aavaniaa ||1||
english: Intoxicated with vice, they understand nothing at all. They are reincarnated, over and over again. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree haumai maar milaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who subdue their ego, and unite with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te har man vasiaa har ras sahaj peeaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They serve the Guru, and the Lord dwells within their minds; they intuitively drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵੇਦੁ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ved paRahi har ras nahee aaiaa ||
english: The Pandits read the Vedas, but they do not obtain the Lord's essence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vaad vakhaanahi mohe maaiaa ||
english: Intoxicated with Maya, they argue and debate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨਮਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: agiaanamatee sadaa a(n)dhiaaraa guramukh boojh har gaavaniaa ||2||
english: The foolish intellectuals are forever in spiritual darkness. The Gurmukhs understand, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥੋ ਕਥੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: akatho katheeai sabad suhaavai ||
english: The Indescribable is described only through the beauteous Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੋ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramatee man sacho bhaavai ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Truth becomes pleasing to the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sacho sach ravahi din raatee ihu man sach ra(n)gaavaniaa ||3||
english: Those who speak of the truest of the true, day and night-their minds are imbued with the Truth. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੋ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo sach rate tin sacho bhaavai ||
english: Those who are attuned to Truth, love the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aape dei na pachhotaavai ||
english: The Lord Himself bestows this gift; He shall not take it back.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad sadaa sach jaataa mil sache sukh paavaniaa ||4||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the True Lord is known forever; meeting the True One, peace is found. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: kooR kusat tinaa mail na laagai ||
english: The filth of fraud and falsehood does not stick to those who,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee anadin jaagai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, remain awake and aware, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: niramal naam vasai ghat bheetar jotee jot milaavaniaa ||5||
english: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within their hearts; their light merges into the Light. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: trai gun paRahi har tat na jaanahi ||
english: They read about the three qualities, but they do not know the essential reality of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: moolahu bhule gurasabad na pachhaanahi ||
english: They forget the Primal Lord, the Source of all, and they do not recognize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: moh biaape kichh soojhai naahee gurasabadee har paavaniaa ||6||
english: They are engrossed in emotional attachment; they do not understand anything at all. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ved pukaarai tribidh maaiaa ||
english: The Vedas proclaim that Maya is of three qualities.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh na boojhahi doojai bhaaiaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs, in love with duality, do not understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: trai gun paRahi har ek na jaanahi bin boojhe dukh paavaniaa ||7||
english: They read of the three qualities, but they do not know the One Lord. Without understanding, they obtain only pain and suffering. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai taa aap milaae ||
english: When it pleases the Lord, He unites us with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee sahasaa dookh chukaae ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, skepticism and suffering are dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩੦॥੩੧॥
transliteration: naanak naavai kee sachee vadiaaee naamo ma(n)n sukh paavaniaa ||8||30||31||
english: O Nanak, True is the Greatness of the Name. Believing in the Name, peace is obtained. ||8||30||31||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: niragun saragun aape soee ||
english: The Lord Himself is Unmanifest and Unrelated; He is Manifest and Related as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tat pachhaanai so pa(n)dit hoee ||
english: Those who recognize this essential reality are the true Pandits, the spiritual scholars.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aap tarai sagale kul taarai har naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1||
english: They save themselves, and save all their families and ancestors as well, when they enshrine the Lord's Name in the mind. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree har ras chakh saad paavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who taste the essence of the Lord, and savor its taste.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ras chaakhahi se jan niramal niramal naam dhiaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who taste this essence of the Lord are the pure, immaculate beings. They meditate on the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਿਹਕਰਮੀ ਜੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: so nihakaramee jo sabad beechaare ||
english: Those who reflect upon the Shabad are beyond karma.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar tat giaan haumai maare ||
english: They subdue their ego, and find the essence of wisdom, deep within their being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam padaarath nau nidh paae trai gun met samaavaniaa ||2||
english: They obtain the nine treasures of the wealth of the Naam. Rising above the three qualities, they merge into the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਹਕਰਮੀ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: haumai karai nihakaramee na hovai ||
english: Those who act in ego do not go beyond karma.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee haumai khovai ||
english: It is only by Guru's Grace that one is rid of ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)tar bibek sadaa aap veechaare gurasabadee gun gaavaniaa ||3||
english: Those who have discriminating minds, continually examine their own selves. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they sing the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har sar saagar niramal soee ||
english: The Lord is the most pure and sublime Ocean.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t chugahi nit guramukh hoee ||
english: The Saintly Gurmukhs continually peck at the Naam, like swans pecking at pearls in the ocean.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: isanaan karahi sadaa din raatee haumai mail chukaavaniaa ||4||
english: They bathe in it continually, day and night, and the filth of ego is washed away. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੰਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: niramal ha(n)saa prem piaar ||
english: The pure swans, with love and affection,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har sar vasai haumai maar ||
english: Dwell in the Ocean of the Lord, and subdue their ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ahinis preet sabad saachai har sar vaasaa paavaniaa ||5||
english: Day and night, they are in love with the True Word of the Shabad. They obtain their home in the Ocean of the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਬਗੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sadaa bag mailaa haumai mal laaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs shall always be filthy cranes, smeared with the filth of ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਪਰੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: isanaan karai par mail na jaaee ||
english: They may bathe, but their filth is not removed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jeevat marai gurasabad beechaarai haumai mail chukaavaniaa ||6||
english: One who dies while yet alive, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad, is rid of this filth of ego. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ratan padaarath ghar te paaiaa ||
english: The Priceless Jewel is found, in the home of one's own being,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poorai satigur sabad sunaaiaa ||
english: when one listens to the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur parasaad mitiaa a(n)dhiaaraa ghat chaanan aap pachhaananiaa ||7||
english: By Guru's Grace, the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled; I have come to recognize the Divine Light within my own heart. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: aap upaae tai aape vekhai ||
english: The Lord Himself creates, and He Himself beholds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevai so jan lekhai ||
english: Serving the True Guru, one becomes acceptable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩੧॥੩੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghat a(n)tar gur kirapaa te paavaniaa ||8||31||32||
english: O Nanak, the Naam dwells deep within the heart; by Guru's Grace, it is obtained. ||8||31||32||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maajh, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu jagat sabaaiaa ||
english: The whole world is engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: trai gun deesahi mohe maaiaa ||
english: Those who are controlled by the three qualities are attached to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ko viralaa boojhai chauthai pad liv laavaniaa ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, a few come to understand; they center their consciousness in the fourth state. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree maaiaa mohu sabad jalaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who burn away their emotional attachment to Maya, through the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu jalaae so har siu chit laae har dar mahalee sobhaa paavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who burn away this attachment to Maya, and focus their consciousness on the Lord are honored in the True Court, and the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: devee devaa mool hai maaiaa ||
english: The source, the root, of the gods and goddesses is Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਜਿੰਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: si(n)mrit saasat ji(n)n upaaiaa ||
english: For them, the Simritees and the Shaastras were composed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaam krodh pasariaa sa(n)saare aai jaai dukh paavaniaa ||2||
english: Sexual desire and anger are diffused throughout the universe. Coming and going, people suffer in pain. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tis vich giaan ratan ik paaiaa ||
english: The jewel of spiritual wisdom was placed within the universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, it is enshrined within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jat sat sa(n)jam sach kamaavai gur poorai naam dhiaavaniaa ||3||
english: Celibacy, chastity, self-discipline and the practice of truthfulness are obtained from the Perfect Guru, by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਧਨ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: peeeaRai dhan bharam bhulaanee ||
english: In this world of her parents' home, the soul-bride has been deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: doojai laagee phir pachhotaanee ||
english: Attached to duality, she later comes to regret it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਵਾਏ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: halat palat dovai gavaae supanai sukh na paavaniaa ||4||
english: She forfeits both this world and the next, and even in her dreams, she does not find peace. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਧਨ ਕੰਤੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: peeeaRai dhan ka(n)t samaale ||
english: The soul-bride who remembers her Husband Lord in this world,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee vekhai naale ||
english: by Guru's Grace, sees Him close at hand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: pir kai sahaj rahai ra(n)g raatee sabad si(n)gaar banaavaniaa ||5||
english: She remains intuitively attuned to the Love of her Beloved; she makes the Word of His Shabad her decoration. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam jinaa satigur paaiaa ||
english: Blessed and fruitful is the coming of those who find the True Guru;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: doojaa bhaau gur sabad jalaaiaa ||
english: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they burn their love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: eko rav rahiaa ghat a(n)tar mil satasa(n)gat har gun gaavaniaa ||6||
english: The One Lord is permeating and pervading deep within the heart. Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur na seve so kaahe aaiaa ||
english: Those who do not serve the True Guru-why did they even come into this world?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhrig jeevan birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||
english: Cursed are their lives; they have uselessly wasted this human life.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: manamukh naam chit na aavai bin naavai bahu dukh paavaniaa ||7||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not remember the Naam. Without the Naam, they suffer in terrible pain. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jin sisat saajee soee jaanai ||
english: The One who created the Universe, He alone knows it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: aape melai sabad pachhaanai ||
english: He unites with Himself those who realize the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੨॥੩੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam miliaa tin jan kau jin dhur masatak lekh likhaavaniaa ||8||1||32||33||
english: O Nanak, they alone receive the Naam, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is recorded. ||8||1||32||33||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aad purakh apara(n)par aape ||
english: The Primal Being is Himself remote and beyond.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aape thaape thaap uthaape ||
english: He Himself establishes, and having established, He disestablishes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh mahi varatai eko soee guramukh sobhaa paavaniaa ||1||
english: The One Lord is pervading in all; those who become Gurmukh are honored. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree nira(n)kaaree naam dhiaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tis roop na rekhiaa ghat ghat dekhiaa guramukh alakh lakhaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He has no form or shape; He is seen within each and every heart. The Gurmukh comes to know the unknowable. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: too daiaal kirapaal prabh soee ||
english: You are God, Kind and Merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tudh bin doojaa avar na koee ||
english: Without You, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਾਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur parasaad kare naam devai naame naam samaavaniaa ||2||
english: When the Guru showers His Grace upon us, He blesses us with the Naam; through the Naam, we merge in the Naam. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape sachaa sirajanahaaraa ||
english: You Yourself are the True Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagatee bhare tere bha(n)daaraa ||
english: Your treasures are overflowing with devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh naam milai man bheejai sahaj samaadh lagaavaniaa ||3||
english: The Gurmukhs obtain the Naam. Their minds are enraptured, and they easily and intuitively enter into Samaadhi. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: anadin gun gaavaa prabh tere ||
english: Night and day, I sing Your Glorious Praises, God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tudh saalaahee preetam mere ||
english: I praise You, O my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tudh bin avar na koee jaachaa gur parasaadee too(n) paavaniaa ||4||
english: Without You, there is no other for me to seek out. It is only by Guru's Grace that You are found. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar mit nahee paaee ||
english: The limits of the Inaccessible and Incomprehensible Lord cannot be found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: apanee kripaa karahi too(n) laihi milaaee ||
english: Bestowing Your Mercy, You merge us into Yourself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: poore gur kai sabad dhiaaeeai sabad sev sukh paavaniaa ||5||
english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, we meditate on the Lord. Serving the Shabad, peace is found. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa gunava(n)tee gun gaavai ||
english: Praiseworthy is the tongue which sings the Lord's Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naam salaahe sache bhaavai ||
english: Praising the Naam, one becomes pleasing to the True One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: guramukh sadaa rahai ra(n)g raatee mil sache sobhaa paavaniaa ||6||
english: The Gurmukh remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love. Meeting the True Lord, glory is obtained. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: manamukh karam kare aha(n)kaaree ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in ego.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jooai janam sabh baajee haaree ||
english: They lose their whole lives in the gamble.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: a(n)tar lobh mahaa gubaaraa phir phir aavan jaavaniaa ||7||
english: Within is the terrible darkness of greed, and so they come and go in reincarnation, over and over again. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa de vadiaaee ||
english: The Creator Himself bestows Glory

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin kau aap likhat dhur paaee ||
english: On those whom He Himself has so pre-destined.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai bhau bha(n)jan gurasabadee sukh paavaniaa ||8||1||34||
english: O Nanak, they receive the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Destroyer of fear; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they find peace. ||8||1||34||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar alakh na jaaee lakhiaa ||
english: The Unseen Lord is within, but He cannot be seen.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਲੈ ਗੁਝਾ ਰਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naam ratan lai gujhaa rakhiaa ||
english: He has taken the Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and He keeps it well concealed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: agam agochar sabh te oochaa gur kai sabad lakhaavaniaa ||1||
english: The Inaccessible and Incomprehensible Lord is the highest of all. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is known. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree kal mahi naam sunaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who chant the Naam, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਧਾਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t piaare sachai dhaare vadabhaagee darasan paavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Beloved Saints were established by the True Lord. By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of their Darshan is obtained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਜਿਸੈ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: saadhik sidh jisai kau phirade ||
english: The One who is sought by the Siddhas and the seekers,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: brahame i(n)dr dhiaain hirade ||
english: upon whom Brahma and Indra meditate within their hearts,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸਾ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kot teteesaa khojahi taa kau gur mil hiradai gaavaniaa ||2||
english: whom the three hundred thirty million demi-gods search for-meeting the Guru, one comes to sing His Praises within the heart. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਪੇ ਪਵਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar tudh jaape pavanaa ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, the wind breathes Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਪਾਇਕ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: dharatee sevak paaik charanaa ||
english: The earth is Your servant, a slave at Your Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khaanee baanee sarab nivaasee sabhanaa kai man bhaavaniaa ||3||
english: In the four sources of creation, and in all speech, You dwell. You are dear to the minds of all. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahib guramukh jaapai ||
english: The True Lord and Master is known to the Gurmukhs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kai sabad sinjaapai ||
english: He is realized through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਸੇਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਅਘਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jin peeaa seee tripataase sache sach aghaavaniaa ||4||
english: Those who drink it in are satisfied. Through the Truest of the True, they are fulfilled. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਜਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: tis ghar sahajaa soee suhelaa ||
english: In the home of their own beings, they are peacefully and comfortably at ease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਰੇ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: anad binod kare sad kelaa ||
english: They are blissful, enjoying pleasures, and eternally joyful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਸੋ ਵਡ ਸਾਹਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: so dhanava(n)taa so vad saahaa jo gur charanee man laavaniaa ||5||
english: They are wealthy, and the greatest kings; they center their minds on the Guru's Feet. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੋ ਦੇ ਤੈਂ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: pahilo de tai(n) rijak samaahaa ||
english: First, You created nourishment;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਤੈਂ ਜੰਤੁ ਉਪਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: pichho de tai(n) ja(n)t upaahaa ||
english: then, You created the living beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: tudh jevad daataa avar na suaamee lavai na koee laavaniaa ||6||
english: There is no other Giver as Great as You, O my Lord and Master. None approach or equal You. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਠਾ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: jis too(n) tuthaa so tudh dhiaae ||
english: Those who are pleasing to You meditate on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saadh janaa kaa ma(n)tr kamaae ||
english: They practice the Mantra of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aap tarai sagale kul taare tis daragah thaak na paavaniaa ||7||
english: They themselves swim across, and they save all their ancestors and families as well. In the Court of the Lord, they meet with no obstruction. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਵਡਾ ਤੂੰ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) vadaa too(n) oocho oochaa ||
english: You are so Great! You are the Highest of the High!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਮੂਚੋ ਮੂਚਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) bea(n)t at moocho moochaa ||
english: You are Infinite, You are Everything!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਵੰਞਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੫॥
transliteration: hau kurabaanee terai va(n)njaa naanak daas dasaavaniaa ||8||1||35||
english: I am a sacrifice to You. Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||8||1||35||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kaun s mukataa kaun s jugataa ||
english: Who is liberated, and who is united?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kaun s giaanee kaun s bakataa ||
english: Who is a spiritual teacher, and who is a preacher?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaun s girahee kaun udaasee kaun s keemat paae jeeu ||1||
english: Who is a house-holder, and who is a renunciate? Who can estimate the Lord's Value? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
transliteration: kin bidh baadhaa kin bidh chhootaa ||
english: How is one bound, and how is one freed of his bonds?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
transliteration: kin bidh aavan jaavan tootaa ||
english: How can one escape from the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣ ਕਰਮ ਕਉਣ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaun karam kaun nihakaramaa kaun s kahai kahaae jeeu ||2||
english: Who is subject to karma, and who is beyond karma? Who chants the Name, and inspires others to chant it? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kaun s sukheeaa kaun s dukheeaa ||
english: Who is happy, and who is sad?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਵੇਮੁਖੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kaun s sanamukh kaun vemukheeaa ||
english: Who, as sunmukh, turns toward the Guru, and who, as vaymukh, turns away from the Guru?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਛੁਰੈ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kin bidh mileeai kin bidh bichhurai ih bidh kaun pragataae jeeu ||3||
english: How can one meet the Lord? How is one separated from Him? Who can reveal the way to me? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kaun s akhar jit dhaavat rahataa ||
english: What is that Word, by which the wandering mind can be restrained?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kaun upades jit dukh sukh sam sahataa ||
english: What are those teachings, by which we may endure pain and pleasure alike?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਚਾਲ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kaun s chaal jit paarabraham dhiaae kin bidh keeratan gaae jeeu ||4||
english: What is that lifestyle, by which we may come to meditate on the Supreme Lord? How may we sing the Kirtan of His Praises? ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh mukataa guramukh jugataa ||
english: The Gurmukh is liberated, and the Gurmukh is linked.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh giaanee guramukh bakataa ||
english: The Gurmukh is the spiritual teacher, and the Gurmukh is the preacher.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: dha(n)n girahee udaasee guramukh guramukh keemat paae jeeu ||5||
english: Blessed is the Gurmukh, the householder and the renunciate. The Gurmukh knows the Lord's Value. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਾਧਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai baadhaa guramukh chhootaa ||
english: Egotism is bondage; as Gurmukh, one is emancipated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh aavan jaavan tootaa ||
english: The Gurmukh escapes the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: guramukh karam guramukh nihakaramaa guramukh kare s subhaae jeeu ||6||
english: The Gurmukh performs actions of good karma, and the Gurmukh is beyond karma. Whatever the Gurmukh does, is done in good faith. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sukheeaa manamukh dukheeaa ||
english: The Gurmukh is happy, while the self-willed manmukh is sad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਮੁਖੀਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sanamukh manamukh vemukheeaa ||
english: The Gurmukh turns toward the Guru, and the self-willed manmukh turns away from the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramukh mileeai manamukh vichhurai guramukh bidh pragataae jeeu ||7||
english: The Gurmukh is united with the Lord, while the manmukh is separated from Him. The Gurmukh reveals the way. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh akhar jit dhaavat rahataa ||
english: The Guru's Instruction is the Word, by which the wandering mind is restrained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh upades dukh sukh sam sahataa ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, we can endure pain and pleasure alike.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਲ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
transliteration: guramukh chaal jit paarabraham dhiaae guramukh keeratan gaae jeeu ||8||
english: To live as Gurmukh is the lifestyle by which we come to meditate on the Supreme Lord. The Gurmukh sings the Kirtan of His Praises. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: sagalee banat banaaee aape ||
english: The Lord Himself created the entire creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae thaape ||
english: He Himself acts, and causes others to act. He Himself establishes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਹੋਇਓ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥੨॥੩੬॥
transliteration: ikas te hoio ana(n)taa naanak ekas maahi samaae jeeu ||9||2||36||
english: From oneness, He has brought forth the countless multitudes. O Nanak, they shall merge into the One once again. ||9||2||36||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਾੜਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh abinaasee taa kiaa kaaRaa ||
english: God is Eternal and Imperishable, so why should anyone be anxious?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ਤਾ ਜਨੁ ਖਰਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: har bhagava(n)taa taa jan kharaa sukhaalaa ||
english: The Lord is Wealthy and Prosperous, so His humble servant should feel totally secure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jee praan maan sukhadaataa too(n) karahi soee sukh paavaniaa ||1||
english: O Giver of peace of the soul, of life, of honor-as You ordain, I obtain peace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree guramukh man tan bhaavaniaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to that Gurmukh whose mind and body are pleased with You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਓਲਾ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) meraa parabat too(n) meraa olaa tum sa(n)g lavai na laavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are my mountain, You are my shelter and shield. No one can rival You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: teraa keetaa jis laagai meethaa ||
english: That person, unto whom Your actions seem sweet,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat paarabraham tin jan deethaa ||
english: comes to see the Supreme Lord God in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar too(n)hai too(n)hai iko ik varataavaniaa ||2||
english: In all places and interspaces, You exist. You are the One and Only Lord, pervading everywhere. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal manorath too(n) devanahaaraa ||
english: You are the Fulfiller of all the mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagatee bhaai bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
english: Your treasures are overflowing with love and devotion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: daiaa dhaar raakhe tudh seee poorai karam samaavaniaa ||3||
english: Showering Your Mercy, You protect those who, through perfect destiny, merge into You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕੰਢੈ ਚਾੜੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop te ka(n)dhai chaaRe ||
english: You pulled me out of the deep, dark well onto the dry ground.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਾਸ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa daas nadar nihaale ||
english: Showering Your Mercy, You blessed Your servant with Your Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gun gaavahi pooran abinaasee kahi sun tot na aavaniaa ||4||
english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect, Immortal Lord. By speaking and hearing these Praises, they are not used up. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aithai othai too(n)hai rakhavaalaa ||
english: Here and hereafter, You are our Protector.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: maat garabh mahi tum hee paalaa ||
english: In the womb of the mother, You cherish and nurture the baby.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: maaiaa agan na pohai tin kau ra(n)g rate gun gaavaniaa ||5||
english: The fire of Maya does not affect those who are imbued with the Lord's Love; they sing His Glorious Praises. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: kiaa gun tere aakh samaalee ||
english: What Praises of Yours can I chant and contemplate?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar tudh nadar nihaalee ||
english: Deep within my mind and body, I behold Your Presence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: too(n) meraa meet saajan meraa suaamee tudh bin avar na jaananiaa ||6||
english: You are my Friend and Companion, my Lord and Master. Without You, I do not know any other at all. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jis kau too(n) prabh bhaiaa sahaaee ||
english: O God, that one, unto whom You have given shelter,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tis tatee vaau na lagai kaaee ||
english: is not touched by the hot winds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: too saahib saran sukhadaataa satasa(n)gat jap pragataavaniaa ||7||
english: O my Lord and Master, You are my Sanctuary, the Giver of peace. Chanting, meditating on You in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, You are revealed. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਊਚ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) ooch athaahu apaar amolaa ||
english: You are Exalted, Unfathomable, Infinite and Invaluable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਗੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) saachaa saahib daas teraa golaa ||
english: You are my True Lord and Master. I am Your servant and slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੀਰਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੩੭॥
transliteration: too(n) meeraa saachee thakuraaee naanak bal bal jaavaniaa ||8||3||37||
english: You are the King, Your Sovereign Rule is True. Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||8||3||37||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਦਯੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: nit nit day samaaleeai ||
english: Continually, continuously, remember the Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mool na manahu visaareeai || rahaau ||
english: Never forget Him from your mind. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa sa(n)gat paaeeai ||
english: Join the Society of the Saints,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jit jam kai pa(n)th na jaaeeai ||
english: and you shall not have to go down the path of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੁਲਹਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tosaa har kaa naam lai tere kulahi na laagai gaal jeeu ||1||
english: Take the Provisions of the Lord's Name with you, and no stain shall attach itself to your family. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੰਦੇ ਸਾਂਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jo simara(n)de saa(n)eeai ||
english: Those who meditate on the Master

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਸੇਈ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: narak na seee paaeeai ||
english: shall not be thrown down into hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tatee vaau na lagaee jin man vuthaa aai jeeu ||2||
english: Even the hot winds shall not touch them. The Lord has come to dwell within their minds. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੋਹਣੇ ॥
transliteration: seee su(n)dar sohane ||
english: They alone are beautiful and attractive,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਨ ਬੈਹਣੇ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jin baihane ||
english: who abide in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸੰਜਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har dhan jinee sa(n)jiaa seee ga(n)bheer apaar jeeu ||3||
english: Those who have gathered in the wealth of the Lord's Name-they alone are deep and thoughtful and vast. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਪੀਵੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har amiu rasaain peeveeai ||
english: Drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Name,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਜੀਵੀਐ ॥
transliteration: muhi dithai jan kai jeeveeai ||
english: and live by beholding the face of the Lord's servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਨਿਤ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਵ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kaaraj sabh savaar lai nit poojahu gur ke paav jeeu ||4||
english: Let all your affairs be resolved, by continually worshipping the Feet of the Guru. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jo har keetaa aapanaa ||
english: He alone meditates on the Lord of the World,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਹਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਜਾਪਣਾ ॥
transliteration: tinahi gusaaee jaapanaa ||
english: Whom the Lord has made His Own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੋ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: so sooraa paradhaan so masatak jis dai bhaag jeeu ||5||
english: He alone is a warrior, and he alone is the chosen one, upon whose forehead good destiny is recorded. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੰਧੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਵਗਾਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: man ma(n)dhe prabh avagaaheeaa ||
english: Within my mind, I meditate on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ehi ras bhogan paatisaaheeaa ||
english: For me, this is like the enjoyment of princely pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਤਰੇ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ma(n)daa mool na upajio tare sachee kaarai laag jeeu ||6||
english: Evil does not well up within me, since I am saved, and dedicated to truthful actions. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: karataa ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
english: I have enshrined the Creator within my mind;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੈ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: janamai kaa phal paaiaa ||
english: I have obtained the fruits of life's rewards.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: man bhaava(n)daa ka(n)t har teraa thir hoaa sohaag jeeu ||7||
english: If your Husband Lord is pleasing to your mind, then your married life shall be eternal. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਟਲ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: atal padaarath paaiaa ||
english: I have obtained everlasting wealth;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhai bha(n)jan kee saranaaiaa ||
english: I have found the Sanctuary of the Dispeller of fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਇ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਜਿਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੪॥੩੮॥
transliteration: laai a(n)chal naanak taarian jitaa janam apaar jeeu ||8||4||38||
english: Grasping hold of the hem of the Lord's robe, Nanak is saved. He has won the incomparable life. ||8||4||38||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jap jape man dheere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, the mind is held steady. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਭੈ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: simar simar guradeu mit gae bhai doore ||1||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Divine Guru, one's fears are erased and dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਝੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saran aavai paarabraham kee taa phir kaahe jhoore ||2||
english: Entering the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God, how could anyone feel grief any longer? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: charan sev sa(n)t saadh ke sagal manorath poore ||3||
english: Serving at the Feet of the Holy Saints, all desires are fulfilled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ghat ghat ek varatadaa jal thal maheeal poore ||4||
english: In each and every heart, the One Lord is pervading. He is totally permeating the water, the land, and the sky. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: paap binaasan seviaa pavitr sa(n)tan kee dhoore ||5||
english: I serve the Destroyer of sin, and I am sanctified by the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਛਡਾਈ ਖਸਮਿ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਈ ਠਰੂਰੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sabh chhadaaee khasam aap har jap bhaee tharoore ||6||
english: My Lord and Master Himself has saved me completely; I am comforted by meditating on the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੈ ਕੀਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੋ ਦੁਸਟ ਮੁਏ ਹੋਇ ਮੂਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: karatai keeaa tapaavaso dusat mue hoi moore ||7||
english: The Creator has passed judgement, and the evil-doers have been silenced and killed. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak rataa sach naai har vekhai sadaa hajoore ||8||5||39||1||32||1||5||39||
english: Nanak is attuned to the True Name; he beholds the Presence of the Ever-present Lord. ||8||5||39||1||32||1||5||39||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹਾ ਮਾਂਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: baarah maahaa maa(n)jh mahalaa 5 ghar 4 ||
english: Baarah Maahaa ~ The Twelve Months: Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਵੀਛੁੜੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kirat karam ke veechhuRe kar kirapaa melahu raam ||
english: By the actions we have committed, we are separated from You. Please show Your Mercy, and unite us with Yourself, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਥਕਿ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਾਮ ॥
transliteration: chaar ku(n)t dah dis bhrame thak aae prabh kee saam ||
english: We have grown weary of wandering to the four corners of the earth and in the ten directions. We have come to Your Sanctuary, God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੇਨੁ ਦੁਧੈ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dhen dudhai te baaharee kitai na aavai kaam ||
english: Without milk, a cow serves no purpose.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਖ ਕੁਮਲਾਵਤੀ ਉਪਜਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jal bin saakh kumalaavatee upajahi naahee daam ||
english: Without water, the crop withers, and it will not bring a good price.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹ ਨ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਾਜਨੈ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਸਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har naah na mileeai saajanai kat paaeeai bisaraam ||
english: If we do not meet the Lord, our Friend, how can we find our place of rest?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਈ ਭਠਿ ਨਗਰ ਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jit ghar har ka(n)t na pragataee bhath nagar se graam ||
english: Those homes, those hearts, in which the Husband Lord is not manifest-those towns and villages are like burning furnaces.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ ਸਣੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਭ ਖਾਮ ॥
transliteration: srab seegaar ta(n)bol ras san dehee sabh khaam ||
english: All decorations, the chewing of betel to sweeten the breath, and the body itself, are all useless and vain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ਮੀਤ ਸਜਣ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਮ ॥
transliteration: prabh suaamee ka(n)t vihooneeaa meet sajan sabh jaam ||
english: Without God, our Husband, our Lord and Master, all friends and companions are like the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)teeaa kar kirapaa deejai naam ||
english: This is Nanak's prayer: "Please show Your Mercy, and bestow Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਧਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har melahu suaamee sa(n)g prabh jis kaa nihachal dhaam ||1||
english: O my Lord and Master, please unite me with Yourself, O God, in the Eternal Mansion of Your Presence". ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
transliteration: chet govi(n)d araadheeai hovai ana(n)d ghanaa ||
english: In the month of Chayt, by meditating on the Lord of the Universe, a deep and profound joy arises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil paaeeai rasanaa naam bhanaa ||
english: Meeting with the humble Saints, the Lord is found, as we chant His Name with our tongues.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਗਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jin paaiaa prabh aapanaa aae tisahi ganaa ||
english: Those who have found God-blessed is their coming into this world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ik khin tis bin jeevanaa birathaa janam janaa ||
english: Those who live without Him, for even an instant-their lives are rendered useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਰਵਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooriaa raviaa vich vanaa ||
english: The Lord is totally pervading the water, the land, and all space. He is contained in the forests as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਕਿਤੜਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਣਾ ॥
transliteration: so prabh chit na aavaee kitaRaa dukh ganaa ||
english: Those who do not remember God-how much pain must they suffer!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jinee raaviaa so prabhoo ti(n)naa bhaag manaa ||
english: Those who dwell upon their God have great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੰਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har darasan ka(n)u man lochadaa naanak piaas manaa ||
english: My mind yearns for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. O Nanak, my mind is so thirsty!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chet milaae so prabhoo tis kai paai lagaa ||2||
english: I touch the feet of one who unites me with God in the month of Chayt. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੈਸਾਖਿ ਧੀਰਨਿ ਕਿਉ ਵਾਢੀਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ॥
transliteration: vaisaakh dheeran kiu vaadheeaa jinaa prem bichhohu ||
english: In the month of Vaisaakh, how can the bride be patient? She is separated from her Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਗੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੋਹੁ ॥
transliteration: har saajan purakh visaar kai lagee maaiaa dhohu ||
english: She has forgotten the Lord, her Life-companion, her Master; she has become attached to Maya, the deceitful one.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਓਹੁ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr na sa(n)g dhanaa har avinaasee ohu ||
english: Neither son, nor spouse, nor wealth shall go along with you-only the Eternal Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਲਚਿ ਪਲਚਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਮੁਈ ਝੂਠੈ ਧੰਧੈ ਮੋਹੁ ॥
transliteration: palach palach sagalee muee jhoothai dha(n)dhai mohu ||
english: Entangled and enmeshed in the love of false occupations, the whole world is perishing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਗੈ ਲਈਅਹਿ ਖੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ikas har ke naam bin agai laeeahi khohi ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the One Lord, they lose their lives in the hereafter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਯੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: day visaar viguchanaa prabh bin avar na koi ||
english: Forgetting the Merciful Lord, they are ruined. Without God, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਚਰਣੀ ਜੋ ਲਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: preetam charanee jo lage tin kee niramal soi ||
english: Pure is the reputation of those who are attached to the Feet of the Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak kee prabh benatee prabh milahu paraapat hoi ||
english: Nanak makes this prayer to God: "Please, come and unite me with Yourself."

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੈਸਾਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਲਗੈ ਜਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vaisaakh suhaavaa taa(n) lagai jaa sa(n)t bhetai har soi ||3||
english: The month of Vaisaakh is beautiful and pleasant, when the Saint causes me to meet the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਠਿ ਜੁੜੰਦਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: har jeth juRa(n)daa loReeai jis agai sabh niva(n)n ||
english: In the month of Jayt'h, the bride longs to meet with the Lord. All bow in humility before Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਦਾਵਣਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਬੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: har sajan daavan lagiaa kisai na deee ba(n)n ||
