english: One who has grasped the hem of the robe of the Lord, the True Friend-no one can keep him in bondage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਉਨ ਲਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: maanak motee naam prabh un lagai naahee sa(n)n ||
english: God's Name is the Jewel, the Pearl. It cannot be stolen or taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਸਭੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g sabhe naaraainai jete man bhaava(n)n ||
english: In the Lord are all pleasures which please the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਅ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: jo har loRe so kare soee jee kara(n)n ||
english: As the Lord wishes, so He acts, and so His creatures act.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਸੇਈ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: jo prabh keete aapane seee kaheeahi dha(n)n ||
english: They alone are called blessed, whom God has made His Own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਿਉ ਰੋਵੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: aapan leeaa je milai vichhuR kiu rova(n)n ||
english: If people could meet the Lord by their own efforts, why would they be crying out in the pain of separation?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g paraapate naanak ra(n)g maana(n)n ||
english: Meeting Him in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, celestial bliss is enjoyed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਠੁ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥੰਨਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har jeth ra(n)geelaa tis dhanee jis kai bhaag matha(n)n ||4||
english: In the month of Jayt'h, the playful Husband Lord meets her, upon whose forehead such good destiny is recorded. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਤਪੰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ਨ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: aasaaR tapa(n)daa tis lagai har naahu na ji(n)naa paas ||
english: The month of Aasaarh seems burning hot, to those who are not close to their Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਸੰਦੀ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan purakh tiaag kai maanas sa(n)dee aas ||
english: They have forsaken God the Primal Being, the Life of the World, and they have come to rely upon mere mortals.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਯੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਗਲਿ ਪਈਸੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
transliteration: duyai bhaai vigucheeai gal paees jam kee phaas ||
english: In the love of duality, the soul-bride is ruined; around her neck she wears the noose of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਮਥੈ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jehaa beejai so lunai mathai jo likhiaas ||
english: As you plant, so shall you harvest; your destiny is recorded on your forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਗਈ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥
transliteration: rain vihaanee pachhutaanee uth chalee gaee niraas ||
english: The life-night passes away, and in the end, one comes to regret and repent, and then depart with no hope at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੌ ਸਾਧੂ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਸੋ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੋਇ ਖਲਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jin kau saadhoo bheteeai so daragah hoi khalaas ||
english: Those who meet with the Holy Saints are liberated in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਹੋਇ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee tere darasan hoi piaas ||
english: Show Your Mercy to me, O God; I am thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh tudh bin doojaa ko nahee naanak kee aradaas ||
english: Without You, God, there is no other at all. This is Nanak's humble prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aasaaR suha(n)daa tis lagai jis man har charan nivaas ||5||
english: The month of Aasaarh is pleasant, when the Feet of the Lord abide in the mind. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saavan sarasee kaamanee charan kamal siu piaar ||
english: In the month of Saawan, the soul-bride is happy, if she falls in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man tan rataa sach ra(n)g iko naam adhaar ||
english: Her mind and body are imbued with the Love of the True One; His Name is her only Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰੰਗ ਕੂੜਾਵਿਆ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa ra(n)g kooRaaviaa disan sabhe chhaar ||
english: The pleasures of corruption are false. All that is seen shall turn to ashes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)mrit boo(n)d suhaavanee mil saadhoo peevanahaar ||
english: The drops of the Lord's Nectar are so beautiful! Meeting the Holy Saint, we drink these in.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਣੁ ਤਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: van tin prabh sa(n)g mauliaa sa(n)mrath purakh apaar ||
english: The forests and the meadows are rejuvenated and refreshed with the Love of God, the All-powerful, Infinite Primal Being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਨੋ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har milanai no man lochadaa karam milaavanahaar ||
english: My mind yearns to meet the Lord. If only He would show His Mercy, and unite me with Himself!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹੰਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jinee sakheee prabh paaiaa ha(n)u tin kai sad balihaar ||
english: Those brides who have obtained God-I am forever a sacrifice to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak har jee maiaa kar sabad savaaranahaar ||
english: O Nanak, when the Dear Lord shows kindness, He adorns His bride with the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saavan tinaa suhaaganee jin raam naam ur haar ||6||
english: Saawan is delightful for those happy soul-brides whose hearts are adorned with the Necklace of the Lord's Name. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਦੁਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: bhaadui bharam bhulaaneeaa doojai lagaa het ||
english: In the month of Bhaadon, she is deluded by doubt, because of her attachment to duality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: lakh seegaar banaaiaa kaaraj naahee ket ||
english: She may wear thousands of ornaments, but they are of no use at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਨਸਸੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਵੇਲੈ ਕਹਸਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jit din deh binasasee tit velai kahasan pret ||
english: On that day when the body perishes-at that time, she becomes a ghost.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਨਿ ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਨੀ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: pakaR chalaain doot jam kisai na denee bhet ||
english: The Messenger of Death seizes and holds her, and does not tell anyone his secret.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਡਿ ਖੜੋਤੇ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਗਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chhad khaRote khinai maahi jin siu lagaa het ||
english: And her loved ones-in an instant, they move on, leaving her all alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਥ ਮਰੋੜੈ ਤਨੁ ਕਪੇ ਸਿਆਹਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: hath maroRai tan kape siaahahu hoaa set ||
english: She wrings her hands, her body writhes in pain, and she turns from black to white.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕਰਮਾ ਸੰਦੜਾ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jehaa beejai so lunai karamaa sa(n)daRaa khet ||
english: As she has planted, so does she harvest; such is the field of karma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਚਰਣ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee charan bohith prabh det ||
english: Nanak seeks God's Sanctuary; God has given him the Boat of His Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਾਦੁਇ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: se bhaadui narak na paaeeahi gur rakhan vaalaa het ||7||
english: Those who love the Guru, the Protector and Savior, in Bhaadon, shall not be thrown down into hell. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਉਮਾਹੜਾ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: asun prem umaahaRaa kiu mileeai har jaai ||
english: In the month of Assu, my love for the Lord overwhelms me. How can I go and meet the Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਦਰਸਨ ਘਣੀ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan piaas darasan ghanee koee aan milaavai maai ||
english: My mind and body are so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Won't someone please come and lead me to him, O my mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sahaaee prem ke hau tin kai laagaa paai ||
english: The Saints are the helpers of the Lord's lovers; I fall and touch their feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vin prabh kiu sukh paaeeai doojee naahee jaai ||
english: Without God, how can I find peace? There is nowhere else to go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਨੑੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ji(n)nhee chaakhiaa prem ras se tripat rahe aaghaai ||
english: Those who have tasted the sublime essence of His Love, remain satisfied and fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aap tiaag binatee karahi lehu prabhoo laR laai ||
english: They renounce their selfishness and conceit, and they pray, "God, please attach me to the hem of Your robe."

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ਸਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo har ka(n)t milaaeeaa s vichhuR katahi na jaai ||
english: Those whom the Husband Lord has united with Himself, shall not be separated from Him again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਿਣੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh vin doojaa ko nahee naanak har saranaai ||
english: Without God, there is no other at all. Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸੂ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸੰਦੀਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: asoo sukhee vasa(n)deeaa jinaa maiaa har raai ||8||
english: In Assu, the Lord, the Sovereign King, has granted His Mercy, and they dwell in peace. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਤਿਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: katik karam kamaavane dos na kaahoo jog ||
english: In the month of Katak, do good deeds. Do not try to blame anyone else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਤੇ ਭੁਲਿਆਂ ਵਿਆਪਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਰੋਗ ॥
transliteration: paramesar te bhuliaa(n) viaapan sabhe rog ||
english: Forgetting the Transcendent Lord, all sorts of illnesses are contracted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੇਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਲਗਨਿ ਜਨਮ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: vemukh hoe raam te lagan janam vijog ||
english: Those who turn their backs on the Lord shall be separated from Him and consigned to reincarnation, over and over again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਉੜੇ ਹੋਇ ਗਏ ਜਿਤੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਭੋਗ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi kauRe hoi gae jitaRe maaiaa bhog ||
english: In an instant, all of Maya's sensual pleasures turn bitter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ਕਿਸ ਥੈ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਰੋਜ ॥
transliteration: vich na koee kar sakai kis thai rovahi roj ||
english: No one can then serve as your intermediary. Unto whom can we turn and cry?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: keetaa kichhoo na hovaee likhiaa dhur sa(n)jog ||
english: By one's own actions, nothing can be done; destiny was pre-determined from the very beginning.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਓਗ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee meraa prabh milai taa(n) utarahi sabh biog ||
english: By great good fortune, I meet my God, and then all pain of separation departs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬੰਦੀ ਮੋਚ ॥
transliteration: naanak kau prabh raakh lehi mere saahib ba(n)dee moch ||
english: Please protect Nanak, God; O my Lord and Master, please release me from bondage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਤਿਕ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸਭੇ ਸੋਚ ॥੯॥
transliteration: katik hovai saadhasa(n)g binasahi sabhe soch ||9||
english: In Katak, in the Company of the Holy, all anxiety vanishes. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਘਿਰਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਸੋਹੰਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਠੜੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)ghir maahi soha(n)deeaa har pir sa(n)g baithaReeaah ||
english: In the month of Maghar, those who sit with their Beloved Husband Lord are beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਿ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਮੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: tin kee sobhaa kiaa ganee j saahib melaReeaah ||
english: How can their glory be measured? Their Lord and Master blends them with Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: tan man mauliaa raam siu sa(n)g saadh sahelaReeaah ||
english: Their bodies and minds blossom forth in the Lord; they have the companionship of the Holy Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਸੇ ਰਹਨਿ ਇਕੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: saadh janaa te baaharee se rahan ikelaReeaah ||
english: Those who lack the Company of the Holy, remain all alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਉਤਰੈ ਸੇ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਪੜੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: tin dukh na kabahoo utarai se jam kai vas paReeaah ||
english: Their pain never departs, and they fall into the grip of the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਖੜੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: jinee raaviaa prabh aapanaa se disan nit khaReeaah ||
english: Those who have ravished and enjoyed their God, are seen to be continually exalted and uplifted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਜੜੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: ratan javehar laal har ka(n)th tinaa jaReeaah ||
english: They wear the Necklace of the jewels, emeralds and rubies of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੀ ਦਰਿ ਪੜੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: naanak baa(n)chhai dhooR tin prabh saranee dar paReeaah ||
english: Nanak seeks the dust of the feet of those who take to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਘਿਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਨਮੜੀਆਹ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: ma(n)ghir prabh aaraadhanaa bahuR na janamaReeaah ||10||
english: Those who worship and adore God in Maghar, do not suffer the cycle of reincarnation ever again. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੋਖਿ ਤੁਖਾਰੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਕੰਠਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: pokh tukhaar na viaapaee ka(n)th miliaa har naahu ||
english: In the month of Poh, the cold does not touch those, whom the Husband Lord hugs close in His Embrace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਲਗੜਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: man bedhiaa charanaarabi(n)d darasan lagaRaa saahu ||
english: Their minds are transfixed by His Lotus Feet. They are attached to the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਟ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: ot govi(n)d gopaal raai sevaa suaamee laahu ||
english: Seek the Protection of the Lord of the Universe; His service is truly profitable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa pohi na sakaee mil saadhoo gun gaahu ||
english: Corruption shall not touch you, when you join the Holy Saints and sing the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਹ ਮਿਲੀ ਸਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਮਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jah te upajee tah milee sachee preet samaahu ||
english: From where it originated, there the soul is blended again. It is absorbed in the Love of the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੀਆਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kar gahi leenee paarabraham bahuR na vichhuReeaahu ||
english: When the Supreme Lord God grasps someone's hand, he shall never again suffer separation from Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਲਖ ਬੇਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: baar jaau lakh bereeaa har sajan agam agaahu ||
english: I am a sacrifice, 100,000 times, to the Lord, my Friend, the Unapproachable and Unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਮ ਪਈ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਪਈਆਹੁ ॥
transliteration: saram paee naaraainai naanak dar paeeaahu ||
english: Please preserve my honor, Lord; Nanak begs at Your Door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੋਖੁ ਸੋੁਹੰਦਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: pokh souha(n)daa sarab sukh jis bakhase veparavaahu ||11||
english: Poh is beautiful, and all comforts come to that one, whom the Carefree Lord has forgiven. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਘਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂਆ ਧੂੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: maagh majan sa(n)g saadhooaa dhooRee kar isanaan ||
english: In the month of Maagh, let your cleansing bath be the dust of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam dhiaai sun sabhanaa no kar daan ||
english: Meditate and listen to the Name of the Lord, and give it to everyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਕਰਮ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: janam karam mal utarai man te jaai gumaan ||
english: In this way, the filth of lifetimes of karma shall be removed, and egotistical pride shall vanish from your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨ ਮੋਹੀਐ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kaam karodh na moheeai binasai lobh suaan ||
english: Sexual desire and anger shall not seduce you, and the dog of greed shall depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sachai maarag chaladiaa usatat kare jahaan ||
english: Those who walk on the Path of Truth shall be praised throughout the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਗਲ ਪੁੰਨ ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: athasath teerath sagal pu(n)n jee daiaa paravaan ||
english: Be kind to all beings-this is more meritorious than bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage and the giving of charity.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jis no devai daiaa kar soee purakh sujaan ||
english: That person, upon whom the Lord bestows His Mercy, is a wise person.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jinaa miliaa prabh aapanaa naanak tin kurabaan ||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who have merged with God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਘਿ ਸੁਚੇ ਸੇ ਕਾਂਢੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: maagh suche se kaa(n)dheeahi jin pooraa gur miharavaan ||12||
english: In Maagh, they alone are known as true, unto whom the Perfect Guru is Merciful. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਲਗੁਣਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: phalagun ana(n)d upaarajanaa har sajan pragate aai ||
english: In the month of Phalgun, bliss comes to those, unto whom the Lord, the Friend, has been revealed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sahaaee raam ke kar kirapaa deeaa milaai ||
english: The Saints, the Lord's helpers, in their mercy, have united me with Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਹੁਣਿ ਦੁਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sej suhaavee sarab sukh hun dukhaa naahee jaai ||
english: My bed is beautiful, and I have all comforts. I feel no sadness at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਵਡਭਾਗਣੀ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ichh punee vadabhaaganee var paaiaa har raai ||
english: My desires have been fulfilled-by great good fortune, I have obtained the Sovereign Lord as my Husband.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਹੀਆ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹੀ ਗੀਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mil saheeaa ma(n)gal gaavahee geet govi(n)d alaai ||
english: Join with me, my sisters, and sing the songs of rejoicing and the Hymns of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਕੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har jehaa avar na disaee koee doojaa lavai na laai ||
english: There is no other like the Lord-there is no equal to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਓਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: halat palat savaarion nihachal diteean jaai ||
english: He embellishes this world and the world hereafter, and He gives us our permanent home there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar te rakhian bahuR na janamai dhaai ||
english: He rescues us from the world-ocean; never again do we have to run the cycle of reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਗੁਣ ਤਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਣੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa ek anek gun tare naanak charanee paai ||
english: I have only one tongue, but Your Glorious Virtues are beyond counting. Nanak is saved, falling at Your Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਲਗੁਣਿ ਨਿਤ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: phalagun nit salaaheeai jis no til na tamaai ||13||
english: In Phalgun, praise Him continually; He has not even an iota of greed. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jin jin naam dhiaaiaa tin ke kaaj sare ||
english: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord-their affairs are all resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har gur pooraa aaraadhiaa daragah sach khare ||
english: Those who meditate on the Perfect Guru, the Lord-Incarnate-they are judged true in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa nidh charan har bhaujal bikham tare ||
english: The Lord's Feet are the Treasure of all peace and comfort for them; they cross over the terrifying and treacherous world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prem bhagat tin paaeeaa bikhiaa naahi jare ||
english: They obtain love and devotion, and they do not burn in corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜ ਗਏ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਸੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਚਿ ਭਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kooR gae dubidhaa nasee pooran sach bhare ||
english: Falsehood has vanished, duality has been erased, and they are totally overflowing with Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh sevade man a(n)dar ek dhare ||
english: They serve the Supreme Lord God, and enshrine the One Lord within their minds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਹ ਦਿਵਸ ਮੂਰਤ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maah divas moorat bhale jis kau nadar kare ||
english: The months, the days, and the moments are auspicious, for those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਰਸ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ma(n)gai daras daan kirapaa karahu hare ||14||1||
english: Nanak begs for the blessing of Your Vision, O Lord. Please, shower Your Mercy upon me! ||14||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦਿਨ ਰੈਣਿ ॥
transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 din rain ||
english: Maajh, Fifth Mehl: Day And Night:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਿ ਰੈਣ ॥
transliteration: sevee satigur aapanaa har simaree din sabh rain ||
english: I serve my True Guru, and meditate on Him all day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਵਾਂ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਮਿਠੜੇ ਵੈਣ ॥
transliteration: aap tiaag saranee pavaa(n) mukh bolee mithaRe vain ||
english: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, I seek His Sanctuary, and speak sweet words to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੈਣ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa vichhuRiaa har melahu sajan sain ||
english: Through countless lifetimes and incarnations, I was separated from Him. O Lord, you are my Friend and Companion-please unite me with Yourself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੀਅ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਸੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਨ ਵਸਨਿ ਭੈਣ ॥
transliteration: jo jee har te vichhuRe se sukh na vasan bhain ||
english: Those who are separated from the Lord do not dwell in peace, O sister.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਚੈਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਖੋਜਿ ਡਿਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਗੈਣ ॥
transliteration: har pir bin chain na paaeeai khoj dithe sabh gain ||
english: Without their Husband Lord, they find no comfort. I have searched and seen all realms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੇਣ ॥
transliteration: aap kamaanai vichhuRee dos na kaahoo den ||
english: My own evil actions have kept me separate from Him; why should I accuse anyone else?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੇਣ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh raakh lehu hor naahee karan karen ||
english: Bestow Your Mercy, God, and save me! No one else can bestow Your Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਖਾਕੂ ਰੂਲਣਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਥੈ ਵੈਣ ॥
transliteration: har tudh vin khaakoo roolanaa kaheeai kithai vain ||
english: Without You, Lord, we roll around in the dust. Unto whom should we utter our cries of distress?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਰਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਨੈਣ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)teeaa har surajan dekhaa nain ||1||
english: This is Nanak's prayer: "May my eyes behold the Lord, the Angelic Being." ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jee kee birathaa so sune har sa(n)mrith purakh apaar ||
english: The Lord hears the anguish of the soul; He is the All-powerful and Infinite Primal Being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣਿ ਜੀਵਣਿ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: maran jeevan aaraadhanaa sabhanaa kaa aadhaar ||
english: In death and in life, worship and adore the Lord, the Support of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ ਵਡਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sasurai peeeai tis ka(n)t kee vadaa jis paravaar ||
english: In this world and in the next, the soul-bride belongs to her Husband Lord, who has such a vast family.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: oochaa agam agaadh bodh kichh a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: He is Lofty and Inaccessible. His Wisdom is Unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sevaa saa tis bhaavasee sa(n)taa kee hoi chhaar ||
english: He has no end or limitation. That service is pleasing to Him, which makes one humble, like the dust of the feet of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦੈਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: deenaa naath daiaal dev patit udhaaranahaar ||
english: He is the Patron of the poor, the Merciful, Luminous Lord, the Redeemer of sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਰਖਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aad jugaadee rakhadaa sach naam karataar ||
english: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the True Name of the Creator has been our Saving Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: keemat koi na jaanaee ko naahee tolanahaar ||
english: No one can know His Value; no one can weigh it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar vas rahe naanak nahee sumaar ||
english: He dwells deep within the mind and body. O Nanak, He cannot be measured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੰਉ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: din rain j prabh ka(n)u sevade tin kai sad balihaar ||2||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve God, day and night. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਅਰਾਧਨਿ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t araadhan sad sadaa sabhanaa kaa bakhasi(n)d ||
english: The Saints worship and adore Him forever and ever; He is the Forgiver of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਿਤੀਨੁ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d jin saajiaa kar kirapaa diteen ji(n)d ||
english: He fashioned the soul and the body, and by His Kindness, He bestowed the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee aaraadheeai japeeai niramal ma(n)t ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, worship and adore Him, and chant His Pure Mantra.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: keemat kahan na jaaeeai paramesur bea(n)t ||
english: His Value cannot be evaluated. The Transcendent Lord is endless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਰਾਇਣੋ ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jis man vasai naraaino so kaheeai bhagava(n)t ||
english: That one, within whose mind the Lord abides, is said to be most fortunate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jee kee lochaa pooreeai milai suaamee ka(n)t ||
english: The soul's desires are fulfilled, upon meeting the Master, our Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ ਦੋਖ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਹੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak jeevai jap haree dokh sabhe hee ha(n)t ||
english: Nanak lives by chanting the Lord's Name; all sorrows have been erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੰਤੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: din rain jis na visarai so hariaa hovai ja(n)t ||3||
english: One who does not forget Him, day and night, is continually rejuvenated. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਣੋ ਮੰਞੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab kalaa prabh poorano ma(n)nj nimaanee thaau ||
english: God is overflowing with all powers. I have no honor-He is my resting place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ot gahee man a(n)dare jap jap jeevaa(n) naau ||
english: I have grasped the Support of the Lord within my mind; I live by chanting and meditating on His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਨ ਧੂੜੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee jan dhooRee sa(n)g samaau ||
english: Grant Your Grace, God, and bless me, that I may merge into the dust of the feet of the humble.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨਾ ਖਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu too(n) raakhahi tiu rahaa teraa ditaa painaa khaau ||
english: As You keep me, so do I live. I wear and eat whatever You give me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: udam soee karaai prabh mil saadhoo gun gaau ||
english: May I make the effort, O God, to sing Your Glorious Praises in the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਕੂਕਣ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: doojee jaai na sujhaee kithai kookan jaau ||
english: I can conceive of no other place; where could I go to lodge a complaint?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਤਮ ਹਰਣ ਊਚੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਮਾਉ ॥
transliteration: agiaan binaasan tam haran ooche agam amaau ||
english: You are the Dispeller of ignorance, the Destroyer of darkness, O Lofty, Unfathomable and Unapproachable Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: man vichhuRiaa har meleeai naanak ehu suaau ||
english: Please unite this separated one with Yourself; this is Nanak's yearning.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: sarab kaliaanaa tit din har parasee gur ke paau ||4||1||
english: That day shall bring every joy, O Lord, when I take to the Feet of the Guru. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰ ਮਾਝ ਕੀ ਤਥਾ ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਮਲਕ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਤਥਾ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਹੜਾ ਸੋਹੀਆ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਗਾਵਣੀ ॥
transliteration: vaar maajh kee tathaa salok mahalaa 1 malak mureed tathaa cha(n)drahaRaa soheeaa kee dhunee gaavanee ||
english: Vaar In Maajh, And Saloks Of The First Mehl: To Be Sung To The Tune Of "Malik Mureed And Chandrahraa Sohee-Aa"

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਤਿਹ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur daataa gur hivai ghar gur deepak tih loi ||
english: The Guru is the Giver; the Guru is the House of ice. The Guru is the Light of the three worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: amar padaarath naanakaa man maaniai sukh hoi ||1||
english: O Nanak, He is everlasting wealth. Place your mind's faith in Him, and you shall find peace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਥਣ ਦੁਧਿ ॥
transliteration: pahilai piaar lagaa than dudh ||
english: First, the baby loves mother's milk;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥
transliteration: doojai maai baap kee sudh ||
english: second, he learns of his mother and father;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਜੈ ਭਯਾ ਭਾਭੀ ਬੇਬ ॥
transliteration: teejai bhayaa bhaabhee beb ||
english: third, his brothers, sisters-in-law and sisters;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਉਪੰਨੀ ਖੇਡ ॥
transliteration: chauthai piaar upa(n)nee khed ||
english: fourth, the love of play awakens.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਜਵੈ ਖਾਣ ਪੀਅਣ ਕੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)javai khaan peean kee dhaat ||
english: Fifth, he runs after food and drink;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਿਵੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: chhivai kaam na puchhai jaat ||
english: sixth, in his sexual desire, he does not respect social customs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਵੈ ਸੰਜਿ ਕੀਆ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: satavai sa(n)j keeaa ghar vaas ||
english: Seventh, he gathers wealth and dwells in his house;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਠਵੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਨ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: athavai krodh hoaa tan naas ||
english: eighth, he becomes angry, and his body is consumed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵੈ ਧਉਲੇ ਉਭੇ ਸਾਹ ॥
transliteration: naavai dhaule ubhe saah ||
english: Ninth, he turns grey, and his breathing becomes labored;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸਵੈ ਦਧਾ ਹੋਆ ਸੁਆਹ ॥
transliteration: dasavai dadhaa hoaa suaah ||
english: tenth, he is cremated, and turns to ashes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਏ ਸਿਗੀਤ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ਧਾਹ ॥
transliteration: gae sigeet pukaaree dhaah ||
english: His companions send him off, crying out and lamenting.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਡਿਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਦਸਾਏ ਰਾਹ ॥
transliteration: udiaa ha(n)s dasaae raah ||
english: The swan of the soul takes flight, and asks which way to go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਇਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aaiaa gaiaa muiaa naau ||
english: He came and he went, and now, even his name has died.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਛੈ ਪਤਲਿ ਸਦਿਹੁ ਕਾਵ ॥
transliteration: pichhai patal sadihu kaav ||
english: After he left, food was offered on leaves, and the birds were called to come and eat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak manamukh a(n)dh piaar ||
english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs love the darkness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਡੁਬਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: baajh guroo dubaa sa(n)saar ||2||
english: Without the Guru, the world is drowning. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਬਾਲਤਣਿ ਬੀਸ ਰਵਣਿ ਤੀਸਾ ਕਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: das baalatan bees ravan teesaa kaa su(n)dar kahaavai ||
english: At the age of ten, he is a child; at twenty, a youth, and at thirty, he is called handsome.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਲੀਸੀ ਪੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਚਾਸੀ ਪਗੁ ਖਿਸੈ ਸਠੀ ਕੇ ਬੋਢੇਪਾ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: chaaleesee pur hoi pachaasee pag khisai sathee ke bodhepaa aavai ||
english: At forty, he is full of life; at fifty, his foot slips, and at sixty, old age is upon him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਅਸੀਹਾਂ ਕਾ ਵਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: satar kaa matiheen aseehaa(n) kaa viuhaar na paavai ||
english: At seventy, he loses his intellect, and at eighty, he cannot perform his duties.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਵੈ ਕਾ ਸਿਹਜਾਸਣੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਪ ਬਲੁ ॥
transliteration: navai kaa sihajaasanee mool na jaanai ap bal ||
english: At ninety, he lies in his bed, and he cannot understand his weakness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਢੰਢੋਲਿਮੁ ਢੂਢਿਮੁ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗੁ ਧੂਏ ਕਾ ਧਵਲਹਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dha(n)dholim dhoodhim dith mai naanak jag dhooe kaa dhavalahar ||3||
english: After seeking and searching for such a long time, O Nanak, I have seen that the world is just a mansion of smoke. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) karataa purakh aga(n)m hai aap srisat upaatee ||
english: You, O Creator Lord, are Unfathomable. You Yourself created the Universe,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g para(n)g upaarajanaa bahu bahu bidh bhaatee ||
english: its colors, qualities and varieties, in so many ways and forms.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈਐ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) jaanahi jin upaaeeai sabh khel tumaatee ||
english: You created it, and You alone understand it. It is all Your Play.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: ik aavahi ik jaahi uth bin naavai mar jaatee ||
english: Some come, and some arise and depart; but without the Name, all are bound to die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ra(n)g chalooliaa ra(n)g har ra(n)g raatee ||
english: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the deep crimson color of the poppy; they are dyed in the color of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: so sevahu sat nira(n)jano har purakh bidhaatee ||
english: So serve the True and Pure Lord, the Supremely Powerful Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਡਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape aap sujaan hai vad purakh vadaatee ||
english: You Yourself are All-knowing. O Lord, You are the Greatest of the Great!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਚਿਆ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo man chit tudh dhiaaide mere sachiaa bal bal hau tin jaatee ||1||
english: O my True Lord, I am a sacrifice, a humble sacrifice, to those who meditate on You within their conscious mind. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਰਖਿਆ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jeeu paai tan saajiaa rakhiaa banat banaai ||
english: He placed the soul in the body which He had fashioned. He protects the Creation which He has created.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: akhee dekhai jihavaa bolai ka(n)nee surat samaai ||
english: With their eyes, they see, and with their tongues, they speak; with their ears, they bring the mind to awareness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਚਲੈ ਹਥੀ ਕਰਣਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pairee chalai hathee karanaa ditaa painai khaai ||
english: With their feet, they walk, and with their hands, they work; they wear and eat whatever is given.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jin rach rachiaa tisahi na jaanai a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamaai ||
english: They do not know the One who created the Creation. The blind fools do their dark deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਭਜੈ ਤਾ ਠੀਕਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾੜਤ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa bhajai taa theekar hovai ghaaRat ghaRee na jaai ||
english: When the pitcher of the body breaks and shatters into pieces, it cannot be re-created again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak gur bin naahi pat pat vin paar na paai ||1||
english: O Nanak, without the Guru, there is no honor; without honor, no one is carried across. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਂਦੇ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਚੰਗਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਐਸਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: de(n)de thaavahu ditaa cha(n)gaa manamukh aisaa jaaneeai ||
english: They prefer the gift, instead of the Giver; such is the way of the self-willed manmukhs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: surat mat chaturaaee taa kee kiaa kar aakh vakhaaneeai ||
english: What can anyone say about their intelligence, their understanding or their cleverness?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਹਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar bahi kai karam kamaavai so chahu ku(n)dee jaaneeai ||
english: The deeds which one commits, while sitting in one's own home, are known far and wide, in the four directions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਨਾਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਪਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jo dharam kamaavai tis dharam naau hovai paap kamaanai paapee jaaneeai ||
english: One who lives righteously is known as righteous; one who commits sins is known as a sinner.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape khel karahi sabh karate kiaa doojaa aakh vakhaaneeai ||
english: You Yourself enact the entire play, O Creator. Why should we speak of any other?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂੰ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿਹੁ ਦਿਖਾ ਸਿਆਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jichar teree jot tichar jotee vich too(n) bolahi vin jotee koee kichh karihu dikhaa siaaneeai ||
english: As long as Your Light is within the body, You speak through that Light. Without Your Light, who can do anything? Show me any such cleverness!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੀਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh nadaree aaiaa har iko sughaR sujaaneeai ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Lord alone is Perfect and All-knowing; He is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape jagat upaai kai tudh aape dha(n)dhai laaiaa ||
english: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself put it to work.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: moh thagaulee paai kai tudh aapahu jagat khuaaiaa ||
english: Administering the drug of emotional attachment, You Yourself have led the world astray.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਹੈ ਨਹ ਤਿਪਤੈ ਭੁਖਾ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tisanaa a(n)dar agan hai nah tipatai bhukhaa tihaaiaa ||
english: The fire of desire is deep within; unsatisfied, people remain hungry and thirsty.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sahasaa ihu sa(n)saar hai mar ja(n)mai aaiaa jaaiaa ||
english: This world is an illusion; it dies and it is re-born-it comes and it goes in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਸਭਿ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur mohu na tutaee sabh thake karam kamaaiaa ||
english: Without the True Guru, emotional attachment is not broken. All have grown weary of performing empty rituals.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੁਖਿ ਰਜਾ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramatee naam dhiaaeeai sukh rajaa jaa tudh bhaaiaa ||
english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Filled with a joyful peace, they surrender to Your Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kul udhaare aapanaa dha(n)n janedee maaiaa ||
english: They save their families and ancestors; blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sobhaa surat suhaavanee jin har setee chit laaiaa ||2||
english: Beautiful and sublime is the glory and the understanding of those who focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਕੰਨਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ॥
transliteration: akhee baajhahu vekhanaa vin ka(n)naa sunanaa ||
english: To see without eyes; to hear without ears;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੈਰਾ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਚਲਣਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਹਥਾ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: pairaa baajhahu chalanaa vin hathaa karanaa ||
english: to walk without feet; to work without hands;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਭੈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਇਉ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jeebhai baajhahu bolanaa iu jeevat maranaa ||
english: to speak without a tongue-like this, one remains dead while yet alive.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਕੈ ਤਉ ਖਸਮੈ ਮਿਲਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak hukam pachhaan kai tau khasamai milanaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and merge with your Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਸੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: disai suneeai jaaneeai saau na paaiaa jaai ||
english: He is seen, heard and known, but His subtle essence is not obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੁਹਲਾ ਟੁੰਡਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਕਿਉ ਗਲਿ ਲਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ruhalaa tu(n)daa a(n)dhulaa kiu gal lagai dhaai ||
english: How can the lame, armless and blind person run to embrace the Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਭਾਵ ਕੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: bhai ke charan kar bhaav ke loin surat karei ||
english: Let the Fear of God be your feet, and let His Love be your hands; let His Understanding be your eyes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਿਆਣੀਏ ਇਵ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kahai siaaneee iv ka(n)t milaavaa hoi ||2||
english: Says Nanak, in this way, O wise soul-bride, you shall be united with your Husband Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa too(n) ek hai tudh doojaa khel rachaaiaa ||
english: Forever and ever, You are the only One; You set the play of duality in motion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੰਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai garab upaai kai lobh a(n)tar ja(n)taa paaiaa ||
english: You created egotism and arrogant pride, and You placed greed within our beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu rakh too sabh kare teraa karaaiaa ||
english: Keep me as it pleases Your Will; everyone acts as You cause them to act.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਬਖਸਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa bakhasahi mel laihi guramatee tudhai laaiaa ||
english: Some are forgiven, and merge with You; through the Guru's Teachings, we are joined to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਖੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ik khaRe karahi teree chaakaree vin naavai hor na bhaaiaa ||
english: Some stand and serve You; without the Name, nothing else pleases them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਾਰ ਵੇਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਇਕਿ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hor kaar vekaar hai ik sachee kaarai laaiaa ||
english: Any other task would be worthless to them-You have enjoined them to Your True Service.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ ਇਕਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: put kalat kuta(n)b hai ik alipat rahe jo tudh bhaaiaa ||
english: In the midst of children, spouse and relations, some still remain detached; they are pleasing to Your Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹਿ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ohi a(n)darahu baaharahu niramale sachai naai samaaiaa ||3||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, they are pure, and they are absorbed in the True Name. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕੈ ਪਰਬਤਿ ਗੁਫਾ ਕਰੀ ਕੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
transliteration: suine kai parabat guphaa karee kai paanee paiaal ||
english: I may make a cave, in a mountain of gold, or in the water of the nether regions;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਕੈ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਉਰਧਿ ਰਹਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kai vich dharatee kai aakaasee uradh rahaa sir bhaar ||
english: I may remain standing on my head, upside-down, on the earth or up in the sky;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਪੜੁ ਪਹਿਰਾ ਧੋਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: pur kar kaaiaa kapaR pahiraa dhovaa sadaa kaar ||
english: I may totally cover my body with clothes, and wash them continually;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਗਾ ਰਤਾ ਪੀਅਲਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਬੇਦਾ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bagaa rataa peealaa kaalaa bedaa karee pukaar ||
english: I may shout out loud, the white, red, yellow and black Vedas;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕੁਚੀਲੁ ਰਹਾ ਮਲੁ ਧਾਰੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hoi kucheel rahaa mal dhaaree duramat mat vikaar ||
english: I may even live in dirt and filth. And yet, all this is just a product of evil-mindedness, and intellectual corruption.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਨਾ ਹਉ ਹੋਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naa hau naa mai naa hau hovaa naanak sabad veechaar ||1||
english: I was not, I am not, and I will never be anything at all! O Nanak, I dwell only on the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਖਾਲਿ ਪਖਾਲੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: vasatr pakhaal pakhaale kaaiaa aape sa(n)jam hovai ||
english: They wash their clothes, and scrub their bodies, and try to practice self-discipline.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਗੀ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar mail lagee nahee jaanai baaharahu mal mal dhovai ||
english: But they are not aware of the filth staining their inner being, while they try and try to wash off the outer dirt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਇਆ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhaa bhool paiaa jam jaale ||
english: The blind go astray, caught by the noose of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: vasat paraaee apunee kar jaanai haumai vich dukh ghaale ||
english: They see other people's property as their own, and in egotism, they suffer in pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh haumai tutai taa har har naam dhiaavai ||
english: O Nanak, the egotism of the Gurmukhs is broken, and then, they meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam jape naamo aaraadhe naame sukh samaavai ||2||
english: They chant the Naam, meditate on the Naam, and through the Naam, they are absorbed in peace. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pavaRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa ha(n)s sa(n)jog mel milaaiaa ||
english: Destiny has brought together and united the body and the soul-swan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tin hee keeaa vijog jin upaaiaa ||
english: He who created them, also separates them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗੁ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: moorakh bhoge bhog dukh sabaaiaa ||
english: The fools enjoy their pleasures; they must also endure all their pains.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਹੁ ਉਠੇ ਰੋਗ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sukhahu uthe rog paap kamaaiaa ||
english: From pleasures, arise diseases and the commission of sins.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: harakhahu sog vijog upaai khapaaiaa ||
english: From sinful pleasures come sorrow, separation, birth and death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਇ ਝਗੜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: moorakh ganat ganaai jhagaRaa paaiaa ||
english: The fools try to account for their misdeeds, and argue uselessly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਝਗੜੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur hath nibeR jhagaR chukaaiaa ||
english: The judgement is in the Hands of the True Guru, who puts an end to the argument.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: karataa kare s hog na chalai chalaaiaa ||4||
english: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. It cannot be changed by anyone's efforts. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kooR bol muradaar khaai ||
english: Telling lies, they eat dead bodies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੀ ਨੋ ਸਮਝਾਵਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: avaree no samajhaavan jaai ||
english: And yet, they go out to teach others.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਹਾਏ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
transliteration: muthaa aap muhaae saathai ||
english: They are deceived, and they deceive their companions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਆਗੂ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak aisaa aagoo jaapai ||1||
english: O Nanak, such are the leaders of men. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis dai a(n)dar sach hai so sachaa naam mukh sach alaae ||
english: Those, within whom the Truth dwells, obtain the True Name; they speak only the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਦਾ ਹੋਰਨਾ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ohu har maarag aap chaladaa horanaa no har maarag paae ||
english: They walk on the Lord's Path, and inspire others to walk on the Lord's Path as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਅਗੈ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਹੈ ਛਪੜਿ ਨਾਤੈ ਸਗਵੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: je agai teerath hoi taa mal lahai chhapaR naatai sagavee mal laae ||
english: Bathing in a pool of holy water, they are washed clean of filth. But, by bathing in a stagnant pond, they are contaminated with even more filth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: teerath pooraa satiguroo jo anadin har har naam dhiaae ||
english: The True Guru is the Perfect Pool of Holy Water. Night and day, He meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ohu aap chhutaa kuta(n)b siu de har har naam sabh srisat chhadaae ||
english: He is saved, along with his family; bestowing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, He saves the whole world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜੋ ਆਪਿ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak tis balihaaranai jo aap japai avaraa naam japaae ||2||
english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to one who himself chants the Naam, and inspires others to chant it as well. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: ik ka(n)d mool chun khaahi van kha(n)d vaasaa ||
english: Some pick and eat fruits and roots, and live in the wilderness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭਗਵਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: ik bhagavaa ves kar phirahi jogee sa(n)niaasaa ||
english: Some wander around wearing saffron robes, as Yogis and Sanyaasees.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar trisanaa bahut chhaadan bhojan kee aasaa ||
english: But there is still so much desire within them-they still yearn for clothes and food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਨ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: birathaa janam gavaai na girahee na udaasaa ||
english: They waste their lives uselessly; they are neither householders nor renunciates.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਹੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਨਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jamakaal sirahu na utarai tribidh manasaa ||
english: The Messenger of Death hangs over their heads, and they cannot escape the three-phased desire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: guramatee kaal na aavai neRai jaa hovai daasan daasaa ||
english: Death does not even approach those who follow the Guru's Teachings, and become the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa sabad sach man ghar hee maahi udaasaa ||
english: The True Word of the Shabad abides in their true minds; within the home of their own inner beings, they remain detached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak satigur sevan aapanaa se aasaa te niraasaa ||5||
english: O Nanak, those who serve their True Guru, rise from desire to desirelessness. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਰਤੁ ਲਗੈ ਕਪੜੈ ਜਾਮਾ ਹੋਇ ਪਲੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: je rat lagai kapaRai jaamaa hoi paleet ||
english: If one's clothes are stained with blood, the garment becomes polluted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਰਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਮਾਣਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਉ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jo rat peevahi maanasaa tin kiu niramal cheet ||
english: Those who suck the blood of human beings-how can their consciousness be pure?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਉ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਕਾ ਦਿਲਿ ਹਛੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak naau khudaai kaa dil hachhai mukh lehu ||
english: O Nanak, chant the Name of God, with heart-felt devotion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਦਿਵਾਜੇ ਦੁਨੀ ਕੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਅਮਲ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: avar divaaje dunee ke jhoothe amal karehu ||1||
english: Everything else is just a pompous worldly show, and the practice of false deeds. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਾ ਕਿਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa hau naahee taa kiaa aakhaa kihu naahee kiaa hovaa ||
english: Since I am no one, what can I say? Since I am nothing, what can I be?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਕਥਨਾ ਭਰਿਆ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਧੋਵਾਂ ॥
transliteration: keetaa karanaa kahiaa kathanaa bhariaa bhar bhar dhovaa(n) ||
english: As He created me, so I act. As He causes me to speak, so I speak. I am full and overflowing with sins-if only I could wash them away!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬੁਝਾ ਲੋਕ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਐਸਾ ਆਗੂ ਹੋਵਾਂ ॥
transliteration: aap na bujhaa lok bujhaaee aisaa aagoo hovaa(n) ||
english: I do not understand myself, and yet I try to teach others. Such is the guide I am!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਦਸੇ ਰਾਹੈ ਸਭਸੁ ਮੁਹਾਏ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
transliteration: naanak a(n)dhaa hoi kai dase raahai sabhas muhaae saathai ||
english: O Nanak, the one who is blind shows others the way, and misleads all his companions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਹਿ ਸੁ ਐਸਾ ਆਗੂ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: agai gaiaa muhe muhi paahi s aisaa aagoo jaapai ||2||
english: But, going to the world hereafter, he shall be beaten and kicked in the face; then, it will be obvious, what sort of guide he was! ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਹਾ ਰੁਤੀ ਸਭ ਤੂੰ ਘੜੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maahaa rutee sabh too(n) ghaRee moorat veechaaraa ||
english: Through all the months and the seasons, the minutes and the hours, I dwell upon You, O Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਗਣਤੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) ganatai kinai na paaio sache alakh apaaraa ||
english: No one has attained You by clever calculations, O True, Unseen and Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿਆ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: paRiaa moorakh aakheeai jis lab lobh aha(n)kaaraa ||
english: That scholar who is full of greed, arrogant pride and egotism, is known to be a fool.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਪੜੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naau paReeai naau bujheeai guramatee veechaaraa ||
english: So read the Name, and realize the Name, and contemplate the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramatee naam dhan khatiaa bhagatee bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I have earned the wealth of the Naam; I possess the storehouses, overflowing with devotion to the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: niramal naam ma(n)niaa dar sachai sachiaaraa ||
english: Believing in the Immaculate Naam, one is hailed as true, in the True Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis daa jeeu paraan hai a(n)tar jot apaaraa ||
english: The Divine Light of the Infinite Lord, who owns the soul and the breath of life, is deep within the inner being.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sachaa saahu ik too(n) hor jagat vanajaaraa ||6||
english: You alone are the True Banker, O Lord; the rest of the world is just Your petty trader. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਸਿਦਕੁ ਮੁਸਲਾ ਹਕੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: mihar maseet sidak musalaa hak halaal kuraan ||
english: Let mercy be your mosque, faith your prayer-mat, and honest living your Koran.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਮ ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਰੋਜਾ ਹੋਹੁ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: saram su(n)nat seel rojaa hohu musalamaan ||
english: Make modesty your circumcision, and good conduct your fast. In this way, you shall be a true Muslim.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਬਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੀਰੁ ਕਲਮਾ ਕਰਮ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥
transliteration: karanee kaabaa sach peer kalamaa karam nivaaj ||
english: Let good conduct be your Kaabaa, Truth your spiritual guide, and the karma of good deeds your prayer and chant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਸਬੀ ਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਖੈ ਲਾਜ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tasabee saa tis bhaavasee naanak rakhai laaj ||1||
english: Let your rosary be that which is pleasing to His Will. O Nanak, God shall preserve your honor. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਕੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਉਸੁ ਸੂਅਰ ਉਸੁ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hak paraaiaa naanakaa us sooar us gaai ||
english: : To take what rightfully belongs to another, is like a Muslim eating pork, or a Hindu eating beef.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ਹਾਮਾ ਤਾ ਭਰੇ ਜਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur peer haamaa taa bhare jaa muradaar na khaai ||
english: Our Guru, our Spiritual Guide, stands by us, if we do not eat those carcasses.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਲੀ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਛੁਟੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: galee bhisat na jaaeeai chhutai sach kamaai ||
english: By mere talk, people do not earn passage to Heaven. Salvation comes only from the practice of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਣ ਪਾਹਿ ਹਰਾਮ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maaran paahi haraam mahi hoi halaal na jaai ||
english: By adding spices to forbidden foods, they are not made acceptable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਲੀ ਕੂੜੀਈ ਕੂੜੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak galee kooReeee kooRo palai paai ||2||
english: O Nanak, from false talk, only falsehood is obtained. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ਵਖਤ ਪੰਜਿ ਪੰਜਾ ਪੰਜੇ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)j nivaajaa vakhat pa(n)j pa(n)jaa pa(n)je naau ||
english: There are five prayers and five times of day for prayer; the five have five names.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਹਲਾਲ ਦੁਇ ਤੀਜਾ ਖੈਰ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pahilaa sach halaal dui teejaa khair khudaai ||
english: Let the first be truthfulness, the second honest living, and the third charity in the Name of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੀ ਨੀਅਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਜਵੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chauthee neeat raas man pa(n)javee siphat sanaai ||
english: Let the fourth be good will to all, and the fifth the praise of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਲਮਾ ਆਖਿ ਕੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਸਦਾਇ ॥
transliteration: karanee kalamaa aakh kai taa musalamaan sadaai ||
english: Repeat the prayer of good deeds, and then, you may call yourself a Muslim.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇਤੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak jete kooRiaar kooRai kooRee paai ||3||
english: O Nanak, the false obtain falsehood, and only falsehood. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਵਣਜਦੇ ਇਕਿ ਕਚੈ ਦੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ik ratan padaarath vanajade ik kachai de vaapaaraa ||
english: Some trade in priceless jewels, while others deal in mere glass.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur tuthai paaeean a(n)dar ratan bha(n)daaraa ||
english: When the True Guru is pleased, we find the treasure of the jewel, deep within the self.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਲਧਿਆ ਅੰਧੇ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: vin gur kinai na ladhiaa a(n)dhe bhauk mue kooRiaaraa ||
english: Without the Guru, no one has found this treasure. The blind and the false have died in their endless wanderings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh doojai pach mue naa boojhahi veechaaraa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs putrefy and die in duality. They do not understand contemplative meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ikas baajhahu doojaa ko nahee kis agai karahi pukaaraa ||
english: Without the One Lord, there is no other at all. Unto whom should they complain?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਸਦਾ ਭਉਕਦੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਭਰੇ ਤੁਜਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ik niradhan sadaa bhaukade ikanaa bhare tujaaraa ||
english: Some are destitute, and wander around endlessly, while others have storehouses of wealth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai hor dhan naahee hor bikhiaa sabh chhaaraa ||
english: Without God's Name, there is no other wealth. Everything else is just poison and ashes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak aap karaae kare aap hukam savaaranahaaraa ||7||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself acts, and causes others to act; by the Hukam of His Command, we are embellished and exalted. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵਣੁ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: musalamaan kahaavan musakal jaa hoi taa musalamaan kahaavai ||
english: It is difficult to be called a Muslim; if one is truly a Muslim, then he may be called one.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਲਿ ਅਉਲਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਮਸਕਲ ਮਾਨਾ ਮਾਲੁ ਮੁਸਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aval aul deen kar mithaa masakal maanaa maal musaavai ||
english: First, let him savor the religion of the Prophet as sweet; then, let his pride of his possessions be scraped away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਮੁਸਲਿਮੁ ਦੀਨ ਮੁਹਾਣੈ ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hoi musalim deen muhaanai maran jeevan kaa bharam chukaavai ||
english: Becoming a true Muslim, a disciple of the faith of Mohammed, let him put aside the delusion of death and life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਬ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਿਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: rab kee rajaai ma(n)ne sir upar karataa ma(n)ne aap gavaavai ||
english: As he submits to God's Will, and surrenders to the Creator, he is rid of selfishness and conceit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਮਿਹਰੰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tau naanak sarab jeeaa mihara(n)mat hoi ta musalamaan kahaavai ||1||
english: And when, O Nanak, he is merciful to all beings, only then shall he be called a Muslim. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: parahar kaam krodh jhooth ni(n)daa taj maaiaa aha(n)kaar chukaavai ||
english: Renounce sexual desire, anger, falsehood and slander; forsake Maya and eliminate egotistical pride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਜੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: taj kaam kaaminee mohu tajai taa a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan paavai ||
english: Renounce sexual desire and promiscuity, and give up emotional attachment. Only then shall you obtain the Immaculate Lord amidst the darkness of the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਤਜਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਆਸ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: taj maan abhimaan preet sut daaraa taj piaas aas raam liv laavai ||
english: Renounce selfishness, conceit and arrogant pride, and your love for your children and spouse. Abandon your thirsty hopes and desires, and embrace love for the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saachaa man vasai saach sabad har naam samaavai ||2||
english: O Nanak, the True One shall come to dwell in your mind. Through the True Word of the Shabad, you shall be absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੇ ਰਯਤਿ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਹਸੀਓ ॥
transliteration: raaje rayat sikadaar koi na rahaseeo ||
english: Neither the kings, nor their subjects, nor the leaders shall remain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਢਹਸੀਓ ॥
transliteration: hat patan baajaar hukamee dhahaseeo ||
english: The shops, the cities and the streets shall eventually disintegrate, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਕੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
transliteration: pake ba(n)k duaar moorakh jaanai aapane ||
english: Those solid and beautiful mansions-the fools think that they belong to them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਬਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਰੀਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਖਣੇ ॥
transliteration: darab bhare bha(n)daar reete ik khane ||
english: The treasure-houses, filled with wealth, shall be emptied out in an instant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾਜੀ ਰਥ ਤੁਖਾਰ ਹਾਥੀ ਪਾਖਰੇ ॥
transliteration: taajee rath tukhaar haathee paakhare ||
english: The horses, chariots, camels and elephants, with all their decorations;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਗ ਮਿਲਖ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ਕਿਥੈ ਸਿ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
transliteration: baag milakh ghar baar kithai s aapane ||
english: the gardens, lands, houses, tents, soft beds and satin pavilions -

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੰਬੂ ਪਲੰਘ ਨਿਵਾਰ ਸਰਾਇਚੇ ਲਾਲਤੀ ॥
transliteration: ta(n)boo pala(n)gh nivaar saraaiche laalatee ||
english: Oh, where are those things, which they believe to be their own?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਿਨਾਖਤੁ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak sach daataar sinaakhat kudaratee ||8||
english: O Nanak, the True One is the Giver of all; He is revealed through His All-powerful Creative Nature. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦੀਆ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਧੇਣਵਾ ਸੁੰਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦੁਧੁ ਘੀਉ ॥
transliteration: nadeeaa hovahi dhenavaa su(n)m hovahi dudh gheeu ||
english: If the rivers became cows, giving milk, and the spring water became milk and ghee;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਕਰ ਹੋਵੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sagalee dharatee sakar hovai khusee kare nit jeeu ||
english: If all the earth became sugar, to continually excite the mind;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਬਤੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: parabat suinaa rupaa hovai heere laal jaRaau ||
english: if the mountains became gold and silver, studded with gems and jewels

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhee too(n)hai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau ||1||
english: -even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮੇਵਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਰੁੜਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaar athaarah mevaa hovai garuRaa hoi suaau ||
english: If all the eighteen loads of vegetation became fruits,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)d sooraj dui phirade rakheeahi nihachal hovai thaau ||
english: and the growing grass became sweet rice; if I were able to stop the sun and the moon in their orbits and hold them perfectly steady

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhee too(n)hai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau ||2||
english: -even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਦੇਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਪਾਪ ਗਰਹ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: je dehai dukh laaeeai paap garah dui raahu ||
english: If my body were afflicted with pain, under the evil influence of unlucky stars;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਤੁ ਪੀਣੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਸਿਰੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਪੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rat peene raaje sirai upar rakheeahi evai jaapai bhaau ||
english: and if the blood-sucking kings were to hold power over me

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhee too(n)hai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau ||3||
english: -even if this were my condition, I would still worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੀ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਖਾਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਉ ॥
transliteration: agee paalaa kapaR hovai khaanaa hovai vaau ||
english: If fire and ice were my clothes, and the wind was my food;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਗੈ ਦੀਆ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੋ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: suragai deeaa mohaneeaa isatareeaa hovan naanak sabho jaau ||
english: and even if the enticing heavenly beauties were my wives, O Nanak-all this shall pass away!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bhee toohai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau ||4||
english: Even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pavaRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਦਫੈਲੀ ਗੈਬਾਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ॥
transliteration: badaphailee gaibaanaa khasam na jaanaee ||
english: The foolish demon, who does evil deeds, does not know his Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ॥
transliteration: so kaheeai devaanaa aap na pachhaanaee ||
english: Call him a mad-man, if he does not understand himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਹਿ ਬੁਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਵਾਦੇ ਖਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kalahi buree sa(n)saar vaade khapeeai ||
english: The strife of this world is evil; these struggles are consuming it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਵੇਕਾਰਿ ਭਰਮੇ ਪਚੀਐ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai vekaar bharame pacheeai ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, life is worthless. Through doubt, the people are being destroyed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਹ ਦੋਵੈ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਸਿਝਸੀ ॥
transliteration: raah dovai ik jaanai soee sijhasee ||
english: One who recognizes that all spiritual paths lead to the One shall be emancipated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਫਰ ਗੋਅ ਕੁਫਰਾਣੈ ਪਇਆ ਦਝਸੀ ॥
transliteration: kuphar go kupharaanai paiaa dajhasee ||
english: One who speaks lies shall fall into hell and burn.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੁਬਹਾਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sabh duneeaa subahaan sach samaaeeai ||
english: In all the world, the most blessed and sanctified are those who remain absorbed in Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਝੈ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਵਾਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
transliteration: sijhai dar deevaan aap gavaaeeai ||9||
english: One who eliminates selfishness and conceit is redeemed in the Court of the Lord. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਃ ੧ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: mah 1 salok ||
english: First Mehl, Salok:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: so jeeviaa jis man vasiaa soi ||
english: They alone are truly alive, whose minds are filled with the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak avar na jeevai koi ||
english: O Nanak, no one else is truly alive;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜੀਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਲਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je jeevai pat lathee jaai ||
english: those who merely live shall depart in dishonor;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਹਰਾਮੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh haraam jetaa kichh khaai ||
english: everything they eat is impure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਲਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: raaj ra(n)g maal ra(n)g ||
english: Intoxicated with power and thrilled with wealth,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਨਚੈ ਨੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g rataa nachai na(n)g ||
english: They delight in their pleasures, and dance about shamelessly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਗਿਆ ਮੁਠਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak thagiaa muthaa jaai ||
english: O Nanak, they are deluded and defrauded.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vin naavai pat gaiaa gavaai ||1||
english: Without the Lord's Name, they lose their honor and depart. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਖਾਧੈ ਕਿਆ ਪੈਧੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kiaa khaadhai kiaa paidhai hoi ||
english: What good is food, and what good are clothes,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa man naahee sachaa soi ||
english: if the True Lord does not abide within the mind?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮੇਵਾ ਕਿਆ ਘਿਉ ਗੁੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੈਦਾ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: kiaa mevaa kiaa ghiu guR mithaa kiaa maidaa kiaa maas ||
english: What good are fruits, what good is ghee, sweet jaggery, what good is flour, and what good is meat?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਪੜੁ ਕਿਆ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਕੀਜਹਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸ ॥
transliteration: kiaa kapaR kiaa sej sukhaalee keejahi bhog bilaas ||
english: What good are clothes, and what good is a soft bed, to enjoy pleasures and sensual delights?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਲਸਕਰ ਕਿਆ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸੀ ਆਵੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: kiaa lasakar kiaa neb khavaasee aavai mahalee vaas ||
english: What good is an army, and what good are soldiers, servants and mansions to live in?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਭੇ ਟੋਲ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sache naam vin sabhe tol vinaas ||2||
english: O Nanak, without the True Name, all this paraphernalia shall disappear. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pavaRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤੀ ਦੈ ਕਿਆ ਹਥਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਖੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jaatee dai kiaa hath sach parakheeai ||
english: What good is social class and status? Truthfulness is measured within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹੁਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਥਿ ਮਰੀਐ ਚਖੀਐ ॥
transliteration: mahuraa hovai hath mareeai chakheeai ||
english: Pride in one's status is like poison-holding it in your hand and eating it, you shall die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sache kee sirakaar jug jug jaaneeai ||
english: The True Lord's Sovereign Rule is known throughout the ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਿਰਦਾਰੁ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: hukam ma(n)ne siradaar dar deebaaneeai ||
