english: One who respects the Hukam of the Lord's Command is honored and respected in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫੁਰਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ਕਾਰ ਖਸਮਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: phuramaanee hai kaar khasam pathaaiaa ||
english: By the Order of our Lord and Master, we have been brought into this world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਬਲਬਾਜ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tabalabaaj beechaar sabad sunaaiaa ||
english: The Drummer, the Guru, has announced the Lord's meditation, through the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਹੋਏ ਅਸਵਾਰ ਇਕਨਾ ਸਾਖਤੀ ॥
transliteration: ik hoe asavaar ikanaa saakhatee ||
english: Some have mounted their horses in response, and others are saddling up.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੀ ਬਧੇ ਭਾਰ ਇਕਨਾ ਤਾਖਤੀ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: ikanee badhe bhaar ikanaa taakhatee ||10||
english: Some have tied up their bridles, and others have already ridden off. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਪਕਾ ਤਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਰਹੀ ਸੁ ਪਲਰਿ ਵਾੜਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa pakaa taa katiaa rahee s palar vaaR ||
english: When the crop is ripe, then it is cut down; only the stalks are left standing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਣੁ ਕੀਸਾਰਾ ਚਿਥਿਆ ਕਣੁ ਲਇਆ ਤਨੁ ਝਾੜਿ ॥
transliteration: san keesaaraa chithiaa kan laiaa tan jhaaR ||
english: The corn on the cob is put into the thresher, and the kernels are separated from the cobs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਪੁੜ ਚਕੀ ਜੋੜਿ ਕੈ ਪੀਸਣ ਆਇ ਬਹਿਠੁ ॥
transliteration: dui puR chakee joR kai peesan aai bahith ||
english: Placing the kernels between the two mill-stones, people sit and grind the corn.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸੁ ਉਬਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਜਬੁ ਡਿਠੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo dar rahe s ubare naanak ajab dith ||1||
english: Those kernels which stick to the central axle are spared-Nanak has seen this wonderful vision! ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਖੁ ਜਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਕਟਿ ਕੁਟਿ ਬਧਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vekh j mithaa katiaa kat kut badhaa paai ||
english: Look, and see how the sugar-cane is cut down. After cutting away its branches, its feet are bound together into bundles,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੁੰਢਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਕੈ ਦੇਨਿ ਸੁ ਮਲ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khu(n)dhaa a(n)dar rakh kai den s mal sajaai ||
english: and then, it is placed between the wooden rollers and crushed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸੁ ਕਸੁ ਟਟਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਪੈ ਤੈ ਵਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ras kas tatar paaeeai tapai tai vilalaai ||
english: What punishment is inflicted upon it! Its juice is extracted and placed in the cauldron; as it is heated, it groans and cries out.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਸੋ ਫੋਗੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਦਿਚੈ ਅਗਿ ਜਾਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhee so phog samaaleeai dichai ag jaalaai ||
english: And then, the crushed cane is collected and burnt in the fire below.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਠੈ ਪਤਰੀਐ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak mithai patareeai vekhahu lokaa aai ||2||
english: Nanak: come, people, and see how the sweet sugar-cane is treated! ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pavaRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਸ ਘਣੇਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa maran na chit aas ghaneriaa ||
english: Some do not think of death; they entertain great hopes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਕੇਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mahi nit kisai na keriaa ||
english: They die, and are re-born, and die, over and over again. They are of no use at all!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹਨਿ ਚੰਗੇਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aapanaRai man chit kahan cha(n)geriaa ||
english: In their conscious minds, they call themselves good.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮਰਾਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੇਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jamaraajai nit nit manamukh heriaa ||
english: The King of the Angels of Death hunts down those self-willed manmukhs, over and over again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਲੂਣ ਹਾਰਾਮ ਕਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh loon haaraam kiaa na jaaniaa ||
english: The manmukhs are false to their own selves; they feel no gratitude for what they have been given.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਧੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਸਲਾਮ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: badhe karan salaam khasam na bhaaniaa ||
english: Those who merely perform rituals of worship are not pleasing to their Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
transliteration: sach milai mukh naam saahib bhaavasee ||
english: Those who attain the True Lord and chant His Name are pleasing to the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਸਨਿ ਤਖਤਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਵਸੀ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: karasan takhat salaam likhiaa paavasee ||11||
english: They worship the Lord and bow at His Throne. They fulfill their pre-ordained destiny. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਃ ੧ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: mah 1 salok ||
english: First Mehl, Salok:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਛੀ ਤਾਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਪੰਖੀ ਕਿਆ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: machhee taaroo kiaa kare pa(n)khee kiaa aakaas ||
english: What can deep water do to a fish? What can the vast sky do to a bird?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਥਰ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਸਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: pathar paalaa kiaa kare khusare kiaa ghar vaas ||
english: What can cold do to a stone? What is married life to a eunuch?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਤੇ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਭੀ ਸੋ ਕੁਤੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kute cha(n)dan laaeeai bhee so kutee dhaat ||
english: You may apply sandalwood oil to a dog, but he will still be a dog.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਾ ਜੇ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪਾਠ ॥
transliteration: bolaa je samajhaaeeai paReeahi si(n)mrit paath ||
english: You may try to teach a deaf person by reading the Simritees to him, but how will he learn?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਦੀਵੇ ਬਲਹਿ ਪਚਾਸ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhaa chaanan rakheeai deeve balahi pachaas ||
english: You may place a light before a blind man and burn fifty lamps, but how will he see?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਣੇ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਵੈ ਘਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: chaune suinaa paaeeai chun chun khaavai ghaas ||
english: You may place gold before a herd of cattle, but they will pick out the grass to eat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੋਹਾ ਮਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਢਹੈ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਕਪਾਸ ॥
transliteration: lohaa maaran paaeeai dhahai na hoi kapaas ||
english: You may add flux to iron and melt it, but it will not become soft like cotton.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੂਰਖ ਏਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak moorakh ehi gun bole sadaa vinaas ||1||
english: O Nanak, this is the nature of a fool-everything he speaks is useless and wasted. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੈਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kaihaa ka(n)chan tutai saar ||
english: When pieces of bronze or gold or iron break,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨੀ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਾਏ ਲੋਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aganee ga(n)dh paae lohaar ||
english: the metal-smith welds them together again in the fire, and the bond is established.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੋਰੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਤੁਟੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: goree setee tutai bhataar ||
english: If a husband leaves his wife,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤਂੀ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: puta(n)ee ga(n)dh pavai sa(n)saar ||
english: their children may bring them back together in the world, and the bond is established.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਿਤੈ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raajaa ma(n)gai ditai ga(n)dh paai ||
english: When the king makes a demand, and it is met, the bond is established.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਜਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhukhiaa ga(n)dh pavai jaa khaai ||
english: When the hungry man eats, he is satisfied, and the bond is established.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਨਦੀਆ ਮੀਹ ਝੋਲ ॥
transliteration: kaalaa ga(n)dh nadeeaa meeh jhol ||
english: In the famine, the rain fills the streams to overflowing, and the bond is established.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੰਢੁ ਪਰੀਤੀ ਮਿਠੇ ਬੋਲ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)dh pareetee mithe bol ||
english: There is a bond between love and words of sweetness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bedaa ga(n)dh bole sach koi ||
english: When one speaks the Truth, a bond is established with the Holy Scriptures.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਇਆ ਗੰਢੁ ਨੇਕੀ ਸਤੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: muiaa ga(n)dh nekee sat hoi ||
english: Through goodness and truth, the dead establish a bond with the living.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤੁ ਗੰਢਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: et ga(n)dh varatai sa(n)saar ||
english: Such are the bonds which prevail in the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਮਾਰ ॥
transliteration: moorakh ga(n)dh pavai muhi maar ||
english: The fool establishes his bonds only when he is slapped in the face.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak aakhai ehu beechaar ||
english: Nanak says this after deep reflection:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: siphatee ga(n)dh pavai darabaar ||2||
english: through the Lord's Praise, we establish a bond with His Court. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਕੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape kudarat saaj kai aape kare beechaar ||
english: He Himself created and adorned the Universe, and He Himself contemplates it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਇਕਿ ਖਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ik khote ik khare aape parakhanahaar ||
english: Some are counterfeit, and some are genuine. He Himself is the Appraiser.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਰੇ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਸਟੀਅਹਿ ਬਾਹਰ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: khare khajaanai paaeeahi khote sateeahi baahar vaar ||
english: The genuine are placed in His Treasury, while the counterfeit are thrown away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਟੀਅਹਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: khote sachee daragah suteeahi kis aagai karahi pukaar ||
english: The counterfeit are thrown out of the True Court-unto whom should they complain?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਿਛੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur pichhai bhaj pavahi ehaa karanee saar ||
english: They should worship and follow the True Guru-this is the lifestyle of excellence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਖੋਟਿਅਹੁ ਖਰੇ ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur khotiahu khare kare sabad savaaranahaar ||
english: The True Guru converts the counterfeit into genuine; through the Word of the Shabad, He embellishes and exalts us.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sachee daragah ma(n)neean gur kai prem piaar ||
english: Those who have enshrined love and affection for the Guru, are honored in the True Court.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਣਤ ਤਿਨਾ ਦੀ ਕੋ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਆਪਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: ganat tinaa dee ko kiaa kare jo aap bakhase karataar ||12||
english: Who can estimate the value of those who have been forgiven by the Creator Lord Himself? ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਜੇਰ ਜਿਮੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਪੀਰਾ ਮਸਾਇਕਾ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ham jer jimee duneeaa peeraa masaaikaa raaiaa ||
english: All the spiritual teachers, their disciples and the rulers of the world shall be buried under the ground.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇ ਰਵਦਿ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹਾ ਅਫਜੂ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
transliteration: me ravad baadisaahaa aphajoo khudaai ||
english: The emperors shall also pass away; God alone is Eternal.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਤੂਹੀ ਏਕ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek toohee ek tuhee ||1||
english: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵਾ ਨਰਾ ॥
transliteration: na dev daanavaa naraa ||
english: Neither the angels, nor the demons, nor human beings,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਧਰਾ ॥
transliteration: na sidh saadhikaa dharaa ||
english: Nor the Siddhas, nor the seekers shall remain on the earth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਤਿ ਏਕ ਦਿਗਰਿ ਕੁਈ ॥
transliteration: asat ek digar kuee ||
english: Who else is there?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ek tuee ek tuee ||2||
english: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਦਾਦੇ ਦਿਹੰਦ ਆਦਮੀ ॥
transliteration: na daade diha(n)d aadamee ||
english: Neither the just, nor the generous, nor any humans at all,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਸਪਤ ਜੇਰ ਜਿਮੀ ॥
transliteration: na sapat jer jimee ||
english: Nor the seven realms beneath the earth, shall remain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਤਿ ਏਕ ਦਿਗਰਿ ਕੁਈ ॥
transliteration: asat ek digar kuee ||
english: The One Lord alone exists. Who else is there?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ek tuee ek tuee ||3||
english: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਸੂਰ ਸਸਿ ਮੰਡਲੋ ॥
transliteration: na soor sas ma(n)dalo ||
english: Neither the sun, nor the moon, nor the planets,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਨਹ ਜਲੋ ॥
transliteration: na sapat deep nah jalo ||
english: Nor the seven continents, nor the oceans,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਨ ਪਉਣ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਕੁਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)n paun thir na kuee ||
english: Nor food, nor the wind-nothing is permanent.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਤੁਈ ਏਕੁ ਤੁਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ek tuee ek tuee ||4||
english: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦਸਤ ਆ ਕਸੇ ॥
transliteration: na rijak dasat aa kase ||
english: Our sustenance is not in the hands of any person.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮਾ ਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਆਸ ਵਸੇ ॥
transliteration: hamaa raa ek aas vase ||
english: The hopes of all rest in the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਤਿ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਗਰ ਕੁਈ ॥
transliteration: asat ek digar kuee ||
english: The One Lord alone exists-who else is there?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ਏਕੁ ਤੁਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ek tuee ek tuee ||5||
english: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰੰਦਏ ਨ ਗਿਰਾਹ ਜਰ ॥
transliteration: para(n)dae na giraah jar ||
english: The birds have no money in their pockets.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਖਤ ਆਬ ਆਸ ਕਰ ॥
transliteration: darakhat aab aas kar ||
english: They place their hopes on trees and water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਹੰਦ ਸੁਈ ॥
transliteration: diha(n)d suee ||
english: He alone is the Giver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ek tuee ek tuee ||6||
english: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਲਾਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak lilaar likhiaa soi ||
english: O Nanak, that destiny which is pre-ordained and written on one's forehead

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: met na saakai koi ||
english: no one can erase it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਾ ਧਰੈ ਹਿਰੈ ਸੁਈ ॥
transliteration: kalaa dharai hirai suee ||
english: The Lord infuses strength, and He takes it away again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਤੁਈ ਏਕੁ ਤੁਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ek tuee ek tuee ||7||
english: You alone, O Lord, You alone. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sachaa teraa hukam guramukh jaaniaa ||
english: True is the Hukam of Your Command. To the Gurmukh, it is known.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: guramatee aap gavaai sach pachhaaniaa ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, selfishness and conceit are eradicated, and the Truth is realized.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sach teraa darabaar sabad neesaaniaa ||
english: True is Your Court. It is proclaimed and revealed through the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sachaa sabad veechaar sach samaaniaa ||
english: Meditating deeply on the True Word of the Shabad, I have merged into the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sadaa kooRiaar bharam bhulaaniaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are always false; they are deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: visataa a(n)dar vaas saad na jaaniaa ||
english: They dwell in manure, and they do not know the taste of the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai dukh paai aavan jaaniaa ||
english: Without the Name, they suffer the agonies of coming and going.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak paarakh aap jin khotaa kharaa pachhaaniaa ||13||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself is the Appraiser, who distinguishes the counterfeit from the genuine. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੀਹਾ ਬਾਜਾ ਚਰਗਾ ਕੁਹੀਆ ਏਨਾ ਖਵਾਲੇ ਘਾਹ ॥
transliteration: seehaa baajaa charagaa kuheeaa enaa khavaale ghaah ||
english: Tigers, hawks, falcons and eagles-the Lord could make them eat grass.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਾਹੁ ਖਾਨਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਖਵਾਲੇ ਏਹਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਰਾਹ ॥
transliteration: ghaahu khaan tinaa maas khavaale ehi chalaae raah ||
english: And those animals which eat grass-He could make them eat meat. He could make them follow this way of life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਟਿਬੇ ਦੇਖਾਲੇ ਥਲੀ ਕਰੇ ਅਸਗਾਹ ॥
transliteration: nadeeaa vich tibe dekhaale thalee kare asagaah ||
english: He could raise dry land from the rivers, and turn the deserts into bottomless oceans.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀੜਾ ਥਾਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਲਸਕਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਆਹ ॥
transliteration: keeRaa thaap dei paatisaahee lasakar kare suaah ||
english: He could appoint a worm as king, and reduce an army to ashes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਲੈ ਸਾਹਾ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਤਾ ਕਿ ਅਸਾਹ ॥
transliteration: jete jee jeevahi lai saahaa jeevaale taa k asaah ||
english: All beings and creatures live by breathing, but He could keep us alive, even without the breath.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਦੇਇ ਗਿਰਾਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jiu jiu sache bhaavai tiu tiu dei giraah ||1||
english: O Nanak, as it pleases the True Lord, He gives us sustenance. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮਾਸਹਾਰੀ ਇਕਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik maasahaaree ik trin khaahi ||
english: Some eat meat, while others eat grass.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa chhateeh a(n)mrit paahi ||
english: Some have all the thirty-six varieties of delicacies,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮਿਟੀਆ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਟੀਆ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik miteeaa mahi miteeaa khaahi ||
english: while others live in the dirt and eat mud.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪਉਣ ਸੁਮਾਰੀ ਪਉਣ ਸੁਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ik paun sumaaree paun sumaar ||
english: Some control the breath, and regulate their breathing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਨਾਮ ਆਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ik nira(n)kaaree naam aadhaar ||
english: Some live by the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jeevai daataa marai na koi ||
english: The Great Giver lives; no one dies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਠੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak muthe jaahi naahee man soi ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who do not enshrine the Lord within their minds are deluded. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਮਿ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kee kaar karam kamaaeeai ||
english: By the karma of good actions, some come to serve the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: guramatee aap gavaai naam dhiaaeeai ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, some eliminate selfishness and conceit, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: doojee kaarai lag janam gavaaeeai ||
english: Undertaking any other task, they waste their lives in vain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਵਿਸੁ ਪੈਝੈ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai sabh vis paijhai khaaeeai ||
english: Without the Name, all that they wear and eat is poison.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sachaa sabad saalaahi sach samaaeeai ||
english: Praising the True Word of the Shabad, they merge with the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: vin satigur seve naahee sukh nivaas phir phir aaeeai ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, they do not obtain the home of peace; they are consigned to reincarnation, over and over again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: duneeaa khotee raas kooR kamaaeeai ||
english: Investing counterfeit capital, they earn only falsehood in the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak sach kharaa saalaahi pat siu jaaeeai ||14||
english: O Nanak, singing the Praises of the Pure, True Lord, they depart with honor. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਵਾਵਹਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tudh bhaavai taa vaavahi gaavahi tudh bhaavai jal naavahi ||
english: When it pleases You, we play music and sing; when it pleases You, we bathe in water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਾ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavahi taa karahi bibhootaa si(n)ngee naad vajaavahi ||
english: When it pleases You, we smear our bodies with ashes, and blow the horn and the conch shell.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਮੁਲਾ ਸੇਖ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai taa paRahi katebaa mulaa sekh kahaavahi ||
english: When it pleases You, we read the Islamic Scriptures, and are acclaimed as Mullahs and Shaykhs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai taa hovahi raaje ras kas bahut kamaavahi ||
english: When it pleases You, we become kings, and enjoy all sorts of tastes and pleasures.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਗ ਵਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਰ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai teg vagaavahi sir mu(n)dee kat jaavahi ||
english: When it pleases You, we wield the sword, and cut off the heads of our enemies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai jaahi disa(n)tar sun galaa ghar aavahi ||
english: When it pleases You, we go out to foreign lands; hearing news of home, we come back again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਇ ਰਚਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai naai rachaavahi tudh bhaane too(n) bhaavahi ||
english: When it pleases You, we are attuned to the Name, and when it pleases You, we become pleasing to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ek kahai bena(n)tee hor sagale kooR kamaavahi ||1||
english: Nanak utters this one prayer; everything else is just the practice of falsehood. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਵਡਾ ਸਭਿ ਵਡਿਆਂਈਆ ਚੰਗੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa too(n) vadaa sabh vadiaa(n)eeaa cha(n)gai cha(n)gaa hoee ||
english: You are so Great-all Greatness flows from You. You are So Good-Goodness radiates from You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਕੂੜਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa too(n) sachaa taa sabh ko sachaa kooRaa koi na koee ||
english: You are True-all that flows from You is True. Nothing at all is false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਚਲਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
transliteration: aakhan vekhan bolan chalan jeevan maranaa dhaat ||
english: Talking, seeing, speaking, walking, living and dying-all these are transitory.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hukam saaj hukamai vich rakhai naanak sachaa aap ||2||
english: By the Hukam of His Command, He creates, and in His Command, He keeps us. O Nanak, He Himself is True. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev nisa(n)g bharam chukaaeeai ||
english: Serve the True Guru fearlessly, and your doubt shall be dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੈ ਕਾਰ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur aakhai kaar s kaar kamaaeeai ||
english: Do that work which the True Guru asks you to do.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal ta naam dhiaaeeai ||
english: When the True Guru becomes merciful, we meditate on the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: laahaa bhagat s saar guramukh paaeeai ||
english: The profit of devotional worship is excellent. It is obtained by the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kooR gubaar kooR kamaaeeai ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are trapped in the darkness of falsehood; they practice nothing but falsehood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਦੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਚੁ ਚਵਾਂਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sache dai dar jaai sach chavaa(n)eeai ||
english: Go to the Gate of Truth, and speak the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sachai a(n)dar mahal sach bulaaeeai ||
english: The True Lord calls the true ones to the Mansion of His Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak sach sadaa sachiaar sach samaaeeai ||15||
english: O Nanak, the true ones are forever true; they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਾਤੀ ਰਾਜੇ ਕਾਸਾਈ ਧਰਮੁ ਪੰਖ ਕਰਿ ਉਡਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kal kaatee raaje kaasaaee dharam pa(n)kh kar udariaa ||
english: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the knife, and the kings are butchers; righteousness has sprouted wings and flown away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਅਮਾਵਸ ਸਚੁ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਹ ਚੜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kooR amaavas sach cha(n)dramaa deesai naahee kah chaRiaa ||
english: In this dark night of falsehood, the moon of Truth is not visible anywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਭਾਲਿ ਵਿਕੁੰਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: hau bhaal viku(n)nee hoee ||
english: I have searched in vain, and I am so confused;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਧੇਰੈ ਰਾਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aadherai raahu na koee ||
english: In this darkness, I cannot find the path.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਈ ॥
transliteration: vich haumai kar dukh roee ||
english: In egotism, they cry out in pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak kin bidh gat hoee ||1||
english: Says Nanak, how will they be saved? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kal keerat paragat chaanan sa(n)saar ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise has appeared as a Light in the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਉਤਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh koee utarai paar ||
english: How rare are those few Gurmukhs who swim across to the other side!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jis no nadar kare tis devai ||
english: The Lord bestows His Glance of Grace;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਸੋ ਲੇਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh ratan so levai ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh receives the jewel. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਤੈ ਸੈਸਾਰੀਆ ਜੋੜੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa tai saisaareeaa joR kade na aaiaa ||
english: Between the Lord's devotees and the people of the world, there can never be any true alliance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਹੈ ਨ ਭੁਲੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: karataa aap abhul hai na bhulai kisai daa bhulaaiaa ||
english: The Creator Himself is infallible. He cannot be fooled; no one can fool Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhagat aape melian jinee sacho sach kamaaiaa ||
english: He blends His devotees with Himself; they practice Truth, and only Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੈਸਾਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saisaaree aap khuaaian jinee kooR bol bol bikh khaaiaa ||
english: The Lord Himself leads the people of the world astray; they tell lies, and by telling lies, they eat poison.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਲਣ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਸੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: chalan saar na jaananee kaam karodh vis vadhaaiaa ||
english: They do not recognize the ultimate reality, that we all must go; they continue to cultivate the poisons of sexual desire and anger.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਕਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhagat karan har chaakaree jinee anadin naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: The devotees serve the Lord; night and day, they meditate on the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: daasan daas hoi kai jinee vichahu aap gavaaiaa ||
english: Becoming the slaves of the Lord's slaves, they eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: onaa khasamai kai dar mukh ujale sachai sabad suhaaiaa ||16||
english: In the Court of their Lord and Master, their faces are radiant; they are embellished and exalted with the True Word of the Shabad. ||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ॥
transliteration: sabaahee saalaah jinee dhiaaiaa ik man ||
english: Those who praise the Lord in the early hours of the morning and meditate on Him single-mindedly,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹ ਵਖਤੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਮੁਏ ॥
transliteration: seee poore saah vakhatai upar laR mue ||
english: are the perfect kings; at the right time, they die fighting.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਰਾਹ ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਮਤੀ ਖਿੰਡੀਆ ॥
transliteration: doojai bahute raah man keeaa matee khi(n)deeaa ||
english: In the second watch, the focus of the mind is scattered in all sorts of ways.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਏ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਗੋਤੇ ਖਾਹਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਲਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bahut pae asagaah gote khaahi na nikalahi ||
english: So many fall into the bottomless pit; they are dragged under, and they cannot get out again.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਤੀਜੈ ਮੁਹੀ ਗਿਰਾਹ ਭੁਖ ਤਿਖਾ ਦੁਇ ਭਉਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: teejai muhee giraah bhukh tikhaa dui bhaukeeaa ||
english: In the third watch, both hunger and thirst bark for attention, and food is put into the mouth.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਖਾਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਹ ਭੀ ਖਾਣੇ ਸਿਉ ਦੋਸਤੀ ॥
transliteration: khaadhaa hoi suaah bhee khaane siu dosatee ||
english: That which is eaten becomes dust, but they are still attached to eating.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੈ ਆਈ ਊਂਘ ਅਖੀ ਮੀਟਿ ਪਵਾਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: chauthai aaee oo(n)gh akhee meet pavaar gaiaa ||
english: In the fourth watch, they become drowsy. They close their eyes and begin to dream.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਉਠਿ ਰਚਿਓਨੁ ਵਾਦੁ ਸੈ ਵਰੑਿਆ ਕੀ ਪਿੜ ਬਧੀ ॥
transliteration: bhee uth rachion vaad sai varhiaa kee piR badhee ||
english: Rising up again, they engage in conflicts; they set the stage as if they will live for 100 years.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੇ ਅਠੀ ਭਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhe velaa vakhat sabh je athee bhau hoi ||
english: If at all times, at each and every moment, they live in the fear of God

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saahib man vasai sachaa naavan hoi ||1||
english: -O Nanak, the Lord dwells within their minds, and their cleansing bath is true. ||1||

author: Guru Angad
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹ ਜਿਨੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: seee poore saah jinee pooraa paaiaa ||
english: They are the perfect kings, who have found the Perfect Lord.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਅਠੀ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਰਹਨਿ ਇਕਤੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: athee veparavaah rahan ikatai ra(n)g ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, they remain unconcerned, imbued with the Love of the One Lord.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਥਾਹ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
transliteration: darasan roop athaah virale paaeeahi ||
english: Only a few obtain the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Unimaginably Beauteous Lord.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: karam poorai pooraa guroo pooraa jaa kaa bol ||
english: Through the perfect karma of good deeds, one meets the Perfect Guru, whose speech is perfect.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਲੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak pooraa je kare ghatai naahee tol ||2||
english: O Nanak, when the Guru makes one perfect, one's weight does not decrease. ||2||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ਮੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jaa too(n) taa kiaa hor mai sach sunaaeeai ||
english: When You are with me, what more could I want? I speak only the Truth.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਚੋਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: muthee dha(n)dhai chor mahal na paaeeai ||
english: Plundered by the thieves of worldly affairs, she does not obtain the Mansion of His Presence.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਏਨੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਠੋਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: enai chit kathor sev gavaaeeai ||
english: Being so stone-hearted, she has lost her chance to serve the Lord.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਸੁ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jit ghat sach na paai s bha(n)n ghaRaaeeai ||
english: That heart, in which the True Lord is not found, should be torn down and re-built.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਟਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kiu kar poorai vat tol tulaaeeai ||
english: How can she be weighed accurately, upon the scale of perfection?

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਆਖੈ ਘਟਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: koi na aakhai ghat haumai jaaeeai ||
english: No one will say that her weight has been shorted, if she rids herself of egotism.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਲਈਅਨਿ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖਿ ਦਰਿ ਬੀਨਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: laeean khare parakh dar beenaaeeai ||
english: The genuine are assayed, and accepted in the Court of the All-knowing Lord.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਉਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਹਟਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: saudaa ikat hat poorai gur paaeeai ||17||
english: The genuine merchandise is found only in one shop-it is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||17||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਅਠੀ ਪਹਰੀ ਅਠ ਖੰਡ ਨਾਵਾ ਖੰਡੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: athee paharee ath kha(n)d naavaa kha(n)d sareer ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, destroy the eight things, and in the ninth place, conquer the body.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tis vich nau nidh naam ek bhaalahi gunee gaheer ||
english: Within the body are the nine treasures of the Name of the Lord-seek the depths of these virtues.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: karamava(n)tee saalaahiaa naanak kar gur peer ||
english: Those blessed with the karma of good actions praise the Lord. O Nanak, they make the Guru their spiritual teacher.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰਿ ਸਬਾਹ ਕੈ ਸੁਰਤਿਆ ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chauthai pahar sabaah kai suratiaa upajai chaau ||
english: In the fourth watch of the early morning hours, a longing arises in their higher consciousness.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਦਰੀਆਵਾ ਸਿਉ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tinaa dareeaavaa siu dosatee man mukh sachaa naau ||
english: They are attuned to the river of life; the True Name is in their minds and on their lips.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਕਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
transliteration: othai a(n)mrit va(n)deeai karamee hoi pasaau ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar is distributed, and those with good karma receive this gift.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਸੀਐ ਵੰਨੀ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)chan kaaiaa kaseeai va(n)nee chaRai chaRaau ||
english: Their bodies become golden, and take on the color of spirituality.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫ ਕੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਤਾਉ ॥
transliteration: je hovai nadar saraaph kee bahuR na paaee taau ||
english: If the Jeweller casts His Glance of Grace, they are not placed in the fire again.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਤੀ ਪਹਰੀ ਸਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਬਹੀਐ ਪੜਿਆ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: satee paharee sat bhalaa baheeai paRiaa paas ||
english: Throughout the other seven watches of the day, it is good to speak the Truth, and sit with the spiritually wise.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਘਟੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: othai paap pu(n)n beechaareeai kooRai ghatai raas ||
english: There, vice and virtue are distinguished, and the capital of falsehood is decreased.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਖੋਟੇ ਸਟੀਅਹਿ ਖਰੇ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: othai khote sateeahi khare keechahi saabaas ||
english: There, the counterfeit are cast aside, and the genuine are cheered.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਣੁ ਫਾਦਲੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਖਸਮੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bolan phaadal naanakaa dukh sukh khasamai paas ||1||
english: Speech is vain and useless. O Nanak, pain and pleasure are in the power of our Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Angad
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
transliteration: paun guroo paanee pitaa maataa dharat mahat ||
english: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
transliteration: dinas raat dui daaee daaiaa khelai sagal jagat ||
english: Day and night are the two nurses, in whose lap all the world is at play.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਵਾਚੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)giaaeeaa buriaaeeaa vaache dharam hadoor ||
english: Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord of Dharma.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: karamee aapo aapanee ke neRai ke door ||
english: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਏ ਮਸਕਤਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee naam dhiaaiaa gae masakat ghaal ||
english: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed after having worked by the sweat of their brow

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak te mukh ujale hor ketee chhutee naal ||2||
english: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many others are saved along with them! ||2||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sachaa bhojan bhaau satigur dasiaa ||
english: The True Food is the Love of the Lord; the True Guru has spoken.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇ ਸਚਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sache hee pateeaai sach vigasiaa ||
english: With this True Food, I am satisfied, and with the Truth, I am delighted.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਗਿਰਾਂਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sachai kot giraa(n)i nij ghar vasiaa ||
english: True are the cities and the villages, where one abides in the True Home of the self.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਨਾਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਹਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur tuthai naau prem rahasiaa ||
english: When the True Guru is pleased, one receives the Lord's Name, and blossoms forth in His Love.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਦੈ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sachai dai deebaan kooR na jaaeeai ||
english: No one enters the Court of the True Lord through falsehood.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੋ ਝੂਠੁ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਸੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jhootho jhooth vakhaan s mahal khuaaeeai ||
english: By uttering falsehood and only falsehood, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad neesaan thaak na paaeeai ||
english: No one blocks the way of those who are blessed with the Banner of the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: sach sun bujh vakhaan mahal bulaaeeai ||18||
english: Hearing, understanding and speaking Truth, one is called to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||18||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: pahiraa agan hivai ghar baadhaa bhojan saar karaaee ||
english: If I dressed myself in fire, and built my house of snow, and made iron my food;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਵਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਹਾਕ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sagale dookh paanee kar peevaa dharatee haak chalaaee ||
english: and if I were to drink in all pain like water, and drive the entire earth before me;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਿ ਤਾਰਾਜੀ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਤੋਲੀ ਪਿਛੈ ਟੰਕੁ ਚੜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dhar taaraajee a(n)bar tolee pichhai ta(n)k chaRaaee ||
english: and if I were to place the earth upon a scale and balance it with a single copper coin;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਵਡੁ ਵਧਾ ਮਾਵਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭਸੈ ਨਥਿ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: evad vadhaa maavaa naahee sabhasai nath chalaaee ||
english: and if I were to become so great that I could not be contained, and if I were to control and lead all;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: etaa taan hovai man a(n)dar karee bh aakh karaaee ||
english: and if I were to possess so much power within my mind that I could cause others to do my bidding-so what?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਤੇਵਡ ਦਾਤੀ ਦੇ ਦੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jevad saahib tevad daatee de de kare rajaaee ||
english: As Great as our Lord and Master is, so great are His gifts. He bestows them according to His Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak nadar kare jis upar sach naam vadiaaee ||1||
english: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtain the glorious greatness of the True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਰਜਿਆ ਸੁਨਣਿ ਨ ਰਜੇ ਕੰਨ ॥
transliteration: aakhan aakh na rajiaa sunan na raje ka(n)n ||
english: The mouth is not satisfied by speaking, and the ears are not satisfied by hearing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਰਜੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕ ਇਕ ਵੰਨ ॥
transliteration: akhee dekh na rajeeaa gun gaahak ik va(n)n ||
english: The eyes are not satisfied by seeing-each organ seeks out one sensory quality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗਲੀ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhukhiaa bhukh na utarai galee bhukh na jaai ||
english: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased; by mere words, hunger is not relieved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੁਖਾ ਤਾ ਰਜੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak bhukhaa taa rajai jaa gun kahi gunee samaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, hunger is relieved only when one utters the Glorious Praises of the Praiseworthy Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: vin sache sabh kooR kooR kamaaeeai ||
english: Without the True One, all are false, and all practice falsehood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ਬੰਨਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: vin sache kooRiaar ba(n)n chalaaeeai ||
english: Without the True One, the false ones are bound and gagged and driven off.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਰਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: vin sache tan chhaar chhaar ralaaeeai ||
english: Without the True One, the body is just ashes, and it mingles again with ashes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਜਿ ਪੈਝੈ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: vin sache sabh bhukh j paijhai khaaeeai ||
english: Without the True Ome, all food and clothes are unsatisfying.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: vin sache darabaar kooR na paaeeai ||
english: Without the True One, the false ones do not attain the Lord's Court.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਗਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kooRai laalach lag mahal khuaaeeai ||
english: Attached to false attachments, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਓ ਠਗਿ ਆਈਐ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag thagio thag aaeeai jaaeeai ||
english: The whole world is deceived by deception, coming and going in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: tan mahi trisanaa ag sabad bujhaaeeai ||19||
english: Within the body is the fire of desire; through the Word of the Shabad, it is quenched. ||19||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak gur sa(n)tokh rukh dharam phul phal giaan ||
english: O Nanak, the Guru is the tree of contentment, with flowers of faith, and fruits of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਪਕੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ॥
transliteration: ras rasiaa hariaa sadaa pakai karam dhiaan ||
english: Watered with the Lord's Love, it remains forever green; through the karma of good deeds and meditation, it ripens.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਕੇ ਸਾਦ ਖਾਦਾ ਲਹੈ ਦਾਨਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pat ke saad khaadaa lahai daanaa kai sir daan ||1||
english: Honor is obtained by eating this tasty dish; of all gifts, this is the greatest gift. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਪਤ ਪਰਵਾਲਾ ਫੁਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ॥
transliteration: suine kaa birakh pat paravaalaa phul javehar laal ||
english: The Guru is the tree of gold, with leaves of coral, and blossoms of jewels and rubies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਫਲ ਰਤਨ ਲਗਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਖਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: tit phal ratan lagahi mukh bhaakhit hiradai ridai nihaal ||
english: The Words from His Mouth are fruits of jewels. Within His Heart, He beholds the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak karam hovai mukh masatak likhiaa hovai lekh ||
english: O Nanak, He is obtained by those, upon whose faces and foreheads such pre-recorded destiny is written.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਠਿਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਪੂਜੈ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: athisath teerath gur kee charanee poojai sadaa visekh ||
english: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage are contained in the constant worship of the feet of the Exalted Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕੋਪੁ ਚਾਰੇ ਨਦੀਆ ਅਗਿ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)s het lobh kop chaare nadeeaa ag ||
english: Cruelty, material attachment, greed and anger are the four rivers of fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਵਹਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਰੀਐ ਕਰਮੀ ਲਗਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pavahi dajhahi naanakaa tareeai karamee lag ||2||
english: Falling into them, one is burned, O Nanak! One is saved only by holding tight to good deeds. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jeevadiaa mar maar na pachhotaaeeai ||
english: While you are alive, conquer death, and you shall have no regrets in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jhoothaa ihu sa(n)saar kin samajhaaeeai ||
english: This world is false, but only a few understand this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sach na dhare piaar dha(n)dhai dhaaeeai ||
english: People do not enshrine love for the Truth; they chase after worldly affairs instead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਖੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੁਨੀਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kaal buraa khai kaal sir duneeaaeeai ||
english: The terrible time of death and annihilation hovers over the heads of the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਦਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: hukamee sir ja(n)daar maare daaeeai ||
english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the Messenger of Death smashes his club over their heads.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: aape dei piaar ma(n)n vasaaeeai ||
english: The Lord Himself gives His Love, and enshrines it within their minds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਵਿਲੰਮੁ ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: muhat na chasaa vila(n)m bhareeai paaeeai ||
english: Not a moment or an instant's delay is permitted, when one's measure of life is full.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee bujh sach samaaeeai ||20||
english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to know the True One, and is absorbed into Him. ||20||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੀ ਤੁਮਾ ਵਿਸੁ ਅਕੁ ਧਤੂਰਾ ਨਿਮੁ ਫਲੁ ॥
transliteration: tumee tumaa vis ak dhatooraa nim phal ||
english: Bitter melon, swallow-wort, thorn-apple and nim fruit

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: man mukh vasahi tis jis too(n) chit na aavahee ||
english: these bitter poisons lodge in the minds and mouths of those who do not remember You

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੰਢਨਿ ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kaheeai kis ha(n)dhan karamaa baahare ||1||
english: O Nanak, how shall I tell them this? Without the karma of good deeds, they are only destroying themselves. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਕਬ ਉਤਮ ਕਬ ਨੀਚ ॥
transliteration: mat pa(n)kheroo kirat saath kab utam kab neech ||
english: The intellect is a bird; on account of its actions, it is sometimes high, and sometimes low.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਬ ਚੰਦਨਿ ਕਬ ਅਕਿ ਡਾਲਿ ਕਬ ਉਚੀ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kab cha(n)dan kab ak daal kab uchee pareet ||
english: Sometimes it is perched on the sandalwood tree, and sometimes it is on the branch of the poisonous swallow-wort. Sometimes, it soars through the heavens.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਲਗੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak hukam chalaaeeai saahib lagee reet ||2||
english: O Nanak, our Lord and Master leads us on, according to the Hukam of His Command; such is His Way. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਖਾਣ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kete kahahi vakhaan kahi kahi jaavanaa ||
english: Some speak and expound, and while speaking and lecturing, they pass away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਖਿਆਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ved kahahi vakhiaan a(n)t na paavanaa ||
english: The Vedas speak and expound on the Lord, but they do not know His limits.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਭੇਦੁ ਬੁਝਿਐ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: paRiai naahee bhed bujhiai paavanaa ||
english: Not by studying, but through understanding, is the Lord's Mystery revealed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਭੇਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: khat darasan kai bhekh kisai sach samaavanaa ||
english: There are six pathways in the Shaastras, but how rare are those who merge in the True Lord through them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa purakh alakh sabad suhaavanaa ||
english: The True Lord is Unknowable; through the Word of His Shabad, we are embellished.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਬਿਸੰਖ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)ne naau bisa(n)kh daragah paavanaa ||
english: One who believes in the Name of the Infinite Lord, attains the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਲਕ ਕਉ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: khaalak kau aades dhaadhee gaavanaa ||
english: I humbly bow to the Creator Lord; I am a minstrel singing His Praises.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਾ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak jug jug ek ma(n)n vasaavanaa ||21||
english: Nanak enshrines the Lord within his mind. He is the One, throughout the ages. ||21||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਠੂਹਿਆ ਨਾਗੀ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)tree hoi athoohiaa naagee lagai jaai ||
english: Those who charm scorpions and handle snakes

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀ ਆਪਣੈ ਦੇ ਕੂਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aapan hathee aapanai de koochaa aape laai ||
english: Only brand themselves with their own hands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਅਤੀ ਹੂ ਧਕਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hukam paiaa dhur khasam kaa atee hoo dhakaa khaai ||
english: By the pre-ordained Order of our Lord and Master, they are beaten badly, and struck down.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੜੈ ਡੁਬੈ ਹਕਿ ਨਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh siu manamukh aRai dubai hak niaai ||
english: If the self-willed manmukhs fight with the Gurmukh, they are condemned by the Lord, the True Judge.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਖਸਮੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਉਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: duhaa siriaa aape khasam vekhai kar viupaai ||
english: He Himself is the Lord and Master of both worlds. He beholds all and makes the exact determination.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak evai jaaneeai sabh kichh tisahi rajaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, know this well: everything is in accordance with His Will. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਖੇ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਤਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak parakhe aap kau taa paarakh jaan ||
english: O Nanak, if someone judges himself, only then is he known as a real judge.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਦੋਵੈ ਬੁਝੈ ਤਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: rog daaroo dovai bujhai taa vaid sujaan ||
english: If someone understands both the disease and the medicine, only then is he a wise physician.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਟ ਨ ਕਰਈ ਮਾਮਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: vaat na karaee maamalaa jaanai mihamaan ||
english: Do not involve yourself in idle business on the way; remember that you are only a guest here.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਾਣਿ ਲਾਏ ਹਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: mool jaan galaa kare haan laae haan ||
english: Speak with those who know the Primal Lord, and renounce your evil ways.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਬਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸੋ ਵਿਸਟੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: lab na chalaee sach rahai so visat paravaan ||
english: That virtuous person who does not walk in the way of greed, and who abides in Truth, is accepted and famous.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰੁ ਸੰਧੇ ਆਗਾਸ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sar sa(n)dhe aagaas kau kiu pahuchai baan ||
english: If an arrow is shot at the sky, how can it reach there?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਓਹੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੇਦੜੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: agai ohu aga(n)m hai vaahedaR jaan ||2||
english: The sky above is unreachable-know this well, O archer! ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: naaree purakh piaar prem seegaareeaa ||
english: The soul-bride loves her Husband Lord; she is embellished with His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨ ਰਹਨੀ ਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: karan bhagat din raat na rahanee vaareeaa ||
english: She worships Him day and night; she cannot be restrained from doing so.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ਮੰਝਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa ma(n)jh nivaas sabad savaareeaa ||
english: In the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, she has made her home; she is adorned with the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹਨਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੇ ਵੇਚਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sach kahan aradaas se vechaareeaa ||
english: She is humble, and she offers her true and sincere prayer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਨਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਪਾਸਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sohan khasamai paas hukam sidhaareeaa ||
english: She is beautiful in the Company of her Lord and Master; she walks in the Way of His Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਕਹਨਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sakhee kahan aradaas manahu piaareeaa ||
english: With her dear friends, she offers her heart-felt prayers to her Beloved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai dhrig vaas phit s jeeviaa ||
english: Cursed is that home, and shameful is that life, which is without the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਿਆ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: sabad savaareeaas a(n)mrit peeviaa ||22||
english: But she who is adorned with the Word of His Shabad, drinks in the Amrit of His Nectar. ||22||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮੀਹਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਅਗੀ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਭੁਖ ॥
transliteration: maaroo meehi na tripatiaa agee lahai na bhukh ||
english: The desert is not satisfied by rain, and the fire is not quenched by desire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਜਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਸਾਇਰ ਭਰੇ ਕਿਸੁਕ ॥
transliteration: raajaa raaj na tripatiaa saair bhare kisuk ||
english: The king is not satisfied with his kingdom, and the oceans are full, but still they thirst for more.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕੇਤੀ ਪੁਛਾ ਪੁਛ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sache naam kee ketee puchhaa puchh ||1||
english: O Nanak, how many times must I seek and ask for the True Name? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਫਲੰ ਤਸਿ ਜਨਮਸਿ ਜਾਵਤੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨ ਬਿੰਦਤੇ ॥
transliteration: nihaphala(n) tas janamas jaavat braham na bi(n)date ||
english: Life is useless, as long as one does not know the Lord God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੰ ਸੰਸਾਰਸਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਰਹਿ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: saagara(n) sa(n)saaras gur parasaadee tarahi ke ||
english: Only a few cross over the world-ocean, by Guru's Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath hai kahu naanak beechaar ||
english: The Lord is the All-powerful Cause of causes, says Nanak after deep deliberation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਲ ਰਖੀ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaaran karate vas hai jin kal rakhee dhaar ||2||
english: The creation is subject to the Creator, who sustains it by His Almighty Power. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ਢਾਢੀ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: khasamai kai darabaar dhaadhee vasiaa ||
english: In the Court of the Lord and Master, His minstrels dwell.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਲਾਣਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sachaa khasam kalaan kamal vigasiaa ||
english: Singing the Praises of their True Lord and Master, the lotuses of their hearts have blossomed forth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮਹੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇ ਮਨਹੁ ਰਹਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: khasamahu pooraa paai manahu rahasiaa ||
english: Obtaining their Perfect Lord and Master, their minds are transfixed with ecstasy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਕਢੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਸਰਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dusaman kadhe maar sajan sarasiaa ||
english: Their enemies have been driven out and subdued, and their friends are very pleased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sachaa satigur sevan sachaa maarag dasiaa ||
english: Those who serve the Truthful True Guru are shown the True Path.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਵਿਧਉਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sachaa sabad beechaar kaal vidhausiaa ||
english: Reflecting on the True Word of the Shabad, death is overcome.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dhaadhee kathe akath sabad savaariaa ||
english: Speaking the Unspoken Speech of the Lord, one is adorned with the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: naanak gun gahi raas har jeeu mile piaariaa ||23||
english: Nanak holds tight to the Treasure of Virtue, and meets with the Dear, Beloved Lord. ||23||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਤਿਅਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਤ ਖਤਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: khatiahu ja(n)me khate karan ta khatiaa vich paahi ||
english: Born because of the karma of their past mistakes, they make more mistakes, and fall into mistakes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੋਤੇ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: dhote mool na utarahi je sau dhovan paahi ||
english: By washing, their pollution is not removed, even though they may wash hundreds of times.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਹੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bakhase bakhaseeahi naahi ta paahee paahi ||1||
english: O Nanak, if God forgives, they are forgiven; otherwise, they are kicked and beaten. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਝਖਣਾ ਦੁਖ ਛਡਿ ਮੰਗੀਅਹਿ ਸੁਖ ॥
transliteration: naanak bolan jhakhanaa dukh chhad ma(n)geeahi sukh ||
english: O Nanak, it is absurd to ask to be spared from pain by begging for comfort.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਇ ਦਰਿ ਕਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਨੁਖ ॥
transliteration: sukh dukh dui dar kapaRe pahirahi jaai manukh ||
english: Pleasure and pain are the two garments given, to be worn in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਬੋਲਣਿ ਹਾਰੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਚੰਗੀ ਚੁਪ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jithai bolan haareeai tithai cha(n)gee chup ||2||
english: Where you are bound to lose by speaking, there, you ought to remain silent. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਭਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa dekh a(n)dar bhaaliaa ||
english: After looking around in the four directions, I looked within my own self.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਅਲਖਿ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sachai purakh alakh siraj nihaaliaa ||
english: There, I saw the True, Invisible Lord Creator.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਝੜਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਰਾਹ ਗੁਰਿ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ujhaR bhule raah gur vekhaaliaa ||
english: I was wandering in the wilderness, but now the Guru has shown me the Way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur sache vaahu sach samaaliaa ||
english: Hail to the True, True Guru, through whom we merge in the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਰਤਨੁ ਘਰਾਹੁ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paaiaa ratan gharaahu deevaa baaliaa ||
english: I have found the jewel within the home of my own self; the lamp within has been lit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਚ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad salaahi sukheee sach vaaliaa ||
english: Those who praise the True Word of the Shabad, abide in the peace of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਡਰਿਆ ਡਰੁ ਲਗਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਸਿ ਗਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: nidariaa dar lag garab s gaaliaa ||
english: But those who do not have the Fear of God, are overtaken by fear. They are destroyed by their own pride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: naavahu bhulaa jag phirai betaaliaa ||24||
english: Having forgotten the Name, the world is roaming around like a wild demon. ||24||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਭੈ ਮਰੈ ਭੀ ਭਉ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich ja(n)mai bhai marai bhee bhau man mahi hoi ||
english: In fear we are born, and in fear we die. Fear is always present in the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bhai vich je marai sahilaa aaiaa soi ||1||
english: O Nanak, if one dies in the fear of God, his coming into the world is blessed and approved. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhai vin jeevai bahut bahut khuseeaa khusee kamaai ||
english: Without the fear of God, you may live very, very long, and savor the most enjoyable pleasures.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak bhai vin je marai muhi kaalai uth jaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, if you die without the fear of God, you will arise and depart with a blackened face. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal ta saradhaa pooreeai ||
english: When the True Guru is merciful, then your desires will be fulfilled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal na kabahoo(n) jhooreeai ||
english: When the True Guru is merciful, you will never grieve.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal taa dukh na jaaneeai ||
english: When the True Guru is merciful, you will know no pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal taa har ra(n)g maaneeai ||
english: When the True Guru is merciful, you will enjoy the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal taa jam kaa dar kehaa ||
english: When the True Guru is merciful, then why should you fear death?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal taa sad hee sukh dehaa ||
english: When the True Guru is merciful, the body is always at peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal taa nav nidh paaeeai ||
english: When the True Guru is merciful, the nine treasures are obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal ta sach samaaeeai ||25||
english: When the True Guru is merciful, you shall be absorbed in the True Lord. ||25||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੁ ਖੋਹਾਇ ਪੀਅਹਿ ਮਲਵਾਣੀ ਜੂਠਾ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sir khohaai peeahi malavaanee joothaa ma(n)g ma(n)g khaahee ||
english: They pluck the hair out of their heads, and drink in filthy water; they beg endlessly and eat the garbage which others have thrown away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫੋਲਿ ਫਦੀਹਤਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਭੜਾਸਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਗਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: phol phadeehat muhi lain bhaRaasaa paanee dekh sagaahee ||
english: They spread manure, they suck in rotting smells, and they are afraid of clean water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੇਡਾ ਵਾਗੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਖੋਹਾਇਨਿ ਭਰੀਅਨਿ ਹਥ ਸੁਆਹੀ ॥
transliteration: bhedaa vaagee sir khohaain bhareean hath suaahee ||
english: Their hands are smeared with ashes, and the hair on their heads is plucked out-they are like sheep!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਊ ਪੀਊ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਗਵਾਇਨਿ ਟਬਰ ਰੋਵਨਿ ਧਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: maaoo peeoo kirat gavaain tabar rovan dhaahee ||
english: They have renounced the lifestyle of their mothers and fathers, and their families and relatives cry out in distress.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਨ ਪਤਲਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਨ ਦੀਵਾ ਮੁਏ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: onaa pi(n)d na patal kiriaa na deevaa mue kithaaoo paahee ||
english: No one offers the rice dishes at their last rites, and no one lights the lamps for them. After their death, where will they be sent?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਨਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: athasath teerath den na dhoee brahaman a(n)n na khaahee ||
english: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage give them no place of protection, and no Brahmin will eat their food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਥੈ ਟਿਕੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sadaa kucheel rahahi din raatee mathai tike naahee ||
english: They remain polluted forever, day and night; they do not apply the ceremonial tilak mark to their foreheads.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੁੰਡੀ ਪਾਇ ਬਹਨਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਮਰਣੈ ਦੜਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jhu(n)dee paai bahan nit maranai daR deebaan na jaahee ||
english: They sit together in silence, as if in mourning; they do not go to the Lord's Court.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਕੀ ਕਾਸੇ ਹਥੀ ਫੁੰਮਣ ਅਗੋ ਪਿਛੀ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: lakee kaase hathee phu(n)man ago pichhee jaahee ||
english: With their begging bowls hanging from their waists, and their fly-brushes in their hands, they walk along in single file.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜੰਗਮ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁੰਲਾ ॥
transliteration: naa oi jogee naa oi ja(n)gam naa oi kaajee mu(n)laa ||
english: They are not Yogis, and they are not Jangams, followers of Shiva. They are not Qazis or Mullahs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਯਿ ਵਿਗੋਏ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ਫਿਟਾ ਵਤੈ ਗਲਾ ॥
transliteration: day vigoe phirahi vigute phitaa vatai galaa ||
english: Ruined by the Merciful Lord, they wander around in disgrace, and their entire troop is contaminated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਖੈ ॥
transliteration: jeeaa maar jeevaale soee avar na koee rakhai ||
english: The Lord alone kills and restores to life; no one else can protect anyone from Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨਹੁ ਤੈ ਇਸਨਾਨਹੁ ਵੰਜੇ ਭਸੁ ਪਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਖੁਥੈ ॥
transliteration: daanahu tai isanaanahu va(n)je bhas paee sir khuthai ||
english: They go without giving alms or any cleansing baths; their shaven heads become covered with dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਰਤਨ ਉਪੰਨੇ ਮੇਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਮਾਧਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: paanee vichahu ratan upa(n)ne mer keeaa maadhaanee ||
english: The jewel emerged from the water, when the mountain of gold was used to churn it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਵੀ ਥਾਪੇ ਪੁਰਬੀ ਲਗੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: athasath teerath devee thaape purabee lagai baanee ||
english: The gods established the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where the festivals are celebrated and hymns are chanted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ਨਾਤੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਨਾਵਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: naai nivaajaa naatai poojaa naavan sadaa sujaanee ||
english: After bathing, the Muslims recite their prayers, and after bathing, the Hindus perform their worship services. The wise always take cleansing baths.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਇਆ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: muiaa jeevadiaa gat hovai jaa(n) sir paaeeai paanee ||
english: At the time of death, and at the time of birth, they are purified, when water is poured on their heads.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਰਖੁਥੇ ਸੈਤਾਨੀ ਏਨਾ ਗਲ ਨ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak sirakhuthe saitaanee enaa gal na bhaanee ||
english: O Nanak, the shaven-headed ones are devils. They are not pleased to hear these words.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੁਠੈ ਹੋਇਐ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਜੀਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: vuthai hoiai hoi bilaaval jeeaa jugat samaanee ||
english: When it rains, there is happiness. Water is the key to all life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੁਠੈ ਅੰਨੁ ਕਮਾਦੁ ਕਪਾਹਾ ਸਭਸੈ ਪੜਦਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: vuthai a(n)n kamaad kapaahaa sabhasai paRadaa hovai ||
english: When it rains, the corn grows, and the sugar cane, and the cotton, which provides clothing for all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੁਠੈ ਘਾਹੁ ਚਰਹਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਸੁਰਹੀ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਦਹੀ ਵਿਲੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: vuthai ghaahu charahi nit surahee saa dhan dahee vilovai ||
english: When it rains, the cows always have grass to graze upon, and housewives can churn the milk into butter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਿਇ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਸਦ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਇਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: tit ghii hom jag sad poojaa paiai kaaraj sohai ||
english: With that ghee, sacred feasts and worship services are performed; all these efforts are blessed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਨਦੀ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਖੀ ਨਾਤੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: guroo samu(n)d nadee sabh sikhee naatai jit vadiaaee ||
english: The Guru is the ocean, and all His Teachings are the river. Bathing within it, glorious greatness is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਸਿਰਖੁਥੇ ਨਾਵਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਸਤ ਚਟੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak je sirakhuthe naavan naahee taa sat chate sir chhaaee ||1||
english: O Nanak, if the shaven-headed ones do not bathe, then seven handfuls of ashes are upon their heads. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੀ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੇਹੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: agee paalaa k kare sooraj kehee raat ||
english: What can the cold do to the fire? How can the night affect the sun?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦ ਅਨੇਰਾ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)d aneraa k kare paun paanee kiaa jaat ||
english: What can the darkness do to the moon? What can social status do to air and water?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਚੀਜੀ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dharatee cheejee k kare jis vich sabh kichh hoi ||
english: What are personal possessions to the earth, from which all things are produced?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਰਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak taa pat jaaneeai jaa pat rakhai soi ||2||
english: O Nanak, he alone is known as honorable, whose honor the Lord preserves. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੇ ਸੁਬਹਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਲਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh sache subahaan sadaa kalaaniaa ||
english: It is of You, O my True and Wondrous Lord, that I sing forever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sachaa deebaan hor aavan jaaniaa ||
english: Yours is the True Court. All others are subject to coming and going.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਜਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਜੇਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sach j ma(n)gahi daan s tudhai jehiaa ||
english: Those who ask for the gift of the True Name are like You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sach teraa phuramaan sabade sohiaa ||
english: Your Command is True; we are adorned with the Word of Your Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤੁਧੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)niai giaan dhiaan tudhai te paaiaa ||
english: Through faith and trust, we receive spiritual wisdom and meditation from You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: karam pavai neesaan na chalai chalaaiaa ||
english: By Your Grace, the banner of honor is obtained. It cannot be taken away or lost.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sachaa daataar nit devahi chaRahi savaaiaa ||
english: You are the True Giver; You give continually. Your Gifts continue to increase.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: naanak ma(n)gai daan jo tudh bhaaiaa ||26||
english: Nanak begs for that gift which is pleasing to You. ||26||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਖਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮੇਉ ॥
transliteration: deekhiaa aakh bujhaaiaa siphatee sach sameu ||
english: Those who have accepted the Guru's Teachings, and who have found the path, remain absorbed in the Praises of the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਉਪਦੇਸੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin kau kiaa upadeseeai jin gur naanak deu ||1||
english: What teachings can be imparted to those who have the Divine Guru Nanak as their Guru? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: aap bujhaae soee boojhai ||
english: We understand the Lord only when He Himself inspires us to understand Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਝਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: jis aap sujhaae tis sabh kichh soojhai ||
english: He alone knows everything, unto whom the Lord Himself gives knowledge.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਥਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: kahi kahi kathanaa maaiaa loojhai ||
english: One may talk and preach and give sermons but still yearn after Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਗਲ ਕਰੇ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hukamee sagal kare aakaar ||
english: The Lord, by the Hukam of His Command, has created the entire creation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aape jaanai sarab veechaar ||
english: He Himself knows the inner nature of all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਖਿਓ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: akhar naanak akhio aap ||
english: O Nanak, He Himself uttered the Word.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਹੈ ਭਰਾਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: lahai bharaat hovai jis daat ||2||
english: Doubt departs from one who receives this gift. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hau dhaadhee vekaar kaarai laaiaa ||
english: I was a minstrel, out of work, when the Lord took me into His service.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੈ ਕੈ ਵਾਰ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: raat dihai kai vaar dhurahu phuramaaiaa ||
english: To sing His Praises day and night, He gave me His Order, right from the start.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਖਸਮਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhaadhee sachai mahal khasam bulaaiaa ||
english: My Lord and Master has summoned me, His minstrel, to the True Mansion of His Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਕਪੜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
