transliteration: sachee siphat saalaah kapaRaa paaiaa ||
english: He has dressed me in the robes of His True Praise and Glory.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sachaa a(n)mrit naam bhojan aaiaa ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name has become my food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਖਾਧਾ ਰਜਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramatee khaadhaa raj tin sukh paaiaa ||
english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings, who eat this food and are satisfied, find peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhaadhee kare pasaau sabad vajaaiaa ||
english: His minstrel spreads His Glory, singing and vibrating the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨੭॥ ਸੁਧੁ
transliteration: naanak sach saalaahi pooraa paaiaa ||27|| sudh
english: O Nanak, praising the True Lord, I have obtained His Perfection. ||27||Sudh||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee guaareree mahalaa 1 chaupade dupade ||
english: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay & Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਮੁਚੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਵਡਾ ਤੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bhau much bhaaraa vadaa tol ||
english: The Fear of God is overpowering, and so very heavy,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਤਿ ਹਉਲੀ ਬੋਲੇ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: man mat haulee bole bol ||
english: while the intellect is lightweight, as is the speech one speaks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਚਲੀਐ ਸਹੀਐ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sir dhar chaleeai saheeai bhaar ||
english: So place the Fear of God upon your head, and bear that weight;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nadaree karamee gur beechaar ||1||
english: by the Grace of the Merciful Lord, contemplate the Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲੰਘਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhai bin koi na la(n)ghas paar ||
english: Without the Fear of God, no one crosses over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਉ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhai bhau raakhiaa bhaai savaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This Fear of God adorns the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ਭੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: bhai tan agan bhakhai bhai naal ||
english: The fire of fear within the body is burnt away by the Fear of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਉ ਘੜੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhai bhau ghaReeai sabad savaar ||
english: Through this Fear of God, we are adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਾੜਤ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚ ॥
transliteration: bhai bin ghaaRat kach nikach ||
english: Without the Fear of God, all that is fashioned is false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਸਚਾ ਅੰਧੀ ਸਟ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)dhaa sachaa a(n)dhee sat ||2||
english: Useless is the mold, and useless are the hammer-strokes on the mold. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੁਧੀ ਬਾਜੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: budhee baajee upajai chaau ||
english: The desire for the worldly drama arises in the intellect,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਪਵੈ ਨ ਤਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sahas siaanap pavai na taau ||
english: but even with thousands of clever mental tricks, the heat of the Fear of God does not come into play.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਵਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naanak manamukh bolan vaau ||
english: O Nanak, the speech of the self-willed manmukh is just wind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਅਖਰੁ ਵਾਉ ਦੁਆਉ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)dhaa akhar vaau duaau ||3||1||
english: His words are worthless and empty, like the wind. ||3||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਡਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dar ghar ghar dar dar dar jaai ||
english: Place the Fear of God within the home of your heart; with this Fear of God in your heart, all other fears shall be frightened away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਡਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਡਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: so dar kehaa jit dar dar paai ||
english: What sort of fear is that, which frightens other fears?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tudh bin doojee naahee jaai ||
english: Without You, I have other place of rest at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo kichh varatai sabh teree rajaai ||1||
english: Whatever happens is all according to Your Will. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡਰੀਐ ਜੇ ਡਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dareeai je dar hovai hor ||
english: Be afraid, if you have any fear, other than the Fear of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਡਰਣਾ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dar dar daranaa man kaa sor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Afraid of fear, and living in fear, the mind is held in tumult. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਡੂਬੈ ਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: naa jeeu marai na doobai tarai ||
english: The soul does not die; it does not drown, and it does not swim across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jin kichh keeaa so kichh karai ||
english: The One who created everything does everything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hukame aavai hukame jaai ||
english: By the Hukam of His Command we come, and by the Hukam of His Command we go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aagai paachhai hukam samaai ||2||
english: Before and after, His Command is pervading. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਆਸਾ ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)s het aasaa asamaan ||
english: Cruelty, attachment, desire and egotism

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਭੂਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨੈ ਸਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tis vich bhookh bahut nai saan ||
english: there is great hunger in these, like the raging torrent of a wild stream.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhau khaanaa peenaa aadhaar ||
english: Let the Fear of God be your food, drink and support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਖਾਧੇ ਮਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vin khaadhe mar hohi gavaar ||3||
english: Without doing this, the fools simply die. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੋਇ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa koi koee koi koi ||
english: If anyone really has anyone else - how rare is that person!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko teraa too(n) sabhanaa kaa soi ||
english: All are Yours - You are the Lord of all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa ke jee ja(n)t dhan maal ||
english: All beings and creatures, wealth and property belong to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak aakhan bikham beechaar ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, it is so difficult to describe and contemplate Him. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
transliteration: maataa mat pitaa sa(n)tokh ||
english: Let wisdom be your mother, and contentment your father.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਏਹੁ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sat bhaaee kar ehu visekh ||1||
english: Let Truth be your brother - these are your best relatives. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਣਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kahanaa hai kichh kahan na jaai ||
english: He has been described, but He cannot be described at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tau kudarat keemat nahee paai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your All-pervading creative nature cannot be estimated. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਮ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਸਸੁਰ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: saram surat dui sasur bhae ||
english: Modesty, humility and intuitive understanding are my mother-in-law and father-in-law;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਲਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karanee kaaman kar man lae ||2||
english: I have made good deeds my spouse. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵੀਆਹੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: saahaa sa(n)jog veeaahu vijog ||
english: Union with the Holy is my wedding date, and separation from the world is my marriage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤਤਿ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੩॥੩॥
transliteration: sach sa(n)tat kahu naanak jog ||3||3||
english: Says Nanak, Truth is the child born of this Union. ||3||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
transliteration: paunai paanee aganee kaa mel ||
english: The union of air, water and fire

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲ ਚਪਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਾ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)chal chapal budh kaa khel ||
english: the body is the play-thing of the fickle and unsteady intellect.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਦਸਵਾ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: nau daravaaje dasavaa duaar ||
english: It has nine doors, and then there is the Tenth Gate.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੁਝੁ ਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bujh re giaanee ehu beechaar ||1||
english: Reflect upon this and understand it, O wise one. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਥਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਸੁਨਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kathataa bakataa sunataa soee ||
english: The Lord is the One who speaks, teaches and listens.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aap beechaare s giaanee hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who contemplates his own self is truly wise. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਮਾਟੀ ਬੋਲੈ ਪਉਣੁ ॥
transliteration: dehee maatee bolai paun ||
english: The body is dust; the wind speaks through it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੁਝੁ ਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮੂਆ ਹੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
transliteration: bujh re giaanee mooaa hai kaun ||
english: Understand, O wise one, who has died.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mooee surat baad aha(n)kaar ||
english: Awareness, conflict and ego have died,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਜੋ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ohu na mooaa jo dekhanahaar ||2||
english: but the One who sees does not die. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jai kaaran tat teerath jaahee ||
english: For the sake of it, you journey to sacred shrines and holy rivers;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ratan padaarath ghat hee maahee ||
english: but this priceless jewel is within your own heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit baad vakhaanai ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read endlessly; they stir up arguments and controversies,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੋਦੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bheetar hodee vasat na jaanai ||3||
english: but they do not know the secret deep within. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੁਈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hau na mooaa meree muee balaai ||
english: I have not died - that evil nature within me has died.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਜੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ohu na mooaa jo rahiaa samaai ||
english: The One who is pervading everywhere does not die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur braham dikhaaiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has revealed God to me,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਤਾ ਜਾਤਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: marataa jaataa nadar na aaiaa ||4||4||
english: and now I see that there is no such thing as birth or death. ||4||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 dakhanee ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl, Dakhanee:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਮਾਨੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sun sun boojhai maanai naau ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to the one who listens and hears,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taa kai sad balihaarai jaau ||
english: Who understands and believes in the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aap bhulaae thaur na thaau ||
english: When the Lord Himself leads us astray, there is no other place of rest for us to find.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too(n) samajhaavahi mel milaau ||1||
english: You impart understanding, and You unite us in Your Union. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਚਲੈ ਮੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: naam milai chalai mai naal ||
english: I obtain the Naam, which shall go along with me in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਧੀ ਸਭ ਕਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai baadhee sabh kaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Name, all are held in the grip of Death. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੇਤੀ ਵਣਜੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
transliteration: khetee vanaj naavai kee ot ||
english: My farming and my trading are by the Support of the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਜ ਕੀ ਪੋਟ ॥
transliteration: paap pu(n)n beej kee pot ||
english: The seeds of sin and virtue are bound together.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਚੋਟ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh jee mahi chot ||
english: Sexual desire and anger are the wounds of the soul.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲੇ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam visaar chale man khot ||2||
english: The evil-minded ones forget the Naam, and then depart. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੀਖ ॥
transliteration: saache gur kee saachee seekh ||
english: True are the Teachings of the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਖ ॥
transliteration: tan man seetal saach pareekh ||
english: The body and mind are cooled and soothed, by the touchstone of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਪੁਰਾਇਨਿ ਰਸ ਕਮਲ ਪਰੀਖ ॥
transliteration: jal puraain ras kamal pareekh ||
english: This is the true mark of wisdom: that one remains detached, like the water-lily, or the lotus upon the water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਮੀਠੇ ਰਸ ਈਖ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabad rate meethe ras eekh ||3||
english: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, one becomes sweet, like the juice of the sugar cane. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਗੜਿ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: hukam sa(n)jogee gaR das duaar ||
english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the castle of the body has ten gates.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਵਸਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch vasahi mil jot apaar ||
english: The five passions dwell there, together with the Divine Light of the Infinite.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤੁਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aap tulai aape vanajaar ||
english: The Lord Himself is the merchandise, and He Himself is the trader.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam savaaranahaar ||4||5||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, we are adorned and rejuvenated. ||4||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤੋ ਜਾਇ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaato jaai kahaa te aavai ||
english: How can we know where we came from?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹ ਉਪਜੈ ਕਹ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kah upajai kah jaai samaavai ||
english: Where did we originate, and where will we go and merge?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kiu baadhio kiu mukatee paavai ||
english: How are we bound, and how do we obtain liberation?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kiu abinaasee sahaj samaavai ||1||
english: How do we merge with intuitive ease into the Eternal, Imperishable Lord? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: naam ridai a(n)mrit mukh naam ||
english: With the Naam in the heart and the Ambrosial Naam on our lips,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਰਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰ ਨਿਹਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: narahar naam narahar nihakaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: through the Name of the Lord, we rise above desire, like the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਆਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sahaje aavai sahaje jaai ||
english: With intuitive ease we come, and with intuitive ease we depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man te upajai man maahi samaai ||
english: From the mind we originate, and into the mind we are absorbed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤੋ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh mukato ba(n)dh na paai ||
english: As Gurmukh, we are liberated, and are not bound.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਛੁਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabad beechaar chhutai har naai ||2||
english: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, we are emancipated through the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਰਵਰ ਪੰਖੀ ਬਹੁ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: taravar pa(n)khee bahu nis baas ||
english: At night, lots of birds settle on the tree.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sukh dukheeaa man moh vinaas ||
english: Some are happy, and some are sad. Caught in the desires of the mind, they perish.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਝ ਬਿਹਾਗ ਤਕਹਿ ਆਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: saajh bihaag takahi aagaas ||
english: And when the life-night comes to its end, then they look to the sky.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dah dis dhaavahi karam likhiaas ||3||
english: They fly away in all ten directions, according to their pre-ordained destiny. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਥਾਟੁ ॥
transliteration: naam sa(n)jogee goil thaat ||
english: Those who are committed to the Naam, see the world as merely a temporary pasture.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਫੂਟੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਟੁ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh phootai bikh maat ||
english: Sexual desire and anger are broken, like a jar of poison.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਵਖਰ ਸੂਨੋ ਘਰੁ ਹਾਟੁ ॥
transliteration: bin vakhar soono ghar haat ||
english: Without the merchandise of the Name, the house of the body and the store of the mind are empty.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਖੋਲੇ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur mil khole bajar kapaat ||4||
english: Meeting the Guru, the hard and heavy doors are opened. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪੂਰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: saadh milai poorab sa(n)jog ||
english: One meets the Holy Saint only through perfect destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਹਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਗ ॥
transliteration: sach rahase poore har log ||
english: The Lord's perfect people rejoice in the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇ ਲੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan de lai sahaj subhaai ||
english: Surrendering their minds and bodies, they find the Lord with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak tin kai laagau paai ||5||6||
english: Nanak falls at their feet. ||5||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh maaiaa mahi cheet ||
english: The conscious mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠ ਵਿਕਾਰਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਿਤ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jhooth vikaar jaagai hit cheet ||
english: The conscious mind is awake only to falsehood, corruption and attachment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਪਾਪ ਲੋਭ ਕੀ ਕੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: poo(n)jee paap lobh kee keet ||
english: It gathers in the assets of sin and greed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਚੀਤੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tar taaree man naam sucheet ||1||
english: So swim across the river of life, O my mind, with the Sacred Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਮੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu saache mai teree tek ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! - Great! Great is my True Lord! I seek Your All-powerful Support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau paapee too(n) niramal ek ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sinner - You alone are pure. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੋਲੈ ਭੜਵਾਉ ॥
transliteration: agan paanee bolai bhaRavaau ||
english: Fire and water join together, and the breath roars in its fury!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa i(n)dree ek suaau ||
english: The tongue and the sex organs each seek to taste.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਸਟਿ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: disat vikaaree naahee bhau bhaau ||
english: The eyes which look upon corruption do not know the Love and the Fear of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap maare taa paae naau ||2||
english: Conquering self-conceit, one obtains the Name. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad marai phir maran na hoi ||
english: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, shall never again have to die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਮੂਏ ਕਿਉ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin mooe kiu pooraa hoi ||
english: Without such a death, how can one attain perfection?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਪੰਚਿ ਵਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਦੋਇ ॥
transliteration: parapa(n)ch viaap rahiaa man doi ||
english: The mind is engrossed in deception, treachery and duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: thir naaraain kare s hoi ||3||
english: Whatever the Immortal Lord does, comes to pass. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਚੜਉ ਜਾ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bohith chaRau jaa aavai vaar ||
english: So get aboard that boat when your turn comes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੇ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਰ ॥
transliteration: thaake bohith daragah maar ||
english: Those who fail to embark upon that boat shall be beaten in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sach saalaahee dha(n)n guraduaar ||
english: Blessed is that Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, where the Praises of the True Lord are sung.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak dar ghar eka(n)kaar ||4||7||
english: O Nanak, the One Creator Lord is pervading hearth and home. ||4||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਲਟਿਓ ਕਮਲੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ulatio kamal braham beechaar ||
english: The inverted heart-lotus has been turned upright, through reflective meditation on God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ਗਗਨਿ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit dhaar gagan das duaar ||
english: From the Sky of the Tenth Gate, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tribhavan bedhiaa aap muraar ||1||
english: The Lord Himself is pervading the three worlds. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: re man mere bharam na keejai ||
english: O my mind, do not give in to doubt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man maaniai a(n)mrit ras peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When the mind surrenders to the Name, it drinks in the essence of Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: janam jeet maran man maaniaa ||
english: So win the game of life; let your mind surrender and accept death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮੂਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aap mooaa man man te jaaniaa ||
english: When the self dies, the individual mind comes to know the Supreme Mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਜਰਿ ਭਈ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: najar bhaee ghar ghar te jaaniaa ||2||
english: As the inner vision is awakened, one comes to know one's own home, deep within the self. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ॥
transliteration: jat sat teerath majan naam ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is austerity, chastity and cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਕ ਬਿਥਾਰੁ ਕਰਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
transliteration: adhik bithaar karau kis kaam ||
english: What good are ostentatious displays?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਰ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nar naaraain a(n)tarajaam ||3||
english: The All-pervading Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਮਨਉ ਤਉ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aan manau tau par ghar jaau ||
english: If I had faith in someone else, then I would go to that one's house.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਜਾਚਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kis jaachau naahee ko thaau ||
english: But where should I go, to beg? There is no other place for me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak guramat sahaj samaau ||4||8||
english: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, I am intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||4||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai s maran dikhaae ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, we are shown the way to die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣ ਰਹਣ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: maran rahan ras a(n)tar bhaae ||
english: Remaining alive in this death brings joy deep within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਗਗਨ ਪੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: garab nivaar gagan pur paae ||1||
english: Overcoming egotistical pride, the Tenth Gate is found. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਆਏ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
transliteration: maran likhaai aae nahee rahanaa ||
english: Death is pre-ordained - no one who comes can remain here.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪਿ ਰਹਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jap jaap rahan har saranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: So chant and meditate on the Lord, and remain in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta dubidhaa bhaagai ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, duality is dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: kamal bigaas man har prabh laagai ||
english: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and the mind is attached to the Lord God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਆਗੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jeevat marai mahaa ras aagai ||2||
english: One who remains dead while yet alive obtains the greatest happiness hereafter. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਸੂਚਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai sach sa(n)jam soochaa ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, one becomes truthful, chaste and pure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kee pauRee oocho oochaa ||
english: Climbing up the steps of the Guru's Path, one becomes the highest of the high.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karam milai jam kaa bhau moochaa ||3||
english: When the Lord grants His Mercy, the fear of death is conquered. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur miliai mil a(n)k samaaiaa ||
english: Uniting in Guru's Union, we are absorbed in His Loving Embrace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa ghar mahal dikhaaiaa ||
english: Granting His Grace, He reveals the Mansion of His Presence, within the home of the self.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak haumai maar milaaiaa ||4||9||
english: O Nanak, conquering egotism, we are absorbed into the Lord. ||4||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਨਹ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kirat paiaa nah metai koi ||
english: Past actions cannot be erased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਆ ਆਗੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kiaa jaanaa kiaa aagai hoi ||
english: What do we know of what will happen hereafter?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਹੂਆ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaanaa soee hooaa ||
english: Whatever pleases Him shall come to pass.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਵਾਲਾ ਦੂਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: avar na karanai vaalaa dooaa ||1||
english: There is no other Doer except Him. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਰਮ ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: naa jaanaa karam kevad teree daat ||
english: I do not know about karma, or how great Your gifts are.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam tere naam kee jaat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The karma of actions, the Dharma of righteousness, social class and status, are contained within Your Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਏਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: too evad daataa devanahaar ||
english: You are So Great, O Giver, O Great Giver!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tot naahee tudh bhagat bha(n)daar ||
english: The treasure of Your devotional worship is never exhausted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਆ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: keeaa garab na aavai raas ||
english: One who takes pride in himself shall never be right.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh terai paas ||2||
english: The soul and body are all at Your disposal. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਹਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: too maar jeevaalahi bakhas milaai ||
english: You kill and rejuvenate. You forgive and merge us into Yourself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੀ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavee tiu naam japaai ||
english: As it pleases You, You inspire us to chant Your Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) daanaa beenaa saachaa sir merai ||
english: You are All-knowing, All-seeing and True, O my Supreme Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਭਰੋਸੈ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramat dei bharosai terai ||3||
english: Please, bless me with the Guru's Teachings; my faith is in You alone. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tan mahi mail naahee man raataa ||
english: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord, has no pollution in his body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gur bachanee sach sabad pachhaataa ||
english: Through the Guru's Word, the True Shabad is realized.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: teraa taan naam kee vadiaaee ||
english: All Power is Yours, through the greatness of Your Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak rahanaa bhagat saranaaee ||4||10||
english: Nanak abides in the Sanctuary of Your devotees. ||4||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਹਾਇਆ ਅਪਿਓ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin akath kahaaiaa apio peeaaiaa ||
english: Those who speak the Unspoken, drink in the Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਭੈ ਵਿਸਰੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: an bhai visare naam samaaiaa ||1||
english: Other fears are forgotten, and they are absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਡਰੀਐ ਡਰੁ ਡਰਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kiaa dareeai dar darahi samaanaa ||
english: Why should we fear, when fear is dispelled by the Fear of God?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kai sabad pachhaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, I recognize God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jis nar raam ridai har raas ||
english: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord's essence are blessed and acclaimed,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sahaj subhaai mile saabaas ||2||
english: And intuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਹਿ ਸਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਝ ਬਿਆਲ ॥
transliteration: jaahi savaarai saajh biaal ||
english: Those whom the Lord puts to sleep, evening and morning

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬਾਧੇ ਕਾਲ ॥੩॥
transliteration: it ut manamukh baadhe kaal ||3||
english: - those self-willed manmukhs are bound and gagged by Death, here and hereafter. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ahinis raam ridai se poore ||
english: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord, day and night, are perfect.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਮਿਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak raam mile bhram doore ||4||11||
english: O Nanak, they merge into the Lord, and their doubts are cast away. ||4||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: janam marai trai gun hitakaar ||
english: One who loves the three qualities is subject to birth and death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਕਥਹਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: chaare bed kathahi aakaar ||
english: The four Vedas speak only of the visible forms.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਖਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: teen avasathaa kahahi vakhiaan ||
english: They describe and explain the three states of mind,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਰੀਆਵਸਥਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tureeaavasathaa satigur te har jaan ||1||
english: but the fourth state, union with the Lord, is known only through the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: raam bhagat gur sevaa taranaa ||
english: Through devotional worship of the Lord, and service to the Guru, one swims across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਮਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: baahuR janam na hoi hai maranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Then, one is not born again, and is not subject to death. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: chaar padaarath kahai sabh koee ||
english: Everyone speaks of the four great blessings;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: si(n)mrit saasat pa(n)dit mukh soee ||
english: the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Pandits speak of them as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਰਥੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bin gur arath beechaar na paaiaa ||
english: But without the Guru, they do not understand their true significance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mukat padaarath bhagat har paaiaa ||2||
english: The treasure of liberation is obtained through devotional worship of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai hiradai vasiaa har soee ||
english: Those, within whose hearts the Lord dwells,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat paraapat hoee ||
english: become Gurmukh; they receive the blessings of devotional worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: har kee bhagat mukat aana(n)d ||
english: Through devotional worship of the Lord, liberation and bliss are obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramat paae paramaana(n)d ||3||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, supreme ecstasy is obtained. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin paaiaa gur dekh dikhaaiaa ||
english: One who meets the Guru, beholds Him, and inspires others to behold Him as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aasaa maahi niraas bujhaaiaa ||
english: In the midst of hope, the Guru teaches us to live above hope and desire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: deenaa naath sarab sukhadaataa ||
english: He is the Master of the meek, the Giver of peace to all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak har charanee man raataa ||4||12||
english: Nanak's mind is imbued with the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||4||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee chetee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਬਾਜੀ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit kaaiaa rahai sukhaalee baajee ihu sa(n)saaro ||
english: With your nectar-like body, you live in comfort, but this world is just a passing drama.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਠਾਵਹਿ ਭਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: lab lobh much kooR kamaavahi bahut uthaavahi bhaaro ||
english: You practice greed, avarice and great falsehood, and you carry such a heavy burden.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਰੁਲਦੀ ਦੇਖੀ ਜਿਉ ਧਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਛਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too(n) kaaiaa mai ruladee dekhee jiu dhar upar chhaaro ||1||
english: O body, I have seen you blowing away like dust on the earth. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sun sun sikh hamaaree ||
english: Listen - listen to my advice!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਰਹਸੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukrit keetaa rahasee mere jeeaRe bahuR na aavai vaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Only the good deeds which you have done shall remain with you, O my soul. This opportunity shall not come again! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: hau tudh aakhaa meree kaaiaa too(n) sun sikh hamaaree ||
english: I say to you, O my body: listen to my advice!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਚਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਝੂਠੀ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa chi(n)daa karahi paraaee jhoothee laaitabaaree ||
english: You slander, and then praise others; you indulge in lies and gossip.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਲਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਚੋਰੀ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: vel paraaee johahi jeeaRe karahi choree buriaaree ||
english: You gaze upon the wives of others, O my soul; you steal and commit evil deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਪਿਛੈ ਰਹੀਏਹਿ ਛੁਟੜਿ ਹੋਈਅਹਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ha(n)s chaliaa too(n) pichhai raheeehi chhutaR hoeeahi naaree ||2||
english: But when the swan departs, you shall remain behind, like an abandoned woman. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਹੀਅਹਿ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: too(n) kaaiaa raheeahi supana(n)tar tudh kiaa karam kamaaiaa ||
english: O body, you are living in a dream! What good deeds have you done?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਚੋਰੀ ਮੈ ਜਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੀਆ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar choree mai jaa kichh leeaa taa man bhalaa bhaaiaa ||
english: When I stole something by deception, then my mind was pleased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਲਤਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: halat na sobhaa palat na dhoee ahilaa janam gavaaiaa ||3||
english: I have no honor in this world, and I shall find no shelter in the world hereafter. My life has been lost, wasted in vain! ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਖਰੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ਹੋਈ ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau kharee duhelee hoee baabaa naanak meree baat na puchhai koee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am totally miserable! O Baba Nanak, no one cares for me at all! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾਜੀ ਤੁਰਕੀ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਕਪੜ ਕੇਰੇ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: taajee turakee suinaa rupaa kapaR kere bhaaraa ||
english: Turkish horses, gold, silver and loads of gorgeous clothes

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਝੜਿ ਝੜਿ ਪਏ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kis hee naal na chale naanak jhaR jhaR pae gavaaraa ||
english: - none of these shall go with you, O Nanak. They are lost and left behind, you fool!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂਜਾ ਮੇਵਾ ਮੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: koojaa mevaa mai sabh kichh chaakhiaa ik a(n)mrit naam tumaaraa ||4||
english: I have tasted all the sugar candy and sweets, but Your Name alone is Ambrosial Nectar. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਨੀਵ ਦਿਵਾਲ ਉਸਾਰੀ ਭਸਮੰਦਰ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: de de neev divaal usaaree bhasama(n)dar kee dheree ||
english: Digging deep foundations, the walls are constructed, but in the end, the buildings return to heaps of dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਚੇ ਸੰਚਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)che sa(n)ch na deee kis hee a(n)dh jaanai sabh meree ||
english: People gather and hoard their possessions, and give nothing to anyone else - the poor fools think that everything is theirs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਇਨ ਲੰਕਾ ਸੋਇਨ ਮਾੜੀ ਸੰਪੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: soin la(n)kaa soin maaRee sa(n)pai kisai na keree ||5||
english: Riches do not remain with anyone - not even the golden palaces of Sri Lanka. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੰਨ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sun moorakh ma(n)n ajaanaa ||
english: Listen, you foolish and ignorant mind

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਗੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hog tisai kaa bhaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - only His Will prevails. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saahu hamaaraa thaakur bhaaraa ham tis ke vanajaare ||
english: My Banker is the Great Lord and Master. I am only His petty merchant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਰਾਸਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ॥੬॥੧॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh raas tisai kee maar aape jeevaale ||6||1||13||
english: This soul and body all are His. He Himself kills, and brings back to life. ||6||1||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee chetee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਹਮ ਏਕ ਜਨਾ ਕਿਉ ਰਾਖਉ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: avar pa(n)ch ham ek janaa kiu raakhau ghar baar manaa ||
english: There are five of them, but I am all alone. How can I protect my hearth and home, O my mind?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਹਿ ਲੂਟਹਿ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maarahi lootahi neet neet kis aagai karee pukaar janaa ||1||
english: They are beating and plundering me over and over again; unto whom can I complain? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਚਰੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sree raam naamaa uchar manaa ||
english: Chant the Name of the Supreme Lord, O my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਜਮ ਦਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਘਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aagai jam dal bikham ghanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Otherwise, in the world hereafter, you will have to face the awesome and cruel army of Death. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਸਾਰਿ ਮੜੋਲੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬੈਠੀ ਸਾ ਧਨਾ ॥
transliteration: usaar maRolee raakhai duaaraa bheetar baithee saa dhanaa ||
english: God has erected the temple of the body; He has placed the nine doors, and the soul-bride sits within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਅਵਰਿ ਲੁਟੇਨਿ ਸੁ ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit kel kare nit kaaman avar luten s pa(n)ch janaa ||2||
english: She enjoys the sweet play again and again, while the five demons are plundering her. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਢਾਹਿ ਮੜੋਲੀ ਲੂਟਿਆ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਪਕੜੀ ਏਕ ਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: dhaahi maRolee lootiaa dehuraa saa dhan pakaRee ek janaa ||
english: In this way, the temple is being demolished; the body is being plundered, and the soul-bride, left all alone, is captured.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਡੰਡਾ ਗਲਿ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਪੜਿਆ ਭਾਗਿ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jam da(n)daa gal sa(n)gal paRiaa bhaag gae se pa(n)ch janaa ||3||
english: Death strikes her down with his rod, the shackles are placed around her neck, and now the five have left. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਲੋੜੈ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਲੁੜੇਨਿ ਸੁ ਖਾਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaman loRai suinaa rupaa mitr luRen s khaadhaataa ||
english: The wife yearns for gold and silver, and her friends, the senses, yearn for good food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak paap kare tin kaaran jaasee jamapur baadhaataa ||4||2||14||
english: O Nanak, she commits sins for their sake; she shall go, bound and gagged, to the City of Death. ||4||2||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee chetee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਤੇ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਖਿੰਥਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)draa te ghat bheetar mu(n)draa kaa(n)iaa keejai khi(n)thaataa ||
english: Let your ear-rings be those ear-rings which pierce deep within your heart. Let your body be your patched coat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਚੇਲੇ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਜਹਿ ਰਾਵਲ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਡੰਡਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch chele vas keejahi raaval ihu man keejai da(n)daataa ||1||
english: Let the five passions be disciples under your control, O begging Yogi, and make this mind your walking stick. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jog jugat iv paavasitaa ||
english: Thus you shall find the Way of Yoga.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ek sabad doojaa hor naasat ka(n)d mool man laavasitaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: There is only the One Word of the Shabad; everything else shall pass away. Let this be the fruits and roots of your mind's diet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂੰਡਿ ਮੁੰਡਾਇਐ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਮ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਗੰਗਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: moo(n)d mu(n)daaiai je gur paaeeai ham gur keenee ga(n)gaataa ||
english: Some try to find the Guru by shaving their heads at the Ganges, but I have made the Guru my Ganges.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਅੰਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tribhavan taaranahaar suaamee ek na chetas a(n)dhaataa ||2||
english: The Saving Grace of the three worlds is the One Lord and Master, but those in darkness do not remember Him. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਪਟੰਬੁ ਗਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਸਿ ਸੰਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kar pata(n)b galee man laavas sa(n)saa mool na jaavasitaa ||
english: Practicing hypocrisy and attaching your mind to worldly objects, your doubt shall never depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਜੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਕੀ ਧਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ekas charanee je chit laavahi lab lobh kee dhaavasitaa ||3||
english: If you focus your consciousness on the Feet of the One Lord, what reason would you have to chase after greed? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਚਸਿ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: japas nira(n)jan rachas manaa ||
english: Meditate on the Immaculate Lord, and saturate your mind with Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਪਟੁ ਘਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaahe bolahi jogee kapat ghanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Why, O Yogi, do you make so many false and deceptive claims? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਮਲੀ ਹੰਸੁ ਇਆਣਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਣੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kamalee ha(n)s iaanaa meree meree karat bihaaneetaa ||
english: The body is wild, and the mind is foolish. Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, your life is passing away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਗੀ ਦਾਝੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੫॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak naagee daajhai phir paachhai pachhutaaneetaa ||4||3||15||
english: Prays Nanak, when the naked body is cremated, then you will come to regret and repent. ||4||3||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee chetee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲੁ ਮਨ ਏਕੈ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aukhadh ma(n)tr mool man ekai je kar driR chit keejai re ||
english: O mind, there is only the One medicine, mantra and healing herb - center your consciousness firmly on the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam janam ke paap karam ke kaatanahaaraa leejai re ||1||
english: Take to the Lord, the Destroyer of the sins and karma of past incarnations. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man eko saahib bhaaee re ||
english: The One Lord and Master is pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tere teen gunaa sa(n)saar samaavahi alakh na lakhanaa jaaee re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In Your three qualities, the world is engrossed; the Unknowable cannot be known. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਕਰ ਖੰਡੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਹਮ ਤਉ ਪੰਡ ਉਚਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sakar kha(n)d maaiaa tan meethee ham tau pa(n)d uchaaee re ||
english: Maya is so sweet to the body, like sugar or molasses. We all carry loads of it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਰੀ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਲਜੁ ਟੂਕਸਿ ਮੂਸਾ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raat aneree soojhas naahee laj tookas moosaa bhaaee re ||2||
english: In the dark of the night, nothing can be seen. The mouse of death is gnawing away at the rope of life, O Siblings of Destiny! ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh karahi tetaa dukh laagai guramukh milai vadaaee re ||
english: As the self-willed manmukhs act, they suffer in pain. The Gurmukh obtains honor and greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo tin keeaa soee hoaa kirat na metiaa jaaee re ||3||
english: Whatever He does, that alone happens; past actions cannot be erased. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਊਣੇ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: subhar bhare na hovahi oone jo raate ra(n)g laaee re ||
english: Those who are imbued with, and committed to the Lord's Love, are filled to overflowing; they never lack anything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਉ ਮੂੜਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੬॥
transliteration: tin kee pa(n)k hovai je naanak tau mooRaa kichh paaee re ||4||4||16||
english: If Nanak could be the dust of their feet, then he, the ignorant one, might also obtain some. ||4||4||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee chetee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਤ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪੁ ਕਤ ਕੇਰਾ ਕਿਦੂ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਹਮ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: kat kee maaee baap kat keraa kidoo thaavahu ham aae ||
english: Who is our mother, and who is our father? Where did we come from?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿੰਬ ਜਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨਿਪਜੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੰਮਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: agan bi(n)b jal bheetar nipaje kaahe ka(n)m upaae ||1||
english: We are formed from the fire of the womb within, and the bubble of water of the sperm. For what purpose are we created? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mere saahibaa kaun jaanai gun tere ||
english: O my Master, who can know Your Glorious Virtues?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੇ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਅਉਗਣ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kahe na jaanee augan mere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My own demerits cannot be counted. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਰੁਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਹਮ ਚੀਨੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਸੂ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kete rukh birakh ham cheene kete pasoo upaae ||
english: I took the form of so many plants and trees, and so many animals.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਨਾਗ ਕੁਲੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ਕੇਤੇ ਪੰਖ ਉਡਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kete naag kulee mahi aae kete pa(n)kh udaae ||2||
english: Many times I entered the families of snakes and flying birds. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਿਜ ਮੰਦਰ ਭੰਨੈ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਰੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hat patan bij ma(n)dar bha(n)nai kar choree ghar aavai ||
english: I broke into the shops of the city and well-guarded palaces; stealing from them, I snuck home again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਿਛਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: agahu dekhai pichhahu dekhai tujh te kahaa chhapaavai ||3||
english: I looked in front of me, and I looked behind me, but where could I hide from You? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਹਮ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tat teerath ham nav kha(n)d dekhe hat patan baajaaraa ||
english: I saw the banks of sacred rivers, the nine continents, the shops and bazaars of the cities.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਤਕੜੀ ਤੋਲਣਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: lai kai takaRee tolan laagaa ghat hee mahi vanajaaraa ||4||
english: Taking the scale, the merchant begins to weigh his actions within his own heart. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਤੇਤੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jetaa samu(n)d saagar neer bhariaa tete augan hamaare ||
english: As the seas and the oceans are overflowing with water, so vast are my own sins.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਹਰ ਉਪਾਵਹੁ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਥਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: daiaa karahu kichh mihar upaavahu dubade pathar taare ||5||
english: Please, shower me with Your Mercy, and take pity upon me. I am a sinking stone - please carry me across! ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅੜਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਤਪੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਗੈ ਕਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: jeeaRaa agan baraabar tapai bheetar vagai kaatee ||
english: My soul is burning like fire, and the knife is cutting deep.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੬॥੫॥੧੭॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak hukam pachhaanai sukh hovai din raatee ||6||5||17||
english: Prays Nanak, recognizing the Lord's Command, I am at peace, day and night. ||6||5||17||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਸੋਇ ਕੈ ਦਿਵਸੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: rain gavaaee soi kai divas gavaaiaa khaai ||
english: The nights are wasted sleeping, and the days are wasted eating.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੀਰੇ ਜੈਸਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: heere jaisaa janam hai kaudee badale jaai ||1||
english: Human life is such a precious jewel, but it is being lost in exchange for a mere shell. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: naam na jaaniaa raam kaa ||
english: You do not know the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂੜੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mooRe phir paachhai pachhutaahi re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You fool - you shall regret and repent in the end! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਧਰਣੀ ਧਰੇ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਚਾਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anataa dhan dharanee dhare anat na chaahiaa jaai ||
english: You bury your temporary wealth in the ground, but how can you love that which is temporary?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਤ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਨ ਜੋ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਆਏ ਅਨਤ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anat kau chaahan jo gae se aae anat gavaai ||2||
english: Those who have departed, after craving for temporary wealth, have returned home without this temporary wealth. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਭਾਗਠੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aapan leeaa je milai taa sabh ko bhaagath hoi ||
english: If people could gather it in by their own efforts, then everyone would be so lucky.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karamaa upar nibaRai je lochai sabh koi ||3||
english: According to the karma of past actions, one's destiny unfolds, even though everyone wants to be so lucky. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak karanaa jin keeaa soee saar karei ||
english: O Nanak, the One who created the creation - He alone takes care of it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੮॥
transliteration: hukam na jaapee khasam kaa kisai vadaaee dei ||4||1||18||
english: The Hukam of our Lord and Master's Command cannot be known; He Himself blesses us with greatness. ||4||1||18||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਣੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਬਨਿ ਬਸਾ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਉ ॥
transliteration: haranee hovaa ban basaa ka(n)d mool chun khaau ||
english: What if I were to become a deer, and live in the forest, picking and eating fruits and roots

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਹਉ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee meraa sahu milai vaar vaar hau jaau jeeu ||1||
english: - by Guru's Grace, I am a sacrifice to my Master. Again and again, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਬਨਜਾਰਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: mai banajaaran raam kee ||
english: I am the shop-keeper of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teraa naam vakhar vaapaar jee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your Name is my merchandise and trade. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਕਿਲ ਹੋਵਾ ਅੰਬਿ ਬਸਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kokil hovaa a(n)b basaa sahaj sabad beechaar ||
english: If I were to become a cuckoo, living in a mango tree, I would still contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sahaj subhaai meraa sahu milai darasan roop apaar ||2||
english: I would still meet my Lord and Master, with intuitive ease; the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of His Form, is incomparably beautiful. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਸਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: machhulee hovaa jal basaa jee ja(n)t sabh saar ||
english: If I were to become a fish, living in the water, I would still remember the Lord, who watches over all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਉ ਮਿਲਉਗੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: uravaar paar meraa sahu vasai hau milaugee baah pasaar ||3||
english: My Husband Lord dwells on this shore, and on the shore beyond; I would still meet Him, and hug Him close in my embrace. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਗਨਿ ਹੋਵਾ ਧਰ ਵਸਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naagan hovaa dhar vasaa sabad vasai bhau jaai ||
english: If I were to become a snake, living in the ground, the Shabad would still dwell in my mind, and my fears would be dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak sadaa sohaaganee jin jotee jot samaai ||4||2||19||
english: O Nanak, they are forever the happy soul-brides, whose light merges into His Light. ||4||2||19||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਦੀਪਕੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee deepakee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree Poorbee Deepkee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: jai ghar keerat aakheeai karate kaa hoi beechaaro ||
english: In that house where the Praises of the Creator are chanted

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਿਵਰਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tit ghar gaavahu sohilaa sivarahu sirajanahaaro ||1||
english: - in that house, sing the Songs of Praise, and meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ॥
transliteration: tum gaavahu mere nirabhau kaa sohilaa ||
english: Sing the Songs of Praise of my Fearless Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਾਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree jaau jit sohilai sadaa sukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to that Song of Praise which brings eternal peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਦੇਖੈਗਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: nit nit jeeaRe samaaleean dekhaigaa devanahaar ||
english: Day after day, He cares for His beings; the Great Giver watches over all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਤੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tere daanai keemat naa pavai tis daate kavan sumaar ||2||
english: Your gifts cannot be appraised; how can anyone compare to the Giver? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਬਤਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)bat saahaa likhiaa mil kar paavahu tel ||
english: The day of my wedding is pre-ordained. Come - let's gather together and pour the oil over the threshold.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਜਣ ਆਸੀਸੜੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dehu sajan aaseesaReeaa jiu hovai saahib siu mel ||3||
english: My friends, give me your blessings, that I may merge with my Lord and Master. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹੋ ਪਾਹੁਚਾ ਸਦੜੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: ghar ghar eho paahuchaa sadaRe nit pava(n)n ||
english: Unto each and every home, into each and every heart, this summons is sent out; the call comes each and every day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦਣਹਾਰਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਦਿਹ ਆਵੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੦॥
transliteration: sadanahaaraa simareeai naanak se dih aava(n)n ||4||1||20||
english: Remember in meditation the One who summons us; O Nanak, that day is drawing near! ||4||1||20||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee guaareree || mahalaa 3 chaupade ||
english: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree: Third Mehl, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur miliai har melaa hoee ||
english: Meeting the Guru, we meet the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape mel milaavai soee ||
english: He Himself unites us in His Union.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh sabh bidh aape jaanai ||
english: My God knows all His Own Ways.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hukame mele sabad pachhaanai ||1||
english: By the Hukam of His Command, He unites those who recognize the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਇ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kai bhai bhram bhau jaai ||
english: By the Fear of the True Guru, doubt and fear are dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਰਾਚੈ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhai raachai sach ra(n)g samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Imbued with His Fear, we are absorbed in the Love of the True One. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur miliai har man vasai subhaai ||
english: Meeting the Guru, the Lord naturally dwells within the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh bhaaraa keemat nahee paai ||
english: My God is Great and Almighty; His value cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabad saalaahai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: Through the Shabad, I praise Him; He has no end or limitations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: meraa prabh bakhase bakhasanahaar ||2||
english: My God is the Forgiver. I pray that He may forgive me. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur miliai sabh mat budh hoi ||
english: Meeting the Guru, all wisdom and understanding are obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man niramal vasai sach soi ||
english: The mind becomes pure, when the True Lord dwells within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਵਸਿਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਭ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: saach vasiai saachee sabh kaar ||
english: When one dwells in Truth, all actions become true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ootam karanee sabad beechaar ||3||
english: The ultimate action is to contemplate the Word of the Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur te saachee sevaa hoi ||
english: Through the Guru, true service is performed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam pachhaanai koi ||
english: How rare is that Gurmukh who recognizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jeevai daataa devanahaar ||
english: The Giver, the Great Giver, lives forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak har naame lagai piaar ||4||1||21||
english: Nanak enshrines love for the Name of the Lord. ||4||1||21||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur te giaan paae jan koi ||
english: Those who obtain spiritual wisdom from the Guru are very rare.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੀਝੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur te boojhai seejhai soi ||
english: Those who obtain this understanding from the Guru become acceptable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur te sahaj saach beechaar ||
english: Through the Guru, we intuitively contemplate the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur te paae mukat duaar ||1||
english: Through the Guru, the Gate of Liberation is found. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag milai gur aai ||
english: Through perfect good destiny, we come to meet the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saachai sahaj saach samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The true ones are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur miliai trisanaa agan bujhaae ||
english: Meeting the Guru, the fire of desire is quenched.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: gur te saa(n)t vasai man aae ||
english: Through the Guru, peace and tranquility come to dwell within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੁਚਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur te pavit paavan such hoi ||
english: Through the Guru, we become pure, holy and true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur te sabad milaavaa hoi ||2||
english: Through the Guru, we are absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: baajh guroo sabh bharam bhulaaee ||
english: Without the Guru, everyone wanders in doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai bahutaa dukh paaee ||
english: Without the Name, they suffer in terrible pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s naam dhiaaee ||
english: Those who meditate on the Naam become Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: darasan sachai sachee pat hoee ||3||
english: True honor is obtained through the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਦਾਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kis no kaheeai daataa ik soee ||
english: Why speak of any other? He alone is the Giver.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa kare sabad milaavaa hoee ||
english: When He grants His Grace, union with the Shabad is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: mil preetam saache gun gaavaa ||
english: Meeting with my Beloved, I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak saache saach samaavaa ||4||2||22||
english: O Nanak, becoming true, I am absorbed in the True One. ||4||2||22||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁ ਥਾਉ ਸਚੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: s thaau sach man niramal hoi ||
english: True is that place, where the mind becomes pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sach nivaas kare sach soi ||
english: True is the one who abides in Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: sachee baanee jug chaare jaapai ||
english: The True Bani of the Word is known throughout the four ages.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh kichh saachaa aape aapai ||1||
english: The True One Himself is everything. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: karam hovai satasa(n)g milaae ||
english: Through the karma of good actions, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁ ਥਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavai bais s thaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Sing the Glories of the Lord, sitting in that place. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਲਉ ਇਹ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jalau ih jihavaa doojai bhaai ||
english: Burn this tongue, which loves duality,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਾਖੈ ਫੀਕਾ ਆਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har ras na chaakhai pheekaa aalaai ||
english: which does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and which utters insipid words.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin boojhe tan man pheekaa hoi ||
english: Without understanding, the body and mind become tasteless and insipid.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin naavai dukheeaa chaliaa roi ||2||
english: Without the Name, the miserable ones depart crying out in pain. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa har ras chaakhiaa sahaj subhaai ||
english: One whose tongue naturally and intuitively tastes the Lord's sublime essence,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te sach samaai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, is absorbed in the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: saache raatee gurasabad veechaar ||
english: Imbued with Truth, one contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਧਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit peevai niramal dhaar ||3||
english: and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, from the immaculate stream within. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਭਾਡਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naam samaavai jo bhaadaa hoi ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is collected in the vessel of the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਊਂਧੈ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: oo(n)dhai bhaa(n)dai tikai na koi ||
english: Nothing is collected if the vessel is upside-down.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee man naam nivaas ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Naam abides within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਪਿਆਸ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੩॥
transliteration: naanak sach bhaa(n)daa jis sabad piaas ||4||3||23||
english: O Nanak, True is that vessel of the mind, which thirsts for the Shabad. ||4||3||23||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਰਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik gaavat rahe man saad na paai ||
english: Some sing on and on, but their minds do not find happiness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai vich gaavahi birathaa jaai ||
english: In egotism, they sing, but it is wasted uselessly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਣਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gaavan gaavahi jin naam piaar ||
english: Those who love the Naam, sing the song.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saachee baanee sabad beechaar ||1||
english: They contemplate the True Bani of the Word, and the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਤ ਰਹੈ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gaavat rahai je satigur bhaavai ||
english: They sing on and on, if it pleases the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man tan raataa naam suhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Their minds and bodies are embellished and adorned, attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik gaavahi ik bhagat karehi ||
english: Some sing, and some perform devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਸਨੇਹ ॥
transliteration: naam na paavahi bin asaneh ||
english: Without heart-felt love, the Naam is not obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sachee bhagat gurasabad piaar ||
english: True devotional worship consists of love for the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: apanaa pir raakhiaa sadaa ur dhaar ||2||
english: The devotee keeps his Beloved clasped tightly to his heart. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bhagat karahi moorakh aap janaavahi ||
english: The fools perform devotional worship by showing off;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਚਿ ਨਚਿ ਟਪਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: nach nach tapahi bahut dukh paavahi ||
english: they dance and dance and jump all around, but they only suffer in terrible pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਚਿਐ ਟਪਿਐ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: nachiai tapiai bhagat na hoi ||
english: By dancing and jumping, devotional worship is not performed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabad marai bhagat paae jan soi ||3||
english: But one who dies in the Word of the Shabad, obtains devotional worship. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal bhagat karaae soi ||
english: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He inspires them to perform devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sachee bhagat vichahu aap khoi ||
english: True devotional worship consists of eliminating selfishness and conceit from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa sabh bidh jaanai ||
english: My True God knows all ways and means.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੪॥
transliteration: naanak bakhase naam pachhaanai ||4||4||24||
english: O Nanak, He forgives those who recognize the Naam. ||4||4||24||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਧਾਤੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man maare dhaat mar jaai ||
english: When someone kills and subdues his own mind, his wandering nature is also subdued.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਮੂਏ ਕੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin mooe kaise har paai ||
english: Without such a death, how can one find the Lord?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man marai daaroo jaanai koi ||
english: Only a few know the medicine to kill the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man sabad marai boojhai jan soi ||1||
english: One whose mind dies in the Word of the Shabad, understands Him. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jis no bakhase de vadiaaee ||
english: He grants greatness to those whom He forgives.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad har vasai man aaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh karanee kaar kamaavai ||
english: The Gurmukh practices doing good deeds;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: taa is man kee sojhee paavai ||
english: thus he comes to understand this mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਮਤੁ ਮੈਗਲ ਮਿਕਦਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man mai mat maigal mikadaaraa ||
english: The mind is like an elephant, drunk with wine.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur a(n)kas maar jeevaalanahaaraa ||2||
english: The Guru is the rod which controls it, and shows it the way. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਸਾਧੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man asaadh saadhai jan koi ||
english: The mind is uncontrollable; how rare are those who subdue it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: achar charai taa niramal hoi ||
english: Those who move the immovable become pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਇਆ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ihu man laiaa savaar ||
english: The Gurmukhs embellish and beautify this mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਤਜੇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: haumai vichahu taje vikaar ||3||
english: They eradicate egotism and corruption from within. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਅਨੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo dhur raakhian mel milaai ||
english: Those who, by pre-ordained destiny, are united in the Lord's Union,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kade na vichhuRahi sabad samaai ||
english: are never separated from Him again; they are absorbed in the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਕਲਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: aapanee kalaa aape hee jaanai ||
english: He Himself knows His Own Almighty Power.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh naam pachhaanai ||4||5||25||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||5||25||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai vich sabh jag bauraanaa ||
english: The entire world has gone insane in egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai bharam bhulaanaa ||
english: In the love of duality, it wanders deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
