transliteration: bahu chi(n)taa chitavai aap na pachhaanaa ||
english: The mind is distracted by great anxiety; no one recognizes one's own self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਿਹਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa karatiaa anadin vihaanaa ||1||
english: Occupied with their own affairs, their nights and days are passing away. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hiradai raam ramahu mere bhaaee ||
english: Meditate on the Lord in your hearts, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh rasanaa har rasan rasaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Gurmukh's tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hiradai jin raam pachhaataa ||
english: The Gurmukhs recognize the Lord in their own hearts;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan sev jug chaare jaataa ||
english: they serve the Lord, the Life of the World. They are famous throughout the four ages.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar gur sabad pachhaataa ||
english: They subdue egotism, and realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kripaa kare prabh karam bidhaataa ||2||
english: God, the Architect of Destiny, showers His Mercy upon them. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: se jan sache jo gur sabad milaae ||
english: True are those who merge into the Word of the Guru's Shabad;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤ ਵਰਜੇ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat varaje thaak rahaae ||
english: they restrain their wandering mind and keep it steady.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naam nav nidh gur te paae ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the nine treasures. It is obtained from the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har kirapaa te har vasai man aae ||3||
english: By the Lord's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
transliteration: raam raam karatiaa sukh saa(n)t sareer ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, the body becomes peaceful and tranquil.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਮ ਪੀਰ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar vasai na laagai jam peer ||
english: He dwells deep within - the pain of death does not touch Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਜੀਰ ॥
transliteration: aape saahib aap vajeer ||
english: He Himself is our Lord and Master; He is His Own Advisor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੬॥
transliteration: naanak sev sadaa har gunee gaheer ||4||6||26||
english: O Nanak, serve the Lord forever; He is the treasure of glorious virtue. ||4||6||26||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: so kiu visarai jis ke jee paraanaa ||
english: Why forget Him, unto whom the soul and the breath of life belong?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: so kiu visarai sabh maahi samaanaa ||
english: Why forget Him, who is all-pervading?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jit seviai daragah pat paravaanaa ||1||
english: Serving Him, one is honored and accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam vitahu bal jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤਦਿ ਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) visarahi tad hee mar jaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If I were to forget You, at that very instant, I would die. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tin too(n) visarahi j tudh aap bhulaae ||
english: Those whom You Yourself have led astray, forget You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tin too(n) visarahi j doojai bhaae ||
english: Thse who are in love with duality forget You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: manamukh agiaanee jonee paae ||2||
english: The ignorant, self-willed manmukhs are consigned to reincarnation. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jin ik man tuthaa se satigur sevaa laae ||
english: Those who are pleasing to the One Lord are assigned

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jin ik man tuthaa tin har ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: to His service and enshrine Him within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramatee har naam samaae ||3||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, they are absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jinaa potai pu(n)n se giaan beechaaree ||
english: Those who have virtue as their treasure, contemplate spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jinaa potai pu(n)n tin haumai maaree ||
english: Those who have virtue as their treasure, subdue egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak jo naam rate tin kau balihaaree ||4||7||27||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||7||27||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਥਿਆ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: too(n) akath kiu kathiaa jaahi ||
english: You are Indescribable; how can I describe You?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਮਾਰਣੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gurasabad maaran man maahi samaahi ||
english: Those who subdue their minds, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, are absorbed in You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਅਨੇਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tere gun anek keemat nah paahi ||1||
english: Your Glorious Virtues are countless; their value cannot be estimated. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jis kee baanee tis maahi samaanee ||
english: The Word of His Bani belongs to Him; in Him, it is diffused.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teree akath kathaa gur sabad vakhaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your Speech cannot be spoken; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is chanted. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਹ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jah satigur tah satasa(n)gat banaaee ||
english: Where the True Guru is - there is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jah satigur sahaje har gun gaaee ||
english: Where the True Guru is - there, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are intuitively sung.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਹਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jah satigur tahaa haumai sabad jalaaee ||2||
english: Where the True Guru is - there egotism is burnt away, through the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਹਲੀ ਥਾਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sevaa mahalee thaau paae ||
english: The Gurmukhs serve Him; they obtain a place in the Mansion of His Presence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh a(n)tar har naam vasaae ||
english: The Gurmukhs enshrine the Naam within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat har naam samaae ||3||
english: The Gurmukhs worship the Lord, and are absorbed in the Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape daat kare daataar ||
english: The Giver Himself gives His Gifts,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: poore satigur siu lagai piaar ||
english: as we enshrine love for the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੮॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate tin kau jaikaar ||4||8||28||
english: Nanak celebrates those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||8||28||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੂਪ ਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: ekas te sabh roop hahi ra(n)gaa ||
english: All forms and colors come from the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਸਭਿ ਸਹਲੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: paun paanee baisa(n)tar sabh sahala(n)gaa ||
english: Air, water and fire are all kept together.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhi(n)n bhi(n)n vekhai har prabh ra(n)gaa ||1||
english: The Lord God beholds the many and various colors. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ek acharaj eko hai soee ||
english: The One Lord is wondrous and amazing! He is the One, the One and Only.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh veechaare viralaa koee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How rare is that Gurmukh who meditates on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਭਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sahaj bhavai prabh sabhanee thaaee ||
english: God is naturally pervading all places.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahaa gupat pragat prabh banat banaaee ||
english: Sometimes He is hidden, and sometimes He is revealed; thus God has made the world of His making.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਜਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape sutiaa dei jagaaee ||2||
english: He Himself wakes us from sleep. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tis kee keemat kinai na hoee ||
english: No one can estimate His value,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਥਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kahi kahi kathan kahai sabh koee ||
english: although everyone has tried, over and over again, to describe Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur sabad samaavai boojhai har soee ||3||
english: Those who merge in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, come to understand the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sun sun vekhai sabad milaae ||
english: They listen to the Shabad continually; beholding Him, they merge into Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: vadee vadiaaee gur sevaa te paae ||
english: They obtain glorious greatness by serving the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੯॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate har naam samaae ||4||9||29||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Name are absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||4||9||29||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sootaa maaiaa mohi piaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are asleep, in love and attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jaage gun giaan beechaar ||
english: The Gurmukhs are awake, contemplating spiritual wisdom and the Glory of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: se jan jaage jin naam piaar ||1||
english: Those humble beings who love the Naam, are awake and aware. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sahaje jaagai savai na koi ||
english: One who is awake to this intuitive wisdom does not fall asleep.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poore gur te boojhai jan koi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How rare are those humble beings who understand this through the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਤੁ ਅਨਾੜੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)t anaaRee kade na boojhai ||
english: The unsaintly blockhead shall never understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: kathanee kare tai maaiaa naal loojhai ||
english: He babbles on and on, but he is infatuated with Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਸੀਝੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)dh agiaanee kade na seejhai ||2||
english: Blind and ignorant, he shall never be reformed. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: is jug mahi raam naam nisataaraa ||
english: In this age, salvation comes only from the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: viralaa ko paae gur sabad veechaaraa ||
english: How rare are those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap tarai sagale kul udhaaraa ||3||
english: They save themselves, and save all their family and ancestors as well. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: is kalijug mahi karam dharam na koee ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, no one is interested in good karma, or Dharmic faith.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲੀ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਚੰਡਾਲ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kalee kaa janam cha(n)daal kai ghar hoee ||
english: This Dark Age was born in the house of evil.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੩੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam binaa ko mukat na hoee ||4||10||30||
english: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one is liberated. ||4||10||30||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 3 guaareree ||
english: Gauree, Third Mehl, Gwaarayree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sachaa amar sachaa paatisaahu ||
english: True is the Lord King, True is His Royal Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: man saachai raate har veparavaahu ||
english: Those whose minds are attuned to the True,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sachai mahal sach naam samaahu ||1||
english: Carefree Lord enter the True Mansion of His Presence, and merge in the True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sun man mere sabad veechaar ||
english: Listen, O my mind: contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam japahu bhavajal utarahu paar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chant the Lord's Name, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਆਵੈ ਭਰਮੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bharame aavai bharame jaai ||
english: In doubt he comes, and in doubt he goes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਨਮਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu jag janamiaa doojai bhaai ||
english: This world is born out of the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: manamukh na chetai aavai jaai ||2||
english: The self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord; he continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aap bhulaa k prabh aap bhulaaiaa ||
english: Does he himself go astray, or does God lead him astray?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ihu jeeu vidaanee chaakaree laaiaa ||
english: This soul is enjoined to the service of someone else.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mahaa dukh khate birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||3||
english: It earns only terrible pain, and this life is lost in vain. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa kar satiguroo milaae ||
english: Granting His Grace, He leads us to meet the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: eko naam chete vichahu bharam chukaae ||
english: Remembering the One Name, doubt is cast out from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੩੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam jape naau nau nidh paae ||4||11||31||
english: O Nanak, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the nine treasures of the Name are obtained. ||4||11||31||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jinaa guramukh dhiaaiaa tin poochhau jaai ||
english: Go and ask the Gurmukhs, who meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te man pateeaai ||
english: Serving the Guru, the mind is satisfied.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: se dhanava(n)t har naam kamaai ||
english: Those who earn the Lord's Name are wealthy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poore gur te sojhee paai ||1||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, understanding is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu mere bhaaee ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਘਾਲ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sevaa har ghaal thaai paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Gurmukhs serve the Lord, and so they are accepted. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aap pachhaanai man niramal hoi ||
english: Those who recognize the self - their minds become pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jeevan mukat har paavai soi ||
english: They become Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive, and they find the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavai mat ootam hoi ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the intellect becomes pure and sublime,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sahaje sahaj samaavai soi ||2||
english: and they are easily and intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai na seviaa jaai ||
english: In the love of duality, no one can serve the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai maaiaa mahaa bikh khaai ||
english: In egotism and Maya, they are eating toxic poison.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤਿ ਕੁਟੰਬਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: put kuta(n)b grihi mohiaa maai ||
english: They are emotionally attached to their children, family and home.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhaa aavai jaai ||3||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs come and go in reincarnation. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam devai jan soi ||
english: Those, unto whom the Lord bestows His Name,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat gurasabadee hoi ||
english: Worship Him night and day, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramat viralaa boojhai koi ||
english: How rare are those who understand the Guru's Teachings!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੩੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam samaavai soi ||4||12||32||
english: O Nanak, they are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||12||32||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa jug chaare hoee ||
english: The Guru's service has been performed throughout the four ages.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: pooraa jan kaar kamaavai koee ||
english: Very few are those perfect ones who do this good deed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: akhut naam dhan har tot na hoee ||
english: The wealth of the Lord's Name is inexhaustible; it shall never be exhausted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aithai sadaa sukh dar sobhaa hoee ||1||
english: In this world, it brings a constant peace, and at the Lord's Gate, it brings honor. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: e man mere bharam na keejai ||
english: O my mind, have no doubt about this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sevaa a(n)mrit ras peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those Gurmukhs who serve, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਮਹਾਪੁਰਖ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi se mahaapurakh sa(n)saare ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru are the greatest people of the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aap udhare kul sagal nisataare ||
english: They save themselves, and they redeem all their generations as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam rakhahi ur dhaare ||
english: They keep the Name of the Lord clasped tightly to their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਭਉਜਲ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam rate bhaujal utarahi paare ||2||
english: Attuned to the Naam, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi sadaa man daasaa ||
english: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes humble forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar kamal paragaasaa ||
english: Egotism is subdued, and the heart-lotus blossoms forth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: anahad vaajai nij ghar vaasaa ||
english: The Unstruck Melody vibrates, as they dwell within the home of the self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਘਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam rate ghar maahi udaasaa ||3||
english: Attuned to the Naam, they remain detached within their own home. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi tin kee sachee baanee ||
english: Serving the True Guru, their words are true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jug jug bhagatee aakh vakhaanee ||
english: Throughout the ages, the devotees chant and repeat these words.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਰੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: anadin japahi har saara(n)gapaanee ||
english: Night and day, they meditate on the Lord, the Sustainer of the Earth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੩੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate nihakeval nirabaanee ||4||13||33||
english: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they are detached, in the perfect balance of Nirvaanaa. ||4||13||33||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai vadabhaag sa(n)jog ||
english: Through great good fortune and high destiny, one meets the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hiradai naam nit har ras bhog ||1||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is constantly within the heart, and one enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh praanee naam har dhiaai ||
english: O mortal, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam jeet laahaa naam paai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Be victorious in the game of life, and earn the profit of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan gurasabad hai meethaa ||
english: Spiritual wisdom and meditation come to those unto whom the Word of the Guru's Shabad is sweet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te kinai viralai chakh deethaa ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, a few have tasted, and seen it. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਾਂਡ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: karam kaa(n)d bahu karahi achaar ||
english: They may perform all sorts of religious rituals and good actions,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin naavai dhrig dhrig aha(n)kaar ||3||
english: but without the Name, the egotistical ones are cursed and doomed. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan baadhio maaiaa phaas ||
english: They are bound and gagged, and hung by Maya's noose;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੩੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak chhootai gur paragaas ||4||14||34||
english: O servant Nanak, they shall be released only by Guru's Grace. ||4||14||34||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 3 gauRee bairaagan ||
english: Third Mehl, Gauree Bairaagan:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਊਪਰਿਮੇਘੁਲਾ ਬਰਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਧੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jaisee dharatee ooparimeghulaa barasat hai kiaa dharatee madhe paanee naahee ||
english: The clouds pour their rain down upon the earth, but isn't there water within the earth as well?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਧੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਗਾ ਵਰਸਤ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaise dharatee madhe paanee paragaasiaa bin pagaa varasat phiraahee ||1||
english: Water is contained within the earth; without feet, the clouds run around and let down their rain. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਤੂੰ ਐਸੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: baabaa too(n) aise bharam chukaahee ||
english: O Baba, get rid of your doubts like this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤੈਸੇ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karat hai soee koee hai re taise jaai samaahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As you act, so shall you become, and so you shall go and mingle. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸਤਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਕਿਆ ਓਇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: isataree purakh hoi kai kiaa oi karam kamaahee ||
english: As woman or man, what can anyone do?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਸਦਾ ਹਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanaa roop sadaa hahi tere tujh hee maahi samaahee ||2||
english: The many and various forms are always Yours, O Lord; they shall merge again into You. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਤਨੇ ਜਨਮ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਸੇ ਜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਭੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: itane janam bhool pare se jaa paaiaa taa bhoole naahee ||
english: In countless incarnations, I went astray. Now that I have found You, I shall no longer wander.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kaa kaaraj soee par jaanai je gur kai sabad samaahee ||3||
english: It is His work; those who are absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad come to know it well. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਹਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਹਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: teraa sabad too(n)hai hahi aape bharam kahaahee ||
english: The Shabad is Yours; You are Yourself. Where is there any doubt?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਤਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫॥੩੫॥
transliteration: naanak tat tat siu miliaa punarap janam na aahee ||4||1||15||35||
english: O Nanak, one whose essence is merged with the Lord's essence does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again. ||4||1||15||35||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਬਾਧਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag kaalai vas hai baadhaa doojai bhaai ||
english: The whole world is under the power of Death, bound by the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haumai karam kamaavade manamukh milai sajaai ||1||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in ego; they receive their just rewards. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man gur charanee chit laai ||
english: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਲੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam nidhaan lai daragah lae chhadaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As Gurmukh, you shall be awarded the treasure of the Naam. In the Court of the Lord, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh bharamade manahath aavai jaai ||
english: Through 8.4 million incarnations, people wander lost; in stubborn-mindedness, they come and go.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿਓ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad na cheenio phir phir jonee paai ||2||
english: They do not realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad; they are reincarnated over and over again. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh aap pachhaaniaa har naam vasiaa man aai ||
english: The Gurmukh understands his own self. The Lord's Name comes to dwell within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anadin bhagatee ratiaa har naame sukh samaai ||3||
english: Imbued with devotion to the Lord's Name, night and day, he merges in peace. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: man sabad marai parateet hoi haumai taje vikaar ||
english: When one's mind dies in the Shabad, one radiates faith and confidence, shedding egotism and corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬॥੩੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak karamee paaeean har naamaa bhagat bha(n)daar ||4||2||16||36||
english: O servant Nanak, through the karma of good actions, the treasure of devotional worship and the Name of the Lord are attained. ||4||2||16||36||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: peeeaRai din chaar hai har har likh paaiaa ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, has ordained that the soul is to stay in her parents' home for only a few short days.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sobhaava(n)tee naar hai guramukh gun gaaiaa ||
english: Glorious is that soul-bride, who as Gurmukh, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਮਲੈ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਵਾਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pevakaRai gun sa(n)malai saahurai vaas paaiaa ||
english: She who cultivates virtue in her parents' home, shall obtain a home at her in-laws.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh sahaj samaaneeaa har har man bhaaiaa ||1||
english: The Gurmukhs are intuitively absorbed into the Lord. The Lord is pleasing to their minds. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sasurai peeeai pir vasai kahu kit bidh paaeeai ||
english: Our Husband Lord dwells in this world, and in the world beyond. Tell me, how can He be found?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aap nira(n)jan alakh hai aape melaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Immaculate Lord Himself is unseen. He unites us with Himself. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: aape hee prabh dehi mat har naam dhiaaeeai ||
english: God Himself bestows wisdom; meditate on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee satigur milai mukh a(n)mrit paaeeai ||
english: By great good fortune, one meets the True Guru, who places the Ambrosial Nectar in the mouth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: haumai dubidhaa binas jaai sahaje sukh samaaeeai ||
english: When egotism and duality are eradicated, one intuitively merges in peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh aape aap varatadaa aape naai laaeeai ||2||
english: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself links us to His Name. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਇਆਣੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh garab na paaio agiaan iaane ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs, in their arrogant pride, do not find God; they are so ignorant and foolish!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevaa naa karahi phir phir pachhutaane ||
english: They do not serve the True Guru, and in the end, they regret and repent, over and over again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਗਰਭੇ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: garabh jonee vaas paaide garabhe gal jaane ||
english: They are cast into the womb to be reincarnated, and within the womb, they rot.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mere karate evai bhaavadaa manamukh bharamaane ||3||
english: As it pleases my Creator Lord, the self-willed manmukhs wander around lost. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: merai har prabh lekh likhaaiaa dhur masatak pooraa ||
english: My Lord God inscribed the full pre-ordained destiny upon the forehead.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam dhiaaiaa bhetiaa gur sooraa ||
english: When one meets the Great and Courageous Guru, one meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਬੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa pitaa maataa har naam hai har ba(n)dhap beeraa ||
english: The Lord's Name is my mother and father; the Lord is my relative and brother.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭॥੩੭॥
transliteration: har har bakhas milaai prabh jan naanak keeraa ||4||3||17||37||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, please forgive me and unite me with Yourself. Servant Nanak is a lowly worm. ||4||3||17||37||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur te giaan paaiaa har tat beechaaraa ||
english: From the True Guru, I obtained spiritual wisdom; I contemplate the Lord's essence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਮਲੀਣ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mat maleen paragat bhaee jap naam muraaraa ||
english: My polluted intellect was enlightened by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਮਿਟਾਈਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: siv sakat mitaaeeaa chookaa a(n)dhiaaraa ||
english: The distinction between Shiva and Shakti - mind and matter - has been destroyed, and the darkness has been dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhur masatak jin kau likhiaa tin har naam piaaraa ||1||
english: The Lord's Name is loved by those, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny was written. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
transliteration: har kit bidh paaeeai sa(n)t janahu jis dekh hau jeevaa ||
english: How can the Lord be obtained, O Saints? Seeing Him, my life is sustained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਜੀਵਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bin chasaa na jeevatee gur melihu har ras peevaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant. Unite me with the Guru, so that I may drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: hau har gun gaavaa nit har sunee har har gat keenee ||
english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and I listen to them daily; the Lord, Har, Har, has emancipated me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: har ras gur te paaiaa meraa man tan leenee ||
english: I have obtained the Lord's essence from the Guru; my mind and body are drenched with it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan gur sat purakh hai jin bhagat har deenee ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the True Being, who has blessed me with devotional worship of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਮ ਕੀਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis gur te har paaiaa so gur ham keenee ||2||
english: From the Guru, I have obtained the Lord; I have made Him my Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gunadaataa har raai hai ham avaganiaare ||
english: The Sovereign Lord is the Giver of virtue. I am worthless and without virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਥਰ ਡੂਬਦੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: paapee paathar doobade guramat har taare ||
english: The sinners sink like stones; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord carries us across.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਮ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: too(n) gunadaataa niramalaa ham avaganiaare ||
english: You are the Giver of virtue, O Immaculate Lord; I am worthless and without virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har saranaagat raakh lehu mooR mugadh nisataare ||3||
english: I have entered Your Sanctuary, Lord; please save me, as You have saved the idiots and fools. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sahaj ana(n)d sadaa guramatee har har man dhiaaiaa ||
english: Eternal celestial bliss comes through the Guru's Teachings, by meditating continually on the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਜਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sajan har prabh paaiaa ghar sohilaa gaaiaa ||
english: I have obtained the Lord God as my Best Friend, within the home of my own self. I sing the Songs of Joy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har daiaa dhaar prabh benatee har har chetaaiaa ||
english: Please shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord God, that I may meditate on Your Name, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੮॥੩੮॥
transliteration: jan naanak ma(n)gai dhooR tin jin satigur paaiaa ||4||4||18||38||
english: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those who have found the True Guru. ||4||4||18||38||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਚਉਥਾ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 4 chauthaa chaupade ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit saasat simrit paRiaa ||
english: The Pandit - the religious scholar - recites the Shaastras and the Simritees;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jogee gorakh gorakh kariaa ||
english: the Yogi cries out, "Gorakh, Gorakh".

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਪੜਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mai moorakh har har jap paRiaa ||1||
english: But I am just a fool - I just chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: naa jaanaa kiaa gat raam hamaaree ||
english: I do not know what my condition shall be, Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bhaj man mere tar bhaujal too taaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Name of the Lord. You shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਲਾਇ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)niaasee bibhoot laai deh savaaree ||
english: The Sannyaasee smears his body with ashes;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਕਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: par tri tiaag karee brahamachaaree ||
english: renouncing other men's women, he practices celibacy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mai moorakh har aas tumaaree ||2||
english: I am just a fool, Lord; I place my hopes in You! ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਸੂਰਤਣੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: khatree karam kare sooratan paavai ||
english: The Kh'shaatriya acts bravely, and is recognized as a warrior.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਪਰ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sood vais par kirat kamaavai ||
english: The Shoodra and the Vaisha work and slave for others;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mai moorakh har naam chhadaavai ||3||
english: I am just a fool - I am saved by the Lord's Name. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh teree srisat too(n) aap rahiaa samaaee ||
english: The entire Universe is Yours; You Yourself permeate and pervade it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naanak de vadiaaee ||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are blessed with glorious greatness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੯॥
transliteration: mai a(n)dhule har tek tikaaee ||4||1||39||
english: I am blind - I have taken the Lord as my Support. ||4||1||39||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਥਾ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: niragun kathaa kathaa hai har kee ||
english: The Speech of the Lord is the most sublime speech, free of any attributes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: bhaj mil saadhoo sa(n)gat jan kee ||
english: Vibrate on it, meditate on it, and join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tar bhaujal akath kathaa sun har kee ||1||
english: Cross over the terrifying world-ocean, listening to the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d satasa(n)gat melaai ||
english: O Lord of the Universe, unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ras rasanaa raam gun gaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord, singing the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: jo jan dhiaavahi har har naamaa ||
english: Those humble beings who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: tin daasan daas karahu ham raamaa ||
english: please make me the slave of their slaves, Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਊਤਮ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan kee sevaa ootam kaamaa ||2||
english: Serving Your slaves is the ultimate good deed. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo har kee har kathaa sunaavai ||
english: One who chants the Speech of the Lord

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so jan hamarai man chit bhaavai ||
english: that humble servant is pleasing to my conscious mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਪਗ ਰੇਣੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan pag ren vadabhaagee paavai ||3||
english: Those who are blessed with great good fortune obtain the dust of the feet of the humble. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa siu preet ban aaee ||
english: Those who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin kau likhat likhiaa dhur paaee ||
english: Are in love with the humble Saints.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੦॥
transliteration: te jan naanak naam samaaee ||4||2||40||
english: Those humble beings, O Nanak, are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||2||40||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਤੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maataa preet kare put khaai ||
english: The mother loves to see her son eat.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੀਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਈ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: meene preet bhaee jal naai ||
english: The fish loves to bathe in the water.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur preet gurasikh mukh paai ||1||
english: The True Guru loves to place food in the mouth of His GurSikh. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: te har jan har melahu ham piaare ||
english: If only I could meet those humble servants of the Lord, O my Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin miliaa dukh jaahi hamaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting with them, my sorrows depart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਛਰੇ ਗਊ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu mil bachhare gaoo preet lagaavai ||
english: As the cow shows her love to her strayed calf when she finds it,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kaaman preet jaa pir ghar aavai ||
english: and as the bride shows her love for her husband when he returns home,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har jan preet jaa har jas gaavai ||2||
english: so does the Lord's humble servant love to sing the Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਸੈ ਜਲ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saari(n)g preet basai jal dhaaraa ||
english: The rainbird loves the rainwater, falling in torrents;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: narapat preet maaiaa dekh pasaaraa ||
english: the king loves to see his wealth on display.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਪੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har jan preet japai nira(n)kaaraa ||3||
english: The humble servant of the Lord loves to meditate on the Formless Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟੇ ॥
transliteration: nar praanee preet maaiaa dhan khaate ||
english: The mortal man loves to accumulate wealth and property.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਲਾਟੇ ॥
transliteration: gurasikh preet gur milai galaate ||
english: The GurSikh loves to meet and embrace the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਚਾਟੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak preet saadh pag chaate ||4||3||41||
english: Servant Nanak loves to kiss the feet of the Holy. ||4||3||41||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੀਖਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭੀਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bheekhak preet bheekh prabh paai ||
english: The beggar loves to receive charity from the wealthy landlord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੂਖੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਅੰਨੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhookhe preet hovai a(n)n khaai ||
english: The hungry person loves to eat food.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਘਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gurasikh preet gur mil aaghaai ||1||
english: The GurSikh loves to find satisfaction by meeting the Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har darasan dehu har aas tumaaree ||
english: O Lord, grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; I place my hopes in You, Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੋਚ ਪੂਰਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa loch poor hamaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Shower me with Your Mercy, and fulfill my longing. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਕਵੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: chakavee preet sooraj mukh laagai ||
english: The song-bird loves the sun shining in her face.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
transliteration: milai piaare sabh dukh tiaagai ||
english: Meeting her Beloved, all her pains are left behind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gurasikh preet guroo mukh laagai ||2||
english: The GurSikh loves to gaze upon the Face of the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਛਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਖੀਰੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bachhare preet kheer mukh khaai ||
english: The calf loves to suck its mother's milk;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hiradai bigasai dekhai maai ||
english: its heart blossoms forth upon seeing its mother.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gurasikh preet guroo mukh laai ||3||
english: The GurSikh loves to gaze upon the Face of the Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: hor sabh preet maaiaa mohu kaachaa ||
english: All other loves and emotional attachment to Maya are false.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੂਰਾ ਕਚੁ ਪਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: binas jaai kooraa kach paachaa ||
english: They shall pass away, like false and transitory decorations.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੪੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak preet tripat gur saachaa ||4||4||42||
english: Servant Nanak is fulfilled, through the Love of the True Guru. ||4||4||42||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਬਣੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevaa saphal hai banee ||
english: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਧਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jit mil har naam dhiaaiaa har dhanee ||
english: meeting Him, I meditate on the Name of the Lord, the Lord Master.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਛੂਟੀ ਘਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin har japiaa tin peechhai chhootee ghanee ||1||
english: So many are emancipated along with those who meditate on the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gurasikh har bolahu mere bhaaee ||
english: O GurSikhs, chant the Name of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਤ ਸਭ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bolat sabh paap lahi jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name, all sins are washed away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਬ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jab gur miliaa tab man vas aaiaa ||
english: When one meets the Guru, then the mind becomes centered.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤ ਪੰਚ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat pa(n)ch rahe har dhiaaiaa ||
english: The five passions, running wild, are brought to rest by meditating on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਗਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anadin nagaree har gun gaaiaa ||2||
english: Night and day, within the body-village, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur pag dhoor jinaa mukh laaee ||
english: Those who apply the dust of the Feet of the True Guru to their faces,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੂੜ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tin kooR tiaage har liv laaee ||
english: renounce falsehood and enshrine love for the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: te har daragah mukh oojal bhaaee ||3||
english: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa aap har bhaavai ||
english: Service to the Guru is pleasing to the Lord Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਬਲਭਦ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਲਗਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: krisan balabhadr gur pag lag dhiaavai ||
english: Even Krishna and Balbhadar meditated on the Lord, falling at the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੪੩॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh har aap taraavai ||4||5||43||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself saves the Gurmukhs. ||4||5||43||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਡੰਡਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har aape jogee da(n)daadhaaree ||
english: The Lord Himself is the Yogi, who wields the staff of authority.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har aape rav rahiaa banavaaree ||
english: The Lord Himself practices tapa - intense self-disciplined meditation;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ਲਾਇ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har aape tap taapai laai taaree ||1||
english: He is deeply absorbed in His primal trance. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aisaa meraa raam rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: Such is my Lord, who is all-pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nikat vasai naahee har door ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He dwells near at hand - the Lord is not far away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: har aape sabad surat dhun aape ||
english: The Lord Himself is the Word of the Shabad. He Himself is the awareness, attuned to its music.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: har aape vekhai vigasai aape ||
english: The Lord Himself beholds, and He Himself blossoms forth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har aap japaai aape har jaape ||2||
english: The Lord Himself chants, and the Lord Himself inspires others to chant. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har aape saari(n)g a(n)mritadhaaraa ||
english: He Himself is the rainbird, and the Ambrosial Nectar raining down.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)mrit aap peeaavanahaaraa ||
english: The Lord is the Ambrosial Nectar; He Himself leads us to drink it in.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har aap kare aape nisataaraa ||3||
english: The Lord Himself is the Doer; He Himself is our Saving Grace. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੇੜੀ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har aape beRee tulahaa taaraa ||
english: The Lord Himself is the Boat, the Raft and the Boatman.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har aape guramatee nisataaraa ||
english: The Lord Himself, through the Guru's Teachings, saves us.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੪੪॥
transliteration: har aape naanak paavai paaraa ||4||6||44||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself carries us across to the other side. ||4||6||44||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਸਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਹਮ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: saahu hamaaraa too(n) dhanee jaisee too(n) raas dehi taisee ham lehi ||
english: O Master, You are my Banker. I receive only that capital which You give me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣੰਜਹ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਜੇ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੇਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har naam vana(n)jah ra(n)g siu je aap daiaal hoi dehi ||1||
english: I would purchase the Lord's Name with love, if You Yourself, in Your Mercy, would sell it to me. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: ham vanajaare raam ke ||
english: I am the merchant, the peddler of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har vanaj karaavai de raas re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I trade in the merchandise and capital of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: laahaa har bhagat dhan khatiaa har sache saah man bhaaiaa ||
english: I have earned the profit, the wealth of devotional worship of the Lord. I have become pleasing to the Mind of the Lord, the True Banker.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har jap har vakhar ladiaa jam jaagaatee neR na aaiaa ||2||
english: I chant and meditate on the Lord, loading the merchandise of the Lord's Name. The Messenger of Death, the tax collector, does not even approach me. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਅਨੰਤ ਤਰੰਗੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hor vanaj karahi vaapaareee ana(n)t tara(n)gee dukh maaiaa ||
english: Those traders who trade in other merchandise, are caught up in the endless waves of the pain of Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜੇਹੈ ਵਣਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇਆ ਫਲੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: oi jehai vanaj har laaiaa phal tehaa tin paaiaa ||3||
english: According to the business in which the Lord has placed them, so are the rewards they obtain. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਈ ॥
transliteration: har har vanaj so jan kare jis kripaal hoi prabh deee ||
english: People trade in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, when the God shows His Mercy and bestows it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਲੇਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੪੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak saahu har seviaa phir lekhaa mool na leee ||4||1||7||45||
english: Servant Nanak serves the Lord, the Banker; he shall never again be called to render his account. ||4||1||7||45||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਨਨੀ ਗਰਭੁ ਪਾਲਤੀ ਸੁਤ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu jananee garabh paalatee sut kee kar aasaa ||
english: The mother nourishes the fetus in the womb, hoping for a son,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ਦੇਇ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: vadaa hoi dhan khaat dei kar bhog bilaasaa ||
english: who will grow and earn and give her money to enjoy herself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਦਾ ਦੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਥਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tiu har jan preet har raakhadaa de aap hathaasaa ||1||
english: In just the same way, the humble servant of the Lord loves the Lord, who extends His Helping Hand to us. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਸਈਆ ॥
transliteration: mere raam mai moorakh har raakh mere gusaeeaa ||
english: O my Lord, I am so foolish; save me, O my Lord God!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਵਡਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jan kee upamaa tujhahi vadaeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your servant's praise is Your Own Glorious Greatness. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)dar ghar aana(n)d har har jas man bhaavai ||
english: Those whose minds are pleased by the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, are joyful in the palaces of their own homes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਰਸ ਮੀਠੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਗਹਿ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh ras meethe mukh lagahi jaa har gun gaavai ||
english: Their mouths savor all the sweet delicacies when they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਸਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਇਕੀਹ ਕੁਲੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har jan paravaar sadhaar hai ikeeh kulee sabh jagat chhadaavai ||2||
english: The Lord's humble servants are the saviors of their families; they save their families for twenty-one generations - they save the entire world! ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh keeaa so har keeaa har kee vadiaaee ||
english: Whatever has been done, has been done by the Lord; it is the Glorious Greatness of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har jee tere too(n) varatadaa har pooj karaaee ||
english: O Lord, in Your creatures, You are pervading; You inspire them to worship You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਲਹਾਇਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har bhagat bha(n)daar lahaaidaa aape varataaee ||3||
english: The Lord leads us to the treasure of devotional worship; He Himself bestows it. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਾ ਹਾਟਿ ਵਿਹਾਝਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: laalaa haat vihaajhiaa kiaa tis chaturaaee ||
english: I am a slave, purchased in Your market; what clever tricks do I have?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਰਾਜਿ ਬਹਾਲੇ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਲਾਮੁ ਘਾਸੀ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਢਾਈ ॥
transliteration: je raaj bahaale taa har gulaam ghaasee kau har naam kadhaaee ||
english: If the Lord were to set me upon a throne, I would still be His slave. If I were a grass-cutter, I would still chant the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੮॥੪੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai har kee vadiaaee ||4||2||8||46||
english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; contemplate the Glorious Greatness of the Lord||4||2||8||46||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kirasaanee kirasaan kare lochai jeeu laai ||
english: The farmers love to work their farms;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਲੁ ਜੋਤੈ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੁਤੁ ਧੀ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hal jotai udam kare meraa put dhee khaai ||
english: they plow and work the fields, so that their sons and daughters may eat.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tiu har jan har har jap kare har a(n)t chhadaai ||1||
english: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and in the end, the Lord shall save them. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mai moorakh kee gat keejai mere raam ||
english: I am foolish - save me, O my Lord!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇ ਹਮ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur sevaa har laai ham kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Lord, enjoin me to work and serve the Guru, the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਤੁਰੇ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੀ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: lai ture saudaagaree saudaagar dhaavai ||
english: The traders buy horses, planning to trade them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਖਟੈ ਆਸਾ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dhan khatai aasaa karai maaiaa mohu vadhaavai ||
english: They hope to earn wealth; their attachment to Maya increases.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tiu har jan har har bolataa har bol sukh paavai ||2||
english: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; chanting the Lord's Name, they find peace. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੈ ਹਟਵਾਣੀਆ ਬਹਿ ਹਾਟਿ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bikh sa(n)chai hatavaaneeaa bahi haat kamaai ||
english: The shop-keepers collect poison, sitting in their shops, carrying on their business.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਝੂਠ ਕਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: moh jhooth pasaaraa jhooth kaa jhoothe lapataai ||
english: Their love is false, their displays are false, and they are engrossed in falsehood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tiu har jan har dhan sa(n)chiaa har kharach lai jaai ||3||
english: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants gather the wealth of the Lord's Name; they take the Lord's Name as their supplies. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਫਾਸ ॥
transliteration: ihu maaiaa moh kuta(n)b hai bhaai doojai phaas ||
english: This emotional attachment to Maya and family, and the love of duality, is a noose around the neck.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: guramatee so jan tarai jo daasan daas ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the humble servants are carried across; they become the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੪॥੩॥੯॥੪੭॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa guramukh paragaas ||4||3||9||47||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam; the Gurmukh is enlightened. ||4||3||9||47||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਕਰੇ ਭਰਮੈ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nit dinas raat laalach kare bharamai bharamaaiaa ||
english: Continuously, day and night, they are gripped by greed and deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵੇਗਾਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਵੇਗਾਰੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vegaar phirai vegaareeaa sir bhaar uthaaiaa ||
english: The slaves labor in slavery, carrying the loads upon their heads.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo gur kee jan sevaa kare so ghar kai ka(n)m har laaiaa ||1||
english: That humble being who serves the Guru is put to work by the Lord in His Home. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਤੋੜਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mere raam toR ba(n)dhan maaiaa ghar kai ka(n)m laai ||
english: O my Lord, please break these bonds of Maya, and put me to work in Your Home.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nit har gun gaavah har naam samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I continuously sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; I am absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕਰੇ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਅਰਥਿ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nar praanee chaakaree kare narapat raaje arath sabh maaiaa ||
english: Mortal men work for kings, all for the sake of wealth and Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੈ ਬੰਧੈ ਕੈ ਡਾਨਿ ਲੇਇ ਕੈ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kai ba(n)dhai kai daan lei kai narapat mar jaaiaa ||
english: But the king either imprisons them, or fines them, or else dies himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dhan sevaa saphal satiguroo kee jit har har naam jap har sukh paaiaa ||2||
english: Blessed, rewarding and fruitful is the service of the True Guru; through it, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and I have found peace. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਸਉਦਾ ਸੂਦੁ ਕੀਚੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: nit saudaa sood keechai bahu bhaat kar maaiaa kai taaee ||
english: Everyday, people carry on their business, with all sorts of devices to earn interest, for the sake of Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਦੇਇ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨੇ ਤੋਟੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa laahaa dei taa sukh mane totai mar jaaee ||
english: If they earn a profit, they are pleased, but their hearts are broken by losses.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo gun saajhee gur siu kare nit nit sukh paaee ||3||
english: One who is worthy, becomes a partner with the Guru, and finds a lasting peace forever. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਨੀ ਭੂਖ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਹੈ ਤਿਤਨੀ ਭੂਖ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jitanee bhookh an ras saad hai titanee bhookh phir laagai ||
english: The more one feels hunger for other tastes and pleasures, the more this hunger persists.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਵੇਚੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jis har aap kripaa kare so veche sir gur aagai ||
english: Those unto whom the Lord Himself shows mercy, sell their head to the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੮॥
transliteration: jan naanak har ras tripatiaa phir bhookh na laagai ||4||4||10||48||
english: Servant Nanak is satisfied by the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. He shall never feel hungry again. ||4||4||10||48||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਨਿਤ ਕਿਉ ਦੇਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hamarai man chit har aas nit kiu dekhaa har daras tumaaraa ||
english: Within my conscious mind is the constant longing for the Lord. How can I behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, Lord?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣਤਾ ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jin preet laaee so jaanataa hamarai man chit har bahut piaaraa ||
english: One who loves the Lord knows this; the Lord is very dear to my conscious mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hau kurabaanee gur aapane jin vichhuRiaa meliaa meraa sirajanahaaraa ||1||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has re-united me with my Creator Lord; I was separated from Him for such a long time! ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: mere raam ham paapee saran pare har duaar ||
english: O my Lord, I am a sinner; I have come to Your Sanctuary, and fallen at Your Door, Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਹਮ ਮੇਲੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mat niragun ham melai kabahoo(n) apunee kirapaa dhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My intellect is worthless; I am filthy and polluted. Please shower me with Your Mercy sometime. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hamare avagun bahut bahut hai bahu baar baar har ganat na aavai ||
english: My demerits are so many and numerous. I have sinned so many times, over and over again. O Lord, they cannot be counted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) gunava(n)taa har har daiaal har aape bakhas laihi har bhaavai ||
english: You, Lord, are the Merciful Treasure of Virtue. When it pleases You, Lord, You forgive me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ham aparaadhee raakhe gur sa(n)gatee upades deeo har naam chhadaavai ||2||
english: I am a sinner, saved only by the Company of the Guru. He has bestowed the Teachings of the Lord's Name, which saves me. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਜਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਹ ਤਬ ਬਿਸਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tumare gun kiaa kahaa mere satiguraa jab gur bolah tab bisam hoi jaai ||
english: What Glorious Virtues of Yours can I describe, O my True Guru? When the Guru speaks, I am transfixed with wonder.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਖੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ham jaise aparaadhee avar koee raakhai jaise ham satigur raakh leee chhadaai ||
english: Can anyone else save a sinner like me? The True Guru has protected and saved me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਸਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too(n) gur pitaa too(n)hai gur maataa too(n) gur ba(n)dhap meraa sakhaa sakhaai ||3||
english: O Guru, You are my father. O Guru, You are my mother. O Guru, You are my relative, companion and friend. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਮਰੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੋਤੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਸਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: jo hamaree bidh hotee mere satiguraa saa bidh tum har jaanahu aape ||
english: My condition, O my True Guru - that condition, O Lord, is known only to You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਰੁਲਤੇ ਫਿਰਤੇ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੂਛਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੀਰੇ ਹਮ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: ham rulate phirate koee baat na poochhataa gur satigur sa(n)g keere ham thaape ||
english: I was rolling around in the dirt, and no one cared for me at all. In the Company of the Guru, the True Guru, I, the worm, have been raised up and exalted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੇਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਚੂਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੧॥੪੯॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n guroo naanak jan keraa jit miliai chooke sabh sog sa(n)taape ||4||5||11||49||
english: Blessed, blessed is the Guru of servant Nanak; meeting Him, all my sorrows and troubles have come to an end. ||4||5||11||49||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਨਾਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਲੁਭਤੁ ਹੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)chan naaree mahi jeeu lubhat hai mohu meethaa maaiaa ||
english: The soul of the man is lured by gold and women; emotional attachment to Maya is so sweet to him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਘੋੜੇ ਖੁਸੀ ਮਨੁ ਅਨ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ghar ma(n)dar ghoRe khusee man an ras laaiaa ||
english: The mind has become attached to the pleasures of houses, palaces, horses and other enjoyments.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har prabh chit na aavaee kiu chhootaa mere har raaiaa ||1||
english: The Lord God does not even enter his thoughts; how can he be saved, O my Lord King? ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਇਹ ਨੀਚ ਕਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mere raam ih neech karam har mere ||
english: O my Lord, these are my lowly actions, O my Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gunava(n)taa har har daiaal kar kirapaa bakhas avagan sabh mere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, Treasure of Virtue, Merciful Lord: please bless me with Your Grace and forgive me for all my mistakes. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਢੰਗੁ ਨ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kichh roop nahee kichh jaat naahee kichh dha(n)g na meraa ||
english: I have no beauty, no social status, no manners.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ ਬੋਲਹ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਨ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kiaa muhu lai bolah gun bihoon naam japiaa na teraa ||
english: With what face am I to speak? I have no virtue at all; I have not chanted Your Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਉਬਰੇ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ham paapee sa(n)g gur ubare pu(n)n satigur keraa ||2||
english: I am a sinner, saved only by the Company of the Guru. This is the generous blessing of the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਕੁ ਦੀਆ ਵਰਤਣ ਕਉ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh jeeu pi(n)d mukh nak deeaa varatan kau paanee ||
english: He gave all beings souls, bodies, mouths, noses and water to drink.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਦੀਆ ਰਸ ਅਨਿ ਭੋਗਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)n khaanaa kapaR painan deeaa ras an bhogaanee ||
english: He gave them corn to eat, clothes to wear, and other pleasures to enjoy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਸੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਪਸੂ ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin deee s chit na aavaee pasoo hau kar jaanee ||3||
english: But they do not remember the One who gave them all this. The animals think that they made themselves! ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh keetaa teraa varatadaa too(n) a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: You made them all; You are all-pervading. You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: ham ja(n)t vichaare kiaa karah sabh khel tum suaamee ||
english: What can these wretched creatures do? This whole drama is Yours, O Lord and Master.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਾਟਿ ਵਿਹਾਝਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਲਮ ਗੁਲਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੨॥੫੦॥
transliteration: jan naanak haat vihaajhiaa har gulam gulaamee ||4||6||12||50||
english: Servant Nanak was purchased in the slave-market. He is the slave of the Lord's slaves. ||4||6||12||50||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਨਨੀ ਸੁਤੁ ਜਣਿ ਪਾਲਤੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jiu jananee sut jan paalatee raakhai nadar majhaar ||
english: Just as the mother, having given birth to a son, feeds him and keeps him in her vision

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਗਿਰਾਸੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪੋਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar mukh de giraas khin khin pochaar ||
english: - indoors and outdoors, she puts food in his mouth; each and every moment, she caresses him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰਾਖਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tiu satigur gurasikh raakhataa har preet piaar ||1||
english: In just the same way, the True Guru protects His GurSikhs, who love their Beloved Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਹੈ ਇਆਣੇ ॥
transliteration: mere raam ham baarik har prabh ke hai iaane ||
english: O my Lord, we are just the ignorant children of our Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਧਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੇ ਕੀਏ ਸਿਆਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n guroo gur satigur paadhaa jin har upades de keee siaane ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Hail, hail, to the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru, the Divine Teacher who has made me wise through the Lord's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਗਗਨਿ ਫਿਰੰਤੀ ਊਡਤੀ ਕਪਰੇ ਬਾਗੇ ਵਾਲੀ ॥
