transliteration: jaisee gagan phira(n)tee oodatee kapare baage vaalee ||
english: The white flamingo circles through the sky,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਚੀਤੁ ਪੀਛੈ ਬਿਚਿ ਬਚਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: oh raakhai cheet peechhai bich bachare nit hiradai saar samaalee ||
english: but she keeps her young ones in her mind; she has left them behind, but she constantly remembers them in her heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਰਖੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tiu satigur sikh preet har har kee gur sikh rakhai jee naalee ||2||
english: In just the same way, the True Guru loves His Sikhs. The Lord cherishes His GurSikhs, and keeps them clasped to His Heart. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਤੀ ਤੀਸ ਬਤੀਸ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਮਾਸ ਰਤੁ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jaise kaatee tees batees hai vich raakhai rasanaa maas rat keree ||
english: Just as the tongue, made of flesh and blood, is protected within the scissors of the thirty-two teeth

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਮਾਸ ਕਾਤੀ ਕੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: koee jaanahu maas kaatee kai kichh haath hai sabh vasagat hai har keree ||
english: who thinks that the power lies in the flesh or the scissors? Everything is in the Power of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਪੈਜ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tiu sa(n)t janaa kee nar ni(n)daa karahi har raakhai paij jan keree ||3||
english: In just the same way, when someone slanders the Saint, the Lord preserves the honor of His servant. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਮਤ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee mat koee jaanahu kisee kai kichh haath hai sabh kare karaaiaa ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, let none think that they have any power. All act as the Lord causes them to act.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਤਾਪੁ ਸਿਰਤਿ ਸਾਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaraa maraa taap sirat saap sabh har kai vas hai koee laag na sakai bin har kaa laaiaa ||
english: Old age, death, fever, poisons and snakes - everything is in the Hands of the Lord. Nothing can touch anyone without the Lord's Order.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਅੰਤੀ ਅਉਸਰਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੩॥੫੧॥
transliteration: aisaa har naam man chit nit dhiaavahu jan naanak jo a(n)tee ausar lae chhadaaiaa ||4||7||13||51||
english: Within your conscious mind, O servant Nanak, meditate forever on the Name of the Lord, who shall deliver you in the end. ||4||7||13||51||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jis miliai man hoi ana(n)d so satigur kaheeai ||
english: Meeting Him, the mind is filled with bliss. He is called the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man kee dubidhaa binas jaai har param pad laheeai ||1||
english: Double-mindedness departs, and the supreme status of the Lord is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
transliteration: meraa satigur piaaraa kit bidh milai ||
english: How can I meet my Beloved True Guru?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau khin khin karee namasakaar meraa gur pooraa kiu milai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Each and every moment, I humbly bow to Him. How will I meet my Perfect Guru? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa har meliaa meraa satigur pooraa ||
english: Granting His Grace, the Lord has led me to meet my Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀਆ ਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਧੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ichh pu(n)nee jan kereeaa le satigur dhooraa ||2||
english: The desire of His humble servant has been fulfilled. I have received the dust of the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har bhagat driRaavai har bhagat sunai tis satigur mileeai ||
english: Those who meet the True Guru implant devotional worship to the Lord, and listen to this devotional worship of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਨਿਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: totaa mool na aavaee har laabh nit driReeai ||3||
english: They never suffer any loss; they continually earn the profit of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jis kau ridai vigaas hai bhaau doojaa naahee ||
english: One whose heart blossoms forth, is not in love with duality.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੪॥੫੨॥
transliteration: naanak tis gur mil udharai har gun gaavaahee ||4||8||14||52||
english: O Nanak, meeting the Guru, one is saved, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||8||14||52||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 4 gauRee poorabee ||
english: Fourth Mehl, Gauree Poorbee:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀ ॥
transliteration: har daiaal daiaa prabh keenee merai man tan mukh har bolee ||
english: The Merciful Lord God showered me with His Mercy; with mind and body and mouth, I chant the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਗੂੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਚੋਲੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh ra(n)g bhaiaa at gooRaa har ra(n)g bheenee meree cholee ||1||
english: As Gurmukh, I have been dyed in the deep and lasting color of the Lord's Love. The robe of my body is drenched with His Love. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਗੋਲੀ ॥
transliteration: apune har prabh kee hau golee ||
english: I am the maid-servant of my Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੋਲ ਅਮੋਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab ham har setee man maaniaa kar deeno jagat sabh gol amolee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When my mind surrendered to the Lord, He made all the world my slave. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਖੋਜਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਢੰਢੋਲੀ ॥
transliteration: karahu bibek sa(n)t jan bhaaee khoj hiradai dekh dha(n)dholee ||
english: Consider this well, O Saints, O Siblings of Destiny - search your own hearts, seek and find Him there.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋਲੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har har roop sabh jot sabaaee har nikat vasai har kolee ||2||
english: The Beauty and the Light of the Lord, Har, Har, is present in all. In all places, the Lord dwells near by, close at hand. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਕੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੋਲੀ ॥
transliteration: har har nikat vasai sabh jag kai apara(n)par purakh atolee ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, dwells close by, all over the world. He is Infinite, All-powerful and Immeasurable.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਕੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੋਲੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har pragat keeo gur poorai sir vechio gur pahi molee ||3||
english: The Perfect Guru has revealed the Lord, Har, Har, to me. I have sold my head to the Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡੋਲੀ ॥
transliteration: har jee a(n)tar baahar tum saranaagat tum vad purakh vadolee ||
english: O Dear Lord, inside and outside, I am in the protection of Your Sanctuary; You are the Greatest of the Great, All-powerful Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਵੇਚੋਲੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫॥੫੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak anadin har gun gaavai mil satigur gur vecholee ||4||1||15||53||
english: Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day, meeting the Guru, the True Guru, the Divine Intermediary. ||4||1||15||53||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan apara(n)par suaamee jagadeesur purakh bidhaate ||
english: Life of the World, Infinite Lord and Master, Master of the Universe, All-powerful Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਹਮ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jit maarag tum prerahu suaamee tit maarag ham jaate ||1||
english: Whichever way You turn me, O my Lord and Master, that is the way I shall go. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: raam meraa man har setee raate ||
english: O Lord, my mind is attuned to the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mil raam ras paaiaa har raamai naam samaate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. I am absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਿ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam har har jag avakhadh har har naam har saate ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the panacea, the medicine for the world. The Lord, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, bring peace and tranquility.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin ke paap dokh sabh binase jo guramat raam ras khaate ||2||
english: Those who partake of the Lord's sublime essence, through the Guru's Teachings - their sins and sufferings are all eliminated. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: jin kau likhat likhe dhur masatak te gur sa(n)tokh sar naate ||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed on their foreheads, bathe in the pool of contentment of the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: duramat mail gaee sabh tin kee jo raam naam ra(n)g raate ||3||
english: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away, from those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord's Name. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਮ ਜੇਵਡ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: raam tum aape aap aap prabh thaakur tum jevad avar na daate ||
english: O Lord, You Yourself are Your Own Master, O God. There is no other Giver as Great as You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬॥੫੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam lae taa(n) jeevai har japeeai har kirapaa te ||4||2||16||54||
english: Servant Nanak lives by the Naam, the Name of the Lord; by the Lord's Mercy, he chants the Lord's Name. ||4||2||16||54||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਚੇ ॥
transliteration: karahu kripaa jagajeevan daate meraa man har setee raache ||
english: Show Mercy to me, O Life of the World, O Great Giver, so that my mind may merge with the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬਚਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਚੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur bachan deeo at niramal jap har har har man maache ||1||
english: The True Guru has bestowed His most pure and sacred Teachings. Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, my mind is transfixed and enraptured. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬੇਧਿ ਲੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
transliteration: raam meraa man tan bedh leeo har saache ||
english: O Lord, my mind and body have been pierced through by the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਕਾਲ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਬਾਚੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jih kaal kai mukh jagat sabh grasiaa gur satigur kai bachan har ham baache ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The whole world is caught and held in the mouth of Death. Through the Teachings of the Guru, the True Guru, O Lord, I am saved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਨਰ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
transliteration: jin kau preet naahee har setee te saakat mooR nar kaache ||
english: Those who are not in love with the Lord are foolish and false - they are faithless cynics.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਪਾਚੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin kau janam maran at bhaaree vich visataa mar mar paache ||2||
english: They suffer the most extreme agonies of birth and death; they die over and over again, and they rot away in manure. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਜਾਚੇ ॥
transliteration: tum daiaal saran pratipaalak mo kau deejai daan har ham jaache ||
english: You are the Merciful Cherisher of those who seek Your Sanctuary. I beg of You: please grant me Your gift, Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਹਮ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਚੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har ke daas daas ham keejai man nirat kare kar naache ||3||
english: Make me the slave of the Lord's slaves, so that my mind might dance in Your Love. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹ ਵਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਹਹਿ ਤਾ ਚੇ ॥
transliteration: aape saah vade prabh suaamee ham vanajaare hahi taa che ||
english: He Himself is the Great Banker; God is our Lord and Master. I am His petty merchant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭॥੫੫॥
transliteration: meraa man tan jeeu raas sabh teree jan naanak ke saah prabh saache ||4||3||17||55||
english: My mind, body and soul are all Your capital assets. You, O God, are the True Banker of servant Nanak. ||4||3||17||55||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਰਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਦੇ ਕਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: tum daiaal sarab dukh bha(n)jan ik binau sunahu de kaane ||
english: You are Merciful, the Destroyer of all pain. Please give me Your Ear and listen to my prayer.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis te tum har jaane suaamee so satigur mel meraa praane ||1||
english: Please unite me with the True Guru, my breath of life; through Him, O my Lord and Master, You are known. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: raam ham satigur paarabraham kar maane ||
english: O Lord, I acknowledge the True Guru as the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਸੁਧ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham mooR mugadh asudh mat hote gur satigur kai bachan har ham jaane ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am foolish and ignorant, and my intellect is impure. Through the Teachings of the Guru, the True Guru, O Lord, I come to know You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਰਸ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਹਮ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਭ ਤਿਤਨੇ ਫੀਕ ਫੀਕਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: jitane ras an ras ham dekhe sabh titane pheek pheekaane ||
english: All the pleasures and enjoyments which I have seen - I have found them all to be bland and insipid.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੀਠ ਰਸ ਗਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har kaa naam a(n)mrit ras chaakhiaa mil satigur meeth ras gaane ||2||
english: I have tasted the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, by meeting the True Guru. It is sweet, like the juice of the sugarcane. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: jin kau gur satigur nahee bhetiaa te saakat mooR divaane ||
english: Those who have not met the Guru, the True Guru, are foolish and insane - they are faithless cynics.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਰਮਹੀਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਚਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tin ke karamaheen dhur paae dekh deepak mohi pachaane ||3||
english: Those who were pre-ordained to have no good karma at all - gazing into the lamp of emotional attachment, they are burnt, like moths in a flame. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਲਗਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: jin kau tum daiaa kar melahu te har har sev lagaane ||
english: Those whom You, in Your Mercy, have met, Lord, are committed to Your Service.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੮॥੫੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak har har har jap pragate mat guramat naam samaane ||4||4||18||56||
english: Servant Nanak chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. He is famous, and through the Guru's Teachings, He merges in the Name. ||4||4||18||56||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਹੁ ਨਸੀਐ ॥
transliteration: mere man so prabh sadaa naal hai suaamee kahu kithai har pahu naseeai ||
english: O my mind, God is always with you; He is your Lord and Master. Tell me, where could you run to get away from the Lord?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har aape bakhas lae prabh saachaa har aap chhadaae chhuteeai ||1||
english: The True Lord God Himself grants forgiveness; we are emancipated only when the Lord Himself emancipates us. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: mere man jap har har har man japeeai ||
english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har - chant it in your mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੀਛੈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee saranaaee bhaj pau mere manaa gur satigur peechhai chhuteeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Quickly now, run to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, O my mind; following the Guru, the True Guru, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੀਐ ॥
transliteration: mere man sevahu so prabh srab sukhadaataa jit seviai nij ghar vaseeai ||
english: O my mind, serve God, the Giver of all peace; serving Him, you shall come to dwell in your own home deep within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਇ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਘਸਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਘਸੀਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh jaai lahahu ghar apanaa ghas cha(n)dan har jas ghaseeai ||2||
english: As Gurmukh, go and enter your own home; anoint yourself with the sandalwood oil of the Lord's Praises. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਹਸੀਐ ॥
transliteration: mere man har har har har har jas ootam lai laahaa har man haseeai ||
english: O my mind, the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are exalted and sublime. Earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and let your mind be happy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har aap daiaa kar devai taa a(n)mrit har ras chakheeai ||3||
english: If the Lord, Har, Har, in His Mercy, bestows it, then we partake of the ambrosial essence of the Lord's Name. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਜਮਿ ਘੁਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: mere man naam binaa jo doojai laage te saakat nar jam ghuteeai ||
english: O my mind, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and attached to duality, those faithless cynics are strangled by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਚੋਰ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਭਿਟੀਐ ॥੪॥
transliteration: te saakat chor jinaa naam visaariaa man tin kai nikat na bhiteeai ||4||
english: Such faithless cynics, who have forgotten the Naam, are thieves. O my mind, do not even go near them. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਲੇਖਾ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: mere man sevahu alakh nira(n)jan narahar jit seviai lekhaa chhuteeai ||
english: O my mind, serve the Unknowable and Immaculate Lord, the Man-lion; serving Him, your account will be cleared.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਾਸਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਘਟੀਐ ॥੫॥੫॥੧੯॥੫੭॥
transliteration: jan naanak har prabh poore keee khin maasaa tol na ghateeai ||5||5||19||57||
english: The Lord God has made servant Nanak perfect; he is not diminished by even the tiniest particle. ||5||5||19||57||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: hamare praan vasagat prabh tumarai meraa jeeu pi(n)d sabh teree ||
english: My breath of life is in Your Power, God; my soul and body are totally Yours.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚ ਘਣੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daiaa karahu har daras dikhaavahu merai man tan loch ghaneree ||1||
english: Be merciful to me, and show me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. There is such a great longing within my mind and body! ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚ ਮਿਲਣ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: raam merai man tan loch milan har keree ||
english: O my Lord, there is such a great longing within my mind and body to meet the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kripaal kripaa ki(n)chat gur keenee har miliaa aai prabh meree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When the Guru, the Merciful Guru, showed just a little mercy to me, my Lord God came and met me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jo hamarai man chit hai suaamee saa bidh tum har jaanahu meree ||
english: Whatever is in my conscious mind, O Lord and Master - that condition of mine is known only to You, Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਵਾ ਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anadin naam japee sukh paaee nit jeevaa aas har teree ||2||
english: Night and day, I chant Your Name, and I find peace. I live by placing my hopes in You, Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur daatai pa(n)th bataaiaa har miliaa aai prabh meree ||
english: The Guru, the True Guru, the Giver, has shown me the Way; my Lord God came and met me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਭ ਆਸ ਪੁਜੀ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anadin anad bhaiaa vadabhaagee sabh aas pujee jan keree ||3||
english: Night and day, I am filled with bliss; by great good fortune, all of the hopes of His humble servant have been fulfilled. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਭ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jaga(n)naath jagadeesur karate sabh vasagat hai har keree ||
english: O Lord of the World, Master of the Universe, everything is under Your control.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੦॥੫੮॥
transliteration: jan naanak saranaagat aae har raakhahu paij jan keree ||4||6||20||58||
english: Servant Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, Lord; please, preserve the honor of Your humble servant. ||4||6||20||58||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਦਹ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਹਾਢੇ ॥
transliteration: ihu manooaa khin na tikai bahu ra(n)gee dah dah dis chal chal haadhe ||
english: This mind does not hold still, even for an instant. Distracted by all sorts of distractions, it wanders around aimlessly in the ten directions.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਠਾਢੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur pooraa paaiaa vadabhaagee har ma(n)tr deeaa man thaadhe ||1||
english: I have found the Perfect Guru, through great good fortune; He has given me the Mantra of the Lord's Name, and my mind has become quiet and tranquil. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਾਂਢੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam ham satigur laale kaa(n)dhe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Lord, I am the slave of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਦਾਗੁ ਦਗਾਨਾ ਹਮ ਕਰਜ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਢੇ ॥
transliteration: hamarai masatak daag dagaanaa ham karaj guroo bahu saadhe ||
english: My forehead has been branded with His brand; I owe such a great debt to the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਭਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਢੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paraupakaar pu(n)n bahu keeaa bhau dutar taar paraadhe ||2||
english: He has been so generous and kind to me; He has carried me across the treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੂਰੇ ਗਾਢਨ ਗਾਢੇ ॥
transliteration: jin kau preet ridai har naahee tin koore gaadhan gaadhe ||
english: Those who do not have love for the Lord within their hearts, harbor only false intentions and goals.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਤਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਰਭਿ ਗਲਾਢੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu paanee kaagad binas jaat hai tiu manamukh garabh galaadhe ||3||
english: As paper breaks down and dissolves in water, the self-willed manmukh wastes away in arrogant pride. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਠਾਢੇ ॥
transliteration: ham jaaniaa kachhoo na jaanah aagai jiu har raakhai tiu thaadhe ||
english: I know nothing, and I do not know the future; as the Lord keeps me, so do I stand.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਤਰੇ ਕਾਢੇ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੧॥੫੯॥
transliteration: ham bhool chook gur kirapaa dhaarahu jan naanak kutare kaadhe ||4||7||21||59||
english: For my failings and mistakes, O Guru, grant me Your Grace; servant Nanak is Your obedient dog. ||4||7||21||59||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: kaam karodh nagar bahu bhariaa mil saadhoo kha(n)dal kha(n)daa he ||
english: The body-village is filled to overflowing with sexual desire and anger, which were broken into bits when I met with the Holy Saint.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poorab likhat likhe gur paaiaa man har liv ma(n)dal ma(n)daa he ||1||
english: By pre-ordained destiny, I have met with the Guru. I have entered into the realm of the Lord's Love. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: kar saadhoo a(n)julee pu(n)n vadaa he ||
english: Greet the Holy Saint with your palms pressed together; this is an act of great merit.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar da(n)daut pun vadaa he ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Bow down before Him; this is a virtuous action indeed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: saakat har ras saad na jaaniaa tin a(n)tar haumai ka(n)daa he ||
english: The wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not know the taste of the Lord's sublime essence. The thorn of egotism is embedded deep within them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu jiu chalahi chubhai dukh paavahi jamakaal sahahi sir da(n)daa he ||2||
english: The more they walk away, the deeper it sticks into them, and the more they suffer in pain, until finally, the Messenger of Death smashes his club against their heads. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: har jan har har naam samaane dukh janam maran bhav kha(n)daa he ||
english: The humble servants of the Lord are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The pain of birth and the fear of death are eradicated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: abinaasee purakh paaiaa paramesar bahu sobh kha(n)d brahama(n)daa he ||3||
english: They have obtained the Imperishable Supreme Being, the Transcendent Lord God, and they obtain great honor throughout all the worlds and realms. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: ham gareeb masakeen prabh tere har raakh raakh vad vadaa he ||
english: I am poor and meek, God, but I am Yours! Save me, please save me, O Greatest of the Great!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੨॥੬੦॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam adhaar tek hai har naame hee sukh ma(n)daa he ||4||8||22||60||
english: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||8||22||60||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਧੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: is gaR mahi har raam raai hai kichh saad na paavai dheethaa ||
english: Within this body-fortress is the Lord, the Sovereign Lord King, but the stubborn ones do not find the taste.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har deen daiaal anugrahu keeaa har gurasabadee chakh deethaa ||1||
english: When the Lord, Merciful to the meek, showed His Mercy, I found and tasted it, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਲਿਵ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam har keeratan gur liv meethaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Lovingly focused upon the Guru, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise has become sweet to me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਿ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: har agam agochar paarabraham hai mil satigur laag baseethaa ||
english: The Lord, the Supreme Lord God, is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. Those who are committed to the True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, meet the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਤਿਨ ਆਗੈ ਆਣਿ ਪਰੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin gur bachan sukhaane heearai tin aagai aan pareethaa ||2||
english: Those whose hearts are pleased with the Guru's Teachings - the Lord's Presence is revealed to them. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੀਅਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh heearaa at kathor hai tin a(n)tar kaar kareethaa ||
english: The hearts of the self-willed manmukhs are hard and cruel; their inner beings are dark.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਈਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਫੋਲਿ ਫੁਲੀਠਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: biseear kau bahu doodh peeaaeeai bikh nikasai phol phuleethaa ||3||
english: Even if the poisonous snake is fed large amounts of milk, it will still yield only poison. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਘਸਿ ਗਰੁੜੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: har prabh aan milaavahu gur saadhoo ghas garuR sabad mukh leethaa ||
english: O Lord God, please unite me with the Holy Guru, so that I might joyfully grind and eat the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰੂਆ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੩॥੬੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak gur ke laale gole lag sa(n)gat karooaa meethaa ||4||9||23||61||
english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Guru; in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the bitter becomes sweet. ||4||9||23||61||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਰਥਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਮ ਬੇਚਿਆ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਗੇ ॥
transliteration: har har arath sareer ham bechiaa poore gur kai aage ||
english: For the sake of the Lord, Har, Har, I have sold my body to the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur daatai naam diRaaiaa mukh masatak bhaag sabhaage ||1||
english: The True Guru, the Giver, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. A very blessed and fortunate destiny is recorded upon my forehead. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam guramat har liv laage ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I am lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat ramaeeaa ramat raam raai gur sabad guroo liv laage ||
english: The All-pervading Sovereign Lord King is contained in each and every heart. Through the Guru, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am lovingly centered on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hau man tan devau kaat guroo kau meraa bhram bhau gur bachanee bhaage ||2||
english: Cutting my mind and body into pieces, I offer them to my Guru. The Guru's Teachings have dispelled my doubt and fear. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ ਦੀਪਕ ਆਨਿ ਜਲਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhiaarai deepak aan jalaae gur giaan guroo liv laage ||
english: In the darkness, the Guru has lit the lamp of the Guru's wisdom; I am lovingly focused on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੀ ਮਨ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: agiaan a(n)dheraa binas binaasio ghar vasat lahee man jaage ||3||
english: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled, and my mind has been awakened; within the home of my inner being, I have found the genuine article. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਬਧਿਕ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਜੋਹਨਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: saakat badhik maaiaadhaaree tin jam johan laage ||
english: The vicious hunters, the faithless cynics, are hunted down by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸੀਸੁ ਨ ਬੇਚਿਆ ਓਇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: un satigur aagai sees na bechiaa oi aavahi jaahi abhaage ||4||
english: They have not sold their heads to the True Guru; those wretched, unfortunate ones continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: hamaraa binau sunahu prabh thaakur ham saran prabhoo har maage ||
english: Hear my prayer, O God, my Lord and Master: I beg for the Sanctuary of the Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਲਜ ਪਾਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਬੇਚਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੇ ॥੫॥੧੦॥੨੪॥੬੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak kee laj paat guroo hai sir bechio satigur aage ||5||10||24||62||
english: Servant Nanak's honor and respect is the Guru; he has sold his head to the True Guru. ||5||10||24||62||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ham aha(n)kaaree aha(n)kaar agiaan mat gur miliai aap gavaaiaa ||
english: I am egotistical and conceited, and my intellect is ignorant. Meeting the Guru, my selfishness and conceit have been abolished.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haumai rog gaiaa sukh paaiaa dhan dha(n)n guroo har raaiaa ||1||
english: The illness of egotism is gone, and I have found peace. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Sovereign Lord King. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam gur kai bachan har paaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have found the Lord, through the Teachings of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: merai heearai preet raam raai kee gur maarag pa(n)th bataaiaa ||
english: My heart is filled with love for the Sovereign Lord King; the Guru has shown me the path and the way to find Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: meraa jeeu pi(n)d sabh satigur aagai jin vichhuRiaa har gal laaiaa ||2||
english: My soul and body all belong to the Guru; I was separated, and He has led me into the Lord's Embrace. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: merai a(n)tar preet lagee dekhan kau gur hirade naal dikhaaiaa ||
english: Deep within myself, I would love to see the Lord; the Guru has inspired me to see Him within my heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੋਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sahaj ana(n)d bhaiaa man morai gur aagai aap vechaaiaa ||3||
english: Within my mind, intuitive peace and bliss have arisen; I have sold myself to the Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਪਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਚੋਰ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ham aparaadh paap bahu keene kar dusatee chor churaaiaa ||
english: I am a sinner - I have committed so many sins; I am a villainous, thieving thief.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੫॥੬੩॥
transliteration: ab naanak saranaagat aae har raakhahu laaj har bhaaiaa ||4||11||25||63||
english: Now, Nanak has come to the Lord's Sanctuary; preserve my honor, Lord, as it pleases Your Will. ||4||11||25||63||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramat baajai sabad anaahad guramat manooaa gaavai ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the unstruck music resounds; through the Guru's Teachings, the mind sings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee gur darasan paaiaa dhan dha(n)n guroo liv laavai ||1||
english: By great good fortune, I received the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, who has led me to love the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har liv laavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Gurmukh is lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hamaraa thaakur satigur pooraa man gur kee kaar kamaavai ||
english: My Lord and Master is the Perfect True Guru. My mind works to serve the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਾਵ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ham mal mal dhovah paav guroo ke jo har har kathaa sunaavai ||2||
english: I massage and wash the Feet of the Guru, who recites the Sermon of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hiradai guramat raam rasaain jihavaa har gun gaavai ||
english: The Teachings of the Guru are in my heart; the Lord is the Source of nectar. My tongue sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਆਘਾਨੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man rasak rasak har ras aaghaane phir bahur na bhookh lagaavai ||3||
english: My mind is immersed in, and drenched with the Lord's essence. Fulfilled with the Lord's Love, I shall never feel hunger again. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਉਪਾਵ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: koee karai upaav anek bahutere bin kirapaa naam na paavai ||
english: People try all sorts of things, but without the Lord's Mercy, His Name is not obtained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੬॥੬੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau har kirapaa dhaaree mat guramat naam driRaavai ||4||12||26||64||
english: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; through the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, he has enshrined the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||12||26||64||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee maajh mahalaa 4 ||
english: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿੰਦੂ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ji(n)doo jap naam kara(n)maa ||
english: O my soul, as Gurmukh, do this deed: chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: mat maataa mat jeeu naam mukh raamaa ||
english: Make that teaching your mother, that it may teach you to keep the Lord's Name in your mouth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਜਨਮਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tokh pitaa kar gur purakh ajanamaa ||
english: Let contentment be your father; the Guru is the Primal Being, beyond birth or incarnation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਰਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee mil raamaa ||1||
english: By great good fortune, you shall meet with the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gur jogee purakh miliaa ra(n)g maanee jeeu ||
english: I have met the Guru, the Yogi, the Primal Being; I am delighted with His Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gur har ra(n)g rataRaa sadaa nirabaanee jeeu ||
english: The Guru is imbued with the Love of the Lord; He dwells forever in Nirvaanaa.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee mil sughaR sujaanee jeeu ||
english: By great good fortune, I met the most accomplished and all-knowing Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: meraa man tan har ra(n)g bhi(n)naa ||2||
english: My mind and body are drenched in the Love of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aavahu sa(n)tahu mil naam japaahaa ||
english: Come, O Saints - let's meet together and chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: vich sa(n)gat naam sadaa lai laahaa jeeu ||
english: In the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, let's earn the lasting profit of the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੰਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kar sevaa sa(n)taa a(n)mrit mukh paahaa jeeu ||
english: Let's serve the Saints, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਅੜੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mil poorab likhiaRe dhur karamaa ||3||
english: By one's karma and pre-ordained destiny, they are met. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਵਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਜਗੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: saavan varas a(n)mrit jag chhaaiaa jeeu ||
english: In the month of Saawan, the clouds of Ambrosial Nectar hang over the world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰੁ ਕੁਹੁਕਿਅੜਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man mor kuhukiaRaa sabad mukh paaiaa ||
english: The peacock of the mind chirps, and receives the Word of the Shabad, in its mouth;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੁਠੜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)mrit vuthaRaa miliaa har raaiaa jeeu ||
english: the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord rains down, and the Sovereign Lord King is met.

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: jan naanak prem rata(n)naa ||4||1||27||65||
english: Servant Nanak is imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||1||27||65||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee maajh mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰੀਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aau sakhee gun kaaman kareehaa jeeu ||
english: Come, O sisters - let's make virtue our charms.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਹ ਰਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)t janaa ra(n)g maanih raleeaa jeeu ||
english: Let's join the Saints, and enjoy the pleasure of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gur deepak giaan sadaa man baleeaa jeeu ||
english: The lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom burns steadily in my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਢੁਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har tuthai dhul dhul mileeaa jeeu ||1||
english: The Lord, being pleased and moved by pity, has led me to meet Him. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਢੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: merai man tan prem lagaa har dhole jeeu ||
english: My mind and body are filled with love for my Darling Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੇਚੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: mai mele mitr satigur vechole jeeu ||
english: The True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, has united me with my Friend.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾਂ ਸੰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: man devaa(n) sa(n)taa meraa prabh mele jeeu ||
english: I offer my mind to the Guru, who has led me to meet my God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਘੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har vitaRiahu sadaa ghole jeeu ||2||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: vas mere piaariaa vas mere govidaa har kar kirapaa man vas jeeu ||
english: Dwell, O my Beloved, dwell, O my Lord of the Universe; O Lord, show mercy to me and come to dwell within my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: man chi(n)diaRaa phal paaiaa mere govi(n)daa gur pooraa vekh vigas jeeu ||
english: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, O my Lord of the Universe; I am transfixed with ecstasy, gazing upon the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har naam miliaa sohaaganee mere govi(n)daa man anadin anad rahas jeeu ||
english: The happy soul-brides receive the Lord's Name, O my Lord of the Universe; night and day, their minds are blissful and happy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਨਿਤ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਨਿ ਹਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har paaiaRaa vadabhaageeee mere govi(n)daa nit lai laahaa man has jeeu ||3||
english: By great good fortune, the Lord is found, O my Lord of the Universe; earning profit continually, the mind laughs with joy. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har aap upaae har aape vekhai har aape kaarai laaiaa jeeu ||
english: The Lord Himself creates, and the Lord Himself beholds; the Lord Himself assigns all to their tasks.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਬਖਸ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਇਕਨਾ ਫਕਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ik khaavahi bakhas tot na aavai ikanaa phakaa paaiaa jeeu ||
english: Some partake of the bounty of the Lord's favor, which never runs out, while others receive only a handful.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਇਕਨਾ ਭਿਖ ਮੰਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ik raaje takhat bahahi nit sukheee ikanaa bhikh ma(n)gaaiaa jeeu ||
english: Some sit upon thrones as kings, and enjoy constant pleasures, while others must beg for charity.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੮॥੬੬॥
transliteration: sabh iko sabad varatadaa mere govidaa jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa jeeu ||4||2||28||66||
english: The Word of the Shabad is pervading in everyone, O my Lord of the Universe; servant Nanak meditates on the Naam. ||4||2||28||66||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee maajh mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: man maahee man maahee mere govi(n)daa har ra(n)g rataa man maahee jeeu ||
english: From within my mind, from within my mind, O my Lord of the Universe, I am imbued with the Love of the Lord, from within my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g naal na lakheeai mere govidaa gur pooraa alakh lakhaahee jeeu ||
english: The Lord's Love is with me, but it cannot be seen, O my Lord of the Universe; the Perfect Guru has led me to see the unseen.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਸਭ ਦਾਲਦ ਦੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam paragaasiaa mere govi(n)daa sabh daalad dukh lahi jaahee jeeu ||
english: He has revealed the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my Lord of the Universe; all poverty and pain have departed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har pad ootam paaiaa mere govi(n)daa vadabhaagee naam samaahee jeeu ||1||
english: I have obtained the supreme status of the Lord, O my Lord of the Universe; by great good fortune, I am absorbed in the Naam. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨੈਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਨੈਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠੜਾ ਨੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: nainee mere piaariaa nainee mere govidaa kinai har prabh dithaRaa nainee jeeu ||
english: With his eyes, O my Beloved, with his eyes, O my Lord of the Universe - has anyone ever seen the Lord God with his eyes?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਧਨ ਕੁਮਲੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: meraa man tan bahut bairaagiaa mere govi(n)daa har baajhahu dhan kumalainee jeeu ||
english: My mind and body are sad and depressed, O my Lord of the Universe; without her Husband Lord, the soul-bride is withering away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil paaiaa mere govidaa meraa har prabh sajan sainee jeeu ||
english: Meeting the Saints, O my Lord of the Universe, I have found my Lord God, my Companion, my Best Friend.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਮੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਰੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har aai miliaa jagajeevan mere govi(n)daa mai sukh vihaanee rainee jeeu ||2||
english: The Lord, the Life of the World, has come to meet me, O my Lord of the Universe. The night of my life now passes in peace. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: mai melahu sa(n)t meraa har prabh sajan mai man tan bhukh lagaaeeaa jeeu ||
english: O Saints, unite me with my Lord God, my Best Friend; my mind and body are hungry for Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: hau rahi na sakau bin dekhe mere preetam mai a(n)tar birahu har laaeeaa jeeu ||
english: I cannot survive without seeing my Beloved; deep within, I feel the pain of separation from the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har raaiaa meraa sajan piaaraa gur mele meraa man jeevaaeeaa jeeu ||
english: The Sovereign Lord King is my Beloved, my Best Friend. Through the Guru, I have met Him, and my mind has been rejuvenated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: merai man tan aasaa pooreeaa mere govi(n)daa har miliaa man vaadhaaeeaa jeeu ||3||
english: The hopes of my mind and body have been fulfilled, O my Lord of the Universe; meeting the Lord, my mind vibrates with joy. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਸਦ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: vaaree mere govi(n)daa vaaree mere piaariaa hau tudh vitaRiahu sad vaaree jeeu ||
english: A sacrifice, O my Lord of the Universe, a sacrifice, O my Beloved; I am forever a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: merai man tan prem pira(n)m kaa mere govidaa har poo(n)jee raakh hamaaree jeeu ||
english: My mind and body are filled with love for my Husband Lord; O my Lord of the Universe, please preserve my assets.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਿਸਟੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਿ ਰੈਬਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur visat mel mere govi(n)daa har mele kar raibaaree jeeu ||
english: Unite me with the True Guru, Your Advisor, O my Lord of the Universe; through His guidance, He shall lead me to the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੯॥੬੭॥
transliteration: har naam daiaa kar paaiaa mere govi(n)daa jan naanak saran tumaaree jeeu ||4||3||29||67||
english: I have obtained the Lord's Name, by Your Mercy, O my Lord of the Universe; servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary. ||4||3||29||67||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee maajh mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: chojee mere govi(n)daa chojee mere piaariaa har prabh meraa chojee jeeu ||
english: Playful is my Lord of the Universe; playful is my Beloved. My Lord God is wondrous and playful.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਨੑੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੋਪੀ ਖੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har aape kaanh upaaidaa mere govidaa har aape gopee khojee jeeu ||
english: The Lord Himself created Krishna, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself is the milkmaids who seek Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਭੋਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har aape sabh ghat bhogadaa mere govi(n)daa aape raseeaa bhogee jeeu ||
english: The Lord Himself enjoys every heart, O my Lord of the Universe; He Himself is the Ravisher and the Enjoyer.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har sujaan na bhulaee mere govi(n)daa aape satigur jogee jeeu ||1||
english: The Lord is All-knowing - He cannot be fooled, O my Lord of the Universe. He is the True Guru, the Yogi. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਖੇਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aape jagat upaaidaa mere govidaa har aap khelai bahu ra(n)gee jeeu ||
english: He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself plays in so many ways!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਇਕਿ ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨੰਗ ਨੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa bhog bhogaaidaa mere govi(n)daa ik nagan phirahi na(n)g na(n)gee jeeu ||
english: Some enjoy enjoyments, O my Lord of the Universe, while others wander around naked, the poorest of the poor.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਭ ਮੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aape jagat upaaidaa mere govidaa har daan devai sabh ma(n)gee jeeu ||
english: He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord gives His gifts to all who beg for them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhagataa naam aadhaar hai mere govi(n)daa har kathaa ma(n)gahi har cha(n)gee jeeu ||2||
english: His devotees have the Support of the Naam, O my Lord of the Universe; they beg for the sublime sermon of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਲੋਚ ਮਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har aape bhagat karaaidaa mere govi(n)daa har bhagataa loch man pooree jeeu ||
english: The Lord Himself inspires His devotees to worship Him, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord fulfills the desires of the minds of His devotees.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aape jal thal varatadaa mere govidaa rav rahiaa nahee dooree jeeu ||
english: He Himself is permeating and pervading the waters and the lands, O my Lord of the Universe; He is All-pervading - He is not far away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)tar baahar aap hai mere govidaa har aap rahiaa bharapooree jeeu ||
english: The Lord Himself is within the self, and outside as well, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself is fully pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਹਦੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har aatam raam pasaariaa mere govi(n)daa har vekhai aap hadooree jeeu ||3||
english: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is diffused everywhere, O my Lord of the Universe. The Lord Himself beholds all; His Immanent Presence is pervading everywhere. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਉਣੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਵਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)tar vaajaa paun hai mere govi(n)daa har aap vajaae tiu vaajai jeeu ||
english: O Lord, the music of the praanic wind is deep within, O my Lord of the Universe; as the Lord Himself plays this music, so does it vibrate and resound.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)tar naam nidhaan hai mere govi(n)daa gurasabadee har prabh gaajai jeeu ||
english: O Lord, the treasure of the Naam is deep within, O my Lord of the Universe; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord God is revealed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aape saran pavaaidaa mere govi(n)daa har bhagat janaa raakh laajai jeeu ||
english: He Himself leads us to enter His Sanctuary, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord preserves the honor of His devotees.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੮॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee mil sa(n)gatee mere govi(n)daa jan naanak naam sidh kaajai jeeu ||4||4||30||68||
english: By great good fortune, one joins the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, O my Lord of the Universe; O servant Nanak, through the Naam, one's affairs are resolved. ||4||4||30||68||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee maajh mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: mai har naamai har birahu lagaaee jeeu ||
english: The Lord has implanted a longing for the Lord's Name within me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: meraa har prabh mit milai sukh paaee jeeu ||
english: I have met the Lord God, my Best Friend, and I have found peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har prabh dekh jeevaa meree maaee jeeu ||
english: Beholding my Lord God, I live, O my mother.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: meraa naam sakhaa har bhaaee jeeu ||1||
english: The Lord's Name is my Friend and Brother. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavahu sa(n)t jeeu mere har prabh kere jeeu ||
english: O Dear Saints, sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jap guramukh naam jeeu bhaag vadere jeeu ||
english: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O very fortunate ones.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam jeeu praan har mere jeeu ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my soul and my breath of life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲ ਫੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: phir bahuR na bhavajal phere jeeu ||2||
english: I shall never again have to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵੇਖਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kiu har prabh vekhaa merai man tan chaau jeeu ||
english: How shall I behold my Lord God? My mind and body yearn for Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਿ ਲਗਾ ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har melahu sa(n)t jeeu man lagaa bhaau jeeu ||
english: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints; my mind is in love with Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee paaeeai har preetam raau jeeu ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have found the Sovereign Lord, my Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee jap naau jeeu ||3||
english: O very fortunate ones, chant the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਡੜੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: merai man tan vadaRee govi(n)d prabh aasaa jeeu ||
english: Within my mind and body, there is such a great longing for God, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har melahu sa(n)t jeeu govid prabh paasaa jeeu ||
english: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints. God, the Lord of the Universe, is so close to me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur mat naam sadaa paragaasaa jeeu ||
english: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, the Naam is always revealed;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਿਅੜੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੧॥੬੯॥
transliteration: jan naanak pooriaRee man aasaa jeeu ||4||5||31||69||
english: the desires of servant Nanak's mind have been fulfilled. ||4||5||31||69||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee maajh mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: meraa birahee naam milai taa jeevaa jeeu ||
english: If I receive my Love, the Naam, then I live.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: man a(n)dar a(n)mrit guramat har leevaa jeeu ||
english: In the temple of the mind, is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord; through the Guru's Teachings, we drink it in.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: man har ra(n)g rataRaa har ras sadaa peevaa jeeu ||
english: My mind is drenched with the Love of the Lord. I continually drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har paaiaRaa man jeevaa jeeu ||1||
english: I have found the Lord within my mind, and so I live. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: merai man tan prem lagaa har baan jeeu ||
english: The arrow of the Lord's Love has pierced by mind and body.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: meraa preetam mitr har purakh sujaan jeeu ||
english: The Lord, the Primal Being, is All-knowing; He is my Beloved and my Best Friend.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gur mele sa(n)t har sughaR sujaan jeeu ||
english: The Saintly Guru has united me with the All-knowing and All-seeing Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hau naam vitahu kurabaan jeeu ||2||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: hau har har sajan har meet dasaaee jeeu ||
english: I seek my Lord, Har, Har, my Intimate, my Best Friend.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਸਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਪਵਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har dasahu sa(n)tahu jee har khoj pavaaee jeeu ||
english: Show me the way to the Lord, Dear Saints; I am searching all over for Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠੜਾ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur tuthaRaa dase har paaee jeeu ||
english: The Kind and Compassionate True Guru has shown me the Way, and I have found the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har naame naam samaaee jeeu ||3||
english: Through the Name of the Lord, I am absorbed in the Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਵੇਦਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: mai vedan prem har birahu lagaaee jeeu ||
english: I am consumed with the pain of separation from the Love of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gur saradhaa poor a(n)mrit mukh paaee jeeu ||
english: The Guru has fulfilled my desire, and I have received the Ambrosial Nectar in my mouth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har hohu daiaal har naam dhiaaee jeeu ||
english: The Lord has become merciful, and now I meditate on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: jan naanak har ras paaee jeeu ||4||6||20||18||32||70||
english: Servant Nanak has obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. ||4||6||20||18||32||70||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 5 raag gauRee guaareree chaupade ||
english: Fifth Mehl, Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਹੋਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kin bidh kusal hot mere bhaaee ||
english: How can happiness be found, O my Siblings of Destiny?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kiu paaeeai har raam sahaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How can the Lord, our Help and Support, be found? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੁਸਲੁ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kusal na grihi meree sabh maaiaa ||
english: There is no happiness in owning one's own home, in all of Maya,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ooche ma(n)dar su(n)dar chhaaiaa ||
english: or in lofty mansions casting beautiful shadows.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jhoothe laalach janam gavaaiaa ||1||
english: In fraud and greed, this human life is being wasted. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: hasatee ghoRe dekh vigaasaa ||
english: He is pleased at the sight of his elephants and horses

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਸਕਰ ਜੋੜੇ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: lasakar joRe neb khavaasaa ||
english: and his armies assembled, his servants and his soldiers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੇ ਫਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gal jevaRee haumai ke phaasaa ||2||
english: But the noose of egotism is tightening around his neck. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: raaj kamaavai dah dis saaree ||
english: His rule may extend in all ten directions;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੈ ਰੰਗ ਭੋਗ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maanai ra(n)g bhog bahu naaree ||
english: he may revel in pleasures, and enjoy many women

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu narapat supanai bhekhaaree ||3||
english: - but he is just a beggar, who in his dream, is a king. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ek kusal mo kau satiguroo bataaiaa ||
english: The True Guru has shown me that there is only one pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har jo kichh kare s har kiaa bhagataa bhaaiaa ||
english: Whatever the Lord does, is pleasing to the Lord's devotee.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak haumai maar samaaiaa ||4||
english: Servant Nanak has abolished his ego, and he is absorbed in the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲ ਹੋਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: in bidh kusal hot mere bhaaee ||
english: This is the way to find happiness, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: iu paaeeai har raam sahaaee ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||
english: This is the way to find the Lord, our Help and Support. ||1||Second Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਭ੍ਰਮੀਐ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kiu bhrameeai bhram kis kaa hoee ||
english: Why do you doubt? What do you doubt?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa jal thal maheeal raviaa soee ||
english: God is pervading the water, the land and the sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh ubare manamukh pat khoee ||1||
english: The Gurmukhs are saved, while the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis raakhai aap raam daiaaraa ||
english: One who is protected by the Merciful Lord

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tis nahee doojaa ko pahuchanahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - no one else can rival him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi varatai ek ana(n)taa ||
english: The Infinite One is pervading among all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਉ ਹੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: taa too(n) sukh sou hoi achi(n)taa ||
english: So sleep in peace, and don't worry.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਵਰਤੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ohu sabh kichh jaanai jo varata(n)taa ||2||
english: He knows everything which happens. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ ਜਿਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mue jin doojee piaasaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are dying in the thirst of duality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਵਹਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: bahu jonee bhavahi dhur kirat likhiaasaa ||
english: They wander lost through countless incarnations; this is their pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜਹਿ ਤੈਸਾ ਖਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaisaa beejahi taisaa khaasaa ||3||
english: As they plant, so shall they harvest. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਵਿਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: dekh daras man bhaiaa vigaasaa ||
english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my mind has blossomed forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh nadaree aaiaa braham paragaasaa ||
english: And now everywhere I look, God is revealed to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੭੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak kee har pooran aasaa ||4||2||71||
english: Servant Nanak's hopes have been fulfilled by the Lord. ||4||2||71||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਭਏ ਕੀਟ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: kaee janam bhae keet pata(n)gaa ||
english: In so many incarnations, you were a worm and an insect;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਗਜ ਮੀਨ ਕੁਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: kaee janam gaj meen kura(n)gaa ||
english: in so many incarnations, you were an elephant, a fish and a deer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਪੰਖੀ ਸਰਪ ਹੋਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kaee janam pa(n)khee sarap hoio ||
english: In so many incarnations, you were a bird and a snake.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਹੈਵਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਖ ਜੋਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaee janam haivar brikh joio ||1||
english: In so many incarnations, you were yoked as an ox and a horse. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mil jagadees milan kee bareeaa ||
english: Meet the Lord of the Universe - now is the time to meet Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਇਹ ਦੇਹ ਸੰਜਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chira(n)kaal ih deh sa(n)jareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: After so very long, this human body was fashioned for you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਸੈਲ ਗਿਰਿ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kaee janam sail gir kariaa ||
english: In so many incarnations, you were rocks and mountains;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਗਰਭ ਹਿਰਿ ਖਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kaee janam garabh hir khariaa ||
english: in so many incarnations, you were aborted in the womb;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਸਾਖ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kaee janam saakh kar upaaiaa ||
english: in so many incarnations, you developed branches and leaves;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jon bhramaaiaa ||2||
english: you wandered through 8.4 million incarnations. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਇਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g bhaio janam paraapat ||
english: Through the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you obtained this human life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kar sevaa bhaj har har guramat ||
english: Do seva - selfless service; follow the Guru's Teachings, and vibrate the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tiaag maan jhooth abhimaan ||
english: Abandon pride, falsehood and arrogance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jeevat marahi daragah paravaan ||3||
english: Remain dead while yet alive, and you shall be welcomed in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੁ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh hoaa s tujh te hog ||
english: Whatever has been, and whatever shall be, comes from You, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: avar na doojaa karanai jog ||
english: No one else can do anything at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਜਾ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: taa mileeai jaa laihi milaai ||
english: We are united with You, when You unite us with Yourself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak har har gun gaai ||4||3||72||
english: Says Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||72||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮਿ ਮਹਿ ਬੋਅਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: karam bhoom mahi boahu naam ||
english: In the field of karma, plant the seed of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: pooran hoi tumaaraa kaam ||
english: Your works shall be brought to fruition.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
transliteration: phal paavahi mitai jam traas ||
english: You shall obtain these fruits, and the fear of death shall be dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nit gaavahi har har gun jaas ||1||
english: Sing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har har naam a(n)tar ur dhaar ||
english: Keep the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, enshrined in your heart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਘਰ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: seeghar kaaraj lehu savaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and your affairs shall be quickly resolved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਹੋਹੁ ਸਾਵਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: apane prabh siu hohu saavadhaan ||
english: Be always attentive to your God;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: taa too(n) daragah paavahi maan ||
english: thus you shall be honored in His Court.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
transliteration: ukat siaanap sagalee tiaag ||
english: Give up all your clever tricks and devices,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee charanee laag ||2||
english: and hold tight to the Feet of the Saints. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਹਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: sarab jee hahi jaa kai haath ||
english: The One, who holds all creatures in His Hands,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: kade na vichhuRai sabh kai saath ||
english: is never separated from them; He is with them all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਪਾਵ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
transliteration: upaav chhod gahu tis kee ot ||
english: Abandon your clever devices, and grasp hold of His Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਛੋਟਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nimakh maahi hovai teree chhot ||3||
english: In an instant, you shall be saved. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa nikat kar tis no jaan ||
english: Know that He is always near at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee aagiaa sat kar maan ||
english: Accept the Order of God as True.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੁ ਆਪੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan mitaavahu aap ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, eradicate selfishness and conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੭੩॥
transliteration: har har naam naanak jap jaap ||4||4||73||
english: O Nanak, chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||4||73||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa bachan sadaa abinaasee ||
english: The Guru's Word is eternal and everlasting.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan katee jam phaasee ||
english: The Guru's Word cuts away the noose of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa bachan jee kai sa(n)g ||
english: The Guru's Word is always with the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਚੈ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan rachai raam kai ra(n)g ||1||
english: Through the Guru's Word, one is immersed in the Love of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
transliteration: jo gur deeaa s man kai kaam ||
english: Whatever the Guru gives, is useful to the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa keeaa sat kar maan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever the Saint does - accept that as True. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਅਟਲ ਅਛੇਦ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa bachan atal achhed ||
english: The Guru's Word is infallible and unchanging.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਟੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੇਦ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan kate bhram bhed ||
english: Through the Guru's Word, doubt and prejudice are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa bachan katahu na jaai ||
english: The Guru's Word never goes away;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan har ke gun gaai ||2||
english: through the Guru's Word, we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਾਥ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa bachan jee kai saath ||
english: The Guru's Word accompanies the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa bachan anaath ko naath ||
english: The Guru's Word is the Master of the masterless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan narak na pavai ||
english: The Guru's Word saves one from falling into hell.

author: Guru Arjan
