gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan rasanaa a(n)mrit ravai ||3||
english: Through the Guru's Word, the tongue savors the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa bachan paragat sa(n)saar ||
english: The Guru's Word is revealed in the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan na aavai haar ||
english: Through the Guru's Word, no one suffers defeat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jis jan hoe aap kripaal ||
english: O Nanak, the True Guru is always kind and compassionate,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥੫॥੭੪॥
transliteration: naanak satigur sadaa daiaal ||4||5||74||
english: Unto those whom the Lord Himself has blessed with His Mercy. ||4||5||74||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਤੇ ਰਤਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jin keetaa maatee te ratan ||
english: He makes jewels out of the dust,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
transliteration: garabh mahi raakhiaa jin kar jatan ||
english: and He managed to preserve you in the womb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jin deenee sobhaa vadiaaee ||
english: He has given you fame and greatness;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis prabh kau aath pahar dhiaaee ||1||
english: meditate on that God, twenty-four hours a day. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਮਈਆ ਰੇਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: ramaeeaa ren saadh jan paavau ||
english: O Lord, I seek the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur mil apunaa khasam dhiaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting the Guru, I meditate on my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਮੂੜ ਤੇ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jin keetaa mooR te bakataa ||
english: He transformed me, the fool, into a fine speaker,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਬੇਸੁਰਤ ਤੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jin keetaa besurat te surataa ||
english: and He made the unconscious become conscious;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jis parasaad navai nidh paaee ||
english: by His Grace, I have obtained the nine treasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so prabh man te bisarat naahee ||2||
english: May I never forget that God from my mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jin deeaa nithaave kau thaan ||
english: He has given a home to the homeless;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਿਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jin deeaa nimaane kau maan ||
english: He has given honor to the dishonored.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jin keenee sabh pooran aasaa ||
english: He has fulfilled all desires;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: simarau din rain saas giraasaa ||3||
english: remember Him in meditation, day and night, with every breath and every morsel of food. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਿਲਕ ਕਾਟੀ ॥
transliteration: jis prasaad maaiaa silak kaatee ||
english: By His Grace, the bonds of Maya are cut away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਟੀ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad a(n)mrit bikh khaatee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the bitter poison has become Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak is te kichh naahee ||
english: Says Nanak, I cannot do anything;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ਕਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੭੫॥
transliteration: raakhanahaare kau saalaahee ||4||6||75||
english: I praise the Lord, the Protector. ||4||6||75||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: tis kee saran naahee bhau sog ||
english: In His Sanctuary, there is no fear or sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: us te baahar kachhoo na hog ||
english: Without Him, nothing at all can be done.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜੀ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tajee siaanap bal budh bikaar ||
english: I have renounced clever tricks, power and intellectual corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daas apane kee raakhanahaar ||1||
english: God is the Protector of His servant. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: jap man mere raam raam ra(n)g ||
english: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord, Raam, Raam, with love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ghar baahar terai sad sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Within your home, and beyond it, He is always with you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: tis kee tek manai mahi raakh ||
english: Keep His Support in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad a(n)mrit ras chaakh ||
english: Taste the ambrosial essence, the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਜਤਨ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਉਨ ਕਾਜ ॥
transliteration: avar jatan kahahu kaun kaaj ||
english: Of what use are other efforts?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਜ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhai aap laaj ||2||
english: Showing His Mercy, the Lord Himself protects our honor. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kiaa maanukh kahahu kiaa jor ||
english: What is the human? What power does he have?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jhoothaa maaiaa kaa sabh sor ||
english: All the tumult of Maya is false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavanahaar suaamee ||
english: Our Lord and Master is the One who acts, and causes others to act.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sagal ghataa ke a(n)tarajaamee ||3||
english: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa sukh saachaa ehu ||
english: Of all comforts, this is the true comfort.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: gur upades manai mahi lehu ||
english: Keep the Guru's Teachings in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau raam naam liv laagee ||
english: Those who bear love for the Name of the Lord

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੭॥੭੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak so dha(n)n vadabhaagee ||4||7||76||
english: - says Nanak, they are blessed, and very fortunate. ||4||7||76||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਉਤਾਰੀ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
transliteration: sun har kathaa utaaree mail ||
english: Listening to the Lord's sermon, my pollution has been washed away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਏ ਸੁਖ ਸੈਲੁ ॥
transliteration: mahaa puneet bhae sukh sail ||
english: I have become totally pure, and I now walk in peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag paaiaa saadhasa(n)g ||
english: By great good fortune, I found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paarabraham siu laago ra(n)g ||1||
english: I have fallen in love with the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਜਨੁ ਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japat jan taario ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, His servant has been carried across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: agan saagar gur paar utaario ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru has lifted me up and carried me across the ocean of fire. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਮਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: kar keeratan man seetal bhae ||
english: Singing the Kirtan of His Praises, my mind has become peaceful;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਗਏ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh gae ||
english: the sins of countless incarnations have been washed away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪੇਖੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan pekhe man maahi ||
english: I have seen all the treasures within my own mind;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਢੂਢਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ab dhoodhan kaahe kau jaahi ||2||
english: why should I now go out searching for them? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: prabh apune jab bhae daiaal ||
english: When God Himself becomes merciful,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਸੇਵਕ ਘਾਲ ॥
transliteration: pooran hoee sevak ghaal ||
english: the work of His servant becomes perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan kaat keee apane daas ||
english: He has cut away my bonds, and made me His slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥੩॥
transliteration: simar simar simar gunataas ||3||
english: Remember, remember, remember Him in meditation; He is the treasure of excellence. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: eko man eko sabh thaai ||
english: He alone is in the mind; He alone is everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pooran poor rahio sabh jaai ||
english: The Perfect Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai sabh bharam chukaaiaa ||
english: The Perfect Guru has dispelled all doubts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੭੭॥
transliteration: har simarat naanak sukh paaiaa ||4||8||77||
english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, Nanak has found peace. ||4||8||77||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਲੇ ਮੁਏ ਸਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰੇ ॥
transliteration: agale mue s paachhai pare ||
english: Those who have died have been forgotten.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਬਰੇ ਸੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਲਕੁ ਖਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jo ubare se ba(n)dh lak khare ||
english: Those who survive have fastened their belts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਧੰਧੇ ਮਹਿ ਓਇ ਲਪਟਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jih dha(n)dhe mahi oi lapataae ||
english: They are busily occupied in their affairs;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਦੁਗੁਣ ਦਿੜੀ ਉਨ ਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: un te dugun diRee un maae ||1||
english: they cling twice as hard to Maya. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਬੇਲਾ ਕਛੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: oh belaa kachh cheet na aavai ||
english: No one thinks of the time of death;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਤਾਹੂ ਲਪਟਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: binas jaai taahoo lapataavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: people grasp to hold that which shall pass away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਬੰਧੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ba(n)dhee moorakh deh ||
english: The fools - their bodies are bound down by desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਅਸਨੇਹ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lapatio asaneh ||
english: They are mired in sexual desire, anger and attachment;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਠਾਢੋ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sir oopar thaadho dharam raai ||
english: the Righteous Judge of Dharma stands over their heads.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਠੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: meethee kar kar bikhiaa khaai ||2||
english: Believing it to be sweet, the fools eat poison. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬੰਧਉ ਹਉ ਸਾਧਉ ਬੈਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hau ba(n)dhau hau saadhau bair ||
english: They say, "I shall tie up my enemy, and I shall cut him down.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਘਾਲੈ ਪੈਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hamaree bhoom kaun ghaalai pair ||
english: Who dares to set foot upon my land?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹਉ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
transliteration: hau pa(n)dit hau chatur siaanaa ||
english: I am learned, I am clever and wise."

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karanaihaar na bujhai bigaanaa ||3||
english: The ignorant ones do not recognize their Creator. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: apunee gat mit aape jaanai ||
english: The Lord Himself knows His Own state and condition.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa ko kahai kiaa aakh vakhaanai ||
english: What can anyone say? How can anyone describe Him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jit jit laavahi tit tit laganaa ||
english: Whatever He attaches us to - to that we are attached.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਭ ਕਾਹੂ ਮੰਗਨਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: apanaa bhalaa sabh kaahoo ma(n)ganaa ||4||
english: Everyone begs for their own good. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh teraa too(n) karanaihaar ||
english: Everything is Yours; You are the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t naahee kichh paaraavaar ||
english: You have no end or limitation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: daas apane kau deejai daan ||
english: Please give this gift to Your servant,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੫॥੯॥੭੮॥
transliteration: kabahoo na visarai naanak naam ||5||9||78||
english: that Nanak might never forget the Naam. ||5||9||78||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤ ਛੁਟਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: anik jatan nahee hot chhutaaraa ||
english: By all sorts of efforts, people do not find salvation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਆਗਲ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bahut siaanap aagal bhaaraa ||
english: Through clever tricks, the weight is only piled on more and more.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੇਤ ॥
transliteration: har kee sevaa niramal het ||
english: Serving the Lord with a pure heart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh kee daragah sobhaa set ||1||
english: you shall be received with honor at God's Court. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਓਲਾ ॥
transliteration: man mere gahu har naam kaa olaa ||
english: O my mind, hold tight to the Support of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝੈ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾਤਾ ਝੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tujhai na laagai taataa jholaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The hot winds shall never even touch you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jiu bohith bhai saagar maahi ||
english: Like a boat in the ocean of fear;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਦੀਪਕ ਦੀਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhakaar deepak deepaahi ||
english: like a lamp which illumines the darkness;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਸੀਤ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਸਿ ਦੂਖ ॥
transliteration: agan seet kaa laahas dookh ||
english: like fire which takes away the pain of cold

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੂਖ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam japat man hovat sookh ||2||
english: - just so, chanting the Name, the mind becomes peaceful. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਤਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਤੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: utar jaai tere man kee piaas ||
english: The thirst of your mind shall be quenched,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: pooran hovai sagalee aas ||
english: and all hopes shall be fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡੋਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: dolai naahee tumaraa cheet ||
english: Your consciousness shall not waver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੀਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam jap guramukh meet ||3||
english: Meditate on the Ambrosial Naam as Gurmukh, O my friend. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naam aukhadh soee jan paavai ||
english: He alone receives the panacea, the medicine of the Naam,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis aap divaavai ||
english: unto whom the Lord, in His Grace, bestows it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥
transliteration: har har naam jaa kai hiradai vasai ||
english: One whose heart is filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਤਿਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਸੈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੭੯॥
transliteration: dookh darad tih naanak nasai ||4||10||79||
english: - O Nanak, his pains and sorrows are eliminated. ||4||10||79||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਅਘਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bahut darab kar man na aghaanaa ||
english: Even with vast sums of wealth, the mind is not satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੂਪ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: anik roop dekh nah pateeaanaa ||
english: Gazing upon countless beauties, the man is not satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਜਾਨਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr urajhio jaan meree ||
english: He is so involved with his wife and sons - he believes that they belong to him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਓਇ ਭਸਮੈ ਢੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: oh binasai oi bhasamai dheree ||1||
english: That wealth shall pass away, and those relatives shall be reduced to ashes. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਦੇਖਉ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: bin har bhajan dekhau bilalaate ||
english: Without meditating and vibrating on the Lord, they are crying out in pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhrig tan dhrig dhan maaiaa sa(n)g raate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Their bodies are cursed, and their wealth is cursed - they are imbued with Maya. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਿਗਾਰੀ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੀਜਹਿ ਦਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jiu bigaaree kai sir deejahi daam ||
english: The servant carries the bags of money on his head,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਉਨ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਮ ॥
transliteration: oi khasamai kai grihi un dookh sahaam ||
english: but it goes to his master's house, and he receives only pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਸਤ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu supanai hoi baisat raajaa ||
english: The man sits as a king in his dreams,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪਸਾਰੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਾਰਥ ਕਾਜਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: netr pasaarai taa niraarath kaajaa ||2||
english: but when he opens his eyes, he sees that it was all in vain. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਾ ਖੇਤ ਊਪਰਿ ਪਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jiu raakhaa khet oopar paraae ||
english: The watchman oversees the field of another,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਤੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: khet khasam kaa raakhaa uth jaae ||
english: but the field belongs to his master, while he must get up and depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸੁ ਖੇਤ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਰਾਖਾ ਕੜੈ ॥
transliteration: us khet kaaran raakhaa kaRai ||
english: He works so hard, and suffers for that field,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਲੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪੜੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis kai paalai kachhoo na paRai ||3||
english: but still, nothing comes into his hands. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਰਾਜੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa raaj tisai kaa supanaa ||
english: The dream is His, and the kingdom is His;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀਨੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jin maaiaa deenee tin laaee trisanaa ||
english: He who has given the wealth of Maya, has infused the desire for it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬਿਨਾਹੇ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: aap binaahe aap kare raas ||
english: He Himself annihilates, and He Himself restores.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੮੦॥
transliteration: naanak prabh aagai aradaas ||4||11||80||
english: Nanak offers this prayer to God. ||4||11||80||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੇਖੀ ॥
transliteration: bahu ra(n)g maaiaa bahu bidh pekhee ||
english: I have gazed upon the many forms of Maya, in so many ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਮ ਕਾਗਦ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਲੇਖੀ ॥
transliteration: kalam kaagad siaanap lekhee ||
english: With pen and paper, I have written clever things.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਰ ਮਲੂਕ ਹੋਇ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਖਾਨ ॥
transliteration: mahar malook hoi dekhiaa khaan ||
english: I have seen what it is to be a chief, a king, and an emperor,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa te naahee man tripataan ||1||
english: but they do not satisfy the mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸੰਤ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: so sukh mo kau sa(n)t bataavahu ||
english: Show me that peace, O Saints,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa boojhai man tripataavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: which will quench my thirst and satisfy my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸੁ ਪਵਨ ਹਸਤਿ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: as pavan hasat asavaaree ||
english: You may have horses as fast as the wind, elephants to ride on,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: choaa cha(n)dan sej su(n)dar naaree ||
english: sandalwood oil, and beautiful women in bed,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਆਖਾਰੇ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nat naatik aakhaare gaaiaa ||
english: actors in dramas, singing in theaters

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa mahi man sa(n)tokh na paaiaa ||2||
english: - but even with them, the mind does not find contentment. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਖਤੁ ਸਭਾ ਮੰਡਨ ਦੋਲੀਚੇ ॥
transliteration: takhat sabhaa ma(n)dan doleeche ||
english: You may have a throne at the royal court, with beautiful decorations and soft carpets,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮੇਵੇ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਾਗੀਚੇ ॥
transliteration: sagal meve su(n)dar baageeche ||
english: all sorts of luscious fruits and beautiful gardens,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਖੇੜ ਬਿਰਤਿ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aakheR birat raajan kee leelaa ||
english: the excitement of the chase and princely pleasures

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਹੀਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man na suhelaa parapa(n)ch heelaa ||3||
english: - but still, the mind is not made happy by such illusory diversions. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa sa(n)tan sach kahiaa ||
english: In their kindness, the Saints have told me of the True One,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਇਹੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sarab sookh ihu aana(n)d lahiaa ||
english: and so I have obtained all comforts and joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har keeratan gaaeeai ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak vadabhaagee paaeeai ||4||
english: Says Nanak, through great good fortune, I have found this. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai har dhan soee suhelaa ||
english: One who obtains the wealth of the Lord becomes happy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੨॥੮੧॥
transliteration: prabh kirapaa te saadhasa(n)g melaa ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||12||81||
english: By God's Grace, I have joined the Saadh Sangat. ||1||Second Pause||12||81||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: praanee jaanai ihu tan meraa ||
english: The mortal claims this body as his own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਉਆਹੂ ਲਪਟੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bahur bahur uaahoo lapateraa ||
english: Again and again, he clings to it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਕਾ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr girasat kaa phaasaa ||
english: He is entangled with his children, his wife and household affairs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hon na paaeeai raam ke daasaa ||1||
english: He cannot be the slave of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kavan s bidh jit raam gun gaai ||
english: What is that way, by which the Lord's Praises might be sung?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਰੈ ਇਹ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kavan s mat jit tarai ih maai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: What is that intellect, by which this person might swim across, O mother? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਭਲਾਈ ਸੋ ਬੁਰਾ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jo bhalaaee so buraa jaanai ||
english: That which is for his own good, he thinks is evil.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਬਿਖੈ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: saach kahai so bikhai samaanai ||
english: If someone tells him the truth, he looks upon that as poison.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੀਤ ਅਰੁ ਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jaanai naahee jeet ar haar ||
english: He cannot tell victory from defeat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਵਲੇਵਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ihu valevaa saakat sa(n)saar ||2||
english: This is the way of life in the world of the faithless cynic. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਲਾਹਲ ਸੋ ਪੀਵੈ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jo halaahal so peevai bauraa ||
english: The demented fool drinks in the deadly poison,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਉਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam jaanai kar kauraa ||
english: while he believes the Ambrosial Naam to be bitter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਨੇਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g kai naahee ner ||
english: He does not even approach the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਾ ਫੇਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh bhramataa pher ||3||
english: he wanders lost through 8.4 million incarnations. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਜਾਲਿ ਫਹਾਏ ਪੰਖੀ ॥
transliteration: ekai jaal phahaae pa(n)khee ||
english: The birds are caught in the net of Maya;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
transliteration: ras ras bhog karahi bahu ra(n)gee ||
english: immersed in the pleasures of love, they frolic in so many ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jis bhae kripaal ||
english: Says Nanak, the Perfect Guru has cut away the noose from those,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: gur poorai taa ke kaate jaal ||4||13||82||
english: Unto whom the Lord has shown His Mercy. ||4||13||82||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: tau kirapaa te maarag paaeeai ||
english: By Your Grace, we find the Way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: prabh kirapaa te naam dhiaaeeai ||
english: By God's Grace, we meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kirapaa te ba(n)dhan chhutai ||
english: By God's Grace, we are released from our bondage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tau kirapaa te haumai tutai ||1||
english: By Your Grace, egotism is eradicated. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਲਾਗਹ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: tum laavahu tau laagah sev ||
english: As You assign me, so I take to Your service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham te kachhoo na hovai dev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By myself, I cannot do anything at all, O Divine Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗਾਵਾ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: tudh bhaavai taa gaavaa baanee ||
english: If it pleases You, then I sing the Word of Your Bani.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: tudh bhaavai taa sach vakhaanee ||
english: If it pleases You, then I speak the Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh bhaavai taa satigur maiaa ||
english: If it pleases You, then the True Guru showers His Mercy upon me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa prabh teree daiaa ||2||
english: All peace comes by Your Kindness, God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so niramal karamaa ||
english: Whatever pleases You is a pure action of karma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so sach dharamaa ||
english: Whatever pleases You is the true faith of Dharma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਣ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan gun tum hee paas ||
english: The treasure of all excellence is with You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too(n) saahib sevak aradaas ||3||
english: Your servant prays to You, O Lord and Master. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: man tan niramal hoi har ra(n)g ||
english: The mind and body become immaculate through the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਪਾਵਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa paavau satasa(n)g ||
english: All peace is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਰਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: naam terai rahai man raataa ||
english: My mind remains attuned to Your Name;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਕਲਿਆਣੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੮੩॥
transliteration: ihu kaliaan naanak kar jaataa ||4||14||83||
english: Nanak affirms this as his greatest pleasure. ||4||14||83||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਜੇਤੇ ਤੈ ਚਾਖੇ ॥
transliteration: aan rasaa jete tai chaakhe ||
english: You may taste the other flavors,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: nimakh na trisanaa teree laathe ||
english: but your thirst shall not depart, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕਾ ਤੂੰ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: har ras kaa too(n) chaakhahi saad ||
english: But when you taste the sweet flavor the the Lord's sublime essence

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਖਤ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chaakhat hoi rahahi bisamaad ||1||
english: - upon tasting it, you shall be wonder-struck and amazed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਪੀਉ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit rasanaa peeu piaaree ||
english: O dear beloved tongue, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ih ras raatee hoi tripataaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Imbued with this sublime essence, you shall be satisfied. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਜਿਹਵੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: he jihave too(n) raam gun gaau ||
english: O tongue, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
transliteration: nimakh nimakh har har har dhiaau ||
english: Each and every moment, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਨ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: aan na suneeai katahoo(n) jaaeeai ||
english: Do not listen to any other, and do not go anywhere else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat vadabhaagee paaeeai ||2||
english: By great good fortune, you shall find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਿਹਵੇ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar jihave aaraadh ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, O tongue, dwell upon God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਆਗਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham thaakur aagaadh ||
english: The Unfathomable, Supreme Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥
transliteration: eehaa oohaa sadaa suhelee ||
english: Here and hereafter, you shall be happy forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਰਸਨ ਅਮੋਲੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har gun gaavat rasan amolee ||3||
english: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O tongue, you shall become priceless. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਨਸਪਤਿ ਮਉਲੀ ਫਲ ਫੁਲ ਪੇਡੇ ॥
transliteration: banasapat maulee phal phul pede ||
english: All the vegetation will blossom forth for you, flowering in fruition;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੇ ॥
transliteration: ih ras raatee bahur na chhode ||
english: imbued with this sublime essence, you shall never leave it again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਨ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aan na ras kas lavai na laaee ||
english: No other sweet and tasty flavors can compare to it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੮੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur bhae hai sahaaee ||4||15||84||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has become my Support. ||4||15||84||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜੀ ਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man ma(n)dar tan saajee baar ||
english: The mind is the temple, and the body is the fence built around it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਧੇ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: is hee madhe basat apaar ||
english: The infinite substance is within it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: is hee bheetar suneeat saahu ||
english: Within it, the great merchant is said to dwell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਬਾਪਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਊਹਾ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kavan baapaaree jaa kaa oohaa visaahu ||1||
english: Who is the trader who deals there? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: naam ratan ko ko biuhaaree ||
english: How rare is that trader who deals in the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਆਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit bhojan kare aahaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He takes the Ambrosial Nectar as his food. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: man tan arapee sev kareejai ||
english: He dedicates his mind and body to serving the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kavan s jugat jit kar bheejai ||
english: How can we please the Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਤਜਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: paai lagau taj meraa terai ||
english: I fall at His Feet, and I renounce all sense of 'mine and yours'.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਜੋ ਸਉਦਾ ਜੋਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kavan s jan jo saudaa jorai ||2||
english: Who can settle this bargain? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੁ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mahal saah kaa kin bidh paavai ||
english: How can I attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kavan s bidh jit bheetar bulaavai ||
english: How can I get Him to call me inside?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਸਾਹੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: too(n) vad saahu jaa ke kot vanajaare ||
english: You are the Great Merchant; You have millions of traders.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਲੇ ਸੰਚਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kavan s daataa le sa(n)chaare ||3||
english: Who is the benefactor? Who can take me to Him? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat nij ghar paaiaa ||
english: Seeking and searching, I have found my own home, deep within my own being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮੋਲ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: amol ratan saach dikhalaaiaa ||
english: The True Lord has shown me the priceless jewel.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਬ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jab mele saahi ||
english: When the Great Merchant shows His Mercy, He blends us into Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਵੇਸਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੮੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur kai vesaahi ||4||16||85||
english: Says Nanak, place your faith in the Guru. ||4||16||85||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 guaareree ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl, Gwaarayree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਹੈ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: rain dinas rahai ik ra(n)gaa ||
english: Night and day, they remain in the Love of the One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau jaanai sad hee sa(n)gaa ||
english: They know that God is always with them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਓ ਉਨਿ ਵਰਤਨਿ ॥
transliteration: thaakur naam keeo un varatan ||
english: They make the Name of their Lord and Master their way of life;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tripat aghaavan har kai darasan ||1||
english: they are satisfied and fulfilled with the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)g raate man tan hare ||
english: Imbued with the Love of the Lord, their minds and bodies are rejuvenated,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kee saranee pare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: entering the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਆਤਮ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal aatam aadhaar ||
english: The Lord's Lotus Feet are the Support of the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਹਿ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ek nihaarahi aagiaakaar ||
english: They see only the One, and obey His Order.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਬਨਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: eko banaj eko biuhaaree ||
english: There is only one trade, and one occupation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: avar na jaanahi bin nira(n)kaaree ||2||
english: They know no other than the Formless Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਹਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ ॥
transliteration: harakh sog duhahoo(n) te mukate ||
english: They are free of both pleasure and pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਜੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਜੁਗਤੇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa alipat jog ar jugate ||
english: They remain unattached, joined to the Lord's Way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
transliteration: deesahi sabh mahi sabh te rahate ||
english: They are seen among all, and yet they are distinct from all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਓਇ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਤੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paarabraham kaa oi dhiaan dharate ||3||
english: They focus their meditation on the Supreme Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਵਨ ਵਖਾਨਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kee mahimaa kavan vakhaanau ||
english: How can I describe the Glories of the Saints?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
transliteration: agaadh bodh kichh mit nahee jaanau ||
english: Their knowledge is unfathomable; their limits cannot be known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham mohi kirapaa keejai ||
english: O Supreme Lord God, please shower Your Mercy upon me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੂਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੮੬॥
transliteration: dhoor sa(n)tan kee naanak deejai ||4||17||86||
english: Bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||17||86||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: too(n) meraa sakhaa too(n)hee meraa meet ||
english: You are my Companion; You are my Best Friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: too(n) meraa preetam tum sa(n)g heet ||
english: You are my Beloved; I am in love with You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) meree pat toohai meraa gahanaa ||
english: You are my honor; You are my decoration.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਮਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tujh bin nimakh na jaaee rahanaa ||1||
english: Without You, I cannot survive, even for an instant. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: too(n) mere laalan too(n) mere praan ||
english: You are my Intimate Beloved, You are my breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਖਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) mere saahib too(n) mere khaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are my Lord and Master; You are my Leader. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu tum raakhahu tiv hee rahanaa ||
english: As You keep me, so do I survive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਹਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jo tum kahahu soee mohi karanaa ||
english: Whatever You say, that is what I do.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹਾ ਤੁਮ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jah pekhau tahaa tum basanaa ||
english: Wherever I look, there I see You dwelling.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nirabhau naam japau teraa rasanaa ||2||
english: O my Fearless Lord, with my tongue, I chant Your Name. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੂੰ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: too(n) meree nav nidh too(n) bha(n)daar ||
english: You are my nine treasures, You are my storehouse.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਰਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g rasaa too(n) manahi adhaar ||
english: I am imbued with Your Love; You are the Support of my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚੀਆ ॥
transliteration: too(n) meree sobhaa tum sa(n)g racheeaa ||
english: You are my Glory; I am blended with You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰ ਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਕੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too(n) meree ot too(n) hai meraa takeeaa ||3||
english: You are my Shelter; You are my Anchoring Support. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar tuhee dhiaaiaa ||
english: Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਰਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maram tumaaraa gur te paaiaa ||
english: I have obtained Your secret from the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਏਕੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur te driRiaa ik ekai ||
english: Through the True Guru, the One and only Lord was implanted within me;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕੈ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੮੭॥
transliteration: naanak daas har har har tekai ||4||18||87||
english: servant Nanak has taken to the Support of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||18||87||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
transliteration: biaapat harakh sog bisathaar ||
english: It torments us with the expression of pleasure and pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਸੁਰਗ ਨਰਕ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: biaapat surag narak avataar ||
english: It torments us through incarnations in heaven and hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਧਨ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਪੇਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ॥
transliteration: biaapat dhan niradhan pekh sobhaa ||
english: It is seen to afflict the rich, the poor and the glorious.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਬਿਆਧੀ ਬਿਆਪਸਿ ਲੋਭਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mool biaadhee biaapas lobhaa ||1||
english: The source of this illness which torments us is greed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa biaapat bahu parakaaree ||
english: Maya torments us in so many ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t jeevahi prabh ot tumaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: But the Saints live under Your Protection, God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: biaapat aha(n)budh kaa maataa ||
english: It torments us through intoxication with intellectual pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: biaapat putr kalatr sa(n)g raataa ||
english: It torments us through the love of children and spouse.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਹਸਤਿ ਘੋੜੇ ਅਰੁ ਬਸਤਾ ॥
transliteration: biaapat hasat ghoRe ar basataa ||
english: It torments us through elephants, horses and beautiful clothes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਰੂਪ ਜੋਬਨ ਮਦ ਮਸਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: biaapat roop joban mad masataa ||2||
english: It torments us through the intoxication of wine and the beauty of youth. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਭੂਮਿ ਰੰਕ ਅਰੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: biaapat bhoom ra(n)k ar ra(n)gaa ||
english: It torments landlords, paupers and lovers of pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: biaapat geet naad sun sa(n)gaa ||
english: It torments us through the sweet sounds of music and parties.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਸੇਜ ਮਹਲ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
transliteration: biaapat sej mahal seegaar ||
english: It torments us through beautiful beds, palaces and decorations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਅੰਧਿਆਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch doot biaapat a(n)dhiaar ||3||
english: It torments us through the darkness of the five evil passions. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਹਉ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: biaapat karam karai hau phaasaa ||
english: It torments those who act, entangled in ego.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪਤਿ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: biaapat girasat biaapat udaasaa ||
english: It torments us through household affairs, and it torments us in renunciation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਚਾਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਇਹ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: aachaar biuhaar biaapat ih jaat ||
english: It torments us through character, lifestyle and social status.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sabh kichh biaapat bin har ra(n)g raat ||4||
english: It torments us through everything, except for those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan ke ba(n)dhan kaate har raai ||
english: The Sovereign Lord King has cut away the bonds of His Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: taa kau kahaa biaapai maai ||
english: How can Maya torment them?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jin dhoor sa(n)t paaee ||
english: Says Nanak, Maya does not draw near those

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਾਈ ॥੫॥੧੯॥੮੮॥
transliteration: taa kai nikat na aavai maaee ||5||19||88||
english: Who have obtained the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||5||19||88||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਨੀਦ ਪਰ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: nainahu need par drisat vikaar ||
english: The eyes are asleep in corruption, gazing upon the beauty of another.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਸੋਏ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਿੰਦ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sravan soe sun ni(n)d veechaar ||
english: The ears are asleep, listening to slanderous stories.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਸੋਈ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੀਠੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa soee lobh meethai saad ||
english: The tongue is asleep, in its desire for sweet flavors.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man soiaa maaiaa bisamaad ||1||
english: The mind is asleep, fascinated by Maya. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: is grih mahi koee jaagat rahai ||
english: Those who remain awake in this house are very rare;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਬਤੁ ਵਸਤੁ ਓਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saabat vasat ohu apanee lahai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: by doing so, they receive the whole thing. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਅਪਨੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: sagal sahelee apanai ras maatee ||
english: All of my companions are intoxicated with their sensory pleasures;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: grih apune kee khabar na jaatee ||
english: they do not know how to guard their own home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਨਹਾਰ ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: musanahaar pa(n)ch batavaare ||
english: The five thieves have plundered them;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਨੇ ਨਗਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਠਗਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: soone nagar pare thagahaare ||2||
english: the thugs descend upon the unguarded village. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: un te raakhai baap na maaee ||
english: Our mothers and fathers cannot save us from them;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: un te raakhai meet na bhaaee ||
english: friends and brothers cannot protect us from them

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਬਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
transliteration: darab siaanap naa oi rahate ||
english: they cannot be restrained by wealth or cleverness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਓਇ ਦੁਸਟ ਵਸਿ ਹੋਤੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g oi dusat vas hote ||3||
english: Only through the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, can those villains be brought under control. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi saari(n)gapaan ||
english: Have Mercy upon me, O Lord, Sustainer of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan dhoor sarab nidhaan ||
english: The dust of the feet of the Saints is all the treasure I need.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਬਤੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: saabat poo(n)jee satigur sa(n)g ||
english: In the Company of the True Guru, one's investment remains intact.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak jaagai paarabraham kai ra(n)g ||4||
english: Nanak is awake to the Love of the Supreme Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਾਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: so jaagai jis prabh kirapaal ||
english: He alone is awake, unto whom God shows His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨੦॥੮੯॥
transliteration: ih poo(n)jee saabat dhan maal ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||20||89||
english: This investment, wealth and property shall remain intact. ||1||Second Pause||20||89||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਖਾਨ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai vas khaan sulataan ||
english: Kings and emperors are under His Power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai vas hai sagal jahaan ||
english: The whole world is under His Power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa keeaa sabh kichh hoi ||
english: Everything is done by His doing;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis te baahar naahee koi ||1||
english: other than Him, there is nothing at all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kahu bena(n)tee apune satigur paahi ||
english: Offer your prayers to your True Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaaj tumaare dei nibaahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He will resolve your affairs. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh te ooch jaa kaa darabaar ||
english: The Darbaar of His Court is the most exalted of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sagal bhagat jaa kaa naam adhaar ||
english: His Name is the Support of all His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਬਿਆਪਿਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sarab biaapit pooran dhanee ||
english: The Perfect Master is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa kee sobhaa ghat ghat banee ||2||
english: His Glory is manifest in each and every heart. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat dukh deraa dhahai ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, the home of sorrow is abolished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat jam kichhoo na kahai ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, the Messenger of Death shall not touch you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹੋਤ ਸੂਕੇ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat hot sooke hare ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, the dry branches become green again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਡੂਬਤ ਪਾਹਨ ਤਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis simarat doobat paahan tare ||3||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, sinking stones are made to float. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa kau sadaa jaikaar ||
english: I salute and applaud the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har har naam jan praan adhaar ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the Support of the breath of life of His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak meree sunee aradaas ||
english: Says Nanak, the Lord has heard my prayer;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੯੦॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad mo kau naam nivaas ||4||21||90||
english: by the Grace of the Saints, I dwell in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||21||90||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur darasan agan nivaaree ||
english: By the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, the fire of desire is quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhetat haumai maaree ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, egotism is subdued.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sa(n)g naahee man dolai ||
english: In the Company of the True Guru, the mind does not waver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee guramukh bolai ||1||
english: The Gurmukh speaks the Ambrosial Word of Gurbani. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਾ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag saachaa jaa sach mahi raate ||
english: He sees the True One pervading the whole world; he is imbued with the True One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: seetal saat gur te prabh jaate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have become cool and tranquil, knowing God, through the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad japai har naau ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, one chants the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad har keeratan gaau ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, one sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਖ ਮਿਟੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad sagal dukh mite ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, all pains are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad ba(n)dhan te chhute ||2||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, one is released from bondage. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kripaa te mite moh bharam ||
english: By the kind Mercy of the Saints, emotional attachment and doubt are removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਰੇਣ ਮਜਨ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
transliteration: saadh ren majan sabh dharam ||
english: Taking a bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy - this is true Dharmic faith.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: saadh kripaal daiaal govi(n)d ||
english: By the kindness of the Holy, the Lord of the Universe becomes merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਾ ਮਹਿ ਇਹ ਹਮਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhaa mahi ih hamaree ji(n)d ||3||
english: The life of my soul is with the Holy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa nidh kirapaal dhiaavau ||
english: Meditating on the Merciful Lord, the Treasure of Mercy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਬੈਠਣੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g taa baithan paavau ||
english: I have obtained a seat in the Saadh Sangat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mohi niragun kau prabh keenee daiaa ||
english: I am worthless, but God has been kind to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੯੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak naam laiaa ||4||22||91||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, Nanak has taken to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||22||91||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g japio bhagava(n)t ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: keval naam deeo gur ma(n)t ||
english: The Guru has given me the Mantra of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ॥
transliteration: taj abhimaan bhae niravair ||
english: Shedding my ego, I have become free of hate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aath pahar poojahu gur pair ||1||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I worship the Guru's Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਦੁਸਟ ਬਿਗਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ab mat binasee dusat bigaanee ||
english: Now, my evil sense of alienation is eliminated,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab te suniaa har jas kaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: since I have heard the Praises of the Lord with my ears. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: sahaj sookh aana(n)d nidhaan ||
english: The Savior Lord is the treasure of intuitive peace, poise and bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਇ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥
transliteration: raakhanahaar rakh lei nidaan ||
english: He shall save me in the end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ॥
transliteration: dookh darad binase bhai bharam ||
english: My pains, sufferings, fears and doubts have been erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aavan jaan rakhe kar karam ||2||
english: He has mercifully saved me from coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: pekhai bolai sunai sabh aap ||
english: He Himself beholds, speaks and hears all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sa(n)g taa kau man jaap ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the One who is always with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad bhaio paragaas ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, the Light has dawned.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਏਕੈ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: poor rahe ekai gunataas ||3||
english: The One Lord, the Treasure of Excellence, is perfectly pervading everywhere. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਣਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: kahat pavitr sunat puneet ||
english: Pure are those who speak, and sanctified are those who hear and sing,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: gun govi(n)d gaavahi nit neet ||
english: Forever and ever, the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jaa kau hohu kripaal ||
english: Says Nanak, when the Lord bestows His Mercy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੯੨॥
transliteration: tis jan kee sabh pooran ghaal ||4||23||92||
english: all one's efforts are fulfilled. ||4||23||92||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਬੋਲਾਵੈ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan toR bolaavai raam ||
english: He breaks our bonds, and inspires us to chant the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: man mahi laagai saach dhiaan ||
english: With the mind centered in meditation on the True Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: mitahi kales sukhee hoi raheeai ||
english: Anguish is eradicated, and one comes to dwell in peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aisaa daataa satigur kaheeai ||1||
english: Such is the True Guru, the Great Giver. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so sukhadaataa j naam japaavai ||
english: He alone is the Giver of peace, who inspires us to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa tis sa(n)g milaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By His Grace, He leads us to merge with Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jis hoi daiaal tis aap milaavai ||
english: He unites with Himself those unto whom He has shown His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan guroo te paavai ||
english: All treasures are received from the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: aap tiaag mitai aavan jaanaa ||
english: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, coming and going come to an end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g paarabraham pachhaanaa ||2||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Supreme Lord God is recognized. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: jan oopar prabh bhae daiaal ||
english: God has become merciful to His humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jan kee tek ek gopaal ||
english: The One Lord of the Universe is the Support of His humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਲਿਵ ਏਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ekaa liv eko man bhaau ||
english: They love the One Lord; their minds are filled with love for the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan jan kai har naau ||3||
english: The Name of the Lord is all treasures for them. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham siu laagee preet ||
english: They are in love with the Supreme Lord God;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: niramal karanee saachee reet ||
english: their actions are pure, and their lifestyle is true.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai metiaa a(n)dhiaaraa ||
english: The Perfect Guru has dispelled the darkness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੯੩॥
transliteration: naanak kaa prabh apar apaaraa ||4||24||93||
english: Nanak's God is Incomparable and Infinite. ||4||24||93||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis man vasai tarai jan soi ||
english: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord, swim across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai karam paraapat hoi ||
english: Those who have the blessing of good karma, meet with the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਛੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: dookh rog kachh bhau na biaapai ||
english: Pain, disease and fear do not affect them at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam ridai har jaapai ||1||
english: They meditate on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord within their hearts. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham paramesur dhiaaeeai ||
english: Meditate on the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poore te ih mat paaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: From the Perfect Guru, this understanding is obtained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavanahaar daiaal ||
english: The Merciful Lord is the Doer, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sagale pratipaal ||
english: He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸਦਾ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar sadaa bea(n)taa ||
english: He is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, Eternal and Infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: simar manaa poore gur ma(n)taa ||2||
english: Meditate on Him, O my mind, through the Teachings of the Perfect Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee sevaa sarab nidhaan ||
english: Serving Him, all treasures are obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee poojaa paaeeai maan ||
english: Worshipping God, honor is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee tahal na birathee jaai ||
english: Working for Him is never in vain;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa har ke gun gaai ||3||
english: forever and ever, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: Show Mercy to me, O God, O Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: sukh nidhaan har alakh suaamee ||
english: The Unseen Lord and Master is the Treasure of Peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t teree saranaaee ||
english: All beings and creatures seek Your Sanctuary;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੯੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee ||4||25||94||
english: Nanak is blessed to receive the greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||25||94||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: jee jugat jaa kai hai haath ||
english: Our way of life is in His Hands;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
transliteration: so simarahu anaath ko naath ||
english: remember Him, the Master of the masterless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh chit aae sabh dukh jaai ||
english: When God comes to mind, all pains depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhai sabh binasahi har kai naai ||1||
english: All fears are dispelled through the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਉ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਾ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bin har bhau kaahe kaa maanahi ||
english: Why do you fear any other than the Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਕਾਹੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bisarat kaahe sukh jaanahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Forgetting the Lord, why do you pretend to be at peace? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਧਰਣਿ ਅਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jin dhaare bahu dharan agaas ||
english: He established the many worlds and skies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee jot jee paragaas ||
english: The soul is illumined with His Light;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee bakhas na metai koi ||
english: no one can revoke His Blessing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: simar simar prabh nirabhau hoi ||2||
english: Meditate, meditate in remembrance on God, and become fearless. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar simarahu prabh naam ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate in remembrance on God's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: anik teerath majan isanaan ||
english: In it are the many sacred shrines of pilgrimage and cleansing baths.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham kee saranee paahi ||
english: Seek the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲੰਕ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kot kala(n)k khin mahi mit jaahi ||3||
english: Millions of mistakes shall be erased in an instant. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: bemuhataaj pooraa paatisaahu ||
english: The Perfect King is self-sufficient.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh sevak saachaa vesaahu ||
english: God's servant has true faith in Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਰਾਖੇ ਦੇ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai raakhe de haath ||
english: Giving him His Hand, the Perfect Guru protects him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮਰਾਥ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੯੫॥
transliteration: naanak paarabraham samaraath ||4||26||95||
english: O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God is All-powerful. ||4||26||95||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad naam man laagaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, my mind is attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa soiaa jaagaa ||
english: Asleep for so many incarnations, it is now awakened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit gun ucharai prabh baanee ||
english: I chant the Ambrosial Bani, the Glorious Praises of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poore gur kee sumat paraanee ||1||
english: The Pure Teachings of the Perfect Guru have been revealed to me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕੁਸਲ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: prabh simarat kusal sabh paae ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on God, I have found total peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਬਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ghar baahar sukh sahaj sabaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Within my home, and outside as well, there is peace and poise all around. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: soee pachhaataa jinahi upaaiaa ||
english: I have recognized the One who created me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aap milaaiaa ||
english: Showing His Mercy, God has blended me with Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: baah pakar leeno kar apanaa ||
english: Taking me by the arm, He has made me His Own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har har kathaa sadaa jap japanaa ||2||
english: I continually chant and meditate on the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਤੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਪੁਨਹਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)tr ta(n)tr aukhadh punahachaar ||
english: Mantras, tantras, all-curing medicines and acts of atonement,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har har naam jee praan adhaar ||
english: are all in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Support of the soul and the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: saachaa dhan paaio har ra(n)g ||
english: I have obtained the true wealth of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੇ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dutar tare saadh kai sa(n)g ||3||
english: I have crossed over the treacherous world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sukh baisahu sa(n)t sajan paravaar ||
english: Sit in peace, O Saints, with the family of friends.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਓ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har dhan khatio jaa kaa naahi sumaar ||
english: Earn the wealth of the Lord, which is beyond estimation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: jisahi paraapat tis gur dei ||
english: He alone obtains it, unto whom the Guru has bestowed it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੇਇ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੯੬॥
transliteration: naanak birathaa koi na hei ||4||27||96||
english: O Nanak, no one shall go away empty-handed. ||4||27||96||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਤਤਕਾਲ ॥
transliteration: hasat puneet hohi tatakaal ||
english: The hands are sanctified instantly,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
transliteration: binas jaahi maaiaa ja(n)jaal ||
english: and the entanglements of Maya are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਮਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa ramahu raam gun neet ||
english: Repeat constantly with your tongue the Glorious Praises of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sukh paavahu mere bhaaee meet ||1||
english: and you shall find peace, O my friends, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖੁ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਕਾਗਦਿ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: likh lekhan kaagad masavaanee ||
english: With pen and ink, write upon your paper

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam har a(n)mrit baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: the Name of the Lord, the Ambrosial Word of the Lord's Bani. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ih kaaraj tere jaahi bikaar ||
english: By this act, your sins shall be washed away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਮਾਰ ॥
transliteration: simarat raam naahee jam maar ||
english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, you shall not be punished by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: dharam raai ke doot na johai ||
english: The couriers of the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall not touch you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਮੋਹੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maaiaa magan na kachhooai mohai ||2||
english: The intoxication of Maya shall not entice you at all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਧਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: udharahi aap tarai sa(n)saar ||
english: You shall be redeemed, and through you, the whole world shall be saved,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raam naam jap eka(n)kaar ||
english: if you chant the Name of the One and Only Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਮਾਉ ਅਵਰਾ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
transliteration: aap kamaau avaraa upades ||
english: Practice this yourself, and teach others;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam naam hiradai paraves ||3||
english: instill the Lord's Name in your heart. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai maathai ehu nidhaan ||
english: That person, who has this treasure upon his forehead

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਪੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: soee purakh japai bhagavaan ||
english: that person meditates on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar har har gun gaau ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੯੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak hau tis bal jaau ||4||28||97||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||4||28||97||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 chaupade dupade ||
english: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪਰਾਇਓ ਸੋਈ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jo paraaio soee apanaa ||
english: That which belongs to another - he claims as his own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo taj chhodan tis siu man rachanaa ||1||
english: That which he must abandon - to that, his mind is attracted. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਹੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਕੇਹ ॥
transliteration: kahahu gusaaee mileeai keh ||
english: Tell me, how can he meet the Lord of the World?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬਿਬਰਜਤ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo bibarajat tis siu neh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: That which is forbidden - with that, he is in love. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੁ ਬਾਤ ਸਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: jhooth baat saa sach kar jaatee ||
english: That which is false - he deems as true.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਹੋਵਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sat hovan man lagai na raatee ||2||
english: That which is true - his mind is not attached to that at all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਟੇਢਾ ਚਲਨਾ ॥
transliteration: baavai maarag tedhaa chalanaa ||
english: He takes the crooked path of the unrighteous way;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਧਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਪੂਠਾ ਬੁਨਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: seedhaa chhod apoothaa bunanaa ||3||
english: leaving the straight and narrow path, he weaves his way backwards. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
