gurmukhi: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: duhaa siriaa kaa khasam prabh soee ||
english: God is the Lord and Master of both worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੯੮॥
transliteration: jis mele naanak so mukataa hoee ||4||29||98||
english: He, whom the Lord unites with Himself, O Nanak, is liberated. ||4||29||98||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਏ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: kalijug mahi mil aae sa(n)jog ||
english: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, they come together through destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਆਗਿਆ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jichar aagiaa tichar bhogahi bhog ||1||
english: As long as the Lord commands, they enjoy their pleasures. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jalai na paaeeai raam sanehee ||
english: By burning oneself, the Beloved Lord is not obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਸਤੀ ਉਠਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kirat sa(n)jog satee uth hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Only by the actions of destiny does she rise up and burn herself, as a 'satee'. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਾ ਦੇਖੀ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: dekhaa dekhee manahath jal jaaeeai ||
english: Imitating what she sees, with her stubborn mind-set, she goes into the fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pri sa(n)g na paavai bahu jon bhavaaeeai ||2||
english: She does not obtain the Company of her Beloved Lord, and she wanders through countless incarnations. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਲ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: seel sa(n)jam pri aagiaa maanai ||
english: With pure conduct and self-restraint, she surrenders to her Husband Lord's Will;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਮਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis naaree kau dukh na jamaanai ||3||
english: that woman shall not suffer pain at the hands of the Messenger of Death. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jin priu paramesar kar jaaniaa ||
english: Says Nanak, she who looks upon the Transcendent Lord as her Husband,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੯੯॥
transliteration: dha(n)n satee daragah paravaaniaa ||4||30||99||
english: is the blessed 'satee'; she is received with honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||30||99||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਭਾਗਠ ਸਚ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ham dhanava(n)t bhaagath sach naai ||
english: I am prosperous and fortunate, for I have received the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavah sahaj subhaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, with natural, intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਊ ਦਾਦੇ ਕਾ ਖੋਲਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: peeoo daade kaa khol dithaa khajaanaa ||
english: When I opened it up and gazed upon the treasures of my father and grandfather,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa merai man bhaiaa nidhaanaa ||1||
english: then my mind became very happy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਮੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: ratan laal jaa kaa kachhoo na mol ||
english: The storehouse is inexhaustible and immeasurable,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਅਖੂਟ ਅਤੋਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhare bha(n)daar akhoot atol ||2||
english: Overflowing with priceless jewels and rubies. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਵਹਿ ਖਰਚਹਿ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: khaavahi kharachahi ral mil bhaaee ||
english: The Siblings of Destiny meet together, and eat and spend,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵਧਦੋ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tot na aavai vadhado jaaee ||3||
english: but these resources do not diminish; they continue to increase. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jis masatak lekh likhaai ||
english: Says Nanak, one who has such destiny written on his forehead,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁ ਏਤੁ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਲਇਆ ਰਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੧੦੦॥
transliteration: s et khajaanai laiaa ralaai ||4||31||100||
english: becomes a partner in these treasures. ||4||31||100||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਮਰਤੇ ਜਬ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dar dar marate jab jaaneeai door ||
english: I was scared, scared to death, when I thought that He was far away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਰੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dar chookaa dekhiaa bharapoor ||1||
english: But my fear was removed, when I saw that He is pervading everywhere. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur apane kau balihaarai ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਰਪਰ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chhod na jaaee sarapar taarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He shall not abandon me; He shall surely carry me across. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਬ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: dookh rog sog bisarai jab naam ||
english: Pain, disease and sorrow come when one forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d jaa har gun gaam ||2||
english: Eternal bliss comes when one sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਕਹੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: buraa bhalaa koee na kaheejai ||
english: Do not say that anyone is good or bad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chhod maan har charan gaheejai ||3||
english: Renounce your arrogant pride, and grasp the Feet of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur ma(n)tr chitaar ||
english: Says Nanak, remember the GurMantra;

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: sukh paavahi saachai darabaar ||4||32||101||
english: you shall find peace at the True Court. ||4||32||101||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਮੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa meet saajan hai sameeaa ||
english: Those who have the Lord as their Friend and Companion

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਕਮੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis jan kau kahu kaa kee kameeaa ||1||
english: - tell me, what else do they need? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee preet gobi(n)d siu laagee ||
english: Those who are in love with the Lord of the Universe

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dookh darad bhram taa kaa bhaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - pain, suffering and doubt run away from them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੈ ਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau ras har ras hai aaio ||
english: Those who have enjoyed the flavor of the Lord's sublime essence

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਨਾਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so an ras naahee lapataaio ||2||
english: are not attracted to any other pleasures. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਚਲੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa kahiaa daragah chalai ||
english: Those whose speech is accepted in the Court of the Lord

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਵੈ ਤਲੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so kis kau nadar lai aavai talai ||3||
english: - what do they care about anything else? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa sabh kichh taa kaa hoi ||
english: Those who belong to the One, unto whom all things belong

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੧੦੨॥
transliteration: naanak taa kau sadaa sukh hoi ||4||33||102||
english: - O Nanak, they find a lasting peace. ||4||33||102||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai dukh sukh sam kar jaapai ||
english: Those who look alike upon pleasure and pain

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਾੜਾ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa kau kaaRaa kahaa biaapai ||1||
english: - how can anxiety touch them? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sahaj ana(n)d har saadhoo maahi ||
english: The Lord's Holy Saints abide in celestial bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aagiaakaaree har har raai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They remain obedient to the Lord, the Sovereign Lord King. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai achi(n)t vasai man aai ||
english: Those who have the Carefree Lord abiding in their minds

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa kau chi(n)taa katahoo(n) naahi ||2||
english: - no cares will ever bother them. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai binasio man te bharamaa ||
english: Those who have banished doubt from their minds

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਛੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਡਰੁ ਜਮਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa kai kachhoo naahee dar jamaa ||3||
english: are not afraid of death at all. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai hiradai deeo gur naamaa ||
english: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord's Name by the Guru

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੧੦੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak taa kai sagal nidhaanaa ||4||34||103||
english: - says Nanak, all treasures come to them. ||4||34||103||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪ ਕਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: agam roop kaa man mahi thaanaa ||
english: The Lord of Unfathomable Form has His Place in the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur prasaad kinai viralai jaanaa ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, a rare few come to understand this. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੁੰਟਾ ॥
transliteration: sahaj kathaa ke a(n)mrit ku(n)taa ||
english: The Ambrosial Pools of the celestial sermon

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਲੈ ਭੁੰਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jisahi paraapat tis lai bhu(n)chaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - those who find them, drink them in. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਥਾਨੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: anahat baanee thaan niraalaa ||
english: The unstruck melody of the Guru's Bani vibrates in that most special place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa kee dhun mohe gopaalaa ||2||
english: The Lord of the World is fascinated with this melody. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਸਹਜ ਅਖਾਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tah sahaj akhaare anek ana(n)taa ||
english: The numerous, countless places of celestial peace

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਸੰਗੀ ਸੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paarabraham ke sa(n)gee sa(n)taa ||3||
english: - there, the Saints dwell, in the Company of the Supreme Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਅਨੰਤ ਸੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਬੀਆ ॥
transliteration: harakh ana(n)t sog nahee beeaa ||
english: There is infinite joy, and no sorrow or duality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੧੦੪॥
transliteration: so ghar gur naanak kau deeaa ||4||35||104||
english: The Guru has blessed Nanak with this home. ||4||35||104||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mah 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਉ ॥
transliteration: kavan roop teraa aaraadhau ||
english: What form of Yours should I worship and adore?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਜੋਗ ਕਾਇਆ ਲੇ ਸਾਧਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kavan jog kaaiaa le saadhau ||1||
english: What Yoga should I practice to control my body? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨੁ ਜੋ ਤੁਝੁ ਲੈ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: kavan gun jo tujh lai gaavau ||
english: What is that virtue, by which I may sing of You?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਬੋਲ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰੀਝਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kavan bol paarabraham reejhaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: What is that speech, by which I may please the Supreme Lord God? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਰਉ ॥
transliteration: kavan s poojaa teree karau ||
english: What worship service shall I perform for You?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kavan s bidh jit bhavajal tarau ||2||
english: How can I cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਤਪੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਪੀਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kavan tap jit tapeeaa hoi ||
english: What is that penance, by which I may become a penitent?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kavan s naam haumai mal khoi ||3||
english: What is that Name, by which the filth of egotism may be washed away? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਪੂਜਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਗਲ ਘਾਲ ॥
transliteration: gun poojaa giaan dhiaan naanak sagal ghaal ||
english: Virtue, worship, spiritual wisdom, meditation and all service, O Nanak,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jis kar kirapaa satigur milai daiaal ||4||
english: are obtained from the True Guru, when, in His Mercy and Kindness, He meets us. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਗੁਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tis hee gun tin hee prabh jaataa ||
english: They alone receive this merit, and they alone know God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੇਇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੩੬॥੧੦੫॥
transliteration: jis kee maan lei sukhadaataa ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||36||105||
english: who are approved by the Giver of peace. ||1||Second Pause||36||105||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਤਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਗਰਬਾ ॥
transliteration: aapan tan nahee jaa ko garabaa ||
english: The body which you are so proud of, does not belong to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਨਹੀ ਆਪਨ ਦਰਬਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raaj milakh nahee aapan darabaa ||1||
english: Power, property and wealth are not yours. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਨਹੀ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: aapan nahee kaa kau lapataaio ||
english: They are not yours, so why do you cling to them?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aapan naam satigur te paaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is yours; it is received from the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਆਪਨ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sut banitaa aapan nahee bhaaee ||
english: Children, spouse and siblings are not yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸਟ ਮੀਤ ਆਪ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: isat meet aap baap na maaee ||2||
english: Dear friends, mother and father are not yours. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੂਪਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਦਾਮ ॥
transliteration: suinaa roopaa phun nahee daam ||
english: Gold, silver and money are not yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਆਪਨ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: haivar gaivar aapan nahee kaam ||3||
english: Fine horses and magnificent elephants are of no use to you. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jo gur bakhas milaaiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, those whom the Guru forgives, meet with the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੧੦੬॥
transliteration: tis kaa sabh kichh jis kaa har raaiaa ||4||37||106||
english: Everything belongs to those who have the Lord as their King. ||4||37||106||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਊਪਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan oopar mere maathe ||
english: I place the Guru's Feet on my forehead,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa te dukh mere sagale laathe ||1||
english: and all my pains are gone. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur apune kau kurabaanee ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਚੀਨਿ ਪਰਮ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aatam cheen param ra(n)g maanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have come to understand my soul, and I enjoy supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਰੇਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: charan ren gur kee mukh laagee ||
english: I have applied the dust of the Guru's Feet to my face,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aha(n)budh tin sagal tiaagee ||2||
english: which has removed all my arrogant intellect. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਗੋ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad lago man meethaa ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has become sweet to my mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paarabraham taa te mohi deethaa ||3||
english: and I behold the Supreme Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur sukhadaataa gur karataar ||
english: The Guru is the Giver of peace; the Guru is the Creator.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੩੮॥੧੦੭॥
transliteration: jee praan naanak gur aadhaar ||4||38||107||
english: O Nanak, the Guru is the Support of the breath of life and the soul. ||4||38||107||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਆਹਿ ॥
transliteration: re man mere too(n) taa kau aahi ||
english: O my mind, seek the One,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਊਣਾ ਕਛਹੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kai oonaa kachhahoo naahi ||1||
english: who lacks nothing. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: har saa preetam kar man meet ||
english: Make the Beloved Lord your friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਦ ਚੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: praan adhaar raakhahu sad cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Keep Him constantly in your mind; He is the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਿ ॥
transliteration: re man mere too(n) taa kau sev ||
english: O my mind, serve Him;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਦੇਵ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aad purakh apara(n)par dev ||2||
english: He is the Primal Being, the Infinite Divine Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਨ ਕਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: tis oopar man kar too(n) aasaa ||
english: Place your hopes in the One

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aad jugaad jaa kaa bharavaasaa ||3||
english: who is the Support of all beings, from the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee preet sadaa sukh hoi ||
english: His Love brings eternal peace;

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak gaavai gur mil soi ||4||39||108||
english: meeting the Guru, Nanak sings His Glorious Praises. ||4||39||108||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਹਮ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: meet karai soee ham maanaa ||
english: Whatever my Friend does, I accept.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਕੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: meet ke karatab kusal samaanaa ||1||
english: My Friend's actions are pleasing to me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਟੇਕ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤ ॥
transliteration: ekaa tek merai man cheet ||
english: Within my conscious mind, the One Lord is my only Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis kichh karanaa s hamaraa meet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who does this is my Friend. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: meet hamaaraa veparavaahaa ||
english: My Friend is Carefree.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਸਨਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te mohi asanaahaa ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, I give my love to Him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: meet hamaaraa a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: My Friend is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: samarath purakh paarabraham suaamee ||3||
english: He is the All-powerful Being, the Supreme Lord and Master. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਦਾਸੇ ਤੁਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ham daase tum thaakur mere ||
english: I am Your servant; You are my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੧੦੯॥
transliteration: maan mahat naanak prabh tere ||4||40||109||
english: Nanak: my honor and glory are Yours, God. ||4||40||109||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਭਏ ਸਮਰਥ ਅੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau tum bhae samarath a(n)gaa ||
english: Those who have You on their side, O All-powerful Lord

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਲੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa kau kachh naahee kaala(n)gaa ||1||
english: - no black stain can stick to them. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਉ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਆਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maadhau jaa kau hai aas tumaaree ||
english: O Lord of wealth, those who place their hopes in You

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taa kau kachh naahee sa(n)saaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - nothing of the world can touch them at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai hiradai thaakur hoi ||
english: Those whose hearts are filled with their Lord and Master

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਹਸਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa kau sahasaa naahee koi ||2||
english: - no anxiety can affect them. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਦੀਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧੀਰ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau tum deenee prabh dheer ||
english: Those, unto whom You give Your consolation, God

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa kai nikat na aavai peer ||3||
english: - pain does not even approach them. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak mai so gur paaiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, I have found that Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪੧॥੧੧੦॥
transliteration: paarabraham pooran dekhaaiaa ||4||41||110||
english: who has shown me the Perfect, Supreme Lord God. ||4||41||110||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: dulabh deh paaee vadabhaagee ||
english: This human body is so difficult to obtain; it is only obtained by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਤੇ ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam na japahi te aatam ghaatee ||1||
english: Those who do not meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are murderers of the soul. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mar na jaahee jinaa bisarat raam ||
english: Those who forget the Lord might just as well die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਕਉਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam bihoon jeevan kaun kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Naam, of what use are their lives? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਹਸਤ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
transliteration: khaat peet khelat hasat bisathaar ||
english: Eating, drinking, playing, laughing and showing off

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਅਰਥ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kavan arath miratak seegaar ||2||
english: - what use are the ostentatious displays of the dead? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਜਸੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: jo na sunahi jas paramaana(n)daa ||
english: Those who do not listen to the Praises of the Lord of supreme bliss,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਤੇ ਮੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pas pa(n)khee trigad jon te ma(n)daa ||3||
english: are worse off than beasts, birds or creeping creatures. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur ma(n)tr driRaaiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, the GurMantra has been implanted within me;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪੨॥੧੧੧॥
transliteration: keval naam rid maahi samaaiaa ||4||42||111||
english: the Name alone is contained within my heart. ||4||42||111||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਬਾਪ ॥
transliteration: kaa kee maaee kaa ko baap ||
english: Whose mother is this? Whose father is this?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰੀਕ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam dhaareek jhoothe sabh saak ||1||
english: They are relatives in name only- they are all false. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਮੂਰਖ ਭਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kaahe kau moorakh bhakhalaaiaa ||
english: Why are you screaming and shouting, you fool?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)jog hukam too(n) aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By good destiny and the Lord's Order, you have come into the world. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ekaa maatee ekaa jot ||
english: There is the one dust, the one light,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਉਨੁ ਰੋਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: eko pavan kahaa kaun rot ||2||
english: the one praanic wind. Why are you crying? For whom do you cry? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: meraa meraa kar bilalaahee ||
english: People weep and cry out, "Mine, mine!"

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maranahaar ihu jeearaa naahee ||3||
english: This soul is not perishable. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲੇ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur khole kapaat ||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has opened my shutters;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਥਾਟ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੧੧੨॥
transliteration: mukat bhae binase bhram thaat ||4||43||112||
english: I am liberated, and my doubts have been dispelled. ||4||43||112||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਜੋ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਲੋਗ ॥
transliteration: vade vade jo deesahi log ||
english: Those who seem to be great and powerful,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਰੋਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin kau biaapai chi(n)taa rog ||1||
english: are afflicted by the disease of anxiety. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨ ਵਡਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kaun vadaa maaiaa vadiaaee ||
english: Who is great by the greatness of Maya?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਵਡਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: so vadaa jin raam liv laaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They alone are great, who are lovingly attached to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਮੀਆ ਭੂਮਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਲੁਝੈ ॥
transliteration: bhoomeeaa bhoom oopar nit lujhai ||
english: The landlord fights over his land each day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਬੁਝੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chhod chalai trisanaa nahee bujhai ||2||
english: He shall have to leave it in the end, and yet his desire is still not satisfied. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ihu tat beechaaraa ||
english: Says Nanak, this is the essence of Truth:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਛੁਟਕਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੪੪॥੧੧੩॥
transliteration: bin har bhajan naahee chhutakaaraa ||3||44||113||
english: without the Lord's meditation, there is no salvation. ||3||44||113||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: pooraa maarag pooraa isanaan ||
english: Perfect is the path; perfect is the cleansing bath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh kichh pooraa hiradai naam ||1||
english: Everything is perfect, if the Naam is in the heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੀ ਰਹੀ ਜਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: pooree rahee jaa poorai raakhee ||
english: One's honor remains perfect, when the Perfect Lord preserves it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਨ ਤਾਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham kee saran jan taakee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: His servant takes to the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
transliteration: pooraa sukh pooraa sa(n)tokh ||
english: Perfect is the peace; perfect is the contentment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਤਪੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pooraa tap pooran raaj jog ||2||
english: Perfect is the penance; perfect is the Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: har kai maarag patit puneet ||
english: On the Lord's Path, sinners are purified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਲੋਕੀਕ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pooree sobhaa pooraa lokeek ||3||
english: Perfect is their glory; perfect is their humanity. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਦ ਵਸੈ ਹਦੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: karanahaar sad vasai hadooraa ||
english: They dwell forever in the Presence of the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੪੫॥੧੧੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak meraa satigur pooraa ||4||45||114||
english: Says Nanak, my True Guru is Perfect. ||4||45||114||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਅਘ ਕੋਟ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kee dhoor mite agh kot ||
english: Millions of sins are wiped away by the dust of the feet of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਛੋਟ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad janam maran te chhot ||1||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, one is released from birth and death. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa daras pooran isanaan ||
english: The Blessed Vision of the Saints is the perfect cleansing bath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kripaa te japeeai naam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, one comes to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai sa(n)g mitiaa aha(n)kaar ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, egotism is shed,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: drisat aavai sabh eka(n)kaar ||2||
english: and the One Lord is seen everywhere. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਆਏ ਵਸਿ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t suprasa(n)n aae vas pa(n)chaa ||
english: By the pleasure of the Saints, the five passions are overpowered,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਸੰਚਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam ridai lai sa(n)chaa ||3||
english: and the heart is irrigated with the Ambrosial Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਮ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jaa kaa pooraa karam ||
english: Says Nanak, one whose karma is perfect,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: tis bhete saadhoo ke charan ||4||46||115||
english: touches the feet of the Holy. ||4||46||115||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਪਤ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸੈ ॥
transliteration: har gun japat kamal paragaasai ||
english: Meditating on the Glories of the Lord, the heart-lotus blossoms radiantly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har simarat traas sabh naasai ||1||
english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, all fears are dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saa mat pooree jit har gun gaavai ||
english: Perfect is that intellect, by which the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag saadhoo sa(n)g paavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By great good fortune, one finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g paaeeai nidh naamaa ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the treasure of the Name is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g pooran sabh kaamaa ||2||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, all one's works are brought to fruition. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: har kee bhagat janam paravaan ||
english: Through devotion to the Lord, one's life is approved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te naam vakhaan ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, one chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak so jan paravaan ||
english: Says Nanak, that humble being is accepted,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: jaa kai ridai vasai bhagavaan ||4||47||116||
english: within whose heart the Lord God abides. ||4||47||116||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ekas siu jaa kaa man raataa ||
english: Those whose minds are imbued with the One Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਰੀ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਈ ਤਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: visaree tisai paraaee taataa ||1||
english: forget to feel jealous of others. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bin gobi(n)d na deesai koee ||
english: They see none other than the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan karataa soee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Creator is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: manahi kamaavai mukh har har bolai ||
english: Those who work willingly, and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so jan it ut katahi na dolai ||2||
english: - they do not waver, here or hereafter. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੋ ਸਚ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai har dhan so sach saahu ||
english: Those who possess the wealth of the Lord are the true bankers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur poorai kar deeno visaahu ||3||
english: The Perfect Guru has established their line of credit. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jeevan purakh miliaa har raaiaa ||
english: The Giver of life, the Sovereign Lord King meets them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪੮॥੧੧੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak param pad paaiaa ||4||48||117||
english: Says Nanak, they attain the supreme status. ||4||48||117||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naam bhagat kai praan adhaar ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of the breath of life of His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naamo dhan naamo biuhaar ||1||
english: The Naam is their wealth, the Naam is their occupation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਵਡਾਈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naam vadaaee jan sobhaa paae ||
english: By the greatness of the Naam, His humble servants are blessed with glory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis aap divaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord Himself bestows it, in His Mercy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤ ਕੈ ਸੁਖ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: naam bhagat kai sukh asathaan ||
english: The Naam is the home of peace of His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤੁ ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam rat so bhagat paravaan ||2||
english: Attuned to the Naam, His devotees are approved. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam jan kau dhaarai ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the support of His humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saas saas jan naam samaarai ||3||
english: With each and every breath, they remember the Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jis pooraa bhaag ||
english: Says Nanak, those who have perfect destiny

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naam sa(n)g taa kaa man laag ||4||49||118||
english: - their minds are attached to the Naam. ||4||49||118||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad har naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, I meditated on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tab te dhaavat man tripataaiaa ||1||
english: Since then, my restless mind has been satisfied. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sukh bisraam paaiaa gun gaai ||
english: I have obtained the home of peace, singing His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਹਤੀ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sram mitiaa meree hatee balaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My troubles have ended, and the demon has been destroyed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal araadh bhagava(n)taa ||
english: Worship and adore the Lotus Feet of the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤੇ ਮਿਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har simaran te mitee meree chi(n)taa ||2||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, my anxiety has come to an end. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤਜਿ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਏਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: sabh taj anaath ek saran aaio ||
english: I have renounced all - I am an orphan. I have come to the Sanctuary of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ਤਬ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ooch asathaan tab sahaje paaio ||3||
english: Since then, I have found the highest celestial home. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਨਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dookh darad bharam bhau nasiaa ||
english: My pains, troubles, doubts and fears are gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਬਸਿਆ ॥੪॥੫੦॥੧੧੯॥
transliteration: karanahaar naanak man basiaa ||4||50||119||
english: The Creator Lord abides in Nanak's mind. ||4||50||119||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਟਹਲ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kar tahal rasanaa gun gaavau ||
english: With my hands I do His work; with my tongue I sing His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਧਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charan thaakur kai maarag dhaavau ||1||
english: With my feet, I walk on the Path of my Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਲੋ ਸਮੋ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: bhalo samo simaran kee bareeaa ||
english: It is a good time, when I remember Him in meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: simarat naam bhai paar utareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: netr sa(n)tan kaa darasan pekh ||
english: With your eyes, behold the Blessed Vision of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prabh avinaasee man mahi lekh ||2||
english: Record the Immortal Lord God within your mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sun keeratan saadh pahi jaai ||
english: Listen to the Kirtan of His Praises, at the Feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam maran kee traas mitaai ||3||
english: Your fears of birth and death shall depart. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal thaakur ur dhaar ||
english: Enshrine the Lotus Feet of your Lord and Master within your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੫੧॥੧੨੦॥
transliteration: dulabh deh naanak nisataar ||4||51||120||
english: Thus this human life, so difficult to obtain, shall be redeemed. ||4||51||120||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau apanee kirapaa dhaarai ||
english: Those, upon whom the Lord Himself showers His Mercy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so jan rasanaa naam uchaarai ||1||
english: chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with their tongues. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: har bisarat sahasaa dukh biaapai ||
english: Forgetting the Lord, superstition and sorrow shall overtake you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: simarat naam bharam bhau bhaagai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating on the Naam, doubt and fear shall depart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har keeratan sunai har keeratan gaavai ||
english: Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and singing the Lord's Kirtan,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis jan dookh nikat nahee aavai ||2||
english: misfortune shall not even come near you. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਰਤ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: har kee tahal karat jan sohai ||
english: Working for the Lord, His humble servants look beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa kau maaiaa agan na pohai ||3||
english: The fire of Maya does not touch them. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: man tan mukh har naam daiaal ||
english: Within their minds, bodies and mouths, is the Name of the Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ ਅਵਰਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੪॥੫੨॥੧੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak tajeeale avar ja(n)jaal ||4||52||121||
english: Nanak has renounced other entanglements. ||4||52||121||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: chhaad siaanap bahu chaturaaee ||
english: Renounce your cleverness, and your cunning tricks.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur poore kee tek tikaaee ||1||
english: Seek the Support of the Perfect Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh binase sukh har gun gaai ||
english: Your pain shall depart, and in peace, you shall sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa bhetiaa liv laai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting the Perfect Guru, let yourself be absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam deeo gur ma(n)tr ||
english: The Guru has given me the Mantra of the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੇ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ਉਤਰੀ ਚਿੰਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mite visoore utaree chi(n)t ||2||
english: My worries are forgotten, and my anxiety is gone. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: anad bhae gur milat kripaal ||
english: Meeting with the Merciful Guru, I am in ecstasy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa kaate jam jaal ||3||
english: Showering His Mercy, He has cut away the noose of the Messenger of Death. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur pooraa paaiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫੩॥੧੨੨॥
transliteration: taa te bahur na biaapai maaiaa ||4||53||122||
english: Maya shall no longer harass me. ||4||53||122||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: raakh leeaa gur poorai aap ||
english: The Perfect Guru Himself has saved me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: manamukh kau laago sa(n)taap ||1||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are afflicted with misfortune. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪਿ ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guroo guroo jap meet hamaare ||
english: Chant and meditate on the Guru, the Guru, O my friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mukh oojal hovahi darabaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan hiradai vasaai ||
english: Enshrine the Feet of the Guru within your heart;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਹਤੈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dukh dusaman teree hatai balaai ||2||
english: your pains, enemies and bad luck shall be destroyed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad terai sa(n)g sahaaee ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is your Companion and Helper.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: daiaal bhae sagale jee bhaaee ||3||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, all beings shall be kind to you. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਜਬ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai jab kirapaa karee ||
english: When the Perfect Guru granted His Grace,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰੀ ॥੪॥੫੪॥੧੨੩॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak meree pooree paree ||4||54||123||
english: says Nanak, I was totally, completely fulfilled. ||4||54||123||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰਸਾ ਖਾਏ ਜੈਸੇ ਢੋਰ ॥
transliteration: anik rasaa khaae jaise dhor ||
english: Like beasts, they consume all sorts of tasty treats.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਚੋਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: moh kee jevaree baadhio chor ||1||
english: With the rope of emotional attachment, they are bound and gagged like thieves. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਦੇਹ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ॥
transliteration: miratak deh saadhasa(n)g bihoonaa ||
english: Their bodies are corpses, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਖ ਖੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aavat jaat jonee dukh kheenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They come and go in reincarnation, and are destroyed by pain. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anik basatr su(n)dar pahiraaiaa ||
english: They wear all sorts of beautiful robes,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਡਰਨਾ ਖੇਤ ਮਾਹਿ ਡਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu daranaa khet maahi daraaiaa ||2||
english: but they are still just scarecrows in the field, frightening away the birds. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਰੀਰ ਆਵਤ ਸਭ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sagal sareer aavat sabh kaam ||
english: All bodies are of some use,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਫਲ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nihaphal maanukh japai nahee naam ||3||
english: but those who do not meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are totally useless. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jaa kau bhae daiaalaa ||
english: Says Nanak, those unto whom the Lord becomes Merciful,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mil bhajahi goupaalaa ||4||55||124||
english: join the Saadh Sangat, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe. ||4||55||124||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kal kales gur sabad nivaare ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad quiets worries and troubles.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aavan jaan rahe sukh saare ||1||
english: Coming and going ceases, and all comforts are obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhai binase nirabhau har dhiaaiaa ||
english: Fear is dispelled, meditating on the Fearless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har ke gun gaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: charan kaval rid a(n)tar dhaare ||
english: I have enshrined the Lotus Feet of the Lord within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: agan saagar gur paar utaare ||2||
english: The Guru has carried me across the ocean of fire. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਜਾਤ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢੇ ॥
transliteration: boodat jaat poorai gur kaadhe ||
english: I was sinking down, and the Perfect Guru pulled me out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਟੂਟੇ ਗਾਢੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam janam ke toote gaadhe ||3||
english: I was cut off from the Lord for countless incarnations, and now the Guru united me with Him again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tis gur balihaaree ||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੫੬॥੧੨੫॥
transliteration: jis bhetat gat bhaee hamaaree ||4||56||125||
english: meeting Him, I have been saved. ||4||56||125||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g taa kee saranee parahu ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, seek His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਆਗੈ ਧਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man tan apanaa aagai dharahu ||1||
english: Place your mind and body in offering before Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam peevahu mere bhaaee ||
english: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਭ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: simar simar sabh tapat bujhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the fire of desire is totally quenched. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: taj abhimaan janam maran nivaarahu ||
english: Renounce your arrogant pride, and end the cycle of birth and death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har ke daas ke charan namasakaarahu ||2||
english: Bow in humility to the feet of the Lord's slave. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: saas saas prabh manahi samaale ||
english: Remember God in your mind, with each and every breath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਜੋ ਚਾਲੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so dhan sa(n)chahu jo chaalai naale ||3||
english: Gather only that wealth, which shall go with you. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: tisahi paraapat jis masatak bhaag ||
english: He alone obtains it, upon whose forehead such destiny is written.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੪॥੫੭॥੧੨੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak taa kee charanee laag ||4||57||126||
english: Says Nanak, fall at the Feet of that Lord. ||4||57||126||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਕੇ ਹਰੇ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: sooke hare keee khin maahe ||
english: The dried branches are made green again in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਜੀਵਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit drisat sa(n)ch jeevaae ||1||
english: His Ambrosial Glance irrigates and revives them. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੇ ਕਸਟ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: kaate kasat poore guradev ||
english: The Perfect Divine Guru has removed my sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੀ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sevak kau deenee apunee sev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He blesses His servant with His service. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਚਿੰਤ ਪੁਨੀ ਮਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: mit gaee chi(n)t punee man aasaa ||
english: Anxiety is removed, and the desires of the mind are fulfilled,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੀ ਦਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karee daiaa satigur gunataasaa ||2||
english: when the True Guru, the Treasure of Excellence, shows His Kindness. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ਸੁਖ ਆਇ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dukh naathe sukh aai samaae ||
english: Pain is driven far away, and peace comes in its place;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਢੀਲ ਨ ਪਰੀ ਜਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dheel na paree jaa gur phuramaae ||3||
english: there is no delay, when the Guru gives the Order. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ॥
transliteration: ichh punee poore gur mile ||
english: Desires are fulfilled, when one meets the True Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲੇ ॥੪॥੫੮॥੧੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak te jan suphal phale ||4||58||127||
english: O Nanak, His humble servant is fruitful and prosperous. ||4||58||127||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਪ ਗਏ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: taap gae paaee prabh saa(n)t ||
english: The fever has departed; God has showered us with peace and tranquility.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਕੀਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: seetal bhae keenee prabh daat ||1||
english: A cooling peace prevails; God has granted this gift. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kirapaa te bhae suhele ||
english: By God's Grace, we have become comfortable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਛੁਰੇ ਮੇਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke bichhure mele ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Separated from Him for countless incarnations, we are now reunited with Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: simarat simarat prabh kaa naau ||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God's Name,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਰੋਗ ਕਾ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sagal rog kaa binasiaa thaau ||2||
english: the dwelling of all disease is destroyed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaj subhaai bolai har baanee ||
english: In intuitive peace and poise, chant the Word of the Lord's Bani.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aath pahar prabh simarahu praanee ||3||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, O mortal, meditate on God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dookh darad jam neR na aavai ||
english: Pain, suffering and the Messenger of Death do not even approach that one,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੫੯॥੧੨੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jo har gun gaavai ||4||59||128||
english: says Nanak, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||59||128||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਲੇ ਦਿਨਸ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: bhale dinas bhale sa(n)jog ||
english: Auspicious is the day, and auspicious is the chance,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰਜੋਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jit bhete paarabraham nirajog ||1||
english: which brought me to the Supreme Lord God, the Unjoined, Unlimited One. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਬੇਲਾ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: oh belaa kau hau bal jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to that time,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit meraa man japai har naau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: when my mind chants the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਸਫਲ ਓਹ ਘਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saphal moorat saphal oh gharee ||
english: Blessed is that moment, and blessed is that time,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jit rasanaa ucharai har haree ||2||
english: when my tongue chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Haree. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਓਹੁ ਮਾਥਾ ਸੰਤ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਸਿ ॥
transliteration: saphal ohu maathaa sa(n)t namasakaaras ||
english: Blessed is that forehead, which bows in humility to the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਚਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: charan puneet chalahi har maarag ||3||
english: Sacred are those feet, which walk on the Lord's Path. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਲਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bhalaa meraa karam ||
english: Says Nanak, auspicious is my karma,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: jit bhete saadhoo ke charan ||4||60||129||
english: which has led me to touch the Feet of the Holy. ||4||60||129||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad raakh man maahi ||
english: Keep the Word of the Guru's Shabad in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਭ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam simar chi(n)taa sabh jaahi ||1||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all anxiety is removed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin bhagava(n)t naahee an koi ||
english: Without the Lord God, there is no one else at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਖੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maarai raakhai eko soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He alone preserves and destroys. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan ridai ur dhaar ||
english: Enshrine the Guru's Feet in your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਪਿ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: agan saagar jap utarahi paar ||2||
english: Meditate on Him and cross over the ocean of fire. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur moorat siu laai dhiaan ||
english: Focus your meditation on the Guru's Sublime Form.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: eehaa oohaa paavahi maan ||3||
english: Here and hereafter, you shall be honored. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sagal tiaag gur saranee aaiaa ||
english: Renouncing everything, I have come to the Guru's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬੧॥੧੩੦॥
transliteration: mite a(n)dese naanak sukh paaiaa ||4||61||130||
english: My anxieties are over - O Nanak, I have found peace. ||4||61||130||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੂਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat dookh sabh jaai ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, all pains are gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam ratan vasai man aai ||1||
english: The jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jap man mere govi(n)d kee baanee ||
english: O my mind, chant the Bani, the Hymns of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਸਨ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo jan raam rasan vakhaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Holy People chant the Lord's Name with their tongues. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ikas bin naahee doojaa koi ||
english: Without the One Lord, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa kee drisat sadaa sukh hoi ||2||
english: By His Glance of Grace, eternal peace is obtained. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ॥
transliteration: saajan meet sakhaa kar ek ||
english: Make the One Lord your friend, intimate and companion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਖਰ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har akhar man mahi lekh ||3||
english: Write in your mind the Word of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: rav rahiaa sarabat suaamee ||
english: The Lord Master is totally pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੬੨॥੧੩੧॥
transliteration: gun gaavai naanak a(n)tarajaamee ||4||62||131||
english: Nanak sings the Praises of the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||62||131||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhai mahi rachio sabh sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The whole world is engrossed in fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis bhau naahee jis naam adhaaraa ||1||
english: Those who have the Naam, the Name of the Lord, as their Support, feel no fear. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: bhau na viaapai teree saranaa ||
english: Fear does not affect those who take to Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai soee karanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You do whatever You please. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਮਹਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sog harakh mahi aavan jaanaa ||
english: In pleasure and in pain, the world is coming and going in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin sukh paaiaa jo prabh bhaanaa ||2||
english: Those who are pleasing to God, find peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: agan saagar mahaa viaapai maaiaa ||
english: Maya pervades the awesome ocean of fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: se seetal jin satigur paaiaa ||3||
english: Those who have found the True Guru are calm and cool. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: raakh lei prabh raakhanahaaraa ||
english: Please preserve me, O God, O Great Preserver!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੬੩॥੧੩੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak kiaa ja(n)t vichaaraa ||4||63||132||
english: Says Nanak, what a helpless creature I am! ||4||63||132||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tumaree kripaa te japeeai naau ||
english: By Your Grace, I chant Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tumaree kripaa te daragah thaau ||1||
english: By Your Grace, I obtain a seat in Your Court. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin paarabraham nahee koi ||
english: Without You, O Supreme Lord God, there is no one.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tumaree kripaa te sadaa sukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Your Grace, everlasting peace is obtained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੇ ਤਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: tum man vase tau dookh na laagai ||
english: If You abide in the mind, we do not suffer in sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tumaree kripaa te bhram bhau bhaagai ||2||
english: By Your Grace, doubt and fear run away. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham apara(n)par suaamee ||
english: O Supreme Lord God, Infinite Lord and Master,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sagal ghataa ke a(n)tarajaamee ||3||
english: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: karau aradaas apane satigur paas ||
english: I offer this prayer to the True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak naam milai sach raas ||4||64||133||
english: O Nanak, may I be blessed with the treasure of the True Name. ||4||64||133||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਣ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਥੋਥਰ ਤੁਖਾ ॥
transliteration: kan binaa jaise thothar tukhaa ||
english: As the husk is empty without the grain,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਸੂਨੇ ਸੇ ਮੁਖਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam bihoon soone se mukhaa ||1||
english: so is the mouth empty without the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu nit praanee ||
english: O mortal, chant continually the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਗਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam bihoon dhrig deh bigaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Naam, cursed is the body, which shall be taken back by Death. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa naahee mukh bhaag ||
english: Without the Naam, no one's face shows good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਤ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਕਹਾ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bharat bihoon kahaa sohaag ||2||
english: Without the Husband, where is the marriage? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਲਗੈ ਅਨ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
transliteration: naam bisaar lagai an suaai ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, and attached to other tastes,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ਕਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa kee aas na poojai kaai ||3||
english: no desires are fulfilled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh apanee daat ||
english: O God, grant Your Grace, and give me this gift.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak naam japai din raat ||4||65||134||
english: Please, let Nanak chant Your Name, day and night. ||4||65||134||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) samarath too(n)hai meraa suaamee ||
english: You are All-powerful, You are my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh kichh tum te too(n) a(n)tarajaamee ||1||
english: Everything comes from You; You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਨ ਓਟ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham pooran jan ot ||
english: The Perfect Supreme Lord God is the Support of His humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਜਨ ਕੋਟਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teree saran udharahi jan kot ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Millions are saved in Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jete jee tete sabh tere ||
english: As many creatures as there are - they are all Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tumaree kripaa te sookh ghanere ||2||
english: By Your Grace, all sorts of comforts are obtained. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh varatai sabh teraa bhaanaa ||
english: Whatever happens, is all according to Your Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hukam boojhai so sach samaanaa ||3||
english: One who understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, is absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa deejai prabh daan ||
english: Please grant Your Grace, God, and bestow this gift

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak simarai naam nidhaan ||4||66||135||
english: upon Nanak, that he may meditate on the treasure of the Naam. ||4||66||135||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: taa kaa daras paaeeai vadabhaagee ||
english: By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is obtained,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kee raam naam liv laagee ||1||
english: by those who are lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai har vasiaa man maahee ||
english: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taa kau dukh supanai bhee naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: do not suffer pain, even in dreams. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan raakhe jan maahi ||
english: All treasures have been placed within the minds of His humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa kai sa(n)g kilavikh dukh jaahi ||2||
english: In their company, sinful mistakes and sorrows are taken away. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jan kee mahimaa kathee na jaai ||
english: The Glories of the Lord's humble servants cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paarabraham jan rahiaa samaai ||3||
english: The servants of the Supreme Lord God remain absorbed in Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh binau suneejai ||
english: Grant Your Grace, God, and hear my prayer:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੬੭॥੧੩੬॥
transliteration: daas kee dhoor naanak kau deejai ||4||67||136||
english: please bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of Your slave. ||4||67||136||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਾਇ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har simarat teree jaai balaai ||
english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, your misfortune shall be taken away,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarab kaliaan vasai man aai ||1||
english: and all joy shall come to abide in your mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhaj man mere eko naam ||
english: Meditate, O my mind, on the One Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jee tere kai aavai kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It alone shall be of use to your soul. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: rain dinas gun gaau ana(n)taa ||
english: Night and day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur poore kaa niramal ma(n)taa ||2||
english: through the Pure Mantra of the Perfect Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: chhod upaav ek tek raakh ||
english: Give up other efforts, and place your faith in the Support of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mahaa padaarath a(n)mrit ras chaakh ||3||
english: Taste the Ambrosial Essence of this, the greatest treasure. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਮ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤੇਈ ਜਨ ਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bikham saagar teee jan tare ||
english: They alone cross over the treacherous world-ocean,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੪॥੬੮॥੧੩੭॥
transliteration: naanak jaa kau nadar kare ||4||68||137||
english: O Nanak, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||4||68||137||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hiradai charan kamal prabh dhaare ||
english: I have enshrined the Lotus Feet of God within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poore satigur mil nisataare ||1||
english: Meeting the Perfect True Guru, I am emancipated. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: govi(n)d gun gaavahu mere bhaaee ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhoo har naam dhiaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Joining the Holy Saints, meditate on the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਹੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: dulabh deh hoee paravaan ||
english: This human body, so difficult to obtain, is redeemed

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur te paaiaa naam neesaan ||2||
english: when one receives the banner of the Naam from the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har simarat pooran pad paaiaa ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the state of perfection is attained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g bhai bharam mitaaiaa ||3||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, fear and doubt depart. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jat kat dekhau tat rahiaa samaai ||
english: Wherever I look, there I see the Lord pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੪॥੬੯॥੧੩੮॥
transliteration: naanak daas har kee saranaai ||4||69||138||
english: Slave Nanak has entered the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||69||138||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur jee ke darasan kau bal jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jap jap jeevaa satigur naau ||1||
english: Chanting and meditating on the Name of the True Guru, I live. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham pooran guradev ||
english: O Supreme Lord God, O Perfect Divine Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲਾਗਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa laagau teree sev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: show mercy to me, and commit me to Your service. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal hiradai ur dhaaree ||
english: I enshrine His Lotus Feet within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man tan dhan gur praan adhaaree ||2||
english: I offer my mind, body and wealth to the Guru, the Support of the breath of life. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam hovai paravaan ||
english: My life is prosperous, fruitful and approved;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur paarabraham nikat kar jaan ||3||
english: I know that the Guru, the Supreme Lord God, is near me. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t dhoor paaeeai vadabhaagee ||
english: By great good fortune, I have obtained the dust of the feet of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੭੦॥੧੩੯॥
transliteration: naanak gur bhetat har siu liv laagee ||4||70||139||
english: O Nanak, meeting the Guru, I have fallen in love with the Lord. ||4||70||139||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੈ ਦੁਹਕਰਮ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: karai duhakaram dikhaavai hor ||
english: They do their evil deeds, and pretend otherwise;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਾਧਾ ਚੋਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam kee daragah baadhaa chor ||1||
english: but in the Court of the Lord, they shall be bound and gagged like thieves. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮੈ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: raam ramai soee raamaanaa ||
english: Those who remember the Lord belong to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal ek samaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The One Lord is contained in the water, the land and the sky. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar bikh mukh a(n)mrit sunaavai ||
english: Their inner beings are filled with poison, and yet with their mouths, they preach words of Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jam pur baadhaa chotaa khaavai ||2||
english: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, they are punished and beaten. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪੜਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: anik paRade mahi kamaavai vikaar ||
english: Hiding behind many screens, they commit acts of corruption,
