transliteration: gur gobi(n)d paarabraham pooraa ||
english: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, the Supreme Lord God, is perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tisahi araadh meraa man dheeraa || rahaau ||
english: Worshipping Him, my mind has found a lasting peace. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: anadin japau guroo gur naam ||
english: Night and day, I meditate on the Guru, and the Name of the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਂਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa te sidh bhae sagal kaa(n)m ||2||
english: Thus all my works are brought to perfection. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੀਤਲ ਮਨ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: darasan dekh seetal man bhae ||
english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my mind has become cool and tranquil,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh gae ||3||
english: and the sinful mistakes of countless incarnations have been washed away. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਾ ਭੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak kahaa bhai bhaaee ||
english: Says Nanak, where is fear now, O Siblings of Destiny?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੧੨॥
transliteration: apane sevak kee aap paij rakhaaee ||4||112||
english: The Guru Himself has preserved the honor of His servant. ||4||112||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: apane sevak kau aap sahaaee ||
english: The Lord Himself is the Help and Support of His servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੈ ਬਾਪ ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nit pratipaarai baap jaise maaee ||1||
english: He always cherishes them, like their father and mother. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਉਬਰੈ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee saran ubarai sabh koi ||
english: In God's Sanctuary, everyone is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan pooran sach soi || rahaau ||
english: That Perfect True Lord is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮਨਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ab man basiaa karanaihaaraa ||
english: My mind now dwells in the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhai binase aatam sukh saaraa ||2||
english: My fears have been dispelled, and my soul has found the most sublime peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apane jan raakhe ||
english: The Lord has granted His Grace, and saved His humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh laathe ||3||
english: The sinful mistakes of so many incarnations have been washed away. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kahan na jaai prabh kee vadiaaee ||
english: The Greatness of God cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak daas sadaa saranaaee ||4||113||
english: Servant Nanak is forever in His Sanctuary. ||4||113||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee chetee mahalaa 5 dupade ||
english: Raag Gauree Chaytee, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਬਲੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raam ko bal pooran bhaaee ||
english: The power of the Lord is universal and perfect, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taa te brithaa na biaapai kaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: So no pain can ever afflict me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo jo chitavai daas har maaee ||
english: Whatever the Lord's slave wishes, O mother,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so so karataa aap karaaee ||1||
english: the Creator Himself causes that to be done. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kee prabh pat gavaaee ||
english: God causes the slanderers to lose their honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak har gun nirabhau gaaee ||2||114||
english: Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Fearless Lord. ||2||114||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੁਜ ਬਲ ਬੀਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਗਰਤ ਪਰਤ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਅੰਗੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhuj bal beer braham sukh saagar garat parat gahi lehu a(n)gureeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Brave and Powerful God, Ocean of Peace, I fell into the pit - please, take my hand. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨੈਨ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਹੀ ਆਰਤ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਰਟਤ ਪਿੰਗੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sravan na surat nain su(n)dar nahee aarat duaar ratat pi(n)gureeaa ||1||
english: My ears do not hear, and my eyes are not beautiful. I am in such pain; I am a poor cripple, crying at Your Door. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਹਤਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: deenaa naath anaath karunaa mai saajan meet pitaa mahatareeaa ||
english: O Master of the poor and helpless, O Embodiment of Compassion, You are my Friend and Intimate, my Father and Mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਆ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧੫॥
transliteration: charan kaval hiradai gahi naanak bhai saagar sa(n)t paar utareeaa ||2||2||115||
english: Nanak holds tight to the Lord's Lotus Feet in his heart; thus the Saints cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||2||115||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਯ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੀਤੁਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: day gusaaee meetulaa too(n) sa(n)g hamaarai baas jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Dear Lord God, my Best Friend, please, abide with me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਰਹਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin gharee na jeevanaa dhrig rahanaa sa(n)saar ||
english: Without You, I cannot live, even for an instant, and my life in this world is cursed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਿਆ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jee praan sukhadaatiaa nimakh nimakh balihaar jee ||1||
english: O Breath of Life of the soul, O Giver of peace, each and every instant I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਅਲੰਬਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਰਤਹੁ ਉਧਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: hasat ala(n)ban dehu prabh garatahu udhar gopaal ||
english: Please, God, give me the Support of Your Hand; lift me up and pull me out of this pit, O Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਮਤਿ ਥੋਰੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mohi niragun mat thoreeaa too(n) sad hee deen daiaal ||2||
english: I am worthless, with such a shallow intellect; You are always Merciful to the meek. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧੀ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kiaa sukh tere sa(n)malaa kavan bidhee beechaar ||
english: What comforts of Yours can I dwell upon? How can I contemplate You?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਦਾਸ ਹਿਤ ਊਚੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saran samaaee daas hit ooche agam apaar ||3||
english: You lovingly absorb Your slaves into Your Sanctuary, O Lofty, Inaccessible and Infinite Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਾਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sagal padaarath asat sidh naam mahaa ras maahi ||
english: All wealth, and the eight miraculous spiritual powers are in the supremely sublime essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਕੇਸਵਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: suprasa(n)n bhae kesavaa se jan har gun gaahi ||4||
english: Those humble beings, with whom the beautifully-haired Lord is thoroughly pleased, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪੋ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa sut ba(n)dhapo too(n) mere praan adhaar ||
english: You are my mother, father, son and relative; You are the Support of the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਜੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੧੬॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak bhajai bikh tariaa sa(n)saar ||5||1||116||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak meditates on the Lord, and swims across the poisonous world-ocean. ||5||1||116||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਰਹੋਏ ਕੇ ਛੰਤ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan rahoe ke chha(n)t ke ghar mah 5 ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, Chhants Of Rehoay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hai koee raam piaaro gaavai ||
english: Is there anyone who will sing of the Beloved Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੂਖ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab kaliaan sookh sach paavai || rahaau ||
english: Surely, this will bring all pleasures and comforts. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: ban ban khojat phirat bairaagee ||
english: The renunciate goes out into the woods, searching for Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਲੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: birale kaahoo ek liv laagee ||
english: But those who embrace love for the One Lord are very rare.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin har paaiaa se vadabhaagee ||1||
english: Those who find the Lord are very fortunate and blessed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਚਾਹੈ ॥
transliteration: brahamaadik sanakaadik chaahai ||
english: The Gods like Brahma and Sanak yearn for Him;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਸਿਧ ਹਰਿ ਆਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jogee jatee sidh har aahai ||
english: the Yogis, celibates and Siddhas yearn for the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jisahi paraapat so har gun gaahai ||2||
english: One who is so blessed, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਿਨ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: taa kee saran jin bisarat naahee ||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of those who have not forgotten Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee har sa(n)t milaahee ||
english: By great good fortune, one meets the Lord's Saint.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤਿਹ ਮੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam maran tih moole naahee ||3||
english: They are not subject to the cycle of birth and death. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mil preetam piaare ||
english: Show Your Mercy, and lead me to meet You, O my Darling Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: binau sunahu prabh ooch apaare ||
english: Hear my prayer, O Lofty and Infinite God;

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak maa(n)gat naam adhaare ||4||1||117||
english: Nanak begs for the Support of Your Name. ||4||1||117||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee poorabee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kavan gun praanapat milau meree maaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By what virtues can I meet the Lord of life, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਹੀਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਹੀਨੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਰਦੇਸਨਿ ਦੂਰ ਤੇ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: roop heen budh bal heenee mohi paradesan door te aaee ||1||
english: I have no beauty, understanding or strength; I am a stranger, from far away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਹਿਨ ਦਰਬੁ ਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਮਾਤੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naahin darab na joban maatee mohi anaath kee karahu samaaee ||2||
english: I am not wealthy or youthful. I am an orphan - please, unite me with Yourself. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਈ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਤ ਤਿਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khojat khojat bhaee bairaagan prabh darasan kau hau phirat tisaaee ||3||
english: Searching and searching, I have become a renunciate, free of desire. I wander around, searching for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੧੮॥
transliteration: deen daiaal kripaal prabh naanak saadhasa(n)g meree jalan bujhaaee ||4||1||118||
english: God is Compassionate, and Merciful to the meek; O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the fire of desire has been quenched. ||4||1||118||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh milabe kau preet man laagee ||
english: The loving desire to meet my Beloved has arisen within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕੋਊ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paai lagau mohi karau benatee kooo sa(n)t milai badabhaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I touch His Feet, and offer my prayer to Him. If only I had the great good fortune to meet the Saint. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਖਉ ਆਗੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
transliteration: man arapau dhan raakhau aagai man kee mat mohi sagal tiaagee ||
english: I surrender my mind to Him; I place my wealth before Him. I totally renounce my selfish ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਫਿਰਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਵਿਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo prabh kee har kathaa sunaavai anadin phirau tis pichhai viraagee ||1||
english: One who teaches me the Sermon of the Lord God - night and day, I shall follow Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਕਰਮ ਅੰਕੁਰ ਜਬ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਰਸਿਕ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: poorab karam a(n)kur jab pragate bhetio purakh rasik bairaagee ||
english: When the seed of the karma of past actions sprouted, I met the Lord; He is both the Enjoyer and the Renunciate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿਓ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਮਿਲਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧੯॥
transliteration: mitio a(n)dher milat har naanak janam janam kee soee jaagee ||2||2||119||
english: My darkness was dispelled when I met the Lord. O Nanak, after being asleep for countless incarnations, I have awakened. ||2||2||119||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਸੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਖੀ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਂਖ ॥
transliteration: nikas re pa(n)khee simar har paa(n)kh ||
english: Come out, O soul-bird, and let the meditative remembrance of the Lord be your wings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੀਅਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhoo saran gahu pooran raam ratan heeare sa(n)g raakh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meet the Holy Saint, take to His Sanctuary, and keep the perfect jewel of the Lord enshrined in your heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਕੂਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਰਸ ਪੰਕਜ ਅਤਿ ਤੀਖੵਣ ਮੋਹ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
transliteration: bhram kee kooee trisanaa ras pa(n)kaj at teekhyn moh kee phaas ||
english: Superstition is the well, thirst for pleasure is the mud, and emotional attachment is the noose, so tight around your neck.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaatanahaar jagat gur gobid charan kamal taa ke karahu nivaas ||1||
english: The only one who can cut this is the Guru of the World, the Lord of the Universe. So let yourself dwell at His Lotus Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa gobi(n)d prabh preetam deenaa naath sunahu aradaas ||
english: Bestow Your Mercy, O Lord of the Universe, O God, My Beloved, Master of the meek - please, listen to my prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੨੦॥
transliteration: kar gahi lehu naanak ke suaamee jeeu pi(n)d sabh tumaree raas ||2||3||120||
english: Take my hand, O Lord and Master of Nanak; my body and soul all belong to You. ||2||3||120||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har pekhan kau simarat man meraa ||
english: My mind yearns to behold the Lord in meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aas piaasee chitavau din rainee hai koee sa(n)t milaavai neraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I think of Him, I hope and thirst for Him, day and night; is there any Saint who may bring Him near me? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sevaa karau daas daasan kee anik bhaa(n)t tis karau nihoraa ||
english: I serve the slaves of His slaves; in so many ways, I beg of Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਤੋਲੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ ਸਭੋ ਹੀ ਥੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tulaa dhaar tole sukh sagale bin har daras sabho hee thoraa ||1||
english: Setting them upon the scale, I have weighed all comforts and pleasures; without the Lord's Blessed Vision, they are all totally inadequate. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਗਰ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੋ ਜਾਤ ਬਹੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad gaae gun saagar janam janam ko jaat bahoraa ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, I sing the Praises of the Ocean of virtue; after countless incarnations, I have been released.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਾਰਥੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੨੧॥
transliteration: aanad sookh bhetat har naanak janam kritaarath saphal saveraa ||2||4||121||
english: Meeting the Lord, Nanak has found peace and bliss; his life is redeemed, and prosperity dawns for him. ||2||4||121||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ₁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee poorabee₁ mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kin bidh milai gusaaee mere raam raai ||
english: How may I meet my Master, the King, the Lord of the Universe?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੇਇ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: koee aisaa sa(n)t sahaj sukhadaataa mohi maarag dei bataaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Is there any Saint, who can bestow such celestial peace, and show me the Way to Him? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar alakh na jaaee lakhiaa vich paRadaa haumai paaee ||
english: The Unseen Lord is deep within the self; He cannot be seen; the curtain of egotism intervenes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਭੋ ਜਗੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਇਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi sabho jag soiaa ihu bharam kahahu kiu jaaee ||1||
english: In emotional attachment to Maya, all the world is asleep. Tell me, how can this doubt be dispelled? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਕਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਸਤੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ekaa sa(n)gat ikat grihi basate mil baat na karate bhaaee ||
english: The one lives together with the other in the same house, but they do not talk to one another, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ ਓਹ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਠਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ek basat bin pa(n)ch duhele oh basat agochar thaaee ||2||
english: Without the one substance, the five are miserable; that substance is in the unapproachable place. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤਾਲਾ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਉਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa grihu tin deeaa taalaa ku(n)jee gur saupaaee ||
english: And the one whose home it is, has locked it up, and given the key to the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anik upaav kare nahee paavai bin satigur saranaaee ||3||
english: You may make all sorts of efforts, but it cannot be obtained, without the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin ke ba(n)dhan kaate satigur tin saadhasa(n)gat liv laaee ||
english: Those whose bonds have been broken by the True Guru, enshrine love for the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch janaa mil ma(n)gal gaaiaa har naanak bhed na bhaaee ||4||
english: The self-elect, the self-realized beings, meet together and sing the joyous songs of the Lord. Nanak, there is no difference between them, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mere raam raai in bidh milai gusaaee ||
english: This is how my Sovereign Lord King, the Lord of the Universe, is met;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਠਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੧੨੨॥
transliteration: sahaj bhaiaa bhram khin mahi naathaa mil jotee jot samaaee ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||1||122||
english: celestial bliss is attained in an instant, and doubt is dispelled. Meeting Him, my light merges in the Light. ||1||Second Pause||1||122||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਪਰਚਉ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: aiso parachau paaio ||
english: I am intimate with Him;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਬੀਠੁਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karee kripaa daiaal beethulai satigur mujhahi bataaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: granting His Grace, my Kind Beloved has told me of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸੁਆਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: jat kat dekhau tat tat tum hee mohi ihu bisuaas hoi aaio ||
english: Wherever I look, there You are; I am totally convinced of this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਉ ਸੁਨਤੋ ਹੈ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kai pahi karau aradaas benatee jau sunato hai raghuraaio ||1||
english: Unto whom should I pray? The Lord Himself hears all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਹਿਓ ਸਹਸਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਤੋਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: lahio sahasaa ba(n)dhan gur tore taa(n) sadaa sahaj sukh paaio ||
english: My anxiety is over. The Guru has cut away my bonds, and I have found eternal peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਣਾ ਸਾ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਹਾ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: honaa saa soee phun hosee sukh dukh kahaa dikhaaio ||2||
english: Whatever shall be, shall be in the end; so where can pain and pleasure be seen? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਠਾਣਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਦਾ ਖੋਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)d brahama(n)d kaa eko thaanaa gur paradaa khol dikhaaio ||
english: The continents and the solar systems rest in the support of the One Lord. The Guru has removed the veil of illusion, and shown this to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ਤਉ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੈਠੈ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nau nidh naam nidhaan ik thaaee tau baahar kaithai jaaio ||3||
english: The nine treasures of the wealth of the Name of the Lord are in that one place. Where else should we go? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਰਚਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: ekai kanik anik bhaat saajee bahu parakaar rachaaio ||
english: The same gold is fashioned into various articles; just so, the Lord has made the many patterns of the creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਹੈ ਇਵ ਤਤੈ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bharam gur khoee hai iv tatai tat milaaio ||4||2||123||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt; in this way, my essence merges into God's essence. ||4||2||123||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee₂ mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: audh ghatai dinas rainaare ||
english: This life is diminishing, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man gur mil kaaj savaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: karau bena(n)tee sunahu mere meetaa sa(n)t tahal kee belaa ||
english: Listen, my friends, I beg of you: now is the time to serve the Saints!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਆਗੈ ਬਸਨੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: eehaa khaat chalahu har laahaa aagai basan suhelaa ||1||
english: In this world, earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and hereafter, you shall dwell in peace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਸਹਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ihu sa(n)saar bikaar sahase mahi tario braham giaanee ||
english: This world is engrossed in corruption and cynicism. Only those who know God are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਪੀਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jisahi jagaai peeaae har ras akath kathaa tin jaanee ||2||
english: Those who are awakened by the Lord to drink in this sublime essence, come to know the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਏ ਸੋਈ ਵਿਹਾਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau aae soee vihaajhahu har gur te manahi baseraa ||
english: Purchase only that for which you have come into the world, and through the Guru, the Lord shall dwell within your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nij ghar mahal paavahu sukh sahaje bahur na hoigo pheraa ||3||
english: Within the home of your own inner being, you shall obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence with intuitive ease. You shall not be consigned again to the wheel of reincarnation. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee purakh bidhaate saradhaa man kee poore ||
english: O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, Primal Being, Architect of Destiny: please fulfill this yearning of my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਇਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨੪॥
transliteration: naanak daas ihee sukh maagai mo kau kar sa(n)tan kee dhoore ||4||3||124||
english: Nanak, Your slave, begs for this happiness: let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||3||124||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raakh pitaa prabh mere ||
english: Save me, O My Father God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਸਭ ਗੁਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mohi niragun sabh gun tere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am worthless and without virtue; all virtues are Yours. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਏਕੁ ਗਰੀਬਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch bikhaadee ek gareebaa raakhahu raakhanahaare ||
english: The five vicious thieves are assaulting my poor being; save me, O Savior Lord!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਦੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਰੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸੰਤਾਵਹਿ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khed karahi ar bahut sa(n)taavahi aaio saran tuhaare ||1||
english: They are tormenting and torturing me. I have come, seeking Your Sanctuary. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kar kar haario anik bahu bhaatee chhodahi katahoo(n) naahee ||
english: Trying all sorts of things, I have grown weary, but still, they will not leave me alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਤਾਕੀ ਓਟਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ek baat sun taakee otaa saadhasa(n)g mit jaahee ||2||
english: But I have heard that they can be rooted out, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; and so I seek their Shelter. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa sa(n)t mile mohi tin te dheeraj paaiaa ||
english: In their Mercy, the Saints have met me, and from them, I have obtained satisfaction.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤੀ ਮੰਤੁ ਦੀਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)tee ma(n)t deeo mohi nirabhau gur kaa sabad kamaaiaa ||3||
english: The Saints have given me the Mantra of the Fearless Lord, and now I practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਤਿ ਲਏ ਓਇ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jeet lae oi mahaa bikhaadee sahaj suhelee baanee ||
english: I have now conquered those terrible evil-doers, and my speech is now sweet and sublime.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak man bhaiaa paragaasaa paaiaa pad nirabaanee ||4||4||125||
english: Says Nanak, the Divine Light has dawned within my mind; I have obtained the state of Nirvaanaa. ||4||4||125||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ohu abinaasee raaiaa ||
english: He is the Eternal King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਬਸਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਡਰਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau sa(n)g tumaarai basate ihu daran kahaa te aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Fearless Lord abides with you. So where does this fear come from? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਹਿ ਅਫਾਰੋ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਨਿਮਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: ek mahal too(n) hohi aphaaro ek mahal nimaano ||
english: In one person, You are arrogant and proud, and in another, You are meek and humble.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਗਰੀਬਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek mahal too(n) aape aape ek mahal gareebaano ||1||
english: In one person, You are all by Yourself, and in another, You are poor. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬਕਤਾ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਖਲੁ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ek mahal too(n) pa(n)dit bakataa ek mahal khal hotaa ||
english: In one person, you are a Pandit, a religious scholar and a preacher, and in another, You are just a fool.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਗ੍ਰਾਹਜੁ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲੇਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ek mahal too(n) sabh kichh graahaj ek mahal kachhoo na letaa ||2||
english: In one person, You grab hold of everything, and in another, You accept nothing. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਖਿਲਾਵਨਹਾਰੋ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: kaath kee putaree kahaa karai bapuree khilaavanahaaro jaanai ||
english: What can the poor wooden puppet do? The Master Puppeteer knows everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਭੇਖੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਸਾਜੁ ਆਨੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaisaa bhekh karaavai baajeegar ohu taiso hee saaj aanai ||3||
english: As the Puppeteer dresses the puppet, so is the role the puppet plays. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: anik kotharee bahut bhaat kareeaa aap hoaa rakhavaaraa ||
english: The Lord has created the various chambers of assorted descriptions, and He Himself protects them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਹਲਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤੈਸੈ ਰਹਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jaise mahal raakhai taisai rahanaa kiaa ihu karai bichaaraa ||4||
english: As is that vessel in which the Lord places the soul, so does it dwell. What can this poor being do? ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
transliteration: jin kichh keeaa soee jaanai jin ih sabh bidh saajee ||
english: The One who created the thing, understands it; He has fashioned all of this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਾਜੀ ॥੫॥੫॥੧੨੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak apara(n)par suaamee keemat apune kaajee ||5||5||126||
english: Says Nanak, the Lord and Master is Infinite; He alone understands the value of His Creation. ||5||5||126||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₃ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee₃ mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਰਸੂਆ ॥
transliteration: chhod chhod re bikhiaa ke rasooaa ||
english: Give them up - give up the pleasures of corruption;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਰੇ ਬਾਵਰ ਗਾਵਰ ਜਿਉ ਕਿਰਖੈ ਹਰਿਆਇਓ ਪਸੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: urajh rahio re baavar gaavar jiu kirakhai hariaaio pasooaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: you are entangled in them, you crazy fool, like an animal grazing in the green fields. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਾਜੈ ਸੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਤਸੂਆ ॥
transliteration: jo jaanahi too(n) apune kaajai so sa(n)g na chaalai terai tasooaa ||
english: That which you believe to be of use to you, shall not go even an inch with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਗੋ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਗ ਸਿਧਾਸੀ ਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਗਰਸੂਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naago aaio naag sidhaasee pher phirio ar kaal garasooaa ||1||
english: Naked you came, and naked you shall depart. You shall go round and round the cycle of birth and death, and you shall be food for Death. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਰੇ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਮਾਚਿ ਤਿਨਹੂੰ ਲਉ ਹਸੂਆ ॥
transliteration: pekh pekh re kasu(n)bh kee leelaa raach maach tinahoo(n) lau hasooaa ||
english: Watching, watching the transitory dramas of the world, you are embroiled and enmeshed in them, and you laugh with delight.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੀਜਤ ਡੋਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਛੂਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chheejat dor dinas ar rainee jee ko kaaj na keeno kachhooaa ||2||
english: The string of life is wearing thin, day and night, and you have done nothing for your soul. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਬਿਰਧਾਨੋ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਉਕਤੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਨਸੂਆ ॥
transliteration: karat karat iv hee biradhaano haario ukate tan kheenasooaa ||
english: Doing your deeds, you have grown old; your voice fails you, and your body has become weak.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਉਨਿ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਬਾਲਾ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੁਚ ਚਸੂਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu mohio un mohanee baalaa us te ghatai naahee ruch chasooaa ||3||
english: You were enticed by Maya in your youth, and your attachment for it has not diminished, one little bit. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਐਸਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਤਜਿ ਗਰਬਸੂਆ ॥
transliteration: jag aisaa mohi gurahi dikhaaio tau saran pario taj garabasooaa ||
english: The Guru has shown me that this is the way of the world; I have abandoned the dwelling of pride, and entered Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਸੰਤਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੂਆ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੨੭॥
transliteration: maarag prabh ko sa(n)t bataaio driRee naanak daas bhagat har jasooaa ||4||6||127||
english: The Saint has shown me the Path of God; slave Nanak has implanted devotional worship and the Praise of the Lord. ||4||6||127||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₄ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee₄ mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin kavan hamaaraa ||
english: Except for You, who is mine?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mere preetam praan adhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O my Beloved, You are the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kee bidh tum hee jaanee tum hee sajan suhele ||
english: You alone know the condition of my inner being. You are my Beautiful Friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa mai tujh te paae mere thaakur agah atole ||1||
english: I receive all comforts from You, O my Unfathomable and Immeasurable Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਰੰਗਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: baran na saakau tumare ra(n)gaa gun nidhaan sukhadaate ||
english: I cannot describe Your Manifestations, O Treasure of Excellence, O Giver of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: agam agochar prabh abinaasee poore gur te jaate ||2||
english: God is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible and Imperishable; He is known through the Perfect Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਜਬ ਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bhram bhau kaat keee nihakeval jab te haumai maaree ||
english: My doubt and fear have been taken away, and I have been made pure, since my ego was conquered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੋ ਚੂਕੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਦਰਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam maran ko chooko sahasaa saadhasa(n)gat darasaaree ||3||
english: My fear of birth and death has been abolished, beholding Your Blessed Vision in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: charan pakhaar karau gur sevaa baar jaau lakh bareeaa ||
english: I wash the Guru's Feet and serve Him; I am a sacrifice to Him, 100,000 times.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਇਹੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਰੀਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੨੮॥
transliteration: jih prasaad ihu bhaujal tariaa jan naanak pri sa(n)g mireeaa ||4||7||128||
english: By His Grace, servant Nanak has crossed over this terrifying world-ocean; I am united with my Beloved. ||4||7||128||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ਤੋਹੀ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin kavan reejhaavai tohee ||
english: Who can please You, except You Yourself?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tero roop sagal dekh mohee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Gazing upon Your Beauteous Form, all are entranced. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਗ ਪਇਆਲ ਮਿਰਤ ਭੂਅ ਮੰਡਲ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਏਕੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
transliteration: surag paiaal mirat bhoo ma(n)dal sarab samaano ekai ohee ||
english: In the heavenly paradise, in the nether regions of the underworld, on the planet earth and throughout the galaxies, the One Lord is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਕਰਤ ਸਗਲ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਮਇਆ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਦੋਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: siv siv karat sagal kar jorahi sarab maiaa thaakur teree dohee ||1||
english: Everyone calls upon You with their palms pressed together, saying, "Shiva, Shiva". O Merciful Lord and Master, everyone cries out for Your Help. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੀਤਲੋਹੀ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan thaakur naam tumaraa sukhadaaee niramal seetalohee ||
english: Your Name, O Lord and Master, is the Purifier of sinners, the Giver of peace, immaculate, cooling and soothing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਿਉ ਗਾਲ ਗਲੋਹੀ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨੯॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan naanak vadiaaee sa(n)t tere siu gaal galohee ||2||8||129||
english: O Nanak, spiritual wisdom, meditation and glorious greatness come from dialogue and discourse with Your Saints. ||2||8||129||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: milahu piaare jeeaa ||
english: Meet with me, O my Dear Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh keeaa tumaaraa theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O God, whatever You do - that alone happens. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anik janam bahu jonee bhramiaa bahur bahur dukh paaiaa ||
english: Wandering around through countless incarnations, I endured pain and suffering in so many lives, over and over again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tumaree kripaa te maanukh deh paaee hai dehu daras har raaiaa ||1||
english: By Your Grace, I obtained this human body; grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Sovereign Lord King. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: soee hoaa jo tis bhaanaa avar na kin hee keetaa ||
english: That which pleases His Will has come to pass; no one else can do anything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tumarai bhaanai bharam mohi mohiaa jaagat naahee sootaa ||2||
english: By Your Will, enticed by the illusion of emotional attachment, the people are asleep; they do not wake up. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: binau sunahu tum praanapat piaare kirapaa nidh daiaalaa ||
english: Please hear my prayer, O Lord of Life, O Beloved, Ocean of mercy and compassion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਾਥਹ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raakh lehu pitaa prabh mere anaathah kar pratipaalaa ||3||
english: Save me, O my Father God. I am an orphan - please, cherish me! ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ॥
transliteration: jis no tumahi dikhaaio darasan saadhasa(n)gat kai paachhai ||
english: You reveal the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, for the sake of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧੂਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਹੁ ਬਾਛੈ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੩੦॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa dhoor dehu sa(n)tan kee sukh naanak ihu baachhai ||4||9||130||
english: Grant Your Grace, and bless us with the dust of the feet of the Saints; Nanak yearns for this peace. ||4||9||130||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: hau taa kai balihaaree ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai keval naam adhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: who take the Support of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਗਨੀਐ ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: mahimaa taa kee ketak ganeeai jan paarabraham ra(n)g raate ||
english: How can I recount the praises of those humble beings who are attuned to the Love of the Supreme Lord God?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਨ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d tinaa sa(n)g un samasar avar na daate ||1||
english: Peace, intuitive poise and bliss are with them. There are no other givers equal to them. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਸੇਈ ਆਏ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jagat udhaaran seee aae jo jan daras piaasaa ||
english: They have come to save the world - those humble beings who thirst for His Blessed Vision.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: un kee saran parai so tariaa sa(n)tasa(n)g pooran aasaa ||2||
english: Those who seek their Sanctuary are carried across; in the Society of the Saints, their hopes are fulfilled. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਚਰਣਿ ਪਰਉ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: taa kai charan parau taa jeevaa jan kai sa(n)g nihaalaa ||
english: If I fall at their Feet, then I live; associating with those humble beings, I remain happy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੋਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhagatan kee ren hoi man meraa hohu prabhoo kirapaalaa ||3||
english: O God, please be merciful to me, that my mind might become the dust of the feet of Your devotees. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਅਵਧ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਘਾਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: raaj joban avadh jo deesai sabh kichh jug mahi ghaatiaa ||
english: Power and authority, youth and age - whatever is seen in this world, all of it shall fade away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੩੧॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan sad navatan niramal ihu naanak har dhan khaatiaa ||4||10||131||
english: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever new and immaculate. Nanak has earned this wealth of the Lord. ||4||10||131||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ॥
transliteration: jog jugat sun aaio gur te ||
english: I came to the Guru, to learn the Way of Yoga.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mo kau satigur sabad bujhaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru has revealed it to me through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: nau kha(n)d prithamee is tan mahi raviaa nimakh nimakh namasakaaraa ||
english: He is contained in the nine continents of the world, and within this body; each and every moment, I humbly bow to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਖਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਨੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਿਓ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: deekhiaa gur kee mu(n)draa kaanee driRio ek nira(n)kaaraa ||1||
english: I have made the Guru's Teachings my ear-rings, and I have enshrined the One Formless Lord within my being. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਚੇਲੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਏ ਇਕਤ੍ਰਾ ਏਕਸੁ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਏ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch chele mil bhae ikatraa ekas kai vas keee ||
english: I have brought the five disciples together, and they are now under the control of the one mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਤਬ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਗੀ ਥੀਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: das bairaagan aagiaakaaree tab niramal jogee theee ||2||
english: When the ten hermits become obedient to the Lord, then I became an immaculate Yogi. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਜਰਾਇ ਚਰਾਈ ਬਿਭੂਤਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੇਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bharam jaraai charaaee bibhootaa pa(n)th ek kar pekhiaa ||
english: I have burnt my doubt, and smeared my body with the ashes. My path is to see the One and Only Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਸੋ ਕੀਨੀ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਜੋ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sahaj sookh so keenee bhugataa jo thaakur masatak lekhiaa ||3||
english: I have made that intuitive peace my food; the Lord Master has written this pre-ordained destiny upon my forehead. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਹਾ ਆਸਨੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਸਿੰਗੀ ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jah bhau naahee tahaa aasan baadhio si(n)gee anahat baanee ||
english: In that place where there is no fear, I have assumed my Yogic posture. The unstruck melody of His Bani is my horn.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਡੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tat beechaar da(n)daa kar raakhio jugat naam man bhaanee ||4||
english: I have made contemplation upon the essential reality my Yogic staff. The Love of the Name in my mind is my Yogic lifestyle. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਭੇਟੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੈ ॥
transliteration: aisaa jogee vadabhaagee bhetai maaiaa ke ba(n)dhan kaatai ||
english: By great good fortune, such a Yogi is met, who cuts away the bonds of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਗ ਚਾਟੈ ॥੫॥੧੧॥੧੩੨॥
transliteration: sevaa pooj karau tis moorat kee naanak tis pag chaatai ||5||11||132||
english: Nanak serves and adores this wondrous person, and kisses his feet. ||5||11||132||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨੂਪ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਧਿਆਇਲੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: anoop padaarath naam sunahu sagal dhiaaile meetaa ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is an incomparably beautiful treasure. Listen, everyone, and meditate on it, O friends.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har aukhadh jaa kau gur deeaa taa ke niramal cheetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those, unto whom the Guru has given the Lord's medicine - their minds become pure and immaculate. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhakaar mitio tih tan te gur sabad deepak paragaasaa ||
english: Darkness is dispelled from within that body, in which the Divine Light of the Guru's Shabad shines.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਜਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhram kee jaalee taa kee kaatee jaa kau saadhasa(n)gat bisvaasaa ||1||
english: The noose of doubt is cut away from those who place their faith in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਰੀਲੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੂ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: taareele bhavajal taaroo bikhaRaa bohith saadhoo sa(n)gaa ||
english: The treacherous and terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, in the boat of the Saadh Sangat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pooran hoee man kee aasaa gur bhetio har ra(n)gaa ||2||
english: My mind's desires are fulfilled, meeting the Guru, in love with the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naam khajaanaa bhagatee paaiaa man tan tripat aghaae ||
english: The devotees have found the treasure of the Naam; their minds and bodies are satisfied and satiated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੩॥੧੨॥੧੩੩॥
transliteration: naanak har jeeu taa kau devai jaa kau hukam manaae ||3||12||133||
english: O Nanak, the Dear Lord gives it only to those who surrender to the Lord's Command. ||3||12||133||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₅ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee₅ mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਮੋਰੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: daiaa maiaa kar praanapat more mohi anaath saran prabh toree ||
english: Please be kind and compassionate, O Lord of my life; I am helpless, and I seek Your Sanctuary, God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop mahi haath de raakhahu kachhoo siaanap ukat na moree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please, give me Your Hand, and lift me up, out of the deep dark pit. I have no clever tricks at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨ ਹੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan sabh kichh tum hee tum samarath naahee an horee ||
english: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes - You are everything. You are All-powerful; there is no other than You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਸੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਜਿਨ ਭਾਗ ਮਥੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tumaree gat mit tum hee jaanee se sevak jin bhaag mathoree ||1||
english: You alone know Your condition and extent. They alone become Your servants, upon whose foreheads such good destiny is recorded. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਤੇ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: apune sevak sa(n)g tum prabh raate ot pot bhagatan sa(n)g joree ||
english: You are imbued with Your servant, God; Your devotees are woven into Your Fabric, through and through.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਚਾਹੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਓਹ ਚੰਦ ਚਕੋਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: priu priu naam teraa darasan chaahai jaise drisat oh cha(n)d chakoree ||2||
english: O Darling Beloved, they yearn for Your Name and the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, like the chakvee bird which longs to see the moon. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਸੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਕਈ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: raam sa(n)t mahi bhed kichh naahee ek jan kaee mahi laakh karoree ||
english: Between the Lord and His Saint, there is no difference at all. Among hundreds of thousands and millions, there is scarcely one humble being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਰਸਨ ਰਮੋਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kai heeai pragat prabh hoaa anadin keeratan rasan ramoree ||3||
english: Those whose hearts are illuminated by God, sing the Kirtan of His Praises night and day with their tongues. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਤਿ ਊਚੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tum samarath apaar at ooche sukhadaate prabh praan adhoree ||
english: You are All-powerful and Infinite, the most lofty and exalted, the Giver of peace; O God, You are the Support of the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਉਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗੋਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੩੪॥
transliteration: naanak kau prabh keejai kirapaa un sa(n)tan kai sa(n)g sa(n)goree ||4||13||134||
english: Please show mercy to Nanak, O God, that he may remain in the Society of the Saints. ||4||13||134||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥
transliteration: tum har setee raate sa(n)tahu ||
english: O Saint, You are attuned to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਓੜਿ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਹੁ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nibaahi lehu mo kau purakh bidhaate oR pahuchaavahu daate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please stand my me, Architect of Destiny; please take me to my destination, Great Giver. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਤੁਮਾ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: tumaraa maram tumaa hee jaaniaa tum pooran purakh bidhaate ||
english: You alone know Your mystery; You are the Perfect Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਦੀਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raakhahu saran anaath deen kau karahu hamaaree gaate ||1||
english: I am a helpless orphan - please keep me under Your Protection and save me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਰਣ ਸਾਗਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਭਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: taran saagar bohith charan tumaare tum jaanahu apunee bhaate ||
english: Your Feet are the boat to carry us across the world-ocean; You alone know Your ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis raakhahu sa(n)ge te te paar paraate ||2||
english: Those whom You keep protected, by Your Kindness, cross over to the other side. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਹਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: eet oot prabh tum samarathaa sabh kichh tumarai haathe ||
english: Here and hereafter, God, You are All-powerful; everything is in Your Hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਚਲੈ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aisaa nidhaan dehu mo kau har jan chalai hamaarai saathe ||3||
english: Please give me that treasure, which will go along with me, O servant of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: niraguneeaare kau gun keejai har naam meraa man jaape ||
english: I am without virtue - please bless me with virtue, so that my mind might chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੩੫॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad naanak har bhete man tan seetal dhraape ||4||14||135||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, Nanak has met the Lord; his mind and body are soothed and satisfied. ||4||14||135||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sahaj samaaio dev ||
english: I am intuitively absorbed in the Divine Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mo kau satigur bhae daiaal dev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Divine True Guru has become Merciful to me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਕੀਓ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਤਨ ਟਹਲਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kaat jevaree keeo daasaro sa(n)tan tahalaaio ||
english: Cutting away the halter, He has made me His slave, and now I work for the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਥੀਓ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek naam ko theeo poojaaree mo kau acharaj gurahi dikhaaio ||1||
english: I have become a worshipper of the One Name; the Guru has shown me this amazing wonder. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: bhaio pragaas sarab ujeeaaraa gur giaan manahi pragataaio ||
english: The Divine Light has dawned, and everything is illuminated; the Guru has revealed this spiritual wisdom to my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਓ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਅਨਭੈ ਠਹਰਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam peeo man tripatiaa anabhai thaharaaio ||2||
english: Drinking deeply of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, my mind is satisfied, and my fears have been vanquished. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਦੂਖਹ ਠਾਉ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: maan aagiaa sarab sukh paae dookhah thaau gavaaio ||
english: Accepting the Command of the Lord's Will, I have found total peace; the home of suffering has been destroyed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਭੁ ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jau suprasa(n)n bhae prabh thaakur sabh aanad roop dikhaaio ||3||
english: When God, our Lord and Master was totally pleased, He revealed everything in the form of ecstasy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਵਤ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਵਤ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: naa kichh aavat naa kichh jaavat sabh khel keeo har raaio ||
english: Nothing comes, and nothing goes; this play is all set in motion by the Lord, the Sovereign King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਗਤ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੩੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak agam agam hai thaakur bhagat tek har naaio ||4||15||136||
english: Says Nanak, our Lord and Master is inaccessible and unfathomable. The Lord's devotees take His Name as their Support. ||4||15||136||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee₆ mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham pooran paramesur man taa kee ot gaheejai re ||
english: He is the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Transcendent Lord; O my mind, hold tight to the Support of the One

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin dhaare brahama(n)d kha(n)d har taa ko naam japeejai re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: who established the solar systems and galaxies. Chant the Name of that Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man kee mat tiaagahu har jan hukam boojh sukh paaeeai re ||
english: Renounce the intellectual cleverness of your mind, O humble servants of the Lord; understanding the Hukam of His Command, peace is found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਓਹੀ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo prabh karai soee bhal maanahu sukh dukh ohee dhiaaeeai re ||1||
english: Whatever God does, accept that with pleasure; in comfort and in suffering, meditate on Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kot patit udhaare khin mahi karate baar na laagai re ||
english: The Creator emancipates millions of sinners in an instant, without a moment's delay.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: deen darad dukh bha(n)jan suaamee jis bhaavai tisahi nivaajai re ||2||
english: The Lord, the Destroyer of the pain and sorrow of the poor, blesses those with whom He is pleased. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੋ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko maat pitaa pratipaalak jee praan sukh saagar re ||
english: He is Mother and Father, the Cherisher of all; He is the Breath of life of all beings, the Ocean of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਂਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: de(n)de tot naahee tis karate poor rahio ratanaagar re ||3||
english: While giving so generously, the Creator does not diminish at all. The Source of jewels, He is All-pervading. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaachik jaachai naam teraa suaamee ghat ghat a(n)tar soee re ||
english: The beggar begs for Your Name, O Lord and Master; God is contained deep within the nucleus of each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੧੩੭॥
transliteration: naanak daas taa kee saranaaee jaa te brithaa na koee re ||4||16||137||
english: Slave Nanak has entered His Sanctuary; no one returns from Him empty-handed. ||4||16||137||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ₁ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee₁ poorabee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har kabahoo na manahu bisaare ||
english: Never forget the Lord, Har, Har, from your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: eehaa oohaa sarab sukhadaataa sagal ghataa pratipaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Here and hereafter, He is the Giver of all peace. He is the Cherisher of all hearts. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਕਸਟ ਕਾਟੈ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mahaa kasat kaatai khin bheetar rasanaa naam chitaare ||
english: He removes the most terrible pains in an instant, if the tongue repeats His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਜਲਤੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: seetal saa(n)t sookh har saranee jalatee agan nivaare ||1||
english: In the Lord's Sanctuary there is soothing coolness, peace and tranquility. He has extinguished the burning fire. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਡ ਨਰਕ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: garabh ku(n)d narak te raakhai bhavajal paar utaare ||
english: He saves us from the hellish pit of the womb, and carries us across the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਰਾਧਤ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: charan kamal aaraadhat man mahi jam kee traas bidaare ||2||
english: Adoring His Lotus Feet in the mind, the fear of death is banished. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: pooran paarabraham paramesur oochaa agam apaare ||
english: He is the Perfect, Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, lofty, unfathomable and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਧਿਆਵਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਜੂਏ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gun gaavat dhiaavat sukh saagar jooe janam na haare ||3||
english: Singing His Glorious Praises, and meditating on the Ocean of peace, one's life is not lost in the gamble. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨੋ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohi man leeno niragun ke daataare ||
english: My mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, O Giver to the unworthy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩੮॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apuno naam deejai naanak sad balihaare ||4||1||138||
english: Please grant Your Grace, and bless me with Your Name; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||138||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ₁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee chetee₁ mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Gauree Chaytee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sukh naahee re har bhagat binaa ||
english: There is no peace without devotional worship of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਤਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਇਹੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਇਕ ਖਿਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jeet janam ihu ratan amolak saadhasa(n)gat jap ik khinaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Be victorious, and win the priceless jewel of this human life, by meditating on Him in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ॥
transliteration: sut sa(n)pat banitaa binod ||
english: Many have renounced and left their children,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਗਏ ਬਹੁ ਲੋਗ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chhod gae bahu log bhog ||1||
english: Wealth, spouses, joyful games and pleasures. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਰਾਜ ਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: haivar gaivar raaj ra(n)g ||
english: Horses, elephants and the pleasures of power

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਹੈ ਮੂੜ ਨੰਗ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tiaag chalio hai mooR na(n)g ||2||
english: - leaving these behind, the fool must depart naked. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਦੇਹ ਫੂਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: choaa cha(n)dan deh phooliaa ||
english: The body, scented with musk and sandalwood

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਧਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੂਲਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so tan dhar sa(n)g rooliaa ||3||
english: - that body shall come to roll in the dust. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜਾਨੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: mohi mohiaa jaanai door hai ||
english: Infatuated with emotional attachment, they think that God is far away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sadaa hadoor hai ||4||1||139||
english: Says Nanak, he is Ever-present! ||4||1||139||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਧਰ ਤਰਬੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨੋ ॥
transliteration: man dhar tarabe har naam no ||
english: O mind, cross over with the Support of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਸੰਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਰ ਗਰਾਮਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saagar lahar sa(n)saa sa(n)saar gur bohith paar garaamano ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru is the boat to carry you across the world-ocean, through the waves of cynicism and doubt. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲਖ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kal kaalakh a(n)dhiaareeaa ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there is only pitch darkness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਦੀਪਕ ਉਜਿਆਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur giaan deepak ujiaareeaa ||1||
english: The lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom illuminates and enlightens. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪਸਰੀ ਅਤਿ ਘਨੀ ॥
transliteration: bikh bikhiaa pasaree at ghanee ||
english: The poison of corruption is spread out far and wide.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ubare jap jap har gunee ||2||
english: Only the virtuous are saved, chanting and meditating on the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: matavaaro maaiaa soiaa ||
english: Intoxicated with Maya, the people are asleep.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur bhetat bhram bhau khoiaa ||3||
english: Meeting the Guru, doubt and fear are dispelled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ek dhiaaiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, meditate on the One Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪੦॥
transliteration: ghat ghat nadaree aaiaa ||4||2||140||
english: behold Him in each and every heart. ||4||2||140||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਤੁਹੀ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: deebaan hamaaro tuhee ek ||
english: You alone are my Chief Advisor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਟੇਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sevaa thaaree gurahi tek ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I serve You with the Support of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anik jugat nahee paaiaa ||
english: By various devices, I could not find You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਚਾਕਰ ਲੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur chaakar lai laaiaa ||1||
english: Taking hold of me, the Guru has made me Your slave. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੇ ਪੰਚ ਬਿਖਾਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: maare pa(n)ch bikhaadeeaa ||
english: I have conquered the five tyrants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਦਲੁ ਸਾਧਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te dal saadhiaa ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have vanquished the army of evil. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਖਸੀਸ ਵਜਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bakhasees vajahu mil ek naam ||
english: I have received the One Name as His bounty and blessing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d bisraam ||3||
english: Now, I dwell in peace, poise and bliss. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh ke chaakar se bhale ||
english: The slaves of God are good.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪੧॥
transliteration: naanak tin mukh oojale ||4||3||141||
english: O Nanak, their faces are radiant. ||4||3||141||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਰੇ ਓਲੑਾ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: jeeare olhaa naam kaa ||
english: Hey, soul: your only Support is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਜਿ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨੋ ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਉ ਹੈ ਜਾਮ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avar j karan karaavano tin mahi bhau hai jaam kaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever else you do or make happen, the fear of death still hangs over you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਜਤਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: avar jatan nahee paaeeai ||
english: He is not obtained by any other efforts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag har dhiaaeeai ||1||
english: By great good fortune, meditate on the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਹਿਕਮਤੀ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
transliteration: laakh hikamatee jaaneeai ||
english: You may know hundreds of thousands of clever tricks,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aagai til nahee maaneeai ||2||
english: but not even one will be of any use at all hereafter. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਨੇ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)budh karam kamaavane ||
english: Good deeds done in the pride of ego are swept away,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਾਲੂ ਨੀਰਿ ਬਹਾਵਨੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: grih baaloo neer bahaavane ||3||
english: Like the house of sand by water. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kripaal kirapaa karai ||
english: When God the Merciful shows His Mercy,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naam naanak saadhoo sa(n)g milai ||4||4||142||
english: Nanak receives the Naam in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||4||4||142||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਨੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਨੈ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: baaranai balihaaranai lakh bareeaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, dedicated hundreds of thousands of times, to my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਹੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naamo ho naam saahib ko praan adhareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: His Name, and His Name alone, is the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਤੁਹੀ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan tuhee ek ||
english: You alone are the Doer, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੀ ਤੁਹੀ ਟੇਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t kee tuhee tek ||1||
english: You are the Support of all beings and creatures. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂੰ ਧਨੀ ॥
transliteration: raaj joban prabh too(n) dhanee ||
english: O God, You are my power, authority and youth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਤੂੰ ਸਰਗੁਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too(n) niragun too(n) saragunee ||2||
english: You are absolute, without attributes, and also related, with the most sublime attributes. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਤੁਮ ਰਖੇ ॥
transliteration: eehaa oohaa tum rakhe ||
english: Here and hereafter, You are my Savior and Protector.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਕੋ ਲਖੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te ko lakhe ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, some understand You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee prabh sujaan ||
english: God is All-knowing, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਕੀਆ ਤੁਹੀ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੪੩॥
transliteration: naanak takeeaa tuhee taan ||4||5||143||
english: You are Nanak's strength and support. ||4||5||143||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har har har aaraadheeai ||
english: Worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਉ ਸਾਧੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g har man vasai bharam mohu bhau saadheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, He dwells in the mind; doubt, emotional attachment and fear are vanquished. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਨੇ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan simrit bhane ||
english: The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees are heard to proclaim

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਊਚ ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਜਨ ਸੁਨੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh ooch biraajit jan sune ||1||
english: that the Lord's servant dwells as the highest of all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਭੈ ਭੀਤ ਚੀਨ ॥
transliteration: sagal asathaan bhai bheet cheen ||
english: All places are filled with fear - know this well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਸੇਵਕ ਭੈ ਰਹਤ ਕੀਨ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam sevak bhai rahat keen ||2||
english: Only the Lord's servants are free of fear. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੋਨਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jon phirahi ||
english: People wander through 8.4 million incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਲੋਕ ਨਹੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d lok nahee janam marahi ||3||
english: God's people are not subject to birth and death. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਹਉਮੈ ਰਹੀ ॥
transliteration: bal budh siaanap haumai rahee ||
english: He has given up power, wisdom, cleverness and egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਹੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੪੪॥
transliteration: har saadh saran naanak gahee ||4||6||144||
english: Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy Saints. ||4||6||144||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: man raam naam gun gaaeeai ||
english: O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: neet neet har seveeai saas saas har dhiaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Serve the Lord continually and continuously; with each and every breath, meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g har man vasai ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, the Lord dwells in the mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਅਨੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dukh darad aneraa bhram nasai ||1||
english: and pain, suffering, darkness and doubt depart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad har jaapeeai ||
english: That humble being, who meditates on the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਦੂਖਿ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੀਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so jan dookh na viaapeeai ||2||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, is not afflicted with pain. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau gur har ma(n)tr de ||
english: Those unto whom the Guru gives the Mantra of the Lord's Name,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਉਬਰਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so ubariaa maaiaa agan te ||3||
english: are saved from the fire of Maya. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak kau prabh maiaa kar ||
english: Be kind to Nanak, O God;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਾਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੪੫॥
transliteration: merai man tan vaasai naam har ||4||7||145||
english: let the Lord's Name dwell within my mind and body. ||4||7||145||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa japeeai ek naam ||
english: With your tongue, chant the Name of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਘਨਾ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: eehaa sukh aana(n)d ghanaa aagai jee kai sa(n)g kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In this world, it shall bring you peace, comfort and great joy; hereafter, it shall go with your soul, and shall be of use to you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਟੀਐ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਹੰ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kateeai teraa aha(n) rog ||
english: The disease of your ego shall be eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too(n) gur prasaad kar raaj jog ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har ras jin jan chaakhiaa ||
english: Those who taste the sublime essence of the Lord

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਥੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa kee trisanaa laatheeaa ||2||
english: have their thirst quenched. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har bisraam nidh paaiaa ||
english: Those who have found the Lord, the Treasure of peace,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਧਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so bahur na kat hee dhaaiaa ||3||
english: shall not go anywhere else again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har har naam jaa kau gur deeaa ||
english: Those, unto whom the Guru has given the Lord's Name, Har, Har

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੪੬॥
transliteration: naanak taa kaa bhau gaiaa ||4||8||146||
