english: - O Nanak, their fears are removed. ||4||8||146||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee₂ mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਤਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਪੀਰ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau bisarai raam naam taahoo kau peer ||
english: One who forgets the Lord's Name, suffers in pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat mil har ravahi se gunee gaheer ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and dwell upon the Lord, find the Ocean of virtue. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau guramukh ridai budh ||
english: Those Gurmukhs whose hearts are filled with wisdom,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa kai kar tal nav nidh sidh ||1||
english: hold the nine treasures, and the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas in the palms of their hands. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jo jaanahi har prabh dhanee ||
english: Those who know the Lord God as their Master,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਮੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kichh naahee taa kai kamee ||2||
english: do not lack anything. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: karanaihaar pachhaaniaa ||
english: Those who realize the Creator Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sarab sookh ra(n)g maaniaa ||3||
english: enjoy all peace and pleasure. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
transliteration: har dhan jaa kai grihi vasai ||
english: Those whose inner homes are filled with the Lord's wealth

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਸੈ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੪੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tin sa(n)g dukh nasai ||4||9||147||
english: - says Nanak, in their company, pain departs. ||4||9||147||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬੁ ਬਡੋ ਮੂਲੁ ਇਤਨੋ ॥
transliteration: garab bado mool itano ||
english: Your pride is so great, but what about your origins?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਗਹੁ ਕਿਤਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rahan nahee gahu kitano ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You cannot remain, no matter how much you try to hold on. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਬਰਜਤ ਬੇਦ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਉਆਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਰੇ ਹਿਤਨੋ ॥
transliteration: bebarajat bed sa(n)tanaa uaahoo siu re hitano ||
english: That which is forbidden by the Vedas and the Saints - with that, you are in love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਰ ਜੂਆਰ ਜੂਆ ਬਿਧੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਲੈ ਜਿਤਨੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haar jooaar jooaa bidhe i(n)dree vas lai jitano ||1||
english: Like the gambler losing the game of chance, you are held in the power of sensory desires. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਨ ਭਰਨ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਾ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਿਤਨੋ ॥
transliteration: haran bharan sa(n)pooranaa charan kamal ra(n)g ritano ||
english: The One who is All-powerful to empty out and fill up - you have no love for His Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੈ ਦਿਤਨੋ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੪੮॥
transliteration: naanak udhare saadhasa(n)g kirapaa nidh mai ditano ||2||10||148||
english: O Nanak, I have been saved, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. I have been blessed by the Treasure of Mercy. ||2||10||148||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₃ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee₃ mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੋ ॥
transliteration: mohi daasaro thaakur ko ||
english: I am the slave of my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਖਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhaan prabh kaa khaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I eat whatever God gives me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aiso hai re khasam hamaaraa ||
english: Such is my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khin mahi saaj savaaranahaaraa ||1||
english: In an instant, He creates and embellishes. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam karee je thaakur bhaavaa ||
english: I do that work which pleases my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੀਤ ਚਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: geet charit prabh ke gun gaavaa ||2||
english: I sing the songs of God's glory, and His wondrous play. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਵਜੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saran pario thaakur vajeeraa ||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord's Prime Minister;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tinaa dekh meraa man dheeraa ||3||
english: beholding Him, my mind is comforted and consoled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕੋ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ek tek eko aadhaaraa ||
english: The One Lord is my support, the One is my steady anchor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਕਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੪੯॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kee laagaa kaaraa ||4||11||149||
english: Servant Nanak is engaged in the Lord's work. ||4||11||149||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੋਰੈ ॥
transliteration: hai koee aisaa haumai torai ||
english: Is there anyone, who can shatter his ego,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮੀਠੀ ਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: is meethee te ihu man horai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and turn his mind away from this sweet Maya? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੋ ਲੋਰੈ ॥
transliteration: agiaanee maanukh bhaiaa jo naahee so lorai ||
english: Humanity is in spiritual ignorance; people see things that do not exist.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਕਾਰੀਆ ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rain a(n)dhaaree kaareeaa kavan jugat jit bhorai ||1||
english: The night is dark and gloomy; how will the morning dawn? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਤੋ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੋ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧੀ ਕਰਿ ਟੋਰੈ ॥
transliteration: bhramato bhramato haariaa anik bidhee kar torai ||
english: Wandering, wandering all around, I have grown weary; trying all sorts of things, I have been searching.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੋਰੈ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੧੫੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak kirapaa bhaee saadhasa(n)gat nidh morai ||2||12||150||
english: Says Nanak, He has shown mercy to me; I have found the treasure of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||12||150||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chi(n)taaman karunaa mae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Wish-fulfilling Jewel, the Embodiment of Mercy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: deen daiaalaa paarabraham || jaa kai simaran sukh bhae ||1||
english: The Supreme Lord God is Merciful to the meek; Meditating in remembrance on Him, peace is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ॥ ਸੁਨਤ ਜਸੋ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਖਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: akaal purakh agaadh bodh || sunat jaso kot agh khae ||2||
english: The Wisdom of the Undying Primal Being is beyond comprehension. Hearing His Praises, millions of sins are erased. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਏ ॥੩॥੧੩॥੧੫੧॥
transliteration: kirapaa nidh prabh maiaa dhaar || naanak har har naam lae ||3||13||151||
english: O God, Treasure of Mercy, please bless Nanak with Your kindness, that he may repeat the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||13||151||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ₄ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee₄ mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mere man saran prabhoo sukh paae ||
english: O my mind, in the Sanctuary of God, peace is found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਦਿਨਿ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਤ ਅਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa din bisarai praan sukhadaataa so din jaat ajaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: That day, when the Giver of life and peace is forgotten - that day passes uselessly. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਰੈਣ ਕੇ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਆਏ ਬਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਆਸ ਬਧਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ek rain ke paahun tum aae bahu jug aas badhaae ||
english: You have come as a guest for one short night, and yet you hope to live for many ages.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੰਪੈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: grih ma(n)dar sa(n)pai jo deesai jiu taravar kee chhaae ||1||
english: Households, mansions and wealth - whatever is seen, is like the shade of a tree. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੰਪੈ ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਗ ਮਿਲਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tan meraa sa(n)pai sabh meree baag milakh sabh jaae ||
english: My body, wealth, and all my gardens and property shall all pass away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰਾ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤ ਪਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: devanahaaraa bisario thaakur khin mahi hot paraae ||2||
english: You have forgotten your Lord and Master, the Great Giver. In an instant, these shall belong to somebody else. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰੈ ਬਾਗਾ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pahirai baagaa kar isanaanaa choaa cha(n)dan laae ||
english: You wear white clothes and take cleansing baths, and anoint yourself with sandalwood oil.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਹਸਤੀ ਨਾਵਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nirabhau nira(n)kaar nahee cheeniaa jiu hasatee naavaae ||3||
english: But you do not remember the Fearless, Formless Lord - you are like an elephant bathing in the mud. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jau hoi kripaal ta satigur melai sabh sukh har ke naae ||
english: When God becomes merciful, He leads you to meet the True Guru; all peace is in the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੫੨॥
transliteration: mukat bhaiaa ba(n)dhan gur khole jan naanak har gun gaae ||4||14||152||
english: The Guru has liberated me from bondage; servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||14||152||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਦ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: mere man gur gur gur sad kareeai ||
english: O my mind, dwell always upon the Guru, Guru, Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ratan janam saphal gur keeaa darasan kau balihareeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru has made the jewel of this human life prosperous and fruitful. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਨੁ ਲੇਤਾ ਤੇਤੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jete saas graas man letaa tete hee gun gaaeeai ||
english: As many breaths and morsels as you take, O my mind - so many times, sing His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਹੋਇ ਦੈਆਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਤਾ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jau hoi daiaal satigur apunaa taa ih mat budh paaeeai ||1||
english: When the True Guru becomes merciful, then this wisdom and understanding is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਏ ਜਮ ਬੰਧ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: mere man naam lae jam ba(n)dh te chhootahi sarab sukhaa sukh paaeeai ||
english: O my mind, taking the Naam, you shall be released from the bondage of death, and the peace of all peace will be found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨ ਬੰਛਤ ਫਲ ਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sev suaamee satigur daataa man ba(n)chhat phal aaeeai ||2||
english: Serving your Lord and Master, the True Guru, the Great Giver, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸਟੁ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਮਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: naam isat meet sut karataa man sa(n)g tuhaarai chaalai ||
english: The Name of the Creator is your beloved friend and child; it alone shall go along with you, O my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਲੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kar sevaa satigur apune kee gur te paaeeai paalai ||3||
english: So serve your True Guru, and you shall receive the Name from the Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਰਬ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaal kripaa prabh dhaaree binase sarab a(n)desaa ||
english: When God, the Merciful Guru, showered His Mercy upon me, all my anxieties were dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸਾ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੫੩॥
transliteration: naanak sukh paaiaa har keeratan mitio sagal kalesaa ||4||15||153||
english: Nanak has found the peace of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. All his sorrows have been dispelled. ||4||15||153||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa birale hee kee bujhee he ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The thirst of only a few is quenched. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਰੇ ਲਾਖ ਕ੍ਰੋਰੇ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੇ ॥ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਲੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kot jore laakh krore man na hore || parai parai hee kau lujhee he ||1||
english: People may accumulate hundreds of thousands, millions, tens of millions, and yet the mind is not restrained. They only yearn for more and more. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਰਕਾਰੀ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ॥ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: su(n)dar naaree anik parakaaree par grih bikaaree || buraa bhalaa nahee sujhee he ||2||
english: They may have all sorts of beautiful women, but still, they commit adultery in the homes of others. They do not distinguish between good and bad. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਤੁ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਇਆ ॥ ਮਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਲੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anik ba(n)dhan maaiaa bharamat bharamaaiaa gun nidh nahee gaaiaa || man bikhai hee mahi lujhee he ||3||
english: They wander around lost, trapped in the myriad bonds of Maya; they do not sing the Praises of the Treasure of Virtue. Their minds are engrossed in poison and corruption. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ਜੀਵਤ ਸੋਈ ਮਰੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਰੈ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੪॥
transliteration: jaa kau re kirapaa karai jeevat soee marai saadhasa(n)g maaiaa tarai || naanak so jan dar har sijhee he ||4||1||154||
english: Those, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, remain dead while yet alive. In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they cross over the ocean of Maya. O Nanak, those humble beings are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||4||1||154||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਹੂ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabhahoo ko ras har ho ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord is the essence of all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਜੋਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਭੋਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਧਿਆਨ ॥ ਕਾਹੂ ਹੋ ਡੰਡ ਧਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaahoo jog kaahoo bhog kaahoo giaan kaahoo dhiaan || kaahoo ho da(n)d dhar ho ||1||
english: Some practice Yoga, some indulge in pleasures; some live in spiritual wisdom, some live in meditation. Some are bearers of the staff. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਤਾਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਮ ਨੇਮ ॥ ਕਾਹੂ ਹੋ ਗਉਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaahoo jaap kaahoo taap kaahoo poojaa hom nem || kaahoo ho gaun kar ho ||2||
english: Some chant in meditation, some practice deep, austere meditation; some worship Him in adoration, some practice daily rituals. Some live the life of a wanderer. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਤੀਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਨੀਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਹੋ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੫੫॥
transliteration: kaahoo teer kaahoo neer kaahoo bed beechaar || naanakaa bhagat pri ho ||3||2||155||
english: Some live by the shore, some live on the water; some study the Vedas. Nanak loves to worship the Lord. ||3||2||155||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gun keerat nidh moree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: To sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is my treasure. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰਹੀ ਰਸ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਜਸ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਰੂਪ ਤੂਹੀ ਰੰਗ ॥ ਆਸ ਓਟ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too(n)hee ras too(n)hee jas too(n)hee roop toohee ra(n)g || aas ot prabh toree ||1||
english: You are my delight, You are my praise. You are my beauty, You are my love. O God, You are my hope and support. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂਹੀ ਮਾਨ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਧਾਨ ਤੂਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਤੂਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥ ਗੁਰਿ ਤੂਟੀ ਲੈ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: toohee maan too(n)hee dhaan toohee pat toohee praan || gur tootee lai joree ||2||
english: You are my pride, You are my wealth. You are my honor, You are my breath of life. The Guru has repaired that which was broken. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਤੂਹੀ ਬਨਿ ਤੂਹੀ ਗਾਉ ਤੂਹੀ ਸੁਨਿ ॥ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੇਰ ਨੇਰੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੧੫੬॥
transliteration: toohee grihi toohee ban toohee gaau toohee sun || hai naanak ner neree ||3||3||156||
english: You are in the household, and You are in the forest. You are in the village, and You are in the wilderness. Nanak: You are near, so very near! ||3||3||156||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਤੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maato har ra(n)g maato ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am intoxicated, intoxicated with the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓੁਹੀ ਪੀਓ ਓੁਹੀ ਖੀਓ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦੀਓ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਓ ॥ ਉਆਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ouhee peeo ouhee kheeo gurahi deeo daan keeo || uaahoo siu man raato ||1||
english: I drink it in - I am drunk with it. The Guru has given it to me in charity. My mind is drenched with it. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓੁਹੀ ਭਾਠੀ ਓੁਹੀ ਪੋਚਾ ਉਹੀ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਉਹੀ ਰੂਚਾ ॥ ਮਨਿ ਓਹੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਤੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ouhee bhaathee ouhee pochaa uhee piaaro uhee roochaa || man oho sukh jaato ||2||
english: It is my furnace, it is the cooling plaster. It is my love, it is my longing. My mind knows it as peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਕੇਲ ਅਨਦ ਖੇਲ ਰਹੇ ਫੇਰ ਭਏ ਮੇਲ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰਾਤੋ ॥੩॥੪॥੧੫੭॥
transliteration: sahaj kel anad khel rahe pher bhae mel || naanak gur sabad paraato ||3||4||157||
english: I enjoy intuitive peace, and I play in bliss; the cycle of reincarnation is ended for me, and I am merged with the Lord. Nanak is pierced through with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||4||157||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੌੜੀ ਮਾਲਵਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee maalavaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Gauree Maalwaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਗੈ ਬਿਖਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਭੈਆਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har naam lehu meetaa lehu aagai bikham pa(n)th bhaiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chant the Lord's Name; O my friend, chant it. Hereafter, the path is terrifying and treacherous. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਤ ਸੇਵਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: sevat sevat sadaa sev terai sa(n)g basat hai kaal ||
english: Serve, serve, forever serve the Lord. Death hangs over your head.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਹੋ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar sevaa too(n) saadh kee ho kaateeai jam jaal ||1||
english: Do seva, selfless service, for the Holy Saints, and the noose of Death shall be cut away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੀਏ ਬਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਧੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hom jag teerath keee bich haumai badhe bikaar ||
english: You may make burnt offerings, sacrificial feasts and pilgrimages to sacred shrines in egotism, but your corruption only increases.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕੁ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਦੁਇ ਭੁੰਚਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: narak surag dui bhu(n)chanaa hoi bahur bahur avataar ||2||
english: You are subject to both heaven and hell, and you are reincarnated over and over again. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਪੁਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪੁਰੀ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: siv puree braham i(n)dr puree nihachal ko thaau naahi ||
english: The realm of Shiva, the realms of Brahma and Indra as well - no place anywhere is permanent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਹੋ ਸਾਕਤ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin har sevaa sukh nahee ho saakat aavahi jaahi ||3||
english: Without serving the Lord, there is no peace at all. The faithless cynic comes and goes in reincarnation. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਮੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਕਹਿਆ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jaiso gur upadesiaa mai taiso kahiaa pukaar ||
english: As the Guru has taught me, so have I spoken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੮॥
transliteration: naanak kahai sun re manaa kar keeratan hoi udhaar ||4||1||158||
english: Says Nanak, listen, people: sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and you shall be saved. ||4||1||158||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ₁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee maalaa₁ mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਓ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: paaio baal budh sukh re ||
english: Adopting the innocent mind of a child, I have found peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਹਾਨਿ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਦੂਖ ਸੁਖ ਚਿਤਿ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: harakh sog haan mirat dookh sukh chit samasar gur mile ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Joy and sorrow, profit and loss, birth and death, pain and pleasure - they are all the same to my consciousness, since I met the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋਚਉ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਦੁਖਨੁ ਭਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jau lau hau kichh sochau chitavau tau lau dukhan bhare ||
english: As long as I plotted and planned things, I was full of frustration.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਉ ਆਨਦ ਸਹਜੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jau kripaal gur pooraa bhetiaa tau aanad sahaje ||1||
english: When I met the Kind, Perfect Guru, then I obtained bliss so easily. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਰਮ ਹਉ ਕੀਏ ਤੇਤੇ ਬੰਧ ਪਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jetee siaanap karam hau keee tete ba(n)dh pare ||
english: The more clever tricks I tried, the more bonds I was saddled with.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਤਬ ਹਮ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jau saadhoo kar masatak dhario tab ham mukat bhae ||2||
english: When the Holy Saint placed His Hand upon my forehead, then I was liberated. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਮੇਰੋ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਰਤੋ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਘੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jau lau mero mero karato tau lau bikh ghere ||
english: As long as I claimed, "Mine, mine!", I was surrounded by wickedness and corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਰਪੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਤਬ ਹਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man tan budh arapee thaakur kau tab ham sahaj soe ||3||
english: But when I dedicated my mind, body and intellect to my Lord and Master, then I began to sleep in peace. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਪੋਟ ਉਠਾਈ ਚਲਿਅਉ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਡਾਨ ਭਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jau lau pot uthaaee chaliau tau lau daan bhare ||
english: As long as I walked along, carrying the load, I continued to pay the fine.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੋਟ ਡਾਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੯॥
transliteration: pot daar gur pooraa miliaa tau naanak nirabhae ||4||1||159||
english: But I threw away that bundle, when I met the Perfect Guru; O Nanak, then I became fearless. ||4||1||159||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee maalaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਵਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ਰੀ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ॥
transliteration: bhaavan tiaagio ree tiaagio ||
english: I have renounced my desires; I have renounced them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ॥
transliteration: tiaagio mai gur mil tiaagio ||
english: I have renounced them; meeting the Guru, I have renounced them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਮਾਨਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੈ ਆਗਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab sukh aana(n)d ma(n)gal ras maan gobi(n)dai aagio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All peace, joy, happiness and pleasures have come since I surrendered to the Will of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਦੋਊ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਡਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਗਿਓ ॥
transliteration: maan abhimaan dooo samaane masatak daar gur paagio ||
english: Honor and dishonor are the same to me; I have placed my forehead upon the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਪਤ ਹਰਖੁ ਨ ਆਪਤ ਦੂਖਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੈ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)pat harakh na aapat dookhaa ra(n)g thaakurai laagio ||1||
english: Wealth does not excite me, and misfortune does not disturb me; I have embraced love for my Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਸ ਬਾਸਰੀ ਏਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਗਿਓ ॥
transliteration: baas baasaree ekai suaamee udiaan drisataagio ||
english: The One Lord and Master dwells in the home; He is seen in the wilderness as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸੰਤ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਾਗਿਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nirabhau bhae sa(n)t bhram daario pooran sarabaagio ||2||
english: I have become fearless; the Saint has removed my doubts. The All-knowing Lord is pervading everywhere. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਰੋ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karatai kaaran keeno man buro na laagio ||
english: Whatever the Creator does, my mind is not troubled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੋਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗਿਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat parasaad sa(n)tan kai soio man jaagio ||3||
english: By the Grace of the Saints and the Company of the Holy, my sleeping mind has been awakened. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਓੜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਪਰਿਓ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਣਾਗਿਓ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak oR tuhaaree pario aaio saranaagio ||
english: Servant Nanak seeks Your Support; he has come to Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਸਹਜ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬੦॥
transliteration: naam ra(n)g sahaj ras maane phir dookh na laagio ||4||2||160||
english: In the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he enjoys intuitive peace; pain no longer touches him. ||4||2||160||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ₂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee maalaa₂ mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਲੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paaiaa laal ratan man paaiaa ||
english: I have found the jewel of my Beloved within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan seetal man seetal theeaa satagur sabad samaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My body is cooled, my mind is cooled and soothed, and I am absorbed into the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: laathee bhookh trisan sabh laathee chi(n)taa sagal bisaaree ||
english: My hunger has departed, my thirst has totally departed, and all my anxiety is forgotten.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਧਰਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤੋ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar masatak gur poorai dhario man jeeto jag saaree ||1||
english: The Perfect Guru has placed His Hand upon my forehead; conquering my mind, I have conquered the whole world. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ ਅਬ ਚੂਕੇ ॥
transliteration: tripat aghaai rahe rid a(n)tar dolan te ab chooke ||
english: Satisfied and satiated, I remain steady within my heart, and now, I do not waver at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਖੁਟੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ਮੂਕੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: akhut khajaanaa satigur deeaa tot nahee re mooke ||2||
english: The True Guru has given me the inexhaustible treasure; it never decreases, and never runs out. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਐਸੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: acharaj ek sunahu re bhaaee gur aisee boojh bujhaaee ||
english: Listen to this wonder, O Siblings of Destiny: the Guru has given me this understanding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਿ ਪਰਦਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਉ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਤਉ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: laahi paradaa thaakur jau bhetio tau bisaree taat paraaee ||3||
english: I threw off the veil of illusion, when I met my Lord and Master; then, I forgot my jealousy of others. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਏਹੁ ਅਚੰਭਉ ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kahio na jaaee ehu acha(n)bhau so jaanai jin chaakhiaa ||
english: This is a wonder which cannot be described. They alone know it, who have tasted it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਭਏ ਬਿਗਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sach bhae bigaasaa gur nidhaan ridai lai raakhiaa ||4||3||161||
english: Says Nanak, the Truth has been revealed to me. The Guru has given me the treasure; I have taken it and enshrined it within my heart. ||4||3||161||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee maalaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਬਰਤ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ubarat raajaa raam kee saranee ||
english: Those who take to the Sanctuary of the Lord, the King, are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਲੋਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮੰਡਲ ਗਿਰਿ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਰਤੇ ਧਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab lok maaiaa ke ma(n)dal gir gir parate dharanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All other people, in the mansion of Maya, fall flat on their faces on the ground. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਨ ਇਉ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saasat si(n)mrit bed beechaare mahaa purakhan iu kahiaa ||
english: The great men have studied the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas, and they have said this:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਸੂਖੁ ਨ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin har bhajan naahee nisataaraa sookh na kinahoo(n) lahiaa ||1||
english: "Without the Lord's meditation, there is no emancipation, and no one has ever found peace." ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਕੀ ਲਖਮੀ ਜੋਰੀ ਬੂਝਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਲਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: teen bhavan kee lakhamee joree boojhat naahee lahare ||
english: People may accumulate the wealth of the three worlds, but the waves of greed are still not subdued.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਹਾ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਫਿਰਤੋ ਪਹਰੇ ਪਹਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin har bhagat kahaa thit paavai phirato pahare pahare ||2||
english: Without devotional worship of the Lord, where can anyone find stability? People wander around endlessly. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਕਰਤ ਮਨ ਮੋਹਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: anik bilaas karat man mohan pooran hot na kaamaa ||
english: People engage in all sorts of mind-enticing pastimes, but their passions are not fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਤੋ ਜਲਤੋ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬੂਝਤ ਸਗਲ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jalato jalato kabahoo na boojhat sagal brithe bin naamaa ||3||
english: They burn and burn, and are never satisfied; without the Lord's Name, it is all useless. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਇਹੈ ਸਾਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam japahu mere meetaa ihai saar sukh pooraa ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, my friend; this is the essence of perfect peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੬੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat janam maran nivaarai naanak jan kee dhooraa ||4||4||162||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, birth and death are ended. Nanak is the dust of the feet of the humble. ||4||4||162||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee maalaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mo kau ih bidh ko samajhaavai ||
english: Who can help me understand my condition?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਹੋਇ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karataa hoi janaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Only the Creator knows it. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਜਾਨਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਇਨਹਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: anajaanat kichh inahi kamaano jap tap kachhoo na saadhaa ||
english: This person does things in ignorance; he does not chant in meditation, and does not perform any deep, self-disciplined meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਲੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦਉਰਾਇਓ ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dah dis lai ihu man dauraaio kavan karam kar baadhaa ||1||
english: This mind wanders around in the ten directions - how can it be restrained? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਉ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan dhan bhoom kaa thaakur hau is kaa ihu meraa ||
english: "I am the lord, the master of my mind, body, wealth and lands. These are mine."

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਕਛੁ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਹ ਪੈਖਰ ਪਏ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bharam moh kachh soojhas naahee ih paikhar pae pairaa ||2||
english: In doubt and emotional attachment, this person understands nothing; with this leash, these feet are tied up. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਪਰਿਆ ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tab ihu kahaa kamaavan pariaa jab ihu kachhoo na hotaa ||
english: What did this person do, when he did not exist?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਏਕ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jab ek nira(n)jan nira(n)kaar prabh sabh kichh aapahi karataa ||3||
english: When the Immaculate and Formless Lord God was all alone, He did everything by Himself. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: apane karatab aape jaanai jin ihu rachan rachaaiaa ||
english: He alone knows His actions; He created this creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak karanahaar hai aape satigur bharam chukaaiaa ||4||5||163||
english: Says Nanak, the Lord Himself is the Doer. The True Guru has dispelled my doubts. ||4||5||163||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee maalaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਬਿਰਥੇ ॥
transliteration: har bin avar kriaa birathe ||
english: Without the Lord, other actions are useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਇਹਿ ਓਰੈ ਮੂਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam karam kamaane ihi orai moose ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditative chants, intense deep meditation, austere self-discipline and rituals - these are plundered in this world. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤਾ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਆਢੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: barat nem sa(n)jam mahi rahataa tin kaa aadh na paaiaa ||
english: Fasting, daily rituals, and austere self-discipline - those who keep the practice of these, are rewarded with less than a shell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਚਲਣੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਊਂਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aagai chalan aur hai bhaaee oo(n)haa kaam na aaiaa ||1||
english: Hereafter, the way is different, O Siblings of Destiny. There, these things are of no use at all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ਅਰੁ ਧਰਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਾ ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: teerath naai ar dharanee bhramataa aagai thaur na paavai ||
english: Those who bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and wander over the earth, find no place of rest hereafter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਓਹੁ ਲੋਗਨ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: oohaa kaam na aavai ih bidh ohu logan hee pateeaavai ||2||
english: There, these are of no use at all. By these things, they only please other people. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਮੁਖ ਬਚਨੀ ਉਚਰੈ ਆਗੈ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: chatur bed mukh bachanee ucharai aagai mahal na paaeeai ||
english: Reciting the four Vedas from memory, they do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence hereafter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਧਾਖਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਝਾਖ ਝਖਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: boojhai naahee ek sudhaakhar ohu sagalee jhaakh jhakhaaeeai ||3||
english: Those who do not understand the One Pure Word, utter total nonsense. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤੋ ਇਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਜਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਾਰ ਗਰਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak kahato ihu beechaaraa j kamaavai s paar garaamee ||
english: Nanak voices this opinion: those who practice it, swim across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੬੪॥
transliteration: gur sevahu ar naam dhiaavahu tiaagahu manahu gumaanee ||4||6||164||
english: Serve the Guru, and meditate on the Naam; renounce the egotistical pride from your mind. ||4||6||164||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee maalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: maadhau har har har mukh kaheeai ||
english: O Lord, I chant Your Name, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham te kachhoo na hovai suaamee jiu raakhahu tiu raheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I cannot do anything by myself, O Lord and Master. As You keep me, so I remain. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਕਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਇਸੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kiaa kichh karai k karanaihaaraa kiaa is haath bichaare ||
english: What can the mere mortal do? What is in the hands of this poor creature?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਮ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jit tum laavahu tit hee laagaa pooran khasam hamaare ||1||
english: As You attach us, so we are attached, O my Perfect Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: karahu kripaa sarab ke daate ek roop liv laavahu ||
english: Take pity on me, O Great Giver of all, that I may enshrine love for Your Form alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੬੫॥
transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)tee har pahi apunaa naam japaavahu ||2||7||165||
english: Nanak offers this prayer to the Lord, that he may chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||7||165||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ₁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee maajha₁ mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਰਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal damodar raaiaa jeeu ||
english: O Merciful to the meek, O Dear Lord King,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਲਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kot janaa kar sev lagaaiaa jeeu ||
english: You have engaged millions of people in Your Service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਵਛਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal teraa birad rakhaaiaa jeeu ||
english: You are the Lover of Your devotees; this is Your Nature.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pooran sabhanee jaaee jeeu ||1||
english: You are totally pervading all places. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਪੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਕਵਣ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kiu pekhaa preetam kavan sukaranee jeeu ||
english: How can I behold my Beloved? What is that way of life?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa daasee sevaa charanee jeeu ||
english: Become the slave of the Saints, and serve at their feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਵਤਾਈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ihu jeeu vataaee bal bal jaaee jeeu ||
english: I dedicate this soul; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis niv niv laagau paaee jeeu ||2||
english: Bowing low, I fall at the Feet of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬੇਦ ਖੋਜੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: pothee pa(n)dit bed khoja(n)taa jeeu ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, study the books of the Vedas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: hoi bairaagee teerath naava(n)taa jeeu ||
english: Some become renunciates, and bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: geet naad keeratan gaava(n)taa jeeu ||
english: Some sing tunes and melodies and songs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har nirabhau naam dhiaaee jeeu ||3||
english: But I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bhae kripaal suaamee mere jeeu ||
english: My Lord and Master has become merciful to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਲਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੈਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: patit pavit lag gur ke paire jeeu ||
english: I was a sinner, and I have been sanctified, taking to the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bhram bhau kaat keee niravaire jeeu ||
english: Dispelling my doubts and fears, the Guru has rid me of hatred.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur man kee aas pooraaee jeeu ||4||
english: The Guru has fulfilled the desires of my mind. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jin naau paaiaa so dhanava(n)taa jeeu ||
english: One who has obtained the Name is wealthy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੁ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jin prabh dhiaaiaa s sobhaava(n)taa jeeu ||
english: One who meditates on God is glorified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jis saadhoo sa(n)gat tis sabh sukaranee jeeu ||
english: Sublime are all the actions of those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੬੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak sahaj samaaee jeeu ||5||1||166||
english: Servant Nanak is intuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||5||1||166||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਮਾਝ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 maajh ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl, Maajh:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aau hamaarai raam piaare jeeu ||
english: Come to me, O my Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: rain dinas saas saas chitaare jeeu ||
english: Night and day, with each and every breath, I think of You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਦੇਉ ਸੰਦੇਸਾ ਪੈ ਚਰਣਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t deu sa(n)desaa pai charanaare jeeu ||
english: O Saints, give Him this message; I fall at Your Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tudh bin kit bidh tareeai jeeu ||1||
english: Without You, how can I be saved? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਮੈ ਕਰੇ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g tumaarai mai kare ana(n)daa jeeu ||
english: In Your Company, I am in ecstasy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਣਿ ਤਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: van tin tribhavan sukh paramaana(n)daa jeeu ||
english: In the forest, the fields and the three worlds, there is peace and supreme bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sej suhaavee ihu man bigasa(n)daa jeeu ||
english: My bed is beautiful, and my mind blossoms forth in ecstasy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pekh darasan ihu sukh laheeai jeeu ||2||
english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I have found this peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: charan pakhaar karee nit sevaa jeeu ||
english: I wash Your Feet, and constantly serve You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਦੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: poojaa arachaa ba(n)dan devaa jeeu ||
english: O Divine Lord, I worship and adore You; I bow down before You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: daasan daas naam jap levaa jeeu ||
english: I am the slave of Your slaves; I chant Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਉ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binau thaakur pahi kaheeai jeeu ||3||
english: I offer this prayer to my Lord and Master. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ichh pu(n)nee meree man tan hariaa jeeu ||
english: My desires are fulfilled, and my mind and body are rejuvenated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: darasan pekhat sabh dukh parahariaa jeeu ||
english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, all my pains have been taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਜਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam jape jap tariaa jeeu ||
english: Chanting and meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਅਜਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬੭॥
transliteration: ihu ajar naanak sukh saheeai jeeu ||4||2||167||
english: Nanak endures this unendurable celestial bliss. ||4||2||167||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sun sun saajan man mit piaare jeeu ||
english: Listen, listen, O my friend and companion, O Beloved of my mind:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਭਿ ਵਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: man tan teraa ihu jeeu bh vaare jeeu ||
english: my mind and body are Yours. This life is a sacrifice to You as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: visar naahee prabh praan adhaare jeeu ||
english: May I never forget God, the Support of the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa teree saranaaee jeeu ||1||
english: I have come to Your Eternal Sanctuary. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jis miliai man jeevai bhaaee jeeu ||
english: Meeting Him, my mind is revived, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee so har har paaee jeeu ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have found the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh prabh kaa prabh keeaa jaaee jeeu ||
english: All things belong to God; all places belong to God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prabh kau sad bal jaaee jeeu ||2||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ehu nidhaan japai vadabhaagee jeeu ||
english: Very fortunate are those who meditate on this treasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: naam nira(n)jan ek liv laagee jeeu ||
english: They enshrine love for the Naam, the Name of the One Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa paaiaa sabh dukh mitaaiaa jeeu ||
english: Finding the Perfect Guru, all suffering is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aath pahar gun gaaiaa jeeu ||3||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glories of God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ratan padaarath har naam tumaaraa jeeu ||
english: Your Name is the treasure of jewels, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sachaa saahu bhagat vanajaaraa jeeu ||
english: You are the True Banker; Your devotee is the trader.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har dhan raas sach vaapaaraa jeeu ||
english: True is the trade of those who have the wealth of the Lord's assets.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬੮॥
transliteration: jan naanak sad balihaaraa jeeu ||4||3||168||
english: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice. ||4||3||168||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: too(n) meraa bahu maan karate too(n) meraa bahu maan ||
english: I am so proud of You, O Creator; I am so proud of You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jor tumaarai sukh vasaa sach sabad neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through Your Almighty Power, I dwell in peace. The True Word of the Shabad is my banner and insignia. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਜਾਤੀਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਚੁਪ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sabhe galaa jaateeaa sun kai chup keeaa ||
english: He hears and knows everything, but he keeps silent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਲਧੀਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੜਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kad hee surat na ladheeaa maaiaa mohaRiaa ||1||
english: Bewitched by Maya, he never regains awareness. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਰਤ ਸਾਰਤਾ ਸੇ ਅਖੀ ਡਿਠੜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dei bujhaarat saarataa se akhee dithaRiaa ||
english: The riddles and hints are given, and he sees them with his eyes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਜਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਸੁਣੀ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: koee j moorakh lobheeaa mool na sunee kahiaa ||2||
english: But he is foolish and greedy, and he never listens to what he is told. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਦੁਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਸਭ ਇਕਤੁ ਸਾਦਿ ਮੁਠੀ ॥
transliteration: ikas duhu chahu kiaa ganee sabh ikat saad muthee ||
english: Why bother to count one, two, three, four? The whole world is defrauded by the same enticements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਅਧੁ ਨਾਇ ਰਸੀਅੜਾ ਕਾ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਵੁਠੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ik adh naai raseeaRaa kaa viralee jaai vuthee ||3||
english: Hardly anyone loves the Lord's Name; how rare is that place which is in bloom. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਸਚੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bhagat sache dar sohade anad karahi din raat ||
english: The devotees look beautiful in the True Court; night and day, they are happy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਤ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੬੯॥
transliteration: ra(n)g rate paramesarai jan naanak tin bal jaat ||4||1||169||
english: They are imbued with the Love of the Transcendent Lord; servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||4||1||169||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਮਾਂਝ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 maa(n)jh ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl, Maajh:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: dukh bha(n)jan teraa naam jee dukh bha(n)jan teraa naam ||
english: The Destroyer of sorrow is Your Name, Lord; the Destroyer of sorrow is Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar aaraadheeai pooran satigur giaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, dwell upon the wisdom of the Perfect True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit ghat vasai paarabraham soee suhaavaa thaau ||
english: That heart, in which the Supreme Lord God abides, is the most beautiful place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jam ka(n)kar neR na aavaee rasanaa har gun gaau ||1||
english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord with the tongue. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਪੈ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: sevaa surat na jaaneeaa naa jaapai aaraadh ||
english: I have not understood the wisdom of serving Him, nor have I worshipped Him in meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਟ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ot teree jagajeevanaa mere thaakur agam agaadh ||2||
english: You are my Support, O Life of the World; O my Lord and Master, Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈਆ ਨਠੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: bhae kripaal gusaaeeaa nathe sog sa(n)taap ||
english: When the Lord of the Universe became merciful, sorrow and suffering departed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tatee vaau na lagaee satigur rakhe aap ||3||
english: The hot winds do not even touch those who are protected by the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਦਯੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur naaraain day gur gur sachaa sirajanahaar ||
english: The Guru is the All-pervading Lord, the Guru is the Merciful Master; the Guru is the True Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੭੦॥
transliteration: gur tuthai sabh kichh paaiaa jan naanak sad balihaar ||4||2||170||
english: When the Guru was totally satisfied, I obtained everything. Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||2||170||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: har raam raam raam raamaa ||
english: The Lord, the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jap pooran hoe kaamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: meditating on Him, all affairs are resolved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜਪੇਦਿਆ ਹੋਆ ਮੁਖੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raam gobi(n)d japediaa hoaa mukh pavitr ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, one's mouth is sanctified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੋਈ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har jas suneeai jis te soee bhaaee mitr ||1||
english: One who recites to me the Praises of the Lord is my friend and brother. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਭਿ ਫਲਾ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh padaarath sabh phalaa sarab gunaa jis maahi ||
english: All treasures, all rewards and all virtues are in the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kiu gobi(n)d manahu visaareeai jis simarat dukh jaahi ||2||
english: Why forget Him from your mind? Remembering Him in meditation, pain departs. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਗਿਐ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਈਐ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jis laR lagiai jeeveeai bhavajal paeeai paar ||
english: Grasping the hem of His robe, we live, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mil saadhoo sa(n)g udhaar hoi mukh oojal darabaar ||3||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved, and one's face becomes radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jeevan roop gopaal jas sa(n)t janaa kee raas ||
english: The Praise of the Sustainer of the Universe is the essence of life, and the wealth of His Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਬਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭੧॥
transliteration: naanak ubare naam jap dar sachai saabaas ||4||3||171||
english: Nanak is saved, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord; in the True Court, he is cheered and applauded. ||4||3||171||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਠੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਜਿੰਦੂ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਠੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: meethe har gun gaau ji(n)doo too(n) meethe har gun gaau ||
english: Sing the Sweet Praises of the Lord, O my soul, sing the Sweet Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sache setee ratiaa miliaa nithaave thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Attuned to the True One, even the homeless find a home. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿ ਸਾਦ ਸਭਿ ਫਿਕਿਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: hor saad sabh phikiaa tan man phikaa hoi ||
english: All other tastes are bland and insipid; through them, the body and mind are rendered insipid as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਫਿਟੁ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vin paramesar jo kare phit s jeevan soi ||1||
english: Without the Transcendent Lord, what can anyone do? Cursed is his life, and cursed his reputation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਚਲੁ ਗਹਿ ਕੈ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਤਰਣਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)chal gahi kai saadh kaa taranaa ihu sa(n)saar ||
english: Grasping the hem of the robe of the Holy Saint, we cross over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paarabraham aaraadheeai udharai sabh paravaar ||2||
english: Worship and adore the Supreme Lord God, and all your family will be saved as well. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਬੰਧੁ ਸੁਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: saajan ba(n)dh sumitr so har naam hiradai dei ||
english: He is a companion, a relative, and a good friend of mine, who implants the Lord's Name within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਕੈ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: augan sabh mitaai kai paraupakaar karei ||3||
english: He washes off all my demerits, and is so generous to me. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਥੇਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: maal khajaanaa thehu ghar har ke charan nidhaan ||
english: Wealth, treasures, and household are all just ruins; the Lord's Feet are the only treasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚਕੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੭੨॥
transliteration: naanak jaachak dar terai prabh tudhano ma(n)gai daan ||4||4||172||
english: Nanak is a beggar standing at Your Door, God; he begs for Your charity. ||4||4||172||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Raag Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੋ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਉ ॥
transliteration: saadho man kaa maan tiaagau ||
english: Holy Saadhus: forsake the pride of your mind.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਕੀ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਾਗਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh sa(n)gat durajan kee taa te ahinis bhaagau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Sexual desire, anger and the company of evil people - run away from them, day and night. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੋਨੋ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sukh dukh dono sam kar jaanai aur maan apamaanaa ||
english: One who knows that pain and pleasure are both the same, and honor and dishonor as well,

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਗਿ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: harakh sog te rahai ateetaa tin jag tat pachhaanaa ||1||
english: who remains detached from joy and sorrow, realizes the true essence in the world. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਖੋਜੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: usatat ni(n)daa dooo tiaagai khojai pad nirabaanaa ||
english: Renounce both praise and blame; seek instead the state of Nirvaanaa.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਠਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak ihu khel kathan hai kinahoo(n) guramukh jaanaa ||2||1||
english: O servant Nanak, this is such a difficult game; only a few Gurmukhs understand it! ||2||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੋ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saadho rachanaa raam banaaee ||
english: Holy Saadhus: the Lord fashioned the creation.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਇਕ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਲਖਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ik binasai ik asathir maanai acharaj lakhio na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One person passes away, and another thinks that he will live forever - this is a wonder beyond understanding! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮੋਹ ਬਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh moh bas praanee har moorat bisaraaee ||
english: The mortal beings are held in the power of sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment; they have forgotten the Lord, the Immortal Form.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਰੈਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jhoothaa tan saachaa kar maanio jiu supanaa rainaaee ||1||
english: The body is false, but they believe it to be true; it is like a dream in the night. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਦਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai so sagal binaasai jiu baadar kee chhaaee ||
english: Whatever is seen, shall all pass away, like the shadow of a cloud.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak jag jaanio mithiaa rahio raam saranaaee ||2||2||
english: O servant Nanak, one who knows the world to be unreal, dwells in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: praanee kau har jas man nahee aavai ||
english: The Praise of the Lord does not come to dwell in the minds of the mortal beings.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ahinis magan rahai maaiaa mai kahu kaise gun gaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Day and night, they remain engrossed in Maya. Tell me, how can they sing God's Glories? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪੂਤ ਮੀਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: poot meet maaiaa mamataa siu ih bidh aap ba(n)dhaavai ||
english: In this way, they bind themselves to children, friends, Maya and possessiveness.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਝੂਠੋ ਇਹੁ ਜਗ ਦੇਖਿ ਤਾਸਿ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mrig trisanaa jiu jhootho ihu jag dekh taas uth dhaavai ||1||
english: Like the deer's delusion, this world is false; and yet, beholding it, they chase after it. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੂੜ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bhugat mukat kaa kaaran suaamee mooR taahi bisaraavai ||
english: Our Lord and Master is the source of pleasures and liberation; and yet, the fool forgets Him.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਨ ਮੈ ਕੋਊ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak kotan mai kooo bhajan raam ko paavai ||2||3||
english: O servant Nanak, among millions, there is scarcely anyone who attains the Lord's meditation. ||2||3||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saadho ihu man gahio na jaaee ||
english: Holy Saadhus: this mind cannot be restrained.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਯਾ ਤੇ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)chal trisanaa sa(n)g basat hai yaa te thir na rahaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Fickle desires dwell with it, and so it cannot remain steady. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਠਨ ਕਰੋਧ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਿਹ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kathan karodh ghat hee ke bheetar jih sudh sabh bisaraaee ||
english: The heart is filled with anger and violence, which cause all sense to be forgotten.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ratan giaan sabh ko hir leenaa taa siu kachh na basaaee ||1||
english: The jewel of spiritual wisdom has been taken away from everyone; nothing can withstand it. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਰੇ ਗੁਨੀ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jogee jatan karat sabh haare gunee rahe gun gaaee ||
english: The Yogis have tried everything and failed; the virtuous have grown weary of singing God's Glories.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਤਉ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak har bhae daiaalaa tau sabh bidh ban aaee ||2||4||
english: O servant Nanak, when the Lord becomes merciful, then every effort is successful. ||2||4||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੋ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: saadho gobi(n)d ke gun gaavau ||
english: Holy Saadhus: sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਾਹਿ ਗਵਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maanas janam amolak paaio birathaa kaahi gavaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You have obtained the priceless jewel of this human life; why are you uselessly wasting it? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਆਵਉ ॥
transliteration: patit puneet deen ba(n)dh har saran taahi tum aavau ||
english: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Friend of the poor. Come, and enter the Lord's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਗਜ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤੁਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਰਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gaj ko traas mitio jih simarat tum kaahe bisaraavau ||1||
english: Remembering Him, the elephant's fear was removed; so why do you forget Him? ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੁਨਿ ਭਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: taj abhimaan moh maaiaa phun bhajan raam chit laavau ||
english: Renounce your egotistical pride and your emotional attachment to Maya; focus your consciousness on the Lord's meditation.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕੋਊ ਮਾਈ ਭੂਲਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kooo maaee bhoolio man samajhaavai ||
english: O mother, if only someone would instruct my wayward mind.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪੰਥ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak kahat mukat pa(n)th ihu guramukh hoi tum paavau ||2||5||
english: Says Nanak, this is the path to liberation. Become Gurmukh, and attain it. ||2||5||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਾਧ ਮਗ ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan saadh mag sun kar nimakh na har gun gaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This mind listens to the Vedas, the Puraanas, and the ways of the Holy Saints, but it does not sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, for even an instant. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਇ ਮਾਨਸ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: duralabh deh paai maanas kee birathaa janam siraavai ||
english: Having obtained this human body, so very difficult to obtain, it is now being uselessly wasted.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਸੰਕਟ ਬਨ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਉਪਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maaiaa moh mahaa sa(n)kat ban taa siu ruch upajaavai ||1||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya is such a treacherous wilderness, and yet, people are in love with it. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar sadaa sa(n)g prabh taa siu nehu na laavai ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, God is always with them, and yet, they do not enshrine Love for Him.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak mukat taahi tum maanahu jih ghat raam samaavai ||2||6||
english: O Nanak, know that those whose hearts are filled with the Lord are liberated. ||2||6||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੋ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: saadho raam saran bisaraamaa ||
english: Holy Saadhus: rest and peace are in the Sanctuary of the Lord.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਪੜੇ ਕੋ ਇਹ ਗੁਨ ਸਿਮਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan paRe ko ih gun simare har ko naamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This is the blessing of studying the Vedas and the Puraanas, that you may meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਅਉ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: lobh moh maaiaa mamataa phun au bikhian kee sevaa ||
english: Greed, emotional attachment to Maya, possessiveness, the service of evil, pleasure and pain,

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਪਰਸੈ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਸੋ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: harakh sog parasai jih naahan so moorat hai devaa ||1||
english: - those who are not touched by these, are the very embodiment of the Divine Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਗ ਨਰਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਖੁ ਏ ਸਭ ਤਿਉ ਕੰਚਨ ਅਰੁ ਪੈਸਾ ॥
transliteration: surag narak a(n)mrit bikh e sabh tiu ka(n)chan ar paisaa ||
english: Heaven and hell, ambrosial nectar and poison, gold and copper - these are all alike to them.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਏ ਸਮ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਤੈਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: usatat ni(n)daa e sam jaa kai lobh mohu phun taisaa ||2||
english: Praise and slander are all the same to them, as are greed and attachment. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਏ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਤਿਹ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਉ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh e baadhe jih naahan tih tum jaanau giaanee ||
english: They are not bound by pleasure and pain - know that they are truly wise.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਉ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak mukat taahi tum maanau ih bidh ko jo praanee ||3||7||
english: O Nanak, recognize those mortal beings as liberated, who live this way of life. ||3||7||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਤੈ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man re kahaa bhaio tai bauraa ||
english: O mind, why have you gone crazy?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਭਇਓ ਲੋਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ahinis audh ghatai nahee jaanai bhaio lobh sa(n)g hauraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Don't you know that your life is decreasing, day and night? Your life is made worthless with greed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਨੁ ਤੈ ਅਪਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jo tan tai apano kar maanio ar su(n)dar grih naaree ||
english: That body, which you believe to be your own, and your beautiful home and spouse

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਮੈਂ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਰੇ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਦੇਖੋ ਸੋਚ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: in mai(n) kachh tero re naahan dekho soch bichaaree ||1||
english: - none of these is yours to keep. See this, reflect upon it and understand. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਨੋ ਤੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ratan janam apano tai haario gobi(n)d gat nahee jaanee ||
english: You have wasted the precious jewel of this human life; you do not know the Way of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਲੀਨ ਭਇਓ ਚਰਨਨ ਸਿਂਉ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅਉਧ ਸਿਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nimakh na leen bhaio charanan si(n)u birathaa audh siraanee ||2||
english: You have not been absorbed in the Lord's Feet, even for an instant. Your life has passed away in vain! ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak soee nar sukheeaa raam naam gun gaavai ||
english: Says Nanak, that man is happy, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅਉਰ ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੮॥
transliteration: aur sagal jag maaiaa mohiaa nirabhai pad nahee paavai ||3||8||
english: All the rest of the world is enticed by Maya; they do not obtain the state of fearless dignity. ||3||8||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਰ ਅਚੇਤ ਪਾਪ ਤੇ ਡਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: nar achet paap te dar re ||
english: You people are unconscious; you should be afraid of sin.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਪਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal sagal bhai bha(n)jan saran taahi tum par re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of all fear. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਜਾਸ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੀਐ ਮੋ ਧਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan jaas gun gaavat taa ko naam heeai mo dhar re ||
english: The Vedas and the Puraanas sing His Praises; enshrine His Name within your heart.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਕਸਮਲ ਸਭ ਹਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paavan naam jagat mai har ko simar simar kasamal sabh har re ||1||
english: Pure and sublime is the Name of the Lord in the world. Remembering it in meditation, all sinful mistakes shall be washed away. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਕਛੂ ਉਪਾਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਾ ਕਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maanas deh bahur nah paavai kachhoo upaau mukat kaa kar re ||
english: You shall not obtain this human body again; make the effort - try to achieve liberation!

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਗਾਇ ਕਰੁਨਾ ਮੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੫੧॥
transliteration: naanak kahat gaai karunaa mai bhav saagar kai paar utar re ||2||9||251||
english: Says Nanak, sing of the Lord of compassion, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||9||251||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee asatapadeeaa mahalaa 1 gauRee guaareree ||
english: Raag Gauree, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl: Gauree Gwaarayree:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: nidh sidh niramal naam beechaar ||
english: The nine treasures and the miraculous spiritual powers come by contemplating the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: pooran poor rahiaa bikh maar ||
english: The Perfect Lord is All-pervading everywhere; He destroys the poison of Maya.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੀ ਬਿਮਲ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: trikutee chhootee bimal majhaar ||
english: I am rid of the three-phased Maya, dwelling in the Pure Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਜੀਇ ਆਈ ਕਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kee mat jeei aaee kaar ||1||
english: The Guru's Teachings are useful to my soul. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: in bidh raam ramat man maaniaa ||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name in this way, my mind is satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: giaan a(n)jan gur sabad pachhaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have obtained the ointment of spiritual wisdom, recognizing the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ik sukh maaniaa sahaj milaaiaa ||
english: Blended with the One Lord, I enjoy intuitive peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: niramal baanee bharam chukaaiaa ||
english: Through the Immaculate Bani of the Word, my doubts have been dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਭਏ ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: laal bhae soohaa ra(n)g maaiaa ||
english: Instead of the pale color of Maya, I am imbued with the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਭਈ ਬਿਖੁ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nadar bhaee bikh thaak rahaaiaa ||2||
english: By the Lord's Glance of Grace, the poison has been eliminated. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਲਟ ਭਈ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਗਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ulat bhaee jeevat mar jaagiaa ||
english: When I turned away, and became dead while yet alive, I was awakened.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੇ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabad rave man har siu laagiaa ||
english: Chanting the Word of the Shabad, my mind is attached to the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ras sa(n)grahi bikh parahar tiaagiaa ||
english: I have gathered in the Lord's sublime essence, and cast out the poison.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਬਸੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhaai base jam kaa bhau bhaagiaa ||3||
english: Abiding in His Love, the fear of death has run away. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਦ ਰਹੇ ਬਾਦੰ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saad rahe baada(n) aha(n)kaaraa ||
english: My taste for pleasure ended, along with conflict and egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: chit har siu raataa hukam apaaraa ||
english: My consciousness is attuned to the Lord, by the Order of the Infinite.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਪਤਿ ਕੇ ਆਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jaat rahe pat ke aachaaraa ||
english: My pursuit for worldy pride and honour is over.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਭਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਤਮ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: drisat bhaee sukh aatam dhaaraa ||4||
english: When He blessed me with His Glance of Grace, peace was established in my soul. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦੇਖਉ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin koi na dekhau meet ||
english: Without You, I see no friend at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kis sevau kis devau cheet ||
english: Whom should I serve? Unto whom should I dedicate my consciousness?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਛਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kis poochhau kis laagau paai ||
english: Whom should I ask? At whose feet should I fall?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kis upades rahaa liv laai ||5||
english: By whose teachings will I remain absorbed in His Love? ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੀ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
