transliteration: gur sevee gur laagau paai ||
english: I serve the Guru, and I fall at the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਰਾਚਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat karee raachau har naai ||
english: I worship Him, and I am absorbed in the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖਿਆ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਭੋਜਨ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sikhiaa deekhiaa bhojan bhaau ||
english: The Lord's Love is my instruction, sermon and food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: hukam sa(n)jogee nij ghar jaau ||6||
english: Enjoined to the Lord's Command, I have entered the home of my inner self. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬ ਗਤੰ ਸੁਖ ਆਤਮ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: garab gata(n) sukh aatam dhiaanaa ||
english: With the extinction of pride, my soul has found peace and meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਭਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jot bhaee jotee maahi samaanaa ||
english: The Divine Light has dawned, and I am absorbed in the Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਤੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਹੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: likhat mitai nahee sabad neesaanaa ||
english: Pre-ordained destiny cannot be erased; the Shabad is my banner and insignia.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: karataa karanaa karataa jaanaa ||7||
english: I know the Creator, the Creator of His Creation. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਨਹ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: nah pa(n)dit nah chatur siaanaa ||
english: I am not a learned Pandit, I am not clever or wise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਭੂਲੋ ਨਹ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: nah bhoolo nah bharam bhulaanaa ||
english: I do not wander; I am not deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਥਉ ਨ ਕਥਨੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kathau na kathanee hukam pachhaanaa ||
english: I do not speak empty speech; I have recognized the Hukam of His Command.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramat sahaj samaanaa ||8||1||
english: Nanak is absorbed in intuitive peace through the Guru's Teachings. ||8||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਉਦਿਆਨੈ ॥
transliteration: man ku(n)char kaaiaa udiaanai ||
english: The mind is an elephant in the forest of the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: gur a(n)kas sach sabad neesaanai ||
english: The Guru is the controlling stick; when the Insignia of the True Shabad is applied,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਸੋਭ ਸੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raaj duaarai sobh s maanai ||1||
english: One obtains honor in the Court of God the King. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਨਹ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chaturaaee nah cheeniaa jaai ||
english: He cannot be known through clever tricks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin maare kiu keemat paai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without subduing the mind, how can His value be estimated? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
transliteration: ghar mahi a(n)mrit tasakar leee ||
english: In the house of the self is the Ambrosial Nectar, which is being stolen by the thieves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੰਨਾਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
transliteration: na(n)naakaar na koi kareee ||
english: No one can say no to them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raakhai aap vadiaaee deee ||2||
english: He Himself protects us, and blesses us with greatness. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੀਲ ਅਨੀਲ ਅਗਨਿ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ॥
transliteration: neel aneel agan ik thaaee ||
english: There are billions, countless billions of fires of desire at the seat of the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jal nivaree gur boojh bujhaaee ||
english: They are extinguished only with the water of understanding, imparted by the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਲੀਆ ਰਹਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man de leeaa rahas gun gaaee ||3||
english: Offering my mind, I have attained it, and I joyfully sing His Glorious Praises. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਤੈਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa ghar baahar so taisaa ||
english: Just as He is within the home of the self, so is He beyond.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੈਸਿ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਖਉ ਕੈਸਾ ॥
transliteration: bais guphaa mahi aakhau kaisaa ||
english: But how can I describe Him, sitting in a cave?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰਿ ਡੂਗਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਐਸਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: saagar doogar nirabhau aisaa ||4||
english: The Fearless Lord is in the oceans, just as He is in the mountains. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਕਹੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਉਨੁ ॥
transliteration: mooe kau kahu maare kaun ||
english: Tell me, who can kill someone who is already dead?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਡਰੇ ਕਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਡਰੁ ਕਵਨੁ ॥
transliteration: nidare kau kaisaa dar kavan ||
english: What does he fear? Who can frighten the fearless one?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ਤੀਨੇ ਭਉਨ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sabad pachhaanai teene bhaun ||5||
english: He recognizes the Word of the Shabad, throughout the three worlds. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਵਖਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jin kahiaa tin kahan vakhaaniaa ||
english: One who speaks, merely describes speech.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jin boojhiaa tin sahaj pachhaaniaa ||
english: But one who understands, intuitively realizes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: dekh beechaar meraa man maaniaa ||6||
english: Seeing and reflecting upon it, my mind surrenders. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸੂਰਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਇਕ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: keerat soorat mukat ik naaee ||
english: Praise, beauty and liberation are in the One Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਹੀ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tahee nira(n)jan rahiaa samaaee ||
english: In it, the Immaculate Lord is permeating and pervading.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਜ ਠਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: nij ghar biaap rahiaa nij thaaee ||7||
english: He dwells in the home of the self, and in His own sublime place. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: usatat karahi kete mun preet ||
english: The many silent sages lovingly praise Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੂਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: tan man soochai saach s cheet ||
english: Their bodies and minds are purified, as they enshrine the True Lord in their consciousness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤਿ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak har bhaj neetaa neet ||8||2||
english: O Nanak, meditate on the Lord, each and every day. ||8||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naa man marai na kaaraj hoi ||
english: The mind does not die, so the job is not accomplished.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਦੂਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man vas dootaa duramat doi ||
english: The mind is under the power of the demons of evil intellect and duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man maanai gur te ik hoi ||1||
english: But when the mind surrenders, through the Guru, it becomes one. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਰਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਹ ਵਸਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: niragun raam gunah vas hoi ||
english: The Lord is without attributes; the attributes of virtue are under His control.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aap nivaar beechaare soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who eliminates selfishness contemplates Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲੋ ਬਹੁ ਚਿਤੈ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man bhoolo bahu chitai vikaar ||
english: The deluded mind thinks of all sorts of corruption.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲੋ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man bhoolo sir aavai bhaar ||
english: When the mind is deluded, the load of wickedness falls on the head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man maanai har eka(n)kaar ||2||
english: But when the mind surrenders to the Lord, it realizes the One and Only Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man bhoolo maaiaa ghar jaai ||
english: The deluded mind enters the house of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਬਿਰੂਧਉ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaam biroodhau rahai na thaai ||
english: Engrossed in sexual desire, it does not remain steady.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har bhaj praanee rasan rasaai ||3||
english: O mortal, lovingly vibrate the Lord's Name with your tongue. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੈਵਰ ਹੈਵਰ ਕੰਚਨ ਸੁਤ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gaivar haivar ka(n)chan sut naaree ||
english: Elephants, horses, gold, children and spouses

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਪਿੜ ਚਾਲੈ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bahu chi(n)taa piR chaalai haaree ||
english: in the anxious affairs of all these, people lose the game and depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੂਐ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਕਾਚੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jooai khelan kaachee saaree ||4||
english: In the game of chess, their pieces do not reach their destination. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਪਉ ਸੰਚੀ ਭਏ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)pau sa(n)chee bhae vikaar ||
english: They gather wealth, but only evil comes from it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਕ ਉਭੇ ਦਰਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: harakh sok ubhe daravaar ||
english: Pleasure and pain stand in the doorway.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sukh sahaje jap ridai muraar ||5||
english: Intuitive peace comes by meditating on the Lord, within the heart. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa mel milaae ||
english: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then He unites us in His Union.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gun sa(n)grahi augan sabad jalaae ||
english: Through the Word of the Shabad, merits are gathered in, and demerits are burned away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
transliteration: guramukh naam padaarath paae ||6||
english: The Gurmukh obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai sabh dookh nivaas ||
english: Without the Name, all live in pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mooR maaiaa chit vaas ||
english: The consciousness of the foolish, self-willed manmukh is the dwelling place of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramukh giaan dhur karam likhiaas ||7||
english: The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom, according to pre-ordained destiny. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: man cha(n)chal dhaavat phun dhaavai ||
english: The fickle mind continuously runs after fleeting things.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸੂਚੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saache sooche mail na bhaavai ||
english: The Pure True Lord is not pleased by filth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh har gun gaavai ||8||3||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||8||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਨਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai karatiaa nah sukh hoi ||
english: Acting in egotism, peace is not obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮਤਿ ਝੂਠੀ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: manamat jhoothee sachaa soi ||
english: The intellect of the mind is false; only the Lord is True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਗੂਤੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਦੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sagal bigoote bhaavai doi ||
english: All who love duality are ruined.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so kamaavai dhur likhiaa hoi ||1||
english: People act as they are pre-ordained. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਜਗੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜੂਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aisaa jag dekhiaa jooaaree ||
english: I have seen the world to be such a gambler;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh sukh maagai naam bisaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: all beg for peace, but they forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਤਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: adisat disai taa kahiaa jaai ||
english: If the Unseen Lord could be seen, then He could be described.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਕਹਣਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin dekhe kahanaa birathaa jaai ||
english: Without seeing Him, all descriptions are useless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh deesai sahaj subhaai ||
english: The Gurmukh sees Him with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sevaa surat ek liv laai ||2||
english: So serve the One Lord, with loving awareness. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਂਗਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗਲ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sukh maa(n)gat dukh aagal hoi ||
english: People beg for peace, but they receive severe pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sagal vikaaree haar paroi ||
english: They are all weaving a wreath of corruption.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ek binaa jhoothe mukat na hoi ||
english: You are false - without the One, there is no liberation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kar kar karataa dekhai soi ||3||
english: The Creator created the creation, and He watches over it. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa agan sabad bujhaae ||
english: The fire of desire is quenched by the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: doojaa bharam sahaj subhaae ||
english: Duality and doubt are automatically eliminated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramatee naam ridai vasaae ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Naam abides in the heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: saachee baanee har gun gaae ||4||
english: Through the True Word of His Bani, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan mahi saacho guramukh bhaau ||
english: The True Lord abides within the body of that Gurmukh who enshrines love for Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਜ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa naahee nij thaau ||
english: Without the Naam, none obtain their own place.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਾਇਣ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prem paraain preetam raau ||
english: The Beloved Lord King is dedicated to love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa boojhai naau ||5||
english: If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then we realize His Name. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu sarab ja(n)jaalaa ||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya is total entanglement.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਕੁਛਿਤ ਬਿਕਰਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kucheel kuchhit bikaraalaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is filthy, cursed and dreadful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve chookai ja(n)jaalaa ||
english: Serving the True Guru, these entanglements are ended.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਲਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam sadaa sukh naalaa ||6||
english: In the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, you shall abide in lasting peace. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh boojhai ek liv laae ||
english: The Gurmukhs understand the One Lord, and enshrine love for Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nij ghar vaasai saach samaae ||
english: They dwell in the home of their own inner beings, and merge in the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa thaak rahaae ||
english: The cycle of birth and death is ended.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: poore gur te ih mat paae ||7||
english: This understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਕਥਉ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਓਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kathanee kathau na aavai or ||
english: Speaking the speech, there is no end to it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਰੁ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur puchh dekhiaa naahee dar hor ||
english: I have consulted the Guru, and I have seen that there is no other door than His.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh bhaanai tisai rajaai ||
english: Pain and pleasure reside in the Pleasure of His Will and His Command.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੮॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak neech kahai liv laai ||8||4||
english: Nanak, the lowly, says embrace love for the Lord. ||8||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗਤ ਚਿਤ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: doojee maaiaa jagat chit vaas ||
english: The duality of Maya dwells in the consciousness of the people of the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar binaas ||1||
english: They are destroyed by sexual desire, anger and egotism. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: doojaa kaun kahaa nahee koee ||
english: Whom should I call the second, when there is only the One?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi ek nira(n)jan soee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The One Immaculate Lord is pervading among all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਖੈ ਦੋਇ ॥
transliteration: doojee duramat aakhai doi ||
english: The dual-minded evil intellect speaks of a second.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਮਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aavai jaai mar doojaa hoi ||2||
english: One who harbors duality comes and goes and dies. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨ ਨਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਦੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dharan gagan nah dekhau doi ||
english: In the earth and in the sky, I do not see any second.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਬਾਈ ਲੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naaree purakh sabaaee loi ||3||
english: Among all the women and the men, His Light is shining. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੇਖਉ ਦੀਪਕ ਉਜਿਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: rav sas dekhau deepak ujiaalaa ||
english: In the lamps of the sun and the moon, I see His Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਬਾਲਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sarab nira(n)tar preetam baalaa ||4||
english: Dwelling among all is my ever-youthful Beloved. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa meraa chit laaiaa ||
english: In His Mercy, He attuned my consciousness to the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਏਕੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: satigur mo kau ek bujhaaiaa ||5||
english: The True Guru has led me to understand the One Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ek nira(n)jan guramukh jaataa ||
english: The Gurmukh knows the One Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: doojaa maar sabad pachhaataa ||6||
english: Subduing duality, one comes to realize the Word of the Shabad. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: eko hukam varatai sabh loee ||
english: The Command of the One Lord prevails throughout all the worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ekas te sabh opat hoee ||7||
english: From the One, all have arisen. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਹ ਦੋਵੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: raah dovai khasam eko jaan ||
english: There are two routes, but remember that their Lord and Master is only One.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੮॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad hukam pachhaan ||8||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਨ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sagal roop varan man maahee ||
english: He is contained in all forms, colors and minds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥੯॥੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak eko saalaahee ||9||5||
english: Says Nanak, praise the One Lord. ||9||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: adhiaatam karam kare taa saachaa ||
english: Those who live a spiritual lifestyle - they alone are true.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਾਚਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mukat bhed kiaa jaanai kaachaa ||1||
english: What can the false know about the secrets of liberation? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aisaa jogee jugat beechaarai ||
english: Those who contemplate the Way are Yogis.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch maar saach ur dhaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They conquer the five thieves, and enshrine the True Lord in the heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਸਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jis kai a(n)tar saach vasaavai ||
english: Those who enshrine the True Lord deep within,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jog jugat kee keemat paavai ||2||
english: realize the value of the Way of Yoga. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਏਕੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਉਦਿਆਨੈ ॥
transliteration: rav sas eko grih udiaanai ||
english: The sun and the moon are one and the same for them, as are household and wilderness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karanee keerat karam samaanai ||3||
english: The karma of their daily practice is to praise the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਸਬਦ ਇਕ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: ek sabad ik bhikhiaa maagai ||
english: They beg for the alms of the one and only Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan jugat sach jaagai ||4||
english: They remain awake and aware in spiritual wisdom and meditation, and the true way of life. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਰਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhai rach rahai na baahar jaai ||
english: They remain absorbed in the fear of God; they never leave it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: keemat kaun rahai liv laai ||5||
english: Who can estimate their value? They remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape mele bharam chukaae ||
english: The Lord unites them with Himself, dispelling their doubts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paae ||6||
english: By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is obtained. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa sabad veechaar ||
english: In the Guru's service is reflection upon the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: haumai maare karanee saar ||7||
english: Subduing ego, practice pure actions. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam paath puraan ||
english: Chanting, meditation, austere self-discipline and the reading of the Puraanas,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੮॥੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak apara(n)par maan ||8||6||
english: says Nanak, are contained in surrender to the Unlimited Lord. ||8||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹੀ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਤੋਖੰ ॥
transliteration: khimaa gahee brat seel sa(n)tokha(n) ||
english: To practice forgiveness is the true fast, good conduct and contentment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਨਾ ਜਮ ਦੋਖੰ ॥
transliteration: rog na biaapai naa jam dokha(n) ||
english: Disease does not afflict me, nor does the pain of death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖੰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mukat bhae prabh roop na rekha(n) ||1||
english: I am liberated, and absorbed into God, who has no form or feature. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਡਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jogee kau kaisaa dar hoi ||
english: What fear does the Yogi have?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੂਖਿ ਬਿਰਖਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rookh birakh grihi baahar soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord is among the trees and the plants, within the household and outside as well. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau jogee nira(n)jan dhiaavai ||
english: The Yogis meditate on the Fearless, Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: anadin jaagai sach liv laavai ||
english: Night and day, they remain awake and aware, embracing love for the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so jogee merai man bhaavai ||2||
english: Those Yogis are pleasing to my mind. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨੀ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaal jaal braham aganee jaare ||
english: The trap of death is burnt by the Fire of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ ਗਤੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaraa maran gat garab nivaare ||
english: Old age, death and pride are conquered.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap tarai pitaree nisataare ||3||
english: They swim across, and save their ancestors as well. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve so jogee hoi ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru are the Yogis.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਰਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhai rach rahai s nirabhau hoi ||
english: Those who remain immersed in the Fear of God become fearless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਸੇਵੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jaisaa sevai taiso hoi ||4||
english: They become just like the One they serve. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਰ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nar nihakeval nirabhau naau ||
english: The Name makes a man pure and fearless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥ ਕਰੇ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anaathah naath kare bal jaau ||
english: It makes the masterless become the master of all. I am a sacrifice to him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: punarap janam naahee gun gaau ||5||
english: Such a person is not reincarnated again; he sings the Glories of God. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar eko jaanai ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, he knows the One Lord;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabade aap pachhaanai ||
english: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he realizes himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saachai sabad dar neesaanai ||6||
english: He bears the Banner and Insignia of the True Shabad in the Lord's Court. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad marai tis nij ghar vaasaa ||
english: One who dies in the Shabad abides in his own home within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aavai na jaavai chookai aasaa ||
english: He does not come or go in reincarnation, and his hopes are subdued.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad kamal paragaasaa ||7||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, his heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai so aas niraasaa ||
english: Whoever is seen, is driven by hope and despair,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh bikh bhookh piaasaa ||
english: by sexual desire, anger, corruption, hunger and thirst.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੮॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak birale milahi udaasaa ||8||7||
english: O Nanak, those detached recluses who meet the Lord are so very rare. ||8||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aiso daas milai sukh hoee ||
english: Meeting such a slave, peace is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dukh visarai paavai sach soee ||1||
english: Pain is forgotten, when the True Lord is found. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
transliteration: darasan dekh bhaee mat pooree ||
english: Beholding the blessed vision of his darshan, my understanding has become perfect.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਚਰਨਹ ਧੂਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: athasath majan charanah dhooree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage are in the dust of his feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: netr sa(n)tokhe ek liv taaraa ||
english: My eyes are contented with the constant love of the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸੂਚੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jihavaa soochee har ras saaraa ||2||
english: My tongue is purified by the most sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sach karanee abh a(n)tar sevaa ||
english: True are my actions, and deep within my being, I serve Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿਆ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man tripataasiaa alakh abhevaa ||3||
english: My mind is satisfied by the Inscrutable, Mysterious Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: jah jah dekhau tah tah saachaa ||
english: Wherever I look, there I find the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਝਗਰਤ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bin boojhe jhagarat jag kaachaa ||4||
english: Without understanding, the world argues in falsehood. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur samajhaavai sojhee hoee ||
english: When the Guru instructs, understanding is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koee ||5||
english: How rare is that Gurmukh who understands. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhahu rakhavaale ||
english: Show Your Mercy, and save me, O Savior Lord!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਪਸੂ ਭਏ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bin boojhe pasoo bhae betaale ||6||
english: Without understanding, people become beasts and demons. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kahiaa avar nahee doojaa ||
english: The Guru has said that there is no other at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਰਉ ਅਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kis kahu dekh karau an poojaa ||7||
english: So tell me, who should I see, and who should I worship? ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਹੇਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t het prabh tribhavan dhaare ||
english: For the sake of the Saints, God has established the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਸੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: aatam cheenai s tat beechaare ||8||
english: One who understands his own soul, contemplates the essence of reality. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਚੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
transliteration: saach ridai sach prem nivaas ||
english: One whose heart is filled with Truth and true love

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥੯॥੮॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak ham taa ke daas ||9||8||
english: - prays Nanak, I am his servant. ||9||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਕੀਆ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: brahamai garab keeaa nahee jaaniaa ||
english: Brahma acted in pride, and did not understand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਕੀ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਪੜੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bed kee bipat paRee pachhutaaniaa ||
english: Only when he was faced with the downfall of the Vedas did he repent.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰੇ ਤਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jah prabh simare tahee man maaniaa ||1||
english: Remembering God in meditation, the mind is conciliated. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aisaa garab buraa sa(n)saarai ||
english: Such is the horrible pride of the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis gur milai tis garab nivaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru eliminates the pride of those who meet Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bal raajaa maaiaa aha(n)kaaree ||
english: Bal the King, in Maya and egotism,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰ ਅਫਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jagan karai bahu bhaar aphaaree ||
english: held his ceremonial feasts, but he was puffed up with pride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛੇ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin gur poochhe jaai paiaaree ||2||
english: Without the Guru's advice, he had to go to the underworld. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰੀਚੰਦੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hareecha(n)d daan karai jas levai ||
english: Hari Chand gave in charity, and earned public praise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਅਭੇਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bin gur a(n)t na paai abhevai ||
english: But without the Guru, he did not find the limits of the Mysterious Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap bhulaai aape mat devai ||3||
english: The Lord Himself misleads people, and He Himself imparts understanding. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਦੁਰਾਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: duramat haranaakhas duraachaaree ||
english: The evil-minded Harnaakhash committed evil deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਗਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh naaraain garab prahaaree ||
english: God, the Lord of all, is the Destroyer of pride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: prahalaad udhaare kirapaa dhaaree ||4||
english: He bestowed His Mercy, and saved Prahlaad. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੋ ਰਾਵਣੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਅਚੇਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bhoolo raavan mugadh achet ||
english: Raawan was deluded, foolish and unwise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੂਟੀ ਲੰਕਾ ਸੀਸ ਸਮੇਤਿ ॥
transliteration: lootee la(n)kaa sees samet ||
english: Sri Lanka was plundered, and he lost his head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬਿ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੇਤਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: garab gaiaa bin satigur het ||5||
english: He indulged in ego, and lacked the love of the True Guru. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਬਾਹੁ ਮਧੁ ਕੀਟ ਮਹਿਖਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: sahasabaahu madh keet mahikhaasaa ||
english: The Lord killed the thousand-armed Arjun, and the demons Madhu-keetab and Meh-khaasaa.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਲੇ ਨਖਹੁ ਬਿਧਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: haranaakhas le nakhahu bidhaasaa ||
english: He seized Harnaakhash and tore him apart with his nails.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੈਤ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਭਿਆਸਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: dait sa(n)ghaare bin bhagat abhiaasaa ||6||
english: The demons were slain; they did not practice devotional worship. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਰਾਸੰਧਿ ਕਾਲਜਮੁਨ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaraasa(n)dh kaalajamun sa(n)ghaare ||
english: The demons Jaraa-sandh and Kaal-jamun were destroyed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਕਤਬੀਜੁ ਕਾਲੁਨੇਮੁ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: rakatabeej kaalunem bidaare ||
english: Rakat-beej and Kaal-naym were annihilated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੈਤ ਸੰਘਾਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: dait sa(n)ghaar sa(n)t nisataare ||7||
english: Slaying the demons, the Lord saved His Saints. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aape satigur sabad beechaare ||
english: He Himself, as the True Guru, contemplates the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੈਤ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai dait sa(n)ghaare ||
english: Because of the love of duality, God killed the demons.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: guramukh saach bhagat nisataare ||8||
english: By their true devotion, the Gurmukhs have been saved. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਾ ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨੁ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: boodaa durajodhan pat khoee ||
english: Sinking down, Durodhan lost his honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: raam na jaaniaa karataa soee ||
english: He did not know the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੂਖਿ ਪਚੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੯॥
transliteration: jan kau dookh pachai dukh hoee ||9||
english: One who makes the Lord's humble servant suffer, shall himself suffer and rot. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੇਜੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: janamejai gurasabad na jaaniaa ||
english: Janameja did not know the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kiu sukh paavai bharam bhulaaniaa ||
english: Deluded by doubt, how could he find peace?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਿਆ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: ik til bhoole bahur pachhutaaniaa ||10||
english: Making a mistake, for even an instant, you shall regret and repent later on. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੰਸੁ ਕੇਸੁ ਚਾਂਡੂਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)s kes chaa(n)door na koee ||
english: Kansa the King and his warriors Kays and Chandoor had no equals.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਅਪਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: raam na cheeniaa apanee pat khoee ||
english: But they did not remember the Lord, and they lost their honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: bin jagadees na raakhai koee ||11||
english: Without the Lord of the Universe, no one can be saved. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur garab na metiaa jaai ||
english: Without the Guru, pride cannot be eradicated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramat dharam dheeraj har naai ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, one obtains Dharmic faith, composure and the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੨॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai gun gaai ||12||9||
english: O Nanak, singing the Glories of God, His Name is received. ||12||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਅੰਕਿ ਚੜਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: choaa cha(n)dan a(n)k chaRaavau ||
english: I may anoint my limbs with sandalwood oil.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਹਢਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: paat pata(n)bar pahir hadhaavau ||
english: I may dress up and wear silk and satin clothes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin har naam kahaa sukh paavau ||1||
english: But without the Lord's Name, where would I find peace? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਪਹਿਰਉ ਕਿਆ ਓਢਿ ਦਿਖਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: kiaa pahirau kiaa odh dikhaavau ||
english: So what should I wear? In what clothes should I display myself?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin jagadees kahaa sukh paavau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Lord of the Universe, how can I find peace? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੀ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਗਲਿ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kaanee ku(n)dal gal moteean kee maalaa ||
english: I may wear ear-rings, and a pearl necklace around my neck;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਫੂਲ ਗੁਲਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: laal nihaalee phool gulaalaa ||
english: my bed may be adorned with red blankets, flowers and red powder;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin jagadees kahaa sukh bhaalaa ||2||
english: but without the Lord of the Universe, where can I search for peace? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਸਲੋਨੀ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: nain salonee su(n)dar naaree ||
english: I may have a beautiful woman with fascinating eyes;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋੜ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਰੈ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: khoR seegaar karai at piaaree ||
english: she may decorate herself with the sixteen adornments, and make herself appear gorgeous.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਭਜੇ ਨਿਤ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin jagadees bhaje nit khuaaree ||3||
english: But without meditating on the Lord of the Universe, there is only continual suffering. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: dar ghar mahalaa sej sukhaalee ||
english: In his hearth and home, in his palace, upon his soft and comfortable bed,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਫੂਲ ਬਿਛਾਵੈ ਮਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: ahinis phool bichhaavai maalee ||
english: day and night, the flower-girls scatter flower petals;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸੁ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bin har naam s deh dukhaalee ||4||
english: but without the Lord's Name, the body is miserable. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਨੇਜੇ ਵਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: haivar gaivar neje vaaje ||
english: Horses, elephants, lances, marching bands,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਸਕਰ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸੀ ਪਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: lasakar neb khavaasee paaje ||
english: armies, standard bearers, royal attendants and ostentatious displays

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਝੂਠੇ ਦਿਵਾਜੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bin jagadees jhoothe divaaje ||5||
english: - without the Lord of the Universe, these undertakings are all useless. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧੁ ਕਹਾਵਉ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: sidh kahaavau ridh sidh bulaavau ||
english: He may be called a Siddha, a man of spiritual perfection, and he may summon riches and supernatural powers;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾਜ ਕੁਲਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਬਨਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: taaj kulah sir chhatr banaavau ||
english: he may place a crown upon his head, and carry a royal umbrella;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bin jagadees kahaa sach paavau ||6||
english: but without the Lord of the Universe, where can Truth be found? ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਨੁ ਮਲੂਕੁ ਕਹਾਵਉ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: khaan malook kahaavau raajaa ||
english: He may be called an emperor, a lord, and a king;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਬੇ ਤਬੇ ਕੂੜੇ ਹੈ ਪਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: abe tabe kooRe hai paajaa ||
english: he may give orders - "Do this now, do this then" - but this is a false display.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਸਵਰਸਿ ਕਾਜਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin gurasabad na savaras kaajaa ||7||
english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, his works are not accomplished. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa gur sabad visaaree ||
english: Egotism and possessiveness are dispelled by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: guramat jaaniaa ridai muraaree ||
english: With the Guru's Teachings in my heart, I have come to know the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੧੦॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak saran tumaaree ||8||10||
english: Prays Nanak, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||8||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਅਵਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sevaa ek na jaanas avare ||
english: Those who serve the One Lord, do not know any other.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਪੰਚ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਕਵਰੇ ॥
transliteration: parapa(n)ch biaadh tiaagai kavare ||
english: They abandon the bitter worldly conflicts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhaai milai sach saachai sach re ||1||
english: Through love and truth, they meet the Truest of the True. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aisaa raam bhagat jan hoee ||
english: Such are the humble devotees of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaai milai mal dhoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and their pollution is washed away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਂਧੋ ਕਵਲੁ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: oo(n)dho kaval sagal sa(n)saarai ||
english: The heart-lotus of the entire universe is upside-down.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਗਤ ਪਰਜਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: duramat agan jagat parajaarai ||
english: The fire of evil-mindedness is burning up the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so ubarai gurasabad beechaarai ||2||
english: They alone are saved, who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਅਰੁ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bhri(n)g pata(n)g ku(n)char ar meenaa ||
english: The bumble bee, the moth, the elephant, the fish

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਗੁ ਮਰੈ ਸਹਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mirag marai sahi apunaa keenaa ||
english: and the deer - all suffer for their actions, and die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਤਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: trisanaa raach tat nahee beenaa ||3||
english: Trapped by desire, they cannot see reality. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਚਿਤੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaam chitai kaaman hitakaaree ||
english: The lover of women is obsessed with sex.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: krodh binaasai sagal vikaaree ||
english: All the wicked are ruined by their anger.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਖੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: pat mat khovahi naam visaaree ||4||
english: Honor and good sense are lost, when one forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਚੀਤੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਡੋਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: par ghar cheet manamukh dolaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is lured by another man's wife.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gal jevaree dha(n)dhai lapataai ||
english: The noose is around his neck, and he is entangled in petty conflicts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramukh chhootas har gun gaai ||5||
english: The Gurmukh is emancipated, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਧਵਾ ਪਰ ਕਉ ਦੇਈ ॥
transliteration: jiu tan bidhavaa par kau deee ||
english: The lonely widow gives her body to a stranger;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਦਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਪਰ ਵਸਿ ਸੇਈ ॥
transliteration: kaam daam chit par vas seee ||
english: she allows her mind to be controlled by others for lust or money

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bin pir tripat na kabahoo(n) hoee ||6||
english: , but without her husband, she is never satisfied. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੋਥੀ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪਾਠਾ ॥
transliteration: paR paR pothee si(n)mrit paathaa ||
english: You may read, recite and study the scriptures,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੜੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਥਾਟਾ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan paRai sun thaataa ||
english: The Simritees, Vedas and Puraanas;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਟਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin ras raate man bahu naataa ||7||
english: but without being imbued with the Lord's essence, the mind wanders endlessly. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu chaatrik jal prem piaasaa ||
english: As the rainbird thirsts longingly for the drop of rain,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਲਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu meenaa jal maahi ulaasaa ||
english: and as the fish delights in the water,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਾ ॥੮॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak har ras pee tripataasaa ||8||11||
english: Nanak is satisfied by the sublime essence of the Lord. ||8||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਠੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hath kar marai na lekhai paavai ||
english: One who dies in stubbornness shall not be approved,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਸ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ves karai bahu bhasam lagaavai ||
english: even though he may wear religious robes and smear his body all over with ashes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam bisaar bahur pachhutaavai ||1||
english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he comes to regret and repent in the end. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਸੂਖ ॥
transliteration: too(n) man har jeeu too(n) man sookh ||
english: Believe in the Dear Lord, and you shall find peace of mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਸਹਹਿ ਜਮ ਦੂਖ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam bisaar sahahi jam dookh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, you shall have to endure the pain of death. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਅਗਰ ਕਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: choaa cha(n)dan agar kapoor ||
english: The smell of musk, sandalwood and camphor,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa magan param pad door ||
english: and the intoxication of Maya, takes one far away from the state of supreme dignity.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam bisaariai sabh kooRo koor ||2||
english: Forgetting the Naam, one becomes the most false of all the false. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੇਜੇ ਵਾਜੇ ਤਖਤਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: neje vaaje takhat salaam ||
english: Lances and swords, marching bands, thrones and the salutes of others

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਧਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: adhakee trisanaa viaapai kaam ||
english: only increase his desire; he is engrossed in sexual desire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਚੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin har jaache bhagat na naam ||3||
english: Without seeking the Lord, neither devotional worship nor the Naam are obtained. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਦਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: vaad aha(n)kaar naahee prabh melaa ||
english: Union with God is not obtained by arguments and egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: man de paavahi naam suhelaa ||
english: But by offering your mind, the comfort of the Naam is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai agiaan duhelaa ||4||
english: In the love of duality and ignorance, you shall suffer. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਮ ਕੇ ਸਉਦਾ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਟ ॥
transliteration: bin dam ke saudaa nahee haat ||
english: Without money, you cannot buy anything in the store.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਹੀ ਵਾਟ ॥
transliteration: bin bohith saagar nahee vaat ||
english: Without a boat, you cannot cross over the ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਘਾਟੇ ਘਾਟਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bin gur seve ghaate ghaat ||5||
english: Without serving the Guru, everything is lost. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿ ਵਾਟ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tis kau vaahu vaahu j vaat dikhaavai ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who shows us the Way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tis kau vaahu vaahu j sabad sunaavai ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who teaches the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: tis kau vaahu vaahu j mel milaavai ||6||
english: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who unites me in the Lord's Union. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis kau jis kaa ihu jeeu ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who is the Keeper of this soul.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਥਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee math a(n)mrit peeu ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, contemplate this Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਵਡਾਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੈ ਦੀਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naam vadaaee tudh bhaanai deeu ||7||
english: The Glorious Greatness of the Naam is bestowed according to the Pleasure of Your Will. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa kiu jeevaa maai ||
english: Without the Naam, how can I live, O mother?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਤੁ ਰਹਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin japat rahau teree saranaai ||
english: Night and day, I chant it; I remain in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate pat paai ||8||12||
english: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, honor is attained. ||8||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤ ਭੇਖੀ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai karat bhekhee nahee jaaniaa ||
english: Acting in egotism, the Lord is not known, even by wearing religious robes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat virale man maaniaa ||1||
english: How rare is that Gurmukh, who surrenders his mind in devotional worship. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: hau hau karat nahee sach paaeeai ||
english: By actions done in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the True Lord is not obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: haumai jaai param pad paaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: But when egotism departs, then the state of supreme dignity is obtained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai kar raaje bahu dhaavahi ||
english: The kings act in egotism, and undertake all sorts of expeditions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਖਪਹਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: haumai khapahi janam mar aavahi ||2||
english: But through their egotism, they are ruined; they die, only to be reborn over and over again. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: haumai nivarai gurasabad veechaarai ||
english: Egotism is overcome only by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਪੰਚ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: cha(n)chal mat tiaagai pa(n)ch sa(n)ghaarai ||3||
english: One who restrains his fickle mind subdues the five passions. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar saach sahaj ghar aavahi ||
english: With the True Lord deep within the self, the Celestial Mansion is intuitively found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਨੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: raajan jaan param gat paavahi ||4||
english: Understanding the Sovereign Lord, the state of supreme dignity is obtained. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sach karanee gur bharam chukaavai ||
english: The Guru dispels the doubts of those whose actions are true.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: nirabhau kai ghar taaRee laavai ||5||
english: They focus their attention on the Home of the Fearless Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਣਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hau hau kar maranaa kiaa paavai ||
english: Those who act in egotism, selfishness and conceit die; what do they gain?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੋ ਝਗਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: pooraa gur bhete so jhagar chukaavai ||6||
english: Those who meet the Perfect Guru are rid of all conflicts. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਕਿਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jetee hai tetee kihu naahee ||
english: Whatever exists, is in reality nothing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਭੇਟਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramukh giaan bhet gun gaahee ||7||
english: Obtaining spiritual wisdom from the Guru, I sing the Glories of God. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: haumai ba(n)dhan ba(n)dh bhavaavai ||
english: Egotism binds people in bondage, and causes them to wander around lost.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak raam bhagat sukh paavai ||8||13||
english: O Nanak, peace is obtained through devotional worship of the Lord. ||8||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਕਾਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: prathame brahamaa kaalai ghar aaiaa ||
english: First, Brahma entered the house of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਇਆਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: braham kamal paiaal na paaiaa ||
english: Brahma entered the lotus, and searched the nether regions, but he did not find the end of it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਲੀਨੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aagiaa nahee leenee bharam bhulaaiaa ||1||
english: He did not accept the Lord's Order - he was deluded by doubt. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਲਿ ਸੰਘਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jo upajai so kaal sa(n)ghaariaa ||
english: Whoever is created, shall be destroyed by Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham har raakhe gurasabad beechaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: But I am protected by the Lord; I contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੇ ਦੇਵੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohe devee sabh devaa ||
english: All the gods and goddesses are enticed by Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: kaal na chhodai bin gur kee sevaa ||
english: Death cannot be avoided, without serving the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ohu abinaasee alakh abhevaa ||2||
english: That Lord is Imperishable, Invisible and Inscrutable. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sulataan khaan baadisaah nahee rahanaa ||
english: The sultans, emperors and kings shall not remain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਹੁ ਭੂਲੈ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naamahu bhoolai jam kaa dukh sahanaa ||
english: Forgetting the Name, they shall endure the pain of death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mai dhar naam jiu raakhahu rahanaa ||3||
english: My only Support is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as He keeps me, I survive. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਧਰੀ ਰਾਜੇ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: chaudharee raaje nahee kisai mukaam ||
english: The leaders and kings shall not remain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹ ਮਰਹਿ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saah marahi sa(n)chahi maaiaa daam ||
english: The bankers shall die, after accumulating their wealth and money.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: mai dhan deejai har a(n)mrit naam ||4||
english: Grant me, O Lord, the wealth of Your Ambrosial Naam. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਯਤਿ ਮਹਰ ਮੁਕਦਮ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: rayat mahar mukadam sikadaarai ||
english: The people, rulers, leaders and chiefs

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: nihachal koi na disai sa(n)saarai ||
english: none of them shall be able to remain in the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਫਰਿਉ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aphariu kaal kooR sir maarai ||5||
english: Death is inevitable; it strikes the heads of the false. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: nihachal ek sachaa sach soee ||
english: Only the One Lord, the Truest of the True, is permanent.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jin kar saajee tinahi sabh goee ||
english: He who created and fashioned everything, shall destroy it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ohu guramukh jaapai taa(n) pat hoee ||6||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh and meditates on the Lord is honored. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਸੇਖ ਭੇਖ ਫਕੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaajee sekh bhekh phakeeraa ||
english: The Qazis, Shaykhs and Fakeers in religious robes

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਪੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: vade kahaavahi haumai tan peeraa ||
english: call themselves great; but through their egotism, their bodies are suffering in pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kaal na chhodai bin satigur kee dheeraa ||7||
english: Death does not spare them, without the Support of the True Guru. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਅਰੁ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: kaal jaal jihavaa ar nainee ||
english: The trap of Death is hanging over their tongues and eyes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਬੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: kaanee kaal sunai bikh bainee ||
english: Death is over their ears, when they hear talk of evil.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੂਠੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣੀ ॥੮॥
transliteration: bin sabadai moothe din rainee ||8||
english: Without the Shabad, they are plundered, day and night. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hiradai saach vasai har naai ||
english: Death cannot touch those whose hearts are filled with the True Name of the Lord,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹਿ ਸਕੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaal na johi sakai gun gaai ||
english: And who sing the Glories of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੯॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh sabad samaai ||9||14||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||9||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bolahi saach mithiaa nahee raaee ||
english: They speak the Truth - not an iota of falsehood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਲਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: chaalahi guramukh hukam rajaaee ||
english: The Gurmukhs walk in the Way of the Lord's Command.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹਹਿ ਅਤੀਤ ਸਚੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rahahi ateet sache saranaaee ||1||
english: They remain unattached, in the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sach ghar baisai kaal na johai ||
english: They dwell in their true home, and Death does not touch them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kau aavat jaavat dukh mohai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs come and go, in the pain of emotional attachment. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਅਉ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: apiu peeau akath kath raheeai ||
english: So, drink deeply of this Nectar, and speak the Unspoken Speech.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: nij ghar bais sahaj ghar laheeai ||
english: Dwelling in the home of your own being within, you shall find the home of intuitive peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har ras maate ihu sukh kaheeai ||2||
english: One who is imbued with the Lord's sublime essence, is said to experience this peace. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਾਲ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨਹੀ ਡੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: guramat chaal nihachal nahee dolai ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, one becomes perfectly stable, and never wavers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: guramat saach sahaj har bolai ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, one intuitively chants the Name of the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੀਵੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਤੁ ਵਿਰੋਲੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: peevai a(n)mrit tat virolai ||3||
english: Drinking in this Ambrosial Nectar, and churning it, the essential reality is discerned. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur dekhiaa deekhiaa leenee ||
english: Beholding the True Guru, I have received His Teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਓ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: man tan arapio a(n)taragat keenee ||
english: I have offered my mind and body, after searching deep within my own being.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gat mit paaee aatam cheenee ||4||
english: I have come to realize the value of understanding my own soul. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhojan naam nira(n)jan saar ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord, is the most excellent and sublime food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: param ha(n)s sach jot apaar ||
english: The pure swan-souls see the True Light of the Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jah dekhau tah eka(n)kaar ||5||
english: Wherever I look, I see the One and Only Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਏਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: rahai niraalam ekaa sach karanee ||
english: One who remains pure and unblemished and practices only true deeds,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: param pad paaiaa sevaa gur charanee ||
english: obtains the supreme status, serving at the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਚੂਕੀ ਅਹੰ ਭ੍ਰਮਣੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: man te man maaniaa chookee aha(n) bhramanee ||6||
english: The mind is reconciliated with the mind, and the ego's wandering ways come to an end. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: in bidh kaun kaun nahee taariaa ||
english: In this way, who - who has not been saved?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har jas sa(n)t bhagat nisataariaa ||
english: The Lord's Praises have saved His Saints and devotees.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਏ ਹਮ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: prabh paae ham avar na bhaariaa ||7||
english: I have found God - I am not searching for any other. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਮਹਲਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saach mahal gur alakh lakhaaiaa ||
english: The Guru has shown me the unseen Mansion of the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਹਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nihachal mahal nahee chhaaiaa maaiaa ||
english: His Mansion is eternal and unchanging; it is not a mere reflection of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: saach sa(n)tokhe bharam chukaaiaa ||8||
english: Through truth and contentment, doubt is dispelled. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jin kai man vasiaa sach soee ||
english: That person, within whose mind the True Lord dwells

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tin kee sa(n)gat guramukh hoee ||
english: in his company, one becomes Gurmukh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਈ ॥੯॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak saach naam mal khoee ||9||15||
english: O Nanak, the True Name washes off the pollution. ||9||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਾਪੈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam chit raapai jaa kaa ||
english: One whose consciousness is permeated with the Lord's Name

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਪਜੰਪਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: upaja(n)p darasan keejai taa kaa ||1||
english: - receive the blessing of his darshan in the early light of dawn. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨ ਜਪਹੁ ਅਭਾਗੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: raam na japahu abhaag tumaaraa ||
english: If you do not meditate on the Lord, it is your own misfortune.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jug jug daataa prabh raam hamaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In each and every age, the Great Giver is my Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramat raam japai jan pooraa ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the perfect humble beings meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟ ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਜੇ ਤੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tit ghat anahat baaje tooraa ||2||
english: Within their hearts, the unstruck melody vibrates. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jo jan raam bhagat har piaar ||
english: Those who worship the Lord and love the Lord

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: se prabh raakhe kirapaa dhaar ||3||
english: - showering His Mercy, God protects them. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jin kai hiradai har har soee ||
english: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord, Har, Har

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tin kaa daras paras sukh hoee ||4||
english: - gazing upon the blessed vision of their darshan, peace is obtained. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sarab jeeaa mahi eko ravai ||
english: Among all beings, the One Lord is pervading.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਭਵੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: manamukh aha(n)kaaree phir joonee bhavai ||5||
english: The eogtistical, self-willed manmukhs wander in reincarnation. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: so boojhai jo satigur paae ||
english: They alone understand, who have found the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
transliteration: haumai maare gurasabade paae ||6||
english: Subduing their ego, they receive the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਧਿ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: aradh uradh kee sa(n)dh kiu jaanai ||
english: How can anyone know of the Union between the being below and the Supreme Being above?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramukh sa(n)dh milai man maanai ||7||
english: The Gurmukhs obtain this Union; their minds are reconciliated. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: ham paapee niragun kau gun kareeai ||
english: I am a worthless sinner, without merit. What merit do I have?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
transliteration: prabh hoi daiaal naanak jan tareeai ||8||16||
english: When God showers His Mercy, servant Nanak is emancipated. ||8||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਲਹ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਗਉੜੀ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: solah asatapadeeaa guaareree gauRee keeaa ||
english: Sixteen Ashtpadheeyaa Of Gwaarayree Gauree||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਗਾਈ ਕਉ ਗੋਇਲੀ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu gaaee kau goilee raakhahi kar saaraa ||
english: As the dairy farmer watches over and protects his cows, so does the Lord cherish and protect us, night and day. He blesses the soul with peace. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪਾਲਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ahinis paalahi raakh lehi aatam sukh dhaaraa ||1||
english: Please protect me here and hereafter, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: it ut raakhahu deen daiaalaa ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary; please bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tau saranaagat nadar nihaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Wherever I look, there You are. Save me, O Savior Lord!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਰਖੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhau tah rav rahe rakh raakhanahaaraa ||
english: You are the Giver, and You are the Enjoyer;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too(n) daataa bhugataa too(n)hai too(n) praan adhaaraa ||2||
english: You are the Support of the breath of life. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਅਧ ਊਰਧੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kirat paiaa adh ooradhee bin giaan beechaaraa ||
english: According to the karma of past actions, people descend to the depths or rise to the heights, unless they contemplate spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin upamaa jagadees kee binasai na a(n)dhiaaraa ||3||
english: Without the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the darkness is not dispelled. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਲੋਭੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jag binasat ham dekhiaa lobhe aha(n)kaaraa ||
english: I have seen the world being destroyed by greed and egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur sevaa prabh paaiaa sach mukat duaaraa ||4||
english: Only by serving the Guru is God obtained, and the true gate of liberation found. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੋ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: nij ghar mahal apaar ko apara(n)par soee ||
english: The Mansion of the Infinite Lord's Presence is within the home of one's own being. He is beyond any boundaries.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bin sabadai thir ko nahee boojhai sukh hoee ||5||
english: Without the Word of the Shabad, nothing shall endure. Through understanding, peace is obtained. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਲੇ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਆ ਫਾਸਹਿ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kiaa lai aaiaa le jaai kiaa phaasahi jam jaalaa ||
english: What have you brought, and what will you take away, when you are caught by the noose of Death?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡੋਲੁ ਬਧਾ ਕਸਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਪਤਾਲਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: dol badhaa kas jevaree aakaas pataalaa ||6||
english: Like the bucket tied to the rope in the well, you are pulled up to the Akaashic Ethers, and then lowered down to the nether regions of the underworld. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: guramat naam na veesarai sahaje pat paaeeai ||
english: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall automatically obtain honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੭॥
transliteration: a(n)tar sabad nidhaan hai mil aap gavaaeeai ||7||
english: Deep within the self is the treasure of the Shabad; it is obtained only by eradicating selfishness and conceit. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare prabh aapanee gun a(n)k samaavai ||
english: When God bestows His Glance of Grace, people settle in the Lap of the Virtuous Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak mel na chookaee laahaa sach paavai ||8||1||17||
english: O Nanak, this Union cannot be broken; the true profit is obtained. ||8||1||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝਿ ਲੇ ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee boojh le tau hoi niberaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand, and then, the account is settled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ghar ghar naam nira(n)janaa so thaakur meraa ||1||
english: In each and every heart is the Name of the Immaculate Lord; He is my Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bin gurasabad na chhooteeai dekhahu veechaaraa ||
english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, no one is emancipated. See this, and reflect upon it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: je lakh karam kamaavahee bin gur a(n)dhiaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Even though you may perform hundreds of thousands of rituals, without the Guru, there is only darkness. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਅਕਲੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe akalee baahare kiaa tin siu kaheeai ||
english: What can you say, to one who is blind and without wisdom?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਿਰਬਹੀਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin gur pa(n)th na soojhaee kit bidh nirabaheeai ||2||
english: Without the Guru, the Path cannot be seen. How can anyone proceed? ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਕਉ ਖਰਾ ਕਹੈ ਖਰੇ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: khote kau kharaa kahai khare saar na jaanai ||
english: He calls the counterfeit genuine, and does not know the value of the genuine.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe kaa naau paarakhoo kalee kaal vidaanai ||3||
english: The blind man is known as an appraiser; this Dark Age of Kali Yuga is so strange! ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਤੇ ਕਉ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਕਹੈ ਜਾਗਤ ਕਉ ਸੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: soote kau jaagat kahai jaagat kau sootaa ||
english: The sleeper is said to be awake, and those who are awake are like sleepers.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਕਉ ਮੂਆ ਕਹੈ ਮੂਏ ਨਹੀ ਰੋਤਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jeevat kau mooaa kahai mooe nahee rotaa ||4||
english: The living are said to be dead, and no one mourns for those who have died. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਕਉ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਹੈ ਜਾਤੇ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aavat kau jaataa kahai jaate kau aaiaa ||
english: One who is coming is said to be going, and one who is gone is said to have come.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਕੀ ਕਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਹੈ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: par kee kau apunee kahai apuno nahee bhaaiaa ||5||
