english: That which belongs to others, he calls his own, but he has no liking for that which is his. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੀਠੇ ਕਉ ਕਉੜਾ ਕਹੈ ਕੜੂਏ ਕਉ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: meethe kau kauRaa kahai kaRooe kau meethaa ||
english: That which is sweet is said to be bitter, and the bitter is said to be sweet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੇ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਐਸਾ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: raate kee ni(n)daa karahi aisaa kal mahi deethaa ||6||
english: One who is imbued with the Lord's Love is slandered - this is what I have seen in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚੇਰੀ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
transliteration: cheree kee sevaa karahi thaakur nahee deesai ||
english: He serves the maid, and does not see his Lord and Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੋਖਰੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਲੀਐ ਮਾਖਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਰੀਸੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: pokhar neer viroleeai maakhan nahee reesai ||7||
english: Churning the water in the pond, no butter is produced. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਪਦ ਜੋ ਅਰਥਾਇ ਲੇਇ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: is pad jo arathaai lei so guroo hamaaraa ||
english: One who understands the meaning of this verse is my Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਸੋ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak cheenai aap kau so apar apaaraa ||8||
english: O Nanak, one who knows his own self, is infinite and incomparable. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh aape aap varatadaa aape bharamaaiaa ||
english: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself misleads the people.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੯॥੨॥੧੮॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te boojheeai sabh braham samaaiaa ||9||2||18||
english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand, that God is contained in all. ||9||2||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee guaareree mahalaa 3 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man kaa sootak doojaa bhaau ||
english: The pollution of the mind is the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bharame bhoole aavau jaau ||1||
english: Deluded by doubt, people come and go in reincarnation. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sootak kabahi na jaai ||
english: The pollution of the self-willed manmukhs will never go away,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jichar sabad na bheejai har kai naai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: as long as they do not dwell on the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੋ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabho sootak jetaa mohu aakaar ||
english: All the created beings are contaminated by emotional attachment;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mai vaaro vaar ||2||
english: they die and are reborn, only to die over and over again. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਉਣੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sootak agan paunai paanee maahi ||
english: Fire, air and water are polluted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sootak bhojan jetaa kichh khaahi ||3||
english: The food which is eaten is polluted. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਤਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sootak karam na poojaa hoi ||
english: The actions of those who do not worship the Lord are polluted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naam rate man niramal hoi ||4||
english: Attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind becomes immaculate. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur seviai sootak jaai ||
english: Serving the True Guru, pollution is eradicated,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: marai na janamai kaal na khaai ||5||
english: and then, one does not suffer death and rebirth, or get devoured by death. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saasat si(n)mrit sodh dekhahu koi ||
english: You may study and examine the Shaastras and the Simritees,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: vin naavai ko mukat na hoi ||6||
english: but without the Name, no one is liberated. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jug chaare naam utam sabad beechaar ||
english: Throughout the four ages, the Naam is the ultimate; reflect upon the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kal mahi guramukh utaras paar ||7||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only the Gurmukhs cross over. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saachaa marai na aavai jaai ||
english: The True Lord does not die; He does not come or go.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh rahai samaai ||8||1||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains absorbed in the Lord. ||8||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sevaa praan adhaaraa ||
english: Selfless service is the support of the breath of life of the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu raakhahu hiradai ur dhaaraa ||
english: Keep the Dear Lord enshrined in your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਚ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh sobhaa saach duaaraa ||1||
english: The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਪੜੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit har paR tajahu vikaaraa ||
english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, read about the Lord, and renounce your corrupt ways.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਉਤਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhaujal utarahu paaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Gurmukh crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh vichahu haumai jaai ||
english: The Gurmukh eradicates egotism from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh mail na laagai aai ||
english: No filth sticks to the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh naam vasai man aai ||2||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell within the mind of the Gurmukh. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਚਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh karam dharam sach hoee ||
english: Through karma and Dharma, good actions and righteous faith, the Gurmukh becomes true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਜਲਾਏ ਦੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh aha(n)kaar jalaae doee ||
english: The Gurmukh burns away egotism and duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh naam rate sukh hoee ||3||
english: The Gurmukh is attuned to the Naam, and is at peace. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹੁ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa man parabodhahu boojhahu soee ||
english: Instruct your own mind, and understand Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਸਮਝਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: lok samajhaavahu sune na koee ||
english: You may preach to other people, but no one will listen.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮਝਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramukh samajhahu sadaa sukh hoee ||4||
english: The Gurmukh understands, and is always at peace. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਡੰਫੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh da(n)ph bahut chaturaaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are such clever hypocrites.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh kamaavai s thaai na paaee ||
english: No matter what they do, it is not acceptable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aavai jaavai thaur na kaaee ||5||
english: They come and go in reincarnation, and find no place of rest. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh karam kare bahut abhimaanaa ||
english: The manmukhs perform their rituals, but they are totally selfish and conceited.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਗ ਜਿਉ ਲਾਇ ਬਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bag jiu laai bahai nit dhiaanaa ||
english: They sit there, like storks, pretending to meditate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿਆ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jam pakaRiaa tab hee pachhutaanaa ||6||
english: Caught by the Messenger of Death, they shall regret and repent in the end. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve mukat na hoee ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, liberation is not obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee milai har soee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one meets the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur daataa jug chaare hoee ||7||
english: The Guru is the Great Giver, throughout the four ages. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jaat pat naame vadiaaee ||
english: For the Gurmukh, the Naam is social status, honor and glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਇਰ ਕੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saair kee putree bidaar gavaaee ||
english: Maya, the daughter of the ocean, has been slain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਝੂਠੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak bin naavai jhoothee chaturaaee ||8||2||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, all clever tricks are false. ||8||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mah 3 ||
english: Gauree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਪੜਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: is jug kaa dharam paRahu tum bhaaee ||
english: Learn the Dharma of this age, O Siblings of Destiny;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: poorai gur sabh sojhee paaee ||
english: all understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਅਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aithai agai har naam sakhaaee ||1||
english: Here and hereafter, the Lord's Name is our Companion. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਪੜਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raam paRahu man karahu beechaar ||
english: Learn of the Lord, and contemplate Him in your mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee mail utaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, your filth shall be washed away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਦਿ ਵਿਰੋਧਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaad virodh na paaiaa jaai ||
english: Through argument and debate, He cannot be found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan pheekaa doojai bhaai ||
english: The mind and body are made insipid through the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad sach liv laai ||2||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, lovingly attune yourself to the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai mailaa ihu sa(n)saaraa ||
english: This world is polluted with egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: nit teerath naavai na jaai aha(n)kaaraa ||
english: By taking cleansing baths daily at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, egotism is not eliminated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin gur bhete jam kare khuaaraa ||3||
english: Without meeting the Guru, they are tortured by Death. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so jan saachaa j haumai maarai ||
english: Those humble beings are true, who conquer their ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪੰਚ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad pa(n)ch sa(n)ghaarai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they conquer the five thieves.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aap tarai sagale kul taarai ||4||
english: They save themselves, and save all their generations as well. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਟਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi nat baajee paaee ||
english: The Actor has staged the drama of emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਰਹੇ ਲਪਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dh rahe lapataaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs cling blindly to it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramukh alipat rahe liv laaee ||5||
english: The Gurmukhs remain detached, and lovingly attune themselves to the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bahute bhekh karai bhekhadhaaree ||
english: The disguisers put on their various disguises.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar tisanaa phirai aha(n)kaaree ||
english: Desire rages within them, and they carry on egotistically.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aap na cheenai baajee haaree ||6||
english: They do not understand themselves, and they lose the game of life. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਪੜ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaapaR pahir kare chaturaaee ||
english: Putting on religious robes, they act so clever,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਤਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi at bharam bhulaaee ||
english: but they are totally deluded by doubt and emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin gur seve bahut dukh paaee ||7||
english: Without serving the Guru, they suffer in terrible pain. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: naam rate sadaa bairaagee ||
english: Those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, remain detached forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: grihee a(n)tar saach liv laagee ||
english: Even as householders, they lovingly attune themselves to the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak satigur sevahi se vadabhaagee ||8||3||
english: O Nanak, those who serve the True Guru are blessed and very fortunate. ||8||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਵੇਦ ਅਭਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa mool ved abhiaasaa ||
english: Brahma is the founder of the study of the Vedas.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਦੇਵ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: tis te upaje dev moh piaasaa ||
english: From him emanated the gods, enticed by desire.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: trai gun bharame naahee nij ghar vaasaa ||1||
english: They wander in the three qualities, and they do not dwell within their own home. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ham har raakhe satiguroo milaaiaa ||
english: The Lord has saved me; I have met the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat har naam driRaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He has implanted devotional worship of the Lord's Name, night and day. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: trai gun baanee braham ja(n)jaalaa ||
english: The songs of Brahma entangle people in the three qualities.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮਕਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: paR vaad vakhaanahi sir maare jamakaalaa ||
english: Reading about the debates and disputes, they are hit over the head by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਬੰਨਹਿ ਪੰਡ ਪਰਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tat na cheenahi ba(n)nahi pa(n)d paraalaa ||2||
english: They do not understand the essence of reality, and they gather their worthless bundles of straw. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਕੁਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh agiaan kumaarag paae ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs, in ignorance, take the path of evil.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har naam bisaariaa bahu karam driRaae ||
english: They forget the Lord's Name, and in its place, they establish all sorts of rituals.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੂਬੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhavajal doobe doojai bhaae ||3||
english: They drown in the terrifying world-ocean, in the love of duality. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa kaa muhataaj pa(n)dit kahaavai ||
english: Driven crazy, infatuated by Maya, they call themselves Pandits - religious scholars;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa raataa bahut dukh paavai ||
english: stained with corruption, they suffer terrible pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵੜਾ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jam kaa gal jevaRaa nit kaal sa(n)taavai ||4||
english: The noose of the Messenger of Death is around their necks; they are constantly tormented by death. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jamakaal neR na aavai ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach the Gurmukhs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: haumai doojaa sabad jalaavai ||
english: Through the Word of the Shabad, they burn away their ego and duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naame raate har gun gaavai ||5||
english: Attuned to the Name, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾਸੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa daasee bhagataa kee kaar kamaavai ||
english: Maya is the slave of the Lord's devotees; it works for them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: charanee laagai taa mahal paavai ||
english: One who falls at their feet attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sad hee niramal sahaj samaavai ||6||
english: He is forever immaculate; he is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: har kathaa sunahi se dhanava(n)t disahi jug maahee ||
english: Those who listen to the Lord's Sermon are seen to be the wealthy people in this world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: tin kau sabh nivahi anadin pooj karaahee ||
english: Everyone bows down to them, and adores them, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sahaje gun ravahi saache man maahee ||7||
english: They intuitively savor the Glories of the True Lord within their minds. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poorai satigur sabad sunaaiaa ||
english: The Perfect True Guru has revealed the Shabad;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ ਚਉਥੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: trai gun mete chauthai chit laaiaa ||
english: it eradicates the three qualities, and attunes the consciousness to the fourth state.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak haumai maar braham milaaiaa ||8||4||
english: O Nanak, subduing egotism, one is absorbed into God. ||8||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਵੇਦੁ ਪੜੈ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa ved paRai vaad vakhaanai ||
english: Brahma studied the Vedas, but these lead only to debates and disputes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar taamas aap na pachhaanai ||
english: He is filled with darkness; he does not understand himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa prabh paae gurasabad vakhaanai ||1||
english: And yet, if he chants the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he finds God. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa karau phir kaal na khaai ||
english: So serve the Guru, and you shall not be consumed by death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖਾਧੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: manamukh khaadhe doojai bhaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs have been consumed by the love of duality. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਸੀਧੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh praanee aparaadhee seedhe ||
english: Becoming Gurmukh, the sinful mortals are purified.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰੀਧੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad a(n)tar sahaj reedhe ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they find intuitive peace and poise deep within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਧੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: meraa prabh paaiaa gur kai sabad seedhe ||2||
english: I have found my God, through the Guru's Shabad, and I have been reformed. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur mele prabh aap milaae ||
english: God Himself unites us in Union with the True Guru,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mere prabh saache kai man bhaae ||
english: when we become pleasing to the Mind of my True God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har gun gaavahi sahaj subhaae ||3||
english: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, in the poise of celestial peace. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bin gur saache bharam bhulaae ||
english: Without the True Guru, they are deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhe sadaa bikh khaae ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs constantly eat poison.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jam da(n)d sahahi sadaa dukh paae ||4||
english: They are beaten by the Messenger of Death with his rod, and they suffer in constant pain. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮੂਆ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jamooaa na johai har kee saranaaee ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not catch sight of those who enter the Sanctuary of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar sach liv laaee ||
english: Subduing egotism, they lovingly center their consciousness on the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sadaa rahai har naam liv laaee ||5||
english: They keep their consciousness constantly focused on the Lord's Name. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi se jan niramal pavitaa ||
english: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are pure and immaculate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: man siu man milaai sabh jag jeetaa ||
english: Merging their minds into the Mind, they conquer the entire world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: in bidh kusal terai mere meetaa ||6||
english: In this way, you too shall find happiness, O my friend. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo seve so phal paae ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru are blessed with fruitful rewards.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hiradai naam vichahu aap gavaae ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides in their hearts; selfishness and conceit depart from within them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: anahad baanee sabad vajaae ||7||
english: The unstruck melody of the Shabad vibrates for them. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਵਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਨ ਸੀਧੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur te kavan kavan na seedho mere bhaaee ||
english: Who - who has not been purified by the True Guru, O my Siblings of Destiny?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਸੀਧੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhagatee seedhe dar sobhaa paaee ||
english: The devotees are purified, and honored in His Court.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam vadiaaee ||8||5||
english: O Nanak, greatness is in the Lord's Name. ||8||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: trai gun vakhaanai bharam na jaai ||
english: Those who speak of the three qualities - their doubts do not depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan na tootahi mukat na paai ||
english: Their bonds are not broken, and they do not obtain liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mukat daataa satigur jug maahi ||1||
english: The True Guru is the Bestower of liberation in this age. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh praanee bharam gavaai ||
english: Those mortals who become Gurmukh give up their doubts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sahaj dhun upajai har liv laai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The celestial music wells up, when they lovingly attune their consciousness to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਲੈ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: trai gun kaalai kee sir kaaraa ||
english: Those who are controlled by the three qualities have death hovering over their heads.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naam na chetahi upaavanahaaraa ||
english: They do not remember the Name of the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mar ja(n)mahi phir vaaro vaaraa ||2||
english: They die, and are reborn, over and over, again and again. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe guroo te bharam na jaaee ||
english: Those whose guru is spiritually blind - their doubts are not dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mool chhod laage doojai bhaaee ||
english: Abandoning the Source of all, they have become attached to the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bikh kaa maataa bikh maahi samaaee ||3||
english: Infected with poison, they are immersed in poison. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa kar mool ja(n)tr bharamaae ||
english: Believing Maya to be the source of all, they wander in doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu visariaa doojai bhaae ||
english: They have forgotten the Dear Lord, and they are in love with duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jis nadar kare so param gat paae ||4||
english: The supreme status is obtained only by those who are blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar saach baahar saach varataae ||
english: One who has Truth pervading within, radiates Truth outwardly as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਛਪੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਰਖੈ ਛਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saach na chhapai je ko rakhai chhapaae ||
english: The Truth does not remain hidden, even though one may try to hide it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: giaanee boojhahi sahaj subhaae ||5||
english: The spiritually wise know this intuitively. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saach rahiaa liv laae ||
english: The Gurmukhs keep their consciousness lovingly centered on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: haumai maaiaa sabad jalaae ||
english: Ego and Maya are burned away by the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੬॥
transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa mel milaae ||6||
english: My True God unites them in His Union. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur daataa sabad sunaae ||
english: The True Guru, The Giver, preaches the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat raakhai thaak rahaae ||
english: He controls, and restrains, and holds still the wandering mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: poore gur te sojhee paae ||7||
english: Understanding is obtained through the Perfect Guru. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa srisat siraj jin goee ||
english: The Creator Himself has created the universe; He Himself shall destroy it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na koee ||
english: Without Him, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੮॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh boojhai koee ||8||6||
english: O Nanak, how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this! ||8||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naam amolak guramukh paavai ||
english: The Gurmukhs obtain the Naam, the Priceless Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naamo seve naam sahaj samaavai ||
english: They serve the Name, and through the Name, they are absorbed in intuitive peace and poise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam rasanaa nit gaavai ||
english: With their tongues, they continually sing the Ambrosial Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis no kripaa kare so har ras paavai ||1||
english: They obtain the Lord's Name; the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਪਉ ਜਗਦੀਸਾ ॥
transliteration: anadin hiradai japau jagadeesaa ||
english: Night and day, within your heart, meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਸੂਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh paavau param pad sookhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Gurmukhs obtain the supreme state of peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੂਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: hiradai sookh bhaiaa paragaas ||
english: Peace comes to fill the hearts of those

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh gaavahi sach gunataas ||
english: who, as Gurmukh, sing of the True Lord, the treasure of excellence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: daasan daas nit hovahi daas ||
english: They become the constant slaves of the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: grih kuta(n)b mahi sadaa udaas ||2||
english: Within their households and families, they remain always detached. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jeevan mukat guramukh ko hoee ||
english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, become Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: param padaarath paavai soee ||
english: They alone obtain the supreme treasure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: trai gun mete niramal hoee ||
english: Eradicating the three qualities, they become pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sahaje saach milai prabh soee ||3||
english: They are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: moh kuta(n)b siu preet na hoi ||
english: Emotional attachment to family does not exist,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa hiradai vasiaa sach soi ||
english: when the True Lord abides within the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh man bedhiaa asathir hoi ||
english: The mind of the Gurmukh is pierced through and held steady.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: hukam pachhaanai boojhai sach soi ||4||
english: One who recognizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command understands the True Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: too(n) karataa mai avar na koi ||
english: You are the Creator Lord - there is no other for me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tujh sevee tujh te pat hoi ||
english: I serve You, and through You, I obtain honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਗਾਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa karahi gaavaa prabh soi ||
english: God showers His Mercy, and I sing His Praises.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naam ratan sabh jag mahi loi ||5||
english: The light of the jewel of the Naam permeates the entire world. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh baanee meethee laagee ||
english: To the Gurmukhs, the Word of God's Bani seems so sweet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar bigasai anadin liv laagee ||
english: Deep within, their hearts blossom forth; night and day, they lovingly center themselves on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaje sach miliaa parasaadee ||
english: The True Lord is intuitively obtained, by His Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: satigur paaiaa poorai vadabhaagee ||6||
english: The True Guru is obtained by the destiny of perfect good fortune. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa duramat dukh naas ||
english: Egotism, possessiveness, evil-mindedness and suffering depart,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jab hiradai raam naam gunataas ||
english: when the Lord's Name, the Ocean of Virtue, comes to dwell within the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh budh pragatee prabh jaas ||
english: The intellect of the Gurmukhs is awakened, and they praise God,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿਆ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jab hiradai raviaa charan nivaas ||7||
english: when the Lord's Lotus Feet come to dwell within the heart. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis naam dei soee jan paae ||
english: They alone receive the Naam, unto whom it is given.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh mele aap gavaae ||
english: The Gurmukhs shed their ego, and merge with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hiradai saachaa naam vasaae ||
english: The True Name abides within their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੮॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak sahaje saach samaae ||8||7||
english: O Nanak, they are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord. ||8||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਭੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man hee man savaariaa bhai sahaj subhaai ||
english: The mind has intuitively healed itself, through the Fear of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad man ra(n)giaa liv laai ||
english: The mind is attuned to the Word of the Shabad; it is lovingly attuned to the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nij ghar vasiaa prabh kee rajaai ||1||
english: It abides within its own home, in harmony with the Lord's Will. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਜਾਇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur seviai jaai abhimaan ||
english: Serving the True Guru, egotistical pride departs,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: govid paaeeai gunee nidhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and the Lord of the Universe, the Treasure of Excellence, is obtained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man bairaagee jaa sabad bhau khaai ||
english: The mind becomes detached and free of desire, when it experiences the Fear of God, through the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh niramalaa sabh tai rahiaa samaai ||
english: My Immaculate God is pervading and contained among all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te milai milaai ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, one is united in His Union. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har daasan ko daas sukh paae ||
english: The slave of the Lord's slave attains peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: meraa har prabh in bidh paaiaa jaae ||
english: My Lord God is found in this way.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har kirapaa te raam gun gaae ||3||
english: By the Grace of the Lord, one comes to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਹੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dhrig bahu jeevan jit har naam na lagai piaar ||
english: Cursed is that long life, during which love for the Lord's Name is not enshrined.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dhrig sej sukhaalee kaaman moh gubaar ||
english: Cursed is that comfortable bed which lures one into the darkness of attachment to sexual desire.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tin saphal janam jin naam adhaar ||4||
english: Fruitful is the birth of that person who takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dhrig dhrig grihu kuta(n)b jit har preet na hoi ||
english: Cursed, cursed is that home and family, in which the love of the Lord is not embraced.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: soee hamaaraa meet jo har gun gaavai soi ||
english: He alone is my friend, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: har naam binaa mai avar na koi ||5||
english: Without the Lord's Name, there is no other for me. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur te ham gat pat paaee ||
english: From the True Guru, I have obtained salvation and honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਦੂਖੁ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har naam dhiaaiaa dookh sagal mitaaee ||
english: I have meditated on the Name of the Lord, and all my sufferings have been erased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d har naam liv laaee ||6||
english: I am in constant bliss, lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਰੀਰ ਸੁਧਿ ਭਈ ॥
transliteration: gur miliai ham kau sareer sudh bhaee ||
english: Meeting the Guru, I came to understand my body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਭ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਈ ॥
transliteration: haumai trisanaa sabh agan bujhaee ||
english: The fires of ego and desire have been totally quenched.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹਿ ਲਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: binase krodh khimaa gahi laee ||7||
english: Anger has been dispelled, and I have grasped hold of tolerance. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har aape kripaa kare naam devai ||
english: The Lord Himself showers His Mercy, and bestows the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ratan ko viralaa levai ||
english: How rare is that Gurmukh, who receives the jewel of the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵੈ ॥੮॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak gun gaavai har alakh abhevai ||8||8||
english: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Unknowable, the Incomprehensible. ||8||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 3 ||
english: Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫੇਰੇ ਤੇ ਵੇਮੁਖ ਬੁਰੇ ਦਿਸੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur te jo muh phere te vemukh bure disa(n)n ||
english: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru, are seen to be unfaithful and evil.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਨਾ ਲਹੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin badhe maareean phir velaa naa laha(n)n ||1||
english: They shall be bound and beaten night and day; they shall not have this opportunity again. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har har raakhahu kripaa dhaar ||
english: O Lord, please shower Your Mercy upon me, and save me!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat melaai prabh har hiradai har gun saar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Lord God, please lead me to meet the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, that I may dwell upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord within my heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: se bhagat har bhaavade jo guramukh bhaai chala(n)n ||
english: Those devotees are pleasing to the Lord, who as Gurmukh, walk in harmony with the Way of the Lord's Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਨਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮੁਏ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap chhod sevaa karan jeevat mue raha(n)n ||2||
english: Subduing their selfishness and conceit, and performing selfless service, they remain dead while yet alive. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰਾਣ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jis daa pi(n)d paraan hai tis kee sir kaar ||
english: The body and the breath of life belong to the One - perform the greatest service to Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ohu kiu manahu visaareeai har rakheeai hiradai dhaar ||3||
english: Why forget Him from your mind? Keep the Lord enshrined in your heart. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naam miliai pat paaeeai naam ma(n)niai sukh hoi ||
english: Receiving the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains honor; believing in the Naam, one is at peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: satigur te naam paaeeai karam milai prabh soi ||4||
english: The Naam is obtained from the True Guru; by His Grace, God is found. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ ਓਇ ਭ੍ਰਮਦੇ ਨਾ ਟਿਕੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur te jo muhu phere oi bhramade naa tika(n)n ||
english: They turn their faces away from the True Guru; they continue to wander aimlessly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤਿ ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਝਲਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਪਏ ਪਚੰਨਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: dharat asamaan na jhalaee vich visataa pae pacha(n)n ||5||
english: They are not accepted by the earth or the sky; they fall into manure, and rot. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu jag bharam bhulaaiaa moh thagaulee paai ||
english: This world is deluded by doubt - it has taken the drug of emotional attachment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਭਿਟੈ ਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jinaa satigur bhetiaa tin neR na bhitai maai ||6||
english: Maya does not draw near those who have met with the True Guru. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੋ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevan so sohane haumai mail gavaai ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru are very beautiful; they cast off the filth of selfishness and conceit.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sabad rate se niramale chalahi satigur bhaai ||7||
english: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are immaculate and pure. They walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har prabh daataa ek too(n) too(n) aape bakhas milaai ||
english: O Lord God, You are the One and Only Giver; You forgive us, and unite us with Yourself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
transliteration: jan naanak saranaagatee jiu bhaavai tivai chhadaai ||8||1||9||
english: Servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; if it is Your Will, please save him! ||8||1||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਕਰਹਲੇ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 karahale ||
english: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl, Karhalay:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਲੇ ਮਨ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: karahale man paradeseeaa kiu mileeai har maai ||
english: O my wandering mind, you are like a camel - how will you meet the Lord, your Mother?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਗਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur bhaag poorai paaiaa gal miliaa piaaraa aai ||1||
english: When I found the Guru, by the destiny of perfect good fortune, my Beloved came and embraced me. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa satigur purakh dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O camel-like mind, meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa veechaareeaa har raam naam dhiaai ||
english: O camel-like mind, contemplate the Lord, and meditate on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeai har aape lae chhadaai ||2||
english: When you are called to answer for your account, the Lord Himself shall release you. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa at niramalaa mal laagee haumai aai ||
english: O camel-like mind, you were once very pure; the filth of egotism has now attached itself to you.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਤਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paratakh pir ghar naal piaaraa vichhuR chotaa khaai ||3||
english: Your Beloved Husband is now manifest before you in your own home, but you are separated from Him, and you suffer such pain! ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਾਲਿ ਭਾਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa mere preetamaa har ridai bhaal bhaalaai ||
english: O my beloved camel-like mind, search for the Lord within your own heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: upaai kitai na labhaee gur hiradai har dekhaai ||4||
english: He cannot be found by any device; the Guru will show you the Lord within your heart. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa mere preetamaa din rain har liv laai ||
english: O my beloved camel-like mind, day and night, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ghar jaai paavahi ra(n)g mahalee gur mele har melaai ||5||
english: Return to your own home, and find the palace of love; meet the Guru, and meet the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa too(n) meet meraa paakha(n)d lobh tajaai ||
english: O camel-like mind, you are my friend; abandon hypocrisy and greed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d lobhee maareeai jam da(n)d dei sajaai ||6||
english: The hypocritical and the greedy are struck down; the Messenger of Death punishes them with his club. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤੂੰ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa mere praan too(n) mail paakha(n)d bharam gavaai ||
english: O camel-like mind, you are my breath of life; rid yourself of the pollution of hypocrisy and doubt.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har a(n)mrit sar gur pooriaa mil sa(n)gatee mal lahi jaai ||7||
english: The Perfect Guru is the Ambrosial Pool of the Lord's Nectar; join the Holy Congregation, and wash away this pollution. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa mere piaariaa ik gur kee sikh sunaai ||
english: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, listen only to the Teachings of the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: ihu mohu maaiaa pasariaa a(n)t saath na koee jaai ||8||
english: This emotional attachment to Maya is so pervasive. Ultimately, nothing shall go along with anyone. ||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੀਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa mere saajanaa har kharach leeaa pat paai ||
english: O camel-like mind, my good friend, take the supplies of the Lord's Name, and obtain honor.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: har daragah painaaiaa har aap laiaa gal laai ||9||
english: In the Court of the Lord, you shall be robed with honor, and the Lord Himself shall embrace you. ||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa gur ma(n)niaa guramukh kaar kamaai ||
english: O camel-like mind, one who surrenders to the Guru becomes Gurmukh, and works for the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਦੜੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
transliteration: gur aagai kar jodaRee jan naanak har melaai ||10||1||
english: Offer your prayers to the Guru; O servant Nanak, He shall unite you with the Lord. ||10||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gauree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa veechaareeaa veechaar dekh samaal ||
english: O contemplative camel-like mind, contemplate and look carefully.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਬਨ ਵਾਸੀਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ban phir thake ban vaaseeaa pir guramat ridai nihaal ||1||
english: The forest-dwellers have grown weary of wandering in the forests; following the Guru's Teachings, see your Husband Lord within your heart. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa gur govi(n)d samaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O camel-like mind, dwell upon the Guru and the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਾਥਿਆ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa veechaareeaa manamukh phaathiaa mahaa jaal ||
english: O camel-like contemplative mind, the self-willed manmukhs are caught in the great net.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh praanee mukat hai har har naam samaal ||2||
english: The mortal who becomes Gurmukh is liberated, dwelling upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa mere piaariaa satasa(n)gat satigur bhaal ||
english: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, seek the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat lag har dhiaaeeai har har chalai terai naal ||3||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, meditate on the Lord, and the Lord, Har, Har, shall go along with you. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa vadabhaageeaa har ek nadar nihaal ||
english: O very fortunate camel-like mind, with one Glance of Grace from the Lord, you shall be enraptured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aap chhadaae chhuteeai satigur charan samaal ||4||
english: If the Lord Himself saves you, then you shall be saved. Dwell upon the Feet of the True Guru. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa mere piaariaa vich dehee jot samaal ||
english: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, dwell upon the Divine Light within the body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਦਇਆਲਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur nau nidh naam vikhaaliaa har daat karee daiaal ||5||
english: The Guru has shown me the nine treasures of the Naam. The Merciful Lord has bestowed this gift. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਚੰਚਲਾ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਛਡਿ ਵਿਕਰਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa too(n) cha(n)chalaa chaturaaee chhad vikaraal ||
english: O camel-like mind, you are so fickle; give up your cleverness and corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: har har naam samaal too(n) har mukat kare a(n)t kaal ||6||
english: Dwell upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; at the very last moment, the Lord shall liberate you. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: man karahalaa vadabhaageeaa too(n) giaan ratan samaal ||
english: O camel-like mind, you are so very fortunate; dwell upon the jewel of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਖੜਗੁ ਹਥਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿਅੜਾ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur giaan khaRag hath dhaariaa jam maariaRaa jamakaal ||7||
english: You hold in your hands the sword of the Guru's spiritual wisdom; with this destroyer of death, kill the Messenger of Death. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭਵਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar nidhaan man karahale bhram bhavahi baahar bhaal ||
english: The treasure is deep within, O camel-like mind, but you wander around outside in doubt, searching for it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਲਧੜਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੮॥
transliteration: gur purakh pooraa bhetiaa har sajan ladhaRaa naal ||8||
english: Meeting the Perfect Guru, the Primal Being, you shall discover that the Lord, your Best Friend, is with you. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜੇ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g rataRe man karahale har ra(n)g sadaa samaal ||
english: You are engrossed in pleasures, O camel-like mind; dwell upon the Lord's lasting love instead!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੯॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g kade na utarai gur sevaa sabad samaal ||9||
english: The color of the Lord's Love never fades away; serve the Guru, and dwell upon the Word of the Shabad. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪੰਖੀ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਕਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: ham pa(n)khee man karahale har taravar purakh akaal ||
english: We are birds, O camel-like mind; the Lord, the Immortal Primal Being, is the tree.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee guramukh paaiaa jan naanak naam samaal ||10||2||
english: The Gurmukhs are very fortunate - they find it. O servant Nanak, dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਤ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jab ihu man mahi karat gumaanaa ||
english: When this mind is filled with pride,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਬਾਵਰੁ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tab ihu baavar phirat bigaanaa ||
english: then it wanders around like a madman and a lunatic.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਹੂਆ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jab ihu hooaa sagal kee reenaa ||
english: But when it becomes the dust of all,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਮਈਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa te ramaeeaa ghat ghat cheenaa ||1||
english: then it recognizes the Lord in each and every heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਫਲੁ ਮਸਕੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaj suhelaa phal masakeenee ||
english: The fruit of humility is intuitive peace and pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur apunai mohi daan deenee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My True Guru has given me this gift. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: jab kis kau ihu jaanas ma(n)daa ||
english: When he believes others to be bad,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਸਗਲੇ ਇਸੁ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਫੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: tab sagale is melahi pha(n)daa ||
english: then everyone lays traps for him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰ ਤੇਰ ਜਬ ਇਨਹਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mer ter jab inahi chukaaee ||
english: But when he stops thinking in terms of 'mine' and 'yours',

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਇਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa te is sa(n)g nahee bairaaee ||2||
english: then no one is angry with him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jab in apunee apanee dhaaree ||
english: When he clings to 'my own, my own',

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tab is kau hai musakal bhaaree ||
english: then he is in deep trouble.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jab in karanaihaar pachhaataa ||
english: But when he recognizes the Creator Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tab is no naahee kichh taataa ||3||
english: then he is free of torment. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਮੋਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jab in apuno baadhio mohaa ||
english: When he entangles himself in emotional attachment,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aavai jaai sadaa jam johaa ||
english: he comes and goes in reincarnation, under the constant gaze of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: jab is te sabh binase bharamaa ||
english: But when all his doubts are removed,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੇਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bhed naahee hai paarabrahamaa ||4||
english: then there is no difference between him and the Supreme Lord God. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਭੇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: jab in kichh kar maane bhedaa ||
english: When he perceives differences,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੂਖ ਡੰਡ ਅਰੁ ਖੇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: tab te dookh da(n)d ar khedaa ||
english: then he suffers pain, punishment and sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੀ ਬੂਝਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jab in eko ekee boojhiaa ||
english: But when he recognizes the One and Only Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: tab te is no sabh kichh soojhiaa ||5||
english: he understands everything. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਰਥੀ ॥
transliteration: jab ihu dhaavai maaiaa arathee ||
english: When he runs around for the sake of Maya and riches,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ਨਹ ਤਿਸ ਲਾਥੀ ॥
transliteration: nah tripataavai nah tis laathee ||
english: he is not satisfied, and his desires are not quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਜਉਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jab is te ihu hoio jaulaa ||
english: But when he runs away from Maya,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਛੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਚਲੀ ਉਠਿ ਕਉਲਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: peechhai laag chalee uth kaulaa ||6||
english: then the Goddess of Wealth gets up and follows him. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jau satigur milio ||
english: When, by His Grace, the True Guru is met,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਜਲਿਓ ॥
transliteration: man ma(n)dar mahi deepak jalio ||
english: the lamp is lit within the temple of the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਤ ਹਾਰ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jeet haar kee sojhee karee ||
english: When he realizes what victory and defeat really are,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਇਸੁ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਰੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tau is ghar kee keemat paree ||7||
english: then he comes to appreciate the true value of his own home. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਏਕੈ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan sabh kichh ekai ||
english: The One Lord is the Creator of all things, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬੁਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੈ ॥
transliteration: aape budh beechaar bibekai ||
english: He Himself is wisdom, contemplation and discerning understanding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: door na nerai sabh kai sa(n)gaa ||
english: He is not far away; He is near at hand, with all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: sach saalaahan naanak har ra(n)gaa ||8||1||
english: So praise the True One, O Nanak, with love! ||8||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te naame laagaa ||
english: Serving the Guru, one is committed to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: tis kau miliaa jis masatak bhaagaa ||
english: It is received only by those who have such good destiny inscribed upon their foreheads.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis kai hiradai raviaa soi ||
english: The Lord dwells within their hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man tan seetal nihachal hoi ||1||
english: Their minds and bodies become peaceful and stable. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa keeratan kar man mere ||
english: O my mind, sing such Praises of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਜੋ ਕਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: eehaa oohaa jo kaam terai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: which shall be of use to you here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਭਉ ਅਪਦਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat bhau apadaa jaai ||
english: Meditating on Him, fear and misfortune depart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤ ਮਨੂਆ ਆਵੈ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat manooaa aavai thaai ||
english: and the wandering mind is held steady.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat phir dookh na laagai ||
english: Meditating on Him, suffering shall never again overtake you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਇਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaas japat ih haumai bhaagai ||2||
english: Meditating on Him, this ego runs away. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਵਸਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat vas aavahi pa(n)chaa ||
english: Meditating on Him, the five passions are overcome.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਰਿਦੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਚਾ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat ridai a(n)mrit sa(n)chaa ||
english: Meditating on Him, Ambrosial Nectar is collected in the heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਇਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat ih trisanaa bujhai ||
english: Meditating on Him, this desire is quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਝੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaas japat har daragah sijhai ||3||
english: Meditating on Him, one is approved in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਅਪਰਾਧ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat kot mitahi aparaadh ||
english: Meditating on Him, millions of mistakes are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸਾਧ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat har hovahi saadh ||
english: Meditating on Him, one becomes Holy, blessed by the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat man seetal hovai ||
english: Meditating on Him, the mind is cooled and soothed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਲੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jaas japat mal sagalee khovai ||4||
english: Meditating on Him, all filth is washed away. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat ratan har milai ||
english: Meditating on Him, the jewel of the Lord is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਿਲੈ ॥
transliteration: bahur na chhodai har sa(n)g hilai ||
english: One is reconciled with the Lord, and shall not abandon Him again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਈ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat kaee baiku(n)th vaas ||
english: Meditating on Him, many acquire a home in the heavens.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jaas japat sukh sahaj nivaas ||5||
english: Meditating on Him, one abides in intuitive peace. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਇਹ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਪੋਹਤ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat ih agan na pohat ||
english: Meditating on Him, one is not affected by this fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਇਹੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹਤ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat ihu kaal na johat ||
english: Meditating on Him, one is not under the gaze of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਾਥਾ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat teraa niramal maathaa ||
english: Meditating on Him, your forehead shall be immaculate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jaas japat sagalaa dukh laathaa ||6||
english: Meditating on Him, all pains are destroyed. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat musakal kachhoo na banai ||
english: Meditating on Him, no difficulties are encountered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਣਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਧੁਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat sun anahat dhunai ||
english: Meditating on Him, one hears the unstruck melody.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਇਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat ih niramal soi ||
english: Meditating on Him, one acquires this pure reputation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਮਲੁ ਸੀਧਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jaas japat kamal seedhaa hoi ||7||
english: Meditating on Him, the heart-lotus is turned upright. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸੁਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gur subh drisat sabh oopar karee ||
english: The Guru has bestowed His Glance of Grace upon all,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੇ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jis kai hiradai ma(n)tr de haree ||
english: within whose hearts the Lord has implanted His Mantra.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਖੰਡ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਚੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: akha(n)d keeratan tin bhojan chooraa ||
english: The unbroken Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is their food and nourishment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jis satigur pooraa ||8||2||
english: Says Nanak, they have the Perfect True Guru. ||8||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad rid a(n)tar dhaarai ||
english: Those who implant the Word of the Guru's Shabad within their hearts

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch janaa siu sa(n)g nivaarai ||
english: cut their connections with the five passions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਵਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: das i(n)dree kar raakhai vaas ||
english: They keep the ten organs under their control;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਆਤਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa kai aatamai hoi paragaas ||1||
english: their souls are enlightened. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aisee driRataa taa kai hoi ||
english: They alone acquire such stability,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau daiaa maiaa prabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: whom God blesses with His Mercy and Grace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: saajan dusat jaa kai ek samaanai ||
english: Friend and foe are one and the same to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਤੇਤਾ ਗਿਆਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jetaa bolan tetaa giaanai ||
english: Whatever they speak is wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਤੇਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jetaa sunanaa tetaa naam ||
english: Whatever they hear is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਪੇਖਨੁ ਤੇਤਾ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jetaa pekhan tetaa dhiaan ||2||
english: Whatever they see is meditation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਗਣੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sahaje jaagan sahaje soi ||
english: They awaken in peace and poise; they sleep in peace and poise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਤਾ ਜਾਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sahaje hotaa jaai s hoi ||
english: That which is meant to be, automatically happens.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sahaj bairaag sahaje hee hasanaa ||
english: In peace and poise, they remain detached; in peace and poise, they laugh.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਚੂਪ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sahaje choop sahaje hee japanaa ||3||
english: In peace and poise, they remain silent; in peace and poise, they chant. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sahaje bhojan sahaje bhaau ||
english: In peace and poise they eat; in peace and poise they love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਰਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sahaje mitio sagal duraau ||
english: The illusion of duality is easily and totally removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: sahaje hoaa saadhoo sa(n)g ||
english: They naturally join the Saadh Sangat, the Society of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sahaj milio paarabraham nisa(n)g ||4||
english: In peace and poise, they meet and merge with the Supreme Lord God. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaje grih mahi sahaj udaasee ||
english: They are at peace in their homes, and they are at peace while detached.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaje dubidhaa tan kee naasee ||
english: In peace, their bodies' duality is eliminated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai sahaj man bhaiaa ana(n)d ||
english: Bliss comes naturally to their minds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: taa kau bhetiaa paramaana(n)d ||5||
english: They meet the Lord, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਓ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sahaje a(n)mrit peeo naam ||
english: In peaceful poise, they drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਕੀਨੋ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sahaje keeno jee ko daan ||
english: In peace and poise, they give to the poor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਰਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sahaj kathaa mahi aatam rasiaa ||
english: Their souls naturally delight in the Lord's Sermon.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਵਸਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: taa kai sa(n)g abinaasee vasiaa ||6||
english: The Imperishable Lord abides with them. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਆਸਣੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sahaje aasan asathir bhaaiaa ||
english: In peace and poise, they assume the unchanging position.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਅਨਹਤ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sahaje anahat sabad vajaaiaa ||
english: In peace and poise, the unstruck vibration of the Shabad resounds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sahaje run jhunakaar suhaaiaa ||
english: In peace and poise, the celestial bells resound.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: taa kai ghar paarabraham samaaiaa ||7||
english: Within their homes, the Supreme Lord God is pervading. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪਰਿਓ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: sahaje jaa kau pario karamaa ||
english: With intuitive ease, they meet the Lord, according to their karma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: sahaje gur bhetio sach dharamaa ||
english: With intuitive ease, they meet with the Guru, in the true Dharma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai sahaj bhaiaa so jaanai ||
english: Those who know, attain the poise of intuitive peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak daas taa kai kurabaanai ||8||3||
english: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||8||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਗਰਭ ਵਾਸ ਤੇ ਟਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: prathame garabh vaas te tariaa ||
english: First, they come forth from the womb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੁਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr kuta(n)b sa(n)g juriaa ||
english: They become attached to their children, spouses and families.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੋਜਨੁ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਪਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bhojan anik prakaar bahu kapare ||
english: The foods of various sorts and appearances,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਪਰ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰਹਿਗੇ ਬਪੁਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarapar gavan karahige bapure ||1||
english: will surely pass away, O wretched mortal! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ਜੋ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਟਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kavan asathaan jo kabahu na tarai ||
english: What is that place which never perishes?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kavan sabad jit duramat harai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: What is that Word by which the dirt of the mind is removed? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪੁਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: i(n)dr puree mahi sarapar maranaa ||
english: In the Realm of Indra, death is sure and certain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੁਰੀ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
transliteration: braham puree nihachal nahee rahanaa ||
english: The Realm of Brahma shall not remain permanent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਪੁਰੀ ਕਾ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਕਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: siv puree kaa hoigaa kaalaa ||
english: The Realm of Shiva shall also perish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਤਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: trai gun maaiaa binas bitaalaa ||2||
english: The three dispositions, Maya and the demons shall vanish. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨ ਅਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gir tar dharan gagan ar taare ||
english: The mountains, the trees, the earth, the sky and the stars;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਪਵਣੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਨੀਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: rav sas pavan paavak neeraare ||
english: the sun, the moon, the wind, water and fire;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਬਰਤ ਅਰੁ ਭੇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: dinas rain barat ar bhedaa ||
english: day and night, fasting days and their determination;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬਿਨਸਹਿਗੇ ਬੇਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saasat si(n)mrit binasahige bedaa ||3||
english: the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas shall pass away. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਪੋਥੀ ॥
transliteration: teerath dev dehuraa pothee ||
english: The sacred shrines of pilgrimage, gods, temples and holy books;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਸੋਚ ਪਾਕ ਹੋਤੀ ॥
transliteration: maalaa tilak soch paak hotee ||
english: rosaries, ceremonial tilak marks on the forehead, meditative people, the pure, and the performers of burnt offerings;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੋਤੀ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਪਰਸਾਦਨ ਭੋਗਾ ॥
transliteration: dhotee da(n)daut parasaadan bhogaa ||
english: wearing loin cloths, bowing in reverence and the enjoyment of sacred foods

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰੈਗੋ ਸਗਲੋ ਲੋਗਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gavan karaigo sagalo logaa ||4||
english: - all these, and all people, shall pass away. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਵਰਨ ਤੁਰਕ ਅਰੁ ਹਿੰਦੂ ॥
transliteration: jaat varan turak ar hi(n)doo ||
english: Social classes, races, Muslims and Hindus;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਿੰਦੂ ॥
transliteration: pas pa(n)khee anik jon ji(n)doo ||
english: beasts, birds and the many varieties of beings and creatures;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal paasaar deesai paasaaraa ||
english: the entire world and the visible universe

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇਗੋ ਸਗਲ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: binas jaaigo sagal aakaaraa ||5||
english: - all forms of existence shall pass away. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
