transliteration: sahaj siphat bhagat tat giaanaa ||
english: Through the Praises of the Lord, devotional worship, spiritual wisdom and the essence of reality,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d nihachal sach thaanaa ||
english: eternal bliss and the imperishable true place are obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਣ ਰਸੈ ॥
transliteration: tahaa sa(n)gat saadh gun rasai ||
english: There, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord's Glorious Praises are sung with love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਭਉ ਨਗਰੁ ਤਹਾ ਸਦ ਵਸੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: anabhau nagar tahaa sad vasai ||6||
english: There, in the city of fearlessness, He dwells forever. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਭਉ ਭਰਮਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tah bhau bharamaa sog na chi(n)taa ||
english: There is no fear, doubt, suffering or anxiety there;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaavan mirat na hotaa ||
english: there is no coming or going, and no death there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨਹਤ ਆਖਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tah sadaa ana(n)d anahat aakhaare ||
english: There is eternal bliss, and the unstruck celestial music there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਵਸਹਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਆਧਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bhagat vasahi keeratan aadhaare ||7||
english: The devotees dwell there, with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises as their support. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham kaa a(n)t na paar ||
english: There is no end or limitation to the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kaun karai taa kaa beechaar ||
english: Who can embrace His contemplation?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jis kirapaa karai ||
english: Says Nanak, when the Lord showers His Mercy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ॥੮॥੪॥
transliteration: nihachal thaan saadhasa(n)g tarai ||8||4||
english: the imperishable home is obtained; in the Saadh Sangat, you shall be saved. ||8||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jo is maare soee sooraa ||
english: One who kills this is a spiritual hero.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jo is maare soee pooraa ||
english: One who kills this is perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jo is maare tisahi vadiaaee ||
english: One who kills this obtains glorious greatness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo is maare tis kaa dukh jaaee ||1||
english: One who kills this is freed of suffering. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ਜਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aisaa koi j dubidhaa maar gavaavai ||
english: How rare is such a person, who kills and casts off duality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: isahi maar raaj jog kamaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Killing it, he attains Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jo is maare tis kau bhau naahi ||
english: One who kills this has no fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jo is maare s naam samaahi ||
english: One who kills this is absorbed in the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
transliteration: jo is maare tis kee trisanaa bujhai ||
english: One who kills this has his desires quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਝੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo is maare s daragah sijhai ||2||
english: One who kills this is approved in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jo is maare so dhanava(n)taa ||
english: One who kills this is wealthy and prosperous.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਤਿਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jo is maare so pativa(n)taa ||
english: One who kills this is honorable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਤੀ ॥
transliteration: jo is maare soee jatee ||
english: One who kills this is truly a celibate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਤੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo is maare tis hovai gatee ||3||
english: One who kills this attains salvation. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਆਇਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jo is maare tis kaa aaiaa ganee ||
english: One who kills this - his coming is auspicious.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਧਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jo is maare s nihachal dhanee ||
english: One who kills this is steady and wealthy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jo is maare so vadabhaagaa ||
english: One who kills this is very fortunate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jo is maare s anadin jaagaa ||4||
english: One who kills this remains awake and aware, night and day. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jo is maare s jeevan mukataa ||
english: One who kills this is Jivan Mukta, liberated while yet alive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jo is maare tis kee niramal jugataa ||
english: One who kills this lives a pure lifestyle.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jo is maare soee sugiaanee ||
english: One who kills this is spiritually wise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jo is maare s sahaj dhiaanee ||5||
english: One who kills this meditates intuitively. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਰੈ ॥
transliteration: is maaree bin thaai na parai ||
english: Without killing this, one is not acceptable,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ਜਾਪ ਤਪ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kot karam jaap tap karai ||
english: Even though one may perform millions of rituals, chants and austerities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
transliteration: is maaree bin janam na mitai ||
english: Without killing this, one does not escape the cycle of reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: is maaree bin jam te nahee chhutai ||6||
english: Without killing this, one does not escape death. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: is maaree bin giaan na hoee ||
english: Without killing this, one does not obtain spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਧੋਈ ॥
transliteration: is maaree bin jooth na dhoee ||
english: Without killing this, one's impurity is not washed off.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
transliteration: is maaree bin sabh kichh mailaa ||
english: Without killing this, everything is filthy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਉਲਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: is maaree bin sabh kichh jaulaa ||7||
english: Without killing this, everything is a losing game. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau bhae kripaal kripaa nidh ||
english: When the Lord, the Treasure of Mercy, bestows His Mercy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਈ ਖਲਾਸੀ ਹੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
transliteration: tis bhaee khalaasee hoee sagal sidh ||
english: one obtains release, and attains total perfection.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gur dubidhaa jaa kee hai maaree ||
english: One whose duality has been killed by the Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak so braham beechaaree ||8||5||
english: says Nanak, contemplates God. ||8||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: har siu jurai ta sabh ko meet ||
english: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, then everyone is his friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: har siu jurai ta nihachal cheet ||
english: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, then his consciousness is steady.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕਾੜੑਾ ॥
transliteration: har siu jurai na viaapai kaaRhaa ||
english: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, he is not afflicted by worries.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har siu jurai ta hoi nisataaraa ||1||
english: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, he is emancipated. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: re man mere too(n) har siu jor ||
english: O my mind, unite yourself with the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaaj tuhaarai naahee hor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Nothing else is of any use to you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਜੋ ਦੁਨੀਆਦਾਰ ॥
transliteration: vade vade jo duneeaadaar ||
english: The great and powerful people of the world

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo kaaj naahee gaavaar ||
english: are of no use, you fool!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲੁ ਸੁਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: har kaa daas neech kul sunahi ||
english: The Lord's slave may be born of humble origins,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਧਰਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis kai sa(n)g khin mahi udharahi ||2||
english: but in his company, you shall be saved in an instant. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kot majan jaa kai sun naam ||
english: Hearing the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is equal to millions of cleansing baths.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: kot poojaa jaa kai hai dhiaan ||
english: Meditating on it is equal to millions of worship ceremonies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: kot pu(n)n sun har kee baanee ||
english: Hearing the Word of the Lord's Bani is equal to giving millions in alms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਫਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kot phalaa gur te bidh jaanee ||3||
english: To know the way, through the Guru, is equal to millions of rewards. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚੇਤ ॥
transliteration: man apune mahi phir phir chet ||
english: Within your mind, over and over again, think of Him,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ॥
transliteration: binas jaahi maaiaa ke het ||
english: and your love of Maya shall depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: har abinaasee tumarai sa(n)g ||
english: The Imperishable Lord is always with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਚੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: man mere rach raam kai ra(n)g ||4||
english: O my mind, immerse yourself in the Love of the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਭ ਭੂਖ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai kaam utarai sabh bhookh ||
english: Working for Him, all hunger departs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਦੂਤ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai kaam na johahi doot ||
english: Working for Him, the Messenger of Death will not be watching you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਗਮਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai kaam teraa vad gamar ||
english: Working for Him, you shall obtain glorious greatness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਮਰੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jaa kai kaam hovahi too(n) amar ||5||
english: Working for Him, you shall become immortal. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਡਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jaa ke chaakar kau nahee daan ||
english: His servant does not suffer punishment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jaa ke chaakar kau nahee baan ||
english: His servant suffers no loss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਫਤਰਿ ਪੁਛੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai daphatar puchhai na lekhaa ||
english: In His Court, His servant does not have to answer for his account.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਸੇਖਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: taa kee chaakaree karahu bisekhaa ||6||
english: So serve Him with distinction. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਊਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai oon naahee kaahoo baat ||
english: He is not lacking in anything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਨੇਕਹਿ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ekahi aap anekahi bhaat ||
english: He Himself is One, although He appears in so many forms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee drisat hoi sadaa nihaal ||
english: By His Glance of Grace, you shall be happy forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ॥੭॥
transliteration: man mere kar taa kee ghaal ||7||
english: So work for Him, O my mind. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੂੜਾ ॥
transliteration: naa ko chatur naahee ko mooRaa ||
english: No one is clever, and no one is foolish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naa ko heen naahee ko sooraa ||
english: No one is weak, and no one is a hero.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jit ko laaiaa tit hee laagaa ||
english: As the Lord attaches someone, so is he attached.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੮॥੬॥
transliteration: so sevak naanak jis bhaagaa ||8||6||
english: He alone is the Lord's servant, O Nanak, who is so blessed. ||8||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਸਰਪ ਆਰਜਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bin simaran jaise sarap aarajaaree ||
english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's life is like that of a snake.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tiu jeevahi saakat naam bisaaree ||1||
english: This is how the faithless cynic lives, forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ek nimakh jo simaran mahi jeeaa ||
english: One who lives in meditative remembrance, even for an instant,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਲਾਖ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot dinas laakh sadaa thir theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: lives for hundreds of thousands and millions of days, and becomes stable forever. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਸ ॥
transliteration: bin simaran dhrig karam karaas ||
english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's actions and works are cursed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਗ ਬਤਨ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaag batan bisataa mahi vaas ||2||
english: Like the crow's beak, he dwells in manure. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਭਏ ਕੂਕਰ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bin simaran bhae kookar kaam ||
english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one acts like a dog.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਬੇਸੁਆ ਪੂਤ ਨਿਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saakat besuaa poot ninaam ||3||
english: The faithless cynic is nameless, like the prostitute's son. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੀਙ ਛਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bin simaran jaise seeng chhataaraa ||
english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a horned ram.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹਿ ਕੂਰੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bolahi koor saakat mukh kaaraa ||4||
english: The faithless cynic barks out his lies, and his face is blackened. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਗਰਧਭ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: bin simaran garadhabh kee niaaee ||
english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a donkey.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਥਾਨ ਭਰਿਸਟ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: saakat thaan bharisat phiraahee ||5||
english: The faithless cynic wanders around in polluted places. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੂਕਰ ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bin simaran kookar harakaaiaa ||
english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a mad dog.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਲੋਭੀ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saakat lobhee ba(n)dh na paaiaa ||6||
english: The greedy, faithless cynic falls into entanglements. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਹੈ ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: bin simaran hai aatam ghaatee ||
english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, he murders his own soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨੀਚ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: saakat neech tis kul nahee jaatee ||7||
english: The faithless cynic is wretched, without family or social standing. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis bhaiaa kripaal tis satasa(n)g milaaiaa ||
english: When the Lord becomes merciful, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur jagat taraaiaa ||8||7||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has saved the world. ||8||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan mohi param gat paaee ||
english: Through the Guru's Word, I have attained the supreme status.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur poorai meree paij rakhaaee ||1||
english: The Perfect Guru has preserved my honor. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan dhiaaio mohi naau ||
english: Through the Guru's Word, I meditate on the Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad mohi miliaa thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained a place of rest. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਰਸਨ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan sun rasan vakhaanee ||
english: I listen to the Guru's Word, and chant it with my tongue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te a(n)mrit meree baanee ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, my speech is like nectar. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਪੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan mitiaa meraa aap ||
english: Through the Guru's Word, my selfishness and conceit have been removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kee daiaa te meraa vad parataap ||3||
english: Through the Guru's kindness, I have obtained glorious greatness. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan mitiaa meraa bharam ||
english: Through the Guru's Word, my doubts have been removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan pekhio sabh braham ||4||
english: Through the Guru's Word, I see God everywhere. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan keeno raaj jog ||
english: Through the Guru's Word, I practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur kai sa(n)g tariaa sabh log ||5||
english: In the Company of the Guru, all the people of the world are saved. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan mere kaaraj sidh ||
english: Through the Guru's Word, my affairs are resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan paaiaa naau nidh ||6||
english: Through the Guru's Word, I have obtained the nine treasures. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jin jin keenee mere gur kee aasaa ||
english: Whoever places his hopes in my Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tis kee kateeai jam kee phaasaa ||7||
english: has the noose of death cut away. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan jaagiaa meraa karam ||
english: Through the Guru's Word, my good karma has been awakened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥੮॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak gur bhetiaa paarabraham ||8||8||
english: O Nanak, meeting with the Guru, I have found the Supreme Lord God. ||8||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: tis gur kau simarau saas saas ||
english: I remember the Guru with each and every breath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur mere praan satigur meree raas ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru is my breath of life, the True Guru is my wealth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa darasan dekh dekh jeevaa ||
english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur ke charan dhoi dhoi peevaa ||1||
english: I wash the Guru's Feet, and drink in this water. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਨਿਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kee ren nit majan karau ||
english: I take my daily bath in the dust of the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਹਰਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: janam janam kee haumai mal harau ||2||
english: The egotistical filth of countless incarnations is washed off. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਝੂਲਾਵਉ ਪਾਖਾ ॥
transliteration: tis gur kau jhoolaavau paakhaa ||
english: I wave the fan over the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ ਹਾਥੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mahaa agan te haath de raakhaa ||3||
english: Giving me His Hand, He has saved me from the great fire. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਢੋਵਉ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: tis gur kai grihi dhovau paanee ||
english: I carry water for the Guru's household;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਅਕਲ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jis gur te akal gat jaanee ||4||
english: from the Guru, I have learned the Way of the One Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੀਸਉ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: tis gur kai grihi peesau neet ||
english: I grind the corn for the Guru's household.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਸਭ ਮੀਤ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jis parasaad vairee sabh meet ||5||
english: By His Grace, all my enemies have become friends. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jin gur mo kau deenaa jeeu ||
english: The Guru who gave me my soul,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੁਲਿ ਲੀਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aapunaa daasaraa aape mul leeu ||6||
english: has Himself purchased me, and made me His slave. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇਓ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape laaio apanaa piaar ||
english: He Himself has blessed me with His Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa tis gur kau karee namasakaar ||7||
english: Forever and ever, I humbly bow to the Guru. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਭੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥਾ ॥
transliteration: kal kales bhai bhram dukh laathaa ||
english: My troubles, conflicts, fears, doubts and pains have been dispelled;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਾਥਾ ॥੮॥੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak meraa gur samaraathaa ||8||9||
english: says Nanak, my Guru is All-powerful. ||8||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: mil mere gobi(n)d apanaa naam dehu ||
english: Meet me, O my Lord of the Universe. Please bless me with Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa dhrig dhrig asanehu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, cursed, cursed is love and intimacy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੋ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa jo pahirai khaai ||
english: Without the Naam, one who dresses and eats well

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕੂਕਰੁ ਜੂਠਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu kookar joothan mahi paai ||1||
english: is like a dog, who falls in and eats impure foods. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa jetaa biuhaar ||
english: Without the Naam, all occupations are useless,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu miratak mithiaa seegaar ||2||
english: Like decorations on a dead body. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
transliteration: naam bisaar kare ras bhog ||
english: One who forgets the Naam and indulges in pleasures,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਗ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sukh supanai nahee tan mahi rog ||3||
english: shall find no peace, even in dreams; his body shall become diseased. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਨ ਕਾਜ ॥
transliteration: naam tiaag kare an kaaj ||
english: One who renounces the Naam and engages in other occupations,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਜ ॥੪॥
transliteration: binas jaai jhoothe sabh paaj ||4||
english: shall see all of his false pretenses fall away. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naam sa(n)g man preet na laavai ||
english: One whose mind does not embrace love for the Naam

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੋ ਨਰਕਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kot karam karato narak jaavai ||5||
english: shall go to hell, even though he may perform millions of ceremonial rituals. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਆਰਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam jin man na aaraadhaa ||
english: One whose mind does not contemplate the Name of the Lord

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੋਰ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: chor kee niaaee jam pur baadhaa ||6||
english: is bound like a thief, in the City of Death. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: laakh ada(n)bar bahut bisathaaraa ||
english: Hundreds of thousands of ostentatious shows and great expanses

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naam binaa jhoothe paasaaraa ||7||
english: - without the Naam, all these displays are false. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam soee jan lei ||
english: That humble being repeats the Name of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ॥੮॥੧੦॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa naanak jis dei ||8||10||
english: O Nanak, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy. ||8||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਜੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਬਾਹੈ ॥
transliteration: aad madh jo a(n)t nibaahai ||
english: My mind longs for that Friend,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਚਾਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so saajan meraa man chaahai ||1||
english: Who shall stand by me in the beginning, in the middle and in the end. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: har kee preet sadaa sa(n)g chaalai ||
english: The Lord's Love goes with us forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: daiaal purakh pooran pratipaalai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect and Merciful Lord cherishes all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: binasat naahee chhod na jaai ||
english: He shall never perish, and He shall never abandon me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਪੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jah pekhaa tah rahiaa samaai ||2||
english: Wherever I look, there I see Him pervading and permeating. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar sughaR chatur jee daataa ||
english: He is Beautiful, All-knowing, the most Clever, the Giver of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਪੂਤੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhaaee poot pitaa prabh maataa ||3||
english: God is my Brother, Son, Father and Mother. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jeevan praan adhaar meree raas ||
english: He is the Support of the breath of life; He is my Wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: preet laaee kar ridai nivaas ||4||
english: Abiding within my heart, He inspires me to enshrine love for Him. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਸਿਲਕ ਕਾਟੀ ਗੋਪਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa silak kaatee gopaal ||
english: The Lord of the World has cut away the noose of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਲੀਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kar apunaa leeno nadar nihaal ||5||
english: He has made me His own, blessing me with His Glance of Grace. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ॥
transliteration: simar simar kaate sabh rog ||
english: Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, all diseases are healed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਭੋਗ ॥੬॥
transliteration: charan dhiaan sarab sukh bhog ||6||
english: Meditating on His Feet, all comforts are enjoyed. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: pooran purakh navatan nit baalaa ||
english: The Perfect Primal Lord is Ever-fresh and Ever-young.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har a(n)tar baahar sa(n)g rakhavaalaa ||7||
english: The Lord is with me, inwardly and outwardly, as my Protector. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak har har pad cheen ||
english: Says Nanak, that devotee who realizes the state of the Lord, Har, Har,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਦੀਨ ॥੮॥੧੧॥
transliteration: sarabas naam bhagat kau deen ||8||11||
english: is blessed with the treasure of the Naam. ||8||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee maajh mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰੇ ਅਸੰਖ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: khojat phire asa(n)kh a(n)t na paareeaa ||
english: Countless are those who wander around searching for You, but they do not find Your limits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਹੋਏ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: seee hoe bhagat jinaa kirapaareeaa ||1||
english: They alone are Your devotees, who are blessed by Your Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਾਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau vaareeaa har vaareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਡਰਾਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਭੈਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sun sun pa(n)th daraau bahut bhaihaareeaa ||
english: Continually hearing of the terrifying path, I am so afraid.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਤਕੀ ਓਟ ਸੰਤਾਹ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mai takee ot sa(n)taah lehu ubaareeaa ||2||
english: I have sought the Protection of the Saints; please, save me! ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਲਾਲ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰਬ ਸਾਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mohan laal anoop sarab saadhaareeaa ||
english: The Fascinating and Beauteous Beloved is the Giver of support to all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur niv niv laagau paai dehu dikhaareeaa ||3||
english: I bow low and fall at the Feet of the Guru; if only I could see the Lord! ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਕੀਏ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਇਕਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mai keee mitr anek ikas balihaareeaa ||
english: I have made many friends, but I am a sacrifice to the One alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੀਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sabh gun kis hee naahi har poor bha(n)daareeaa ||4||
english: No one has all virtues; the Lord alone is filled to overflowing with them. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: chahu dis japeeai naau sookh savaareeaa ||
english: His Name is chanted in the four directions; those who chant it are embellished with peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਆਹੀ ਓੜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: mai aahee oR tuhaar naanak balihaareeaa ||5||
english: I seek Your Protection; Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿਓ ਭੁਜਾ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਮੋਹ ਕੂਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gur kaadhio bhujaa pasaar moh koopaareeaa ||
english: The Guru reached out to me, and gave me His Arm; He lifted me up, out of the pit of emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: mai jeetio janam apaar bahur na haareeaa ||6||
english: I have won the incomparable life, and I shall not lose it again. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mai paaio sarab nidhaan akath kathaareeaa ||
english: I have obtained the treasure of all; His Speech is unspoken and subtle.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਰੀਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har daragah sobhaava(n)t baah ludaareeaa ||7||
english: In the Court of the Lord, I am honored and glorified; I swing my arms in joy. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਧਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak ladhaa ratan amol apaareeaa ||
english: Servant Nanak has received the invaluable and incomparable jewel.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਕਹਉ ਪੁਕਾਰੀਆ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
transliteration: gur sevaa bhaujal tareeai kahau pukaareeaa ||8||12||
english: Serving the Guru, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean; I proclaim this loudly to all. ||8||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੋ ॥
transliteration: naaraain har ra(n)g ra(n)go ||
english: Dye yourself in the color of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਮੰਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jap jihavaa har ek ma(n)go ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chant the Name of the One Lord with your tongue, and ask for Him alone. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਭਜੋ ॥
transliteration: taj haumai gur giaan bhajo ||
english: Renounce your ego, and dwell upon the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਲਿਖਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)gat dhur karam likhio ||1||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, join the Sangat, the Holy Congregation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਗਇਓ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai so sa(n)g na gaio ||
english: Whatever you see, shall not go with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤੁ ਮੂੜੁ ਲਗੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saakat mooR lage pach muio ||2||
english: The foolish, faithless cynics are attached - they waste away and die. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਓ ॥
transliteration: mohan naam sadaa rav rahio ||
english: The Name of the Fascinating Lord is all-pervading forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹਿਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kot madhe kinai guramukh lahio ||3||
english: Among millions, how rare is that Gurmukh who attains the Name. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)tan kar namo namo ||
english: Greet the Lord's Saints humbly, with deep respect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਸੁਖੋ ॥੪॥
transliteration: nau nidh paavahi atul sukho ||4||
english: You shall obtain the nine treasures, and receive infinite peace. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਅਲੋਵਉ ਸਾਧ ਜਨੋ ॥
transliteration: nain alovau saadh jano ||
english: With your eyes, behold the holy people;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧੋ ॥੫॥
transliteration: hiradai gaavahu naam nidho ||5||
english: in your heart, sing the treasure of the Naam. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਜੋ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu tajo ||
english: Abandon sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਹੁ ਤੇ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੬॥
transliteration: janam maran duhu te rahio ||6||
english: Thus you shall be rid of both birth and death. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਮਿਟਿਓ ॥
transliteration: dookh a(n)dheraa ghar te mitio ||
english: Pain and darkness shall depart from your home,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਦੀਪ ਬਲਿਓ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur giaan driRaaio deep balio ||7||
english: when the Guru implants spiritual wisdom within you, and lights that lamp. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: jin seviaa so paar pario ||
english: One who serves the Lord crosses over to the other side.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਿਓ ॥੮॥੧॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak guramukh jagat tario ||8||1||13||
english: O servant Nanak, the Gurmukh saves the world. ||8||1||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 5 gauRee ||
english: Fifth Mehl, Gauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਭਰਮ ਗਏ ॥
transliteration: har har gur gur karat bharam gae ||
english: Dwelling upon the Lord, Har, Har, and the Guru, the Guru, my doubts have been dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: merai man sabh sukh paaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind has obtained all comforts. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਤੋ ਜਲਤੋ ਤਉਕਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: balato jalato taukiaa gur cha(n)dan seetalaaio ||1||
english: I was burning, on fire, and the Guru poured water on me; He is cooling and soothing, like the sandalwood tree. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: agiaan a(n)dheraa mit gaiaa gur giaan deepaaio ||2||
english: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled; the Guru has lit the lamp of spiritual wisdom. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਕੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗਹਰੋ ਚਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਨਾਵ ਤਰਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paavak saagar gaharo char sa(n)tan naav taraaio ||3||
english: The ocean of fire is so deep; the Saints have crossed over, in the boat of the Lord's Name. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਆਪਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naa ham karam na dharam such prabh gahi bhujaa aapaaio ||4||
english: I have no good karma; I have no Dharmic faith or purity. But God has taken me by the arm, and made me His own. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bhau kha(n)dan dukh bha(n)jano bhagat vachhal har naaio ||5||
english: The Destroyer of fear, the Dispeller of pain, the Lover of His Saints - these are the Names of the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਸੰਤ ਓਟਾਇਓ ॥੬॥
transliteration: anaathah naath kripaal deen sa(n)mrith sa(n)t otaaio ||6||
english: He is the Master of the masterless, Merciful to the meek, All-powerful, the Support of His Saints. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥੭॥
transliteration: niraguneeaare kee benatee dehu daras har raaio ||7||
english: I am worthless - I offer this prayer, O my Lord King: "Please, grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan." ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਓ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak saran tuhaaree thaakur sevak duaarai aaio ||8||2||14||
english: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord and Master; Your servant has come to Your Door. ||8||2||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਭੋਗਾ ਇਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਧ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ra(n)g sa(n)g bikhiaa ke bhogaa in sa(n)g a(n)dh na jaanee ||1||
english: He is immersed in the enjoyment of corrupt pleasures; engrossed in them, the blind fool does not understand. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸੰਚਉ ਹਉ ਖਾਟਤਾ ਸਗਲੀ ਅਵਧ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau sa(n)chau hau khaatataa sagalee avadh bihaanee || rahaau ||
english: "I am earning profits, I am getting rich", he says, as his life passes away. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਹਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hau sooraa paradhaan hau ko naahee mujhahi samaanee ||2||
english: "I am a hero, I am famous and distinguished; no one is equal to me." ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਬਨਵੰਤ ਅਚਾਰ ਕੁਲੀਨਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jobanava(n)t achaar kuleenaa man mahi hoi gumaanee ||3||
english: "I am young, cultured, and born of a good family." In his mind, he is proud and arrogant like this. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਉਲਝਾਇਓ ਬਾਧ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਾ ਮਰਤਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਸਰਾਨੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jiu ulajhaaio baadh budh kaa maratiaa nahee bisaraanee ||4||
english: He is trapped by his false intellect, and he does not forget this until he dies. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਸਖੇ ਪਾਛੇ ਤਿਨਹੂ ਕਉ ਸੰਪਾਨੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bhaaee meet ba(n)dhap sakhe paachhe tinahoo kau sa(n)paanee ||5||
english: Brothers, friends, relatives and companions who live after him - he entrusts his wealth to them. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਨੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jit laago man baasanaa a(n)t saaee pragataanee ||6||
english: That desire, to which the mind is attached, at the last moment, becomes manifest. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਚਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਇਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਬੰਧਾਨੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aha(n)budh such karam kar ih ba(n)dhan ba(n)dhaanee ||7||
english: He may perform religious deeds, but his mind is egotistical, and he is bound by these bonds. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਨੀ ॥੮॥੩॥੧੫॥੪੪॥ ਜੁਮਲਾ
transliteration: daiaal purakh kirapaa karahu naanak daas dasaanee ||8||3||15||44|| jumalaa
english: O Merciful Lord, please bless me Your Mercy, that Nanak may become the slave of Your slaves. ||8||3||15||44||Total||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee poorabee chha(n)t mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Chhant, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਰੈਣਿ ਦੁਹੇਲੜੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dh rain duhelaReeaa jeeu need na aavai ||
english: For the bride, the night is painful; sleep does not come.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਦੁਬਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan dubaleeaa jeeu pir kai haavai ||
english: The soul-bride has grown weak, in the pain of separation from her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਥੀਈ ਦੁਬਲਿ ਕੰਤ ਹਾਵੈ ਕੇਵ ਨੈਣੀ ਦੇਖਏ ॥
transliteration: dhan theeee dubal ka(n)t haavai kev nainee dekhae ||
english: The soul-bride is wasting away, in the pain of separation from her Husband; how can she see Him with her eyes?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੀਗਾਰ ਮਿਠ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਜਨ ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਏ ॥
transliteration: seegaar mith ras bhog bhojan sabh jhooth kitai na lekhae ||
english: Her decorations, sweet foods, sensuous pleasures and delicacies are all false; they are of no account at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਤ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਾਲੀ ਦੁਧਾ ਥਣੀ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
transliteration: mai mat joban garab gaalee dudhaa thanee na aavae ||
english: Intoxicated with the wine of youthful pride, she has been ruined, and her breasts no longer yield milk.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saa dhan milai milaaee bin pir need na aavae ||1||
english: O Nanak, the soul-bride meets her Husband Lord, when He causes her to meet Him; without Him, sleep does not come to her. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਨਿਮਾਨੜੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਧਨੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dh nimaanaReeaa jeeu bin dhanee piaare ||
english: The bride is dishonored without her Beloved Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kiu sukh paavaigee bin ur dhaare ||
english: How can she find peace, without enshrining Him in her heart?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: naah bin ghar vaas naahee puchhahu sakhee saheleeaa ||
english: Without her Husband, her home is not worth living in; go and ask your sisters and companions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: bin naam preet piaar naahee vasahi saach suheleeaa ||
english: Without Naam, the Name of the Lord, there is no love and affection; but with her True Lord, she abides in peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਜਨ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sach man sajan sa(n)tokh melaa guramatee sahu jaaniaa ||
english: Through mental truth and contentment, union with the True Friend is attained; through the Guru's Teachings, the Husband Lord is known.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam na chhodai saa dhan naam sahaj samaaneeaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, that soul-bride who does not abandon the Naam, is intuitively absorbed in the Naam. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ ਹਮ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: mil sakhee sahelaReeho ham pir raavehaa ||
english: Come, O my sisters and companions - let's enjoy our Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਲਿਖਉਗੀ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: gur puchh likhaugee jeeu sabad sanehaa ||
english: I will ask the Guru, and write His Word as my love-note.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sabad saachaa gur dikhaaiaa manamukhee pachhutaaneeaa ||
english: The Guru has shown me the True Word of the Shabad. The self-willed manmukhs will regret and repent.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਸਿ ਜਾਤਉ ਰਹੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਾਮਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: nikas jaatau rahai asathir jaam sach pachhaaniaa ||
english: My wandering mind became steady, when I recognized the True One.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਉਤਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਓ ॥
transliteration: saach kee mat sadaa nautan sabad nehu navelao ||
english: The Teachings of Truth are forever new; the love of the Shabad is forever fresh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree sahaj saachaa milahu sakhee saheleeho ||3||
english: O Nanak, through the Glance of Grace of the True Lord, celestial peace is obtained; let's meet Him, O my sisters and companions. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਜੀਉ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: meree ichh punee jeeu ham ghar saajan aaiaa ||
english: My desire has been fulfilled - my Friend has come to my home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਵਰੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mil var naaree ma(n)gal gaaiaa ||
english: At the Union of husband and wife, the songs of rejoicing were sung.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਹਸੀ ਮੁੰਧ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਓ ॥
transliteration: gun gaai ma(n)gal prem rahasee mu(n)dh man omaahao ||
english: Singing the songs of joyful praise and love to Him, the soul-bride's mind is thrilled and delighted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਰਹੰਸੇ ਦੁਸਟ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਹਓ ॥
transliteration: saajan raha(n)se dusat viaape saach jap sach laahao ||
english: My friends are happy, and my enemies are unhappy; meditating on the True Lord, the true profit is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਸਿ ਭਿੰਨੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kar joR saa dhan karai binatee rain din ras bhi(n)neeaa ||
english: With her palms pressed together, the soul-bride prays, that she may remain immersed in the Love of her Lord, night and day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੁ ਧਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਇਛ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak pir dhan karahi raleeaa ichh meree pu(n)neeaa ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, the Husband Lord and the soul-bride revel together; my desires are fulfilled. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: gauRee chha(n)t mahalaa 1 ||
english: Gauree, Chhant, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜੀਉ ਏਕਲੜੀ ਬਨ ਮਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: sun naah prabhoo jeeu ekalaRee ban maahe ||
english: Hear me, O my Dear Husband God - I am all alone in the wilderness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰੈਗੀ ਨਾਹ ਬਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: kiu dheeraigee naah binaa prabh veparavaahe ||
english: How can I find comfort without You, O my Carefree Husband God?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਨਾਹ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਬਿਖਮ ਰੈਣਿ ਘਣੇਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: dhan naah baajhahu rahi na saakai bikham rain ghanereeaa ||
english: The soul-bride cannot live without her Husband; the night is so painful for her.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਨੀਦ ਆਵੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: nah need aavai prem bhaavai sun bena(n)tee mereeaa ||
english: Sleep does not come. I am in love with my Beloved. Please, listen to my prayer!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਾਰੇ ਏਕਲੜੀ ਕੁਰਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: baajhahu piaare koi na saare ekalaRee kuralaae ||
english: Other than my Beloved, no one cares for me; I cry all alone in the wilderness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saa dhan milai milaaee bin preetam dukh paae ||1||
english: O Nanak, the bride meets Him when He causes her to meet Him; without her Beloved, she suffers in pain. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਅੜੀ ਜੀਉ ਕਵਣੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: pir chhodiaRee jeeu kavan milaavai ||
english: She is separated from her Husband Lord - who can unite her with Him?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ras prem milee jeeu sabad suhaavai ||
english: Tasting His Love, she meets Him, through the Beautiful Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਦੀਪਕ ਦੇਹ ਉਜਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sabade suhaavai taa pat paavai deepak deh ujaarai ||
english: Adorned with the Shabad, she obtains her Husband, and her body is illuminated with the lamp of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sun sakhee sahelee saach suhelee saache ke gun saarai ||
english: Listen, O my friends and companions - she who is at peace dwells upon the True Lord and His True Praises.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਬਿਗਸੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur melee taa pir raavee bigasee a(n)mrit baanee ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, she is ravished and enjoyed by her Husband Lord; she blossoms forth with the Ambrosial Word of His Bani.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਜਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saa dhan taa pir raave jaa tis kai man bhaanee ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Husband Lord enjoys His bride when she is pleasing to His Mind. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਨੀਘਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohanee neeghareeaa jeeu kooR muthee kooRiaare ||
english: Fascination with Maya made her homeless; the false are cheated by falsehood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਖੂਲੈ ਗਲ ਜੇਵੜੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kiu khoolai gal jevaReeaa jeeu bin gur at piaare ||
english: How can the noose around her neck be untied, without the Most Beloved Guru?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har preet piaare sabad veechaare tis hee kaa so hovai ||
english: One who loves the Beloved Lord, and reflects upon the Shabad, belongs to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਨਾਵਣ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਤਰ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: pu(n)n daan anek naavan kiu a(n)tar mal dhovai ||
english: How can giving donations to charities and countless cleansing baths wash off the filth within the heart?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਗਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਬੇਬਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa gat koi na paavai hath nigrahi bebaanai ||
english: Without the Naam, no one attains salvation. Stubborn self-discipline and living in the wilderness are of no use at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਘਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak sach ghar sabad sinjaapai dubidhaa mahal k jaanai ||3||
english: O Nanak, the home of Truth is attained through the Shabad. How can the Mansion of His Presence be known through duality? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: teraa naam sachaa jeeu sabad sachaa veechaaro ||
english: True is Your Name, O Dear Lord; True is contemplation of Your Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: teraa mahal sachaa jeeu naam sachaa vaapaaro ||
english: True is the Mansion of Your Presence, O Dear Lord, and True is trade in Your Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ॥
transliteration: naam kaa vaapaar meethaa bhagat laahaa anadino ||
english: Trade in Your Name is very sweet; the devotees earn this profit night and day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੋ ॥
transliteration: tis baajh vakhar koi na soojhai naam levahu khin khino ||
english: Other than this, I can think of no other merchandise. So chant the Naam each and every moment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਖਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: parakh lekhaa nadar saachee karam poorai paaiaa ||
english: The account is read; by the Grace of the True Lord and good karma, the Perfect Lord is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam mahaa ras meethaa gur poorai sach paaiaa ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, the Nectar of the Name is so sweet. Through the Perfect True Guru, it is obtained. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee poorabee chha(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
english: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Chhant, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan binau kare jeeu har ke gun saare ||
english: The soul-bride offers her prayers to her Dear Lord; she dwells upon His Glorious Virtues.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: khin pal rahi na sakai jeeu bin har piaare ||
english: She cannot live without her Beloved Lord, for a moment, even for an instant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: bin har piaare rahi na saakai gur bin mahal na paaeeai ||
english: She cannot live without her Beloved Lord; without the Guru, the Mansion of His Presence is not found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jo gur kahai soee par keejai tisanaa agan bujhaaeeai ||
english: Whatever the Guru says, she should surely do, to extinguish the fire of desire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har saachaa soee tis bin avar na koee bin seviai sukh na paae ||
english: The Lord is True; there is no one except Him. Without serving Him, peace is not found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saa dhan milai milaaee jis no aap milaae ||1||
english: O Nanak, that soul-bride, whom the Lord Himself unites, is united with Him; He Himself merges with her. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੀਏ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dhan rain suhelaReee jeeu har siu chit laae ||
english: The life-night of the soul-bride is blessed and joyful, when she focuses her consciousness on her Dear Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve bhaau kare jeeu vichahu aap gavaae ||
english: She serves the True Guru with love; she eradicates selfishness from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਓ ॥
transliteration: vichahu aap gavaae har gun gaae anadin laagaa bhaao ||
english: Eradicating selfishness and conceit from within, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, she is in love with the Lord, night and day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਮੇਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਓ ॥
transliteration: sun sakhee sahelee jee kee melee gur kai sabad samaao ||
english: Listen, dear friends and companions of the soul - immerse yourselves in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੀ ਤਾ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਧਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
transliteration: har gun saaree taa ka(n)t piaaree naame dharee piaaro ||
english: Dwell upon the Lord's Glories, and you shall be loved by your Husband, embracing love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kaaman naah piaaree raam naam gal haaro ||2||
english: O Nanak, the soul-bride who wears the necklace of the Lord's Name around her neck is loved by her Husband Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਏਕਲੜੀ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dhan ekalaRee jeeu bin naah piaare ||
english: The soul-bride who is without her beloved Husband is all alone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮੁਠੀ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai muthee jeeu bin gurasabad karaare ||
english: She is cheated by the love of duality, without the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਉਣੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
transliteration: bin sabad piaare kaun dutar taare maaiaa mohi khuaaee ||
english: Without the Shabad of her Beloved, how can she cross over the treacherous ocean? Attachment to Maya has led her astray.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਤਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੁਤੀ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kooR vigutee taa pir mutee saa dhan mahal na paaee ||
english: Ruined by falsehood, she is deserted by her Husband Lord. The soul-bride does not attain the Mansion of His Presence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gurasabade raatee sahaje maatee anadin rahai samaae ||
english: But she who is attuned to the Guru's Shabad is intoxicated with celestial love; night and day, she remains absorbed in Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak kaaman sadaa ra(n)g raatee har jeeu aap milaae ||3||
english: O Nanak, that soul-bride who remains constantly steeped in His Love, is blended by the Lord into Himself. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: taa mileeai har mele jeeu har bin kavan milaae ||
english: If the Lord merges us with Himself, we are merged with Him. Without the Dear Lord, who can merge us with Him?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਆਪਣੇ ਜੀਉ ਕਉਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bin gur preetam aapane jeeu kaun bharam chukaae ||
english: Without our Beloved Guru, who can dispel our doubt?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਇਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮਾਏ ਤਾ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur bharam chukaae iu mileeai maae taa saa dhan sukh paae ||
english: Through the Guru, doubt is dispelled. O my mother, this is the way to meet Him; this is how the soul-bride finds peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa bin ghor a(n)dhaar bin gur mag na paae ||
english: Without serving the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. Without the Guru, the Way is not found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaaman ra(n)g raatee sahaje maatee gur kai sabad veechaare ||
english: That wife who is intuitively imbued with the color of His Love, contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kaaman har var paaiaa gur kai bhaai piaare ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, the soul-bride obtains the Lord as her Husband, by enshrining love for the Beloved Guru. ||4||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਰੀ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: pir bin kharee nimaanee jeeu bin pir kiu jeevaa meree maaee ||
english: Without my Husband, I am utterly dishonored. Without my Husband Lord, how can I live, O my mother?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਤਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: pir bin need na aavai jeeu kaapaR tan na suhaaee ||
english: Without my Husband, sleep does not come, and my body is not adorned with my bridal dress.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਪਰੁ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ਜਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kaapar tan suhaavai jaa pir bhaavai guramatee chit laaeeai ||
english: The bridal dress looks beautiful upon my body, when I am pleasing to my Husband Lord. Following the Guru's Teachings, my consciousness is focused on Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sadaa suhaagan jaa satigur seve gur kai a(n)k samaaeeai ||
english: I become His happy soul-bride forever, when I serve the True Guru; I sit in the Lap of the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਮੇਲਾ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadai melaa taa pir raavee laahaa naam sa(n)saare ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the soul-bride meets her Husband Lord, who ravishes and enjoys her. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only profit in this world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kaaman naah piaaree jaa har ke gun saare ||1||
english: O Nanak, the soul-bride is loved by her Husband, when she dwells upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan ra(n)g maane jeeu aapane naal piaare ||
english: The soul-bride enjoys the Love of her Beloved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ahinis ra(n)g raatee jeeu gurasabad veechaare ||
english: Imbued with His Love night and day, she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabad veechaare haumai maare in bidh milahu piaare ||
english: Contemplating the Guru's Shabad, she conquers her ego, and in this way, she meets her Beloved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan sohaagan sadaa ra(n)g raatee saachai naam piaare ||
english: She is the happy soul-bride of her Lord, who is forever imbued with the Love of the True Name of her Beloved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗਹੀਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: apune gur mil raheeai a(n)mrit gaheeai dubidhaa maar nivaare ||
english: Abiding in the Company of our Guru, we grasp the Ambrosial Nectar; we conquer and cast out our sense of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kaaman har var paaiaa sagale dookh visaare ||2||
english: O Nanak, the soul-bride attains her Husband Lord, and forgets all her pains. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਭੁਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaaman pirahu bhulee jeeu maaiaa mohi piaare ||
english: The soul-bride has forgotten her Husband Lord, because of love and emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਲਗੀ ਜੀਉ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jhoothee jhooth lagee jeeu kooR muthee kooRiaare ||
english: The false bride is attached to falsehood; the insincere one is cheated by insincerity.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੇ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kooR nivaare guramat saare jooai janam na haare ||
english: She who drives out her falsehood, and acts according to the Guru's Teachings, does not lose her life in the gamble.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabad seve sach samaavai vichahu haumai maare ||
english: One who serves the Word of the Guru's Shabad is absorbed in the True Lord; she eradicates egotism from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ਐਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam ridai vasaae aisaa kare seegaaro ||
english: So let the Name of the Lord abide within your heart; decorate yourself in this way.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak kaaman sahaj samaanee jis saachaa naam adhaaro ||3||
english: O Nanak, the soul-bride who takes the Support of the True Name is intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਰੀ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: mil mere preetamaa jeeu tudh bin kharee nimaanee ||
english: Meet me, O my Dear Beloved. Without You, I am totally dishonored.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨੈਣੀ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: mai nainee need na aavai jeeu bhaavai a(n)n na paanee ||
english: Sleep does not come to my eyes, and I have no desire for food or water.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਰੀਐ ਹਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: paanee a(n)n na bhaavai mareeai haavai bin pir kiu sukh paaeeai ||
english: I have no desire for food or water, and I am dying from the pain of separation. Without my Husband Lord, how can I find peace?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gur aagai karau bina(n)tee je gur bhaavai jiu milai tivai milaaeeai ||
english: I offer my prayers to the Guru; if it pleases the Guru, He shall unite me with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: aape mel lae sukhadaataa aap miliaa ghar aae ||
english: The Giver of peace has united me with Himself; He Himself has come to my home to meet me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kaaman sadaa suhaagan naa pir marai na jaae ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, the soul-bride is forever the Lord's favorite wife; her Husband Lord does not die, and He shall never leave. ||4||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਬੇਧੀ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaaman har ras bedhee jeeu har kai sahaj subhaae ||
english: The soul-bride is pierced through with the sublime essence of the Lord, in intuitive peace and poise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: man mohan mohi leeaa jeeu dubidhaa sahaj samaae ||
english: The Enticer of hearts has enticed her, and her sense of duality has been easily dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa sahaj samaae kaaman var paae guramatee ra(n)g laae ||
english: Her sense of duality has been easily dispelled, and the soul-bride obtains her Husband Lord; following the Guru's Teachings, she makes merry.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੁਸਤਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਗਲ ਤਾਈ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ihu sareer kooR kusat bhariaa gal taaee paap kamaae ||
english: This body is filled to overflowing with falsehood, deception and the commission of sins.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat jit sahaj dhun upajai bin bhagatee mail na jaae ||
english: The Gurmukh practices that devotional worship, by which the celestial music wells up; without this devotional worship, filth is not removed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kaaman pirahi piaaree vichahu aap gavaae ||1||
english: O Nanak, the soul-bride who sheds selfishness and conceit from within, is dear to her Beloved. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaaman pir paaiaa jeeu gur kai bhaai piaare ||
english: The soul-bride has found her Husband Lord, through the love and affection of the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਤੀ ਜੀਉ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: rain sukh sutee jeeu a(n)tar ur dhaare ||
english: She passes her life-night sleeping in peace, enshrining the Lord in her heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar ur dhaare mileeai piaare anadin dukh nivaare ||
english: Enshrining Him deep within her heart night and day, she meets her Beloved, and her pains depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar mahal pir raave kaaman guramatee veechaare ||
english: Deep within the mansion of her inner being, she enjoys her Husband Lord, reflecting upon the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam peeaa din raatee dubidhaa maar nivaare ||
english: She drinks deeply of the Nectar of the Naam, day and night; she conquers and casts off her sense of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sach milee sohaagan gur kai het apaare ||2||
english: O Nanak, the happy soul-bride meets her True Lord, through the Infinite Love of the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aavahu daiaa kare jeeu preetam at piaare ||
english: Come, and shower Your Mercy upon me, my most Darling, Dear Beloved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaaman binau kare jeeu sach sabad seegaare ||
english: The soul-bride offers her prayers to You, to adorn her with the True Word of Your Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sach sabad seegaare haumai maare guramukh kaaraj savaare ||
english: Adorned with the True Word of Your Shabad, she conquers her ego, and as Gurmukh, her affairs are resolved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jug jug eko sachaa soee boojhai gur beechaare ||
english: Throughout the ages, the One Lord is True; through the Guru's Wisdom, He is known.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਸੰਤਾਪੀ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kaam viaapee mohi sa(n)taapee kis aagai jaai pukaare ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is engrossed in sexual desire, and tormented by emotional attachment. With whom should she lodge her complaints?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak manamukh thaau na paae bin gur at piaare ||3||
english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest, without the most Beloved Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਭੋਲੀ ਨਿਗੁਣੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dh iaanee bholee niguneeaa jeeu pir agam apaaraa ||
english: The bride is foolish, ignorant and unworthy. Her Husband Lord is Unapproachable and Incomparable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape mel mileeai jeeu aape bakhasanahaaraa ||
english: He Himself unites us in His Union; He Himself forgives us.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰਾ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: avagan bakhasanahaaraa kaaman ka(n)t piaaraa ghat ghat rahiaa samaaee ||
english: The soul-bride's Beloved Husband Lord is the Forgiver of sins; He is contained in each and every heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: prem preet bhaai bhagatee paaeeai satigur boojh bujhaaee ||
english: The True Guru has made me understand this understanding, that the Lord is obtained through love, affection and loving devotion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahai din raatee anadin rahai liv laaee ||
english: She remains forever in bliss, day and night; she remains immersed in His Love, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak sahaje har var paaiaa saa dhan nau nidh paaee ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, that soul-bride who obtains the nine treasures, intuitively obtains her Husband Lord. ||4||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਸਰੁ ਸਬਲੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa sar sabal varatai jeeu kiu kar dutar tariaa jaai ||
english: The sea of Maya is agitated and turbulent; how can anyone cross over this terrifying world-ocean?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raam naam kar bohithaa jeeu sabad khevat vich paai ||
english: Make the Lord's Name your boat, and install the Word of the Shabad as the boatman.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਘਾਏ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sabad khevat vich paae har aap laghaae in bidh dutar tareeai ||
english: With the Shabad installed as the boatman, the Lord Himself shall take you across. In this way, the difficult ocean is crossed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਉ ਮਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat paraapat hovai jeevatiaa iu mareeai ||
english: The Gurmukh obtains devotional worship of the Lord, and thus remains dead while yet alive.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi raam naam kilavikh kaate bhae pavit sareeraa ||
english: In an instant, the Lord's Name erases his sinful mistakes, and his body becomes pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੂਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam nisataaraa ka(n)chan bhae manooraa ||1||
english: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, emancipation is obtained, and the slag iron is transformed into gold. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸਤਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: isataree purakh kaam viaape jeeu raam naam kee bidh nahee jaanee ||
english: Men and women are obsessed with sex; they do not know the Way of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਖਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa sut bhaaee khare piaare jeeu doob mue bin paanee ||
english: Mother, father, children and siblings are very dear, but they drown, even without water.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਧਾਤੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: doob mue bin paanee gat nahee jaanee haumai dhaat sa(n)saare ||
english: They are drowned to death without water - they do not know the path of salvation, and they wander around the world in egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jo aaiaa so sabh ko jaasee ubare gur veechaare ||
english: All those who come into the world shall depart. Only those who contemplate the Guru shall be saved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai raam naam vakhaanai aap tarai kul taare ||
english: Those who become Gurmukh and chant the Lord's Name, save themselves and save their families as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghat a(n)tar guramat mile piaare ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within their hearts; through the Guru's Teachings, they meet their Beloved. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ਬਾਜੀ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam bin ko thir naahee jeeu baajee hai sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, nothing is stable. This world is just a drama.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: driR bhagat sachee jeeu raam naam vaapaaraa ||
english: Implant true devotional worship within your heart, and trade in the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: raam naam vaapaaraa agam apaaraa guramatee dhan paaeeai ||
english: Trade in the Lord's Name is infinite and unfathomable. Through the Guru's Teachings, this wealth is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਹ ਸਾਚੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sevaa surat bhagat ih saachee vichahu aap gavaaeeai ||
english: This selfless service, meditation and devotion is true, if you eliminate selfishness and conceit from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਣ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਅੰਧੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ham mat heen moorakh mugadh a(n)dhe satigur maarag paae ||
english: I am senseless, foolish, idiotic and blind, but the True Guru has placed me on the Path.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh sabad suhaave anadin har gun gaae ||3||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are adorned with the Shabad; night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aap karaae kare aap jeeu aape sabad savaare ||
english: He Himself acts, and inspires others to act; He Himself embellishes us with the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਜੀਉ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aape satigur aap sabad jeeu jug jug bhagat piaare ||
english: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Shabad; in each and every age, He loves His devotees.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jug jug bhagat piaare har aap savaare aape bhagatee laae ||
