english: In age after age, He loves His devotees; the Lord Himself adorns them, and He Himself enjoins them to worship Him with devotion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape daanaa aape beenaa aape sev karaae ||
english: He Himself is All-knowing, and He Himself is All-seeing; He inspires us to serve Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਾਟੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape gunadaataa avagun kaate hiradai naam vasaae ||
english: He Himself is the Giver of merits, and the Destroyer of demerits; He causes His Name to dwell within our hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਚੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak sad balihaaree sache vitahu aape kare karaae ||4||4||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Lord, who Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||4||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Gauree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa kar piraa jeeu har naam dhiaae ||
english: Serve the Guru, O my dear soul; meditate on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੰਞਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)njahu door na jaahi piraa jeeu ghar baithiaa har paae ||
english: Do not leave me, O my dear soul - you shall find the Lord while sitting within the home of your own being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ghar baithiaa har paae sadaa chit laae sahaje sat subhaae ||
english: You shall obtain the Lord while sitting within the home of your own being, focusing your consciousness constantly upon the Lord, with true intuitive faith.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa kharee sukhaalee jis no aap karaae ||
english: Serving the Guru brings great peace; they alone do it, whom the Lord inspires to do so.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naamo beeje naamo ja(n)mai naamo ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: They plant the seed of the Name, and the Name sprouts within; the Name abides within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sach naam vadiaaee poorab likhiaa paae ||1||
english: O Nanak, glorious greatness rests in the True Name; It is obtained by perfect pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਜਾ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam meethaa piraa jeeu jaa chaakhahi chit laae ||
english: The Name of the Lord is so sweet, O my dear; taste it, and focus your consciousness on it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਮੁਯੇ ਜੀਉ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa har ras chaakh muye jeeu an ras saad gavaae ||
english: Taste the sublime essence of the Lord with your tongue, my dear, and renounce the pleasures of other tastes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਏ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sadaa har ras paae jaa har bhaae rasanaa sabad suhaae ||
english: You shall obtain the everlasting essence of the Lord when it pleases the Lord; your tongue shall be adorned with the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naam dhiaae sadaa sukh paae naam rahai liv laae ||
english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, a lasting peace is obtained; so remain lovingly focused on the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naame upajai naame binasai naame sach samaae ||
english: From the Naam we originate, and into the Naam we shall pass; through the Naam, we are absorbed in the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਲਵਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam guramatee paaeeai aape lae lavaae ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Naam is obtained through the Guru's Teachings; He Himself attaches us to it. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਧਨ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਸਿਧਾਏ ॥
transliteration: eh vidaanee chaakaree piraa jeeu dhan chhod parades sidhaae ||
english: Working for someone else, O my dear, is like forsaking the bride, and going to foreign countries.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: doojai kinai sukh na paaio piraa jeeu bikhiaa lobh lubhaae ||
english: In duality, no one has ever found peace, O my dear; you are greedy for corruption and greed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਾਏ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਓਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa lobh lubhaae bharam bhulaae ohu kiu kar sukh paae ||
english: Greedy for corruption and greed, and deluded by doubt, how can anyone find peace?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਕਰੀ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਖਰੀ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: chaakaree vidaanee kharee dukhaalee aap vech dharam gavaae ||
english: Working for strangers is very painful; doing so, one sells himself and loses his faith in the Dharma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਏ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa ba(n)dhan tikai naahee khin khin dukh sa(n)taae ||
english: Bound by Maya, the mind is not stable. Each and every moment, it suffers in pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਦੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak maaiaa kaa dukh tade chookai jaa gurasabadee chit laae ||3||
english: O Nanak, the pain of Maya is taken away by focusing one's consciousness on the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mugadh gaavaar piraa jeeu sabad man na vasaae ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are foolish and crazy, O my dear; they do not enshrine the Shabad within their minds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa kaa bhram a(n)dh piraa jeeu har maarag kiu paae ||
english: The delusion of Maya has made them blind, O my dear; how can they find the Way of the Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kiu maarag paae bin satigur bhaae manamukh aap ganaae ||
english: How can they find the Way, without the Will of the True Guru? The manmukhs foolishly display themselves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har ke chaakar sadaa suhele gur charanee chit laae ||
english: The Lord's servants are forever comfortable. They focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis no har jeeu kare kirapaa sadaa har ke gun gaae ||
english: Those unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak naam ratan jag laahaa guramukh aap bujhaae ||4||5||7||
english: O Nanak, the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only profit in this world. The Lord Himself imparts this understanding to the Gurmukh. ||4||5||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ₁ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee₁ chha(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Gauree, Chhant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਉ ਦੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: merai man bairaag bhaiaa jeeu kiu dekhaa prabh daate ||
english: My mind has become sad and depressed; how can I see God, the Great Giver?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: mere meet sakhaa har jeeu gur purakh bidhaate ||
english: My Friend and Companion is the Dear Lord, the Guru, the Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੋ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲਹ ਤੁਝੈ ਉਡੀਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: purakho bidhaataa ek sreedhar kiu milah tujhai udeeneeaa ||
english: The One Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is the Master of the Goddess of Wealth; how can I, in my sadness, meet You?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੀਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਦਰਸ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kar karahi sevaa sees charanee man aas daras nimaaneeaa ||
english: My hands serve You, and my head is at Your Feet. My mind, dishonored, yearns for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨ ਘੜੀ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਲੁ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: saas saas na ghaRee visarai pal moorat din raate ||
english: With each and every breath, I think of You, day and night; I do not forget You, for an instant, even for a moment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਜਿਉ ਪਿਆਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saari(n)g jiu piaase kiu mileeai prabh daate ||1||
english: O Nanak, I am thirsty, like the rainbird; how can I meet God, the Great Giver? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਜੀਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ik binau karau jeeu sun ka(n)t piaare ||
english: I offer this one prayer - please listen, O my Beloved Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: meraa man tan mohi leeaa jeeu dekh chalat tumaare ||
english: My mind and body are enticed, beholding Your wondrous play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਲਤਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਉਦਾਸ ਧਨ ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰਏ ॥
transliteration: chalataa tumaare dekh mohee udaas dhan kiu dheerae ||
english: Beholding Your wondrous play, I am enticed; but how can the sad, forlorn bride find contentment?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤ ਨਾਹ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਬਾਲਾ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਪੂਰਏ ॥
transliteration: gunava(n)t naah daiaal baalaa sarab gun bharapoorae ||
english: My Lord is Meritorious, Merciful and Eternally Young; He is overflowing with all excellences.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਦੋਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਤੇ ਹਉ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: pir dos naahee sukhah daate hau vichhuRee buriaare ||
english: The fault is not with my Husband Lord, the Giver of peace; I am separated from Him by my own mistakes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak daiaa dhaarahu ghar aavahu naah piaare ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, and return home, O my Beloved Husband Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: hau man arapee sabh tan arapee arapee sabh desaa ||
english: I surrender my mind, I surrender my whole body; I surrender all my lands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸਿਰੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਇ ਸਦੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: hau sir arapee tis meet piaare jo prabh dei sadesaa ||
english: I surrender my head to that beloved friend, who brings me news of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਰਪਿਆ ਤ ਸੀਸੁ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: arapiaa ta sees suthaan gur pahi sa(n)g prabhoo dikhaaiaa ||
english: I have offered my head to the Guru, the most exalted; He has shown me that God is with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: khin maahi sagalaa dookh mitiaa manahu chi(n)diaa paaiaa ||
english: In an instant, all suffering is removed. I have obtained all my mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਕਰੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: din rain raleeaa karai kaaman mite sagal a(n)desaa ||
english: Day and night, the soul-bride makes merry; all her anxieties are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਲੋੜਤੇ ਹਮ ਜੈਸਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak ka(n)t miliaa loRate ham jaisaa ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, I have met the Husband Lord of my longing. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
transliteration: merai man anad bhaiaa jeeu vajee vaadhaaee ||
english: My mind is filled with bliss, and congratulations are pouring in.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਭ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ghar laal aaiaa piaaraa sabh tikhaa bujhaaee ||
english: My Darling Beloved has come home to me, and all my desires have been satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤ ਲਾਲੁ ਗੁਪਾਲੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਖੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: miliaa ta laal gupaal thaakur sakhee ma(n)gal gaaiaa ||
english: I have met my Sweet Lord and Master of the Universe, and my companions sing the songs of joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮੀਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਹਰਖੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਦੂਤ ਥਾਉ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh meet ba(n)dhap harakh upajiaa doot thaau gavaaiaa ||
english: All my friends and relatives are happy, and all traces of my enemies have been removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜਹਿ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ॥
transliteration: anahat vaaje vajahi ghar mahi pir sa(n)g sej vichhaaee ||
english: The unstruck melody vibrates in my home, and the bed has been made up for my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sahaj rahai har miliaa ka(n)t sukhadaaee ||4||1||
english: Prays Nanak, I am in celestial bliss. I have obtained the Lord, the Giver of peace, as my Husband. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee₂ mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mohan tere ooche ma(n)dar mahal apaaraa ||
english: O Mohan, your temple is so lofty, and your mansion is unsurpassed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਜੀਉ ਸੰਤ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: mohan tere sohan duaar jeeu sa(n)t dharam saalaa ||
english: O Mohan, your gates are so beautiful. They are the worship-houses of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ਅਪਾਰ ਦੈਆਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: dharam saal apaar daiaar thaakur sadaa keeratan gaavahe ||
english: In these incomparable worship-houses, they continually sing Kirtan, the Praises of their Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਹਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: jah saadh sa(n)t ikatr hovahi tahaa tujhahi dhiaavahe ||
english: Where the Saints and the Holy gather together, there they meditate on you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹੋਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kar daiaa maiaa daiaal suaamee hohu deen kripaaraa ||
english: Be Kind and Compassionate, O Merciful Lord; be Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak daras piaase mil darasan sukh saaraa ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, I thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; receiving Your Darshan, I am totally at peace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਚਾਲ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: mohan tere bachan anoop chaal niraalee ||
english: O Mohan, your speech is incomparable; wondrous are your ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੂੰ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਜੀ ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਰਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: mohan too(n) maanahi ek jee avar sabh raalee ||
english: O Mohan, you believe in the One. Everything else is dust to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਹਿ ਤ ਏਕੁ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: maanahi ta ek alekh thaakur jinahi sabh kal dhaareeaa ||
english: You adore the One Lord, the Unknowable Lord and Master; His Power gives Support to all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਚਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh bachan gur kai vas keeaa aad purakh banavaareeaa ||
english: Through the Guru's Word, you have captured the heart of the Primal Being, the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aap chaliaa aap rahiaa aap sabh kal dhaareeaa ||
english: You Yourself move, and You Yourself stand still; You Yourself support the whole creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak paij raakhahu sabh sevak saran tumaareeaa ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, please preserve my honor; all Your servants seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mohan tudh satasa(n)gat dhiaavai daras dhiaanaa ||
english: O Mohan, the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, meditates on you; they meditate on the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਨਿਦਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mohan jam neR na aavai tudh japahi nidaanaa ||
english: O Mohan, the Messenger of Death does not even approach those who meditate on You, at the last moment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: jamakaal tin kau lagai naahee jo ik man dhiaavahe ||
english: The Messenger of Death cannot touch those who meditate on You single-mindedly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਸੇ ਸਭੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: man bachan karam j tudh araadhahi se sabhe phal paavahe ||
english: Those who worship and adore You in thought, word and deed, obtain all fruits and rewards.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਮੂੜ ਜਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਹੋਤੇ ਸਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mal moot mooR j mugadh hote s dekh daras sugiaanaa ||
english: Those who are foolish and stupid, filthy with urine and manure, become all-knowing upon gaining the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak raaj nihachal pooran purakh bhagavaanaa ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, Your Kingdom is Eternal, O Perfect Primal Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਫਲੁ ਫਲਿਆ ਸਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mohan too(n) suphal phaliaa san paravaare ||
english: O Mohan, you have blossomed forth with the flower of your family.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mohan putr meet bhaaee kuta(n)b sabh taare ||
english: O Mohan, your children, friends, siblings and relatives have all been saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਰਿਆ ਜਹਾਨੁ ਲਹਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: taariaa jahaan lahiaa abhimaan jinee darasan paaiaa ||
english: You save those who give up their egotistical pride, upon gaining the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਕਹਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jinee tudhano dha(n)n kahiaa tin jam neR na aaiaa ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who call you 'blessed'.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਥੇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bea(n)t gun tere kathe na jaahee satigur purakh muraare ||
english: Your Virtues are unlimited - they cannot be described, O True Guru, Primal Being, Destroyer of demons.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਰਾਖੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak tek raakhee jit lag tariaa sa(n)saare ||4||2||
english: Prays Nanak, Yours is that Anchor, holding onto which the whole world is saved. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₃ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee₃ mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਅਸੰਖ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: patit asa(n)kh puneet kar punah punah balihaar ||
english: Countless sinners have been purified; I am a sacrifice, over and over again, to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਪਾਵਕੋ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦਾਹਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam jap paavako tin kilabikh daahanahaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, meditation on the Lord's Name is the fire which burns away sinful mistakes like straw. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਧੋ ॥
transliteration: jap manaa too(n) raam naraain govi(n)daa har maadho ||
english: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord God, the Lord of the Universe, the Lord, the Master of Wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨਾ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮੁਕੰਦੇ ਕਟੀਐ ਕਾਲ ਦੁਖ ਫਾਧੋ ॥
transliteration: dhiaai manaa muraar muka(n)de kateeai kaal dukh phaadho ||
english: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord, the Destroyer of ego, the Giver of salvation, who cuts away the noose of agonizing death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖਹਰਣ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ॥
transliteration: dukhaharan deen saran sreedhar charan kamal araadheeai ||
english: Meditate lovingly on the Lotus Feet of the Lord, the Destroyer of distress, the Protector of the poor, the Lord of excellence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਧੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jam pa(n)th bikhaRaa agan saagar nimakh simarat saadheeai ||
english: The treacherous path of death and the terrifying ocean of fire are crossed over by meditating in remembrance on the Lord, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਮਲਹ ਦਹਤਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਅਰਾਧੋ ॥
transliteration: kalimalah dahataa sudh karataa dinas rain araadho ||
english: Meditate day and night on the Lord, the Destroyer of desire, the Purifier of pollution.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਾਧੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa gopaal gobi(n)d maadho ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, please be Merciful to me, O Cherisher of the world, Lord of the Universe, Lord of wealth. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਦਾਮੋਦਰੁ ਦੁਖਹਰੁ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: simar manaa daamodar dukhahar bhai bha(n)jan har raaiaa ||
english: O my mind, remember the Lord in meditation; He is the Destroyer of pain, the Eradicator of fear, the Sovereign Lord King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗੋ ਦਇਆਲ ਮਨੋਹਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sreera(n)go daiaal manohar bhagat vachhal biradaaiaa ||
english: He is the Greatest Lover, the Merciful Master, the Enticer of the mind, the Support of His devotees - this is His very nature.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal purakh pooran manahi chi(n)diaa paaeeai ||
english: The Perfect Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He fulfills the desires of the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਮ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਉਧਾਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: tam a(n)dh koop te udhaarai naam ma(n)n vasaaeeai ||
english: He lifts us up out of the deep, dark pit; enshrine His Name within your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰ ਸਿਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਗੁਣ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤੀ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sur sidh gan ga(n)dharab mun jan gun anik bhagatee gaaiaa ||
english: The gods, the Siddhas, the angels, the heavenly singers, the silent sages and the devotees sing Your countless Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa paarabraham har raaiaa ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, O Supreme Lord God, my King. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: chet manaa paarabraham paramesar sarab kalaa jin dhaaree ||
english: O my mind, be conscious of the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, who wields all power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: karunaa mai samarath suaamee ghat ghat praan adhaaree ||
english: He is All-powerful, the Embodiment of compassion. He is the Master of each and every heart;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: praan man tan jee daataa bea(n)t agam apaaro ||
english: He is the Support of the breath of life. He is the Giver of the breath of life, of mind, body and soul. He is Infinite, Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਦਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: saran jog samarath mohan sarab dokh bidaaro ||
english: The All-powerful Lord is our Sanctuary; He is the Enticer of the mind, who banishes all sorrows.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: rog sog sabh dokh binasahi japat naam muraaree ||
english: All illnesses, sufferings and pains are dispelled, by chanting the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa samarath sabh kal dhaaree ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, All-powerful Lord; You are the Wielder of all power. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਮਨਾ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: gun gaau manaa achut abinaasee sabh te ooch daiaalaa ||
english: O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable, Eternal, Merciful Master, the Highest of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸੰਭਰੁ ਦੇਵਨ ਕਉ ਏਕੈ ਸਰਬ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: bisa(n)bhar devan kau ekai sarab karai pratipaalaa ||
english: The One Lord is the Sustainer of the Universe, the Great Giver; He is the Cherisher of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਮਹਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਾਨਾ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਭ ਕਿਸੈ ॥
transliteration: pratipaal mahaa daiaal daanaa daiaa dhaare sabh kisai ||
english: The Cherisher Lord is so very merciful and wise; He is compassionate to all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਾਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ ॥
transliteration: kaal ka(n)tak lobh mohu naasai jee jaa kai prabh basai ||
english: The pains of death, greed and emotional attachment simply vanish, when God comes to dwell in the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਦੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: suprasa(n)n devaa saphal sevaa bhaee pooran ghaalaa ||
english: When the Lord is thoroughly pleased, then one's service becomes perfectly fruitful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਜਪਤ ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak ichh punee japat deen daiaalaa ||4||3||
english: Prays Nanak, my desires are fulfilled by meditating on the Lord, Merciful to the meek. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ਮਨਾਇ ਲੈਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੈ ॥
transliteration: sun sakheee mil udam karehaa manaai laihi har ka(n)tai ||
english: Listen, O my companions: let's join together and make the effort, to surrender to our Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਮੋਹਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੰਤੈ ॥
transliteration: maan tiaag kar bhagat thagauree mohah saadhoo ma(n)tai ||
english: Renouncing our pride, let's charm Him with the potion of devotional worship, and the mantra of the Holy Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਇਹ ਰੀਤਿ ਭਲੀ ਭਗਵੰਤੈ ॥
transliteration: sakhee vas aaiaa phir chhod na jaaee ih reet bhalee bhagava(n)tai ||
english: O my companions, when He comes under our power, He shall never leave us again. This is the good nature of the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੰਤੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jaraa maran bhai narak nivaarai puneet karai tis ja(n)tai ||1||
english: O Nanak, God dispels the fear of old age, death and hell; He purifies His beings. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਇਹ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਏਹੁ ਮਤਾਂਤੁ ਪਕਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sun sakheee ih bhalee bina(n)tee ehu mataa(n)t pakaaeeai ||
english: Listen, O my companions, to my sincere prayer: let's make this firm resolve.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਹੋਇ ਗੀਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਹਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sahaj subhaai upaadh rahat hoi geet govi(n)dahi gaaeeai ||
english: In the peaceful poise of intuitive bliss, violence will be gone, as we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kal kales mitahi bhram naasahi man chi(n)diaa phal paaeeai ||
english: Our pains and troubles shall be eradicated, and our doubts shall be dispelled; we will receive the fruits of our minds' desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paarabraham pooran paramesar naanak naam dhiaaeeai ||2||
english: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect, Transcendent Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਇਛ ਕਰੀ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਮਨਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sakhee ichh karee nit sukh manaaee prabh meree aas pujaae ||
english: O my companions, I yearn for Him continually; I invoke His Blessings, and pray that God may fulfill my hopes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਦਰਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਪੇਖਉ ਥਾਨ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
transliteration: charan piaasee daras bairaagan pekhau thaan sabaae ||
english: I thirst for His Feet, and I long for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; I look for Him everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: khoj lahau har sa(n)t janaa sa(n)g sa(n)mrith purakh milaae ||
english: I search for traces of the Lord in the Society of the Saints; they will unite me with the All-powerful Primal Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਰਿਜਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak tin miliaa surijan sukhadaataa se vadabhaagee maae ||3||
english: O Nanak, those humble, noble beings who meet the Lord, the Giver of peace, are very blessed, O my mother. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਸਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਿਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sakhee naal vasaa apune naah piaare meraa man tan har sa(n)g hiliaa ||
english: O my companions, now I dwell with my Beloved Husband; my mind and body are attuned to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੇਰੀ ਨੀਦ ਭਲੀ ਮੈ ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sun sakheee meree need bhalee mai aapanaRaa pir miliaa ||
english: Listen, O my companions: now I sleep well, since I found my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਖੋਇਓ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਕਉਲੁ ਖਿਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bhram khoio saa(n)t sahaj suaamee paragaas bhaiaa kaul khiliaa ||
english: My doubts have been dispelled, and I have found intuitive peace and tranquility through my Lord and Master. I have been enlightened, and my heart-lotus has blossomed forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਨ ਟਲਿਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੨॥੫॥੧੧॥
transliteration: var paaiaa prabh a(n)tarajaamee naanak sohaag na taliaa ||4||4||2||5||11||
english: I have obtained God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, as my Husband; O Nanak, my marriage shall last forever. ||4||4||2||5||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬਾਵਨ ਅਖਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee baavan akharee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Baavan Akhree ~ The 52 Letters, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev maataa guradev pitaa guradev suaamee paramesuraa ||
english: The Divine Guru is my mother, the Divine Guru is my father; the Divine Guru is my Transcendent Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਖਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਬੰਧਿਪ ਸਹੋਦਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev sakhaa agiaan bha(n)jan guradev ba(n)dhip sahodaraa ||
english: The Divine Guru is my companion, the Destroyer of ignorance; the Divine Guru is my relative and brother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਿਰੋਧਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev daataa har naam upadesai guradev ma(n)t nirodharaa ||
english: The Divine Guru is the Giver, the Teacher of the Lord's Name. The Divine Guru is the Mantra which never fails.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਪਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev saa(n)t sat budh moorat guradev paaras paras paraa ||
english: The Divine Guru is the Image of peace, truth and wisdom. The Divine Guru is the Philosopher's Stone - touching it, one is transformed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਜਨੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev teerath a(n)mrit sarovar gur giaan majan apara(n)paraa ||
english: The Divine Guru is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, and the pool of divine ambrosia; bathing in the Guru's wisdom, one experiences the Infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਕਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev karataa sabh paap harataa guradev patit pavit karaa ||
english: The Divine Guru is the Creator, and the Destroyer of all sins; the Divine Guru is the Purifier of sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev aad jugaad jug jug guradev ma(n)t har jap udharaa ||
english: The Divine Guru existed at the primal beginning, throughout the ages, in each and every age. The Divine Guru is the Mantra of the Lord's Name; chanting it, one is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev sa(n)gat prabh mel kar kirapaa ham mooR paapee jit lag taraa ||
english: O God, please be merciful to me, that I may be with the Divine Guru; I am a foolish sinner, but holding onto Him, I am carried across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guradev satigur paarabraham paramesar guradev naanak har namasakaraa ||1||
english: The Divine Guru is the True Guru, the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; Nanak bows in humble reverence to the Lord, the Divine Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: aapahi keeaa karaaiaa aapahi karanai jog ||
english: He Himself acts, and causes others to act; He Himself can do everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak eko rav rahiaa doosar hoaa na hog ||1||
english: O Nanak, the One Lord is pervading everywhere; there has never been any other, and there never shall be. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਅੰ ਸਾਧ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: oa(n) saadh satigur namasakaara(n) ||
english: ONG: I humbly bow in reverence to the One Universal Creator, to the Holy True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: aad madh a(n)t nira(n)kaara(n) ||
english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is the Formless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਆਪਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਆਸਨ ॥
transliteration: aapahi su(n)n aapahi sukh aasan ||
english: He Himself is in the absolute state of primal meditation; He Himself is in the seat of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜਾਸਨ ॥
transliteration: aapahi sunat aap hee jaasan ||
english: He Himself listens to His Own Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਉਪਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: aapan aap aapahi upaaio ||
english: He Himself created Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਬਾਪ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਮਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: aapahi baap aap hee maaio ||
english: He is His Own Father, He is His Own Mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਸੂਖਮ ਆਪਹਿ ਅਸਥੂਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aapahi sookham aapahi asathoolaa ||
english: He Himself is subtle and etheric; He Himself is manifest and obvious.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lakhee na jaaee naanak leelaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, His wondrous play cannot be understood. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh deen daiaalaa ||
english: O God, Merciful to the meek, please be kind to me,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tere sa(n)tan kee man hoi ravaalaa || rahaau ||
english: that my mind might become the dust of the feet of Your Saints. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: nira(n)kaar aakaar aap niragun saragun ek ||
english: He Himself is formless, and also formed; the One Lord is without attributes, and also with attributes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਬਖਾਨਨੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ekahi ek bakhaanano naanak ek anek ||1||
english: Describe the One Lord as One, and Only One; O Nanak, He is the One, and the many. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਅੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਓ ਅਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: oa(n) guramukh keeo akaaraa ||
english: ONG: The One Universal Creator created the Creation through the Word of the Primal Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ekahi soot parovanahaaraa ||
english: He strung it upon His one thread.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: bhi(n)n bhi(n)n trai gun bisathaara(n) ||
english: He created the diverse expanse of the three qualities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਤੇ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: niragun te saragun drisataara(n) ||
english: From formless, He appeared as form.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਪਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: sagal bhaat kar karahi upaaio ||
english: The Creator has created the creation of all sorts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਮਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਢਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: janam maran man mohu badhaaio ||
english: The attachment of the mind has led to birth and death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੂ ਭਾਤਿ ਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: duhoo bhaat te aap niraaraa ||
english: He Himself is above both, untouched and unaffected.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak a(n)t na paaraavaaraa ||2||
english: O Nanak, He has no end or limitation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਸਾਹ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਸੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: seee saah bhagava(n)t se sach sa(n)pai har raas ||
english: Those who gather Truth, and the riches of the Lord's Name, are rich and very fortunate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਚਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sach such paaeeai tih sa(n)tan kai paas ||1||
english: O Nanak, truthfulness and purity are obtained from Saints such as these. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pavaRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਸਾ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੋਊ ॥
transliteration: sasaa sat sat sat sooo ||
english: SASSA: True, True, True is that Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
transliteration: sat purakh te bhi(n)n na kooo ||
english: No one is separate from the True Primal Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਊ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੈ ਜਿਹ ਪਾਯੰ ॥
transliteration: sooo saran parai jih paaya(n) ||
english: They alone enter the Lord's Sanctuary, whom the Lord inspires to enter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਸੁਨਾਯੰ ॥
transliteration: simar simar gun gaai sunaaya(n) ||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, they sing and preach the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਆਪਤ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)sai bharam nahee kachh biaapat ||
english: Doubt and skepticism do not affect them at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਜਾਪਤ ॥
transliteration: pragat prataap taahoo ko jaapat ||
english: They behold the manifest glory of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਇਹ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: so saadhoo ih pahuchanahaaraa ||
english: They are the Holy Saints - they reach this destination.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak taa kai sad balihaaraa ||3||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਪੁਕਾਰਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸਭ ਕੂਰ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan kahaa pukaarate maaiaa moh sabh koor ||
english: Why are you crying out for riches and wealth? All this emotional attachment to Maya is false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹੋਤ ਜਾਤ ਸਭੁ ਧੂਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam bihoone naanakaa hot jaat sabh dhoor ||1||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, all are reduced to dust. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pavaRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਧਾ ਧੂਰਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨੂਆ ॥
transliteration: dhadhaa dhoor puneet tere janooaa ||
english: DHADHA: The dust of the feet of the Saints is sacred.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਤੇਊ ਜਿਹ ਰੁਚ ਇਆ ਮਨੂਆ ॥
transliteration: dhan teoo jih ruch iaa manooaa ||
english: Blessed are those whose minds are filled with this longing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਸੁਰਗ ਨ ਆਛਹਿ ॥
transliteration: dhan nahee baachhahi surag na aachhahi ||
english: They do not seek wealth, and they do not desire paradise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਰਜ ਰਾਚਹਿ ॥
transliteration: at pri preet saadh raj raachahi ||
english: They are immersed in the deep love of their Beloved, and the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧੇ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਆਪਹਿ ਤਾਹੂ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhe kahaa biaapahi taahoo ||
english: How can worldly affairs affect those,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਏਕ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੂ ॥
transliteration: jo ek chhaad an katahi na jaahoo ||
english: Who do not abandon the One Lord, and who go nowhere else?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਐ ਦੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai heeai deeo prabh naam ||
english: One whose heart is filled with God's Name,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak saadh pooran bhagavaan ||4||
english: O Nanak, is a perfect spiritual being of God. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭੇਖ ਅਰੁ ਙਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਮਿਲਿਅਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: anik bhekh ar ngiaan dhiaan manahath miliau na koi ||
english: By all sorts of religious robes, knowledge, meditation and stubborn-mindedness, no one has ever met God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਙਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak kirapaa bhaee bhagat ngiaanee soi ||1||
english: Says Nanak, those upon whom God showers His Mercy, are devotees of spiritual wisdom. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਙੰਙਾ ਙਿਆਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੁਖ ਬਾਤਉ ॥
transliteration: nga(n)ngaa ngiaan nahee mukh baatau ||
english: NGANGA: Spiritual wisdom is not obtained by mere words of mouth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਤਉ ॥
transliteration: anik jugat saasatr kar bhaatau ||
english: It is not obtained through the various debates of the Shaastras and scriptures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਙਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਸੋਊ ॥
transliteration: ngiaanee soi jaa kai driR sooo ||
english: They alone are spiritually wise, whose minds are firmly fixed on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਕਛੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
transliteration: kahat sunat kachh jog na hooo ||
english: Hearing and telling stories, no one attains Yoga.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਙਿਆਨੀ ਰਹਤ ਆਗਿਆ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: ngiaanee rahat aagiaa driR jaa kai ||
english: They alone are spiritually wise, who remain firmly committed to the Lord's Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: usan seet samasar sabh taa kai ||
english: Heat and cold are all the same to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਙਿਆਨੀ ਤਤੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ngiaanee tat guramukh beechaaree ||
english: The true people of spiritual wisdom are the Gurmukhs, who contemplate the essence of reality;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak jaa kau kirapaa dhaaree ||5||
english: O Nanak, the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਨ ਆਏ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਪਸੁ ਢੋਰ ॥
transliteration: aavan aae srisat mahi bin boojhe pas dhor ||
english: Those who have come into the world without understanding are like animals and beasts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਬੁਝੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਾਗ ਮਥੋਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh so bujhai jaa kai bhaag mathor ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who become Gurmukh understand; upon their foreheads is such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਾ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਏਕਹਿ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: yaa jug mahi ekahi kau aaiaa ||
english: They have come into this world to meditate on the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਤ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: janamat mohio mohanee maaiaa ||
english: But ever since their birth, they have been enticed by the fascination of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਤਪ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: garabh ku(n)t mahi uradh tap karate ||
english: Upside-down in the chamber of the womb, they performed intense meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
transliteration: saas saas simarat prabh rahate ||
english: They remembered God in meditation with each and every breath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰੇ ਜੋ ਛੋਡਿ ਛਡਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: urajh pare jo chhod chhadaanaa ||
english: But now, they are entangled in things which they must leave behind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: devanahaar manahi bisaraanaa ||
english: They forget the Great Giver from their minds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dhaarahu kirapaa jisahi gusaaee ||
english: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: it ut naanak tis bisarahu naahee ||6||
english: do not forget Him, here or hereafter. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aavat hukam binaas hukam aagiaa bhi(n)n na koi ||
english: By His Command, we come, and by His Command, we go; no one is beyond His Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਤਿਹ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa tih mitai naanak jih man soi ||1||
english: Coming and going in reincarnation is ended, O Nanak, for those whose minds are filled with the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਊ ਜੀਅ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਭ ਵਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: eoo jee bahut grabh vaase ||
english: This soul has lived in many wombs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਮੀਠ ਜੋਨਿ ਫਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: moh magan meeth jon phaase ||
english: Enticed by sweet attachment, it has been trapped in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: in maaiaa trai gun bas keene ||
english: This Maya has subjugated beings through the three qualities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਮੋਹ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: aapan moh ghate ghat deene ||
english: Maya has infused attachment to itself in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏ ਸਾਜਨ ਕਛੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: e saajan kachh kahahu upaaiaa ||
english: O friend, tell me some way,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤਰਉ ਬਿਖਮ ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa te tarau bikham ih maaiaa ||
english: by which I may swim across this treacherous ocean of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa satasa(n)g milaae ||
english: The Lord showers His Mercy, and leads us to join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਮਾਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak taa kai nikat na maae ||7||
english: O Nanak, Maya does not even come near. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਸੁਭ ਅਸੁਭ ਕੀਨੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: kirat kamaavan subh asubh keene tin prabh aap ||
english: God Himself causes one to perform good and bad actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pas aapan hau hau karai naanak bin har kahaa kamaat ||1||
english: The beast indulges in egotism, selfishness and conceit; O Nanak, without the Lord, what can anyone do? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ekahi aap karaavanahaaraa ||
english: The One Lord Himself is the Cause of all actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aapahi paap pu(n)n bisathaaraa ||
english: He Himself distributes sins and noble acts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਜੁਗ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: iaa jug jit jit aapahi laaio ||
english: In this age, people are attached as the Lord attaches them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ ਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: so so paaio j aap divaaio ||
english: They receive that which the Lord Himself gives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ ॥
transliteration: uaa kaa a(n)t na jaanai kooo ||
english: No one knows His limits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਊ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਊ ॥
transliteration: jo jo karai sooo phun hooo ||
english: Whatever He does, comes to pass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਤੇ ਸਗਲਾ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ekahi te sagalaa bisathaaraa ||
english: From the One, the entire expanse of the Universe emanated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak aap savaaranahaaraa ||8||
english: O Nanak, He Himself is our Saving Grace. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕੁਸਮ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਖ ਸੋਰ ॥
transliteration: raach rahe banitaa binod kusam ra(n)g bikh sor ||
english: Man remains engrossed in women and playful pleasures; the tumult of his passion is like the dye of the safflower, which fades away all too soon.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰਉ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਮੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tih saranee parau binas jaai mai mor ||1||
english: O Nanak, seek God's Sanctuary, and your selfishness and conceit shall be taken away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਹ ਰਚਹੁ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: re man bin har jah rachahu tah tah ba(n)dhan paahi ||
english: O mind: without the Lord, whatever you are involved in shall bind you in chains.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਸਾਕਤ ਤੇਊ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jih bidh katahoo na chhooteeai saakat teoo kamaahi ||
english: The faithless cynic does those deeds which will never allow him to be emancipated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਰਤ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hau hau karate karam rat taa ko bhaar aphaar ||
english: Acting in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the lovers of rituals carry the unbearable load.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਉ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਤਉ ਏਊ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: preet nahee jau naam siu tau eoo karam bikaar ||
english: When there is no love for the Naam, then these rituals are corrupt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਧੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਮੀਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: baadhe jam kee jevaree meethee maaiaa ra(n)g ||
english: The rope of death binds those who are in love with the sweet taste of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਮੋਹੇ ਨਹ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਹੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
transliteration: bhram ke mohe nah bujhahi so prabh sadahoo sa(n)g ||
english: Deluded by doubt, they do not understand that God is always with them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਕਾਚੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਨ ਸੁਧਿ ॥
transliteration: lekhai ganat na chhooteeai kaachee bheet na sudh ||
english: When their accounts are called for, they shall not be released; their wall of mud cannot be washed clean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਿਹ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੁਧਿ ॥੯॥
transliteration: jisahi bujhaae naanakaa tih guramukh niramal budh ||9||
english: One who is made to understand - O Nanak, that Gurmukh obtains immaculate understanding. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜਾਸੁ ਕੇ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: toote ba(n)dhan jaas ke hoaa saadhoo sa(n)g ||
english: One whose bonds are cut away joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo raate ra(n)g ek kai naanak gooRaa ra(n)g ||1||
english: Those who are imbued with the Love of the One Lord, O Nanak, take on the deep and lasting color of His Love. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਰਾ ਰੰਗਹੁ ਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: raaraa ra(n)gahu iaa man apanaa ||
english: RARRA: Dye this heart of yours in the color of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu jap rasanaa ||
english: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - chant it with your tongue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਰੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
transliteration: re re daragah kahai na kooo ||
english: In the Court of the Lord, no one shall speak harshly to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਬੈਠੁ ਆਦਰੁ ਸੁਭ ਦੇਊ ॥
transliteration: aau baith aadar subh deoo ||
english: Everyone shall welcome you, saying, "Come, and sit down."

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: uaa mahalee paavahi too baasaa ||
english: In that Mansion of the Lord's Presence, you shall find a home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਨਹ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: janam maran nah hoi binaasaa ||
english: There is no birth or death, or destruction there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਧੁਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: masatak karam likhio dhur jaa kai ||
english: One who has such karma written on his forehead,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: har sa(n)pai naanak ghar taa kai ||10||
english: O Nanak, has the wealth of the Lord in his home. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਧ ॥
transliteration: laalach jhooth bikaar moh biaapat mooRe a(n)dh ||
english: Greed, falsehood, corruption and emotional attachment entangle the blind and the foolish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
transliteration: laag pare duraga(n)dh siu naanak maaiaa ba(n)dh ||1||
english: Bound down by Maya, O Nanak, a foul odor clings to them. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਲਾ ਲਪਟਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: lalaa lapat bikhai ras raate ||
english: LALLA: People are entangled in the love of corrupt pleasures;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)budh maaiaa mad maate ||
english: they are drunk with the wine of egotistical intellect and Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: iaa maaiaa mahi janamahi maranaa ||
english: In this Maya, they are born and die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu jiu hukam tivai tiu karanaa ||
english: People act according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਊ ਊਨ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kooo oon na kooo pooraa ||
english: No one is perfect, and no one is imperfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਊ ਸੁਘਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਮੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kooo sughar na kooo mooraa ||
english: No one is wise, and no one is foolish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jit jit laavahu tit tit laganaa ||
english: Wherever the Lord engages someone, there he is engaged.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਨਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak thaakur sadaa alipanaa ||11||
english: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is forever detached. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹ ॥
transliteration: laal gupaal gobi(n)d prabh gahir ga(n)bheer athaah ||
english: My Beloved God, the Sustainer of the World, the Lord of the Universe, is deep, profound and unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: doosar naahee avar ko naanak beparavaah ||1||
english: There is no other like Him; O Nanak, He is not worried. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਲਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
transliteration: lalaa taa kai lavai na kooo ||
english: LALLA: There is no one equal to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਵਰ ਨਹ ਹੋਊ ॥
transliteration: ekahi aap avar nah hooo ||
english: He Himself is the One; there shall never be any other.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਹੋਤ ਸਦ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hovanahaar hot sad aaiaa ||
english: He is now, He has been, and He shall always be.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: uaa kaa a(n)t na kaahoo paaiaa ||
english: No one has ever found His limit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: keet hasat mahi poor samaane ||
english: In the ant and in the elephant, He is totally pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭ ਠਾਊ ਜਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: pragat purakh sabh thaaoo jaane ||
english: The Lord, the Primal Being, is known by everyone everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau deeno har ras apanaa ||
english: That one, unto whom the Lord has given His Love

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਹ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh har har tih japanaa ||12||
english: - O Nanak, that Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aatam ras jih jaaniaa har ra(n)g sahaje maan ||
english: One who knows the taste of the Lord's sublime essence, intuitively enjoys the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak dhan dhan dha(n)n jan aae te paravaan ||1||
english: O Nanak, blessed, blessed, blessed are the Lord's humble servants; how fortunate is their coming into the world! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਸਫਲ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਗਨੀਐ ॥
transliteration: aaiaa saphal taahoo ko ganeeai ||
english: How fruitful is the coming into the world, of those

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਨੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jaas rasan har har jas bhaneeai ||
english: whose tongues celebrate the Praises of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਬਸਹਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
transliteration: aai basahi saadhoo kai sa(n)ge ||
english: They come and dwell with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
transliteration: anadin naam dhiaavahi ra(n)ge ||
english: night and day, they lovingly meditate on the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aavat so jan naamahi raataa ||
english: Blessed is the birth of those humble beings who are attuned to the Naam;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau daiaa maiaa bidhaataa ||
english: the Lord, the Architect of Destiny, bestows His Kind Mercy upon them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਵਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ekahi aavan phir jon na aaiaa ||
english: They are born only once - they shall not be reincarnated again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak har kai daras samaaiaa ||13||
english: O Nanak, they are absorbed into the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: yaas japat man hoi ana(n)d binasai doojaa bhaau ||
english: Chanting it, the mind is filled with bliss; love of duality is eliminated, and pain, distress and desires are quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dookh darad trisanaa bujhai naanak naam samaau ||1||
english: O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਯਾ ਜਾਰਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੋਊ ॥
transliteration: yayaa jaarau duramat dooo ||
english: YAYYA: Burn away duality and evil-mindedness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਊ ॥
transliteration: tisahi tiaag sukh sahaje sooo ||
english: Give them up, and sleep in intuitive peace and poise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਯਾ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: yayaa jaai parahu sa(n)t saranaa ||
english: Yaya: Go, and seek the Sanctuary of the Saints;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਆਸਰ ਇਆ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jih aasar iaa bhavajal taranaa ||
english: with their help, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਯਾ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸੋਊ ॥
transliteration: yayaa janam na aavai sooo ||
english: Yaya: One who weaves the One Name into his heart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਲੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਪਰੋਊ ॥
transliteration: ek naam le manahi parooo ||
english: Does not have to take birth again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਯਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: yayaa janam na haareeai gur poore kee tek ||
english: Yaya: This human life shall not be wasted, if you take the Support of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਏਕ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak tih sukh paaiaa jaa kai heearai ek ||14||
english: O Nanak, one whose heart is filled with the One Lord finds peace. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar man tan bas rahe eet oot ke meet ||
english: The One who dwells deep within the mind and body is your friend here and hereafter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur poorai upadesiaa naanak japeeai neet ||1||
english: The Perfect Guru has taught me, O Nanak, to chant His Name continually. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin simarahu taas kau jo a(n)t sahaaee hoi ||
english: Night and day, meditate in remembrance on the One who will be your Help and Support in the end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਛਿਅ ਛਾਡਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ih bikhiaa din chaar chhi chhaad chalio sabh koi ||
english: This poison shall last for only a few days; everyone must depart, and leave it behind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾ ਕੋ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਧੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kaa ko maat pitaa sut dheeaa ||
english: Who is our mother, father, son and daughter?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: grih banitaa kachh sa(n)g na leeaa ||
english: Household, wife, and other things shall not go along with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਸੰਚਿ ਜੁ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: aisee sa(n)ch j binasat naahee ||
english: So gather that wealth which shall never perish,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: pat setee apunai ghar jaahee ||
english: so that you may go to your true home with honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g kal keeratan gaaiaa ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, those who sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak te te bahur na aaiaa ||15||
english: - O Nanak, they do not have to endure reincarnation again. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਚਤੁਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਙਿਆਨੀ ਧਨਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: at su(n)dar kuleen chatur mukh ngiaanee dhanava(n)t ||
english: He may be very handsome, born into a highly respected family, very wise, a famous spiritual teacher, prosperous and wealthy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: miratak kaheeahi naanakaa jih preet nahee bhagava(n)t ||1||
english: but even so, he is looked upon as a corpse, O Nanak, if he does not love the Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਙੰਙਾ ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ ਙਿਆਤਾ ॥
transliteration: nga(n)ngaa khat saasatr hoi ngiaataa ||
english: NGANGA: He may be a scholar of the six Shaastras.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਕੁ ਕੁੰਭਕ ਰੇਚਕ ਕਰਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: poorak ku(n)bhak rechak karamaataa ||
english: He may practice inhaling, exhaling and holding the breath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਙਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ngiaan dhiaan teerath isanaanee ||
english: He may practice spiritual wisdom, meditation, pilgrimages to sacred shrines and ritual cleansing baths.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਮਪਾਕ ਅਪਰਸ ਉਦਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: somapaak aparas udiaanee ||
english: He may cook his own food, and never touch anyone else's; he may live in the wilderness like a hermit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਹੇਤਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam sa(n)g man nahee hetaa ||
english: But if he does not enshrine love for the Lord's Name within his heart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋਊ ਅਨੇਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jo kachh keeno sooo anetaa ||
english: then everything he does is transitory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਤੇ ਊਤਮੁ ਗਨਉ ਚੰਡਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: uaa te ootam ganau cha(n)daalaa ||
english: Even an untouchable pariah is superior to him,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak jih man basahi gupaalaa ||16||
english: O Nanak, if the Lord of the World abides in his mind. ||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਟ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਰੇਖ ॥
transliteration: ku(n)t chaar dah dis bhrame karam kirat kee rekh ||
english: He wanders around in the four quarters and in the ten directions, according to the dictates of his karma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਲੇਖ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sookh dookh mukat jon naanak likhio lekh ||1||
english: Pleasure and pain, liberation and reincarnation, O Nanak, come according to one's pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pavaRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਕਾ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਊ ॥
transliteration: kakaa kaaran karataa sooo ||
english: KAKKA: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਓ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਤ ਕੋਊ ॥
transliteration: likhio lekh na metat kooo ||
english: No one can erase His pre-ordained plan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤ ਕਛੁ ਦੋਊ ਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: nahee hot kachh dooo baaraa ||
english: Nothing can be done a second time.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਭੂਲਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: karanaihaar na bhoolanahaaraa ||
english: The Creator Lord does not make mistakes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਾਰੈ ਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo pa(n)th dikhaarai aapai ||
english: To some, He Himself shows the Way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਪਛੁਤਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo udiaan bhramat pachhutaapai ||
english: While He causes others to wander miserably in the wilderness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਕੀਨੋ ॥
transliteration: aapan khel aap hee keeno ||
english: He Himself has set His own play in motion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਨੋ ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਨੋ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: jo jo deeno s naanak leeno ||17||
english: Whatever He gives, O Nanak, that is what we receive. ||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ ਰਹੇ ਟੂਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: khaat kharachat bilachhat rahe toot na jaahi bha(n)daar ||
english: People continue to eat and consume and enjoy, but the Lord's warehouses are never exhausted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har japat anek jan naanak naahi sumaar ||1||
english: So many chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, they cannot be counted. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਖਾ ਖੂਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਕੈ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: khakhaa khoonaa kachh nahee tis sa(n)mrath kai paahi ||
english: KHAKHA: The All-powerful Lord lacks nothing;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੇਨਾ ਸੋ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਓ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jo denaa so de rahio bhaavai tah tah jaahi ||
english: whatever He is to give, He continues to give - let anyone go anywhere he pleases.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਰਚੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਇਆ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: kharach khajaanaa naam dhan iaa bhagatan kee raas ||
english: The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a treasure to spend; it is the capital of His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜ ਜਪਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
transliteration: khimaa gareebee anad sahaj japat rahahi gunataas ||
english: With tolerance, humility, bliss and intuitive poise, they continue to meditate on the Lord, the Treasure of excellence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਲਹਿ ਬਿਗਸਹਿ ਅਨਦ ਸਿਉ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: khelahi bigasahi anad siu jaa kau hot kripaal ||
english: Those, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, play happily and blossom forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦੀਵ ਗਨੀਵ ਸੁਹਾਵਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sadeev ganeev suhaavane raam naam grihi maal ||
english: Those who have the wealth of the Lord's Name in their homes are forever wealthy and beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਦੁ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਡਾਨੁ ਤਿਹ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: khed na dookh na daan tih jaa kau nadar karee ||
english: Those who are blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace suffer neither torture, nor pain, nor punishment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਪਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak jo prabh bhaaniaa pooree tinaa paree ||18||
english: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God become perfectly successful. ||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਨਿ ਮਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਚਲਨੋ ਲੋਗ ॥
transliteration: gan min dekhahu manai maahi sarapar chalano log ||
english: See, that even by calculating and scheming in their minds, people must surely depart in the end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਅਨਿਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਰੋਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aas anit guramukh mitai naanak naam arog ||1||
english: Hopes and desires for transitory things are erased for the Gurmukh; O Nanak, the Name alone brings true health. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਗਾ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਜਪਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: gagaa gobid gun ravahu saas saas jap neet ||
english: GAGGA: Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe with each and every breath; meditate on Him forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਬਿਸਾਸਾ ਦੇਹ ਕਾ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਕਰਿਹੋ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: kahaa bisaasaa deh kaa bilam na kariho meet ||
english: How can you rely on the body? Do not delay, my friend;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਨਹ ਜੋਬਨੈ ਨਹ ਬਿਰਧੀ ਕਛੁ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: nah baarik nah jobanai nah biradhee kachh ba(n)dh ||
english: there is nothing to stand in Death's way - neither in childhood, nor in youth, nor in old age.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਬੇਰਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਜਉ ਆਇ ਪਰੈ ਜਮ ਫੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: oh beraa nah boojheeai jau aai parai jam pha(n)dh ||
english: That time is not known, when the noose of Death shall come and fall on you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਚਤੁਰ ਪੇਖਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਹ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: giaanee dhiaanee chatur pekh rahan nahee ih thaai ||
english: See, that even spiritual scholars, those who meditate, and those who are clever shall not stay in this place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਗਈ ਮੂੜ ਤਹਾ ਲਪਟਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: chhaad chhaad sagalee gaee mooR tahaa lapataahi ||
english: Only the fool clings to that, which everyone else has abandoned and left behind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਜਾਹੂ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad simarat rahai jaahoo masatak bhaag ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one who has such good destiny written on his forehead remembers the Lord in meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸਫਲ ਤੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅਹਿ ਸੁਹਾਗ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak aae saphal te jaa kau priahi suhaag ||19||
english: O Nanak, blessed and fruitful is the coming of those who obtain the Beloved Lord as their Husband. ||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੋਖੇ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਸਭ ਆਨ ਨ ਕਥਤਉ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ghokhe saasatr bed sabh aan na kathatau koi ||
english: I have searched all the Shaastras and the Vedas, and they say nothing except this:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੁਣਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aad jugaadee hun hovat naanak ekai soi ||1||
english: "In the beginning, throughout the ages, now and forevermore, O Nanak, the One Lord alone exists." ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਘਾ ਘਾਲਹੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਏਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ghaghaa ghaalahu manahi eh bin har doosar naahi ||
english: GHAGHA: Put this into your mind, that there is no one except the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਹੋਆ ਨਹ ਹੋਵਨਾ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਓਹੀ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: nah hoaa nah hovanaa jat kat ohee samaahi ||
english: There never was, and there never shall be. He is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੂਲਹਿ ਤਉ ਮਨ ਜਉ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ghoolahi tau man jau aavahi saranaa ||
english: You shall be absorbed into Him, O mind, if you come to His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਤਤੁ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naam tat kal mahi punahacharanaa ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall be of any real use to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਾਲਿ ਘਾਲਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ghaal ghaal anik pachhutaavahi ||
english: So many work and slave continually, but they come to regret and repent in the end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਹਾ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bin har bhagat kahaa thit paavahi ||
english: Without devotional worship of the Lord, how can they find stability?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਿਹ ਪੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ghol mahaa ras a(n)mrit tih peeaa ||
english: They alone taste the supreme essence, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak har gur jaa kau deeaa ||20||
english: O Nanak, unto whom the Lord, the Guru, gives it. ||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਙਣਿ ਘਾਲੇ ਸਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਸਾਸ ਨਹ ਬਢਨ ਘਟਨ ਤਿਲੁ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ngan ghaale sabh divas saas nah badhan ghatan til saar ||
english: He has counted all the days and the breaths, and placed them in people's destiny; they do not increase or decrease one little bit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਲੋਰਹਿ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਊ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeevan lorahi bharam moh naanak teoo gavaar ||1||
english: Those who long to live in doubt and emotional attachment, O Nanak, are total fools. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਙੰਙਾ ਙ੍ਰਾਸੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਹ ਜੋ ਸਾਕਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨ ॥
transliteration: nga(n)ngaa ngraasai kaal tih jo saakat prabh keen ||
english: NGANGA: Death seizes those whom God has made into faithless cynics.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨ ॥
transliteration: anik jon janamahi marahi aatam raam na cheen ||
english: They are born and they die, enduring countless incarnations; they do not realize the Lord, the Supreme Soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਙਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਤਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: ngiaan dhiaan taahoo kau aae ||
english: They alone find spiritual wisdom and meditation,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਹ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jih aap divaae ||
english: whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਙਣਤੀ ਙਣੀ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਊ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
transliteration: nganatee nganee nahee kooo chhootai ||
english: no one is emancipated by counting and calculating.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਫੂਟੈ ॥
transliteration: kaachee gaagar sarapar phootai ||
english: The vessel of clay shall surely break.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜੀਵਤ ਜਿਹ ਜੀਵਤ ਜਪਿਆ ॥
transliteration: so jeevat jih jeevat japiaa ||
english: They alone live, who, while alive, meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਛਪਿਆ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: pragat bhae naanak nah chhapiaa ||21||
english: They are respected, O Nanak, and do not remain hidden. ||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਊਧ ਕਵਲ ਬਿਗਸਾਂਤ ॥
transliteration: chit chitavau charanaarabi(n)d oodh kaval bigasaa(n)t ||
english: Focus your consciousness on His Lotus Feet, and the inverted lotus of your heart shall blossom forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਆਪਹਿ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਮਤਾਂਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pragat bhae aapahi goubi(n)d naanak sa(n)t mataa(n)t ||1||
english: The Lord of the Universe Himself becomes manifest, O Nanak, through the Teachings of the Saints. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਚਾ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: chachaa charan kamal gur laagaa ||
english: CHACHA: Blessed, blessed is that day,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਉਆ ਦਿਨ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan uaa din sa(n)jog sabhaagaa ||
english: when I became attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: chaar ku(n)t dah dis bhram aaio ||
english: After wandering around in the four quarters and the ten directions,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤਬ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: bhaee kripaa tab darasan paaio ||
