english: God showed His Mercy to me, and then I obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਸਭ ਦੂਆ ॥
transliteration: chaar bichaar binasio sabh dooaa ||
english: By pure lifestyle and meditation, all duality is removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੂਆ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g man niramal hooaa ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the mind becomes immaculate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
transliteration: chi(n)t bisaaree ek drisatetaa ||
english: Anxieties are forgotten, and the One Lord alone is seen,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਜਿਹ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਾ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak giaan a(n)jan jih netraa ||22||
english: O Nanak, by those whose eyes are anointed with the ointment of spiritual wisdom. ||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਾਤੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਮਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਛੰਤ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chhaatee seetal man sukhee chha(n)t gobid gun gaai ||
english: The heart is cooled and soothed, and the mind is at peace, chanting and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aisee kirapaa karahu prabh naanak daas dasaai ||1||
english: Show such Mercy, O God, that Nanak may become the slave of Your slaves. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਛਾ ਛੋਹਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: chhachhaa chhohare daas tumaare ||
english: CHHACHHA: I am Your child-slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਨੀਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: daas daasan ke paaneehaare ||
english: I am the water-carrier of the slave of Your slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਛਾ ਛਾਰੁ ਹੋਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: chhachhaa chhaar hot tere sa(n)taa ||
english: Chhachha: I long to become the dust under the feet of Your Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: apanee kripaa karahu bhagava(n)taa ||
english: Please shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord God!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: chhaad siaanap bahu chaturaaee ||
english: I have given up my excessive cleverness and scheming,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kee man tek tikaaee ||
english: and I have taken the support of the Saints as my mind's support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਾਰੁ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: chhaar kee putaree param gat paaee ||
english: Even a puppet of ashes attains the supreme status,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: naanak jaa kau sa(n)t sahaaee ||23||
english: O Nanak, if it has the help and support of the Saints. ||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਰ ਜੁਲਮ ਫੂਲਹਿ ਘਨੋ ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jor julam phoolahi ghano kaachee deh bikaar ||
english: Practicing oppression and tyranny, he puffs himself up; he acts in corruption with his frail, perishable body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਛੁਟਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aha(n)budh ba(n)dhan pare naanak naam chhutaar ||1||
english: He is bound by his egotistical intellect; O Nanak, salvation comes only through the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਜਾ ਜਾਨੈ ਹਉ ਕਛੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
transliteration: jajaa jaanai hau kachh hooaa ||
english: JAJJA: When someone, in his ego, believes that he has become something,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਧਿਓ ਜਿਉ ਨਲਿਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੂਆ ॥
transliteration: baadhio jiu nalinee bhram sooaa ||
english: he is caught in his error, like a parrot in a trap.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਜਾਨੈ ਹਉ ਭਗਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jau jaanai hau bhagat giaanee ||
english: When he believes, in his ego, that he is a devotee and a spiritual teacher,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: aagai thaakur til nahee maanee ||
english: then, in the world hereafter, the Lord of the Universe shall have no regard for him at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੈ ਕਥਨੀ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jau jaanai mai kathanee karataa ||
english: When he believes himself to be a preacher,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪਾਰੀ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਜਿਉ ਫਿਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: biaapaaree basudhaa jiu phirataa ||
english: he is merely a peddler wandering over the earth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jih haumai maaree ||
english: But one who conquers his ego in the Company of the Holy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੇ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: naanak taa kau mile muraaree ||24||
english: O Nanak, meets the Lord. ||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝਾਲਾਘੇ ਉਠਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: jhaalaaghe uth naam jap nis baasur aaraadh ||
english: Rise early in the morning, and chant the Naam; worship and adore the Lord, night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰ੍ਹਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਨ ਬਿਆਪਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਟੈ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaarhaa tujhai na biaapaee naanak mitai upaadh ||1||
english: Anxiety shall not afflict you, O Nanak, and your misfortune shall vanish. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝਝਾ ਝੂਰਨੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਤੁਮਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: jhajhaa jhooran mitai tumaaro ||
english: JHAJHA: Your sorrows shall depart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: raam naam siu kar biuhaaro ||
english: when you deal with the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਰਤ ਝੂਰਤ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂਆ ॥
transliteration: jhoorat jhoorat saakat mooaa ||
english: The faithless cynic dies in sorrow and pain;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਹੋਤ ਭਾਉ ਬੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai ridai hot bhaau beeaa ||
english: his heart is filled with the love of duality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝਰਹਿ ਕਸੰਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਤੇਰੇ ਮਨੂਆ ॥
transliteration: jharahi kasa(n)mal paap tere manooaa ||
english: Your evil deeds and sins shall fall away, O my mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਨੂਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit kathaa sa(n)tasa(n)g sunooaa ||
english: listening to the ambrosial speech in the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝਰਹਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਦ੍ਰੁਸਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jharahi kaam krodh drusataaee ||
english: Sexual desire, anger and wickedness fall away,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak jaa kau kripaa gusaaee ||25||
english: O Nanak, from those who are blessed by the Mercy of the Lord of the World. ||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਞਤਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: njatan karahu tum anik bidh rahan na paavahu meet ||
english: You can try all sorts of things, but you still cannot remain here, my friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਰਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeevat rahahu har har bhajahu naanak naam pareet ||1||
english: But you shall live forevermore, O Nanak, if you vibrate and love the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pavaRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਞੰਞਾ ਞਾਣਹੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸਹੀ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਤ ਏਹ ਹੇਤ ॥
transliteration: nja(n)njaa njaanahu driR sahee binas jaat eh het ||
english: NYANYA: Know this as absolutely correct, that that this ordinary love shall come to an end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣਉ ਨ ਗਣਿ ਸਕਉ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਕੇਤ ॥
transliteration: ganatee ganau na gan sakau ooth sidhaare ket ||
english: You may count and calculate as much as you want, but you cannot count how many have arisen and departed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਞੋ ਪੇਖਉ ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਤਉ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀਐ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: njo pekhau so binasatau kaa siu kareeai sa(n)g ||
english: Whoever I see shall perish. With whom should I associate?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਞਾਣਹੁ ਇਆ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਹੀ ਚਿਤ ਝੂਠਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: njaanahu iaa bidh sahee chit jhoothau maaiaa ra(n)g ||
english: Know this as true in your consciousness, that the love of Maya is false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਞਾਣਤ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਤੇ ਕੀਚਿਤ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
transliteration: njaanat soee sa(n)t sui bhram te keechit bhi(n)n ||
english: He alone knows, and he alone is a Saint, who is free of doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਤਿਹ ਕਢਹੁ ਜਿਹ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop te tih kadhahu jih hovahu suprasa(n)n ||
english: He is lifted up and out of the deep dark pit; the Lord is totally pleased with him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਞਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਤੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: njaa kai haath samarath te kaaran karanai jog ||
english: God's Hand is All-powerful; He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਞਾਹੂ ਕੀਓ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: naanak tih usatat karau njaahoo keeo sa(n)jog ||26||
english: O Nanak, praise the One, who joins us to Himself. ||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: toote ba(n)dhan janam maran saadh sev sukh paai ||
english: The bondage of birth and death is broken and peace is obtained, by serving the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਬੀਸਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak manahu na beesarai gun nidh gobid raai ||1||
english: O Nanak, may I never forget from my mind, the Treasure of Virtue, the Sovereign Lord of the Universe. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟਹਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tahal karahu tau ek kee jaa te brithaa na koi ||
english: Work for the One Lord; no one returns empty-handed from Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੀਐ ਬਸੈ ਜੋ ਚਾਹਹੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan mukh heeai basai jo chaahahu so hoi ||
english: When the Lord abides within your mind, body, mouth and heart, then whatever you desire shall come to pass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟਹਲ ਮਹਲ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: tahal mahal taa kau milai jaa kau saadh kripaal ||
english: He alone obtains the Lord's service, and the Mansion of His Presence, unto whom the Holy Saint is compassionate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਉ ਬਸੈ ਜਉ ਆਪਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat tau basai jau aapan hohi daiaal ||
english: He joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, only when the Lord Himself shows His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਹੇ ਟਾਹੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਵਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tohe taahe bahu bhavan bin naavai sukh naahi ||
english: I have searched and searched, across so many worlds, but without the Name, there is no peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟਲਹਿ ਜਾਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਤਿਹ ਜੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: talahi jaam ke doot tih j saadhoo sa(n)g samaahi ||
english: The Messenger of Death retreats from those who dwell in the Saadh Sangat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿ ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਕੇ ॥
transliteration: baar baar jaau sa(n)t sadake ||
english: Again and again, I am forever devoted to the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਕਦਿ ਕੇ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak paap binaase kad ke ||27||
english: O Nanak, my sins from so long ago have been erased. ||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਿਨਹੁ ਦਰਿ ਜਿਹ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
transliteration: thaak na hotee tinahu dar jih hovahu suprasa(n)n ||
english: Those beings, with whom the Lord is thoroughly pleased, meet with no obstacles at His Door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo jan prabh apune kare naanak te dhan dha(n)n ||1||
english: Those humble beings whom God has made His own, O Nanak, are blessed, so very blessed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਠਾ ਮਨੂਆ ਠਾਹਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: thathaa manooaa thaahahi naahee ||
english: T'HAT'HA: Those who have abandoned all else,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਏਕਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jo sagal tiaag ekahi lapataahee ||
english: and who cling to the One Lord alone, do not make trouble for anyone's mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਹਕਿ ਠਹਕਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੂਏ ॥
transliteration: thahak thahak maaiaa sa(n)g mooe ||
english: Those who are totally absorbed and preoccupied with Maya are dead;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਕੈ ਕੁਸਲ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਹੂਏ ॥
transliteration: uaa kai kusal na katahoo hooe ||
english: they do not find happiness anywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਂਢਿ ਪਰੀ ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: thaa(n)dh paree sa(n)tah sa(n)g basiaa ||
english: One who dwells in the Society of the Saints finds a great peace;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਹਾ ਜੀਅ ਰਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam tahaa jee rasiaa ||
english: the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam becomes sweet to his soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: thaakur apune jo jan bhaaiaa ||
english: That humble being, who is pleasing to his Lord and Master

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਆ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਆ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: naanak uaa kaa man seetalaaiaa ||28||
english: - O Nanak, his mind is cooled and soothed. ||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥ ॥
transliteration: da(n)daut ba(n)dan anik baar sarab kalaa samarath ||
english: I bow down, and fall to the ground in humble adoration, countless times, to the All-powerful Lord, who possesses all powers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਥ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dolan te raakhahu prabhoo naanak de kar hath ||1||
english: Please protect me, and save me from wandering, God. Reach out and give Nanak Your Hand. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਡਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਹ ਡੇਰਾ ਤਹ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: dadaa deraa ihu nahee jah deraa tah jaan ||
english: DADDA: This is not your true place; you must know where that place really is.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: uaa deraa kaa sa(n)jamo gur kai sabad pachhaan ||
english: You shall come to realize the way to that place, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਉ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: iaa deraa kau sram kar ghaalai ||
english: This place, here, is established by hard work,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤਸੂ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa tasoo nahee sa(n)g chaalai ||
english: but not one iota of this shall go there with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: uaa deraa kee so mit jaanai ||
english: The value of that place beyond is known only to those,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau drisat pooran bhagavaanai ||
english: upon whom the Perfect Lord God casts His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡੇਰਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: deraa nihachal sach saadhasa(n)g paaiaa ||
english: That permanent and true place is obtained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਹ ਡੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: naanak te jan nah dolaaiaa ||29||
english: O Nanak, those humble beings do not waver or wander. ||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਢਾਹਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਨ ਘਾਲਿਓ ਬੰਧ ॥
transliteration: dhaahan laage dharam raai kinahi na ghaalio ba(n)dh ||
english: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma begins to destroy someone, no one can place any obstacle in His Way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਨਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ubare jap haree saadhasa(n)g sanaba(n)dh ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat and meditate on the Lord are saved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਢਢਾ ਢੂਢਤ ਕਹ ਫਿਰਹੁ ਢੂਢਨੁ ਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: dhadhaa dhoodhat kah phirahu dhoodhan iaa man maahi ||
english: DHADHA: Where are you going, wandering and searching? Search instead within your own mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g tuhaarai prabh basai ban ban kahaa phiraahi ||
english: God is with you, so why do you wander around from forest to forest?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਢੇਰੀ ਢਾਹਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
transliteration: dheree dhaahahu saadhasa(n)g aha(n)budh bikaraal ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, tear down the mound of your frightful, egotistical pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਸਹੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sukh paavahu sahaje basahu darasan dekh nihaal ||
english: You shall find peace, and abide in intuitive bliss; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan, you shall be delighted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਢੇਰੀ ਜਾਮੈ ਜਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dheree jaamai jam marai garabh jon dukh paai ||
english: One who has such a mound as this, dies and suffers the pain of reincarnation through the womb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਲਪਟਤ ਰਹੈ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: moh magan lapatat rahai hau hau aavai jaai ||
english: One who is intoxicated by emotional attachment, entangled in egotism, selfishness and conceit, shall continue coming and going in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਢਹਤ ਢਹਤ ਅਬ ਢਹਿ ਪਰੇ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhahat dhahat ab dhahi pare saadh janaa saranaai ||
english: Slowly and steadily, I have now surrendered to the Holy Saints; I have come to their Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: dukh ke phaahe kaatiaa naanak leee samaai ||30||
english: God has cut away the noose of my pain; O Nanak, He has merged me into Himself. ||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: jah saadhoo gobid bhajan keeratan naanak neet ||
english: Where the Holy people constantly vibrate the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O Nanak

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਣਾ ਹਉ ਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਣਹ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਅਹੁ ਦੂਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naa hau naa too(n) nah chhutahi nikat na jaaeeahu doot ||1||
english: - the Righteous Judge says, "Do not approach that place, O Messenger of Death, or else neither you nor I shall escape!" ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਣਾਣਾ ਰਣ ਤੇ ਸੀਝੀਐ ਆਤਮ ਜੀਤੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanaa ran te seejheeai aatam jeetai koi ||
english: NANNA: One who conquers his own soul, wins the battle of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੂ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai an siu lar marai so sobhaa doo hoi ||
english: One who dies, while fighting against egotism and alienation, becomes sublime and beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਣੀ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
transliteration: manee mitaai jeevat marai gur poore upades ||
english: One who eradicates his ego, remains dead while yet alive, through the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਜੀਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਹ ਸੂਰਤਣ ਵੇਸ ॥
transliteration: manooaa jeetai har milai tih sooratan ves ||
english: He conquers his mind, and meets the Lord; he is dressed in robes of honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਣਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੋ ਏਕਹਿ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naa ko jaanai aapano ekahi tek adhaar ||
english: He does not claim anything as his own; the One Lord is his Anchor and Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਣਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: rain dinas simarat rahai so prabh purakh apaar ||
english: Night and day, he continually contemplates the Almighty, Infinite Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇਣ ਸਗਲ ਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਏਊ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ren sagal iaa man karai eoo karam kamaai ||
english: He makes his mind the dust of all; such is the karma of the deeds he does.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: hukamai boojhai sadaa sukh naanak likhiaa paai ||31||
english: Understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he attains everlasting peace. O Nanak, such is his pre-ordained destiny. ||31||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tan man dhan arapau tisai prabhoo milaavai mohi ||
english: I offer my body, mind and wealth to anyone who can unite me with God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੋਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bhram bhau kaateeai chookai jam kee joh ||1||
english: O Nanak, my doubts and fears have been dispelled, and the Messenger of Death does not see me any longer. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਤਾ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tataa taa siu preet kar gun nidh gobid raai ||
english: TATTA: Embrace love for the Treasure of Excellence, the Sovereign Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਬਾਛਤੇ ਤਪਤਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: phal paavahi man baachhate tapat tuhaaree jaai ||
english: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires, and your burning thirst shall be quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੈ ਜਮ ਪੰਥ ਕੀ ਜਾਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: traas mitai jam pa(n)th kee jaas basai man naau ||
english: One whose heart is filled with the Name shall have no fear on the path of death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gat paavahi mat hoi pragaas mahalee paavahi thaau ||
english: He shall obtain salvation, and his intellect shall be enlightened; he will find his place in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਧਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਬਨ ਨਹ ਰਾਜ ॥
transliteration: taahoo sa(n)g na dhan chalai grih joban nah raaj ||
english: Neither wealth, nor household, nor youth, nor power shall go along with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹੁ ਇਹੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਕਾਜ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g simarat rahahu ihai tuhaarai kaaj ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord. This alone shall be of use to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਤਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਉ ਤਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਆਪ ॥
transliteration: taataa kachhoo na hoee hai jau taap nivaarai aap ||
english: There will be no burning at all, when He Himself takes away your fever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮਹਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੩੨॥
transliteration: pratipaalai naanak hamahi aapahi maaee baap ||32||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself cherishes us; He is our Mother and Father. ||32||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਘਾਲਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਥ ॥
transliteration: thaake bahu bidh ghaalate tripat na trisanaa laath ||
english: They have grown weary, struggling in all sorts of ways; but they are not satisfied, and their thirst is not quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਚਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)ch sa(n)ch saakat mooe naanak maaiaa na saath ||1||
english: Gathering in and hoarding what they can, the faithless cynics die, O Nanak, but the wealth of Maya does not go with them in the end. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਥਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋਊ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਇ ਪਸਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਵ ॥
transliteration: thathaa thir kooo nahee kaai pasaarahu paav ||
english: T'HAT'HA: Nothing is permanent - why do you stretch out your feet?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬੰਚ ਬਲ ਛਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਏਕ ਉਪਾਵ ॥
transliteration: anik ba(n)ch bal chhal karahu maaiaa ek upaav ||
english: You commit so many fraudulent and deceitful actions as you chase after Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥੈਲੀ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਥਾਕਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: thailee sa(n)chahu sram karahu thaak parahu gaavaar ||
english: You work to fill up your bag, you fool, and then you fall down exhausted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅੰਤੇ ਅਉਸਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: man kai kaam na aavaee a(n)te ausar baar ||
english: But this shall be of no use to you at all at that very last instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: thit paavahu gobid bhajahu sa(n)tah kee sikh lehu ||
english: You shall find stability only by vibrating upon the Lord of the Universe, and accepting the Teachings of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: preet karahu sad ek siu iaa saachaa asanehu ||
english: Embrace love for the One Lord forever - this is true love!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨੋ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਏਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: kaaran karan karaavano sabh bidh ekai haath ||
english: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes. All ways and means are in His Hands alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਅਨਾਥ ॥੩੩॥
transliteration: jit jit laavahu tit tit lagahi naanak ja(n)t anaath ||33||
english: Whatever You attach me to, to that I am attached; O Nanak, I am just a helpless creature. ||33||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਹ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: daasah ek nihaariaa sabh kachh devanahaar ||
english: His slaves have gazed upon the One Lord, the Giver of everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saas saas simarat rahahi naanak daras adhaar ||1||
english: They continue to contemplate Him with each and every breath; O Nanak, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is their Support. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਦਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: dadaa daataa ek hai sabh kau devanahaar ||
english: DADDA: The One Lord is the Great Giver; He is the Giver to all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਂਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅਗਨਤ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: de(n)de tot na aavaee aganat bhare bha(n)daar ||
english: There is no limit to His Giving. His countless warehouses are filled to overflowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੈਨਹਾਰੁ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dainahaar sad jeevanahaaraa ||
english: The Great Giver is alive forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਿਉ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man moorakh kiu taahi bisaaraa ||
english: O foolish mind, why have you forgotten Him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੋਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: dos nahee kaahoo kau meetaa ||
english: No one is at fault, my friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਬੰਧੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa moh ba(n)dh prabh keetaa ||
english: God created the bondage of emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: darad nivaarahi jaa ke aape ||
english: He Himself removes the pains of the Gurmukh;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ॥੩੪॥
transliteration: naanak te te guramukh dhraape ||34||
english: O Nanak, he is fulfilled. ||34||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਇਕ ਟੇਕ ਤੂ ਲਾਹਿ ਬਿਡਾਨੀ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: dhar jeeare ik tek too laahi bidaanee aas ||
english: O my soul, grasp the Support of the One Lord; give up your hopes in others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeeai kaaraj aavai raas ||1||
english: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਤਉ ਮਿਟੈ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: dhadhaa dhaavat tau mitai sa(n)tasa(n)g hoi baas ||
english: DHADHA: The mind's wanderings cease, when one comes to dwell in the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਹਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: dhur te kirapaa karahu aap tau hoi manahi paragaas ||
english: If the Lord is Merciful from the very beginning, then one's mind is enlightened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਤੇਊ ਸਚ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: dhan saachaa teoo sach saahaa ||
english: Those who have the true wealth are the true bankers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਸਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: har har poo(n)jee naam bisaahaa ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is their wealth, and they trade in His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਜਸੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਤਿਹ ਬਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dheeraj jas sobhaa tih baniaa ||
english: Patience, glory and honor come to those

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜਿਹ ਸੁਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har har naam sravan jih suniaa ||
english: who listen to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jih ghat rahe samaaee ||
english: That Gurmukh whose heart remains merged with the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੩੫॥
transliteration: naanak tih jan milee vadaaee ||35||
english: O Nanak, obtains glorious greatness. ||35||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak naam naam jap japiaa a(n)tar baahar ra(n)g ||
english: O Nanak, one who chants the Naam, and meditates on the Naam with love inwardly and outwardly,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਰਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur poorai upadesiaa narak naahi saadhasa(n)g ||1||
english: receives the Teachings from the Perfect Guru; he joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and does not fall into hell. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੰਨਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਪਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: na(n)naa narak parahi te naahee ||
english: NANNA: Those whose minds and bodies are filled with the Naam,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai man tan naam basaahee ||
english: The Name of the Lord, shall not fall into hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਜਪਤੇ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan guramukh jo japate ||
english: Those Gurmukhs who chant the treasure of the Naam,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਖਪਤੇ ॥
transliteration: bikh maaiaa mahi naa oi khapate ||
english: are not destroyed by the poison of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੰਨਾਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਤਾ ਕਹੁ ॥
transliteration: na(n)naakaar na hotaa taa kahu ||
english: Those who have been given the Mantra of the Naam by the Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਾ ਕਹੁ ॥
transliteration: naam ma(n)tr gur deeno jaa kahu ||
english: Shall not be turned away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: nidh nidhaan har a(n)mrit poore ||
english: They are filled and fulfilled with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, the Treasure of sublime wealth;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਬਾਜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥੩੬॥
transliteration: tah baaje naanak anahad toore ||36||
english: O Nanak, the unstruck celestial melody vibrates for them. ||36||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਜਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: pat raakhee gur paarabraham taj parapa(n)ch moh bikaar ||
english: The Guru, the Supreme Lord God, preserved my honor, when I renounced hypocrisy, emotional attachment and corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਊ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sooo aaraadheeai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, worship and adore the One, who has no end or limitation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਪਾ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: papaa paramit paar na paaiaa ||
english: PAPPA: He is beyond estimation; His limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਅਗਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan agam har raaiaa ||
english: The Sovereign Lord King is inaccessible;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕੋਟ ਅਪਰਾਧੂ ॥
transliteration: hot puneet kot aparaadhoo ||
english: He is the Purifier of sinners. Millions of sinners are purified;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam japahi mil saadhoo ||
english: they meet the Holy, and chant the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਪਚ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਮੋਹ ਮਿਟਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: parapach dhroh moh mitanaaee ||
english: Deception, fraud and emotional attachment are eliminated,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau raakhahu aap gusaaee ||
english: by those who are protected by the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਰ ਸੋਊ ॥
transliteration: paatisaahu chhatr sir sooo ||
english: He is the Supreme King, with the royal canopy above His Head.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਸਰ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥੩੭॥
transliteration: naanak doosar avar na kooo ||37||
english: O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||37||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਗਵਨ ਫਤਿਹ ਭਈ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਤ ॥
transliteration: phaahe kaate mite gavan phatih bhaee man jeet ||
english: The noose of Death is cut, and one's wanderings cease; victory is obtained, when one conquers his own mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਥਿਤ ਪਾਈ ਫਿਰਨ ਮਿਟੇ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak gur te thit paaee phiran mite nit neet ||1||
english: O Nanak, eternal stability is obtained from the Guru, and one's day-to-day wanderings cease. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਫਾ ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਤੂ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: phaphaa phirat phirat too aaiaa ||
english: FAFFA: After wandering and wandering for so long, you have come;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: drulabh deh kalijug mahi paaiaa ||
english: in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, you have obtained this human body, so very difficult to obtain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਇਆ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਨ ਹਾਥਾ ॥
transliteration: phir iaa ausar charai na haathaa ||
english: This opportunity shall not come into your hands again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਉ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: naam japahu tau kateeahi phaasaa ||
english: So chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the noose of Death shall be cut away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: phir phir aavan jaan na hoee ||
english: You shall not have to come and go in reincarnation over and over again,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ekahi ek japahu jap soee ||
english: if you chant and meditate on the One and Only Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: karahu kripaa prabh karanaihaare ||
english: Shower Your Mercy, O God, Creator Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਲਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਚਾਰੇ ॥੩੮॥
transliteration: mel lehu naanak bechaare ||38||
english: and unite poor Nanak with Yourself. ||38||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: binau sunahu tum paarabraham deen daiaal gupaal ||
english: Hear my prayer, O Supreme Lord God, Merciful to the meek, Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪੈ ਬਹੁ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sukh sa(n)pai bahu bhog ras naanak saadh ravaal ||1||
english: The dust of the feet of the Holy is peace, wealth, great enjoyment and pleasure for Nanak. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਬਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਾਨਤ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ॥
transliteration: babaa braham jaanat te brahamaa ||
english: BABBA: One who knows God is a Brahmin.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਸਨੋ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਚ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: baisano te guramukh such dharamaa ||
english: A Vaishnaav is one who, as Gurmukh, lives the righteous life of Dharma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੀਰਾ ਆਪਨ ਬੁਰਾ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: beeraa aapan buraa mitaavai ||
english: One who eradicates his own evil is a brave warrior;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਹੂ ਬੁਰਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: taahoo buraa nikat nahee aavai ||
english: no evil even approaches him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਧਿਓ ਆਪਨ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: baadhio aapan hau hau ba(n)dhaa ||
english: Man is bound by the chains of his own egotism, selfishness and conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੋਸੁ ਦੇਤ ਆਗਹ ਕਉ ਅੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: dos det aagah kau a(n)dhaa ||
english: The spiritually blind place the blame on others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਤ ਚੀਤ ਸਭ ਰਹੀ ਸਿਆਨਪ ॥
transliteration: baat cheet sabh rahee siaanap ||
english: But all debates and clever tricks are of no use at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਨਾਵਹੁ ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਨਾਨਕ ॥੩੯॥
transliteration: jisahi janaavahu so jaanai naanak ||39||
english: O Nanak, he alone comes to know, whom the Lord inspires to know. ||39||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਅਘ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bhai bha(n)jan agh dookh naas manahi araadh hare ||
english: The Destroyer of fear, the Eradicator of sin and sorrow - enshrine that Lord in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਜਿਹ ਰਿਦ ਬਸਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g jih rid basio naanak te na bhrame ||1||
english: One whose heart abides in the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, does not wander around in doubt. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਭਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bhabhaa bharam mitaavahu apanaa ||
english: BHABHA: Cast out your doubt and delusion

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: iaa sa(n)saar sagal hai supanaa ||
english: this world is just a dream.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: bharame sur nar devee devaa ||
english: The angelic beings, goddesses and gods are deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: bharame sidh saadhik brahamevaa ||
english: The Siddhas and seekers, and even Brahma are deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਡਹਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bharam bharam maanukh dahakaae ||
english: Wandering around, deluded by doubt, people are ruined.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤਰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮ ਇਹ ਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dutar mahaa bikham ih maae ||
english: It is so very difficult and treacherous to cross over this ocean of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhram bhai moh mitaaiaa ||
english: That Gurmukh who has eradicated doubt, fear and attachment,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਹ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪੦॥
transliteration: naanak teh param sukh paaiaa ||40||
english: O Nanak, obtains supreme peace. ||40||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਗ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa dolai bahu bidhee man lapatio tih sa(n)g ||
english: Maya clings to the mind, and causes it to waver in so many ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਗਨ ਤੇ ਜਿਹ ਤੁਮ ਰਖਹੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maagan te jih tum rakhahu s naanak naamahi ra(n)g ||1||
english: When You, O Lord, restrain someone from asking for wealth, then, O Nanak, he comes to love the Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਮਾ ਮਾਗਨਹਾਰ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mamaa maaganahaar iaanaa ||
english: MAMMA: The beggar is so ignorant

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਨਹਾਰ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਓ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: denahaar de rahio sujaanaa ||
english: the Great Giver continues to give. He is All-knowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਨੋ ਸੋ ਏਕਹਿ ਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jo deeno so ekahi baar ||
english: Whatever He gives, He gives once and for all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਹ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: man moorakh kah karahi pukaar ||
english: O foolish mind, why do you complain, and cry out so loud?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਤਉ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਬੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jau maagahi tau maagahi beeaa ||
english: Whenever you ask for something, you ask for worldly things;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਕੁਸਲ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਥੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa te kusal na kaahoo theeaa ||
english: no one has obtained happiness from these.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਗਨਿ ਮਾਗ ਤ ਏਕਹਿ ਮਾਗ ॥
transliteration: maagan maag ta ekahi maag ||
english: If you must ask for a gift, then ask for the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਪਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਗ ॥੪੧॥
transliteration: naanak jaa te parahi paraag ||41||
english: O Nanak, by Him, you shall be saved. ||41||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੰਤ ॥
transliteration: mat pooree paradhaan te gur poore man ma(n)t ||
english: Perfect is the intellect, and most distinguished is the reputation, of those whose minds are filled with the Mantra of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jih jaanio prabh aapunaa naanak te bhagava(n)t ||1||
english: Those who come to know their God, O Nanak, are very fortunate. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਮਾ ਜਾਹੂ ਮਰਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mamaa jaahoo maram pachhaanaa ||
english: MAMMA: Those who understand God's mystery are satisfied,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bhetat saadhasa(n)g pateeaanaa ||
english: joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਉਆ ਕੈ ਸਮਤ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh uaa kai samat beechaaraa ||
english: They look upon pleasure and pain as the same.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਰਹਤ ਅਉਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: narak surag rahat autaaraa ||
english: They are exempt from incarnation into heaven or hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਹੂ ਸੰਗ ਤਾਹੂ ਨਿਰਲੇਪਾ ॥
transliteration: taahoo sa(n)g taahoo niralepaa ||
english: They live in the world, and yet they are detached from it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਸੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: pooran ghat ghat purakh bisekhaa ||
english: The Sublime Lord, the Primal Being, is totally pervading each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਉਆਹੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: uaa ras mahi uaahoo sukh paaiaa ||
english: In His Love, they find peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਪਤ ਨਹੀ ਤਿਹ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪੨॥
transliteration: naanak lipat nahee tih maaiaa ||42||
english: O Nanak, Maya does not cling to them at all. ||42||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਾਰ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਾਜਨਹੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: yaar meet sun saajanahu bin har chhootan naahi ||
english: Listen, my dear friends and companions: without the Lord, there is no salvation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tih ba(n)dhan kate gur kee charanee paahi ||1||
english: O Nanak, one who falls at the Feet of the Guru, has his bonds cut away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pavaRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਯਾ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧੀਆ ॥
transliteration: yayaa jatan karat bahu bidheeaa ||
english: YAYYA: People try all sorts of things,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹ ਲਉ ਸਿਧੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ek naam bin kah lau sidheeaa ||
english: but without the One Name, how far can they succeed?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਾਹੂ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਹੋਤ ਛੁਟਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: yaahoo jatan kar hot chhutaaraa ||
english: Those efforts, by which emancipation may be attained

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆਹੂ ਜਤਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: uaahoo jatan saadh sa(n)gaaraa ||
english: those efforts are made in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਾ ਉਬਰਨ ਧਾਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ॥
transliteration: yaa ubaran dhaarai sabh kooo ||
english: Everyone has this idea of salvation,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆਹਿ ਜਪੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਬਰ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
transliteration: uaahi jape bin ubar na hooo ||
english: but without meditation, there can be no salvation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਾਹੂ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਸਮਰਾਥਾ ॥
transliteration: yaahoo taran taaran samaraathaa ||
english: The All-powerful Lord is the boat to carry us across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਨਰਨਾਥਾ ॥
transliteration: raakh lehu niragun naranaathaa ||
english: O Lord, please save these worthless beings!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਜਿਹ ਆਪਿ ਜਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man bach kram jih aap janaaee ||
english: Those whom the Lord Himself instructs in thought, word and deed

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਆਈ ॥੪੩॥
transliteration: naanak tih mat pragatee aaee ||43||
english: - O Nanak, their intellect is enlightened. ||43||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ros na kaahoo sa(n)g karahu aapan aap beechaar ||
english: Do not be angry with anyone else; look within your own self instead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਨਾ ਜਗਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hoi nimaanaa jag rahahu naanak nadaree paar ||1||
english: Be humble in this world, O Nanak, and by His Grace you shall be carried across. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਰਾ ਰੇਨ ਹੋਤ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raaraa ren hot sabh jaa kee ||
english: RARRA: Be the dust under the feet of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਛੁਟੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਕੀ ॥
transliteration: taj abhimaan chhutai teree baakee ||
english: Give up your egotistical pride, and the balance of your account shall be written off.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਣਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਤਉ ਸੀਝਹਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ran daragahi tau seejhahi bhaaee ||
english: Then, you shall win the battle in the Court of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jau guramukh raam naam liv laaee ||
english: As Gurmukh, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਹਤ ਰਹਤ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: rahat rahat rahi jaahi bikaaraa ||
english: Your evil ways shall be slowly and steadily blotted out,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kai sabad apaaraa ||
english: By the Shabad, the Incomparable Word of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਮ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: raate ra(n)g naam ras maate ||
english: You shall be imbued with the Lord's Love, and intoxicated with the Nectar of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੪੪॥
transliteration: naanak har gur keenee daate ||44||
english: O Nanak, the Lord, the Guru, has given this gift. ||44||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਇਆ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਸ ॥
transliteration: laalach jhooth bikhai biaadh iaa dehee mahi baas ||
english: The afflictions of greed, falsehood and corruption abide in this body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har a(n)mrit guramukh peeaa naanak sookh nivaas ||1||
english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, O Nanak, the Gurmukh abides in peace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਲਾ ਲਾਵਉ ਅਉਖਧ ਜਾਹੂ ॥
transliteration: lalaa laavau aukhadh jaahoo ||
english: LALLA: One who takes the medicine of the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਤਿਹ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਖਿਨਾਹੂ ॥
transliteration: dookh darad tih mitahi khinaahoo ||
english: is cured of his pain and sorrow in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਿਹ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਿਤਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naam aukhadh jih ridai hitaavai ||
english: One whose heart is filled with the medicine of the Naam,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਹਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: taahi rog supanai nahee aavai ||
english: is not infested with disease, even in his dreams.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har aukhadh sabh ghat hai bhaaee ||
english: The medicine of the Lord's Name is in all hearts, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur poore bin bidh na banaaee ||
english: Without the Perfect Guru, no one knows how to prepare it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai sa(n)jam kar deeaa ||
english: When the Perfect Guru gives the instructions to prepare it,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੪੫॥
transliteration: naanak tau phir dookh na theeaa ||45||
english: then, O Nanak, one does not suffer illness again. ||45||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaasudev sarabatr mai oon na katahoo thaai ||
english: The All-pervading Lord is in all places. There is no place where He does not exist.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਇ ਦੁਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar sa(n)g hai naanak kaai duraai ||1||
english: Inside and outside, He is with you. O Nanak, what can be hidden from Him? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਵਾ ਵੈਰੁ ਨ ਕਰੀਐ ਕਾਹੂ ॥
transliteration: vavaa vair na kareeai kaahoo ||
english: WAWWA: Do not harbor hatred against anyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮਾਹੂ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar braham samaahoo ||
english: In each and every heart, God is contained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: vaasudev jal thal mahi raviaa ||
english: The All-pervading Lord is permeating and pervading the oceans and the land.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਹੀ ਗਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad viralai hee gaviaa ||
english: How rare are those who, by Guru's Grace, sing of Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਮਿਟੇ ਤਿਹ ਮਨ ਤੇ ॥
transliteration: vair virodh mite tih man te ||
english: Hatred and alienation depart from those

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਸੁਨਤੇ ॥
transliteration: har keeratan guramukh jo sunate ||
english: who, as Gurmukh, listen to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਨ ਚਿਹਨ ਸਗਲਹ ਤੇ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
transliteration: varan chihan sagalah te rahataa ||
english: O Nanak, one who becomes Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਕਹਤਾ ॥੪੬॥
transliteration: naanak har har guramukh jo kahataa ||46||
english: Har, Har, and rises above all social classes and status symbols. ||46||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀਆ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
transliteration: hau hau karat bihaaneeaa saakat mugadh ajaan ||
english: Acting in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the foolish, ignorant, faithless cynic wastes his life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੜੜਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਜਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: RaRak mue jiu trikhaava(n)t naanak kirat kamaan ||1||
english: He dies in agony, like one dying of thirst; O Nanak, this is because of the deeds he has done. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੜਾੜਾ ੜਾੜਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ॥
transliteration: RaaRaa RaaR mitai sa(n)g saadhoo ||
english: RARRA: Conflict is eliminated in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਨਾਮ ਅਰਾਧੂ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam tat naam araadhoo ||
english: meditate in adoration on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the essence of karma and Dharma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂੜੋ ਜਿਹ ਬਸਿਓ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: rooRo jih basio rid maahee ||
english: When the Beautiful Lord abides within the heart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਕੀ ੜਾੜਿ ਮਿਟਤ ਬਿਨਸਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: uaa kee RaaR mitat binasaahee ||
english: conflict is erased and ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੜਾੜਿ ਕਰਤ ਸਾਕਤ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: RaaR karat saakat gaavaaraa ||
english: The foolish, faithless cynic picks arguments

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹ ਹੀਐ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jeh heeai aha(n)budh bikaaraa ||
english: his heart is filled with corruption and egotistical intellect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੜਾੜਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ੜਾੜਿ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: RaaRaa guramukh RaaR mitaaee ||
english: RARRA: For the Gurmukh, conflict is eliminated in an instant,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੪੭॥
transliteration: nimakh maahi naanak samajhaaee ||47||
english: O Nanak, through the Teachings. ||47||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਓਟ ਗਹੁ ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo kee man ot gahu ukat siaanap tiaag ||
english: O mind, grasp the Support of the Holy Saint; give up your clever arguments.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur deekhiaa jih man basai naanak masatak bhaag ||1||
english: One who has the Guru's Teachings within his mind, O Nanak, has good destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਸਾ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਅਬ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sasaa saran pare ab haare ||
english: SASSA: I have now entered Your Sanctuary, Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੂਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saasatr simrit bed pookaare ||
english: I am so tired of reciting the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sodhat sodhat sodh beechaaraa ||
english: I searched and searched and searched, and now I have come to realize,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bin har bhajan nahee chhutakaaraa ||
english: that without meditating on the Lord, there is no emancipation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਮ ਭੂਲਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saas saas ham bhoolanahaare ||
english: With each and every breath, I make mistakes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਗਨਤ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tum samarath aganat apaare ||
english: You are All-powerful, endless and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: saran pare kee raakh daiaalaa ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary - please save me, Merciful Lord!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੪੮॥
transliteration: naanak tumare baal gupaalaa ||48||
english: Nanak is Your child, O Lord of the World. ||48||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਤਬ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਅਰੋਗ ॥
transliteration: khudee mitee tab sukh bhae man tan bhae arog ||
english: When selfishness and conceit are erased, peace comes, and the mind and body are healed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak drisatee aaiaa usatat karanai jog ||1||
english: O Nanak, then He comes to be seen - the One who is worthy of praise. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਖਾ ਖਰਾ ਸਰਾਹਉ ਤਾਹੂ ॥
transliteration: khakhaa kharaa saraahau taahoo ||
english: KHAKHA: Praise and extol Him on High,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਊਨੇ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਾਹੂ ॥
transliteration: jo khin mahi oone subhar bharaahoo ||
english: who fills the empty to over-flowing in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਰਾ ਨਿਮਾਨਾ ਹੋਤ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kharaa nimaanaa hot paraanee ||
english: When the mortal being becomes totally humble,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: anadin jaapai prabh nirabaanee ||
english: then he meditates night and day on God, the Detached Lord of Nirvaanaa.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਵੈ ਖਸਮ ਤ ਉਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaavai khasam ta uaa sukh detaa ||
english: If it pleases the Will of our Lord and Master, then He blesses us with peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਐਸੋ ਆਗਨਤਾ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham aiso aaganataa ||
english: Such is the Infinite, Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਖਤੇ ਖਿਨ ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh khate khin bakhasanahaaraa ||
english: He forgives countless sins in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਰਾ ॥੪੯॥
transliteration: naanak saahib sadaa daiaaraa ||49||
english: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is merciful forever. ||49||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਕਹਉ ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sat kahau sun man mere saran parahu har raai ||
english: I speak the Truth - listen, O my mind: take to the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ukat siaanap sagal tiaag naanak lae samaai ||1||
english: Give up all your clever tricks, O Nanak, and He shall absorb you into Himself. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਸਾ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਛਾਡੁ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sasaa siaanap chhaad iaanaa ||
english: SASSA: Give up your clever tricks, you ignorant fool!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: hikamat hukam na prabh pateeaanaa ||
english: God is not pleased with clever tricks and commands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sahas bhaat karahi chaturaaee ||
english: You may practice a thousand forms of cleverness,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g tuhaarai ek na jaaee ||
english: but not even one will go along with you in the end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਊ ਸੋਊ ਜਪਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: sooo sooo jap din raatee ||
english: Meditate on that Lord, that Lord, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਚਲੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਸਾਥੀ ॥
transliteration: re jee chalai tuhaarai saathee ||
english: O soul, He alone shall go along with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਵੈ ਜਿਹ ਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: saadh sevaa laavai jih aapai ||
english: Those whom the Lord Himself commits to the service of the Holy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥੫੦॥
transliteration: naanak taa kau dookh na biaapai ||50||
english: O Nanak, are not afflicted by suffering. ||50||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har har mukh te bolanaa man voothai sukh hoi ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and keeping it in your mind, you shall find peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sabh mahi rav rahiaa thaan thana(n)tar soi ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Lord is pervading everywhere; He is contained in all spaces and interspaces. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇਰਉ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਗਲ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: herau ghat ghat sagal kai poor rahe bhagavaan ||
english: Behold! The Lord God is totally pervading each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਵਤ ਆਏ ਸਦ ਸਦੀਵ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: hovat aae sad sadeev dukh bha(n)jan gur giaan ||
english: Forever and ever, the Guru's wisdom has been the Destroyer of pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਤਿਹ ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਹ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: hau chhutakai hoi ana(n)d tih hau naahee tah aap ||
english: Quieting the ego, ecstasy is obtained. Where the ego does not exist, God Himself is there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਤੇ ਦੂਖ ਜਨਮਹ ਮਰਨ ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: hate dookh janamah maran sa(n)tasa(n)g parataap ||
english: The pain of birth and death is removed, by the power of the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: hit kar naam driRai daiaalaa ||
english: He becomes kind to those who lovingly enshrine the Name of the Merciful Lord within their hearts,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tah sa(n)g hot kirapaalaa ||
english: In the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਰੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਕਿਨਹੂ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: orai kachhoo na kinahoo keeaa ||
english: In this world, no one accomplishes anything by himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੂਆ ॥੫੧॥
transliteration: naanak sabh kachh prabh te hooaa ||51||
english: O Nanak, everything is done by God. ||51||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੂਲਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: lekhai katahi na chhooteeai khin khin bhoolanahaar ||
english: Because of the balance due on his account, he can never be released; he makes mistakes each and every moment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bakhasanahaar bakhas lai naanak paar utaar ||1||
english: O Forgiving Lord, please forgive me, and carry Nanak across. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ਅਲਪ ਮਤਿ ॥
transliteration: loon haraamee gunahagaar begaanaa alap mat ||
english: The sinner is unfaithful to himself; he is ignorant, with shallow understanding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਤਤ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d jin sukh deee taahi na jaanat tat ||
english: He does not know the essence of all, the One who gave him body, soul and peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਢੂਢਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: laahaa maaiaa kaarane dah dis dhoodhan jaai ||
english: For the sake of personal profit and Maya, he goes out, searching in the ten directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: devanahaar daataar prabh nimakh na manahi basaai ||
english: He does not enshrine the Generous Lord God, the Great Giver, in his mind, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਇਆ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: laalach jhooth bikaar moh iaa sa(n)pai man maahi ||
english: Greed, falsehood, corruption and emotional attachment - these are what he collects within his mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੰਪਟ ਚੋਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਹਾ ਤਿਨਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: la(n)pat chor ni(n)dak mahaa tinahoo sa(n)g bihaai ||
english: The worst perverts, thieves and slanderers - he passes his time with them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tudh bhaavai taa bakhas laihi khote sa(n)g khare ||
english: But if it pleases You, Lord, then You forgive the counterfeit along with the genuine.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਾਹਨ ਨੀਰਿ ਤਰੇ ॥੫੨॥
transliteration: naanak bhaavai paarabraham paahan neer tare ||52||
english: O Nanak, if it pleases the Supreme Lord God, then even a stone will float on water. ||52||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਹਸਤ ਭਰਮੇ ਜਨਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
transliteration: khaat peet khelat hasat bharame janam anek ||
english: Eating, drinking, playing and laughing, I have wandered through countless incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhavajal te kaadhahu prabhoo naanak teree tek ||1||
english: Please, God, lift me up and out of the terrifying world-ocean. Nanak seeks Your Support. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਲਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਆਇਓ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khelat khelat aaio anik jon dukh paai ||
english: Playing, playing, I have been reincarnated countless times, but this has only brought pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਦ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khed mite saadhoo milat satigur bachan samaai ||
english: Troubles are removed, when one meets with the Holy; immerse yourself in the Word of the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਚਿਓ ਖਾਇਓ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: khimaa gahee sach sa(n)chio khaaio a(n)mrit naam ||
english: Adopting an attitude of tolerance, and gathering truth, partake of the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਈ ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kharee kripaa thaakur bhaee anad sookh bisraam ||
english: When my Lord and Master showed His Great Mercy, I found peace, happiness and bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਪ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲਾਭ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਪਤਿਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: khep nibaahee bahut laabh ghar aae pativa(n)t ||
english: My merchandise has arrived safely, and I have made a great profit; I have returned home with honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਰਾ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: kharaa dilaasaa gur deeaa aai mile bhagava(n)t ||
english: The Guru has given me great consolation, and the Lord God has come to meet me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aapan keeaa karahi aap aagai paachhai aap ||
english: He Himself has acted, and He Himself acts. He was in the past, and He shall be in the future.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਊ ਸਰਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥੫੩॥
transliteration: naanak sooo saraaheeai j ghat ghat rahiaa biaap ||53||
english: O Nanak, praise the One, who is contained in each and every heart. ||53||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਾਗਤੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: aae prabh saranaagatee kirapaa nidh daiaal ||
english: O God, I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Merciful Lord, Ocean of compassion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਅਖਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਬਸਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek akhar har man basat naanak hot nihaal ||1||
english: One whose mind is filled with the One Word of the Lord, O Nanak, becomes totally blissful. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: akhar mahi tribhavan prabh dhaare ||
english: In the Word, God established the three worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: akhar kar kar bed beechaare ||
english: Created from the Word, the Vedas are contemplated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: akhar saasatr si(n)mrit puraanaa ||
english: From the Word, came the Shaastras, Simritees and Puraanas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਨਾਦ ਕਥਨ ਵਖੵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: akhar naad kathan vakhyaanaa ||
english: From the Word, came the sound current of the Naad, speeches and explanations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: akhar mukat jugat bhai bharamaa ||
english: From the Word, comes the way of liberation from fear and doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੁਚ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: akhar karam kirat such dharamaa ||
english: From the Word, come religious rituals, karma, sacredness and Dharma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿਮਾਨ ਅਖਰ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ॥
transliteration: drisatimaan akhar hai jetaa ||
english: In the visible universe, the Word is seen.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰਲੇਪਾ ॥੫੪॥
transliteration: naanak paarabraham niralepaa ||54||
english: O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God remains unattached and untouched. ||54||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਥਿ ਕਲੰਮ ਅਗੰਮ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਾਵਤੀ ॥
transliteration: hath kala(n)m aga(n)m masatak likhaavatee ||
english: With pen in hand, the Inaccessible Lord writes man's destiny on his forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪਾਵਤੀ ॥
transliteration: urajh rahio sabh sa(n)g anoop roopaavatee ||
english: The Lord of Incomparable Beauty is involved with all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: usatat kahan na jaai mukhahu tuhaareeaa ||
english: I cannot describe Your Praises with my mouth, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mohee dekh daras naanak balihaareeaa ||1||
english: Nanak is fascinated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; he is a sacrifice to You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਅਚੁਤ ਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਘਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: he achut he paarabraham abinaasee aghanaas ||
english: O Immovable Lord, O Supreme Lord God, Imperishable, Destroyer of sins:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੇ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
transliteration: he pooran he sarab mai dukh bha(n)jan gunataas ||
english: O Perfect, All-pervading Lord, Destroyer of pain, Treasure of virtue:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਸੰਗੀ ਹੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਹੇ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਸਭ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: he sa(n)gee he nira(n)kaar he niragun sabh tek ||
english: O Companion, Formless, Absolute Lord, Support of all:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਹੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
transliteration: he gobid he gun nidhaan jaa kai sadaa bibek ||
english: O Lord of the Universe, Treasure of excellence, with clear eternal understanding:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਹਿ ਭੀ ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: he apara(n)par har hare hahi bhee hovanahaar ||
english: Most Remote of the Remote, Lord God: You are, You were, and You shall always be.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: he sa(n)tah kai sadaa sa(n)g nidhaaraa aadhaar ||
english: O Constant Companion of the Saints, You are the Support of the unsupported.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਉ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: he thaakur hau daasaro mai niragun gun nahee koi ||
english: O my Lord and Master, I am Your slave. I am worthless, I have no worth at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਰਾਖਉ ਹੀਐ ਪਰੋਇ ॥੫੫॥
transliteration: naanak deejai naam daan raakhau heeai paroi ||55||
english: Nanak: grant me the Gift of Your Name, Lord, that I may string it and keep it within my heart. ||55||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev maataa guradev pitaa guradev suaamee paramesuraa ||
english: The Divine Guru is our mother, the Divine Guru is our father; the Divine Guru is our Lord and Master, the Transcendent Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਖਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਬੰਧਿਪ ਸਹੋਦਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev sakhaa agiaan bha(n)jan guradev ba(n)dhip sahodaraa ||
english: The Divine Guru is my companion, the Destroyer of ignorance; the Divine Guru is my relative and brother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਿਰੋਧਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev daataa har naam upadesai guradev ma(n)t nirodharaa ||
english: The Divine Guru is the Giver, the Teacher of the Lord's Name. The Divine Guru is the Mantra which never fails.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਪਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev saa(n)t sat budh moorat guradev paaras paras paraa ||
english: The Divine Guru is the image of peace, truth and wisdom. The Divine Guru is the Philosopher's Stone - touching it, one is transformed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਜਨੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev teerath a(n)mrit sarovar gur giaan majan apara(n)paraa ||
english: The Divine Guru is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, and the pool of divine nectar; bathing in the Guru's wisdom, one experiences the Infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਕਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev karataa sabh paap harataa guradev patit pavit karaa ||
english: The Divine Guru is the Creator, and the Destroyer of all sins; the Divine Guru is the Purifier of sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev aad jugaad jug jug guradev ma(n)t har jap udharaa ||
english: The Divine Guru existed in the very beginning, throughout the ages, in each and every age. The Divine Guru is the Mantra of the Lord's Name; chanting it, one is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guradev sa(n)gat prabh mel kar kirapaa ham mooR paapee jit lag taraa ||
english: O God, please be merciful to me, that I may be with the Divine Guru; I am a foolish sinner, but holding onto Him, I will be carried across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guradev satigur paarabraham paramesar guradev naanak har namasakaraa ||1||
english: The Divine Guru is the True Guru, the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; Nanak bows in humble reverence to the Lord, the Divine Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸਲੋਕੁ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪੜਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ehu salok aad a(n)t paRanaa ||
english: Read this Salok at the beginning, and at the end. ||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਸੁਖਮਨੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee sukhamanee mah 5 ||
english: Gauree Sukhmani, Fifth Mehl,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਗੁਰਏ ਨਮਹ ॥
transliteration: aad gurae namah ||
english: I bow to the Primal Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਗੁਰਏ ਨਮਹ ॥
transliteration: jugaad gurae namah ||
english: I bow to the Guru of the ages.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਏ ਨਮਹ ॥
transliteration: satigurae namah ||
english: I bow to the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਏ ਨਮਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sree guradevae namah ||1||
english: I bow to the Great, Divine Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: simarau simar simar sukh paavau ||
english: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਤਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਮਿਟਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: kal kales tan maahi mitaavau ||
english: Worry and anguish shall be dispelled from your body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਜਾਸੁ ਬਿਸੁੰਭਰ ਏਕੈ ॥
transliteration: simarau jaas bisu(n)bhar ekai ||
english: Remember in praise the One who pervades the whole Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਅਗਨਤ ਅਨੇਕੈ ॥
transliteration: naam japat aganat anekai ||
english: His Name is chanted by countless people, in so many ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੁਧਾਖੵਰ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan si(n)mrit sudhaakhyr ||
english: The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, the purest of utterances,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਇਕ ਆਖੵਰ ॥
transliteration: keene raam naam ik aakhyr ||
english: were created from the One Word of the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਕਾ ਏਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਜੀਅ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kinakaa ek jis jee basaavai ||
english: That one, in whose soul the One Lord dwells

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਗਨੀ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: taa kee mahimaa ganee na aavai ||
english: the praises of his glory cannot be recounted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਖੀ ਏਕੈ ਦਰਸ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: kaa(n)khee ekai daras tuhaaro ||
english: Those who yearn only for the blessing of Your Darshan

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak un sa(n)g mohi udhaaro ||1||
english: - Nanak: save me along with them! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਮਨੀ ਸੁਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sukhamanee sukh a(n)mrit prabh naam ||
english: Sukhmani: Peace of Mind, the Nectar of the Name of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kai man bisraam || rahaau ||
english: The minds of the devotees abide in a joyful peace. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਬਸੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran garabh na basai ||
english: Remembering God, one does not have to enter into the womb again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਜਮੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran dookh jam nasai ||
english: Remembering God, the pain of death is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran kaal paraharai ||
english: Remembering God, death is eliminated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਟਰੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran dusaman tarai ||
english: Remembering God, one's enemies are repelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh simarat kachh bighan na laagai ||
english: Remembering God, no obstacles are met.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran anadin jaagai ||
english: Remembering God, one remains awake and aware, night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran bhau na biaapai ||
english: Remembering God, one is not touched by fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran dukh na sa(n)taapai ||
english: Remembering God, one does not suffer sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh kaa simaran saadh kai sa(n)g ||
