english: The meditative remembrance of God is in the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan naanak har ra(n)g ||2||
english: All treasures, O Nanak, are in the Love of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran ridh sidh nau nidh ||
english: In the remembrance of God are wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran giaan dhiaan tat budh ||
english: In the remembrance of God are knowledge, meditation and the essence of wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran jap tap poojaa ||
english: In the remembrance of God are chanting, intense meditation and devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran binasai doojaa ||
english: In the remembrance of God, duality is removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran teerath isanaanee ||
english: In the remembrance of God are purifying baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran daragah maanee ||
english: In the remembrance of God, one attains honor in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran hoi s bhalaa ||
english: In the remembrance of God, one becomes good.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran suphal phalaa ||
english: In the remembrance of God, one flowers in fruition.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਮਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: se simarahi jin aap simaraae ||
english: They alone remember Him in meditation, whom He inspires to meditate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak taa kai laagau paae ||3||
english: Nanak grasps the feet of those humble beings. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh kaa simaran sabh te oochaa ||
english: The remembrance of God is the highest and most exalted of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਮੂਚਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran udhare moochaa ||
english: In the remembrance of God, many are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran trisanaa bujhai ||
english: In the remembrance of God, thirst is quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran sabh kichh sujhai ||
english: In the remembrance of God, all things are known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran naahee jam traasaa ||
english: In the remembrance of God, there is no fear of death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran pooran aasaa ||
english: In the remembrance of God, hopes are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran man kee mal jaai ||
english: In the remembrance of God, the filth of the mind is removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam rid maahi samaai ||
english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is absorbed into the heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਬਸਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh jee basahi saadh kee rasanaa ||
english: God abides upon the tongues of His Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਸਨਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak jan kaa daasan dasanaa ||4||
english: Nanak is the servant of the slave of His slaves. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi se dhanava(n)te ||
english: Those who remember God are wealthy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi se pativa(n)te ||
english: Those who remember God are honorable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi se jan paravaan ||
english: Those who remember God are approved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi se purakh pradhaan ||
english: Those who remember God are the most distinguished persons.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi s bemuhataaje ||
english: Those who remember God are not lacking.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi s sarab ke raaje ||
english: Those who remember God are the rulers of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi se sukhavaasee ||
english: Those who remember God dwell in peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi sadaa abinaasee ||
english: Those who remember God are immortal and eternal.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਿਨ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: simaran te laage jin aap daiaalaa ||
english: They alone hold to the remembrance of Him, unto whom He Himself shows His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮੰਗੈ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak jan kee ma(n)gai ravaalaa ||5||
english: Nanak begs for the dust of their feet. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi se paraupakaaree ||
english: Those who remember God generously help others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi tin sad balihaaree ||
english: Those who remember God - to them, I am forever a sacrifice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi se mukh suhaave ||
english: Those who remember God - their faces are beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੂਖਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi tin sookh bihaavai ||
english: Those who remember God abide in peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi tin aatam jeetaa ||
english: Those who remember God conquer their souls.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi tin niramal reetaa ||
english: Those who remember God have a pure and spotless lifestyle.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਅਨਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi tin anad ghanere ||
english: Those who remember God experience all sorts of joys.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau simarahi basahi har nere ||
english: Those who remember God abide near the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kripaa te anadin jaag ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, one remains awake and aware, night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak simaran poorai bhaag ||6||
english: O Nanak, this meditative remembrance comes only by perfect destiny. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran kaaraj poore ||
english: Remembering God, one's works are accomplished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran kabahu na jhoore ||
english: Remembering God, one never grieves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran har gun baanee ||
english: Remembering God, one speaks the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran sahaj samaanee ||
english: Remembering God, one is absorbed into the state of intuitive ease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਨੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran nihachal aasan ||
english: Remembering God, one attains the unchanging position.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸਨੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran kamal bigaasan ||
english: Remembering God, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਝੁਨਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai simaran anahad jhunakaar ||
english: Remembering God, the unstruck melody vibrates.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sukh prabh simaran kaa a(n)t na paar ||
english: The peace of the meditative remembrance of God has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ॥
transliteration: simarahi se jan jin kau prabh maiaa ||
english: They alone remember Him, upon whom God bestows His Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak tin jan saranee paiaa ||7||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of those humble beings. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har simaran kar bhagat pragataae ||
english: Remembering the Lord, His devotees are famous and radiant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਲਗਿ ਬੇਦ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har simaran lag bed upaae ||
english: Remembering the Lord, the Vedas were composed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਏ ਸਿਧ ਜਤੀ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: har simaran bhae sidh jatee daate ||
english: Remembering the Lord, we become Siddhas, celibates and givers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨੀਚ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: har simaran neech chahu ku(n)t jaate ||
english: Remembering the Lord, the lowly become known in all four directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har simaran dhaaree sabh dharanaa ||
english: For the remembrance of the Lord, the whole world was established.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: simar simar har kaaran karanaa ||
english: Remember, remember in meditation the Lord, the Creator, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕੀਓ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har simaran keeo sagal akaaraa ||
english: For the remembrance of the Lord, He created the whole creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har simaran mahi aap nira(n)kaaraa ||
english: In the remembrance of the Lord, He Himself is Formless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis aap bujhaaiaa ||
english: By His Grace, He Himself bestows understanding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh har simaran tin paaiaa ||8||1||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains the remembrance of the Lord. ||8||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: deen darad dukh bha(n)janaa ghat ghat naath anaath ||
english: O Destroyer of the pains and the suffering of the poor, O Master of each and every heart, O Masterless One:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saran tumhaaree aaio naanak ke prabh saath ||1||
english: I have come seeking Your Sanctuary. O God, please be with Nanak! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jah maat pitaa sut meet na bhaaee ||
english: Where there is no mother, father, children, friends or siblings

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਊਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man oohaa naam terai sa(n)g sahaaee ||
english: O my mind, there, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall be with you as your help and support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਦਲੈ ॥
transliteration: jah mahaa bhaiaan doot jam dalai ||
english: Where the great and terrible Messenger of Death shall try to crush you,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ॥
transliteration: tah keval naam sa(n)g terai chalai ||
english: there, only the Naam shall go along with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਮੁਸਕਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jah musakal hovai at bhaaree ||
english: Where the obstacles are so very heavy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har ko naam khin maahi udhaaree ||
english: the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: anik punahacharan karat nahee tarai ||
english: By performing countless religious rituals, you shall not be saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
transliteration: har ko naam kot paap paraharai ||
english: The Name of the Lord washes off millions of sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam japahu man mere ||
english: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, O my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak paavahu sookh ghanere ||1||
english: O Nanak, you shall obtain countless joys. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sagal srisat ko raajaa dukheeaa ||
english: The rulers of the all the world are unhappy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਖੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam japat hoi sukheeaa ||
english: one who chants the Name of the Lord becomes happy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰੀ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਰੈ ॥
transliteration: laakh karoree ba(n)dh na parai ||
english: Acquiring hundreds of thousands and millions, your desires shall not be contained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam japat nisatarai ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall find release.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਤਿਖ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: anik maaiaa ra(n)g tikh na bujhaavai ||
english: By the countless pleasures of Maya, your thirst shall not be quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਆਘਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam japat aaghaavai ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall be satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jih maarag ihu jaat ikelaa ||
english: Upon that path where you must go all alone,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਤ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: tah har naam sa(n)g hot suhelaa ||
english: there, only the Lord's Name shall go with you to sustain you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: aisaa naam man sadaa dhiaaeeai ||
english: On such a Name, O my mind, meditate forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh param gat paaeeai ||2||
english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, you shall obtain the state of supreme dignity. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੂਟਤ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: chhootat nahee kot lakh baahee ||
english: You shall not be saved by hundreds of thousands and millions of helping hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤਹ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: naam japat tah paar paraahee ||
english: Chanting the Naam, you shall be lifted up and carried across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਘਨ ਜਹ ਆਇ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: anik bighan jah aai sa(n)ghaarai ||
english: Where countless misfortunes threaten to destroy you,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam tatakaal udhaarai ||
english: the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਮ ॥
transliteration: anik jon janamai mar jaam ||
english: Through countless incarnations, people are born and die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: naam japat paavai bisraam ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall come to rest in peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮੈਲਾ ਮਲੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hau mailaa mal kabahu na dhovai ||
english: The ego is polluted by a filth which can never be washed off.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam kot paap khovai ||
english: The Name of the Lord erases millions of sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: aisaa naam japahu man ra(n)g ||
english: Chant such a Name with love, O my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak paaeeai saadh kai sa(n)g ||3||
english: O Nanak, it is obtained in the Company of the Holy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਮਾਰਗ ਕੇ ਗਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨ ਕੋਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jih maarag ke gane jaahi na kosaa ||
english: On that path where the miles cannot be counted,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਹਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੋਸਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam oohaa sa(n)g tosaa ||
english: there, the Name of the Lord shall be your sustenance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪੈਡੈ ਮਹਾ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jih paidai mahaa a(n)dh gubaaraa ||
english: On that journey of total, pitch-black darkness,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam sa(n)g ujeeaaraa ||
english: the Name of the Lord shall be the Light with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਪੰਥਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਨੂ ॥
transliteration: jahaa pa(n)th teraa ko na sinjaanoo ||
english: On that journey where no one knows you,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਛਾਨੂ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam tah naal pachhaanoo ||
english: with the Name of the Lord, you shall be recognized.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਤਪਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਘਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jah mahaa bhaiaan tapat bahu ghaam ||
english: Where there is awesome and terrible heat and blazing sunshine,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੁਮ ਊਪਰਿ ਛਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tah har ke naam kee tum oopar chhaam ||
english: there, the Name of the Lord will give you shade.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਮਨ ਤੁਝੁ ਆਕਰਖੈ ॥
transliteration: jahaa trikhaa man tujh aakarakhai ||
english: Where thirst, O my mind, torments you to cry out,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਰਖੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tah naanak har har a(n)mrit barakhai ||4||
english: there, O Nanak, the Ambrosial Name, Har, Har, shall rain down upon you. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬਰਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kee baratan naam ||
english: Unto the devotee, the Naam is an article of daily use.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kai man bisraam ||
english: The minds of the humble Saints are at peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam daas kee ot ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the Support of His servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਨ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
transliteration: har kai naam udhare jan kot ||
english: By the Name of the Lord, millions have been saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਤ ਸੰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har jas karat sa(n)t din raat ||
english: The Saints chant the Praises of the Lord, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਸਾਧ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har har aukhadh saadh kamaat ||
english: Har, Har - the Lord's Name - the Holy use it as their healing medicine.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: har jan kai har naam nidhaan ||
english: The Lord's Name is the treasure of the Lord's servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਜਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham jan keeno daan ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has blessed His humble servant with this gift.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕੈ ॥
transliteration: man tan ra(n)g rate ra(n)g ekai ||
english: Mind and body are imbued with ecstasy in the Love of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਬਿਰਤਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak jan kai birat bibekai ||5||
english: O Nanak, careful and discerning understanding is the way of the Lord's humble servant. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam jan kau mukat jugat ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the path of liberation for His humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har kai naam jan kau tripat bhugat ||
english: With the food of the Name of the Lord, His servants are satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam jan kaa roop ra(n)g ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the beauty and delight of His servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਬ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: har naam japat kab parai na bha(n)g ||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name, one is never blocked by obstacles.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam jan kee vadiaaee ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the glorious greatness of His servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har kai naam jan sobhaa paaee ||
english: Through the Name of the Lord, His servants obtain honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਭੋਗ ਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam jan kau bhog jog ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the enjoyment and Yoga of His servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥
transliteration: har naam japat kachh naahi biog ||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name, there is no separation from Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jan raataa har naam kee sevaa ||
english: His servants are imbued with the service of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak poojai har har devaa ||6||
english: O Nanak, worship the Lord, the Lord Divine, Har, Har. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har har jan kai maal khajeenaa ||
english: The Lord's Name, Har, Har, is the treasure of wealth of His servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har dhan jan kau aap prabh deenaa ||
english: The treasure of the Lord has been bestowed on His servants by God Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har har jan kai ot sataanee ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har is the All-powerful Protection of His servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ਜਨ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har prataap jan avar na jaanee ||
english: His servants know no other than the Lord's Magnificence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: ot pot jan har ras raate ||
english: Through and through, His servants are imbued with the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: su(n)n samaadh naam ras maate ||
english: In deepest Samaadhi, they are intoxicated with the essence of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar jan har har japai ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, His servants chant Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਨਹੀ ਛਪੈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa bhagat pragat nahee chhapai ||
english: The devotees of the Lord are known and respected; they do not hide in secrecy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har kee bhagat mukat bahu kare ||
english: Through devotion to the Lord, many have been liberated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak jan sa(n)g kete tare ||7||
english: O Nanak, along with His servants, many others are saved. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: paarajaat ihu har ko naam ||
english: This Elysian Tree of miraculous powers is the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਧੇਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kaamadhen har har gun gaam ||
english: The Khaamadhayn, the cow of miraculous powers, is the singing of the Glory of the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh te ootam har kee kathaa ||
english: Highest of all is the Lord's Speech.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਲਥਾ ॥
transliteration: naam sunat darad dukh lathaa ||
english: Hearing the Naam, pain and sorrow are removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸੰਤ ਰਿਦ ਵਸੈ ॥
transliteration: naam kee mahimaa sa(n)t rid vasai ||
english: The Glory of the Naam abides in the hearts of His Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prataap durat sabh nasai ||
english: By the Saint's kind intervention, all guilt is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa sa(n)g vadabhaagee paaeeai ||
english: The Society of the Saints is obtained by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kee sevaa naam dhiaaeeai ||
english: Serving the Saint, one meditates on the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naam tul kachh avar na hoi ||
english: There is nothing equal to the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh naam paavai jan koi ||8||2||
english: O Nanak, rare are those, who, as Gurmukh, obtain the Naam. ||8||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਪੇਖੇ ਸਰਬ ਢਢੋਲਿ ॥
transliteration: bahu saasatr bahu simritee pekhe sarab dhadhol ||
english: The many Shaastras and the many Simritees - I have seen and searched through them all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਮੋਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poojas naahee har hare naanak naam amol ||1||
english: They are not equal to Har, Haray - O Nanak, the Lord's Invaluable Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: jaap taap giaan sabh dhiaan ||
english: Chanting, intense meditation, spiritual wisdom and all meditations;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਟ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਵਖਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: khat saasatr simrit vakhiaan ||
english: the six schools of philosophy and sermons on the scriptures;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਕਰਮ ਧ੍ਰਮ ਕਿਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jog abhiaas karam dhram kiriaa ||
english: the practice of Yoga and righteous conduct;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਨ ਮਧੇ ਫਿਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sagal tiaag ban madhe phiriaa ||
english: the renunciation of everything and wandering around in the wilderness;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਜਤਨਾ ॥
transliteration: anik prakaar keee bahu jatanaa ||
english: the performance of all sorts of works;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਹੋਮੇ ਬਹੁ ਰਤਨਾ ॥
transliteration: pu(n)n daan home bahu ratanaa ||
english: donations to charities and offerings of jewels to fire;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਟਾਇ ਹੋਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: sareer kataai homai kar raatee ||
english: cutting the body apart and making the pieces into ceremonial fire offerings;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: varat nem karai bahu bhaatee ||
english: keeping fasts and making vows of all sorts

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਤੁਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: nahee tul raam naam beechaar ||
english: - none of these are equal to the contemplation of the Name of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh naam japeeai ik baar ||1||
english: O Nanak, if, as Gurmukh, one chants the Naam, even once. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nau kha(n)d prithamee phirai chir jeevai ||
english: You may roam over the nine continents of the world and live a very long life;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਤਪੀਸਰੁ ਥੀਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mahaa udaas tapeesar theevai ||
english: you may become a great ascetic and a master of disciplined meditation

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਹੋਮਤ ਪਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: agan maahi homat paraan ||
english: and burn yourself in fire;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਹੈਵਰ ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨ ॥
transliteration: kanik asv haivar bhoom daan ||
english: you may give away gold, horses, elephants and land;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਉਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਆਸਨ ॥
transliteration: niulee karam karai bahu aasan ||
english: you may practice techniques of inner cleansing and all sorts of Yogic postures;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਨ ਮਾਰਗ ਸੰਜਮ ਅਤਿ ਸਾਧਨ ॥
transliteration: jain maarag sa(n)jam at saadhan ||
english: you may adopt the self-mortifying ways of the Jains and great spiritual disciplines;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਕਰਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਟਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nimakh nimakh kar sareer kataavai ||
english: piece by piece, you may cut your body apart;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਭੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tau bhee haumai mail na jaavai ||
english: but even so, the filth of your ego shall not depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam samasar kachh naahi ||
english: There is nothing equal to the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh naam japat gat paahi ||2||
english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, chant the Naam, and obtain salvation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਹ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
transliteration: man kaamanaa teerath deh chhutai ||
english: With your mind filled with desire, you may give up your body at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹੁਟੈ ॥
transliteration: garab gumaan na man te hutai ||
english: but even so, egotistical pride shall not be removed from your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਚ ਕਰੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: soch karai dinas ar raat ||
english: You may practice cleansing day and night,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: man kee mail na tan te jaat ||
english: but the filth of your mind shall not leave your body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: is dehee kau bahu saadhanaa karai ||
english: You may subject your body to all sorts of disciplines,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਟਰੈ ॥
transliteration: man te kabahoo na bikhiaa tarai ||
english: but your mind will never be rid of its corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਹ ਅਨੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jal dhovai bahu deh aneet ||
english: You may wash this transitory body with loads of water,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਧ ਕਹਾ ਹੋਇ ਕਾਚੀ ਭੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sudh kahaa hoi kaachee bheet ||
english: but how can a wall of mud be washed clean?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਊਚ ॥
transliteration: man har ke naam kee mahimaa ooch ||
english: O my mind, the Glorious Praise of the Name of the Lord is the highest;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਪਤਿਤ ਬਹੁ ਮੂਚ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam udhare patit bahu mooch ||3||
english: O Nanak, the Naam has saved so many of the worst sinners. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: bahut siaanap jam kaa bhau biaapai ||
english: Even with great cleverness, the fear of death clings to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: anik jatan kar trisan naa dhraapai ||
english: You try all sorts of things, but your thirst is still not satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੇਖ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
transliteration: bhekh anek agan nahee bujhai ||
english: Wearing various religious robes, the fire is not extinguished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਹੀ ਸਿਝੈ ॥
transliteration: kot upaav daragah nahee sijhai ||
english: Even making millions of efforts, you shall not be accepted in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਊਭ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
transliteration: chhootas naahee oobh paiaal ||
english: You cannot escape to the heavens, or to the nether regions,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: mohi biaapahi maaiaa jaal ||
english: if you are entangled in emotional attachment and the net of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਜਮੁ ਡਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: avar karatoot sagalee jam daanai ||
english: All other efforts are punished by the Messenger of Death,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: govi(n)d bhajan bin til nahee maanai ||
english: which accepts nothing at all, except meditation on the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam japat dukh jaai ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, sorrow is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak bolai sahaj subhaai ||4||
english: O Nanak, chant it with intuitive ease. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: chaar padaarath je ko maagai ||
english: One who prays for the four cardinal blessings

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: saadh janaa kee sevaa laagai ||
english: should commit himself to the service of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਪੁਨਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je ko aapunaa dookh mitaavai ||
english: If you wish to erase your sorrows,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har har naam ridai sad gaavai ||
english: sing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਲੋਰੈ ॥
transliteration: je ko apunee sobhaa lorai ||
english: If you long for honor for yourself,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਇਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੋਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g ih haumai chhorai ||
english: then renounce your ego in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਡਰੈ ॥
transliteration: je ko janam maran te darai ||
english: If you fear the cycle of birth and death,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saadh janaa kee saranee parai ||
english: then seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jis jan kau prabh daras piaasaa ||
english: Those who thirst for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak taa kai bal bal jaasaa ||5||
english: - Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sagal purakh mahi purakh pradhaan ||
english: Among all persons, the supreme person is the one

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jaa kaa mitai abhimaan ||
english: who gives up his egotistical pride in the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਨੀਚਾ ॥
transliteration: aapas kau jo jaanai neechaa ||
english: One who sees himself as lowly,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਊ ਗਨੀਐ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
transliteration: sooo ganeeai sabh te oochaa ||
english: shall be accounted as the highest of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa man hoi sagal kee reenaa ||
english: One whose mind is the dust of all,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam tin ghat ghat cheenaa ||
english: recognizes the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਤੇ ਬੁਰਾ ਮਿਟਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man apune te buraa mitaanaa ||
english: One who eradicates cruelty from within his own mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖੈ ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: pekhai sagal srisat saajanaa ||
english: looks upon all the world as his friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਜਨ ਸਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sookh dookh jan sam drisatetaa ||
english: One who looks upon pleasure and pain as one and the same,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਨਹੀ ਲੇਪਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak paap pu(n)n nahee lepaa ||6||
english: O Nanak, is not affected by sin or virtue. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕਉ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: niradhan kau dhan tero naau ||
english: To the poor, Your Name is wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nithaave kau naau teraa thaau ||
english: To the homeless, Your Name is home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: nimaane kau prabh tero maan ||
english: To the dishonored, You, O God, are honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sagal ghataa kau devahu daan ||
english: To all, You are the Giver of gifts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavanahaar suaamee ||
english: O Creator Lord, Cause of causes, O Lord and Master,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: sagal ghataa ke a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: Inner-knower, Searcher of all hearts:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: apanee gat mit jaanahu aape ||
english: You alone know Your own condition and state.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: aapan sa(n)g aap prabh raate ||
english: You Yourself, God, are imbued with Yourself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tumhree usatat tum te hoi ||
english: You alone can celebrate Your Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak avar na jaanas koi ||7||
english: O Nanak, no one else knows. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਧਰਮ ਮਹਿ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sarab dharam mahi sresat dharam ||
english: Of all religions, the best religion

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: har ko naam jap niramal karam ||
english: is to chant the Name of the Lord and maintain pure conduct.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਿਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sagal kriaa mahi ootam kiriaa ||
english: Of all religious rituals, the most sublime ritual

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g duramat mal hiriaa ||
english: is to erase the filth of the dirty mind in the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਉਦਮ ਮਹਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal udam mahi udam bhalaa ||
english: Of all efforts, the best effort

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਸਦਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam japahu jee sadaa ||
english: is to chant the Name of the Lord in the heart, forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਬਾਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sagal baanee mahi a(n)mrit baanee ||
english: Of all speech, the most ambrosial speech

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: har ko jas sun rasan bakhaanee ||
english: is to hear the Lord's Praise and chant it with the tongue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਥਾਨ ਤੇ ਓਹੁ ਊਤਮ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sagal thaan te ohu ootam thaan ||
english: Of all places, the most sublime place,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak jih ghat vasai har naam ||8||3||
english: O Nanak, is that heart in which the Name of the Lord abides. ||8||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰ ਇਆਨਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: niraguneeaar iaaniaa so prabh sadaa samaal ||
english: You worthless, ignorant fool - dwell upon God forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਰਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin keeaa tis cheet rakh naanak nibahee naal ||1||
english: Cherish in your consciousness the One who created you; O Nanak, He alone shall go along with you. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਮਈਆ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਚੇਤਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ramaeeaa ke gun chet paraanee ||
english: Think of the Glory of the All-pervading Lord, O mortal;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਮੂਲ ਤੇ ਕਵਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kavan mool te kavan drisataanee ||
english: what is your origin, and what is your appearance?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jin too(n) saaj savaar seegaariaa ||
english: He who fashioned, adorned and decorated you

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: garabh agan mahi jinahi ubaariaa ||
english: in the fire of the womb, He preserved you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਦੂਧ ॥
transliteration: baar bivasathaa tujhahi piaarai doodh ||
english: In your infancy, He gave you milk to drink.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਸੂਧ ॥
transliteration: bhar joban bhojan sukh soodh ||
english: In the flower of your youth, He gave you food, pleasure and understanding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਕ ਸੈਨ ॥
transliteration: biradh bhaiaa oopar saak sain ||
english: As you grow old, family and friends,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਅਪਿਆਉ ਬੈਠ ਕਉ ਦੈਨ ॥
transliteration: mukh apiaau baith kau dain ||
english: Are there to feed you as you rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਗੁਨੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu niragun gun kachhoo na boojhai ||
english: This worthless person has not appreciated in the least, all the good deeds done for him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਖਸਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੀਝੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bakhas lehu tau naanak seejhai ||1||
english: If you bless him with forgiveness, O Nanak, only then will he be saved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬਸਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad dhar oopar sukh basahi ||
english: By His Grace, you abide in comfort upon the earth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਸਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sut bhraat meet banitaa sa(n)g hasahi ||
english: With your children, siblings, friends and spouse, you laugh.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad peevahi seetal jalaa ||
english: By His Grace, you drink in cool water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪਵਨੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਅਮੁਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sukhadaaee pavan paavak amulaa ||
english: You have peaceful breezes and priceless fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਰਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad bhogahi sabh rasaa ||
english: By His Grace, you enjoy all sorts of pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਬਸਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal samagree sa(n)g saath basaa ||
english: You are provided with all the necessities of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨੇ ਹਸਤ ਪਾਵ ਕਰਨ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: deene hasat paav karan netr rasanaa ||
english: He gave you hands, feet, ears, eyes and tongue,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tisahi tiaag avar sa(n)g rachanaa ||
english: and yet, you forsake Him and attach yourself to others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਦੋਖ ਮੂੜ ਅੰਧ ਬਿਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aise dokh mooR a(n)dh biaape ||
english: Such sinful mistakes cling to the blind fools;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kaadh lehu prabh aape ||2||
english: Nanak: uplift and save them, God! ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਜੋ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aad a(n)t jo raakhanahaar ||
english: From beginning to end, He is our Protector,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tis siu preet na karai gavaar ||
english: and yet, the ignorant do not give their love to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee sevaa nav nidh paavai ||
english: Serving Him, the nine treasures are obtained,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਮੂੜਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: taa siu mooRaa man nahee laavai ||
english: and yet, the foolish do not link their minds with Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jo thaakur sad sadaa hajoore ||
english: Our Lord and Master is Ever-present, forever and ever,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਅੰਧਾ ਜਾਨਤ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: taa kau a(n)dhaa jaanat doore ||
english: and yet, the spiritually blind believe that He is far away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਪਾਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee tahal paavai daragah maan ||
english: In His service, one obtains honor in the Court of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰੈ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਅਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tisahi bisaarai mugadh ajaan ||
english: and yet, the ignorant fool forgets Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਇਹੁ ਭੂਲਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa ihu bhoolanahaar ||
english: Forever and ever, this person makes mistakes;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak raakhanahaar apaar ||3||
english: O Nanak, the Infinite Lord is our Saving Grace. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਉਡੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚੈ ॥
transliteration: ratan tiaag kaudee sa(n)g rachai ||
english: Forsaking the jewel, they are engrossed with a shell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਝੂਠ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਚੈ ॥
transliteration: saach chhod jhooth sa(n)g machai ||
english: They renounce Truth and embrace falsehood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਛਡਨਾ ਸੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jo chhadanaa s asathir kar maanai ||
english: That which passes away, they believe to be permanent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹੋਵਨੁ ਸੋ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jo hovan so door paraanai ||
english: That which is immanent, they believe to be far off.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: chhod jaai tis kaa sram karai ||
english: They struggle for what they must eventually leave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g sahaaee tis paraharai ||
english: They turn away from the Lord, their Help and Support, who is always with them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪੁ ਉਤਾਰੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)dan lep utaarai dhoi ||
english: They wash off the sandalwood paste;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਧਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਸਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: garadhab preet bhasam sa(n)g hoi ||
english: like donkeys, they are in love with the mud.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop mahi patit bikaraal ||
english: They have fallen into the deep, dark pit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak kaadh lehu prabh daiaal ||4||
english: Nanak: lift them up and save them, O Merciful Lord God! ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਪਸੂ ਕੀ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: karatoot pasoo kee maanas jaat ||
english: They belong to the human species, but they act like animals.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਪਚਾਰਾ ਕਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: lok pachaaraa karai din raat ||
english: They curse others day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: baahar bhekh a(n)tar mal maaiaa ||
english: Outwardly, they wear religious robes, but within is the filth of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਪਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: chhapas naahi kachh karai chhapaaiaa ||
english: They cannot conceal this, no matter how hard they try.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥
transliteration: baahar giaan dhiaan isanaan ||
english: Outwardly, they display knowledge, meditation and purification,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar biaapai lobh suaan ||
english: but within clings the dog of greed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਆਹ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar agan baahar tan suaah ||
english: The fire of desire rages within; outwardly they apply ashes to their bodies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੈਸੇ ਤਰੈ ਅਥਾਹ ॥
transliteration: gal paathar kaise tarai athaah ||
english: There is a stone around their neck - how can they cross the unfathomable ocean?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai a(n)tar basai prabh aap ||
english: Those, within whom God Himself abides

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਤਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak te jan sahaj samaat ||5||
english: - O Nanak, those humble beings are intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sun a(n)dhaa kaise maarag paavai ||
english: By listening, how can the blind find the path?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਓੜਿ ਨਿਬਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kar gahi lehu oR nibahaavai ||
english: Take hold of his hand, and then he can reach his destination.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਬੁਝਾਰਤਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਡੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kahaa bujhaarat boojhai doraa ||
english: How can a riddle be understood by the deaf?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਤਉ ਸਮਝੈ ਭੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: nis kaheeai tau samajhai bhoraa ||
english: Say 'night', and he thinks you said 'day'.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਬਿਸਨਪਦ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁੰਗ ॥
transliteration: kahaa bisanapad gaavai gu(n)g ||
english: How can the mute sing the Songs of the Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਤਉ ਭੀ ਸੁਰ ਭੰਗ ॥
transliteration: jatan karai tau bhee sur bha(n)g ||
english: He may try, but his voice will fail him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹ ਪਿੰਗੁਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਪਰ ਭਵਨ ॥
transliteration: kah pi(n)gul parabat par bhavan ||
english: How can the cripple climb up the mountain?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤ ਊਹਾ ਉਸੁ ਗਵਨ ॥
transliteration: nahee hot oohaa us gavan ||
english: He simply cannot go there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਦੀਨੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: karataar karunaa mai deen benatee karai ||
english: O Creator, Lord of Mercy - Your humble servant prays;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਰੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak tumaree kirapaa tarai ||6||
english: Nanak: by Your Grace, please save me. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g sahaaee s aavai na cheet ||
english: The Lord, our Help and Support, is always with us, but the mortal does not remember Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jo bairaaee taa siu preet ||
english: He shows love to his enemies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲੂਆ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ॥
transliteration: balooaa ke grih bheetar basai ||
english: He lives in a castle of sand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਕੇਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸੈ ॥
transliteration: anad kel maaiaa ra(n)g rasai ||
english: He enjoys the games of pleasure and the tastes of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਮਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: driR kar maanai manahi prateet ||
english: He believes them to be permanent - this is the belief of his mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੂੜੇ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kaal na aavai mooRe cheet ||
english: Death does not even come to mind for the fool.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮੋਹ ॥
transliteration: bair birodh kaam krodh moh ||
english: Hate, conflict, sexual desire, anger, emotional attachment,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਹਾ ਲੋਭ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ॥
transliteration: jhooth bikaar mahaa lobh dhroh ||
english: falsehood, corruption, immense greed and deceit:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਆਹੂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਿਹਾਨੇ ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ॥
transliteration: iaahoo jugat bihaane kaee janam ||
english: So many lifetimes are wasted in these ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak raakh lehu aapan kar karam ||7||
english: Nanak: uplift them, and redeem them, O Lord - show Your Mercy! ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: too thaakur tum pahi aradaas ||
english: You are our Lord and Master; to You, I offer this prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh teree raas ||
english: This body and soul are all Your property.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tum maat pitaa ham baarik tere ||
english: You are our mother and father; we are Your children.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tumaree kripaa mahi sookh ghanere ||
english: In Your Grace, there are so many joys!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: koi na jaanai tumaraa a(n)t ||
english: No one knows Your limits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: ooche te oochaa bhagava(n)t ||
english: O Highest of the High, Most Generous God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਸੂਤ੍ਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sagal samagree tumarai sootr dhaaree ||
english: the whole creation is strung on Your thread.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tum te hoi s aagiaakaaree ||
english: That which has come from You is under Your Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: tumaree gat mit tum hee jaanee ||
english: You alone know Your state and extent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੮॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak daas sadaa kurabaanee ||8||4||
english: Nanak, Your slave, is forever a sacrifice. ||8||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਆਨ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
transliteration: denahaar prabh chhod kai laagahi aan suaai ||
english: One who renounces God the Giver, and attaches himself to other affairs

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹੂ ਨ ਸੀਝਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kahoo na seejhaee bin naavai pat jaai ||1||
english: - O Nanak, he shall never succeed. Without the Name, he shall lose his honor. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਬਸਤੂ ਲੇ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: das basatoo le paachhai paavai ||
english: He obtains ten things, and puts them behind him;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਬਿਖੋਟਿ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ek basat kaaran bikhot gavaavai ||
english: for the sake of one thing withheld, he forfeits his faith.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਭੀ ਨ ਦੇਇ ਦਸ ਭੀ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: ek bhee na dei das bhee hir lei ||
english: But what if that one thing were not given, and the ten were taken away?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਮੂੜਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: tau mooRaa kahu kahaa karei ||
english: Then, what could the fool say or do?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis thaakur siu naahee chaaraa ||
english: Our Lord and Master cannot be moved by force.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਦ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: taa kau keejai sad namasakaaraa ||
english: Unto Him, bow forever in adoration.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai man laagaa prabh meethaa ||
english: That one, unto whose mind God seems sweet

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਤਾਹੂ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab sookh taahoo man voothaa ||
english: all pleasures come to abide in his mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਅਪਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis jan apanaa hukam manaaiaa ||
english: One who abides by the Lord's Will,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarab thok naanak tin paaiaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, obtains all things. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਤ ਸਾਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: aganat saahu apanee de raas ||
english: God the Banker gives endless capital to the mortal,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਤ ਬਰਤੈ ਅਨਦ ਉਲਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: khaat peet baratai anad ulaas ||
english: who eats, drinks and expends it with pleasure and joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਅਮਾਨ ਕਛੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਸਾਹੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: apunee amaan kachh bahur saahu lei ||
english: If some of this capital is later taken back by the Banker,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: agiaanee man ros karei ||
english: the ignorant person shows his anger.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: apanee parateet aap hee khovai ||
english: He himself destroys his own credibility,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bahur us kaa bisvaas na hovai ||
english: and he shall not again be trusted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: jis kee basat tis aagai raakhai ||
english: When one offers to the Lord, that which belongs to the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨੈ ਮਾਥੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee aagiaa maanai maathai ||
english: and willingly abides by the Will of God's Order,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਚਉਗੁਨ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: us te chaugun karai nihaal ||
english: the Lord will make him happy four times over.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saahib sadaa daiaal ||2||
english: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is merciful forever. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ॥
transliteration: anik bhaat maaiaa ke het ||
english: The many forms of attachment to Maya shall surely pass away

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਪਰ ਹੋਵਤ ਜਾਨੁ ਅਨੇਤ ॥
transliteration: sarapar hovat jaan anet ||
english: - know that they are transitory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਖ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: birakh kee chhaaiaa siu ra(n)g laavai ||
english: People fall in love with the shade of the tree,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਉਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: oh binasai uhu man pachhutaavai ||
english: and when it passes away, they feel regret in their minds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਚਾਲਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai so chaalanahaar ||
english: Whatever is seen, shall pass away;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਤਹ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: lapat rahio tah a(n)dh a(n)dhaar ||
english: and yet, the blindest of the blind cling to it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਟਾਊ ਸਿਉ ਜੋ ਲਾਵੈ ਨੇਹ ॥
transliteration: bataaoo siu jo laavai neh ||
english: One who gives her love to a passing traveler

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕੇਹ ॥
transliteration: taa kau haath na aavai keh ||
english: nothing shall come into her hands in this way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man har ke naam kee preet sukhadaaee ||
english: O mind, the love of the Name of the Lord bestows peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa naanak aap lae laaee ||3||
english: O Nanak, the Lord, in His Mercy, unites us with Himself. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa tan dhan kuta(n)b sabaaiaa ||
english: False are body, wealth, and all relations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa haumai mamataa maaiaa ||
english: False are ego, possessiveness and Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa raaj joban dhan maal ||
english: False are power, youth, wealth and property.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa kaam krodh bikaraal ||
english: False are sexual desire and wild anger.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਥ ਹਸਤੀ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਬਸਤ੍ਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa rath hasatee asv basatraa ||
english: False are chariots, elephants, horses and expensive clothes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਸਤਾ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa ra(n)g sa(n)g maaiaa pekh hasataa ||
english: False is the love of gathering wealth, and reveling in the sight of it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਮੋਹ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa dhroh moh abhimaan ||
english: False are deception, emotional attachment and egotistical pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਆਪਸ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa aapas oopar karat gumaan ||
english: False are pride and self-conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸਰਨ ॥
transliteration: asathir bhagat saadh kee saran ||
english: Only devotional worship is permanent, and the Sanctuary of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak jap jap jeevai har ke charan ||4||
english: Nanak lives by meditating, meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸੁਨਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa sravan par ni(n)daa sunahi ||
english: False are the ears which listen to the slander of others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਹਸਤ ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਕਉ ਹਿਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa hasat par darab kau hirahi ||
english: False are the hands which steal the wealth of others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੂਪਾਦ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa netr pekhat par tri roopaad ||
english: False are the eyes which gaze upon the beauty of another's wife.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਭੋਜਨ ਅਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa rasanaa bhojan an svaad ||
english: False is the tongue which enjoys delicacies and external tastes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਚਰਨ ਪਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa charan par bikaar kau dhaavahi ||
english: False are the feet which run to do evil to others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮਨ ਪਰ ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa man par lobh lubhaavahi ||
english: False is the mind which covets the wealth of others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਤਨ ਨਹੀ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa tan nahee paraupakaaraa ||
english: False is the body which does not do good to others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਬਾਸੁ ਲੇਤ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa baas let bikaaraa ||
english: False is the nose which inhales corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸਭ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: bin boojhe mithiaa sabh bhae ||
english: Without understanding, everything is false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਦੇਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: saphal deh naanak har har naam lae ||5||
english: Fruitful is the body, O Nanak, which takes to the Lord's Name. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥੀ ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਆਰਜਾ ॥
transliteration: birathee saakat kee aarajaa ||
english: The life of the faithless cynic is totally useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਹ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੂਚਾ ॥
transliteration: saach binaa kah hovat soochaa ||
english: Without the Truth, how can anyone be pure?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਧ ॥
transliteration: birathaa naam binaa tan a(n)dh ||
english: Useless is the body of the spiritually blind, without the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਆਵਤ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ॥
transliteration: mukh aavat taa kai duraga(n)dh ||
english: From his mouth, a foul smell issues forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin simaran din rain brithaa bihaai ||
english: Without the remembrance of the Lord, day and night pass in vain,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਘ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਖੇਤੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: megh binaa jiu khetee jaai ||
english: like the crop which withers without rain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gobid bhajan bin brithe sabh kaam ||
english: Without meditation on the Lord of the Universe, all works are in vain,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਾਰਥ ਦਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jiu kirapan ke niraarath daam ||
english: like the wealth of a miser, which lies useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n te jan jih ghat basio har naau ||
english: Blessed, blessed are those, whose hearts are filled with the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak taa kai bal bal jaau ||6||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਹਤ ਅਵਰ ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰ ਕਮਾਵਤ ॥
transliteration: rahat avar kachh avar kamaavat ||
english: He says one thing, and does something else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਗੰਢ ਲਾਵਤ ॥
transliteration: man nahee preet mukhahu ga(n)dh laavat ||
english: There is no love in his heart, and yet with his mouth he talks tall.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨਨਹਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪਰਬੀਨ ॥
transliteration: jaananahaar prabhoo parabeen ||
english: The Omniscient Lord God is the Knower of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਭੀਨ ॥
transliteration: baahar bhekh na kaahoo bheen ||
english: He is not impressed by outward display.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: avar upadesai aap na karai ||
english: One who does not practice what he preaches to others,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ਜਨਮੈ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aavat jaavat janamai marai ||
english: shall come and go in reincarnation, through birth and death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jis kai a(n)tar basai nira(n)kaar ||
english: One whose inner being is filled with the Formless Lord

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੀਖ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tis kee seekh tarai sa(n)saar ||
english: by his teachings, the world is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਨੇ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jo tum bhaane tin prabh jaataa ||
english: Those who are pleasing to You, God, know You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਨ ਜਨ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak un jan charan paraataa ||7||
english: Nanak falls at their feet. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: karau benatee paarabraham sabh jaanai ||
english: Offer your prayers to the Supreme Lord God, who knows everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: apanaa keeaa aapahi maanai ||
english: He Himself values His own creatures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aapahi aap aap karat niberaa ||
english: He Himself, by Himself, makes the decisions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਜਨਾਵਤ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਵਤ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kisai door janaavat kisai bujhaavat neraa ||
english: To some, He appears far away, while others perceive Him near at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਪਾਵ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
transliteration: upaav siaanap sagal te rahat ||
english: He is beyond all efforts and clever tricks.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਤਮ ਕੀ ਰਹਤ ॥
transliteration: sabh kachh jaanai aatam kee rahat ||
english: He knows all the ways and means of the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis bhaavai tis lae laR laai ||
english: Those with whom He is pleased are attached to the hem of His robe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar rahiaa samaai ||
english: He is pervading all places and interspaces.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: so sevak jis kirapaa karee ||
english: Those upon whom He bestows His favor, become His servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰੀ ॥੮॥੫॥
transliteration: nimakh nimakh jap naanak haree ||8||5||
english: Each and every moment, O Nanak, meditate on the Lord. ||8||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh ar lobh moh binas jaai aha(n)mev ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment - may these be gone, and egotism as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee kar prasaad guradev ||1||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; please bless me with Your Grace, O Divine Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad chhateeh a(n)mrit khaahi ||
english: By His Grace, you partake of the thirty-six delicacies;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tis thaakur kau rakh man maahi ||
english: enshrine that Lord and Master within your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਗੰਧਤ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad suga(n)dhat tan laavahi ||
english: By His Grace, you apply scented oils to your body;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tis kau simarat param gat paavahi ||
english: remembering Him, the supreme status is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਮੰਦਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad basahi sukh ma(n)dar ||
english: By His Grace, you dwell in the palace of peace;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tisahi dhiaai sadaa man a(n)dar ||
english: meditate forever on Him within your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਖ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad grih sa(n)g sukh basanaa ||
english: By His Grace, you abide with your family in peace;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar simarahu tis rasanaa ||
english: keep His remembrance upon your tongue, twenty-four hours a day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad ra(n)g ras bhog ||
english: By His Grace, you enjoy tastes and pleasures;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਧਿਆਵਨ ਜੋਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sadaa dhiaaeeai dhiaavan jog ||1||
english: O Nanak, meditate forever on the One, who is worthy of meditation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਹਢਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad paat pata(n)bar hadhaavahi ||
english: By His Grace, you wear silks and satins;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਤ ਅਵਰ ਲੁਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tisahi tiaag kat avar lubhaavahi ||
english: why abandon Him, to attach yourself to another?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਈਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad sukh sej soeejai ||
english: By His Grace, you sleep in a cozy bed;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: man aath pahar taa kaa jas gaaveejai ||
english: O my mind, sing His Praises, twenty-four hours a day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad tujh sabh kooo maanai ||
english: By His Grace, you are honored by everyone;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: mukh taa ko jas rasan bakhaanai ||
english: with your mouth and with your tongue, chant His Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਰਹਤਾ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad tero rahataa dharam ||
english: By His Grace, you remain in the Dharma;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਕੇਵਲ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
transliteration: man sadaa dhiaai keval paarabraham ||
english: O mind, meditate continually on the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਜਪਤ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh jee japat daragah maan paavahi ||
english: Meditating on God, you shall be honored in His Court;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak pat setee ghar jaavahi ||2||
english: O Nanak, you shall return to your true home with honor. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਆਰੋਗ ਕੰਚਨ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad aarog ka(n)chan dehee ||
english: By His Grace, you have a healthy, golden body;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: liv laavahu tis raam sanehee ||
english: attune yourself to that Loving Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਓਲਾ ਰਹਤ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad teraa olaa rahat ||
english: By His Grace, your honor is preserved;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤ ॥
transliteration: man sukh paavahi har har jas kahat ||
english: O mind, chant the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, and find peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਢਾਕੇ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad tere sagal chhidr dhaake ||
english: By His Grace, all your deficits are covered;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: man saranee par thaakur prabh taa kai ||
english: O mind, seek the Sanctuary of God, our Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad tujh ko na pahoochai ||
english: By His Grace, no one can rival you;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚੇ ॥
transliteration: man saas saas simarahu prabh ooche ||
english: O mind, with each and every breath, remember God on High.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਈ ਦ੍ਰੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad paaee drulabh deh ||
english: By His Grace, you obtained this precious human body;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਹ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak taa kee bhagat kareh ||3||
english: O Nanak, worship Him with devotion. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਆਭੂਖਨ ਪਹਿਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad aabhookhan pahireejai ||
english: By His Grace, you wear decorations;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਿਉ ਆਲਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: man tis simarat kiu aalas keejai ||
english: O mind, why are you so lazy? Why don't you remember Him in meditation?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਹਸਤਿ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad asv hasat asavaaree ||
english: By His Grace, you have horses and elephants to ride;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: man tis prabh kau kabahoo na bisaaree ||
english: O mind, never forget that God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਬਾਗ ਮਿਲਖ ਧਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad baag milakh dhanaa ||
english: By His Grace, you have land, gardens and wealth;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੁ ਪਰੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: raakh paroi prabh apune manaa ||
english: keep God enshrined in your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਨ ਬਨਤ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin teree man banat banaaee ||
english: O mind, the One who formed your form

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸਦ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat sad tisahi dhiaaee ||
english: standing up and sitting down, meditate always on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੋ ਏਕ ਅਲਖੈ ॥
transliteration: tisahi dhiaai jo ek alakhai ||
english: Meditate on Him - the One Invisible Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਖੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: eehaa oohaa naanak teree rakhai ||4||
english: here and hereafter, O Nanak, He shall save you. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad karahi pu(n)n bahu daan ||
english: By His Grace, you give donations in abundance to charities;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: man aath pahar kar tis kaa dhiaan ||
english: O mind, meditate on Him, twenty-four hours a day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੂ ਆਚਾਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad too aachaar biuhaaree ||
english: By His Grace, you perform religious rituals and worldly duties;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tis prabh kau saas saas chitaaree ||
english: think of God with each and every breath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad teraa su(n)dar roop ||
english: By His Grace, your form is so beautiful;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: so prabh simarahu sadaa anoop ||
english: constantly remember God, the Incomparably Beautiful One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਨੀਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad teree neekee jaat ||
english: By His Grace, you have such high social status;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: so prabh simar sadaa din raat ||
english: remember God always, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad teree pat rahai ||
english: By His Grace, your honor is preserved;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਕਹੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak jas kahai ||5||
english: by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, chant His Praises. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਕਰਨ ਨਾਦ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad sunahi karan naad ||
english: By His Grace, you listen to the sound current of the Naad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪੇਖਹਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad pekhahi bisamaad ||
english: By His Grace, you behold amazing wonders.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad bolahi a(n)mrit rasanaa ||
english: By His Grace, you speak ambrosial words with your tongue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad sukh sahaje basanaa ||
english: By His Grace, you abide in peace and ease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਸਤ ਕਰ ਚਲਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad hasat kar chalahi ||
english: By His Grace, your hands move and work.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਫਲਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad sa(n)pooran phalahi ||
english: By His Grace, you are completely fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad param gat paavahi ||
english: By His Grace, you obtain the supreme status.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad sukh sahaj samaavahi ||
english: By His Grace, you are absorbed into celestial peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਤ ਲਾਗਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aisaa prabh tiaag avar kat laagahu ||
english: Why forsake God, and attach yourself to another?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਜਾਗਹੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak man jaagahu ||6||
english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, awaken your mind! ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad too(n) pragat sa(n)saar ||
english: By His Grace, you are famous all over the world;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tis prabh kau mool na manahu bisaar ||
english: never forget God from your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad teraa parataap ||
english: By His Grace, you have prestige;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: re man mooR too taa kau jaap ||
english: O foolish mind, meditate on Him!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad tere kaaraj poore ||
english: By His Grace, your works are completed;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਜਾਨੁ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tisahi jaan man sadaa hajoore ||
english: O mind, know Him to be close at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ॥
