transliteration: jih prasaad too(n) paavahi saach ||
english: By His Grace, you find the Truth;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚੁ ॥
transliteration: re man mere too(n) taa siu raach ||
english: O my mind, merge yourself into Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jih prasaad sabh kee gat hoi ||
english: By His Grace, everyone is saved;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਪੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak jaap japai jap soi ||7||
english: O Nanak, meditate, and chant His Chant. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਏ ਜਪੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aap japaae japai so naau ||
english: Those, whom He inspires to chant, chant His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਗਾਵਾਏ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aap gaavaae s har gun gaau ||
english: Those, whom He inspires to sing, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh kirapaa te hoi pragaas ||
english: By God's Grace, enlightenment comes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: prabhoo daiaa te kamal bigaas ||
english: By God's Kind Mercy, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਬਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh suprasa(n)n basai man soi ||
english: When God is totally pleased, He comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh daiaa te mat ootam hoi ||
english: By God's Kind Mercy, the intellect is exalted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan prabh teree maiaa ||
english: All treasures, O Lord, come by Your Kind Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਕਿਨਹੂ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aapahu kachhoo na kinahoo laiaa ||
english: No one obtains anything by himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: jit jit laavahu tit lagahi har naath ||
english: As You have delegated, so do we apply ourselves, O Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਨ ਕੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹਾਥ ॥੮॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak in kai kachhoo na haath ||8||6||
english: O Nanak, nothing is in our hands. ||8||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: agam agaadh paarabraham soi ||
english: Unapproachable and Unfathomable is the Supreme Lord God;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo jo kahai s mukataa hoi ||
english: whoever speaks of Him shall be liberated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sun meetaa naanak binava(n)taa ||
english: Listen, O friends, Nanak prays,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਕਥਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadh janaa kee acharaj kathaa ||1||
english: To the wonderful story of the Holy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਤ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g mukh oojal hot ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one's face becomes radiant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਲੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਖੋਤ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mal sagalee khot ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, all filth is removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g mitai abhimaan ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, egotism is eliminated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੈ ਸੁਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g pragatai sugiaan ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, spiritual wisdom is revealed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g bujhai prabh neraa ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, God is understood to be near at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g sabh hot niberaa ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, all conflicts are settled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g paae naam ratan ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains the jewel of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g ek oopar jatan ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one's efforts are directed toward the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਰਨੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: saadh kee mahimaa baranai kaun praanee ||
english: What mortal can speak of the Glorious Praises of the Holy?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saadh kee sobhaa prabh maahi samaanee ||1||
english: O Nanak, the glory of the Holy people merges into God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g agochar milai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one meets the Incomprehensible Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਫੁਲੈ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g sadaa paraphulai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one flourishes forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਬਸਿ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g aavahi bas pa(n)chaa ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, the five passions are brought to rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਭੁੰਚਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g a(n)mrit ras bhu(n)chaa ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one enjoys the essence of ambrosia.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g hoi sabh kee ren ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one becomes the dust of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਬੈਨ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g manohar bain ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one's speech is enticing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g na katahoo(n) dhaavai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, the mind does not wander.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਅਸਥਿਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g asathit man paavai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, the mind becomes stable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g maaiaa te bhi(n)n ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one is rid of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak prabh suprasa(n)n ||2||
english: In the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, God is totally pleased. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਸਭਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g dusaman sabh meet ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, all one's enemies become friends.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo kai sa(n)g mahaa puneet ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, there is great purity.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਨਹੀ ਬੈਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g kis siu nahee bair ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, no one is hated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਬੀਗਾ ਪੈਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g na beegaa pair ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one's feet do not wander.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g naahee ko ma(n)daa ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, no one seems evil.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਨੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jaane paramaana(n)daa ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, supreme bliss is known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਉ ਤਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g naahee hau taap ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, the fever of ego departs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੁ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g tajai sabh aap ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one renounces all selfishness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਾਧ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aape jaanai saadh badaaee ||
english: He Himself knows the greatness of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak saadh prabhoo ban aaee ||3||
english: O Nanak, the Holy are at one with God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g na kabahoo dhaavai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, the mind never wanders.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g sadaa sukh paavai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains everlasting peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਲਹੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g basat agochar lahai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one grasps the Incomprehensible.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਜਰੁ ਸਹੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo kai sa(n)g ajar sahai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one can endure the unendurable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਊਚੈ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g basai thaan oochai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one abides in the loftiest place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo kai sa(n)g mahal pahoochai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g driRai sabh dharam ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one's Dharmic faith is firmly established.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g keval paarabraham ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one dwells with the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g paae naam nidhaan ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains the treasure of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak saadhoo kai kurabaan ||4||
english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Holy. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g sabh kul udhaarai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, all one's family is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g saajan meet kuta(n)b nisataarai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one's friends, acquaintances and relatives are redeemed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo kai sa(n)g so dhan paavai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, that wealth is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਰਸਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jis dhan te sabh ko varasaavai ||
english: Everyone benefits from that wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g dharam raai kare sevaa ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, the Lord of Dharma serves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g sobhaa suradevaa ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, the divine, angelic beings sing God's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪ ਪਲਾਇਨ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo kai sa(n)g paap palaain ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one's sins fly away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਨ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g a(n)mrit gun gaain ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one sings the Ambrosial Glories.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਗੰਮਿ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g srab thaan ga(n)m ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, all places are within reach.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak saadh kai sa(n)g saphal jana(n)m ||5||
english: O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy, one's life becomes fruitful. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g nahee kachh ghaal ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, there is no suffering.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: darasan bhetat hot nihaal ||
english: The Blessed Vision of their Darshan brings a sublime, happy peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਲੂਖਤ ਹਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g kalookhat harai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, blemishes are removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਰਕ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g narak paraharai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, hell is far away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g eehaa oohaa suhelaa ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one is happy here and hereafter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g bichhurat har melaa ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, the separated ones are reunited with the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo ichhai soee phal paavai ||
english: The fruits of one's desires are obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g na birathaa jaavai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, no one goes empty-handed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਾਧ ਰਿਦ ਬਸੈ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham saadh rid basai ||
english: The Supreme Lord God dwells in the hearts of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਸੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak udharai saadh sun rasai ||6||
english: O Nanak, listening to the sweet words of the Holy, one is saved. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਨਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g sunau har naau ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, listen to the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har ke gun gaau ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g na man te bisarai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, do not forget Him from your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g sarapar nisatarai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, you shall surely be saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g lagai prabh meethaa ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, God seems very sweet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo kai sa(n)g ghat ghat deethaa ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, He is seen in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਏ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g bhae aagiaakaaree ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, we become obedient to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g gat bhaee hamaaree ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, we obtain the state of salvation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ॥
transliteration: saadh kai sa(n)g mite sabh rog ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, all diseases are cured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak saadh bhete sa(n)jog ||7||
english: O Nanak, one meets with the Holy, by highest destiny. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
transliteration: saadh kee mahimaa bed na jaanahi ||
english: The glory of the Holy people is not known to the Vedas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਬਖਿਆਨਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jetaa sunahi tetaa bakhiaanahi ||
english: They can describe only what they have heard.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saadh kee upamaa tihu gun te door ||
english: The greatness of the Holy people is beyond the three qualities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਰਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saadh kee upamaa rahee bharapoor ||
english: The greatness of the Holy people is all-pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤ ॥
transliteration: saadh kee sobhaa kaa naahee a(n)t ||
english: The glory of the Holy people has no limit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥
transliteration: saadh kee sobhaa sadaa bea(n)t ||
english: The glory of the Holy people is infinite and eternal.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੀ ॥
transliteration: saadh kee sobhaa ooch te oochee ||
english: The glory of the Holy people is the highest of the high.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੂਚ ਤੇ ਮੂਚੀ ॥
transliteration: saadh kee sobhaa mooch te moochee ||
english: The glory of the Holy people is the greatest of the great.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਧ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: saadh kee sobhaa saadh ban aaee ||
english: The glory of the Holy people is theirs alone;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੮॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak saadh prabh bhed na bhaaee ||8||7||
english: O Nanak, there is no difference between the Holy people and God. ||8||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man saachaa mukh saachaa soi ||
english: The True One is on his mind, and the True One is upon his lips.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੇਖੈ ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: avar na pekhai ekas bin koi ||
english: He sees only the One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਲਛਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ih lachhan braham giaanee hoi ||1||
english: O Nanak, these are the qualities of the God-conscious being. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee sadaa niralep ||
english: The God-conscious being is always unattached,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਲ ਅਲੇਪ ॥
transliteration: jaise jal mahi kamal alep ||
english: as the lotus in the water remains detached.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee sadaa niradokh ||
english: The God-conscious being is always unstained,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਕਉ ਸੋਖ ॥
transliteration: jaise soor sarab kau sokh ||
english: like the sun, which gives its comfort and warmth to all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai drisat samaan ||
english: The God-conscious being looks upon all alike,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਰੰਕ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਪਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jaise raaj ra(n)k kau laagai tul pavaan ||
english: like the wind, which blows equally upon the king and the poor beggar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai dheeraj ek ||
english: The God-conscious being has a steady patience,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕੋਊ ਖੋਦੈ ਕੋਊ ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪ ॥
transliteration: jiu basudhaa kooo khodai kooo cha(n)dan lep ||
english: like the earth, which is dug up by one, and anointed with sandal paste by another.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਇਹੈ ਗੁਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kaa ihai gunaau ||
english: This is the quality of the God-conscious being:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਾ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jiu paavak kaa sahaj subhaau ||1||
english: O Nanak, his inherent nature is like a warming fire. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee niramal te niramalaa ||
english: The God-conscious being is the purest of the pure;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jaise mail na laagai jalaa ||
english: filth does not stick to water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai man hoi pragaas ||
english: The God-conscious being's mind is enlightened,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jaise dhar oopar aakaas ||
english: like the sky above the earth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai mitr satr samaan ||
english: To the God-conscious being, friend and foe are the same.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai naahee abhimaan ||
english: The God-conscious being has no egotistical pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee ooch te oochaa ||
english: The God-conscious being is the highest of the high.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੀਚਾ ॥
transliteration: man apanai hai sabh te neechaa ||
english: Within his own mind, he is the most humble of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee se jan bhae ||
english: They alone become God-conscious beings,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jin prabh aap karei ||2||
english: O Nanak, whom God Himself makes so. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee sagal kee reenaa ||
english: The God-conscious being is the dust of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਸੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aatam ras braham giaanee cheenaa ||
english: The God-conscious being knows the nature of the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kee sabh oopar maiaa ||
english: The God-conscious being shows kindness to all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee te kachh buraa na bhaiaa ||
english: No evil comes from the God-conscious being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee sadaa samadarasee ||
english: The God-conscious being is always impartial.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਰਸੀ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kee drisat a(n)mrit barasee ||
english: Nectar rains down from the glance of the God-conscious being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee ba(n)dhan te mukataa ||
english: The God-conscious being is free from entanglements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kee niramal jugataa ||
english: The lifestyle of the God-conscious being is spotlessly pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kaa bhojan giaan ||
english: Spiritual wisdom is the food of the God-conscious being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak braham giaanee kaa braham dhiaan ||3||
english: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is absorbed in God's meditation. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee ek oopar aas ||
english: The God-conscious being centers his hopes on the One alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kaa nahee binaas ||
english: The God-conscious being shall never perish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai gareebee samaahaa ||
english: The God-conscious being is steeped in humility.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਉਮਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee paraupakaar umaahaa ||
english: The God-conscious being delights in doing good to others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai naahee dha(n)dhaa ||
english: The God-conscious being has no worldly entanglements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਲੇ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee le dhaavat ba(n)dhaa ||
english: The God-conscious being holds his wandering mind under control.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai hoi s bhalaa ||
english: The God-conscious being acts in the common good.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee suphal phalaa ||
english: The God-conscious being blossoms in fruitfulness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee sa(n)g sagal udhaar ||
english: In the Company of the God-conscious being, all are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਪੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak braham giaanee japai sagal sa(n)saar ||4||
english: O Nanak, through the God-conscious being, the whole world meditates on God. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai ekai ra(n)g ||
english: The God-conscious being loves the One Lord alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਬਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai basai prabh sa(n)g ||
english: The God-conscious being dwells with God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai naam aadhaar ||
english: The God-conscious being takes the Naam as his Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai naam paravaar ||
english: The God-conscious being has the Naam as his Family.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜਾਗਤ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee sadaa sad jaagat ||
english: The God-conscious being is awake and aware, forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਤਿਆਗਤ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee aha(n)budh tiaagat ||
english: The God-conscious being renounces his proud ego.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai man paramaana(n)d ||
english: In the mind of the God-conscious being, there is supreme bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai ghar sadaa ana(n)d ||
english: In the home of the God-conscious being, there is everlasting bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee sukh sahaj nivaas ||
english: The God-conscious being dwells in peaceful ease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak braham giaanee kaa nahee binaas ||5||
english: O Nanak, the God-conscious being shall never perish. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਬੇਤਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee braham kaa betaa ||
english: The God-conscious being knows God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਏਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee ek sa(n)g hetaa ||
english: The God-conscious being is in love with the One alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai hoi achi(n)t ||
english: The God-conscious being is carefree.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kaa niramal ma(n)t ||
english: Pure are the Teachings of the God-conscious being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee jis karai prabh aap ||
english: The God-conscious being is made so by God Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kaa bad parataap ||
english: The God-conscious being is gloriously great.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kaa daras badabhaagee paaeeai ||
english: The Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the God-conscious being, is obtained by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kau bal bal jaaeeai ||
english: To the God-conscious being, I make my life a sacrifice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਮਹੇਸੁਰ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kau khojahi mahesur ||
english: The God-conscious being is sought by the great god Shiva.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak braham giaanee aap paramesur ||6||
english: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is Himself the Supreme Lord God. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kee keemat naahi ||
english: The God-conscious being cannot be appraised.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਸਗਲ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kai sagal man maahi ||
english: The God-conscious being has all within his mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਕਉਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kaa kaun jaanai bhed ||
english: Who can know the mystery of the God-conscious being?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kau sadaa ades ||
english: Forever bow to the God-conscious being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਕਥਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਧਾਖੵਰੁ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kaa kathiaa na jaai adhaakhyr ||
english: The God-conscious being cannot be described in words.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee sarab kaa thaakur ||
english: The God-conscious being is the Lord and Master of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਉਨੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kee mit kaun bakhaanai ||
english: Who can describe the limits of the God-conscious being?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kee gat braham giaanee jaanai ||
english: Only the God-conscious being can know the state of the God-conscious being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kaa a(n)t na paar ||
english: The God-conscious being has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak braham giaanee kau sadaa namasakaar ||7||
english: O Nanak, to the God-conscious being, bow forever in reverence. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee sabh srisat kaa karataa ||
english: The God-conscious being is the Creator of all the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਦ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee sad jeevai nahee marataa ||
english: The God-conscious being lives forever, and does not die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee mukat jugat jee kaa daataa ||
english: The God-conscious being is the Giver of the way of liberation of the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee pooran purakh bidhaataa ||
english: The God-conscious being is the Perfect Supreme Being, who orchestrates all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅਨਾਥ ਕਾ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee anaath kaa naath ||
english: The God-conscious being is the helper of the helpless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kaa sabh oopar haath ||
english: The God-conscious being extends his hand to all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kaa sagal akaar ||
english: The God-conscious being owns the entire creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee aap nira(n)kaar ||
english: The God-conscious being is himself the Formless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਨੀ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee kee sobhaa braham giaanee banee ||
english: The glory of the God-conscious being belongs to the God-conscious being alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਾ ਧਨੀ ॥੮॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak braham giaanee sarab kaa dhanee ||8||8||
english: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is the Lord of all. ||8||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ਜੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: ur dhaarai jo a(n)tar naam ||
english: One who enshrines the Naam within the heart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਪੇਖੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sarab mai pekhai bhagavaan ||
english: who sees the Lord God in all,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: nimakh nimakh thaakur namasakaarai ||
english: who, each and every moment, bows in reverence to the Lord Master

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੁ ਅਪਰਸੁ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ohu aparas sagal nisataarai ||1||
english: - O Nanak, such a one is the true 'touch-nothing Saint', who emancipates everyone. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਪਰਸ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa naahee rasanaa paras ||
english: One whose tongue does not touch falsehood;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦਰਸ ॥
transliteration: man mahi preet nira(n)jan daras ||
english: whose mind is filled with love for the Blessed Vision of the Pure Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਪੇਖੈ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ॥
transliteration: par tri roop na pekhai netr ||
english: whose eyes do not gaze upon the beauty of others' wives,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤ ॥
transliteration: saadh kee tahal sa(n)tasa(n)g het ||
english: who serves the Holy and loves the Saints' Congregation,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਨ ਸੁਨੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: karan na sunai kaahoo kee ni(n)daa ||
english: whose ears do not listen to slander against anyone,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh te jaanai aapas kau ma(n)daa ||
english: who deems himself to be the worst of all,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad bikhiaa paraharai ||
english: who, by Guru's Grace, renounces corruption,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ ॥
transliteration: man kee baasanaa man te tarai ||
english: who banishes the mind's evil desires from his mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਜਿਤ ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
transliteration: i(n)dree jit pa(n)ch dokh te rahat ||
english: who conquers his sexual instincts and is free of the five sinful passions

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਐਸਾ ਅਪਰਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kot madhe ko aisaa aparas ||1||
english: - O Nanak, among millions, there is scarcely one such 'touch-nothing Saint'. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਸਨੋ ਸੋ ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
transliteration: baisano so jis oopar suprasa(n)n ||
english: The true Vaishnaav, the devotee of Vishnu, is the one with whom God is thoroughly pleased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
transliteration: bisan kee maaiaa te hoi bhi(n)n ||
english: He dwells apart from Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਹਕਰਮ ॥
transliteration: karam karat hovai nihakaram ||
english: Performing good deeds, he does not seek rewards.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਧਰਮ ॥
transliteration: tis baisano kaa niramal dharam ||
english: Spotlessly pure is the religion of such a Vaishnaav;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਫਲ ਕੀ ਇਛਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛੈ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo phal kee ichhaa nahee baachhai ||
english: he has no desire for the fruits of his labors.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਲ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੈ ॥
transliteration: keval bhagat keeratan sa(n)g raachai ||
english: He is absorbed in devotional worship and the singing of Kirtan, the songs of the Lord's Glory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar simaran gopaal ||
english: Within his mind and body, he meditates in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sabh oopar hovat kirapaal ||
english: He is kind to all creatures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਅਵਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aap driRai avarah naam japaavai ||
english: He holds fast to the Naam, and inspires others to chant it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੁ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak ohu baisano param gat paavai ||2||
english: O Nanak, such a Vaishnaav obtains the supreme status. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਉਤੀ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: bhagautee bhagava(n)t bhagat kaa ra(n)g ||
english: The true Bhagaautee, the devotee of Adi Shakti, loves the devotional worship of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਦੁਸਟ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: sagal tiaagai dusat kaa sa(n)g ||
english: He forsakes the company of all wicked people.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਗਲਾ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: man te binasai sagalaa bharam ||
english: All doubts are removed from his mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜੈ ਸਗਲ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
transliteration: kar poojai sagal paarabraham ||
english: He performs devotional service to the Supreme Lord God in all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g paapaa mal khovai ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, the filth of sin is washed away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tis bhagautee kee mat ootam hovai ||
english: The wisdom of such a Bhagaautee becomes supreme.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bhagava(n)t kee tahal karai nit neet ||
english: He constantly performs the service of the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੈ ਬਿਸਨ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: man tan arapai bisan pareet ||
english: He dedicates his mind and body to the Love of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har ke charan hiradai basaavai ||
english: The Lotus Feet of the Lord abide in his heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak aisaa bhagautee bhagava(n)t kau paavai ||3||
english: O Nanak, such a Bhagaautee attains the Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਜੋ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ॥
transliteration: so pa(n)dit jo man parabodhai ||
english: He is a true Pandit, a religious scholar, who instructs his own mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਤਮ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਧੈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam aatam mahi sodhai ||
english: He searches for the Lord's Name within his own soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਾਰੁ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam saar ras peevai ||
english: He drinks in the Exquisite Nectar of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
transliteration: us pa(n)dit kai upades jag jeevai ||
english: By that Pandit's teachings, the world lives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har kee kathaa hiradai basaavai ||
english: He implants the Sermon of the Lord in his heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so pa(n)dit phir jon na aavai ||
english: Such a Pandit is not cast into the womb of reincarnation again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਮੂਲ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan simrit boojhai mool ||
english: He understands the fundamental essence of the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖਮ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਸਥੂਲੁ ॥
transliteration: sookham mahi jaanai asathool ||
english: In the unmanifest, he sees the manifest world to exist.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਕਉ ਦੇ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: chahu varanaa kau de upades ||
english: He gives instruction to people of all castes and social classes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਸੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਦੇਸੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak us pa(n)dit kau sadaa ades ||4||
english: O Nanak, to such a Pandit, I bow in salutation forever. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੀਜ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: beej ma(n)tr sarab ko giaan ||
english: The Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra, is spiritual wisdom for everyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਪੈ ਕੋਊ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: chahu varanaa mahi japai kooo naam ||
english: Anyone, from any class, may chant the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo jo japai tis kee gat hoi ||
english: Whoever chants it, is emancipated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g paavai jan koi ||
english: And yet, rare are those who attain it, in the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa a(n)tar ur dhaarai ||
english: By His Grace, He enshrines it within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਮੁਘਦ ਪਾਥਰ ਕਉ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: pas pret mughad paathar kau taarai ||
english: Even beasts, ghosts and the stone-hearted are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ਕਾ ਅਉਖਦੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sarab rog kaa aukhad naam ||
english: The Naam is the panacea, the remedy to cure all ills.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਣ ਰੂਪ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kaliaan roop ma(n)gal gun gaam ||
english: Singing the Glory of God is the embodiment of bliss and emancipation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਧਰਮਿ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo jugat kitai na paaeeai dharam ||
english: It cannot be obtained by any religious rituals.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak tis milai jis likhiaa dhur karam ||5||
english: O Nanak, he alone obtains it, whose karma is so pre-ordained. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jis kai man paarabraham kaa nivaas ||
english: One whose mind is a home for the Supreme Lord God

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa naam sat raamadaas ||
english: - his name is truly Ram Das, the Lord's servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aatam raam tis nadaree aaiaa ||
english: He comes to have the Vision of the Lord, the Supreme Soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਦਸੰਤਣ ਭਾਇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: daas dasa(n)tan bhaai tin paaiaa ||
english: Deeming himself to be the slave of the Lord's slaves, he obtains it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa nikat nikat har jaan ||
english: He knows the Lord to be Ever-present, close at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: so daas daragah paravaan ||
english: Such a servant is honored in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: apune daas kau aap kirapaa karai ||
english: To His servant, He Himself shows His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਰੈ ॥
transliteration: tis daas kau sabh sojhee parai ||
english: Such a servant understands everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਤਮ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sagal sa(n)g aatam udaas ||
english: Amidst all, his soul is unattached.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aisee jugat naanak raamadaas ||6||
english: Such is the way, O Nanak, of the Lord's servant. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਆਤਮ ਹਿਤਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee aagiaa aatam hitaavai ||
english: One who, in his soul, loves the Will of God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸੋਊ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jeevan mukat sooo kahaavai ||
english: is said to be Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸਾ ਹਰਖੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਉਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: taisaa harakh taisaa us sog ||
english: As is joy, so is sorrow to him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਤਹ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d tah nahee biog ||
english: He is in eternal bliss, and is not separated from God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸਾ ਸੁਵਰਨੁ ਤੈਸੀ ਉਸੁ ਮਾਟੀ ॥
transliteration: taisaa suvaran taisee us maatee ||
english: As is gold, so is dust to him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤੈਸੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਟੀ ॥
transliteration: taisaa a(n)mrit taisee bikh khaatee ||
english: As is ambrosial nectar, so is bitter poison to him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: taisaa maan taisaa abhimaan ||
english: As is honor, so is dishonor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਰਾਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: taisaa ra(n)k taisaa raajaan ||
english: As is the beggar, so is the king.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਵਰਤਾਏ ਸਾਈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jo varataae saaee jugat ||
english: Whatever God ordains, that is his way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak ohu purakh kaheeai jeevan mukat ||7||
english: O Nanak, that being is known as Jivan Mukta. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham ke sagale thaau ||
english: All places belong to the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit jit ghar raakhai taisaa tin naau ||
english: According to the homes in which they are placed, so are His creatures named.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: aape karan karaavan jog ||
english: He Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh bhaavai soee phun hog ||
english: Whatever pleases God, ultimately comes to pass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਸਰਿਓ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: pasario aap hoi anat tara(n)g ||
english: He Himself is All-pervading, in endless waves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: lakhe na jaahi paarabraham ke ra(n)g ||
english: The playful sport of the Supreme Lord God cannot be known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਤੈਸਾ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jaisee mat dei taisaa paragaas ||
english: As the understanding is given, so is one enlightened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham karataa abinaas ||
english: The Supreme Lord God, the Creator, is eternal and everlasting.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa sadaa daiaal ||
english: Forever, forever and ever, He is merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੮॥੯॥
transliteration: simar simar naanak bhae nihaal ||8||9||
english: Remembering Him, remembering Him in meditation, O Nanak, one is blessed with ecstasy. ||8||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: usatat karahi anek jan a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: Many people praise the Lord. He has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਚਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਚੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak rachanaa prabh rachee bahu bidh anik prakaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, God created the creation, with its many ways and various species. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਹੋਏ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot hoe poojaaree ||
english: Many millions are His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਆਚਾਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot aachaar biuhaaree ||
english: Many millions perform religious rituals and worldly duties.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਭਏ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot bhae teerath vaasee ||
english: Many millions become dwellers at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot ban bhramahi udaasee ||
english: Many millions wander as renunciates in the wilderness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਬੇਦ ਕੇ ਸ੍ਰੋਤੇ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot bed ke srote ||
english: Many millions listen to the Vedas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਤਪੀਸੁਰ ਹੋਤੇ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot tapeesur hote ||
english: Many millions become austere penitents.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਆਤਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਾਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot aatam dhiaan dhaarahi ||
english: Many millions enshrine meditation within their souls.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਬਿ ਕਾਬਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot kab kaab beechaarahi ||
english: Many millions of poets contemplate Him through poetry.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਵਤਨ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot navatan naam dhiaavahi ||
english: Many millions meditate on His eternally new Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak karate kaa a(n)t na paavahi ||1||
english: O Nanak, none can find the limits of the Creator. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਭਏ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot bhae abhimaanee ||
english: Many millions become self-centered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਅੰਧ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot a(n)dh agiaanee ||
english: Many millions are blinded by ignorance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਠੋਰ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot kirapan kathor ||
english: Many millions are stone-hearted misers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਭਿਗ ਆਤਮ ਨਿਕੋਰ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot abhig aatam nikor ||
english: Many millions are heartless, with dry, withered souls.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਕਉ ਹਿਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot par darab kau hirahi ||
english: Many millions steal the wealth of others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot par dookhanaa karahi ||
english: Many millions slander others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot maaiaa sram maahi ||
english: Many millions struggle in Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਦੇਸ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot parades bhramaahi ||
english: Many millions wander in foreign lands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jit jit laavahu tit tit laganaa ||
english: Whatever God attaches them to - with that they are engaged.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak karate kee jaanai karataa rachanaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Creator alone knows the workings of His creation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਸਿਧ ਜਤੀ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot sidh jatee jogee ||
english: Many millions are Siddhas, celibates and Yogis.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot raaje ras bhogee ||
english: Many millions are kings, enjoying worldly pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪੰਖੀ ਸਰਪ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot pa(n)khee sarap upaae ||
english: Many millions of birds and snakes have been created.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਨਿਪਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot paathar birakh nipajaae ||
english: Many millions of stones and trees have been produced.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot pavan paanee baisa(n)tar ||
english: Many millions are the winds, waters and fires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੇਸ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot des bhoo ma(n)dal ||
english: Many millions are the countries and realms of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਸੂਰ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot saseear soor nakhytr ||
english: Many millions are the moons, suns and stars.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot dev daanav i(n)dr sir chhatr ||
english: Many millions are the demi-gods, demons and Indras, under their regal canopies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਅਪਨੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sagal samagree apanai soot dhaarai ||
english: He has strung the entire creation upon His thread.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak jis jis bhaavai tis tis nisataarai ||3||
english: O Nanak, He emancipates those with whom He is pleased. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਰਾਜਸ ਤਾਮਸ ਸਾਤਕ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot raajas taamas saatak ||
english: Many millions abide in heated activity, slothful darkness and peaceful light.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਸਾਸਤ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot bed puraan simrit ar saasat ||
english: Many millions are the Vedas, Puraanas, Simritees and Shaastras.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਰਤਨ ਸਮੁਦ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot keee ratan samud ||
english: Many millions are the pearls of the oceans.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਜੰਤ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot naanaa prakaar ja(n)t ||
english: Many millions are the beings of so many descriptions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਚਿਰ ਜੀਵੇ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot keee chir jeeve ||
english: Many millions are made long-lived.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਗਿਰੀ ਮੇਰ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਥੀਵੇ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot giree mer suvaran theeve ||
english: Many millions of hills and mountains have been made of gold.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਖੵ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਪਿਸਾਚ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot jakhy ki(n)nar pisaach ||
english: Many millions are the Yakhshas - the servants of the god of wealth, the Kinnars - the gods of celestial music, and the evil spirits of the Pisaach.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਸੂਕਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਾਚ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot bhoot pret sookar mrigaach ||
english: Many millions are the evil nature-spirits, ghosts, pigs and tigers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਭਹੂ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh te nerai sabhahoo te door ||
english: He is near to all, and yet far from all;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak aap alipat rahiaa bharapoor ||4||
english: O Nanak, He Himself remains distinct, while yet pervading all. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਕੇ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot paataal ke vaasee ||
english: Many millions inhabit the nether regions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot narak surag nivaasee ||
english: Many millions dwell in heaven and hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot janamahi jeevahi marahi ||
english: Many millions are born, live and die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot bahu jonee phirahi ||
english: Many millions are reincarnated, over and over again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਬੈਠਤ ਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot baithat hee khaahi ||
english: Many millions eat while sitting at ease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਘਾਲਹਿ ਥਕਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot ghaalahi thak paahi ||
english: Many millions are exhausted by their labors.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਧਨਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot keee dhanava(n)t ||
english: Many millions are created wealthy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਚਿੰਤ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot maaiaa mahi chi(n)t ||
english: Many millions are anxiously involved in Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
transliteration: jah jah bhaanaa tah tah raakhe ||
english: Wherever He wills, there He keeps us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਹਾਥੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak sabh kichh prabh kai haathe ||5||
english: O Nanak, everything is in the Hands of God. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਭਏ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot bhae bairaagee ||
english: Many millions become Bairaagees, who renounce the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: raam naam sa(n)g tin liv laagee ||
english: They have attached themselves to the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਖੋਜੰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot prabh kau khoja(n)te ||
english: Many millions are searching for God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲਹੰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: aatam mahi paarabraham laha(n)te ||
english: Within their souls, they find the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot darasan prabh piaas ||
english: Many millions thirst for the Blessing of God's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: tin kau milio prabh abinaas ||
english: They meet with God, the Eternal.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot maagahi satasa(n)g ||
english: Many millions pray for the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਿਨ ਲਾਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham tin laagaa ra(n)g ||
english: They are imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
transliteration: jin kau hoe aap suprasa(n)n ||
english: Those with whom He Himself is pleased,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak te jan sadaa dhan dha(n)n ||6||
english: O Nanak, are blessed, forever blessed. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਅਰੁ ਖੰਡ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot khaanee ar kha(n)d ||
english: Many millions are the fields of creation and the galaxies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot akaas brahama(n)d ||
english: Many millions are the etheric skies and the solar systems.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਹੋਏ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot hoe avataar ||
english: Many millions are the divine incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kaee jugat keeno bisathaar ||
english: In so many ways, He has unfolded Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਬਾਰ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਪਾਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kaee baar pasario paasaar ||
english: So many times, He has expanded His expansion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਇਕੁ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa ik eka(n)kaar ||
english: Forever and ever, He is the One, the One Universal Creator.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot keene bahu bhaat ||
english: Many millions are created in various forms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh te hoe prabh maahi samaat ||
english: From God they emanate, and into God they merge once again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: taa kaa a(n)t na jaanai koi ||
english: His limits are not known to anyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aape aap naanak prabh soi ||7||
english: Of Himself, and by Himself, O Nanak, God exists. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot paarabraham ke daas ||
english: Many millions are the servants of the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਆਤਮ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: tin hovat aatam paragaas ||
english: Their souls are enlightened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਤਤ ਕੇ ਬੇਤੇ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot tat ke bete ||
english: Many millions know the essence of reality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਰਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa nihaarahi eko netre ||
english: Their eyes gaze forever on the One alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot naam ras peevahi ||
english: Many millions drink in the essence of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰ ਭਏ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: amar bhae sad sad hee jeevahi ||
english: They become immortal; they live forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaee kot naam gun gaavahi ||
english: Many millions sing the Glorious Praises of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਸਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aatam ras sukh sahaj samaavahi ||
english: They are absorbed in intuitive peace and pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: apune jan kau saas saas samaare ||
english: He remembers His servants with each and every breath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਇ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੮॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak oi paramesur ke piaare ||8||10||
english: O Nanak, they are the beloveds of the Transcendent Lord God. ||8||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran prabh ek hai doosar naahee koi ||
english: God alone is the Doer of deeds - there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tis balihaaranai jal thal maheeal soi ||1||
english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the One, who pervades the waters, the lands, the sky and all space. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan karanai jog ||
english: The Doer, the Cause of causes, is potent to do anything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee hog ||
english: That which pleases Him, comes to pass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi thaap uthaapanahaaraa ||
english: In an instant, He creates and destroys.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t nahee kichh paaraavaaraa ||
english: He has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਧਰ ਰਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hukame dhaar adhar rahaavai ||
english: By His Order, He established the earth, and He maintains it unsupported.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hukame upajai hukam samaavai ||
english: By His Order, the world was created; by His Order, it shall merge again into Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hukame ooch neech biuhaar ||
english: By His Order, one's occupation is high or low.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਪਰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hukame anik ra(n)g parakaar ||
english: By His Order, there are so many colors and forms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kar kar dekhai apanee vadiaaee ||
english: Having created the Creation, He beholds His own greatness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sabh mahi rahiaa samaaee ||1||
english: O Nanak, He is pervading in all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh bhaavai maanukh gat paavai ||
english: If it pleases God, one attains salvation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਥਰ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh bhaavai taa paathar taraavai ||
english: If it pleases God, then even stones can swim.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਸ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh bhaavai bin saas te raakhai ||
english: If it pleases God, the body is preserved, even without the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh bhaavai taa har gun bhaakhai ||
english: If it pleases God, then one chants the Lord's Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh bhaavai taa patit udhaarai ||
english: If it pleases God, then even sinners are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੈ ਆਪਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aap karai aapan beechaarai ||
english: He Himself acts, and He Himself contemplates.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: duhaa siriaa kaa aap suaamee ||
english: He Himself is the Master of both worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਲੈ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: khelai bigasai a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: He plays and He enjoys; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo bhaavai so kaar karaavai ||
english: As He wills, He causes actions to be done.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak drisatee avar na aavai ||2||
english: Nanak sees no other than Him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kahu maanukh te kiaa hoi aavai ||
english: Tell me - what can a mere mortal do?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karaavai ||
english: Whatever pleases God is what He causes us to do.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: is kai haath hoi taa sabh kichh lei ||
english: If it were in our hands, we would grab up everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karei ||
english: Whatever pleases God - that is what He does.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਜਾਨਤ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਰਚੈ ॥
transliteration: anajaanat bikhiaa mahi rachai ||
english: Through ignorance, people are engrossed in corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਾਨਤ ਆਪਨ ਆਪ ਬਚੈ ॥
transliteration: je jaanat aapan aap bachai ||
english: If they knew better, they would save themselves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bharame bhoolaa dah dis dhaavai ||
english: Deluded by doubt, they wander around in the ten directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nimakh maahi chaar ku(n)t phir aavai ||
english: In an instant, their minds go around the four corners of the world and come back again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis apanee bhagat dei ||
english: Those whom the Lord mercifully blesses with His devotional worship

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੇਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak te jan naam milei ||3||
english: - O Nanak, they are absorbed into the Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨੀਚ ਕੀਟ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi neech keet kau raaj ||
english: In an instant, the lowly worm is transformed into a king.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham gareeb nivaaj ||
english: The Supreme Lord God is the Protector of the humble.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa drisat kachhoo na aavai ||
english: Even one who has never been seen at all,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tis tatakaal dah dis pragataavai ||
english: becomes instantly famous in the ten directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰੈ ਬਖਸੀਸ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau apunee karai bakhasees ||
english: And that one upon whom He bestows His blessings

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਨ ਗਨੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
transliteration: taa kaa lekhaa na ganai jagadees ||
english: the Lord of the world does not hold him to his account.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis kee raas ||
english: Soul and body are all His property.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat pooran braham pragaas ||
english: Each and every heart is illuminated by the Perfect Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਬਣਤ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: apanee banat aap banaaee ||
english: He Himself fashioned His own handiwork.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak jeevai dekh badaaee ||4||
english: Nanak lives by beholding His greatness. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: is kaa bal naahee is haath ||
english: There is no power in the hands of mortal beings;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan sarab ko naath ||
english: the Doer, the Cause of causes is the Lord of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aagiaakaaree bapuraa jeeu ||
english: The helpless beings are subject to His Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਥੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee phun theeu ||
english: That which pleases Him, ultimately comes to pass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੈ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo ooch neech mahi basai ||
english: Sometimes, they abide in exaltation; sometimes, they are depressed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਸੈ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo sog harakh ra(n)g hasai ||
english: Sometimes, they are sad, and sometimes they laugh with joy and delight.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਨਿੰਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo ni(n)d chi(n)d biuhaar ||
english: Sometimes, they are occupied with slander and anxiety.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਊਭ ਅਕਾਸ ਪਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo oobh akaas paiaal ||
english: Sometimes, they are high in the Akaashic Ethers, sometimes in the nether regions of the underworld.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਬੇਤਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo betaa braham beechaar ||
english: Sometimes, they know the contemplation of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak aap milaavanahaar ||5||
english: O Nanak, God Himself unites them with Himself. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo nirat karai bahu bhaat ||
english: Sometimes, they dance in various ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo soi rahai din raat ||
english: Sometimes, they remain asleep day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਮਹਾ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo mahaa krodh bikaraal ||
english: Sometimes, they are awesome, in terrible rage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂੰ ਸਰਬ ਕੀ ਹੋਤ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo(n) sarab kee hot ravaal ||
english: Sometimes, they are the dust of the feet of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਹੋਇ ਬਹੈ ਬਡ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo hoi bahai bad raajaa ||
english: Sometimes, they sit as great kings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੁ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਨੀਚ ਕਾ ਸਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: kabahu bhekhaaree neech kaa saajaa ||
english: Sometimes, they wear the coat of a lowly beggar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਅਪਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo apakeerat mahi aavai ||
english: Sometimes, they come to have evil reputations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਭਲਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo bhalaa bhalaa kahaavai ||
english: Sometimes, they are known as very, very good.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu prabh raakhai tiv hee rahai ||
english: As God keeps them, so they remain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak sach kahai ||6||
english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the Truth is told. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਹੋਇ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਬਖੵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo hoi pa(n)dit kare bakhyaan ||
english: Sometimes, as scholars, they deliver lectures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਮੋਨਿਧਾਰੀ ਲਾਵੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo monidhaaree laavai dhiaan ||
english: Sometimes, they hold to silence in deep meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo tat teerath isanaan ||
english: Sometimes, they take cleansing baths at places of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo sidh saadhik mukh giaan ||
english: Sometimes, as Siddhas or seekers, they impart spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo keet hasat pata(n)g hoi jeeaa ||
english: Sometimes, they becomes worms, elephants, or moths.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਰਮੈ ਭਰਮੀਆ ॥
transliteration: anik jon bharamai bharameeaa ||
english: They may wander and roam through countless incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਜਿਉ ਸ੍ਵਾਗੀ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naanaa roop jiu svaagee dikhaavai ||
english: In various costumes, like actors, they appear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਨਚਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu prabh bhaavai tivai nachaavai ||
english: As it pleases God, they dance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee hoi ||
english: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak doojaa avar na koi ||7||
english: O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo saadhasa(n)gat ihu paavai ||
english: Sometimes, this being attains the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸੁ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: us asathaan te bahur na aavai ||
english: From that place, he does not have to come back again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਗਿਆਨ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar hoi giaan paragaas ||
english: The light of spiritual wisdom dawns within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸੁ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: us asathaan kaa nahee binaas ||
english: That place does not perish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: man tan naam rate ik ra(n)g ||
english: The mind and body are imbued with the Love of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਬਸਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa basahi paarabraham kai sa(n)g ||
english: He dwells forever with the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਲੁ ਆਇ ਖਟਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu jal mahi jal aai khataanaa ||
english: As water comes to blend with water,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਜੋਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tiu jotee sa(n)g jot samaanaa ||
english: his light blends into the Light.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਗਵਨ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mit gae gavan paae bisraam ||
english: Reincarnation is ended, and eternal peace is found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੮॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak prabh kai sad kurabaan ||8||11||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to God. ||8||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੀ ਬਸੈ ਮਸਕੀਨੀਆ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਤਲੇ ॥
transliteration: sukhee basai masakeeneeaa aap nivaar tale ||
english: The humble beings abide in peace; subduing egotism, they are meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਡੇ ਬਡੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bade bade aha(n)kaareeaa naanak garab gale ||1||
english: The very proud and arrogant persons, O Nanak, are consumed by their own pride. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਾਜ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jis kai a(n)tar raaj abhimaan ||
english: One who has the pride of power within,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਰਕਪਾਤੀ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੁਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: so narakapaatee hovat suaan ||
english: shall dwell in hell, and become a dog.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੈ ਜੋਬਨਵੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jo jaanai mai jobanava(n)t ||
english: One who deems himself to have the beauty of youth,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹੋਵਤ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਜੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: so hovat bisataa kaa ja(n)t ||
english: shall become a maggot in manure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਕਰਮਵੰਤੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aapas kau karamava(n)t kahaavai ||
english: One who claims to act virtuously,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: janam marai bahu jon bhramaavai ||
english: shall live and die, wandering through countless reincarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: dhan bhoom kaa jo karai gumaan ||
english: One who takes pride in wealth and lands

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: so moorakh a(n)dhaa agiaan ||
english: is a fool, blind and ignorant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis kai hiradai gareebee basaavai ||
english: One whose heart is mercifully blessed with abiding humility,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਈਹਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak eehaa mukat aagai sukh paavai ||1||
english: O Nanak, is liberated here, and obtains peace hereafter. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਗਰਬਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dhanava(n)taa hoi kar garabaavai ||
english: One who becomes wealthy and takes pride in it

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: trin samaan kachh sa(n)g na jaavai ||
english: not even a piece of straw shall go along with him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਲਸਕਰ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: bahu lasakar maanukh oopar kare aas ||
english: He may place his hopes on a large army of men,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: pal bheetar taa kaa hoi binaas ||
english: but he shall vanish in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਆਪ ਜਾਨੈ ਬਲਵੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh te aap jaanai balava(n)t ||
english: One who deems himself to be the strongest of all,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ਭਸਮੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi hoi jaai bhasama(n)t ||
english: in an instant, shall be reduced to ashes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਬਦੈ ਆਪਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kisai na badai aap aha(n)kaaree ||
english: One who thinks of no one else except his own prideful self

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: dharam raai tis kare khuaaree ||
english: the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall expose his disgrace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad jaa kaa mitai abhimaan ||
english: One who, by Guru's Grace, eliminates his ego,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so jan naanak daragah paravaan ||2||
english: O Nanak, becomes acceptable in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਹਉ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kot karam karai hau dhaare ||
english: If someone does millions of good deeds, while acting in ego,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਬਿਰਥਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sram paavai sagale birathaare ||
english: he shall incur only trouble; all this is in vain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਤਪਸਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: anik tapasiaa kare aha(n)kaar ||
english: If someone performs great penance, while acting in selfishness and conceit,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: narak surag phir phir avataar ||
english: he shall be reincarnated into heaven and hell, over and over again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਨਹੀ ਦ੍ਰਵੈ ॥
transliteration: anik jatan kar aatam nahee dravai ||
english: He makes all sorts of efforts, but his soul is still not softened

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਗਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har daragah kahu kaise gavai ||
english: how can he go to the Court of the Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਭਲਾ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aapas kau jo bhalaa kahaavai ||
english: One who calls himself good

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਭਲਾਈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tisahi bhalaaee nikat na aavai ||
english: goodness shall not draw near him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sarab kee ren jaa kaa man hoi ||
english: One whose mind is the dust of all

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak taa kee niramal soi ||3||
english: - says Nanak, his reputation is spotlessly pure. ||3||
