author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jab lag jaanai mujh te kachh hoi ||
english: As long as someone thinks that he is the one who acts,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tab is kau sukh naahee koi ||
english: he shall have no peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਹ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jab ih jaanai mai kichh karataa ||
english: As long as this mortal thinks that he is the one who does things,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tab lag garabh jon mahi phirataa ||
english: he shall wander in reincarnation through the womb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਧਾਰੈ ਕੋਊ ਬੈਰੀ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jab dhaarai kooo bairee meet ||
english: As long as he considers one an enemy, and another a friend,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: tab lag nihachal naahee cheet ||
english: his mind shall not come to rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jab lag moh magan sa(n)g maai ||
english: As long as he is intoxicated with attachment to Maya,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tab lag dharam raai dei sajaai ||
english: the Righteous Judge shall punish him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kirapaa te ba(n)dhan tootai ||
english: By God's Grace, his bonds are shattered;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak hau chhootai ||4||
english: by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, his ego is eliminated. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਖਟੇ ਲਖ ਕਉ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sahas khate lakh kau uth dhaavai ||
english: Earning a thousand, he runs after a hundred thousand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tripat na aavai maaiaa paachhai paavai ||
english: Satisfaction is not obtained by chasing after Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: anik bhog bikhiaa ke karai ||
english: He may enjoy all sorts of corrupt pleasures,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: nah tripataavai khap khap marai ||
english: but he is still not satisfied; he indulges again and again, wearing himself out, until he dies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਾ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਊ ਰਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: binaa sa(n)tokh nahee kooo raajai ||
english: Without contentment, no one is satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: supan manorath brithe sabh kaajai ||
english: Like the objects in a dream, all his efforts are in vain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naam ra(n)g sarab sukh hoi ||
english: Through the love of the Naam, all peace is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: badabhaagee kisai paraapat hoi ||
english: Only a few obtain this, by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan aape aap ||
english: He Himself is Himself the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa naanak har jaap ||5||
english: Forever and ever, O Nanak, chant the Lord's Name. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan karanaihaar ||
english: The Doer, the Cause of causes, is the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਕਹਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: is kai haath kahaa beechaar ||
english: What deliberations are in the hands of mortal beings?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੇ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaisee drisat kare taisaa hoi ||
english: As God casts His Glance of Grace, they come to be.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape aap aap prabh soi ||
english: God Himself, of Himself, is unto Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੁ ਅਪਨੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh keeno s apanai ra(n)g ||
english: Whatever He created, was by His Own Pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ਸਭਹੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh te door sabhahoo kai sa(n)g ||
english: He is far from all, and yet with all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
transliteration: boojhai dekhai karai bibek ||
english: He understands, He sees, and He passes judgment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਏਕ ਆਪਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
transliteration: aapahi ek aapahi anek ||
english: He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: marai na binasai aavai na jaai ||
english: He does not die or perish; He does not come or go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak sad hee rahiaa samaai ||6||
english: O Nanak, He remains forever All-pervading. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਸਮਝੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aap upadesai samajhai aap ||
english: He Himself instructs, and He Himself learns.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਚਿਆ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: aape rachiaa sabh kai saath ||
english: He Himself mingles with all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਆਪਨ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aap keeno aapan bisathaar ||
english: He Himself created His own expanse.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh kachh us kaa ohu karanaihaar ||
english: All things are His; He is the Creator.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: us te bhi(n)n kahahu kichh hoi ||
english: Without Him, what could be done?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar ekai soi ||
english: In the spaces and interspaces, He is the One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਚਲਿਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: apune chalit aap karanaihaar ||
english: In His own play, He Himself is the Actor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਤਕ ਕਰੈ ਰੰਗ ਆਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kautak karai ra(n)g aapaar ||
english: He produces His plays with infinite variety.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: man mahi aap man apune maahi ||
english: He Himself is in the mind, and the mind is in Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak keemat kahan na jaai ||7||
english: O Nanak, His worth cannot be estimated. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: sat sat sat prabh suaamee ||
english: True, True, True is God, our Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਖਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad kinai vakhiaanee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, some speak of Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sach sach sach sabh keenaa ||
english: True, True, True is the Creator of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਬਿਰਲੈ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kot madhe kinai biralai cheenaa ||
english: Out of millions, scarcely anyone knows Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਲਾ ਭਲਾ ਭਲਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: bhalaa bhalaa bhalaa teraa roop ||
english: Beautiful, Beautiful, Beautiful is Your Sublime Form.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
transliteration: at su(n)dar apaar anoop ||
english: You are Exquisitely Beautiful, Infinite and Incomparable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: niramal niramal niramal teree baanee ||
english: Pure, Pure, Pure is the Word of Your Bani,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੁਨੀ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਖੵਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat sunee sravan bakhyaanee ||
english: heard in each and every heart, spoken to the ears.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: pavitr pavitr pavitr puneet ||
english: Holy, Holy, Holy and Sublimely Pure

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naam japai naanak man preet ||8||12||
english: - chant the Naam, O Nanak, with heart-felt love. ||8||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਉਧਰਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t saran jo jan parai so jan udharanahaar ||
english: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints shall be saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kee ni(n)daa naanakaa bahur bahur avataar ||1||
english: One who slanders the Saints, O Nanak, shall be reincarnated over and over again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਆਰਜਾ ਘਟੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai dookhan aarajaa ghatai ||
english: Slandering the Saints, one's life is cut short.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai dookhan jam te nahee chhutai ||
english: Slandering the Saints, one shall not escape the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai dookhan sukh sabh jaai ||
english: Slandering the Saints, all happiness vanishes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai dookhan narak mahi paai ||
english: Slandering the Saints, one falls into hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਲੀਨ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai dookhan mat hoi maleen ||
english: Slandering the Saints, the intellect is polluted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੇ ਹੀਨ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai dookhan sobhaa te heen ||
english: Slandering the Saints, one's reputation is lost.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਹਤੇ ਕਉ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ke hate kau rakhai na koi ||
english: One who is cursed by a Saint cannot be saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਥਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਸਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai dookhan thaan bhrasat hoi ||
english: Slandering the Saints, one's place is defiled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kripaal kripaa je karai ||
english: But if the Compassionate Saint shows His Kindness,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਭੀ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)tasa(n)g ni(n)dak bhee tarai ||1||
english: O Nanak, in the Company of the Saints, the slanderer may still be saved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੂਖਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਖੁ ਭਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ke dookhan te mukh bhavai ||
english: Slandering the Saints, one becomes a wry-faced malcontent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਕਾਗ ਜਿਉ ਲਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kai dookhan kaag jiu lavai ||
english: Slandering the Saints, one croaks like a raven.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸਰਪ ਜੋਨਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kai dookhan sarap jon paai ||
english: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a snake.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਿਰਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai dookhan trigad jon kiramaai ||
english: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a wiggling worm.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਲੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kai dookhan trisanaa mahi jalai ||
english: Slandering the Saints, one burns in the fire of desire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਛਲੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai dookhan sabh ko chhalai ||
english: Slandering the Saints, one tries to deceive everyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਤੇਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai dookhan tej sabh jaai ||
english: Slandering the Saints, all one's influence vanishes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਨੀਚਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai dookhan neech neechaai ||
english: Slandering the Saints, one becomes the lowest of the low.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਾ ਥਾਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t dokhee kaa thaau ko naahi ||
english: For the slanderer of the Saint, there is no place of rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਓਇ ਭੀ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa oi bhee gat paahi ||2||
english: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, even then, he may be saved. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਮਹਾ ਅਤਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dak mahaa atataaee ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is the worst evil-doer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਟਿਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dak khin tikan na paaee ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint has not even a moment's rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਮਹਾ ਹਤਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dak mahaa hatiaaraa ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is a brutal butcher.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਿ ਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dak paramesur maaraa ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is cursed by the Transcendent Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਹੀਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dak raaj te heen ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint has no kingdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਅਰੁ ਦੀਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dak dukheeaa ar deen ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint becomes miserable and poor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ke ni(n)dak kau sarab rog ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint contracts all diseases.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ke ni(n)dak kau sadaa bijog ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is forever separated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਖ ਮਹਿ ਦੋਖੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kee ni(n)daa dokh mahi dokh ||
english: To slander a Saint is the worst sin of sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਭੀ ਹੋਇ ਮੋਖੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa us kaa bhee hoi mokh ||3||
english: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even this one may be liberated. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਦਾ ਅਪਵਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee sadaa apavit ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is forever impure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee kisai kaa nahee mit ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is nobody's friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਡਾਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ke dokhee kau daan laagai ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint shall be punished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ke dokhee kau sabh tiaagai ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is abandoned by all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਮਹਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee mahaa aha(n)kaaree ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is totally egocentric.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee sadaa bikaaree ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is forever corrupt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਜਨਮੈ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee janamai marai ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint must endure birth and death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kee dookhanaa sukh te tarai ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ke dokhee kau naahee thaau ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint has no place of rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa lae milaai ||4||
english: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even such a one may merge in union. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਅਧ ਬੀਚ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee adh beech te tootai ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint breaks down mid-way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee kitai kaaj na pahoochai ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint cannot accomplish his tasks.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ke dokhee kau udiaan bhramaaeeai ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint wanders in the wilderness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee ujhaR paaeeai ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is misled into desolation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਅੰਤਰ ਤੇ ਥੋਥਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee a(n)tar te thothaa ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is empty inside,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਸ ਬਿਨਾ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕੀ ਲੋਥਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu saas binaa miratak kee lothaa ||
english: like the corpse of a dead man, without the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ ਜੜ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ke dokhee kee jaR kichh naahi ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint has no heritage at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aapan beej aape hee khaahi ||
english: He himself must eat what he has planted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ke dokhee kau avar na raakhanahaar ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint cannot be saved by anyone else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa lae ubaar ||5||
english: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even he may be saved. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਇਉ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee iu bilalaai ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint bewails like this

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤੜਫੜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jiu jal bihoon machhulee taRaphaRaai ||
english: like a fish, out of water, writhing in agony.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਭੂਖਾ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee bhookhaa nahee raajai ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is hungry and is never satisfied,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਈਧਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu paavak eedhan nahee dhraapai ||
english: as fire is not satisfied by fuel.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਛੁਟੈ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee chhutai ikelaa ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is left all alone,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੂਆੜੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਖੇਤ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu booaaR til khet maahi duhelaa ||
english: like the miserable barren sesame stalk abandoned in the field.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਧਰਮ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee dharam te rahat ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of faith.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਦ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਹਤ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee sad mithiaa kahat ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint constantly lies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਹੀ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kirat ni(n)dak kaa dhur hee paiaa ||
english: The fate of the slanderer is pre-ordained from the very beginning of time.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaavai soee thiaa ||6||
english: O Nanak, whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਬਿਗੜ ਰੂਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee bigaR roop hoi jaai ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint becomes deformed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ke dokhee kau daragah milai sajaai ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint receives his punishment in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਕਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee sadaa sahakaaeeai ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint is eternally in limbo.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੀਵਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee na marai na jeevaaeeai ||
english: He does not die, but he does not live either.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ke dokhee kee pujai na aasaa ||
english: The hopes of the slanderer of the Saint are not fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee uth chalai niraasaa ||
english: The slanderer of the Saint departs disappointed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੋਖਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai dokh na trisatai koi ||
english: Slandering the Saint, no one attains satisfaction.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa bhaavai taisaa koee hoi ||
english: As it pleases the Lord, so do people become;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਇਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: paiaa kirat na metai koi ||
english: no one can erase their past actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak jaanai sachaa soi ||7||
english: O Nanak, the True Lord alone knows all. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh ghat tis ke ohu karanaihaar ||
english: All hearts are His; He is the Creator.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa tis kau namasakaar ||
english: Forever and ever, I bow to Him in reverence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee usatat karahu din raat ||
english: Praise God, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: tisahi dhiaavahu saas giraas ||
english: Meditate on Him with every breath and morsel of food.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh kachh varatai tis kaa keeaa ||
english: Everything happens as He wills.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋ ਥੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa kare taisaa ko theeaa ||
english: As He wills, so people become.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: apanaa khel aap karanaihaar ||
english: He Himself is the play, and He Himself is the actor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਸਰ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: doosar kaun kahai beechaar ||
english: Who else can speak or deliberate upon this?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: jis no kripaa karai tis aapan naam dei ||
english: He Himself gives His Name to those, upon whom He bestows His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਸੇਇ ॥੮॥੧੩॥
transliteration: badabhaagee naanak jan sei ||8||13||
english: Very fortunate, O Nanak, are those people. ||8||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਹੁ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸੁਰਿ ਜਨਹੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tajahu siaanap sur janahu simarahu har har raai ||
english: Give up your cleverness, good people - remember the Lord God, your King!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek aas har man rakhahu naanak dookh bharam bhau jaai ||1||
english: Enshrine in your heart, your hopes in the One Lord. O Nanak, your pain, doubt and fear shall depart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: maanukh kee tek brithee sabh jaan ||
english: Reliance on mortals is in vain - know this well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਨ ਕਉ ਏਕੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: devan kau ekai bhagavaan ||
english: The Great Giver is the One Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਦੀਐ ਰਹੈ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis kai deeai rahai aghaai ||
english: By His gifts, we are satisfied,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: bahur na trisanaa laagai aai ||
english: and we suffer from thirst no longer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਖੈ ਏਕੋ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: maarai raakhai eko aap ||
english: The One Lord Himself destroys and also preserves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: maanukh kai kichh naahee haath ||
english: Nothing at all is in the hands of mortal beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa hukam boojh sukh hoi ||
english: Understanding His Order, there is peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa naam rakh ka(n)th paroi ||
english: So take His Name, and wear it as your necklace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: simar simar simar prabh soi ||
english: Remember, remember, remember God in meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bighan na laagai koi ||1||
english: O Nanak, no obstacle shall stand in your way. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: usatat man mahi kar nira(n)kaar ||
english: Praise the Formless Lord in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kar man mere sat biuhaar ||
english: O my mind, make this your true occupation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
transliteration: niramal rasanaa a(n)mrit peeu ||
english: Let your tongue become pure, drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa suhelaa kar lehi jeeu ||
english: Your soul shall be forever peaceful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਪੇਖੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: nainahu pekh thaakur kaa ra(n)g ||
english: With your eyes, see the wondrous play of your Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਭ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g binasai sabh sa(n)g ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, all other associations vanish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਚਲਉ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: charan chalau maarag gobi(n)d ||
english: With your feet, walk in the Way of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: mitahi paap japeeai har bi(n)d ||
english: Sins are washed away, chanting the Lord's Name, even for a moment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ॥
transliteration: kar har karam sravan har kathaa ||
english: So do the Lord's Work, and listen to the Lord's Sermon.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਊਜਲ ਮਥਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har daragah naanak oojal mathaa ||2||
english: In the Lord's Court, O Nanak, your face shall be radiant. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: badabhaagee te jan jag maahi ||
english: Very fortunate are those humble beings in this world,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa har ke gun gaahi ||
english: who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: raam naam jo karahi beechaar ||
english: Those who dwell upon the Lord's Name,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਗਨੀ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: se dhanava(n)t ganee sa(n)saar ||
english: are the most wealthy and prosperous in the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖੀ ॥
transliteration: man tan mukh bolahi har mukhee ||
english: Those who speak of the Supreme Lord in thought, word and deed

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa jaanahu te sukhee ||
english: know that they are peaceful and happy, forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: eko ek ek pachhaanai ||
english: One who recognizes the One and only Lord as One,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕੀ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: it ut kee ohu sojhee jaanai ||
english: understands this world and the next.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naam sa(n)g jis kaa man maaniaa ||
english: One whose mind accepts the Company of the Naam,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak tinahi nira(n)jan jaaniaa ||3||
english: the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, knows the Immaculate Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad aapan aap sujhai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one understands himself;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
transliteration: tis kee jaanahu trisanaa bujhai ||
english: know that then, his thirst is quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har har jas kahat ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, one chants the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ਤੇ ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਹਤ ॥
transliteration: sarab rog te ohu har jan rahat ||
english: Such a devotee of the Lord is free of all disease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਬਖੵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: anadin keeratan keval bakhyaan ||
english: Night and day, sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: grihasat mahi soee nirabaan ||
english: In the midst of your household, remain balanced and unattached.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: ek oopar jis jan kee aasaa ||
english: One who places his hopes in the One Lord

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: tis kee kateeai jam kee phaasaa ||
english: the noose of Death is cut away from his neck.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਭੂਖ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham kee jis man bhookh ||
english: One whose mind hungers for the Supreme Lord God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਦੂਖ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak tisahi na laagahi dookh ||4||
english: O Nanak, shall not suffer pain. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jis kau har prabh man chit aavai ||
english: One who focuses his conscious mind on the Lord God

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਡੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so sa(n)t suhelaa nahee dulaavai ||
english: - that Saint is at peace; he does not waver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jis prabh apunaa kirapaa karai ||
english: Those unto whom God has granted His Grace

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਡਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so sevak kahu kis te darai ||
english: who do those servants need to fear?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਸਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa saa taisaa drisataaiaa ||
english: As God is, so does He appear;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: apune kaaraj mahi aap samaaiaa ||
english: in His Own creation, He Himself is pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਸੀਝਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sodhat sodhat sodhat seejhiaa ||
english: Searching, searching, searching, and finally, success!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਬੂਝਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad tat sabh boojhiaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the essence of all reality is understood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਬ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jab dekhau tab sabh kichh mool ||
english: Wherever I look, there I see Him, at the root of all things.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੂਖਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਅਸਥੂਲੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak so sookham soee asathool ||5||
english: O Nanak, He is the subtle, and He is also the manifest. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਨਮੈ ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: nah kichh janamai nah kichh marai ||
english: Nothing is born, and nothing dies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aapan chalit aap hee karai ||
english: He Himself stages His own drama.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਵਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅਨਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaavan drisat anadrisat ||
english: Coming and going, seen and unseen,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ॥
transliteration: aagiaakaaree dhaaree sabh srisat ||
english: all the world is obedient to His Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਗਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aape aap sagal mahi aap ||
english: He Himself is All-in-Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਰਚਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: anik jugat rach thaap uthaap ||
english: In His many ways, He establishes and disestablishes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਖੰਡ ॥
transliteration: abinaasee naahee kichh kha(n)d ||
english: He is Imperishable; nothing can be broken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਣ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ॥
transliteration: dhaaran dhaar rahio brahama(n)d ||
english: He lends His Support to maintain the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: alakh abhev purakh parataap ||
english: Unfathomable and Inscrutable is the Glory of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਏ ਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਪ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aap japaae ta naanak jaap ||6||
english: As He inspires us to meditate, O Nanak, so do we meditate. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੁ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: jin prabh jaataa s sobhaava(n)t ||
english: Those who know God are glorious.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਤਿਨ ਮੰਤ ॥
transliteration: sagal sa(n)saar udharai tin ma(n)t ||
english: The whole world is redeemed by their teachings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰਨ ॥
transliteration: prabh ke sevak sagal udhaaran ||
english: God's servants redeem all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਨ ॥
transliteration: prabh ke sevak dookh bisaaran ||
english: God's servants cause sorrows to be forgotten.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: aape mel lae kirapaal ||
english: The Merciful Lord unites them with Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਪਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad jap bhae nihaal ||
english: Chanting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they become ecstatic.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋਈ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: un kee sevaa soee laagai ||
english: He alone is committed to serve them,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਡਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jis no kripaa karahi badabhaagai ||
english: upon whom God bestows His Mercy, by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: naam japat paavahi bisraam ||
english: Those who chant the Naam find their place of rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਉ ਊਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak tin purakh kau ootam kar maan ||7||
english: O Nanak, respect those persons as the most noble. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karai s prabh kai ra(n)g ||
english: Whatever you do, do it for the Love of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਬਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa basai har sa(n)g ||
english: Forever and ever, abide with the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sahaj subhaai hovai so hoi ||
english: By its own natural course, whatever will be will be.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: karanaihaar pachhaanai soi ||
english: Acknowledge that Creator Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਨ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh kaa keeaa jan meeth lagaanaa ||
english: God's doings are sweet to His humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਸਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa saa taisaa drisataanaa ||
english: As He is, so does He appear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis te upaje tis maahi samaae ||
english: From Him we came, and into Him we shall merge again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਉਨਹੂ ਬਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: oi sukh nidhaan unahoo ban aae ||
english: He is the treasure of peace, and so does His servant become.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aapas kau aap deeno maan ||
english: Unto His own, He has given His honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੮॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak prabh jan eko jaan ||8||14||
english: O Nanak, know that God and His humble servant are one and the same. ||8||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਨਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sarab kalaa bharapoor prabh birathaa jaananahaar ||
english: God is totally imbued with all powers; He is the Knower of our troubles.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਉਧਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran udhareeai naanak tis balihaar ||1||
english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, we are saved; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੀ ਗਾਢਨਹਾਰ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: tootee gaadhanahaar goupaal ||
english: The Lord of the World is the Mender of the broken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sarab jeeaa aape pratipaal ||
english: He Himself cherishes all beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sagal kee chi(n)taa jis man maahi ||
english: The cares of all are on His Mind;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tis te birathaa koee naahi ||
english: no one is turned away from Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: re man mere sadaa har jaap ||
english: O my mind, meditate forever on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: abinaasee prabh aape aap ||
english: The Imperishable Lord God is Himself All-in-all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aapan keeaa kachhoo na hoi ||
english: By one's own actions, nothing is accomplished,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਲੋਚੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: je sau praanee lochai koi ||
english: even though the mortal may wish it so, hundreds of times.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tis bin naahee terai kichh kaam ||
english: Without Him, nothing is of any use to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gat naanak jap ek har naam ||1||
english: Salvation, O Nanak, is attained by chanting the Name of the One Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪਵੰਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: roopava(n)t hoi naahee mohai ||
english: One who is good-looking should not be vain;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਘਟ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee jot sagal ghat sohai ||
english: the Light of God is in all hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਹੋਇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਗਰਬੈ ॥
transliteration: dhanava(n)taa hoi kiaa ko garabai ||
english: Why should anyone be proud of being rich?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੀਆ ਦਰਬੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa sabh kichh tis kaa deeaa darabai ||
english: All riches are His gifts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਸੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕੋਊ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: at sooraa je kooo kahaavai ||
english: One may call himself a great hero,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਹ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee kalaa binaa kah dhaavai ||
english: but without God's Power, what can anyone do?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ਬਹੈ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: je ko hoi bahai daataar ||
english: One who brags about giving to charities

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tis denahaar jaanai gaavaar ||
english: the Great Giver shall judge him to be a fool.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੂਟੈ ਹਉ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jis gur prasaad tootai hau rog ||
english: One who, by Guru's Grace, is cured of the disease of ego

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਰੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak so jan sadaa arog ||2||
english: - O Nanak, that person is forever healthy. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮੰਦਰ ਕਉ ਥਾਮੈ ਥੰਮਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu ma(n)dar kau thaamai tha(n)man ||
english: As a palace is supported by its pillars,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਸਥੰਮਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tiu gur kaa sabad manahi asatha(n)man ||
english: so does the Guru's Word support the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਖਾਣੁ ਨਾਵ ਚੜਿ ਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu paakhaan naav chaR tarai ||
english: As a stone placed in a boat can cross over the river,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਗਤੁ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: praanee gur charan lagat nisatarai ||
english: so is the mortal saved, grasping hold of the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਦੀਪਕ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu a(n)dhakaar deepak paragaas ||
english: As the darkness is illuminated by the lamp,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: gur darasan dekh man hoi bigaas ||
english: so does the mind blossom forth, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu mahaa udiaan mahi maarag paavai ||
english: The path is found through the great wilderness by joining the Saadh Sangat,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tiu saadhoo sa(n)g mil jot pragataavai ||
english: The Company of the Holy, and one's light shines forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਛਉ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tin sa(n)tan kee baachhau dhoor ||
english: I seek the dust of the feet of those Saints;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak kee har lochaa poor ||3||
english: O Lord, fulfill Nanak's longing! ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: man moorakh kaahe bilalaaeeai ||
english: O foolish mind, why do you cry and bewail?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: purab likhe kaa likhiaa paaeeai ||
english: You shall obtain your pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਸੂਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dookh sookh prabh devanahaar ||
english: God is the Giver of pain and pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਤੂ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: avar tiaag too tisahi chitaar ||
english: Abandon others, and think of Him alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jo kachh karai soee sukh maan ||
english: Whatever He does - take comfort in that.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
transliteration: bhoolaa kaahe phirahi ajaan ||
english: Why do you wander around, you ignorant fool?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨ ਬਸਤੁ ਆਈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗ ॥
transliteration: kaun basat aaee terai sa(n)g ||
english: What things did you bring with you?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਸਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਪਤੰਗ ॥
transliteration: lapat rahio ras lobhee pata(n)g ||
english: You cling to worldly pleasures like a greedy moth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: raam naam jap hirade maahi ||
english: Dwell upon the Lord's Name in your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak pat setee ghar jaahi ||4||
english: O Nanak, thus you shall return to your home with honor. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ ਲੈਨਿ ਤੂ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis vakhar kau lain too aaiaa ||
english: This merchandise, which you have come to obtain

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: raam naam sa(n)tan ghar paaiaa ||
english: - the Lord's Name is obtained in the home of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੋਲਿ ॥
transliteration: taj abhimaan lehu man mol ||
english: Renounce your egotistical pride, and with your mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
transliteration: raam naam hirade mahi tol ||
english: Purchase the Lord's Name - measure it out within your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਦਿ ਖੇਪ ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: laad khep sa(n)tah sa(n)g chaal ||
english: Load up this merchandise, and set out with the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
transliteration: avar tiaag bikhiaa ja(n)jaal ||
english: Give up other corrupt entanglements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n kahai sabh koi ||
english: "Blessed, blessed", everyone will call you,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mukh oojal har daragah soi ||
english: and your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu vaapaar viralaa vaapaarai ||
english: In this trade, only a few are trading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak taa kai sad balihaarai ||5||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਉ ॥
transliteration: charan saadh ke dhoi dhoi peeu ||
english: Wash the feet of the Holy, and drink in this water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਰਪਿ ਸਾਧ ਕਉ ਅਪਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: arap saadh kau apanaa jeeu ||
english: Dedicate your soul to the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: saadh kee dhoor karahu isanaan ||
english: Take your cleansing bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: saadh oopar jaaeeai kurabaan ||
english: To the Holy, make your life a sacrifice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: saadh sevaa vadabhaagee paaeeai ||
english: Service to the Holy is obtained by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har keeratan gaaeeai ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is sung.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਘਨ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: anik bighan te saadhoo raakhai ||
english: From all sorts of dangers, the Saint saves us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaai a(n)mrit ras chaakhai ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, we taste the ambrosial essence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੰਤਹ ਦਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ot gahee sa(n)tah dar aaiaa ||
english: Seeking the Protection of the Saints, we have come to their door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sarab sookh naanak tih paaiaa ||6||
english: All comforts, O Nanak, are so obtained. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਉ ਜੀਵਾਲਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: miratak kau jeevaalanahaar ||
english: He infuses life back into the dead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਖੇ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਤ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bhookhe kau devat adhaar ||
english: He gives food to the hungry.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan jaa kee drisatee maahi ||
english: All treasures are within His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਣਾ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: purab likhe kaa lahanaa paahi ||
english: People obtain that which they are pre-ordained to receive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh tis kaa ohu karanai jog ||
english: All things are His; He is the Doer of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: tis bin doosar hoaa na hog ||
english: Other than Him, there has never been any other, and there shall never be.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jap jan sadaa sadaa din rainee ||
english: Meditate on Him forever and ever, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਇਹ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh te ooch niramal ih karanee ||
english: This way of life is exalted and immaculate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis kau naam deeaa ||
english: One whom the Lord, in His Grace, blesses with His Name

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak so jan niramal theeaa ||7||
english: - O Nanak, that person becomes immaculate and pure. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai man gur kee parateet ||
english: One who has faith in the Guru in his mind

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: tis jan aavai har prabh cheet ||
english: comes to dwell upon the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat bhagat suneeai tihu loi ||
english: He is acclaimed as a devotee, a humble devotee throughout the three worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai hiradai eko hoi ||
english: The One Lord is in his heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਹਤ ॥
transliteration: sach karanee sach taa kee rahat ||
english: True are his actions; true are his ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਤਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹਤ ॥
transliteration: sach hiradai sat mukh kahat ||
english: True is his heart; Truth is what he speaks with his mouth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saachee drisat saachaa aakaar ||
english: True is his vision; true is his form.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sach varatai saachaa paasaar ||
english: He distributes Truth and he spreads Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham jin sach kar jaataa ||
english: One who recognizes the Supreme Lord God as True

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਤਾ ॥੮॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak so jan sach samaataa ||8||15||
english: - O Nanak, that humble being is absorbed into the True One. ||8||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
transliteration: roop na rekh na ra(n)g kichh trihu gun te prabh bhi(n)n ||
english: He has no form, no shape, no color; God is beyond the three qualities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tisahi bujhaae naanakaa jis hovai suprasa(n)n ||1||
english: They alone understand Him, O Nanak, with whom He is pleased. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: abinaasee prabh man mahi raakh ||
english: Keep the Immortal Lord God enshrined within your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
transliteration: maanukh kee too preet tiaag ||
english: Renounce your love and attachment to people.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis te parai naahee kichh koi ||
english: Beyond Him, there is nothing at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sarab nira(n)tar eko soi ||
english: The One Lord is pervading among all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aape beenaa aape daanaa ||
english: He Himself is All-seeing; He Himself is All-knowing,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗਹੀਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: gahir ga(n)bheer gaheer sujaanaa ||
english: Unfathomable, Profound, Deep and All-knowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham paramesur gobi(n)d ||
english: He is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the Lord of the Universe,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਬਖਸੰਦ ॥
transliteration: kripaa nidhaan daiaal bakhasa(n)d ||
english: the Treasure of mercy, compassion and forgiveness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadh tere kee charanee paau ||
english: To fall at the Feet of Your Holy Beings

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਅਨਰਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kai man ihu anaraau ||1||
english: - this is the longing of Nanak's mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਨਾ ਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: manasaa pooran saranaa jog ||
english: He is the Fulfiller of wishes, who can give us Sanctuary;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jo kar paaiaa soee hog ||
english: That which He has written, comes to pass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਨ ਭਰਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਫੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: haran bharan jaa kaa netr phor ||
english: He destroys and creates in the twinkling of an eye.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa ma(n)tr na jaanai hor ||
english: No one else knows the mystery of His ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਦ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: anad roop ma(n)gal sad jaa kai ||
english: He is the embodiment of ecstasy and everlasting joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਸੁਨੀਅਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: sarab thok suneeahi ghar taa kai ||
english: I have heard that all things are in His home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: raaj mahi raaj jog mahi jogee ||
english: Among kings, He is the King; among yogis, He is the Yogi.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਪ ਮਹਿ ਤਪੀਸਰੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਮਹਿ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: tap mahi tapeesar grihasat mahi bhogee ||
english: Among ascetics, He is the Ascetic; among householders, He is the Enjoyer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਭਗਤਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhiaai dhiaai bhagatah sukh paaiaa ||
english: By constant meditation, His devotee finds peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak tis purakh kaa kinai a(n)t na paaiaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, no one has found the limits of that Supreme Being. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee leelaa kee mit naahi ||
english: There is no limit to His play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਦੇਵ ਹਾਰੇ ਅਵਗਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sagal dev haare avagaahi ||
english: All the demigods have grown weary of searching for it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੂਤੁ ॥
transliteration: pitaa kaa janam k jaanai poot ||
english: What does the son know of his father's birth?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪਰੋਈ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਸੂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sagal paroee apunai soot ||
english: All are strung upon His string.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਮਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: sumat giaan dhiaan jin dei ||
english: He bestows good sense, spiritual wisdom and meditation,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
transliteration: jan daas naam dhiaavahi sei ||
english: On His humble servants and slaves who meditate on the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tihu gun mahi jaa kau bharamaae ||
english: He leads some astray in the three qualities;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: janam marai phir aavai jaae ||
english: they are born and die, coming and going over and over again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਅਸਥਾਨ ॥
transliteration: ooch neech tis ke asathaan ||
english: The high and the low are His places.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਜਨਾਵੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaisaa janaavai taisaa naanak jaan ||3||
english: As He inspires us to know Him, O Nanak, so is He known. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਨਾਨਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: naanaa roop naanaa jaa ke ra(n)g ||
english: Many are His forms; many are His colors.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਕ ਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: naanaa bhekh karahi ik ra(n)g ||
english: Many are the appearances which He assumes, and yet He is still the One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanaa bidh keeno bisathaar ||
english: In so many ways, He has extended Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh abinaasee eka(n)kaar ||
english: The Eternal Lord God is the One, the Creator.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਚਲਿਤ ਕਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naanaa chalit kare khin maahi ||
english: He performs His many plays in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: poor rahio pooran sabh thaai ||
english: The Perfect Lord is pervading all places.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਨਤ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naanaa bidh kar banat banaaee ||
english: In so many ways, He created the creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: apanee keemat aape paaee ||
english: He alone can estimate His worth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh ghat tis ke sabh tis ke thaau ||
english: All hearts are His, and all places are His.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jap jap jeevai naanak har naau ||4||
english: Nanak lives by chanting, chanting the Name of the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੰਤ ॥
transliteration: naam ke dhaare sagale ja(n)t ||
english: The Naam is the Support of all creatures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ॥
transliteration: naam ke dhaare kha(n)d brahama(n)d ||
english: The Naam is the Support of the earth and solar systems.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: naam ke dhaare simrit bed puraan ||
english: The Naam is the Support of the Simritees, the Vedas and the Puraanas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਸੁਨਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: naam ke dhaare sunan giaan dhiaan ||
english: The Naam is the Support by which we hear of spiritual wisdom and meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਆਗਾਸ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: naam ke dhaare aagaas paataal ||
english: The Naam is the Support of the Akaashic ethers and the nether regions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naam ke dhaare sagal aakaar ||
english: The Naam is the Support of all bodies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਸਭ ਭਵਨ ॥
transliteration: naam ke dhaare pureeaa sabh bhavan ||
english: The Naam is the Support of all worlds and realms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥
transliteration: naam kai sa(n)g udhare sun sravan ||
english: Associating with the Naam, listening to it with the ears, one is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਨੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis aapanai naam laae ||
english: Those whom the Lord mercifully attaches to His Naam

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak chauthe pad mahi so jan gat paae ||5||
english: - O Nanak, in the fourth state, those humble servants attain salvation. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਸਤਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਤਿ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: roop sat jaa kaa sat asathaan ||
english: His form is true, and true is His place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: purakh sat keval paradhaan ||
english: His personality is true - He alone is supreme.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: karatoot sat sat jaa kee baanee ||
english: His acts are true, and true is His Word.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sat purakh sabh maahi samaanee ||
english: The True Lord is permeating all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਸਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sat karam jaa kee rachanaa sat ||
english: True are His actions; His creation is true.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਉਤਪਤਿ ॥
transliteration: mool sat sat utapat ||
english: His root is true, and true is what originates from it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ॥
transliteration: sat karanee niramal niramalee ||
english: True is His lifestyle, the purest of the pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਭ ਭਲੀ ॥
transliteration: jisahi bujhaae tisahi sabh bhalee ||
english: All goes well for those who know Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sat naam prabh kaa sukhadaaee ||
english: The True Name of God is the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bisvaas sat naanak gur te paaee ||6||
english: Nanak has obtained true faith from the Guru. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
transliteration: sat bachan saadhoo upades ||
english: True are the Teachings, and the Instructions of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ॥
transliteration: sat te jan jaa kai ridai praves ||
english: True are those into whose hearts He enters.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sat nirat boojhai je koi ||
english: One who knows and loves the Truth

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naam japat taa kee gat hoi ||
english: chanting the Naam, he obtains salvation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸਤਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸਤਿ ॥
transliteration: aap sat keeaa sabh sat ||
english: He Himself is True, and all that He has made is true.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਗਤਿ ॥
transliteration: aape jaanai apanee mit gat ||
english: He Himself knows His own state and condition.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jis kee srisat s karanaihaar ||
english: He is the Creator Lord of His world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਨ ਬੂਝਿ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: avar na boojh karat beechaar ||
english: No one else understands Him, although they may try.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: karate kee mit na jaanai keeaa ||
english: The created cannot know the extent of the Creator.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਵਰਤੀਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaavai so varateeaa ||7||
english: O Nanak, whatever pleases Him comes to pass. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
transliteration: bisaman bisam bhae bisamaad ||
english: Gazing upon His wondrous wonder, I am wonder-struck and amazed!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ॥
transliteration: jin boojhiaa tis aaiaa svaad ||
english: One who realizes this, comes to taste this state of joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਚਿ ਜਨ ਰਹੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai ra(n)g raach jan rahe ||
english: God's humble servants remain absorbed in His Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲਹੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan padaarath lahe ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, they receive the four cardinal blessings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਦਾਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: oi daate dukh kaatanahaar ||
english: They are the givers, the dispellers of pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai sa(n)g tarai sa(n)saar ||
english: In their company, the world is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: jan kaa sevak so vadabhaagee ||
english: The slave of the Lord's servant is so very blessed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: jan kai sa(n)g ek liv laagee ||
english: In the company of His servant, one becomes attached to the Love of the One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਜਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gun gobid keeratan jan gaavai ||
english: His humble servant sings the Kirtan, the songs of the glory of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak phal paavai ||8||16||
english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, he receives the fruits of his rewards. ||8||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਚੁ ॥
transliteration: aad sach jugaad sach ||
english: True in the beginning, True throughout the ages,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭਿ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hai bh sach naanak hosee bh sach ||1||
english: True here and now. O Nanak, He shall forever be True. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪਰਸਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: charan sat sat parasanahaar ||
english: His Lotus Feet are True, and True are those who touch Them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੇਵਦਾਰ ॥
transliteration: poojaa sat sat sevadaar ||
english: His devotional worship is True, and True are those who worship Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪੇਖਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: darasan sat sat pekhanahaar ||
english: The Blessing of His Vision is True, and True are those who behold it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਧਿਆਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naam sat sat dhiaavanahaar ||
english: His Naam is True, and True are those who meditate on it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਭ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aap sat sat sabh dhaaree ||
english: He Himself is True, and True is all that He sustains.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aape gun aape gunakaaree ||
english: He Himself is virtuous goodness, and He Himself is the Bestower of virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad sat sat prabh bakataa ||
english: The Word of His Shabad is True, and True are those who speak of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਤਾ ॥
transliteration: surat sat sat jas sunataa ||
english: Those ears are True, and True are those who listen to His Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਝਨਹਾਰ ਕਉ ਸਤਿ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bujhanahaar kau sat sabh hoi ||
english: All is True to one who understands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sat sat prabh soi ||1||
english: O Nanak, True, True is He, the Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sat saroop ridai jin maaniaa ||
english: One who believes in the Embodiment of Truth with all his heart

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਤਿਨਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan tin mool pachhaaniaa ||
english: recognizes the Cause of causes as the Root of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai ridai bisvaas prabh aaiaa ||
english: One whose heart is filled with faith in God

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tat giaan tis man pragataaiaa ||
english: the essence of spiritual wisdom is revealed to his mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਬਸਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bhai te nirabhau hoi basaanaa ||
english: Coming out of fear, he comes to live without fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jis te upajiaa tis maahi samaanaa ||
english: He is absorbed into the One, from whom he originated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸਤੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਲੇ ਬਸਤੁ ਗਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: basat maahi le basat gadaaee ||
english: When something blends with its own,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕਹਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: taa kau bhi(n)n na kahanaa jaaee ||
english: it cannot be said to be separate from it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
transliteration: boojhai boojhanahaar bibek ||
english: This is understood only by one of discerning understanding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naaraain mile naanak ek ||2||
english: Meeting with the Lord, O Nanak, he becomes one with Him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: thaakur kaa sevak aagiaakaaree ||
english: The servant is obedient to his Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: thaakur kaa sevak sadaa poojaaree ||
english: The servant worships his Lord and Master forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: thaakur ke sevak kai man parateet ||
english: The servant of the Lord Master has faith in his mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: thaakur ke sevak kee niramal reet ||
english: The servant of the Lord Master lives a pure lifestyle.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: thaakur kau sevak jaanai sa(n)g ||
english: The servant of the Lord Master knows that the Lord is with him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh kaa sevak naam kai ra(n)g ||
english: God's servant is attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਲਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sevak kau prabh paalanahaaraa ||
english: God is the Cherisher of His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sevak kee raakhai nira(n)kaaraa ||
english: The Formless Lord preserves His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so sevak jis daiaa prabh dhaarai ||
english: Unto His servant, God bestows His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak so sevak saas saas samaarai ||3||
english: O Nanak, that servant remembers Him with each and every breath. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਪਰਦਾ ਢਾਕੈ ॥
transliteration: apune jan kaa paradaa dhaakai ||
english: He covers the faults of His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਪਰ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: apane sevak kee sarapar raakhai ||
english: He surely preserves the honor of His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: apane daas kau dei vadaaee ||
english: He blesses His slave with greatness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: apane sevak kau naam japaaee ||
english: He inspires His servant to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: apane sevak kee aap pat raakhai ||
english: He Himself preserves the honor of His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: taa kee gat mit koi na laakhai ||
english: No one knows His state and extent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh ke sevak kau ko na pahoochai ||
english: No one is equal to the servant of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh ke sevak ooch te ooche ||
english: The servant of God is the highest of the high.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jo prabh apanee sevaa laaiaa ||
english: One whom God applies to His own service, O Nanak

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak so sevak dah dis pragataaiaa ||4||
english: - that servant is famous in the ten directions. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਕੀ ਕੀਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: neekee keeree mahi kal raakhai ||
english: He infuses His Power into the tiny ant;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਸਮ ਕਰੈ ਲਸਕਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: bhasam karai lasakar kot laakhai ||
english: it can then reduce the armies of millions to ashes

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਢਤ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa saas na kaadhat aap ||
english: Those whose breath of life He Himself does not take away

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਤ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: taa kau raakhat de kar haath ||
english: He preserves them, and holds out His Hands to protect them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: maanas jatan karat bahu bhaat ||
english: You may make all sorts of efforts,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: tis ke karatab birathe jaat ||
english: but these attempts are in vain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੈ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: maarai na raakhai avar na koi ||
english: No one else can kill or preserve

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sarab jeeaa kaa raakhaa soi ||
english: He is the Protector of all beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਸੋਚ ਕਰਹਿ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: kaahe soch karahi re praanee ||
english: So why are you so anxious, O mortal?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਲਖ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jap naanak prabh alakh vidaanee ||5||
english: Meditate, O Nanak, on God, the invisible, the wonderful! ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: baara(n) baar baar prabh japeeai ||
english: Time after time, again and again, meditate on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: pee a(n)mrit ihu man tan dhrapeeai ||
english: Drinking in this Nectar, this mind and body are satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naam ratan jin guramukh paaiaa ||
english: The jewel of the Naam is obtained by the Gurmukhs;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tis kichh avar naahee drisataaiaa ||
english: they see no other than God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: naam dhan naamo roop ra(n)g ||
english: Unto them, the Naam is wealth, the Naam is beauty and delight.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: naamo sukh har naam kaa sa(n)g ||
english: The Naam is peace, the Lord's Name is their companion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: naam ras jo jan tripataane ||
english: Those who are satisfied by the essence of the Naam

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: man tan naamahi naam samaane ||
english: their minds and bodies are drenched with the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat sovat naam ||
english: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, the Naam,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕਾਮ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jan kai sad kaam ||6||
english: says Nanak, is forever the occupation of God's humble servant. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਜਸੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bolahu jas jihabaa din raat ||
english: Chant His Praises with your tongue, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਜਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh apanai jan keenee daat ||
english: God Himself has given this gift to His servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਆਤਮ ਕੈ ਚਾਇ ॥
transliteration: karahi bhagat aatam kai chaai ||
english: Performing devotional worship with heart-felt love,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh apane siu rahahi samaai ||
english: they remain absorbed in God Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹੋਆ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jo hoaa hovat so jaanai ||
english: They know the past and the present.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh apane kaa hukam pachhaanai ||
english: They recognize God's Own Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਉਨ ਬਖਾਨਉ ॥
transliteration: tis kee mahimaa kaun bakhaanau ||
english: Who can describe His Glory?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa gun kahi ek na jaanau ||
english: I cannot describe even one of His virtuous qualities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਸਹਿ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar prabh basahi hajoore ||
english: Those who dwell in God's Presence, twenty-four hours a day

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak seee jan poore ||7||
english: - says Nanak, they are the perfect persons. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: man mere tin kee ot lehi ||
english: O my mind, seek their protection;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: man tan apanaa tin jan dehi ||
english: give your mind and body to those humble beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jin jan apanaa prabhoo pachhaataa ||
english: Those humble beings who recognizes God

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: so jan sarab thok kaa daataa ||
english: are the givers of all things.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tis kee saran sarab sukh paavahi ||
english: In His Sanctuary, all comforts are obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਭ ਪਾਪ ਮਿਟਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tis kai daras sabh paap mitaavahi ||
english: By the Blessing of His Darshan, all sins are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਡੁ ॥
transliteration: avar siaanap sagalee chhaad ||
english: So renounce all other clever devices,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: tis jan kee too sevaa laag ||
english: and enjoin yourself to the service of those servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaan na hovee teraa ||
english: Your comings and goings shall be ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਸਦ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak tis jan ke poojahu sad pairaa ||8||17||
english: O Nanak, worship the feet of God's humble servants forever. ||8||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sat purakh jin jaaniaa satigur tis kaa naau ||
english: The one who knows the True Lord God, is called the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਖੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis kai sa(n)g sikh udharai naanak har gun gaau ||1||
english: In His Company, the Sikh is saved, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕੀ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: satigur sikh kee karai pratipaal ||
english: The True Guru cherishes His Sikh.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: sevak kau gur sadaa daiaal ||
english: The Guru is always merciful to His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਹਿਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sikh kee gur duramat mal hirai ||
english: The Guru washes away the filth of the evil intellect of His Sikh.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur bachanee har naam ucharai ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, he chants the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sikh ke ba(n)dhan kaatai ||
english: The True Guru cuts away the bonds of His Sikh.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਹਾਟੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sikh bikaar te haatai ||
english: The Sikh of the Guru abstains from evil deeds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sikh kau naam dhan dei ||
english: The True Guru gives His Sikh the wealth of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sikh vadabhaagee he ||
english: The Sikh of the Guru is very fortunate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਾ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sikh kaa halat palat savaarai ||
english: The True Guru arranges this world and the next for His Sikh.

author: Guru Arjan
