gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak satigur sikh kau jee naal samaarai ||1||
english: O Nanak, with the fullness of His heart, the True Guru mends His Sikh. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai grihi sevak jo rahai ||
english: That selfless servant, who lives in the Guru's household,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kee aagiaa man mahi sahai ||
english: is to obey the Guru's Commands with all his mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aapas kau kar kachh na janaavai ||
english: He is not to call attention to himself in any way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har har naam ridai sad dhiaavai ||
english: He is to meditate constantly within his heart on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: man bechai satigur kai paas ||
english: One who sells his mind to the True Guru

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: tis sevak ke kaaraj raas ||
english: - that humble servant's affairs are resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਕਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: sevaa karat hoi nihakaamee ||
english: One who performs selfless service, without thought of reward,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: tis kau hot paraapat suaamee ||
english: shall attain his Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: apanee kripaa jis aap karei ||
english: He Himself grants His Grace;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੇਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak so sevak gur kee mat lei ||2||
english: O Nanak, that selfless servant lives the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸਵੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: bees bisave gur kaa man maanai ||
english: One who obeys the Guru's Teachings one hundred per cent

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: so sevak paramesur kee gat jaanai ||
english: that selfless servant comes to know the state of the Transcendent Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: so satigur jis ridai har naau ||
english: The True Guru's Heart is filled with the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anik baar gur kau bal jaau ||
english: So many times, I am a sacrifice to the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan jee kaa daataa ||
english: He is the treasure of everything, the Giver of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar paarabraham ra(n)g raataa ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, He is imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹਿ ਜਨੁ ਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
transliteration: braham mahi jan jan mahi paarabraham ||
english: The servant is in God, and God is in the servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: ekahi aap nahee kachh bharam ||
english: He Himself is One - there is no doubt about this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sahas siaanap laiaa na jaaeeai ||
english: By thousands of clever tricks, He is not found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak aisaa gur badabhaagee paaeeai ||3||
english: O Nanak, such a Guru is obtained by the greatest good fortune. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: saphal darasan pekhat puneet ||
english: Blessed is His Darshan; receiving it, one is purified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਸਤ ਚਰਨ ਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: parasat charan gat niramal reet ||
english: Touching His Feet, one's conduct and lifestyle become pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਰਵੇ ॥
transliteration: bhetat sa(n)g raam gun rave ||
english: Abiding in His Company, one chants the Lord's Praise,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਗਵੇ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham kee daragah gave ||
english: and reaches the Court of the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਚਨ ਕਰਨ ਆਘਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: sun kar bachan karan aaghaane ||
english: Listening to His Teachings, one's ears are satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਆਤਮ ਪਤੀਆਨੇ ॥
transliteration: man sa(n)tokh aatam pateeaane ||
english: The mind is contented, and the soul is fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਖੵਓ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ॥
transliteration: pooraa gur akhyo jaa kaa ma(n)tr ||
english: The Guru is perfect; His Teachings are everlasting.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪੇਖੈ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit drisat pekhai hoi sa(n)t ||
english: Beholding His Ambrosial Glance, one becomes saintly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gun bia(n)t keemat nahee paai ||
english: Endless are His virtuous qualities; His worth cannot be appraised.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak jis bhaavai tis lae milaai ||4||
english: O Nanak, one who pleases Him is united with Him. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਏਕ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
transliteration: jihabaa ek usatat anek ||
english: The tongue is one, but His Praises are many.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
transliteration: sat purakh pooran bibek ||
english: The True Lord, of perfect perfection

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬੋਲ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bol na pahuchat praanee ||
english: - no speech can take the mortal to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar prabh nirabaanee ||
english: God is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, balanced in the state of Nirvaanaa.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: niraahaar niravair sukhadaaee ||
english: He is not sustained by food; He has no hatred or vengeance; He is the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: taa kee keemat kinai na paaee ||
english: No one can estimate His worth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤ ਬੰਦਨ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: anik bhagat ba(n)dan nit karahi ||
english: Countless devotees continually bow in reverence to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal hiradai simarahi ||
english: In their hearts, they meditate on His Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
transliteration: sad balihaaree satigur apane ||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak jis prasaad aisaa prabh japane ||5||
english: by His Grace, he meditates on God. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu har ras paavai jan koi ||
english: Only a few obtain this ambrosial essence of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit peevai amar so hoi ||
english: Drinking in this Nectar, one becomes immortal.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: us purakh kaa naahee kade binaas ||
english: That person whose mind is illuminated

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਗੁਨਤਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai man pragate gunataas ||
english: By the treasure of excellence, never dies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar har kaa naam lei ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, he takes the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: sach upades sevak kau dei ||
english: The Lord gives true instruction to His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਲੇਪੁ ॥
transliteration: moh maaiaa kai sa(n)g na lep ||
english: He is not polluted by emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ॥
transliteration: man mahi raakhai har har ek ||
english: In his mind, he cherishes the One Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਦੀਪਕ ਪਰਗਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhakaar deepak paragaase ||
english: In the pitch darkness, a lamp shines forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ ਤਹ ਤੇ ਨਾਸੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak bharam moh dukh tah te naase ||6||
english: O Nanak, doubt, emotional attachment and pain are erased. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਪਤਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਠਾਢਿ ਵਰਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tapat maahi thaadh varataaee ||
english: In the burning heat, a soothing coolness prevails.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: anad bhaiaa dukh naathe bhaaee ||
english: Happiness ensues and pain departs, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ॥
transliteration: janam maran ke mite a(n)dese ||
english: The fear of birth and death is dispelled,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਉਪਦੇਸੇ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo ke pooran upadese ||
english: by the perfect Teachings of the Holy Saint.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਚੂਕਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਬਸੇ ॥
transliteration: bhau chookaa nirabhau hoi base ||
english: Fear is lifted, and one abides in fearlessness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਖੈ ਨਸੇ ॥
transliteration: sagal biaadh man te khai nase ||
english: All evils are dispelled from the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa saa tin kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: He takes us into His favor as His own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jap naam muraaree ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਚੂਕੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਗਵਨ ॥
transliteration: thit paaee chooke bhram gavan ||
english: Stability is attained; doubt and wandering cease,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sun naanak har har jas sravan ||7||
english: O Nanak, listening with one's ears to the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਰਗੁਨੁ ਭੀ ਓਹੀ ॥
transliteration: niragun aap saragun bhee ohee ||
english: He Himself is absolute and unrelated; He Himself is also involved and related.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਮੋਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kalaa dhaar jin sagalee mohee ||
english: Manifesting His power, He fascinates the entire world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਚਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਏ ॥
transliteration: apane charit prabh aap banaae ||
english: God Himself sets His play in motion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: apunee keemat aape paae ||
english: Only He Himself can estimate His worth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har bin doojaa naahee koi ||
english: There is none, other than the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sarab nira(n)tar eko soi ||
english: Permeating all, He is the One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: ot pot raviaa roop ra(n)g ||
english: Through and through, He pervades in form and color.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗ ॥
transliteration: bhae pragaas saadh kai sa(n)g ||
english: He is revealed in the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਚਿ ਰਚਨਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: rach rachanaa apanee kal dhaaree ||
english: Having created the creation, He infuses His own power into it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੧੮॥
transliteration: anik baar naanak balihaaree ||8||18||
english: So many times, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||8||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saath na chaalai bin bhajan bikhiaa sagalee chhaar ||
english: Nothing shall go along with you, except your devotion. All corruption is like ashes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਵਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har naam kamaavanaa naanak ihu dhan saar ||1||
english: Practice the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. O Nanak, this is the most excellent wealth. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil karahu beechaar ||
english: Joining the Company of the Saints, practice deep meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ek simar naam aadhaar ||
english: Remember the One, and take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਭਿ ਮੀਤ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: avar upaav sabh meet bisaarahu ||
english: Forget all other efforts, O my friend

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal rid mahi ur dhaarahu ||
english: - enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran so prabh samarath ||
english: God is All-powerful; He is the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਹਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਥੁ ॥
transliteration: driR kar gahahu naam har vath ||
english: Grasp firmly the object of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: ihu dhan sa(n)chahu hovahu bhagava(n)t ||
english: Gather this wealth, and become very fortunate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kaa niramal ma(n)t ||
english: Pure are the instructions of the humble Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਆਸ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ek aas raakhahu man maahi ||
english: Keep faith in the One Lord within your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarab rog naanak mit jaahi ||1||
english: All disease, O Nanak, shall then be dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jis dhan kau chaar ku(n)t uth dhaavahi ||
english: The wealth which you chase after in the four directions

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: so dhan har sevaa te paavahi ||
english: you shall obtain that wealth by serving the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: jis sukh kau nit baachhahi meet ||
english: The peace, which you always yearn for, O friend

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: so sukh saadhoo sa(n)g pareet ||
english: that peace comes by the love of the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਲੀ ਕਰਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jis sobhaa kau karahi bhalee karanee ||
english: The glory, for which you perform good deeds

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ॥
transliteration: saa sobhaa bhaj har kee saranee ||
english: - you shall obtain that glory by seeking the Lord's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵੀ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anik upaavee rog na jaai ||
english: All sorts of remedies have not cured the disease

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: rog mitai har avakhadh laai ||
english: - the disease is cured only by giving the medicine of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan mahi har naam nidhaan ||
english: Of all treasures, the Lord's Name is the supreme treasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jap naanak daragahi paravaan ||2||
english: Chant it, O Nanak, and be accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man parabodhahu har kai naai ||
english: Enlighten your mind with the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵਤ ਆਵੈ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dah dis dhaavat aavai thaai ||
english: Having wandered around in the ten directions, it comes to its place of rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: taa kau bighan na laagai koi ||
english: No obstacle stands in the way of one

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai ridai basai har soi ||
english: whose heart is filled with the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਤਾਤੀ ਠਾਂਢਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kal taatee thaa(n)dhaa har naau ||
english: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is so hot; the Lord's Name is soothing and cool.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਉ ॥
transliteration: simar simar sadaa sukh paau ||
english: Remember, remember it in meditation, and obtain everlasting peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: bhau binasai pooran hoi aas ||
english: Your fear shall be dispelled, and your hopes shall be fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਆਤਮ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: bhagat bhaai aatam paragaas ||
english: By devotional worship and loving adoration, your soul shall be enlightened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਸੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: tit ghar jaai basai abinaasee ||
english: You shall go to that home, and live forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak kaatee jam phaasee ||3||
english: Says Nanak, the noose of death is cut away. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: tat beechaar kahai jan saachaa ||
english: One who contemplates the essence of reality, is said to be the true person.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਚੋ ਕਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: janam marai so kaacho kaachaa ||
english: Birth and death are the lot of the false and the insincere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: aavaa gavan mitai prabh sev ||
english: Coming and going in reincarnation is ended by serving God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: aap tiaag saran guradev ||
english: Give up your selfishness and conceit, and seek the Sanctuary of the Divine Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: iu ratan janam kaa hoi udhaar ||
english: Thus the jewel of this human life is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har har simar praan aadhaar ||
english: Remember the Lord, Har, Har, the Support of the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਨ ਛੂਟਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: anik upaav na chhootanahaare ||
english: By all sorts of efforts, people are not saved

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: si(n)mrit saasat bed beechaare ||
english: not by studying the Simritees, the Shaastras or the Vedas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har kee bhagat karahu man laai ||
english: Worship the Lord with whole-hearted devotion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬੰਛਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: man ba(n)chhat naanak phal paai ||4||
english: O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desire. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਸਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਧਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g na chaalas terai dhanaa ||
english: Your wealth shall not go with you;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਿਆ ਲਪਟਾਵਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) kiaa lapataavahi moorakh manaa ||
english: why do you cling to it, you fool?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਅਰੁ ਬਨਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sut meet kuta(n)b ar banitaa ||
english: Children, friends, family and spouse

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਕਵਨ ਸਨਾਥਾ ॥
transliteration: in te kahahu tum kavan sanaathaa ||
english: who of these shall accompany you?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
transliteration: raaj ra(n)g maaiaa bisathaar ||
english: Power, pleasure, and the vast expanse of Maya

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਛੁਟਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: in te kahahu kavan chhutakaar ||
english: who has ever escaped from these?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸੁ ਹਸਤੀ ਰਥ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: as hasatee rath asavaaree ||
english: Horses, elephants, chariots and pageantry

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਡੰਫੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਾਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jhoothaa da(n)ph jhooth paasaaree ||
english: - false shows and false displays.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਨ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jin deee tis bujhai na bigaanaa ||
english: The fool does not acknowledge the One who gave this;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naam bisaar naanak pachhutaanaa ||5||
english: forgetting the Naam, O Nanak, he will repent in the end. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤੂੰ ਲੇਹਿ ਇਆਨੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kee mat too(n) lehi iaane ||
english: Take the Guru's advice, you ignorant fool;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਡੂਬੇ ਸਿਆਨੇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat binaa bahu doobe siaane ||
english: without devotion, even the clever have drowned.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: har kee bhagat karahu man meet ||
english: Worship the Lord with heart-felt devotion, my friend;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਚੀਤ ॥
transliteration: niramal hoi tumhaaro cheet ||
english: your consciousness shall become pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal raakhahu man maahi ||
english: Enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet in your mind;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh jaahi ||
english: the sins of countless lifetimes shall depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਅਵਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aap japahu avaraa naam japaavahu ||
english: Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਤ ਕਹਤ ਰਹਤ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sunat kahat rahat gat paavahu ||
english: Hearing, speaking and living it, emancipation is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰ ਭੂਤ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saar bhoot sat har ko naau ||
english: The essential reality is the True Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sahaj subhaai naanak gun gaau ||6||
english: With intuitive ease, O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavat teree utaras mail ||
english: Chanting His Glories, your filth shall be washed off.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਫੈਲੁ ॥
transliteration: binas jaai haumai bikh phail ||
english: The all-consuming poison of ego will be gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹਿ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਬਸੈ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: hohi achi(n)t basai sukh naal ||
english: You shall become carefree, and you shall dwell in peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: saas graas har naam samaal ||
english: With every breath and every morsel of food, cherish the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲੀ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: chhaad siaanap sagalee manaa ||
english: Renounce all clever tricks, O mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਨਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g paavahi sach dhanaa ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, you shall obtain the true wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸੰਚਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har poo(n)jee sa(n)ch karahu biuhaar ||
english: So gather the Lord's Name as your capital, and trade in it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: eehaa sukh daragah jaikaar ||
english: In this world you shall be at peace, and in the Court of the Lord, you shall be acclaimed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: sarab nira(n)tar eko dekh ||
english: See the One permeating all;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jaa kai masatak lekh ||7||
english: says Nanak, your destiny is pre-ordained. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਜਪਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: eko jap eko saalaahi ||
english: Meditate on the One, and worship the One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਮਨ ਆਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ek simar eko man aahi ||
english: Remember the One, and yearn for the One in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
transliteration: ekas ke gun gaau ana(n)t ||
english: Sing the endless Glorious Praises of the One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਪਿ ਏਕ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: man tan jaap ek bhagava(n)t ||
english: With mind and body, meditate on the One Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: eko ek ek har aap ||
english: The One Lord Himself is the One and Only.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: pooran poor rahio prabh biaap ||
english: The Pervading Lord God is totally permeating all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ਏਕ ਤੇ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: anik bisathaar ek te bhae ||
english: The many expanses of the creation have all come from the One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਗਏ ॥
transliteration: ek araadh paraachhat gae ||
english: Adoring the One, past sins are removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar ek prabh raataa ||
english: Mind and body within are imbued with the One God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੮॥੧੯॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak ik jaataa ||8||19||
english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the One is known. ||8||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ਪਰਿਆ ਤਉ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: phirat phirat prabh aaiaa pariaa tau saranaai ||
english: After wandering and wandering, O God, I have come, and entered Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kee prabh benatee apanee bhagatee laai ||1||
english: This is Nanak's prayer, O God: please, attach me to Your devotional service. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਕ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jaachak jan jaachai prabh daan ||
english: I am a beggar; I beg for this gift from You:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa devahu har naam ||
english: please, by Your Mercy, Lord, give me Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਗਉ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saadh janaa kee maagau dhoor ||
english: I ask for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham meree saradhaa poor ||
english: O Supreme Lord God, please fulfill my yearning;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa prabh ke gun gaavau ||
english: may I sing the Glorious Praises of God forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
transliteration: saas saas prabh tumahi dhiaavau ||
english: With each and every breath, may I meditate on You, O God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu laagai preet ||
english: May I enshrine affection for Your Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bhagat karau prabh kee nit neet ||
english: May I perform devotional worship to God each and every day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਓਟ ਏਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ek ot eko aadhaar ||
english: You are my only Shelter, my only Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak maagai naam prabh saar ||1||
english: Nanak asks for the most sublime, the Naam, the Name of God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee drisat mahaa sukh hoi ||
english: By God's Gracious Glance, there is great peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har ras paavai biralaa koi ||
english: Rare are those who obtain the juice of the Lord's essence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: jin chaakhiaa se jan tripataane ||
english: Those who taste it are satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਹੀ ਡੋਲਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: pooran purakh nahee dolaane ||
english: They are fulfilled and realized beings - they do not waver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: subhar bhare prem ras ra(n)g ||
english: They are totally filled to over-flowing with the sweet delight of His Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: upajai chaau saadh kai sa(n)g ||
english: Spiritual delight wells up within, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰੇ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਨ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥
transliteration: pare saran aan sabh tiaag ||
english: Taking to His Sanctuary, they forsake all others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar pragaas anadin liv laag ||
english: Deep within, they are enlightened, and they center themselves on Him, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਪਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: badabhaagee japiaa prabh soi ||
english: Most fortunate are those who meditate on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate sukh hoi ||2||
english: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, they are at peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਭਈ ॥
transliteration: sevak kee manasaa pooree bhaee ||
english: The wishes of the Lord's servant are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਤਿ ਲਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur te niramal mat laee ||
english: From the True Guru, the pure teachings are obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jan kau prabh hoio daiaal ||
english: Unto His humble servant, God has shown His kindness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: sevak keeno sadaa nihaal ||
english: He has made His servant eternally happy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan kaat mukat jan bhaiaa ||
english: The bonds of His humble servant are cut away, and he is liberated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: janam maran dookh bhram gaiaa ||
english: The pains of birth and death, and doubt are gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ichh punee saradhaa sabh pooree ||
english: Desires are satisfied, and faith is fully rewarded,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਜੂਰੀ ॥
transliteration: rav rahiaa sad sa(n)g hajooree ||
english: imbued forever with His all-pervading peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa saa tin leeaa milaai ||
english: He is His - he merges in Union with Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak bhagatee naam samaai ||3||
english: Nanak is absorbed in devotional worship of the Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਭਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: so kiu bisarai j ghaal na bhaanai ||
english: Why forget Him, who does not overlook our efforts?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: so kiu bisarai j keeaa jaanai ||
english: Why forget Him, who acknowledges what we do?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: so kiu bisarai jin sabh kichh deeaa ||
english: Why forget Him, who has given us everything?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: so kiu bisarai j jeevan jeeaa ||
english: Why forget Him, who is the Life of the living beings?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: so kiu bisarai j agan mahi raakhai ||
english: Why forget Him, who preserves us in the fire of the womb?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਲਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad ko biralaa laakhai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, rare is the one who realizes this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
transliteration: so kiu bisarai j bikh te kaadhai ||
english: Why forget Him, who lifts us up out of corruption?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਟੂਟਾ ਗਾਢੈ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa tootaa gaadhai ||
english: Those separated from Him for countless lifetimes, are re-united with Him once again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਤੁ ਇਹੈ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai tat ihai bujhaaiaa ||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, this essential reality is understood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: prabh apanaa naanak jan dhiaaiaa ||4||
english: O Nanak, God's humble servants meditate on Him. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: saajan sa(n)t karahu ihu kaam ||
english: O friends, O Saints, make this your work.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: aan tiaag japahu har naam ||
english: Renounce everything else, and chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: simar simar simar sukh paavahu ||
english: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਅਵਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aap japahu avarah naam japaavahu ||
english: Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਤਰੀਐ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhagat bhaai tareeai sa(n)saar ||
english: By loving devotional worship, you shall cross over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin bhagatee tan hosee chhaar ||
english: Without devotional meditation, the body will be just ashes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੂਖ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sarab kaliaan sookh nidh naam ||
english: All joys and comforts are in the treasure of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਜਾਤ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: boodat jaat paae bisraam ||
english: Even the drowning can reach the place of rest and safety.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਦੂਖ ਕਾ ਹੋਵਤ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sagal dookh kaa hovat naas ||
english: All sorrows shall vanish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਨਤਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam japahu gunataas ||5||
english: O Nanak, chant the Naam, the treasure of excellence. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਪਜੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: upajee preet prem ras chaau ||
english: Love and affection, and the taste of yearning, have welled up within;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਇਹੀ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar ihee suaau ||
english: within my mind and body, this is my purpose:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: netrahu pekh daras sukh hoi ||
english: beholding with my eyes His Blessed Vision, I am at peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man bigasai saadh charan dhoi ||
english: My mind blossoms forth in ecstasy, washing the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kai man tan ra(n)g ||
english: The minds and bodies of His devotees are infused with His Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: biralaa kooo paavai sa(n)g ||
english: Rare is the one who obtains their company.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ek basat deejai kar maiaa ||
english: Show Your mercy - please, grant me this one request:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naam jap laiaa ||
english: by Guru's Grace, may I chant the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: taa kee upamaa kahee na jaai ||
english: His Praises cannot be spoken;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak rahiaa sarab samaai ||6||
english: O Nanak, He is contained among all. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਖਸੰਦ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: prabh bakhasa(n)d deen daiaal ||
english: God, the Forgiving Lord, is kind to the poor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal sadaa kirapaal ||
english: He loves His devotees, and He is always merciful to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: anaath naath gobi(n)d gupaal ||
english: The Patron of the patronless, the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the world,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਕਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sarab ghataa karat pratipaal ||
english: the Nourisher of all beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aad purakh kaaran karataar ||
english: The Primal Being, the Creator of the Creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa ke praan adhaar ||
english: The Support of the breath of life of His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: jo jo japai s hoi puneet ||
english: Whoever meditates on Him is sanctified,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਵੈ ਮਨ ਹੀਤ ॥
transliteration: bhagat bhaai laavai man heet ||
english: focusing the mind in loving devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰ ਨੀਚ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
transliteration: ham niraguneeaar neech ajaan ||
english: I am unworthy, lowly and ignorant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak tumaree saran purakh bhagavaan ||7||
english: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, O Supreme Lord God. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮੋਖ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sarab baiku(n)th mukat mokh paae ||
english: Everything is obtained: the heavens, liberation and deliverance,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ek nimakh har ke gun gaae ||
english: if one sings the Lord's Glories, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਬਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: anik raaj bhog badiaaee ||
english: So many realms of power, pleasures and great glories,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam kee kathaa man bhaaee ||
english: come to one whose mind is pleased with the Sermon of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਭੋਜਨ ਕਾਪਰ ਸੰਗੀਤ ॥
transliteration: bahu bhojan kaapar sa(n)geet ||
english: Abundant foods, clothes and music

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa japatee har har neet ||
english: come to one whose tongue continually chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਲੀ ਸੁ ਕਰਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਧਨਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: bhalee s karanee sobhaa dhanava(n)t ||
english: His actions are good, he is glorious and wealthy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ ॥
transliteration: hiradai base pooran gur ma(n)t ||
english: the Mantra of the Perfect Guru dwells within his heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g prabh dehu nivaas ||
english: O God, grant me a home in the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੮॥੨੦॥
transliteration: sarab sookh naanak paragaas ||8||20||
english: All pleasures, O Nanak, are so revealed. ||8||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਗੁਨ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: saragun niragun nira(n)kaar su(n)n samaadhee aap ||
english: He possesses all qualities; He transcends all qualities; He is the Formless Lord. He Himself is in Primal Samaadhi.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aapan keeaa naanakaa aape hee phir jaap ||1||
english: Through His Creation, O Nanak, He meditates on Himself. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jab akaar ihu kachh na drisatetaa ||
english: When this world had not yet appeared in any form,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਬ ਕਹ ਤੇ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
transliteration: paap pu(n)n tab kah te hotaa ||
english: who then committed sins and performed good deeds?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਧਾਰੀ ਆਪਨ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: jab dhaaree aapan su(n)n samaadh ||
english: When the Lord Himself was in Profound Samaadhi,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਕਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: tab bair birodh kis sa(n)g kamaat ||
english: then against whom were hate and jealousy directed?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਤ ॥
transliteration: jab is kaa baran chihan na jaapat ||
english: When there was no color or shape to be seen,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ॥
transliteration: tab harakh sog kahu kisahi biaapat ||
english: then who experienced joy and sorrow?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਆਪਨ ਆਪ ਆਪਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
transliteration: jab aapan aap aap paarabraham ||
english: When the Supreme Lord Himself was Himself All-in-all,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਮੋਹ ਕਹਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਭਰਮ ॥
transliteration: tab moh kahaa kis hovat bharam ||
english: then where was emotional attachment, and who had doubts?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੀਜਾ ॥
transliteration: aapan khel aap varateejaa ||
english: He Himself has staged His own drama;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak karanaihaar na doojaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, there is no other Creator. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹੋਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਵਲ ਧਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jab hovat prabh keval dhanee ||
english: When there was only God the Master,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਬੰਧ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: tab ba(n)dh mukat kahu kis kau ganee ||
english: then who was called bound or liberated?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਏਕਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jab ekahi har agam apaar ||
english: When there was only the Lord, Unfathomable and Infinite,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਕਹੁ ਕਉਨ ਅਉਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tab narak surag kahu kaun autaar ||
english: then who entered hell, and who entered heaven?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jab niragun prabh sahaj subhaai ||
english: When God was without attributes, in absolute poise,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tab siv sakat kahahu kit thaai ||
english: then where was mind and where was matter - where was Shiva and Shakti?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jab aapahi aap apanee jot dharai ||
english: When He held His Own Light unto Himself,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਕਵਨ ਨਿਡਰੁ ਕਵਨ ਕਤ ਡਰੈ ॥
transliteration: tab kavan nidar kavan kat darai ||
english: then who was fearless, and who was afraid?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਚਲਿਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aapan chalit aap karanaihaar ||
english: He Himself is the Performer in His own plays;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak thaakur agam apaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Master is Unfathomable and Infinite. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸੁਖ ਆਪਨ ਆਸਨ ॥
transliteration: abinaasee sukh aapan aasan ||
english: When the Immortal Lord was seated at ease,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ॥
transliteration: tah janam maran kahu kahaa binaasan ||
english: then where was birth, death and dissolution?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jab pooran karataa prabh soi ||
english: When there was only God, the Perfect Creator,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tab jam kee traas kahahu kis hoi ||
english: then who was afraid of death?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕਾ ॥
transliteration: jab abigat agochar prabh ekaa ||
english: When there was only the One Lord, unmanifest and incomprehensible,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤ ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਛਤ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: tab chitr gupat kis poochhat lekhaa ||
english: then who was called to account by the recording scribes of the conscious and the subconscious?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਅਗਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: jab naath nira(n)jan agochar agaadhe ||
english: When there was only the Immaculate, Incomprehensible, Unfathomable Master,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਕਉਨ ਛੁਟੇ ਕਉਨ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: tab kaun chhute kaun ba(n)dhan baadhe ||
english: then who was emancipated, and who was held in bondage?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਆਪ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਅਚਰਜਾ ॥
transliteration: aapan aap aap hee acharajaa ||
english: He Himself, in and of Himself, is the most wonderful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਨ ਰੂਪ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਉਪਰਜਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak aapan roop aap hee uparajaa ||3||
english: O Nanak, He Himself created His Own Form. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jah niramal purakh purakh pat hotaa ||
english: When there was only the Immaculate Being, the Lord of beings,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਧੋਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tah bin mail kahahu kiaa dhotaa ||
english: there was no filth, so what was there to be washed clean?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਬਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jah nira(n)jan nira(n)kaar nirabaan ||
english: When there was only the Pure, Formless Lord in Nirvaanaa,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਕਉਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਨ ਕਉਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: tah kaun kau maan kaun abhimaan ||
english: then who was honored, and who was dishonored?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਸਰੂਪ ਕੇਵਲ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
transliteration: jah saroop keval jagadees ||
english: When there was only the Form of the Lord of the Universe,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਛਲ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਲਗਤ ਕਹੁ ਕੀਸ ॥
transliteration: tah chhal chhidr lagat kahu kees ||
english: then who was tainted by fraud and sin?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jah jot saroopee jot sa(n)g samaavai ||
english: When the Embodiment of Light was immersed in His Own Light,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਭੂਖ ਕਵਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tah kisahi bhookh kavan tripataavai ||
english: then who was hungry, and who was satisfied?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan karanaihaar ||
english: He is the Cause of causes, the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak karate kaa naahi sumaar ||4||
english: O Nanak, the Creator is beyond calculation. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jab apanee sobhaa aapan sa(n)g banaaee ||
english: When His Glory was contained within Himself,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਕਵਨ ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tab kavan maai baap mitr sut bhaaee ||
english: then who was mother, father, friend, child or sibling?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਆਪਹਿ ਪਰਬੀਨ ॥
transliteration: jah sarab kalaa aapahi parabeen ||
english: When all power and wisdom was latent within Him,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਕਹਾ ਕੋਊ ਚੀਨ ॥
transliteration: tah bed kateb kahaa kooo cheen ||
english: then where were the Vedas and the scriptures, and who was there to read them?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jab aapan aap aap ur dhaarai ||
english: When He kept Himself, All-in-all, unto His Own Heart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਸਗਨ ਅਪਸਗਨ ਕਹਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: tau sagan apasagan kahaa beechaarai ||
english: then who considered omens to be good or bad?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਆਪਨ ਊਚ ਆਪਨ ਆਪਿ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jah aapan ooch aapan aap neraa ||
english: When He Himself was lofty, and He Himself was near at hand,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਕਉਨ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਚੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tah kaun thaakur kaun kaheeai cheraa ||
english: then who was called master, and who was called disciple?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
transliteration: bisaman bisam rahe bisamaad ||
english: We are wonder-struck at the wondrous wonder of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪਨੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਆਪਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak apanee gat jaanahu aap ||5||
english: O Nanak, He alone knows His own state. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jah achhal achhed abhed samaaiaa ||
english: When the Undeceiveable, Impenetrable, Inscrutable One was self-absorbed,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਹਾ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: oohaa kisahi biaapat maaiaa ||
english: then who was swayed by Maya?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: aapas kau aapahi aades ||
english: When He paid homage to Himself,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: tihu gun kaa naahee paraves ||
english: then the three qualities were not prevailing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਏਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jah ekahi ek ek bhagava(n)taa ||
english: When there was only the One, the One and Only Lord God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਕਉਨੁ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tah kaun achi(n)t kis laagai chi(n)taa ||
english: then who was not anxious, and who felt anxiety?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jah aapan aap aap pateeaaraa ||
english: When He Himself was satisfied with Himself,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਥੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਸੁਨਨੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tah kaun kathai kaun sunanaihaaraa ||
english: then who spoke and who listened?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
transliteration: bahu bea(n)t ooch te oochaa ||
english: He is vast and infinite, the highest of the high.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਆਪਹਿ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak aapas kau aapahi pahoochaa ||6||
english: O Nanak, He alone can reach Himself. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਆਪਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਅਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jah aap rachio parapa(n)ch akaar ||
english: When He Himself fashioned the visible world of the creation,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tihu gun mahi keeno bisathaar ||
english: he made the world subject to the three dispositions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਤਹ ਭਈ ਕਹਾਵਤ ॥
transliteration: paap pu(n)n tah bhaee kahaavat ||
english: Sin and virtue then began to be spoken of.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਊ ਨਰਕ ਕੋਊ ਸੁਰਗ ਬੰਛਾਵਤ ॥
transliteration: kooo narak kooo surag ba(n)chhaavat ||
english: Some have gone to hell, and some yearn for paradise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
transliteration: aal jaal maaiaa ja(n)jaal ||
english: Worldly snares and entanglements of Maya,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਭੈ ਭਾਰ ॥
transliteration: haumai moh bharam bhai bhaar ||
english: egotism, attachment, doubt and loads of fear;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਸੂਖ ਮਾਨ ਅਪਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: dookh sookh maan apamaan ||
english: pain and pleasure, honor and dishonor

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕੀਓ ਬਖੵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: anik prakaar keeo bakhyaan ||
english: these came to be described in various ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: aapan khel aap kar dekhai ||
english: He Himself creates and beholds His own drama.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਲੁ ਸੰਕੋਚੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: khel sa(n)kochai tau naanak ekai ||7||
english: He winds up the drama, and then, O Nanak, He alone remains. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਅਬਿਗਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਤਹ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: jah abigat bhagat tah aap ||
english: Wherever the Eternal Lord's devotee is, He Himself is there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਪਸਰੈ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਰਤਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: jah pasarai paasaar sa(n)t parataap ||
english: He unfolds the expanse of His creation for the glory of His Saint.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੂ ਪਾਖ ਕਾ ਆਪਹਿ ਧਨੀ ॥
transliteration: duhoo paakh kaa aapahi dhanee ||
english: He Himself is the Master of both worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਉਨਹੂ ਬਨੀ ॥
transliteration: un kee sobhaa unahoo banee ||
english: His Praise is to Himself alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਕਉਤਕ ਕਰੈ ਅਨਦ ਚੋਜ ॥
transliteration: aapahi kautak karai anad choj ||
english: He Himself performs and plays His amusements and games.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਨ ਨਿਰਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: aapahi ras bhogan nirajog ||
english: He Himself enjoys pleasures, and yet He is unaffected and untouched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jis bhaavai tis aapan naai laavai ||
english: He attaches whomever He pleases to His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਖੇਲ ਖਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jis bhaavai tis khel khilaavai ||
english: He causes whomever He pleases to play in His play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਗਨਤ ਅਤੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: besumaar athaah aganat atolai ||
english: He is beyond calculation, beyond measure, uncountable and unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਬੋਲੈ ॥੮॥੨੧॥
transliteration: jiu bulaavahu tiu naanak daas bolai ||8||21||
english: As You inspire him to speak, O Lord, so does servant Nanak speak. ||8||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਣਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t ke thaakuraa aape varatanahaar ||
english: O Lord and Master of all beings and creatures, You Yourself are prevailing everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak eko pasariaa doojaa kah drisataar ||1||
english: O Nanak, The One is All-pervading; where is any other to be seen? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਥੈ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਨਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aap kathai aap sunanaihaar ||
english: He Himself is the speaker, and He Himself is the listener.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aapahi ek aap bisathaar ||
english: He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai taa srisat upaae ||
english: When it pleases Him, He creates the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aapanai bhaanai lae samaae ||
english: As He pleases, He absorbs it back into Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tum te bhi(n)n nahee kichh hoi ||
english: Without You, nothing can be done.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਸੂਤਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aapan soot sabh jagat paroi ||
english: Upon Your thread, You have strung the whole world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau prabh jeeu aap bujhaae ||
english: One whom God Himself inspires to understand

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sach naam soee jan paae ||
english: - that person obtains the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਤਤ ਕਾ ਬੇਤਾ ॥
transliteration: so samadarasee tat kaa betaa ||
english: He looks impartially upon all, and he knows the essential reality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਜੇਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sagal srisat kaa jetaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, he conquers the whole world. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)tr sabh taa kai haath ||
english: All beings and creatures are in His Hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal anaath ko naath ||
english: He is Merciful to the meek, the Patron of the patronless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jis raakhai tis koi na maarai ||
english: No one can kill those who are protected by Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੂਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so mooaa jis manahu bisaarai ||
english: One who is forgotten by God, is already dead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਤਜਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tis taj avar kahaa ko jaai ||
english: Leaving Him, where else could anyone go?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸਿਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh sir ek nira(n)jan raai ||
english: Over the heads of all is the One, the Immaculate King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: jee kee jugat jaa kai sabh haath ||
english: The ways and means of all beings are in His Hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar jaanahu saath ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, know that He is with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan bea(n)t apaar ||
english: He is the Ocean of excellence, infinite and endless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak daas sadaa balihaar ||2||
english: Slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: pooran poor rahe daiaal ||
english: The Perfect, Merciful Lord is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sabh oopar hovat kirapaal ||
english: His kindness extends to all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: apane karatab jaanai aap ||
english: He Himself knows His own ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee rahio biaap ||
english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is present everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਜੀਅਨ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: pratipaalai jeean bahu bhaat ||
english: He cherishes His living beings in so many ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਰਚਿਓ ਸੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jo jo rachio s tisahi dhiaat ||
english: That which He has created meditates on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis bhaavai tis lae milaai ||
english: Whoever pleases Him, He blends into Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat karahi har ke gun gaai ||
english: They perform His devotional service and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: man a(n)tar bisvaas kar maaniaa ||
english: With heart-felt faith, they believe in Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਹਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karanahaar naanak ik jaaniaa ||3||
english: O Nanak, they realize the One, the Creator Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jan laagaa har ekai naai ||
english: The Lord's humble servant is committed to His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tis kee aas na birathee jaai ||
english: His hopes do not go in vain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sevak kau sevaa ban aaee ||
english: The servant's purpose is to serve;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hukam boojh param pad paaee ||
english: obeying the Lord's Command, the supreme status is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: is te oopar nahee beechaar ||
english: Beyond this, he has no other thought.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai man basiaa nira(n)kaar ||
english: Within his mind, the Formless Lord abides.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan tor bhae niravair ||
english: His bonds are cut away, and he becomes free of hatred.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੈਰ ॥
transliteration: anadin poojahi gur ke pair ||
english: Night and day, he worships the Feet of the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: ih lok sukheee paralok suhele ||
english: He is at peace in this world, and happy in the next.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਮੇਲੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak har prabh aapahi mele ||4||
english: O Nanak, the Lord God unites him with Himself. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mil karahu ana(n)d ||
english: Join the Company of the Holy, and be happy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavahu prabh paramaana(n)d ||
english: Sing the Glories of God, the embodiment of supreme bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਤਤੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raam naam tat karahu beechaar ||
english: Contemplate the essence of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: drulabh deh kaa karahu udhaar ||
english: Redeem this human body, so difficult to obtain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit bachan har ke gun gaau ||
english: Sing the Ambrosial Words of the Lord's Glorious Praises;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਰਨ ਕਾ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: praan taran kaa ihai suaau ||
english: this is the way to save your mortal soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਹੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar prabh pekhahu neraa ||
english: Behold God near at hand, twenty-four hours a day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mitai agiaan binasai a(n)dheraa ||
english: Ignorance shall depart, and darkness shall be dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sun upades hiradai basaavahu ||
english: Listen to the Teachings, and enshrine them in your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: man ichhe naanak phal paavahu ||5||
english: O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੁਇ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: halat palat dui lehu savaar ||
english: Embellish both this world and the next;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: raam naam a(n)tar ur dhaar ||
english: enshrine the Lord's Name deep within your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਦੀਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kee pooree deekhiaa ||
english: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jis man basai tis saach pareekhiaa ||
english: That person, within whose mind it abides, realizes the Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan naam japahu liv laai ||
english: With your mind and body, chant the Naam; lovingly attune yourself to it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dookh darad man te bhau jaai ||
english: Sorrow, pain and fear shall depart from your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sach vaapaar karahu vaapaaree ||
english: Deal in the true trade, O trader,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਖੇਪ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: daragah nibahai khep tumaaree ||
english: and your merchandise shall be safe in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਟੇਕ ਰਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ekaa tek rakhahu man maahi ||
english: Keep the Support of the One in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak bahur na aavahi jaahi ||6||
english: O Nanak, you shall not have to come and go in reincarnation again. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tis te door kahaa ko jaai ||
english: Where can anyone go, to get away from Him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਬਰੈ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: ubarai raakhanahaar dhiaai ||
english: Meditating on the Protector Lord, you shall be saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਪੈ ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau japai sagal bhau mitai ||
english: Meditating on the Fearless Lord, all fear departs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kirapaa te praanee chhutai ||
english: By God's Grace, mortals are released.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਖ ॥
transliteration: jis prabh raakhai tis naahee dookh ||
english: One who is protected by God never suffers in pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੂਖ ॥
transliteration: naam japat man hovat sookh ||
english: Chanting the Naam, the mind becomes peaceful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: chi(n)taa jaai mitai aha(n)kaar ||
english: Anxiety departs, and ego is eliminated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tis jan kau koi na pahuchanahaar ||
english: No one can equal that humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਠਾਢਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sir oopar thaadhaa gur sooraa ||
english: The Brave and Powerful Guru stands over his head.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak taa ke kaaraj pooraa ||7||
english: O Nanak, his efforts are fulfilled. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ॥
transliteration: mat pooree a(n)mrit jaa kee drisat ||
english: His wisdom is perfect, and His Glance is Ambrosial.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਉਧਰਤ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ॥
transliteration: darasan pekhat udharat srisat ||
english: Beholding His Vision, the universe is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal jaa ke anoop ||
english: His Lotus Feet are incomparably beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: saphal darasan su(n)dar har roop ||
english: The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; His Lordly Form is beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n sevaa sevak paravaan ||
english: Blessed is His service; His servant is famous.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee purakh pradhaan ||
english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is the most exalted Supreme Being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jis man basai s hot nihaal ||
english: That one, within whose mind He abides, is blissfully happy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: taa kai nikat na aavat kaal ||
english: Death does not draw near him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰ ਭਏ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: amar bhae amaraa pad paaiaa ||
english: One becomes immortal, and obtains the immortal status,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੮॥੨੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak har dhiaaiaa ||8||22||
english: meditating on the Lord, O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy. ||8||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: giaan a(n)jan gur deeaa agiaan a(n)dher binaas ||
english: The Guru has given the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, and dispelled the darkness of ignorance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kirapaa te sa(n)t bhetiaa naanak man paragaas ||1||
english: By the Lord's Grace, I have met the Saint; O Nanak, my mind is enlightened. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g a(n)tar prabh deethaa ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, I see God deep within my being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: naam prabhoo kaa laagaa meethaa ||
english: God's Name is sweet to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਿਗ੍ਰੀ ਏਕਸੁ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sagal samigree ekas ghat maahi ||
english: All things are contained in the Heart of the One,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਨਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: anik ra(n)g naanaa drisataahi ||
english: although they appear in so many various colors.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: nau nidh a(n)mrit prabh kaa naam ||
english: The nine treasures are in the Ambrosial Name of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: dehee mahi is kaa bisraam ||
english: Within the human body is its place of rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਤਹ ਨਾਦ ॥
transliteration: su(n)n samaadh anahat tah naad ||
english: The Deepest Samaadhi, and the unstruck sound current of the Naad are there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਅਚਰਜ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
transliteration: kahan na jaaee acharaj bisamaad ||
english: The wonder and marvel of it cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tin dekhiaa jis aap dikhaae ||
english: He alone sees it, unto whom God Himself reveals it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tis jan sojhee paae ||1||
english: O Nanak, that humble being understands. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
transliteration: so a(n)tar so baahar ana(n)t ||
english: The Infinite Lord is inside, and outside as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat biaap rahiaa bhagava(n)t ||
english: Deep within each and every heart, the Lord God is pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਨਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਆਕਾਸ ਪਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: dharan maahi aakaas paiaal ||
english: In the earth, in the Akaashic ethers, and in the nether regions of the underworld

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਲੋਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sarab lok pooran pratipaal ||
english: in all worlds, He is the Perfect Cherisher.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਨਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਰਬਤਿ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
transliteration: ban tin parabat hai paarabraham ||
english: In the forests, fields and mountains, He is the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਤੈਸਾ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jaisee aagiaa taisaa karam ||
english: As He orders, so do His creatures act.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: paun paanee baisa(n)tar maahi ||
english: He permeates the winds and the waters.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸੇ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: chaar ku(n)t dah dise samaahi ||
english: He is pervading in the four corners and in the ten directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tis te bhi(n)n nahee ko thaau ||
english: Without Him, there is no place at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak sukh paau ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, peace is obtained. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan si(n)mrit mahi dekh ||
english: See Him in the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਸੀਅਰ ਸੂਰ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ॥
transliteration: saseear soor nakhytr mahi ek ||
english: In the moon, the sun and the stars, He is the One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: baanee prabh kee sabh ko bolai ||
english: The Bani of God's Word is spoken by everyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਡੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: aap adol na kabahoo dolai ||
english: He Himself is unwavering - He never wavers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲ ॥
transliteration: sarab kalaa kar khelai khel ||
english: With absolute power, He plays His play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣਹ ਅਮੋਲ ॥
transliteration: mol na paaeeai gunah amol ||
english: His value cannot be estimated; His virtues are invaluable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sarab jot mahi jaa kee jot ||
english: In all light, is His Light.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: dhaar rahio suaamee ot pot ||
english: The Lord and Master supports the weave of the fabric of the universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਰਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad bharam kaa naas ||
english: By Guru's Grace, doubt is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak tin mahi ehu bisaas ||3||
english: O Nanak, this faith is firmly implanted within. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਪੇਖਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kaa pekhan sabh braham ||
english: In the eye of the Saint, everything is God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kai hiradai sabh dharam ||
english: In the heart of the Saint, everything is Dharma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਸੁਭ ਬਚਨ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa sunahi subh bachan ||
english: The Saint hears words of goodness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਬਿਆਪੀ ਰਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚਨ ॥
transliteration: sarab biaapee raam sa(n)g rachan ||
english: He is absorbed in the All-pervading Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਰਹਤ ॥
transliteration: jin jaataa tis kee ih rahat ||
english: This is the way of life of one who knows God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਭਿ ਕਹਤ ॥
transliteration: sat bachan saadhoo sabh kahat ||
english: True are all the words spoken by the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jo jo hoi soee sukh maanai ||
english: Whatever happens, he peacefully accepts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavanahaar prabh jaanai ||
english: He knows God as the Doer, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੀ ਓਹੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar base baahar bhee ohee ||
english: He dwells inside, and outside as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਭ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak darasan dekh sabh mohee ||4||
english: O Nanak, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are fascinated. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸਤਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸਤਿ ॥
transliteration: aap sat keeaa sabh sat ||
english: He Himself is True, and all that He has made is True.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਸਗਲੀ ਉਤਪਤਿ ॥
transliteration: tis prabh te sagalee utapat ||
english: The entire creation came from God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tis bhaavai taa kare bisathaar ||
english: As it pleases Him, He creates the expanse.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tis bhaavai taa eka(n)kaar ||
english: As it pleases Him, He becomes the One and Only again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਲਾ ਲਖੀ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anik kalaa lakhee nah jaai ||
english: His powers are so numerous, they cannot be known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis bhaavai tis lae milaai ||
english: As it pleases Him, He merges us into Himself again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਵਨ ਕਹੀਐ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kavan nikat kavan kaheeai door ||
english: Who is near, and who is far away?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aape aap aap bharapoor ||
english: He Himself is Himself pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਨਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)taragat jis aap janaae ||
english: One whom God causes to know that He is within the heart

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak tis jan aap bujhaae ||5||
english: - O Nanak, He causes that person to understand Him. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab bhoot aap varataaraa ||
english: In all forms, He Himself is pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨੈਨ ਆਪਿ ਪੇਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab nain aap pekhanahaaraa ||
english: Through all eyes, He Himself is watching.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal samagree jaa kaa tanaa ||
english: All the creation is His Body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਜਸੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਸੁਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aapan jas aap hee sunaa ||
english: He Himself listens to His Own Praise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaan ik khel banaaiaa ||
english: The One has created the drama of coming and going.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aagiaakaaree keenee maaiaa ||
english: He made Maya subservient to His Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh kai madh alipato rahai ||
english: In the midst of all, He remains unattached.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh kahanaa s aape kahai ||
english: Whatever is said, He Himself says.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆ ਆਵੈ ਆਗਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aagiaa aavai aagiaa jaai ||
english: By His Will we come, and by His Will we go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak jaa bhaavai taa lae samaai ||6||
english: O Nanak, when it pleases Him, then He absorbs us into Himself. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੁਰਾ ॥
transliteration: is te hoi s naahee buraa ||
english: If it comes from Him, it cannot be bad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਰੈ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਾ ॥
transliteration: orai kahahu kinai kachh karaa ||
english: Other than Him, who can do anything?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕੀ ॥
transliteration: aap bhalaa karatoot at neekee ||
english: He Himself is good; His actions are the very best.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: aape jaanai apane jee kee ||
english: He Himself knows His Own Being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭ ਸਾਚੁ ॥
transliteration: aap saach dhaaree sabh saach ||
english: He Himself is True, and all that He has established is True.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੁ ॥
transliteration: ot pot aapan sa(n)g raach ||
english: Through and through, He is blended with His creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: taa kee gat mit kahee na jaai ||
english: His state and extent cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doosar hoi ta sojhee paai ||
english: If there were another like Him, then only he could understand Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa keeaa sabh paravaan ||
english: His actions are all approved and accepted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak ihu jaan ||7||
english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, this is known. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo jaanai tis sadaa sukh hoi ||
