english: One who knows Him, obtains everlasting peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aap milaai lae prabh soi ||
english: God blends that one into Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਧਨਵੰਤੁ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੁ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: ohu dhanava(n)t kulava(n)t pativa(n)t ||
english: He is wealth and prosperous, and of noble birth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jeevan mukat jis ridai bhagava(n)t ||
english: He is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive; the Lord God abides in his heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n dha(n)n jan aaiaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed, blessed is the coming of that humble being;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis prasaad sabh jagat taraaiaa ||
english: by his grace, the whole world is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਆਵਨ ਕਾ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: jan aavan kaa ihai suaau ||
english: This is his purpose in life;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jan kai sa(n)g chit aavai naau ||
english: in the Company of this humble servant, the Lord's Name comes to mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aap mukat mukat karai sa(n)saar ||
english: He Himself is liberated, and He liberates the universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੨੩॥
transliteration: naanak tis jan kau sadaa namasakaar ||8||23||
english: O Nanak, to that humble servant, I bow in reverence forever. ||8||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pooraa prabh aaraadhiaa pooraa jaa kaa naau ||
english: I worship and adore the Perfect Lord God. Perfect is His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak pooraa paaiaa poore ke gun gaau ||1||
english: O Nanak, I have obtained the Perfect One; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: asatapadee ||
english: Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kaa sun upades ||
english: Listen to the Teachings of the Perfect Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਪੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham nikat kar pekh ||
english: see the Supreme Lord God near you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: saas saas simarahu gobi(n)d ||
english: With each and every breath, meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਉਤਰੈ ਚਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: man a(n)tar kee utarai chi(n)d ||
english: and the anxiety within your mind shall depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਅਨਿਤ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਤਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: aas anit tiaagahu tara(n)g ||
english: Abandon the waves of fleeting desire,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੰਗ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee dhoor man ma(n)g ||
english: and pray for the dust of the feet of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aap chhod benatee karahu ||
english: Renounce your selfishness and conceit and offer your prayers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g agan saagar tarahu ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, cross over the ocean of fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: har dhan ke bhar lehu bha(n)daar ||
english: Fill your stores with the wealth of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak gur poore namasakaar ||1||
english: Nanak bows in humility and reverence to the Perfect Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਮ ਕੁਸਲ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: khem kusal sahaj aana(n)d ||
english: Happiness, intuitive peace, poise and bliss

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਜੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g bhaj paramaana(n)d ||
english: in the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Lord of supreme bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਉਧਾਰਹੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: narak nivaar udhaarahu jeeu ||
english: You shall be spared from hell - save your soul!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gun gobi(n)d a(n)mrit ras peeu ||
english: Drink in the ambrosial essence of the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਹੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: chit chitavahu naaraain ek ||
english: Focus your consciousness on the One, the All-pervading Lord

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
transliteration: ek roop jaa ke ra(n)g anek ||
english: He has One Form, but He has many manifestations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: gopaal daamodar deen daiaal ||
english: Sustainer of the Universe, Lord of the world, Kind to the poor,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: dukh bha(n)jan pooran kirapaal ||
english: Destroyer of sorrow, perfectly Merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: simar simar naam baara(n) baar ||
english: Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Naam, again and again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਇਹੈ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jee kaa ihai adhaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, it is the Support of the soul. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਤਮ ਸਲੋਕ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ॥
transliteration: utam salok saadh ke bachan ||
english: The most sublime hymns are the Words of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲੀਕ ਲਾਲ ਏਹਿ ਰਤਨ ॥
transliteration: amuleek laal ehi ratan ||
english: These are priceless rubies and gems.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਤ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਹੋਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sunat kamaavat hot udhaar ||
english: One who listens and acts on them is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਲੋਕਹ ਨਿਸਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aap tarai lokah nisataar ||
english: He himself swims across, and saves others as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: saphal jeevan saphal taa kaa sa(n)g ||
english: His life is prosperous, and his company is fruitful;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai man laagaa har ra(n)g ||
english: his mind is imbued with the love of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jai jai sabad anaahad vaajai ||
english: Hail, hail to him, for whom the sound current of the Shabad vibrates.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਨਦ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: sun sun anad kare prabh gaajai ||
english: Hearing it again and again, he is in bliss, proclaiming God's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਮਹਾਂਤ ਕੈ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: pragate gupaal mahaa(n)t kai maathe ||
english: The Lord radiates from the foreheads of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak udhare tin kai saathe ||3||
english: Nanak is saved in their company. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: saran jog sun saranee aae ||
english: Hearing that He can give Sanctuary, I have come seeking His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aap milaae ||
english: Bestowing His Mercy, God has blended me with Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਬੈਰ ਭਏ ਸਭ ਰੇਨ ॥
transliteration: mit gae bair bhae sabh ren ||
english: Hatred is gone, and I have become the dust of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਲੈਨ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam saadhasa(n)g lain ||
english: I have received the Ambrosial Naam in the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: suprasa(n)n bhae guradev ||
english: The Divine Guru is perfectly pleased;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: pooran hoee sevak kee sev ||
english: the service of His servant has been rewarded.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
transliteration: aal ja(n)jaal bikaar te rahate ||
english: I have been released from worldly entanglements and corruption,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਤੇ ॥
transliteration: raam naam sun rasanaa kahate ||
english: hearing the Lord's Name and chanting it with my tongue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kar prasaad daiaa prabh dhaaree ||
english: By His Grace, God has bestowed His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਖੇਪ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak nibahee khep hamaaree ||4||
english: O Nanak, my merchandise has arrived save and sound. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee usatat karahu sa(n)t meet ||
english: Sing the Praises of God, O Saints, O friends,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਏਕਾਗਰ ਚੀਤ ॥
transliteration: saavadhaan ekaagar cheet ||
english: with total concentration and one-pointedness of mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਮਨੀ ਸਹਜ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sukhamanee sahaj gobi(n)d gun naam ||
english: Sukhmani is the peaceful ease, the Glory of God, the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jis man basai s hot nidhaan ||
english: When it abides in the mind, one becomes wealthy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਇਛਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sarab ichhaa taa kee pooran hoi ||
english: All desires are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: pradhaan purakh pragat sabh loi ||
english: One becomes the most respected person, famous all over the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਪਾਏ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh te ooch paae asathaan ||
english: He obtains the highest place of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: bahur na hovai aavan jaan ||
english: He does not come and go in reincarnation any longer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har dhan khaat chalai jan soi ||
english: One who departs, after earning the wealth of the Lord's Name,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak jisahi paraapat hoi ||5||
english: O Nanak, realizes it. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਮ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
transliteration: khem saa(n)t ridh nav nidh ||
english: Comfort, peace and tranquility, wealth and the nine treasures;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਤਹ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
transliteration: budh giaan sarab tah sidh ||
english: wisdom, knowledge, and all spiritual powers;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਤਪੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: bidiaa tap jog prabh dhiaan ||
english: learning, penance, Yoga and meditation on God;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਊਤਮ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: giaan sresat ootam isanaan ||
english: The most sublime wisdom and purifying baths;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: chaar padaarath kamal pragaas ||
english: the four cardinal blessings, the opening of the heart-lotus;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ ਸਗਲ ਤੇ ਉਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: sabh kai madh sagal te udaas ||
english: in the midst of all, and yet detached from all;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਤਤ ਕਾ ਬੇਤਾ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar chatur tat kaa betaa ||
english: beauty, intelligence, and the realization of reality;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
transliteration: samadarasee ek drisatetaa ||
english: to look impartially upon all, and to see only the One

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਫਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਨੇ ॥
transliteration: ih phal tis jan kai mukh bhane ||
english: - these blessings come to one who,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਚਨ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਨੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gur naanak naam bachan man sune ||6||
english: through Guru Nanak, chants the Naam with his mouth, and hears the Word with his ears. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu nidhaan japai man koi ||
english: One who chants this treasure in his mind

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh jug mahi taa kee gat hoi ||
english: in every age, he attains salvation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gun gobi(n)d naam dhun baanee ||
english: In it is the Glory of God, the Naam, the chanting of Gurbani.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਬਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: simrit saasatr bed bakhaanee ||
english: The Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas speak of it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਤਾਂਤ ਕੇਵਲ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sagal mataa(n)t keval har naam ||
english: The essence of all religion is the Lord's Name alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d bhagat kai man bisraam ||
english: It abides in the minds of the devotees of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
transliteration: kot apraadh saadhasa(n)g mitai ||
english: Millions of sins are erased, in the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kripaa te jam te chhutai ||
english: By the Grace of the Saint, one escapes the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai masatak karam prabh paae ||
english: Those, who have such pre-ordained destiny on their foreheads,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਆਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: saadh saran naanak te aae ||7||
english: O Nanak, enter the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jis man basai sunai laai preet ||
english: One, within whose mind it abides, and who listens to it with love

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: tis jan aavai har prabh cheet ||
english: that humble person consciously remembers the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: janam maran taa kaa dookh nivaarai ||
english: The pains of birth and death are removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: dulabh deh tatakaal udhaarai ||
english: The human body, so difficult to obtain, is instantly redeemed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਭਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: niramal sobhaa a(n)mrit taa kee baanee ||
english: Spotlessly pure is his reputation, and ambrosial is his speech.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ek naam man maahi samaanee ||
english: The One Name permeates his mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ॥
transliteration: dookh rog binase bhai bharam ||
english: Sorrow, sickness, fear and doubt depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ॥
transliteration: saadh naam niramal taa ke karam ||
english: He is called a Holy person; his actions are immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh te ooch taa kee sobhaa banee ||
english: His glory becomes the highest of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਗੁਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਮਨੀ ॥੮॥੨੪॥
transliteration: naanak ih gun naam sukhamanee ||8||24||
english: O Nanak, by these Glorious Virtues, this is named Sukhmani, Peace of mind. ||8||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਿਤੀ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: thitee gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
english: T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days: Gauree, Fifth Mehl,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooriaa suaamee sirajanahaar ||
english: The Creator Lord and Master is pervading the water, the land, and the sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik bhaa(n)t hoi pasariaa naanak eka(n)kaar ||1||
english: In so many ways, the One, the Universal Creator has diffused Himself, O Nanak. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਮ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਉ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: ekam eka(n)kaar prabh karau ba(n)danaa dhiaai ||
english: The first day of the lunar cycle: Bow in humility and meditate on the One, the Universal Creator Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gun gobi(n)d gupaal prabh saran parau har raai ||
english: Praise God, the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World; seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੁਖ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: taa kee aas kaliaan sukh jaa te sabh kachh hoi ||
english: Place your hopes in Him, for salvation and peace; all things come from Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: chaar ku(n)t dah dis bhramio tis bin avar na koi ||
english: I wandered around the four corners of the world and in the ten directions, but I saw nothing except Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੁਨੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan simrit sune bahu bidh karau beechaar ||
english: I listened to the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, and I pondered over them in so many ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: patit udhaaran bhai haran sukh saagar nira(n)kaar ||
english: The Saving Grace of sinners, the Destroyer of fear, the Ocean of peace, the Formless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: daataa bhugataa denahaar tis bin avar na jaai ||
english: The Great Giver, the Enjoyer, the Bestower - there is no place at all without Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo chaahahi soee milai naanak har gun gaai ||1||
english: You shall obtain all that you desire, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d jas gaaeeai har neet ||
english: Sing the Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, each and every day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਭਜੀਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mil bhajeeai saadhasa(n)g mere meet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and vibrate, meditate on Him, O my friend. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਵਾਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: karau ba(n)danaa anik vaar saran parau har raai ||
english: Bow in humility to the Lord, over and over again, and enter the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhram kateeai naanak saadhasa(n)g duteeaa bhaau mitaai ||2||
english: Doubt is eradicated, O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy, and the love of duality is eliminated. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: duteeaa duramat door kar gur sevaa kar neet ||
english: The second day of the lunar cycle: Get rid of your evil-mindedness, and serve the Guru continually.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: raam ratan man tan basai taj kaam krodh lobh meet ||
english: The jewel of the Lord's Name shall come to dwell in your mind and body, when you renounce sexual desire, anger and greed, O my friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
transliteration: maran mitai jeevan milai binasahi sagal kales ||
english: Conquer death and obtain eternal life; all your troubles will depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
transliteration: aap tajahu gobi(n)d bhajahu bhaau bhagat paraves ||
english: Renounce your self-conceit and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe; loving devotion to Him shall permeate your being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੋਟਾ ਹਿਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: laabh milai totaa hirai har daragah pativa(n)t ||
english: You shall earn profit and suffer no loss, and in the Court of the Lord you shall be honored.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਵੈ ਸਾਚ ਸਾਹ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: raam naam dhan sa(n)chavai saach saah bhagava(n)t ||
english: Those who gather in the riches of the Lord's Name are truly wealthy, and very blessed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat har bhajahu saadhoo sa(n)g pareet ||
english: So, when standing up and sitting down, vibrate upon the Lord, and cherish the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੁਟਿ ਗਈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਸੇ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak duramat chhut gaee paarabraham base cheet ||2||
english: O Nanak, evil-mindedness is eradicated, when the Supreme Lord God comes to dwell in the mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਬਿਆਪਹਿ ਜਗਤ ਕਉ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: teen biaapahi jagat kau tureeaa paavai koi ||
english: The world is in the grip of the three qualities; only a few attain the fourth state of absorption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)t niramal bhae jin man vasiaa soi ||3||
english: O Nanak, the Saints are pure and immaculate; the Lord abides within their minds. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਖੈ ਫਲ ਕਬ ਉਤਮ ਕਬ ਨੀਚੁ ॥
transliteration: triteeaa trai gun bikhai phal kab utam kab neech ||
english: The third day of the lunar cycle: Those who are bound by the three qualities gather poison as their fruit; now they are good, and now they are bad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਉ ਘਣੋ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਮੀਚੁ ॥
transliteration: narak surag bhramatau ghano sadaa sa(n)ghaarai meech ||
english: They wander endlessly in heaven and hell, until death annihilates them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: harakh sog sahasaa sa(n)saar hau hau karat bihaai ||
english: In pleasure and pain and worldly cynicism, they pass their lives acting in ego.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jin keee tisahi na jaananee chitavahi anik upaai ||
english: They do not know the One who created them; they think up all sorts of schemes and plans.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਸ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: aadh biaadh upaadh ras kabahu na tootai taap ||
english: Their minds and bodies are distracted by pleasure and pain, and their fever never departs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਨੀ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham pooran dhanee nah boojhai parataap ||
english: They do not realize the glorious radiance of the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਬੂਡਤ ਘਣੋ ਮਹਾ ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸ ॥
transliteration: moh bharam boodat ghano mahaa narak mahi vaas ||
english: So many are being drowned in emotional attachment and doubt; they dwell in the most horrible hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh raakh lehu naanak teree aas ||3||
english: Please bless me with Your Mercy, God, and save me! Nanak places his hopes in You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਤਜਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: chatur siaanaa sughaR soi jin tajiaa abhimaan ||
english: One who renounces egotistical pride is intelligent, wise and refined.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: chaar padaarath asat sidh bhaj naanak har naam ||4||
english: The four cardinal blessings, and the eight spiritual powers of the Siddhas are obtained, O Nanak, by meditating, vibrating on the Lord's Name. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰਥਿ ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੋਧਿਓ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: chaturath chaare bed sun sodhio tat beechaar ||
english: The fourth day of the lunar cycle: Listening to the four Vedas, and contemplating the essence of reality, I have come to realize

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਖੇਮ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sarab khem kaliaan nidh raam naam jap saar ||
english: that the treasure of all joy and comfort is found in sublime meditation on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੈ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
transliteration: narak nivaarai dukh harai tootahi anik kales ||
english: One is saved from hell, suffering is destroyed, countless pains depart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਚੁ ਹੁਟੈ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
transliteration: meech hutai jam te chhutai har keeratan paraves ||
english: death is overcome, and one escapes the Messenger of Death, by absorption in the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bhau binasai a(n)mrit rasai ra(n)g rate nira(n)kaar ||
english: Fear departs, and one savors the Ambrosial Nectar, imbued with the Love of the Formless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਦਾਰਿਦ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: dukh daarid apavitrataa naasahi naam adhaar ||
english: Pain, poverty and impurity are removed, with the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਖੋਜਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sur nar mun jan khojate sukh saagar gopaal ||
english: The angels, the seers and the silent sages search for the Ocean of peace, the Sustainer of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੪॥
transliteration: man niramal mukh oojalaa hoi naanak saadh ravaal ||4||
english: The mind becomes pure, and one's face is radiant, O Nanak, when one becomes the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੇ ਰਾਚੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch bikaar man mahi base raache maaiaa sa(n)g ||
english: The five evil passions dwell in the mind of one who is engrossed in Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g hoi niramalaa naanak prabh kai ra(n)g ||5||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, one becomes pure, O Nanak, imbued with the Love of God. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚਮਿ ਪੰਚ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਤੇ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)cham pa(n)ch pradhaan te jih jaanio parapa(n)ch ||
english: The fifth day of the lunar cycle: They are the self-elect, the most distinguished, who know the true nature of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਘਣੋ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਬਲਬੰਚੁ ॥
transliteration: kusam baas bahu ra(n)g ghano sabh mithiaa balaba(n)ch ||
english: The many colors and scents of flowers - all worldly deceptions are transitory and false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਜਾਪੈ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: nah jaapai nah boojheeai nah kachh karat beechaar ||
english: People do not see, and they do not understand; they do not reflect upon anything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਦ ਮੋਹ ਰਸ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: suaad moh ras bedhio agiaan rachio sa(n)saar ||
english: The world is pierced through with attachment to tastes and pleasures, engrossed in ignorance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਣ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
transliteration: janam maran bahu jon bhraman keene karam anek ||
english: Those who perform empty religious rituals will be born, only to die again. They wander through endless incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਚਨਹਾਰੁ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
transliteration: rachanahaar nah simario man na beechaar bibek ||
english: They do not meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord; their minds do not understand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਿਪਤ ਨ ਰੰਚ ॥
transliteration: bhaau bhagat bhagavaan sa(n)g maaiaa lipat na ra(n)ch ||
english: By loving devotion to the Lord God, you shall not be polluted by Maya at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਜੋ ਨ ਰਚਹਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak birale paaeeahi jo na rachahi parapa(n)ch ||5||
english: O Nanak, how rare are those, who are not engrossed in worldly entanglements. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਟ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਊਚੌ ਕਹਹਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: khat saasatr oochau kahahi a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: The six Shaastras proclaim Him to be the greatest; He has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bhagat sohahi gun gaavate naanak prabh kai duaar ||6||
english: The devotees look beauteous, O Nanak, when they sing the Glories of God at His Door. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਸਟਮਿ ਖਟ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕਥਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
transliteration: khasatam khat saasatr kahahi si(n)mrit kathahi anek ||
english: The sixth day of the lunar cycle: The six Shaastras say, and countless Simritees assert,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮੁ ਊਚੌ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੇਖ ॥
transliteration: ootam oochau paarabraham gun a(n)t na jaanahi sekh ||
english: that the Supreme Lord God is the most sublime and lofty. Even the thousand-tongued serpent does not know the limits of His Glories.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੁਕ ਬਿਆਸ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: naarad mun jan suk biaas jas gaavat gobi(n)d ||
english: Naarad, the humble beings, Suk and Vyaasa sing the Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਗੀਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬੀਧੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਚੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: ras geedhe har siu beedhe bhagat rache bhagava(n)t ||
english: They are imbued with the Lord's essence; united with Him; they are absorbed in devotional worship of the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਪਾਈ ਸਰਨਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: moh maan bhram binasio paaee saran daiaal ||
english: Emotional attachment, pride and doubt are eliminated, when one takes to the Sanctuary of the Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal man tan base darasan dekh nihaal ||
english: His Lotus Feet abide within my mind and body and I am enraptured, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੋਟਾ ਹਿਰੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: laabh milai totaa hirai saadhasa(n)g liv laai ||
english: People reap their profits, and suffer no loss, when they embrace love for the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਟਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: khaat khajaanaa gun nidh hare naanak naam dhiaai ||6||
english: They gather in the treasure of the Lord, the Ocean of Excellence, O Nanak, by meditating on the Naam. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਥਹਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ma(n)dal har jas kathahi bolahi sat subhaai ||
english: In the gathering of the Saints, chant the Praises of the Lord, and speak the Truth with love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak man sa(n)tokheeai ekas siu liv laai ||7||
english: O Nanak, the mind becomes contented, enshrining love for the One Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਪਤਮਿ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਟੂਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sapatam sa(n)chahu naam dhan toot na jaahi bha(n)daar ||
english: The seventh day of the lunar cycle: Gather the wealth of the Naam; this is a treasure which shall never be exhausted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)gat mahi paaeeai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, He is obtained; He has no end or limitations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aap tajahu gobi(n)d bhajahu saran parahu har raai ||
english: Renounce your selfishness and conceit, and meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe; take to the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਹਰੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dookh harai bhavajal tarai man chi(n)diaa phal paai ||
english: Your pains shall depart - swim across the terrifying world-ocean, and obtain the fruits of your mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar man har japai saphal janam paravaan ||
english: One who meditates on the Lord twenty-four hours a day - fruitful and blessed is his coming into the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar sadaa sa(n)g karanaihaar pachhaan ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, realize that the Creator Lord is always with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਸਖਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: so saajan so sakhaa meet jo har kee mat dei ||
english: He is your friend, your companion, your very best friend, who imparts the Teachings of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak tis balihaaranai har har naam japei ||7||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice to one who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਤਜੀਅਹਿ ਅਵਰਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar gun gaaeeahi tajeeahi avar ja(n)jaal ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord twenty-four hours a day; renounce other entanglements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jamaka(n)kar johi na sakaee naanak prabhoo daiaal ||8||
english: The Minister of Death cannot even see that person, O Nanak, unto whom God is merciful. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਮੀ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
transliteration: asatamee asat sidh nav nidh ||
english: The eighth day of the lunar cycle: The eight spiritual powers of the Siddhas, the nine treasures,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
transliteration: sagal padaarath pooran budh ||
english: all precious things, perfect intellect,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: kaval pragaas sadaa aana(n)d ||
english: the opening of the heart-lotus, eternal bliss,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ਨਿਰੋਧਰ ਮੰਤ ॥
transliteration: niramal reet nirodhar ma(n)t ||
english: pure lifestyle, the infallible Mantra,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sagal dharam pavitr isanaan ||
english: all Dharmic virtues, sacred purifying baths,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਊਚ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi ooch bisekh giaan ||
english: the most lofty and sublime spiritual wisdom

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: har har bhajan poore gur sa(n)g ||
english: these are obtained by meditating, vibrating upon the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jap tareeai naanak naam har ra(n)g ||8||
english: You shall be saved, O Nanak, by lovingly chanting the Lord's Name. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਸੁਆਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naaraain nah simario mohio suaad bikaar ||
english: He does not remember the Lord in meditation; he is fascinated by the pleasures of corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak naam bisaariai narak surag avataar ||9||
english: O Nanak, forgetting the Naam, he is reincarnated into heaven and hell. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉਮੀ ਨਵੇ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਅਪਵੀਤ ॥
transliteration: naumee nave chhidr apaveet ||
english: The ninth day of the lunar cycle: The nine holes of the body are defiled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har naam na japahi karat bipareet ||
english: People do not chant the Lord's Name; instead, they practice evil.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰਮਹਿ ਬਕਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਨਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: par tri ramahi bakahi saadh ni(n)d ||
english: They commit adultery, slander the Saints,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਨ ਸੁਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: karan na sunahee har jas bi(n)d ||
english: and do not listen to even a tiny bit of the Lord's Praise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਹਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਉਦਰ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hirahi par darab udar kai taaee ||
english: They steal others' wealth for the sake of their own bellies,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: agan na nivarai trisanaa na bujhaaee ||
english: but the fire is not extinguished, and their thirst is not quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਏਹ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: har sevaa bin eh phal laage ||
english: Without serving the Lord, these are their rewards.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਮਰਿ ਜਮਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak prabh bisarat mar jamahi abhaage ||9||
english: O Nanak, forgetting God, the unfortunate people are born, only to die. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਦਿਸ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: das dis khojat mai phirio jat dekhau tat soi ||
english: I have wandered, searching in the ten directions - wherever I look, there I see Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: man bas aavai naanakaa je pooran kirapaa hoi ||10||
english: The mind comes to be controlled, O Nanak, if He grants His Perfect Grace. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸਮੀ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: dasamee das duaar bas keene ||
english: The tenth day of the lunar cycle: Overpower the ten sensory and motor organs;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਲੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: man sa(n)tokh naam jap leene ||
english: your mind will be content, as you chant the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਜਸੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: karanee suneeai jas gopaal ||
english: With your ears, hear the Praises of the Lord of the World;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨੀ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: nainee pekhat saadh daiaal ||
english: with your eyes, behold the kind, Holy Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa gun gaavai bea(n)t ||
english: With your tongue, sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: man mahi chitavai pooran bhagava(n)t ||
english: In your mind, remember the Perfect Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: hasat charan sa(n)t tahal kamaaeeai ||
english: With your hands and feet, work for the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak ihu sa(n)jam prabh kirapaa paaeeai ||10||
english: O Nanak, this way of life is obtained by God's Grace. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਸ੍ਵਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: eko ek bakhaaneeai biralaa jaanai svaad ||
english: Describe the Lord as the One, the One and Only. How rare are those who know the taste of this essence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: gun gobi(n)d na jaaneeai naanak sabh bisamaad ||11||
english: The Glories of the Lord of the Universe cannot be known. O Nanak, He is totally amazing and wonderful! ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਪੇਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: ekaadasee nikat pekhahu har raam ||
english: The eleventh day of the lunar cycle: Behold the Lord, the Lord, near at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਬਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: i(n)dree bas kar sunahu har naam ||
english: Subdue the desires of your sexual organs, and listen to the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man sa(n)tokh sarab jee daiaa ||
english: Let your mind be content, and be kind to all beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਰਤੁ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: in bidh barat sa(n)pooran bhaiaa ||
english: In this way, your fast will be successful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਇਕ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat man raakhai ik thaai ||
english: Keep your wandering mind restrained in one place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan sudh japat har naai ||
english: Your mind and body shall become pure, chanting the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi poor rahe paarabraham ||
english: The Supreme Lord God is pervading amongst all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਟਲ ਏਹੁ ਧਰਮ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak har keeratan kar atal ehu dharam ||11||
english: O Nanak, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; this alone is the eternal faith of Dharma. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: duramat haree sevaa karee bhete saadh kripaal ||
english: Evil-mindedness is eliminated, by meeting with and serving the compassionate Holy Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak prabh siu mil rahe binase sagal ja(n)jaal ||12||
english: Nanak is merged with God; all his entanglements have come to an end. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਦਸੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: duaadasee daan naam isanaan ||
english: The twelfth day of the lunar cycle: Dedicate yourself to giving charity, chanting the Naam and purification.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: har kee bhagat karahu taj maan ||
english: Worship the Lord with devotion, and get rid of your pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਾਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)mrit paan karahu saadhasa(n)g ||
english: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: man tripataasai keeratan prabh ra(n)g ||
english: The mind is satisfied by lovingly singing the Kirtan of God's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਭ ਕਉ ਸੰਤੋਖੈ ॥
transliteration: komal baanee sabh kau sa(n)tokhai ||
english: The Sweet Words of His Bani soothe everyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਆਤਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਪੋਖੈ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch bhoo aatamaa har naam ras pokhai ||
english: The soul, the subtle essence of the five elements, cherishes the Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਏਹ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gur poore te eh nihachau paaeeai ||
english: This faith is obtained from the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak raam ramat phir jon na aaeeai ||12||
english: O Nanak, dwelling upon the Lord, you shall not enter the womb of reincarnation again. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: teen gunaa mahi biaapiaa pooran hot na kaam ||
english: Engrossed in the three qualities, one's efforts do not succeed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਮ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: patit udhaaran man basai naanak chhootai naam ||13||
english: When the Saving Grace of sinners dwells in the mind, O Nanak, then one is saved by the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਉਦਸੀ ਤੀਨਿ ਤਾਪ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: traudasee teen taap sa(n)saar ||
english: The thirteenth day of the lunar cycle: The world is in the fever of the three qualities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਨਰਕ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aavat jaat narak avataar ||
english: It comes and goes, and is reincarnated in hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: har har bhajan na man mahi aaio ||
english: Meditation on the Lord, Har, Har, does not enter into the minds of the people.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar prabh nimakh na gaaio ||
english: They do not sing the Praises of God, the Ocean of peace, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਾ ਦੇਹ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ॥
transliteration: harakh sog kaa deh kar baadhio ||
english: This body is the embodiment of pleasure and pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਸਾਧਿਓ ॥
transliteration: deeragh rog maaiaa aasaadhio ||
english: It suffers from the chronic and incurable disease of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕਰਤ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: dinahi bikaar karat sram paaio ||
english: By day, people practice corruption, wearing themselves out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨੀ ਨੀਦ ਸੁਪਨ ਬਰੜਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: nainee need supan baraRaaio ||
english: And then with sleep in their eyes, they mutter in dreams.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਹੋਵਤ ਏਹ ਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: har bisarat hovat eh haal ||
english: Forgetting the Lord, this is their condition.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: saran naanak prabh purakh daiaal ||13||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the kind and compassionate Primal Being. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਚਉਦਹ ਭਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: chaar ku(n)t chaudah bhavan sagal biaapat raam ||
english: The Lord is pervading in all the four directions and the fourteen worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਊਨ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak oon na dekheeai pooran taa ke kaam ||14||
english: O Nanak, He is not seen to be lacking anything; His works are perfectly complete. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਉਦਹਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪ ॥
transliteration: chaudahi chaar ku(n)t prabh aap ||
english: The fourteenth day of the lunar cycle: God Himself is in all four directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: sagal bhavan pooran parataap ||
english: On all worlds, His radiant glory is perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸੇ ਦਿਸਾ ਰਵਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
transliteration: dase disaa raviaa prabh ek ||
english: The One God is diffused in the ten directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: dharan akaas sabh mahi prabh pekh ||
english: Behold God in all the earth and sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਬਨ ਪਰਬਤ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jal thal ban parabat paataal ||
english: In the water, on the land, in the forests and mountains, and in the nether regions of the underworld,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਤਹ ਬਸਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: paramesvar tah basahi daiaal ||
english: the Merciful Transcendent Lord is abiding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖਮ ਅਸਥੂਲ ਸਗਲ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: sookham asathool sagal bhagavaan ||
english: The Lord God is in all mind and matter, subtle and manifest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh braham pachhaan ||14||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes God. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: aatam jeetaa guramatee gun gaae gobi(n)d ||
english: The soul is conquered, through the Guru's Teachings, singing the Glories of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਭੈ ਮਿਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaadee bhai mite naanak binasee chi(n)d ||15||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, fear is dispelled, O Nanak, and anxiety is ended. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮਾਵਸ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੀ ਭਏ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: amaavas aatam sukhee bhae sa(n)tokh deeaa guradev ||
english: The day of the new moon: My soul is at peace; the Divine Guru has blessed me with contentment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਲਾਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: man tan seetal saa(n)t sahaj laagaa prabh kee sev ||
english: My mind and body are cooled and soothed, in intuitive peace and poise; I have dedicated myself to serving God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸਫਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: toote ba(n)dhan bahu bikaar saphal pooran taa ke kaam ||
english: One who meditates in remembrance on the Name of the Lord - his bonds are broken, all his sins are erased,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਟੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੁਟੀ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: duramat mitee haumai chhutee simarat har ko naam ||
english: and his works are brought to perfect fruition; his evil-mindedness disappears, and his ego is subdued.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨ ॥
transliteration: saran gahee paarabraham kee mitiaa aavaa gavan ||
english: Taking to the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God, his comings and goings in reincarnation are ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਵਨ ॥
transliteration: aap tariaa kuta(n)b siu gun gubi(n)d prabh ravan ||
english: He saves himself, along with his family, chanting the Praises of God, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਜਪੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: har kee tahal kamaavanee japeeai prabh kaa naam ||
english: I serve the Lord, and I chant the Name of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: gur poore te paaiaa naanak sukh bisraam ||15||
english: From the Perfect Guru, Nanak has obtained peace and comfortable ease. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਡੋਲਤਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: pooran kabahu na dolataa pooraa keeaa prabh aap ||
english: The perfect person never wavers; God Himself made him perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਘਾਟਿ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: din din chaRai savaaiaa naanak hot na ghaat ||16||
english: Day by day, he prospers; O Nanak, he shall not fail. ||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨਮਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
transliteration: pooranamaa pooran prabh ek karan kaaran samarath ||
english: The day of the full moon: God alone is Perfect; He is the All-powerful Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹਥੁ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t daiaal purakh sabh oopar jaa kaa hath ||
english: The Lord is kind and compassionate to all beings and creatures; His Protecting Hand is over all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan gobi(n)d gur keeaa jaa kaa hoi ||
english: He is the Treasure of Excellence, the Lord of the Universe; through the Guru, He acts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee prabh sujaan alakh nira(n)jan soi ||
english: God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is All-knowing, Unseen and Immaculately Pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham paramesaro sabh bidh jaananahaar ||
english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, is the Knower of all ways and means.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sahaaee saran jog aath pahar namasakaar ||
english: He is the Support of His Saints, with the Power to give Sanctuary. Twenty-four hours a day, I bow in reverence to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥
transliteration: akath kathaa nah boojheeai simarahu har ke charan ||
english: His Unspoken Speech cannot be understood; I meditate on the Feet of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: patit udhaaran anaath naath naanak prabh kee saran ||16||
english: He is the Saving Grace of sinners, the Master of the masterless; Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary. ||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਹਸਾ ਗਇਓ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh binase sahasaa gaio saran gahee har raai ||
english: My pain is gone, and my sorrows have departed, since I took to the Sanctuary of the Lord, my King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: man chi(n)de phal paaiaa naanak har gun gaai ||17||
english: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: koee gaavai ko sunai koee karai beechaar ||
english: Some sing, some listen, and some contemplate;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਕੋ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ko upadesai ko driRai tis kaa hoi udhaar ||
english: some preach, and some implant the Name within; this is how they are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kilabikh kaatai hoi niramalaa janam janam mal jaai ||
english: Their sinful mistakes are erased, and they become pure; the filth of countless incarnations is washed away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਨਹ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: halat palat mukh oojalaa nah pohai tis maai ||
english: In this world and the next, their faces shall be radiant; they shall not be touched by Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਨਵੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: so surataa so baisano so giaanee dhanava(n)t ||
english: They are intuitively wise, and they are Vaishnaavs, worshippers of Vishnu; they are spiritually wise, wealthy and prosperous.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਜਿਆ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: so sooraa kulava(n)t soi jin bhajiaa bhagava(n)t ||
english: They are spiritual heros, of noble birth, who vibrate upon the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਬੈਸੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥
transliteration: khatree braahaman sood bais udharai simar cha(n)daal ||
english: The Kh'shatriyas, the Brahmins, the low-caste Soodras, the Vaisha workers and the outcast pariahs are all saved,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: jin jaanio prabh aapanaa naanak tisahi ravaal ||17||
english: meditating on the Lord. Nanak is the dust of the feet of those who know his God. ||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kee vaar mahalaa 4 ||
english: Vaar In Gauree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਮਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh daiaal hai jis no samat sabh koi ||
english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is kind and compassionate; all are alike to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਦਾ ਮਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਤੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ek drisat kar dekhadaa man bhaavanee te sidh hoi ||
english: He looks upon all impartially; with pure faith in the mind, He is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur vich a(n)mrit hai har utam har pad soi ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar is within the True Guru; He is exalted and sublime, of Godly status.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kirapaa te har dhiaaeeai guramukh paavai koi ||1||
english: O Nanak, by His Grace, one meditates on the Lord; the Gurmukhs obtain Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਜਗਿ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai maaiaa sabh bikh hai nit jag totaa sa(n)saar ||
english: Egotism and Maya are total poison; in these, people continually suffer loss in this world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: laahaa har dhan khatiaa guramukh sabad veechaar ||
english: The Gurmukh earns the profit of the wealth of the Lord's Name, contemplating the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai mail bikh utarai har a(n)mrit har ur dhaar ||
english: The poisonous filth of egotism is removed, when one enshrines the Ambrosial Name of the Lord within the heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh kaaraj tin ke sidh hahi jin guramukh kirapaa dhaar ||
english: All the Gurmukh's affairs are brought to perfect completion; the Lord has showered him with His Mercy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jo dhur mile se mil rahe har mele sirajanahaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, one who meets the Primal Lord remains blended with the Lord, the Creator Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: too sachaa saahib sach hai sach sachaa gosaaee ||
english: You are True, O True Lord and Master. You are the Truest of the True, O Lord of the World.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸਭ ਧਿਆਇਦੀ ਸਭ ਲਗੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tudhuno sabh dhiaaidee sabh lagai teree paaee ||
english: Everyone meditates on You; everyone falls at Your Feet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਈ ॥
transliteration: teree siphat suaaliu saroop hai jin keetee tis paar laghaaee ||
english: Your Praises are graceful and beautiful; You save those who speak them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukhaa no phal paaidaa sach naam samaaee ||
english: You reward the Gurmukhs, who are absorbed in the True Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਵਡੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vade mere saahibaa vadee teree vadiaaee ||1||
english: O my Great Lord and Master, great is Your glorious greatness. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai hor salaahanaa sabh bolan phikaa saad ||
english: Without the Name, all other praise and speech is insipid and tasteless.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਲਾਹਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh aha(n)kaar salaahade haumai mamataa vaad ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs praise their own egos; their attachment to egotism is useless.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਖਪਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਵਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jin saalaahan se marahi khap jaavai sabh apavaad ||
english: Those whom they praise, die; they all waste away in conflict.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮਾਨਾਦੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak guramukh ubare jap har har paramaanaad ||1||
english: O servant Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur har prabh das naam dhiaaee man haree ||
english: O True Guru, tell me of my Lord God, that I may meditate on the Naam within my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam pavit har mukh bolee sabh dukh paraharee ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Lord's Name is sacred and pure; chanting it, all my pain has been taken away. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: too aape aap nira(n)kaar hai nira(n)jan har raaiaa ||
english: You Yourself are the Formless Lord, the Immaculate Lord, our Sovereign King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਤੂ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jinee too ik man sach dhiaaiaa tin kaa sabh dukh gavaaiaa ||
english: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord with one-pointed mind, are rid of all their pain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਵੈ ਲਾਇ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: teraa sareek ko naahee jis no lavai laai sunaaiaa ||
english: You have no equal, next to whom I might sit and speak of You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh jevad daataa toohai nira(n)janaa toohai sach merai man bhaaiaa ||
english: You are the only Giver as great as Yourself. You are Immaculate; O True Lord, you are pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sache mere saahibaa sache sach naaiaa ||2||
english: O my True Lord and Master, Your Name is the Truest of the True. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man a(n)tar haumai rog hai bhram bhoole manamukh durajanaa ||
english: Deep within the mind is the disease of ego; the self-willed manmukhs, the evil beings, are deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak rog gavaai mil satigur saadhoo sajanaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, this disease is eradicated, only when one meets the True Guru, our Holy Friend. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: man tan rataa ra(n)g siu guramukh har gunataas ||
english: The mind and body of the Gurmukh are imbued with the Love of the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak har saranaagatee har mele gur saabaas ||2||
english: Servant Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord. Hail to the Guru, who has united me with the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਵੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: too karataa purakh aga(n)m hai kis naal too vaReeai ||
english: You are the Personification of Creativity, the Inaccessible Lord. With whom should I compare You?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਪੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: tudh jevad hoi s aakheeai tudh jehaa toohai paReeai ||
english: If there was anyone else as great as You, I would name him; You alone are like Yourself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: too ghat ghat ik varatadaa guramukh paragaReeai ||
english: You are the One, permeating each and every heart; You are revealed to the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਤੂ ਚੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: too sachaa sabhas daa khasam hai sabh doo too chaReeai ||
english: You are the True Lord and Master of all; You are the Highest of all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਹੋਇਸੀ ਤਾ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਕੜੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too karahi s sache hoisee taa kaait kaReeai ||3||
english: Whatever You do, O True Lord - that is what happens, so why should we grieve? ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਲਗੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: mai man tan prem pira(n)m kaa athe pahar laga(n)n ||
english: My mind and body are imbued with the Love of my Beloved, twenty-four hours a day.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak kirapaa dhaar prabh satigur sukh vasa(n)n ||1||
english: Shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, O God, that he may dwell in peace with the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਸੋਹੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: jin a(n)dar preet pira(n)m kee jiu bolan tivai soha(n)n ||
english: Those whose inner beings are filled with the Love of their Beloved, look beautiful as they speak.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਰੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak har aape jaanadaa jin laaee preet pira(n)n ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself knows all; the Beloved Lord has infused His Love. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਹੈ ਭੁਲਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: too karataa aap abhul hai bhulan vich naahee ||
english: O Creator Lord, You Yourself are infallible; You never make mistakes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਭਲਾ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: too karahi s sache bhalaa hai gur sabad bujhaahee ||
english: Whatever You do is good, O True Lord; this understanding is obtained through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: too karan kaaran samarath hai doojaa ko naahee ||
english: You are the Cause of causes, the All-powerful Lord; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਹੀ ॥
transliteration: too saahib agam daiaal hai sabh tudh dhiaahee ||
english: O Lord and Master, You are inaccessible and merciful. Everyone meditates on You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਛਡਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sabh jee tere too sabhas daa too sabh chhadaahee ||4||
english: All beings are Yours; You belong to all. You deliver all. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸੰਦੇਸਰਾ ਅਖੀ ਤਾਰ ਲਗੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: sun saajan prem sa(n)desaraa akhee taar laga(n)n ||
english: Listen, O my Friend, to my message of love; my eyes are fixed upon You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur tuthai sajan meliaa jan naanak sukh sava(n)n ||1||
english: The Guru was pleased - He united servant Nanak with his friend, and now he sleeps in peace. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur daataa daiaal hai jis no daiaa sadaa hoi ||
english: The True Guru is the Merciful Giver; He is always compassionate.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur a(n)darahu niravair hai sabh dekhai braham ik soi ||
english: The True Guru has no hatred within Him; He beholds the One God everywhere.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਵੈਰਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਚਲਾਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਤਿਸਟਿਆ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: niravairaa naal j vair chalaaide tin vichahu tisatiaa na koi ||
english: Anyone who directs hate against the One who has no hate, shall never be satisfied within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਇਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sabhanaa daa bhalaa manaaidaa tis daa buraa kiu hoi ||
english: The True Guru wishes everyone well; how can anything bad happen to Him?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਇਛਦਾ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur no jehaa ko ichhadaa tehaa phal paae koi ||
english: As one feels towards the True Guru, so are the rewards he receives.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਜਿਦੂ ਕਿਛੁ ਗੁਝਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak karataa sabh kichh jaanadaa jidoo kichh gujhaa na hoi ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Creator knows everything; nothing can be hidden from Him. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਡਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਵਡ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jis no saahib vadaa kare soee vad jaanee ||
english: One who has been made great by his Lord and Master - know him to be great!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jis saahib bhaavai tis bakhas lae so saahib man bhaanee ||
english: By His Pleasure, the Lord and Master forgives those who are pleasing to His Mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਓਸ ਦੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਮੂੜ ਅਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: je ko os dee rees kare so mooR ajaanee ||
english: One who tries to compete with Him is a senseless fool.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jis no satigur mele s gun ravai gun aakh vakhaanee ||
english: One who is united with the Lord by the True Guru, sings His Praises and speaks His Glories.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak sachaa sach hai bujh sach samaanee ||5||
english: O Nanak, the True Lord is True; one who understands Him is absorbed in Truth. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har sat nira(n)jan amar hai nirabhau niravair nira(n)kaar ||
english: The Lord is true, immaculate and eternal; He has no fear, hatred or form.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਲਥਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jin japiaa ik man ik chit tin lathaa haumai bhaar ||
english: Those who chant and meditate on Him, who single-mindedly focus their consciousness on Him, are rid of the burden of their ego.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jin guramukh har aaraadhiaa tin sa(n)t janaa jaikaar ||
english: Those Gurmukhs who worship and adore the Lord - hail to those Saintly beings!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਫਿਟੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: koee ni(n)daa kare poore satiguroo kee tis no phit phit kahai sabh sa(n)saar ||
english: If someone slanders the Perfect True Guru, he will be rebuked and reproached by the whole world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur vich aap varatadaa har aape rakhanahaar ||
english: The Lord Himself abides within the True Guru; He Himself is His Protector.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n guroo gun gaavadaa tis no sadaa sadaa namasakaar ||
english: Blessed, Blessed is the Guru, who sings the Glories of God. Unto Him, I bow forever and ever in deepest reverence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak tin kau vaariaa jin japiaa sirajanahaar ||1||
english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who have meditated on the Creator Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: aape dharatee saajeean aape aakaas ||
english: He Himself made the earth; He Himself made the sky.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਗਿਰਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: vich aape ja(n)t upaaian mukh aape dei giraas ||
english: He Himself created the beings there, and He Himself places food in their mouths.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh aape aap varatadaa aape hee gunataas ||
english: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself is the Treasure of Excellence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਟੇ ਤਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaai too sabh kilavikh kate taas ||2||
english: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He shall take away all your sinful mistakes. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: too sachaa saahib sach hai sach sache bhaavai ||
english: You, O True Lord and Master, are True; the Truth is pleasing to the True One.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh sach salaahade tin jam ka(n)kar neR na aavai ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who praise You, O True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਦਰਿ ਉਜਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tin ke mukh dar ujale jin har hiradai sachaa bhaavai ||
english: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord; the Lord is pleasing to their hearts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਪਿਛਾਹਾ ਸਟੀਅਨਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kooRiaar pichhaahaa sateean kooR hiradai kapat mahaa dukh paavai ||
english: The false ones are left behind; because of the falsehood and deceit in their hearts, they suffer in terrible pain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀਆ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: muh kaale kooRiaareeaa kooRiaar kooRo hoi jaavai ||6||
english: Black are the faces of the false; the false remain just false. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਰਮ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur dharatee dharam hai tis vich jehaa ko beeje tehaa phal paae ||
english: The True Guru is the field of Dharma; as one plants the seeds there, so are the fruits obtained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhee a(n)mrit beejiaa tin a(n)mrit phal har paae ||
english: The GurSikhs plant ambrosial nectar, and obtain the Lord as their ambrosial fruit.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਓਇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚੀ ਪੈਨਾਏ ॥
transliteration: onaa halat palat mukh ujale oi har daragah sachee painaae ||
english: Their faces are radiant in this world and the next; in the Court of the Lord, they are robed with honor.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖੋਟੁ ਨਿਤ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਓਹੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ikanhaa a(n)dar khot nit khot kamaavahi ohu jehaa beeje tehaa phal khaae ||
english: Some have cruelty in their hearts - they constantly act in cruelty; as they plant, so are the fruits which they eat.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਆਵਗੀਰ ਸਭਿ ਉਘੜਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: jaa satigur saraaph nadar kar dekhai suaavageer sabh ughaR aae ||
english: When the True Guru, the Tester, observes with His Glance, the selfish ones are all exposed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜੇਹਾ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਤੇਹਾ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਓਇ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹੇ ਦਯਿ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: oi jehaa chitavahi nit tehaa paain oi teho jehe day vajaae ||
english: As one thinks, so does he receive, and so does the Lord make him known.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਹੀ ਸਿਰੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਚਲਤ ਸਬਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak duhee siree khasam aape varatai nit kar kar dekhai chalat sabaae ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is pervading at both ends; He continually acts, and beholds His own play. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਮਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik man ik varatadaa jit lagai so thaai paai ||
english: The mortal is of one mind - whatever he dedicates it to, in that he is successful.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਘਨੇਰੀਆ ਜਿ ਘਰਿ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: koee galaa kare ghanereeaa j ghar vath hovai saaee khaai ||
english: Some talk a lot, but they eat only that which is in their own homes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur sojhee naa pavai aha(n)kaar na vichahu jaai ||
english: Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained, and egotism does not depart from within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਨੋ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਹਥੁ ਤਡਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)kaareeaa no dukh bhukh hai hath tadahi ghar ghar ma(n)gaai ||
english: Suffering and hunger cling to the egotistical people; they hold out their hands and beg from door to door.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਠਗੀ ਗੁਝੀ ਨਾ ਰਹੈ ਮੁਲੰਮਾ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kooR thagee gujhee naa rahai mula(n)maa paaj lahi jaai ||
english: Their falsehood and fraud cannot remain concealed; their false appearances fall off in the end.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jis hovai poorab likhiaa tis satigur milai prabh aai ||
english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny comes to meet God through the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਵਰਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jiu lohaa paaras bheteeai mil sa(n)gat suvaran hoi jaai ||
