english: Just as iron is transmuted into gold by the touch of the Philosopher's Stone, so are people transformed by joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak ke prabh too dhanee jiu bhaavai tivai chalaai ||2||
english: O God, You are the Master of servant Nanak; as it pleases You, You lead him. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jin har hiradai seviaa tin har aap milaae ||
english: One who serves the Lord with all his heart - the Lord Himself unites him with Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਸਾਝਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gun kee saajh tin siu karee sabh avagan sabad jalaae ||
english: He enters into a partnership with virtue and merit, and burns off all his demerits with the fire of the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਿ ਪਲਰੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: augan vikan palaree jis dehi s sache paae ||
english: Demerits are purchased cheap, like straw; he alone gathers merit, who is so blessed by the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਮੇਟਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟੀਆਏ ॥
transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane jin augan met gun paragateeaae ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has erased my demerits, and revealed my virtuous merits.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: vadee vadiaaee vade kee guramukh aalaae ||7||
english: The Gurmukh chants the glorious greatness of the great Lord God. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur vich vadee vadiaaee jo anadin har har naam dhiaavai ||
english: Great is the greatness within the True Guru, who meditates night and day on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਚ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har har naam ramat such sa(n)jam har naame hee tripataavai ||
english: The repetition of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is his purity and self-restraint; with the Name of the Lord, He is satisfied.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਰਖ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har naam taan har naam deebaan har naamo rakh karaavai ||
english: The Lord's Name is His power, and the Lord's Name is His Royal Court; the Lord's Name protects Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਪੂਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸੋ ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo chit laai pooje gur moorat so man ichhe phal paavai ||
english: One who centers his consciousness and worships the Guru, obtains the fruits of his mind's desires.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਮਾਰ ਦਿਵਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo ni(n)daa kare satigur poore kee tis karataa maar divaavai ||
english: But one who slanders the Perfect True Guru, shall be killed and destroyed by the Creator.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਫੇਰਿ ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਓਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਓਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: pher oh velaa os hath na aavai ohu aapanaa beejiaa aape khaavai ||
english: This opportunity shall not come into his hands again; he must eat what he himself has planted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕਿ ਘੋਰਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਖੜਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਪਾਇ ਗਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: narak ghor muhi kaalai khaRiaa jiu tasakar paai galaavai ||
english: He shall be taken to the most horrible hell, with his face blackened like a thief, and a noose around his neck.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਵੈ ਤਾ ਉਬਰੈ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: phir satigur kee saranee pavai taa ubarai jaa har har naam dhiaavai ||
english: But if he should again take to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, and meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, then he shall be saved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਾਤਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har baataa aakh sunaae naanak har karate evai bhaavai ||1||
english: Nanak speaks and proclaims the Lord's Story; as it pleases the Creator, so does he speak. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੰਨੈ ਓਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਮੁਠਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kaa hukam na ma(n)nai ohu manamukh agiaan muthaa bikh maaiaa ||
english: One who does not obey the Hukam, the Command of the Perfect Guru - that self-willed manmukh is plundered by his ignorance and poisoned by Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਕਰਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਅਣਹੋਦੇ ਝਗੜੇ ਦਯਿ ਓਸ ਦੈ ਗਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: os a(n)dar kooR kooRo kar bujhai anahode jhagaRe day os dai gal paaiaa ||
english: Within him is falsehood, and he sees everyone else as false; the Lord has tied these useless conflicts around his neck.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਗਲ ਫਰੋਸੀ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੀ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ohu gal pharosee kare bahuteree os daa boliaa kisai na bhaaiaa ||
english: He babbles on and on, but the words he speaks please no one.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਹੰਢੈ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਨ ਦੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਓਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਜੋੜੇ ਓਸੁ ਭੀ ਲਛਣੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ohu ghar ghar ha(n)dhai jiu ra(n)n douhaagan os naal muhu joRe os bhee lachhan laaiaa ||
english: He wanders from house to house like an abandoned woman; whoever associates with him is stained by the mark of evil as well.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਪਾਸੁ ਛਡਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਹਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hoi s alipato varatai os daa paas chhad gur paas bahi jaaiaa ||
english: Those who become Gurmukh avoid him; they forsake his company and sit near the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਓਨਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jo gur gope aapanaa s bhalaa naahee pa(n)chahu on laahaa mool sabh gavaaiaa ||
english: O chosen people, O self-elect, one who does not publicly affirm his Guru is not a good person; he loses all his profits and capital.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਆਗਮੁ ਨਿਗਮੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pahilaa aagam nigam naanak aakh sunaae poore gur kaa bachan upar aaiaa ||
english: People used to chant and recite the Shaastras and the Vedas, O Nanak, but now the Words of the Perfect Guru have come to be the most exalted of all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa vadiaaee bhaavai gur poore kee manamukhaa oh velaa hath na aaiaa ||2||
english: The glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru is pleasing to the GurSikh; the self-willed manmukhs have lost this opportunity. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਲਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਟਿਕੇ ॥
transliteration: sach sachaa sabh doo vadaa hai so lae jis satigur tike ||
english: The True Lord is truly the greatest of all; he alone obtains Him, who is anointed by the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਇਕੇ ॥
transliteration: so satigur j sach dhiaaidaa sach sachaa satigur ike ||
english: He is the True Guru, who meditates on the True Lord. The True Lord and the True Guru are truly One.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੰਜੇ ਦੂਤ ਕੀਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਛਿਕੇ ॥
transliteration: soee satigur purakh hai jin pa(n)je doot keete vas chhike ||
english: He is the True Guru, the Primal Being, who has totally conquered his five passions.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਮੁਹ ਫਿਕੇ ॥
transliteration: j bin satigur seve aap ganaaide tin a(n)dar kooR phit phit muh phike ||
english: One who does not serve the True Guru, and who praises himself, is filled with falsehood within. Cursed, cursed is his ugly face.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਚੁਕੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: oi bole kisai na bhaavanee muh kaale satigur te chuke ||8||
english: His words are not pleasing to anyone; his face is blackened, and he is separated from the True Guru. ||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har prabh kaa sabh khet hai har aap kirasaanee laaiaa ||
english: Everyone is the field of the Lord God; the Lord Himself cultivates this field.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਜਮਾਈਅਨੁ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bakhas jamaaeean manamukhee mool gavaaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukh grows the crop of forgiveness, while the self-willed manmukh loses even his roots.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਭਲੇ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਖੇਤੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko beeje aapane bhale no har bhaavai so khet jamaaiaa ||
english: They all plant for their own good, but the Lord causes to grow only that field with which He is pleased.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhee har a(n)mrit beejiaa har a(n)mrit naam phal a(n)mrit paaiaa ||
english: The GurSikh plants the seed of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, and obtains the Lord's Ambrosial Naam as his Ambrosial Fruit.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਚੂਹਾ ਕਿਰਸ ਨਿਤ ਕੁਰਕਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jam choohaa kiras nit kurakadaa har karatai maar kadhaaiaa ||
english: The mouse of Death is continually gnawing away at the crop, but the Creator Lord has beaten it off and driven it away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਜੰਮੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਹਲ ਬਖਸ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kirasaanee ja(n)mee bhaau kar har bohal bakhas jamaaiaa ||
english: The farm was successful, by the Love of the Lord, and the crop was produced by God's Grace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਾੜਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਹਿਓਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tin kaa kaaRaa a(n)desaa sabh laahion jinee satigur purakh dhiaaiaa ||
english: He has removed all the burning and anxiety of those, who have meditated on the True Guru, the Primal Being.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam araadhiaa aap tariaa sabh jagat taraaiaa ||1||
english: O servant Nanak, one who worships and adores the Naam, the Name of the Lord, swims across, and saves the whole world as well. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੇ ਗਲਾ ॥
transliteration: saaraa din laalach atiaa manamukh hore galaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is occupied with greed all day long, although he may claim otherwise.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੀ ਊਘੈ ਦਬਿਆ ਨਵੇ ਸੋਤ ਸਭਿ ਢਿਲਾ ॥
transliteration: raatee ooghai dabiaa nave sot sabh dhilaa ||
english: At night, he is overcome by fatigue, and all his nine holes are weakened.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਦੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੋਰਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਭਲਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukhaa dai sir joraa amar hai nit devahi bhalaa ||
english: Over the head of the manmukh is the order of the woman; to her, he ever holds out his promises of goodness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਰਾ ਦਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਸੇ ਅਪਵਿਤ ਅਮੇਧ ਖਲਾ ॥
transliteration: joraa daa aakhiaa purakh kamaavade se apavit amedh khalaa ||
english: Those men who act according to the orders of women are impure, filthy and foolish.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਨਰ ਸੇ ਜੋਰਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਚਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam viaape kusudh nar se joraa puchh chalaa ||
english: Those impure men are engrossed in sexual desire; they consult their women and walk accordingly.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਖਿਐ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਲ ਭਲਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur kai aakhiai jo chalai so sat purakh bhal bhalaa ||
english: One who walks as the True Guru tells him to, is the true man, the best of the best.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਰਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਖੇਲ ਸਭਿ ਖਿਲਾ ॥
transliteration: joraa purakh sabh aap upaaian har khel sabh khilaa ||
english: He Himself created all women and men; the Lord Himself plays every play.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਵਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਲ ਭਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh teree banat banaavanee naanak bhal bhalaa ||2||
english: You created the entire creation; O Nanak, it is the best of the best. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤੁਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: too veparavaahu athaahu hai atul kiu tuleeai ||
english: You are carefree, unfathomable and immeasurable; how can You be measured?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: se vadabhaagee j tudh dhiaaide jin satigur mileeai ||
english: Those who have met the True Guru and who meditate on You are very fortunate.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਬਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee baanee sat saroop hai gurabaanee baneeai ||
english: The Word of the True Guru's Bani is the embodiment of Truth; through Gurbani, one becomes perfect.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੀਸੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਚੁ ਪਿਚੁ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੇ ਝੜਿ ਪੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee reesai hor kach pich bolade se kooRiaar kooRe jhaR paReeai ||
english: Jealously emulating the True Guru, some others may speak of good and bad, but the false are destroyed by their falsehood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਨੑਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਝਖਿ ਮਰਦੇ ਕੜੀਐ ॥੯॥
transliteration: onhaa a(n)dar hor mukh hor hai bikh maaiaa no jhakh marade kaReeai ||9||
english: Deep within them is one thing, and in their mouths is another; they suck in the poison of Maya, and then they painfully waste away. ||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee sevaa niramalee niramal jan hoi s sevaa ghaale ||
english: Service to the True Guru is immaculate and pure; those humble beings who are pure perform this service.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਓਇ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੈ ਵਖਿ ਕਢੇ ਜਜਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jin a(n)dar kapat vikaar jhooth oi aape sachai vakh kadhe jajamaale ||
english: Those who have deceit, corruption and falsehood within - the True Lord Himself casts them out like lepers.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿਆਰ ਸਿਖ ਬਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਘਾਲਨਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਨ ਲਭਨੀ ਕਿਤੈ ਥਾਇ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: sachiaar sikh bahi satigur paas ghaalan kooRiaar na labhanee kitai thaai bhaale ||
english: The truthful Sikhs sit by the True Guru's side and serve Him. The false ones search, but find no place of rest.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਮੁਹ ਭਲੇਰੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਦਯਿ ਗਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jinaa satigur kaa aakhiaa sukhaavai naahee tinaa muh bhalere phirahi day gaale ||
english: Those who are not pleased with the Words of the True Guru - their faces are cursed, and they wander around, condemned by God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ਸੇ ਕਿਚਰਕੁ ਵੇਰਾਈਅਨਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jin a(n)dar preet nahee har keree se kicharak veraaeean manamukh betaale ||
english: Those who do not have the Love of the Lord within their hearts - how long can those demonic, self-willed manmukhs be consoled?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਥਾਇ ਰਖੈ ਓਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਵਥੁ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur no milai s aapanaa man thaai rakhai ohu aap varatai aapanee vath naale ||
english: One who meets the True Guru, keeps his mind in its own place; he spends only his own assets.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਖਿ ਕਢੈ ਠਗਵਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak ikanaa gur mel sukh devai ik aape vakh kadhai thagavaale ||1||
english: O servant Nanak, some are united with the Guru; to some, the Lord grants peace, while others - deceitful cheats - suffer in isolation. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਦਯਿ ਆਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jinaa a(n)dar naam nidhaan har tin ke kaaj day aade raas ||
english: Those who have the treasure of the Lord's Name deep within their hearts - the Lord resolves their affairs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਚੂਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: tin chookee muhataajee lokan kee har prabh a(n)g kar baithaa paas ||
english: They are no longer subservient to other people; the Lord God sits by them, at their side.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਕਰਤਾ ਵਲਿ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਲਿ ਸਭਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) karataa val taa sabh ko val sabh darasan dekh karahi saabaas ||
english: When the Creator is on their side, then everyone is on their side. Beholding their vision, everyone applauds them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: saahu paatisaahu sabh har kaa keeaa sabh jan kau aai karahi raharaas ||
english: Kings and emperors are all created by the Lord; they all come and bow in reverence to the Lord's humble servant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਵਡਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kee vadee vadiaaee har vadaa sev atul sukh paaiaa ||
english: Great is the greatness of the Perfect Guru. Serving the Great Lord, I have obtained immeasurable peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਿਤ ਬਖਸੇ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai daan deeaa har nihachal nit bakhase chaRai savaaiaa ||
english: The Lord has bestowed this eternal gift upon the Perfect Guru; His blessings increase day by day.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸੋ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: koee ni(n)dak vadiaaee dekh na sakai so karatai aap pachaaiaa ||
english: The slanderer, who cannot endure His greatness, is destroyed by the Creator Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak gun bolai karate ke bhagataa no sadaa rakhadaa aaiaa ||2||
english: Servant Nanak chants the Glorious Praises of the Creator, who protects His devotees forever. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਵਡ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: too saahib agam daiaal hai vad daataa daanaa ||
english: You, O Lord and Master, are inaccessible and merciful; You are the Great Giver, All-knowing.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋ ਦਿਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤੂਹੈਂ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: tudh jevad mai hor ko dis na aavaee toohai(n) sughaR merai man bhaanaa ||
english: I can see no other as great as You; O Lord of Wisdom, You are pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਆਵਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਚਲਣਹਾਰਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: mohu kuta(n)b dis aavadaa sabh chalanahaaraa aavan jaanaa ||
english: Emotional attachment to your family and everything you see is temporary, coming and going.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜਾ ਤਿਨ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jo bin sache horat chit laaide se kooRiaar kooRaa tin maanaa ||
english: Those who attach their consciousness to anything except the True Lord are false, and false is their pride.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak sach dhiaai too bin sache pach pach mue ajaanaa ||10||
english: O Nanak, meditate on the True Lord; without the True Lord, the ignorant rot away and putrefy to death. ||10||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਸਤ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦਿਚੈ ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਆਖਿਆ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ago de sat bhaau na dichai pichho de aakhiaa ka(n)m na aavai ||
english: At first, he did not show respect to the Guru; later, he offered excuses, but it is no use.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਧ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਗਲੀ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: adh vich phirai manamukh vechaaraa galee kiu sukh paavai ||
english: The wretched, self-willed manmukhs wander around and are stuck mid-way; how can they find peace by mere words?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jis a(n)dar preet nahee satigur kee s kooRee aavai kooRee jaavai ||
english: Those who have no love for the True Guru within their hearts come with falsehood, and leave with falsehood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je kripaa kare meraa har prabh karataa taa(n) satigur paarabraham nadaree aavai ||
english: When my Lord God, the Creator, grants His Grace, then they come to see the True Guru as the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਾੜਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: taa apiu peevai sabad gur keraa sabh kaaRaa a(n)desaa bharam chukaavai ||
english: Then, they drink in the Nectar, the Word of the Guru's Shabad; all burning, anxiety, and doubts are eliminated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahai din raatee jan naanak anadin har gun gaavai ||1||
english: They remain in ecstasy forever, day and night; O servant Nanak, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਅਖਾਏ ਸੁ ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur kaa jo sikh akhaae s bhalake uth har naam dhiaavai ||
english: One who calls himself a Sikh of the Guru, the True Guru, shall rise in the early morning hours and meditate on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਭਲਕੇ ਪਰਭਾਤੀ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: udam kare bhalake parabhaatee isanaan kare a(n)mrit sar naavai ||
english: Upon arising early in the morning, he is to bathe, and cleanse himself in the pool of nectar.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਦੋਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: upades guroo har har jap jaapai sabh kilavikh paap dokh lahi jaavai ||
english: Following the Instructions of the Guru, he is to chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. All sins, misdeeds and negativity shall be erased.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਚੜੈ ਦਿਵਸੁ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵੈ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: phir chaRai divas gurabaanee gaavai bahadiaa uthadiaa har naam dhiaavai ||
english: Then, at the rising of the sun, he is to sing Gurbani; whether sitting down or standing up, he is to meditate on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo saas giraas dhiaae meraa har har so gurasikh guroo man bhaavai ||
english: One who meditates on my Lord, Har, Har, with every breath and every morsel of food - that GurSikh becomes pleasing to the Guru's Mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jis no daiaal hovai meraa suaamee tis gurasikh guroo upades sunaavai ||
english: That person, unto whom my Lord and Master is kind and compassionate - upon that GurSikh, the Guru's Teachings are bestowed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਧੂੜਿ ਮੰਗੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਆਪਿ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak dhooR ma(n)gai tis gurasikh kee jo aap japai avarah naam japaavai ||2||
english: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of that GurSikh, who himself chants the Naam, and inspires others to chant it. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਥੋੜੇ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh sach dhiaaide se virale thoRe ||
english: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord - they are very rare.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਕਰੋੜੇ ॥
transliteration: jo man chit ik araadhade tin kee barakat khaahi asa(n)kh karoRe ||
english: Those who worship and adore the One Lord in their conscious minds - through their generosity, countless millions are fed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸਭ ਧਿਆਇਦੀ ਸੇ ਥਾਇ ਪਏ ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਲੋੜੇ ॥
transliteration: tudhuno sabh dhiaaidee se thaai pae jo saahib loRe ||
english: All meditate on You, but they alone are accepted, who are pleasing to their Lord and Master.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਖਾਦੇ ਪੈਨਦੇ ਸੇ ਮੁਏ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੇ ਕੋੜ੍ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: jo bin satigur seve khaade painade se mue mar ja(n)me koRhe ||
english: Those who eat and dress without serving the True Guru die; after death, those wretched lepers are consigned to reincarnation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਵਿਸੁ ਕਢਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਘੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: oi haajar mithaa bolade baahar vis kadhahi mukh ghole ||
english: In His Sublime Presence, they talk sweetly, but behind His back, they exude poison from their mouths.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਦਯਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: man khote day vichhoRe ||11||
english: The evil-minded are consigned to separation from the Lord. ||11||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਲੁ ਜੂਈ ਭਰਿਆ ਨੀਲਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਖਿਧੋਲੜਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਵੇਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਮੁਖੈ ਨੋ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mal jooee bhariaa neelaa kaalaa khidholaRaa tin vemukh vemukhai no paaiaa ||
english: The faithless baymukh sent out his faithless servant, wearing a blue-black coat, filled with filth and vermin.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਸਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕੋਈ ਬਹਣਿ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਗੂਹ ਪੜਿ ਸਗਵੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਇ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paas na deee koee bahan jagat mahi gooh paR sagavee mal laai manamukh aaiaa ||
english: No one in the world will sit near him; the self-willed manmukh fell into manure, and returned with even more filth covering him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਾਈ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਨੋ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਭੇਜਿਆ ਓਥੈ ਭੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਦੁਹਾ ਵੇਮੁਖਾ ਦਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paraaee jo ni(n)daa chugalee no vemukh kar kai bhejiaa othai bhee muhu kaalaa duhaa vemukhaa daa karaaiaa ||
english: The faithless baymukh was sent to slander and back-bite others, but when he went there, the faces of both he and his faithless master were blackened instead.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੜ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਸਭਤੁ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਾਈ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਸਣੈ ਨਫਰੈ ਪਉਲੀ ਪਉਦੀ ਫਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਉਠਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: taR suniaa sabhat jagat vich bhaaee vemukh sanai napharai paulee paudee phaavaa hoi kai uth ghar aaiaa ||
english: It was immediately heard throughout the whole world, O Siblings of Destiny, that this faithless man, along with his servant, was kicked and beaten with shoes; in humiliation, they got up and returned to their homes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਕੁੜਮੀ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਰਲਣਾ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਵਹੁਟੀ ਭਤੀਜਂੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: agai sa(n)gatee kuRamee vemukh ralanaa na milai taa vahutee bhateeja(n)ee phir aan ghar paaiaa ||
english: The faithless baymukh was not allowed to mingle with others; his wife and niece then brought him home to lie down.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਏ ਨਿਤ ਭੁਖਾ ਕੂਕੇ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: halat palat dovai gae nit bhukhaa kooke tihaaiaa ||
english: He has lost both this world and the next; he cries out continually, in hunger and thirst.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੁ ਬਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan suaamee karataa purakh hai jin niaau sach bahi aap karaaiaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the Creator, the Primal Being, our Lord and Master; He Himself sits and dispenses true justice.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jo ni(n)daa kare satigur poore kee so saachai maar pachaaiaa ||
english: One who slanders the Perfect True Guru is punished and destroyed by the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਆਖਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ehu akhar tin aakhiaa jin jagat sabh upaaiaa ||1||
english: This Word is spoken by the One who created the whole universe. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਨੰਗਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਨਫਰੁ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਰਜਿ ਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saahib jis kaa na(n)gaa bhukhaa hovai tis daa naphar kithahu raj khaae ||
english: One who has a poor beggar for a master - how can he be well-fed?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਫਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਆਵੈ ਅਣਹੋਦੀ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: j saahib kai ghar vath hovai s napharai hath aavai anahodee kithahu paae ||
english: If there is something in his master's house, he can get it; but how can he get what is not there?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਉਖੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jis dee sevaa keetee phir lekhaa ma(n)geeai saa sevaa aukhee hoee ||
english: Serving him, who will be called to answer for his account? That service is painful and useless.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sevaa karahu har gur saphal darasan kee phir lekhaa ma(n)gai na koee ||2||
english: O Nanak, serve the Guru, the Lord Incarnate; the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is profitable, and in the end, you shall not be called to account. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਕਹੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: naanak veechaarahi sa(n)t jan chaar ved kaha(n)de ||
english: O Nanak, the Saints consider, and the four Vedas proclaim,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਮੁਖੈ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸੇ ਵਚਨ ਹੋਵੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat mukhai te bolade se vachan hova(n)de ||
english: that whatever the Lord's devotees utter with their mouths, shall come to pass.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਹਾਰਾ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: pragat pahaaraa jaapadaa sabh lok suna(n)de ||
english: He is manifest in His cosmic workshop. All people hear of this.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਰ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਖਹੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: sukh na paain mugadh nar sa(n)t naal khaha(n)de ||
english: The stubborn men who fight with the Saints shall never find peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਲੋਚਨਿ ਓਨਾ ਗੁਣੈ ਨੋ ਓਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਸੜੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: oi lochan onaa gunai no oi aha(n)kaar saRa(n)de ||
english: The Saints seek to bless them with virtue, but they only burn in their egos.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਾ ਭਾਗ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: oi vichaare kiaa karahi jaa bhaag dhur ma(n)de ||
english: What can those wretched ones do, since, from the very beginning, their destiny is cursed with evil.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਸੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: jo maare tin paarabraham se kisai na sa(n)de ||
english: Those who are struck down by the Supreme Lord God are of no use to anyone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਆਇ ਪਚੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: vair karahi niravair naal dharam niaai pacha(n)de ||
english: Those who hate the One who has no hatred - according to the true justice of Dharma, they shall perish.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੰਤਿ ਸਰਾਪਿਆ ਸੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਭਵੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: jo jo sa(n)t saraapiaa se phirahi bhava(n)de ||
english: Those who are cursed by the Saints will continue wandering aimlessly.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੇਡੁ ਮੁੰਢਾਹੂੰ ਕਟਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਡਾਲ ਸੁਕੰਦੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: ped mu(n)dhaahoo(n) katiaa tis daal suka(n)de ||12||
english: When the tree is cut off at its roots, the branches wither and die. ||12||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar har guroo dhiaaidaa vadee vadiaaee ||
english: Great is the greatness of the Guru, who meditates on the Lord within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਸਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਘਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tus ditee poorai satiguroo ghatai naahee ik til kisai dee ghataaee ||
english: By His Pleasure, the Lord has bestowed this upon the Perfect True Guru; it is not diminished one bit by anyone's efforts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਵਲਿ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਸਭ ਲੋੁਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sach saahib satiguroo kai val hai taa(n) jhakh jhakh marai sabh loukaaee ||
english: The True Lord and Master is on the side of the True Guru; and so, all those who oppose Him waste away to death in anger, envy and conflict.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dakaa ke muh kaale kare har karatai aap vadhaaee ||
english: The Lord, the Creator, blackens the faces of the slanderers, and increases the glory of the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jiu jiu ni(n)dak ni(n)d karahi tiu tiu nit nit chaRai savaaee ||
english: As the slanderers spread their slander, so does the Guru's glory increase day by day.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਆਣਿ ਸਭ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak har aaraadhiaa tin pairee aan sabh paaee ||1||
english: Servant Nanak worships the Lord, who makes everyone fall at His Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਗਣਤ ਜਿ ਰਖੈ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur setee ganat j rakhai halat palat sabh tis kaa gaiaa ||
english: One who enters into a calculated relationship with the True Guru loses everything, this world and the next.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਝਹੀਆ ਪਾਏ ਝਗੂ ਸੁਟੇ ਝਖਦਾ ਝਖਦਾ ਝੜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nit jhaheeaa paae jhagoo sute jhakhadaa jhakhadaa jhaR paiaa ||
english: He grinds his teeth continually and foams at the mouth; screaming in anger, he perishes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਅਗਲਾ ਧਨੁ ਭੀ ਉਡਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nit upaav karai maaiaa dhan kaaran agalaa dhan bhee ud gaiaa ||
english: He continually chases after Maya and wealth, but even his own wealth flies away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਖਟੇ ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kiaa ohu khate kiaa ohu khaavai jis a(n)dar sahasaa dukh paiaa ||
english: What shall he earn, and what shall he eat? Within his heart, there is only cynicism and pain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਏ ਸਭੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਜਗਤੈ ਕਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: niravairai naal j vair rachaae sabh paap jagatai kaa tin sir laiaa ||
english: One who hates the One who has no hatred, shall bear the load of all the sins of the world on his head.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਮੁਹਿ ਅੰਬੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: os agai pichhai dhoee naahee jis a(n)dar ni(n)daa muhi a(n)b paiaa ||
english: He shall find no shelter here or hereafter; his mouth blisters with the slander in his heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਨੋ ਓਹੁ ਹਥੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਖੇਹੂ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: je suine no ohu hath paae taa khehoo setee ral gaiaa ||
english: If gold comes into his hands, it turns to dust.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: je gur kee saranee phir ohu aavai taa pichhale augan bakhas laiaa ||
english: But if he should come again to the Sanctuary of the Guru, then even his past sins shall be forgiven.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak anadin naam dhiaaiaa har simarat kilavikh paap gaiaa ||2||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, night and day. Remembering the Lord in meditation, wickedness and sins are erased. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਉਪਰਿ ਤੂ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: toohai sachaa sach too sabh doo upar too deebaan ||
english: You are the Truest of the True; Your Regal Court is the most exalted of all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh sach dhiaaide sach sevan sache teraa maan ||
english: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord, serve the Truth; O True Lord, they take pride in You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: onaa a(n)dar sach mukh ujale sach bolan sache teraa taan ||
english: Within them is the Truth; their faces are radiant, and they speak the Truth. O True Lord, You are their strength.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: se bhagat jinee guramukh saalaahiaa sach sabad neesaan ||
english: Those who, as Gurmukh, praise You are Your devotees; they have the insignia and the banner of the Shabad, the True Word of God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਜਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: sach j sache sevade tin vaaree sad kurabaan ||13||
english: I am truly a sacrifice, forever devoted to those who serve the True Lord. ||13||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਈ ਹੁਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dhur maare poorai satiguroo seee hun satigur maare ||
english: Those who were cursed by the Perfect True Guru, from the very beginning, are even now cursed by the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮੇਲਣ ਨੋ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਮਿਲਣ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: je melan no bahuteraa locheeai na deee milan karataare ||
english: Even though they may have a great longing to associate with the Guru, the Creator does not allow it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat dhoee naa lahan vich sa(n)gat gur veechaare ||
english: They shall not find shelter in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; in the Sangat, the Guru has proclaimed this.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹੁਣਿ ਓਨਾ ਨੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: koee jaai milai hun onaa no tis maare jam ja(n)daare ||
english: Whoever goes out to meet them now, will be destroyed by the tyrant, the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਬਾਬੈ ਫਿਟਕੇ ਸੇ ਫਿਟੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਗਦਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur baabai phitake se phite gur a(n)gad keete kooRiaare ||
english: Those who were condemned by Guru Nanak were declared counterfeit by Guru Angad as well.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੀਜੀ ਪੀੜੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਹਥਿ ਏਨਾ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur teejee peeRee veechaariaa kiaa hath enaa vechaare ||
english: The Guru of the third generation thought, "What lies in the hands of these poor people?"

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਚਉਥੀ ਪੀੜੀ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur chauthee peeRee tikiaa tin ni(n)dak dusat sabh taare ||
english: The Guru of the fourth generation saved all these slanderers and evil-doers.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਪੁਤੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: koee put sikh sevaa kare satiguroo kee tis kaaraj sabh savaare ||
english: If any son or Sikh serves the True Guru, then all of his affairs will be resolved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਪੁਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਲਖਮੀ ਖੜਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jo ichhai so phal paaisee put dhan lakhamee khaR mele har nisataare ||
english: He obtains the fruits of his desires - children, wealth, property, union with the Lord and emancipation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh nidhaan satiguroo vich jis a(n)dar har ur dhaare ||
english: All treasures are in the True Guru, who has enshrined the Lord within the heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਲਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: so paae pooraa satiguroo jis likhiaa likhat lilaare ||
english: He alone obtains the Perfect True Guru, on whose forehead such blessed destiny is pre-ordained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਿਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak maagai dhooR tin jo gurasikh mit piaare ||1||
english: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those GurSikhs who love the Lord, their Friend. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੀ ਆਪੇ ਆਣਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jin kau aap dei vadiaaee jagat bhee aape aan tin kau pairee paae ||
english: The Lord Himself bestows glorious greatness; He Himself causes the world to come and fall at their feet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਡਰੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪ ਦੂ ਕੀਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਲਾ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dareeai taa(n) je kichh aap doo keechai sabh karataa aapanee kalaa vadhaae ||
english: We should only be afraid, if we try to do things by ourselves; the Creator is increasing His Power in every way.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਏਹੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਜੋਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਆਣਿ ਨਿਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dekhahu bhaaee ehu akhaaRaa har preetam sache kaa jin aapanai jor sabh aan nivaae ||
english: Behold, O Siblings of Destiny: this is the Arena of the Beloved True Lord; His power brings everyone to bow in humility.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਖ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਦੁਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aapaniaa bhagataa kee rakh kare har suaamee ni(n)dakaa dusataa ke muh kaale karaae ||
english: The Lord, our Lord and Master, preserves and protects His devotees; He blackens the faces of the slanderers and evil-doers.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee vadiaaee nit chaRai savaaee har keerat bhagat nit aap karaae ||
english: The glorious greatness of the True Guru increases day by day; the Lord inspires His devotees to continually sing the Kirtan of His Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਘਰੀ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anadin naam japahu gurasikhahu har karataa satigur gharee vasaae ||
english: O GurSikhs, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, night and day; through the True Guru, the Creator Lord will come to dwell within the home of your inner being.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਕਢਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee baanee sat sat kar jaanahu gurasikhahu har karataa aap muhahu kadhaae ||
english: O GurSikhs, know that the Bani, the Word of the True Guru, is true, absolutely true. The Creator Lord Himself causes the Guru to chant it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਉਜਲੇ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa ke muh ujale kare har piaaraa gur kaa jaikaar sa(n)saar sabhat karaae ||
english: The Beloved Lord makes the faces of His GurSikhs radiant; He makes the whole world applaud and acclaim the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai har daasan kee har paij rakhaae ||2||
english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; the Lord Himself preserves the honor of His slave. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: too sachaa saahib aap hai sach saah hamaare ||
english: O My True Lord and Master, You Yourself are my True Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਥਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sach poojee naam driRaai prabh vanajaare thaare ||
english: Please, implant within me the true treasure of Your Name; O God, I am Your merchant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਥਹ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sach sevahi sach vana(n)j laihi gun kathah niraare ||
english: I serve the True One, and deal in the True One; I chant Your Wondrous Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sevak bhaai se jan mile gur sabad savaare ||
english: Those humble beings who serve the Lord with love meet Him; they are adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਖਾਰੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: too sachaa saahib alakh hai gur sabad lakhaare ||14||
english: O my True Lord and Master, You are unknowable; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are known. ||14||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jis a(n)dar taat paraaee hovai tis daa kade na hovee bhalaa ||
english: One whose heart is filled with jealousy of others, never comes to any good.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਸ ਦੈ ਆਖਿਐ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਓਜਾੜੀ ਪੂਕਾਰੇ ਖਲਾ ॥
transliteration: os dai aakhiai koee na lagai nit ojaaRee pookaare khalaa ||
english: No one pays any attention to what he says; he is just a fool, crying out endlessly in the wilderness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਚੁਗਲੋ ਵਜੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis a(n)dar chugalee chugalo vajai keetaa karatiaa os daa sabh gaiaa ||
english: One whose heart is filled with malicious gossip, is known as a malicious gossip; everything he does is in vain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਕਰੇ ਅਣਹੋਦੀ ਪਰਾਈ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਢਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nit chugalee kare anahodee paraaee muhu kadh na sakai os daa kaalaa bhaiaa ||
english: Night and day, he continually gossips about others; his face has been blackened, and he cannot show it to anyone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: karam dharatee sareer kalijug vich jehaa ko beeje tehaa ko khaae ||
english: The body is the field of action, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; as you plant, so shall you harvest.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਲਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਵਿਸੁ ਖਾਧੀ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: galaa upar tapaavas na hoee vis khaadhee tatakaal mar jaae ||
english: Justice is not passed on mere words; if someone eats poison, he dies.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee vekhahu niaau sach karate kaa jehaa koee kare tehaa koee paae ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, behold the justice of the True Creator; as people act, so they are rewarded.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau sabh sojhee paaee har dar keeaa baataa aakh sunaae ||1||
english: The Lord has bestowed total understanding upon servant Nanak; he speaks and proclaims the words of the Lord's Court. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਦੈ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੋ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: hodai paratakh guroo jo vichhuRe tin kau dar dhoee naahee ||
english: Those who separate themselves from the Guru, in spite of His Constant Presence - they find no place of rest in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਮੁਹ ਫਿਕੇ ਥੁਕ ਥੁਕ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: koee jaai milai tin ni(n)dakaa muh phike thuk thuk muhi paahee ||
english: If someone goes to meet with those dull-faced slanderers, he will find their faces covered with spit.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਫਿਟਕੇ ਸੇ ਸਭ ਜਗਤਿ ਫਿਟਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਭੰਭਲ ਭੂਸੇ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jo satigur phitake se sabh jagat phitake nit bha(n)bhal bhoose khaahee ||
english: Those who are cursed by the True Guru, are cursed by all the world. They wander around endlessly.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਲੈਦੇ ਢਹਾ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jin gur gopiaa aapanaa se laide dhahaa phiraahee ||
english: Those who do not publicly affirm their Guru wander around, moaning and groaning.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਭੁਖਾ ਭੁਖ ਕੂਕਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: tin kee bhukh kade na utarai nit bhukhaa bhukh kookaahee ||
english: Their hunger shall never depart; afflicted by constant hunger, they cry out in pain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਦਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਕੋ ਨਾ ਸੁਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਉਲੇ ਹਉਲਿ ਮਰਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: onaa daa aakhiaa ko naa sunai nit haule haul maraahee ||
english: No one hears what they have to say; they live in constant fear and terror, until they finally die.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਨੀ ਓਨਾ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee vadiaaee vekh na sakanee onaa agai pichhai thaau naahee ||
english: They cannot bear the glorious greatness of the True Guru, and they find no place of rest, here or hereafter.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਰਹਦੀ ਖੁਹਦੀ ਸਭ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jo satigur maare tin jaai milahi rahadee khuhadee sabh pat gavaahee ||
english: Those who go out to meet with those who have been cursed by the True Guru, lose all remnants of their honor.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਅਗੈ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਫਿਟਕੇ ਜਿ ਓਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਸਟੁ ਉਠਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: oi agai kusatee gur ke phitake j os milai tis kusat uthaahee ||
english: They have already become like lepers; cursed by the Guru, whoever meets them is also afflicted with leprosy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: har tin kaa darasan naa karahu jo doojai bhaai chit laahee ||
english: O Lord, I pray that I may not even catch sight of those, who focus their consciousness on the love of duality.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਿਹੁ ਚਾਰਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: dhur karatai aap likh paaiaa tis naal kihu chaaraa naahee ||
english: That which the Creator pre-ordained from the very beginning - there can be no escape from that.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਤੂ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਕਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam araadh too tis apaR ko na sakaahee ||
english: O servant Nanak, worship and adore the Naam, the Name of the Lord; no one can equal it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਵਾਈ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naavai kee vadiaaee vadee hai nit savaaee chaRai chaRaahee ||2||
english: Great is the greatness of His Name; it increases, day by day. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਹੋਂਦੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹਿ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: j ho(n)dai guroo bahi tikiaa tis jan kee vadiaaee vadee hoee ||
english: Great is the greatness of that humble being, whom the Guru Himself anointed in His Presence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਵਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਇਆ ਜਸੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tis kau jagat niviaa sabh pairee paiaa jas varatiaa loee ||
english: All the world comes and bows to him, falling at his feet. His praises spread throughout the world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਥੁ ਧਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tis kau kha(n)d brahama(n)d namasakaar karahi jis kai masatak hath dhariaa gur poorai so pooraa hoee ||
english: The galaxies and solar systems bow in reverence to him; the Perfect Guru has placed His hand upon his head, and he has become perfect.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur kee vadiaaee nit chaRai savaaee apaR ko na sakoee ||
english: The glorious greatness of the Guru increases day by day; no one can equal it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਬਹਿ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak har karatai aap bahi tikiaa aape paij rakhai prabh soee ||3||
english: O servant Nanak, the Creator Lord Himself established him; God preserves his honor. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kot apaar hai a(n)dar hatanaale ||
english: The human body is a great fortress, with its shops and streets within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saudaa jo kare har vasat samaale ||
english: The Gurmukh who comes to trade gathers the cargo of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਣਜੀਐ ਹੀਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan har vanajeeai heere paravaale ||
english: He deals in the treasure of the Lord's Name, the jewels and the diamonds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਜਿ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਧਨੁ ਖੋਜਦੇ ਸੇ ਮੂੜ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: vin kaaiaa j hor thai dhan khojade se mooR betaale ||
english: Those who search for this treasure outside of the body, in other places, are foolish demons.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਝਾੜ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: se ujhaR bharam bhavaaeeahi jiu jhaaR mirag bhaale ||15||
english: They wander around in the wilderness of doubt, like the deer who searches for the musk in the bushes. ||15||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸੁ ਅਉਖਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jo ni(n)daa kare satigur poore kee s aukhaa jag mahi hoiaa ||
english: One who slanders the Perfect True Guru, shall have difficulty in this world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰੁ ਦੁਖ ਖੂਹੁ ਹੈ ਓਥੈ ਪਕੜਿ ਓਹੁ ਢੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: narak ghor dukh khoohu hai othai pakaR ohu dhoiaa ||
english: He is caught and thrown into the most horrible hell, the well of pain and suffering.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਕੋ ਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਓਹੁ ਅਉਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਰੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kook pukaar ko na sune ohu aukhaa hoi hoi roiaa ||
english: No one listens to his shrieks and cries; he cries out in pain and misery.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਿ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: on halat palat sabh gavaaiaa laahaa mool sabh khoiaa ||
english: He totally loses this world and the next; he has lost all of his investment and profit.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਤੇਲੀ ਸੰਦਾ ਬਲਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ohu telee sa(n)daa balad kar nit bhalake uth prabh joiaa ||
english: He is like the ox at the oil-press; each morning when he rises, God places the yoke upon him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਦੂ ਕਿਛੁ ਗੁਝਾ ਨ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har vekhai sunai nit sabh kichh tidoo kichh gujhaa na hoiaa ||
english: The Lord always sees and hears everything; nothing can be concealed from Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਬੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa beeje so lunai jehaa purab kinai boiaa ||
english: As you plant, so shall you harvest, according to what you planted in the past.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis kripaa kare prabh aapanee tis satigur ke charan dhoiaa ||
english: One who is blessed by God's Grace washes the feet of the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਿਛੈ ਤਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਿਉ ਲੋਹਾ ਕਾਠ ਸੰਗੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur pichhai tar gaiaa jiu lohaa kaath sa(n)goiaa ||
english: He is carried across by the Guru, the True Guru, like iron which is carried across by wood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaai too jap har har naam sukh hoiaa ||1||
english: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, peace is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaageeaa sohaaganee jinaa guramukh miliaa har raai ||
english: Very fortunate is the soul-bride, who, as Gurmukh, meets the Lord, her King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)tar jot pragaaseeaa naanak naam samaai ||2||
english: Her inner being is illiminated with His Divine Light; O Nanak, she is absorbed in His Name. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ihu sareer sabh dharam hai jis a(n)dar sache kee vich jot ||
english: This body is the home of Dharma; the Divine Light of the True Lord is within it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਹਜ ਰਤਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੁਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਢੈ ਖੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: guhaj ratan vich luk rahe koee guramukh sevak kadhai khot ||
english: Hidden within it are the jewels of mystery; how rare is that Gurmukh, that selfless servant, who digs them out.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਇਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਇਕੋ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa taa(n) ik raviaa iko ot pot ||
english: When someone realizes the All-pervading Soul, then he sees the One and Only Lord permeating, through and through.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਇਕੋ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਸਰੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ik dekhiaa ik ma(n)niaa iko suniaa sravan sarot ||
english: He sees the One, he believes in the One, and with his ears, he listens only to the One.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਤਿ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam salaahi too sach sache sevaa teree hot ||16||
english: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is your service to the Lord, the Truest of the True. ||16||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh ras tin kai ridai hahi jin har vasiaa man maahi ||
english: All joy is in the hearts of those, within whose minds the Lord abides.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਭਿ ਦੇਖਣ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: har daragahi te mukh ujale tin kau sabh dekhan jaahi ||
english: In the Court of the Lord, their faces are radiant, and everyone goes to see them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jin nirabhau naam dhiaaiaa tin kau bhau koee naahi ||
english: Those who meditate on the Name of the Fearless Lord have no fear.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਰੇਵਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਹਿ ॥
transliteration: har utam tinee sareviaa jin kau dhur likhiaa aahi ||
english: Those who have such pre-destined destiny remember the Sublime Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਨਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: te har daragahi painaaeeahi jin har vuthaa man maahi ||
english: Those, within whose minds the Lord abides, are robed with honor in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਿਛੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: oi aap tare sabh kuta(n)b siu tin pichhai sabh jagat chhadaahi ||
english: They are carried across, along with all their family, and the whole world is saved along with them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਜਨ ਤਿਨ ਵੇਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਮ ਜੀਵਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau har mel jan tin vekh vekh ham jeevaahi ||1||
english: O Lord, please unite servant Nanak with Your humble servants; beholding them, beholding them, I live. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਭਈ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਜਿਥੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: saa dharatee bhaee hareeaavalee jithai meraa satigur baithaa aai ||
english: That land, where my True Guru comes and sits, becomes green and fertile.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜੰਤ ਭਏ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: se ja(n)t bhae hareeaavale jinee meraa satigur dekhiaa jaai ||
english: Those beings who go and behold my True Guru are rejuvenated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਨਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਣਿਆ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n pitaa dhan dha(n)n kul dhan dhan s jananee jin guroo janiaa maai ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the father; blessed, blessed is the family; blessed, blessed is the mother, who gave birth to the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੀ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n guroo jin naam araadhiaa aap tariaa jinee dithaa tinaa lae chhadaai ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, who worships and adores the Naam; He saves Himself, and emancipates those who see Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har satigur melahu daiaa kar jan naanak dhovai paai ||2||
english: O Lord, be kind, and unite me with the True Guru, that servant Nanak may wash His feet. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sach sachaa satigur amar hai jis a(n)dar har ur dhaariaa ||
english: Truest of the True is the Immortal True Guru; He has enshrined the Lord deep within His heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sach sachaa satigur purakh hai jin kaam krodh bikh maariaa ||
english: Truest of the True is the True Guru, the Primal Being, who has conquered sexual desire, anger and corruption.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਡਿਠਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa dithaa pooraa satiguroo taa(n) a(n)darahu man saadhaariaa ||
english: When I see the Perfect True Guru, then deep within, my mind is comforted and consoled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਘੁਮਿ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane sadaa sadaa ghum vaariaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru; I am devoted and dedicated to Him, forever and ever.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਤਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: guramukh jitaa manamukh haariaa ||17||
english: A Gurmukh wins the battle of life whereas a self-willed manmukh loses it. ||17||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿਓਨੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa satigur melion mukh guramukh naam dhiaaisee ||
english: By His Grace, He leads us to meet the True Guru; then, as Gurmukh, we chant the Lord's Name, and meditate on it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਘਰੀ ਵਸਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: so kare j satigur bhaavasee gur pooraa gharee vasaaisee ||
english: We do that which pleases the True Guru; the Perfect Guru comes to dwell in the home of the heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jin a(n)dar naam nidhaan hai tin kaa bhau sabh gavaaisee ||
english: Those who have the treasure of the Naam deep within - all their fears are removed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਰਖਣ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਜਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jin rakhan kau har aap hoi hor ketee jhakh jhakh jaaisee ||
english: They are protected by the Lord Himself; others struggle and fight against them, but they only come to death.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਛੋਡਾਇਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaai too har halat palat chhodaaisee ||1||
english: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam; the Lord shall deliver you, here and hereafter. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa kai man bhaavadee gur satigur kee vadiaaee ||
english: The glorious greatness of the Guru, the True Guru, is pleasing to the GurSikh's mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har raakhahu paij satiguroo kee nit chaRai savaaee ||
english: The Lord preserves the honor of the True Guru, which increases day by day.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਛਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur kai man paarabraham hai paarabraham chhadaaee ||
english: The Supreme Lord God is in the Mind of the Guru, the True Guru; the Supreme Lord God saves Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਭ ਆਣਿ ਨਿਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur taan deebaan har tin sabh aan nivaaee ||
english: The Lord is the Power and Support of the Guru, the True Guru; all come to bow before Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਡਿਠਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jinee dithaa meraa satigur bhaau kar tin ke sabh paap gavaaee ||
english: Those who have gazed lovingly upon my True Guru - all their sins are taken away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har daragah te mukh ujale bahu sobhaa paaee ||
english: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and they obtain great glory.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak ma(n)gai dhooR tin jo gur ke sikh mere bhaaee ||2||
english: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those GurSikhs, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਆਖਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: hau aakh salaahee siphat sach sach sache kee vadiaaee ||
english: I chant the Praises and Glories of the True One. True is the glorious greatness of the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saalaahee sach salaah sach sach keemat kinai na paaee ||
english: I praise the True Lord, and the Praises of the True Lord. His worth cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਚਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sach sachaa ras jinee chakhiaa se tripat rahe aaghaaee ||
english: Those who have tasted the true essence of the True Lord, remain satisfied and fulfilled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਦੇ ਜਿਉ ਗੂੰਗੈ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ihu har ras seee jaanade jiu goo(n)gai mithiaaee khaaee ||
english: They know this essence of the Lord, but they say nothing, like the mute who tastes the sweet candy, and says nothing.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: gur poorai har prabh seviaa man vajee vaadhaaee ||18||
english: The Perfect Guru serves the Lord God; His vibration vibrates and resounds in the mind. ||18||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਉਮਰਥਲ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਸੂਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jinaa a(n)dar umarathal seee jaanan sooleeaa ||
english: Those who have a festering boil within - they alone know its pain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਘੁਮਿ ਘੋਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har jaanahi seee birahu hau tin vitahu sad ghum gholeeaa ||
english: Those who know the pain of separation from the Lord - I am forever a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਤਲ ਰੋਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har melahu sajan purakh meraa sir tin vitahu tal roleeaa ||
english: O Lord, please lead me to meet the Guru, the Primal Being, my Friend; my head shall roll in the dust under His feet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਹਉ ਗੁਲਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਗੋਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jo sikh gur kaar kamaavahi hau gulam tinaa kaa goleeaa ||
english: I am the slave of the slaves of those GurSikhs who serve Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਭਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚੋਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g chaloolai jo rate tin bhinee har ra(n)g choleeaa ||
english: Those who are imbued with the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love - their robes are drenched in the Love of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਮੋਲੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa naanak mel gur pahi sir vechiaa moleeaa ||1||
english: Grant Your Grace, and lead Nanak to meet the Guru; I have sold my head to Him. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣੀ ਭਰਿਆ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: auganee bhariaa sareer hai kiu sa(n)tahu niramal hoi ||
english: The body is full of mistakes and misdeeds; how can it become pure, O Saints?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਵੇਹਾਝੀਅਹਿ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh gun vehaajheeahi mal haumai kadhai dhoi ||
english: The Gurmukh purchases virtues, which wash off the sin of egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sach vana(n)jahi ra(n)g siu sach saudaa hoi ||
english: True is the trade which purchases the True Lord with love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: totaa mool na aavaee laahaa har bhaavai soi ||
english: No loss will come from this, and the profit comes by the Lord's Will.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak tin sach vana(n)jiaa jinaa dhur likhiaa paraapat hoi ||2||
english: O Nanak, they alone purchase the Truth, who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: saalaahee sach saalaahanaa sach sachaa purakh niraale ||
english: I praise the True One, who alone is worthy of praise. The True Primal Being is True - this is His unique quality.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: sach sevee sach man vasai sach sachaa har rakhavaale ||
english: Serving the True Lord, the Truth comes to dwell in the mind. The Lord, the Truest of the True, is my Protector.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਾਇ ਰਲੇ ਸਚ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: sach sachaa jinee araadhiaa se jaai rale sach naale ||
english: Those who worship and adore the Truest of the True, shall go and merge with the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: sach sachaa jinee na seviaa se manamukh mooR betaale ||
english: Those who do not serve the Truest of the True - those self-willed manmukhs are foolish demons.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਆਲੁ ਪਤਾਲੁ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਜਿਉ ਪੀਤੈ ਮਦਿ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: oh aal pataal muhahu bolade jiu peetai mad matavaale ||19||
english: With their mouths, they babble on about this and that, like the drunkard who has drunk his wine. ||19||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਰਾਗਿ ਸੁਲਖਣੀ ਜੇ ਖਸਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: gauRee raag sulakhanee je khasamai chit karei ||
english: Gauree Raga is auspicious, if, through it, one comes to think of his Lord and Master.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਐਸਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai chalai satiguroo kai aisaa seegaar karei ||
english: He should walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru; this should be his decoration.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇਇ ॥
transliteration: sachaa sabad bhataar hai sadaa sadaa raavei ||
english: The True Word of the Shabad is our spouse; ravish and enjoy it, forever and ever.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਉਬਲੀ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਗਹਗਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਸਚੇ ਨੋ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: jiu ubalee majeethai ra(n)g gahagahaa tiu sache no jeeu dei ||
english: Like the deep crimson color of the madder plant - such is the dye which shall color you, when you dedicate your soul to the True One.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਅਤਿ ਰਤੀ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਗਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g chaloolai at ratee sache siu lagaa nehu ||
english: One who loves the True Lord is totally imbued with the Lord's Love, like the deep crimson color of the poppy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਠਗੀ ਗੁਝੀ ਨਾ ਰਹੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਮੁਲੰਮਾ ਪਲੇਟਿ ਧਰੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kooR thagee gujhee naa rahai kooR mula(n)maa palet dharehu ||
english: Falsehood and deception may be covered with false coatings, but they cannot remain hidden.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੀ ਕਰਨਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਕੂੜੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਗਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kooRee karan vadaaeeaa kooRe siu lagaa nehu ||
english: False is the uttering of praises, by those who love falsehood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sachaa aap hai aape nadar karei ||1||
english: O Nanak, He alone is True; He Himself casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mahi har usatat hai sa(n)g saadhoo mile piaariaa ||
english: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Lord's Praises are sung. In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Beloved Lord is met.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨ ਹਹਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: oi purakh praanee dha(n)n jan hahi upades karahi paraupakaariaa ||
english: Blessed is that mortal being, who shares the Teachings for the good of others.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਜਗੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har naam driRaavahi har naam sunaavahi har naame jag nisataariaa ||
english: He implants the Name of the Lord, and he preaches the Name of the Lord; through the Name of the Lord, the world is saved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੋਚੈ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਜਗਤਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur vekhan kau sabh koee lochai nav kha(n)d jagat namasakaariaa ||
english: Everyone longs to see the Guru; the world, and the nine continents, bow down to Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape aap rakhiaa satigur vich gur aape tudh savaariaa ||
english: You Yourself have established the True Guru; You Yourself have adorned the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: too aape poojahi pooj karaavahi satigur kau sirajanahaariaa ||
english: You Yourself worship and adore the True Guru; You inspire others to worship Him as well, O Creator Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਮੁਹੁ ਜਮਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: koee vichhuR jaai satiguroo paasahu tis kaalaa muhu jam maariaa ||
english: If someone separates himself from the True Guru, his face is blackened, and he is destroyed by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tis agai pichhai dhoee naahee gurasikhee man veechaariaa ||
english: He shall find no shelter, here or hereafter; the GurSikhs have realized this in their minds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo no mile seee jan ubare jin hiradai naam samaariaa ||
english: That humble being who meets the True Guru is saved; he cherishes the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in his heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੁਤਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak ke gurasikh putahahu har japiahu har nisataariaa ||2||
english: Servant Nanak says: O GurSikhs, O my sons, meditate on the Lord; only the Lord shall save you. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: haumai jagat bhulaaiaa duramat bikhiaa bikaar ||
english: Egotism has led the world astray, along with evil-mindedness and the poison of corruption.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta nadar hoi manamukh a(n)dh a(n)dhiaar ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, we are blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace, while the self-willed manmukh gropes around in the darkness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਏ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak aape mel lae jis no sabad laae piaar ||3||
english: O Nanak, the Lord absorbs into Himself those whom He inspires to love the Word of His Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਭਿਜੈ ॥
transliteration: sach sache kee siphat salaah hai so kare jis a(n)dar bhijai ||
english: True are the Praises and the Glories of the True One; he alone speaks them, whose mind is softened within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕੰਧੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਛਿਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jinee ik man ik araadhiaa tin kaa ka(n)dh na kabahoo chhijai ||
english: Those who worship the One Lord with single-minded devotion - their bodies shall never perish.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਿਜੈ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan purakh saabaas hai jin sach rasanaa a(n)mrit pijai ||
english: Blessed, blessed and acclaimed is that person, who tastes with his tongue the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਸੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਿਜੈ ॥
transliteration: sach sachaa jin man bhaavadaa se man sachee daragah lijai ||
english: One whose mind is pleased with the Truest of the True is accepted in the True Court.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਚਿਆਰੀਆ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿਜੈ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n janam sachiaareeaa mukh ujal sach karijai ||20||
english: Blessed, blessed is the birth of those true beings; the True Lord brightens their faces. ||20||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਜਾਇ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saakat jaai nivahi gur aagai man khote kooR kooRiaare ||
english: The faithless cynics go and bow before the Guru, but their minds are corrupt and false, totally false.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਉਠਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਬਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਘੁਸਰਿ ਬਗੁਲਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa gur kahai uthahu mere bhaaee bahi jaahi ghusar bagulaare ||
english: When the Guru says, "Rise up, my Siblings of Destiny", they sit down, crowded in like cranes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਕਢੇ ਲਧੋਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa a(n)dar satigur varatai chun kadhe ladhovaare ||
english: The True Guru prevails among His GurSikhs; they pick out and expel the wanderers.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਬਹਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਛਪਾਇਨਿ ਨ ਰਲਨੀ ਖੋਟੇਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: oi agai pichhai bahi muhu chhapaain na ralanee khoteaare ||
english: Sitting here and there, they hide their faces; being counterfeit, they cannot mix with the genuine.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਦਾ ਭਖੁ ਸੁ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਕੂੜੁ ਲਹਨਿ ਭੇਡਾਰੇ ॥
