transliteration: onaa daa bhakh s othai naahee jaai kooR lahan bhedaare ||
english: There is no food for them there; the false go into the filth like sheep.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਨਰੁ ਖਾਵਾਈਐ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਢੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਉਗਲਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: je saakat nar khaavaaeeai locheeai bikh kadhai mukh ugalaare ||
english: If you try to feed the faithless cynic, he will spit out poison from his mouth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੇਤੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਓਇ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har saakat setee sa(n)g na kareeahu oi maare sirajanahaare ||
english: O Lord, let me not be in the company of the faithless cynic, who is cursed by the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis kaa ihu khel soee kar vekhai jan naanak naam samaare ||1||
english: This drama belongs to the Lord; He performs it, and He watches over it. Servant Nanak cherishes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh aga(n)m hai jis a(n)dar har ur dhaariaa ||
english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is inaccessible; He has enshrined the Lord's Name within His heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਲਿ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo no apaR koi na sakaee jis val sirajanahaariaa ||
english: No one can equal the True Guru; the Creator Lord is on His side.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਖੜਗੁ ਸੰਜੋਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo kaa khaRag sa(n)jou har bhagat hai jit kaal ka(n)tak maar vidaariaa ||
english: Devotional worship of the Lord is the sword and armor of the True Guru; He has killed and cast out Death, the torturer.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo kaa rakhanahaaraa har aap hai satiguroo kai pichhai har sabh ubaariaa ||
english: The Lord Himself is the Protector of the True Guru. The Lord saves all those who follow in the footsteps of the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮੰਦਾ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰੈ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jo ma(n)daa chitavai poore satiguroo kaa so aap upaavanahaarai maariaa ||
english: One who thinks evil of the Perfect True Guru - the Creator Lord Himself destroys him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਗਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: eh gal hovai har daragah sache kee jan naanak agam veechaariaa ||2||
english: These words will be confirmed as true in the Court of the Lord; servant Nanak reveals this mystery. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਜਾ ਉਠੇ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਚਵੇ ॥
transliteration: sach sutiaa jinee araadhiaa jaa uthe taa sach chave ||
english: Those who dwell upon the True Lord while asleep, utter the True Name when they are awake.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਵੇ ॥
transliteration: se virale jug mahi jaaneeahi jo guramukh sach rave ||
english: How rare in the world are those Gurmukhs who dwell upon the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਲਵੇ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree tin kau j anadin sach lave ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who chant the True Name, night and day.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਸੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਗਵੇ ॥
transliteration: jin man tan sachaa bhaavadaa se sachee daragah gave ||
english: The True Lord is pleasing to their minds and bodies; they go to the Court of the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਵੇ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak bolai sach naam sach sachaa sadaa nave ||21||
english: Servant Nanak chants the True Name; truly, the True Lord is forever brand new. ||21||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਸਵਣਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਗਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: kiaa savanaa kiaa jaaganaa guramukh te paravaan ||
english: Who is asleep, and who is awake? Those who are Gurmukh are approved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jinaa saas giraas na visarai se poore purakh paradhaan ||
english: Those who do not forget the Lord, with each and every breath and morsel of food, are the perfect and famous persons.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: karamee satigur paaeeai anadin lagai dhiaan ||
english: By His Grace they find the True Guru; night and day, they meditate.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tin kee sa(n)gat mil rahaa daragah paaee maan ||
english: I join the society of those persons, and in so doing, I am honored in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਉਦੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਉਠਦੇ ਭੀ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: saude vaahu vaahu ucharahi uthade bhee vaahu karen ||
english: While asleep, they chant, "Waaho! Waaho!", and while awake, they chant, "Waaho!" as well.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਜਿ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਸੰਮਾਲੇਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak te mukh ujale j nit uth sa(n)maalen ||1||
english: O Nanak, radiant are the faces of those, who rise up early each day, and dwell upon the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur seveeai aapanaa paaeeai naam apaar ||
english: Serving his True Guru, one obtains the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਉਜਲਿ ਡੁਬਦਿਆ ਕਢਿ ਲਏ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhaujal dubadiaa kadh lae har daat kare daataar ||
english: The drowning person is lifted up and out of the terrifying world-ocean; the Great Giver gives the gift of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n se saah hai j naam karahi vaapaar ||
english: Blessed, blessed are those bankers who trade the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਸਿਖ ਆਵਦੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਘਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: vanajaare sikh aavade sabad laghaavanahaar ||
english: The Sikhs, the traders come, and through the Word of His Shabad, they are carried across.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭਈ ਤਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak jin kau kripaa bhaee tin seviaa sirajanahaar ||2||
english: O servant Nanak, they alone serve the Creator Lord, who are blessed by His Grace. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਭਗਤ ਹਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sach sache ke jan bhagat hahi sach sachaa jinee araadhiaa ||
english: Those who truly worship and adore the True Lord, are truly the humble devotees of the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jin guramukh khoj dha(n)dholiaa tin a(n)darahu hee sach laadhiaa ||
english: Those Gurmukhs who search and seek, find the True One within themselves.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਾਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sach saahib sach jinee seviaa kaal ka(n)tak maar tinee saadhiaa ||
english: Those who truly serve their True Lord and Master, overwhelm and conquer Death, the torturer.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਲਾਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sach sachaa sabh doo vadaa hai sach sevan se sach ralaadhiaa ||
english: The True One is truly the greatest of all; those who serve the True One are blended with the True One.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਨੋ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਫਲਾਧਿਆ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: sach sache no saabaas hai sach sachaa sev phalaadhiaa ||22||
english: Blessed and acclaimed is the Truest of the True; serving the Truest of the True, one blossoms forth in fruition. ||22||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਹੀਣ ਭਰਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh praanee mugadh hai naamaheen bharamaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is foolish; he wanders around without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur manooaa naa tikai phir phir joonee paai ||
english: Without the Guru, his mind is not held steady, and he is reincarnated, over and over again.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: har prabh aap daiaal hohi taa(n) satigur miliaa aai ||
english: But when the Lord God Himself becomes merciful to him, then the True Guru comes to meet him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam salaahi too janam maran dukh jaai ||1||
english: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam; the pains of birth and death shall come to an end. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur saalaahee aapanaa bahu bidh ra(n)g subhaai ||
english: I praise my Guru in so many ways, with joyful love and affection.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰਖਿਆ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur setee man rataa rakhiaa banat banaai ||
english: My mind is imbued with the True Guru; He has preserved the make of its making.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa saalaahi na rajaee har preetam chit laai ||
english: My tongue is not satisfied by praising Him; He has linked my consciousness with the Lord, my Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naavai kee man bhukh hai man tripatai har ras khaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, my mind hungers for the Name of the Lord; my mind is satisfied, tasting the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਣਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: sach sachaa kudarat jaaneeai din raatee jin banaaeeaa ||
english: The True Lord is truly known for His all-powerful creative nature; He fashioned the days and the nights.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
transliteration: so sach salaahee sadaa sadaa sach sache keeaa vadiaaeeaa ||
english: I praise that True Lord, forever and ever; True is the glorious greatness of the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: saalaahee sach salaah sach sach keemat kinai na paaeeaa ||
english: True are the Praises of the Praiseworthy True Lord; the value of the True Lord cannot be appraised.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤਾ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਈਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa miliaa pooraa satiguroo taa haajar nadaree aaeeaa ||
english: When someone meets the Perfect True Guru, then His Sublime Presence comes to be seen.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਈਆ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: sach guramukh jinee salaahiaa tinaa bhukhaa sabh gavaaeeaa ||23||
english: Those Gurmukhs who praise the True Lord - all their hunger is gone. ||23||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜੇਦਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਧਾ ਲੋੜਿ ॥
transliteration: mai man tan khoj khojediaa so prabh ladhaa loR ||
english: Searching and examining my mind and body, I have found that God, whom I longed for.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਟੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਜੋੜਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: visat guroo mai paaiaa jin har prabh ditaa joR ||1||
english: I have found the Guru, the Divine Intermediary, who has united me with the Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਅਤਿ ਅੰਨਾ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaadhaaree at a(n)naa bolaa ||
english: One who is attached to Maya is totally blind and deaf.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਬਹੁ ਰੋਲ ਘਚੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad na sunaee bahu rol ghacholaa ||
english: He does not listen to the Word of the Shabad; he makes a great uproar and tumult.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jaapai sabad liv laai ||
english: The Gurmukhs chant and meditate on the Shabad, and lovingly center their consciousness on it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har naam sun ma(n)ne har naam samaai ||
english: They hear and believe in the Name of the Lord; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai s kare karaaiaa ||
english: Whatever pleases God, He causes that to be done.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਜਦਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak vajadaa ja(n)t vajaaiaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, human beings are the instruments which vibrate as God plays them. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਜੋ ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤੈ ॥
transliteration: too karataa sabh kichh jaanadaa jo jeeaa a(n)dar varatai ||
english: You, O Creator, know everything which occurs within our beings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਗਣਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਣਤੈ ॥
transliteration: too karataa aap aganat hai sabh jag vich ganatai ||
english: You Yourself, O Creator, are incalculable, while the entire world is within the realm of calculation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਣਤੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh keetaa teraa varatadaa sabh teree banatai ||
english: Everything happens according to Your Will; You created all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਚਲਤੈ ॥
transliteration: too ghat ghat ik varatadaa sach saahib chalatai ||
english: You are the One, pervading in each and every heart; O True Lord and Master, this is Your play.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਪਰਤੈ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: satigur no mile s har mile naahee kisai paratai ||24||
english: One who meets the True Guru meets the Lord; no one can turn him away. ||24||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: ihu manooaa driR kar rakheeai guramukh laaeeai chit ||
english: Hold this mind steady and stable; become Gurmukh and focus your consciousness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ॥
transliteration: kiu saas giraas visaareeai bahadiaa uthadiaa nit ||
english: How could you ever forget Him, with each breath and morsel of food, sitting down or standing up?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਈ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਸਿ ॥
transliteration: maran jeevan kee chi(n)taa gaee ihu jeeaRaa har prabh vas ||
english: My anxiety about birth and death has ended; this soul is under the control of the Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਖਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu rakh too jan naanak naam bakhas ||1||
english: If it pleases You, then save servant Nanak, and bless him with Your Name. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਪੀਛੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh aha(n)kaaree mahal na jaanai khin aagai khin peechhai ||
english: The egotistical, self-willed manmukh does not know the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; one moment he is here, and the next moment he is there.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ਮਹਲਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੀਝੈ ॥
transliteration: sadaa bulaaeeai mahal na aavai kiu kar daragah seejhai ||
english: He is always invited, but he does not go to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. How shall he be accepted in the Court of the Lord?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur kaa mahal viralaa jaanai sadaa rahai kar joR ||
english: How rare are those who know the Mansion of the True Guru; they stand with their palms pressed together.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਏ ਬਹੋੜਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aapanee kripaa kare har meraa naanak lae bahoR ||2||
english: If my Lord grants His Grace, O Nanak, He restores them to Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨੇ ॥
transliteration: saa sevaa keetee saphal hai jit satigur kaa man ma(n)ne ||
english: Fruitful and rewarding is that service, which is pleasing to the Guru's Mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਾ ਪਾਪ ਕਸੰਮਲ ਭੰਨੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa satigur kaa man ma(n)niaa taa paap kasa(n)mal bha(n)ne ||
english: When the Mind of the True Guru is pleased, then sins and misdeeds run away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਜਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਸਿਖੀ ਕੰਨੇ ॥
transliteration: upades j ditaa satiguroo so suniaa sikhee ka(n)ne ||
english: The Sikhs listen to the Teachings imparted by the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਚੜੀ ਚਵਗਣਿ ਵੰਨੇ ॥
transliteration: jin satigur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)niaa tin chaRee chavagan va(n)ne ||
english: Those who surrender to the True Guru's Will are imbued with the four-fold Love of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਚਾਲ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਭਿੰਨੇ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: ih chaal niraalee guramukhee gur deekhiaa sun man bhi(n)ne ||25||
english: This is the unique and distinct life-style of the Gurmukhs: listening to the Guru's Teachings, their minds blossom forth. ||25||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin gur gopiaa aapanaa tis thaur na thaau ||
english: Those who do not affirm their Guru shall have no home or place of rest.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਏ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: halat palat dovai gae daragah naahee thaau ||
english: They lose both this world and the next; they have no place in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਗਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: oh velaa hath na aavaee phir satigur lagahi paai ||
english: This opportunity to bow at the Feet of the True Guru shall never come again.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਣਤੈ ਘੁਸੀਐ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee ganatai ghuseeai dukhe dukh vihaai ||
english: If they miss out on being counted by the True Guru, they shall pass their lives in pain and misery.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh niravair hai aape lae jis laai ||
english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has no hatred or vengeance; He unites with Himself those with whom He is pleased.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਓਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak darasan jinaa vekhaalion tinaa daragah lae chhadaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, are emancipated in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: manamukh agiaan duramat aha(n)kaaree ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is ignorant, evil-minded and egotistical.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜੂਐ ਮਤਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar krodh jooai mat haaree ||
english: He is filled with anger within, and he loses his mind in the gamble.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਓਹੁ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kooR kusat ohu paap kamaavai ||
english: He commits the sins of fraud and unrighteousness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa ohu sunai kiaa aakh sunaavai ||
english: What can he hear, and what can he tell others?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਨਾ ਬੋਲਾ ਖੁਇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)naa bolaa khui ujhaR paai ||
english: He is blind and deaf; he loses his way, and wanders lost in the wilderness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhaa aavai jaai ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukh comes and goes in reincarnation;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur bhete thaai na paai ||
english: without meeting the True Guru, he finds no place of rest.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, he acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਕਠੋਰ ਹਹਿ ਸੇ ਬਹਹਿ ਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jin ke chit kathor hahi se bahahi na satigur paas ||
english: Those who have hearts as hard as stone, do not sit near the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਚਿਤ ਉਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: othai sach varatadaa kooRiaaraa chit udaas ||
english: Truth prevails there; the false ones do not attune their consciousness to it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਵਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਝਤਿ ਕਢਦੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹਹਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: oi val chhal kar jhat kadhade phir jaai bahahi kooRiaaraa paas ||
english: By hook or by crook, they pass their time, and then they go back to sit with the false ones again.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਗਡਈ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: vich sache kooR na gadaee man vekhahu ko nirajaas ||
english: Falsehood does not mix with the Truth; O people, check it out and see.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀ ਜਾਇ ਰਲੇ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਸਿਖ ਬੈਠੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: kooRiaar kooRiaaree jaai rale sachiaar sikh baithe satigur paas ||26||
english: The false go and mingle with the false, while the truthful Sikhs sit by the side of the True Guru. ||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਹਦੇ ਖੁਹਦੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਹਰੁ ॥
transliteration: rahade khuhade ni(n)dak maarian kar aape aahar ||
english: By their own efforts, the slanderers have destroyed all remnants of themselves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਜਾਹਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sahaaee naanakaa varatai sabh jaahar ||1||
english: The Support of the Saints, O Nanak, is manifest, pervading everywhere. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਮੁੰਢ ਤੇ ਕਿਥੈ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਹਥੁ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dhahu bhule mu(n)dh te kithai paain hath ||
english: Those who went astray from the Primal Being in the very beginning - where can they find refuge?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿੰਨੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ti(n)nai maare naanakaa j karan kaaran samarath ||2||
english: O Nanak, they are struck down by the All-powerful, the Cause of causes. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ ॥
transliteration: pauRee 5 ||
english: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਫਾਹੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਤੁਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: lai phaahe raatee turahi prabh jaanai praanee ||
english: They take the noose in their hands, and go out at night to strangle others, but God knows everything, O mortal.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਕਹਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਈਆ ਲੁਕਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਠਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: takahi naar paraaeeaa luk a(n)dar thaanee ||
english: They spy on other men's women, concealed in their hiding places.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਨੑੀ ਦੇਨੑਿ ਵਿਖੰਮ ਥਾਇ ਮਿਠਾ ਮਦੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)nhee denhi vikha(n)m thaai mithaa mad maanee ||
english: They break into well-protected places, and revel in sweet wine.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: karamee aapo aapanee aape pachhutaanee ||
english: But they shall come to regret their actions - they create their own karma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਫਰੇਸਤਾ ਤਿਲ ਪੀੜੇ ਘਾਣੀ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: ajaraaeel pharesataa til peeRe ghaanee ||27||
english: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, shall crush them like sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਕੇ ਸੇਈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sevak sache saah ke seee paravaan ||
english: The servants of the True King are acceptable and approved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੇ ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਜਾਣ ॥੧॥
transliteration: doojaa sevan naanakaa se pach pach mue ajaan ||1||
english: Those ignorant ones who serve duality, O Nanak, rot, waste away and die. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa lekh prabh metanaa na jaai ||
english: That destiny which was pre-ordained by God from the very beginning cannot be erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਖਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam naam dhan vakharo naanak sadaa dhiaai ||2||
english: The wealth of the Lord's Name is Nanak's capital; he meditates on it forever. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ ॥
transliteration: pauRee 5 ||
english: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣਿ ਲਇਆ ਨਾਠੂੰਗੜਾ ਪੈਰ ਕਿਥੈ ਰਖੈ ॥
transliteration: naaraain laiaa naathoo(n)gaRaa pair kithai rakhai ||
english: One who has received a kick from the Lord God - where can he place his foot?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਦਾ ਪਾਪ ਅਮਿਤਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਵਿਸੋ ਚਖੈ ॥
transliteration: karadaa paap amitiaa nit viso chakhai ||
english: He commits countless sins, and continually eats poison.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਭਖੈ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa karadaa pach muaa vich dehee bhakhai ||
english: Slandering others, he wastes away and dies; within his body, he burns.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਰਖੈ ॥
transliteration: sachai saahib maariaa kaun tis no rakhai ||
english: One who has been struck down by the True Lord and Master - who can save him now?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲਖੈ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: naanak tis saranaagatee jo purakh alakhai ||28||
english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Unseen Lord, the Primal Being. ||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: narak ghor bahu dukh ghane akirataghanaa kaa thaan ||
english: In the most horrible hell, there is terrible pain and suffering. It is the place of the ungrateful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਏ ਹਰਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin prabh maare naanakaa hoi hoi mue haraam ||1||
english: They are struck down by God, O Nanak, and they die a most miserable death. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਖਧ ਸਭੇ ਕੀਤਿਅਨੁ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: avakhadh sabhe keetian ni(n)dak kaa daaroo naahi ||
english: All kinds of medicines may be prepared, but there is no cure for the slanderer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap bhulaae naanakaa pach pach jonee paahi ||2||
english: Those whom the Lord Himself misleads, O Nanak, putrefy and rot in reincarnation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ ॥
transliteration: pauRee 5 ||
english: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਸਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ॥
transliteration: tus ditaa poorai satiguroo har dhan sach akhut ||
english: By His Pleasure, the True Guru has blessed me with the inexhaustible wealth of the Name of the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਛੁਟੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh a(n)dese mit gae jam kaa bhau chhut ||
english: All my anxiety is ended; I am rid of the fear of death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤੁਟੁ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh buriaaeeaa(n) sa(n)g saadhoo tut ||
english: Sexual desire, anger and other evils have been subdued in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਹੁਇ ਮਰਸਨਿ ਬੁਟੁ ॥
transliteration: vin sache doojaa sevade hui marasan but ||
english: Those who serve another, instead of the True Lord, die unfulfilled in the end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੁਟੁ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: naanak kau gur bakhasiaa naamai sa(n)g jut ||29||
english: The Guru has blessed Nanak with forgiveness; he is united with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਪਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਅੰਦ੍ਰਹੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਨਿਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਫਿਰੈ ਜਜਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tapaa na hovai a(n)drahu lobhee nit maaiaa no phirai jajamaaliaa ||
english: He is not a penitent, who is greedy within his heart, and who constantly chases after Maya like a leper.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਸਦਿਆ ਸਤੈ ਦੀ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਲਏ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਣਿ ਤਪੈ ਪੁਤੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ago de sadiaa satai dee bhikhiaa lae naahee pichho de pachhutaai kai aan tapai put vich bahaaliaa ||
english: When this penitent was first invited, he refused our charity; but later he repented and sent his son, who was seated in the congregation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਲੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਹਸਣ ਲਗੇ ਤਪਾ ਲੋਭਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਗਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch log sabh hasan lage tapaa lobh lahar hai gaaliaa ||
english: The village elders all laughed, saying that the waves of greed have destroyed this penitent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਥੋੜਾ ਧਨੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਤਪਾ ਭਿਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਧਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੈ ਡਿਠੈ ਤਪੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jithai thoRaa dhan vekhai tithai tapaa bhitai naahee dhan bahutai dithai tapai dharam haariaa ||
english: If he sees only a little wealth, he does not bother to go there; but when he sees a lot of wealth, the penitent forsakes his vows.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਏਹੁ ਤਪਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਹੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee ehu tapaa na hovee bagulaa hai bahi saadh janaa veechaariaa ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, he is not a penitent - he is only a stork. Sitting together, the Holy Congregation has so decided.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਤਪਾ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਏਤੁ ਦੋਖੈ ਤਪਾ ਦਯਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sat purakh kee tapaa ni(n)daa karai sa(n)saarai kee usatatee vich hovai et dokhai tapaa day maariaa ||
english: The penitent slanders the True Primal Being, and sings the praises of the material world. For this sin, he is cursed by the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਾਂ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਾ ਵੇਖੁ ਜਿ ਤਪੇ ਨੋ ਫਲੁ ਲਗਾ ਸਭੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਪੇ ਕਾ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa purakhaa(n) kee ni(n)daa kaa vekh j tape no phal lagaa sabh gaiaa tape kaa ghaaliaa ||
english: Behold the fruit the penitent gathers, for slandering the Great Primal Being; all his labors have gone in vain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬਹੈ ਪੰਚਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਪਾ ਸਦਾਏ ॥ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਹੈ ਤਪਾ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਏ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਲਾ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੰਚਾ ਨੋ ਉਘਾ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: baahar bahai pa(n)chaa vich tapaa sadaae || a(n)dar bahai tapaa paap kamaae || har a(n)daralaa paap pa(n)chaa no ughaa kar vekhaaliaa ||
english: When he sits outside among the elders, he is called a penitent; But when he sits within the congregation, the penitent commits sin. The Lord has exposed the penitent's secret sin to the elders.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਮਕੰਕਰਾ ਨੋ ਆਖਿ ਛਡਿਆ ਏਸੁ ਤਪੇ ਨੋ ਤਿਥੈ ਖੜਿ ਪਾਇਹੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਮਹਾ ਮਹਾਂ ਹਤਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dharam raai jamaka(n)karaa no aakh chhadiaa es tape no tithai khaR paaihu jithai mahaa mahaa(n) hatiaariaa ||
english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma said to the Messenger of Death, "Take this penitent and put him with the worst of the worst murderers."

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਏਸੁ ਤਪੇ ਦੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਲਗਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹੈ ਫਿਟਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: phir es tape dai muhi koee lagahu naahee ehu satigur hai phitakaariaa ||
english: No one is to look at the face of this penitent again. He has been cursed by the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੁ ਦਯਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kai dar varatiaa s naanak aakh sunaaiaa || so boojhai j day savaariaa ||1||
english: Nanak speaks and reveals what has taken place in the Court of the Lord. He alone understands, who is blessed and adorned by the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: har bhagataa(n) har aaraadhiaa har kee vadiaaee ||
english: The devotees of the Lord worship and adore the Lord, and the glorious greatness of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਂਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har keeratan bhagat nit gaa(n)vade har naam sukhadaaee ||
english: The Lord's devotees continually sing the Kirtan of His Praises; the Name of the Lord is the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਨੋ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har bhagataa(n) no nit naavai dee vadiaaee bakhaseean nit chaRai savaaee ||
english: The Lord ever bestows upon His devotees the glorious greatness of His Name, which increases day by day.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਨੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰੀ ਬਹਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਅਪਣੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har bhagataa(n) no thir gharee bahaalian apanee paij rakhaaee ||
english: The Lord inspires His devotees to sit, steady and stable, in the home of their inner being. He preserves their honor.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕਾਂ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗਸੀ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dakaa(n) paasahu har lekhaa ma(n)gasee bahu dei sajaaee ||
english: The Lord summons the slanderers to answer for their accounts, and He punishes them severely.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਅਪਣੈ ਜੀਇ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਤੇਹੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jehaa ni(n)dak apanai jeei kamaavade teho phal paaee ||
english: As the slanderers think of acting, so are the fruits they obtain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸਰਪਰ ਉਘੜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਬਹਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar kamaanaa sarapar ughaRai bhaavai koee bahi dharatee vich kamaaee ||
english: Actions done in secrecy are sure to come to light, even if one does it underground.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak dekh vigasiaa har kee vadiaaee ||2||
english: Servant Nanak blossoms forth in joy, beholding the glorious greatness of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: pauRee mah 5 ||
english: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa(n) kaa raakhaa har aap hai kiaa paapee kareeai ||
english: The Lord Himself is the Protector of His devotees; what can the sinner do to them?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੂੜ ਗੁਮਾਨੀਆ ਵਿਸੁ ਖਾਧੀ ਮਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: gumaan karahi mooR gumaaneeaa vis khaadhee mareeai ||
english: The proud fool acts in pride, and eating his own poison, he dies.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਲਗੇ ਨੀ ਦਿਹ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਜਿਉ ਪਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਲੁਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: aai lage nee dih thoRaRe jiu pakaa khet luneeai ||
english: His few days have come to an end, and he is cut down like the crop at harvest.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਭਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jehe karam kamaavade teveho bhaneeai ||
english: According to one's actions, so is one spoken of.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾ ਧਣੀਐ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: jan naanak kaa khasam vadaa hai sabhanaa daa dhaneeai ||30||
english: Glorious and great is the Lord and Master of servant Nanak; He is the Master of all. ||30||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh moolahu bhuliaa vich lab lobh aha(n)kaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs forget the Primal Lord, the Source of all; they are caught in greed and egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਝਗੜਾ ਕਰਦਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਦਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jhagaRaa karadiaa anadin gudarai sabad na karahi veechaar ||
english: They pass their nights and days in conflict and struggle; they do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਧਿ ਮਤਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sudh mat karatai sabh hir laee bolan sabh vikaar ||
english: The Creator has taken away all their understanding and purity; all their speech is evil and corrupt.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਿਤੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਅਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ditai kitai na sa(n)tokheeahi a(n)tar tisanaa bahu agiaan a(n)dhyaar ||
english: No matter what they are given, they are not satisfied; within their hearts there is great desire, ignorance and darkness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨਾਲੋ ਤੁਟੀ ਭਲੀ ਜਿਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak manamukhaa naalo tutee bhalee jin maaiaa moh piaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, it is good to break away from the self-willed manmukhs, who have love and attachment to Maya. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jinaa a(n)dar doojaa bhaau hai tinhaa guramukh preet na hoi ||
english: Those whose hearts are filled with the love of duality, do not love the Gurmukhs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ohu aavai jaai bhavaaeeai supanai sukh na koi ||
english: They come and go, and wander in reincarnation; even in their dreams, they find no peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kooR kamaavai kooR ucharai kooR lagiaa kooR hoi ||
english: They practice falsehood and they speak falsehood; attached to falsehood, they become false.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabh dukh hai dukh binasai dukh roi ||
english: The love of Maya is total pain; in pain they perish, and in pain they cry out.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਲਿਵੈ ਜੋੜੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak dhaat livai joR na aavaee je lochai sabh koi ||
english: O Nanak, there can be no union between the love of worldliness and the love of the Lord, no matter how much everyone may desire it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਇਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin kau potai pu(n)n paiaa tinaa gurasabadee sukh hoi ||2||
english: Those who have the treasure of virtuous deeds find peace through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: pauRee mah 5 ||
english: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨਾਂ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਕਹੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: naanak veechaarahi sa(n)t mun janaa(n) chaar ved kaha(n)de ||
english: O Nanak, the Saints and the silent sages think, and the four Vedas proclaim,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਮੁਖੈ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸੇ ਵਚਨ ਹੋਵੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat mukhai te bolade se vachan hova(n)de ||
english: that whatever the Lord's devotees speak comes to pass.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਗਟ ਪਾਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਪਦੇ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: paragat paahaarai jaapade sabh lok suna(n)de ||
english: He is revealed in His cosmic workshop; all people hear of it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਰ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਖਹੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: sukh na paain mugadh nar sa(n)t naal khaha(n)de ||
english: The foolish people, who fight with the Saints, find no peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਲੋਚਨਿ ਓਨਾ ਗੁਣਾ ਨੋ ਓਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਸੜੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: oi lochan onaa gunaa no oi aha(n)kaar saRa(n)de ||
english: The Saints seek to bless them with virtue, but they are burning with egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਾਂ ਭਾਗ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: oi vechaare kiaa karahi jaa(n) bhaag dhur ma(n)de ||
english: What can those wretched ones do? Their evil destiny was pre-ordained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਸੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: jo maare tin paarabraham se kisai na sa(n)de ||
english: Those who are struck down by the Supreme Lord God do not belong to anyone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰਨਿ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਧਰਮਿ ਨਿਆਇ ਪਚੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: vair karan niravair naal dharam niaai pacha(n)de ||
english: Those who hate the One who has no hatred, are destroyed by righteous justice.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੰਤਿ ਸਰਾਪਿਆ ਸੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਭਵੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: jo jo sa(n)t saraapiaa se phirahi bhava(n)de ||
english: Those who are cursed by the Saints wander around lost.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੇਡੁ ਮੁੰਢਾਹੂ ਕਟਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਡਾਲ ਸੁਕੰਦੇ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: ped mu(n)dhaahoo katiaa tis daal suka(n)de ||31||
english: When the tree is cut off at its roots, the branches wither and die. ||31||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਭੰਨਣ ਘੜਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
transliteration: gur naanak har naam driRaaiaa bha(n)nan ghaRan samarath ||
english: Guru Nanak implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; He is All-powerful, to create and destroy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਤੂ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਲਥੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh sadaa samaalahi mitr too dukh sabaaiaa lath ||1||
english: Remember God forever, my friend, and all your suffering will disappear. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖੁਧਿਆਵੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਲਾਜ ਕੁਲਾਜ ਕੁਬੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: khudhiaava(n)t na jaanaee laaj kulaaj kubol ||
english: The hungry person does not care about honor, dishonor or harsh words.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak maa(n)gai naam har kar kirapaa sa(n)jog ||2||
english: Nanak begs for the Name of the Lord; please grant Your Grace, and unite me with Yourself. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਵੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦਾ ਤੇਵੇਹੇ ਫਲਤੇ ॥
transliteration: jevehe karam kamaavadaa tevehe phalate ||
english: According to the deeds which one does, so are the fruits one obtains.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਬੇ ਤਤਾ ਲੋਹ ਸਾਰੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਘੈ ਪਲਤੇ ॥
transliteration: chabe tataa loh saar vich sa(n)ghai palate ||
english: If someone chews on red-hot iron, his throat will be burned.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਤਿ ਗਲਾਵਾਂ ਚਾਲਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੂਤਿ ਅਮਲ ਤੇ ॥
transliteration: ghat galaavaa(n) chaaliaa tin doot amal te ||
english: The halter is put around his neck and he is led away, because of the evil deeds he has done.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਈ ਆਸ ਨ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਪਰ ਮਲੁ ਹਿਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: kaaee aas na pu(n)neeaa nit par mal hirate ||
english: None of his desires are fulfilled; he continually steals the filth of others.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੀਆ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: keeaa na jaanai akirataghan vich jonee phirate ||
english: The ungrateful wretch does not appreciate what he has been given; he wanders lost in reincarnation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਧਿਰਾਂ ਨਿਖੁਟੀਅਸੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈਅਸੁ ਧਰ ਤੇ ॥
transliteration: sabhe dhiraa(n) nikhuteeas hir laeeas dhar te ||
english: He loses all support, when the Support of the Lord is taken away from him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਝਣ ਕਲਹ ਨ ਦੇਵਦਾ ਤਾਂ ਲਇਆ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: vijhan kalah na devadaa taa(n) laiaa karate ||
english: He does not let the embers of strife die down, and so the Creator destroys him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਤੇ ਅਹੰਮੇਉ ਝੜਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਪੜਤੇ ॥੩੨॥
transliteration: jo jo karate aha(n)meu jhaR dharatee paRate ||32||
english: Those who indulge in egotism crumble and fall to the ground. ||32||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh giaan bibek budh hoi ||
english: The Gurmukh is blessed with spiritual wisdom and a discerning intellect.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavai hiradai haar paroi ||
english: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and weaves this garland into his heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਪਰਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pavit paavan param beechaaree ||
english: He becomes the purest of the pure, a being of supreme understanding.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਓਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: j os milai tis paar utaaree ||
english: Whoever he meets, he saves and carries across.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar har naam baasanaa samaanee ||
english: The fragrance of the Lord's Name permeates his being deep within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਮਹਾ ਉਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har dar sobhaa mahaa utam baanee ||
english: He is honored in the Court of the Lord, and his speech is the most sublime.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: j purakh sunai s hoi nihaal ||
english: Those who hear him are delighted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak satigur miliai paaiaa naam dhan maal ||1||
english: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, one obtains the wealth and property of the Naam. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur ke jee kee saar na jaapai k poorai satigur bhaavai ||
english: The sublime state of the True Guru is not known; no one knows what pleases the Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੋ ਸਿਖਾਂ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਖੁਸੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa(n) a(n)dar satiguroo varatai jo sikhaa(n) no lochai so gur khusee aavai ||
english: Deep within the hearts of His GurSikhs, the True Guru is pervading. The Guru is pleased with those who long for His Sikhs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਨਿ ਸੁ ਜਪੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ਸਚਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur aakhai s kaar kamaavan s jap kamaavahi gurasikhaa(n) kee ghaal sachaa thaai paavai ||
english: As the True Guru directs them, they do their work and chant their prayers. The True Lord accepts the service of His GurSikhs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਲੋੜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: vin satigur ke hukamai j gurasikhaa(n) paasahu ka(n)m karaaiaa loRe tis gurasikh phir neR na aavai ||
english: But those who want the GurSikhs to work for them, without the Order of the True Guru - the Guru's Sikhs shall not come near them again.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਇ ਘਾਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur agai ko jeeu laai ghaalai tis agai gurasikh kaar kamaavai ||
english: One who works diligently for the Guru, the True Guru - the GurSikhs work for him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਠਗੀ ਆਵੈ ਠਗੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: j thagee aavai thagee uth jaai tis neRai gurasikh mool na aavai ||
english: One who comes to deceive, who rises up and goes out to deceive - the GurSikhs shall never come near him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥ ਜਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਰਾਏ ਸੋ ਜੰਤੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: braham beechaar naanak aakh sunaavai || j vin satigur ke man ma(n)ne ka(n)m karaae so ja(n)t mahaa dukh paavai ||2||
english: Nanak proclaims and announces this wisdom of God. One who is not pleasing to the Mind of the True Guru may do his deeds, but that being will only suffer in terrible pain. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਤੁਹਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਵਡੇ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sachaa saahib at vadaa tuhi jevad too(n) vad vade ||
english: O True Lord and Master, You are so very great. As great as You are, You are the greatest of the great.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਛਡੇ ॥
transliteration: jis too(n) melahi so tudh milai too(n) aape bakhas laihi lekhaa chhade ||
english: He alone is united with You, whom You unite with Yourself. You Yourself bless and forgive us, and tear up our accounts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਮਨੁ ਗਡ ਗਡੇ ॥
transliteration: jis no too(n) aap milaaidaa so satigur seve man gad gade ||
english: One whom You unite with Yourself, whole-heartedly serves the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਚੰਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹਡੇ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sachaa saahib sach too sabh jeeu pi(n)d cha(n)m teraa hade ||
english: You are the True One, the True Lord and Master; my soul, body, flesh and bones are all Yours.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡ ਵਡੇ ॥੩੩॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu rakh too(n) sachiaa naanak man aas teree vad vade ||33||1|| sudh ||
english: If it pleases You, then save me, True Lord. Nanak places the hopes of his mind in You alone, O greatest of the great! ||33||1|| Sudh||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਰਾਇ ਕਮਾਲਦੀ ਮੋਜਦੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਗਾਵਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kee vaar mahalaa 5 raai kamaaladee mojadee kee vaar kee dhun upar gaavanee ||
english: Gauree Kee Vaar, Fifth Mehl: Sung To The Tune Of Vaar Of Raa-I Kamaaldee-Mojadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਸੋ ਆਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: har har naam jo jan japai so aaiaa paravaan ||
english: Auspicious and approved is the birth of that humble being who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਜਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: tis jan kai balihaaranai jin bhajiaa prabh nirabaan ||
english: I am a sacrifice to that humble being who vibrates and meditates on God, the Lord of Nirvaanaa.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh katiaa har bhetiaa purakh sujaan ||
english: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, upon meeting the All-knowing Lord, the Primal Being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sa(n)g saagar tare jan naanak sachaa taan ||1||
english: In the Society of the Saints, he crosses over the world-ocean; O servant Nanak, he has the strength and support of the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਪਰਾਹੁਣਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਉ ॥
transliteration: bhalake uth paraahunaa merai ghar aavau ||
english: I rise up in the early morning hours, and the Holy Guest comes into my home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਉ ਪਖਾਲਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: paau pakhaalaa tis ke man tan nit bhaavau ||
english: I wash His feet; He is always pleasing to my mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: naam sune naam sa(n)grahai naame liv laavau ||
english: I hear the Naam, and I gather in the Naam; I am lovingly attuned to the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: grihu dhan sabh pavitr hoi har ke gun gaavau ||
english: My home and wealth are totally sanctified as I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har naam vaapaaree naanakaa vadabhaagee paavau ||2||
english: The Trader in the Lord's Name, O Nanak, is found by great good fortune. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa sach teraa bhaanaa ||
english: Whatever pleases You is good; True is the Pleasure of Your Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: too sabh mahi ek varatadaa sabh maahi samaanaa ||
english: You are the One, pervading in all; You are contained in all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜੀਅ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa jee a(n)dar jaanaa ||
english: You are diffused throughout and permeating all places and interspaces; You are known to be deep within the hearts of all beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mil paaeeai man sache bhaanaa ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and submitting to His Will, the True Lord is found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee sad sad kurabaanaa ||1||
english: Nanak takes to the Sanctuary of God; he is forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਾ ਈ ਤਾਂ ਚੇਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ॥
transliteration: chetaa ee taa(n) chet saahib sachaa so dhanee ||
english: If you are conscious, then be conscious of the True Lord, Your Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਚੜਿ ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak satigur sev chaR bohith bhaujal paar pau ||1||
english: O Nanak, come aboard upon the boat of the service of the True Guru, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਊ ਸੰਦੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: vaaoo sa(n)de kapaRe pahirahi garab gavaar ||
english: He wears his body, like clothes of wind - what a proud fool he is!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਨੀ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਹੋਏ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naal na chalanee jal bal hoe chhaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, they will not go with him in the end; they shall be burnt to ashes. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਗੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋ ਸਚੈ ਰਖੇ ॥
transliteration: seee ubare jagai vich jo sachai rakhe ||
english: They alone are delivered from the world, who are preserved and protected by the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਖੇ ॥
transliteration: muhi dithai tin kai jeeveeai har a(n)mrit chakhe ||
english: I live by beholding the faces of those who taste the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧਾ ਭਖੇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu sa(n)g saadhaa bhakhe ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment are burnt away, in the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਖੇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee har aap parakhe ||
english: God grants His Grace, and the Lord Himself tests them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਲਤ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਲਖੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak chalat na jaapanee ko sakai na lakhe ||2||
english: O Nanak, His play is not known; no one can understand it. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਵੈ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak soee dinas suhaavaRaa jit prabh aavai chit ||
english: O Nanak, that day is beautiful, when God comes to mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਭਲੇਰੀ ਰੁਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jit din visarai paarabraham phit bhaleree rut ||1||
english: Cursed is that day, no matter how pleasant the season, when the Supreme Lord God is forgotten. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak mitraaee tis siu sabh kichh jis kai haath ||
english: O Nanak, become friends with the One, who holds everything in His hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸੇਈ ਕਾਂਢੀਅਹਿ ਇਕ ਵਿਖ ਨ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kumitraa seee kaa(n)dheeahi ik vikh na chalahi saath ||2||
english: They are accounted as false friends, who do not go with you, for even one step. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan hai mil peevahu bhaaee ||
english: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar; meet together and drink it in, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਭ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat sukh paaeeai sabh tikhaa bujhaaee ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, peace is found, and all thirst is quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਭੁਖ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kar sevaa paarabraham gur bhukh rahai na kaaee ||
english: So serve the Supreme Lord God and the Guru, and you shall never be hungry again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੁੰਨਿਆ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sagal manorath pu(n)niaa amaraa pad paaee ||
english: All your desires shall be fulfilled, and you shall obtain the status of immortality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tudh jevad toohai paarabraham naanak saranaaee ||3||
english: You alone are as great as Yourself, O Supreme Lord God; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਿਠੜੋ ਹਭ ਠਾਇ ਊਣ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dithaRo habh thaai oon na kaaee jaai ||
english: I have seen all places; there is no place without Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਧਾ ਤਿਨ ਸੁਆਉ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ladhaa tin suaau jinaa satigur bhetiaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who meet with the True Guru find the object of life. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਮਨੀ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਤਿਉ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਜਗ ਖੇ ॥
transliteration: daamanee chamatakaar tiu varataaraa jag khe ||
english: Like the flash of lightning, worldly affairs last only for a moment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਥੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਉ ਜਪੰਦੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vath suhaavee saai naanak naau japa(n)do tis dhanee ||2||
english: The only thing which is pleasing, O Nanak, is that which inspires one to meditate on the Name of the Master. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਧਿ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: simrit saasatr sodh sabh kinai keem na jaanee ||
english: People have searched all the Simritees and Shaastras, but no one knows the Lord's value.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jo jan bhetai saadhasa(n)g so har ra(n)g maanee ||
english: That being, who joins the Saadh Sangat enjoys the Love of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਹ ਰਤਨਾ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sach naam karataa purakh eh ratanaa khaanee ||
english: True is the Naam, the Name of the Creator, the Primal Being. It is the mine of precious jewels.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: masatak hovai likhiaa har simar paraanee ||
english: That mortal, who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, meditates in remembrance on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੋਸਾ ਦਿਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tosaa dichai sach naam naanak mihamaanee ||4||
english: O Lord, please bless Nanak, Your humble guest, with the supplies of the True Name. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨੈਣੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਭੁਖ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar chi(n)taa nainee sukhee mool na utarai bhukh ||
english: He harbors anxiety within himself, but to the eyes, he appears to be happy; his hunger never departs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਥੋ ਦੁਖੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sache naam bin kisai na latho dukh ||1||
english: O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's sorrows have ever departed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਠੜੇ ਸੇਈ ਸਾਥ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਲਦਿਆ ॥
transliteration: muthaRe seee saath jinee sach na ladiaa ||
english: Those caravans which did not load the Truth have been plundered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak se saabaas jinee gur mil ik pachhaaniaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who meet the True Guru, and acknowledge the One Lord, are congratulated. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਬੈਸਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: jithai baisan saadh jan so thaan suha(n)daa ||
english: Beautiful is that place, where the Holy people dwell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: oi sevan sa(n)mrith aapanaa binasai sabh ma(n)daa ||
english: They serve their All-powerful Lord, and they give up all their evil ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੰਤ ਬੇਦੁ ਕਹੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: patit udhaaran paarabraham sa(n)t bed kaha(n)daa ||
english: The Saints and the Vedas proclaim, that the Supreme Lord God is the Saving Grace of sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਵਰਤੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal teraa birad hai jug jug varata(n)daa ||
english: You are the Lover of Your devotees - this is Your natural way, in each and every age.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak jaachai ek naam man tan bhaava(n)daa ||5||
english: Nanak asks for the One Name, which is pleasing to his mind and body. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿੜੀ ਚੁਹਕੀ ਪਹੁ ਫੁਟੀ ਵਗਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: chiRee chuhakee pahu phutee vagan bahut tara(n)g ||
english: The sparrows are chirping, and dawn has come; the wind stirs up the waves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਚੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: acharaj roop sa(n)tan rache naanak naamahi ra(n)g ||1||
english: Such a wondrous thing the Saints have fashioned, O Nanak, in the Love of the Naam. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਤਹੀ ਜਹ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ghar ma(n)dar khuseeaa tahee jah too aavahi chit ||
english: Homes, palaces and pleasures are there, where You, O Lord, come to mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਮਿਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: duneeaa keeaa vadiaaeeaa naanak sabh kumit ||2||
english: All worldly grandeur, O Nanak, is like false and evil friends. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har dhan sachee raas hai kinai viralai jaataa ||
english: The wealth of the Lord is the true capital; how rare are those who understand this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਭਾਇਰਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tisai paraapat bhaairahu jis dei bidhaataa ||
english: He alone receives it, O Siblings of Destiny, unto whom the Architect of Destiny gives it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan bheetar mauliaa har ra(n)g jan raataa ||
english: His servant is imbued with the Love of the Lord; his body and mind blossom forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖਹ ਖਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g gun gaaiaa sabh dokhah khaataa ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and all of his sufferings are removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak soee jeeviaa jin ik pachhaataa ||6||
english: O Nanak, he alone lives, who acknowledges the One Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਖੜੀਆ ਸੁਹਾਵੀਆ ਲਗੜੀਆ ਅਕ ਕੰਠਿ ॥
transliteration: khakhaReeaa suhaaveeaa lagaReeaa ak ka(n)th ||
english: The fruit of the swallow-wort plant looks beautiful, attached to the branch of the tree;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਹ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਧਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਸੈ ਗੰਠਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: birah vichhoRaa dhanee siu naanak sahasai ga(n)th ||1||
english: but when it is separated from the stem of its Master, O Nanak, it breaks apart into thousands of fragments. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਾਰੇਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਗਏ ਮਰਿ ਭਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
transliteration: visaarede mar gae mar bh na sakahi mool ||
english: Those who forget the Lord die, but they cannot die a complete death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੇਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਤਸਕਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vemukh hoe raam te jiu tasakar upar sool ||2||
english: Those who turn their backs on the Lord suffer, like the thief impaled on the gallows. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sukh nidhaan prabh ek hai abinaasee suniaa ||
english: The One God is the treasure of peace; I have heard that He is eternal and imperishable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooriaa ghat ghat har bhaniaa ||
english: He is totally pervading the water, the land and the sky; the Lord is said to be permeating each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਭ ਇਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤੀ ਬਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ooch neech sabh ik samaan keet hasatee baniaa ||
english: He looks alike upon the high and the low, the ant and the elephant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਿਪੋ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਦੇ ਜਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: meet sakhaa sut ba(n)dhipo sabh tis de janiaa ||
english: Friends, companions, children and relatives are all created by Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਸਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tus naanak devai jis naam tin har ra(n)g maniaa ||7||
english: O Nanak, one who is blessed with the Naam, enjoys the Lord's love and affection. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jinaa saas giraas na visarai har naamaa(n) man ma(n)t ||
english: Those who do not forget the Lord, with each breath and morsel of food, whose minds are filled with the Mantra of the Lord's Name

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s seee naanakaa pooran soee sa(n)t ||1||
english: - they alone are blessed; O Nanak, they are the perfect Saints. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਭਉਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਖਾਵਣ ਸੰਦੜੈ ਸੂਲਿ ॥
transliteration: athe pahar bhaudaa phirai khaavan sa(n)daRai sool ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, he wanders around, driven by his hunger for food.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੋਜਕਿ ਪਉਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਜਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਰਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dojak paudaa kiu rahai jaa chit na hoi rasool ||2||
english: How can he escape from falling into hell, when he does not remember the Prophet? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਹੋ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਲੈ ॥
transliteration: tisai sarevahu praaneeho jis dai naau palai ||
english: Serve Him, O mortals, who has the Lord's Name in His lap.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਰਹਹੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਿਆ ਅਗੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
transliteration: aithai rahahu suheliaa agai naal chalai ||
english: You shall dwell in peace and ease in this world; in the world hereafter, it shall go with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਬੰਧਹੁ ਸਚ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਗਡਿ ਥੰਮੁ ਅਹਲੈ ॥
transliteration: ghar ba(n)dhahu sach dharam kaa gad tha(n)m ahalai ||
english: So build your home of true righteousness, with the unshakable pillars of Dharma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਟ ਲੈਹੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਝਲੈ ॥
transliteration: ot laihu naaraainai deen duneeaa jhalai ||
english: Take the Support of the Lord, who gives support in the spiritual and material worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਕੜੇ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਲੈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak pakaRe charan har tis daragah malai ||8||
english: Nanak grasps the Lotus Feet of the Lord; he humbly bows in His Court. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jaachak ma(n)gai daan dehi piaariaa ||
english: The beggar begs for charity: give to me, O my Beloved!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮੈ ਨਿਤ ਚਿਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: devanahaar daataar mai nit chitaariaa ||
english: O Great Giver, O Giving Lord, my consciousness is continually centered on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਮੂਲਿ ਅਤੁਲ ਭੰਡਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: nikhut na jaaee mool atul bha(n)daariaa ||
english: The immeasurable warehouses of the Lord can never be emptied out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sabad apaar tin sabh kichh saariaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Word of the Shabad is infinite; it has arranged everything perfectly. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: sikhahu sabad piaariho janam maran kee tek ||
english: O Sikhs, love the Word of the Shabad; in life and death, it is our only support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਏਕ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mukh oojal sadaa sukhee naanak simarat ek ||2||
english: Your face shall be radiant, and you shall find a lasting peace, O Nanak, remembering the One Lord in meditation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਣੇ ॥
transliteration: othai a(n)mrit va(n)deeai sukheeaa har karane ||
english: There, the Ambrosial Nectar is distributed; the Lord is the Bringer of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਥਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਰਣੇ ॥
transliteration: jam kai pa(n)th na paaeeahi phir naahee marane ||
english: They are not placed upon the path of Death, and they shall not have to die again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਜਰਣੇ ॥
transliteration: jis no aaiaa prem ras tisai hee jarane ||
english: One who comes to savor the Lord's Love experiences it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਅਮਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ ਝਰਣੇ ॥
transliteration: baanee ucharahi saadh jan amiu chalahi jharane ||
english: The Holy beings chant the Bani of the Word, like nectar flowing from a spring.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧਰਣੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: pekh darasan naanak jeeviaa man a(n)dar dharane ||9||
english: Nanak lives by beholding the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those who have implanted the Lord's Name within their minds. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦੂਖਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur poorai seviai dookhaa kaa hoi naas ||
english: Serving the Perfect True Guru, suffering ends.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਅਰਾਧਿਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam araadhiai kaaraj aavai raas ||1||
english: O Nanak, worshipping the Naam in adoration, one's affairs come to be resolved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੰਕਟ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat sa(n)kat chhutahi anad ma(n)gal bisraam ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, misfortune departs, and one comes to abide in peace and bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak japeeai sadaa har nimakh na bisarau naam ||2||
english: O Nanak, meditate forever on the Lord - do not forget Him, even for an instant. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਧਾ ॥
transliteration: tin kee sobhaa kiaa ganee jinee har har ladhaa ||
english: How can I estimate the glory of those, who have found the Lord, Har, Har?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਾ ਸਰਣੀ ਜੋ ਪਵੈ ਸੋ ਛੁਟੈ ਬਧਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhaa saranee jo pavai so chhutai badhaa ||
english: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Holy is released from bondage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀਐ ਜੋਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਦਧਾ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavai abinaaseeai jon garabh na dadhaa ||
english: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable Lord does not burn in the womb of reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਧਾ ॥
transliteration: gur bhetiaa paarabraham har paR bujh samadhaa ||
english: One who meets the Guru and the Supreme Lord God, who reads and understands, enters the state of Samaadhi.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਧਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak paaiaa so dhanee har agam agadhaa ||10||
english: Nanak has obtained that Lord Master, who is inaccessible and unfathomable. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਵਤਾ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kaam na karahee aapanaa phirahi avataa loi ||
english: People do not perform their duties, but instead, they wander around aimlessly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਿਨੇਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naai visaariai sukh kinehaa hoi ||1||
english: O Nanak, if they forget the Name, how can they ever find peace? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਕਉੜਤਣਿ ਸਗਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਗਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bikhai kauRatan sagal maahi jagat rahee lapataai ||
english: The bitter poison of corruption is everywhere; it clings to the substance of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਮੀਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jan veechaariaa meethaa har kaa naau ||2||
english: O Nanak, the humble being has realized that the Name of the Lord alone is sweet. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: ih neesaanee saadh kee jis bhetat tareeai ||
english: This is the distinguishing sign of the Holy Saint, that by meeting with him, one is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jamaka(n)kar neR na aavaee phir bahuR na mareeai ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not come near him; he never has to die again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: bhav saagar sa(n)saar bikh so paar utareeai ||
english: He crosses over the terrifying, poisonous world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁੰਫਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਮਲੁ ਪਰਹਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har gun gu(n)phahu man maal har sabh mal parahareeai ||
english: So weave the garland of the Lord's Glorious Praises into your mind, and all your filth shall be washed away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਰਹਰੀਐ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak preetam mil rahe paarabraham narahareeai ||11||
english: Nanak remains blended with his Beloved, the Supreme Lord God. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak aae se paravaan hai jin har vuthaa chit ||
english: O Nanak, approved is the birth of those, within whose consciousness the Lord abides.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਲੑੀ ਅਲ ਪਲਾਲੀਆ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਮਿਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gaalhee al palaaleeaa ka(n)m na aavahi mit ||1||
english: Useless talk and babbling is useless, my friend. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਗਮ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh drisatee aaiaa pooran agam bisamaad ||
english: I have come to see the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect, Inaccessible, Wonderful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam dhan keetaa poore gur parasaad ||2||
english: Nanak has made the Lord's Name his wealth, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੋਹੁ ਨ ਚਲੀ ਖਸਮ ਨਾਲਿ ਲਬਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ॥
transliteration: dhohu na chalee khasam naal lab mohi vigute ||
english: Deception does not work with our Lord and Master; through their greed and emotional attachment, people are ruined.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਬ ਕਰਨਿ ਭਲੇਰਿਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਤੇ ॥
transliteration: karatab karan bhaleriaa mad maaiaa sute ||
english: They do their evil deeds, and sleep in the intoxication of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਨਿ ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੁਤੇ ॥
transliteration: phir phir joon bhavaaeean jam maarag mute ||
english: Time and time again, they are consigned to reincarnation, and abandoned on the path of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਦੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਜੁਤੇ ॥
transliteration: keetaa paain aapanaa dukh setee jute ||
english: They receive the consequences of their own actions, and are yoked to their pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਸਭ ਮੰਦੀ ਰੁਤੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak naai visaariai sabh ma(n)dee rute ||12||
