english: O Nanak, if one forgets the Name, all the seasons are evil. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਠੰਦਿਆ ਬਹੰਦਿਆ ਸਵੰਦਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: utha(n)diaa baha(n)diaa sava(n)diaa sukh soi ||
english: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, be at peace;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਲਾਹਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam salaahiai man tan seetal hoi ||1||
english: O Nanak, praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are cooled and soothed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੁਆਰਥੁ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: laalach atiaa nit phirai suaarath kare na koi ||
english: Filled with greed, he constantly wanders around; he does not do any good deeds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis gur bhetai naanakaa tis man vasiaa soi ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Lord abides within the mind of one who meets with the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਵਸਤੂ ਕਉੜੀਆ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਉ ਮਿਠਾ ॥
transliteration: sabhe vasatoo kauReeaa sache naau mithaa ||
english: All material things are bitter; the True Name alone is sweet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਾਂ ਚਖਿ ਸਾਧੀ ਡਿਠਾ ॥
transliteration: saad aaiaa tin har janaa(n) chakh saadhee dithaa ||
english: Those humble servants of the Lord who taste it, come to savor its flavor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham jis likhiaa man tisai vuthaa ||
english: It comes to dwell within the mind of those who are so pre-destined by the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਯਾ ਕੁਠਾ ॥
transliteration: ik nira(n)jan rav rahiaa bhaau duyaa kuthaa ||
english: The One Immaculate Lord is pervading everywhere; He destroys the love of duality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਤੁਠਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: har naanak ma(n)gai joR kar prabh devai tuthaa ||13||
english: Nanak begs for the Lord's Name, with his palms pressed together; by His Pleasure, God has granted it. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਚੜੀ ਸਾ ਸਾਰੁ ਜੋ ਜਾਚੰਦੀ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
transliteration: jaachaRee saa saar jo jaacha(n)dee hekaRo ||
english: The most excellent begging is begging for the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਲੑੀ ਬਿਆ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਣੀ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gaalhee biaa vikaar naanak dhanee vihooneeaa ||1||
english: Other talk is corrupt, O Nanak, except that of the Lord Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਹਿ ਜਿ ਵਿਧਾ ਮੰਨੁ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਵਿਰਲੋ ਥਿਓ ॥
transliteration: neehi j vidhaa ma(n)n pachhaanoo viralo thio ||
english: One who recognizes the Lord is very rare; his mind is pierced through with the Love of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋੜਣਹਾਰਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਪਧਰੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: joRanahaaraa sa(n)t naanak paadhar padharo ||2||
english: Such a Saint is the Uniter, O Nanak - he straightens out the path. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: soee sevihu jeeaRe daataa bakhasi(n)d ||
english: Serve Him, O my soul, who is the Giver and the Forgiver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ਹੋਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: kilavikh sabh binaas hon simarat govi(n)d ||
english: All sinful mistakes are erased, by meditating in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਦਸਿਆ ਜਪੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: har maarag saadhoo dasiaa japeeai gurama(n)t ||
english: The Holy Saint has shown me the Way to the Lord; I chant the GurMantra.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਆਦ ਸਭਿ ਫਿਕਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa suaad sabh phikiaa har man bhaava(n)d ||
english: The taste of Maya is totally bland and insipid; the Lord alone is pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: dhiaai naanak paramesarai jin ditee ji(n)d ||14||
english: Meditate, O Nanak, on the Transcendent Lord, who has blessed you with your soul and your life. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਤ ਲਗੀ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vat lagee sache naam kee jo beeje so khaai ||
english: The time has come to plant the seed of the Lord's Name; one who plants it, shall eat its fruit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tisahi paraapat naanakaa jis no likhiaa aai ||1||
english: He alone receives it, O Nanak, whose destiny is so pre-ordained. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਣਾ ਤ ਸਚੁ ਇਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)ganaa ta sach ik jis tus devai aap ||
english: If one begs, then he should beg for the Name of the True One, which is given only by His Pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jit khaadhai man tripateeai naanak saahib daat ||2||
english: Eating this gift from the Lord and Master, O Nanak, the mind is satisfied. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੇ ਖਟਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: laahaa jag mahi se khatahi jin har dhan raas ||
english: They alone earn profit in this world, who have the wealth of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਸਚੇ ਦੀ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: duteeaa bhaau na jaananee sache dee aas ||
english: They do not know the love of duality; they place their hopes in the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵਿਆ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: nihachal ek sareviaa hor sabh vinaas ||
english: They serve the One Eternal Lord, and give up everything else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham jis visarai tis birathaa saas ||
english: One who forgets the Supreme Lord God - useless is his breath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਜਨ ਰਖਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: ka(n)th laai jan rakhiaa naanak bal jaas ||15||
english: God draws His humble servant close in His loving embrace and protects him - Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਮੀਹੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham phuramaaiaa meehu vuthaa sahaj subhaai ||
english: The Supreme Lord God gave the Order, and the rain automatically began to fall.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਰਜੀ ਤਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)n dha(n)n bahut upajiaa prithamee rajee tipat aghaai ||
english: Grain and wealth were produced in abundance; the earth was totally satisfied and satiated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa gun ucharai dukh daalad gaiaa bilaai ||
english: Forever and ever, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and pain and poverty shall run away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa paaiaa miliaa tisai rajaai ||
english: People obtain that which they are pre-ordained to receive, according to the Will of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paramesar jeevaaliaa naanak tisai dhiaai ||1||
english: The Transcendent Lord keeps you alive; O Nanak, meditate on Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jeevan pad nirabaan iko simareeai ||
english: To obtain the state of life of Nirvaanaa, meditate in remembrance on the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਧੀਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: doojee naahee jaai kin bidh dheereeai ||
english: There is no other place; how else can we be comforted?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਿਠਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ॥
transliteration: dithaa sabh sa(n)saar sukh na naam bin ||
english: I have seen the whole world - without the Lord's Name, there is no peace at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਛਾਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਜਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tan dhan hosee chhaar jaanai koi jan ||
english: Body and wealth shall return to dust - hardly anyone realizes this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਬਾਦਿ ਕਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g roop ras baad k karahi paraaneeaa ||
english: Pleasure, beauty and delicious tastes are useless; what are you doing, O mortal?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਲ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jis bhulaae aap tis kal nahee jaaneeaa ||
english: One whom the Lord Himself misleads, does not understand His awesome power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਸਚਾ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g rate nirabaan sachaa gaavahee ||
english: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord attain Nirvaanaa, singing the Praises of the True One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saran duaar je tudh bhaavahee ||2||
english: Nanak: those who are pleasing to Your Will, O Lord, seek Sanctuary at Your Door. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maran na tinh kau jo har laR laage ||
english: Those who are attached to the hem of the Lord's robe, do not suffer birth and death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: jeevat se paravaan hoe har keeratan jaage ||
english: Those who remain awake to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - their lives are approved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jin paaiaa seee vadabhaage ||
english: Those who attain the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are very fortunate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਤੂਟੇ ਕਚ ਧਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: naai visariai dhrig jeevanaa toote kach dhaage ||
english: But those who forget the Name - their lives are cursed, and broken like thin strands of thread.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੂੜਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਾਧ ਲਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਿਰਾਗੇ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak dhooR puneet saadh lakh kot piraage ||16||
english: O Nanak, the dust of the feet of the Holy is more sacred than hundreds of thousands, even millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines. ||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਣਿ ਸੁਵੰਨੀ ਖੜ ਰਤਨ ਜੜਾਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
transliteration: dharan suva(n)nee khaR ratan jaRaavee har prem purakh man vuthaa ||
english: Like the beautiful earth, adorned with jewels of grass - such is the mind, within which the Love of the Lord abides.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੇ ਥੀਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabhe kaaj suhelaRe theee gur naanak satigur tuthaa ||1||
english: All one's affairs are easily resolved, O Nanak, when the Guru, the True Guru, is pleased. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਦੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਾ ਜਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਬਨਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: phiradee phiradee dah disaa jal parabat banaraai ||
english: Roaming and wandering in the ten directions, over water, mountains and forests

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਡਿਠਾ ਮਿਰਤਕੋ ਇਲ ਬਹਿਠੀ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jithai dithaa miratako il bahithee aai ||2||
english: - wherever the vulture sees a dead body, he flies down and lands. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਫਲ ਲੋੜੀਅਹਿ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: jis sarab sukhaa phal loReeahi so sach kamaavau ||
english: One who longs for all comforts and rewards should practice Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੇੜੈ ਦੇਖਉ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
transliteration: neRai dekhau paarabraham ik naam dhiaavau ||
english: Behold the Supreme Lord God near you, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: hoi sagal kee renukaa har sa(n)g samaavau ||
english: Become the dust of all men's feet, and so merge with the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਿਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: dookh na deee kisai jee pat siu ghar jaavau ||
english: Do not cause any being to suffer, and you shall go to your true home with honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਾਵਉ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: patit puneet karataa purakh naanak sunaavau ||17||
english: Nanak speaks of the Purifier of sinners, the Creator, the Primal Being. ||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਦੋਹਾ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok dohaa mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Dohaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਜਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
transliteration: ek j saajan mai keeaa sarab kalaa samarath ||
english: I have made the One Lord my Friend; He is All-powerful to do everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੰਦੜੀ ਵਥੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeeu hamaaraa kha(n)neeai har man tan sa(n)daRee vath ||1||
english: My soul is a sacrifice to Him; the Lord is the treasure of my mind and body. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
transliteration: je kar gahahi piaaraRe tudh na chhodaa mool ||
english: Take my hand, O my Beloved; I shall never forsake You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਨਿ ਸੇ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਦੋਜਕ ਕੈ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har chhodan se durajanaa paRahi dojak kai sool ||2||
english: Those who forsake the Lord, are the most evil people; they shall fall into the horrible pit of hell. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh nidhaan ghar jis dai har kare s hovai ||
english: All treasures are in His Home; whatever the Lord does, comes to pass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਪਾਪਾ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jap jap jeevahi sa(n)t jan paapaa mal dhovai ||
english: The Saints live by chanting and meditating on the Lord, washing off the filth of their sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਹਿ ਸੰਕਟ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal hiradai vasahi sa(n)kat sabh khovai ||
english: With the Lotus Feet of the Lord dwelling within the heart, all misfortune is taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa jis bheteeai mar janam na rovai ||
english: One who meets the Perfect Guru, shall not have to suffer through birth and death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: prabh daras piaas naanak ghanee kirapaa kar devai ||18||
english: Nanak is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; by His Grace, He has bestowed it. ||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣਾ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok dakhanaa mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Dakhanaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੋਰੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਵਞਾਇ ਪਿਰੀ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਹਿਕੁ ਤੂ ॥
transliteration: bhoree bharam vanjaai piree muhabat hik too ||
english: If you can dispel your doubts, even for an instant, and love your only Beloved,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥਹੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਥਾਊ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jithahu va(n)njai jaai tithaaoo maujood soi ||1||
english: then wherever you go, there you shall find Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੜਿ ਕੈ ਘੋੜੜੈ ਕੁੰਦੇ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਖੂੰਡੀ ਦੀ ਖੇਡਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: chaR kai ghoRaRai ku(n)de pakaRahi khoo(n)dee dee khedaaree ||
english: Can they mount horses and handle guns, if all they know is the game of polo?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਉਲਾਸਹਿ ਕੁਕੜ ਦੀ ਓਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ha(n)saa setee chit ulaasahi kukaR dee odaaree ||2||
english: Can they be swans, and fulfill their conscious desires, if they can only fly like chickens? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੋ ਉਧਰੈ ਮਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa ucharai har sravanee sunai so udharai mitaa ||
english: Those who chant the Lord's Name with their tongues and hear it with their ears are saved, O my friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਲਾਇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਸੇ ਹਸਤ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har jas likhahi laai bhaavanee se hasat pavitaa ||
english: Those hands which lovingly write the Praises of the Lord are pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨਾ ਸਭਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: athasath teerath majanaa sabh pu(n)n tin kitaa ||
english: It is like performing all sorts of virtuous deeds, and bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਗੜੁ ਜਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar te udhare bikhiaa gaR jitaa ||
english: They cross over the world-ocean, and conquer the fortress of corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਉਧਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਦਯੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak laR laai udhaarian day sev amitaa ||19||
english: O Nanak, serve the Infinite Lord; grasp the hem of His robe, and He will save you. ||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧੜੇ ਕੁਲਾਹ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaRe kulaah chit na aavai hekaRo ||
english: Worldly affairs are unprofitable, if the One Lord does not come to mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਤੰਨ ਫੁਟੰਨਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਂਈ ਵਿਸਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak seee ta(n)n phuta(n)n jinaa saa(n)ee visarai ||1||
english: O Nanak, the bodies of those who forget their Master shall burst apart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰੇਤਹੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: paretahu keeton devataa tin karanaihaare ||
english: The ghost has been transformed into an angel by the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਸਿਖ ਉਬਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabhe sikh ubaarian prabh kaaj savaare ||
english: God has emancipated all the Sikhs and resolved their affairs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਪਕੜਿ ਪਛਾੜਿਅਨੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak pakaR pachhaaRian jhoothe darabaare ||
english: He has seized the slanderers and thrown them to the ground, and declared them false in His Court.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kaa prabh vadaa hai aap saaj savaare ||2||
english: Nanak's God is glorious and great; He Himself creates and adorns. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh bea(n)t kichh a(n)t naahi sabh tisai karanaa ||
english: God is unlimited; He has no limit; He is the One who does everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਜੀਆਂ ਕਾ ਪਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar saahibo jeeaa(n) kaa paranaa ||
english: The Inaccessible and Unapproachable Lord and Master is the Support of His beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਭਰਣ ਪੋਖਣੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: hasat dei pratipaaladaa bharan pokhan karanaa ||
english: Giving His Hand, He nurtures and cherishes; He is the Filler and Fulfiller.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਚੇ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: miharavaan bakhasi(n)d aap jap sache taranaa ||
english: He Himself is Merciful and Forgiving. Chanting the True Name, one is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa naanak daas saranaa ||20||
english: Whatever pleases You - that alone is good; slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਕਾ ਰਹੀ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ti(n)naa bhukh na kaa rahee jis daa prabh hai soi ||
english: One who belongs to God has no hunger.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੋ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak charanee lagiaa udharai sabho koi ||1||
english: O Nanak, everyone who falls at his feet is saved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਬੂਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jaachik ma(n)gai nit naam saahib kare kabool ||
english: If the beggar begs for the Lord's Name every day, his Lord and Master will grant his request.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜਜਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਮੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak paramesar jajamaan tisahi bhukh na mool ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord is the most generous host; He does not lack anything at all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਜੋੜੇ ॥
transliteration: man rataa govi(n)d sa(n)g sach bhojan joRe ||
english: To imbue the mind with the Lord of the Universe is the true food and dress.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਏ ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ॥
transliteration: preet lagee har naam siu e hasatee ghoRe ||
english: To embrace love for the Name of the Lord is to possess horses and elephants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਘਣੀ ਧਿਆਇ ਮੁਖੁ ਨ ਮੋੜੇ ॥
transliteration: raaj milakh khuseeaa ghanee dhiaai mukh na moRe ||
english: To meditate on the Lord steadfastly is to rule over kingdoms of property and enjoy all sorts of pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਦਰੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛੋੜੇ ॥
transliteration: dhaadhee dar prabh ma(n)ganaa dar kade na chhoRe ||
english: The minstrel begs at God's Door - he shall never leave that Door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਲੋੜੇ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ਕੀਚੇ
transliteration: naanak man tan chaau ehu nit prabh kau loRe ||21||1|| sudh keeche
english: Nanak has this yearning in his mind and body - he longs continually for God. ||21||1|| Sudh Keechay||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee bhagataa(n) kee baanee ||
english: Raag Gauree, The Word Of The Devotees:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ ੧੪ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree sree kabeer jeeu ke chaupade 14 ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourteen Chau-Padhay Of Kabeer Jee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਲਤ ਰਾਮ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ab mohi jalat raam jal paaiaa ||
english: I was on fire, but now I have found the Water of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ ਤਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam udak tan jalat bujhaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This Water of the Lord's Name has cooled my burning body. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਣ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: man maaran kaaran ban jaaeeai ||
english: To subdue their minds, some go off into the forests;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਲੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so jal bin bhagava(n)t na paaeeai ||1||
english: but that Water is not found without the Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪਾਵਕ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਹੈ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jih paavak sur nar hai jaare ||
english: That fire has consumed angels and mortal beings,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ ਜਨ ਜਲਤ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam udak jan jalat ubaare ||2||
english: but the Water of the Lord's Name saves His humble servants from burning. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: bhav saagar sukh saagar maahee ||
english: In the terrifying world-ocean, there is an ocean of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਜਲ ਨਿਖੁਟਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: peev rahe jal nikhutat naahee ||3||
english: I continue to drink it in, but this Water is never exhausted. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਜੁ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer bhaj saari(n)gapaanee ||
english: Says Kabeer, meditate and vibrate upon the Lord, like the rainbird remembering the water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: raam udak meree tikhaa bujhaanee ||4||1||
english: The Water of the Lord's Name has quenched my thirst. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਉ ਜਲ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maadhau jal kee piaas na jaai ||
english: O Lord, my thirst for the Water of Your Name will not go away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਠੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jal mahi agan uthee adhikaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The fire of my thirst burns even more brightly in that Water. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਹਉ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਮੀਨੁ ॥
transliteration: too(n) jalanidh hau jal kaa meen ||
english: You are the Ocean of Water, and I am just a fish in that Water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਉ ਜਲਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖੀਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jal mahi rahau jalahi bin kheen ||1||
english: In that Water, I remain; without that Water, I would perish. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਹਉ ਸੂਅਟਾ ਤੋਰ ॥
transliteration: too(n) pi(n)jar hau sooataa tor ||
english: You are the cage, and I am Your parrot.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਮੰਜਾਰੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jam ma(n)jaar kahaa karai mor ||2||
english: So what can the cat of death do to me? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਹਉ ਪੰਖੀ ਆਹਿ ॥
transliteration: too(n) taravar hau pa(n)khee aahi ||
english: You are the tree, and I am the bird.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀ ਤੇਰੋ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ma(n)dabhaagee tero darasan naahi ||3||
english: I am so unfortunate - I cannot see the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan! ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਉ ਨਉਤਨੁ ਚੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) satigur hau nautan chelaa ||
english: You are the True Guru, and I am Your new disciple.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਿਲੁ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer mil a(n)t kee belaa ||4||2||
english: Says Kabeer, O Lord, please meet me - this is my very last chance! ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jab ham eko ek kar jaaniaa ||
english: When I realize that there is One, and only One Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਲੋਗਹ ਕਾਹੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tab logah kaahe dukh maaniaa ||1||
english: why then should the people be upset? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਪਤਹ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ham apatah apunee pat khoee ||
english: I am dishonored; I have lost my honor.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਖੋਜਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਮਤਿ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hamarai khoj parahu mat koee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: No one should follow in my footsteps. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੰਦੇ ਮੰਦੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ham ma(n)de ma(n)de man maahee ||
english: I am bad, and bad in my mind as well.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਝ ਪਾਤਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saajh paat kaahoo siu naahee ||2||
english: I have no partnership with anyone. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਅਪਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਜ ॥
transliteration: pat apat taa kee nahee laaj ||
english: I have no shame about honor or dishonor.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਜਾਨਹੁਗੇ ਜਬ ਉਘਰੈਗੋ ਪਾਜ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tab jaanahuge jab ugharaigo paaj ||3||
english: But you shall know, when your own false covering is laid bare. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer pat har paravaan ||
english: Says Kabeer, honor is that which is accepted by the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਜੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: sarab tiaag bhaj keval raam ||4||3||
english: Give up everything - meditate, vibrate upon the Lord alone. ||4||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਤ ਜੌ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: nagan phirat jau paaeeai jog ||
english: If Yoga could be obtained by wandering around naked,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਨ ਕਾ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ban kaa mirag mukat sabh hog ||1||
english: then all the deer of the forest would be liberated. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਨਾਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਬਾਧੇ ਚਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kiaa naage kiaa baadhe chaam ||
english: What does it matter whether someone goes naked, or wears a deer skin,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab nahee cheenas aatam raam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: if he does not remember the Lord within his soul? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੂਡ ਮੁੰਡਾਏ ਜੌ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mood mu(n)daae jau sidh paaee ||
english: If the spiritual perfection of the Siddhas could be obtained by shaving the head,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੀ ਭੇਡ ਨ ਗਈਆ ਕਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mukatee bhed na gaeeaa kaaee ||2||
english: then why haven't sheep found liberation? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਜੌ ਤਰੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bi(n)d raakh jau tareeai bhaaee ||
english: If someone could save himself by celibacy, O Siblings of Destiny,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖੁਸਰੈ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khusarai kiu na param gat paaee ||3||
english: why then haven't eunuchs obtained the state of supreme dignity? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਨਰ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer sunahu nar bhaaee ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O men, O Siblings of Destiny:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: raam naam bin kin gat paaee ||4||4||
english: without the Lord's Name, who has ever found salvation? ||4||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਧਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਇਸ੍ਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)dhiaa praat isnaan karaahee ||
english: Those who take their ritual baths in the evening and the morning

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਏ ਦਾਦੁਰ ਪਾਨੀ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu bhae daadur paanee maahee ||1||
english: are like the frogs in the water. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jau pai raam raam rat naahee ||
english: When people do not love the Lord's Name,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: te sabh dharam raai kai jaahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: they must all go to the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਰਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪ ਰਚਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa rat bahu roop rachaahee ||
english: Those who love their bodies and try different looks,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin kau daiaa supanai bhee naahee ||2||
english: do not feel compassion, even in dreams. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਹਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਆਗਰ ॥
transliteration: chaar charan kahahi bahu aagar ||
english: The wise men call them four-footed creatures;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਲਿ ਸਾਗਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhoo sukh paavahi kal saagar ||3||
english: the Holy find peace in this ocean of pain. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਾਇ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer bahu kaai kareejai ||
english: Says Kabeer, why do you perform so many rituals?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: sarabas chhod mahaa ras peejai ||4||5||
english: Renounce everything, and drink in the supreme essence of the Lord. ||4||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jee gauRee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਿਆ ਤਪੁ ਕਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: kiaa jap kiaa tap kiaa brat poojaa ||
english: What use is chanting, and what use is penance, fasting or devotional worship,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kai ridai bhaau hai doojaa ||1||
english: to one whose heart is filled with the love of duality? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਜਨ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਧਉ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: re jan man maadhau siu laaeeai ||
english: O humble people, link your mind to the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਨ ਚਤੁਰਭੁਜੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chaturaaee na chaturabhuj paaeeai || rahaau ||
english: Through cleverness, the four-armed Lord is not obtained. ||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਰਹਰੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਕਾਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: parahar lobh ar lokaachaar ||
english: Set aside your greed and worldly ways.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਰਹਰੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: parahar kaam krodh aha(n)kaar ||2||
english: Set aside sexual desire, anger and egotism. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਬਧੇ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
transliteration: karam karat badhe aha(n)mev ||
english: Ritual practices bind people in egotism;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mil paathar kee karahee sev ||3||
english: meeting together, they worship stones. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer bhagat kar paaiaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, He is obtained only by devotional worship.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭੋਲੇ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: bhole bhaai mile raghuraaiaa ||4||6||
english: Through innocent love, the Lord is met. ||4||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਵਾਸ ਮਹਿ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: garabh vaas mahi kul nahee jaatee ||
english: In the dwelling of the womb, there is no ancestry or social status.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਉਤਪਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: braham bi(n)d te sabh utapaatee ||1||
english: All have originated from the Seed of God. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬਾਮਨ ਕਬ ਕੇ ਹੋਏ ॥
transliteration: kahu re pa(n)dit baaman kab ke hoe ||
english: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar: since when have you been a Brahmin?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਮਨ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਤ ਖੋਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: baaman kahi kahi janam mat khoe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Don't waste your life by continually claiming to be a Brahmin. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੌ ਤੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੀ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jau too(n) braahaman brahamanee jaaiaa ||
english: If you are indeed a Brahmin, born of a Brahmin mother,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਆਨ ਬਾਟ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tau aan baat kaahe nahee aaiaa ||2||
english: then why didn't you come by some other way? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਕਤ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਹਮ ਕਤ ਸੂਦ ॥
transliteration: tum kat braahaman ham kat sood ||
english: How is it that you are a Brahmin, and I am of a low social status?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕਤ ਲੋਹੂ ਤੁਮ ਕਤ ਦੂਧ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ham kat lohoo tum kat doodh ||3||
english: How is it that I am formed of blood, and you are made of milk? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer jo braham beechaarai ||
english: Says Kabeer, one who contemplates God,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: so braahaman kaheeat hai hamaarai ||4||7||
english: is said to be a Brahmin among us. ||4||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਸੁਖਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhakaar sukh kabahi na soee hai ||
english: In the darkness, no one can sleep in peace.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਦੋਊ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਈ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raajaa ra(n)k dooo mil roee hai ||1||
english: The king and the pauper both weep and cry. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਹਿਬੋ ॥
transliteration: jau pai rasanaa raam na kahibo ||
english: As long as the tongue does not chant the Lord's Name,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਪਜਤ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਰੋਵਤ ਰਹਿਬੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: upajat binasat rovat rahibo ||1|| rahaau ||
english: the person continues coming and going in reincarnation, crying out in pain. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਸ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jas dekheeai taravar kee chhaaiaa ||
english: It is like the shadow of a tree;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗਏ ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: praan gae kahu kaa kee maaiaa ||2||
english: when the breath of life passes out of the mortal being, tell me, what becomes of his wealth? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਸ ਜੰਤੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jas ja(n)tee mahi jeeu samaanaa ||
english: It is like the music contained in the instrument;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੂਏ ਮਰਮੁ ਕੋ ਕਾ ਕਰ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mooe maram ko kaa kar jaanaa ||3||
english: how can anyone know the secret of the dead? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸਾ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)saa saravar kaal sareer ||
english: Like the swan on the lake, death hovers over the body.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਪੀਉ ਰੇ ਕਬੀਰ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: raam rasaain peeu re kabeer ||4||8||
english: Drink in the Lord's sweet elixir, Kabeer. ||4||8||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੀ ਜੋਤੀ ॥
transliteration: jot kee jaat jaat kee jotee ||
english: The creation is born of the Light, and the Light is in the creation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੇ ਕੰਚੂਆ ਫਲ ਮੋਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tit laage ka(n)chooaa phal motee ||1||
english: It bears two fruits: the false glass and the true pearl. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਘਰੁ ਜੋ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kavan s ghar jo nirabhau kaheeai ||
english: Where is that home, which is said to be free of fear?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhau bhaj jaai abhai hoi raheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: There, fear is dispelled and one lives without fear. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
transliteration: tat teerath nahee man pateeaai ||
english: On the banks of sacred rivers, the mind is not appeased.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰ ਅਚਾਰ ਰਹੇ ਉਰਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chaar achaar rahe urajhaai ||2||
english: People remain entangled in good and bad deeds. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਦੁਇ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: paap pu(n)n dui ek samaan ||
english: Sin and virtue are both the same.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਗੁਨ ਆਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nij ghar paaras tajahu gun aan ||3||
english: In the home of your own being, is the Philosopher's Stone; renounce your search for any other virtue. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer niragun naam na ros ||
english: Kabeer: O worthless mortal, do not lose the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਪਰਚਾਇ ਪਰਚਿ ਰਹੁ ਏਸੁ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: is parachaai parach rahu es ||4||9||
english: Keep this mind of yours involved in this involvement. ||4||9||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਪਰਮਨੁ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jo jan paramit paraman jaanaa ||
english: He claims to know the Lord, who is beyond measure and beyond thought;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਤਨ ਹੀ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baatan hee baiku(n)th samaanaa ||1||
english: by mere words, he plans to enter heaven. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕਹਾ ਹੀ ॥
transliteration: naa jaanaa baiku(n)th kahaa hee ||
english: I do not know where heaven is.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ਸਭਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਤਹਾ ਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaan jaan sabh kahahi tahaa hee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Everyone claims that he plans to go there. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਅਈ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: kahan kahaavan nah pateeaee hai ||
english: By mere talk, the mind is not appeased.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਈ ਹੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tau man maanai jaa te haumai jaee hai ||2||
english: The mind is only appeased, when egotism is conquered. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਨਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: jab lag man baiku(n)th kee aas ||
english: As long as the mind is filled with the desire for heaven,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਹੀ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tab lag hoi nahee charan nivaas ||3||
english: he does not dwell at the Lord's Feet. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer ih kaheeai kaahi ||
english: Says Kabeer, unto whom should I tell this?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੈ ਆਹਿ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat baiku(n)thai aahi ||4||10||
english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is heaven. ||4||10||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਪਜੈ ਨਿਪਜੈ ਨਿਪਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: upajai nipajai nipaj samaaee ||
english: We are born, and we grow, and having grown, we pass away.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨਹ ਦੇਖਤ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nainah dekhat ihu jag jaaee ||1||
english: Before our very eyes, this world is passing away. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਾਜ ਨ ਮਰਹੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: laaj na marahu kahahu ghar meraa ||
english: How can you not die of shame, claiming, This world is mine?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kee baar nahee kachh teraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: At the very last moment, nothing is yours. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: anik jatan kar kaaiaa paalee ||
english: Trying various methods, you cherish your body,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਅਗਨਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maratee baar agan sa(n)g jaalee ||2||
english: but at the time of death, it is burned in the fire. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮਰਦਨ ਅੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: choaa cha(n)dan maradan a(n)gaa ||
english: You apply sandalwood oil to your limbs,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਕਾਠ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so tan jalai kaath kai sa(n)gaa ||3||
english: but that body is burned with the firewood. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਗੁਨੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer sunahu re guneeaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O virtuous people:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੈਗੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: binasaigo roop dekhai sabh duneeaa ||4||11||
english: your beauty shall vanish, as the whole world watches. ||4||11||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਮੂਏ ਕਿਆ ਸੋਗੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: avar mooe kiaa sog kareejai ||
english: Why do you cry and mourn, when another person dies?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਉ ਆਪਨ ਜੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tau keejai jau aapan jeejai ||1||
english: Do so only if you yourself are to live. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨ ਮਰਉ ਮਰਿਬੋ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mai na marau maribo sa(n)saaraa ||
english: I shall not die as the rest of the world dies,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਹੈ ਜੀਆਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ab mohi milio hai jeeaavanahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: for now I have met the life-giving Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਦੇਹੀ ਪਰਮਲ ਮਹਕੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: iaa dehee paramal mahaka(n)daa ||
english: People anoint their bodies with fragrant oils,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa sukh bisare paramaana(n)daa ||2||
english: and in that pleasure, they forget the supreme bliss. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੂਅਟਾ ਏਕੁ ਪੰਚ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kooataa ek pa(n)ch panihaaree ||
english: There is one well, and five water-carriers.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੀ ਲਾਜੁ ਭਰੈ ਮਤਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tootee laaj bharai mat haaree ||3||
english: Even though the rope is broken, the fools continue trying to draw water. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer ik budh beechaaree ||
english: Says Kabeer, through contemplation, I have obtained this one understanding.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਕੂਅਟਾ ਨਾ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naa ohu kooataa naa panihaaree ||4||12||
english: There is no well, and no water-carrier. ||4||12||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਾਵਰ ਜੰਗਮ ਕੀਟ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: asathaavar ja(n)gam keet pata(n)gaa ||
english: The mobile and immobile creatures, insects and moths

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik janam keee bahu ra(n)gaa ||1||
english: - in numerous lifetimes, I have passed through those many forms. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਘਰ ਹਮ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aise ghar ham bahut basaae ||
english: I lived in many such homes, O Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਰਾਮ ਗਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab ham raam garabh hoi aae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: before I came into the womb this time. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jogee jatee tapee brahamachaaree ||
english: I was a Yogi, a celibate, a penitent, and a Brahmchaaree, with strict self-discipline.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਰਾਜਾ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kabahoo raajaa chhatrapat kabahoo bhekhaaree ||2||
english: Sometimes I was a king, sitting on the throne, and sometimes I was a beggar. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਮਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: saakat marahi sa(n)t sabh jeevahi ||
english: The faithless cynics shall die, while the Saints shall all survive.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਪੀਵਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam rasaain rasanaa peevahi ||3||
english: They drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Essence with their tongues. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer prabh kirapaa keejai ||
english: Says Kabeer, O God, have mercy on me.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਅਬ ਪੂਰਾ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੧੩॥
transliteration: haar pare ab pooraa deejai ||4||13||
english: I am so tired; now, please bless me with Your perfection. ||4||13||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਲਾਇ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee kee naal ralaai likhiaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, With Writings Of The Fifth Mehl:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
transliteration: aiso acharaj dekhio kabeer ||
english: Kabeer has seen such wonders!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਧਿ ਕੈ ਭੋਲੈ ਬਿਰੋਲੈ ਨੀਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dadh kai bholai birolai neer ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Mistaking it for cream, the people are churning water. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰੀ ਅੰਗੂਰੀ ਗਦਹਾ ਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: haree a(n)gooree gadahaa charai ||
english: The donkey grazes upon the green grass;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਹਾਸੈ ਹੀਗੈ ਮਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nit uth haasai heegai marai ||1||
english: arising each day, he laughs and brays, and then dies. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਭੈਸਾ ਅੰਮੁਹਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maataa bhaisaa a(n)muhaa jaai ||
english: The bull is intoxicated, and runs around wildly.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਿ ਕੁਦਿ ਚਰੈ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kud kud charai rasaatal paai ||2||
english: He romps and eats and then falls into hell. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਖੇਡ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer paragat bhaee khed ||
english: Says Kabeer, a strange sport has become manifest:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੇਲੇ ਕਉ ਚੂਘੈ ਨਿਤ ਭੇਡ ॥੩॥
transliteration: lele kau chooghai nit bhed ||3||
english: the sheep is sucking the milk of her lamb. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: raam ramat mat paragatee aaee ||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name, my intellect is enlightened.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer gur sojhee paaee ||4||1||14||
english: Says Kabeer, the Guru has blessed me with this understanding. ||4||1||14||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ₂ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee pa(n)chapade₂ ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Panch-Padhay:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਇਓ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu jal chhod baahar bhaio meenaa ||
english: I am like a fish out of water,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਹਉ ਤਪ ਕਾ ਹੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poorab janam hau tap kaa heenaa ||1||
english: because in my previous life, I did not practice penance and intense meditation. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਕਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ab kahu raam kavan gat moree ||
english: Now tell me, Lord, what will my condition be?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਜੀ ਲੇ ਬਨਾਰਸ ਮਤਿ ਭਈ ਥੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tajee le banaaras mat bhaee thoree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I left Benares - I had little common sense. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਵ ਪੁਰੀ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sagal janam siv puree gavaaiaa ||
english: I wasted my whole life in the city of Shiva;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਮਗਹਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maratee baar magahar uth aaiaa ||2||
english: at the time of my death, I moved to Magahar. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਰਸ ਤਪੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: bahut baras tap keeaa kaasee ||
english: For many years, I practiced penance and intense meditation at Kaashi;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਗਹਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maran bhaiaa magahar kee baasee ||3||
english: now that my time to die has come, I have come to dwell at Magahar! ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਸੀ ਮਗਹਰ ਸਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaasee magahar sam beechaaree ||
english: Kaashi and Magahar - I consider them the same.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਛੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ochhee bhagat kaise utaras paaree ||4||
english: With inadequate devotion, how can anyone swim across? ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਜ ਸਿਵ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: kahu gur gaj siv sabh ko jaanai ||
english: Says Kabeer, the Guru and Ganaysha and Shiva all know

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁਆ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਰਮਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮੈ ॥੫॥੧੫॥
transliteration: muaa kabeer ramat sree raamai ||5||15||
english: that Kabeer died chanting the Lord's Name. ||5||15||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਮਰਦਨ ਅੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: choaa cha(n)dan maradan a(n)gaa ||
english: You may anoint your limbs with sandalwood oil,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਕਾਠ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so tan jalai kaath kai sa(n)gaa ||1||
english: but in the end, that body will be burned with the firewood. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: is tan dhan kee kavan badaaee ||
english: Why should anyone take pride in this body or wealth?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧਰਨਿ ਪਰੈ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dharan parai uravaar na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They shall end up lying on the ground; they shall not go along with you to the world beyond. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਜਿ ਸੋਵਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: raat j sovahi din karahi kaam ||
english: They sleep by night and work during the day,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਲੇਹਿ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ik khin lehi na har ko naam ||2||
english: but they do not chant the Lord's Name, even for an instant. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥਿ ਤ ਡੋਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਖਾਇਓ ਤੰਬੋਰ ॥
transliteration: haath ta dor mukh khaaio ta(n)bor ||
english: They hold the string of the kite in their hands, and chew betel leaves in their mouths,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਕਸਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਚੋਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maratee baar kas baadhio chor ||3||
english: but at the time of death, they shall be tied up tight, like thieves. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramat ras ras har gun gaavai ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, and immersed in His Love, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: raamai raam ramat sukh paavai ||4||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, and find peace. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa kar kai naam driRaaee ||
english: In His Mercy, He implants the Naam within us;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਸੁ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: har har baas suga(n)dh basaaee ||5||
english: inhale deeply the sweet aroma and fragrance of the Lord, Har, Har. ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਅੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer chet re a(n)dhaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, remember Him, you blind fool!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਸਭੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੬॥੧੬॥
transliteration: sat raam jhoothaa sabh dha(n)dhaa ||6||16||
english: The Lord is True; all worldly affairs are false. ||6||16||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਤਿਪਦੇ ਚਾਰਤੁਕੇ₂ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee tipade chaaratuke₂ ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Thi-Padhay And Chau-Thukay:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਤੇ ਉਲਟਿ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jam te ulat bhae hai raam ||
english: I have turned away from death and turned to the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਓ ਬਿਸਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dukh binase sukh keeo bisaraam ||
english: Pain has been eliminated, and I dwell in peac and comfort.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰੀ ਉਲਟਿ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bairee ulat bhae hai meetaa ||
english: My enemies have been transformed into friends.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਉਲਟਿ ਸੁਜਨ ਭਏ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saakat ulat sujan bhae cheetaa ||1||
english: The faithless cynics have been transformed into good-hearted people. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ab mohi sarab kusal kar maaniaa ||
english: Now, I feel that everything brings me peace.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭਈ ਜਬ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)t bhaee jab gobid jaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Peace and tranquility have come, since I realized the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: tan mahi hotee kot upaadh ||
english: My body was afflicted with millions of diseases.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਲਟਿ ਭਈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: ulat bhaee sukh sahaj samaadh ||
english: They have been transformed into the peaceful, tranquil concentration of Samaadhi.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ਆਪੈ ਆਪ ॥
transliteration: aap pachhaanai aapai aap ||
english: When someone understands his own self,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਤੀਨੌ ਤਾਪ ॥੨॥
transliteration: rog na biaapai teenau taap ||2||
english: he no longer suffers from illness and the three fevers. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮਨੁ ਉਲਟਿ ਸਨਾਤਨੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
transliteration: ab man ulat sanaatan hooaa ||
english: My mind has now been restored to its original purity.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਜਬ ਜੀਵਤ ਮੂਆ ॥
transliteration: tab jaaniaa jab jeevat mooaa ||
english: When I became dead while yet alive, only then did I come to know the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer sukh sahaj samaavau ||
english: Says Kabeer, I am now immersed in intuitive peace and poise.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਡਰਉ ਨ ਅਵਰ ਡਰਾਵਉ ॥੩॥੧੭॥
transliteration: aap na darau na avar daraavau ||3||17||
english: I do not fear anyone, and I do not strike fear into anyone else. ||3||17||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਿੰਡਿ ਮੂਐ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਹ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: pi(n)d mooai jeeu kih ghar jaataa ||
english: When the body dies, where does the soul go?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤੀਤਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad ateet anaahad raataa ||
english: It is absorbed into the untouched, unstruck melody of the Word of the Shabad.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jin raam jaaniaa tinahi pachhaaniaa ||
english: Only one who knows the Lord realizes Him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਗੂੰਗੇ ਸਾਕਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu goo(n)ge saakar man maaniaa ||1||
english: The mind is satisfied and satiated, like the mute who eats the sugar candy and just smiles, without speaking. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਥੈ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aisaa giaan kathai banavaaree ||
english: Such is the spiritual wisdom which the Lord has imparted.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਪਵਨ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man re pavan driR sukhaman naaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O mind, hold your breath steady within the central channel of the Sushmanaa. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: so gur karahu j bahur na karanaa ||
english: Adopt such a Guru, that you shall not have to adopt another again.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਦੁ ਰਵਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਰਵਨਾ ॥
transliteration: so pad ravahu j bahur na ravanaa ||
english: Dwell in such a state, that you shall never have to dwell in any other.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: so dhiaan dharahu j bahur na dharanaa ||
english: Embrace such a meditation, that you shall never have to embrace any other.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਮਰਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aise marahu j bahur na maranaa ||2||
english: Die in such a way, that you shall never have to die again. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਲਟੀ ਗੰਗਾ ਜਮੁਨ ਮਿਲਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: ulatee ga(n)gaa jamun milaavau ||
english: Turn your breath away from the left channel, and away from the right channel, and unite them in the central channel of the Sushmanaa.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਸੰਗਮ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਨੑਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: bin jal sa(n)gam man mahi nhaavau ||
english: At their confluence within your mind, take your bath there without water.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੋਚਾ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: lochaa samasar ihu biuhaaraa ||
english: To look upon all with an impartial eye - let this be your daily occupation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਅਵਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tat beechaar kiaa avar beechaaraa ||3||
english: Contemplate this essence of reality - what else is there to contemplate? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁ ਤੇਜੁ ਬਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਆਕਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: ap tej baai prithamee aakaasaa ||
english: Water, fire, wind, earth and ether

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਰਹਤ ਰਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aisee rahat rahau har paasaa ||
english: adopt such a way of life and you shall be close to the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
transliteration: kahai kabeer nira(n)jan dhiaavau ||
english: Says Kabeer, meditate on the Immaculate Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
transliteration: tit ghar jaau j bahur na aavau ||4||18||
english: Go to that home, which you shall never have to leave. ||4||18||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਤਿਪਦੇ₁₅ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee tipade₁₅ ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Thi-Padhay:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਸਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਹੀ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)chan siu paaeeai nahee tol ||
english: He cannot be obtained by offering your weight in gold.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਲੀਆ ਹੈ ਮੋਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man de raam leeaa hai mol ||1||
english: But I have bought the Lord by giving my mind to Him. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ab mohi raam apunaa kar jaaniaa ||
english: Now I recognize that He is my Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sahaj subhaai meraa man maaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind is intuitively pleased with Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: brahamai kath kath a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: Brahma spoke of Him continually, but could not find His limit.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam bhagat baithe ghar aaiaa ||2||
english: Because of my devotion to the Lord, He has come to sit within the home of my inner being. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer cha(n)chal mat tiaagee ||
english: Says Kabeer, I have renounced my restless intellect.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਜ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥੧॥੧੯॥
transliteration: keval raam bhagat nij bhaagee ||3||1||19||
english: It is my destiny to worship the Lord alone. ||3||1||19||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਮਰਨੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jih maranai sabh jagat taraasiaa ||
english: That death which terrifies the entire world

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਰਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so maranaa gur sabad pragaasiaa ||1||
english: - the nature of that death has been revealed to me, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਰਉ ਮਰਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ab kaise marau maran man maaniaa ||
english: Now, how shall I die? My mind has already accepted death.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੇ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mar mar jaate jin raam na jaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who do not know the Lord, die over and over again, and then depart. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਨੋ ਮਰਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: marano maran kahai sabh koee ||
english: Everyone says, I will die, I will die.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sahaje marai amar hoi soee ||2||
english: But he alone becomes immortal, who dies with intuitive understanding. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer man bhaiaa ana(n)daa ||
english: Says Kabeer, my mind is filled with bliss;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਇਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੩॥੨੦॥
transliteration: gaiaa bharam rahiaa paramaana(n)daa ||3||20||
english: my doubts have been eliminated, and I am in ecstasy. ||3||20||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਤ ਨਹੀ ਠਉਰ ਮੂਲੁ ਕਤ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: kat nahee thaur mool kat laavau ||
english: There is no special place where the soul aches; where should I apply the ointment?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khojat tan mahi thaur na paavau ||1||
english: I have searched the body, but I have not found such a place. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਾਗੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੀਰ ॥
transliteration: laagee hoi s jaanai peer ||
english: He alone knows it, who feels the pain of such love;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਨੀਆਲੇ ਤੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam bhagat aneeaale teer ||1|| rahaau ||
english: the arrows of the Lord's devotional worship are so sharp! ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਭਾਇ ਦੇਖਉ ਸਭ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ek bhaai dekhau sabh naaree ||
english: I look upon all His soul-brides with an impartial eye;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ ਸਹ ਕਉਨ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kiaa jaanau sah kaun piaaree ||2||
english: how can I know which ones are dear to the Husband Lord? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer jaa kai masatak bhaag ||
english: Says Kabeer, one who has such destiny inscribed upon her forehead

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ॥੩॥੨੧॥
transliteration: sabh parahar taa kau milai suhaag ||3||21||
english: - her Husband Lord turns all others away, and meets with her. ||3||21||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai har saa thaakur bhaaee ||
english: One who has the Lord as his Master, O Siblings of Destiny

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਅਨੰਤ ਪੁਕਾਰਣਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mukat ana(n)t pukaaran jaaee ||1||
english: - countless liberations knock at his door. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਤੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ab kahu raam bharosaa toraa ||
english: If I say now that my trust is in You alone, Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tab kaahoo kaa kavan nihoraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: then what obligation do I have to anyone else? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਹਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
transliteration: teen lok jaa kai hahi bhaar ||
english: He bears the burden of the three worlds;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so kaahe na karai pratipaar ||2||
english: why should He not cherish you also? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer ik budh beechaaree ||
english: Says Kabeer, through contemplation, I have obtained this one understanding.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਬਸੁ ਜਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੨੨॥
transliteration: kiaa bas jau bikh de mahataaree ||3||22||
english: If the mother poisons her own child, what can anyone do? ||3||22||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤ ਸਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bin sat satee hoi kaise naar ||
english: Without Truth, how can the woman be a true satee - a widow who burns herself on her husband's funeral pyre?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit dekhahu ridai beechaar ||1||
english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, see this and contemplate it within your heart. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਧੈ ਸਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: preet binaa kaise badhai sanehu ||
english: Without love, how can one's affection increase?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਰਸੁ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab lag ras tab lag nahee nehu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As long as there is attachment to pleasure, there can be no spiritual love. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਨਿ ਸਤੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੀਅ ਅਪਨੈ ॥
transliteration: saahan sat karai jee apanai ||
english: One who, in his own soul, believes the Queen Maya to be true,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਰਮਯੇ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਸੁਪਨੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so ramaye kau milai na supanai ||2||
english: does not meet the Lord, even in dreams. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਉਪਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tan man dhan grihu saup sareer ||
english: One who surrenders her body, mind, wealth, home and self

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥੩॥੨੩॥
transliteration: soee suhaagan kahai kabeer ||3||23||
english: - she is the true soul-bride, says Kabeer. ||3||23||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa biaapiaa sagal sa(n)saar ||
english: The whole world is engrossed in corruption.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੈ ਡੂਬੀ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bikhiaa lai doobee paravaar ||1||
english: This corruption has drowned entire families. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਨਾਵ ਚਉੜਿ ਕਤ ਬੋੜੀ ॥
transliteration: re nar naav chauR kat boRee ||
english: O man, why have you wrecked your boat and sunk it?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਤੋੜਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋੜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har siu toR bikhiaa sa(n)g joRee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You have broken with the Lord, and joined hands with corruption. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦਾਧੇ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਗਿ ॥
transliteration: sur nar daadhe laagee aag ||
english: Angels and human beings alike are burning in the raging fire.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨੀਰੁ ਪਸੁ ਪੀਵਸਿ ਨ ਝਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nikat neer pas peevas na jhaag ||2||
english: The water is near at hand, but the beast does not drink it in. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਤ ਚੇਤਤ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਨੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: chetat chetat nikasio neer ||
english: By constant contemplation and awareness, the water is brought forth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕਥਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥੩॥੨੪॥
transliteration: so jal niramal kathat kabeer ||3||24||
english: That water is immaculate and pure, says Kabeer. ||3||24||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਕੁਲਿ ਪੂਤੁ ਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jih kul poot na giaan beechaaree ||
english: That family, whose son has no spiritual wisdom or contemplation

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਧਵਾ ਕਸ ਨ ਭਈ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bidhavaa kas na bhaee mahataaree ||1||
english: - why didn't his mother just become a widow? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹਿ ਸਾਧੀ ॥
transliteration: jih nar raam bhagat nahi saadhee ||
english: That man who has not practiced devotional worship of the Lord

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਤ ਕਸ ਨ ਮੁਓ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janamat kas na muo aparaadhee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - why didn't such a sinful man die at birth? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁਚੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਗਰਭ ਗਏ ਕੀਨ ਬਚਿਆ ॥
transliteration: much much garabh gae keen bachiaa ||
english: So many pregnancies end in miscarriage - why was this one spared?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੁਡਭੁਜ ਰੂਪ ਜੀਵੇ ਜਗ ਮਝਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: budabhuj roop jeeve jag majhiaa ||2||
english: He lives his life in this world like a deformed amputee. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer jaise su(n)dar saroop ||
english: Says Kabeer, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਬਜ ਕੁਰੂਪ ॥੩॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naam binaa jaise kubaj kuroop ||3||25||
english: Beautiful and handsome people are just ugly hunch-backs. ||3||25||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਲੇਹਿ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo jan lehi khasam kaa naau ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to those humble beings

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin kai sad balihaarai jaau ||1||
english: Who take the Name of their Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so niramal niramal har gun gaavai ||
english: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Pure Lord are pure.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਭਾਈ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: so bhaaee merai man bhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They are my Siblings of Destiny, so dear to my heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਘਟ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jih ghat raam rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: I am the dust of the lotus feet of those

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ ਹਮ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin kee pag pa(n)kaj ham dhoor ||2||
english: Whose hearts are filled with the All-pervading Lord. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਜੁਲਾਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਧੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jaat julaahaa mat kaa dheer ||
english: I am a weaver by birth, and patient of mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥੩॥੨੬॥
transliteration: sahaj sahaj gun ramai kabeer ||3||26||
english: Slowly, steadily, Kabeer chants the Glories of God. ||3||26||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਗਨਿ ਰਸਾਲ ਚੁਐ ਮੇਰੀ ਭਾਠੀ ॥
transliteration: gagan rasaal chuai meree bhaathee ||
english: From the Sky of the Tenth Gate, the nectar trickles down, distilled from my furnace.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਚਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਤਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਕਾਠੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)ch mahaa ras tan bhaiaa kaathee ||1||
english: I have gathered in this most sublime essence, making my body into firewood. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਕਉ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਹਜ ਮਤਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: uaa kau kaheeai sahaj matavaaraa ||
english: He alone is called intoxicated with intuitive peace and poise,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: peevat raam ras giaan beechaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: who drinks in the juice of the Lord's essence, contemplating spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਕਲਾਲਨਿ ਜਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sahaj kalaalan jau mil aaee ||
english: Intuitive poise is the bar-maid who comes to serve it.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aana(n)d maate anadin jaaee ||2||
english: I pass my nights and days in ecstasy. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੀਨਤ ਚੀਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: cheenat cheet nira(n)jan laaiaa ||
english: Through conscious meditation, I linked my consciousness with the Immaculate Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੌ ਅਨਭਉ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥੨੭॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer tau anabhau paaiaa ||3||27||
english: Says Kabeer, then I obtained the Fearless Lord. ||3||27||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਿਆਪੀ ॥
transliteration: man kaa subhaau manahi biaapee ||
english: The natural tendency of the mind is to chase the mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਵਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਥਾਪੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: manahi maar kavan sidh thaapee ||1||
english: Who has established himself as a Siddha, a being of miraculous spiritual powers, by killing his mind? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਨਿ ਜੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kavan s mun jo man maarai ||
english: Who is that silent sage, who has killed his mind?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man kau maar kahahu kis taarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By killing the mind, tell me, who is saved? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: man a(n)tar bolai sabh koee ||
english: Everyone speaks through the mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man maare bin bhagat na hoee ||2||
english: Without killing the mind, devotional worship is not performed. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer jo jaanai bheu ||
english: Says Kabeer, one who knows the secret of this mystery,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥੨੮॥
transliteration: man madhusoodan tribhavan deu ||3||28||
english: beholds within his own mind the Lord of the three worlds. ||3||28||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜੁ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਅੰਬਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: oi j deesahi a(n)bar taare ||
english: The stars which are seen in the sky

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਿ ਓਇ ਚੀਤੇ ਚੀਤਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kin oi cheete cheetanahaare ||1||
english: - who is the painter who painted them? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu re pa(n)dit a(n)bar kaa siu laagaa ||
english: Tell me, O Pandit, what is the sky attached to?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: boojhai boojhanahaar sabhaagaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Very fortunate is the knower who knows this. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜ ਚੰਦੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sooraj cha(n)d karahi ujeeaaraa ||
english: The sun and the moon give their light;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh mahi pasariaa braham pasaaraa ||2||
english: God's creative extension extends everywhere. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾਨੈਗਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer jaanaigaa soi ||
english: Says Kabeer, he alone knows this,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥੨੯॥
transliteration: hiradai raam mukh raamai hoi ||3||29||
english: whose heart is filled with the Lord, and whose mouth is also filled with the Lord. ||3||29||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਕੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bed kee putree si(n)mrit bhaaee ||
english: The Simritee is the daughter of the Vedas, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਕਲ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਲੈ ਹੈ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saa(n)kal jevaree lai hai aaee ||1||
english: She has brought a chain and a rope. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਨਗਰੁ ਆਪ ਤੇ ਬਾਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aapan nagar aap te baadhiaa ||
english: She has imprisoned the people in her own city.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਕੈ ਫਾਧਿ ਕਾਲ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਂਧਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: moh kai phaadh kaal sar saa(n)dhiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: She has tightened the noose of emotional attachment and shot the arrow of death. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਟੀ ਨ ਕਟੈ ਤੂਟਿ ਨਹ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: katee na katai toot nah jaaee ||
