english: By cutting, she cannot be cut, and she cannot be broken.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਸਾਪਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saa saapan hoi jag kau khaaee ||2||
english: She has become a serpent, and she is eating the world. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਦੇਖਤ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ham dekhat jin sabh jag lootiaa ||
english: Before my very eyes, she has plundered the entire world.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਿ ਛੂਟਿਆ ॥੩॥੩੦॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer mai raam kahi chhootiaa ||3||30||
english: Says Kabeer, chanting the Lord's Name, I have escaped her. ||3||30||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਇ ਮੁਹਾਰ ਲਗਾਮੁ ਪਹਿਰਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: dei muhaar lagaam pahiraavau ||
english: I have grasped the reins and attached the bridle;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਤ ਜੀਨੁ ਗਗਨ ਦਉਰਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sagal ta jeen gagan dauraavau ||1||
english: abandoning everything, I now ride through the skies. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: apanai beechaar asavaaree keejai ||
english: I made self-reflection my mount,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਕੈ ਪਾਵੜੈ ਪਗੁ ਧਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sahaj kai paavaRai pag dhar leejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and in the stirrups of intuitive poise, I placed my feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਲੁ ਰੇ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਲੇ ਤਾਰਉ ॥
transliteration: chal re baiku(n)th tujhahi le taarau ||
english: Come, and let me ride you to heaven.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਿਚਹਿ ਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਚਾਬੁਕ ਮਾਰਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hichahi ta prem kai chaabuk maarau ||2||
english: If you hold back, then I shall strike you with the whip of spiritual love. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਲੇ ਅਸਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer bhale asavaaraa ||
english: Says Kabeer, those who remain detached from the

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਤੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੩੧॥
transliteration: bed kateb te rahahi niraaraa ||3||31||
english: Vedas, the Koran and the Bible are the best riders. ||3||31||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਂਚਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jih mukh paa(n)chau a(n)mrit khaae ||
english: That mouth, which used to eat the five delicacies

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਮੁਖ ਦੇਖਤ ਲੂਕਟ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tih mukh dekhat lookat laae ||1||
english: - I have seen the flames being applied to that mouth. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ik dukh raam raai kaatahu meraa ||
english: O Lord, my King, please rid me of this one affliction:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਦਹੈ ਅਰੁ ਗਰਭ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: agan dahai ar garabh baseraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: may I not be burned in fire, or cast into the womb again. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਬਿਗੂਤੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa bigootee bahu bidh bhaatee ||
english: The body is destroyed by so many ways and means.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਜਾਰੇ ਕੋ ਗਡਿ ਲੇ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ko jaare ko gad le maatee ||2||
english: Some burn it, and some bury it in the earth. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer har charan dikhaavahu ||
english: Says Kabeer, O Lord, please reveal to me Your Lotus Feet;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੈ ਤੇ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਪਠਾਵਹੁ ॥੩॥੩੨॥
transliteration: paachhai te jam kiu na pathaavahu ||3||32||
english: after that, go ahead and send me to my death. ||3||32||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਪਵਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aape paavak aape pavanaa ||
english: He Himself is the fire, and He Himself is the wind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾਰੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਤ ਰਾਖੈ ਕਵਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaarai khasam ta raakhai kavanaa ||1||
english: When our Lord and Master wishes to burn someone, then who can save him? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਤਨੁ ਜਰਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raam japat tan jar kee na jaai ||
english: When I chant the Lord's Name, what does it matter if my body burns?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam chit rahiaa samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My consciousness remains absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾ ਕੋ ਜਰੈ ਕਾਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: kaa ko jarai kaahi hoi haan ||
english: Who is burned, and who suffers loss?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਵਟ ਖੇਲੈ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nat vat khelai saarigapaan ||2||
english: The Lord plays, like the juggler with his ball. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਖਰ ਦੁਇ ਭਾਖਿ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer akhar dui bhaakh ||
english: Says Kabeer, chant the two letters of the Lord's Name - Raa Maa.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇਗਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਤ ਲੇਇਗਾ ਰਾਖਿ ॥੩॥੩੩॥
transliteration: hoigaa khasam ta leigaa raakh ||3||33||
english: If He is your Lord and Master, He will protect you. ||3||33||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਦੁਪਦੇ₂ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee dupade₂ ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Dho-Padhay:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naa mai jog dhiaan chit laaiaa ||
english: I have not practiced Yoga, or focused my consciousness on meditation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin bairaag na chhootas maaiaa ||1||
english: Without renunciation, I cannot escape Maya. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaise jeevan hoi hamaaraa ||
english: How have I passed my life?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab na hoi raam naam adhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have not taken the Lord's Name as my Support. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਖੋਜਉ ਅਸਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer khojau asamaan ||
english: Says Kabeer, I have searched the skies,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਸਮਾਨ ਨ ਦੇਖਉ ਆਨ ॥੨॥੩੪॥
transliteration: raam samaan na dekhau aan ||2||34||
english: and have not seen another, equal to the Lord. ||2||34||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਬਾਧਤ ਪਾਗ ॥
transliteration: jih sir rach rach baadhat paag ||
english: That head which was once embellished with the finest turban

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਚੁੰਚ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਕਾਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so sir chu(n)ch savaarahi kaag ||1||
english: - upon that head, the crow now cleans his beak. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕੋ ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬਈਆ ॥
transliteration: is tan dhan ko kiaa garabaeeaa ||
english: What pride should we take in this body and wealth?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam kaahe na driRheeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Why not hold tight to the Lord's Name instead? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu man mere ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O my mind:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹੀ ਹਵਾਲ ਹੋਹਿਗੇ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੨॥੩੫॥
transliteration: ihee havaal hohige tere ||2||35||
english: this may be your fate as well! ||2||35||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਪੈਤੀਸ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree ke pade paitees ||
english: Thirty-Five Steps Of Gauree Gwaarayree. ||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee guaareree asatapadee kabeer jee kee ||
english: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Ashtpadheeyaa Of Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਂਗਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sukh maa(n)gat dukh aagai aavai ||
english: People beg for pleasure, but pain comes instead.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਂਗਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so sukh hamahu na maa(n)giaa bhaavai ||1||
english: I would rather not beg for that pleasure. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅਜਹੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa ajahu surat sukh aasaa ||
english: People are involved in corruption, but still, they hope for pleasure.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaise hoee hai raajaa raam nivaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How will they find their home in the Sovereign Lord King? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਸਿਵ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਡਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: is sukh te siv braham daraanaa ||
english: Even Shiva and Brahma are afraid of this pleasure,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so sukh hamahu saach kar jaanaa ||2||
english: but I have judged that pleasure to be true. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਸੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: sanakaadik naarad mun sekhaa ||
english: Even sages like Sanak and Naarad, and the thousand-headed serpent,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tin bhee tan mahi man nahee pekhaa ||3||
english: did not see the mind within the body. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: is man kau koee khojahu bhaaee ||
english: Anyone can search for this mind, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tan chhoote man kahaa samaaee ||4||
english: When it escapes from the body, where does the mind go? ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਨਾਮਾਂ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee jaideu naamaa(n) ||
english: By Guru's Grace, Jai Dayv and Naam Dayv

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bhagat kai prem in hee hai jaanaa(n) ||5||
english: came to know this, through loving devotional worship of the Lord. ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: is man kau nahee aavan jaanaa ||
english: This mind does not come or go.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jis kaa bharam gaiaa tin saach pachhaanaa ||6||
english: One whose doubt is dispelled, knows the Truth. ||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: is man kau roop na rekhiaa kaaee ||
english: This mind has no form or outline.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: hukame hoiaa hukam boojh samaaee ||7||
english: By God's Command it was created; understanding God's Command, it will be absorbed into Him again. ||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
transliteration: is man kaa koee jaanai bheu ||
english: Does anyone know the secret of this mind?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਮਨਿ ਲੀਣ ਭਏ ਸੁਖਦੇਉ ॥੮॥
transliteration: ih man leen bhae sukhadeu ||8||
english: This mind shall merge into the Lord, the Giver of peace and pleasure. ||8||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਏਕੁ ਅਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jeeu ek ar sagal sareeraa ||
english: There is One Soul, and it pervades all bodies.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੯॥੧॥੩੬॥
transliteration: is man kau rav rahe kabeeraa ||9||1||36||
english: Kabeer dwells upon this Mind. ||9||1||36||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee guaareree ||
english: Gauree Gwaarayree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਜੋ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: ahinis ek naam jo jaage ||
english: Those who are awake to the One Name, day and night

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤਕ ਸਿਧ ਭਏ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ketak sidh bhae liv laage ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - many of them have become Siddhas - perfect spiritual beings - with their consciousness attuned to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਮੁਨਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saadhak sidh sagal mun haare ||
english: The seekers, the Siddhas and the silent sages have all lost the game.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਕਲਿਪ ਤਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek naam kalip tar taare ||1||
english: The One Name is the wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree, which saves them and carries them across. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jo har hare s hohi na aanaa ||
english: Those who are rejuvenated by the Lord, do not belong to any other.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੩੭॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer raam naam pachhaanaa ||2||37||
english: Says Kabeer, they realize the Name of the Lord. ||2||37||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਭੀ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਭੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bhee sorath bhee ||
english: Gauree And Also Sorat'h:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਨਿਲਜ ਲਾਜ ਤੋੁਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: re jee nilaj laaj touhi naahee ||
english: O shameless being, don't you feel ashamed?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਜਿ ਕਤ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਜਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har taj kat kaahoo ke jaa(n)hee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You have forsaken the Lord - now where will you go? Unto whom will you turn? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa ko thaakur oochaa hoee ||
english: One whose Lord and Master is the highest and most exalted

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਸੋਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so jan par ghar jaat na sohee ||1||
english: - it is not proper for him to go to the house of another. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: so saahib rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: That Lord and Master is pervading everywhere.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa sa(n)g naahee har door ||2||
english: The Lord is always with us; He is never far away. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਵਲਾ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: kavalaa charan saran hai jaa ke ||
english: Even Maya takes to the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu jan kaa naahee ghar taa ke ||3||
english: Tell me, what is there which is not in His home? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ ਜਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh kooo kahai jaas kee baataa ||
english: Everyone speaks of Him; He is All-powerful.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਨਿਜ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: so sa(n)mrath nij pat hai daataa ||4||
english: He is His Own Master; He is the Giver. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਗ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kahai kabeer pooran jag soee ||
english: Says Kabeer, he alone is perfect in this world,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੩੮॥
transliteration: jaa ke hiradai avar na hoee ||5||38||
english: in whose heart there is none other than the Lord. ||5||38||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਤੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਾ ਕੋ ॥
transliteration: kaun ko poot pitaa ko kaa ko ||
english: Whose son is he? Whose father is he?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਕੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੰਤਾਪੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaun marai ko dei sa(n)taapo ||1||
english: Who dies? Who inflicts pain? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਠਗ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har thag jag kau thagauree laaee ||
english: The Lord is the thug, who has drugged and robbed the whole world.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਬਿਓਗ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਅਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ke biog kaise jeeau meree maaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am separated from the Lord; how can I survive, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨ ਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਉਨ ਕੀ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaun ko purakh kaun kee naaree ||
english: Whose husband is he? Whose wife is she?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਤਤ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: iaa tat lehu sareer bichaaree ||2||
english: Contemplate this reality within your body. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਠਗ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer thag siu man maaniaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, my mind is pleased and satisfied with the thug.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਠਗੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥੩੯॥
transliteration: gaee thagauree thag pahichaaniaa ||3||39||
english: The effects of the drug have vanished, since I recognized the thug. ||3||39||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ab mo kau bhae raajaa raam sahaaee ||
english: Now, the Lord, my King, has become my help and support.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਟਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam maran kat param gat paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have cut away birth and death, and attained the supreme status. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੀਓ ਰਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat deeo ralaai ||
english: He has united me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤੇ ਲੀਓ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch doot te leeo chhadaai ||
english: He has rescued me from the five demons.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam japau jap rasanaa ||
english: I chant with my tongue and meditate on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਮੋਲ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਅਪਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: amol daas kar leeno apanaa ||1||
english: He has made me his own slave. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀਨੋ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur keeno paraupakaar ||
english: The True Guru has blessed me with His generosity.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਨ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kaadh leen saagar sa(n)saar ||
english: He has lifted me up, out of the world-ocean.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu laagee preet ||
english: I have fallen in love with His Lotus Feet.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਤਾ ਨਿਤ ਚੀਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d basai nitaa nit cheet ||2||
english: The Lord of the Universe dwells continually within my consciousness. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਅੰਗਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa tapat bujhiaa a(n)giaar ||
english: The burning fire of Maya has been extinguished.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man sa(n)tokh naam aadhaar ||
english: My mind is contented with the Support of the Naam.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: jal thal poor rahe prabh suaamee ||
english: God, the Lord and Master, is totally permeating the water and the land.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jat pekhau tat a(n)tarajaamee ||3||
english: Wherever I look, there is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: apanee bhagat aap hee driRaaee ||
english: He Himself has implanted His devotional worship within me.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: poorab likhat miliaa mere bhaaee ||
english: By pre-ordained destiny, one meets Him, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਜ ॥
transliteration: jis kripaa kare tis pooran saaj ||
english: When He grants His Grace, one is perfectly fulfilled.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥੪॥੪੦॥
transliteration: kabeer ko suaamee gareeb nivaaj ||4||40||
english: Kabeer's Lord and Master is the Cherisher of the poor. ||4||40||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਥਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸੂਤਕ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jal hai sootak thal hai sootak sootak opat hoee ||
english: There is pollution in the water, and pollution on the land; whatever is born is polluted.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੇ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਮੂਏ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸੂਤਕ ਪਰਜ ਬਿਗੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janame sootak mooe phun sootak sootak paraj bigoee ||1||
english: There is pollution in birth, and more pollution in death; all beings are ruined by pollution. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡੀਆ ਕਉਨ ਪਵੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu re pa(n)deeaa kaun paveetaa ||
english: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar: who is clean and pure?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aisaa giaan japahu mere meetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditate on such spiritual wisdom, O my friend. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਬੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: nainahu sootak bainahu sootak sootak sravanee hoee ||
english: There is pollution in the eyes, and pollution in speech; there is pollution in the ears as well.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਪਰੈ ਰਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: oothat baithat sootak laagai sootak parai rasoee ||2||
english: Standing up and sitting down, one is polluted; one's kitchen is polluted as well. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਫਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੈ ਛੂਟਨ ਕੀ ਇਕੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: phaasan kee bidh sabh kooo jaanai chhootan kee ik koee ||
english: Everyone knows how to be caught, but hardly anyone knows how to escape.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥੪੧॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer raam ridai bichaarai sootak tinai na hoee ||3||41||
english: Says Kabeer, those who meditate on the Lord within their hearts, are not polluted. ||3||41||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਝਗਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਹੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jhagaraa ek niberahu raam ||
english: Resolve this one conflict for me, O Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਸੌ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jau tum apane jan sau kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: if you require any work from Your humble servant. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਜਾ ਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ihu man badaa k jaa sau man maaniaa ||
english: Is this mind greater, or the One to whom the mind is attuned?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਬਡਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam badaa kai raamahi jaaniaa ||1||
english: Is the Lord greater, or one who knows the Lord? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਜਾਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa badaa k jaas upaaiaa ||
english: Is Brahma greater, or the One who created Him?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦੁ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਜਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bed badaa k jahaa(n) te aaiaa ||2||
english: Are the Vedas greater, or the One from which they came? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਉ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer hau bhaiaa udaas ||
english: Says Kabeer, I have become depressed;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੩॥੪੨॥
transliteration: teerath badaa k har kaa daas ||3||42||
english: is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage greater, or the slave of the Lord? ||3||42||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee chetee ||
english: Raag Gauree Chaytee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੌ ਭਾਈ ਗੵਾਨ ਕੀ ਆਈ ਆਂਧੀ ॥
transliteration: dekhau bhaaee gyaan kee aaee aa(n)dhee ||
english: Behold, O Siblings of Destiny, the storm of spiritual wisdom has come.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭੈ ਉਡਾਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਟਾਟੀ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਾਂਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabhai udaanee bhram kee taatee rahai na maaiaa baa(n)dhee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It has totally blown away the thatched huts of doubt, and torn apart the bonds of Maya. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਚਿਤੇ ਕੀ ਦੁਇ ਥੂਨਿ ਗਿਰਾਨੀ ਮੋਹ ਬਲੇਡਾ ਟੂਟਾ ॥
transliteration: duchite kee dui thoon giraanee moh baledaa tootaa ||
english: The two pillars of double-mindedness have fallen, and the beams of emotional attachment have come crashing down.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਛਾਨਿ ਪਰੀ ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਫੂਟਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tisanaa chhaan paree dhar oopar duramat bhaa(n)daa phootaa ||1||
english: The thatched roof of greed has caved in, and the pitcher of evil-mindedness has been broken. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਂਧੀ ਪਾਛੇ ਜੋ ਜਲੁ ਬਰਖੈ ਤਿਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਭੀਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: aa(n)dhee paachhe jo jal barakhai tihi teraa jan bheenaa(n) ||
english: Your servant is drenched with the rain that has fallen in this storm.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਉਦੈ ਭਾਨੁ ਜਬ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੨॥੪੩॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer man bhaiaa pragaasaa udai bhaan jab cheenaa ||2||43||
english: Says Kabeer, my mind became enlightened, when I saw the sun rise. ||2||43||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee chetee ||
english: Gauree Chaytee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: har jas sunahi na har gun gaavahi ||
english: They do not listen to the Lord's Praises, and they do not sing the Lord's Glories,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਤਨ ਹੀ ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ਗਿਰਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baatan hee asamaan giraavahi ||1||
english: but they try to bring down the sky with their talk. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਲੋਗਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: aise logan siu kiaa kaheeai ||
english: What can anyone say to such people?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਏ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਜ ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਡਰਾਨੇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo prabh keee bhagat te baahaj tin te sadaa daraane raheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You should always be careful around those whom God has excluded from His devotional worship. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਦੇਹਿ ਚੁਰੂ ਭਰਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: aap na dehi churoo bhar paanee ||
english: They do not offer even a handful of water,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਨਿੰਦਹਿ ਜਿਹ ਗੰਗਾ ਆਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tih ni(n)dahi jih ga(n)gaa aanee ||2||
english: while they slander the one who brought forth the Ganges. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੈਠਤ ਉਠਤ ਕੁਟਿਲਤਾ ਚਾਲਹਿ ॥
transliteration: baithat uthat kutilataa chaalahi ||
english: Sitting down or standing up, their ways are crooked and evil.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਏ ਅਉਰਨ ਹੂ ਘਾਲਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap gae auran hoo ghaalahi ||3||
english: They ruin themselves, and then they ruin others. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਕੁਚਰਚਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
transliteration: chhaad kucharachaa aan na jaanahi ||
english: They know nothing except evil talk.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਹੂ ਕੋ ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: brahamaa hoo ko kahio na maanahi ||4||
english: They would not even obey Brahma's orders. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਏ ਅਉਰਨ ਹੂ ਖੋਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aap gae auran hoo khovahi ||
english: They themselves are lost, and they mislead others as well.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮੈ ਸੋਵਹਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aag lagaai ma(n)dar mai sovahi ||5||
english: They set their own temple on fire, and then they fall asleep within it. ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਨ ਹਸਤ ਆਪ ਹਹਿ ਕਾਂਨੇ ॥
transliteration: avaran hasat aap hahi kaa(n)ne ||
english: They laugh at others, while they themselves are one-eyed.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਲਜਾਨੇ ॥੬॥੧॥੪੪॥
transliteration: tin kau dekh kabeer lajaane ||6||1||44||
english: Seeing them, Kabeer is embarrassed. ||6||1||44||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ₁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee bairaagani₁ kabeer jee ||
english: Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਪਿਤਰ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ ਮੂਏਂ ਸਿਰਾਧ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jeevat pitar na maanai kooo mooe(n) siraadh karaahee ||
english: He does not honor his ancestors while they are alive, but he holds feasts in their honor after they have died.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਰ ਭੀ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਊਆ ਕੂਕਰ ਖਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pitar bhee bapure kahu kiu paavahi kaooaa kookar khaahee ||1||
english: Tell me, how can his poor ancestors receive what the crows and the dogs have eaten up? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: mo kau kusal bataavahu koee ||
english: If only someone would tell me what real happiness is!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੁਸਲੁ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kusal kusal karate jag binasai kusal bhee kaise hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Speaking of happiness and joy, the world is perishing. How can happiness be found? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਕੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: maatee ke kar devee devaa tis aagai jeeu dehee ||
english: Making gods and goddesses out of clay, people sacrifice living beings to them.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਪਿਤਰ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਆਪਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aise pitar tumaare kaheeahi aapan kahiaa na lehee ||2||
english: Such are your dead ancestors, who cannot ask for what they want. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਰਜੀਉ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਨਿਰਜੀਉ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਕਉ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sarajeeu kaatahi nirajeeu poojahi a(n)t kaal kau bhaaree ||
english: You murder living beings and worship lifeless things; at your very last moment, you shall suffer in terrible pain.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਭੈ ਡੂਬੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam naam kee gat nahee jaanee bhai doobe sa(n)saaree ||3||
english: You do not know the value of the Lord's Name; you shall drown in the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: devee devaa poojahi dolahi paarabraham nahee jaanaa ||
english: You worship gods and goddesses, but you do not know the Supreme Lord God.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੫॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer akul nahee chetiaa bikhiaa siu lapataanaa ||4||1||45||
english: Says Kabeer, you have not remembered the Lord who has no ancestors; you are clinging to your corrupt ways. ||4||1||45||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਮਰੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਐਸੇ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jeevat marai marai phun jeevai aise su(n)n samaaiaa ||
english: One who remains dead while yet alive, will live even after death; thus he merges into the Primal Void of the Absolute Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan raheeai bahuR na bhavajal paaiaa ||1||
english: Remaining pure in the midst of impurity, he will never again fall into the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਐਸਾ ਖੀਰੁ ਬਿਲੋਈਐ ॥
transliteration: mere raam aisaa kheer biloeeai ||
english: O my Lord, this is the milk to be churned.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਓਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramat manooaa asathir raakhahu in bidh a(n)mrit peeoeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, hold your mind steady and stable, and in this way, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਾਣਿ ਬਜਰ ਕਲ ਛੇਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਪਦੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kai baan bajar kal chhedee pragatiaa pad paragaasaa ||
english: The Guru's arrow has pierced the hard core of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, and the state of enlightenment has dawned.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਕਤਿ ਅਧੇਰ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sakat adher jevaRee bhram chookaa nihachal siv ghar baasaa ||2||
english: In the darkness of Maya, I mistook the rope for the snake, but that is over, and now I dwell in the eternal home of the Lord. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੈ ਧਨਖੁ ਚਢਾਈਐ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tin bin baanai dhanakh chadhaaeeai ihu jag bedhiaa bhaaee ||
english: Maya has drawn her bow without an arrow, and has pierced this world, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬੂਡੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਵੈ ਡੋਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dah dis boodee pavan jhulaavai dor rahee liv laaee ||3||
english: The drowning person is blown around in the ten directions by the wind, but I hold tight to the string of the Lord's Love. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਨਮਨਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: unaman manooaa su(n)n samaanaa dubidhaa duramat bhaagee ||
english: The disturbed mind has been absorbed in the Lord; duality and evil-mindedness have run away.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਨਭਉ ਇਕੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੬॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer anabhau ik dekhiaa raam naam liv laagee ||4||2||46||
english: Says Kabeer, I have seen the One Lord, the Fearless One; I am attuned to the Name of the Lord. ||4||2||46||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਤਿਪਦੇ₃ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan tipade₃ ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, Thi-Padhay:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਲਟਤ ਪਵਨ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਖਟੁ ਭੇਦੇ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: ulatat pavan chakr khat bhede surat su(n)n anaraagee ||
english: I turned my breath inwards, and pierced through the six chakras of the body, and my awareness was centered on the Primal Void of the Absolute Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾਸੁ ਖੋਜੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aavai na jaai marai na jeevai taas khoj bairaagee ||1||
english: Search for the One who does not come or go, who does not die and is not born, O renunciate. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਉਲਟਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man man hee ulat samaanaa ||
english: My mind has turned away from the world, and is absorbed in the Mind of God.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਕਲਿ ਭਈ ਅਵਰੈ ਨਾਤਰੁ ਥਾ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad akal bhaee avarai naatar thaa begaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, my understanding has been changed; otherwise, I was totally ignorant. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਵਰੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: nivarai door door phun nivarai jin jaisaa kar maaniaa ||
english: That which was near has become distant, and again, that which was distant is near, for those who realize the Lord as He is.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਲਉਤੀ ਕਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਇਆ ਬਰੇਡਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: alautee kaa jaise bhaiaa baredaa jin peeaa tin jaaniaa ||2||
english: It is like the sugar water made from the candy; only one who drinks it knows its taste. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਥਾ ਕਾਇ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ॥
transliteration: teree niragun kathaa kaai siu kaheeai aisaa koi bibekee ||
english: Unto whom should I speak Your speech, O Lord; it is beyond the three qualities. Is there anyone with such discerning wisdom?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਪਲੀਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਝਲ ਦੇਖੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੪੭॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer jin deeaa paleetaa tin taisee jhal dekhee ||3||3||47||
english: Says Kabeer, as is the fuse which you apply, so is the flash you will see. ||3||3||47||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਪਾਵਸ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਧੂਪ ਨਹੀ ਛਹੀਆ ਤਹ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: tah paavas si(n)dh dhoop nahee chhaheeaa tah utapat paralau naahee ||
english: There is no rainy season, ocean, sunshine or shade, no creation or destruction there.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਦੋਊ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeevan mirat na dukh sukh biaapai su(n)n samaadh dooo tah naahee ||1||
english: No life or death, no pain or pleasure is felt there. There is only the Primal Trance of Samaadhi, and no duality. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaj kee akath kathaa hai niraaree ||
english: The description of the state of intuitive poise is indescribable and sublime.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਚਢੈ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਮੁਕਾਤੀ ਹਲੁਕੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tul nahee chadhai jaai na mukaatee halukee lagai na bhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It is not measured, and it is not exhausted. It is neither light nor heavy. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਦੋਊ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: aradh uradh dooo tah naahee raat dinas tah naahee ||
english: Neither lower nor upper worlds are there; neither day nor night are there.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਹਾ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jal nahee pavan paavak phun naahee satigur tahaa samaahee ||2||
english: There is no water, wind or fire; there, the True Guru is contained. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar rahai nira(n)tar gur kirapaa te laheeai ||
english: The Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord dwells there within Himself; by Guru's Grace, He is found.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੩॥੪॥੪੮॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer bal jaau gur apune satasa(n)gat mil raheeai ||3||4||48||
english: Says Kabeer, I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I remain in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||4||48||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₂ ॥
transliteration: gauRee₂ ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਬੈਲ ਬਿਸਾਹੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਓ ॥
transliteration: paap pu(n)n dui bail bisaahe pavan poojee paragaasio ||
english: With both sin and virtue, the ox of the body is purchased; the air of the breath is the capital which has appeared.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਗੂਣਿ ਭਰੀ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਟਾਂਡ ਬਿਸਾਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: trisanaa goon bharee ghat bheetar in bidh taa(n)d bisaahio ||1||
english: The bag on its back is filled with desire; this is how we purchase the herd. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aisaa naaik raam hamaaraa ||
english: My Lord is such a wealthy merchant!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਬਨਜਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal sa(n)saar keeo banajaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He has made the whole world his peddler. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਭਏ ਜਗਾਤੀ ਮਨ ਤਰੰਗ ਬਟਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh dui bhae jagaatee man tara(n)g batavaaraa ||
english: Sexual desire and anger are the tax-collectors, and the waves of the mind are the highway robbers.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਹਿ ਟਾਂਡਾ ਉਤਰਿਓ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch tat mil daan niberahi taa(n)daa utario paaraa ||2||
english: The five elements join together and divide up their loot. This is how our herd is disposed of! ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅਬ ਐਸੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu ab aisee ban aaee ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: This is the state of affairs now!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਾਟੀ ਚਢਤ ਬੈਲੁ ਇਕੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਚਲੋ ਗੋਨਿ ਛਿਟਕਾਈ ॥੩॥੫॥੪੯॥
transliteration: ghaatee chadhat bail ik thaakaa chalo gon chhitakaaee ||3||5||49||
english: Going uphill, the ox has grown weary; throwing off his load, he continues on his journey. ||3||5||49||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ₃ ॥
transliteration: gauRee pa(n)chapadaa₃ ||
english: Gauree, Panch-Padhay:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: pevakaRai din chaar hai saahuraRai jaanaa ||
english: For a few short days, the soul-bride stays in her parent's house; then, she must go to her in-laws.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਏਆਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)dhaa lok na jaanaee moorakh eaanaa ||1||
english: The blind, foolish and ignorant people do not know this. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਡਡੀਆ ਬਾਧੈ ਧਨ ਖੜੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu dadeeaa baadhai dhan khaRee ||
english: Tell me, why is the bride wearing her ordinary clothes?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਹੂ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਮੁਕਲਾਊ ਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paahoo ghar aae mukalaaoo aae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The guests have arrived at her home, and her Husband has come to take her away. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਜਿ ਦਿਸੈ ਖੂਹੜੀ ਕਉਨ ਲਾਜੁ ਵਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: oh j disai khoohaRee kaun laaj vahaaree ||
english: Who has lowered the rope of the breath down, into the well of the world which we see?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਾਜੁ ਘੜੀ ਸਿਉ ਤੂਟਿ ਪੜੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: laaj ghaRee siu toot paRee uth chalee panihaaree ||2||
english: The rope of the breath breaks away from the pitcher of the body, and the water-carrier gets up and departs. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saahib hoi daiaal kripaa kare apunaa kaaraj savaare ||
english: When the Lord and Master is kind and grants His Grace, then her affairs are all resolved.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa sohaagan jaaneeai gurasabad beechaare ||3||
english: Then she is known as the happy soul-bride, if she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kirat kee baa(n)dhee sabh phirai dekhahu beechaaree ||
english: Bound by the actions she has committed, she wanders around - see this and understand.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਆ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: es no kiaa aakheeai kiaa kare vichaaree ||4||
english: What can we say to her? What can the poor soul-bride do? ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਚਿਤ ਬੰਧਿ ਨ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaee niraasee uth chalee chit ba(n)dh na dheeraa ||
english: Disappointed and hopeless, she gets up and departs. There is no support or encouragement in her consciousness.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਭਜੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥੫੦॥
transliteration: har kee charanee laag rahu bhaj saran kabeeraa ||5||6||50||
english: So remain attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet, and hurry to His Sanctuary, Kabeer! ||5||6||50||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₂ ॥
transliteration: gauRee₂ ||
english: Gauree :

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹਹਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਭਲ ਮੀਠਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jogee kahahi jog bhal meethaa avar na doojaa bhaaee ||
english: The Yogi says that Yoga is good and sweet, and nothing else is, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੁੰਡਿਤ ਮੁੰਡਿਤ ਏਕੈ ਸਬਦੀ ਏਇ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ru(n)dit mu(n)dit ekai sabadee ei kahahi sidh paaee ||1||
english: Those who shave their heads, and those who amputate their limbs, and those who utter only a single word, all say that they have attained the spiritual perfection of the Siddhas. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਅੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: har bin bharam bhulaane a(n)dhaa ||
english: Without the Lord, the blind ones are deluded by doubt.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਉ ਆਪੁ ਛੁਟਕਾਵਨਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਬਹੁ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa pahi jaau aap chhutakaavan te baadhe bahu pha(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: And those, to whom I go to find release - they themselves are bound by all sorts of chains. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jah te upajee tahee samaanee ih bidh bisaree tab hee ||
english: The soul is re-absorbed into that from which it originated, when one leaves this path of errors.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਗੁਣੀ ਸੂਰ ਹਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਏਹਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਬਡ ਹਮ ਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit gunee soor ham daate ehi kahahi bad ham hee ||2||
english: The scholarly Pandits, the virtuous, the brave and the generous, all assert that they alone are great. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jisahi bujhaae soee boojhai bin boojhe kiu raheeai ||
english: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. Without understanding, what can anyone do?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur milai a(n)dheraa chookai in bidh maanak laheeai ||3||
english: Meeting the True Guru, the darkness is dispelled, and in this way, the jewel is obtained. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਬਾਵੇ ਦਾਹਨੇ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: taj baave daahane bikaaraa har pad driR kar raheeai ||
english: Give up the evil actions of your left and right hands, and grasp hold of the Feet of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੂੰਗੈ ਗੁੜੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਪੂਛੇ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੧॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer goo(n)gai guR khaaiaa poochhe te kiaa kaheeai ||4||7||51||
english: Says Kabeer, the mute has tasted the molasses, but what can he say about it if he is asked? ||4||7||51||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ₁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee poorabee₁ kabeer jee ||
english: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਕਛੁ ਅਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jah kachh ahaa tahaa kichh naahee pa(n)ch tat tah naahee ||
english: Where something existed, now there is nothing. The five elements are no longer there.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਬੰਦੇ ਏ ਅਵਗਨ ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: iRaa pi(n)gulaa sukhaman ba(n)de e avagan kat jaahee ||1||
english: The Ida, the Pingala and the Sushmanaa - O human being, how can the breaths through these be counted now? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾਗਾ ਤੂਟਾ ਗਗਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਬੋਲਤੁ ਕਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: taagaa tootaa gagan binas gaiaa teraa bolat kahaa samaaee ||
english: The string has been broken, and the Sky of the Tenth Gate has been destroyed. Where has your speech gone?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਸੰਸਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: eh sa(n)saa mo kau anadin biaapai mo kau ko na kahai samajhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This cynicism afflicts me, night and day; who can explain this to me and help me understand? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਬਰਭੰਡੁ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਚਨਹਾਰੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jah barabha(n)d pi(n)d tah naahee rachanahaar tah naahee ||
english: Where the world is - the body is not there; the mind is not there either.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋੜਨਹਾਰੋ ਸਦਾ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਇਹ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: joRanahaaro sadaa ateetaa ih kaheeai kis maahee ||2||
english: The Joiner is forever unattached; now, within whom is the soul said to be contained? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋੜੀ ਜੁੜੈ ਨ ਤੋੜੀ ਤੂਟੈ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: joRee juRai na toRee tootai jab lag hoi binaasee ||
english: By joining the elements, people cannot join them, and by breaking, they cannot be broken, until the body perishes.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੈ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaa ko thaakur kaa ko sevak ko kaahoo kai jaasee ||3||
english: Of whom is the soul the master, and of whom is it the servant? Where, and to whom does it go? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ ਜਹਾ ਬਸੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer liv laag rahee hai jahaa base din raatee ||
english: Says Kabeer, I have lovingly focused my attention on that place where the Lord dwells, day and night.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਓਹੁ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੫੨॥
transliteration: uaa kaa maram ohee par jaanai ohu tau sadaa abinaasee ||4||1||52||
english: Only He Himself truly knows the secrets of His mystery; He is eternal and indestructible. ||4||1||52||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਕੰਨੀ ਮੁੰਦਾ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਖਿੰਥਾ ॥
transliteration: surat simrit dui ka(n)nee mu(n)daa paramit baahar khi(n)thaa ||
english: Let contemplation and intuitive meditation be your two ear-rings, and true wisdom your patched overcoat.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਕਲਪ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ ਪੰਥਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: su(n)n guphaa mahi aasan baisan kalap bibarajit pa(n)thaa ||1||
english: In the cave of silence, dwell in your Yogic posture; let the subjugation of desire be your spiritual path. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਜਨ ਮੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: mere raajan mai bairaagee jogee ||
english: O my King, I am a Yogi, a hermit, a renunciate.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਤ ਨ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਓਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: marat na sog biogee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I do not die or suffer pain or separation. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਟੂਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਸਮਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)d brahama(n)d mahi si(n)ngee meraa batooaa sabh jag bhasamaadhaaree ||
english: The solar systems and galaxies are my horn; the whole world is the bag to carry my ashes.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਲੁ ਪਲਟੀਐ ਛੂਟੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taaRee laagee tripal palateeai chhootai hoi pasaaree ||2||
english: Eliminating the three qualities and finding release from this world is my deep meditation. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਪਵਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਤੂੰਬਾ ਕਰੀ ਹੈ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗ ਸਾਰਦ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
transliteration: man pavan dui too(n)baa karee hai jug jug saarad saajee ||
english: My mind and breath are the two gourds of my fiddle, and the Lord of all the ages is its frame.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਭਈ ਤੰਤੀ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨਹਦ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: thir bhaee ta(n)tee tootas naahee anahad ki(n)guree baajee ||3||
english: The string has become steady, and it does not break; this guitar vibrates with the unstruck melody. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: sun man magan bhae hai poore maaiaa dol na laagee ||
english: Hearing it, the mind is enraptured and becomes perfect; it does not waver, and it is not affected by Maya.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਖੇਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੩॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer taa kau punarap janam nahee khel gaio bairaagee ||4||2||53||
english: Says Kabeer, the bairaagee, the renunciate, who has played such a game, is not reincarnated again into the world of form and substance. ||4||2||53||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਜ ਨਵ ਗਜ ਦਸ ਗਜ ਇਕੀਸ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਤਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gaj nav gaj das gaj ikees pureeaa ek tanaaee ||
english: Nine yards, ten yards, and twenty-one yards - weave these into the full piece of cloth;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਠ ਸੂਤ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਬਹਤਰਿ ਪਾਟੁ ਲਗੋ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saath soot nav kha(n)d bahatar paat lago adhikaaee ||1||
english: take the sixty threads and add nine joints to the seventy-two on the loom. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਈ ਬੁਨਾਵਨ ਮਾਹੋ ॥
transliteration: gaee bunaavan maaho ||
english: Life weaves itself into its patterns.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਛੋਡਿਐ ਜਾਇ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ghar chhodiai jaai julaaho ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Leaving her home, the soul goes to the world of the weaver. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਜੀ ਨ ਮਿਨੀਐ ਤੋਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਪਾਚਨੁ ਸੇਰ ਅਢਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gajee na mineeai tol na tuleeai paachan ser adhaaee ||
english: This cloth cannot be measured in yards or weighed with weights; its food is two and a half measures.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੌ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਚਨੁ ਬੇਗਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਝਗਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਘਰਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jau kar paachan beg na paavai jhagar karai gharahaaee ||2||
english: If it does not obtain food right away, it quarrels with the master of the house. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਕੀ ਬੈਠ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਸ ਇਹ ਬੇਲਾ ਕਤ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: din kee baith khasam kee barakas ih belaa kat aaee ||
english: How many days will you sit here, in opposition to your Lord and Master? When will this opportunity come again?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛੂਟੇ ਕੂੰਡੇ ਭੀਗੈ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਚਲਿਓ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ਰੀਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chhoote koo(n)de bheegai pureeaa chalio julaaho reesaaee ||3||
english: Leaving his pots and pans, and the bobbins wet with his tears, the weaver soul departs in jealous anger. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛੋਛੀ ਨਲੀ ਤੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਨਤਰ ਰਹੀ ਉਰਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: chhochhee nalee ta(n)t nahee nikasai natar rahee urajhaaee ||
english: The wind-pipe is empty now; the thread of the breath does not come out any longer. The thread is tangled; it has run out.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਪਸਾਰੁ ਈਹਾ ਰਹੁ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੪॥
transliteration: chhod pasaar eehaa rahu bapuree kahu kabeer samajhaaee ||4||3||54||
english: So renounce the world of form and substance while you remain here, O poor soul; says Kabeer: you must understand this! ||4||3||54||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਮਿਲੀ ਕਿੰਬਾ ਹੋਇ ਮਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ek jot ekaa milee ki(n)baa hoi mahoi ||
english: When one light merges into another, what becomes of it then?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jit ghat naam na oopajai phoot marai jan soi ||1||
english: That person, within whose heart the Lord's Name does not well up - may that person burst and die! ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਲ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥
transliteration: saaval su(n)dar raamaeeaa ||
english: O my dark and beautiful Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: meraa man laagaa tohi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: my mind is attached to You. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿ ਏਹੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਿ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: saadh milai sidh paaeeai k ehu jog k bhog ||
english: Meeting with the Holy, the perfection of the Siddhas is obtained. What good is Yoga or indulgence in pleasures?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: duhu mil kaaraj oopajai raam naam sa(n)jog ||2||
english: When the two meet together, the business is conducted, and the link with the Lord's Name is established. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੋਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਇਹੁ ਗੀਤੁ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਤਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: log jaanai ihu geet hai ihu tau braham beechaar ||
english: People believe that this is just a song, but it is a meditation on God.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਾਸੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਨਸ ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu kaasee upades hoi maanas maratee baar ||3||
english: It is like the instructions given to the dying man at Benares. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: koee gaavai ko sunai har naamaa chit laai ||
english: Whoever sings or listens to the Lord's Name with conscious awareness

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਸਾ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥੫੫॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer sa(n)saa nahee a(n)t param gat paai ||4||1||4||55||
english: - says Kabeer, without a doubt, in the end, he obtains the highest status. ||4||1||4||55||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਤੇ ਡੂਬੇ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jete jatan karat te doobe bhav saagar nahee taario re ||
english: Those who try to do things by their own efforts are drowned in the terrifying world-ocean; they cannot cross over.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karam dharam karate bahu sa(n)jam aha(n)budh man jaario re ||1||
english: Those who practice religious rituals and strict self-discipline - their egotistical pride shall consume their minds. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ਕੋ ਦਾਤੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saas graas ko daato thaakur so kiu manahu bisaario re ||
english: Your Lord and Master has given you the breath of life and food to sustain you; Oh, why have you forgotten Him?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੀਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: heeraa laal amol janam hai kaudee badalai haario re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Human birth is a priceless jewel, which has been squandered in exchange for a worthless shell. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਭੂਖ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa trikhaa bhookh bhram laagee hiradai naahi beechaario re ||
english: The thirst of desire and the hunger of doubt afflict you; you do not contemplate the Lord in your heart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਨਮਤ ਮਾਨ ਹਿਰਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: unamat maan hirio man maahee gur kaa sabad na dhaario re ||2||
english: Intoxicated with pride, you cheat yourself; you have not enshrined the Word of the Guru's Shabad within your mind. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਦ ਲੁਭਤ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਓ ਮਦ ਰਸ ਲੈਤ ਬਿਕਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: suaad lubhat i(n)dree ras prerio mad ras lait bikaario re ||
english: Those who are deluded by sensual pleasures, who are tempted by sexual delights and enjoy wine are corrupt.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਭਾਗ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਗਾਨੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karam bhaag sa(n)tan sa(n)gaane kaasat loh udhaario re ||3||
english: But those who, through destiny and good karma, join the Society of the Saints, float over the ocean, like iron attached to wood. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਅਬ ਦੁਖ ਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat jon janam bhram thaake ab dukh kar ham haario re ||
english: I have wandered in doubt and confusion, through birth and reincarnation; now, I am so tired. I am suffering in pain and wasting away.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥੫੬॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer gur milat mahaa ras prem bhagat nisataario re ||4||1||5||56||
english: Says Kabeer, meeting with the Guru, I have obtained supreme joy; my love and devotion have saved me. ||4||1||5||56||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲਬੂਤ ਕੀ ਹਸਤਨੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਚਲਤੁ ਰਚਿਓ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
transliteration: kaalaboot kee hasatanee man bauraa re chalat rachio jagadees ||
english: Like the straw figure of a female elephant, fashioned to trap the bull elephant, O crazy mind, the Lord of the Universe has staged the drama of this world.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਸੁਆਇ ਗਜ ਬਸਿ ਪਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਹਿਓ ਸੀਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaam suaai gaj bas pare man bauraa re a(n)kas sahio sees ||1||
english: Attracted by the lure of sexual desire, the elephant is captured, O crazy mind, and now the halter is placed around its neck. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਾਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਚੁ ਸਮਝੁ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bikhai baach har raach samajh man bauraa re ||
english: So escape from corruption and immerse yourself in the Lord; take this advice, O crazy mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਰਾਮ ਜਹਾਜੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nirabhai hoi na har bhaje man bauraa re gahio na raam jahaaj ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You have not meditated fearlessly on the Lord, O crazy mind; you have not embarked upon the Lord's Boat. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਕਟ ਮੁਸਟੀ ਅਨਾਜ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਲੀਨੀ ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: marakat musatee anaaj kee man bauraa re leenee haath pasaar ||
english: The monkey stretches out its hand, O crazy mind, and takes a handful of corn;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛੂਟਨ ਕੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਪਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਨਾਚਿਓ ਘਰ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chhootan ko sahasaa pariaa man bauraa re naachio ghar ghar baar ||2||
english: now unable to escape, O crazy mind, it is made to dance door to door. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਨਲਨੀ ਸੂਅਟਾ ਗਹਿਓ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਮਾਯਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu nalanee sooataa gahio man bauraa re maayaa ihu biuhaar ||
english: Like the parrot caught in the trap, O crazy mind, you trapped by the affairs of Maya.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਤਿਉ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaisaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kaa man bauraa re tiu pasario paasaar ||3||
english: Like the weak dye of the safflower, O crazy mind, so is the expanse of this world of form and substance. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਨ ਕਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਘਨੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਪੂਜਨ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: naavan kau teerath ghane man bauraa re poojan kau bahu dev ||
english: There are so many holy shrines in which to bathe, O crazy mind, and so many gods to worship.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥੫੭॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer chhootan nahee man bauraa re chhootan har kee sev ||4||1||6||57||
english: Says Kabeer, you shall not be saved like this, O crazy mind; only by serving the Lord will you find release. ||4||1||6||57||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਦਹੈ ਪਵਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਗਨੈ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਨੇਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: agan na dahai pavan nahee maganai tasakar ner na aavai ||
english: Fire does not burn it, and the wind does not blow it away; thieves cannot get near it.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਚਉਨੀ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam dhan kar sa(n)chaunee so dhan kat hee na jaavai ||1||
english: Accumulate the wealth of the Lord's Name; that wealth does not go anywhere. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਧਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਇਹੈ ਸਾਰ ਧਨੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: hamaraa dhan maadhau gobi(n)d dharaneedhar ihai saar dhan kaheeai ||
english: My wealth is God, the Lord of Wealth, the Lord of the Universe, the Support of the earth: this is called the most excellent wealth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਰਾਜਿ ਨ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo sukh prabh gobi(n)d kee sevaa so sukh raaj na laheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The peace which is obtained by serving God, the Lord of the Universe - that peace cannot be found in kingdoms or power. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: is dhan kaaran siv sanakaadik khojat bhae udaasee ||
english: Shiva and Sanak, in their search for this wealth, became Udaasees, and renounced the world.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man muka(n)d jihabaa naaraain parai na jam kee phaasee ||2||
english: One whose mind is filled with the Lord of liberation, and whose tongue chants the Name of the Lord, shall not be caught by the noose of Death. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਧਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਤਾਸੁ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: nij dhan giaan bhagat gur deenee taas sumat man laagaa ||
english: My own wealth is the spiritual wisdom and devotion given by the Guru; my mind is held steady in perfect neutral balance.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਲਤ ਅੰਭ ਥੰਭਿ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤ ਭਰਮ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jalat a(n)bh tha(n)bh man dhaavat bharam ba(n)dhan bhau bhaagaa ||3||
english: It is like water for the burning soul, like an anchoring support for the wandering mind; the bondage of doubt and fear is dispelled. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਮਦਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kahai kabeer madan ke maate hiradai dekh beechaaree ||
english: Says Kabeer: O you who are intoxicated with sexual desire, reflect upon this in your heart, and see.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਹਸਤੀ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੫੮॥
transliteration: tum ghar laakh kot asv hasatee ham ghar ek muraaree ||4||1||7||58||
english: Within your home there are hundreds of thousands, millions of horses and elephants; but within my home is the One Lord. ||4||1||7||58||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਪਿ ਕੇ ਕਰ ਮੁਸਟਿ ਚਨਨ ਕੀ ਲੁਬਧਿ ਨ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
transliteration: jiu kap ke kar musat chanan kee lubadh na tiaag daio ||
english: Like the monkey with a handful of grain, who will not let go because of greed

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਲਾਲਚ ਸਿਉ ਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਹਿ ਪਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo jo karam keee laalach siu te phir garahi pario ||1||
english: - just so, all the deeds committed in greed ultimately become a noose around one's neck. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਓ ॥
transliteration: bhagat bin birathe janam gaio ||
english: Without devotional worship, human life passes away in vain.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat bhagavaan bhajan bin kahee na sach rahio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, without vibrating and meditating on the Lord God, one does not abide in Truth. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਕੁਸਮ ਪਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਨ ਘ੍ਰਾਉ ਲਇਓ ॥
transliteration: jiu udiaan kusam paraphulit kinahi na ghraau laio ||
english: Like the flower which blossoms in the wilderness with no one to enjoy its fragrance,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲ ਹਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taise bhramat anek jon mahi phir phir kaal haio ||2||
english: so do people wander in reincarnation; over and over again, they are destroyed by Death. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਜੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
transliteration: iaa dhan joban ar sut daaraa pekhan kau j daio ||
english: This wealth, youth, children and spouse which the Lord has given you - this is all just a passing show.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਟਕਿ ਜੋ ਉਰਝੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿ ਲਇਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tin hee maahi atak jo urajhe i(n)dree prer laio ||3||
english: Those who are caught and entangled in these are carried away by sensual desire. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਉਧ ਅਨਲ ਤਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸ ਠਾਟੁ ਠਇਓ ॥
transliteration: audh anal tan tin ko ma(n)dar chahu dis thaat thaio ||
english: Age is the fire, and the body is the house of straw; on all four sides, this play is being played out.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰਨ ਕਉ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਟ ਲਇਓ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥੫੯॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer bhai saagar taran kau mai satigur ot laio ||4||1||8||59||
english: Says Kabeer, to cross over the terriffying world-ocean, I have taken to the Shelter of the True Guru. ||4||1||8||59||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₈ ॥
transliteration: gauRee₈ ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਨੀ ਮੈਲਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਗੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: paanee mailaa maatee goree ||
english: The water of the sperm is cloudy, and the egg of the ovary is crimson.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: is maatee kee putaree joree ||1||
english: From this clay, the puppet is fashioned. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਆਹਿ ਨ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mai naahee kachh aahi na moraa ||
english: I am nothing, and nothing is mine.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਸੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਤੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan dhan sabh ras gobi(n)d toraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This body, wealth, and all delicacies are Yours, O Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਮਾਟੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: is maatee mahi pavan samaaiaa ||
english: Into this clay, the breath is infused.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਜੋਰਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jhoothaa parapa(n)ch jor chalaaiaa ||2||
english: By Your Power, You have set this false contrivance in motion. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੂ ਲਾਖ ਪਾਂਚ ਕੀ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kinahoo laakh paa(n)ch kee joree ||
english: Some collect hundreds of thousands of dollars,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਗਗਰੀਆ ਫੋਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)t kee baar gagareeaa phoree ||3||
english: but in the end, the pitcher of the body bursts. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਨੀਵ ਉਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer ik neev usaaree ||
english: Says Kabeer, that single foundation which you have laid

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੯॥੬੦॥
transliteration: khin mahi binas jaai aha(n)kaaree ||4||1||9||60||
english: will be destroyed in an instant - you are so egotistical. ||4||1||9||60||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਉ ਜੀਅ ਐਸੇ ਐਸੇ ॥
transliteration: raam japau jee aise aise ||
english: Just as Dhroo and Prahlaad meditated on the Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਜੈਸੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhroo prahilaad japio har jaise ||1||
english: So should you meditate on the Lord, O my soul. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਰੋਸੇ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal bharose tere ||
english: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, I have placed my faith in You;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ਬੇੜੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh paravaar chaRaaiaa beRe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: along with all my family, I have come aboard Your boat. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai taa hukam manaavai ||
english: When it is pleasing to Him, then He inspires us to obey the Hukam of His Command.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਬੇੜੇ ਕਉ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: is beRe kau paar laghaavai ||2||
english: He causes this boat to cross over. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਐਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad aisee budh samaanee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, such understanding is infused into me;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੂਕਿ ਗਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chook gaee phir aavan jaanee ||3||
english: my comings and goings in reincarnation have ended. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਜੁ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer bhaj saarigapaanee ||
english: Says Kabeer, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਸਭ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੦॥੬੧॥
transliteration: uravaar paar sabh eko daanee ||4||2||10||61||
english: In this world, in the world beyond and everywhere, He alone is the Giver. ||4||2||10||61||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ੯ ॥
transliteration: gauRee 9 ||
english: Gauree 9:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਨਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਜਉ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: jon chhaad jau jag mahi aaio ||
english: He leaves the womb, and comes into the world;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਾਗਤ ਪਵਨ ਖਸਮੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: laagat pavan khasam bisaraaio ||1||
english: as soon as the air touches him, he forgets his Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨਾ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jeearaa har ke gunaa gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O my soul, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: garabh jon mahi uradh tap karataa ||
english: You were upside-down, living in the womb; you generated the intense meditative heat of 'tapas'.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਜਠਰ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tau jathar agan mahi rahataa ||2||
english: Then, you escaped the fire of the belly. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jon bhram aaio ||
english: After wandering through 8.4 million incarnations, you came.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕੇ ਛੁਟਕੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ab ke chhutake thaur na thaaio ||3||
english: If you stumble and fall now, you shall find no home or place of rest. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਜੁ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer bhaj saarigapaanee ||
english: Says Kabeer, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
transliteration: aavat deesai jaat na jaanee ||4||1||11||62||
english: He is not seen to be coming or going; He is the Knower of all. ||4||1||11||62||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee ||
english: Gauree Poorbee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਗ ਬਾਸੁ ਨ ਬਾਛੀਐ ਡਰੀਐ ਨ ਨਰਕਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: surag baas na baachheeai dareeai na narak nivaas ||
english: Don't wish for a home in heaven, and don't be afraid to live in hell.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੋਨਾ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਮਨਹਿ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: honaa hai so hoee hai manahi na keejai aas ||1||
english: Whatever will be will be, so don't get your hopes up in your mind. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਮਈਆ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: ramaeeaa gun gaaeeai ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa te paaeeai param nidhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: from whom the most excellent treasure is obtained. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਿਆ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਕਿਆ ਬਰਤੁ ਕਿਆ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kiaa jap kiaa tap sa(n)jamo kiaa barat kiaa isanaan ||
english: What good is chanting, penance or self-mortification? What good is fasting or cleansing baths,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jab lag jugat na jaaneeai bhaau bhagat bhagavaan ||2||
english: unless you know the way to worship the Lord God with loving devotion? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਪੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਹਰਖੀਐ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)pai dekh na harakheeai bipat dekh na roi ||
english: Don't feel so delighted at the sight of wealth, and don't weep at the sight of suffering and adversity.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਸੰਪੈ ਤਿਉ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਬਿਧ ਨੇ ਰਚਿਆ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu sa(n)pai tiu bipat hai bidh ne rachiaa so hoi ||3||
english: As is wealth, so is adversity; whatever the Lord proposes, comes to pass. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer ab jaaniaa sa(n)tan ridai majhaar ||
english: Says Kabeer, now I know that the Lord dwells within the hearts of His Saints;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਹ ਘਟ ਬਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥੬੩॥
transliteration: sevak so sevaa bhale jih ghat basai muraar ||4||1||12||63||
english: that servant performs the best service, whose heart is filled with the Lord. ||4||1||12||63||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੋਇ ਨਹੀ ਖਿੰਚਿ ਲੇਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: re man tero koi nahee khi(n)ch lei jin bhaar ||
english: O my mind, even if you carry someone's burden, they don't belong to you.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਖ ਬਸੇਰੋ ਪੰਖਿ ਕੋ ਤੈਸੋ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: birakh basero pa(n)kh ko taiso ihu sa(n)saar ||1||
english: This world is like the perch of the bird on the tree. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raam ras peeaa re ||
english: I drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਰਸ ਅਉਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jih ras bisar gae ras aur ||1|| rahaau ||
english: With the taste of this essence, I have forgotten all other tastes. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਉਰ ਮੁਏ ਕਿਆ ਰੋਈਐ ਜਉ ਆਪਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aur mue kiaa roeeai jau aapaa thir na rahaai ||
english: Why should we weep at the death of others, when we ourselves are not permanent?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo upajai so binas hai dukh kar rovai balaai ||2||
english: Whoever is born shall pass away; why should we cry out in grief? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਕੀ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਹ ਰਚੀ ਪੀਵਤ ਮਰਦਨ ਲਾਗ ॥
transliteration: jah kee upajee tah rachee peevat maradan laag ||
english: We are re-absorbed into the One from whom we came; drink in the Lord's essence, and remain attached to Him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਚਿਤਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੩॥੬੪॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer chit chetiaa raam simar bairaag ||3||2||13||64||
english: Says Kabeer, my consciousness is filled with thoughts of remembrance of the Lord; I have become detached from the world. ||3||2||13||64||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee ||
english: Raag Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੈ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਲੋਚਨ ਭਰੀ ਲੇ ਉਸਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)th nihaarai kaamanee lochan bharee le usaasaa ||
english: The bride gazes at the path, and sighs with tearful eyes.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਰ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਪਗੁ ਨਾ ਖਿਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ur na bheejai pag naa khisai har darasan kee aasaa ||1||
english: Her heart is not happy, but she does not retrace her steps, in hopes of seeing the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਡਹੁ ਨ ਕਾਗਾ ਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: udahu na kaagaa kaare ||
english: So fly away, black crow,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੇਗਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: beg mileejai apune raam piaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: so that I may quickly meet my Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer jeevan pad kaaran har kee bhagat kareejai ||
english: Says Kabeer, to obtain the status of eternal life, worship the Lord with devotion.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੪॥੬੫॥
transliteration: ek aadhaar naam naaraain rasanaa raam raveejai ||2||1||14||65||
english: The Name of the Lord is my only Support; with my tongue, I chant the Lord's Name. ||2||1||14||65||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ੧੧ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee 11 ||
english: Raag Gauree 11:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪਾਸ ਘਨ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਮਾਝ ਬਨਾ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਊਂ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aas paas ghan turasee kaa biravaa maajh banaa ras gaaoo(n) re ||
english: All around, there are thick bushes of sweet basil, and there in the midst of the forest, the Lord is singing with joy.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਗੁਆਰਨਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਹੂ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: uaa kaa saroop dekh mohee guaaran mo kau chhod na aau na jaahoo re ||1||
english: Beholding His wondrous beauty, the milk-maid was entranced, and said, "Please don't leave me; please don't come and go!" ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੋਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ ॥
transliteration: tohi charan man laago saari(n)gadhar ||
english: My mind is attached to Your Feet, O Archer of the Universe;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੋ ਬਡਭਾਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: so milai jo badabhaago ||1|| rahaau ||
english: he alone meets You, who is blessed by great good fortune. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨ ਮਨ ਹਰਨ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਗਾਊ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bi(n)draaban man haran manohar krisan charaavat gaaoo re ||
english: In Brindaaban, where Krishna grazes his cows, he entices and fascinates my mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਨਾਊ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫॥੬੬॥
transliteration: jaa kaa thaakur tuhee saari(n)gadhar mohi kabeeraa naaoo re ||2||2||15||66||
