english: You are my Lord Master, the Archer of the Universe; my name is Kabeer. ||2||2||15||66||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ੧੨ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee 12 ||
english: Gauree Poorbee 12:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਪਲ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਹੈ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਬਨ ਮਧੇ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: bipal basatr kete hai pahire kiaa ban madhe baasaa ||
english: Many people wear various robes, but what is the use of living in the forest?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਆ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ਧੋਖੇ ਕਿਆ ਜਲਿ ਬੋਰਿਓ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahaa bhaiaa nar devaa dhokhe kiaa jal borio giaataa ||1||
english: What good does it do if a man burns incense before his gods? What good does it do to dip one's body in water? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਰੇ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: jeeare jaahigaa mai jaanaa(n) ||
english: O soul, I know that I will have to depart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਗਤ ਸਮਝੁ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: abigat samajh iaanaa ||
english: You ignorant idiot: understand the Imperishable Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਪੇਖਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jat jat dekhau bahur na pekhau sa(n)g maaiaa lapataanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever you see, you will not see that again, but still, you cling to Maya. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਬਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੀ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਗਲੋ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: giaanee dhiaanee bahu upadesee ihu jag sagalo dha(n)dhaa ||
english: The spiritual teachers, meditators and the great preachers are all engrossed in these worldly affairs.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਧਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੬॥੬੭॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer ik raam naam bin iaa jag maaiaa a(n)dhaa ||2||1||16||67||
english: Says Kabeer, without the Name of the One Lord, this world is blinded by Maya. ||2||1||16||67||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ੧੨ ॥
transliteration: gauRee 12 ||
english: Gauree 12:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਛਾਡਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਡਾਂਡੇ ॥
transliteration: man re chhaadahu bharam pragat hoi naachahu iaa maaiaa ke daa(n)de ||
english: O people, O victims of this Maya, abandon your doubts and dance out in the open.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰੁ ਕਿ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਰਨ ਤੇ ਡਰਪੈ ਸਤੀ ਕਿ ਸਾਂਚੈ ਭਾਂਡੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: soor k sanamukh ran te darapai satee k saa(n)chai bhaa(n)de ||1||
english: What sort of a hero is one who is afraid to face the battle? What sort of satee is she who, when her time comes, starts collecting her pots and pans? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਡਗਮਗ ਛਾਡਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dagamag chhaad re man bauraa ||
english: Stop your wavering, O crazy people!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਜਰੇ ਮਰੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਲੀਨੋ ਹਾਥਿ ਸੰਧਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ab tau jare mare sidh paaeeai leeno haath sa(n)dhauraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Now that you have taken up the challenge of death, let yourself burn and die, and attain perfection. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਲੀਨੇ ਇਆ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh maaiaa ke leene iaa bidh jagat bigootaa ||
english: The world is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and Maya; in this way it is plundered and ruined.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਸਗਲ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੭॥੬੮॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer raajaa raam na chhodau sagal ooch te oochaa ||2||2||17||68||
english: Says Kabeer, do not forsake the Lord, your Sovereign King, the Highest of the High. ||2||2||17||68||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ੧੩ ॥
transliteration: gauRee 13 ||
english: Gauree 13:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਿਰੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: phuramaan teraa sirai oopar phir na karat beechaar ||
english: Your Command is upon my head, and I no longer question it.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਹੀ ਦਰੀਆ ਤੁਹੀ ਕਰੀਆ ਤੁਝੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tuhee dareeaa tuhee kareeaa tujhai te nisataar ||1||
english: You are the river, and You are the boatman; salvation comes from You. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੰਦੇ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਇਕਤੀਆਰ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)de ba(n)dagee ikateeaar ||
english: O human being, embrace the Lord's meditation,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰੋਸੁ ਧਰਉ ਕਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saahib ros dharau k piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: whether your Lord and Master is angry with you or in love with you. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਫੂਲੁ ਜਈ ਹੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naam teraa aadhaar meraa jiu phool jaee hai naar ||
english: Your Name is my Support, like the flower blossoming in the water.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਲਾਮੁ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਜੀਆਇ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੬੯॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer gulaam ghar kaa jeeaai bhaavai maar ||2||18||69||
english: Says Kabeer, I am the slave of Your home; I live or die as You will. ||2||18||69||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₅ ॥
transliteration: gauRee₅ ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨੰਦੁ ਬਹੁ ਥਾਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jee jon mahi bhramat na(n)d bahu thaako re ||
english: Wandering through 8.4 million incarnations, Krishna's father Nand was totally exhausted.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਲੀਓ ਹੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਬਡੋ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhagat het avataar leeo hai bhaag bado bapuraa ko re ||1||
english: Because of his devotion, Krishna was incarnated in his home; how great was the good fortune of this poor man! ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਜੁ ਕਹਤ ਹਉ ਨੰਦ ਕੋ ਨੰਦਨੁ ਨੰਦ ਸੁ ਨੰਦਨੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tumh j kahat hau na(n)d ko na(n)dan na(n)d s na(n)dan kaa ko re ||
english: You say that Krishna was Nand's son, but whose son was Nand himself?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਦਸੋ ਦਿਸ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਨੰਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਥੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dharan akaas daso dis naahee tab ihu na(n)d kahaa tho re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When there was no earth or ether or the ten directions, where was this Nand then? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਕਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਰੈ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)kat nahee parai jon nahee aavai naam nira(n)jan jaa ko re ||
english: He does not fall into misfortune, and He does not take birth; His Name is the Immaculate Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਐਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਾਈ ਨ ਬਾਪੋ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੭੦॥
transliteration: kabeer ko suaamee aiso thaakur jaa kai maaee na baapo re ||2||19||70||
english: Kabeer's Lord is such a Lord and Master, who has no mother or father. ||2||19||70||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਉ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਲੋਗੁ ਨਿੰਦਉ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dau ni(n)dau mo kau log ni(n)dau ||
english: Slander me, slander me - go ahead, people, and slander me.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਖਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa jan kau kharee piaaree ||
english: Slander is pleasing to the Lord's humble servant.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬਾਪੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa baap ni(n)daa mahataaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Slander is my father, slander is my mother. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa hoi ta baiku(n)th jaaeeai ||
english: If I am slandered, I go to heaven;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: naam padaarath manahi basaaeeai ||
english: the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within my mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਿਦੈ ਸੁਧ ਜਉ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ridai sudh jau ni(n)daa hoi ||
english: If my heart is pure, and I am slandered,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਕਪਰੇ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hamare kapare ni(n)dak dhoi ||1||
english: then the slanderer washes my clothes. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa karai s hamaraa meet ||
english: One who slanders me is my friend;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਹਿ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak maahi hamaaraa cheet ||
english: the slanderer is in my thoughts.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਸੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak so jo ni(n)daa horai ||
english: The slanderer is the one who prevents me from being slandered.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਲੋਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hamaraa jeevan ni(n)dak lorai ||2||
english: The slanderer wishes me long life. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਮਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa hamaree prem piaar ||
english: I have love and affection for the slanderer.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਮਰਾ ਕਰੈ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa hamaraa karai udhaar ||
english: Slander is my salvation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਉ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jan kabeer kau ni(n)daa saar ||
english: Slander is the best thing for servant Kabeer.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਡੂਬਾ ਹਮ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥੨੦॥੭੧॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak doobaa ham utare paar ||3||20||71||
english: The slanderer is drowned, while I am carried across. ||3||20||71||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਤੂੰ ਐਸਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raajaa raam too(n) aisaa nirabhau taran taaran raam raaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O my Sovereign Lord King, You are Fearless; You are the Carrier to carry us across, O my Lord King. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਹੋਤੇ ਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਬ ਤੁਮ ਹਹੁ ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jab ham hote tab tum naahee ab tum hahu ham naahee ||
english: When I was, then You were not; now that You are, I am not.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਏਕ ਭਏ ਹਹਿ ਏਕੈ ਦੇਖਤ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ab ham tum ek bhae hahi ekai dekhat man pateeaahee ||1||
english: Now, You and I have become one; seeing this, my mind is content. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਬ ਬਲੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਅਬ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲੁ ਨ ਖਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jab budh hotee tab bal kaisaa ab budh bal na khataaee ||
english: When there was wisdom, how could there be strength? Now that there is wisdom, strength cannot prevail.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਦਲੀ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੭੨॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer budh har laee meree budh badalee sidh paaee ||2||21||72||
english: Says Kabeer, the Lord has taken away my wisdom, and I have attained spiritual perfection. ||2||21||72||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਟ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਬੀਚ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: khat nem kar kothaRee baa(n)dhee basat anoop beech paaee ||
english: He fashioned the body chamber with six rings, and placed within it the incomparable thing.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਜੀ ਕੁਲਫੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ku(n)jee kulaph praan kar raakhe karate baar na laaee ||1||
english: He made the breath of life the watchman, with lock and key to protect it; the Creator did this in no time at all. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮਨ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ab man jaagat rahu re bhaaee ||
english: Keep your mind awake and aware now, O Sibling of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਾਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਚੋਰੁ ਮੁਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gaaphal hoi kai janam gavaaio chor musai ghar jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You were careless, and you have wasted your life; your home is being plundered by thieves. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਪਹਰੂਆ ਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch paharooaa dar mahi rahate tin kaa nahee pateeaaraa ||
english: The five senses stand as guards at the gate, but now can they be trusted?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਸੁਚੇਤ ਚਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਲੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਉਜਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chet suchet chit hoi rahu tau lai paragaas ujaaraa ||2||
english: When you are conscious in your consciousness, you shall be enlightened and illuminated. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਘਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੁ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: nau ghar dekh j kaaman bhoolee basat anoop na paaee ||
english: Seeing the nine openings of the body, the soul-bride is led astray; she does not obtain that incomparable thing.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਵੈ ਘਰ ਮੂਸੇ ਦਸਵੈਂ ਤਤੁ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥੨੨॥੭੩॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer navai ghar moose dasavai(n) tat samaaee ||3||22||73||
english: Says Kabeer, the nine openings of the body are being plundered; rise up to the Tenth Gate, and discover the true essence. ||3||22||73||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gauRee ||
english: Gauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਆਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: maaee mohi avar na jaanio aanaanaa(n) ||
english: O mother, I do not know any other, except Him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਜਾਸੁ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਾਸੁ ਬਸਹਿ ਮੋਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: siv sanakaad jaas gun gaavahi taas basahi more praanaanaa(n) || rahaau ||
english: My breath of life resides in Him, whose praises are sung by Shiva and Sanak and so many others. ||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੰਮਿਤ ਗਗਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: hirade pragaas giaan gur ga(n)mit gagan ma(n)dal mahi dhiaanaanaa(n) ||
english: My heart is illuminated by spiritual wisdom; meeting the Guru, I meditate in the Sky of the Tenth Gate.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਰੋਗ ਭੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਾਗੇ ਮਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bikhai rog bhai ba(n)dhan bhaage man nij ghar sukh jaanaanaa ||1||
english: The diseases of corruption, fear and bondage have run away; my mind has come to know peace in its own true home. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਰਤਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੂਸਰ ਮਨਹਿ ਨ ਆਨਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ek sumat rat jaan maan prabh doosar manahi na aanaanaa ||
english: Imbued with a balanced single-mindedness, I know and obey God; nothing else enters my mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਬਾਸੁ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਬਾਸਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਘਟਿਓ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: cha(n)dan baas bhae man baasan tiaag ghatio abhimaanaanaa ||2||
english: My mind has become fragrant with the scent of sandalwood; I have renounced egotistical selfishness and conceit. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਗਾਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹੈ ਥਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: jo jan gaai dhiaai jas thaakur taas prabhoo hai thaanaanaa(n) ||
english: That humble being, who sings and meditates on the Praises of his Lord and Master, is the dwelling-place of God.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਬਡ ਭਾਗ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਮਥਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tih bad bhaag basio man jaa kai karam pradhaan mathaanaanaa ||3||
english: He is blessed with great good fortune; the Lord abides in his mind. Good karma radiates from his forehead. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਸਹਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਓ ਏਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kaat sakat siv sahaj pragaasio ekai ek samaanaanaa ||
english: I have broken the bonds of Maya; the intuitive peace and poise of Shiva has dawned within me, and I am merged in oneness with the One.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਰਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੭੪॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer gur bhet mahaa sukh bhramat rahe man maanaanaa(n) ||4||23||74||
english: Says Kabeer, meeting the Guru, I have found absolute peace. My mind has ceased its wanderings; I am happy. ||4||23||74||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਬਾਵਨ ਅਖਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee poorabee baavan akharee kabeer jeeu kee ||
english: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Baawan Akhree Of Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਨ ਅਛਰ ਲੋਕ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: baavan achhar lok trai sabh kachh in hee maahi ||
english: Through these fifty-two letters, the three worlds and all things are described.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏ ਅਖਰ ਖਿਰਿ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਓਇ ਅਖਰ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: e akhar khir jaahige oi akhar in mahi naahi ||1||
english: These letters shall perish; they cannot describe the Imperishable Lord. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਬੋਲ ਤਹ ਅਛਰ ਆਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jahaa bol tah achhar aavaa ||
english: Wherever there is speech, there are letters.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਅਬੋਲ ਤਹ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jah abol tah man na rahaavaa ||
english: Where there is no speech, there, the mind rests on nothing.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲ ਅਬੋਲ ਮਧਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bol abol madh hai soee ||
english: He is in both speech and silence.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਸ ਓਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਸ ਲਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jas ohu hai tas lakhai na koee ||2||
english: No one can know Him as He is. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਲਹ ਲਹਉ ਤਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਕਹਉ ਤ ਕੋ ਉਪਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: alah lahau tau kiaa kahau kahau ta ko upakaar ||
english: If I come to know the Lord, what can I say; what good does it do to speak?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਟਕ ਬੀਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: batak beej mahi rav rahio jaa ko teen lok bisathaar ||3||
english: He is contained in the seed of the banyan-tree, and yet, His expanse spreads across the three worlds. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਲਹ ਲਹੰਤਾ ਭੇਦ ਛੈ ਕਛੁ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਭੇਦ ॥
transliteration: alah laha(n)taa bhed chhai kachh kachh paaio bhed ||
english: One who knows the Lord understands His mystery, and bit by bit, the mystery disappears.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਲਟਿ ਭੇਦ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਭੰਗ ਅਛੇਦ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ulat bhed man bedhio paaio abha(n)g achhed ||4||
english: Turning away from the world, one's mind is pierced through with this mystery, and one obtains the Indestructible, Impenetrable Lord. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਰਕ ਤਰੀਕਤਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: turak tareekat jaaneeai hi(n)doo bed puraan ||
english: The Muslim knows the Muslim way of life; the Hindu knows the Vedas and Puraanas.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਨ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਕਛੂਅਕ ਪੜੀਐ ਗਿਆਨ ॥੫॥
transliteration: man samajhaavan kaarane kachhooak paReeai giaan ||5||
english: To instruct their minds, people ought to study some sort of spiritual wisdom. ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਆਦਿ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: oa(n)kaar aad mai jaanaa ||
english: I know only the One, the Universal Creator, the Primal Being.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿ ਅਰੁ ਮੇਟੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: likh ar metai taahi na maanaa ||
english: I do not believe in anyone whom the Lord writes and erases.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: oa(n)kaar lakhai jau koee ||
english: If someone knows the One, the Universal Creator,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਲਖਿ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: soee lakh metanaa na hoee ||6||
english: he shall not perish, since he knows Him. ||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਕਾ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: kakaa kiran kamal mahi paavaa ||
english: KAKKA: When the rays of Divine Light come into the heart-lotus,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਸਿ ਬਿਗਾਸ ਸੰਪਟ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sas bigaas sa(n)pat nahee aavaa ||
english: the moon-light of Maya cannot enter the basket of the mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਰੁ ਜੇ ਤਹਾ ਕੁਸਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: ar je tahaa kusam ras paavaa ||
english: And if one obtains the subtle fragrance of that spiritual flower,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਕਹ ਕਹਾ ਕਹਿ ਕਾ ਸਮਝਾਵਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: akah kahaa kahi kaa samajhaavaa ||7||
english: he cannot describe the indescribable; he could speak, but who would understand? ||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਖਾ ਇਹੈ ਖੋੜਿ ਮਨ ਆਵਾ ॥
transliteration: khakhaa ihai khoR man aavaa ||
english: KHAKHA: The mind has entered this cave.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖੋੜੇ ਛਾਡਿ ਨ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: khoRe chhaad na dah dis dhaavaa ||
english: It does not leave this cave to wander in the ten directions.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮਹਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਖਿਮਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: khasamahi jaan khimaa kar rahai ||
english: Knowing their Lord and Master, people show compassion;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਖਿਅਉ ਅਖੈ ਪਦੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: tau hoi nikhiau akhai pad lahai ||8||
english: then, they become immortal, and attain the state of eternal dignity. ||8||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਗਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: gagaa gur ke bachan pachhaanaa ||
english: GAGGA: One who understands the Guru's Word

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਧਰਈ ਕਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: doojee baat na dharaee kaanaa ||
english: does not listen to anything else.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਬਿਹੰਗਮ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: rahai biha(n)gam katahi na jaaee ||
english: He remains like a hermit and does not go anywhere,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਗਹ ਗਹੈ ਗਹਿ ਗਗਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੯॥
transliteration: agah gahai gahi gagan rahaaee ||9||
english: when he grasps the Ungraspable Lord and dwells in the sky of the Tenth Gate. ||9||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਘਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਿਮਸੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ghaghaa ghat ghat nimasai soee ||
english: GHAGHA: He dwells in each and every heart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ghat phoote ghat kabahi na hoee ||
english: Even when the body-pitcher bursts, he does not diminish.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ਘਾਟ ਜਉ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: taa ghat maahi ghaat jau paavaa ||
english: When someone finds the Path to the Lord within his own heart,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਘਟੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਵਘਟ ਕਤ ਧਾਵਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: so ghat chhaad avaghat kat dhaavaa ||10||
english: why should he abandon that Path to follow some other path? ||10||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਙੰਙਾ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਵਾਰੋ ਸੰਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: nga(n)ngaa nigrahi sanehu kar niravaaro sa(n)deh ||
english: NGANGA: Restrain yourself, love the Lord, and dismiss your doubts.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਭਾਜੀਐ ਪਰਮ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਏਹ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naahee dekh na bhaajeeai param siaanap eh ||11||
english: Even if you do not see the Path, do not run away; this is the highest wisdom. ||11||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਚਾ ਰਚਿਤ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: chachaa rachit chitr hai bhaaree ||
english: CHACHA: He painted the great picture of the world.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਚਿਤ੍ਰੈ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਚਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: taj chitrai chetahu chitakaaree ||
english: Forget this picture, and remember the Painter.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਇਹੈ ਅਵਝੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: chitr bachitr ihai avajheraa ||
english: This wondrous painting is now the problem.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਚਿਤ੍ਰੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਚਿਤੇਰਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: taj chitrai chit raakh chiteraa ||12||
english: Forget this picture and focus your consciousness on the Painter. ||12||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛਛਾ ਇਹੈ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: chhachhaa ihai chhatrapat paasaa ||
english: CHHACHHA: The Sovereign Lord of the Universe is here with you.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛਕਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਰਹਹੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: chhak k na rahahu chhaad k na aasaa ||
english: Why are you so unhappy? Why don't you abandon your desires?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਤਉ ਛਿਨ ਛਿਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: re man mai tau chhin chhin samajhaavaa ||
english: O my mind, each and every moment I try to instruct you,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾਹਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਕਤ ਆਪੁ ਬਧਾਵਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: taahi chhaad kat aap badhaavaa ||13||
english: but you forsake Him, and entangle yourself with others. ||13||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਜਾ ਜਉ ਤਨ ਜੀਵਤ ਜਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jajaa jau tan jeevat jaraavai ||
english: JAJJA: If someone burns his body while he is still alive,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਬਨ ਜਾਰਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: joban jaar jugat so paavai ||
english: and burns away the desires of his youth, then he finds the right way.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਸ ਜਰਿ ਪਰ ਜਰਿ ਜਰਿ ਜਬ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: as jar par jar jar jab rahai ||
english: When he burns his desire for his own wealth, and that of others,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਜਾਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜਾਰਉ ਲਹੈ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: tab jaai jot ujaarau lahai ||14||
english: then he finds the Divine Light. ||14||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਝਝਾ ਉਰਝਿ ਸੁਰਝਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jhajhaa urajh surajh nahee jaanaa ||
english: JHAJHA: You are entangled in the world, and you do not know how to get untangled.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਹਿਓ ਝਝਕਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: rahio jhajhak naahee paravaanaa ||
english: You hold back in fear, and are not approved by the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਤ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਅਉਰਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: kat jhakh jhakh auran samajhaavaa ||
english: Why do you talk such nonsense, trying to convince others?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਝਗਰੁ ਕੀਏ ਝਗਰਉ ਹੀ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: jhagar keee jhagarau hee paavaa ||15||
english: Stirring up arguments, you shall only obtain more arguments. ||15||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਞੰਞਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜੁ ਘਟ ਰਹਿਓ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: nja(n)njaa nikat j ghat rahio door kahaa taj jaai ||
english: NYANYA: He dwells near you, deep within your heart; why do you leave Him and go far away?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਜਗੁ ਢੂਢਿਅਉ ਨੇਰਉ ਪਾਇਅਉ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: jaa kaaran jag dhoodhiau nerau paaiau taahi ||16||
english: I searched the whole world for Him, but I found Him near myself. ||16||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਟਟਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਘਾਟ ਘਟ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: tataa bikat ghaat ghat maahee ||
english: TATTA: It is such a difficult path, to find Him within your own heart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖੋਲਿ ਕਪਾਟ ਮਹਲਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: khol kapaat mahal k na jaahee ||
english: Open the doors within, and enter the Mansion of His Presence.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਟਲ ਟਲਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: dekh atal tal katahi na jaavaa ||
english: Beholding the Immovable Lord, you shall not slip and go anywhere else.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਲਪਟਿ ਘਟ ਪਰਚਉ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: rahai lapat ghat parachau paavaa ||17||
english: You shall remain firmly attached to the Lord, and your heart will be happy. ||17||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਠਠਾ ਇਹੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਠਗ ਨੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: thathaa ihai door thag neeraa ||
english: T'HAT'HA: Keep yourself far away from this mirage.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨੀਠਿ ਨੀਠਿ ਮਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: neeth neeth man keeaa dheeraa ||
english: With great difficulty, I have calmed my mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਠਗਿ ਠਗਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jin thag thagiaa sagal jag khaavaa ||
english: That cheater, who cheated and devoured the whole world

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਠਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਠਉਰ ਮਨੁ ਆਵਾ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: so thag thagiaa thaur man aavaa ||18||
english: - I have cheated that cheater, and my mind is now at peace. ||18||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਡਡਾ ਡਰ ਉਪਜੇ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dadaa dar upaje dar jaaee ||
english: DADDA: When the Fear of God wells up, other fears depart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਡਰ ਮਹਿ ਡਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: taa dar mahi dar rahiaa samaaee ||
english: Other fears are absorbed into that Fear.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਡਰ ਡਰੈ ਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jau dar darai ta phir dar laagai ||
english: When one rejects the Fear of God, then other fears cling to him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਡਰ ਹੂਆ ਡਰੁ ਉਰ ਹੋਇ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: nidar hooaa dar ur hoi bhaagai ||19||
english: But if he becomes fearless, the fears of his heart run away. ||19||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਢਢਾ ਢਿਗ ਢੂਢਹਿ ਕਤ ਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: dhadhaa dhig dhoodhahi kat aanaa ||
english: DHADHA: Why do you search in other directions?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਢੂਢਤ ਹੀ ਢਹਿ ਗਏ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: dhoodhat hee dhahi gae paraanaa ||
english: Searching for Him like this, the breath of life runs out.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੜਿ ਸੁਮੇਰਿ ਢੂਢਿ ਜਬ ਆਵਾ ॥
transliteration: chaR sumer dhoodh jab aavaa ||
english: When I returned after climbing the mountain,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਗੜੁ ਗੜਿਓ ਸੁ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: jih gaR gaRio s gaR mahi paavaa ||20||
english: I found Him in the fortress - the fortress which He Himself made. ||20||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਣਾਣਾ ਰਣਿ ਰੂਤਉ ਨਰ ਨੇਹੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: naanaa ran rootau nar nehee karai ||
english: NANNA: The warrior who fights on the battle-field should keep up and press on.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਨਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੰਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: naa nivai naa phun sa(n)charai ||
english: He should not yield, and he should not retreat.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਗਣੈ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n janam taahee ko ganai ||
english: Blessed is the coming of one

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੈ ਏਕਹਿ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇ ਘਣੈ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: maarai ekahi taj jaai ghanai ||21||
english: who conquers the one and renounces the many. ||21||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਤਾ ਅਤਰ ਤਰਿਓ ਨਹ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tataa atar tario nah jaaee ||
english: TATTA: The impassable world-ocean cannot be crossed over;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tan tribhavan mahi rahio samaaee ||
english: the body remains embroiled in the three worlds.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਤਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jau tribhavan tan maahi samaavaa ||
english: But when the Lord of the three worlds enters into the body,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਤਤਹਿ ਤਤ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: tau tatahi tat miliaa sach paavaa ||22||
english: then one's essence merges with the essence of reality, and the True Lord is attained. ||22||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਥਥਾ ਅਥਾਹ ਥਾਹ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: thathaa athaah thaah nahee paavaa ||
english: T'HAT'HA: He is Unfathomable; His depths cannot be fathomed.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਅਥਾਹ ਇਹੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: ohu athaah ihu thir na rahaavaa ||
english: He is Unfathomable; this body is impermanent, and unstable.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਥੋੜੈ ਥਲਿ ਥਾਨਕ ਆਰੰਭੈ ॥
transliteration: thoRai thal thaanak aara(n)bhai ||
english: The mortal builds his dwelling upon this tiny space;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹੀ ਥਾਭਹ ਮੰਦਿਰੁ ਥੰਭੈ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: bin hee thaabhah ma(n)dir tha(n)bhai ||23||
english: without any pillars, he wishes to support a mansion. ||23||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੁ ਬਿਨਸਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dadaa dekh j binasanahaaraa ||
english: DADDA: Whatever is seen shall perish.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਸ ਅਦੇਖਿ ਤਸ ਰਾਖਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jas adekh tas raakh bichaaraa ||
english: Contemplate the One who is unseen.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਸਵੈ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਕੁੰਚੀ ਜਬ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: dasavai duaar ku(n)chee jab deejai ||
english: When the key is inserted in the Tenth Gate,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੋ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: tau daiaal ko darasan keejai ||24||
english: then the Blessed Vision of the Merciful Lord's Darshan is seen. ||24||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧਧਾ ਅਰਧਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dhadhaa aradhahi uradh niberaa ||
english: DHADHA: When one ascends from the lower realms of the earth to the higher realms of the heavens, then everything is resolved.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਰਧਹਿ ਉਰਧਹ ਮੰਝਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aradhahi uradhah ma(n)jh baseraa ||
english: The Lord dwells in both the lower and higher worlds.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਰਧਹ ਛਾਡਿ ਉਰਧ ਜਉ ਆਵਾ ॥
transliteration: aradhah chhaad uradh jau aavaa ||
english: Leaving the earth, the soul ascends to the heavens;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਅਰਧਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: tau aradhahi uradh miliaa sukh paavaa ||25||
english: then, the lower and higher join together, and peace is obtained. ||25||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨੰਨਾ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: na(n)naa nis din nirakhat jaaee ||
english: NANNA: The days and nights go by; I am looking for the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਖਤ ਨੈਨ ਰਹੇ ਰਤਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: nirakhat nain rahe ratavaaee ||
english: Looking for Him, my eyes have become blood-shot.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਖਤ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਜਬ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: nirakhat nirakhat jab jaai paavaa ||
english: After looking and looking,when He is finally found,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਲੇ ਨਿਰਖਹਿ ਨਿਰਖ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: tab le nirakhahi nirakh milaavaa ||26||
english: then the one who was looking merges into the One who was looked for. ||26||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਪਾ ਅਪਰ ਪਾਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: papaa apar paar nahee paavaa ||
english: PAPPA: He is limitless; His limits cannot be found.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਰਚਉ ਲਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: param jot siu parachau laavaa ||
english: I have attuned myself to the Supreme Light.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚਉ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕਰਈ ॥
transliteration: paa(n)chau i(n)dree nigrah karaee ||
english: One who controls his five senses

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੋਊ ਨਿਰਵਰਈ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: paap pu(n)n dooo niravaraee ||27||
english: rises above both sin and virtue. ||27||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਫਫਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਫੂਲਹ ਫਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: phaphaa bin phoolah phal hoee ||
english: FAFFA: Even without the flower, the fruit is produced.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਫਲ ਫੰਕ ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: taa phal pha(n)k lakhai jau koee ||
english: One who looks at a slice of that fruit

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੂਣਿ ਨ ਪਰਈ ਫੰਕ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: doon na paraee pha(n)k bichaarai ||
english: and reflects on it, will not be consigned to reincarnation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਫਲ ਫੰਕ ਸਭੈ ਤਨ ਫਾਰੈ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: taa phal pha(n)k sabhai tan phaarai ||28||
english: A slice of that fruit slices all bodies. ||28||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਬਾ ਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: babaa bi(n)dahi bi(n)d milaavaa ||
english: BABBA: When one drop blends with another drop,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਬਿੰਦਿ ਨ ਬਿਛੁਰਨ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: bi(n)dahi bi(n)d na bichhuran paavaa ||
english: then these drops cannot be separated again.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੰਦਉ ਹੋਇ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਗਹੈ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dau hoi ba(n)dagee gahai ||
english: Become the Lord's slave, and hold tight to His meditation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੰਦਕ ਹੋਇ ਬੰਧ ਸੁਧਿ ਲਹੈ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: ba(n)dak hoi ba(n)dh sudh lahai ||29||
english: If you turn your thoughts to the Lord, the Lord will take care of you like a relative. ||29||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਭਾ ਭੇਦਹਿ ਭੇਦ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: bhabhaa bhedahi bhed milaavaa ||
english: BHABHA: When doubt is pierced, union is achieved.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਭਉ ਭਾਨਿ ਭਰੋਸਉ ਆਵਾ ॥
transliteration: ab bhau bhaan bharosau aavaa ||
english: I have shattered my fear, and now I have come to have faith.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jo baahar so bheetar jaaniaa ||
english: I thought that He was outside of me, but now I know that He is within me.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਇਆ ਭੇਦੁ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: bhaiaa bhed bhoopat pahichaaniaa ||30||
english: When I came to understand this mystery, then I recognized the Lord. ||30||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਮਾ ਮੂਲ ਗਹਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: mamaa mool gahiaa man maanai ||
english: MAMMA: Clinging to the source, the mind is satisfied.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: maramee hoi s man kau jaanai ||
english: One who knows this mystery understands his own mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਤ ਕੋਈ ਮਨ ਮਿਲਤਾ ਬਿਲਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mat koee man milataa bilamaavai ||
english: Let no one delay in uniting his mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਗਨ ਭਇਆ ਤੇ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: magan bhaiaa te so sach paavai ||31||
english: Those who obtain the True Lord are immersed in delight. ||31||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਮਾ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਸਾਧੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mamaa man siu kaaj hai man saadhe sidh hoi ||
english: MAMMA: The mortal's business is with his own mind; one who disciplines his mind attains perfection.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਮਨ ਸਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
transliteration: man hee man siu kahai kabeeraa man saa miliaa na koi ||32||
english: Only the mind can deal with the mind; says Kabeer, I have not met anything like the mind. ||32||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਕਤੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ihu man sakatee ihu man seeu ||
english: This mind is Shakti; this mind is Shiva.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ihu man pa(n)ch tat ko jeeu ||
english: This mind is the life of the five elements.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲੇ ਜਉ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu man le jau unaman rahai ||
english: When this mind is channeled, and guided to enlightenment,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਕੀ ਬਾਤੈ ਕਹੈ ॥੩੩॥
transliteration: tau teen lok kee baatai kahai ||33||
english: it can describe the secrets of the three worlds. ||33||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਯਯਾ ਜਉ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਸਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: yayaa jau jaanahi tau duramat han kar bas kaaiaa gaau ||
english: YAYYA: If you know anything, then destroy your evil-mindedness, and subjugate the body-village.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਣਿ ਰੂਤਉ ਭਾਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਰਉ ਥਾਰਉ ਨਾਉ ॥੩੪॥
transliteration: ran rootau bhaajai nahee soorau thaarau naau ||34||
english: When you are engaged in the battle, don't run away; then, you shall be known as a spiritual hero. ||34||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਰਾ ਰਸੁ ਨਿਰਸ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: raaraa ras niras kar jaaniaa ||
english: RARRA: I have found tastes to be tasteless.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਸ ਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hoi niras s ras pahichaaniaa ||
english: Becoming tasteless, I have realized that taste.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਰਸ ਛਾਡੇ ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਾ ॥
transliteration: ih ras chhaade uh ras aavaa ||
english: Abandoning these tastes, I have found that taste.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਇਹ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੩੫॥
transliteration: uh ras peeaa ih ras nahee bhaavaa ||35||
english: Drinking in that taste, this taste is no longer pleasing. ||35||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਲਾ ਐਸੇ ਲਿਵ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: lalaa aise liv man laavai ||
english: LALLA: Embrace such love for the Lord in your mind,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਨਤ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: anat na jaai param sach paavai ||
english: that you shall not have to go to any other; you shall attain the supreme truth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਰੁ ਜਉ ਤਹਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ar jau tahaa prem liv laavai ||
english: And if you embrace love and affection for Him there,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਅਲਹ ਲਹੈ ਲਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩੬॥
transliteration: tau alah lahai lahi charan samaavai ||36||
english: then you shall obtain the Lord; obtaining Him, you shall be absorbed in His Feet. ||36||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਵਵਾ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਬਿਸਨ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: vavaa baar baar bisan samhaar ||
english: WAWA: Time and time again, dwell upon the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਨ ਸੰਮ੍ਹਾਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bisan sa(n)mhaar na aavai haar ||
english: Dwelling upon the Lord, defeat shall not come to you.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜੇ ਬਿਸਨਤਨਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bal bal je bisanatanaa jas gaavai ||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those, who sing the praises of the Saints, the sons of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩੭॥
transliteration: visan mile sabh hee sach paavai ||37||
english: Meeting the Lord, total Truth is obtained. ||37||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਵਾਵਾ ਵਾਹੀ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਵਾ ਜਾਨੇ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vaavaa vaahee jaaneeai vaa jaane ihu hoi ||
english: WAWA: Know Him. By knowing Him, this mortal becomes Him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਜਬ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਬ ਮਿਲਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੮॥
transliteration: ihu ar ohu jab milai tab milat na jaanai koi ||38||
english: When this soul and that Lord are blended, then, having been blended, they cannot be known separately. ||38||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਸਾ ਸੋ ਨੀਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੋਧਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sasaa so neekaa kar sodhahu ||
english: SASSA: Discipline your mind with sublime perfection.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਪਰਚਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਨਿਰੋਧਹੁ ॥
transliteration: ghat parachaa kee baat nirodhahu ||
english: Refrain from that talk which attracts the heart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਪਰਚੈ ਜਉ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ghat parachai jau upajai bhaau ||
english: The heart is attracted, when love wells up.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਰਾਉ ॥੩੯॥
transliteration: poor rahiaa tah tribhavan raau ||39||
english: The King of the three worlds is perfectly pervading and permeating there. ||39||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਖਾ ਖੋਜਿ ਪਰੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: khakhaa khoj parai jau koee ||
english: KHAKHA: Anyone who seeks Him, and by seeking Him,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਖੋਜੈ ਸੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jo khojai so bahur na hoee ||
english: finds Him, shall not be born again.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜ ਬੂਝਿ ਜਉ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: khoj boojh jau karai beechaaraa ||
english: When someone seeks Him, and comes to understand and contemplate Him,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੪੦॥
transliteration: tau bhavajal tarat na laavai baaraa ||40||
english: then he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean in an instant. ||40||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਸਾ ਸੋ ਸਹ ਸੇਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sasaa so sah sej savaarai ||
english: SASSA: The bed of the soul-bride is adorned by her Husband Lord;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸਹੀ ਸੰਦੇਹ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: soee sahee sa(n)deh nivaarai ||
english: her skepticism is dispelled.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖ ਛਾਡਿ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: alap sukh chhaad param sukh paavaa ||
english: Renouncing the shallow pleasures of the world, she obtains the supreme delight.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਇਹ ਤ੍ਰੀਅ ਓੁਹੁ ਕੰਤੁ ਕਹਾਵਾ ॥੪੧॥
transliteration: tab ih tree ouhu ka(n)t kahaavaa ||41||
english: Then, she is the soul-bride; He is called her Husband Lord. ||41||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਾਹਾ ਹੋਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: haahaa hot hoi nahee jaanaa ||
english: HAHA: He exists, but He is not known to exist.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਤਬਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jab hee hoi tabahi man maanaa ||
english: When He is known to exist, then the mind is pleased and appeased.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਤਉ ਸਹੀ ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: hai tau sahee lakhai jau koee ||
english: Of course the Lord exists, if one could only understand Him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਓਹੀ ਉਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪੨॥
transliteration: tab ohee uhu ehu na hoee ||42||
english: Then, He alone exists, and not this mortal being. ||42||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਿੰਉ ਲਿੰਉ ਕਰਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: li(n)u li(n)u karat phirai sabh log ||
english: Everyone goes around saying, I'll take this, and I'll take that.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: taa kaaran biaapai bahu sog ||
english: Because of that, they suffer in terrible pain.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਖਿਮੀ ਬਰ ਸਿਉ ਜਉ ਲਿਉ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: lakhimee bar siu jau liu laavai ||
english: When someone comes to love the Lord of Lakhshmi,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਗੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪੩॥
transliteration: sog mitai sabh hee sukh paavai ||43||
english: his sorrow departs, and he obtains total peace. ||43||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਖਾ ਖਿਰਤ ਖਪਤ ਗਏ ਕੇਤੇ ॥
transliteration: khakhaa khirat khapat gae kete ||
english: KHAKHA: Many have wasted their lives, and then perished.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਿਰਤ ਖਪਤ ਅਜਹੂੰ ਨਹ ਚੇਤੇ ॥
transliteration: khirat khapat ajahoo(n) nah chete ||
english: Wasting away, they do not remember the Lord, even now.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨਿ ਜਉ ਮਨਾ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: ab jag jaan jau manaa rahai ||
english: But if someone, even now, comes to know the transitory nature of the world and restrain his mind,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਕਾ ਬਿਛੁਰਾ ਤਹ ਥਿਰੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੪੪॥
transliteration: jah kaa bichhuraa tah thir lahai ||44||
english: he shall find his permanent home, from which he was separated. ||44||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਨ ਅਖਰ ਜੋਰੇ ਆਨਿ ॥
transliteration: baavan akhar jore aan ||
english: The fifty-two letters have been joined together.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਕਿਆ ਨ ਅਖਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: sakiaa na akhar ek pachhaan ||
english: But people cannot recognize the One Word of God.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਤ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਕਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sat kaa sabad kabeeraa kahai ||
english: Kabeer speaks the Shabad, the Word of Truth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਅਨਭੈ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit hoi s anabhai rahai ||
english: One who is a Pandit, a religious scholar, must remain fearless.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਲੋਗਹ ਕਉ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit logah kau biuhaar ||
english: It is the business of the scholarly person to join letters.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨਵੰਤ ਕਉ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: giaanava(n)t kau tat beechaar ||
english: The spiritual person contemplates the essence of reality.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਜੀਅ ਜੈਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai jee jaisee budh hoee ||
english: According to the wisdom within the mind,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾਨੈਗਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੪੫॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer jaanaigaa soee ||45||
english: says Kabeer, so does one come to understand. ||45||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਥਿਤੀੰ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀੰ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee thitee(n) kabeer jee kee(n) ||
english: Raag Gauree, T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days Of Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਦ੍ਰਹ ਥਿਤੀੰ ਸਾਤ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)drah thitee(n) saat vaar ||
english: There are fifteen lunar days, and seven days of the week.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਉਰਵਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer uravaar na paar ||
english: Says Kabeer, it is neither here nor there.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਭੇਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhik sidh lakhai jau bheu ||
english: When the Siddhas and seekers come to know the Lord's mystery,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape karataa aape deu ||1||
english: they themselves become the Creator; they themselves become the Divine Lord. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
transliteration: thitee(n) ||
english: T'hitee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮਾਵਸ ਮਹਿ ਆਸ ਨਿਵਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)maavas mahi aas nivaarahu ||
english: On the day of the new moon, give up your hopes.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee raam samaarahu ||
english: Remember the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: jeevat paavahu mokh duaar ||
english: You shall attain the Gate of Liberation while yet alive.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਨਭਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਤੁ ਨਿਜੁ ਸਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anabhau sabad tat nij saar ||1||
english: You shall come to know the Shabad, the Word of the Fearless Lord, and the essence of your own inner being. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal gobi(n)d ra(n)g laagaa ||
english: One who enshrines love for the Lotus Feet of the Lord of the Universe

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad bhae man niramal har keeratan mahi anadin jaagaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - by the Grace of the Saints, her mind becomes pure; night and day, she remains awake and aware, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਰਿਵਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: parivaa preetam karahu beechaar ||
english: On the first day of the lunar cycle, contemplate the Beloved Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਲੈ ਅਘਟ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ghat mahi khelai aghat apaar ||
english: He is playing within the heart; He has no body - He is Infinite.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਕਲਪਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaal kalapanaa kade na khaai ||
english: The pain of death never consumes that person

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aad purakh mahi rahai samaai ||2||
english: who remains absorbed in the Primal Lord God. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਦੁਹ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਅੰਗ ॥
transliteration: duteeaa duh kar jaanai a(n)g ||
english: On the second day of the lunar cycle, know that there are two beings within the fiber of the body.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰਮੈ ਸਭ ਸੰਗ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa braham ramai sabh sa(n)g ||
english: Maya and God are blended with everything.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਬਢੈ ਨ ਘਟਤਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naa ohu badhai na ghatataa jaai ||
english: God does not increase or decrease.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: akul nira(n)jan ekai bhaai ||3||
english: He is unknowable and immaculate; He does not change. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਤੀਨੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਲਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: triteeaa teene sam kar liaavai ||
english: On the third day of the lunar cycle, one who maintains his equilibrium amidst the three modes

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aanad mool param pad paavai ||
english: finds the source of ecstasy and the highest status.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat upajai bisvaas ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, faith wells up.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥੪॥
transliteration: baahar bheetar sadaa pragaas ||4||
english: Outwardly, and deep within, God's Light is always radiant. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥਹਿ ਚੰਚਲ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਗਹਹੁ ॥
transliteration: chauthahi cha(n)chal man kau gahahu ||
english: On the fourth day of the lunar cycle, restrain your fickle mind,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਹਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh sa(n)g kabahu na bahahu ||
english: and do not ever associate with sexual desire or anger.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਾਹੇ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maahe aapahi aap ||
english: On land and sea, He Himself is in Himself.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਜਪਹੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਜਾਪ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aapai japahu aapanaa jaap ||5||
english: He Himself meditates and chants His Chant. ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚੈ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
transliteration: paa(n)chai pa(n)ch tat bisathaar ||
english: On the fifth day of the lunar cycle, the five elements expand outward.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਜੁਗ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kanik kaaminee jug biuhaar ||
english: Men are occupied in the pursuit of gold and women.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: prem sudhaa ras peevai koi ||
english: How rare are those who drink in the pure essence of the Lord's Love.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jaraa maran dukh pher na hoi ||6||
english: They shall never again suffer the pains of old age and death. ||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛਠਿ ਖਟੁ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਛਹੂੰ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chhath khat chakr chhahoo(n) dis dhaai ||
english: On the sixth day of the lunar cycle, the six chakras run in six directions.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਰਚੈ ਨਹੀ ਥਿਰਾ ਰਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin parachai nahee thiraa rahaai ||
english: Without enlightenment, the body does not remain steady.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮੇਟਿ ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹਿ ਰਹਹੁ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa met khimaa gahi rahahu ||
english: So erase your duality and hold tight to forgiveness,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਸੂਲ ਨ ਸਹਹੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: karam dharam kee sool na sahahu ||7||
english: and you will not have to endure the torture of karma or religious rituals. ||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਤੈਂ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਚਾ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: saatai(n) sat kar baachaa jaan ||
english: On the seventh day of the lunar cycle, know the Word as True,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: aatam raam lehu paravaan ||
english: and you shall be accepted by the Lord, the Supreme Soul.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛੂਟੈ ਸੰਸਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
transliteration: chhootai sa(n)saa mit jaahi dukh ||
english: Your doubts shall be eradicated, and your pains eliminated,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਖ ॥੮॥
transliteration: su(n)n sarovar paavahu sukh ||8||
english: and in the ocean of the celestial void, you shall find peace. ||8||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਮੀ ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਕੀ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: asatamee asat dhaat kee kaaiaa ||
english: On the eighth day of the lunar cycle, the body is made of the eight ingredients.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਅਕੁਲ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: taa mahi akul mahaa nidh raaiaa ||
english: Within it is the Unknowable Lord, the King of the supreme treasure.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਭੇਦ ॥
transliteration: gur gam giaan bataavai bhed ||
english: The Guru, who knows this spiritual wisdom, reveals the secret of this mystery.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਲਟਾ ਰਹੈ ਅਭੰਗ ਅਛੇਦ ॥੯॥
transliteration: ulataa rahai abha(n)g achhed ||9||
english: Turning away from the world, He abides in the Unbreakable and Impenetrable Lord. ||9||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਉਮੀ ਨਵੈ ਦੁਆਰ ਕਉ ਸਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: naumee navai duaar kau saadh ||
english: On the ninth day of the lunar cycle, discipline the nine gates of the body.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਹਤੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਬਾਂਧਿ ॥
transliteration: bahatee manasaa raakhahu baa(n)dh ||
english: Keep your pulsating desires restrained.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਸਭ ਬੀਸਰਿ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: lobh moh sabh beesar jaahu ||
english: Forget all your greed and emotional attachment;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਅਮਰ ਫਲ ਖਾਹੁ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: jug jug jeevahu amar phal khaahu ||10||
english: you shall live throughout the ages, eating the fruit of immortality. ||10||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਸਮੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: dasamee dah dis hoi ana(n)d ||
english: On the tenth day of the lunar cycle, there is ecstasy in all directions.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛੂਟੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: chhootai bharam milai gobi(n)d ||
english: Doubt is dispelled, and the Lord of the Universe is met.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਤਤ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
transliteration: jot saroopee tat anoop ||
english: He is the Embodiment of light, the incomparable essence.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਮਲ ਨ ਮਲ ਨ ਛਾਹ ਨਹੀ ਧੂਪ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: amal na mal na chhaah nahee dhoop ||11||
english: He is stainless, without stain, beyond both sunshine and shade. ||11||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਏਕ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ekaadasee ek dis dhaavai ||
english: On the eleventh day of the lunar cycle, if you run in the direction of the One,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਕਟ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tau jonee sa(n)kat bahur na aavai ||
english: you will not have to suffer the pains of reincarnation again.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਇਆ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: seetal niramal bhaiaa sareeraa ||
english: Your body will become cool, immaculate and pure.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਿ ਬਤਾਵਤ ਪਾਇਆ ਨੀਰਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: door bataavat paaiaa neeraa ||12||
english: The Lord was said to be far away, but He is found near at hand. ||12||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਸਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਉਗਵੈ ਸੂਰ ॥
transliteration: baaras baarah ugavai soor ||
english: On the twelfth day of the lunar cycle, twelve suns rise.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰ ॥
transliteration: ahinis baaje anahad toor ||
english: Day and night, the celestial bugles vibrate the unstruck melody.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤਿਹੂੰ ਲੋਕ ਕਾ ਪੀਉ ॥
transliteration: dekhiaa tihoo(n) lok kaa peeu ||
english: Then, one beholds the Father of the three worlds.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੀਵ ਤੇ ਸੀਉ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: acharaj bhaiaa jeev te seeu ||13||
english: This is wonderful! The human being has become God! ||13||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਸਿ ਤੇਰਹ ਅਗਮ ਬਖਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: teras terah agam bakhaan ||
english: On the thirteenth day of the lunar cycle, the thirteen holy books proclaim

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਬਿਚਿ ਸਮ ਪਹਿਚਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: aradh uradh bich sam pahichaan ||
english: that you must recognize the Lord in the nether regions of the underworld as well as the heavens.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨੀਚ ਊਚ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨ ਅਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: neech ooch nahee maan amaan ||
english: There is no high or low, no honor or dishonor.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪਿਕ ਰਾਮ ਸਗਲ ਸਾਮਾਨ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: biaapik raam sagal saamaan ||14||
english: The Lord is pervading and permeating all. ||14||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਉਦਸਿ ਚਉਦਹ ਲੋਕ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: chaudas chaudah lok majhaar ||
english: On the fourteenth day of the lunar cycle, in the fourteen worlds

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: rom rom mahi basahi muraar ||
english: and on each and every hair, the Lord abides.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਧਰਹੁ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh kaa dharahu dhiaan ||
english: Center yourself and meditate on truth and contentment.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਕਥੀਐ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: kathanee katheeai braham giaan ||15||
english: Speak the speech of God's spiritual wisdom. ||15||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੂਨਿਉ ਪੂਰਾ ਚੰਦ ਅਕਾਸ ॥
transliteration: pooniu pooraa cha(n)d akaas ||
english: On the day of the full moon, the full moon fills the heavens.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਸਰਹਿ ਕਲਾ ਸਹਜ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: pasarahi kalaa sahaj paragaas ||
english: Its power is diffused through its gentle light.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਿਆ ਥੀਰ ॥
transliteration: aad a(n)t madh hoi rahiaa theer ||
english: In the beginning, in the end, and in the middle, God remains firm and steady.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਮਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: sukh saagar mahi ramahi kabeer ||16||
english: Kabeer is immersed in the ocean of peace. ||16||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਵਾਰ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ੭ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee vaar kabeer jeeu ke 7 ||
english: Raag Gauree, The Seven Days Of The Week Of Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: baar baar har ke gun gaavau ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord each and every day.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਮਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur gam bhed s har kaa paavau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, you shall come to know the mystery of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿਤ ਕਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਆਰੰਭ ॥
transliteration: aadit karai bhagat aara(n)bh ||
english: On Sunday, begin the devotional worship of the Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਨਸਾ ਥੰਭ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa ma(n)dar manasaa tha(n)bh ||
english: and restrain the desires within the temple of the body.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਖੰਡ ਸੁਰਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ahinis akha(n)d surahee jaai ||
english: When your attention is focused day and night upon that imperishable place,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੇਣੁ ਸਹਜ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tau anahad ben sahaj mahi baai ||1||
english: then the celestial flutes play the unstruck melody in tranquil peace and poise. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਮਵਾਰਿ ਸਸਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਝਰੈ ॥
transliteration: somavaar sas a(n)mrit jharai ||
english: On Monday, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down from the moon.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਾਖਤ ਬੇਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਖ ਹਰੈ ॥
transliteration: chaakhat beg sagal bikh harai ||
english: Tasting it, all poisons are removed in an instant.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਰੋਕਿਆ ਰਹੈ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: baanee rokiaa rahai duaar ||
english: Restrained by Gurbani, the mind remains indoors;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਪੀਵਨਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tau man matavaaro peevanahaar ||2||
english: drinking in this Nectar, it is intoxicated. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਲਵਾਰੇ ਲੇ ਮਾਹੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)galavaare le maaheet ||
english: On Tuesday, understand reality;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਕੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch chor kee jaanai reet ||
english: you must know the way the five thieves work.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਛੋਡੇਂ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ghar chhode(n) baahar jin jaai ||
english: Those who leave their own home to go out wandering

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਤਰੁ ਖਰਾ ਰਿਸੈ ਹੈ ਰਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naatar kharaa risai hai raai ||3||
english: shall feel the terrible wrath of the Lord, their King. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੁਧਵਾਰਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: budhavaar budh karai pragaas ||
english: On Wednesday, one's understanding is enlightened.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਾਸ ॥
transliteration: hiradai kamal mahi har kaa baas ||
english: The Lord comes to dwell in the lotus of the heart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੋਊ ਏਕ ਸਮ ਧਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur mil dooo ek sam dharai ||
english: Meeting the Guru, one comes to look alike upon pleasure and pain,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਰਧ ਪੰਕ ਲੈ ਸੂਧਾ ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: uradh pa(n)k lai soodhaa karai ||4||
english: and the inverted lotus is turned upright. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਿਹਸਪਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਬਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: brihasapat bikhiaa dei bahaai ||
english: On Thursday, wash off your corruption.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਏਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: teen dev ek sa(n)g laai ||
english: Forsake the trinity, and attach yourself to the One God.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਨਦੀ ਤਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: teen nadee tah trikutee maahi ||
english: At the confluence of the three rivers of knowledge, right action and devotion, there,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਸਮਲ ਧੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ahinis kasamal dhovahi naahi ||5||
english: why not wash away your sinful mistakes? ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਾਰੈ ਸੁ ਇਹ ਬ੍ਰਤਿ ਚੜੈ ॥
transliteration: sukrit sahaarai s ih brat chaRai ||
english: On Friday, keep up and complete your fast;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨ ਆਪਿ ਆਪ ਸਿਉ ਲੜੈ ॥
transliteration: anadin aap aap siu laRai ||
english: day and night, you must fight against your own self.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਖੀ ਪਾਂਚਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਬੈ ॥
transliteration: surakhee paa(n)chau raakhai sabai ||
english: If you restrain your five senses,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਦੂਜੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਪੈਸੈ ਕਬੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: tau doojee drisat na paisai kabai ||6||
english: then you shall not cast your glance on another. ||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਥਾਵਰ ਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: thaavar thir kar raakhai soi ||
english: On Saturday, keep the candle of God's Light

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਦੀ ਵਟੀ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jot dee vatee ghat mahi joi ||
english: Steady within your heart;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: baahar bheetar bhaiaa pragaas ||
english: you will be enlightened, inwardly and outwardly.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਹੂਆ ਸਗਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tab hooaa sagal karam kaa naas ||7||
english: All your karma will be erased. ||7||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਆਨ ॥
transliteration: jab lag ghat mahi doojee aan ||
english: Know that as long as you place your hopes in others,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਲਉ ਮਹਲਿ ਨ ਲਾਭੈ ਜਾਨ ॥
transliteration: tau lau mahal na laabhai jaan ||
english: you shall not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: ramat raam siu laago ra(n)g ||
english: When you embrace love for the Lord,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਬ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅੰਗ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer tab niramal a(n)g ||8||1||
english: says Kabeer, then, you shall become pure in your very fiber. ||8||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee chetee baanee naamadeu jeeu kee ||
english: Raag Gauree Chaytee, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਾ ਪਾਹਨ ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
transliteration: devaa paahan taareeale ||
english: God makes even stones float.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ ਜਨ ਕਸ ਨ ਤਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam kahat jan kas na tare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: So why shouldn't Your humble slave also float across, chanting Your Name, O Lord? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤਾਰੀਲੇ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੂਪ ਕੁਬਿਜਾ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
transliteration: taareele ganikaa bin roop kubijaa biaadh ajaamal taareeale ||
english: You saved the prostitute, and the ugly hunch-back; You helped the hunter and Ajaamal swim across as well.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਬਧਿਕ ਜਨ ਤੇਊ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: charan badhik jan teoo mukat bhae ||
english: The hunter who shot Krishna in the foot - even he was liberated.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਕਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hau bal bal jin raam kahe ||1||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who chant the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਦਰੁ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ਦੀਏ ॥
transliteration: daasee sut jan bidar sudaamaa ugrasain kau raaj deee ||
english: You saved Bidur, the son of the slave-girl, and Sudama; You restored Ugrasain to his throne.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਹੀਨ ਤਪ ਹੀਨ ਕੁਲ ਹੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹੀਨ ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਊ ਤਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: jap heen tap heen kul heen kram heen naame ke suaamee teoo tare ||2||1||
english: Without meditation, without penance, without a good family, without good deeds, Naam Dayv's Lord and Master saved them all. ||2||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: raag gauRee ravidaas jee ke pade gauRee guaareree ||
english: Raag Gauree, Padhay Of Ravi Daas Jee, Gauree Gwaarayree:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੋਚ ਸੋਚ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: meree sa(n)gat poch soch din raatee ||
english: The company I keep is wretched and low, and I am anxious day and night;

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਕੁਟਿਲਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਕੁਭਾਂਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: meraa karam kutilataa janam kubhaa(n)tee ||1||
english: my actions are crooked, and I am of lowly birth. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਸਈਆ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਜੀਵਨਾ ॥
transliteration: raam gusaeeaa jee ke jeevanaa ||
english: O Lord, Master of the earth, Life of the soul,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mohi na bisaarahu mai jan teraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: please do not forget me! I am Your humble servant. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਹੁ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਜਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: meree harahu bipat jan karahu subhaaee ||
english: Take away my pains, and bless Your humble servant with Your Sublime Love.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਨ ਛਾਡਉ ਸਰੀਰ ਕਲ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: charan na chhaadau sareer kal jaaee ||2||
english: I shall not leave Your Feet, even though my body may perish. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਪਰਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਭਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu ravidaas parau teree saabhaa ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, I seek the protection of Your Sanctuary;

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬੇਗਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਲਾਂਬਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: beg milahu jan kar na bilaa(n)baa ||3||1||
english: please, meet Your humble servant - do not delay! ||3||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬੇਗਮ ਪੁਰਾ ਸਹਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: begam puraa sahar ko naau ||
english: Baygumpura, 'the city without sorrow', is the name of the town.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਦੋਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਿਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dookh a(n)dohu nahee tihi thaau ||
english: There is no suffering or anxiety there.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਂ ਤਸਵੀਸ ਖਿਰਾਜੁ ਨ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: naa(n) tasavees khiraaj na maal ||
english: There are no troubles or taxes on commodities there.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਖਉਫੁ ਨ ਖਤਾ ਨ ਤਰਸੁ ਜਵਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khauph na khataa na taras javaal ||1||
english: There is no fear, blemish or downfall there. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੂਬ ਵਤਨ ਗਹ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ab mohi khoob vatan gah paaee ||
english: Now, I have found this most excellent city.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਊਹਾਂ ਖੈਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: oohaa(n) khair sadaa mere bhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: There is lasting peace and safety there, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਮੁ ਦਾਇਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kaaim daaim sadaa paatisaahee ||
english: God's Kingdom is steady, stable and eternal.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਦੋਮ ਨ ਸੇਮ ਏਕ ਸੋ ਆਹੀ ॥
transliteration: dom na sem ek so aahee ||
english: There is no second or third status; all are equal there.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਆਬਾਦਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਸਹੂਰ ॥
transliteration: aabaadaan sadaa masahoor ||
english: That city is populous and eternally famous.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਊਹਾਂ ਗਨੀ ਬਸਹਿ ਮਾਮੂਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: oohaa(n) ganee basahi maamoor ||2||
english: Those who live there are wealthy and contented. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਸੈਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tiu tiu sail karahi jiu bhaavai ||
english: They stroll about freely, just as they please.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਰਮ ਮਹਲ ਨ ਕੋ ਅਟਕਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: maharam mahal na ko atakaavai ||
english: They know the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and no one blocks their way.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਖਲਾਸ ਚਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas khalaas chamaaraa ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, the emancipated shoe-maker:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਮ ਸਹਰੀ ਸੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: jo ham saharee s meet hamaaraa ||3||2||
english: whoever is a citizen there, is a friend of mine. ||3||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan ravidaas jeeu ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan, Ravi Daas Jee:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਅਵਘਟ ਡੂਗਰ ਘਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਬੈਲੁ ਹਮਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ghat avaghat doogar ghanaa ik niragun bail hamaar ||
english: The path to God is very treacherous and mountainous, and all I have is this worthless ox.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਮਈਏ ਸਿਉ ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ramaeee siu ik benatee meree poo(n)jee raakh muraar ||1||
english: I offer this one prayer to the Lord, to preserve my capital. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਬਨਜਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਟਾਂਡਾ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਜਾਇ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ko banajaaro raam ko meraa taa(n)daa laadiaa jaai re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Is there any merchant of the Lord to join me? My cargo is loaded, and now I am leaving. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਨਜਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਸਹਜ ਕਰਉ ਬੵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hau banajaaro raam ko sahaj karau byaapaar ||
english: I am the merchant of the Lord; I deal in spiritual wisdom.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mai raam naam dhan laadiaa bikh laadee sa(n)saar ||2||
english: I have loaded the Wealth of the Lord's Name; the world has loaded poison. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਉਰਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਕੇ ਦਾਨੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਲ ਪਤਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: uravaar paar ke daaneeaa likh lehu aal pataal ||
english: O you who know this world and the world beyond: write whatever nonsense you please about me.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਤਜੀਲੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mohi jam da(n)d na laagaee tajeele sarab ja(n)jaal ||3||
english: The club of the Messenger of Death shall not strike me, since I have cast off all entanglements. ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kaa taisaa ihu sa(n)saar ||
english: Love of this world is like the pale, temporary color of the safflower.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਮਈਏ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਕਾ ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: mere ramaeee ra(n)g majeeth kaa kahu ravidaas chamaar ||4||1||
english: The color of my Lord's Love, however, is permanent, like the dye of the madder plant. So says Ravi Daas, the tanner. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gauRee poorabee ravidaas jeeu ||
english: Gauree Poorbee, Ravi Daas Jee:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕੂਪੁ ਭਰਿਓ ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਦਿਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਬਿਦੇਸੁ ਨ ਬੂਝ ॥
transliteration: koop bhario jaise daadiraa kachh des bides na boojh ||
english: The frog in the deep well knows nothing of its own country or other lands;

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਆਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aise meraa man bikhiaa bimohiaa kachh aaraa paar na soojh ||1||
english: just so, my mind, infatuated with corruption, understands nothing about this world or the next. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਕੇ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal bhavan ke naaikaa ik chhin daras dikhaai jee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Lord of all worlds: reveal to me, even for an instant, the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਲਿਨ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਮਾਧਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: malin bhaee mat maadhavaa teree gat lakhee na jaai ||
english: My intellect is polluted; I cannot understand Your state, O Lord.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਈ ਮੈ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karahu kripaa bhram chookaee mai sumat dehu samajhaai ||2||
english: Take pity on me, dispel my doubts, and teach me true wisdom. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀਸਰ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਤੁਅ ਗੁਣ ਕਥਨੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jogeesar paavahi nahee tu gun kathan apaar ||
english: Even the great Yogis cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues; they are beyond words.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਕਾਰਣੈ ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: prem bhagat kai kaaranai kahu ravidaas chamaar ||3||1||
english: I am dedicated to Your loving devotional worship, says Ravi Daas the tanner. ||3||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ॥
transliteration: gauRee bairaagan ||
english: Gauree Bairaagan:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਤੁ ਤੇਤਾ ਜਗੀ ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਪੂਜਾਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: satajug sat tetaa jagee duaapar poojaachaar ||
english: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, was Truth; in the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga, charitable feasts; in the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga, there was worship.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨੌ ਜੁਗ ਤੀਨੌ ਦਿੜੇ ਕਲਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: teenau jug teenau diRe kal keval naam adhaar ||1||
english: In those three ages, people held to these three ways. But in the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, the Name of the Lord is your only Support. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਇਬੋ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: paar kaise paaibo re ||
english: How can I swim across?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਸਉ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mo sau kooo na kahai samajhaai ||
english: No one has explained to me,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨੁ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa te aavaa gavan bilaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: so that I might understand how I can escape reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਰੂਪੀਐ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bahu bidh dharam niroopeeai karataa deesai sabh loi ||
english: So many forms of religion have been described; the whole world is practicing them.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਜਿਹ ਸਾਧੇ ਸਭ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kavan karam te chhooteeai jih saadhe sabh sidh hoi ||2||
english: What actions will bring emancipation, and total perfection? ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਅਕਰਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਸੰਕਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: karam akaram beechaareeai sa(n)kaa sun bed puraan ||
english: One may distinguish between good and evil actions, and listen to the Vedas and the Puraanas,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾ ਸਦ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਿਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)saa sad hiradai basai kaun hirai abhimaan ||3||
english: but doubt still persists. Skepticism continually dwells in the heart, so who can eradicate egotistical pride? ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਉਦਕਿ ਪਖਾਰੀਐ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: baahar udak pakhaareeai ghat bheetar bibidh bikaar ||
english: Outwardly, he washes with water, but deep within, his heart is tarnished by all sorts of vices.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਧ ਕਵਨ ਪਰ ਹੋਇਬੋ ਸੁਚ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sudh kavan par hoibo such ku(n)char bidh biuhaar ||4||
english: So how can he become pure? His method of purification is like that of an elephant, covering himself with dust right after his bath! ||4||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਰਜਨੀ ਜਥਾ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਨਤ ਸਭ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: rav pragaas rajanee jathaa gat jaanat sabh sa(n)saar ||
english: With the rising of the sun, the night is brought to its end; the whole world knows this.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਮਾਨੋ ਤਾਬੋ ਛੁਏ ਕਨਕ ਹੋਤ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੫॥
transliteration: paaras maano taabo chhue kanak hot nahee baar ||5||
english: It is believed that with the touch of the Philosopher's Stone, copper is immediately transformed into gold. ||5||
