author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਪਰਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
transliteration: param paras gur bheteeai poorab likhat lilaat ||
english: When one meets the Supreme Philosopher's Stone, the Guru, if such pre-ordained destiny is written on one's forehead,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਉਨਮਨ ਮਨ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਛੁਟਕਤ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ॥੬॥
transliteration: unaman man man hee mile chhutakat bajar kapaat ||6||
english: then the soul blends with the Supreme Soul, and the stubborn doors are opened wide. ||6||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bhagat jugat mat sat karee bhram ba(n)dhan kaat bikaar ||
english: Through the way of devotion, the intellect is imbued with Truth; doubts, entanglements and vices are cut away.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਬਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਏਕ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥੭॥
transliteration: soee bas ras man mile gun niragun ek bichaar ||7||
english: The mind is restrained, and one attains joy, contemplating the One Lord, who is both with and without qualities. ||7||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੀਏ ਟਾਰੀ ਨ ਟਰੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਫਾਸ ॥
transliteration: anik jatan nigrah keee taaree na tarai bhram phaas ||
english: I have tried many methods, but by turning it away, the noose of doubt is not turned away.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: prem bhagat nahee oopajai taa te ravidaas udaas ||8||1||
english: Love and devotion have not welled up within me, and so Ravi Daas is sad and depressed. ||8||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 ghar 1 so dar ||
english: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, First House, So Dar ~ That Gate:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: so dar teraa kehaa so ghar kehaa jit bahi sarab samhaale ||
english: What is that Gate, and what is that Home, in which You sit and take care of all?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: vaaje tere naad anek asa(n)khaa kete tere vaavanahaare ||
english: Countless musical instruments of so many various kinds vibrate there for You; so many are the musicians there for You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kete tere raag paree siu kaheeahi kete tere gaavanahaare ||
english: There are so many Ragas there for You, along with their accompanying harmonies; so many minstrels sing to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavanhi tudhano paun paanee baisa(n)tar gaavai raajaa dharam duaare ||
english: The winds sing to You, as do water and fire; the Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavanhi tudhano chit gupat likh jaanan likh likh dharam veechaare ||
english: Chitar and Gupat, the recording angels of the conscious and the subconscious, sing to You; they know, and they write, and on the basis of what they write, the Lord of Dharma passes judgement.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavanhi tudhano eesar brahamaa devee sohan tere sadaa savaare ||
english: Shiva and Brahma and the Goddess Parvaati, so beautiful and ever adorned by You, sing to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavanhi tudhano i(n)dr i(n)draasan baithe devatiaa dar naale ||
english: The Indras, seated upon their celestial thrones, with the deities at Your Gate, sing to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਾਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavanhi tudhano sidh samaadhee a(n)dar gaavanhi tudhano saadh beechaare ||
english: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing to You, and the Holy Saints, in their contemplative meditation, sing to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavanhi tudhano jatee satee sa(n)tokhee gaavan tudhano veer karaare ||
english: The celibates, the truthful and the patient beings sing to You, and the mighty warriors sing to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜੇ ਰਖੀਸੁਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਬੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan tudhano pa(n)dit paRe rakheesur jug jug bedaa naale ||
english: The scholarly Pandits sing to You, along with the holy Rishis and the readers of the Vedas throughout the ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavan tudhano mohaneeaa man mohan surag machh paiaale ||
english: The Mohinis, the heavenly beauties who entice the heart in paradise, in this world and in the nether regions, sing to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੇਤੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavanhi tudhano ratan upaae tere jete athasath teerath naale ||
english: The fourteen priceless jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, sing to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavanhi tudhano jodh mahaabal sooraa gaavanhi tudhano khaanee chaare ||
english: The mighty warriors and the divine heroes sing to You, and the four sources of creation sing to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavanhi tudhano kha(n)d ma(n)dal brahama(n)daa kar kar rakhe tere dhaare ||
english: The continents, the worlds and the solar systems, created and installed by Your Hand, sing to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨੑਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: seee tudhano gaavanhi jo tudh bhaavanhi rate tere bhagat rasaale ||
english: They alone sing to You, who are pleasing to Your Will, and who are imbued with the nectar of Your devotional worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hor kete tudhano gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa beechaare ||
english: So many others sing to You, they do not come into my mind; how can Nanak think of them?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: soee soee sadaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naaee ||
english: That Lord and Master - He is True, forever True; He is True, and True is His Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hai bhee hosee jaai na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaaee ||
english: He who created the creation is True, and He shall always be True; He shall not depart, even when the creation departs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)gee ra(n)gee bhaatee jinasee maaiaa jin upaaee ||
english: He created the world of Maya with its various colors and species.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kar kar dekhai keetaa apanaa jiu tis dee vadiaaee ||
english: Having created the creation, He Himself watches over it, as it pleases His Greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karasee phir hukam na karanaa jaaee ||
english: Whatever pleases Him, that is what He does. No one can issue any commands to Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥੧॥
transliteration: so paatisaahu saahaa pat saahib naanak rahan rajaaee ||1||1||
english: He is the King, the King of Kings, the Emperor of Kings! Nanak lives in surrender to His Will. ||1||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: so purakh nira(n)jan har purakh nira(n)jan har agamaa agam apaaraa ||
english: That Lord is Immaculate; the Lord God is Immaculate. The Lord is Unapproachable, Unfathomable and Incomparable.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh dhiaavahi sabh dhiaavahi tudh jee har sache sirajanahaaraa ||
english: All meditate, all meditate on You, O Dear Lord, O True Creator.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh jee tumaare jee too(n) jeeaa kaa daataaraa ||
english: All beings are Yours; You are the Giver of all beings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har dhiaavahu sa(n)tahu jee sabh dookh visaaranahaaraa ||
english: So meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He is the One who takes away all pain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੀ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har aape thaakur har aape sevak jee kiaa naanak ja(n)t vichaaraa ||1||
english: The Lord Himself is the Master, and He Himself is His own servant. O Nanak, how insignificant are mortal beings! ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) ghat ghat a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar jee har eko purakh samaanaa ||
english: You are totally pervading within each and every heart; O Lord, You are the One Primal Being, All-permeating.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ik daate ik bhekhaaree jee sabh tere choj vidaanaa ||
english: Some are givers, and some are beggars; all of this is Your wondrous play!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਜੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape daataa aape bhugataa jee hau tudh bin avar na jaanaa ||
english: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. I know of no other than You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) paarabraham bea(n)t bea(n)t jee tere kiaa gun aakh vakhaanaa ||
english: You are the Supreme Lord God, Infinite and Eternal; what Glorious Praises of Yours should I speak and chant?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo sevahi jo sevahi tudh jee jan naanak tinh kurabaanaa ||2||
english: Unto those who serve, unto those who serve You, slave Nanak is a sacrifice. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: har dhiaavahi har dhiaavahi tudh jee se jan jug mahi sukh vaasee ||
english: Those who meditate on the Lord, those who meditate on You, O Dear Lord, those humble beings dwell in peace in this world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਟੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: se mukat se mukat bhae jinh har dhiaaiaa jeeu tin tootee jam kee phaasee ||
english: They are liberated, they are liberated, who meditate on the Lord; the noose of Death is cut away from them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jin nirabhau jinh har nirabhau dhiaaiaa jeeu tin kaa bhau sabh gavaasee ||
english: Those who meditate on the Fearless One, on the Fearless Lord, all their fears are dispelled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਸਮਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jinh seviaa jinh seviaa meraa har jeeu te har har roop samaasee ||
english: Those who have served, those who have served my Dear Lord, are absorbed into the Being of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: se dha(n)n se dha(n)n jin har dhiaaiaa jeeu jan naanak tin bal jaasee ||3||
english: Blessed are they, blessed are they, who have meditated on the Dear Lord; slave Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਜੀ ਭਰੇ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: teree bhagat teree bhagat bha(n)daar jee bhare bea(n)t bea(n)taa ||
english: Devotion to You, devotion to You, is a treasure, overflowing, infinite and endless.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tere bhagat tere bhagat salaahan tudh jee har anik anek ana(n)taa ||
english: Your devotees, Your devotees praise You, O Dear Lord, in many and various ways.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: teree anik teree anik karahi har poojaa jee tap taapahi japahi bea(n)taa ||
english: For You, so many, for You, so very many, O Dear Lord, perform worship and adoration; they practice penance and endlessly chant in meditation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਪੜਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tere anek tere anek paRahi bahu si(n)mrit saasat jee kar kiriaa khat karam kara(n)taa ||
english: For You, many - for You, so very many read the various Simritees and Shaastras; they perform religious rituals and the six ceremonies.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਭਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: se bhagat se bhagat bhale jan naanak jee jo bhaavahi mere har bhagava(n)taa ||4||
english: Those devotees, those devotees are good, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing to my Lord God. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aad purakh apara(n)par karataa jee tudh jevad avar na koee ||
english: You are the Primal Being, the Unrivalled Creator Lord; there is no other as Great as You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) jug jug eko sadaa sadaa too(n) eko jee too(n) nihachal karataa soee ||
english: You are the One, age after age; forever and ever, You are One and the same. You are the Eternal, Unchanging Creator.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape bhaavai soee varatai jee too(n) aape karahi s hoee ||
english: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. Whatever You Yourself do, happens.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape srisat sabh upaaee jee tudh aape siraj sabh goee ||
english: You Yourself created the entire Universe, and having done so, You Yourself shall destroy it all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੋਈ ॥੫॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak gun gaavai karate ke jee jo sabhasai kaa jaanoee ||5||2||
english: Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Creator, the Knower of all. ||5||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 chaupade ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Chaupadhay, Second House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sun vadaa aakhai sabh koee ||
english: Hearing, everyone calls You Great,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਡੀਠਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kevad vadaa deethaa hoee ||
english: but only one who has seen You, knows just how Great You are.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: keemat paai na kahiaa jaai ||
english: No one can measure Your Worth, or describe You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਣੈ ਵਾਲੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahanai vaale tere rahe samaai ||1||
english: Those who describe You, remain absorbed in You. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: vade mere saahibaa gahir ga(n)bheeraa gunee gaheeraa ||
english: O my Great Lord and Master of Unfathomable Depth, You are the Ocean of Excellence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਤਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਚੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: koee na jaanai teraa ketaa kevad cheeraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: No one knows the greatness of Your expanse. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh suratee mil surat kamaaee ||
english: All the contemplators met together and practiced contemplation;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh keemat mil keemat paaee ||
english: all the appraisers met together and tried to appraise You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: giaanee dhiaanee gur gur haaee ||
english: The theologians, the meditators and the teachers of teachers

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahan na jaaee teree til vadiaaee ||2||
english: could not express even an iota of Your Greatness. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh sat sabh tap sabh cha(n)giaaeeaa ||
english: All Truth, all austerities, all goodness,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧਾ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆਂ ॥
transliteration: sidhaa purakhaa keeaa vadiaaeeaa(n) ||
english: and the greatness of the Siddhas, the beings of perfect spiritual powers

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਧੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh vin sidhee kinai na paaeeaa ||
english: without You, none has attained such spiritual powers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਈਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karam milai naahee thaak rahaaeeaa ||3||
english: They are obtained by Your Grace; their flow cannot be blocked. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਕਿਆ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aakhan vaalaa kiaa bechaaraa ||
english: What can the helpless speaker do?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: siphatee bhare tere bha(n)daaraa ||
english: Your bounties are overflowing with Your Praises.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis too(n) dehi tisai kiaa chaaraa ||
english: And the one, unto whom You give - why should he think of any other?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sach savaaranahaaraa ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, the True Lord is the Embellisher. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aakhaa jeevaa visarai mar jaau ||
english: Chanting the Name, I live; forgetting it, I die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aakhan aukhaa saachaa naau ||
english: It is so difficult to chant the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਭੂਖ ॥
transliteration: saache naam kee laagai bhookh ||
english: If someone feels hunger for the True Name,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਭੂਖੈ ਖਾਇ ਚਲੀਅਹਿ ਦੂਖ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tit bhookhai khaai chaleeahi dookh ||1||
english: then that hunger shall consume his pains. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: so kiu visarai meree maai ||
english: So how could I ever forget Him, O my Mother?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahib saachai naai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: True is the Master, and True is His Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: saache naam kee til vadiaaee ||
english: People have grown weary of trying to appraise the greatness of the True Name,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਿ ਥਕੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aakh thake keemat nahee paaee ||
english: But they have not been able to appraise even an iota of it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਆਖਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: je sabh mil kai aakhan paahi ||
english: Even if they were all to meet together and recount them,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vadaa na hovai ghaat na jaai ||2||
english: You would not be made any greater or lesser. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: naa ohu marai na hovai sog ||
english: He does not die - there is no reason to mourn.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਂਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: de(n)daa rahai na chookai bhog ||
english: He continues to give, but His Provisions are never exhausted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣੁ ਏਹੋ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gun eho hor naahee koi ||
english: This Glorious Virtue is His alone - no one else is like Him;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naa ko hoaa naa ko hoi ||3||
english: there has never been anyone like Him, and there never shall be. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਆਪਿ ਤੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jevad aap tevad teree daat ||
english: As Great as You Yourself are, so Great are Your Gifts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕੀਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jin din kar kai keetee raat ||
english: It is You who created day and night as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਕਮਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: khasam visaarahi te kamajaat ||
english: Those who forget their Lord and Master are vile and despicable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਨਾਤਿ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naavai baajh sanaat ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, people are wretched outcasts. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਂਗਤੁ ਕੂਕ ਕਰੇ ਮਹਲੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
transliteration: je dar maa(n)gat kook kare mahalee khasam sune ||
english: If a beggar cries out at the door, the Master hears it in His Mansion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਵੈ ਧੀਰਕ ਭਾਵੈ ਧਕੇ ਏਕ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhaavai dheerak bhaavai dhake ek vadaaee dei ||1||
english: Whether He receives him or pushes him away, it is the Gift of the Lord's Greatness. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਨ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਤੀ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaanahu jot na poochhahu jaatee aagai jaat na he ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Recognize the Lord's Light within all, and do not consider social class or status; there are no classes or castes in the world hereafter. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aap karaae aap karei ||
english: He Himself acts, and He Himself inspires us to act.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਲਾਮੑੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aap ulaamhe chit dharei ||
english: He Himself considers our complaints.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa too(n) karanahaar karataar ||
english: Since You, O Creator Lord, are the Doer,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਕਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kiaa muhataajee kiaa sa(n)saar ||2||
english: why should I submit to the world? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aap upaae aape dei ||
english: You Yourself created and You Yourself give.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਹਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aape duramat manahi karei ||
english: You Yourself eliminate evil-mindedness;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad vasai man aai ||
english: by Guru's Grace, You come to abide in our minds,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਅਨੑੇਰਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dukh anheraa vichahu jaai ||3||
english: and then, pain and darkness are dispelled from within. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: saach piaaraa aap karei ||
english: He Himself infuses love for the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੀ ਕਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: avaree kau saach na dei ||
english: Unto others, the Truth is not bestowed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਗੈ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਲੇਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: je kisai dei vakhaanai naanak aagai poochh na lei ||4||3||
english: If He bestows it upon someone, says Nanak, then, in the world hereafter, that person is not called to account. ||4||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾਲ ਮਦੀਰੇ ਘਟ ਕੇ ਘਾਟ ॥
transliteration: taal madeere ghat ke ghaat ||
english: The urges of the heart are like cymbals and ankle-bells;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੋਲਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਵਾਜ ॥
transliteration: dolak duneeaa vaajahi vaaj ||
english: the drum of the world resounds with the beat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਕਲਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naarad naachai kal kaa bhaau ||
english: Naarad dances to the tune of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਕਹ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jatee satee kah raakhahi paau ||1||
english: where can the celibates and the men of truth place their feet? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak naam vitahu kurabaan ||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhee duneeaa saahib jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The world is blind; our Lord and Master is All-seeing. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਚੇਲਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guroo paasahu phir chelaa khaai ||
english: The disciple feeds on the Guru;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾਮਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: taam pareet vasai ghar aai ||
english: out of love for bread, he comes to dwell in his home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵਰ੍ਹਿਆ ਜੀਵਣ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: je sau varhiaa jeevan khaan ||
english: If one were to live and eat for hundreds of years,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khasam pachhaanai so din paravaan ||2||
english: that day alone would be auspicious, when he recognizes his Lord and Master. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਐ ਦਇਆ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: darasan dekhiai daiaa na hoi ||
english: Beholding the sight of the petitioner, compassion is not aroused.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਏ ਦਿਤੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: lae dite vin rahai na koi ||
english: No one lives without give and take.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰੇ ਹਥਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: raajaa niaau kare hath hoi ||
english: The king administers justice only if his palm is greased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahai khudaai na maanai koi ||3||
english: No one is moved by the Name of God. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: maanas moorat naanak naam ||
english: O Nanak, they are human beings in form and name only;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੁਤਾ ਦਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: karanee kutaa dar phuramaan ||
english: by their deeds they are dogs - this is the Command of the Lord's Court.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਿਹਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad jaanai mihamaan ||
english: By Guru's Grace, if one sees himself as a guest in this world,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: taa kichh daragah paavai maan ||4||4||
english: then he gains honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਤੇਤੀ ਜੇਤਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jetaa sabad surat dhun tetee jetaa roop kaaiaa teree ||
english: As much as the Shabad is in the mind, so much is Your melody; as much as the form of the universe is, so much is Your body, Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਸਨਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹਉ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too(n) aape rasanaa aape basanaa avar na doojaa kahau maaee ||1||
english: You Yourself are the tongue, and You Yourself are the nose. Do not speak of any other, O my mother. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: saahib meraa eko hai ||
english: My Lord and Master is One;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: eko hai bhaaee eko hai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the One and Only; O Siblings of Destiny, He is the One alone. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਛੋਡੈ ਆਪੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aape maare aape chhodai aape levai dei ||
english: He Himself kills, and He Himself emancipates; He Himself gives and takes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape vekhai aape vigasai aape nadar karei ||2||
english: He Himself beholds, and He Himself rejoices; He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa avar na karanaa jaaee ||
english: Whatever He is to do, that is what He is doing. No one else can do anything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaisaa varatai taiso kaheeai sabh teree vadiaaee ||3||
english: As He projects Himself, so do we describe Him; this is all Your Glorious Greatness, Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਲਾ ਪੀਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: kal kalavaalee maaiaa mad meethaa man matavaalaa peevat rahai ||
english: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the bottle of wine; Maya is the sweet wine, and the intoxicated mind continues to drink it in.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰੂਪ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਂਤੀਂ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਏਵ ਕਹੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: aape roop kare bahu bhaa(n)tee(n) naanak bapuRaa ev kahai ||4||5||
english: He Himself assumes all sorts of forms; thus poor Nanak speaks. ||4||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਜਾ ਮਤਿ ਪਖਾਵਜੁ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vaajaa mat pakhaavaj bhaau ||
english: Make your intellect your instrument, and love your tambourine;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hoi ana(n)d sadaa man chaau ||
english: thus bliss and lasting pleasure shall be produced in your mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਏਹੋ ਤਪ ਤਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ehaa bhagat eho tap taau ||
english: This is devotional worship, and this is the practice of penance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: it ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh paau ||1||
english: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਤਾਲ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
transliteration: poore taal jaanai saalaah ||
english: Know that the perfect beat is the Praise of the Lord;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਨਚਣਾ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hor nachanaa khuseeaa man maah ||1|| rahaau ||
english: other dances produce only temporary pleasure in the mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਦੁਇ ਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh vajahi dui taal ||
english: Play the two cymbals of truth and contentment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਵਾਜਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: pairee vaajaa sadaa nihaal ||
english: Let your ankle bells be the lasting Vision of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਨਾਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raag naad nahee doojaa bhaau ||
english: Let your harmony and music be the elimination of duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: it ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh paau ||2||
english: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਫੇਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bhau pheree hovai man cheet ||
english: Let the fear of God within your heart and mind be your spinning dance,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bahadiaa uthadiaa neetaa neet ||
english: and keep up, whether sitting or standing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਟਣਿ ਲੇਟਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਆਹੁ ॥
transliteration: letan let jaanai tan suaahu ||
english: To roll around in the dust is to know that the body is only ashes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: it ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh paau ||3||
english: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਸਭਾ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਕਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sikh sabhaa deekhiaa kaa bhaau ||
english: Keep the company of the disciples, the students who love the teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਣਣਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sunanaa saachaa naau ||
english: As Gurmukh, listen to the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਰਾ ਵੇਰ ॥
transliteration: naanak aakhan veraa ver ||
english: O Nanak, chant it, over and over again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪੈਰ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: it ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh pair ||4||6||
english: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||4||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੀ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਜਲ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: paun upaai dharee sabh dharatee jal aganee kaa ba(n)dh keeaa ||
english: He created the air, and He supports the whole world; he bound water and fire together.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਦਹਸਿਰਿ ਮੂੰਡੁ ਕਟਾਇਆ ਰਾਵਣੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)dhulai dahasir moo(n)d kataaiaa raavan maar kiaa vadaa bhaiaa ||1||
english: The blind, ten-headed Raavan had his heads cut off, but what greatness was obtained by killing him? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਖੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kiaa upamaa teree aakhee jaai ||
english: What Glories of Yours can be chanted?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sarabe poor rahiaa liv laai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are totally pervading everywhere; You love and cherish all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹਥਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਾਲੀ ਨਥਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jee upaai jugat hath keenee kaalee nath kiaa vadaa bhaiaa ||
english: You created all beings, and You hold the world in Your Hands; what greatness is it to put a ring in the nose of the black cobra, as Krishna did?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜੋਰੂ ਕਉਣ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kis too(n) purakh joroo kaun kaheeai sarab nira(n)tar rav rahiaa ||2||
english: Whose Husband are You? Who is Your wife? You are subtly diffused and pervading in all. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਲਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਵਰਦਾਤਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਭਾਲਣ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naal kuta(n)b saath varadaataa brahamaa bhaalan srisat gaiaa ||
english: Brahma, the bestower of blessings, entered the stem of the lotus, with his relatives, to find the extent of the universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕੰਸੁ ਛੇਦਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aagai a(n)t na paaio taa kaa ka(n)s chhed kiaa vadaa bhaiaa ||3||
english: Proceeding on, he could not find its limits; what glory was obtained by killing Kansa, the king? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੇ ਖੀਰੁ ਮਥਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ਭਖਲਾਏ ਜਿ ਅਸੀ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ratan upaai dhare kheer mathiaa hor bhakhalaae j asee keeaa ||
english: The jewels were produced and brought forth by churning the ocean of milk. The other gods proclaimed We are the ones who did this!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਛਪੈ ਕਿਉ ਛਪਿਆ ਏਕੀ ਏਕੀ ਵੰਡਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: kahai naanak chhapai kiu chhapiaa ekee ekee va(n)d deeaa ||4||7||
english: Says Nanak, by hiding, how can the Lord be hidden? He has given each their share, one by one. ||4||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਬੇਲਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
transliteration: karam karatoot bel bisathaaree raam naam phal hooaa ||
english: The vine of good actions and character has spread out, and it bears the fruit of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਕੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis roop na rekh anaahad vaajai sabad nira(n)jan keeaa ||1||
english: The Name has no form or outline; it vibrates with the unstruck Sound Current; through the Word of the Shabad, the Immaculate Lord is revealed. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਵਖਿਆਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kare vakhiaan jaanai je koee ||
english: One can speak on this only when he knows it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit peevai soee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He alone drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਪੀਆ ਸੇ ਮਸਤ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਤੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਫਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: jinh peeaa se masat bhae hai toote ba(n)dhan phaahe ||
english: Those who drink it in are enraptured; their bonds and shackles are cut away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਛੋਡੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਲਾਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jotee jot samaanee bheetar taa chhode maaiaa ke laahe ||2||
english: When one's light blends into the Divine Light, then the desire for Maya is ended. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sarab jot roop teraa dekhiaa sagal bhavan teree maaiaa ||
english: Among all lights, I behold Your Form; all the worlds are Your Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਰੈ ਰੂਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raarai roop niraalam baithaa nadar kare vich chhaaiaa ||3||
english: Among the tumults and forms, He sits in serene detachment; He bestows His Glance of Grace upon those who are engrossed in the illusion. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੀਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: beenaa sabad vajaavai jogee darasan roop apaaraa ||
english: The Yogi who plays on the instrument of the Shabad gains the Blessed Vision of the Infinitely Beautiful Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: sabad anaahad so sahu raataa naanak kahai vichaaraa ||4||8||
english: He, the Lord, is immersed in the Unstruck Shabad of the Word, says Nanak, the humble and meek. ||4||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਾ ਕੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
transliteration: mai gun galaa ke sir bhaar ||
english: My virtue is that I carry the load of my words upon my head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਲੀ ਗਲਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: galee galaa sirajanahaar ||
english: The real words are the Words of the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਹਸਣਾ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: khaanaa peenaa hasanaa baad ||
english: How useless are eating, drinking and laughing,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਯਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jab lag ridai na aavahi yaad ||1||
english: if the Lord is not cherished in the heart! ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਕੇਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: tau paravaah kehee kiaa keejai ||
english: Why should someone care for anything else,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੀਜੀ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kichh leejee leejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: if throughout his life, he gathers in that which is truly worth gathering? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਮਤਾਗਲੁ ਮਤਾ ॥
transliteration: man kee mat mataagal mataa ||
english: The intellect of the mind is like a drunken elephant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਖਤੋ ਖਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh boleeai sabh khato khataa ||
english: Whatever one utters is totally false, the most false of the false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ ਕੀਚੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: kiaa muhu lai keechai aradaas ||
english: So what face should we put on to offer our prayer,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਖੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paap pu(n)n dui saakhee paas ||2||
english: when both virtue and vice are close at hand as witnesses? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa too(n) karahi taisaa ko hoi ||
english: As You make us, so we become.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin doojaa naahee koi ||
english: Without You, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੇਹੀ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jehee too(n) mat dehi tehee ko paavai ||
english: As is the understanding which You bestow, so do we receive.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tudh aape bhaavai tivai chalaavai ||3||
english: As it pleases Your Will, so do You lead us. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਪਰੀਆ ਪਰਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: raag ratan pareeaa paravaar ||
english: The divine crystalline harmonies, their consorts, and their celestial families

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tis vich upajai a(n)mrit saar ||
english: from them, the essence of Ambrosial Nectar is produced.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak karate kaa ihu dhan maal ||
english: O Nanak, this is the wealth and property of the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: je ko boojhai ehu beechaar ||4||9||
english: If only this essential reality were understood! ||4||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apanai ghar aaiaa taa mil sakheeaa kaaj rachaaiaa ||
english: When by His Grace He came to my home, then my companions met together to celebrate my marriage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੇਲੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਹੁ ਵੀਆਹਣ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khel dekh man anad bhaiaa sahu veeaahan aaiaa ||1||
english: Beholding this play, my mind became blissful; my Husband Lord has come to marry me. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gaavahu gaavahu kaamanee bibek beechaar ||
english: So sing - yes, sing the songs of wisdom and reflection, O brides.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hamarai ghar aaiaa jagajeevan bhataar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My spouse, the Life of the world, has come into my home. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਮਰਾ ਵੀਆਹੁ ਜਿ ਹੋਆ ਜਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: guroo duaarai hamaraa veeaahu j hoaa jaa(n) sahu miliaa taa(n) jaaniaa ||
english: When I was married within the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, I met my Husband Lord, and I came to know Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਹੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tihu lokaa mahi sabad raviaa hai aap gaiaa man maaniaa ||2||
english: The Word of His Shabad is pervading the three worlds; when my ego was quieted, my mind became happy. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਹੋਰਨਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa kaaraj aap savaare horan kaaraj na hoee ||
english: He Himself arranges His own affairs; His affairs cannot be arranged by anyone else.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jit kaaraj sat sa(n)tokh daiaa dharam hai guramukh boojhai koee ||3||
english: By the affair of this marriage, truth, contentment, mercy and faith are produced; but how rare is that Gurmukh who understands it! ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak sabhanaa kaa pir eko soi ||
english: Says Nanak, that Lord alone is the Husband of all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: jis no nadar kare saa sohaagan hoi ||4||10||
english: She, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, becomes the happy soul-bride. ||4||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਬਨੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: grihu ban samasar sahaj subhaai ||
english: Home and forest are the same, for one who dwells in the balance of intuitive peace and poise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਤੁ ਭਈ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: duramat gat bhaee keerat thaai ||
english: His evil-mindedness departs, and the Praises of God take its place.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਪਉੜੀ ਸਾਚਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਂਉ ॥
transliteration: sach pauRee saachau mukh naa(n)u ||
english: To chant the True Name with one's mouth is the true ladder.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur sev paae nij thaau ||1||
english: Serving the True Guru, one finds one's own place within the self. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚੂਰੇ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: man choore khat darasan jaan ||
english: To conquer the mind is the knowledge of the six Shaastras.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab jot pooran bhagavaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Divine Light of the Lord God is perfectly pervading. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਕ ਤਿਆਸ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: adhik tiaas bhekh bahu karai ||
english: Excessive thirst for Maya makes people wear all sorts of religious robes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਨਿ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
transliteration: dukh bikhiaa sukh tan paraharai ||
english: The pain of corruption destroys the body's peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh a(n)tar dhan hirai ||
english: Sexual desire and anger steal the wealth of the self within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dubidhaa chhod naam nisatarai ||2||
english: But by abandoning duality, one is emancipated through the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: siphat salaahan sahaj ana(n)d ||
english: In the Lord's Praise and adoration is intuitive peace, poise and bliss.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਖਾ ਸੈਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: sakhaa sain prem gobi(n)d ||
english: The Love of the Lord God is one's family and friends.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: aape kare aape bakhasi(n)d ||
english: He Himself is the Doer, and He Himself is the Forgiver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tan man har pahi aagai ji(n)d ||3||
english: My body and mind belong to the Lord; my life is at His Command. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: jhooth vikaar mahaa dukh deh ||
english: Falsehood and corruption cause terrible suffering.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੇਖ ਵਰਨ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਖੇਹ ॥
transliteration: bhekh varan deesahi sabh kheh ||
english: All the religious robes and social classes look just like dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo upajai so aavai jaai ||
english: Whoever is born, continues to come and go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak asathir naam rajaai ||4||11||
english: O Nanak, only the Naam and the Lord's Command are eternal and everlasting. ||4||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਕਮਲ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
transliteration: eko saravar kamal anoop ||
english: In the pool is the one incomparably beautiful lotus.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਬਿਗਾਸੈ ਪਰਮਲ ਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: sadaa bigaasai paramal roop ||
english: It blossoms continually; its form is pure and fragrant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਜਲ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੂਗਹਿ ਹੰਸ ॥
transliteration: oojal motee choogahi ha(n)s ||
english: The swans pick up the bright jewels.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ਅੰਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarab kalaa jagadeesai a(n)s ||1||
english: They take on the essence of the All-powerful Lord of the Universe. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai so upajai binasai ||
english: Whoever is seen, is subject to birth and death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin jal saravar kamal na deesai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the pool without water, the lotus is not seen. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
transliteration: biralaa boojhai paavai bhed ||
english: How rare are those who know and understand this secret.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਖਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਕਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਬੇਦੁ ॥
transliteration: saakhaa teen kahai nit bed ||
english: The Vedas continually speak of the three branches.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਦ ਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naad bi(n)d kee surat samaai ||
english: One who merges into the knowledge of the Lord as absolute and related,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur sev param pad paai ||2||
english: serves the True Guru and obtains the supreme status. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੋ ਰਾਤਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵਾਂਤਉ ॥
transliteration: mukato raatau ra(n)g ravaa(n)tau ||
english: One who is imbued with the Love of the Lord and dwells continually upon Him is liberated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਨ ਰਾਜਿ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਗਸਾਂਤਉ ॥
transliteration: raajan raaj sadaa bigasaa(n)tau ||
english: He is the king of kings, and blossoms forth continually.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jis too(n) raakhahi kirapaa dhaar ||
english: That one whom You preserve, by bestowing Your Mercy, O Lord,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਪਾਹਨ ਤਾਰਹਿ ਤਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: boodat paahan taarahi taar ||3||
english: even the sinking stone - You float that one across. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tribhavan mahi jot tribhavan mahi jaaniaa ||
english: Your Light is pervading the three worlds; I know that You are permeating the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਲਟ ਭਈ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ulat bhaee ghar ghar mahi aaniaa ||
english: When my mind turned away from Maya, I came to dwell in my own home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ahinis bhagat kare liv laai ||
english: Nanak falls at the feet of that person who immerses himself in the Lord's Love,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak tin kai laagai paai ||4||12||
english: And performs devotional worship night and day. ||4||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਹੁਜਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramat saachee hujat door ||
english: Receiving the True Teachings from the Guru, arguments depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਲਾਗੈ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bahut siaanap laagai dhoor ||
english: But through excessive cleverness, one is only plastered with dirt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਗੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਚ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: laagee mail mitai sach naai ||
english: The filth of attachment is removed by the True Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaad rahai liv laai ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, one remains lovingly attached to the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: hai hajoor haajar aradaas ||
english: He is the Presence Ever-present; offer your prayers to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh saach karate prabh paas ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Pain and pleasure are in the Hands of God, the True Creator. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kooR kamaavai aavai jaavai ||
english: One who practices falsehood comes and goes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਣਿ ਕਥਨਿ ਵਾਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kahan kathan vaaraa nahee aavai ||
english: By speaking and talking, His limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa dekhaa soojh boojh na paavai ||
english: Whatever one sees, is not understood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin naavai man tripat na aavai ||2||
english: Without the Name, satisfaction does not enter into the mind. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨਮੇ ਸੇ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: jo janame se rog viaape ||
english: Whoever is born is afflicted by disease,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੂਖਿ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: haumai maaiaa dookh sa(n)taape ||
english: tortured by the pain of egotism and Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਬਾਚੇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
transliteration: se jan baache jo prabh raakhe ||
english: They alone are saved, who are protected by God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur sev a(n)mrit ras chaakhe ||3||
english: Serving the True Guru, they drink in the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਲਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: chalatau man raakhai a(n)mrit chaakhai ||
english: The unstable mind is restrained by tasting this Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦੁ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev a(n)mrit sabad bhaakhai ||
english: Serving the True Guru, one comes to cherish the Ambrosial Nectar of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saachai sabad mukat gat paae ||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, the state of liberation is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak vichahu aap gavaae ||4||13||
english: O Nanak, self-conceit is eradicated from within. ||4||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jo tin keeaa so sach theeaa ||
english: Whatever He has done, has proved to be true.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam satigur deeaa ||
english: The True Guru bestows the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: hiradai naam naahee man bha(n)g ||
english: With the Naam in the heart, the mind is not separated from the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin naal piaare sa(n)g ||1||
english: Night and day, one dwells with the Beloved. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu raakhahu apanee saranaaee ||
english: O Lord, please keep me in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har ras paaiaa naam padaarath nau nidh paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord; I have received the wealth of the Naam and the nine treasures. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam sach saachaa naau ||
english: Those whose karma and Dharma - whose actions and faith - are in the True Name of the True Lord

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taa kai sad balihaarai jaau ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jo har raate se jan paravaan ||
english: Those who are imbued with the Lord are accepted and respected.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin kee sa(n)gat param nidhaan ||2||
english: In their company, the supreme wealth is obtained. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har var jin paaiaa dhan naaree ||
english: Blessed is that bride, who has obtained the Lord as her Husband.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har siu raatee sabad veechaaree ||
english: She is imbued with the Lord, and she reflects upon the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aap tarai sa(n)gat kul taarai ||
english: She saves herself, and saves her family and friends as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur sev tat veechaarai ||3||
english: She serves the True Guru, and contemplates the essence of reality. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hamaree jaat pat sach naau ||
english: The True Name is my social status and honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਤ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam sa(n)jam sat bhaau ||
english: The love of the Truth is my karma and Dharma - my faith and my actions, and my self-control.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੇ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak bakhase poochh na hoi ||
english: O Nanak, one who is forgiven by the Lord is not called to account.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਮੇਟੇ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥
transliteration: doojaa mete eko soi ||4||14||
english: The One Lord erases duality. ||4||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: ik aavahi ik jaavahi aaee ||
english: Some come, and after they come, they go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ik har raate rahahi samaaee ||
english: Some are imbued with the Lord; they remain absorbed in Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਧਰਨਿ ਗਗਨ ਮਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik dharan gagan mahi thaur na paavahi ||
english: Some find no place of rest at all, on the earth or in the sky.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: se karamaheen har naam na dhiaavahi ||1||
english: Those who do not meditate on the Name of the Lord are the most unfortunate. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur poore te gat mit paaee ||
english: From the Perfect Guru, the way to salvation is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਵਤ ਅਤਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ihu sa(n)saar bikh vat at bhaujal gurasabadee har paar la(n)ghaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This world is a terrifying ocean of poison; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord helps us cross over. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jinh kau aap lae prabh mel ||
english: Those, whom God unites with Himself,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਪੇਲਿ ॥
transliteration: tin kau kaal na saakai pel ||
english: cannot be crushed by death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰਹਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh niramal rahahi piaare ||
english: The beloved Gurmukhs remain immaculately pure,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਮਲ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu jal a(n)bh oopar kamal niraare ||2||
english: like the lotus in the water, which remains untouched. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: buraa bhalaa kahu kis no kaheeai ||
english: Tell me: who should we call good or bad?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਸੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: deesai braham guramukh sach laheeai ||
english: Behold the Lord God; the truth is revealed to the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਉ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: akath kathau guramat veechaar ||
english: I speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord, contemplating the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mil gur sa(n)gat paavau paar ||3||
english: I join the Sangat, the Guru's Congregation, and I find God's limits. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਦ ॥
transliteration: saasat bed si(n)mrit bahu bhed ||
english: The Shaastras, the Vedas, the Simritees and all their many secrets;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰੇਦ ॥
transliteration: athasath majan har ras red ||
english: bathing at the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage - all this is found by enshrining the sublime essence of the Lord in the heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh niramal mail na laagai ||
english: The Gurmukhs are immaculately pure; no filth sticks to them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak hiradai naam vade dhur bhaagai ||4||15||
english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides in the heart, by the greatest pre-ordained destiny. ||4||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: niv niv paai lagau gur apune aatam raam nihaariaa ||
english: Bowing down, again and again, I fall at the Feet of my Guru; through Him, I have seen the Lord, the Divine Self, within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karat beechaar hiradai har raviaa hiradai dekh beechaariaa ||1||
english: Through contemplation and meditation, the Lord dwells within the heart; see this, and understand. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bolahu raam kare nisataaraa ||
english: So speak the Lord's Name, which shall emancipate you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੈ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad ratan har laabhai mitai agiaan hoi ujeeaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the jewel of the Lord is found; ignorance is dispelled, and the Divine Light shines forth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਵਨੀ ਰਵੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਨਹੀ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ravanee ravai ba(n)dhan nahee tootahi vich haumai bharam na jaaee ||
english: By merely saying it with the tongue, one's bonds are not broken, and egotism and doubt do not depart from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੂਟੈ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta haumai tootai taa ko lekhai paaee ||2||
english: But when one meets the True Guru, egotism departs, and then, one realizes his destiny. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam bhagat pri preetam sukh saagar ur dhaare ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet and dear to His devotees; it is the ocean of peace - enshrine it within the heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal jagajeevan daataa mat guramat har nisataare ||3||
english: The Lover of His devotees, the Life of the World, the Lord bestows the Guru's Teachings upon the intellect, and one is emancipated. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੂਝਿ ਮਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: man siu joojh marai prabh paae manasaa manahi samaae ||
english: One who dies fighting against his own stubborn mind finds God, and the desires of the mind are quieted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak kripaa kare jagajeevan sahaj bhaai liv laae ||4||16||
english: O Nanak, if the Life of the World bestows His Mercy, one is intuitively attuned to the Love of the Lord. ||4||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
transliteration: kis kau kahahi sunaavahi kis kau kis samajhaavahi samajh rahe ||
english: Unto whom do they speak? Unto whom do they preach? Who understands? Let them understand themselves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੈ ਪੜਾਵਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਗੁਣਿ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kisai paRaavahi paR gun boojhe satigur sabad sa(n)tokh rahe ||1||
english: Who do they teach? Through study, they come to realize the Lord's Glorious Virtues. Through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, they come to dwell in contentment. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਮਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aisaa guramat ramat sareeraa ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, realize that He is pervading in all bodies;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bhaj mere man gahir ga(n)bheeraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O my soul, vibrate on the Profound, Unfathomable Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: anat tara(n)g bhagat har ra(n)gaa ||
english: Loving devotion to the Lord brings endless waves of joy and delight.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੂਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: anadin sooche har gun sa(n)gaa ||
english: One who dwells with the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day, is sanctified.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa janam saakat sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The birth into the world of the faithless cynic is totally useless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam bhagat jan rahai niraaraa ||2||
english: The humble devotee of the Lord remains unattached. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਚੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: soochee kaaiaa har gun gaaiaa ||
english: The body which sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord is sanctified.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aatam cheen rahai liv laaiaa ||
english: The soul remains conscious of the Lord, absorbed in His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aad apaar apara(n)par heeraa ||
english: The Lord is the Infinite Primal Being, beyond the beyond, the priceless jewel.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਿ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: laal rataa meraa man dheeraa ||3||
english: My mind is totally content, imbued with my Beloved. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਕਹਹਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੇ ਮੂਏ ॥
transliteration: kathanee kahahi kahahi se mooe ||
english: Those who speak and babble on and on, are truly dead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂੰ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: so prabh door naahee prabh too(n) hai ||
english: God is not far away - O God, You are right here.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag dekhiaa maaiaa chhaaiaa ||
english: I have seen that the whole world is engrossed in Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak guramat naam dhiaaiaa ||4||17||
english: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||17||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਤਿਤੁਕਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 titukaa ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl, Thi-Thukay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਭੀਖਕੁ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: koee bheekhak bheekhiaa khaai ||
english: One is a beggar, living on charity;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: koee raajaa rahiaa samaai ||
english: another is a king, absorbed in himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਅਪਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kis hee maan kisai apamaan ||
english: One receives honor, and another dishonor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਧਰੇ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: dhaahi usaare dhare dhiaan ||
english: The Lord destroys and creates; He is enshrined in His meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਵਡਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tujh te vadaa naahee koi ||
english: There is no other as great as You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੀ ਚੰਗਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kis vekhaalee cha(n)gaa hoi ||1||
english: So whom should I present to You? Who is good enough? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਤਾਂ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mai taa(n) naam teraa aadhaar ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my only Support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) daataa karanahaar karataar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are the Great Giver, the Doer, the Creator. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ਵੀਗਾ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vaat na paavau veegaa jaau ||
english: I have not walked on Your Path; I have followed the crooked path.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: daragah baisan naahee thaau ||
english: In the Court of the Lord, I find no place to sit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: man kaa a(n)dhulaa maaiaa kaa ba(n)dh ||
english: I am mentally blind, in the bondage of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੀਨ ਖਰਾਬੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਕੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: kheen kharaab hovai nit ka(n)dh ||
english: The wall of my body is breaking down, wearing away, growing weaker.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: khaan jeevan kee bahutee aas ||
english: You have such high hopes of eating and living

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ॥੨॥
transliteration: lekhai terai saas giraas ||2||
english: - your breaths and morsels of food are already counted! ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: ahinis a(n)dhule deepak dei ||
english: Night and day they are blind - please, bless them with Your Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਉਜਲ ਡੂਬਤ ਚਿੰਤ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaujal doobat chi(n)t karei ||
english: They are drowning in the terrifying world-ocean, crying out in pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਜੋ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kahahi sunahi jo maanahi naau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who chant,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaarai taa kai jaau ||
english: Hear and believe in the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak ek kahai aradaas ||
english: Nanak utters this one prayer;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh terai paas ||3||
english: soul and body, all belong to You, Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) too(n) dehi japee teraa naau ||
english: When You bless me, I chant Your Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣ ਹੋਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: daragah baisan hovai thaau ||
english: Thus I find my seat in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) tudh bhaavai taa duramat jaai ||
english: When it pleases You, evil-mindedness departs,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: giaan ratan man vasai aai ||
english: and the jewel of spiritual wisdom comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa satigur milai ||
english: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then one comes to meet the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak bhavajal tarai ||4||18||
english: Prays Nanak, carry us across the terrifying world-ocean. ||4||18||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ₆ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 pa(n)chapade₆ ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਧੇਨੁ ਪੰਖ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਕਾਮਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: dudh bin dhen pa(n)kh bin pa(n)khee jal bin utabhuj kaam naahee ||
english: A cow without milk; a bird without wings; a garden without water - totally useless!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਸਲਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਅੰਧੀ ਕੋਠੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kiaa sulataan salaam vihoonaa a(n)dhee kothee teraa naam naahee ||1||
english: What is an emperor, without respect? The chamber of the soul is so dark, without the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: kee visarahi dukh bahutaa laagai ||
english: How could I ever forget You? It would be so painful!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dukh laagai too(n) visar naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I would suffer such pain - no, I shall not forget You! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਜੀਭ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੰਨੀ ਪਵਣੁ ਨ ਵਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: akhee a(n)dh jeebh ras naahee ka(n)nee pavan na vaajai ||
english: The eyes grow blind, the tongue does not taste, and the ears do not hear any sound.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣੀ ਚਲੈ ਪਜੂਤਾ ਆਗੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: charanee chalai pajootaa aagai vin sevaa phal laage ||2||
english: He walks on his feet only when supported by someone else; without serving the Lord, such are the fruits of life. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਾਗ ਭੁਇ ਚੋਖੀ ਸਿੰਚਿਤ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: akhar birakh baag bhui chokhee si(n)chit bhaau karehee ||
english: The Word is the tree; the garden of the heart is the farm; tend it, and irrigate it with the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabhanaa phal laagai naam eko bin karamaa kaise lehee ||3||
english: All these trees bear the fruit of the Name of the One Lord; but without the karma of good actions, how can anyone obtain it? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਫਲੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jete jee tete sabh tere vin sevaa phal kisai naahee ||
english: As many living beings are there are, they are all Yours. Without selfless service, no one obtains any reward.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਰਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: dukh sukh bhaanaa teraa hovai vin naavai jeeu rahai naahee ||4||
english: Pain and pleasure come by Your Will; without the Name, the soul does not even exist. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਜਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: mat vich maran jeevan hor kaisaa jaa jeevaa taa(n) jugat naahee ||
english: To die in the Teachings is to live. Otherwise, what is life? That is not the way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਜੀਆ ਜਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੫॥੧੯॥
transliteration: kahai naanak jeevaale jeeaa jah bhaavai tah raakh tuhee ||5||19||
english: Says Nanak, He grants life to the living beings; O Lord, please keep me according to Your Will. ||5||19||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੈ ਧੋਤੀ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa brahamaa man hai dhotee ||
english: Let the body be the Brahmin, and let the mind be the loin-cloth;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜਨੇਊ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕੁਸਪਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: giaan janeoo dhiaan kusapaatee ||
english: let spiritual wisdom be the sacred thread, and meditation the ceremonial ring.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਜਸੁ ਜਾਚਉ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har naamaa jas jaachau naau ||
english: I seek the Name of the Lord and His Praise as my cleansing bath.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee braham samaau ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, I am absorbed into God. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਐਸਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: paa(n)de aisaa braham beechaar ||
english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, contemplate God in such a way

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਚਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਪੜਉ ਨਾਮੇ ਚਜੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naame such naamo paRau naame chaj aachaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: that His Name may sanctify you, that His Name may be your study, and His Name your wisdom and way of life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਨੇਊ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: baahar janeoo jichar jot hai naal ||
english: The outer sacred thread is worthwhile only as long as the Divine Light is within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੋਤੀ ਟਿਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: dhotee tikaa naam samaal ||
english: So make the remembrance of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, your loin-cloth and the ceremonial mark on your forehead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: aithai othai nibahee naal ||
english: Here and hereafter, the Name alone shall stand by you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vin naavai hor karam na bhaal ||2||
english: Do not seek any other actions, except the Name. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਰਜਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: poojaa prem maaiaa parajaal ||
english: Worship the Lord in loving adoration, and burn your desire for Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: eko vekhahu avar na bhaal ||
english: Behold only the One Lord, and do not seek out any other.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੀਨੑੈ ਤਤੁ ਗਗਨ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: cheenhai tat gagan das duaar ||
english: Become aware of reality, in the Sky of the Tenth Gate;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਠ ਪੜੈ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har mukh paath paRai beechaar ||3||
english: read aloud the Lord's Word, and contemplate it. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: bhojan bhaau bharam bhau bhaagai ||
english: With the diet of His Love, doubt and fear depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਹਰੂਅਰਾ ਛਬਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: paaharooaraa chhab chor na laagai ||
english: With the Lord as your night watchman, no thief will dare to break in.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲਕੁ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
transliteration: tilak lilaat jaanai prabh ek ||
english: Let the knowledge of the One God be the ceremonial mark on your forehead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: boojhai braham a(n)tar bibek ||4||
english: Let the realization that God is within you be your discrimination. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਚਾਰੀ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aachaaree nahee jeetiaa jaai ||
english: Through ritual actions, God cannot be won over;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਠ ਪੜੈ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paath paRai nahee keemat paai ||
english: by reciting sacred scriptures, His value cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਦਸੀ ਚਹੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: asat dasee chahu bhed na paaiaa ||
english: The eighteen Puraanas and the four Vedas do not know His mystery.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak satigur braham dikhaaiaa ||5||20||
english: O Nanak, the True Guru has shown me the Lord God. ||5||20||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sevak daas bhagat jan soee ||
english: He alone is the selfless servant, slave and humble devotee,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: thaakur kaa daas guramukh hoee ||
