english: who as Gurmukh, becomes the slave of his Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jin sir saajee tin phun goee ||
english: He, who created the Universe, shall ultimately destroy it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na koee ||1||
english: Without Him, there is no other at all. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saach naam gur sabad veechaar ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Gurmukh reflects upon the True Name;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saache saachai darabaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the True Court, he is found to be true. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਅਰਜੁ ਸਚੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: sachaa araj sachee aradaas ||
english: The true supplication, the true prayer

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: mahalee khasam sune saabaas ||
english: - within the Mansion of His Sublime Presence, the True Lord Master hears and applauds these.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sachai takhat bulaavai soi ||
english: He summons the truthful to His Heavenly Throne

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: de vadiaaee kare s hoi ||2||
english: and bestows glorious greatness upon them; that which He wills, comes to pass. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: teraa taan toohai deebaan ||
english: The Power is Yours; You are my only Support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad sach neesaan ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is my true password.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)ne hukam s paragat jaai ||
english: One who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, goes to Him openly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sach neesaanai thaak na paai ||3||
english: With the password of truth, his way is not blocked. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਵੇਦੁ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit paRahi vakhaanahi ved ||
english: The Pandit reads and expounds on the Vedas,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar vasat na jaanahi bhed ||
english: but he does not know the secret of the thing within himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur bin sojhee boojh na hoi ||
english: Without the Guru, understanding and realization are not obtained;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: saachaa rav rahiaa prabh soi ||4||
english: but still God is True, pervading everywhere. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਆਖਾ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: kiaa hau aakhaa aakh vakhaanee ||
english: What should I say, or speak or describe?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape jaanahi sarab vidaanee ||
english: Only You Yourself know, O Lord of total wonder.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਦਰੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak eko dar deebaan ||
english: Nanak takes the Support of the Door of the One God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਤਹਾ ਗੁਦਰਾਣੁ ॥੫॥੨੧॥
transliteration: guramukh saach tahaa gudaraan ||5||21||
english: There, at the True Door, the Gurmukhs sustain themselves. ||5||21||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaachee gaagar deh duhelee upajai binasai dukh paaee ||
english: The clay pitcher of the body is miserable; it suffers in pain through birth and death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ihu jag saagar dutar kiu tareeai bin har gur paar na paaee ||1||
english: How can this terrifying world-ocean be crossed over? Without the Lord - Guru, it cannot be crossed. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin avar na koee mere piaare tujh bin avar na koi hare ||
english: Without You, there is no other at all, O my Beloved; without you, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਰੂਪੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarabee ra(n)gee roopee too(n)hai tis bakhase jis nadar kare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are in all colors and forms; he alone is forgiven, upon whom You bestow Your Glance of Grace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸੁ ਬੁਰੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਿਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਣ ਨ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saas buree ghar vaas na devai pir siu milan na dei buree ||
english: Maya, my mother-in-law, is evil; she does not let me live in my own home. The vicious one does not let me meet with my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਸਾਜਨੀ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਚਰਨ ਸਰੇਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sakhee saajanee ke hau charan sarevau har gur kirapaa te nadar dharee ||2||
english: I serve at the feet of my companions and friends; the Lord has showered me with His Mercy, through Guru's Grace. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤੁਮ ਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਅਵਰੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aap beechaar maar man dekhiaa tum saa meet na avar koee ||
english: Reflecting upon my self, and conquering my mind, I have seen that there is no other friend like You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu too(n) raakhahi tiv hee rahanaa dukh sukh devahi karahi soee ||3||
english: As You keep me, so do I live. You are the Giver of peace and pleasure. Whatever You do, comes to pass. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਦੋਊ ਬਿਨਾਸਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਭਈ ॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa dooo binaasat trihu gun aas niraas bhaee ||
english: Hope and desire have both been dispelled; I have renounced my longing for the three qualities.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਰੀਆਵਸਥਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਲਹੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tureeaavasathaa guramukh paaeeai sa(n)t sabhaa kee ot lahee ||4||
english: The Gurmukh obtains the state of ecstasy, taking to the Shelter of the Saints' Congregation. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan sagale sabh jap tap jis har hiradai alakh abhevaa ||
english: All wisdom and meditation, all chanting and penance, come to one whose heart is filled with the Invisible, Inscrutable Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੫॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam man raataa guramat paae sahaj sevaa ||5||22||
english: O Nanak, one whose mind is imbued with the Lord's Name, finds the Guru's Teachings, and intuitively serves. ||5||22||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ₂ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 pa(n)chapade₂ ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: mohu kuta(n)b mohu sabh kaar ||
english: Your attachment to your family, your attachment to all your affairs

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਤਜਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mohu tum tajahu sagal vekaar ||1||
english: - renounce all your attachments, for they are all corrupt. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਬੀਰ ॥
transliteration: mohu ar bharam tajahu tumh beer ||
english: Renounce your attachments and doubts, O brother,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਰਵੈ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saach naam ride ravai sareer ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and dwell upon the True Name within your heart and body. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sach naam jaa nav nidh paaee ||
english: When one receives the nine treasures of the True Name,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵੈ ਪੂਤੁ ਨ ਕਲਪੈ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: rovai poot na kalapai maaee ||2||
english: his children do not weep, and his mother does not grieve. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਡੂਬਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: et mohi doobaa sa(n)saar ||
english: In this attachment, the world is drowning.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਉਤਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh koee utarai paar ||3||
english: Few are the Gurmukhs who swim across. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: et mohi phir joonee paahi ||
english: In this attachment, people are reincarnated over and over again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੇ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: mohe laagaa jam pur jaahi ||4||
english: Attached to emotional attachment, they go to the city of Death. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੇ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur deekhiaa le jap tap kamaahi ||
english: You have received the Guru's Teachings - now practice meditation and penance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੂਟੈ ਨਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naa mohu tootai naa thaai paahi ||5||
english: If attachment is not broken, no one is approved. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa ehu mohu jaai ||
english: But if He bestows His Glance of Grace, then this attachment departs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥੨੩॥
transliteration: naanak har siu rahai samaai ||6||23||
english: O Nanak, then one remains merged in the Lord. ||6||23||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aap kare sach alakh apaar ||
english: He Himself does everything, the True, Invisible, Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਤੂੰ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hau paapee too(n) bakhasanahaar ||1||
english: I am a sinner, You are the Forgiver. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: teraa bhaanaa sabh kichh hovai ||
english: By Your Will, everything come to pass.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੋਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: manahath keechai a(n)t vigovai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who acts in stubborn-mindedness is ruined in the end. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਆਪੀ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kee mat kooR viaapee ||
english: The intellect of the self-willed manmukh is engrossed in falsehood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਪਾਪਿ ਸੰਤਾਪੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin har simaran paap sa(n)taapee ||2||
english: Without the meditative remembrance of the Lord, it suffers in sin. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੇਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: duramat tiaag laahaa kichh levahu ||
english: Renounce evil-mindedness, and you shall reap the rewards.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਹੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo upajai so alakh abhevahu ||3||
english: Whoever is born, comes through the Unknowable and Mysterious Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਹਮਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aisaa hamaraa sakhaa sahaaee ||
english: Such is my Friend and Companion;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur har miliaa bhagat driRaaee ||4||
english: meeting with the Guru, the Lord, devotion was implanted within me. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲਂੀ ਸਉਦਂੀ ਤੋਟਾ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sagala(n)ee sauda(n)ee totaa aavai ||
english: In all other transactions, one suffers loss.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੫॥੨੪॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam man bhaavai ||5||24||
english: The Name of the Lord is pleasing to Nanak's mind. ||5||24||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ₄ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 chaupade₄ ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਤਾਂ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: vidiaa veechaaree taa(n) paraupakaaree ||
english: Contemplate and reflect upon knowledge, and you will become a benefactor to others.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਪੰਚ ਰਾਸੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa(n) pa(n)ch raasee taa(n) teerath vaasee ||1||
english: When you conquer the five passions, then you shall come to dwell at the sacred shrine of pilgrimage. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਵਾਜੈ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: ghu(n)gharoo vaajai je man laagai ||
english: You shall hear the vibrations of the tinkling bells, when your mind is held steady.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਜਮੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ਆਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tau jam kahaa kare mo siu aagai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: So what can the Messenger of Death do to me hereafter? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਤਉ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥
transliteration: aas niraasee tau sa(n)niaasee ||
english: When you abandon hope and desire, then you become a true Sannyaasi.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਜਤੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾਂ ਕਾਇਆ ਭੋਗੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa(n) jat jogee taa(n) kaaiaa bhogee ||2||
english: When the Yogi practices abstinence, then he enjoys his body. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਦਿਗੰਬਰੁ ਦੇਹ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: daiaa diga(n)bar deh beechaaree ||
english: Through compassion, the naked hermit reflects upon his inner self.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮਰੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਨਹ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap marai avaraa nah maaree ||3||
english: He slays his own self, instead of slaying others. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਰਿ ਵੇਸ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ek too hor ves bahutere ||
english: You, O Lord, are the One, but You have so many Forms.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਚੋਜ ਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੪॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak jaanai choj na tere ||4||25||
english: Nanak does not know Your wondrous plays. ||4||25||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨ ਭਰੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਿ ਧੋਵਾ ॥
transliteration: ek na bhareeaa gun kar dhovaa ||
english: I am not stained by only one sin, that could be washed clean by virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: meraa sahu jaagai hau nis bhar sovaa ||1||
english: My Husband Lord is awake, while I sleep through the entire night of my life. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਿਉ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਹੋਵਾ ॥
transliteration: iu kiu ka(n)t piaaree hovaa ||
english: In this way, how can I become dear to my Husband Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਉ ਨਿਸ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sahu jaagai hau nis bhar sovaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My Husband Lord remains awake, while I sleep through the entire night of my life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਵਾ ॥
transliteration: aas piaasee sejai aavaa ||
english: With hope and desire, I approach His Bed,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਸਹ ਭਾਵਾ ਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aagai sah bhaavaa k na bhaavaa ||2||
english: but I do not know whether He will be pleased with me or not. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa jaanaa kiaa hoigaa ree maaee ||
english: How do I know what will happen to me, O my mother?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har darasan bin rahan na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, I cannot survive. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਤਿਸ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: prem na chaakhiaa meree tis na bujhaanee ||
english: I have not tasted His Love, and my thirst is not quenched.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਇਆ ਸੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gaiaa s joban dhan pachhutaanee ||3||
english: My beautiful youth has run away, and now I, the soul-bride, repent and regret. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਜਾਗਉ ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ॥
transliteration: ajai s jaagau aas piaasee ||
english: Even now, I am held by hope and desire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਈਲੇ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਰਹਉ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaeele udaasee rahau niraasee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am depressed; I have no hope at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਇ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: haumai khoi kare seegaar ||
english: She overcomes her egotism, and adorns herself;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tau kaaman sejai ravai bhataar ||4||
english: the Husband Lord now ravishes and enjoys the soul-bride on His Bed. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਤੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tau naanak ka(n)tai man bhaavai ||
english: Then, O Nanak, the bride becomes pleasing to the Mind of her Husband Lord;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਅਪਣੇ ਖਸਮ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: chhod vadaaee apane khasam samaavai ||1|| rahaau ||26||
english: she sheds her self-conceit, and is absorbed in her Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||26||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਇਆਣੀ ॥
transliteration: pevakaRai dhan kharee iaanee ||
english: In this world of my father's house, I, the soul-bride, have been very childish;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis sah kee mai saar na jaanee ||1||
english: I did not realize the value of my Husband Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sahu meraa ek doojaa nahee koee ||
english: My Husband is the One; there is no other like Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare melaavaa hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then I shall meet Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਧਨ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saahuraRai dhan saach pachhaaniaa ||
english: In the next world of my in-law's house, I, the the soul-bride, shall realize Truth;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sahaj subhaai apanaa pir jaaniaa ||2||
english: I shall come to know the celestial peace of my Husband Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਐਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee aisee mat aavai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, such wisdom comes to me,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੰਤੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa(n) kaaman ka(n)tai man bhaavai ||3||
english: so that the soul-bride becomes pleasing to the Mind of the Husband Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭੈ ਭਾਵ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kahat naanak bhai bhaav kaa kare seegaar ||
english: Says Nanak, she who adorns herself with the Love and the Fear of God,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੭॥
transliteration: sad hee sejai ravai bhataar ||4||27||
english: enjoys her Husband Lord forever on His Bed. ||4||27||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਪੂਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: na kis kaa poot na kis kee maaee ||
english: No one is anyone else's son, and no one is anyone else's mother.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jhoothai mohi bharam bhulaaee ||1||
english: Through false attachments, people wander around in doubt. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਹਉ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mere saahib hau keetaa teraa ||
english: O My Lord and Master, I am created by You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਪੀ ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) too(n) dehi japee naau teraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If You give it to me, I will chant Your Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਕੂਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bahute augan kookai koee ||
english: That person who is filled with all sorts of sins may pray at the Lord's Door,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai bakhase soee ||2||
english: but he is forgiven only when the Lord so wills. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee duramat khoee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, evil-mindedness is destroyed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah eko soee ||3||
english: Wherever I look, there I find the One Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kahat naanak aisee mat aavai ||
english: Says Nanak, if one comes to such an understanding,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਕੋ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੨੮॥
transliteration: taa(n) ko sache sach samaavai ||4||28||
english: then he is absorbed into the Truest of the True. ||4||28||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 dupade ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਰਵਰੜੈ ਭਈਲੇ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tit saravaraRai bhaeele nivaasaa paanee paavak tinahi keeaa ||
english: In that pool of the world, the people have their homes; there, the Lord has created water and fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਕਜੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਡੂਬੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pa(n)kaj moh pag nahee chaalai ham dekhaa tah doobeeale ||1||
english: In the mud of earthly attachment, their feet have become mired, and I have seen them drowning there. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man ek na chetas mooR manaa ||
english: O foolish people, why don't you remember the One Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bisarat tere gun galiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Forgetting the Lord, your virtues shall wither away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naa hau jatee satee nahee paRiaa moorakh mugadhaa janam bhaiaa ||
english: I am not a celibate, nor am I truthful, nor a scholar; I was born foolish and ignorant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਤੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੨੯॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak tinh kee saranaa jinh too(n) naahee veesariaa ||2||29||
english: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who do not forget You, Lord. ||2||29||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਘਰ ਛਿਅ ਗੁਰ ਛਿਅ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
transliteration: chhi ghar chhi gur chhi upades ||
english: There are six systems of philosophy, six teachers, and six doctrines;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur gur eko ves anek ||1||
english: but the Teacher of teachers is the One Lord, who appears in so many forms. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jai ghar karate keerat hoi ||
english: That system, where the Praises of the Creator are sung

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: so ghar raakh vadaaee tohi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - follow that system; in it rests greatness. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸੁਏ ਚਸਿਆ ਘੜੀਆ ਪਹਰਾ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: visue chasiaa ghaReeaa paharaa thitee vaaree maahu bhaiaa ||
english: As the seconds, minutes, hours, days, weekdays months

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
transliteration: sooraj eko rut anek ||
english: And seasons all originate from the one sun,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਵੇਸ ॥੨॥੩੦॥
transliteration: naanak karate ke kete ves ||2||30||
english: O Nanak, so do all forms originate from the One Creator. ||2||30||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ghar 3 mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, Third House, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਸਕਰ ਲਖ ਵਾਜੇ ਨੇਜੇ ਲਖ ਉਠਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: lakh lasakar lakh vaaje neje lakh uth karahi salaam ||
english: You may have thousands of armies, thousands of marching bands and lances, and thousands of men to rise and salute you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਲਖ ਉਠਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: lakhaa upar phuramaais teree lakh uth raakhahi maan ||
english: Your rule may extend over thousands of miles, and thousands of men may rise to honor you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਰਾਫਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa(n) pat lekhai naa pavai taa(n) sabh niraaphal kaam ||1||
english: But, if your honor is of no account to the Lord, then all of your ostentatious show is useless. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam binaa jag dha(n)dhaa ||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, the world is in turmoil.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਭੋਲਾ ਭੀ ਸੋ ਅੰਧੋ ਅੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: je bahutaa samajhaaeeai bholaa bhee so a(n)dho a(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Even though the fool may be taught again and again, he remains the blindest of the blind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਖਟੀਅਹਿ ਲਖ ਸੰਜੀਅਹਿ ਖਾਜਹਿ ਲਖ ਆਵਹਿ ਲਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: lakh khateeahi lakh sa(n)jeeahi khaajahi lakh aavahi lakh jaahi ||
english: You may earn thousands, collect thousands, and spend thousands of dollars; thousands may come, and thousands may go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਅ ਕਿਥੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa(n) pat lekhai naa pavai taa(n) jee kithai phir paahi ||2||
english: But, if your honor is of no account to the Lord, then where will you go to find a safe haven? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ ਲਖ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
transliteration: lakh saasat samajhaavanee lakh pa(n)dit paRahi puraan ||
english: Thousands of Shaastras may be explained to the mortal, and thousands of Pandits may read the Puraanas to him;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭੇ ਕੁਪਰਵਾਣ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa(n) pat lekhai naa pavai taa(n) sabhe kuparavaan ||3||
english: but, if his honor is of no account to the Lord, then all of this is unacceptable. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sach naam pat oopajai karam naam karataar ||
english: Honor comes from the True Name, the Name of the Merciful Creator.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
transliteration: ahinis hiradai je vasai naanak nadaree paar ||4||1||31||
english: If it abides in the heart, day and night, O Nanak, then the mortal shall swim across, by His Grace. ||4||1||31||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਵਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
transliteration: deevaa meraa ek naam dukh vich paaiaa tel ||
english: The One Name is my lamp; I have put the oil of suffering into it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਨਿ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਖਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: un chaanan ohu sokhiaa chookaa jam siu mel ||1||
english: Its flame has dried up this oil, and I have escaped my meeting with the Messenger of Death. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਾ ਮਤ ਕੋ ਫਕੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: lokaa mat ko phakaR paai ||
english: O people, do not make fun of me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਮੜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਏਕਠੇ ਏਕ ਰਤੀ ਲੇ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: lakh maRiaa kar ekathe ek ratee le bhaahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Thousands of wooden logs, piled up together, need only a tiny flame to burn. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਤਲਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਕੇਸਉ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pi(n)d patal meree kesau kiriaa sach naam karataar ||
english: The Lord is my festive dish, of rice balls on leafy plates; the True Name of the Creator Lord is my funeral ceremony.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਏਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aithai othai aagai paachhai ehu meraa aadhaar ||2||
english: Here and hereafter, in the past and in the future, this is my support. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਸਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਨਾਵੈ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)g banaaras siphat tumaaree naavai aatam raau ||
english: The Lord's Praise is my River Ganges and my city of Benares; my soul takes its sacred cleansing bath there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sachaa naavan taa(n) theeai jaa(n) ahinis laagai bhaau ||3||
english: That becomes my true cleansing bath, if night and day, I enshrine love for You. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਲੋਕੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਛਮਿਛਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਵਟਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik lokee hor chhamichharee braahaman vat pi(n)d khaai ||
english: The rice balls are offered to the gods and the dead ancestors, but it is the Brahmins who eat them!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਕਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨਿਖੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
transliteration: naanak pi(n)d bakhasees kaa kabahoo(n) nikhootas naahi ||4||2||32||
english: O Nanak, the rice balls of the Lord are a gift which is never exhausted. ||4||2||32||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ghar 4 mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth House, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੀਏ ॥
transliteration: devatiaa darasan kai taaee dookh bhookh teerath keee ||
english: The Gods, yearning for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, suffered through pain and hunger at the sacred shrines.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਵੇ ਭੇਖ ਭਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jogee jatee jugat mahi rahate kar kar bhagave bhekh bhae ||1||
english: The yogis and the celibates live their disciplined lifestyle, while others wear saffron robes and become hermits. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: tau kaaran saahibaa ra(n)g rate ||
english: For Your sake, O Lord Master, they are imbued with love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕਾ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕੇਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tere naam anekaa roop ana(n)taa kahan na jaahee tere gun kete ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your Names are so many, and Your Forms are endless. No one can tell how may Glorious Virtues You have. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਲਾਇਤਿ ਦੇਸ ਗਏ ॥
transliteration: dar ghar mahalaa hasatee ghoRe chhod vilaait des gae ||
english: Leaving behind hearth and home, palaces, elephants, horses and native lands, mortals have journeyed to foreign lands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਪੇਕਾਂਬਰ ਸਾਲਿਕ ਸਾਦਿਕ ਛੋਡੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: peer pekaa(n)bar saalik saadik chhodee duneeaa thaai pae ||2||
english: The spiritual leaders, prophets, seers and men of faith renounced the world, and became acceptable. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਦ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ ਕਾਪੜ ਛੋਡੇ ਚਮੜ ਲੀਏ ॥
transliteration: saad sahaj sukh ras kas tajeeale kaapaR chhode chamaR leee ||
english: Renouncing tasty delicacies, comfort, happiness and pleasures, some have abandoned their clothes and now wear skins.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀਏ ਦਰਦਵੰਦ ਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਭਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dukheee daradava(n)d dar terai naam rate daraves bhae ||3||
english: Those who suffer in pain, imbued with Your Name, have become beggars at Your Door. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਲੜੀ ਖਪਰੀ ਲਕੜੀ ਚਮੜੀ ਸਿਖਾ ਸੂਤੁ ਧੋਤੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ॥
transliteration: khalaRee khaparee lakaRee chamaRee sikhaa soot dhotee keenhee ||
english: Some wear skins, and carry begging bowls, bearing wooden staffs, and sitting on deer skins. Others raise their hair in tufts and wear sacred threads and loin-cloths.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹਉ ਸਾਂਗੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੈਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੩॥
transliteration: too(n) saahib hau saa(n)gee teraa pranavai naanak jaat kaisee ||4||1||33||
english: You are the Lord Master, I am just Your puppet. Prays Nanak, what is my social status to be? ||4||1||33||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ghar 5 mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth House, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਗੁਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: bheetar pa(n)ch gupat man vaase ||
english: The five evil passions dwell hidden within the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: thir na rahahi jaise bhavahi udaase ||1||
english: They do not remain still, but move around like wanderers. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: man meraa daiaal setee thir na rahai ||
english: My soul does not stay held by the Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੀ ਕਪਟੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਧਿਕ ਲਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: lobhee kapatee paapee paakha(n)dee maaiaa adhik lagai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It is greedy, deceitful, sinful and hypocritical, and totally attached to Maya. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫੂਲ ਮਾਲਾ ਗਲਿ ਪਹਿਰਉਗੀ ਹਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: phool maalaa gal pahiraugee haaro ||
english: I will decorate my neck with garlands of flowers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੈਗਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਤਬ ਕਰਉਗੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: milaigaa preetam tab karaugee seegaaro ||2||
english: When I meet my Beloved, then I will put on my decorations. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਖੀ ਹਮ ਏਕੁ ਭਤਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch sakhee ham ek bhataaro ||
english: I have five companions and one Spouse.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੇਡਿ ਲਗੀ ਹੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ped lagee hai jeeaRaa chaalanahaaro ||3||
english: It is ordained from the very beginning, that the soul must ultimately depart. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਖੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੁਦਨੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch sakhee mil rudan karehaa ||
english: The five companions will lament together.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁ ਪਜੂਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
transliteration: saahu pajootaa pranavat naanak lekhaa dehaa ||4||1||34||
english: When the soul is trapped, prays Nanak, it is called to account. ||4||1||34||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ghar 6 mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, Sixth House, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਜੇ ਗਹਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਉਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੂਤ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: man motee je gahanaa hovai paun hovai soot dhaaree ||
english: If the pearl of the mind is strung like a jewel on the thread of the breath,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਰਾਵੈ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khimaa seegaar kaaman tan pahirai raavai laal piaaree ||1||
english: and the soul-bride adorns her body with compassion, then the Beloved Lord will enjoy His lovely bride. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮੋਹੀ ॥
transliteration: laal bahu gun kaaman mohee ||
english: O my Love, I am fascinated by Your many glories;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅਵਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tere gun hohi na avaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your Glorious Virtues are not found in any other. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਲੇ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਦਾਮੋਦਰੁ ਦੰਤੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
transliteration: har har haar ka(n)th le pahirai daamodar da(n)t leee ||
english: If the bride wears the garland of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, around her neck, and if she uses the toothbrush of the Lord;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੰਗਨ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਧਰੇਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kar kar karataa ka(n)gan pahirai in bidh chit dhareee ||2||
english: and if she fashions and wears the bracelet of the Creator Lord around her wrist, then she shall hold her consciousness steady. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਕਰ ਮੁੰਦਰੀ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਟੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
transliteration: madhusoodan kar mu(n)daree pahirai paramesar pat leee ||
english: She should make the Lord, the Slayer of demons, her ring, and take the Transcendent Lord as her silken clothes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੜੀ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰਮਾ ਦੇਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dheeraj dhaRee ba(n)dhaavai kaaman sreera(n)g suramaa deee ||3||
english: The soul-bride should weave patience into the braids of her hair, and apply the lotion of the Lord, the Great Lover. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਜੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਜਾਲੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੇਜ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
transliteration: man ma(n)dar je deepak jaale kaaiaa sej kareee ||
english: If she lights the lamp in the mansion of her mind, and makes her body the bed of the Lord,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਾਉ ਜਬ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਵੈ ਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੫॥
transliteration: giaan raau jab sejai aavai ta naanak bhog kareee ||4||1||35||
english: then, when the King of spiritual wisdom comes to her bed, He shall take her, and enjoy her. ||4||1||35||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: keetaa hovai kare karaaiaa tis kiaa kaheeai bhaaee ||
english: The created being acts as he is made to act; what can be said to him, O Siblings of Destiny?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa keete kiaa chaturaaee ||1||
english: Whatever the Lord is to do, He is doing; what cleverness could be used to affect Him? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: teraa hukam bhalaa tudh bhaavai ||
english: The Order of Your Will is so sweet, O Lord; this is pleasing to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naanak taa kau milai vadaaee saache naam samaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Nanak, he alone is honored with greatness, who is absorbed in the True Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kirat paiaa paravaanaa likhiaa baahuR hukam na hoee ||
english: The deeds are done according to pre-ordained destiny; no one can turn back this Order.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤੈਸਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaisaa likhiaa taisaa paRiaa met na sakai koee ||2||
english: As it is written, so it comes to pass; no one can erase it. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਵੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: je ko daragah bahutaa bolai naau pavai baajaaree ||
english: He who talks on and on in the Lord's Court is known as a joker.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਰੰਜ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਚੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satara(n)j baajee pakai naahee kachee aavai saaree ||3||
english: He is not successful in the game of chess, and his chessmen do not reach their goal. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: naa ko paRiaa pa(n)dit beenaa naa ko moorakh ma(n)daa ||
english: By himself, no one is literate, learned or wise; no one is ignorant or evil.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਦੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹੀਐ ਬੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੬॥
transliteration: ba(n)dee a(n)dar siphat karaae taa kau kaheeai ba(n)daa ||4||2||36||
english: When, as a slave, one praises the Lord, only then is he known as a human being. ||4||2||36||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਖਿਮਾ ਹਢਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad manai mahi mu(n)draa khi(n)thaa khimaa hadhaavau ||
english: Let the Word of the Guru's Shabad be the ear-rings in your mind, and wear the patched coat of tolerance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਉ ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo kichh karai bhalaa kar maanau sahaj jog nidh paavau ||1||
english: Whatever the Lord does, look upon that as good; thus you shall obtain the treasure of Sehj Yoga. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗ ਜੋਗੀ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੰ ॥
transliteration: baabaa jugataa jeeu jugah jug jogee param ta(n)t mahi joga(n) ||
english: O father, the soul which is united in union as a Yogi, remains united in the supreme essence throughout the ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam nira(n)jan paaiaa giaan kaaiaa ras bhoga(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who has obtained the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord - his body enjoys the pleasure of spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸਉ ਕਲਪ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
transliteration: siv nagaree mahi aasan baisau kalap tiaagee baada(n) ||
english: In the Lord's City, he sits in his Yogic posture, and he forsakes his desires and conflicts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਦੰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: si(n)ngee sabad sadaa dhun sohai ahinis poorai naada(n) ||2||
english: The sound of the horn ever rings out its beautiful melody, and day and night, he is filled with the sound current of the Naad. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਬਿਭੂਤੰ ॥
transliteration: pat veechaar giaan mat da(n)daa varatamaan bibhoota(n) ||
english: My cup is reflective meditation, and spiritual wisdom is my walking stick; to dwell in the Lord's Presence is the ashes I apply to my body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਅਤੀਤੰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har keerat raharaas hamaaree guramukh pa(n)th ateeta(n) ||3||
english: The Praise of the Lord is my occupation; and to live as Gurmukh is my pure religion. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੰਮਿਆ ਨਾਨਾ ਵਰਨ ਅਨੇਕੰ ॥
transliteration: sagalee jot hamaaree sa(n)miaa naanaa varan aneka(n) ||
english: My arm-rest is to see the Lord's Light in all, although their forms and colors are so numerous.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਏਕੰ ॥੪॥੩॥੩੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sun bharathar jogee paarabraham liv eka(n) ||4||3||37||
english: Says Nanak, listen, O Bharthari Yogi: love only the Supreme Lord God. ||4||3||37||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਵੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: guR kar giaan dhiaan kar dhaavai kar karanee kas paaeeai ||
english: Make spiritual wisdom your molasses, and meditation your scented flowers; let good deeds be the herbs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਠੀ ਭਵਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਾ ਪੋਚਾ ਇਤੁ ਰਸਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਚੁਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhaathee bhavan prem kaa pochaa it ras amiu chuaaeeai ||1||
english: Let devotional faith be the distilling fire, and your love the ceramic cup. Thus the sweet nectar of life is distilled. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜ ਰੰਗ ਰਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: baabaa man matavaaro naam ras peevai sahaj ra(n)g rach rahiaa ||
english: O Baba, the mind is intoxicated with the Naam, drinking in its Nectar. It remains absorbed in the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਬਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਗਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ahinis banee prem liv laagee sabad anaahad gahiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Night and day, remaining attached to the Love of the Lord, the celestial music of the Shabad resounds. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪੀਆਏ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: pooraa saach piaalaa sahaje tisahi peeaae jaa kau nadar kare ||
english: The Perfect Lord naturally gives the cup of Truth, to the one upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਦਿ ਛੂਛੈ ਭਾਉ ਧਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit kaa vaapaaree hovai kiaa mad chhoochhai bhaau dhare ||2||
english: One who trades in this Nectar - how could he ever love the wine of the world? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੀਵਤ ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur kee saakhee a(n)mrit baanee peevat hee paravaan bhaiaa ||
english: The Teachings of the Guru, the Ambrosial Bani - drinking them in, one becomes acceptable and renowned.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੈ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dar darasan kaa preetam hovai mukat baiku(n)thai karai kiaa ||3||
english: Unto the one who loves the Lord's Court, and the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, of what use is liberation or paradise? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਾ ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: siphatee rataa sad bairaagee jooai janam na haarai ||
english: Imbued with the Lord's Praises, one is forever a Bairaagee, a renunciate, and one's life is not lost in the gamble.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਖੀਵਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sun bharathar jogee kheevaa a(n)mrit dhaarai ||4||4||38||
english: Says Nanak, listen, O Bharthari Yogi: drink in the intoxicating nectar of the Lord. ||4||4||38||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੁਰਾਸਾਨ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਹਿੰਦੁਸਤਾਨੁ ਡਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: khuraasaan khasamaanaa keeaa hi(n)dusataan daraaiaa ||
english: Having attacked Khuraasaan, Baabar terrified Hindustan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਗਲੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aapai dos na deee karataa jam kar mugal chaRaaiaa ||
english: The Creator Himself does not take the blame, but has sent the Mugal as the messenger of death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤੀ ਮਾਰ ਪਈ ਕਰਲਾਣੇ ਤੈਂ ਕੀ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: etee maar paee karalaane tai(n) kee darad na aaiaa ||1||
english: There was so much slaughter that the people screamed. Didn't You feel compassion, Lord? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: karataa too(n) sabhanaa kaa soee ||
english: O Creator Lord, You are the Master of all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਕਤਾ ਸਕਤੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: je sakataa sakate kau maare taa man ros na hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If some powerful man strikes out against another man, then no one feels any grief in their mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਕਤਾ ਸੀਹੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੈ ਵਗੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਸਾ ਪੁਰਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sakataa seehu maare pai vagai khasamai saa purasaaee ||
english: But if a powerful tiger attacks a flock of sheep and kills them, then its master must answer for it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਵਿਗਾੜਿ ਵਿਗੋਏ ਕੁਤਂੀ ਮੁਇਆ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ratan vigaaR vigoe kuta(n)ee muiaa saar na kaaee ||
english: This priceless country has been laid waste and defiled by dogs, and no one pays any attention to the dead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape joR vichhoRe aape vekh teree vadiaaee ||2||
english: You Yourself unite, and You Yourself separate; I gaze upon Your Glorious Greatness. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਏ ਵਡਾ ਸਾਦ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: je ko naau dharaae vadaa saad kare man bhaane ||
english: One may give himself a great name, and revel in the pleasures of the mind,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਕੀੜਾ ਆਵੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਚੁਗੈ ਦਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: khasamai nadaree keeRaa aavai jete chugai daane ||
english: but in the Eyes of the Lord and Master, he is just a worm, for all the corn that he eats.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥੩॥੫॥੩੯॥
transliteration: mar mar jeevai taa kichh paae naanak naam vakhaane ||3||5||39||
english: Only one who dies to his ego while yet alive, obtains the blessings, O Nanak, by chanting the Lord's Name. ||3||5||39||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 2 mahalaa 3 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Second House, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: har darasan paavai vadabhaag ||
english: The Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is obtained by great good fortune.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad sachai bairaag ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, true detachment is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: khat darasan varatai varataaraa ||
english: The six systems of philosophy are pervasive,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kaa darasan agam apaaraa ||1||
english: but the Guru's system is profound and unequalled. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai darasan mukat gat hoi ||
english: The Guru's system is the way to liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saachaa aap vasai man soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Lord Himself comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur darasan udharai sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Through the Guru's system, the world is saved,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਲਾਏ ਭਾਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: je ko laae bhaau piaaraa ||
english: if it is embraced with love and affection.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਲਾਏ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaau piaaraa laae viralaa koi ||
english: How rare is that person who truly loves the Guru's Way.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kai darasan sadaa sukh hoi ||2||
english: Through the Guru's system, everlasting peace is obtained. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kai darasan mokh duaar ||
english: Through the Guru's system, the Door of Salvation is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevai paravaar saadhaar ||
english: Serving the True Guru, one's family is saved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕਉ ਗਤਿ ਕਾਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: nigure kau gat kaaee naahee ||
english: There is no salvation for those who have no Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: avagan muthe chotaa khaahee ||3||
english: Beguiled by worthless sins, they are struck down. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad sukh saa(n)t sareer ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the body finds peace and tranquility.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
transliteration: guramukh taa kau lagai na peer ||
english: The Gurmukh is not afflicted by pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jamakaal tis neR na aavai ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not come near him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੦॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh saach samaavai ||4||1||40||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in the True Lord. ||4||1||40||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮੁਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad muaa vichahu aap gavaai ||
english: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, eradicates his self-conceit from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve til na tamaai ||
english: He serves the True Guru, with no iota of self-interest.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau daataa sadaa man hoi ||
english: The Fearless Lord, the Great Giver, ever abides in his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sachee baanee paae bhaag koi ||1||
english: The True Bani of the Word is obtained only by good destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਅਉਗੁਣ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gun sa(n)grahu vichahu augun jaahi ||
english: So gather merits, and let your demerits depart from within you.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kai sabad samaahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall be absorbed into the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gunaa kaa gaahak hovai so gun jaanai ||
english: One who purchases merits, knows the value of these merits.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit sabad naam vakhaanai ||
english: He chants the Ambrosial Nectar of the Word, and the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੂਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saachee baanee soochaa hoi ||
english: Through the True Bani of the Word, he becomes pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gun te naam paraapat hoi ||2||
english: Through merit, the Name is obtained. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਅਮੋਲਕ ਪਾਏ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gun amolak paae na jaahi ||
english: The invaluable merits cannot be acquired.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: man niramal saachai sabad samaahi ||
english: The pure mind is absorbed into the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: se vadabhaagee jinh naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: How very fortunate are those who meditate on the Naam,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sadaa gunadaataa ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||3||
english: and ever enshrine in their minds the Lord, the Giver of merit. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo gun sa(n)grahai tinh balihaarai jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who gather merits.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dar saachai saache gun gaau ||
english: At the Gate of Truth, I sing the Glorious Praises of the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape devai sahaj subhaai ||
english: He Himself spontaneously bestows His gifts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੧॥
transliteration: naanak keemat kahan na jaai ||4||2||41||
english: O Nanak, the value of the Lord cannot be described. ||4||2||41||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur vich vadee vadiaaee ||
english: Great is the greatness of the True Guru;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: chiree vichhu(n)ne mel milaaee ||
english: He merges in His Merger, those who have been separated for so long.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape mele mel milaae ||
english: He Himself merges the merged in His Merger.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aapanee keemat aape paae ||1||
english: He Himself knows His own worth. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har kee keemat kin bidh hoi ||
english: How can anyone appraise the Lord's worth?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har apara(n)par agam agochar gur kai sabad milai jan koi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one may merge with the Infinite, Unapproachable and Incomprehensible Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh keemat jaanai koi ||
english: Few are the Gurmukhs who know His worth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: virale karam paraapat hoi ||
english: How rare are those who receive the Lord's Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਊਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: oochee baanee oochaa hoi ||
english: Through the Sublime Bani of His Word, one becomes sublime.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh sabad vakhaanai koi ||2||
english: The Gurmukh chants the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai dukh darad sareer ||
english: Without the Name, the body suffers in pain;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਉਤਰੈ ਪੀਰ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhete taa utarai peer ||
english: but when one meets the True Guru, then that pain is removed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur bhete dukh kamaai ||
english: Without meeting the Guru, the mortal earns only pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: manamukh bahutee milai sajaai ||3||
english: The self-willed manmukh receives only more punishment. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਅਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam meethaa at ras hoi ||
english: The essence of the Lord's Name is so very sweet;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਤ ਰਹੈ ਪੀਆਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: peevat rahai peeaae soi ||
english: he alone drinks it, whom the Lord causes to drink it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te har ras paae ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the essence of the Lord is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate gat paae ||4||3||42||
english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, salvation is attained. ||4||3||42||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa gahir ga(n)bheer ||
english: My God is True, deep and profound.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਤ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
transliteration: sevat hee sukh saa(n)t sareer ||
english: Serving Him, the body acquires peace and tranquility.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੇ ਜਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad tare jan sahaj subhaai ||
english: Through the Word of the Shabad, His humble servants easily swim across.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਮ ਸਦ ਲਾਗਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin kai ham sad laagah paai ||1||
english: I fall at their feet forever and ever. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo man raate har ra(n)g laai ||
english: Those being whose minds are imbued and drenched with the Lord's Love

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tin kaa janam maran dukh laathaa te har daragah mile subhaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - their pains of birth and death are taken away. They are automatically ushered into the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਚਾਖੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabad chaakhai saachaa saad paae ||
english: One who has tasted the Shabad, obtains the true flavor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: The Name of the Lord abides within his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har prabh sadaa rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: The Lord God is Eternal and All-pervading.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape neRai aape door ||2||
english: He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਿ ਆਖੈ ਬਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aakhan aakhai bakai sabh koi ||
english: Everyone talks and speaks through speech;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape bakhas milaae soi ||
english: the Lord Himself forgives, and unites us with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਣੈ ਕਥਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kahanai kathan na paaiaa jaai ||
english: By merely speaking and talking, He is not obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur parasaad vasai man aai ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, He comes to abide in the mind. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh vichahu aap gavaai ||
english: The Gurmukh eradicates his self-conceit from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g raate mohu chukaai ||
english: He is imbued with the Lord's Love, having discarded worldly attachment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: at niramal gurasabad veechaar ||
english: He contemplates the utterly Immaculate Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੪॥੪੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam savaaranahaar ||4||4||43||
english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is our Salvation. ||4||4||43||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਗੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai lage dukh paaiaa ||
english: Attached to the love of duality, one only incurs pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||
english: Without the Word of the Shabad, one's life is wasted away in vain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevai sojhee hoi ||
english: Serving the True Guru, understanding is obtained,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai na laagai koi ||1||
english: and then, one is not attached to the love of duality. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: mool laage se jan paravaan ||
english: Those who hold fast to their roots, become acceptable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anadin raam naam jap hiradai gurasabadee har eko jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Night and day, they meditate within their hearts on the Lord's Name; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they know the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਡਾਲੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: daalee laagai nihaphal jaai ||
english: One who is attached to the branch, does not receive the fruits.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਂੀ ਕੰਮੀ ਅੰਧ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dha(n)ee ka(n)mee a(n)dh sajaai ||
english: For blind actions, blind punishment is received.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhaa thaur na paai ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bisataa kaa keeRaa bisataa maahi pachaai ||2||
english: He is a maggot in manure, and in manure he shall rot away. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa sadaa sukh paae ||
english: Serving the Guru, everlasting peace is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)gat mil har gun gaae ||
english: Joining the True Congregation, the Sat Sangat, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naame naam kare veechaar ||
english: One who contemplates the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap tarai kul udharanahaar ||3||
english: saves himself, and his family as well. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kee baanee naam vajaae ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, the Naam resounds;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naanak mahal sabad ghar paae ||
english: O Nanak, through the Word of the Shabad, one finds the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within the home of the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramat sat sar har jal naaiaa ||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, bathe in the Pool of Truth, in the Water of the Lord;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੪੪॥
transliteration: duramat mail sabh durat gavaaiaa ||4||5||44||
english: thus the filth of evil-mindedness and sin shall all be washed away. ||4||5||44||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਗਾੜਹਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh marahi mar maran vigaaRahi ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are dying; they are wasting away in death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਆਤਮ ਸੰਘਾਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai aatam sa(n)ghaarahi ||
english: In the love of duality, they murder their own souls.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa meraa kar kar vigootaa ||
english: Crying out, Mine, mine!, they are ruined.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aatam na cheenhai bharamai vich sootaa ||1||
english: They do not remember their souls; they are asleep in superstition. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰੁ ਮੁਇਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mar muiaa sabade mar jaai ||
english: He alone dies a real death, who dies in the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮ ਜਾਣਾਈ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: usatat ni(n)daa gur sam jaanaaee is jug mahi laahaa har jap lai jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru has inspired me to realize, that praise and slander are one and the same; in this world, the profit is obtained by chanting the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣ ਗਰਭ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naam vihoon garabh gal jaai ||
english: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are dissolved within the womb.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: birathaa janam doojai lobhaai ||
english: Useless is the birth of those who are lured by duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਣੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਜਲੈ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naam bihoonee dukh jalai sabaaee ||
english: Without the Naam, all are burning in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur poorai boojh bujhaaee ||2||
english: The Perfect True Guru has given me this understanding. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਬਹੁ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man cha(n)chal bahu chotaa khaai ||
english: The fickle mind is struck down so many times.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਥਹੁ ਛੁੜਕਿਆ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ethahu chhuRakiaa thaur na paai ||
english: Having lost this opportunity, no place of rest shall be found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: garabh jon visataa kaa vaas ||
english: Cast into the womb of reincarnation, the mortal lives in manure;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tit ghar manamukh kare nivaas ||3||
english: in such a home, the self-willed manmukh takes up residence. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: apune satigur kau sadaa bal jaaee ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jotee jot milaaee ||
english: the light of the Gurmukh blends with the Divine Light of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: niramal baanee nij ghar vaasaa ||
english: Through the Immaculate Bani of the Word, the mortal dwells within the home of his own inner self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੪੫॥
transliteration: naanak haumai maare sadaa udaasaa ||4||6||45||
english: O Nanak, he conquers his ego, and remains forever detached. ||4||6||45||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: laalai aapanee jaat gavaaee ||
english: The Lord's slave sets aside his own social status.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tan man arape satigur saranaaee ||
english: He dedicates his mind and body to the True Guru, and seeks His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: hiradai naam vadee vadiaaee ||
english: His greatest greatness is that the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is in his heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa preetam prabh hoi sakhaaee ||1||
english: The Beloved Lord God is his constant companion. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਲਾਲਾ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so laalaa jeevat marai ||
english: He alone is the Lord's slave, who remains dead while yet alive.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਗੁ ਹਰਖੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sog harakh dui sam kar jaanai gur parasaadee sabad udharai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He looks upon pleasure and pain alike; by Guru's Grace, he is saved through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: karanee kaar dhurahu phuramaaee ||
english: He does his deeds according to the Lord's Primal Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕੋ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai ko thaai na paaee ||
english: Without the Shabad, no one is approved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: karanee keerat naam vasaaee ||
english: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, the Naam abides within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape devai dhil na paaee ||2||
english: He Himself gives His gifts, without hesitation. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bharam bhulai sa(n)saar ||
english: The self-willed manmukh wanders around the world in doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਕੂੜਾ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin raasee kooRaa kare vaapaar ||
english: Without any capital, he makes false transactions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਵਖਰੁ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vin raasee vakhar palai na paai ||
english: Without any capital, he does not obtain any merchandise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: manamukh bhulaa janam gavaai ||3||
english: The mistaken manmukh wastes away his life. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁ ਲਾਲਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve s laalaa hoi ||
english: One who serves the True Guru is the Lord's slave.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਜਾਤੀ ਊਤਮੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ootam jaatee ootam soi ||
english: His social status is exalted, and his reputation is exalted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur pauRee sabh doo oochaa hoi ||
english: Climbing the Guru's Ladder, he becomes the most exalted of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੬॥
transliteration: naanak naam vadaaee hoi ||4||7||46||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, greatness is obtained. ||4||7||46||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠੋ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh jhootho jhooth kamaavai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh practices falsehood, only falsehood.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: khasamai kaa mahal kade na paavai ||
english: He never attains the Mansion of the Lord Presence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: doojai lagee bharam bhulaavai ||
english: Attached to duality, he wanders, deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਬਾਧਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mamataa baadhaa aavai jaavai ||1||
english: Entangled in worldly attachments, he comes and goes. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਾ ਮਨ ਦੇਖੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dohaaganee kaa man dekh seegaar ||
english: Behold, the decorations of the discarded bride!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤਿ ਧਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਝੂਠੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: putr kalat dhan maaiaa chit laae jhooth mohu paakha(n)d vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Her consciousness is attached to children, spouse, wealth, and Maya, falsehood, emotional attachment, hypocrisy and corruption. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sohaagan jo prabh bhaavai ||
english: She who is pleasing to God is forever a happy soul-bride.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee seegaar banaavai ||
english: She makes the Word of the Guru's Shabad her decoration.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sej sukhaalee anadin har raavai ||
english: Her bed is so comfortable; she enjoys her Lord, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mil preetam sadaa sukh paavai ||2||
english: Meeting her Beloved, the obtains eternal peace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saa sohaagan saachee jis saach piaar ||
english: She is a true, virtuous soul-bride, who enshrines love for the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: apanaa pir raakhai sadaa ur dhaar ||
english: She keeps her Husband Lord always clasped to her heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨੇੜੈ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: neRai vekhai sadaa hadoor ||
english: She sees Him near at hand, ever-present.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: meraa prabh sarab rahiaa bharapoor ||3||
english: My God is all-pervading everywhere. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aagai jaat roop na jaai ||
english: Social status and beauty will not go with you hereafter.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਹਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tehaa hovai jehe karam kamaai ||
english: As are the deeds done here, so does one become.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabade oocho oochaa hoi ||
english: Through the Word of the Shabad, one becomes the highest of the high.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੭॥
transliteration: naanak saach samaavai soi ||4||8||47||
english: O Nanak, he is absorbed in the True Lord. ||4||8||47||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤਾ ਜਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat rataa jan sahaj subhaai ||
english: The Lord's humble servant is imbued with devotional love, effortlessly and spontaneously.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bhai saachai saach samaai ||
english: Through awe and fear of the Guru, he is truly absorbed in the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur poore bhagat na hoi ||
english: Without the Perfect Guru, devotional love is not obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਅਪਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: manamukh ru(n)ne apanee pat khoi ||1||
english: The self-willed manmukhs lose their honor, and cry out in pain. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man har jap sadaa dhiaai ||
english: O my mind, chant the Lord's Name, and meditate on Him forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d hovai din raatee jo ichhai soee phal paai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall always be in ecstasy, day and night, and you shall obtain the fruits of your desires. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur poore te pooraa paae ||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, the Perfect Lord is obtained,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hiradai sabad sach naam vasaae ||
english: and the Shabad, the True Name, is enshrined in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar niramal a(n)mrit sar naae ||
english: One who bathes in the Pool of Ambrosial Nectar becomes immaculately pure within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa sooche saach samaae ||2||
english: He becomes forever sanctified, and is absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har prabh vekhai sadaa hajoor ||
english: He sees the Lord God ever-present.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: By Guru's Grace, he sees the Lord permeating and pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਜਾਉ ਤਹ ਵੇਖਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jahaa jaau tah vekhaa soi ||
english: Wherever I go, there I see Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur bin daataa avar na koi ||3||
english: Without the Guru, there is no other Giver. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: gur saagar pooraa bha(n)daar ||
english: The Guru is the ocean, the perfect treasure,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ootam ratan javaahar apaar ||
english: the most precious jewel and priceless ruby.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee devanahaar ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Great Giver blesses us;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੯॥੪੮॥
transliteration: naanak bakhase bakhasanahaar ||4||9||48||
english: O Nanak, the Forgiving Lord forgives us. ||4||9||48||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur saair satigur sach soi ||
english: The Guru is the Ocean; the True Guru is the Embodiment of Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag gur sevaa hoi ||
english: Through perfect good destiny, one serves the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: so boojhai jis aap bujhaae ||
english: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself inspires to understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sev karaae ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, one serves Him. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨਿ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
