transliteration: giaan ratan sabh sojhee hoi ||
english: With the jewel of spiritual wisdom, total understanding is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad agiaan binaasai anadin jaagai vekhai sach soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, ignorance is dispelled; one then remains wakeful, night and day, and beholds the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mohu gumaan gur sabad jalaae ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, attachment and pride are burnt away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: poore gur te sojhee paae ||
english: From the Perfect Guru, true understanding is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar mahal gur sabad pachhaanai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one realizes the Lord's Presence within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aavan jaan rahai thir naam samaane ||2||
english: Then, one's coming and going cease, and one becomes stable, absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa hai sa(n)saar ||
english: The world is tied to birth and death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh achet maaiaa mohu gubaar ||
english: The unconscious, self-willed manmukh is enveloped in the darkness of Maya and emotional attachment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬਹੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: par ni(n)daa bahu kooR kamaavai ||
english: He slanders others, and practices utter falsehood.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: visataa kaa keeRaa visataa maahi samaavai ||3||
english: He is a maggot in manure, and into manure he is absorbed. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mil sabh sojhee paae ||
english: Joining the True Congregation, the Sat Sangat, total understanding is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad har bhagat driRaae ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, devotional love for the Lord is implanted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaanaa ma(n)ne sadaa sukh hoi ||
english: One who surrenders to the Lord's Will is peaceful forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੯॥
transliteration: naanak sach samaavai soi ||4||10||49||
english: O Nanak, he is absorbed into the True Lord. ||4||10||49||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ₂ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 pa(n)chapade₂ ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: sabad marai tis sadaa ana(n)d ||
english: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, finds eternal bliss.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhete gur gobi(n)d ||
english: He is united with the True Guru, the Guru, the Lord God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naa phir marai na aavai jaai ||
english: He does not die any more, and he does not come or go.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poore gur te saach samaai ||1||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, he merges with the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: jinh kau naam likhiaa dhur lekh ||
english: One who has the Naam, the Name of the Lord, written in his pre-ordained destiny,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: te anadin naam sadaa dhiaavahi gur poore te bhagat visekh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: night and day, meditates forever on the Naam; he obtains the wondrous blessing of devotional love from the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jinh kau har prabh lae milaai ||
english: Those, whom the Lord God has blended with Himself

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tinh kee gahan gat kahee na jaai ||
english: their sublime state cannot be described.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਿਤੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: poorai satigur ditee vadiaaee ||
english: The Perfect True Guru has given the Glorious Greatness,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ootam padavee har naam samaaee ||2||
english: of the most exalted order, and I am absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh kare s aape aap ||
english: Whatever the Lord does, He does all by Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: ek ghaRee mahi thaap uthaap ||
english: In an instant, He establishes, and disestablishes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਣਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kahi kahi kahanaa aakh sunaae ||
english: By merely speaking, talking, shouting and preaching about the Lord,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਘਾਲੇ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je sau ghaale thaai na paae ||3||
english: Even hundreds of times, the mortal is not approved. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jinh kai potai pu(n)n tinhaa guroo milaae ||
english: The Guru meets with those, who take virtue as their treasure;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sach baanee gur sabad sunaae ||
english: they listen to the True Word of the Guru's Bani, the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾਂ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਤਹਾਂ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jahaa(n) sabad vasai tahaa(n) dukh jaae ||
english: Pain departs, from that place where the Shabad abides.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: giaan ratan saachai sahaj samaae ||4||
english: By the jewel of spiritual wisdom, one is easily absorbed into the True Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naavai jevad hor dhan naahee koi ||
english: No other wealth is as great as the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis no bakhase saachaa soi ||
english: It is bestowed only by the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: poorai sabad ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: Through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, it abides in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥੧੧॥੫੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate sukh paae ||5||11||50||
english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, peace is obtained. ||5||11||50||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nirat kare bahu vaaje vajaae ||
english: One may dance and play numerous instruments;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਬੋਲਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ihu man a(n)dhaa bolaa hai kis aakh sunaae ||
english: but this mind is blind and deaf, so for whose benefit is this speaking and preaching?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਅਨਲ ਵਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar lobh bharam anal vaau ||
english: Deep within is the fire of greed, and the dust-storm of doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਵਾ ਬਲੈ ਨ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: deevaa balai na sojhee paai ||1||
english: The lamp of knowledge is not burning, and understanding is not obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat ghat chaanan hoi ||
english: The Gurmukh has the light of devotional worship within his heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aap pachhaan milai prabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Understanding his own self, he meets God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh nirat har laagai bhaau ||
english: The Gurmukh's dance is to embrace love for the Lord;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਤਾਲ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: poore taal vichahu aap gavaai ||
english: to the beat of the drum, he sheds his ego from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa aape jaan ||
english: My God is True; He Himself is the Knower of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad a(n)tar braham pachhaan ||2||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Creator Lord within yourself. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat a(n)tar preet piaar ||
english: The Gurmukh is filled with devotional love for the Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad sahaj veechaar ||
english: He intuitively reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat jugat sach soi ||
english: For the Gurmukh, loving devotional worship is the way to the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d bhagat nirat dukh hoi ||3||
english: But the dances and the worship of the hypocrites bring only pain. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਨੁ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ehaa bhagat jan jeevat marai ||
english: True Devotion is to remain dead while yet alive.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee bhavajal tarai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one crosses over the terrible world-ocean.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan bhagat thaai paai ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, one's devotion is accepted,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har jeeu aap vasai man aai ||4||
english: and then, the Dear Lord Himself comes to dwell in the mind. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har kripaa kare satiguroo milaae ||
english: When the Lord bestows His Mercy, He leads us to meet the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nihachal bhagat har siu chit laae ||
english: Then, one's devotion becomes steady, and the consciousness is centered upon the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat rate tinh sachee soi ||
english: Those who are imbued with Devotion have truthful reputations.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੨॥੫੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate sukh hoi ||5||12||51||
english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, peace is obtained. ||5||12||51||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ghar 8 kaaphee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har kai bhaanai satigur milai sach sojhee hoee ||
english: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, one meets the True Guru, and true understanding is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee man vasai har boojhai soee ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Lord abides in the mind, and one comes to understand the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਸਹੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: mai sahu daataa ek hai avar naahee koee ||
english: My Husband Lord, the Great Giver, is One. There is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te man vasai taa sadaa sukh hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's merciful favor, He abides in the mind, and then, a lasting peace ensues. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: is jug mahi nirabhau har naam hai paaeeai gur veechaar ||
english: In this age, the Lord's Name is fearless; it is obtained by meditative reflection upon the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin naavai jam kai vas hai manamukh a(n)dh gavaar ||2||
english: Without the Name, the blind, foolish, self-willed manmukh is under Death's power. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har kai bhaanai jan sevaa karai boojhai sach soee ||
english: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, the humble being performs His service, and understands the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har kai bhaanai saalaaheeai bhaanai ma(n)niai sukh hoee ||3||
english: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, He is to be praised; surrendering to His Will, peace ensues. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har kai bhaanai janam padaarath paaiaa mat ootam hoee ||
english: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, the prize of this human birth is obtained, and the intellect is exalted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੧੩॥੫੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam salaahi too(n) guramukh gat hoee ||4||39||13||52||
english: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, you shall be emancipated. ||4||39||13||52||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) karataa sachiaar maidaa saa(n)ee ||
english: You are the True Creator, my Lord Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥੀਸੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo tau bhaavai soee theesee jo too(n) dehi soee hau paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: That which is pleasing to Your Will, comes to pass. Whatever You give, that is what I receive. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh teree too(n) sabhanee dhiaaiaa ||
english: All are Yours; all meditate on You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis no kripaa karahi tin naam ratan paaiaa ||
english: He alone, whom You bless with Your Mercy, obtains the jewel of the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਧਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh laadhaa manamukh gavaaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukhs obtain it, and the self-willed manmukhs lose it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tudh aap vichhoRiaa aap milaaiaa ||1||
english: You Yourself separate the mortals, and You Yourself unite them. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: too(n) dareeaau sabh tujh hee maahi ||
english: You are the River - all are within You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin doojaa koee naahi ||
english: Other than You, there is no one at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh teraa khel ||
english: All beings and creatures are your play-things.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vijog mil vichhuRiaa sa(n)jogee mel ||2||
english: The united ones are separated, and the separated ones are re-united. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jis no too jaanaaihi soee jan jaanai ||
english: That humble being, whom You inspire to understand, understands;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: har gun sad hee aakh vakhaanai ||
english: he continually speaks and chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin har seviaa tin sukh paaiaa ||
english: One who serves the Lord, obtains peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sahaje hee har naam samaaiaa ||3||
english: He is easily absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: too aape karataa teraa keeaa sabh hoi ||
english: You Yourself are the Creator; by Your doing, all things come to be.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tudh bin doojaa avar na koi ||
english: Without You, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: too kar kar vekhahi jaanahi soi ||
english: You watch over the creation, and understand it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੫੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak guramukh paragat hoi ||4||1||53||
english: O servant Nanak, the Lord is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||4||1||53||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 2 mahalaa 4 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Second House, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kis hee dhaRaa keeaa mitr sut naal bhaaee ||
english: Some form alliances with friends, children and siblings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਕੁੜਮ ਸਕੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kis hee dhaRaa keeaa kuRam sake naal javaaee ||
english: Some form alliances with in-laws and relatives.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kis hee dhaRaa keeaa sikadaar chaudharee naal aapanai suaaee ||
english: Some form alliances with chiefs and leaders for their own selfish motives.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਾਰਾ ਧੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hamaaraa dhaRaa har rahiaa samaaee ||1||
english: My alliance is with the Lord, who is pervading everywhere. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: ham har siu dhaRaa keeaa meree har tek ||
english: I have formed my alliance with the Lord; the Lord is my only support.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਖੁ ਧੜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mai har bin pakh dhaRaa avar na koee hau har gun gaavaa asa(n)kh anek ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Other than the Lord, I have no other faction or alliance; I sing of the countless and endless Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਧੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jinh siu dhaRe karahi se jaahi ||
english: Those with whom you form alliances, shall perish.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੁ ਧੜੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jhooth dhaRe kar pachhotaahi ||
english: Making false alliances, the mortals repent and regret in the end.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: thir na rahahi man khot kamaahi ||
english: Those who practice falsehood shall not last.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ham har siu dhaRaa keeaa jis kaa koee samarath naahi ||2||
english: I have formed my alliance with the Lord; there is no one more powerful than Him. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਸਭਿ ਧੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: eh sabh dhaRe maaiaa moh pasaaree ||
english: All these alliances are mere extensions of the love of Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਲੂਝਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa kau loojhahi gaavaaree ||
english: Only fools argue over Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: janam marahi jooai baajee haaree ||
english: They are born, and they die, and they lose the game of life in the gamble.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਜਿ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hamarai har dhaRaa j halat palat sabh savaaree ||3||
english: My alliance is with the Lord, who embellishes all, in this world and the next. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਧੜੇ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਝਗੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kalijug mahi dhaRe pa(n)ch chor jhagaRaae ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the five thieves instigate alliances and conflicts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu abhimaan vadhaae ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and self-conceit have increased.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis no kripaa kare tis satasa(n)g milaae ||
english: One who is blessed by the Lord's Grace, joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਧੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: hamaraa har dhaRaa jin eh dhaRe sabh gavaae ||4||
english: My alliance is with the Lord, who has destroyed all these alliances. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਧੜੇ ਬਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa doojaa bhaau dhaRe bahi paavai ||
english: In the false love of duality, people sit and form alliances.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਾਇਆ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਅਟਕਲੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: paraaiaa chhidr atakalai aapanaa aha(n)kaar vadhaavai ||
english: They complain about other peoples' faults, while their own self-conceit only increases.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa beejai taisaa khaavai ||
english: As they plant, so shall they harvest.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੫॥੨॥੫੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak kaa har dhaRaa dharam sabh srisat jin aavai ||5||2||54||
english: Servant Nanak has joined the Lord's alliance of Dharma, which shall conquer the whole world. ||5||2||54||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hiradai sun sun man a(n)mrit bhaaiaa ||
english: Constantly listening to the Ambrosial Gurbani in the heart, it becomes pleasing to the mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gurabaanee har alakh lakhaaiaa ||1||
english: Through Gurbani, the Incomprehensible Lord is comprehended. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਭੈਨਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam sunahu meree bhainaa ||
english: As Gurmukh, listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my sisters.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: eko rav rahiaa ghat a(n)tar mukh bolahu gur a(n)mrit bainaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The One Lord is pervading and permeating deep within the heart; with your mouth, recite the Ambrosial Hymns of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: mai man tan prem mahaa bairaag ||
english: My mind and body are filled with divine love, and great sadness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur purakh paaiaa vadabhaag ||2||
english: By great good fortune, I have obtained the True Guru, the Primal Being. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਵਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai bhavahi bikh maaiaa ||
english: In the love of duality, the mortals wander through poisonous Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhaagaheen nahee satigur paaiaa ||3||
english: The unfortunate ones do not meet the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit har ras har aap peeaaiaa ||
english: The Lord Himself inspires us to drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Elixir.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੫॥
transliteration: gur poorai naanak har paaiaa ||4||3||55||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, O Nanak, the Lord is obtained. ||4||3||55||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: merai man tan prem naam aadhaar ||
english: The Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of my mind and body.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਨਾਮੋ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam japee naamo sukh saar ||1||
english: I chant the Naam; the Naam is the essence of peace. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੈਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naam japahu mere saajan sainaa ||
english: So chant the Naam, O my friends and companions.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa mai avar na koee vadai bhaag guramukh har lainaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Naam, there is nothing else for me. By great good fortune, as Gurmukh, I have received the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa nahee jeeviaa jaai ||
english: Without the Naam, I cannot live.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag guramukh har paai ||2||
english: By great good fortune, the Gurmukhs obtain the Naam. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਕਾਲਖ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naamaheen kaalakh mukh maaiaa ||
english: Those who lack the Naam have their faces rubbed in the dirt of Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam binaa dhrig dhrig jeevaaiaa ||3||
english: Without the Naam, cursed, cursed are their lives. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਵਡਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਗ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vadaa vadaa har bhaag kar paaiaa ||
english: The Great Lord is obtained by great good destiny.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੫੬॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh naam divaaiaa ||4||4||56||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is blessed with the Naam. ||4||4||56||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavaa gun bolee baanee ||
english: I sing His Glorious Praises, and through the Word of His Bani, I speak His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh har gun aakh vakhaanee ||1||
english: As Gurmukh, I chant and recite the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: jap jap naam man bhaiaa ana(n)daa ||
english: Chanting and meditating on the Naam, my mind becomes blissful.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sat sat satigur naam diRaaiaa ras gaae gun paramaana(n)daa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru has implanted the True Name of the True Lord within me; I sing His Glorious Praises, and taste the supreme ecstasy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਗਾ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavai har jan logaa ||
english: The humble servants of the Lord sing the Lord's Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਜੋਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag paae har nirajogaa ||2||
english: By great good fortune, the detached, absolute Lord is obtained. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਵਿਹੂਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਲੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gun vihoon maaiaa mal dhaaree ||
english: Those without virtue are stained by Maya's filth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vin gun janam mue aha(n)kaaree ||3||
english: Lacking virtue, the egotistical die, and suffer reincarnation. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰੀਰਿ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟਿ ਕੀਏ ॥
transliteration: sareer sarovar gun paragat keee ||
english: The ocean of the body yields pearls of virtue.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢੀਏ ॥੪॥੫॥੫੭॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh math tat kadheee ||4||5||57||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh churns this ocean, and discovers this essence. ||4||5||57||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀ ਨਾਮੋ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naam sunee naamo man bhaavai ||
english: I listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Naam is pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag guramukh har paavai ||1||
english: By great good fortune, the Gurmukh obtains the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: naam japahu guramukh paragaasaa ||
english: Chant the Naam, as Gurmukh, and be exalted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa mai dhar nahee kaaee naam raviaa sabh saas giraasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Naam, I have no other support; the Naam is woven into all my breaths and morsels of food. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naamai surat sunee man bhaaee ||
english: The Naam illuminates my mind; listening to it, my mind is pleased.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo naam sunaavai so meraa meet sakhaaee ||2||
english: One who speaks the Naam - he alone is my friend and companion. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਹੀਣ ਗਏ ਮੂੜ ਨੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: naamaheen gae mooR na(n)gaa ||
english: Without the Naam, the fools depart naked.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pach pach mue bikh dekh pata(n)gaa ||3||
english: They burn away to death, chasing the poison of Maya, like the moth chasing the flame. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aape thaape thaap uthaape ||
english: He Himself establishes, and, having established, disestablishes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੫੮॥
transliteration: naanak naam devai har aape ||4||6||58||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself bestows the Naam. ||4||6||58||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਲਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har har vel vadhaaee ||
english: The vine of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, has taken root in the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਕ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: phal laage har rasak rasaaee ||1||
english: It bears the fruit of the Lord; its taste is so tasty! ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam jap anat tara(n)gaa ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in endless waves of joy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jap jap naam guramat saalaahee maariaa kaal jamaka(n)kar bhuia(n)gaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chant and repeat the Naam; through the Guru's Teachings praise the Lord, and slay the horrible serpent of the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har har gur mahi bhagat rakhaaee ||
english: The Lord has implanted His devotional worship in the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur tuthaa sikh devai mere bhaaee ||2||
english: When the Guru is pleased, He bestows it upon His Sikh, O my siblings of Destiny. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: haumai karam kichh bidh nahee jaanai ||
english: One who acts in ego, knows nothing about the Way.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਨਾਇ ਖਾਕੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu ku(n)char naai khaak sir chhaanai ||3||
english: He acts like an elephant, who takes a bath, and then throws dust on his head. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ॥
transliteration: je vad bhaag hovahi vad ooche ||
english: If one's destiny is great and exalted,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸੂਚੇ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੯॥
transliteration: naanak naam japahi sach sooche ||4||7||59||
english: O Nanak, one chants the Naam, the Name of the Immaculate, True Lord. ||4||7||59||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har har naam kee man bhookh lagaaee ||
english: My mind suffers hunger for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਨਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam suniai man tripatai mere bhaaee ||1||
english: Hearing the Naam, my mind is satisfied, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: naam japahu mere gurasikh meetaa ||
english: Chant the Naam, O my friends, O GurSikhs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam japahu naame sukh paavahu naam rakhahu guramat man cheetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chant the Naam, and through the Naam, obtain peace; through the Guru's Teachings, enshrine the Naam in your heart and mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਰਸਾ ॥
transliteration: naamo naam sunee man sarasaa ||
english: Hearing the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind is in bliss.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਗਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam laahaa lai guramat bigasaa ||2||
english: Reaping the profit of the Naam, through the Guru's Teachings, my soul has blossomed forth. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa kusatee moh a(n)dhaa ||
english: Without the Naam, the mortal is a leper, blinded by emotional attachment.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਦੁਖੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh nihaphal karam keee dukh dha(n)dhaa ||3||
english: All his actions are fruitless; they lead only to painful entanglements. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਪੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: har har har jas japai vadabhaagee ||
english: The very fortunate ones chant the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੮॥੬੦॥
transliteration: naanak guramat naam liv laagee ||4||8||60||
english: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, one embraces love for the Naam. ||4||8||60||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਕੇ ੩ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 4 raag aasaa ghar 6 ke 3 ||
english: Fourth Mehl, Raag Aasaa, 3 Of Sixth House :

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਥਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਥੋਥਰ ਵਾਜੈ ਬੇਨ ॥
transliteration: hath kar ta(n)t vajaavai jogee thothar vaajai ben ||
english: You may pluck the strings with your hand, O Yogi, but your playing of the harp is in vain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੇਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramat har gun bolahu jogee ihu manooaa har ra(n)g bhen ||1||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O Yogi, and this mind of yours shall be imbued with the Lord's Love. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jogee har dehu matee upades ||
english: O Yogi, give your intellect the Teachings of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਹਮ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jug jug har har eko varatai tis aagai ham aades ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord, the One Lord, is pervading throughout all the ages; I humbly bow down to Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਗ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi raag bhaat bahu bolahi ihu manooaa khelai khel ||
english: You sing in so many Ragas and harmonies, and you talk so much, but this mind of yours is only playing a game.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਵਹਿ ਕੂਪ ਸਿੰਚਨ ਕਉ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਉਠਿ ਬੈਲ ਗਏ ਚਰਿ ਬੇਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jovahi koop si(n)chan kau basudhaa uth bail gae char bel ||2||
english: You work the well and irrigate the fields, but the oxen have already left to graze in the jungle. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਮੈ ਹਰਿਆ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa nagar mahi karam har bovahu har jaamai hariaa khet ||
english: In the field of the body, plant the Lord's Name, and the Lord will sprout there, like a lush green field.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਬੈਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜੇਤੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: manooaa asathir bail man jovahu har si(n)chahu guramat jet ||3||
english: O mortal, hook up your unstable mind like an ox, and irrigate your fields with the Lord's Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਜੋ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਚੇਲ ॥
transliteration: jogee ja(n)gam srisat sabh tumaree jo dehu matee tit chel ||
english: The Yogis, the wandering Jangams, and all the world is Yours, O Lord. According to the wisdom which You give them, so do they follow their ways.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੇਲ ॥੪॥੯॥੬੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak ke prabh a(n)tarajaamee har laavahu manooaa pel ||4||9||61||
english: O Lord God of servant Nanak, O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, please link my mind to You. ||4||9||61||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਬ ਕੋ ਭਾਲੈ ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਤਾਲਾ ਕਬ ਕੋ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਰਬਾਬੁ ॥
transliteration: kab ko bhaalai ghu(n)gharoo taalaa kab ko bajaavai rabaab ||
english: How long must one search for angle bells and cymbals, and how long must one play the guitar?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਾਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਉ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਮਾਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aavat jaat baar khin laagai hau tab lag samaarau naam ||1||
english: In the brief instant between coming and going, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਐਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: merai man aisee bhagat ban aaee ||
english: Such is the devotional love which has been produced in my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau har bin khin pal rahi na sakau jaise jal bin meen mar jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Lord, I cannot live even for an instant, like the fish which dies without water. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਬ ਕੋਊ ਮੇਲੈ ਪੰਚ ਸਤ ਗਾਇਣ ਕਬ ਕੋ ਰਾਗ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਠਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kab kooo melai pa(n)ch sat gaain kab ko raag dhun uthaavai ||
english: How long must one tune the five strings, and assemble the seven singers, and how long will they raise their voices in song?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਲਤ ਚੁਨਤ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਚਸਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: melat chunat khin pal chasaa laagai tab lag meraa man raam gun gaavai ||2||
english: In the time it takes to select and assemble these musicians, a moment elapses, and my mind sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਬ ਕੋ ਨਾਚੈ ਪਾਵ ਪਸਾਰੈ ਕਬ ਕੋ ਹਾਥ ਪਸਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kab ko naachai paav pasaarai kab ko haath pasaarai ||
english: How long must one dance and stretch out one's feet, and how long must one reach out with one's hands?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਪਾਵ ਪਸਾਰਤ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: haath paav pasaarat bilam til laagai tab lag meraa man raam samhaarai ||3||
english: Stretching out one's hands and feet, there is a moment's delay; and then, my mind meditates on the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਬ ਕੋਊ ਲੋਗਨ ਕਉ ਪਤੀਆਵੈ ਲੋਕਿ ਪਤੀਣੈ ਨਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kab kooo logan kau pateeaavai lok pateenai naa pat hoi ||
english: How long must one satisfy the people, in order to obtain honor?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੬੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak har hiradai sad dhiaavahu taa jai jai kare sabh koi ||4||10||62||
english: O servant Nanak, meditate forever in your heart on the Lord, and then everyone will congratulate you. ||4||10||62||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mileeai har saadhoo mil sa(n)gat har gun gaai ||
english: Join the Sat Sangat, the Lord's True Congregation; joining the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਲਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: giaan ratan baliaa ghat chaanan agiaan a(n)dheraa jaai ||1||
english: With the sparkling jewel of spiritual wisdom, the heart is illumined, and ignorance is dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: har jan naachahu har har dhiaai ||
english: O humble servant of the Lord, let your dancing be meditation on the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਮ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aise sa(n)t milahi mere bhaaee ham jan ke dhovah paai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If only I cold meet such Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny; I would wash the feet of such servants. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere anadin har liv laai ||
english: Meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my mind; night and day, center your consciousness on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo ichhahu soee phal paavahu phir bhookh na laagai aai ||2||
english: You shall have the fruits of your desires, and you shall never feel hunger again. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape har apara(n)par karataa har aape bol bulaai ||
english: The Infinite Lord Himself is the Creator; the Lord Himself speaks, and causes us to speak.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: seee sa(n)t bhale tudh bhaavahi jinh kee pat paavahi thaai ||3||
english: The Saints are good, who are pleasing to Your Will; their honor is approved by You. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਰਾਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਿਉ ਆਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak aakh na raajai har gun jiu aakhai tiu sukh paai ||
english: Nanak is not satisfied by chanting the Lord's Glorious Praises; the more he chants them, the more he is at peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਵਣਜਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੬੩॥
transliteration: bhagat bha(n)daar deee har apune gun gaahak vanaj lai jaai ||4||11||63||
english: The Lord Himself has bestowed the treasure of devotional love; His customers purchase virtues, and carry them home. ||4||11||63||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕੇ ਕਾਫੀ₂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 8 ke kaaphee₂ mahalaa 4 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਮਰਣੁ ਧੁਰਾਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਈਐ ॥
transliteration: aaiaa maran dhuraahu haumai roeeai ||
english: Death is ordained from the very beginning, and yet ego makes us cry.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaai asathir hoeeai ||1||
english: Meditating on the Naam, as Gurmukh, one becomes stable and steady. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poore saabaas chalan jaaniaa ||
english: Blessed is the Perfect Guru, through whom the way of Death is known.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: laahaa naam s saar sabad samaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The sublime people earn the profit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they are absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਡੇਹ ਸਿ ਆਏ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poorab likhe deh s aae maaiaa ||
english: The days of one's life are pre-ordained; they will come to their end, O mother.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲੑਿ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chalan aj k kalhi dhurahu phuramaaiaa ||2||
english: One must depart, today or tomorrow, according to the Lord's Primal Order. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: birathaa janam tinaa jinhee naam visaariaa ||
english: Useless are the lives of those, who have forgotten the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੂਐ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਜਗਿ ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jooai khelan jag k ihu man haariaa ||3||
english: They play the game of chance in this world, and lose their mind. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jeevan maran sukh hoi jinhaa gur paaiaa ||
english: Those who have found the Guru are at peace, in life and in death.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੬੪॥
transliteration: naanak sache sach sach samaaiaa ||4||12||64||
english: O Nanak, the true ones are truly absorbed into the True Lord. ||4||12||64||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: janam padaarath paai naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: Having obtained the treasure of this human birth, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee bujh sach samaaiaa ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, I understand, and I am absorbed into the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jinh dhur likhiaa lekh tinhee naam kamaaiaa ||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny practice the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dar sachai sachiaar mahal bulaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Lord summons the truthful to the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar naam nidhaan guramukh paaeeai ||
english: Deep within is the treasure of the Naam; it is obtained by the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anadin naam dhiaai har gun gaaeeai ||2||
english: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar vasat anek manamukh nahee paaeeai ||
english: Deep within are infinite substances, but the self-willed manmukh does not find them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: haumai garabai garab aap khuaaeeai ||3||
english: In egotism and pride, the mortal's proud self consumes him. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: naanak aape aap aap khuaaeeai ||
english: O Nanak, his identity consumes his identical identity.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੬੫॥
transliteration: guramat man paragaas sachaa paaeeai ||4||13||65||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the mind is illumined, and meets the True Lord. ||4||13||65||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੬ ਕੇ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸੁਧੰਗ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaavaree ghar 16 ke 2 mahalaa 4 sudha(n)g ||
english: Raag Aasaavaree, 2 Of Sixteenth House, Fourth Mehl, Sudhang:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
transliteration: hau anadin har naam keeratan karau ||
english: Night and day, I sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur mo kau har naam bataaiaa hau har bin khin pal rahi na sakau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru has revealed to me the Name of the Lord; without the Lord, I cannot live, for a moment, even an instant. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ॥
transliteration: hamarai sravan simaran har keeratan hau har bin rahi na sakau hau ik khin ||
english: My ears hear the Lord's Kirtan, and I contemplate Him; without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਹੰਸੁ ਸਰਵਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaise ha(n)s saravar bin rahi na sakai taise har jan kiu rahai har sevaa bin ||1||
english: As the swan cannot live without the lake, how can the Lord's slave live without serving Him? ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਰਿਦ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਮੋਹ ਅਪਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: kinahoo(n) preet laaee doojaa bhaau rid dhaar kinahoo(n) preet laaee moh apamaan ||
english: Some enshrine love for duality in their hearts, and some pledge love for worldly attachments and ego.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੬੬॥
transliteration: har jan preet laaee har nirabaan pad naanak simarat har har bhagavaan ||2||14||66||
english: The Lord's servant embraces love for the Lord and the state of Nirvaanaa; Nanak contemplates the Lord, the Lord God. ||2||14||66||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaavaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮੋਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maaee moro preetam raam bataavahu ree maaee ||
english: O mother, my mother, tell me about my Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਹਲੁ ਬੇਲਿ ਰੀਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau har bin khin pal rahi na sakau jaise karahal bel reejhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Lord, I cannot live for a moment, even an instant; I love Him, like the camel loves the vine. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਬਿਰਕਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਮੀਤ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hamaraa man bairaag birakat bhaio har darasan meet kai taaee ||
english: My mind has become sad and distant, longing for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my Friend.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaise al kamalaa bin rahi na sakai taise mohi har bin rahan na jaaee ||1||
english: As the bumblebee cannot live without the lotus, I cannot live without the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raakh saran jagadeesur piaare mohi saradhaa poor har gusaaee ||
english: Keep me under Your Protection, O Beloved Master of the Universe; fulfill my faith, O Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੩੯॥੧੩॥੧੫॥੬੭॥
transliteration: jan naanak kai man anad hot hai har darasan nimakh dikhaaee ||2||39||13||15||67||
english: Servant Nanak's mind is filled with bliss, when he beholds the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, even for an instant. ||2||39||13||15||67||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 2 mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Second House, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin laaee preet soee phir khaaiaa ||
english: One who loves her, is ultimately devoured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬੈਠਾਲੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin sukh baithaalee tis bhau bahut dikhaaiaa ||
english: One who seats her in comfort, is totally terrified by her.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਬਾਦੇ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee meet kuta(n)b dekh bibaade ||
english: Siblings, friends and family, beholding her, argue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਆਈ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ham aaee vasagat gur parasaade ||1||
english: But she has come under my control, by Guru's Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਮੋਹਿਤ ਹੋਏ ॥
transliteration: aisaa dekh bimohit hoe ||
english: Beholding her, all are bewitched:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਨੁਖਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਭਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹਨਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhik sidh suradev manukhaa bin saadhoo sabh dhrohan dhrohe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: the strivers, the Siddhas, the demi-gods, angels and mortals. All, except the Saadhus, are deceived by her deception. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: ik phirahi udaasee tinh kaam viaapai ||
english: Some wander around as renunciates, but they are engrossed in sexual desire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: ik sa(n)chahi girahee tinh hoi na aapai ||
english: Some grow rich as householders, but she does not belong to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਲਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ik satee kahaavahi tinh bahut kalapaavai ||
english: Some call themselves men of charity, and she torments them terribly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਲਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ham har raakhe lag satigur paavai ||2||
english: The Lord has saved me, by attaching me to the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਪੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਤਪਸੀ ਭੂਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tap karate tapasee bhoolaae ||
english: She leads astray the penitents who practice penance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਹੇ ਲੋਭਿ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit mohe lobh sabaae ||
english: The scholarly Pandits are all seduced by greed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੋਹੇ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: trai gun mohe mohiaa aakaas ||
english: The world of the three qualities is enticed, and the heavens are enticed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ham satigur raakhe de kar haath ||3||
english: The True Guru has saved me, by giving me His Hand. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੀ ਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: giaanee kee hoi varatee daas ||
english: She is the slave of those who are spiritually wise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: kar joRe sevaa kare aradaas ||
english: With her palms pressed together, she serves them and offers her prayer:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jo too(n) kahahi s kaar kamaavaa ||
english: "Whatever you wish, that is what I shall do."

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak guramukh neR na aavaa ||4||1||
english: O servant Nanak, she does not draw near to the Gurmukh. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਸੂ ਤੇ ਪਿਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਵਾਖਿ ॥
transliteration: sasoo te pir keenee vaakh ||
english: I have been separated from my Beloved by Maya (my mother-in-law).

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਰ ਜਿਠਾਣੀ ਮੁਈ ਦੂਖਿ ਸੰਤਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: der jithaanee muee dookh sa(n)taap ||
english: Hope and desire (my younger brother-in-law and sister-in-law) are dying of grief.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਕੇ ਜਿਠੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: ghar ke jithere kee chookee kaan ||
english: I am no longer swayed by the fear of Death (my elder brother-in-law).

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਕੀਨੀ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pir rakhiaa keenee sughaR sujaan ||1||
english: I am protected by my All-knowing, Wise Husband Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sunahu lokaa mai prem ras paaiaa ||
english: Listen, O people: I have tasted the elixir of love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਵੈਰੀ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: durajan maare vairee sa(n)ghaare satigur mo kau har naam divaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The evil ones are dead, and my enemies are destroyed. The True Guru has given me the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: prathame tiaagee haumai preet ||
english: First, I renounced my egotistical love of myself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਲੋਗਾ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: duteeaa tiaagee logaa reet ||
english: Second, I renounced the ways of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: trai gun tiaag durajan meet samaane ||
english: Renouncing the three qualities, I look alike upon friend and enemy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਰੀਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਛਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tureeaa gun mil saadh pachhaane ||2||
english: And then, the fourth state of bliss was revealed to me by the Holy One. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sahaj guphaa mahi aasan baadhiaa ||
english: In the cave of celestial bliss, I have obtained a seat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jot saroop anaahad vaajiaa ||
english: The Lord of Light plays the unstruck melody of bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: mahaa ana(n)d gurasabad veechaar ||
english: I am in ecstasy, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pri siu raatee dhan sohaagan naar ||3||
english: Imbued with my Beloved Husband Lord, I am the blessed, happy soul-bride. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak bole braham beechaar ||
english: Servant Nanak chants the wisdom of God;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jo sune kamaavai s utarai paar ||
english: one who listens and practices it, is carried across and saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: janam na marai na aavai na jaai ||
english: He is not born, and he does not die; he does not come or go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਓਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: har setee ohu rahai samaai ||4||2||
english: He remains blended with the Lord. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਭਗਤੀ ਸੀਲਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: nij bhagatee seelava(n)tee naar ||
english: The bride shows such special devotion, and has such an agreeable disposition.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪਿ ਅਨੂਪ ਪੂਰੀ ਆਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: roop anoop pooree aachaar ||
english: Her beauty is incomparable, and her character is perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jit grihi vasai so grihu sobhaava(n)taa ||
english: The house in which she dwells is such a praiseworthy house.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜੰਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh paaee kinai viralai ja(n)taa ||1||
english: But rare are those who, as Gurmukh, attain that state||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਮ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sukaranee kaaman gur mil ham paaee ||
english: As the soul-bride of pure actions, I have met with the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਜਿ ਕਾਜਿ ਪਰਥਾਇ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaj kaaj parathaai suhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In worship, marriage and in the next world, such a soul-bride looks beautiful. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਵਸੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: jichar vasee pitaa kai saath ||
english: As long as she lived with her father,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਕੰਤੁ ਬਹੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਉਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: tichar ka(n)t bahu phirai udaas ||
english: her Husband wandered around in sadness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar sevaa sat purakh manaaiaa ||
english: I served and surrendered to the Lord, the True Being;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਆਣੀ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਤਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur aanee ghar mahi taa sarab sukh paaiaa ||2||
english: the Guru brought my bride to my home, and I obtained total happiness. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਤੀਹ ਸੁਲਖਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤਤਿ ਪੂਤ ॥
transliteration: bateeh sulakhanee sach sa(n)tat poot ||
english: She is blessed with all sublime attributes,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸੁਘੜ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: aagiaakaaree sughaR saroop ||
english: And her generations are unblemished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਛ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: ichh poore man ka(n)t suaamee ||
english: Her Husband, her Lord and Master, fulfills her heart's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਦੇਰ ਜੇਠਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sagal sa(n)tokhee der jethaanee ||3||
english: Hope and desire (my younger brother-in-law and sister-in-law) are now totally content. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਰੇਸਟ ॥
transliteration: sabh paravaarai maahi saresat ||
english: She is the most noble of all the family.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤੀ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਰ ਜੇਸਟ ॥
transliteration: matee devee devar jesat ||
english: She counsels and advises her hope and desire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s grihu jit pragatee aai ||
english: How blessed is that household, in which she has appeared.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak sukhe sukh vihaai ||4||3||
english: O servant Nanak, she passes her time in perfect peace and comfort. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤਾ ਕਰਉ ਸੋ ਪਕਨਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ॥
transliteration: mataa karau so pakan na deee ||
english: Whatever I resolve, she does not allow it to come to pass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਲ ਸੰਜਮ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਖਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: seel sa(n)jam kai nikat khaloee ||
english: She stands blocking the way of goodness and self-discipline.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ves kare bahu roop dikhaavai ||
english: She wears many disguises, and assumes many forms,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਸਨਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਵਖਿ ਵਖਿ ਭਰਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: grihi basan na deee vakh vakh bharamaavai ||1||
english: and she does not allow me to dwell in my own home. She forces me to wander around in different directions. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਇਕਿ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ghar kee naaik ghar vaas na devai ||
english: She has become the mistress of my home, and she does not allow me to live in it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਕਰਉ ਉਰਝਾਇ ਪਰੇਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jatan karau urajhaai parevai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If I try, she fights with me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਭੇਜੀ ਆਈ ਆਮਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dhur kee bhejee aaee aamar ||
english: In the beginning, she was sent as a helper,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਜੀਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰ ॥
transliteration: nau kha(n)d jeete sabh thaan thana(n)tar ||
english: but she has overwhelmed the nine continents, all places and interspaces.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਜੋਗ ਸੰਨਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: tat teerath na chhodai jog sa(n)niaas ||
english: She has not spared even the river banks, the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, the Yogis and Sannyaasees,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਅਭਿਆਸ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paR thaake si(n)mrit bed abhiaas ||2||
english: or those who tirelessly read the Simritees and study the Vedas. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਬੈਸਉ ਤਹ ਨਾਲੇ ਬੈਸੈ ॥
transliteration: jah baisau tah naale baisai ||
english: Wherever I sit, she sits there with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਲ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸੈ ॥
transliteration: sagal bhavan mahi sabal pravesai ||
english: She has imposed her power upon the whole world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਛੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hochhee saran paiaa rahan na paaee ||
english: Seeking meager protection, I am not protected from her.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu meetaa hau kai pahi jaaee ||3||
english: Tell me, O my friend: unto whom should I turn for protection? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sun upades satigur pahi aaiaa ||
english: I heard of His Teachings, and so I have come to the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur har har naam mohi ma(n)tr driRaaiaa ||
english: The Guru has implanted the Mantra of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: nij ghar vasiaa gun gaai ana(n)taa ||
english: And now, I dwell in the home of my own inner self; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: prabh milio naanak bhae achi(n)taa ||4||
english: I have met God, O Nanak, and I have become care-free. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਇਹ ਨਾਇਕਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ghar meraa ih naaik hamaaree ||
english: My home is now my own, and she is now my mistress.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਆਮਰਿ ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਦਰਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: ih aamar ham gur keee darabaaree ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||4||4||
english: She is now my servant, and the Guru has made me intimate with the Lord. ||1||Second Pause||4||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਮਤਾ ਜਿ ਪਤ੍ਰੀ ਚਲਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: prathame mataa j patree chalaavau ||
english: First, they advised me to send a letter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਏ ਮਤਾ ਦੁਇ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: duteee mataa dui maanukh pahuchaavau ||
english: Second, they advised me to send two men.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਏ ਮਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਉ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: triteee mataa kichh karau upaaiaa ||
english: Third, they advised me to make the effort and do something.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਹੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mai sabh kichh chhod prabh tuhee dhiaaiaa ||1||
english: But I have renounced everything, and I meditate only on You, God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਸਹਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa ana(n)d achi(n)t sahajaaiaa ||
english: Now, I am totally blissful, carefree and at ease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਤ ਮੁਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dusaman doot mue sukh paaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The enemies and evil-doers have perished, and I have obtained peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur mo kau deeaa upades ||
english: The True Guru has imparted the Teachings to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh har kaa des ||
english: My soul, body and everything belong to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੀ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karee s teraa taan ||
english: Whatever I do, is by Your Almighty Power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too(n) meree ot too(n)hai deebaan ||2||
english: You are my only Support, You are my only Court. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧਨੋ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈਂ ਧਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tudhano chhod jaaeeai prabh kai(n) dhar ||
english: If I were to renounce You, God, unto whom could I turn?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਨ ਬੀਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਮਸਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aan na beeaa teree samasar ||
english: There is no other, comparable to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: tere sevak kau kis kee kaan ||
english: Who else is Your servant to serve?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਬੇਬਾਣਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saakat bhoolaa phirai bebaan ||3||
english: The faithless cynics are deluded; they wander around in the wilderness. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: teree vadiaaee kahee na jaai ||
english: Your Glorious Greatness cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਕਹ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jah kah raakh laihi gal laai ||
english: Wherever I am, you save me, hugging me close in Your embrace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaaee ||
english: Nanak, Your slave, has entered Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪੈਜ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: prabh raakhee paij vajee vaadhaaee ||4||5||
english: God has preserved his honor, and congratulations are pouring in. ||4||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਦੇਸੁ ਝਾਗਿ ਸਉਦੇ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: parades jhaag saude kau aaiaa ||
english: Having wandered through foreign lands, I have come here to do business.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਣੀ ਲਾਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vasat anoop sunee laabhaaiaa ||
english: I heard of the incomparable and profitable merchandise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਰਾਸਿ ਬੰਨੑਿ ਪਲੈ ਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: gun raas ba(n)nhi palai aanee ||
english: I have gathered in my pockets my capital of virtue, and I have brought it here with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਪਟਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dekh ratan ihu man lapataanee ||1||
english: Beholding the jewel, this mind is fascinated. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: saah vaapaaree duaarai aae ||
english: I have come to the door of the Trader.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਖਰੁ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vakhar kaadhahu saudaa karaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please display the merchandise, so that the business may be transacted. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਸਾਹੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: saahi pathaaiaa saahai paas ||
english: The Trader has sent me to the Banker.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮੋਲ ਰਤਨ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: amol ratan amolaa raas ||
english: The jewel is priceless, and the capital is priceless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਟੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: visat subhaaee paaiaa meet ||
english: O my gentle brother, mediator and friend

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਉਦਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਚੀਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saudaa miliaa nihachal cheet ||2||
english: - I have obtained the merchandise, and my consciousness is now steady and stable. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਤਸਕਰ ਪਉਣ ਨ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: bhau nahee tasakar paun na paanee ||
english: I have no fear of thieves, of wind or water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਵਿਹਾਝੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaj vihaajhee sahaj lai jaanee ||
english: I have easily made my purchase, and I easily take it away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤ ਕੈ ਖਟਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sat kai khatiai dukh nahee paaiaa ||
english: I have earned Truth, and I shall have no pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sahee salaamat ghar lai aaiaa ||3||
english: I have brought this merchandise home, safe and sound. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: miliaa laahaa bhae ana(n)d ||
english: I have earned the profit, and I am happy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸਾਹ ਪੂਰੇ ਬਖਸਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n saah poore bakhasi(n)d ||
english: Blessed is the Banker, the Perfect Bestower.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ihu saudaa guramukh kinai viralai paaiaa ||
english: How rare is the Gurmukh who obtains this merchandise;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਲੀ ਖੇਪ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: sahalee khep naanak lai aaiaa ||4||6||
english: Nanak has brought this profitable merchandise home. ||4||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: gun avagan mero kachh na beechaaro ||
english: He does not consider my merits or demerits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸਂੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: nah dekhio roop ra(n)g sa(n)eegaaro ||
english: He does not look at my beauty, color or decorations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਜ ਅਚਾਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: chaj achaar kichh bidh nahee jaanee ||
english: I do not know the ways of wisdom and good conduct.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baah pakar pri sejai aanee ||1||
english: But taking me by the arm, my Husband Lord has led me to His Bed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿਬੋ ਸਖੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਕੀਅਲੋ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sunibo sakhee ka(n)t hamaaro keealo khasamaanaa ||
english: Hear, O my companions, my Husband, my Lord Master, possesses me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨੈ ਇਹੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਅਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar masatak dhaar raakhio kar apunaa kiaa jaanai ihu lok ajaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Placing His Hand upon my forehead, He protects me as His Own. What do these ignorant people know? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਅਬ ਹੁਣਿ ਸੋਹਿਓ ॥
transliteration: suhaag hamaaro ab hun sohio ||
english: My married life now appears so beauteous;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮੇਰੋ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜੋਹਿਓ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)t milio mero sabh dukh johio ||
english: my Husband Lord has met me, and He sees all my pains.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਂਗਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਚੰਦ ॥
transliteration: aa(n)gan merai sobhaa cha(n)d ||
english: Within the courtyard of my heart, the glory of the moon shines.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਨੰਦ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nis baasur pri sa(n)g ana(n)d ||2||
english: Night and day, I have fun with my Beloved. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲ ॥
transliteration: basatr hamaare ra(n)g chalool ||
english: My clothes are dyed the deep crimson color of the poppy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਆਭਰਣ ਸੋਭਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਫੂਲ ॥
transliteration: sagal aabharan sobhaa ka(n)th phool ||
english: All the ornaments and garlands around my neck adorn me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪੇਖੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: pri pekhee drisat paae sagal nidhaan ||
english: Gazing upon my Beloved with my eyes, I have obtained all treasures;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟ ਦੂਤ ਕੀ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਨਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dusat doot kee chookee kaan ||3||
english: I have shaken off the power of the evil demons. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: sad khuseeaa sadaa ra(n)g maane ||
english: I have obtained eternal bliss, and I constantly celebrate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: nau nidh naam grih mahi tripataane ||
english: With the nine treasures of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am satisfied in my own home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਉ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jau pirahi seegaaree ||
english: Says Nanak, when the happy soul-bride is adorned by her Beloved,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਤਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: thir sohaagan sa(n)g bhataaree ||4||7||
english: she is forever happy with her Husband Lord. ||4||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: daan dei kar poojaa karanaa ||
english: They give you donations and worship you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੈਤ ਦੇਤ ਉਨੑ ਮੂਕਰਿ ਪਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: lait det unh mookar paranaa ||
english: You take from them, and then deny that they have given anything to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jit dar tumh hai braahaman jaanaa ||
english: That door, through which you must ultimately go, O Brahmin

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਹੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tit dar too(n)hee hai pachhutaanaa ||1||
english: - at that door, you will come to regret and repent. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਡੂਬੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aise braahaman doobe bhaaee ||
english: Such Brahmins shall drown, O Siblings of Destiny;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਾਪਰਾਧ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: niraaparaadh chitavahi buriaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: they think of doing evil to the innocent. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਹਲਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar lobh phirahi halakaae ||
english: Within them is greed, and they wander around like mad dogs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa karahi sir bhaar uthaae ||
english: They slander others and carry loads of sin upon their heads.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਠਾ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa moothaa chetai naahee ||
english: Intoxicated by Maya, they do not think of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਰਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bharame bhoolaa bahutee raahee ||2||
english: Deluded by doubt, they wander off on many paths. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: baahar bhekh karahi ghanere ||
english: Outwardly, they wear various religious robes,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਉਤਰੀ ਘੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar bikhiaa utaree ghere ||
english: but within, they are enveloped by poison.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: avar upadesai aap na boojhai ||
english: They instruct others, but do not understand themselves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਸੀਝੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aisaa braahaman kahee na seejhai ||3||
english: Such Brahmins will never be emancipated. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਬਾਮਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: moorakh baaman prabhoo samaal ||
english: O foolish Brahmin, reflect upon God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
