transliteration: dekhat sunat terai hai naal ||
english: He watches and hears, and is always with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਹੋਵੀ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak je hovee bhaag ||
english: Says Nanak, if this is your destiny,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: maan chhod gur charanee laag ||4||8||
english: renounce your pride, and grasp the Guru's Feet. ||4||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਭਏ ਗਤੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dookh rog bhae gat tan te man niramal har har gun gaai ||
english: Pain and disease have left my body, and my mind has become pure; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਬ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhae ana(n)d mil saadhoo sa(n)g ab meraa man kat hee na jaai ||1||
english: I am in bliss, meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and now, my mind does not go wandering. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tapat bujhee gurasabadee maai ||
english: My burning desires are quenched, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, O mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਓ ਤਾਪ ਸਭ ਸਹਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: binas gaio taap sabh sahasaa gur seetal milio sahaj subhaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The fever of doubt has been totally eliminated; meeting the Guru, I am cooled and soothed, with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹੇ ਏਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਆਇ ਬਸੇ ਅਬ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat rahe ek ik boojhiaa aai base ab nihachal thaai ||
english: My wandering has ended, since I have realized the One and Only Lord; now, I have come to dwell in the eternal place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤੁ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jagat udhaaran sa(n)t tumaare darasan pekhat rahe aghaai ||2||
english: Your Saints are the Saving Grace of the world; beholding the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, I remain satisfied. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਦੋਖ ਪਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਾਛੈ ਅਬ ਪਕਰੇ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: janam dokh pare mere paachhai ab pakare nihachal saadhoo paai ||
english: I have left behind the sins of countless incarnations, now that I have grasped the feet of the eternal Holy Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਮੰਗਲ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਬ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sahaj dhun gaavai ma(n)gal manooaa ab taa kau phun kaal na khaai ||3||
english: My mind sings the celestial melody of bliss, and death shall no longer consume it. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath hamaare sukhadaaee mere har har raai ||
english: My Lord, the Cause of all causes, is All-powerful, the Giver of peace; He is my Lord, my Lord King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: naam teraa jap jeevai naanak ot pot merai sa(n)g sahaai ||4||9||
english: Nanak lives by chanting Your Name, O Lord; You are my helper, with me, through and through. ||4||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਰੜਾਵੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਵੈ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ॥
transliteration: araRaavai bilalaavai ni(n)dak ||
english: The slanderer cries out and bewails.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham paramesar bisariaa apanaa keetaa paavai ni(n)dak ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He has forgotten the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord; the slanderer reaps the rewards of his own actions. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਲੇ ਲਏ ਸਿਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je koee us kaa sa(n)gee hovai naale lae sidhaavai ||
english: If someone is his companion, then he shall be taken along with him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਅਜਗਰੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਏ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anahodaa ajagar bhaar uthaae ni(n)dak aganee maahi jalaavai ||1||
english: Like the dragon, the slanderer carries his huge, useless loads, and burns in his own fire. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਜਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਤੀਤੈ ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: paramesar kai duaarai j hoi biteetai s naanak aakh sunaavai ||
english: Nanak proclaims and announces what happens at the Door of the Transcendent Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ਬਿਗਸਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੧੦॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kau sadaa ana(n)d hai har keeratan gaai bigasaavai ||2||10||
english: The humble devotees of the Lord are forever in bliss; singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, they blossom forth. ||2||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਕੀਓ ਸਗਲ ਸੀਗਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jau mai keeo sagal seegaaraa ||
english: Even though I totally decorated myself,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਭੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tau bhee meraa man na pateeaaraa ||
english: still, my mind was not satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸੁਗੰਧਤ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: anik suga(n)dhat tan mahi laavau ||
english: I applied various scented oils to my body,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: ohu sukh til samaan nahee paavau ||
english: and yet, I did not obtain even a tiny bit of pleasure from this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਐਸੀ ਆਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man mahi chitavau aisee aasaaee ||
english: Within my mind, I hold such a desire,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਦੇਖਤ ਜੀਵਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pri dekhat jeevau meree maaee ||1||
english: that I may live only to behold my Beloved, O my mother. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਧੀਰੈ ॥
transliteration: maaee kahaa karau ihu man na dheerai ||
english: O mother, what should I do? This mind cannot rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਹਿਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pri preetam bairaag hirai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It is bewitched by the tender love of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਭੂਖਨ ਸੁਖ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਿਸੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: basatr bibhookhan sukh bahut bisekhai ||
english: Garments, ornaments, and such exquisite pleasures

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਭੀ ਜਾਨਉ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: oi bhee jaanau kitai na lekhai ||
english: I look upon these as of no account.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਅਰੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
transliteration: pat sobhaa ar maan mahat ||
english: Likewise, honor, fame, dignity and greatness,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
transliteration: aagiaakaaree sagal jagat ||
english: obedience by the whole world,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਐਸਾ ਹੈ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਲਾਲ ॥
transliteration: grihu aisaa hai su(n)dar laal ||
english: and a household as beautiful as a jewel.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prabh bhaavaa taa sadaa nihaal ||2||
english: If I am pleasing to God's Will, then I shall be blessed, and forever in bliss. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿੰਜਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bi(n)jan bhojan anik parakaar ||
english: With foods and delicacies of so many different kinds,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g tamaase bahut bisathaar ||
english: and such abundant pleasures and entertainments,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਅਰੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ॥
transliteration: raaj milakh ar bahut phuramaais ||
english: power and property and absolute command

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਜਾਇਸਿ ॥
transliteration: man nahee dhraapai trisanaa na jaais ||
english: with these, the mind is not satisfied, and its thirst is not quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਇਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਨ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bin milabe ihu din na bihaavai ||
english: Without meeting Him, this day does not pass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਾ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: milai prabhoo taa sabh sukh paavai ||3||
english: Meeting God, I find peace. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਸੁਨੀ ਇਹ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat sunee ih soi ||
english: By searching and seeking, I have heard this news,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat bin tario na koi ||
english: that without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, no one swims across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis masatak bhaag tin satigur paaiaa ||
english: One who has this good destiny written upon his forehead, finds the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pooree aasaa man tripataaiaa ||
english: His hopes are fulfilled, and his mind is satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਚੂਕੀ ਡੰਝਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh miliaa taa chookee da(n)jhaa ||
english: When one meets God, then his thirst is quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਧਾ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਮੰਝਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak ladhaa man tan ma(n)jhaa ||4||11||
english: Nanak has found the Lord, within his mind and body. ||4||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ₃ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 pa(n)chapade₃ ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਨੀਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: prathame teree neekee jaat ||
english: First, your social status is high.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਨੀਐ ਪਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: duteeaa teree maneeai paa(n)t ||
english: Second, you are honored in society.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: triteeaa teraa su(n)dar thaan ||
english: Third, your home is beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਗੜ ਰੂਪੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bigaR roop man mahi abhimaan ||1||
english: But you are so ugly, with self-conceit in your mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਨੀ ਸਰੂਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ਬਿਚਖਨਿ ॥
transliteration: sohanee saroop sujaan bichakhan ||
english: O beautiful, attractive, wise and clever woman:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਗਰਬੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਫਾਕੀ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: at garabai mohi phaakee too(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: you have been trapped by your pride and attachment. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਸੂਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਕਸਾਲ ॥
transliteration: at soochee teree paakasaal ||
english: Your kitchen is so clean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਲਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kar isanaan poojaa tilak laal ||
english: You take your bath, and worship, and apply the crimson mark upon your forehead;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਲੀ ਗਰਬਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੋਵਹਿ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: galee garabahi mukh govahi giaan ||
english: with your mouth you speak wisdom, but you are destroyed by pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਖੋਈ ਲੋਭਿ ਸੁਆਨ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh bidh khoee lobh suaan ||2||
english: The dog of greed has ruined you in every way. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਪਰ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਭੋਗ ॥
transliteration: kaapar pahirahi bhogahi bhog ||
english: You wear your robes and enjoy pleasures;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਚਾਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਗ ॥
transliteration: aachaar karahi sobhaa mahi log ||
english: you practice good conduct to impress people;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
transliteration: choaa cha(n)dan suga(n)dh bisathaar ||
english: you apply scented oils of sandalwood and musk,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗੀ ਖੋਟਾ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)gee khotaa krodh cha(n)daal ||3||
english: but your constant companion is the demon of anger. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਜੋਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: avar jon teree panihaaree ||
english: Other people may be your water-carriers;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: is dharatee mahi teree sikadaaree ||
english: in this world, you may be a ruler.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੂਪਾ ਤੁਝ ਪਹਿ ਦਾਮ ॥
transliteration: suinaa roopaa tujh pahi daam ||
english: Gold, silver and wealth may be yours,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਾਮ ॥੪॥
transliteration: seel bigaario teraa kaam ||4||
english: but the goodness of your conduct has been destroyed by sexual promiscuity. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau drisat maiaa har raai ||
english: That soul, upon whom the Lord has bestowed His Glance of Grace,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਬੰਦੀ ਤੇ ਲਈ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saa ba(n)dee te laee chhadaai ||
english: is delivered from bondage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mil har ras paaiaa ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord's sublime essence is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਓਹ ਕਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak saphal oh kaaiaa ||5||
english: Says Nanak, how fruitful is that body. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਬਨੇ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh roop sabh sukh bane suhaagan ||
english: All graces and all comforts shall come to you, as the happy soul-bride;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਬਿਚਖਨਿ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: at su(n)dar bichakhan too(n) ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||12||
english: you shall be supremely beautiful and wise. ||1||Second Pause||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਇਕਤੁਕੇ ੨ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ikatuke 2 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Ek-Thukay 2 :

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਦੀਸੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jeevat deesai tis sarapar maranaa ||
english: One who is seen to be alive, shall surely die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: muaa hovai tis nihachal rahanaa ||1||
english: But he who is dead shall remain ever-lasting. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮੁਏ ਮੁਏ ਸੇ ਜੀਵੇ ॥
transliteration: jeevat mue mue se jeeve ||
english: Those who die while yet alive, shall through this death, live on.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam avakhadh mukh paaiaa gurasabadee ras a(n)mrit peeve ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They place the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, as medicine in their mouths, and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੀ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: kaachee matukee binas binaasaa ||
english: The clay pot of the body shall be broken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis chhootai trikutee tis nij ghar vaasaa ||2||
english: One who has eliminated the three qualities dwells in the home of his inner self. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਚੜੈ ਸੁ ਪਵੈ ਪਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: oochaa chaRai s pavai paiaalaa ||
english: One who climbs high, shall fall into the nether regions of the underworld.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਨਿ ਪੜੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dharan paRai tis lagai na kaalaa ||3||
english: One who lies upon the ground, shall not be touched by death. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhramat phire tin kichhoo na paaiaa ||
english: Those who continue to wander around, achieve nothing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: se asathir jin gurasabad kamaaiaa ||4||
english: Those who practice the Guru's Teachings, become steady and stable. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh har kaa maal ||
english: This body and soul all belong to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੫॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak gur mil bhae nihaal ||5||13||
english: O Nanak, meeting the Guru, I am enraptured. ||5||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤਰੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਟੀ ॥
transliteration: putaree teree bidh kar thaatee ||
english: The puppet of the body has been fashioned with great skill.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਹੋਇਗੀ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaan sat kar hoigee maatee ||1||
english: Know for sure that it shall turn to dust. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਸਮਾਲਹੁ ਅਚੇਤ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mool samaalahu achet gavaaraa ||
english: Remember your origins, O thoughtless fool.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਤਨੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: itane kau tumh kiaa garabe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Why are you so proud of yourself? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਸੇਰ ਕਾ ਦਿਹਾੜੀ ਮਿਹਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: teen ser kaa dihaaRee mihamaan ||
english: You are a guest, given three meals a day;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਵਸਤੁ ਤੁਝ ਪਾਹਿ ਅਮਾਨ ॥੨॥
transliteration: avar vasat tujh paahi amaan ||2||
english: other things are entrusted to you. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਅਸਤ ਰਕਤੁ ਪਰੇਟੇ ਚਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bisataa asat rakat parete chaam ||
english: you are just excrement, bones and blood, wrapped up in skin

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਲੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਗੁਮਾਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: is oopar le raakhio gumaan ||3||
english: - this is what you are taking such pride in! ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਤਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਪਾਕ ॥
transliteration: ek vasat boojhahi taa hovahi paak ||
english: If you could understand even one thing, then you would be pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਤੂੰ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਪਾਕ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bin boojhe too(n) sadaa naapaak ||4||
english: Without understanding, you shall be forever impure. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur kau kurabaan ||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥੫॥੧੪॥
transliteration: jis te paaeeai har purakh sujaan ||5||14||
english: through Him, I obtain the Lord, the All-knowing Primal Being. ||5||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਇਕਤੁਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ikatuke chaupade ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Ek-Thukay, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ik ghaRee dinas mo kau bahut dihaare ||
english: One moment, one day, is for me many days.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਿਲਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man na rahai kaise milau piaare ||1||
english: My mind cannot survive - how can I meet my Beloved? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਪਲੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ik pal dinas mo kau kabahu na bihaavai ||
english: I cannot endure one day, even one instant without Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਘਨੇਰੀ ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: darasan kee man aas ghaneree koee aisaa sa(n)t mo kau pirahi milaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind's desire for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is so great. Is there any Saint who can lead me to meet my Beloved? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਹਰ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਹ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: chaar pahar chahu jugah samaane ||
english: The four watches of the day are like the four ages.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਭਈ ਤਬ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: rain bhaee tab a(n)t na jaane ||2||
english: And when night comes, I think that it shall never end. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੋੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch doot mil pirahu vichhoRee ||
english: The five demons have joined together, to separate me from my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਹਾਥ ਪਛੋੜੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhram bhram rovai haath pachhoRee ||3||
english: Wandering and rambling, I cry out and wring my hands. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau har daras dikhaaiaa ||
english: The Lord has revealed the Blessed Vision of His Darshan to servant Nanak;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨੑਿ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
transliteration: aatam cheenhi param sukh paaiaa ||4||15||
english: realizing his own self, he has obtained supreme peace. ||4||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: har sevaa mahi param nidhaan ||
english: In the Lord's service, are the greatest treasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har sevaa mukh a(n)mrit naam ||1||
english: Serving the Lord, the Ambrosial Naam comes into one's mouth. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਥੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har meraa saathee sa(n)g sakhaaee ||
english: The Lord is my Companion; He is with me, as my Help and Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਤਹ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ਜਮੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਡਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh simaree tah maujood jam bapuraa mo kau kahaa daraaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In pain and pleasure, whenever I remember Him, He is present. How can the poor Messenger of Death frighten me now? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: har meree ot mai har kaa taan ||
english: The Lord is my Support; the Lord is my Power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har meraa sakhaa man maahi deebaan ||2||
english: The Lord is my Friend; He is my mind's advisor. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: har meree poo(n)jee meraa har vesaahu ||
english: The Lord is my capital; the Lord is my credit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh dhan khatee har meraa saahu ||3||
english: As Gurmukh, I earn the wealth, with the Lord as my Banker. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te ih mat aavai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, this wisdom has come.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kai a(n)k samaavai ||4||16||
english: Servant Nanak has merged into the Being of the Lord. ||4||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: prabh hoi kripaal ta ihu man laaee ||
english: When God shows His Mercy, then this mind is focused on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਭੈ ਫਲ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur sev sabhai phal paaee ||1||
english: Serving the True Guru, all rewards are obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਕਰਹਿਗਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man kiu bairaag karahigaa satigur meraa pooraa ||
english: O my mind, why are you so sad? My True Guru is Perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: manasaa kaa daataa sabh sukh nidhaan a(n)mrit sar sad hee bharapooraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Giver of blessings, the treasure of all comforts; His Ambrosial Pool of Nectar is always overflowing. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal rid a(n)tar dhaare ||
english: One who enshrines His Lotus Feet within the heart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pragatee jot mile raam piaare ||2||
english: meets the Beloved Lord; the Divine Light is revealed to him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਖੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch sakhee mil ma(n)gal gaaiaa ||
english: The five companions have met together to sing the songs of joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anahad baanee naad vajaaiaa ||3||
english: The unstruck melody, the sound current of the Naad, vibrates and resounds. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur naanak tuthaa miliaa har raai ||
english: O Nanak, when the Guru is totally pleased, one meets the Lord, the King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੭॥
transliteration: sukh rain vihaanee sahaj subhaai ||4||17||
english: Then, the night of one's life passes in peace and natural ease. ||4||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa har paragatee aaiaa ||
english: Showing His Mercy, the Lord has revealed Himself to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mil satigur dhan pooraa paaiaa ||1||
english: Meeting the True Guru, I have received the perfect wealth. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aisaa har dhan sa(n)cheeai bhaaee ||
english: Gather such a wealth of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਲੈ ਜਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ ਸੰਗੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaahi na jaalai jal nahee doobai sa(n)g chhod kar katahu na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It cannot be burned by fire, and water cannot drown it; it does not forsake society, or go anywhere else. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tot na aavai nikhut na jaai ||
english: It does not run short, and it does not run out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਘਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khaai kharach man rahiaa aghaai ||2||
english: Eating and consuming it, the mind remains satisfied. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: so sach saahu jis ghar har dhan sa(n)chaanaa ||
english: He is the true banker, who gathers the wealth of the Lord within his own home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਸਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: is dhan te sabh jag varasaanaa ||3||
english: With this wealth, the whole world profits. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਣਾ ॥
transliteration: tin har dhan paaiaa jis purab likhe kaa lahanaa ||
english: He alone receives the Lord's wealth, who is pre-ordained to receive it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
transliteration: jan naanak a(n)t vaar naam gahanaa ||4||18||
english: O servant Nanak, at that very last moment, the Naam shall be your only decoration. ||4||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਬੋਵੈ ਕਿਰਸਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jaise kirasaan bovai kirasaanee ||
english: Just like the farmer, He plants His crop,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੀ ਪਾਕੀ ਬਾਢਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaachee paakee baadh paraanee ||1||
english: and, whether it is ripe or unripe, He cuts it down. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨਮੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਮੂਆ ॥
transliteration: jo janamai so jaanahu mooaa ||
english: Just so, you must know this well, that whoever is born, shall die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਗਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: govi(n)d bhagat asathir hai theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Only the devotee of the Lord of the Universe becomes stable and permanent. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਸਰਪਰ ਪਉਸੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: din te sarapar pausee raat ||
english: The day shall certainly be followed by the night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਗਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: rain gaee phir hoi parabhaat ||2||
english: And when the night passes, the morning shall again dawn. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi soi rahe abhaage ||
english: In the love of Maya, the unfortunate ones remain in sleep.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur prasaad ko viralaa jaage ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, a rare few remain awake and aware. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gun gaaeeahi neet ||
english: Says Nanak, sing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਚੀਤ ॥੪॥੧੯॥
transliteration: mukh oojal hoi niramal cheet ||4||19||
english: Your face shall be radiant, and your consciousness shall be immaculately pure. ||4||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: nau nidh terai sagal nidhaan ||
english: The nine treasures are Yours - all treasures are Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰਕੁ ਰਖੈ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ichhaa poorak rakhai nidaan ||1||
english: The Fulfiller of desires saves mortals in the end. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਤਾ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੂਖਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) mero piaaro taa kaisee bhookhaa ||
english: You are my Beloved, so what hunger can I have?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਦੂਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) man vasiaa lagai na dookhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When You dwell within my mind, pain does not touch me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jo too(n) karahi soee paravaan ||
english: Whatever You do, is acceptable to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਚੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saache saahib teraa sach phuramaan ||2||
english: O True Lord and Master, True is Your Order. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai taa har gun gaau ||
english: When it is pleasing to Your Will, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਆਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: terai ghar sadaa sadaa hai niaau ||3||
english: Within Your Home, there is justice, forever and ever. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥
transliteration: saache saahib alakh abhev ||
english: O True Lord and Master, You are unknowable and mysterious.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਇਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੇਵ ॥੪॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak laaiaa laagaa sev ||4||20||
english: Nanak is committed to Your service. ||4||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: nikat jee kai sad hee sa(n)gaa ||
english: He is near at hand; He is the eternal Companion of the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਰੂਪ ਅਰੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kudarat varatai roop ar ra(n)gaa ||1||
english: His Creative Power is all-pervading, in form and color. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ੍ਹੈ ਨ ਝੁਰੈ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: karhai na jhurai naa man rovanahaaraa ||
english: My mind does not worry; it does not grieve, or cry out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avinaasee avigat agochar sadaa salaamat khasam hamaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Imperishable, Unshakable, Unapproachable and forever safe and sound is my Husband Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਰੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: tere daasare kau kis kee kaan ||
english: Unto whom does Your servant pay homage?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਮੀਰਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਣਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis kee meeraa raakhai aan ||2||
english: His King preserves his honor. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਲਉਡਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਆ ਅਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jo laudaa prabh keeaa ajaat ||
english: That slave, whom God has released from the restrictions of social status

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਲਉਡੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਤਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis laude kau kis kee taat ||3||
english: - who can now hold him in bondage? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੇਮੁਹਤਾਜਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: vemuhataajaa veparavaahu ||
english: The Lord is absolutely independent, and totally care-free;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕਹਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਹੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak daas kahahu gur vaahu ||4||21||
english: O servant Nanak, chant His Glorious Praises. ||4||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਹੋਛੈ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har ras chhod hochhai ras maataa ||
english: Forsaking the Lord's sublime essence, the mortal is intoxicated with false essences.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ghar mahi vasat baahar uth jaataa ||1||
english: The substance is within the home of the self, but the mortal goes out to find it. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਥਾ ॥
transliteration: sunee na jaaee sach a(n)mrit kaathaa ||
english: He cannot hear the true ambrosial discourse.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਝੂਠੀ ਲਗਿ ਗਾਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raar karat jhoothee lag gaathaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Attached to false scriptures, he is engaged in argument. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਜਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਸੇਵ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: vajahu saahib kaa sev biraanee ||
english: He takes his wages from his Lord and Master, but he serves another.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਅਛਾਦਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aise gunah achhaadio praanee ||2||
english: With such sins, the mortal is engrossed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਕ ਜੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੀ ॥
transliteration: tis siu look jo sad hee sa(n)gee ||
english: He tries to hide from the One who is always with him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੰਗੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaam na aavai so phir phir ma(n)gee ||3||
english: He begs from Him, again and again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh deen daiaalaa ||
english: Says Nanak, God is merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੨੨॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu kar pratipaalaa ||4||22||
english: As it pleases Him, He cherishes us. ||4||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jee praan dhan har ko naam ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my soul, my life, my wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾਂ ਉਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: eehaa oohaa(n) un sa(n)g kaam ||1||
english: Here and hereafter, it is with me, to help me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਵਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਥੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bin har naam avar sabh thoraa ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, everything else is useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tripat aghaavai har darasan man moraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind is satisfied and satiated by the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਲ ॥
transliteration: bhagat bha(n)daar gurabaanee laal ||
english: Gurbani is the jewel, the treasure of devotion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gaavat sunat kamaavat nihaal ||2||
english: Singing, hearing and acting upon it, one is enraptured. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu laago maan ||
english: My mind is attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੂਠੈ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur toothai keeno daan ||3||
english: The True Guru, in His Pleasure, has given this gift. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਦੀਨੑ ॥
transliteration: naanak kau gur deekhiaa deenh ||
english: Unto Nanak, the Guru has revealed these instructions:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨੑ ॥੪॥੨੩॥
transliteration: prabh abinaasee ghat ghat cheenh ||4||23||
english: recognize the Imperishable Lord God in each and every heart. ||4||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਭਰੇਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: anad binod bharepur dhaariaa ||
english: The All-pervading Lord has established joys and celebrations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apunaa kaaraj aap savaariaa ||1||
english: He Himself embellishes His own works. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: poor samagree poore thaakur kee ||
english: Perfect is the Creation of the Perfect Lord Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਸੋਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bharipur dhaar rahee sobh jaa kee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: His magnificent greatness is totally all-pervading. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan jaa kee niramal soi ||
english: His Name is the treasure; His reputation is immaculate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape karataa avar na koi ||2||
english: He Himself is the Creator; there is no other. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh taa kai haath ||
english: All beings and creatures are in His Hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: rav rahiaa prabh sabh kai saath ||3||
english: God is pervading in all, and is always with them. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: pooraa gur pooree banat banaaee ||
english: The Perfect Guru has fashioned His perfect fashion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੨੪॥
transliteration: naanak bhagat milee vadiaaee ||4||24||
english: O Nanak, the Lord's devotees are blessed with glorious greatness. ||4||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬਨਾਵਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad banaavahu ihu man ||
english: I have shaped this mind in the mold of the Guru's Word.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kaa darasan sa(n)chahu har dhan ||1||
english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I have gathered the wealth of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੂੰ ਆਉ ॥
transliteration: ootam mat merai ridai too(n) aau ||
english: O sublime understanding, come, enter into my mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਵਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhiaavau gaavau gun govi(n)daa at preetam mohi laagai naau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: that I may meditate and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and love so dearly the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਵਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tripat aghaavan saachai naai ||
english: I am satisfied and satiated by the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: athasath majan sa(n)t dhooraai ||2||
english: My cleansing bath at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage is the dust of the Saints. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਨਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi jaanau karataa ek ||
english: I recognize that the One Creator is contained in all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat mil budh bibek ||3||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my understanding is refined. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸੁ ਸਗਲ ਕਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: daas sagal kaa chhod abhimaan ||
english: I have become the servant of all; I have renounced my ego and pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak kau gur deeno daan ||4||25||
english: The Guru has given this gift to Nanak. ||4||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
transliteration: budh pragaas bhaee mat pooree ||
english: My intellect has been enlightened, and my understanding is perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa te binasee duramat dooree ||1||
english: Thus my evil-mindedness, which kept me far from Him, has been removed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਅਲੇ ॥
transliteration: aisee guramat paaeeale ||
english: Such are the Teachings which I have received from the Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: boodat ghor a(n)dh koop mahi nikasio mere bhaaee re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: while I was drowning in the pitch black well, I was saved, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਾਹ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mahaa agaah agan kaa saagar ||
english: The Guru is the boat to cross over the totally unfathomable ocean of fire;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur bohith taare ratanaagar ||2||
english: He is treasure of jewels. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤਰ ਅੰਧ ਬਿਖਮ ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dutar a(n)dh bikham ih maaiaa ||
english: This ocean of Maya is dark and treacherous.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur poorai paragat maarag dikhaaiaa ||3||
english: The Perfect Guru has revealed the way to cross over it. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਕਛੁ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jaap taap kachh ukat na moree ||
english: I do not have the ability to chant or practice intense meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੪॥੨੬॥
transliteration: gur naanak saranaagat toree ||4||26||
english: Guru Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||4||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਤਿਪਦੇ ੨ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 tipade 2 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Thi-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har ras peevat sad hee raataa ||
english: One who drinks in the Lord's sublime essence is forever imbued with it,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aan rasaa khin mahi lahi jaataa ||
english: while other essences wear off in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: har ras ke maate man sadaa ana(n)d ||
english: Intoxicated with the Lord's sublime essence, the mind is forever in ecstasy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aan rasaa mahi viaapai chi(n)d ||1||
english: Other essences bring only anxiety. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਅਲਮਸਤੁ ਮਤਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har ras peevai alamasat matavaaraa ||
english: One who drinks in the Lord's sublime essence, is intoxicated and enraptured;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਛੇ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aan rasaa sabh hochhe re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: all other essences have no effect. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har ras kee keemat kahee na jaai ||
english: The value of the Lord's sublime essence cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਾਟਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har ras saadhoo haat samaai ||
english: The Lord's sublime essence permeates the homes of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਕੇਹ ॥
transliteration: laakh karoree milai na keh ||
english: One may spend thousands and millions, but it cannot be purchased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਦੇਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jisahi paraapat tis hee dehi ||2||
english: He alone obtains it, who is so pre-ordained. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਖਿ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak chaakh bhae bisamaad ||
english: Tasting it, Nanak is wonder-struck.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak gur te aaiaa saad ||
english: Through the Guru, Nanak has obtained this taste.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: eet oot kat chhod na jaai ||
english: Here and hereafter, it does not leave him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੀਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੩॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak geedhaa har ras maahi ||3||27||
english: Nanak is imbued and enraptured with the Lord's subtle essence. ||3||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu mitaavai chhutakai duramat apunee dhaaree ||
english: If she renounces and eliminates her sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, and her evil-mindedness and self-conceit as well;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hoi nimaanee sev kamaavahi taa preetam hovahi man piaaree ||1||
english: and if, becoming humble, she serves Him, then she becomes dear to her Beloved's Heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਬਚਨ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sun su(n)dar saadhoo bachan udhaaree ||
english: Listen, O beautiful soul-bride: By the Word of the Holy Saint, you shall be saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਮਿਟੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖਮਨਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dookh bhookh mitai tero sahasaa sukh paavahi too(n) sukhaman naaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your pain, hunger and doubt shall vanish, and you shall obtain peace, O happy soul-bride. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਸ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: charan pakhaar karau gur sevaa aatam sudh bikh tiaas nivaaree ||
english: Washing the Guru's feet, and serving Him, the soul is sanctified, and the thirst for sin is quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਿ ਦਾਸਰੀ ਤਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: daasan kee hoi daas daasaree taa paavahi sobhaa har duaaree ||2||
english: If you become the slave of the slave of the Lord's slaves, then you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੀ ਅਚਾਰ ਇਹੀ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ihee achaar ihee biuhaaraa aagiaa maan bhagat hoi tumhaaree ||
english: This is right conduct, and this is the correct lifestyle, to obey the Command of the Lord's Will; this is your devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਹੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੨੮॥
transliteration: jo ihu ma(n)tr kamaavai naanak so bhaujal paar utaaree ||3||28||
english: One who practices this Mantra, O Nanak, swims across the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 dupade ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹੁਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaee paraapat maanukh dehureeaa ||
english: You have been blessed with this human body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d milan kee ih teree bareeaa ||
english: This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: avar kaaj terai kitai na kaam ||
english: Other efforts are of no use to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਜੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)gat bhaj keval naam ||1||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, vibrate and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰੰਜਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਨ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: sara(n)jaam laag bhavajal taran kai ||
english: Make the effort, and cross over the terrifying world ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam brithaa jaat ra(n)g maaiaa kai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This human life is passing away in vain, in the love of Maya. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam dharam na kamaaiaa ||
english: I have not practiced meditation, penance, self-restraint or righteous living;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sevaa saadh na jaaniaa har raaiaa ||
english: I have not served the Holy Saints, and I do not know the Lord, my King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ham neech kara(n)maa ||
english: Says Nanak, my actions are vile and despicable;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਮਾ ॥੨॥੨੯॥
transliteration: saran pare kee raakhahu saramaa ||2||29||
english: O Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary - please, preserve my honor. ||2||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin avar naahee mai doojaa too(n) mere man maahee ||
english: Without You, there is no other for me; You alone are in my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਜੀਅ ਡਰਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too(n) saajan sa(n)gee prabh meraa kaahe jee daraahee ||1||
english: You are my Friend and Companion, God; why should my soul be afraid? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: tumaree ot tumaaree aasaa ||
english: You are my support, You are my hope.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਠਤ ਊਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: baithat oothat sovat jaagat visar naahee too(n) saas giraasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: While sitting down or standing up, while sleeping or waking, with every breath and morsel of food, I never forget You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਵਿਕਰਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: raakh raakh saran prabh apanee agan saagar vikaraalaa ||
english: Protect me, please protect me, O God; I have come to Your Sanctuary; the ocean of fire is so horrible.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਮ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੩੦॥
transliteration: naanak ke sukhadaate satigur ham tumare baal gupaalaa ||2||30||
english: The True Guru is the Giver of peace to Nanak; I am Your child, O Lord of the World. ||2||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਲੀਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har jan leene prabhoo chhadaai ||
english: The Lord God has saved me, His slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਾਪੁ ਮੁਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: preetam siu mero man maaniaa taap muaa bikh khaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind has surrendered to my Beloved; my fever has taken poison and died. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਲਾ ਤਾਊ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paalaa taaoo kachhoo na biaapai raam naam gun gaai ||
english: Cold and heat do not touch me at all, when I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਾਕੀ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daakee ko chit kachhoo na laagai charan kamal saranaai ||1||
english: My consciousness is not affected by the witch, Maya; I take to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad bhae kirapaalaa hoe aap sahaai ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, the Lord has shown His Mercy to me; He Himself is my Help and Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਤਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥੨॥੩੧॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan nit gaavai naanak sahasaa dukh mitaai ||2||31||
english: Nanak ever sings the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of excellence; his doubts and pains are eliminated. ||2||31||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਖਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aukhadh khaaio har ko naau ||
english: I have taken the medicine of the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sukh paae dukh binasiaa thaau ||1||
english: I have found peace, and the seat of pain has been removed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਬਚਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: taap gaiaa bachan gur poore ||
english: The fever has been broken, by the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anad bhaiaa sabh mite visoore ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am in ecstasy, and all of my sorrows have been dispelled. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sagal sukh paaiaa ||
english: All beings and creatures obtain peace,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੨॥੩੨॥
transliteration: paarabraham naanak man dhiaaiaa ||2||32||
english: O Nanak, meditating on the Supreme Lord God. ||2||32||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਂਛਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁ ਬੇਲਾ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: baa(n)chhat naahee s belaa aaee ||
english: That time, which the mortal does not wish for, eventually comes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਕਿਉ ਬੁਝੈ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin hukamai kiu bujhai bujhaaee ||1||
english: Without the Lord's Command, how can understanding be understood? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠੰਢੀ ਤਾਤੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tha(n)dhee taatee mitee khaaee ||
english: The body is consumed by water, fire and earth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਬਾਲਾ ਬੂਢਾ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ohu na baalaa boodhaa bhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: But the soul is neither young nor old, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naanak daas saadh saranaaee ||
english: Servant Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਉ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੨॥੩੩॥
transliteration: gur prasaad bhau paar paraaee ||2||33||
english: By Guru's Grace, he has shaken off the fear of death. ||2||33||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਤਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa aatam paragaas ||
english: Forever and ever, the soul is illumined;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat har charan nivaas ||1||
english: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, it dwells at the Feet of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raam naam nit jap man mere ||
english: Chant the Lord's Name each and every day, O my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਸਭੇ ਮਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: seetal saa(n)t sadaa sukh paavahi kilavikh jaahi sabhe man tere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall find lasting peace, contentment and tranquility, and all your sins shall depart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jaa ke pooran karam ||
english: Says Nanak, one who is blessed with perfect good karma,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥੨॥੩੪॥
transliteration: satigur bhete pooran paarabraham ||2||34||
english: meets the True Guru, and obtains the Perfect Supreme Lord God. ||2||34||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੇ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਚਉਤੀਸ ॥
transliteration: dooje ghar ke chautees ||
english: Thirty-four Shabads in Second House. ||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਲੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa har suaamee prabh belee ||
english: She who has the Lord God as her Friend

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀੜ ਗਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: peeR gaee phir nahee duhelee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: her pain is dispelled, and she shall not become sad again. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੀ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa charan sa(n)g melee ||
english: Showing His Mercy, He joins her with His Feet,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d suhelee ||1||
english: and she attains celestial peace, joy and comfort. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਤੋਲੀ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g gun gaai atolee ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, she sings the Glorious Praises of the Immeasurable Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਈ ਅਮੋਲੀ ॥੨॥੩੫॥
transliteration: har simarat naanak bhaee amolee ||2||35||
english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak, she becomes invaluable. ||2||35||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਏ ਖੇਲਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh maaiaa mad matasar e khelat sabh jooai haare ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, intoxication with Maya and jealousy - I have lost all of these in the game of chance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਇਹ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh daiaa dharam sach ih apunai grih bheetar vaare ||1||
english: Purity, contentment, compassion, faith and truthfulness - I have ushered these into the home of my self. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਚੂਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਭਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: janam maran chooke sabh bhaare ||
english: All the loads of birth and death have been removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: milat sa(n)g bhaio man niramal gur poorai lai khin mahi taare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Joining the Saints' Society, my mind has become pure; the Perfect Guru has saved me in an instant. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh kee ren hoi rahai manooaa sagale deesahi meet piaare ||
english: My mind has become the dust of all, and everyone seems a sweet friend to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਧੇ ਰਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh madhe raviaa meraa thaakur daan det sabh jee samhaare ||2||
english: My Lord and Master is contained in all. He gives His Gifts to all beings, and cherishes them. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਇਕੁ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਹੈ ਸਗਲਾ ਪਾਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: eko ek aap ik ekai ekai hai sagalaa paasaare ||
english: He Himself is the One and only; from the One, the One and only, came the expanse of the entire creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jap jap hoe sagal saadh jan ek naam dhiaai bahut udhaare ||3||
english: Chanting and meditating, all the humble beings have become Holy; meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, so many have been saved. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gahir ga(n)bheer bia(n)t gusaaee a(n)t nahee kichh paaraavaare ||
english: The Lord of the Universe is deep, profound and infinite; He has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੩੬॥
transliteration: tumhree kripaa te gun gaavai naanak dhiaai dhiaai prabh kau namasakaare ||4||36||
english: By Your Grace, Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises; meditating, meditating, he humbly bows to God. ||4||36||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: too bia(n)t avigat agochar ihu sabh teraa aakaar ||
english: You are Infinite, Eternal and Incomprehensible; all this is Your Creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਕਰਹ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਜਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kiaa ham ja(n)t karah chaturaaee jaa(n) sabh kichh tujhai majhaar ||1||
english: What clever games can we play, when everything is contained in You? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਬਾਲਿਕ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲੀਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: mere satigur apane baalik raakhahu leelaa dhaar ||
english: O my True Guru, protect me, Your child, through the power of Your play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dehu sumat sadaa gun gaavaa mere thaakur agam apaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Grant me the good sense to ever sing Your Glorious Praises, O my Inaccessible and Infinite Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਨਨਿ ਜਠਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਓਹੁ ਰਹਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jaise janan jathar mahi praanee ohu rahataa naam adhaar ||
english: The mortal is preserved in the womb of his mother, by the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ਨਾ ਪੋਹੈ ਅਗਨਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anad karai saas saas samhaarai naa pohai aganaar ||2||
english: he makes merry, and with each and every breath he remembers the Lord, and the fire does not touch him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: par dhan par daaraa par ni(n)daa in siu preet nivaar ||
english: Others' wealth, others' wives, and the slander of others - renounce your craving for these.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੇਵੀ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: charan kamal sevee rid a(n)tar gur poore kai aadhaar ||3||
english: Serve the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart, and hold to the Support of the Perfect Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਜੋ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਸੰਗਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: grihu ma(n)dar mahalaa jo deesahi naa koee sa(n)gaar ||
english: Houses, mansions and palaces which you see - none of these shall go with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੩੭॥
transliteration: jab lag jeevahi kalee kaal mahi jan naanak naam samhaar ||4||37||
english: As long as you live in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O servant Nanak, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||37||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ghar 3 mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Third House, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਕ ਜੋਬਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੋਭਾ ਰੂਪਵੰਤੁ ਜੋੁਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: raaj milak joban grih sobhaa roopava(n)t jouaanee ||
english: Power, property, youth, household, fame and the beauty of youth;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਹਸਤੀ ਅਰੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਲਾਲ ਲਾਖ ਬੈ ਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: bahut darab hasatee ar ghoRe laal laakh bai aanee ||
english: great wealth, elephants, horses and jewels, purchased with tens of thousands of dollars;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aagai daragahi kaam na aavai chhod chalai abhimaanee ||1||
english: hereafter, these shall be of no avail in the Court of the Lord; the proud must depart, leaving them behind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kaahe ek binaa chit laaeeai ||
english: Why center your consciousness on any other than the Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat sovat jaagat sadaa sadaa har dhiaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Sitting down, standing up, sleeping and waking, forever and ever, meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਆਖਾੜੇ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਤੇ ਪਵਾੜੇ ॥
transliteration: mahaa bachitr su(n)dar aakhaaRe ran mahi jite pavaaRe ||
english: He may have the most wondrous and beautiful arenas, and be victorious on the field of battle.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਾਰਉ ਹਉ ਬੰਧਉ ਛੋਡਉ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਏਵ ਬਬਾੜੇ ॥
transliteration: hau maarau hau ba(n)dhau chhodau mukh te ev babaaRe ||
english: He may proclaim, "I can kill anyone, I can capture anyone, and I can release anyone."

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਏਕ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aaiaa hukam paarabraham kaa chhod chaliaa ek dihaaRe ||2||
english: But when the Order comes from the Supreme Lord God, he departs and leaves in a day. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam jugat bahu karataa karanaihaar na jaanai ||
english: He may perform all sorts of religious rituals and good actions, but he does not know the Creator Lord, the Doer of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਤੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: upades karai aap na kamaavai tat sabad na pachhaanai ||
english: He teaches, but does not practice what he preaches; he does not realize the essential reality of the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਂਗਾ ਆਇਆ ਨਾਂਗੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਜਿਉ ਹਸਤੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naa(n)gaa aaiaa naa(n)go jaasee jiu hasatee khaak chhaanai ||3||
english: Naked he came, and naked he shall depart; he is like an elephant, throwing dust on himself. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਝੂਠਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sajan sunahu sabh meetaa jhoothaa ehu pasaaraa ||
english: O Saints, and friends, listen to me: all this world is false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਡੂਬੇ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: meree meree kar kar doobe khap khap mue gavaaraa ||
english: Continually claiming, "Mine, mine", the mortals are drowned; the fools waste away and die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੮॥
transliteration: gur mil naanak naam dhiaaiaa saach naam nisataaraa ||4||1||38||
english: Meeting the Guru, O Nanak, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the True Name, I am emancipated. ||4||1||38||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 5 mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Fifth House, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤ ਧੰਧ ਅੰਧ ॥ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhram mahi soee sagal jagat dha(n)dh a(n)dh || kooo jaagai har jan ||1||
english: The whole world is asleep in doubt; it is blinded by worldly entanglements. How rare is that humble servant of the Lord who is awake and aware. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮਗਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥ ਕੋਊ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mahaa mohanee magan pri preet praan || kooo tiaagai viralaa ||2||
english: The mortal is intoxicated with the great enticement of Maya, which is dearer to him than life. How rare is the one who renounces it. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਨੂਪ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਤ ॥ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਾਧੂ ॥੩॥
transliteration: charan kamal aanoop har sa(n)t ma(n)t || kooo laagai saadhoo ||3||
english: The Lord's Lotus Feet are incomparably beautiful; so is the Mantra of the Saint. How rare is that holy person who is attached to them. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਰੰਗਿ ॥ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੯॥
transliteration: naanak saadhoo sa(n)g jaage giaan ra(n)g || vadabhaage kirapaa ||4||1||39||
english: O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the love of divine knowledge is awakened; The Lord's Mercy is bestowed upon those who are blessed with such good destiny. ||4||1||39||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 6 mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Sixth House, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so paravaanaa sookh sahaj man soee ||
english: Whatever pleases You is acceptable to me; that alone brings peace and ease to my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath apaaraa avar naahee re koee ||1||
english: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes, All-powerful and Infinite; there is none other than You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tere jan rasak rasak gun gaavahi ||
english: Your humble servants sing Your Glorious Praises with enthusiasm and love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਸਲਤਿ ਮਤਾ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: masalat mataa siaanap jan kee jo too(n) karahi karaavahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: That alone is good advice, wisdom and cleverness for Your humble servant, which You do or cause to be done. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam tumaaraa piaare saadhasa(n)g ras paaiaa ||
english: Your Name is Ambrosial Nectar, O Beloved Lord; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained its sublime essence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tripat aghaai seee jan poore sukh nidhaan har gaaiaa ||2||
english: Those humble beings are satisfied and fulfilled, singing the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau tek tumhaaree suaamee taa kau naahee chi(n)taa ||
english: One who has Your Support, O Lord Master, is not afflicted by anxiety.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਭਲੇ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kau daiaa tumaaree hoee se saah bhale bhagava(n)taa ||3||
english: One who is blessed by Your Kind Mercy, is the best, the most fortunate king. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਜਬ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bharam moh dhroh sabh nikase jab kaa darasan paaiaa ||
english: Doubt, attachment, and deceit have all disappeared, since I obtained the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਤਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੦॥
transliteration: varatan naam naanak sach keenaa har naame ra(n)g samaaiaa ||4||1||40||
english: Dealing in the Naam, O Nanak, we become truthful, and in the Love of the Lord's Name, we are absorbed. ||4||1 | 40||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਪਰਾਈ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kee mal dhovai paraaee aapanaa keetaa paavai ||
english: He washes off the filth of other peoples' incarnations, but he obtains the rewards of his own actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਚਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: eehaa sukh nahee daragah dhoee jam pur jaai pachaavai ||1||
english: He has no peace in this world, and he has no place in the Court of the Lord. In the City of Death, he is tortured. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕਿ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak ahilaa janam gavaaiaa ||
english: The slanderer loses his life in vain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤੈ ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pahuch na saakai kaahoo baatai aagai thaur na paaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He cannot succeed in anything, and in the world hereafter, he finds no place at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kirat paiaa ni(n)dak bapure kaa kiaa ohu karai bichaaraa ||
english: Such is the fate of the wretched slanderer - what can the poor creature do?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹਾ ਬਿਗੂਤਾ ਜਹ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਓਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tahaa bigootaa jah koi na raakhai ohu kis pahi kare pukaaraa ||2||
english: He is ruined there, where no one can protect him; with whom should he lodge his complaint? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kee gat katahoo(n) naahee khasamai evai bhaanaa ||
english: The slanderer shall never attain emancipation; this is the Will of the Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo jo ni(n)d kare sa(n)tan kee tiu sa(n)tan sukh maanaa ||3||
english: The more the Saints are slandered, the more they dwell in peace. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa tek tumaaree suaamee too(n) sa(n)tan kaa sahaaee ||
english: The Saints have Your Support, O Lord and Master; You are the Saints' Help and Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੀਏ ਰੁੜਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sa(n)t har raakhe ni(n)dak deee ruRaaee ||4||2||41||
english: Says Nanak, the Saints are saved by the Lord; the slanderers are drowned in the deep. ||4||2||41||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਧੋਇ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਠਉਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਖੋਏ ॥
transliteration: baahar dhoi a(n)tar man mailaa dui thaur apune khoe ||
english: He washes outwardly, but within, his mind is filthy; thus he loses his place in both worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਆਗੈ ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਿ ਰੋਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: eehaa kaam krodh mohi viaapiaa aagai mus mus roe ||1||
english: Here, he is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment; hereafter, he shall sigh and weep. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਹੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: govi(n)d bhajan kee mat hai horaa ||
english: The way to vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe is different.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਮੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਰਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੁਨਈ ਡੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: varamee maaree saap na maraee naam na sunaee doraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Destroying the snake-hole, the snake is not killed; the deaf person does not hear the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa kee kirat chhod gavaaee bhagatee saar na jaanai ||
english: He renounces the affairs of Maya, but he does not appreciate the value of devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਉ ਤਰਕਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਤੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bed saasatr kau tarakan laagaa tat jog na pachhaanai ||2||
english: He finds fault with the Vedas and the Shaastras, and does not know the essence of Yoga. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਘਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਜੈਸਾ ਖੋਟਾ ਢਬੂਆ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ughar gaiaa jaisaa khotaa dhabooaa nadar saraaphaa aaiaa ||
english: He stands exposed, like a counterfeit coin, when inspected by the Lord, the Assayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee sabh kichh jaanai us te kahaa chhapaaiaa ||3||
english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything; how can we hide anything from Him? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਬੰਚਿ ਨਿੰਮੁਨੀਆਦਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ ਤਤਕਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: kooR kapat ba(n)ch ni(n)muneeaadaa binas gaiaa tatakaale ||
english: Through falsehood, fraud and deceit, the mortal collapses in an instant - he has no foundation at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਅਪਨੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੨॥
transliteration: sat sat sat naanak kahiaa apanai hiradai dekh samaale ||4||3||42||
english: Truly, truly, truly, Nanak speaks; look within your own heart, and realize this. ||4||3||42||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: udam karat hovai man niramal naachai aap nivaare ||
english: Making the effort, the mind becomes pure; in this dance, the self is silenced.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਲੇ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch janaa le vasagat raakhai man mahi eka(n)kaare ||1||
english: The five passions are kept under control, and the One Lord dwells in the mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: teraa jan nirat kare gun gaavai ||
english: Your humble servant dances and sings Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਬਾਬੁ ਪਖਾਵਜ ਤਾਲ ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rabaab pakhaavaj taal ghu(n)gharoo anahad sabad vajaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He plays upon the guitar, tambourine and cymbals, and the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਅਵਰ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: prathame man parabodhai apanaa paachhai avar reejhaavai ||
english: First, he instructs his own mind, and then, he leads others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਾਪੈ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam naam jap hiradai jaapai mukh te sagal sunaavai ||2||
english: He chants the Lord's Name and meditates on it in his heart; with his mouth, he announces it to all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੈ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kar sa(n)g saadhoo charan pakhaarai sa(n)t dhoor tan laavai ||
english: He joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and washes their feet; he applies the dust of the Saints to his body

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man tan arap dhare gur aagai sat padaarath paavai ||3||
english: He surrenders his mind and body, and places them before the Guru; thus, he obtains the true wealth. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਪੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ਸਰਧਾ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jo jo sunai pekhai laai saradhaa taa kaa janam maran dukh bhaagai ||
english: Whoever listens to, and beholds the Guru with faith, shall see his pains of birth and death taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੪੩॥
transliteration: aisee nirat narak nivaarai naanak guramukh jaagai ||4||4||43||
english: Such a dance eliminates hell; O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains wakeful. ||4||4||43||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਧਮ ਚੰਡਾਲੀ ਭਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੀ ਸੂਦੀ ਤੇ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: adham cha(n)daalee bhaee brahamanee soodee te sresataaee re ||
english: The lowly outcaste becomes a Brahmin, and the untouchable sweeper becomes pure and sublime.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਸਖਨੀ ਲਹਬਰ ਬੂਝੀ ਖਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paataalee aakaasee sakhanee lahabar boojhee khaaee re ||1||
english: The burning desire of the nether regions and the etheric realms is finally quenched and extinguished. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਲਾਈ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਖਾਈ ਮੂਸਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਡਰਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ghar kee bilaaee avar sikhaaee moosaa dekh daraaee re ||
english: The house-cat has been taught otherwise, and is terrified upon seeing the mouse.

author: Guru Arjan
