gurmukhi: ਅਜ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਕੇਹਰਿ ਕੂਕਰ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aj kai vas gur keeno kehar kookar tinahi lagaaee re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru has put the tiger under the control of the sheep, and now, the dog eats grass. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਥੂਨੀਆ ਛਪਰਾ ਥਾਮੑਿਆ ਨੀਘਰਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: baajh thooneeaa chhaparaa thaamhiaa neeghariaa ghar paaiaa re ||
english: Without pillars, the roof is supported, and the homeless have found a home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜੜੀਏ ਲੈ ਜੜਿਓ ਜੜਾਵਾ ਥੇਵਾ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin jaReee lai jaRio jaRaavaa thevaa acharaj laaiaa re ||2||
english: Without the jeweller, the jewel has been set, and the wonderful stone shines forth. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਦੀ ਦਾਦਿ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ਚੂਪੀ ਨਿਰਨਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: daadee daad na pahuchanahaaraa choopee niranau paaiaa re ||
english: The claimant does not succeed by placing his claim, but by keeping silent, he obtains justice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲਿ ਦੁਲੀਚੈ ਬੈਠੀ ਲੇ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਨੈਨ ਦਿਖਾਲਨੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maal duleechai baithee le miratak nain dikhaalan dhaaiaa re ||3||
english: The dead sit on costly carpets, and what is seen with the eyes shall vanish. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾ ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਛਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: soee ajaan kahai mai jaanaa jaananahaar na chhaanaa re ||
english: One who claims to know, is ignorant; he does not know the Knower of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਪੀਆਇਆ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੪੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur amiu peeaaiaa rasak rasak bigasaanaa re ||4||5||44||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has given me the Ambrosial Nectar to drink in; savoring it and relishing it, I blossom forth in bliss. ||4||5||44||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ਅਉਗਨ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan kaat bisaare augan apanaa birad samhaariaa ||
english: He has cut away my bonds, and overlooked my shortcomings, and so He has confirmed His nature.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤ ਨਿਆਈ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hoe kripaal maat pit niaaee baarik jiu pratipaariaa ||1||
english: Becoming merciful to me, like a mother or a father, he has come to cherish me as His own child. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: gurasikh raakhe gur gopaal ||
english: The GurSikhs are preserved by the Guru, by the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਮਹਾ ਭਵਜਲ ਤੇ ਅਪਨੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaadh leee mahaa bhavajal te apanee nadar nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He rescues them from the terrible world ocean, casting His Glance of Grace upon them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran jam te chhuteeai halat palat sukh paaeeai ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, we escape from the Messenger of Death; here and hereafter, we obtain peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saas giraas japahu jap rasanaa neet neet gun gaaeeai ||2||
english: With every breath and morsel of food, meditate, and chant with your tongue, continually, each and every day; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat prem param pad paaiaa saadhasa(n)g dukh naathe ||
english: Through loving devotional worship, the supreme status is obtained, and in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sorrows are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਿਜੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗਾਠੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chhijai na jaai kichh bhau na biaape har dhan niramal gaathe ||3||
english: I am not worn down, I do not die, and nothing strikes fear in me, since I have the wealth of the Lord's Immaculate Name in my purse. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal prabh bhae sahaaee it ut raakhanahaare ||
english: At the very last moment, God becomes the mortal's Help and Support; here and hereafter, He is the Savior Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੀਤ ਹੀਤ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੪੫॥
transliteration: praan meet heet dhan merai naanak sad balihaare ||4||6||45||
english: He is my breath of life, my friend, support and wealth; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||6||45||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa too(n) saahib taa bhau kehaa hau tudh bin kis saalaahee ||
english: Since You are my Lord and Master, what is there for me to fear? Other than You, who else should I praise?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਮੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek too(n) taa sabh kichh hai mai tudh bin doojaa naahee ||1||
english: You are the One and only, and so do all things exist; without You, there is nothing at all for me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: baabaa bikh dekhiaa sa(n)saar ||
english: O Father, I have seen that the world is poison.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਖਿਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rakhiaa karahu gusaaee mere mai naam teraa aadhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Save me, O Lord of the Universe! Your Name is my only Support. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਭਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jaanahi birathaa sabhaa man kee hor kis pahi aakh sunaaeeai ||
english: You know completely the condition of my mind; who else could I go to tell of it?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vin naavai sabh jag bauraaiaa naam milai sukh paaeeai ||2||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the whole world has gone crazy; obtaining the Naam, it finds peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ਜਿ ਕਹਣਾ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: kiaa kaheeai kis aakh sunaaeeai j kahanaa s prabh jee paas ||
english: What shall I say? Unto whom shall I speak? What I have to say, I say to God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh kichh keetaa teraa varatai sadaa sadaa teree aas ||3||
english: Everything which exists was created by You. You are my hope, forever and ever. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
transliteration: je dehi vadiaaee taa teree vadiaaee it ut tujhahi dhiaau ||
english: If you bestow greatness, then it is Your greatness; here and hereafter, I meditate on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੬॥
transliteration: naanak ke prabh sadaa sukhadaate mai taan teraa ik naau ||4||7||46||
english: The Lord God of Nanak is forever the Giver of peace; Your Name is my only strength. ||4||7||46||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਏਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਜਨਹਿ ਪੀਓ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam tumhaaraa thaakur ehu mahaa ras janahi peeo ||
english: Your Name is Ambrosial Nectar, O Lord Master; Your humble servant drinks in this supreme elixir.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਚੂਕੇ ਭੈ ਭਾਰੇ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਓ ਭਰਮੁ ਬੀਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam janam chooke bhai bhaare durat binaasio bharam beeo ||1||
english: The fearful load of sins from countless incarnations has vanished; doubt and duality are also dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਮੈ ਜੀਓ ॥
transliteration: darasan pekhat mai jeeo ||
english: I live by beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਰੁ ਥੀਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sun kar bachan tumhaare satigur man tan meraa thaar theeo ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Listening to Your Words, O True Guru, my mind and body are cooled and soothed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਏਹੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਓ ॥
transliteration: tumhree kripaa te bhaio saadhasa(n)g ehu kaaj tumh aap keeo ||
english: By Your Grace, I have joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; You Yourself have caused this to happen.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਭਈ ਖੀਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: diR kar charan gahe prabh tumhre sahaje bikhiaa bhaee kheeo ||2||
english: Holding fast to Your Feet, O God, the poison is easily neutralized. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਏਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਲੀਓ ॥
transliteration: sukh nidhaan naam prabh tumaraa ehu abinaasee ma(n)tr leeo ||
english: Your Name, O God, is the treasure of peace; I have received this everlasting Mantra.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਤਾਪੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੈਰੁ ਗੀਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi satigur deenaa taap sa(n)taap meraa bair geeo ||3||
english: Showing His Mercy, the True Guru has given it to me, and my fever and pain and hatred are annulled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਓ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s maanas dehee paaee jit prabh apanai mel leeo ||
english: Blessed is the attainment of this human body, by which God blends Himself with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੀਓ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੭॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s kalijug saadhasa(n)g keeratan gaaeeai naanak naam adhaar heeo ||4||8||47||
english: Blessed, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, is the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.O Nanak, the Naam is my only Support. ||4||8||47||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੂਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aagai hee te sabh kichh hooaa avar k jaanai giaanaa ||
english: Everything is pre-ordained; what else can be known through study?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhool chook apanaa baarik bakhasiaa paarabraham bhagavaanaa ||1||
english: The errant child has been forgiven by the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur meraa sadaa daiaalaa mohi deen kau raakh leeaa ||
english: My True Guru is always merciful; He has saved me, the meek one.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaatiaa rog mahaa sukh paaiaa har a(n)mrit mukh naam deeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He has cured me of my disease, and I have obtained the greatest peace; He has placed the Ambrosial Name of the Lord in my mouth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਪ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: anik paap mere parahariaa ba(n)dhan kaate mukat bhae ||
english: He has washed away my countless sins; He has cut away my bonds, and I am liberated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਘੋਰ ਤੇ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop mahaa ghor te baah pakar gur kaadh leee ||2||
english: He has taken me by the arm, and pulled me out of the terrible, deep dark pit. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਰਾਖੇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau bhae sagal bhau mitiaa raakhe raakhanahaare ||
english: I have become fearless, and all my fears have been erased. The Savior Lord has saved me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aisee daat teree prabh mere kaaraj sagal savaare ||3||
english: Such is Your generosity, O my God, that You have resolved all my affairs. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan saahib man melaa ||
english: My mind has met with my Lord and Master, the treasure of excellence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੪੮॥
transliteration: saran paiaa naanak souhelaa ||4||9||48||
english: Taking to His Sanctuary, Nanak has become blissful. ||4||9||48||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੂ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) visarahi taa(n) sabh ko laagoo cheet aavahi taa(n) sevaa ||
english: If I forget You, then everyone becomes my enemy. When You come to mind, then they serve me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੂਝੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: avar na kooo doojaa soojhai saache alakh abhevaa ||1||
english: I do not know any other at all, O True, Invisible, Inscrutable Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਲੋਗਨ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: cheet aavai taa(n) sadaa daiaalaa logan kiaa vechaare ||
english: When You come to mind, You are always merciful to me; what can the poor people do to me?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: buraa bhalaa kahu kis no kaheeai sagale jee tumhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Tell me, who should I call good or bad, since all beings are Yours? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ॥
transliteration: teree tek teraa aadhaaraa haath dei too(n) raakhahi ||
english: You are my Shelter, You are my Support; giving me Your hand, You protect me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਿਪੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਭਾਖੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis jan oopar teree kirapaa tis kau bip na kooo bhaakhai ||2||
english: That humble being, upon whom You bestow Your Grace, is not touched by slander or suffering. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਓਹਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: oho sukh ohaa vadiaaee jo prabh jee man bhaanee ||
english: That is peace, and that is greatness, which is pleasing to the mind of the Dear Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਦ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too(n) daanaa too(n) sad miharavaanaa naam milai ra(n)g maanee ||3||
english: You are all-knowing, You are forever compassionate; obtaining Your Name, I revel in it and make merry. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tudh aagai aradaas hamaaree jeeu pi(n)d sabh teraa ||
english: I offer my prayer to You; my body and soul are all Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sabh teree vadiaaee koee naau na jaanai meraa ||4||10||49||
english: Says Nanak, this is all Your greatness; no one even knows my name. ||4||10||49||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh a(n)tarajaamee saadhasa(n)g har paaeeai ||
english: Show Your Mercy, O God, O Searcher of hearts, that in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I might obtain You, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਲਿ ਕਿਵਾਰ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khol kivaar dikhaale darasan punarap janam na aaeeai ||1||
english: When You open Your Door, and reveal the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the mortal is not relegated to reincarnation again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਉ ਪਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਹਰਉ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: milau pareetam suaamee apune sagale dookh harau re ||
english: Meeting with my Beloved Lord aand Master, all my pains are taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਨੑਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham jinhi ridai araadhiaa taa kai sa(n)g tarau re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am saved and carried across, in the company of those who remember the Supreme Lord God in their hearts. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਪਾਵਕ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਏ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mahaa udiaan paavak saagar bhae harakh sog mahi basanaa ||
english: This world is a great wilderness, an ocean of fire, in which mortals abide, in pleasure and pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur bhet bhaiaa man niramal jap a(n)mrit har rasanaa ||2||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, the mortal becomes immaculately pure; with his tongue, he chants the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਕੀਓ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੋਮਲ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tan dhan thaap keeo sabh apanaa komal ba(n)dhan baa(n)dhiaa ||
english: He preserves his body and wealth, and takes everything as his own; such are the subtle bonds which bind him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur parasaad bhae jan mukate har har naam araadhiaa ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, the mortal becomes liberated, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: raakh leee prabh raakhanahaarai jo prabh apune bhaane ||
english: God, the Savior, has saved those, who are pleasing to the Will of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਦਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੫੦॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tumhraa daate naanak sad kurabaane ||4||11||50||
english: The soul and body are all Yours, O Great Giver; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice. ||4||11||50||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਲਨ ਨੀਦ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਭਇਓ ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: moh malan need te chhutakee kaun anugrahu bhaio ree ||
english: You have avoided the slumber of attachment and impurity - by whose favor has this happened?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mahaa mohanee tudh na viaapai teraa aalas kahaa gaio ree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The great enticer does not affect you. Where has your laziness gone? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਗਾਖਰੋ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਕਉਨ ਛੁਟਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar gaakharo sa(n)jam kaun chhutio ree ||
english: How have you escaped from the treachery of sexual desire, anger and egotism?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਅਸੁਰ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨੀਆ ਸਗਲੋ ਭਵਨੁ ਲੁਟਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sur nar dev asur trai guneeaa sagalo bhavan lutio ree ||1||
english: The holy beings, angels and demons of the three qualities, and all the worlds have been plundered. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਵਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਜਾਲੇ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿਆ ਬੂਟੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: daavaa agan bahut trin jaale koee hariaa boot rahio ree ||
english: The forest fire has burnt down so much of the grass; how rare are the plants which have remained green.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਵਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aiso samarath varan na saakau taa kee upamaa jaat na kahio ree ||2||
english: He is so All-powerful, that I cannot even describe Him; no one can chant His Praises. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜਰ ਕੋਠ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਨ ਕਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਰਨੁ ਬਨਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaajar koth mahi bhaee na kaaree niramal baran banio ree ||
english: In the store-room of the lamp-black, I did not turn black; my color remained immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਿਓ ਅਚਰਜ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mahaa ma(n)tr gur hiradai basio acharaj naam sunio ree ||3||
english: The Guru has implanted the Maha Mantra, the Great Mantra, within my heart, and I have heard the wondrous Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਦਰਿ ਅਵਲੋਕਨ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਚਰਣਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh nadar avalokan apunai charan lagaaee ||
english: Showing His Mercy, God has looked upon me with favor, and He has attached me to His feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੫੧॥
transliteration: prem bhagat naanak sukh paaiaa saadhoo sa(n)g samaaee ||4||12||51||
english: Through loving devotional worship, O Nanak, I have obtained peace; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am absorbed into the Lord. ||4||12||51||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੭ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 7 mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Seventh House, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੁ ਚੋਲਨਾ ਤੈ ਤਨਿ ਸੋਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: laal cholanaa tai tan sohiaa ||
english: That red dress looks so beautiful on your body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿਜਨ ਭਾਨੀ ਤਾਂ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: surijan bhaanee taa(n) man mohiaa ||1||
english: Your Husband Lord is pleased, and His heart is enticed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਬਨੀ ਰੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਲਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: kavan banee ree teree laalee ||
english: Whose handiwork is this red beauty of yours?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਤੂੰ ਭਈ ਗੁਲਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kavan ra(n)g too(n) bhaee gulaalee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whose love has rendered the poppy so red? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: tum hee su(n)dar tumahi suhaag ||
english: You are so beautiful; you are the happy soul-bride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tum ghar laalan tum ghar bhaag ||2||
english: Your Beloved is in your home; good fortune is in your home. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਤਵੰਤੀ ਤੂੰ ਪਰਧਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: too(n) satava(n)tee too(n) paradhaan ||
english: You are pure and chaste, you are most distinguished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਨੀ ਤੁਹੀ ਸੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too(n) preetam bhaanee tuhee sur giaan ||3||
english: You are pleasing to Your Beloved, and you have sublime understanding. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਨੀ ਤਾਂ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੁਲਾਲ ॥
transliteration: preetam bhaanee taa(n) ra(n)g gulaal ||
english: I am pleasing to my Beloved, and so I am imbued with the deep red color.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak subh drisat nihaal ||4||
english: Says Nanak, I have been totally blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ਇਹ ਹਮਰੀ ਘਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sun ree sakhee ih hamaree ghaal ||
english: Listen, O companions: this is my only work;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ਸਵਾਰਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੫੨॥
transliteration: prabh aap seegaar savaaranahaar ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||1||52||
english: God Himself is the One who embellishes and adorns. ||1||Second Pause||1||52||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਘਨੋ ਜਬ ਹੋਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dookh ghano jab hote door ||
english: I suffered in pain, when I thought He was far away;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ab masalat mohi milee hadoor ||1||
english: but now, He is Ever-present, and I receive His instructions. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੁਕਾ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: chukaa nihoraa sakhee saheree ||
english: My pride is gone, O friends and companions;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bharam gaiaa gur pir sa(n)g meree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: my doubt is dispelled, and the Guru has united me with my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਆਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੇਜ ਧਰੀ ॥
transliteration: nikat aan pri sej dharee ||
english: My Beloved has drawn me near to Him, and seated me on His Bed;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਣਿ ਕਢਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿ ਪਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaan kadhan te chhoot paree ||2||
english: I have escaped the clutches of others. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਜਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)dar merai sabad ujaaraa ||
english: In the mansion of my heart, shines the Light of the Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anad binodee khasam hamaaraa ||3||
english: My Husband Lord is blissful and playful. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: masatak bhaag mai pir ghar aaiaa ||
english: According to the destiny written upon my forehead, my Husband Lord has come home to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੩॥
transliteration: thir sohaag naanak jan paaiaa ||4||2||53||
english: Servant Nanak has obtained the eternal marriage. ||4||2||53||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: saach naam meraa man laagaa ||
english: My mind is attached to the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਗਨ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਠਾ ਬਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: logan siu meraa thaathaa baagaa ||1||
english: My dealings with other people are only superficial. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੂਤੁ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਮਉਲਾ ॥
transliteration: baahar soot sagal siu maulaa ||
english: Outwardly, I am on good terms with all;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਉਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: alipat rahau jaise jal mahi kaulaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: but I remain detached, like the lotus upon the water. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: mukh kee baat sagal siu karataa ||
english: By word of mouth, I talk with everyone;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਧਰਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jee sa(n)g prabh apunaa dharataa ||2||
english: but I keep God clasped to my heart. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਸਿ ਆਵਤ ਹੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਭੀਹਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: dees aavat hai bahut bheehaalaa ||
english: I may appear utterly terrible,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sagal charan kee ihu man raalaa ||3||
english: but my mind is the dust of all men's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak jan gur pooraa paaiaa ||
english: Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੪॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar ek dikhaaiaa ||4||3||54||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, He has shown me the One Lord. ||4||3||54||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਤੁ ਰਲੀਆ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: paavat raleeaa joban baleeaa ||
english: The mortal revels in joy, in the vigor of youth;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਲੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam binaa maatee sa(n)g raleeaa ||1||
english: but without the Name, he mingles with dust. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਨ ਕੁੰਡਲੀਆ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਓਢਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kaan ku(n)daleeaa basatr odhaleeaa ||
english: He may wear ear-rings and fine clothes,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਲੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਗਰਬਲੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sej sukhaleeaa man garabaleeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and have a comfortable bed, and his mind may be so proud. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਲੈ ਕੁੰਚਰੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਨਿਕ ਛਤਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: talai ku(n)chareeaa sir kanik chhatareeaa ||
english: He may have elephants to ride, and golden umbrellas over his head;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਲੇ ਧਰਨਿ ਗਡਲੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har bhagat binaa le dharan gadaleeaa ||2||
english: but without devotional worship to the Lord, he is buried beneath the dirt. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਸੁੰਦਰੀਆ ਅਨਿਕ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: roop su(n)dareeaa anik isatareeaa ||
english: He may enjoy many women, of exquisite beauty;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਆਦ ਫਿਕਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har ras bin sabh suaad phikareeaa ||3||
english: but without the sublime essence of the Lord, all tastes are tasteless. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਛਲੀਆ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਖਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa chhaleeaa bikaar bikhaleeaa ||
english: Deluded by Maya, the mortal is led into sin and corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਅਲੀਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੫੫॥
transliteration: saran naanak prabh purakh daialeeaa ||4||4||55||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the All-powerful, Compassionate Lord. ||4||4||55||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਬਗੀਚਾ ਪੇਡ ਘਨ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ek bageechaa ped ghan kariaa ||
english: There is a garden, in which so many plants have grown.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਹਾ ਮਹਿ ਫਲਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam tahaa mahi phaliaa ||1||
english: They bear the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam as their fruit. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: aisaa karahu beechaar giaanee ||
english: Consider this, O wise one,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa te paaeeai pad nirabaanee ||
english: by which you may attain the state of Nirvaanaa.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਿਖੂਆ ਕੇ ਕੁੰਟਾ ਬੀਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aas paas bikhooaa ke ku(n)taa beech a(n)mrit hai bhaaee re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All around this garden are pools of poison, but within it is the Ambrosial Nectar, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਚਨਹਾਰੇ ਏਕੈ ਮਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: si(n)chanahaare ekai maalee ||
english: There is only one gardener who tends it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਬਰਿ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਤ ਪਤ ਡਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khabar karat hai paat pat daalee ||2||
english: He takes care of every leaf and branch. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਬਨਸਪਤਿ ਆਣਿ ਜੜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sagal banasapat aan jaRaaee ||
english: He brings all sorts of plants and plants them there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਫੂਲੀ ਨਿਫਲ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sagalee phoolee niphal na kaaee ||3||
english: They all bear fruit - none is without fruit. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit phal naam jin gur te paaiaa ||
english: One who receives the Ambrosial Fruit of the Naam from the Guru

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਰੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੫੬॥
transliteration: naanak daas taree tin maaiaa ||4||5||56||
english: - O Nanak, such a servant crosses over the ocean of Maya. ||4||5||56||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਲੀਲਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raaj leelaa terai naam banaaee ||
english: The pleasures of royalty are derived from Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੁ ਬਨਿਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jog baniaa teraa keeratan gaaee ||1||
english: I attain Yoga, singing the Kirtan of Your Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਬਨੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਓਲੑੈ ॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa bane terai olhai ||
english: All comforts are obtained in Your Shelter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਪਰਦੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਖੋਲੑੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhram ke parade satigur kholhe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru has removed the veil of doubt. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: hukam boojh ra(n)g ras maane ||
english: Understanding the Command of the Lord's Will, I revel in pleasure and joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur sevaa mahaa nirabaane ||2||
english: Serving the True Guru, I obtain the supreme state of Nirvaanaa. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jin too(n) jaataa so girasat udaasee paravaan ||
english: One who recognizes You is recognized as a householder, and as a renunciate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam rataa soee nirabaan ||3||
english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he dwells in Nirvaanaa. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau milio naam nidhaanaa ||
english: One who has obtained the treasure of the Naam

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਪੂਰ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੫੭॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak taa kaa poor khajaanaa ||4||6||57||
english: - prays Nanak, his treasure-house is filled to overflowing. ||4||6||57||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਜਾਉ ਤ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: teerath jaau ta hau hau karate ||
english: Journeying to sacred shrines of pilgrimage, I see the mortals acting in ego.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੂਛਉ ਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit poochhau ta maaiaa raate ||1||
english: If I ask the Pandits, I find them tainted by Maya. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: so asathaan bataavahu meetaa ||
english: Show me that place, O friend,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai har har keeratan neetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are forever sung. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: saasatr bed paap pu(n)n veechaar ||
english: The Shaastras and the Vedas speak of sin and virtue;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਅਉਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: narak surag phir phir autaar ||2||
english: they say that mortals are reincarnated into heaven and hell, over and over again. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਸਤ ਮਹਿ ਚਿੰਤ ਉਦਾਸ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: girasat mahi chi(n)t udaas aha(n)kaar ||
english: In the householder's life, there is anxiety, and in the life of the renunciate, there is egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਜੀਅ ਕਉ ਜੰਜਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karam karat jee kau ja(n)jaar ||3||
english: Performing religious rituals, the soul is entangled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh kirapaa te man vas aaiaa ||
english: By God's Grace, the mind is brought under control;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh taree tin maaiaa ||4||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh crosses over the ocean of Maya. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har keeratan gaaeeai ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭॥੫੮॥
transliteration: ihu asathaan guroo te paaeeai ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||7||58||
english: This place is found through the Guru. ||1||Second Pause||7||58||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਖਾ ॥
transliteration: ghar mahi sookh baahar phun sookhaa ||
english: Within my home there is peace, and outwardly there is peace as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਦੂਖਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har simarat sagal binaase dookhaa ||1||
english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, all pains are erased. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਂਵੈਂ ॥
transliteration: sagal sookh jaa(n) too(n) chit aa(n)vai(n) ||
english: There is total peace, when You come into my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: so naam japai jo jan tudh bhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He alone is pleasing to Your Will, who chants the Naam. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tan man seetal jap naam teraa ||
english: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, chanting the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਢਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har har japat dhahai dukh deraa ||2||
english: Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, the house of pain is demolished. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: hukam boojhai soee paravaan ||
english: He alone, who understands the Command of the Lord's Will, is approved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saach sabad jaa kaa neesaan ||3||
english: The True Shabad of the Word of God is his trademark and insignia. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai har naam driRaaiaa ||
english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੫੯॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak merai man sukh paaiaa ||4||8||59||
english: Prays Nanak, my mind has found peace. ||4||8||59||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਪਠਾਵਹੁ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਜਾਈਁ ॥
transliteration: jahaa pathaavahu tah tah jaaee(n) ||
english: Wherever You send me, there I go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo tum dehu soee sukh paaee(n) ||1||
english: Whatever You give me, brings me peace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਚੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sadaa chere govi(n)d gosaaee ||
english: I am forever the chaylaa, the humble disciple, of the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈਁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tumhree kripaa te tripat aghaaee(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Your Grace, I am satisfied and satiated. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰਾ ਦੀਆ ਪੈਨੑਉ ਖਾਈਁ ॥
transliteration: tumaraa deeaa painh khaaee(n) ||
english: Whatever You give me, I wear and eat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਲਾਈਁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tau prasaad prabh sukhee valaaee(n) ||2||
english: By Your Grace, O God, my life passes peacefully. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਈਁ ॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar tujhai dhiaaee(n) ||
english: Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਈਁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tumhrai lavai na kooo laaee(n) ||3||
english: I recognize none as equal to You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਤ ਇਵੈ ਧਿਆਈਁ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak nit ivai dhiaaee(n) ||
english: Says Nanak, this is my continual meditation:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਤਹ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਈਁ ॥੪॥੯॥੬੦॥
transliteration: gat hovai sa(n)tah lag paaee(n) ||4||9||60||
english: that I may be emancipated, clinging to the Feet of the Saints. ||4||9||60||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat sovat dhiaaeeai ||
english: While standing up, and sitting down, and even while asleep, meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਤ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maarag chalat hare har gaaeeai ||1||
english: Walking on the Way, sing the Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨੀਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ॥
transliteration: sravan suneejai a(n)mrit kathaa ||
english: With your ears, listen to the Ambrosial Sermon.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਸੁਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਮਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaas sunee man hoi ana(n)daa dookh rog man sagale lathaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Listening to it, your mind shall be filled with bliss, and the troubles and diseases of your mind shall all depart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਬਾਟ ਘਾਟ ਜਪੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kaaraj kaam baat ghaat japeejai ||
english: While you work at your job, on the road and at the beach, meditate and chant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur prasaad har a(n)mrit peejai ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: dinas rain har keeratan gaaeeai ||
english: The humble being who sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, day and night,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਵਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so jan jam kee vaat na paaeeai ||3||
english: does not have to go with the Messenger of Death. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar jis visarahi naahee ||
english: One who does not forget the Lord, twenty-four hours a day, is emancipated;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੬੧॥
transliteration: gat hovai naanak tis lag paaee ||4||10||61||
english: O Nanak, I fall at his feet. ||4||10||61||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran sookh nivaas ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, one abides in peace;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਦੁਖ ਹੋਵਤ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhaee kaliaan dukh hovat naas ||1||
english: one becomes happy, and suffering is ended. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: anad karahu prabh ke gun gaavahu ||
english: Celebrate, make merry, and sing God's Glories.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur apanaa sad sadaa manaavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Forever and ever, surrender to the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur kaa sach sabad kamaavahu ||
english: Act in accordance with the Shabad, the True Word of the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: thir ghar baithe prabh apanaa paavahu ||2||
english: Remain steady and stable within the home of your own self, and find God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਕਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਚੀਤ ॥
transliteration: par kaa buraa na raakhahu cheet ||
english: Do not harbor evil intentions against others in your mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tum kau dukh nahee bhaaee meet ||3||
english: and you shall not be troubled, O Siblings of Destiny, O friends. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥
transliteration: har har ta(n)t ma(n)t gur deenhaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the Tantric exercise, and the Mantra, given by the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਚੀਨੑਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੬੨॥
transliteration: ihu sukh naanak anadin cheenhaa ||4||11||62||
english: Nanak knows this peace alone, night and day. ||4||11||62||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jis neech kau koee na jaanai ||
english: That wretched being, whom no one knows

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਉਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam japat uhu chahu ku(n)t maanai ||1||
english: - chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he is honored in the four directions. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: darasan maagau dehi piaare ||
english: I beg for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please, give it to me, O Beloved!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਨ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tumaree sevaa kaun kaun na taare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Serving You, who, who has not been saved? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai nikat na aavai koee ||
english: That person, whom no one wants to be near

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਆ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sagal srisat uaa ke charan mal dhoee ||2||
english: - the whole world comes to wash the dirt of his feet. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jo praanee kaahoo na aavat kaam ||
english: That mortal, who is of no use to anyone at all

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad taa ko japeeai naam ||3||
english: - by the Grace of the Saints, he meditates on the Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਨ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g man sovat jaage ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the sleeping mind awakens.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੀਠੇ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੬੩॥
transliteration: tab prabh naanak meethe laage ||4||12||63||
english: Then, O Nanak, God seems sweet. ||4||12||63||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੀ ਨੈਨ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ॥
transliteration: eko ekee nain nihaarau ||
english: With my eyes, I behold the One and Only Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa har naam samhaarau ||1||
english: Forever and ever, I contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮਾ ਰਾਮਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: raam raamaa raamaa gun gaavau ||
english: I sing the Praises of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prataap saadh kai sa(n)ge har har naam dhiaavau re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By the graceful favor of the Saints, I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sagal samagree jaa kai soot paroee ||
english: Everything is strung on His string.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar raviaa soee ||2||
english: He is contained in each and every heart. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: opat paralau khin mahi karataa ||
english: He creates and destroys in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਲੇਪਾ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap alepaa niragun rahataa ||3||
english: He Himself remains unattached, and without attributes. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੬੪॥
transliteration: ana(n)d karai naanak kaa suaamee ||4||13||64||
english: Nanak's Lord and Master celebrates in bliss. ||4||13||64||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਰਹੇ ਭਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kot janam ke rahe bhavaare ||
english: My wandering through millions of births has ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਜੀਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dulabh deh jeetee nahee haare ||1||
english: I have won, and not lost, this human body, so difficult to obtain. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਦੁਖ ਦਰਦ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kilabikh binaase dukh darad door ||
english: My sins have been erased, and my sufferings and pains are gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhae puneet sa(n)tan kee dhoor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have been sanctified by the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: prabh ke sa(n)t udhaaran jog ||
english: The Saints of God have the ability to save us;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis bhete jis dhur sa(n)jog ||2||
english: they meet with those of us who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: man aana(n)d ma(n)tr gur deeaa ||
english: My mind is filled with bliss, since the Guru gave me the Mantra of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: trisan bujhee man nihachal theeaa ||3||
english: My thirst has been quenched, and my mind has become steady and stable. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
transliteration: naam padaarath nau nidh sidh ||
english: The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is for me the nine treasures, and the spiritual powers of the Siddhas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਬੁਧਿ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੬੫॥
transliteration: naanak gur te paaee budh ||4||14||65||
english: O Nanak, I have obtained understanding from the Guru. ||4||14||65||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੀ ਤਿਆਸ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mitee tiaas agiaan a(n)dhere ||
english: My thirst, and the darkness of ignorance have been removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਘ ਕਟੇ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadh sevaa agh kate ghanere ||1||
english: Serving the Holy Saints, countless sins are obliterated. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਘਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ghanaa ||
english: I have obtained celestial peace and immense joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te bhae man niramal har har har har naam sunaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Serving the Guru, my mind has become immaculately pure, and I have heard the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਢੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: binasio man kaa moorakh dheethaa ||
english: The stubborn foolishness of my mind is gone;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prabh kaa bhaanaa laagaa meethaa ||2||
english: God's Will has become sweet to me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ॥
transliteration: gur poore ke charan gahe ||
english: I have grasped the Feet of the Perfect Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਲਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kot janam ke paap lahe ||3||
english: and the sins of countless incarnations have been washed away. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਫਲ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ratan janam ihu saphal bhaiaa ||
english: The jewel of this life has become fruitful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰੀ ਮਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੬੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh karee maiaa ||4||15||66||
english: Says Nanak, God has shown mercy to me. ||4||15||66||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur apanaa sad sadaa samhaare ||
english: I contemplate, forever and ever, the True Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕੇਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਝਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur ke charan kes sa(n)g jhaare ||1||
english: with my hair, I dust the feet of the Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਗਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaag re man jaaganahaare ||
english: Be wakeful, O my awakening mind!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ ਕਾਮਾ ਝੂਠਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin har avar na aavas kaamaa jhoothaa mohu mithiaa pasaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Lord, nothing else shall be of use to you; false is emotional attachment, and useless are worldly entanglements. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kee baanee siu ra(n)g laai ||
english: Embrace love for the Word of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kirapaal hoi dukh jaai ||2||
english: When the Guru shows His Mercy, pain is destroyed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur bin doojaa naahee thaau ||
english: Without the Guru, there is no other place of rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur daataa gur devai naau ||3||
english: The Guru is the Giver, the Guru gives the Name. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: gur paarabraham paramesar aap ||
english: The Guru is the Supreme Lord God; He Himself is the Transcendent Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੬੭॥
transliteration: aath pahar naanak gur jaap ||4||16||67||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, O Nanak, meditate on the Guru. ||4||16||67||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪੇਡੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੀ ਸਾਖ ॥
transliteration: aape ped bisathaaree saakh ||
english: He Himself is the tree, and the branches extending out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਖੇਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apanee khetee aape raakh ||1||
english: He Himself preserves His own crop. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਏਕੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jat kat pekhau ekai ohee ||
english: Wherever I look, I see that One Lord alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar aape soee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Deep within each and every heart, He Himself is contained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੂਰੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape soor kiran bisathaar ||
english: He Himself is the sun, and the rays emanating from it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: soee gupat soee aakaar ||2||
english: He is concealed, and He is revealed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਗੁਣ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਥਾਪੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saragun niragun thaapai naau ||
english: He is said to be of the highest attributes, and without attributes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕੈ ਕੀਨੋ ਠਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: duh mil ekai keeno thaau ||3||
english: Both converge onto His single point. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur bhram bhau khoiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt and fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਨੈਨ ਅਲੋਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੬੮॥
transliteration: anad roop sabh nain aloiaa ||4||17||68||
english: With my eyes, I perceive the Lord, the embodiment of bliss, to be everywhere. ||4||17||68||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ukat siaanap kichhoo na jaanaa ||
english: I know nothing of arguments or cleverness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: din rain teraa naam vakhaanaa ||1||
english: Day and night, I chant Your Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mai niragun gun naahee koi ||
english: I am worthless; I have no virtue at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavanahaar prabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God is the Creator, the Cause of all causes. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: moorakh mugadh agiaan aveechaaree ||
english: I am foolish, stupid, ignorant and thoughtless;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam tere kee aas man dhaaree ||2||
english: Your Name is my mind's only hope. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam karam na saadhaa ||
english: I have not practiced chanting, deep meditation, self-discipline or good actions;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam prabhoo kaa manahi araadhaa ||3||
english: but within my mind, I have worshipped God's Name. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kichhoo na jaanaa mat meree thoree ||
english: I know nothing, and my intellect is inadequate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੬੯॥
transliteration: binavat naanak ot prabh toree ||4||18||69||
english: Prays Nanak, O God, You are my only Support. ||4||18||69||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਖਰ ਦੁਇ ਇਹ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: har har akhar dui ih maalaa ||
english: These two words, Har, Har, make up my maalaa.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਤ ਜਪਤ ਭਏ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: japat japat bhae deen daiaalaa ||1||
english: Continually chanting and reciting this rosary, God has become merciful to me, His humble servant. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੀ ॥
transliteration: karau benatee satigur apunee ||
english: I offer my prayer to the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhahu saranaaee mo kau dehu hare har japanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Shower Your Mercy upon me, and keep me safe in Your Sanctuary; please, give me the maalaa, the rosary of Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਉਰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: har maalaa ur a(n)tar dhaarai ||
english: One who enshrines this rosary of the Lord's Name within his heart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: janam maran kaa dookh nivaarai ||2||
english: is freed of the pains of birth and death. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: hiradai samaalai mukh har har bolai ||
english: The humble being who contemplates the Lord within his heart, and chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har, with his mouth,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so jan it ut katahi na dolai ||3||
english: never wavers, here or hereafter. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਰਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jo raachai naai ||
english: Says Nanak, one who is imbued with the Name,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: har maalaa taa kai sa(n)g jaai ||4||19||70||
english: goes to the next world with the maalaa of the Lord's Name. ||4||19||70||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa sabh kichh tis kaa hoi ||
english: All things belong to Him - let yourself belong to Him as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis jan lep na biaapai koi ||1||
english: No stain clings to such a humble being. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa sevak sad hee mukataa ||
english: The Lord's servant is liberated forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karai soee bhal jan kai at niramal daas kee jugataa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever He does, is pleasing to His servant; the way of life of His slave is immaculately pure. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sagal tiaag har saranee aaiaa ||
english: One who renounces everything, and enters the Lord's Sanctuary

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis jan kahaa biaapai maaiaa ||2||
english: - how can Maya cling to him? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan jaa ke man maahi ||
english: With the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in his mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis kau chi(n)taa supanai naahi ||3||
english: he suffers no anxiety, even in dreams. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur pooraa paaiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਸਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੭੧॥
transliteration: bharam mohu sagal binasaaiaa ||4||20||71||
english: My doubts and attachments have been totally obliterated. ||4||20||71||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੋਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jau suprasa(n)n hoio prabh meraa ||
english: When my God is totally pleased with me,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa(n) dookh bharam kahu kaise neraa ||1||
english: then, tell me, how can suffering or doubt draw near me? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sun sun jeevaa soi tumhaaree ||
english: Continually listening to Your Glory, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਉ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mohi niragun kau lehu udhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am worthless - save me, O Lord! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਦੂਖੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: mit gaiaa dookh bisaaree chi(n)taa ||
english: My suffering has been ended, and my anxiety is forgotten.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਪਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: phal paaiaa jap satigur ma(n)taa ||2||
english: I have obtained my reward, chanting the Mantra of the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: soee sat sat hai soi ||
english: He is True, and True is His glory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਖੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: simar simar rakh ka(n)th paroi ||3||
english: Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, keep Him clasped to your heart. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉਨ ਉਹ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak kaun uh karamaa ||
english: Says Nanak, what action is there left to do,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੭੨॥
transliteration: jaa kai man vasiaa har naamaa ||4||21||72||
english: by one whose mind is filled with the Lord's Name? ||4||21||72||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar vigoote ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, and egotism lead to ruin.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har simaran kar har jan chhoote ||1||
english: Meditating on the Lord, the Lord's humble servants are redeemed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: soi rahe maaiaa mad maate ||
english: The mortals are asleep, intoxicated with the wine of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਤ ਭਗਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaagat bhagat simarat har raate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The devotees remain awake, imbued with the Lord's meditation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: moh bharam bahu jon bhavaaiaa ||
english: In emotional attachment and doubt, the mortals wander through countless incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: asathir bhagat har charan dhiaaiaa ||2||
english: The devotees remain ever-stable, meditating on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan a(n)dh koop grih meraa ||
english: Bound to household and possessions, the mortals are lost in the deep, dark pit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mukate sa(n)t bujhahi har neraa ||3||
english: The Saints are liberated, knowing the Lord to be near at hand. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jo prabh saranaaee ||
english: Says Nanak, one who has taken to God's Sanctuary,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੭੩॥
transliteration: eehaa sukh aagai gat paaee ||4||22||73||
english: obtains peace in this world, and salvation in the world hereafter. ||4||22||73||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਰੰਗੁ ਹਮ ਮੀਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: too meraa tara(n)g ham meen tumaare ||
english: You are my waves, and I am Your fish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too meraa thaakur ham terai duaare ||1||
english: You are my Lord and Master; I wait at Your Door. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਹਉ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) meraa karataa hau sevak teraa ||
english: You are my Creator, and I am Your servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saran gahee prabh gunee gaheraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have taken to Your Sanctuary, O God, most profound and excellent. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਤੂ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: too meraa jeevan too aadhaar ||
english: You are my life, You are my Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝਹਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਕਉਲਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tujhahi pekh bigasai kaulaar ||2||
english: Beholding You, my heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਤੂ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: too meree gat pat too paravaan ||
english: You are my salvation and honor; You make me acceptable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਮੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too samarath mai teraa taan ||3||
english: You are All-powerful, You are my strength. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਉ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: anadin japau naam gunataas ||
english: Night and day, I chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the treasure of excellence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੭੪॥
transliteration: naanak kee prabh pahi aradaas ||4||23||74||
english: This is Nanak's prayer to God. ||4||23||74||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: rovanahaarai jhooth kamaanaa ||
english: The mourner practices falsehood;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਸੋਗੁ ਕਰਤ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: has has sog karat begaanaa ||1||
english: he laughs with glee, while mourning for others. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਮੂਆ ਕਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ko mooaa kaa kai ghar gaavan ||
english: Someone has died, while there is singing in someone else's house.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੋ ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਪਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ko rovai ko has has paavan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One mourns and bewails, while another laughs with glee. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: baal bivasathaa te biradhaanaa ||
english: From childhood to old age,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਮੂਕਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pahuch na mookaa phir pachhutaanaa ||2||
english: the mortal does not attain his goals, and he comes to regret in the end. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: trihu gun mahi varatai sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The world is under the influence of the three qualities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਅਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: narak surag phir phir autaaraa ||3||
english: The mortal is reincarnated, again and again, into heaven and hell. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jo laaiaa naam ||
english: Says Nanak, one who is attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੭੫॥
transliteration: saphal janam taa kaa paravaan ||4||24||75||
english: becomes acceptable, and his life becomes fruitful. ||4||24||75||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: soi rahee prabh khabar na jaanee ||
english: She remains asleep, and does not know the news of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhor bhaiaa bahur pachhutaanee ||1||
english: The day dawns, and then, she regrets. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਧਰਉ ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pri prem sahaj man anad dharau ree ||
english: Loving the Beloved, the mind is filled with celestial bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕੀ ਲਾਲਸਾ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh milabe kee laalasaa taa te aalas kahaa karau ree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You yearn to meet with God, so why do you delay? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਆਣਿ ਨਿਸਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: kar mahi a(n)mrit aan nisaario ||
english: He came and poured His Ambrosial Nectar into your hands,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਓ ਭੂਮ ਪਰਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khisar gaio bhoom par daario ||2||
english: but it slipped through your fingers, and fell onto the ground. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਦਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਾਦੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saad mohi laadee aha(n)kaare ||
english: You are burdened with desire, emotional attachment and egotism;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੋਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dos naahee prabh karanaihaare ||3||
english: it is not the fault of God the Creator. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਭਰਮ ਅੰਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mite bharam a(n)dhaare ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the darkness of doubt is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੀ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੭੬॥
transliteration: naanak melee sirajanahaare ||4||25||76||
english: O Nanak, the Creator Lord blends us with Himself. ||4||25||76||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal kee aas piaare ||
english: I long for the Lotus Feet of my Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jamaka(n)kar nas gae vichaare ||1||
english: The wretched Messenger of Death has run away from me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਇਆ ॥
transliteration: too chit aavahi teree maiaa ||
english: You enter into my mind, by Your Kind Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮ ਸਗਲ ਰੋਗ ਖਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: simarat naam sagal rog khaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all diseases are destroyed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਦੂਖ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਕਉ ॥
transliteration: anik dookh devahi avaraa kau ||
english: Death gives so much pain to others,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pahuch na saakahi jan tere kau ||2||
english: but it cannot even come near Your slave. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: daras tere kee piaas man laagee ||
english: My mind thirsts for Your Vision;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਬਸੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sahaj ana(n)d basai bairaagee ||3||
english: in peaceful ease and bliss, I dwell in detachment. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: naanak kee aradaas suneejai ||
english: Hear this prayer of Nanak:

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: keval naam ride mahi deejai ||4||26||77||
english: please, infuse Your Name into his heart. ||4||26||77||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੋ ਮਿਟੇ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
transliteration: man tripataano mite ja(n)jaal ||
english: My mind is satisfied, and my entanglements have been dissolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh apunaa hoiaa kirapaal ||1||
english: God has become merciful to me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਲੀ ਬਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad bhalee banee ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, everything has turned out well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸੋ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai grihi sabh kichh hai pooran so bhetiaa nirabhai dhanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: His House is overflowing with all things; I have met Him, the Fearless Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: naam driRaaiaa saadh kripaal ||
english: By the Kind Mercy of the Holy Saints, the Naam has been implanted within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਭੂਖ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mit gaee bhookh mahaa bikaraal ||2||
english: The most dreadful desires have been eliminated. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: thaakur apunai keenee daat ||
english: My Master has given me a gift;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jalan bujhee man hoee saa(n)t ||3||
english: the fire has been extinguished, and my mind is now at peace. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਭਾਲ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mit gaee bhaal man sahaj samaanaa ||
english: My search has ended, and my mind is absorbed in celestial bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੭੮॥
transliteration: naanak paaiaa naam khajaanaa ||4||27||78||
english: Nanak has obtained the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||27||78||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: thaakur siu jaa kee ban aaee ||
english: Those who are attuned to their Lord and Master

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੋਜਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhojan pooran rahe aghaaee ||1||
english: are satisfied and fulfilled with the perfect food. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਛੂ ਨ ਥੋਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ॥
transliteration: kachhoo na thoraa har bhagatan kau ||
english: The Lord's devotees never run short of anything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ ਦੇਵਨ ਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khaat kharachat bilachhat devan kau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They have plenty to eat, spend, enjoy and give. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਧਨੀ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa dhanee agam gusaaee ||
english: One who has the Unfathomable Lord of the Universe as his Master

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੀ ਕਹੁ ਕੇਤ ਚਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maanukh kee kahu ket chalaaee ||2||
english: - how can any mere mortal stand up to him? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee sevaa das asat sidhaaee ||
english: One who is served by the eighteen supernatural powers of the Siddhas

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਲਕ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: palak disat taa kee laagahu paaee ||3||
english: - grasp his feet, even for an instant. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau daiaa karahu mere suaamee ||
english: That one, upon whom You have showered Your Mercy, O my Lord Master

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੭੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak naahee tin kaamee ||4||28||79||
english: - says Nanak, he does not lack anything. ||4||28||79||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jau mai apunaa satigur dhiaaiaa ||
english: When I meditate on my True Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tab merai man mahaa sukh paaiaa ||1||
english: my mind becomes supremely peaceful. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਗਣਤ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਉ ਸੰਸਾ ॥
transliteration: mit gaee ganat binaasiu sa(n)saa ||
english: The record of my account is erased, and my doubts are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam rate jan bhae bhagava(n)taa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, His humble servant is blessed with good fortune. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jau mai apunaa saahib cheet ||
english: When I remember my Lord and Master,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tau bhau mitio mere meet ||2||
english: my fears are dispelled, O my friend. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jau mai ot gahee prabh teree ||
english: When I took to Your Protection, O God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa(n) pooran hoee manasaa meree ||3||
english: my desires were fulfilled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਿਤ ਮਨਿ ਭਏ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: dekh chalit man bhae dilaasaa ||
english: Gazing upon the wonder of Your play, my mind has become encouraged.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੮੦॥
transliteration: naanak daas teraa bharavaasaa ||4||29||80||
english: Servant Nanak relies on You alone. ||4||29||80||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮੂਸਾ ਲਾਜੁ ਟੁਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: anadin moosaa laaj tukaaee ||
english: Night and day, the mouse of time gnaws away at the rope of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਤ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਮਿਠਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: girat koop mahi khaahi mithaaee ||1||
english: Falling into the well, the mortal eats the sweet treats of Maya. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਚਤ ਸਾਚਤ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sochat saachat rain bihaanee ||
english: Thinking and planning, the night of the life is passing away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anik ra(n)g maaiaa ke chitavat kabahoo na simarai saari(n)gapaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Thinking of the many pleasures of Maya, the mortal never remembers the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: drum kee chhaaiaa nihachal grihu baa(n)dhiaa ||
english: Believing the shade of the tree to be permanent, he builds his house beneath it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਕੈ ਫਾਂਸਿ ਸਕਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਂਧਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaal kai phaa(n)s sakat sar saa(n)dhiaa ||2||
english: But the noose of death is around his neck, and Shakti, the power of Maya, has aimed her arrows at him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲੂ ਕਨਾਰਾ ਤਰੰਗ ਮੁਖਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: baaloo kanaaraa tara(n)g mukh aaiaa ||
english: The sandy shore is being washed away by the waves,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਮੂੜਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so thaan mooR nihachal kar paaiaa ||3||
english: but the fool still believes that place to be permanent. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g japio har raai ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Name of the Lord, the King.
