author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੮੧॥
transliteration: naanak jeevai har gun gaai ||4||30||81||
english: Nanak lives by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||30||81||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ੯ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 dutuke 9 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Thukay 9:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਕਰਤੀ ਕੇਲ ॥
transliteration: un kai sa(n)g too karatee kel ||
english: With that, you are engaged in playful sport;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲ ॥
transliteration: un kai sa(n)g ham tum sa(n)g mel ||
english: with that, I am joined to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਲੋਰੈ ॥
transliteration: unh kai sa(n)g tum sabh kooo lorai ||
english: With that, everyone longs for you;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋਊ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: os binaa kooo mukh nahee jorai ||1||
english: without it, no one would even look at your face. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਹਾ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: te bairaagee kahaa samaae ||
english: Where is that detached soul now contained?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਦੁਹੇਰੀ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tis bin tuhee duheree ree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without it, you are miserable. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: unh kai sa(n)g too grih mahi maahar ||
english: With that, you are the woman of the house;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਾਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: unh kai sa(n)g too hoee hai jaahar ||
english: with that, you are respected.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਰਖੀ ਪਪੋਲਿ ॥
transliteration: unh kai sa(n)g too rakhee papol ||
english: With that, you are caressed;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਰੋਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: os binaa too(n) chhutakee rol ||2||
english: without it, you are reduced to dust. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
transliteration: unh kai sa(n)g teraa maan mahat ||
english: With that, you have honor and respect;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਾਕੁ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
transliteration: unh kai sa(n)g tum saak jagat ||
english: with that, you have relatives in the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਥਾਟੀ ॥
transliteration: unh kai sa(n)g teree sabh bidh thaatee ||
english: With that, you are adorned in every way;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: os binaa too(n) hoee hai maatee ||3||
english: without it, you are reduced to dust. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ohu bairaagee marai na jaai ||
english: That detached soul is neither born, nor dies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਬਾਧਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hukame baadhaa kaar kamaai ||
english: It acts according to the Command of the Lord's Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਥਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: joR vichhoRe naanak thaap ||
english: O Nanak, having fashioned the body, the Lord unites the soul with it, and separates them again;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੮੨॥
transliteration: apanee kudarat jaanai aap ||4||31||82||
english: He alone knows His All-powerful creative nature. ||4||31||82||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰਤਾ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਡਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naa ohu marataa naa ham dariaa ||
english: He does not die, so I do not fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕੜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naa ohu binasai naa ham kaRiaa ||
english: He does not perish, so I do not grieve.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਭੂਖੇ ॥
transliteration: naa ohu niradhan naa ham bhookhe ||
english: He is not poor, so I do not hunger.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਸੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਦੂਖੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naa os dookh na ham kau dookhe ||1||
english: He is not in pain, so I do not suffer. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਮਾਰਨਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: avar na kooo maaranavaaraa ||
english: There is no other Destroyer than Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਉ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jeeau hamaaraa jeeu denahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is my very life, the Giver of life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਬੰਧਨ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: naa us ba(n)dhan naa ham baadhe ||
english: He is not bound, so I am not in bondage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਧੰਧਾ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਧਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: naa us dha(n)dhaa naa ham dhaadhe ||
english: He has no occupation, so I have no entanglements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
transliteration: naa us mail na ham kau mailaa ||
english: He has no impurities, so I have no impurities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਤ ਹਮ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: os ana(n)d ta ham sad kelaa ||2||
english: He is in ecstasy, so I am always happy. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਸੋਚੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸੋਚਾ ॥
transliteration: naa us soch na ham kau sochaa ||
english: He has no anxiety, so I have no cares.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਪੋਚਾ ॥
transliteration: naa us lep na ham kau pochaa ||
english: He has no stain, so I have no pollution.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naa us bhookh na ham kau trisanaa ||
english: He has no hunger, so I have no thirst.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਉਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤਾਂ ਹਮ ਜਚਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa uhu niramal taa(n) ham jachanaa ||3||
english: Since He is immaculately pure, I correspond to Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਕੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ham kichh naahee ekai ohee ||
english: I am nothing; He is the One and only.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aagai paachhai eko soee ||
english: Before and after, He alone exists.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਏ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: naanak gur khoe bhram bha(n)gaa ||
english: O Nanak, the Guru has taken away my doubts and mistakes;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਓਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੋਏ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੮੩॥
transliteration: ham oi mil hoe ik ra(n)gaa ||4||32||83||
english: He and I, joining together, are of the same color. ||4||32||83||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: anik bhaa(n)t kar sevaa kareeai ||
english: Serve Him in many different ways;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jeeu praan dhan aagai dhareeai ||
english: Dedicate your soul, your breath of life and your wealth to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਨੀ ਪਖਾ ਕਰਉ ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: paanee pakhaa karau taj abhimaan ||
english: Carry water for Him, and wave the fan over Him - renounce your ego.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik baar jaaeeai kurabaan ||1||
english: Make yourself a sacrifice to Him, time and time again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saaee suhaagan jo prabh bhaaee ||
english: She alone is the happy soul-bride, who is pleasing to God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tis kai sa(n)g milau meree maaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In her company, I may meet Him, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੀ ਕੀ ਪਨਿਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: daasan daasee kee panihaar ||
english: I am the water-carrier of the slaves of His slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨੑ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: unh kee ren basai jee naal ||
english: I treasure in my soul the dust of their feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਥੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਤ ਪਾਵਉ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: maathai bhaag ta paavau sa(n)g ||
english: By that good destiny inscribed upon my forehead, I obtain their society.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: milai suaamee apunai ra(n)g ||2||
english: Through His Love, the Lord Master meets me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਦੇਵਉ ਸਭ ਨੇਮਾ ॥
transliteration: jaap taap devau sabh nemaa ||
english: I dedicate all to Him - chanting and meditation, austerity and religious observances.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਅਰਪਉ ਸਭ ਹੋਮਾ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam arapau sabh homaa ||
english: I offer all to Him - good actions, righteous conduct and incense burning.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਹੋਵਉ ਰੇਨ ॥
transliteration: garab mohu taj hovau ren ||
english: Renouncing pride and attachment, I become the dust of the feet of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੈਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: unh kai sa(n)g dekhau prabh nain ||3||
english: In their society, I behold God with my eyes. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਏਹੀ ਆਰਾਧਉ ॥
transliteration: nimakh nimakh ehee aaraadhau ||
english: Each and every moment, I contemplate and adore Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਏਹ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧਉ ॥
transliteration: dinas rain eh sevaa saadhau ||
english: Day and night, I serve Him like this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: bhae kripaal gupaal gobi(n)d ||
english: The Lord of the Universe, the Cherisher of the World, has become merciful;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿੰਦ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੮੪॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak bakhasi(n)d ||4||33||84||
english: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, He forgives us. ||4||33||84||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee preet sadaa sukh hoi ||
english: In the Love of God, eternal peace is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee preet dukh lagai na koi ||
english: In the Love of God, one is not touched by pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee preet haumai mal khoi ||
english: In the Love of God, the filth of ego is washed away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh kee preet sad niramal hoi ||1||
english: In the Love of God, one becomes forever immaculate. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੀਤ ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sunahu meet aisaa prem piaar ||
english: Listen, O friend: show such love and affection to God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jee praan ghat ghat aadhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: the Support of the soul, the breath of life, of each and every heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee preet bhae sagal nidhaan ||
english: In the Love of God, all treasures are obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee preet ridai niramal naam ||
english: In the Love of God, the Immaculate Naam fills the heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee preet sad sobhaava(n)t ||
english: In the Love of God, one is eternally embellished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਭ ਮਿਟੀ ਹੈ ਚਿੰਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prabh kee preet sabh mitee hai chi(n)t ||2||
english: In the Love of God, all anxiety is ended. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee preet ihu bhavajal tarai ||
english: In the Love of God, one crosses over this terrible world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਡਰੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee preet jam te nahee darai ||
english: In the Love of God, one does not fear death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee preet sagal udhaarai ||
english: In the Love of God, all are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਲੈ ਸੰਗਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: prabh kee preet chalai sa(n)gaarai ||3||
english: The Love of God shall go along with you. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਭੂਲੈ ॥
transliteration: aapahu koee milai na bhoolai ||
english: By himself, no one is united, and no one goes astray.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਘੂਲੈ ॥
transliteration: jis kripaal tis saadhasa(n)g ghoolai ||
english: One who is blessed by God's Mercy, joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak terai kurabaan ||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਓਟ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੮੫॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ot prabh teraa taan ||4||34||85||
english: O God, You are the Support and the Strength of the Saints. ||4||34||85||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhoopat hoi kai raaj kamaaiaa ||
english: Becoming a king, the mortal wields his royal authority;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਨਰਥ ਵਿਹਾਝੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kar anarath vihaajhee maaiaa ||
english: oppressing the people, he gathers wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਚਤ ਸੰਚਤ ਥੈਲੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)chat sa(n)chat thailee keenhee ||
english: Gathering it and collecting it, he fills his bags.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੑੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh us te daar avar kau deenhee ||1||
english: But God takes it away from him, and gives it to another. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚ ਗਗਰੀਆ ਅੰਭ ਮਝਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kaach gagareeaa a(n)bh majhareeaa ||
english: The mortal is like an unbaked clay pot in water;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਉਆਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: garab garab uaahoo mahi pareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: indulging in pride and egotism, he crumbles down and dissolves. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇਓ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਹੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau hoio bhaiaa niha(n)gaa ||
english: Being fearless, he becomes unrestrained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: cheet na aaio karataa sa(n)gaa ||
english: He does not think of the Creator, who is ever with him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਸਕਰ ਜੋੜੇ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਬਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: lasakar joRe keeaa sa(n)baahaa ||
english: He raises armies, and collects arms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਫੂਕ ਤ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਓ ਸੁਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nikasiaa phook ta hoi gaio suaahaa ||2||
english: But when the breath leaves him, he turns to ashes. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ooche ma(n)dar mahal ar raanee ||
english: He has lofty palaces, mansions and queens,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤਿ ਘੋੜੇ ਜੋੜੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: hasat ghoRe joRe man bhaanee ||
english: elephants and pairs of horses, delighting the mind;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਪੂਤ ਅਰੁ ਧੀਆ ॥
transliteration: vad paravaar poot ar dheeaa ||
english: he is blessed with a great family of sons and daughters.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਪਚੇ ਪਚਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਮੂਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mohi pache pach a(n)dhaa mooaa ||3||
english: But, engrossed in attachment, the blind fool wastes away to death. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਹਾ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਬਿਨਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jinahi upaahaa tinahi binaahaa ||
english: The One who created him destroys him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਰਸਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੁਪਨਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g rasaa jaise supanaahaa ||
english: Enjoyments and pleasures are like just a dream.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: soee mukataa tis raaj maal ||
english: He alone is liberated, and possesses regal power and wealth,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਜਿਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੮੬॥
transliteration: naanak daas jis khasam daiaal ||4||35||86||
english: O Nanak, whom the Lord Master blesses with His Mercy. ||4||35||86||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: inh siu preet karee ghaneree ||
english: The mortal is in love with this,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਤਉ ਵਧੈ ਵਧੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jau mileeai tau vadhai vadheree ||
english: but the more he has, the more he longs for more.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਚਮੜੀ ਜਉ ਛੋਡੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: gal chamaRee jau chhodai naahee ||
english: It hangs around his neck, and does not leave him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਗਿ ਛੁਟੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: laag chhuto satigur kee paaee ||1||
english: But falling at the feet of the True Guru, he is saved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਹਮ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jag mohanee ham tiaag gavaaee ||
english: I have renounced and discarded Maya, the Enticer of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: niragun milio vajee vadhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have met the Absolute Lord, and congratulations are pouring in. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: aisee su(n)dar man kau mohai ||
english: She is so beautiful, she captivates the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਟਿ ਘਾਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਨਿ ਬਨਿ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: baat ghaat grihi ban ban johai ||
english: On the road, and the beach, at home, in the forest and in the wilderness, she touches us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
transliteration: man tan laagai hoi kai meethee ||
english: She seems so sweet to the mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੈ ਖੋਟੀ ਡੀਠੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur prasaad mai khotee deethee ||2||
english: But by Guru's Grace, I have seen her to be deceptive. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਰਕ ਉਸ ਕੇ ਵਡੇ ਠਗਾਊ ॥
transliteration: agarak us ke vade thagaaoo ||
english: Her courtiers are also great deceivers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਾਪ ਨ ਮਾਊ ॥
transliteration: chhodahi naahee baap na maaoo ||
english: They do not spare even their fathers or mothers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਲੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਉਨਿ ਲੇ ਬਾਂਧੇ ॥
transliteration: melee apane un le baa(n)dhe ||
english: They have enslaved their companions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te mai sagale saadhe ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have subjugated them all. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: ab morai man bhaiaa ana(n)d ||
english: Now, my mind is filled with bliss;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਚੂਕਾ ਟੂਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਫੰਦ ॥
transliteration: bhau chookaa toote sabh pha(n)d ||
english: my fear is gone, and the noose is cut away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jaa satigur paaiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, when I met the True Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਮੈ ਸੁਖੀ ਬਸਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩੬॥੮੭॥
transliteration: ghar sagalaa mai sukhee basaaiaa ||4||36||87||
english: I came to dwell within my home in absolute peace. ||4||36||87||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar nikat kar jaanai ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, he knows the Lord to be near at hand;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kaa keeaa meethaa maanai ||
english: he surrenders to the Sweet Will of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ek naam sa(n)tan aadhaar ||
english: The One Name is the Support of the Saints;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hoi rahe sabh kee pag chhaar ||1||
english: they remain the dust of the feet of all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਰਹਤ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t rahat sunahu mere bhaaee ||
english: Listen, to the way of life of the Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: uaa kee mahimaa kathan na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: their praises cannot be described. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਤਣਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: varatan jaa kai keval naam ||
english: Their occupation is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: anad roop keeratan bisraam ||
english: The Kirtan, the Praise of the Lord, the embodiment of bliss, is their rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: mitr satr jaa kai ek samaanai ||
english: Friends and enemies are one and the same to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prabh apune bin avar na jaanai ||2||
english: They know of no other than God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kot kot agh kaatanahaaraa ||
english: They erase millions upon millions of sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਨ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dukh door karan jee ke daataaraa ||
english: They dispel suffering; they are givers of the life of the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਬਚਨ ਕੇ ਬਲੀ ॥
transliteration: soorabeer bachan ke balee ||
english: They are so brave; they are men of their word.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਲਾ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਸੰਤੀ ਛਲੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaulaa bapuree sa(n)tee chhalee ||3||
english: The Saints have enticed Maya herself. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਸੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: taa kaa sa(n)g baachhahi suradev ||
english: Their company is cherished even by the gods and the angels.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸੁ ਸਫਲ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: amogh daras saphal jaa kee sev ||
english: Blessed is their Darshan, and fruitful is their service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: kar joR naanak kare aradaas ||
english: With his palms pressed together, Nanak offers his prayer:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਸੰਤਹ ਟਹਲ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੮੮॥
transliteration: mohi sa(n)tah tahal deejai gunataas ||4||37||88||
english: O Lord, Treasure of Excellence, please bless me with the service of the Saints. ||4||37||88||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਜਪਿ ਏਕੈ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sagal sookh jap ekai naam ||
english: All peace and comforts are in the meditation of the One Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sagal dharam har ke gun gaam ||
english: All righteous actions of Dharma are in the singing of the Lord's Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: mahaa pavitr saadh kaa sa(n)g ||
english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is so very pure and sacred.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis bhetat laagai prabh ra(n)g ||1||
english: Meeting with them, love for God is embraced. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਓਇ ਆਨੰਦ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad oi aana(n)d paavai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, bliss is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat man hoi pragaasaa taa kee gat mit kahan na jaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating upon Him in remembrance, the mind is illumined; his state and condition cannot be described. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਮਜਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: varat nem majan tis poojaa ||
english: Fasts, religious vows, cleansing baths, and worship to Him;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੁਨੀਜਾ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan tin si(n)mrit suneejaa ||
english: listening to the Vedas, Puraanas, and Shaastras.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: mahaa puneet jaa kaa niramal thaan ||
english: Extremely pure is he, and immaculate is his place,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat jaa kai har har naam ||2||
english: who meditates upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਗਲੇ ਭਵਨ ॥
transliteration: pragatio so jan sagale bhavan ||
english: That humble being becomes renowned all over the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਰੇਨ ॥
transliteration: patit puneet taa kee pag ren ||
english: Even sinners are purified, by the dust of his feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau bhetio har har raai ||
english: One who has met the Lord, the Lord our King,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa kee gat mit kathan na jaai ||3||
english: his condition and state cannot be described. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar kar joR dhiaavau ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, with palms pressed together, I meditate;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਸਾਧਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: un saadhaa kaa darasan paavau ||
english: I yearn to obtain the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those Holy Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਗਰੀਬ ਕਉ ਲੇਹੁ ਰਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mohi gareeb kau lehu ralaai ||
english: Merge me, the poor one, with You, O Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਇ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੪॥੩੮॥੮੯॥
transliteration: naanak aai pae saranaai ||4||38||89||
english: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||38||89||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਉਦਕ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar udak isanaanee ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, he takes his cleansing bath in water;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭੋਗੁ ਲਗਾਇ ਸੁਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sad hee bhog lagaai sugiaanee ||
english: he makes continual offerings to the Lord; he is a true man of wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਾਹੂ ਛੋਡੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: birathaa kaahoo chhodai naahee ||
english: He never leaves anything uselessly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਹ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bahur bahur tis laagah paaee ||1||
english: Again and again, he falls at the Lord's Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਗਿਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: saalagiraam hamaarai sevaa ||
english: Such is the Saalagraam, the stone idol, which I serve;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poojaa arachaa ba(n)dan devaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: such is my worship, flower-offerings and divine adoration as well. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੰਟਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ॥
transliteration: gha(n)taa jaa kaa suneeai chahu ku(n)t ||
english: His bell resounds to the four corners of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਨੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ॥
transliteration: aasan jaa kaa sadaa baiku(n)th ||
english: His seat is forever in heaven.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਚਵਰੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਝੂਲੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa chavar sabh oopar jhoolai ||
english: His chauri, his fly-brush, waves over all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਧੂਪੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਫੁਲੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa kaa dhoop sadaa paraphulai ||2||
english: His incense is ever-fragrant. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੰਪਟੁ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat sa(n)pat hai re jaa kaa ||
english: He is treasured in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਭਗ ਸਭਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: abhag sabhaa sa(n)g hai saadhaa ||
english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is His Eternal Court.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਰਤੀ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: aaratee keeratan sadaa ana(n)d ||
english: His Aartee, his lamp-lit worship service, is the Kirtan of His Praises, which brings lasting bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਦਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mahimaa su(n)dar sadaa bea(n)t ||3||
english: His Greatness is so beautiful, and ever limitless. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਲਹਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jisahi paraapat tis hee lahanaa ||
english: He alone obtains it, who is so pre-ordained;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਓਹੁ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t charan ohu aaio saranaa ||
english: he takes to the Sanctuary of the Saints' Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥਿ ਚੜਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਗਿਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: haath chaRio har saalagiraam ||
english: I hold in my hands the Saalagraam of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: kahu naanak gur keeno daan ||4||39||90||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has given me this Gift. ||4||39||90||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ₁ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 pa(n)chapadaa₁ ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Panch-Pada:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪੈਡੈ ਲੂਟੀ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jih paidai lootee panihaaree ||
english: That highway, upon which the water-carrier is plundered

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਦੂਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so maarag sa(n)tan dooraaree ||1||
english: - that way is far removed from the Saints. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur poorai saach kahiaa ||
english: The True Guru has spoken the Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਬੀਥੀ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam tere kee mukate beethee jam kaa maarag door rahiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your Name, O Lord, is the Way to Salvation; the road of the Messenger of Death is far away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਲਾਲਚ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਘਾਟ ॥
transliteration: jah laalach jaagaatee ghaat ||
english: That place, where the greedy toll-collector dwells

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਉਹ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਬਾਟ ॥੨॥
transliteration: door rahee uh jan te baat ||2||
english: - that path remains far removed from the Lord's humble servant. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਆਵਟੇ ਬਹੁਤ ਘਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
transliteration: jah aavate bahut ghan saath ||
english: There, where so very many caravans of men are caught,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਾਧ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paarabraham ke sa(n)gee saadh ||3||
english: the Holy Saints remain with the Supreme Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਸਭ ਲਿਖਤੇ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: chitr gupat sabh likhate lekhaa ||
english: Chitra and Gupat, the recording angels of the conscious and the unconscious, write the accounts of all mortal beings,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਪੇਖਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kau drisat na pekhaa ||4||
english: but they cannot even see the Lord's humble devotees. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jis satigur pooraa ||
english: Says Nanak, one whose True Guru is Perfect

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੇ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰਾ ॥੫॥੪੦॥੯੧॥
transliteration: vaaje taa kai anahad tooraa ||5||40||91||
english: - the unblown bugles of ecstasy vibrate for him. ||5||40||91||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 dupadaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Du-Pada 1:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਖਾਇਓ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g sikhaaio naam ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Naam is learned;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sarab manorath pooran kaam ||
english: all desires and tasks are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸਹਿ ਅਘਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: bujh gaee trisanaa har jasahi aghaane ||
english: My thirst has been quenched, and I am satiated with the Lord's Praise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jap jap jeevaa saarigapaane ||1||
english: I live by chanting and meditating upon the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan saran pariaa ||
english: I have entered the Sanctuary of the Creator, the Cause of all causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਚੰਦੁ ਚੜਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad sahaj ghar paaiaa mitiaa a(n)dheraa cha(n)d chaRiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have entered the home of celestial bliss. Darkness is dispelled, and the moon of wisdom has risen. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: laal javehar bhare bha(n)daar ||
english: My treasure-house is overflowing with rubies and jewels;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tot na aavai jap nira(n)kaar ||
english: I meditate on the Formless Lord, and so they never run short.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit sabad peevai jan koi ||
english: How rare is that humble being, who drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੪੧॥੯੨॥
transliteration: naanak taa kee param gat hoi ||2||41||92||
english: O Nanak, he attains the state of highest dignity. ||2||41||92||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੭ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ghar 7 mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Seventh House, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam ridai nit dhiaaee ||
english: Meditate continually on the Name of the Lord within your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗੀ ਸਾਥੀ ਸਗਲ ਤਰਾਂਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)gee saathee sagal taraa(n)ee ||1||
english: Thus you shall save all your companions and associates. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gur merai sa(n)g sadaa hai naale ||
english: My Guru is always with me, near at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: simar simar tis sadaa samhaale ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I cherish Him forever. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: teraa keeaa meethaa laagai ||
english: Your actions seem so sweet to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ॥੨॥੪੨॥੯੩॥
transliteration: har naam padaarath naanak maa(n)gai ||2||42||93||
english: Nanak begs for the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||42||93||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat tariaa sa(n)saar ||
english: The world is saved by the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kaa naam manahi aadhaar ||1||
english: The Name of the Lord is the Support of the mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal guradev piaare ||
english: The Saints worship and adore the Lotus Feet of the Divine Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poojahi sa(n)t har preet piaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: they love the Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai masatak likhiaa bhaag ||
english: She who has such good destiny written upon her forehead,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ॥੨॥੪੩॥੯੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak taa kaa thir sohaag ||2||43||94||
english: says Nanak, is blessed with the eternal happy marriage with the Lord. ||2||43||94||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਠੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: meethee aagiaa pir kee laagee ||
english: The Order of my Husband Lord seems so sweet to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਉਕਨਿ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
transliteration: saukan ghar kee ka(n)t tiaagee ||
english: My Husband Lord has driven out the one who was my rival.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pri sohaagan seegaar karee ||
english: My Beloved Husband has decorated me, His happy soul-bride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man mere kee tapat haree ||1||
english: He has quieted the burning thirst of my mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਲੋ ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bhalo bhaio pri kahiaa maaniaa ||
english: It is good that I submitted to the Will of my Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਇਸੁ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj is ghar kaa jaaniaa || rahaau ||
english: I have realized celestial peace and poise within this home of mine. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬੰਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਖਿਜਮਤਦਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hau ba(n)dee pri khijamatadaar ||
english: I am the hand-maiden, the attendant of my Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ohu abinaasee agam apaar ||
english: He is eternal and imperishable, inaccessible and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੇ ਪਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਝਲਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: le pakhaa pri jhalau paae ||
english: Holding the fan, sitting at His Feet, I wave it over my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਗਿ ਗਏ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਲਾਵੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhaag gae pa(n)ch doot laave ||2||
english: The five demons who tortured me have run away. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਾ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: naa mai kul naa sobhaava(n)t ||
english: I am not from a noble family, and I am not beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ ਕਿਉ ਭਾਨੀ ਕੰਤ ॥
transliteration: kiaa jaanaa kiu bhaanee ka(n)t ||
english: What do I know? Why am I pleasing to my Beloved?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: mohi anaath gareeb nimaanee ||
english: I am a poor orphan, destitute and dishonored.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਤ ਪਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਕੀਨੀ ਰਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ka(n)t pakar ham keenee raanee ||3||
english: My Husband took me in, and made me His queen. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jab mukh preetam saajan laagaa ||
english: When I saw my Beloved's face before me,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਮੇਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj meraa dhan sohaagaa ||
english: I became so happy and peaceful; my married life was blessed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਰੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak moree pooran aasaa ||
english: Says Nanak, my desires are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੯੫॥
transliteration: satigur melee prabh gunataasaa ||4||1||95||
english: The True Guru has united me with God, the treasure of excellence. ||4||1||95||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਥੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: maathai trikutee drisat karoor ||
english: A frown creases her forehead, and her look is evil.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲੈ ਕਉੜਾ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਕੀ ਫੂੜਿ ॥
transliteration: bolai kauRaa jihabaa kee phooR ||
english: Her speech is bitter, and her tongue is rude.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਭੂਖੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa bhookhee pir jaanai door ||1||
english: She is always hungry, and she believes her Husband to be far away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਇਕ ਰਾਮਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aisee isatree ik raam upaaee ||
english: Such is Maya, the woman, which the One Lord has created.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: un sabh jag khaaiaa ham gur raakhe mere bhaaee || rahaau ||
english: She is devouring the whole world, but the Guru has saved me, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜੋਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paai thagaulee sabh jag johiaa ||
english: Administering her poisons, she has overcome the whole world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਮੋਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahaadeu mohiaa ||
english: She has bewitched Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਸੋਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh naam lage se sohiaa ||2||
english: Only those Gurmukhs who are attuned to the Naam are blessed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: varat nem kar thaake punahacharanaa ||
english: Performing fasts, religious observances and atonements, the mortals have grown weary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਵੇ ਸਭ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tat teerath bhave sabh dharanaa ||
english: They wander over the entire planet, on pilgrimages to the banks of sacred rivers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: se ubare j satigur kee saranaa ||3||
english: But they alone are saved, who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਭੋ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi sabho jag baadhaa ||
english: Attached to Maya, the whole world is in bondage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਰਾਖਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai pachai manamukh mooraakhaa ||
english: The foolish self-willed manmukhs are consumed by their egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੯੬॥
transliteration: gur naanak baah pakar ham raakhaa ||4||2||96||
english: Taking me by the arm, Guru Nanak has saved me. ||4||2||96||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਦੂਖ ਜਬ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: sarab dookh jab bisarahi suaamee ||
english: Everything is painful, when one forgets the Lord Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: eehaa oohaa kaam na praanee ||1||
english: Here and hereafter, such a mortal is useless. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧੵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t tripataase har har dhyaai ||
english: The Saints are satisfied, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਏ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apunai naai laae sarab sookh prabh tumaree rajaai || rahaau ||
english: Bestowing Your Mercy, God, You attach us to Your Name; all peace comes by Your Will. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਤ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g hovat kau jaanat door ||
english: The Lord is Ever-present; one who deems Him to be far away,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮਰਤਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so jan marataa nit nit jhoor ||2||
english: Dies again and again, repenting. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jin sabh kichh deeaa tis chitavat naahi ||
english: The mortals do not remember the One, who has given them everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mahaa bikhiaa mahi din rain jaahi ||3||
english: Engrossed in such terrible corruption, their days and nights waste away. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh simarahu ek ||
english: Says Nanak, meditate in remembrance of the One Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਟੇਕ ॥੪॥੩॥੯੭॥
transliteration: gat paaeeai gur poore tek ||4||3||97||
english: Salvation is obtained, in the Shelter of the Perfect Guru. ||4||3||97||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naam japat man tan sabh hariaa ||
english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are totally rejuvenated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਮਲ ਦੋਖ ਸਗਲ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kalamal dokh sagal parahariaa ||1||
english: All sins and sorrows are washed away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਦਿਵਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: soee divas bhalaa mere bhaaee ||
english: How blessed is that day, O my Siblings of Destiny,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaai param gat paaee || rahaau ||
english: when the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung, and the supreme status is obtained. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਜੇ ਪੈਰ ॥
transliteration: saadh janaa ke pooje pair ||
english: Worshipping the feet of the Holy Saints,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੇ ਉਪਦ੍ਰਹ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬੈਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mite upadrah man te bair ||2||
english: troubles and hatred are eliminated from the mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਝਗਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poore mil jhagar chukaaiaa ||
english: Meeting with the Perfect Guru, conflict is ended,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸਭਿ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch doot sabh vasagat aaiaa ||3||
english: and the five demons are totally subdued. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jis man vasiaa har kaa naam ||
english: One whose mind is filled with the Name of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੪॥੪॥੯੮॥
transliteration: naanak tis oopar kurabaan ||4||4||98||
english: O Nanak - I am a sacrifice to him. ||4||4||98||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਤੂ ਗਾਵਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaav lehi too gaavanahaare ||
english: O singer, sing of the One,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪਿੰਡ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jee pi(n)d ke praan adhaare ||
english: who is the Support of the soul, the body and the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee sevaa sarab sukh paavahi ||
english: Serving Him, all peace is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਹਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: avar kaahoo pahi bahuR na jaavahi ||1||
english: You shall no longer go to any other. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨੰਦੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d ana(n)dee saahib gun nidhaan nit nit jaapeeai ||
english: My Blissful Lord Master is forever in bliss; meditate continually and forever, on the Lord, the treasure of excellence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸੀਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: balihaaree tis sa(n)t piaare jis prasaad prabh man vaaseeai || rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Beloved Saints; by their kind favor, God comes to dwell in the mind. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਿਖੂਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa daan nikhootai naahee ||
english: His gifts are never exhausted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਲੀ ਭਾਤਿ ਸਭ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: bhalee bhaat sabh sahaj samaahee ||
english: In His subtle way, He easily absorbs all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee bakhas na metai koee ||
english: His benevolence cannot be erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸਾਈਐ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man vaasaaeeai saachaa soee ||2||
english: So enshrine that True Lord within your mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ॥
transliteration: sagal samagree grih jaa kai pooran ||
english: His house is filled with all sorts of articles;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਝੂਰਨ ॥
transliteration: prabh ke sevak dookh na jhooran ||
english: God's servants never suffer pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਟਿ ਗਹੀ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: ot gahee nirabhau pad paaeeai ||
english: Holding to His Support, the state of fearless dignity is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸੋ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saas saas so gun nidh gaaeeai ||3||
english: With each and every breath, sing of the Lord, the treasure of excellence. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: door na hoee katahoo jaaeeai ||
english: He is not far from us, wherever we go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa har har paaeeai ||
english: When He shows His Mercy, we obtain the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: aradaas karee poore gur paas ||
english: I offer this prayer to the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੫॥੯੯॥
transliteration: naanak ma(n)gai har dhan raas ||4||5||99||
english: Nanak begs for the treasure of the Lord's Name. ||4||5||99||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਤਨ ਕਾ ਦੂਖ ॥
transliteration: prathame mitiaa tan kaa dookh ||
english: First, the pains of the body vanish;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਗਲ ਕਉ ਹੋਆ ਸੂਖੁ ॥
transliteration: man sagal kau hoaa sookh ||
english: then, the mind becomes totally peaceful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਨੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa gur deeno naau ||
english: In His Mercy, the Guru bestows the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bal bal tis satigur kau jaau ||1||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to that True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa paaio mere bhaaee ||
english: I have obtained the Perfect Guru, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rog sog sabh dookh binaase satigur kee saranaaee || rahaau ||
english: All illness, sorrows and sufferings are dispelled, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan hiradai vasaae ||
english: The feet of the Guru abide within my heart;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਤਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: man chi(n)tat sagale phal paae ||
english: I have received all the fruits of my heart's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: agan bujhee sabh hoee saa(n)t ||
english: The fire is extinguished, and I am totally peaceful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa gur keenee daat ||2||
english: Showering His Mercy, the Guru has given this gift. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: nithaave kau gur deeno thaan ||
english: The Guru has given shelter to the shelterless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: nimaane kau gur keeno maan ||
english: The Guru has given honor to the dishonored.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan kaat sevak kar raakhe ||
english: Shattering his bonds, the Guru has saved His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਚਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee rasanaa chaakhe ||3||
english: I taste with my tongue the Ambrosial Bani of His Word. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪੂਜ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag pooj gur charanaa ||
english: By great good fortune, I worship the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal tiaag paaee prabh saranaa ||
english: Forsaking everything, I have obtained God's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਆ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: gur naanak jaa kau bhaiaa daiaalaa ||
english: That humble being, O Nanak, unto whom the Guru grants His Mercy,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: so jan hoaa sadaa nihaalaa ||4||6||100||
english: Is forever enraptured. ||4||6||100||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਦੀਆ ਭੇਜਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur saachai deeaa bhej ||
english: The True Guru has truly given a child.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ॥
transliteration: chir jeevan upajiaa sa(n)jog ||
english: The long-lived one has been born to this destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਰੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਆਇ ਕੀਆ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: udarai maahi aai keeaa nivaas ||
english: He came to acquire a home in the womb,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maataa kai man bahut bigaas ||1||
english: and his mother's heart is so very glad. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਿਆ ਪੂਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)miaa poot bhagat govi(n)d kaa ||
english: A son is born - a devotee of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰ ਕਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pragatiaa sabh mahi likhiaa dhur kaa || rahaau ||
english: This pre-ordained destiny has been revealed to all. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸੀ ਮਾਸੀ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: dasee maasee hukam baalak janam leeaa ||
english: In the tenth month, by the Lord's Order, the baby has been born.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mitiaa sog mahaa ana(n)d theeaa ||
english: Sorrow is dispelled, and great joy has ensued.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸਖੀ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gurabaanee sakhee ana(n)d gaavai ||
english: The companions blissfully sing the songs of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saache saahib kai man bhaavai ||2||
english: This is pleasing to the Lord Master. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਧੀ ਵੇਲਿ ਬਹੁ ਪੀੜੀ ਚਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: vadhee vel bahu peeRee chaalee ||
english: The vine has grown, and shall last for many generations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਕਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਬਹਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: dharam kalaa har ba(n)dh bahaalee ||
english: The Power of the Dharma has been firmly established by the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man chi(n)diaa satiguroo divaaiaa ||
english: That which my mind wishes for, the True Guru has granted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhae achi(n)t ek liv laaiaa ||3||
english: I have become carefree, and I fix my attention on the One Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu baalak pitaa oopar kare bahu maan ||
english: As the child places so much faith in his father,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: bulaaiaa bolai gur kai bhaan ||
english: I speak as it pleases the Guru to have me speak.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਝੀ ਛੰਨੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਾਤ ॥
transliteration: gujhee chha(n)nee naahee baat ||
english: This is not a hidden secret;

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: gur naanak tuthaa keenee daat ||4||7||101||
english: Guru Nanak, greatly pleased, has bestowed this gift. ||4||7||101||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਦੇ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: gur poore raakhiaa de haath ||
english: Giving His Hand, the Perfect Guru has protected the child.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pragat bhaiaa jan kaa parataap ||1||
english: The glory of His servant has become manifest. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਪੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: gur gur japee guroo gur dhiaaee ||
english: I contemplate the Guru, the Guru; I meditate on the Guru, the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jee kee aradaas guroo pahi paaee || rahaau ||
english: I offer my heart-felt prayer to the Guru, and it is answered. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: saran pare saache guradev ||
english: I have taken to the Sanctuary of the True Divine Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pooran hoee sevak sev ||2||
english: The service of His servant has been fulfilled. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d joban raakhai praan ||
english: He has preserved my soul, body, youth and breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੩॥੮॥੧੦੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur kau kurabaan ||3||8||102||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||3||8||102||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ghar 8 kaaphee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਬੰਦਾ ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mai ba(n)daa bai khareed sach saahib meraa ||
english: I am Your purchased slave, O True Lord Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis daa sabh kichh hai teraa ||1||
english: My soul and body, and all of this, everything is Yours. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: maan nimaane too(n) dhanee teraa bharavaasaa ||
english: You are the honor of the dishonored. O Master, in You I place my trust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਨ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin saache an tek hai so jaanahu kaachaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the True One, any other support is false - know this well. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: teraa hukam apaar hai koee a(n)t na paae ||
english: Your Command is infinite; no one can find its limit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਸੀ ਸੋ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis gur pooraa bhetasee so chalai rajaae ||2||
english: One who meets with the Perfect Guru, walks in the Way of the Lord's Will. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: chaturaaee siaanapaa kitai kaam na aaeeai ||
english: Cunning and cleverness are of no use.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਠਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tuthaa saahib jo devai soee sukh paaeeai ||3||
english: That which the Lord Master gives, by the Pleasure of His Will - that is pleasing to me. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈਅਹਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਵੈ ਨ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: je lakh karam kamaaeeahi kichh pavai na ba(n)dhaa ||
english: One may perform tens of thousands of actions, but attachment to things is not satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰ ਹੋਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak keetaa naam dhar hor chhodiaa dha(n)dhaa ||4||1||103||
english: Servant Nanak has made the Naam his Support. He has renounced other entanglements. ||4||1||103||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮੈ ਭਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa mai bhaaliaa har jevad na koee ||
english: I have pursued all pleasures, but none is as great as the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur tuthe te paaeeai sach saahib soee ||1||
english: By the Pleasure of the Guru's Will, the True Lord Master is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane sad sad kurabaanaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever and ever a sacrifice to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਚਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam na visarau ik khin chasaa ihu keejai daanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please, grant me this one blessing, that I may never, even for an instant, forget Your Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਗਠੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhaagath sachaa soi hai jis har dhan a(n)tar ||
english: How very fortunate are those who have the wealth of the Lord deep within the heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਛੂਟੈ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲ ਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so chhootai mahaa jaal te jis gurasabad nira(n)tar ||2||
english: They escape from the great noose of death; they are permeated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸਤ ਸਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kee mahimaa kiaa kahaa gur bibek sat sar ||
english: How can I chant the Glorious Praises of the Guru? The Guru is the ocean of Truth and clear understanding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ohu aad jugaadee jugah jug pooraa paramesar ||3||
english: He is the Perfect Transcendent Lord, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
transliteration: naam dhiaavahu sad sadaa har har man ra(n)ge ||
english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, forever and ever, my mind is filled with the Love of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੦੪॥
transliteration: jeeu praan dhan guroo hai naanak kai sa(n)ge ||4||2||104||
english: The Guru is my soul, my breath of life, and wealth; O Nanak, He is with me forever. ||4||2||104||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਭੋਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
transliteration: saaee alakh apaar bhoree man vasai ||
english: If the Invisible and Infinite Lord dwells within my mind, even for a moment,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਾਇ ਮੈਡਾ ਹਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dookh darad rog maai maidaa habh nasai ||1||
english: then all my pains, troubles, and diseases vanish. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵੰਞਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਸਾਈ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
transliteration: hau va(n)njaa kurabaan saaee aapane ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Lord Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਪਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hovai anad ghanaa man tan jaapane ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating on Him, a great joy wells up within my mind and body. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿੰਦਕ ਗਾਲੑਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ॥
transliteration: bi(n)dak gaalhi sunee sache tis dhanee ||
english: I have heard only a little bit of news about the True Lord Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ਮਾਇ ਨ ਕੀਮ ਗਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sookhee hoo(n) sukh paai maai na keem ganee ||2||
english: I have obtained the peace of all peace, O my mother; I cannot estimate its worth. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਣ ਪਸੰਦੋ ਸੋਇ ਪੇਖਿ ਮੁਸਤਾਕ ਭਈ ॥
transliteration: nain pasa(n)do soi pekh musataak bhaee ||
english: He is so beautiful to my eyes; beholding Him, I have been bewitched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ਆਪਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਲਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mai niragun meree maai aap laR laai laee ||3||
english: I am worthless, O my mother; He Himself has attached me to the hem of His robe. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹਭਾ ਹੂੰ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bed kateb sa(n)saar habhaa hoo(n) baaharaa ||
english: He is beyond the world of the Vedas, the Koran and the Bible.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੦੫॥
transliteration: naanak kaa paatisaahu disai jaaharaa ||4||3||105||
english: The Supreme King of Nanak is immanent and manifest. ||4||3||105||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਭਗਤ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ਜਪਤੇ ਪੀਉ ਪੀਉ ॥
transliteration: laakh bhagat aaraadhahi japate peeu peeu ||
english: Tens of thousands of devotees worship and adore You, chanting, "Beloved, Beloved."

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਉ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kavan jugat melaavau niragun bikhaee jeeu ||1||
english: How shall You unite me, the worthless and corrupt soul, with Yourself. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ॥
transliteration: teree tek govi(n)d gupaal daiaal prabh ||
english: You are my Support, O Merciful God, Lord of the Universe, Sustainer of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sabhanaa ke naath teree srisat sabh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are the Master of all; the entire creation is Yours. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਤ ਪੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sahaaee sa(n)t pekhahi sadaa hajoor ||
english: You are the constant help and support of the Saints, who behold You Ever-present.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੜਿਆ ਸੇ ਮਰਨੑਿ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam bihoonaRiaa se maranhi visoor visoor ||2||
english: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall die, engulfed in sorrow and pain. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਤਣ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗਉਣੁ ॥
transliteration: daas daasatan bhaai mitiaa tinaa gaun ||
english: Those servants, who lovingly perform the Lord's service, are freed from the cycle of reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਾੜਾ ਹਾਲੁ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: visariaa jinhaa naam tinaaRaa haal kaun ||3||
english: What shall be the fate of those who forget the Naam? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਹਰੑਿਆਉ ਤੈਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਭ ॥
transliteration: jaise pas harhiaau taisaa sa(n)saar sabh ||
english: As are the cattle which have strayed, so is the entire world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦੬॥
transliteration: naanak ba(n)dhan kaat milaavahu aap prabh ||4||4||106||
english: O God, please cut away Nanak's bonds, and unite him with Yourself. ||4||4||106||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਹਿਕੋ ਖਿਆਲੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
transliteration: habhe thok visaar hiko khiaal kar ||
english: Forget all other things, and dwell upon the Lord alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਲਾਹਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jhoothaa laahi gumaan man tan arap dhar ||1||
english: Lay aside your false pride, and dedicate your mind and body to Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰ ਤੂੰ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar saalaahi sirajanahaar too(n) ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, praise the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jeevaa(n) teree daat kirapaa karahu moo(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I live by Your bountiful gifts - please, shower me with Your Mercy! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ॥
transliteration: soee ka(n)m kamaai jit mukh ujalaa ||
english: So, do that work, by which your face shall be made radiant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਲਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: soee lagai sach jis too(n) dehi alaa ||2||
english: He alone becomes attached to the Truth, O Lord, unto whom You give it. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨ ਢਹੰਦੋ ਮੂਲਿ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jo na dhaha(n)do mool so ghar raas kar ||
english: So build and adorn that house, which shall never be destroyed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hiko chit vasaai kade na jaai mar ||3||
english: Enshrine the One Lord within your consciousness; He shall never die. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tinhaa piaaraa raam jo prabh bhaaniaa ||
english: The Lord is dear to those, who are pleasing to the Will of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੦੭॥
transliteration: gur parasaad akath naanak vakhaaniaa ||4||5||107||
english: By Guru's Grace, Nanak describes the indescribable. ||4||5||107||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇ ਕਿਨੇਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jinhaa na visarai naam se kinehiaa ||
english: What are they like - those who do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਜੇਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhed na jaanahu mool saa(n)ee jehiaa ||1||
english: Know that there is absolutely no difference; they are exactly like the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਸੰਗਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: man tan hoi nihaal tumh sa(n)g bhetiaa ||
english: The mind and body are enraptured, meeting with You, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਮੇਟਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukh paaiaa jan parasaad dukh sabh metiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Peace is obtained, by the favor of the Lord's humble servant; all pains are taken away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਤਿੰਨੑ ਖੇ ॥
transliteration: jete kha(n)d brahama(n)d udhaare ti(n)nh khe ||
english: As many as are the continents of the world, so many have been saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jinh man vuthaa aap poore bhagat se ||2||
english: Those, in whose minds You Yourself dwell, O Lord, are the perfect devotees. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨੇ ਆਪਿ ਸੋਈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jis no ma(n)ne aap soee maaneeai ||
english: Those whom You approve, are approved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pragat purakh paravaan sabh thaaee jaaneeai ||3||
english: Such a celebrated and honored person is known everywhere. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ॥
transliteration: dinas rain aaraadh samhaale saah saah ||
english: Day and night, with every breath to worship and adore the Lord

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੦੮॥
transliteration: naanak kee lochaa poor sache paatisaah ||4||6||108||
english: - please, O True Supreme King, fulfill this, Nanak's desire. ||4||6||108||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਇ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: poor rahiaa srab thaai hamaaraa khasam soi ||
english: He, my Lord Master, is fully pervading all places.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek saahib sir chhat doojaa naahi koi ||1||
english: He is the One Lord Master, the roof over our heads; there is no other than Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakh raakhanahaariaa ||
english: As it pleases Your Will, please save me, O Savior Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin avar na koi nadar nihaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without You, my eyes see no other at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: pratipaale prabh aap ghat ghat saareeai ||
english: God Himself is the Cherisher; He takes care of each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis man vuthaa aap tis na visaareeai ||2||
english: That person, within whose mind You Yourself dwell, never forgets You. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh kare s aap aapan bhaaniaa ||
english: He does that which is pleasing to Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhagataa kaa sahaaee jug jug jaaniaa ||3||
english: He is known as the help and support of His devotees, throughout the ages. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jap jap har kaa naam kade na jhooreeai ||
english: Chanting and meditating up the Lord's Name, the mortal never comes to regret anything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੦੯॥
transliteration: naanak daras piaas lochaa pooreeai ||4||7||109||
english: O Nanak, I thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please, fulfill my desire, O Lord. ||4||7||109||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਸੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਗਾਫਲ ਗਹਿਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kiaa sovahi naam visaar gaaphal gahiliaa ||
english: Why are you sleeping, and forgetting the Name, O careless and foolish mortal?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤਂੀ ਇਤੁ ਦਰੀਆਇ ਵੰਞਨੑਿ ਵਹਦਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kita(n)ee it dareeaai va(n)njanhi vahadiaa ||1||
english: So many have been washed away and carried off by this river of life. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਹਿਥੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਮਨ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘੀਐ ॥
transliteration: bohithaRaa har charan man chaR la(n)gheeai ||
english: O mortal, get aboard the boat of the Lord's Lotus Feet, and cross over.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar gun gaai saadhoo sa(n)geeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੋਗਹਿ ਭੋਗ ਅਨੇਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁੰਞਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bhogahi bhog anek vin naavai su(n)njiaa ||
english: You may enjoy various pleasures, but they are useless without the Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਰੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har kee bhagat binaa mar mar ru(n)niaa ||2||
english: Without devotion to the Lord, you shall die in sorrow, again and again. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਤਨਿ ਮਰਦਨ ਮਾਲਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kapaR bhog suga(n)dh tan maradan maalanaa ||
english: You may dress and eat and apply scented oils to your body,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਚਾਲਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin simaran tan chhaar sarapar chaalanaa ||3||
english: but without the meditative remembrance of the Lord, your body shall surely turn to dust, and you shall have to depart. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਪੇਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa bikham sa(n)saar viralai pekhiaa ||
english: How very treacherous is this world-ocean; how very few realize this!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੂਟਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੧੦॥
transliteration: chhootan har kee saran lekh naanak lekhiaa ||4||8||110||
english: Salvation rests in the Lord's Sanctuary; O Nanak, this is your pre-ordained destiny. ||4||8||110||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬੀਐ ॥
transliteration: koi na kis hee sa(n)g kaahe garabeeai ||
english: No one is anyone's companion; why take any pride in others?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਬੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek naam aadhaar bhaujal tarabeeai ||1||
english: With the Support of the One Name, this terrible world-ocean is crossed over. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗਰੀਬ ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mai gareeb sach tek too(n) mere satigur poore ||
english: You are the True Support of me, the poor mortal, O my Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dekh tumhaaraa darasano meraa man dheere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, my mind is encouraged. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਗਨੋੁ ॥
transliteration: raaj maal ja(n)jaal kaaj na kitai ganou ||
english: Royal powers, wealth, and worldly involvements are of no use at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਨੋੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har keeratan aadhaar nihachal ehu dhanou ||2||
english: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is my Support; this wealth is everlasting. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਤੇਤ ਪਛਾਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jete maaiaa ra(n)g tet pachhaaviaa ||
english: As many as are the pleasures of Maya, so many are the shadows they leave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sukh kaa naam nidhaan guramukh gaaviaa ||3||
english: The Gurmukhs sing of the Naam, the treasure of peace. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sachaa gunee nidhaan too(n) prabh gahir ga(n)bheere ||
english: You are the True Lord, the treasure of excellence; O God, You are deep and unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਜੀਅਰੇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੧੧॥
transliteration: aas bharosaa khasam kaa naanak ke jeeare ||4||9||111||
english: The Lord Master is the hope and support of Nanak's mind. ||4||9||111||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat dukh jaai sahaj sukh paaeeai ||
english: Remembering Him, suffering is removed, and celestial peace is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rain dinas kar joR har har dhiaaeeai ||1||
english: Night and day, with your palms pressed together, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak kaa prabh soi jis kaa sabh koi ||
english: He alone is Nanak's God, unto whom all beings belong.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab rahiaa bharapoor sachaa sach soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is totally pervading everywhere, the Truest of the True. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਗਿਆਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar sa(n)g sahaaee giaan jog ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, He is my companion and my helper; He is the One to be realized.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਮਨਾ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਸਗਲ ਰੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tisahi araadh manaa binaasai sagal rog ||2||
english: Adoring Him, my mind is cured of all its ailments. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: raakhanahaar apaar raakhai agan maahi ||
english: The Savior Lord is infinite; He saves us from the fire of the womb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: seetal har har naam simarat tapat jaai ||3||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is soothing and cool; remembering it in meditation, the inner fire is quenched. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ghanaa naanak jan dhooraa ||
english: Peace, poise, and immense bliss, O Nanak, are obtained, when one becomes the dust of the feet of the humble servants of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਏ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੧੨॥
transliteration: kaaraj sagale sidh bhae bhetiaa gur pooraa ||4||10||112||
english: All of one's affairs are perfectly resolved, meeting with the Perfect Guru. ||4||10||112||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
