gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d gunee nidhaan guramukh jaaneeai ||
english: The Lord of the Universe is the treasure of excellence; He is known only to the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hoi kripaal daiaal har ra(n)g maaneeai ||1||
english: When He shows His Mercy and Kindness, we revel in the Lord's Love. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਹ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aavahu sa(n)t milaah har kathaa kahaaneeaa ||
english: Come, O Saints - let us join together and speak the Sermon of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਕਾਣੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anadin simarah naam taj laaj lokaaneeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and ignore the criticism of others. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jap jap jeevaa naam hovai anad ghanaa ||
english: I live by chanting and meditating on the Naam, and so I obtain immense bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਵਿਣਸਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mithiaa mohu sa(n)saar jhoothaa vinasanaa ||2||
english: Attachment to the world is useless and vain; it is false, and perishes in the end. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal sa(n)g nehu kinai viralai laaiaa ||
english: How rare are those who embrace love for the Lord's Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dha(n)n suhaavaa mukh jin har dhiaaiaa ||3||
english: Blessed and beautiful is that mouth, which meditates on the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਲ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਵਈ ॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh kaal simarat mit jaavaee ||
english: The pains of birth, death and reincarnation are erased by meditating on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak kai sukh soi jo prabh bhaavaee ||4||11||113||
english: That alone is Nanak's joy, which is pleasing to God. ||4||11||113||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਭਿ ਭੁੰਚਹ ॥
transliteration: aavahu meet ikatr hoi ras kas sabh bhu(n)chah ||
english: Come, O friends: let us meet together and enjoy all the tastes and flavors.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਹ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਮੁੰਚਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam har har japah mil paapaa mu(n)chah ||1||
english: Let us join together and chant the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and so wipe away our sins. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: tat veechaarahu sa(n)t janahu taa te bighan na laagai ||
english: Reflect upon the essence of reality, O Saintly beings, and no troubles shall afflict you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੀਨ ਭਏ ਸਭਿ ਤਸਕਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kheen bhae sabh tasakaraa guramukh jan jaagai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All of the thieves shall be destroyed, as the Gurmukhs remain wakeful. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਧਿ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: budh gareebee kharach laihu haumai bikh jaarahu ||
english: Take wisdom and humility as your supplies, and burn away the poison of pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਹਟੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saachaa hat pooraa saudaa vakhar naam vaapaarahu ||2||
english: True is that shop, and perfect the transaction; deal only in the merchandise of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d dhan arapiaa seee pativa(n)te ||
english: They alone are accepted and approved, who dedicate their souls, bodies and wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੰਤੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aapanaRe prabh bhaaniaa nit kel kara(n)te ||3||
english: Those who are pleasing to their God, celebrate in happiness. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਦੁ ਜੋ ਪੀਵਤੇ ਬਿਖਲੀ ਪਤਿ ਕਮਲੀ ॥
transliteration: duramat mad jo peevate bikhalee pat kamalee ||
english: Those fools, who drink in the wine of evil-mindedness, become the husbands of prostitutes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਅਮਲੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੧੪॥
transliteration: raam rasaain jo rate naanak sach amalee ||4||12||114||
english: But those who are imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord, O Nanak, are intoxicated with the Truth. ||4||12||114||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਆਰੰਭੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: udam keeaa karaaiaa aara(n)bh rachaaiaa ||
english: I made the effort; I did it, and made a beginning.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam jape jap jeevanaa gur ma(n)tr driRaaiaa ||1||
english: I live by chanting and meditating on the Naam. The Guru has implanted this Mantra within me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਪਰਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paai parah satiguroo kai jin bharam bidaariaa ||
english: I fall at the Feet of the True Guru, who has dispelled my doubts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee sach saaj savaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Bestowing His Mercy, God has dressed me, and decorated me with the Truth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਚੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kar gahi leene aapane sach hukam rajaaee ||
english: Taking me by the hand, He made me His own, through the True Order of His Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo prabh ditee daat saa pooran vadiaaee ||2||
english: That gift which God gave to me, is perfect greatness. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa gun gaaeeahi jap naam muraaree ||
english: Forever and ever, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and chant the Name of the Destroyer of ego.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੇਮੁ ਨਿਬਾਹਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nem nibaahio satiguroo prabh kirapaa dhaaree ||3||
english: My vows have been honored, by the Grace of God and the True Guru, who has showered His Mercy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਲਾਭੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: naam dhan gun gaau laabh poorai gur ditaa ||
english: The Perfect Guru has given the wealth of the Naam, and the profit of singing the Lord's Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੧੫॥
transliteration: vanajaare sa(n)t naanakaa prabh saahu amitaa ||4||13||115||
english: The Saints are the traders, O Nanak, and the Infinite Lord God is their Banker. ||4||13||115||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa thaakur tuhee prabh taa ke vadabhaagaa ||
english: One who has You as His Master, O God, is blessed with great destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਸਦ ਸੁਖੀ ਸਭੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ohu suhelaa sad sukhee sabh bhram bhau bhaagaa ||1||
english: He is happy, and forever at peace; his doubts and fears are all dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਚਾਕਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ham chaakar gobi(n)d ke thaakur meraa bhaaraa ||
english: I am the slave of the Lord of the Universe; my Master is the greatest of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan sagal bidh so satiguroo hamaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes; He is my True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਉਰੁ ਕੋ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: doojaa naahee aur ko taa kaa bhau kareeai ||
english: There is no other whom I should fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur sevaa mahal paaeeai jag dutar tareeai ||2||
english: Serving the Guru, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is obtained, and the impassable world-ocean is crossed over. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: drisat teree sukh paaeeai man maahi nidhaanaa ||
english: By Your Glance of Grace, peace is obtained, and the treasure fills the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kau tum kirapaal bhae sevak se paravaanaa ||3||
english: That servant, unto whom You bestow Your Mercy, is approved and accepted. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੋ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪੀਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit ras har keeratano ko viralaa peevai ||
english: How rare is that person who drinks in the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord's Kirtan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਜਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੧੬॥
transliteration: vajahu naanak milai ek naam rid jap jap jeevai ||4||14||116||
english: Nanak has obtained the commodity of the One Name; he lives by chanting and meditating on it within his heart. ||4||14||116||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਚੇਰੁਲੀ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa prabh kee hau cherulee so sabh te oochaa ||
english: I am God's maid-servant; He is the highest of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ਥੋਰਾ ਅਰੁ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh kichh taa kaa kaa(n)dheeai thoraa ar moochaa ||1||
english: All things, big and small, are said to belong to Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਧਨੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਮਨੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jee praan meraa dhano saahib kee maneeaa ||
english: I surrender my soul, my breath of life, and my wealth, to my Lord Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਊਜਲੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਸੀ ਗਨੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam jisai kai oojalee tis daasee ganeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through His Name, I become radiant; I am known as His slave. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਨੰਦ ਮੈ ਨਾਉ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: veparavaahu ana(n)d mai naau maanak heeraa ||
english: You are Carefree, the Embodiment of Bliss. Your Name is a gem, a jewel.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਜੀ ਧਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: rajee dhaaee sadaa sukh jaa kaa too(n) meeraa ||2||
english: One who has You as her Master, is satisfied, satiated and happy forever. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਰੀ ਸੰਗ ਕੀ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: sakhee saheree sa(n)g kee sumat driRaavau ||
english: O my companions and fellow maidens, please implant that balanced understanding within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਤਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sevahu saadhoo bhaau kar tau nidh har paavau ||3||
english: Serve the Holy Saints lovingly, and find the treasure of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਠਾਕੁਰੈ ਸਭ ਕਹਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sagalee daasee thaakurai sabh kahatee meraa ||
english: All are servants of the Lord Master, and all call Him their own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਖਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੧੭॥
transliteration: jisahi seegaare naanakaa tis sukhahi baseraa ||4||15||117||
english: She alone dwells in peace, O Nanak, whom the Lord adorns. ||4||15||117||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਰੀ ਏਹੁ ਅਚਾਰਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa kee hoi daasaree ehu achaaraa sikh ree ||
english: Become the servant of the Saints, and learn this way of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਊਤਮੋ ਭਰਤਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਪਿਖੁ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sagal gunaa gun ootamo bharataa door na pikh ree ||1||
english: Of all virtues, the most sublime virtue is to see your Husband Lord near at hand. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ihu man su(n)dar aapanaa har naam majeethai ra(n)g ree ||
english: So, dye this mind of yours with the color of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਚਾਤੁਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣੁ ਗੁਪਾਲਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tiaag siaanap chaaturee too(n) jaan gupaalahi sa(n)g ree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Renounce cleverness and cunning, and know that the Sustainer of the world is with you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਤਾ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਏਹੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bharataa kahai s maaneeai ehu seegaar banaai ree ||
english: Whatever your Husband Lord says, accept that, and make it your decoration.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਏਹੁ ਤੰਬੋਲਾ ਖਾਇ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: doojaa bhaau visaareeai ehu ta(n)bolaa khaai ree ||2||
english: Forget the love of duality, and chew upon this betel leaf. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਪਕੋ ਇਹ ਸਤ ਕੀ ਸੇਜ ਬਿਛਾਇ ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad kar deepako ih sat kee sej bichhaai ree ||
english: Make the Word of the Guru's Shabad your lamp, and let your bed be Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aath pahar kar joR rahu tau bhetai har raai ree ||3||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, stand with your palms pressed together, and the Lord, your King, shall meet you. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਚਜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਈ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tis hee chaj seegaar sabh saaee roop apaar ree ||
english: She alone is cultured and embellished, and she alone is of incomparable beauty.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੋ ਭਾਣੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੧੧੮॥
transliteration: saaee souhaagan naanakaa jo bhaanee karataar ree ||4||16||118||
english: She alone is the happy soul-bride, O Nanak, who is pleasing to the Creator Lord. ||4||16||118||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡੀਗਨ ਡੋਲਾ ਤਊ ਲਉ ਜਉ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: deegan dolaa taoo lau jau man ke bharamaa ||
english: As long as there are doubts in the mind, the mortal staggers and falls.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾਟੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸਰਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhram kaate gur aapanai paae bisaraamaa ||1||
english: The Guru removed my doubts, and I have obtained my place of rest. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਦੋਖੀਆ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੂਟੇ ॥
transliteration: oi bikhaadee dokheeaa te gur te hoote ||
english: Those quarrelsome enemies have been overcome, through the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਛੂਟੇ ਅਬ ਉਨੑਾ ਤੇ ਓਇ ਹਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham chhoote ab unhaa te oi ham te chhoote ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have now escaped from them, and they have run away from me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਾਨਤਾ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa teraa jaanataa tab hee te ba(n)dhaa ||
english: He is concerned with 'mine and yours', and so he is held in bondage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਟੀ ਅਗਿਆਨਤਾ ਤਬ ਛੁਟਕੇ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kaatee agiaanataa tab chhutake pha(n)dhaa ||2||
english: When the Guru dispelled my ignorance, then the noose of death was cut away from my neck. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਤਾ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਲਉ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jab lag hukam na boojhataa tab hee lau dukheeaa ||
english: As long as he does not understand the Command of God's Will, he remains miserable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur mil hukam pachhaaniaa tab hee te sukheeaa ||3||
english: Meeting with the Guru, he comes to recognize God's Will, and then, he becomes happy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੋਖੀਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: naa ko dusaman dokheeaa naahee ko ma(n)daa ||
english: I have no enemies and no adversaries; no one is wicked to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੈ ਬੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੧੧੯॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa sevako naanak khasamai ba(n)daa ||4||17||119||
english: That servant, who performs the Lord's service, O Nanak, is the slave of the Lord Master. ||4||17||119||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aanad ghanaa har keeratan gaau ||
english: Peace, celestial poise and absolute bliss are obtained, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਹ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: garah nivaare satiguroo de apanaa naau ||1||
english: Bestowing His Name, the True Guru removes the evil omens. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane sad sad bal jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guroo vitahu hau vaariaa jis mil sach suaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Guru; meeting Him, I am absorbed into the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗੁਨ ਅਪਸਗੁਨ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਲਗਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sagun apasagun tis kau lagahi jis cheet na aavai ||
english: Good omens and bad omens affect those who do not keep the Lord in the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis jam neR na aavaee jo har prabh bhaavai ||2||
english: The Messenger of Death does not approach those who are pleasing to the Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਜੇਤੇ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: pu(n)n daan jap tap jete sabh oopar naam ||
english: Donations to charity, meditation and penance - above all of them is the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har rasanaa jo japai tis pooran kaam ||3||
english: One who chants with his tongue the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - his works are brought to perfect completion. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਗਏ ਕੋ ਦਿਸੈ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
transliteration: bhai binase bhram moh gae ko disai na beeaa ||
english: His fears are removed, and his doubts and attachments are gone; he sees none other than God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੧੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak raakhe paarabraham phir dookh na theeaa ||4||18||120||
english: O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God preserves him, and no pain or sorrow afflicts him any longer. ||4||18||120||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੯ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ghar 9 mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Ninth House, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤਵਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਉ ਆਗੈ ਭਾਵਉ ਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: chitavau chitav sarab sukh paavau aagai bhaavau k na bhaavau ||
english: Contemplating Him within my consciousness, I obtain total peace; but hereafter, will I be pleasing to Him or not?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦੂਸਰ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek daataar sagal hai jaachik doosar kai pahi jaavau ||1||
english: There is only One Giver; all others are beggars. Who else can we turn to? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਆਨ ਲਜਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: hau maagau aan lajaavau ||
english: When I beg from others, I am ashamed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal chhatrapat eko thaakur kaun samasar laavau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The One Lord Master is the Supreme King of all; who else is equal to Him? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਉ ਬੈਸਉ ਰਹਿ ਭਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: oothau baisau rahi bh na saakau darasan khoj khojaavau ||
english: Standing up and sitting down, I cannot live without Him. I search and search for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦਨ ਸਨਾਤਨ ਸਨਤਕੁਮਾਰ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਦੁਲਭਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: brahamaadik sanakaadik sanak sana(n)dan sanaatan sanatakumaar tinh kau mahal dulabhaavau ||2||
english: Even Brahma and the sages Sanak, Sanandan, Sanaatan and Sanat Kumar, find it difficult to obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਆਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: agam agam aagaadh bodh keemat parai na paavau ||
english: He is unapproachable and unfathomable; His wisdom is deep and profound; His value cannot be appraised.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taakee saran sat purakh kee satigur purakh dhiaavau ||3||
english: I have taken to the Sanctuary of the True Lord, the Primal Being, and I meditate on the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਓ ਬੰਧੁ ਗਰਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaio kripaal daiaal prabh thaakur kaatio ba(n)dh garaavau ||
english: God, the Lord Master, has become kind and compassionate; He has cut the noose of death away from my neck.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਉ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jau saadhasa(n)g paaio tau phir janam na aavau ||4||1||121||
english: Says Nanak, now that I have obtained the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I shall not have to be reincarnated again. ||4||1||121||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਾਵਉ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਜਾਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar gaavau baahar gaavau gaavau jaag savaaree ||
english: Inwardly, I sing His Praises, and outwardly, I sing His Praises; I sing His Praises while awake and asleep.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲਨ ਕਉ ਤੋਸਾ ਦੀਨੑਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)g chalan kau tosaa deenhaa gobi(n)d naam ke biuhaaree ||1||
english: I am a trader in the Name of the Lord of the Universe; He has given it to me as my supplies, to carry with me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: avar bisaaree bisaaree ||
english: I have forgotten and forsaken other things.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਓ ਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam daan gur poorai deeo mai eho aadhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has given me the Gift of the Naam; this alone is my Support. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖਨਿ ਗਾਵਉ ਸੁਖਿ ਭੀ ਗਾਵਉ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: dookhan gaavau sukh bhee gaavau maarag pa(n)th samhaaree ||
english: I sing His Praises while suffering, and I sing His Praises while I am at peace as well. I contemplate Him while I walk along the Path.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਆ ਮੋਰੀ ਤਿਸਾ ਬੁਝਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam driR gur man mahi deeaa moree tisaa bujhaaree ||2||
english: The Guru has implanted the Naam within my mind, and my thirst has been quenched. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਗਾਵਉ ਰੈਨੀ ਗਾਵਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਰਸਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: din bhee gaavau rainee gaavau gaavau saas saas rasanaaree ||
english: I sing His Praises during the day, and I sing His Praises during the night; I sing them with each and every breath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਤ ਸੰਗਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mahi bisaas hoi har jeevat marat sa(n)gaaree ||3||
english: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, this faith is established, that the Lord is with us, in life and in death. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਵਉ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau ihu daan dehu prabh paavau sa(n)t ren ur dhaaree ||
english: Bless servant Nanak with this gift, O God, that he may obtain, and enshrine in his heart, the dust of the feet of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਕਥਾ ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਉ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੨॥
transliteration: sravanee kathaa nain daras pekhau masatak gur charanaaree ||4||2||122||
english: Hear the Lord's Sermon with your ears, and behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan with your eyes; place your forehead upon the Guru's Feet. ||4||2||122||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Aasaa, Tenth House, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ghar 10 mahalaa 5 ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Aasaa, Tenth House, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਤੇ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਦੋ ਦਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jis no too(n) asathir kar maanahi te paahun do daahaa ||
english: That which you believe to be permanent, is a guest here for only a few days.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਅਸਨਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: putr kalatr grih sagal samagree sabh mithiaa asanaahaa ||1||
english: Children, wives, homes, and all possessions - attachment to all of these is false. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਹੈ ਹਾ ਹਾ ॥
transliteration: re man kiaa karahi hai haa haa ||
english: O mind, why do you burst out laughing?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: drisat dekh jaise haricha(n)dauree ik raam bhajan lai laahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: See with your eyes, that these things are only mirages. So earn the profit of meditation on the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਸਤਰ ਦੇਹ ਓਢਾਨੇ ਦਿਨ ਦੋਇ ਚਾਰਿ ਭੋਰਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jaise basatar deh odhaane din doi chaar bhoraahaa ||
english: It is like the clothes which you wear on your body - they wear off in a few days.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੀਤਿ ਊਪਰੇ ਕੇਤਕੁ ਧਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਿ ਓਰਕੋ ਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bheet oopare ketak dhaaeeai a(n)t orako aahaa ||2||
english: How long can you run upon a wall? Ultimately, you come to its end. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਅੰਭ ਕੁੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਪਰਤ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jaise a(n)bh ku(n)d kar raakhio parat si(n)dh gal jaahaa ||
english: It is like salt, preserved in its container; when it is put into water, it dissolves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਗਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਚਸਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aavag aagiaa paarabraham kee uth jaasee muhat chasaahaa ||3||
english: When the Order of the Supreme Lord God comes, the soul arises, and departs in an instant. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਲੈਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: re man lekhai chaalahi lekhai baisahi lekhai laidaa saahaa ||
english: O mind, your steps are numbered, your moments spent sitting are numbered, and the breaths you are to take are numbered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਓਟਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੩॥
transliteration: sadaa keerat kar naanak har kee ubare satigur charan otaahaa ||4||1||123||
english: Sing forever the Praises of the Lord, O Nanak, and you shall be saved, under the Shelter of the Feet of the True Guru. ||4||1||123||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਸਟ ਬਾਤ ਤੇ ਭਈ ਸੀਧਰੀ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਜਨਈ ॥
transliteration: apusat baat te bhaee seedharee doot dusat sajanaee ||
english: That which was upside-down has been set upright; the deadly enemies and adversaries have become friends.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਓ ਮਲੀਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਹਛਨਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)dhakaar mahi ratan pragaasio maleen budh hachhanaee ||1||
english: In the darkness, the jewel shines forth, and the impure understanding has become pure. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਈ ॥
transliteration: jau kirapaa gobi(n)d bhaee ||
english: When the Lord of the Universe became merciful,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukh sa(n)pat har naam phal paae satigur milaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I found peace, wealth and the fruit of the Lord's Name; I have met the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਈ ॥
transliteration: mohi kirapan kau koi na jaanat sagal bhavan pragataee ||
english: No one knew me, the miserable miser, but now, I have become famous all over the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਠਨੋ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੁਣਿ ਸਗਲ ਚਰਣ ਸੇਵਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)g baithano kahee na paavat hun sagal charan sevaee ||2||
english: Before, no one would even sit with me, but now, all worship my feet. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਢ ਆਢ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਤ ਢੂੰਢਤੇ ਮਨ ਸਗਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ॥
transliteration: aadh aadh kau phirat dhoo(n)dhate man sagal trisan bujh gaee ||
english: I used to wander in search of pennies, but now, all the desires of my mind are satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਬੋਲੁ ਭੀ ਖਵਤੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੀਤਲਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ek bol bhee khavato naahee saadhasa(n)gat seetalaee ||3||
english: I could not bear even one criticism, but now, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am cooled and soothed. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਗੁਣ ਕਵਨ ਵਖਾਨੈ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮਈ ॥
transliteration: ek jeeh gun kavan vakhaanai agam agam agamaee ||
english: What Glorious Virtues of the Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Profound Lord can one mere tongue describe?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੪॥
transliteration: daas daas daas ko kareeahu jan naanak har saranaee ||4||2||124||
english: Please, make me the slave of the slave of Your slaves; servant Nanak seeks the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||2||124||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ ਲਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਢੀਲਾ ਢੀਲਾ ਤੋਟੇ ਕਉ ਬੇਗਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: re mooRe laahe kau too(n) dheelaa dheelaa tote kau beg dhaaiaa ||
english: O fool, you are so slow to earn your profits, and so quick to run up losses.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਸਤ ਵਖਰੁ ਤੂੰ ਘਿੰਨਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਬਾਧਾ ਰੇਨਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sasat vakhar too(n) ghi(n)nahi naahee paapee baadhaa renaaiaa ||1||
english: You do not purchase the inexpensive merchandise; O sinner, you are tied to your debts. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur teree aasaaiaa ||
english: O True Guru, You are my only hope.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਓਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan tero naam paarabraham mai ehaa otaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your Name is the Purifier of sinners, O Supreme Lord God; You are my only Shelter. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੰਧਣ ਵੈਣ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਉਰਝਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਅਲਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)dhan vain sunahi urajhaavahi naam lait alakaaiaa ||
english: Listening to the evil talk, you are caught up in it, but you are hesitant to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਮਾਹਿਓ ਬੂਝੀ ਉਲਟਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ni(n)d chi(n)d kau bahut umaahio boojhee ulataaiaa ||2||
english: You are delighted by slanderous talk; your understanding is corrupt. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਤੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਅਖਾਧਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: par dhan par tan par tee ni(n)daa akhaadh khaahi harakaaiaa ||
english: Others' wealth, others' wives and the slander of others - eating the uneatable, you have gone crazy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਛੋਹਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saach dharam siu ruch nahee aavai sat sunat chhohaaiaa ||3||
english: You have not enshrined love for the True Faith of Dharma; hearing the Truth, you are enraged. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਗਤ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal kripaal prabh thaakur bhagat tek har naaiaa ||
english: O God, Merciful to the meek, Compassionate Lord Master, Your Name is the Support of Your devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਹਿ ਸਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਓ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak aahi saran prabh aaio raakh laaj apanaaiaa ||4||3||125||
english: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary; O God, make him Your Own, and preserve his honor. ||4||3||125||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਏ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa sa(n)g sa(n)g lapataae moh maaiaa kar baadhe ||
english: They are attached to falsehood; clinging to the transitory, they are trapped in emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ ਸੋ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਭਏ ਆਂਧੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jah jaano so cheet na aavai aha(n)budh bhae aa(n)dhe ||1||
english: Wherever they go, they do not think of the Lord; they are blinded by intellectual egotism. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਅਰਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: man bairaagee kiu na araadhe ||
english: O mind, O renunciate, why don't you adore Him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਸਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੀ ਬਿਆਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaach kotharee maahi too(n) basataa sa(n)g sagal bikhai kee biaadhe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You dwell in that flimsy chamber, with all the sins of corruption. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਪਲੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ਅਰਜਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: meree meree karat din rain bihaavai pal khin chheejai arajaadhe ||
english: Crying out, "Mine, mine", your days and nights pass away; moment by moment, your life is running out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਠੈ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋਭਾਏ ਝੂਠ ਧੰਧਿ ਦੁਰਗਾਧੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaise meethai saad lobhaae jhooth dha(n)dh duragaadhe ||2||
english: The sweet flavors tempt you, and you are occupied by your false and filthy business. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਇਹ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh ar lobh moh ih i(n)dree ras lapataadhe ||
english: Your senses are beguiled by sensual pleasures of sex, by anger, greed and emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਈ ਭਵਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਜਨਮਾਧੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: deeee bhavaaree purakh bidhaatai bahur bahur janamaadhe ||3||
english: The All-powerful Architect of Destiny has ordained that you shall be reincarnated over and over again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਲਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: jau bhaio kripaal deen dukh bha(n)jan tau gur mil sabh sukh laadhe ||
english: When the Destroyer of the pains of the poor becomes merciful, then, as Gurmukh, you shall find absolute peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਾਢੀ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਧੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak din rain dhiaavau maar kaadhee sagal upaadhe ||4||
english: Says Nanak, meditate on the Lord, day and night, and all your sickness shall be banished. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਜਪਿਓ ਭਾਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: iu japio bhaaee purakh bidhaate ||
english: Meditate in this way, O Siblings of Destiny, on the Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨੬॥
transliteration: bhaio kripaal deen dukh bha(n)jan janam maran dukh laathe ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||4||4||126||
english: The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful; He has removed the pains of birth and death. ||1||Second Pause||4||4||126||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਕਾਮ ਸੁਆਦ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: nimakh kaam suaad kaaran kot dinas dukh paavahi ||
english: For a moment of sexual pleasure, you shall suffer in pain for millions of days.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gharee muhat ra(n)g maanahi phir bahur bahur pachhutaavahi ||1||
english: For an instant, you may savor pleasure, but afterwards, you shall regret it, again and again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਚੇਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe chet har har raaiaa ||
english: O blind man, meditate on the Lord, the Lord, your King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teraa so din neRai aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your day is drawing near. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਲਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲੋ ਆਕ ਨੀਮ ਕੋ ਤੂੰਮਰੁ ॥
transliteration: palak drisat dekh bhoolo aak neem ko too(n)mar ||
english: You are deceived, beholding with your eyes, the bitter melon and swallow-wort.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਸਿਉ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaisaa sa(n)g biseear siu hai re taiso hee ihu par grihu ||2||
english: But, like the companionship of a poisonous snake, so is the desire for another's spouse. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰੀ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤਾ ਬਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਅਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bairee kaaran paap karataa basat rahee amaanaa ||
english: For the sake of your enemy, you commit sins, while you neglect the reality of your faith.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chhod jaahi tin hee siu sa(n)gee saajan siu bairaanaa ||3||
english: Your friendship is with those who abandon you, and you are angry with your friends. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਇਹੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਸੋ ਉਬਰਿਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal sa(n)saar ihai bidh biaapio so ubario jis gur pooraa ||
english: The entire world is entangled in this way; he alone is saved, who has the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bhav saagar tario bhae puneet sareeraa ||4||5||127||
english: Says Nanak, I have crossed over the terrifying world-ocean; my body has become sanctified. ||4||5||127||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 dupade ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੂਕਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਮੑ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਮੁਕਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: look kamaano soee tumh pekhio mooR mugadh mukaraanee ||
english: O Lord, You behold whatever we do in secrecy; the fool may stubbornly deny it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਕਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਲੇ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aap kamaane kau le baa(n)dhe phir paachhai pachhutaanee ||1||
english: By his own actions, he is tied down, and in the end, he regrets and repents. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh mere sabh bidh aagai jaanee ||
english: My God knows, ahead of time, all things.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਮੂਸੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਤ ਪਰਦਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhram ke moose too(n) raakhat paradaa paachhai jee kee maanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Deceived by doubt, you may hide your actions, but in the end, you shall have to confess the secrets of your mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jit jit laae tit tit laage kiaa ko karai paraanee ||
english: Whatever they are attached to, they remain joined to that. What can any mere mortal do?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨੮॥
transliteration: bakhas laihu paarabraham suaamee naanak sad kurabaanee ||2||6||128||
english: Please, forgive me, O Supreme Lord Master. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||6||128||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: apune sevak kee aape raakhai aape naam japaavai ||
english: He Himself preserves His servants; He causes them to chant His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਕਾਜ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਤਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jah jah kaaj kirat sevak kee tahaa tahaa uth dhaavai ||1||
english: Wherever the business and affairs of His servants are, there the Lord hurries to be. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਨਿਕਟੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sevak kau nikatee hoi dikhaavai ||
english: The Lord appears near at hand to His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo jo kahai thaakur pahi sevak tatakaal hoi aavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever the servant asks of his Lord and Master, immediately comes to pass. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tis sevak kai hau balihaaree jo apane prabh bhaavai ||
english: I am a sacrifice to that servant, who is pleasing to his God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਸਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨੯॥
transliteration: tis kee soi sunee man hariaa tis naanak parasan aavai ||2||7||129||
english: Hearing of his glory, the mind is rejuvenated; Nanak comes to touch his feet. ||2||7||129||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੧੧ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ghar 11 mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Eleventh House, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਟੂਆ ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: natooaa bhekh dikhaavai bahu bidh jaisaa hai ohu taisaa re ||
english: The actor displays himself in many disguises, but he remains just as he is.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੁਖਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik jon bhramio bhram bheetar sukhahi naahee paravesaa re ||1||
english: The soul wanders through countless incarnations in doubt, but it does not come to dwell in peace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਨੀਤਾ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saajan sa(n)t hamaare meetaa bin har har aaneetaa re ||
english: O Saints, my friends and companions, without the Lord, Har, Har, you shall perish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mil har gun gaae ihu janam padaarath jeetaa re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and win this precious treasure of human life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: trai gun maaiaa braham kee keenhee kahahu kavan bidh tareeai re ||
english: God has created Maya of the three qualities; tell me, how can it be crossed over?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰ ਅਗਾਹ ਗਾਖਰੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਐ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghooman gher agaah gaakharee gurasabadee paar utareeai re ||2||
english: The whirlpool is awesome and unfathomable; only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad is one carried across. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਤਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat khoj beechaario tat naanak ihu jaanaa re ||
english: Searching and searching endlessly, seeking and deliberating, Nanak has realized the true essence of reality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੩॥੧॥੧੩੦॥
transliteration: simarat naam nidhaan niramolak man maanak pateeaanaa re ||3||1||130||
english: Meditating on the invaluable treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the jewel of the mind is satisfied. ||3||1||130||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 dupade ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਜੋ ਮਾਗਉ ਸੋ ਪਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad merai man vasiaa jo maagau so paavau re ||
english: By Guru's Grace, He dwells within my mind; whatever I ask for, I receive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨਾ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam ra(n)g ihu man tripataanaa bahur na katahoo(n) dhaavau re ||1||
english: This mind is satisfied with the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; it does not go out, anywhere, anymore. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hamaraa thaakur sabh te oochaa rain dinas tis gaavau re ||
english: My Lord and Master is the highest of all; night and day, I sing the Glories of His Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਡਰਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi thaap uthaapanahaaraa tis te tujhahi daraavau re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; through Him, I frighten you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਉ ਅਵਰਹਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jab dekhau prabh apunaa suaamee tau avarahi cheet na paavau re ||
english: When I behold my God, my Lord and Master, I do not pay any attention to any other.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮੇਟਿ ਲਿਖਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੩੧॥
transliteration: naanak daas prabh aap pahiraaiaa bhram bhau met likhaavau re ||2||2||131||
english: God Himself has adorned servant Nanak; his doubts and fears have been dispelled, and he writes the account of the Lord. ||2||2||131||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਬਰਨ ਚਉਹਾ ਕੇ ਮਰਦਨ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਰ ਤਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: chaar baran chauhaa ke maradan khat darasan kar talee re ||
english: The four castes and social classes, and the preachers with the six Shaastras on their finger-tips,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਹੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਛਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: su(n)dar sughar saroop siaane pa(n)chahu hee mohi chhalee re ||1||
english: the beautiful, the refined, the shapely and the wise - the five passions have enticed and beguiled them all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੰਚ ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਐਸੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਬਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jin mil maare pa(n)ch soorabeer aiso kaun balee re ||
english: Who has seized and conquered the five powerful fighters? Is there anyone strong enough?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ਗੁਦਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਇਹ ਕਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin pa(n)ch maar bidaar gudaare so pooraa ih kalee re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He alone, who conquers and defeats the five demons, is perfect in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਕੋਮ ਵਸਿ ਭਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਹਕਮ ਫਉਜ ਹਠਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: vadee kom vas bhaagahi naahee muhakam phauj hathalee re ||
english: They are so awesome and great; they cannot be controlled, and they do not run away. Their army is mighty and unyielding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਨਿਰਦਲਿਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਝਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੩੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tin jan niradaliaa saadhasa(n)gat kai jhalee re ||2||3||132||
english: Says Nanak, that humble being who is under the protection of the Saadh Sangat, crushes those terrible demons. ||2||3||132||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਕੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਊਤਮ ਆਨ ਸਗਲ ਰਸ ਫੀਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: neekee jee kee har kathaa ootam aan sagal ras pheekee re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Sublime Sermon of the Lord is the best thing for the soul. All other tastes are insipid. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਗੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਖਟੁ ਬੇਤੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਾਈਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bahu gun dhun mun jan khat bete avar na kichh laaeekee re ||1||
english: The worthy beings, heavenly singers, silent sages and the knowers of the six Shaastras proclaim that nothing else is worthy of consideration. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਅਪਾਰੀ ਸਹਜਾਰੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੀਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੩੩॥
transliteration: bikhaaree niraaree apaaree sahajaaree saadhasa(n)g naanak peekee re ||2||4||133||
english: It is the cure for evil passions, unique, unequalled and peace-giving; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, drink it in. ||2||4||133||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮਾਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਟਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hamaaree piaaree a(n)mrit dhaaree gur nimakh na man te taaree re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My Beloved has brought forth a river of nectar. The Guru has not held it back from my mind, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਸਰਸਨ ਹਰਸਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਕਰਤਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: darasan parasan sarasan harasan ra(n)g ra(n)gee karataaree re ||1||
english: Beholding it, and touching it, I am sweetened and delighted. It is imbued with the Creator's Love. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਹਰਿ ਦਮ ਨਹ ਜਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੩੪॥
transliteration: khin ram gur gam har dam nah jam har ka(n)th naanak ur haaree re ||2||5||134||
english: Chanting it even for a moment, I rise to the Guru; meditating on it, one is not trapped by the Messenger of Death. The Lord has placed it as a garland around Nanak's neck, and within his heart. ||2||5||134||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਕੀ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: neekee saadh sa(n)gaanee || rahaau ||
english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is exalted and sublime. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਹਰ ਮੂਰਤ ਪਲ ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pahar moorat pal gaavat gaavat govi(n)d govi(n)d vakhaanee ||1||
english: Every day, hour and moment, I continually sing and speak of Govind, Govind, the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਲਤ ਬੈਸਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਖਟਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chaalat baisat sovat har jas man tan charan khataanee ||2||
english: Walking, sitting and sleeping, I chant the Lord's Praises; I treasure His Feet in my mind and body. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਂਉ ਹਉਰੋ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗਉਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੩੫॥
transliteration: ha(n)u hauro too thaakur gauro naanak saran pachhaanee ||3||6||135||
english: I am so small, and You are so great, O Lord and Master; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||3||6||135||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੨ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 5 ghar 12 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Twelfth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਨਪਾ ਭਜੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tiaag sagal siaanapaa bhaj paarabraham nira(n)kaar ||
english: Renounce all your cleverness and remember the Supreme, Formless Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੀਸੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek saache naam baajhahu sagal deesai chhaar ||1||
english: Without the One True Name, everything appears as dust. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: so prabh jaaneeai sad sa(n)g ||
english: Know that God is always with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaadee boojheeai ek har kai ra(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one understands, and is imbued with the Love of the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਏਕ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saran samarath ek keree doojaa naahee thaau ||
english: Seek the Shelter of the One All-powerful Lord; there is no other place of rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mahaa bhaujal la(n)gheeai sadaa har gun gaau ||2||
english: The vast and terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, singing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: janam maran nivaareeai dukh na jam pur hoi ||
english: Birth and death are overcome, and one does not have to suffer in the City of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan soee paae kripaa kare prabh soi ||3||
english: He alone obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, unto whom God shows His Mercy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ek tek adhaar eko ek kaa man jor ||
english: The One Lord is my Anchor and Support; the One Lord alone is the power of my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩੬॥
transliteration: naanak japeeai mil saadhasa(n)gat har bin avar na hor ||4||1||136||
english: O Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him; without the Lord, there is no other at all. ||4||1||136||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਦੀਏ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
transliteration: jeeu man tan praan prabh ke deee sabh ras bhog ||
english: The soul, the mind, the body and the breath of life belong to God. He has given all tastes and pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧਪ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਰਾਖਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: deen ba(n)dhap jee daataa saran raakhan jog ||1||
english: He is the Friend of the poor, the Giver of life, the Protector of those who seek His Sanctuary. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mere man dhiaai har har naau ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸਹਾਇ ਸੰਗੇ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: halat palat sahaai sa(n)ge ek siu liv laau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Here and hereafter, He is our Helper and Companion; embrace love and affection for the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਰਣ ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bed saasatr jan dhiaavahi taran kau sa(n)saar ||
english: They meditate on the Vedas and the Shaastras, to swim across the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karam dharam anek kiriaa sabh oopar naam achaar ||2||
english: The many religious rituals, good deeds of karma and Dharmic worship - above all of these is the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar binasai milai satigur dev ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, and egotism depart, meeting with the Divine True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam driR kar bhagat har kee bhalee prabh kee sev ||3||
english: Implant the Naam within, perform devotional worship to the Lord and serve God - this is good. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: charan saran daiaal teree too(n) nimaane maan ||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O Merciful Lord; You are the Honor of the dishonored.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩੭॥
transliteration: jee praan adhaar teraa naanak kaa prabh taan ||4||2||137||
english: You are the Support of my soul, my breath of life; O God, You are Nanak's strength. ||4||2||137||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
transliteration: dol dol mahaa dukh paaiaa binaa saadhoo sa(n)g ||
english: He wavers and falters, and suffers such great pain, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਟਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਇਕ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khaat laabh gobi(n)d har ras paarabraham ik ra(n)g ||1||
english: The profit of the sublime essence of the Lord of the Universe is obtained, by the Love of the One Supreme Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har ko naam japeeai neet ||
english: Chant continually the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saas saas dhiaai so prabh tiaag avar pareet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: With each and every breath, meditate on God, and renounce other love. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath so prabh jee daataa aap ||
english: God is the Doer, the All-powerful Cause of causes; He Himself is the Giver of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tiaag sagal siaanapaa aath pahar prabh jaap ||2||
english: So renounce all your cleverness, and meditate on God, twenty-four hours a day. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਇ ਸੰਗੀ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: meet sakhaa sahaai sa(n)gee ooch agam apaar ||
english: He is our best friend and companion, our help and support; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਬਸਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: charan kamal basaai hiradai jee ko aadhaar ||3||
english: Enshrine His Lotus Feet within your heart; He is the Support of the soul. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh paarabraham gun teraa jas gaau ||
english: Show Your Mercy, O Supreme Lord God, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੩੮॥
transliteration: sarab sookh vadee vadiaaee jap jeevai naanak naau ||4||3||138||
english: Total peace, and the greatest greatness, O Nanak, are obtained by living to chant the Name of the Lord. ||4||3||138||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਕਰਾਵਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: udam karau karaavahu thaakur pekhat saadhoo sa(n)g ||
english: I make the effort, as You cause me to do, my Lord and Master, to behold You in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਰਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har naam charaavahu ra(n)gan aape hee prabh ra(n)g ||1||
english: I am imbued with the color of the Love of the Lord, Har, Har; God Himself has colored me in His Love. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: man mahi raam naamaa jaap ||
english: I chant the Lord's Name within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਵਸਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਈ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa vasahu merai hiradai hoi sahaaee aap ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Bestow Your Mercy, and dwell within my heart; please, become my Helper. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sun sun naam tumaaraa preetam prabh pekhan kaa chaau ||
english: Listening continually to Your Name, O Beloved God, I yearn to behold You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਇਹੈ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: daiaa karahu kiram apune kau ihai manorath suaau ||2||
english: Please, be kind to me - I am just a worm. This is my object and purpose. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਮਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tan dhan teraa too(n) prabh meraa hamarai vas kichh naahi ||
english: My body and wealth are Yours; You are my God - nothing is in my power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਣਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਆ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu jiu raakhahi tiu tiu rahanaa teraa deeaa khaahi ||3||
english: As You keep me, so do I live; I eat what You give me. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਮਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh kaatai majan har jan dhoor ||
english: The sins of countless incarnations are washed away, by bathing in the dust of the Lord's humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਨਾਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩੯॥
transliteration: bhaai bhagat bharam bhau naasai har naanak sadaa hajoor ||4||4||139||
english: By loving devotional worship, doubt and fear depart; O Nanak, the Lord is Ever-present. ||4||4||139||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar daras teraa so paae jis masatak bhaag ||
english: The Blessed Vision of Your Darshan is unapproachable and incomprehensible; he alone obtains it, who has such good destiny recorded upon his forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aap kripaal kripaa prabh dhaaree satigur bakhasiaa har naam ||1||
english: The Merciful Lord God has bestowed His Mercy, and the True Guru has granted the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: kalijug udhaariaa guradev ||
english: The Divine Guru is the Saving Grace in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਮੂੜ ਜਿ ਮੁਘਦ ਹੋਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਗੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mal moot mooR j mughad hote sabh lage teree sev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Even those fools and idiots, stained with feces and urine, have all taken to Your service. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: too aap karataa sabh srisat dharataa sabh mahi rahiaa samaai ||
english: You Yourself are the Creator, who established the entire world. You are contained in all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਜਾ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਭ ਪਈ ਪੈਰੀ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dharam raajaa bisamaad hoaa sabh paee pairee aai ||2||
english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is wonder-struck, at the sight of everyone falling at the Lord's Feet. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗੁ ਤ੍ਰੇਤਾ ਦੁਆਪਰੁ ਭਣੀਐ ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਊਤਮੋ ਜੁਗਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: satajug tretaa duaapar bhaneeai kalijug ootamo jugaa maahi ||
english: The Golden Age of Sat Yuga, the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga, and the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga are good; but the best is the Dark Age, the Iron Age, of Kali Yuga.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਕੜੀਐ ਕਿਸੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ahi kar kare s ahi kar paae koee na pakaReeai kisai thaai ||3||
english: As we act, so are the rewards we receive; no one can take the place of another. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਏਹੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu soee karahi j bhagat tere jaachahi ehu teraa birad ||
english: O Dear Lord, whatever Your devotees ask for, You do. This is Your Way, Your very nature.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਅਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੪੦॥
transliteration: kar joR naanak daan maagai apaniaa sa(n)taa dehi har daras ||4||5||140||
english: With my palms pressed together, O Nanak, I beg for this gift; Lord, please bless Your Saints with Your Vision. ||4||5||140||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੩ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 5 ghar 13 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Thirteenth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur bachan tumhaare ||
english: O True Guru, by Your Words,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: niragun nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: even the worthless have been saved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਦੁਸਟ ਅਪਵਾਦੀ ਤੇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸੰਗਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mahaa bikhaadee dusat apavaadee te puneet sa(n)gaare ||1||
english: Even the most argumentative, vicious and indecent people, have been purified in Your company. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਭਵੰਤੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਪੜੰਤੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: janam bhava(n)te narak paRa(n)te tinh ke kul udhaare ||2||
english: Those who have wandered in reincarnation, and those who have been consigned to hell - even their families have been redeemed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਸੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: koi na jaanai koi na maanai se paragat har duaare ||3||
english: Those whom no one knew, and those whom no one respected - even they have become famous and respected at the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪੧॥
transliteration: kavan upamaa deu kavan vadaaee naanak khin khin vaare ||4||1||141||
english: What praise, and what greatness should I attribute to You? Nanak is a sacrifice to You, each and every moment. ||4||1||141||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਰ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: baavar soi rahe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The crazy people are asleep. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਗਹਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: moh kuta(n)b bikhai ras maate mithiaa gahan gahe ||1||
english: They are intoxicated with attachment to their families and sensory pleasures; they are held in the grip of falsehood. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸੁਪਨ ਆਨੰਦ ਉਲਾਸ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mithan manorath supan aana(n)d ulaas man mukh sat kahe ||2||
english: The false desires, and the dream-like delights and pleasures - these, the self-willed manmukhs call true. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਤਿਲੁ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਲਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam padaarath sa(n)ge til maram na lahe ||3||
english: The wealth of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is with them, but they do not find even a tiny bit of its mystery. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਤਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਹੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪੨॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhe satasa(n)ge naanak saran aahe ||4||2||142||
english: By Your Grace, O Lord, You save those, who take to the Sanctuary of the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||4||2||142||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਤਿਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 tipade ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Thi-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ohaa prem piree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I seek the Love of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਗਜ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਲਾਲਨ ਨਹ ਨਾਹ ਨਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kanik maanik gaj moteean laalan nah naah nahee ||1||
english: Gold, jewels, giant pearls and rubies - I have no need for them. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਨ ਭਾਗ ਨ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਸਾਦਨ ॥ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਚਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raaj na bhaag na hukam na saadan || kichh kichh na chaahee ||2||
english: Imperial power, fortunes, royal command and mansions - I have no desire for these. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨਨ ਸਰਨਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਬੰਦਨ ॥ ਸੁਖੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਹੀ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਪਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥ ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੧੪੩॥
transliteration: charanan saranan sa(n)tan ba(n)dan || sukho sukh paahee || naanak tapat haree || mile prem piree ||3||3||143||
english: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet, and dedication to the Saints these bring me peace and pleasure. O Nanak, my burning fire has been put out, obtaining the Love of the Beloved. ||3||3||143||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਲੋਇਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gurahi dikhaaio loinaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru has revealed Him to my eyes. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਤਹਿ ਊਤਹਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੋਹਿਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: eetahi ootahi ghat ghat ghat ghat too(n)hee too(n)hee mohinaa ||1||
english: Here and there, in each and every heart, and each and every being, You, O Fascinating Lord, You exist. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਧਾਰਨ ਧਰਨਾ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਸੋਹਿਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaaran karanaa dhaaran dharanaa ekai ekai sohinaa ||2||
english: You are the Creator, the Cause of causes, the Support of the earth; You are the One and only, Beauteous Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਇਨਾ ॥੩॥੪॥੧੪੪॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan parasan balihaaree darasan naanak sukh sukh soinaa ||3||4||144||
english: Meeting the Saints, and beholding the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, Nanak is a sacrifice to them; he sleeps in absolute peace. ||3||4||144||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam amolaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is priceless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ohu sahaj suhelaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It brings peace and poise. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਓਹੁ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)g sahaaee chhod na jaaee ohu agah atolaa ||1||
english: The Lord is my Companion and Helper; He shall not forsake me or leave me. He is unfathomable and unequalled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਭਾਈ ਬਾਪੁ ਮੋਰੋ ਮਾਈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਓਲੑਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: preetam bhaaee baap moro maaee bhagatan kaa olhaa ||2||
english: He is my Beloved, my brother, father and mother; He is the Support of His devotees. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਚੋਲੑਾ ॥੩॥੫॥੧੪੫॥
transliteration: alakh lakhaaiaa gur te paaiaa naanak ihu har kaa cholhaa ||3||5||145||
english: The Invisible Lord is seen through the Guru; O Nanak, this is the wondrous play of the Lord. ||3||5||145||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aapunee bhagat nibaahi ||
english: Please help me sustain my devotion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਆਇਓ ਆਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: thaakur aaio aahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Lord Master, I have come to You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਕਾਰਥੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਚਰਨ ਬਸਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam padaarath hoi sakaarath hiradai charan basaahi ||1||
english: With the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, life becomes fruitful. Lord, please place Your Feet within my heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਏਹ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: eh mukataa eh jugataa raakhahu sa(n)t sa(n)gaahi ||2||
english: This is liberation, and this is the best way of life; please, keep me in the Society of the Saints. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੪੬॥
transliteration: naam dhiaavau sahaj samaavau naanak har gun gaahi ||3||6||146||
english: Meditating on the Naam, I am absorbed in celestial peace; O Nanak, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||6||146||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ॥
transliteration: thaakur charan suhaave ||
english: The Feet of my Lord and Master are so Beautiful!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਵੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)tan paave ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord's Saints obtain them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਗੁਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਵੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aap gavaaiaa sev kamaaiaa gun ras ras gaave ||1||
english: They eradicate their self-conceit and serve the Lord; drenched in His Love, they sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਸਾ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਭਾਵੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ekahi aasaa daras piaasaa aan na bhaave ||2||
english: They place their hopes in Him, and they thirst for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Nothing else is pleasing to them. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੇ ॥੩॥੭॥੧੪੭॥
transliteration: daiaa tuhaaree kiaa ja(n)t vichaaree naanak bal bal jaave ||3||7||147||
english: This is Your Mercy, Lord; what can Your poor creatures do? Nanak is devoted, a sacrifice to You. ||3||7||147||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ek simar man maahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Remember the One Lord in meditation within your mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam dhiaavahu ridai basaavahu tis bin ko naahee ||1||
english: Meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and enshrine Him within your heart. Without Him there is no other. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prabh saranee aaeeai sarab phal paaeeai sagale dukh jaahee ||2||
english: Entering God's Sanctuary, all rewards are obtained, and all pains are taken away. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਹੀ ॥੩॥੮॥੧੪੮॥
transliteration: jeean ko daataa purakh bidhaataa naanak ghat ghat aahee ||3||8||148||
english: He is the Giver of all beings, the Architect of Destiny; O Nanak, He is contained in each and every heart. ||3||8||148||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸੋ ਮੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bisarat so mooaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who forgets the Lord is dead. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਹੂਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam dhiaavai sarab phal paavai so jan sukheeaa hooaa ||1||
english: One who meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtains all rewards. That person becomes happy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਨਲਿਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੂਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raaj kahaavai hau karam kamaavai baadhio nalinee bhram sooaa ||2||
english: One who calls himself a king, and acts in ego and pride, is caught by his doubts, like a parrot in a trap. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੩॥੯॥੧੪੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jis satigur bhetiaa so jan nihachal theeaa ||3||9||149||
english: Says Nanak, one who meets the True Guru, becomes permanent and immortal. ||3||9||149||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ghar 14 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Fourteenth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ ॥ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ohu nehu navelaa || apune preetam siu laag rahai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: That love is forever fresh and new, Which is for the Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਚੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo prabh bhaavai janam na aavai || har prem bhagat har preet rachai ||1||
english: One who is pleasing to God shall not be reincarnated again. He remains absorbed in the loving devotional worship of the Lord, in the Love of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੫੦॥
transliteration: prabh sa(n)g mileejai ihu man deejai || naanak naam milai apanee daiaa karahu ||2||1||150||
english: He is blended with God, by dedicating his mind to Him. Bless Nanak with Your Name, O Lord - please, shower Your Mercy upon him! ||2||1||150||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mil raam piaare tum bin dheeraj ko na karai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please, come to me, O Beloved Lord; without You, no one can comfort me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਦਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: si(n)mrit saasatr bahu karam kamaae prabh tumare daras bin sukh naahee ||1||
english: One may read the Simritees and the Shaastras, and perform all sorts of religious rituals; and yet, without the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, God, there is no peace at all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੧॥
transliteration: varat nem sa(n)jam kar thaake naanak saadh saran prabh sa(n)g vasai ||2||2||151||
english: People have grown weary of observing fasts, vows and rigorous self-discipline; Nanak abides with God, in the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||2||2||151||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ghar 15 paRataal ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Fifteenth House, Partaal:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਦਿ ਸੋਇਓ ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bikaar maaiaa maad soio soojh boojh na aavai ||
english: He sleeps, intoxicated by corruption and Maya; he does not come to realize or understand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਕਰਿ ਕੇਸ ਜਮਿ ਉਠਾਰਿਓ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pakar kes jam uthaario tad hee ghar jaavai ||1||
english: Seizing him by the hair, the Messenger of Death pulls him up; then, he comes to his senses. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਹਿਰਿ ਵਿਤ ਚਿਤ ਦੁਖਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: lobh bikhiaa bikhai laage hir vit chit dukhaahee ||
english: Those who are attached to the poison of greed and sin grab at the wealth of others; they only bring pain on themselves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਭੰਗੁਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਸੁਰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khin bha(n)gunaa kai maan maate asur jaanahi naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They are intoxicated by their pride in those things which shall be destroyed in an instant; those demons do not understand. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਨ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਸੁਨੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bed saasatr jan pukaarahi sunai naahee doraa ||
english: The Vedas, the Shaastras and the holy men proclaim it, but the deaf do not hear it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਪਟਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰਿ ਮੂਕਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਭੋਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nipat baajee haar mookaa pachhutaaio man bhoraa ||2||
english: When the game of life is over, and he has lost, and he breathes his last, then the fool regrets and repents in his mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਾਨੁ ਸਗਲ ਗੈਰ ਵਜਹਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਦੀਵਾਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਨ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: daan sagal gair vajahi bhariaa deevaan lekhai na pariaa ||
english: He paid the fine, but it is in vain - in the Court of the Lord, his account is not credited.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਂਹ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਓਲੑਾ ਸੋਇ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je(n)h kaaraj rahai olhaa soi kaam na kariaa ||3||
english: Those deeds which would have covered him - those deeds, he has not done. ||3||
