author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aiso jag mohi gur dikhaaio tau ek keerat gaaiaa ||
english: The Guru has shown me the world to be thus; I sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਤਾਨੁ ਤਜਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੨॥
transliteration: maan taan taj siaanap saran naanak aaiaa ||4||1||152||
english: Renouncing his pride in strength and cleverness, Nanak has come to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||1||152||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਪਾਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਾਏ ॥
transliteration: baapaar govi(n)d naae ||
english: Dealing in the Name of the Lord of the Universe,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਨਾਦ ਤੂਰ ਬਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadh sa(n)t manaae pri paae gun gaae pa(n)ch naad toor bajaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and pleasing the Saints and holy men, obtain the Beloved Lord and sing His Glorious Praises; play the sound current of the Naad with the five instruments. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜਾਏ ਦਰਸਾਏ ਅਬ ਰਾਤਿਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa paae sahajaae darasaae ab raatiaa govi(n)d siu ||
english: Obtaining His Mercy, I easily gained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; now, I am imbued with the Love of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਥ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲਨ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sev preet naath ra(n)g laalan laae ||1||
english: Serving the Saints, I feel love and affection for my Beloved Lord Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰਹਸਾਏ ਨਹੀ ਆਏ ਸਹਜਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur giaan man driRaae rahasaae nahee aae sahajaae man nidhaan paae ||
english: The Guru has implanted spiritual wisdom within my mind, and I rejoice that I shall not have to come back again. I have obtained celestial poise, and the treasure within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤਜੀ ਮਨੈ ਕੀ ਕਾਮ ਕਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh tajee manai kee kaam karaa ||
english: I have renounced all of the affairs of my mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: chir chir chir chir bhaiaa man bahut piaas laagee ||
english: It has been so long, so long, so long, so very long, since my mind has felt such a great thirst.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: har darasano dikhaavahu mohi tum bataavahu ||
english: Please, reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, and show Yourself to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਏ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੩॥
transliteration: naanak deen saran aae gal laae ||2||2||153||
english: Nanak the meek has entered Your Sanctuary; please, take me in Your embrace. ||2||2||153||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਊ ਬਿਖਮ ਗਾਰ ਤੋਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kooo bikham gaar torai ||
english: Who can destroy the fortress of sin,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਧੋਹ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aas piaas dhoh moh bharam hee te horai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and release me from hope, thirst, deception, attachment and doubt? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਾਨ ਇਹ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਛੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh maan ih biaadh chhorai ||1||
english: How can I escape the afflictions of sexual desire, anger, greed and pride? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g naam ra(n)g gun govi(n)d gaavau ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, love the Naam, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
transliteration: anadino prabh dhiaavau ||
english: Night and day, meditate on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਮਿਟਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: bhram bheet jeet mitaavau ||
english: I have captured and demolished the walls of doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: nidh naam naanak morai ||2||3||154||
english: O Nanak, the Naam is my only treasure. ||2||3||154||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh tiaag ||
english: Renounce sexual desire, anger and greed;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: man simar gobi(n)d naam ||
english: remember the Name of the Lord of the Universe in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਸਫਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bhajan saphal kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditation on the Lord is the only fruitful action. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: taj maan moh vikaar mithiaa jap raam raam raam ||
english: Renounce pride, attachment, corruption and falsehood, and chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੈ ਚਰਨਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man sa(n)tanaa kai charan laag ||1||
english: O mortal, attach yourself to the Feet of the Saints. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh gopaal deen daiaal patit paavan paarabraham har charan simar jaag ||
english: God is the Sustainer of the world, Merciful to the meek, the Purifier of sinners, the Transcendent Lord God. Awaken, and meditate on His Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੫੫॥
transliteration: kar bhagat naanak pooran bhaag ||2||4||155||
english: Perform His devotional worship, O Nanak, and your destiny shall be fulfilled. ||2||4||155||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਅਨੰਦੀ ਖੇਲੁ ਰੀ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: harakh sog bairaag ana(n)dee khel ree dikhaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Pleasure and pain, detachment and ecstasy - the Lord has revealed His Play. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਭੈ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: khinahoo(n) bhai nirabhai khinahoo(n) khinahoo(n) uth dhaaio ||
english: One moment, the mortal is in fear, and the next moment he is fearless; in a moment, he gets up and departs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਨ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਖਿਨਹੂ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khinahoo(n) ras bhogan khinahoo(n) khinahoo taj jaaio ||1||
english: One moment, he enjoys pleasures, and the next moment, he leaves and goes away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਜੋਗ ਤਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਭਰਮਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: khinahoo(n) jog taap bahu poojaa khinahoo(n) bharamaaio ||
english: One moment, he practices Yoga and intense meditation, and all sorts of worship; the next moment, he wanders in doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੫੬॥
transliteration: khinahoo(n) kirapaa saadhoo sa(n)g naanak har ra(n)g laaio ||2||5||156||
english: One moment, O Nanak, the Lord bestows His Mercy and blesses him with His Love, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||5||156||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੭ ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 5 ghar 17 aasaavaree ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Seventeenth House, Aasaavaree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d gobi(n)d kar haa(n) ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: har har man piaar haa(n) ||
english: Cherish the Beloved Lord, Har, Har, in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: gur kahiaa s chit dhar haa(n) ||
english: The Guru says to install it in your consciousness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਤੋਰਿ ਫੇਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: an siu tor pher haa(n) ||
english: Turn away from others, and turn to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aise laalan paaio ree sakhee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Thus you shall obtain your Beloved, O my companion. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਕਜ ਮੋਹ ਸਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)kaj moh sar haa(n) ||
english: In the pool of the world is the mud of attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: pag nahee chalai har haa(n) ||
english: Stuck in it, his feet cannot walk towards the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਡਿਓ ਮੂੜ ਨਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: gahadio mooR nar haa(n) ||
english: The fool is stuck;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: anin upaav kar haa(n) ||
english: he cannot do anything else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੈ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tau nikasai saran pai ree sakhee ||1||
english: Only by entering the Lord's Sanctuary, O my companion, will you be released. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰ ਥਿਰ ਚਿਤ ਥਿਰ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: thir thir chit thir haa(n) ||
english: Thus your consciousness shall be stable and steady and firm.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: ban grihu samasar haa(n) ||
english: Wilderness and household are the same.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕ ਪਿਰ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar ek pir haa(n) ||
english: Deep within dwells the One Husband Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਧਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: baahar anek dhar haa(n) ||
english: outwardly, there are many distractions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਨ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: raajan jog kar haa(n) ||
english: Practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੋਗ ਅਲੋਗੀ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੫੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak log alogee ree sakhee ||2||1||157||
english: Says Nanak, this is the way to dwell with the people, and yet remain apart from them. ||2||1||157||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਏਕ ਮਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: manasaa ek maan haa(n) ||
english: Cherish one desire only:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਤ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: gur siu net dhiaan haa(n) ||
english: meditate continually on the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਤ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: driR sa(n)t ma(n)t giaan haa(n) ||
english: Install the wisdom of the Saints' Mantra.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: sevaa gur charaan haa(n) ||
english: Serve the Feet of the Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tau mileeai gur kripaan mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and you shall meet Him, by Guru's Grace, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੇ ਅਨ ਭਰਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: toote an bharaan haa(n) ||
english: All doubts are dispelled,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: ravio sarab thaan haa(n) ||
english: and the Lord is seen to be pervading all places.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਹਿਓ ਜਮ ਭਇਆਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: lahio jam bhaiaan haa(n) ||
english: The fear of death is dispelled,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਓ ਪੇਡ ਥਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: paaio ped thaan haa(n) ||
english: and the primal place is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਚੂਕੀ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tau chookee sagal kaan ||1||
english: Then, all subservience is removed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਹਨੋ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਥਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: lahano jis mathaan haa(n) ||
english: One who has such destiny recorded upon his forehead, obtains it;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਪਾਵਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: bhai paavak paar paraan haa(n) ||
english: he crosses over the terrifying ocean of fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਥਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: nij ghar tisahi thaan haa(n) ||
english: He obtains a place in the home of his own self,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਰਸਹਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: har ras rasahi maan haa(n) ||
english: and enjoys the most sublime essence of the Lord's essence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਥੀ ਤਿਸ ਭੁਖਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: laathee tis bhukhaan haa(n) ||
english: His hunger is appeased;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੮॥
transliteration: naanak sahaj samaaio re manaa ||2||2||158||
english: Nanak, he is absorbed in celestial peace, O my mind. ||2||2||158||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: har har har gunee haa(n) ||
english: Sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪੀਐ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: japeeai sahaj dhunee haa(n) ||
english: Meditate on the celestial music.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਰਸਨ ਭਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo rasan bhanee haa(n) ||
english: The tongues of the holy Saints repeat it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੂਟਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੁਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: chhootan bidh sunee haa(n) ||
english: I have heard that this is the way to emancipation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡ ਪੁਨੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paaeeai vad punee mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This is found by the greatest merit, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਹਿ ਜਨ ਮੁਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: khojahi jan munee haa(n) ||
english: The silent sages search for Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਬ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: srab kaa prabh dhanee haa(n) ||
english: God is the Master of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਕਲਿ ਦੁਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: dulabh kal dunee haa(n) ||
english: It is so difficult to find Him in this world, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: dookh binaasanee haa(n) ||
english: He is the Dispeller of distress.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਨੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh pooran aasanee mere manaa ||1||
english: God is the Fulfiller of desires, O my mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸੋ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: man so seveeai haa(n) ||
english: O my mind, serve Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵੀਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: alakh abheveeai haa(n) ||
english: He is unknowable and inscrutable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: taa(n) siu preet kar haa(n) ||
english: Enshrine love for Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: binas na jaai mar haa(n) ||
english: He does not perish, or go away, or die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: gur te jaaniaa haa(n) ||
english: He is known only through the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੫੯॥
transliteration: naanak man maaniaa mere manaa ||2||3||159||
english: Nanak, my mind is satisfied with the Lord, O my mind. ||2||3||159||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਓਟ ਗਹੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: ekaa ot gahu haa(n) ||
english: Grab hold of the Support of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਹੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad kahu haa(n) ||
english: Chant the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆ ਸਤਿ ਸਹੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: aagiaa sat sahu haa(n) ||
english: Submit to the Order of the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਲਹੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: manahi nidhaan lahu haa(n) ||
english: Receive the treasure in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਹਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukhahi samaaeeai mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Thus you shall be absorbed in peace, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: jeevat jo marai haa(n) ||
english: One who is dead while yet alive,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤਰੁ ਸੋ ਤਰੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: dutar so tarai haa(n) ||
english: crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: sabh kee ren hoi haa(n) ||
english: One who becomes the dust of all

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਹਉ ਸੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau kahau soi haa(n) ||
english: he alone is called fearless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸਿਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: mite a(n)desiaa haa(n) ||
english: His anxieties are removed

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t upadesiaa mere manaa ||1||
english: by the Teachings of the Saints, O my mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: jis jan naam sukh haa(n) ||
english: That humble being, who takes happiness in the Naam, the Name of the Lord

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: tis nikat na kade dukh haa(n) ||
english: pain never draws near him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: jo har har jas sune haa(n) ||
english: One who listens to the Praise of the Lord, Har, Har,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko tis ma(n)ne haa(n) ||
english: is obeyed by all men.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: saphal s aaiaa haa(n) ||
english: How fortunate it is that he came into the world;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੬੦॥
transliteration: naanak prabh bhaaiaa mere manaa ||2||4||160||
english: Nanak, he is pleasing to God, O my mind. ||2||4||160||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: mil har jas gaaeeai haa(n) ||
english: Meeting together, let us sing the Praises of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: param pad paaeeai haa(n) ||
english: and attain the supreme state.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਰਸ ਜੋ ਬਿਧੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: uaa ras jo bidhe haa(n) ||
english: Those who obtain that sublime essence,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਧੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: taa kau sagal sidhe haa(n) ||
english: obtain all of the spiritual powers of the Siddhas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: anadin jaagiaa haa(n) ||
english: They remain awake and aware night and day;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਡਭਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naanak badabhaagiaa mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Nanak, they are blessed by great good fortune, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪਗ ਧੋਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t pag dhoeeai haa(n) ||
english: Let us wash the feet of the Saints;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: duramat khoeeai haa(n) ||
english: our evil-mindedness shall be cleansed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਹ ਰੇਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: daasah ren hoi haa(n) ||
english: Becoming the dust of the feet of the Lord's slaves,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: biaapai dukh na koi haa(n) ||
english: one shall not be afflicted with pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾਂ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa(n) saran par haa(n) ||
english: Taking to the Sanctuary of His devotees,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਮਰੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: janam na kade mar haa(n) ||
english: he is no longer subject to birth and death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸੇ ਭਏ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: asathir se bhae haa(n) ||
english: They alone become eternal,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਜਪਿ ਲਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har jinh jap lae mere manaa ||1||
english: who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: saajan meet too(n) haa(n) ||
english: You are my Friend, my Best Friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਮੂੰ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: naam driRaai moo(n) haa(n) ||
english: Please, implant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: tis bin naahi koi haa(n) ||
english: Without Him, there is not any other.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਸੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: manahi araadh soi haa(n) ||
english: Within my mind, I worship Him in adoration.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: nimakh na veesarai haa(n) ||
english: I do not forget Him, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਸਰੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: tis bin kiu sarai haa(n) ||
english: How can I live without Him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਜਾਉ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: gur kau kurabaan jaau haa(n) ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੬੧॥
transliteration: naanak jape naau mere manaa ||2||5||161||
english: Nanak, chant the Name, O my mind. ||2||5||161||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਤੂੰ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: kaaran karan too(n) haa(n) ||
english: You are the Creator, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾ ਸੁਝੈ ਮੂੰ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: avar naa sujhai moo(n) haa(n) ||
english: I cannot think of any other.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: karahi s hoeeai haa(n) ||
english: Whatever You do, comes to pass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: sahaj sukh soeeai haa(n) ||
english: I sleep in peace and poise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੀਰਜ ਮਨਿ ਭਏ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: dheeraj man bhae haa(n) ||
english: My mind has become patient,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਪਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh kai dar pae mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: since I fell at God's Door, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਮੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)game haa(n) ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਸੰਜਮੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: pooran sa(n)jame haa(n) ||
english: I gained perfect control over my senses.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੇ ਆਪ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: jab te chhute aap haa(n) ||
english: Ever since I rid myself of my self-conceit,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਤਾਪ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: tab te mite taap haa(n) ||
english: my sufferings have ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa dhaareeaa haa(n) ||
english: He has showered His Mercy upon me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਰਖੁ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pat rakh banavaareeaa mere manaa ||1||
english: The Creator Lord has preserved my honor, O my mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: ihu sukh jaaneeai haa(n) ||
english: Know that this is the only peace;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: har kare s maaneeai haa(n) ||
english: accept whatever the Lord does.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)daa naahi koi haa(n) ||
english: No one is bad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kee ren hoi haa(n) ||
english: Become the dust of the Feet of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਖੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: aape jis rakhai haa(n) ||
english: He Himself preserves those

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੋ ਚਖੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har a(n)mrit so chakhai mere manaa ||2||
english: who taste the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, O my mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa naahi koi haa(n) ||
english: One who has no one to call his own

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa prabhoo soi haa(n) ||
english: God belongs to him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: a(n)taragat bujhai haa(n) ||
english: God knows the state of our innermost being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਝੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh tis sujhai haa(n) ||
english: He knows everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: patit udhaar lehu haa(n) ||
english: Please, Lord, save the sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਏਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੬੨॥
transliteration: naanak aradaas ehu mere manaa ||3||6||162||
english: This is Nanak's prayer, O my mind. ||3||6||162||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਇਕਤੁਕਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 5 ikatukaa ||
english: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl, Ek-Thukay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: oi paradeseeaa haa(n) ||
english: O my stranger soul,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਤ ਸੰਦੇਸਿਆ ਹਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sunat sa(n)desiaa haa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: listen to the call. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: jaa siu rach rahe haa(n) ||
english: Whatever you are attached to,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਉ ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: sabh kau taj gae haa(n) ||
english: you shall have to leave it all behind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਭਏ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: supanaa jiu bhae haa(n) ||
english: These things seem like only a dream,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੑਿ ਲਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har naam jinhi lae ||1||
english: to one who takes the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਜਿ ਅਨ ਲਗੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: har taj an lage haa(n) ||
english: Forsaking the Lord, and clinging to another,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਭਗੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: janamahi mar bhage haa(n) ||
english: they run toward death and reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਿ ਲਹੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: har har jan lahe haa(n) ||
english: But those humble beings, who attach themselves to the Lord, Har, Har,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਸੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: jeevat se rahe haa(n) ||
english: continue to live.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: jisahi kripaal hoi haa(n) ||
english: One who is blessed with the Lord's Mercy,

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: naanak bhagat soi ||2||7||163||232||
english: O Nanak, becomes His devotee. ||2||7||163||232||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 9 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਹਉ ਕਉਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: birathaa kahau kaun siu man kee ||
english: Who should I tell the condition of the mind?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ ਦਸ ਹੂ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਤ ਆਸਾ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਧਨ ਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: lobh grasio das hoo dis dhaavat aasaa laagio dhan kee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Engrossed in greed, running around in the ten directions, you hold to your hopes of wealth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਤ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਤ ਜਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: sukh kai het bahut dukh paavat sev karat jan jan kee ||
english: For the sake of pleasure, you suffer such great pain, and you have to serve each and every person.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਰਹਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਸੁਆਨ ਜਿਉ ਡੋਲਤ ਨਹ ਸੁਧ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: duaarahi duaar suaan jiu dolat nah sudh raam bhajan kee ||1||
english: You wander from door to door like a dog, unconscious of the Lord's meditation. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਖੋਵਤ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਲੋਕ ਹਸਨ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: maanas janam akaarath khovat laaj na lok hasan kee ||
english: You lose this human life in vain, and You are not even ashamed when others laugh at you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਿਉ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਤ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਤਨ ਕੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੩੩॥
transliteration: naanak har jas kiu nahee gaavat kumat binaasai tan kee ||2||1||233||
english: O Nanak, why not sing the Lord's Praises, so that you may be rid of the body's evil disposition? ||2||1||233||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 asatapadeeaa ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਤਰਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਨੑਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: utar avaghat saravar nhaavai ||
english: He descends the treacherous precipice, to bathe in the cleansing pool;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਕੈ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bakai na bolai har gun gaavai ||
english: without speaking or saying anything, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲੁ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jal aakaasee su(n)n samaavai ||
english: Like water vapor in the sky, he remains absorbed in the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸੁ ਸਤੁ ਝੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ras sat jhol mahaa ras paavai ||1||
english: He churns the true pleasures to obtain the supreme nectar. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਅਭ ਮੋਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa giaan sunahu abh more ||
english: Listen to such spiritual wisdom, O my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਉਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bharipur dhaar rahiaa sabh thaure ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord is totally pervading and permeating all places. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਨੇਮੁ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sach brat nem na kaal sa(n)taavai ||
english: One who makes Truthfulness his fast and religious vows, does not suffer the pain of death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sabad karodh jalaavai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he burns away his anger.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gagan nivaas samaadh lagaavai ||
english: He dwells in the Tenth Gate, immersed in the Samaadhi of deep meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paaras paras param pad paavai ||2||
english: Touching the philosopher's stone, he obtains the supreme status. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sach man kaaran tat bilovai ||
english: For the benefit of the mind, churn the true essence of reality;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭਰ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: subhar saravar mail na dhovai ||
english: bathing in the over-flowing tank of nectar, filth is washed away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jai siu raataa taiso hovai ||
english: We become like the One with whom we are imbued.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape karataa kare s hovai ||3||
english: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਹਿਵ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur hiv seetal agan bujhaavai ||
english: The Guru is cool and soothing like ice; He puts out the fire of the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਚੜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sevaa surat bibhoot chaRaavai ||
english: Smear your body with the ashes of dedicated service,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: darasan aap sahaj ghar aavai ||
english: and live in the home of peace - make this your religious order.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: niramal baanee naad vajaavai ||4||
english: Let the Immaculate Bani of the Word be your playing of the flute. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar giaan mahaa ras saaraa ||
english: Spiritual wisdom within is the supreme, sublime nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: teerath majan gur veechaaraa ||
english: Contemplation of the Guru is one's bathing at holy places of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar poojaa thaan muraaraa ||
english: Worship and adoration within is the Lord's dwelling.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jotee jot milaavanahaaraa ||5||
english: He is the One who blends one's light with the Divine Light. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿਆ ਮਤਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ras rasiaa mat ekai bhaai ||
english: He delights in the delightful wisdom of loving the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਖਤ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਪੰਚ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: takhat nivaasee pa(n)ch samaai ||
english: He is one of the self-elect - he merges with the Lord, who occupies the throne.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaar kamaaee khasam rajaai ||
english: He performs his works in obedience to the Will of his Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਨਾਥੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: avigat naath na lakhiaa jaai ||6||
english: The Unknowable Lord cannot be understood. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jal mahi upajai jal te door ||
english: The lotus originates in the water, and yet it remains distinct from the water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jal mahi jot rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: Just so, the Divine Light pervades and permeates the water of the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kis neRai kis aakhaa door ||
english: Who is near, and who is far away?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਧਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: nidh gun gaavaa dekh hadoor ||7||
english: I sing the Glories of the Lord, the treasure of virtue; I behold Him ever-present. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar avar na koi ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, there is none other than Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so phun hoi ||
english: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sun bharathar naanak kahai beechaar ||
english: Listen, O Bharthari Yogi - Nanak speaks after deliberation;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: niramal naam meraa aadhaar ||8||1||
english: the Immaculate Name is my only Support. ||8||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ ਸਭ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh jap sabh tap sabh chaturaaee ||
english: All meditation, all austerities, and all clever tricks,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਝੜਿ ਭਰਮੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: oojhaR bharamai raahi na paaee ||
english: lead one to wander in the wilderness, but he does not find the Path.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕੋ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin boojhe ko thaai na paaee ||
english: Without understanding, he is not approved;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਣੈ ਮਾਥੇ ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam bihoonai maathe chhaaee ||1||
english: without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, ashes are thrown upon one's head. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਧਣੀ ਜਗੁ ਆਇ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: saach dhanee jag aai binaasaa ||
english: True is the Master; the world comes and goes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੂਟਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chhootas praanee guramukh daasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The mortal is emancipated, as Gurmukh, as the Lord's slave. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jag mohi baadhaa bahutee aasaa ||
english: The world is bound by its attachments to the many desires.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਇਕਿ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: guramatee ik bhae udaasaa ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, some become free of desire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar naam kamal paragaasaa ||
english: Within them is the Naam, and their heart lotus blossoms forth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tinh kau naahee jam kee traasaa ||2||
english: They have no fear of death. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jag tri jit kaaman hitakaaree ||
english: The men of the world are conquered by woman; they love the ladies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਲਗਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr lag naam visaaree ||
english: Attached to children and wife, they forget the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: birathaa janam gavaaiaa baajee haaree ||
english: They waste this human life in vain, and lose the game in the gamble.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur seve karanee saaree ||3||
english: Serving the True Guru is the best occupation. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: baaharahu haumai kahai kahaae ||
english: One who speaks egotistically in public,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)darahu mukat lep kade na laae ||
english: never attains liberation within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu gur sabad jalaae ||
english: One who burns away his attachment to Maya, by the Word of the Guru's Shabad,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: niramal naam sad hiradai dhiaae ||4||
english: meditates forever within his heart on the Immaculate Naam. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat raakhai thaak rahaae ||
english: He restrains his wandering mind, and keeps it under control.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sikh sa(n)gat karam milaae ||
english: The company of such a Sikh is obtained only by Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭੂਲੋ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur bin bhoolo aavai jaae ||
english: Without the Guru, he goes astray and continues coming and going.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: nadar kare sa(n)jog milaae ||5||
english: Bestowing His Mercy, the Lord unites him in Union. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੂੜੋ ਕਹਉ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: rooRo kahau na kahiaa jaaee ||
english: I cannot describe the Beauteous Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਉ ਨਹ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: akath kathau nah keemat paaee ||
english: I speak the unspoken; I cannot estimate His value.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੂਖ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh dukh tere sookh rajaaee ||
english: All pain and pleasure come by Your Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sabh dukh mete saachai naaee ||6||
english: All pain is eradicated by the True Name. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਗ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kar bin vaajaa pag bin taalaa ||
english: He plays the instrument without hands, and dances without feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: je sabad bujhai taa sach nihaalaa ||
english: But if he understands the Word of the Shabad, then he shall behold the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar saach sabhe sukh naalaa ||
english: With the True Lord within the self, all happiness comes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: nadar kare raakhai rakhavaalaa ||7||
english: Showering His Mercy, the Preserving Lord preserves him. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੂਝੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tribhavan soojhai aap gavaavai ||
english: He understands the three worlds; he eliminates his self-conceit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: baanee boojhai sach samaavai ||
english: He understands the Bani of the Word, and he is absorbed into the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad veechaare ek liv taaraa ||
english: Contemplating the Shabad, he enshrines love for the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak dha(n)n savaaranahaaraa ||8||2||
english: O Nanak, blessed is the Lord, the Embellisher. ||8||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖ ਅਸੰਖ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: lekh asa(n)kh likh likh maan ||
english: There are innumerable writings; those who write them take pride in them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਖਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: man maaniai sach surat vakhaan ||
english: When one's mind accepts the Truth, he understands, and speaks of it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kathanee badanee paR paR bhaar ||
english: Words, spoken and read again and again, are useless loads.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lekh asa(n)kh alekh apaar ||1||
english: There are innumerable writings, but the Infinite Lord remains unwritten. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aisaa saachaa too(n) eko jaan ||
english: Know that such a True Lord is the One and only.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa hukam pachhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Understand that birth and death come according to the Lord's Will. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਾ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi jag baadhaa jamakaal ||
english: Because of attachment to Maya, the world is bound by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਂਧਾ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: baa(n)dhaa chhootai naam samhaal ||
english: These bonds are released when one remembers the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: gur sukhadaataa avar na bhaal ||
english: The Guru is the Giver of peace; do not look for any other.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: halat palat nibahee tudh naal ||2||
english: In this world, and the next, He shall stand by you. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾਂ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabad marai taa(n) ek liv laae ||
english: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, embraces love for the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਤਾਂ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: achar charai taa(n) bharam chukaae ||
english: One who eats the uneatable, has his doubts dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jeevan mukat man naam vasaae ||
english: He is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive; the Naam abides in his mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh hoi ta sach samaae ||3||
english: Becoming Gurmukh, he merges into the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਧਰ ਸਾਜੀ ਗਗਨੁ ਅਕਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jin dhar saajee gagan akaas ||
english: The One who created the earth and the Akaashic ethers of the sky,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭ ਥਾਪੀ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: jin sabh thaapee thaap uthaap ||
english: established all; He establishes and disestablishes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: sarab nira(n)tar aape aap ||
english: He Himself is permeating all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਪੂਛੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kisai na poochhe bakhase aap ||4||
english: He does not consult anyone; He Himself forgives. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: too pur saagar maanak heer ||
english: You are the Ocean, over-flowing with jewels and rubies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: too niramal sach gunee gaheer ||
english: You are immaculate and pure, the true treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sukh maanai bhetai gur peer ||
english: Peace is enjoyed, meeting the Guru, the Spiritual Teacher.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਵਜੀਰੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: eko saahib ek vajeer ||5||
english: The Lord is the only Master; He is the only Minister. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਬੰਦੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਹਉ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jag ba(n)dee mukate hau maaree ||
english: The world is held in bondage; he alone is emancipated, who conquers his ego.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jag giaanee viralaa aachaaree ||
english: How rare in the world is that wise person, who practices this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jag pa(n)dit viralaa veechaaree ||
english: How rare in this world is that scholar who reflects upon this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bin satigur bhete sabh phirai aha(n)kaaree ||6||
english: Without meeting the True Guru, all wander in ego. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jag dukheeaa sukheeaa jan koi ||
english: The world is unhappy; only a few are happy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਗੁਣ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jag rogee bhogee gun roi ||
english: The world is diseased, from its indulgences; it weeps over its lost virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jag upajai binasai pat khoi ||
english: The world wells up, and then subsides, losing its honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai boojhai soi ||7||
english: He alone, who becomes Gurmukh, understands. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਘੋ ਮੋਲਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਅਫਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mahagho mol bhaar aphaar ||
english: His price is so costly; His weight is unbearable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਟਲ ਅਛਲੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: atal achhal guramatee dhaar ||
english: He is immovable and undeceivable; enshrine Him in your mind, through the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਭਇਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhaai milai bhaavai bhaikaar ||
english: Meet Him through love, become pleasing to Him, and act in fear of Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak neech kahai beechaar ||8||3||
english: Nanak the lowly says this, after deep contemplation. ||8||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਮਰੈ ਪੰਚੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ek marai pa(n)che mil rovahi ||
english: When someone dies, the five passions meet and mourn his death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai jaai sabad mal dhovahi ||
english: Overcoming self-conceit, he washes off his filth with the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਮਝਿ ਸੂਝਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: samajh soojh sahaj ghar hovahi ||
english: One who knows and understands, enters the home of peace and poise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਗਲੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin boojhe sagalee pat khovahi ||1||
english: Without understanding, he loses all his honor. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਮਰੈ ਕਉਣੁ ਰੋਵੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kaun marai kaun rovai ohee ||
english: Who dies, and who weeps for him?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਭਸੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੋਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran sabhasai sir tohee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Lord, Creator, Cause of causes, You are over the heads of all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਰੋਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mooe kau rovai dukh koi ||
english: Who weeps over the pain of the dead?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਰੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੇਦਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: so rovai jis bedan hoi ||
english: Those who weep, do so over their own troubles.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੀਤੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis beetee jaanai prabh soi ||
english: God knows the condition of those who are so affected.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape karataa kare s hoi ||2||
english: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਣਾ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jeevat maranaa taare taranaa ||
english: One who remains dead while yet alive, is saved, and saves others as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jai jagadees param gat saranaa ||
english: Celebrate the Victory of the Lord; taking to His Sanctuary, the supreme status is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur charanaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the feet of the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੈ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur bohith sabad bhai taranaa ||3||
english: The Guru is the boat; through the Shabad of His Word, the terrifying world-ocean is crossed over. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau aap nira(n)tar jot ||
english: He Himself is Fearless; His Divine Light is contained in all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਜਗਿ ਛੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai sootak jag chhot ||
english: Without the Name, the world is defiled and untouchable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਰੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: duramat binasai kiaa kahi rot ||
english: Through evil-mindedness, they are ruined; why should they cry out and weep?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮੂਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰੋਤਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: janam mooe bin bhagat sarot ||4||
english: They are born only to die, without hearing the music of devotional worship. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: mooe kau sach rovahi meet ||
english: Only one's true friends mourn one's death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: trai gun rovahi neetaa neet ||
english: Those under the sway of the three dispositions continue to mourn on and on.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਚੀਤ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh parahar sahaj sucheet ||
english: Disregarding pain and pleasure, center your consciousness on the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: tan man saupau krisan pareet ||5||
english: Dedicate your body and mind to the Love of the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖ ॥
transliteration: bheetar ek anek asa(n)kh ||
english: The One Lord dwells within the various and countless beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਖ ਅਸੰਖ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam bahu sa(n)kh asa(n)kh ||
english: There are so many rituals and religious faiths, their number is innumerable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰੰਥ ॥
transliteration: bin bhai bhagatee janam bira(n)th ||
english: Without the Fear of God, and devotional worship, one's life is in vain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਰਮਾਰੰਥ ॥੬॥
transliteration: har gun gaavahi mil paramaara(n)th ||6||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the supreme wealth is obtained. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਭੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aap marai maare bhee aap ||
english: He Himself dies, and He Himself kills.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aap upaae thaap uthaap ||
english: He Himself establishes, and having established, disestablishes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: srisat upaaee jotee too jaat ||
english: He created the Universe, and by His Divine Nature, instilled His Divine Light into it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sabad veechaar milan nahee bhraat ||7||
english: One who reflects upon the Word of the Shabad, meets the Lord, without doubt. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sootak agan bhakhai jag khaai ||
english: Pollution is the burning fire, which is consuming the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sootak jal thal sabh hee thaai ||
english: Pollution is in the water, upon the land, and everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਤਕਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: naanak sootak janam mareejai ||
english: O Nanak, people are born and die in pollution.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੪॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har ras peejai ||8||4||
english: By Guru's Grace, they drink in the Lord's sublime elixir. ||8||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ਸੁ ਪਰਖੇ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aap veechaarai s parakhe heeraa ||
english: One who contemplates his own self, tests the worth of the jewel.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ek drisat taare gur pooraa ||
english: With a single glance, the Perfect Guru saves him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur maanai man te man dheeraa ||1||
english: When the Guru is pleased, one's mind comforts itself. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਰਾਫੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aisaa saahu saraaphee karai ||
english: He is such a banker, who tests us.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saachee nadar ek liv tarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By His True Glance of Grace, we are blessed with the Love of the One Lord, and are saved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: poo(n)jee naam nira(n)jan saar ||
english: The capital of the Naam is immaculate and sublime.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤਾ ਪੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: niramal saach rataa paikaar ||
english: That peddler is rendered pure, who is imbued with the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: siphat sahaj ghar gur karataar ||2||
english: Praising the Lord, in the house of poise, he attains the Guru, the Creator. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa sabad jalaae ||
english: One who burns away hope and desire through the Word of the Shabad,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: raam naraain kahai kahaae ||
english: chants the Lord's Name, and inspires others to chant it as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵਾਟ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur te vaat mahal ghar paae ||3||
english: Through the Guru, he finds the Path home, to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)chan kaaiaa jot anoop ||
english: His body becomes golden, by the Lord's Incomparable Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਦੇਵਾ ਸਗਲ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: tribhavan devaa sagal saroop ||
english: He beholds the divine beauty in all the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਖੂਟੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: mai so dhan palai saach akhoot ||4||
english: That inexhaustible wealth of Truth is now in my lap. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤੀਨਿ ਨਵ ਚਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch teen nav chaar samaavai ||
english: In the five elements, the three worlds, the nine regions and the four directions, the Lord is pervading.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਕਲ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dharan gagan kal dhaar rahaavai ||
english: He supports the earth and the sky, exercising His almighty power.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਉ ਉਲਟਿ ਪਰਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: baahar jaatau ulat paraavai ||5||
english: He turns the outgoing mind around. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਖੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: moorakh hoi na aakhee soojhai ||
english: The fool does not realize what he sees with his eyes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa ras nahee kahiaa boojhai ||
english: He does not taste with his tongue, and does not understand what is said.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਜਗ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bikh kaa maataa jag siu loojhai ||6||
english: Intoxicated with poison, he argues with the world. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ootam sa(n)gat ootam hovai ||
english: In the uplifting society, one is uplifted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਧਾਵੈ ਅਵਗਣ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gun kau dhaavai avagan dhovai ||
english: He chases after virtue and washes off his sins.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin gur seve sahaj na hovai ||7||
english: Without serving the Guru, celestial poise is not obtained. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੀਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: heeraa naam javehar laal ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a diamond, a jewel, a ruby.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: man motee hai tis kaa maal ||
english: The pearl of the mind is the inner wealth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੮॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak parakhai nadar nihaal ||8||5||
english: O Nanak, the Lord tests us, and blesses us with His Glance of Grace. ||8||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh giaan dhiaan man maan ||
english: The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom, meditation and satisfaction of the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh mahalee mahal pachhaan ||
english: The Gurmukh realizes the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh surat sabad neesaan ||1||
english: The Gurmukh is attuned to the Word of the Shabad, as his Insignia. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aise prem bhagat veechaaree ||
english: Such is the loving devotional worship of the Lord's contemplation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saachaa naam muraaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Gurmukh realizes the True Name, the Destroyer of ego. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ahinis niramal thaan suthaan ||
english: Day and night, he remains immaculately pure, and abides in the sublime place.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨ ਭਵਨ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: teen bhavan nihakeval giaan ||
english: He gains the wisdom of the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saache gur te hukam pachhaan ||2||
english: Through the True Guru, the Command of the Lord's Will is realized. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: saachaa harakh naahee tis sog ||
english: He enjoys true pleasure, and suffers no pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit giaan mahaa ras bhog ||
english: He enjoys the ambrosial wisdom, and the highest sublime essence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਮਾਈ ਸੁਖੀ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch samaaee sukhee sabh log ||3||
english: He overcomes the five evil passions, and becomes the happiest of all men. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sagalee jot teraa sabh koee ||
english: Your Divine Light is contained in all; everyone belongs to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape joR vichhoRe soee ||
english: You Yourself join and separate again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aape karataa kare s hoee ||4||
english: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dhaahi usaare hukam samaavai ||
english: He demolishes, and He builds; by His Order, he merges us into Himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hukamo varatai jo tis bhaavai ||
english: Whatever is pleasing to His Will, happens.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur bin pooraa koi na paavai ||5||
english: Without the Guru, no one obtains the Perfect Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲਕ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: baalak biradh na surat paraan ||
english: In childhood and old age, he does not understand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬੂਡੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: bhar joban boodai abhimaan ||
english: In the prime of youth, he is drowned in his pride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਲਹਸਿ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bin naavai kiaa lahas nidaan ||6||
english: Without the Name, what can the fool obtain? ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa an dhan sahaj na jaanaa ||
english: He does not know the One who blesses him with nourishment and wealth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bharam bhulaanaa phir pachhutaanaa ||
english: Deluded by doubt, he later regrets and repents.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਬਉਰਾ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gal phaahee bauraa bauraanaa ||7||
english: The noose of death is around the neck of that crazy madman. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਜਗੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤਉ ਡਰਿ ਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: boodat jag dekhiaa tau dar bhaage ||
english: I saw the world drowning, and I ran away in fear.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur raakhe se vadabhaage ||
english: How very fortunate are those who have been saved by the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੮॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak gur kee charanee laage ||8||6||
english: O Nanak, they are attached to the feet of the Guru. ||8||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੀਤੇ ਚੀਤਿ ਅਨੀਤੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi geete cheet aneete ||
english: They sing religious songs, but their consciousness is wicked.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਸੁਣਾਇ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ਬੀਤੇ ॥
transliteration: raag sunaai kahaavahi beete ||
english: They sing the songs, and call themselves divine,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਅਨੀਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin naavai man jhooth aneete ||1||
english: but without the Name, their minds are false and wicked. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਚਲਹੁ ਮਨ ਰਹਹੁ ਘਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kahaa chalahu man rahahu ghare ||
english: Where are you going? O mind, remain in your own home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਖੋਜਤ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh raam naam tripataase khojat paavahu sahaj hare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Gurmukhs are satisfied with the Lord's Name; searching, they easily find the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh man mohu sareeraa ||
english: Sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment fill the mind and body;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਸੁ ਪੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: lab lobh aha(n)kaar s peeraa ||
english: greed and egotism lead only to pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam naam bin kiu man dheeraa ||2||
english: How can the mind be comforted without the Lord's Name? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar naavan saach pachhaanai ||
english: One who cleanses himself within, knows the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kee gat guramukh jaanai ||
english: The Gurmukh knows the condition of his innermost being.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saach sabad bin mahal na pachhaanai ||3||
english: Without the True Word of the Shabad, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not realized. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nira(n)kaar mahi aakaar samaavai ||
english: One who merges his form into the Formless Lord,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਟਿਕਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: akal kalaa sach saach tikaavai ||
english: abides in the True Lord, the Powerful, beyond power.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: so nar garabh jon nahee aavai ||4||
english: Such a person does not enter into the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾਂ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਹ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jahaa(n) naam milai tah jaau ||
english: Go there, where you may obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee karam kamaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, perform good deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naame raataa har gun gaau ||5||
english: Imbued with the Naam, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te aap pachhaataa ||
english: Serving the Guru, I have come to understand myself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam vasiaa sukhadaataa ||
english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Giver of Peace, abides within my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: anadin baanee naame raataa ||6||
english: Night and day, I am imbued with the Word of the Guru's Bani, and the Naam. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਏ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh laae taa ko laagai ||
english: When my God attaches someone to Him, only then is that person attached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਬਦੇ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: haumai maare sabade jaagai ||
english: Conquering ego, he remains awake to the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aithai othai sadaa sukh aagai ||7||
english: Here and hereafter, he enjoys lasting peace. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: man cha(n)chal bidh naahee jaanai ||
english: The fickle mind does not know the way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mailaa sabad na pachhaanai ||
english: The filthy self-willed manmukh does not understand the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: guramukh niramal naam vakhaanai ||8||
english: The Gurmukh chants the Immaculate Naam. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਗੈ ਕਰੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu aagai karee aradaas ||
english: I offer my prayer to the Lord,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo jan sa(n)gat hoi nivaas ||
english: that I might dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੯॥
transliteration: kilavikh dukh kaate har naam pragaas ||9||
english: There, sins and sufferings are erased, and one is illumined with the Lord's Name. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kar beechaar aachaar paraataa ||
english: In reflective meditation, I have come to love good conduct.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur bachanee eko jaataa ||
english: Through the Word of the True Guru, I recognize the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੧੦॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam man raataa ||10||7||
english: O Nanak, my mind is imbued with the Lord's Name. ||10||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man maigal saakat devaanaa ||
english: The mind of the faithless cynic is like a crazy elephant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਨ ਖੰਡਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਹੈਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ban kha(n)d maaiaa mohi hairaanaa ||
english: It wanders around the forest, distracted by attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਚਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: it ut jaahi kaal ke chaape ||
english: It goes here and there, hounded by death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ਘਰੁ ਆਪੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh khoj lahai ghar aape ||1||
english: The Gurmukh seeks, and finds his own home. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਠਉਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bin gurasabadai man nahee thauraa ||
english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind finds no place of rest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: simarahu raam naam at niramal avar tiaagahu haumai kauraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Remember in meditation the Lord's Name, the most pure and sublime; renounce your bitter egotism. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹਸੀ ॥
transliteration: ihu man mugadh kahahu kiu rahasee ||
english: Tell me, how can this stupid mind be rescued?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਮਝੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਸੀ ॥
transliteration: bin samajhe jam kaa dukh sahasee ||
english: Without understanding, it shall suffer the pains of death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ॥
transliteration: aape bakhase satigur melai ||
english: The Lord Himself forgives us, and unites us with the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਪੇਲੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaal ka(n)tak maare sach pelai ||2||
english: The True Lord conquers and overcomes the tortures of death. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: ihu man karamaa ihu man dharamaa ||
english: This mind commits its deeds of karma, and this mind follows the Dharma.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਤੇ ਜਨਮਾ ॥
transliteration: ihu man pa(n)ch tat te janamaa ||
english: This mind is born of the five elements.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੂੜਾ ॥
transliteration: saakat lobhee ihu man mooRaa ||
english: This foolish mind is perverted and greedy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਮਨੁ ਰੂੜਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh naam japai man rooRaa ||3||
english: Chanting the Naam, the mind of the Gurmukh becomes beautiful. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਅਸਥਾਨੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh man asathaane soee ||
english: The mind of the Gurmukh finds the Lord's home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh tribhavan sojhee hoee ||
english: The Gurmukh comes to know the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu man jogee bhogee tap taapai ||
english: This mind is a Yogi, an enjoyer, a practicer of austerities.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramukh cheenhai har prabh aapai ||4||
english: The Gurmukh understands the Lord God Himself. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
transliteration: man bairaagee haumai tiaagee ||
english: This mind is a detached renunciate, forsaking egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat manasaa dubidhaa laagee ||
english: Desire and duality afflict each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: raam rasaain guramukh chaakhai ||
english: The Gurmukh drinks in the Lord's sublime essence;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: dar ghar mahalee har pat raakhai ||5||
english: at His Door, in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, He preserves his honor. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੂਰ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮਿ ॥
transliteration: ihu man raajaa soor sa(n)graam ||
english: This mind is the king, the hero of cosmic battles.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ॥
transliteration: ihu man nirabhau guramukh naam ||
english: The mind of the Gurmukh becomes fearless through the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੇ ਪੰਚ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਏ ॥
transliteration: maare pa(n)ch apunai vas keee ||
english: Overpowering and subduing the five passions,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਿ ਇਕਤੁ ਥਾਇ ਕੀਏ ॥੬॥
transliteration: haumai graas ikat thaai keee ||6||
english: holding ego in its grip, it confines them to one place. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਗ ਸੁਆਦ ਅਨ ਤਿਆਗੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh raag suaad an tiaage ||
english: The Gurmukh renounces other songs and tastes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ihu man bhagatee jaage ||
english: The mind of the Gurmukh is awakened to devotion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: anahad sun maaniaa sabad veechaaree ||
english: Hearing the unstruck music of the sound current, this mind contemplates the Shabad, and accepts it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨੑਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aatam cheenhi bhae nira(n)kaaree ||7||
english: Understanding itself, this soul becomes attuned to the Formless Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ihu man niramal dar ghar soee ||
english: This mind becomes immaculately pure, in the Court and the Home of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਧੁਨਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat bhaau dhun hoee ||
english: The Gurmukh shows his love through loving devotional worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ahinis har jas gur parasaad ||
english: Night and day, by Guru's Grace, sing the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ॥੮॥
transliteration: ghat ghat so prabh aad jugaad ||8||
english: God dwells in each and every heart, since the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: raam rasaain ihu man maataa ||
english: This mind is intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab rasaain guramukh jaataa ||
english: The Gurmukh realizes the essence of totality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagat het gur charan nivaasaa ||
english: For the sake of devotional worship, he dwells at the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੯॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak har jan ke daasan daasaa ||9||8||
english: Nanak is the humble servant of the slave of the Lord's slaves. ||9||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਧਨੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: tan binasai dhan kaa ko kaheeai ||
english: When the body perishes, whose wealth is it?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਤ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: bin gur raam naam kat laheeai ||
english: Without the Guru, how can the Lord's Name be obtained?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam dhan sa(n)g sakhaaee ||
english: The wealth of the Lord's Name is my Companion and Helper.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ahinis niramal har liv laaee ||1||
english: Night and day, center your loving attention on the Immaculate Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam bin kavan hamaaraa ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, who is ours?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukh dukh sam kar naam na chhodau aape bakhas milaavanahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I look upon pleasure and pain alike; I shall not forsake the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Lord Himself forgives me, and blends me with Himself. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਹੇਤੁ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kanik kaamanee het gavaaraa ||
english: The fool loves gold and women.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa laage naam visaaraa ||
english: Attached to duality, he has forgotten the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਬਖਸਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis too(n) bakhasahi naam japaai ||
english: O Lord, he alone chants the Naam, whom You have forgiven.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਸਕੈ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: doot na laag sakai gun gaai ||2||
english: Death cannot touch one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: har gur daataa raam gupaalaa ||
english: The Lord, the Guru, is the Giver; the Lord, the Sustainer of the World.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakh daiaalaa ||
english: If it is pleasing to Your Will, please preserve me, O Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh raam merai man bhaaiaa ||
english: As Gurmukh, my mind is pleased with the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: rog mite dukh thaak rahaaiaa ||3||
english: My diseases are cured, and my pains are taken away. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਤੰਤ ਨ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: avar na aukhadh ta(n)t na ma(n)taa ||
english: There is no other medicine, Tantric charm or mantra.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har har simaran kilavikh ha(n)taa ||
english: Meditative remembrance upon the Lord, Har, Har, destroys sins.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aap bhulaavahi naam visaar ||
english: You Yourself cause us to stray from the path, and forget the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: too(n) aape raakhahi kirapaa dhaar ||4||
english: Showering Your Mercy, You Yourself save us. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: rog bharam bhed man doojaa ||
english: The mind is diseased with doubt, superstition and duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਜਪੁ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: gur bin bharam japahi jap doojaa ||
english: Without the Guru, it dwells in doubt, and contemplates duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਨ ਦੇਖਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aad purakh gur daras na dekhahi ||
english: The Guru reveals the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Primal Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
