gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਿ ਲੇਖਹਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: vin gurasabadai janam k lekhahi ||5||
english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, what use is human life? ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: dekh acharaj rahe bisamaad ||
english: Beholding the Marvellous Lord, I am wonder-struck and astonished.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat sur nar sahaj samaadh ||
english: In each and every heart, of the angels and holy men, He dwells in celestial Samaadhi.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: bharipur dhaar rahe man maahee ||
english: I have enshrined the All-pervading Lord within my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: tum samasar avar ko naahee ||6||
english: There is no one else equal to You. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee bhagat het mukh naam ||
english: For the sake of devotional worship, we chant Your Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t bhagat kee sa(n)gat raam ||
english: The Lord's devotees dwell in the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan tore sahaj dhiaan ||
english: Breaking his bonds, one comes to meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: chhootai guramukh har gur giaan ||7||
english: The Gurmukhs are emancipated, by the Guru-given knowledge of the Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਦੂਖੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: naa jamadoot dookh tis laagai ||
english: The Messenger of Death cannot touch him with pain;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jo jan raam naam liv jaagai ||
english: the Lord's humble servant remains awake to the Love of the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal bhagataa har sa(n)g ||
english: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He dwells with His devotees.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੮॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak mukat bhae har ra(n)g ||8||9||
english: O Nanak, they are liberated, through the Love of the Lord. ||8||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਇਕਤੁਕੀ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ikatukee ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl, Ik-Tukee:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: gur seve so thaakur jaanai ||
english: One who serves the Guru, knows his Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dookh mitai sach sabad pachhaanai ||1||
english: His pains are erased, and he realizes the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਖੀ ਸਖੈਨੀ ॥
transliteration: raam japahu meree sakhee sakhainee ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, O my friends and companions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੈਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev dekhahu prabh nainee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Serving the True Guru, you shall behold God with your eyes. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan maat pitaa sa(n)saar ||
english: People are entangled with mother, father and the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਸੁਤ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan sut ka(n)niaa ar naar ||2||
english: They are entangled with sons, daughters and spouses. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਹਉ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan karam dharam hau keeaa ||
english: They are entangled with religious rituals, and religious faith, acting in ego.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan put kalat man beeaa ||3||
english: They are entangled with sons, wives and others in their minds. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਿਰਖੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਰਸਾਨ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan kirakhee karahi kirasaan ||
english: The farmers are entangled by farming.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਡੰਨੁ ਸਹੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨ ॥੪॥
transliteration: haumai da(n)n sahai raajaa ma(n)gai daan ||4||
english: People suffer punishment in ego, and the Lord King exacts the penalty from them. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਸਉਦਾ ਅਣਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan saudaa anaveechaaree ||
english: They are entangled in trade without contemplation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਪਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: tipat naahee maaiaa moh pasaaree ||5||
english: They are not satisfied by attachment to the expanse of Maya. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਸਾਹ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan saah sa(n)chahi dhan jaai ||
english: They are entangled with that wealth, amassed by bankers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਥਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bin har bhagat na pavaee thaai ||6||
english: Without devotion to the Lord, they do not become acceptable. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan bed baad aha(n)kaar ||
english: They are entangled with the Vedas, religious discussions and egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan binasai moh vikaar ||7||
english: They are entangled, and perish in attachment and corruption. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam saranaaee ||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੧੦॥
transliteration: satigur raakhe ba(n)dh na paaee ||8||10||
english: One who is saved by the True Guru, does not suffer entanglement. ||8||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 asatapadeeaa ghar 3 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Third House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪਟੀਆ ਮਾਂਗੀ ਪਾਇ ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jin sir sohan pateeaa maa(n)gee paai sa(n)dhoor ||
english: Those heads adorned with braided hair, with their parts painted with vermillion

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਿਰ ਕਾਤੀ ਮੁੰਨੀਅਨੑਿ ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਵੈ ਧੂੜਿ ॥
transliteration: se sir kaatee mu(n)neeanhi gal vich aavai dhooR ||
english: those heads were shaved with scissors, and their throats were choked with dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਦੀਆ ਹੁਣਿ ਬਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲਨੑਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mahalaa a(n)dar hodeeaa hun bahan na milanhi hadoor ||1||
english: They lived in palatial mansions, but now, they cannot even sit near the palaces. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਬਾਬਾ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: aades baabaa aades ||
english: Hail to You, O Father Lord, Hail to You!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਵੇਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aad purakh teraa a(n)t na paaiaa kar kar dekhahi ves ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Primal Lord. Your limits are not known; You create, and create, and behold the scenes. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਦਹੁ ਸੀਆ ਵੀਆਹੀਆ ਲਾੜੇ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jadahu seeaa veeaaheeaa laaRe sohan paas ||
english: When they were married, their husbands looked so handsome beside them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੀਡੋਲੀ ਚੜਿ ਆਈਆ ਦੰਦ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਤੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: heedolee chaR aaeeaa da(n)d kha(n)d keete raas ||
english: They came in palanquins, decorated with ivory;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਪਰਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਾਰੀਐ ਝਲੇ ਝਿਮਕਨਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: uparahu paanee vaareeai jhale jhimakan paas ||2||
english: water was sprinkled over their heads, and glittering fans were waved above them. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਲਖੁ ਲਹਨੑਿ ਬਹਿਠੀਆ ਲਖੁ ਲਹਨੑਿ ਖੜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ik lakh lahanhi bahitheeaa lakh lahanhi khaReeaa ||
english: They were given hundreds of thousands of coins when they sat, and hundreds of thousands of coins when they stood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਰੀ ਛੁਹਾਰੇ ਖਾਂਦੀਆ ਮਾਣਨੑਿ ਸੇਜੜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: garee chhuhaare khaa(n)deeaa maananhi sejaReeaa ||
english: They ate coconuts and dates, and rested comfortably upon their beds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਗਲਿ ਸਿਲਕਾ ਪਾਈਆ ਤੁਟਨੑਿ ਮੋਤਸਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tinh gal silakaa paaeeaa tutanhi motasareeaa ||3||
english: But ropes were put around their necks, and their strings of pearls were broken. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਵੈਰੀ ਹੋਏ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਰਖੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhan joban dui vairee hoe jinhee rakhe ra(n)g laai ||
english: Their wealth and youthful beauty, which gave them so much pleasure, have now become their enemies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਤਾ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dootaa no phuramaaiaa lai chale pat gavaai ||
english: The order was given to the soldiers, who dishonored them, and carried them away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: je tis bhaavai de vadiaaee je bhaavai dei sajaai ||4||
english: If it is pleasing to God's Will, He bestows greatness; if is pleases His Will, He bestows punishment. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਜੇ ਚੇਤੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ago de je cheteeai taa(n) kaait milai sajaai ||
english: If someone focuses on the Lord beforehand, then why should he be punished?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਾਂ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਤਮਾਸੈ ਚਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saahaa(n) surat gavaaeeaa ra(n)g tamaasai chaai ||
english: The kings had lost their higher consciousness, reveling in pleasure and sensuality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਰਵਾਣੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਈ ਕੁਇਰੁ ਨ ਰੋਟੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: baabaravaanee phir gaee kuir na rotee khaai ||5||
english: Since Baabar's rule has been proclaimed, even the princes have no food to eat. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਵਖਤ ਖੁਆਈਅਹਿ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa vakhat khuaaeeahi ikanhaa poojaa jaai ||
english: The Muslims have lost their five times of daily prayer, and the Hindus have lost their worship as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਕੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਹਿੰਦਵਾਣੀਆ ਕਿਉ ਟਿਕੇ ਕਢਹਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chauke vin hi(n)davaaneeaa kiu tike kadhahi naai ||
english: Without their sacred squares, how shall the Hindu women bathe and apply the frontal marks to their foreheads?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਹੁਣਿ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: raam na kabahoo chetio hun kahan na milai khudaai ||6||
english: They never remembered their Lord as Raam, and now they cannot even chant Khudaa-i||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਇਕਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਸੁਖ ॥
transliteration: ik ghar aavahi aapanai ik mil mil puchhahi sukh ||
english: Some have returned to their homes, and meeting their relatives, they ask about their safety.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਏਹੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
transliteration: ikanhaa eho likhiaa bahi bahi rovahi dukh ||
english: For some, it is pre-ordained that they shall sit and cry out in pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਨੁਖ ॥੭॥੧੧॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai naanak kiaa maanukh ||7||11||
english: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass. O Nanak, what is the fate of mankind? ||7||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਖੇਲ ਤਬੇਲਾ ਘੋੜੇ ਕਹਾ ਭੇਰੀ ਸਹਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahaa s khel tabelaa ghoRe kahaa bheree sahanaaee ||
english: Where are the games, the stables, the horses? Where are the drums and the bugles?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਤੇਗਬੰਦ ਗਾਡੇਰੜਿ ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਲਾਲ ਕਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahaa s tegaba(n)d gaaderaR kahaa s laal kavaaee ||
english: Where are the sword-belts and chariots? Where are those scarlet uniforms?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਆਰਸੀਆ ਮੁਹ ਬੰਕੇ ਐਥੈ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahaa s aaraseeaa muh ba(n)ke aithai disahi naahee ||1||
english: Where are the rings and the beautiful faces? They are no longer to be seen here. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ihu jag teraa too gosaaee ||
english: This world is Yours; You are the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਜਰੁ ਵੰਡਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਭਾਂਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ek ghaRee mahi thaap uthaape jar va(n)d devai bhaa(n)ee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In an instant, You establish and disestablish. You distribute wealth as it pleases You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾਂ ਸੁ ਘਰ ਦਰ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਹਲਾ ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਬੰਕ ਸਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahaa(n) s ghar dar ma(n)dap mahalaa kahaa s ba(n)k saraaee ||
english: Where are the houses, the gates, the hotels and palaces? Where are those beautiful way-stations?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾਂ ਸੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahaa(n) s sej sukhaalee kaaman jis vekh need na paaee ||
english: Where are those beautiful women, reclining on their beds, whose beauty would not allow one to sleep?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਪਾਨ ਤੰਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਮਾ ਹੋਈਆ ਛਾਈ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahaa s paan ta(n)bolee haramaa hoeeaa chhaaee maaee ||2||
english: Where are those betel leaves, their sellers, and the haremees? They have vanished like shadows. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਘਣੀ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਇਨਿ ਜਰ ਘਣੀ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
transliteration: is jar kaaran ghanee vigutee in jar ghanee khuaaee ||
english: For the sake of this wealth, so many were ruined; because of this wealth, so many have been disgraced.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪਾ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਇਆ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: paapaa baajhahu hovai naahee muiaa saath na jaaee ||
english: It was not gathered without sin, and it does not go along with the dead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਖੁਸਿ ਲਏ ਚੰਗਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis no aap khuaae karataa khus lae cha(n)giaaee ||3||
english: Those, whom the Creator Lord would destroy - first He strips them of virtue. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟੀ ਹੂ ਪੀਰ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਜਾ ਮੀਰੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kotee hoo peer varaj rahaae jaa meer suniaa dhaaiaa ||
english: Millions of religious leaders failed to halt the invader, when they heard of the Emperor's invasion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਮੁਕਾਮ ਜਲੇ ਬਿਜ ਮੰਦਰ ਮੁਛਿ ਮੁਛਿ ਕੁਇਰ ਰੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: thaan mukaam jale bij ma(n)dar muchh muchh kuir rulaaiaa ||
english: He burned the rest-houses and the ancient temples; he cut the princes limb from limb, and cast them into the dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਮੁਗਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਰਚਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: koee mugal na hoaa a(n)dhaa kinai na parachaa laaiaa ||4||
english: None of the Mugals went blind, and no one performed any miracle. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਗਲ ਪਠਾਣਾ ਭਈ ਲੜਾਈ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਗ ਵਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mugal pathaanaa bhaee laRaaee ran mahi teg vagaaee ||
english: The battle raged between the Mugals and the Pat'haans, and the swords clashed on the battlefield.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਨੑੀ ਤੁਪਕ ਤਾਣਿ ਚਲਾਈ ਓਨੑੀ ਹਸਤਿ ਚਿੜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: onhee tupak taan chalaaee onhee hasat chiRaaee ||
english: They took aim and fired their guns, and they attacked with their elephants.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਚੀਰੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਟੀ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਭਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jinh kee cheeree daragah paatee tinhaa maranaa bhaaee ||5||
english: Those men whose letters were torn in the Lord's Court, were destined to die, O Siblings of Destiny. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਹਿੰਦਵਾਣੀ ਅਵਰ ਤੁਰਕਾਣੀ ਭਟਿਆਣੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ik hi(n)davaanee avar turakaanee bhatiaanee thakuraanee ||
english: The Hindu women, the Muslim women, the Bhattis and the Rajputs

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਪੇਰਣ ਸਿਰ ਖੁਰ ਪਾਟੇ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਸਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ikanhaa peran sir khur paate ikanhaa vaas masaanee ||
english: some had their robes torn away, from head to foot, while others came to dwell in the cremation ground.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਬੰਕੇ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਿਉ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jinh ke ba(n)ke gharee na aaiaa tinh kiu rain vihaanee ||6||
english: Their husbands did not return home - how did they pass their night? ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa kis no aakh sunaaeeai ||
english: The Creator Himself acts, and causes others to act. Unto whom should we complain?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸ ਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਰੂਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh terai bhaanai hovai kis thai jaai rooaaeeai ||
english: Pleasure and pain come by Your Will; unto whom should we go and cry?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੭॥੧੨॥
transliteration: hukamee hukam chalaae vigasai naanak likhiaa paaeeai ||7||12||
english: The Commander issues His Command, and is pleased. O Nanak, we receive what is written in our destiny. ||7||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aasaa kaaphee mahalaa 1 ghar 8 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Aasaa, Kaafee, First Mehl, Eighth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਗੋਇਲੀ ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jaise goil goilee taise sa(n)saaraa ||
english: As the shepherd is in the field for only a short time, so is one in the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਆਦਮੀ ਬਾਂਧਹਿ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kooR kamaavahi aadamee baa(n)dhahi ghar baaraa ||1||
english: Practicing falsehood, they build their homes. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਹੁ ਜਾਗਹੁ ਸੂਤਿਹੋ ਚਲਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaagahu jaagahu sootiho chaliaa vanajaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Wake up! Wake up! O sleepers, see that the travelling merchant is leaving. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਘਰ ਬਾਂਧੀਅਹਿ ਜੇ ਰਹਣਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: neet neet ghar baa(n)dheeahi je rahanaa hoee ||
english: Go ahead and build your houses, if you think you will stay here forever and ever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਚਲਸੀ ਜੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pi(n)d pavai jeeu chalasee je jaanai koee ||2||
english: The body shall fall, and the soul shall depart; if only they knew this. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੀ ਓਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ohee ohee kiaa karahu hai hosee soee ||
english: Why do you cry out and mourn for the dead? The Lord is, and shall always be.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਰੋਵਹੁਗੇ ਓਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਉ ਕਉਣੁ ਰੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tum rovahuge os no tumh kau kaun roee ||3||
english: You mourn for that person, but who will mourn for you? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਪਿਟਿਹੁ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa pitihu bhaaeeho tumh kooR kamaavahu ||
english: You are engrossed in worldly entanglements, O Siblings of Destiny, and you are practicing falsehood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ohu na sunaee kat hee tumh lok sunaavahu ||4||
english: The dead person does not hear anything at all; your cries are heard only by other people. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਤਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਾਗਾਏ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jis te sutaa naanakaa jaagaae soee ||
english: Only the Lord, who causes the mortal to sleep, O Nanak, can awaken him again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਘਰੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਾਂ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: je ghar boojhai aapanaa taa(n) need na hoee ||5||
english: One who understands his true home, does not sleep. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਚਲਦਾ ਲੈ ਚਲਿਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: je chaladaa lai chaliaa kichh sa(n)pai naale ||
english: If the departing mortal can take his wealth with him,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: taa dhan sa(n)chahu dekh kai boojhahu beechaare ||6||
english: then go ahead and gather wealth yourself. See this, reflect upon it, and understand. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਖਸੂਦੁ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਤ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: vanaj karahu makhasood laihu mat pachhotaavahu ||
english: Make your deals, and obtain the true merchandise, or else you shall regret it later.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਹੁ ਐਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਪਰਾਵਹੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: augan chhodahu gun karahu aise tat paraavahu ||7||
english: Abandon your vices, and practice virtue, and you shall obtain the essence of reality. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੁ ਭੂਮਿ ਸਤੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਐਸੀ ਕਿਰਸ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: dharam bhoom sat beej kar aisee kiras kamaavahu ||
english: Plant the seed of Truth in the soil of Dharmic faith, and practice such farming.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਜਾਣੀਅਹੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥੮॥
transliteration: taa(n) vaapaaree jaaneeahu laahaa lai jaavahu ||8||
english: Only then will you be known as a merchant, if you take your profits with you. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: karam hovai satigur milai boojhai beechaaraa ||
english: If the Lord shows His Mercy, one meets the True Guru; contemplating Him, one comes to understand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: naam vakhaanai sune naam naame biuhaaraa ||9||
english: Then, one chants the Naam, hears the Naam, and deals only in the Naam. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਤੋਟਾ ਤਿਵੈ ਵਾਟ ਚਲਦੀ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jiu laahaa totaa tivai vaat chaladee aaee ||
english: As is the profit, so is the loss; this is the way of the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਾਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੦॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa saaee vadiaaee ||10||13||
english: Whatever pleases His Will, O Nanak, is glory for me. ||10||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਢੂਢੀਆ ਕੋ ਨੀਮੑੀ ਮੈਡਾ ॥
transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa dhoodheeaa ko neemhee maidaa ||
english: I have searched in the four directions, but no one is mine.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਹਉ ਤੈਡਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: je tudh bhaavai saahibaa too mai hau taidaa ||1||
english: If it pleases You, O Lord Master, then You are mine, and I am Yours. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰੁ ਬੀਭਾ ਮੈ ਨੀਮੑਿ ਕੋ ਕੈ ਕਰੀ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: dar beebhaa mai neemhi ko kai karee salaam ||
english: There is no other door for me; where shall I go to worship?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿਕੋ ਮੈਡਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hiko maidaa too dhanee saachaa mukh naam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are my only Lord; Your True Name is in my mouth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਿਧ ਪੀਰ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
transliteration: sidhaa sevan sidh peer maagahi ridh sidh ||
english: Some serve the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, and some serve spiritual teachers; they beg for wealth and miraculous powers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਬੁਧਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mai ik naam na veesarai saache gur budh ||2||
english: May I never forget the Naam, the Name of the One Lord. This is the wisdom of the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਕਾਪੜੀ ਕਿਆ ਭਵਹਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ॥
transliteration: jogee bhogee kaapaRee kiaa bhavahi disa(n)tar ||
english: Why do the Yogis, the revellers, and the beggars wander in foreign lands?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑਹੀ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad na cheenhhee tat saar nira(n)tar ||3||
english: They do not understand the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and the essence of excellence within them. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪਾਧੇ ਜੋਇਸੀ ਨਿਤ ਪੜ੍ਹਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit paadhe joisee nit paRhahi puraanaa ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, the teachers and astrologers, and those who endlessly read the Puraanas,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੁਕਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: a(n)tar vasat na jaananhee ghat braham lukaanaa ||4||
english: do not know what is within; God is hidden deep within them. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਤਪਸੀ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: ik tapasee ban mahi tap karahi nit teerath vaasaa ||
english: Some penitents perform penance in the forests, and some dwell forever at sacred shrines.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਤਾਮਸੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aap na cheenahi taamasee kaahe bhae udaasaa ||5||
english: The unenlightened people do not understand themselves - why have they become renunciates? ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਦੇ ਸੇ ਜਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik bi(n)d jatan kar raakhade se jatee kahaavahi ||
english: Some control their sexual energy, and are known as celibates.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਛੂਟਹੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bin gurasabad na chhootahee bhram aavahi jaavahi ||6||
english: But without the Guru's Word, they are not saved, and they wander in reincarnation. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: ik girahee sevak saadhikaa guramatee laage ||
english: Some are householders, servants, and seekers, attached to the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naam daan isanaan driR har bhagat s jaage ||7||
english: They hold fast to the Naam, to charity, to cleansing and purification; they remain awake in devotion to the Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸੋ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gur te dar ghar jaaneeai so jaai sinjaanai ||
english: Through the Guru, the Gate of the Lord's Home is found, and that place is recognized.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੮॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai saache man maanai ||8||14||
english: Nanak does not forget the Naam; his mind has surrendered to the True Lord. ||8||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਲੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸਚਿ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: manasaa manahi samaaile bhaujal sach taranaa ||
english: Stilling the desires of the mind, the mortal truly crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aad jugaad daiaal too thaakur teree saranaa ||1||
english: In the very beginning, and throughout the ages, You have been the Merciful Lord and Master; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤੌ ਹਮ ਜਾਚਿਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: too daatau ham jaachikaa har darasan deejai ||
english: You are the Giver, and I am a mere beggar. Lord, please grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaaeeai man ma(n)dar bheejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam; the temple of his mind resounds with joy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਤਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: kooRaa laalach chhodeeai tau saach pachhaanai ||
english: Renouncing false greed, one comes to realize the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad samaaeeai paramaarath jaanai ||2||
english: So let yourself be absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and know this supreme realization. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਲੁਭਤਉ ਲੋਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ihu man raajaa lobheeaa lubhatau lobhaaee ||
english: This mind is a greedy king, engrossed in greed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh lobh nivaareeai har siu ban aaee ||3||
english: The Gurmukh eliminates his greed, and comes to an understanding with the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਰਿ ਖੇਤੀ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kalar khetee beejeeai kiu laahaa paavai ||
english: Planting the seeds in the rocky soil, how can one reap a profit?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਭੀਜਈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਗਡਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: manamukh sach na bheejaee kooR kooR gadaavai ||4||
english: The self-willed manmukh is not pleased with Truth; the false are buried in falsehood. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਅੰਧਿਹੋ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: laalach chhodahu a(n)dhiho laalach dukh bhaaree ||
english: So renounce greed - you are blind! Greed only brings pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੌ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: saachau saahib man vasai haumai bikh maaree ||5||
english: When the True Lord dwells within the mind, the poisonous ego is conquered. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਕੁਵਾਟੜੀ ਮੂਸਹੁਗੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa chhod kuvaataRee moosahuge bhaaee ||
english: Renounce the evil way of duality, or you shall be plundered, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ahinis naam salaaheeai satigur saranaaee ||6||
english: Day and night, praise the Naam, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru's protection. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਥਰੁ ਸੈਲੁ ਹੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਫੀਕਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh pathar sail hai dhrig jeevan pheekaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is a rock, a stone. His life is cursed and useless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕੇਤਾ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੂਕਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jal mahi ketaa raakheeai abh a(n)tar sookaa ||7||
english: No matter now long a stone is kept under water, it still remains dry at its core. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam nidhaan hai poorai gur deeaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the treasure; the Perfect Guru has given it to me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮਥਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥੮॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai math a(n)mrit peeaa ||8||15||
english: O Nanak, one who does not forget the Naam, churns and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||8||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਲੇ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: chale chalanahaar vaat vataaiaa ||
english: The travellers travel from one road to another.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dha(n)dh pite sa(n)saar sach na bhaaiaa ||1||
english: The world is engrossed in its entanglements, and does not appreciate the Truth. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਭਵੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਢੂਢੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kiaa bhaveeai kiaa dhoodheeai gur sabad dikhaaiaa ||
english: Why wander around, and why go searching, when the Guru's Shabad reveals Him to us?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਸਰਜਿਆ ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mamataa mohu visarajiaa apanai ghar aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Leaving behind egotism and attachment, I have arrived at my own home. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sach milai sachiaar kooR na paaeeai ||
english: Through Truth, one meets the True One; He is not obtained through falsehood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sache siu chit laai bahuR na aaeeai ||2||
english: Centering your consciousness on the True Lord, you shall not have to come into the world again. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਇਆ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਰੋਵਹੁ ਰੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੂ ॥
transliteration: moiaa kau kiaa rovahu roi na jaanahoo ||
english: Why do you weep for the dead? You do not know how to weep.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਹੂ ॥੩॥
transliteration: rovahu sach salaahi hukam pachhaanahoo ||3||
english: Weep by praising the True Lord, and recognize His Command. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਵਜਹੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: hukamee vajahu likhaai aaiaa jaaneeai ||
english: Blessed is the birth of one who is destined to abide by the Lord's Command.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ॥੪॥
transliteration: laahaa palai paai hukam sinjaaneeai ||4||
english: He obtains the true profit, realizing the Lord's Command. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: hukamee paidhaa jaai daragah bhaaneeai ||
english: If it pleases the Commander, one goes to His Court, robed in honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ਬੰਦਿ ਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥੫॥
transliteration: hukame hee sir maar ba(n)d rabaaneeai ||5||
english: By His Command, God's slaves are hit over the head. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: laahaa sach niaau man vasaaeeai ||
english: The profit is earned by enshrining Truth and justice in the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ਗਰਬੁ ਵਞਾਈਐ ॥੬॥
transliteration: likhiaa palai paai garab vanjaaeeai ||6||
english: They obtain what is written in their destiny, and overcome pride. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ਵਾਦਿ ਖਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: manamukheeaa sir maar vaad khapaaeeai ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are hit over the head, and consumed by conflict.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਠਗਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਬੰਨੑਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ॥੭॥
transliteration: thag muthee kooRiaar ba(n)nhi chalaaeeai ||7||
english: The cheaters are plundered by falsehood; they are chained and led away. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: saahib ridai vasaai na pachhotaavahee ||
english: Enshrine the Lord Master in your mind, and you shall not have to repent.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨਹਾਂ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੀ ॥੮॥
transliteration: gunahaa(n) bakhasanahaar sabad kamaavahee ||8||
english: He forgives our sins, when we practice the Teachings of the Guru's Word. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: naanak ma(n)gai sach guramukh ghaaleeai ||
english: Nanak begs for the True Name, which is obtained by the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥੯॥੧੬॥
transliteration: mai tujh bin avar na koi nadar nihaaleeai ||9||16||
english: Without You, I have no other at all; please, bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||9||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਢੂਢੀ ਜਾਇ ਮੈ ਘਰਿ ਬਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kiaa ja(n)gal dhoodhee jaai mai ghar ban hareeaavalaa ||
english: Why should I go searching in the forests, when the woods of my home are so green?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਤਾਵਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sach tikai ghar aai sabad utaavalaa ||1||
english: The True Word of the Shabad has instantaneously come and settled in my heart. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah soi avar na jaaneeai ||
english: Wherever I look, there He is; I know no other.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kee kaar kamaai mahal pachhaaneeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Working for the Guru, one realizes the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਈ ॥
transliteration: aap milaavai sach taa man bhaavaee ||
english: The True Lord blends us with Himself, when it is pleasing to His Mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਇ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chalai sadaa rajaai a(n)k samaavaee ||2||
english: One who ever walks in accordance with His Will, merges into His Being. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib man vasai vasiaa man soee ||
english: When the True Lord dwells in the mind, that mind flourishes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape de vadiaaeeaa de tot na hoee ||3||
english: He Himself grants greatness; His Gifts are never exhausted. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਬੇ ਤਬੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: abe tabe kee chaakaree kiu daragah paavai ||
english: Serving this and that person, how can one obtain the Lord's Court?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਥਰ ਕੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਜੇ ਚੜੈ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਬੁਡਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: pathar kee beRee je chaRai bhar naal budaavai ||4||
english: If someone embarks on a boat of stone, he shall drown with its cargo. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਮਨੁ ਵੇਚੀਐ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: aapanaRaa man vecheeai sir deejai naale ||
english: So offer your mind, and surrender your head with it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਅਪਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramukh vasat pachhaaneeai apanaa ghar bhaale ||5||
english: The Gurmukh realizes the true essence, and finds the home of his own self. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa aakheeai tin karatai keeaa ||
english: People discuss birth and death; the Creator created this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aap gavaaiaa mar rahe phir maran na theeaa ||6||
english: Those who conquer their selfhood and remain dead, shall never have to die again. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saaee kaar kamaavanee dhur kee phuramaaee ||
english: Do those deeds which the Primal Lord has ordered for you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: je man satigur de milai kin keemat paaee ||7||
english: If one surrenders his mind upon meeting the True Guru, who can estimate its value? ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ratanaa paarakh so dhanee tin keemat paaee ||
english: That Lord Master is the Assayer of the jewel of the mind; He places the value on it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak saahib man vasai sachee vadiaaee ||8||17||
english: O Nanak, True is the Glory of that one, in whose mind the Lord Master dwells. ||8||17||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jinhee naam visaariaa doojai bharam bhulaaee ||
english: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are deluded by doubt and duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਡਾਲੀ ਲਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mool chhod daalee lage kiaa paavahi chhaaee ||1||
english: Those who abandon the roots and cling to the branches, shall obtain only ashes. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਜੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai kiu chhooteeai je jaanai koee ||
english: Without the Name, how can one be emancipated? Who knows this?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hoi ta chhooteeai manamukh pat khoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh is emancipated; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jinhee eko seviaa pooree mat bhaaee ||
english: Those who serve the One Lord become perfect in their understanding, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aad jugaad nira(n)janaa jan har saranaaee ||2||
english: The Lord's humble servant finds Sanctuary in Him, the Immaculate One, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saahib meraa ek hai avar nahee bhaaee ||
english: My Lord and Master is the One; there is no other, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੇ ਪਰਥਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kirapaa te sukh paaiaa saache parathaaee ||3||
english: By the Grace of the True Lord, celestial peace is obtained. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕੇਤੀ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur bin kinai na paaio ketee kahai kahaae ||
english: Without the Guru, no one has obtained Him, although many may claim to have done so.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਵਾਟੜੀਂ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aap dikhaavai vaataRee(n) sachee bhagat driRaae ||4||
english: He Himself reveals the Way, and implants true devotion within. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜੇ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਭੀ ਉਝੜਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh je samajhaaeeai bhee ujhaR jaae ||
english: Even if the self-willed manmukh is instructed, he stills goes into the wilderness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਛੂਟਸੀ ਮਰਿ ਨਰਕ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bin har naam na chhootasee mar narak samaae ||5||
english: Without the Lord's Name, he shall not be emancipated; he shall die, and sink into hell. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
transliteration: janam marai bharamaaeeai har naam na levai ||
english: He wanders through birth and death, and never chants the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: taa kee keemat naa pavai bin gur kee sevai ||6||
english: He never realizes his own value, without serving the Guru. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਈਐ ਕਰਣੀ ਭੀ ਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jehee sev karaaeeai karanee bhee saaee ||
english: Whatever service the Lord causes us to do, that is just what we do.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai vekhai vadiaaee ||7||
english: He Himself acts; who else should be mentioned? He beholds His own greatness. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa so kare jis aap karaae ||
english: He alone serves the Guru, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak sir de chhooteeai daragah pat paae ||8||18||
english: O Nanak, offering his head, one is emancipated, and honored in the Court of the Lord. ||8||18||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੂੜੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਾਹਰੋ ਰੂੜੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: rooRo thaakur maaharo rooRee gurabaanee ||
english: Beautiful is the Supreme Lord and Master, and beautiful is the Word of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag satigur milai paaeeai pad nirabaanee ||1||
english: By great good fortune, one meets the True Guru, and the supreme status of Nirvaanaa is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਓਲੑਗੀਆ ਓਲੑਗੀ ਹਮ ਛੋਰੂ ਥਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mai olhgeeaa olhgee ham chhoroo thaare ||
english: I am the lowest slave of Your slaves; I am Your most humble servant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu too(n) raakhahi tiu rahaa mukh naam hamaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As You keep me, I live. Your Name is in my mouth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਘਣੀ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: darasan kee piaasaa ghanee bhaanai man bhaaeeai ||
english: I have such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; my mind accepts Your Will, and so You are pleased with me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਭਾਣੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mere thaakur haath vadiaaeeaa bhaanai pat paaeeai ||2||
english: Greatness is in the Hands of my Lord and Master; by His Will, honor is obtained. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: saachau door na jaaneeai a(n)tar hai soee ||
english: Do not think that the True Lord is far away; He is deep within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah rav rahe kin keemat hoee ||3||
english: Wherever I look, there I find Him pervading; how can I estimate His value? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: aap kare aape hare vekhai vadiaaee ||
english: He Himself does, and He Himself undoes. He Himself beholds His glorious greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਇਉ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramukh hoi nihaaleeai iu keemat paaee ||4||
english: Becoming Gurmukh, one beholds Him, and so, His value is appraised. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jeevadiaa laahaa milai gur kaar kamaavai ||
english: So earn your profits while you are alive, by serving the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: poorab hovai likhiaa taa satigur paavai ||5||
english: If it is so pre-ordained, then one finds the True Guru. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤੋਟਾ ਨਿਤ ਹੈ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh totaa nit hai bharamahi bharamaae ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs continually lose, and wander around, deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dh na chetaee kiu darasan paae ||6||
english: The blind manmukhs do not remember the Lord; how can they obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan? ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: taa jag aaiaa jaaneeai saachai liv laae ||
english: One's coming into the world is judged worthwhile only if one lovingly attunes oneself to the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭਏ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur bhete paaras bhae jotee jot milaae ||7||
english: Meeting the Guru, one becomes invaluable; his light merges into the Light. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੋ ਕਾਰ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ahinis rahai niraalamo kaar dhur kee karanee ||
english: Day and night, he remains detached, and serves the Primal Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੮॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak naam sa(n)tokheeaa raate har charanee ||8||19||
english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Lord's Lotus Feet, are content with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||8||19||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ketaa aakhan aakheeai taa ke a(n)t na jaanaa ||
english: No matter how much one may describe the Lord, His limits still cannot be known.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਿਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਏਕ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਸਤਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mai nidhariaa dhar ek too(n) mai taan sataanaa ||1||
english: I am without any support; You, O Lord, are my only Support; You are my almighty power. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: naanak kee aradaas hai sach naam suhelaa ||
english: This is Nanak's prayer, that he may be adorned with the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aap gaiaa sojhee paee gurasabadee melaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When self-conceit is eradicated, and understanding is obtained, one meets the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: haumai garab gavaaeeai paaeeai veechaar ||
english: Abandoning egotism and pride, one obtains contemplative understanding.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਦੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saahib siu man maaniaa de saach adhaar ||2||
english: When the mind surrenders to the Lord Master, He bestows the support of the Truth. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ahinis naam sa(n)tokheeaa sevaa sach saaee ||
english: Day and night, remain content with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; that is the true service.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਚਾਲੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa kau bighan na laagaee chaalai hukam rajaaee ||3||
english: No misfortune troubles one who follows the Command of the Lord's Will. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: hukam rajaaee jo chalai so pavai khajaanai ||
english: One who follows the Command of the Lord's Will is taken into the Lord's Treasury.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਠਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਰਲੇ ਜੂਠਾਨੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: khote thavar na paainee rale joothaanai ||4||
english: The counterfeit find no place there; they are mixed with the false ones. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਖਰਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: nit nit kharaa samaaleeai sach saudaa paaeeai ||
english: Forever and ever, the genuine coins are treasured; with them, the true merchandise is purchased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਲੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਈਐ ॥੫॥
transliteration: khote nadar na aavanee le agan jalaaeeai ||5||
english: The false ones are not seen in the Lord's Treasury; they are seized and cast into the fire again. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਤਮੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jinee aatam cheeniaa paramaatam soee ||
english: Those who understand their own souls, are themselves the Supreme Soul.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਫਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: eko a(n)mrit birakh hai phal a(n)mrit hoee ||6||
english: The One Lord is the tree of ambrosial nectar, which bears the ambrosial fruit. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit phal jinee chaakhiaa sach rahe aghaaee ||
english: Those who taste the ambrosial fruit remain satisfied with Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ti(n)naa bharam na bhed hai har rasan rasaaee ||7||
english: They have no doubt or sense of separation - their tongues taste the divine taste. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਆਇਆ ਚਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hukam sa(n)jogee aaiaa chal sadaa rajaaee ||
english: By His Command, and through your past actions, you came into the world; walk forever according to His Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣਿਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੮॥੨੦॥
transliteration: auganiaare kau gun naanakai sach milai vadaaee ||8||20||
english: Please, grant virtue to Nanak, the virtueless one; bless him with the glorious greatness of the Truth. ||8||20||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: man raatau har naai sach vakhaaniaa ||
english: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord's Name speaks the truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਾ ਦਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਇ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lokaa daa kiaa jaai jaa tudh bhaaniaa ||1||
english: What would the people lose, if I became pleasing to You, O Lord? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਣ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jau lag jeeu paraan sach dhiaaeeai ||
english: As long as there is the breath of life, meditate on the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: laahaa har gun gaai milai sukh paaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall receive the profit of singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and find peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਾਰ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਤੂੰ ॥
transliteration: sachee teree kaar dehi daiaal too(n) ||
english: True is Your Service; bless me with it, O Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੂੰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hau jeevaa tudh saalaahi mai tek adhaar too(n) ||2||
english: I live by praising You; You are my Anchor and Support. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਰਵਾਨੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹੀ ॥
transliteration: dar sevak daravaan darad too(n) jaanahee ||
english: I am Your servant, the gate-keeper at Your Gate; You alone know my pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhagat teree hairaan darad gavaavahee ||3||
english: How wonderful is Your devotional worship! It removes all pains. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਸੀ ॥
transliteration: daragah naam hadoor guramukh jaanasee ||
english: The Gurmukhs know that by chanting the Naam, they shall dwell in His Court, in His Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਸੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: velaa sach paravaan sabad pachhaanasee ||4||
english: True and acceptable is that time, when one recognizes the Word of the Shabad. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਇ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh kar bhaau tosaa har naam sei ||
english: Those who practice Truth, contentment and love, obtain the supplies of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: manahu chhod vikaar sachaa sach dei ||5||
english: So banish corruption from your mind, and the True One will grant you Truth. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sache sachaa nehu sachai laaiaa ||
english: The True Lord inspires true love in the truthful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aape kare niaau jo tis bhaaiaa ||6||
english: He Himself administers justice, as it pleases His Will. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sache sachee daat dehi daiaal hai ||
english: True is the gift of the True, Compassionate Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tis sevee din raat naam amol hai ||7||
english: Day and night, I serve the One whose Name is priceless. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਉ ਨੀਚੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਆ ॥
transliteration: too(n) utam hau neech sevak kaa(n)dheeaa ||
english: You are so sublime, and I am so lowly, but I am called Your slave.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਂਢੀਆ ॥੮॥੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak nadar karehu milai sach vaa(n)dheeaa ||8||21||
english: Please, shower Nanak with Your Glance of Grace, that he, the separated one, may merge with You again, O Lord. ||8||21||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa kiu rahai kiu melaa hoee ||
english: How can coming and going, the cycle of reincarnation be ended? And how can one meet the Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਨਿਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam maran kaa dukh ghano nit sahasaa doee ||1||
english: The pain of birth and death is so great, in constant skepticism and duality. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਫਿਟੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai kiaa jeevanaa phit dhrig chaturaaee ||
english: Without the Name, what is life? Cleverness is detestable and cursed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur saadh na seviaa har bhagat na bhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who does not serve the Holy True Guru, is not pleased by devotion to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤਉ ਰਹੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaavan tau rahai paaeeai gur pooraa ||
english: Coming and going is ended only when one finds the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਦੇਇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam naam dhan raas dei binasai bhram kooraa ||2||
english: He gives the wealth and capital of the Lord's Name, and false doubt is destroyed. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kau mil rahai dhan dhan jas gaae ||
english: Joining the humble Saintly beings, let us sing the blessed, blessed Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aad purakh apara(n)paraa guramukh har paae ||3||
english: The Primal Lord, the Infinite, is obtained by the Gurmukh. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਟੂਐ ਸਾਂਗੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਬਾਜੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: natooai saa(n)g banaaiaa baajee sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The drama of the world is staged like the show of a buffoon.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਉਝਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: khin pal baajee dekheeai ujharat nahee baaraa ||4||
english: For an instant, for a moment, the show is seen, but it disappears in no time at all. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਖੇਲਣਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai chaupaR khelanaa jhoothe aha(n)kaaraa ||
english: The game of chance is played on the board of egotism, with the pieces of falsehood and ego.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਾਰੈ ਸੋ ਜਿਣੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sabh jag haarai so jinai gurasabad veechaaraa ||5||
english: The whole world loses; he alone wins, who reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਹਥਿ ਟੋਹਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu a(n)dhulai hath tohanee har naam hamaarai ||
english: As is the cane in the hand of the blind man, so is the Lord's Name for me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਉਤ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: raam naam har tek hai nis daut savaarai ||6||
english: The Lord's Name is my Support, night and day and morning. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu too(n) raakhahi tiu rahaa har naam adhaaraa ||
english: As You keep me, Lord, I live; the Lord's Name is my only Support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: a(n)t sakhaaee paaiaa jan mukat duaaraa ||7||
english: It is my only comfort in the end; the gate of salvation is found by His humble servants. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh metiaa jap naam muraare ||
english: The pain of birth and death is removed, by chanting and meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai pooraa gur taare ||8||22||
english: O Nanak, one who does not forget the Naam, is saved by the Perfect Guru. ||8||22||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 asatapadeeaa ghar 2 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: saasat bed si(n)mrit sar teraa surasaree charan samaanee ||
english: The Shaastras, the Vedas and the Simritees are contained in the ocean of Your Name; the River Ganges is held in Your Feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਖਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਮਤਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਤੂੰ ਤਾਂ ਸਰਬ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saakhaa teen mool mat raavai too(n) taa(n) sarab vidaanee ||1||
english: The intellect can understand the world of the three modes, but You, O Primal Lord, are totally astounding. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taa ke charan japai jan naanak bole a(n)mrit baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on His Feet, and chants the Ambrosial Word of His Bani. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tetees karoRee daas tumhaare ridh sidh praan adhaaree ||
english: Three hundred thirty million gods are Your servants. You bestow wealth, and the supernatural powers of the Siddhas; You are the Support of the breath of life.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਲਖਣੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa ke roop na jaahee lakhane kiaa kar aakh veechaaree ||2||
english: His beauteous forms cannot be comprehended; what can anyone accomplish by discussing and debating? ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਰੇ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: teen gunaa tere jug hee a(n)tar chaare tereeaa khaanee ||
english: Throughout the ages, You are the three qualities, and the four sources of creation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karam hovai taa param pad paaeeai kathe akath kahaanee ||3||
english: If You show Your Mercy, then one obtains the supreme status, and speaks the Unspoken Speech. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) karataa keeaa sabh teraa kiaa ko kare paraanee ||
english: You are the Creator; all are created by You. What can any mortal being do?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਪਣੀ ਸਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jaa kau nadar karahi too(n) apanee saaee sach samaanee ||4||
english: He alone, upon whom You shower Your Grace, is absorbed into the Truth. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: naam teraa sabh koee let hai jetee aavan jaanee ||
english: Everyone who comes and goes chants Your Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੋਰ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਇਆਣੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai taa guramukh boojhai hor manamukh phirai iaanee ||5||
english: When it is pleasing to Your Will, then the Gurmukh understands. Otherwise, the self-willed manmukhs wander in ignorance. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਵੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: chaare ved brahame kau deee paR paR kare veechaaree ||
english: You gave the four Vedas to Brahma, for him to read and read continually, and reflect upon.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: taa kaa hukam na boojhai bapuRaa narak surag avataaree ||6||
english: The wretched one does not understand His Command, and is reincarnated into heaven and hell. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗਹ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੀਏ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jugah jugah ke raaje keee gaavahi kar avataaree ||
english: In each and every age, He creates the kings, who are sung of as His Incarnations.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tin bhee a(n)t na paaiaa taa kaa kiaa kar aakh veechaaree ||7||
english: Even they have not found His limits; what can I speak of and contemplate? ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sachaa teraa keeaa sabh saachaa dehi ta saach vakhaanee ||
english: You are True, and all that You do is True. If You bless me with the Truth, I will speak on it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਵਹਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੨੩॥
transliteration: jaa kau sach bujhaavahi apanaa sahaje naam samaanee ||8||1||23||
english: One whom You inspire to understand the Truth, is easily absorbed into the Naam. ||8||1||23||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਮਰਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur hamaraa bharam gavaaiaa ||
english: The True Guru has dispelled my doubts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har naam nira(n)jan ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
english: He has enshrined the Immaculate Name of the Lord within my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabad cheen sadaa sukh paaiaa ||1||
english: Focusing on the Word of the Shabad, I have obtained lasting peace. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sun man mere tat giaan ||
english: Listen, O my mind, to the essence of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: devan vaalaa sabh bidh jaanai guramukh paaeeai naam nidhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Great Giver knows our condition completely; the Gurmukh obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhete kee vadiaaee ||
english: The great glory of meeting the True Guru is

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਮਤਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin mamataa agan trisanaa bujhaaee ||
english: that it has quenched the fire of possessiveness and desire;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sahaje maataa har gun gaaee ||2||
english: imbued with peace and poise, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: vin gur poore koi na jaanee ||
english: Without the Perfect Guru, no one knows the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi doojai lobhaanee ||
english: Attached to Maya, they are engrossed in duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh naam milai har baanee ||3||
english: The Gurmukh receives the Naam, and the Bani of the Lord's Word. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਪਾਂ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਪੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa tapaa(n) sir tap saar ||
english: Service to the Guru is the most excellent and sublime penance of penances.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu man vasai sabh dookh visaaranahaar ||
english: The Dear Lord dwells in the mind, and all suffering departs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: dar saachai deesai sachiaar ||4||
english: Then, at the Gate of the True Lord, one appears truthful. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te tribhavan sojhee hoi ||
english: Serving the Guru, one comes to know the three worlds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aap pachhaan har paavai soi ||
english: Understanding his own self, he obtains the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: saachee baanee mahal paraapat hoi ||5||
english: Through the True Word of His Bani, we enter the Mansion of His Presence. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te sabh kul udhaare ||
english: Serving the Guru, all of one's generations are saved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: niramal naam rakhai ur dhaare ||
english: Keep the Immaculate Naam enshrined within your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saachee sobhaa saach duaare ||6||
english: In the Court of the True Lord, you shall be adorned with True Glory. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: se vadabhaagee j gur sevaa laae ||
english: How very fortunate are they, who are committed to the Guru's service.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat sach naam driRaae ||
english: Night and day, they are engaged in devotional worship; the True Name is implanted within them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਸਬਾਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naame udhare kul sabaae ||7||
english: Through the Naam, all of one's generations are saved. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak saach kahai veechaar ||
english: Nanak chants the true thought.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam rakhahu ur dhaar ||
english: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined within your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੨੪॥
transliteration: har bhagatee raate mokh duaar ||8||2||24||
english: Imbued with devotion to the Lord, the gate of salvation is found. ||8||2||24||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aasaa aas kare sabh koee ||
english: Everyone lives, hoping in hope.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: hukamai boojhai niraasaa hoee ||
english: Understanding His Command, one becomes free of desire.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਤੇ ਕਈ ਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aasaa vich sute kaee loee ||
english: So many are asleep in hope.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਾਗੈ ਜਾਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so jaagai jaagaavai soee ||1||
english: He alone wakes up, whom the Lord awakens. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur naam bujhaaiaa vin naavai bhukh na jaaee ||
english: The True Guru has led me to understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the Naam, hunger does not go away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naame trisanaa agan bujhai naam milai tisai rajaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Naam, the fire of desire is extinguished; the Naam is obtained by His Will. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kal keerat sabad pachhaan ||
english: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, realize the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ehaa bhagat chookai abhimaan ||
english: By this devotional worship, egotism is eliminated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur seviai hovai paravaan ||
english: Serving the True Guru, one becomes approved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin aasaa keetee tis no jaan ||2||
english: So know the One, who created hope and desire. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tis kiaa deejai j sabad sunaae ||
english: What shall we offer to one who proclaims the Word of the Shabad?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: By His Grace, the Naam is enshrined within our minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ihu sir deejai aap gavaae ||
english: Offer your head, and shed your self-conceit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hukamai boojhe sadaa sukh paae ||3||
english: One who understands the Lord's Command finds lasting peace. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aap kare tai aap karaae ||
english: He Himself does, and causes others to do.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape guramukh naam vasaae ||
english: He Himself enshrines His Name in the mind of the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aap bhulaavai aap maarag paae ||
english: He Himself misleads us, and He Himself puts us back on the Path.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sachai sabad sach samaae ||4||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, we merge into the True Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sachaa sabad sachee hai baanee ||
english: True is the Shabad, and True is the Word of the Lord's Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jug jug aakh vakhaanee ||
english: In each and every age, the Gurmukhs speak it and chant it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੋਲਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mohi bharam bholaanee ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt and attachment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਉਰਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bin naavai sabh phirai bauraanee ||5||
english: Without the Name, everyone wanders around insane. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਕਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: teen bhavan mahi ekaa maaiaa ||
english: Throughout the three worlds, is the one Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: moorakh paR paR doojaa bhaau driRaaiaa ||
english: The fool reads and reads, but holds tight to duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bahu karam kamaavai dukh sabaaiaa ||
english: He performs all sorts of rituals, but still suffers terrible pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaiaa ||6||
english: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit meethaa sabad veechaar ||
english: Reflective meditation upon the Shabad is such sweet nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਗੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhoge haumai maar ||
english: Night and day, one enjoys it, subduing his ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sahaj ana(n)d kirapaa dhaar ||
english: When the Lord showers His Mercy, we enjoy celestial bliss.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naam rate sadaa sach piaar ||7||
english: Imbued with the Naam, love the True Lord forever. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har jap paReeai gurasabad veechaar ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, and read and reflect upon the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har jap paReeai haumai maar ||
english: Subdue your ego and meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਭਇ ਸਚਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har japeeai bhai sach piaar ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, and be imbued with fear and love of the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੩॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam guramat ur dhaar ||8||3||25||
english: O Nanak, enshrine the Naam within your heart, through the Guru's Teachings. ||8||3||25||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕਾਫੀ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 3 asatapadeeaa ghar 8 kaaphee ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Eighth House, Kaafee:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur te saa(n)t oopajai jin trisanaa agan bujhaaee ||
english: Peace emanates from the Guru; He puts out the fire of desire.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur te naam paaeeai vadee vadiaaee ||1||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained from the Guru; it is the greatest greatness. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: eko naam chet mere bhaaee ||
english: Keep the One Name in your consciousness, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲੰਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jagat jala(n)daa dekh kai bhaj pae saranaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Seeing the world on fire, I have hurried to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਹਾ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur te giaan oopajai mahaa tat beechaaraa ||
english: Spiritual wisdom emanates from the Guru; reflect upon the supreme essence of reality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur te ghar dar paaiaa bhagatee bhare bha(n)daaraa ||2||
english: Through the Guru, the Lord's Mansion and His Court are attained; His devotional worship is overflowing with treasures. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਬੂਝੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaaeeai boojhai veechaaraa ||
english: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam; he achieves reflective meditation and understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat salaah hai a(n)tar sabad apaaraa ||3||
english: The Gurmukh is the Lord's devotee, immersed in His Praises; the Infinite Word of the Shabad dwells within him. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sookh oopajai dukh kade na hoee ||
english: Happiness emanates from the Gurmukh; he never suffers pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramukh haumai maareeai man niramal hoee ||4||
english: The Gurmukh conquers his ego, and his mind is immaculately pure. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai aap gaiaa tribhavan sojhee paaee ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, self-conceit is removed, and understanding of the three worlds is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਸਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: niramal jot pasar rahee jotee jot milaaee ||5||
english: The Immaculate Divine Light is pervading and permeating everywhere; one's light merges into the Light. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: poorai gur samajhaaiaa mat ootam hoee ||
english: The Perfect Guru instructs, and one's intellect becomes sublime.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: a(n)tar seetal saa(n)t hoi naame sukh hoee ||6||
english: A cooling and soothing peace comes within, and through the Naam, peace is obtained. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਂ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾਂ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
transliteration: pooraa satigur taa(n) milai jaa(n) nadar kareee ||
english: One meets the Perfect True Guru only when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਸਭ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kilavikh paap sabh kateeahi phir dukh bighan na hoee ||7||
english: All sins and vices are eradicated, and one shall never again suffer pain or distress. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aapanai hath vadiaaeeaa de naame laae ||
english: Glory is in His Hands; He bestows His Name, and attaches us to it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥੪॥੨੬॥
transliteration: naanak naam nidhaan man vasiaa vadiaaee paae ||8||4||26||
english: O Nanak, the treasure of the Naam abides within the mind, and glory is obtained. ||8||4||26||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sun man ma(n)n vasaai too(n) aape aai milai mere bhaaee ||
english: Listen, O mortal: enshrine His Name within your mind; He shall come to meet with you, O my Sibling of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin sachee bhagat kar sachai chit laaee ||1||
english: Night and day, center your consciousness on true devotional worship of the True Lord. ||1||
