author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: eko naam dhiaai too(n) sukh paavahi mere bhaaee ||
english: Meditate on the One Naam, and you shall find peace, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: haumai doojaa door kar vadee vadiaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Eradicate egotism and duality, and your glory shall be glorious. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਨੋ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਚਦੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: is bhagatee no sur nar mun jan lochade vin satigur paaee na jaai ||
english: The angels, humans and silent sages long for this devotional worship, but without the True Guru, it cannot be attained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਦੇ ਜੋਤਿਕੀ ਤਿਨ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit paRade jotikee tin boojh na paai ||2||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers read their books, but they do not understand. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਥੈ ਸਭੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aapai thai sabh rakhion kichh kahan na jaaee ||
english: He Himself keeps all in His Hand; nothing else can be said.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape dei s paaeeai gur boojh bujhaaee ||3||
english: Whatever He gives, is received. The Guru has imparted this understanding to me. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਦੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh tis de sabhanaa kaa soee ||
english: All beings and creatures are His; He belongs to all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ma(n)daa kis no aakheeai je doojaa hoee ||4||
english: So who can we call bad, since there is no other? ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਏਕਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: iko hukam varatadaa ekaa sir kaaraa ||
english: The Command of the One Lord is pervading throughout; duty to the One Lord is upon the heads of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭਵਾਲੀ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aap bhavaalee diteean a(n)tar lobh vikaaraa ||5||
english: He Himself has led them astray, and placed greed and corruption within their hearts. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਤਿਅਨੁ ਬੂਝਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ik aape guramukh keetian boojhan veechaaraa ||
english: He has sanctified those few Gurmukhs who understand Him, and reflect upon Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭੀ ਓਨਾ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bhagat bhee onaa no bakhaseean a(n)tar bha(n)daaraa ||6||
english: He grants devotional worship to them, and within them is the treasure. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: giaaneeaa no sabh sach hai sach sojhee hoee ||
english: The spiritual teachers know nothing but the Truth; they obtain true understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ ਨ ਭੁਲਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: oi bhulaae kisai de na bhulanhee sach jaanan soee ||7||
english: They are led astray by Him, but they do not go astray, because they know the True Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਵਰਤਦੇ ਪੰਚੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ghar mahi pa(n)ch varatade pa(n)che veechaaree ||
english: Within the homes of their bodies, the five passions are pervading, but here, the five are well-behaved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੑੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੫॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak bin satigur vas na aavanhee naam haumai maaree ||8||5||27||
english: O Nanak, without the True Guru, they are not overcome; through the Naam, the ego is conquered. ||8||5||27||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਥੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: gharai a(n)dar sabh vath hai baahar kichh naahee ||
english: Everything is within the home of your own self; there is nothing beyond it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeeai a(n)tar kapat khulaahee ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, it is obtained, and the doors of the inner heart are opened wide. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur te har paaeeai bhaaee ||
english: From the True Guru, the Lord's Name is obtained, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar naam nidhaan hai poorai satigur deeaa dikhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The treasure of the Naam is within; the Perfect True Guru has shown this to me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਲਏ ਪਾਏ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa gaahak hovai so lae paae ratan veechaaraa ||
english: One who is a buyer of the Lord's Name, finds it, and obtains the jewel of contemplation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਲੈ ਦਿਬ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)dar kholai dib disat dekhai mukat bha(n)daaraa ||2||
english: He opens the doors deep within, and through the Eyes of Divine Vision, beholds the treasure of liberation. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਅਨੇਕ ਹਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਰੇ ਵਸੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar mahal anek hahi jeeu kare vaseraa ||
english: There are so many mansions within the body; the soul dwells within them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man chi(n)diaa phal paaisee phir hoi na pheraa ||3||
english: He obtains the fruits of his mind's desires, and he shall not have to go through reincarnation again. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਖੀਆ ਵਥੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: paarakheeaa vath samaal laee gur sojhee hoee ||
english: The appraisers cherish the commodity of the Name; they obtain understanding from the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naam padaarath amul saa guramukh paavai koee ||4||
english: The wealth of the Naam is priceless; how few are the Gurmukhs who obtain it. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਲਹੈ ਵਥੁ ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: baahar bhaale s kiaa lahai vath gharai a(n)dar bhaaee ||
english: Searching outwardly, what can anyone find? The commodity is deep within the home of the self, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bharame bhoolaa sabh jag phirai manamukh pat gavaaee ||5||
english: The entire world is wandering around, deluded by doubt; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਛੋਡੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਝੂਠਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ghar dar chhode aapanaa par ghar jhoothaa jaaee ||
english: The false one leaves his own hearth and home, and goes out to another's home.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚੋਰੈ ਵਾਂਗੂ ਪਕੜੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: chorai vaa(n)goo pakaReeai bin naavai chotaa khaaee ||6||
english: Like a thief, he is caught, and without the Naam, he is beaten and struck down. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jinhee ghar jaataa aapanaa se sukheee bhaaee ||
english: Those who know their own home, are happy, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: a(n)tar braham pachhaaniaa gur kee vadiaaee ||7||
english: They realize God within their own hearts, through the glorious greatness of the Guru. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aape daan kare kis aakheeai aape dei bujhaaee ||
english: He Himself gives gifts, and He Himself bestows understanding; unto whom can we complain?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੬॥੨੮॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaai too(n) dar sachai sobhaa paaee ||8||6||28||
english: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall obtain glory in the True Court. ||8||6||28||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਾਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aapai aap pachhaaniaa saad meethaa bhaaee ||
english: Those who recognize their own selves, enjoy the sweet flavor, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਚਾਖਿਐ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਸਾਚੋ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har ras chaakhiai mukat bhae jinhaa saacho bhaaee ||1||
english: Those who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord are emancipated; they love the Truth. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu niramal niramalaa niramal man vaasaa ||
english: The Beloved Lord is the purest of the pure; He comes to dwell in the pure mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramatee saalaaheeai bikhiaa maahi udaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Praising the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, one remains unaffected by corruption. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਸਭ ਅੰਧੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai aap na jaapaee sabh a(n)dhee bhaaee ||
english: Without the Word of the Shabad, they do not understand themselves -they are totally blind, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramatee ghat chaananaa naam a(n)t sakhaaee ||2||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the heart is illuminated, and in the end, only the Naam shall be your companion. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਰਤਦੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naame hee naam varatade naame varataaraa ||
english: They are occupied with the Naam, and only the Naam; they deal only in the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)tar naam mukh naam hai naame sabad veechaaraa ||3||
english: Deep within their hearts is the Naam; upon their lips is the Naam; they contemplate the Word of God, and the Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: naam suneeai naam ma(n)neeai naame vadiaaee ||
english: They listen to the Naam, believe in the Naam, and through the Naam, they obtain glory.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naam salaahe sadaa sadaa naame mahal paaee ||4||
english: They praise the Naam, forever and ever, and through the Naam, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naame hee ghat chaananaa naame sobhaa paaee ||
english: Through the Naam, their hearts are illumined, and through the Naam, they obtain honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naame hee sukh oopajai naame saranaaee ||5||
english: Through the Naam, peace wells up; I seek the Sanctuary of the Naam. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai koi na ma(n)neeai manamukh pat gavaaee ||
english: Without the Naam, no one is accepted; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jam pur baadhe maareeahi birathaa janam gavaaee ||6||
english: In the City of Death, they are tied down and beaten, and they lose their lives in vain. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naamai kee sabh sevaa karai guramukh naam bujhaaee ||
english: Those Gurmukhs who realize the Naam, all serve the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਹੁ ਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naamahu hee naam ma(n)neeai naame vadiaaee ||7||
english: So believe in the Naam, and only the Naam; through the Naam, glorious greatness is obtained. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jis no devai tis milai guramatee naam bujhaaee ||
english: He alone receives it, unto whom it is given. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is realized.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੭॥੨੯॥
transliteration: naanak sabh kichh naavai kai vas hai poorai bhaag ko paaee ||8||7||29||
english: O Nanak, everything is under the influence of the Naam; by perfect good destiny, a few obtain it. ||8||7||29||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੑੀ ਨ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: dohaaganee mahal na paainhee na jaanan pir kaa suaau ||
english: The deserted brides do not obtain the Mansion of their Husband's Presence, nor do they know His taste.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਨਾ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: phikaa bolahi naa nivahi doojaa bhaau suaau ||1||
english: They speak harsh words, and do not bow to Him; they are in love with another. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu manooaa kiu kar vas aavai ||
english: How can this mind come under control?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਠਾਕੀਐ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee thaakeeai giaan matee ghar aavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, it is held in check; instructed in spiritual wisdom, it returns to its home. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਓਨੁ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sohaaganee aap savaareeon laai prem piaar ||
english: He Himself adorns the happy soul-brides; they bear Him love and affection.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai chaladeeaa naame sahaj seegaar ||2||
english: They live in harmony with the Sweet Will of the True Guru, naturally adorned with the Naam. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa raavahi pir aapanaa sachee sej subhaai ||
english: They enjoy their Beloved forever, and their bed is decorated with Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਮੋਹੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pir kai prem moheeaa mil preetam sukh paai ||3||
english: They are fascinated with the Love of their Husband Lord; meeting their Beloved, they obtain peace. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: giaan apaar seegaar hai sobhaava(n)tee naar ||
english: Spiritual wisdom is the incomparable decoration of the happy soul-bride.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਸਭਰਾਈ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: saa sabharaaee su(n)daree pir kai het piaar ||4||
english: She is so beautiful - she is the queen of all; she enjoys the love and affection of her Husband Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਸਚੈ ਅਲਖਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sohaaganee vich ra(n)g rakhion sachai alakh apaar ||
english: The True Lord, the Unseen, the Infinite, has infused His Love among the happy soul-brides.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: satigur sevan aapanaa sachai bhaai piaar ||5||
english: They serve their True Guru, with true love and affection. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sohaaganee seegaar banaaiaa gun kaa gal haar ||
english: The happy soul-bride has adorned herself with the necklace of virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰਮਲੁ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵਣਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: prem piramal tan laavanaa a(n)tar ratan veechaar ||6||
english: She applies the perfume of love to her body, and within her mind is the jewel of reflective meditation. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਊਤਮਾ ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat rate se ootamaa jat pat sabade hoi ||
english: Those who are imbued with devotional worship are the most exalted. Their social standing and honor come from the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin naavai sabh neech jaat hai bisataa kaa keeRaa hoi ||7||
english: Without the Naam, all are low class, like maggots in manure. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਦੀ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਹਉ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hau hau karadee sabh phirai bin sabadai hau na jaai ||
english: Everyone proclaims, "Me, me!"; but without the Shabad, the ego does not depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਸਚੈ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੮॥੩੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate tin haumai gaee sachai rahe samaai ||8||8||30||
english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam lose their ego; they remain absorbed in the True Lord. ||8||8||30||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sache rate se niramale sadaa sachee soi ||
english: Those who are imbued with the True Lord are spotless and pure; their reputation is forever true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਪਦੇ ਆਗੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aithai ghar ghar jaapade aagai jug jug paragat hoi ||1||
english: Here, they are known in each and every home, and hereafter, they are famous throughout the ages. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਰੂੜੑੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: e man rooRhe ra(n)gule too(n) sachaa ra(n)g chaRaai ||
english: O beauteous and joyful mind, imbue yourself with your true color.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੂੜੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੇ ਰਪੈ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rooRee baanee je rapai naa ihu ra(n)g lahai na jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If you imbue yourself with the Beauteous Word of the Guru's Bani, then this color shall never fade away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਮੈਲੇ ਅਤਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ham neech maile at abhimaanee doojai bhaai vikaar ||
english: I am lowly, filthy, and totally egotistical; I am attached to the corruption of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਏ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur paaras miliai ka(n)chan hoe niramal jot apaar ||2||
english: But meeting with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone, I am transformed into gold; I am blended with the Pure Light of the Infinite Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰੰਗੀਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin gur koi na ra(n)geeai gur miliai ra(n)g chaRaau ||
english: Without the Guru, no one is imbued with the color of the Lord's Love; meeting with the Guru, this color is applied.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kai bhai bhaai jo rate siphatee sach samaau ||3||
english: Those who are imbued with the Fear, and the Love of the Guru, are absorbed in the Praise of the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhai bin laag na lagaee naa man niramal hoi ||
english: Without fear, the cloth is not dyed, and the mind is not rendered pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਠਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bin bhai karam kamaavane jhoothe thaau na koi ||4||
english: Without fear, the performance of rituals is false, and one finds no place of rest. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਸੁ ਰਪਸੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis no aape ra(n)ge s rapasee satasa(n)gat milaai ||
english: Only those whom the Lord imbues, are so imbued; they join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: poore gur te satasa(n)gat oopajai sahaje sach subhaai ||5||
english: From the Perfect Guru, the Sat Sangat emanates, and one easily merges into the Love of the True One. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਐਸੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਢੋਰ ॥
transliteration: bin sa(n)gatee sabh aise rahahi jaise pas dhor ||
english: Without the Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all remain like beasts and animals.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਚੋਰ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jinhi keete tisai na jaananhee bin naavai sabh chor ||6||
english: They do not know the One who created them; without the Name, all are thieves. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik gun vihaajhahi augan vikanahi gur kai sahaj subhaai ||
english: Some purchase merits and sell off their demerits; through the Guru, they obtain peace and poise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਵੁਠਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te naau paaiaa vuthaa a(n)dar aai ||7||
english: Serving the Guru, they obtain the Name, which comes to dwell deep within. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa kaa daataa ek hai sir dha(n)dhai laai ||
english: The One Lord is the Giver of all; He assigns tasks to each and every person.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੮॥੯॥੩੧॥
transliteration: naanak naame laai savaarian sabade lae milaai ||8||9||31||
english: O Nanak, the Lord embellishes us with the Name; attached to the Word of the Shabad, we are merged into Him. ||8||9||31||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਲੋਚਦੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabh naavai no lochadee jis kripaa kare so paae ||
english: Everyone longs for the Name, but he alone receives it, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin naavai sabh dukh hai sukh tis jis ma(n)n vasaae ||1||
english: Without the Name, there is only pain; he alone obtains peace, whose mind is filled with the Name. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) bea(n)t daiaal hai teree saranaaee ||
english: You are infinite and merciful; I seek Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poore te paaeeai naame vadiaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: From the Perfect Guru, the glorious greatness of the Naam is obtained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar ek hai bahu bidh srisat upaaee ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, there is only the One Lord. He has created the world, with its many varieties.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hukame kaar karaaidaa doojaa kis kaheeai bhaaee ||2||
english: According to the Order of His Will, He makes us act. What else can we talk about, O Siblings of Destiny? ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੁਝਣਾ ਅਬੁਝਣਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਕੀਆ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bujhanaa abujhanaa tudh keeaa ih teree sir kaar ||
english: Knowledge and ignorance are all your making; You have control over these.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਬਖਸਿਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ikanhaa bakhasihi mel laihi ik daragah maar kadhe kooRiaar ||3||
english: Some, You forgive, and unite with Yourself; while others, the wicked, you strike down and drive out of Your Court. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਹਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ik dhur pavit paavan hahi tudh naame laae ||
english: Some, from the very beginning, are pure and pious; You attach them to Your Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te sukh oopajai sachai sabad bujhaae ||4||
english: Serving the Guru, peace wells up; through the True Word of the Shabad, one comes to understand. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਕੁਚਲ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਵਿਖਲੀ ਪਤੇ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
transliteration: ik kuchal kucheel vikhalee pate naavahu aap khuaae ||
english: Some are crooked, filthy and vicious; the Lord Himself has led them astray from the Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੈ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਉਤਵਤਾਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naa on sidh na budh hai na sa(n)jamee phirahi utavataae ||5||
english: They have no intuition, no understanding and no self-discipline; they wander around delirious. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare jis aapanee tis no bhaavanee laae ||
english: He grants faith to those whom He has blessed with His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਇਹ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh ih sa(n)jamee man niramal sabad sunaae ||6||
english: This mind finds truth, contentment and self-discipline, hearing the Immaculate Word of the Shabad. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜਿ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੀਐ ਕਥਿ ਕਹਣੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: lekhaa paR na pahoocheeai kath kahanai a(n)t na paai ||
english: By reading books, one cannot reach Him; by speaking and talking, His limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur te keemat paaeeai sach sabad sojhee paai ||7||
english: Through the Guru, His value is found; through the True Word of the Shabad, understanding is obtained. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸੋਧਿ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ihu man dehee sodh too(n) gur sabad veechaar ||
english: So reform this mind and body, by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੧੦॥੩੨॥
transliteration: naanak is dehee vich naam nidhaan hai paaeeai gur kai het apaar ||8||10||32||
english: O Nanak, within this body is the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; it is found through the Love of the Infinite Guru. ||8||10||32||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sach rateeaa sohaaganee jinaa gur kai sabad seegaar ||
english: The happy soul-brides are imbued with Truth; they are adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ghar hee so pir paaiaa sachai sabad veechaar ||1||
english: They find their Husband Lord within their own home, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣੀ ਬਖਸਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: avagan gunee bakhasaaiaa har siu liv laaee ||
english: Through merits, their demerits are forgiven, and they embrace love for the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har var paaiaa kaamanee gur mel milaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The soul-bride then obtains the Lord as her Husband; meeting the Guru, this union comes about. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik pir hadoor na jaananhee doojai bharam bhulaai ||
english: Some do not know the Presence of their Husband Lord; they are deluded by duality and doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਇਨੑਿ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kiu paainhi dohaaganee dukhee rain vihaai ||2||
english: How can the forsaken brides meet Him? Their life night passes in pain. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jin kai man sach vasiaa sachee kaar kamaai ||
english: Those whose minds are filled with the True Lord, perform truthful actions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਿਉ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anadin sevahi sahaj siu sache maahi samaai ||3||
english: Night and day, they serve the Lord with poise, and are absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: dohaaganee bharam bhulaaeeaa kooR bol bikh khaahi ||
english: The forsaken brides wander around, deluded by doubt; telling lies, they eat poison.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਸੇਜ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: pir na jaanan aapanaa su(n)njee sej dukh paahi ||4||
english: They do not know their Husband Lord, and upon their deserted bed, they suffer in misery. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਮਤੁ ਮਨ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib ek hai mat man bharam bhulaahi ||
english: The True Lord is the One and only; do not be deluded by doubt, O my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur poochh sevaa karahi sach niramal ma(n)n vasaahi ||5||
english: Consult with the Guru, serve the True Lord, and enshrine the Immaculate Truth within your mind. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sohaaganee sadaa pir paaiaa haumai aap gavaai ||
english: The happy soul-bride always finds her Husband Lord; she banishes egotism and self-conceit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਚੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: pir setee anadin gahi rahee sachee sej sukh paai ||6||
english: She remains attached to her Husband Lord, night and day, and she finds peace upon His Bed of Truth. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਪਲੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: meree meree kar gae palai kichh na paai ||
english: Those who shouted, "Mine, mine!" have departed, without obtaining anything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: mahal naahee dohaaganee a(n)t gaee pachhutaai ||7||
english: The separated one does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and departs, repenting in the end. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: so pir meraa ek hai ekas siu liv laai ||
english: That Husband Lord of mine is the One and only; I am in love with the One alone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੧॥੩੩॥
transliteration: naanak je sukh loRahi kaamanee har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaai ||8||11||33||
english: O Nanak, if the soul-bride longs for peace, she should enshrine the Lord's Name within her mind. ||8||11||33||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਚਖਾਇਓਨੁ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit jinhaa chakhaaion ras aaiaa sahaj subhaai ||
english: Those whom the Lord has caused to drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, naturally, intuitively, enjoy the sublime essence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sachaa veparavaahu hai tis no til na tamaai ||1||
english: The True Lord is care-free; he does not have even an iota of greed. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit sachaa varasadaa guramukhaa mukh paai ||
english: The True Ambrosial Nectar rains down, and trickles into the mouths of the Gurmukhs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man sadaa hareeaavalaa sahaje har gun gaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Their minds are forever rejuvenated, and they naturally, intuitively, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਦਰਿ ਖੜੀਆ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sadaa dohaaganee dar khaReeaa bilalaahi ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are forever forsaken brides; they cry out and bewail at the Lord's Gate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jinhaa pir kaa suaad na aaio jo dhur likhiaa sou kamaahi ||2||
english: Those who do not enjoy the sublime taste of their Husband Lord, act according to their pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੀਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਜਮੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh beeje sach jamai sach naam vaapaar ||
english: The Gurmukh plants the seed of the True Name, and it sprouts. He deals in the True Name alone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਤੁ ਲਾਹੈ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo it laahai laaian bhagatee dei bha(n)daar ||3||
english: Those whom the Lord has attached to this profitable venture, are granted the treasure of devotional worship. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sadaa sohaaganee bhai bhagat seegaar ||
english: The Gurmukh is forever the true, happy soul-bride; she adorns herself with the fear of God and devotion to Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: anadin raavahi pir aapanaa sach rakhahi ur dhaar ||4||
english: Night and day, she enjoys her Husband Lord; she keeps Truth enshrined within her heart. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jinhaa pir raaviaa aapanaa tinhaa vitahu bal jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who have enjoyed their Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sadaa pir kai sa(n)g rahahi vichahu aap gavaai ||5||
english: They dwell forever with their Husband Lord; they eradicate self-conceit from within. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tan man seetal mukh ujale pir kai bhaai piaar ||
english: Their bodies and minds are cooled and soothed, and their faces are radiant, from the love and affection of their Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sej sukhaalee pir ravai haumai trisanaa maar ||6||
english: They enjoy their Husband Lord upon His cozy bed, having conquered their ego and desire. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa ghar aaiaa gur kai het apaar ||
english: Granting His Grace, He comes into our homes, through our infinite Love for the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕੇਵਲ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: var paaiaa sohaaganee keval ek muraar ||7||
english: The happy soul-bride obtains the One Lord as her Husband. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਬਖਸਾਇ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabhe gunah bakhasaai laion mele melanahaar ||
english: All of her sins are forgiven; the Uniter unites her with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੮॥੧੨॥੩੪॥
transliteration: naanak aakhan aakheeai je sun dhare piaar ||8||12||34||
english: O Nanak, chant such chants, that hearing them, He may enshrine love for you. ||8||12||34||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur te gun oopajai jaa prabh melai soi ||
english: Merit is obtained from the True Guru, when God causes us to meet Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sahaje naam dhiaaeeai giaan paragat hoi ||1||
english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with intuitive ease and poise, spiritual wisdom is revealed. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮਤ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: e man mat jaanahi har door hai sadaa vekh hadoor ||
english: O my mind, do not think of the Lord as being far away; behold Him ever close at hand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਸਦ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sad sunadaa sad vekhadaa sabad rahiaa bharapoor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is always listening, and always watching over us; the Word of His Shabad is all-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh aap pachhaaniaa tinhee ik man dhiaaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukhs understand their own selves; they meditate single-mindedly on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa ravahi pir aapanaa sachai naam sukh paaiaa ||2||
english: They enjoy their Husband Lord continually; through the True Name, they find peace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: e man teraa ko nahee kar vekh sabad veechaar ||
english: O my mind, no one belongs to you; contemplate the Shabad, and see this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har saranaaee bhaj pau paaihi mokh duaar ||3||
english: So run to the Lord's Sanctuary, and find the gate of salvation. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad suneeai sabad bujheeai sach rahai liv laai ||
english: Listen to the Shabad, and understand the Shabad, and lovingly focus your consciousness on the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sabade haumai maareeai sachai mahal sukh paai ||4||
english: Through the Shabad, conquer your ego, and in the True Mansion of the Lord's Presence, you shall find peace. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੋਭ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: is jug mahi sobhaa naam kee bin naavai sobh na hoi ||
english: In this age, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glory; without the Name, there is no glory.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ਜਾਦੀ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ih maaiaa kee sobhaa chaar dihaaRe jaadee bilam na hoi ||5||
english: The glory of this Maya lasts for only a few days; it disappears in an instant. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਮੁਏ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa se mue mar jaahi ||
english: Those who forget the Naam are already dead, and they continue dying.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: har ras saad na aaio bisataa maahi samaahi ||6||
english: They do not enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord's taste; they sink into the manure. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik aape bakhas milaaian anadin naame laai ||
english: Some are forgiven by the Lord; He unites them with Himself, and keeps them attached to the Naam, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sach kamaavahi sach rahahi sache sach samaahi ||7||
english: They practice Truth, and abide in Truth; being truthful, they merge into Truth. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਜਗੁ ਬੋਲਾ ਅੰਨੑਾ ਭਰਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai suneeai na dekheeai jag bolaa a(n)nhaa bharamaai ||
english: Without the Shabad, the world does not hear, and does not see; deaf and blind, it wanders around.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: bin naavai dukh paaisee naam milai tisai rajaai ||8||
english: Without the Naam, it obtains only misery; the Naam is received only by His Will. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jin baanee siu chit laaiaa se jan niramal paravaan ||
english: Those persons who link their consciousness with the Word of His Bani, are immaculately pure, and approved by the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੯॥੧੩॥੩੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam tinhaa kade na veesarai se dar sache jaan ||9||13||35||
english: O Nanak, they never forget the Naam, and in the Court of the Lord, they are known as true. ||9||13||35||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੌ ਹੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਾਪਦੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabadau hee bhagat jaapade jinh kee baanee sachee hoi ||
english: Through the Word of the Shabad, the devotees are known; their words are true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vichahu aap gaiaa naau ma(n)niaa sach milaavaa hoi ||1||
english: They eradicate ego from within themselves; they surrender to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and meet with the True One. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam jan kee pat hoi ||
english: Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, His humble servants obtain honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਮਾਨੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saphal tinhaa kaa janam hai tinh maanai sabh koi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How blessed is their coming into the world! Everyone adores them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: haumai meraa jaat hai at krodh abhimaan ||
english: Ego, self-centeredness, excessive anger and pride are the lot of mankind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabad marai taa jaat jaai jotee jot milai bhagavaan ||2||
english: If one dies in the Word of the Shabad, then he is rid of this, and his light is merged into the Light of the Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pooraa satigur bhetiaa saphal janam hamaaraa ||
english: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, my life has been blessed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਰੇ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam navai nidh paaiaa bhare akhut bha(n)daaraa ||3||
english: I have obtained the nine treasures of the Naam, and my storehouse is inexhaustible, filled to overflowing. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਇਸੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aavahi is raasee ke vaapaareee jinhaa naam piaaraa ||
english: Those who love the Naam come as dealers in the merchandise of the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai so dhan paae tinhaa a(n)tar sabad veechaaraa ||4||
english: Those who become Gurmukh obtain this wealth; deep within, they contemplate the Shabad. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bhagatee saar na jaananhee manamukh aha(n)kaaree ||
english: The egotistical, self-willed manmukhs do not appreciate the value of devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: dhurahu aap khuaaian jooai baajee haaree ||5||
english: The Primal Lord Himself has beguiled them; they lose their lives in the gamble. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bin piaarai bhagat na hovaee naa sukh hoi sareer ||
english: Without loving affection, devotional worship is not possible, and the body cannot be at peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਨ ਧੀਰਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: prem padaarath paaeeai gur bhagatee man dheer ||6||
english: The wealth of love is obtained from the Guru; through devotion, the mind becomes steady. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jis no bhagat karaae so kare gurasabad veechaar ||
english: He alone performs devotional worship, whom the Lord so blesses; he contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: hiradai eko naam vasai haumai dubidhaa maar ||7||
english: The One Name abides in his heart, and he conquers his ego and duality. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਏਕੋੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa kee jat pat ekou naam hai aape lae savaar ||
english: The One Name is the social status and honor of the devotees; the Lord Himself adorns them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੮॥
transliteration: sadaa saranaaee tis kee jiu bhaavai tiu kaaraj saar ||8||
english: They remain forever in the Protection of His Sanctuary. As it pleases His Will, He arranges their affairs. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਅਲਾਹ ਦੀ ਜਾਪੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhagat niraalee alaah dee jaapai gur veechaar ||
english: The worship of the Lord is unique - it is known only by reflecting upon the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੯॥੧੪॥੩੬॥
transliteration: naanak naam hiradai vasai bhai bhagatee naam savaar ||9||14||36||
english: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with the Naam, through the Lord's Fear and devotion, is embellished with the Naam. ||9||14||36||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਭੋਲਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: an ras mahi bholaaiaa bin naamai dukh paai ||
english: He wanders around, engrossed in other pleasures, but without the Naam, he suffers in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਜਿ ਸਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur purakh na bhetio j sachee boojh bujhaai ||1||
english: He does not meet the True Guru, the Primal Being, who imparts true understanding. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਵਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: e man mere baavale har ras chakh saad paai ||
english: O my insane mind, drink in the sublime essence of the Lord, and savor its taste.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੂੰ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: an ras laagaa too(n) phirahi birathaa janam gavaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Attached to other pleasures, you wander around, and your life wastes away uselessly. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: is jug mahi guramukh niramale sach naam rahahi liv laai ||
english: In this age, the Gurmukhs are pure; they remain absorbed in the love of the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vin karamaa kichh paaeeai nahee kiaa kar kahiaa jaai ||2||
english: Without the destiny of good karma, nothing can be obtained; what can we say or do? ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aap pachhaanahi sabad marahi manahu taj vikaar ||
english: He understands his own self, and dies in the Word of the Shabad; he banishes corruption from his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur saranaaee bhaj pae bakhase bakhasanahaar ||3||
english: He hurries to the Guru's Sanctuary, and is forgiven by the Forgiving Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai sukh na paaeeai naa dukh vichahu jaai ||
english: Without the Name, peace is not obtained, and pain does not depart from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ihu jag maaiaa mohi viaapiaa doojai bharam bhulaai ||4||
english: This world is engrossed in attachment to Maya; it has gone astray in duality and doubt. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dohaaganee pir kee saar na jaanahee kiaa kar karahi seegaar ||
english: The forsaken soul-brides do not know the value of their Husband Lord; how can they decorate themselves?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਲਦੀਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਨ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: anadin sadaa jaladeeaa phirahi sejai ravai na bhataar ||5||
english: Night and day, they continually burn, and they do not enjoy the Bed of their Husband Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sohaaganee mahal paaiaa vichahu aap gavaai ||
english: The happy soul-brides obtain the Mansion of His Presence, eradicating their self-conceit from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ਅਪਣੇ ਸਹਿ ਲਈਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gurasabadee seegaareeaa apane sahi laeeaa milaai ||6||
english: They decorate themselves with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and their Husband Lord unites them with Himself. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣਾ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: maranaa manahu visaariaa maaiaa mohu gubaar ||
english: He has forgotten death, in the darkness of attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਭੀ ਮਰਹਿ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: manamukh mar mar ja(n)mahi bhee marahi jam dar hohi khuaar ||7||
english: The self-willed manmukhs die again and again, and are reborn; they die again, and are miserable at the Gate of Death. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aap milaaian se mile gur sabad veechaar ||
english: They alone are united, whom the Lord unites with Himself; they contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੨੨॥੧੫॥੩੭॥
transliteration: naanak naam samaane mukh ujale tit sachai darabaar ||8||22||15||37||
english: O Nanak, they are absorbed in the Naam; their faces are radiant, in that True Court. ||8||22||15||37||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 asatapadeeaa ghar 2 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਮਨਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਰੁਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch manaae pa(n)ch rusaae ||
english: When the five virtues were reconciled, and the five passions were estranged,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਵਸਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch vasaae pa(n)ch gavaae ||1||
english: I enshrined the five within myself, and cast out the other five. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਨੑ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: inh bidh nagar vuthaa mere bhaaee ||
english: In this way, the village of my body became inhabited, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: durat gaiaa gur giaan driRaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Vice departed, and the Guru's spiritual wisdom was implanted within me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saach dharam kee kar deenee vaar ||
english: The fence of true Dharmic religion has been built around it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਰਹੇ ਮੁਹਕਮ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pharahe muhakam gur giaan beechaar ||2||
english: The spiritual wisdom and reflective meditation of the Guru has become its strong gate. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਖੇਤੀ ਬੀਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: naam khetee beejahu bhaaee meet ||
english: So plant the seed of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O friends, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਉਦਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਨੀਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saudaa karahu gur sevahu neet ||3||
english: Deal only in the constant service of the Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਟ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)t sahaj sukh ke sabh haat ||
english: With intuitive peace and happiness, all the shops are filled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਏਕੈ ਥਾਟ ॥੪॥
transliteration: saah vaapaaree ekai thaat ||4||
english: The Banker and the dealers dwell in the same place. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਜੀਆ ਡੰਨੁ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਨ ਜਗਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jejeeaa da(n)n ko lae na jagaat ||
english: There is no tax on non-believers, nor any fines or taxes at death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਪ ॥੫॥
transliteration: satigur kar deenee dhur kee chhaap ||5||
english: The True Guru has set the Seal of the Primal Lord upon these goods. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਦਿ ਖੇਪ ਚਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: vakhar naam lad khep chalaavahu ||
english: So load the merchandise of the Naam, and set sail with your cargo.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: lai laahaa guramukh ghar aavahu ||6||
english: Earn your profit, as Gurmukh, and you shall return to your own home. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਿਖ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur saahu sikh vanajaare ||
english: The True Guru is the Banker, and His Sikhs are the traders.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: poo(n)jee naam lekhaa saach samhaare ||7||
english: Their merchandise is the Naam, and meditation on the True Lord is their account. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਵਸੈ ਇਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: so vasai it ghar jis gur pooraa sev ||
english: One who serves the True Guru dwells in this house.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨਗਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: abichal nagaree naanak dev ||8||1||
english: O Nanak, the Divine City is eternal. ||8||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
english: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: mere man har siu laagee preet ||
english: My mind is in love with the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har har japat niramal saachee reet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; my lifestyle is pure and true. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਘਣੀ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: darasan kee piaas ghanee chitavat anik prakaar ||
english: I have such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; I think of him in so many ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karahu anugrahu paarabraham har kirapaa dhaar muraar ||1||
english: So be Merciful, O Supreme Lord; shower Your Mercy upon me, O Lord, Destroyer of pride. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਆਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: man paradesee aaiaa milio saadh kai sa(n)g ||
english: My stranger soul has come to join the Saadh Sangat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਤਾ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis vakhar kau chaahataa so paaio naamahi ra(n)g ||2||
english: That commodity, which I longed for, I have found in the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jete maaiaa ra(n)g ras binas jaahi khin maahi ||
english: There are so many pleasures and delights of Maya, but they pass away in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੁੰਚਹਿ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhagat rate tere naam siu sukh bhu(n)chahi sabh thaai ||3||
english: Your devotees are imbued with Your Name; they enjoy peace everywhere. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਚਲਤਉ ਪੇਖੀਐ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag chalatau pekheeai nihachal har ko naau ||
english: The entire world is seen to be passing away; only the Lord's Name is lasting and stable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ਸਾਧ ਸਿਉ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kar mitraaee saadh siu nihachal paavahi thaau ||4||
english: So make friends with the Holy Saints, so that you may obtain a lasting place of rest. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪਾ ਕੋਊ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
transliteration: meet saajan sut ba(n)dhapaa kooo hot na saath ||
english: Friends, acquaintances, children and relatives - none of these shall be your companion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਵਾਹੂ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਦੀਨਾ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਥ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ek nivaahoo raam naam deenaa kaa prabh naath ||5||
english: The Lord's Name alone shall go with you; God is the Master of the meek. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਭਏ ਲਗਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਤੇਹ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal bohith bhae lag saagar tario teh ||
english: The Lord's Lotus Feet are the Boat; attached to Them, you shall cross over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੇਟਿਓ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bhetio pooraa satiguroo saachaa prabh siu neh ||6||
english: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, I embrace True Love for God. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਜਾਚਨਾ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: saadh tere kee jaachanaa visar na saas giraas ||
english: The prayer of Your Holy Saints is, "May I never forget You, for even one breath or morsel of food."

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਾਰਜ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa terai bhaanai kaaraj raas ||7||
english: Whatever is pleasing to Your Will is good; by Your Sweet Will, my affairs are adjusted. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਿਲੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar preetam mile upaje mahaa ana(n)d ||
english: I have met my Beloved, the Ocean of Peace, and Supreme Bliss has welled up within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਮਿਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਟੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sabh dukh mite prabh bhete paramaana(n)d ||8||1||2||
english: Says Nanak, all my pains have been eradicated, meeting with God, the Lord of Supreme Bliss. ||8||1||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਬਿਰਹੜੇ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਛੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਜਤਿ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 birahaRe ghar 4 chha(n)taa kee jat ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Birharray ~ Songs Of Separation, To Be Sung In The Tune Of The Chhants. Fourth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh simareeai piaare darasan kau bal jaau ||1||
english: Remember the Supreme Lord God, O Beloved, and make yourself a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਬੀਸਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਤਜਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis simarat dukh beesarahi piaare so kiu tajanaa jaai ||2||
english: Remembering Him, sorrows are forgotten, O Beloved; how can one forsake Him? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਵੇਚੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ihu tan vechee sa(n)t pahi piaare preetam dei milaai ||3||
english: I would sell this body to the Saint, O Beloved, if he would lead me to my Dear Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਫੀਕੇ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sukh seegaar bikhiaa ke pheeke taj chhode meree maai ||4||
english: The pleasures and adornments of corruption are insipid and useless; I have forsaken and abandoned them, O my Mother. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh taj gae piaare satigur charanee paai ||5||
english: Lust, anger and greed left me, O Beloved, when I fell at the Feet of the True Guru. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jo jan raate raam siu piaare anat na kaahoo jaai ||6||
english: Those humble beings who are imbued with the Lord, O Beloved, do not go anywhere else. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har ras jinhee chaakhiaa piaare tripat rahe aaghaai ||7||
english: Those who have tasted the Lord's sublime essence, O Beloved, remain satisfied and satiated. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਚਲੁ ਗਹਿਆ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)chal gahiaa saadh kaa naanak bhai saagar paar paraai ||8||1||3||
english: One who grasps the Hem of the Gown of the Holy Saint, O Nanak, crosses over the terrible world-ocean. ||8||1||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਬ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh kateeai piaare jab bhetai har raai ||1||
english: The pains of birth and death are removed, O Beloved, when the mortal meets with the Lord, the King. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: su(n)dar sughar sujaan prabh meraa jeevan daras dikhaai ||2||
english: God is so Beautiful, so Refined, so Wise - He is my very life! Reveal to me Your Darshan! ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬੀਛੁਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo jee tujh te beechhure piaare janam marahi bikh khaai ||3||
english: Those beings who are separated from You, O Beloved, are born only to die; they eat the poison of corruption. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jis too(n) melahi so milai piaare tis kai laagau paai ||4||
english: He alone meets You, whom You cause to meet, O Beloved; I fall at his feet. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jo sukh darasan pekhate piaare mukh te kahan na jaai ||5||
english: That happiness which one receives by beholding Your Darshan, O Beloved, cannot be described in words. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saachee preet na tutaee piaare jug jug rahee samaai ||6||
english: True Love cannot be broken, O Beloved; throughout the ages, it remains. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਅਮਰੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa piaare teree amar rajaai ||7||
english: Whatever pleases You is good, O Beloved; Your Will is Eternal. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak ra(n)g rate naaraainai piaare maate sahaj subhaai ||8||2||4||
english: Nanak, those who are imbued with the Love of the All-Pervading Lord, O Beloved, remain intoxicated with His Love, in natural ease. ||8||2||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਤੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਹਉ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh bidh tum hee jaanate piaare kis pahi kahau sunaai ||1||
english: You know all about my condition, O Beloved; who can I speak to about it? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਆ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too(n) daataa jeeaa sabhanaa kaa teraa ditaa pahirahi khaai ||2||
english: You are the Giver of all beings; they eat and wear what You give them. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sukh dukh teree aagiaa piaare doojee naahee jaai ||3||
english: Pleasure and pain come by Your Will, O Beloved; they do not come from any other. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jo too(n) karaavahi so karee piaare avar kichh karan na jaai ||4||
english: Whatever You cause me to do, that I do, O Beloved; I cannot do anything else. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: din rain sabh suhaavane piaare jit japeeai har naau ||5||
english: All my days and nights are blessed, O Beloved, when I chant and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saaee kaar kamaavanee piaare dhur masatak lekh likhaai ||6||
english: He does the deeds, O Beloved, which are pre-ordained, and inscribed upon his forehead. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: eko aap varatadaa piaare ghat ghat rahiaa samaai ||7||
english: The One is Himself prevailing everywhere, O Beloved; He is pervading in each and every heart. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਉਧਰਿ ਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੨੨॥੧੫॥੨॥੪੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar koop te udhar lai piaare naanak har saranaai ||8||3||22||15||2||42||
english: Lift me up out of the deep pit of the world, O Beloved; Nanak has taken to Your Sanctuary. ||8||3||22||15||2||42||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪਟੀ ਲਿਖੀ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 patee likhee ||
english: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Patee Likhee ~ The Poem Of The Alphabet:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਸੈ ਸੋਇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sasai soi srisat jin saajee sabhanaa saahib ek bhaiaa ||
english: Sassa: He who created the world, is the One Lord and Master of all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਤ ਰਹੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sevat rahe chit jinh kaa laagaa aaiaa tinh kaa saphal bhaiaa ||1||
english: Those whose consciousness remains committed to His Service - blessed is their birth and their coming into the world. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man kaahe bhoole mooR manaa ||
english: O mind, why forget Him? You foolish mind!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਬੀਰਾ ਤਉ ਪੜਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab lekhaa devahi beeraa tau paRiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When your account is adjusted, O brother, only then shall you be judged wise. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਈਵੜੀ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: eevaRee aad purakh hai daataa aape sachaa soee ||
english: Eevree: The Primal Lord is the Giver; He alone is True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਨਾ ਅਖਰਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: enaa akharaa mahi jo guramukh boojhai tis sir lekh na hoee ||2||
english: No accounting is due from the Gurmukh who understands the Lord through these letters. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊੜੈ ਉਪਮਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ooRai upamaa taa kee keejai jaa kaa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: Ooraa: Sing the Praises of the One whose limit cannot be found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sevaa karahi seee phal paavahi jinhee sach kamaaiaa ||3||
english: Those who perform service and practice truth, obtain the fruits of their rewards. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਙੰਙੈ ਙਿਆਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: nga(n)ngai ngiaan boojhai je koee paRiaa pa(n)dit soee ||
english: Nganga: One who understands spiritual wisdom becomes a Pandit, a religious scholar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sarab jeeaa mahi eko jaanai taa haumai kahai na koee ||4||
english: One who recognizes the One Lord among all beings does not talk of ego. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਕੈ ਕੇਸ ਪੁੰਡਰ ਜਬ ਹੂਏ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਬੂਣੈ ਉਜਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kakai kes pu(n)dar jab hooe vin saaboonai ujaliaa ||
english: Kakka: When the hair grows grey, then it shines without shampoo.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੇ ਹੇਰੂ ਆਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਲਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jam raaje ke heroo aae maaiaa kai sa(n)gal ba(n)dh laiaa ||5||
english: The hunters of the King of Death come, and bind him in the chains of Maya. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਖੈ ਖੁੰਦਕਾਰੁ ਸਾਹ ਆਲਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਖਰੀਦਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: khakhai khu(n)dakaar saah aalam kar khareed jin kharach deeaa ||
english: Khakha: The Creator is the King of the world; He enslaves by giving nourishment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਅਵਰੀ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan jaa kai sabh jag baadhiaa avaree kaa nahee hukam paiaa ||6||
english: By His Binding, all the world is bound; no other Command prevails. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਗੈ ਗੋਇ ਗਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਗਲੀ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਰਬਿ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gagai goi gaai jin chhodee galee gobid garab bhaiaa ||
english: Gagga: One who renounces the singing of the songs of the Lord of the Universe, becomes arrogant in his speech.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘੜਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਵੀ ਸਾਜੀ ਚਾੜਣ ਵਾਹੈ ਤਈ ਕੀਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ghaR bhaa(n)de jin aavee saajee chaaRan vaahai taee keeaa ||7||
english: One who has shaped the pots, and made the world the kiln, decides when to put them in it. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਘੈ ਘਾਲ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਘਾਲੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: ghaghai ghaal sevak je ghaalai sabad guroo kai laag rahai ||
english: Ghagha: The servant who performs service, remains attached to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਮਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: buraa bhalaa je sam kar jaanai in bidh saahib ramat rahai ||8||
english: One who recognizes bad and good as one and the same - in this way he is absorbed into the Lord and Master. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਚੈ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੇ ਚਾਰੇ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰਿ ਜੁਗਾ ॥
transliteration: chachai chaar ved jin saaje chaare khaanee chaar jugaa ||
english: Chacha: He created the four Vedas, the four sources of creation, and the four ages

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਖਾਣੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਆਪਿ ਥੀਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: jug jug jogee khaanee bhogee paRiaa pa(n)dit aap theeaa ||9||
english: - through each and every age, He Himself has been the Yogi, the enjoyer, the Pandit and the scholar. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛਛੈ ਛਾਇਆ ਵਰਤੀ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
transliteration: chhachhai chhaaiaa varatee sabh a(n)tar teraa keeaa bharam hoaa ||
english: Chhachha: Ignorance exists within everyone; doubt is Your doing, O Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: bharam upaai bhulaaeean aape teraa karam hoaa tinh guroo miliaa ||10||
english: Having created doubt, You Yourself cause them to wander in delusion; those whom You bless with Your Mercy meet with the Guru. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਜੈ ਜਾਨੁ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭੀਖ ਭਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jajai jaan ma(n)gat jan jaachai lakh chauraaseeh bheekh bhaviaa ||
english: Jajja: That humble being who begs for wisdom has wandered begging through 8.4 million incarnations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਏਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਮੈ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: eko levai eko devai avar na doojaa mai suniaa ||11||
english: The One Lord takes away, and the One Lord gives; I have not heard of any other. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝਝੈ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇਣਾ ਸੁ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jhajhai jhoor marahu kiaa praanee jo kichh denaa s de rahiaa ||
english: Jhajha: O mortal being, why are you dying of anxiety? Whatever the Lord is to give, He shall keep on giving.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਜਿਉ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: de de vekhai hukam chalaae jiu jeeaa kaa rijak paiaa ||12||
english: He gives, and gives, and watches over us; according to the Orders which He issues, His beings receive nourishment. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਞੰਞੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਦੇਖਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: nja(n)njai nadar kare jaa dekhaa doojaa koee naahee ||
english: Nyanya: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then I do not behold any other.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਏਕੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: eko rav rahiaa sabh thaaee ek vasiaa man maahee ||13||
english: The One Lord is totally pervading everywhere; the One Lord abides within the mind. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਟਟੈ ਟੰਚੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਘੜੀ ਕਿ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ॥
transliteration: tatai ta(n)ch karahu kiaa praanee ghaRee k muhat k uth chalanaa ||
english: Tatta: Why do you practice hypocrisy, O mortal? In a moment, in an instant, you shall have to get up and depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਹੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਜਿ ਪੜਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: jooai janam na haarahu apanaa bhaaj paRahu tum har saranaa ||14||
english: Don't lose your life in the gamble - hurry to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਠਠੈ ਠਾਢਿ ਵਰਤੀ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: thathai thaadh varatee tin a(n)tar har charanee jinh kaa chit laagaa ||
english: T'hat'ha: Peace pervades within those who link their consciousness to the Lord's Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਤਉ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: chit laagaa seee jan nisatare tau parasaadee sukh paaiaa ||15||
english: Those humble beings, whose consciousness is so linked, are saved; by Your Grace, they obtain peace. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡਡੈ ਡੰਫੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਚਲਣਾ ॥
transliteration: dadai da(n)ph karahu kiaa praanee jo kichh hoaa s sabh chalanaa ||
english: Dadda: Why do you make such ostentatious shows, O mortal? Whatever exists, shall all pass away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: tisai sarevahu taa sukh paavahu sarab nira(n)tar rav rahiaa ||16||
english: So serve Him, who is contained and pervading among everyone, and you shall obtain peace. ||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਢਢੈ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੈ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dhadhai dhaahi usaarai aape jiu tis bhaavai tivai kare ||
english: Dhadha: He Himself establishes and disestablishes; as it pleases His Will, so does He act.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: kar kar vekhai hukam chalaae tis nisataare jaa kau nadar kare ||17||
english: Having created the creation, He watches over it; He issues His Commands, and emancipates those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace. ||17||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਣਾਣੈ ਰਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: naanai ravat rahai ghat a(n)tar har gun gaavai soee ||
english: Nanna: One whose heart is filled with the Lord, sings His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: aape aap milaae karataa punarap janam na hoee ||18||
english: One whom the Creator Lord unites with Himself, is not consigned to reincarnation. ||18||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਤੈ ਤਾਰੂ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tatai taaroo bhavajal hoaa taa kaa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: Tatta: The terrible world-ocean is so very deep; its limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਰ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਮ ਬੂਡਸਿ ਤਾਰਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਤਾਰਣ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naa tar naa tulahaa ham boodas taar lehi taaran raaiaa ||19||
english: I do not have a boat, or even a raft; I am drowning - save me, O Savior King! ||19||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਥੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਥਾਨੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
transliteration: thathai thaan thaana(n)tar soee jaa kaa keeaa sabh hoaa ||
english: T'hat'ha: In all places and interspaces, He is; everything which exists, is by His doing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲਾ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: kiaa bharam kiaa maaiaa kaheeai jo tis bhaavai soee bhalaa ||20||
english: What is doubt? What is called Maya? Whatever pleases Him is good. ||20||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਦੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਊ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਆਪਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dadai dos na deoo kisai dos kara(n)maa aapaniaa ||
english: Dadda: Do not blame anyone else; blame instead your own actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਅਵਰ ਜਨਾ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: jo mai keeaa so mai paaiaa dos na deejai avar janaa ||21||
english: Whatever I did, for that I have suffered; I do not blame anyone else. ||21||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਧੈ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਹਰਿ ਚੀਜੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਰੰਗ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: dhadhai dhaar kalaa jin chhodee har cheejee jin ra(n)g keeaa ||
english: Dhadha: His power established and upholds the earth; the Lord has imparted His color to everything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਦੀਆ ਸਭਨੀ ਲੀਆ ਕਰਮੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: tis daa deeaa sabhanee leeaa karamee karamee hukam paiaa ||22||
english: His gifts are received by everyone; all act according to His Command. ||22||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੰਨੈ ਨਾਹ ਭੋਗ ਨਿਤ ਭੋਗੈ ਨਾ ਡੀਠਾ ਨਾ ਸੰਮ੍ਹਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: na(n)nai naah bhog nit bhogai naa deethaa naa sa(n)mhaliaa ||
english: Nanna: The Husband Lord enjoys eternal pleasures, but He is not seen or understood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਲੀ ਹਉ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਭੈਣੇ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: galee hau sohaagan bhaine ka(n)t na kabahoo(n) mai miliaa ||23||
english: I am called the happy soul-bride, O sister, but my Husband Lord has never met me. ||23||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਪੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: papai paatisaahu paramesar vekhan kau parapa(n)ch keeaa ||
english: Pappa: The Supreme King, the Transcendent Lord, created the world, and watches over it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: dekhai boojhai sabh kichh jaanai a(n)tar baahar rav rahiaa ||24||
english: He sees and understands, and knows everything; inwardly and outwardly, he is fully pervading. ||24||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਫੈ ਫਾਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਾਸਾ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਲਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: phaphai phaahee sabh jag phaasaa jam kai sa(n)gal ba(n)dh laiaa ||
english: Faffa: The whole world is caught in the noose of Death, and all are bound by its chains.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇ ਨਰ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਭਜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee se nar ubare j har saranaagat bhaj paiaa ||25||
english: By Guru's Grace, they alone are saved, who hurry to enter the Lord's Sanctuary. ||25||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਬੈ ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲਣ ਲਾਗਾ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਚਾਰਿ ਜੁਗਾ ॥
transliteration: babai baajee khelan laagaa chaupaR keete chaar jugaa ||
english: Babba: He set out to play the game, on the chess-board of the four ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਸਾਰੀ ਕੀਤੇ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲਣਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਗਾ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh saaree keete paasaa dhaalan aap lagaa ||26||
english: He made all beings and creatures his chessmen, and He Himself threw the dice. ||26||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਭੈ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhabhai bhaalahi se phal paavahi gur parasaadee jinh kau bhau paiaa ||
english: Bhabha: Those who search, find the fruits of their rewards; by Guru's Grace, they live in the Fear of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: manamukh phirahi na chetahi mooRe lakh chauraaseeh pher paiaa ||27||
english: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, and they do not remember the Lord; the fools are consigned to the cycle of 8.4 million incarnations. ||27||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਬ ਚੇਤਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)mai mohu maran madhusoodan maran bhaiaa tab chetaviaa ||
english: Mamma: In emotional attachment, he dies; he only thinks of the Lord, the Love of Nectar, when he dies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਵਰੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੰਮਾ ਅਖਰੁ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨੮॥
