transliteration: kaaiaa bheetar avaro paRiaa ma(n)maa akhar veesariaa ||28||
english: As long as the body is alive, he reads other things, and forgets the letter 'm', which stands for marnaa - death. ||28||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਯਯੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਕਦ ਹੀ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: yayai janam na hovee kad hee je kar sach pachhaanai ||
english: Yaya: He is never reincarnated again, if he recognizes the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: guramukh aakhai guramukh boojhai guramukh eko jaanai ||29||
english: The Gurmukh speaks, the Gurmukh understands, and the Gurmukh knows only the One Lord. ||29||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਰੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਕੀਏ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: raarai rav rahiaa sabh a(n)tar jete keee ja(n)taa ||
english: Rarra: The Lord is contained among all; He created all beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਸਭ ਲਾਏ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: ja(n)t upaai dha(n)dhai sabh laae karam hoaa tin naam laiaa ||30||
english: Having created His beings, He has put them all to work; they alone remember the Naam, upon whom He bestows His Grace. ||30||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਲੈ ਲਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: lalai laai dha(n)dhai jin chhodee meethaa maaiaa mohu keeaa ||
english: Lalla: He has assigned people to their tasks, and made the love of Maya seem sweet to them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਣਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: khaanaa peenaa sam kar sahanaa bhaanai taa kai hukam paiaa ||31||
english: We eat and drink; we should endure equally whatever occurs, by His Will, by His Command. ||31||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਵੈ ਵਾਸੁਦੇਉ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਵੇਸੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: vavai vaasudeu paramesar vekhan kau jin ves keeaa ||
english: Wawa: The all-pervading Transcendent Lord beholds the world; He created the form it wears.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਖੈ ਚਾਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੩੨॥
transliteration: vekhai chaakhai sabh kichh jaanai a(n)tar baahar rav rahiaa ||32||
english: He beholds, tastes, and knows everything; He is pervading and permeating inwardly and outwardly. ||32||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੜਾੜੈ ਰਾੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
transliteration: RaaRai raaR karahi kiaa praanee tisahi dhiaavahu j amar hoaa ||
english: Rarra: Why do you quarrel, O mortal? Meditate on the Imperishable Lord,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ਓਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥੩੩॥
transliteration: tisahi dhiaavahu sach samaavahu os vitahu kurabaan keeaa ||33||
english: and be absorbed into the True One. Become a sacrifice to Him. ||33||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਾਹੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: haahai hor na koee daataa jee upaai jin rijak deeaa ||
english: Haha: There is no other Giver than Him; having created the creatures, He gives them nourishment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਆ ॥੩੪॥
transliteration: har naam dhiaavahu har naam samaavahu anadin laahaa har naam leeaa ||34||
english: Meditate on the Lord's Name, be absorbed into the Lord's Name, and night and day, reap the Profit of the Lord's Name. ||34||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਇੜੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aaiRai aap kare jin chhodee jo kichh karanaa s kar rahiaa ||
english: Airaa: He Himself created the world; whatever He has to do, He continues to do.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਇਰ ਇਵ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੩੫॥੧॥
transliteration: kare karaae sabh kichh jaanai naanak saair iv kahiaa ||35||1||
english: He acts, and causes others to act, and He knows everything; so says Nanak, the poet. ||35||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਪਟੀ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 3 patee ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Third Mehl, Patee - The Alphabet:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਯੋ ਅੰਙੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਇਆ ਕਾਖੈ ਘੰਙੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ayo a(n)ngai sabh jag aaiaa kaakhai gha(n)ngai kaal bhaiaa ||
english: Ayo, Angai: The whole world which was created - Kaahkai, Ghangai: It shall pass away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੀਰੀ ਲਲੀ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਪੜਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: reeree lalee paap kamaane paR avagan gun veesariaa ||1||
english: Reeree, Laalee: People commit sins, and falling into vice, forget virtue. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਐਸਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਤੂੰ ਕੀ ਪੜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: man aisaa lekhaa too(n) kee paRiaa ||
english: O mortal, why have you studied such an account,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਣਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: lekhaa denaa terai sir rahiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: which shall call you to answer for payment? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧੰਙਾਇਐ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨੰਨੈ ਨਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sidha(n)ngaaiai simarahi naahee na(n)nai naa tudh naam laiaa ||
english: Sidhan, Ngaayiyai: You do not remember the Lord. Nanna: You do not take the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛਛੈ ਛੀਜਹਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਜਮਿ ਪਾਕੜਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chhachhai chheejahi ahinis mooRe kiu chhootahi jam paakaRiaa ||2||
english: Chhachha: You are wearing away, every night and day; you fool, how will you find release? You are held in the grip of death. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਬੈ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: babai boojhahi naahee mooRe bharam bhule teraa janam gaiaa ||
english: Babba: You do not understand, you fool; deluded by doubt, you are wasting your life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਓ ਪਾਧਾ ਅਵਰਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਰੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anahodaa naau dharaaio paadhaa avaraa kaa bhaar tudh laiaa ||3||
english: Without justification, you call yourself a teacher; thus you take on the loads of others. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਜੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jajai jot hir laee teree mooRe a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaavahigaa ||
english: Jajja: You have been robbed of your Light, you fool; in the end, you shall have to depart, and you shall regret and repent.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਤੂੰ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਵਹਿਗਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ek sabad too(n) cheenahi naahee phir phir joonee aavahigaa ||4||
english: You have not remembered the One Word of the Shabad, and so you shall have to enter the womb over and over again. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੜੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਅਵਰਾ ਨੋ ਨ ਸਿਖਾਲਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh sir likhiaa so paR pa(n)dit avaraa no na sikhaal bikhiaa ||
english: Read that which is written on your forehead, O Pandit, and do not teach wickedness to others.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਪਇਆ ਪਾਧੇ ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਗਲਿ ਚਾਟੜਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: pahilaa phaahaa paiaa paadhe pichho de gal chaataRiaa ||5||
english: First, the teacher is tied down, and then, the noose is placed around the pupil's neck. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਸੈ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਗਇਓ ਮੂੜੇ ਏਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਕੁਥਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sasai sa(n)jam gaio mooRe ek daan tudh kuthaai laiaa ||
english: Sassa: You have lost your self-discipline, you fool, and you have accepted an offering under false pretenses.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਜਜਮਾਨ ਕੀ ਸਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਏਤੁ ਧਾਨਿ ਖਾਧੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saaee putree jajamaan kee saa teree et dhaan khaadhai teraa janam gaiaa ||6||
english: The daughter of the alms-giver is just like your own; by accepting this payment for performing the wedding ceremony, you have cursed your own life. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੰਮੈ ਮਤਿ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)mai mat hir laee teree mooRe haumai vadaa rog paiaa ||
english: Mamma: You have been cheated out your intellect, you fool, and you are afflicted with the great disease of ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: a(n)tar aatamai braham na cheenhiaa maaiaa kaa muhataaj bhaiaa ||7||
english: Within your innermost self, you do not recognize God, and you compromise yourself for the sake of Maya. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਭਰਮਿਓਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਮਤਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kakai kaam krodh bharamiohu mooRe mamataa laage tudh har visariaa ||
english: Kakka: You wander around in sexual desire and anger, you fool; attached to possessiveness, you have forgotten the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਹਿ ਗੁਣਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਤੂੰ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: paRahi gunahi too(n) bahut pukaarahi vin boojhe too(n) doob muaa ||8||
english: You read, and reflect, and proclaim out loud, but without understanding, you are drowned to death. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਤੈ ਤਾਮਸਿ ਜਲਿਓਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਥਥੈ ਥਾਨ ਭਰਿਸਟੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
transliteration: tatai taamas jaliohu mooRe thathai thaan bharisat hoaa ||
english: Tatta: In anger, you are burnt, you fool. T'hat'ha: That place where you live, is cursed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਘੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਮੂੜੇ ਦਦੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: ghaghai ghar ghar phirahi too(n) mooRe dadai daan na tudh laiaa ||9||
english: Ghagha: You go begging from door to door, you fool. Dadda: But still, you do not receive the gift. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਪੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਵਹੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਪਰਪੰਚਿ ਤੂੰ ਪਲਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: papai paar na pavahee mooRe parapa(n)ch too(n) palach rahiaa ||
english: Pappa: You shall not be able to swim across, you fool, since you are engrossed in worldly affairs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਓਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਇਹੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: sachai aap khuaaiohu mooRe ihu sir terai lekh paiaa ||10||
english: The True Lord Himself has ruined you, you fool; this is the destiny written on your forehead. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਭੈ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੁਬੋਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਲਤਾਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhabhai bhavajal dubohu mooRe maaiaa vich galataan bhaiaa ||
english: Bhabha: You have drowned in the terrifying world-ocean, you fool, and you have become engrossed in Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee eko jaanai ek ghaRee mahi paar paiaa ||11||
english: One who comes to know the One Lord, by Guru's Grace, is carried across in an instant. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ਆਈਆ ਮੂੜੇ ਵਾਸੁਦੇਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: vavai vaaree aaeeaa mooRe vaasudeu tudh veesariaa ||
english: Wawa: Your turn has come, you fool, but you have forgotten the Lord of Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਨ ਲਹਸਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: eh velaa na lahasahi mooRe phir too(n) jam kai vas paiaa ||12||
english: This opportunity shall not come again, you fool; you shall fall under the power of the Messenger of Death. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਝਝੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਝੂਰਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਖਾ ॥
transliteration: jhajhai kade na jhoorahi mooRe satigur kaa upades sun too(n) vikhaa ||
english: Jhajha: You shall never have to regret and repent, you fool, if you listen to the Teachings of the True Guru, for even an instant.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ਬੁਰਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: satigur baajhahu gur nahee koee nigure kaa hai naau buraa ||13||
english: Without the True Guru, there is no Guru at all; one who is without a Guru has a bad reputation. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਧੈ ਧਾਵਤ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਖੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhadhai dhaavat varaj rakh mooRe a(n)tar terai nidhaan paiaa ||
english: Dhadha: Restrain your wandering mind, you fool; deep within you the treasure is to be found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਜੁਗਾ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: guramukh hovahi taa har ras peevahi jugaa juga(n)tar khaahi paiaa ||14||
english: When one becomes Gurmukh, then he drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; throughout the ages, he continues to drink it in. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਗੈ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਗਲੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gagai gobid chit kar mooRe galee kinai na paaiaa ||
english: Gagga: Keep the Lord of the Universe in your mind, you fool; by mere words, no one has ever attained Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ ਮੂੜੇ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਸਭ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: gur ke charan hiradai vasaai mooRe pichhale gunah sabh bakhas laiaa ||15||
english: Enshrine the Guru's feet within your heart, you fool, and all your past sins shall be forgiven. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਾਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਬੂਝੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੂੜੇ ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: haahai har kathaa boojh too(n) mooRe taa sadaa sukh hoee ||
english: Haha: Understand the Lord's Sermon, you fool; only then shall you attain eternal peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: manamukh paRahi tetaa dukh laagai vin satigur mukat na hoee ||16||
english: The more the self-willed manmukhs read, the more pain they suffer. Without the True Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਰੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: raarai raam chit kar mooRe hiradai jinh kai rav rahiaa ||
english: Rarra: Center your consciousness on the Lord, you fool; abide with those whose hearts are filled with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਰਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਬੂਝਿ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee jinhee raam pachhaataa niragun raam tinhee boojh lahiaa ||17||
english: By Guru's Grace, those who recognize the Lord, understand the absolute Lord. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਅਕਥੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਿਆ ॥
transliteration: teraa a(n)t na jaaee lakhiaa akath na jaaee har kathiaa ||
english: Your limits cannot be known; the indescribable Lord cannot be described.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਿਬੜਿਆ ॥੧੮॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jinh kau satigur miliaa tinh kaa lekhaa nibaRiaa ||18||1||2||
english: O Nanak, whose who have met the True Guru, have their accounts settled. ||18||1||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 chha(n)t ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Chhant, First House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਲੀਆਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dh joban baalaReee meraa pir raleeaalaa raam ||
english: O beautiful young bride, my Beloved Lord is very playful.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਨੇਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dhan pir nehu ghanaa ras preet daiaalaa raam ||
english: When the bride enshrines great love for her Husband Lord, He becomes merciful, and loves her in return.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dhan pirahi melaa hoi suaamee aap prabh kirapaa kare ||
english: The soul-bride meets her Husband Lord, when the Lord Master Himself showers His favor upon her.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜਾ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸਾਤ ਸਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sejaa suhaavee sa(n)g pir kai saat sar a(n)mrit bhare ||
english: Her bed is decorated in the company of her Beloved, and her seven pools are filled with ambrosial nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਓ ॥
transliteration: kar daiaa maiaa daiaal saache sabad mil gun gaavao ||
english: Be kind and compassionate to me, O Merciful True Lord, that I may obtain the Word of the Shabad, and sing Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਗਸੀ ਮੁੰਧ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanakaa har var dekh bigasee mu(n)dh man omaahao ||1||
english: O Nanak, gazing upon her Husband Lord, the soul-bride is delighted, and her mind is filled with joy. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਲੋਨੜੀਏ ਇਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dh sahaj salonaReee ik prem bina(n)tee raam ||
english: O bride of natural beauty, offer your loving prayers to the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਮਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mai man tan har bhaavai prabh sa(n)gam raatee raam ||
english: The Lord is pleasing to my mind and body; I am intoxicated in my Lord God's Company.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh prem raatee har bina(n)tee naam har kai sukh vasai ||
english: Imbued with the Love of God, I pray to the Lord, and through the Lord's Name, I abide in peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਗੁਣ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਗੁਣਹ ਵਸਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਨਸੈ ॥
transliteration: tau gun pachhaanahi taa prabh jaanahi gunah vas avagan nasai ||
english: If you recognize His Glorious Virtues, then you shall come to know God; thus virtue shall dwell in you, and sin shall run away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਾ ਕਹਣਿ ਸੁਨਣਿ ਨ ਧੀਜਏ ॥
transliteration: tudh baajh ik til rahi na saakaa kahan sunan na dheejae ||
english: Without You, I cannot survive, even for an instant; by merely talking and listening about You, I am not satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanakaa priu priu kar pukaare rasan ras man bheejae ||2||
english: Nanak proclaims, "O Beloved, O Beloved!" His tongue and mind are drenched with the Lord's sublime essence. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀਹੋ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sakheeho sahelaReeho meraa pir vanajaaraa raam ||
english: O my companions and friends, my Husband Lord is the merchant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋੁ ਵਣੰਜੜਿਆ ਰਸਿ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har naamou vana(n)jaRiaa ras mol apaaraa raam ||
english: I have purchased the Lord's Name; its sweetness and value are unlimited.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲੋ ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਲੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮੁੰਧ ਭਲੀ ॥
transliteration: mol amolo sach ghar dholo prabh bhaavai taa mu(n)dh bhalee ||
english: His value is invaluable; the Beloved dwells in His true home. If it is pleasing to God, then He blesses His bride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਹਉ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ਦਰਿ ਖਲੀ ॥
transliteration: ik sa(n)g har kai karahi raleeaa hau pukaaree dar khalee ||
english: Some enjoy sweet pleasures with the Lord, while I stand crying at His door.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਏ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath sreedhar aap kaaraj saarae ||
english: The Creator, the Cause of causes, the All-powerful Lord Himself arranges our affairs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਭ ਸਾਧਾਰਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree dhan sohaagan sabad abh saadhaarae ||3||
english: O Nanak, blessed is the soul-bride, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace; she enshrines the Word of the Shabad in her heart. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਅੜੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ham ghar saachaa sohilaRaa prabh aaiaRe meetaa raam ||
english: In my home, the true songs of rejoicing resound; the Lord God, my Friend, has come to me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੜਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਅੜਾ ਦੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: raave ra(n)g raataRiaa man leeaRaa deetaa raam ||
english: He enjoys me, and imbued with His Love, I have captivated His heart, and given mine to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਲੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa man deeaa har var leeaa jiu bhaavai tiu raavae ||
english: I gave my mind, and obtained the Lord as my Husband; as it pleases His Will, He enjoys me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਭਾਗੈ ਘਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: tan man pir aagai sabad sabhaagai ghar a(n)mrit phal paavae ||
english: I have placed my body and mind before my Husband Lord, and through the Shabad, I have been blessed. Within the home of my own self, I have obtained the ambrosial fruit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਠਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈਐ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: budh paath na paaeeai bahu chaturaaeeai bhaai milai man bhaane ||
english: He is not obtained by intellectual recitation or great cleverness; only by love does the mind obtain Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਲੋਕਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak thaakur meet hamaare ham naahee lokaane ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Master is my Best Friend; I am not an ordinary person. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦੋ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: anahado anahad vaajai run jhunakaare raam ||
english: The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds with the vibrations of the celestial instruments.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: meraa mano meraa man raataa laal piaare raam ||
english: My mind, my mind is imbued with the Love of my Darling Beloved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੁੰਨ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anadin raataa man bairaagee su(n)n ma(n)dal ghar paaiaa ||
english: Night and day, my detached mind remains absorbed in the Lord, and I obtain my home in the profound trance of the celestial void.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aad purakh apara(n)par piaaraa satigur alakh lakhaaiaa ||
english: The True Guru has revealed to me the Primal Lord, the Infinite, my Beloved, the Unseen.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸਣਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aasan baisan thir naaraain tit man raataa veechaare ||
english: The Lord's posture and His seat are permanent; my mind is absorbed in reflective contemplation upon Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate bairaagee anahad run jhunakaare ||1||
english: O Nanak, the detached ones are imbued with His Name, the unstruck melody, and the celestial vibrations. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਤਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਪੁਰੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tit agam tit agam pure kahu kit bidh jaaeeai raam ||
english: Tell me, how can I reach that unreachable, that unreachable city?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਸਾਰਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sach sa(n)jamo saar gunaa gurasabad kamaaeeai raam ||
english: By practicing truthfulness and self-restraint, by contemplating His Glorious Virtues, and living the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sach sabad kamaaeeai nij ghar jaaeeai paaeeai gunee nidhaanaa ||
english: Practicing the True Word of the Shabad, one comes to the home of his own inner being, and obtains the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਖਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਡਾਲੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tit saakhaa mool pat nahee daalee sir sabhanaa paradhaanaa ||
english: He has no stems, roots, leaves or branches, but He is the Supreme Lord over the heads of all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਥਾਕੀ ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jap tap kar kar sa(n)jam thaakee hath nigrahi nahee paaeeai ||
english: Practicing intensive meditation, chanting and self-discipline, people have grown weary; stubbornly practicing these rituals, they still have not found Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sahaj mile jagajeevan satigur boojh bujhaaeeai ||2||
english: O Nanak, through spiritual wisdom, the Lord, the Life of the world, is met; the True Guru imparts this understanding. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਰਤਨ ਘਣੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur saagaro ratanaagar tit ratan ghanere raam ||
english: The Guru is the ocean, the mountain of jewels, overflowing with jewels.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਮਜਨੋ ਸਪਤ ਸਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kar majano sapat sare man niramal mere raam ||
english: Take your bath in the seven seas, O my mind, and become pure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲਿ ਨੑਾਏ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: niramal jal nhaae jaa prabh bhaae pa(n)ch mile veechaare ||
english: One bathes in the water of purity when it is pleasing to God, and obtains the five virtues by reflective meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਤਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaam karodh kapat bikhiaa taj sach naam ur dhaare ||
english: Renouncing sexual desire, anger, deceit and corruption, he enshrines the True Name in his heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਲਬ ਥਾਕੇ ਪਾਏ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai lobh lahar lab thaake paae deen daiaalaa ||
english: When the waves of ego, greed and avarice subside, he finds the Lord Master, Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak gur samaan teerath nahee koee saache gur gopaalaa ||3||
english: O Nanak, there is no place of pilgrimage comparable to the Guru; the True Guru is the Lord of the world. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਨੁ ਬਨੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: hau ban bano dekh rahee trin dekh sabaaiaa raam ||
english: I have searched the jungles and forests, and looked upon all the fields.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੋ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tribhavano tujhahi keeaa sabh jagat sabaaiaa raam ||
english: You created the three worlds, the entire universe, everything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: teraa sabh keeaa too(n) thir theeaa tudh samaan ko naahee ||
english: You created everything; You alone are permanent. Nothing is equal to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) daataa sabh jaachik tere tudh bin kis saalaahee ||
english: You are the Giver - all are Your beggars; without You, who should we praise?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: anama(n)giaa daan deejai daate teree bhagat bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
english: You bestow Your gifts, even when we do not ask for them, O Great Giver; devotion to You is a treasure over-flowing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na hoee naanak kahai veechaaraa ||4||2||
english: Without the Lord's Name, there is no liberation; so says Nanak, the meek. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: meraa mano meraa man raataa raam piaare raam ||
english: My mind, my mind is attuned to the Love of my Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sach saahibo aad purakh apara(n)paro dhaare raam ||
english: The True Lord Master, the Primal Being, the Infinite One, is the Support of the earth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar apar apaaraa paarabraham paradhaano ||
english: He is unfathomable, unapproachable, infinite and incomparable. He is the Supreme Lord God, the Lord above all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਸਭੁ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: aad jugaadee hai bhee hosee avar jhoothaa sabh maano ||
english: He is the Lord, from the beginning, throughout the ages, now and forevermore; know that all else is false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam kee saar na jaanai surat mukat kiu paaeeai ||
english: If one does not appreciate the value of good deeds and Dharmic faith, how can one obtain clarity of consciousness and liberation?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh sabad pachhaanai ahinis naam dhiaaeeai ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Word of the Shabad; night and day, he meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: meraa mano meraa man maaniaa naam sakhaaee raam ||
english: My mind, my mind has come to accept, that the Naam is our only Friend.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa maaiaa sa(n)g na jaaee raam ||
english: Egotism, worldly attachment, and the lures of Maya shall not go with you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maataa pit bhaaee sut chaturaaee sa(n)g na sa(n)pai naare ||
english: Mother, father, famliy, children, cleverness, property and spouses - none of these shall go with you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਇਰ ਕੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਚਰਣ ਤਲੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saair kee putree parahar tiaagee charan talai veechaare ||
english: I have renounced Maya, the daughter of the ocean; reflecting upon reality, I have trampled it under my feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਇਕੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aad purakh ik chalat dikhaaiaa jah dekhaa tah soee ||
english: The Primal Lord has revealed this wondrous show; wherever I look, there I see Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak har kee bhagat na chhodau sahaje hoi s hoee ||2||
english: O Nanak, I shall not forsake the Lord's devotional worship; in the natural course, what shall be, shall be. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: meraa mano meraa man niramal saach samaale raam ||
english: My mind, my mind has become immaculately pure, contemplating the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਮੇਟਿ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਮ ਨਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: avagan met chale gun sa(n)gam naale raam ||
english: I have dispelled my vices, and now I walk in the company of the virtuous.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੋ ॥
transliteration: avagan parahar karanee saaree dar sachai sachiaaro ||
english: Discarding my vices, I do good deeds, and in the True Court, I am judged as true.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaavan thaak rahaae guramukh tat veechaaro ||
english: My coming and going has come to an end; as Gurmukh, I reflect upon the nature of reality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸਖਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: saajan meet sujaan sakhaa too(n) sach milai vadiaaee ||
english: O my Dear Friend, You are my all-knowing companion; grant me the glory of Your True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਐਸੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam ratan paragaasiaa aisee guramat paaee ||3||
english: O Nanak, the jewel of the Naam has been revealed to me; such are the Teachings I have received from the Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਅੰਜਨੋ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sach a(n)jano a(n)jan saar nira(n)jan raataa raam ||
english: I have carefully applied the healing ointment to my eyes, and I am attuned to the Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: man tan rav rahiaa jagajeevano daataa raam ||
english: He is permeating my mind and body, the Life of the world, the Lord, the Great Giver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan daataa har man raataa sahaj milai melaaiaa ||
english: My mind is imbued with the Lord, the Great Giver, the Life of the world; I have merged and blended with Him, with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸਭਾ ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saadh sabhaa sa(n)taa kee sa(n)gat nadar prabhoo sukh paaiaa ||
english: In the Company of the Holy, and the Saints' Society, by God's Grace, peace is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਚੂਕੇ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: har kee bhagat rate bairaagee chooke moh piaasaa ||
english: The renunciates remain absorbed in devotional worship to the Lord; they are rid of emotional attachment and desire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਤੀਣੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak haumai maar pateene virale daas udaasaa ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, how rare is that unattached servant, who conquers his ego, and remains pleased with the Lord. ||4||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 chha(n)t ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Chhant, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਉ ਜਾਈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sabhanee thaaee jithai hau jaaee saachaa sirajanahaar jeeu ||
english: You are everywhere, wherever I go, O True Creator Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa kaa daataa karam bidhaataa dookh bisaaranahaar jeeu ||
english: You are the Giver of all, the Architect of Destiny, the Dispeller of distress.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dookh bisaaranahaar suaamee keetaa jaa kaa hovai ||
english: The Lord Master is the Dispeller of distress; all that happens is by His doing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਪਾਪਾ ਕੇਰੇ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kot kota(n)tar paapaa kere ek ghaRee mahi khovai ||
english: Millions upon millions of sins, He destroys in an instant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸ ਸਿ ਹੰਸਾ ਬਗ ਸਿ ਬਗਾ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)s s ha(n)saa bag s bagaa ghat ghat kare beechaar jeeu ||
english: He calls a swan a swan, and a crane a crane; He contemplates each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਉ ਜਾਈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too(n) sabhanee thaaee jithai hau jaaee saachaa sirajanahaar jeeu ||1||
english: You are everywhere, wherever I go, O True Creator Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jinh ik man dhiaaiaa tinh sukh paaiaa te virale sa(n)saar jeeu ||
english: Those who meditate on Him single-mindedly obtain peace; how rare are they in this world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਹਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tin jam neR na aavai gurasabad kamaavai kabahu na aavahi haar jeeu ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not draw near those who live the Guru's Teachings; they never return defeated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: te kabahu na haarahi har har gun saarahi tinh jam neR na aavai ||
english: Those who appreciate the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, never suffer defeat; the Messenger of Death does not even approach them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maran tinhaa kaa chookaa jo har laage paavai ||
english: Birth and death are ended for those who are attached to the feet of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: guramat har ras har phal paaiaa har har naam ur dhaar jeeu ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, they obtain the sublime essence of the Lord, and the fruit of the Lord; they enshrine the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in their hearts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jinh ik man dhiaaiaa tinh sukh paaiaa te virale sa(n)saar jeeu ||2||
english: Those who meditate on Him single-mindedly obtain peace; how rare are they in this world. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jin jagat upaaiaa dha(n)dhai laaiaa tisai vitahu kurabaan jeeu ||
english: He who created the world and assigned all to their tasks - unto Him I am a sacrifice.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: taa kee sev kareejai laahaa leejai har daragah paaeeai maan jeeu ||
english: So serve Him, and gather profit, and you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: har daragah maan soee jan paavai jo nar ek pachhaanai ||
english: That humble being, who recognizes the One Lord alone, obtains honor in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: ohu nav nidh paavai guramat har dhiaavai nit har gun aakh vakhaanai ||
english: One who meditates on the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, obtains the nine treasures; he chants and repeats continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ahinis naam tisai kaa leejai har ootam purakh paradhaan jeeu ||
english: Day and night, take the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the most sublime Primal Being.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin jagat upaaiaa dha(n)dhai laaiaa hau tisai vitahu kurabaan jeeu ||3||
english: The One who created the world and assigned all to their tasks - I am a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨਿ ਸਿ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: naam lain s sohahi tin sukh phal hovahi maanahi se jin jaahi jeeu ||
english: Those who chant the Naam look beautiful; they obtain the fruit of peace. Those who believe in the Name win the game of life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਫਲ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tin phal tot na aavai jaa tis bhaavai je jug kete jaahi jeeu ||
english: Their blessings are not exhausted, if it pleases the Lord, even though numerous ages may pass.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਫਲ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je jug kete jaahi suaamee tin phal tot na aavai ||
english: Even though numerous ages may pass, O Lord Master, their blessings are not exhausted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਜਰਾ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਰਣਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tinh jaraa na maranaa narak na paranaa jo har naam dhiaavai ||
english: They do not age, they do not die and fall into hell, if they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਸੂਕਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੀੜ ਨ ਖਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har karahi s sookahi naahee naanak peeR na khaahi jeeu ||
english: Those who chant the Lord's Name, Har, Har, do not wither, O Nanak; they are not afflicted by pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨੑਿ ਸਿ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: naam lainhi s sohahi tinh sukh phal hovahi maanahi se jin jaahi jeeu ||4||1||4||
english: Those who chant the Naam look beautiful; they obtain the fruit of peace. Those who believe in the Name win the game of life. ||4||1||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 chha(n)t ghar 3 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl, Chhant, Third House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਣਾ ਕਾਲਿਆ ਕੀ ਵਾੜੀਐ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sun haranaa kaaliaa kee vaaReeai raataa raam ||
english: Listen, O black deer: why are you so attached to the orchard of passion?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bikh phal meethaa chaar din phir hovai taataa raam ||
english: The fruit of sin is sweet for only a few days, and then it grows hot and bitter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਾਤਾ ਖਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਰਤਾਪਏ ॥
transliteration: phir hoi taataa kharaa maataa naam bin parataapae ||
english: That fruit which intoxicated you has now become bitter and painful, without the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਜੇਵ ਸਾਇਰ ਦੇਇ ਲਹਰੀ ਬਿਜੁਲ ਜਿਵੈ ਚਮਕਏ ॥
transliteration: ohu jev saair dei laharee bijul jivai chamakae ||
english: It is temporary, like the waves on the sea, and the flash of lightning.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਾਝੁ ਰਾਖਾ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har baajh raakhaa koi naahee soi tujhahi bisaariaa ||
english: Without the Lord, there is no other protector, but you have forgotten Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਰਹਿ ਹਰਣਾ ਕਾਲਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sach kahai naanak chet re man marahi haranaa kaaliaa ||1||
english: Nanak speaks the Truth. Reflect upon it, O mind; you shall die, O black deer. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਵਰਾ ਫੂਲਿ ਭਵੰਤਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhavaraa phool bhava(n)tiaa dukh at bhaaree raam ||
english: O bumble bee, you wander among the flowers, but terrible pain awaits you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਛਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mai gur poochhiaa aapanaa saachaa beechaaree raam ||
english: I have asked my Guru for true understanding.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੁਝੈ ਪੂਛਿਆ ਭਵਰੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਰਾਤਓ ॥
transliteration: beechaar satigur mujhai poochhiaa bhavar belee raatao ||
english: I have asked my True Guru for understanding about the bumble bee, who is so involved with the flowers of the garden.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪੜਿਆ ਤੇਲੁ ਤਾਵਣਿ ਤਾਤਓ ॥
transliteration: sooraj chaRiaa pi(n)d paRiaa tel taavan taatao ||
english: When the sun rises, the body will fall, and it will be cooked in hot oil.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਖਾਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jam mag baadhaa khaahi chotaa sabad bin betaaliaa ||
english: You shall be bound and beaten on the road of Death, without the Word of the Shabad, O madman.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਰਹਿ ਭਵਰਾ ਕਾਲਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sach kahai naanak chet re man marahi bhavaraa kaaliaa ||2||
english: Nanak speaks the Truth. Reflect upon it, O mind; you shall die, O bumble bee. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜਿਆ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਪਵਹਿ ਜੰਜਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mere jeeaRiaa paradeseeaa kit pavahi ja(n)jaale raam ||
english: O my stranger soul, why do you fall into entanglements?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਹਿ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahib man vasai kee phaasahi jam jaale raam ||
english: The True Lord abides within your mind; why are you trapped by the noose of Death?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਨੈਣ ਰੁੰਨੀ ਜਾਲੁ ਬਧਿਕਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: machhulee vichhu(n)nee nain ru(n)nee jaal badhik paaiaa ||
english: The fish leaves the water with tearful eyes, when the fisherman casts his net.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar maaiaa mohu meethaa a(n)t bharam chukaaiaa ||
english: The love of Maya is sweet to the world, but in the end, this delusion is dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bhagat kar chit laai har siu chhod manahu a(n)desiaa ||
english: So perform devotional worship, link your consciousness to the Lord, and dispel anxiety from your mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਜੀਅੜਿਆ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sach kahai naanak chet re man jeeaRiaa paradeseeaa ||3||
english: Nanak speaks the Truth; focus your consciousness on the Lord, O my stranger soul. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦੀਆ ਵਾਹ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਮੇਲਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: nadeeaa vaah vichhu(n)niaa melaa sa(n)jogee raam ||
english: The rivers and streams which separate may sometime be united again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਵਿਸੁ ਭਰੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jug jug meethaa vis bhare ko jaanai jogee raam ||
english: In age after age, that which is sweet, is full of poison; how rare is the Yogi who understands this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਸਹਜਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: koee sahaj jaanai har pachhaanai satiguroo jin chetiaa ||
english: That rare person who centers his consciousness on the True Guru, knows intuitively and realizes the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਚੇਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bin naam har ke bharam bhoole pachahi mugadh achetiaa ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the thoughtless fools wander in doubt, and are ruined.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਧਾਹੀ ਰੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har naam bhagat na ridai saachaa se a(n)t dhaahee ru(n)niaa ||
english: Those whose hearts are not touched by devotional worship and the Name of the True Lord, shall weep and wail loudly in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
transliteration: sach kahai naanak sabad saachai mel chiree vichhu(n)niaa ||4||1||5||
english: Nanak speaks the Truth; through the True Word of the Shabad, those long separated from the Lord, are united once again. ||4||1||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 chha(n)t ghar 1 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl, Chhant, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਘਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ham ghare saachaa sohilaa saachai sabad suhaaiaa raam ||
english: Within my home, the true wedding songs of rejoicing are sung; my home is adorned with the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dhan pir mel bhaiaa prabh aap milaaiaa raam ||
english: The soul-bride has met her Husband Lord; God Himself has consummated this union.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh aap milaaiaa sach ma(n)n vasaaiaa kaaman sahaje maatee ||
english: God Himself has consummated this union; the soul-bride enshrines Truth within her mind, intoxicated with peaceful poise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: gur sabad seegaaree sach savaaree sadaa raave ra(n)g raatee ||
english: Embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and beautified with Truth, she enjoys her Beloved forever, imbued with His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aap gavaae har var paae taa har ras ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
english: Eradicating her ego, she obtains her Husband Lord, and then, the sublime essence of the Lord dwells within her mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸਫਲਿਉ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur sabad savaaree saphaliu janam sabaaiaa ||1||
english: Says Nanak, fruitful and prosperous is her entire life; she is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੜੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: doojaRai kaaman bharam bhulee har var na paae raam ||
english: The soul-bride who has been led astray by duality and doubt, does not attain her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kaaman gun naahee birathaa janam gavaae raam ||
english: That soul-bride has no virtue, and she wastes her life in vain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਇਆਣੀ ਅਉਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: birathaa janam gavaae manamukh iaanee auganava(n)tee jhoore ||
english: The self-willed, ignorant and disgraceful manmukh wastes her life in vain, and in the end, she comes to grief.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa satigur sev sadaa sukh paaiaa taa pir miliaa hadoore ||
english: But when she serves her True Guru, she obtains peace, and then she meets her Husband Lord, face to face.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਿਗਸੀ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਸਰਸੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dekh pir vigasee a(n)darahu sarasee sachai sabad subhaae ||
english: Beholding her Husband Lord, she blossoms forth; her heart is delighted, and she is beautified by the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak vin naavai kaaman bharam bhulaanee mil preetam sukh paae ||2||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, the soul-bride wanders around, deluded by doubt. Meeting her Beloved, she obtains peace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: pir sa(n)g kaaman jaaniaa gur mel milaaee raam ||
english: The soul-bride knows that her Husband Lord is with her; the Guru unites her in this union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar sabad milee sahaje tapat bujhaaee raam ||
english: Within her heart, she is merged with the Shabad, and the fire of her desire is easily extinguished.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabad tapat bujhaaee a(n)tar saa(n)t aaee sahaje har ras chaakhiaa ||
english: The Shabad has quenched the fire of desire, and within her heart, peace and tranquility have come; she tastes the Lord's essence with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਪਣੇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mil preetam apane sadaa ra(n)g maane sachai sabad subhaakhiaa ||
english: Meeting her Beloved, she enjoys His Love continually, and her speech rings with the True Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਾਕੇ ਭੇਖੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit monee thaake bhekhee mukat na paaee ||
english: Reading and studying continually, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages have grown weary; wearing religious robes, liberation is not obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak bin bhagatee jag bauraanaa sachai sabad milaaee ||3||
english: O Nanak, without devotional worship, the world has gone insane; through the True Word of the Shabad, one meets the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan man anad bhaiaa har jeeu mel piaare raam ||
english: Bliss permeates the mind of the soul-bride, who meets her Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਸਿ ਰਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan har kai ras rasee gur kai sabad apaare raam ||
english: The soul-bride is enraptured with the sublime essence of the Lord, through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੇ ॥
transliteration: sabad apaare mile piaare sadaa gun saare man vase ||
english: Through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad, she meets her Beloved; she continually contemplates and enshrines His Glorious Virtues in her mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਵਗਣ ਨਸੇ ॥
transliteration: sej suhaavee jaa pir raavee mil preetam avagan nase ||
english: Her bed was adorned when she enjoyed her Husband Lord; meeting with her Beloved, her demerits were erased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jit ghar naam har sadaa dhiaaeeai sohilaRaa jug chaare ||
english: That house, within which the Lord's Name is continually meditated upon, resounds with the wedding songs of rejoicing, throughout the four ages.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate sadaa anad hai har miliaa kaaraj saare ||4||1||6||
english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, we are in bliss forever; meeting the Lord, our affairs are resolved. ||4||1||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 chha(n)t ghar 3 ||
english: Aasaa, Third Mehl, Chhant, Third House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਹੋ ॥
transliteration: saajan mere preetamahu tum sah kee bhagat kareho ||
english: O my beloved friend, dedicate yourself to the devotional worship of your Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲੇਹੋ ॥
transliteration: gur sevahu sadaa aapanaa naam padaarath leho ||
english: Serve your Guru constantly, and obtain the wealth of the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਸਹੈ ਕੇਰੀ ਜੋ ਸਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: bhagat karahu tum sahai keree jo sah piaare bhaavae ||
english: Dedicate yourself to the worship of your Husband Lord; this is pleasing to your Beloved Husband.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਹ ਖੁਸੀ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa bhaanaa tum karahu taa phir sah khusee na aavae ||
english: If you walk in accordance with your own will, then your Husband Lord will not be pleased with you.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਕੋ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: bhagat bhaav ihu maarag bikhaRaa gur duaarai ko paavae ||
english: This path of loving devotional worship is very difficult; how rare are those who find it, through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahai naanak jis kare kirapaa so har bhagatee chit laavae ||1||
english: Says Nanak, that one, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, links his consciousness to the worship of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mere man bairaageeaa too(n) bairaag kar kis dikhaavahi ||
english: O my detached mind, unto whom do you show your detachment?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: har sohilaa tinh sad sadaa jo har gun gaavahi ||
english: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord live in the joy of the Lord, forever and ever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਤੂੰ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਏ ॥
transliteration: kar bairaag too(n) chhod paakha(n)d so sahu sabh kichh jaanae ||
english: So become detached, and renounce hypocrisy; Your Husband Lord knows everything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਏ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal eko soee guramukh hukam pachhaanae ||
english: The One Lord is pervading the water, the land and the sky; the Gurmukh realizes the Command of His Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹਰੀ ਕੇਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: jin hukam pachhaataa haree keraa soee sarab sukh paavae ||
english: One who realizes the Lord's Command, obtains all peace and comforts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਵ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: iv kahai naanak so bairaagee anadin har liv laavae ||2||
english: Thus says Nanak: such a detached soul remains absorbed in the Lord's Love, day and night. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jah jah man too(n) dhaavadaa tah tah har terai naale ||
english: Wherever you wander, O my mind, the Lord is there with you.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: man siaanap chhodeeai gur kaa sabad samaale ||
english: Renounce your cleverness, O my mind, and reflect upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਥਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹੇ ॥
transliteration: saath terai so sahu sadaa hai ik khin har naam samaalahe ||
english: Your Husband Lord is always with you, if you remember the Lord's Name, even for an instant.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਟੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke tere paap kate a(n)t param pad paavahe ||
english: The sins of countless incarnations shall be washed away, and in the end, you shall obtain the supreme status.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: saache naal teraa ga(n)dh laagai guramukh sadaa samaale ||
english: You shall be linked to the True Lord, and as Gurmukh, remember Him forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਹ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: iu kahai naanak jah man too(n) dhaavadaa tah har terai sadaa naale ||3||
english: Thus says Nanak: wherever you go, O my mind, the Lord is there with you. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਥੰਮੑਿਆ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai dhaavat tha(n)mhiaa nij ghar vasiaa aae ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, the wandering mind is held steady; it comes to abide in its own home.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naam vihaajhe naam lae naam rahe samaae ||
english: It purchases the Naam, chants the Naam, and remains absorbed in the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਥੰਮੑਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਦਸਵਾ ਦੁਆਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat tha(n)mhiaa satigur miliai dasavaa duaar paaiaa ||
english: The outgoing, wandering soul, upon meeting the True Guru, opens the Tenth Gate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਥੰਮੑਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tithai a(n)mrit bhojan sahaj dhun upajai jit sabad jagat tha(n)mhi rahaaiaa ||
english: There, Ambrosial Nectar is food and the celestial music resounds; the world is held spell-bound by the music of the Word.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਅਨੇਕ ਵਾਜੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tah anek vaaje sadaa anad hai sache rahiaa samaae ||
english: The many strains of the unstruck melody resound there, as one merges in Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਥੰਮੑਿਆ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਆਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: iu kahai naanak satigur miliai dhaavat tha(n)mhiaa nij ghar vasiaa aae ||4||
english: Thus says Nanak: by meeting the True Guru, the wandering soul becomes steady, and comes to dwell in the home of its own self. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: man too(n) jot saroop hai aapanaa mool pachhaan ||
english: O my mind, you are the embodiment of the Divine Light - recognize your own origin.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: man har jee terai naal hai guramatee ra(n)g maan ||
english: O my mind, the Dear Lord is with you; through the Guru's Teachings, enjoy His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: mool pachhaanahi taa(n) sahu jaanahi maran jeevan kee sojhee hoee ||
english: Acknowledge your origin, and then you shall know your Husband Lord, and so understand death and birth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee eko jaanahi taa(n) doojaa bhaau na hoee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, know the One; then, you shall not love any other.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: man saa(n)t aaee vajee vadhaaee taa hoaa paravaan ||
english: Peace comes to the mind, and gladness resounds; then, you shall be acclaimed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਅਪਣਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: iu kahai naanak man too(n) jot saroop hai apanaa mool pachhaan ||5||
english: Thus says Nanak: O my mind, you are the very image of the Luminous Lord; recognize the true origin of your self. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਲਦਿਆ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: man too(n) gaarab atiaa gaarab ladiaa jaahi ||
english: O mind, you are so full of pride; loaded with pride, you shall depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਭਵਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohanee mohiaa phir phir joonee bhavaahi ||
english: The fascinating Maya has fascinated you, over and over again, and lured you into reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਾਰਬਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: gaarab laagaa jaahi mugadh man a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaavahe ||
english: Clinging to pride, you shall depart, O foolish mind, and in the end, you shall regret and repent.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)kaar tisanaa rog lagaa birathaa janam gavaavahe ||
english: You are afflicted with the diseases of ego and desire, and you are wasting your life away in vain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mugadh chetahi naahee agai gaiaa pachhutaavahe ||
english: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord, and shall regret and repent hereafter.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਲਦਿਆ ਜਾਵਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: iu kahai naanak man too(n) gaarab atiaa gaarab ladiaa jaavahe ||6||
english: Thus says Nanak: O mind, you are full of pride; loaded with pride, you shall depart. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਮਤ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਹੋਹੁ ॥
transliteration: man too(n) mat maan karahi j hau kichh jaanadaa guramukh nimaanaa hohu ||
english: O mind, don't be so proud of yourself, as if you know it all; the Gurmukh is humble and modest.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਉ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਹੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar agiaan hau budh hai sach sabad mal khohu ||
english: Within the intellect are ignorance and ego; through the True Word of the Shabad, this filth is washed off.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਅਗੈ ਮਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: hohu nimaanaa satiguroo agai mat kichh aap lakhaavahe ||
english: So be humble, and surrender to the True Guru; do not attach your identity to your ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲਿਆ ਮਤ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: aapanai aha(n)kaar jagat jaliaa mat too(n) aapanaa aap gavaavahe ||
english: The world is consumed by ego and self-identity; see this, lest you lose your own self as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਾਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai karahi kaar satigur kai bhaanai laag rahu ||
english: Make yourself follow the Sweet Will of the True Guru; remain attached to His Sweet Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਪੁ ਛਡਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: iu kahai naanak aap chhad sukh paavahi man nimaanaa hoi rahu ||7||
english: Thus says Nanak: renounce your ego and self-conceit, and obtain peace; let your mind abide in humility. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s velaa jit mai satigur miliaa so sahu chit aaiaa ||
english: Blessed is that time, when I met the True Guru, and my Husband Lord came into my consciousness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa ana(n)d sahaj bhaiaa man tan sukh paaiaa ||
english: I became so very blissful, and my mind and body found such a natural peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: so sahu chit aaiaa ma(n)n vasaaiaa avagan sabh visaare ||
english: My Husband Lord came into my consciousness; I enshrined Him within my mind, and I renounced all vice.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟ ਹੋਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa tis bhaanaa gun paragat hoe satigur aap savaare ||
english: When it pleased Him, virtues appeared in me, and the True Guru Himself adorned me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਿਆ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: se jan paravaan hoe jinhee ik naam diRiaa duteeaa bhaau chukaaiaa ||
english: Those humble beings become acceptable, who cling to the One Name and renounce the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: iu kahai naanak dha(n)n s velaa jit mai satigur miliaa so sahu chit aaiaa ||8||
english: Thus says Nanak: blessed is the time when I met the True Guru, and my Husband Lord came into my consciousness. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਜੰਤ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ik ja(n)t bharam bhule tin sahi aap bhulaae ||
english: Some people wander around, deluded by doubt; their Husband Lord Himself has misled them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai phirahi haumai karam kamaae ||
english: They wander around in the love of duality, and they do their deeds in ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਕੁਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tin sahi aap bhulaae kumaarag paae tin kaa kichh na vasaaee ||
english: Their Husband Lord Himself has misled them, and put them on the path of evil. Nothing lies in their power.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਅਵਗਤਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਰਚਨ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tin kee gat avagat too(n)hai jaanahi jin ih rachan rachaaee ||
english: You alone know their ups and downs, You, who created the creation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖਰਾ ਭਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hukam teraa kharaa bhaaraa guramukh kisai bujhaae ||
english: The Command of Your Will is very strict; how rare is the Gurmukh who understands.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥੯॥
transliteration: iu kahai naanak kiaa ja(n)t vichaare jaa tudh bharam bhulaae ||9||
english: Thus says Nanak: what can the poor creatures do, when You mislead them into doubt? ||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sache mere saahibaa sachee teree vadiaaee ||
english: O My True Lord Master, True is Your glorious greatness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) paarabraham bea(n)t suaamee teree kudarat kahan na jaaee ||
english: You are the Supreme Lord God, the Infinite Lord and Master. Your creative power cannot be described.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: sachee teree vadiaaee jaa kau tudh ma(n)n vasaaee sadaa tere gun gaavahe ||
english: True is Your glorious greatness; when You enshrine it within the mind, one sings Your Glorious Praises forever.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: tere gun gaavahi jaa tudh bhaavahi sache siu chit laavahe ||
english: He sings Your Glorious Praises, when it is pleasing to You, O True Lord; he centers his consciousness on You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jis no too(n) aape melahi s guramukh rahai samaaee ||
english: One whom You unite with Yourself, as Gurmukh, remains absorbed in You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੦॥੨॥੭॥੫॥੨॥੭॥
transliteration: iu kahai naanak sache mere saahibaa sachee teree vadiaaee ||10||2||7||5||2||7||
english: Thus says Nanak: O my True Lord Master, True is Your Glorious Greatness. ||10||2||7||5||2||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa chha(n)t mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨੋ ਮੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jeevano mai jeevan paaiaa guramukh bhaae raam ||
english: Life - I have found real life, as Gurmukh, through His Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har naamo har naam devai merai praan vasaae raam ||
english: The Lord's Name - He has given me the Lord's Name, and enshrined it within my breath of life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har har naam merai praan vasaae sabh sa(n)saa dookh gavaaiaa ||
english: He has enshrined the Name of the Lord, Har, Har within my breath of lfe, and all my doubts and sorrows have departed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: adisat agochar gur bachan dhiaaiaa pavitr param pad paaiaa ||
english: I have meditated on the invisible and unapproachable Lord, through the Guru's Word, and I have obtained the pure, supreme status.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਗਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: anahad dhun vaajahi nit vaaje gaaee satigur baanee ||
english: The unstruck melody resounds, and the instruments ever vibrate, singing the Bani of the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak daat karee prabh daatai jotee jot samaanee ||1||
english: O Nanak, God the Great Giver has given me a gift; He has blended my light into the Light. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਏ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: manamukhaa manamukh mue meree kar maaiaa raam ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs die in their self-willed stubbornness, declaring that the wealth of Maya is theirs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਮੜੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: khin aavai khin jaavai duraga(n)dh maRai chit laaiaa raam ||
english: They attach their consciousness to the foul-smelling pile of filth, which comes for a moment, and departs in an instant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਇਆ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਮੜੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: laaiaa duraga(n)dh maRai chit laagaa jiu ra(n)g kasu(n)bh dikhaaiaa ||
english: They attach their consciousness to the foul-smelling pile of filth, which is transitory, like the fading color of the safflower.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਛਮਿ ਛਾਏ ਜਿਉ ਚਕੁ ਕੁਮੑਿਆਰਿ ਭਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: khin poorab khin pachham chhaae jiu chak kumhiaar bhavaaiaa ||
english: One moment, they are facing east, and the next instant, they are facing west; they continue spinning around, like the potter's wheel.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dukh khaavahi dukh sa(n)chahi bhogahi dukh kee biradh vadhaaee ||
english: In sorrow, they eat, and in sorrow, they gather things and try to enjoy them, but they only increase their stores of sorrow.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਤਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak bikham suhelaa tareeai jaa aavai gur saranaaee ||2||
english: O Nanak, one easily crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, when he comes to the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: meraa thaakuro thaakur neekaa agam athaahaa raam ||
english: My Lord, my Lord Master is sublime, unapproachable and unfathomable.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜੀ ਚਾਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har poojee har poojee chaahee mere satigur saahaa raam ||
english: The wealth of the Lord - I seek the wealth of the Lord, from my True Guru, the Divine Banker.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜੀ ਚਾਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har poojee chaahee naam bisaahee gun gaavai gun bhaavai ||
english: I seek the wealth of the Lord, to purchase the Naam; I sing and love the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨੀਦ ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਸੁੰਨੇ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: need bhookh sabh parahar tiaagee su(n)ne su(n)n samaavai ||
english: I have totally renounced sleep and hunger, and through deep meditation, I am absorbed into the Absolute Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਭਾਤੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: vanajaare ik bhaatee aavahi laahaa har naam lai jaahe ||
english: The traders of one kind come and take away the Name of the Lord as their profit.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak man tan arap gur aagai jis praapat so paae ||3||
english: O Nanak, dedicate your mind and body to the Guru; one who is so destined, attains it. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨਾ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ratanaa ratan padaarath bahu saagar bhariaa raam ||
english: The great ocean is full of the treasures of jewels upon jewels.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਹਥਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: baanee gurabaanee laage tinh hath chaRiaa raam ||
english: Those who are committed to the Word of the Guru's Bani, see them come into their hands.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਹਥਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gurabaanee laage tinh hath chaRiaa niramolak ratan apaaraa ||
english: This priceless, incomparable jewel comes into the hands of those who are committed to the Word of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਤੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam atolak paaiaa teree bhagat bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
english: They obtain the immeasurable Name of the Lord, Har, Har; their treasure is overflowing with devotional worship.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਵਿਰੋਲਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਇਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: samu(n)d virol sareer ham dekhiaa ik vasat anoop dikhaaee ||
english: I have churned the ocean of the body, and I have seen the incomparable thing come into view.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋੁਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥
transliteration: gur govi(n)d gouvi(n)d guroo hai naanak bhed na bhaaee ||4||1||8||
english: The Guru is God, and God is the Guru, O Nanak; there is no difference between the two, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||1||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਝਿਮਿ ਝਿਮੇ ਝਿਮਿ ਝਿਮਿ ਵਰਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jhim jhime jhim jhim varasai a(n)mrit dhaaraa raam ||
english: Slowly, slowly, slowly, very slowly, the drops of Ambrosial Nectar trickle down.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramukhe guramukh nadaree raam piaaraa raam ||
english: As Gurmukh, the Gurmukh beholds the Lord, the Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਗਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam piaaraa jagat nisataaraa raam naam vadiaaee ||
english: The Name of the Lord, the Emancipator of the world, is dear to him; the Name of the Lord is his glory.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kalijug raam naam bohithaa guramukh paar laghaaee ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the boat, which carries the Gurmukh across.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: halat palat raam naam suhele guramukh karanee saaree ||
english: This world, and the world hereafter, are adorned with the Lord's Name; the Gurmukh's lifestyle is the most excellent.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਤਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak daat daiaa kar devai raam naam nisataaree ||1||
english: O Nanak, bestowing His kindness, the Lord gives the gift of His emancipating Name. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: raamo raam naam japiaa dukh kilavikh naas gavaaiaa raam ||
english: I chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, which destroys my sorrows and erases my sins.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur parachai gur parachai dhiaaiaa mai hiradai raam ravaaiaa raam ||
english: Associating with the Guru, associating with the Guru, I practice meditation; I have enshrined the Lord within my heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿਆ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: raviaa raam hiradai param gat paaee jaa gur saranaaee aae ||
english: I enshrined the Lord within my heart, and obtained the supreme status, when I came to the Sanctuary of the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਵ ਡੁਬਦੀ ਨਿਕਲੀ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: lobh vikaar naav dubadee nikalee jaa satigur naam diRaae ||
english: My boat was sinking under the weight of greed and corruption, but it was uplifted when the True Guru implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jee daan gur poorai deeaa raam naam chit laae ||
english: The Perfect Guru has given me the gift of spiritual life, and I center my consciousness on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap kripaal kripaa kar devai naanak gur saranaae ||2||
english: The Merciful Lord Himself has mercifully given this gift to me; O Nanak, I take to the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਣੀ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: baanee raam naam sunee sidh kaaraj sabh suhaae raam ||
english: Hearing the Bani of the Lord's Name, all my affairs were brought to perfection and embellished.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰੋਮੇ ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: rome rom rom rome mai guramukh raam dhiaae raam ||
english: With each and every hair, with each and every hair, as Gurmukh, I meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam dhiaae pavit hoi aae tis roop na rekhiaa kaaee ||
english: I meditate on the Lord's Name, and become pure; He has no form or shape.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raamo raam raviaa ghat a(n)tar sabh trisanaa bhookh gavaaee ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, is permeating my heart deep within, and all of my desire and hunger has disappeared.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan seetal seegaar sabh hoaa guramat raam pragaasaa ||
english: My mind and body are totally adorned with peace and tranquility; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord has been revealed to me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak aap anugrahu keeaa ham daasan daasan daasaa ||3||
