english: The Lord Himself has shown His kind mercy to Nanak; He has made me the slave of the slaves of His slaves. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਅਭਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jinee raamo raam naam visaariaa se manamukh mooR abhaagee raam ||
english: Those who forget the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, are foolish, unfortunate, self-willed manmukhs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰੇ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tin a(n)tare mohu viaapai khin khin maaiaa laagee raam ||
english: Within, they are engrossed in emotional attachment; each and every moment, Maya clings to them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੂੜ ਭਏ ਅਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mal laagee mooR bhae abhaagee jin raam naam nah bhaaiaa ||
english: The filth of Maya clings to them, and they become unfortunate fools - they do not love the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੋਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anek karam karahi abhimaanee har raamo naam choraaiaa ||
english: The egotistical and proud perform all sorts of rituals, but they shy away from the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ਕਾਲੂਖਤ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mahaa bikham jam pa(n)th duhelaa kaalookhat moh a(n)dhiaaraa ||
english: The path of Death is very arduous and painful; it is stained with the darkness of emotional attachment.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh naam dhiaaiaa taa paae mokh duaaraa ||4||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and finds the gate of salvation. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: raamo raam naam guroo raam guramukhe jaanai raam ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, and the Lord Guru, are known by the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਊਭ ਪਇਆਲੀ ਭਰਮਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ihu manooaa khin oobh paiaalee bharamadaa ikat ghar aanai raam ||
english: One moment, this mind is in the heavens, and the next, it is in the nether regions; the Guru brings the wandering mind back to one-pointedness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ਸਭ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: man ikat ghar aanai sabh gat mit jaanai har raamo naam rasaae ||
english: When the mind returns to one-pointedness, one totally understands the value of salvation, and enjoys the subtle essence of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jan kee paij rakhai raam naamaa prahilaad udhaar taraae ||
english: The Lord's Name preserves the honor of His servant, as He preserved and emancipated Prahlaad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮੋ ਰਮੁ ਊਚਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਤਿਆ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: raamo raam ramo ram oochaa gun kahatiaa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: So repeat continually the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; chanting His Glorious Virtues, His limit cannot be found.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਭੀਨੇ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam sun bheene raamai naam samaaiaa ||5||
english: Nanak is drenched in happiness, hearing the Name of the Lord; he is merged in the Name of the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਨ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਭ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jin a(n)tare raam naam vasai tin chi(n)taa sabh gavaaiaa raam ||
english: Those beings, whose minds are filled with the Lord's Name, forsake all anxiety.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਅਰਥਾ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ਮਿਲੇ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sabh arathaa sabh dharam mile man chi(n)diaa so phal paaiaa raam ||
english: They obtain all wealth, and all Dharmic faith, and the fruits of their minds' desires.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: man chi(n)diaa phal paaiaa raam naam dhiaaiaa raam naam gun gaae ||
english: They obtain the fruits of their hearts' desires, meditating on the Lord's Name, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਬੁਧਿ ਗਈ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: duramat kabudh gaee sudh hoee raam naam man laae ||
english: Evil-mindedness and duality depart, and their understanding is enlightened. They attach their minds to the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam sareer sabh hoaa jit raam naam paragaasiaa ||
english: Their lives and bodies become totally blessed and fruitful; the Lord's Name illumines them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak har bhaj sadaa din raatee guramukh nij ghar vaasiaa ||6||
english: O Nanak, by continually vibrating upon the Lord, day and night, the Gurmukhs abide in the home of the inner self. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਰਧਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਦੂਜੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jin saradhaa raam naam lagee tinh doojai chit na laaiaa raam ||
english: Those who place their faith in the Lord's Name, do not attach their consciousness to another.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਭ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: je dharatee sabh ka(n)chan kar deejai bin naavai avar na bhaaiaa raam ||
english: Even if the entire earth were to be transformed into gold, and given to them, without the Naam, they love nothing else.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam man bhaaiaa param sukh paaiaa a(n)t chaladiaa naal sakhaaee ||
english: The Lord's Name is pleasing to their minds, and they obtain supreme peace; when they depart in the end, it shall go with them as their support.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸੰਚੀ ਨਾ ਡੂਬੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam dhan poo(n)jee sa(n)chee naa doobai naa jaaee ||
english: I have gathered the capital, the wealth of the Lord's Name; it does not sink, and does not depart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam is jug mahi tulahaa jamakaal neR na aavai ||
english: The Lord's Name is the only true support in this age; the Messenger of Death does not draw near it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh raam pachhaataa kar kirapaa aap milaavai ||7||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs recognize the Lord; in His Mercy, He unites them with Himself. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤੇ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: raamo raam naam sate sat guramukh jaaniaa raam ||
english: True, True is the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; the Gurmukh knows the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sevako gur sevaa laagaa jin man tan arap chaRaaiaa raam ||
english: The Lord's servant is the one who commits himself to the Guru's service, and dedicates his mind and body as an offering to Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਆ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਰਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: man tan arapiaa bahut man saradhiaa gur sevak bhaai milaae ||
english: He dedicates his mind and body to Him, placing great faith in Him; the Guru lovingly unites His servant with Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: deenaa naath jeeaa kaa daataa poore gur te paae ||
english: The Master of the meek, the Giver of souls, is obtained through the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guroo sikh sikh guroo hai eko gur upades chalaae ||
english: The Guru's Sikh, and the Sikh's Guru, are one and the same; both spread the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਮੰਤੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੮॥੨॥੯॥
transliteration: raam naam ma(n)t hiradai devai naanak milan subhaae ||8||2||9||
english: The Mantra of the Lord's Name is enshrined within the heart, O Nanak, and we merge with the Lord so easily. ||8||2||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: aasaa chha(n)t mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
english: Aasaa, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har karataa dookh binaasan patit paavan har naam jeeu ||
english: The Creator Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of distress; the Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har sevaa bhaaee param gat paaee har ootam har har kaam jeeu ||
english: One who lovingly serves the Lord, obtains the supreme status. Service to the Lord, Har, Har, is more exalted than anything.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har ootam kaam japeeai har naam har japeeai asathir hovai ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord is the most exalted occupation; chanting the Name of the Lord, one becomes immortal.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਵੈ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: janam maran dovai dukh mete sahaje hee sukh sovai ||
english: The pains of both birth and death are eradicated, and one comes to sleep in peaceful ease.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har kirapaa dhaarahu thaakur har japeeai aatam raam jeeu ||
english: O Lord, O Lord and Master, shower Your Mercy upon me; within my mind, I chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har karataa dookh binaasan patit paavan har naam jeeu ||1||
english: The Creator Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of distress; the Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har naam padaarath kalijug ootam har japeeai satigur bhaai jeeu ||
english: The wealth of the Lord's Name is the most exalted in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; chant the Lord's Name according to the Way of the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har paReeai guramukh har suneeai har japat sunat dukh jaai jeeu ||
english: As Gurmukh, read of the Lord; as Gurmukh, hear of the Lord. Chanting and listening to the Lord's Name, pain departs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japiaa dukh binasiaa har naam param sukh paaiaa ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, pains are removed. Through the Name of the Lord, supreme peace is obtained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਲਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur giaan baliaa ghat chaanan agiaan a(n)dher gavaaiaa ||
english: The spiritual wisdom of the True Guru illumines the heart; this Light dispels the darkness of spiritual ignorance.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam tinee aaraadhiaa jin masatak dhur likh paai jeeu ||
english: They alone meditate on the Lord's Name, Har, Har, upon whose foreheads such destiny is written.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har naam padaarath kalijug ootam har japeeai satigur bhaai jeeu ||2||
english: The wealth of the Lord's Name is the most exalted in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; chant the Lord's Name according to the Way of the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har man bhaaiaa param sukh paaiaa har laahaa pad nirabaan jeeu ||
english: One whose mind loves the Lord, Har, Har, obtains supreme peace. He reaps the profit of the Lord's Name, the state of Nirvaanaa.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har preet lagaaee har naam sakhaaee bhram chookaa aavan jaan jeeu ||
english: He embraces love for the Lord, and the Lord's Name becomes his companion. His doubts, and his comings and goings are ended.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa bhram bhau bhaagaa har har har gun gaaiaa ||
english: His comings and goings, doubts and fears come to an end, and he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਉਤਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh dukh utare har har naam samaaiaa ||
english: The sins and pains of countless incarnations are washed away, and he merges into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jin har dhiaaiaa dhur bhaag likh paaiaa tin saphal janam paravaan jeeu ||
english: Those who are blessed by such pre-ordained destiny, meditate on the Lord, and their lives become fruitful and approved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har man bhaaiaa param sukh paaiaa har laahaa pad nirabaan jeeu ||3||
english: One whose mind loves the Lord, Har, Har, obtains supreme peace. He reaps the profit of the Lord's Name, the state of Nirvaanaa. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਗ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jinh har meeth lagaanaa te jan paradhaanaa te ootam har har log jeeu ||
english: Celebrated are those people, unto whom the Lord seems sweet; how exalted are those people of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har naam vadaaee har naam sakhaaee gurasabadee har ras bhog jeeu ||
english: The Lord's Name is their glorious greatness; the Lord's Name is their companion and helper. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਜੋਗ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har ras bhog mahaa nirajog vadabhaagee har ras paaiaa ||
english: They enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord, and remain totally detached. By great good fortune, they obtain the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡੇ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: se dha(n)n vade sat purakhaa poore jin guramat naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: So very blessed and truly perfect are those, who through Guru's Instruction meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰੇਣੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਪਗ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਨਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak ren ma(n)gai pag saadhoo man chookaa sog vijog jeeu ||
english: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy; his mind is rid of sorrow and separation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਗ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੦॥
transliteration: jinh har meeth lagaanaa te jan paradhaanaa te ootam har har log jeeu ||4||3||10||
english: Celebrated are those people, unto whom the Lord seems sweet; how exalted are those people of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||10||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਪਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satajug sabh sa(n)tokh sareeraa pag chaare dharam dhiaan jeeu ||
english: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone embodied contentment and meditation; religion stood upon four feet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: man tan har gaavahi param sukh paavahi har hiradai har gun giaan jeeu ||
english: With mind and body, they sang of the Lord, and attained supreme peace. In their hearts was the spiritual wisdom of the Lord's Glorious Virtues.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਤਾਰਥੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gun giaan padaarath har har kirataarath sobhaa guramukh hoee ||
english: Their wealth was the spiritual wisdom of the Lord's Glorious Virtues; the Lord was their success, and to live as Gurmukh was their glory.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar har prabh eko doojaa avar na koee ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, they saw only the One Lord God; for them there was no other second.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har liv laaee har naam sakhaaee har daragah paavai maan jeeu ||
english: They centered their consciousness lovingly on the Lord, Har, Har. The Lord's Name was their companion, and in the Court of the Lord, they obtained honor.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਪਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satajug sabh sa(n)tokh sareeraa pag chaare dharam dhiaan jeeu ||1||
english: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone embodied contentment and meditation; religion stood upon four feet. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਤਾ ਜੁਗੁ ਆਇਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਤੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tetaa jug aaiaa a(n)tar jor paaiaa jat sa(n)jam karam kamaai jeeu ||
english: Then came the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga; men's minds were ruled by power, and they practiced celibacy and self-discipline.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਗੁ ਚਉਥਾ ਖਿਸਿਆ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਪਗ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: pag chauthaa khisiaa trai pag tikiaa man hiradai krodh jalaai jeeu ||
english: The fourth foot of religion dropped off, and three remained. Their hearts and minds were inflamed with anger.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਸਲੋਧੁ ਨਿਰਪ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਲੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man hiradai krodh mahaa bisalodh nirap dhaavahi laR dukh paaiaa ||
english: Their hearts and minds were filled with the horribly poisonous essence of anger. The kings fought their wars and obtained only pain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਮਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar mamataa rog lagaanaa haumai aha(n)kaar vadhaaiaa ||
english: Their minds were afflicted with the illness of egotism, and their self-conceit and arrogance increased.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har kripaa dhaaree merai thaakur bikh guramat har naam lahi jaai jeeu ||
english: If my Lord, Har, Har, shows His Mercy, my Lord and Master eradicates the poison by the Guru's Teachings and the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਤਾ ਜੁਗੁ ਆਇਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਤੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tetaa jug aaiaa a(n)tar jor paaiaa jat sa(n)jam karam kamaai jeeu ||2||
english: Then came the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga; men's minds were ruled by power, and they practiced celibacy and self-discipline. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਦੁਆਪੁਰੁ ਆਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪੀ ਕਾਨੑੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jug duaapur aaiaa bharam bharamaaiaa har gopee kaanh upaai jeeu ||
english: The Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga came, and people wandered in doubt. The Lord created the Gopis and Krishna.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਨ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਜਗ ਪੁੰਨ ਆਰੰਭਹਿ ਅਤਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tap taapan taapahi jag pu(n)n aara(n)bhahi at kiriaa karam kamaai jeeu ||
english: The penitents practiced penance, they offered sacred feasts and charity, and performed many rituals and religious rites.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਪਗ ਦੁਇ ਖਿਸਕਾਇਆ ਦੁਇ ਪਗ ਟਿਕੈ ਟਿਕਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kiriaa karam kamaaiaa pag dui khisakaaiaa dui pag tikai tikaai jeeu ||
english: They performed many rituals and religious rites; two legs of religion dropped away, and only two legs remained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਜੁਧ ਜੋਧ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: mahaa judh jodh bahu keenhe vich haumai pachai pachaai jeeu ||
english: So many heroes waged great wars; in their egos they were ruined, and they ruined others as well.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal gur saadh milaaiaa mil satigur mal lahi jaai jeeu ||
english: The Lord, Compassionate to the poor, led them to meet the Holy Guru. Meeting the True Guru, their filth is washed away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਦੁਆਪੁਰੁ ਆਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪੀ ਕਾਨੑੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jug duaapur aaiaa bharam bharamaaiaa har gopee kaanh upaai jeeu ||3||
english: The Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga came, and the people wandered in doubt. The Lord created the Gopis and Krishna. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਗ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਖਿਸਕੀਆ ਪਗੁ ਚਉਥਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਟਿਕਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kalijug har keeaa pag trai khisakeeaa pag chauthaa tikai tikaai jeeu ||
english: The Lord ushered in the Dark Age, the Iron Age of Kali Yuga; three legs of religion were lost, and only the fourth leg remained intact.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gurasabad kamaaiaa aukhadh har paaiaa har keerat har saa(n)t paai jeeu ||
english: Acting in accordance with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the medicine of the Lord's Name is obtained. Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, divine peace is obtained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਰੁਤਿ ਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har keerat rut aaee har naam vadaaee har har naam khet jamaaiaa ||
english: The season of singing the Lord's Praise has arrived; the Lord's Name is glorified, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, grows in the field of the body.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਬੀਜੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kalijug beej beeje bin naavai sabh laahaa mool gavaaiaa ||
english: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, if one plants any other seed than the Name, all profit and capital is lost.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਖਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak gur pooraa paaiaa man hiradai naam lakhaai jeeu ||
english: Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru, who has revealed to him the Naam within his heart and mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਗ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਖਿਸਕੀਆ ਪਗੁ ਚਉਥਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਟਿਕਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: kalajug har keeaa pag trai khisakeeaa pag chauthaa tikai tikaai jeeu ||4||4||11||
english: The Lord ushered in the Dark Age, the Iron Age of Kali Yuga; three legs of religion were lost, and only the fourth leg remained intact. ||4||4||11||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har keerat man bhaaee param gat paaee har man tan meeth lagaan jeeu ||
english: One whose mind is pleased with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, attains the supreme status; the Lord seems so sweet to her mind and body.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har ras paaiaa guramat har dhiaaiaa dhur masatak bhaag puraan jeeu ||
english: She obtains the sublime essence of the Lord, Har, Har; through the Guru's Teachings, she meditates on the Lord, and the destiny written on her forehead is fulfilled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhur masatak bhaag har naam suhaag har naamai har gun gaaiaa ||
english: By that high destiny written on her forehead, she chants the Name of the Lord, her Husband, and through the Name of the Lord, she sings the Lord's Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: masatak manee preet bahu pragatee har naamai har sohaaiaa ||
english: The jewel of immense love sparkles on her forehead, and she is adorned with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jotee jot milee prabh paaiaa mil satigur manooaa maan jeeu ||
english: Her light blends with the Supreme Light, and she obtains God; meeting the True Guru, her mind is satisfied.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har keerat man bhaaee param gat paaee har man tan meeth lagaan jeeu ||1||
english: One whose mind is pleased with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, attains the supreme status; the Lord seems sweet to her mind and body. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har jas gaaiaa param pad paaiaa te ootam jan paradhaan jeeu ||
english: Those who sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, obtain the supreme status; they are the most exalted and acclaimed people.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਹਮ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਹ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਗ ਧੋਵਹ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tinh ham charan sarevah khin khin pag dhovah jin har meeth lagaan jeeu ||
english: I bow at their feet; each and every moment, I wash the feet of those, unto whom the Lord seems sweet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਗਾ ਰਤੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har meethaa laaiaa param sukh paaiaa mukh bhaagaa ratee chaare ||
english: The Lord seems sweet to them, and they obtain the supreme status; their faces are radiant and beautiful with good fortune.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਉਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramat har gaaiaa har haar ur paaiaa har naamaa ka(n)th dhaare ||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, they sing the Lord's Name, and wear the garland of the Lord's Name around their necks; they keep the Lord's Name in their throats.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh ek drisat samat kar dekhai sabh aatam raam pachhaan jeeu ||
english: They look upon all with equality, and recognize the Supreme Soul, the Lord, pervading among all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har har jas gaaiaa param pad paaiaa te ootam jan paradhaan jeeu ||2||
english: Those who sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, obtain the supreme status; they are the most exalted and acclaimed people. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat man bhaaee har rasan rasaaee vich sa(n)gat har ras hoi jeeu ||
english: One whose mind is pleased with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, savors the sublime essence of the Lord; in the Sangat, is this essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿਆ ਬੀਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har aaraadhiaa gur sabad vigaasiaa beejaa avar na koi jeeu ||
english: He meditates in adoration upon the Lord, Har, Har, and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he blossoms forth. He plants no other seed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਸੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: avar na koi har a(n)mrit soi jin peeaa so bidh jaanai ||
english: There is no Nectar, other than the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. One who drinks it in, knows the way.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n guroo pooraa prabh paaiaa lag sa(n)gat naam pachhaanai ||
english: Hail, hail to the Perfect Guru; through Him, God is found. Joining the Sangat, the Naam is understood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: naamo sev naamo aaraadhai bin naamai avar na koi jeeu ||
english: I serve the Naam, and I meditate on the Naam. Without the Naam, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat man bhaaee har rasan rasaaee vich sa(n)gat har ras hoi jeeu ||3||
english: One whose mind is pleased with the Sat Sangat, savors the sublime essence of the Lord; in the Sangat, is this essence of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਖਣ ਹਮ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਕਢਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har daiaa prabh dhaarahu paakhan ham taarahu kadh levahu sabad subhaai jeeu ||
english: O Lord God, shower Your Mercy upon me; I am just a stone. Please, carry me across, and lift me up with ease, through the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਚੀਕੜਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਨਿਘਰਤ ਹਮ ਜਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਂਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪਕਰਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: moh cheekaR phaathe nigharat ham jaate har baa(n)h prabhoo pakaraai jeeu ||
english: I am stuck in the swamp of emotional attachment, and I am sinking. O Lord God, please, take me by the arm.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਬਾਂਹ ਪਕਰਾਈ ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh baa(n)h pakaraaee ootam mat paaee gur charanee jan laagaa ||
english: God took me by the arm, and I obtained the highest understanding; as His slave, I grasped the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japiaa aaraadhiaa mukh masatak bhaag sabhaagaa ||
english: I chant and meditate in adoration upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, according to the good destiny written upon my forehead.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kirapaa dhaaree man har har meethaa laai jeeu ||
english: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, seems so sweet to his mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਖਣ ਹਮ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਕਢਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨॥
transliteration: har daiaa prabh dhaarahu paakhan ham taarahu kadh levahu sabad subhaai jeeu ||4||5||12||
english: O Lord God, shower Your Mercy upon me; I am just a stone. Please, carry me across, and lift me up with ease, through the Word of the Shabad. ||4||5||12||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: man naam japaanaa har har man bhaanaa har bhagat janaa man chaau jeeu ||
english: One who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har in his mind - the Lord is pleasing to his mind. In the mind of the devotees there is a great yearning for the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੇ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jo jan mar jeeve tinh a(n)mrit peeve man laagaa guramat bhaau jeeu ||
english: Those humble beings who remain dead while yet alive, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar; through the Guru's Teachings, their minds embrace love for the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: man har har bhaau gur kare pasaau jeevan mukat sukh hoee ||
english: Their minds love the Lord, Har, Har, and the Guru is Merciful to them. They are Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive, and they are at peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jeevan maran har naam suhele man har har hiradai soee ||
english: Their birth and death, through the Name of the Lord, are illustrious, and in their hearts and minds, the Lord, Har, Har, abides.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਗਟਾਕ ਪੀਆਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: man har har vasiaa guramat har rasiaa har har ras gataak peeaau jeeu ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, abides in their minds, and through the Guru's Teachings, they savor the Lord, Har, Har; they drink in the sublime essence of the Lord with abandon.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man naam japaanaa har har man bhaanaa har bhagat janaa man chaau jeeu ||1||
english: One who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in his mind - the Lord is pleasing to his mind. In the mind of the devotees there is such a great yearning for the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਮਤ ਜਮੁ ਪਕਰੈ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jag maran na bhaaiaa nit aap lukaaiaa mat jam pakarai lai jaai jeeu ||
english: The people of the world do not like death; they try to hide from it. They are afraid that the Messenger of Death may catch them and take them away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਰਖਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)tar baahar har prabh eko ihu jeeaRaa rakhiaa na jaai jeeu ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, the Lord God is the One and Only; this soul cannot be concealed from Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਜੀਉ ਰਖੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲੋੜੀਜੈ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਸੋ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kiu jeeu rakheejai har vasat loReejai jis kee vasat so lai jaai jeeu ||
english: How can one keep one's soul, when the Lord wishes to have it? All things belong to Him, and He shall take them away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮੇ ਸਭਿ ਅਉਖਧ ਦਾਰੂ ਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: manamukh karan palaav kar bharame sabh aukhadh daaroo laai jeeu ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs wander around in pathetic lamentation, trying all medicines and remedies.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਏ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jis kee vasat prabh lae suaamee jan ubare sabad kamaai jeeu ||
english: God, the Master, unto whom all things belong, shall take them away; the Lord's servant is redeemed by living the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਮਤ ਜਮੁ ਪਕਰੈ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jag maran na bhaaiaa nit aap lukaaiaa mat jam pakarai lai jaai jeeu ||2||
english: The people of the world do not like death; they try to hide from it. They are afraid that the Messenger of Death may catch them and take them away. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: dhur maran likhaaiaa guramukh sohaaiaa jan ubare har har dhiaan jeeu ||
english: Death is pre-ordained; the Gurmukhs look beauteous, and the humble beings are saved, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਨਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har sobhaa paaee har naam vadiaaee har daragah paidhe jaan jeeu ||
english: Through the Lord they obtain honor, and through the Lord's Name, glorious greatness. In the Court of the Lord, they are robed in honor.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਸੀਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har daragah paidhe har naamai seedhe har naamai te sukh paaiaa ||
english: Robed in honor in the Court of the Lord, in the perfection of the Lord's Name, they obtain peace through the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਵੈ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: janam maran dovai dukh mete har raamai naam samaaiaa ||
english: The pains of both birth and death are eliminated, and they merge into the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਲਿ ਏਕੋ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har jan prabh ral eko hoe har jan prabh ek samaan jeeu ||
english: The Lord's servants meet with God and merge into Oneness. The Lord's servant and God are one and the same.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhur maran likhaaiaa guramukh sohaaiaa jan ubare har har dhiaan jeeu ||3||
english: Death is pre-ordained; the Gurmukhs look beauteous, and the humble beings are saved, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਲਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jag upajai binasai binas binaasai lag guramukh asathir hoi jeeu ||
english: The people of the world are born, only to perish, and perish, and perish again. Only by attaching oneself to the Lord as Gurmukh, does one become permanent.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gur ma(n)tr driRaae har rasak rasaae har a(n)mrit har mukh choi jeeu ||
english: The Guru implants His Mantra within the heart, and one savors the sublime essence of the Lord; the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord trickles into his mouth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੁਆ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)mrit ras paaiaa muaa jeevaaiaa phir baahuR maran na hoee ||
english: Obtaining the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord, the dead are restored to life, and do not die again.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har har naam amar pad paaiaa har naam samaavai soee ||
english: Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, one obtains the immortal status, and merges into the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam adhaar tek hai bin naavai avar na koi jeeu ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only Support and Anchor of servant Nanak; without the Naam, there is nothing else at all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਲਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jag upajai binasai binas binaasai lag guramukh asathir hoi jeeu ||4||6||13||
english: The people of the world are born, only to perish, and perish, and perish again. Only by attaching oneself to the Lord as Gurmukh, does one become permanent. ||4||6||13||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 chha(n)t ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Chhant:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: vadaa meraa govi(n)d agam agochar aad nira(n)jan nira(n)kaar jeeu ||
english: My Lord of the Universe is great, unapproachable, unfathomable, primal, immaculate and formless.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਅਮਿਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: taa kee gat kahee na jaaee amit vadiaaee meraa govi(n)d alakh apaar jeeu ||
english: His condition cannot be described; His Glorious Greatness is immeasurable. My Lord of the Universe is invisible and infinite.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: govi(n)d alakh apaar apara(n)par aap aapanaa jaanai ||
english: The Lord of the Universe is invisible, infinite and unlimited. He Himself knows Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਇਹ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa ih ja(n)t vichaare kaheeahi jo tudh aakh vakhaanai ||
english: What should these poor creatures say? How can they speak of and describe You?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਪਣੀ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jis no nadar karahi too(n) apanee so guramukh kare veechaar jeeu ||
english: That Gurmukh who is blessed by Your Glance of Grace contemplates You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vadaa meraa govi(n)d agam agochar aad nira(n)jan nira(n)kaar jeeu ||1||
english: My Lord of the Universe is great, unapproachable, unfathomable, primal, immaculate and formless. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aad purakh apara(n)par karataa teraa paar na paaiaa jaai jeeu ||
english: You, O Lord, O Primal Being, are the Limitless Creator; Your limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) ghat ghat a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar sabh mahi rahiaa samaai jeeu ||
english: You are pervading and permeating each and every heart, everywhere, You are contained in all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ghat a(n)tar paarabraham paramesar taa kaa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: Within the heart is the Transcendent, Supreme Lord God, whose limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tis roop na rekh adisat agochar guramukh alakh lakhaaiaa ||
english: He has no form or shape; He is unseen and unknown. The Gurmukh sees the unseen Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahai din raatee sahaje naam samaai jeeu ||
english: He remains in continual ecstasy, day and night, and is spontaneously absorbed into the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too(n) aad purakh apara(n)par karataa teraa paar na paaiaa jaai jeeu ||2||
english: You, O Lord, O Primal Being, are the Limitless Creator; Your limits cannot be found. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sat paramesar sadaa abinaasee har har gunee nidhaan jeeu ||
english: You are the True, Transcendent Lord, forever imperishable. The Lord, Har, Har, is the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har prabh eko avar na koee too(n) aape purakh sujaan jeeu ||
english: The Lord God, Har, Har, is the One and only; there is no other at all. You Yourself are the all-knowing Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: purakh sujaan too(n) paradhaan tudh jevad avar na koee ||
english: You are the all-knowing Lord, the most exalted and auspicious; there is no other as great as You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: teraa sabad sabh too(n)hai varatahi too(n) aape karahi s hoee ||
english: The Word of Your Shabad is pervading in all; whatever You do, comes to pass.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har sabh mahi raviaa eko soee guramukh lakhiaa har naam jeeu ||
english: The One Lord God is permeating all; the Gurmukh comes to understand the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too(n) sat paramesar sadaa abinaasee har har gunee nidhaan jeeu ||3||
english: You are the True, Transcendent Lord, forever imperishable. The Lord, Har, Har, is the treasure of virtue. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh too(n)hai karataa sabh teree vadiaaee jiu bhaavai tivai chalaai jeeu ||
english: You are the Creator of all, and all greatness is Yours. As it pleases Your Will, so do we act.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape bhaavai tivai chalaavahi sabh terai sabad samaai jeeu ||
english: As it pleases Your Will, so do we act. All are merged into Your Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh sabad samaavai jaa(n) tudh bhaavai terai sabad vadiaaee ||
english: When it pleases Your Will, we obtain greatness through Your Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh budh paaeeai aap gavaaeeai sabade rahiaa samaaee ||
english: The Gurmukh obtains wisdom, and eliminates his self-conceit, and remains absorbed in the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: teraa sabad agochar guramukh paaeeai naanak naam samaai jeeu ||
english: The Gurmukh obtains Your incomprehensible Shabad; O Nanak, he remains merged in the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੪॥
transliteration: sabh too(n)hai karataa sabh teree vadiaaee jiu bhaavai tivai chalaai jeeu ||4||7||14||
english: You are the Creator of all, and all greatness is Yours. As it pleases Your Will, so do we act. ||4||7||14||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 chha(n)t ghar 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Chhant, Fourth House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਿੰਨੇ ਲੋਇਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਤੰਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)mrit bhi(n)ne loinaa man prem rata(n)naa raam raaje ||
english: My eyes are wet with the Nectar of the Lord, and my mind is imbued with His Love, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸੋਵਿੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man raam kasavatee laaiaa ka(n)chan sovi(n)naa ||
english: The Lord applied His touch-stone to my mind, and found it one hundred per cent gold.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੋ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ra(n)g chalooliaa meraa man tano bhi(n)naa ||
english: As Gurmukh, I am dyed in the deep red of the poppy, and my mind and body are drenched with His Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੁਸਕਿ ਝਕੋਲਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak musak jhakoliaa sabh janam dhan dha(n)naa ||1||
english: Servant Nanak is drenched with His Fragrance; blessed, blessed is his entire life. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਅਣੀਆਲੇ ਅਣੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: har prem baanee man maariaa aneeaale aneeaa raam raaje ||
english: The Bani of the Lord's Love is the pointed arrow, which has pierced my mind, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਪੀਰ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jis laagee peer pira(n)m kee so jaanai jareeaa ||
english: Only those who feel the pain of this love, know how to endure it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਮਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jeevan mukat so aakheeai mar jeevai mareeaa ||
english: Those who die, and remain dead while yet alive, are said to be Jivan Mukta, liberated while yet alive.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak satigur mel har jag dutar tareeaa ||2||
english: O Lord, unite servant Nanak with the True Guru, that he may cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਰੰਗਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: ham moorakh mugadh saranaagatee mil govi(n)d ra(n)gaa raam raaje ||
english: I am foolish and ignorant, but I have taken to His Sanctuary; may I merge in the Love of the Lord of the Universe, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਕ ਮੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai har paaiaa har bhagat ik ma(n)gaa ||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, I have obtained the Lord, and I beg for the one blessing of devotion to the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa man tan sabad vigaasiaa jap anat tara(n)gaa ||
english: My mind and body blossom forth through the Word of the Shabad; I meditate on the Lord of infinite waves.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਸੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)t janaa har paaiaa naanak satasa(n)gaa ||3||
english: Meeting with the humble Saints, Nanak finds the Lord, in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal sun benatee har prabh har raaiaa raam raaje ||
english: O Merciful to the meek, hear my prayer, O Lord God; You are my Master, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hau maagau saran har naam kee har har mukh paaiaa ||
english: I beg for the Sanctuary of the Lord's Name, Har, Har; please, place it in my mouth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal har birad hai har laaj rakhaaiaa ||
english: It is the Lord's natural way to love His devotees; O Lord, please preserve my honor!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak saranaagatee har naam taraaiaa ||4||8||15||
english: Servant Nanak has entered His Sanctuary, and has been saved by the Name of the Lord. ||4||8||15||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਢੂਢੇਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਲਧਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh dhoo(n)dh dhoodhediaa har sajan ladhaa raam raaje ||
english: As Gurmukh, I searched and searched, and found the Lord, my Friend, my Sovereign Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟ ਗੜ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਧਾ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)chan kaaiaa kot gaR vich har har sidhaa ||
english: Within the walled fortress of my golden body, the Lord, Har, Har, is revealed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਵਿਧਾ ॥
transliteration: har har heeraa ratan hai meraa man tan vidhaa ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is a jewel, a diamond; my mind and body are pierced through.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਧਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhur bhaag vade har paaiaa naanak ras gudhaa ||1||
english: By the great good fortune of pre-ordained destiny, I have found the Lord. Nanak is permeated with His sublime essence. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਖੜੀ ਮੁੰਧ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)th dasaavaa nit khaRee mu(n)dh joban baalee raam raaje ||
english: I stand by the roadside, and ask the way; I am just a youthful bride of the Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: har har naam chetaai gur har maarag chaalee ||
english: The Guru has caused me to remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; I follow the Path to Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: merai man tan naam aadhaar hai haumai bikh jaalee ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of my mind and body; I have burnt away the poison of ego.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak satigur mel har har miliaa banavaalee ||2||
english: O True Guru, unite me with the Lord, unite me with the Lord, adorned with garlands of flowers. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਮੈ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh piaare aai mil mai chiree vichhu(n)ne raam raaje ||
english: O my Love, come and meet me as Gurmukh; I have been separated from You for so long, Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨੈਣ ਰਸਿ ਭਿੰਨੇ ॥
transliteration: meraa man tan bahut bairaagiaa har nain ras bhi(n)ne ||
english: My mind and body are sad; my eyes are wet with the Lord's sublime essence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦਸਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨੇ ॥
transliteration: mai har prabh piaaraa das gur mil har man ma(n)ne ||
english: Show me my Lord God, my Love, O Guru; meeting the Lord, my mind is pleased.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਮੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hau moorakh kaarai laaeeaa naanak har ka(n)me ||3||
english: I am just a fool, O Nanak, but the Lord has appointed me to perform His service. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਿੰਨੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੁਰਕੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: gur a(n)mrit bhi(n)nee dehuree a(n)mrit burake raam raaje ||
english: The Guru's body is drenched with Ambrosial Nectar; He sprinkles it upon me, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਛਕਿ ਛਕੇ ॥
transliteration: jinaa gurabaanee man bhaaeeaa a(n)mrit chhak chhake ||
english: Those whose minds are pleased with the Word of the Guru's Bani, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar again and again.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਚੂਕੇ ਧਕ ਧਕੇ ॥
transliteration: gur tuthai har paaiaa chooke dhak dhake ||
english: As the Guru is pleased, the Lord is obtained, and you shall not be pushed around any more.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇਆ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੬॥
transliteration: har jan har har hoiaa naanak har ike ||4||9||16||
english: The Lord's humble servant becomes the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, the Lord and His servant are one and the same. ||4||9||16||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)mrit bhagat bha(n)daar hai gur satigur paase raam raaje ||
english: The treasure of Ambrosial Nectar, the Lord's devotional service, is found through the Guru, the True Guru, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur sachaa saahu hai sikh dei har raase ||
english: The Guru, the True Guru, is the True Banker, who gives to His Sikh the capital of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਵਣਜੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਬਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n vanajaaraa vanaj hai gur saahu saabaase ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the trader and the trade; how wonderful is the Banker, the Guru!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak gur tinhee paaiaa jin dhur likhat lilaat likhaase ||1||
english: O servant Nanak, they alone obtain the Guru, who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: sach saahu hamaaraa too(n) dhanee sabh jagat vanajaaraa raam raaje ||
english: You are my True Banker, O Lord; the whole world is Your trader, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh bhaa(n)de tudhai saajiaa vich vasat har thaaraa ||
english: You fashioned all vessels, O Lord, and that which dwells within is also Yours.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਾ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jo paavahi bhaa(n)de vich vasat saa nikalai kiaa koee kare vechaaraa ||
english: Whatever You place in that vessel, that alone comes out again. What can the poor creatures do?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau har bakhasiaa har bhagat bha(n)daaraa ||2||
english: The Lord has given the treasure of His devotional worship to servant Nanak. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿਥਰਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂੰ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: ham kiaa gun tere vitharah suaamee too(n) apar apaaro raam raaje ||
english: What Glorious Virtues of Yours can I describe, O Lord and Master? You are the most infinite of the infinite, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਹ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਏਹਾ ਆਸ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: har naam saalaahah din raat ehaa aas aadhaaro ||
english: I praise the Lord's Name, day and night; this alone is my hope and support.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਿਛੂਅ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਾ ਕਿਵ ਪਾਵਹ ਪਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: ham moorakh kichhoo na jaanahaa kiv paavah paaro ||
english: I am a fool, and I know nothing. How can I find Your limits?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai har daas panihaaro ||3||
english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord, the water-carrier of the slaves of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈ ਹਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਏ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakh lai ham saran prabh aae raam raaje ||
english: As it pleases You, You save me; I have come seeking Your Sanctuary, O God, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਭੂਲਿ ਵਿਗਾੜਹ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ham bhool vigaaRah dinas raat har laaj rakhaae ||
english: I am wandering around, ruining myself day and night; O Lord, please save my honor!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਹੈ ਦੇ ਮਤਿ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ham baarik too(n) gur pitaa hai de mat samajhaae ||
english: I am just a child; You, O Guru, are my father. Please give me understanding and instruction.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਂਢਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੭॥
transliteration: jan naanak daas har kaa(n)dhiaa har paij rakhaae ||4||10||17||
english: Servant Nanak is known as the Lord's slave; O Lord, please preserve his honor! ||4||10||17||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: jin masatak dhur har likhiaa tinaa satigur miliaa raam raaje ||
english: Those who have the blessed pre-ordained destiny of the Lord written on their foreheads, meet the True Guru, the Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਘਟਿ ਬਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: agiaan a(n)dheraa katiaa gur giaan ghat baliaa ||
english: The Guru removes the darkness of ignorance, and spiritual wisdom illuminates their hearts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਲਧਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਚਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har ladhaa ratan padaaratho phir bahuR na chaliaa ||
english: They find the wealth of the jewel of the Lord, and then, they do not wander any longer.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam aaraadhiaa aaraadh har miliaa ||1||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and in meditation, he meets the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਗਿ ਆਏ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: jinee aisaa har naam na chetio se kaahe jag aae raam raaje ||
english: Those who have not kept the Lord's Name in their consciousness - why did they bother to come into the world, O Lord King?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ihu maanas janam dula(n)bh hai naam binaa birathaa sabh jaae ||
english: It is so difficult to obtain this human incarnation, and without the Naam, it is all futile and useless.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਣਿ ਵਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੀਜਿਓ ਅਗੈ ਭੁਖਾ ਕਿਆ ਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hun vatai har naam na beejio agai bhukhaa kiaa khaae ||
english: Now, in this most fortunate season, he does not plant the seed of the Lord's Name; what will the hungry soul eat, in the world hereafter?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: manamukhaa no phir janam hai naanak har bhaae ||2||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are born again and again. O Nanak, such is the Lord's Will. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: too(n) har teraa sabh ko sabh tudh upaae raam raaje ||
english: You, O Lord, belong to all, and all belong to You. You created all, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kichh haath kisai dai kichh naahee sabh chalahi chalaae ||
english: Nothing is in anyone's hands; all walk as You cause them to walk.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jinh too(n) melahi piaare se tudh milahi jo har man bhaae ||
english: They alone are united with You, O Beloved, whom You cause to be so united; they alone are pleasing to Your Mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak satigur bhetiaa har naam taraae ||3||
english: Servant Nanak has met the True Guru, and through the Lord's Name, he has been carried across. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਦੀ ਬੇਦੀ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: koee gaavai raagee naadee bedee bahu bhaat kar nahee har har bheejai raam raaje ||
english: Some sing of the Lord, through musical Ragas and the sound current of the Naad, through the Vedas, and in so many ways. But the Lord, Har, Har, is not pleased by these, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨਾ ਰੋਇ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jinaa a(n)tar kapat vikaar hai tinaa roi kiaa keejai ||
english: Those who are filled with fraud and corruption within - what good does it do for them to cry out?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਰੋਗ ਹਥੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: har karataa sabh kichh jaanadaa sir rog hath deejai ||
english: The Creator Lord knows everything, although they may try to hide their sins and the causes of their diseases.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੮॥
transliteration: jinaa naanak guramukh hiradaa sudh hai har bhagat har leejai ||4||11||18||
english: O Nanak, those Gurmukhs whose hearts are pure, obtain the Lord, Har, Har, by devotional worship. ||4||11||18||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੁਘੜ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: jin a(n)tar har har preet hai te jan sughaR siaane raam raaje ||
english: Those whose hearts are filled with the love of the Lord, Har, Har, are the wisest and most clever people, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਭੁਲਿ ਚੁਕਿ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਭੀ ਖਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: je baaharahu bhul chuk bolade bhee khare har bhaane ||
english: Even if they misspeak outwardly, they are still very pleasing to the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਨੋ ਹੋਰੁ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)taa no hor thaau naahee har maan nimaane ||
english: The Lord's Saints have no other place. The Lord is the honor of the dishonored.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਣੁ ਸਤਾਣੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam deebaan hai har taan sataane ||1||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Royal Court for servant Nanak; the Lord's power is his only power. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: jithai jaai bahai meraa satiguroo so thaan suhaavaa raam raaje ||
english: Wherever my True Guru goes and sits, that place is beautiful, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਂੀ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਭਾਲਿਆ ਲੈ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: gurasikha(n)ee so thaan bhaaliaa lai dhoor mukh laavaa ||
english: The Guru's Sikhs seek out that place; they take the dust and apply it to their faces.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ਥਾਇ ਪਈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਾ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa kee ghaal thaai paee jin har naam dhiaavaa ||
english: The works of the Guru's Sikhs, who meditate on the Lord's Name, are approved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jinh naanak satigur poojiaa tin har pooj karaavaa ||2||
english: Those who worship the True Guru, O Nanak - the Lord causes them to be worshipped in turn. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa man har preet hai har naam har teree raam raaje ||
english: The Guru's Sikh keeps the Love of the Lord, and the Name of the Lord, in his mind. He loves You, O Lord, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਭੁਖ ਜਾਇ ਲਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kar sevahi pooraa satiguroo bhukh jaai lahi meree ||
english: He serves the Perfect True Guru, and his hunger and self-conceit are eliminated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਗਈ ਤਿਨ ਪਿਛੈ ਹੋਰ ਖਾਇ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa kee bhukh sabh gaee tin pichhai hor khaai ghaneree ||
english: The hunger of the Gursikh is totally eliminated; indeed, many others are satisfied through them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak har pu(n)n beejiaa phir tot na aavai har pu(n)n keree ||3||
english: Servant Nanak has planted the Seed of the Lord's Goodness; this Goodness of the Lord shall never be exhausted. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ਜਿਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਡਿਠਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa man vaadhaaeeaa jin meraa satiguroo dithaa raam raaje ||
english: The minds of the Gursikhs rejoice, because they have seen my True Guru, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਗਲ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਲਗੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਮਿਠਾ ॥
transliteration: koee kar gal sunaavai har naam kee so lagai gurasikhaa man mithaa ||
english: If someone recites to them the story of the Lord's Name, it seems so sweet to the mind of those Gursikhs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੈਨਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ॥
transliteration: har daragah gurasikh painaaeeahi jinhaa meraa satigur tuthaa ||
english: The Gursikhs are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord; my True Guru is very pleased with them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੯॥
transliteration: jan naanak har har hoiaa har har man vuthaa ||4||12||19||
english: Servant Nanak has become the Lord, Har, Har; the Lord, Har, Har, abides within his mind. ||4||12||19||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: jinhaa bhetiaa meraa pooraa satiguroo tin har naam driRaavai raam raaje ||
english: Those who meet my Perfect True Guru - He implants within them the Name of the Lord, the Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tis kee trisanaa bhukh sabh utarai jo har naam dhiaavai ||
english: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name have all of their desire and hunger removed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo har har naam dhiaaide tinh jam neR na aavai ||
english: Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - the Messenger of Death cannot even approach them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau har kripaa kar nit japai har naam har naam taraavai ||1||
english: O Lord, shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, that he may ever chant the Name of the Lord; through the Name of the Lord, he is saved. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: jinee guramukh naam dhiaaiaa tinaa phir bighan na hoee raam raaje ||
english: Those who, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, meet no obstacles in their path, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਜੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jinee satigur purakh manaaiaa tin pooje sabh koee ||
english: Those who are pleasing to the almighty True Guru are worshipped by everyone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਦ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jinhee satigur piaaraa seviaa tinhaa sukh sad hoee ||
english: Those who serve their Beloved True Guru obtain eternal peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jinhaa naanak satigur bhetiaa tinhaa miliaa har soee ||2||
english: Those who meet the True Guru, O Nanak - the Lord Himself meets them. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: jinhaa a(n)tar guramukh preet hai tinh har rakhanahaaraa raam raaje ||
english: Those Gurmukhs, who are filled with His Love, have the Lord as their Saving Grace, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tinh kee ni(n)daa koee kiaa kare jinh har naam piaaraa ||
english: How can anyone slander them? The Lord's Name is dear to them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਸਭ ਦੁਸਟ ਝਖ ਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jin har setee man maaniaa sabh dusat jhakh maaraa ||
english: Those whose minds are in harmony with the Lord - all their enemies attack them in vain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa har rakhanahaaraa ||3||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Lord Protector. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: har jug jug bhagat upaaiaa paij rakhadaa aaiaa raam raaje ||
english: In each and every age, He creates His devotees and preserves their honor, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haranaakhas dusat har maariaa prahalaad taraaiaa ||
english: The Lord killed the wicked Harnaakhash, and saved Prahlaad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਪਿਠਿ ਦੇਇ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)kaareeaa ni(n)dakaa pith dei naamadeu mukh laaiaa ||
english: He turned his back on the egotists and slanderers, and showed His Face to Naam Dayv.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੦॥
transliteration: jan naanak aisaa har seviaa a(n)t lae chhadaaiaa ||4||13||20||
english: Servant Nanak has so served the Lord, that He will deliver him in the end. ||4||13||20||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 chha(n)t ghar 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Chhant, Fifth House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਵੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਆਉ ਘਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mere man paradesee ve piaare aau ghare ||
english: O my dear beloved stranger mind, please come home!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har guroo milaavahu mere piaare ghar vasai hare ||
english: Meet with the Lord-Guru, O my dear beloved, and He will dwell in the home of your self.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g raleeaa maanahu mere piaare har kirapaa kare ||
english: Revel in His Love, O my dear beloved, as the Lord bestows His Mercy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur naanak tuthaa mere piaare mele hare ||1||
english: As Guru Nanak is pleased, O my dear beloved, we are united with the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mai prem na chaakhiaa mere piaare bhaau kare ||
english: I have not tasted divine love, O my dear beloved, within my heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਆਸ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man trisanaa na bujhee mere piaare nit aas kare ||
english: The mind's desires are not quenched, O my dear beloved, but I still hold out hope.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਸਾਸ ਹਿਰੇ ॥
transliteration: nit joban jaavai mere piaare jam saas hire ||
english: Youth is passing away, O my dear beloved, and death is stealing away the breath of life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਗ ਮਣੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhaag manee sohaagan mere piaare naanak har ur dhaare ||2||
english: The virtuous bride realizes the good fortune of her destiny, O my dear beloved; O Nanak, she enshrines the Lord within her heart. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਰਤਿਅੜੇ ਮੈਡੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਵੈ ॥
transliteration: pir ratiaRe maide loin mere piaare chaatrik boo(n)d jivai ||
english: My eyes are drenched with the Love of my Husband Lord, O my dear beloved, like the song-bird with the rain drop.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਪੀਵੈ ॥
transliteration: man seetal hoaa mere piaare har boo(n)d peevai ||
english: My mind is cooled and soothed, O my dear beloved, by drinking in the rain drops of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਜਗਾਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਕਿਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tan birahu jagaavai mere piaare need na pavai kivai ||
english: Separation from my Lord keeps my body awake, O my dear beloved; I cannot sleep at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਲਧਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har sajan ladhaa mere piaare naanak guroo livai ||3||
english: Nanak has found the Lord, the True Friend, O my dear beloved, by loving the Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੜਿ ਚੇਤੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਲੀਅ ਰੁਤੇ ॥
transliteration: chaR chet basa(n)t mere piaare bhalee rute ||
english: In the month of Chayt, O my dear beloved, the pleasant season of spring begins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਬਾਝੜਿਅਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਆਂਗਣਿ ਧੂੜਿ ਲੁਤੇ ॥
transliteration: pir baajhaRiahu mere piaare aa(n)gan dhooR lute ||
english: But without my Husband Lord, O my dear beloved, my courtyard is filled with dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਉਡੀਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੁਇ ਨੈਨ ਜੁਤੇ ॥
transliteration: man aas udeenee mere piaare dui nain jute ||
english: But my sad mind is still hopeful, O my dear beloved; my eyes are both fixed upon Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤ ਸੁਤੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur naanak dekh vigasee mere piaare jiu maat sute ||4||
english: Beholding the Guru, Nanak is filled with wondrous joy, like a child, gazing upon his mother. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: har keeaa kathaa kahaaneeaa mere piaare satiguroo sunaaeeaa ||
english: The True Guru has preached the sermon of the Lord, O my dear beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: gur vitaRiahu hau gholee mere piaare jin har melaaeeaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, O my dear beloved, who has united me with the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਆਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh aasaa har pooreeaa mere piaare man chi(n)diaRaa phal paaiaa ||
english: The Lord has fulfilled all my hopes, O my dear beloved; I have obtained the fruits of my heart's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਠੜਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: har tuthaRaa mere piaare jan naanak naam samaaiaa ||5||
english: When the Lord is pleased, O my dear beloved, servant Nanak is absorbed into the Naam. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਖੇਲਸਾ ॥
transliteration: piaare har bin prem na khelasaa ||
english: Without the Beloved Lord, there is no play of love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦੇਖਸਾ ॥
transliteration: kiu paaee gur jit lag piaaraa dekhasaa ||
english: How can I find the Guru? Grasping hold of Him, I behold my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤੜੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਸਾ ॥
transliteration: har daataRe mel guroo mukh guramukh melasaa ||
english: O Lord, O Great Giver, let me meet the Guru; as Gurmukh, may I merge with You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਸਾ ॥੬॥੧੪॥੨੧॥
transliteration: gur naanak paaiaa mere piaare dhur masatak lekh saa ||6||14||21||
english: Nanak has found the Guru, O my dear beloved; such was the destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||6||14||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੋ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: anado anad ghanaa mai so prabh deethaa raam ||
english: Joy - great joy! I have seen the Lord God!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਖਿਅੜਾ ਚਾਖਿਅੜਾ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: chaakhiaRaa chaakhiaRaa mai har ras meethaa raam ||
english: Tasted - I have tasted the sweet essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੂਠਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har ras meethaa man mahi voothaa satigur toothaa sahaj bhaiaa ||
english: The sweet essence of the Lord has rained down in my mind; by the pleasure of the True Guru, I have attained peaceful ease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਪੰਚ ਦੁਸਟ ਓਇ ਭਾਗਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: grihu vas aaiaa ma(n)gal gaaiaa pa(n)ch dusat oi bhaag gaiaa ||
english: I have come to dwell in the home of my own self, and I sing the songs of joy; the five villains have fled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਆਘਾਣੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: seetal aaghaane a(n)mrit baane saajan sa(n)t baseethaa ||
english: I am soothed and satisfied with the Ambrosial Bani of His Word; the friendly Saint is my advocate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੈਣੀ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak har siu man maaniaa so prabh nainee deethaa ||1||
english: Says Nanak, my mind is in harmony with the Lord; I have seen God with my eyes. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਿਅੜੇ ਸੋਹਿਅੜੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sohiaRe sohiaRe mere ba(n)k duaare raam ||
english: Adorned - adorned are my beauteous gates, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਹੁਨੜੇ ਪਾਹੁਨੜੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: paahunaRe paahunaRe mere sa(n)t piaare raam ||
english: Guests - my guests are the Beloved Saints, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t piaare kaaraj saare namasakaar kar lage sevaa ||
english: The Beloved Saints have resolved my affairs; I humbly bowed to them, and committed myself to their service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਞੀ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਞੀ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: aape jaanjee aape maanjee aap suaamee aap devaa ||
english: He Himself is the groom's party, and He Himself the bride's party; He Himself is the Lord and Master; He Himself is the Divine Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਧਾਰਨ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: apanaa kaaraj aap savaare aape dhaaran dhaare ||
english: He Himself resolves His own affairs; He Himself sustains the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਸੋਹੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sahu ghar mahi baithaa sohe ba(n)k duaare ||2||
english: Says Nanak, my Bridegroom is sitting in my home; the gates of my body are beautifully adorned. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਨਿਧੇ ਨਉ ਨਿਧੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: nav nidhe nau nidhe mere ghar mahi aaee raam ||
english: The nine treasures - the nine treasures come into my home, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh mai sabh kichh paaiaa naam dhiaaee raam ||
english: Everything - I obtain everything, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਖਾਈ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: naam dhiaaee sadaa sakhaaee sahaj subhaaee govi(n)daa ||
