english: Meditating on the Naam, the Lord of the Universe becomes one's eternal companion, and he dwells in peaceful ease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਣਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਚੂਕੀ ਧਾਈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: ganat mitaaee chookee dhaaee kade na viaapai man chi(n)daa ||
english: His calculations are ended, his wanderings cease, and his mind is no longer afflicted with anxiety.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਸੋਭ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: govi(n)d gaaje anahad vaaje acharaj sobh banaaee ||
english: When the Lord of the Universe reveals Himself, and the unstruck melody of the sound current vibrates, the drama of wondrous splendor is enacted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak pir merai sa(n)ge taa mai nav nidh paaee ||3||
english: Says Nanak, when my Husband Lord is with me, I obtain the nine treasures. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਸਿਅੜੇ ਸਰਸਿਅੜੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਸਭ ਮੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sarasiaRe sarasiaRe mere bhaaee sabh meetaa raam ||
english: Over-joyed - over-joyed are all my brothers and friends.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਮੋ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bikhamo bikham akhaaRaa mai gur mil jeetaa raam ||
english: Meeting the Guru, I have won the most arduous battle in the arena of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੀਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੂਟੀ ਭੀਤਾ ਭਰਮ ਗੜਾ ॥
transliteration: gur mil jeetaa har har keetaa tootee bheetaa bharam gaRaa ||
english: Meeting the Guru, I am victorious; praising the Lord, Har, Har, the walls of the fortress of doubt have been destroyed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਸਾਣਥ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਖੜਾ ॥
transliteration: paaiaa khajaanaa bahut nidhaanaa saanath meree aap khaRaa ||
english: I have obtained the wealth of so many treasures; the Lord Himself has stood by my side.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਗਿਆਨਾ ਸੋ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: soee sugiaanaa so paradhaanaa jo prabh apanaa keetaa ||
english: He is the man of spiritual wisdom, and he is the leader, whom God has made His own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਂ ਵਲਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਸਰਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jaa(n) val suaamee taa sarase bhaaee meetaa ||4||1||
english: Says Nanak, when the Lord and Master is on my side, then my brothers and friends rejoice. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: akathaa har akath kathaa kichh jaai na jaanee raam ||
english: Inexpressible is the sermon of the inexpressible Lord; it cannot be known at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sur nar sur nar mun jan sahaj vakhaanee raam ||
english: The demi-gods, mortal beings, angels and silent sages express it in their peaceful poise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਅਮਿਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sahaje vakhaanee amiu baanee charan kamal ra(n)g laaiaa ||
english: In their poise, they recite the Ambrosial Bani of the Lord's Word; they embrace love for the Lord's Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jap ek alakh prabh nira(n)jan man chi(n)diaa phal paaiaa ||
english: Meditating on the One incomprehensible and immaculate Lord, they obtain the fruits of their heart's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: taj maan mohu vikaar doojaa jotee jot samaanee ||
english: Renouncing self-conceit, emotional attachment, corruption and duality, their light merges into the Light.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak gur prasaadee sadaa har ra(n)g maanee ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, by Guru's Grace, one enjoys the Lord's Love forever. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)taa har sa(n)t sajan mere meet sahaaee raam ||
english: The Lord's Saints - the Lord's Saints are my friends, my best friends and helpers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee vadabhaagee satasa(n)gat paaee raam ||
english: By great good fortune, by great good fortune, I have obtained the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਲਾਥੇ ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee paae naam dhiaae laathe dookh sa(n)taapai ||
english: By great good fortune, I obtained it, and I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; my pains and sufferings have been taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੇ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: gur charanee laage bhram bhau bhaage aap mitaaiaa aapai ||
english: I have grasped the Guru's Feet, and my doubts and fears are gone. He Himself has erased my self-conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mele prabh apunai vichhuR katahi na jaaee ||
english: Granting His Grace, God has united me with Himself; no longer do I suffer the pains of separation, and I shall not have to go anywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak daas teraa sadaa har saranaaee ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, I am forever Your slave, Lord; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har dare har dar sohan tere bhagat piaare raam ||
english: The Lord's Gate - at the Lord's Gate, Your beloved devotees look beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਾਵਾ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: vaaree tin vaaree jaavaa sad balihaare raam ||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, again and again a sacrifice to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sad balihaare kar namasakaare jin bhetat prabh jaataa ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice, and I humbly bow to them; meeting them, I know God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat rav rahiaa sabh thaaee pooran purakh bidhaataa ||
english: The Perfect and All-powerful Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is contained in each and every heart, everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa paaiaa naam dhiaaiaa jooai janam na haare ||
english: Meeting the Perfect Guru, we meditate on the Naam, and do not lose this life in the gamble.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak saran teree raakh kirapaa dhaare ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, shower Your Mercy upon me, and protect me. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੇਤਕ ਗਾਵਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bea(n)taa bea(n)t gun tere ketak gaavaa raam ||
english: Innumerable - innumerable are Your Glorious Virtues; how many of them can I sing?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਣਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਵਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tere charanaa tere charan dhooR vadabhaagee paavaa raam ||
english: The dust of Your feet, of Your feet, I have obtained, by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧੂੜੀ ਨੑਾਈਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: har dhooRee nhaaeeai mail gavaaeeai janam maran dukh laathe ||
english: Bathing in the Lord's dust, my filth has been washed away, and the pains of birth and death have departed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar sadaa hadoore paramesar prabh saathe ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, the Transcendent Lord God is ever-present, always with us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੇ ਦੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: mite dookh kaliaan keeratan bahuR jon na paavaa ||
english: Suffering departs, and there is peace; singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, one is not consigned to reincarnation again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak gur saran tareeai aapane prabh bhaavaa ||4||2||
english: Prays Nanak, in the Guru's Sanctuary, one swims across, and is pleasing to God. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa chha(n)t mahalaa 5 ghar 4 ||
english: Aasaa, Chhant, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: har charan kamal man bedhiaa kichh aan na meethaa raam raaje ||
english: My mind is pierced by the Lord's Lotus Feet; He alone is sweet to my mind, the Lord King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਡੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)tasa(n)gat aaraadhiaa har ghat ghate deethaa raam raaje ||
english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I meditate on the Lord in adoration; I behold the Lord King in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਡੀਠਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੋੁ ਵੂਠਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
transliteration: har ghat ghate deethaa a(n)mritou voothaa janam maran dukh naathe ||
english: I behold the Lord in each and every heart, and the Ambrosial Nectar rains down upon me; the pains of birth and death are gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਗਾਠੇ ॥
transliteration: gun nidh gaaiaa sabh dookh mitaaiaa haumai binasee gaathe ||
english: Singing the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue, all my pains are erased, and the knot of ego has been untied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: priu sahaj subhaaee chhod na jaaee man laagaa ra(n)g majeethaa ||
english: My Beloved shall not leave me to go anywhere - this is His natural way; my mind is imbued with the lasting color of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਧੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har naanak bedhe charan kamal kichh aan na meethaa ||1||
english: The Lotus Feet of the Lord have pierced Nanak's mind, and now, nothing else seems sweet to him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਲਿ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: jiu raatee jal maachhulee tiu raam ras maate raam raaje ||
english: Just like the fish which revels in water, I am intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, my Lord King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਜੀਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਭਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai upadesiaa jeevan gat bhaate raam raaje ||
english: The Perfect Guru has instructed me, and blessed me with salvation in my life; I love the Lord, my King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jeevan gat suaamee a(n)tarajaamee aap leee laR laae ||
english: The Lord Master, the Searcher of hearts, blesses me with salvation in my life; He Himself attaches me to His Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੋ ਪਰਗਟੋ ਪੂਰਨੋ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har ratan padaaratho paragato poorano chhod na katahoo jaae ||
english: The Lord is the treasure of jewels, the perfect manifestation; He shall not forsake us to go anywhere else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਘਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh sughar saroop sujaan suaamee taa kee mitai na daate ||
english: God, the Lord Master, is so accomplished, beauteous, and all-knowing; His gifts are never exhausted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jal sa(n)g raatee maachhulee naanak har maate ||2||
english: As the fish is enraptured by the water, so is Nanak intoxicated by the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: chaatrik jaachai boo(n)d jiu har praan adhaaraa raam raaje ||
english: As the song-bird yearns for the rain-drop, the Lord, the Lord my King, is the Support of my breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜੀਨਾ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਸਭਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: maal khajeenaa sut bhraat meet sabhahoo(n) te piaaraa raam raaje ||
english: My Lord King is more beloved than all wealth, treasure, children, siblings and friends.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sabhahoo(n) te piaaraa purakh niraaraa taa kee gat nahee jaaneeai ||
english: The absolute Lord, the Primal Being, is more beloved than all; His condition cannot be known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har saas giraas na bisarai kabahoo(n) gurasabadee ra(n)g maaneeai ||
english: I shall never forget the Lord, for an instant, for a single breath; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I enjoy His Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੋ ਸੰਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨੋ ਜਪਿ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ ਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh purakh jagajeevano sa(n)t ras peevano jap bharam moh dukh daaraa ||
english: The Primal Lord God is the Life of the Universe; His Saints drink in the Lord's sublime essence. Meditating on Him, doubts, attachments and pains are shaken off.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chaatrik jaachai boo(n)d jiu naanak har piaaraa ||3||
english: As the song-bird yearns for the rain-drop, so does Nanak love the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੇ ਨਰਾਇਣ ਆਪਣੇ ਮਾਨੋਰਥੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: mile naraain aapane maanoratho pooraa raam raaje ||
english: Meeting the Lord, my Lord King, my desires are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਢਾਠੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਭਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਭੇਟਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: dhaathee bheet bhara(n)m kee bhetat gur sooraa raam raaje ||
english: The walls of doubt have been torn down, meeting the Brave Guru, O Lord King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਾਏ ਸਭ ਨਿਧਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: pooran gur paae purab likhaae sabh nidh deen daiaalaa ||
english: The Perfect Guru is obtained by perfect pre-ordained destiny; God is the Giver of all treasures - He is merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aad madh a(n)t prabh soee su(n)dar gur gopaalaa ||
english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, is God, the most beautiful Guru, the Sustainer of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ghanere patit paavan saadhoo dhooraa ||
english: The dust of the feet of the Holy purifies sinners, and brings great joy, bliss and ecstasy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਰਾਇਣ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਾਨੋਰਥੋੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: har mile naraain naanakaa maanorathou pooraa ||4||1||3||
english: The Lord, the Infinite Lord, has met with Nanak, and his desires are fulfilled. ||4||1||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ghar 6 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Sixth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਈ ਜਪਾਤ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau bhae kripaal prabh har har seee japaat ||
english: Those beings, unto whom the Lord God shows His Mercy, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak preet lagee tinh raam siu bhetat saadh sa(n)gaat ||1||
english: O Nanak, they embrace love for the Lord, meeting the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਨਿਆਈ ਰੀਤਿ ਅਬ ਦੁਧ ਆਚ ਨਹੀ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jal dudh niaaee reet ab dudh aach nahee man aisee preet hare ||
english: Just like water, which loves milk so much that it will not let it burn - O my mind, so love the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲੇਹ ਬਾਸਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਮਗਨ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਟਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ab urajhio al kamaleh baasan maahi magan ik khin bhee naahi tarai ||
english: The bumble bee becomes enticed by the lotus, intoxicated by its fragrance, and does not leave it, even for a moment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਟਰੀਐ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰੀਐ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਹਭਿ ਰਸ ਅਰਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: khin naahi tareeai preet hareeai seegaar habh ras arapeeai ||
english: Do not let up your love for the Lord, even for an instant; dedicate all your decorations and pleasures to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੂਖੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਭਣੀਐ ਤਹ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਡਰਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jah dookh suneeai jam pa(n)th bhaneeai tah saadhasa(n)g na darapeeai ||
english: Where painful cries are heard, and the Way of Death is shown, there, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall not be afraid.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣੀਐ ਸਗਲ ਪ੍ਰਾਛਤ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kar keerat govi(n)d guneeai sagal praachhat dukh hare ||
english: Sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and all sins and sorrows shall depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੰਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਰੇਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak chha(n)t govi(n)d har ke man har siu nehu karehu aisee man preet hare ||1||
english: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, O mind, and enshrine love for the Lord; love the Lord this way in your mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਨਾ ਧੀਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jaisee machhulee neer ik khin bhee naa dheere man aisaa nehu karehu ||
english: As the fish loves the water, and is not content even for an instant outside it, O my mind, love the Lord in this way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਚਵੈ ਬਰਸੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jaisee chaatrik piaas khin khin boo(n)d chavai baras suhaave mehu ||
english: Like the song-bird, thirsting for the rain-drops, chirping each and every moment to the beautiful rain clouds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਅਤਿ ਲਾਈਐ ਚਿਤੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har preet kareejai ihu man deejai at laaeeai chit muraaree ||
english: So love the Lord, and give to Him this mind of yours; totally focus your consciousness on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੀਜੈ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maan na keejai saran pareejai darasan kau balihaaree ||
english: Do not take pride in yourself, but seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, and make yourself a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੇ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਹ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਧਨ ਦੇਦੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: gur suprasa(n)ne mil naah vichhu(n)ne dhan dedee saach sanehaa ||
english: When the Guru is totally pleased, the separated soul-bride is re-united with her Husband Lord; she sends the message of her true love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੰਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਨੇਹਾ ਮਨ ਐਸਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak chha(n)t ana(n)t thaakur ke har siu keejai nehaa man aisaa nehu karehu ||2||
english: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Infinite Lord Master; O my mind, love Him and enshrine such love for Him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਆਸ ਘਣੀ ਕਦਿ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ ॥
transliteration: chakavee soor sanehu chitavai aas ghanee kad dineear dekheeai ||
english: The chakvi bird is in love with the sun, and thinks of it constantly; her greatest longing is to behold the dawn.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਕਿਲ ਅੰਬ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਚਵੈ ਸੁਹਾਵੀਆ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kokil a(n)b pareet chavai suhaaveeaa man har ra(n)g keejeeai ||
english: The cuckoo is in love with the mango tree, and sings so sweetly. O my mind, love the Lord in this way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਇਕ ਰਾਤੀ ਕੇ ਹਭਿ ਪਾਹੁਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har preet kareejai maan na keejai ik raatee ke habh paahuniaa ||
english: Love the Lord, and do not take pride in yourself; everyone is a guest for a single night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਓ ਮੋਹੁ ਰਚਾਇਓ ਨਾਗੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ab kiaa ra(n)g laaio mohu rachaaio naage aavan jaavaniaa ||
english: Now, why are you entangled in pleasures, and engrossed in emotional attachment? Naked we come, and naked we go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣੀ ਪੜੀਐ ਚਰਣੀ ਅਬ ਟੂਟਸਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਜੁ ਕਿਤੀਐ ॥
transliteration: thir saadhoo saranee paReeai charanee ab tootas mohu j kiteeai ||
english: Seek the eternal Sanctuary of the Holy and fall at their feet, and the attachments which you feel shall depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਕਬ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak chha(n)t daiaal purakh ke man har laai pareet kab dineear dekheeai ||3||
english: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Merciful Lord God, and enshrine love for the Lord, O my mind; otherwise, how will you come to behold the dawn? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਨਾਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਹੀਉ ਡਿਵੈ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: nis kura(n)k jaise naad sun sravanee heeu divai man aisee preet keejai ||
english: Like the deer in the night, who hears the sound of the bell and gives his heart - O my mind, love the Lord in this way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਤਰੁਣਿ ਭਤਾਰ ਉਰਝੀ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਸਿਵੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jaisee tarun bhataar urajhee pirahi sivai ihu man laal deejai ||
english: Like the wife, who is bound by love to her husband, and serves her beloved - like this, give your heart to the Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲਹਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਭੋਗ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਹਭਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: man laalahi deejai bhog kareejai habh khuseeaa ra(n)g maane ||
english: Give your heart to your Beloved Lord, and enjoy His bed, and enjoy all pleasure and bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਰਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: pir apanaa paaiaa ra(n)g laal banaaiaa at milio mitr chiraane ||
english: I have obtained my Husband Lord, and I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love; after such a long time, I have met my Friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਥੀਆ ਸਾਖੀ ਤਾ ਡਿਠਮੁ ਆਖੀ ਪਿਰ ਜੇਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
transliteration: gur theeaa saakhee taa ditham aakhee pir jehaa avar na deesai ||
english: When the Guru became my advocate, then I saw the Lord with my eyes. No one else looks like my Beloved Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਨ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੀਜੈ ਐਸੀ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak chha(n)t daiaal mohan ke man har charan gaheejai aisee man preet keejai ||4||1||4||
english: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the merciful and fascinating Lord, O mind. Grasp the lotus feet of the Lord, and enshrine such love for Him in your mind. ||4||1||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਫਿਰਤੀ ਖੋਜਤੀ ਹਾਰੀ ਬਹੁ ਅਵਗਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ban ban phiratee khojatee haaree bahu avagaahi ||
english: From forest to forest, I wandered searching; I am so tired of taking baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਜਬ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bhete saadh jab har paaiaa man maahi ||1||
english: O Nanak, when I met the Holy Saint, I found the Lord within my mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਮੁਨੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਤਪੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau khojahi asa(n)kh munee anek tape ||
english: Countless silent sages and innumerable ascetics seek Him;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਪ ਜਪੇ ॥
transliteration: brahame kot araadhahi giaanee jaap jape ||
english: millions of Brahmas meditate and adore Him; the spiritual teachers meditate and chant His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਾਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੋਧਨ ਬੰਦਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jap taap sa(n)jam kiriaa poojaa anik sodhan ba(n)danaa ||
english: Through chanting, deep meditation, strict and austere self-discipline, religious rituals, sincere worship, endless purifications and humble salutations,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਤੀਰਥਹ ਮਜਨੁ ਮਿਲਨ ਕਉ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kar gavan basudhaa teerathah majan milan kau nira(n)janaa ||
english: wandering all over the earth and bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, people seek to meet the Pure Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਬਨੁ ਤਿਨੁ ਪਸੂ ਪੰਖੀ ਸਗਲ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਤੇ ॥
transliteration: maanukh ban tin pasoo pa(n)khee sagal tujhahi araadhate ||
english: Mortals, forests, blades of grass, animals and birds all meditate on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਲਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਗਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daiaal laal gobi(n)d naanak mil saadhasa(n)gat hoi gate ||1||
english: The Merciful Beloved Lord, the Lord of the Universe is found; O Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, salvation is attained. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਸਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸੰਕਰ ਜਟਾਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kot bisan avataar sa(n)kar jataadhaar ||
english: Millions of incarnations of Vishnu and Shiva, with matted hair

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਹਹਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਦਇਆਰ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੁਚ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: chaahahi tujhahi daiaar man tan ruch apaar ||
english: yearn for You, O Merciful Lord; their minds and bodies are filled with infinite longing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਗਲ ਪੂਰਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨੀ ॥
transliteration: apaar agam gobi(n)d thaakur sagal poorak prabh dhanee ||
english: The Lord Master, the Lord of the Universe, is infinite and unapproachable; God is the all-pervading Lord of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰ ਸਿਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜਖ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਗੁਣ ਭਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sur sidh gan ga(n)dharab dhiaavahi jakh ki(n)nar gun bhanee ||
english: The angels,the Siddhas,the beings of spiritual perfection,the heavenly heralds and celestial singers meditate on You. The Yakhsha demons,the guards of the divine treasures,and the Kinnars, the dancers of the god of wealth chant Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਦੇਵਾ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kot i(n)dr anek devaa japat suaamee jai jai kaar ||
english: Millions of Indras and countless gods and super-human beings meditate on the Lord Master and celebrate His Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anaath naath daiaal naanak saadhasa(n)gat mil udhaar ||2||
english: The Merciful Lord is the Master of the masterless, O Nanak; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਲਖਿਮੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kot devee jaa kau sevahi lakhimee anik bhaat ||
english: Millions of gods and goddesses of wealth serve Him in so many ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: gupat pragat jaa kau araadhahi paun paanee dinas raat ||
english: The invisible and visible beings worship Him in adoration, along with wind and water, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਖਿਅਤ੍ਰ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਸੂਰ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਬਸੁਧ ਗਗਨਾ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: nakhiatr saseear soor dhiaavahi basudh gaganaa gaavae ||
english: The stars, the moon and the sun meditate on Him; the earth and the sky sing to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਖਾਣੀ ਸਗਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਏ ॥
transliteration: sagal khaanee sagal baanee sadaa sadaa dhiaavae ||
english: All the sources of creation, and all languages meditate on Him, forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦਹ ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜਪਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: simrit puraan chatur bedah khat saasatr jaa kau japaat ||
english: The Simritees, the Puraanas, the four Vedas and the six Shaastras meditate on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: patit paavan bhagat vachhal naanak mileeai sa(n)g saat ||3||
english: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Lover of His Saints; O Nanak, He is met in the Society of the Saints. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜਨਾਈ ਰਸਨਾ ਤੇਤ ਭਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jetee prabhoo janaaee rasanaa tet bhanee ||
english: As much as God has revealed to us, that much we can speak with our tongues.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਜਾਨਤ ਜੋ ਸੇਵੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: anajaanat jo sevai tetee nah jaai ganee ||
english: Those unknown ones who serve You cannot be counted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਅਗਨਤ ਅਥਾਹ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਗਲ ਮੰਝੇ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: avigat aganat athaah thaakur sagal ma(n)jhe baaharaa ||
english: Imperishable, incalculable, and unfathomable is the Lord and Master; He is everywhere, inside and out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਹ ਦੂਰਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab jaachik ek daataa nah door sa(n)gee jaaharaa ||
english: We are all beggars, He is the One and only Giver; He is not far away, but is with us, ever-present.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਸਿ ਭਗਤ ਥੀਆ ਮਿਲੇ ਜੀਆ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਿਤ ਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: vas bhagat theeaa mile jeeaa taa kee upamaa kit ganee ||
english: He is in the power of His devotees; those whose souls are united with Him - how can their praises be sung?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਾਏ ਸੀਸੁ ਸਾਧਹ ਧਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: ihu daan maan naanak paae sees saadhah dhar charanee ||4||2||5||
english: May Nanak receive this gift and honor, of placing his head on the feet of the Holy Saints. ||4||2||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: udam karahu vadabhaageeho simarahu har har raai ||
english: Make the effort, O very fortunate ones, and meditate on the Lord, the Lord King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jis simarat sabh sukh hovahi dookh darad bhram jaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, remembering Him in meditation, you shall obtain total peace, and your pains and troubles and doubts shall depart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਹ ਅਲਸਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: naam japat gobi(n)d nah alasaaeeai ||
english: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe; don't be lazy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਨਹ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: bhetat saadhoo sa(n)g jam pur nah jaaeeai ||
english: Meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall not have to go to the City of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਦ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
transliteration: dookh darad na bhau biaapai naam simarat sad sukhee ||
english: Pain, trouble and fear will not afflict you; meditating on the Naam, a lasting peace is found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖੀ ॥
transliteration: saas saas araadh har har dhiaai so prabh man mukhee ||
english: With each and every breath, worship the Lord in adoration; meditate on the Lord God in your mind and with your mouth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਰਸਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kripaal daiaal rasaal gun nidh kar daiaa sevaa laaeeai ||
english: O kind and compassionate Lord, O treasure of sublime essence, treasure of excellence, please link me to Your service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਣ ਜੰਪੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਹ ਅਲਸਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai charan ja(n)pai naam japat gobi(n)d nah alasaaeeai ||1||
english: Prays Nanak: may I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet, and not be lazy in chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: paavan patit puneet naam nira(n)janaa ||
english: The Purifier of sinners is the Naam, the Pure Name of the Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bharam a(n)dher binaas giaan gur a(n)janaa ||
english: The darkness of doubt is removed by the healing ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur giaan a(n)jan prabh nira(n)jan jal thal maheeal pooriaa ||
english: By the healing ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom, one meets the Immaculate Lord God, who is totally pervading the water, the land and the sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਿਟੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਵਿਸੂਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ik nimakh jaa kai ridai vasiaa mite tisahi visooriaa ||
english: If He dwells within the heart, for even an instant, sorrows are forgotten.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: agaadh bodh samarath suaamee sarab kaa bhau bha(n)janaa ||
english: The wisdom of the all-powerful Lord and Master is incomprehensible; He is the Destroyer of the fears of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਣ ਜੰਪੈ ਪਾਵਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai charan ja(n)pai paavan patit puneet naam nira(n)janaa ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet. The Purifier of sinners is the Naam, the Pure Name of the Immaculate Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧੇ ॥
transliteration: ot gahee gopaal daiaal kripaa nidhe ||
english: I have grasped the protection of the merciful Lord, the Sustainer of the Universe, the treasure of grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਆਸਰ ਤੁਅ ਚਰਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਿਧੇ ॥
transliteration: mohi aasar tu charan tumaaree saran sidhe ||
english: I take the support of Your lotus feet, and in the protection of Your Sanctuary, I attain perfection.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har charan kaaran karan suaamee patit udharan har hare ||
english: The Lord's lotus feet are the cause of causes; the Lord Master saves even the sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਭਵ ਉਤਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਬਹੁ ਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saagar sa(n)saar bhav utaar naam simarat bahu tare ||
english: So many are saved; they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, contemplating the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸੁਨੀ ਉਧਰਨ ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਬਿਧੇ ॥
transliteration: aad a(n)t bea(n)t khojahi sunee udharan sa(n)tasa(n)g bidhe ||
english: In the beginning and in the end, countless are those who seek the Lord. I have heard that the Society of the Saints is the way to salvation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਨ ਜੰਪੈ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai charan ja(n)pai ot gahee gopaal daiaal kripaa nidhe ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet, and grasp the protection of the Lord of the Universe, the merciful, the ocean of kindness. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal har birad aap banaaiaa ||
english: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; this is His natural way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਸੰਤ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jah jah sa(n)t araadhahi tah tah pragataaiaa ||
english: Wherever the Saints worship the Lord in adoration, there He is revealed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਸਮਾਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਭਗਤ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh aap leee samaai sahaj subhaai bhagat kaaraj saariaa ||
english: God blends Himself with His devotees in His natural way, and resolves their affairs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਜਸ ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਰਬ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aana(n)d har jas mahaa ma(n)gal sarab dookh visaariaa ||
english: In the ecstasy of the Lord's Praises, they obtain supreme joy, and forget all their sorrows.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਏਕੁ ਤਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: chamatakaar pragaas dah dis ek tah drisataaiaa ||
english: The brilliant flash of the One Lord is revealed to them - they behold Him in the ten directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਣ ਜੰਪੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai charan ja(n)pai bhagat vachhal har birad aap banaaiaa ||4||3||6||
english: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet; the Lord is the Lover of His devotees; this is His natural way. ||4||3||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: thir sa(n)tan sohaag marai na jaavae ||
english: The Husband Lord of the Saints is eternal; He does not die or go away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ਸੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai grihi har naahu s sad hee raavae ||
english: She, whose home is blessed by her Husband Lord, enjoys Him forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ॥
transliteration: avinaasee avigat so prabh sadaa navatan niramalaa ||
english: God is eternal and immortal, forever young and immaculately pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਦੂਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ॥
transliteration: nah door sadaa hadoor thaakur dah dis pooran sad sadaa ||
english: He is not far away, He is ever-present; the Lord and Master fills the ten directions, forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: praanapat gat mat jaa te pri preet preetam bhaavae ||
english: He is the Lord of souls, the source of salvation and wisdom. The Love of my Dear Beloved is pleasing to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਵਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai thir sa(n)tan sohaag marai na jaavae ||1||
english: Nanak speaks what the Guru's Teachings have led him to know. The Husband Lord of the Saints is eternal; He does not die or go away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau raam bhataar taa kai anad ghanaa ||
english: One who has the Lord as her Husband enjoys great bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਵੰਤੀ ਸਾ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਬਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sukhava(n)tee saa naar sobhaa poor banaa ||
english: That soul-bride is happy, and her glory is perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਕਲਿਆਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਰਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ॥
transliteration: maan mahat kaliaan har jas sa(n)g surajan so prabhoo ||
english: She obtains honor, greatness and happiness, singing the Praise of the Lord. God, the Great Being, is always with her.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਊਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੂ ॥
transliteration: sarab sidh nav nidh tit grihi nahee oonaa sabh kachhoo ||
english: She attains total perfection and the nine treasures; her home lacks nothing. - everything is there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਰ ਬਾਨੀ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਬਣਾ ॥
transliteration: madhur baanee pirahi maanee thir sohaag taa kaa banaa ||
english: Her speech is so sweet; she obeys her Beloved Lord; her marriage is permanent and everlasting.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai jaa ko raam bhataar taa kai anad ghanaa ||2||
english: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings: One who has the Lord as her Husband enjoys great bliss. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀਐ ॥
transliteration: aau sakhee sa(n)t paas sevaa laageeai ||
english: Come, O my companions, let us dedicate ourselves to serving the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਸਉ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ॥
transliteration: peesau charan pakhaar aap tiaageeai ||
english: Let us grind their corn, wash their feet and so renounce our self-conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਆਪੁ ਨਹ ਜਾਣਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: taj aap mitai sa(n)taap aap nah jaanaaeeai ||
english: Let us shed our egos, and our troubles shall be removed; let us not display ourselves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀਜੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: saran gaheejai maan leejai kare so sukh paaeeai ||
english: Let us take to His Sanctuary and obey Him, and be happy with whatever He does.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੀ ਤਜਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਾਗੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kar daas daasee taj udaasee kar joR din rain jaageeai ||
english: Let us become the slaves of His slaves, and shed our sadness, and with our palms pressed together, remain wakeful day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai aau sakhee sa(n)t paas sevaa laageeai ||3||
english: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings; come, O my companions, let us dedicate ourselves to serving the Saints. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai masatak bhaag s sevaa laaiaa ||
english: One who has such good destiny written upon his forehead, dedicates himself to His service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਜਿਨੑ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: taa kee pooran aas jinh saadhasa(n)g paaiaa ||
english: One who attains the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, has his desires fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਲਾਗਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har kai ra(n)g gobi(n)d simaran laagiaa ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, immerse yourself in the Love of the Lord; remember the Lord of the Universe in meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bharam mohu vikaar doojaa sagal tinahi tiaagiaa ||
english: Doubt, emotional attachment, sin and duality - he renounces them all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਵੂਠਾ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man saa(n)t sahaj subhaau voothaa anad ma(n)gal gun gaaiaa ||
english: Peace, poise and tranquility fill his mind, and he sings the Lord's Glorious Praises with joy and delight.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai jaa kai masatak bhaag s sevaa laaiaa ||4||4||7||
english: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings: one who has such good destiny written upon his forehead, dedicates himself to His service. ||4||4||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਤਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japa(n)tiaa kachh na kahai jamakaal ||
english: If you chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Messenger of Death will have nothing to say to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak man tan sukhee hoi a(n)te milai gopaal ||1||
english: O Nanak, the mind and body will be at peace, and in the end, you shall merge with the Lord of the world. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: milau sa(n)tan kai sa(n)g mohi udhaar lehu ||
english: Let me join the Society of the Saints - save me, Lord!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: binau karau kar joR har har naam dehu ||
english: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer: give me Your Name, O Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗਉ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har naam maagau charan laagau maan tiaagau tumh daiaa ||
english: I beg for the Lord's Name, and fall at His feet; I renounce my self-conceit, by Your kindness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨ ਧਾਵਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
transliteration: katahoo(n) na dhaavau saran paavau karunaa mai prabh kar maiaa ||
english: I shall not wander anywhere else, but take to Your Sanctuary. O God, embodiment of mercy, have mercy on me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਅਗਥ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਿਨਉ ਏਹੁ ॥
transliteration: samarath agath apaar niramal sunahu suaamee binau ehu ||
english: O all-powerful, indescribable, infinite and immaculate Lord Master, listen to this, my prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar joR naanak daan maagai janam maran nivaar lehu ||1||
english: With palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing: O Lord, let my cycle of birth and death come to an end. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਮਤਿਹੀਨੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਨੀਚੁ ॥
transliteration: aparaadhee matiheen niragun anaath neech ||
english: I am a sinner, devoid of wisdom, worthless, destitute and vile.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਠ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਕੁਲਹੀਨੁ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮੋਹ ਕੀਚੁ ॥
transliteration: sath kathor kulaheen biaapat moh keech ||
english: I am deceitful, hard-hearted, lowly and entangled in the mud of emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲ ਭਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਅਹੰ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
transliteration: mal bharam karam aha(n) mamataa maran cheet na aavae ||
english: I am stuck in the filth of doubt and egotistical actions, and I try not to think of death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਅਨੰਦ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨਤਾ ਲਪਟਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: banitaa binod ana(n)d maaiaa agiaanataa lapataavae ||
english: In ignorance, I cling to the pleasures of woman and the joys of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਸੈ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਧੈ ਜਰੂਆ ਦਿਨ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੀਚੁ ॥
transliteration: khisai joban badhai jarooaa din nihaare sa(n)g meech ||
english: My youth is wasting away, old age is approaching, and Death, my companion, is counting my days.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਰਾਖੁ ਨੀਚੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak aas teree saran saadhoo raakh neech ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, my hope is in You, Lord; please preserve me, the lowly one, in the Sanctuary of the Holy. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਜਨਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੰਕਟ ਮਹਾ ਜੋਨ ॥
transliteration: bharame janam anek sa(n)kat mahaa jon ||
english: I have wandered through countless incarnations, suffering terrible pain in these lives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੀਠੇ ਭੋਗ ਸੋਨ ॥
transliteration: lapat rahio tih sa(n)g meethe bhog son ||
english: I am entangled in sweet pleasures and gold.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭਾਰ ਅਗਨਤ ਆਇਓ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਦੇਸਹ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: bhramat bhaar aganat aaio bahu pradesah dhaaio ||
english: After wandering around with such great loads of sin, I have come, after wandering through so many foreign lands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਓਟ ਧਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: ab ot dhaaree prabh muraaree sarab sukh har naaio ||
english: Now, I have taken the protection of God, and I have found total peace in the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਆ ਹੋਨ ॥
transliteration: raakhanahaare prabh piaare mujh te kachhoo na hoaa hon ||
english: God, my Beloved, is my protector; nothing was done, or will ever be done, by myself alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਰੈ ਭਉਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d naanak kripaa teree tarai bhaun ||3||
english: I have found peace, poise and bliss, O Nanak; by Your mercy, I swim across the world-ocean. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰੀਕ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਭਗਤਹ ਸੰਸਾ ਕਉਨ ॥
transliteration: naam dhaareek udhaare bhagatah sa(n)saa kaun ||
english: You saved those who only pretended to believe, so what doubts should Your true devotees have?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਨ ਕੇਨ ਪਰਕਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥
transliteration: jen ken parakaare har har jas sunahu sravan ||
english: By every means possible, listen to the Praises of the Lord with your ears.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਾਨੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: sun sravan baanee purakh giaanee man nidhaanaa paavahe ||
english: Listen with your ears to the Word of the Lord's Bani, the hymns of spiritual wisdom; thus you shall obtain the treasure in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g raate prabh bidhaate raam ke gun gaavahe ||
english: Attuned to the Love of the Lord God, the Architect of Destiny, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੁਧ ਕਾਗਦ ਬਨਰਾਜ ਕਲਮਾ ਲਿਖਣ ਕਉ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਪਵਨ ॥
transliteration: basudh kaagad banaraaj kalamaa likhan kau je hoi pavan ||
english: The earth is the paper, the forest is the pen and the wind is the writer,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਨ ॥੪॥੫॥੮॥
transliteration: bea(n)t a(n)t na jaai paaiaa gahee naanak charan saran ||4||5||8||
english: but still, the end of the endless Lord cannot be found. O Nanak, I have taken to the Sanctuary of His lotus feet. ||4||5||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖ ਪਤੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ॥
transliteration: purakh pate bhagavaan taa kee saran gahee ||
english: The Primal Lord is the Lord God of all beings. I have taken to His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਪਰਾਨ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਲਹੀ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau bhae paraan chi(n)taa sagal lahee ||
english: My life has become fearless, and all my anxieties have been removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਰਿਜਨ ਇਸਟ ਬੰਧਪ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa sut meet surijan isat ba(n)dhap jaaniaa ||
english: I know the Lord as my mother, father, son, friend, well-wisher and close relative.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਸੁ ਬਿਮਲ ਸੰਤ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gahi ka(n)th laaiaa gur milaaiaa jas bimal sa(n)t vakhaaniaa ||
english: The Guru has led me to embrace Him; the Saints chant His Pure Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਹੀ ॥
transliteration: bea(n)t gun anek mahimaa keemat kachhoo na jaai kahee ||
english: His Glorious Virtues are infinite, and His greatness is unlimited. His value cannot be described at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਲਖ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh ek anik alakh thaakur ot naanak tis gahee ||1||
english: God is the One and only, the Unseen Lord and Master; O Nanak, I have grasped His protection. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਹਾਈ ਆਪਿ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit ban sa(n)saar sahaaee aap bhae ||
english: The world is a pool of nectar, when the Lord becomes our helper.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਹਾਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਕੇ ਦਿਵਸ ਗਏ ॥
transliteration: raam naam ur haar bikh ke divas gae ||
english: One who wears the necklace of the Lord's Name - his days of suffering are ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਤੁ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਜੋਨਿ ਆਵਣ ਸਭ ਰਹੇ ॥
transliteration: gat bharam moh bikaar binase jon aavan sabh rahe ||
english: His state of doubt, attachment and sin is erased, and the cycle of reincarnation into the womb is totally ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਏ ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਧ ਅੰਚਲ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
transliteration: agan saagar bhae seetal saadh a(n)chal gahi rahe ||
english: The ocean of fire becomes cool, when one grasps the hem of the robe of the Holy Saint.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਜੈ ਜਏ ॥
transliteration: govi(n)d gupaal daiaal sa(n)mrith bol saadhoo har jai jae ||
english: The Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World, the merciful all-powerful Lord - the Holy Saints proclaim the victory of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaai pooran saadhasa(n)g paaee param gate ||2||
english: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, in the perfect Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained the supreme status. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhau tah sa(n)g eko rav rahiaa ||
english: Wherever I look, there I find the One Lord permeating and pervading all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat vaasee aap viralai kinai lahiaa ||
english: In each and every heart, He Himself dwells, but how rare is that person who realizes this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal poor pooran keet hasat samaaniaa ||
english: The Lord is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky; He is contained in the ant and the elephant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aad a(n)te madh soee gur prasaadee jaaniaa ||
english: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, He exists. By Guru's Grace, He is known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲੀਲਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਨਿ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: braham pasariaa braham leelaa govi(n)d gun nidh jan kahiaa ||
english: God created the expanse of the universe, God created the play of the world. His humble servants call Him the Lord of the Universe, the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: simar suaamee a(n)tarajaamee har ek naanak rav rahiaa ||3||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord Master, the Searcher of hearts; O Nanak, He is the One, pervading and permeating all. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਆਈ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: din rain suhaavaRee aaee simarat naam hare ||
english: Day and night, become beauteous by remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਲਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਟਰੇ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal sa(n)g preet kalamal paap tare ||
english: In love with the Lord's Lotus Feet, corruption and sin depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਨਾਠੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਮਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dookh bhookh daaridr naathe pragat mag dikhaaiaa ||
english: Pain, hunger and poverty run away, and the path is clearly revealed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)ge naam ra(n)ge man loReedaa paaiaa ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is attuned to the Naam, and obtains the desires of the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਕੁਲ ਸੰਬੂਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har dekh darasan ichh pu(n)nee kul sa(n)boohaa sabh tare ||
english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, desires are fulfilled; all one's family and relatives are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
transliteration: dinas rain ana(n)d anadin simara(n)t naanak har hare ||4||6||9||
english: Day and night, he is in bliss, night and day, remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak. ||4||6||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ghar 7 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Seventh House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭ ਚਿੰਤਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
transliteration: subh chi(n)tan gobi(n)d raman niramal saadhoo sa(n)g ||
english: It is the most sublime contemplation, to speak of the Lord of the Universe in the pure Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam na visarau ik ghaRee kar kirapaa bhagava(n)t ||1||
english: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, even for a moment; bless me with Your Grace, Lord God! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਨੜੀਐ ਚਾਮਕਨਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bhi(n)nee rainaReeai chaamakan taare ||
english: The night is wet with dew, and the stars twinkle in the heavens.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaagahi sa(n)t janaa mere raam piaare ||
english: The Saints remain wakeful; they are the Beloveds of my Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ॥
transliteration: raam piaare sadaa jaagahi naam simarahi anadino ||
english: The Beloveds of the Lord remain ever wakeful, remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੋ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal dhiaan hiradai prabh bisar naahee ik khino ||
english: In their hearts, they meditate on the lotus feet of God; they do not forget Him, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕਲਮਲਾ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: taj maan mohu bikaar man kaa kalamalaa dukh jaare ||
english: They renounce their pride, emotional attachment and mental corruption, and burn away the pain of wickedness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sadaa jaagahi har daas sa(n)t piaare ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, the Saints, the beloved servants of the Lord, remain ever wakeful. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੇਜੜੀਐ ਆਡੰਬਰੁ ਬਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: meree sejaReeai aada(n)bar baniaa ||
english: My bed is adorned in splendor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਵਤ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: man anad bhaiaa prabh aavat suniaa ||
english: My mind is filled with bliss, since I heard that God is coming.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਚਾਵ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਭਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh mile suaamee sukhah gaamee chaav ma(n)gal ras bhare ||
english: Meeting God, the Lord and Master, I have entered the realm of peace; I am filled with joy and delight.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਖ ਭਾਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸਭਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)g sa(n)g laage dookh bhaage praan man tan sabh hare ||
english: He is joined to me, in my very fiber; my sorrows have departed, and my body, mind and soul are all rejuvenated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਈ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਸੁਭ ਗਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: man ichh paaee prabh dhiaaee sa(n)jog saahaa subh ganiaa ||
english: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, meditating on God; the day of my wedding is auspicious.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਸਗਲ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਬਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak mile sreedhar sagal aana(n)d ras baniaa ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, when I meet the Lord of excellence, I came to experience all pleasure and bliss. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਕਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: mil sakheeaa puchhahi kahu ka(n)t neesaanee ||
english: I meet with my companions and say, "Show me the insignia of my Husband Lord."

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਰੀ ਕਛੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ras prem bharee kachh bol na jaanee ||
english: I am filled with the sublime essence of His Love, and I do not know how to say anything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੂੜ ਗੁਪਤ ਅਪਾਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਨਿਗਮ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: gun gooR gupat apaar karate nigam a(n)t na paavahe ||
english: The Glorious Virtues of the Creator are profound, mysterious and infinite; even the Vedas cannot find His limits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat bhaai dhiaai suaamee sadaa har gun gaavahe ||
english: With loving devotion, I meditate on the Lord Master, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਗਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sagal gun sugiaan pooran aapane prabh bhaanee ||
english: Filled with all virtues and spiritual wisdom, I have become pleasing to my God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak ra(n)g raatee prem sahaj samaanee ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, imbued with the color of the Lord's Love, I am imperceptibly absorbed into Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸੋਹਿਲੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਣ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: sukh sohilaRe har gaavan laage ||
english: When I began to sing the songs of rejoicing to the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਸਰਸਿਅੜੇ ਦੁਖ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: saajan sarasiaRe dukh dusaman bhaage ||
english: My friends became glad, and my troubles and enemies departed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਰਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sukh sahaj sarase har naam rahase prabh aap kirapaa dhaareeaa ||
english: My peace and happiness increased; I rejoiced in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and God Himself blessed me with His mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har charan laage sadaa jaage mile prabh banavaareeaa ||
english: I have grasped the Lord's feet, and remaining ever wakeful, I have met the Lord, the Creator.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਆਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: subh divas aae sahaj paae sagal nidh prabh paage ||
english: The appointed day came, and I attained peace and poise; all treasures are in the feet of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਤਾਗੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee sadaa har jan taage ||4||1||10||
english: Prays Nanak, the Lord's humble servants always seek the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master. ||4||1||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਠਿ ਵੰਞੁ ਵਟਾਊੜਿਆ ਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਿਰੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: uth va(n)nj vataaooRiaa tai kiaa chir laaiaa ||
english: Rise up and go forth, O traveller; why do you delay?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਪੁੰਨੜੀਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: muhalat pu(n)naReeaa kit kooR lobhaaiaa ||
english: Your allotted time is now complete - why are you engrossed in falsehood?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੇ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ਧੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਅਮਿਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kooRe lubhaaiaa dhohu maaiaa karahi paap amitiaa ||
english: You desire that which is false; deceived by Maya, you commit innumerable sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮ ਢੇਰੀ ਜਮਹਿ ਹੇਰੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਬਪੁੜੈ ਜਿਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tan bhasam dheree jamahi heree kaal bapuRai jitiaa ||
english: Your body shall become a pile of dust; the Messenger of Death has spotted you, and will conquer you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਵੈਸੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maal joban chhod vaisee rahio painan khaaiaa ||
english: Abandoning your wealth and youth, you will have to leave, without any food or clothing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੁਲਿਆ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kamaanaa sa(n)g juliaa nah jaai kirat mitaaiaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, only your actions shall go with you; the consequences of your actions cannot be erased. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਾਥੋਹੁ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਵੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
transliteration: phaathohu mirag jivai pekh rain cha(n)draain ||
english: Like the deer, captured on a moon-lit night,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖਹੁ ਦੂਖ ਭਏ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਇਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sookhahu dookh bhae nit paap kamaain ||
english: so does the constant commission of sins turn pleasure into pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪਾ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਛਡਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਘਤਿ ਗਲਾਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paapaa kamaane chhadahi naahee lai chale ghat galaaviaa ||
english: The sins you have committed shall not leave you; placing the noose around your neck, they shall lead you away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੂਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੇਜਾ ਰਾਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: haricha(n)dauree dekh moothaa kooR sejaa raaviaa ||
english: Beholding an illusion, you are deceived, and on your bed, you enjoy a false lover.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਭਇਆ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ॥
transliteration: lab lobh aha(n)kaar maataa garab bhaiaa samaain ||
english: You are intoxicated with greed, avarice and egotism; you are engrossed in self-conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਨਹ ਮਿਟੈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਇਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak mrig agiaan binase nah mitai aavan jaain ||2||
english: O Nanak, like the deer, you are being destroyed by your ignorance; your comings and goings shall never end. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਠੈ ਮਖੁ ਮੁਆ ਕਿਉ ਲਏ ਓਡਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: mithai makh muaa kiu lae odaaree ||
english: The fly is caught in the sweet candy - how can it fly away?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤੀ ਗਰਤਿ ਪਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: hasatee garat paiaa kiu tareeai taaree ||
english: The elephant has fallen into the pit - how can it escape?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਰਣੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ਭਇਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: taran duhelaa bhaiaa khin mahi khasam chit na aaio ||
english: It shall be so difficult to swim across, for one who does not remember the Lord and Master, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖਾ ਸਜਾਈ ਗਣਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: dookhaa sajaaee ganat naahee keeaa apanaa paaio ||
english: His sufferings and punishments are beyond reckoning; he receives the consequences of his own actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਝਾ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਈਤ ਉਤਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gujhaa kamaanaa pragat hoaa eet utahi khuaaree ||
english: His secret deeds are exposed, and he is ruined here and hereafter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਮੂਠਾ ਮਨਮੁਖੋ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak satigur baajh moothaa manamukho aha(n)kaaree ||3||
english: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the self-willed egotistical manmukh is defrauded. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਜੀਵੇ ਲਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke daas jeeve lag prabh kee charanee ||
english: The Lord's slaves live by holding on to God's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਲੀਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)th lagaai leee tis thaakur saranee ||
english: The Lord and Master embraces those who seek His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bal budh giaan dhiaan apanaa aap naam japaaiaa ||
english: He blesses them with power, wisdom, knowledge and meditation; He Himself inspires them to chant His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat aap hoaa aap jagat taraaiaa ||
english: He Himself is the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and He Himself saves the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: raakh leee rakhanahaarai sadaa niramal karanee ||
english: The Preserver preserves those whose actions are always pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak narak na jaahi kabahoo(n) har sa(n)t har kee saranee ||4||2||11||
english: O Nanak, they never have to go to hell; the Lord's Saints are under the Lord's Protection. ||4||2||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੰਞੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਆਲਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: va(n)nj mere aalasaa har paas bena(n)tee ||
english: Be gone, O my laziness, that I may pray to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਵਉ ਸਹੁ ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਹੰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: raavau sahu aapanaRaa prabh sa(n)g soha(n)tee ||
english: I enjoy my Husband Lord, and look beautiful with my God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗੇ ਸੋਹੰਤੀ ਕੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣੀ ਰਾਵੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)ge soha(n)tee ka(n)t suaamee dinas rainee raaveeai ||
english: I look beautiful in the Company of my Husband Lord; I enjoy my Lord Master day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਐ ॥
transliteration: saas saas chitaar jeevaa prabh pekh har gun gaaveeai ||
english: I live by remembering God with each and every breath, beholding the Lord, and singing His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਹਾ ਲਜਾਇਆ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਮਿਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਿੰਚੰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: birahaa lajaaiaa daras paaiaa amiu drisat si(n)cha(n)tee ||
english: The pain of separation has grown shy, for I have obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; His Ambrosial Glance of Grace has filled me with bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਖੋਜੰਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak meree ichh pu(n)nee mile jis khoja(n)tee ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, my desires are fulfilled; I have met the One I was seeking. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਸਿ ਵੰਞਹੁ ਕਿਲਵਿਖਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nas va(n)njahu kilavikhahu karataa ghar aaiaa ||
english: Run away, O sins; the Creator has entered my home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਤਹ ਦਹਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dootah dahan bhaiaa govi(n)d pragataaiaa ||
english: The demons within me have been burnt; the Lord of the Universe has revealed Himself to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਲਾਲਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pragate gupaal gobi(n)d laalan saadhasa(n)g vakhaaniaa ||
english: The Beloved Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the World has revealed Himself; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I chant His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਚਰਜੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਅਮਿਉ ਵੂਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aacharaj deethaa amiu voothaa gur prasaadee jaaniaa ||
english: I have seen the Wondrous Lord; He showers His Ambrosial Nectar upon me, and by Guru's Grace, I know Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਨਹ ਅੰਤੁ ਜਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man saa(n)t aaee vajee vadhaaee nah a(n)t jaaee paaiaa ||
english: My mind is at peace, resounding with the music of bliss; the Lord's limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪਿ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sukh sahaj melaa prabhoo aap banaaiaa ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, God brings us to union with Himself, in the poise of celestial peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਨ ਡੀਠੜਿਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: narak na deethaRiaa simarat naaraain ||
english: They do not have to see hell, if they remember the Lord in meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਦੂਤ ਭਏ ਪਲਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: jai jai dharam kare doot bhae palaain ||
english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma applauds them, and the Messenger of Death runs away from them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਧੀਰਜ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ ॥
transliteration: dharam dheeraj sahaj sukheee saadhasa(n)gat har bhaje ||
english: Dharmic faith, patience, peace and poise are obtained by vibrating upon the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਮੋਹ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਭ ਤਜੇ ॥
transliteration: kar anugrahu raakh leene moh mamataa sabh taje ||
english: Showering His Blessings, He saves those who renounce all attachments and egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਪਤ ਅਘਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: gahi ka(n)th laae gur milaae govi(n)d japat aghaain ||
english: The Lord embraces us; the Guru unites us with Him. Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, we are satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਗਲ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਇਣ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak simar suaamee sagal aas pujaain ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, remembering the Lord and Master in meditation, all hopes are fulfilled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਤਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ ॥
transliteration: nidh sidh charan gahe taa kehaa kaaRaa ||
english: Grasping the Lord's Feet, the treasure of the Siddhas, what suffering can I feel?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਅਸਾੜਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh vas jisai so prabhoo asaaRaa ||
english: Everything is in His Power - He is my God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੀਨੇ ਕਰੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gahi bhujaa leene naam deene kar dhaar masatak raakhiaa ||
english: Holding me by the arm, He blesses me with His Name; placing His Hand upon my forehead, He saves me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਅਮਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar nah viaapai amiu har ras chaakhiaa ||
english: The world-ocean does not trouble me, for I have drunk the sublime elixir of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਣੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਅਖਾੜਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)ge naam ra(n)ge ran jeet vadaa akhaaRaa ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am victorious on the great battlefield of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜਮਿ ਨ ਉਪਾੜਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee bahuR jam na upaaRaa ||4||3||12||
english: Prays Nanak, I have entered the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master; the Messenger of Death shall not destroy me again. ||4||3||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਕਮਾਇਅੜੋ ਸੋ ਆਇਓ ਮਾਥੈ ॥
transliteration: din raat kamaaiaRo so aaio maathai ||
english: Those actions you perform, day and night, are recorded upon your forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ਲੁਕਾਇਦੜੋ ਸੋ ਵੇਖੀ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
transliteration: jis paas lukaaidaRo so vekhee saathai ||
english: And the One, from whom you hide these actions - He sees them, and is always with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਕਾਇ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g dekhai karanahaaraa kaai paap kamaaeeai ||
english: The Creator Lord is with you; He sees you, so why commit sins?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਨਰਕਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sukrit keejai naam leejai narak mool na jaaeeai ||
english: So perform good deeds, and chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall never have to go to hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar har naam simarahu chalai terai saathe ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, dwell upon the Lord's Name in meditation; it alone shall go along with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਦੋਖ ਕਮਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhaj saadhasa(n)gat sadaa naanak mitahi dokh kamaate ||1||
english: So vibrate continually in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, and the sins you committed shall be erased. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਲਵੰਚ ਕਰਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: valava(n)ch kar udar bharahi moorakh gaavaaraa ||
english: Practicing deceit, you fill your belly, you ignorant fool!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh de rahiaa har devanahaaraa ||
english: The Lord, the Great Giver, continues to give you everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਾਇ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: daataar sadaa daiaal suaamee kaai manahu visaareeai ||
english: The Great Giver is always merciful. Why should we forget the Lord Master from our minds?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਭਜੁ ਨਿਸੰਗੇ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)ge bhaj nisa(n)ge kul samoohaa taareeai ||
english: Join the Saadh Sangat, and vibrate fearlessly; all your relations shall be saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦੇਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik dev mun jan bhagat naam adhaaraa ||
english: The Siddhas, the seekers, the demi-gods, the silent sages and the devotees, all take the Naam as their support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਭਜੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sadaa bhajeeai prabh ek karanaihaaraa ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, vibrate continually upon God, the One Creator Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੁ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: khot na keechaee prabh parakhanahaaraa ||
english: Do not practice deception - God is the Assayer of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੜੇ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kooR kapat kamaavadaRe janamahi sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Those who practice falsehood and deceit are reincarnated in the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar tinhee tariaa jinhee ek dhiaaiaa ||
english: Those who meditate on the One Lord, cross over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਨਿੰਦ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: taj kaam krodh ani(n)d ni(n)daa prabh saranaaee aaiaa ||
english: Renouncing sexual desire, anger, flattery and slander, they enter the Sanctuary of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal raviaa suaamee ooch agam apaaraa ||
english: The lofty, inaccessible and infinite Lord and Master is pervading the water, the land and the sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak tek jan kee charan kamal adhaaraa ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, He is the support of His servants; His Lotus Feet are their only sustenance. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖੁ ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੜੀ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: pekh haricha(n)dauraRee asathir kichh naahee ||
english: Behold - the world is a mirage; nothing here is permanent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਜੇਤੇ ਸੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa ra(n)g jete se sa(n)g na jaahee ||
english: The pleasures of Maya which are here, shall not go with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥੀ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)g saathee sadaa terai dinas rain samaaleeai ||
english: The Lord, your companion, is always with you; remember Him day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਜਾਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har ek bin kachh avar naahee bhaau duteeaa jaaleeai ||
english: Without the One Lord, there is no other; burn away the love of duality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: meet joban maal sarabas prabh ek kar man maahee ||
english: Know in your mind, that the One God is your friend, youth, wealth and everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak vadabhaag paaeeai sookh sahaj samaahee ||4||4||13||
english: Prays Nanak, by great good fortune, we find the Lord, and merge in peace and celestial poise. ||4||4||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੮ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ghar 8 ||
english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Eighth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਮਲਾ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਹੇ ਤੀਖਣ ਮਦ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ਹੇ ਅਵਧ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਾਤ ॥
