transliteration: kamalaa bhram bheet kamalaa bhram bheet he teekhan mad bipareet he avadh akaarath jaat ||
english: Maya is the wall of doubt - Maya is the wall of doubt. It is such a powerful and destructive intoxicant; it corrupts and wastes away one's life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਬਰ ਬਨ ਘੋਰ ਗਹਬਰ ਬਨ ਘੋਰ ਹੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੂਸਤ ਮਨ ਚੋਰ ਹੇ ਦਿਨਕਰੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਖਾਤ ॥
transliteration: gahabar ban ghor gahabar ban ghor he grih moosat man chor he dinakaro anadin khaat ||
english: In the terrible, impenetrable world-forest - in the terrible, impenetrable world-forest, the thieves are plundering man's house in broad daylight; night and day, this life is being consumed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਖਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਪਤੇ ॥
transliteration: din khaat jaat bihaat prabh bin milahu prabh karunaa pate ||
english: The days of your life are being consumed; they are passing away without God. So meet God, the Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਅਨੇਕ ਬੀਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਹ ਗਤੇ ॥
transliteration: janam maran anek beete pri sa(n)g bin kachh nah gate ||
english: I passed through so many births and deaths; without Union with the Beloved, I did not obtain salvation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਲ ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਗਿਆਨਹੀਨੀ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਵਨ ਮਾਤ ॥
transliteration: kul roop dhoop giaanaheenee tujh binaa mohi kavan maat ||
english: I am without the status of high birth, beauty, glory or spiritual wisdom; without You, who is mine, O Mother?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਾਥ ਨਰਹਰ ਕਰਹੁ ਗਾਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar joR naanak saran aaio pri naath narahar karahu gaat ||1||
english: With my palms pressed together, O Nanak, I enter the Lord's Sanctuary; O beloved almighty Lord and Master, please, save me! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲਹੀਨ ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲਹੀਨ ਹੇ ਓਹੁ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਖੀਨ ਹੇ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਤ ॥
transliteration: meenaa jalaheen meenaa jalaheen he ohu bichhurat man tan kheen he kat jeevan pri bin hot ||
english: Like a fish out of water - like a fish out of water, separated from the Lord, the mind and body perish; how can I live, without my Beloved?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਹਿ ਬਾਨ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਹਿ ਬਾਨ ਹੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਅਰਪੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹੇ ਓਹੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਸਹਜ ਸਰੋਤ ॥
transliteration: sanamukh sahi baan sanamukh sahi baan he mrig arape man tan praan he ohu bedhio sahaj sarot ||
english: Facing the arrow head-on - facing the arrow head-on, the deer surrenders his mind, body and breath of life; he is struck by the hunter's soothing music.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
transliteration: pri preet laagee mil bairaagee khin rahan dhrig tan tis binaa ||
english: I have enshrined love for my Beloved. In order to meet Him, I have become a renunciate. Cursed is that body which remains without Him, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਲਕਾ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਾਗੈ ਚਿਤਵੰਤਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: palakaa na laagai pri prem paagai chitava(n)t anadin prabh manaa ||
english: My eyelids do not close, for I am absorbed in the love of my Beloved. Day and night, my mind thinks only of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਮਾਤੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਖੋਤ ॥
transliteration: sreera(n)g raate naam maate bhai bharam duteeaa sagal khot ||
english: Attuned to the Lord, intoxicated with the Naam, fear, doubt and duality have all left me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਗਨ ਹੋਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kar maiaa daiaa daiaal pooran har prem naanak magan hot ||2||
english: Bestow Your mercy and compassion, O merciful and perfect Lord, that Nanak may be intoxicated with Your Love. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਲੀਅਲ ਗੁੰਜਾਤ ਅਲੀਅਲ ਗੁੰਜਾਤ ਹੇ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਬਾਸਨ ਮਾਤ ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਮਲ ਬੰਧਾਵਤ ਆਪ ॥
transliteration: aleeal gu(n)jaat aleeal gu(n)jaat he makara(n)d ras baasan maat he preet kamal ba(n)dhaavat aap ||
english: The bumble-bee is buzzing - the bumble-bee is buzzing, intoxicated with the honey, the flavor and the fragrance; because of its love for the lotus, it entangles itself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੇ ਘਨ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਹੇ ਅਲ ਪੀਵਤ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: chaatrik chit piaas chaatrik chit piaas he ghan boo(n)d bachitr man aas he al peevat binasat taap ||
english: The mind of the rainbird thirsts - the mind of the rainbird thirsts; its mind longs for the beautiful rain-drops from the clouds. Drinking them in, its fever departs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਪਾ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸਨ ਮਿਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅਤਿ ਘਨਾ ॥
transliteration: taapaa binaasan dookh naasan mil prem man tan at ghanaa ||
english: O Destroyer of fever, Remover of pain, please unite me with You. My mind and body have such great love for You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਭਨਾ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar chatur sujaan suaamee kavan rasanaa gun bhanaa ||
english: O my beautiful, wise and all-knowing Lord and Master, with what tongue should I chant Your Praises?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਤ ਮਿਟਤ ਪਾਪ ॥
transliteration: gahi bhujaa levahu naam devahu drisat dhaarat mitat paap ||
english: Take me by the arm, and grant me Your Name. One who is blessed with Your Glance of Grace, has his sins erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੰਪੈ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਨਹ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak ja(n)pai patit paavan har daras pekhat nah sa(n)taap ||3||
english: Nanak meditates on the Lord, the Purifier of sinners; beholding His Vision, he suffers no more. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤ ਨਾਥ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤ ਨਾਥ ਹੇ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਹੇ ਮਿਲੁ ਚਾਉ ਚਾਈਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: chitavau chit naath chitavau chit naath he rakh levahu saran anaath he mil chaau chaaeele praan ||
english: I focus my consciousness on the Lord - I focus my consciousness upon the Lord; I am helpless - please, keep me under Your Protection. I yearn to meet You, my soul hungers for You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਲੁਬਧ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੇ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਜਨ ਰਾਖਤ ਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar tan dhiaan su(n)dar tan dhiaan he man lubadh gopaal giaan he jaachik jan raakhat maan ||
english: I meditate on Your beautiful body - I meditate on Your beautiful body; my mind is fascinated by Your spiritual wisdom, O Lord of the world. Please, preserve the honor of Your humble servants and beggars.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਦੀਰਨ ਸਗਲ ਇਛ ਪੁਜੰਤੀਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh maan pooran dukh bideeran sagal ichh puja(n)teeaa ||
english: God bestows perfect honor and destroys pain; He has fulfilled all my desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਹ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹੰਤੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har ka(n)th laage din sabhaage mil naah sej soha(n)teeaa ||
english: How very blessed was that day when the Lord embraced me; meeting my Husband Lord, my bed was beautified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਕਲਮਲ ਭਏ ਹਾਨ ॥
transliteration: prabh drisat dhaaree mile muraaree sagal kalamal bhae haan ||
english: When God granted His Grace and met me, all my sins were erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak meree aas pooran mile sreedhar gun nidhaan ||4||1||14||
english: Prays Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; I have met the Lord, the Lord of Lakshmi, the treasure of excellence. ||4||1||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa, First Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਲੋਕ ਭੀ ਮਹਲੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਕੇ ਲਿਖੇ ਟੁੰਡੇ ਅਸ ਰਾਜੈ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
transliteration: vaar salokaa naal salok bhee mahale pahile ke likhe tu(n)de as raajai kee dhunee ||
english: Vaar With Saloks, And Saloks Written By The First Mehl. To Be Sung To The Tune Of 'Tunda-Asraajaa':

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਦਿਉਹਾੜੀ ਸਦ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane diuhaaRee sad vaar ||
english: A hundred times a day, I am a sacrifice to my Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਸ ਤੇ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਕੀਏ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin maanas te devate keee karat na laagee vaar ||1||
english: He made angels out of men, without delay. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਚੰਦਾ ਉਗਵਹਿ ਸੂਰਜ ਚੜਹਿ ਹਜਾਰ ॥
transliteration: je sau cha(n)daa ugavahi sooraj chaRahi hajaar ||
english: If a hundred moons were to rise, and a thousand suns appeared,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਚਾਨਣ ਹੋਦਿਆਂ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ete chaanan hodiaa(n) gur bin ghor a(n)dhaar ||2||
english: even with such light, there would still be pitch darkness without the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਚੇਤ ॥
transliteration: naanak guroo na chetanee man aapanai suchet ||
english: O Nanak, those who do not think of the Guru, and who think of themselves as clever,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੁਟੇ ਤਿਲ ਬੂਆੜ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖੇਤ ॥
transliteration: chhute til booaaR jiu su(n)nje a(n)dar khet ||
english: shall be left abandoned in the field, like the scattered sesame.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੇਤੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਛੁਟਿਆ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਉ ਨਾਹ ॥
transliteration: khetai a(n)dar chhutiaa kahu naanak sau naah ||
english: They are abandoned in the field, says Nanak, and they have a hundred masters to please.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਲੀਅਹਿ ਫੁਲੀਅਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਆਹ ॥੩॥
transliteration: phaleeahi phuleeahi bapuRe bhee tan vich suaah ||3||
english: The wretches bear fruit and flower, but within their bodies, they are filled with ashes. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿਓ ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਰਚਿਓ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aapeenhai aap saajio aapeenhai rachio naau ||
english: He Himself created Himself; He Himself assumed His Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਯੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਡਿਠੋ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: duyee kudarat saajeeai kar aasan ditho chaau ||
english: Secondly, He fashioned the creation; seated within the creation, He beholds it with delight.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
transliteration: daataa karataa aap too(n) tus devahi karahi pasaau ||
english: You Yourself are the Giver and the Creator; by Your Pleasure, You bestow Your Mercy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣੋਈ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਲੈਸਹਿ ਜਿੰਦੁ ਕਵਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) jaanoee sabhasai de laisahi ji(n)d kavaau ||
english: You are the Knower of all; You give life, and take it away again with a word.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਡਿਠੋ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar aasan ditho chaau ||1||
english: Seated within the creation, You behold it with delight. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਖੰਡ ਸਚੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ॥
transliteration: sache tere kha(n)d sache brahama(n)d ||
english: True are Your worlds, True are Your solar Systems.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਲੋਅ ਸਚੇ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sache tere lo sache aakaar ||
english: True are Your realms, True is Your creation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਰਣੇ ਸਰਬ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sache tere karane sarab beechaar ||
english: True are Your actions, and all Your deliberations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sachaa teraa amar sachaa deebaan ||
english: True is Your Command, and True is Your Court.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sachaa teraa hukam sachaa phuramaan ||
english: True is the Command of Your Will, True is Your Order.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sachaa teraa karam sachaa neesaan ||
english: True is Your Mercy, True is Your Insignia.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਹਿ ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ ॥
transliteration: sache tudh aakhahi lakh karoR ||
english: Hundreds of thousands and millions call You True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਣਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਭਿ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabh taan sachai sabh jor ||
english: In the True Lord is all power, in the True Lord is all might.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
transliteration: sachee teree siphat sachee saalaah ||
english: True is Your Praise, True is Your Adoration.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥
transliteration: sachee teree kudarat sache paatisaah ||
english: True is Your almighty creative power, True King.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸਚੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak sach dhiaain sach ||
english: O Nanak, true are those who meditate on the True One.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੇ ਸੁ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo mar ja(n)me s kach nikach ||1||
english: Those who are subject to birth and death are totally false. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਵਡਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vadee vadiaaee jaa vadaa naau ||
english: Great is His greatness, as great as His Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
transliteration: vadee vadiaaee jaa sach niaau ||
english: Great is His greatness, as True is His justice.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vadee vadiaaee jaa nihachal thaau ||
english: Great is His greatness, as permanent as His Throne.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਲਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vadee vadiaaee jaanai aalaau ||
english: Great is His greatness, as He knows our utterances.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਬੁਝੈ ਸਭਿ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vadee vadiaaee bujhai sabh bhaau ||
english: Great is His greatness, as He understands all our affections.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: vadee vadiaaee jaa puchh na daat ||
english: Great is His greatness, as He gives without being asked.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: vadee vadiaaee jaa aape aap ||
english: Great is His greatness, as He Himself is all-in-all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਥਨੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak kaar na kathanee jaai ||
english: O Nanak, His actions cannot be described.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਸਰਬ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: keetaa karanaa sarab rajaai ||2||
english: Whatever He has done, or will do, is all by His Own Will. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਚੈ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: ihu jag sachai kee hai kothaRee sache kaa vich vaas ||
english: This world is the room of the True Lord; within it is the dwelling of the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲਏ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: ikanhaa hukam samaai lae ikanhaa hukame kare vinaas ||
english: By His Command, some are merged into Him, and some, by His Command, are destroyed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਢਿ ਲਏ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: ikanhaa bhaanai kadh lae ikanhaa maaiaa vich nivaas ||
english: Some, by the Pleasure of His Will, are lifted up out of Maya, while others are made to dwell within it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਵ ਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਜਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਆਣੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: ev bh aakh na jaapaee j kisai aane raas ||
english: No one can say who will be rescued.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh jaaneeai jaa kau aap kare paragaas ||3||
english: O Nanak, he alone is known as Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord reveals Himself. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak jee upaai kai likh naavai dharam bahaaliaa ||
english: O Nanak, having created the souls, the Lord installed the Righteous Judge of Dharma to read and record their accounts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਵਖਿ ਕਢੇ ਜਜਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: othai sache hee sach nibaRai chun vakh kadhe jajamaaliaa ||
english: There, only the Truth is judged true; the sinners are picked out and separated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੑੈ ਦੋਜਕਿ ਚਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: thaau na paain kooRiaar muh kaalhai dojak chaaliaa ||
english: The false find no place there, and they go to hell with their faces blackened.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਗਏ ਹਾਰਿ ਗਏ ਸਿ ਠਗਣ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: terai naai rate se jin gae haar gae s thagan vaaliaa ||
english: Those who are imbued with Your Name win, while the cheaters lose.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: likh naavai dharam bahaaliaa ||2||
english: The Lord installed the Righteous Judge of Dharma to read and record the accounts. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨਾਦ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਵੇਦ ॥
transliteration: visamaad naad visamaad ved ||
english: Wonderful is the sound current of the Naad, wonderful is the knowledge of the Vedas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਜੀਅ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਭੇਦ ॥
transliteration: visamaad jee visamaad bhed ||
english: Wonderful are the beings, wonderful are the species.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਰੂਪ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: visamaad roop visamaad ra(n)g ||
english: Wonderful are the forms, wonderful are the colors.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨਾਗੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜੰਤ ॥
transliteration: visamaad naage phirahi ja(n)t ||
english: Wonderful are the beings who wander around naked.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਪਉਣੁ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: visamaad paun visamaad paanee ||
english: Wonderful is the wind, wonderful is the water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਅਗਨੀ ਖੇਡਹਿ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: visamaad aganee khedahi vidaanee ||
english: Wonderful is fire, which works wonders.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: visamaad dharatee visamaad khaanee ||
english: Wonderful is the earth, wonderful the sources of creation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਾਦਿ ਲਗਹਿ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: visamaad saad lagahi paraanee ||
english: Wonderful are the tastes to which mortals are attached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: visamaad sa(n)jog visamaad vijog ||
english: Wonderful is union, and wonderful is separation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਭੁਖ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: visamaad bhukh visamaad bhog ||
english: Wonderful is hunger, wonderful is satisfaction.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
transliteration: visamaad siphat visamaad saalaah ||
english: Wonderful is His Praise, wonderful is His adoration.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਉਝੜ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਰਾਹ ॥
transliteration: visamaad ujhaR visamaad raah ||
english: Wonderful is the wilderness, wonderful is the path.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: visamaad neRai visamaad door ||
english: Wonderful is closeness, wonderful is distance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਾਜਰਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: visamaad dekhai haajaraa hajoor ||
english: How wonderful to behold the Lord, ever-present here.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: vekh vidaan rahiaa visamaad ||
english: Beholding His wonders, I am wonder-struck.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੁਝਣੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bujhan poorai bhaag ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who understand this are blessed with perfect destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਦਿਸੈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਭਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kudarat disai kudarat suneeai kudarat bhau sukh saar ||
english: By His Power we see, by His Power we hear; by His Power we have fear, and the essence of happiness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kudarat paataalee aakaasee kudarat sarab aakaar ||
english: By His Power the nether worlds exist, and the Akaashic ethers; by His Power the entire creation exists.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kudarat ved puraan katebaa kudarat sarab veechaar ||
english: By His Power the Vedas and the Puraanas exist, and the Holy Scriptures of the Jewish, Christian and Islamic religions. By His Power all deliberations exist.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਪੈਨੑਣੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kudarat khaanaa peenaa painhn kudarat sarab piaar ||
english: By His Power we eat, drink and dress; by His Power all love exists.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
transliteration: kudarat jaatee jinasee ra(n)gee kudarat jee jahaan ||
english: - By His Power come the species of all kinds and colors; by His Power the living beings of the world exist.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਨੇਕੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਬਦੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kudarat nekeeaa kudarat badeeaa kudarat maan abhimaan ||
english: By His Power virtues exist, and by His Power vices exist. By His Power come honor and dishonor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: kudarat paun paanee baisa(n)tar kudarat dharatee khaak ||
english: By His Power wind, water and fire exist; by His Power earth and dust exist.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੂੰ ਕਾਦਿਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਾਕੀ ਨਾਈ ਪਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh teree kudarat too(n) kaadir karataa paakee naaee paak ||
english: Everything is in Your Power, Lord; You are the all-powerful Creator. Your Name is the Holiest of the Holy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਾਕੋ ਤਾਕੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak hukamai a(n)dar vekhai varatai taako taak ||2||
english: O Nanak, through the Command of His Will, He beholds and pervades the creation; He is absolutely unrivalled. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਿ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਭਸਮੜਿ ਭਉਰੁ ਸਿਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aapeenhai bhog bhog kai hoi bhasamaR bhaur sidhaaiaa ||
english: Enjoying his pleasures, one is reduced to a pile of ashes, and the soul passes away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਹੋਆ ਦੁਨੀਦਾਰੁ ਗਲਿ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਘਤਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vadaa hoaa duneedaar gal sa(n)gal ghat chalaaiaa ||
english: He may be great, but when he dies, the chain is thrown around his neck, and he is led away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਵਾਚੀਐ ਬਹਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: agai karanee keerat vaacheeai bahi lekhaa kar samajhaaiaa ||
english: There, his good and bad deeds are added up; sitting there, his account is read.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਾਉ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਪਉਦੀਈ ਹੁਣਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਰੂਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: thaau na hovee paudeeee hun suneeai kiaa rooaaiaa ||
english: He is whipped, but finds no place of rest, and no one hears his cries of pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man a(n)dhai janam gavaaiaa ||3||
english: The blind man has wasted his life away. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਵਣੁ ਵਹੈ ਸਦਵਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich pavan vahai sadavaau ||
english: In the Fear of God, the wind and breezes ever blow.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich chalahi lakh dareeaau ||
english: In the Fear of God, thousands of rivers flow.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਢੈ ਵੇਗਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich agan kadhai vegaar ||
english: In the Fear of God, fire is forced to labor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਦਬੀ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich dharatee dabee bhaar ||
english: In the Fear of God, the earth is crushed under its burden.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਇੰਦੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਿਰ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich i(n)d phirai sir bhaar ||
english: In the Fear of God, the clouds move across the sky.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich raajaa dharam duaar ||
english: In the Fear of God, the Righteous Judge of Dharma stands at His Door.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਚੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich sooraj bhai vich cha(n)d ||
english: In the Fear of God, the sun shines, and in the Fear of God, the moon reflects.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਹ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਚਲਤ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: koh karoRee chalat na a(n)t ||
english: They travel millions of miles, endlessly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਸੁਰ ਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich sidh budh sur naath ||
english: In the Fear of God, the Siddhas exist, as do the Buddhas, the demi-gods and Yogis.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਡਾਣੇ ਆਕਾਸ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich aadaane aakaas ||
english: In the Fear of God, the Akaashic ethers are stretched across the sky.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich jodh mahaabal soor ||
english: In the Fear of God, the warriors and the most powerful heroes exist.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਰ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich aavahi jaavahi poor ||
english: In the Fear of God, multitudes come and go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲਿਆ ਭਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: sagaliaa bhau likhiaa sir lekh ||
english: God has inscribed the Inscription of His Fear upon the heads of all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਏਕੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak nirabhau nira(n)kaar sach ek ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Fearless Lord, the Formless Lord, the True Lord, is One. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
transliteration: naanak nirabhau nira(n)kaar hor kete raam ravaal ||
english: O Nanak, the Lord is fearless and formless; myriads of others, like Rama, are mere dust before Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕੰਨੑ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਕੇਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: keteeaa ka(n)nh kahaaneeaa kete bed beechaar ||
english: There are so many stories of Krishna, so many who reflect over the Vedas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਨਚਹਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਗਿੜਿ ਮੁੜਿ ਪੂਰਹਿ ਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kete nachahi ma(n)gate giR muR poorahi taal ||
english: So many beggars dance, spinning around to the beat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇ ਕਢਹਿ ਬਾਜਾਰ ॥
transliteration: baajaaree baajaar mahi aai kadhahi baajaar ||
english: The magicians perform their magic in the market place, creating a false illusion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਣੀਆ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਆਲ ਪਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi raaje raaneeaa bolahi aal pataal ||
english: They sing as kings and queens, and speak of this and that.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਟਕਿਆ ਕੇ ਮੁੰਦੜੇ ਲਖ ਟਕਿਆ ਕੇ ਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: lakh takiaa ke mu(n)daRe lakh takiaa ke haar ||
english: They wear earrings, and necklaces worth thousands of dollars.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਛਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jit tan paaeeahi naanakaa se tan hovahi chhaar ||
english: Those bodies on which they are worn, O Nanak, those bodies turn to ashes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਗਲੀਈ ਢੂਢੀਐ ਕਥਨਾ ਕਰੜਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: giaan na galeeee dhoodheeai kathanaa karaRaa saar ||
english: Wisdom cannot be found through mere words. To explain it is as hard as iron.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karam milai taa paaeeai hor hikamat hukam khuaar ||2||
english: When the Lord bestows His Grace, then alone it is received; other tricks and orders are useless. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nadar karahi je aapanee taa nadaree satigur paaiaa ||
english: If the Merciful Lord shows His Mercy, then the True Guru is found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਭਰੰਮਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ehu jeeu bahute janam bhara(n)miaa taa satigur sabad sunaaiaa ||
english: This soul wandered through countless incarnations, until the True Guru instructed it in the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur jevad daataa ko nahee sabh suniahu lok sabaaiaa ||
english: There is no giver as great as the True Guru; hear this, all you people.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai sach paaiaa jinhee vichahu aap gavaaiaa ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, the True Lord is found; He removes self-conceit from within,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jin sacho sach bujhaaiaa ||4||
english: and instructs us in the Truth of Truths. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘੜੀਆ ਸਭੇ ਗੋਪੀਆ ਪਹਰ ਕੰਨੑ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: ghaReeaa sabhe gopeeaa pahar ka(n)nh gopaal ||
english: All the hours are the milk-maids, and the quarters of the day are the Krishnas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਹਣੇ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: gahane paun paanee baisa(n)tar cha(n)d sooraj avataar ||
english: The wind, water and fire are the ornaments; the sun and moon are the incarnations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sagalee dharatee maal dhan varatan sarab ja(n)jaal ||
english: All of the earth, property, wealth and articles are all entanglements.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਸੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਖਾਇ ਗਇਆ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak musai giaan vihoonee khaai gaiaa jamakaal ||1||
english: O Nanak, without divine knowledge, one is plundered, and devoured by the Messenger of Death. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਇਨਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਨਚਨਿ ਗੁਰ ॥
transliteration: vaain chele nachan gur ||
english: The disciples play the music, and the gurus dance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੈਰ ਹਲਾਇਨਿ ਫੇਰਨੑਿ ਸਿਰ ॥
transliteration: pair halaain pheranhi sir ||
english: They move their feet and roll their heads.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਡਿ ਉਡਿ ਰਾਵਾ ਝਾਟੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ud ud raavaa jhaatai paai ||
english: The dust flies and falls upon their hair.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਖੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਹਸੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vekhai lok hasai ghar jaai ||
english: Beholding them, the people laugh, and then go home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਟੀਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪੂਰਹਿ ਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: roteeaa kaaran poorahi taal ||
english: They beat the drums for the sake of bread.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾੜਹਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: aap pachhaaRahi dharatee naal ||
english: They throw themselves upon the ground.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਗੋਪੀਆ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਕਾਨੑ ॥
transliteration: gaavan gopeeaa gaavan kaanh ||
english: They sing of the milk-maids, they sing of the Krishnas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੀਤਾ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gaavan seetaa raaje raam ||
english: They sing of Sitas, and Ramas and kings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau nira(n)kaar sach naam ||
english: The Lord is fearless and formless; His Name is True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa keeaa sagal jahaan ||
english: The entire universe is His Creation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sevak sevahi karam chaRaau ||
english: Those servants, whose destiny is awakened, serve the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhi(n)nee rain jinhaa man chaau ||
english: The night of their lives is cool with dew; their minds are filled with love for the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖੀ ਸਿਖਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sikhee sikhiaa gur veechaar ||
english: Contemplating the Guru, I have been taught these teachings;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਘਾਏ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: nadaree karam laghaae paar ||
english: granting His Grace, He carries His servants across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਲੂ ਚਰਖਾ ਚਕੀ ਚਕੁ ॥
transliteration: koloo charakhaa chakee chak ||
english: The oil-press, the spinning wheel, the grinding stones, the potter's wheel,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਲ ਵਾਰੋਲੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਨੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: thal vaarole bahut ana(n)t ||
english: the numerous, countless whirlwinds in the desert,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਟੂ ਮਾਧਾਣੀਆ ਅਨਗਾਹ ॥
transliteration: laatoo maadhaaneeaa anagaah ||
english: the spinning tops, the churning sticks, the threshers,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਖੀ ਭਉਦੀਆ ਲੈਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਹ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)khee bhaudeeaa lain na saah ||
english: the breathless tumblings of the birds,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਐ ਚਾੜਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਜੰਤ ॥
transliteration: sooai chaaR bhavaaeeahi ja(n)t ||
english: and the men moving round and round on spindles

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਉਦਿਆ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਅੰਤ ॥
transliteration: naanak bhaudiaa ganat na a(n)t ||
english: O Nanak, the tumblers are countless and endless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan ba(n)dh bhavaae soi ||
english: The Lord binds us in bondage - so do we spin around.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਨਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: paiai kirat nachai sabh koi ||
english: According to their actions, so do all people dance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਚਿ ਨਚਿ ਹਸਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: nach nach hasahi chalahi se roi ||
english: Those who dance and dance and laugh, shall weep on their ultimate departure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਸਿਧ ਨ ਹੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ud na jaahee sidh na hohi ||
english: They do not fly to the heavens, nor do they become Siddhas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਚਣੁ ਕੁਦਣੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nachan kudan man kaa chaau ||
english: They dance and jump around on the urgings of their minds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਭਉ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jinh man bhau tinhaa man bhaau ||2||
english: O Nanak, those whose minds are filled with the Fear of God, have the love of God in their minds as well. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਇ ਲਇਐ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: naau teraa nira(n)kaar hai naai laiai narak na jaaeeai ||
english: Your Name is the Fearless Lord; chanting Your Name, one does not have to go to hell.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਦੇ ਖਾਜੈ ਆਖਿ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis daa de khaajai aakh gavaaeeai ||
english: Soul and body all belong to Him; asking Him to give us sustenance is a waste.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਚੰਗਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਕਰਿ ਪੁੰਨਹੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਸਦਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: je loRahi cha(n)gaa aapanaa kar pu(n)nahu neech sadaaeeai ||
english: If you yearn for goodness, then perform good deeds and feel humble.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਰਵਾਣਾ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਜਰੁ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਦੀ ਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: je jaravaanaa paraharai jar ves karedee aaeeai ||
english: Even if you remove the signs of old age, old age shall still come in the guise of death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ko rahai na bhareeai paaeeai ||5||
english: No one remains here when the count of the breaths is full. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਰੀਅਤਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: musalamaanaa siphat sareeat paR paR karahi beechaar ||
english: The Muslims praise the Islamic law; they read and reflect upon it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਦੇ ਸੇ ਜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੰਦੀ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)de se j pavahi vich ba(n)dee vekhan kau deedaar ||
english: The Lord's bound servants are those who bind themselves to see the Lord's Vision.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hi(n)doo saalaahee saalaahan darasan roop apaar ||
english: The Hindus praise the Praiseworthy Lord; the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, His form is incomparable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਅਰਚਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਗਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਹਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: teerath naavahi arachaa poojaa agar vaas bahakaar ||
english: They bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, making offerings of flowers, and burning incense before idols.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਨੑਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਅਲਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jogee su(n)n dhiaavanhi jete alakh naam karataar ||
english: The Yogis meditate on the absolute Lord there; they call the Creator the Unseen Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖਮ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sookham moorat naam nira(n)jan kaaiaa kaa aakaar ||
english: But to the subtle image of the Immaculate Name, they apply the form of a body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੇਣੈ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sateeaa man sa(n)tokh upajai denai kai veechaar ||
english: In the minds of the virtuous, contentment is produced, thinking about their giving.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਗੂਣਾ ਸੋਭ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: de de ma(n)gahi sahasaa goonaa sobh kare sa(n)saar ||
english: They give and give, but ask a thousand-fold more, and hope that the world will honor them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੋਰਾ ਜਾਰਾ ਤੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਖਾਰਾਬਾ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: choraa jaaraa tai kooRiaaraa khaaraabaa vekaar ||
english: The thieves, adulterers, perjurers, evil-doers and sinners

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਹੋਦਾ ਖਾਇ ਚਲਹਿ ਐਥਾਊ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਕਾਈ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ik hodaa khaai chalahi aithaaoo tinaa bh kaaee kaar ||
english: - after using up what good karma they had, they depart; have they done any good deeds here at all?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਜੀਆ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਲੋਆ ਆਕਾਰਾ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jal thal jeeaa pureeaa loaa aakaaraa aakaar ||
english: There are beings and creatures in the water and on the land, in the worlds and universes, form upon form.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਸੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: oi j aakhahi s too(n)hai jaanahi tinaa bh teree saar ||
english: Whatever they say, You know; You care for them all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak bhagataa bhukh saalaahan sach naam aadhaar ||
english: O Nanak, the hunger of the devotees is to praise You; the True Name is their only support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਪਾ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahahi din raatee gunava(n)tiaa paa chhaar ||1||
english: They live in eternal bliss, day and night; they are the dust of the feet of the virtuous. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੀ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਕੀ ਪੇੜੈ ਪਈ ਕੁਮੑਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: mitee musalamaan kee peRai paee kumhiaar ||
english: The clay of the Muslim's grave becomes clay for the potter's wheel.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘੜਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਇਟਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਲਦੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ghaR bhaa(n)de itaa keeaa jaladee kare pukaar ||
english: Pots and bricks are fashioned from it, and it cries out as it burns.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਝੜਿ ਝੜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਅੰਗਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: jal jal rovai bapuRee jhaR jhaR pavahi a(n)giaar ||
english: The poor clay burns, burns and weeps, as the fiery coals fall upon it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jin karatai kaaran keeaa so jaanai karataar ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Creator created the creation; the Creator Lord alone knows. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur kinai na paaio bin satigur kinai na paaiaa ||
english: Without the True Guru, no one has obtained the Lord; without the True Guru, no one has obtained the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur vich aap rakhion kar paragat aakh sunaaiaa ||
english: He has placed Himself within the True Guru; revealing Himself, He declares this openly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai sadaa mukat hai jin vichahu mohu chukaaiaa ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, eternal liberation is obtained; He has banished attachment from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਤਮੁ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: utam ehu beechaar hai jin sache siu chit laaiaa ||
english: This is the highest thought, that one's consciousness is attached to the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jagajeevan daataa paaiaa ||6||
english: Thus the Lord of the World, the Great Giver is obtained. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vich aaiaa hau vich gaiaa ||
english: In ego they come, and in ego they go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੁਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vich ja(n)miaa hau vich muaa ||
english: In ego they are born, and in ego they die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vich ditaa hau vich laiaa ||
english: In ego they give, and in ego they take.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਟਿਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vich khatiaa hau vich gaiaa ||
english: In ego they earn, and in ego they lose.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hau vich sachiaar kooRiaar ||
english: In ego they become truthful or false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hau vich paap pu(n)n veechaar ||
english: In ego they reflect on virtue and sin.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hau vich narak surag avataar ||
english: In ego they go to heaven or hell.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਸੈ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hau vich hasai hau vich rovai ||
english: In ego they laugh, and in ego they weep.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਰੀਐ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hau vich bhareeai hau vich dhovai ||
english: In ego they become dirty, and in ego they are washed clean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hau vich jaatee jinasee khovai ||
english: In ego they lose social status and class.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
transliteration: hau vich moorakh hau vich siaanaa ||
english: In ego they are ignorant, and in ego they are wise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: mokh mukat kee saar na jaanaa ||
english: They do not know the value of salvation and liberation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hau vich maaiaa hau vich chhaaiaa ||
english: In ego they love Maya, and in ego they are kept in darkness by it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai kar kar ja(n)t upaaiaa ||
english: Living in ego, mortal beings are created.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: haumai boojhai taa dar soojhai ||
english: When one understands ego, then the Lord's gate is known.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: giaan vihoonaa kath kath loojhai ||
english: Without spiritual wisdom, they babble and argue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak hukamee likheeai lekh ||
english: O Nanak, by the Lord's Command, destiny is recorded.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਵੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jehaa vekhahi tehaa vekh ||1||
english: As the Lord sees us, so are we seen. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai ehaa jaat hai haumai karam kamaahi ||
english: This is the nature of ego, that people perform their actions in ego.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਈ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai eee ba(n)dhanaa phir phir jonee paahi ||
english: This is the bondage of ego, that time and time again, they are reborn.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਇਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai kithahu oopajai kit sa(n)jam ih jaai ||
english: Where does ego come from? How can it be removed?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai eho hukam hai paiai kirat phiraahi ||
english: This ego exists by the Lord's Order; people wander according to their past actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਭੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai deeragh rog hai daaroo bhee is maahi ||
english: Ego is a chronic disease, but it contains its own cure as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa kare je aapanee taa gur kaa sabad kamaahi ||
english: If the Lord grants His Grace, one acts according to the Teachings of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨਹੁ ਇਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kahai sunahu janahu it sa(n)jam dukh jaahi ||2||
english: Nanak says, listen, people: in this way, troubles depart. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਈਁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sev keetee sa(n)tokheeee(n) jinhee sacho sach dhiaaiaa ||
english: Those who serve are content. They meditate on the Truest of the True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਨੑੀ ਮੰਦੈ ਪੈਰੁ ਨ ਰਖਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: onhee ma(n)dai pair na rakhio kar sukrit dharam kamaaiaa ||
english: They do not place their feet in sin, but do good deeds and live righteously in Dharma.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਨੑੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਤੋੜੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਅੰਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਥੋੜਾ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: onhee duneeaa toRe ba(n)dhanaa a(n)n paanee thoRaa khaaiaa ||
english: They burn away the bonds of the world, and eat a simple diet of grain and water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਬਖਸੀਸੀ ਅਗਲਾ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: too(n) bakhaseesee agalaa nit devahi chaRahi savaaiaa ||
english: You are the Great Forgiver; You give continually, more and more each day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: vadiaaee vadaa paaiaa ||7||
english: By His greatness, the Great Lord is obtained. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖਾਂ ਬਿਰਖਾਂ ਤੀਰਥਾਂ ਤਟਾਂ ਮੇਘਾਂ ਖੇਤਾਂਹ ॥
transliteration: purakhaa(n) birakhaa(n) teerathaa(n) tataa(n) meghaa(n) khetaa(n)h ||
english: Men, trees, sacred shrines of pilgrimage, banks of sacred rivers, clouds, fields,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਾਂ ਲੋਆਂ ਮੰਡਲਾਂ ਖੰਡਾਂ ਵਰਭੰਡਾਂਹ ॥
transliteration: deepaa(n) loaa(n) ma(n)dalaa(n) kha(n)daa(n) varabha(n)daa(n)h ||
english: islands, continents, worlds, solar systems, and universes;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਉਤਭੁਜਾਂ ਖਾਣੀ ਸੇਤਜਾਂਹ ॥
transliteration: a(n)daj jeraj utabhujaa(n) khaanee setajaa(n)h ||
english: the four sources of creation - born of eggs, born of the womb, born of the earth and born of sweat;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਰਾਂ ਮੇਰਾਂ ਜੰਤਾਹ ॥
transliteration: so mit jaanai naanakaa saraa(n) meraa(n) ja(n)taah ||
english: oceans, mountains, and all beings - O Nanak, He alone knows their condition.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਸੰਮਾਲੇ ਸਭਨਾਹ ॥
transliteration: naanak ja(n)t upaai kai sa(n)maale sabhanaah ||
english: O Nanak, having created the living beings, He cherishes them all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਭਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਤਾਹ ॥
transliteration: jin karatai karanaa keeaa chi(n)taa bh karanee taah ||
english: The Creator who created the creation, takes care of it as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ॥
transliteration: so karataa chi(n)taa kare jin upaaiaa jag ||
english: He, the Creator who formed the world, cares for it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਹਾਰੀ ਸੁਅਸਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਅਭਗੁ ॥
transliteration: tis johaaree suasat tis tis deebaan abhag ||
english: Unto Him I bow and offer my reverence; His Royal Court is eternal.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਟਿਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਤਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sache naam bin kiaa tikaa kiaa tag ||1||
english: O Nanak, without the True Name, of what use is the frontal mark of the Hindus, or their sacred thread? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਨੇਕੀਆ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਲਖ ਪੁੰਨਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: lakh nekeeaa cha(n)giaaeeaa lakh pu(n)naa paravaan ||
english: Hundreds of thousands of virtues and good actions, and hundreds of thousands of blessed charities,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਤਪ ਉਪਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਾਂ ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗ ਬੇਬਾਣ ॥
transliteration: lakh tap upar teerathaa(n) sahaj jog bebaan ||
english: hundreds of thousands of penances at sacred shrines, and the practice of Sehj Yoga in the wilderness,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਸੂਰਤਣ ਸੰਗਰਾਮ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਪਰਾਣ ॥
transliteration: lakh sooratan sa(n)garaam ran mahi chhutahi paraan ||
english: hundreds of thousands of courageous actions and giving up the breath of life on the field of battle,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਲਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
transliteration: lakh suratee lakh giaan dhiaan paReeahi paath puraan ||
english: hundreds of thousands of divine understandings, hundreds of thousands of divine wisdoms and meditations and readings of the Vedas and the Puraanas

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jin karatai karanaa keeaa likhiaa aavan jaan ||
english: - before the Creator who created the creation, and who ordained coming and going,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਤੀ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak matee mithiaa karam sachaa neesaan ||2||
english: O Nanak, all these things are false. True is the Insignia of His Grace. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib ek too(n) jin sacho sach varataaiaa ||
english: You alone are the True Lord. The Truth of Truths is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis too(n) dehi tis milai sach taa tinhee sach kamaaiaa ||
english: He alone receives the Truth, unto whom You give it; then, he practices Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai sach paaiaa jinh kai hiradai sach vasaaiaa ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, Truth is found. In His Heart, Truth is abiding.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: moorakh sach na jaananhee manamukhee janam gavaaiaa ||
english: The fools do not know the Truth. The self-willed manmukhs waste their lives away in vain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: vich duneeaa kaahe aaiaa ||8||
english: Why have they even come into the world? ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਗਡੀ ਲਦੀਅਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭਰੀਅਹਿ ਸਾਥ ॥
transliteration: paR paR gadee ladeeahi paR paR bhareeahi saath ||
english: You may read and read loads of books; you may read and study vast multitudes of books.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਗਡੀਅਹਿ ਖਾਤ ॥
transliteration: paR paR beRee paaeeai paR paR gadeeahi khaat ||
english: You may read and read boat-loads of books; you may read and read and fill pits with them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਬਰਸ ਬਰਸ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਸ ॥
transliteration: paReeahi jete baras baras paReeahi jete maas ||
english: You may read them year after year; you may read them as many months are there are.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜੀਐ ਜੇਤੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
transliteration: paReeai jetee aarajaa paReeahi jete saas ||
english: You may read them all your life; you may read them with every breath.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖੈ ਇਕ ਗਲ ਹੋਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਝਖਣਾ ਝਾਖ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak lekhai ik gal hor haumai jhakhanaa jhaakh ||1||
english: O Nanak, only one thing is of any account: everything else is useless babbling and idle talk in ego. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿਆ ॥ ਤੇਤਾ ਕੜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: likh likh paRiaa || tetaa kaRiaa ||
english: The more one write and reads, the more one burns.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਵਿਆ ॥ ਤੇਤੋ ਲਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bahu teerath bhaviaa || teto laviaa ||
english: The more one wanders at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, the more one talks uselessly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕੀਆ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: bahu bhekh keeaa dehee dukh deeaa ||
english: The more one wears religious robes, the more pain he causes his body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹੁ ਵੇ ਜੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sahu ve jeeaa apanaa keeaa ||
english: O my soul, you must endure the consequences of your own actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਇਆ ਸਾਦੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)n na khaaiaa saad gavaaiaa ||
english: One who does not eat the corn, misses out on the taste.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bahu dukh paaiaa doojaa bhaaiaa ||
english: One obtains great pain, in the love of duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਪਹਿਰੈ ॥ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਹਰੈ ॥
transliteration: basatr na pahirai || ahinis kaharai ||
english: One who does not wear any clothes, suffers night and day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਨਿ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ॥ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: mon vigootaa || kiu jaagai gur bin sootaa ||
english: Through silence, he is ruined. How can the sleeping one be awakened without the Guru?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਗ ਉਪੇਤਾਣਾ ॥ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: pag upetaanaa || apanaa keeaa kamaanaa ||
english: One who goes barefoot suffers by his own actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਲੁ ਮਲੁ ਖਾਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: al mal khaaee sir chhaaee paaee ||
english: One who eats filth and throws ashes on his head

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: moorakh a(n)dhai pat gavaaee ||
english: the blind fool loses his honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai kichh thaai na paaee ||
english: Without the Name, nothing is of any use.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਬੇਬਾਣੀ ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: rahai bebaanee maRee masaanee ||
english: One who lives in the wilderness, in cemetaries and cremation grounds

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh na jaanai phir pachhutaanee ||
english: - that blind man does not know the Lord; he regrets and repents in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhete so sukh paae ||
english: One who meets the True Guru finds peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: He enshrines the Name of the Lord in his mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naanak nadar kare so paae ||
english: O Nanak, when the Lord grants His Grace, He is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਤੇ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aas a(n)dese te nihakeval haumai sabad jalaae ||2||
english: He becomes free of hope and fear, and burns away his ego with the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਵਦੇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat terai man bhaavade dar sohan keerat gaavade ||
english: Your devotees are pleasing to Your Mind, Lord. They look beautiful at Your door, singing Your Praises.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਅ ਨ ਲਹਨੑੀ ਧਾਵਦੇ ॥
transliteration: naanak karamaa baahare dar dho na lahanhee dhaavade ||
english: O Nanak, those who are denied Your Grace, find no shelter at Your Door; they continue wandering.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਨੑਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ॥
transliteration: ik mool na bujhanhi aapanaa anahodaa aap ganaaide ||
english: Some do not understand their origins, and without cause, they display their self-conceit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਾ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੋਰਿ ਉਤਮ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਦਾਇਦੇ ॥
transliteration: hau dhaadhee kaa neech jaat hor utam jaat sadaaide ||
english: I am the Lord's minstrel, of low social status; others call themselves high caste.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਮੰਗਾ ਜਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: tinh ma(n)gaa j tujhai dhiaaide ||9||
english: I seek those who meditate on You. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਪਰਜਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kooR raajaa kooR parajaa kooR sabh sa(n)saar ||
english: False is the king, false are the subjects; false is the whole world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਮੰਡਪ ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾੜੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੈਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kooR ma(n)dap kooR maaRee kooR baisanahaar ||
english: False is the mansion, false are the skyscrapers; false are those who live in them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੁਪਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਪੈਨੑਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kooR suinaa kooR rupaa kooR painhnahaar ||
english: False is gold, and false is silver; false are those who wear them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪੜੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kooR kaaiaa kooR kapaR kooR roop apaar ||
english: False is the body, false are the clothes; false is incomparable beauty.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਮੀਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੀਬੀ ਖਪਿ ਹੋਏ ਖਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kooR meeaa kooR beebee khap hoe khaar ||
english: False is the husband, false is the wife; they mourn and waste away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਕੂੜੈ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kooR kooRai nehu lagaa visariaa karataar ||
english: The false ones love falsehood, and forget their Creator.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kis naal keechai dosatee sabh jag chalanahaar ||
english: With whom should I become friends, if all the world shall pass away?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾਖਿਉ ਕੂੜੁ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kooR mithaa kooR maakhiu kooR dobe poor ||
english: False is sweetness, false is honey; through falsehood, boat-loads of men have drowned.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak vakhaanai benatee tudh baajh kooRo kooR ||1||
english: Nanak speaks this prayer: without You, Lord, everything is totally false. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sach taa par jaaneeai jaa ridai sachaa hoi ||
english: One knows the Truth only when the Truth is in his heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਤਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਛਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kooR kee mal utarai tan kare hachhaa dhoi ||
english: The filth of falsehood departs, and the body is washed clean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sach taa par jaaneeai jaa sach dhare piaar ||
english: One knows the Truth only when he bears love to the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naau sun man rahaseeai taa paae mokh duaar ||
english: Hearing the Name, the mind is enraptured; then, he attains the gate of salvation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sach taa par jaaneeai jaa jugat jaanai jeeu ||
english: One knows the Truth only when he knows the true way of life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਇ ਕਰਤਾ ਬੀਉ ॥
transliteration: dharat kaaiaa saadh kai vich dei karataa beeu ||
english: Preparing the field of the body, he plants the Seed of the Creator.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਿਖ ਸਚੀ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: sach taa par jaaneeai jaa sikh sachee lei ||
english: One knows the Truth only when he receives true instruction.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: daiaa jaanai jee kee kichh pu(n)n daan karei ||
english: Showing mercy to other beings, he makes donations to charities.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾਂ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਤਮ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sach taa(n) par jaaneeai jaa aatam teerath kare nivaas ||
english: One knows the Truth only when he dwells in the sacred shrine of pilgrimage of his own soul.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਪੁਛਿ ਕੈ ਬਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo no puchh kai bahi rahai kare nivaas ||
english: He sits and receives instruction from the True Guru, and lives in accordance with His Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਰੂ ਪਾਪ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sach sabhanaa hoi daaroo paap kadhai dhoi ||
english: Truth is the medicine for all; it removes and washes away our sins.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak vakhaanai benatee jin sach palai hoi ||2||
english: Nanak speaks this prayer to those who have Truth in their laps. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੁ ਮਹਿੰਡਾ ਤਲੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: daan mahi(n)daa talee khaak je milai ta masatak laaeeai ||
english: The gift I seek is the dust of the feet of the Saints; if I were to obtain it, I would apply it to my forehead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛਡੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kooRaa laalach chhadeeai hoi ik man alakh dhiaaeeai ||
english: Renounce false greed, and meditate single-mindedly on the unseen Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਲੁ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇਵੇਹੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: phal teveho paaeeai jevehee kaar kamaaeeai ||
english: As are the actions we commit, so are the rewards we receive.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: je hovai poorab likhiaa taa dhooR tinhaa dee paaeeai ||
english: If it is so pre-ordained, then one obtains the dust of the feet of the Saints.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਥੋੜੀ ਸੇਵ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: mat thoRee sev gavaaeeai ||10||
english: But through small-mindedness, we forfeit the merits of selfless service. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲਖ ਬੇਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sach kaal kooR varatiaa kal kaalakh betaal ||
english: There is a famine of Truth; falsehood prevails, and the blackness of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga has turned men into demons.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੀਉ ਬੀਜਿ ਪਤਿ ਲੈ ਗਏ ਅਬ ਕਿਉ ਉਗਵੈ ਦਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: beeu beej pat lai gae ab kiu ugavai daal ||
english: Those who planted their seed have departed with honor; now, how can the shattered seed sprout?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਉਗਵੈ ਰੁਤੀ ਹੂ ਰੁਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: je ik hoi ta ugavai rutee hoo rut hoi ||
english: If the seed is whole, and it is the proper season, then the seed will sprout.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak paahai baaharaa korai ra(n)g na soi ||
english: O Nanak, without treatment, the raw fabric cannot be dyed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਖੁੰਬਿ ਚੜਾਈਐ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਾਹੁ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich khu(n)b chaRaaeeai saram paahu tan hoi ||
english: In the Fear of God it is bleached white, if the treatment of modesty is applied to the cloth of the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤੀ ਜੇ ਰਪੈ ਕੂੜੈ ਸੋਇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bhagatee je rapai kooRai soi na koi ||1||
english: O Nanak, if one is imbued with devotional worship, his reputation is not false. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਹਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: lab paap dui raajaa mahataa kooR hoaa sikadaar ||
english: Greed and sin are the king and prime minister; falsehood is the treasurer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਨੇਬੁ ਸਦਿ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kaam neb sad puchheeai bahi bahi kare beechaar ||
english: Sexual desire, the chief advisor, is summoned and consulted; they all sit together and contemplate their plans.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੀ ਰਯਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਭਾਹਿ ਭਰੇ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhee rayat giaan vihoonee bhaahi bhare muradaar ||
english: Their subjects are blind, and without wisdom, they try to please the will of the dead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਨਚਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਵਾਵਹਿ ਰੂਪ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: giaanee nachahi vaaje vaavahi roop karahi seegaar ||
english: The spiritually wise dance and play their musical instruments, adorning themselves with beautiful decorations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਕੂਕਹਿ ਵਾਦਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋਧਾ ਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ooche kookahi vaadaa gaavahi jodhaa kaa veechaar ||
english: They shout out loud, and sing epic poems and heroic stories.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਜਤਿ ਸੰਜੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: moorakh pa(n)dit hikamat hujat sa(n)jai karahi piaar ||
english: The fools call themselves spiritual scholars, and by their clever tricks, they love to gather wealth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਵਹਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dharamee dharam karahi gaavaavahi ma(n)gahi mokh duaar ||
english: The righteous waste their righteousness, by asking for the door of salvation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤੀ ਸਦਾਵਹਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਛਡਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jatee sadaavahi jugat na jaanahi chhad bahahi ghar baar ||
english: They call themselves celibate, and abandon their homes, but they do not know the true way of life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਟਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko pooraa aape hovai ghat na koee aakhai ||
english: Everyone calls himself perfect; none call themselves imperfect.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੋਲਿਆ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pat paravaanaa pichhai paaeeai taa naanak toliaa jaapai ||2||
english: If the weight of honor is placed on the scale, then, O Nanak, one sees his true weight. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਦੀ ਸੁ ਵਜਗਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vadee s vajag naanakaa sachaa vekhai soi ||
english: Evil actions become publicly known; O Nanak, the True Lord sees everything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨੀ ਛਾਲਾ ਮਾਰੀਆ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanee chhaalaa maareeaa karataa kare s hoi ||
english: Everyone makes the attempt, but that alone happens which the Creator Lord does.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਅਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਨਵੇ ॥
transliteration: agai jaat na jor hai agai jeeu nave ||
english: In the world hereafter, social status and power mean nothing; hereafter, the soul is new.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੈ ਚੰਗੇ ਸੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin kee lekhai pat pavai cha(n)ge seee kei ||3||
english: Those few, whose honor is confirmed, are good. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਤਿਨੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhur karam jinaa kau tudh paaiaa taa tinee khasam dhiaaiaa ||
english: Only those whose karma You have pre-ordained from the very beginning, O Lord, meditate on You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਵੇਕੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: enaa ja(n)taa kai vas kichh naahee tudh vekee jagat upaaiaa ||
english: Nothing is in the power of these beings; You created the various worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਆਪਹੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa no too(n) mel laihi ik aapahu tudh khuaaiaa ||
english: Some, You unite with Yourself, and some, You lead astray.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਜਿਥੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te jaaniaa jithai tudh aap bujhaaiaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace You are known; through Him, You reveal Yourself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: sahaje hee sach samaaiaa ||11||
english: We are easily absorbed in You. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾਮਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: dukh daaroo sukh rog bhaiaa jaa sukh taam na hoee ||
english: Suffering is the medicine, and pleasure the disease, because where there is pleasure, there is no desire for God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾ ਹਉ ਕਰੀ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too(n) karataa karanaa mai naahee jaa hau karee na hoee ||1||
english: You are the Creator Lord; I can do nothing. Even if I try, nothing happens. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: balihaaree kudarat vasiaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to Your almighty creative power which is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teraa a(n)t na jaaee lakhiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your limits cannot be known. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jaat mahi jot jot mahi jaataa akal kalaa bharapoor rahiaa ||
english: Your Light is in Your creatures, and Your creatures are in Your Light; Your almighty power is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸੁਆਲੑਿਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: too(n) sachaa saahib siphat suaalhiu jin keetee so paar paiaa ||
english: You are the True Lord and Master; Your Praise is so beautiful. One who sings it, is carried across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak karate keeaa baataa jo kichh karanaa s kar rahiaa ||2||
english: Nanak speaks the stories of the Creator Lord; whatever He is to do, He does. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦੰ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਬਦੰ ਬੇਦ ਸਬਦੰ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣਹ ॥
transliteration: jog sabada(n) giaan sabada(n) bed sabada(n) braahamanah ||
english: The Way of Yoga is the Way of spiritual wisdom; the Vedas are the Way of the Brahmins.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਦ੍ਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਪਰਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਹ ॥
transliteration: khatree sabada(n) soor sabada(n) soodr sabada(n) paraa kritah ||
english: The Way of the Khshatriya is the Way of bravery; the Way of the Shudras is service to others.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸਬਦੰ ਏਕ ਸਬਦੰ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab sabada(n) ek sabada(n) je ko jaanai bheu ||
english: The Way of all is the Way of the One; Nanak is a slave to one who knows this secret;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak taa kaa daas hai soee nira(n)jan deu ||3||
english: He himself is the Immaculate Divine Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੰ ਸਰਬ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾ ਤ ਆਤਮਾ ॥
transliteration: ek krisana(n) sarab devaa dev devaa ta aatamaa ||
english: The One Lord Krishna is the Divine Lord of all; He is the Divinity of the individual soul.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮਾ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵਸੵਿ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
transliteration: aatamaa baasudevasy je ko jaanai bheu ||
english: Nanak is a slave to anyone who understands this mystery of the all-pervading Lord;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak taa kaa daas hai soee nira(n)jan deu ||4||
english: He himself is the Immaculate Divine Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਭੇ ਬਧਾ ਜਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ku(n)bhe badhaa jal rahai jal bin ku(n)bh na hoi ||
english: Water remains confined within the pitcher, but without water, the pitcher could not have been formed;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਬਧਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: giaan kaa badhaa man rahai gur bin giaan na hoi ||5||
english: just so, the mind is restrained by spiritual wisdom, but without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰੁ ਤਾ ਓਮੀ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਮਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: paRiaa hovai gunahagaar taa omee saadh na maareeai ||
english: If an educated person is a sinner, then the illiterate holy man is not to be punished.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਘਾਲੇ ਘਾਲਣਾ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਨਾਉ ਪਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jehaa ghaale ghaalanaa teveho naau pachaareeai ||
english: As are the deeds done, so is the reputation one acquires.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਕਲਾ ਨ ਖੇਡੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਗਇਆ ਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: aisee kalaa na khedeeai jit daragah gaiaa haareeai ||
english: So do not play such a game, which will bring you to ruin at the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿਆ ਅਤੈ ਓਮੀਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਅਗੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: paRiaa atai omeeaa veechaar agai veechaareeai ||
english: The accounts of the educated and the illiterate shall be judged in the world hereafter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਿ ਚਲੈ ਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: muhi chalai s agai maareeai ||12||
english: One who stubbornly follows his own mind shall suffer in the world hereafter. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੁ ਸਰੀਰ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਰਥੁ ਇਕੁ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak mer sareer kaa ik rath ik rathavaahu ||
english: O Nanak, the soul of the body has one chariot and one charioteer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਵਟਾਈਅਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jug jug pher vataaeeahi giaanee bujhahi taahi ||
english: In age after age they change; the spiritually wise understand this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਰਥੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: satajug rath sa(n)tokh kaa dharam agai rathavaahu ||
english: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, contentment was the chariot and righteousness the charioteer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਰਥੁ ਜਤੈ ਕਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: tretai rath jatai kaa jor agai rathavaahu ||
english: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, celibacy was the chariot and power the charioteer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਰਥੁ ਤਪੈ ਕਾ ਸਤੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: duaapur rath tapai kaa sat agai rathavaahu ||
english: In the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga, penance was the chariot and truth the charioteer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਰਥੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kalajug rath agan kaa kooR agai rathavaahu ||1||
english: In the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, fire is the chariot and falsehood the charioteer. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਮ ਕਹੈ ਸੇਤੰਬਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਆਛੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
transliteration: saam kahai seta(n)bar suaamee sach mahi aachhai saach rahe ||
english: The Sama Veda says that the Lord Master is robed in white; in the Age of Truth,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko sach samaavai ||
english: Everyone desired Truth, abided in Truth, and was merged in the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਿਗੁ ਕਹੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: rig kahai rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: The Rig Veda says that God is permeating and pervading everywhere;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raam naam devaa mahi soor ||
english: among the deities, the Lord's Name is the most exalted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਲਇਐ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naai laiai paraachhat jaahi ||
english: Chanting the Name, sins depart;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਉ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak tau mokha(n)tar paahi ||
english: O Nanak, then, one obtains salvation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਜ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਛਲੀ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਵਲਿ ਕਾਨੑ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਜਾਦਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: juj mahi jor chhalee cha(n)draaval kaanh krisan jaadam bhaiaa ||
english: In the Jujar Veda, Kaan Krishna of the Yaadva tribe seduced Chandraavali by force.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਗੋਪੀ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: paarajaat gopee lai aaiaa bi(n)draaban mahi ra(n)g keeaa ||
english: He brought the Elysian Tree for his milk-maid, and revelled in Brindaaban.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ ਹੂਆ ਨਾਉ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਅਲਹੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kal mahi bed atharaban hooaa naau khudaaee alahu bhaiaa ||
english: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Atharva Veda became prominent; Allah became the Name of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੀਲ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਤੁਰਕ ਪਠਾਣੀ ਅਮਲੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: neel basatr le kapaRe pahire turak pathaanee amal keeaa ||
english: Men began to wear blue robes and garments; Turks and Pat'haans assumed power.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਵੇਦ ਹੋਏ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: chaare ved hoe sachiaar ||
english: The four Vedas each claim to be true.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜਹਿ ਗੁਣਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਚਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: paRahi gunahi tinh chaar veechaar ||
english: Reading and studying them, four doctrines are found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਸਦਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhaau bhagat kar neech sadaae ||
english: With loving devotional worship, abiding in humility,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tau naanak mokha(n)tar paae ||2||
english: O Nanak, salvation is attained. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur vitahu vaariaa jit miliai khasam samaaliaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru; meeting Him, I have come to cherish the Lord Master.

author: Guru Nanak
