gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਇਨੑੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jin kar upades giaan a(n)jan deeaa inhee netree jagat nihaaliaa ||
english: He has taught me and given me the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, and with these eyes, I behold the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਡੁਬੇ ਸੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: khasam chhod doojai lage dube se vanajaariaa ||
english: Those dealers who abandon their Lord and Master and attach themselves to another, are drowned.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo hai bohithaa viralai kinai veechaariaa ||
english: The True Guru is the boat, but few are those who realize this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa paar utaariaa ||13||
english: Granting His Grace, He carries them across. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮਲ ਰੁਖੁ ਸਰਾਇਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਦੀਰਘ ਅਤਿ ਮੁਚੁ ॥
transliteration: si(n)mal rukh saraairaa at deeragh at much ||
english: The simmal tree is straight as an arrow; it is very tall, and very thick.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਸ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: oi j aavahi aas kar jaahi niraase kit ||
english: But those birds which visit it hopefully, depart disappointed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਫਿਕੇ ਫੁਲ ਬਕਬਕੇ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਪਤ ॥
transliteration: phal phike phul bakabake ka(n)m na aavahi pat ||
english: Its fruits are tasteless, its flowers are nauseating, and its leaves are useless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਤੁ ਨੀਵੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਤਤੁ ॥
transliteration: mithat neevee naanakaa gun cha(n)giaaeeaa tat ||
english: Sweetness and humility, O Nanak, are the essence of virtue and goodness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਵੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਪਰ ਕਉ ਨਿਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko nivai aap kau par kau nivai na koi ||
english: Everyone bows down to himself; no one bows down to another.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਿ ਤਾਰਾਜੂ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਨਿਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਉਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dhar taaraajoo toleeai nivai s gauraa hoi ||
english: When something is placed on the balancing scale and weighed, the side which descends is heavier.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਦੂਣਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਜੋ ਹੰਤਾ ਮਿਰਗਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aparaadhee doonaa nivai jo ha(n)taa miragaahi ||
english: The sinner, like the deer hunter, bows down twice as much.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੀਸਿ ਨਿਵਾਇਐ ਕਿਆ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਕੁਸੁਧੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sees nivaaiai kiaa theeai jaa ridai kusudhe jaahi ||1||
english: But what can be achieved by bowing the head, when the heart is impure? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੁਸਤਕ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
transliteration: paR pusatak sa(n)dhiaa baada(n) ||
english: You read your books and say your prayers, and then engage in debate;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਲ ਪੂਜਸਿ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧੰ ॥
transliteration: sil poojas bagul samaadha(n) ||
english: you worship stones and sit like a stork, pretending to be in Samaadhi.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਭੂਖਣ ਸਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: mukh jhooth bibhookhan saara(n) ||
english: With your mouth you utter falsehood, and you adorn yourself with precious decorations;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈਪਾਲ ਤਿਹਾਲ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: traipaal tihaal bichaara(n) ||
english: you recite the three lines of the Gayatri three times a day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਲਿਲਾਟੰ ॥
transliteration: gal maalaa tilak lilaata(n) ||
english: Around your neck is a rosary, and on your forehead is a sacred mark;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਧੋਤੀ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਪਾਟੰ ॥
transliteration: dui dhotee basatr kapaata(n) ||
english: upon your head is a turban, and you wear two loin cloths.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਸਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
transliteration: je jaanas brahama(n) karama(n) ||
english: If you knew the nature of God,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਫੋਕਟ ਨਿਸਚਉ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
transliteration: sabh phokat nisachau karama(n) ||
english: you would know that all of these beliefs and rituals are in vain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak nihachau dhiaavai ||
english: Says Nanak, meditate with deep faith;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vin satigur vaat na paavai ||2||
english: without the True Guru, no one finds the Way. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਪੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਛਡਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kapaR roop suhaavanaa chhad duneeaa a(n)dar jaavanaa ||
english: Abandoning the world of beauty, and beautiful clothes, one must depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਚੰਗਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)daa cha(n)gaa aapanaa aape hee keetaa paavanaa ||
english: He obtains the rewards of his good and bad deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮ ਕੀਏ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਰਾਹਿ ਭੀੜੈ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: hukam keee man bhaavade raahi bheeRai agai jaavanaa ||
english: He may issue whatever commands he wishes, but he shall have to take to the narrow path hereafter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੰਗਾ ਦੋਜਕਿ ਚਾਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਦਿਸੈ ਖਰਾ ਡਰਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: na(n)gaa dojak chaaliaa taa disai kharaa daraavanaa ||
english: He goes to hell naked, and he looks hideous then.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: kar augan pachhotaavanaa ||14||
english: He regrets the sins he committed. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਪਾਹ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਜਤੁ ਗੰਢੀ ਸਤੁ ਵਟੁ ॥
transliteration: daiaa kapaah sa(n)tokh soot jat ga(n)dhee sat vat ||
english: Make compassion the cotton, contentment the thread, modesty the knot and truth the twist.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਜਨੇਊ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਹਈ ਤ ਪਾਡੇ ਘਤੁ ॥
transliteration: ehu janeoo jee kaa haee ta paade ghat ||
english: This is the sacred thread of the soul; if you have it, then go ahead and put it on me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਨ ਮਲੁ ਲਗੈ ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naa ehu tutai na mal lagai naa ehu jalai na jaai ||
english: It does not break, it cannot be soiled by filth, it cannot be burnt, or lost.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੋ ਗਲਿ ਚਲੇ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s maanas naanakaa jo gal chale paai ||
english: Blessed are those mortal beings, O Nanak, who wear such a thread around their necks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਕੜਿ ਮੁਲਿ ਅਣਾਇਆ ਬਹਿ ਚਉਕੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: chaukaR mul anaaiaa bahi chaukai paaiaa ||
english: You buy the thread for a few shells, and seated in your enclosure, you put it on.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖਾ ਕੰਨਿ ਚੜਾਈਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਥਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sikhaa ka(n)n chaRaaeeaa gur braahaman thiaa ||
english: Whispering instructions into others' ears, the Brahmin becomes a guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਮੁਆ ਓਹੁ ਝੜਿ ਪਇਆ ਵੇਤਗਾ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ohu muaa ohu jhaR paiaa vetagaa gaiaa ||1||
english: But he dies, and the sacred thread falls away, and the soul departs without it. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚੋਰੀਆ ਲਖ ਜਾਰੀਆ ਲਖ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਲਖ ਗਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: lakh choreeaa lakh jaareeaa lakh kooReeaa lakh gaal ||
english: He commits thousands of robberies, thousands of acts of adultery, thousands of falsehoods and thousands of abuses.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਠਗੀਆ ਪਹਿਨਾਮੀਆ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: lakh thageeaa pahinaameeaa raat dinas jee naal ||
english: He practices thousands of deceptions and secret deeds, night and day, against his fellow beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਗੁ ਕਪਾਹਹੁ ਕਤੀਐ ਬਾਮੑਣੁ ਵਟੇ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: tag kapaahahu kateeai baamhn vate aai ||
english: The thread is spun from cotton, and the Brahmin comes and twists it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਹਿ ਬਕਰਾ ਰਿੰਨੑਿ ਖਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kuhi bakaraa ri(n)nhi khaaiaa sabh ko aakhai paai ||
english: The goat is killed, cooked and eaten, and everyone then says, "Put on the sacred thread."

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਸੁਟੀਐ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hoi puraanaa suteeai bhee phir paaeeai hor ||
english: When it wears out, it is thrown away, and another one is put on.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਜੇ ਤਗਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak tag na tutaee je tag hovai jor ||2||
english: O Nanak, the thread would not break, if it had any real strength. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੂਤੁ ॥
transliteration: naai ma(n)niai pat oopajai saalaahee sach soot ||
english: Believing in the Name, honor is obtained. The Lord's Praise is the true sacred thread.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਪੂਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: daragah a(n)dar paaeeai tag na tootas poot ||3||
english: Such a sacred thread is worn in the Court of the Lord; it shall never break. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tag na i(n)dree tag na naaree ||
english: There is no sacred thread for the sexual organ, and no thread for woman.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਲਕੇ ਥੁਕ ਪਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਦਾੜੀ ॥
transliteration: bhalake thuk pavai nit daaRee ||
english: The man's beard is spat upon daily.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਪੈਰੀ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਹਥੀ ॥
transliteration: tag na pairee tag na hathee ||
english: There is no sacred thread for the feet, and no thread for the hands;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਅਖੀ ॥
transliteration: tag na jihavaa tag na akhee ||
english: no thread for the tongue, and no thread for the eyes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਤਗਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਤੈ ॥
transliteration: vetagaa aape vatai ||
english: The Brahmin himself goes to the world hereafter without a sacred thread.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਟਿ ਧਾਗੇ ਅਵਰਾ ਘਤੈ ॥
transliteration: vat dhaage avaraa ghatai ||
english: Twisting the threads, he puts them on others.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਭਾੜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਆਹੁ ॥
transliteration: lai bhaaR kare veeaahu ||
english: He takes payment for performing marriages;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਢਿ ਕਾਗਲੁ ਦਸੇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kadh kaagal dase raahu ||
english: reading their horoscopes, he shows them the way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਏਹੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sun vekhahu lokaa ehu vidaan ||
english: Hear, and see, O people, this wondrous thing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: man a(n)dhaa naau sujaan ||4||
english: He is mentally blind, and yet his name is wisdom. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: saahib hoi daiaal kirapaa kare taa saaee kaar karaaisee ||
english: One, upon whom the Merciful Lord bestows His Grace, performs His service.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: so sevak sevaa kare jis no hukam manaaisee ||
english: That servant, whom the Lord causes to obey the Order of His Will, serves Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: hukam ma(n)niai hovai paravaan taa khasamai kaa mahal paaisee ||
english: Obeying the Order of His Will, he becomes acceptable, and then, he obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: khasamai bhaavai so kare manahu chi(n)diaa so phal paaisee ||
english: One who acts to please His Lord and Master, obtains the fruits of his mind's desires.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇਸੀ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: taa daragah paidhaa jaaisee ||15||
english: Then, he goes to the Court of the Lord, wearing robes of honor. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਊ ਬਿਰਾਹਮਣ ਕਉ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਬਰਿ ਤਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gaoo biraahaman kau kar laavahu gobar taran na jaaee ||
english: They tax the cows and the Brahmins, but the cow-dung they apply to their kitchen will not save them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੋਤੀ ਟਿਕਾ ਤੈ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ਧਾਨੁ ਮਲੇਛਾਂ ਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dhotee tikaa tai japamaalee dhaan malechhaa(n) khaaee ||
english: They wear their loin cloths, apply ritual frontal marks to their foreheads, and carry their rosaries, but they eat food with the Muslims.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਤੁਰਕਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar poojaa paRahi katebaa sa(n)jam turakaa bhaaee ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, you perform devotional worship indoors, but read the Islamic sacred texts, and adopt the Muslim way of life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡੀਲੇ ਪਾਖੰਡਾ ॥
transliteration: chhodeele paakha(n)daa ||
english: Renounce your hypocrisy!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਲਇਐ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਰੰਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam laiai jaahi tara(n)daa ||1||
english: Taking the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall swim across. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਖਾਣੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥
transliteration: maanas khaane karahi nivaaj ||
english: The man-eaters say their prayers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੁਰੀ ਵਗਾਇਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਗਲਿ ਤਾਗ ॥
transliteration: chhuree vagaain tin gal taag ||
english: Those who wield the knife wear the sacred thread around their necks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਘਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਪੂਰਹਿ ਨਾਦ ॥
transliteration: tin ghar brahaman poorahi naad ||
english: In their homes, the Brahmins sound the conch.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਨੑਾ ਭਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਓਈ ਸਾਦ ॥
transliteration: unhaa bh aavahi oee saad ||
english: They too have the same taste.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਕੂੜਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kooRee raas kooRaa vaapaar ||
english: False is their capital, and false is their trade.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kooR bol karahi aahaar ||
english: Speaking falsehood, they take their food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saram dharam kaa deraa door ||
english: The home of modesty and Dharma is far from them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੂੜੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak kooR rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: O Nanak, they are totally permeated with falsehood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਥੈ ਟਿਕਾ ਤੇੜਿ ਧੋਤੀ ਕਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mathai tikaa teR dhotee kakhaaee ||
english: The sacred marks are on their foreheads, and the saffron loin-cloths are around their waists;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਥਿ ਛੁਰੀ ਜਗਤ ਕਾਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hath chhuree jagat kaasaaee ||
english: in their hands they hold the knives - they are the butchers of the world!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੀਲ ਵਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: neel vasatr pahir hovahi paravaan ||
english: Wearing blue robes, they seek the approval of the Muslim rulers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲੇਛ ਧਾਨੁ ਲੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: malechh dhaan le poojahi puraan ||
english: Accepting bread from the Muslim rulers, they still worship the Puraanas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਭਾਖਿਆ ਕਾ ਕੁਠਾ ਬਕਰਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: abhaakhiaa kaa kuthaa bakaraa khaanaa ||
english: They eat the meat of the goats, killed after the Muslim prayers are read over them,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਕੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: chauke upar kisai na jaanaa ||
english: but they do not allow anyone else to enter their kitchen areas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇ ਕੈ ਚਉਕਾ ਕਢੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: de kai chaukaa kadhee kaar ||
english: They draw lines around them, plastering the ground with cow-dung.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਪਰਿ ਆਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: upar aai baithe kooRiaar ||
english: The false come and sit within them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਭਿਟੈ ਵੇ ਮਤੁ ਭਿਟੈ ॥
transliteration: mat bhitai ve mat bhitai ||
english: They cry out, "Do not touch our food,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਅੰਨੁ ਅਸਾਡਾ ਫਿਟੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu a(n)n asaadaa phitai ||
english: Or it will be polluted!"

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨਿ ਫਿਟੈ ਫੇੜ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: tan phitai pheR karen ||
english: But with their polluted bodies, they commit evil deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਜੂਠੈ ਚੁਲੀ ਭਰੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: man joothai chulee bharen ||
english: With filthy minds, they try to cleanse their mouths.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sach dhiaaeeai ||
english: Says Nanak, meditate on the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: such hovai taa sach paaeeai ||2||
english: If you are pure, you will obtain the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵੇਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਹੇਠਿ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: chitai a(n)dar sabh ko vekh nadaree heth chalaaidaa ||
english: All are within Your mind; You see and move them under Your Glance of Grace, O Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: aape de vadiaaeeaa aape hee karam karaaidaa ||
english: You Yourself grant them glory, and You Yourself cause them to act.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸਿਰੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: vadahu vadaa vad medanee sire sir dha(n)dhai laaidaa ||
english: The Lord is the greatest of the great; great is His world. He enjoins all to their tasks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਉਪਠੀ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਲਤਾਨਾ ਘਾਹੁ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: nadar upathee je kare sulataanaa ghaahu karaaidaa ||
english: If he should cast an angry glance, He can transform kings into blades of grass.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਮੰਗਨਿ ਭਿਖ ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: dar ma(n)gan bhikh na paaidaa ||16||
english: Even though they may beg from door to door, no one will give them charity. ||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮੋਹਾਕਾ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਹੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: je mohaakaa ghar muhai ghar muhi pitaree dei ||
english: The thief robs a house, and offers the stolen goods to his ancestors.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਚੋਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: agai vasat sinjaaneeai pitaree chor karei ||
english: In the world hereafter, this is recognized, and his ancestors are considered thieves as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਢੀਅਹਿ ਹਥ ਦਲਾਲ ਕੇ ਮੁਸਫੀ ਏਹ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: vadheeahi hath dalaal ke musaphee eh karei ||
english: The hands of the go-between are cut off; this is the Lord's justice.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿ ਖਟੇ ਘਾਲੇ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak agai so milai j khate ghaale dei ||1||
english: O Nanak, in the world hereafter, that alone is received, which one gives to the needy from his own earnings and labor. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜੋਰੂ ਸਿਰਨਾਵਣੀ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jiu joroo siranaavanee aavai vaaro vaar ||
english: As a woman has her periods, month after month,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੂਠੇ ਜੂਠਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: joothe joothaa mukh vasai nit nit hoi khuaar ||
english: so does falsehood dwell in the mouth of the false; they suffer forever, again and again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਚੇ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਬਹਨਿ ਜਿ ਪਿੰਡਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sooche ehi na aakheeahi bahan j pi(n)daa dhoi ||
english: They are not called pure, who sit down after merely washing their bodies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਚੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sooche seee naanakaa jin man vasiaa soi ||2||
english: Only they are pure, O Nanak, within whose minds the Lord abides. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਰੇ ਪਲਾਣੇ ਪਉਣ ਵੇਗ ਹਰ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਰਮ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ture palaane paun veg har ra(n)gee haram savaariaa ||
english: With saddled horses, as fast as the wind, and harems decorated in every way;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਲਾਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kothe ma(n)dap maaReeaa laai baithe kar paasaariaa ||
english: in houses and pavilions and lofty mansions, they dwell, making ostentatious shows.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੀਜ ਕਰਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: cheej karan man bhaavade har bujhan naahee haariaa ||
english: They act out their minds' desires, but they do not understand the Lord, and so they are ruined.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਖਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਿ ਮਹਲਤਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kar phuramaais khaaiaa vekh mahalat maran visaariaa ||
english: Asserting their authority, they eat, and beholding their mansions, they forget about death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਰੁ ਆਈ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: jar aaee joban haariaa ||17||
english: But old age comes, and youth is lost. ||17||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: je kar sootak ma(n)neeai sabh tai sootak hoi ||
english: If one accepts the concept of impurity, then there is impurity everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੋਹੇ ਅਤੈ ਲਕੜੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gohe atai lakaRee a(n)dar keeRaa hoi ||
english: In cow-dung and wood there are worms.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਦਾਣੇ ਅੰਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਆ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jete daane a(n)n ke jeeaa baajh na koi ||
english: As many as are the grains of corn, none is without life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: pahilaa paanee jeeu hai jit hariaa sabh koi ||
english: First, there is life in the water, by which everything else is made green.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਪਵੈ ਰਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sootak kiu kar rakheeai sootak pavai rasoi ||
english: How can it be protected from impurity? It touches our own kitchen.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਏਵ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਉਤਾਰੇ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sootak ev na utarai giaan utaare dhoi ||1||
english: O Nanak, impurity cannot be removed in this way; it is washed away only by spiritual wisdom. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕੂੜੁ ॥
transliteration: man kaa sootak lobh hai jihavaa sootak kooR ||
english: The impurity of the mind is greed, and the impurity of the tongue is falsehood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: akhee sootak vekhanaa par tri par dhan roop ||
english: The impurity of the eyes is to gaze upon the beauty of another man's wife, and his wealth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੰਨੀ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕੰਨਿ ਪੈ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)nee sootak ka(n)n pai laaitabaaree khaahi ||
english: The impurity of the ears is to listen to the slander of others.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੰਸਾ ਆਦਮੀ ਬਧੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak ha(n)saa aadamee badhe jam pur jaahi ||2||
english: O Nanak, the mortal's soul goes, bound and gagged to the city of Death. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੋ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabho sootak bharam hai doojai lagai jaai ||
english: All impurity comes from doubt and attachment to duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa hukam hai bhaanai aavai jaai ||
english: Birth and death are subject to the Command of the Lord's Will; through His Will we come and go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਦਿਤੋਨੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: khaanaa peenaa pavitr hai diton rijak sa(n)baahi ||
english: Eating and drinking are pure, since the Lord gives nourishment to all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak jinhee guramukh bujhiaa tinhaa sootak naahi ||3||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs, who understand the Lord, are not stained by impurity. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur vadaa kar saalaaheeai jis vich vadeeaa vadiaaeeaa ||
english: Praise the Great True Guru; within Him is the greatest greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਈਆ ॥
transliteration: sahi mele taa nadaree aaeeaa ||
english: When the Lord causes us to meet the Guru, then we come to see them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa tis bhaanaa taa man vasaaeeaa ||
english: When it pleases Him, they come to dwell in our minds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਥੁ ਧਰਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੀਆ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ॥
transliteration: kar hukam masatak hath dhar vichahu maar kadheeaa buriaaeeaa ||
english: By His Command, when He places His hand on our foreheads, wickedness departs from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਆ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: sahi tuthai nau nidh paaeeaa ||18||
english: When the Lord is thoroughly pleased, the nine treasures are obtained. ||18||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਸੁਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਚੈ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: pahilaa suchaa aap hoi suchai baithaa aai ||
english: First, purifying himself, the Brahmin comes and sits in his purified enclosure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਚੇ ਅਗੈ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਭਿਟਿਓ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: suche agai rakhion koi na bhitio jaai ||
english: The pure foods, which no one else has touched, are placed before him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਚਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜੇਵਿਆ ਲਗਾ ਪੜਣਿ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: suchaa hoi kai jeviaa lagaa paRan salok ||
english: Being purified, he takes his food, and begins to read his sacred verses.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਹਥੀ ਜਾਈ ਸਟਿਆ ਕਿਸੁ ਏਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਦੋਖੁ ॥
transliteration: kuhathee jaaee satiaa kis ehu lagaa dokh ||
english: But it is then thrown into a filthy place - whose fault is this?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਲੂਣੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)n devataa paanee devataa baisa(n)tar devataa loon ||
english: The corn is sacred, the water is sacred; the fire and salt are sacred as well;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਜਵਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਿਰਤੁ ॥ ਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਕੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)javaa paaiaa ghirat || taa hoaa paak pavit ||
english: When the fifth thing, the ghee, is added, then the food becomes pure and sanctified.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀ ਸਿਉ ਤਨੁ ਗਡਿਆ ਥੁਕਾ ਪਈਆ ਤਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: paapee siu tan gadiaa thukaa paeeaa tit ||
english: Coming into contact with the sinful human body, the food becomes so impure that is is spat upon.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਚਰਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਰਸ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jit mukh naam na oocharahi bin naavai ras khaahi ||
english: That mouth which does not chant the Naam, and without the Name eats tasty foods

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਥੁਕਾ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak evai jaaneeai tit mukh thukaa paahi ||1||
english: - O Nanak, know this: such a mouth is to be spat upon. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੰਡਿ ਜੰਮੀਐ ਭੰਡਿ ਨਿੰਮੀਐ ਭੰਡਿ ਮੰਗਣੁ ਵੀਆਹੁ ॥
transliteration: bha(n)d ja(n)meeai bha(n)d ni(n)meeai bha(n)d ma(n)gan veeaahu ||
english: From woman, man is born; within woman, man is conceived; to woman he is engaged and married.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੰਡਹੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਭੰਡਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: bha(n)dahu hovai dosatee bha(n)dahu chalai raahu ||
english: Woman becomes his friend; through woman, the future generations come.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੰਡੁ ਮੁਆ ਭੰਡੁ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਭੰਡਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਬੰਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: bha(n)d muaa bha(n)d bhaaleeai bha(n)d hovai ba(n)dhaan ||
english: When his woman dies, he seeks another woman; to woman he is bound.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮੰਦਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਰਾਜਾਨ ॥
transliteration: so kiu ma(n)daa aakheeai jit ja(n)mahi raajaan ||
english: So why call her bad? From her, kings are born.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੰਡਹੁ ਹੀ ਭੰਡੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਭੰਡੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bha(n)dahu hee bha(n)d oopajai bha(n)dai baajh na koi ||
english: From woman, woman is born; without woman, there would be no one at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੰਡੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak bha(n)dai baaharaa eko sachaa soi ||
english: O Nanak, only the True Lord is without a woman.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਗਾ ਰਤੀ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jit mukh sadaa saalaaheeai bhaagaa ratee chaar ||
english: That mouth which praises the Lord continually is blessed and beautiful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak te mukh oojale tit sachai darabaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, those faces shall be radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੋ ਚੁਣਿ ਕਢੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko aakhai aapanaa jis naahee so chun kadheeai ||
english: All call You their own, Lord; one who does not own You, is picked up and thrown away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਲੇਖਾ ਸੰਢੀਐ ॥
transliteration: keetaa aapo aapanaa aape hee lekhaa sa(n)dheeai ||
english: Everyone receives the rewards of his own actions; his account is adjusted accordingly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਐਤੁ ਜਗਿ ਤਾ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਹੰਢੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jaa rahanaa naahee ait jag taa kaait gaarab ha(n)dheeai ||
english: Since one is not destined to remain in this world anyway, why should he ruin himself in pride?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੜਿ ਅਖਰੁ ਏਹੋ ਬੁਝੀਐ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)daa kisai na aakheeai paR akhar eho bujheeai ||
english: Do not call anyone bad; read these words, and understand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਲੁਝੀਐ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: moorakhai naal na lujheeai ||19||
english: Don't argue with fools. ||19||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਫਿਕੈ ਬੋਲਿਐ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak phikai boliai tan man phikaa hoi ||
english: O Nanak, speaking insipid words, the body and mind become insipid.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਿਕੋ ਫਿਕਾ ਸਦੀਐ ਫਿਕੇ ਫਿਕੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: phiko phikaa sadeeai phike phikee soi ||
english: He is called the most insipid of the insipid; the most insipid of the insipid is his reputation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਿਕਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਟੀਐ ਮੁਹਿ ਥੁਕਾ ਫਿਕੇ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: phikaa daragah sateeai muhi thukaa phike paai ||
english: The insipid person is discarded in the Court of the Lord, and the insipid one's face is spat upon.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਿਕਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਾਣਾ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: phikaa moorakh aakheeai paanaa lahai sajaai ||1||
english: The insipid one is called a fool; he is beaten with shoes in punishment. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਪੈਜ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਫੈਲੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)darahu jhoothe paij baahar duneeaa a(n)dar phail ||
english: Those who are false within, and honorable on the outside, are very common in this world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜੇ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
transliteration: athasath teerath je naavahi utarai naahee mail ||
english: Even though they may bathe at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, still, their filth does not depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਪਟੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਗੁਦੜੁ ਤੇ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jinh pat a(n)dar baahar gudaR te bhale sa(n)saar ||
english: Those who have silk on the inside and rags on the outside, are the good ones in this world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਰਬ ਸੇਤੀ ਦੇਖਨੑੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tinh nehu lagaa rab setee dekhanhe veechaar ||
english: They embrace love for the Lord, and contemplate beholding Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਹਸਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਚੁਪ ਭੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g hasahi ra(n)g rovahi chup bhee kar jaahi ||
english: In the Lord's Love, they laugh, and in the Lord's Love, they weep, and also keep silent.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੇਰੀ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਹ ॥
transliteration: paravaah naahee kisai keree baajh sache naah ||
english: They do not care for anything else, except their True Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਵਾਟ ਉਪਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਮੰਗਾ ਜਬੈ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: dar vaat upar kharach ma(n)gaa jabai dei ta khaahi ||
english: Sitting, waiting at the Lord's Door, they beg for food, and when He gives to them, they eat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਕਲਮ ਏਕਾ ਹਮਾ ਤੁਮੑਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
transliteration: deebaan eko kalam ekaa hamaa tumhaa mel ||
english: There is only One Court of the Lord, and He has only one pen; there, you and I shall meet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਲਏ ਲੇਖਾ ਪੀੜਿ ਛੁਟੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਲੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dar lae lekhaa peeR chhutai naanakaa jiu tel ||2||
english: In the Court of the Lord, the accounts are examined; O Nanak, the sinners are crushed, like oil seeds in the press. ||2||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਓ ਕਲ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਤੈ ਧਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: aape hee karanaa keeo kal aape hee tai dhaareeai ||
english: You Yourself created the creation; You Yourself infused Your power into it.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਹਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਿ ਕਚੀ ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: dekhahi keetaa aapanaa dhar kachee pakee saareeai ||
english: You behold Your creation, like the losing and winning dice of the earth.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਆਈ ਵਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jo aaiaa so chalasee sabh koee aaee vaareeai ||
english: Whoever has come, shall depart; all shall have their turn.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ਹਹਿ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jis ke jee paraan hahi kiu saahib manahu visaareeai ||
english: He who owns our soul, and our very breath of life - why should we forget that Lord and Master from our minds?

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕਾਜੁ ਸਵਾਰੀਐ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: aapan hathee aapanaa aape hee kaaj savaareeai ||20||
english: With our own hands, let us resolve our own affairs. ||20||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਆਸਕੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: eh kinehee aasakee doojai lagai jaai ||
english: What sort of love is this, which clings to duality?

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸਕੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak aasak kaa(n)dheeai sad hee rahai samaai ||
english: O Nanak, he alone is called a lover, who remains forever immersed in absorption.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਚੰਗੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਮੰਦੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)gai cha(n)gaa kar ma(n)ne ma(n)dai ma(n)daa hoi ||
english: But one who feels good only when good is done for him, and feels bad when things go badly

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਆਸਕੁ ਏਹੁ ਨ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aasak ehu na aakheeai j lekhai varatai soi ||1||
english: - do not call him a lover. He trades only for his own account. ||1||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਲਾਮੁ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਘੁਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: salaam jabaab dovai kare mu(n)dhahu ghuthaa jaai ||
english: One who offers both respectful greetings and rude refusal to his master, has gone wrong from the very beginning.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੋਵੈ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak dovai kooReeaa thaai na kaaee paai ||2||
english: O Nanak, both of his actions are false; he obtains no place in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jit seviai sukh paaeeai so saahib sadaa samhaaleeai ||
english: Serving Him, peace is obtained; meditate and dwell upon that Lord and Master forever.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾ ਘਾਲ ਬੁਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jit keetaa paaeeai aapanaa saa ghaal buree kiu ghaaleeai ||
english: Why do you do such evil deeds, that you shall have to suffer so?

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਦੇ ਲੰਮੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)daa mool na keechaee de la(n)mee nadar nihaaleeai ||
english: Do not do any evil at all; look ahead to the future with foresight.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ ਤੇਵੇਹਾ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jiu saahib naal na haareeai tevehaa paasaa dhaaleeai ||
english: So throw the dice in such a way, that you shall not lose with your Lord and Master.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਲਾਹੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: kichh laahe upar ghaaleeai ||21||
english: Do those deeds which shall bring you profit. ||21||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਲਗੈ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਨਾਲੇ ਗਾਰਬੁ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: chaakar lagai chaakaree naale gaarab vaad ||
english: If a servant performs service, while being vain and argumentative,

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਘਣੇਰੀਆ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: galaa kare ghanereeaa khasam na paae saad ||
english: he may talk as much as he wants, but he shall not be pleasing to his Master.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aap gavaai sevaa kare taa kichh paae maan ||
english: But if he eliminates his self-conceit and then performs service, he shall be honored.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਗਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਗਾ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jis no lagaa tis milai lagaa so paravaan ||1||
english: O Nanak, if he merges with the one with whom he is attached, his attachment becomes acceptable. ||1||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੀਇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਉਗਵੈ ਮੁਹ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਵਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo jeei hoi s ugavai muh kaa kahiaa vaau ||
english: Whatever is in the mind, comes forth; spoken words by themselves are just wind.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਬੀਜੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: beeje bikh ma(n)gai a(n)mrit vekhahu ehu niaau ||2||
english: He sows seeds of poison, and demands Ambrosial Nectar. Behold - what justice is this? ||2||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਲਿ ਇਆਣੇ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: naal iaane dosatee kade na aavai raas ||
english: Friendship with a fool never works out right.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jehaa jaanai teho varatai vekhahu ko nirajaas ||
english: As he knows, he acts; behold, and see that it is so.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਵਸਤੂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: vasatoo a(n)dar vasat samaavai doojee hovai paas ||
english: One thing can be absorbed into another thing, but duality keeps them apart.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੇਤੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਕਹੀ ਬਣੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: saahib setee hukam na chalai kahee banai aradaas ||
english: No one can issue commands to the Lord Master; offer instead humble prayers.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kooR kamaanai kooRo hovai naanak siphat vigaas ||3||
english: Practicing falsehood, only falsehood is obtained. O Nanak, through the Lord's Praise, one blossoms forth. ||3||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਲਿ ਇਆਣੇ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਵਡਾਰੂ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: naal iaane dosatee vadaaroo siu nehu ||
english: Friendship with a fool, and love with a pompous person,

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲੀਕ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਥੇਹੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: paanee a(n)dar leek jiu tis daa thaau na thehu ||4||
english: are like lines drawn in water, leaving no trace or mark. ||4||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਇਆਣਾ ਕਰੇ ਕੰਮੁ ਆਣਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: hoi iaanaa kare ka(n)m aan na sakai raas ||
english: If a fool does a job, he cannot do it right.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਇਕ ਅਧ ਚੰਗੀ ਕਰੇ ਦੂਜੀ ਭੀ ਵੇਰਾਸਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: je ik adh cha(n)gee kare doojee bhee veraas ||5||
english: Even if he does something right, he does the next thing wrong. ||5||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਲਗੈ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chaakar lagai chaakaree je chalai khasamai bhaai ||
english: If a servant, performing service, obeys the Will of his Master,

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਹੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਗਲੀ ਓਹੁ ਵਜਹੁ ਭਿ ਦੂਣਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: huramat tis no agalee ohu vajahu bh doonaa khaai ||
english: his honor increases, and he receives double his wages.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੈ ਕਰੇ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਗੈਰਤਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khasamai kare baraabaree phir gairat a(n)dar paai ||
english: But if he claims to be equal to his Master, he earns his Master's displeasure.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਵਜਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਅਗਲਾ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਣਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vajahu gavaae agalaa muhe muhi paanaa khaai ||
english: He loses his entire salary, and is also beaten on his face with shoes.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jis daa ditaa khaavanaa tis kaheeai saabaas ||
english: Let us all celebrate Him, from whom we receive our nourishment.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਨਾਲਿ ਖਸਮ ਚਲੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak hukam na chalaee naal khasam chalai aradaas ||22||
english: O Nanak, no one can issue commands to the Lord Master; let us offer prayers instead. ||22||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਆਪਸ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: eh kinehee daat aapas te jo paaeeai ||
english: What sort of gift is this, which we receive only by our own asking?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੁਠੈ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saa karamaat saahib tuthai jo milai ||1||
english: O Nanak, that is the most wonderful gift, which is received from the Lord, when He is totally pleased. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਉ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: eh kinehee chaakaree jit bhau khasam na jaai ||
english: What sort of service is this, by which the fear of the Lord Master does not depart?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਾਢੀਐ ਜਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਖਸਮ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sevak kaadheeai j setee khasam samaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, he alone is called a servant, who merges with the Lord Master. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naanak a(n)t na jaapanhee har taa ke paaraavaar ||
english: O Nanak, the Lord's limits cannot be known; He has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਮਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aap karaae saakhatee phir aap karaae maar ||
english: He Himself creates, and then He Himself destroys.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਗਲੀ ਜੰਜੀਰੀਆ ਇਕਿ ਤੁਰੀ ਚੜਹਿ ਬਿਸੀਆਰ ॥
transliteration: ikanhaa galee ja(n)jeereeaa ik turee chaRahi biseeaar ||
english: Some have chains around their necks, while some ride on many horses.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aap karaae kare aap hau kai siu karee pukaar ||
english: He Himself acts, and He Himself causes us to act. Unto whom should I complain?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: naanak karanaa jin keeaa phir tis hee karanee saar ||23||
english: O Nanak, the One who created the creation - He Himself takes care of it. ||23||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਸਾਜਿਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਣੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aape bhaa(n)de saajian aape pooran dei ||
english: He Himself fashioned the vessel of the body, and He Himself fills it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑੀ ਦੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਇਕਿ ਚੁਲੑੈ ਰਹਨੑਿ ਚੜੇ ॥
transliteration: ikanhee dudh samaaeeai ik chulhai rahanhi chaRe ||
english: Into some, milk is poured, while others remain on the fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਪੈ ਸਵਨੑਿ ਇਕਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਖੜੇ ॥
transliteration: ik nihaalee pai savanhi ik upar rahan khaRe ||
english: Some lie down and sleep on soft beds, while others remain watchful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tinhaa savaare naanakaa jinh kau nadar kare ||1||
english: He adorns those, O Nanak, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਈ ਭਿ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aape saaje kare aap jaaee bh rakhai aap ||
english: He Himself creates and fashions the world, and He Himself keeps it in order.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: tis vich ja(n)t upaai kai dekhai thaap uthaap ||
english: Having created the beings within it, He oversees their birth and death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kis no kaheeai naanakaa sabh kichh aape aap ||2||
english: Unto whom should we speak, O Nanak, when He Himself is all-in-all? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vade keeaa vadiaaeeaa kichh kahanaa kahan na jaai ||
english: The description of the greatness of the Great Lord cannot be described.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਦਰ ਕਰੀਮੁ ਦੇ ਜੀਆ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: so karataa kaadar kareem de jeeaa rijak sa(n)baahi ||
english: He is the Creator, all-powerful and benevolent; He gives sustenance to all beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਤਿੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saaee kaar kamaavanee dhur chhodee ti(n)nai paai ||
english: The mortal does that work, which has been pre-destined from the very beginning.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੀ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਹੋਰ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak ekee baaharee hor doojee naahee jaai ||
english: O Nanak, except for the One Lord, there is no other place at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨੪॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
transliteration: so kare j tisai rajaai ||24||1|| sudh
english: He does whatever He wills. ||24||1|| Sudh||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag aasaa baanee bhagataa kee ||
english: Raag Aasaa, The Word Of The Devotees:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kabeer jeeu naamadeu jeeu ravidaas jeeu ||
english: Kabeer, Naam Dayv And Ravi Daas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aasaa sree kabeer jeeu ||
english: Aasaa, Kabeer Jee:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗਿ ਹਮ ਬਿਨਵਤਾ ਪੂਛਤ ਕਹ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur charan laag ham binavataa poochhat kah jeeu paaiaa ||
english: Falling at the Feet of the Guru, I pray, and ask Him, "Why was man created?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਾਜਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kavan kaaj jag upajai binasai kahahu mohi samajhaaiaa ||1||
english: What deeds cause the world to come into being, and be destroyed? Tell me, that I may understand." ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੈ ॥
transliteration: dev karahu daiaa mohi maarag laavahu jit bhai ba(n)dhan tootai ||
english: O Divine Guru, please, show Mercy to me, and place me on the right path, by which the bonds of fear may be cut away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਫੇੜ ਕਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਜੀਅ ਜਨਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh pheR karam sukh jee janam te chhootai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The pains of birth and death come from past actions and karma; peace comes when the soul finds release from reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸ ਬੰਧ ਨਹੀ ਫਾਰੈ ਅਰੁ ਮਨ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਨ ਲੂਕੇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa phaas ba(n)dh nahee phaarai ar man su(n)n na looke ||
english: The mortal does not break free from the bonds of the noose of Maya, and he does not seek the shelter of the profound, absolute Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਾ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑਿਆ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਭਿਉ ਨ ਚੂਕੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aapaa pad nirabaan na cheenhiaa in bidh abhiu na chooke ||2||
english: He does not realize the dignity of the self, and Nirvaanaa; because of this, his doubt does not depart. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੀ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਉਪਜੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਭਾਵ ਅਭਾਵ ਬਿਹੂਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kahee na upajai upajee jaanai bhaav abhaav bihoonaa ||
english: The soul is not born, even though he thinks it is born; it is free from birth and death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਦੈ ਅਸਤ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਨਾਸੀ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: udai asat kee man budh naasee tau sadaa sahaj liv leenaa ||3||
english: When the mortal gives up his ideas of birth and death, he remains constantly absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਬਿੰਬੁ ਬਿੰਬ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੀ ਹੈ ਉਦਕ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਬਿਗਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu pratibi(n)b bi(n)b kau milee hai udak ku(n)bh bigaraanaa ||
english: As the reflection of an object blends in the water when the pitcher is broken,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਗੁਣ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer aisaa gun bhram bhaagaa tau man su(n)n samaanaa(n) ||4||1||
english: says Kabeer, just so virtue dispels doubt, and then the soul is absorbed in the profound, absolute Lord. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਜ ਸਾਢੇ ਤੈ ਤੈ ਧੋਤੀਆ ਤਿਹਰੇ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਤਗ ॥
transliteration: gaj saadhe tai tai dhoteeaa tihare paain tag ||
english: They wear loin cloths, three and a half yards long, and triple-wound sacred threads.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਲੀ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਜਪਮਾਲੀਆ ਲੋਟੇ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਬਗ ॥
transliteration: galee jinhaa japamaaleeaa lote hath nibag ||
english: They have rosaries around their necks, and they carry glittering jugs in their hands.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਬਾਨਾਰਸਿ ਕੇ ਠਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: oi har ke sa(n)t na aakheeahi baanaaras ke thag ||1||
english: They are not called Saints of the Lord - they are thugs of Benares. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aise sa(n)t na mo kau bhaavahi ||
english: Such 'saints' are not pleasing to me;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਡਾਲਾ ਸਿਉ ਪੇਡਾ ਗਟਕਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: daalaa siu pedaa gatakaavahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: they eat the trees along with the branches. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਸਨ ਮਾਂਜਿ ਚਰਾਵਹਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਾਠੀ ਧੋਇ ਜਲਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: baasan maa(n)j charaavahi oopar kaathee dhoi jalaavahi ||
english: They wash their pots and pans before putting them on the stove, and they wash the wood before lighting it.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਖੋਦਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੁਇ ਚੂਲੑੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਮਾਣਸ ਖਾਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: basudhaa khod karahi dui choolhe saare maanas khaavahi ||2||
english: They dig up the earth and make two fireplaces, but they eat the whole person! ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਪਰਸ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: oi paapee sadaa phirahi aparaadhee mukhahu aparas kahaavahi ||
english: Those sinners continually wander in evil deeds, while they call themselves touch-nothing saints.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਸਗਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਡੁਬਾਵਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa phirahi abhimaanee sagal kuta(n)b dubaavahi ||3||
english: They wander around forever and ever in their self-conceit, and all their families are drowned. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੈਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jit ko laaiaa tit hee laagaa taise karam kamaavai ||
english: He is attached to that, to which the Lord has attached him, and he acts accordingly.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer jis satigur bhetai punarap janam na aavai ||4||2||
english: Says Kabeer, one who meets the True Guru, is not reincarnated again. ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਪਿ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਮੇਰੋ ਕੀਨੑਾ ॥
transliteration: baap dilaasaa mero keenhaa ||
english: My Father has comforted me. He has given me a cozy bed,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥
transliteration: sej sukhaalee mukh a(n)mrit deenhaa ||
english: And placed His Ambrosial Nectar in my mouth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਪ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tis baap kau kiu manahu visaaree ||
english: How could I forget that Father from my mind?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਨ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aagai gaiaa na baajee haaree ||1||
english: When I go to the world hereafter, I shall not lose the game. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਹਉ ਖਰਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: muee meree maaee hau kharaa sukhaalaa ||
english: Maya is dead, O mother, and I am very happy.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰਉ ਨਹੀ ਦਗਲੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pahirau nahee dagalee lagai na paalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I do not wear the patched coat, nor do I feel the chill. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਪੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bal tis baapai jin hau jaaiaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Father, who gave me life.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚਾ ਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)chaa te meraa sa(n)g chukaaiaa ||
english: He put an end to my association with the five deadly sins.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਾਵਾ ਤਲਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch maar paavaa tal deene ||
english: I have conquered those five demons, and trampled them underfoot.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har simaran meraa man tan bheene ||2||
english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, my mind and body are drenched with His Love. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਵਡ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: pitaa hamaaro vad gosaaee ||
english: My Father is the Great Lord of the Universe.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਹਿ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tis pitaa pahi hau kiu kar jaaee ||
english: How shall I go to that Father?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਤ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur mile ta maarag dikhaaiaa ||
english: When I met the True Guru, He showed me the Way.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jagat pitaa merai man bhaaiaa ||3||
english: The Father of the Universe is pleasing to my mind. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਪੂਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਬਾਪੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hau poot teraa too(n) baap meraa ||
english: I am Your son, and You are my Father.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਠਾਹਰ ਦੁਹਾ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ekai thaahar duhaa baseraa ||
english: We both dwell in the same place.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨਿ ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer jan eko boojhiaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, the Lord's humble servant knows only the One.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: gur prasaad mai sabh kichh soojhiaa ||4||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have come to know everything. ||4||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਪਤਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਉਰਕਟ ਕੁਰਕਟ ਇਕਤੁ ਪਤਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ikat patar bhar urakat kurakat ikat patar bhar paanee ||
english: In one pot, they put a boiled chicken, and in the other pot, they put wine.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਪੰਚ ਜੋਗੀਆ ਬੈਠੇ ਬੀਚਿ ਨਕਟ ਦੇ ਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aas paas pa(n)ch jogeeaa baithe beech nakat de raanee ||1||
english: The five Yogis of the Tantric ritual sit there, and in their midst sits the noseless one, the shameless queen. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਕਟੀ ਕੋ ਠਨਗਨੁ ਬਾਡਾ ਡੂੰ ॥
transliteration: nakatee ko thanagan baadaa doo(n) ||
english: The bell of the shameless queen, Maya, rings in both worlds.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kinahi bibekee kaatee too(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Some rare person of discriminating wisdom has cut off your nose. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਕਟੀ ਕਾ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਾਰਿ ਅਉਹੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sagal maahi nakatee kaa vaasaa sagal maar auheree ||
english: Within all dwells the noseless Maya, who kills all, and destroys them.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲਿਆ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਬਹਿਨ ਭਾਨਜੀ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਬਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sagaliaa kee hau bahin bhaanajee jinahi baree tis cheree ||2||
english: She says, "I am the sister, and the daughter of the sister of everyone; I am the hand-maiden of one who marries me." ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੋ ਭਰਤਾ ਬਡੋ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੰਤੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hamaro bharataa bado bibekee aape sa(n)t kahaavai ||
english: My Husband is the Great One of discriminating wisdom; He alone is called a Saint.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਕਾਇਮੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਹਮਰੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ohu hamaarai maathai kaaim aur hamarai nikat na aavai ||3||
english: He stands by me, and no one else comes near me. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਕਹੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਾਨਹੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੂਟਿ ਕੈ ਡਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: naakahu kaatee kaanahu kaatee kaat koot kai daaree ||
english: I have cut off her nose, and cut off her ears, and cutting her into bits, I have expelled her.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਬੈਰਨਿ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer sa(n)tan kee bairan teen lok kee piaaree ||4||4||
english: Says Kabeer, she is the darling of the three worlds, but the enemy of the Saints. ||4||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਬਹੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਭ੍ਰਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jogee jatee tapee sa(n)niaasee bahu teerath bhramanaa ||
english: The Yogis, celibates, penitents and Sannyaasees make pilgrimages to all the sacred places.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੁੰਜਿਤ ਮੁੰਜਿਤ ਮੋਨਿ ਜਟਾਧਰ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lu(n)jit mu(n)jit mon jataadhar a(n)t taoo maranaa ||1||
english: The Jains with shaven heads, the silent ones, the beggars with matted hair - in the end, they all shall die. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸੇਵੀਅਲੇ ਰਾਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: taa te seveeale raamanaa ||
english: Meditate, therefore, on the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਜਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa raam naam hit jaa kai kahaa karai jamanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: What can the Messenger of Death do to one whose tongue loves the Name of the Lord? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਗਮ ਨਿਰਗਮ ਜੋਤਿਕ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਆਕਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aagam niragam jotik jaanahi bahu bahu biaakaranaa ||
english: Those who know the Shaastras and the Vedas, astrology and the rules of grammar of many languages;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੰਤ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ ਅਉਖਧ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ta(n)t ma(n)tr sabh aukhadh jaanahi a(n)t taoo maranaa ||2||
english: those who know Tantras and mantras and all medicines - even they shall die in the end. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਬਹੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਰਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: raaj bhog ar chhatr si(n)ghaasan bahu su(n)dar ramanaa ||
english: Those who enjoy regal power and rule, royal canopies and thrones, many beautiful women,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਨ ਕਪੂਰ ਸੁਬਾਸਕ ਚੰਦਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paan kapoor subaasak cha(n)dan a(n)t taoo maranaa ||3||
english: betel nuts, camphor and fragrant sandalwood oil - in the end, they too shall die. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਭ ਖੋਜੇ ਕਹੂ ਨ ਊਬਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan si(n)mrit sabh khoje kahoo na oobaranaa ||
english: I have searched all the Vedas, Puraanas and Simritees, but none of these can save anyone.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਉ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜੰਪਉ ਮੇਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer iu raamahi ja(n)pau met janam maranaa ||4||5||
english: Says Kabeer, meditate on the Lord, and eliminate birth and death. ||4||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਫੀਲੁ ਰਬਾਬੀ ਬਲਦੁ ਪਖਾਵਜ ਕਊਆ ਤਾਲ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: pheel rabaabee balad pakhaavaj kaooaa taal bajaavai ||
english: The elephant is the guitar player, the ox is the drummer, and the crow plays the cymbals.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰਿ ਚੋਲਨਾ ਗਦਹਾ ਨਾਚੈ ਭੈਸਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pahir cholanaa gadahaa naachai bhaisaa bhagat karaavai ||1||
english: Putting on the skirt, the donkey dances around, and the water buffalo performs devotional worship. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕਕਰੀਆ ਬਰੇ ਪਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: raajaa raam kakareeaa bare pakaae ||
english: The Lord, the King, has cooked the cakes of ice,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰੈ ਖਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kinai boojhanahaarai khaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: but only the rare man of understanding eats them. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੈਠਿ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਨ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਘੀਸ ਗਲਉਰੇ ਲਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: baith si(n)gh ghar paan lagaavai ghees galaure liaavai ||
english: Sitting in his den, the lion prepares the betel leaves, and the muskrat brings the betel nuts.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੁਸਰੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਛੂਆ ਸੰਖੁ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghar ghar musaree ma(n)gal gaavahi kachhooaa sa(n)kh bajaavai ||2||
english: Going from house to house, the mouse sings the songs of joy, and the turtle blows on the conch-shell. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੰਸ ਕੋ ਪੂਤੁ ਬੀਆਹਨ ਚਲਿਆ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਛਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)s ko poot beeaahan chaliaa suine ma(n)dap chhaae ||
english: The son of the sterile woman goes to get married, and the golden canopy is spread out for him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਬੇਧੀ ਸਸੈ ਸਿੰਘ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: roop ka(n)niaa su(n)dar bedhee sasai si(n)gh gun gaae ||3||
english: He marries a beautiful and enticing young woman; the rabbit and the lion sing their praises. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੀਟੀ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu keetee parabat khaaiaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - the ant has eaten the mountain.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਛੂਆ ਕਹੈ ਅੰਗਾਰ ਭਿ ਲੋਰਉ ਲੂਕੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: kachhooaa kahai a(n)gaar bh lorau lookee sabad sunaaiaa ||4||6||
english: The turtle says, "I need a burning coal, also." Listen to this mystery of the Shabad. ||4||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਟੂਆ ਏਕੁ ਬਹਤਰਿ ਆਧਾਰੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: batooaa ek bahatar aadhaaree eko jisahi duaaraa ||
english: The body is a bag with seventy-two chambers, and one opening, the Tenth Gate.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਵੈ ਖੰਡ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਮਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਗਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: navai kha(n)d kee prithamee maagai so jogee jag saaraa ||1||
english: He alone is a real Yogi on this earth, who asks for the primal world of the nine regions. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aisaa jogee nau nidh paavai ||
english: Such a Yogi obtains the nine treasures.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਲ ਕਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੇ ਗਗਨਿ ਚਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tal kaa braham le gagan charaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He lifts his soul up from below, to the skies of the Tenth Gate. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਈ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਾਗਾ ਮਥਿ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: khi(n)thaa giaan dhiaan kar sooee sabad taagaa math ghaalai ||
english: He makes spiritual wisdom his patched coat, and meditation his needle. He twists the thread of the Word of the Shabad.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਰਗਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch tat kee kar miragaanee gur kai maarag chaalai ||2||
english: Making the five elements his deer skin to sit on, he walks on the Guru's Path. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਫਾਹੁਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਧੂਈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: daiaa phaahuree kaaiaa kar dhooee drisat kee agan jalaavai ||
english: He makes compassion his shovel, his body the firewood, and he kindles the fire of divine vision.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਾਉ ਲਏ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis kaa bhaau lae rid a(n)tar chahu jug taaRee laavai ||3||
english: He places love within his heart, and he remains in deep meditation throughout the four ages. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਜੋਗਤਣ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh jogatan raam naam hai jis kaa pi(n)d paraanaa ||
english: All Yoga is in the Name of the Lord; the body and the breath of life belong to Him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer je kirapaa dhaarai dei sachaa neesaanaa ||4||7||
english: Says Kabeer, if God grants His Grace, He bestows the insignia of Truth. ||4||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਏ ਕਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hi(n)doo turak kahaa te aae kin eh raah chalaaee ||
english: Where have the Hindus and Muslims come from? Who put them on their different paths?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਚਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕਵਾਦੇ ਭਿਸਤ ਦੋਜਕ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dil mahi soch bichaar kavaade bhisat dojak kin paaee ||1||
english: Think of this, and contemplate it within your mind, O men of evil intentions. Who will go to heaven and hell? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਤੈ ਕਵਨ ਕਤੇਬ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kaajee tai kavan kateb bakhaanee ||
english: O Qazi, which book have you read?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੜ੍ਹਤ ਗੁਨਤ ਐਸੇ ਸਭ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paRhat gunat aise sabh maare kinahoo(n) khabar na jaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Such scholars and students have all died, and none of them have discovered the inner meaning. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਕਤਿ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਕਰੀਐ ਮੈ ਨ ਬਦਉਗਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sakat sanehu kar su(n)nat kareeai mai na badaugaa bhaaee ||
english: Because of the love of woman, circumcision is done; I don't believe in it, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੁਰਕੁ ਕਰੈਗਾ ਆਪਨ ਹੀ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jau re khudaai mohi turak karaigaa aapan hee kat jaaee ||2||
english: If God wished me to be a Muslim, it would be cut off by itself. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਕੀਏ ਤੁਰਕੁ ਜੇ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਅਉਰਤ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: su(n)nat keee turak je hoigaa aurat kaa kiaa kareeai ||
english: If circumcision makes one a Muslim, then what about a woman?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਰਧ ਸਰੀਰੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਹੀ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aradh sareeree naar na chhodai taa te hi(n)doo hee raheeai ||3||
english: She is the other half of a man's body, and she does not leave him, so he remains a Hindu. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਕਤੇਬ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਜੁਲਮ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: chhaad kateb raam bhaj baure julam karat hai bhaaree ||
english: Give up your holy books, and remember the Lord, you fool, and stop oppressing others so badly.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰੈ ਪਕਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੁਰਕ ਰਹੇ ਪਚਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: kabeerai pakaree tek raam kee turak rahe pachihaaree ||4||8||
english: Kabeer has grasped hold of the Lord's Support, and the Muslims have utterly failed. ||4||8||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੀਵੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਤੀ ਤਬ ਸੂਝੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jab lag tel deeve mukh baatee tab soojhai sabh koee ||
english: As long as the oil and the wick are in the lamp, everything is illuminated.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇਲ ਜਲੇ ਬਾਤੀ ਠਹਰਾਨੀ ਸੂੰਨਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tel jale baatee thaharaanee soo(n)naa ma(n)dar hoee ||1||
english: But when the oil is burnt, the wick goes out, and the mansion becomes desolate. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਬਉਰੇ ਤੁਹਿ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: re baure tuhi gharee na raakhai koee ||
english: O mad-man, no one will keep you, for even a moment.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) raam naam jap soee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditate on the Name of that Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਕਵਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਜੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kaa kee maat pitaa kahu kaa ko kavan purakh kee joee ||
english: Tell me, whose mother is that, whose father is that, and which man has a wife?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ ਕੋਊ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੂਛੈ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghat phoote kooo baat na poochhai kaadhahu kaadhahu hoee ||2||
english: When the pitcher of the body breaks, no one cares for you at all. Everyone says, "Take him away, take him away!" ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਬੈਠੀ ਮਾਤਾ ਰੋਵੈ ਖਟੀਆ ਲੇ ਗਏ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dehuree baithee maataa rovai khateeaa le gae bhaaee ||
english: Sitting on the threshold, his mother cries, and his brothers take away the coffin.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਟ ਛਿਟਕਾਏ ਤਿਰੀਆ ਰੋਵੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: lat chhitakaae tireeaa rovai ha(n)s ikelaa jaaee ||3||
english: Taking down her hair, his wife cries out in sorrow, and the swan-soul departs all alone. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu bhai saagar kai taaee ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints, about the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਬੰਦੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੁਲਮੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਟੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੪॥੯॥ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ
transliteration: is ba(n)de sir julam hot hai jam nahee hatai gusaaee ||4||9|| dutuke
english: This human suffers torture and the Messenger of Death will not leave him alone, O Lord of the World. ||4||9|| Dho-Thukay

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਇਕਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: aasaa sree kabeer jeeu ke chaupade ikatuke ||
english: Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, Chau-Padhay, Ek-Thukay:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sanak sana(n)d a(n)t nahee paaiaa ||
english: Sanak and Sanand, the sons of Brahma, could not find the Lord's limits.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bed paRe paR brahame janam gavaaiaa ||1||
english: Brahma wasted his life away, continually reading the Vedas. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਨਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa bilovanaa bilovahu mere bhaaee ||
english: Churn the churn of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਬਿਲੋਵਹੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sahaj bilovahu jaise tat na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Churn it steadily, so that the essence, the butter, may not be lost. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tan kar matukee man maahi biloee ||
english: Make your body the churning jar, and use the stick of your mind to churn it.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੰਜੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: is matukee mahi sabad sa(n)joee ||2||
english: Gather the curds of the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਨਾ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa bilovanaa man kaa beechaaraa ||
english: The churning of the Lord is to reflect upon Him within your mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur prasaad paavai a(n)mrit dhaaraa ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Ambrosial Nectar flows into us. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਮਂੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer nadar kare je ma(n)eeraa ||
english: Says Kabeer, if the Lord, our King casts His Glance of Grace,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਗਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਤੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
transliteration: raam naam lag utare teeraa ||4||1||10||
english: one is carried across to the other side, holding fast to the Lord's Name. ||4||1||10||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਤੀ ਸੂਕੀ ਤੇਲੁ ਨਿਖੂਟਾ ॥
transliteration: baatee sookee tel nikhootaa ||
english: The wick has dried up, and the oil is exhausted.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਲੁ ਨ ਬਾਜੈ ਨਟੁ ਪੈ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ma(n)dal na baajai nat pai sootaa ||1||
english: The drum does not sound, and the actor has gone to sleep. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਧੂੰਆ ॥
transliteration: bujh gaee agan na nikasio dhoo(n)aa ||
english: The fire has gone out, and no smoke is produced.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rav rahiaa ek avar nahee dooaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The One Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere; there is no other second. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੀ ਤੰਤੁ ਨ ਬਜੈ ਰਬਾਬੁ ॥
transliteration: tootee ta(n)t na bajai rabaab ||
english: The string has broken, and the guitar makes no sound.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਿ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਜੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhool bigaario apanaa kaaj ||2||
english: He mistakenly ruins his own affairs. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਹਨੁ ਕਹਾਵਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kathanee badanee kahan kahaavan ||
english: When one comes to understand,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਮਝਿ ਪਰੀ ਤਉ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਗਾਵਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: samajh paree tau bisario gaavan ||3||
english: He forgets his preaching, ranting and raving, and arguing. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਪੰਚ ਜੋ ਚੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer pa(n)ch jo choore ||
english: Says Kabeer, the state of supreme dignity is never far

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: tin te naahi param pad doore ||4||2||11||
english: From those who conquer the five demons of the body passions. ||4||2||11||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤੁ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ॥
transliteration: sut aparaadh karat hai jete ||
english: As many mistakes as the son commits,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਨਨੀ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਰਾਖਸਿ ਤੇਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jananee cheet na raakhas tete ||1||
english: his mother does not hold them against him in her mind. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਈਆ ਹਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: raamaeeaa hau baarik teraa ||
english: O Lord, I am Your child.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਖੰਡਸਿ ਅਵਗਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaahe na kha(n)das avagan meraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Why not destroy my sins? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: je at krop kare kar dhaaiaa ||
english: If the son, in anger, runs away,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਭੀ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਰਾਖਸਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa bhee cheet na raakhas maaiaa ||2||
english: even then, his mother does not hold it against him in her mind. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤ ਭਵਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: chi(n)t bhavan man pario hamaaraa ||
english: My mind has fallen into the whirlpool of anxiety.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam binaa kaise utaras paaraa ||3||
english: Without the Naam, how can I cross over to the other side? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਿ ਬਿਮਲ ਮਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dehi bimal mat sadaa sareeraa ||
english: Please, bless my body with pure and lasting understanding, Lord;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਨ ਰਵੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
transliteration: sahaj sahaj gun ravai kabeeraa ||4||3||12||
english: in peace and poise, Kabeer chants the Praises of the Lord. ||4||3||12||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਜ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗੋਮਤੀ ਤੀਰ ॥
transliteration: haj hamaaree gomatee teer ||
english: My pilgrimage to Mecca is on the banks of the Gomati River;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਬਸਹਿ ਪੀਤੰਬਰ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jahaa basahi peeta(n)bar peer ||1||
english: the spiritual teacher in his yellow robes dwells there. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਖੂਬੁ ਗਾਵਤਾ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu kiaa khoob gaavataa hai ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Hail! Hail! How wondrously he sings.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਤਾ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam merai man bhaavataa hai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Name of the Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦ ਸਾਰਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: naarad saarad karahi khavaasee ||
english: Naarada the sage, and Shaarada the goddess of knowledge, serve the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਸਿ ਬੈਠੀ ਬੀਬੀ ਕਵਲਾ ਦਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paas baithee beebee kavalaa daasee ||2||
english: The goddess Lakhshmi sits by Him as His slave. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੰਠੇ ਮਾਲਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)the maalaa jihavaa raam ||
english: The mala is around my neck, and the Lord's Name is upon my tongue.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਹੰਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਕਰਉ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saha(n)s naam lai lai karau salaam ||3||
english: I repeat the Naam, the Name of the Lord, a thousand times, and bow in reverence to Him. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
