transliteration: kahat kabeer raam gun gaavau ||
english: Says Kabeer, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਦੋਊ ਸਮਝਾਵਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
transliteration: hi(n)doo turak dooo samajhaavau ||4||4||13||
english: I teach both Hindus and Muslims. ||4||4||13||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ ੯ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ੫ ॥
transliteration: aasaa sree kabeer jeeu ke pa(n)chapade 9 dutuke 5 ||
english: Aasaa, Kabeer Jee, 9 Panch-Padhay, 5 Dho-Thukay:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਤੀ ਤੋਰੈ ਮਾਲਿਨੀ ਪਾਤੀ ਪਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: paatee torai maalinee paatee paatee jeeu ||
english: You tear off the leaves, O gardener, but in each and every leaf, there is life.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਹਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਤੀ ਤੋਰੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਹਨ ਨਿਰਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis paahan kau paatee torai so paahan nirajeeu ||1||
english: That stone idol, for which you tear off those leaves - that stone idol is lifeless. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੀ ਮਾਲਨੀ ਹੈ ਏਉ ॥
transliteration: bhoolee maalanee hai eu ||
english: In this, you are mistaken, O gardener.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਗਤਾ ਹੈ ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur jaagataa hai deu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru is the Living Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਾਤੀ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਡਾਰੀ ਫੂਲ ਸੰਕਰਦੇਉ ॥
transliteration: braham paatee bisan daaree phool sa(n)karadeu ||
english: Brahma is in the leaves, Vishnu is in the branches, and Shiva is in the flowers.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਪ੍ਰਤਖਿ ਤੋਰਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: teen dev pratakh torahi karahi kis kee seu ||2||
english: When you break these three gods, whose service are you performing? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖਾਨ ਗਢਿ ਕੈ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਛਾਤੀ ਪਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paakhaan gadh kai moorat keenhee de kai chhaatee paau ||
english: The sculptor carves the stone and fashions it into an idol, placing his feet upon its chest.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਏਹ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਹੈ ਤਉ ਗੜ੍ਹਣਹਾਰੇ ਖਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je eh moorat saachee hai tau gaRhanahaare khaau ||3||
english: If this stone god was true, it would devour the sculptor for this! ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਾਤੁ ਪਹਿਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਲਾਪਸੀ ਕਰਕਰਾ ਕਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhaat pahit ar laapasee karakaraa kaasaar ||
english: Rice and beans, candies, cakes and cookies

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭੋਗਨਹਾਰੇ ਭੋਗਿਆ ਇਸੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bhoganahaare bhogiaa is moorat ke mukh chhaar ||4||
english: - the priest enjoys these, while he puts ashes into the mouth of the idol. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲਿਨਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਜਗੁ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ਹਮ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: maalin bhoolee jag bhulaanaa ham bhulaane naahi ||
english: The gardener is mistaken, and the world is mistaken, but I am not mistaken.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਖੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੪॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer ham raam raakhe kripaa kar har raai ||5||1||14||
english: Says Kabeer, the Lord preserves me; the Lord, my King, has showered His Blessings upon me. ||5||1||14||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਬਰਸ ਬਾਲਪਨ ਬੀਤੇ ਬੀਸ ਬਰਸ ਕਛੁ ਤਪੁ ਨ ਕੀਓ ॥
transliteration: baarah baras baalapan beete bees baras kachh tap na keeo ||
english: Twelve years pass in childhood, and for another twenty years, he does not practice self-discipline and austerity.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੀਸ ਬਰਸ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਵ ਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tees baras kachh dev na poojaa phir pachhutaanaa biradh bhaio ||1||
english: For another thirty years, he does not worship God in any way, and then, when he is old, he repents and regrets. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਓ ॥
transliteration: meree meree karate janam gaio ||
english: His life wastes away as he cries out, "Mine, mine!"

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਇਰੁ ਸੋਖਿ ਭੁਜੰ ਬਲਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saair sokh bhuja(n) balaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The pool of his power has dried up. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੂਕੇ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਪਾਲਿ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ਲੂਣੈ ਖੇਤਿ ਹਥ ਵਾਰਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sooke saravar paal ba(n)dhaavai loonai khet hath vaar karai ||
english: He makes a dam around the dried-up pool, and with his hands, he makes a fence around the harvested field.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਇਓ ਚੋਰੁ ਤੁਰੰਤਹ ਲੇ ਗਇਓ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਖਤ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਫਿਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aaio chor tura(n)tah le gaio meree raakhat mugadh phirai ||2||
english: When the thief of Death comes, he quickly carries away what the fool had tried to preserve as his own. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸੀਸੁ ਕਰ ਕੰਪਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਨੈਨੀ ਨੀਰੁ ਅਸਾਰ ਬਹੈ ॥
transliteration: charan sees kar ka(n)pan laage nainee neer asaar bahai ||
english: His feet and head and hands begin to tremble, and the tears flow copiously from his eyes.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਤਬ ਰੇ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jihavaa bachan sudh nahee nikasai tab re dharam kee aas karai ||3||
english: His tongue has not spoken the correct words, but now, he hopes to practice religion! ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਓ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu kripaa karai liv laavai laahaa har har naam leeo ||
english: If the Dear Lord shows His Mercy, one enshrines love for Him, and obtains the Profit of the Lord's Name.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਅੰਤੇ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲਿਓ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har dhan paaio a(n)te chaladiaa naal chalio ||4||
english: By Guru's Grace, he receives the wealth of the Lord's Name, which alone shall go with him, when he departs in the end. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਛੂਐ ਲੈ ਨ ਗਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu an dhan kachhooai lai na gaio ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - he shall not take any other wealth with him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਈ ਤਲਬ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੰਦਰ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਓ ॥੫॥੨॥੧੫॥
transliteration: aaee talab gopaal raai kee maaiaa ma(n)dar chhod chalio ||5||2||15||
english: When the summons comes from the King, the Lord of the Universe, the mortal departs, leaving behind his wealth and mansions. ||5||2||15||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਦੀਨੑੇ ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਲਘ ਨਿਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo deenhe paat pata(n)bar kaahoo palagh nivaaraa ||
english: To some, the Lord has given silks and satins, and to some, beds decorated with cotton ribbons.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਗਰੀ ਗੋਦਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਖਾਨ ਪਰਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaahoo garee godaree naahee kaahoo khaan paraaraa ||1||
english: Some do not even have a poor patched coat, and some live in thatched huts. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਰਖ ਵਾਦੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੇ ਮਨ ॥
transliteration: ahirakh vaad na keejai re man ||
english: Do not indulge in envy and bickering, O my mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਰੇ ਮਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukrit kar kar leejai re man ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By continually doing good deeds, these are obtained, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੁਮੑਾਰੈ ਏਕ ਜੁ ਮਾਟੀ ਗੂੰਧੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਨੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kumhaarai ek j maatee goo(n)dhee bahu bidh baanee laaee ||
english: The potter works the same clay, and colors the pots in different ways.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਮੋਤੀ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaahoo mahi motee mukataahal kaahoo biaadh lagaaee ||2||
english: Into some, he sets pearls, while to others, he attaches filth. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੂਮਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਕਹੈ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: soomahi dhan raakhan kau deeaa mugadh kahai dhan meraa ||
english: God gave wealth to the miser for him to preserve, but the fool calls it his own.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਮੂੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jam kaa da(n)d moo(n)d mahi laagai khin mahi karai niberaa ||3||
english: When the Messenger of Death strikes him with his club, in an instant, everything is settled. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਸਦਾਵੈ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har jan ootam bhagat sadaavai aagiaa man sukh paaee ||
english: The Lord's humble servant is called the most exalted Saint; he obeys the Command of the Lord's Order, and obtains peace.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai sat kar maanai bhaanaa ma(n)n vasaaee ||4||
english: Whatever is pleasing to the Lord, he accepts as True; he enshrines the Lord's Will within his mind. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਝੂਠੀ ॥
transliteration: kahai kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu meree meree jhoothee ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - it is false to call out, "Mine, mine."

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਿਰਗਟ ਫਾਰਿ ਚਟਾਰਾ ਲੈ ਗਇਓ ਤਰੀ ਤਾਗਰੀ ਛੂਟੀ ॥੫॥੩॥੧੬॥
transliteration: chiragat phaar chataaraa lai gaio taree taagaree chhootee ||5||3||16||
english: Breaking the bird cage, death takes the bird away, and only the torn threads remain. ||5||3||16||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਬੰਦੇ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ham masakeen khudaaee ba(n)de tum raajas man bhaavai ||
english: I am Your humble servant, Lord; Your Praises are pleasing to my mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਲਹ ਅਵਲਿ ਦੀਨ ਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜੋਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: alah aval deen ko saahib jor nahee phuramaavai ||1||
english: The Lord, the Primal Being, the Master of the poor, does not ordain that they should be oppressed. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਬਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaajee boliaa ban nahee aavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Qazi, it is not right to speak before Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੋਜਾ ਧਰੈ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰੈ ਕਲਮਾ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: rojaa dharai nivaaj gujaarai kalamaa bhisat na hoee ||
english: Keeping your fasts, reciting your prayers, and reading the Kalma, the Islamic creed, shall not take you to paradise.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਤਰਿ ਕਾਬਾ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satar kaabaa ghat hee bheetar je kar jaanai koee ||2||
english: The Temple of Mecca is hidden within your mind, if you only knew it. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਵਾਜ ਸੋਈ ਜੋ ਨਿਆਉ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ਕਲਮਾ ਅਕਲਹਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: nivaaj soee jo niaau bichaarai kalamaa akalahi jaanai ||
english: That should be your prayer, to administer justice. Let your Kalma be the knowledge of the unknowable Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਚਹੁ ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਲਾ ਬਿਛਾਵੈ ਤਬ ਤਉ ਦੀਨੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paachahu mus musalaa bichhaavai tab tau deen pachhaanai ||3||
english: Spread your prayer mat by conquering your five desires, and you shall recognize the true religion. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਿ ਤਰਸ ਕਰਿ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਫੀਕੀ ॥
transliteration: khasam pachhaan taras kar jee mahi maar manee kar pheekee ||
english: Recognize Your Lord and Master, and fear Him within your heart; conquer your egotism, and make it worthless.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਜਨਾਇ ਅਵਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਬ ਹੋਇ ਭਿਸਤ ਸਰੀਕੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aap janaai avar kau jaanai tab hoi bhisat sareekee ||4||
english: As you see yourself, see others as well; only then will you become a partner in heaven. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਏਕ ਭੇਖ ਧਰਿ ਨਾਨਾ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: maatee ek bhekh dhar naanaa taa mahi braham pachhaanaa ||
english: The clay is one, but it has taken many forms; I recognize the One Lord within them all.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਭਿਸਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਜਕ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੫॥੪॥੧੭॥
transliteration: kahai kabeeraa bhisat chhod kar dojak siu man maanaa ||5||4||17||
english: Says Kabeer, I have abandoned paradise, and reconciled my mind to hell. ||5||4||17||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਗਨ ਨਗਰਿ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨ ਬਰਖੈ ਨਾਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਜੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: gagan nagar ik boo(n)d na barakhai naad kahaa j samaanaa ||
english: From the city of the Tenth Gate, the sky of the mind, not even a drop rains down. Where is the music of the sound current of the Naad, which was contained in it?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਮਾਧੋ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸੁ ਲੇ ਸਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paarabraham paramesur maadho param ha(n)s le sidhaanaa ||1||
english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the Master of wealth has taken away the Supreme Soul. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਬੋਲਤੇ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਗਏ ਦੇਹੀ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
transliteration: baabaa bolate te kahaa gae dehee ke sa(n)g rahate ||
english: O Father, tell me: where has it gone? It used to dwell within the body,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਨਿਰਤੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਥਾ ਬਾਰਤਾ ਕਹਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: surat maahi jo nirate karate kathaa baarataa kahate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and dance in the mind, teaching and speaking. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਜਾਵਨਹਾਰੋ ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਕੀਨੑਾ ॥
transliteration: bajaavanahaaro kahaa gaio jin ihu ma(n)dar keenhaa ||
english: Where has the player gone - he who made this temple his own?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਖੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਖਿੰਚਿ ਤੇਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਲੀਨੑਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saakhee sabad surat nahee upajai khi(n)ch tej sabh leenhaa ||2||
english: No story, word or understanding is produced; the Lord has drained off all the power. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਏ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ ਥਾਕਾ ॥
transliteration: sravanan bikal bhae sa(n)g tere i(n)dree kaa bal thaakaa ||
english: The ears, your companions, have gone deaf, and the power of your organs is exhausted.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਰਹੇ ਕਰ ਢਰਕਿ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਨ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਬਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: charan rahe kar dharak pare hai mukhahu na nikasai baataa ||3||
english: Your feet have failed, your hands have gone limp, and no words issue forth from your mouth. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਥਾਕੇ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸਭ ਤਸਕਰ ਆਪ ਆਪਣੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ॥
transliteration: thaake pa(n)ch doot sabh tasakar aap aapanai bhramate ||
english: Having grown weary, the five enemies and all the thieves have wandered away according to their own will.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਥਾਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਉਰੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਤੇਜੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਧਰਿ ਰਮਤੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: thaakaa man ku(n)char ur thaakaa tej soot dhar ramate ||4||
english: The elephant of the mind has grown weary, and the heart has grown weary as well; through its power, it used to pull the strings. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਭਏ ਦਸੈ ਬੰਦ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਭਾਈ ਸਭ ਛੋਰੇ ॥
transliteration: miratak bhae dasai ba(n)d chhoote mitr bhaaee sabh chhore ||
english: He is dead, and the bonds of the ten gates are opened; he has left all his friends and brothers.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਜੀਵਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰੇ ॥੫॥੫॥੧੮॥
transliteration: kahat kabeeraa jo har dhiaavai jeevat ba(n)dhan tore ||5||5||18||
english: Says Kabeer, one who meditates on the Lord, breaks his bonds, even while yet alive. ||5||5||18||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਇਕਤੁਕੇ ੪ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ikatuke 4 ||
english: Aasaa, 4 Ek-Thukay:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਰਪਨੀ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sarapanee te oopar nahee baleeaa ||
english: No one is more powerful than the she-serpent Maya,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਛਲੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin brahamaa bisan mahaadeu chhaleeaa ||1||
english: who deceived even Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੁ ਮਾਰੁ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲਿ ਪੈਠੀ ॥
transliteration: maar maar srapanee niramal jal paithee ||
english: Having bitten and struck them down, she now sits in the immaculate waters.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਡਸੀਅਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਡੀਠੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin tribhavan daseeale gur prasaad deethee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have seen her, who has bitten the three worlds. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: srapanee srapanee kiaa kahahu bhaaee ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, why is she called a she-serpent?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin saach pachhaaniaa tin srapanee khaaee ||2||
english: One who realizes the True Lord, devours the she-serpent. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਤੇ ਆਨ ਛੂਛ ਨਹੀ ਅਵਰਾ ॥
transliteration: srapanee te aan chhoochh nahee avaraa ||
english: No one else is more frivolous than this she-serpent.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਜੀਤੀ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਜਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: srapanee jeetee kahaa karai jamaraa ||3||
english: When the she-serpent is overcome, what can the Messengers of the King of Death do? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ih srapanee taa kee keetee hoee ||
english: This she-serpent is created by Him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਲੁ ਅਬਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bal abal kiaa is te hoee ||4||
english: What power or weakness does she have by herself? ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਸਤੀ ਤਾ ਬਸਤ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ih basatee taa basat sareeraa ||
english: If she abides with the mortal, then his soul abides in his body.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਤਰੇ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥੧੯॥
transliteration: gur prasaad sahaj tare kabeeraa ||5||6||19||
english: By Guru's Grace, Kabeer has easily crossed over. ||5||6||19||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁਆਨ ਕਉ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੁਨਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kahaa suaan kau simrit sunaae ||
english: Why bother to read the Simritees to a dog?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਪਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahaa saakat pahi har gun gaae ||1||
english: Why bother to sing the Lord's Praises to the faithless cynic? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਮੇ ਰਮਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: raam raam raam rame ram raheeai ||
english: Remain absorbed in the Lord's Name, Raam, Raam, Raam.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਭੂਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saakat siu bhool nahee kaheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Do not bother to speak of it to the faithless cynic, even by mistake. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਊਆ ਕਹਾ ਕਪੂਰ ਚਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaooaa kahaa kapoor charaae ||
english: Why offer camphor to a crow?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹ ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਕਉ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kah biseear kau doodh peeaae ||2||
english: Why give the snake milk to drink? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mil bibek budh hoee ||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, discriminating understanding is attained.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਲੋਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paaras paras lohaa ka(n)chan soee ||3||
english: That iron which touches the Philosopher's Stone becomes gold. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saakat suaan sabh kare karaaiaa ||
english: The dog, the faithless cynic, does everything as the Lord causes him to do.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa s karam kamaaiaa ||4||
english: He does the deeds pre-ordained from the very beginning. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਨੀਮੁ ਸਿੰਚਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit lai lai neem si(n)chaaee ||
english: If you take Ambrosial Nectar and irrigate the neem tree with it,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥੭॥੨੦॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer uaa ko sahaj na jaaee ||5||7||20||
english: still, says Kabeer, its natural qualities are not changed. ||5||7||20||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੰਕਾ ਸਾ ਕੋਟੁ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸੀ ਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: la(n)kaa saa kot samu(n)d see khaaee ||
english: A fortress like that of Sri Lanka, with the ocean as a moat around it

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਰਾਵਨ ਘਰ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tih raavan ghar khabar na paaee ||1||
english: - there is no news about that house of Raavan. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa maagau kichh thir na rahaaee ||
english: What shall I ask for? Nothing is permanent.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਤ ਨੈਨ ਚਲਿਓ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dekhat nain chalio jag jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I see with my eyes that the world is passing away. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਲਖੁ ਪੂਤ ਸਵਾ ਲਖੁ ਨਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: ik lakh poot savaa lakh naatee ||
english: Thousands of sons and thousands of grandsons

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਰਾਵਨ ਘਰ ਦੀਆ ਨ ਬਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tih raavan ghar deeaa na baatee ||2||
english: - but in that house of Raavan, the lamps and wicks have gone out. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਤਪਤ ਰਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)d sooraj jaa ke tapat rasoee ||
english: The moon and the sun cooked his food.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕਪਰੇ ਧੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: baisa(n)tar jaa ke kapare dhoee ||3||
english: The fire washed his clothes. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਬਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramat raamai naam basaaee ||
english: Under Guru's Instructions, one whose mind is filled with the Lord's Name,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: asathir rahai na katahoo(n) jaaee ||4||
english: becomes permanent, and does not go anywhere. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re loee ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, people:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੮॥੨੧॥
transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na hoee ||5||8||21||
english: without the Lord's Name, no one is liberated. ||5||8||21||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਪੂਤੁ ਪਿਛੈਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: pahilaa poot pichhairee maaee ||
english: First, the son was born, and then, his mother.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਚੇਲੇ ਕੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur laago chele kee paaee ||1||
english: The guru falls at the feet of the disciple. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਅਚੰਭਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ek acha(n)bhau sunahu tumh bhaaee ||
english: Listen to this wonderful thing, O Siblings of Destiny!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਤ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dekhat si(n)gh charaavat gaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I saw the lion herding the cows. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤਰਵਰਿ ਬਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jal kee machhulee taravar biaaee ||
english: The fish of the water gives birth upon a tree.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਤ ਕੁਤਰਾ ਲੈ ਗਈ ਬਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dekhat kutaraa lai gaee bilaaee ||2||
english: I saw a cat carrying away a dog. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਲੈ ਰੇ ਬੈਸਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਸੂਲਾ ॥
transliteration: talai re baisaa oopar soolaa ||
english: The branches are below, and the roots are above.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪੇਡਿ ਲਗੇ ਫਲ ਫੂਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis kai ped lage phal phoolaa ||3||
english: The trunk of that tree bears fruits and flowers. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘੋਰੈ ਚਰਿ ਭੈਸ ਚਰਾਵਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ghorai char bhais charaavan jaaee ||
english: Riding a horse, the buffalo takes him out to graze.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬੈਲੁ ਗੋਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: baahar bail gon ghar aaee ||4||
english: The bull is away, while his load has come home. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੁ ਇਸ ਪਦ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer j is pad boojhai ||
english: Says Kabeer, one who understands this hymn,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੫॥੯॥੨੨॥
transliteration: raam ramat tis sabh kichh soojhai ||5||9||22||
english: and chants the Lord's Name, comes to understand everything. ||5||9||22||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਈਸ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਤਥਾ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ
transliteration: baaees chaupade tathaa pa(n)chapade
english: 22 Chau-Padhay And Panch-Padhay

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਤਿਪਦੇ ੮ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ੭ ਇਕਤੁਕਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: aasaa sree kabeer jeeu ke tipade 8 dutuke 7 ikatukaa 1 ||
english: Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, 8 Thri-Padhay, 7 Dho-Thukay, 1 Ik-Tuka:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਤੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕੀਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੁੰਡ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bi(n)d te jin pi(n)d keeaa agan ku(n)d rahaaiaa ||
english: The Lord created the body from sperm, and protected it in the fire pit.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਮਾਸ ਮਾਤਾ ਉਦਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: das maas maataa udar raakhiaa bahur laagee maaiaa ||1||
english: For ten months He preserved you in your mother's womb, and then, after you were born, you became attached to Maya. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਲੋਭਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: praanee kaahe kau lobh laage ratan janam khoiaa ||
english: O mortal, why have you attached yourself to greed, and lost the jewel of life?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮਿ ਬੀਜੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੋਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poorab janam karam bhoom beej naahee boiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You did not plant the seeds of good actions in the earth of your past lives. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਹੋਨਾ ਸੋ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: baarik te biradh bhaiaa honaa so hoiaa ||
english: From an infant, you have grown old. That which was to happen, has happened.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਝੋਟ ਪਕਰੈ ਤਬਹਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਰੋਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa jam aai jhot pakarai tabahi kaahe roiaa ||2||
english: When the Messenger of Death comes and grabs you by your hair, why do you cry out then? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨੈ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੈ ਸਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jeevanai kee aas karahi jam nihaarai saasaa ||
english: You hope for long life, while Death counts your breaths.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜੀਗਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਚੇਤਿ ਢਾਲਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੩॥੧॥੨੩॥
transliteration: baajeegaree sa(n)saar kabeeraa chet dhaal paasaa ||3||1||23||
english: The world is a game, O Kabeer, so throw the dice consciously. ||3||1||23||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਪੁਨ ਰਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਉ ਪਾਚਉ ਤਤ ਬਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: tan rainee man pun rap kar hau paachau tat baraatee ||
english: I make my body the dying vat, and within it, I dye my mind. I make the five elements my marriage guests.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸਿਉ ਭਾਵਰਿ ਲੈਹਉ ਆਤਮ ਤਿਹ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam raai siu bhaavar laihau aatam tih ra(n)g raatee ||1||
english: I take my marriage vows with the Lord, my King; my soul is imbued with His Love. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਾਉ ਗਾਉ ਰੀ ਦੁਲਹਨੀ ਮੰਗਲਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gaau gaau ree dulahanee ma(n)galachaaraa ||
english: Sing, sing, O brides of the Lord, the marriage songs of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mere grih aae raajaa raam bhataaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord, my King, has come to my house as my Husband. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਬੇਦੀ ਰਚਿ ਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naabh kamal mahi bedee rach le braham giaan uchaaraa ||
english: Within the lotus of my heart, I have made my bridal pavilion, and I have spoken the wisdom of God.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸੋ ਦੂਲਹੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਸ ਬਡਭਾਗ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam raai so doolahu paaio as badabhaag hamaaraa ||2||
english: I have obtained the Lord King as my Husband - such is my great good fortune. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਕਉਤਕ ਆਏ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਉਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: sur nar mun jan kautak aae kot tetees ujaanaa(n) ||
english: The angles, holy men, silent sages, and the 330,000,000 deities have come in their heavenly chariots to see this spectacle.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਹਿ ਚਲੇ ਹੈ ਪੁਰਖ ਏਕ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥੨॥੨੪॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer mohi biaahi chale hai purakh ek bhagavaanaa ||3||2||24||
english: Says Kabeer, I have been taken in marriage by the One Supreme Being, the Lord God. ||3||2||24||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਸਸੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੇਠ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਡਰਉ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saas kee dukhee sasur kee piaaree jeth ke naam darau re ||
english: I am bothered by my mother-in-law, Maya, and loved by my father-in-law, the Lord. I fear even the name of my husband's elder brother, Death.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਨਨਦ ਗਹੇਲੀ ਦੇਵਰ ਕੈ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਜਰਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sakhee sahelee nanad gahelee devar kai birahi jarau re ||1||
english: O my mates and companions, my husband's sister, misunderstanding has seized me, and I am burning with the pain of separation from my husband's younger brother, divine knowledge. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਬਉਰੀ ਮੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਰਹਉ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: meree mat bauree mai raam bisaario kin bidh rahan rahau re ||
english: My mind has gone insane, since I forgot the Lord. How can I lead a virtuous lifestyle?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜੈ ਰਮਤੁ ਨੈਨ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖਉ ਇਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾ ਸਉ ਕਹਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sejai ramat nain nahee pekhau ihu dukh kaa sau kahau re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He rests in the bed of my mind, but I cannot see Him with my eyes. Unto whom should I tell my sufferings? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਪੁ ਸਾਵਕਾ ਕਰੈ ਲਰਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਦ ਮਤਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: baap saavakaa karai laraaee maaiaa sad matavaaree ||
english: My step-father, egotism, fights with me, and my mother, desire, is always intoxicated.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਡੇ ਭਾਈ ਕੈ ਜਬ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਬ ਹਉ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bade bhaaee kai jab sa(n)g hotee tab hau naah piaaree ||2||
english: When I stayed with my elder brother, meditation, then I was loved by my Husband Lord. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਪੰਚ ਕੋ ਝਗਰਾ ਝਗਰਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer pa(n)ch ko jhagaraa jhagarat janam gavaaiaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, the five passions argue with me, and in these arguments, my life is wasting away.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥੨੫॥
transliteration: jhoothee maaiaa sabh jag baadhiaa mai raam ramat sukh paaiaa ||3||3||25||
english: The false Maya has bound the whole world, but I have obtained peace, chanting the Name of the Lord. ||3||3||25||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਤੁ ਤਨਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਤਾਨਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਨੇਊ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ham ghar soot tanahi nit taanaa ka(n)th janeoo tumaare ||
english: In my house, I constantly weave the thread, while you wear the thread around your neck, O Brahmin.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਤਉ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹੁ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tumh tau bed paRahu gaaitree gobi(n)d ridai hamaare ||1||
english: You read the Vedas and sacred hymns, while I have enshrined the Lord of the Universe in my heart. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਨੈਨ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਹਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: meree jihabaa bisan nain naaraain hiradai basahi gobi(n)daa ||
english: Upon my tongue, within my eyes, and within my heart, abides the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰ ਜਬ ਪੂਛਸਿ ਬਵਰੇ ਤਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਸਿ ਮੁਕੰਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jam duaar jab poochhas bavare tab kiaa kahas muka(n)daa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When you are interrogated at Death's door, O mad-man, what will you say then? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਗੋਰੂ ਤੁਮ ਗੁਆਰ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ham goroo tum guaar gusaaee janam janam rakhavaare ||
english: I am a cow, and You are the herdsman, the Sustainer of the World. You are my Saving Grace, lifetime after lifetime.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਚਰਾਇਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kabahoo(n) na paar utaar charaaihu kaise khasam hamaare ||2||
english: You have never taken me across to graze there - what sort of a herdsman are You? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਬਾਮੑਨੁ ਮੈ ਕਾਸੀਕ ਜੁਲਹਾ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਮੋਰ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) baamhn mai kaaseek julahaa boojhahu mor giaanaa ||
english: You are a Brahmin, and I am a weaver of Benares; can You understand my wisdom?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਤਉ ਜਾਚੇ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਉ ਮੋਰ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥੩॥੪॥੨੬॥
transliteration: tumh tau jaache bhoopat raaje har sau mor dhiaanaa ||3||4||26||
english: You beg from emperors and kings, while I meditate on the Lord. ||3||4||26||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਜੈਸਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੁਪਨ ਸਮਾਨੰ ॥
transliteration: jag jeevan aisaa supane jaisaa jeevan supan samaana(n) ||
english: The life of the world is only a dream; life is just a dream.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਗਾਠਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saach kar ham gaath deenee chhod param nidhaana(n) ||1||
english: Believing it to be true, I grasped at it, and abandoned the supreme treasure. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਹਿਤੁ ਕੀਨੑ ॥
transliteration: baabaa maaiaa moh hit keenh ||
english: O Father, I have enshrined love and affection for Maya,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੀਨੑ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin giaan ratan hir leenh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: which has taken the jewel of spiritual wisdom away from me. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਉਰਝੈ ਪਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਗਿ ॥
transliteration: nain dekh pata(n)g urajhai pas na dekhai aag ||
english: The moth sees with its eyes, but it still becomes entangled; the insect does not see the fire.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਨ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਚੇਤੈ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨਿ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaal phaas na mugadh chetai kanik kaamin laag ||2||
english: Attached to gold and woman, the fool does not think of the noose of Death. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kar bichaar bikaar parahar taran taaran soi ||
english: Reflect upon this, and abandon sin; the Lord is a boat to carry you across.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਦੁਤੀਅ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥੫॥੨੭॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer jagajeevan aisaa dutee naahee koi ||3||5||27||
english: Says Kabeer, such is the Lord, the Life of the World; there is no one equal to Him. ||3||5||27||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਰੂਪ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਅਬ ਫੁਨਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jau mai roop keee bahutere ab phun roop na hoee ||
english: In the past, I have taken many forms, but I shall not take form again.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾਗਾ ਤੰਤੁ ਸਾਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਸਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taagaa ta(n)t saaj sabh thaakaa raam naam bas hoee ||1||
english: The strings and wires of the musical instrument are worn out, and I am in the power of the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਚਨੋ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ab mohi naachano na aavai ||
english: Now, I no longer dance to the tune.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਰੀਆ ਨ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: meraa man ma(n)dareeaa na bajaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind no longer beats the drum. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਲੈ ਜਾਰੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਫੂਟੀ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh maaiaa lai jaaree trisanaa gaagar phootee ||
english: I have burnt away sexual desire, anger and attachment to Maya, and the pitcher of my desires has burst.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਚੋਲਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ਗਇਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਛੂਟੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaam cholanaa bhaiaa hai puraanaa gaiaa bharam sabh chhootee ||2||
english: The gown of sensuous pleasures is worn out, and all my doubts have been dispelled. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਏਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਚੂਕੇ ਬਾਦ ਬਿਬਾਦਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab bhoot ekai kar jaaniaa chooke baad bibaadaa ||
english: I look upon all beings alike, and my conflict and strife are ended.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਏ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਸਾਦਾ ॥੩॥੬॥੨੮॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer mai pooraa paaiaa bhae raam parasaadaa ||3||6||28||
english: Says Kabeer, when the Lord showed His Favor, I obtained Him, the Perfect One. ||3||6||28||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੋਜਾ ਧਰੈ ਮਨਾਵੈ ਅਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਦਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: rojaa dharai manaavai alahu suaadat jee sa(n)ghaarai ||
english: You keep your fasts to please Allah, while you murder other beings for pleasure.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਝਖ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aapaa dekh avar nahee dekhai kaahe kau jhakh maarai ||1||
english: You look after your own interests, and so not see the interests of others. What good is your word? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੋਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਚਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: kaajee saahib ek tohee mahi teraa soch bichaar na dekhai ||
english: O Qazi, the One Lord is within you, but you do not behold Him by thought or contemplation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਕੇ ਬਉਰੇ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਲੇਖੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khabar na karahi deen ke baure taa te janam alekhai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You do not care for others, you are a religious fanatic, and your life is of no account at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਤੇਬ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਅਲਹੁ ਨਾਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: saach kateb bakhaanai alahu naar purakh nahee koee ||
english: Your holy scriptures say that Allah is True, and that he is neither male nor female.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਢੇ ਗੁਨੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਜਉ ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: padhe gune naahee kachh baure jau dil mahi khabar na hoee ||2||
english: But you gain nothing by reading and studying, O mad-man, if you do not gain the understanding in your heart. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਲਹੁ ਗੈਬੁ ਸਗਲ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: alahu gaib sagal ghat bheetar hiradai lehu bichaaree ||
english: Allah is hidden in every heart; reflect upon this in your mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੈ ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੭॥੨੯॥
transliteration: hi(n)doo turak duhoo(n) mahi ekai kahai kabeer pukaaree ||3||7||29||
english: The One Lord is within both Hindu and Muslim; Kabeer proclaims this out loud. ||3||7||29||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥ ਤਿਪਦਾ ॥ ਇਕਤੁਕਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa || tipadaa || ikatukaa ||
english: Aasaa, Ti-Pada, Ik-Tuka:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੀਓ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੇ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: keeo si(n)gaar milan ke taaee ||
english: I have decorated myself to meet my Husband Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har na mile jagajeevan gusaaee ||1||
english: But the Lord, the Life of the Word, the Sustainer of the Universe, has not come to meet me. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har mero pir hau har kee bahureeaa ||
english: The Lord is my Husband, and I am the Lord's bride.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਬਡੇ ਮੈ ਤਨਕ ਲਹੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam bade mai tanak lahureeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord is so great, and I am infinitesimally small. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਏਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dhan pir ekai sa(n)g baseraa ||
english: The bride and the Groom dwell together.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ ਪੈ ਮਿਲਨੁ ਦੁਹੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sej ek pai milan duheraa ||2||
english: They lie upon the one bed, but their union is difficult. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਜੋ ਪੀਅ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n suhaagan jo pee bhaavai ||
english: Blessed is the soul-bride, who is pleasing to her Husband Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥੮॥੩੦॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer phir janam na aavai ||3||8||30||
english: Says Kabeer, she shall not have to be reincarnated again. ||3||8||30||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: aasaa sree kabeer jeeu ke dupade ||
english: Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, Dho-Padhay:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿ ਪਵਨ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: heerai heeraa bedh pavan man sahaje rahiaa samaaee ||
english: When the Diamond of the Lord pierces the diamond of my mind, the fickle mind waving in the wind is easily absorbed into Him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਇਨਿ ਹੀਰੈ ਬੇਧੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sagal jot in heerai bedhee satigur bachanee mai paaee ||1||
english: This Diamond fills all with Divine Light; through the True Guru's Teachings, I have found Him. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: har kee kathaa anaahad baanee ||
english: The sermon of the Lord is the unstruck, endless song.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸੁ ਹੁਇ ਹੀਰਾ ਲੇਇ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)s hui heeraa lei pachhaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Becoming a swan, one recognizes the Diamond of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹੀਰਾ ਅਸ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਜਗ ਮਹ ਰਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer heeraa as dekhio jag mah rahaa samaaee ||
english: Says Kabeer, I have seen such a Diamond, permeating and pervading the world.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤਾ ਹੀਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਓ ਜਬ ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
transliteration: gupataa heeraa pragat bhaio jab gur gam deeaa dikhaaee ||2||1||31||
english: The hidden diamond became visible, when the Guru revealed it to me. ||2||1||31||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੀ ਕਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਲਖਨੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਬੁਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pahilee karoop kujaat kulakhanee saahurai peeeai buree ||
english: My first wife, ignorance, was ugly, of low social status and bad character; she was evil in my home, and in her parents' home.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕੀ ਸਰੂਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਨਿ ਸੁਲਖਨੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਉਦਰਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ab kee saroop sujaan sulakhanee sahaje udar dharee ||1||
english: My present bride, divine understanding, is beautiful, wise and well-behaved; I have taken her to my heart. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਲੀ ਸਰੀ ਮੁਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਬਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bhalee saree muee meree pahilee baree ||
english: It has turned out so well, that my first wife has died.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਵਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਅਬ ਕੀ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jug jug jeevau meree ab kee dharee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: May she, whom I have now married, live throughout the ages. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਬ ਲਹੁਰੀ ਆਈ ਬਡੀ ਕਾ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਟਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer jab lahuree aaee badee kaa suhaag tario ||
english: Says Kabeer, when the younger bride came, the elder one lost her husband.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਹੁਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਈ ਅਬ ਮੇਰੈ ਜੇਠੀ ਅਉਰੁ ਧਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੨॥
transliteration: lahuree sa(n)g bhaee ab merai jethee aur dhario ||2||2||32||
english: The younger bride is with me now, and the elder one has taken another husband. ||2||2||32||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ ਕੋ ਧਨੀਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: meree bahureeaa ko dhaneeaa naau ||
english: My daughter-in-law was first called Dhannia, the woman of wealth,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਜਨੀਆ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: le raakhio raam janeeaa naau ||1||
english: but now she is called Raam-jannia, the servant of the Lord. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਨੑ ਮੁੰਡੀਅਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਘਰੁ ਧੁੰਧਰਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: inh mu(n)deean meraa ghar dhu(n)dharaavaa ||
english: These shaven-headed saints have ruined my house.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਟਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਊਆ ਲਾਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bitavahi raam ramaooaa laavaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They have caused my son to start chanting the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu meree maaee ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O mother:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਨੑ ਮੁੰਡੀਅਨ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੩॥
transliteration: inh mu(n)deean meree jaat gavaaee ||2||3||33||
english: these shaven-headed saints have done away with my low social status. ||2||3||33||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਹੁ ਰਹੁ ਰੀ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ ਘੂੰਘਟੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
transliteration: rahu rahu ree bahureeaa ghoo(n)ghat jin kaadhai ||
english: Stay, stay, O daughter-in-law - do not cover your face with a veil.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਲਹੈਗੀ ਨ ਆਢੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kee baar lahaigee na aadhai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the end, this shall not bring you even half a shell. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘੂੰਘਟੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਗਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਗੈ ॥
transliteration: ghoo(n)ghat kaadh gaee teree aagai ||
english: The one before you used to veil her face;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਕੀ ਗੈਲਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: un kee gail tohi jin laagai ||1||
english: do not follow in her footsteps. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘੂੰਘਟ ਕਾਢੇ ਕੀ ਇਹੈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ghoo(n)ghat kaadhe kee ihai badaaee ||
english: The only merit in veiling your face is

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਦਸ ਪਾਂਚ ਬਹੂ ਭਲੇ ਆਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: din das paa(n)ch bahoo bhale aaee ||2||
english: that for a few days, people will say, "What a noble bride has come". ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘੂੰਘਟੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਤਉ ਪਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ॥
transliteration: ghoo(n)ghat tero tau par saachai ||
english: Your veil shall be true only if

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਕੂਦਹਿ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਚੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har gun gaai koodahi ar naachai ||3||
english: you skip, dance and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਬਹੂ ਤਬ ਜੀਤੈ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer bahoo tab jeetai ||
english: Says Kabeer, the soul-bride shall win,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਤੀਤੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
transliteration: har gun gaavat janam biteetai ||4||1||34||
english: only if she passes her life singing the Lord's Praises. ||4||1||34||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਵਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਕਰਵਟ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: karavat bhalaa na karavat teree ||
english: I would rather be cut apart by a saw, than have You turn Your back on me.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਾਗੁ ਗਲੇ ਸੁਨੁ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: laag gale sun binatee meree ||1||
english: Hug me close, and listen to my prayer. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree mukh pher piaare ||
english: I am a sacrifice to You - please, turn Your face to me, O Beloved Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਵਟੁ ਦੇ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karavat de mo kau kaahe kau maare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Why have You turned Your back to me? Why have You killed me? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਚੀਰਹਿ ਅੰਗੁ ਨ ਮੋਰਉ ॥
transliteration: jau tan cheerahi a(n)g na morau ||
english: Even if You cut my body apart, I shall not pull my limbs away from You.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰੈ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੋਰਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pi(n)d parai tau preet na torau ||2||
english: Even if my body falls, I shall not break my bonds of love with You. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਬੀਚੁ ਭਇਓ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ham tum beech bhaio nahee koee ||
english: Between You and I, there is no other.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਨਾਰਿ ਹਮ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tumahi s ka(n)t naar ham soee ||3||
english: You are the Husband Lord, and I am the soul-bride. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re loee ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O people:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੫॥
transliteration: ab tumaree parateet na hoee ||4||2||35||
english: now, I place no reliance in you. ||4||2||35||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋਰੀ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: koree ko kaahoo maram na jaanaa(n) ||
english: No one knows the secret of God, the Cosmic Weaver.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਨਿ ਤਨਾਇਓ ਤਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag aan tanaaio taanaa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He has stretched out the fabric of the whole world. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਨਿ ਲੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: jab tum sun le bed puraanaa(n) ||
english: When you listen to the Vedas and the Puraanas,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਹਮ ਇਤਨਕੁ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਤਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tab ham itanak pasario taanaa(n) ||1||
english: you shall know that the whole world is only a small piece of His woven fabric. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਕੀ ਕਰਗਹ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dharan akaas kee karagah banaaee ||
english: He has made the earth and sky His loom.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਥ ਚਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: cha(n)d sooraj dui saath chalaaee ||2||
english: Upon it, He moves the two bobbins of the sun and the moon. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਈ ਜੋਰਿ ਬਾਤ ਇਕ ਕੀਨੀ ਤਹ ਤਾਂਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: paaee jor baat ik keenee tah taa(n)tee man maanaa(n) ||
english: Placing my feet together, I have accomplished one thing - my mind is pleased with that Weaver.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਲਾਹੇ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਚੀਨੑਾਂ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾਂ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jolaahe ghar apanaa cheenhaa(n) ghat hee raam pachhaanaa(n) ||3||
english: I have come to understand my own home, and recognize the Lord within my heart. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਕਾਰਗਹ ਤੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer kaaragah toree ||
english: Says Kabeer, when my body workshop breaks,

author: Bhagat Kabir
transliteration: sootai soot milaae koree ||4||3||36||
english: the Weaver shall blend my thread with His thread. ||4||3||36||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਜੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar mail je teerath naavai tis baiku(n)th na jaanaa(n) ||
english: With filth within the heart, even if one bathes at sacred places of pilgrimage, still, he shall not go to heaven.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਪਤੀਣੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਅਯਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lok pateene kachhoo na hovai naahee raam ayaanaa ||1||
english: Nothing is gained by trying to please others - the Lord cannot be fooled. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: poojahu raam ek hee devaa ||
english: Worship the One Divine Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saachaa naavan gur kee sevaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The true cleansing bath is service to the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਕੈ ਮਜਨਿ ਜੇ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮੇਂਡੁਕ ਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jal kai majan je gat hovai nit nit me(n)duk naavahi ||
english: If salvation can be obtained by bathing in water, then what about the frog, which is always bathing in water?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੇਂਡੁਕ ਤੈਸੇ ਓਇ ਨਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਆਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaise me(n)duk taise oi nar phir phir jonee aavahi ||2||
english: As is the frog, so is that mortal; he is reincarnated, over and over again. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹੁ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਬਾਨਾਰਸਿ ਨਰਕੁ ਨ ਬਾਂਚਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manahu kathor marai baanaaras narak na baa(n)chiaa jaaee ||
english: If the hard-hearted sinner dies in Benaares, he cannot escape hell.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਾੜੰਬੈ ਤ ਸਗਲੀ ਸੈਨ ਤਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har kaa sa(n)t marai haaRa(n)bai ta sagalee sain taraaee ||3||
english: And even if the Lord's Saint dies in the cursed land of Haramba, still, he saves all his family. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਨ ਰੈਨਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਤਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dinas na rain bed nahee saasatr tahaa basai nira(n)kaaraa ||
english: Where there is neither day nor night, and neither Vedas nor Shaastras, there, the Formless Lord abides.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਰ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਬਾਵਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੭॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer nar tisahi dhiaavahu baavariaa sa(n)saaraa ||4||4||37||
english: Says Kabeer, meditate on Him, O mad-men of the world. ||4||4||37||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: aasaa baanee sree naamadeu jee kee ||
english: Aasaa, The Word Of The Reverend Naam Dayv Jee:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਆਪਕ ਪੂਰਕ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ek anek biaapak poorak jat dekhau tat soee ||
english: In the one and in the many, He is pervading and permeating; wherever I look, there He is.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਮੋਹਿਤ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maaiaa chitr bachitr bimohit biralaa boojhai koee ||1||
english: The marvellous image of Maya is so fascinating; how few understand this. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh gobi(n)d hai sabh gobi(n)d hai gobi(n)d bin nahee koee ||
english: God is everything, God is everything. Without God, there is nothing at all.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੂਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਮਣਿ ਸਤ ਸਹੰਸ ਜੈਸੇ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: soot ek man sat saha(n)s jaise ot pot prabh soee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As one thread holds hundreds and thousands of beads, He is woven into His creation. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਅਰੁ ਫੇਨ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jal tara(n)g ar phen budabudaa jal te bhi(n)n na hoee ||
english: The waves of the water, the foam and bubbles, are not distinct from the water.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਬਿਚਰਤ ਆਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ihu parapa(n)ch paarabraham kee leelaa bicharat aan na hoee ||2||
english: This manifested world is the playful game of the Supreme Lord God; reflecting upon it, we find that it is not different from Him. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਪਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa bharam ar supan manorath sat padaarath jaaniaa ||
english: False doubts and dream objects - man believes them to be true.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਮਨਸਾ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਗਤ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sukrit manasaa gur upadesee jaagat hee man maaniaa ||3||
english: The Guru has instructed me to try to do good deeds, and my awakened mind has accepted this. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kahat naamadeu har kee rachanaa dekhahu ridai beechaaree ||
english: Says Naam Dayv, see the Creation of the Lord, and reflect upon it in your heart.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਏਕ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar keval ek muraaree ||4||1||
english: In each and every heart, and deep within the very nucleus of all, is the One Lord. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਕੁੰਭ ਭਰਾਈਲੇ ਊਦਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
transliteration: aaneele ku(n)bh bharaaeele oodak thaakur kau isanaan karau ||
english: Bringing the pitcher, I fill it with water, to bathe the Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਇਆਲੀਸ ਲਖ ਜੀ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤੇ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਭੈਲਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baiaalees lakh jee jal mahi hote beethal bhailaa kaai karau ||1||
english: But 4.2 million species of beings are in the water - how can I use it for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny? ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਉ ਤਤ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਭੈਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jatr jaau tat beethal bhailaa ||
english: Wherever I go, the Lord is there.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mahaa ana(n)d kare sad kelaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He continually plays in supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਫੂਲ ਪਰੋਈਲੇ ਮਾਲਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਉ ॥
transliteration: aaneele phool paroeele maalaa thaakur kee hau pooj karau ||
english: I bring flowers to weave a garland, in worshipful adoration of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਬਾਸੁ ਲਈ ਹੈ ਭਵਰਹ ਬੀਠਲ ਭੈਲਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pahile baas laee hai bhavarah beethal bhailaa kaai karau ||2||
english: But the bumble bee has already sucked out the fragrance - how can I use it for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny? ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਦੂਧੁ ਰੀਧਾਈਲੇ ਖੀਰੰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਨੈਵੇਦੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
transliteration: aaneele doodh reedhaaeele kheera(n) thaakur kau naived karau ||
english: I carry milk and cook it to make pudding, with which to feed the Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਦੂਧੁ ਬਿਟਾਰਿਓ ਬਛਰੈ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਭੈਲਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pahile doodh bitaario bachharai beethal bhailaa kaai karau ||3||
english: But the calf has already tasted the milk - how can I use it for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny? ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਈਭੈ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਊਭੈ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਬੀਠਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
transliteration: eebhai beethal oobhai beethal beethal bin sa(n)saar nahee ||
english: The Lord is here, the Lord is there; without the Lord, there is no world at all.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬ ਮਹੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar naamaa pranavai poor rahio too(n) sarab mahee ||4||2||
english: Prays Naam Dayv, O Lord, You are totally permeating and pervading all places and interspaces. ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਗਜੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: man mero gaj jihabaa meree kaatee ||
english: My mind is the yardstick, and my tongue is the scissors.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਪਿ ਮਪਿ ਕਾਟਉ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: map map kaatau jam kee phaasee ||1||
english: I measure it out and cut off the noose of death. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਜਾਤੀ ਕਹ ਕਰਉ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: kahaa karau jaatee kah karau paatee ||
english: What do I have to do with social status? What do I have to with ancestry?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam ko naam japau din raatee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I meditate on the Name of the Lord, day and night. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਂਗਨਿ ਰਾਂਗਉ ਸੀਵਨਿ ਸੀਵਉ ॥
transliteration: raa(n)gan raa(n)gau seevan seevau ||
english: I dye myself in the color of the Lord, and sew what has to be sewn.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਰੀਅ ਨ ਜੀਵਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam naam bin gharee na jeevau ||2||
english: Without the Lord's Name, I cannot live, even for a moment. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: bhagat karau har ke gun gaavau ||
english: I perform devotional worship, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਪਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aath pahar apanaa khasam dhiaavau ||3||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on my Lord and Master. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕੀ ਸੂਈ ਰੁਪੇ ਕਾ ਧਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: suine kee sooee rupe kaa dhaagaa ||
english: My needle is gold, and my thread is silver.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਉ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naame kaa chit har sau laagaa ||4||3||
english: Naam Dayv's mind is attached to the Lord. ||4||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਾਪੁ ਕੁੰਚ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਛਾਡੈ ॥
transliteration: saap ku(n)ch chhodai bikh nahee chhaadai ||
english: The snake sheds its skin, but does not lose its venom.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਉਦਕ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਗੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਮਾਡੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: udak maahi jaise bag dhiaan maadai ||1||
english: The heron appears to be meditating, but it is concentrating on the water. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜਪੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kaahe kau keejai dhiaan japa(n)naa ||
english: Why do you practice meditation and chanting,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਧੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab te sudh naahee man apanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: when your mind is not pure? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਘਚ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: si(n)ghach bhojan jo nar jaanai ||
english: That man who feeds like a lion,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਹੀ ਠਗਦੇਉ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aise hee thagadeu bakhaanai ||2||
english: is called the god of thieves. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਾਹਿ ਲੇ ਝਗਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naame ke suaamee laahi le jhagaraa ||
english: Naam Dayv's Lord and Master has settled my inner conflicts.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਪੀਓ ਰੇ ਦਗਰਾ ॥੩॥੪॥
transliteration: raam rasaain peeo re dagaraa ||3||4||
english: Drink in the sublime elixir of the Lord, O deceitful one. ||3||4||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿ ਚੀਨੑਸੀ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਨ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham j cheenhsee aasaa te na bhaavasee ||
english: One who recognizes the Supreme Lord God, dislikes other desires.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾ ਭਗਤਹ ਚੇਤੀਅਲੇ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raamaa bhagatah cheteeale achi(n)t man raakhasee ||1||
english: He focuses his consciousness on the Lord's devotional worship, and keeps his mind free of anxiety. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਤਰਹਿਗਾ ਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੋ ਬਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kaise man tarahigaa re sa(n)saar saagar bikhai ko banaa ||
english: O my mind, how will you cross over the world-ocean, if you are filled with the water of corruption?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭੂਲਾ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jhoothee maaiaa dekh kai bhoolaa re manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Gazing upon the falseness of Maya, you have gone astray, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਛੀਪੇ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੈਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਭੈਲਾ ॥
transliteration: chheepe ke ghar janam dailaa gur upades bhailaa ||
english: You have given me birth in the house of a calico-printer, but I have found the Teachings of the Guru.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੁਲਾ ॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: sa(n)tah kai parasaad naamaa har bhetulaa ||2||5||
english: By the Grace of the Saint, Naam Dayv has met the Lord. ||2||5||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: aasaa baanee sree ravidaas jeeu kee ||
english: Aasaa, The Word Of The Reverend Ravi Daas Jee:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮੀਨ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਪਤੰਗ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਏਕ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: mrig meen bhri(n)g pata(n)g ku(n)char ek dokh binaas ||
english: The deer, the fish, the bumble bee, the moth and the elephant are destroyed, each for a single defect.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch dokh asaadh jaa mahi taa kee ketak aas ||1||
english: So the one who is filled with the five incurable vices - what hope is there for him? ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧੋ ਅਬਿਦਿਆ ਹਿਤ ਕੀਨ ॥
transliteration: maadho abidiaa hit keen ||
english: O Lord, he is in love with ignorance.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਦੀਪ ਮਲੀਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bibek deep maleen ||1|| rahaau ||
english: His lamp of clear wisdom has grown dim. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਸੰਭਵ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪ ਅਸੋਚ ॥
transliteration: trigad jon achet sa(n)bhav pu(n)n paap asoch ||
english: The creeping creatures live thoughtless lives, and cannot discriminate between good and evil.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁਖਾ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਦੁਲਭ ਤਿਹੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੋਚ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maanukhaa avataar dulabh tihee sa(n)gat poch ||2||
english: It is so difficult to obtain this human incarnation, and yet, they keep company with the low. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਲਗੁ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਬਸਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t jahaa jahaa lag karam ke bas jaai ||
english: Wherever the beings and creatures are, they are born according to the karma of their past actions.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਅਬਧ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਉਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaal phaas abadh laage kachh na chalai upaai ||3||
english: The noose of death is unforgiving, and it shall catch them; it cannot be warded off. ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ਤਜੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਪਨ ਤਪੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: ravidaas daas udaas taj bhram tapan tap gur giaan ||
english: O servant Ravi Daas, dispel your sorrow and doubt, and know that Guru-given spiritual wisdom is the penance of penances.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: bhagat jan bhai haran paramaana(n)d karahu nidaan ||4||1||
english: O Lord, Destroyer of the fears of Your humble devotees, make me supremely blissful in the end. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਤੁਝੀ ਤਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t tujhee tan sa(n)gat praan ||
english: Your Saints are Your body, and their company is Your breath of life.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur giaan jaanai sa(n)t devaa dev ||1||
english: By the True Guru-given spiritual wisdom, I know the Saints as the gods of gods. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਕਥਾ ਰਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t chee sa(n)gat sa(n)t kathaa ras ||
english: O Lord, God of gods, grant me the Society of the Saints,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਾਝੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prem maajhai deejai devaa dev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The sublime essence of the Saints' conversation, and the Love of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਆਚਰਣ ਸੰਤ ਚੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤ ਚ ਓਲ੍ਹਗ ਓਲ੍ਹਗਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)t aacharan sa(n)t cho maarag sa(n)t ch olhag olhaganee ||2||
english: The Character of the Saints, the lifestyle of the Saints, and the service of the servant of the Saints. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਉਰ ਇਕ ਮਾਗਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ॥
transliteration: aur ik maagau bhagat chi(n)taaman ||
english: I ask for these, and for one thing more - devotional worship, which shall fulfill my desires.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਣੀ ਲਖਾਵਹੁ ਅਸੰਤ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਣਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janee lakhaavahu asa(n)t paapee san ||3||
english: Do not show me the wicked sinners. ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਭਣੈ ਜੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: ravidaas bhanai jo jaanai so jaan ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, he alone is wise, who knows this:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਅਨੰਤਹਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)t ana(n)tahi a(n)tar naahee ||4||2||
english: there is no difference between the Saints and the Infinite Lord. ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਚੰਦਨ ਹਮ ਇਰੰਡ ਬਾਪੁਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: tum cha(n)dan ham ira(n)d baapure sa(n)g tumaare baasaa ||
english: You are sandalwood, and I am the poor castor oil plant, dwelling close to you.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨੀਚ ਰੂਖ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: neech rookh te ooch bhae hai ga(n)dh suga(n)dh nivaasaa ||1||
english: From a lowly tree, I have become exalted; Your fragrance, Your exquisite fragrance now permeates me. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maadhau satasa(n)gat saran tumhaaree ||
english: O Lord, I seek the Sanctuary of the company of Your Saints;

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਉਗਨ ਤੁਮੑ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham augan tumh upakaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am worthless, and You are so benevolent. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਮਖਤੂਲ ਸੁਪੇਦ ਸਪੀਅਲ ਹਮ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਜਸ ਕੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tum makhatool suped sapeeal ham bapure jas keeraa ||
english: You are the white and yellow threads of silk, and I am like a poor worm.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਮਧੁਪ ਮਖੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mil raheeai maadhau jaise madhup makheeraa ||2||
english: O Lord, I seek to live in the Company of the Saints, like the bee with its honey. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤੀ ਓਛਾ ਪਾਤੀ ਓਛਾ ਓਛਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jaatee ochhaa paatee ochhaa ochhaa janam hamaaraa ||
english: My social status is low, my ancestry is low, and my birth is low as well.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੩॥
transliteration: raajaa raam kee sev na keenee kahi ravidaas chamaaraa ||3||3||
english: I have not performed the service of the Lord, the Lord, says Ravi Daas the cobbler. ||3||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kahaa bhaio jau tan bhaio chhin chhin ||
english: What would it matter, if my body were cut into pieces?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਉ ਡਰਪੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prem jaai tau darapai tero jan ||1||
english: If I were to lose Your Love, Lord, then Your humble servant would be afraid. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਅਰਬਿੰਦ ਭਵਨ ਮਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tujhahi charan arabi(n)d bhavan man ||
english: Your lotus feet are the home of my mind.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਨ ਕਰਤ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਾਇਓ ਰਾਮਈਆ ਧਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paan karat paaio paaio raamaeeaa dhan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Drinking in Your Nectar, I have obtained the wealth of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਪਤਿ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਪਟਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)pat bipat patal maaiaa dhan ||
english: Prosperity, adversity, property and wealth are just Maya.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਮਗਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa mahi magan hot na tero jan ||2||
english: Your humble servant is not engrossed in them. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨ ॥
transliteration: prem kee jevaree baadhio tero jan ||
english: Your humble servant is tied by the rope of Your Love.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਛੂਟਿਬੋ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ॥੩॥੪॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas chhootibo kavan gun ||3||4||
english: Says Ravi Daas, what benefit would I get by escaping from it? ||3||4||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har har har har har hare ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, Haray.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਨ ਗਏ ਨਿਸਤਰਿ ਤਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har simarat jan gae nisatar tare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, the humble are carried across to salvation. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕਬੀਰ ਉਜਾਗਰ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam kabeer ujaagar ||
english: Through the Lord's Name, Kabeer became famous and respected.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਾਗਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kaate kaagar ||1||
english: The accounts of his past incarnations were torn up. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nimat naamadeu doodh peeaaiaa ||
english: Because of Naam Dayv's devotion, the Lord drank the milk he offered.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਜਗ ਜਨਮ ਸੰਕਟ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tau jag janam sa(n)kat nahee aaiaa ||2||
english: He shall not have to suffer the pains of reincarnation into the world again. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jan ravidaas raam ra(n)g raataa ||
english: Servant Ravi Daas is imbued with the Lord's Love.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: iu gur parasaad narak nahee jaataa ||3||5||
english: By Guru's Grace, he shall not have to go to hell. ||3||5||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਕੋ ਪੁਤਰਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਨਚਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: maatee ko putaraa kaise nachat hai ||
english: How does the puppet of clay dance?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਦਉਰਿਓ ਫਿਰਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dekhai dekhai sunai bolai daurio phirat hai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He looks and listens, hears and speaks, and runs around. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਬ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jab kachh paavai tab garab karat hai ||
english: When he acquires something, he is inflated with ego.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਗਈ ਤਬ ਰੋਵਨੁ ਲਗਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maaiaa gaee tab rovan lagat hai ||1||
english: But when his wealth is gone, then he cries and bewails. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਰਸ ਕਸਹਿ ਲੁਭਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man bach kram ras kasahi lubhaanaa ||
english: In thought, word and deed, he is attached to the sweet and tangy flavors.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਕਹੂੰ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binas gaiaa jaai kahoo(n) samaanaa ||2||
english: When he dies, no one knows where he has gone. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਬਾਜੀ ਜਗੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas baajee jag bhaaee ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, the world is just a dramatic play, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਸਉ ਮੋੁਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥੬॥
transliteration: baajeegar sau mouhi preet ban aaee ||3||6||
english: I have enshrined love for the Lord, the star of the show. ||3||6||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਧੰਨੇ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: aasaa baanee bhagat dha(n)ne jee kee ||
english: Aasaa, The Word Of Devotee Dhanna Jee:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਹੁ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਲਾਨੇ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਧੀਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bhramat phirat bahu janam bilaane tan man dhan nahee dheere ||
english: I wandered through countless incarnations, but mind, body and wealth never remain stable.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾਮ ਲੁਬਧ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੀਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: laalach bikh kaam lubadh raataa man bisare prabh heere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Attached to, and stained by the poisons of sexual desire and greed, the mind has forgotten the jewel of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲ ਮੀਠ ਲਗੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰੇ ਚਾਰ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bikh phal meeth lage man baure chaar bichaar na jaaniaa ||
english: The poisonous fruit seems sweet to the demented mind, which does not know the difference between good and evil.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਢੀ ਅਨ ਭਾਂਤੀ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਤਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gun te preet badhee an bhaa(n)tee janam maran phir taaniaa ||1||
english: Turning away from virtue, his love for other things increases, and he weaves again the web of birth and death. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਜਲਤ ਜਾਲ ਜਮ ਫੰਧ ਪਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jugat jaan nahee ridai nivaasee jalat jaal jam pha(n)dh pare ||
english: He does not know the way to the Lord, who dwells within his heart; burning in the trap, he is caught by the noose of death.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲ ਸੰਚਿ ਭਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੇ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨ ਬਿਸਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bikh phal sa(n)ch bhare man aise param purakh prabh man bisare ||2||
english: Gathering the poisonous fruits, he fills his mind with them, and he forgets God, the Supreme Being, from his mind. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸੁ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਨ ਏਕ ਮਏ ॥
transliteration: giaan praves gurahi dhan deeaa dhiaan maan man ek mae ||
english: The Guru has given the wealth of spiritual wisdom; practicing meditation, the mind becomes one with Him.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: prem bhagat maanee sukh jaaniaa tripat aghaane mukat bhae ||3||
english: Embracing loving devotional worship for the Lord, I have come to know peace; satisfied and satiated, I have been liberated. ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅਛਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jot samaai samaanee jaa kai achhalee prabh pahichaaniaa ||
english: One who is filled with the Divine Light, recognizes the undeceivable Lord God.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੈ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: dha(n)nai dhan paaiaa dharaneedhar mil jan sa(n)t samaaniaa ||4||1||
english: Dhanna has obtained the Lord, the Sustainer of the World, as his wealth; meeting the humble Saints, he merges in the Lord. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d gobi(n)d gobi(n)d sa(n)g naamadeu man leenaa ||
english: Naam Dayv's mind was absorbed into God, Gobind, Gobind, Gobind.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਆਢ ਦਾਮ ਕੋ ਛੀਪਰੋ ਹੋਇਓ ਲਾਖੀਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aadh daam ko chheeparo hoio laakheenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The calico-printer, worth half a shell, became worth millions. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬੁਨਨਾ ਤਨਨਾ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bunanaa tananaa tiaag kai preet charan kabeeraa ||
english: Abandoning weaving and stretching thread, Kabeer enshrined love for the Lord's lotus feet.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲਾ ਜੋਲਾਹਰਾ ਭਇਓ ਗੁਨੀਯ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: neech kulaa jolaaharaa bhaio guneey gaheeraa ||1||
english: A weaver from a lowly family, he became an ocean of excellence. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਢੁਵੰਤਾ ਢੋਰ ਨੀਤਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ravidaas dhuva(n)taa dhor neet tin tiaagee maaiaa ||
english: Ravi Daas, who used to carry dead cows every day, renounced the world of Maya.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
