gurmukhi: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paragat hoaa saadhasa(n)g har darasan paaiaa ||2||
english: He became famous in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and obtained the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੈਨੁ ਨਾਈ ਬੁਤਕਾਰੀਆ ਓਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੁਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sain naaee butakaareeaa ohu ghar ghar suniaa ||
english: Sain, the barber, the village drudge, became famous in each and every house.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਗਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hirade vasiaa paarabraham bhagataa mahi ganiaa ||3||
english: The Supreme Lord God dwelled in his heart, and he was counted among the devotees. ||3||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਜਾਟਰੋ ਉਠਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: ih bidh sun kai jaataro uth bhagatee laagaa ||
english: Hearing this, Dhanna the Jaat applied himself to devotional worship.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਖਿ ਗੁਸਾਈਆ ਧੰਨਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: mile pratakh gusaaeeaa dha(n)naa vadabhaagaa ||4||2||
english: The Lord of the Universe met him personally; Dhanna was so very blessed. ||4||2||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਬਿਬਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: re chit chetas kee na dayaal damodar bibahi na jaanas koee ||
english: O my consciousness, why don't you remain conscious of the Merciful Lord? How can you recognize any other?

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: je dhaavahi brahama(n)d kha(n)d kau karataa karai s hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You may run around the whole universe, but that alone happens which the Creator Lord does. ||1||Pause||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਨਨੀ ਕੇਰੇ ਉਦਰ ਉਦਕ ਮਹਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕੀਆ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jananee kere udar udak mahi pi(n)d keeaa das duaaraa ||
english: In the water of the mother's womb, He fashioned the body with ten gates.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਦੇਇ ਅਹਾਰੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਐਸਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dei ahaar agan mahi raakhai aisaa khasam hamaaraa ||1||
english: He gives it sustenance, and preserves it in fire - such is my Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਮੀ ਜਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਤਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੰਖ ਖੀਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ku(n)mee jal maahi tan tis baahar pa(n)kh kheer tin naahee ||
english: The mother turtle is in the water, and her babies are out of the water. She has no wings to protect them, and no milk to feed them.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਸਮਝਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pooran paramaana(n)d manohar samajh dekh man maahee ||2||
english: The Perfect Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss, the Fascinating Lord takes care of them. See this, and understand it in your mind||2||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖਣਿ ਕੀਟੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਤਾ ਤਾ ਚੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: paakhan keet gupat hoi rahataa taa cho maarag naahee ||
english: The worm lies hidden under the stone - there is no way for him to escape.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਧੰਨਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਮਤ ਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਡਰਾਂਹੀ ॥੩॥੩॥
transliteration: kahai dha(n)naa pooran taahoo ko mat re jee daraa(n)hee ||3||3||
english: Says Dhanna, the Perfect Lord takes care of him. Fear not, O my soul. ||3||3||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aasaa sekh phareed jeeu kee baanee ||
english: Aasaa, The Word Of Shaykh Fareed Jee:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਦਿਲਹੁ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਜਿੰਨੑ ਸੇਈ ਸਚਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dilahu muhabat ji(n)nh seee sachiaa ||
english: They alone are true, whose love for God is deep and heart-felt.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਿ ਕਾਂਢੇ ਕਚਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jinh man hor mukh hor s kaa(n)dhe kachiaa ||1||
english: Those who have one thing in their heart, and something else in their mouth, are judged to be false. ||1||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਰਤੇ ਇਸਕ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਰੰਗਿ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: rate isak khudaai ra(n)g deedaar ke ||
english: Those who are imbued with love for the Lord, are delighted by His Vision.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇ ਭੁਇ ਭਾਰੁ ਥੀਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: visariaa jinh naam te bhui bhaar theee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are a burden on the earth. ||1||Pause||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਸੇ ॥
transliteration: aap leee laR laai dar daraves se ||
english: Those whom the Lord attaches to the hem of His robe, are the true dervishes at His Door.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਉ ਆਏ ਸਫਲੁ ਸੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin dha(n)n janedee maau aae saphal se ||2||
english: Blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them, and fruitful is their coming into the world. ||2||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗਮ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਤੂ ॥
transliteration: paravadagaar apaar agam bea(n)t too ||
english: O Lord, Sustainer and Cherisher, You are infinite, unfathomable and endless.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਚੁੰਮਾ ਪੈਰ ਮੂੰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jinaa pachhaataa sach chu(n)maa pair moo(n) ||3||
english: Those who recognize the True Lord - I kiss their feet. ||3||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਪਨਹ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਤੂ ਬਖਸੰਦਗੀ ॥
transliteration: teree panah khudaai too bakhasa(n)dagee ||
english: I seek Your Protection - You are the Forgiving Lord.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦੈ ਖੈਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਬੰਦਗੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: sekh phareedai khair deejai ba(n)dagee ||4||1||
english: Please, bless Shaykh Fareed with the bounty of Your meditative worship. ||4||1||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ||
english: Aasaa:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲੈ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਲਹ ਲਗੇ ॥
transliteration: bolai sekh phareed piaare alah lage ||
english: Says Shaykh Fareed, O my dear friend, attach yourself to the Lord.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਖਾਕ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਗੋਰ ਘਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ihu tan hosee khaak nimaanee gor ghare ||1||
english: This body shall turn to dust, and its home shall be a neglected graveyard. ||1||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਟਾਕਿਮ ਕੂੰਜੜੀਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਮਚਿੰਦੜੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aaj milaavaa sekh phareed taakim koo(n)jaReeaa manahu machi(n)daReeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You can meet the Lord today, O Shaykh Fareed, if you restrain your bird-like desires which keep your mind in turmoil. ||1||Pause||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਘੁਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: je jaanaa mar jaaeeai ghum na aaeeai ||
english: If I had known that I was to die, and not return again,

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਲਗਿ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਵਞਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jhoothee duneeaa lag na aap vanjaaeeai ||2||
english: I would not have ruined myself by clinging to the world of falsehood. ||2||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਨ ਬੋਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: boleeai sach dharam jhooth na boleeai ||
english: So speak the Truth, in righteousness, and do not speak falsehood.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਸੈ ਵਾਟ ਮੁਰੀਦਾ ਜੋਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo gur dasai vaat mureedaa joleeai ||3||
english: The disciple ought to travel the route, pointed out by the Guru. ||3||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਛੈਲ ਲੰਘੰਦੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਗੋਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: chhail la(n)gha(n)de paar goree man dheeriaa ||
english: Seeing the youths being carried across, the hearts of the beautiful young soul-brides are encouraged.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਵੰਨੇ ਪਾਸੇ ਕਲਵਤਿ ਚੀਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ka(n)chan va(n)ne paase kalavat cheeriaa ||4||
english: Those who side with the glitter of gold, are cut down with a saw. ||4||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸੇਖ ਹੈਯਾਤੀ ਜਗਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sekh haiyaatee jag na koee thir rahiaa ||
english: O Shaykh, no one's life is permanent in this world.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਸਣਿ ਹਮ ਬੈਠੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਬੈਸਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jis aasan ham baithe kete bais gaiaa ||5||
english: That seat, upon which we now sit - many others sat on it and have since departed. ||5||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਤਿਕ ਕੂੰਜਾਂ ਚੇਤਿ ਡਉ ਸਾਵਣਿ ਬਿਜੁਲੀਆਂ ॥
transliteration: katik koo(n)jaa(n) chet dau saavan bijuleeaa(n) ||
english: As the swallows appear in the month of Katik, forest fires in the month of Chayt, and lightning in Saawan,

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸੀਆਲੇ ਸੋਹੰਦੀਆਂ ਪਿਰ ਗਲਿ ਬਾਹੜੀਆਂ ॥੬॥
transliteration: seeaale soha(n)deeaa(n) pir gal baahaReeaa(n) ||6||
english: and as the bride's arms adorn her husband's neck in winter;||6||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਚਲੇ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ਲੇਇ ਮਨੋ ॥
transliteration: chale chalanahaar vichaaraa lei mano ||
english: Just so, the transitory human bodies pass away. Reflect upon this in your mind.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਗੰਢੇਦਿਆਂ ਛਿਅ ਮਾਹ ਤੁੜੰਦਿਆ ਹਿਕੁ ਖਿਨੋ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ga(n)dhediaa(n) chhi maah tuRa(n)diaa hik khino ||7||
english: It takes six months to form the body, but it breaks in an instant. ||7||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਿਮੀ ਪੁਛੈ ਅਸਮਾਨ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਖੇਵਟ ਕਿੰਨਿ ਗਏ ॥
transliteration: jimee puchhai asamaan phareedaa khevat ki(n)n gae ||
english: O Fareed, the earth asks the sky, "Where have the boatmen gone?"

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਾਲਣ ਗੋਰਾਂ ਨਾਲਿ ਉਲਾਮੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਹੇ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: jaalan goraa(n) naal ulaame jee sahe ||8||2||
english: Some have been cremated, and some lie in their graves; their souls are suffering rebukes. ||8||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag goojaree mahalaa 1 chaupade ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Goojaree, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰੀ ਚਨਣਾਠੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਉਰਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: teraa naam karee chananaatheeaa je man urasaa hoi ||
english: I would make Your Name the sandalwood, and my mind the stone to rub it on;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਜੇ ਰਲੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karanee ku(n)goo je ralai ghat a(n)tar poojaa hoi ||1||
english: for saffron, I would offer good deeds; thus, I perform worship and adoration within my heart. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਕੀਚੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poojaa keechai naam dhiaaeeai bin naavai pooj na hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Perform worship and adoration by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the Name, there is no worship and adoration. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦੇਵ ਪਖਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: baahar dev pakhaaleeahi je man dhovai koi ||
english: If one were to wash his heart inwardly, like the stone idol which is washed on the outside,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੂਠਿ ਲਹੈ ਜੀਉ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਮੋਖ ਪਇਆਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jooth lahai jeeu maajeeai mokh paiaanaa hoi ||2||
english: his filth would be removed, his soul would be cleansed, and he would be liberated when he departs. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਖੜੁ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: pasoo milahi cha(n)giaaeeaa khaR khaavahi a(n)mrit dehi ||
english: Even beasts have value, as they eat grass and give milk.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਆਦਮੀ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam vihoone aadamee dhrig jeevan karam karehi ||3||
english: Without the Naam, the mortal's life is cursed, as are the actions he performs. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੇੜਾ ਹੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਅਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰੇ ਸੰਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: neRaa hai door na jaaniahu nit saare sa(n)mhaale ||
english: The Lord is hear at hand - do not think that He is far away. He always cherishes us, and remembers us.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jo devai so khaavanaa kahu naanak saachaa he ||4||1||
english: Whatever He gives us, we eat; says Nanak, He is the True Lord. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Goojaree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਉਪਜੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naabh kamal te brahamaa upaje bed paRahi mukh ka(n)th savaar ||
english: From the lotus of Vishnu's navel, Brahma was born; He chanted the Vedas with a melodious voice.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਣਾ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa ko a(n)t na jaaee lakhanaa aavat jaat rahai gubaar ||1||
english: He could not find the Lord's limits, and he remained in the darkness of coming and going. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: preetam kiu bisarahi mere praan adhaar ||
english: Why should I forget my Beloved? He is the support of my very breath of life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee bhagat karahi jan poore mun jan sevahi gur veechaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The perfect beings perform devotional worship to Him. The silent sages serve Him through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: rav sas deepak jaa ke tribhavan ekaa jot muraar ||
english: His lamps are the sun and the moon; the One Light of the Destroyer of ego fills the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh hoi s ahinis niramal manamukh rain a(n)dhaar ||2||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh remains immaculately pure, day and night, while the self-willed manmukh is enveloped by the darkness of night. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਝਗਰਾ ਦੁਹੁ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਿਆ ਹੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sidh samaadh karahi nit jhagaraa duhu lochan kiaa herai ||
english: The Siddhas in Samaadhi are continually in conflict; what can they see with their two eyes?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਝਗਰੁ ਨਿਬੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)tar jot sabad dhun jaagai satigur jhagar niberai ||3||
english: One who has the Divine Light within his heart, and is awakened to the melody of the Word of the Shabad - the True Guru settles his conflicts. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sur nar naath bea(n)t ajonee saachai mahal apaaraa ||
english: O Lord of angels and men, infinite and unborn, Your True Mansion is incomparable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sahaj mile jagajeevan nadar karahu nisataaraa ||4||2||
english: Nanak merges imperceptibly into the Life of the world; shower Your mercy upon him, and save him. ||4||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag goojaree mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Goojaree, Third Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਇਵੇਹਾ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhrig ivehaa jeevanaa jit har preet na paai ||
english: Cursed is that life, in which the Lord's Love is not obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੰਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jit ka(n)m har veesarai doojai lagai jaai ||1||
english: Cursed is that occupation, in which the Lord is forgotten, and one becomes attached to duality. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਮਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਅਵਰ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa satigur seveeai manaa jit seviai govid preet oopajai avar visar sabh jaai ||
english: Serve such a True Guru, O my mind, that by serving Him, God's Love may be produced, and all others may be forgotten.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਜਰਾ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har setee chit gahi rahai jaraa kaa bhau na hovaee jeevan padavee paai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your consciousness shall remain attached to the Lord; there shall be no fear of old age, and the supreme status shall be obtained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਇਕੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਵੇਖੁ ਜੈਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d preet siu ik sahaj upajiaa vekh jaisee bhagat banee ||
english: A divine peace wells up from God's Love; behold, it comes from devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਸੇਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap setee aap khaaiaa taa man niramal hoaa jotee jot samaee ||2||
english: When my identity consumed my identical identity, then my mind became immaculately pure, and my light was blended with the Divine Light. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin bhaagaa aisaa satigur na paaeeai je lochai sabh koi ||
english: Without good fortune, such a True Guru cannot be found, no matter how much all may yearn for Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਪਾਲਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kooRai kee paal vichahu nikalai taa sadaa sukh hoi ||3||
english: If the veil of falsehood is removed from within, then lasting peace is obtained. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak aise satigur kee kiaa ohu sevak sevaa kare gur aagai jeeu dharei ||
english: O Nanak, what service can the servant perform for such a True Guru? He should offer his life, his very soul, to the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur kaa bhaanaa chit kare satigur aape kripaa karei ||4||1||3||
english: If he focuses his consciousness on the Will of the True Guru, then the True Guru Himself will bless him. ||4||1||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Goojaree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਤੁਮ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: har kee tum sevaa karahu doojee sevaa karahu na koi jee ||
english: Serve the Lord; do not serve anyone else.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੂਜੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ਜੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kee sevaa te manahu chi(n)diaa phal paaeeai doojee sevaa janam birathaa jaai jee ||1||
english: Serving the Lord, you shall obtain the fruits of your heart's desires; serving another, your life shall pass away in vain. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਨੀ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: har meree preet reet hai har meree har meree kathaa kahaanee jee ||
english: The Lord is my Love, the Lord is my way of life, the Lord is my speech and conversation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਏਹਾ ਸੇਵ ਬਨੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad meraa man bheejai ehaa sev banee jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, my mind is saturated with the Lord's Love; this is what makes up my service. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har meraa simrit har meraa saasatr har meraa ba(n)dhap har meraa bhaaee ||
english: The Lord is my Simritees, the Lord is my Shaastras; the Lord is my relative and the Lord is my brother.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਭੂਖ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਕੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har kee mai bhookh laagai har naam meraa man tripatai har meraa saak a(n)t hoi sakhaaee ||2||
english: I am hungry for the Lord; my mind is satisfied with the Name of the Lord. The Lord is my relation, my helper in the end. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰ ਰਾਸਿ ਕੂੜੀ ਹੈ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har bin hor raas kooRee hai chaladiaa naal na jaaee ||
english: Without the Lord, other assets are false. They do not go with the mortal when he departs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਚਾਲੈ ਜਹਾ ਹਉ ਜਾਉ ਤਹ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har meraa dhan merai saath chaalai jahaa hau jaau tah jaaee ||3||
english: The Lord is my wealth, which shall go with me; wherever I go, it will go. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਝੂਠਾ ਜੋ ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਗੈ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: so jhoothaa jo jhoothe laagai jhoothe karam kamaaee ||
english: One who is attached to falsehood is false; false are the deeds he does.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਹੋਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: kahai naanak har kaa bhaanaa hoaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaaee ||4||2||4||
english: Says Nanak, everything happens according to the Will of the Lord; no one has any say in this at all. ||4||2||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Goojaree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jug maahi naam dula(n)bh hai guramukh paaiaa jaai ||
english: It is so difficult to obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in this age; only the Gurmukh obtains it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਉਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin naavai mukat na hovaee vekhahu ko viupaai ||1||
english: Without the Name, no one is liberated; let anyone make other efforts, and see. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane sad balihaarai jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever a sacrifice to Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai har man vasai sahaje rahai samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and one remains absorbed in Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਭਉ ਪਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) bhau paae aapanaa bairaag upajai man aai ||
english: When God instills His fear, a balanced detachment springs up in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰਾਗੈ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bairaagai te har paaeeai har siu rahai samaai ||2||
english: Through this detachment, the Lord is obtained, and one remains absorbed in the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਇ ਮੁਕਤ ਜਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: sei mukat j man jinahi phir dhaat na laagai aai ||
english: He alone is liberated, who conquers his mind; Maya does not stick to him again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਸਵੈ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਰਹਤ ਕਰੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dasavai duaar rahat kare tribhavan sojhee paai ||3||
english: He dwells in the Tenth Gate, and obtains the understanding of the three worlds. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak gur te gur hoiaa vekhahu tis kee rajaai ||
english: O Nanak, through the Guru, one becomes the Guru; behold, His Wondrous Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: ihu kaaran karataa kare jotee jot samaai ||4||3||5||
english: This deed was done by the Creator Lord; one's light merges into the Light. ||4||3||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Goojaree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਿਐ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: raam raam sabh ko kahai kahiai raam na hoi ||
english: Everyone chants the Lord's Name, Raam, Raam; but by such chanting, the Lord is not obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee raam man vasai taa phal paavai koi ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and then, the fruits are obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar govi(n)d jis laagai preet ||
english: One who enshrines love for God within his mind,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har tis kade na veesarai har har karahi sadaa man cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: never forgets the Lord; he continually chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har, in his conscious mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਸੈ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਕਹਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: hiradai jinh kai kapat vasai baaharahu sa(n)t kahaahi ||
english: Those whose hearts are filled with hypocrisy, who are called saints only for their outward show

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: trisanaa mool na chukaee a(n)t gae pachhutaahi ||2||
english: - their desires are never satisfied, and they depart grieving in the end. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਤੀਰਥ ਜੇ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anek teerath je jatan karai taa a(n)tar kee haumai kade na jaai ||
english: Although one may bathe at many places of pilgrimage, still, his ego never departs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਰ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis nar kee dubidhaa na jaai dharam raai tis dei sajaai ||3||
english: That man, whose sense of duality does not depart - the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall punish him. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: karam hovai soee jan paae guramukh boojhai koee ||
english: That humble being, unto whom God showers His Mercy, obtains Him; how few are the Gurmukhs who understand Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak vichahu haumai maare taa(n) har bhetai soee ||4||4||6||
english: O Nanak, if one conquers his ego within, then he comes to meet the Lord. ||4||4||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Goojaree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tis jan saa(n)t sadaa mat nihachal jis kaa abhimaan gavaae ||
english: That humble being who eliminates his ego is at peace; he is blessed with an ever-stable intellect.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so jan niramal j guramukh boojhai har charanee chit laae ||1||
english: That humble being is immaculately pure, who, as Gurmukh, understands the Lord, and focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਮਨਾ ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har chet achet manaa jo ichhahi so phal hoee ||
english: O my unconscious mind, remain conscious of the Lord, and you shall obtain the fruits of your desires.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪੀਵਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har ras paavahi peevat rahahi sadaa sukh hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, you shall obtain the sublime elixir of the Lord; by continually drinking it in, you shall have eternal peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhete taa paaras hovai paaras hoi ta pooj karaae ||
english: When one meets the True Guru, he becomes the philosopher's stone, with the ability to transform others, inspiring them to worship the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਸੁ ਪੂਜੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo us pooje so phal paae deekhiaa devai saach bujhaae ||2||
english: One who worships the Lord in adoration, obtains his rewards; instructing others, he reveals the Truth. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਰਸੈ ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਮਨ ਪਰਚੇ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: vin paarasai pooj na hovaee vin man parache avaraa samajhaae ||
english: Without becoming the philosopher's stone, he does not inspire others to worship the Lord; without instructing his own mind, how can he instruct others?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਦਾਏ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਓਹੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guroo sadaae agiaanee a(n)dhaa kis ohu maarag paae ||3||
english: The ignorant, blind man calls himself the guru, but to whom can he show the way? ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naanak vin nadaree kichhoo na paaeeai jis nadar kare so paae ||
english: O Nanak, without His Mercy, nothing can be obtained. One upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, obtains Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee de vadiaaee apanaa sabad varataae ||4||5||7||
english: By Guru's Grace, God bestows greatness, and projects the Word of His Shabad. ||4||5||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 pa(n)chapade ||
english: Goojaree, Third Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਾਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾ ਕਾਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naa kaasee mat oopajai naa kaasee mat jaai ||
english: Wisdom is not produced in Benares, nor is wisdom lost in Benares.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਾ ਇਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur miliai mat oopajai taa ih sojhee paai ||1||
english: Meeting the True Guru, wisdom is produced, and then, one obtains this understanding. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har kathaa too(n) sun re man sabad ma(n)n vasaai ||
english: Listen to the sermon of the Lord, O mind, and enshrine the Shabad of His Word within your mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਭਰਮੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ih mat teree thir rahai taa(n) bharam vichahu jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If your intellect remains stable and steady, then doubt shall depart from within you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ ਤੂ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: har charan ridai vasaai too kilavikh hovahi naas ||
english: Enshrine the Lord's lotus feet within your heart, and your sins shall be erased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਆਤਮਾ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch bhoo aatamaa vas karahi taa teerath karahi nivaas ||2||
english: If your soul overcomes the five elements, then you shall come to have a home at the true place of pilgrimage. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh ihu man mugadh hai sojhee kichhoo na paai ||
english: This mind of the self-centered manmukh is so stupid; it does not obtain any understanding at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har kaa naam na bujhaee a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaai ||3||
english: It does not understand the Name of the Lord; it departs repenting in the end. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਾਸੀ ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu man kaasee sabh teerath simrit satigur deeaa bujhaai ||
english: In this mind are found Benares, all sacred shrines of pilgrimage and the Shaastras; the True Guru has explained this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: athasath teerath tis sa(n)g rahahi jin har hiradai rahiaa samaai ||4||
english: The sixty-eight places of pilgrimage remain with one, whose heart is filled with the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak satigur miliai hukam bujhiaa ek vasiaa man aai ||
english: O Nanak, upon meeting the True Guru, the Order of the Lord's Will is understood, and the One Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੫॥੬॥੮॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai sabh sach hai sache rahai samaai ||5||6||8||
english: Those who are pleasing to You, O True Lord, are true. They remain absorbed in You. ||5||6||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਤੀਜਾ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 teejaa ||
english: Goojaree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: eko naam nidhaan pa(n)dit sun sikh sach soee ||
english: The One Name is the treasure, O Pandit. Listen to these True Teachings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਜੇਤਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੜਤ ਗੁਣਤ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai jetaa paRahi paRat gunat sadaa dukh hoee ||1||
english: No matter what you read in duality, reading and contemplating it, you shall only continue to suffer. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਤੂੰ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har charanee too(n) laag rahu gur sabad sojhee hoee ||
english: So grasp the Lord's lotus feet; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall come to understand.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਚਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਤਾਂ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ras rasanaa chaakh too(n) taa(n) man niramal hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: With your tongue, taste the sublime elixir of the Lord, and your mind shall be rendered immaculately pure. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai man sa(n)tokheeai taa phir trisanaa bhookh na hoi ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, the mind becomes content, and then, hunger and desire will not trouble you any longer.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan paaiaa par ghar jaai na koi ||2||
english: Obtaining the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one does not go knocking at other doors. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kathanee badanee je kare manamukh boojh na hoi ||
english: The self-willed manmukh babbles on and on, but he does not understand.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramatee ghat chaananaa har naam paavai soi ||3||
english: One whose heart is illumined, by Guru's Teachings, obtains the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਤੂੰ ਨ ਬੁਝਹੀ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sun saasatr too(n) na bujhahee taa phirahi baaro baar ||
english: You may listen to the Shaastras, but you do not understand, and so you wander from door to door.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਜੋ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: so moorakh jo aap na pachhaanaee sach na dhare piaar ||4||
english: He is a fool, who does not understand his own self, and who does not enshrine love for the True Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਡਹਕਾਇਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sachai jagat dahakaaiaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaai ||
english: The True Lord has fooled the world - no one has any say in this at all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੫॥੭॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaavai so kare jiu tis kee rajaai ||5||7||9||
english: O Nanak, He does whatever He pleases, according to His Will. ||5||7||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag goojaree mahalaa 4 chaupade ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Goojaree, Fourth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਹਉ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: har ke jan satigur sat purakhaa hau binau karau gur paas ||
english: O Servant of the Lord, O True Guru, O True Primal Being, I offer my prayers to You, O Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਿਰਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ham keere kiram satigur saranaaee kar daiaa naam paragaas ||1||
english: I am an insect and a worm; O True Guru, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, be merciful and bestow upon me the Light of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: mere meet guradev mo kau raam naam paragaas ||
english: O my Best Friend, O Divine Guru, please illuminate me with the Light of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਮਰੀ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramat naam meraa praan sakhaaee har keerat hamaree raharaas ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Instructions, the Naam is my breath of life, and the Praise of the Lord is my occupation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: har jan ke vadabhaag vadere jin har har saradhaa har piaas ||
english: The Lord's servants have the greatest good fortune; they have faith in the Lord, Har, Har, and a thirst for the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har har naam milai tripataasahi mil sa(n)gat gun paragaas ||2||
english: Obtaining the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are satisfied; joining the Company of the Holy, their virtues shine forth. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਜਮ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jinh har har har ras naam na paaiaa te bhaagaheen jam paas ||
english: Those who have not obtained the essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are most unfortunate; they are taken away by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਏ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵੇ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo satigur saran sa(n)gat nahee aae dhrig jeeve dhrig jeevaas ||3||
english: Those who have not sought the Sanctuary of the True Guru and the Company of the Holy - cursed are their lives, and cursed are their hopes of life. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jin har jan satigur sa(n)gat paaee tin dhur masatak likhiaa likhaas ||
english: Those humble servants of the Lord, who have obtained the Company of the True Guru, have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n satasa(n)gat jit har ras paaiaa mil naanak naam paragaas ||4||1||
english: Blessed, blessed is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the sublime essence of the Lord is obtained. Meeting with His humble servant, O Nanak, the Naam shines forth. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: govi(n)d govi(n)d preetam man preetam mil satasa(n)gat sabad man mohai ||
english: The Lord, the Lord of the Universe is the Beloved of the minds of those who join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. The Shabad of His Word fascinates their minds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭ ਕਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਓਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jap govi(n)d govi(n)d dhiaaeeai sabh kau daan dei prabh ohai ||1||
english: Chant, and meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the Universe; God is the One who gives gifts to all. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਜਨਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: mere bhaaee janaa mo kau govi(n)d govi(n)d govi(n)d man mohai ||
english: O my Siblings of Destiny, the Lord of the Universe, Govind, Govind, Govind, has enticed and fascinated my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: govi(n)d govi(n)d govi(n)d gun gaavaa mil gur saadhasa(n)gat jan sohai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, Govind, Govind, Govind; joining the Holy Society of the Guru, Your humble servant is beautified. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਉਲਾ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਗਿ ਓਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar har bhagat hai guramat kaulaa ridh sidh laagai pag ohai ||
english: Devotional worship to the Lord is an ocean of peace; through the Guru's Teachings, wealth, prosperity and the spiritual powers of the Siddhas fall at our feet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan kau raam naam aadhaaraa har naam japat har naame sohai ||2||
english: The Lord's Name is the Support of His humble servant; he chants the Lord's Name, and with the Lord's Name he is adorned. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਮਤਿ ਫੀਕੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: duramat bhaagaheen mat pheeke naam sunat aavai man rohai ||
english: Evil-minded, unfortunate and shallow-minded are those who feel anger in their minds, when they hear the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਊਆ ਕਾਗ ਕਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਖਾਇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੋਹੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaooaa kaag kau a(n)mrit ras paaeeai tripatai visataa khaai mukh gohai ||3||
english: You may place ambrosial nectar before crows and ravens, but they will be satisfied only by eating manure and dung with their mouths. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਵਾਦੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਤੈ ਕਊਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit sar satigur sativaadee jit naatai kaooaa ha(n)s hohai ||
english: The True Guru, the Speaker of Truth, is the pool of Ambrosial Nectar; bathing within it, the crow becomes a swan.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਹੈ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak dhan dha(n)n vade vadabhaagee jinh guramat naam ridai mal dhohai ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, blessed, blessed and very fortunate are those who, through the Guru's Teachings, with the Naam, wash away the filth of their hearts. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har jan ootam ootam baanee mukh bolahi paraupakaare ||
english: The humble servants of the Lord are exalted, and exalted is their speech. With their mouths, they speak for the benefit of others.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਸਰਧਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo jan sunai saradhaa bhagat setee kar kirapaa har nisataare ||1||
english: Those who listen to them with faith and devotion, are blessed by the Lord; showering His Mercy, He saves them. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raam mo kau har jan mel piaare ||
english: Lord, please, let me meet the beloved servants of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mere preetam praan satigur gur pooraa ham paapee gur nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru, the Perfect Guru, is my Beloved, my very breath of life; the Guru has saved me, the sinner. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh vadabhaagee vadabhaage jin har har naam adhaare ||
english: The Gurmukhs are fortunate, so very fortunate; their Support is the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har har a(n)mrit har ras paavahi guramat bhagat bha(n)daare ||2||
english: They obtain the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; through the Guru's Teachings, they obtain this treasure-house of devotional worship. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਜਮਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jin darasan satigur sat purakh na paaiaa te bhaagaheen jam maare ||
english: Those who do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the True Guru, the True Primal Being, are most unfortunate; they are destroyed by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਕੂਕਰ ਸੂਕਰ ਗਰਧਭ ਪਵਹਿ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਦਯਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਹਾ ਹਤਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: se kookar sookar garadhabh pavahi garabh jonee day maare mahaa hatiaare ||3||
english: They are like dogs, pigs and jackasses; they are cast into the womb of reincarnation, and the Lord strikes them down as the worst of murderers. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਹੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal hohu jan oopar kar kirapaa lehu ubaare ||
english: O Lord, Kind to the poor, please shower Your mercy upon Your humble servant, and save him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak jan har kee saranaaee har bhaavai har nisataare ||4||3||
english: Servant Nanak has entered the Lord's Sanctuary; if it pleases You, Lord, please save him. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਹਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: hohu daiaal meraa man laavahu hau anadin raam naam nit dhiaaee ||
english: Be Merciful and attune my mind, so that I might meditate continually on the Lord's Name, night and day.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪਿਐ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh sukh sabh gun sabh nidhaan har jit japiai dukh bhukh sabh lahi jaaee ||1||
english: The Lord is all peace, all virtue and all wealth; remembering Him, all misery and hunger depart. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man mere meraa raam naam sakhaa har bhaaee ||
english: O my mind, the Lord's Name is my companion and brother.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramat raam naam jas gaavaa a(n)t belee daragah lae chhadaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, I sing the Praises of the Lord's Name; it shall be my help and support in the end, and it shall deliver me in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੋਚ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) aape daataa prabh a(n)tarajaamee kar kirapaa loch merai man laaee ||
english: You Yourself are the Giver, O God, Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts; by Your Grace, You have infused longing for You in my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲੋਚ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mai man tan loch lagee har setee prabh loch pooree satigur saranaaee ||2||
english: My mind and body long for the Lord; God has fulfilled my longing. I have entered the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maanas janam pu(n)n kar paaiaa bin naavai dhrig dhrig birathaa jaaee ||
english: Human birth is obtained through good actions; without the Name, it is cursed, totally cursed, and it passes away in vain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਥੁਕ ਥੂਕ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam binaa ras kas dukh khaavai mukh pheekaa thuk thook mukh paaee ||3||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains only suffering for his delicacies to eat. His mouth is insipid, and his face is spat upon, again and again. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jo jan har prabh har har saranaa tin daragah har har de vadiaaee ||
english: Those humble beings, who have entered the Sanctuary of the Lord God, Har, Har, are blessed with glory in the Court of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n saabaas kahai prabh jan kau jan naanak mel lae gal laaee ||4||4||
english: Blessed, blessed and congratulations, says God to His humble servant. O servant Nanak, He embraces him, and blends him with Himself. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sakhee sahelee meree mo kau devahu daan har praan jeevaaiaa ||
english: O Gurmukhs, O my friends and companions, give me the gift of the Lord's Name, the life of my very life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਹੋਵਹ ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ham hovah laale gole gurasikhaa ke jinhaa anadin har prabh purakh dhiaaiaa ||1||
english: I am the slave, the servant of the Guru's Sikhs, who meditate on the Lord God, the Primal Being, night and day. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਗ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: merai man tan birahu gurasikh pag laaiaa ||
english: Within my mind and body, I have enshrined love for the feet of the Guru's Sikhs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਭਾਈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mere praan sakhaa gur ke sikh bhaaee mo kau karahu upades har milai milaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O my life-mates, O Sikhs of the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, instruct me in the Teachings, that I might merge in the Lord's Merger. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਵਚਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa har prabh bhaavai taa guramukh mele jinh vachan guroo satigur man bhaaiaa ||
english: When it pleases the Lord God, he causes us to meet the Gurmukhs; the Hymns of the Guru, the True Guru, are very sweet to their minds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee gur ke sikh piaare har nirabaanee nirabaan pad paaiaa ||2||
english: Very fortunate are the beloved Sikhs of the Guru; through the Lord, they attain the supreme state of Nirvaanaa. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat gur kee har piaaree jin har har naam meethaa man bhaaiaa ||
english: The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the Guru, is loved by the Lord. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet and pleasing to their minds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਮਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin satigur sa(n)gat sa(n)g na paaiaa se bhaagaheen paapee jam khaaiaa ||3||
english: One who does not obtain the Association of the True Guru, is a most unfortunate sinner; he is consumed by the Messenger of Death. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aap kripaal kripaa prabh dhaare har aape guramukh milai milaaiaa ||
english: If God, the Kind Master, Himself shows His kindness, then the Lord causes the Gurmukh to merge into Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak bole gun baanee gurabaanee har naam samaaiaa ||4||5||
english: Servant Nanak chants the Glorious Words of the Guru's Bani; through them, one is absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jin satigur purakh jin har prabh paaiaa mo kau kar upades har meeth lagaavai ||
english: One who has found the Lord God through the True Guru, has made the Lord seem so sweet to me, through the His Teachings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਭ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man tan seetal sabh hariaa hoaa vadabhaagee har naam dhiaavai ||1||
english: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed, and totally rejuvenated; by great good fortune, I meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re mo kau koee aai milai har naam driRaavai ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, let anyone who can implant the Lord's Name within me, come and meet with me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mere preetam praan man tan sabh devaa mere har prabh kee har kathaa sunaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Unto my Beloved, I give my mind and body, and my very breath of life. He speaks to me of the sermon of my Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dheeraj dharam guramat har paaiaa nit har naamai har siu chit laavai ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained courage, faith and the Lord. He keeps my mind focused continually on the Lord, and the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit bachan satigur kee baanee jo bolai so mukh a(n)mrit paavai ||2||
english: The Words of the True Guru's Teachings are Ambrosial Nectar; this Amrit trickles into the mouth of the one who chants them. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: niramal naam jit mail na laagai guramat naam japai liv laavai ||
english: Immaculate is the Naam, which cannot be stained by filth. Through the Guru's Teachings, chant the Naam with love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਿਨ ਨਰ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਮੁਏ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam padaarath jin nar nahee paaiaa se bhaagaheen mue mar jaavai ||3||
english: That man who has not found the wealth of the Naam is most unfortunate; he dies over and over again. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aanad mool jagajeevan daataa sabh jan kau anad karahu har dhiaavai ||
english: The source of bliss, the Life of the world, the Great Giver brings bliss to all who meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: too(n) daataa jee sabh tere jan naanak guramukh bakhas milaavai ||4||6||
english: You are the Great Giver, all beings belong to You. O servant Nanak, You forgive the Gurmukhs, and merge them into Yourself. ||4||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 ghar 3 ||
english: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ॥
transliteration: maaee baap putr sabh har ke keee ||
english: Mother, father and sons are all made by the Lord;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabhanaa kau sanaba(n)dh har kar deee ||1||
english: the relationships of all are established by the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੀਰ ॥
transliteration: hamaraa jor sabh rahio mere beer ||
english: I have given up all my strength, O my brother.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har kaa tan man sabh har kai vas hai sareer ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The mind and body belong to the Lord, and the human body is entirely under His control. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਰਧਾ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kau saradhaa aap har laaee ||
english: The Lord Himself infuses devotion into His humble devotees.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਸਤ ਉਦਾਸ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: viche grisat udaas rahaaee ||2||
english: In the midst of family life, they remain unattached. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jab a(n)tar preet har siu ban aaee ||
english: When inner love is established with the Lord,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tab jo kichh kare s mere har prabh bhaaee ||3||
english: then whatever one does, is pleasing to my Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jit kaarai ka(n)m ham har laae ||
english: I do those deeds and tasks which the Lord has set me to;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: so ham karah j aap karaae ||4||
english: I do that which He makes me to do. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin kee bhagat mere prabh bhaaee ||
english: Those whose devotional worship is pleasing to my God

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥੧॥੭॥੧੬॥
transliteration: te jan naanak raam naam liv laaee ||5||1||7||16||
english: - O Nanak, those humble beings center their minds lovingly on the Lord's Name. ||5||1||7||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 1 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਜਾ ਆਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kaahe re man chitavahi udam jaa aahar har jeeu pariaa ||
english: Why, O mind, do you contrive your schemes, when the Dear Lord Himself provides for your care?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੈਲ ਪਥਰ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sail pathar mahi ja(n)t upaae taa kaa rijak aagai kar dhariaa ||1||
english: From rocks and stones, He created the living beings, and He places before them their sustenance. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਿ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mere maadhau jee satasa(n)gat mile s tariaa ||
english: O my Dear Lord of Souls, one who meets with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਹਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paaiaa sooke kaasat hariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, he obtains the supreme status, and the dry branch blossoms forth in greenery. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਨਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: janan pitaa lok sut banitaa koi na kis kee dhariaa ||
english: Mother, father, friends, children, and spouse - no one is the support of any other.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਭਉ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sir sir rijak sa(n)baahe thaakur kaahe man bhau kariaa ||2||
english: For each and every individual, the Lord and Master provides sustenance; why do you fear, O my mind? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਡੈ ਊਡਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੈ ਕੋਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਬਚਰੇ ਛਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: oodai ood aavai sai kosaa tis paachhai bachare chhariaa ||
english: The flamingoes fly hundreds of miles, leaving their young ones behind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਕਵਨੁ ਖਲਾਵੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਚੁਗਾਵੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: un kavan khalaavai kavan chugaavai man mahi simaran kariaa ||3||
english: Who feeds them, and who teaches them to feed themselves? Have you ever thought of this in your mind? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh nidhaan das asat sidhaan thaakur kar tal dhariaa ||
english: All treasures and the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas are held by the Lord and Master in the palm of His hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak bal bal sad bal jaaeeai teraa a(n)t na paaraavariaa ||4||1||
english: Servant Nanak is devoted, dedicated, and forever a sacrifice to You - Your vast expanse has no limit. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 2 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਿਆਚਾਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਇਤੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kiriaachaar karahi khat karamaa it raate sa(n)saaree ||
english: They perform the four rituals and six religious rites; the world is engrossed in these.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tar mail na utarai haumai bin gur baajee haaree ||1||
english: They are not cleansed of the filth of their ego within; without the Guru, they lose the game of life. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: mere thaakur rakh levahu kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: O my Lord and Master, please, grant Your Grace and preserve me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot madhe ko viralaa sevak hor sagale biuhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Out of millions, hardly anyone is a servant of the Lord. All the others are mere traders. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੋਧੇ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਬਾਤ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saasat bed simrit sabh sodhe sabh ekaa baat pukaaree ||
english: I have searched all the Shaastras, the Vedas and the Simritees, and they all affirm one thing:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin gur mukat na kooo paavai man vekhahu kar beechaaree ||2||
english: without the Guru, no one obtains liberation; see, and reflect upon this in your mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਏ ਧਰ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: athasath majan kar isanaanaa bhram aae dhar saaree ||
english: Even if one takes cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and wanders over the whole planet,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸੋਚ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anik soch karahi din raatee bin satigur a(n)dhiaaree ||3||
english: and performs all the rituals of purification day and night, still, without the True Guru, there is only darkness. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤ ਧਾਵਤ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਧਾਇਓ ਅਬ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat dhaavat sabh jag dhaaio ab aae har duaaree ||
english: Roaming and wandering around, I have travelled over the whole world, and now, I have arrived at the Lord's Door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੇਟਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: duramat met budh paragaasee jan naanak guramukh taaree ||4||1||2||
english: The Lord has eliminated my evil-mindedness, and enlightened my intellect; O servant Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved. ||4||1||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਪ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਤਾਪ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har dhan jaap har dhan taap har dhan bhojan bhaaiaa ||
english: The wealth of the Lord is my chanting, the wealth of the Lord is my deep meditation; the wealth of the Lord is the food I enjoy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਉ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nimakh na bisarau man te har har saadhasa(n)gat mahi paaiaa ||1||
english: I do not forget the Lord, Har, Har, from my mind, even for an instant; I have found Him in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਖਾਟਿ ਆਇਓ ਘਰਿ ਪੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: maaee khaat aaio ghar pootaa ||
english: O mother, your son has returned home with a profit:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਚਲਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਬੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਗਤ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har dhan chalate har dhan baise har dhan jaagat sootaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: the wealth of the Lord while walking, the wealth of the Lord while sitting, and the wealth of the Lord while waking and sleeping. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har dhan isanaan har dhan giaan har sa(n)g laai dhiaanaa ||
english: The wealth of the Lord is my cleansing bath, the wealth of the Lord is my wisdom; I center my meditation on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har dhan tulahaa har dhan beRee har har taar paraanaa ||2||
english: The wealth of the Lord is my raft, the wealth of the Lord is my boat; the Lord, Har, Har, is the ship to carry me across. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਮੇਰੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਨਿ ਲਾਹਿਆ ਧੋਖਾ ॥
transliteration: har dhan meree chi(n)t visaaree har dhan laahiaa dhokhaa ||
english: Through the wealth of the Lord, I have forgotten my anxiety; through the wealth of the Lord, my doubt has been dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਾਥਿ ਚਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਥੋਕਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har dhan te mai nav nidh paaee haath chario har thokaa ||3||
english: From the wealth of the Lord, I have obtained the nine treasures; the true essence of the Lord has come into my hands. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਵਹੁ ਖਰਚਹੁ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਲਤ ਪਲਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
transliteration: khaavahu kharachahu tot na aavai halat palat kai sa(n)ge ||
english: No matter how much I eat and expend this wealth, it is not exhausted; here and hereafter, it remains with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਦਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: laad khajaanaa gur naanak kau deeaa ihu man har ra(n)g ra(n)ge ||4||2||3||
english: Loading the treasure, Guru Nanak has given it, and this mind is imbued with the Lord's Love. ||4||2||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat sabh kilavikh naasahi pitaree hoi udhaaro ||
english: Remembering Him, all sins are erased, and ones generations are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so har har tumh sad hee jaapahu jaa kaa a(n)t na paaro ||1||
english: So meditate continually on the Lord, Har, Har; He has no end or limitation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸੀਸ ॥
transliteration: pootaa maataa kee aasees ||
english: O son, this is your mother's hope and prayer,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਭਜਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nimakh na bisarau tumh kau har har sadaa bhajahu jagadees ||1|| rahaau ||
english: that you may never forget the Lord, Har, Har, even for an instant. May you ever vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur tumh kau hoi daiaalaa sa(n)tasa(n)g teree preet ||
english: May the True Guru be kind to you, and may you love the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਪੜੁ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਾਖੀ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaapaR pat paramesar raakhee bhojan keeratan neet ||2||
english: May the preservation of your honor by the Transcendent Lord be your clothes, and may the singing of His Praises be your food. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਨਦ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit peevahu sadaa chir jeevahu har simarat anad ana(n)taa ||
english: So drink in forever the Ambrosial Nectar; may you live long, and may the meditative remembrance of the Lord give you infinite delight.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ra(n)g tamaasaa pooran aasaa kabahi na biaapai chi(n)taa ||3||
english: May joy and pleasure be yours; may your hopes be fulfilled, and may you never be troubled by worries. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵਰੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣਾ ਹੋਹੁ ਕਉਲਾ ॥
transliteration: bhavar tumhaaraa ihu man hovau har charanaa hohu kaulaa ||
english: Let this mind of yours be the bumble bee, and let the Lord's feet be the lotus flower.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਉਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ਜਿਉ ਬੂੰਦਹਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਮਉਲਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak daas un sa(n)g lapataaio jiu boo(n)dahi chaatrik maulaa ||4||3||4||
english: Says servant Nanak, attach your mind to them, and blossom forth like the song-bird, upon finding the rain-drop. ||4||3||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਪਛਮ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਪੂਰਬ ਹੀ ਲੈ ਜਾਤ ॥
transliteration: mataa karai pachham kai taaee poorab hee lai jaat ||
english: He decides to go to the west, but the Lord leads him away to the east.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ਆਪਨ ਹਾਥਿ ਮਤਾਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khin mahi thaap uthaapanahaaraa aapan haath mataat ||1||
english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; He holds all matters in His hands. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਤ ॥
transliteration: siaanap kaahoo kaam na aat ||
english: Cleverness is of no use at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਅਨਰੂਪਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਉਹ ਬਾਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo anaroopio thaakur merai hoi rahee uh baat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever my Lord and Master deems to be right - that alone comes to pass. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਧਨ ਜੋਰਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਬੀਚੇ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
transliteration: des kamaavan dhan joran kee manasaa beeche nikase saas ||
english: In his desire to acquire land and accumulate wealth, one's breath escapes him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਸਕਰ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਸ ॥੨॥
transliteration: lasakar neb khavaas sabh tiaage jam pur ooth sidhaas ||2||
english: He must leave all his armies, assistants and servants; rising up, he departs to the City of Death. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਨਿ ਮਨਹਠ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਾਤ ॥
transliteration: hoi ana(n)n manahath kee driRataa aapas kau jaanaat ||
english: Believing himself to be unique, he clings to his stubborn mind, and shows himself off.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਅਨਿੰਦੁ ਨਿੰਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਓ ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਖਾਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo ani(n)d ni(n)d kar chhodio soee phir phir khaat ||3||
english: That food, which the blameless people have condemned and discarded, he eats again and again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
transliteration: sahaj subhaai bhae kirapaalaa tis jan kee kaatee phaas ||
english: One, unto whom the Lord shows His natural mercy, has the noose of Death cut away from him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur pooraa bhetiaa paravaan girasat udaas ||4||4||5||
english: Says Nanak, one who meets the Perfect Guru, is celebrated as a householder as well as a renunciate. ||4||4||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan jin jan japio tin ke ba(n)dhan kaate ||
english: Those humble beings who chant the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, have their bonds broken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਇਹ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਤੇ ਹਾਟੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaam krodh maaiaa bikh mamataa ih biaadh te haate ||1||
english: Sexual desirer, anger, the poison of Maya and egotism - they are rid of these afflictions. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: har jas saadhasa(n)g mil gaaio ||
english: One who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and chants the Praises of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad bhaio man niramal sarab sukhaa sukh paaiau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: has his mind purified, by Guru's Grace, and he obtains the joy of all joys. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਓ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ਐਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh keeo soee bhal maanai aisee bhagat kamaanee ||
english: Whatever the Lord does, he sees that as good; such is the devotional service he performs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਭ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mitr satr sabh ek samaane jog jugat neesaanee ||2||
english: He sees friends and enemies as all the same; this is the sign of the Way of Yoga. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਈ ਆਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: pooran poor rahio srab thaaee aan na katahoo(n) jaataa ||
english: The all-pervading Lord is fully filling all places; why should I go anywhere else?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵਿਓ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar ra(n)g ravio ra(n)g raataa ||3||
english: He is permeating and pervading within each and every heart; I am immersed in His Love, dyed in the color of His Love. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhae kripaal daiaal gupaalaa taa nirabhai kai ghar aaiaa ||
english: When the Lord of the Universe becomes kind and compassionate, then one enters the home of the Fearless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੬॥
transliteration: kal kales mite khin bheetar naanak sahaj samaaiaa ||4||5||6||
english: His troubles and worries are ended in an instant; O Nanak, he merges in celestial peace. ||4||5||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸੋ ਅਪਨੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jis maanukh pahi karau benatee so apanai dukh bhariaa ||
english: Whoever I approach to ask for help, I find him full of his own troubles.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਭਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paarabraham jin ridai araadhiaa tin bhau saagar tariaa ||1||
english: One who worships in his heart the Supreme Lord God, crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ॥
transliteration: gur har bin ko na brithaa dukh kaatai ||
english: No one, except the Guru-Lord, can dispel our pain and sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਜਿ ਅਵਰ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਜਸੁ ਘਾਟੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh taj avar sevak je hoee hai tit maan mahat jas ghaatai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Forsaking God, and serving another, one's honor, dignity and reputation are decreased. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਸੈਨ ਸਾਕ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa ke sanaba(n)dh sain saak kit hee kaam na aaiaa ||
english: Relatives, relations and family bound through Maya are of no avail.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲੁ ਊਚਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har kaa daas neech kul oochaa tis sa(n)g man baa(n)chhat phal paaiaa ||2||
english: The Lord's servant, although of lowly birth, is exalted. Associating with him, one obtains the fruits of his mind's desires. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੀ ॥
transliteration: laakh kot bikhiaa ke bi(n)jan taa mahi trisan na boojhee ||
english: Through corruption, one may obtain thousands and millions of enjoyments, but even so, his desires are not satisfied through them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੂਝੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: simarat naam kot ujeeaaraa basat agochar soojhee ||3||
english: Remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, millions of lights appear, and the incomprehensible is understood. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: phirat phirat tumhrai duaar aaiaa bhai bha(n)jan har raaiaa ||
english: Wandering and roaming around, I have come to Your Door, Destroyer of fear, O Lord King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਬਾਛੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥੭॥
transliteration: saadh ke charan dhoor jan baachhai sukh naanak ihu paaiaa ||4||6||7||
english: Servant Nanak yearns for the dust of the feet of the Holy; in it, he finds peace. ||4||6||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 pa(n)chapadaa ghar 2 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Panch-Pada, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਗਰਭ ਮਾਤਾ ਕੈ ਵਾਸਾ ਊਹਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਧਰਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: prathame garabh maataa kai vaasaa oohaa chhod dharan mahi aaiaa ||
english: First, he came to dwell in his mother's womb; leaving it, he came into the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਲ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਾਗ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਛਹੂ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chitr saal su(n)dar baag ma(n)dar sa(n)g na kachhahoo jaaiaa ||1||
english: Splendid mansions, beautiful gardens and palaces - none of these shall go with him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਲੋਭ ਲਬੀ ॥
transliteration: avar sabh mithiaa lobh labee ||
english: All other greeds of the greedy are false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਉ ਏਹਾ ਵਸਤੁ ਫਬੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai deeo har naamaa jee kau ehaa vasat phabee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has given me the Name of the Lord, which my soul has come to treasure. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸਟ ਮੀਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਰਚਿ ਹਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: isat meet ba(n)dhap sut bhaaee sa(n)g banitaa rach hasiaa ||
english: Surrounded by dear friends, relatives, children, siblings and spouse, he laughs playfully.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਅੰਤੀ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਆਇ ਬਨਿਓ ਹੈ ਉਨੑ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jab a(n)tee ausar aai banio hai unh pekhat hee kaal grasiaa ||2||
english: But when the very last moment arrives, Death seizes him, while they merely look on. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਨਰਥ ਬਿਹਾਝੀ ਸੰਪੈ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੂਪਾ ਦਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kar anarath bihaajhee sa(n)pai suinaa roopaa daamaa ||
english: By continual oppression and exploitation, he accumulates wealth, gold, silver and money,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾੜੀ ਕਉ ਓਹੁ ਭਾੜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਭਇਓ ਬਿਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhaaRee kau ohu bhaaRaa miliaa hor sagal bhaio biraanaa ||3||
english: but the load-bearer gets only paltry wages, while the rest of the money passes on to others. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਰਥ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਗਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: haivar gaivar rath sa(n)baahe gahu kar keene mere ||
english: He grabs and collects horses, elephants and chariots, and claims them as his own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ਲਾਂਮੀ ਧਾਈ ਚਲਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕ ਪੈਰੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jab te hoee laa(n)mee dhaaee chalahi naahee ik paire ||4||
english: But when he sets out on the long journey, they will not go even one step with him. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
