transliteration: naam dhan naam sukh raajaa naam kuta(n)b sahaaee ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my wealth; the Naam is my princely pleasure; the Naam is my family and helper.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਈ ਓਹ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥੧॥੮॥
transliteration: naam sa(n)pat gur naanak kau deeee oh marai na aavai jaaee ||5||1||8||
english: The Guru has given Nanak the wealth of the Naam; it neither perishes, nor comes or goes. ||5||1||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਤਿਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 tipade ghar 2 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Thi-Padhay, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਆ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dukh binase sukh keeaa nivaasaa trisanaa jalan bujhaaee ||
english: My sorrows are ended, and I am filled with peace. The fire of desire within me has been quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan satiguroo driRaaiaa binas na aavai jaaee ||1||
english: The True Guru has implanted the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; it neither dies, nor goes anywhere. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੇ ॥
transliteration: har jap maaiaa ba(n)dhan toote ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, the bonds of Maya are cut away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhae kripaal daiaal prabh mere saadhasa(n)gat mil chhoote ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When my God becomes kind and compassionate, one joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and is emancipated. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar har ke gun gaavai bhagat prem ras maataa ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, absorbed in loving devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਹੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: harakh sog duhu maahi niraalaa karanaihaar pachhaataa ||2||
english: He remains unaffected by both fortune and misfortune, and he recognizes the Creator Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa saa tin hee rakh leeaa sagal jugat ban aaee ||
english: The Lord saves those who belong to Him, and all pathways are opened to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥੧॥੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh purakh daiaalaa keemat kahan na jaaee ||3||1||9||
english: Says Nanak, the value of the Merciful Lord God cannot be described. ||3||1||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 dupade ghar 2 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਲੀਏ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਗਲ ਕਰਤ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: patit pavitr leee kar apune sagal karat namasakaaro ||
english: The Lord has sanctified the sinners and made them His own; all bow in reverence to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਨੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੋਊ ਪੂਛੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਰਵਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baran jaat kooo poochhai naahee baachhahi charan ravaaro ||1||
english: No one asks about their ancestry and social status; instead, they yearn for the dust of their feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਐਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: thaakur aiso naam tumhaaro ||
english: O Lord Master, such is Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੋ ਧਣੀ ਕਹੀਜੈ ਜਨ ਕੋ ਅੰਗੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal srisat ko dhanee kaheejai jan ko a(n)g niraaro ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are called the Lord of all creation; You give Your unique support to Your servant. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak budh paaee har keeratan aadhaaro ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has obtained understanding; singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is his only support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਓ ਚੰਮਿਆਰੋ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naamadeu trilochan kabeer daasaro mukat bhaio cha(n)miaaro ||2||1||10||
english: The Lord's servants, Naam Dayv, Trilochan, Kabeer and Ravi Daas the shoe-maker have been liberated. ||2||1||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਊ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਭਤਾ ॥
transliteration: hai naahee kooo boojhanahaaro jaanai kavan bhataa ||
english: No one understands the Lord; who can understand His plans?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਬਿਰੰਚਿ ਅਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਮੋਨਿ ਜਨ ਗਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾਹਿ ਗਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: siv bira(n)ch ar sagal mon jan gahi na sakaahi gataa ||1||
english: Shiva, Brahma and all the silent sages cannot understand the state of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕਥਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee agam agaadh kathaa ||
english: God's sermon is profound and unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਅਵਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਬਕਨ ਕਥਨ ਰਹਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: suneeai avar avar bidh bujheeai bakan kathan rahataa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is heard to be one thing, but He is understood to be something else again; He is beyond description and explanation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aape bhagataa aap suaamee aapan sa(n)g rataa ||
english: He Himself is the devotee, and He Himself is the Lord and Master; He is imbued with Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਕਤਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak ko prabh poor rahio hai pekhio jatr kataa ||2||2||11||
english: Nanak's God is pervading and permeating everywhere; wherever he looks, He is there. ||2||2||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਤਿ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: mataa masoorat avar siaanap jan kau kachhoo na aaio ||
english: The humble servant of the Lord has no plans, politics or other clever tricks.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਆਇ ਬਨਿਓ ਹੈ ਤਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jah jah ausar aai banio hai tahaa tahaa har dhiaaio ||1||
english: Whenever the occasion arises, there, he meditates on the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: prabh ko bhagat vachhal biradaaio ||
english: It is the very nature of God to love His devotees;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kare pratipaal baarik kee niaaee jan kau laad ladaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He cherishes His servant, and caresses him as His own child. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਜਨਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam karam dharam har keeratan jan gaaio ||
english: The Lord's servant sings the Kirtan of His Praises as his worship, deep meditation, self-discipline and religious observances.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੨॥
transliteration: saran pario naanak thaakur kee abhai daan sukh paaio ||2||3||12||
english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master, and has received the blessings of fearlessness and peace. ||2||3||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਢੀਲਾ ॥
transliteration: din raatee aaraadhahu piaaro nimakh na keejai dheelaa ||
english: Worship the Lord in adoration, day and night, O my dear - do not delay for a moment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਹਾਠੀਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sevaa kar bhaavanee laaeeai tiaag maan haatheelaa ||1||
english: Serve the Saints with loving faith, and set aside your pride and stubbornness. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਰਾਗੀਲਾ ॥
transliteration: mohan praan maan raageelaa ||
english: The fascinating, playful Lord is my very breath of life and honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਸਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੀਅਰੇ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਪੇਖਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: baas rahio heeare kai sa(n)ge pekh mohio man leelaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He abides in my heart; beholding His playful games, my mind is fascinated. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨਹੁ ਜੰਗੀਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat man hot ana(n)daa utarai manahu ja(n)geelaa ||
english: Remembering Him, my mind is in bliss, and the rust of my mind is removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੀਲਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੩॥
transliteration: milabe kee mahimaa baran na saakau naanak parai pareelaa ||2||4||13||
english: The great honor of meeting the Lord cannot be described; O Nanak, it is infinite, beyond measure. ||2||4||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਨਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰਗਿ ਕਹਾਵਤ ਸਭ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਬਸਿ ਅਪਨਹੀ ॥
transliteration: mun jogee saasatrag kahaavat sabh keenhe bas apanahee ||
english: They call themselves silent sages, Yogis and scholars of the Shaastras, but Maya has has them all under her control.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਰੁ ਕੋੜਿ ਤੇਤੀਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਹੈਰਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਰਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: teen dev ar koR teteesaa tin kee hairat kachh na rahee ||1||
english: The three gods, and the 330,000,000 demi-gods, were astonished. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਵੰਤਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਭ ਮਹੀ ॥
transliteration: balava(n)t biaap rahee sabh mahee ||
english: The power of Maya is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਕੋਊ ਮਰਮਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avar na jaanas kooo maramaa gur kirapaa te lahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Her secret is known only by Guru's Grace - no one else knows it. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਜੀਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨਾ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਲਪਟਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jeet jeet jeete sabh thaanaa sagal bhavan lapatahee ||
english: Conquering and conquering, she has conquered everywhere, and she clings to the whole world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਤੇ ਭਾਗੀ ਹੋਇ ਚੇਰੀ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak saadh te bhaagee hoi cheree charan gahee ||2||5||14||
english: Says Nanak, she surrenders to the Holy Saint; becoming his servant, she falls at his feet. ||2||5||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dui kar joR karee bena(n)tee thaakur apanaa dhiaaiaa ||
english: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer, meditating on my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haath dei raakhe paramesar sagalaa durat mitaaiaa ||1||
english: Giving me His hand, the Transcendent Lord has saved me, and erased all my sins. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: thaakur hoe aap daiaal ||
english: The Lord and Master Himself has become merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪ ਹੁਈ ਹੈ ਉਬਰੇ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaee kaliaan aana(n)d roop huee hai ubare baal gupaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have been emancipated, the embodiment of bliss; I am the child of the Lord of the Universe - He has carried me across. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਵਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mil var naaree ma(n)gal gaaiaa thaakur kaa jaikaar ||
english: Meeting her Husband, the soul-bride sings the songs of joy, and celebrates her Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tis gur balihaaree jin sabh kaa keeaa udhaar ||2||6||15||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who has emancipated everyone. ||2||6||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ ਹੈ ਥੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut ba(n)dhap tin kaa bal hai thoraa ||
english: Mother, father, siblings, children and relatives - their power is insignificant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਪੇਖੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਭੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik ra(n)g maaiaa ke pekhe kichh saath na chaalai bhoraa ||1||
english: I have seen the many pleasures of Maya, but none goes with them in the end. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਹਿ ਨ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: thaakur tujh bin aahi na moraa ||
english: O Lord Master, other than You, no one is mine.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਆਹਿਓ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਧੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mohi anaath niragun gun naahee mai aahio tumhraa dhoraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a worthless orphan, devoid of merit; I long for Your Support. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਜੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bal bal bal bal charan tumhaare eehaa oohaa tumhaaraa joraa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Your lotus feet; here and hereafter, Yours is the only power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੬॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak daras paaio binasio sagal nihoraa ||2||7||16||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has obtained the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; my obligations to all others are annulled. ||2||7||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਤਜਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aal jaal bhram moh tajaavai prabh setee ra(n)g laaee ||
english: He rids us of entanglements, doubt and emotional attachment, and leads us to love God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਇਹ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man kau ih upades driRaavai sahaj sahaj gun gaaee ||1||
english: He implants this instruction in our minds, for us to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, in peace and poise. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਐਸੋ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saajan aiso sa(n)t sahaaee ||
english: O friend, the Saintly Guru is such a helper.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis bhete tootahi maaiaa ba(n)dh bisar na kabahoo(n) jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting Him, the bonds of Maya are released, and one never forgets the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਨੀਕੀ ਇਹ ਠਹਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: karat karat anik bahu bhaatee neekee ih thaharaaee ||
english: Practicing, practicing various actions in so many ways, I came to recognize this as the best way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੭॥
transliteration: mil saadhoo har jas gaavai naanak bhavajal paar paraaee ||2||8||17||
english: Joining the Company of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||8||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi thaap uthaapanahaaraa keemat jaai na karee ||
english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; His value cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਕਰੈ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨੀਚਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raajaa ra(n)k karai khin bheetar neechah jot dharee ||1||
english: He turns the king into a beggar in an instant, and He infuses splendor into the lowly. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅਪਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: dhiaaeeai apano sadaa haree ||
english: Meditate forever on Your Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਚ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: soch a(n)desaa taa kaa kahaa kareeai jaa mahi ek gharee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Why should I feel worry or anxiety, when I am here for only a short time. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੈ ਪਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tumhree tek poore mere satigur man saran tumhaarai paree ||
english: You are my support, O my Perfect True Guru; my mind has taken to the protection of Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚੇਤ ਇਆਨੇ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੮॥
transliteration: achet iaane baarik naanak ham tum raakhahu dhaar karee ||2||9||18||
english: Nanak, I am a foolish and ignorant child; reach out to me with Your hand, Lord, and save me. ||2||9||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਆ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਬਸਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) daataa jeeaa sabhanaa kaa basahu mere man maahee ||
english: You are the Giver of all beings; please, come to dwell within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਤਹ ਭਰਮੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charan kamal rid maahi samaae tah bharam a(n)dheraa naahee ||1||
english: That heart, within which Your lotus feet are enshrined, suffers no darkness or doubt. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜਾ ਸਿਮਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਤਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: thaakur jaa simaraa too(n) taahee ||
english: O Lord Master, wherever I remember You, there I find You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa sarab pratipaalak prabh kau sadaa salaahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Show Mercy to me, O God, Cherisher of all, that I may sing Your Praises forever. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰਉ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਹੀ ॥
transliteration: saas saas teraa naam samaarau tum hee kau prabh aahee ||
english: With each and every breath, I contemplate Your Name; O God, I long for You alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਭਈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਹੋਰ ਆਸ ਬਿਡਾਣੀ ਲਾਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak tek bhaee karate kee hor aas bidaanee laahee ||2||10||19||
english: O Nanak, my support is the Creator Lord; I have renounced all other hopes. ||2||10||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਅਰੁ ਭੋਰ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apanaa daras deejai jas gaavau nis ar bhor ||
english: Show Mercy to me, and grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. I sing Your Praises night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਾਸ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਉ ਇਹੈ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kes sa(n)g daas pag jhaarau ihai manorath mor ||1||
english: With my hair, I wash the feet of Your slave; this is my life's purpose. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੀਆ ਨ ਹੋਰ ॥
transliteration: thaakur tujh bin beeaa na hor ||
english: O Lord and Master, without You, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਅਰਾਧਉ ਨਿਰਖਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chit chitavau har rasan araadhau nirakhau tumaree or ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Lord, in my mind I remain conscious of You; with my tongue I worship You, and with my eyes, I gaze upon You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
transliteration: daiaal purakh sarab ke thaakur binau karau kar jor ||
english: O Merciful Lord, O Lord and Master of all, with my palms pressed together I pray to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਉਧਰਸਿ ਆਖੀ ਫੋਰ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naam japai naanak daas tumaro udharas aakhee phor ||2||11||20||
english: Nanak, Your slave, chants Your Name, and is redeemed in the twinkling of an eye. ||2||11||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲੋਕ ਅਰੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਆਈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਤੇ ਧਾਇ ॥
transliteration: braham lok ar rudr lok aaee i(n)dr lok te dhaai ||
english: Overwhelming the realm of Brahma, the realm of Shiva and the realm of Indra, Maya has come running here.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kau johi na saakai mal mal dhovai paai ||1||
english: But she cannot touch the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; she washes and massages their feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਇ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ab mohi aai pario saranaai ||
english: Now, I have come and entered the Lord's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਹਜ ਪਾਵਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਜਾਰੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਹੈ ਬਤਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guhaj paavako bahut prajaarai mo kau satigur deeo hai bataai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This awful fire has burned so many; the True Guru has cautioned me about it. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਰੁ ਜਖੵ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਨਰ ਰਹੀ ਕੰਠਿ ਉਰਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik ar jakhy ki(n)nar nar rahee ka(n)th urajhaai ||
english: It clings to the necks of the Siddhas, and the seekers, the demi-gods, angels and mortals.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਐਸੀ ਦਾਸਾਇ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੨੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak a(n)g keeaa prabh karatai jaa kai kot aisee daasaai ||2||12||21||
english: Servant Nanak has the support of God the Creator, who has millions of slaves like her. ||2||12||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਜਸੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਗਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: apajas mitai hovai jag keerat daragah baisan paaeeai ||
english: His bad reputation is erased, he is acclaimed all over the world, and he obtains a seat in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jam kee traas naas hoi khin mahi sukh anad setee ghar jaaeeai ||1||
english: The fear of death is removed in an instant, and he goes to the Lord's House in peace and bliss. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jaa te ghaal na birathee jaaeeai ||
english: His works do not go in vain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar simarahu prabh apanaa man tan sadaa dhiaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, remember your God in meditation; meditate on Him continually in your mind and body. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: mohi saran deen dukh bha(n)jan too(n) dehi soee prabh paaeeai ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Destroyer of the pains of the poor; whatever You give me, God, that is what I receive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਹ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੨੨॥
transliteration: charan kamal naanak ra(n)g raate har daasah paij rakhaaeeai ||2||13||22||
english: Nanak is imbued with the love of Your lotus feet; O Lord, please preserve the honor of Your slave. ||2||13||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸ੍ਵੰਭਰ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bisva(n)bhar jeean ko daataa bhagat bhare bha(n)daar ||
english: The all-sustaining Lord is the Giver of all beings; His devotional worship is an overflowing treasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਫਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kee sevaa niphal na hovat khin mahi kare udhaar ||1||
english: Service to Him is not wasted; in an instant, He emancipates. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੁ ॥
transliteration: man mere charan kamal sa(n)g raach ||
english: O my mind, immerse yourself in the Lord's lotus feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜੀਅ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ਤਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਚੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal jee jaa kau aaraadhahi taahoo kau too(n) jaach ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Seek from Him, who is worshipped by all beings. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naanak saran tumhaaree karate too(n) prabh praan adhaar ||
english: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, O Creator Lord; You, O God, are the support of my breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੨੩॥
transliteration: hoi sahaaee jis too(n) raakhahi tis kahaa kare sa(n)saar ||2||14||23||
english: He who is protected by You, O Helper Lord - what can the world do to him? ||2||14||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਆਪ ॥
transliteration: jan kee paij savaaree aap ||
english: The Lord Himself has protected the honor of His humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਉਤਰਿ ਗਇਓ ਸਭੁ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam deeo gur avakhadh utar gaio sabh taap ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru has given the medicine of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, and all afflictions are gone. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਰਖਿਓ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: harigobi(n)d rakhio paramesar apunee kirapaa dhaar ||
english: The Transcendent Lord, in His Mercy, has preserved Har Gobind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੀ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mitee biaadh sarab sukh hoe har gun sadaa beechaar ||1||
english: The disease is over, and there is joy all around; we ever contemplate the Glories of God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਮੇਰੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeo merai karatai gur poore kee vadiaaee ||
english: My Creator Lord has made me His own; such is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਧਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੨੪॥
transliteration: abichal neev dharee gur naanak nit nit chaRai savaaee ||2||15||24||
english: Guru Nanak laid the immovable foundation, which grows higher and higher each day. ||2||15||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚੀਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo har siu cheet na laaio ||
english: You never focused your consciousness on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ਅਉਧਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa karat bihaanee audhahi gun nidh naam na gaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You have spent your life engaged in worldly pursuits; you have not sung the Glorious Praises of the treasure of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉਡੀ ਜੋਰਤ ਕਪਟੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kaudee kaudee jorat kapate anik jugat kar dhaaio ||
english: Shell by shell, you accumulate money; in various ways, you work for this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਗਨੀਅਹਿ ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bisarat prabh kete dukh ganeeahi mahaa mohanee khaaio ||1||
english: Forgetting God, you suffer awful pain beyond measure, and you are consumed by the Great Enticer, Maya. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗਨਹੁ ਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਮਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: karahu anugrahu suaamee mere ganahu na mohi kamaaio ||
english: Show Mercy to me, O my Lord and Master, and do not hold me to account for my actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੨੫॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d daiaal kripaal sukh saagar naanak har saranaaio ||2||16||25||
english: O merciful and compassionate Lord God, ocean of peace, Nanak has taken to Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||16||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa raam raam rava(n)t ||
english: With your tongue, chant the Lord's Name, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਆਨ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chhod aan biuhaar mithiaa bhaj sadaa bhagava(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Renounce other false occupations, and vibrate forever on the Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਈਤ ਆਗੈ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: naam ek adhaar bhagataa eet aagai tek ||
english: The One Name is the support of His devotees; in this world, and in the world hereafter, it is their anchor and support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kripaa gobi(n)d deeaa gur giaan budh bibek ||1||
english: In His mercy and kindness, the Guru has given me the divine wisdom of God, and a discriminating intellect. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਹੀ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran sa(n)mrath sreedhar saran taa kee gahee ||
english: The all-powerful Lord is the Creator, the Cause of causes; He is the Master of wealth - I seek His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਰਵਾਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਲਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੨੬॥
transliteration: mukat jugat ravaal saadhoo naanak har nidh lahee ||2||17||26||
english: Liberation and worldly success come from the dust of the feet of the Holy Saints; Nanak has obtained the Lord's treasure. ||2||17||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ghar 4 chaupade ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਉ ॥
transliteration: chhaad sagal siaanapaa saadh saranee aau ||
english: Give up all your clever tricks, and seek the Sanctuary of the Holy Saint.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paarabraham paramesaro prabhoo ke gun gaau ||1||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਚਿਤ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਅਰਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: re chit charan kamal araadh ||
english: O my consciousness, contemplate and adore the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab sookh kaliaan paavahi mitai sagal upaadh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall obtain total peace and salvation, and all troubles shall depart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa sut meet bhaaee tis binaa nahee koi ||
english: Mother, father, children, friends and siblings - without the Lord, none of them are real.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਰਬ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: eet oot jee naal sa(n)gee sarab raviaa soi ||2||
english: Here and hereafter, He is the companion of the soul; He is pervading everywhere. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
transliteration: kot jatan upaav mithiaa kachh na aavai kaam ||
english: Millions of plans, tricks, and efforts are of no use, and serve no purpose.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saran saadhoo niramalaa gat hoi prabh kai naam ||3||
english: In the Sanctuary of the Holy, one becomes immaculate and pure, and obtains salvation, through the Name of God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਊਚਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: agam daiaal prabhoo oochaa saran saadhoo jog ||
english: God is profound and merciful, lofty and exalted; He gives Sanctuary to the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੭॥
transliteration: tis paraapat naanakaa jis likhiaa dhur sa(n)jog ||4||1||27||
english: He alone obtains the Lord, O Nanak, who is blessed with such pre-ordained destiny to meet Him. ||4||1||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਮਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa gur sev sad hee ramahu gun gobi(n)d ||
english: Serve your Guru forever, and chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saas saas araadh har har lahi jaai man kee chi(n)d ||1||
english: With each and every breath, worship the Lord, Har, Har, in adoration, and the anxiety of your mind will be dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mere man jaap prabh kaa naau ||
english: O my mind, chant the Name of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj ana(n)d paavahi milee niramal thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall be blessed with peace, poise and pleasure, and you shall find the immaculate place. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g udhaar ihu man aath pahar aaraadh ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, redeem your mind, and adore the Lord, twenty-four hours a day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar binasai mitai sagal upaadh ||2||
english: Sexual desire, anger and egotism will be dispelled, and all troubles shall end. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਟਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਉ ॥
transliteration: atal achhed abhed suaamee saran taa kee aau ||
english: The Lord Master is immovable, immortal and inscrutable; seek His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: charan kamal araadh hiradai ek siu liv laau ||3||
english: Worship in adoration the lotus feet of the Lord in your heart, and center your consciousness lovingly on Him alone. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੀਨੑੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh daiaa dhaaree bakhas leenhe aap ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has shown mercy to me, and He Himself has forgiven me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੮॥
transliteration: sarab sukh har naam deeaa naanak so prabh jaap ||4||2||28||
english: The Lord has given me His Name, the treasure of peace; O Nanak, meditate on that God. ||4||2||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਈ ਸੰਕਾ ਤੂਟਿ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaadee prabh dhiaaiaa gaee sa(n)kaa toot ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on God, and my doubts are gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਅਨੇਰਾ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਪਾਪ ਗਏ ਨਿਖੂਟਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dukh aneraa bhai binaase paap gae nikhoot ||1||
english: Pain, ignorance and fear have left me, and my sins have been dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: har har naam kee man preet ||
english: My mind is filled with love for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਧਿਆਏ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mil saadh bachan gobi(n)d dhiaae mahaa niramal reet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting the Holy Saint, under His Instruction, I meditate on the Lord of the Universe, in the most immaculate way. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਫਲ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jaap taap anek karanee saphal simarat naam ||
english: Chanting, deep meditation and various rituals are contained in the fruitful meditative remembrance of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kar anugrahu aap raakhe bhae pooran kaam ||2||
english: Showing His Mercy, the Lord Himself has protected me, and all my works have been brought to fruition. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਮਰਥ ॥
transliteration: saas saas na bisar kabahoo(n) braham prabh samarath ||
english: With each and every breath, may I never forget You, O God, Almighty Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਅਨਿਕ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਅਗਨਤ ਸਦਾ ਅਕਥ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gun anik rasanaa kiaa bakhaanai aganat sadaa akath ||3||
english: How can my tongue describe Your countless virtues? They are uncountable, and forever indescribable. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਣ ॥
transliteration: deen darad nivaar taaran daiaal kirapaa karan ||
english: You are the Remover of the pains of the poor, the Savior, the Compassionate Lord, the Bestower of Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਟਲ ਪਦਵੀ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੯॥
transliteration: atal padavee naam simaran driR naanak har har saran ||4||3||29||
english: Remembering the Naam in meditation, the state of eternal dignity is obtained; Nanak has grasped the protection of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਘਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਾ ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)budh bahu saghan maaiaa mahaa deeragh rog ||
english: Intellectual egotism and great love for Maya are the most serious chronic diseases.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har naam aukhadh gur naam deeno karan kaaran jog ||1||
english: The Lord's Name is the medicine, which is potent to cure everything. The Guru has given me the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਾਛੀਐ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man tan baachheeai jan dhoor ||
english: My mind and body yearn for the dust of the Lord's humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਲਹਹਿ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot janam ke lahahi paatik gobi(n)d lochaa poor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: With it, the sins of millions of incarnations are obliterated. O Lord of the Universe, please fulfill my desire. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਆਸਾ ਕੂਕਰੀ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
transliteration: aad a(n)te madh aasaa kookaree bikaraal ||
english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, one is hounded by dreadful desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣੰ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur giaan keeratan gobi(n)d ramana(n) kaateeai jam jaal ||2||
english: Through the Guru's spiritual wisdom, we sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and the noose of death is cut away. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮੂਠੇ ਸਦਾ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh moh moothe sadaa aavaa gavan ||
english: Those who are cheated by sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment suffer reincarnation forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਮਿਟਤ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਵਣ ॥੩॥
transliteration: prabh prem bhagat gupaal simaran mitat jonee bhavan ||3||
english: By loving devotional worship to God, and meditative remembrance of the Lord of the World, one's wandering in reincarnation is ended. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਰ ਰਿਦ ਤੀਨਿ ਤਾਪ ਜਲੰਤ ॥
transliteration: mitr putr kalatr sur rid teen taap jala(n)t ||
english: Friends, children, spouses and well-wishers are burnt by the three fevers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮਾ ਦੁਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jap raam raamaa dukh nivaare milai har jan sa(n)t ||4||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, one's miseries are ended, as one meets the Saintly servants of the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਬਿਧਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਛੋਟਿ ॥
transliteration: sarab bidh bhramate pukaarahi katahi naahee chhot ||
english: Wandering around in all directions, they cry out, "Nothing can save us!"

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਗਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ॥੫॥੪॥੩੦॥
transliteration: har charan saran apaar prabh ke driR gahee naanak ot ||5||4||30||
english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lotus Feet of the Infinite Lord; he holds fast to their Support. ||5||4||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ghar 4 dupade ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਰਾਧਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: aaraadh sreedhar saphal moorat karan kaaran jog ||
english: Worship and adore the Lord of wealth, the fulfilling vision, the Almighty Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਰਮਣ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਅਪਾਰ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gun raman sravan apaar mahimaa phir na hot biog ||1||
english: Uttering His Praises, and hearing of His infinite glory, you shall never suffer separation from Him again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਉਪਾਸ ॥
transliteration: man charanaarabi(n)d upaas ||
english: O my mind, worship the Lord's Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੰਤ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਫਾਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kal kales mita(n)t simaran kaat jamadoot phaas ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating in remembrance, strife and sorrow are ended, and the noose of the Messenger of Death is snapped. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਦਹਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਨ ਅਵਰ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਉਪਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satr dahan har naam kahan avar kachh na upaau ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, and your enemies shall be consumed; there is no other way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
transliteration: kar anugrahu prabhoo mere naanak naam suaau ||2||1||31||
english: Show Mercy, O my God, and bestow upon Nanak the taste of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||1||31||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: too(n) samarath saran ko daataa dukh bha(n)jan sukh raai ||
english: You are the Almighty Lord, the Giver of Sanctuary, the Destroyer of pain, the King of happiness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਹਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaahi kales mite bhai bharamaa niramal gun prabh gaai ||1||
english: Troubles depart, and fear and doubt are dispelled, singing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: govi(n)d tujh bin avar na thaau ||
english: O Lord of the Universe, without You, there is no other place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਪੀ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa paarabraham suaamee japee tumaaraa naau || rahaau ||
english: Show Mercy to me, O Supreme Lord Master, that I may chant Your Name. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਲਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev lage har charanee vadai bhaag liv laagee ||
english: Serving the True Guru, I am attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet; by great good fortune, I have embraced love for Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਵਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਏ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaval pragaas bhae saadhasa(n)ge duramat budh tiaagee ||2||
english: My heart lotus blossoms forth in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I have renounced evil-mindedness and intellectualism. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar har ke gun gaavai simarai deen daiaalaa ||
english: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, twenty-four hours a day, and remembers the Lord in meditation, who is Kind to the poor,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਭ ਉਧਰੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap tarai sa(n)gat sabh udharai binase sagal ja(n)jaalaa ||3||
english: saves himself, and redeems all his generations; all of his bonds are released. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: charan adhaar teraa prabh suaamee ot pot prabh saath ||
english: I take the Support of Your Feet, O God, O Lord and Master; you are with me through and through, God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
transliteration: saran pario naanak prabh tumaree de raakhio har haath ||4||2||32||
english: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, God; giving him His hand, the Lord has protected him. ||4||2||32||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: goojaree asatapadeeaa mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
english: Goojaree, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਗਰੀ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਬਸੀਅਲੇ ਬਰਜਤ ਚੋਰੀ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ek nagaree pa(n)ch chor baseeale barajat choree dhaavai ||
english: In the one village of the body, live the five thieves; they have been warned, but they still go out stealing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਹਦਸ ਮਾਲ ਰਖੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: trihadas maal rakhai jo naanak mokh mukat so paavai ||1||
english: One who keeps his assets safe from the three modes and the ten passions, O Nanak, attains liberation and emancipation. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਹੁ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਉ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: chetahu baasudeu banavaalee ||
english: Center your mind on the all-pervading Lord, the Wearer of garlands of the jungles.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam ridai japamaalee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Let your rosary be the chanting of the Lord's Name in your heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਰਧ ਮੂਲ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਖ ਤਲਾਹਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: uradh mool jis saakh talaahaa chaar bed jit laage ||
english: Its roots extend upwards, and its branches reach down; the four Vedas are attached to it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sahaj bhaai jaai te naanak paarabraham liv jaage ||2||
english: He alone reaches this tree with ease, O Nanak, who remains wakeful in the Love of the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਗਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਪੁਹਪ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਤਤੁ ਡਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: paarajaat ghar aagan merai puhap patr tat daalaa ||
english: The Elysian Tree is the courtyard of my house; in it are the flowers, leaves and stems of reality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸੰਭੂ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sarab jot nira(n)jan sa(n)bhoo chhodahu bahut ja(n)jaalaa ||3||
english: Meditate on the self-existent, immaculate Lord, whose Light is pervading everywhere; renounce all your worldly entanglements. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖਵੰਤੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੈ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sun sikhava(n)te naanak binavai chhodahu maaiaa jaalaa ||
english: Listen, O seekers of Truth - Nanak begs you to renounce the traps of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: man beechaar ek liv laagee punarap janam na kaalaa ||4||
english: Reflect within your mind, that by enshrining love for the One Lord, you shall not be subject to birth and death again. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਸੋ ਵੈਦੁ ਜਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: so guroo so sikh katheeale so vaid j jaanai rogee ||
english: He alone is said to be a Guru, he alone is said to be a Sikh, and he alone is said to be a physician, who knows the patient's illness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕੰਮੁ ਨ ਧੰਧਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜੋਗੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: tis kaaran ka(n)m na dha(n)dhaa naahee dha(n)dhai girahee jogee ||5||
english: He is not affected by actions, responsibilities and entanglements; in the entanglements of his household, he maintains the detachment of Yoga. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar tajeeale lobh mohu tis maaiaa ||
english: He renounces sexual desire, anger, egotism, greed, attachment and Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਤੁ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: man tat avigat dhiaaiaa gur parasaadee paaiaa ||6||
english: Within his mind, he meditates on the reality of the Imperishable Lord; by Guru's Grace he finds Him. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਭ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਸੇਤ ਬਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan sabh daat katheeale set baran sabh dootaa ||
english: Spiritual wisdom and meditation are all said to be God's gifts; all of the demons are turned white before him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਮਲ ਮਧੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਰਸਾਦੰ ਜਾਗਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: braham kamal madh taas rasaada(n) jaagat naahee sootaa ||7||
english: He enjoys the taste of the honey of God's lotus; he remains awake, and does not fall asleep. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੁਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa ga(n)bheer patr paataalaa naanak sarab juaaiaa ||
english: This lotus is very deep; its leaves are the nether regions, and it is connected to the whole universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਪਦੇਸ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਮ ਪੁਨਹਿ ਨ ਗਰਭੰ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਜਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: upades guroo mam punahi na garabha(n) bikh taj a(n)mrit peeaaiaa ||8||1||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, I shall not have to enter the womb again; I have renounced the poison of corruption, and I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||8||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Goojaree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਪਰਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kavan kavan jaachahi prabh daate taa ke a(n)t na parahi sumaar ||
english: Those who beg of God the Great Giver - their numbers cannot be counted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ਹੋਇ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaisee bhookh hoi abh a(n)tar too(n) samarath sach devanahaar ||1||
english: You, Almighty True Lord, fulfill the desires within their hearts. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐ ਜੀ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ai jee jap tap sa(n)jam sach adhaar ||
english: O Dear Lord, chanting, deep meditation, self-discipline and truth are my foundations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam dehi sukh paaeeai teree bhagat bhare bha(n)daar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Bless me with Your Name, Lord, that I may find peace. Your devotional worship is a treasure over-flowing. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਏਕਾ ਏਕੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: su(n)n samaadh rahahi liv laage ekaa ekee sabad beechaar ||
english: Some remain absorbed in Samaadhi, their minds fixed lovingly on the One Lord; they reflect only on the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲੁ ਥਲੁ ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jal thal dharan gagan tah naahee aape aap keeaa karataar ||2||
english: In that state, there is no water, land, earth or sky; only the Creator Lord Himself exists. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨੁ ਨ ਛਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਸੂਰਜ ਚੰਦ ਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naa tad maaiaa magan na chhaaiaa naa sooraj cha(n)d na jot apaar ||
english: There is no intoxication of Maya there, and no shadow, nor the infinite light of the sun or the moon.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਲੋਚਨ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਸੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sarab drisat lochan abh a(n)tar ekaa nadar s tribhavan saar ||3||
english: The eyes within the mind which see everything - with one glance, they see the three worlds. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਵਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸ ਅਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: pavan paanee agan tin keeaa brahamaa bisan mahes akaar ||
english: He created air, water and fire, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva - the whole creation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sarabe jaachik too(n) prabh daataa daat kare apunai beechaar ||4||
english: All are beggars; You alone are the Great Giver, God. You give Your gifts according to Your own considerations. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਇਕ ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kot tetees jaachahi prabh naaik dede tot naahee bha(n)daar ||
english: Three hundred thirty million gods beg of God the Master; even as He gives, His treasures are never exhausted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਂਧੈ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੀਧੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਰੈ ਨਿਹਾਰ ॥੫॥
transliteration: oo(n)dhai bhaa(n)dai kachh na samaavai seedhai a(n)mrit parai nihaar ||5||
english: Nothing can be contained in a vessel turned upside-down; Ambrosial Nectar pours into the upright one. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਜਾਚਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੈਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sidh samaadhee a(n)tar jaachahi ridh sidh jaach karahi jaikaar ||
english: The Siddhas in Samaadhi beg for wealth and miracles, and proclaim His victory.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੈਸੋ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਪਰਕਾਰ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jaisee piaas hoi man a(n)tar taiso jal devahi parakaar ||6||
english: As is the thirst within their minds, so is the water which You give to them. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਭੇਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੁਰਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bade bhaag gur sevahi apunaa bhed naahee guradev muraar ||
english: The most fortunate ones serve their Guru; there is no difference between the Divine Guru and the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੭॥
transliteration: taa kau kaal naahee jam johai boojhahi a(n)tar sabad beechaar ||7||
english: The Messenger of Death cannot see those who come to realize within their minds the contemplative meditation of the Word of the Shabad. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਤਬ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਗਉ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ab tab avar na maagau har pahi naam nira(n)jan deejai piaar ||
english: I shall never ask anything else of the Lord; please, bless me with the Love of Your Immaculate Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak chaatrik a(n)mrit jal maagai har jas deejai kirapaa dhaar ||8||2||
english: Nanak, the song-bird, begs for the Ambrosial Water; O Lord, shower Your Mercy upon him, and bless him with Your Praise. ||8||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Goojaree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐ ਜੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਆਵੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ai jee janam marai aavai phun jaavai bin gur gat nahee kaaee ||
english: O Dear One, he is born, and then dies; he continues coming and going; without the Guru, he is not emancipated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh praanee naame raate naame gat pat paaee ||1||
english: Those mortals who become Gurmukhs are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Name, they obtain salvation and honor. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re raam naam chit laaee ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, focus your consciousness lovingly on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚੇ ਐਸੀ ਨਾਮ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har prabh jaache aisee naam badaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one begs of the Lord God; such is the glorious greatness of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐ ਜੀ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਕਉ ਕੇਤੇ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ai jee bahute bhekh karahi bhikhiaa kau kete udar bharan kai taaee ||
english: O Dear One, so many wear various religious robes, for begging and filling their bellies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin har bhagat naahee sukh praanee bin gur garab na jaaee ||2||
english: Without devotional worship to the Lord, O mortal, there can be no peace. Without the Guru, pride does not depart. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐ ਜੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਵੈਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ai jee kaal sadaa sir oopar thaadhe janam janam vairaaee ||
english: O Dear One, death hangs constantly over his head. Incarnation after incarnation, it is his enemy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਬਾਚੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saachai sabad rate se baache satigur boojh bujhaaee ||3||
english: Those who are attuned to the True Word of the Shabad are saved. The True Guru has imparted this understanding. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸੰਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur saranaaee johi na saakai doot na sakai sa(n)taaee ||
english: In the Guru's Sanctuary, the Messenger of Death cannot see the mortal, or torture him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: avigat naath nira(n)jan raate nirabhau siu liv laaee ||4||
english: I am imbued with the Imperishable and Immaculate Lord Master, and lovingly attached to the Fearless Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ai jeeu naam diRahu naame liv laavahu satigur tek tikaaee ||
english: O Dear One, implant the Naam within me; lovingly attached to the Naam, I lean on the True Guru's Support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karasee kirat na metiaa jaaee ||5||
english: Whatever pleases Him, He does; no one can erase His actions. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐ ਜੀ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਮੈ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ai jee bhaag pare gur saran tumhaaree mai avar na doojee bhaaee ||
english: O Dear One, I have hurried to the Sanctuary of the Guru; I have no love for any other except You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਤਬ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਉ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ab tab eko ek pukaarau aad jugaad sakhaaee ||6||
english: I constantly call upon the One Lord; since the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He has been my help and support. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐ ਜੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: ai jee raakhahu paij naam apune kee tujh hee siu ban aaee ||
english: O Dear One, please preserve the Honor of Your Name; I am hand and glove with You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa gur daras dikhaavahu haumai sabad jalaaee ||7||
english: Bless me with Your Mercy, and reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Guru. Through the Word of the Shabad, I have burnt away my ego. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐ ਜੀ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ai jee kiaa maagau kichh rahai na deesai is jag mahi aaiaa jaaee ||
english: O Dear One, what should I ask of You? Nothing appears permanent; whoever comes into this world shall depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam padaarath deejai hiradai ka(n)th banaaee ||8||3||
english: Bless Nanak with the wealth of the Naam, to adorn his heart and neck. ||8||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Goojaree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐ ਜੀ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਉਤਮ ਨੀਚ ਨ ਮਧਿਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ॥
transliteration: ai jee naa ham utam neech na madhim har saranaagat har ke log ||
english: O Dear One, I am not high or low or in the middle. I am the Lord's slave, and I seek the Lord's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤੇ ਕੇਵਲ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਜੋਗ ਬਿਸਰਜਿਤ ਰੋਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam rate keval bairaagee sog bijog bisarajit rog ||1||
english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am detached from the world; I have forgotten sorrow, separation and disease. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re gur kirapaa te bhagat thaakur kee ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, by Guru's Grace, I perform devotional worship to my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਾਕਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾ ਜਮ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur vaak hiradai har niramal naa jam kaan na jam kee baakee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One whose heart is filled with the Hymns of the True Guru, obtains the Pure Lord. He is not under the power of the Messenger of Death, nor does he owe Death anything. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਸਨ ਰਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗੇ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har gun rasan ravahi prabh sa(n)ge jo tis bhaavai sahaj haree ||
english: He chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord with his tongue, and abides with God; he does whatever pleases the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਗਿ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਮੇਕ ਘਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin har naam brithaa jag jeevan har bin nihaphal mek gharee ||2||
english: Without the Lord's Name, life passes in vain in the world, and every moment is useless. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐ ਜੀ ਖੋਟੇ ਠਉਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ai jee khote thaur naahee ghar baahar ni(n)dak gat nahee kaaee ||
english: The false have no place of rest, either inside or outside; the slanderer does not find salvation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ros karai prabh bakhas na metai nit nit chaRai savaaee ||3||
english: Even if one is resentful, God does not withhold His blessings; day by day, they increase. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐ ਜੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ai jee gur kee daat na metai koee merai thaakur aap divaaee ||
english: No one can take away the Guru's gifts; my Lord and Master Himself has given them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਰ ਕਾਲੇ ਮੁਖ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak nar kaale mukh ni(n)daa jinh gur kee daat na bhaaee ||4||
english: The black-faced slanderers, with slander in their mouths, do not appreciate the Guru's gifts. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐ ਜੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਅਧੂਆ ਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ai jee saran pare prabh bakhas milaavai bilam na adhooaa raaee ||
english: God forgives and blends with Himself those who take to His Sanctuary; He does not delay for an instant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਾਥਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aanad mool naath sir naathaa satigur mel milaaee ||5||
english: He is the source of bliss, the Greatest Lord; through the True Guru, we are united in His Union. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐ ਜੀ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਨਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ai jee sadaa daiaal daiaa kar raviaa guramat bhraman chukaaee ||
english: Through His Kindness, the Kind Lord pervades us; through Guru's Teachings, our wanderings cease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੋਈ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: paaras bhet ka(n)chan dhaat hoee satasa(n)gat kee vadiaaee ||6||
english: Touching the philosopher's stone, metal is transformed into gold. Such is the glorious greatness of the Society of the Saints. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ਮਜਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har jal niramal man isanaanee majan satigur bhaaee ||
english: The Lord is the immaculate water; the mind is the bather, and the True Guru is the bath attendant, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: punarap janam naahee jan sa(n)gat jotee jot milaaee ||7||
english: That humble being who joins the Sat Sangat shall not be consigned to reincarnation again; his light merges into the Light. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮ ਤਰੋਵਰੁ ਹਮ ਪੰਖੀ ਤੁਝ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) vad purakh aga(n)m tarovar ham pa(n)khee tujh maahee ||
english: You are the Great Primal Lord, the infinite tree of life; I am a bird perched on Your branches.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ॥੮॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam nira(n)jan deejai jug jug sabad salaahee ||8||4||
english: Grant to Nanak the Immaculate Naam; throughout the ages, he sings the Praises of the Shabad. ||8||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 1 ghar 4 ||
english: Goojaree, First Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਆਰਾਧਿਤੰ ਸਚੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਪਰਮ ਹਿਤੰ ॥
transliteration: bhagat prem aaraadhita(n) sach piaas param hita(n) ||
english: The devotees worship the Lord in loving adoration. They thirst for the True Lord, with infinite affection.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਲਾਪ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਨੰਤੀਆ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ ਚਿਤ ਹਿਤੰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bilalaap bilal bina(n)teeaa sukh bhaai chit hita(n) ||1||
english: They tearfully beg and implore the Lord; in love and affection, their consciousness is at peace. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jap man naam har saranee ||
english: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my mind, and take to His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣ ਰਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar taar taaran ram naam kar karanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord's Name is the boat to cross over the world-ocean. Practice such a way of life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮਿਰਤ ਸੁਭ ਚਿੰਤੰ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਮਣੰ ॥
transliteration: e man mirat subh chi(n)ta(n) gur sabad har ramana(n) ||
english: O mind, even death wishes you well, when you remember the Lord through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੰ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਮਨਿ ਰਮਣੰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mat tat giaana(n) kaliaan nidhaana(n) har naam man ramana(n) ||2||
english: The intellect receives the treasure, the knowledge of reality and supreme bliss, by repeating the Lord's Name in the mind. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਵਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੰ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਹਿਤੰ ॥
transliteration: chal chit vit bhramaa bhrama(n) jag moh magan hita(n) ||
english: The fickle consciousness wanders around chasing after wealth; it is intoxicated with worldly love and emotional attachment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਿੜੰ ਮਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕਿ ਸਬਦ ਰਤੰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: thir naam bhagat diRa(n) matee gur vaak sabad rata(n) ||3||
english: Devotion to the Naam is permanently implanted within the mind, when it is attuned to the Guru's Teachings and His Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਾਤਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਜਗੁ ਜਨਮਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਖਪੰ ॥
transliteration: bharamaat bharam na chookaee jag janam biaadh khapa(n) ||
english: Wandering around, doubt is not dispelled; afflicted by reincarnation, the world is being ruined.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੰ ਸਤਿ ਮਤੀ ਨਾਮ ਤਪੰ ॥੪॥
transliteration: asathaan har nihakevala(n) sat matee naam tapa(n) ||4||
english: The Lord's eternal throne is free of this affliction; he is truly wise, who takes the Naam as his deep meditation. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹ ਹੇਤ ਬਿਆਪਿਤੰ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੰ ॥
transliteration: ihu jag moh het biaapita(n) dukh adhik janam marana(n) ||
english: This world is engrossed in attachment and transitory love; it suffers the terrible pains of birth and death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਊਬਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਰਮਣੰ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bhaj saran satigur oobarahi har naam rid ramana(n) ||5||
english: Run to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, chant the Lord's Name in your heart, and you shall swim across. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਨੰ ਸਹਜ ਬੀਚਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: guramat nihachal man man mana(n) sahaj beechaara(n) ||
english: Following the Guru's Teaching, the mind becomes stable; the mind accepts it, and reflects upon it in peaceful poise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਰੰ ॥੬॥
transliteration: so man niramal jit saach a(n)tar giaan ratan saara(n) ||6||
english: That mind is pure, which enshrines Truth within, and the most excellent jewel of spiritual wisdom. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਰੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਮਨਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: bhai bhaai bhagat tar bhavajal manaa chit laai har charanee ||
english: By the Fear of God, and Love of God, and by devotion, man crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, focusing his consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਤਉ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har naam hiradai pavitr paavan ihu sareer tau saranee ||7||
english: The Name of the Lord, the most pure and sacred, is within my heart; this body is Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਬ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਾਸਿ ਮਨੰ ॥
transliteration: lab lobh lahar nivaarana(n) har naam raas mana(n) ||
english: The waves of greed and avarice are subdued, by treasuring the Lord's Name in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਰਨੰ ॥੮॥੧॥੫॥
transliteration: man maar tuhee nira(n)janaa kahu naanakaa sarana(n) ||8||1||5||
english: Subdue my mind, O Pure Immaculate Lord; says Nanak, I have entered Your Sanctuary. ||8||1||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
english: Goojaree, Third Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਚਾਈ ॥
transliteration: nirat karee ihu man nachaaee ||
english: I dance, and make this mind dance as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee aap gavaaee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I eliminate my self-conceit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਇਛੀ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chit thir raakhai so mukat hovai jo ichhee soee phal paaee ||1||
english: One who keeps his consciousness focused on the Lord is liberated; he obtains the fruits of his desires. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਚੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਗੈ ॥
transliteration: naach re man gur kai aagai ||
english: So dance, O mind, before your Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਜਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bhaanai naachahi taa sukh paavahi a(n)te jam bhau bhaagai || rahaau ||
english: If you dance according to the Guru's Will, you shall obtain peace, and in the end, the fear of death shall leave you. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਚਾਏ ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aap nachaae so bhagat kaheeai aapanaa piaar aap laae ||
english: One whom the Lord Himself causes to dance, is called a devotee. He Himself links us to His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape gaavai aap sunaavai is man a(n)dhe kau maarag paae ||2||
english: He Himself sings, He Himself listens, and He puts this blind mind on the right path. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਸਕਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: anadin naachai sakat nivaarai siv ghar need na hoee ||
english: One who dances night and day, and banishes Shakti's Maya, enters the House of the Lord Shiva, where there is no sleep.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਸੂਤਾ ਨਾਚੈ ਟਾਪੈ ਅਵਰੋ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sakatee ghar jagat sootaa naachai taapai avaro gaavai manamukh bhagat na hoee ||3||
english: The world is asleep in Maya, the house of Shakti; it dances, jumps and sings in duality. The self-willed manmukh has no devotion. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਖਿ ਕਰਮੀ ਨਾਚੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sur nar virat pakh karamee naache mun jan giaan beechaaree ||
english: The angels, mortals, renunciates, ritualists, silent sages and beings of spiritual wisdom dance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਨਾਚੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik liv laagee naache jin guramukh budh veechaaree ||4||
english: The Siddhas and seekers, lovingly focused on the Lord, dance, as do the Gurmukhs, whose minds dwell in reflective meditation. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਚੇ ਜਿਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)d brahama(n)d trai gun naache jin laagee har liv tumaaree ||
english: The planets and solar systems dance in the three qualities, as do those who bear love for You, Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਚੇ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabhe hee naache naachahi khaanee chaaree ||5||
english: The beings and creatures all dance, and the four sources of creation dance. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavahi seee naachahi jin guramukh sabad liv laae ||
english: They alone dance, who are pleasing to You, and who, as Gurmukhs, embrace love for the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੬॥
transliteration: se bhagat se tat giaanee jin kau hukam manaae ||6||
english: They are devotees, with the essence of spiritual wisdom, who obey the Hukam of His Command. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ehaa bhagat sache siu liv laagai bin sevaa bhagat na hoee ||
english: This is devotional worship, that one loves the True Lord; without service, one cannot be a devotee.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jeevat marai taa sabad beechaarai taa sach paavai koee ||7||
english: If one remains dead while yet alive, he reflects upon the Shabad, and then, he obtains the True Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਅਰਥਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੋਕ ਨਾਚੇ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa kai arath bahut lok naache ko viralaa tat beechaaree ||
english: So many people dance for the sake of Maya; how rare are those who contemplate reality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee soee jan paae jin kau kripaa tumaaree ||8||
english: By Guru's Grace, that humble being obtains You, Lord, upon whom You show Mercy. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਦਮੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik dam saachaa veesarai saa velaa birathaa jaai ||
english: If I forget the True Lord, even for an instant, that time passes in vain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: saahi saahi sadaa samaaleeai aape bakhase kare rajaai ||9||
english: With each and every breath, constantly remember the Lord; He Himself shall forgive you, according to His Will. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: seee naachahi jo tudh bhaavahi j guramukh sabad veechaaree ||
english: They alone dance, who are pleasing to Your Will, and who, as Gurmukhs, contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੦॥੧॥੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak se sahaj sukh paavahi jin kau nadar tumaaree ||10||1||6||
english: Says Nanak, they alone find celestial peace, whom You bless with Your Grace. ||10||1||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
english: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਖੀਰ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har bin jeearaa rahi na sakai jiu baalak kheer adhaaree ||
english: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive, like an infant without milk.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: agam agochar prabh guramukh paaeeai apune satigur kai balihaaree ||1||
english: The inaccessible and incomprehensible Lord God is obtained by the Gurmukh; I am a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: man re har keerat tar taaree ||
english: O my mind, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is a boat to carry you across.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam a(n)mrit jal paaeeai jin kau kripaa tumaaree || rahaau ||
english: The Gurmukhs obtain the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. You bless them with Your Grace. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦਨ ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sanak sana(n)dan naarad mun sevahi anadin japat rahahi banavaaree ||
english: Sanak, Sanandan and Naarad the sage serve You; night and day, they continue to chant Your Name, O Lord of the jungle.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਜਨ ਆਏ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saranaagat prahalaad jan aae tin kee paij savaaree ||2||
english: Slave Prahlaad sought Your Sanctuary, and You saved his honor. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: alakh nira(n)jan eko varatai ekaa jot muraaree ||
english: The One unseen immaculate Lord is pervading everywhere, as is the Light of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh jaachik too eko daataa maagahi haath pasaaree ||3||
english: All are beggars, You alone are the Great Giver. Reaching out our hands, we beg from You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kee ootam baanee gaavahi akath kathaa nit niaaree ||
english: The speech of the humble devotees is sublime; they sing continually the wondrous, Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: saphal janam bhaiaa tin keraa aap tare kul taaree ||4||
english: Their lives become fruitful; they save themselves, and all their generations. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: manamukh dubidhaa duramat biaape jin a(n)tar moh gubaaree ||
