english: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in duality and evil-mindedness; within them is the darkness of attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਓਇ ਡੂਬੇ ਸਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee kathaa na bhaavai oi doobe san paravaaree ||5||
english: They do not love the sermon of the humble Saints, and they are drowned along with their families. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਓਹੁ ਮਲਭਖੁ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak ni(n)daa kar mal dhovai ohu malabhakh maaiaadhaaree ||
english: By slandering, the slanderer washes the filth off others; he is an eater of filth, and a worshipper of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee ni(n)daa viaape naa uravaar na paaree ||6||
english: He indulges in the slander of the humble Saints; he is neither on this shore, nor the shore beyond. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ehu parapa(n)ch khel keeaa sabh karatai har karatai sabh kal dhaaree ||
english: All this worldly drama is set in motion by the Creator Lord; He has infused His almighty strength into all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਸੂਤੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੂਤੁ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har eko soot varatai jug a(n)tar soot khi(n)chai eka(n)kaaree ||7||
english: The thread of the One Lord runs through the world; when He pulls out this thread, the One Creator alone remains. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਿ ਰਸਨਿ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: rasan rasan ras gaavahi har gun rasanaa har ras dhaaree ||
english: With their tongues, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and savor Them. They place the sublime essence of the Lord upon their tongues, and savor it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਗਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak har bin avar na maagau har ras preet piaaree ||8||1||7||
english: O Nanak, other than the Lord, I ask for nothing else; I am in love with the Love of the Lord's sublime essence. ||8||1||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਜਾ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਭੂਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੂਮਾ ॥
transliteration: raajan mahi too(n) raajaa kaheeahi bhooman mahi bhoomaa ||
english: Among kings, You are called the King. Among land-lords, You are the Land-lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੋਮਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਕੋਮਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: thaakur mahi thakuraaee teree koman sir komaa ||1||
english: Among masters, You are the Master. Among tribes, Yours is the Supreme Tribe. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਮੇਰੋ ਬਡੋ ਧਨੀ ਅਗਮਾ ॥
transliteration: pitaa mero bado dhanee agamaa ||
english: My Father is wealthy, deep and profound.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਵਨ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਪੇਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: usatat kavan kareejai karate pekh rahe bisamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: What praises should I chant, O Creator Lord? Beholding You, I am wonder-struck. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੀਅਨ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਦਾਤਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sukheean mahi sukheeaa too(n) kaheeahi daatan sir daataa ||
english: Among the peaceful, You are called the Peaceful One. Among givers, You are the Greatest Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਜਵੰਸੀ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਰਸੀਅਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tejan mahi tejava(n)see kaheeahi raseean mahi raataa ||2||
english: Among the glorious, You are said to be the Most Glorious. Among revellers, You are the Reveller. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਭੋਗਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: sooran mahi sooraa too(n) kaheeahi bhogan mahi bhogee ||
english: Among warriors, You are called the Warrior. Among indulgers, You are the Indulger.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਸਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਡੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤੀ ਜੋਗਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: grasatan mahi too(n) bado grihasatee jogan mahi jogee ||3||
english: Among householders, You are the Great Householder. Among yogis, You are the Yogi. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਆਚਾਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: karatan mahi too(n) karataa kaheeahi aachaaran mahi aachaaree ||
english: Among creators, You are called the Creator. Among the cultured, You are the Cultured One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: saahan mahi too(n) saachaa saahaa vaapaaran mahi vaapaaree ||4||
english: Among bankers, You are the True Banker. Among merchants, You are the Merchant. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਬਾਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ਸਰਨ ਪਾਲਨ ਟੀਕਾ ॥
transliteration: darabaaran mahi tero darabaaraa saran paalan teekaa ||
english: Among courts, Yours is the Court. Yours is the Most Sublime of Sanctuaries.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖਿਮੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਗਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਗਨਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਸੀਕਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: lakhimee ketak ganee na jaaeeai gan na sakau seekaa ||5||
english: The extent of Your wealth cannot be determined. Your Coins cannot be counted. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮਾ ਗਿਆਨਨ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: naaman mahi tero prabh naamaa giaanan mahi giaanee ||
english: Among names, Your Name, God, is the most respected. Among the wise, You are the Wisest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਇਸਨਾਨਨ ਮਹਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jugatan mahi teree prabh jugataa isanaanan mahi isanaanee ||6||
english: Among ways, Yours, God, is the Best Way. Among purifying baths, Yours is the Most Purifying. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਧਾ ਕਰਮਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: sidhan mahi teree prabh sidhaa karaman sir karamaa ||
english: Among spiritual powers, Yours, O God, are the Spiritual Powers. Among actions, Yours are the Greatest Actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗਿਆ ਹੁਕਮਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aagiaa mahi teree prabh aagiaa hukaman sir hukamaa ||7||
english: Among wills, Your Will, God, is the Supreme Will. Of commands, Yours is the Supreme Command. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਬੋਲਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਨ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jiu bolaavahi tiu bolah suaamee kudarat kavan hamaaree ||
english: As You cause me to speak, so do I speak, O Lord Master. What other power do I have?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੮॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak jas gaaio jo prabh kee at piaaree ||8||1||8||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, sing His Praises; they are so very dear to God. ||8||1||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ghar 4 ||
english: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਥ ਨਰਹਰ ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧਵ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: naath narahar deen ba(n)dhav patit paavan dev ||
english: O Lord, Man-lion Incarnate, Companion to the poor, Divine Purifier of sinners;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨਾਸ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਫਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhai traas naas kripaal gun nidh saphal suaamee sev ||1||
english: O Destroyer of fear and dread, Merciful Lord Master, Treasure of Excellence, fruitful is Your service. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: har gopaal gur gobi(n)d ||
english: O Lord, Cherisher of the World, Guru-Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੇਸਵ ਤਾਰਿ ਜਗ ਭਵ ਸਿੰਧ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: charan saran daiaal kesav taar jag bhav si(n)dh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O Merciful Lord. Carry me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਹਰਨ ਮਦ ਮੋਹ ਦਹਨ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਕਰੰਦ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh haran mad moh dahan muraar man makara(n)d ||
english: O Dispeller of sexual desire and anger, Eliminator of intoxication and attachment, Destroyer of ego, Honey of the mind;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥੨॥
transliteration: janam maran nivaar dharaneedhar pat raakh paramaana(n)d ||2||
english: set me free from birth and death, O Sustainer of the earth, and preserve my honor, O Embodiment of supreme bliss. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਤਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਮੰਤ ॥
transliteration: jalat anik tara(n)g maaiaa gur giaan har rid ma(n)t ||
english: The many waves of desire for Maya are burnt away, when the Guru's spiritual wisdom is enshrined in the heart, through the Guru's Mantra.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੇਦਿ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਚਿੰਤ ਮੇਟਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਨੰਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chhed aha(n)budh karunaa mai chi(n)t met purakh ana(n)t ||3||
english: Destroy my egotism, O Merciful Lord; dispel my anxiety, O Infinite Primal Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਪਲ ਮਹੂਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: simar samarath pal mahoorat prabh dhiaan sahaj samaadh ||
english: Remember in meditation the Almighty Lord, every moment and every instant; meditate on God in the celestial peace of Samaadhi.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾਚੀਐ ਰਜ ਸਾਧ ॥੪॥
transliteration: deen daiaal prasa(n)n pooran jaacheeai raj saadh ||4||
english: O Merciful to the meek, perfectly blissful Lord, I beg for the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਿਥਨ ਦੁਰੰਤ ਆਸਾ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: moh mithan dura(n)t aasaa baasanaa bikaar ||
english: Emotional attachment is false, desire is filthy, and longing is corrupt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਖੁ ਧਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਉਧਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੫॥
transliteration: rakh dharam bharam bidaar man te udhar har nira(n)kaar ||5||
english: Please, preserve my faith, dispel these doubts from my mind, and save me, O Formless Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਢਿ ਆਢਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਹੋਤ ਜਿਨਾ ਨ ਚੀਰ ॥
transliteration: dhanaadh aadh bha(n)daar har nidh hot jinaa na cheer ||
english: They have become wealthy, loaded with the treasures of the Lord's riches; they were lacking even clothes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਲ ਮੁਗਧ ਮੂੜ ਕਟਾਖੵ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਮਤਿ ਧੀਰ ॥੬॥
transliteration: khal mugadh mooR kataakhy sreedhar bhae gun mat dheer ||6||
english: The idiotic, foolish and senseless people have become virtuous and patient, receiving the Gracious Glance of the Lord of wealth. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jeevan mukat jagadees jap man dhaar rid parateet ||
english: Become Jivan-Mukta, liberated while yet alive, by meditating on the Lord of the Universe, O mind, and maintaining faith in Him in your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਰਮਣੰ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸਹ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jee daiaa maiaa sarabatr ramana(n) param ha(n)sah reet ||7||
english: Show kindness and mercy to all beings, and realize that the Lord is pervading everywhere; this is the way of life of the enlightened soul, the supreme swan. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਤ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਨਾਮ ਉਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: det darasan sravan har jas rasan naam uchaar ||
english: He grants the Blessed Vision of His Darshan to those who listen to His Praises, and who, with their tongues, chant His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥੫॥੧॥੧॥੨॥੫੭॥
transliteration: a(n)g sa(n)g bhagavaan parasan prabh naanak patit udhaar ||8||1||2||5||1||1||2||57||
english: They are part and parcel, life and limb with the Lord God; O Nanak, they feel the Touch of God, the Savior of sinners. ||8||1||2||5||1||1||2||57||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਸਿਕੰਦਰ ਬਿਰਾਹਿਮ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਗਾਉਣੀ ॥
transliteration: goojaree kee vaar mahalaa 3 sika(n)dar biraahim kee vaar kee dhunee gaaunee ||
english: Goojaree Ki Vaar, Third Mehl, Sung In The Tune Of The Vaar Of Sikandar & Biraahim:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੁਆ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ihu jagat mamataa muaa jeevan kee bidh naahi ||
english: This world perishing in attachment and possessiveness; no one knows the way of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵਣ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bhaanai jo chalai taa(n) jeevan padavee paahi ||
english: One who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, obtains the supreme status of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਜੀਵਤੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: oi sadaa sadaa jan jeevate jo har charanee chit laahi ||
english: Those humble beings who focus their consciousness on the Lord's Feet, live forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree man vasai guramukh sahaj samaahi ||1||
english: O Nanak, by His Grace, the Lord abides in the minds of the Gurmukhs, who merge in celestial bliss. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਮਾਰ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar sahasaa dukh hai aapai sir dha(n)dhai maar ||
english: Within the self is the pain of doubt; engrossed in worldly affairs, they are killing themselves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai sute kabahi na jaagahi maaiaa moh piaar ||
english: Asleep in the love of duality, they never wake up; they are in love with, and attached to Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naam na chetahi sabad na veechaarahi ihu manamukh kaa aachaar ||
english: They do not think of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and they do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad. This is the conduct of the self-willed manmukhs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har naam na paaiaa janam birathaa gavaaiaa naanak jam maar kare khuaar ||2||
english: They do not obtain the Lord's Name, and they waste away their lives in vain; O Nanak, the Messenger of Death punishes and dishonors them. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਤਦਹੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa aap upaaion tadahu hor na koee ||
english: He created Himself - at that time, there was no other.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: mataa masoorat aap kare jo kare s hoee ||
english: He consulted Himself for advice, and what He did came to pass.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਦਹੁ ਆਕਾਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਤਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tadahu aakaas na paataal hai naa trai loee ||
english: At that time, there were no Akaashic Ethers, no nether regions, nor the three worlds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਦਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tadahu aape aap nira(n)kaar hai naa opat hoee ||
english: At that time, only the Formless Lord Himself existed - there was no creation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu tis bhaavai tivai kare tis bin avar na koee ||1||
english: As it pleased Him, so did He act; without Him, there was no other. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saahib meraa sadaa hai disai sabad kamaai ||
english: My Master is eternal. He is seen by practicing the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਅਉਹਾਣੀ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ohu auhaanee kade naahi naa aavai naa jaai ||
english: He never perishes; He does not come or go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੋ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa so seveeai jo sabh mahi rahai samaai ||
english: So serve Him, forever and ever; He is contained in all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਿਉ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਜੰਮੈ ਤੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: avar doojaa kiu seveeai ja(n)mai tai mar jaai ||
english: Why serve another who is born, and then dies?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਵਰੀ ਕਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: nihaphal tin kaa jeeviaa j khasam na jaanahi aapanaa avaree kau chit laai ||
english: Fruitless is the life of those who do not know their Lord and Master, and who center their consciousness on others.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੇਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ev na jaapaee karataa ketee dei sajaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, it cannot be known, how much punishment the Creator shall inflict on them. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
transliteration: sachaa naam dhiaaeeai sabho varatai sach ||
english: Meditate on the True Name; the True Lord is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak hukam bujh paravaan hoi taa phal paavai sach ||
english: O Nanak, by understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, one becomes acceptable, and then obtains the fruit of Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kathanee badanee karataa phirai hukamai mool na bujhaee a(n)dhaa kach nikach ||2||
english: He wanders around babbling and speaking, but he does not understand the Lord's Command at all. He is blind, the falsest of the false. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)jog vijog upaaion srisatee kaa mool rachaaiaa ||
english: Creating union and separation, He laid the foundations of the Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hukamee srisat saajeean jotee jot milaaiaa ||
english: By His Command, the Lord of Light fashioned the Universe, and infused His Divine Light into it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਹੂੰ ਸਭੁ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jotee hoo(n) sabh chaananaa satigur sabad sunaaiaa ||
english: From the Lord of Light, all light originates. The True Guru proclaims the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes trai gun sir dha(n)dhai laaiaa ||
english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, under the influence of the three dispositions, were put to their tasks.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maaiaa kaa mool rachaaion tureeaa sukh paaiaa ||2||
english: He created the root of Maya, and the peace obtained in the fourth state of consciousness. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਪੁ ਸੋ ਤਪੁ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so jap so tap j satigur bhaavai ||
english: That alone is chanting, and that alone is deep meditation, which is pleasing to the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai vadiaaee paavai ||
english: Pleasing the True Guru, glorious greatness is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak aap chhod gur maahi samaavai ||1||
english: O Nanak, renouncing self-conceit, one merges into the Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sikh ko viralaa levai ||
english: How rare are those who receive the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jis aap vadiaaee devai ||2||
english: O Nanak, he alone receives it, whom the Lord Himself blesses with glorious greatness. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu agiaan hai bikham at bhaaree ||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya is spiritual darkness; it is very difficult and such a heavy load.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਥਰ ਪਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pathar paap bahu ladiaa kiu tareeai taaree ||
english: Loaded with so very many stones of sin, how can the boat cross over?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhagatee ratiaa har paar utaaree ||
english: Those who are attuned to the Lord's devotional worship night and day are carried across.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਛਡਿ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee man niramalaa haumai chhad vikaaree ||
english: Under the Instruction of the Guru's Shabad, one sheds egotism and corruption, and the mind becomes immaculate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har naam dhiaaeeai har har nisataaree ||3||
english: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; the Lord, Har, Har, is our Saving Grace. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸੰਕੁੜਾ ਰਾਈ ਦਸਵੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer mukat duaaraa sa(n)kuRaa raaee dasavai bhaai ||
english: O Kabeer, the gate of liberation is narrow, less than one-tenth of a mustard seed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਉ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਾ ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man tau maigal hoi rahaa nikasiaa kiu kar jaai ||
english: The mind has become as big as an elephant; how can it pass through this gate?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੁਠਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aisaa satigur je milai tuthaa kare pasaau ||
english: If one meets such a True Guru, by His Pleasure, He shows His Mercy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਮੋਕਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mukat duaaraa mokalaa sahaje aavau jaau ||1||
english: Then, the gate of liberation becomes wide open, and the soul easily passes through. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕਾ ਨਾਨੑਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak mukat duaaraa at neekaa naanhaa hoi s jaai ||
english: O Nanak, the gate of liberation is very narrow; only the very tiny can pass through.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਅਸਥੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਚੁ ਦੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai man asathool hai kiu kar vich de jaai ||
english: Through egotism, the mind has become bloated. How can it pass through?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਭ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai haumai gaee jot rahee sabh aai ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, egotism departs, and one is filled with the Divine Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ihu jeeu sadaa mukat hai sahaje rahiaa samaai ||2||
english: Then, this soul is liberated forever, and it remains absorbed in celestial bliss. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh sa(n)saar upaai kai vas aapanai keetaa ||
english: God created the Universe, and He keeps it under His power.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਣਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ganatai prabhoo na paaeeai doojai bharameetaa ||
english: God cannot be obtained by counting; the mortal wanders in doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai jeevat marai bujh sach sameetaa ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, one remains dead while yet alive; understanding Him, he is absorbed in the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sabade haumai khoeeai har mel mileetaa ||
english: Through the Word of the Shabad, egotism is eradicated, and one is united in the Lord's Union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਗਸੀਤਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sabh kichh jaanai kare aap aape vigaseetaa ||4||
english: He knows everything, and Himself does everything; beholding His Creation, He rejoices. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur siu chit na laaio naam na vasio man aai ||
english: One who has not focused his consciousness on the True Guru, and into whose mind the Naam does not come

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਇਵੇਹਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: dhrig ivehaa jeeviaa kiaa jug mahi paaiaa aai ||
english: cursed is such a life. What has he gained by coming into the world?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਚਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa khotee raas hai ek chase mahi paaj lahi jaai ||
english: Maya is false capital; in an instant, its false covering falls off.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਥਹੁ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਤਨੁ ਸਿਆਹੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਦਨੁ ਜਾਇ ਕੁਮਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hathahu chhuRakee tan siaahu hoi badan jaai kumalaai ||
english: When it slips from his hand, his body turns black, and his face withers away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jin satigur siu chit laaiaa tinh sukh vasiaa man aai ||
english: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru - peace comes to abide in their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har naam dhiaavahi ra(n)g siu har naam rahe liv laai ||
english: They meditate on the Name of the Lord with love; they are lovingly attuned to the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਜਿ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak satigur so dhan saupiaa j jee mahi rahiaa samaai ||
english: O Nanak, the True Guru has bestowed upon them the wealth, which remains contained within their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਉ ਅਗਲਾ ਵੰਨੀ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ra(n)g tisai kau agalaa va(n)nee chaRai chaRaai ||1||
english: They are imbued with supreme love; its color increases day by day. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਹੋਈ ਨਾਗਨੀ ਜਗਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa hoee naaganee jagat rahee lapataai ||
english: Maya is a serpent, clinging to the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: is kee sevaa jo kare tis hee kau phir khaai ||
english: Whoever serves her, she ultimately devours.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਗਾਰੜੂ ਤਿਨਿ ਮਲਿ ਦਲਿ ਲਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh koee gaaraRoo tin mal dal laaee paai ||
english: The Gurmukh is a snake-charmer; he has trampled her and thrown her down, and crushed her underfoot.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak seee ubare j sach rahe liv laai ||2||
english: O Nanak, they alone are saved, who remain lovingly absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: dhaadhee kare pukaar prabhoo sunaaisee ||
english: The minstrel cries out, and God hears him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧੀਰਕ ਹੋਇ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar dheerak hoi pooraa paaisee ||
english: He is comforted within his mind, and he obtains the Perfect Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa lekh se karam kamaaisee ||
english: Whatever destiny is pre-ordained by the Lord, those are the deeds he does.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa hovai khasam daiaal taa mahal ghar paaisee ||
english: When the Lord and Master becomes Merciful, then one obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence as his home.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਾਇਸੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: so prabh meraa at vadaa guramukh melaaisee ||5||
english: That God of mine is so very great; as Gurmukh, I have met Him. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa kaa sahu ek hai sad hee rahai hajoor ||
english: There is One Lord God of all; He remains ever-present.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਈ ਤਾ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak hukam na ma(n)naee taa ghar hee a(n)dar door ||
english: O Nanak, if one does not obey the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then within one's own home, the Lord seems far away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭੀ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਨਾਇਸੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: hukam bhee tinhaa manaaisee jinh kau nadar karei ||
english: They alone obey the Lord's Command, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hukam ma(n)n sukh paaiaa prem suhaagan hoi ||1||
english: Obeying His Command, one obtains peace, and becomes the happy, loving soul-bride. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਜਲਿ ਮੁਈ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rain sabaaee jal muee ka(n)t na laaio bhaau ||
english: She who does not love her Husband Lord, burns and wastes away all through the night of her life.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਨਿ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sukh vasan souhaaganee jinh piaaraa purakh har raau ||2||
english: O Nanak, the soul-brides dwell in peace; they have the Lord, their King, as their Husband. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag phir mai dekhiaa har iko daataa ||
english: Roaming over the entire world, I have seen that the Lord is the only Giver.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: upaai kitai na paaeeai har karam bidhaataa ||
english: The Lord cannot be obtained by any device at all; He is the Architect of Karma.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee har man vasai har sahaje jaataa ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and the Lord is easily revealed within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)darahu trisanaa agan bujhee har a(n)mrit sar naataa ||
english: The fire of desire within is quenched, and one bathes in the Lord's Pool of Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਾਤਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: vadee vadiaaee vade kee guramukh bolaataa ||6||
english: The great greatness of the great Lord God - the Gurmukh speaks of this. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਪਇਆ ਹੀ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa ha(n)s kiaa preet hai j paiaa hee chhad jaai ||
english: What love is this between the body and soul, which ends when the body falls?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਸ ਨੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਿ ਖਵਾਲੀਐ ਜਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: es no kooR bol k khavaaleeai j chaladiaa naal na jaai ||
english: Why feed it by telling lies? When you leave, it does not go with you.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਮਿਟੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਪਉਣੈ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa mitee a(n)dh hai paunai puchhahu jaai ||
english: The body is merely blind dust; go, and ask the soul.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hau taa maaiaa mohiaa phir phir aavaa jaai ||
english: The soul answers, "I am enticed by Maya, and so I come and go, again and again."

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਤੋ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਜਿ ਰਹਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak hukam na jaato khasam kaa j rahaa sach samaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, I do not know my Lord and Master's Command, by which I would merge in the Truth. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: eko nihachal naam dhan hor dhan aavai jaai ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only permanent wealth; all other wealth comes and goes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਨਾ ਓਚਕਾ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: is dhan kau tasakar johi na sakaee naa ochakaa lai jaai ||
english: Thieves cannot steal this wealth, nor can robbers take it away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜੀਐ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜੀਐ ਨਾਲੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu har dhan jeeai setee rav rahiaa jeeai naale jaai ||
english: This wealth of the Lord is embedded in the soul, and with the soul, it shall depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: poore gur te paaeeai manamukh palai na paai ||
english: It is obtained from the Perfect Guru; the self-willed manmukhs do not receive it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhan vaapaaree naanakaa jinhaa naam dhan khatiaa aai ||2||
english: Blessed are the traders, O Nanak, who have come to earn the wealth of the Naam. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa saahib at vadaa sach gahir ga(n)bheeraa ||
english: My Master is so very great, true, profound and unfathomable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਚੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag tis kai vas hai sabh tis kaa cheeraa ||
english: The whole world is under His power; everything is the projection of Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeeai nihachal dhan dheeraa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the eternal wealth is obtained, bringing peace and patience to the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa te har man vasai bhetai gur sooraa ||
english: By His Grace, the Lord dwells in the mind, and one meets the Brave Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gunava(n)tee saalaahiaa sadaa thir nihachal har pooraa ||7||
english: The virtuous praise the ever-stable, permanent, perfect Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhrig tinhaa daa jeeviaa jo har sukh parahar tiaagade dukh haumai paap kamaai ||
english: Cursed is the life of those who forsake and throw away the peace of the Lord's Name, and suffer pain instead by practicing ego and sin.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh agiaanee maaiaa mohi viaape tinh boojh na kaaee paai ||
english: The ignorant self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in the love of Maya; they have no understanding at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਓਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: halat palat oi sukh na paavahi a(n)t gae pachhutaai ||
english: In this world and in the world beyond, they do not find peace; in the end, they depart regretting and repenting.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ko naam dhiaae tis haumai vichahu jaai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one may meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and egotism departs from within him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਆਇ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jis poorab hovai likhiaa so gur charanee aai paai ||1||
english: O Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny, comes and falls at the Guru's Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਊਧਾ ਕਉਲੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: manamukh oodhaa kaul hai naa tis bhagat na naau ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is like the inverted lotus; he has neither devotional worship, nor the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਕਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਉਪਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sakatee a(n)dar varatadaa kooR tis kaa hai upaau ||
english: He remains engrossed in material wealth, and his efforts are false.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਫੀਕਾ ਆਲਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa a(n)dar chit na bhijaee mukh pheekaa aalaau ||
english: His consciousness is not softened within, and the words from his mouth are insipid.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਧਰਮਿ ਰਲਾਏ ਨਾ ਰਲਨੑਿ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: oi dharam ralaae naa ralanhi onaa a(n)dar kooR suaau ||
english: He does not mingle with the righteous; within him are falsehood and selfishness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੈ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak karatai banat banaaee manamukh kooR bol bol dube guramukh tare jap har naau ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Creator Lord has arranged things, so that the self-willed manmukhs are drowned by telling lies, while the Gurmukhs are saved by chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਵਡਾ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin boojhe vadaa pher paiaa phir aavai jaaee ||
english: Without understanding, one must wander around the cycle of reincarnation, and continue coming and going.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨ ਕੀਤੀਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee sevaa na keeteeaa a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaaee ||
english: One who has not served the True Guru, shall depart regretting and repenting in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aapanee kirapaa kare gur paaeeai vichahu aap gavaaee ||
english: But if the Lord shows His Mercy, one finds the Guru, and ego is banished from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa bhukh vichahu utarai sukh vasai man aaee ||
english: Hunger and thirst depart from within, and peace comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa saalaaheeai hiradai liv laaee ||8||
english: Forever and ever, praise Him with love in your heart. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪੂਜੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: j satigur seve aapanaa tis no pooje sabh koi ||
english: One who serves his True Guru, is worshipped by everyone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਉਪਾਵਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਉਪਾਉ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa upaavaa sir upaau hai har naam paraapat hoi ||
english: Of all efforts, the supreme effort is the attainment of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar seetal saat vasai jap hiradai sadaa sukh hoi ||
english: Peace and tranquility come to dwell within the mind; meditating within the heart, there comes a lasting peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit khaanaa a(n)mrit painanaa naanak naam vadaaee hoi ||1||
english: The Ambrosial Amrit is his food, and the Ambrosial Amrit is his clothes; O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, greatness is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: e man gur kee sikh sun har paavahi gunee nidhaan ||
english: O mind, listen to the Guru's Teachings, and you shall obtain the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: har sukhadaataa man vasai haumai jaai gumaan ||
english: The Lord, the Giver of peace, shall dwell in your mind, and your egotism and pride shall depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai taa anadin laagai dhiaan ||2||
english: O Nanak, when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then, night and day, one centers his meditation on the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh sabh sach hai guramukh pavitaa ||
english: The Gurmukh is totally truthful, content and pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਗਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)darahu kapat vikaar gaiaa man sahaje jitaa ||
english: Deception and wickedness have departed from within him, and he easily conquers his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਅਨੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tah jot pragaas ana(n)d ras agiaan gavitaa ||
english: There, the Divine Light and the essence of bliss are manifest, and ignorance is eliminated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: anadin har ke gun ravai gun paragat kitaa ||
english: Night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and manifests the excellence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਇਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਤਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: sabhanaa daataa ek hai iko har mitaa ||9||
english: The One Lord is the Giver of all; the Lord alone is our friend. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: braham bi(n)de so braahaman kaheeai j anadin har liv laae ||
english: One who understands God, who lovingly centers his mind on the Lord night and day, is called a Brahmin.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਛੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur puchhai sach sa(n)jam kamaavai haumai rog tis jaae ||
english: Consulting the True Guru, he practices Truth and self-restraint, and he is rid of the disease of ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavai gun sa(n)grahai jotee jot milaae ||
english: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and gathers in His Praises; his light is blended with the Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: is jug mahi ko viralaa braham giaanee j haumai met samaae ||
english: In this world, one who knows God is very rare; eradicating ego, he is absorbed in God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tis no miliaa sadaa sukh paaeeai j anadin har naam dhiaae ||1||
english: O Nanak, meeting him, peace is obtained; night and day, he meditates on the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kapat manamukh agiaanee rasanaa jhooth bolaai ||
english: Within the ignorant self-willed manmukh is deception; with his tongue, he speaks lies.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਪਟਿ ਕੀਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kapat keetai har purakh na bheejai nit vekhai sunai subhaai ||
english: Practicing deception, he does not please the Lord God, who always sees and hears with natural ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਜਗੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai jaai jag parabodhai bikh maaiaa moh suaai ||
english: In the love of duality, he goes to instruct the world, but he is engrossed in the poison of Maya and attachment to pleasure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੰਮੈ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: it kamaanai sadaa dukh paavai ja(n)mai marai phir aavai jaai ||
english: By doing so, he suffers in constant pain; he is born and then dies, and comes and goes again and again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sahasaa mool na chukaee vich visataa pachai pachaai ||
english: His doubts do not leave him at all, and he rots away in manure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis no kripaa kare meraa suaamee tis gur kee sikh sunaai ||
english: One, unto whom my Lord Master shows His Mercy, listens to the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har naam dhiaavai har naamo gaavai har naamo a(n)t chhadaai ||2||
english: He meditates on the Lord's Name, and sings the Lord's Name; in the end, the Lord's Name will deliver him. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਇਓਨੁ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jinaa hukam manaaion te poore sa(n)saar ||
english: Those who obey the Hukam of the Lord's Command, are the perfect persons in the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵਨੑਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saahib sevanhi aapanaa poorai sabad veechaar ||
english: They serve their Lord Master, and reflect upon the Perfect Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har kee sevaa chaakaree sachai sabad piaar ||
english: They serve the Lord, and love the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har kaa mahal tinhee paaiaa jinh haumai vichahu maar ||
english: They attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, as they eradicate egotism from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh mil rahe jap har naamaa ur dhaar ||10||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs remain united with Him, chanting the Name of the Lord, and enshrining it within their hearts. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh dhiaan sahaj dhun upajai sach naam chit laaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord; the celestial sound-current resounds within him, and he focuses his consciousness on the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh anadin rahai ra(n)g raataa har kaa naam man bhaaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukh remains imbued with the Lord's Love, night and day; his mind is pleased with the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har vekhahi guramukh har bolahi guramukh har sahaj ra(n)g laaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukh beholds the Lord, the Gurmukh speaks of the Lord, and the Gurmukh naturally loves the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਮਰ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh giaan paraapat hovai timar agiaan adher chukaaiaa ||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains spiritual wisdom, and the pitch-black darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis no karam hovai dhur pooraa tin guramukh har naam dhiaaiaa ||1||
english: One who is blessed by the Perfect Lord's Grace - as Gurmukh, he meditates on the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur jinaa na sevio sabad na lago piaar ||
english: Those who do not serve the True Guru do not embrace love for the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sahaje naam na dhiaaiaa kit aaiaa sa(n)saar ||
english: They do not meditate on the Celestial Naam, the Name of the Lord - why did they even bother to come into the world?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਸਦਾ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: phir phir joonee paaeeai visataa sadaa khuaar ||
english: Time and time again, they are reincarnated, and they rot away forever in manure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kooRai laalach lagiaa naa uravaar na paar ||
english: They are attached to false greed; they are not on this shore, nor on the one beyond.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh ubare j aap mele karataar ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; the Creator Lord unites them with Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhagat sachai dar sohade sachai sabad rahaae ||
english: The devotees look beauteous in the True Court of the Lord; they abide in the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਊਪਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har kee preet tin oopajee har prem kasaae ||
english: The Lord's Love wells up in them; they are attracted by the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g rahahi sadaa ra(n)g raate rasanaa har ras piaae ||
english: They abide in the Lord's Love, they remain imbued with the Lord's Love forever, and with their tongues, they drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam jinhee guramukh jaataa har jeeu ridai vasaae ||
english: Fruitful are the lives of those Gurmukhs who recognize the Lord and enshrine Him in their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਏ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: baajh guroo phirai bilalaadee doojai bhaai khuaae ||11||
english: Without the Guru, they wander around crying out in misery; in the love of duality, they are ruined. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਖਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kalijug mahi naam nidhaan bhagatee khatiaa har utam pad paaiaa ||
english: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the devotees earn the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they obtain the supreme status of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev har naam man vasaaiaa anadin naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: Serving the True Guru, they enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds, and they meditate on the Naam, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: viche grih gur bachan udaasee haumai mohu jalaaiaa ||
english: Within the home of their own selves, they remain unattached, through the Guru's Teachings; they burn away egotism and emotional attachment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਲ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aap tariaa kul jagat taraaiaa dha(n)n janedee maaiaa ||
english: They save themselves, and they save the whole world. Blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aisaa satigur soee paae jis dhur masatak har likh paaiaa ||
english: He alone finds such a True Guru, upon whose forehead the Lord inscribed such pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak balihaaree gur aapane vitahu jin bhram bhulaa maarag paaiaa ||1||
english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to his Guru; when he was wandering in doubt, He placed him on the Path. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੀਪਕਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: trai gun maaiaa vekh bhule jiu dekh deepak pata(n)g pachaaiaa ||
english: Beholding Maya with her three dispositions, he goes astray; he is like the moth, which sees the flame, and is consumed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਭੁਲਿ ਭੁਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਦਿਖਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਕਿਹੁ ਆਣਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit bhul bhul maaiaa vekhahi dikhaa kinai kihu aan chaRaaiaa ||
english: The mistaken, deluded Pandits gaze upon Maya, and watch to see whether anyone has offered them something.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪੜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਦਯਿ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai paRahi nit bikhiaa naavahu day khuaaiaa ||
english: In the love of duality, they read continually about sin, while the Lord has withheld His Name from them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਭੁਲੇ ਓਨੑਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jogee ja(n)gam sa(n)niaasee bhule onhaa aha(n)kaar bahu garab vadhaaiaa ||
english: The Yogis, the wandering hermits and the Sannyaasees have gone astray; their egotism and arrogance have increased greatly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਛਾਦਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨ ਲੈਹੀ ਸਤ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: chhaadan bhojan na laihee sat bhikhiaa manahath janam gavaaiaa ||
english: They do not accept the true donations of clothes and food, and their lives are ruined by their stubborn minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਤੜਿਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਮਧਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: etaRiaa vichahu so jan samadhaa jin guramukh naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: Among these, he alone is a man of poise, who, as Gurmukh, meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak kis no aakh sunaaeeai jaa karade sabh karaaiaa ||2||
english: Unto whom should servant Nanak speak and complain? All act as the Lord causes them to act. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu paret hai kaam krodh aha(n)kaaraa ||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya, sexual desire, anger and egotism are demons.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਏਨੑਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: eh jam kee sirakaar hai enhaa upar jam kaa da(n)d karaaraa ||
english: Because of them, mortals are subject to death; above their heads hangs the heavy club of the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਪਾਈਅਨੑਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh jam mag paaeeanhi jinh doojaa bhaau piaaraa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs, in love with duality, are led onto the path of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਨ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jam pur badhe maareean ko sunai na pookaaraa ||
english: In the City of Death, they are tied up and beaten, and no one hears their cries.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: jis no kripaa kare tis gur milai guramukh nisataaraa ||12||
english: One who is blessed by the Lord's Grace meets the Guru; as Gurmukh, he is emancipated. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਗਈ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa mohanee manamukhaa no gaee khaai ||
english: By egotism and pride, the self-willed manmukhs are enticed, and consumed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਵਿਆਪਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo mohi doojai chit laaide tinaa viaap rahee lapataai ||
english: Those who center their consciousness on duality are caught in it, and remain stuck.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰਜਾਲੀਐ ਤਾ ਏਹ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad parajaaleeai taa eh vichahu jaai ||
english: But when it is burnt away by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, only then does it depart from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਜਲਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: tan man hovai ujalaa naam vasai man aai ||
english: The body and mind become radiant and bright, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak maaiaa kaa maaran har naam hai guramukh paaiaa jaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Lord's Name is the antidote to Maya; the Gurmukh obtains it. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਭਰਮਿਆ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu man ketaRiaa jug bharamiaa thir rahai na aavai jaai ||
english: This mind has wandered through so many ages; it has not remained stable - it continues coming and going.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਭਰਮਾਇਅਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har bhaanaa taa bharamaaian kar parapa(n)ch khel upaai ||
english: When it is pleasing to the Lord's Will, then He causes the soul to wander; He has set the world-drama in motion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa har bakhase taa gur milai asathir rahai samaai ||
english: When the Lord forgives, then one meets the Guru, and becoming stable, he remains absorbed in the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak man hee te man maaniaa naa kichh marai na jaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, through the mind, the mind is satisfied, and then, nothing comes or goes. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਣਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kot apaar hai milanaa sa(n)jogee ||
english: The body is the fortress of the Infinite Lord; it is obtained only by destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar aap vas rahiaa aape ras bhogee ||
english: The Lord Himself dwells within the body; He Himself is the Enjoyer of pleasures.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਜੋਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: aap ateet alipat hai nirajog har jogee ||
english: He Himself remains detached and unaffected; while unattached, He is still attached.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so kare har kare s hogee ||
english: He does whatever He pleases, and whatever He does, comes to pass.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: har guramukh naam dhiaaeeai lahi jaahi vijogee ||13||
english: The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord's Name, and separation from the Lord is ended. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਖਾਇਦਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu aap akhaaidaa gurasabadee sach soi ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! The Lord Himself causes us to praise Him, through the True Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu siphat salaah hai guramukh boojhai koi ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! is His Eulogy and Praise; how rare are the Gurmukhs who understand this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu baanee sach hai sach milaavaa hoi ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! is the True Word of His Bani, by which we meet our True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu karatiaa prabh paaiaa karam paraapat hoi ||1||
english: O Nanak, chanting Waaho! Waaho! God is attained; by His Grace, He is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatee rasanaa sabad suhaaee ||
english: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! the tongue is adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: poorai sabad prabh miliaa aaee ||
english: Through the Perfect Shabad, one comes to meet God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਕਢਾਈ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaageeaa vaahu vaahu muhahu kadhaaee ||
english: How very fortunate are those, who with their mouths, chant Waaho! Waaho!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਪਰਜਾ ਪੂਜਣ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu karahi seee jan sohane tinh kau parajaa poojan aaee ||
english: How beautiful are those persons who chant Waaho! Waaho! ; people come to venerate them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu karam paraapat hovai naanak dar sachai sobhaa paaee ||2||
english: Waaho! Waaho! is obtained by His Grace; O Nanak, honor is obtained at the Gate of the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜੑ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: bajar kapaat kaaiaa gaRh bheetar kooR kusat abhimaanee ||
english: Within the fortress of body, are the hard and rigid doors of falsehood, deception and pride.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: bharam bhoole nadar na aavanee manamukh a(n)dh agiaanee ||
english: Deluded by doubt, the blind and ignorant self-willed manmukhs cannot see them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲਭਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖਵਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: upaai kitai na labhanee kar bhekh thake bhekhavaanee ||
english: They cannot be found by any efforts; wearing their religious robes, the wearers have grown weary of trying.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਖੋਲਾਈਅਨੑਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee kholaaeeanhi har naam japaanee ||
english: The doors are opened only by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and then, one chants the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: har jeeu a(n)mrit birakh hai jin peeaa te tripataanee ||14||
english: The Dear Lord is the Tree of Ambrosial Nectar; those who drink in this Nectar are satisfied. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa rain sukh vihaai ||
english: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! the night of one's life passes in peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa sadaa ana(n)d hovai meree maai ||
english: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! I am in eternal bliss, O my mother!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa har siu liv laai ||
english: Chanting Waaho! Waaho!, I have fallen in love with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਬੋਲੈ ਬੋਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu karamee bolai bolaai ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Through the karma of good deeds, I chant it, and inspire others to chant it as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa sobhaa paai ||
english: Chanting Waaho! Waaho!, one obtains honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu sat rajaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, Waaho! Waaho! is the Will of the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਧੀ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu baanee sach hai guramukh ladhee bhaal ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! is the Bani of the True Word. Searching, the Gurmukhs have found it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਉਚਰੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu sabade ucharai vaahu vaahu hiradai naal ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! They chant the Word of the Shabad. Waaho! Waaho! They enshrine it in their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa har paaiaa sahaje guramukh bhaal ||
english: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! the Gurmukhs easily obtain the Lord, after searching.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: se vadabhaagee naanakaa har har ridai samaal ||2||
english: O Nanak, very fortunate are those who reflect upon the Lord, Har, Har, within their hearts. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨਾ ਅਤਿ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਲੋਭੇ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: e manaa at lobheeaa nit lobhe raataa ||
english: O my utterly greedy mind, you are constantly engrossed in greed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਫਿਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa manasaa mohanee dah dis phiraataa ||
english: In your desire for the enticing Maya, you wander in the ten directions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਨਾਉ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: agai naau jaat na jaaisee manamukh dukh khaataa ||
english: Your name and social status shall not go with you hereafter; the self-willed manmukh is consumed by pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਖਿਓ ਫੀਕਾ ਬੋਲਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa har ras na chakhio pheekaa bolaataa ||
english: Your tongue does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord; it utters only insipid words.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਤਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: jinaa guramukh a(n)mrit chaakhiaa se jan tripataataa ||15||
english: Those Gurmukhs who drink in the Ambrosial Nectar are satisfied. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeai j sachaa gahir ga(n)bheer ||
english: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is True, profound and unfathomable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਧੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeai j gunadaataa mat dheer ||
english: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is the Giver of virtue, intelligence and patience.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeai j sabh mahi rahiaa samaai ||
english: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is permeating and pervading in all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਬਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeai j dedaa rijak sabaahi ||
english: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is the Giver of sustenance to all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਇਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu iko kar saalaaheeai j satigur deeaa dikhaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, Waaho! Waaho! - praise the One Lord, revealed by the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu guramukh sadaa karahi manamukh marahi bikh khaai ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! The Gurmukhs praise the Lord continually, while the self-willed manmukhs eat poison and die.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: onaa vaahu vaahu na bhaavaee dukhe dukh vihaai ||
english: They have no love for the Lord's Praises, and they pass their lives in misery.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਣਾ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh a(n)mrit peevanaa vaahu vaahu karahi liv laai ||
english: The Gurmukhs drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, and they center their consciousness on the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu karahi se jan niramale tribhavan sojhee paai ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who chant Waaho! Waaho! are immaculate and pure; they obtain the knowledge of the three worlds. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: har kai bhaanai gur milai sevaa bhagat baneejai ||
english: By the Lord's Will, one meets the Guru, serves Him, and worships the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: har kai bhaanai har man vasai sahaje ras peejai ||
english: By the Lord's Will, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and one easily drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਿਤ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: har kai bhaanai sukh paaeeai har laahaa nit leejai ||
english: By the Lord's Will, one finds peace, and continually earns the Lord's Profit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹਾਲੀਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਵਸੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: har kai takhat bahaaleeai nij ghar sadaa vaseejai ||
english: He is seated on the Lord's throne, and he dwells continually in the home of his own being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਨੀ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: har kaa bhaanaa tinee ma(n)niaa jinaa guroo mileejai ||16||
english: He alone surrenders to the Lord's Will, who meets the Guru. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu se jan sadaa karahi jinh kau aape dei bujhaai ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Those humble beings ever praise the Lord, unto whom the Lord Himself grants understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa man niramal hovai haumai vichahu jaai ||
english: Chanting Waaho! Waaho!, the mind is purified, and egotism departs from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਜੋ ਨਿਤ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu gurasikh jo nit kare so man chi(n)diaa phal paai ||
english: The Gurmukh who continually chants Waaho! Waaho! attains the fruits of his heart's desires.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu karahi se jan sohane har tinh kai sa(n)g milaai ||
english: Beauteous are those humble beings who chant Waaho! Waaho! O Lord, let me join them!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਚਰਾ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਭੀ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu hiradai ucharaa mukhahu bhee vaahu vaahu kareu ||
english: Within my heart, I chant Waaho! Waaho!, and with my mouth, Waaho! Waaho!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਉ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu jo karahi hau tan man tinh kau deu ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who chant Waaho! Waaho! - unto them I dedicate my body and mind. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu saahib sach hai a(n)mrit jaa kaa naau ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! is the True Lord Master; His Name is Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin seviaa tin phal paaiaa hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
english: Those who serve the Lord are blessed with the fruit; I am a sacrifice to them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu gunee nidhaan hai jis no dei s khaai ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! is the treasure of virtue; he alone tastes it, who is so blessed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu jal thal bharapoor hai guramukh paaiaa jaai ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! The Lord is pervading and permeating the oceans and the land; the Gurmukh attains Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਨਿਤ ਸਭ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu gurasikh nit sabh karahu gur poore vaahu vaahu bhaavai ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Let all the Gursikhs continually praise Him. Waaho! Waaho! The Perfect Guru is pleased with His Praises.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu jo man chit kare tis jamaka(n)kar neR na aavai ||2||
english: O Nanak, one who chants Waaho! Waaho! with his heart and mind - the Messenger of Death does not approach him. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu sachaa sach hai sachee gurabaanee ||
english: The Dear Lord is the Truest of the True; True is the Word of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur te sach pachhaaneeai sach sahaj samaanee ||
english: Through the True Guru, the Truth is realized, and one is easily absorbed in the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਨਾ ਸਵਹਿ ਜਾਗਤ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: anadin jaagahi naa savahi jaagat rain vihaanee ||
english: Night and day, they remain awake, and do not sleep; in wakefulness, the night of their lives passes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: guramatee har ras chaakhiaa se pu(n)n paraanee ||
english: Those who taste the sublime essence of the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, are the most worthy persons.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਜਾਣੀ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: bin gur kinai na paaio pach mue ajaanee ||17||
english: Without the Guru, no one has obtained the Lord; the ignorant rot away and die. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu baanee nira(n)kaar hai tis jevad avar na koi ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! is the Bani, the Word, of the Formless Lord. There is no other as great as He is.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu agam athaahu hai vaahu vaahu sachaa soi ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! The Lord is unfathomable and inaccessible. Waaho! Waaho! He is the True One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu veparavaahu hai vaahu vaahu kare s hoi ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! He is the self-existent Lord. Waaho! Waaho! As He wills, so it comes to pass.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu a(n)mrit naam hai guramukh paavai koi ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtained by the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu karamee paaeeai aap daiaa kar dei ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! This is realized by His Grace, as He Himself grants His Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu guramukh paaeeai anadin naam laei ||1||
english: O Nanak, Waaho! Waaho! This is obtained by the Gurmukhs, who hold tight to the Naam, night and day. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਾਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve saat na aavaee doojee naahee jaai ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, peace is not obtained, and the sense of duality does not depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je bahuteraa locheeai vin karamai na paaiaa jaai ||
english: No matter how much one may wish, without the Lord's Grace, He is not found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jinhaa a(n)tar lobh vikaar hai doojai bhaai khuaai ||
english: Those who are filled with greed and corruption are ruined by the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maran na chukaee haumai vich dukh paai ||
english: They cannot escape birth and death, and with egotism within them, they suffer in misery.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jinhaa satigur siu chit laaiaa s khaalee koee naahi ||
english: Those who center their consciousness on the True Guru, never go empty-handed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tin jam kee talab na hovaee naa oi dukh sahaahi ||
english: They are not summoned by the Messenger of Death, and they do not suffer in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh ubare sachai sabad samaahi ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; they merge in the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dhaadhee tis no aakheeai j khasamai dhare piaar ||
english: He alone is called a minstrel, who enshrines love for his Lord and Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਖੜਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dar khaRaa sevaa kare gurasabadee veechaar ||
english: Standing at the Lord's Door, he serves the Lord, and reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
