transliteration: dhaadhee dar ghar paaisee sach rakhai ur dhaar ||
english: The minstrel attains the Lord's Gate and Mansion, and he keeps the True Lord clasped to his heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dhaadhee kaa mahal agalaa har kai naai piaar ||
english: The status of the minstrel is exalted; he loves the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: dhaadhee kee sevaa chaakaree har jap har nisataar ||18||
english: The service of the minstrel is to meditate on the Lord; he is emancipated by the Lord. ||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਰਿ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ॥
transliteration: goojaree jaat gavaar jaa sahu paae aapanaa ||
english: The milkmaid's status is very low, but she attains her Husband Lord

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad veechaar anadin har jap jaapanaa ||
english: when she reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and chants the Lord's Name, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਪਵੈ ਸਾ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jis satigur milai tis bhau pavai saa kulava(n)tee naar ||
english: She who meets the True Guru, lives in the Fear of God; she is a woman of noble birth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਕੰਤ ਕਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saa hukam pachhaanai ka(n)t kaa jis no kripaa keetee karataar ||
english: She alone realizes the Hukam of her Husband Lord's Command, who is blessed by the Creator Lord's Mercy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਕੁਚਜੀ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਭਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: oh kuchajee kulakhanee parahar chhodee bhataar ||
english: She who is of little merit and ill-mannered, is discarded and forsaken by her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਮਲੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhai paiai mal kateeai niramal hovai sareer ||
english: By the Fear of God, filth is washed off, and the body becomes immaculately pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar paragaas mat ootam hovai har jap gunee gaheer ||
english: The soul is enlightened, and the intellect is exalted, meditating on the Lord, the ocean of excellence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਭੈ ਰਹੈ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich baisai bhai rahai bhai vich kamaavai kaar ||
english: One who dwells in the Fear of God, lives in the Fear of God, and acts in the Fear of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: aithai sukh vadiaaeeaa daragah mokh duaar ||
english: He obtains peace and glorious greatness here, in the Lord's Court, and at the Gate of Salvation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bhai te nirabhau paaeeai mil jotee jot apaar ||
english: Through the Fear of God, the Fearless Lord is obtained, and one's light merges in the Infinite Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak khasamai bhaavai saa bhalee jis no aape bakhase karataar ||1||
english: O Nanak, that bride alone is good, who is pleasing to her Lord and Master, and whom the Creator Lord Himself forgives. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa saalaaheeai sache kau bal jaau ||
english: Praise the Lord, forever and ever, and make yourself a sacrifice to the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਸਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak ek chhod doojai lagai saa jihavaa jal jaau ||2||
english: O Nanak, let that tongue be burnt, which renounces the One Lord, and attaches itself to another. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਸਾ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)saa autaar upaaion bhaau doojaa keeaa ||
english: From a single particle of His greatness, He created His incarnations, but they indulged in the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਭਿੜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jiu raaje raaj kamaavade dukh sukh bhiReeaa ||
english: They ruled like kings, and fought for pleasure and pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: eesar brahamaa sevade a(n)t tinhee na laheeaa ||
english: Those who serve Shiva and Brahma do not find the limits of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀਆ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau nira(n)kaar alakh hai guramukh pragateeaa ||
english: The Fearless, Formless Lord is unseen and invisible; He is revealed only to the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਗਿ ਥੀਆ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: tithai sog vijog na viaapaee asathir jag theeaa ||19||
english: There, one does not suffer sorrow or separation; he becomes stable and immortal in the world. ||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਹੈ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ehu sabh kichh aavan jaan hai jetaa hai aakaar ||
english: All these things come and go, all these things of the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਹੋਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jin ehu lekhaa likhiaa so hoaa paravaan ||
english: One who knows this written account is acceptable and approved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦਾ ਸੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak je ko aap ganaaidaa so moorakh gaavaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, anyone who takes pride in himself is foolish and unwise. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਪੀਲਕੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਜਹ ਖਿੰਚੇ ਤਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man ku(n)char peelak guroo giaan ku(n)daa jah khi(n)che tah jaai ||
english: The mind is the elephant, the Guru is the elephant-driver, and knowledge is the whip. Wherever the Guru drives the mind, it goes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਸਤੀ ਕੁੰਡੇ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak hasatee ku(n)de baaharaa phir phir ujhaR paai ||2||
english: O Nanak, without the whip, the elephant wanders into the wilderness, again and again. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tis aagai aradaas jin upaaiaa ||
english: I offer my prayer to the One, from whom I was created.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur apanaa sev sabh phal paaiaa ||
english: Serving my True Guru, I have obtained all the fruits.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naau sadaa dhiaaiaa ||
english: I meditate continually on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kai sa(n)g dukh mitaaiaa ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, I am rid of my pain and suffering.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak bhae achi(n)t har dhan nihachalaaiaa ||20||
english: O Nanak, I have become care-free; I have obtained the imperishable wealth of the Lord. ||20||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖੇਤਿ ਮਿਆਲਾ ਉਚੀਆ ਘਰੁ ਉਚਾ ਨਿਰਣਉ ॥
transliteration: khet miaalaa ucheeaa ghar uchaa niranau ||
english: Raising the embankments of the mind's field, I gaze at the heavenly mansion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲ ਭਗਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਸਰੈ ਸਜਣ ਪਾਹੁਣਿਅਉ ॥
transliteration: mahal bhagatee ghar sarai sajan paahuniau ||
english: When devotion comes to the mind of the soul-bride, she is visited by the friendly guest.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਰਸਨਾ ਤ ਬਰਸੁ ਘਨਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਰਸਹਿ ਕਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: barasanaa ta baras ghanaa bahuR barasahi kaahi ||
english: O clouds, if you are going to rain, then go ahead and rain; why rain after the season has passed?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tinh balihaaranai jinh guramukh paaiaa man maahi ||1||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice to those Gurmukhs who obtain the Lord in their minds. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਸੋ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੋ ਜਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: mithaa so jo bhaavadaa sajan so j raas ||
english: That which is pleasing is sweet, and one who is sincere is a friend.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh jaaneeai jaa kau aap kare paragaas ||2||
english: O Nanak, he is known as a Gurmukh, whom the Lord Himself enlightens. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
transliteration: prabh paas jan kee aradaas too sachaa saa(n)ee ||
english: O God, Your humble servant offers his prayer to You; You are my True Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: too rakhavaalaa sadaa sadaa hau tudh dhiaaee ||
english: You are my Protector, forever and ever; I meditate on You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh teriaa too rahiaa samaaee ||
english: All the beings and creatures are Yours; You are pervading and permeating in them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo daas tere kee ni(n)daa kare tis maar pachaaee ||
english: One who slanders Your slave is crushed and destroyed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਛਡਿ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਰਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: chi(n)taa chhad achi(n)t rahu naanak lag paaee ||21||
english: Falling at Your Feet, Nanak has renounced his cares, and has become care-free. ||21||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਆਸਾ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aasaa karataa jag muaa aasaa marai na jaai ||
english: Building up its hopes, the world dies, but its hopes do not die or depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak aasaa pooreeaa sache siu chit laai ||1||
english: O Nanak, hopes are fulfilled only by attaching one's consciousness to the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa mar jaaisee jin keetee so lai jaai ||
english: Hopes and desires shall die only when He, who created them, takes them away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak nihachal ko nahee baajhahu har kai naai ||2||
english: O Nanak, nothing is permanent, except the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ॥
transliteration: aape jagat upaaion kar pooraa thaat ||
english: He Himself created the world, with His perfect workmanship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਟੁ ॥
transliteration: aape saahu aape vanajaaraa aape hee har haat ||
english: He Himself is the true banker, He Himself is the merchant, and He Himself is the store.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖੇਵਾਟੁ ॥
transliteration: aape saagar aape bohithaa aape hee khevaat ||
english: He Himself is the ocean, He Himself is the boat, and He Himself is the boatman.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਦਸੇ ਘਾਟੁ ॥
transliteration: aape gur chelaa hai aape aape dase ghaat ||
english: He Himself is the Guru, He Himself is the disciple, and He Himself shows the destination.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੁ ॥੨੨॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaai too sabh kilavikh kaat ||22||1|| sudh
english: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and all your sins shall be eradicated. ||22||1||Sudh||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag goojaree vaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Goojaree, Vaar, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar gur aaraadhanaa jihavaa jap gur naau ||
english: Deep within yourself, worship the Guru in adoration, and with your tongue, chant the Guru's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੇਖਣਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: netree satigur pekhanaa sravanee sunanaa gur naau ||
english: Let your eyes behold the True Guru, and let your ears hear the Guru's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur setee ratiaa daragah paaeeai thaau ||
english: Attuned to the True Guru, you shall receive a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਏਹ ਵਥੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak kirapaa kare jis no eh vath dei ||
english: Says Nanak, this treasure is bestowed on those who are blessed with His Mercy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਉਤਮ ਕਾਢੀਅਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jag mahi utam kaadheeahi virale keee kei ||1||
english: In the midst of the world, they are known as the most pious - they are rare indeed. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਖੇ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
transliteration: rakhe rakhanahaar aap ubaarian ||
english: O Savior Lord, save us and take us across.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kee pairee paai kaaj savaarian ||
english: Falling at the feet of the Guru, our works are embellished with perfection.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
transliteration: hoaa aap daiaal manahu na visaarian ||
english: You have become kind, merciful and compassionate; we do not forget You from our minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
transliteration: saadh janaa kai sa(n)g bhavajal taarian ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, we are carried across the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
transliteration: saakat ni(n)dak dusat khin maahi bidaarian ||
english: In an instant, You have destroyed the faithless cynics and slanderous enemies.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tis saahib kee tek naanak manai maahi ||
english: That Lord and Master is my Anchor and Support; O Nanak, hold firm in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis simarat sukh hoi sagale dookh jaahi ||2||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, happiness comes, and all sorrows and pains simply vanish. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: akul nira(n)jan purakh agam apaareeai ||
english: He is without relatives, immaculate, all-powerful, unapproachable and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sacho sachaa sach sach nihaareeai ||
english: Truly, the True Lord is seen to be the Truest of the True.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਧਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kooR na jaapai kichh teree dhaareeai ||
english: Nothing established by You appears to be false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਜੇਤ ਉਪਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sabhasai de daataar jet upaareeai ||
english: The Great Giver gives sustenance to all those He has created.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੰਜਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: ikat soot paroi jot sa(n)jaareeai ||
english: He has strung all on only one thread; He has infused His Light in them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਮੰਝਿ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: hukame bhavajal ma(n)jh hukame taareeai ||
english: By His Will, some drown in the terrifying world-ocean, and by His Will, some are carried across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: prabh jeeu tudh dhiaae soi jis bhaag mathaareeai ||
english: O Dear Lord, he alone meditates on You, upon whose forehead such blessed destiny is inscribed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: teree gat mit lakhee na jaai hau tudh balihaareeai ||1||
english: Your condition and state cannot be known; I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa too(n) tusahi miharavaan achi(n)t vasahi man maahi ||
english: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, you automatically come to dwell within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa too(n) tusahi miharavaan nau nidh ghar mahi paahi ||
english: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, I find the nine treasures within the home of my own self.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa too(n) tusahi miharavaan taa gur kaa ma(n)tr kamaahi ||
english: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, I act according to the Guru's Instructions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa too(n) tusahi miharavaan taa naanak sach samaahi ||1||
english: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, then Nanak is absorbed in the True One. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੀ ਬੈਹਨੑਿ ਬੈਹਣੇ ਮੁਚੁ ਵਜਾਇਨਿ ਵਜ ॥
transliteration: kitee baihanhi baihane much vajaain vaj ||
english: Many sit on thrones, to the sounds of musical instruments.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਰਹੀਆ ਲਜ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sache naam vin kisai na raheeaa laj ||2||
english: O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's honor is safe. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਨੑਿ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਸਣੁ ਖੜੇ ॥
transliteration: tudh dhiaainhi bed katebaa san khaRe ||
english: The followers of the Vedas, the Bible and the Koran, standing at Your Door, meditate on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਰਿ ਪੜੇ ॥
transliteration: ganatee ganee na jaai terai dar paRe ||
english: Uncounted are those who fall at Your Door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਨੑਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਾ ॥
transliteration: brahame tudh dhiaainhi i(n)dr i(n)draasanaa ||
english: Brahma meditates on You, as does Indra on his throne.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਕਰ ਬਿਸਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)kar bisan avataar har jas mukh bhanaa ||
english: Shiva and Vishnu, and their incarnations, chant the Lord's Praise with their mouths,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਪਿਕਾਬਰ ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਅਉਲੀਏ ॥
transliteration: peer pikaabar sekh masaaik auleee ||
english: as do the Pirs, the spiritual teachers, the prophets and the Shaykhs, the silent sages and the seers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਉਲੀਏ ॥
transliteration: ot pot nira(n)kaar ghat ghat mauleee ||
english: Through and through, the Formless Lord is woven into each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ਧਰਮੇ ਤਗੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kooRahu kare vinaas dharame tageeai ||
english: One is destroyed through falsehood; through righteousness, one prospers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੀਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jit jit laaihi aap tit tit lageeai ||2||
english: Whatever the Lord links him to, to that he is linked. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੰਗਿਆਈਁ ਆਲਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਁ ਹੋਇ ਸੇਰੁ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)giaaee(n) aalak kare buriaaee(n) hoi ser ||
english: He is reluctant to do good, but eager to practice evil.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਜੁ ਕਲਿ ਆਵਸੀ ਗਾਫਲ ਫਾਹੀ ਪੇਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak aj kal aavasee gaaphal phaahee per ||1||
english: O Nanak, today or tomorrow, the feet of the careless fool shall fall into the trap. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੀਆ ਕੁਢੰਗ ਗੁਝਾ ਥੀਐ ਨ ਹਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kiteeaa kudha(n)g gujhaa theeai na hit ||
english: No matter how evil my ways are, still, Your Love for me is not concealed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਢਕਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਮਿਤੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak tai sahi dhakiaa man mahi sachaa mit ||2||
english: Nanak: You, O Lord, conceal my short-comings and dwell within my mind; You are my true friend. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਤੁਝੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਗੋਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau maagau tujhai daiaal kar daasaa goliaa ||
english: I beg of You, O Merciful Lord: please, make me the slave of Your slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਬੋਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: nau nidh paaee raaj jeevaa boliaa ||
english: I obtain the nine treasures and royalty; chanting Your Name, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦਾਸਾ ਘਰਿ ਘਣਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan daasaa ghar ghanaa ||
english: The great ambrosial treasure, the Nectar of the Naam, is in the home of the Lord's slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣਾ ॥
transliteration: tin kai sa(n)g nihaal sravanee jas sunaa ||
english: In their company, I am in ecstasy, listening to Your Praises with my ears.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਮਾਵਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kamaavaa tin kee kaar sareer pavit hoi ||
english: Serving them, my body is purified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਖਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪੀਸਿ ਬਿਗਸਾ ਪੈਰ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: pakhaa paanee pees bigasaa pair dhoi ||
english: I wave the fans over them, and carry water for them; I grind the corn for them, and washing their feet, I am over-joyed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: aapahu kachhoo na hoi prabh nadar nihaaleeai ||
english: By myself, I can do nothing; O God, bless me with Your Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਦਿਚੈ ਥਾਉ ਸੰਤ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mohi niragun dichai thaau sa(n)t dharam saaleeai ||3||
english: I am worthless - please, bless me with a seat in the place of worship of the Saints. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਾ ਸਦ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saajan tere charan kee hoi rahaa sad dhoor ||
english: O Friend, I pray that I may remain forever the dust of Your Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saran tuhaareeaa pekhau sadaa hajoor ||1||
english: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, and beholds You ever-present. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਅਸੰਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥
transliteration: patit puneet asa(n)kh hohi har charanee man laag ||
english: Countless sinners become pure, by fixing their minds on the Feet of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ॥੨॥
transliteration: athasath teerath naam prabh jis naanak masatak bhaag ||2||
english: The Name of God is the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, O Nanak, for one who has such destiny written upon his forehead. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨਾਉ ਪਰਵਦਿਗਾਰ ਦਾ ॥
transliteration: nit japeeai saas giraas naau paravadigaar daa ||
english: With every breath and morsel of food, chant the Name of the Lord, the Cherisher.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰੇ ਰਹੰਮ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: jis no kare raha(n)m tis na visaaradaa ||
english: The Lord does not forget one upon whom He has bestowed His Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਮਾਰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: aap upaavanahaar aape hee maaradaa ||
english: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself destroys.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh jaanai jaan bujh veechaaradaa ||
english: The Knower knows everything; He understands and contemplates.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੂਪ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਧਾਰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: anik roop khin maahi kudarat dhaaradaa ||
english: By His creative power, He assumes numerous forms in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਸਚਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਉਧਾਰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: jis no laai sach tisahi udhaaradaa ||
english: One whom the Lord attaches to the Truth is redeemed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਲਿ ਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹਾਰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: jis dai hovai val s kade na haaradaa ||
english: One who has God on his side is never conquered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਭਗੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਦਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sadaa abhag deebaan hai hau tis namasakaaradaa ||4||
english: His Court is eternal and imperishable; I humbly bow to Him. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਦੀਜੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh chhodeeai deejai agan jalaai ||
english: Renounce sexual desire, anger and greed, and burn them in the fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeevadiaa nit jaapeeai naanak saachaa naau ||1||
english: As long as you are alive, O Nanak, meditate continually on the True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਆਹਿ ॥
transliteration: simarat simarat prabh aapanaa sabh phal paae aahi ||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my God, I have obtained all the fruits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam araadhiaa gur poorai deeaa milaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, I worship the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: so mukataa sa(n)saar j gur upadesiaa ||
english: One who has been instructed by the Guru is liberated in this world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਇ ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tis kee gaee balaai mite a(n)desiaa ||
english: He avoids disaster, and his anxiety is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa darasan dekh jagat nihaal hoi ||
english: Beholding the blessed vision of his Darshan, the world is over-joyed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਪਾਪਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jan kai sa(n)g nihaal paapaa mail dhoi ||
english: In the company of the Lord's humble servants, the world is over-joyed, and the filth of sin is washed away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ਓਥੈ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit saachaa naau othai jaapeeai ||
english: There, they meditate on the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਭੁਖਾ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: man kau hoi sa(n)tokh bhukhaa dhraapeeai ||
english: The mind becomes content, and its hunger is satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jis ghat vasiaa naau tis ba(n)dhan kaateeai ||
english: One whose heart is filled with the Name, has his bonds cut away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟੀਐ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur parasaad kinai viralai har dhan khaateeai ||5||
english: By Guru's Grace, some rare person earns the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤਵਨੀ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਉਠਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: man mahi chitavau chitavanee udam karau uth neet ||
english: Within my mind, I think thoughts of always rising early, and making the effort.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਕਾ ਆਹਰੋ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har keeratan kaa aaharo har dehu naanak ke meet ||1||
english: O Lord, my Friend, please bless Nanak with the habit of singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
transliteration: drisat dhaar prabh raakhiaa man tan rataa mool ||
english: Casting His Glance of Grace, God has saved me; my mind and body are imbued with the Primal Being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀਆ ਮਰਉ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jo prabh bhaaneeaa marau vichaaree sool ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God, have their cries of suffering taken away. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jee kee birathaa hoi s gur pahi aradaas kar ||
english: When your soul is feeling sad, offer your prayers to the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
transliteration: chhod siaanap sagal man tan arap dhar ||
english: Renounce all your cleverness, and dedicate your mind and body to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੈਰ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਜਰਿ ॥
transliteration: poojahu gur ke pair duramat jaai jar ||
english: Worship the Feet of the Guru, and your evil-mindedness shall be burnt away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saadh janaa kai sa(n)g bhavajal bikham tar ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall cross over the terrifying and difficult world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ਅਗੈ ਨ ਮਰਹੁ ਡਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sevahu satigur dev agai na marahu dar ||
english: Serve the True Guru, and in the world hereafter, you shall not die of fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਊਣੇ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਿ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi kare nihaal oone subhar bhar ||
english: In an instant, he shall make you happy, and the empty vessel shall be filled to overflowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man kau hoi sa(n)tokh dhiaaeeai sadaa har ||
english: The mind becomes content, meditating forever on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਲਗਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਮੁ ਧੁਰਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: so lagaa satigur sev jaa kau karam dhur ||6||
english: He alone dedicates himself to the Guru's service, unto whom the Lord has granted His Grace. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਗੜੀ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਜੋੜਣਹਾਰੈ ਜੋੜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: lagaRee suthaan joRanahaarai joReeaa ||
english: I am attached to the right place; the Uniter has united me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਹਰੀ ਲਖ ਸੈ ਆਨ ਡੁਬਣ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak laharee lakh sai aan duban dei na maa piree ||1||
english: O Nanak, there are hundreds and thousands of waves, but my Husband Lord does not let me drown. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਨਿ ਭੀਹਾਵਲੈ ਹਿਕੁ ਸਾਥੀ ਲਧਮੁ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: ban bheehaavalai hik saathee ladham dukh harataa har naamaa ||
english: In the dreadful wilderness, I have found the one and only companion; the Name of the Lord is the Destroyer of distress.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮਾਂ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bal bal jaaee sa(n)t piaare naanak pooran kaamaa(n) ||2||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Beloved Saints, O Nanak; through them, my affairs have been brought to fulfillment. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paaeean sabh nidhaan terai ra(n)g ratiaa ||
english: All treasures are obtained, when we are attuned to Your Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਪਛੋਤਾਉ ਤੁਧ ਨੋ ਜਪਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: na hovee pachhotaau tudh no japatiaa ||
english: One does not have to suffer regret and repentance, when he meditates on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਜਨ ॥
transliteration: pahuch na sakai koi teree tek jan ||
english: No one can equal Your humble servant, who has Your Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਾ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ਮਨ ॥
transliteration: gur poore vaahu vaahu sukh lahaa chitaar man ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! How wonderful is the Perfect Guru! Cherishing Him in my mind, I obtain peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gur pahi siphat bha(n)daar karamee paaeeai ||
english: The treasure of the Lord's Praise comes from the Guru; by His Mercy, it is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur nadar nihaal bahuR na dhaaeeai ||
english: When the True Guru bestows His Glance of Grace, one does not wander any more.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
transliteration: rakhai aap daiaal kar daasaa aapane ||
english: The Merciful Lord preserves him - He makes him His own slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har har har har naam jeevaa sun sune ||7||
english: Listening, hearing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, I live. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਟੋਲਾ ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਢਕਣ ਕੂ ਪਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: prem patolaa tai sahi ditaa dhakan koo pat meree ||
english: O Husband Lord, You have given me the silk gown of Your Love to cover and protect my honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਸਾਈ ਮੈਡਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daanaa beenaa saaee maidaa naanak saar na jaanaa teree ||1||
english: You are all-wise and all-knowing, O my Master; Nanak: I have not appreciated Your value, Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੈਡੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਹਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਧਮੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਨ ਡਿਠਮੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: taidai simaran habh kichh ladham bikham na ditham koee ||
english: By Your meditative remembrance, I have found everything; nothing seems difficult to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਤਿ ਰਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis pat rakhai sachaa saahib naanak met na sakai koee ||2||
english: One whose honor the True Lord Master has preserved - O Nanak, no one can dishonor him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ ਦਯਿ ਧਿਆਇਐ ॥
transliteration: hovai sukh ghanaa day dhiaaiai ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, there comes a great peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੰਞੈ ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਐ ॥
transliteration: va(n)njai rogaa ghaan har gun gaaiai ||
english: Multitudes of illnesses vanish, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਠਾਢਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਐ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar varatai thaadh prabh chit aaiai ||
english: Utter peace pervades within, when God comes to mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਸ ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਐ ॥
transliteration: pooran hovai aas naai ma(n)n vasaaiai ||
english: One's hopes are fulfilled, when one's mind is filled with the Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਐ ॥
transliteration: koi na lagai bighan aap gavaaiai ||
english: No obstacles stand in the way, when one eliminates his self-conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਐ ॥
transliteration: giaan padaarath mat gur te paaiai ||
english: The intellect attains the blessing of spiritual wisdom from the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਇਐ ॥
transliteration: tin paae sabhe thok jis aap divaaiai ||
english: He receives everything, unto whom the Lord Himself gives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਇਐ ॥੮॥
transliteration: too(n) sabhanaa kaa khasam sabh teree chhaaiai ||8||
english: You are the Lord and Master of all; all are under Your Protection. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਦੀ ਤਰੰਦੜੀ ਮੈਡਾ ਖੋਜੁ ਨ ਖੁੰਭੈ ਮੰਝਿ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: nadee tara(n)daRee maidaa khoj na khu(n)bhai ma(n)jh muhabat teree ||
english: Crossing the stream, my foot does not get stuck - I am filled with love for You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਸਹ ਚਰਣੀ ਮੈਡਾ ਹੀਅੜਾ ਸੀਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਬੇੜੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tau sah charanee maidaa heeaRaa seetam har naanak tulahaa beRee ||1||
english: O Lord, my heart is attached to Your Feet; the Lord is Nanak's raft and boat. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਦਿਸੰਦੜਿਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਵੰਞੈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਾਡੜੇ ਸੇਈ ॥
transliteration: jinhaa disa(n)daRiaa duramat va(n)njai mitr asaadaRe seee ||
english: The sight of them banishes my evil-mindedness; they are my only true friends.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਜਗੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hau dhoodhedee jag sabaaiaa jan naanak virale keee ||2||
english: I have searched the whole world; O servant Nanak, how rare are such persons! ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਡਿਠਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aavai saahib chit teriaa bhagataa dithiaa ||
english: You come to mind, O Lord and Master, when I behold Your devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਵੁਠਿਆ ॥
transliteration: man kee kateeai mail saadhasa(n)g vuthiaa ||
english: The filth of my mind is removed, when I dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਪਿ ॥
transliteration: janam maran bhau kateeai jan kaa sabad jap ||
english: The fear of birth and death is dispelled, meditating on the Word of His humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਖੋਲਨੑਿ ਸੰਤ ਦੂਤ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਛਪਿ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan kholanhi sa(n)t doot sabh jaahi chhap ||
english: The Saints untie the bonds, and all the demons are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇਨੑਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tis siu laainhi ra(n)g jis dee sabh dhaareeaa ||
english: They inspire us to love Him, the One who established the entire universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚੀ ਹੂੰ ਊਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: oochee hoo(n) oochaa thaan agam apaareeaa ||
english: The seat of the inaccessible and infinite Lord is the highest of the high.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: rain dinas kar joR saas saas dhiaaeeai ||
english: Night and day, with your palms pressed together, with each and every breath, meditate on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾਂ ਭਗਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
transliteration: jaa aape hoi daiaal taa(n) bhagat sa(n)g paaeeai ||9||
english: When the Lord Himself becomes merciful, then we attain the Society of His devotees. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਨੜੈ ਹੁੰਮਸ ਧੁੰਮਸ ਕੂਕਾ ਪਈਆ ਰਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: baar vidaanaRai hu(n)mas dhu(n)mas kookaa paeeaa raahee ||
english: In this wondrous forest of the world, there is chaos and confusion; shrieks emanate from the highways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਸਹ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਗੜੀ ਡੋਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਬਨੁ ਗਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tau sah setee lagaRee doree naanak anad setee ban gaahee ||1||
english: I am in love with You, O my Husband Lord; O Nanak, I cross the jungle joyfully. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬੈਸਕ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sachee baisak tinhaa sa(n)g jin sa(n)g japeeai naau ||
english: The true society is the company of those who meditate on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tinh sa(n)g sa(n)g na keechaee naanak jinaa aapanaa suaau ||2||
english: Do not associate with those, O Nanak, who look out only for their own interests. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saa velaa paravaan jit satigur bhetiaa ||
english: Approved is that time, when one meets the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਤੇਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hoaa saadhoo sa(n)g phir dookh na tetiaa ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he does not suffer pain again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਲੇਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paaiaa nihachal thaan phir garabh na letiaa ||
english: When he attains the eternal place, he does not have to enter the womb again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਇਕੁ ਸਗਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: nadaree aaiaa ik sagal brahametiaa ||
english: He comes to see the One God everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮੇਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tat giaan laai dhiaan drisat sametiaa ||
english: He focuses his meditation on the essence of spiritual wisdom, and withdraws his attention from other sights.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਬੋਲੇਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabho japeeai jaap j mukhahu boletiaa ||
english: All chants are chanted by one who chants them with his mouth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਬੁਝਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੇਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hukame bujh nihaal sukh sukhetiaa ||
english: Realizing the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he becomes happy, and he is filled with peace and tranquility.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਏ ਸੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਖੋਟਿਆ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: parakh khajaanai paae se bahuR na khotiaa ||10||
english: Those who are assayed, and placed in the Lord's treasury, are not declared counterfeit again. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੋਹੇ ਜੰਬੂਰ ਖਵੇ ਨ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਗਾਖੜੇ ॥
transliteration: vichhohe ja(n)boor khave na va(n)njan gaakhaRe ||
english: The pincers of separation are so painful to endure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਮਿਲੰਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਬੂਹ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: je so dhanee mila(n)n naanak sukh sa(n)booh sach ||1||
english: If only the Master would come to meet me! O Nanak, I would then obtain all the true comforts. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਮੀ ਵਸੰਦੀ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਈਧਣੁ ਰਖੈ ਭਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jimee vasa(n)dee paaneeai eedhan rakhai bhaahi ||
english: The earth is in the water, and the fire is contained in the wood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਆਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਆਢਲਿ ਹਭੁ ਕੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak so sahu aahi jaa kai aadhal habh ko ||2||
english: O Nanak, yearn for that Lord, who is the Support of all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਕੰਮ ਤੁਧੈ ਹੀ ਗੋਚਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tere keete ka(n)m tudhai hee gochare ||
english: The works which You have done, O Lord, could only have been performed by You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜਗਿ ਜਿ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਧੁਰੇ ॥
transliteration: soee varatai jag j keeaa tudh dhure ||
english: That alone happens in the world, which You, O Master, have done.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮੁ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: bisam bhae bisamaad dekh kudarat tereeaa ||
english: I am wonderstruck beholding the wonder of Your Almighty Creative Power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: saran pare teree daas kar gat hoi mereeaa ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary - I am Your slave; if it is Your Will, I shall be emancipated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: terai hath nidhaan bhaavai tis dehi ||
english: The treasure is in Your Hands; according to Your Will, You bestow it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਇ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jis no hoi daiaal har naam sei lehi ||
english: One, upon whom You have bestowed Your Mercy, is blessed with the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar bea(n)t a(n)t na paaeeai ||
english: You are unapproachable, unfathomable and infinite; Your limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: jis no hohi kripaal s naam dhiaaeeai ||11||
english: One, unto whom You have been compassionate, meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੜਛੀਆ ਫਿਰੰਨੑਿ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑਿ ਸੁਞੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kaRachheeaa phira(n)nhi suaau na jaananhi sunjeeaa ||
english: The ladles cruise through the food, but they do not know the taste of it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਮੁਖ ਦਿਸੰਨੑਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: seee mukh disa(n)nhi naanak rate prem ras ||1||
english: I long to see the faces of those, O Nanak, who are imbued with the essence of the Lord's Love. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜੀ ਲਧਮੁ ਖੋਜੁ ਛਡੀਆ ਉਜਾੜਿ ॥
transliteration: khojee ladham khoj chhadeeaa ujaaR ||
english: Through the Tracker, I discovered the tracks of those who ruined my crops.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਵਾੜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਖੇਤੁ ਨ ਛਿਜਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tai sahi ditee vaaR naanak khet na chhijaee ||2||
english: You, O Lord, have put up the fence; O Nanak, my fields shall not be plundered again. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਰਾਧਿਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: aaraadhihu sachaa soi sabh kichh jis paas ||
english: Worship in adoration that True Lord; everything is under His Power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਖਸਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: duhaa siriaa khasam aap khin mahi kare raas ||
english: He Himself is the Master of both ends; in an instant, He adjusts our affairs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੁ ॥
transliteration: tiaagahu sagal upaav tis kee ot gahu ||
english: Renounce all your efforts, and hold fast to His Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖ ਲਹੁ ॥
transliteration: pau saranaaee bhaj sukhee hoo(n) sukh lahu ||
english: Run to His Sanctuary, and you shall obtain the comfort of all comforts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam tat giaan sa(n)taa sa(n)g hoi ||
english: The karma of good deeds, the righteousness of Dharma and the essence of spiritual wisdom are obtained in the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: japeeai a(n)mrit naam bighan na lagai koi ||
english: Chanting the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, no obstacle shall block your way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jis no aap daiaal tis man vuthiaa ||
english: The Lord abides in the mind of one who is blessed by His Kindness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਈਅਨੑਿ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਤੁਠਿਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: paaeeanhi sabh nidhaan saahib tuthiaa ||12||
english: All treasures are obtained, when the Lord and Master is pleased. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਧਮੁ ਲਭਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੰਦੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ladham labhanahaar karam kara(n)do maa piree ||
english: I have found the object of my search - my Beloved took pity on me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੋ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਆ ਨ ਪਸੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: iko sirajanahaar naanak biaa na paseeai ||1||
english: There is One Creator; O Nanak, I do not see any other. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੜਿਆ ਪਛਾੜਿ ਬਾਣੁ ਸਚਾਵਾ ਸੰਨੑਿ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: paapaRiaa pachhaaR baan sachaavaa sa(n)nhi kai ||
english: Take aim with the arrow of Truth, and shoot down sin.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੜਾ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਵਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur ma(n)traRaa chitaar naanak dukh na theevaee ||2||
english: Cherish the Words of the Guru's Mantra, O Nanak, and you shall not suffer in pain. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਠਾਢਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu sirajanahaar paaeean thaadh aap ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! The Creator Lord Himself has brought about peace and tranquility.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t miharavaan tis no sadaa jaap ||
english: He is Kind to all beings and creatures; meditate forever on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਮਰਥਿ ਚੁਕੇ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲਾਪ ॥
transliteration: daiaa dhaaree samarath chuke bil bilaap ||
english: The all-powerful Lord has shown Mercy, and my cries of suffering are ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਠੇ ਤਾਪ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: nathe taap dukh rog poore gur prataap ||
english: My fevers, pains and diseases are gone, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤੀਅਨੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਰਖ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ਥਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: keeteean aapanee rakh gareeb nivaaj thaap ||
english: The Lord has established me, and protected me; He is the Cherisher of the poor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਛਡਾਇ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aape laian chhadaai ba(n)dhan sagal kaap ||
english: He Himself has delivered me, breaking all my bonds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਆਸ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: tisan bujhee aas pu(n)nee man sa(n)tokh dhraap ||
english: My thirst is quenched, my hopes are fulfilled, and my mind is contented and satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਹੂੰ ਵਡਾ ਅਪਾਰ ਖਸਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਪਾਪਿ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: vadee hoo(n) vadaa apaar khasam jis lep na pu(n)n paap ||13||
english: The greatest of the great, the Infinite Lord and Master - He is not affected by virtue and vice. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਈ ਜਪਾਤ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau bhae kripaal prabh har har seee japaat ||
english: They alone meditate on the Lord God, Har, Har, unto whom the Lord is Merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak preet lagee tin raam siu bhetat saadh sa(n)gaat ||1||
english: O Nanak, they enshrine love for the Lord, meeting the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮਹੁ ਬਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: raam ramahu badabhaageeho jal thal maheeal soi ||
english: Contemplate the Lord, O very fortunate ones; He is pervading in the water, the land and the sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਅਰਾਧਿਐ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam araadhiai bighan na laagai koi ||2||
english: O Nanak, worshipping the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal encounters no misfortune. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਵੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa kaa boliaa paravaan hai daragah pavai thaai ||
english: The speech of the devotees is approved; it is accepted in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa teree tek rate sach naai ||
english: Your devotees take to Your Support; they are imbued with the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis no hoi kripaal tis kaa dookh jaai ||
english: One unto whom You are Merciful, has his sufferings depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਓਨੑਾ ਮਿਹਰ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat tere daiaal onhaa mihar paai ||
english: O Merciful Lord, You bless Your devotees with Your Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਵਡ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਪੋਹੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dookh darad vad rog na pohe tis maai ||
english: Suffering, pain, terrible disease and Maya do not afflict them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa ehu adhaar gun govi(n)d gaai ||
english: This is the Support of the devotees, that they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa din rain iko ik dhiaai ||
english: Forever and ever, day and night, they meditate on the One and Only Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: peevat a(n)mrit naam jan naame rahe aghaai ||14||
english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Amrit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, His humble servants remain satisfied with the Naam. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਤੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot bighan tis laagate jis no visarai naau ||
english: Millions of obstacles stand in the way of one who forgets the Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਲਪਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak anadin bilapate jiu su(n)njai ghar kaau ||1||
english: O Nanak, night and day, he croaks like a raven in a deserted house. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੀ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਜਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਾਈ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਰੁਤਿ ॥
transliteration: piree milaavaa jaa theeai saaee suhaavee rut ||
english: Beauteous is that season, when I am united with my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨਹ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵੀਐ ਨਿਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghaRee muhat nah veesarai naanak raveeai nit ||2||
english: I do not forget Him for a moment or an instant; O Nanak, I contemplate Him constantly. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਵਰੀਆਮ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: soorabeer vareeaam kinai na hoReeai ||
english: Even brave and mighty men cannot withstand the powerful

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਉਜ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਹਾਠ ਪੰਚਾ ਜੋੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: phauj sataanee haath pa(n)chaa joReeai ||
english: And overwhelming army which the five passions have gathered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਨਾਰੀ ਅਉਧੂਤ ਦੇਨਿ ਚਮੋੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: das naaree audhoot den chamoReeai ||
english: The ten organs of sensation attach even detached renunciates to sensory pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਣਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਲੈਨੑਿ ਰਲਾਇ ਏਹੋ ਏਨਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jin jin lainhi ralaai eho enaa loReeai ||
english: They seek to conquer and overpower them, and so increase their following.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਇਨ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਮੋੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: trai gun in kai vas kinai na moReeai ||
english: The world of the three dispositions is under their influence; no one can stand against them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਖਾਈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੋੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: bharam kot maaiaa khaaee kahu kit bidh toReeai ||
english: So tell me - how can the fort of doubt and the moat of Maya be overcome?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਬਿਖਮ ਦਲੁ ਫੋੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadh bikham dal phoReeai ||
english: Worshipping the Perfect Guru, this awesome force is subdued.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰ ਜੋੜੀਐ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: hau tis agai din raat rahaa kar joReeai ||15||
english: I stand before Him, day and night, with my palms pressed together. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭੇ ਉਤਰਨਿ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kilavikh sabhe utaran neet neet gun gaau ||
english: All sins are washed away, by continually singing the Lord's Glories.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲੇਸਾ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kot kalesaa oopajahi naanak bisarai naau ||1||
english: Millions of afflictions are produced, O Nanak, when the Name is forgotten. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak satigur bhetiai pooree hovai jugat ||
english: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, one comes to know the Perfect Way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਸੰਦਿਆ ਖੇਲੰਦਿਆ ਪੈਨੰਦਿਆ ਖਾਵੰਦਿਆ ਵਿਚੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hasa(n)diaa khela(n)diaa paina(n)diaa khaava(n)diaa viche hovai mukat ||2||
english: While laughing, playing, dressing and eating, he is liberated. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਰਮ ਗੜੁ ਤੋੜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: so satigur dhan dha(n)n jin bharam gaR toRiaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, who has demolished the fortress of doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੋੜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: so satigur vaahu vaahu jin har siu joRiaa ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail! Hail! to the True Guru, who has united me with the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਰੂਓ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan akhut gur dei daarooo ||
english: The Guru has given me the medicine of the inexhaustible treasure of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਤਿਨੈ ਬਿਦਾਰੂਓ ॥
transliteration: mahaa rog bikaraal tinai bidaarooo ||
english: He has banished the great and terrible disease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paaiaa naam nidhaan bahut khajaaniaa ||
english: I have obtained the great treasure of the wealth of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jitaa janam apaar aap pachhaaniaa ||
english: I have obtained eternal life, recognizing my own self.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: mahimaa kahee na jaai gur samarath dev ||
english: The Glory of the all-powerful Divine Guru cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: gur paarabraham paramesur apara(n)par alakh abhev ||16||
english: The Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, infinite, unseen and unknowable. ||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇਦਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਤੂੰ ਕਮਾਵਦਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਭੁੰਚੁ ॥
transliteration: udam karediaa jeeu too(n) kamaavadiaa sukh bhu(n)ch ||
english: Make the effort, and you shall live; practicing it, you shall enjoy peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਇਦਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤਰੀ ਚਿੰਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhiaaidiaa too(n) prabhoo mil naanak utaree chi(n)t ||1||
english: Meditating, you shall meet God, O Nanak, and your anxiety shall vanish. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭ ਚਿੰਤਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
transliteration: subh chi(n)tan gobi(n)d raman niramal saadhoo sa(n)g ||
english: Bless me with sublime thoughts, O Lord of the Universe, and contemplation in the immaculate Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam na visarau ik ghaRee kar kirapaa bhagava(n)t ||2||
english: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, for even an instant; be merciful to me, Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਕਾਹੇ ਡਰਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: teraa keetaa hoi ta kaahe darapeeai ||
english: Whatever happens is according to Your Will, so why should I be afraid?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੀਉ ਅਰਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jis mil japeeai naau tis jeeu arapeeai ||
english: Meeting Him, I meditate on the Name - I offer my soul to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇਐ ਚਿਤਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ॥
transliteration: aaiai chit nihaal saahib besumaar ||
english: When the Infinite Lord comes to mind, one is enraptured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪੋਹੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਲਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tis no pohe kavan jis val nira(n)kaar ||
english: Who can touch one who has the Formless Lord on his side?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh tis kai vas na koee baaharaa ||
english: Everything is under His control; no one is beyond Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: so bhagataa man vuthaa sach samaaharaa ||
english: He, the True Lord, dwells in the minds of His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਖਣ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tere daas dhiaain tudh too(n) rakhan vaaliaa ||
english: Your slaves meditate on You; You are the Savior, the Protector Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: sir sabhanaa samarath nadar nihaaliaa ||17||
english: You are the Almighty Overlord of all; You bless us with Your Glance of Grace. ||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਦ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਸਟ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh mad lobh moh dusat baasanaa nivaar ||
english: Take away my sexual desire, anger, pride, greed, emotional attachment and evil desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raakh lehu prabh aapane naanak sad balihaar ||1||
english: Protect me, O my God; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਂਦਿਆ ਖਾਂਦਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਘਠਾ ਪੈਨੰਦਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: khaa(n)diaa khaa(n)diaa muhu ghathaa paina(n)diaa sabh a(n)g ||
english: By eating and eating, the mouth is worn out; by wearing clothes, the limbs grow weary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak dhrig tinaa daa jeeviaa jin sach na lago ra(n)g ||2||
english: O Nanak, cursed are the lives of those who are not attuned to the Love of the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਹੋਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu jiu teraa hukam tivai tiu hovanaa ||
english: As is the Hukam of Your Command, so do things happen.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਰਖਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਇ ਖੜੋਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jah jah rakhahi aap tah jaai khaRovanaa ||
english: Wherever You keep me, there I go and stand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਧੋਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: naam terai kai ra(n)g duramat dhovanaa ||
english: With the Love of Your Name, I wash away my evil-mindedness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jap jap tudh nira(n)kaar bharam bhau khovanaa ||
english: By continually meditating on You, O Formless Lord, my doubts and fears are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਜੋਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jo terai ra(n)g rate se jon na jovanaa ||
english: Those who are attuned to Your Love, shall not be trapped in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar ik nain alovanaa ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, they behold the One Lord with their eyes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਰੋਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jinhee pachhaataa hukam tinh kade na rovanaa ||
english: Those who recognize the Lord's Command never weep.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਰੋਵਣਾ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naau naanak bakhasees man maahi parovanaa ||18||
english: O Nanak, they are blessed with the gift of the Name, woven into the fabric of their minds. ||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮੁਆ ਰਲੰਦੜੋ ਖਾਕ ॥
transliteration: jeevadiaa na chetio muaa rala(n)daRo khaak ||
english: Those who do not remember the Lord while they are alive, shall mix with the dust when they die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਦਾਰਿਆ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਨਪਾਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak duneeaa sa(n)g gudaariaa saakat mooR napaak ||1||
english: O Nanak, the foolish and filthy faithless cynic passes his life engrossed in the world. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵੰਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਮਰੰਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: jeeva(n)diaa har chetiaa mara(n)diaa har ra(n)g ||
english: One who remembers the Lord while he is alive, shall be imbued with the Lord's Love when he dies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: janam padaarath taariaa naanak saadhoo sa(n)g ||2||
english: The precious gift of his life is redeemed, O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਆਪਿ ਰਖਣ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aad jugaadee aap rakhan vaaliaa ||
english: From the beginning, and through the ages, You have been our Protector and Preserver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sach naam karataar sach pasaariaa ||
english: True is Your Name, O Creator Lord, and True is Your Creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਣਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: oonaa kahee na hoi ghate ghat saariaa ||
english: You do not lack anything; You are filling each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: miharavaan samarath aape hee ghaaliaa ||
english: You are merciful and all-powerful; You Yourself cause us to serve You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jinh man vuthaa aap se sadaa sukhaaliaa ||
english: Those whose minds in which You dwell are forever at peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aape rachan rachaai aape hee paaliaa ||
english: Having created the creation, You Yourself cherish it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਪਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap bea(n)t apaariaa ||
english: You Yourself are everything, O infinite, endless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਮੑਾਲਿਆ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: gur poore kee tek naanak sa(n)mhaaliaa ||19||
english: Nanak seeks the Protection and Support of the Perfect Guru. ||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅਰੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਰਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aad madh ar a(n)t paramesar rakhiaa ||
english: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, the Transcendent Lord has saved me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur ditaa har naam a(n)mrit chakhiaa ||
english: The True Guru has blessed me with the Lord's Name, and I have tasted the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhaa sa(n)g apaar anadin har gun ravai ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਏ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸਭਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਹ ਭਵੈ ॥
transliteration: paae manorath sabh jonee nah bhavai ||
english: I have obtained all my objectives, and I shall not wander in reincarnation again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਥਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh karate hath kaaran jo karai ||
english: Everything is in the Hands of the Creator; He does what is done.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੰਤਾ ਧੂਰਿ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ma(n)gai daan sa(n)taa dhoor tarai ||1||
english: Nanak begs for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Holy, which shall deliver him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tis no ma(n)n vasaai jin upaaiaa ||
english: Enshrine Him in your mind, the One who created you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਖਸਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin jan dhiaaiaa khasam tin sukh paaiaa ||
english: Whoever meditates on the Lord and Master obtains peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam paravaan guramukh aaiaa ||
english: Fruitful is the birth, and approved is the coming of the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਖਸਮਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hukamai bujh nihaal khasam phuramaaiaa ||
english: One who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command shall be blessed - so has the Lord and Master ordained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁ ਨਹ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis hoaa aap kripaal s nah bharamaaiaa ||
english: One who is blessed with the Lord's Mercy does not wander.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦਿਤਾ ਖਸਮਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jo jo ditaa khasam soee sukh paaiaa ||
english: Whatever the Lord and Master gives him, with that he is content.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਿਤ ॥
transliteration: naanak jisahi daiaal bujhaae hukam mit ||
english: O Nanak, one who is blessed with the kindness of the Lord, our Friend, realizes the Hukam of His Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਮਹਿ ਨਿਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jisahi bhulaae aap mar mar jamahi nit ||2||
english: But those whom the Lord Himself causes to wander, continue to die, and take reincarnation again. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਤਕਾਲਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਟਿਕਣ ਨ ਦਿਤੇ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak maare tatakaal khin tikan na dite ||
english: The slanderers are destroyed in an instant; they are not spared for even a moment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਖਵਿ ਸਕਹਿ ਫੜਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਜੁਤੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh daas kaa dukh na khav sakahi phaR jonee jute ||
english: God will not endure the sufferings of His slaves, but catching the slanderers, He binds them to the cycle of reincarnation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਥੇ ਵਾਲਿ ਪਛਾੜਿਅਨੁ ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੁਤੇ ॥
transliteration: mathe vaal pachhaaRian jam maarag mute ||
english: Grabbing them by the hair on their heads, the Lord throws them down, and leaves them on the path of Death.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਣਿਆ ਨਰਕਿ ਘੋਰਿ ਸੁਤੇ ॥
transliteration: dukh lagai bilalaaniaa narak ghor sute ||
english: They cry out in pain, in the darkest of hells.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਦਾਸ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਤੇ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: ka(n)th laai daas rakhian naanak har sate ||20||
english: But hugging His slaves close to His Heart, O Nanak, the True Lord saves them. ||20||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: raam japahu vadabhaageeho jal thal pooran soi ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, O fortunate ones; He is pervading the waters and the earth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਧਿਆਇਐ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaiai bighan na laagai koi ||1||
english: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and no misfortune shall strike you. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਤੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot bighan tis laagate jis no visarai naau ||
english: Millions of misfortunes block the way of one who forgets the Name of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਲਪਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak anadin bilapate jiu su(n)njai ghar kaau ||2||
english: O Nanak, like a crow in a deserted house, he cries out, night and day. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: simar simar daataar manorath pooriaa ||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance of the Great Giver, one's heart's desires are fulfilled.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਗਏ ਵਿਸੂਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ichh pu(n)nee man aas gae visooriaa ||
english: The hopes and desires of the mind are realized, and sorrows are forgotten.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਲਦਾ ॥
transliteration: paaiaa naam nidhaan jis no bhaaladaa ||
english: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained; I have searched for it for so long.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਾਲਦਾ ॥
transliteration: jot milee sa(n)g jot rahiaa ghaaladaa ||
english: My light is merged into the Light, and my labors are over.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਵੁਠੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d vuthe tit ghar ||
english: I abide in that house of peace, poise and bliss.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਤਹਾ ਮਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaan rahe janam na tahaa mar ||
english: My comings and goings have ended - there is no birth or death there.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saahib sevak ik ik drisataaiaa ||
english: The Master and the servant have become one, with no sense of separation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥੧॥੨॥ ਸੁਧੁ
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak sach samaaiaa ||21||1||2|| sudh
english: By Guru's Grace, Nanak is absorbed in the True Lord. ||21||1||2||Sudh||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: raag goojaree bhagataa kee baanee ||
english: Raag Goojaree, The Words Of The Devotees:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ਚਉਪਦਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: sree kabeer jeeu kaa chaupadaa ghar 2 doojaa ||
english: Chau-Padhay Of Kabeer Jee, Second House:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਾਵ ਦੁਇ ਸਿੰਗ ਗੁੰਗ ਮੁਖ ਤਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਈਹੈ ॥
transliteration: chaar paav dui si(n)g gu(n)g mukh tab kaise gun gaeehai ||
english: With four feet, two horns and a mute mouth, how could you sing the Praises of the Lord?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਠੇਗਾ ਪਰਿਹੈ ਤਬ ਕਤ ਮੂਡ ਲੁਕਈਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: oothat baithat thegaa parihai tab kat mood lukaeehai ||1||
english: Standing up and sitting down, the stick shall still fall on you, so where will you hide your head? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਲ ਬਿਰਾਨੇ ਹੁਈਹੈ ॥
transliteration: har bin bail biraane hueehai ||
english: Without the Lord, you are like a stray ox;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਫਾਟੇ ਨਾਕਨ ਟੂਟੇ ਕਾਧਨ ਕੋਦਉ ਕੋ ਭੁਸੁ ਖਈਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: phaate naakan toote kaadhan kodau ko bhus khaeehai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: with your nose torn, and your shoulders injured, you shall have only the straw of coarse grain to eat. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਡੋਲਤ ਬਨ ਮਹੀਆ ਅਜਹੁ ਨ ਪੇਟ ਅਘਈਹੈ ॥
transliteration: saaro din dolat ban maheeaa ajahu na pet aghaeehai ||
english: All day long, you shall wander in the forest, and even then, your belly will not be full.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੋ ਕਹੋ ਨ ਮਾਨੋ ਕੀਓ ਅਪਨੋ ਪਈਹੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan bhagatan ko kaho na maano keeo apano paeehai ||2||
english: You did not follow the advice of the humble devotees, and so you shall obtain the fruits of your actions. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਤ ਮਹਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਬੂਡੋ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਰਮਈਹੈ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh karat mahaa bhram boodo anik jon bharamaeehai ||
english: Enduring pleasure and pain, drowned in the great ocean of doubt, you shall wander in numerous reincarnations.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਇਹੁ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਕਤ ਪਈਹੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ratan janam khoio prabh bisario ihu ausar kat paeehai ||3||
english: You have lost the jewel of human birth by forgetting God; when will you have such an opportunity again? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਤੇਲਕ ਕੇ ਕਪਿ ਜਿਉ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਈਹੈ ॥
transliteration: bhramat phirat telak ke kap jiu gat bin rain bihaeehai ||
english: You turn on the wheel of reincarnation, like an ox at the oil-press; the night of your life passes away without salvation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੂੰਡ ਧੁਨੇ ਪਛੁਤਈਹੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer raam naam bin moo(n)d dhune pachhutaeehai ||4||1||
english: Says Kabeer, without the Name of the Lord, you shall pound your head, and regret and repent. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: goojaree ghar 3 ||
english: Goojaree, Third House:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mus mus rovai kabeer kee maaee ||
english: Kabeer's mother sobs, cries and bewails

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਰਘੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: e baarik kaise jeevahi raghuraaee ||1||
english: - O Lord, how will my grandchildren live? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਨਨਾ ਬੁਨਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਤਜਿਓ ਹੈ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
transliteration: tananaa bunanaa sabh tajio hai kabeer ||
english: Kabeer has given up all his spinning and weaving,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੀਓ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
