transliteration: har kaa naam likh leeo sareer ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and written the Name of the Lord on his body. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤਾਗਾ ਬਾਹਉ ਬੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jab lag taagaa baahau behee ||
english: As long as I pass the thread through the bobbin,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tab lag bisarai raam sanehee ||2||
english: I forget the Lord, my Beloved. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਜੁਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: ochhee mat meree jaat julaahaa ||
english: My intellect is lowly - I am a weaver by birth,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਹਿਓ ਮੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har kaa naam lahio mai laahaa ||3||
english: but I have earned the profit of the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu meree maaee ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O my mother

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਇਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਰਘੁਰਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: hamaraa in kaa daataa ek raghuraaee ||4||2||
english: - the Lord alone is the Provider, for me and my children. ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: goojaree sree naamadev jee ke pade ghar 1 ||
english: Goojaree, Padhay Of Naam Dayv Jee, First House:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੌ ਰਾਜੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jau raaj dehi ta kavan badaaee ||
english: If You gave me an empire, then what glory would be in it for me?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੌ ਭੀਖ ਮੰਗਾਵਹਿ ਤ ਕਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jau bheekh ma(n)gaavahi ta kiaa ghat jaaee ||1||
english: If You made me beg for charity, what would it take away from me? ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: too(n) har bhaj man mere pad nirabaan ||
english: Meditate and vibrate upon the Lord, O my mind, and you shall obtain the state of Nirvaanaa.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bahur na hoi teraa aavan jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall not have to come and go in reincarnation any longer. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੈ ਉਪਾਈ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh tai upaaee bharam bhulaaee ||
english: You created all, and You lead them astray in doubt.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis too(n) devahi tisahi bujhaaee ||2||
english: They alone understand, unto whom You give understanding. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta sahasaa jaaee ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, doubt is dispelled.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਪੂਜਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kis hau poojau doojaa nadar na aaee ||3||
english: Who else should I worship? I can see no other. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀਜੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ekai paathar keejai bhaau ||
english: One stone is lovingly decorated,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਾਥਰ ਧਰੀਐ ਪਾਉ ॥
transliteration: doojai paathar dhareeai paau ||
english: while another stone is walked upon.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਓਹੁ ਦੇਉ ਤ ਓਹੁ ਭੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: je ohu deu ta ohu bhee devaa ||
english: If one is a god, then the other must also be a god.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahi naamadeu ham har kee sevaa ||4||1||
english: Says Naam Dayv, I serve the Lord. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: goojaree ghar 1 ||
english: Goojaree, First House:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਲੈ ਨ ਲਾਛੈ ਪਾਰ ਮਲੋ ਪਰਮਲੀਓ ਬੈਠੋ ਰੀ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: malai na laachhai paar malo paramaleeo baitho ree aaee ||
english: He does not have even a trace of impurity - He is beyond impurity. He is fragrantly scented - He has come to take His Seat in my mind.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਕਵਨੈ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੀ ਬਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aavat kinai na pekhio kavanai jaanai ree baaee ||1||
english: No one saw Him come - who can know Him, O Siblings of Destiny? ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਿਣਿ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਰਮਈਆ ਆਕੁਲੁ ਰੀ ਬਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaun kahai kin boojheeai ramaeeaa aakul ree baaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Who can describe Him? Who can understand Him? The all-pervading Lord has no ancestors, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਆਕਾਸੈ ਪੰਖੀਅਲੋ ਖੋਜੁ ਨਿਰਖਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jiu aakaasai pa(n)kheealo khoj nirakhio na jaaee ||
english: As the path of a bird's flight across the sky cannot be seen,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਾਝੈ ਮਾਛਲੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੇਖਣੋ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu jal maajhai maachhalo maarag pekhano na jaaee ||2||
english: and the path of a fish through the water cannot be seen;||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਆਕਾਸੈ ਘੜੂਅਲੋ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jiu aakaasai ghaRooalo mrig trisanaa bhariaa ||
english: As the mirage leads one to mistake the sky for a pitcher filled with water

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਚੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੀਠਲੋ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੀਨੈ ਜਰਿਆ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: naame che suaamee beethalo jin teenai jariaa ||3||2||
english: - so is God, the Lord and Master of Naam Dayv, who fits these three comparisons. ||3||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: goojaree sree ravidaas jee ke pade ghar 3 ||
english: Goojaree, Padhay Of Ravi Daas Jee, Third House:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੂਧੁ ਤ ਬਛਰੈ ਥਨਹੁ ਬਿਟਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: doodh ta bachharai thanahu bitaario ||
english: The calf has contaminated the milk in the teats.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਫੂਲੁ ਭਵਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਮੀਨਿ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: phool bhavar jal meen bigaario ||1||
english: The bumble bee has contaminated the flower, and the fish the water. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਹਾ ਲੈ ਚਰਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: maaee gobi(n)d poojaa kahaa lai charaavau ||
english: O mother, where shall I find any offering for the Lord's worship?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਫੂਲੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avar na phool anoop na paavau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I cannot find any other flowers worthy of the incomparable Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾਗਰ ਬੇਰ੍ਹੇ ਹੈ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: mailaagar berhe hai bhuia(n)gaa ||
english: The snakes encircle the sandalwood trees.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਸਹਿ ਇਕ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bikh a(n)mrit basahi ik sa(n)gaa ||2||
english: Poison and nectar dwell there together. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਨਈਬੇਦਹਿ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: dhoop deep naeebedahi baasaa ||
english: Even with incense, lamps, offerings of food and fragrant flowers,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕੈਸੇ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaise pooj karahi teree daasaa ||3||
english: how are Your slaves to worship You? ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਪੂਜ ਚਰਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: tan man arapau pooj charaavau ||
english: I dedicate and offer my body and mind to You.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur parasaad nira(n)jan paavau ||4||
english: By Guru's Grace, I attain the immaculate Lord. ||4||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਆਹਿ ਨ ਤੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: poojaa arachaa aahi na toree ||
english: I cannot worship You, nor offer You flowers.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਕਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੫॥੧॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas kavan gat moree ||5||1||
english: Says Ravi Daas, what shall my condition be hereafter? ||5||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: goojaree sree trilochan jeeu ke pade ghar 1 ||
english: Goojaree, Padhay Of Trilochan Jee, First House:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਲਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar mal niramal nahee keenaa baahar bhekh udaasee ||
english: You have not cleansed the filth from within yourself, although outwardly, you wear the dress of a renunciate.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਭਇਆ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hiradai kamal ghat braham na cheenhaa kaahe bhaiaa sa(n)niaasee ||1||
english: In the heart-lotus of your self, you have not recognized God - why have you become a Sannyaasee? ||1||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲੀ ਰੇ ਜੈ ਚੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: bharame bhoolee re jai cha(n)daa ||
english: Deluded by doubt, O Jai Chand,

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨੑਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nahee nahee cheenhiaa paramaana(n)daa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: you have not realized the Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਖਾਇਆ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਬਧਾਇਆ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਮੁੰਦਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ghar ghar khaaiaa pi(n)d badhaaiaa khi(n)thaa mu(n)daa maaiaa ||
english: You eat in each and every house, fattening your body; you wear the patched coat and the ear-rings of the beggar, for the sake of wealth.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਮਿ ਮਸਾਣ ਕੀ ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhoom masaan kee bhasam lagaaee gur bin tat na paaiaa ||2||
english: You apply the ashes of cremation to your body, but without a Guru, you have not found the essence of reality. ||2||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਕਾਇ ਤਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਕਾਇ ਬਿਲੋਵਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: kaai japahu re kaai tapahu re kaai bilovahu paanee ||
english: Why bother to chant your spells? Why bother to practice austerities? Why bother to churn water?

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜਿਨੑਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jinhi upaaee so simarahu nirabaanee ||3||
english: Meditate on the Lord of Nirvaanaa, who has created the 8.4 million species of beings. ||3||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇ ਕਮੰਡਲੁ ਕਾਪੜੀਆ ਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਕਾਇ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kaai kama(n)dal kaapaReeaa re athasath kaai phiraahee ||
english: Why bother to carry the water-pot, O saffron-robed Yogi? Why bother to visit the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage?

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਬਦਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕਣ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਾਹੁ ਕਿ ਪਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: badat trilochan sun re praanee kan bin gaahu k paahee ||4||1||
english: Says Trilochan, listen, mortal: you have no corn - what are you trying to thresh? ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ॥
transliteration: goojaree ||
english: Goojaree:

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਲਛਮੀ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal jo lachhamee simarai aisee chi(n)taa mahi je marai ||
english: At the very last moment, one who thinks of wealth, and dies in such thoughts,

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਪ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarap jon val val autarai ||1||
english: shall be reincarnated over and over again, in the form of serpents. ||1||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਅਰੀ ਬਾਈ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਤਿ ਬੀਸਰੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aree baaee gobid naam mat beesarai || rahaau ||
english: O sister, do not forget the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||Pause||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal jo isatree simarai aisee chi(n)taa mahi je marai ||
english: At the very last moment, he who thinks of women, and dies in such thoughts,

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਸਵਾ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: besavaa jon val val autarai ||2||
english: shall be reincarnated over and over again as a prostitute. ||2||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਲੜਿਕੇ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal jo laRike simarai aisee chi(n)taa mahi je marai ||
english: At the very last moment, one who thinks of his children, and dies in such thoughts,

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਕਰ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sookar jon val val autarai ||3||
english: shall be reincarnated over and over again as a pig. ||3||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਮੰਦਰ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal jo ma(n)dar simarai aisee chi(n)taa mahi je marai ||
english: At the very last moment, one who thinks of mansions, and dies in such thoughts,

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: pret jon val val autarai ||4||
english: shall be reincarnated over and over again as a goblin. ||4||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal naaraain simarai aisee chi(n)taa mahi je marai ||
english: At the very last moment, one who thinks of the Lord, and dies in such thoughts,

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਬਦਤਿ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਪੀਤੰਬਰੁ ਵਾ ਕੇ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੈ ॥੫॥੨॥
transliteration: badat tilochan te nar mukataa peeta(n)bar vaa ke ridai basai ||5||2||
english: says Trilochan, that man shall be liberated; the Lord shall abide in his heart. ||5||2||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਜੈਦੇਵ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ਪਦਾ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: goojaree sree jaidev jeeu kaa padaa ghar 4 ||
english: Goojaree, Padhay Of Jai Dayv Jee, Fourth House:

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਪੁਰਖਮਨੋਪਿਮੰ ਸਤਿ ਆਦਿ ਭਾਵ ਰਤੰ ॥
transliteration: paramaad purakhamanopima(n) sat aad bhaav rata(n) ||
english: In the very beginning, was the Primal Lord, unrivalled, the Lover of Truth and other virtues.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤੰ ਪਰਕ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪਰੰ ਜਦਿਚਿੰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਗਤੰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paramadabhuta(n) parakrit para(n) jadichi(n)t sarab gata(n) ||1||
english: He is absolutely wonderful, transcending creation; remembering Him, all are emancipated. ||1||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਮਨੋਰਮੰ ॥
transliteration: keval raam naam manorama(n) ||
english: Dwell only upon the beauteous Name of the Lord,

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਬਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਤ ਮਇਅੰ ॥
transliteration: bad a(n)mrit tat maia(n) ||
english: the embodiment of ambrosial nectar and reality.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਨ ਦਨੋਤਿ ਜਸਮਰਣੇਨ ਜਨਮ ਜਰਾਧਿ ਮਰਣ ਭਇਅੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: na danot jasamaranen janam jaraadh maran bhaia(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, the fear of birth, old age and death will not trouble you. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਇਛਸਿ ਜਮਾਦਿ ਪਰਾਭਯੰ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਵਸਤਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ ॥
transliteration: ichhas jamaad paraabhaya(n) jas svasat sukrit krita(n) ||
english: If you desire to escape the fear of the Messenger of Death, then praise the Lord joyfully, and do good deeds.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਭੂਤ ਭਾਵ ਸਮਬੵਿਅੰ ਪਰਮੰ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨਮਿਦੰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhav bhoot bhaav samabyia(n) parama(n) prasa(n)namida(n) ||2||
english: In the past, present and future, He is always the same; He is the embodiment of supreme bliss. ||2||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭਾਦਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੰ ਜਦਿਬਿਧਿ ਆਚਰਣੰ ॥
transliteration: lobhaad drisat par griha(n) jadibidh aacharana(n) ||
english: If you seek the path of good conduct, forsake greed, and do not look upon other men's property and women.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਸਕਲ ਦੁਹਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਦੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਜੁ ਚਕ੍ਰਧਰ ਸਰਣੰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taj sakal duhakrit duramatee bhaj chakradhar sarana(n) ||3||
english: Renounce all evil actions and evil inclinations, and hurry to the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||3||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਜ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲਾ ਰਿਦ ਕਰਮਣਾ ਬਚਸਾ ॥
transliteration: har bhagat nij nihakevalaa rid karamanaa bachasaa ||
english: Worship the immaculate Lord, in thought, word and deed.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੇਨ ਕਿੰ ਜਗੇਨ ਕਿੰ ਦਾਨੇਨ ਕਿੰ ਤਪਸਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jogen ki(n) jagen ki(n) daanen ki(n) tapasaa ||4||
english: What is the good of practicing Yoga, giving feasts and charity, and practicing penance? ||4||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੇਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਰ ਸਕਲ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਦੰ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d gobi(n)det jap nar sakal sidh pada(n) ||
english: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the Universe, O man; He is the source of all the spiritual powers of the Siddhas.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਦੇਵ ਆਇਉ ਤਸ ਸਫੁਟੰ ਭਵ ਭੂਤ ਸਰਬ ਗਤੰ ॥੫॥੧॥
transliteration: jaidev aaiu tas saphuta(n) bhav bhoot sarab gata(n) ||5||1||
english: Jai Dayv has openly come to Him; He is the salvation of all, in the past, present and future. ||5||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਬਨੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: sevak jan bane thaakur liv laage ||
english: Those who become the humble servants of the Lord and Master, lovingly focus their minds on Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖ ਭਾਗ ਸਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo tumaraa jas kahate guramat tin mukh bhaag sabhaage ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who chant Your Praises, through the Guru's Teachings, have great good fortune recorded upon their foreheads. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਫਾਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: toote maaiaa ke ba(n)dhan phaahe har raam naam liv laage ||
english: The bonds and shackles of Maya are shattered, by lovingly focusing their minds on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਹਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hamaraa man mohio gur mohan ham bisam bhaee mukh laage ||1||
english: My mind is enticed by the Guru, the Enticer; beholding Him, I am wonder-struck. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੋਈ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: sagalee rain soee a(n)dhiaaree gur ki(n)chat kirapaa jaage ||
english: I slept through the entire dark night of my life, but through the tiniest bit of the Guru's Grace, I have been awakened.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak ke prabh su(n)dar suaamee mohi tum sar avar na laage ||2||1||
english: O Beautiful Lord God, Master of servant Nanak, there is none comparable to You. ||2||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੋ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਗਲੀ ॥
transliteration: mero su(n)dar kahahu milai kit galee ||
english: Tell me - on what path will I find my Beauteous Lord?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਹਮ ਪੀਛੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਚਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t bataavahu maarag ham peechhai laag chalee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Saints of the Lord, show me the Way, and I shall follow. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਇਹ ਚਾਲ ਬਨੀ ਹੈ ਭਲੀ ॥
transliteration: pri ke bachan sukhaane heearai ih chaal banee hai bhalee ||
english: I cherish in my heart the Words of my Beloved; this is the best way.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲਟੁਰੀ ਮਧੁਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਈ ਓਹ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਮਿਲੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: laturee madhuree thaakur bhaaee oh su(n)dar har dhul milee ||1||
english: The bride may be hunch-backed and short, but if she is loved by her Lord Master, she becomes beautiful, and she melts in the Lord's embrace. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਸਖੀਆ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਿਰ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ॥
transliteration: eko priu sakheeaa sabh pri kee jo bhaavai pir saa bhalee ||
english: There is only the One Beloved - we are all soul-brides of our Husband Lord. She who is pleasing to her Husband Lord is good.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਚਲੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak gareeb kiaa karai bichaaraa har bhaavai tit raahi chalee ||2||2||
english: What can poor, helpless Nanak do? As it pleases the Lord, so does he walk. ||2||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: mere man mukh har har har boleeai ||
english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭੀਨੀ ਚੋਲੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ra(n)g chaloolai raatee har prem bheenee choleeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Gurmukh is imbued with the deep red color of the poppy. His shawl is saturated with the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਫਿਰਉ ਦਿਵਾਨੀ ਆਵਲ ਬਾਵਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਢੋਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: hau phirau divaanee aaval baaval tis kaaran har dholeeai ||
english: I wander around here and there, like a madman, bewildered, seeking out my Darling Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਮੇਲੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗੁਲ ਗੋਲੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: koee melai meraa preetam piaaraa ham tis kee gul goleeai ||1||
english: I shall be the slave of the slave of whoever unites me with my Darling Beloved. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਵਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਝੋਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh manaavahu apunaa har a(n)mrit pee jholeeai ||
english: So align yourself with the Almighty True Guru; drink in and savor the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਧਾ ਦੇਹ ਟੋਲੀਐ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: gur prasaad jan naanak paaiaa har laadhaa deh toleeai ||2||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, servant Nanak has obtained the wealth of the Lord within. ||2||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਹਮ ਚਲੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ab ham chalee thaakur pahi haar ||
english: Now, I have come, exhausted, to my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੀ ਆਈ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab ham saran prabhoo kee aaee raakh prabhoo bhaavai maar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Now that I have come seeking Your Sanctuary, God, please, either save me, or kill me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੇ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: lokan kee chaturaaee upamaa te baisa(n)tar jaar ||
english: I have burnt in the fire the clever devices and praises of the world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਭਲਾ ਕਹਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਹਉ ਹਮ ਤਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਹੈ ਢਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: koee bhalaa kahau bhaavai buraa kahau ham tan deeo hai dhaar ||1||
english: Some speak good of me, and some speak ill of me, but I have surrendered my body to You. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਆਵਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jo aavat saran thaakur prabh tumaree tis raakhahu kirapaa dhaar ||
english: Whoever comes to Your Sanctuary, O God, Lord and Master, You save by Your Merciful Grace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak saran tumaaree har jeeu raakhahu laaj muraar ||2||4||
english: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, Dear Lord; O Lord, please, protect his honor! ||2||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavai hau tis balihaaree ||
english: I am a sacrifice to one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dekh dekh jeevaa saadh gur darasan jis hiradai naam muraaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I live by continuously beholding the Blessed Vision of the Holy Guru's Darshan; within His Mind is the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਵਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਜੂਠਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tum pavitr paavan purakh prabh suaamee ham kiu kar milah joothaaree ||
english: You are pure and immaculate, O God, Almighty Lord and Master; how can I, the impure one, meet You?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਜੀਇ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hamarai jeei hor mukh hor hot hai ham karamaheen kooRiaaree ||1||
english: I have one thing in my mind, and another thing on my lips; I am such a poor, unfortunate liar! ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦੁਸਟ ਦੁਸਟਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: hamaree mudr naam har suaamee rid a(n)tar dusat dusataaree ||
english: I appear to chant the Lord's Name, but within my heart, I am the most wicked of the wicked.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakhahu suaamee jan naanak saran tumhaaree ||2||5||
english: As it pleases You, save me, O Lord and Master; servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||2||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਹੈ ਨਕਟੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam binaa su(n)dar hai nakatee ||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, the beautiful are just like the noseless ones.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੇਸੁਆ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਪੂਤੁ ਜਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਧ੍ਰਕਟੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu besuaa ke ghar poot jamat hai tis naam pario hai dhrakatee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Like the son, born into the house of a prostitute, his name is cursed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇ ਬਿਗੜ ਰੂਪ ਬੇਰਕਟੀ ॥
transliteration: jin kai hiradai naahi har suaamee te bigaR roop berakatee ||
english: Those who do not have the Name of their Lord and Master within their hearts, are the most wretched, deformed lepers.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਨਿਗੁਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੈ ਭ੍ਰਸਟੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu niguraa bahu baataa jaanai ohu har daragah hai bhrasatee ||1||
english: Like the person who has no Guru, they may know many things, but they are cursed in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਚਕਟੀ ॥
transliteration: jin kau daiaal hoaa meraa suaamee tinaa saadh janaa pag chakatee ||
english: Those, unto whom my Lord Master becomes Merciful, long for the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਛੈ ਛੁਕਟੀ ॥੨॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧
transliteration: naanak patit pavit mil sa(n)gat gur satigur paachhai chhukatee ||2||6|| chhakaa 1
english: O Nanak, the sinners become pure, joining the Company of the Holy; following the Guru, the True Guru, they are emancipated. ||2||6|| First Set of Six||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: maaee gur charanee chit laaeeai ||
english: O mother, I focus my consciousness on the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh hoi kripaal kamal paragaase sadaa sadaa har dhiaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As God shows His Mercy, the lotus of my heart blossoms, and forever and ever, I meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar eko baahar eko sabh mahi ek samaaeeai ||
english: The One Lord is within, and the One Lord is outside; the One Lord is contained in all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ghat avaghat raviaa sabh thaaee har pooran braham dikhaaeeai ||1||
english: Within the heart, beyond the heart, and in all places, God, the Perfect One, is seen to be permeating. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: usatat karahi sevak mun kete teraa a(n)t na katahoo paaeeai ||
english: So many of Your servants and silent sages sing Your Praises, but no one has found Your limits.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: sukhadaate dukh bha(n)jan suaamee jan naanak sad bal jaaeeai ||2||1||
english: O Giver of peace, Destroyer of pain, Lord and Master - servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਹੋਨਹਾਰ ਸੋ ਹੋਈਐ ॥
transliteration: maaee honahaar so hoeeai ||
english: O mother, whatever is to be, shall be.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਚਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਹਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਕਹਾ ਖੋਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raach rahio rachanaa prabh apanee kahaa laabh kahaa khoeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God pervades His pervading creation; one gains, while another loses. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਹ ਫੂਲਹਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਬਿਖੈ ਸੋਗ ਕਬ ਹਸਨੋ ਕਬ ਰੋਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kah phoolahi aana(n)d bikhai sog kab hasano kab roeeai ||
english: Sometimes he blossoms in bliss, while at other times, he suffers in mourning. Sometimes he laughs, and sometimes he weeps.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਕਬ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਧੋਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kabahoo mail bhare abhimaanee kab saadhoo sa(n)g dhoeeai ||1||
english: Sometimes he is filled with the filth of ego, while at other times, he washes it off in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਲੋਈਐ ॥
transliteration: koi na metai prabh kaa keeaa doosar naahee aloeeai ||
english: No one can erase the actions of God; I cannot see any other like Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਈਐ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tis gur balihaaree jih prasaad sukh soeeai ||2||2||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru; by His Grace, I sleep in peace. ||2||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੋਚ ਭੈ ਡਰਤ ॥
transliteration: maaee sunat soch bhai darat ||
english: O mother, I hear of death, and think of it, and I am filled with fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰ ਤੇਰ ਤਜਉ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਪਰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mer ter tajau abhimaanaa saran suaamee kee parat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Renouncing 'mine and yours' and egotism, I have sought the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਉ ਨਾਹਿ ਨ ਕਾ ਬੋਲ ਕਰਤ ॥
transliteration: jo jo kahai soee bhal maanau naahi na kaa bol karat ||
english: Whatever He says, I accept that as good. I do not say "No" to what He says.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਉ ਹੀਏ ਮੋਰੇ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਜਾਈ ਹਉ ਮਰਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nimakh na bisarau heee more te bisarat jaaee hau marat ||1||
english: Let me not forget Him, even for an instant; forgetting Him, I die. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਇਆਨਪ ਜਰਤ ॥
transliteration: sukhadaaee pooran prabh karataa meree bahut iaanap jarat ||
english: The Giver of peace, God, the Perfect Creator, endures my great ignorance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ ਕਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਲਹੀਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਰਤ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: niragun karoop kulaheen naanak hau anad roop suaamee bharat ||2||3||
english: I am worthless, ugly and of low birth, O Nanak, but my Husband Lord is the embodiment of bliss. ||2||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਦਹੂੰ ॥
transliteration: man har keerat kar sadahoo(n) ||
english: O my mind, chant forever the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਜਪਤ ਉਧਾਰੈ ਬਰਨ ਅਬਰਨਾ ਸਭਹੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gaavat sunat japat udhaarai baran abaranaa sabhahoo(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By singing, hearing and meditating on Him, all, whether of high or low status, are saved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨੀ ਤਬਹੂੰ ॥
transliteration: jah te upajio tahee samaaio ih bidh jaanee tabahoo(n) ||
english: He is absorbed into the One from which he originated, when he understands the Way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਇਹ ਦੇਹੀ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਬਹੂੰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jahaa jahaa ih dehee dhaaree rahan na paaio kabahoo(n) ||1||
english: Wherever this body was fashioned, it was not allowed to remain there. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਆਇਓ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਹੂਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਬਹੂ ॥
transliteration: sukh aaio bhai bharam binaase kripaal hooe prabh jabahoo ||
english: Peace comes, and fear and doubt are dispelled, when God becomes Merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਜਿ ਲਬਹੂੰ ॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak mere poore manorath saadhasa(n)g taj labahoo(n) ||2||4||
english: Says Nanak, my hopes have been fulfilled, renouncing my greed in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਜਿਉ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: man jiu apune prabh bhaavau ||
english: O my mind, act as it pleases God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਾਨੑਾ ਹੋਇ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: neechahu neech neech at naanhaa hoi gareeb bulaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Become the lowest of the low, the very least of the tiny, and speak in utmost humility. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਘਟਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: anik ada(n)bar maaiaa ke birathe taa siu preet ghataavau ||
english: The many ostentatious shows of Maya are useless; I withhold my love from these.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu apuno suaamee sukh maanai taa mahi sobhaa paavau ||1||
english: As something pleases my Lord and Master, in that I find my glory. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸ ਰੇਣੁ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: daasan daas ren daasan kee jan kee tahal kamaavau ||
english: I am the slave of His slaves; becoming the dust of the feet of his slaves, I serve His humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਬਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਉ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ ॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: sarab sookh badiaaee naanak jeevau mukhahu bulaavau ||2||5||
english: I obtain all peace and greatness, O Nanak, living to chant His Name with my mouth. ||2||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: prabh jee tau prasaad bhram daario ||
english: Dear God, by Your Grace, my doubts have been dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਅਪਨਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਇਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tumaree kripaa te sabh ko apanaa man mahi ihai beechaario ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Your Mercy, all are mine; I reflect upon this in my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਮਿਟੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: kot paraadh mite teree sevaa darasan dookh utaario ||
english: Millions of sins are erased, by serving You; the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan drives away sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam japat mahaa sukh paaio chi(n)taa rog bidaario ||1||
english: Chanting Your Name, I have obtained supreme peace, and my anxieties and diseases have been cast out. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh jhooth ni(n)daa saadhoo sa(n)g bisaario ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, greed, falsehood and slander are forgotten, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੬॥
transliteration: maaiaa ba(n)dh kaate kirapaa nidh naanak aap udhaario ||2||6||
english: The ocean of mercy has cut away the bonds of Maya; O Nanak, He has saved me. ||2||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਰਹੀ ॥
transliteration: man sagal siaanap rahee ||
english: All the cleverness of my mind is gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavanahaar suaamee naanak ot gahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord and Master is the Doer, the Cause of causes; Nanak holds tight to His Support. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਹੀ ॥
transliteration: aap met pae saranaaee ih mat saadhoo kahee ||
english: Erasing my self-conceit, I have entered His Sanctuary; these are the Teachings spoken by the Holy Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ ਲਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh kee aagiaa maan sukh paaiaa bharam adheraa lahee ||1||
english: Surrendering to the Will of God, I attain peace, and the darkness of doubt is dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਅਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jaan prabeen suaamee prabh mere saran tumaaree ahee ||
english: I know that You are all-wise, O God, my Lord and Master; I seek Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਹੀ ॥੨॥੭॥
transliteration: khin mahi thaap uthaapanahaare kudarat keem na pahee ||2||7||
english: In an instant, You establish and disestablish; the value of Your Almighty Creative Power cannot be estimated. ||2||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: har praan prabhoo sukhadaate ||
english: The Lord God is my praanaa, my breath of life; He is the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad kaahoo jaate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, only a few know Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਾਲ ਨ ਖਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t tumaare tumare preetam tin kau kaal na khaate ||
english: Your Saints are Your Beloveds; death does not consume them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਲਾਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ra(n)g tumaarai laal bhae hai raam naam ras maate ||1||
english: They are dyed in the deep crimson color of Your Love, and they are intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੋਖ ਰੋਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਹਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: mahaa kilabikh kot dokh rogaa prabh drisat tuhaaree haate ||
english: The greatest sins, and millions of pains and diseases are destroyed by Your Gracious Glance, O God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥੨॥੮॥
transliteration: sovat jaag har har har gaaiaa naanak gur charan paraate ||2||8||
english: While sleeping and waking, Nanak sings the Lord's Name, Har, Har, Har; he falls at the Guru's feet. ||2||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: so prabh jat kat pekhio nainee ||
english: I have seen that God with my eyes everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬੈਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukhadaaee jeean ko daataa a(n)mrit jaa kee bainee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Giver of peace, the Giver of souls, His Speech is Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ ਸੰਤੀ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: agiaan adheraa sa(n)tee kaatiaa jee daan gur dainee ||
english: The Saints dispel the darkness of ignorance; the Guru is the Giver of the gift of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਜਲਤੇ ਸੀਤਲ ਹੋਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa kar leeno apunaa jalate seetal honee ||1||
english: Granting His Grace, the Lord has made me His own; I was on fire, but now I am cooled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਉਪਜਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਨਹ ਉਪਜੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam kichh upaj na aaio nah upajee niramal karanee ||
english: The karma of good deeds, and the Dharma of righteous faith, have not been produced in me, in the least; nor has pure conduct welled up in me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਗੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੨॥੯॥
transliteration: chhaad siaanap sa(n)jam naanak laago gur kee charanee ||2||9||
english: Renouncing cleverness and self-mortification, O Nanak, I fall at the Guru's feet. ||2||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: har raam naam jap laahaa ||
english: Chant the Lord's Name, and earn the profit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gat paavahi sukh sahaj ana(n)daa kaate jam ke phaahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall attain salvation, peace, poise and bliss, and the noose of Death shall be cut away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਪਹਿ ਆਹਾ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat khoj beechaario har sa(n)t janaa pahi aahaa ||
english: Searching, searching, searching and reflecting, I have found that the Lord's Name is with the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tinhaa paraapat ehu nidhaanaa jinh kai karam likhaahaa ||1||
english: They alone obtain this treasure, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੇ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: se badabhaagee se pativa(n)te seee poore saahaa ||
english: They are very fortunate and honorable; they are the perfect bankers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸਰੂਪ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ॥੨॥੧੦॥
transliteration: su(n)dar sughaR saroop te naanak jinh har har naam visaahaa ||2||10||
english: They are beautiful, so very wise and handsome; O Nanak, purchase the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਹ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਫਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man kah aha(n)kaar aphaaraa ||
english: O mind, why are you so puffed up with egotism?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਪਾਵਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਛਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: duraga(n)dh apavitr apaavan bheetar jo deesai so chhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever is seen in this foul, impure and filthy world, is only ashes. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jin keeaa tis simar paraanee jeeu praan jin dhaaraa ||
english: Remember the One who created you, O mortal; He is the Support of your soul, and the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਲਪਟਾਵਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tisahi tiaag avar lapataavahi mar janamahi mugadh gavaaraa ||1||
english: One who forsakes Him, and attaches himself to another, dies to be reborn; he is such an ignorant fool! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਗੁੰਗ ਪਿੰਗੁਲ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh gu(n)g pi(n)gul mat heenaa prabh raakhahu raakhanahaaraa ||
english: I am blind, mute, crippled and totally lacking in understanding; O God, Preserver of all, please preserve me!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: karan karaavanahaar samarathaa kiaa naanak ja(n)t bichaaraa ||2||11||
english: The Creator, the Cause of causes is all-powerful; O Nanak, how helpless are His beings! ||2||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰੈ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so prabh nerai hoo te nerai ||
english: God is the nearest of the near.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਝ ਸਵੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: simar dhiaai gaai gun gobi(n)d din rain saajh saverai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Remember Him, meditate on Him, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, day and night, evening and morning. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਧਰੁ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਲਭ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: udhar deh dulabh saadhoo sa(n)g har har naam japerai ||
english: Redeem your body in the invaluable Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰੀ ਨ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਬਿਲੰਬਹੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਹੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gharee na muhat na chasaa bila(n)bahu kaal nitahi nit herai ||1||
english: Do not delay for an instant, even for a moment. Death is keeping you constantly in his vision. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਬਿਲਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh bilaa te kaadhahu karate kiaa naahee ghar terai ||
english: Lift me up out of the dark dungeon, O Creator Lord; what is there which is not in Your home?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਆਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੈ ॥੨॥੧੨॥ ਛਕੇ ੨ ॥
transliteration: naam adhaar deejai naanak kau aanad sookh ghanerai ||2||12|| chhake 2 ||
english: Bless Nanak with the Support of Your Name, that he may find great happiness and peace. ||2||12|| Second Set of Six||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਓ ॥
transliteration: man gur mil naam araadhio ||
english: O mind, meet with the Guru, and worship the Naam in adoration.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਜੀਵਨ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ma(n)gal ras jeevan kaa mool baadhio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall obtain peace, poise, bliss, joy and pleasure, and lay the foundation of eternal life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਾਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਧਿਓ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apunaa daas keeno kaate maaiaa phaadhio ||
english: Showing His Mercy, the Lord has made me His slave, and shattered the bonds of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਾਧਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhaau bhagat gaai gun gobid jam kaa maarag saadhio ||1||
english: Through loving devotion, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, I have escaped the Path of Death. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਮੋਰਚਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਾਧਿਓ ॥
transliteration: bhaio anugrahu mitio morachaa amol padaarath laadhio ||
english: When he became Merciful, the rust was removed, and I found the priceless treasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਖ ਬੇਰਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿਓ ॥੨॥੧੩॥
transliteration: balihaarai naanak lakh beraa mere thaakur agam agaadhio ||2||13||
english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice, a hundred thousand times, to my unapproachable, unfathomable Lord and Master. ||2||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: maaee jo prabh ke gun gaavai ||
english: O mother, how fruitful is the birth of one who sings the Glories of God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਆਇਆ ਜੀਵਨ ਫਲੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saphal aaiaa jeevan phal taa ko paarabraham liv laavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and enshrines love for the Supreme Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਸੋ ਬੇਤਾ ਜੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar sughaR soor so betaa jo saadhoo sa(n)g paavai ||
english: Beautiful, wise, brave and divine is one who obtains the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam uchaar kare har rasanaa bahuR na jonee dhaavai ||1||
english: He chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with his tongue, and does not have to wander in reincarnation again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਨ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: pooran braham raviaa man tan mahi aan na drisatee aavai ||
english: The Perfect Lord God pervades his mind and body; he does not look upon any other.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਰੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਵਤ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੧੪॥
transliteration: narak rog nahee hovat jan sa(n)g naanak jis laR laavai ||2||14||
english: Hell and disease do not afflict one who joins the Company of the Lord's humble servants, O Nanak; the Lord attaches him to the hem of His robe. ||2||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਹੀ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)chal supanai hee urajhaaio ||
english: His fickle mind is entangled in a dream.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਤਨੀ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਚਲਨਾ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਇਓ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: itanee na boojhai kabahoo chalanaa bikal bhaio sa(n)g maaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He does not even understand this much, that someday he shall have to depart; he has gone crazy with Maya. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਸਮ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਰਸਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਏਕ ਉਪਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kusam ra(n)g sa(n)g ras rachiaa bikhiaa ek upaaio ||
english: He is engrossed in the delight of the flower's color; he strives only to indulge in corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਸੁਨੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਬੇਗਿ ਤਹਾ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lobh sunai man sukh kar maanai beg tahaa uth dhaaio ||1||
english: Hearing about greed, he feels happy in his mind, and he runs after it. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਸੰਤ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: phirat phirat bahut sram paaio sa(n)t duaarai aaio ||
english: Wandering and roaming all around, I have endured great pain, but now, I have come to the door of the Saint.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਓ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧੫॥
transliteration: karee kripaa paarabraham suaamee naanak leeo samaaio ||2||15||
english: Granting His Grace, the Supreme Lord Master has blended Nanak with Himself. ||2||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa gur charanaa ||
english: All peace is found in the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਮਲ ਡਾਰਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਧਾਰਨ ਇਹ ਆਸਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kalimal daaran manahi sadhaaran ih aasar mohi taranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They drive away my sins and purify my mind; their Support carries me across. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਇਹੈ ਟਹਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: poojaa arachaa sevaa ba(n)dan ihai tahal mohi karanaa ||
english: This is the labor which I perform: worship, flower-offerings, service and devotion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਗਰਭੈ ਪਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bigasai man hovai paragaasaa bahur na garabhai paranaa ||1||
english: My mind blossoms forth and is enlightened, and I am not cast into the womb again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪਰਸਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਇਹੈ ਧਿਆਨਾ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: saphal moorat parasau sa(n)tan kee ihai dhiaanaa dharanaa ||
english: I behold the fruitful vision of the Saint; this is the meditation I have taken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੨॥੧੬॥
transliteration: bhaio kripaal thaakur naanak kau pario saadh kee saranaa ||2||16||
english: The Lord Master has become Merciful to Nanak, and he has entered the Sanctuary of the Holy. ||2||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: apune har pahi binatee kaheeai ||
english: Offer your prayer to your Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਿਧਿ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chaar padaarath anad ma(n)gal nidh sookh sahaj sidh laheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall obtain the four blessings, and the treasures of bliss, pleasure, peace, poise and the spiritual powers of the Siddhas. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਚਲੁ ਗਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: maan tiaag har charanee laagau tis prabh a(n)chal gaheeai ||
english: Renounce your self-conceit, and grasp hold of the Guru's feet; hold tight to the hem of God's robe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਂਚ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਅਹੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aa(n)ch na laagai agan saagar te saran suaamee kee aheeai ||1||
english: The heat of the ocean of fire does not affect one who longs for the Lord and Master's Sanctuary. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਮਹਾ ਅਕ੍ਰਿਤਘਨ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kot paraadh mahaa akritaghan bahur bahur prabh saheeai ||
english: Again and again, God puts up with the millions of sins of the supremely ungrateful ones.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਨਹੀਐ ॥੨॥੧੭॥
transliteration: karunaa mai pooran paramesur naanak tis saranaheeai ||2||17||
english: The embodiment of mercy, the Perfect Transcendent Lord - Nanak longs for His Sanctuary. ||2||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan ridai paravesaa ||
english: Place the Guru's feet within your heart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਉਤਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rog sog sabh dookh binaase utare sagal kalesaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and all illness, sorrow and pain shall be dispelled; all suffering shall come to an end. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh naasahi kot majan isanaanaa ||
english: The sins of countless incarnations are erased, as if one has taken purifying baths at millions of sacred shrines.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਲਾਗੋ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan gaavat gun gobi(n)d laago sahaj dhiaanaa ||1||
english: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and centering one's mind in meditation on Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apunaa daas keeno ba(n)dhan tor niraare ||
english: Showing His Mercy, the Lord has made me His slave; breaking my bonds, He has saved me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੮॥ ਛਕੇ ੩ ॥
transliteration: jap jap naam jeevaa teree baanee naanak daas balihaare ||2||18|| chhake 3 ||
english: I live by chanting and meditating on the Naam, and the Bani of Your Word; slave Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||2||18|| Third Set of Six||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ॥
transliteration: maaee prabh ke charan nihaarau ||
english: O mother, I long to see the Feet of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਡਾਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karahu anugrahu suaamee mere man te kabahu na daarau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Be Merciful to me, O my Lord and Master, that I might never forsake them from my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਲਾਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo dhoor laaee mukh masatak kaam krodh bikh jaarau ||
english: Applying the dust of the feet of the Holy to my face and forehead, I burn away the poison of sexual desire and anger.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੀਚੁ ਆਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਉ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਧਾਰਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh te neech aatam kar maanau man mahi ihu sukh dhaarau ||1||
english: I judge myself to be the lowest of all; in this way, I instill peace within my mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਲਮਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਝਾਰਉ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavah thaakur abinaasee kalamal sagale jhaarau ||
english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable Lord and Master, and I shake off all my sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਉ ॥੨॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan naanak daan paavau ka(n)th laai ur dhaarau ||2||19||
english: I have found the gift of the treasure of the Naam, O Nanak; I hug it close, and enshrine it in my heart. ||2||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਪੇਖਉ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh jeeu pekhau daras tumaaraa ||
english: Dear God, I long to behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਾਰੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar dhiaan dhaar din rainee jee praan te piaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I cherish this beautiful meditation day and night; You are dearer to me than my soul, dearer than life itself. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਅਵਿਲੋਕੇ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saasatr bed puraan aviloke simrit tat beechaaraa ||
english: I have studied and contemplated the essence of the Shaastras, the Vedas and the Puraanas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਵਜਲ ਉਧਰਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: deenaa naath praanapat pooran bhavajal udharanahaaraa ||1||
english: Protector of the meek, Lord of the breath of life, O Perfect One, carry us across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aad jugaad bhagat jan sevak taa kee bikhai adhaaraa ||
english: Since the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the humble devotees have been Your servants; in the midst of the world of corruption, You are their Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਛੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੨੦॥
transliteration: tin jan kee dhoor baachhai nit naanak paramesar devanahaaraa ||2||20||
english: Nanak longs for the dust of the feet of such humble beings; the Transcendent Lord is the Giver of all. ||2||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: teraa jan raam rasaain maataa ||
english: Your humble servant, O Lord, is intoxicated with Your sublime essence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਉਪਜੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prem rasaa nidh jaa kau upajee chhod na katahoo jaataa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who obtains the treasure of the Nectar of Your Love, does not renounce it to go somewhere else. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: baithat har har sovat har har har ras bhojan khaataa ||
english: While sitting, he repeats the Lord's Name, Har, Har; while sleeping, he repeats the Lord's Name, Har, Har; he eats the Nectar of the Lord's Name as his food.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰੀ ਨਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: athasath teerath majan keeno saadhoo dhooree naataa ||1||
english: Bathing in the dust of the feet of the Holy is equal to taking cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਉਤੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam har jan kaa upajiaa jin keeno saut bidhaataa ||
english: How fruitful is the birth of the Lord's humble servant; the Creator is his Father.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮੂਹ ਲੈ ਉਧਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੨॥੨੧॥
transliteration: sagal samooh lai udhare naanak pooran braham pachhaataa ||2||21||
english: O Nanak, one who recognizes the Perfect Lord God, takes all with him, and saves everyone. ||2||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: maaee gur bin giaan na paaeeai ||
english: O mother, without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੇ ਮਿਲਤ ਨਹੀ ਗੋਸਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anik prakaar phirat bilalaate milat nahee gosaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They wander around, weeping and crying out in various ways, but the Lord of the World does not meet them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਤਨੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: moh rog sog tan baadhio bahu jonee bharamaaeeai ||
english: The body is tied up with emotional attachment, disease and sorrow, and so it is lured into countless reincarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟਿਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਇ ਰੂਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tikan na paavai bin satasa(n)gat kis aagai jaai rooaaeeai ||1||
english: He finds no place of rest without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; to whom should he go and cry? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੈ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: karai anugrahu suaamee meraa saadh charan chit laaeeai ||
english: When my Lord and Master shows His Mercy, we lovingly focus our consciousness on the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਕਟ ਘੋਰ ਕਟੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੨੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)kat ghor kate khin bheetar naanak har daras samaaeeai ||2||22||
english: The most horrible agonies are dispelled in an instant, O Nanak, and we merge in the Blessed Vision of the Lord. ||2||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: thaakur hoe aap daiaal ||
english: The Lord and Master Himself has become Merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਅਨੰਦ ਰੂਪ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਉਬਰੇ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaee kaliaan ana(n)d roop hoee hai ubare baal gupaal || rahaau ||
english: I have been emancipated, and I have become the embodiment of bliss; I am the Lord's child - He has saved me. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dui kar joR karee bena(n)tee paarabraham man dhiaaiaa ||
english: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer; within my mind, I meditate on the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥੁ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haath dei raakhe paramesur sagalaa durat mitaaiaa ||1||
english: Giving me His hand, the Transcendent Lord has eradicated all my sins. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: var naaree mil ma(n)gal gaaiaa thaakur kaa jaikaar ||
english: Husband and wife join together in rejoicing, celebrating the Victory of the Lord Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਜੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੨੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jan kau bal jaaeeai jo sabhanaa kare udhaar ||2||23||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the humble servant of the Lord, who emancipates everyone. ||2||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: apune satigur pahi binau kahiaa ||
english: I offer my prayer to my True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਰਾ ਗਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhae kripaal daiaal dukh bha(n)jan meraa sagal a(n)desaraa gaiaa || rahaau ||
english: The Destroyer of distress has become kind and merciful, and all my anxiety is over. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਲੋਭੀ ਹਮਰਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗੁਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ham paapee paakha(n)dee lobhee hamaraa gun avagun sabh sahiaa ||
english: I am a sinner, hypocritical and greedy, but still, He puts up with all of my merits and demerits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਮੁਏ ਦੁਸਟ ਜੋ ਖਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar masatak dhaar saaj nivaaje mue dusat jo khaiaa ||1||
english: Placing His hand on my forehead, He has exalted me. The wicked ones who wanted to destroy me have been killed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਸਧਾਰੀ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਹਜਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paraupakaaree sarab sadhaaree saphal darasan sahajaiaa ||
english: He is generous and benevolent, the beautifier of all, the embodiment of peace; the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is so fruitful!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਉਰ ਧਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੨੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak niragun kau daataa charan kamal ur dhariaa ||2||24||
english: Says Nanak, He is the Giver to the unworthy; I enshrine His Lotus Feet within my heart. ||2||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: anaath naath prabh hamaare ||
english: My God is the Master of the masterless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saran aaio raakhanahaare || rahaau ||
english: I have come to the Sanctuary of the Savior Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਪਾਖ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sarab paakh raakh muraare ||
english: Protect me on all sides, O Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਅੰਤੀ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aagai paachhai a(n)tee vaare ||1||
english: protect me in the future, in the past, and at the very last moment. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਤਬ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jab chitavau tab tuhaare ||
english: Whenever something comes to mind, it is You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: un samhaar meraa man sadhaare ||2||
english: Contemplating Your virtues, my mind is sanctified. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sun gaavau gur bachanaare ||
english: I hear and sing the Hymns of the Guru's Word.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਸਾਧ ਦਰਸਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bal bal jaau saadh darasaare ||3||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਏਕ ਅਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man mahi raakhau ek asaare ||
english: Within my mind, I have the Support of the One Lord alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak prabh mere karanaihaare ||4||25||
english: O Nanak, my God is the Creator of all. ||4||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਇਹੈ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh ihai manorath meraa ||
english: God, this is my heart's desire:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਚੇਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kripaa nidhaan daiaal mohi deejai kar sa(n)tan kaa cheraa || rahaau ||
english: O treasure of kindness, O Merciful Lord, please make me the slave of your Saints. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਤਹਕਾਲ ਲਾਗਉ ਜਨ ਚਰਨੀ ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: praatahakaal laagau jan charanee nis baasur daras paavau ||
english: In the early hours of the morning, I fall at the feet of Your humble servants; night and day, I obtain the Blessed Vision of their Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਕਰਉ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tan man arap karau jan sevaa rasanaa har gun gaavau ||1||
english: Dedicating my body and mind, I serve the humble servant of the Lord; with my tongue, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਤ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: saas saas simarau prabh apunaa sa(n)tasa(n)g nit raheeai ||
english: With each and every breath, I meditate in remembrance on my God; I live continually in the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੨॥੨੬॥
transliteration: ek adhaar naam dhan moraa anad naanak ihu laheeai ||2||26||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my only support and wealth; O Nanak, from this, I obtain bliss. ||2||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raag devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
english: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤਾ ਐਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: meetaa aise har jeeu paae ||
english: O friend, such is the Dear Lord whom I have obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chhod na jaaee sad hee sa(n)ge anadin gur mil gaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He does not leave me, and He always keeps me company. Meeting the Guru, night and day, I sing His Praises. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮਨੋਹਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੈਨਾ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: milio manohar sarab sukhainaa tiaag na katahoo jaae ||
english: I met the Fascinating Lord, who has blessed me with all comforts; He does not leave me to go anywhere else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਪੇਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik anik bhaat bahu pekhe pri rom na samasar laae ||1||
english: I have seen the mortals of many and various types, but they are not equal to even a hair of my Beloved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਸੋਭ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਅਨਹਤ ਰੁਣੁ ਝੁਣੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)dar bhaag sobh duaarai anahat run jhun laae ||
english: His palace is so beautiful! His gate is so wonderful! The celestial melody of the sound current resounds there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਥੀਤੇ ਸਦ ਥਾਏ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sadaa ra(n)g maane grih pri theete sad thaae ||2||1||27||
english: Says Nanak, I enjoy eternal bliss; I have obtained a permanent place in the home of my Beloved. ||2||1||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਨਾਮ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਆਛੈ ॥
transliteration: darasan naam kau man aachhai ||
english: My mind longs for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, and His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਥਾਨ ਰੇ ਆਹਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਛੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhram aaio hai sagal thaan re aahi pario sa(n)t paachhai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have wandered everywhere, and now I have come to follow the Saint. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਸੇਵੀ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਰਾਧੀ ਜੋ ਦਿਸਟੈ ਸੋ ਗਾਛੈ ॥
transliteration: kis hau sevee kis aaraadhee jo disatai so gaachhai ||
english: Whom should I serve? Whom should I worship in adoration? Whoever I see shall pass away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੀਐ ਚਰਣ ਰੇਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਛੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kee saranee pareeai charan ren man baachhai ||1||
english: I have sought the Sanctuary of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; my mind longs for the dust of their Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮਾਇ ਆਛੈ ॥
transliteration: jugat na jaanaa gun nahee koee mahaa dutar maai aachhai ||
english: I do not know the way, and I have no virtue. It is so difficult to escape from Maya!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਪਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਤਉ ਉਤਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਰਾਛੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੮॥
transliteration: aai paio naanak gur charanee tau utaree sagal duraachhai ||2||2||28||
english: Nanak has come and fallen at the Guru's feet; all of his evil inclinations have vanished. ||2||2||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mritaa pri bachan tuhaare ||
english: O Beloved, Your Words are Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਭਹੂ ਮਧਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: at su(n)dar manamohan piaare sabhahoo madh niraare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O supremely beautiful Enticer, O Beloved, You are among all, and yet distinct from all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਨ ਚਾਹਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਚਾਹਉ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raaj na chaahau mukat na chaahau man preet charan kamalaare ||
english: I do not seek power, and I do not seek liberation. My mind is in love with Your Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਿਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਦਰਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: braham mahes sidh mun i(n)draa mohi thaakur hee darasaare ||1||
english: Brahma, Shiva, the Siddhas, the silent sages and Indra - I seek only the Blessed Vision of my Lord and Master's Darshan. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਓ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਸੰਤ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: deen duaarai aaio thaakur saran pario sa(n)t haare ||
english: I have come, helpless, to Your Door, O Lord Master; I am exhausted - I seek the Sanctuary of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਬਿਗਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh mile manohar man seetal bigasaare ||2||3||29||
english: Says Nanak, I have met my Enticing Lord God; my mind is cooled and soothed - it blossoms forth in joy. ||2||3||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: har jap sevak paar utaario ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, His servant swims across to salvation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal bhae prabh apane bahuR janam nahee maario ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When God becomes merciful to the meek, then one does not have to suffer reincarnation, only to die again. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gam gun gaavah har ke ratan janam nahee haario ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and he does not lose the jewel of this human life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਨੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਲਹ ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh gun gaai bikhai ban tariaa kulah samooh udhaario ||1||
english: Singing the Glories of God, he crosses over the ocean of poison, and saves all his generations as well. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸਿਆ ਰਿਦ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਉਚਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal basiaa rid bheetar saas giraas uchaario ||
english: The Lotus Feet of the Lord abide within his heart, and with every breath and morsel of food, he chants the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੦॥
transliteration: naanak ot gahee jagadeesur punah punah balihaario ||2||4||30||
english: Nanak has grasped the Support of the Lord of the Universe; again and again, he is a sacrifice to Him. ||2||4||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 4 ||
english: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਫਿਰੇ ਬਨ ਭੇਖ ਮੋਹਨ ਰਹਤ ਨਿਰਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karat phire ban bhekh mohan rahat niraar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Some wander around the forests, wearing religious robes, but the Fascinating Lord remains distant from them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨ ਸੁਨਾਵਨ ਗੀਤ ਨੀਕੇ ਗਾਵਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਧਰਤੇ ਗਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kathan sunaavan geet neeke gaavan man mahi dharate gaar ||1||
english: They talk, preach, and sing their lovely songs, but within their minds, the filth of their sins remains. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਚਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: at su(n)dar bahu chatur siaane bidiaa rasanaa chaar ||2||
english: They may be very beautiful, extremely clever, wise and educated, and they may speak very sweetly. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮੇਰ ਤੇਰ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ ਏਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਖੰਡੇ ਧਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maan moh mer ter bibarajit ehu maarag kha(n)de dhaar ||3||
english: To forsake pride, emotional attachment, and the sense of 'mine and yours', is the path of the double-edged sword. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਅਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tin bhavajal tareeale prabh kirapaa sa(n)t sa(n)gaar ||4||1||31||
english: Says Nanak, they alone swim across the terrifying world-ocean, who, by God's Grace, join the Society of the Saints. ||4||1||31||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 5 ||
english: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਰੀ ਊਚਾ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
transliteration: mai pekhio ree oochaa mohan sabh te oochaa ||
english: I have seen the Lord to be on high; the Fascinating Lord is the highest of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਨ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਢੂਢਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਮ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aan na samasar kooo laagai dhoodh rahe ham moochaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: No one else is equal to Him - I have made the most extensive search on this. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਬਡੋ ਗਾਹਰੋ ਥਾਹ ਨਹੀ ਅਗਹੂਚਾ ॥
