transliteration: bahu bea(n)t at bado gaaharo thaah nahee agahoochaa ||
english: Utterly infinite, exceedingly great, deep and unfathomable - He is lofty, beyond reach.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੋਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਮੋਲਿ ਨ ਮੁਲੀਐ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨ ਰੂਚਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tol na tuleeai mol na muleeai kat paaeeai man roochaa ||1||
english: His weight cannot be weighed, His value cannot be estimated. How can the Enticer of the mind be obtained? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਤਪੰਥਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਹੀ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥
transliteration: khoj asa(n)khaa anik tapa(n)thaa bin gur nahee pahoochaa ||
english: Millions search for Him, on various paths, but without the Guru, none find Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਰਸ ਭੂੰਚਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak kirapaa karee thaakur mil saadhoo ras bhoo(n)chaa ||2||1||32||
english: Says Nanak, the Lord Master has become Merciful. Meeting the Holy Saint, I drink in the sublime essence. ||2||1||32||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੀ ਕੋਊ ॥
transliteration: mai bahu bidh pekhio doojaa naahee ree kooo ||
english: I have looked in so many ways, but there is no other like the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਦੀਪ ਸਭ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਲੋਊ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)d deep sabh bheetar raviaa poor rahio sabh looo ||1|| rahaau ||
english: On all the continents and islands, He is permeating and fully pervading; He is in all worlds. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੰਮਾ ਕਵਨ ਮਹਿੰਮਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੋਊ ॥
transliteration: agam aga(n)maa kavan mahi(n)maa man jeevai sun sooo ||
english: He is the most unfathomable of the unfathomable; who can chant His Praises? My mind lives by hearing news of Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਆਸਰਮ ਚਾਰਿ ਬਰੰਨਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਸੇਵਤੋਊ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chaar aasaram chaar bara(n)naa mukat bhae sevatooo ||1||
english: People in the four stages of life, and in the four social classes are liberated, by serving You, Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੁਤੀਅ ਗਏ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਊ ॥
transliteration: gur sabad driRaaiaa param pad paaiaa dutee gae sukh hooo ||
english: The Guru has implanted the Word of His Shabad within me; I have attained the supreme status. My sense of duality has been dispelled, and now, I am at peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਸਹਜੋਊ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bhav saagar tariaa har nidh paaee sahajooo ||2||2||33||
english: Says Nanak, I have easily crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, obtaining the treasure of the Lord's Name. ||2||2||33||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
transliteration: raag devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 6 ||
english: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੈ ਜਾਨ ॥
transliteration: ekai re har ekai jaan ||
english: Know that there is One and only One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ekai re guramukh jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Gurmukh, know that He is One. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਹਉ ਤੁਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਹੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ਰਵਿਆ ਰੇ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaahe bhramat hau tum bhramahu na bhaaee raviaa re raviaa srab thaan ||1||
english: Why are you wandering around? O Siblings of Destiny, don't wander around; He is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਕਾਸਟ ਮਝਾਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jiu baisa(n)tar kaasat majhaar bin sa(n)jam nahee kaaraj saar ||
english: As the fire in the forest, without control, cannot serve any purpose

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: bin gur na paavaigo har jee ko duaar ||
english: just so, without the Guru, one cannot attain the Gate of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੪॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)gat taj abhimaan kahu naanak paae hai param nidhaan ||2||1||34||
english: Joining the Society of the Saints, renounce your ego; says Nanak, in this way, the supreme treasure is obtained. ||2||1||34||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaanee na jaaee taa kee gaat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: His state cannot be known. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹ ਪੇਖਾਰਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮੇ ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kah pekhaarau hau kar chaturaaee bisaman bisame kahan kahaat ||1||
english: How can I behold Him through clever tricks? Those who tell this story are wonder-struck and amazed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਸਿਧ ਅਰੁ ਸਾਧਿਕ ॥
transliteration: gan ga(n)dharab sidh ar saadhik ||
english: The servants of God, the celestial singers, the Siddhas and the seekers,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ॥
transliteration: sur nar dev braham brahamaadik ||
english: the angelic and divine beings, Brahma and those like Brahma,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਉਚਰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: chatur bed ucharat din raat ||
english: and the four Vedas proclaim, day and night,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਗਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: agam agam thaakur aagaadh ||
english: that the Lord and Master is inaccessible, unapproachable and unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਭਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਾਤਿ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੫॥
transliteration: gun bea(n)t bea(n)t bhan naanak kahan na jaaee parai paraat ||2||2||35||
english: Endless, endless are His Glories, says Nanak; they cannot be described - they are beyond our reach. ||2||2||35||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਏ ਗਾਏ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: dhiaae gaae karanaihaar ||
english: I meditate, and sing of the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਓਹੀ ਰੇ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhau naahee sukh sahaj ana(n)daa anik ohee re ek samaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have become fearless, and I have found peace, poise and bliss, remembering the infinite Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ॥
transliteration: saphal moorat gur merai maathai ||
english: The Guru, of the most fruitful image, has placed His hand upon my forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
transliteration: jat kat pekhau tat tat saathai ||
english: Wherever I look, there, I find Him with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charan kamal mere praan adhaar ||1||
english: The Lotus Feet of the Lord are the Support of my very breath of life. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਅਥਾਹ ਬਡਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: samarath athaah badaa prabh meraa ||
english: My God is all-powerful, unfathomable and utterly vast.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar saahib neraa ||
english: The Lord and Master is close at hand - He dwells in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਸਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੬॥
transliteration: taakee saran aasar prabh naanak jaa kaa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||2||3||36||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary and the Support of God, who has no end or limitation. ||2||3||36||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਲਟੀ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਉਲਟੀ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ulatee re man ulatee re ||
english: Turn away, O my mind, turn away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਉਲਟੀ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saakat siu kar ulatee re ||
english: Turn away from the faithless cynic.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੈ ਕੀ ਰੇ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਰੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jhoothai kee re jhooth pareet chhutakee re man chhutakee re saakat sa(n)g na chhutakee re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: False is the love of the false one; break the ties, O my mind, and your ties shall be broken. Break your ties with the faithless cynic. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਾਜਰ ਭਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਜੋ ਪੈਸੈ ਕਾਲੂਖੀ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jiu kaajar bhar ma(n)dar raakhio jo paisai kaalookhee re ||
english: One who enters a house filled with soot is blackened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਿ ਗਇਓ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: doorahu hee te bhaag gaio hai jis gur mil chhutakee trikutee re ||1||
english: Run far away from such people! One who meets the Guru escapes from the bondage of the three dispositions. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜੁਟਸੀ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maagau daan kripaal kripaa nidh meraa mukh saakat sa(n)g na jutasee re ||
english: I beg this blessing of You, O Merciful Lord, ocean of mercy - please, don't bring me face to face with the faithless cyincs.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੂੰਡੁ ਸਾਧ ਪਗਾ ਹੇਠਿ ਰੁਲਸੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੭॥
transliteration: jan naanak daas daas ko kareeahu meraa moo(n)d saadh pagaa heth rulasee re ||2||4||37||
english: Make servant Nanak the slave of Your slave; let his head roll in the dust under the feet of the Holy. ||2||4||37||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
transliteration: raag devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 7 ||
english: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਮਰਥ ਪੰਥ ਬਿਠੁਲੇ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh din ke samarath pa(n)th bithule hau bal bal jaau ||
english: You are all-powerful, at all times; You show me the Way; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨ ਭਾਵਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੋਰੈ ਚਰਨ ਉਵਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gaavan bhaavan sa(n)tan torai charan uvaa kai paau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your Saints sing to You with love; I fall at their feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸਨ ਬਾਸਨ ਸਹਜ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਏਕ ਅਨੰਤ ਅਨੂਪੈ ਠਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaasan baasan sahaj kel karunaa mai ek ana(n)t anoopai thaau ||1||
english: O Praiseworthy Lord, Enjoyer of celestial peace, Embodiment of mercy, One Infinite Lord, Your place is so beautiful. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਨਾਥ ਅਨੇਕੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ridh sidh nidh kar tal jagajeevan srab naath anekai naau ||
english: Riches, supernatural spiritual powers and wealth are in the palm of Your hand. O Lord, Life of the World, Master of all, infinite is Your Name.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਜਸੁ ਜੀਵਾਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੮॥੬॥੪੪॥
transliteration: daiaa maiaa kirapaa naanak kau sun sun jas jeevaau ||2||1||38||6||44||
english: Show Kindness, Mercy and Compassion to Nanak; hearing Your Praises, I live. ||2||1||38||6||44||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: raag devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 9 ||
english: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਯਹ ਮਨੁ ਨੈਕ ਨ ਕਹਿਓ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: yah man naik na kahio karai ||
english: This mind does not follow my advice one tiny bit.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੀਖ ਸਿਖਾਇ ਰਹਿਓ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਤੇ ਨ ਟਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: seekh sikhaai rahio apanee see duramat te na tarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am so tired of giving it instructions - it will not refrain from its evil-mindedness. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਭਇਓ ਬਾਵਰੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਨਹਿ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: mad maaiaa kai bhaio baavaro har jas nahi ucharai ||
english: It has gone insane with the intoxication of Maya; it does not chant the Lord's Praise.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਜਗਤ ਕਉ ਡਹਕੈ ਅਪਨੋ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar parapa(n)ch jagat kau dahakai apano udar bharai ||1||
english: Practicing deception, it tries to cheat the world, and so it fills its belly. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਨ ਪੂਛ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਧੋ ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਕਾਨ ਧਰੈ ॥
transliteration: suaan poochh jiu hoi na soodho kahio na kaan dharai ||
english: Like a dog's tail, it cannot be straightened; it will not listen to what I tell it.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਤ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਜੁ ਸਰੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bhaj raam naam nit jaa te kaaj sarai ||2||1||
english: Says Nanak, vibrate forever the Name of the Lord, and all your affairs shall be adjusted. ||2||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 9 ||
english: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜੀਵਤ ਕੋ ਬਿਵਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh jeevat ko bivahaar ||
english: All things are mere diversions of life:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਅਰੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut ba(n)dhap ar phun grih kee naar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: mother, father, siblings, children, relatives and the wife of your home. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹੋਤ ਜਬ ਨਿਆਰੇ ਟੇਰਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tan te praan hot jab niaare terat pret pukaar ||
english: When the soul is separated from the body, then they will cry out, calling you a ghost.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਆਧ ਘਰੀ ਕੋਊ ਨਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਦੇਤ ਨਿਕਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aadh gharee kooo nahi raakhai ghar te det nikaar ||1||
english: No one will let you stay, for even half an hour; they drive you out of the house. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਗ ਰਚਨਾ ਯਹ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: mrig trisanaa jiu jag rachanaa yah dekhahu ridai bichaar ||
english: The created world is like an illusion, a mirage - see this, and reflect upon it in your mind.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਤ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bhaj raam naam nit jaa te hot udhaar ||2||2||
english: Says Nanak, vibrate forever the Name of the Lord, which shall deliver you. ||2||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 9 ||
english: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਝੂਠੀ ਦੇਖੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jagat mai jhoothee dekhee preet ||
english: In this world, I have seen love to be false.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਿਉ ਸਭ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਦਾਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: apane hee sukh siu sabh laage kiaa daaraa kiaa meet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whether they are spouses or friends, all are concerned only with their own happiness. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਉ ਮੇਰਉ ਸਭੈ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਚੀਤ ॥
transliteration: merau merau sabhai kahat hai hit siu baadhio cheet ||
english: All say, "Mine, mine", and attach their consciousness to you with love.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਨਹ ਕੋਊ ਇਹ ਅਚਰਜ ਹੈ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal sa(n)gee nah kooo ih acharaj hai reet ||1||
english: But at the very last moment, none shall go along with you. How strange are the ways of the world! ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਜਹੂ ਨਹ ਸਮਝਤ ਸਿਖ ਦੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: man moorakh ajahoo nah samajhat sikh dai haario neet ||
english: The foolish mind has not yet reformed itself, although I have grown weary of continually instructing it.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਜਉ ਗਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੀਤ ॥੨॥੩॥੬॥੩੮॥੪੭॥
transliteration: naanak bhaujal paar parai jau gaavai prabh ke geet ||2||3||6||38||47||
english: O Nanak, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, singing the Songs of God. ||2||3||6||38||47||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag bihaagaRaa chaupade mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Bihaagraa, Chau-Padhay, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਤਨ ਸੰਗਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: dootan sa(n)gareeaa ||
english: To associate with your arch enemies,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੁਇਅੰਗਨਿ ਬਸਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: bhuia(n)gan basareeaa ||
english: is to live with poisonous snakes;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik upareeaa ||1||
english: I have made the effort to shake them off. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tau mai har har kareeaa ||
english: Then, I repeated the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tau sukh sahajareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and I obtained celestial peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਨ ਮੋਹਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mithan mohareeaa ||
english: False is the love

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਕਉ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: an kau mereeaa ||
english: Of the many emotional attachments,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਘੂਮਨ ਘਿਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vich ghooman ghireeaa ||2||
english: which suck the mortal into the whirlpool of reincarnation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਬਟਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sagal batareeaa ||
english: All are travellers,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਖ ਇਕ ਤਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: birakh ik tareeaa ||
english: who have gathered under the world-tree,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬੰਧਹਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bahu ba(n)dhahi pareeaa ||3||
english: and are bound by their many bonds. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਧ ਸਫਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: thir saadh saphareeaa ||
english: Eternal is the Company of the Holy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jah keeratan hareeaa ||
english: where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਰੀਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saranareeaa ||4||1||
english: Nanak seeks this Sanctuary. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: raag bihaagaRaa mahalaa 9 ||
english: Raag Bihaagraa, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹਿ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: har kee gat nahi kooo jaanai ||
english: No one knows the state of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀ ਪਚਿ ਹਾਰੇ ਅਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਲੋਗ ਸਿਆਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jogee jatee tapee pach haare ar bahu log siaane ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Yogis, the celibates, the penitents, and all sorts of clever people have failed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਉ ਰੰਕ ਕਉ ਕਰਈ ਰਾਉ ਰੰਕ ਕਰਿ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: chhin mahi raau ra(n)k kau karaee raau ra(n)k kar daare ||
english: In an instant, He changes the beggar into a king, and the king into a beggar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੀਤੇ ਭਰੇ ਭਰੇ ਸਖਨਾਵੈ ਯਹ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਿਵਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: reete bhare bhare sakhanaavai yah taa ko bivahaare ||1||
english: He fills what is empty, and empties what is full - such are His ways. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਪਸਾਰੀ ਆਪਹਿ ਦੇਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: apanee maaiaa aap pasaaree aapahi dekhanahaaraa ||
english: He Himself spread out the expanse of His Maya, and He Himself beholds it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਧਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanaa roop dhare bahu ra(n)gee sabh te rahai niaaraa ||2||
english: He assumes so many forms, and plays so many games, and yet, He remains detached from it all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਤ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਿਹ ਸਭ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: aganat apaar alakh nira(n)jan jih sabh jag bharamaaio ||
english: Incalculable, infinite, incomprehensible and immaculate is He, who has misled the entire world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਰਮ ਤਜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਰਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੩॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: sagal bharam taj naanak praanee charan taahi chit laaio ||3||1||2||
english: Cast off all your doubts; prays Nanak, O mortal, focus your consciousness on His Feet. ||3||1||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag bihaagaRaa chha(n)t mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Bihaagraa, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har har naam dhiaaeeai meree ji(n)duReee guramukh naam amole raam ||
english: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul; as Gurmukh, meditate on the invaluable Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਬੀਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਝਕੋਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har ras beedhaa har man piaaraa man har ras naam jhakole raam ||
english: My mind is pierced through by the sublime essence of the Lord's Name. The Lord is dear to my mind. With the sublime essence of the Lord's Name, my mind is washed clean.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਈਐ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਡੋਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramat man thaharaaeeai meree ji(n)duReee anat na kaahoo dole raam ||
english: Under Guru's Instructions, hold your mind steady; O my soul, do not let it wander anywhere.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੋਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man chi(n)diaRaa phal paaiaa har prabh gun naanak baanee bole raam ||1||
english: One who utters the Bani of the Praises of the Lord God, O Nanak, obtains the fruits of his heart's desires. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੁਠੜਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੈਣ ਅਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramat man a(n)mrit vuthaRaa meree ji(n)duReee mukh a(n)mrit bain alaae raam ||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, the Ambrosial Name abides within the mind, O my soul; with your mouth, utter the words of ambrosia.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee bhagat janaa kee meree ji(n)duReee man suneeai har liv laae raam ||
english: The Words of the devotees are Ambrosial Nectar, O my soul; hearing them in the mind, embrace loving affection for the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: chiree vichhu(n)naa har prabh paaiaa gal miliaa sahaj subhaae raam ||
english: Separated for so very long, I have found the Lord God; He holds me close in His loving embrace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਅਨਹਤ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak man anad bhaiaa hai meree ji(n)duReee anahat sabad vajaae raam ||2||
english: Servant Nanak's mind is filled with bliss, O my soul; the unstruck sound-current of the Shabad vibrates within. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਮੇਰੀਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sakhee sahelee mereeaa meree ji(n)duReee koee har prabh aan milaavai raam ||
english: If only my friends and companions would come and unite me with my Lord God, O my soul.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: hau man devau tis aapanaa meree ji(n)duReee har prabh kee har kathaa sunaavai raam ||
english: I offer my mind to the one who recites the sermon of my Lord God, O my soul.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sadaa araadh har meree ji(n)duReee man chi(n)diaRaa phal paavai raam ||
english: As Gurmukh, ever worship the Lord in adoration, O my soul, and you shall obtain the fruits of your heart's desires.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak bhaj har saranaagatee meree ji(n)duReee vadabhaagee naam dhiaavai raam ||3||
english: O Nanak, hurry to the Lord's Sanctuary; O my soul, those who meditate on the Lord's Name are very fortunate. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aai mil meree ji(n)duReee guramat naam paragaase raam ||
english: By His Mercy, God comes to meet us, O my soul; through the Guru's Teachings, He reveals His Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਝੁ ਉਡੀਣੀਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਮਲ ਉਦਾਸੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: hau har baajh udeeneeaa meree ji(n)duReee jiu jal bin kamal udaase raam ||
english: Without the Lord, I am so sad, O my soul - as sad as the lotus without water.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਸੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai melaaiaa meree ji(n)duReee har sajan har prabh paase raam ||
english: The Perfect Guru has united me, O my soul, with the Lord, my best friend, the Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਦਸਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਬਿਗਾਸੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: dhan dhan guroo har dasiaa meree ji(n)duReee jan naanak naam bigaase raam ||4||1||
english: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, who has shown me the Lord, O my soul; servant Nanak blossoms forth in the Name of the Lord. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag bihaagaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Raag Bihaagraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit har har naam hai meree ji(n)duReee a(n)mrit guramat paae raam ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar, O my soul; through the Guru's Teachings, this Nectar is obtained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: haumai maaiaa bikh hai meree ji(n)duReee har a(n)mrit bikh lahi jaae raam ||
english: Pride in Maya is poison, O my soul; through the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name, this poison is eradicated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸੁਕਾ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: man sukaa hariaa hoiaa meree ji(n)duReee har har naam dhiaae raam ||
english: The dry mind is rejuvenated, O my soul, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har bhaag vade likh paaiaa meree ji(n)duReee jan naanak naam samaae raam ||1||
english: The Lord has given me the pre-ordained blessing of high destiny, O my soul; servant Nanak merges in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕ ਲਗਿ ਦੁਧ ਖੀਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har setee man bedhiaa meree ji(n)duReee jiu baalak lag dudh kheere raam ||
english: My mind is attached to the Lord, O my soul, like the infant, sucking his mother's milk.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਟੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har bin saa(n)t na paaeeai meree ji(n)duReee jiu chaatrik jal bin tere raam ||
english: Without the Lord, I find no peace, O my soul; I am like the song-bird, crying out without the rain drops.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਗੁਣ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: satigur saranee jaai pau meree ji(n)duReee gun dase har prabh kere raam ||
english: Go, and seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru, O my soul; He shall tell you of the Glorious Virtues of the Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਸਬਦ ਘਣੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak har melaaiaa meree ji(n)duReee ghar vaaje sabad ghanere raam ||2||
english: Servant Nanak has merged into the Lord, O my soul; the many melodies of the Shabad resound within his heart. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਬਾਧੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: manamukh haumai vichhuRe meree ji(n)duReee bikh baadhe haumai jaale raam ||
english: Through egotism, the self-willed manmukhs are separated, O my soul; bound to poison, they are burnt by egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪੰਖੀ ਕਪੋਤਿ ਆਪੁ ਬਨੑਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਤਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਭਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jiu pa(n)khee kapot aap banhaaiaa meree ji(n)duReee tiu manamukh sabh vas kaale raam ||
english: Like the pigeon, which itself falls into the trap, O my soul, all the self-willed manmukhs fall under the influence of death.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਬਿਤਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jo mohi maaiaa chit laaide meree ji(n)duReee se manamukh mooR bitaale raam ||
english: Those self-willed manmukhs who focus their consciousness on Maya, O my soul, are foolish, evil demons.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan traahi traahi saranaagatee meree ji(n)duReee gur naanak har rakhavaale raam ||3||
english: The Lord's humble servants beseech and implore Him, and enter His Sanctuary, O my soul; Guru Nanak becomes their Divine Protector. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਬਰੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har jan har liv ubare meree ji(n)duReee dhur bhaag vade har paaiaa raam ||
english: The Lord's humble servants are saved, through the Love of the Lord, O my soul; by their pre-ordained good destiny, they obtain the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੋਤੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਗੁਰ ਖੇਵਟ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har har naam pot hai meree ji(n)duReee gur khevat sabad taraaiaa raam ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the ship, O my soul, and the Guru is the helmsman. Through the Word of the Shabad, He ferries us across.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har har purakh daiaal hai meree ji(n)duReee gur satigur meeth lagaaiaa raam ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is all-powerful and very kind, O my soul; through the Guru, the True Guru, He seems so sweet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa sun benatee har har jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa raam ||4||2||
english: Shower Your Mercy upon me, and hear my prayer, O Lord, Har, Har; please, let servant Nanak meditate on Your Name. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bihaagaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bihaagraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jag sukrit keerat naam hai meree ji(n)duReee har keerat har man dhaare raam ||
english: In this world, the best occupation is to sing the Praises of the Naam, O my soul. Singing the Praises of the Lord, the Lord is enshrined in the mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har har naam pavit hai meree ji(n)duReee jap har har naam udhaare raam ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is immaculate and pure, O my soul. Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, one is saved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਦੁਖ ਕਟਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sabh kilavikh paap dukh katiaa meree ji(n)duReee mal guramukh naam utaare raam ||
english: All sins and errors are erased, O my soul; with the Naam, the Gurmukh washes off this filth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vad pu(n)nee har dhiaaiaa jan naanak ham moorakh mugadh nisataare raam ||1||
english: By great good fortune, servant Nanak meditates on the Lord; even fools and idiots like me have been saved. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਤਿਨਾ ਪੰਚੇ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jo har naam dhiaaide meree ji(n)duReee tinaa pa(n)che vasagat aae raam ||
english: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name, O my soul, overpower the five passions.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar nav nidh naam hai meree ji(n)duReee gur satigur alakh lakhaae raam ||
english: The nine treasures of the Naam are within, O my soul; the Great Guru has made me see the unseen Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur aasaa manasaa pooreeaa meree ji(n)duReee har miliaa bhukh sabh jaae raam ||
english: The Guru has fulfilled my hopes and desires, O my soul; meeting the Lord, all my hunger is satisfied.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhur masatak har prabh likhiaa meree ji(n)duReee jan naanak har gun gaae raam ||2||
english: O servant Nanak, he alone sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O my soul, upon whose forehead God has inscribed such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਬਲਵੰਚੀਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਪਰਦ੍ਰੋਹੀ ਠਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ham paapee balava(n)cheeaa meree ji(n)duReee paradrohee thag maaiaa raam ||
english: I am a deceitful sinner, O my soul, a cheat, and a robber of others' wealth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee gur paaiaa meree ji(n)duReee gur poorai gat mit paaiaa raam ||
english: But, by great good fortune, I have found the Guru, O my soul; through the Perfect Guru, I have found the way to salvation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਦਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur a(n)mrit har mukh choiaa meree ji(n)duReee phir maradaa bahuR jeevaaiaa raam ||
english: The Guru has poured the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name into my mouth, O my soul, and now, my dead soul has come to life again.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak satigur jo mile meree ji(n)duReee tin ke sabh dukh gavaaiaa raam ||3||
english: O servant Nanak: those who meet the True Guru, O my soul, have all of their pains taken away. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪਿਐ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: at ootam har naam hai meree ji(n)duReee jit japiai paap gavaate raam ||
english: The Name of the Lord is sublime, O my soul; chanting it, one's sins are washed away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਜਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: patit pavitr gur har keee meree ji(n)duReee chahu ku(n)dee chahu jug jaate raam ||
english: The Guru, the Lord, has purified even the sinners, O my soul; now, they are famous and respected in the four directions and throughout the four ages.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਭ ਉਤਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: haumai mail sabh utaree meree ji(n)duReee har a(n)mrit har sar naate raam ||
english: The filth of egotism is totally wiped away, O my soul, by bathing in the Ambrosial Pool of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਉਧਰੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: aparaadhee paapee udhare meree ji(n)duReee jan naanak khin har raate raam ||4||3||
english: Even sinners are carried across, O my soul, if they are imbued with the Lord's Name, even for an instant, O servant Nanak. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bihaagaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bihaagraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree tinh kau meree ji(n)duReee jinh har har naam adhaaro raam ||
english: I am a sacrifice, O my soul, to those who take the Support of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur naam driRaaiaa meree ji(n)duReee bikh bhaujal taaranahaaro raam ||
english: The Guru, the True Guru, implanted the Name within me, O my soul, and He has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean of poison.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jin ik man har dhiaaiaa meree ji(n)duReee tin sa(n)t janaa jaikaaro raam ||
english: Those who have meditated one-pointedly on the Lord, O my soul - I proclaim the Victory of those saintly beings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak har jap sukh paaiaa meree ji(n)duReee sabh dookh nivaaranahaaro raam ||1||
english: Nanak has found peace, meditating on the Lord, O my soul; the Lord is the Destroyer of all pain. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saa rasanaa dhan dha(n)n hai meree ji(n)duReee gun gaavai har prabh kere raam ||
english: Blessed, blessed is that tongue, O my soul, which sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਭਲੇ ਸੋਭਨੀਕ ਹਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: te sravan bhale sobhaneek hahi meree ji(n)duReee har keeratan sunahi har tere raam ||
english: Sublime and splendid are those ears, O my soul, which listen to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੀਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜੋ ਜਾਇ ਲਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: so sees bhalaa pavitr paavan hai meree ji(n)duReee jo jaai lagai gur paire raam ||
english: Sublime, pure and pious is that head, O my soul, which falls at the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur vitahu naanak vaariaa meree ji(n)duReee jin har har naam chitere raam ||2||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice to that Guru, O my soul; the Guru has placed the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in my mind. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਭਲੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: te netr bhale paravaan hahi meree ji(n)duReee jo saadhoo satigur dekhahi raam ||
english: Blessed and approved are those eyes, O my soul, which gaze upon the Holy True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਹਸਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਹਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੇਖਹਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: te hasat puneet pavitr hahi meree ji(n)duReee jo har jas har har lekhahi raam ||
english: Sacred and sanctified are those hands, O my soul, which write the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪਗ ਨਿਤ ਪੂਜੀਅਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜੋ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਧਰਮ ਚਲੇਸਹਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tis jan ke pag nit poojeeahi meree ji(n)duReee jo maarag dharam chalesahi raam ||
english: I worship continually the feet of that humble being, O my soul, who walks on the Path of Dharma - the path of righteousness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨੇਸਹਿ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak tin vitahu vaariaa meree ji(n)duReee har sun har naam manesahi raam ||3||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice to those, O my soul, who hear of the Lord, and believe in the Lord's Name. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤਿ ਪਾਤਾਲੁ ਆਕਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਸਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dharat paataal aakaas hai meree ji(n)duReee sabh har har naam dhiaavai raam ||
english: The earth, the nether regions of the underworld, and the Akaashic ethers, O my soul, all meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: paun paanee baisa(n)taro meree ji(n)duReee nit har har har jas gaavai raam ||
english: Wind, water and fire, O my soul, continually sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: van trin sabh aakaar hai meree ji(n)duReee mukh har har naam dhiaavai raam ||
english: The woods, the meadows and the whole world, O my soul, chant with their mouths the Lord's Name, and meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਪੈਨੑਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak te har dar painhaaiaa meree ji(n)duReee jo guramukh bhagat man laavai raam ||4||4||
english: O Nanak, one who, as Gurmukh, focuses his consciousness on the Lord's devotional worship - O my soul, he is robed in honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bihaagaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bihaagraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਤੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਇਆਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jin har har naam na chetio meree ji(n)duReee te manamukh mooR iaane raam ||
english: Those who do not remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul - those self-willed manmukhs are foolish and ignorant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਸੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jo mohi maaiaa chit laaide meree ji(n)duReee se a(n)t gae pachhutaane raam ||
english: Those who attach their consciousness to emotional attachment and Maya, O my soul, depart regretfully in the end.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹਨੑਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜੋ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਪਿ ਲੁਭਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har daragah dhoee naa lahanhi meree ji(n)duReee jo manamukh paap lubhaane raam ||
english: They find no place of rest in the Court of the Lord, O my soul; those self-willed manmukhs are deluded by sin.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak gur mil ubare meree ji(n)duReee har jap har naam samaane raam ||1||
english: O servant Nanak, those who meet the Guru are saved, O my soul; chanting the Name of the Lord, they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sabh jaai milahu satiguroo kau meree ji(n)duReee jo har har naam driRaavai raam ||
english: Go, everyone, and meet the True Guru; O my soul, He implants the Name of the Lord, Har, har, within the heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਦਿਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਮਤੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਵੈ ਕਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har japadiaa khin dhil na keejaee meree ji(n)duReee mat k jaapai saahu aavai k na aavai raam ||
english: Do not hesitate for an instant - meditate on the Lord, O my soul; who knows whether he shall draw another breath?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਸੋ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਸਾ ਘੜੀ ਸੋ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saa velaa so moorat saa ghaRee so muhat saphal hai meree ji(n)duReee jit har meraa chit aavai raam ||
english: That time, that moment, that instant, that second is so fruitful, O my soul, when my Lord comes into my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa meree ji(n)duReee jamaka(n)kar neR na aavai raam ||2||
english: Servant Nanak has meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my soul, and now, the Messenger of Death does not draw near him. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਸੋ ਡਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਤੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har vekhai sunai nit sabh kichh meree ji(n)duReee so darai jin paap kamate raam ||
english: The Lord continually watches, and hears everything, O my soul; he alone is afraid, who commits sins.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਡਰ ਸੁਟਿ ਘਤੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jis a(n)tar hiradaa sudh hai meree ji(n)duReee tin jan sabh dar sut ghate raam ||
english: One whose heart is pure within, O my soul, casts off all his fears.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤੀਜਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਸਭਿ ਝਖ ਮਾਰਨੁ ਦੁਸਟ ਕੁਪਤੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har nirabhau naam pateejiaa meree ji(n)duReee sabh jhakh maaran dusat kupate raam ||
english: One who has faith in the Fearless Name of the Lord, O my soul - all his enemies and attackers speak against him in vain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਆਣਿ ਸਭਿ ਘਤੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur pooraa naanak seviaa meree ji(n)duReee jin pairee aan sabh ghate raam ||3||
english: Nanak has served the Perfect Guru, O my soul, who causes all to fall at His feet. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਡਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: so aisaa har nit seveeai meree ji(n)duReee jo sabh doo saahib vadaa raam ||
english: Serve such a Lord continuously, O my soul, who is the Great Lord and Master of all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਤਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਚਡਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jinhee ik man ik araadhiaa meree ji(n)duReee tinaa naahee kisai dee kichh chadaa raam ||
english: Those who single-mindedly worship Him in adoration, O my soul, are not subservient to anyone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਝਖ ਮਾਰਨੁ ਸਭਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਘੰਡਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur seviai har mahal paaiaa meree ji(n)duReee jhakh maaran sabh ni(n)dak gha(n)daa raam ||
english: Serving the Guru, I have obtained the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, O my soul; all the slanderers and trouble-makers bark in vain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਛਡਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa meree ji(n)duReee dhur masatak har likh chhadaa raam ||4||5||
english: Servant Nanak has meditated on the Name, O my soul; such is the pre-ordained destiny which the Lord written on his forehead. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bihaagaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bihaagraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਜੋ ਜੀਇ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sabh jee tere too(n) varatadaa mere har prabh too(n) jaanahi jo jeei kamaaeeai raam ||
english: All beings are Yours - You permeate them all. O my Lord God, You know what they do in their hearts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਸਭ ਵੇਖੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਕਰਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)tar baahar naal hai meree ji(n)duReee sabh vekhai man mukaraaeeai raam ||
english: The Lord is with them, inwardly and outwardly, O my soul; He sees everything, but the mortal denies the Lord in his mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਸਭ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਘਾਲ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: manamukhaa no har door hai meree ji(n)duReee sabh birathee ghaal gavaaeeai raam ||
english: The Lord is far away from the self-willed manmukhs, O my soul; all their efforts are in vain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak guramukh dhiaaiaa meree ji(n)duReee har haajar nadaree aaeeai raam ||1||
english: Servant Nanak, as Gurmukh, meditates on the Lord, O my soul; he beholds the Lord ever-present. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: se bhagat se sevak meree ji(n)duReee jo prabh mere man bhaane raam ||
english: They are devotees, and they are servants, O my soul, who are pleasing to the Mind of my God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: se har daragah painaaiaa meree ji(n)duReee ahinis saach samaane raam ||
english: They are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord, O my soul; night and day, they remain absorbed in the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tin kai sa(n)g mal utarai meree ji(n)duReee ra(n)g raate nadar neesaane raam ||
english: In their company, the filth of one's sins is washed away, O my soul; imbued with the Lord's Love, one comes to bear the Mark of His Grace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਘਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kee prabh benatee meree ji(n)duReee mil saadhoo sa(n)g aghaane raam ||2||
english: Nanak offers his prayer to God, O my soul; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he is satisfied. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੋ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: he rasanaa jap gobi(n)do meree ji(n)duReee jap har har trisanaa jaae raam ||
english: O tongue, chant the Name of God; O my soul, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, your desires shall be extinguished.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jis daiaa kare meraa paarabraham meree ji(n)duReee tis man naam vasaae raam ||
english: He, unto whom my Supreme Lord God shows Mercy, O my soul, enshrines the Name in his mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jis bhete pooraa satiguroo meree ji(n)duReee so har dhan nidh paae raam ||
english: One who meets the Perfect True Guru, O my soul, obtains the treasure of the Lord's wealth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee sa(n)gat milai meree ji(n)duReee naanak har gun gaae raam ||3||
english: By great good fortune, one joins the Company of the Holy, O my soul. O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa meree ji(n)duReee paarabraham prabh daataa raam ||
english: In the places and interspaces, O my soul, the Supreme Lord God, the Great Giver, is pervading.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: taa kaa a(n)t na paaeeai meree ji(n)duReee pooran purakh bidhaataa raam ||
english: His limits cannot be found, O my soul; He is the Perfect Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sarab jeeaa pratipaaladaa meree ji(n)duReee jiu baalak pit maataa raam ||
english: He cherishes all beings, O my soul, as the mother and father cherish their child.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sahas siaanap nah milai meree ji(n)duReee jan naanak guramukh jaataa raam ||4||6|| chhakaa 1 ||
english: By thousands of clever tricks, He cannot be obtained, O my soul; servant Nanak, as Gurmukh, has come to know the Lord. ||4||6|| First Set of Six||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bihaagaRaa mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ghar 1 ||
english: Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਏਕੁ ਅਚੰਭਉ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੀਉ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har kaa ek acha(n)bhau dekhiaa mere laal jeeu jo kare s dharam niaae raam ||
english: I have seen one miracle of the Lord, O my Dear Beloved - whatever He does is righteous and just.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੀਉ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਸਬਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g akhaaRaa paaion mere laal jeeu aavan jaan sabaae raam ||
english: The Lord has fashioned this beautiful arena, O my Dear Beloved, where all come and go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਤ ਜਾਣਾ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੇਦਨਿ ਸਿਰਜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aavan ta jaanaa tinahi keeaa jin medan sirajeeaa ||
english: The One who fashioned the world causes them to come and go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਦਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa mel satigur mahal bulaae ik bharam bhoole phiradiaa ||
english: Some meet the True Guru - the Lord invites them into the Mansion of His Presence; others wander around, deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t teraa too(n)hai jaanahi too(n) sabh mahi rahiaa samaae ||
english: You alone know Your limits; You are contained in all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਆਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sach kahai naanak sunahu sa(n)tahu har varatai dharam niaae ||1||
english: Nanak speaks the Truth: listen, Saints - the Lord dispenses even-handed justice. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aavahu milahu saheleeho mere laal jeeu har har naam araadhe raam ||
english: Come and join me, O my beautiful dear beloveds; let's worship the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੀਉ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਾਧੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kar sevahu pooraa satiguroo mere laal jeeu jam kaa maarag saadhe raam ||
english: Let's serve the Perfect True Guru, O my dear beloveds, and clear away the Path of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਸਾਧਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: maarag bikhaRaa saadh guramukh har daragah sobhaa paaeeai ||
english: Having cleared the treacherous path, as Gurmukhs, we shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jin kau bidhaatai dhurahu likhiaa tinhaa rain din liv laaeeai ||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, lovingly focus their consciousness on the Lord, night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਛੁਟਾ ਜਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa mohu chhutaa jaa sa(n)g miliaa saadhe ||
english: Self-conceit, egotism and emotional attachment are eradicated when one joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan kahai naanak mukat hoaa har har naam araadhe ||2||
english: Says servant Nanak, one who contemplates the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is liberated. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੀਉ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਜੇਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kar joRihu sa(n)t ikatr hoi mere laal jeeu abinaasee purakh poojehaa raam ||
english: Let's join hands, O Saints; let's come together, O my dear beloveds, and worship the imperishable, Almighty Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਖੋਜੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੀਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪੇਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bahu bidh poojaa khojeeaa mere laal jeeu ihu man tan sabh arapehaa raam ||
english: I sought Him through uncounted forms of adoration, O my dear beloveds; now, I dedicate my entire mind and body to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੇਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: man tan dhan sabh prabhoo keraa kiaa ko pooj chaRaavae ||
english: The mind, body and all wealth belong to God; so what can anyone offer to Him in worship?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: jis hoi kripaal daiaal suaamee so prabh a(n)k samaavae ||
english: He alone merges in the lap of God, unto whom the Merciful Lord Master becomes compassionate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਗੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਇ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaag masatak hoi jis kai tis gur naal sanehaa ||
english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny written on his forehead, comes to bear love for the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੂਜੇਹਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan kahai naanak mil saadhasa(n)gat har har naam poojehaa ||3||
english: Says servant Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, let's worship the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਖੋਜਤ ਹਮ ਫਿਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dah dis khojat ham phire mere laal jeeu har paaiaRaa ghar aae raam ||
english: I wandered around, searching in the ten directions, O my dear beloveds, but I came to find the Lord in the home of my own being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har ma(n)dar har jeeu saajiaa mere laal jeeu har tis mahi rahiaa samaae raam ||
english: The Dear Lord has fashioned the body as the temple of the Lord, O my dear beloveds; the Lord continues to dwell there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sarabe samaanaa aap suaamee guramukh paragat hoiaa ||
english: The Lord and Master Himself is pervading everywhere; through the Guru, He is revealed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅਧੇਰਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਾਠਾ ਅਮਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mitiaa adheraa dookh naathaa amiu har ras choiaa ||
english: Darkness is dispelled, and pains are removed, when the sublime essence of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar trickles down.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਭ ਠਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jahaa dekhaa tahaa suaamee paarabraham sabh thaae ||
english: Wherever I look, the Lord and Master is there. The Supreme Lord God is everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jan kahai naanak satigur milaaiaa har paaiaRaa ghar aae ||4||1||
english: Says servant Nanak, meeting the True Guru, I have found the Lord, within the home of my own being. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag bihaagaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨ ਮੋਹਨਾ ਘਟ ਸੋਹਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: at preetam man mohanaa ghat sohanaa praan adhaaraa raam ||
english: He is dear to me; He fascinates my mind; He is the ornament of my heart, the support of the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੋਭਾ ਲਾਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੀ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar sobhaa laal gopaal daiaal kee apar apaaraa raam ||
english: The Glory of the Beloved, Merciful Lord of the Universe is beautiful; He is infinite and without limit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਲਾਲਨ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gopaal daiaal gobi(n)d laalan milahu ka(n)t nimaaneeaa ||
english: O Compassionate Sustainer of the World, Beloved Lord of the Universe, please, join with Your humble soul-bride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਤਰਸਨ ਦਰਸ ਪਰਸਨ ਨਹ ਨੀਦ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: nain tarasan daras parasan nah need rain vihaaneeaa ||
english: My eyes long for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; the night passes, but I cannot sleep.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਨਾਮ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਸੀਗਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: giaan a(n)jan naam bi(n)jan bhae sagal seegaaraa ||
english: I have applied the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom to my eyes; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my food. These are all my decorations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੰਤ ਜੰਪੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai sa(n)t ja(n)pai mel ka(n)t hamaaraa ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, let's meditate on the Saint, that he may unite us with our Husband Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਉਲਾਹਨੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: laakh ulaahane mohi har jab lag nah milai raam ||
english: I endure thousands of reprimands, and still, my Lord has not met with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਉ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਨਹ ਚਲੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: milan kau karau upaav kichh hamaaraa nah chalai raam ||
english: I make the effort to meet with my Lord, but none of my efforts work.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਬਿਤ ਅਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧੀ ਨ ਧੀਜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: chal chit bit anit pri bin kavan bidhee na dheejeeai ||
english: Unsteady is my consciousness, and unstable is my wealth; without my Lord, I cannot be consoled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: khaan paan seegaar birathe har ka(n)t bin kiu jeejeeai ||
english: Food, drink and decorations are useless; without my Husband Lord, how can I survive?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਰੈਨਿ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੈ ॥
transliteration: aasaa piaasee rain dineear rahi na sakeeai ik tilai ||
english: I yearn for Him, and desire Him night and day. I cannot live without Him, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੰਤ ਦਾਸੀ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai sa(n)t daasee tau prasaad meraa pir milai ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, O Saint, I am Your slave; by Your Grace, I meet my Husband Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sej ek priu sa(n)g daras na paaeeai raam ||
english: I share a bed with my Beloved, but I do not behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਤ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: avagan mohi anek kat mahal bulaaeeai raam ||
english: I have endless demerits - how can my Lord call me to the Mansion of His Presence?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਅਨਾਥਿ ਬਿਨਵੈ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧੇ ॥
transliteration: niragun nimaanee anaath binavai milahu prabh kirapaa nidhe ||
english: The worthless, dishonored and orphaned soul-bride prays, "Meet with me, O God, treasure of mercy."

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਖੋਈਐ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਲਕ ਪੇਖਤ ਨਵ ਨਿਧੇ ॥
transliteration: bhram bheet khoeeai sahaj soeeai prabh palak pekhat nav nidhe ||
english: The wall of doubt has been shattered, and now I sleep in peace, beholding God, the Lord of the nine treasures, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਆਵੈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: grihi laal aavai mahal paavai mil sa(n)g ma(n)gal gaaeeai ||
english: If only I could come into the Mansion of my Beloved Lord's Presence! Joining with Him, I sing the songs of joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai sa(n)t saranee mohi daras dikhaaeeai ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of the Saints; please, reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kai parasaad har har paaiaa raam ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, I have obtained the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ichh pu(n)nee man saa(n)t tapat bujhaaiaa raam ||
english: My desires are fulfilled, and my mind is at peace; the fire within has been quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲਾ ਸੁ ਦਿਨਸ ਰੈਣੇ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸੁ ਘਨਾ ॥
transliteration: saphalaa s dinas raine suhaavee anad ma(n)gal ras ghanaa ||
english: Fruitful is that day, and beauteous is that night, and countless are the joys, celebrations and pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਲਾਲਨ ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਭਨਾ ॥
transliteration: pragate gupaal gobi(n)d laalan kavan rasanaa gun bhanaa ||
english: The Lord of the Universe, the Beloved Sustainer of the World, has been revealed. With what tongue can I speak of His Glory?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਖੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhram lobh moh bikaar thaake mil sakhee ma(n)gal gaaiaa ||
english: Doubt, greed, emotional attachment and corruption are taken away; joining with my companions, I sing the songs of joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੰਤ ਜੰਪੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai sa(n)t ja(n)pai jin har har sa(n)jog milaaiaa ||4||2||
english: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Saint, who has led me to merge with the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bihaagaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa gur paarabraham poore anadin naam vakhaanaa raam ||
english: Shower Your Mercy upon me, O Guru, O Perfect Supreme Lord God, that I might chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਉਚਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee ucharaa har jas mithaa laagai teraa bhaanaa raam ||
english: I speak the Ambrosial Words of the Guru's Bani, praising the Lord. Your Will is sweet to me, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kar daiaa maiaa gopaal gobi(n)d koi naahee tujh binaa ||
english: Show kindness and compassion, O Sustainer of the Word, Lord of the Universe; without You, I have no other.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਅਗਥ ਅਪਾਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਜੀਉ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: samarath agath apaar pooran jeeu tan dhan tumh manaa ||
english: Almighty, sublime, infinite, perfect Lord - my soul, body, wealth and mind are Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਨਾਥ ਚੰਚਲ ਬਲਹੀਨ ਨੀਚ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: moorakh mugadh anaath cha(n)chal balaheen neech ajaanaa ||
english: I am foolish, stupid, masterless, fickle, powerless, lowly and ignorant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak saran teree rakh lehu aavan jaanaa ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, I seek Your Sanctuary - please save me from coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਹ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saadhah saranee paaeeai har jeeu gun gaavah har neetaa raam ||
english: In the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints, I have found the Dear Lord, and I constantly sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੂਰਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਗਉ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਭ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dhoor bhagatan kee man tan lagau har jeeu sabh patit puneetaa raam ||
english: Applying the dust of the devotees to the mind and body, O Dear Lord, all sinners are sanctified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤਾ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਹੋਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: patitaa puneetaa hohi tinh sa(n)g jinh bidhaataa paaiaa ||
english: The sinners are sanctified in the company of those who have met the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤੇ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਹਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naam raate jee daate nit dehi chaRahi savaaiaa ||
english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they are given the gift of the life of the soul; their gifts increase day by day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ridh sidh nav nidh har jap jinee aatam jeetaa ||
english: Wealth, the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, and the nine treasures come to those who meditate on the Lord, and conquer their own soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak vadabhaag paaeeahi saadh saajan meetaa ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, it is only by great good fortune that the Holy Saints, the Lord's companions, are found, O friends. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jinee sach vana(n)jiaa har jeeu se poore saahaa raam ||
english: Those who deal in Truth, O Dear Lord, are the perfect bankers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਤਿੰਨ ਪਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bahut khajaanaa ti(n)n pahi har jeeu har keeratan laahaa raam ||
english: They possess the great treasure, O Dear Lord, and they reap the profit of the Lord's Praise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨ ਲੋਭੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh na lobh biaapai jo jan prabh siu raatiaa ||
english: Sexual desire, anger and greed do not cling to those who are attuned to God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ek jaanahi ek maanahi raam kai ra(n)g maatiaa ||
english: They know the One, and they believe in the One; they are intoxicated with the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਣੀ ਪੜੇ ਸਰਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਓਮਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: lag sa(n)t charanee paRe saranee man tinaa omaahaa ||
english: They fall at the Feet of the Saints, and seek their Sanctuary; their minds are filled with joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਸੇਈ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak jin naam palai seee sache saahaa ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, those who have the Naam in their laps are the true bankers. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: naanak soee simareeai har jeeu jaa kee kal dhaaree raam ||
english: O Nanak, meditate on that Dear Lord, who supports all by His almighty strength.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramukh manahu na veesarai har jeeu karataa purakh muraaree raam ||
english: In their minds, the Gurmukhs do not forget the Dear Lord, the Primal Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dookh rog na bhau biaapai jinhee har har dhiaaiaa ||
english: Pain, disease and fear do not cling to those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤਰੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad tare bhavajal poorab likhiaa paaiaa ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and obtain their pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: vajee vadhaaee man saa(n)t aaee miliaa purakh apaaree ||
english: They are congratulated and applauded, their minds are at peace, and they meet the infinite Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak simar har har ichh pu(n)nee hamaaree ||4||3||
english: Prays Nanak, by meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har, my desires are fulfilled. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: bihaagaRaa mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਧੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਰੈਨੜੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ ॥
transliteration: vadh sukh rainaReee pri prem lagaa ||
english: O peaceful night, grow longer - I have come to enshrine love for my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟੁ ਦੁਖ ਨੀਦੜੀਏ ਪਰਸਉ ਸਦਾ ਪਗਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat dukh needaReee parasau sadaa pagaa ||
english: O painful sleep, grow shorter, so that I may constantly grasp His Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਗ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਂਛਉ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਚਉ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: pag dhoor baa(n)chhau sadaa jaachau naam ras bairaaganee ||
english: I long for the dust of His Feet, and beg for His Name; for His Love, I have renounced the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜ ਮਾਤੀ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: pri ra(n)g raatee sahaj maatee mahaa duramat tiaaganee ||
english: I am imbued with the Love of my Beloved, and I am naturally intoxicated with it; I have forsaken my awful evil-mindedness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੑੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭੀਨੀ ਮਿਲਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਚ ਮਗਾ ॥
transliteration: gahi bhujaa leenhee prem bheenee milan preetam sach magaa ||
english: He has taken me by the arm, and I am saturated with His Love; I have met my Beloved on the Path of Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਹਉ ਚਰਣਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa rahau charanah sa(n)g lagaa ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, please Lord, shower Your Mercy on me, that I may remain attached to Your Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਚਰਣਿ ਲਗਹ ॥
transliteration: meree sakhee sahelaReeho prabh kai charan lagah ||
english: O my friends and companions, let us remain attached to the Feet of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਘਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੰਗਹ ॥
transliteration: man pri prem ghanaa har kee bhagat ma(n)gah ||
english: Within my mind is great love for my Beloved; I beg for the Lord's devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har bhagat paaeeai prabh dhiaaeeai jaai mileeai har janaa ||
english: The Lord's devotional worship is obtained, meditating on God. Let us go and meet the humble servants of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਤਜੀਐ ਅਰਪਿ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: maan mohu bikaar tajeeai arap tan dhan ihu manaa ||
english: Renounce pride, emotional attachment and corruption, and dedicate this body, wealth and mind to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਗਹ ॥
transliteration: bad purakh pooran gun sa(n)pooran bhram bheet har har mil bhagah ||
english: The Lord God is great, perfect, glorious, absolutely perfect; meeting the Lord, Har, Har, the wall of doubt is torn down.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਹ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sun ma(n)tr sakheee har naam nit nit nit japah ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, hear these teachings, O friends - chant the Lord's Name constantly, over and over again. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: har naar suhaagane sabh ra(n)g maane ||
english: The Lord's bride is a happy wife; she enjoys all pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਂਡ ਨ ਬੈਸਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਚਿਰਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: raa(n)d na baisaee prabh purakh chiraane ||
english: She does not sit around like a widow, because the Lord God lives forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀਆ ॥
transliteration: nah dookh paavai prabh dhiaavai dha(n)n te badabhaageeaa ||
english: She does not suffer pain - she meditates on God. She is blessed, and very fortunate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਵਹਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਖੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sukh sahaj sovahi kilabikh khovahi naam ras ra(n)g jaageeaa ||
english: She sleeps in peaceful ease, her sins are erased, and she wakes to the joy and love of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਹਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਹਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਚਨ ਮੀਠੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: mil prem rahanaa har naam gahanaa pri bachan meethe bhaane ||
english: She remains absorbed in her Beloved - the Lord's Name is her ornament. The Words of her Beloved are sweet and pleasing to her.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਚਿਰਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak man ichh paaee har mile purakh chiraane ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, I have obtained my mind's desires; I have met my eternal Husband Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੋਹਿਲੜੇ ਕੋਡ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: tit grihi sohilaRe kod ana(n)daa ||
english: The songs of bliss resound, and millions of pleasures are found in that house;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan rav rahiaa prabh paramaana(n)daa ||
english: the mind and body are permeated by God, the Lord of supreme bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੋ ॥
transliteration: har ka(n)t ana(n)t daiaal sreedhar gobi(n)d patit udhaarano ||
english: My Husband Lord is infinite and merciful; He is the Lord of wealth, the Lord of the Universe, the Saving Grace of sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ਭੈ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਾਰਣੋ ॥
transliteration: prabh kripaa dhaaree har muraaree bhai si(n)dh saagar taarano ||
english: God, the Giver of mercy, the Lord, the Destroyer of pride, carries us across the terrifying world-ocean of poison.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਵੈ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: jo saran aavai tis ka(n)th laavai ihu birad suaamee sa(n)daa ||
english: The Lord lovingly embraces whoever comes to the Lord's Sanctuary - this is the way of the Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak har ka(n)t miliaa sadaa kel kara(n)daa ||4||1||4||
english: Prays Nanak, I have met my Husband Lord, who plays with me forever. ||4||1||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bihaagaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਤਹ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har charan sarovar tah karahu nivaas manaa ||
english: The Lord's Feet are the Pools of Ambrosial Nectar; your dwelling is there, O my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kar majan har sare sabh kilabikh naas manaa ||
english: Take your cleansing bath in the Ambrosial Pool of the Lord, and all of your sins shall be wiped away, O my soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਜਨੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਜਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਨਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: kar sadaa majan gobi(n)d sajan dukh a(n)dheraa naase ||
english: Take your cleansing ever in the Lord God, O friends, and the pain of darkness shall be dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਟੈ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: janam maran na hoi tis kau katai jam ke phaase ||
english: Birth and death shall not touch you, and the noose of Death shall be cut away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਤਹਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸੋ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)ge naam ra(n)ge tahaa pooran aaso ||
english: So join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and be imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; there, your hopes shall be fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਨਿਵਾਸੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa har charan kamal nivaaso ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, shower Your Mercy upon me, O Lord, that I might dwell at Your Lotus Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tah anad binod sadaa anahad jhunakaaro raam ||
english: There is bliss and ecstasy there always, and the unstruck celestial melody resounds there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mil gaavahi sa(n)t janaa prabh kaa jaikaaro raam ||
english: Meeting together, the Saints sing God's Praises, and celebrate His Victory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖਸਮ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰੰਗਿ ਭਿੰਨੀਆ ॥
