transliteration: mil sa(n)t gaavahi khasam bhaavahi har prem ras ra(n)g bhi(n)neeaa ||
english: Meeting together, the Saints sing the Praises of the Lord Master; they are pleasing to the Lord, and saturated with the sublime essence of His love and affection.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਮਿਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har laabh paaiaa aap mitaaiaa mile chiree vichhu(n)niaa ||
english: They obtain the profit of the Lord, eliminate their self-conceit, and meet Him, from whom they were separated for so long.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਦਇਆ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: gahi bhujaa leene daiaa keenhe prabh ek agam apaaro ||
english: Taking them by the arm, He makes them His own; God, the One, inaccessible and infinite, bestows His kindness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sadaa niramal sach sabad run jhunakaaro ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, forever immaculate are those who sing the Praises of the True Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sun vadabhaageeaa har a(n)mrit baanee raam ||
english: Listen, O most fortunate ones, to the Ambrosial Bani of the Word of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jin kau karam likhee tis ridai samaanee raam ||
english: He alone, whose karma is so pre-ordained, has it enter into his heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਾਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: akath kahaanee tinee jaanee jis aap prabh kirapaa kare ||
english: He alone knows the Unspoken Speech, unto whom God has shown His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰੁ ਥੀਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸਾ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: amar theeaa phir na mooaa kal kalesaa dukh hare ||
english: He becomes immortal, and shall not die again; his troubles, disputes and pains are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਾਈ ਤਜਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har saran paaee taj na jaaee prabh preet man tan bhaanee ||
english: He finds the Sanctuary of the Lord; he does not forsake the Lord, and does not leave. God's Love is pleasing to his mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਈਐ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sadaa gaaeeai pavitr a(n)mrit baanee ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, sing forever the Sacred Ambrosial Bani of His Word. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਗਲਤੁ ਭਏ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: man tan galat bhae kichh kahan na jaaee raam ||
english: My mind and body are intoxicated - this state cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਅੜਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੀਆ ਸਮਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jis te upajiaRaa tin leeaa samaaee raam ||
english: We originated from Him, and into Him we shall merge once again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤੀ ਉਦਕੁ ਉਦਕਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mil braham jotee ot potee udak udak samaaiaa ||
english: I merge into God's Light, through and through, like water merging into water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਨਹ ਦੂਜਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal ek raviaa nah doojaa drisataaiaa ||
english: The One Lord permeates the water, the land and the sky - I do not see any other.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ban trin tribhavan poor pooran keemat kahan na jaaee ||
english: He is totally permeating the woods, meadows and the three worlds. I cannot express His worth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak aap jaanai jin eh banat banaaee ||4||2||5||
english: Prays Nanak, He alone knows - He who created this creation. ||4||2||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bihaagaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਸੰਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: khojat sa(n)t phirahi prabh praan adhaare raam ||
english: The Saints go around, searching for God, the support of their breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਣੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਨ ਭਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: taan tan kheen bhaiaa bin milat piaare raam ||
english: They lose the strength of their bodies, if they do not merge with their Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਲੀਜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: prabh milahu piaare maiaa dhaare kar daiaa laR laai leejeeai ||
english: O God, my Beloved, please, bestow Your kindness upon me, that I may merge with You; by Your Mercy, attach me to the hem of Your robe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਜਪਉ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ ਪੇਖੇ ਜੀਜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: dehi naam apanaa japau suaamee har daras pekhe jeejeeai ||
english: Bless me with Your Name, that I may chant it, O Lord and Master; beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: samarath pooran sadaa nihachal ooch agam apaare ||
english: He is all-powerful, perfect, eternal and unchanging, exalted, unapproachable and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa milahu praan piaare ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, bestow Your Mercy upon me, O Beloved of my soul, that I may merge with You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਬਰਤ ਕੀਨੇ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਚਰਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jap tap barat keene pekhan kau charanaa raam ||
english: I have practiced chanting, intensive meditation and fasting, to see Your Feet, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਪਤਿ ਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tapat na katahi bujhai bin suaamee saranaa raam ||
english: But still, my burning is not quenched, without the Sanctuary of the Lord Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਾਟਿ ਬੇਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: prabh saran teree kaat beree sa(n)saar saagar taareeai ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary, God - please, cut away my bonds and carry me across the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਉਗਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: anaath niragun kachh na jaanaa meraa gun augan na beechaareeai ||
english: I am masterless, worthless, and I know nothing; please do not count up my merits and demerits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal gopaal preetam samarath kaaran karanaa ||
english: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, Sustainer of the world, O Beloved, Almighty Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਮਾਗੈ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak chaatrik har boo(n)d maagai jap jeevaa har har charanaa ||2||
english: Nanak, the song-bird, begs for the rain-drop of the Lord's Name; meditating on the Feet of the Lord, Har, Har, he lives. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮਿਅ ਸਰੋਵਰੋ ਪੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ami sarovaro peeu har har naamaa raam ||
english: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar from the pool of the Lord; chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਪਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tah sa(n)g milai jap pooran kaamaa raam ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, one meets the Lord; meditating on Him, one's affairs are resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਾਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਦੀਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਬੀਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh kaam pooran dukh bideeran har nimakh manahu na beesarai ||
english: God is the One who accomplishes everything; He is the Dispeller of pain. Never forget Him from your mind, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aana(n)d anadin sadaa saachaa sarab gun jagadeesarai ||
english: He is blissful, night and day; He is forever True. All Glories are contained in the Lord in the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਣਤ ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਧਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: aganat ooch apaar thaakur agam jaa ko dhaamaa ||
english: Incalculable, lofty and infinite is the Lord and Master. Unapproachable is His home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਇਛ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਰਾਮਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak meree ichh pooran mile sreera(n)g raamaa ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, my desires are fulfilled; I have met the Lord, the Greatest Lover. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਜਗ ਫਲਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਗਾਵਨਹਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kaee kotik jag phalaa sun gaavanahaare raam ||
english: The fruits of many millions of charitable feasts come to those who listen to and sing the Lord's Praise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕੁਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japat kul sagale taare raam ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, all one's generations are carried across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੋਹੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਿਤ ਗਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har naam japat soha(n)t praanee taa kee mahimaa kit ganaa ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, one is beautified; what Praises of His can I chant?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚਿਤਵੰਤਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਦ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har bisar naahee praan piaare chitava(n)t darasan sad manaa ||
english: I shall never forget the Lord; He is the Beloved of my soul. My mind constantly yearns for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਆਏ ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: subh divas aae gahi ka(n)th laae prabh ooch agam apaare ||
english: Auspicious is that day, when God, the lofty, inaccessible and infinite, hugs me close in His embrace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੬॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak saphal sabh kichh prabh mile at piaare ||4||3||6||
english: Prays Nanak, everything is fruitful - I have met my supremely beloved Lord God. ||4||3||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: bihaagaRaa mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ||
english: Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਕਾਏ ਰਾਤੜਿਆ ਵਾਟ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: an kaae raataRiaa vaat duhelee raam ||
english: Why are you imbued with the love of another? That path is very dangerous.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਦਿਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੇਲੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: paap kamaavadiaa teraa koi na belee raam ||
english: O sinner, no one is your friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਏ ਨ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: koe na belee hoi teraa sadaa pachhotaavahe ||
english: No one shall be your friend, and you shall forever regret your actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਦਹੁ ਸੇ ਦਿਹ ਆਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: gun gupaal na japahi rasanaa phir kadahu se dih aavahe ||
english: You have not chanted with your tongue the Praises of the Sustainer of the World; when will these days come again?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਰਵਰ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਨਹ ਪਾਤ ਜੁੜਤੇ ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਗਉਨੁ ਇਕੇਲੀ ॥
transliteration: taravar vichhu(n)ne nah paat juRate jam mag gaun ikelee ||
english: The leaf, separated from the branch, shall not be joined with it again; all alone, it falls on its way to death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰਤ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak bin naam har ke sadaa phirat duhelee ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, without the Lord's Name, the soul wanders, forever suffering. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਵਲਵੰਚ ਲੂਕਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: too(n) valava(n)ch look karahi sabh jaanai jaanee raam ||
english: You are practicing deception secretly, but the Lord, the Knower, knows all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਧਰਮ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਲ ਪੀੜੇ ਘਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: lekhaa dharam bhaiaa til peeRe ghaanee raam ||
english: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma reads your account, you shall be squeezed like a sesame seed in the oil-press.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kirat kamaane dukh sahu paraanee anik jon bhramaaiaa ||
english: For the actions you committed, you shall suffer the penalty; you shall be consigned to countless reincarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa mohanee sa(n)g raataa ratan janam gavaaiaa ||
english: Imbued with the love of Maya, the great enticer, you shall lose the jewel of this human life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਆਨ ਕਾਜ ਸਿਆਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ikas har ke naam baajhahu aan kaaj siaanee ||
english: Except for the One Name of the Lord, you are clever in everything else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੁਭਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak lekh likhiaa bharam mohi lubhaanee ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, those who have such pre-ordained destiny are attracted to doubt and emotional attachment. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੀਚੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇ ਅਕ੍ਰਿਤਘਣੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: beech na koi kare akritaghan vichhuR paiaa ||
english: No one advocates for the ungrateful person, who is separated from the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਏ ਖਰੇ ਕਠਿਨ ਜਮਕੰਕਰਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aae khare kathin jamaka(n)kar pakaR laiaa ||
english: The hard-hearted Messenger of Death comes and seizes him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਕੜੇ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਰਾਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pakaRe chalaaiaa apanaa kamaaiaa mahaa mohanee raatiaa ||
english: He seizes him, and leads him away, to pay for his evil deeds; he was imbued with Maya, the great enticer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਪਤ ਥੰਮੑ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gun govi(n)d guramukh na japiaa tapat tha(n)mh gal laatiaa ||
english: He was not Gurmukh - he did not chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe; and now, the hot irons are put to his chest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮੂਠਾ ਖੋਇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਛੁਤਾਪਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar moothaa khoi giaan pachhutaapiaa ||
english: He is ruined by sexual desire, anger and egotism; deprived of spiritual wisdom, he comes to regret.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੁ ਰਸਨ ਨ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sa(n)jog bhoolaa har jaap rasan na jaapiaa ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, by his cursed destiny he has gone astray; with his tongue, he does not chant the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin ko naahee prabh raakhanahaaraa raam ||
english: Without You, God, no one is our savior.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: patit udhaaran har birad tumaaraa raam ||
english: It is Your Nature, Lord, to save the sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: patit udhaaran saran suaamee kripaa nidh daiaalaa ||
english: O Savior of sinners, I have entered Your Sanctuary, O Lord and Master, Compassionate Ocean of Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਉਧਰੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਗਲ ਘਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop te udhar karate sagal ghat pratipaalaa ||
english: Please, rescue me from the deep, dark pit, O Creator, Cherisher of all hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਟਿ ਮਹਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saran teree kat mahaa beRee ik naam dehi adhaaraa ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary; please, cut away these heavy bonds, and give me the Support of the One Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak kar dei raakhahu gobi(n)d deen daiaaraa ||4||
english: Prays Nanak, please, give me Your Hand and save me, O Lord of the Universe, Merciful to the meek. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਗਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: so din saphal ganiaa har prabhoo milaaiaa raam ||
english: That day is judged to be fruitful, when I merged with my Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਰਗਟਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sabh sukh paragatiaa dukh door paraaiaa raam ||
english: Total happiness was revealed, and pain was taken far away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sukh sahaj anad binod sad hee gun gupaal nit gaaeeai ||
english: Peace, tranquility, joy and eternal happiness come from constantly singing the Glorious Praises of the Sustainer of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: bhaj saadhasa(n)ge mile ra(n)ge bahuR jon na dhaaeeai ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I lovingly remember the Lord; I shall not wander again in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gahi ka(n)th laae sahaj subhaae aad a(n)kur aaiaa ||
english: He has naturally hugged me close in His Loving Embrace, and the seed of my primal destiny has sprouted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak aap miliaa bahuR katahoo na jaaiaa ||5||4||7||
english: Prays Nanak, He Himself has met me, and He shall never again leave me. ||5||4||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: bihaagaRaa mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ||
english: Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sunahu bena(n)teeaa suaamee mere raam ||
english: Listen to my prayer, O my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ ਭਰੇ ਭੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kot apraadh bhare bhee tere chere raam ||
english: I am filled with millions of sins, but still, I am Your slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਨ ਮੋਹਨ ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸਹ ਭੰਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: dukh haran kirapaa karan mohan kal kalesah bha(n)janaa ||
english: O Destroyer of pain, Bestower of Mercy, Fascinating Lord, Destroyer of sorrow and strife,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: saran teree rakh lehu meree sarab mai nira(n)janaa ||
english: I have come to Your Sanctuary; please preserve my honor. You are all-pervading, O Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਤ ਪੇਖਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨੇਰਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sunat pekhat sa(n)g sabh kai prabh nerahoo te nere ||
english: He hears and beholds all; God is with us, the nearest of the near.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਚੇਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aradaas naanak sun suaamee rakh lehu ghar ke chere ||1||
english: O Lord and Master, hear Nanak's prayer; please save the servants of Your household. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: too samarath sadaa ham deen bhekhaaree raam ||
english: You are eternal and all-powerful; I am a mere beggar, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਕਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi magan kadh lehu muraaree raam ||
english: I am intoxicated with the love of Maya - save me, Lord!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਅਨਿਕ ਦੋਖ ਕਮਾਵਨੇ ॥
transliteration: lobh mohi bikaar baadhio anik dokh kamaavane ||
english: Bound down by greed, emotional attachment and corruption, I have made so many mistakes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਲਿਪਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਰਹਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੀਆ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਾਵਨੇ ॥
transliteration: alipat ba(n)dhan rahat karataa keeaa apanaa paavane ||
english: The creator is both attached and detached from entanglements; one obtains the fruits of his own actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kar anugrahu patit paavan bahu jon bhramate haaree ||
english: Show kindness to me, O Purifier of sinners; I am so tired of wandering through reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak daas har kaa prabh jee praan adhaaree ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of the Lord; God is the Support of my soul, and my breath of life. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਵਡਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਥੋਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: too samarath vadaa meree mat thoree raam ||
english: You are great and all-powerful; my understanding is so inadequate, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਲਹਿ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਨਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: paalahi akirataghanaa pooran drisat teree raam ||
english: You cherish even the ungrateful ones; Your Glance of Grace is perfect, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਅਪਾਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: agaadh bodh apaar karate mohi neech kachhoo na jaanaa ||
english: Your wisdom is unfathomable, O Infinite Creator. I am lowly, and I know nothing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਨ ਕਉਡੀ ਪਸੂ ਨੀਚੁ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ratan tiaag sa(n)grahan kaudee pasoo neech iaanaa ||
english: Forsaking the jewel, I have saved the shell; I am a lowly, ignorant beast.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਲਤੀ ਮਹਾ ਚੰਚਲਿ ਦੋਖ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tiaag chalatee mahaa cha(n)chal dokh kar kar joree ||
english: I have kept that which forsakes me, and is very fickle, continually committing sins, again and again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak saran samarath suaamee paij raakhahu moree ||3||
english: Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, Almighty Lord and Master; please, preserve my honor. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਵੀਛੁੜਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jaa te veechhuRiaa tin aap milaaiaa raam ||
english: I was separated from Him, and now, He has united me with Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਮੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)game har gun gaaiaa raam ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਸਦਾ ਨੀਕੇ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਮੈ ਪਰਗਟ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: gun gaai govid sadaa neeke kaliaan mai paragat bhae ||
english: Singing the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the ever-sublime blissful Lord is revealed to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜਾ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਿ ਲਏ ॥
transliteration: sejaa suhaavee sa(n)g prabh kai aapane prabh kar lae ||
english: My bed is adorned with God; my God has made me His own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਚਿੰਤ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹੋਏ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: chhod chi(n)t achi(n)t hoe bahuR dookh na paaiaa ||
english: Abandoning anxiety, I have become carefree, and I shall not suffer in pain any longer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak darasan pekh jeeve govi(n)d gun nidh gaaiaa ||4||5||8||
english: Nanak lives by beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the ocean of excellence. ||4||5||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: bihaagaRaa mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ||
english: Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਿ ਸੁਧਰਮੀੜਿਆ ਮੋਨਿ ਕਤ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bol sudharameeRiaa mon kat dhaaree raam ||
english: O you of sublime faith, chant the Lord's Name; why do you remain silent?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: too netree dekh chaliaa maaiaa biuhaaree raam ||
english: with your eyes, you have seen the treacherous ways of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਬਿਨਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g terai kachh na chaalai binaa gobi(n)d naamaa ||
english: Nothing shall go along with you, except the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਸ ਵੇਸ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਰੂਪਾ ਸਗਲ ਊਣੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: des ves suvaran roopaa sagal oone kaamaa ||
english: Land, clothes, gold and silver - all of these things are useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਸਤ ਘੋਰਿ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr na sa(n)g sobhaa hasat ghor vikaaree ||
english: Children, spouse, worldly honors, elephants, horses and other corrupting influences shall not go with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak bin saadhasa(n)gam sabh mithiaa sa(n)saaree ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the whole world is false. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਨ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਇਆ ਤੂ ਨੀਦ ਭਰੇ ਜਾਗਤ ਕਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: raajan kiu soiaa too need bhare jaagat kat naahee raam ||
english: O king, why are you sleeping? Why don't you wake up to reality?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਝੂਠੁ ਰੁਦਨੁ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa jhooth rudan kete bilalaahee raam ||
english: It is useless to cry and whine about Maya, but so many cry out and bewail.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
transliteration: bilalaahi kete mahaa mohan bin naam har ke sukh nahee ||
english: So many cry out for Maya, the great enticer, but without the Name of the Lord, there is no peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਉਪਾਵ ਥਾਕੇ ਜਹ ਭਾਵਤ ਤਹ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sahas siaanap upaav thaake jah bhaavat tah jaahee ||
english: Thousands of clever tricks and efforts will not succeed. One goes wherever the Lord wills him to go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਹੀ ॥
transliteration: aad a(n)te madh pooran sarabatr ghat ghat aahee ||
english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is all-pervading everywhere; He is in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮੁ ਸੇ ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak jin saadhasa(n)gam se pat setee ghar jaahee ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat go to the house of the Lord with honor. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਗ੍ਰਹਿਓ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: narapat jaan grahio sevak siaane raam ||
english: O king of mortals, know that your palaces and wise servants shall be of no use in the end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਪਰ ਵੀਛੁੜਣਾ ਮੋਹੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sarapar veechhuRanaa mohe pachhutaane raam ||
english: You shall certainly have to separate yourself from them, and their attachment shall make you feel regret.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਕਹਾ ਅਸਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: haricha(n)dauree dekh bhoolaa kahaa asathit paaeeai ||
english: Beholding the phantom city, you have gone astray; how can you now find stability?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਆਨ ਰਚਨਾ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: bin naam har ke aan rachanaa ahilaa janam gavaaeeai ||
english: Absorbed in things other than the Name of the Lord, this human life is wasted in vain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹ ਕਾਂਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥
transliteration: hau hau karat na trisan boojhai nah kaa(n)m pooran giaane ||
english: Indulging in egotistical actions, your thirst is not quenched. Your desires are not fulfilled, and you do not attain spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਕੇਤਿਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak bin naam har ke ketiaa pachhutaane ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, without the Name of the Lord, so many have departed with regret. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੋ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dhaar anugraho apanaa kar leenaa raam ||
english: Showering His blessings, the Lord has made me His own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੁਜਾ ਗਹਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਓ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhujaa gahi kaadh leeo saadhoo sa(n)g deenaa raam ||
english: Grasping me by the arm, He has pulled me out of the mud, and He has blessed me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਸਗਲ ਕਲਮਲ ਦੁਖ ਜਲੇ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gam har araadhe sagal kalamal dukh jale ||
english: Worshipping the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, all my sins and sufferings are burnt away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਦਾਨ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੇ ਚਲੇ ॥
transliteration: mahaa dharam sudaan kiriaa sa(n)g terai se chale ||
english: This is the greatest religion, and the best act of charity; this alone shall go along with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਅਰਾਧੈ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa araadhai ek suaamee har naam man tan bheenaa ||
english: My tongue chants in adoration the Name of the One Lord and Master; my mind and body are drenched in the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਬੀਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak jis no har milaae so sarab gun parabeenaa ||4||6||9||
english: O Nanak, whoever the Lord unites with Himself, is filled with all virtues. ||4||6||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜੇ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bihaagaRe kee vaar mahalaa 4 ||
english: Vaar Of Bihaagraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te sukh paaeeai hor thai sukh na bhaal ||
english: Serving the Guru, peace is obtained; do not search for peace anywhere else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੇਦੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad man bhedeeai sadaa vasai har naal ||
english: The soul is pierced by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. The Lord dwells ever with the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam tinaa kau milai jin har vekhai nadar nihaal ||1||
english: O Nanak, they alone obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord, who are blessed by the Lord with His Glance of Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੈ ਸੋ ਖਰਚੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: siphat khajaanaa bakhas hai jis bakhasai so kharachai khaai ||
english: The treasure of the Lord's Praise is such a blessed gift; he alone obtains it to spend, unto whom the Lord bestows it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਸਭ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur bin hath na aavaee sabh thake karam kamaai ||
english: Without the True Guru, it does not come to hand; all have grown weary of performing religious rituals.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਧਨਹੀਣੁ ਹੈ ਅਗੈ ਭੁਖਾ ਕਿ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak manamukh jagat dhanaheen hai agai bhukhaa k khaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs of the world lack this wealth; when they are hungry in the next world, what will they have to eat there? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਸਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh teree too sabhas daa sabh tudh upaaiaa ||
english: All are Yours, and You belong to all. You created all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਭਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa vich too varatadaa too sabhanee dhiaaiaa ||
english: You are pervading within all - all meditate on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਤੂ ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tis dee too bhagat thaai paaihi jo tudh man bhaaiaa ||
english: You accept the devotional worship of those who are pleasing to Your Mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jo har prabh bhaavai so theeai sabh karan teraa karaaiaa ||
english: Whatever pleases the Lord God happens; all act as You cause them to act.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇ ਵਡਾ ਜੋ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: salaahihu har sabhanaa te vadaa jo sa(n)t janaa(n) kee paij rakhadaa aaiaa ||1||
english: Praise the Lord, the greatest of all; He preserves the honor of the Saints. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਜਗਿ ਜੀਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak giaanee jag jeetaa jag jeetaa sabh koi ||
english: O Nanak, the spiritually wise one has conquered all others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naame kaaraj sidh hai sahaje hoi s hoi ||
english: Through the Name, his affairs are brought to perfection; whatever happens is by His Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਅਚਲੁ ਹੈ ਚਲਾਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramat mat achal hai chalaai na sakai koi ||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, his mind is held steady; no one can make him waver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa kaa har a(n)geekaar kare kaaraj suhaavaa hoi ||
english: The Lord makes His devotee His own, and his affairs are adjusted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh moolahu bhulaaian vich lab lobh aha(n)kaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs have been led astray from the very beginning; within them lurks greed, avarice and ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਝਗੜਾ ਕਰਦਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਦਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jhagaRaa karadiaa anadin gudarai sabad na karai veechaar ||
english: Their nights and days pass in argument, and they do not reflect upon the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਧਿ ਮਤਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sudh mat karatai hir laee bolan sabh vikaar ||
english: The Creator has taken away their subtle intellect, and all their speech is corrupt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਿਤੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਅਨਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਗੵਾਨੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ditai kitai na sa(n)tokheean a(n)tar trisanaa bahut agyaan a(n)dhaar ||
english: No matter what they are given, they are not satisfied; within them is desire, and the great darkness of ignorance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨਾਲਹੁ ਤੁਟੀਆ ਭਲੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak manamukhaa naalahu tuteeaa bhalee jinaa maaiaa mohi piaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, it is right to break with the self-willed manmukhs; to them, the love of Maya is sweet. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਭਉ ਸੰਸਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tinh bhau sa(n)saa kiaa kare jin satigur sir karataar ||
english: What can fear and doubt do to those, who have given their heads to the Creator, and to the True Guru?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dhur tin kee paij rakhadaa aape rakhanahaar ||
english: He who has preserved honor from the beginning of time, He shall preserve their honor as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: mil preetam sukh paaiaa sachai sabad veechaar ||
english: Meeting their Beloved, they find peace; they reflect upon the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sukhadaataa seviaa aape parakhanahaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, I serve the Giver of Peace; He Himself is the Assessor. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh teriaa too sabhanaa raas ||
english: All beings are Yours; You are the wealth of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jis no too dehi tis sabh kichh milai koee hor sareek naahee tudh paas ||
english: One unto whom You give, obtains everything; there is no one else to rival You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: too iko daataa sabhas daa har pahi aradaas ||
english: You alone are the Great Giver of all; I offer my prayer unto You, Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਤੂ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jis dee tudh bhaavai tis dee too ma(n)n laihi so jan saabaas ||
english: One with whom You are pleased, is accepted by You; how blessed is such a person!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਚੋਜੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh teraa choj varatadaa dukh sukh tudh paas ||2||
english: Your wondrous play is pervading everywhere. I place my pain and pleasure before You. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੈ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sachai bhaavade dar sachai sachiaar ||
english: The Gurmukhs are pleasing to the True Lord; they are judged to be true in the True Court.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: saajan man aana(n)d hai gur kaa sabad veechaar ||
english: The minds of such friends are filled with bliss, as they reflect upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar sabad vasaaiaa dukh katiaa chaanan keeaa karataar ||
english: They enshrine the Shabad within their hearts; their pain is dispelled, and the Creator blesses them with the Divine Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਰਖਸੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak rakhanahaaraa rakhasee aapanee kirapaa dhaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Savior Lord shall save them, and shower them with His Mercy. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਭੈ ਰਚਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa chaakaree bhai rach kaar kamaai ||
english: Serve the Guru, and wait upon Him; as you work, maintain the Fear of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਸੇਵੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jehaa sevai teho hovai je chalai tisai rajaai ||
english: As you serve Him, you will become like Him, as you walk according to His Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sabh kichh aap hai avar na doojee jaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, He Himself is everything; there is no other place to go. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: teree vadiaaee toohai jaanadaa tudh jevad avar na koee ||
english: You alone know Your greatness - no one else is as great as You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tudh jevad hor sareek hovai taa aakheeai tudh jevad toohai hoee ||
english: If there were some other rival as great as You, then I would speak of him. You alone are as great as You are.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹੋਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jin too seviaa tin sukh paaiaa hor tis dee rees kare kiaa koee ||
english: One who serves You obtains peace; who else can compare to You?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਭੰਨਣ ਘੜਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਗੈ ਮੰਗਣ ਨੋ ਹਥ ਜੋੜਿ ਖਲੀ ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: too bha(n)nan ghaRan samarath daataar hahi tudh agai ma(n)gan no hath joR khalee sabh hoee ||
english: You are all-powerful to destroy and create, O Great Giver; with palms pressed together, all stand begging before You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭਸੈ ਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਖੰਡੀ ਵਰਭੰਡੀ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਪੁਰਈ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tudh jevad daataar mai koee nadar na aavaee tudh sabhasai no daan ditaa kha(n)dee varabha(n)dee paataalee puraee sabh loee ||3||
english: I see none as great as You, O Great Giver; You give in charity to the beings of all the continents, worlds, solar systems, nether regions and universes. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਈਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man parateet na aaeeaa sahaj na lago bhaau ||
english: O mind, you have no faith, and you have not embraced love for the Celestial Lord;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabadai saad na paaio manahath kiaa gun gaai ||
english: you do not enjoy the sublime taste of the Word of the Shabad - what Praises of the Lord will you stubborn-mindedly sing?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak aaiaa so paravaan hai j guramukh sach samaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, his coming alone is approved, who, as Gurmukh, merges into the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਮੂੜਾ ਅਵਰਾ ਆਖਿ ਦੁਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa aap na pachhaanai mooRaa avaraa aakh dukhaae ||
english: The fool does not understand his own self; he annoys others with his speech.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਢੈ ਦੀ ਖਸਲਤਿ ਨ ਗਈਆ ਅੰਧੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dhai dee khasalat na gaeeaa a(n)dhe vichhuR chotaa khaae ||
english: His underlying nature does not leave him; separated from the Lord, he suffers cruel blows.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਭੰਨਿ ਨ ਘੜਿਓ ਰਹੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur kai bhai bha(n)n na ghaRio rahai a(n)k samaae ||
english: Through the fear of the True Guru, he has not changed and reformed himself, so that he might merge in the lap of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anadin sahasaa kade na chookai bin sabadai dukh paae ||
english: Night and day, his doubts never stop; without the Word of the Shabad, he suffers in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਲਾ ਨਿਤ ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh a(n)tar sabalaa nit dha(n)dhaa karat vihaae ||
english: Sexual desire, anger and greed are so powerful within him; he passes his life constantly entangled in worldly affairs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਦੇਖਤ ਸੁਣਿ ਥਕੇ ਦਿਹ ਮੁਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: charan kar dekhat sun thake dih muke neRai aae ||
english: His feet, hands, eyes and ears are exhausted; his days are numbered, and his death is immanent.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਮੀਠਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sachaa naam na lago meethaa jit naam nav nidh paae ||
english: The True Name does not seem sweet to him - the Name by which the nine treasures are obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਮਰੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jeevat marai marai phun jeevai taa(n) mokha(n)tar paae ||
english: But if he remains dead while yet alive, then by so dying, he truly lives; thus, he attains liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਰਾਣੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dhur karam na paaio paraanee vin karamaa kiaa paae ||
english: But if he is not blessed with such pre-ordained karma, then without this karma, what can he obtain?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਮੂੜੇ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad samaal too mooRe gat mat sabade paae ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you fool; through the Shabad, you shall obtain salvation and wisdom.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਂ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak satigur tad hee paae jaa(n) vichahu aap gavaae ||2||
english: O Nanak, he alone finds the True Guru, who eliminates self-conceit from within. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਗਲੈ ਦਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jis dai chit vasiaa meraa suaamee tis no kiu a(n)desaa kisai galai daa loReeai ||
english: One whose consciousness is filled with my Lord Master - why should he feel anxious about anything?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਕਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਧਿਆਇਦਿਆ ਕਿਵ ਨਿਮਖ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਮੋੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har sukhadaataa sabhanaa galaa kaa tis no dhiaaidiaa kiv nimakh ghaRee muhu moReeai ||
english: The Lord is the Giver of Peace, the Lord of all things; why would we turn our faces away from His meditation, even for a moment, or an instant?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਹੋਏ ਨਿਤ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੀਐ ਮੁਹੁ ਜੋੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jin har dhiaaiaa tis no sarab kaliaan hoe nit sa(n)t janaa kee sa(n)gat jaai baheeai muhu joReeai ||
english: One who meditates on the Lord obtains all pleasures and comforts; let us go each and every day, to sit in the Saints' Society.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sabh dukh bhukh rog gae har sevak ke sabh jan ke ba(n)dhan toReeai ||
english: All the pain, hunger, and disease of the Lord's servant are eradicated; the bonds of the humble beings are torn away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਲੋੜੀਐ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har kirapaa te hoaa har bhagat har bhagat janaa kai muhi dithai jagat tariaa sabh loReeai ||4||
english: By the Lord's Grace, one becomes the Lord's devotee; beholding the face of the Lord's humble devotee, the whole world is saved and carried across. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saa rasanaa jal jaau jin har kaa suaau na paaiaa ||
english: Let that tongue, which has not tasted the Name of the Lord, be burnt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak rasanaa sabad rasaai jin har har ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - his tongue savors the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saa rasanaa jal jaau jin har kaa naau visaariaa ||
english: Let that tongue, which has forgotten the Name of the Lord, be burnt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh rasanaa har japai har kai naai piaariaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, the tongue of the Gurmukh chants the Lord's Name, and loves the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har aape thaakur sevak bhagat har aape kare karaae ||
english: The Lord Himself is the Master, the servant and the devotee; the Lord Himself is the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har aape vekhai vigasai aape jit bhaavai tit laae ||
english: The Lord Himself beholds, and He Himself rejoices. As He wills, so does He enjoin us.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har ikanaa maarag paae aape har ikanaa ujhaR paae ||
english: The Lord places some on the Path, and the Lord leads others into the wilderness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਚਲਤ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har sachaa saahib sach tapaavas kar vekhai chalat sabaae ||
english: The Lord is the True Master; True is His justice. He arranges and beholds all His plays.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur parasaad kahai jan naanak har sache ke gun gaae ||5||
english: By Guru's Grace, servant Nanak speaks and sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਕੋ ਜਾਣਸੀ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: daravesee ko jaanasee viralaa ko daraves ||
english: How rare is the dervish, the Saintly renunciate, who understands renunciation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਹੰਢੈ ਮੰਗਦਾ ਧਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧਿਗੁ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: je ghar ghar ha(n)dhai ma(n)gadaa dhig jeevan dhig ves ||
english: Cursed is the life, and cursed are the clothes, of one who wanders around, begging from door to door.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਤਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: je aasaa a(n)desaa taj rahai guramukh bhikhiaa naau ||
english: But, if he abandons hope and anxiety, and as Gurmukh receives the Name as his charity,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis ke charan pakhaaleeahi naanak hau balihaarai jaau ||1||
english: then Nanak washes his feet, and is a sacrifice to him. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਫਲੁ ਦੁਇ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਆਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak taravar ek phal dui pa(n)kheroo aahi ||
english: O Nanak, the tree has one fruit, but two birds are perched upon it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਦੀਸਹੀ ਨਾ ਪਰ ਪੰਖੀ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aavat jaat na deesahee naa par pa(n)khee taahi ||
english: They are not seen coming or going; these birds have no wings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: bahu ra(n)gee ras bhogiaa sabad rahai nirabaan ||
english: One enjoys so many pleasures, while the other, through the Word of the Shabad, remains in Nirvaanaa.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਫਲਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har ras phal raate naanakaa karam sachaa neesaan ||2||
english: Imbued with the subtle essence of the fruit of the Lord's Name, O Nanak, the soul bears the True Insignia of God's Grace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਰਾਹਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਪੀਸਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aape dharatee aape hai raahak aap ja(n)maai peesaavai ||
english: He Himself is the field, and He Himself is the farmer. He Himself grows and grinds the corn.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਪਕਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਰੋਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬਹਿ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aap pakaavai aap bhaa(n)de dei parosai aape hee bahi khaavai ||
english: He Himself cooks it, He Himself puts the food in the dishes, and He Himself sits down to eat.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਛਿੰਗਾ ਆਪੇ ਚੁਲੀ ਭਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aape jal aape de chhi(n)gaa aape chulee bharaavai ||
english: He Himself is the water, He Himself gives the tooth-pick, and He Himself offers the mouthwash.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਦਿ ਬਹਾਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਦਾ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aape sa(n)gat sad bahaalai aape vidaa karaavai ||
english: He Himself calls and seats the congregation, and He Himself bids them goodbye.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jis no kirapaal hovai har aape tis no hukam manaavai ||6||
english: One whom the Lord Himself blesses with His Mercy - the Lord causes him to walk according to His Will. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam sabh ba(n)dhanaa paap pu(n)n sanaba(n)dh ||
english: Rituals and religions are all just entanglements; bad and good are bound up with them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਸੁ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੁ ਧੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: mamataa mohu s ba(n)dhanaa putr kalatr s dha(n)dh ||
english: Those things done for the sake of children and spouse, in ego and attachment, are just more bonds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah jevaree maaiaa kaa sanaba(n)dh ||
english: Wherever I look, there I see the noose of attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sache naam bin varatan varatai a(n)dh ||1||
english: O Nanak, without the True Name, the world is engrossed in blind entanglements. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe chaanan taa theeai jaa satigur milai rajaai ||
english: The blind receive the Divine Light, when they merge with the Will of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੈ ਸਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan toRai sach vasai agiaan adheraa jaai ||
english: They break their bonds, and dwell in Truth, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh dekhai tisai kaa jin keeaa tan saaj ||
english: They see that everything belongs to the One who created and fashioned the body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਲਾਜ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saran karataar kee karataa raakhai laaj ||2||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Creator - the Creator preserves his honor. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਦਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਥਾਟੁ ਕੀਆ ਬਹਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਤਦਹੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਬੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jadahu aape thaat keeaa bahi karatai tadahu puchh na sevak beeaa ||
english: When the Creator, sitting all by Himself, created the Universe, he did not consult with any of His servants;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਦਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tadahu kiaa ko levai kiaa ko devai jaa(n) avar na doojaa keeaa ||
english: so what can anyone take, and what can anyone give, when He did not create any other like Himself?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਤੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: phir aape jagat upaaiaa karatai daan sabhanaa kau deeaa ||
english: Then, after fashioning the world, the Creator blessed all with His blessings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਬਣਾਈਅਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aape sev banaaeean guramukh aape a(n)mrit peeaa ||
english: He Himself instructs us in His service, and as Gurmukh, we drink in His Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aap nira(n)kaar aakaar hai aape aape karai s theeaa ||7||
english: He Himself is formless, and He Himself is formed; whatever He Himself does, comes to pass. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh prabh sevahi sad saachaa anadin sahaj piaar ||
english: The Gurmukhs serve God forever; night and day, they are steeped in the Love of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਰਧਿ ਉਰਧਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d gaavahi gun saache aradh uradh ur dhaar ||
english: They are in bliss forever, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; in this world and in the next, they keep Him clasped to their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar preetam vasiaa dhur karam likhiaa karataar ||
english: Their Beloved dwells deep within; the Creator pre-ordained this destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak aap milaaian aape kirapaa dhaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, He blends them into Himself; He Himself showers His Mercy upon them. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿਐ ਕਥਿਐ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kahiai kathiai na paaeeai anadin rahai sadaa gun gaai ||
english: By merely talking and speaking, He is not found. Night and day, sing His Glorious Praises continually.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vin karamai kinai na paaio bhauk mue bilalaai ||
english: Without His Merciful Grace, no one finds Him; many have died barking and bewailing.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭਿਜੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad man tan bhijai aap vasai man aai ||
english: When the mind and body are saturated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord Himself comes to dwell in his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai aape lae milaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, by His Grace, He is found; He unites us in His Union. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਥੈ ਆਪਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: aape ved puraan sabh saasat aap kathai aap bheejai ||
english: He Himself is the Vedas, the Puraanas and all the Shaastras; He Himself chants them, and He Himself is pleased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬਹਿ ਪੂਜੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: aape hee bahi pooje karataa aap parapa(n)ch kareejai ||
english: He Himself sits down to worship, and He Himself creates the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਵਿਰਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: aap paravirat aap niraviratee aape akath katheejai ||
english: He Himself is a householder, and He Himself is a renunciate; He Himself utters the Unutterable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਵਰਤੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: aape pu(n)n sabh aap karaae aap alipat varateejai ||
english: He Himself is all goodness, and He Himself causes us to act; He Himself remains detached.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: aape sukh dukh devai karataa aape bakhas kareejai ||8||
english: He Himself grants pleasure and pain; the Creator Himself bestows His gifts. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਖਾ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਜੋਰੁ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਭਉ ਕਰਿ ਝਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sekhaa a(n)darahu jor chhad too bhau kar jhal gavaai ||
english: O Shaykh, abandon your cruel nature; live in the Fear of God and give up your madness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਕੇਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bhai kete nisatare bhai vich nirabhau paai ||
english: Through the Fear of the Guru, many have been saved; in this fear, find the Fearless Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: man kathor sabad bhed too(n) saa(n)t vasai man aai ||
english: Pierce your stone heart with the Word of the Shabad; let peace and tranquility come to abide in your mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)tee vich kaar kamaavanee saa khasam paae thaai ||
english: If good deeds are done in this state of peace, they are approved by the Lord and Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kaam krodh kinai na paaio puchhahu giaanee jaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, through sexual desire and anger, no one has ever found God - go, and ask any wise man. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh maaiaa mohu hai naam na lago piaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is emotionally attached to Maya - he has no love for the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਰੇ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kooR kamaavai kooR sa(n)grahai kooR kare aahaar ||
english: He practices falsehood, gathers in falsehood, and makes falsehood his sustenance.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bikh maaiaa dhan sa(n)ch marahi a(n)te hoi sabh chhaar ||
english: He collects the poisonous wealth of Maya, and then dies; in the end, it is all reduced to ashes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam such sa(n)jam karahi a(n)tar lobh vikaar ||
english: He practices religious rituals, purity and austere self-discipline, but within, there is greed and corruption.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਥਾਇ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak j manamukh kamaavai s thaai naa pavai daragahi hoi khuaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, whatever the self-willed manmukh does, is not acceptable; in the Court of the Lord, he is dishonored. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਖਾਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਖੰਡ ਵਰਭੰਡ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aape khaanee aape baanee aape kha(n)d varabha(n)d kare ||
english: He Himself created the four sources of creation, and He Himself fashioned speech; He Himself formed the worlds and solar systems.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਤਨ ਧਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aap samu(n)d aap hai saagar aape hee vich ratan dhare ||
english: He Himself is the ocean, and He Himself is the sea; He Himself puts the pearls in it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਲਹਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aap lahaae kare jis kirapaa jis no guramukh kare hare ||
english: By His Grace, the Lord enables the Gurmukh to find these pearls.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aape bhaujal aap hai bohithaa aape khevat aap tare ||
english: He Himself is the terrifying world-ocean, and He Himself is the boat; He Himself is the boatman, and He Himself ferries us across.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਰੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa avar na doojaa tujhai sare ||9||
english: The Creator Himself acts, and causes us to act; no one else can equal You, Lord. ||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee sevaa saphal hai je ko kare chit laai ||
english: Fruitful is service to the True Guru, if one does so with a sincere mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: naam padaarath paaeeai achi(n)t vasai man aai ||
english: The treasure of the Naam, is obtained, and the mind comes to be free of anxiety.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh kateeai haumai mamataa jaai ||
english: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, and the mind is rid of egotism and self-conceit.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: utam padavee paaeeai sache rahai samaai ||
english: One achieves the ultimate state, and remains absorbed in the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak poorab jin kau likhiaa tinaa satigur miliaa aai ||1||
english: O Nanak, the True Guru comes and meets those who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naam rataa satiguroo hai kalijug bohith hoi ||
english: The True Guru is imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He is the boat in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s paar pavai jinaa a(n)dar sachaa soi ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh crosses over; the True Lord dwells within him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naam samhaale naam sa(n)grahai naame hee pat hoi ||
english: He remembers the Naam, he gathers in the Naam, and he obtains honor through the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak satigur paaiaa karam paraapat hoi ||2||
english: Nanak has found the True Guru; by His Grace, the Name is obtained. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aape paaras aap dhaat hai aap keeton ka(n)chan ||
english: He Himself is the Philosopher's Stone, He Himself is the metal, and He Himself is transformed into gold.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aape thaakur sevak aape aape hee paap kha(n)dan ||
english: He Himself is the Lord and Master, He Himself is the servant, and He Himself is the Destroyer of sins.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਜਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aape sabh ghat bhogavai suaamee aape hee sabh a(n)jan ||
english: He Himself enjoys every heart; the Lord Master Himself is the basis of all illusion.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਬੇਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੰਜਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aap bibek aap sabh betaa aape guramukh bha(n)jan ||
english: He Himself is the discerning one, and He Himself is the Knower of all; He Himself breaks the bonds of the Gurmukhs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਡਨੁ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: jan naanak saalaahi na rajai tudh karate too har sukhadaataa vadan ||10||
english: Servant Nanak is not satisfied by merely praising You, O Creator Lord; You are the Great Giver of peace. ||10||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve jee ke ba(n)dhanaa jete karam kamaahi ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, the deeds which are done are only chains binding the soul.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਠਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve thavar na paavahee mar ja(n)mahi aavahi jaahi ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, they find no place of rest. They die, only to be born again - they continue coming and going.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve phikaa bolanaa naam na vasai man aai ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, their speech is insipid. They do not enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in the mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bin satigur seve jam pur badhe maareeahi muhi kaalai uth jaahi ||1||
english: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, they are bound and gagged, and beaten in the City of Death; they depart with blackened faces. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ik satigur kee sevaa karahi chaakaree har naame lagai piaar ||
english: Some wait upon and serve the True Guru; they embrace love for the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੁਲ ਕਾ ਕਰਨਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak janam savaaran aapanaa kul kaa karan udhaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, they reform their lives, and redeem their generations as well. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਚਾਟਸਾਲ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਾਧਾ ਆਪੇ ਚਾਟੜੇ ਪੜਣ ਕਉ ਆਣੇ ॥
transliteration: aape chaatasaal aap hai paadhaa aape chaataRe paRan kau aane ||
english: He Himself is the school, He Himself is the teacher, and He Himself brings the students to be taught.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਆਣੇ ॥
transliteration: aape pitaa maataa hai aape aape baalak kare siaane ||
english: He Himself is the father, He Himself is the mother, and He Himself makes the children wise.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਥੈ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਇਕ ਥੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਇਆਣੇ ॥
transliteration: ik thai paR bujhai sabh aape ik thai aape kare iaane ||
english: In one place, He teaches them to read and understand everything, while in another place, He Himself makes them ignorant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa a(n)dar mahal bulaae jaa aap terai man sache bhaane ||
english: Some, You summon to the Mansion of Your Presence within, when they are pleasing to Your Mind, O True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਜਾਣੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: jinaa aape guramukh de vadiaaee se jan sachee daragahi jaane ||11||
english: That Gurmukh, whom You have blessed with greatness - that humble being is known in Your True Court. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਰਦਾਨਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok maradaanaa 1 ||
english: Salok, Mardaanaa:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ ਕਾਮੁ ਮਦੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kal kalavaalee kaam mad manooaa peevanahaar ||
english: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the vessel, filled with the wine of sexual desire; the mind is the drunkard.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕਟੋਰੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਭਰੀ ਪੀਲਾਵਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: krodh katoree mohi bharee peelaavaa aha(n)kaar ||
english: Anger is the cup, filled with emotional attachment, and egotism is the server.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਜਲਸ ਕੂੜੇ ਲਬ ਕੀ ਪੀ ਪੀ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: majalas kooRe lab kee pee pee hoi khuaar ||
english: Drinking too much in the company of falsehood and greed, one is ruined.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਲਾਹਣਿ ਸਤੁ ਗੁੜੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: karanee laahan sat guR sach saraa kar saar ||
english: So let good deeds be your distillery, and Truth your molasses; in this way, make the most excellent wine of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਮੰਡੇ ਕਰਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਘਿਉ ਸਰਮੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gun ma(n)de kar seel ghiu saram maas aahaar ||
english: Make virtue your bread, good conduct the ghee, and modesty the meat to eat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਖਾਧੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh paaeeai naanakaa khaadhai jaahi bikaar ||1||
english: As Gurmukh, these are obtained, O Nanak; partaking of them, one's sins depart. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਦਾਨਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maradaanaa 1 ||
english: Mardaanaa:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਲਾਹਣਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਦੁ ਮਜਲਸ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa laahan aap mad majalas trisanaa dhaat ||
english: The human body is the vat, self-conceit is the wine, and desire is the company of drinking buddies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਕਟੋਰੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਭਰੀ ਪੀਲਾਏ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: manasaa katoree kooR bharee peelaae jamakaal ||
english: The cup of the mind's longing is overflowing with falsehood, and the Messenger of Death is the cup-bearer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਮਦਿ ਪੀਤੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਖਟੀਅਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: it mad peetai naanakaa bahute khateeahi bikaar ||
english: Drinking in this wine, O Nanak, one takes on countless sins and corruptions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁੜੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਮੰਡੇ ਭਉ ਮਾਸੁ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: giaan guR saalaah ma(n)de bhau maas aahaar ||
english: So make spiritual wisdom your molasses, the Praise of God your bread, and the Fear of God the meat you eat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak ihu bhojan sach hai sach naam aadhaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, this is the true food; let the True Name be your only Support. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਯਾਂ ਲਾਹਣਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kaa(n)yaa(n) laahan aap mad a(n)mrit tis kee dhaar ||
english: If the human body is the vat, and self-realization is the wine, then a stream of Ambrosial Nectar is produced.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲਾਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਲਿਵ ਕਟੋਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਰੀ ਪੀ ਪੀ ਕਟਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat siu melaap hoi liv katoree a(n)mrit bharee pee pee katahi bikaar ||3||
english: Meeting with the Society of the Saints, the cup of the Lord's Love is filled with this Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, one's corruptions and sins are wiped away. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬਾ ਆਪੇ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aape sur nar gan ga(n)dharabaa aape khat darasan kee baanee ||
english: He Himself is the angelic being, the heavenly herald, and the celestial singer. He Himself is the one who explains the six schools of philosophy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਵ ਸੰਕਰ ਮਹੇਸਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aape siv sa(n)kar mahesaa aape guramukh akath kahaanee ||
english: He Himself is Shiva, Shankara and Mahaysh; He Himself is the Gurmukh, who speaks the Unspoken Speech.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aape jogee aape bhogee aape sa(n)niaasee phirai bibaanee ||
english: He Himself is the Yogi, He Himself is the Sensual Enjoyer, and He Himself is the Sannyaasee, wandering through the wilderness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਆਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aapai naal gosat aap upadesai aape sughaR saroop siaanee ||
english: He discusses with Himself, and He teaches Himself; He Himself is discrete, graceful and wise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਚੋਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: aapanaa choj kar vekhai aape aape sabhanaa jeeaa kaa hai jaanee ||12||
english: Staging His own play, He Himself watches it; He Himself is the Knower of all beings. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ehaa sa(n)dhiaa paravaan hai jit har prabh meraa chit aavai ||
english: That evening prayer alone is acceptable, which brings the Lord God to my consciousness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har siu preet oopajai maaiaa mohu jalaavai ||
english: Love for the Lord wells up within me, and my attachment to Maya is burnt away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee dubidhaa marai manooaa asathir sa(n)dhiaa kare veechaar ||
english: By Guru's Grace, duality is conquered, and the mind becomes stable; I have made contemplative meditation my evening prayer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)dhiaa karai manamukhee jeeu na tikai mar ja(n)mai hoi khuaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukh may recite his evening prayers, but his mind is not centered on it; through birth and death, he is ruined. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: priu priu karatee sabh jag phiree meree piaas na jaai ||
english: I wandered over the whole world, crying out, "Love, O Love!", but my thirst was not quenched.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਗਈ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak satigur miliai meree piaas gaee pir paaiaa ghar aai ||2||
english: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, my desires are satisfied; I found my Beloved, when I returned to my own home. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤੰਤੁ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape ta(n)t param ta(n)t sabh aape aape thaakur daas bhaiaa ||
english: He Himself is the supreme essence, He Himself is the essence of all. He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the servant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਸ ਅਠ ਵਰਨ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape das ath varan upaaian aap braham aap raaj laiaa ||
english: He Himself created the people of the eighteen castes; God Himself acquired His domain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਛੋਡੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰੇ ਦਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape maare aape chhodai aape bakhase kare daiaa ||
english: He Himself kills, and He Himself redeems; He Himself, in His Kindness, forgives us. He is infallible

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਭੁਲੈ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਥਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aap abhul na bhulai kab hee sabh sach tapaavas sach thiaa ||
english: - He never errs; the justice of the True Lord is totally True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: aape jinaa bujhaae guramukh tin a(n)darahu doojaa bharam gaiaa ||13||
english: Those whom the Lord Himself instructs as Gurmukh - duality and doubt depart from within them. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤੈ ਤਨਿ ਉਡੈ ਖੇਹ ॥
transliteration: har naam na simarahi saadhasa(n)g tai tan udai kheh ||
english: That body, which does not remember the Lord's Name in meditation in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, shall be reduced to dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਿਟੁ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin keetee tisai na jaanaee naanak phit aloonee deh ||1||
english: Cursed and insipid is that body, O Nanak, which does not know the One who created it. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪੈ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: ghat vasahi charanaarabi(n)d rasanaa japai gupaal ||
english: Let the Lotus Feet of the Lord abide within your heart, and with your tongue, chant God's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਉ ਪਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak so prabh simareeai tis dehee kau paal ||2||
english: O Nanak, meditate in remembrance on God, and nurture this body. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aape athasath teerath karataa aap kare isanaan ||
english: The Creator Himself is the sixty-eight sacred places of pilgrimage; He Himself takes the cleansing bath in them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: aape sa(n)jam varatai svaamee aap japaaihi naam ||
english: He Himself practices austere self-discipline; the Lord Master Himself causes us to chant His Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਭਉ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aap daiaal hoi bhau kha(n)dan aap karai sabh daan ||
english: He Himself becomes merciful to us; the Destroyer of fear Himself gives in charity to all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jis no guramukh aap bujhaae so sad hee daragahi paae maan ||
english: One whom He has enlightened and made Gurmukh, ever obtains honor in His Court.

author: Guru Amardas
