gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: jis dee paij rakhai har suaamee so sachaa har jaan ||14||
english: One whose honor the Lord Master has preserved, comes to know the True Lord. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਜਗੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak bin satigur bhete jag a(n)dh hai a(n)dhe karam kamaai ||
english: O Nanak, without meeting the True Guru, the world is blind, and it does blind deeds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਵਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: sabadai siu chit na laavaee jit sukh vasai man aai ||
english: It does not focus its consciousness on the Word of the Shabad, which would bring peace to abide in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਾਮਸਿ ਲਗਾ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਲਤੁ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: taamas lagaa sadaa phirai ahinis jalat bihaai ||
english: Always afflicted with the dark passions of low energy, it wanders around, passing its days and nights burning.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||1||
english: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass; no one has any say in this. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰੀ ਏਹ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo phuramaaiaa kaaree eh karehu ||
english: The True Guru has commanded us to do this:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਮਾਲੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: guroo duaarai hoi kai saahib sa(n)maalehu ||
english: through the Guru's Gate, meditate on the Lord Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਕੇ ਛਉੜ ਕਟਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: saahib sadaa hajoor hai bharamai ke chhauR kat kai a(n)tar jot dharehu ||
english: The Lord Master is ever-present. He tears away the veil of doubt, and installs His Light within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਏਹੁ ਲਾਏਹੁ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam a(n)mrit hai daaroo ehu laaehu ||
english: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar - take this healing medicine!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur kaa bhaanaa chit rakhahu sa(n)jam sachaa nehu ||
english: Enshrine the Will of the True Guru in your consciousness, and make the True Lord's Love your self-discipline.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਸੀ ਅਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak aithai sukhai a(n)dar rakhasee agai har siu kel karehu ||2||
english: O Nanak, you shall be kept in peace here, and hereafter, you shall celebrate with the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਬਣਸਪਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape bhaar athaarah banasapat aape hee phal laae ||
english: He Himself is the vast variety of Nature, and He Himself makes it bear fruit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਲੀ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਸਿੰਚੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape maalee aap sabh si(n)chai aape hee muhi paae ||
english: He Himself is the Gardener, He Himself irrigates all the plants, and He Himself puts them in His mouth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa aape bhugataa aape dei divaae ||
english: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer; He Himself gives, and causes others to give.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਰਾਖਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape saahib aape hai raakhaa aape rahiaa samaae ||
english: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the Protector; He Himself is permeating and pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਏ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak vadiaaee aakhai har karate kee jis no til na tamaae ||15||
english: Servant Nanak speaks of the greatness of the Lord, the Creator, who has no greed at all. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਆਣਿਆ ਮਾਣਸੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: maanas bhariaa aaniaa maanas bhariaa aai ||
english: One person brings a full bottle, and another fills his cup.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਮਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਰਲੁ ਪਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jit peetai mat door hoi baral pavai vich aai ||
english: Drinking the wine, his intelligence departs, and madness enters his mind;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਪਰਾਇਆ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਖਸਮਹੁ ਧਕੇ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa paraaiaa na pachhaanaee khasamahu dhake khaai ||
english: he cannot distinguish between his own and others, and he is struck down by his Lord and Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jit peetai khasam visarai daragah milai sajaai ||
english: Drinking it, he forgets his Lord and Master, and he is punished in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਮਦੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪੀਚਈ ਜੇ ਕਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jhoothaa mad mool na peechaee je kaa paar vasaai ||
english: Do not drink the false wine at all, if it is in your power.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree sach mad paaeeai satigur milai jis aai ||
english: O Nanak, the True Guru comes and meets the mortal; by His Grace, one obtains the True Wine.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa saahib kai ra(n)g rahai mahalee paavai thaau ||1||
english: He shall dwell forever in the Love of the Lord Master, and obtain a seat in the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਜਾ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu jagat jeevat marai jaa is no sojhee hoi ||
english: When this world comes to understand, it remains dead while yet alive.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਨੑਿ ਸਵਾਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਸਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਾਏ ਤਾਂ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa tinhi savaaliaa taa(n) sav rahiaa jagaae taa(n) sudh hoi ||
english: When the Lord puts him to sleep, he remains asleep; when He wakes him up, he regains consciousness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak nadar kare je aapanee satigur melai soi ||
english: O Nanak, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, He causes him to meet the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur prasaad jeevat marai taa phir maran na hoi ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, remain dead while yet alive, and you shall not have to die again. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jis daa keetaa sabh kichh hovai tis no paravaah naahee kisai keree ||
english: By His doing, everything happens; what does He care for anyone else?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਖਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਕਢੈ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu teraa ditaa sabh ko khaavai sabh muhataajee kadhai teree ||
english: O Dear Lord, everyone eats whatever You give - all are subservient to You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਤੁਧ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: j tudh no saalaahe s sabh kichh paavai jis no kirapaa nira(n)jan keree ||
english: One who praises You obtains everything; You bestow Your Mercy upon him, O Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: soee saahu sachaa vanajaaraa jin vakhar ladiaa har naam dhan teree ||
english: He alone is a true banker and trader, who loads the merchandise of the wealth of the Your Name, O Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੂਜੇ ਭਾਵ ਕੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਰੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: sabh tisai no saalaahihu sa(n)tahu jin dooje bhaav kee maar vidaaree dheree ||16||
english: O Saints, let everyone praise the Lord, who has destroyed the pile of the love of duality. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਮਰਤਾ ਮਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਮਰਿ ਭਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeeraa marataa marataa jag muaa mar bh na jaanai koi ||
english: Kabeer, the world is dying - dying to death, but no one knows how to truly die.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਮਰਨੀ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aisee maranee jo marai bahur na maranaa hoi ||1||
english: Whoever dies, let him die such a death, that he does not have to die again. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਵ ਮਰਹਗੇ ਕੈਸਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kiaa jaanaa kiv marahage kaisaa maranaa hoi ||
english: What do I know? How will I die? What sort of death will it be?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: je kar saahib manahu na veesarai taa sahilaa maranaa hoi ||
english: If I do not forget the Lord Master from my mind, then my death will be easy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੈ ਤੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਡਰੈ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਲੋੜੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: maranai te jagat darai jeeviaa loRai sabh koi ||
english: The world is terrified of death; everyone longs to live.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee jeevat marai hukamai boojhai soi ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one who dies while yet alive, understands the Lord's Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸੀ ਮਰਨੀ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak aisee maranee jo marai taa sad jeevan hoi ||2||
english: O Nanak, one who dies such a death, lives forever. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਆਪਣਾਂ ਨਾਉ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa aap kripaal hovai har suaamee taa aapanaa(n) naau har aap japaavai ||
english: When the Lord Master Himself becomes merciful, the Lord Himself causes His Name to be chanted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਣਾਂ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aape satigur mel sukh devai aapanaa(n) sevak aap har bhaavai ||
english: He Himself causes us to meet the True Guru, and blesses us with peace. His servant is pleasing to the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਣਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aapaniaa sevakaa kee aap paij rakhai aapaniaa bhagataa kee pairee paavai ||
english: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; He causes others to fall at the feet of His devotees.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dharam raai hai har kaa keeaa har jan sevak neR na aavai ||
english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is a creation of the Lord; he does not approach the humble servant of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: jo har kaa piaaraa so sabhanaa kaa piaaraa hor ketee jhakh jhakh aavai jaavai ||17||
english: One who is dear to the Lord, is dear to all; so many others come and go in vain. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raam raam karataa sabh jag phirai raam na paaiaa jaai ||
english: The entire world roams around, chanting, "Raam, Raam, Lord, Lord", but the Lord cannot be obtained like this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar at vadaa atul na tuliaa jaai ||
english: He is inaccessible, unfathomable and so very great; He is unweighable, and cannot be weighed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: keemat kinai na paaeeaa kitai na laiaa jaai ||
english: No one can evaluate Him; He cannot be purchased at any price.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿਆ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad bhediaa in bidh vasiaa man aai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, His mystery is known; in this way, He comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਅਮੇਉ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak aap ameu hai gur kirapaa te rahiaa samaai ||
english: O Nanak, He Himself is infinite; by Guru's Grace, He is known to be permeating and pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape miliaa mil rahiaa aape miliaa aai ||1||
english: He Himself comes to blend, and having blended, remains blended. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: e man ihu dhan naam hai jit sadaa sadaa sukh hoi ||
english: O my soul, this is the wealth of the Naam; through it, comes peace, forever and ever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: totaa mool na aavaee laahaa sad hee hoi ||
english: It never brings any loss; through it, one earns profits forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਾਧੈ ਖਰਚਿਐ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਓਹੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: khaadhai kharachiai tot na aavaee sadaa sadaa ohu dei ||
english: Eating and spending it, it never decreases; He continues to give, forever and ever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਾਣਤ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sahasaa mool na hovaee haanat kade na hoi ||
english: One who has no skepticism at all never suffers humiliation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh paaeeai jaa kau nadar karei ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains the Name of the Lord, when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਅੰਦਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aape sabh ghat a(n)dare aape hee baahar ||
english: He Himself is deep within all hearts, and He Himself is outside them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aape gupat varatadaa aape hee jaahar ||
english: He Himself is prevailing unmanifest, and He Himself is manifest.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਛਤੀਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਸੁੰਨਾਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jug chhateeh gubaar kar varatiaa su(n)naahar ||
english: For thirty-six ages, He created the darkness, abiding in the void.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਨ ਸਾਸਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਰਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: othai ved puraan na saasataa aape har narahar ||
english: There were no Vedas, Puraanas or Shaastras there; only the Lord Himself existed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੈਠਾ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਹੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: baithaa taaRee laai aap sabh doo hee baahar ||
english: He Himself sat in the absolute trance, withdrawn from everything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਗਉਹਰੁ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: aapanee mit aap jaanadaa aape hee gauhar ||18||
english: Only He Himself knows His state; He Himself is the unfathomable ocean. ||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੁਆ ਮਰਦੋ ਮਰਦਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai vich jagat muaa marado maradaa jaai ||
english: In egotism, the world is dead; it dies and dies, again and again.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਕਿ ਕਰੇਗੁ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jichar vich da(n)m hai tichar na chetaee k kareg agai jaai ||
english: As long as there is breath in the body, he does not remember the Lord; what will he do in the world hereafter?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਚੇਤੰਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: giaanee hoi s cheta(n)n hoi agiaanee a(n)dh kamaai ||
english: One who remembers the Lord is a spiritual teacher; the ignorant one acts blindly.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਥੈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਗੈ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ethai kamaavai so milai agai paae jaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, whatever one does in this world, determines what he shall receive in the world hereafter. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhur khasamai kaa hukam paiaa vin satigur chetiaa na jaai ||
english: From the very beginning, it has been the Will of the Lord Master, that He cannot be remembered without the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai a(n)tar rav rahiaa sadaa rahiaa liv laai ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, he realizes that the Lord is permeating and pervading deep within him; he remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਮਿ ਦਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਦਾ ਦੰਮੁ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dam dam sadaa samaaladaa da(n)m na birathaa jaai ||
english: With each and every breath, he constantly remembers the Lord in meditation; not a single breath passes in vain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: janam maran kaa bhau gaiaa jeevan padavee paai ||
english: His fears of birth and death depart, and he obtains the honored state of eternal life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਰਤਬਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak ihu maratabaa tis no dei jis no kirapaa kare rajaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, He bestows this rank upon that mortal, upon whom He showers His Mercy. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾਂ ਬੀਨਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਧਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: aape daanaa(n) beeniaa aape paradhaanaa(n) ||
english: He Himself is all-wise and all-knowing; He Himself is supreme.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਲਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: aape roop dikhaaladaa aape laai dhiaanaa(n) ||
english: He Himself reveals His form, and He Himself enjoins us to His meditation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੋਨੀ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਥੈ ਗਿਆਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: aape monee varatadaa aape kathai giaanaa(n) ||
english: He Himself poses as a silent sage, and He Himself speaks spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਉੜਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਸਭਨਾ ਹੀ ਭਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kauRaa kisai na lagaee sabhanaa hee bhaanaa ||
english: He does not seem bitter to anyone; He is pleasing to all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: usatat baran na sakeeai sad sad kurabaanaa ||19||
english: His Praises cannot be described; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||19||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿੰਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kalee a(n)dar naanakaa ji(n)naa(n) daa autaar ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Nanak, the demons have taken birth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤੁ ਜਿਨੂਰਾ ਧੀਅ ਜਿੰਨੂਰੀ ਜੋਰੂ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਦਾ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: put jinooraa dhee ji(n)nooree joroo ji(n)naa daa sikadaar ||1||
english: The son is a demon, and the daughter is a demon; the wife is the chief of the demons. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੂਲੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਅਖੁਟੀ ਜਾਂਹੀ ॥
transliteration: hi(n)doo moole bhoole akhutee jaa(n)hee ||
english: The Hindus have forgotten the Primal Lord; they are going the wrong way.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਂਹੀ ॥
transliteration: naarad kahiaa s pooj karaa(n)hee ||
english: As Naarad instructed them, they are worshipping idols.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਗੁੰਗੇ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe gu(n)ge a(n)dh a(n)dhaar ||
english: They are blind and mute, the blindest of the blind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਥਰੁ ਲੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: paathar le poojahi mugadh gavaar ||
english: The ignorant fools pick up stones and worship them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਹਿ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਤੁਮ ਕਹਾ ਤਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ohi jaa aap dube tum kahaa taranahaar ||2||
english: But when those stones themselves sink, who will carry you across? ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh kihu terai vas hai too sachaa saahu ||
english: Everything is in Your power; You are the True King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: bhagat rate ra(n)g ek kai pooraa vesaahu ||
english: The devotees are imbued with the Love of the One Lord; they have perfect faith in Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਜਿ ਰਜਿ ਜਨ ਖਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit bhojan naam har raj raj jan khaahu ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the ambrosial food; His humble servants eat their fill.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh padaarath paaeean simaran sach laahu ||
english: All treasures are obtained - meditative remembrance on the Lord is the true profit.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹੁ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: sa(n)t piaare paarabraham naanak har agam agaahu ||20||
english: The Saints are very dear to the Supreme Lord God, O Nanak; the Lord is unapproachable and unfathomable. ||20||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh hukame aavadaa sabh kichh hukame jaai ||
english: Everything comes by the Lord's Will, and everything goes by the Lord's Will.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je ko moorakh aapahu jaanai a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamaai ||
english: If some fool believes that he is the creator, he is blind, and acts in blindness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak hukam ko guramukh bujhai jis no kirapaa kare rajaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command; the Lord showers His Mercy upon him. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: so jogee jugat so paae jis no guramukh naam paraapat hoi ||
english: He alone is a Yogi, and he alone finds the Way, who, as Gurmukh, obtains the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਕੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਸੈ ਭੇਖੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis jogee kee nagaree sabh ko vasai bhekhee jog na hoi ||
english: In the body-village of that Yogi are all blessings; this Yoga is not obtained by outward show.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak aisaa viralaa ko jogee jis ghat paragat hoi ||2||
english: O Nanak, such a Yogi is very rare; the Lord is manifest in his heart. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape ja(n)t upaaian aape aadhaar ||
english: He Himself created the creatures, and He Himself supports them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੂਖਮੁ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape sookham bhaaleeai aape paasaar ||
english: He Himself is seen to be subtle, and He Himself is obvious.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਇਕਾਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aap ikaatee hoi rahai aape vad paravaar ||
english: He Himself remains a solitary recluse, and He Himself has a huge family.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਰੇਨਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak ma(n)gai daan har sa(n)taa renaar ||
english: Nanak asks for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
transliteration: hor daataar na sujhaee too devanahaar ||21||1|| sudh ||
english: I cannot see any other Giver; You alone are the Giver, O Lord. ||21||1|| Sudh||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Wadahans, First Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮਲੀ ਅਮਲੁ ਨ ਅੰਬੜੈ ਮਛੀ ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: amalee amal na a(n)baRai machhee neer na hoi ||
english: To the addict, there is nothing like the drug; to the fish, there is nothing else like water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਸਹਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਤਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo rate sahi aapanai tin bhaavai sabh koi ||1||
english: Those who are attuned to their Lord - everyone is pleasing to them. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾ ਤਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੇ ਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree va(n)njaa kha(n)neeai va(n)njaa tau saahib ke naavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice, cut apart into pieces, a sacrifice to Your Name, O Lord Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਰੁਖੜਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saahib saphalio rukhaRaa a(n)mrit jaa kaa naau ||
english: The Lord is the fruitful tree; His Name is ambrosial nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤ ਭਏ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin peeaa te tripat bhae hau tin balihaarai jaau ||2||
english: Those who drink it in are satisfied; I am a sacrifice to them. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਹਭੀਆਂ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: mai kee nadar na aavahee vasahi habheeaa(n) naal ||
english: You are not visible to me, although You dwell with everyone.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਖਾ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਲਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਰ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tikhaa tihaaiaa kiu lahai jaa sar bheetar paal ||3||
english: How can the thirst of the thirsty be quenched, with that wall between me and the pond? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਾਣੀਆ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak teraa baaneeaa too saahib mai raas ||
english: Nanak is Your merchant; You, O Lord Master, are my merchandise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਧੋਖਾ ਤਾ ਲਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: man te dhokhaa taa lahai jaa siphat karee aradaas ||4||1||
english: My mind is cleansed of doubt, only when I praise You, and pray to You. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 ||
english: Wadahans, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਕੂਕੇ ਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gunava(n)tee sahu raaviaa niragun kooke kaai ||
english: The virtuous bride enjoys her Husband Lord; why does the unworthy one cry out?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਥੀ ਰਹੈ ਤਾ ਭੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਣ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: je gunava(n)tee thee rahai taa bhee sahu raavan jaai ||1||
english: If she were to become virtuous, then she too could enjoy her Husband Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਕੀ ਧਨ ਅਵਰਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: meraa ka(n)t reesaaloo kee dhan avaraa raave jee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My Husband Lord is loving and playful; why should the soul-bride enjoy anyone else? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਮਣ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਗਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: karanee kaaman je theeai je man dhaagaa hoi ||
english: If the soul-bride does good deeds, and strings them on the thread of her mind,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਕੁ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਲੀਜੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maanak mul na paaeeai leejai chit paroi ||2||
english: she obtains the jewel, which cannot be purchased for any price, strung upon the thread of her consciousness. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਹੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਨ ਜੁਲਾਂ ਆਖਾਂ ਅੰਮੜੀਆਸੁ ॥
transliteration: raahu dasaaee na julaa(n) aakhaa(n) a(n)maReeaas ||
english: I ask, but do not follow the way shown to me; still, I claim to have reached my destination.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਅਕੂਅਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਥੀਵੈ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tai sah naal akooanaa kiu theevai ghar vaas ||3||
english: I do not speak with You, O my Husband Lord; how then can I come to have a place in Your home? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak ekee baaharaa doojaa naahee koi ||
english: O Nanak, without the One Lord, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਲਗੀ ਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: tai sah lagee je rahai bhee sahu raavai soi ||4||2||
english: If the soul-bride remains attached to You, then she shall enjoy her Husband Lord. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
english: Wadahans, First Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਰੀ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣ ਲਾਇਆ ਭੈਣੇ ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: moree run jhun laaiaa bhaine saavan aaiaa ||
english: The peacocks are singing so sweetly, O sister; the rainy season of Saawan has come.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਮੁੰਧ ਕਟਾਰੇ ਜੇਵਡਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tere mu(n)dh kataare jevadaa tin lobhee lobh lubhaaiaa ||
english: Your beauteous eyes are like a string of charms, fascinating and enticing the soul-bride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੋ ॥
transliteration: tere darasan vitahu kha(n)neeai va(n)njaa tere naam vitahu kurabaano ||
english: I would cut myself into pieces for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; I am a sacrifice to Your Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਹੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੋ ॥
transliteration: jaa too taa mai maan keeaa hai tudh bin kehaa meraa maano ||
english: I take pride in You; without You, what could I be proud of?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੂੜਾ ਭੰਨੁ ਪਲੰਘ ਸਿਉ ਮੁੰਧੇ ਸਣੁ ਬਾਹੀ ਸਣੁ ਬਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: chooRaa bha(n)n pala(n)gh siu mu(n)dhe san baahee san baahaa ||
english: So smash your bracelets along with your bed, O soul-bride, and break your arms, along with the arms of your couch.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਦੀਏ ਮੁੰਧੇ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਤੋ ਅਵਰਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: ete ves karedeee mu(n)dhe sahu raato avaraahaa ||
english: In spite of all the decorations which you have made, O soul-bride, your Husband Lord is enjoying someone else.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮਨੀਆਰੁ ਨ ਚੂੜੀਆ ਨਾ ਸੇ ਵੰਗੁੜੀਆਹਾ ॥
transliteration: naa maneeaar na chooReeaa naa se va(n)guReeaahaa ||
english: You don't have the bracelets of gold, nor the good crystal jewelry; you haven't dealt with the true jeweller.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਹ ਕੰਠਿ ਨ ਲਗੀਆ ਜਲਨੁ ਸਿ ਬਾਹੜੀਆਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jo sah ka(n)th na lageeaa jalan s baahaReeaahaa ||
english: Those arms, which do not embrace the neck of the Husband Lord, burn in anguish.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸਹੀਆ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਗਈਆ ਹਉ ਦਾਧੀ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh saheeaa sahu raavan gaeeaa hau daadhee kai dar jaavaa ||
english: All my companions have gone to enjoy their Husband Lord; which door should I, the wretched one, go to?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਹਉ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਚਜੀ ਤੈ ਸਹ ਏਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)maalee hau kharee suchajee tai sah ek na bhaavaa ||
english: O friend, I may look very attractive, but I am not pleasing to my Husband Lord at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਠਿ ਗੁੰਦਾਈਁ ਪਟੀਆ ਭਰੀਐ ਮਾਗ ਸੰਧੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maath gu(n)daaee(n) pateeaa bhareeai maag sa(n)dhoore ||
english: I have woven my hair into lovely braids, and saturated their partings with vermillion;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਗਈ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਆ ਮਰਉ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: agai gaee na ma(n)neeaa marau visoor visoore ||
english: but when I go before Him, I am not accepted, and I die, suffering in anguish.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਰੋਵੰਦੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਰੁਨਾ ਰੁੰਨੜੇ ਵਣਹੁ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ॥
transliteration: mai rova(n)dee sabh jag runaa ru(n)naRe vanahu pa(n)kheroo ||
english: I weep; the whole world weeps; even the birds of the forest weep with me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਨ ਰੁਨਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੋੜੀ ॥
transliteration: ik na runaa mere tan kaa birahaa jin hau pirahu vichhoRee ||
english: The only thing which doesn't weep is my body's sense of separateness, which has separated me from my Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਆਇਆ ਭੀ ਗਇਆ ਮੈ ਜਲੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: supanai aaiaa bhee gaiaa mai jal bhariaa roi ||
english: In a dream, He came, and went away again; I cried so many tears.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਤੁਝ ਕਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭੇਜਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aai na sakaa tujh kan piaare bhej na sakaa koi ||
english: I can't come to You, O my Beloved, and I can't send anyone to You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਸਭਾਗੀ ਨੀਦੜੀਏ ਮਤੁ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aau sabhaagee needaReee mat sahu dekhaa soi ||
english: Come to me, O blessed sleep - perhaps I will see my Husband Lord again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਜਿ ਆਖੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: tai saahib kee baat j aakhai kahu naanak kiaa deejai ||
english: One who brings me a message from my Lord and Master - says Nanak, what shall I give to Him?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੀਸੁ ਵਢੇ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਰ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: sees vadhe kar baisan deejai vin sir sev kareejai ||
english: Cutting off my head, I give it to Him to sit upon; without my head, I shall still serve Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਮਰੀਜੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਭਇਆ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: kiu na mareejai jeeaRaa na deejai jaa sahu bhaiaa vidaanaa ||1||3||
english: Why haven't I died? Why hasn't my life just ended? My Husband Lord has become a stranger to me. ||1||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਤਨਿ ਧੋਤੈ ਮਨੁ ਹਛਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man mailai sabh kichh mailaa tan dhotai man hachhaa na hoi ||
english: When the mind is filthy, everything is filthy; by washing the body, the mind is not cleaned.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ih jagat bharam bhulaaiaa viralaa boojhai koi ||1||
english: This world is deluded by doubt; how rare are those who understand this. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jap man mere too eko naam ||
english: O my mind, chant the One Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satagur deeaa mo kau ehu nidhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru has given me this treasure. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧਾ ਕੇ ਆਸਣ ਜੇ ਸਿਖੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sidhaa ke aasan je sikhai i(n)dree vas kar kamaai ||
english: Even if one learns the Yogic postures of the Siddhas, and holds his sexual energy in check,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man kee mail na utarai haumai mail na jaai ||2||
english: still, the filth of the mind is not removed, and the filth of egotism is not eliminated. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਰੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: is man kau hor sa(n)jam ko naahee vin satigur kee saranaai ||
english: This mind is not controlled by any other discipline, except the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਉਲਟੀ ਭਈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satagur miliai ulatee bhaee kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||3||
english: Meeting the True Guru, one is transformed beyond description. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਦੋ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak satigur kau milado marai gur kai sabad phir jeevai koi ||
english: Prays Nanak, one who dies upon meeting the True Guru, shall be rejuvenated through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਛਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: mamataa kee mal utarai ihu man hachhaa hoi ||4||1||
english: The filth of his attachment and possessiveness shall depart, and his mind shall become pure. ||4||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: nadaree satagur seveeai nadaree sevaa hoi ||
english: By His Grace, one serves the True Guru; by His Grace, service is performed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nadaree ihu man vas aavai nadaree man niramal hoi ||1||
english: By His grace, this mind is controlled, and by His Grace, it becomes pure. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਚੇਤਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man chet sachaa soi ||
english: O my mind, think of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: eko chetahi taa sukh paavahi phir dookh na moole hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Think of the One Lord, and you shall obtain peace; you shall never suffer in sorrow again. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਮਰਿ ਕੈ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: nadaree mar kai jeeveeai nadaree sabad vasai man aai ||
english: By His Grace, one dies while yet alive, and by His Grace, the Word of the Shabad is enshrined in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nadaree hukam bujheeai hukame rahai samaai ||2||
english: By His Grace, one understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and by His Command, one merges into the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਖਿਓ ਸਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin jihavaa har ras na chakhio saa jihavaa jal jaau ||
english: That tongue, which does not savor the sublime essence of the Lord - may that tongue be burned off!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੇ ਲਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: an ras saade lag rahee dukh paaiaa doojai bhaai ||3||
english: It remains attached to other pleasures, and through the love of duality, it suffers in pain. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਏਕ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਫਰਕੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa nadar ek hai aape pharak karei ||
english: The One Lord grants His Grace to all; He Himself makes distinctions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak satagur miliai phal paaiaa naam vadaaee dei ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, the fruits are obtained, and one is blessed with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam. ||4||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu gubaar hai gur bin giaan na hoee ||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya is darkness; without the Guru, there is no wisdom.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਰਜ ਵਿਗੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabad lage tin bujhiaa doojai paraj vigoee ||1||
english: Those who are attached to the Word of the Shabad understand; duality has ruined the people. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man mere guramat karanee saar ||
english: O my mind, under Guru's Instruction, do good deeds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa har prabh ravahi taa paavahi mokh duaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Dwell forever and ever upon the Lord God, and you shall find the gate of salvation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gunaa kaa nidhaan ek hai aape dei taa ko paae ||
english: The Lord alone is the treasure of virtue; He Himself gives, and then one receives.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin naavai sabh vichhuRee gur kai sabad milaae ||2||
english: Without the Name, all are separated from the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one meets the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਘਟਿ ਗਏ ਤਿਨਾ ਹਥਿ ਕਿਹੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: meree meree karade ghat gae tinaa hath kihu na aaiaa ||
english: Acting in ego, they lose, and nothing comes into their hands.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satagur miliai sach mile sach naam samaaiaa ||3||
english: Meeting the True Guru, they find Truth, and merge into the True Name. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa ehu sareer hai a(n)tar jot jagaae ||
english: Hope and desire abide in this body, but the Lord's Light shines within as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak manamukh ba(n)dh hai guramukh mukat karaae ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs remain in bondage; the Gurmukhs are liberated. ||4||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sohaaganee sadaa mukh ujalaa gur kai sahaj subhaai ||
english: The faces of the happy soul-brides are radiant forever; through the Guru, they are peacefully poised.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa pir raavahi aapanaa vichahu aap gavaai ||1||
english: They enjoy their Husband Lord constantly, eradicating their ego from within. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man too har har naam dhiaai ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satagur mo kau har deeaa bujhaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru has led me to understand the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਖਰੀਆ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dohaaganee khareeaa bilalaadeeaa tinaa mahal na paai ||
english: The abandoned brides cry out in their suffering; they do not attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰੂਪੀ ਦੂਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai karoopee dookh paavahi aagai jaai ||2||
english: In the love of duality, they appear so ugly; they suffer in pain as they go to the world beyond. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਨਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gunava(n)tee nit gun ravai hiradai naam vasaai ||
english: The virtuous soul-bride constantly chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord; she enshrines the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within her heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: auganava(n)tee kaamanee dukh laagai bilalaai ||3||
english: The unvirtuous woman suffers, and cries out in pain. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa kaa bhataar ek hai suaamee kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||
english: The One Lord and Master is the Husband Lord of all; His Praises cannot be expressed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਕ ਕੀਤਿਅਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak aape vek keetian naame laian laai ||4||4||
english: O Nanak, He has separated some from Himself, while others are to His Name. ||4||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam sad meethaa laagaa gurasabadee saad aaiaa ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam is always sweet to me; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I come to taste it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sachee baanee sahaj samaanee har jeeu man vasaaiaa ||1||
english: Through the True Word of the Guru's Bani, I am merged in peace and poise; the Dear Lord is enshrined in the mind. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har kar kirapaa sataguroo milaaiaa ||
english: The Lord, showing His Mercy, has caused me to meet the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poorai satagur har naam dhiaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Perfect True Guru, I meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: brahamai bed baanee paragaasee maaiaa moh pasaaraa ||
english: Through Brahma, the hymns of the Vedas were revealed, but the love of Maya spread.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mahaadeu giaanee varatai ghar aapanai taamas bahut aha(n)kaaraa ||2||
english: The wise one, Shiva, remains absorbed in himself, but he is engrossed in dark passions and excessive egotism. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ਰੂਧਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kisan sadaa avataaree roodhaa kit lag tarai sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Vishnu is always busy reincarnating himself - who will save the world?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh giaan rate jug a(n)tar chookai moh gubaaraa ||3||
english: The Gurmukhs are imbued with spiritual wisdom in this age; they are rid of the darkness of emotional attachment. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: satagur sevaa te nisataaraa guramukh tarai sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Serving the True Guru, one is emancipated; the Gurmukh crosses over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: saachai naai rate bairaagee paain mokh duaaraa ||4||
english: The detached renunciates are imbued with the True Name; they attain the gate of salvation. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: eko sach varatai sabh a(n)tar sabhanaa kare pratipaalaa ||
english: The One True Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere; He cherishes everyone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਦੀਵਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੫॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak ikas bin mai avar na jaanaa sabhanaa deevaan daiaalaa ||5||5||
english: O Nanak, without the One Lord, I do not know any other; He is the Merciful Master of all. ||5||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sach sa(n)jam tat giaan ||
english: The Gurmukh practices true self-discipline, and attains the essence of wisdom.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਲਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh saache lagai dhiaan ||1||
english: The Gurmukh meditates on the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh man mere naam samaal ||
english: As Gurmukh, O my mind, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa nibahai chalai terai naal || rahaau ||
english: It shall stand by you always, and go with you. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jaat pat sach soi ||
english: The True Lord is the social status and honor of the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh a(n)tar sakhaaee prabh hoi ||2||
english: Within the Gurmukh, is God, his friend and helper. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jis no aap kare so hoi ||
english: He alone becomes Gurmukh, whom the Lord so blesses.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh aap vadaaee devai soi ||3||
english: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with greatness. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sabad sach karanee saar ||
english: The Gurmukh lives the True Word of the Shabad, and practices good deeds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: guramukh naanak paravaarai saadhaar ||4||6||
english: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, emancipates his family and relations. ||4||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦਿ ਲਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa har saad lagee sahaj subhaai ||
english: My tongue is intuitively attracted to the taste of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man tripatiaa har naam dhiaai ||1||
english: My mind is satisfied, meditating on the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sukh saachai sabad veechaaree ||
english: Lasting peace is obtained, contemplating the Shabad, the True Word of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aapane satagur vitahu sadaa balihaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: akhee sa(n)tokheeaa ek liv laai ||
english: My eyes are content, lovingly focused on the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man sa(n)tokhiaa doojaa bhaau gavaai ||2||
english: My mind is content, having forsaken the love of duality. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: deh sareer sukh hovai sabad har naai ||
english: The frame of my body is at peace, through the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam paramal hiradai rahiaa samaai ||3||
english: The fragrance of the Naam permeates my heart. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak masatak jis vadabhaag ||
english: O Nanak, one who has such great destiny written upon his forehead,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: gur kee baanee sahaj bairaag ||4||7||
english: through the Bani of the Guru's Word, easily and intuitively becomes free of desire. ||4||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: poore gur te naam paaiaa jaai ||
english: From the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sachai sabad sach samaai ||1||
english: Through the Shabad, the True Word of God, one merges in the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤੂ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: e man naam nidhaan too paai ||
english: O my soul, obtain the treasure of the Naam,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aapane gur kee ma(n)n lai rajaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: by submitting to the Will of your Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad vichahu mail gavaai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, filth is washed away from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: niramal naam vasai man aai ||2||
english: The Immaculate Naam comes to abide within the mind. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bharame bhoolaa phirai sa(n)saar ||
english: Deluded by doubt, the world wanders around.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mar janamai jam kare khuaar ||3||
english: It dies, and is born again, and is ruined by the Messenger of Death. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak se vadabhaagee jin har naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: O Nanak, very fortunate are those who meditate on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||4||8||
english: By Guru's Grace, they enshrine the Name within their minds. ||4||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਇ ਨ ਵਸਹਿ ਇਕ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai naavai naal virodh hai dui na vasahi ik thaai ||
english: Ego is opposed to the Name of the Lord; the two do not dwell in the same place.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haumai vich sevaa na hovaee taa man birathaa jaai ||1||
english: In egotism, selfless service cannot be performed, and so the soul goes unfulfilled. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har chet man mere too gur kaa sabad kamaai ||
english: O my mind, think of the Lord, and practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hukam ma(n)nahi taa har milai taa vichahu haumai jaai || rahaau ||
english: If you submit to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then you shall meet with the Lord; only then will your ego depart from within. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai sabh sareer hai haumai opat hoi ||
english: Egotism is within all bodies; through egotism, we come to be born.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: haumai vadaa gubaar hai haumai vich bujh na sakai koi ||2||
english: Egotism is total darkness; in egotism, no one can understand anything. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai vich bhagat na hovaee hukam na bujhiaa jaai ||
english: In egotism, devotional worship cannot be performed, and the Hukam of the Lord's Command cannot be understood.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਉ ਬੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: haumai vich jeeu ba(n)dh hai naam na vasai man aai ||3||
english: In egotism, the soul is in bondage, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not come to abide in the mind. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak satagur miliai haumai gaee taa sach vasiaa man aai ||
english: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, egotism is eliminated, and then, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੨॥
transliteration: sach kamaavai sach rahai sache sev samaai ||4||9||12||
english: One starts practicing truth, abides in truth and by serving the True One gets absorbed in Him. ||4||9||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sej ek eko prabh thaakur ||
english: There is one bed, and One Lord God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh har raave sukh saagar ||1||
english: The Gurmukh enjoys the Lord, the ocean of peace. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਣ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: mai prabh milan prem man aasaa ||
english: My mind longs to meet my Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਲਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਜਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa melaavai meraa preetam hau vaar vaar aapane guroo kau jaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru leads me to meet my Beloved; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅਵਗਣ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਰੀਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mai avagan bharapoor sareere ||
english: My body is over-flowing with corruption;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਾ ਅਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hau kiu kar milaa apane preetam poore ||2||
english: how can I meet my Perfect Beloved? ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin gunava(n)tee meraa preetam paaiaa ||
english: The virtuous ones obtain my Beloved;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: se mai gun naahee hau kiu milaa meree maaiaa ||3||
english: I do not have these virtues. How can I meet Him, O my mother? ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕਾ ਉਪਾਵ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hau kar kar thaakaa upaav bahutere ||
english: I am so tired of making all these efforts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਰੀਬ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak gareeb raakhahu har mere ||4||1||
english: Please protect Nanak, the meek one, O my Lord. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 4 ||
english: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਮੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: meraa har prabh su(n)dar mai saar na jaanee ||
english: My Lord God is so beautiful. I do not know His worth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hau har prabh chhod doojai lobhaanee ||1||
english: Abandoning my Lord God, I have become entangled in duality. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਉ ਇਆਣੀ ॥
transliteration: hau kiu kar pir kau milau iaanee ||
english: How can I meet with my Husband? I don't know.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਈ ਪਿਰ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਿਆਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo pir bhaavai saa sohaagan saaee pir kau milai siaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: She who pleases her Husband Lord is a happy soul-bride. She meets with her Husband Lord - she is so wise. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੋਸ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: mai vich dos hau kiu kar pir paavaa ||
english: I am filled with faults; how can I attain my Husband Lord?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਪਿਰ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tere anek piaare hau pir chit na aavaa ||2||
english: You have many loves, but I am not in Your thoughts, O my Husband Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ॥
transliteration: jin pir raaviaa saa bhalee suhaagan ||
english: She who enjoys her Husband Lord, is the good soul-bride.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੀ ਦੁਹਾਗਣਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: se mai gun naahee hau kiaa karee duhaagan ||3||
english: I don't have these virtues; what can I, the discarded bride, do? ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nit suhaagan sadaa pir raavai ||
english: The soul-bride continually, constantly enjoys her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: mai karamaheen kab hee gal laavai ||4||
english: I have no good fortune; will He ever hold me close in His embrace? ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪਿਰੁ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਾ ਹਉ ਅਉਗੁਣਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too pir gunava(n)taa hau auguniaaraa ||
english: You, O Husband Lord, are meritorious, while I am without merit.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਬਖਸਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥੫॥੨॥
transliteration: mai niragun bakhas naanak vechaaraa ||5||2||
english: I am worthless; please forgive Nanak, the meek. ||5||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
english: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਡੀ ਆਸ ਹਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: mai man vadee aas hare kiu kar har darasan paavaa ||
english: Within my mind there is such a great yearning; how will I attain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਾ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਤਗੁਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਸਮਝਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: hau jaai puchhaa apane satagurai gur puchh man mugadh samajhaavaa ||
english: I go and ask my True Guru; with the Guru's advice, I shall teach my foolish mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: bhoolaa man samajhai gurasabadee har har sadaa dhiaae ||
english: The foolish mind is instructed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and meditates forever on the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jis nadar kare meraa piaaraa so har charanee chit laae ||1||
english: O Nanak, one who is blessed with the Mercy of my Beloved, focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸਭਿ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: hau sabh ves karee pir kaaran je har prabh saache bhaavaa ||
english: I dress myself in all sorts of robes for my Husband, so that my True Lord God will be pleased.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: so pir piaaraa mai nadar na dekhai hau kiu kar dheeraj paavaa ||
english: But my Beloved Husband Lord does not even cast a glance in my direction; how can I be consoled?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਹਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਵਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis kaaran hau seegaar seegaaree so pir rataa meraa avaraa ||
english: For His sake, I adorn myself with adornments, but my Husband is imbued with the love of another.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਅੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak dhan dha(n)n dha(n)n sohaagan jin pir raaviaRaa sach savaraa ||2||
english: O Nanak, blessed, blessed, blessed is that soul-bride, who enjoys her True, Sublime Husband Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਾ ਸੋਹਾਗ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਤੁਸੀ ਕਿਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hau jaai puchhaa sohaag suhaagan tusee kiu pir paaiaRaa prabh meraa ||
english: I go and ask the fortunate, happy soul-bride, "How did you attain Him - your Husband Lord, my God?"

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਮੈ ਛੋਡਿਅੜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mai oopar nadar karee pir saachai mai chhodiaRaa meraa teraa ||
english: She answers, "My True Husband blessed me with His Mercy; I abandoned the distinction between mine and yours.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਇਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਭੈਣੇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sabh man tan jeeu karahu har prabh kaa it maarag bhaine mileeai ||
english: Dedicate everything, mind, body and soul, to the Lord God; this is the Path to meet Him, O sister."

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਰਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aapanaRaa prabh nadar kar dekhai naanak jot jotee raleeai ||3||
english: If her God gazes upon her with favor, O Nanak, her light merges into the Light. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਮੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਨੇਹਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jo har prabh kaa mai dei sanehaa tis man tan apanaa devaa ||
english: I dedicate my mind and body to the one who brings me a message from my Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਢੋਵਾਂ ॥
transliteration: nit pakhaa pheree sev kamaavaa tis aagai paanee dhovaa(n) ||
english: I wave the fan over him every day, serve him and carry water for him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nit nit sev karee har jan kee jo har har kathaa sunaae ||
english: Constantly and continuously, I serve the Lord's humble servant, who recites to me the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n guroo gur satigur pooraa naanak man aas pujaae ||4||
english: Hail, hail unto the Guru, the Guru, the Perfect True Guru, who fulfills Nanak's heart's desires. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਾ ॥
transliteration: gur sajan meraa mel hare jit mil har naam dhiaavaa ||
english: O Lord, let me meet the Guru, my best friend; meeting Him, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਪੂਛਾਂ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਂ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur paasahu har gosat poochhaa(n) kar saa(n)jhee har gun gaavaa(n) ||
english: I seek the Lord's sermon from the Guru, the True Guru; joining with Him, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavaa nit nit sad har ke man jeevai naam sun teraa ||
english: Each and every day, forever, I sing the Lord's Praises; my mind lives by hearing Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਵੇਲੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak jit velaa visarai meraa suaamee tit velai mar jaai jeeu meraa ||5||
english: O Nanak, that moment when I forget my Lord and Master - at that moment, my soul dies. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੋਚੈ ਸੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: har vekhan kau sabh koee lochai so vekhai jis aap vikhaale ||
english: Everyone longs to see the Lord, but he alone sees Him, whom the Lord causes to see Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jis no nadar kare meraa piaaraa so har har sadaa samaale ||
english: One upon whom my Beloved bestows His Glance of Grace, cherishes the Lord, Har, Har forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: so har har naam sadaa sadaa samaale jis satagur pooraa meraa miliaa ||
english: He alone cherishes the Lord, Har, Har, forever and ever, who meets my Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿਆ ॥੬॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak har jan har ike hoe har jap har setee raliaa ||6||1||3||
english: O Nanak, the Lord's humble servant and the Lord become One; meditating on the Lord, he blends with the Lord. ||6||1||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
english: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: at oochaa taa kaa darabaaraa ||
english: His Darbaar, His Court, is the most lofty and exalted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t naahee kichh paaraavaaraa ||
english: It has no end or limitations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kot kot kot lakh dhaavai ||
english: Millions, millions, tens of millions seek,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ik til taa kaa mahal na paavai ||1||
english: but they cannot find even a tiny bit of His Mansion. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: suhaavee kaun s velaa jit prabh melaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: What is that auspicious moment, when God is met? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ॥
transliteration: laakh bhagat jaa kau aaraadhahi ||
english: Tens of thousands of devotees worship Him in adoration.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਤਪੀਸਰ ਤਪੁ ਹੀ ਸਾਧਹਿ ॥
transliteration: laakh tapeesar tap hee saadhahi ||
english: Tens of thousands of ascetics practice austere discipline.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਜੋਗੀਸਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਜੋਗਾ ॥
transliteration: laakh jogeesar karate jogaa ||
english: Tens of thousands of Yogis practice Yoga.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਭੋਗੀਸਰ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਭੋਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: laakh bhogeesar bhogahi bhogaa ||2||
english: Tens of thousands of pleasure seekers seek pleasure. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਥੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat vasahi jaanahi thoraa ||
english: He dwells in each and every heart, but only a few know this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਜਣੁ ਪਰਦਾ ਤੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hai koee saajan paradaa toraa ||
english: Is there any friend who can rip apart the screen of separation?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਜਤਨ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: karau jatan je hoi miharavaanaa ||
english: I can only make the effort, if the Lord is merciful to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੇਈ ਜੀਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa kau deee jeeu kurabaanaa ||3||
english: I sacrifice my body and soul to Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: phirat phirat sa(n)tan pahi aaiaa ||
english: After wandering around for so long, I have finally come to the Saints;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dookh bhram hamaaraa sagal mitaaiaa ||
english: all of my pains and doubts have been eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭੂੰਚਾ ॥
transliteration: mahal bulaaiaa prabh a(n)mrit bhoo(n)chaa ||
english: God summoned me to the Mansion of His Presence, and blessed me with the Ambrosial Nectar of His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਊਚਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh meraa oochaa ||4||1||
english: Says Nanak, my God is lofty and exalted. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 5 ||
english: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: dhan s velaa jit darasan karanaa ||
english: Blessed is that time, when the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is given;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur charanaa ||1||
english: I am a sacrifice to the feet of the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jee ke daate preetam prabh mere ||
english: You are the Giver of souls, O my Beloved God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man jeevai prabh naam chitere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My soul lives by reflecting upon the Name of God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sach ma(n)tr tumaaraa a(n)mrit baanee ||
english: True is Your Mantra, Ambrosial is the Bani of Your Word.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: seetal purakh drisat sujaanee ||2||
english: Cooling and soothing is Your Presence, all-knowing is Your gaze. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: sach hukam tumaaraa takhat nivaasee ||
english: True is Your Command; You sit upon the eternal throne.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aai na jaavai meraa prabh abinaasee ||3||
english: My eternal God does not come or go. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਦਾਸ ਹਮ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tum miharavaan daas ham deenaa ||
english: You are the Merciful Master; I am Your humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saahib bharapur leenaa ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is totally permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 5 ||
english: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: too bea(n)t ko viralaa jaanai ||
english: You are infinite - only a few know this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur prasaad ko sabad pachhaanai ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, some come to understand You through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sevak kee aradaas piaare ||
english: Your servant offers this prayer, O Beloved:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jap jeevaa prabh charan tumaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I live by meditating on Your Feet, God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: daiaal purakh mere prabh daate ||
english: O my Merciful and Almighty God, O Great Giver,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਨਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jisahi janaavahu tinahi tum jaate ||2||
english: he alone knows You, whom You so bless. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa jaaee balihaaree ||
english: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: it ut dekhau ot tumaaree ||3||
english: Here and hereafter, I seek Your Protection. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: mohi niragun gun kichhoo na jaataa ||
english: I am without virtue; I know none of Your Glorious Virtues.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak saadhoo dekh man raataa ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, seeing the Holy Saint, my mind is imbued with You. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mah 5 ||
english: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee so prabh pooraa ||
english: God is perfect - He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daan dei saadhoo kee dhooraa ||1||
english: He blesses us with the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh deen daiaalaa ||
english: Bless me with Your Grace, God, O Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teree ot pooran gopaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I seek Your Protection, O Perfect Lord, Sustainer of the World. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal rahiaa bharapoore ||
english: He is totally pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nikat vasai naahee prabh doore ||2||
english: God is near at hand, not far away. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: jis no nadar kare so dhiaae ||
english: One whom He blesses with His Grace, meditates on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aath pahar har ke gun gaae ||3||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sagale pratipaare ||
english: He cherishes and sustains all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: saran pario naanak har duaare ||4||4||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door. ||4||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 5 ||
english: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਤਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: too vad daataa a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: You are the Great Giver, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh mahi raviaa pooran prabh suaamee ||1||
english: God, the Perfect Lord and Master, is permeating and pervading in all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mere prabh preetam naam adhaaraa ||
english: The Name of my Beloved God is my only support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau sun sun jeevaa naam tumaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I live by hearing, continually hearing Your Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: teree saran satigur mere poore ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O my Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤਾ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man niramal hoi sa(n)taa dhoore ||2||
english: My mind is purified by the dust of the Saints. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal hiradai ur dhaare ||
english: I have enshrined His Lotus Feet within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tere darasan kau jaaee balihaare ||3||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa tere gun gaavaa ||
english: Show mercy unto me, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam japat sukh paavaa ||4||5||
english: O Nanak, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I obtain peace. ||4||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 5 ||
english: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har a(n)mrit peejai ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naa jeeu marai na kabahoo chheejai ||1||
english: The soul does not die, nor does it ever waste away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee gur pooraa paaeeai ||
english: By great good fortune, one meets the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
