transliteration: gur kirapaa te prabhoo dhiaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one meditates on God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ratan javaahar har maanak laalaa ||
english: The Lord is the jewel, the pearl, the gem, the diamond.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: simar simar prabh bhae nihaalaa ||2||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, I am in ecstasy. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jat kat pekhau saadhoo saranaa ||
english: Wherever I look, I see the Sanctuary of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har gun gaai niramal man karanaa ||3||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my soul becomes immaculately pure. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵੂਠਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar meraa suaamee voothaa ||
english: Within each and every heart, dwells my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂਠਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak naam paaiaa prabh toothaa ||4||6||
english: O Nanak, one obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord, when God bestows His Mercy. ||4||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 5 ||
english: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: visar naahee prabh deen daiaalaa ||
english: Do not forget me, O God, Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teree saran pooran kirapaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Perfect, Compassionate Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jah chit aavahi so thaan suhaavaa ||
english: Wherever You come to mind, that place is blessed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jit velaa visarahi taa laagai haavaa ||1||
english: The moment I forget You, I am stricken with regret. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੂ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਥੀ ॥
transliteration: tere jee too sad hee saathee ||
english: All beings are Yours; You are their constant companion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਕਢੁ ਦੇ ਹਾਥੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar te kadh de haathee ||2||
english: Please, give me Your hand, and pull me up out of this world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa tum hee keeaa ||
english: Coming and going are by Your Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis too raakhahi tis dookh na theeaa ||3||
english: One whom You save is not afflicted by suffering. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਰਿ ॥
transliteration: too eko saahib avar na hor ||
english: You are the One and only Lord and Master; there is no other.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: binau karai naanak kar jor ||4||7||
english: Nanak offers this prayer with his palms pressed together. ||4||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mah 5 ||
english: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: too jaanaaihi taa koee jaanai ||
english: When You allow Yourself to be known, then we know You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: teraa deeaa naam vakhaanai ||1||
english: We chant Your Name, which You have given to us. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਿਸਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too acharaj kudarat teree bisamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are wonderful! Your creative potency is amazing! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape kaaran aape karanaa ||
english: You Yourself are the Cause of causes, You Yourself are the Creator.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hukame ja(n)man hukame maranaa ||2||
english: By Your Will, we are born, and by Your Will, we die. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: naam teraa man tan aadhaaree ||
english: Your Name is the Support of our mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak daas bakhasees tumaaree ||3||8||
english: This is Your blessing to Nanak, Your slave. ||3||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: merai a(n)tar lochaa milan kee piaare hau kiu paaee gur poore ||
english: Deep within me, there is a longing to meet my Beloved; how can I attain my Perfect Guru?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਾਈਐ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਖੀਰੇ ॥
transliteration: je sau khel khelaaeeai baalak rahi na sakai bin kheere ||
english: Even though a baby may play hundreds of games, he cannot survive without milk.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਭੋਜਨ ਮੈ ਨੀਰੇ ॥
transliteration: merai a(n)tar bhukh na utarai a(n)maalee je sau bhojan mai neere ||
english: The hunger within me is not satisfied, O my friend, even though I am served hundreds of dishes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: merai man tan prem pira(n)m kaa bin darasan kiu man dheere ||1||
english: My mind and body are filled with love for my Beloved; how can my soul find relief, without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਜਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਈ ਮੈ ਮੇਲਿਹੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sun sajan mere preetam bhaaee mai melihu mitr sukhadaataa ||
english: Listen, O my dear friends and siblings - lead me to my True Friend, the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਬੇਦਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ohu jee kee meree sabh bedan jaanai nit sunaavai har keeaa baataa ||
english: He knows all the troubles of my soul; every day, he tells me stories of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਲ ਕਉ ਬਿਲਲਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: hau ik khin tis bin rahi na sakaa jiu chaatrik jal kau bilalaataa ||
english: I cannot live without Him, even for an instant. I cry out for Him, just as the song-bird cries for the drop of water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hau kiaa gun tere saar samaalee mai niragun kau rakh letaa ||2||
english: Which of Your Glorious Virtues should I sing? You save even worthless beings like me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਭਈ ਉਡੀਣੀ ਕੰਤ ਕਉ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਦਿ ਨੈਣੀ ਦੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: hau bhaee udeenee ka(n)t kau a(n)maalee so pir kad nainee dekhaa ||
english: I have become depressed, waiting for my Husband Lord, O my friend; when shall my eyes behold my Husband?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਵਿਸਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh ras bhogan visare bin pir kitai na lekhaa ||
english: I have forgotten how to enjoy all pleasures; without my Husband Lord, they are of no use at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਤਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵਈ ਕਰਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਹਉ ਵੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: ihu kaapaR tan na sukhaavaee kar na sakau hau vesaa ||
english: These clothes do not please my body; I cannot dress myself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖੀ ਲਾਲੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਆਗੈ ਹਮ ਆਦੇਸਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jinee sakhee laal raaviaa piaaraa tin aagai ham aadesaa ||3||
english: I bow to those friends of mine, who have enjoyed their Beloved Husband Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਸਭਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: mai sabh seegaar banaaiaa a(n)maalee bin pir kaam na aae ||
english: I have adorned myself with all sorts of decorations, O my friend, but without my Husband Lord, they are of no use at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਸਹਿ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੀਆ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jaa sahi baat na puchheeaa a(n)maalee taa birathaa joban sabh jaae ||
english: When my Husband does not care for me, O my friend, then my youth passes, totally useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan te sohaaganee a(n)maalee jin sahu rahiaa samaae ||
english: Blessed, blessed are the happy soul-brides, O my friend, who are blended with their Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਧੋਵਾ ਸਦ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: hau vaariaa tin sohaaganee a(n)maalee tin ke dhovaa sad paae ||4||
english: I am a sacrifice to those happy soul-brides; I wash their feet again and again. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਾ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਮੈ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jichar doojaa bharam saa a(n)maalee tichar mai jaaniaa prabh doore ||
english: As long as I suffered from duality and doubt, O my friend, I thought God was far away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa miliaa pooraa satiguroo a(n)maalee taa aasaa manasaa sabh poore ||
english: But when I met the Perfect True Guru, O my friend, then all my hopes and desires were fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mai sarab sukhaa sukh paaiaa a(n)maalee pir sarab rahiaa bharapoore ||
english: I have obtained all pleasures and comforts, O my friend; my Husband Lord is all-pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਆ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਲਗਿ ਪੈਰੇ ॥੫॥੧॥੯॥
transliteration: jan naanak har ra(n)g maaniaa a(n)maalee gur satigur kai lag paire ||5||1||9||
english: Servant Nanak enjoys the Lord's Love, O my friend; I fall at the feet of the Guru, the True Guru. ||5||1||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachee baanee sach dhun sach sabad veechaaraa ||
english: True is the Bani of His Word, and True is the melody; True is contemplative meditation on the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin sach salaahanaa dhan dhan vadabhaag hamaaraa ||1||
english: Night and day, I praise the True Lord. Blessed, blessed is my great good fortune. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man mere saache naam vitahu bal jaau ||
english: O my mind, let yourself be a sacrifice to the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਤਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: daasan daasaa hoi rahahi taa paavahi sachaa naau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If you become the slave of the Lord's slaves, you shall obtain the True Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੀ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa sachee sach ratee tan man sachaa hoi ||
english: True is the tongue which is imbued with Truth, and true are the mind and body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਜਾਸਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin saache hor saalaahanaa jaasahi janam sabh khoi ||2||
english: By praising any other than the True Lord, one's whole life is wasted. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖੇਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਬੀਜਣਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sach khetee sach beejanaa saachaa vaapaaraa ||
english: Let Truth be the farm, Truth the seed, and Truth the merchandise you trade.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anadin laahaa sach naam dhan bhagat bhare bha(n)daaraa ||3||
english: Night and day, you shall earn the profit of the Lord's Name; you shall have the treasure overflowing with the wealth of devotional worship. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sach tek har naau ||
english: Let Truth be your food, and let Truth be your clothes; let your True Support be the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jis no bakhase tis milai mahalee paae thaau ||4||
english: One who is so blessed by the Lord, obtains a seat in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aavahi sache jaavahi sache phir joonee mool na paahi ||
english: In Truth we come, and in Truth we go, and then, we are not consigned to reincarnation again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਹਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramukh dar saachai sachiaar hahi saache maahi samaahi ||5||
english: The Gurmukhs are hailed as True in the True Court; they merge in the True Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar sachaa man sachaa sachee siphat sanaai ||
english: Deep within they are True, and their minds are True; they sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sachai thaan sach saalaahanaa satigur balihaarai jaau ||6||
english: In the true place, they praise the True Lord; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sach velaa moorat sach jit sache naal piaar ||
english: True is the time, and true is the moment, when one falls in love with the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sach vekhanaa sach bolanaa sachaa sabh aakaar ||7||
english: Then, he sees Truth, and speaks the Truth; he realizes the True Lord pervading the entire Universe. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਿਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak sachai mele taa mile aape lae milaai ||
english: O Nanak, one merges with the True Lord, when He merges with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu rakhasee aape kare rajaai ||8||1||
english: As it pleases Him, He preserves us; He Himself ordains His Will. ||8||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਓਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: manooaa dah dis dhaavadaa ohu kaise har gun gaavai ||
english: His mind wanders in the ten directions - how can he sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਿਆਪਿ ਰਹੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: i(n)dree viaap rahee adhikaaee kaam krodh nit sa(n)taavai ||1||
english: The sensory organs are totally engrossed in sensuality; sexual desire and anger constantly afflict him. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu sahaje gun raveejai ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Hail! Hail! Chant His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਲਭੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam is jug mahi dulabh hai guramat har ras peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord's Name is so difficult to obtain in this age; under Guru's Instruction, drink in the subtle essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sabad cheen man niramal hovai taa har ke gun gaavai ||
english: Remembering the Word of the Shabad, the mind becomes immaculately pure, and then, one sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramatee aapai aap pachhaanai taa nij ghar vaasaa paavai ||2||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, one comes to understand his own self, and then, he comes to dwell in the home of his inner self. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: e man mere sadaa ra(n)g raate sadaa har ke gun gaau ||
english: O my mind, be imbued forever with the Lord's Love, and sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har niramal sadaa sukhadaataa man chi(n)diaa phal paau ||3||
english: The Immaculate Lord is forever the Giver of peace; from Him, one receives the fruits of his heart's desires. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਸੇ ਊਤਮ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ham neech se ootam bhae har kee saranaaee ||
english: I am lowly, but I have been exalted, entering the Sanctuary of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਥਰੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਆ ਸਾਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: paathar dubadaa kaadh leeaa saachee vadiaaee ||4||
english: He has lifted up the sinking stone; True is His glorious greatness. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਸੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bikh se a(n)mrit bhae guramat budh paaee ||
english: From poison, I have been transformed into Ambrosial Nectar; under Guru's Instruction, I have obtained wisdom.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਕਹੁ ਪਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: akahu paramal bhae a(n)tar vaasanaa vasaaee ||5||
english: From bitter herbs, I have been transformed into sandalwood; this fragrance permeates me deep within. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਖਟਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: maanas janam dula(n)bh hai jag mahi khatiaa aai ||
english: This human birth is so precious; one must earn the right to come into the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag satigur milai har naam dhiaai ||6||
english: By perfect destiny, I met the True Guru, and I meditate on the Lord's Name. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਗੇ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhoole bikh lage ahilaa janam gavaaiaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded; attached to corruption, they waste away their lives in vain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har kaa naam sadaa sukh saagar saachaa sabad na bhaaiaa ||7||
english: The Name of the Lord is forever an ocean of peace, but the manmukhs do not love the Word of the Shabad. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mukhahu har har sabh ko karai viralai hiradai vasaaiaa ||
english: Everyone can chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har with their mouths, but only a few enshrine it within their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jin kai hiradai vasiaa mokh mukat tinh paaiaa ||8||2||
english: O Nanak, those who enshrine the Lord within their hearts, attain liberation and emancipation. ||8||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 chha(n)t ||
english: Wadahans, First Mehl, Chhant:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਗਾੜਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kooR vigaaR kaahe naaeeai ||
english: Why bother to wash the body, polluted by falsehood?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: naataa so paravaan sach kamaaeeai ||
english: One's cleansing bath is only approved, if he practices Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਸਾਚ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਮਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jab saach a(n)dar hoi saachaa taam saachaa paaeeai ||
english: When there is Truth within the heart, then one becomes True, and obtains the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖੇ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: likhe baajhahu surat naahee bol bol gavaaeeai ||
english: Without pre-ordained destiny, understanding is not attained; talking and babbling, one wastes his life away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੀਐ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਿਖਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jithai jaai baheeai bhalaa kaheeai surat sabad likhaaeeai ||
english: Wherever you go and sit, speak well, and write the Word of the Shabad in your consciousness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਗਾੜਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kooR vigaaR kaahe naaeeai ||1||
english: Why bother to wash the body which is polluted by falsehood? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਿਆ ਕਹਣੁ ਜਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: taa mai kahiaa kahan jaa tujhai kahaaiaa ||
english: When I have spoken, I spoke as You made me speak.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naam merai man bhaaiaa ||
english: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਦੂਖਿ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਾਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naam meethaa manahi laagaa dookh deraa dhaahiaa ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, seems so sweet to my mind; it has destroyed the dwelling of pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਇ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਾਮਿ ਤੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sookh man mahi aai vasiaa jaam tai phuramaaiaa ||
english: Peace came to dwell in my mind, when You gave the Order.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nadar tudh aradaas meree ji(n)n aap upaaiaa ||
english: It is Yours to bestow Your Grace, and it is mine to speak this prayer; You created Yourself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਿਆ ਕਹਣੁ ਜਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa mai kahiaa kahan jaa tujhai kahaaiaa ||2||
english: When I have spoken, I spoke as You made me speak. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਢਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: vaaree khasam kadhaae kirat kamaavanaa ||
english: The Lord and Master gives them their turn, according to the deeds they have done.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਝਗੜਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)daa kisai na aakh jhagaRaa paavanaa ||
english: Do not speak ill of others, or get involved in arguments.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਪਾਇ ਝਗੜਾ ਸੁਆਮਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੁ ਵਞਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: nah paai jhagaRaa suaam setee aap aap vanjaavanaa ||
english: Do not get into arguments with the Lord, or you shall ruin yourself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਰੀਕੀ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਆ ਰੂਆਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naal sa(n)gat kar sareekee jaai kiaa rooaavanaa ||
english: If you challenge the One, with whom you must abide, you will cry in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ਸਹਣਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਕਹਣਾ ਆਖਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਵਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jo dei sahanaa manahi kahanaa aakh naahee vaavanaa ||
english: Be satisfied with what God gives you; tell your mind not to complain uselessly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਢਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vaaree khasam kadhaae kirat kamaavanaa ||3||
english: The Lord and Master gives them their turn, according to the deeds they have done. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh upaaeean aap aape nadar kare ||
english: He Himself created all, and He blesses then with His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਉੜਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਭ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: kauRaa koi na maagai meethaa sabh maagai ||
english: No one asks for that which is bitter; everyone asks for sweets.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਮੀਠਾ ਮੰਗਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਖਸਮ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh koi meethaa ma(n)g dekhai khasam bhaavai so kare ||
english: Let everyone ask for sweets, and behold, it is as the Lord wills.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਣੀ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਸਮਸਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kichh pu(n)n daan anek karanee naam tul na samasare ||
english: Giving donations to charity, and performing various religious rituals are not equal to the contemplation of the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਦੇ ॥
transliteration: naanakaa jin naam miliaa karam hoaa dhur kade ||
english: O Nanak, those who are blessed with the Naam have had such good karma pre-ordained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh upaaeean aap aape nadar kare ||4||1||
english: He Himself created all, and He blesses them with His Glance of Grace. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 ||
english: Wadahans, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: karahu daiaa teraa naam vakhaanaa ||
english: Show mercy to me, that I may chant Your Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh upaaeeai aap aape sarab samaanaa ||
english: You Yourself created all, and You are pervading among all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਉਪਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: sarabe samaanaa aap toohai upaai dha(n)dhai laaeeaa ||
english: You Yourself are pervading among all, and You link them to their tasks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਕੀਏ ਰਾਜੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਭਿਖ ਭਵਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: ik tujh hee keee raaje ikanaa bhikh bhavaaeeaa ||
english: Some, You have made kings, while others go about begging.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੁਝੁ ਕੀਆ ਮੀਠਾ ਏਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: lobh mohu tujh keeaa meethaa et bharam bhulaanaa ||
english: You have made greed and emotional attachment seem sweet; they are deluded by this delusion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਪਣੀ ਤਾਮਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa daiaa karahu apanee taam naam vakhaanaa ||1||
english: Be ever merciful to me; only then can I chant Your Name. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: naam teraa hai saachaa sadaa mai man bhaanaa ||
english: Your Name is True, and ever pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਇ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: dookh gaiaa sukh aai samaanaa ||
english: My pains are dispelled, and I am permeated with peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gaavan sur nar sughaR sujaanaa ||
english: The angels, the mortals and the silent sages sing of You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: sur nar sughaR sujaan gaavahi jo terai man bhaavahe ||
english: The angels, the mortals and the silent sages sing of You; they are pleasing to Your Mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੇ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohe chetahi naahee ahilaa janam gavaavahe ||
english: Enticed by Maya, they do not remember the Lord, and they waste away their lives in vain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਮੂਲੇ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ik mooR mugadh na chetahi moole jo aaiaa tis jaanaa ||
english: Some fools and idiots never think of the Lord; whoever has come, shall have to go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam teraa sadaa saachaa soi mai man bhaanaa ||2||
english: Your Name is True, and ever pleasing to my mind. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: teraa vakhat suhaavaa a(n)mrit teree baanee ||
english: Beauteous is Your time, O Lord; the Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਾਉ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sevak sevahi bhaau kar laagaa saau paraanee ||
english: Your servants serve You with love; these mortals are attached to Your essence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saau praanee tinaa laagaa jinee a(n)mrit paaiaa ||
english: Those mortals are attached to Your essence, who are blessed with the Ambrosial Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਜੋਇ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਿਤ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naam terai joi raate nit chaRahi savaaiaa ||
english: Those who are imbued with Your Name, prosper more and more, day by day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜਾਮਿ ਨ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ik karam dharam na hoi sa(n)jam jaam na ek pachhaanee ||
english: Some do not practice good deeds, or live righteously; nor do they practice self-restraint. They do not realize the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਖਤੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vakhat suhaavaa sadaa teraa a(n)mrit teree baanee ||3||
english: Ever beauteous is Your time, O Lord; the Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree saache naavai ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: raaj teraa kabahu na jaavai ||
english: Your rule shall never end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੋ ਤ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: raajo ta teraa sadaa nihachal ehu kabahu na jaavae ||
english: Your rule is eternal and unchanging; it shall never come to an end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਤ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਇ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: chaakar ta teraa soi hovai joi sahaj samaavae ||
english: He alone becomes Your servant, who contemplates You in peaceful ease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਤ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਮੂਲੇ ਪਾਪੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
transliteration: dusaman ta dookh na lagai moole paap neR na aavae ||
english: Enemies and pains shall never touch him, and sin shall never draw near him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਵਾ ਏਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree sadaa hovaa ek tere naavae ||4||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to the One Lord, and Your Name. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jugah juga(n)tar bhagat tumaare ||
english: Throughout the ages, Your devotees sing the Kirtan of Your Praises,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: keerat karahi suaamee terai duaare ||
english: O Lord Master, at Your Door.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪਹਿ ਤ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: japahi ta saachaa ek muraare ||
english: They meditate on the One True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ਤਾਮਿ ਜਾਪਹਿ ਜਾਮਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: saachaa muraare taam jaapahi jaam ma(n)n vasaavahe ||
english: Only then do they meditate on the True Lord, when they enshrine Him in their minds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੋ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਮਿ ਏਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: bharamo bhulaavaa tujhahi keeaa jaam ehu chukaavahe ||
english: Doubt and delusion are Your making; when these are dispelled,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਜਮਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee karahu kirapaa lehu jamahu ubaare ||
english: then, by Guru's Grace, You grant Your Grace, and save them from the noose of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jugah juga(n)tar bhagat tumaare ||5||
english: Throughout the ages, they are Your devotees. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: vade mere saahibaa alakh apaaraa ||
english: O my Great Lord and Master, You are unfathomable and infinite.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਉ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kiu kar karau bena(n)tee hau aakh na jaanaa ||
english: How should I make and offer my prayer? I do not know what to say.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: nadar karahi taa saach pachhaanaa ||
english: If You bless me with Your Glance of Grace, I realize the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੋ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਤਾਮਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਾਮਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: saacho pachhaanaa taam teraa jaam aap bujhaavahe ||
english: Only then do I come to realize the Truth, when You Yourself instruct me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਸਹਸਾ ਏਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: dookh bhookh sa(n)saar keee sahasaa ehu chukaavahe ||
english: The pain and hunger of the world are Your making; dispel this doubt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਸਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak jaai sahasaa bujhai gur beechaaraa ||
english: Prays Nanak, ones skepticism is taken away, when he understands the Guru's wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: vadaa saahib hai aap alakh apaaraa ||6||
english: The Great Lord Master is unfathomable and infinite. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਬੰਕੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਦੰਤ ਰੀਸਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: tere ba(n)ke loin da(n)t reesaalaa ||
english: Your eyes are so beautiful, and Your teeth are delightful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਣੇ ਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਲੰਮੜੇ ਵਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sohane nak jin la(n)maRe vaalaa ||
english: Your nose is so graceful, and Your hair is so long.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕੀ ਢਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)chan kaaiaa suine kee dhaalaa ||
english: Your body is so precious, cast in gold.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਵੰਨ ਢਾਲਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮਾਲਾ ਜਪਹੁ ਤੁਸੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ॥
transliteration: sova(n)n dhaalaa krisan maalaa japahu tusee saheleeho ||
english: His body is cast in gold, and He wears Krishna's mala; meditate on Him, O sisters.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਹੁ ਖੜੀਆ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ ॥
transliteration: jam duaar na hohu khaReeaa sikh sunahu maheleeho ||
english: You shall not have to stand at Death's door, O sisters, if you listen to these teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸ ਹੰਸਾ ਬਗ ਬਗਾ ਲਹੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)s ha(n)saa bag bagaa lahai man kee jaalaa ||
english: From a crane, you shall be transformed into a swan, and the filth of your mind shall be removed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਕੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਦੰਤ ਰੀਸਾਲਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ba(n)ke loin da(n)t reesaalaa ||7||
english: Your eyes are so beautiful, and Your teeth are delightful. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਲ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਮਧੁਰਾੜੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: teree chaal suhaavee madhuraaRee baanee ||
english: Your walk is so graceful, and Your speech is so sweet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਹਕਨਿ ਕੋਕਿਲਾ ਤਰਲ ਜੁਆਣੀ ॥
transliteration: kuhakan kokilaa taral juaanee ||
english: You coo like a songbird, and your youthful beauty is alluring.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਰਲਾ ਜੁਆਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਭਾਣੀ ਇਛ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀਏ ॥
transliteration: taralaa juaanee aap bhaanee ichh man kee pooreee ||
english: Your youthful beauty is so alluring; it pleases You, and it fulfills the heart's desires.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਜਿਉ ਪਗੁ ਧਰੈ ਠਿਮਿ ਠਿਮਿ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੁ ਸੰਧੂਰਏ ॥
transliteration: saara(n)g jiu pag dharai thim thim aap aap sa(n)dhoorae ||
english: Like an elephant, You step with Your Feet so carefully; You are satisfied with Yourself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਾਤੀ ਉਦਕੁ ਗੰਗਾ ਵਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sreera(n)g raatee phirai maatee udak ga(n)gaa vaanee ||
english: She who is imbued with the Love of such a Great Lord, flows intoxicated, like the waters of the Ganges.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਲ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਮਧੁਰਾੜੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak daas har kaa teree chaal suhaavee madhuraaRee baanee ||8||2||
english: Prays Nanak, I am Your slave, O Lord; Your walk is so graceful, and Your speech is so sweet. ||8||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 chha(n)t ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl, Chhant:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ਮੁਈਏ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aapane pir kai ra(n)g ratee mueee sobhaava(n)tee naare ||
english: Let yourself be imbued with the Love of your Husband Lord, O beautiful, mortal bride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀ ਮੁਈਏ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad mil rahee mueee pir raave bhaai piaare ||
english: Let yourself remain merged in the True Word of the Shabad, O mortal bride; savor and enjoy the Love of your Beloved Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sachai bhaai piaaree ka(n)t savaaree har har siu nehu rachaaiaa ||
english: The Husband Lord embellishes His beloved bride with His True Love; she is in love with the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aap gavaaiaa taa pir paaiaa gur kai sabad samaaiaa ||
english: Renouncing her self-centeredness, she attains her Husband Lord, and remains merged in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਸਾਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan sabad suhaaee prem kasaaee a(n)tar preet piaaree ||
english: That soul bride is adorned, who is attracted by His Love, and who treasures the Love of her Beloved within her heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਪਿਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਹਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saa dhan mel laee pir aape saachai saahi savaaree ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Lord blends that soul bride with Himself; the True King adorns her. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣਵੰਤੜੀਏ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: niragunava(n)taReee pir dekh hadoore raam ||
english: O worthless bride, see your Husband Lord ever-present.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਮੁਈਏ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jinee raaviaa mueee pir rav rahiaa bharapoore raam ||
english: One who, as Gurmukh, enjoys her Husband Lord, O mortal bride, knows Him to be all-pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਜੂਰੇ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: pir rav rahiaa bharapoore vekh hajoore jug jug eko jaataa ||
english: The Lord is all-pervading everywhere; behold Him ever-present. Throughout the ages, know Him as the One.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਬਾਲੀ ਭੋਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: dhan baalee bholee pir sahaj raavai miliaa karam bidhaataa ||
english: The young, innocent bride enjoys her Husband Lord; she meets Him, the Architect of karma.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jin har ras chaakhiaa sabad subhaakhiaa har sar rahee bharapoore ||
english: One who tastes the sublime essence of the Lord, and utters the sublime Word of the Shabad, remains immersed in the Lord's Ambrosial Pool.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹੈ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kaaman saa pir bhaavai sabade rahai hadoore ||2||
english: O Nanak, that soul bride is pleasing to her Husband Lord, who, through the Shabad, remains in His Presence. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਾਇ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਮੁਈਏ ਜਿਨੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sohaaganee jaai poochhahu mueee jinee vichahu aap gavaaiaa ||
english: Go and ask the happy soul-brides, O mortal bride, who have eradicated their self-conceit from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਮੁਈਏ ਜਿਨੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pir kaa hukam na paaio mueee jinee vichahu aap na gavaaiaa ||
english: Those who have not eradicated their self-conceit, O mortal bride, do not realize the Hukam of their Husband Lord's Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jinee aap gavaaiaa tinee pir paaiaa ra(n)g siu raleeaa maanai ||
english: Those who eradicate their self-conceit, obtain their Husband Lord; they delight in His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ra(n)g raatee sahaje maatee anadin naam vakhaanai ||
english: Ever imbued with His Love, in perfect poise and grace, she repeats His Name, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kaaman vadabhaagee a(n)tar liv laagee har kaa prem subhaaiaa ||
english: Very fortunate is that bride, who focuses her consciousness on Him; her Lord's Love is so sweet to her.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak kaaman sahaje raatee jin sach seegaar banaaiaa ||3||
english: O Nanak, that soul-bride who is adorned with Truth, is imbued with her Lord's Love, in the state of perfect poise. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮੁਈਏ ਤੂ ਚਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar mueee too chal gur kai bhaae ||
english: Overcome your egotism, O mortal bride, and walk in the Guru's Way.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਈਏ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har var raavahi sadaa mueee nij ghar vaasaa paae ||
english: Thus you shall ever enjoy your Husband Lord, O mortal bride, and obtain an abode in the home of your own inner being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਏ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa paae sabad vajaae sadaa suhaagan naaree ||
english: Obtaining an abode in the home of her inner being, she vibrates the Word of the Shabad, and is a happy soul-bride forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਲੀਆਲਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਲਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੰਤਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pir raleeaalaa joban baalaa anadin ka(n)t savaaree ||
english: The Husband Lord is delightful, and forever young; night and day, He embellishes His bride.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੋ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੋ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har var sohaago masatak bhaago sachai sabad suhaae ||
english: Her Husband Lord activates the destiny written on her forehead, and she is adorned with the True Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਾ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kaaman har ra(n)g raatee jaa chalai satigur bhaae ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, the soul-bride is imbued with the Love of the Lord, when she walks according to the Will of the True Guru. ||4||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਜੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਕੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sabh vaapaar bhalaa je sahaje keejai raam ||
english: All dealings of the Gurmukh are good, if they are accomplished with poise and grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: anadin naam vakhaaneeai laahaa har ras peejai raam ||
english: Night and day, he repeats the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and he earns his profits, drinking in the subtle essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵੀਜੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: laahaa har ras leejai har raaveejai anadin naam vakhaanai ||
english: He earns the profit of the subtle essence of the Lord, meditating on the Lord, and repeating the Naam, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਹਿ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gun sa(n)grahi avagan vikanahi aapai aap pachhaanai ||
english: He gathers in merits, and eliminates demerits, and realizes his own self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: guramat paaee vadee vadiaaee sachai sabad ras peejai ||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, he is blessed with glorious greatness; he drinks in the essence of the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak har kee bhagat niraalee guramukh viralai keejai ||1||
english: O Nanak, devotional worship of the Lord is wonderful, but only a few Gurmukhs perform it. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੇਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਜਮਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramukh khetee har a(n)tar beejeeai har leejai sareer jamaae raam ||
english: As Gurmukh, plant the crop of the Lord within the field of your body, and let it grow.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਘਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੁੰਚੁ ਤੂ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਪਰਥਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aapane ghar a(n)dar ras bhu(n)ch too laahaa lai parathaae raam ||
english: Within the home of your own being, enjoy the Lord's subtle essence, and earn profits in the world hereafter.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਪਰਥਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਧਨੁ ਖੇਤੀ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: laahaa parathaae har ma(n)n vasaae dhan khetee vaapaaraa ||
english: This profit is earned by enshrining the Lord within your mind; blessed is this farming and trade.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har naam dhiaae ma(n)n vasaae boojhai gur beechaaraa ||
english: Meditating on the Lord's Name, and enshrining Him within your mind, you shall come to understand the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖੇਤੀ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh khetee vanaj kar thaake trisanaa bhukh na jaae ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs have grown weary of this farming and trade; their hunger and thirst will not go away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜਿ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam beej man a(n)dar sachai sabad subhaae ||2||
english: O Nanak, plant the seed of the Name within your mind, and adorn yourself with the True Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਣੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har vaapaar se jan laage jinaa masatak manee vadabhaago raam ||
english: Those humble beings engage in the Lord's Trade, who have the jewel of such pre-ordained destiny upon their foreheads.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramatee man nij ghar vasiaa sachai sabad bairaago raam ||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, the soul dwells in the home of the self; through the True Word of the Shabad, she becomes unattached.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੋ ਸਚਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: mukh masatak bhaago sach bairaago saach rate veechaaree ||
english: By the destiny written upon their foreheads, they become truly unattached, and by reflective meditation, they are imbued with Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa sabh jag bauraanaa sabade haumai maaree ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the whole world is insane; through the Shabad, the ego is conquered.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਮਤਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੋ ॥
transliteration: saachai sabad laag mat upajai guramukh naam sohaago ||
english: Attached to the True Word of the Shabad, wisdom comes forth. The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak sabad milai bhau bha(n)jan har raavai masatak bhaago ||3||
english: O Nanak, through the Shabad, one meets the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, and by the destiny written on her forehead, she enjoys Him. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖੇਤੀ ਵਣਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: khetee vanaj sabh hukam hai hukame ma(n)n vadiaaee raam ||
english: All farming and trading is by Hukam of His Will; surrendering to the Lord's Will, glorious greatness is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramatee hukam boojheeai hukame mel milaaee raam ||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, one comes to understand the Lord's Will, and by His Will, he is united in His Union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hukam milaaee sahaj samaaee gur kaa sabad apaaraa ||
english: By His Will, one merges and easily blends with Him. The Shabads of the Guru are incomparable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachee vadiaaee gur te paaee sach savaaranahaaraa ||
english: Through the Guru, true greatness is obtained, and one is embellished with Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhau bha(n)jan paaiaa aap gavaaiaa guramukh mel milaaee ||
english: He finds the Destroyer of fear, and eradicates his self-conceit; as Gurmukh, he is united in His Union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak naam nira(n)jan agam agochar hukame rahiaa samaaee ||4||2||
english: Says Nanak, the Name of the immaculate, inaccessible, unfathomable Commander is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: man meriaa too sadaa sach samaal jeeu ||
english: O my mind, contemplate the True Lord forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aapanai ghar too sukh vasahi pohi na sakai jamakaal jeeu ||
english: Dwell in peace in the home of your own self, and the Messenger of Death shall not touch you.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaal jaal jam johi na saakai saachai sabad liv laae ||
english: The noose of the Messenger of Death shall not touch you, when you embrace love for the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sach rataa man niramal aavan jaan rahaae ||
english: Ever imbued with the True Lord, the mind becomes immaculate, and its coming and going is ended.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai bharam vigutee manamukh mohee jamakaal ||
english: The love of duality and doubt have ruined the self-willed manmukh, who is lured away by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahai naanak sun man mere too sadaa sach samaal ||1||
english: Says Nanak, listen, O my mind: contemplate the True Lord forever. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: man meriaa a(n)tar terai nidhaan hai baahar vasat na bhaal ||
english: O my mind, the treasure is within you; do not search for it on the outside.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭੁੰਚਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jo bhaavai so bhu(n)ch too guramukh nadar nihaal ||
english: Eat only that which is pleasing to the Lord, and as Gurmukh, receive the blessing of His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh nadar nihaal man mere a(n)tar har naam sakhaaee ||
english: As Gurmukh, receive the blessing of His Glance of Grace, O my mind; the Name of the Lord, your help and support, is within you.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhule giaan vihoone doojai bhaai khuaaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are blind, and devoid of wisdom; they are ruined by the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai ko chhootai naahee sabh baadhee jamakaal ||
english: Without the Name, no one is emancipated. All are bound by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak a(n)tar terai nidhaan hai too baahar vasat na bhaal ||2||
english: O Nanak, the treasure is within you; do not search for it on the outside. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਇਕਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man meriaa janam padaarath paai kai ik sach lage vaapaaraa ||
english: O my mind, obtaining the blessing of this human birth, some are engaged in the trade of Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevan aapanaa a(n)tar sabad apaaraa ||
english: They serve their True Guru, and the Infinite Word of the Shabad resounds within them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar sabad apaaraa har naam piaaraa naame nau nidh paaee ||
english: Within them is the Infinite Shabad, and the Beloved Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Naam, the nine treasures are obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਦੂਖਿ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh maaiaa moh viaape dookh sa(n)taape doojai pat gavaaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya; they suffer in pain, and through duality, they lose their honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar sach sabad samaane sach rate adhikaaee ||
english: But those who conquer their ego, and merge in the True Shabad, are totally imbued with Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak maanas janam dula(n)bh hai satigur boojh bujhaaee ||3||
english: O Nanak, it is so difficult to obtain this human life; the True Guru imparts this understanding. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: man mere satigur sevan aapanaa se jan vadabhaagee raam ||
english: O my mind, those who serve their True Guru are the most fortunate beings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jo man maarahi aapanaa se purakh bairaagee raam ||
english: Those who conquer their minds are beings of renunciation and detachment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: se jan bairaagee sach liv laagee aapanaa aap pachhaaniaa ||
english: They are beings of renunciation and detachment, who lovingly focus their consciousness on the True Lord; they realize and understand their own selves.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਅਤਿ ਗੂੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mat nihachal at gooRee guramukh sahaje naam vakhaaniaa ||
english: Their intellect is steady, deep and profound; as Gurmukh, they naturally chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: ik kaaman hitakaaree maaiaa mohi piaaree manamukh soi rahe abhaage ||
english: Some are lovers of beautiful young women; emotional attachment to Maya is very dear to them. The unfortunate self-willed manmukhs remain asleep.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak sahaje sevahi gur apanaa se poore vadabhaage ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, those who intuitively serve their Guru, have perfect destiny. ||4||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਵਣਜੀਅਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ratan padaarath vanajeeahi satigur deeaa bujhaaee raam ||
english: Purchase the jewel, the invaluable treasure; the True Guru has given this understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: laahaa laabh har bhagat hai gun mahi gunee samaaee raam ||
english: The profit of profits is the devotional worship of the Lord; one's virtues merge into the virtues of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਲਾਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੈਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gun mahi gunee samaae jis aap bujhaae laahaa bhagat saisaare ||
english: One's virtues merge into the virtues of the Lord; he comes to understand his own self. He earns the profit of devotional worship in this world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bin bhagatee sukh na hoee doojai pat khoee guramat naam adhaare ||
english: Without devotion, there is no peace; through duality, one's honor is lost, but under Guru's Instruction, he is blessed with the Support of the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਏਤੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: vakhar naam sadaa laabh hai jis no et vaapaar laae ||
english: He ever earns the profit of the merchandise of the Naam, whom the Lord employs in this Trade.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਵਣਜੀਅਹਿ ਜਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ratan padaarath vanajeeahi jaa(n) satigur dei bujhaae ||1||
english: He purchases the jewel, the invaluable treasure, unto whom the True Guru has given this understanding. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਖੋਟਾ ਇਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabh dukh hai khotaa ihu vaapaaraa raam ||
english: The love of Maya is totally painful; this is a bad deal.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣੀ ਬਹੁ ਵਧਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kooR bol bikh khaavanee bahu vadhahi vikaaraa raam ||
english: Speaking falsehood, one eats poison, and the evil within increases greatly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਵਧਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bahu vadhahi vikaaraa sahasaa ihu sa(n)saaraa bin naavai pat khoee ||
english: The evil within increases greatly, in this world of doubt; without the Name, one's honor is lost.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit vaad vakhaanahi bin boojhe sukh na hoee ||
english: Reading and studying, the religious scholars argue and debate; but without understanding, there is no peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa kade na chookai maaiaa moh piaaraa ||
english: Their comings and goings never end; emotional attachment to Maya is dear to them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਖੋਟਾ ਇਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabh dukh hai khotaa ihu vaapaaraa ||2||
english: The love of Maya is totally painful; this is a bad deal. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਰਖੀਅਨਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: khote khare sabh parakheean tit sache kai darabaaraa raam ||
english: The counterfeit and the genuine are all assayed in the Court of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਟੀਅਨਿ ਊਭੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: khote daragah suteean oobhe karan pukaaraa raam ||
english: The counterfeit are cast out of the Court, and they stand there, crying out in misery.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਊਭੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: oobhe karan pukaaraa mugadh gavaaraa manamukh janam gavaaiaa ||
english: They stand there, crying out in misery; the foolish, idiotic, self-willed manmukhs have wasted their lives.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa maaiaa jin jagat bhulaaiaa saachaa naam na bhaaiaa ||
english: Maya is the poison which has deluded the world; it does not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੰਤਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sa(n)taa naal vair kar dukh khate sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are resentful toward the Saints; they harvest only pain in this world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖੀਅਨਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਵਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khote khare parakheean tit sachai daravaaraa raam ||3||
english: The counterfeit and the genuine are assayed in that True Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai hor karanaa kichhoo na jaaee raam ||
english: He Himself acts; who else should I ask? No one else can do anything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਸੀ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jit bhaavai tit laaisee jiu tis dee vadiaaee raam ||
english: As He pleases, He engages us; such is His glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਈ ਵਰੀਆਮੁ ਨ ਫੁਸੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jiu tis dee vadiaaee aap karaaee vareeaam na phusee koee ||
english: Such is His glorious greatness - He Himself causes all to act; no one is a warrior or a coward.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan daataa karam bidhaataa aape bakhase soee ||
english: The Life of the World, the Great Giver, the Architect of karma - He Himself grants forgiveness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee aap gavaaeeai naanak naam pat paaee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, self-conceit is eradicated, O Nanak, and through the Naam, honor is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai hor karanaa kichhoo na jaaee ||4||4||
english: He Himself acts; who else should I ask? No one else can do anything. ||4||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saudaa har naam hai sachaa vaapaaraa raam ||
english: The True merchandise is the Lord's Name. This is the true trade.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣਜੀਐ ਅਤਿ ਮੋਲੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramatee har naam vanajeeai at mol aphaaraa raam ||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, we trade in the Lord's Name; its value is very great.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਮੋਲੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ਸਚ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਸਚਿ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ਲਗੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: at mol aphaaraa sach vaapaaraa sach vaapaar lage vadabhaagee ||
english: The value of this true trade is very great; those who are engaged in the true trade are very fortunate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar bhagatee raate sach naam liv laagee ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, they are imbued with devotion, and they enshrine love for the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare soee sach paae gur kai sabad veechaaraa ||
english: One who is blessed with the Lord's Favor, obtains Truth, and reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੈ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate tin hee sukh paaiaa saachai ke vaapaaraa ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Name find peace; they deal only in the True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੰਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)umai maaiaa mail hai maaiaa mail bhareejai raam ||
english: Egotistical involvement in Maya is filth; Maya is overflowing with filth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramatee man niramalaa rasanaa har ras peejai raam ||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, the mind is made pure and the tongue tastes the subtle essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa har ras peejai a(n)tar bheejai saach sabad beechaaree ||
english: The tongue tastes the subtle essence of the Lord, and deep within, the heart is drenched with His Love, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਖੂਹਟਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਪੀਐ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar khoohataa a(n)mrit bhariaa sabade kaadh peeai panihaaree ||
english: Deep within, the well of the heart is overflowing with the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar; the water-carrier draws and drinks in the water of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jis nadar kare soee sach laagai rasanaa raam raveejai ||
english: One who is blessed with the Lord's favor is attuned to the Truth; with his tongue, he chants the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਰ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate se niramal hor haumai mail bhareejai ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are immaculate. The others are full of the filth of egotism. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਸਭਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕੂਕਦੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit jotakee sabh paR paR kookade kis pahi karahi pukaaraa raam ||
english: All the religious scholars and astrologers read and study, and argue and shout. Who are they trying to teach?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu a(n)tar mal laagai maaiaa ke vaapaaraa raam ||
english: The filth of attachment to Maya clings to their hearts; they deal in Maya alone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਜਗਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਵਣਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa ke vaapaaraa jagat piaaraa aavan jaan dukh paaee ||
english: They love to deal in Maya in this world; coming and going, they suffer in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bikh kaa keeRaa bikh siu laagaa bistaa maahi samaaee ||
english: The worm of poison is addicted to poison; it is immersed in manure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਇ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa soi kamaavai koi na metanahaaraa ||
english: He does what is pre-ordained for him; no one can erase his destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹੋਰਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੂਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate tin sadaa sukh paaiaa hor moorakh kook mue gaavaaraa ||3||
english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, lasting peace is found; the ignorant fools die screaming. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi man ra(n)giaa mohi sudh na kaaee raam ||
english: Their minds are colored by emotional attachment to Maya; because of this emotional attachment, they do not understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੀਐ ਦੂਜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਜਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ihu man ra(n)geeai doojaa ra(n)g jaaee raam ||
english: The soul of the Gurmukh is imbued with the Lord's Love; the love of duality departs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਜਾਈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: doojaa ra(n)g jaaee saach samaaee sach bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
english: The love of duality departs, and the soul merges in Truth; the warehouse is overflowing with Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai soee boojhai sach savaaranahaaraa ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh, comes to understand; the Lord embellishes him with Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape mele so har milai hor kahanaa kichhoo na jaae ||
english: He alone merges with the Lord, whom the Lord causes to merge; nothing else can be said or done.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਇਕਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak vin naavai bharam bhulaaiaa ik naam rate ra(n)g laae ||4||5||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, one is deluded by doubt; but some, imbued with the Name, enshrine love for the Lord. ||4||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: e man meriaa aavaa gaun sa(n)saar hai a(n)t sach nibeRaa raam ||
english: O my mind, the world comes and goes in birth and death; only the True Name shall emancipate you in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aape sachaa bakhas lae phir hoi na pheraa raam ||
english: When the True Lord Himself grants forgiveness, then one does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: phir hoi na pheraa a(n)t sach nibeRaa guramukh milai vadiaaee ||
english: He does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again, and he is emancipated in the end; as Gurmukh, he obtains glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saachai ra(n)g raate sahaje maate sahaje rahe samaaee ||
english: Imbued with love for the True Lord, he is intoxicated with celestial bliss, and he remains absorbed in the Celestial Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa man bhaaiaa sach vasaaiaa sabad rate a(n)t niberaa ||
english: The True Lord is pleasing to his mind; he enshrines the True Lord in his mind; attuned to the Word of the Shabad, he is emancipated in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate se sach samaane bahur na bhavajal pheraa ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam, merge in the True Lord; they are not cast into the terrifying world-ocean again. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਰਲੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabh baral hai doojai bhaai khuaaee raam ||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya is total madness; through the love of duality, one is ruined.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਹੇਤੇ ਪਲਚਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: maataa pitaa sabh het hai hete palachaaee raam ||
english: Mother and father - all are subject to this love; in this love, they are entangled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੇਤੇ ਪਲਚਾਈ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: hete palachaaee purab kamaaee met na sakai koee ||
english: They are entangled in this love, on account of their past actions, which no one can erase.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jin srisat saajee so kar vekhai tis jevad avar na koee ||
english: The One who created the Universe, beholds it; no other is as great as He.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਤਪਿ ਤਪਿ ਖਪੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhaa tap tap khapai bin sabadai saa(n)t na aaee ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukh is consumed by his burning rage; without the Word of the Shabad, peace is not obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਭੁਲਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak bin naavai sabh koee bhulaa maaiaa mohi khuaaee ||2||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, everyone is deluded, ruined by emotional attachment to Maya. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ehu jag jalataa dekh kai bhaj pae har saranaaee raam ||
english: Seeing that this world on fire, I have hurried to the Sanctuary of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਂੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਆਗੈ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aradaas kara(n)ee gur poore aagai rakh levahu dehu vadaaee raam ||
english: I offer my prayer to the Perfect Guru: please save me, and bless me with Your glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: rakh levahu saranaaee har naam vadaaee tudh jevad avar na daataa ||
english: Preserve me in Your Sanctuary, and bless me with the glorious greatness of the Name of the Lord; there is no other Giver as great as You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sevaa laage se vadabhaage jug jug eko jaataa ||
english: Those who are engaged in serving You are very fortunate; throughout the ages, they know the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jat sat sa(n)jam karam kamaavai bin gur gat nahee paaee ||
english: You may practice celibacy, truth, austere self-discipline and rituals, but without the Guru, you shall not be emancipated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਜੋ ਜਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak tis no sabad bujhaae jo jaai pavai har saranaaee ||3||
english: O Nanak, he alone understands the Word of the Shabad, who goes and seeks the Lord's Sanctuary. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਸਾ ਊਪਜੈ ਹੋਰ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jo har mat dei saa oopajai hor mat na kaaee raam ||
english: That understanding, imparted by the Lord, wells up; there is no other understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar ek too aape dehi bujhaaee raam ||
english: Deep within, and beyond as well, You alone are, O Lord; You Yourself impart this understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aape dehi bujhaaee avar na bhaaee guramukh har ras chaakhiaa ||
english: One whom He Himself blesses with this understanding, does not love any other. As Gurmukh, he tastes the subtle essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dar saachai sadaa hai saachaa saachai sabad subhaakhiaa ||
english: In the True Court, he is forever True; with love, he chants the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ghar mahi nij ghar paaiaa satigur dei vadaaee ||
english: Within his home, he finds the home of his own being; the True Guru blesses him with glorious greatness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਈ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak jo naam rate seee mahal paain mat paravaan sach saaee ||4||6||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; their understanding is true, and approved. ||4||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 4 chha(n)t ||
english: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl, Chhant:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: merai man merai man satigur preet lagaaee raam ||
english: My mind, my mind - the True Guru has blessed it with the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har har har har naam merai ma(n)n vasaaee raam ||
english: He has enshrined the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, within my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam merai ma(n)n vasaaee sabh dookh visaaranahaaraa ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, dwells within my mind; He is the Destroyer of all pain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee gur darasan paaiaa dhan dhan satiguroo hamaaraa ||
english: By great good fortune, I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; blessed, blessed is my True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat satigur sevah jit seviai saa(n)t paaee ||
english: While standing up and sitting down, I serve the True Guru; serving Him, I have found peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: merai man merai man satigur preet lagaaee ||1||
english: My mind, my mind - the True Guru has blessed it with the Lord's Love. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਰਸੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: hau jeevaa hau jeevaa satigur dekh sarase raam ||
english: I live, I live, and I blossom forth, beholding the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਗਸੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har naamo har naam driRaae jap har har naam vigase raam ||
english: The Name of the Lord, the Name of the Lord, He has implanted within me; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I blossom forth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਲ ਪਰਗਾਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੰ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jap har har naam kamal paragaase har naam nava(n) nidh paaee ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the heart-lotus blossoms forth, and through the Name of the Lord, I have obtained the nine treasures.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: haumai rog gaiaa dukh laathaa har sahaj samaadh lagaaee ||
english: The disease of egotism has been eradicated, suffering has been eliminated, and I have entered the Lord's state of celestial Samaadhi.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਸੇ ॥
transliteration: har naam vadaaee satigur te paaee sukh satigur dev man parase ||
english: I have obtained the glorious greatness of Name of the Lord from the True Guru; beholding the Divine True Guru, my mind is at peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਰਸੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hau jeevaa hau jeevaa satigur dekh sarase ||2||
english: I live, I live, and I blossom forth, beholding the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: koee aan koee aan milaavai meraa satigur pooraa raam ||
english: If only someone would come, if only someone would come, and lead me to meet my Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: hau man tan hau man tan devaa tis kaat sareeraa raam ||
english: My mind and body, my mind and body - I cut my body into pieces, and I dedicate these to Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਈ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hau man tan kaat kaat tis deee jo satigur bachan sunaae ||
english: Cutting my mind and body apart, cutting them into pieces, I offer these to the one, who recites to me the Words of the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: merai man bairaag bhaiaa bairaagee mil gur darasan sukh paae ||
english: My unattached mind has renounced the world; obtaining the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, it has found peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਹਮ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har har kripaa karahu sukhadaate dehu satigur charan ham dhooraa ||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, O Giver of Peace, please, grant Your Grace, and bless me with the dust of the feet of the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: koee aan koee aan milaavai meraa satigur pooraa ||3||
english: If only someone would come, if only someone would come, and lead me to meet my Perfect True Guru. ||3||
