author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur jevad gur jevad daataa mai avar na koee raam ||
english: A Giver as great as the Guru, as great as the Guru - I cannot see any other.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har daano har daan devai har purakh nira(n)jan soee raam ||
english: He blesses me with the gift of the Lord's Name, the gift of the Lord's Name; He is the Immaculate Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam jinee aaraadhiaa tin kaa dukh bharam bhau bhaagaa ||
english: Those who worship in adoration the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - their pain, doubts and fears are dispelled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: sevak bhaai mile vadabhaagee jin gur charanee man laagaa ||
english: Through their loving service, those very fortunate ones, whose minds are attached to the Guru's Feet, meet Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak har aap milaae mil satigur purakh sukh hoee ||
english: Says Nanak, the Lord Himself causes us to meet the Guru; meeting the Almighty True Guru, peace is obtained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: gur jevad gur jevad daataa mai avar na koee ||4||1||
english: A Giver as great as the Guru, as great as the Guru - I cannot see any other. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 4 ||
english: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੰਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੰਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਰੀ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)u gur bin ha(n)u gur bin kharee nimaanee raam ||
english: Without the Guru, I am - without the Guru, I am totally dishonored.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan jagajeevan daataa gur mel samaanee raam ||
english: The Life of the World, the Life of the World, the Great Giver has led me to meet and merge with the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur mel har naam samaanee jap har har naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, I have merged into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and meditate on it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਹੰਉ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਸੋ ਸਜਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis kaaran ha(n)u dhoo(n)dh dhoodhedee so sajan har ghar paaiaa ||
english: I was seeking and searching for Him, the Lord, my best friend, and I have found Him within the home of my own being.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ek drist har eko jaataa har aatam raam pachhaanee ||
english: I see the One Lord, and I know the One Lord; I realize Him within my soul.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੰਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੰਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਰੀ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ha(n)u gur bin ha(n)u gur bin kharee nimaanee ||1||
english: Without the Guru, I am - without the Guru, I am totally dishonored. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jinaa satigur jin satigur paaiaa tin har prabh mel milaae raam ||
english: Those who have found the True Guru, the True Guru, the Lord God unites them in His Union.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਚਰਣ ਤਿਨ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਹ ਹਮ ਲਾਗਹ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tin charan tin charan sarevah ham laagah tin kai paae raam ||
english: Their feet, their feet, I adore; I fall at their feet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਹ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧੵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har har charan sarevah tin ke jin satigur purakh prabh dhyaaiaa ||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, I adore the feet of those who meditate on the True Guru, and the Almighty Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਵਡਦਾਤਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: too vadadaataa a(n)tarajaamee meree saradhaa poor har raaiaa ||
english: You are the Greatest Giver, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; please, reward my faith, O Lord King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gurasikh mel meree saradhaa pooree anadin raam gun gaae ||
english: Meeting the Gursikh, my faith is rewarded; night and day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin satigur jin satigur paaiaa tin har prabh mel milaae ||2||
english: Those who have found the True Guru, the True Guru, the Lord God unites them in His Union. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੰਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹੰਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)u vaaree ha(n)u vaaree gurasikh meet piaare raam ||
english: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice to the Gursikhs, my dear friends.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har naamo har naam sunaae meraa preetam naam adhaare raam ||
english: They chant the Lord's Name, the Lord's Name; the Beloved Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my only Support.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਾਂ ॥
transliteration: har har naam meraa praan sakhaaee tis bin ghaRee nimakh nahee jeevaa(n) ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the companion of my breath of life; without it, I cannot live for an instant or a moment.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾਂ ॥
transliteration: har har kripaa kare sukhadaataa guramukh a(n)mrit peevaa(n) ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, the Giver of peace, shows His Mercy, and the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har aape saradhaa laai milaae har aape aap savaare ||
english: The Lord blesses him with faith, and unites him in His Union; He Himself adorns him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੰਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹੰਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ha(n)u vaaree ha(n)u vaaree gurasikh meet piaare ||3||
english: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice to the Gursikhs, my dear friends. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har aape har aape purakh nira(n)jan soee raam ||
english: The Lord Himself, the Lord Himself, is the Immaculate Almighty Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ ਕਰੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har aape har aape melai karai so hoee raam ||
english: The Lord Himself, the Lord Himself, unites us with Himself; that which He does, comes to pass.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo har prabh bhaavai soee hovai avar na karanaa jaaee ||
english: Whatever is pleasing to the Lord God, that alone comes to pass; nothing else can be done.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bahut siaanap laiaa na jaaee kar thaake sabh chaturaaee ||
english: Even by very clever tricks, He cannot be obtained; all have grown weary of practicing cleverness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad jan naanak dekhiaa mai har bin avar na koee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, servant Nanak beholds the Lord; without the Lord, I have no other at all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: har aape har aape purakh nira(n)jan soee ||4||2||
english: The Lord Himself, the Lord Himself, is the Immaculate Almighty Lord God. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 4 ||
english: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਹਮ ਭਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har satigur har satigur mel har satigur charan ham bhaaiaa raam ||
english: The Lord, the True Guru, the Lord, the True Guru - if only I could meet the Lord, the True Guru; His Lotus Feet are so pleasing to me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਮਰ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: timar agiaan gavaaiaa gur giaan a(n)jan gur paaiaa raam ||
english: The darkness of my ignorance was dispelled, when the Guru applied the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom to my eyes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: gur giaan a(n)jan satiguroo paaiaa agiaan a(n)dher binaase ||
english: The True Guru has applied the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom to my eyes, and the darkness of ignorance has been dispelled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev param pad paaiaa har japiaa saas giraase ||
english: Serving the Guru, I have obtained the supreme status; I meditate on the Lord with every breath, and every morsel of food.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin ka(n)u har prabh kirapaa dhaaree te satigur sevaa laaiaa ||
english: Those, upon whom the Lord God has bestowed His Grace, are committed to the service of the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਹਮ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har satigur har satigur mel har satigur charan ham bhaaiaa ||1||
english: The Lord, the True Guru, the Lord, the True Guru - if only I could meet the Lord, the True Guru; His Lotus Feet are so pleasing to me. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: meraa satigur meraa satigur piaaraa mai gur bin rahan na jaaee raam ||
english: My True Guru, my True Guru is my Beloved; without the Guru, I cannot live.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har naamo har naam devai meraa a(n)t sakhaaee raam ||
english: He gives me the Name of the Lord, the Name of the Lord, my only companion in the end.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har har naam meraa a(n)t sakhaaee gur satigur naam driRaaiaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my only companion in the end; the Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jithai put kalatr koee belee naahee tithai har har naam chhadaaiaa ||
english: There, where neither child nor spouse shall accompany you, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har shall emancipate you.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan satigur purakh nira(n)jan jit mil har naam dhiaaee ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, the Immaculate, Almighty Lord God; meeting Him, I meditate on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: meraa satigur meraa satigur piaaraa mai gur bin rahan na jaaee ||2||
english: My True Guru, my True Guru is my Beloved; without the Guru, I cannot live. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jinee darasan jinee darasan satigur purakh na paaiaa raam ||
english: Those who have not obtained the Blessed Vision, the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the True Guru, the Almighty Lord God,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tin nihaphal tin nihaphal janam sabh brithaa gavaaiaa raam ||
english: they have fruitlessly, fruitlessly wasted their whole lives in vain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੁਏ ਮਰਿ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: nihaphal janam tin brithaa gavaaiaa te saakat mue mar jhoore ||
english: They have wasted away their whole lives in vain; those faithless cynics die a regretful death.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੈ ਰਤਨਿ ਪਦਾਰਥਿ ਭੂਖੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ghar hodai ratan padaarath bhookhe bhaagaheen har doore ||
english: They have the jewel-treasure in their own homes, but still, they are hungry; those unlucky wretches are far away from the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har har tin kaa daras na kareeahu jinee har har naam na dhiaaiaa ||
english: O Lord, please, let me not see those who do not meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jinee darasan jinee darasan satigur purakh na paaiaa ||3||
english: and who have not obtained the Blessed Vision, the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the True Guru, the Almighty Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ham chaatrik ham chaatrik deen har paas bena(n)tee raam ||
english: I am a song-bird, I am a meek song-bird; I offer my prayer to the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਰਹ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur mil gur mel meraa piaaraa ham satigur karah bhagatee raam ||
english: If only I could meet the Guru, meet the Guru, O my Beloved; I dedicate myself to the devotional worship of the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਰਹ ਭਗਤੀ ਜਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har satigur karah bhagatee jaa(n) har prabh kirapaa dhaare ||
english: I worship the Lord, Har, Har, and the True Guru; the Lord God has granted His Grace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਲੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਹਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mai gur bin avar na koee belee gur satigur praan hamhaare ||
english: Without the Guru, I have no other friend. The Guru, the True Guru, is my very breath of life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ੍ਹਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਤੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur naam driRhaaiaa har har naam har satee ||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has implanted the Naam within me; the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the True Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: ham chaatrik ham chaatrik deen har paas bena(n)tee ||4||3||
english: I am a song-bird, I am a meek song-bird; I offer my prayer to the Lord. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 4 ||
english: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har kirapaa har kirapaa kar satigur mel sukhadaataa raam ||
english: O Lord, show Your Mercy, show Your Mercy, and let me meet the True Guru, the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪੂਛਹ ਹਮ ਪੂਛਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ham poochhah ham poochhah satigur paas har baataa raam ||
english: I go and ask, I go and ask from the True Guru, about the sermon of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਤ ਪੂਛਹ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur paas har baat poochhah jin naam padaarath paaiaa ||
english: I ask about the sermon of the Lord from the True Guru, who has obtained the treasure of the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਹ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paai lagah nit karah bina(n)tee gur satigur pa(n)th bataaiaa ||
english: I bow at His Feet constantly, and pray to Him; the Guru, the True Guru, has shown me the Way.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: soee bhagat dukh sukh samat kar jaanai har har naam har raataa ||
english: He alone is a devotee, who looks alike upon pleasure and pain; he is imbued with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kirapaa har kirapaa kar gur satigur mel sukhadaataa ||1||
english: O Lord, show Your Mercy, show Your Mercy, and let me meet the True Guru, the Giver of peace. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਪਾਪਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sun guramukh sun guramukh naam sabh binase ha(n)umai paapaa raam ||
english: Listen as Gurmukh, listen as Gurmukh, to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; all egotism and sins are eradicated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਥਿਅੜੇ ਜਗਿ ਤਾਪਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jap har har jap har har naam lathiaRe jag taapaa raam ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the troubles of the world vanish.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam jinee aaraadhiaa tin ke dukh paap nivaare ||
english: Those who contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are rid of their suffering and sins.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਹਥਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur giaan khaRag hath deenaa jamaka(n)kar maar bidaare ||
english: The True Guru has placed the sword of spiritual wisdom in my hands; I have overcome and slain the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ਪਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪਾ ॥
transliteration: har prabh kripaa dhaaree sukhadaate dukh laathe paap sa(n)taapaa ||
english: The Lord God, the Giver of peace, has granted His Grace, and I am rid of pain, sin and disease.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਪਾਪਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sun guramukh sun guramukh naam sabh binase ha(n)umai paapaa ||2||
english: Listen as Gurmukh, listen as Gurmukh, to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; all egotism and sins are eradicated. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jap har har jap har har naam merai man bhaaiaa raam ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is so pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mukh guramukh mukh guramukh jap sabh rog gavaaiaa raam ||
english: Speaking as Gurmukh, speaking as Gurmukh, chanting the Naam, all disease is eradicated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਅਰੋਗਤ ਭਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jap sabh rog gavaaiaa arogat bhae sareeraa ||
english: As Gurmukh, chanting the Naam, all disease is eradicated, and the body becomes free of disease.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: anadin sahaj samaadh har laagee har japiaa gahir ga(n)bheeraa ||
english: Night and day, one remains absorbed in the Perfect Poise of Samaadhi; meditate on the Name of the Lord, the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪਰਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaat ajaat naam jin dhiaaiaa tin param padaarath paaiaa ||
english: Whether of high or low social status, one who meditates on the Naam obtains the supreme treasure.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jap har har jap har har naam merai man bhaaiaa ||3||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har dhaarahu har dhaarahu kirapaa kar kirapaa lehu ubaare raam ||
english: Grant Your Grace, grant Your Grace, O Lord, and save me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਦੀਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ham paapee ham paapee niragun deen tumhaare raam ||
english: I am a sinner, I am a worthless sinner, I am meek, but I am Yours, O Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਦੀਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੈਆਲ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ham paapee niragun deen tumhaare har daiaal saranaaiaa ||
english: I am a worthless sinner, and I am meek, but I am Yours; I seek Your Sanctuary, O Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਤਰੇ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: too dukh bha(n)jan sarab sukhadaataa ham paathar tare taraaiaa ||
english: You are the Destroyer of pain, the Giver of absolute peace; I am a stone - carry me across and save me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhet raam ras paaiaa jan naanak naam udhaare ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, servant Nanak has obtained the subtle essence of the Lord; through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he is saved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: har dhaarahu har dhaarahu kirapaa kar kirapaa lehu ubaare raam ||4||4||
english: Grant Your Grace, grant Your Grace, Lord, and save me. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘੋੜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 4 ghoReeaa ||
english: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl, Ghorees ~ The Wedding Procession Songs:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਤੇਜਣਿ ਜੀ ਰਾਮਿ ਉਪਾਈਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: deh tejan jee raam upaaeeaa raam ||
english: This body-horse was created by the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਪਾਈਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n maanas janam pu(n)n paaeeaa raam ||
english: Blessed is human life, which is obtained by virtuous actions.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਵਡ ਪੁੰਨੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੇਹ ਸੁ ਕੰਚਨ ਚੰਗੜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: maanas janam vad pu(n)ne paaiaa deh s ka(n)chan cha(n)gaReeaa ||
english: Human life is obtained only by the most virtuous actions; this body is radiant and golden.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਲੂਲਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਵ ਰੰਗੜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ra(n)g chaloolaa paavai har har har nav ra(n)gaReeaa ||
english: The Gurmukh is imbued with the deep red color of the poppy; he is imbued with the new color of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਦੇਹ ਸੁ ਬਾਂਕੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀਆ ॥
transliteration: eh deh s baa(n)kee jit har jaapee har har naam suhaaveeaa ||
english: This body is so very beautiful; it chants the Name of the Lord, and it is adorned with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮਿ ਉਪਾਈਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee paaee naam sakhaaee jan naanak raam upaaeeaa ||1||
english: By great good fortune, the body is obtained; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is its companion; O servant Nanak, the Lord has created it. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਪਾਵਉ ਜੀਨੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਚੰਗਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: deh paavau jeen bujh cha(n)gaa raam ||
english: I place the saddle on the body-horse, the saddle of realization of the Good Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਾ ਜੀ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: chaR la(n)ghaa jee bikham bhuia(n)gaa raam ||
english: Riding this horse, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਮੁ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bikham bhuia(n)gaa anat tara(n)gaa guramukh paar la(n)ghaae ||
english: The terrifying world-ocean is rocked by countless waves, but the Gurmukh is carried across.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਚੜਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਲੰਘੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har bohith chaR vadabhaagee la(n)ghai gur khevat sabad taraae ||
english: Embarking upon the boat of the Lord, the very fortunate ones cross over; the Guru, the Boatman, carries them across through the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: anadin har ra(n)g har gun gaavai har ra(n)gee har ra(n)gaa ||
english: Night and day, imbued with the Lord's Love, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Lord's lover loves the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak nirabaan pad paaiaa har utam har pad cha(n)gaa ||2||
english: Servant Nanak has obtained the state of Nirvaanaa, the state of ultimate goodness, the state of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੜੀਆਲੁ ਮੁਖੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kaReeaal mukhe gur giaan driRaaiaa raam ||
english: For a bridle in my mouth, the Guru has implanted spiritual wisdom within me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਾਬਕੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tan prem har chaabak laaiaa raam ||
english: He has applied the whip of the Lord's Love to my body.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇ ਚਾਬਕੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tan prem har har laai chaabak man jinai guramukh jeetiaa ||
english: Applying the whip of the Lord's Love to his body, the Gurmukh conquers his mind, and wins the battle of life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਘੜੋ ਘੜਾਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਅਪਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aghaRo ghaRaavai sabad paavai apiu har ras peetiaa ||
english: He trains his untrained mind with the Word of the Shabad, and drinks in the rejuvenating essence of the Lord's Nectar.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਤੁਰੀ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sun sravan baanee gur vakhaanee har ra(n)g turee chaRaaiaa ||
english: Listen with your ears to the Word, uttered by the Guru, and attune your body-horse to the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mahaa maarag pa(n)th bikhaRaa jan naanak paar la(n)ghaaiaa ||3||
english: Servant Nanak has crossed over the long and treacherous path. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘੋੜੀ ਤੇਜਣਿ ਦੇਹ ਰਾਮਿ ਉਪਾਈਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ghoRee tejan deh raam upaaeeaa raam ||
english: The transitory body-horse was created by the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਾ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੁਖਾਈਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jit har prabh jaapai saa dhan dha(n)n tukhaaeeaa raam ||
english: Blessed, blessed is that body-horse which meditates on the Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਾਬਾਸੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਜੁੜੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: jit har prabh jaapai saa dha(n)n saabaasai dhur paaiaa kirat juRa(n)daa ||
english: Blessed and acclaimed is that body-horse which meditates on the Lord God; it is obtained by the merits of past actions.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚੜਿ ਦੇਹੜਿ ਘੋੜੀ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਲਘਾਏ ਮਿਲੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: chaR dehaR ghoRee bikham laghaae mil guramukh paramaana(n)daa ||
english: Riding the body-horse, one crosses over the terrifying world ocean; the Gurmukh meets the Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੰਞ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: har har kaaj rachaaiaa poorai mil sa(n)t janaa ja(n)nj aaee ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, has perfectly arranged this wedding; the Saints have come together as a marriage party.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak har var paaiaa ma(n)gal mil sa(n)t janaa vaadhaaee ||4||1||5||
english: Servant Nanak has obtained the Lord as his Spouse; joining together, the Saints sing the songs of joy and congratulations. ||4||1||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 4 ||
english: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਤੇਜਨੜੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਵ ਰੰਗੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: deh tejanaRee har nav ra(n)geeaa raam ||
english: The body is the Lord's horse; the Lord imbues it with the fresh and new color.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur giaan guroo har ma(n)geeaa raam ||
english: From the Guru, I ask for the Lord's spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਮੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਚੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: giaan ma(n)gee har kathaa cha(n)gee har naam gat mit jaaneeaa ||
english: I ask for the Lord's spiritual wisdom, and the Lord's sublime sermon; through the Name of the Lord, I have come to know His value and His state.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲਿਉ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh janam saphaliu keeaa karatai har raam naam vakhaaneeaa ||
english: The Creator has made my life totally fruitful; I chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੰਗੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har raam naam salaahi har prabh har bhagat har jan ma(n)geeaa ||
english: The Lord's humble servant begs for the Lord's Name, for the Lord's Praises, and for devotional worship of the Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਚੰਗੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan kahai naanak sunahu sa(n)tahu har bhagat govi(n)d cha(n)geeaa ||1||
english: Says servant Nanak, listen, O Saints: devotional worship of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, is sublime and good. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਕੰਚਨ ਜੀਨੁ ਸੁਵਿਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: deh ka(n)chan jeen suvinaa raam ||
english: The golden body is saddled with the saddle of gold.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤੰਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jaR har har naam rata(n)naa raam ||
english: It is adorned with the jewel of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੜਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਖ ਘਣੇ ॥
transliteration: jaR naam ratan govi(n)d paaiaa har mile har gun sukh ghane ||
english: Adorned with the jewel of the Naam, one obtains the Lord of the Universe; he meets the Lord, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and obtains all sorts of comforts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਹਰਿ ਬਣੇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabad paaiaa har naam dhiaaiaa vadabhaagee har ra(n)g har bane ||
english: He obtains the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and he meditates on the Name of the Lord; by great good fortune, he assumes the color of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਵਤਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਵ ਰੰਗੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har mile suaamee a(n)tarajaamee har navatan har nav ra(n)geeaa ||
english: He meets his Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; His body is ever-new, and His color is ever-fresh.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੰਗੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak vakhaanai naam jaanai har naam har prabh ma(n)geeaa ||2||
english: Nanak chants and realizes the Naam; he begs for the Name of the Lord, the Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੜੀਆਲੁ ਮੁਖੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kaReeaal mukhe gur a(n)kas paaiaa raam ||
english: The Guru has placed the reins in the mouth of the body-horse.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: man maigal gur sabad vas aaiaa raam ||
english: The mind-elephant is overpowered by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: man vasagat aaiaa param pad paaiaa saa dhan ka(n)t piaaree ||
english: The bride obtains the supreme status, as her mind is brought under control; she is the beloved of her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar prem lagaa har setee ghar sohai har prabh naaree ||
english: Deep within her inner self, she is in love with her Lord; in His home, she is beautiful - she is the bride of her Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g raatee sahaje maatee har prabh har har paaiaa ||
english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, she is intuitively absorbed in bliss; she obtains the Lord God, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak jan har daas kahat hai vadabhaagee har har dhiaaiaa ||3||
english: Servant Nanak, the Lord's slave, says that only the very fortunate meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਘੋੜੀ ਜੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: deh ghoRee jee jit har paaiaa raam ||
english: The body is the horse, upon which one rides to the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mil satigur jee ma(n)gal gaaiaa raam ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, one sings the songs of joy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਕੀ ॥
transliteration: har gaai ma(n)gal raam naamaa har sev sevak sevakee ||
english: Sing the songs of joy to the Lord, serve the Name of the Lord, and become the servant of His servants.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਵੈ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੈ ਰੰਗ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh jaai paavai ra(n)g mahalee har ra(n)g maanai ra(n)g kee ||
english: You shall go and enter the Mansion of the Beloved Lord's Presence, and lovingly enjoy His Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਰਾਮ ਗਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gun raam gaae man subhaae har guramatee man dhiaaiaa ||
english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, so pleasing to my mind; following the Guru's Teachings, I meditate on the Lord within my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਦੇਹ ਘੋੜੀ ਚੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kirapaa dhaaree deh ghoRee chaR har paaiaa ||4||2||6||
english: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; mounting the body-horse, he has found the Lord. ||4||2||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag vadaha(n)s mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ghar 4 ||
english: Raag Wadahans, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Fourth House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਧਾ ਜੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur mil ladhaa jee raam piaaraa raam ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, I have found my Beloved Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦਿਤੜਾ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ihu tan man ditaRaa vaaro vaaraa raam ||
english: I have made this body and mind a sacrifice, a sacrificial offering to my Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਿਤਾ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਂਣਿ ਜਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: tan man ditaa bhavajal jitaa chookee kaa(n)n jamaanee ||
english: Dedicating my body and mind, I have crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, and shaken off the fear of death.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਰਹਿਆ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: asathir theeaa a(n)mrit peeaa rahiaa aavan jaanee ||
english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, I have become immortal; my comings and goings have ceased.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਲਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: so ghar ladhaa sahaj samadhaa har kaa naam adhaaraa ||
english: I have found that home, of celestial Samaadhi; the Name of the Lord is my only Support.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਾਣੇ ਰਲੀਆਂ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੰਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sukh maane raleeaa(n) gur poore ka(n)u namasakaaraa ||1||
english: Says Nanak, I enjoy peace and pleasure; I bow in reverence to the Perfect Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਜਣ ਜੀ ਮੈਡੜੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sun sajan jee maidaRe meetaa raam ||
english: Listen, O my friend and companion

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਦੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur ma(n)tr sabad sach deetaa raam ||
english: - the Guru has given the Mantra of the Shabad, the True Word of God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਚੂਕੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਅਦੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: sach sabad dhiaaiaa ma(n)gal gaaiaa chooke manahu adesaa ||
english: Meditating on this True Shabad, I sing the songs of joy, and my mind is rid of anxiety.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਸਾ ॥
transliteration: so prabh paaiaa katahi na jaaiaa sadaa sadaa sa(n)g baisaa ||
english: I have found God, who never leaves; forever and ever, He sits with me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਚਾ ਮਾਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਦੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh jee bhaanaa sachaa maanaa prabh har dhan sahaje deetaa ||
english: One who is pleasing to God receives true honor. The Lord God blesses him with wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਹੈ ਲੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tis jan balihaaree teraa daan sabhanee hai leetaa ||2||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to such a humble being. O Lord, You bless all with Your bountiful blessings. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾਂ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tau bhaanaa taa(n) tripat aghaae raam ||
english: When it pleases You, then I am satisfied and satiated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਥੀਆ ਠੰਢਾ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: man theeaa tha(n)dhaa sabh trisan bujhaae raam ||
english: My mind is soothed and calmed, and all my thirst is quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਥੀਆ ਠੰਢਾ ਚੂਕੀ ਡੰਝਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man theeaa tha(n)dhaa chookee da(n)jhaa paaiaa bahut khajaanaa ||
english: My mind is soothed and calmed, the burning has ceased, and I have found so many treasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਭਿ ਭੁੰਚਣ ਲਗੇ ਹੰਉ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sikh sevak sabh bhu(n)chan lage ha(n)u satagur kai kurabaanaa ||
english: All the Sikhs and servants partake of them; I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਖਸਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau bhae khasam ra(n)g raate jam kee traas bujhaae ||
english: I have become fearless, imbued with the Love of my Lord Master, and I have shaken off the fear of death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੰਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak daas sadaa sa(n)g sevak teree bhagat kara(n)u liv laae ||3||
english: Slave Nanak, Your humble servant, lovingly embraces Your meditation; O Lord, be with me always. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਜੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: pooree aasaa jee manasaa mere raam ||
english: My hopes and desires have been fulfilled, O my Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਜੀਉ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mohi niragun jeeu sabh gun tere raam ||
english: I am worthless, without virtue; all virtues are Yours, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh gun tere thaakur mere kit mukh tudh saalaahee ||
english: All virtues are Yours, O my Lord and Master; with what mouth should I praise You?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗੁਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੀਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: gun avagun meraa kichh na beechaariaa bakhas leeaa khin maahee ||
english: You did not consider my merits and demerits; you forgave me in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: nau nidh paaee vajee vaadhaaee vaaje anahad toore ||
english: I have obtained the nine treasures, congratulations are pouring in, and the unstruck melody resounds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਵਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਥੇ ਜੀ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak mai var ghar paaiaa mere laathe jee sagal visoore ||4||1||
english: Says Nanak, I have found my Husband Lord within my own home, and all my anxiety is forgotten. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਸੁਣੇਦੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਪਵਣ ਝੁਲਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kiaa sunedo kooR va(n)njan pavan jhulaariaa ||
english: Why do you listen to falsehood? It shall vanish like a gust of wind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣੀਅਰ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜੋ ਸੁਣੇਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak suneear te paravaan jo sunede sach dhanee ||1||
english: O Nanak, those ears are acceptable, which listen to the True Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਜਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tin ghol ghumaaee jin prabh sravanee suniaa raam ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who listen with their ears to the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਭਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: se sahaj suhele jin har har rasanaa bhaniaa raam ||
english: Blissful and comfortable are those, who with their tongues chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਗੁਣਹ ਅਮੋਲੇ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: se sahaj suhele gunah amole jagat udhaaran aae ||
english: They are naturally embellished, with priceless virtues; they have come to save the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhai bohith saagar prabh charanaa kete paar laghaae ||
english: God's Feet are the boat, which carries so many across the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਨ ਗਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jin ka(n)u kripaa karee merai thaakur tin kaa lekhaa na ganiaa ||
english: Those who are blessed with the favor of my Lord and Master, are not asked to render their account.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tis ghol ghumaaee jin prabh sravanee suniaa ||1||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who listen to God with their ears. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਇਣ ਲੋਈ ਡਿਠ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਮੂ ਘਣੀ ॥
transliteration: loin loee dith piaas na bujhai moo ghanee ||
english: With my eyes, I have seen the Light of the Lord, but my great thirst is not quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਅਖੜੀਆਂ ਬਿਅੰਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਡਿਸੰਦੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak se akhaReeaa(n) bia(n)n jinee disa(n)do maa piree ||1||
english: O Nanak, those eyes are different, which behold my Husband Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jinee har prabh dithaa tin kurabaane raam ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who have seen the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: se saachee daragah bhaane raam ||
english: In the True Court of the Lord, they are approved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਸੇ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: thaakur maane se paradhaane har setee ra(n)g raate ||
english: They are approved by their Lord and Master, and acclaimed as supreme; they are imbued with the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਹਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: har rasahi aghaae sahaj samaae ghat ghat ramaeeaa jaate ||
english: They are satiated with the sublime essence of the Lord, and they merge in celestial peace; in each and every heart, they see the all-pervading Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਸਜਣ ਸੰਤ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪਣੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: seee sajan sa(n)t se sukheee thaakur apane bhaane ||
english: They alone are the friendly Saints, and they alone are happy, who are pleasing to their Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jin har prabh dithaa tin kai sad kurabaane ||2||
english: Says Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to those who have seen the Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਅੰਧ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: deh a(n)dhaaree a(n)dh su(n)njee naam vihooneeaa ||
english: The body is blind, totally blind and desolate, without the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ ਜੈ ਘਟਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saphal jana(n)m jai ghat vuthaa sach dhanee ||1||
english: O Nanak, fruitful is the life of that being, within whose heart the True Lord and Master abides. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾਂ ਜਿਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tin kha(n)neeai va(n)njaa(n) jin meraa har prabh deethaa raam ||
english: I am cut into pieces as a sacrifice, to those who have seen my Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਚਾਖਿ ਅਘਾਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jan chaakh aghaane har har a(n)mrit meethaa raam ||
english: His humble servants partake of the Sweet Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, and are satiated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਹਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੂਠਾ ਅਮਿਉ ਵੂਠਾ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: har manahi meethaa prabhoo toothaa amiu voothaa sukh bhae ||
english: The Lord seems sweet to their minds; God is merciful to them, His Ambrosial Nectar rains down upon them, and they are at peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਈਸਹ ਜੈ ਜਏ ॥
transliteration: dukh naas bharam binaas tan te jap jagadees eesah jai jae ||
english: Pain is eliminated and doubt is dispelled from the body; chanting the Name of the Lord of the World, their victory is celebrated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਰਹਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਪੰਚ ਤੇ ਸੰਗੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
transliteration: moh rahat bikaar thaake pa(n)ch te sa(n)g tootaa ||
english: They are rid of emotional attachment, their sins are erased, and their association with the five passions is broken off.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾ ਜਿਨ ਘਟਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵੂਠਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tin kha(n)neeai va(n)njaa jin ghat meraa har prabh voothaa ||3||
english: Says Nanak, I am every bit a sacrifice to those, within whose hearts my Lord God abides. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਲੋੜੀਦੇ ਰਾਮ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਈ ਕਾਂਢਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jo loReede raam sevak seee kaa(n)dhiaa ||
english: Those who long for the Lord, are said to be His servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੇ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jaane sat saa(n)ee sa(n)t na baaharaa ||1||
english: Nanak knows this Truth, that the Lord is not different from His Saint. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਖਟਾਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mil jal jalahi khataanaa raam ||
english: As water mixes and blends with water,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g jotee jot milaanaa raam ||
english: so does one's light mix and blend with the Lord's Light.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਮਾਇ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)maai pooran purakh karate aap aapahi jaaneeai ||
english: Merging with the perfect, all-powerful Creator, one comes to know his own self.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: tah su(n)n sahaj samaadh laagee ek ek vakhaaneeai ||
english: Then, he enters the celestial state of absolute Samaadhi, and speaks of the One and Only Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aap gupataa aap mukataa aap aap vakhaanaa ||
english: He Himself is unmanifest, and He Himself is liberated; He Himself speaks of Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਖਟਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak bhram bhai gun binaase mil jal jalahi khataanaa ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, doubt, fear and the limitations of the three qualities are dispelled, as one merges into the Lord, like water blending with water. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 5 ||
english: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: prabh karan kaaran samarathaa raam ||
english: God is the all-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਖੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੇ ਹਥਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: rakh jagat sagal de hathaa raam ||
english: He preserves the whole world, reaching out with His hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਸਰਣਾ ਜੋਗੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: samarath saranaa jog suaamee kripaa nidh sukhadaataa ||
english: He is the all-powerful, safe Sanctuary, Lord and Master, Treasure of mercy, Giver of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)u kurabaanee daas tere jinee ek pachhaataa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to Your slaves, who recognize only the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਲਖਿਆ ਕਥਨ ਤੇ ਅਕਥਾ ॥
transliteration: varan chihan na jaai lakhiaa kathan te akathaa ||
english: His color and shape cannot be seen; His description is indescribable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sunahu binatee prabh karan kaaran samarathaa ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, hear my prayer, O God, Almighty Creator, Cause of causes. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ehi jee tere too karataa raam ||
english: These beings are Yours; You are their Creator.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਹਰਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: prabh dookh darad bhram harataa raam ||
english: God is the Destroyer of pain, suffering and doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: bhram dookh darad nivaar khin mahi rakh lehu deen daiaalaa ||
english: Eliminate my doubt, pain and suffering in an instant, and preserve me, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਆਮਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਾਲ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa suaam sajan sabh jagat baal gopaalaa ||
english: You are mother, father and friend, O Lord and Master; the whole world is Your child, O Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jo saran aavai gun nidhaan paavai so bahuR janam na marataa ||
english: One who comes seeking Your Sanctuary, obtains the treasure of virtue, and does not have to enter the cycle of birth and death again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak daas teraa sabh jee tere too karataa ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, I am Your slave. All beings are Yours; You are their Creator. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar har dhiaaeeai raam ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, twenty-four hours a day,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: man ichhiaRaa phal paaeeai raam ||
english: the fruits of the heart's desires are obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: man ichh paaeeai prabh dhiaaeeai mitahi jam ke traasaa ||
english: Your heart's desires are obtained, meditating on God, and the fear of death is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਇਆ ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: gobid gaaiaa saadh sa(n)gaaiaa bhaee pooran aasaa ||
english: I sing of the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and my hopes are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: taj maan mohu vikaar sagale prabhoo kai man bhaaeeai ||
english: Renouncing egotism, emotional attachment and all corruption, we become pleasing to the Mind of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak dinas rainee sadaa har har dhiaaeeai ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, day and night, meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dar vaajahi anahat vaaje raam ||
english: At the Lord's Door, the unstruck melody resounds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਗਾਜੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat har gobi(n)d gaaje raam ||
english: In each and every heart, the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, sings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿਦ ਗਾਜੇ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਰਾਜੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਊਚਾ ॥
transliteration: govid gaaje sadaa biraaje agam agochar oochaa ||
english: The Lord of the Universe sings, and abides forever; He is unfathomable, profoundly deep, lofty and exalted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥
transliteration: gun bea(n)t kichh kahan na jaaee koi na sakai pahoochaa ||
english: His virtues are infinite - none of them can be described. No one can reach Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: aap upaae aap pratipaale jee ja(n)t sabh saaje ||
english: He Himself creates, and He Himself sustains; all beings and creatures are fashioned by Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਵਜਹਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sukh naam bhagatee dar vajahi anahad vaaje ||4||3||
english: Prays Nanak, happiness comes from devotional worship of the Naam; at His Door, the unstruck melody resounds. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਅਲਾਹਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: raag vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 ghar 5 alaahaneeaa ||
english: Raag Wadahans, First Mehl, Fifth House, Alaahanees ~ Songs Of Mourning:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n sira(n)daa sachaa paatisaahu jin jag dha(n)dhai laaiaa ||
english: Blessed is the Creator, the True King, who has linked the whole world to its tasks.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਪੁਨੀ ਪਾਈ ਭਰੀ ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ਘਤਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: muhalat punee paaee bharee jaaneeaRaa ghat chalaaiaa ||
english: When one's time is up, and the measure is full, this dear soul is caught, and driven off.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨੀ ਘਤਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਵੀਰ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jaanee ghat chalaaiaa likhiaa aaiaa ru(n)ne veer sabaae ||
english: This dear soul is driven off, when the pre-ordained Order is received, and all the relatives cry out in mourning.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਥੀਆ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਜਾਂ ਦਿਨ ਪੁੰਨੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaa(n)iaa ha(n)s theeaa vechhoRaa jaa(n) din pu(n)ne meree maae ||
english: The body and the swan-soul are separated, when one's days are past and done, O my mother.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤੇਹਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੇਹਾ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jehaa likhiaa tehaa paaiaa jehaa purab kamaaiaa ||
english: As is one's pre-ordained Destiny, so does one receive, according to one's past actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dha(n)n sira(n)daa sachaa paatisaahu jin jag dha(n)dhai laaiaa ||1||
english: Blessed is the Creator, the True King, who has linked the whole world to its tasks. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਇਆਣਾ ॥
transliteration: saahib simarahu mere bhaaeeho sabhanaa ehu paiaanaa ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master, O my Siblings of Destiny; everyone has to pass this way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਥੈ ਧੰਧਾ ਕੂੜਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਹਾ ਆਗੈ ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ethai dha(n)dhaa kooRaa chaar dihaa aagai sarapar jaanaa ||
english: These false entanglements last for only a few days; then, one must surely move on to the world hereafter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਹਮਾਣਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਗਾਰਬੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: aagai sarapar jaanaa jiu mihamaanaa kaahe gaarab keejai ||
english: He must surely move on to the world hereafter, like a guest; so why does he indulge in ego?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jit seviai daragah sukh paaeeai naam tisai kaa leejai ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord; serving Him, you shall obtain peace in His Court.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਮੂਲੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਿਹਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: aagai hukam na chalai moole sir sir kiaa vihaanaa ||
english: In the world hereafter, no one's commands will be obeyed. According to their actions, each and every person proceeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਮਰਿਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਇਆਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saahib simarihu mere bhaaeeho sabhanaa ehu paiaanaa ||2||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master, O my Siblings of Destiny; everyone has to pass this way. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਹੀਲੜਾ ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai sa(n)mrath so theeai heelaRaa ehu sa(n)saaro ||
english: Whatever pleases the Almighty Lord, that alone comes to pass; this world is an opportunity to please Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਾਚੜਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal rav rahiaa saachaRaa sirajanahaaro ||
english: The True Creator Lord is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the air.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੋ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saachaa sirajanahaaro alakh apaaro taa kaa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: The True Creator Lord is invisible and infinite; His limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aaiaa tin kaa saphal bhaiaa hai ik man jinee dhiaaiaa ||
english: Fruitful is the coming of those, who meditate single-mindedly on Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਢਾਹੇ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: dhaahe dhaahi usaare aape hukam savaaranahaaro ||
english: He destroys, and having destroyed, He creates; by His Order, He adorns us.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਹੀਲੜਾ ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai sa(n)mrath so theeai heelaRaa ehu sa(n)saaro ||3||
english: Whatever pleases the Almighty Lord, that alone comes to pass; this world is an opportunity to please Him. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੁੰਨਾ ਬਾਬਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਰੋਵੈ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
transliteration: naanak ru(n)naa baabaa jaaneeai je rovai laai piaaro ||
english: Nanak: he alone truly weeps, O Baba, who weeps in the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਲੇਵੇ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਈਐ ਰੋਵਣੁ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: vaaleve kaaran baabaa roeeai rovan sagal bikaaro ||
english: One who weeps for the sake of worldly objects, O Baba, weeps totally in vain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਣੁ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰੋ ਗਾਫਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: rovan sagal bikaaro gaaphal sa(n)saaro maaiaa kaaran rovai ||
english: This weeping is all in vain; the world forgets the Lord, and weeps for the sake of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਗਾ ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਏਵੈ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)gaa ma(n)daa kichh soojhai naahee ihu tan evai khovai ||
english: He does not distinguish between good and evil, and wastes away this life in vain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਆਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: aithai aaiaa sabh ko jaasee kooR karahu aha(n)kaaro ||
english: Everyone who comes here, shall have to leave; to act in ego is false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੁੰਨਾ ਬਾਬਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਰੋਵੈ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ru(n)naa baabaa jaaneeai je rovai laai piaaro ||4||1||
english: Nanak: he alone truly weeps, O Baba, who weeps in the Lord's Love. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 ||
english: Wadahans, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਚੜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: aavahu milahu saheleeho sachaRaa naam laehaa(n) ||
english: Come, O my companions - let us meet together and dwell upon the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਤਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਮੑਾਲੇਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: rovah birahaa tan kaa aapanaa saahib sa(n)mhaalehaa(n) ||
english: Let us weep over the body's separation from the Lord and Master; let us remember Him in contemplation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿਹ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਹ ਅਸਾ ਭਿ ਓਥੈ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: saahib samhaalih pa(n)th nihaalih asaa bh othai jaanaa ||
english: Let us remember the Lord and Master in contemplation, and keep a watchful eye on the Path. We shall have to go there as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਲੀਆ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa keeaa tin hee leeaa hoaa tisai kaa bhaanaa ||
english: He who has created, also destroys; whatever happens is by His Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਆਇਆ ਅਸੀ ਕਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jo tin kar paaiaa s aagai aaiaa asee k hukam karehaa ||
english: Whatever He has done, has come to pass; how can we command Him?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਚੜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਹਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aavahu milahu saheleeho sachaRaa naam laehaa ||1||
english: Come, O my companions - let us meet together and dwell upon the True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਮੰਦਾ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: maran na ma(n)daa lokaa aakheeai je mar jaanai aisaa koi ||
english: Death would not be called bad, O people, if one knew how to truly die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਆਗੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sevihu saahib sa(n)mrath aapanaa pa(n)th suhelaa aagai hoi ||
english: Serve your Almighty Lord and Master, and your path in the world hereafter will be easy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਥਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੈ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਤਾਂ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)th suhelai jaavahu taa(n) phal paavahu aagai milai vadaaee ||
english: Take this easy path, and you shall obtain the fruits of your rewards, and receive honor in the world hereafter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੇਟੈ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ਤਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhetai siu jaavahu sach samaavahu taa(n) pat lekhai paaee ||
english: Go there with your offering, and you shall merge in the True Lord; your honor shall be confirmed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: mahalee jaai paavahu khasamai bhaavahu ra(n)g siu raleeaa maanai ||
english: You shall obtain a place in the Mansion of the Lord Master's Presence; being pleasing to Him, you shall enjoy the pleasures of His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਮੰਦਾ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maran na ma(n)daa lokaa aakheeai je koee mar jaanai ||2||
english: Death would not be called bad, O people, if one knew how to truly die. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਮੁਣਸਾ ਸੂਰਿਆ ਹਕੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਨਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ ॥
transliteration: maran munasaa sooriaa hak hai jo hoi maran paravaano ||
english: The death of brave heroes is blessed, if it is approved by God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰੇ ਸੇਈ ਆਗੈ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਮਾਣੋ ॥
transliteration: soore seee aagai aakheeahi daragah paavahi saachee maano ||
english: They alone are acclaimed as brave warriors in the world hereafter, who receive true honor in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਣੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: daragah maan paavahi pat siu jaavahi aagai dookh na laagai ||
english: They are honored in the Court of the Lord; they depart with honor, and they do not suffer pain in the world hereafter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: kar ek dhiaavahi taa(n) phal paavahi jit seviai bhau bhaagai ||
english: They meditate on the One Lord, and obtain the fruits of their rewards. Serving the Lord, their fear is dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੋ ॥
transliteration: oochaa nahee kahanaa man mahi rahanaa aape jaanai jaano ||
english: Do not indulge in egotism, and dwell within your own mind; the Knower Himself knows everything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਮੁਣਸਾਂ ਸੂਰਿਆ ਹਕੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maran munasaa(n) sooriaa hak hai jo hoi marahi paravaano ||3||
english: The death of brave heroes is blessed, if it is approved by God. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਈਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: naanak kis no baabaa roeeai baajee hai ihu sa(n)saaro ||
english: Nanak: for whom should we mourn, O Baba? This world is merely a play.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: keetaa vekhai saahib aapanaa kudarat kare beechaaro ||
english: The Lord Master beholds His work, and contemplates His creative potency.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਧਾਰਣ ਧਾਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: kudarat beechaare dhaaran dhaare jin keeaa so jaanai ||
english: He contemplates His creative potency, having established the Universe. He who created it, He alone knows.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: aape vekhai aape boojhai aape hukam pachhaanai ||
english: He Himself beholds it, and He Himself understands it. He Himself realizes the Hukam of His Command.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: jin kichh keeaa soee jaanai taa kaa roop apaaro ||
english: He who created these things, He alone knows. His subtle form is infinite.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਈਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kis no baabaa roeeai baajee hai ihu sa(n)saaro ||4||2||
english: Nanak: for whom should we mourn, O Baba? This world is merely a play. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 dakhanee ||
english: Wadahans, First Mehl, Dakhanee:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਚੜਾ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: sach sira(n)daa sachaa jaaneeai sachaRaa paravadagaaro ||
english: The True Creator Lord is True - know this well; He is the True Sustainer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਸਚੜਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: jin aapeenai aap saajiaa sachaRaa alakh apaaro ||
english: He Himself fashioned His Own Self; the True Lord is invisible and infinite.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਪੁੜ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: dui puR joR vichhoRian gur bin ghor a(n)dhaaro ||
english: He brought together, and then separated, the two grinding stones of the earth and the sky; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਸਿਰਜਿਅਨੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sooraj cha(n)d sirajian ahinis chalat veechaaro ||1||
english: He created the sun and the moon; night and day, they move according to His Thought. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੜਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਚੜਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sachaRaa saahib sach too sachaRaa dehi piaaro || rahaau ||
english: O True Lord and Master, You are True. O True Lord, bless me with Your Love. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: tudh sirajee medanee dukh sukh devanahaaro ||
english: You created the Universe; You are the Giver of pain and pleasure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਿਰਜਿਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
transliteration: naaree purakh sirajiai bikh maaiaa mohu piaaro ||
english: You created woman and man, the love of poison, and emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਦੇਹਿ ਜੀਆ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: khaanee baanee tereeaa dehi jeeaa aadhaaro ||
english: The four sources of creation, and the power of the Word, are also of Your making. You give Support to all beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kudarat takhat rachaaiaa sach nibeRanahaaro ||2||
english: You have made the Creation as Your Throne; You are the True Judge. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣੁ ਸਿਰਜਿਆ ਤੂ ਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: aavaa gavan sirajiaa too thir karanaihaaro ||
english: You created comings and goings, but You are ever-stable, O Creator Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਬਧਿਕੁ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਕਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa aai gaiaa badhik jeeu bikaaro ||
english: In birth and death, in coming and going, this soul is held in bondage by corruption.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਡੜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਬੂਡੜੈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: bhoodaRai naam visaariaa boodaRai kiaa tis chaaro ||
english: The evil person has forgotten the Naam; he has drowned - what can he do now?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਵਣਜਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gun chhod bikh ladiaa avagun kaa vanajaaro ||3||
english: Forsaking merit, he has loaded the poisonous cargo of demerits; he is a trader of sins. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦੜੇ ਆਏ ਤਿਨਾ ਜਾਨੀਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਚੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: sadaRe aae tinaa jaaneeaa hukam sache karataaro ||
english: The beloved soul has received the Call, the Command of the True Creator Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: naaree purakh vichhu(n)niaa vichhuRiaa melanahaaro ||
english: The soul, the husband, has become separated from the body, the bride. The Lord is the Re-uniter of the separated ones.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਹਣੀਐ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਬਧੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: roop na jaanai sohaneeai hukam badhee sir kaaro ||
english: No one cares for your beauty, O beautiful bride.; the Messenger of Death is bound only by the Lord Commander's Command.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲਕ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤੋੜਨਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੪॥
transliteration: baalak biradh na jaananee toRan het piaaro ||4||
english: He does not distinguish between young children and old people; he tears apart love and affection. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਦਰ ਠਾਕੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਚੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੈਣਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: nau dar thaake hukam sachai ha(n)s gaiaa gainaare ||
english: The nine doors are closed by the True Lord's Command, and the swan-soul takes flight into the skies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਛੁਟੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਵਿਧਣੀਆ ਮਿਰਤਕੜਾ ਅੰਙਨੜੇ ਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan chhutee muthee jhooth vidhaneeaa miratakaRaa a(n)nganaRe baare ||
english: The body-bride is separated, and defrauded by falsehood; she is now a widow - her husband's body lies dead in the courtyard.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੁਈ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਈਏ ਮਹਲ ਰੁੰਨੀ ਦਰ ਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: surat muee mar maaeee mahal ru(n)nee dar baare ||
english: The widow cries out at the door, "The light of my mind has gone out, O my mother, with his death."

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: rovahu ka(n)t maheleeho sache ke gun saare ||5||
english: So cry out, O soul-brides of the Husband Lord, and dwell on the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਜਾਨੀ ਨਾਵਾਲਿਆ ਕਪੜਿ ਪਟਿ ਅੰਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jal mal jaanee naavaaliaa kapaR pat a(n)baare ||
english: Her loved one is cleansed, bathed in water, and dressed in silken robes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜੇ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀਆ ਪੰਚ ਮੁਏ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: vaaje vaje sachee baaneeaa pa(n)ch mue man maare ||
english: The musicians play, and the Bani of the True Lord's Words are sung; the five relatives feel as if they too are dead, so deadened are their minds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੜੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaanee vichhu(n)naRe meraa maran bhaiaa dhrig jeevan sa(n)saare ||
english: "Separation from my beloved is like death to me!" cries the widow. "My life in this world is cursed and worthless!"

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਸੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਸਚੜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jeevat marai s jaaneeai pir sachaRai het piaare ||6||
english: But she alone is approved, who dies, while yet still alive; she lives for the sake of the Love of her Beloved. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਸੀ ਰੋਵਹੁ ਰੋਵਣ ਆਈਹੋ ਝੂਠਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tusee rovahu rovan aaeeho jhooth muthee sa(n)saare ||
english: So cry out in mourning, you who have come to mourn; this world is false and fraudulent.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮੁਠੜੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਣੀਆ ਪਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਅੜੀ ਵਿਧਣਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hau muthaRee dha(n)dhai dhaavaneeaa pir chhodiaRee vidhanakaare ||
english: I too have been defrauded, chasing after worldly entanglements; my Husband Lord has forsaken me - I practice the evil deeds of a wife without a spouse.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਮਹੇਲੀਆ ਰੂੜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ghar ghar ka(n)t maheleeaa rooRai het piaare ||
english: In each and every home, are the brides of the Husband Lord; they gaze upon their Handsome Lord with love and affection.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਹਉ ਰਹਸਿਅੜੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਭਤਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: mai pir sach saalaahanaa hau rahasiaRee naam bhataare ||7||
english: I sing the Praises of my True Husband Lord, and through the Naam, the Name of my Husband Lord, I blossom forth. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਵੇਸੁ ਪਲਟਿਆ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: gur miliai ves palatiaa saa dhan sach seegaaro ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, the soul-bride's dress is transformed, and she is adorned with Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: aavahu milahu saheleeho simarahu sirajanahaaro ||
english: Come and meet with me, O brides of the Lord; let's meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਈਅਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: baeear naam souhaaganee sach savaaranahaaro ||
english: Through the Naam, the soul-bride becomes the Lord's favorite; she is adorned with Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੀਤੁ ਨ ਬਿਰਹੜਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: gaavahu geet na birahaRaa naanak braham beechaaro ||8||3||
english: Do not sing the songs of separation, O Nanak; reflect upon God. ||8||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 ||
english: Wadahans, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੋਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jin jag siraj samaaiaa so saahib kudarat jaanovaa ||
english: The One who creates and dissolves the world - that Lord and Master alone knows His creative power.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੜਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੋਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaRaa door na bhaaleeai ghat ghat sabad pachhaanovaa ||
english: Do not search for the True Lord far away; recognize the Word of the Shabad in each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਾਚੀ ॥
transliteration: sach sabad pachhaanahu door na jaanahu jin eh rachanaa raachee ||
english: Recognize the Shabad, and do not think that the Lord is far away; He created this creation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਿੜ ਕਾਚੀ ॥
transliteration: naam dhiaae taa sukh paae bin naavai piR kaachee ||
english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains peace; without the Naam, he plays a losing game.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਥਾਪੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਵਖਾਣੋ ॥
transliteration: jin thaapee bidh jaanai soee kiaa ko kahai vakhaano ||
english: The One who established the Universe, He alone knows the Way; what can anyone say?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਵਤਾਇਆ ਜਾਲੋੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin jag thaap vataaiaa jaalou so saahib paravaano ||1||
english: The One who established the world cast the net of Maya over it; accept Him as your Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਅਧ ਪੰਧੈ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
transliteration: baabaa aaiaa hai uth chalanaa adh pa(n)dhai hai sa(n)saarovaa ||
english: O Baba, he has come, and now he must get up and depart; this world is only a way-station.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਚੜੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sir sir sachaRai likhiaa dukh sukh purab veechaarovaa ||
english: Upon each and every head, the True Lord writes their destiny of pain and pleasure, according to their past actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੀਆ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh deeaa jehaa keeaa so nibahai jee naale ||
english: He bestows pain and pleasure, according to the deeds done; the record of these deeds stays with the soul.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jehe karam karaae karataa doojee kaar na bhaale ||
english: He does those deeds which the Creator Lord causes him to do; he attempts no other actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਬਾਧੀ ਕਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਛਡਾਵਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: aap niraalam dha(n)dhai baadhee kar hukam chhadaavanahaaro ||
english: The Lord Himself is detached, while the world is entangled in conflict; by His Command, He emancipates it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਜੁ ਕਲਿ ਕਰਦਿਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਕਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aj kal karadiaa kaal biaapai doojai bhaai vikaaro ||2||
english: He may put this off today, but tomorrow he is seized by death; in love with duality, he practices corruption. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਉਝੜੁ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jam maarag pa(n)th na sujhaee ujhaR a(n)dh gubaarovaa ||
english: The path of death is dark and dismal; the way cannot be seen.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਲੇਫ ਤੁਲਾਈਆ ਨਾ ਭੋਜਨ ਪਰਕਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
transliteration: naa jal leph tulaaeeaa naa bhojan parakaarovaa ||
english: There is no water, no quilt or mattress, and no food there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੋਜਨ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਠੰਢਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: bhojan bhaau na tha(n)dhaa paanee naa kaapaR seegaaro ||
english: He receives no food there, no honor or water, no clothes or decorations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਊਭੌ ਨਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: gal sa(n)gal sir maare oobhau naa deesai ghar baaro ||
english: The chain is put around his neck, and the Messenger of Death standing over his head strikes him; he cannot see the door of his home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਬ ਕੇ ਰਾਹੇ ਜੰਮਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: ib ke raahe ja(n)man naahee pachhutaane sir bhaaro ||
english: The seeds planted on this path do not sprout; bearing the weight of his sins upon his head, he regrets and repents.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin saache ko belee naahee saachaa ehu beechaaro ||3||
english: Without the True Lord, no one is his friend; reflect upon this as true. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੁ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: baabaa rovahi ravahi s jaaneeahi mil rovai gun saarevaa ||
english: O Baba, they alone are known to truly weep and wail, who meet together and weep, chanting the Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੁਠੜੀ ਧੰਧੜਾ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: rovai maaiaa muthaRee dha(n)dhaRaa rovanahaarevaa ||
english: Defrauded by Maya and worldly affairs, the weepers weep.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਰੋਵੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa rovai mail na dhovai supana(n)tar sa(n)saaro ||
english: They weep for the sake of worldly affairs, and they do not wash off their own filth; the world is merely a dream.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁ ਭਰਮੈ ਭੂਲੈ ਝੂਠਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: jiu baajeegar bharamai bhoolai jhooth muthee aha(n)kaaro ||
