english: Like the juggler, deceiving by his tricks, one is deluded by egotism, falsehood and illusion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape maarag paavanahaaraa aape karam kamaae ||
english: The Lord Himself reveals the Path; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: naam rate gur poorai raakhe naanak sahaj subhaae ||4||4||
english: Those who are imbued with the Naam, are protected by the Perfect Guru, O Nanak; they merge in celestial bliss. ||4||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 ||
english: Wadahans, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
transliteration: baabaa aaiaa hai uth chalanaa ihu jag jhooth pasaarovaa ||
english: O Baba, whoever has come, will rise up and leave; this world is merely a false show.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਘਰੁ ਸਚੜੈ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੋਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa ghar sachaRai seveeai sach kharaa sachiaarovaa ||
english: One's true home is obtained by serving the True Lord; real Truth is obtained by being truthful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਲਬਿ ਜਾਂ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਸੀ ਅਗੈ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਠਾਓ ॥
transliteration: kooR lab jaa(n) thaai na paasee agai lahai na thaao ||
english: By falsehood and greed, no place of rest is found, and no place in the world hereafter is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਉ ਨ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਓ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar aau na baisahu kaheeai jiu su(n)njai ghar kaao ||
english: No one invites him to come in and sit down. He is like a crow in a deserted home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਡਾ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਗੁ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maran vadaa vechhoRaa binasai jag sabaae ||
english: Trapped by birth and death, he is separated from the Lord for such a long time; the whole world is wasting away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਬਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਖੜਾ ਰੂਆਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lab dha(n)dhai maaiaa jagat bhulaaiaa kaal khaRaa rooaae ||1||
english: Greed, worldly entanglements and Maya deceive the world. Death hovers over its head, and causes it to weep. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਵਹੁ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੇਹ ਆਸੀਸਾ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: baabaa aavahu bhaaeeho gal milah mil mil deh aaseesaa he ||
english: Come, O Baba, and Siblings of Destiny - let's join together; take me in your arms, and bless me with your prayers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਸਚੜਾ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੀਆ ਦੇਹ ਅਸੀਸਾ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: baabaa sachaRaa mel na chukaee preetam keeaa deh aseesaa he ||
english: O Baba, union with the True Lord cannot be broken; bless me with your prayers for union with my Beloved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸੀਸਾ ਦੇਵਹੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਵਹੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਲੋ ॥
transliteration: aaseesaa devaho bhagat karevaho miliaa kaa kiaa melo ||
english: Bless me with your prayers, that I may perform devotional worship service to my Lord; for those already united with Him, what is there to unite?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਥੇਹਹੁ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਖੇਲੋ ॥
transliteration: ik bhoole naavahu thehahu thaavahu gurasabadee sach khelo ||
english: Some have wandered away from the Name of the Lord, and lost the Path. The Word of the Guru's Shabad is the true game.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਵੇਸੇ ॥
transliteration: jam maarag nahee jaanaa sabad samaanaa jug jug saachai vese ||
english: Do not go on Death's path; remain merged in the Word of the Shabad, the true form throughout the ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੈਣ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਖੋਲੇ ਫਾਸੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saajan sain milahu sa(n)jogee gur mil khole phaase ||2||
english: Through good fortune, we meet such friends and relatives, who meet with the Guru, and escape the noose of Death. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਂਗੜਾ ਆਇਆ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: baabaa naa(n)gaRaa aaiaa jag mahi dukh sukh lekh likhaaiaa ||
english: O Baba, we come into the world naked, into pain and pleasure, according to the record of our account.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਅੜਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਨਾ ਟਲੈ ਜੇਹੜਾ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: likhiaRaa saahaa naa talai jehaRaa purab kamaaiaa ||
english: The call of our pre-ordained destiny cannot be altered; it follows from our past actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: bahi saachai likhiaa a(n)mrit bikhiaa jit laaiaa tit laagaa ||
english: The True Lord sits and writes of ambrosial nectar, and bitter poison; as the Lord attaches us, so are we attached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿਆਰੀ ਕਾਮਣ ਪਾਏ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਗਲਿ ਤਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: kaamaniaaree kaaman paae bahu ra(n)gee gal taagaa ||
english: The Charmer, Maya, has worked her charms, and the multi-colored thread is around everyone's neck.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਛਾ ਗੁੜੁ ਸਾ ਮਖੀ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hochhee mat bhaiaa man hochhaa guR saa makhee khaaiaa ||
english: Through shallow intellect, the mind becomes shallow, and one eats the fly, along with the sweets.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮਰਜਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਕਲਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨਾਂਗੋ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naa marajaad aaiaa kal bheetar naa(n)go ba(n)dh chalaaiaa ||3||
english: Contrary to custom, he comes into the Dark Age of Kali Yuga naked, and naked he is bound down and sent away again. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਵਹੁ ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਰੋਵਣਾ ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: baabaa rovahu je kisai rovanaa jaaneeaRaa ba(n)dh pathaaiaa hai ||
english: O Baba, weep and mourn if you must; the beloved soul is bound and driven off.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਅੜਾ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੀਐ ਦਰਿ ਹਾਕਾਰੜਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: likhiaRaa lekh na meteeai dar haakaaraRaa aaiaa hai ||
english: The pre-ordained record of destiny cannot be erased; the summons has come from the Lord's Court.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਾਕਾਰਾ ਆਇਆ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: haakaaraa aaiaa jaa tis bhaaiaa ru(n)ne rovanahaare ||
english: The messenger comes, when it pleases the Lord, and the mourners begin to mourn.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਭਾਤੀਜੇ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: put bhaaee bhaateeje rovahi preetam at piaare ||
english: Sons, brothers, nephews and very dear friends weep and wail.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਰੋਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਕੋ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮੁਇਆ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: bhai rovai gun saar samaale ko marai na muiaa naale ||
english: Let him weep, who weeps in the Fear of God, cherishing the virtues of God. No one dies with the dead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜਾਣ ਸਿਜਾਣਾ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak jug jug jaan sijaanaa rovahi sach samaale ||4||5||
english: O Nanak, throughout the ages, they are known as wise, who weep, remembering the True Lord. ||4||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਮਹਲਾ ਤੀਜਾ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 mahalaa teejaa ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh sachaRaa har saalaaheeai kaaraj sabh kichh karanai jog ||
english: Praise God, the True Lord; He is all-powerful to do all things.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰੰਡ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਬੈਸਈ ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan ra(n)d na kabahoo baisaee naa kade hovai sog ||
english: The soul-bride shall never be a widow, and she shall never have to endure suffering.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: naa kade hovai sog anadin ras bhog saa dhan mahal samaanee ||
english: She shall never suffer - night and day, she enjoys pleasures; that soul-bride merges in the Mansion of her Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jin priu jaataa karam bidhaataa bole a(n)mrit baanee ||
english: She knows her Beloved, the Architect of karma, and she speaks words of ambrosial sweetness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਹਿ ਅਪਣੇ ਕੰਤ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਲਗੈ ਵਿਜੋਗੋ ॥
transliteration: gunava(n)teeaa gun saarahi apane ka(n)t samaalahi naa kade lagai vijogo ||
english: The virtuous soul-brides dwell on the Lord's virtues; they keep their Husband Lord in their remembrance, and so they never suffer separation from Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sachaRaa pir saalaaheeai sabh kichh karanai jogo ||1||
english: So praise your True Husband Lord, who is all-powerful to do all things. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੜਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sachaRaa saahib sabad pachhaaneeai aape lae milaae ||
english: The True Lord and Master is realized through the Word of His Shabad; He blends all with Himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan pri kai ra(n)g ratee vichahu aap gavaae ||
english: That soul-bride is imbued with the Love of her Husband Lord, who banishes her self-conceit from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: vichahu aap gavaae phir kaal na khaae guramukh eko jaataa ||
english: Eradicating her ego from within herself, death shall not consume her again; as Gurmukh, she knows the One Lord God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਿੰਨੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaman ichh pu(n)nee a(n)tar bhi(n)nee miliaa jagajeevan daataa ||
english: The desire of the soul-bride is fulfilled; deep within herself, she is drenched in His Love. She meets the Great Giver, the Life of the World.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮਾਤੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabad ra(n)g raatee joban maatee pir kai a(n)k samaae ||
english: Imbued with love for the Shabad, she is like a youth intoxicated; she merges into the very being of her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੜਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sachaRaa saahib sabad pachhaaneeai aape lae milaae ||2||
english: The True Lord Master is realized through the Word of His Shabad. He blends all with Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jinee aapanaa ka(n)t pachhaaniaa hau tin poochhau sa(n)taa jaae ||
english: Those who have realized their Husband Lord - I go and ask those Saints about Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aap chhod sevaa karee pir sachaRaa milai sahaj subhaae ||
english: Renouncing ego, I serve them; thus I meet my True Husband Lord, with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਏ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਏ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: pir sachaa milai aae saach kamaae saach sabad dhan raatee ||
english: The True Husband Lord comes to meet the soul-bride who practices Truth, and is imbued with the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਰਾਂਡ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧੀ ॥
transliteration: kade na raa(n)d sadaa sohaagan a(n)tar sahaj samaadhee ||
english: She shall never become a widow; she shall always be a happy bride. Deep within herself, she dwells in the celestial bliss of Samaadhi.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pir rahiaa bharapoore vekh hadoore ra(n)g maane sahaj subhaae ||
english: Her Husband Lord is fully pervading everywhere; beholding Him ever-present, she enjoys His Love, with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jinee aapanaa ka(n)t pachhaaniaa hau tin poochhau sa(n)taa jaae ||3||
english: Those who have realized their Husband Lord - I go and ask those Saints about Him. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਭੀ ਮਿਲਹ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਹ ਸਾਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pirahu vichhu(n)neeaa bhee milah je satigur laagah saache paae ||
english: The separated ones also meet with their Husband Lord, if they fall at the Feet of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur sadaa daiaal hai avagun sabad jalaae ||
english: The True Guru is forever merciful; through the Word of His Shabad, demerits are burnt away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਗਵਾਏ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: augun sabad jalaae doojaa bhaau gavaae sache hee sach raatee ||
english: Burning away her demerits through the Shabad, the soul-bride eradicates her love of duality, and remains absorbed in the True, True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad sadaa sukh paaiaa haumai gaee bharaatee ||
english: Through the True Shabad, everlasting peace is obtained, and egotism and doubt are dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pir niramaail sadaa sukhadaataa naanak sabad milaae ||
english: The Immaculate Husband Lord is forever the Giver of peace; O Nanak, through the Word of His Shabad, He is met.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਭੀ ਮਿਲਹ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਹ ਸਾਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: pirahu vichhu(n)neeaa bhee milah je satigur laagah saache paae ||4||1||
english: The separated ones also meet with their Husband Lord, if they fall at the feet of the True Guru. ||4||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: suniahu ka(n)t maheleeho pir sevihu sabad veechaar ||
english: Listen, O brides of the Lord: serve your Beloved Husband Lord, and contemplate the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: avaganava(n)tee pir na jaanaee muthee rovai ka(n)t visaar ||
english: The worthless bride does not know her Husband Lord - she is deluded; forgetting her Husband Lord, she weeps and wails.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤ ਸੰਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: rovai ka(n)t sa(n)maal sadaa gun saar naa pir marai na jaae ||
english: She weeps, thinking of her Husband Lord, and she cherishes His virtues; her Husband Lord does not die, and does not leave.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jaataa sabad pachhaataa saachai prem samaae ||
english: As Gurmukh, she knows the Lord; through the Word of His Shabad, He is realized; through True Love, she merges with Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jin apanaa pir nahee jaataa karam bidhaataa kooR muthee kooRiaare ||
english: She who does not know her Husband Lord, the Architect of karma, is deluded by falsehood - she herself is false.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: suniahu ka(n)t maheleeho pir sevihu sabad veechaare ||1||
english: Listen, O brides of the Lord: serve your Beloved Husband Lord, and contemplate the Word of His Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag aap upaaion aavan jaan sa(n)saaraa ||
english: He Himself created the whole world; the world comes and goes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu khuaaian mar ja(n)mai vaaro vaaraa ||
english: The love of Maya has ruined the world; people die, to be re-born, over and over again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ਵਧਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਮੂਠੀ ॥
transliteration: mar ja(n)mai vaaro vaaraa vadhahi bikaaraa giaan vihoonee moothee ||
english: People die to be re-born, over and over again, while their sins increase; without spiritual wisdom, they are deluded.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਰੋਵੈ ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰੀ ਝੂਠੀ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai pir na paaio janam gavaaio rovai avaguniaaree jhoothee ||
english: Without the Word of the Shabad, the Husband Lord is not found; the worthless, false bride wastes her life away, weeping and wailing.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਰੋਈਐ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: pir jagajeevan kis no roeeai rovai ka(n)t visaare ||
english: He is my Beloved Husband Lord, the Life of the World - for whom should I weep? They alone weep, who forget their Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh jag aap upaaion aavan jaan sa(n)saare ||2||
english: He Himself created the whole world; the world comes and goes. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: so pir sachaa sad hee saachaa hai naa ohu marai na jaae ||
english: That Husband Lord is True, forever True; He does not die, and He does not leave.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਧਨ ਇਆਣੀਆ ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhoolee phirai dhan iaaneeaa ra(n)d baithee doojai bhaae ||
english: The ignorant soul-bride wanders in delusion; in the love of duality, she sits like a widow.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)d baithee doojai bhaae maaiaa mohi dukh paae aav ghatai tan chheejai ||
english: She sits like a widow, in the love of duality; through emotional attachment to Maya, she suffers in pain. She is growing old, and her body is withering away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਸੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh aaiaa sabh kichh jaasee dukh laagaa bhaai doojai ||
english: Whatever has come, all that shall pass away; through the love of duality, they suffer in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਝੈ ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jamakaal na soojhai maaiaa jag loojhai lab lobh chit laae ||
english: They do not see the Messenger of Death; they long for Maya, and their consciousness is attached to greed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so pir saachaa sad hee saachaa naa ohu marai na jaae ||3||
english: That Husband Lord is True, forever True; He does not die, and He does not leave. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਅੰਧੀ ਨਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: ik rovahi pirahi vichhu(n)neeaa a(n)dhee naa jaanai pir naale ||
english: Some weep and wail, separated from their Husband Lord; the blind ones do not know that their Husband is with them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee saachaa pir milai a(n)tar sadaa samaale ||
english: By Guru's Grace, they may meet with their True Husband, and cherish Him always deep within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: pir a(n)tar samaale sadaa hai naale manamukh jaataa doore ||
english: She cherishes her Husband deep within herself - He is always with her; the self-willed manmukhs think that He is far away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਰੁਲੈ ਰੁਲਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ihu tan rulai rulaaiaa kaam na aaiaa jin khasam na jaataa hadoore ||
english: This body rolls in the dust, and is totally useless; it does not realize the Presence of the Lord and Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਪਿਰੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: naanak saa dhan milai milaaee pir a(n)tar sadaa samaale ||
english: O Nanak, that soul-bride is united in Union; she cherishes her Beloved Husband forever, deep within herself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਅੰਧੀ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: ik rovahi pirahi vichhu(n)neeaa a(n)dhee na jaanai pir hai naale ||4||2||
english: Some weep and wail, separated from their Husband Lord; the blind ones do not know that their Husband is with them. ||4||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mah 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: rovahi pirahi vichhu(n)neeaa mai pir sachaRaa hai sadaa naale ||
english: Those who are separated from their Beloved Husband Lord weep and wail, but my True Husband Lord is always with me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਸਹੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jinee chalan sahee jaaniaa satigur sevahi naam samaale ||
english: Those who know that they must depart, serve the True Guru, and dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sadaa naam samaale satigur hai naale satigur sev sukh paaiaa ||
english: They dwell constantly upon the Naam, and the True Guru is with them; they serve the True Guru, and so obtain peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabade kaal maar sach ur dhaar phir aavan jaan na hoiaa ||
english: Through the Shabad, they kill death, and enshrine the True Lord within their hearts; they shall not have to come and go again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee naaee vekhai nadar nihaale ||
english: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His Name; bestowing His Gracious Glance, one is enraptured.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rovahi pirahu vichhu(n)neeaa mai pir sachaRaa hai sadaa naale ||1||
english: Those who are separated from their Beloved Husband Lord weep and wail, but my True Husband Lord is always with me. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਵ ਮਿਲਾਂ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh meraa saahib sabh doo oochaa hai kiv milaa(n) preetam piaare ||
english: God, my Lord and Master, is the highest of all; how can I meet my Dear Beloved?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਾਂ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur melee taa(n) sahaj milee pir raakhiaa ur dhaare ||
english: When the True Guru united me, then I was naturally united with my Husband Lord, and now, I keep Him clasped to my heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ur dhaare nehu naal piaare satigur te pir disai ||
english: I constantly, lovingly cherish my Beloved within my heart; through the True Guru, I see my Beloved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਕਾ ਕਚਾ ਚੋਲਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ ਪਗੁ ਖਿਸੈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa moh kaa kachaa cholaa tit paidhai pag khisai ||
english: The cloak of Maya's love is false; wearing it, one slips and loses his footing.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਚੋਲਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: pir ra(n)g raataa so sachaa cholaa tit paidhai tikhaa nivaare ||
english: That cloak is true, which is dyed in the color of the Love of my Beloved; wearing it, my inner thirst is quenched.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prabh meraa saahib sabh doo oochaa hai kiu milaa preetam piaare ||2||
english: God, my Lord and Master, is the highest of all; how can I meet my Dear Beloved? ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹੋਰ ਭੂਲੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mai prabh sach pachhaaniaa hor bhoolee avaganiaare ||
english: I have realized my True Lord God, while the other worthless ones have gone astray.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mai sadaa raave pir aapanaa sachaRai sabad veechaare ||
english: I dwell constantly upon my Beloved Husband Lord, and reflect upon the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਨਾਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad veechaare ra(n)g raatee naare mil satigur preetam paaiaa ||
english: The bride reflects upon the True Shabad, and is imbued with His Love; she meets with the True Guru, and finds her Beloved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar ra(n)g raatee sahaje maatee gaiaa dusaman dookh sabaaiaa ||
english: Deep within, she is imbued with His Love, and intoxicated with delight; her enemies and sufferings are all taken away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੰਉ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਤਾਂ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: apane gur ka(n)u tan man deejai taa(n) man bheejai trisanaa dookh nivaare ||
english: Surrender body and soul to your Guru, and then you shall become happy; your thirst and pain shall be taken away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹੋਰ ਭੂਲੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mai pir sach pachhaaniaa hor bhoolee avaganiaare ||3||
english: I have realized my True Lord God, while the other worthless ones have gone astray. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੜੈ ਆਪਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: sachaRai aap jagat upaaiaa gur bin ghor a(n)dhaaro ||
english: The True Lord Himself created the world; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
transliteration: aap milaae aap milai aape dei piaaro ||
english: He Himself unites, and causes us to unite with Him; He Himself blesses us with His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਸਹਜਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aape dei piaaro sahaj vaapaaro guramukh janam savaare ||
english: He Himself blesses us with His Love, and deals in celestial peace; the life of the Gurmukh is reformed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੋ ॥
transliteration: dhan jag mahi aaiaa aap gavaaiaa dar saachai sachiaaro ||
english: Blessed is his coming into the world; he banishes his self-conceit, and is acclaimed as true in the Court of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
transliteration: giaan ratan ghat chaanan hoaa naanak naam piaaro ||
english: The light of the jewel of spiritual wisdom shines within his heart, O Nanak, and he loves the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੜੈ ਆਪਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੋ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: sachaRai aap jagat upaaiaa gur bin ghor a(n)dhaaro ||4||3||
english: The True Lord Himself created the world; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. ||4||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
english: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜਜਰੀ ਹੈ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਜਰੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: ihu sareer jajaree hai is no jar pahuchai aae ||
english: This body is frail; old age is overtaking it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰੁ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare hor mar ja(n)mai aavai jaae ||
english: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved, while others die, to be reincarnated; they continue coming and going.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: hor mar ja(n)mahi aavahi jaavahi a(n)t gae pachhutaavahi bin naavai sukh na hoee ||
english: Others die, to be reincarnated; they continue coming and going, and in the end, they depart regretfully. Without the Name, there is no peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aithai kamaavai so phal paavai manamukh hai pat khoee ||
english: As one acts here, so does he obtain his rewards; the self-willed manmukh loses his honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਨਾ ਤਿਥੈ ਭੈਣ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jam pur ghor a(n)dhaar mahaa gubaar naa tithai bhain na bhaaee ||
english: In the City of Death, there is pitch darkness, and huge clouds of dust; neither sister nor brother is there.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜਜਰੀ ਹੈ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਜਰੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ihu sareer jajaree hai is no jar pahuchai aaee ||1||
english: This body is frail; old age is overtaking it. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa ka(n)chan taa(n) theeai jaa(n) satigur lae milaae ||
english: The body becomes like gold, when the True Guru unites one with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਸਚੜੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhram maaiaa vichahu kateeai sachaRai naam samaae ||
english: Doubt and Maya have been removed from within me, and I am merged in the Naam, the True Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sachai naam samaae har gun gaae mil preetam sukh paae ||
english: Merged in the True Name of the Lord, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; meeting my Beloved, I have found peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahai din raatee vichahu ha(n)umai jaae ||
english: I am in constant bliss, day and night; egotism has been dispelled from within me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹੰਉ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jinee purakhee har naam chit laaiaa tin kai ha(n)u laagau paae ||
english: I fall at the feet of those who enshrine the Naam within their consciousness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaa(n)iaa ka(n)chan taa(n) theeai jaa satigur lae milaae ||2||
english: The body becomes like gold, when the True Guru unites one with Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: so sachaa sach salaaheeai je satigur dei bujhaae ||
english: We truly praise the True Lord, when the True Guru imparts understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਨਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur bharam bhulaaneeaa kiaa muhu desan aagai jaae ||
english: Without the True Guru, they are deluded by doubt; going to the world hereafter, what face will they display?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਦੇਨਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਜਾਏ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kiaa den muhu jaae avagun pachhutaae dukho dukh kamaae ||
english: What face will they show, when they go there? They will regret and repent for their sins; their actions will bring them only pain and suffering.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਾ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naam rateeaa se ra(n)g chaloolaa pir kai a(n)k samaae ||
english: Those who are imbued with the Naam are dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love; they merge into the Being of their Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tis jevad avar na soojhaee kis aagai kaheeai jaae ||
english: I can conceive of no other as great as the Lord; unto whom should I go and speak?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so sachaa sach salaaheeai je satigur dei bujhaae ||3||
english: We truly praise the True Lord, when the True Guru imparts understanding. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਹੰਉ ਤਿਨ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jinee sachaRaa sach salaahiaa ha(n)u tin laagau paae ||
english: I fall at the feet of those who praise the Truest of the True.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: se jan sache niramale tin miliaa mal sabh jaae ||
english: Those humble beings are true, and immaculately pure; meeting them, all filth is washed off.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tin miliaa mal sabh jaae sachai sar naae sachai sahaj subhaae ||
english: Meeting them, all filth is washed off; bathing in the Pool of Truth, one becomes truthful, with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naam nira(n)jan agam agochar satigur deeaa bujhaae ||
english: The True Guru has given me the realization of the Naam, the Immaculate Name of the Lord, the unfathomable, the imperceptible.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat karahi ra(n)g raate naanak sach samaae ||
english: Those who perform devotional worship to the Lord night and day, are imbued with His Love; O Nanak, they are absorbed in the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹੰਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jinee sachaRaa sach dhiaaiaa ha(n)u tin kai laagau paae ||4||4||
english: I fall at the feet of those who meditate on the Truest of the True. ||4||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਲਲਾਂ ਬਹਲੀਮਾ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਾਵਣੀ ॥
transliteration: vadaha(n)s kee vaar mahalaa 4 lalaa(n) bahaleemaa kee dhun gaavanee ||
english: Vaar Of Wadahans, Fourth Mehl: To Be Sung In The Tune Of Lalaa-Behleemaa:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਵਡ ਹੰਸ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabad rate vad ha(n)s hai sach naam ur dhaar ||
english: The great swans are imbued with the Word of the Shabad; they enshrine the True Name within their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sach sa(n)grahahi sad sach rahahi sachai naam piaar ||
english: They gather Truth, remain always in Truth, and love the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa niramal mail na lagaee nadar keetee karataar ||
english: They are always pure and immaculate - filth does not touch them; they are blessed with the Grace of the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak hau tin kai balihaaranai jo anadin japahi muraar ||1||
english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who, night and day, meditate on the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਵਡ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: mai jaaniaa vad ha(n)s hai taa mai keeaa sa(n)g ||
english: I thought that he was a great swan, so I associated with him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਗੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਤ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਦੇਦੀ ਅੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: je jaanaa bag bapuRaa ta janam na dedee a(n)g ||2||
english: If I had known that he was only a wretched heron from birth, I would not have touched him. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਤਰੰਦਿਆ ਬਗਾਂ ਭਿ ਆਯਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)saa vekh tara(n)diaa bagaa(n) bh aayaa chaau ||
english: Seeing the swans swimming, the herons became envious.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਡੁਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਗ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਤਲਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dub mue bag bapuRe sir tal upar paau ||3||
english: But the poor herons drowned and died, and floated with their heads down, and their feet above. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: too aape hee aap aap hai aap kaaran keeaa ||
english: You Yourself are Yourself, all by Yourself; You Yourself created the creation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
transliteration: too aape aap nira(n)kaar hai ko avar na beeaa ||
english: You Yourself are Yourself the Formless Lord; there is no other than You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
transliteration: too karan kaaran samarath hai too karahi s theeaa ||
english: You are the all-powerful Cause of causes; what You do, comes to be.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਣਾ ਸਭਨਾਹਾ ਜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: too anama(n)giaa daan devanaa sabhanaahaa jeeaa ||
english: You give gifts to all beings, without their asking.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਆਖਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh aakhahu satigur vaahu vaahu jin daan har naam mukh deeaa ||1||
english: Everyone proclaims, "Waaho! Waaho!" Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, who has given the supreme gift of the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich sabh aakaar hai nirabhau har jeeu soi ||
english: The entire universe is in fear; only the Dear Lord is fearless.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਭਉ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur seviai har man vasai tithai bhau kade na hoi ||
english: Serving the True Guru, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and then, fear cannot stay there.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dusaman dukh tis no neR na aavai pohi na sakai koi ||
english: Enemies and pain cannot come close, and no one can touch him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh man veechaariaa jo tis bhaavai s hoi ||
english: The Gurmukh reflects upon the Lord in his mind; whatever pleases the Lord - that alone comes to pass.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਖਸੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak aape hee pat rakhasee kaaraj savaare soi ||1||
english: O Nanak, He Himself preserves one's honor; He alone resolves our affairs. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਜਣ ਚਲੇ ਇਕਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਏ ਰਹਦੇ ਭੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik sajan chale ik chal gae rahade bhee phun jaahi ||
english: Some friends are leaving, some have already left, and those remaining will eventually leave.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਆਇ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee satigur na sevio se aai gae pachhutaahi ||
english: Those who do not serve the True Guru, come and go regretting.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sach rate se na vichhuRahi satigur sev samaahi ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to Truth are not separated; serving the True Guru, they merge into the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਜਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tis mileeai satigur sajanai jis a(n)tar har gunakaaree ||
english: Meet with that True Guru, the True Friend, within whose mind the Lord, the virtuous One, abides.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tis mileeai satigur preetamai jin ha(n)umai vichahu maaree ||
english: Meet with that Beloved True Guru, who has subdued ego from within himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: so satigur pooraa dhan dha(n)n hai jin har upades de sabh srist savaaree ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the Perfect True Guru, who has given the Lord's Teachings to reform the whole world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: nit japiahu sa(n)tahu raam naam bhaujal bikh taaree ||
english: O Saints, meditate constantly on the Lord's Name, and cross over the terrifying, poisonous world-ocean.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਹੰਉ ਸਦ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur poorai har upadesiaa gur vitaRiahu ha(n)u sad vaaree ||2||
english: The Perfect Guru has taught me about the Lord; I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee sevaa chaakaree sukhee hoo(n) sukh saar ||
english: Service to, and obedience to the True Guru, is the essence of comfort and peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aithai milan vadiaaeeaa daragah mokh duaar ||
english: Doing so, one obtains honor here, and the door of salvation in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sachee kaar kamaavanee sach painan sach naam adhaar ||
english: In this way, perform the tasks of Truth, wear Truth, and take the Support of the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sachee sa(n)gat sach milai sachai naai piaar ||
english: Associating with Truth, obtain Truth, and love the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad harakh sadaa dar sachai sachiaar ||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, be always happy, and you shall be acclaimed as True in the True Court.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak satigur kee sevaa so karai jis no nadar karai karataar ||1||
english: O Nanak, he alone serves the True Guru, whom the Creator has blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: hor vidaanee chaakaree dhrig jeevan dhrig vaas ||
english: Cursed is the life, and cursed is the dwelling, of those who serve another.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਗੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਟਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit chhod bikh lage bikh khatanaa bikh raas ||
english: Abandoning the Ambrosial Nectar, they turn to poison; they earn poison, and poison is their only wealth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਕੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਰਾਸ ॥
transliteration: bikh khaanaa bikh painanaa bikh ke mukh giraas ||
english: Poison is their food, and poison is their dress; they fill their mouths with morsels of poison.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਮੁਇਆ ਨਰਕਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: aithai dukho dukh kamaavanaa muiaa narak nivaas ||
english: In this world, they earn only pain and suffering, and dying, they go to abide in hell.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਹਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh muhi mailai sabad na jaananee kaam karodh vinaas ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs have filthy faces; they do not know the Word of the Shabad; in sexual desire and anger they waste away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕੰਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur kaa bhau chhodiaa manahath ka(n)m na aavai raas ||
english: They forsake the Fear of the True Guru, and because of their stubborn ego, their efforts do not come to fruition.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jam pur badhe maareeahi ko na sune aradaas ||
english: In the City of Death, they are bound and beaten, and no one hears their prayers.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa guramukh naam nivaas ||2||
english: O Nanak, they act according to their pre-ordained destiny; the Gurmukh abides in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: so satigur sevihu saadh jan jin har har naam driRaaiaa ||
english: Serve the True Guru, O Holy people; He implants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in our minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: so satigur poojahu dinas raat jin jaga(n)naath jagadees japaaiaa ||
english: Worship the True Guru day and night; He leads us the meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Master of the Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: so satigur dekhahu ik nimakh nimakh jin har kaa har pa(n)th bataaiaa ||
english: Behold the True Guru, each and every moment; He shows us the Divine Path of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਪਗੀ ਪਵਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tis satigur kee sabh pagee pavahu jin moh a(n)dher chukaaiaa ||
english: Let everyone fall at the feet of the True Guru; He has dispelled the darkness of emotional attachment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਲਹਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so satagur kahahu sabh dha(n)n dha(n)n jin har bhagat bha(n)daar lahaaiaa ||3||
english: Let everyone hail and praise the True Guru, who has led us to find the treasure of the Lord's devotional worship. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਭੇਖੀ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai bhukh gaee bhekhee bhukh na jaai ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, hunger departs; by wearing the robes of a beggar, hunger does not depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਗੈ ਦੂਣੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh lagai ghar ghar phirai agai doonee milai sajaai ||
english: Afflicted with pain, he wanders from house to house, and in the world hereafter, he receives double punishment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਲੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar sahaj na aaio sahaje hee lai khaai ||
english: Peace does not come to his heart - he is not content to eat what comes his way.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਲੈਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manahath jis te ma(n)ganaa lainaa dukh manaai ||
english: With his stubborn mind, he begs, and grabs, and annoys those who give.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਭੇਖੈ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਗਿਰਹੋ ਭਲਾ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਕੋ ਵਰਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: is bhekhai thaavahu giraho bhalaa jithahu ko varasaai ||
english: Instead of wearing these beggar's robes, it is better to be a householder, and give to others.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad rate tinaa sojhee paee doojai bharam bhulaai ||
english: Those who are attuned to the Word of the Shabad, acquire understanding; the others wander, deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paiai kirat kamaavanaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaai ||
english: They act according to their past actions; it is useless to talk to them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaavahi se bhale jin kee pat paavahi thaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who are pleasing unto the Lord are good; He upholds their honor. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur seviai sadaa sukh janam maran dukh jaai ||
english: Serving the True Guru, one finds a lasting peace; the pains of birth and death are removed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: chi(n)taa mool na hovaee achi(n)t vasai man aai ||
english: He is not troubled by anxiety, and the carefree Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar teerath giaan hai satigur deeaa bujhaai ||
english: Deep within himself, is the sacred shrine of spiritual wisdom, revealed by the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mail gaee man niramal hoaa a(n)mrit sar teerath naai ||
english: His filth is removed, and his soul becomes immaculately pure, bathing in the sacred shrine, the pool of Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sajan mile sajanaa sachai sabad subhaai ||
english: The friend meets with the True Friend, the Lord, through the love of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ghar hee parachaa paaiaa jotee jot milaai ||
english: Within the home of his own being, he finds the Divine Self, and his light blends with the Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d jamakaal na chhodaee lai jaasee pat gavaai ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not leave the hypocrite; he is led away in dishonor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate se ubare sache siu liv laai ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam are saved; they are in love with the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਜਾਇ ਬਹਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਲੋਈਐ ॥
transliteration: tit jaai bahahu satasa(n)gatee jithai har kaa har naam biloeeai ||
english: Go, and sit in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the Name of the Lord is churned.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਖੋਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sahaje hee har naam lehu har tat na khoeeai ||
english: In peace and poise, contemplate the Lord's Name - don't lose the essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈਐ ॥
transliteration: nit japiahu har har dinas raat har daragah dhoeeai ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, constantly, day and night, and you shall be accepted in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖੋਈਐ ॥
transliteration: so paae pooraa sataguroo jis dhur masatak lilaat likhoeeai ||
english: He alone finds the Perfect True Guru, on whose forehead such a pre-ordained destiny is written.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੰਉ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਲ ਗਲੋਈਐ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tis gur ka(n)u sabh namasakaar karahu jin har kee har gaal galoeeai ||4||
english: Let everyone bow in worship to the Guru, who utters the sermon of the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sajan mile sajanaa jin satagur naal piaar ||
english: The friends who love the True Guru, meet with the Lord, the True Friend.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mil preetam tinee dhiaaiaa sachai prem piaar ||
english: Meeting their Beloved, they meditate on the True Lord with love and affection.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man hee te man maaniaa gur kai sabad apaar ||
english: Their minds are appeased by their own minds, through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹਿ ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ehi sajan mile na vichhuRahi j aap mele karataar ||
english: These friends are united, and will not be separated again; they have been united by the Creator Lord Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਈਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa darasan kee parateet na aaeeaa sabad na karahi veechaar ||
english: Some do not believe in the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; they do not contemplate the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: vichhuRiaa kaa kiaa vichhuRai jinaa doojai bhaai piaar ||
english: The separated ones are in love with duality - what more separation can they suffer?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਥੋੜੜਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh setee dosatee thoRaRiaa din chaar ||
english: Friendship with the self-willed manmukhs lasts for only a few short days.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਪਰੀਤੀ ਤੁਟਦੀ ਵਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਇਤੁ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਚਲਨਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: is pareetee tutadee vilam na hovaee it dosatee chalan vikaar ||
english: This friendship is broken in an instant; this friendship leads to corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jinaa a(n)dar sache kaa bhau naahee naam na karahi piaar ||
english: They do not fear the True Lord within their hearts, and they do not love the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਚੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tin siu kiaa keechai dosatee j aap bhulaae karataar ||1||
english: O Nanak, why become friends with those whom the Creator Lord Himself has misled? ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਦਾ ਇਕਤੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ik sadaa ikatai ra(n)g rahahi tin kai hau sad balihaarai jaau ||
english: Some remain constantly imbued with the Lord's Love; I am forever a sacrifice to them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tan man dhan arapee tin kau niv niv laagau paai ||
english: I dedicate my mind, soul and wealth to them; bowing low, I fall at their feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tin miliaa man sa(n)tokheeai trisanaa bhukh sabh jaai ||
english: Meeting them, the soul is satisfied, and one's hunger and thirst all depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate sukheee sadaa sache siu liv laai ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are happy forever; they lovingly focus their minds on the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tis gur kau hau vaariaa jin har kee har kathaa sunaaee ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who recites the sermon of the Lord's Teachings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tis gur kau sad balihaaranai jin har sevaa banat banaaee ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru, who has led me to serve the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਕਿਥੈ ਮੈਨੋ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: so satigur piaaraa merai naal hai jithai kithai maino lae chhadaaee ||
english: That Beloved True Guru is always with me; wherever I may be, He will save me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tis gur kau saabaas hai jin har sojhee paaee ||
english: Most blessed is that Guru, who imparts understanding of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਰਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak gur vitahu vaariaa jin har naam deeaa mere man kee aas puraaee ||5||
english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who has given me the Lord's Name, and fulfilled the desires of my mind. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦਾਧੀ ਜਲਿ ਮੁਈ ਜਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa daadhee jal muee jal jal kare pukaar ||
english: Consumed by desires, the world is burning and dying; burning and burning, it cries out.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੀਤਲ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: satigur seetal je milai phir jalai na doojee vaar ||
english: But if it meets with the cooling and soothing True Guru, it does not burn any longer.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak vin naavai nirabhau ko nahee jichar sabad na kare veechaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, and without contemplating the Word of the Shabad, no one becomes fearless. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੇਖੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bhekhee agan na bujhaee chi(n)taa hai man maahi ||
english: Wearing ceremonial robes, the fire is not quenched, and the mind is filled with anxiety.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਰਮੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਪੁ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: varamee maaree saap naa marai tiu nigure karam kamaahi ||
english: Destroying the snake's hole, the snake is not killed; it is just like doing deeds without a Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur daataa seveeai sabad vasai man aai ||
english: Serving the Giver, the True Guru, the Shabad comes to abide in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan seetal saa(n)t hoi trisanaa agan bujhaai ||
english: The mind and body are cooled and soothed; peace ensues, and the fire of desire is quenched.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sukhaa sir sadaa sukh hoi jaa vichahu aap gavaai ||
english: The supreme comforts and lasting peace are obtained, when one eradicates ego from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh udaasee so kare j sach rahai liv laai ||
english: He alone becomes a detached Gurmukh, who lovingly focuses his consciousness on the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਜਾ ਆਘਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chi(n)taa mool na hovaee har naam rajaa aaghaai ||
english: Anxiety does not affect him at all; he is satisfied and satiated with the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam binaa nah chhooteeai haumai pachahi pachaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, without the Naam, no one is saved; they are utterly ruined by egotism. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਅੜੇ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ॥
transliteration: jinee har har naam dhiaaiaa tinee paaiaRe sarab sukhaa ||
english: Those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, obtain all peace and comforts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਭੁਖਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh janam tinaa kaa saphal hai jin har ke naam kee man laagee bhukhaa ||
english: Fruitful is the entire life of those, who hunger for the Name of the Lord in their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖਾ ॥
transliteration: jinee gur kai bachan aaraadhiaa tin visar gae sabh dukhaa ||
english: Those who worship the Lord in adoration, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, forget all their pains and suffering.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਪਰਾਈ ਚੁਖਾ ॥
transliteration: te sa(n)t bhale gurasikh hai jin naahee chi(n)t paraaee chukhaa ||
english: Those Gursikhs are good Saints, who care for nothing other than the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਮੁਖਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n tinaa kaa guroo hai jis a(n)mrit phal har laage mukhaa ||6||
english: Blessed, blessed is their Guru, whose mouth tastes the Ambrosial Fruit of the Lord's Name. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kal mahi jam ja(n)daar hai hukame kaar kamaai ||
english: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Messenger of Death is the enemy of life, but he acts according to the Lord's Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare manamukhaa dei sajaai ||
english: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved, while the self-willed manmukhs receive their punishment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਫਰੂ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jamakaalai vas jag baa(n)dhiaa tis daa pharoo na koi ||
english: The world is under the control, and in the bondage of the Messenger of Death; no one can hold him back.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਮੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੋ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jin jam keetaa so seveeai guramukh dukh na hoi ||
english: So serve the One who created Death; as Gurmukh, no pain shall touch you.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਮੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh jam sevaa kare jin man sachaa hoi ||1||
english: O Nanak, Death serves the Gurmukhs; the True Lord abides in their minds. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਕਾਇਆ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ehaa kaaiaa rog bharee bin sabadai dukh haumai rog na jaai ||
english: This body is filled with disease; without the Word of the Shabad, the pain of the disease of ego does not depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai taa niramal hovai har naamo ma(n)n vasaai ||
english: When one meets the True Guru, then he becomes immaculately pure, and he enshrines the Lord's Name within his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaiaa sukhadaataa dukh visariaa sahaj subhaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Peace-Giving Lord, his pains are automatically forgotten. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin jagajeevan upadesiaa tis gur kau hau sadaa ghumaaiaa ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has taught me about the Lord, the Life of the World.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tis gur kau hau kha(n)neeai jin madhusoodan har naam sunaaiaa ||
english: I am every bit a sacrifice to the Guru, the Lover of Nectar, who has revealed the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tis gur kau hau vaaranai jin haumai bikh sabh rog gavaaiaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who has totally cured me of the fatal disease of egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਡ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਟਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tis satigur kau vad pu(n)n hai jin avagan kat gunee samajhaaiaa ||
english: Glorious and great are the virtues of the Guru, who has eradicated evil, and instructed me in virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: so satigur tin kau bhetiaa jin kai mukh masatak bhaag likh paaiaa ||7||
english: The True Guru meets with those upon whose foreheads such blessed destiny is recorded. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਰਜੀਵੜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat karahi marajeevaRe guramukh bhagat sadaa hoi ||
english: They alone worship the Lord, who remain dead while yet alive; the Gurmukhs worship the Lord continually.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: onaa kau dhur bhagat khajaanaa bakhasiaa met na sakai koi ||
english: The Lord blesses them with the treasure of devotional worship, which no one can destroy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan man paaiaa eko sachaa soi ||
english: They obtain the treasure of virtue, the One True Lord, within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh mil rahe phir vichhoRaa kade na hoi ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs remain united with the Lord; they shall never be separated again. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee sev na keeneeaa kiaa ohu kare veechaar ||
english: He does not serve the True Guru; how can he reflect upon the Lord?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਬਿਖੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabadai saar na jaanaee bikh bhoolaa gaavaar ||
english: He does not appreciate the value of the Shabad; the fool wanders in corruption and sin.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: agiaanee a(n)dh bahu karam kamaavai doojai bhaai piaar ||
english: The blind and ignorant perform all sorts of ritualistic actions; they are in love with duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: anahodaa aap ganaaide jam maar kare tin khuaar ||
english: Those who take unjustified pride in themselves, are punished and humiliated by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kis no aakheeai jaa aape bakhasanahaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, who else is there to ask? The Lord Himself is the Forgiver. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: too karataa sabh kichh jaanadaa sabh jee tumaare ||
english: You, O Creator, know all things; all beings belong to You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jis too bhaavai tis too mel laihi kiaa ja(n)t vichaare ||
english: Those who are pleasing to You, You unite with Yourself; what can the poor creatures do?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: too karan kaaran samarath hai sach sirajanahaare ||
english: You are all-powerful, the Cause of causes, the True Creator Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jis too melahi piaariaa so tudh milai guramukh veechaare ||
english: Only those unite with you, Beloved Lord, whom you approve and who meditate on Guru's Word.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਰੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur aapane jin meraa har alakh lakhaare ||8||
english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has allowed me to see my unseen Lord. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਜੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਰਤਨਾ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ratanaa paarakh jo hovai s ratanaa kare veechaar ||
english: He is the Assayer of jewels; He contemplates the jewel.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ratanaa saar na jaanaee agiaanee a(n)dh a(n)dhaar ||
english: He is ignorant and totally blind - he does not appreciate the value of the jewel.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ratan guroo kaa sabad hai boojhai boojhanahaar ||
english: The Jewel is the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Knower alone knows it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: moorakh aap ganaaide mar ja(n)mahi hoi khuaar ||
english: The fools take pride in themselves, and are ruined in birth and death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਨਾ ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak ratanaa so lahai jis guramukh lagai piaar ||
english: O Nanak, he alone obtains the jewel, who, as Gurmukh, enshrines love for it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਿਤ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa naam ucharai har naamo nit biuhaar ||
english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, forever and ever, make the Name of the Lord your daily occupation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kripaa kare je aapanee taa har rakhaa ur dhaar ||1||
english: If the Lord shows His Mercy, then I keep Him enshrined within my heart. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee sev na keeneeaa har naam na lago piaar ||
english: They do not serve the True Guru, and they do not embrace love for the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਤ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਓਇ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: mat tum jaanahu oi jeevade oi aap maare karataar ||
english: Do not even think that they are alive - the Creator Lord Himself has killed them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai vadaa rog hai bhaai doojai karam kamaai ||
english: Egotism is such a terrible disease; in the love of duality, they do their deeds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮੁਏ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak manamukh jeevadiaa mue har visariaa dukh paai ||2||
english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs are in a living death; forgetting the Lord, they suffer in pain. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jis a(n)tar hiradaa sudh hai tis jan kau sabh namasakaaree ||
english: Let all bow in reverence, to that humble being whose heart is pure within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jis a(n)dar naam nidhaan hai tis jan kau hau balihaaree ||
english: I am a sacrifice to that humble being whose mind is filled with the treasure of the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jis a(n)dar budh bibek hai har naam muraaree ||
english: He has a discriminating intellect; he meditates on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: so satigur sabhanaa kaa mit hai sabh tisahi piaaree ||
english: That True Guru is a friend to all; everyone is dear to Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
transliteration: sabh aatam raam pasaariaa gur budh beechaaree ||9||
english: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is pervading everywhere; reflect upon the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve jee ke ba(n)dhanaa vich haumai karam kamaahi ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, the soul is in the bondage of deeds done in ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve thaur na paavahee mar ja(n)mahi aavahi jaahi ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, one finds no place of rest; he dies, and is reincarnated, and continues coming and going.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve phikaa bolanaa naam na vasai man maahi ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, one's speech is vapid and insipid; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not abide in his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bin satigur seve jam pur badhe maareean muhi kaalai uth jaahi ||1||
english: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, they are bound and beaten in the City of Death; they arise and depart with blackened faces. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਲਉ ਐਸੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jaalau aisee reet jit mai piaaraa veesarai ||
english: Burn away those rituals which lead you to forget the Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saaee bhalee pareet jit saahib setee pat rahai ||2||
english: O Nanak, sublime is that love, which preserves my honor with my Lord Master. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: har iko daataa seveeai har ik dhiaaeeai ||
english: Serve the One Lord, the Great Giver; meditate on the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: har iko daataa ma(n)geeai man chi(n)diaa paaeeai ||
english: Beg from the One Lord, the Great Giver, and you shall obtain your heart's desires.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਦੂਜੇ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਾ ਲਾਜ ਮਰਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: je dooje paasahu ma(n)geeai taa laaj maraaeeai ||
english: But if you beg from another, then you shall be shamed and destroyed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jin seviaa tin phal paaiaa tis jan kee sabh bhukh gavaaeeai ||
english: One who serves the Lord obtains the fruits of his rewards; all of his hunger is satisfied.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak tin vitahu vaariaa jin anadin hiradai har naam dhiaaeeai ||10||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice to those, who night and day, meditate within their hearts on the Name of the Lord. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੰਉ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਜਨ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa ka(n)u aap tuthaa meraa piaaraa aape laian jan laai ||
english: He Himself is pleased with His humble devotees; my Beloved Lord attaches them to Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paatisaahee bhagat janaa kau diteean sir chhat sachaa har banaai ||
english: The Lord blesses His humble devotees with royalty; He fashions the true crown upon their heads.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sukheee niramale satigur kee kaar kamaai ||
english: They are always at peace, and immaculately pure; they perform service for the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੇ ਓਇ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਭਿੜਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: raaje oi na aakheeahi bhiR marahi phir joonee paahi ||
english: They are not said to be kings, who die in conflict, and then enter again the cycle of reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਕਂੀ ਵਢਂੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak vin naavai naka(n)ee vadha(n)ee phirahi sobhaa mool na paahi ||1||
english: O Nanak, without the Name of the Lord, they wander about with their noses cut off in disgrace; they get no respect at all. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖਿਐ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: sun sikhiai saad na aaio jichar guramukh sabad na laagai ||
english: Hearing the teachings, he does not appreciate them, as long as he is not Gurmukh, attached to the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur seviai naam man vasai vichahu bhram bhau bhaagai ||
english: Serving the True Guru, the Naam comes to abide in the mind, and doubts and fears run away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jehaa satigur no jaanai teho hovai taa sach naam liv laagai ||
english: As he knows the True Guru, so he is transformed, and then, he lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਆਗੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee har dar sohan aagai ||2||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, greatness is obtained; he shall be resplendent in the Court of the Lord hereafter. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਣ ਆਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa(n) man har preet hai gur poojan aavahi ||
english: The minds of the Gursikhs are filled with the love of the Lord; they come and worship the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: har naam vana(n)jahi ra(n)g siu laahaa har naam lai jaavahi ||
english: They trade lovingly in the Lord's Name, and depart after earning the profit of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa ke mukh ujale har daragah bhaavahi ||
english: The faces of the Gursikhs are radiant; in the Court of the Lord, they are approved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਂਝ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur bohal har naam kaa vadabhaagee sikh gun saa(n)jh karaavahi ||
english: The Guru, the True Guru, is the treasure of the Lord's Name; how very fortunate are the Sikhs who share in this treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੰਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੋ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: tinaa gurasikhaa ka(n)u hau vaariaa jo bahadiaa uthadiaa har naam dhiaavahi ||11||
english: I am a sacrifice to those Gursikhs who, sitting and standing, meditate on the Lord's Name. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak naam nidhaan hai guramukh paaiaa jaai ||
english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the treasure, which the Gurmukhs obtain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੀ ਵਥੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: manamukh ghar hodee vath na jaananee a(n)dhe bhauk mue bilalaai ||1||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are blind; they do not realize that it is within their own home. They die barking and crying. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)chan kaaiaa niramalee jo sach naam sach laagee ||
english: That body is golden and immaculate, which is attached to the True Name of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
