gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: niramal jot nira(n)jan paaiaa guramukh bhram bhau bhaagee ||
english: The Gurmukh obtains the Pure Light of the Luminous Lord, and his doubts and fears run away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh sadaa sukh paavahi anadin har bairaagee ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find lasting peace; night and day, they remain detached, while in the Love of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਨੀ ॥
transliteration: se gurasikh dhan dha(n)n hai jinee gur upades suniaa har ka(n)nee ||
english: Blessed, blessed are those Gursikhs, who, with their ears, listen to the Guru's Teachings about the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਭੰਨੀ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur naam driRaaiaa tin ha(n)umai dubidhaa bha(n)nee ||
english: The Guru, the True Guru, implants the Naam within them, and their egotism and duality are silenced.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੰਨੀ ॥
transliteration: bin har naavai ko mitr naahee veechaar dithaa har ja(n)nee ||
english: There is no friend, other than the Name of the Lord; the Lord's humble servants reflect upon this and see.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਲ ਮੰਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jinaa gurasikhaa kau har sa(n)tusat hai tinee satigur kee gal ma(n)nee ||
english: Those Gursikhs, with whom the Lord is pleased, accept the Word of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਚੜੀ ਚਵਗਣਿ ਵੰਨੀ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: jo guramukh naam dhiaaide tinee chaRee chavagan va(n)nee ||12||
english: Those Gurmukhs who meditate on the Naam are imbued with the four-fold color of the Lord's Love. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਇਰੁ ਕਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kaair karoop hai bin naavai nak naahi ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is cowardly and ugly; lacking the Name of the Lord, his nose is cut off in disgrace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: anadin dha(n)dhai viaapiaa supanai bhee sukh naahi ||
english: Night and day, he is engrossed in worldly affairs, and even in his dreams, he finds no peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਬਧੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh hovahi taa ubarahi naahi ta badhe dukh sahaahi ||1||
english: O Nanak, if he becomes Gurmukh, then he shall be saved; otherwise, he is held in bondage, and suffers in pain. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sadaa dar sohane gur kaa sabad kamaahi ||
english: The Gurmukhs always look beautiful in the Court of the Lord; they practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar saa(n)t sadaa sukh dar sachai sobhaa paahi ||
english: There is a lasting peace and happiness deep within them; at the Court of the True Lord, they receive honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh har naam paaiaa sahaje sach samaahi ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are blessed with the Name of the Lord; they merge imperceptibly into the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh prahilaad jap har gat paaee ||
english: As Gurmukh, Prahlaad meditated on the Lord, and was saved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh janak har naam liv laaee ||
english: As Gurmukh, Janak lovingly centered his consciousness on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਸਿਸਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh basisat har upades sunaaee ||
english: As Gurmukh, Vashisht taught the Teachings of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin gur har naam na kinai paaiaa mere bhaaee ||
english: Without the Guru, no one has found the Lord's Name, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਹਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: guramukh har bhagat har aap lahaaee ||13||
english: The Lord blesses the Gurmukh with devotion. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਈਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee parateet na aaeeaa sabad na laago bhaau ||
english: One who has no faith in the True Guru, and who does not love the Word of the Shabad,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਸ ਨੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਉ ਗੇੜਾ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: os no sukh na upajai bhaavai sau geRaa aavau jaau ||
english: shall find no peace, even though he may come and go hundreds of times.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh sahaj milai sache siu liv laau ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meets the True Lord with natural ease; he is in love with the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: e man aisaa satigur khoj lahu jit seviai janam maran dukh jaai ||
english: O mind, search for such a True Guru, by serving whom the pains of birth and death are dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sahasaa mool na hovaee haumai sabad jalaai ||
english: Doubt shall never afflict you, and your ego shall be burnt away through the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਪਾਲਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: kooRai kee paal vichahu nikalai sach vasai man aai ||
english: The veil of falsehood shall be torn down from within you, and Truth shall come to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar saa(n)t man sukh hoi sach sa(n)jam kaar kamaai ||
english: Peace and happiness shall fill your mind deep within, if you act according to truth and self-discipline.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak poorai karam satigur milai har jeeu kirapaa kare rajaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, by perfect good karma, you shall meet the True Guru, and then the Dear Lord, by His Sweet Will, shall bless you with His Mercy. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis kai ghar deebaan har hovai tis kee muthee vich jagat sabh aaiaa ||
english: The whole world comes under the control of one whose home is filled with the Lord, the King.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਤਲਕੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਆਣਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tis kau talakee kisai dee naahee har deebaan sabh aan pairee paaiaa ||
english: He is subject to no one else's rule, and the Lord, the King, causes everyone to fall at his feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸਾ ਕਿਅਹੁ ਦੀਬਾਣਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਸਿ ਭਜਿ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maanasaa kiahu deebaanahu koee nas bhaj nikalai har deebaanahu koee kithai jaaiaa ||
english: One may run away from the courts of other men, but where can one go to escape the Lord's Kingdom?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਹਦੇ ਖੁਹਦੇ ਆਣਿ ਸਭਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਅਗੈ ਖਲਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: so aisaa har deebaan vasiaa bhagataa kai hiradai tin rahade khuhade aan sabh bhagataa agai khalavaaiaa ||
english: The Lord is such a King, who abides in the hearts of His devotees; He brings the others, and makes them stand before His devotees.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: har naavai kee vadiaaee karam paraapat hovai guramukh viralai kinai dhiaaiaa ||14||
english: The glorious greatness of the Lord's Name is obtained only by His Grace; how few are the Gurmukhs who meditate on Him. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੁਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve jagat muaa birathaa janam gavaai ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, the people of the world are dead; they waste their lives away in vain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗਾ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai at dukh lagaa mar ja(n)mai aavai jaai ||
english: In love with duality, they suffer terrible pain; they die, and are reincarnated, and continue coming and going.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: visataa a(n)dar vaas hai phir phir joonee paai ||
english: They live in manure, and are reincarnated again and again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bin naavai jam maarasee a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, the Messenger of Death punishes them; in the end, they depart regretting and repenting. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰ ਸਗਲੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
transliteration: is jag mahi purakh ek hai hor sagalee naar sabaaee ||
english: In this world, there is one Husband Lord; all other beings are His brides.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh ghat bhogavai alipat rahai alakh na lakhanaa jaaee ||
english: He enjoys the hearts of all, and yet He remains detached; He is unseen; He cannot be described.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: poorai gur vekhaaliaa sabade sojhee paaee ||
english: The Perfect Guru reveals Him, and through the Word of His Shabad, we come to understand Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੈ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: purakhai sevahi se purakh hovahi jinee haumai sabad jalaaee ||
english: Those who serve their Husband Lord, become like Him; their egos are burnt away by His Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਵੈਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa sareek ko nahee naa ko ka(n)tak vairaaee ||
english: He has no rival, no attacker, no enemy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਰਾਜੁ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: nihachal raaj hai sadaa tis keraa naa aavai naa jaaee ||
english: His rule is unchanging and eternal; He does not come or go.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: anadin sevak sevaa kare har sache ke gun gaaee ||
english: Night and day, His servant serves Him, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak vekh vigasiaa har sache kee vadiaaee ||2||
english: Beholding the Glorious Greatness of the True Lord, Nanak blossoms forth. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਦ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਤਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jin kai har naam vasiaa sad hiradai har naamo tin ka(n)u rakhanahaaraa ||
english: Those whose hearts are forever filled with the Name of the Lord, have the Name of the Lord as their Protector.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har naam pitaa har naamo maataa har naam sakhaaee mitr hamaaraa ||
english: The Lord's Name is my father, the Lord's Name is my mother; the Lord's Name is my helper and friend.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਗਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har naavai naal galaa har naavai naal masalat har naam hamaaree karadaa nit saaraa ||
english: My conversation is with the Lord's Name, and my counseling is with the Lord's Name; the Lord's Name always takes care of me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har naam hamaaree sa(n)gat at piaaree har naam kul har naam paravaaraa ||
english: The Lord's Name is my most beloved society, the Lord's Name is my ancestry, and the Lord's Name is my family.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak ka(n)u har naam har gur deeaa har halat palat sadaa kare nisataaraa ||15||
english: The Guru, the Lord Incarnate, has bestowed upon servant Nanak the Name of the Lord; in this world, and in the next, the Lord ever saves me. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jin ka(n)u satigur bhetiaa se har keerat sadaa kamaahi ||
english: Those who meet the True Guru, ever sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t har naam tin kai man vasiaa sachai sabad samaahi ||
english: The Lord's Name naturally fills their minds, and they are absorbed in the Shabad, the Word of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਮੋਖ ਪਦਵੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kul udhaarahi aapanaa mokh padavee aape paahi ||
english: They redeem their generations, and they themselves obtain the state of liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਜਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham tin ka(n)u sa(n)tusat bhaiaa jo gur charanee jan paahi ||
english: The Supreme Lord God is pleased with those who fall at the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai kar kirapaa har laaj rakhaahi ||1||
english: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave; by His Grace, the Lord preserves his honor. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੰਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖੜਕੁ ਹੈ ਖੜਕੇ ਖੜਕਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)umai a(n)dar khaRak hai khaRake khaRak vihaai ||
english: In egotism, one is assailed by fear; he passes his life totally troubled by fear.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੰਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)umai vadaa rog hai mar ja(n)mai aavai jaai ||
english: Egotism is such a terrible disease; he dies, to be reincarnated - he continues coming and going.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tinaa satagur miliaa prabh aai ||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny meet with the True Guru, God Incarnate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak gur parasaadee ubare haumai sabad jalaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, they are redeemed; their egos are burnt away through the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har naam hamaaraa prabh abigat agochar abinaasee purakh bidhaataa ||
english: The Lord's Name is my immortal, unfathomable, imperishable Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮ ਸ੍ਰੇਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮ ਪੂਜਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har naam ham srevah har naam ham poojah har naame hee man raataa ||
english: I serve the Lord's Name, I worship the Lord's Name, and my soul is imbued with the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har naamai jevad koee avar na soojhai har naamo a(n)t chhadaataa ||
english: I know of no other as great as the Lord's Name; the Lord's Name shall deliver me in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har naam deeaa gur paraupakaaree dhan dha(n)n guroo kaa pitaa maataa ||
english: The Generous Guru has given me the Lord's Name; blessed, blessed are the Guru's mother and father.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੰਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਣੇ ਕੰਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: ha(n)u satigur apune ka(n)u sadaa namasakaaree jit miliai har naam mai jaataa ||16||
english: I ever bow in humble reverence to my True Guru; meeting Him, I have come to know the Lord's Name. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sev na keeneeaa har naam na lago piaar ||
english: One who does not serve the Guru as Gurmukh, who does not love the Lord's Name,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sabadai saad na aaio mar janamai vaaro vaar ||
english: and who does not savor the taste of the Shabad, shall die, and be reborn, over and over again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਇਆ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dh na chetaee kit aaiaa saisaar ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukh does not think of the Lord; why did he even come into the world?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੰਘੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jin kau nadar kare se guramukh la(n)ghe paar ||1||
english: O Nanak, that Gurmukh, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, crosses over the world-ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਗਤਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਗੁ ਸੂਤਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਸਿ ॥
transliteration: iko satigur jaagataa hor jag sootaa mohi piaas ||
english: Only the Guru is awake; the rest of the world is asleep in emotional attachment and desire.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਜਾਗੰਨਿ ਸੇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevan jaaga(n)n se jo rate sach naam gunataas ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru and remain wakeful, are imbued with the True Name, the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dh na chetanee janam mar hohi binaas ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not think of the Lord; they are ruined through birth and death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh tinee naam dhiaaiaa jin ka(n)u dhur poorab likhiaas ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is their destiny, pre-ordained by the Primal Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਛਤੀਹ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਇਐ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭਈ ॥
transliteration: har naam hamaaraa bhojan chhateeh parakaar jit khaaiai ham kau tripat bhaee ||
english: The Lord's Name is my food; eating the thirty-six varieties of it, I am satisfied and satiated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਨੰਗੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਹ ਹੋਰ ਪੈਨਣ ਕੀ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸਰਧ ਗਈ ॥
transliteration: har naam hamaaraa painan jit phir na(n)ge na hovah hor painan kee hamaaree saradh gaee ||
english: The Lord's Name is my clothing; wearing it, I shall never be naked again, and my desire to wear other clothing is gone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਵਣਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਹਮ ਕੰਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਰਕੁਨੀ ਦੀਈ ॥
transliteration: har naam hamaaraa vanaj har naam vaapaar har naamai kee ham ka(n)u satigur kaarakunee deeee ||
english: The Lord's Name is my business, the Lord's Name is my commerce; the True Guru has blessed me with its use.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਕਾ ਹਮ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਭ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਅਗਲੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਗਈ ॥
transliteration: har naamai kaa ham lekhaa likhiaa sabh jam kee agalee kaan gaee ||
english: I record the account of the Lord's Name, and I shall not be subject to death again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਪਈ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: har kaa naam guramukh kinai viralai dhiaaiaa jin ka(n)u dhur karam paraapat likhat paee ||17||
english: Only a few, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Lord's Name; they are blessed by the Lord, and receive their pre-ordained destiny. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jagat agiaanee a(n)dh hai doojai bhaai karam kamaai ||
english: The world is blind and ignorant; in the love of duality, it engages in actions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਨਿ ਧਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai jete karam kare dukh lagai tan dhaai ||
english: But those actions which are performed in the love of duality, cause only pain to the body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sukh oopajai jaa gur kaa sabad kamaai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, peace wells up, when one acts according to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: sachee baanee karam kare anadin naam dhiaai ||
english: He acts according to the True Word of the Guru's Bani; night and day, he meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੇ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jit aape laae tit lage kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, as the Lord Himself engages him, so is he engaged; no one has any say in this matter. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ham ghar naam khajaanaa sadaa hai bhagat bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
english: Within the home of my own being, is the everlasting treasure of the Naam; it is a treasure house, overflowing with devotion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਸਦ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: satagur daataa jee kaa sad jeevai devanahaaraa ||
english: The True Guru is the Giver of the life of the soul; the Great Giver lives forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: anadin keeratan sadaa karahi gur kai sabad apaaraa ||
english: Night and day, I continually sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise, through the Infinite Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਸਦ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵਰਤਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad guroo kaa sad ucharahi jug jug varataavanahaaraa ||
english: I recite continually the Guru's Shabads, which have been effective throughout the ages.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ihu manooaa sadaa sukh vasai sahaje kare vaapaaraa ||
english: This mind ever abides in peace, dealing in peace and poise.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar gur giaan har ratan hai mukat karaavanahaaraa ||
english: Deep within me is the Guru's Wisdom, the Lord's jewel, the Bringer of liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jis no nadar kare so paae so hovai dar sachiaaraa ||2||
english: O Nanak, one who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace obtains this, and is judged to be True in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n so gurasikh kaheeai jo satigur charanee jaai paiaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who goes and falls at the Feet of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n so gurasikh kaheeai jin har naamaa mukh raam kahiaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who with his mouth, utters the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n so gurasikh kaheeai jis har naam suniai man anad bhaiaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, whose mind, upon hearing the Lord's Name, becomes blissful.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n so gurasikh kaheeai jin satigur sevaa kar har naam laiaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who serves the True Guru, and so obtains the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕੰਉ ਹੰਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਚਲਿਆ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: tis gurasikh ka(n)u ha(n)u sadaa namasakaaree jo gur kai bhaanai gurasikh chaliaa ||18||
english: I bow forever in deepest respect to that Sikh of the Guru, who walks in the Way of the Guru. ||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਭ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manahath kinai na paaio sabh thake karam kamaai ||
english: No one has ever found the Lord through stubborn-mindedness. All have grown weary of performing such actions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manahath bhekh kar bharamade dukh paaiaa doojai bhaai ||
english: Through their stubborn-mindedness, and by wearing their disguises, they are deluded; they suffer in pain from the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: ridh sidh sabh mohu hai naam na vasai man aai ||
english: Riches and the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas are all emotional attachments; through them, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not come to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te man niramal hovai agiaan a(n)dheraa jaai ||
english: Serving the Guru, the mind becomes immaculately pure, and the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam ratan ghar paragat hoaa naanak sahaj samaai ||1||
english: The jewel of the Naam is revealed in the home of one's own being; O Nanak, one merges in celestial bliss. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabadai saad na aaio naam na lago piaar ||
english: One who does not savor the taste of the Shabad, who does not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa phikaa bolanaa nit nit hoi khuaar ||
english: and who speaks insipid words with his tongue, is ruined, again and again.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਪਇਐ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kirat paiai kamaavanaa koi na metanahaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, he acts according to the karma of his past actions, which no one can erase. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan sat purakh satiguroo hamaaraa jit miliai ham kau saa(n)t aaee ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the True Being, my True Guru; meeting Him, I have found peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan sat purakh satiguroo hamaaraa jit miliai ham har bhagat paaee ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the True Being, my True Guru; meeting Him, I have attained the Lord's devotional worship.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan har bhagat satiguroo hamaaraa jis kee sevaa te ham har naam liv laaee ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the Lord's devotee, my True Guru; serving Him, I have come to enshrine love for the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਸਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan har giaanee satiguroo hamaaraa jin vairee mitr ham kau sabh sam drisat dikhaaee ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the Knower of the Lord, my True Guru; He has taught me to look upon friend and foe alike.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: dhan dhan satiguroo mitr hamaaraa jin har naam siu hamaaree preet banaaee ||19||
english: Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, my best friend; He has led me to embrace love for the Name of the Lord. ||19||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮੁੰਧਿ ਵਿਦੇਸਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਰੇ ਸੰਮ੍ਹਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: ghar hee mu(n)dh vides pir nit jhoore sa(n)mhaale ||
english: The soul-bride is at home, while the Husband Lord is away; she cherishes His memory, and mourns His absence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਦਿਆ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਨੀਅਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: miladiaa dhil na hovaee je neeat raas kare ||1||
english: She shall meet Him without delay, if she rids herself of duality. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਲੀ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਬਾਝੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak gaalee kooReeaa baajh pareet karei ||
english: O Nanak, false is the speech of one who acts without loving the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tichar jaanai bhalaa kar jichar levai dei ||2||
english: He judges things to be good, only as long as the Lord gives and he receives. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jin upaae jee tin har raakhiaa ||
english: The Lord, who created the creatures, also protects them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit sachaa naau bhojan chaakhiaa ||
english: I have tasted the food of Ambrosial Nectar, the True Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ਮਿਟੀ ਭਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tipat rahe aaghaai mitee bhabhaakhiaa ||
english: I am satisfied and satiated, and my hunger is appeased.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਲਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh a(n)dar ik varatai kinai viralai laakhiaa ||
english: The One Lord is pervading in all, but rare are those who realize this.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪਾਖਿਆ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: jan naanak bhae nihaal prabh kee paakhiaa ||20||
english: Servant Nanak is enraptured, in the Protection of God. ||20||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur no sabh ko vekhadaa jetaa jagat sa(n)saar ||
english: All the living beings of the world behold the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਡਿਠੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dithai mukat na hovaee jichar sabad na kare veechaar ||
english: One is not liberated by merely seeing Him, unless one contemplates the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: haumai mail na chukaee naam na lagai piaar ||
english: The filth of ego is not removed, and he does not enshrine love for the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ik aape bakhas milaaian dubidhaa taj vikaar ||
english: The Lord forgives some, and unites them with Himself; they forsake their duality and sinful ways.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ik darasan dekh mar mile satigur het piaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, some behold the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, with love and affection; conquering their ego, they meet with the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo na sevio moorakh a(n)dh gavaar ||
english: The foolish, blind clown does not serve the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਲਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai bahut dukh laagaa jalataa kare pukaar ||
english: In love with duality, he endures terrible suffering, and burning, he cries out in pain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਨ ਉਪਕਰੇ ਅੰਤੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jin kaaran guroo visaariaa se na upakare a(n)tee vaar ||
english: He forgets the Guru, for the sake of mere objects, but they will not come to his rescue in the end.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramatee sukh paaiaa bakhase bakhasanahaar ||2||
english: Through the Guru's Instructions, Nanak has found peace; the Forgiving Lord has forgiven him. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਅਵਰੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: too aape aap aap sabh karataa koee doojaa hoi s avaro kaheeai ||
english: You Yourself, all by Yourself, are the Creator of all. If there were any other, then I would speak of another.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲੈ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har aape bolai aap bulaavai har aape jal thal rav raheeai ||
english: The Lord Himself speaks, and causes us to speak; He Himself is pervading the water and the land.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਛੋਡੈ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਪੜਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har aape maarai har aape chhodai man har saranee paR raheeai ||
english: The Lord Himself destroys, and the Lord Himself saves. O mind, seek and remain in the Lord's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਮਨ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਚਿੰਦ ਨਿਸਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har bin koee maar jeevaal na sakai man hoi nichi(n)d nisal hoi raheeai ||
english: Other than the Lord, no one can kill or rejuvenate. O mind, do not be anxious - remain fearless.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਠਦਿਆ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
transliteration: uthadiaa bahadiaa sutiaa sadaa sadaa har naam dhiaaeeai jan naanak guramukh har laheeai ||21||1|| sudh
english: While standing, sitting, and sleeping, forever and ever, meditate on the Lord's Name; O servant Nanak, as Gurmukh, you shall attain the Lord. ||21||1||Sudh||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ghar 1 chaupade ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਇਆ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਸਭਨਾਹ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa maranaa aaiaa vechhoRaa sabhanaah ||
english: Death comes to all, and all must suffer separation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਆਣਿਆ ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਕਿਨਾਹ ॥
transliteration: puchhahu jaai siaaniaa aagai milan kinaah ||
english: Go and ask the clever people, whether they shall meet in the world hereafter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਵਡੜੀ ਵੇਦਨ ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin meraa saahib veesarai vadaRee vedan tinaah ||1||
english: Those who forget my Lord and Master shall suffer in terrible pain. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhee saalaahihu saachaa soi ||
english: So praise the True Lord,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee nadar sadaa sukh hoi || rahaau ||
english: by whose Grace peace ever prevails. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: vadaa kar saalaahanaa hai bhee hosee soi ||
english: Praise Him as great; He is, and He shall ever be.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਮਾਣਸ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa daataa ek too maanas daat na hoi ||
english: You alone are the Great Giver; mankind cannot give anything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਰੰਨ ਕਿ ਰੁੰਨੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai ra(n)n k ru(n)nai hoi ||2||
english: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass; what good does it do to cry out in protest? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਉਪਰਿ ਕੋਟ ਗੜ ਕੇਤੀ ਗਈ ਵਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dharatee upar kot gaR ketee gaee vajaai ||
english: Many have proclaimed their sovereignty over millions of fortresses on the earth, but they have now departed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਅਸਮਾਨਿ ਨ ਮਾਵਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਨਕਿ ਨਥਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo asamaan na maavanee tin nak nathaa paai ||
english: And those, whom even the sky could not contain, had ropes put through their noses.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੂਲੀਆ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਿਠਾ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je man jaanahi sooleeaa kaahe mithaa khaahi ||3||
english: O mind, if you only knew the torment in your future, you would not relish the sweet pleasures of the present. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਗੁਣ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਗਲੀ ਜੰਜੀਰ ॥
transliteration: naanak augun jetaRe tete galee ja(n)jeer ||
english: O Nanak, as many as are the sins one commits, so many are the chains around his neck.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਨਿ ਤ ਕਟੀਅਨਿ ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਸੇ ਵੀਰ ॥
transliteration: je gun hon ta kateean se bhaaee se veer ||
english: If he possesses virtues, then the chains are cut away; these virtues are his brothers, his true brothers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਗਏ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਅਨਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਹੁ ਵੇਪੀਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: agai gae na ma(n)neean maar kadhahu vepeer ||4||1||
english: Going to the world hereafter, those who have no Guru are not accepted; they are beaten, and expelled. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਹਾਲੀ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: man haalee kirasaanee karanee saram paanee tan khet ||
english: Make your mind the farmer, good deeds the farm, modesty the water, and your body the field.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਾ ਰਖੁ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: naam beej sa(n)tokh suhaagaa rakh gareebee ves ||
english: Let the Lord's Name be the seed, contentment the plow, and your humble dress the fence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਜੰਮਸੀ ਸੇ ਘਰ ਭਾਗਠ ਦੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhaau karam kar ja(n)masee se ghar bhaagath dekh ||1||
english: Doing deeds of love, the seed shall sprout, and you shall see your home flourish. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: baabaa maaiaa saath na hoi ||
english: O Baba, the wealth of Maya does not go with anyone.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: in maaiaa jag mohiaa viralaa boojhai koi || rahaau ||
english: This Maya has bewitched the world, but only a rare few understand this. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਾਣੁ ਹਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਰਜਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਥੁ ॥
transliteration: haan hat kar aarajaa sach naam kar vath ||
english: Make your ever-decreasing life your shop, and make the Lord's Name your merchandise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੋਚ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਂਡਸਾਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਰਖੁ ॥
transliteration: surat soch kar bhaa(n)dasaal tis vich tis no rakh ||
english: Make understanding and contemplation your warehouse, and in that warehouse, store the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਨ ਹਸੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vanajaariaa siu vanaj kar lai laahaa man has ||2||
english: Deal with the Lord's dealers, earn your profits, and rejoice in your mind. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੀ ਸਤੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਲੈ ਚਲੁ ॥
transliteration: sun saasat saudaagaree sat ghoRe lai chal ||
english: Let your trade be listening to scripture, and let Truth be the horses you take to sell.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਰਚੁ ਬੰਨੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਮਤੁ ਮਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕਲੁ ॥
transliteration: kharach ba(n)n cha(n)giaaeeaa mat man jaanahi kal ||
english: Gather up merits for your travelling expenses, and do not think of tomorrow in your mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਦੇਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਮਹਲੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nira(n)kaar kai des jaahi taa sukh lahahi mahal ||3||
english: When you arrive in the land of the Formless Lord, you shall find peace in the Mansion of His Presence. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: laai chit kar chaakaree ma(n)n naam kar ka(n)m ||
english: Let your service be the focusing of your consciousness, and let your occupation be the placing of faith in the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਨੁ ਬਦੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਵਣੀ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਧੰਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)n badeeaa kar dhaavanee taa ko aakhai dha(n)n ||
english: Let your work be restraint from sin; only then will people call you blessed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਚੜੈ ਚਵਗਣ ਵੰਨੁ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak vekhai nadar kar chaRai chavagan va(n)n ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, the Lord shall look upon you with His Glance of Grace, and you shall be blessed with honor four times over. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੧ ਚਉਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: sorath mah 1 chautuke ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl, Chau-Thukay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਕੋ ਬੇਟਾ ਨੀਕਾ ਸਸੁਰੈ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਜਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maai baap ko betaa neekaa sasurai chatur javaaee ||
english: The son is dear to his mother and father; he is the wise son-in-law to his father-in-law.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਕੌ ਬਾਪੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਭਾਈ ਕੌ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: baal ka(n)niaa kau baap piaaraa bhaaee kau at bhaaee ||
english: The father is dear to his son and daughter, and the brother is very dear to his brother.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਬਾਹਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hukam bhaiaa baahar ghar chhodiaa khin mahi bhaee paraaee ||
english: By the Order of the Lord's Command, he leaves his house and goes outside, and in an instant, everything becomes alien to him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਧੂੜਿ ਧੁਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam daan isanaan na manamukh tit tan dhooR dhumaaee ||1||
english: The self-willed manmukh does not remember the Name of the Lord, does not give in charity, and does not cleanse his consciousness; his body rolls in the dust. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man maaniaa naam sakhaaee ||
english: The mind is comforted by the Comforter of the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਪਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paai parau gur kai balihaarai jin saachee boojh bujhaaee || rahaau ||
english: I fall at the Guru's feet - I am a sacrifice to Him; He has given me to understand the true understanding. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਸਿਉ ਝੂਠ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਵਾਦੁ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jag siu jhooth preet man bedhiaa jan siu vaad rachaaee ||
english: The mind is impressed with the false love of the world; he quarrels with the Lord's humble servant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ਮਰੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa magan ahinis mag johai naam na levai marai bikh khaaee ||
english: Infatuated with Maya, night and day, he sees only the worldly path; he does not chant the Naam, and drinking poison, he dies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੰਧਣ ਵੈਣਿ ਰਤਾ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)dhan vain rataa hitakaaree sabadai surat na aaee ||
english: He is imbued and infatuated with vicious talk; the Word of the Shabad does not come into his consciousness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਨ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਸਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ra(n)g na raataa ras nahee bedhiaa manamukh pat gavaaee ||2||
english: He is not imbued with the Lord's Love, and he is not impressed by the taste of the Name; the self-willed manmukh loses his honor. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saadh sabhaa mahi sahaj na chaakhiaa jihabaa ras nahee raaee ||
english: He does not enjoy celestial peace in the Company of the Holy, and there is not even a bit of sweetness on his tongue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਦਰ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man tan dhan apunaa kar jaaniaa dar kee khabar na paaee ||
english: He calls his mind, body and wealth his own; he has no knowledge of the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਮੀਟਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: akhee meet chaliaa a(n)dhiaaraa ghar dar disai na bhaaee ||
english: Closing his eyes, he walks in darkness; he cannot see the home of his own being, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jam dar baadhaa thaur na paavai apunaa keeaa kamaaee ||3||
english: Tied up at Death's door, he finds no place of rest; he receives the rewards of his own actions. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਅਖੀ ਵੇਖਾ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa akhee vekhaa kahanaa kathan na jaaee ||
english: When the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then I see Him with my own eyes; He is indescribable, and cannot be described.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)nee sun sun sabad salaahee a(n)mrit ridai vasaaee ||
english: With my ears, I continually listen to the Word of the Shabad, and I praise Him; His Ambrosial Name abides within my heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau nira(n)kaar niravair pooran jot samaaee ||
english: He is Fearless, Formless and absolutely without vengeance; I am absorbed in His Perfect Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak gur vin bharam na bhaagai sach naam vadiaaee ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, without the Guru, doubt is not dispelled; through the True Name, glorious greatness is obtained. ||4||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 dutuke ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁੜੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਪੁੜੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਆਸਣੁ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਚਉਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: puR dharatee puR paanee aasan chaar ku(n)t chaubaaraa ||
english: In the realm of land, and in the realm of water, Your seat is the chamber of the four directions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਣ ਕੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਟਕਸਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sagal bhavan kee moorat ekaa mukh terai takasaalaa ||1||
english: Yours is the one and only form of the entire universe; Your mouth is the mint to fashion all. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: mere saahibaa tere choj vidaanaa ||
english: O my Lord Master, Your play is so wonderful!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal bharipur leenaa aape sarab samaanaa || rahaau ||
english: You are pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; You Yourself are contained in all. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਕਿਨੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jah jah dekhaa tah jot tumaaree teraa roop kinehaa ||
english: Wherever I look, there I see Your Light, but what is Your form?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਰੂਪਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਪਰਛੰਨਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੇਹਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ikat roop phirahi parachha(n)naa koi na kis hee jehaa ||2||
english: You have one form, but it is unseen; there is none like any other. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)daj jeraj utabhuj setaj tere keete ja(n)taa ||
english: The beings born of eggs, born of the womb, born of the earth and born of sweat, all are created by You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਮੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਰਵੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ek purab mai teraa dekhiaa too sabhanaa maahi rava(n)taa ||3||
english: I have seen one glory of Yours, that You are pervading and permeating in all. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਮੈ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: tere gun bahute mai ek na jaaniaa mai moorakh kichh deejai ||
english: Your Glories are so numerous, and I do not know even one of them; I am such a fool - please, give me some of them!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਪਥਰੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak sun mere saahibaa dubadaa pathar leejai ||4||4||
english: Prays Nanak, listen, O my Lord Master: I am sinking like a stone - please, save me! ||4||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਤਿਤੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਤੂ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: hau paapee patit param paakha(n)dee too niramal nira(n)kaaree ||
english: I am a wicked sinner and a great hypocrite; You are the Immaculate and Formless Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਪਰਮ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit chaakh param ras raate thaakur saran tumaaree ||1||
english: Tasting the Ambrosial Nectar, I am imbued with supreme bliss; O Lord and Master, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: karataa too mai maan nimaane ||
english: O Creator Lord, You are the honor of the dishonored.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maan mahat naam dhan palai saachai sabad samaane || rahaau ||
english: In my lap is the honor and glory of the wealth of the Name; I merge into the True Word of the Shabad. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਮ ਊਰੇ ਹੋਛੇ ਤੂ ਗਉਰਾ ਹਮ ਹਉਰੇ ॥
transliteration: too pooraa ham oore hochhe too gauraa ham haure ||
english: You are perfect, while I am worthless and imperfect. You are profound, while I am trivial.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪਰਭਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tujh hee man raate ahinis parabhaate har rasanaa jap man re ||2||
english: My mind is imbued with You, day and night and morning, O Lord; my tongue chants Your Name, and my mind meditates on You. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਾਚੇ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਰਾਚੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
transliteration: tum saache ham tum hee raache sabad bhed phun saache ||
english: You are True, and I am absorbed into You; through the mystery of the Shabad, I shall ultimately become True as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਚੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਸੇ ਕਾਚੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ahinis naam rate se sooche mar janame se kaache ||3||
english: Those who are imbued with the Naam day and night are pure, while those who die to be reborn are impure. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: avar na deesai kis saalaahee tisahi sareek na koee ||
english: I do not see any other like the Lord; who else should I praise? No one is equal to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak daasan daasaa guramat jaaniaa soee ||4||5||
english: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of His slaves; by Guru's Instruction, I know Him. ||4||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: alakh apaar aga(n)m agochar naa tis kaal na karamaa ||
english: He is unknowable, infinite, unapproachable and imperceptible. He is not subject to death or karma.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਭਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaat ajaat ajonee sa(n)bhau naa tis bhaau na bharamaa ||1||
english: His caste is casteless; He is unborn, self-illumined, and free of doubt and desire. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: saache sachiaar vitahu kurabaan ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Truest of the True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naa tis roop varan nahee rekhiaa saachai sabad neesaan || rahaau ||
english: He has no form, no color and no features; through the True Word of the Shabad, He reveals Himself. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: naa tis maat pitaa sut ba(n)dhap naa tis kaam na naaree ||
english: He has no mother, father, sons or relatives; He is free of sexual desire; He has no wife.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਪਰ ਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: akul nira(n)jan apar para(n)par sagalee jot tumaaree ||2||
english: He has no ancestry; He is immaculate. He is infinite and endless; O Lord, Your Light is pervading all. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar braham lukaaiaa ghat ghat jot sabaaee ||
english: Deep within each and every heart, God is hidden; His Light is in each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bajar kapaat mukate guramatee nirabhai taaRee laaee ||3||
english: The heavy doors are opened by Guru's Instructions; one becomes fearless, in the trance of deep meditation. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੰਤਾ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)t upaai kaal sir ja(n)taa vasagat jugat sabaaee ||
english: The Lord created all beings, and placed death over the heads of all; all the world is under His Power.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: satigur sev padaarath paavahi chhootahi sabad kamaaee ||4||
english: Serving the True Guru, the treasure is obtained; living the Word of the Shabad, one is emancipated. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਚੈ ਭਾਡੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੂਚਾਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: soochai bhaadai saach samaavai virale soochaachaaree ||
english: In the pure vessel, the True Name is contained; how few are those who practice true conduct.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੰਤੈ ਕਉ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੬॥
transliteration: ta(n)tai kau param ta(n)t milaaiaa naanak saran tumaaree ||5||6||
english: The individual soul is united with the Supreme Soul; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||5||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਤਿਉ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: jiu meenaa bin paaneeai tiu saakat marai piaas ||
english: Like a fish without water is the faithless cynic, who dies of thirst.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰੀਐ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਜੋ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tiu har bin mareeai re manaa jo birathaa jaavai saas ||1||
english: So shall you die, O mind, without the Lord, as your breath goes in vain. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: man re raam naam jas lei ||
english: O mind, chant the Lord's Name, and praise Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin gur ihu ras kiu lahau gur melai har dei || rahaau ||
english: Without the Guru, how will you obtain this juice? The Guru shall unite you with the Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil sa(n)gatee guramukh teerath hoi ||
english: For the Gurmukh, meeting with the Society of the Saints is like making a pilgrimage to a sacred shrine.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: athasath teerath majanaa gur daras paraapat hoi ||2||
english: The benefit of bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage is obtained by the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਤਪੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu jogee jat baaharaa tap naahee sat sa(n)tokh ||
english: Like the Yogi without abstinence, and like penance without truth and contentment,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦੋਖੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tiu naamai bin dehuree jam maarai a(n)tar dokh ||3||
english: so is the body without the Lord's Name; death will slay it, because of the sin within. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saakat prem na paaeeai har paaeeai satigur bhaai ||
english: The faithless cynic does not obtain the Lord's Love; the Lord's Love is obtained only through the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: sukh dukh daataa gur milai kahu naanak siphat samaai ||4||7||
english: One who meets with the Guru, the Giver of pleasure and pain, says Nanak, is absorbed in the Lord's Praise. ||4||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਨਿ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਮ ਥਾਰੇ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: too prabh daataa daan mat pooraa ham thaare bhekhaaree jeeu ||
english: You, God, are the Giver of gifts, the Lord of perfect understanding; I am a mere beggar at Your Door.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mai kiaa maagau kichh thir na rahaaee har deejai naam piaaree jeeu ||1||
english: What should I beg for? Nothing remains permanent; O Lord, please, bless me with Your Beloved Name. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat rav rahiaa banavaaree ||
english: In each and every heart, the Lord, the Lord of the forest, is permeating and pervading.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਗੁਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal gupato varatai gurasabadee dekh nihaaree jeeu || rahaau ||
english: In the water, on the land, and in the sky, He is pervading but hidden; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is revealed. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਤ ਪਇਆਲ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: marat paiaal akaas dikhaaio gur satigur kirapaa dhaaree jeeu ||
english: In this world, in the nether regions of the underworld, and in the Akaashic Ethers, the Guru, the True Guru, has shown me the Lord; He has showered me with His Mercy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਨੀ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so braham ajonee hai bhee honee ghat bheetar dekh muraaree jeeu ||2||
english: He is the unborn Lord God; He is, and shall ever be. Deep within your heart, behold Him, the Destroyer of ego. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਪੁੜੋ ਇਨਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: janam maran kau ihu jag bapuRo in doojai bhagat visaaree jeeu ||
english: This wretched world is caught in birth and death; in the love of duality, it has forgotten devotional worship of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਕਤ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta guramat paaeeai saakat baajee haaree jeeu ||3||
english: Meeting the True Guru, the Guru's Teachings are obtained; the faithless cynic loses the game of life. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਗਰਭ ਮਝਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur ba(n)dhan toR niraare bahuR na garabh majhaaree jeeu ||
english: Breaking my bonds, the True Guru has set me free, and I shall not be cast into the womb of reincarnation again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak giaan ratan paragaasiaa har man vasiaa nira(n)kaaree jeeu ||4||8||
english: O Nanak, the jewel of spiritual wisdom shines forth, and the Lord, the Formless Lord, dwells within my mind. ||4||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤੁਮ ਜਗਿ ਆਏ ਸੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jis jal nidh kaaran tum jag aae so a(n)mrit gur paahee jeeu ||
english: The treasure of the Name, for which you have come into the world - that Ambrosial Nectar is with the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਵੇਸੁ ਭੇਖ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਇਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chhodahu ves bhekh chaturaaee dubidhaa ihu phal naahee jeeu ||1||
english: Renounce costumes, disguises and clever tricks; this fruit is not obtained by duplicity. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੁ ਮਤੁ ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: man re thir rahu mat kat jaahee jeeu ||
english: O my mind, remain steady, and do not wander away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਢੂਢਤ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਘਟ ਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: baahar dhoodhat bahut dukh paavahi ghar a(n)mrit ghat maahee jeeu || rahaau ||
english: By searching around on the outside, you shall only suffer great pain; the Ambrosial Nectar is found within the home of your own being. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਪਛੁਤਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: avagun chhod gunaa kau dhaavahu kar avagun pachhutaahee jeeu ||
english: Renounce corruption, and seek virtue; committing sins, you shall only come to regret and repent.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰ ਅਪਸਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਕੀਚ ਬੁਡਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sar apasar kee saar na jaanahi phir phir keech budaahee jeeu ||2||
english: You do not know the difference between good and evil; again and again, you sink into the mud. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲੋਭ ਬਹੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਕਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar mail lobh bahu jhoothe baahar naavahu kaahee jeeu ||
english: Within you is the great filth of greed and falsehood; why do you bother to wash your body on the outside?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਤਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: niramal naam japahu sad guramukh a(n)tar kee gat taahee jeeu ||3||
english: Chant the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord always, under Guru's Instruction; only then will your innermost being be emancipated. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: parahar lobh ni(n)daa kooR tiaagahu sach gur bachanee phal paahee jeeu ||
english: Let greed and slander be far away from you, and renounce falsehood; through the True Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall obtain the true fruit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakhahu har jeeu jan naanak sabad salaahee jeeu ||4||9||
english: As it pleases You, You preserve me, Dear Lord; servant Nanak sings the Praises of Your Shabad. ||4||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 pa(n)chapade ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਮੂਸਤ ਰਾਖਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਕੀ ਪਰ ਘਰੁ ਜੋਹਨ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: apanaa ghar moosat raakh na saakahi kee par ghar johan laagaa ||
english: You cannot save your own home from being plundered; why do you spy on the houses of others?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਜੇ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ghar dar raakhahi je ras chaakhahi jo guramukh sevak laagaa ||1||
english: That Gurmukh who joins himself to the Guru's service, saves his own home, and tastes the Lord's Nectar. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਮਝੁ ਕਵਨ ਮਤਿ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: man re samajh kavan mat laagaa ||
english: O mind, you must realize what your intellect is focused on.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਲੋਭਾਨੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ਅਭਾਗਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam visaar an ras lobhaane phir pachhutaahi abhaagaa || rahaau ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is involved with other tastes; the unfortunate wretch shall come to regret it in the end. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਕਉ ਹਰਖ ਜਾਤ ਕਉ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਲੇ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: aavat kau harakh jaat kau rovahi ihu dukh sukh naale laagaa ||
english: When things come, he is pleased, but when they go, he weeps and wails; this pain and pleasure remains attached to him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਭੋਗਿ ਭੋਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਅਨਰਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape dukh sukh bhog bhogaavai guramukh so anaraagaa ||2||
english: The Lord Himself causes him to enjoy pleasure and endure pain; the Gurmukh, however, remains unaffected. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: har ras oopar avar kiaa kaheeai jin peeaa so tripataagaa ||
english: What else can be said to be above the subtle essence of the Lord? One who drinks it in is satisfied and satiated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਤ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohit jin ihu ras khoiaa jaa saakat duramat laagaa ||3||
english: One who is lured by Maya loses this juice; that faithless cynic is tied to his evil-mindedness. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਵਨਪਤਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਦੇਉ ਸਮਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: man kaa jeeu pavanapat dehee dehee mahi deu samaagaa ||
english: The Lord is the life of the mind, the Master of the breath of life; the Divine Lord is contained in the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਗਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: je too dehi ta har ras gaaee man tripatai har liv laagaa ||4||
english: If You so bless us, Lord, then we sing Your Praises; the mind is satisfied and fulfilled, lovingly attached to the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਜਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat mahi har ras paaeeai gur miliai jam bhau bhaagaa ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the subtle essence of the Lord is obtained; meeting the Guru, the fear of death departs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੫॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam jap guramukh har paae masatak bhaagaa ||5||10||
english: O Nanak, chant the Name of the Lord, as Gurmukh; you shall obtain the Lord, and realize your pre-ordained destiny. ||5||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਧੁਰਾਹੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab jeeaa sir lekh dhuraahoo bin lekhai nahee koee jeeu ||
english: Destiny, pre-ordained by the Lord, looms over the heads of all beings; no one is without this pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aap alekh kudarat kar dekhai hukam chalaae soee jeeu ||1||
english: Only He Himself is beyond destiny; creating the creation by His creative power, He beholds it, and causes His Command to be followed. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: man re raam japahu sukh hoee ||
english: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, and be at peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ahinis gur ke charan sarevahu har daataa bhugataa soee || rahaau ||
english: Day and night, serve at the Guru's feet; the Lord is the Giver, and the Enjoyer. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jo a(n)tar so baahar dekhahu avar na doojaa koee jeeu ||
english: He is within - see Him outside as well; there is no one, other than Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh ek drisat kar dekhahu ghat ghat jot samoee jeeu ||2||
english: As Gurmukh, look upon all with the single eye of equality; in each and every heart, the Divine Light is contained. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਲਤੌ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: chalatau thaak rakhahu ghar apanai gur miliai ih mat hoee jeeu ||
english: Restrain your fickle mind, and keep it steady within its own home; meeting the Guru, this understanding is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਰਹਉ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dekh adrisat rahau bisamaadee dukh bisarai sukh hoee jeeu ||3||
english: Seeing the unseen Lord, you shall be amazed and delighted; forgetting your pain, you shall be at peace. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਹੁ ਅਪਿਉ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: peevahu apiu param sukh paaeeai nij ghar vaasaa hoee jeeu ||
english: Drinking in the ambrosial nectar, you shall attain the highest bliss, and dwell within the home of your own self.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: janam maran bhav bha(n)jan gaaeeai punarap janam na hoee jeeu ||4||
english: So sing the Praises of the Lord, the Destroyer of the fear of birth and death, and you shall not be reincarnated again. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਸੋਹੰ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tat nira(n)jan jot sabaaee soha(n) bhed na koee jeeu ||
english: The essence, the immaculate Lord, the Light of all - I am He and He is me - there is no difference between us.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧੧॥
transliteration: apara(n)par paarabraham paramesar naanak gur miliaa soee jeeu ||5||11||
english: The Infinite Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God - Nanak has met with Him, the Guru. ||5||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ghar 3 ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa tis bhaavaa tad hee gaavaa ||
english: When I am pleasing to Him, then I sing His Praises.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਗਾਵੇ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: taa gaave kaa phal paavaa ||
english: Singing His Praises, I receive the fruits of my rewards.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੇ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gaave kaa phal hoee ||
english: The rewards of singing His Praises

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa aape devai soee ||1||
english: Are obtained when He Himself gives them. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man mere gur bachanee nidh paaee ||
english: O my mind, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the treasure is obtained;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taa te sach mahi rahiaa samaaee || rahaau ||
english: this is why I remain immersed in the True Name. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: gur saakhee a(n)tar jaagee ||
english: When I awoke within myself to the Guru's Teachings,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
transliteration: taa cha(n)chal mat tiaagee ||
english: then I renounced my fickle intellect.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਕਾ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur saakhee kaa ujeeaaraa ||
english: When the Light of the Guru's Teachings dawned,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਧੵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa mitiaa sagal a(n)dhyaaraa ||2||
english: and then all darkness was dispelled. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: gur charanee man laagaa ||
english: When the mind is attached to the Guru's Feet,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: taa jam kaa maarag bhaagaa ||
english: then the Path of Death recedes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhai vich nirabhau paaiaa ||
english: Through the Fear of God, one attains the Fearless Lord;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਸਹਜੈ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa sahajai kai ghar aaiaa ||3||
english: then, one enters the home of celestial bliss. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak boojhai ko beechaaree ||
english: Prays Nanak, how rare are those who reflect and understand,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: is jag mahi karanee saaree ||
english: the most sublime action in this world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: karanee keerat hoee ||
english: The noblest deed is to sing the Lord's Praises,

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: jaa aape miliaa soee ||4||1||12||
english: and so meet the Lord Himself. ||4||1||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sevak sev karahi sabh teree jin sabadai saad aaiaa ||
english: All of Your servants, who relish the Word of Your Shabad, serve You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te niramal hoaa jin vichahu aap gavaaiaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, they become pure, eradicating self-conceit from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin gun gaavahi nit saache gur kai sabad suhaaiaa ||1||
english: Night and day, they continually sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; they are adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: mere thaakur ham baarik saran tumaaree ||
english: O my Lord and Master, I am Your child; I seek Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਕੇਵਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: eko sachaa sach too keval aap muraaree || rahaau ||
english: You are the One and Only Lord, the Truest of the True; You Yourself are the Destroyer of ego. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jaagat rahe tinee prabh paaiaa sabade haumai maaree ||
english: Those who remain wakeful obtain God; through the Word of the Shabad, they conquer their ego.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: girahee mahi sadaa har jan udaasee giaan tat beechaaree ||
english: Immersed in family life, the Lord's humble servant ever remains detached; he reflects upon the essence of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaiaa har raakhiaa ur dhaaree ||2||
english: Serving the True Guru, he finds eternal peace, and he keeps the Lord enshrined in his heart. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ihu manooaa dah dis dhaavadaa doojai bhaai khuaaiaa ||
english: This mind wanders in the ten directions; it is consumed by the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mugadh har naam na chetai birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||
english: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord's Name; he wastes away his life in vain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਏ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur bhete taa naau paae haumai mohu chukaaiaa ||3||
english: But when he meets the True Guru, then he obtains the Name; he sheds egotism and emotional attachment. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har jan saache saach kamaavahi gur kai sabad veechaaree ||
english: The Lord's humble servants are True - they practice Truth, and reflect upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aape mel lae prabh saachai saach rakhiaa ur dhaaree ||
english: The True Lord God unites them with Himself, and they keep the True Lord enshrined in their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਏਹਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naavahu gat mat paaee ehaa raas hamaaree ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, through the Name, I have obtained salvation and understanding; this alone is my wealth. ||4||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ||
english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਉ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat khajaanaa bhagatan kau deeaa naau har dhan sach soi ||
english: The True Lord has blessed His devotees with the treasure of devotional worship, and the wealth of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਕਦੇ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: akhut naam dhan kade nikhutai naahee kinai na keemat hoi ||
english: The wealth of the Naam, shall never be exhausted; no one can estimate its worth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਧਨਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam dhan mukh ujale hoe har paaiaa sach soi ||1||
english: With the wealth of the Naam, their faces are radiant, and they attain the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man mere gurasabadee har paaiaa jaai ||
english: O my mind, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਭੁਲਦਾ ਫਿਰਦਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai jag bhuladaa phiradaa daragah milai sajaai || rahaau ||
english: Without the Shabad, the world wanders around, and receives its punishment in the Court of the Lord. ||Pause||
