author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਵਸਹਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: is dehee a(n)dar pa(n)ch chor vasahi kaam krodh lobh mohu aha(n)kaaraa ||
english: Within this body dwell the five thieves: sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੂਟਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਣੈ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit lootahi manamukh nahee boojhahi koi na sunai pookaaraa ||
english: They plunder the Nectar, but the self-willed manmukh does not realize it; no one hears his complaint.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)dhaa jagat a(n)dh varataaraa baajh guroo gubaaraa ||2||
english: The world is blind, and its dealings are blind as well; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ਕਿਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai meraa kar kar vigute kihu chalai na chaladiaa naal ||
english: Indulging in egotism and possessiveness, they are ruined; when they depart, nothing goes along with them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s naam dhiaavai sadaa har naam samaal ||
english: But one who becomes Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and ever contemplates the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sachee baanee har gun gaavai nadaree nadar nihaal ||3||
english: Through the True Word of Gurbani, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, he is enraptured. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur giaan sadaa ghat chaanan amar sir baadisaahaa ||
english: The spiritual wisdom of the True Guru is a steady light within the heart. The Lord's decree is over the heads of even kings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat karahi din raatee raam naam sach laahaa ||
english: Night and day, the Lord's devotees worship Him; night and day, they gather in the true profit of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam nisataaraa sabad rate har paahaa ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, one is emancipated; attuned to the Shabad, he finds the Lord. ||4||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sorath mah 3 ||
english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: daasan daas hovai taa har paae vichahu aap gavaaee ||
english: If one becomes the slave of the Lord's slaves, then he finds the Lord, and eradicates ego from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa kaa kaaraj har ana(n)d hai anadin har gun gaaee ||
english: The Lord of bliss is his object of devotion; night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabad rate sadaa ik ra(n)gee har siu rahe samaaee ||1||
english: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, the Lord's devotees remain ever as one, absorbed in the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu saachee nadar tumaaree ||
english: O Dear Lord, Your Glance of Grace is True.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਦਾਸਾ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aapaniaa daasaa no kripaa kar piaare raakhahu paij hamaaree || rahaau ||
english: Show mercy to Your slave, O Beloved Lord, and preserve my honor. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad salaahee sadaa hau jeevaa guramatee bhau bhaagaa ||
english: Continually praising the Word of the Shabad, I live; under Guru's Instruction, my fear has been dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa at suaaliu gur seviaa chit laagaa ||
english: My True Lord God is so beautiful! Serving the Guru, my consciousness is focused on Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saachaa sabad sachee sach baanee so jan anadin jaagaa ||2||
english: One who chants the True Word of the Shabad, and the Truest of the True, the Word of His Bani, remains wakeful, day and night. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa ga(n)bheer sadaa sukhadaataa tis kaa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: He is so very deep and profound, the Giver of eternal peace; no one can find His limit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kee sevaa keenee achi(n)t har ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
english: Serving the Perfect Guru, one becomes carefree, enshrining the Lord within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man tan niramal sadaa sukh a(n)tar vichahu bharam chukaaiaa ||3||
english: The mind and body become immaculately pure, and a lasting peace fills the heart; doubt is eradicated from within. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਵਿਖੜਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa maarag sadaa pa(n)th vikhaRaa ko paae gur veechaaraa ||
english: The Way of the Lord is always such a difficult path; only a few find it, contemplating the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੇ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har kai ra(n)g raataa sabade maataa haumai taje vikaaraa ||
english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, and intoxicated with the Shabad, he renounces ego and corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam rataa ik ra(n)gee sabad savaaranahaaraa ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, and the Love of the One Lord, he is embellished with the Word of the Shabad. ||4||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ||
english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu tudh no sadaa saalaahee piaare jichar ghat a(n)tar hai saasaa ||
english: Dear Beloved Lord, I praise You continually, as long as there is the breath within my body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਪਲੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਾਣਉ ਬਰਸ ਪਚਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: ik pal khin visarahi too suaamee jaanau baras pachaasaa ||
english: If I were to forget You, for a moment, even for an instant, O Lord Master, it would be like fifty years for me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਸਦਾ ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ham mooR mugadh sadaa se bhaaee gur kai sabad pragaasaa ||1||
english: I was always such a fool and an idiot, O Siblings of Destiny, but now, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, my mind is enlightened. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu tum aape dehu bujhaaee ||
english: Dear Lord, You Yourself bestow understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu tudh vitahu vaariaa sad hee tere naam vitahu bal jaaee || rahaau ||
english: Dear Lord, I am forever a sacrifice to You; I am dedicated and devoted to Your Name. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੁਏ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ham sabad mue sabad maar jeevaale bhaaee sabade hee mukat paaee ||
english: I have died in the Word of the Shabad, and through the Shabad, I am dead while yet alive, O Siblings of Destiny; through the Shabad, I have been liberated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sabade man tan niramal hoaa har vasiaa man aaee ||
english: Through the Shabad, my mind and body have been purified, and the Lord has come to dwell within my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabad gur daataa jit man raataa har siu rahiaa samaaee ||2||
english: The Guru is the Giver of the Shabad; my mind is imbued with it, and I remain absorbed in the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੇ ਅੰਨੇ ਬੋਲੇ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad na jaanahi se a(n)ne bole se kit aae sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Those who do not know the Shabad are blind and deaf; why did they even bother to come into the world?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har ras na paaiaa birathaa janam gavaaiaa ja(n)mahi vaaro vaaraa ||
english: They do not obtain the subtle essence of the Lord's elixir; they waste away their lives, and are reincarnated over and over again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bisataa ke keeRe bisataa maahi samaane manamukh mugadh gubaaraa ||3||
english: The blind, idiotic, self-willed manmukhs are like maggots in manure, and in manure they rot away. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਏ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape kar vekhai maarag laae bhaaee tis bin avar na koee ||
english: The Lord Himself creates us, watches over us, and places us on the Path, O Siblings of Destiny; there is no one other than Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa s koi na metai bhaaee karataa kare s hoee ||
english: No one can erase that which is pre-ordained, O Siblings of Destiny; whatever the Creator wills, comes to pass.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam vasiaa man a(n)tar bhaaee avar na doojaa koee ||4||4||
english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the mind; O Siblings of Destiny, there is no other at all. ||4||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ||
english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat karahi prabh bhaavahi anadin naam vakhaane ||
english: The Gurmukhs practice devotional worship, and become pleasing to God; night and day, they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa kee saar karahi aap raakhahi jo terai man bhaane ||
english: You Yourself protect and take care of Your devotees, who are pleasing to Your Mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too gunadaataa sabad pachhaataa gun kahi gunee samaane ||1||
english: You are the Giver of virtue, realized through the Word of Your Shabad. Uttering Your Glories, we merge with You, O Glorious Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: man mere har jeeu sadaa samaal ||
english: O my mind, remember always the Dear Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal teraa belee hovai sadaa nibahai terai naal || rahaau ||
english: At the very last moment, He alone shall be your best friend; He shall always stand by you. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟ ਚਉਕੜੀ ਸਦਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dusat chaukaRee sadaa kooR kamaavahi naa boojhahi veechaare ||
english: The gathering of the wicked enemies shall always practice falsehood; they do not contemplate understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਤੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਣਾਖਸ ਨਖਹਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa dusatee te kin phal paaiaa haranaakhas nakhahi bidaare ||
english: Who can obtain fruit from the slander of evil enemies? Remember that Harnaakhash was torn apart by the Lord's claws.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਜਨੁ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prahilaad jan sad har gun gaavai har jeeu lae ubaare ||2||
english: Prahlaad, the Lord's humble servant, constantly sang the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and the Dear Lord saved him. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aapas kau bahu bhalaa kar jaanahi manamukh mat na kaaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs see themselves as being very virtuous; they have absolutely no understanding at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo jan kee ni(n)daa viaape jaasan janam gavaaee ||
english: They indulge in slander of the humble spiritual people; they waste their lives away, and then they have to depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam naam kade chetahi naahee a(n)t gae pachhutaaee ||3||
english: They never think of the Lord's Name, and in the end, they depart, regretting and repenting. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam bhagataa kaa keetaa gur sevaa aap laae ||
english: The Lord makes the lives of His devotees fruitful; He Himself links them to the Guru's service.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabade raate sahaje maate anadin har gun gaae ||
english: Imbued with the Word of the Shabad, and intoxicated with celestial bliss, night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak daas kahai bena(n)tee hau laagaa tin kai paae ||4||5||
english: Slave Nanak utters this prayer: O Lord, please, let me fall at their feet. ||4||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ||
english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so sikh sakhaa ba(n)dhap hai bhaaee j gur ke bhaane vich aavai ||
english: He alone is a Sikh, a friend, a relative and a sibling, who walks in the Way of the Guru's Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aapanai bhaanai jo chalai bhaaee vichhuR chotaa khaavai ||
english: One who walks according to his own will, O Siblings of Destiny, suffers separation from the Lord, and shall be punished.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin satigur sukh kade na paavai bhaaee phir phir pachhotaavai ||1||
english: Without the True Guru, peace is never obtained, O Siblings of Destiny; again and again, he regrets and repents. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har ke daas suhele bhaaee ||
english: The Lord's slaves are happy, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh dukh kaate aape mel milaaee || rahaau ||
english: The sins and sorrows of countless lifetimes are eradicated; the Lord Himself unites them in His Union. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਾਈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਸੈਂਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ihu kuta(n)b sabh jee ke ba(n)dhan bhaaee bharam bhulaa sai(n)saaraa ||
english: All of these relatives are like chains upon the soul, O Siblings of Destiny; the world is deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੰਧਨ ਟੂਟਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bin gur ba(n)dhan tootahi naahee guramukh mokh duaaraa ||
english: Without the Guru, the chains cannot be broken; the Gurmukhs find the door of salvation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karam karahi gurasabad na pachhaanahi mar janamahi vaaro vaaraa ||2||
english: One who performs rituals without realizing the Word of the Guru's Shabad, shall die and be reborn, again and again. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਗੁ ਪਲਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hau meraa jag palach rahiaa bhaaee koi na kis hee keraa ||
english: The world is entangled in egotism and possessiveness, O Siblings of Destiny, but no one belongs to anyone else.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh mahal paain gun gaavan nij ghar hoi baseraa ||
english: The Gurmukhs attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, singing the Glories of the Lord; they dwell in the home of their own inner being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aithai boojhai s aap pachhaanai har prabh hai tis keraa ||3||
english: One who understands here, realizes himself; the Lord God belongs to him. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo sadaa daiaal hai bhaaee vin bhaagaa kiaa paaeeai ||
english: The True Guru is forever merciful, O Siblings of Destiny; without good destiny, what can anyone obtain?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਜੇਹਾ ਭਾਉ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: ek nadar kar vekhai sabh oopar jehaa bhaau tehaa phal paaeeai ||
english: He looks alike upon all with His Glance of Grace, but people receive the fruits of their rewards according to their love for the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar vichahu aap gavaaeeai ||4||6||
english: O Nanak, when the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell within the mind, then self-conceit is eradicated from within. ||4||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚੌਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 chautuke ||
english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, Chau-Thukay:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚੀ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sachee bhagat satigur te hovai sachee hiradai baanee ||
english: True devotional worship is obtained only through the True Guru, when the True Word of His Bani is in the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve sadaa sukh paae haumai sabad samaanee ||
english: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained; egotism is obliterated through the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਹੋਰ ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਇਆਣੀ ॥
transliteration: bin gur saache bhagat na hovee hor bhoolee phirai iaanee ||
english: Without the Guru, there is no true devotion; otherwise, people wander around, deluded by ignorance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: manamukh phirahi sadaa dukh paavahi doob mue vin paanee ||1||
english: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, suffering in constant pain; they drown and die, even without water. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee re sadaa rahahu saranaaee ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, remain forever in the Lord's Sanctuary, under His Protection.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aapanee nadar kare pat raakhai har naamo de vadiaaee || rahaau ||
english: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He preserves our honor, and blesses us with the glory of the Lord's Name. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: poore gur te aap pachhaataa sabad sachai veechaaraa ||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, one comes to understand himself, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਦ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hiradai jagajeevan sad vasiaa taj kaam krodh aha(n)kaaraa ||
english: The Lord, the Life of the world, ever abides in his heart, and he renounces sexual desire, anger and egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sadaa hajoor raviaa sabh thaaee hiradai naam apaaraa ||
english: The Lord is ever-present, permeating and pervading all places; the Name of the Infinite Lord is enshrined within the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀ ਨਾਉ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jug jug baanee sabad pachhaanee naau meethaa manahi piaaraa ||2||
english: Throughout the ages, through the Word of His Bani, His Shabad is realized, and the Name becomes so sweet and beloved to the mind. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev jin naam pachhaataa saphal janam jag aaiaa ||
english: Serving the Guru, one realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord; fruitful is his life, and his coming into the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣੀ ਅਘਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har ras chaakh sadaa man tripatiaa gun gaavai gunee aghaaiaa ||
english: Tasting the sublime elixir of the Lord, his mind is satisfied and satiated forever; singing the Glories of the Glorious Lord, he is fulfilled and satisfied.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kamal pragaas sadaa ra(n)g raataa anahad sabad vajaaiaa ||
english: The lotus of his heart blossoms forth, he is ever imbued with the Lord's Love, and the unstruck melody of the Shabad resounds within him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tan man niramal niramal baanee sache sach samaaiaa ||3||
english: His body and mind become immaculately pure; his speech becomes immaculate as well, and he merges in the Truest of the True. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam kee gat koi na boojhai guramat ridai samaaee ||
english: No one knows the state of the Lord's Name; through the Guru's Teachings, it comes to abide in the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਮਗੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s mag pachhaanai har ras rasan rasaaee ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands the Path; his tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord's Nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam sabh gur te hovai hiradai naam vasaaee ||
english: Meditation, austere self-discipline and self-restraint are all obtained from the Guru; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide within the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak naam samaalahi se jan sohan dar saachai pat paaee ||4||7||
english: O Nanak, those humble beings who praise the Naam are beautiful; they are honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||4||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੩ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: sorath mah 3 dutuke ||
english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਉਲਟੀ ਭਈ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਬੂਝ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai ulatee bhaee bhaaee jeevat marai taa boojh paai ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, one turns away from the world, O Siblings of Destiny; when he remains dead while yet alive, he obtains true understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so guroo so sikh hai bhaaee jis jotee jot milaai ||1||
english: He alone is the Guru, and he alone is a Sikh, O Siblings of Destiny, whose light merges in the Light. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man re har har setee liv laai ||
english: O my mind, be lovingly attuned to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man har jap meethaa laagai bhaaee guramukh paae har thaai || rahaau ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, it seems so sweet to the mind, O Siblings of Destiny; the Gurmukhs obtain a place in the Court of the Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur preet na oopajai bhaaee manamukh doojai bhaai ||
english: Without the Guru, love for the Lord does not well up, O Siblings of Destiny; the self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਹ ਕੁਟਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਾਈ ਪਲੈ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tuh kutahi manamukh karam karahi bhaaee palai kichhoo na paai ||2||
english: Actions performed by the manmukh are like the threshing of the chaff - they obtain nothing for their efforts. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur miliai naam man raviaa bhaaee saachee preet piaar ||
english: Meeting the Guru, the Naam comes to permeate the mind, O Siblings of Destiny, with true love and affection.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sadaa har ke gun ravai bhaaee gur kai het apaar ||3||
english: He always sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, with infinite love for the Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aaiaa so paravaan hai bhaaee j gur sevaa chit laai ||
english: How blessed and approved is his coming into the world, O Siblings of Destiny, who focuses his mind on serving the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak naam har paaeeai bhaaee gurasabadee melaai ||4||8||
english: O Nanak, the Name of the Lord is obtained, O Siblings of Destiny, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and we merge with the Lord. ||4||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹੀ ਗੁਣੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tihee gunee tribhavan viaapiaa bhaaee guramukh boojh bujhaai ||
english: The three worlds are entangled in the three qualities, O Siblings of Destiny; the Guru imparts understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਿ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam lag chhooteeai bhaaee poochhahu giaaneeaa jaai ||1||
english: Attached to the Lord's Name, one is emancipated, O Siblings of Destiny; go and ask the wise ones about this. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਉਥੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man re trai gun chhod chauthai chit laai ||
english: O mind, renounce the three qualities, and focus your consciousness on the fourth state.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu terai man vasai bhaaee sadaa har ke gun gaai || rahaau ||
english: The Dear Lord abides in the mind, O Siblings of Destiny; ever sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਊਪਜੇ ਭਾਈ ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naamai te sabh oopaje bhaaee naai visariai mar jaai ||
english: From the Naam, everyone originated, O Siblings of Destiny; forgetting the Naam, they die away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਸੂਤੇ ਗਏ ਮੁਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: agiaanee jagat a(n)dh hai bhaaee soote gae muhaai ||2||
english: The ignorant world is blind, O Siblings of Destiny; those who sleep are plundered. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jaage se ubare bhaaee bhavajal paar utaar ||
english: Those Gurmukhs who remain awake are saved, O Siblings of Destiny; they cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jag mahi laahaa har naam hai bhaaee hiradai rakhiaa ur dhaar ||3||
english: In this world, the Name of the Lord is the true profit, O Siblings of Destiny; keep it enshrined within your heart. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur saranaaee ubare bhaaee raam naam liv laai ||
english: In the Guru's Sanctuary, O Siblings of Destiny, you shall be saved; be lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਉ ਬੇੜਾ ਨਾਉ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਜਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak naau beRaa naau tulahaRaa bhaaee jit lag paar jan paai ||4||9||
english: O Nanak, the Name of the Lord is the boat, and the Name is the raft, O Siblings of Destiny; setting out on it, the Lord's humble servant crosses over the world-ocean. ||4||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur sukh saagar jag a(n)tar hor thai sukh naahee ||
english: The True Guru is the ocean of peace in the world; there is no other place of rest and peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਰੋਵੈ ਧਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haumai jagat dukh rog viaapiaa mar janamai rovai dhaahee ||1||
english: The world is afflicted with the painful disease of egotism; dying, only to be reborn, it cries out in pain. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: praanee satigur sev sukh paai ||
english: O mind, serve the True Guru, and obtain peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi taa sukh paavahi naahi ta jaahigaa janam gavaai || rahaau ||
english: If you serve the True Guru, you shall find peace; otherwise, you shall depart, after wasting away your life in vain. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਧਾਤੁ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: trai gun dhaat bahu karam kamaavahi har ras saad na aaiaa ||
english: Led around by the three qualities, he does many deeds, but he does not come to taste and savor the subtle essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਧਿਆ ਤਰਪਣੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)dhiaa tarapan karahi gaaitree bin boojhe dukh paaiaa ||2||
english: He says his evening prayers, and makes offerings of water, and recites his morning prayers, but without true understanding, he still suffers in pain. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve so vadabhaagee jis no aap milaae ||
english: One who serves the True Guru is very fortunate; as the Lord so wills, he meets with the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har ras pee jan sadaa tripataase vichahu aap gavaae ||3||
english: Drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord, His humble servants remain ever satisfied; they eradicate self-conceit from within themselves. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ihu jag a(n)dhaa sabh a(n)dh kamaavai bin gur mag na paae ||
english: This world is blind, and all act blindly; without the Guru, no one finds the Path.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਅਖੀ ਵੇਖੈ ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak satigur milai ta akhee vekhai gharai a(n)dar sach paae ||4||10||
english: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, one sees with his eyes, and finds the True Lord within the home of his own being. ||4||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ||
english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve bahutaa dukh laagaa jug chaare bharamaaee ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, he suffers in terrible pain, and throughout the four ages, he wanders aimlessly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਤੁਮ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਦਾਤੇ ਸਬਦੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ham deen tum jug jug daate sabade dehi bujhaaee ||1||
english: I am poor and meek, and throughout the ages, You are the Great Giver - please, grant me the understanding of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu kripaa karahu tum piaare ||
english: O Dear Beloved Lord, please show mercy to me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਆਧਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur daataa mel milaavahu har naam devahu aadhaare || rahaau ||
english: Unite me in the Union of the True Guru, the Great Giver, and give me the support of the Lord's Name. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: manasaa maar dubidhaa sahaj samaanee paaiaa naam apaaraa ||
english: Conquering my desires and duality, I have merged in celestial peace, and I have found the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har ras chaakh man niramal hoaa kilabikh kaatanahaaraa ||2||
english: I have tasted the sublime essence of the Lord, and my soul has become immaculately pure; the Lord is the Destroyer of sins. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabad marahu phir jeevahu sad hee taa phir maran na hoee ||
english: Dying in the Word of the Shabad, you shall live forever, and you shall never die again.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam sadaa man meethaa sabade paavai koee ||3||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam is ever-sweet to the mind; but how few are those who obtain the Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਾਤੈ ਦਾਤਿ ਰਖੀ ਹਥਿ ਅਪਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਈ ॥
transliteration: daatai daat rakhee hath apanai jis bhaavai tis deee ||
english: The Great Giver keeps His Gifts in His Hand; He gives them to those with whom He is pleased.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਪਹਿ ਸੇਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate sukh paaiaa daragah jaapahi seee ||4||11||
english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, they find peace, and in the Court of the Lord, they are exalted. ||4||11||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ||
english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve taa sahaj dhun upajai gat mat tad hee paae ||
english: Serving the True Guru, the divine melody wells up within, and one is blessed with wisdom and salvation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kaa naam sachaa man vasiaa naame naam samaae ||1||
english: The True Name of the Lord comes to abide in the mind, and through the Name, one merges in the Name. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur sabh jag bauraanaa ||
english: Without the True Guru, the whole world is insane.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਝੂਠੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhaa sabad na jaanai jhoothai bharam bhulaanaa || rahaau ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not realize the Word of the Shabad; they are deluded by false doubts. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: trai gun maaiaa bharam bhulaaiaa haumai ba(n)dhan kamaae ||
english: The three-faced Maya had led them astray in doubt, and they are snared by the noose of egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਊਭਉ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maran sir oopar oobhau garabh jon dukh paae ||2||
english: Birth and death hang over their heads, and being reborn from the womb, they suffer in pain. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: trai gun varatahi sagal sa(n)saaraa haumai vich pat khoee ||
english: The three qualities permeate the whole world; acting in ego, it loses its honor.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਚਉਥਾ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai chauthaa pad cheenai raam naam sukh hoee ||3||
english: But one who becomes Gurmukh comes to realize the fourth state of celestial bliss; he finds peace through the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: trai gun sabh tere too aape karataa jo too karahi s hoee ||
english: The three qualities are all Yours, O Lord; You Yourself created them. Whatever You do, comes to pass.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam nisataaraa sabade haumai khoee ||4||12||
english: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, one is emancipated; through the Shabad, he is rid of egotism. ||4||12||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aape aap varatadaa piaaraa aape aap apaahu ||
english: My Beloved Lord Himself pervades and permeates all; He Himself is, all by Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: vanajaaraa jag aap hai piaaraa aape saachaa saahu ||
english: My Beloved Himself is the trader in this world; He Himself is the true banker.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape vanaj vaapaareeaa piaaraa aape sach vesaahu ||1||
english: My Beloved Himself is the trade and the trader; He Himself is the true credit. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹ ॥
transliteration: jap man har har naam salaah ||
english: O mind, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, and praise His Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te paaeeai piaaraa a(n)mrit agam athaah || rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Beloved, Ambrosial, unapproachable and unfathomable Lord is obtained. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਭ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਹਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aape sun sabh vekhadaa piaaraa mukh bole aap muhaahu ||
english: The Beloved Himself sees and hears everything; He Himself speaks through the mouths of all beings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aape ujhaR paaidaa piaaraa aap vikhaale raahu ||
english: The Beloved Himself leads us into the wilderness, and He Himself shows us the Way.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape hee sabh aap hai piaaraa aape veparavaahu ||2||
english: The Beloved Himself is Himself all-in-all; He Himself is carefree. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਧੰਧੜੈ ਲਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aape aap upaaidaa piaaraa sir aape dha(n)dhaRai laahu ||
english: The Beloved Himself, all by Himself, created everything; He Himself links all to their tasks.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aap karaae saakhatee piaaraa aap maare mar jaahu ||
english: The Beloved Himself creates the Creation, and He Himself destroys it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਤਣੁ ਪਾਤਣੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape patan paatanee piaaraa aape paar la(n)ghaahu ||3||
english: He Himself is the wharf, and He Himself is the ferryman, who ferries us across. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aape saagar bohithaa piaaraa gur khevat aap chalaahu ||
english: The Beloved Himself is the ocean, and the boat; He Himself is the Guru, the boatman who steers it

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵੇਖੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aape hee chaR la(n)ghadaa piaaraa kar choj vekhai paatisaahu ||
english: . The Beloved Himself sets sail and crosses over; He, the King, beholds His wondrous play.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਹੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: aape aap daiaal hai piaaraa jan naanak bakhas milaahu ||4||1||
english: The Beloved Himself is the Merciful Master; O servant Nanak, He forgives and blends with Himself. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਚਉਥਾ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 4 chauthaa ||
english: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਆਪੇ ਖੰਡ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape a(n)daj jeraj setaj utabhuj aape kha(n)d aape sabh loi ||
english: He Himself is born of the egg, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth; He Himself is the continents and all the worlds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੂਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਮਣੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਕਤੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape soot aape bahu maneeaa kar sakatee jagat paroi ||
english: He Himself is the thread, and He Himself is the many beads; through His Almighty Power, He has strung the worlds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸੂਤਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੂਤੁ ਖਿੰਚੇ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape hee sootadhaar hai piaaraa soot khi(n)che dhahi dheree hoi ||1||
english: He holds the thread, and when He withdraws the thread, the beads scatter into heaps. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man mai har bin avar na koi ||
english: O my mind, there is no other than the Lord for me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur vich naam nidhaan hai piaaraa kar daiaa a(n)mrit mukh choi || rahaau ||
english: The treasure of the Beloved Naam is within the True Guru; in His Mercy, he pours the Ambrosial Nectar into my mouth. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਲ ਥਲਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape jal thal sabhat hai piaaraa prabh aape kare s hoi ||
english: The Beloved Himself is in all the oceans and lands; whatever God does, comes to pass.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa rijak samaahadaa piaaraa doojaa avar na koi ||
english: The Beloved brings nourishment to all; there is no other than Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape khel khelaaidaa piaaraa aape kare s hoi ||2||
english: The Beloved Himself plays, and whatever He Himself does, comes to pass. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape hee aap niramalaa piaaraa aape niramal soi ||
english: The Beloved Himself, all by Himself, is immaculate and pure; He Himself is immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape keemat paaidaa piaaraa aape kare s hoi ||
english: The Beloved Himself determines the value of all; whatever He does comes to pass.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਲਖਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape alakh na lakheeai piaaraa aap lakhaavai soi ||3||
english: The Beloved Himself is unseen - He cannot be seen; He Himself causes us to see. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape gahir ga(n)bheer hai piaaraa tis jevad avar na koi ||
english: The Beloved Himself is deep and profound and unfathomable; there is no other as great as He.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh ghat aape bhogavai piaaraa vich naaree purakh sabh soi ||
english: The Beloved Himself enjoys every heart; He is contained within every woman and man.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak gupat varatadaa piaaraa guramukh paragat hoi ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, the Beloved is pervading everywhere, but He is hidden; through the Guru, He is revealed. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 4 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: aape hee sabh aap hai piaaraa aape thaap uthaapai ||
english: He Himself, the Beloved, is Himself all-in-all; He Himself establishes and disestablishes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵੇਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: aape vekh vigasadaa piaaraa kar choj vekhai prabh aapai ||
english: The Beloved Himself beholds, and rejoices; God Himself works wonders, and beholds them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵਣਿ ਤਿਣਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape van tin sabhat hai piaaraa aape guramukh jaapai ||1||
english: The Beloved Himself is contained in all the woods and meadows; as Gurmukh, He reveals Himself. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: jap man har har naam ras dhraapai ||
english: Meditate, O mind, on the Lord, Har, Har; through the sublime essence of Lord's Name, you shall be satisfied.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਚਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam mahaa ras meethaa gurasabadee chakh jaapai || rahaau ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, is the sweetest juice; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, its taste is revealed. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: aape teerath tulahaRaa piaaraa aap tarai prabh aapai ||
english: The Beloved is Himself the place of pilgrimage and the raft; God Himself ferries Himself across.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲੁ ਵਤਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: aape jaal vataaidaa piaaraa sabh jag machhulee har aapai ||
english: The Beloved Himself casts the net over all the world; the Lord Himself is the fish.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap abhul na bhulaee piaaraa avar na doojaa jaapai ||2||
english: The Beloved Himself is infallible; He makes no mistakes. There is no other like Him to be seen. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: aape si(n)ngee naad hai piaaraa dhun aap vajaae aapai ||
english: The Beloved Himself is the Yogi's horn, and the sound current of the Naad; He Himself plays the tune.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: aape jogee purakh hai piaaraa aape hee tap taapai ||
english: The Beloved Himself is the Yogi, the Primal Being; He Himself practices intense meditation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਚੇਲਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape satigur aap hai chelaa upades karai prabh aapai ||3||
english: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the disciple; God Himself imparts the Teachings. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਜਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: aape naau japaaidaa piaaraa aape hee jap jaapai ||
english: The Beloved Himself inspires us to chant His Name, and He Himself practices meditation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: aape a(n)mrit aap hai piaaraa aape hee ras aapai ||
english: The Beloved Himself is the Ambrosial Nectar; He Himself is the juice of it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਲਾਹਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: aape aap salaahadaa piaaraa jan naanak har ras dhraapai ||4||3||
english: The Beloved Himself praises Himself; servant Nanak is satisfied, with the sublime essence of the Lord. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 4 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੰਡਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਜੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape ka(n)daa aap taraajee prabh aape tol tolaaiaa ||
english: God Himself is the balance scale, He Himself is the weigher, and He Himself weighs with the weights.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape saahu aape vanajaaraa aape vanaj karaaiaa ||
english: He Himself is the banker, He Himself is the trader, and He Himself makes the trades.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਟੰਕੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape dharatee saajeean piaarai pichhai ta(n)k chaRaaiaa ||1||
english: The Beloved Himself fashioned the world, and He Himself counter-balances it with a gram. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mere man har har dhiaai sukh paaiaa ||
english: My mind meditates on the Lord, Har, Har, and finds peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam nidhaan hai piaaraa gur poorai meethaa laaiaa || rahaau ||
english: The Name of the Beloved Lord, Har, Har, is a treasure; the Perfect Guru has made it seem sweet to me. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape dharatee aap jal piaaraa aape kare karaaiaa ||
english: The Beloved Himself is the earth, and He Himself is the water; He Himself acts, and causes others to act.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਲੁ ਮਾਟੀ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape hukam varatadaa piaaraa jal maatee ba(n)dh rakhaaiaa ||
english: The Beloved Himself issues His Commands, and keeps the water and the land bound down.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਭਉ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਬੰਨਿ ਬਕਰੀ ਸੀਹੁ ਹਢਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape hee bhau paaidaa piaaraa ba(n)n bakaree seehu hadhaaiaa ||2||
english: The Beloved Himself instills the Fear of God; He binds the tiger and the goat together. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape kaasat aap har piaaraa vich kaasat agan rakhaaiaa ||
english: The Beloved Lord Himself is the firewood, and He Himself keeps the fire within the wood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਭੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape hee aap varatadaa piaaraa bhai agan na sakai jalaaiaa ||
english: The Beloved Lord Himself, all by Himself, permeates them, and because of the Fear of God, the fire cannot burn the wood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਾਹ ਲੈਦੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape maar jeevaaidaa piaaraa saah laide sabh lavaaiaa ||3||
english: The Beloved Himself kills and revives; all draw the breath of life, given by Him. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape taan deebaan hai piaaraa aape kaarai laaiaa ||
english: The Beloved Himself is power and presence; He Himself engages us in our work.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਚਲੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jiu aap chalaae tiu chaleeai piaare jiu har prabh mere bhaaiaa ||
english: As the Beloved makes me walk, I walk, as it pleases my Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤੀ ਜੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: aape ja(n)tee ja(n)t hai piaaraa jan naanak vajahi vajaaiaa ||4||4||
english: The Beloved Himself is the musician, and the musical instrument; servant Nanak vibrates His vibration. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 4 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਚਾਨਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aape srisat upaaidaa piaaraa kar sooraj cha(n)d chaanaan ||
english: The Beloved Himself created the Universe; He made the light of the sun and the moon.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਤਾਣਿਆ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aap nitaaniaa taan hai piaaraa aap nimaaniaa maan ||
english: The Beloved Himself is the power of the powerless; He Himself is the honor of the dishonored.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਰਖਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aap daiaa kar rakhadaa piaaraa aape sughaR sujaan ||1||
english: The Beloved Himself grants His Grace and protects us; He Himself is wise and all-knowing. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: mere man jap raam naam neesaan ||
english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, and receive His Insignia.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mil dhiaai too har har bahuR na aavan jaan || rahaau ||
english: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; you shall not have to come and go in reincarnation again. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aape hee gun varatadaa piaaraa aape hee paravaan ||
english: The Beloved Himself pervades His Glorious Praises, and He Himself approves them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aape bakhas karaaidaa piaaraa aape sach neesaan ||
english: The Beloved Himself grants His forgiveness, and He Himself bestows the Insignia of Truth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape hukam varatadaa piaaraa aape hee phuramaan ||2||
english: The Beloved Himself obeys His Will, and He Himself issues His Command. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aape bhagat bha(n)daar hai piaaraa aape devai daan ||
english: The Beloved Himself is the treasure of devotion; He Himself gives His gifts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aape sev karaaidaa piaaraa aap divaavai maan ||
english: The Beloved Himself commits some to His service, and He Himself blesses them with honor.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape taaRee laaidaa piaaraa aape gunee nidhaan ||3||
english: The Beloved Himself is absorbed in Samaadhi; He Himself is the treasure of excellence. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵਡਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਰਧਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aape vadaa aap hai piaaraa aape hee paradhaan ||
english: The Beloved Himself is the greatest; He Himself is supreme.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਲੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aape keemat paaidaa piaaraa aape tul paravaan ||
english: The Beloved Himself appraises the value; He Himself is the scale, and the weights.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਤੁਲਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: aape atul tulaaidaa piaaraa jan naanak sad kurabaan ||4||5||
english: The Beloved Himself is unweighable - He weighs Himself; servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 4 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਉਮਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aape sevaa laaidaa piaaraa aape bhagat umaahaa ||
english: The Beloved Himself commits some to His service; He Himself blesses them with the joy of devotional worship.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aape gun gaavaaidaa piaaraa aape sabad samaahaa ||
english: The Beloved Himself causes us to sing His Glorious Praises; He Himself is absorbed in the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape lekhan aap likhaaree aape lekh likhaahaa ||1||
english: He Himself is the pen, and He Himself is the scribe; He Himself inscribes His inscription. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਓਮਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man jap raam naam omaahaa ||
english: O my mind, joyfully chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anadin anad hovai vadabhaagee lai gur poorai har laahaa || rahaau ||
english: Those very fortunate ones are in ecstasy night and day; through the Perfect Guru, they obtain the profit of the Lord's Name. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੋਪੀ ਕਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਬਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aape gopee kaan hai piaaraa ban aape gaoo charaahaa ||
english: The Beloved Himself is the milk-maid and Krishna; He Himself herds the cows in the woods.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਵਲ ਸੁੰਦਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਜਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aape saaval su(n)daraa piaaraa aape va(n)s vajaahaa ||
english: The Beloved Himself is the blue-skinned, handsome one; He Himself plays on His flute.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੁਵਲੀਆਪੀੜੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਰਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਪਚਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kuvaleeaapeeR aap maraaidaa piaaraa kar baalak roop pachaahaa ||2||
english: The Beloved Himself took the form of a child, and destroyed Kuwalia-peer, the mad elephant. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਚੋਜਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aap akhaaRaa paaidaa piaaraa kar vekhai aap chojaahaa ||
english: The Beloved Himself sets the stage; He performs the plays, and He Himself watches them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਰੂਪ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਚੰਡੂਰੁ ਕੰਸੁ ਕੇਸੁ ਮਾਰਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: kar baalak roop upaaidaa piaaraa cha(n)door ka(n)s kes maaraahaa ||
english: The Beloved Himself assumed the form of the child, and killed the demons Chandoor, Kansa and Kaysee.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਬਲੁ ਭੰਨੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape hee bal aap hai piaaraa bal bha(n)nai moorakh mugadhaahaa ||3||
english: The Beloved Himself, by Himself, is the embodiment of power; He shatters the power of the fools and idiots. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਸਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹਥਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh aape jagat upaaidaa piaaraa vas aape jugat hathaahaa ||
english: The Beloved Himself created the whole world. In His hands He holds the power of the ages.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: gal jevaRee aape paaidaa piaaraa jiu prabh khi(n)chai tiu jaahaa ||
english: The Beloved Himself puts the chains around their necks; as God pulls them, must they go.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗਰਬੈ ਸੋ ਪਚਸੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: jo garabai so pachasee piaare jap naanak bhagat samaahaa ||4||6||
english: Whoever harbors pride shall be destroyed, O Beloved; meditating on the Lord, Nanak is absorbed in devotional worship. ||4||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੪ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: sorath mah 4 dutuke ||
english: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: anik janam vichhuRe dukh paaiaa manamukh karam karai aha(n)kaaree ||
english: Separated from the Lord for countless lifetimes, the self-willed manmukh suffers in pain, engaged in acts of egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਪਰਸਤ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhoo parasat hee prabh paaiaa gobid saran tumaaree ||1||
english: Beholding the Holy Saint, I found God; O Lord of the Universe, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gobid preet lagee at piaaree ||
english: The Love of God is very dear to me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਸਤਸੰਗ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab satasa(n)g bhae saadhoo jan hiradai miliaa saa(n)t muraaree || rahaau ||
english: When I joined the Sat Sangat, the Company of the Holy People, the Lord, the embodiment of peace, came into my heart. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਗਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: too hiradai gupat vasahi din raatee teraa bhaau na bujhahi gavaaree ||
english: You dwell, hidden, within my heart day and night, Lord; but the poor fools do not understand Your Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur purakh miliaa prabh pragatiaa gun gaavai gun veechaaree ||2||
english: Meeting with the Almighty True Guru, God was revealed to me; I sing His Glorious Praises, and reflect upon His Glories. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਤਿ ਆਈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh pragaas bhaiaa saat aaee duramat budh nivaaree ||
english: As Gurmukh, I have become enlightened; peace has come, and evil-mindedness has been dispelled from my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aatam braham cheen sukh paaiaa satasa(n)gat purakh tumaaree ||3||
english: Understanding the relationship of the individual soul with God, I have found peace, in Your Sat Sangat, Your True Congregation, O Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: purakhai purakh miliaa gur paaiaa jin kau kirapaa bhaee tumaaree ||
english: Those who are blessed by Your Kind Mercy, meet the Almighty Lord, and find the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak atul sahaj sukh paaiaa anadin jaagat rahai banavaaree ||4||7||
english: Nanak has found the immeasurable, celestial peace; night and day, he remains awake to the Lord, the Master of the Forest of the Universe. ||4||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 4 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har siu preet a(n)tar man bedhiaa har bin rahan na jaaee ||
english: The inner depths of my mind are pierced by love for the Lord; I cannot live without the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਰੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu machhulee bin neerai binasai tiu naamai bin mar jaaee ||1||
english: Just as the fish dies without water, I die without the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mere prabh kirapaa jal devahu har naaee ||
english: O my God, please bless me with the water of Your Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਗਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau a(n)tar naam ma(n)gaa din raatee naame hee saa(n)t paaee || rahaau ||
english: I beg for Your Name, deep within myself, day and night; through the Name, I find peace. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਲਲਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jiu chaatrik jal bin bilalaavai bin jal piaas na jaaee ||
english: The song-bird cries out for lack of water - without water, its thirst cannot be quenched.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh jal paavai sukh sahaje hariaa bhaai subhaaee ||2||
english: The Gurmukh obtains the water of celestial bliss, and is rejuvenated, blossoming forth through the blessed Love of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਖੇ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhookhe dah dis dolahi bin naavai dukh paaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are hungry, wandering around in the ten directions; without the Name, they suffer in pain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਆਵੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam marai phir jonee aavai daragahi milai sajaaee ||3||
english: They are born, only to die, and enter into reincarnation again; in the Court of the Lord, they are punished. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kripaa karahi taa har gun gaavah har ras a(n)tar paaee ||
english: But if the Lord shows His Mercy, then one comes to sing His Glorious Praises; deep within the nucleus of his own self, he finds the sublime essence of the Lord's elixir.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak deen daiaal bhae hai trisanaa sabad bujhaaee ||4||8||
english: The Lord has become Merciful to meek Nanak, and through the Word of the Shabad, his desires are quenched. ||4||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 4 pa(n)chapadaa ||
english: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਈ ਸਿਧੀ ਤੇ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: achar charai taa sidh hoee sidhee te budh paaee ||
english: If one eats the uneatable, then he becomes a Siddha, a being of perfect spirituality; through this perfection, he obtains wisdom.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੇ ਸਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prem ke sar laage tan bheetar taa bhram kaatiaa jaaee ||1||
english: When the arrow of the Lord's Love pierces his body, then his doubt is eradicated. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: mere gobid apune jan kau dehi vadiaaee ||
english: O my Lord of the Universe, please bless Your humble servant with glory.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramat raam naam paragaasahu sadaa rahahu saranaaee || rahaau ||
english: Under Guru's Instructions, enlighten me with the Lord's Name, that I may dwell forever in Your Sanctuary. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਚੇਤਿ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ihu sa(n)saar sabh aavan jaanaa man moorakh chet ajaanaa ||
english: This whole world is engrossed in coming and going; O my foolish and ignorant mind, be mindful of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har jeeu kripaa karahu gur melahu taa har naam samaanaa ||2||
english: O Dear Lord, please, take pity upon me, and unite me with the Guru, that I may merge in the Lord's Name. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਥੁ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis kee vath soee prabh jaanai jis no dei s paae ||
english: Only one who has it knows God; he alone has it, to whom God has given it

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vasat anoop at agam agochar gur pooraa alakh lakhaae ||3||
english: - so very beautiful, unapproachable and unfathomable. Through the Perfect Guru, the unknowable is known. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਚਾਖੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੂੰਗੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jin ih chaakhee soee jaanai goo(n)ge kee mithiaaee ||
english: Only one who tastes it knows it, like the mute, who tastes the sweet candy, but cannot speak of it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਲੂਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਰਖੈ ਲੁਕਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ratan lukaaiaa lookai naahee je ko rakhai lukaaee ||4||
english: The jewel is concealed, but it is not concealed, even though one may try to conceal it. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh teraa too a(n)tarajaamee too sabhanaa kaa prabh soee ||
english: Everything is Yours, O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts; You are the Lord God of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੫॥੯॥
transliteration: jis no daat karahi so paae jan naanak avar na koee ||5||9||
english: He alone receives the gift, unto whom You give it; O servant Nanak, there is no one else. ||5||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਤਿਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ghar 1 tituke ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, First House, Thi-Thukay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਜਾਚੀ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਰਾਧੀ ਜਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
transliteration: kis hau jaachee kis aaraadhee jaa sabh ko keetaa hosee ||
english: Who should I ask? Who should I worship? All were created by Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਵਡਾ ਵਡੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਸੋ ਖਾਕੂ ਰਲਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jo jo deesai vadaa vaderaa so so khaakoo ralasee ||
english: Whoever appears to be the greatest of the great, shall ultimately be mixed with the dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਦੇਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nirabhau nira(n)kaar bhav kha(n)dan sabh sukh nav nidh desee ||1||
english: The Fearless, Formless Lord, the Destroyer of Fear bestows all comforts, and the nine treasures. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤੀ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu teree daatee raajaa ||
english: O Dear Lord, Your gifts alone satisfy me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maanas bapuRaa kiaa saalaahee kiaa tis kaa muhataajaa || rahaau ||
english: Why should I praise the poor helpless man? Why should I feel subservient to him? ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin har dhiaaiaa sabh kichh tis kaa tis kee bhookh gavaaee ||
english: All things come to one who meditates on the Lord; the Lord satisfies his hunger.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੈ ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aisaa dhan deeaa sukhadaatai nikhut na kab hee jaaee ||
english: The Lord, the Giver of peace, bestows such wealth, that it can never be exhausted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anad bhaiaa sukh sahaj samaane satigur mel milaaee ||2||
english: I am in ecstasy, absorbed in celestial peace; the True Guru has united me in His Union. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: man naam jap naam aaraadh anadin naam vakhaanee ||
english: O mind, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; worship the Naam, night and day, and recite the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਜਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: upades sun saadh sa(n)tan kaa sabh chookee kaan jamaanee ||
english: Listen to the Teachings of the Holy Saints, and all fear of death will be dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin kau kripaal hoaa prabh meraa se laage gur kee baanee ||3||
english: Those blessed by God's Grace are attached to the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: keemat kaun karai prabh teree too sarab jeeaa daiaalaa ||
english: Who can estimate Your worth, God? You are kind and compassionate to all beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh keetaa teraa varatai kiaa ham baal gupaalaa ||
english: Everything which You do, prevails; I am just a poor child - what can I do?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਪਿਤਾ ਪੂਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: raakh lehu naanak jan tumaraa jiu pitaa poot kirapaalaa ||4||1||
english: Protect and preserve Your servant Nanak; be kind to him, like a father to his son. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚੌਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ghar 1 chautuke ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, First House, Chau-Thukay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: gur govi(n)d salaaheeai bhaaee man tan hiradai dhaar ||
english: Praise the Guru, and the Lord of the Universe, O Siblings of Destiny; enshrine Him in your mind, body and heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahib man vasai bhaaee ehaa karanee saar ||
english: Let the True Lord and Master abide in your mind, O Siblings of Destiny; this is the most excellent way of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਏ ਛਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jit tan naam na oopajai bhaaee se tan hoe chhaar ||
english: Those bodies, in which the Name of the Lord does not well up, O Siblings of Destiny - those bodies are reduced to ashes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਨ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kau vaariaa bhaaee jin eka(n)kaar adhaar ||1||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Siblings of Destiny; they take the Support of the One and Only Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਅਰਾਧਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: soee sach araadhanaa bhaaee jis te sabh kichh hoi ||
english: So worship and adore that True Lord, O Siblings of Destiny; He alone does everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਜਾਣਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai jaanaaiaa bhaaee tis bin avar na koi || rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has taught me, O Siblings of Destiny, that without Him, there is no other at all. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਭਾਈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਗਣੀ ॥
transliteration: naam vihoone pach mue bhaaee ganat na jaai ganee ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they putrefy and die, O Siblings of Destiny; their numbers cannot be counted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਧਣੀ ॥
transliteration: vin sach soch na paaeeai bhaaee saachaa agam dhanee ||
english: Without Truth, purity cannot be achieved, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord is true and unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਭਾਈ ਝੂਠੀ ਦੁਨੀ ਮਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaan na chukaee bhaaee jhoothee dunee manee ||
english: Coming and going do not end, O Siblings of Destiny; pride in worldly valuables is false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਧਾਰਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਦੇ ਨਾਵੈ ਏਕ ਕਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh kot udhaaradaa bhaaee de naavai ek kanee ||2||
english: The Gurmukh saves millions of people, O Siblings of Destiny, blessing them with even a particle of the Name. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸੋਧਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: si(n)mrit saasat sodhiaa bhaaee vin satigur bharam na jaai ||
english: I have searched through the Simritees and the Shaastras, O Siblings of Destiny - without the True Guru, doubt does not depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anik karam kar thaakiaa bhaaee phir phir ba(n)dhan paai ||
english: They are so tired of performing their many deeds, O Siblings of Destiny, but they fall into bondage again and again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਸੋਧੀਆ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa sodheeaa bhaaee vin satigur naahee jaai ||
english: I have searched in the four directions, O Siblings of Destiny, but without the True Guru, there is no place at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee gur paaiaa bhaaee har har naam dhiaai ||3||
english: By great good fortune, I found the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, and I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sach sadaa hai niramalaa bhaaee niramal saache soi ||
english: The Truth is forever pure, O Siblings of Destiny; those who are true are pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare jis aapanee bhaaee tis paraapat hoi ||
english: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, O Siblings of Destiny, then one obtains Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kot madhe jan paaeeai bhaaee viralaa koee koi ||
english: Among millions, O Siblings of Destiny, hardly one humble servant of the Lord is found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak rataa sach naam bhaaee sun man tan niramal hoi ||4||2||
english: Nanak is imbued with the True Name, O Siblings of Destiny; hearing it, the mind and body become immaculately pure. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 dutuke ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਭਾਉ ਅਭਾਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਦੂਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jau lau bhaau abhaau ihu maanai tau lau milan dooraaee ||
english: As long as this person believes in love and hate, it is difficult for him to meet the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਆਪਨਾ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਬੀਚੁ ਬਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aan aapanaa karat beechaaraa tau lau beech bikhaaee ||1||
english: As long as he discriminates between himself and others, he will distance himself from the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਐਸੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maadhave aisee dehu bujhaaee ||
english: O Lord, grant me such understanding,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਉ ਸਾਧ ਗਹਉ ਓਟ ਚਰਨਾ ਨਹ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਚਸਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sevau saadh gahau ot charanaa nah bisarai muhat chasaaee || rahaau ||
english: that I might serve the Holy Saints, and seek the protection of their feet, and not forget them, for a moment, even an instant. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਚੇਤ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਤੁਮ ਐਸੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: re man mugadh achet cha(n)chal chit tum aisee ridai na aaee ||
english: O foolish, thoughtless and fickle mind, such understanding did not come into your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਤੂ ਰਚਿਆ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: praanapat tiaag aan too rachiaa urajhio sa(n)g bairaaee ||2||
english: Renouncing the Lord of Life, you have become engrossed in other things, and you are involved with your enemies. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਥਾਪੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sog na biaapai aap na thaapai saadhasa(n)gat budh paaee ||
english: Sorrow does not afflict one who does not harbor self-conceit; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have attained this understanding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਾ ਬਕਨਾ ਇਉ ਜਾਨਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saakat kaa bakanaa iu jaanau jaise pavan jhulaaee ||3||
english: Know that the babbling of the faithless cynic is like wind passing by. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਅਛਾਦਿਓ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kot paraadh achhaadio ihu man kahanaa kachhoo na jaaee ||
english: This mind is inundated by millions of sins - what can I say?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਠਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak deen saran aaio prabh sabh lekhaa rakhahu uthaaee ||4||3||
english: Nanak, Your humble servant has come to Your Sanctuary, God; please, erase all his accounts. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਨਬੰਧੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr lok grih banitaa maaiaa sanaba(n)dhehee ||
english: Children, spouses, men and women in one's household, are all bound by Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
