gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਕੋ ਖਰਾ ਨ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਅਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)t kee baar ko kharaa na hosee sabh mithiaa asanehee ||1||
english: At the very last moment, none of them shall stand by you; their love is totally false. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਕਾਹੇ ਪਪੋਰਹੁ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: re nar kaahe paporahu dehee ||
english: O man, why do you pamper your body so?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਡਿ ਜਾਇਗੋ ਧੂਮੁ ਬਾਦਰੋ ਇਕੁ ਭਾਜਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ood jaaigo dhoom baadaro ik bhaajahu raam sanehee || rahaau ||
english: It shall disperse like a cloud of smoke; vibrate upon the One, the Beloved Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਸੰਙਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਜਲ ਕੂਕਰ ਭਸਮੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: teen sa(n)ngiaa kar dehee keenee jal kookar bhasamehee ||
english: There are three ways in which the body can be consumed - it can be thrown into water, given to the dogs, or cremated to ashes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਆਮਰੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਬਿਸਰੋਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hoi aamaro grih mahi baithaa karan kaaran bisarohee ||2||
english: He considers himself to be immortal; he sits in his home, and forgets the Lord, the Cause of causes. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਣੀਏ ਸਾਜੇ ਕਾਚੈ ਤਾਗਿ ਪਰੋਹੀ ॥
transliteration: anik bhaat kar maneee saaje kaachai taag parohee ||
english: In various ways, the Lord has fashioned the beads, and strung them on a slender thread.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂਟਿ ਜਾਇਗੋ ਸੂਤੁ ਬਾਪੁਰੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤੋਹੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: toot jaaigo soot baapure phir paachhai pachhutohee ||3||
english: The thread shall break, O wretched man, and then, you shall repent and regret. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਰਜੇ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jin tum siraje siraj savaare tis dhiaavahu din rainehee ||
english: He created you, and after creating you, He adorned you - meditate on Him day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਟ ਗਹੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak prabh kirapaa dhaaree mai satigur ot gahehee ||4||4||
english: God has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; I hold tight to the Support of the True Guru. ||4||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa bhetio vadabhaagee manahi bhaiaa paragaasaa ||
english: I met the True Guru, by great good fortune, and my mind has been enlightened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: koi na pahuchanahaaraa doojaa apune saahib kaa bharavaasaa ||1||
english: No one else can equal me, because I have the loving support of my Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: apune satigur kai balihaarai ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aagai sukh paachhai sukh sahajaa ghar aana(n)d hamaarai || rahaau ||
english: I am at peace in this world, and I shall be in celestial peace in the next; my home is filled with bliss. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee karanaihaaraa soee khasam hamaaraa ||
english: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Creator, my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nirabhau bhae gur charanee laage ik raam naam aadhaaraa ||2||
english: I have become fearless, attached to the Guru's feet; I take the Support of the Name of the One Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saphal darasan akaal moorat prabh hai bhee hovanahaaraa ||
english: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; the Form of God is deathless; He is and shall always be.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ka(n)th lagaai apune jan raakhe apunee preet piaaraa ||3||
english: He hugs His humble servants close, and protects and preserves them; their love for Him is sweet to Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਅਚਰਜ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: vadee vadiaaee acharaj sobhaa kaaraj aaiaa raase ||
english: Great is His glorious greatness, and wondrous is His magnificence; through Him, all affairs are resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak kau gur pooraa bhetio sagale dookh binaase ||4||5||
english: Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru; all his sorrows have been dispelled. ||4||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੀਏ ਕਉ ਪੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਰੋਗੀ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਰੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: sukheee kau pekhai sabh sukheeaa rogee kai bhaanai sabh rogee ||
english: To the happy person, everyone seems happy; to the sick person, everyone seems sick.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪਨ ਹਾਥਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karan karaavanahaar suaamee aapan haath sa(n)jogee ||1||
english: The Lord and Master acts, and causes us to act; union is in His Hands. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: man mere jin apunaa bharam gavaataa ||
english: O my mind, no one appears to be mistaken, to one who has dispelled his own doubts;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tis kai bhaanai koi na bhoolaa jin sagalo braham pachhaataa || rahaau ||
english: He realizes that everyone is God. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਠਾਂਢੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sa(n)g jaa kaa man seetal ohu jaanai sagalee thaa(n)dhee ||
english: One whose mind is comforted in the Society of the Saints, believes that all are joyful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਆਪਿਤ ਓਹੁ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: haumai rog jaa kaa man biaapit ohu janam marai bilalaatee ||2||
english: One whose mind is afflicted by the disease of egotism, cries out in birth and death. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: giaan a(n)jan jaa kee netree paRiaa taa kau sarab pragaasaa ||
english: Everything is clear to one whose eyes are blessed with the ointment of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਅੰਧੇਰੈ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਭਰਮਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: agiaan a(n)dherai soojhas naahee bahuR bahuR bharamaataa ||3||
english: In the darkness of spiritual ignorance, he sees nothing at all; he wanders around in reincarnation, over and over again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: sun bena(n)tee suaamee apune naanak ihu sukh maagai ||
english: Hear my prayer, O Lord and Master; Nanak begs for this happiness:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਹ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: jah keeratan teraa saadhoo gaavahi tah meraa man laagai ||4||6||
english: whereever Your Holy Saints sing the Kirtan of Your Praises, let my mind be attached to that place. ||4||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tan sa(n)tan kaa dhan sa(n)tan kaa man sa(n)tan kaa keeaa ||
english: My body belongs to the Saints, my wealth belongs to the Saints, and my mind belongs to the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਰਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਤਬ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad har naam dhiaaiaa sarab kusal tab theeaa ||1||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, I meditate on the Lord's Name, and then, all comforts come to me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਬੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan bin avar na daataa beeaa ||
english: Without the Saints, there are no other givers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ਕੀਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo jo saran parai saadhoo kee so paaragaraamee keeaa || rahaau ||
english: Whoever takes to the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints, is carried across. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kot paraadh mitahi jan sevaa har keeratan ras gaaeeai ||
english: Millions of sins are erased by serving the humble Saints, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: eehaa sukh aagai mukh oojal jan kaa sa(n)g vadabhaagee paaeeai ||2||
english: One finds peace in this world, and one's face is radiant in the next world, by associating with the humble Saints, through great good fortune. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਗੁਣ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa ek anek gun pooran jan kee ketak upamaa kaheeai ||
english: I have only one tongue, and the Lord's humble servant is filled with countless virtues; how can I sing his praises?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸਦ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: agam agochar sad abinaasee saran sa(n)tan kee laheeai ||3||
english: The inaccessible, unapproachable and eternally unchanging Lord is obtained in the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਨੀਚ ਅਨਾਥ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਓਟ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਆਹੀ ॥
transliteration: niragun neech anaath aparaadhee ot sa(n)tan kee aahee ||
english: I am worthless, lowly, without friends or support, and full of sins; I long for the Shelter of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਮੋਹ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: boodat moh grih a(n)dh koop mahi naanak lehu nibaahee ||4||7||
english: I am drowning in the deep, dark pit of household attachments - please save me, Lord! ||4||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਤੂ ਕਰਤੇ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤੈਂ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai hiradai vasiaa too karate taa kee tai(n) aas pujaaee ||
english: O Creator Lord, You fulfill the desires of those, within whose heart You abide.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਤੂ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਰਣ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daas apune kau too visarahi naahee charan dhoor man bhaaee ||1||
english: Your slaves do not forget You; the dust of Your feet is pleasing to their minds. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: teree akath kathaa kathan na jaaee ||
english: Your Unspoken Speech cannot be spoken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਬਡਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan sukhadaate suaamee sabh te ooch badaaee || rahaau ||
english: O treasure of excellence, Giver of peace, Lord and Master, Your greatness is the highest of all. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੋ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੁਮ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: so so karam karat hai praanee jaisee tum likh paaee ||
english: The mortal does those deeds, and those alone, which You ordained by destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਸੇਵਾ ਦੀਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sevak kau tum sevaa deenee darasan dekh aghaaee ||2||
english: Your servant, whom You bless with Your service, is satisfied and fulfilled, beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sarab nira(n)tar tumahi samaane jaa kau tudh aap bujhaaee ||
english: You are contained in all, but he alone realizes this, whom You bless with understanding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur parasaad mitio agiaanaa pragat bhae sabh thaaee ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, his spiritual ignorance is dispelled, and he is respected everywhere. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਈ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: soee giaanee soee dhiaanee soee purakh subhaaee ||
english: He alone is spiritually enlightened, he alone is a meditator, and he alone is a man of good nature.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jis bhae daiaalaa taa kau man te bisar na jaaee ||4||8||
english: Says Nanak, one unto whom the Lord becomes Merciful, does not forget the Lord from his mind. ||4||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੀ ਕਬ ਊਚੇ ਕਬ ਨੀਚੇ ॥
transliteration: sagal samagree mohi viaapee kab ooche kab neeche ||
english: The whole creation is engrossed in emotional attachment; sometimes, one is high, and at other times, low.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਤਨਾ ਓੜਕਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sudh na hoeeai kaahoo jatanaa oRak ko na pahooche ||1||
english: No one can be purified by any rituals or devices; they cannot reach their goal. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਿ ਛੁਟਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man saadh saran chhutakaaraa ||
english: O my mind, emancipation is attained in the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਰਹਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਤ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin gur poore janam maran na rahaee phir aavat baaro baaraa || rahaau ||
english: Without the Perfect Guru, births and deaths do not cease, and one comes and goes, over and over again. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਜੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ohu j bharam bhulaavaa kaheeat tin mahi urajhio sagal sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The whole world is entangled in what is called the delusion of doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਤੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਾ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਤੇ ਨਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pooran bhagat purakh suaamee kaa sarab thok te niaaraa ||2||
english: The perfect devotee of the Primal Lord God remains detached from everything. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤੈ ਏਹੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dau naahee kaahoo baatai ehu khasam kaa keeaa ||
english: Don't indulge in slander for any reason, for everything is the creation of the Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਉ ਲੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kau kripaa karee prabh merai mil saadhasa(n)gat naau leeaa ||3||
english: One who is blessed with the Mercy of my God, dwells on the Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਤ ਉਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham paramesur satigur sabhanaa karat udhaaraa ||
english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the True Guru, saves all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਰੀਐ ਇਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur bin nahee tareeai ihu pooran tat beechaaraa ||4||9||
english: Says Nanak, without the Guru, no one crosses over; this is the perfect essence of all contemplation. ||4||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat khoj beechaario raam naam tat saaraa ||
english: I have searched and searched and searched, and found that the Lord's Name is the most sublime reality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kilabikh kaate nimakh araadhiaa guramukh paar utaaraa ||1||
english: Contemplating it for even an instant, sins are erased; the Gurmukh is carried across and saved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: har ras peevahu purakh giaanee ||
english: Drink in the sublime essence of the Lord's Name, O man of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਹਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sun sun mahaa tripat man paavai saadhoo a(n)mrit baanee || rahaau ||
english: Listening to the Ambrosial Words of the Holy Saints, the mind finds absolute fulfillment and satisfaction. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: mukat bhugat jugat sach paaeeai sarab sukhaa kaa daataa ||
english: Liberation, pleasures, and the true way of life are obtained from the Lord, the Giver of all peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: apune daas kau bhagat daan devai pooran purakh bidhaataa ||2||
english: The Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny, blesses His slave with the gift of devotional worship. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਰਸਨਾ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sravanee suneeai rasanaa gaaeeai hiradai dhiaaeeai soee ||
english: Hear with your ears, and sing with your tongue, and meditate within your heart on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath suaamee jaa te brithaa na koee ||3||
english: The Lord and Master is all-powerful, the Cause of causes; without Him, there is nothing at all. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag ratan janam paaiaa karahu kripaa kirapaalaa ||
english: By great good fortune, I have obtained the jewel of human life; have mercy on me, O Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak gun gaavai simarai sadaa goupaalaa ||4||10||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and contemplates Him forever in meditation. ||4||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਅਰੋਗਾ ॥
transliteration: kar isanaan simar prabh apanaa man tan bhae arogaa ||
english: After taking your cleansing bath, remember your God in meditation, and your mind and body shall be free of disease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਲਾਥੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kot bighan laathe prabh saranaa pragate bhale sa(n)jogaa ||1||
english: Millions of obstacles are removed, in the Sanctuary of God, and good fortune dawns. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh baanee sabad subhaakhiaa ||
english: The Word of God's Bani, and His Shabad, are the best utterances.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪੜਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gaavahu sunahu paRahu nit bhaaee gur poorai too raakhiaa || rahaau ||
english: So constantly sing them, listen to them, and read them, O Siblings of Destiny, and the Perfect Guru shall save you. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਮਿਤਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahib amit vadaaee bhagat vachhal daiaalaa ||
english: The glorious greatness of the True Lord is immeasurable; the Merciful Lord is the Lover of His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਆਦਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa kee paij rakhadaa aaiaa aad birad pratipaalaa ||2||
english: He has preserved the honor of His Saints; from the very beginning of time, His Nature is to cherish them. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਭੁੰਚਹੁ ਸਰਬ ਵੇਲਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)mrit naam bhojan nit bhu(n)chahu sarab velaa mukh paavahu ||
english: So eat the Ambrosial Name of the Lord as your food; put it into your mouth at all times.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਤਾਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਾਠਾ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaraa maraa taap sabh naathaa gun gobi(n)d nit gaavahu ||3||
english: The pains of old age and death shall all depart, when you constantly sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sunee aradaas suaamee merai sarab kalaa ban aaee ||
english: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer, and all my affairs have been resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਈ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: pragat bhaee sagale jug a(n)tar gur naanak kee vadiaaee ||4||11||
english: The glorious greatness of Guru Nanak is manifest, throughout all the ages. ||4||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ghar 2 chaupade ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਏਕਸ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ek pitaa ekas ke ham baarik too meraa gur haaee ||
english: The One God is our father; we are the children of the One God. You are our Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sun meetaa jeeu hamaaraa bal bal jaasee har darasan dehu dikhaaee ||1||
english: Listen, friends: my soul is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You; O Lord, reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਧੂਰੀ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sun meetaa dhooree kau bal jaaee ||
english: Listen, friends: I am a sacrifice to the dust of Your feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ihu man teraa bhaaee || rahaau ||
english: This mind is yours, O Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੈ ਕੂ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: paav malovaa mal mal dhovaa ihu man tai koo desaa ||
english: I wash your feet, I massage and clean them; I give this mind to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sun meetaa hau teree saranaaee aaiaa prabh milau dehu upadesaa ||2||
english: Listen, friends: I have come to Your Sanctuary; teach me, that I might unite with God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੀਜੈ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: maan na keejai saran pareejai karai s bhalaa manaaeeai ||
english: Do not be proud; seek His Sanctuary, and accept as good all that He does.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀਜੈ ਇਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sun meetaa jeeu pi(n)d sabh tan arapeejai iu darasan har jeeu paaeeai ||3||
english: Listen, friends: dedicate your soul, body and your whole being to Him; thus you shall receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaio anugrahu prasaad sa(n)tan kai har naamaa hai meethaa ||
english: He has shown mercy to me, by the Grace of the Saints; the Lord's Name is sweet to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau gur kirapaa dhaaree sabh akul nira(n)jan deethaa ||4||1||12||
english: The Guru has shown mercy to servant Nanak; I see the casteless, immaculate Lord everywhere. ||4||1||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kot brahama(n)d ko thaakur suaamee sarab jeeaa kaa daataa re ||
english: God is the Lord and Master of millions of universes; He is the Giver of all beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੂਰਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pratipaalai nit saar samaalai ik gun nahee moorakh jaataa re ||1||
english: He ever cherishes and cares for all beings, but the fool does not appreciate any of His virtues. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har aaraadh na jaanaa re ||
english: I do not know how to worship the Lord in adoration.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har gur gur karataa re ||
english: I can only repeat, "Lord, Lord, Guru, Guru."

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu naam pario raamadaas || rahaau ||
english: O Dear Lord, I go by the name of the Lord's slave. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੀ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal kripaal sukh saagar sarab ghataa bharapooree re ||
english: The Compassionate Lord is Merciful to the meek, the ocean of peace; He fills all hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਦੂਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pekhat sunat sadaa hai sa(n)ge mai moorakh jaaniaa dooree re ||2||
english: He sees, hears, and is always with me; but I am a fool, and I think that He is far away. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਹਉ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਨਉ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੋ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har bia(n)t hau mit kar varanau kiaa jaanaa hoi kaiso re ||
english: The Lord is limitless, but I can only describe Him within my limitations; what do I know, about what He is like?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਦੇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੋ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karau benatee satigur apune mai moorakh dehu upadeso re ||3||
english: I offer my prayer to my True Guru; I am so foolish - please, teach me! ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਬਾਤ ਹੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧੀ ਤਰਿਆ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mai moorakh kee ketak baat hai kot paraadhee tariaa re ||
english: I am just a fool, but millions of sinners just like me have been saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ਨ ਪਰਿਆ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩॥
transliteration: gur naanak jin suniaa pekhiaa se phir garabhaas na pariaa re ||4||2||13||
english: Those who have heard, and seen Guru Nanak, do not descend into the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||2||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਬਾਤ ਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਰੋ ਤੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jinaa baat ko bahut a(n)desaro te mite sabh gaiaa ||
english: Those things, which caused me such anxiety, have all vanished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੈਨ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਨਾਰੀ ਊਧ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਸਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sahaj sain ar sukhaman naaree oodh kamal bigasaiaa ||1||
english: Now, I sleep in peace and tranquility, and my mind is in a state of deep and profound peace; the inverted lotus of my heart has blossomed forth. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਹੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dekhahu acharaj bhaiaa ||
english: Behold, a wondrous miracle has happened!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਸੁਨਤ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਸੋ ਰਿਦੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jih thaakur kau sunat agaadh bodh so ridai gur daiaa || rahaau ||
english: That Lord and Master, whose wisdom is said to be unfathomable, has been enshrined within my heart, by the Guru. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਇ ਦੂਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸੰਤਾਵਤ ਤੇ ਭਇਆਨਕ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: joi doot mohi bahut sa(n)taavat te bhaiaanak bhaiaa ||
english: The demons which tormented me so much, have themselves become terrified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karahi benatee raakh thaakur te ham teree saranaiaa ||2||
english: They pray: please, save us from your Lord Master; we seek your protection. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਖੁਲਿਆ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਹ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jah bha(n)daar gobi(n)d kaa khuliaa jih praapat tih laiaa ||
english: When the treasure of the Lord of the Universe is opened, those who are pre-destined, receive it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਥਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ek ratan mo kau gur deenaa meraa man tan seetal thiaa ||3||
english: The Guru has given me the one jewel, and my mind and body have become peaceful and tranquil. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਤਾ ਅਟਲੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਨ ਮੁਆ ॥
transliteration: ek boo(n)d gur a(n)mrit deeno taa atal amar na muaa ||
english: The Guru has blessed me with the one drop of Ambrosial Nectar, and so I have become stable, unmoving and immortal - I shall not die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਸਉਪੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਲਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪॥
transliteration: bhagat bha(n)daar gur naanak kau saupe phir lekhaa mool na laiaa ||4||3||14||
english: The Lord blessed Guru Nanak with the treasure of devotional worship, and did not call him to account again. ||4||3||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu jaa kaa man leenaa se jan tripat aghaaee ||
english: Those whose minds are attached to the lotus feet of the Lord - those humble beings are satisfied and fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਅਮੋਲ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਵਸਿਆ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gun amol jis ridai na vasiaa te nar trisan trikhaaee ||1||
english: But those, within whose hearts the priceless virtue does not abide - those men remain thirsty and unsatisfied. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਅਰੋਗ ਅਨਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har aaraadhe arog anadaaee ||
english: Worshipping the Lord in adoration, one becomes happy, and free of disease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਖ ਬੇਦਨ ਜਣੁ ਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis no visarai meraa raam sanehee tis laakh bedan jan aaee || rahaau ||
english: But one who forgets my Dear Lord - know him to be afflicted with tens of thousands of illnesses. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਜਨ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੇ ॥
transliteration: jih jan ot gahee prabh teree se sukheee prabh sarane ||
english: Those who hold tightly to Your Support, God, are happy in Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਮਹਿ ਗਨਣੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jih nar bisariaa purakh bidhaataa te dukheeaa mahi ganane ||2||
english: But those humble beings who forget the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, are counted among the most miserable beings. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਹ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jih gur maan prabhoo liv laaee tih mahaa ana(n)d ras kariaa ||
english: One who has faith in the Guru, and who is lovingly attached to God, enjoys the delights of supreme ecstasy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੇਮੁਖਾਈ ਤੇ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jih prabhoo bisaar gur te bemukhaaee te narak ghor mahi pariaa ||3||
english: One who forgets God and forsakes the Guru, falls into the most horrible hell. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jit ko laaiaa tit hee laagaa taiso hee varataaraa ||
english: As the Lord engages someone, so he is engaged, and so does he perform.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹ ਪਕਰੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਏ ਮਗਨ ਚਰਨਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak sah pakaree sa(n)tan kee ridai bhae magan charanaaraa ||4||4||15||
english: Nanak has taken to the Shelter of the Saints; his heart is absorbed in the Lord's feet. ||4||4||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ਮਾਨਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: raajan mahi raajaa urajhaaio maanan mahi abhimaanee ||
english: As the king is entangled in kingly affairs, and the egotist in his own egotism,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਲੋਭਾਇਓ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਚੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lobhan mahi lobhee lobhaaio tiu har ra(n)g rache giaanee ||1||
english: and the greedy man is enticed by greed, so is the spiritually enlightened being absorbed in the Love of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਇਹੀ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har jan kau ihee suhaavai ||
english: This is what befits the Lord's servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pekh nikat kar sevaa satigur har keeratan hee tripataavai || rahaau ||
english: Beholding the Lord near at hand, he serves the True Guru, and he is satisfied through the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮਲਨ ਸਿਉ ਅਮਲੀ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ਭੂਮਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: amalan siu amalee lapataaio bhooman bhoom piaaree ||
english: The addict is addicted to his drug, and the landlord is in love with his land.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੀਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਹੈ ਲੀਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਤ ਐਸੇ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kheer sa(n)g baarik hai leenaa prabh sa(n)t aise hitakaaree ||2||
english: As the baby is attached to his milk, so the Saint is in love with God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਦੁਅੰਸੀ ਰਚਿਆ ਨੈਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bidiaa mahi bidua(n)see rachiaa nain dekh sukh paavahi ||
english: The scholar is absorbed in scholarship, and the eyes are happy to see.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੁਭਾਨੀ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaise rasanaa saad lubhaanee tiu har jan har gun gaavahi ||3||
english: As the tongue savors the tastes, so does the humble servant of the Lord sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਕੁ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: jaisee bhookh taisee kaa poorak sagal ghataa kaa suaamee ||
english: As is the hunger, so is the fulfiller; He is the Lord and Master of all hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਲਗੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak piaas lagee darasan kee prabh miliaa a(n)tarajaamee ||4||5||16||
english: Nanak thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; he has met God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||5||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੈਲੇ ਤੁਮ ਊਜਲ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ham maile tum oojal karate ham niragun too daataa ||
english: We are filthy, and You are immaculate, O Creator Lord; we are worthless, and You are the Great Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਤੁਮ ਚਤੁਰ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਾ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ham moorakh tum chatur siaane too sarab kalaa kaa giaataa ||1||
english: We are fools, and You are wise and all-knowing. You are the knower of all things. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧੋ ਹਮ ਐਸੇ ਤੂ ਐਸਾ ॥
transliteration: maadho ham aise too aisaa ||
english: O Lord, this is what we are, and this is what You are.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨ ਨੀਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੇਸਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham paapee tum paap kha(n)dan neeko thaakur desaa || rahaau ||
english: We are sinners, and You are the Destroyer of sins. Your abode is so beautiful, O Lord and Master. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tum sabh saaje saaj nivaaje jeeu pi(n)d de praanaa ||
english: You fashion all, and having fashioned them, You bless them. You bestow upon them soul, body and the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਤੁਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: niraguneeaare gun nahee koee tum daan dehu miharavaanaa ||2||
english: We are worthless - we have no virtue at all; please, bless us with Your gift, O Merciful Lordand Master. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਭਲਾ ਹਮ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਤੁਮ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: tum karahu bhalaa ham bhalo na jaanah tum sadaa sadaa daiaalaa ||
english: You do good for us, but we do not see it as good; You are kind and compassionate, forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਬਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tum sukhadaaee purakh bidhaate tum raakhahu apune baalaa ||3||
english: You are the Giver of peace, the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny; please, save us, Your children! ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਟਲ ਸੁਲਿਤਾਨ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਚੈ ॥
transliteration: tum nidhaan atal sulitaan jee ja(n)t sabh jaachai ||
english: You are the treasure, eternal Lord King; all beings and creatures beg of You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਇਹੈ ਹਵਾਲਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ham ihai havaalaa raakh sa(n)tan kai paachhai ||4||6||17||
english: Says Nanak, such is our condition; please, Lord, keep us on the Path of the Saints. ||4||6||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਨ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਦੇ ਤਹ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maat garabh mahi aapan simaran de tah tum raakhanahaare ||
english: In our mother's womb, You blessed us with Your meditative remembrance, and You preserved us there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਕ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਲਹਰਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਤਾਰਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paavak saagar athaah lahar mahi taarahu taaranahaare ||1||
english: Through the countless waves of the ocean of fire, please, carry us across and save us, O Savior Lord! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧੌ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maadhau too thaakur sir moraa ||
english: O Lord, You are the Master above my head.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਧੋਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: eehaa oohaa tuhaaro dhoraa || rahaau ||
english: Here and hereafter, You alone are my Support. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤੇ ਕਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਮਾਨੈ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: keete kau merai sa(n)maanai karanahaar trin jaanai ||
english: He looks upon the creation like a mountain of gold, and sees the Creator as a blade of grass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਸਗਲੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too daataa maagan kau sagalee daan dehi prabh bhaanai ||2||
english: You are the Great Giver, and we are all mere beggars; O God, You give gifts according to Your Will. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਚਲਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi avar khinai mahi avaraa acharaj chalat tumaare ||
english: In an instant, You are one thing, and in another instant, You are another. Wondrous are Your ways!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂੜੋ ਗੂੜੋ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੋ ਊਚੌ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: rooRo gooRo gahir ga(n)bheero oochau agam apaare ||3||
english: You are beautiful, mysterious, profound, unfathomable, lofty, inaccessible and infinite. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਉ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਸੁਨੀ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jau tumahi milaaio tau sunee tumaaree baanee ||
english: When You brought me to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, then I heard the Bani of Your Word.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੮॥
transliteration: anad bhaiaa pekhat hee naanak prataap purakh nirabaanee ||4||7||18||
english: Nanak is in ecstasy, beholding the Glory of the Primal Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||4||7||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਮ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ham sa(n)tan kee ren piaare ham sa(n)tan kee saranaa ||
english: I am the dust of the feet of the Beloved Saints; I seek the Protection of their Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t hamaaree ot sataanee sa(n)t hamaaraa gahanaa ||1||
english: The Saints are my all-powerful Support; the Saints are my ornament and decoration. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: ham sa(n)tan siu ban aaee ||
english: I am hand and glove with the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa paaee ||
english: I have realized my pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ihu man teraa bhaaee || rahaau ||
english: This mind is yours, O Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਲੇਵਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan siu meree levaa devee sa(n)tan siu biuhaaraa ||
english: My dealings are with the Saints, and my business is with the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਹਮ ਲਾਹਾ ਖਾਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan siu ham laahaa khaatiaa har bhagat bhare bha(n)daaraa ||2||
english: I have earned the profit with the Saints, and the treasure filled to over-flowing with devotion to the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਉਪੀ ਤਉ ਉਤਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਧੋਖਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan mo kau poo(n)jee saupee tau utariaa man kaa dhokhaa ||
english: The Saints entrusted to me the capital, and my mind's delusion was dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਅਬ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈਗੋ ਜਉ ਫਾਟਿਓ ਸਗਲੋ ਲੇਖਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dharam raai ab kahaa karaigo jau phaatio sagalo lekhaa ||3||
english: What can the Righteous Judge of Dharma do now? All my accounts have been torn up. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਭਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦੇ ॥
transliteration: mahaa ana(n)d bhae sukh paaiaa sa(n)tan kai parasaade ||
english: I have found the greatest bliss, and I am at peace, by the Grace of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੇ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak har siu man maaniaa ra(n)g rate bisamaade ||4||8||19||
english: Says Nanak, my mind is reconciled with the Lord; it is imbued with the wondrous Love of the Lord. ||4||8||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mah 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰੇ ਨਰ ਤੇਤੀ ਹੀ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jetee samagree dekhahu re nar tetee hee chhad jaanee ||
english: All the things that you see, O man, you shall have to leave behind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam sa(n)g kar biuhaaraa paavahi pad nirabaanee ||1||
english: Let your dealings be with the Lord's Name, and you shall attain the state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: piaare too mero sukhadaataa ||
english: O my Beloved, You are the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਉਪਦੇਸਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai deeaa upadesaa tum hee sa(n)g paraataa || rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has given me these Teachings, and I am attuned to You. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh moh abhimaanaa taa mahi sukh nahee paaeeai ||
english: In sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and self-conceit, peace is not to be found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਰੇਨ ਤੂ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਉ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hohu ren too sagal kee mere man tau anad ma(n)gal sukh paaeeai ||2||
english: So be the dust of the feet of all, O my mind, and then you shall find bliss, joy and peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਾਲ ਨ ਭਾਨੈ ਅੰਤਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: ghaal na bhaanai a(n)tar bidh jaanai taa kee kar man sevaa ||
english: He knows the condition of your inner self, and He will not let your work go in vain - serve Him, O mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਮਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kar poojaa hom ihu manooaa akaal moorat guradevaa ||3||
english: Worship Him, and dedicate this mind unto Him, the Image of the Undying Lord, the Divine Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਮਾਧਵੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gobid daamodar daiaal maadhave paarabraham nira(n)kaaraa ||
english: He is the Lord of the Universe, the Compassionate Lord, the Supreme Lord God, the Formless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਵਾਲੇਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naam varatan naamo vaalevaa naam naanak praan adhaaraa ||4||9||20||
english: The Naam is my merchandise, the Naam is my nourishment; the Naam, O Nanak, is the Support of my breath of life. ||4||9||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਉ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸਾ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: miratak kau paaio tan saasaa bichhurat aan milaaiaa ||
english: He infuses the breath into the dead bodies, and he reunited the separated ones.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਭਏ ਸ੍ਰੋਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pasoo paret mugadh bhae srote har naamaa mukh gaaiaa ||1||
english: Even beasts, demons and fools become attentive listeners, when He sings the Praises of the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦੇਖੁ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kee dekh vadaaee ||
english: Behold the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taa kee keemat kahan na jaaee || rahaau ||
english: His worth cannot be described. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਾ ਢਾਹਿਓ ਡੇਰਾ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਬਿਸਰਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: dookh sog kaa dhaahio deraa anad ma(n)gal bisaraamaa ||
english: He has demolished the abode of sorrow and disease, and brought bliss, joy and happiness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man baa(n)chhat phal mile achi(n)taa pooran hoe kaamaa ||2||
english: He effortlessly awards the fruits of the mind's desire, and all works are brought to perfection. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: eehaa sukh aagai mukh oojal mit gae aavan jaane ||
english: He finds peace in this world, and his face is radiant in the world hereafter; his comings and goings are finished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nirabhau bhae hiradai naam vasiaa apune satigur kai man bhaane ||3||
english: He becomes fearless, and his heart is filled with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; his mind is pleasing to the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat har gun gaavai dookh darad bhram bhaagaa ||
english: Standing up and sitting down, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; his pain, sorrow and doubt are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੨੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak taa ke poor kara(n)maa jaa kaa gur charanee man laagaa ||4||10||21||
english: Says Nanak, his karma is perfect; his mind is attached to the Guru's feet. ||4||10||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕਉਡੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: ratan chhaad kaudee sa(n)g laage jaa te kachhoo na paaeeai ||
english: Forsaking the jewel, he is attached to the shell; nothing will come of it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pooran paarabraham paramesur mere man sadaa dhiaaeeai ||1||
english: O my mind, meditate forever on the Perfect, Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: simarahu har har naam paraanee ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O mortal.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: binasai kaachee deh agiaanee || rahaau ||
english: Your frail body shall perish, you ignorant fool. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਪਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mrig trisanaa ar supan manorath taa kee kachh na vadaaee ||
english: Illusions and dream-objects possess nothing of greatness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam bhajan bin kaam na aavas sa(n)g na kaahoo jaaee ||2||
english: Without meditating on the Lord, nothing succeeds, and nothing will go along with you. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਇ ਅਵਰਦਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: hau hau karat bihaai avaradaa jee ko kaam na keenaa ||
english: Acting in egotism and pride, his life passes away, and he does nothing for his soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤ ਧਾਵਤ ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhaavat dhaavat nah tripataasiaa raam naam nahee cheenaa ||3||
english: Wandering and wandering all around, he is never satisfied; he does not remember the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੋ ਅਸੰਖ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਫੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saad bikaar bikhai ras maato asa(n)kh khate kar phere ||
english: Intoxicated with the taste of corruption, cruel pleasures and countless sins, he is consigned to the cycle of reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਹਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak kee prabh paahi bina(n)tee kaatahu avagun mere ||4||11||22||
english: Nanak offers his prayer to God, to eradicate his demerits. ||4||11||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavahu pooran abinaasee kaam krodh bikh jaare ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect, Imperishable Lord, and the poison of sexual desire and anger shall be burnt away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੋ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mahaa bikham agan ko saagar saadhoo sa(n)g udhaare ||1||
english: You shall cross over the awesome, arduous ocean of fire, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਟਿਓ ਭਰਮੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: poorai gur metio bharam a(n)dheraa ||
english: The Perfect Guru has dispelled the darkness of doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaj prem bhagat prabh neraa || rahaau ||
english: Remember God with love and devotion; He is near at hand. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har har naam nidhaan ras peeaa man tan rahe aghaaee ||
english: Drink in the sublime essence, the treasure of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and your mind and body shall remain satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕਤ ਆਵੈ ਕਤ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jat kat poor rahio paramesar kat aavai kat jaaee ||2||
english: The Transcendent Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere; where would He come from, and where would He go? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤ ਬੇਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam giaan tat betaa jis man vasai goupaalaa ||
english: One whose mind is filled with the Lord, is a person of meditation, penance, self-restraint and spiritual wisdom, and a knower of reality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam ratan jin guramukh paaiaa taa kee pooran ghaalaa ||3||
english: The Gurmukh obtains the jewel of the Naam; his efforts come to perfect fruition. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: kal kales mite dukh sagale kaatee jam kee phaasaa ||
english: All his struggles, sufferings and pains are dispelled, and the noose of death is cut away from him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਬਿਗਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh kirapaa dhaaree man tan bhae bigaasaa ||4||12||23||
english: Says Nanak, God has extended His Mercy, and so his mind and body blossom forth. ||4||12||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਰਾਵਣਹਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavanahaar prabh daataa paarabraham prabh suaamee ||
english: God is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Great Giver; God is the Supreme Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੀਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sagale jee keee daiaalaa so prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||1||
english: The Merciful Lord created all beings; God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: meraa gur hoaa aap sahaaee ||
english: My Guru is Himself my friend and support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਅਚਰਜ ਭਈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ma(n)gal ras acharaj bhaee badaaee || rahaau ||
english: I am in celestial peace, bliss, joy, pleasure and wondrous glory. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਏ ਭੈ ਨਾਸੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kee saran pae bhai naase saachee daragah maane ||
english: Seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru, my fears have been dispelled, and I am accepted in the Court of the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਏ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਥਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gun gaavat aaraadh naam har aae apunai thaane ||2||
english: Singing His Glorious Praises, and worshipping in adoration the Name of the Lord, I have reached my destination. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਭ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar karai sabh usatat sa(n)gat saadh piaaree ||
english: Everyone applauds and congratulates me; the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is dear to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sad balihaar jaau prabh apune jin pooran paij savaaree ||3||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to my God, who has totally protected and preserved my honor. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਸਟਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gosat giaan naam sun udhare jin jin darasan paaiaa ||
english: They are saved, who receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; they listen to the spiritual dialogue of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੪॥
transliteration: bhaio kripaal naanak prabh apunaa anad setee ghar aaiaa ||4||13||24||
english: Nanak's God has become Merciful to him; he has arrived home in ecstasy. ||4||13||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਲਾਥੇ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee saran sagal bhai laathe dukh binase sukh paaiaa ||
english: In God's Sanctuary, all fears depart, suffering disappears, and peace is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daiaal hoaa paarabraham suaamee pooraa satigur dhiaaiaa ||1||
english: When the Supreme Lord God and Master becomes merciful, we meditate on the Perfect True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh jeeu too mero saahib daataa ||
english: O Dear God, You are my Lord Master and Great Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh deen daiaalaa gun gaavau ra(n)g raataa || rahaau ||
english: By Your Mercy, O God, Merciful to the meek, imbue me with Your Love, that I might sing Your Glorious Praises. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur naam nidhaan driRaaiaa chi(n)taa sagal binaasee ||
english: The True Guru has implanted the treasure of the Naam within me, and all my anxieties have been dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apuno kar leenaa man vasiaa abinaasee ||2||
english: By His Mercy, He has made me His own, and the imperishable Lord has come to dwell within my mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
transliteration: taa kau bighan na kooo laagai jo satigur apunai raakhe ||
english: No misfortune afflicts one who is protected by the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸੇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: charan kamal base rid a(n)tar a(n)mrit har ras chaakhe ||3||
english: The Lotus Feet of God come to abide within his heart, and he savors the sublime essence of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kar sevaa sevak prabh apune jin man kee ichh pujaaee ||
english: So, as a servant, serve your God, who fulfills your mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak daas taa kai balihaarai jin pooran paij rakhaaee ||4||14||25||
english: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to the Perfect Lord, who has protected and preserved his honor. ||4||14||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨੁ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa moh magan a(n)dhiaarai devanahaar na jaanai ||
english: Infatuated with the darkness of emotional attachment to Maya, he does not know the Lord, the Great Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਬਲੁ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d saaj jin rachiaa bal apuno kar maanai ||1||
english: The Lord created his body and fashioned his soul, but he claims that his power is his own. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੂੜੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: man mooRe dekh rahio prabh suaamee ||
english: O foolish mind, God, your Lord and Master is watching over you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਛਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karahi soee soee jaanai rahai na kachhooai chhaanee || rahaau ||
english: Whatever you do, He knows; nothing can remain concealed from Him. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸੁਆਦ ਲੋਭ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤੋ ਉਪਜੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa suaad lobh mad maato upaje anik bikaaraa ||
english: You are intoxicated with the tastes of the tongue, with greed and pride; countless sins spring from these.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਰਮਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੇ ਭਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bahut jon bharamat dukh paaiaa haumai ba(n)dhan ke bhaaraa ||2||
english: You wandered in pain through countless incarnations, weighed down by the chains of egotism. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਇ ਕਿਵਾੜ ਅਨਿਕ ਪੜਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਫਾਕੈ ॥
transliteration: dei kivaaR anik paRade mahi par daaraa sa(n)g phaakai ||
english: Behind closed doors, hidden by many screens, the man takes his pleasure with another man's wife.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਤਬ ਕਉਣੁ ਪੜਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਢਾਕੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chitr gupat jab lekhaa maagahi tab kaun paRadaa teraa dhaakai ||3||
english: When Chitr and Gupt, the celestial accountants of the conscious and subconscious, call for your account, who will screen you then? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤੁਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਓਟ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal pooran dukh bha(n)jan tum bin ot na kaaee ||
english: O Perfect Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pain, without You, I have no shelter at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੬॥
transliteration: kaadh lehu sa(n)saar saagar mahi naanak prabh saranaaee ||4||15||26||
english: Please, lift me up out of the world-ocean; O God, I have come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||15||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਹਾਈ ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham hoaa sahaaee kathaa keeratan sukhadaaee ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has become my helper and friend; His sermon and the Kirtan of His Praises have brought me peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur poore kee baanee jap anad karahu nit praanee ||1||
english: Chant the Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani, and be ever in bliss, O mortal. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har saachaa simarahu bhaaee ||
english: Remember the True Lord in meditation, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g sadaa sukh paaeeai har bisar na kabahoo jaaee || rahaau ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, eternal peace is obtained, and the Lord is never forgotten. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam paramesar teraa jo simarai so jeevai ||
english: Your Name, O Transcendent Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar; whoever meditates on it, lives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਥੀਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis no karam paraapat hovai so jan niramal theevai ||2||
english: One who is blessed with God's Grace - that humble servant becomes immaculate and pure. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਘਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਨ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: bighan binaasan sabh dukh naasan gur charanee man laagaa ||
english: Obstacles are removed, and all pains are eliminated; my mind is attached to the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gun gaavat achut abinaasee anadin har ra(n)g jaagaa ||3||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the immovable and imperishable Lord, one remains awake to the Lord's Love, day and night. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥
transliteration: man ichhe seee phal paae har kee kathaa suhelee ||
english: He obtains the fruits of his mind's desires, listening to the comforting sermon of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਬੇਲੀ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੭॥
transliteration: aad a(n)t madh naanak kau so prabh hoaa belee ||4||16||27||
english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, God is Nanak's best friend. ||4||16||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 pa(n)chapadaa ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binasai mohu meraa ar teraa binasai apanee dhaaree ||1||
english: May my emotional attachment, my sense of mine and yours, and my self-conceit be dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਇਹਾ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu ihaa bataavahu kaaree ||
english: O Saints, show me such a way,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit haumai garab nivaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: by which my egotism and pride might be eliminated. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹੋਵਾਂ ਸਗਲ ਰੇਨਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sarab bhoot paarabraham kar maaniaa hovaa(n) sagal renaaree ||2||
english: I see the Supreme Lord God in all beings, and I am the dust of all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਭੀਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pekhio prabh jeeu apunai sa(n)ge chookai bheet bhramaaree ||3||
english: I see God always with me, and the wall of doubt has been shattered. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aukhadh naam niramal jal a(n)mrit paaeeai guroo duaaree ||4||
english: The medicine of the Naam, and the Immaculate Water of Ambrosial Nectar, are obtained through the Guru's Gate. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਦਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੧੭॥੨੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jis masatak likhiaa tis gur mil rog bidaaree ||5||17||28||
english: Says Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, meets with the Guru, and his diseases are cured. ||5||17||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ghar 2 dupade ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਬਨਸਪਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੂਧ ਮਹਿ ਘੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sagal banasapat mahi baisa(n)tar sagal doodh mahi gheeaa ||
english: Fire is contained in all firewood, and butter is contained in all milk.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ooch neech mahi jot samaanee ghat ghat maadhau jeeaa ||1||
english: God's Light is contained in the high and the low; the Lord is in the hearts of all beings. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਹਿਓ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu ghat ghat rahiaa samaahio ||
english: O Saints, He is pervading and permeating each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਆਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pooran poor rahio sarab mahi jal thal ramaeeaa aahio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Lord is completely permeating everyone, everywhere; He is diffused in the water and the land. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan naanak jas gaavai satigur bharam chukaaio ||
english: Nanak sings the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of excellence; the True Guru has dispelled his doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਦਾ ਅਲੇਪਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੯॥
transliteration: sarab nivaasee sadaa alepaa sabh mahi rahiaa samaaio ||2||1||29||
english: The Lord is pervading everywhere, permeating all, and yet, He is unattached from all. ||2||1||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਦੁਖੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran hoi ana(n)daa binasai janam maran bhai dukhee ||
english: Meditating on Him, one is in ecstasy; the pains of birth and death and fear are removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chaar padaarath nav nidh paavahi bahur na trisanaa bhukhee ||1||
english: The four cardinal blessings, and the nine treasures are received; you shall never feel hunger or thirst again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਤੂ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa ko naam lait too sukhee ||
english: Chanting His Name, you shall be at peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਮੁਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saas saas dhiaavahu thaakur kau man tan jeeare mukhee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: With each and every breath, meditate on the Lord and Master, O my soul, with mind, body and mouth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧੁਖੀ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)t paavahi hovahi man seetal agan na a(n)tar dhukhee ||
english: You shall find peace, and your mind shall be soothed and cooled; the fire of desire shall not burn within you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰੁਖੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੦॥
transliteration: gur naanak kau prabhoo dikhaaiaa jal thal tribhavan rukhee ||2||2||30||
english: The Guru has revealed God to Nanak, in the three worlds, in the water, the earth and the woods. ||2||2||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਝੂਠ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਇਨ ਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh jhooth ni(n)daa in te aap chhadaavahu ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, greed, falsehood and slander - please, save me from these, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਭੀਤਰ ਤੇ ਇਨ ਕਉ ਡਾਰਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ih bheetar te in kau daarahu aapan nikat bulaavahu ||1||
english: Please eradicate these from within me, and call me to come close to You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਨਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: apunee bidh aap janaavahu ||
english: You alone teach me Your Ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jan ma(n)gal gaavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: With the Lord's humble servants, I sing His Praises. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਹੀਏ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: bisar naahee kabahoo heee te ih bidh man mahi paavahu ||
english: May I never forget the Lord within my heart; please, instill such understanding within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਧਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੧॥
transliteration: gur pooraa bhetio vadabhaagee jan naanak katahi na dhaavahu ||2||3||31||
english: By great good fortune, servant Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru, and now, he will not go anywhere else. ||2||3||31||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran sabh kachh paaeeai birathee ghaal na jaaee ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, all things are obtained, and one's efforts shall not be in vain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਤ ਰਾਚਹੁ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis prabh tiaag avar kat raachahu jo sabh mahi rahiaa samaaee ||1||
english: Forsaking God, why do you attach yourself to another? He is contained in everything. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: har har simarahu sa(n)t gopaalaa ||
english: O Saints, meditate in remembrance on the World-Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mil naam dhiaavahu pooran hovai ghaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; your efforts shall be rewarded. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਨਿਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saar samaalai nit pratipaalai prem sahit gal laavai ||
english: He ever preserves and cherishes His servant; with Love, He hugs him close.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਜਗਤ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh tumare bisarat jagat jeevan kaise paavai ||2||4||32||
english: Says Nanak, forgetting You, O God, how can the world find life? ||2||4||32||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: abinaasee jeean ko daataa simarat sabh mal khoee ||
english: He is imperishable, the Giver of all beings; meditating on Him, all filth is removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਬਰਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan bhagatan kau baratan biralaa paavai koee ||1||
english: He is the treasure of excellence, the object of His devotees, but rare are those who find Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: mere man jap gur gopaal prabh soee ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Guru, and God, the Cherisher of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee saran paiaa(n) sukh paaeeai baahuR dookh na hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Seeking His Sanctuary, one finds peace, and he shall not suffer in pain again. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee saadhasa(n)g paraapat tin bhetat duramat khoee ||
english: By great good fortune, one obtains the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Meeting them, evil-mindedness is eliminated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਬਾਛੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰੋਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੩੩॥
transliteration: tin kee dhoor naanak daas baachhai jin har naam ridai paroee ||2||5||33||
english: Slave Nanak yearns for the dust of the feet of those, who have woven the Lord's Name into their hearts. ||2||5||33||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸੂਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke dookh nivaarai sookaa man saadhaarai ||
english: He dispels the pains of countless incarnations, and lends support to the dry and shrivelled mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: darasan bhetat hot nihaalaa har kaa naam beechaarai ||1||
english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, one is enraptured, contemplating the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਬੈਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa baid guroo govi(n)daa ||
english: My physician is the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam aukhadh mukh devai kaatai jam kee pha(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He places the medicine of the Naam into my mouth, and cuts away the noose of Death. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: samarath purakh pooran bidhaate aape karanaihaaraa ||
english: He is the all-powerful, Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੬॥੩੪॥
transliteration: apunaa daas har aap ubaariaa naanak naam adhaaraa ||2||6||34||
english: The Lord Himself saves His slave; Nanak takes the Support of the Naam. ||2||6||34||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪਾਹਿ ਨਿਬੇਰੋ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kee gat tum hee jaanee tujh hee paahi nibero ||
english: Only You know the state of my innermost self; You alone can judge me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਲਾਖ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਫੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bakhas laihu saahib prabh apane laakh khate kar phero ||1||
english: Please forgive me, O Lord God Master; I have committed thousands of sins and mistakes. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨੇਰੋ ॥
transliteration: prabh jee too mero thaakur nero ||
english: O my Dear Lord God Master, You are always near me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਮੋਹਿ ਚੇਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har charan saran mohi chero ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Lord, please bless Your disciple with the shelter of Your feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਊਚੋ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰੋ ॥
transliteration: besumaar bea(n)t suaamee oocho gunee gahero ||
english: Infinite and endless is my Lord and Master; He is lofty, virtuous and profoundly deep.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਕੀਨੋ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਾ ਨਿਹੋਰੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੫॥
transliteration: kaat silak keeno apuno daasaro tau naanak kahaa nihoro ||2||7||35||
english: Cutting away the noose of death, the Lord has made Nanak His slave, and now, what does he owe to anyone else? ||2||7||35||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mah 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhae kripaal guroo govi(n)daa sagal manorath paae ||
english: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, became merciful to me, and I obtained all of my mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਭਏ ਲਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: asathir bhae laag har charanee govi(n)d ke gun gaae ||1||
english: I have become stable and steady, touching the Lord's Feet, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਲੋ ਸਮੂਰਤੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhalo samoorat pooraa ||
english: It is a good time, a perfectly auspicious time.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)t sahaj aana(n)d naam jap vaaje anahad tooraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am in celestial peace, tranquility and ecstasy, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unstruck melody of the sound current vibrates and resounds. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mile suaamee preetam apune ghar ma(n)dar sukhadaaee ||
english: Meeting with my Beloved Lord and Master, my home has become a mansion filled with happiness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥੨॥੮॥੩੬॥
transliteration: har naam nidhaan naanak jan paaiaa sagalee ichh pujaaee ||2||8||36||
english: Servant Nanak has attained the treasure of the Lord's Name; all his desires have been fulfilled. ||2||8||36||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਬਸੇ ਰਿਦ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੁਭ ਲਖਣ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan base rid bheetar subh lakhan prabh keene ||
english: The Guru's feet abide within my heart; God has blessed me with good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਨੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhae kripaal pooran paramesar naam nidhaan man cheene ||1||
english: The Perfect Transcendent Lord became merciful to me, and I found the treasure of the Naam within my mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਰੋ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: mero gur rakhavaaro meet ||
english: My Guru is my Saving Grace, my only best friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਣ ਚਊਣੀ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੋਭਾ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: doon chaoonee de vadiaaee sobhaa neetaa neet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Over and over again, He blesses me with double, even four-fold, greatness. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t prabh sagal udhaare darasan dekhanahaare ||
english: God saves all beings and creatures, giving them the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੩੭॥
transliteration: gur poore kee acharaj vadiaaee naanak sad balihaare ||2||9||37||
english: Wondrous is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||37||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਚਨਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਤੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)chan karau naam dhan niramal thaatee agam apaar ||
english: I gather in and collect the immaculate wealth of the Naam; this commodity is inaccessible and incomparable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਛਿ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਆਨੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣਹੁ ਖਾਇ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਸਿਖ ਪਰਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bilachh binod aana(n)d sukh maanahu khaai jeevahu sikh paravaar ||1||
