english: Revel in it, delight in it, be happy and enjoy peace, and live long, O Sikhs and brethren. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: har ke charan kamal aadhaar ||
english: I have the support of the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਚ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad paaio sach bohith chaR la(n)ghau bikh sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, I have found the boat of Truth; embarking on it, I sail across the ocean of poison. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਆਪਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bhae kripaal pooran abinaasee aapahi keenee saar ||
english: The perfect, imperishable Lord has become merciful; He Himself has taken care of me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾਨੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੩੮॥
transliteration: pekh pekh naanak bigasaano naanak naahee sumaar ||2||10||38||
english: Beholding, beholding His Vision, Nanak has blossomed forth in ecstasy. O Nanak, He is beyond estimation. ||2||10||38||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਉਪਜੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai apanee kal dhaaree sabh ghat upajee daiaa ||
english: The Perfect Guru has revealed His power, and compassion has welled up in every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਕੀਨੀ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਸਭ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape mel vadaaee keenee kusal khem sabh bhaiaa ||1||
english: Blending me with Himself, He has blessed me with glorious greatness, and I have found pleasure and happiness. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur pooraa merai naal ||
english: The Perfect True Guru is always with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham jap sadaa nihaal || rahaau ||
english: Meditating on the Supreme Lord God, I am forever in ecstasy. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar thaan thana(n)tar jat kat pekhau soee ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, in all places and interspaces, wherever I look, He is there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੯॥
transliteration: naanak gur paaio vadabhaagee tis jevad avar na koee ||2||11||39||
english: Nanak has found the Guru, by great good fortune; no one else is as great as He. ||2||11||39||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sookh ma(n)gal kaliaan sahaj dhun prabh ke charan nihaariaa ||
english: I have been blessed with peace, pleasure, bliss, and the celestial sound current, gazing upon the feet of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤਾਪੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raakhanahaarai raakhio baarik satigur taap utaariaa ||1||
english: The Savior has saved His child, and the True Guru has cured his fever. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਬਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ubare satigur kee saranaaee ||
english: I have been saved, in the True Guru's Sanctuary;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee sev na birathee jaaee || rahaau ||
english: service to Him does not go in vain. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ghar mahi sookh baahar phun sookhaa prabh apune bhae daiaalaa ||
english: There is peace within the home of one's heart, and there is peace outside as well, when God becomes kind and compassionate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਊ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੪੦॥
transliteration: naanak bighan na laagai kooo meraa prabh hoaa kirapaalaa ||2||12||40||
english: O Nanak, no obstacles block my way; my God has become gracious and merciful to me. ||2||12||40||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g bhaiaa man udam naam ratan jas gaaee ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my mind became excited, and I sang the Praises of the jewel of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mit gaee chi(n)taa simar ana(n)taa saagar tariaa bhaaee ||1||
english: My anxiety was dispelled, meditating in remembrance on the Infinite Lord; I have crossed over the world ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hiradai har ke charan vasaaee ||
english: I enshrine the Lord's Feet within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਣਿ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukh paaiaa sahaj dhun upajee rogaa ghaan mitaaee || rahaau ||
english: I have found peace, and the celestial sound current resounds within me; countless diseases have been eradicated. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa gun tere aakh vakhaanaa keemat kahan na jaaee ||
english: Which of Your Glorious Virtues can I speak and describe? Your worth cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਭਏ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੪੧॥
transliteration: naanak bhagat bhae abinaasee apunaa prabh bhaiaa sahaaee ||2||13||41||
english: O Nanak, the Lord's devotees become imperishable and immortal; their God becomes their friend and support. ||2||13||41||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mah 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਏ ਕਲੇਸ ਰੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gae kales rog sabh naase prabh apunai kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: My sufferings have come to an end, and all diseases have been eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aath pahar aaraadhahu suaamee pooran ghaal hamaaree ||1||
english: God has showered me with His Grace. Twenty-four hours a day, I worship and adore my Lord and Master; my efforts have come to fruition. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu too sukh sa(n)pat raas ||
english: O Dear Lord, You are my peace, wealth and capital.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raakh laihu bhaaee mere kau prabh aagai aradaas || rahaau ||
english: Please, save me, O my Beloved! I offer this prayer to my God. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਉ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਉ ਅਪਨੇ ਖਸਮ ਭਰੋਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jo maagau soee soee paavau apane khasam bharosaa ||
english: Whatever I ask for, I receive; I have total faith in my Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੪੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur pooraa bhetio mitio sagal a(n)desaa ||2||14||42||
english: Says Nanak, I have met with the Perfect Guru, and all my fears have been dispelled. ||2||14||42||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: simar simar gur satigur apanaa sagalaa dookh mitaaiaa ||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Guru, the True Guru, all pains have been eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਪ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taap rog gae gur bachanee man ichhe phal paaiaa ||1||
english: The fever and the disease are gone, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, and I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa gur pooraa sukhadaataa ||
english: My Perfect Guru is the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath suaamee pooran purakh bidhaataa || rahaau ||
english: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Almighty Lord and Master, the Perfect Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨੰਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ana(n)d binod ma(n)gal gun gaavahu gur naanak bhae daiaalaa ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord in bliss, joy and ecstasy; Guru Nanak has become kind and compassionate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰ ਭਏ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੪੩॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar bhae jag bheetar hoaa paarabraham rakhavaalaa ||2||15||43||
english: Shouts of cheers and congratulations ring out all over the world; the Supreme Lord God has become my Savior and Protector. ||2||15||43||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੀ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਗਣੀਆ ਕਾਈ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: hamaree ganat na ganeeaa kaaee apanaa birad pachhaan ||
english: He did not take my accounts into account; such is His forgiving nature.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haath dei raakhe kar apune sadaa sadaa ra(n)g maan ||1||
english: He gave me His hand, and saved me and made me His own; forever and ever, I enjoy His Love. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਣ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahib sad miharavaan ||
english: The True Lord and Master is forever merciful and forgiving.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹੋਈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dh paaiaa merai satigur poorai hoee sarab kaliaan || rahaau ||
english: My Perfect Guru has bound me to Him, and now, I am in absolute ecstasy. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jeeu paai pi(n)d jin saajiaa ditaa painan khaan ||
english: The One who fashioned the body and placed the soul within, who gives you clothing and nourishment

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੪੪॥
transliteration: apane daas kee aap paij raakhee naanak sad kurabaan ||2||16||44||
english: - He Himself preserves the honor of His slaves. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||16||44||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: durat gavaaiaa har prabh aape sabh sa(n)saar ubaariaa ||
english: The Lord God Himself has rid the whole world of its sins, and saved it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh kirapaa dhaaree apanaa birad samaariaa ||1||
english: The Supreme Lord God extended His mercy, and confirmed His innate nature. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਈ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਰਖਵਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: hoee raaje raam kee rakhavaalee ||
english: I have attained the Protective Sanctuary of the Lord, my King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aanad gun gaavahu man tan deh sukhaalee || rahaau ||
english: In celestial peace and ecstasy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and my mind, body and being are at peace. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: patit udhaaran satigur meraa mohi tis kaa bharavaasaa ||
english: My True Guru is the Savior of sinners; I have placed my trust and faith in Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸਭਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਾ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੪੫॥
transliteration: bakhas lae sabh sachai saahib sun naanak kee aradaasaa ||2||17||45||
english: The True Lord has heard Nanak's prayer, and He has forgiven everything. ||2||17||45||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਖਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bakhasiaa paarabraham paramesar sagale rog bidaare ||
english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, has forgiven me, and all diseases have been cured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur poore kee saranee ubare kaaraj sagal savaare ||1||
english: Those who come to the Sanctuary of the True Guru are saved, and all their affairs are resolved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har jan simariaa naam adhaar ||
english: The Lord's humble servant meditates in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is his only support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਪੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taap utaariaa satigur poorai apanee kirapaa dhaar || rahaau ||
english: The Perfect True Guru extended His Mercy, and the fever has been dispelled. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰਹ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d karah mere piaare har govid gur raakhiaa ||
english: So celebrate and be happy, my beloveds - the Guru has saved Hargobind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੪੬॥
transliteration: vadee vadiaaee naanak karate kee saach sabad sat bhaakhiaa ||2||18||46||
english: Great is the glorious greatness of the Creator, O Nanak; True is the Word of His Shabad, and True is the sermon of His Teachings. ||2||18||46||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhae kripaal suaamee mere tit saachai darabaar ||
english: My Lord and Master has become Merciful, in His True Court.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤਾਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਠਾਂਢਿ ਪਈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur taap gavaaiaa bhaaee thaa(n)dh paee sa(n)saar ||
english: The True Guru has taken away the fever, and the whole world is at peace, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਮਹਿ ਕੀਓ ਹਟਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apane jee ja(n)t aape raakhe jamahi keeo hatataar ||1||
english: The Lord Himself protects His beings and creatures, and the Messenger of Death is out of work. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har ke charan ridai ur dhaar ||
english: Enshrine the Lord's feet within your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਦੁਖ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa prabh simareeai bhaaee dukh kilabikh kaatanahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on God, O Siblings of Destiny. He is the Eradicator of suffering and sins. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਊਬਰੈ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis kee saranee oobarai bhaaee jin rachiaa sabh koi ||
english: He fashioned all beings, O Siblings of Destiny, and His Sanctuary saves them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੋ ਭਾਈ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath so bhaaee sachai sachee soi ||
english: He is the Almighty Creator, the Cause of causes, O Siblings of Destiny; He, the True Lord, is True.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੪੭॥
transliteration: naanak prabhoo dhiaaeeai bhaaee man tan seetal hoi ||2||19||47||
english: Nanak: meditate on God, O Siblings of Destiny, and your mind and body shall be cool and calm. ||2||19||47||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu har har naam dhiaaee ||
english: O Saints, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar prabh visarau naahee man chi(n)diaRaa phal paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Never forget God, the ocean of peace; thus you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਾਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur poorai taap gavaaiaa apanee kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: Extending His Mercy, the Perfect True Guru has dispelled the fever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਭ ਪਰਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh bhae daiaalaa dukh mitiaa sabh paravaaree ||1||
english: The Supreme Lord God has become kind and compassionate, and my whole family is now free of pain and suffering. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਰੂਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan ma(n)gal ras roopaa har kaa naam adhaaro ||
english: The Treasure of absolute joy, sublime elixir and beauty, the Name of the Lord is my only Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੪੮॥
transliteration: naanak pat raakhee paramesar udhariaa sabh sa(n)saaro ||2||20||48||
english: O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord has preserved my honor, and saved the whole world. ||2||20||48||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
transliteration: meraa satigur rakhavaalaa hoaa ||
english: My True Guru is my Savior and Protector.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhaar kripaa prabh haath de raakhiaa har govid navaa niroaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Showering us with His Mercy and Grace, God extended His Hand, and saved Hargobind, who is now safe and secure. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: taap gaiaa prabh aap mitaaiaa jan kee laaj rakhaaee ||
english: The fever is gone - God Himself eradicated it, and preserved the honor of His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat te sabh phal paae satigur kai bal jaa(n)ee ||1||
english: I have obtained all blessings from the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੋਵੈ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਹਮਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗੁਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: halat palat prabh dovai savaare hamaraa gun avagun na beechaariaa ||
english: God has saved me, both here and hereafter. He has not taken my merits and demerits into account.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਟਲ ਬਚਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਫਲ ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੪੯॥
transliteration: atal bachan naanak gur teraa saphal kar masatak dhaariaa ||2||21||49||
english: Your Word is eternal, O Guru Nanak; You placed Your Hand of blessing upon my forehead. ||2||21||49||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)tr sabh tis ke keee soee sa(n)t sahaaee ||
english: All beings and creatures were created by Him; He alone is the support and friend of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apune sevak kee aape raakhai pooran bhaee badaaee ||1||
english: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; their glorious greatness becomes perfect. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham pooraa merai naal ||
english: The Perfect Supreme Lord God is always with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਖੀ ਹੋਏ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai pooree sabh raakhee hoe sarab daiaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has perfectly and totally protected me, and now everyone is kind and compassionate to me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: anadin naanak naam dhiaae jee praan kaa daataa ||
english: Night and day, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He is the Giver of the soul, and the breath of life itself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੨॥੨੨॥੫੦॥
transliteration: apune daas kau ka(n)th laai raakhai jiu baarik pit maataa ||2||22||50||
english: He hugs His slave close in His loving embrace, like the mother and father hug their child. ||2||22||50||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ghar 3 chaupade ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mil pa(n)chahu nahee sahasaa chukaaiaa ||
english: Meeting with the council, my doubts were not dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਕਦਾਰਹੁ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sikadaarahu nah pateeaaiaa ||
english: The chiefs did not give me satisfaction.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਮਰਾਵਹੁ ਆਗੈ ਝੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: umaraavahu aagai jheraa ||
english: I presented my dispute to the noblemen as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਰਾਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mil raajan raam niberaa ||1||
english: But it was only settled by meeting with the King, my Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਢੂਢਨ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ab dhoodhan katahu na jaaee ||
english: Now, I do not go searching anywhere else,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gobid bhete gur gosaaee || rahaau ||
english: because I have met the Guru, the Lord of the Universe. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aaiaa prabh darabaaraa ||
english: When I came to God's Darbaar, His Holy Court,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਸਗਲੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: taa sagalee mitee pookaaraa ||
english: then all of my cries and complaints were settled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਬਧਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: labadh aapanee paaee ||
english: Now that I have attained what I had sought,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਤ ਆਵੈ ਕਤ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa kat aavai kat jaaee ||2||
english: where should I come and where should I go? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਸਾਚ ਨਿਆਇ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tah saach niaai niberaa ||
english: There, true justice is administered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਹਾ ਸਮ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਮ ਚੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: oohaa sam thaakur sam cheraa ||
english: There, the Lord Master and His disciple are one and the same.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee jaanai ||
english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੋਲਤ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin bolat aap pachhaanai ||3||
english: Without our speaking, He understands. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab thaan ko raajaa ||
english: He is the King of all places.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਅਗਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: tah anahad sabad agaajaa ||
english: There, the unstruck melody of the Shabad resounds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tis pahi kiaa chaturaaee ||
english: Of what use is cleverness when dealing with Him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੫੧॥
transliteration: mil naanak aap gavaaee ||4||1||51||
english: Meeting with Him, O Nanak, one loses his self-conceit. ||4||1||51||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: hiradai naam vasaaihu ||
english: Enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: ghar baithe guroo dhiaaihu ||
english: sitting within your own home, meditate on the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai sach kahiaa ||
english: The Perfect Guru has spoken the Truth;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so sukh saachaa lahiaa ||1||
english: the True Peace is obtained only from the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਹੋਇਓ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: apunaa hoio gur miharavaanaa ||
english: My Guru has become merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anad sookh kaliaan ma(n)gal siu ghar aae kar isanaanaa || rahaau ||
english: In bliss, peace, pleasure and joy, I have returned to my own home, after my purifying bath. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਗੁਰ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: saachee gur vadiaaee ||
english: True is the glorious greatness of the Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: taa kee keemat kahan na jaaee ||
english: His worth cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: sir saahaa paatisaahaa ||
english: He is the Supreme Overlord of kings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur bhetat man omaahaa ||2||
english: Meeting with the Guru, the mind is enraptured. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: sagal paraachhat laathe ||
english: All sins are washed away,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)gat kai saathe ||
english: meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan har naamaa ||
english: The Lord's Name is the treasure of excellence;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jap pooran hoe kaamaa ||3||
english: chanting it, one's affairs are perfectly resolved. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur keeno mukat duaaraa ||
english: The Guru has opened the door of liberation,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੈ ਜੈਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh srisat karai jaikaaraa ||
english: and the entire world applauds Him with cheers of victory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: naanak prabh merai saathe ||
english: O Nanak, God is always with me;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੨॥
transliteration: janam maran bhai laathe ||4||2||52||
english: my fears of birth and death are gone. ||4||2||52||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: The Perfect Guru has granted His Grace,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਲੋਚ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh pooree loch hamaaree ||
english: and God has fulfilled my desire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: kar isanaan grihi aae ||
english: After taking my bath of purification, I returned to my home,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anad ma(n)gal sukh paae ||1||
english: and I found bliss, happiness and peace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu raam naam nisatareeai ||
english: O Saints, salvation comes from the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat har har dhiaaeeai anadin sukrit kareeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: While standing up and sitting down, meditate on the Lord's Name. Night and day, do good deeds. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਕੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa maarag dharam kee pauRee ko vadabhaagee paae ||
english: The way of the Saints is the ladder of righteous living, found only by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kot janam ke kilabikh naase har charanee chit laae ||2||
english: The sins of millions of incarnations are washed away, by focusing your consciousness on the Lord's feet. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: usatat karahu sadaa prabh apane jin pooree kal raakhee ||
english: So sing the Praises of your God forever; His almighty power is perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh bhae pavitraa satigur kee sach saakhee ||3||
english: All beings and creatures are purified, listening to the True Teachings of the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਘਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bighan binaasan sabh dukh naasan satigur naam driRaaiaa ||
english: The True Guru has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; it is the Eliminator of obstructions, the Destroyer of all pains.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਏ ਪਾਪ ਭਏ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਵਨ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੩॥
transliteration: khoe paap bhae sabh paavan jan naanak sukh ghar aaiaa ||4||3||53||
english: All of my sins were erased, and I have been purified; servant Nanak has returned to his home of peace. ||4||3||53||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saahib gunee gaheraa ||
english: O Lord Master, You are the ocean of excellence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਲਸਕਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ghar lasakar sabh teraa ||
english: My home and all my possessions are Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: rakhavaale gur gopaalaa ||
english: The Guru, the Lord of the world, is my Savior.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh jee bhae daiaalaa ||1||
english: All beings have become kind and compassionate to me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਅਨਦਿ ਰਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jap anad rahau gur charanaa ||
english: Meditating on the Guru's feet, I am in bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਕਤਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhau katahi nahee prabh saranaa || rahaau ||
english: There is no fear at all, in God's Sanctuary. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਿਆ ਦਾਸਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: teriaa daasaa ridai muraaree ||
english: You dwell in the hearts of Your slaves, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਉਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh abichal neev usaaree ||
english: God has laid the eternal foundation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਤਕੀਆ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bal dhan takeeaa teraa ||
english: You are my strength, wealth and support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਭਾਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too bhaaro thaakur meraa ||2||
english: You are my Almighty Lord and Master. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin jin saadhasa(n)g paaiaa ||
english: Whoever finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: so prabh aap taraaiaa ||
english: is saved by God Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa naam ras deeaa ||
english: By His Grace, He has blessed me with the sublime essence of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਸਭ ਥੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kusal khem sabh theeaa ||3||
english: All joy and pleasure then came to me. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hoe prabhoo sahaaee ||
english: God became my helper and my best friend;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਉਠਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh uth laagee paaee ||
english: everyone rises up and bows down at my feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: saas saas prabh dhiaaeeai ||
english: With each and every breath, meditate on God;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੪॥੫੪॥
transliteration: har ma(n)gal naanak gaaeeai ||4||4||54||
english: O Nanak, sing the songs of joy to the Lord. ||4||4||54||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)daa ||
english: Celestial peace and bliss have come,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh milio man bhaava(n)daa ||
english: meeting God, who is so pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: poorai gur kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: The Perfect Guru showered me with His Mercy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa gat bhaee hamaaree ||1||
english: and I attained salvation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har kee prem bhagat man leenaa ||
english: My mind is absorbed in loving devotional worship of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਤ ਬੀਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nit baaje anahat beenaa || rahaau ||
english: and the unstruck melody of the celestial sound current ever resounds within me. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har charan kee ot sataanee ||
english: The Lord's feet are my all-powerful shelter and support;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਲੋਕਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh chookee kaan lokaanee ||
english: my dependence on other people is totally finished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan daataa paaiaa ||
english: I have found the Life of the world, the Great Giver;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har rasak rasak gun gaaiaa ||2||
english: in joyful rapture, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh kaatiaa jam kaa phaasaa ||
english: God has cut away the noose of death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: man pooran hoee aasaa ||
english: My mind's desires have been fulfilled;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਪੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jah pekhaa tah soee ||
english: wherever I look, He is there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har prabh bin avar na koee ||3||
english: Without the Lord God, there is no other at all. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh raakhe ||
english: In His Mercy, God has protected and preserved me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh janam janam dukh laathe ||
english: I am rid of all the pains of countless incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: I have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਟਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੫੫॥
transliteration: atal sukh naanak paaiaa ||4||5||55||
english: O Nanak, I have found eternal peace. ||4||5||55||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: thaadh paaee karataare ||
english: The Creator has brought utter peace to my home;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: taap chhod gaiaa paravaare ||
english: the fever has left my family.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹੈ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai hai raakhee ||
english: The Perfect Guru has saved us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਤਾਕੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saran sache kee taakee ||1||
english: I sought the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: paramesar aap hoaa rakhavaalaa ||
english: The Transcendent Lord Himself has become my Protector.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)t sahaj sukh khin mahi upaje man hoaa sadaa sukhaalaa || rahaau ||
english: Tranquility, intuitive peace and poise welled up in an instant, and my mind was comforted forever. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਦਾਰੂ ॥
transliteration: har har naam deeo daaroo ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, gave me the medicine of His Name,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਦਾਰੂ ॥
transliteration: tin sagalaa rog bidaaroo ||
english: which has cured all disease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: apanee kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: He extended His Mercy to me,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਬਾਤ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin sagalee baat savaaree ||2||
english: and resolved all these affairs. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh apanaa birad samaariaa ||
english: God confirmed His loving nature;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗੁਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hamaraa gun avagun na beechaariaa ||
english: He did not take my merits or demerits into account.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad bhaio saakhee ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has become manifest,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਾਖੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tin sagalee laaj raakhee ||3||
english: and through it, my honor was totally preserved. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਾਇਆ ਬੋਲੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bolaaiaa bolee teraa ||
english: I speak as You cause me to speak;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too saahib gunee gaheraa ||
english: O Lord and Master, You are the ocean of excellence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: jap naanak naam sach saakhee ||
english: Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, according to the Teachings of Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੫੬॥
transliteration: apune daas kee paij raakhee ||4||6||56||
english: God preserves the honor of His slaves. ||4||6||56||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਖਲੋਆ ॥
transliteration: vich karataa purakh khaloaa ||
english: The Creator Lord Himself stood between us,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਲੁ ਨ ਵਿੰਗਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
transliteration: vaal na vi(n)gaa hoaa ||
english: and not a hair upon my head was touched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਜਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਂਦਾ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: majan gur aa(n)daa raase ||
english: The Guru made my cleansing bath successful;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jap har har kilavikh naase ||1||
english: meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, my sins were erased. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਨੀਕਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu raamadaas sarovar neekaa ||
english: O Saints, the purifying pool of Ram Das is sublime.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕੁਲੁ ਤਰਾਵੈ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਹੈ ਜੀ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo naavai so kul taraavai udhaar hoaa hai jee kaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whoever bathes in it, his family and ancestry are saved, and his soul is saved as well. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar jag gaavai ||
english: The world sings cheers of victory,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: man chi(n)diaRe phal paavai ||
english: and the fruits of his mind's desires are obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਾਇ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: sahee salaamat naai aae ||
english: Whoever comes and bathes here,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: apanaa prabhoo dhiaae ||2||
english: And meditates on his God, is safe and sound. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sarovar naavai ||
english: One who bathes in the healing pool of the Saints,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so jan param gat paavai ||
english: that humble being obtains the supreme status.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: marai na aavai jaaee ||
english: He does not die, or come and go in reincarnation;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har naam dhiaaee ||3||
english: he meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ਸੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu braham bichaar s jaanai ||
english: He alone knows this about God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਭਗਵਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jis daiaal hoi bhagavaanai ||
english: whom God blesses with His kindness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: baabaa naanak prabh saranaaee ||
english: Baba Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਣਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੭॥
transliteration: sabh chi(n)taa ganat mitaaee ||4||7||57||
english: all his worries and anxieties are dispelled. ||4||7||57||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham nibaahee pooree ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has stood by me and fulfilled me,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਈ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਰਹੀਆ ਊਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaaee baat na raheeaa ooree ||
english: and nothing is left unfinished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur charan laai nisataare ||
english: Attached to the Guru's feet, I am saved;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har naam samhaare ||1||
english: I contemplate and cherish the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: apane daas kaa sadaa rakhavaalaa ||
english: He is forever the Savior of His slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apune kar raakhe maat pitaa jiu paalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Bestowing His Mercy, He made me His own and preserved me; like a mother or father, He cherishes me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee satigur paaiaa ||
english: By great good fortune, I found the True Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin jam kaa pa(n)th mitaaiaa ||
english: who obliterated the path of the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: har bhagat bhaai chit laagaa ||
english: My consciousness is focused on loving, devotional worship of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jap jeevahi se vadabhaagaa ||2||
english: One who lives in this meditation is very fortunate indeed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)mrit baanee gaavai ||
english: He sings the Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੀ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhaa kee dhooree naavai ||
english: and bathes in the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: apunaa naam aape deeaa ||
english: He Himself bestows His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: prabh karanahaar rakh leeaa ||3||
english: God, the Creator, saves us. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har darasan praan adhaaraa ||
english: The Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is the support of the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਮਲ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ihu pooran bimal beechaaraa ||
english: This is the perfect, pure wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, has granted His Mercy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੪॥੮॥੫੮॥
transliteration: daas naanak saran suaamee ||4||8||58||
english: slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master. ||4||8||58||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai charanee laaiaa ||
english: The Perfect Guru has attached me to His feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)g sahaaee paaiaa ||
english: I have obtained the Lord as my companion, my support, my best friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਹਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jah jaaeeai tahaa suhele ||
english: Wherever I go, I am happy there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh mele ||1||
english: By His Kind Mercy, God united me with Himself. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavahu sadaa subhaaee ||
english: So sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord with loving devotion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man chi(n)de sagale phal paavahu jee kai sa(n)g sahaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall obtain all the fruits of your mind's desires, and the Lord shall become the companion and the support of your soul. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naaraain praan adhaaraa ||
english: The Lord is the support of the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਰੇਨਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ham sa(n)t janaa(n) renaaraa ||
english: I am the dust of the feet of the Holy people.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: patit puneet kar leene ||
english: I am a sinner, but the Lord made me pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa har jas deene ||2||
english: By His Kind Mercy, the Lord blessed me with His Praises. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham kare pratipaalaa ||
english: The Supreme Lord God cherishes and nurtures me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਜੀਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sad jee sa(n)g rakhavaalaa ||
english: He is always with me, the Protector of my soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: har din rain keeratan gaaeeai ||
english: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises day and night,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bahuR na jonee paaeeai ||3||
english: I shall not be consigned to reincarnation again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jis devai purakh bidhaataa ||
english: One who is blessed by the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har ras tin hee jaataa ||
english: realizes the subtle essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jamaka(n)kar neR na aaiaa ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not come near him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੯॥੫੯॥
transliteration: sukh naanak saranee paaiaa ||4||9||59||
english: In the Lord's Sanctuary, Nanak has found peace. ||4||9||59||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕੀਤੀ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai keetee pooree ||
english: The Perfect Guru has made me perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh rav rahiaa bharapooree ||
english: God is totally pervading and permeating everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਮ ਕੁਸਲ ਭਇਆ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: khem kusal bhaiaa isanaanaa ||
english: With joy and pleasure, I take my purifying bath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paarabraham vitahu kurabaanaa ||1||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ ਰਿਦ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan kaval rid dhaare ||
english: I enshrine the lotus feet of the Guru within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bighan na laagai til kaa koee kaaraj sagal savaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Not even the tiniest obstacle blocks my way; all my affairs are resolved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਏ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhoo duramat khoe ||
english: Meeting with the Holy Saints, my evil-mindedness was eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਭ ਹੋਏ ॥
transliteration: patit puneet sabh hoe ||
english: All the sinners are purified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਦਾਸਿ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਨਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: raamadaas sarovar naate ||
english: Bathing in the sacred pool of Guru Ram Das,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਲਾਥੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh laathe paap kamaate ||2||
english: all the sins one has committed are washed away. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gun gobi(n)d nit gaaeeai ||
english: So sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mil dhiaaeeai ||
english: joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: man baa(n)chhat phal paae ||
english: The fruits of your mind's desires are obtained

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur pooraa ridai dhiaae ||3||
english: by meditating on the Perfect Guru within your heart. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਆਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: gur gopaal aana(n)daa ||
english: The Guru, the Lord of the World, is blissful;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: jap jap jeevai paramaana(n)daa ||
english: chanting, meditating on the Lord of supreme bliss, He lives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੬੦॥
transliteration: prabh apanaa birad rakhaaiaa ||4||10||60||
english: God has confirmed His innate nature. ||4||10||60||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਮੇਘ ਘਟਾ ਘਟ ਦਾਮਨਿ ਚਮਕਿ ਡਰਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: dah dis chhatr megh ghataa ghat daaman chamak daraaio ||
english: In the ten directions, the clouds cover the sky like a canopy; through the dark clouds, lightning flashes, and I am terrified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਇਕੇਲੀ ਨੀਦ ਨਹੁ ਨੈਨਹ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sej ikelee need nahu nainah pir parades sidhaaio ||1||
english: By bed is empty, and my eyes are sleepless; my Husband Lord has gone far away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਣਿ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਦੇਸਰੋ ਮਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: hun nahee sa(n)desaro maaio ||
english: Now, I receive no messages from Him, O mother!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਕੋਸਰੋ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਰਤ ਲਾਲੁ ਤਬ ਚਤੁਰ ਪਾਤਰੋ ਆਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ek kosaro sidh karat laal tab chatur paataro aaio || rahaau ||
english: When my Beloved used to go even a mile away, He would send me four letters. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਇਹੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kiu bisarai ihu laal piaaro sarab gunaa sukhadaaio ||
english: How could I forget this Dear Beloved of mine? He is the Giver of peace, and all virtues.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਚਰਿ ਕੈ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ਨੈਨ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਆਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ma(n)dar char kai pa(n)th nihaarau nain neer bhar aaio ||2||
english: Ascending to His Mansion, I gaze upon His path, and my eyes are filled with tears. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਭੀਤਿ ਭਇਓ ਹੈ ਬੀਚੋ ਸੁਨਤ ਦੇਸਿ ਨਿਕਟਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: hau hau bheet bhaio hai beecho sunat des nikataaio ||
english: The wall of egotism and pride separates us, but I can hear Him nearby.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਭੀਰੀ ਕੇ ਪਾਤ ਪਰਦੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੇਖੇ ਦੂਰਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhaa(n)bheeree ke paat parado bin pekhe dooraaio ||3||
english: There is a veil between us, like the wings of a butterfly; without being able to see Him, He seems so far away. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਗਰੋ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: bhaio kirapaal sarab ko thaakur sagaro dookh mitaaio ||
english: The Lord and Master of all has become merciful; He has dispelled all my sufferings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਭੀਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਤਉ ਦਇਆਰੁ ਬੀਠਲੋ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak haumai bheet gur khoee tau daiaar beethalo paaio ||4||
english: Says Nanak, when the Guru tore down the wall of egotism, then, I found my Merciful Lord and Master. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਅੰਦੇਸਰੋ ਮਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: sabh rahio a(n)desaro maaio ||
english: All my fears have been dispelled, O mother!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: jo chaahat so guroo milaaio ||
english: Whoever I seek, the Guru leads me to find.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਗੁਨਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੧॥੬੧॥
transliteration: sarab gunaa nidh raaio || rahaau doojaa ||11||61||
english: The Lord, our King, is the treasure of all virtue. ||Second Pause||11||61||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਈ ਬਹੋੜੁ ਬੰਦੀ ਛੋੜੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਦੁਖਦਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gaee bahoR ba(n)dee chhoR nira(n)kaar dukhadaaree ||
english: The Restorer of what was taken away, the Liberator from captivity; the Formless Lord, the Destroyer of pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: karam na jaanaa dharam na jaanaa lobhee maaiaadhaaree ||
english: I do not know about karma and good deeds; I do not know about Dharma and righteous living. I am so greedy, chasing after Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਭਗਤੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਇਹ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam pario bhagat govi(n)d kaa ih raakhahu paij tumaaree ||1||
english: I go by the name of God's devotee; please, save this honor of Yours. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਤੂ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu nimaaniaa too maan ||
english: O Dear Lord, You are the honor of the dishonored.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਚੀਜਿਆ ਚੀਜ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nicheejiaa cheej kare meraa govi(n)d teree kudarat kau kurabaan || rahaau ||
english: You make the unworthy ones worthy, O my Lord of the Universe; I am a sacrifice to Your almighty creative power. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਲਖ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa baalak bhaai subhaaee lakh aparaadh kamaavai ||
english: Like the child, innocently making thousands of mistakes

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਝਿੜਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kar upades jhiRake bahu bhaatee bahuR pitaa gal laavai ||
english: his father teaches him, and scolds him so many times, but still, he hugs him close in his embrace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਅਉਗੁਣ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pichhale augun bakhas lae prabh aagai maarag paavai ||2||
english: Please forgive my past actions, God, and place me on Your path for the future. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)tarajaamee sabh bidh jaanai taa kis pahi aakh sunaaeeai ||
english: The Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows all about my state of mind; so who else should I go to and speak to?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਣੈ ਕਥਨਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kahanai kathan na bheejai gobi(n)d har bhaavai paij rakhaaeeai ||
english: The Lord, the Lord of the Universe, is not pleased by mere recitation of words; if it is pleasing to His Will, He preserves our honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਦੇਖੀ ਇਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਰਹਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: avar ot mai sagalee dekhee ik teree ot rahaaeeai ||3||
english: I have seen all other shelters, but Yours alone remains for me. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: hoi daiaal kirapaal prabh thaakur aape sunai bena(n)tee ||
english: Becoming kind and compassionate, God the Lord and Master Himself listens to my prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: pooraa satagur mel milaavai sabh chookai man kee chi(n)tee ||
english: He unites me in Union with the Perfect True Guru, and all the cares and anxieties of my mind are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੰਤੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੬੨॥
transliteration: har har naam avakhad mukh paaiaa jan naanak sukh vasa(n)tee ||4||12||62||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, has placed the medicine of the Naam into my mouth; servant Nanak abides in peace. ||4||12||62||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਦੁਖ ਕਲੇਸ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
transliteration: simar simar prabh bhae ana(n)daa dukh kales sabh naathe ||
english: Remembering, remembering God in meditation, bliss ensues, and one is rid of all suffering and pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਧਿਆਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਂਠੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gun gaavat dhiaavat prabh apanaa kaaraj sagale saa(n)the ||1||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of God, and meditating on Him, all my affairs are brought into harmony. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan naam tumaaraa ||
english: Your Name is the Life of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਦੀਓ ਉਪਦੇਸਾ ਜਪਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poore deeo upadesaa jap bhaujal paar utaaraa || rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has taught me, that by meditating, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂਹੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: toohai ma(n)tree sunahi prabh toohai sabh kichh karanaihaaraa ||
english: You are Your own advisor; You hear everything, God, and You do everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too aape daataa aape bhugataa kiaa ihu ja(n)t vichaaraa ||2||
english: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. What can this poor creature do? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa gun tere aakh vakhaanee keemat kahan na jaaee ||
english: Which of Your Glorious Virtues should I describe and speak of? Your value cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pekh pekh jeevai prabh apanaa acharaj tumahi vadaaee ||3||
english: I live by beholding, beholding You, O God. Your glorious greatness is wonderful and amazing! ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਪਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
transliteration: dhaar anugrahu aap prabh svaamee pat mat keenee pooree ||
english: Granting His Grace, God my Lord and Master Himself saved my honor, and my intellect has been made perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਬਾਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਧੂਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੬੩॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa naanak balihaaree baachhau sa(n)taa dhooree ||4||13||63||
english: Forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice, longing for the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||13||63||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mah 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa namasakaare ||
english: I bow in reverence to the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh sabhe kaaj savaare ||
english: God has resolved all my affairs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har apanee kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: The Lord has showered me with His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh pooran paij savaaree ||1||
english: God has perfectly preserved my honor. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਭਇਓ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: apane daas ko bhaio sahaaee ||
english: He has become the help and support of His slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਤੈ ਊਣੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal manorath keene karatai oonee baat na kaaee || rahaau ||
english: The Creator has achieved all my goals, and now, nothing is lacking. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੈ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਤਾਲੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: karatai purakh taal divaaiaa ||
english: The Creator Lord has caused the pool of nectar to be constructed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਛੈ ਲਗਿ ਚਲੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pichhai lag chalee maaiaa ||
english: The wealth of Maya follows in my footsteps,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: tot na katahoo aavai ||
english: and now, nothing is lacking at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mere poore satagur bhaavai ||2||
english: This is pleasing to my Perfect True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: simar simar daiaalaa ||
english: Remembering, remembering the Merciful Lord in meditation,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh jee bhae kirapaalaa ||
english: all beings have become kind and compassionate to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar gusaaee ||
english: Hail! Hail to the Lord of the world,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin pooree banat banaaee ||3||
english: who created the perfect creation. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਭਾਰੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too bhaaro suaamee moraa ||
english: You are my Great Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ihu pu(n)n padaarath teraa ||
english: These blessings and wealth are Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak ek dhiaaiaa ||
english: Servant Nanak has meditated on the One Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਫਲਾ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੬੪॥
transliteration: sarab phalaa pu(n)n paaiaa ||4||14||64||
english: he has obtained the fruitful rewards for all good deeds. ||4||14||64||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ghar 3 dupade ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਨਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: raamadaas sarovar naate ||
english: Bathing in the nectar tank of Ram Das,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh utare paap kamaate ||
english: all sins are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਏ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: niramal hoe kar isanaanaa ||
english: One becomes immaculately pure, taking this cleansing bath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕੀਨੇ ਦਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur poorai keene daanaa ||1||
english: The Perfect Guru has bestowed this gift. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh kusal khem prabh dhaare ||
english: God has blessed all with peace and pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਥੋਕ ਉਬਾਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sahee salaamat sabh thok ubaare gur kaa sabad veechaare || rahaau ||
english: Everything is safe and sound, as we contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਥੀ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mal laathee ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, filth is washed off.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਥੀ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham bhaio saathee ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has become our friend and helper.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧॥੬੫॥
transliteration: aad purakh prabh paaiaa ||2||1||65||
english: He has found God, the Primal Being. ||2||1||65||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jit paarabraham chit aaiaa ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has established that home,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਦਯਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: so ghar day vasaaiaa ||
english: In which He comes to mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar gur paaiaa ||
english: I found the Guru, the ocean of peace,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa sahasaa sagal mitaaiaa ||1||
english: And all my doubts were dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam kee vadiaaee ||
english: This is the glorious greatness of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar gun gaaee ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poore te paaee || rahaau ||
english: I obtained this from the Perfect Guru. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee akath kahaanee ||
english: God's sermon is inexpressible.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jan bolahi a(n)mrit baanee ||
english: His humble servants speak words of Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak daas vakhaanee ||
english: Slave Nanak has spoken.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: gur poore te jaanee ||2||2||66||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, it is known. ||2||2||66||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aagai sukh gur deeaa ||
english: The Guru has blessed me with peace here,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੈ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: paachhai kusal khem gur keeaa ||
english: and the Guru has arranged peace and pleasure for me hereafter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan sukh paaiaa ||
english: I have all treasures and comforts,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur apunaa ridai dhiaaiaa ||1||
english: meditating on the Guru in my heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: apane satigur kee vadiaaee ||
english: This is the glorious greatness of my True Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man ichhe phal paaee ||
english: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu din din chaRai savaaee || rahaau ||
english: O Saints, His Glory increases day by day. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh bhae daiaalaa prabh apane kar deene ||
english: All beings and creatures have become kind and compassionate to me; my God has made them so.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਨੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੬੭॥
transliteration: sahaj subhaai mile gopaalaa naanak saach pateene ||2||3||67||
english: Nanak has met with the Lord of the world with intuitive ease, and with Truth, he is pleased. ||2||3||67||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad rakhavaare ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is my Saving Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਉਕੀ ਚਉਗਿਰਦ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: chaukee chaugirad hamaare ||
english: It is a guardian posted on all four sides around me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam man laagaa ||
english: My mind is attached to the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਲਜਾਇ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jam lajaai kar bhaagaa ||1||
english: The Messenger of Death has run away in shame. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh jee too mero sukhadaataa ||
english: O Dear Lord, You are my Giver of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan kaat kare man niramal pooran purakh bidhaataa || rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny, has shattered my bonds, and made my mind immaculately pure. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak prabh abinaasee ||
english: O Nanak, God is eternal and imperishable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: taa kee sev na birathee jaasee ||
english: Service to Him shall never go unrewarded.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: anad karahi tere daasaa ||
english: Your slaves are in bliss;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੬੮॥
transliteration: jap pooran hoee aasaa ||2||4||68||
english: chanting and meditating, their desires are fulfilled. ||2||4||68||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gur apune balihaaree ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jin pooran paij savaaree ||
english: He has totally preserved my honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man chi(n)diaa phal paaiaa ||
english: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh apunaa sadaa dhiaaiaa ||1||
english: I meditate forever on my God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu tis bin avar na koee ||
english: O Saints, without Him, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran prabh soee || rahaau ||
english: He is God, the Cause of causes. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਵਰ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh apanai var deene ||
english: My God has given me His Blessing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜੀਅ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: sagal jee vas keene ||
english: He has made all creatures subject to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੫॥੬੯॥
transliteration: taa sagale dookh mitaaiaa ||2||5||69||
english: and all his sorrows depart. ||2||5||69||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: taap gavaaiaa gur poore ||
english: The Perfect Guru has dispelled the fever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: vaaje anahad toore ||
english: The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: sarab kaliaan prabh keene ||
english: God has bestowed all comforts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa aap deene ||1||
english: In His Mercy, He Himself has given them. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bedan satigur aap gavaaee ||
english: The True Guru Himself has eradicated the disease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਸੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sikh sa(n)t sabh sarase hoe har har naam dhiaaee || rahaau ||
english: All the Sikhs and Saints are filled with joy, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਸੋ ਲੇਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jo ma(n)gahi so levahi ||
english: They obtain that which they ask for.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਦੇਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh apaniaa sa(n)taa devahi ||
english: God gives to His Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har govid prabh raakhiaa ||
english: God saved Hargobind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥੨॥੬॥੭੦॥
transliteration: jan naanak saach subhaakhiaa ||2||6||70||
english: Servant Nanak speaks the Truth. ||2||6||70||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: soee karaai jo tudh bhaavai ||
english: You make me do what pleases You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mohi siaanap kachhoo na aavai ||
english: I have no cleverness at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ham baarik tau saranaaee ||
english: I am just a child - I seek Your Protection.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh aape paij rakhaaee ||1||
english: God Himself preserves my honor. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: meraa maat pitaa har raaiaa ||
english: The Lord is my King; He is my mother and father.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਣ ਲਾਗਾ ਕਰਂੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa pratipaalan laagaa kara(n)ee teraa karaaiaa || rahaau ||
english: In Your Mercy, You cherish me; I do whatever You make me do. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t tere dhaare ||
english: The beings and creatures are Your creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਡੋਰੀ ਹਾਥਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh doree haath tumaare ||
english: O God, their reins are in Your hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: j karaavai so karanaa ||
english: Whatever You cause us to do, we do.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੨॥੭॥੭੧॥
transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaa ||2||7||71||
english: Nanak, Your slave, seeks Your Protection. ||2||7||71||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har naam ridai paroiaa ||
english: I have woven the Lord's Name into the fabric of my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh kaaj hamaaraa hoiaa ||
english: All my affairs are resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh charanee man laagaa ||
english: His mind is attached to God's feet,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pooran jaa ke bhaagaa ||1||
english: whose destiny is perfect. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)g har dhiaaiaa ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਰਾਧਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar araadhio har har man chi(n)diaa phal paaiaa || rahaau ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har; I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਜਾਗਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paraa poorabalaa a(n)kur jaagiaa ||
english: The seeds of my past actions have sprouted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਿਆ ॥
transliteration: raam naam man laagiaa ||
english: My mind is attached to the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: man tan har daras samaavai ||
english: My mind and body are absorbed into the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੮॥੭੨॥
transliteration: naanak daas sache gun gaavai ||2||8||72||
english: Slave Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||2||8||72||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਚਿਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur mil prabhoo chitaariaa ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, I contemplate God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kaaraj sabh savaariaa ||
english: All of my affairs have been resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਕੋ ਨ ਅਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)daa ko na alaae ||
english: No one speaks ill of me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh jai jai kaar sunaae ||1||
english: Everyone congratulates me on my victory. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu saachee saran suaamee ||
english: O Saints, I seek the True Sanctuary of the Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh haath tisai kai so prabh a(n)tarajaamee || rahaau ||
english: All beings and creatures are in His hands; He is God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਬ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: karatab sabh savaare ||
english: He has resolved all of my affairs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh apunaa birad samaare ||
english: God has confirmed His innate nature.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan prabh naamaa ||
english: God's Name is the Purifier of sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੯॥੭੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak sad kurabaanaa ||2||9||73||
english: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||73||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham saaj savaariaa ||
english: The Supreme Lord God created and embellished him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਲਹੁੜਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ihu lahuRaa guroo ubaariaa ||
english: The Guru has saved this small child.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: anad karahu pit maataa ||
english: So celebrate and be happy, father and mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paramesar jee kaa daataa ||1||
