english: The Transcendent Lord is the Giver of souls. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭ ਚਿਤਵਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: subh chitavan daas tumaare ||
english: Your slaves, O Lord, focus on pure thoughts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਹਿ ਪੈਜ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raakhahi paij daas apune kee kaaraj aap savaare || rahaau ||
english: You preserve the honor of Your slaves, and You Yourself arrange their affairs. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh paraupakaaree ||
english: My God is so benevolent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਕਲ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pooran kal jin dhaaree ||
english: His Almighty Power is manifest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak saranee aaiaa ||
english: Nanak has come to His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੭੪॥
transliteration: man chi(n)diaa phal paaiaa ||2||10||74||
english: He has obtained the fruits of his mind's desires. ||2||10||74||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa har jaape ||
english: Forever and ever, I chant the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਲਕ ਰਾਖੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh baalak raakhe aape ||
english: God Himself has saved my child.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: seetalaa thaak rahaaee ||
english: He healed him from the smallpox.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਘਨ ਗਏ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bighan gae har naaee ||1||
english: My troubles have been removed through the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh hoaa sadaa daiaalaa ||
english: My God is forever Merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਭਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aradaas sunee bhagat apune kee sabh jee bhaiaa kirapaalaa || rahaau ||
english: He heard the prayer of His devotee, and now all beings are kind and compassionate to him. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਾਥਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh karan kaaran samaraathaa ||
english: God is Almighty, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ ॥
transliteration: har simarat sabh dukh laathaa ||
english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, all pains and sorrows vanish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: apane daas kee sunee bena(n)tee ||
english: He has heard the prayer of His slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵੰਤੀ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੭੫॥
transliteration: sabh naanak sukh sava(n)tee ||2||11||75||
english: O Nanak, now everyone sleeps in peace. ||2||11||75||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: apanaa guroo dhiaae ||
english: I meditated on my Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਕੁਸਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: mil kusal setee ghar aae ||
english: I met with Him, and returned home in joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: naamai kee vadiaaee ||
english: This is the glorious greatness of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis keemat kahan na jaaee ||1||
english: Its value cannot be estimated. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu har har har aaraadhahu ||
english: O Saints, worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਸਭੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧਹੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har aaraadh sabho kichh paaeeai kaaraj sagale saadhahu || rahaau ||
english: Worship the Lord in adoration, and you shall obtain everything; your affairs shall all be resolved. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: prem bhagat prabh laagee ||
english: He alone is attached in loving devotion to God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: so paae jis vadabhaagee ||
english: who realizes his great destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੭੬॥
transliteration: tin sarab sukhaa phal paaiaa ||2||12||76||
english: He obtains the rewards of all joys and peace. ||2||12||76||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਬੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: paramesar ditaa ba(n)naa ||
english: The Transcendent Lord has given me His support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਭੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: dukh rog kaa deraa bha(n)naa ||
english: The house of pain and disease has been demolished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: anad karahi nar naaree ||
english: The men and women celebrate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har prabh kirapaa dhaaree ||1||
english: The Lord God, Har, Har, has extended His Mercy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu sukh hoaa sabh thaaee ||
english: O Saints, there is peace everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham pooran paramesar rav rahiaa sabhanee jaaee || rahaau ||
english: The Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Transcendent Lord, is pervading everywhere. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: dhur kee baanee aaee ||
english: The Bani of His Word emanated from the Primal Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tin sagalee chi(n)t mitaaee ||
english: It eradicates all anxiety.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: daiaal purakh miharavaanaa ||
english: The Lord is merciful, kind and compassionate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੭੭॥
transliteration: har naanak saach vakhaanaa ||2||13||77||
english: Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the True Lord. ||2||13||77||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aithai othai rakhavaalaa ||
english: Here and hereafter, He is our Savior.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh satigur deen daiaalaa ||
english: God, the True Guru, is Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
transliteration: daas apane aap raakhe ||
english: He Himself protects His slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਭਾਖੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ghat ghat sabad subhaakhe ||1||
english: In each and every heart, the Beautiful Word of His Shabad resounds. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਊਪਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan oopar bal jaaee ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dinas rain saas saas samaalee pooran sabhanee thaaee || rahaau ||
english: Day and night, with each and every breath, I remember Him; He is totally pervading and permeating all places. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਆ ॥
transliteration: aap sahaaee hoaa ||
english: He Himself has become my help and support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਢੋਆ ॥
transliteration: sache daa sachaa dhoaa ||
english: True is the support of the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: teree bhagat vadiaaee ||
english: Glorious and great is devotional worship to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੭੮॥
transliteration: paaee naanak prabh saranaaee ||2||14||78||
english: Nanak has found God's Sanctuary. ||2||14||78||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur poore bhaanaa ||
english: When it was pleasing to the Perfect True Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: taa japiaa naam ramaanaa ||
english: then I chanted the Naam, the Name of the Pervading Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: The Lord of the Universe extended His Mercy to me,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪੈਜ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh raakhee paij hamaaree ||1||
english: and God saved my honor. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har ke charan sadaa sukhadaaee ||
english: The Lord's feet are forever peace-giving.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo ichhahi soee phal paavahi birathee aas na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever fruit one desires, he receives; his hopes shall not go in vain. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kripaa kare jis praanapat daataa soee sa(n)t gun gaavai ||
english: That Saint, unto whom the Lord of Life, the Great Giver, extends His Mercy - he alone sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਣਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prem bhagat taa kaa man leenaa paarabraham man bhaavai ||2||
english: His soul is absorbed in loving devotional worship; his mind is pleasing to the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਰਵਣਾ ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਲਾਥੀ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar har kaa jas ravanaa bikhai thagauree laathee ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, he chants the Praises of the Lord, and the bitter poison does not affect him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਲੀਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਭਏ ਸਾਥੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)g milaai leeaa merai karatai sa(n)t saadh bhae saathee ||3||
english: My Creator Lord has united me with Himself, and the Holy Saints have become my companions. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਦੀਨੇ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar gahi leene sarabas deene aapahi aap milaaiaa ||
english: Taking me by the hand, He has given me everything, and blended me with Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੭੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sarab thok pooran pooraa satigur paaiaa ||4||15||79||
english: Says Nanak, everything has been perfectly resolved; I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||4||15||79||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰੀਬੀ ਗਦਾ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gareebee gadaa hamaaree ||
english: Humility is my spiked club.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੰਨਾ ਸਗਲ ਰੇਨੁ ਛਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)naa sagal ren chhaaree ||
english: My dagger is to be the dust of all men's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕੋ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: is aagai ko na tikai vekaaree ||
english: No evil-doer can withstand these weapons.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਏਹ ਗਲ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur poore eh gal saaree ||1||
english: The Perfect Guru has given me this understanding. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਓਟਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam sa(n)tan kee otaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the support and shelter of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੋਟਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo simarai tis kee gat hovai udharahi sagale kotaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who remembers the Lord in meditation, is emancipated; millions have been saved in this way. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sa(n)g jas gaaiaa ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, I sing His Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ihu pooran har dhan paaiaa ||
english: I have found this, the perfect wealth of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak aap mitaaiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, I have eradicated my self-conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੮੦॥
transliteration: sabh paarabraham nadaree aaiaa ||2||16||80||
english: I see the Supreme Lord God everywhere. ||2||16||80||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai pooree keenee ||
english: The Perfect Guru has done it perfectly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਖਸ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: bakhas apunee kar deenee ||
english: He blessed me with forgiveness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nit ana(n)d sukh paaiaa ||
english: I have found lasting peace and bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਵ ਸਗਲੇ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: thaav sagale sukhee vasaaiaa ||1||
english: Everywhere, the people dwell in peace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਫਲ ਦਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: har kee bhagat phal daatee ||
english: Devotional worship to the Lord is what gives rewards.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai kirapaa kar deenee viralai kin hee jaatee || rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru, by His Grace, gave it to me; how rare are those who know this. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਹ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gurabaanee gaavah bhaaee ||
english: Sing the Word of the Guru's Bani, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਸਫਲ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: oh saphal sadaa sukhadaaee ||
english: That is always rewarding and peace-giving.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: Nanak has meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: poorab likhiaa paaiaa ||2||17||81||
english: He has realized his pre-ordained destiny. ||2||17||81||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadhe ||
english: I worship and adore the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: kaaraj sagale saadhe ||
english: All my affairs have been resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sagal manorath poore ||
english: All desires have been fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baaje anahad toore ||1||
english: The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu raam japat sukh paaiaa ||
english: O Saints, meditating on the Lord, we obtain peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਅਸਥਾਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t asathaan base sukh sahaje sagale dookh mitaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the home of the Saints, celestial peace is pervading; all pain and suffering is dispelled. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kee baanee ||
english: The Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham man bhaanee ||
english: is pleasing to the Mind of the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak daas vakhaanee ||
english: Slave Nanak speaks

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੮੨॥
transliteration: niramal akath kahaanee ||2||18||82||
english: the Unspoken, immaculate sermon of the Lord. ||2||18||82||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਖੇ ਖਾਵਤ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bhookhe khaavat laaj na aavai ||
english: The hungry man is not ashamed to eat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tiu har jan har gun gaavai ||1||
english: Just so, the humble servant of the Lord sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਾਜ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਅਲਕਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: apane kaaj kau kiu alakaaeeai ||
english: Why are you so lazy in your own affairs?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit simaran daragah mukh oojal sadaa sadaa sukh paaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord; you shall find peace, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਾਮੀ ਕਾਮਿ ਲੁਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu kaamee kaam lubhaavai ||
english: Just as the lustful man is enticed by lust,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tiu har daas har jas bhaavai ||2||
english: so is the Lord's slave pleased with the Lord's Praise. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਲਿ ਲਪਟਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu maataa baal lapataavai ||
english: Just as the mother holds her baby close,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tiu giaanee naam kamaavai ||3||
english: so does the spiritual person cherish the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur poore te paavai ||
english: This is obtained from the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੮੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaavai ||4||19||83||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||19||83||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਂਦਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sukh saa(n)d ghar aaiaa ||
english: Safe and sound, I have returned home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kai mukh chhaaiaa ||
english: The slanderer's face is blackened with ashes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poorai gur pahiraaiaa ||
english: The Perfect Guru has dressed in robes of honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binase dukh sabaaiaa ||1||
english: All my pains and sufferings are over. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu saache kee vadiaaee ||
english: O Saints, this is the glorious greatness of the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਚਰਜ ਸੋਭ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin acharaj sobh banaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He has created such wonder and glory! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: bole saahib kai bhaanai ||
english: I speak according to the Will of my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: daas baanee braham vakhaanai ||
english: God's slave chants the Word of His Bani.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naanak prabh sukhadaaee ||
english: O Nanak, God is the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੮੪॥
transliteration: jin pooree banat banaaee ||2||20||84||
english: He has created the perfect creation. ||2||20||84||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: prabh apunaa ridai dhiaae ||
english: Within my heart, I meditate on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: ghar sahee salaamat aae ||
english: I have returned home safe and sound.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tokh bhaiaa sa(n)saare ||
english: The world has become contented.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੈ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur poorai lai taare ||1||
english: The Perfect Guru has saved me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu prabh meraa sadaa daiaalaa ||
english: O Saints, my God is forever merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਗਣਈ ਰਾਖੈ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: apane bhagat kee ganat na ganaee raakhai baal gupaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord of the world does not call His devotee to account; He protects His children. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har naam ridai ur dhaare ||
english: I have enshrined the Lord's Name within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tin sabhe thok savaare ||
english: He has resolved all my affairs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai tus deeaa ||
english: The Perfect Guru was pleased, and blessed me,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੮੫॥
transliteration: phir naanak dookh na theeaa ||2||21||85||
english: and now, Nanak shall never again suffer pain. ||2||21||85||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har man tan vasiaa soee ||
english: The Lord abides in my mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar kare sabh koee ||
english: Everyone congratulates me on my victory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kee vadiaaee ||
english: This is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa kee keemat kahee na jaaee ||1||
english: His value cannot be described. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਜਾਈ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hau kurabaan jaaee tere naavai ||
english: I am a sacrifice to Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis no bakhas laihi mere piaare so jas teraa gaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He alone, whom You have forgiven, O my Beloved, sings Your Praises. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਭਾਰੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) bhaaro suaamee meraa ||
english: You are my Great Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa(n) bharavaasaa teraa ||
english: You are the support of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaaee ||
english: Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mukh ni(n)dak kai chhaaee ||2||22||86||
english: The faces of the slanderers are blackened with ashes. ||2||22||86||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aagai sukh mere meetaa ||
english: Peace in this world, O my friends,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੇ ਆਨਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: paachhe aanad prabh keetaa ||
english: and bliss in the world hereafter - God has given me this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: paramesur banat banaaee ||
english: The Transcendent Lord has arranged these arrangements;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਡੋਲਤ ਕਤਹੂ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: phir dolat katahoo naahee ||1||
english: I shall never waver again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saache saahib siu man maaniaa ||
english: My mind is pleased with the True Lord Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har sarab nira(n)tar jaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I know the Lord to be pervading all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh jee tere daiaalaa ||
english: All beings are Yours, O Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: apane bhagat karahi pratipaalaa ||
english: You cherish Your devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: acharaj teree vadiaaee ||
english: Your glorious greatness is wonderful and marvellous.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੨॥੨੩॥੮੭॥
transliteration: nit naanak naam dhiaaee ||2||23||87||
english: Nanak ever meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||23||87||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਲਿ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: naal naraain merai ||
english: The Lord is always with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jamadoot na aavai nerai ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not approach me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)th laai prabh raakhai ||
english: God holds me close in His embrace, and protects me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur kee sach saakhai ||1||
english: True are the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਕੀਤੀ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai pooree keetee ||
english: The Perfect Guru has done it perfectly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੀਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dusaman maar vidaare sagale daas kau sumat deetee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He has beaten and driven off my enemies, and given me, His slave, the sublime understanding of the neutral mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਥਾਨ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: prabh sagale thaan vasaae ||
english: God has blessed all places with prosperity.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਿ ਸਾਂਦਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: sukh saa(n)d phir aae ||
english: I have returned again safe and sound.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaae ||
english: Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਾਏ ॥੨॥੨੪॥੮੮॥
transliteration: jin sagale rog mitaae ||2||24||88||
english: It has eradicated all disease. ||2||24||88||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa kaa daataa satigur taa kee saranee paaeeai ||
english: The True Guru is the Giver of all peace and comfort - seek His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: darasan bhetat hot ana(n)daa dookh gaiaa har gaaeeai ||1||
english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, bliss ensues, pain is dispelled, and one sings the Lord's Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har ras peevahu bhaaee ||
english: Drink in the sublime essence of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam japahu naamo aaraadhahu gur poore kee saranaaee || rahaau ||
english: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; worship the Naam in adoration, and enter the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tisahi paraapat jis dhur likhiaa soee pooran bhaaee ||
english: Only one who has such pre-ordained destiny receives it; he alone becomes perfect, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੫॥੮੯॥
transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)tee prabh jee naam rahaa liv laaee ||2||25||89||
english: Nanak's prayer, O Dear God, is to remain lovingly absorbed in the Naam. ||2||25||89||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan har a(n)tarajaamee jan apune kee raakhai ||
english: The Lord is the Cause of Causes, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He preserves the honor of His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar hot jag bheetar sabad guroo ras chaakhai ||1||
english: He is hailed and congratulated throughout the world, and he tastes the sublime essence of the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: prabh jee teree ot gusaaee ||
english: Dear God, Lord of the world, You are my only support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਮੑ ਧਿਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too samarath saran kaa daataa aath pahar tumh dhiaaee || rahaau ||
english: You are all-powerful, the Giver of Sanctuary; twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on You. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jo jan bhajan kare prabh teraa tisai a(n)desaa naahee ||
english: That humble being, who vibrates upon You, O God, is not afflicted by anxiety.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਗੇ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur charan lage bhau mitiaa har gun gaae man maahee ||2||
english: Attached to the Feet of the True Guru, his fear is dispelled, and within his mind, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ghanere satigur deeaa dilaasaa ||
english: He abides in celestial peace and utter ecstasy; the True Guru has comforted him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin ghar aae sobhaa setee pooran hoee aasaa ||3||
english: He has returned home victorious, with honor, and his hopes have been fulfilled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: pooraa gur pooree mat jaa kee pooran prabh ke kaamaa ||
english: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru; Perfect are the actions of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੯੦॥
transliteration: gur charanee laag tario bhav saagar jap naanak har har naamaa ||4||26||90||
english: Grasping hold of the Guru's feet, Nanak has crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||26||90||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਥਾਟੀ ॥
transliteration: bhaio kirapaal deen dukh bha(n)jan aape sabh bidh thaatee ||
english: Becoming merciful, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor has Himself devised all devices.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਓ ਜਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਬੇੜੀ ਕਾਟੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khin mahi raakh leeo jan apunaa gur poorai beRee kaatee ||1||
english: In an instant, He has saved His humble servant; the Perfect Guru has cut away his bonds. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: mere man gur govi(n)d sad dhiaaeeai ||
english: O my mind, meditate forever on the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal kales mitahi is tan te man chi(n)diaa phal paaeeai || rahaau ||
english: All illness shall depart from this body, and you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t jaa ke sabh keene prabh oochaa agam apaaraa ||
english: God created all beings and creatures; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਏ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੨੭॥੯੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak naam dhiaaiaa mukh oojal bhae darabaaraa ||2||27||91||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; his face is radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||2||27||91||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
transliteration: simarau apunaa saa(n)ee ||
english: I meditate in remembrance on my Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: dinas rain sad dhiaaee ||
english: Day and night, I ever meditate on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
transliteration: haath dei jin raakhe ||
english: He gave me His hand, and protected me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਚਾਖੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har naam mahaa ras chaakhe ||1||
english: I drink in the most sublime essence of the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: apane gur oopar kurabaan ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਹੋਏ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhae kirapaal pooran prabh daate jee hoe miharavaan || rahaau ||
english: God, the Great Giver, the Perfect One, has become merciful to me, and now, all are kind to me. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naanak jan saranaaee ||
english: Servant Nanak has entered His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin pooran paij rakhaaee ||
english: He has perfectly preserved his honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sagale dookh mitaaee ||
english: All suffering has been dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: sukh bhu(n)chahu mere bhaaee ||2||28||92||
english: So enjoy peace, O my Siblings of Destiny! ||2||28||92||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sunahu bina(n)tee thaakur mere jee ja(n)t tere dhaare ||
english: Hear my prayer, O my Lord and Master; all beings and creatures were created by You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੁ ਪੈਜ ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raakh paij naam apune kee karan karaavanahaare ||1||
english: You preserve the honor of Your Name, O Lord, Cause of causes. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh jeeu khasamaanaa kar piaare ||
english: O Dear God, Beloved, please, make me Your own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰੇ ਭਲੇ ਹਮ ਥਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bure bhale ham thaare || rahaau ||
english: Whether good or bad, I am Yours. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sunee pukaar samarath suaamee ba(n)dhan kaat savaare ||
english: The Almighty Lord and Master heard my prayer; cutting away my bonds, He has adorned me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੨੯॥੯੩॥
transliteration: pahir sirapaau sevak jan mele naanak pragat pahaare ||2||29||93||
english: He dressed me in robes of honor, and blended His servant with Himself; Nanak is revealed in glory throughout the world. ||2||29||93||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਭਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh vas kar deene sevak sabh darabaare ||
english: All beings and creatures are subservient to all those who serve in the Lord's Court.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeo prabh apune bhav nidh paar utaare ||1||
english: Their God made them His own, and carried them across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan ke kaaraj sagal savaare ||
english: He resolves all the affairs of His Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal kripaal kripaa nidh pooran khasam hamaare || rahaau ||
english: He is merciful to the meek, kind and compassionate, the ocean of kindness, my Perfect Lord and Master. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਬੈਠੁ ਆਦਰੁ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aau baith aadar sabh thaaee oon na katahoo(n) baataa ||
english: I am asked to come and be seated, everywhere I go, and I lack nothing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਦੀਓ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੨॥੩੦॥੯੪॥
transliteration: bhagat sirapaau deeo jan apune prataap naanak prabh jaataa ||2||30||94||
english: The Lord blesses His humble devotee with robes of honor; O Nanak, the Glory of God is manifest. ||2||30||94||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
english: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: re man raam siu kar preet ||
english: O mind, love the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨੁ ਸੁਨਉ ਅਰੁ ਗਾਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sravan gobi(n)d gun sunau ar gaau rasanaa geet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: With your ears, hear the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and with your tongue, sing His song. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਮਰੁ ਮਾਧੋ ਹੋਹਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: kar saadhasa(n)gat simar maadho hohi patit puneet ||
english: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and meditate in remembrance on the Lord; even a sinner like yourself will become pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਆਲੁ ਜਿਉ ਪਰਿਓ ਡੋਲੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaal biaal jiu pario dolai mukh pasaare meet ||1||
english: Death is on the prowl, with its mouth wide open, friend. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਮਝਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: aaj kaal phun tohi gras hai samajh raakhau cheet ||
english: Today or tomorrow, eventually it will seize you; understand this in your consciousness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਤੁ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਬੀਤ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: kahai naanak raam bhaj lai jaat ausar beet ||2||1||
english: Says Nanak, meditate, and vibrate upon the Lord; this opportunity is slipping away! ||2||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
english: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਰਹੀ ॥
transliteration: man kee man hee maahi rahee ||
english: The mind remains in the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ ਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੇਵੇ ਚੋਟੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naa har bhaje na teerath seve chotee kaal gahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He does not meditate on the Lord, nor does he perform service at sacred shrines, and so death seizes him by the hair. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਰਾ ਮੀਤ ਪੂਤ ਰਥ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਧਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਮਹੀ ॥
transliteration: daaraa meet poot rath sa(n)pat dhan pooran sabh mahee ||
english: Wife, friends, children, carriages, property, total wealth, the entire world

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਏ ਜਾਨਉ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੋ ਸਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: avar sagal mithiaa e jaanau bhajan raam ko sahee ||1||
english: - know that all of these things are false. The Lord's meditation alone is true. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਲਹੀ ॥
transliteration: phirat phirat bahute jug haario maanas deh lahee ||
english: Wandering, wandering around for so many ages, he has grown weary, and finally, he obtained this human body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਬਰੀਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਹਾ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kahat milan kee bareeaa simarat kahaa nahee ||2||2||
english: Says Nanak, this is the opportunity to meet the Lord; why don't you remember Him in meditation? ||2||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
english: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਉਨੁ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਤੈ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: man re kaun kumat tai leenee ||
english: O mind, what evil-mindedness have you developed?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਰਸ ਰਚਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: par daaraa ni(n)diaa ras rachio raam bhagat nahi keenee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are engrossed in the pleasures of other men's wives, and slander; you have not worshipped the Lord at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਤੈ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਧਨ ਜੋਰਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mukat pa(n)th jaanio tai naahan dhan joran kau dhaaiaa ||
english: You do not know the way to liberation, but you run all around chasing wealth.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਸੰਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਦੀਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)t sa(n)g kaahoo nahee deenaa birathaa aap ba(n)dhaaiaa ||1||
english: In the end, nothing shall go along with you; you have entrapped yourself in vain. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿਓ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਨਹ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naa har bhajio na gur jan sevio nah upajio kachh giaanaa ||
english: You have not meditated or vibrated upon the Lord; you have not served the Guru, or His humble servants; spiritual wisdom has not welled up within you.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਤੈ ਖੋਜਤ ਉਦਿਆਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghat hee maahi nira(n)jan terai tai khojat udiaanaa ||2||
english: The Immaculate Lord is within your heart, and yet you search for Him in the wilderness. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮਤ ਤੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bahut janam bharamat tai haario asathir mat nahee paaee ||
english: You have wandered through many many births; you are exhausted but have still not found a way out of this endless cycle.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਇ ਪਦ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥
transliteration: maanas deh paai pad har bhaj naanak baat bataaee ||3||3||
english: Now that you have obtained this human body, meditate on the Lord's Feet; Nanak advises with this advice. ||3||3||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
english: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: man re prabh kee saran bichaaro ||
english: O mind, contemplate the Sanctuary of God.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਨਕਾ ਸੀ ਉਧਰੀ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jih simarat ganakaa see udharee taa ko jas ur dhaaro ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Ganika the prostitute was saved; enshrine His Praises within your heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅਟਲ ਭਇਓ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਅਰੁ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: atal bhaio dhroo jaa kai simaran ar nirabhai pad paaiaa ||
english: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Dhroo became immortal, and obtained the state of fearlessness.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dukh harataa ih bidh ko suaamee tai kaahe bisaraaiaa ||1||
english: The Lord and Master removes suffering in this way - why have you forgotten Him? ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਜ ਗਰਾਹ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
transliteration: jab hee saran gahee kirapaa nidh gaj garaah te chhootaa ||
english: As soon as the elephant took to the protective Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of mercy, he escaped from the crocodile.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਹਮਾ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਬਰਨਉ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਤਿਹ ਤੂਟਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mahamaa naam kahaa lau baranau raam kahat ba(n)dhan tih tootaa ||2||
english: How much can I describe the Glorious Praises of the Naam? Whoever chants the Lord's Name, his bonds are broken. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ajaamal paapee jag jaane nimakh maahi nisataaraa ||
english: Ajaamal, known throughout the world as a sinner, was redeemed in an instant.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਚੇਤ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਤੈ ਭੀ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak kahat chet chi(n)taaman tai bhee utarahi paaraa ||3||4||
english: Says Nanak, remember the Chintaamani, the jewel which fulfills all desires, and you too shall be carried across and saved. ||3||4||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
english: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਪਾਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: praanee kaun upaau karai ||
english: What efforts should the mortal make,

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa te bhagat raam kee paavai jam ko traas harai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: to attain devotional worship of the Lord, and eradicate the fear of death? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਰਈ ॥
transliteration: kaun karam bidiaa kahu kaisee dharam kaun phun karaee ||
english: Which actions, what sort of knowledge, and what religion - what Dharma should one practice?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਉ ਤਰਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaun naam gur jaa kai simarai bhav saagar kau taraee ||1||
english: What Name of the Guru should one remember in meditation, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਲ ਮੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜਪੈ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kal mai ek naam kirapaa nidh jaahi japai gat paavai ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Name of the One Lord is the treasure of mercy; chanting it, one obtains salvation.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅਉਰ ਧਰਮ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਮ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aur dharam taa kai sam naahan ih bidh bed bataavai ||2||
english: No other religion is comparable to this; so speak the Vedas. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰਹਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਲੇਪੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sukh dukh rahat sadaa niralepee jaa kau kahat gusaaee ||
english: He is beyond pain and pleasure, forever unattached; He is called the Lord of the world.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਪਨਿ ਨਿਆਈ ॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: so tum hee mahi basai nira(n)tar naanak darapan niaaee ||3||5||
english: He dwells deep within your inner self, O Nanak, like the image in a mirror. ||3||5||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
english: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮੈ ਕਿਹਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਲਖਉ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maaee mai kihi bidh lakhau gusaaee ||
english: O mother, how can I see the Lord of the world?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਤਿਮਰਿ ਮੋ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਉਰਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mahaa moh agiaan timar mo man rahio urajhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the utter darkness of emotional attachment and spiritual ignorance, my mind remains entangled. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮ ਹੀ ਭਰਮ ਖੋਇਓ ਨਹ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sagal janam bharam hee bharam khoio nah asathir mat paaee ||
english: Deluded by doubt, I have wasted my whole life; I have not obtained a stable intellect.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆਸਕਤ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਨਹ ਛੂਟੀ ਅਧਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bikhiaasakat rahio nis baasur nah chhootee adhamaaee ||1||
english: I remain under the influence of corrupting sins, night and day, and I have not renounced wickedness. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨਾ ਨਹ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g kabahoo nahee keenaa nah keerat prabh gaaee ||
english: I never joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and I did not sing the Kirtan of God's Praises.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਊ ਗੁਨੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak mai naahi kooo gun raakh lehu saranaaee ||2||6||
english: O servant Nanak, I have no virtues at all; keep me in Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||6||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
english: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਬਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: maaee man mero bas naahi ||
english: O mother, my mind is out of control.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਤ ਕਿਹਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੋਕਉ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nis baasur bikhian kau dhaavat kihi bidh rokau taahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Night and day, it runs after sin and corruption. How can I restrain it? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕੇ ਮਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹੀਏ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan simrit ke mat sun nimakh na heee basaavai ||
english: He listens to the teachings of the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, but he does not enshrine them in his heart, even for an instant.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਿਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: par dhan par daaraa siu rachio birathaa janam siraavai ||1||
english: Engrossed in the wealth and women of others, his life passes away uselessly. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਭਇਓ ਬਾਵਰੋ ਸੂਝਤ ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mad maaiaa kai bhaio baavaro soojhat nah kachh giaanaa ||
english: He has gone insane with the wine of Maya, and does not understand even a bit of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਸਤ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghat hee bheetar basat nira(n)jan taa ko maram na jaanaa ||2||
english: Deep within his heart, the Immaculate Lord dwells, but he does not know this secret. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਆਇਓ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jab hee saran saadh kee aaio duramat sagal binaasee ||
english: When I came to the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints, all my evil-mindedness was dispelled.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਨਾਨਕ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੩॥੭॥
transliteration: tab naanak chetio chi(n)taaman kaatee jam kee phaasee ||3||7||
english: Then, O Nanak, I remembered the Chintaamani, the jewel which fulfills all desires, and the noose of Death was snapped. ||3||7||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
english: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਇਹ ਸਾਚੀ ਜੀਅ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: re nar ih saachee jee dhaar ||
english: O man, grasp this Truth firmly in your soul.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਲਗਤ ਨ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal jagat hai jaise supanaa binasat lagat na baar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The whole world is just like a dream; it will pass away in an instant. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰੂ ਭੀਤਿ ਬਨਾਈ ਰਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਰਹਤ ਨਹੀ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: baaroo bheet banaaee rach pach rahat nahee din chaar ||
english: Like a wall of sand, built up and plastered with great care, which does not last even a few days,

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਇਹ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਕਹਾ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taise hee ih sukh maaiaa ke urajhio kahaa gavaar ||1||
english: just so are the pleasures of Maya. Why are you entangled in them, you ignorant fool? ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅਜਹੂ ਸਮਝਿ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਨਾਹਿਨਿ ਭਜਿ ਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ajahoo samajh kachh bigario naahin bhaj le naam muraar ||
english: Understand this today - it is not yet too late! Chant and vibrate the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਜ ਮਤੁ ਸਾਧਨ ਕਉ ਭਾਖਿਓ ਤੋਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak nij mat saadhan kau bhaakhio tohi pukaar ||2||8||
english: Says Nanak, this is the subtle wisdom of the Holy Saints, which I proclaim out loud to you. ||2||8||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
english: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਜਗਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ih jag meet na dekhio koee ||
english: In this world, I have not found any true friend.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ਅਪਨੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal jagat apanai sukh laagio dukh mai sa(n)g na hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The whole world is attached to its own pleasures, and when trouble comes, no one is with you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦਾਰਾ ਮੀਤ ਪੂਤ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ ਸਗਰੇ ਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: daaraa meet poot sanaba(n)dhee sagare dhan siu laage ||
english: Wives, friends, children and relatives - all are attached to wealth.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਨਰ ਕਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਸਭ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jab hee niradhan dekhio nar kau sa(n)g chhaad sabh bhaage ||1||
english: When they see a poor man, they all forsake his company and run away. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹਂਉ ਕਹਾ ਯਿਆ ਮਨ ਬਉਰੇ ਕਉ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kaha(n)u kahaa yiaa man baure kau in siu nehu lagaaio ||
english: So what should I say to this crazy mind, which is affectionately attached to them?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਸਕਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਜਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: deenaa naath sakal bhai bha(n)jan jas taa ko bisaraaio ||2||
english: The Lord is the Master of the meek, the Destroyer of all fears, and I have forgotten to praise Him. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਨ ਪੂਛ ਜਿਉ ਭਇਓ ਨ ਸੂਧਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਤਨੁ ਮੈ ਕੀਨਉ ॥
transliteration: suaan poochh jiu bhaio na soodhau bahut jatan mai keenau ||
english: Like a dog's tail, which will never straighten out, the mind will not change, no matter how many things are tried.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਜ ਬਿਰਦ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਉ ਲੀਨਉ ॥੩॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak laaj birad kee raakhahu naam tuhaarau leenau ||3||9||
english: Says Nanak, please, Lord, uphold the honor of Your innate nature; I chant Your Name. ||3||9||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
english: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: man re gahio na gur upades ||
english: O mind, you have not accepted the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਜਉ ਮੂਡੁ ਮੁਡਾਇਓ ਭਗਵਉ ਕੀਨੋ ਭੇਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kahaa bhaio jau mood mudaaio bhagavau keeno bhes ||1|| rahaau ||
english: What is the use of shaving your head, and wearing saffron robes? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਝੂਠਹ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਓ ॥
transliteration: saach chhaad kai jhoothah laagio janam akaarath khoio ||
english: Abandoning Truth, you cling to falsehood; your life is uselessly wasting away.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਉਦਰ ਨਿਜ ਪੋਖਿਓ ਪਸੁ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਸੋਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar parapa(n)ch udar nij pokhio pas kee niaaee soio ||1||
english: Practicing hypocrisy, you fill your belly, and then sleep like an animal. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: raam bhajan kee gat nahee jaanee maaiaa haath bikaanaa ||
english: You do not know the Way of the Lord's meditation; you have sold yourself into Maya's hands.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਉਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: urajh rahio bikhian sa(n)g bauraa naam ratan bisaraanaa ||2||
english: The madman remains entangled in vice and corruption; he has forgotten the jewel of the Naam. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਹਿਓ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅਉਧ ਸਿਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: rahio achet na chetio gobi(n)d birathaa audh siraanee ||
english: He remains thoughtless, not thinking of the Lord of the Universe; his life is uselessly passing away.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਨਉ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੧੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak har birad pachhaanau bhoole sadaa paraanee ||3||10||
english: Says Nanak, O Lord, please, confirm your innate nature; this mortal is continually making mistakes. ||3||10||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
english: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jo nar dukh mai dukh nahee maanai ||
english: That man, who in the midst of pain, does not feel pain,

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਭੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਮਾਟੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukh sanehu ar bhai nahee jaa kai ka(n)chan maatee maanai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: who is not affected by pleasure, affection or fear, and who looks alike upon gold and dust;||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਨਹ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: nah ni(n)diaa nah usatat jaa kai lobh mohu abhimaanaa ||
english: Who is not swayed by either slander or praise, nor affected by greed, attachment or pride;

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਆਰਉ ਨਾਹਿ ਮਾਨ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: harakh sog te rahai niaarau naahi maan apamaanaa ||1||
english: who remains unaffected by joy and sorrow, honor and dishonor;||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਜਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa sagal tiaagai jag te rahai niraasaa ||
english: who renounces all hopes and desires and remains desireless in the world;

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜਿਹ ਪਰਸੈ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਤਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaam krodh jih parasai naahan tih ghat braham nivaasaa ||2||
english: who is not touched by sexual desire or anger - within his heart, God dwells. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਕਉ ਕੀਨੀ ਤਿਹ ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa jih nar kau keenee tih ih jugat pachhaanee ||
english: That man, blessed by Guru's Grace, understands this way.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਨ ਭਇਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak leen bhaio gobi(n)d siu jiu paanee sa(n)g paanee ||3||11||
english: O Nanak, he merges with the Lord of the Universe, like water with water. ||3||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
english: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਾਨਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: preetam jaan lehu man maahee ||
english: O dear friend, know this in your mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਿਉ ਹੀ ਜਗੁ ਫਾਂਧਿਓ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: apane sukh siu hee jag phaa(n)dhio ko kaahoo ko naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The world is entangled in its own pleasures; no one is for anyone else. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਮੈ ਆਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੈਠਤ ਰਹਤ ਚਹੂ ਦਿਸਿ ਘੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sukh mai aan bahut mil baithat rahat chahoo dis gherai ||
english: In good times, many come and sit together, surrounding you on all four sides.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਪਤਿ ਪਰੀ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਡਿਤ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bipat paree sabh hee sa(n)g chhaadit kooo na aavat nerai ||1||
english: But when hard times come, they all leave, and no one comes near you. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਤ ਸੰਗ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: ghar kee naar bahut hit jaa siu sadaa rahat sa(n)g laagee ||
english: Your wife, whom you love so much, and who has remained ever attached to you,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਹੰਸ ਤਜੀ ਇਹ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jab hee ha(n)s tajee ih kaa(n)iaa pret pret kar bhaagee ||2||
english: runs away crying, "Ghost! Ghost!", as soon as the swan-soul leaves this body. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਬਨਿਓ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: ih bidh ko biuhaar banio hai jaa siu nehu lagaaio ||
english: This is the way they act - those whom we love so much.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਬਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕੋਊ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੩॥੧੨॥੧੩੯॥
transliteration: a(n)t baar naanak bin har jee kooo kaam na aaio ||3||12||139||
english: At the very last moment, O Nanak, no one is any use at all, except the Dear Lord. ||3||12||139||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਚਉਤੁਕੀ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ghar 1 asatapadeeaa chautukee ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa, Chau-Thukay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਪੜਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜਉ ਮੜੈ ਮਸਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa na paRau har bin hor na poojau maRai masaan na jaaee ||
english: I am not torn by duality, because I do not worship any other than the Lord; I do not visit tombs or crematoriums.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਨ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa raach na par ghar jaavaa trisanaa naam bujhaaee ||
english: I do not enter the houses of strangers, engrossed in desire. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, has satisfied my desires.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ghar bheetar ghar guroo dikhaaiaa sahaj rate man bhaaee ||
english: Deep within my heart, the Guru has shown me the home of my being, and my mind is imbued with peace and poise, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too aape daanaa aape beenaa too devahi mat saaee ||1||
english: You Yourself are all-knowing, and You Yourself are all-seeing; You alone bestow intelligence, O Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ਰਤਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man bairaag ratau bairaagee sabad man bedhiaa meree maaee ||
english: My mind is detached, imbued with detachment; the Word of the Shabad has pierced my mind, O my mother.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar jot nira(n)tar baanee saache saahib siu liv laaee || rahaau ||
english: God's Light shines continually within the nucleus of my deepest self; I am lovingly attached to the Bani, the Word of the True Lord Master. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਹਹਿ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh bairaagee kahahi bairaag so bairaagee j khasamai bhaavai ||
english: Countless detached renunciates talk of detachment and renunciation, but he alone is a true renunciate, who is pleasing to the Lord Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਭੈ ਰਚਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hiradai sabad sadaa bhai rachiaa gur kee kaar kamaavai ||
english: The Word of the Shabad is ever in his heart; he is absorbed in the Fear of God, and he works to serve the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: eko chetai manooaa na dolai dhaavat varaj rahaavai ||
english: He remembers the One Lord, his mind does not waver, and he restrains its wanderings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sahaje maataa sadaa ra(n)g raataa saache ke gun gaavai ||2||
english: He is intoxicated with celestial bliss, and is ever imbued with the Lord's Love; he sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਪਉਣੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manooaa paun bi(n)d sukhavaasee naam vasai sukh bhaaee ||
english: The mind is like the wind, but if it comes to rest in peace, even for an instant, then he shall abide in the peace of the Name, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਤ੍ਰ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਲਿ ਬੂਝੀ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jihabaa netr sotr sach raate jal boojhee tujhahi bujhaaee ||
english: His tongue, eyes and ears are imbued with Truth; O Lord, You quench the fires of desire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aas niraas rahai bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laaee ||
english: In hope, the renunciate remains free of hopes; in the home of his own inner self, he is absorbed in the trance of deep meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਜੇ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਆਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhikhiaa naam raje sa(n)tokhee a(n)mrit sahaj peeaaee ||3||
english: He remains content, satisfied with the charity of the Naam; he drinks in the Ambrosial Amrit with ease. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa vich bairaag na hovee jab lag doojee raaee ||
english: There is no renunciation in duality, as long as there is even a particle of duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag teraa too eko daataa avar na doojaa bhaaee ||
english: The whole world is Yours, Lord; You alone are the Giver. There is not any other, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜੰਤ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh ja(n)t dukh sadaa nivaasee guramukh de vadiaaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukh dwells in misery forever, while the Lord bestows greatness upon the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਕਹਣੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: apar apaar aga(n)m agochar kahanai keem na paaee ||4||
english: God is infinite, endless, inaccessible and unfathomable; His worth cannot be described. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਮਹਾ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
transliteration: su(n)n samaadh mahaa paramaarath teen bhavan pat naama(n) ||
english: The consciousness in deep Samaadhi, the Supreme Being, the Lord of the three worlds - these are Your Names, Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਸਹਾਮੰ ॥
transliteration: masatak lekh jeeaa jag jonee sir sir lekh sahaama(n) ||
english: The creatures born into this world have their destiny inscribed upon their foreheads; they experience according to their destinies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਮੰ ॥
transliteration: karam sukaram karaae aape aape bhagat driRaama(n) ||
english: The Lord Himself causes them to do good and bad deeds; He Himself makes them steadfast in devotional worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਜੂਠਿ ਲਹੈ ਭੈ ਮਾਨੰ ਆਪੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਗਾਮੰ ॥੫॥
transliteration: man mukh jooth lahai bhai maana(n) aape giaan agaama(n) ||5||
english: The filth of their mind and mouth is washed off when they live in the Fear of God; the inaccessible Lord Himself blesses them with spiritual wisdom. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਗੁੰਗੇ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jin chaakhiaa seee saad jaanan jiu gu(n)ge mithiaaee ||
english: Only those who taste it know its sweet taste, like the mute, who eats the candy, and only smiles.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥੈ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਚਾਲਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: akathai kaa kiaa katheeai bhaaee chaalau sadaa rajaaee ||
english: How can I describe the indescribable, O Siblings of Destiny? I shall follow His Will forever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur daataa mele taa mat hovai nigure mat na kaaee ||
english: If one meets with the Guru, the Generous Giver, then he understands; those who have no Guru cannot understand this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਚਾਲਹ ਭਾਈ ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jiu chalaae tiu chaalah bhaaee hor kiaa ko kare chaturaaee ||6||
english: As the Lord causes us to act, so do we act, O Siblings of Destiny. What other clever tricks can anyone try? ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ik bharam bhulaae ik bhagatee raate teraa khel apaaraa ||
english: Some are deluded by doubt, while others are imbued with devotional worship; Your play is infinite and endless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਾਏ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੂ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jit tudh laae tehaa phal paaiaa too hukam chalaavanahaaraa ||
english: As You engage them, they receive the fruits of their rewards; You alone are the One who issues Your Commands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਪਣਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sevaa karee je kichh hovai apanaa jeeu pi(n)d tumaaraa ||
english: I would serve You, if anything were my own; my soul and body are Yours.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: satigur miliai kirapaa keenee a(n)mrit naam adhaaraa ||7||
english: One who meets with the True Guru, by His Grace, takes the Support of the Ambrosial Naam. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨੰ ॥
transliteration: gagana(n)tar vaasiaa gun paragaasiaa gun mahi giaan dhiaana(n) ||
english: He dwells in the heavenly realms, and his virtues radiantly shine forth; meditation and spiritual wisdom are found in virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਤਤੋ ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਨੰ ॥
transliteration: naam man bhaavai kahai kahaavai tato tat vakhaana(n) ||
english: The Naam is pleasing to his mind; he speaks it, and causes others to speak it as well. He speaks the essential essence of wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨੰ ॥
transliteration: sabad gur peeraa gahir ga(n)bheeraa bin sabadai jag bauraana(n) ||
english: The Word of the Shabad is his Guru and spiritual teacher, profound and unfathomable; without the Shabad, the world is insane.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਗੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੰ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: pooraa bairaagee sahaj subhaagee sach naanak man maana(n) ||8||1||
english: He is a perfect renunciate, naturally at ease, O Nanak, whose mind is pleased with the True Lord. ||8||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਤਿਤੁਕੀ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 titukee ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl, Thi-Thukay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਬੰਧਨੀ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਬੰਧਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa ba(n)dhanee bhaaee karam dharam ba(n)dhakaaree ||
english: Hope and desire are entrapments, O Siblings of Destiny. Religious rituals and ceremonies are traps.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪਿ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: paap pu(n)n jag jaaiaa bhaaee binasai naam visaaree ||
english: Because of good and bad deeds, one is born into the world, O Siblings of Destiny; forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he is ruined.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗਿ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਮ ਸਭੇ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ih maaiaa jag mohanee bhaaee karam sabhe vekaaree ||1||
english: This Maya is the enticer of the world, O Siblings of Destiny; all such actions are corrupt. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sun pa(n)dit karamaa kaaree ||
english: Listen, O ritualistic Pandit:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਸੁ ਆਤਮ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit karam sukh oopajai bhaaee s aatam tat beechaaree || rahaau ||
english: that religious ritual which produces happiness, O Siblings of Destiny, is contemplation of the essence of the soul. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਕੈ ਖੜੋ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saasat bed bakai khaRo bhaaee karam karahu sa(n)saaree ||
english: You may stand and recite the Shaastras and the Vedas, O Siblings of Destiny, but these are just worldly actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਭਾਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d mail na chookaee bhaaee a(n)tar mail vikaaree ||
english: Filth cannot be washed away by hypocrisy, O Siblings of Destiny; the filth of corruption and sin is within you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਡੂਬੀ ਮਾਕੁਰੀ ਭਾਈ ਊਂਡੀ ਸਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: in bidh doobee maakuree bhaaee oo(n)dee sir kai bhaaree ||2||
english: This is how the spider is destroyed, O Siblings of Destiny, by falling head-long in its own web. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਘਣੀ ਵਿਗੂਤੀ ਭਾਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
transliteration: duramat ghanee vigootee bhaaee doojai bhaai khuaaee ||
english: So many are destroyed by their own evil-mindedness, O Siblings of Destiny; in the love of duality, they are ruined.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur naam na paaeeai bhaaee bin naamai bharam na jaaee ||
english: Without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Name, doubt does not depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur seve taa sukh paae bhaaee aavan jaan rahaaee ||3||
english: If one serves the True Guru, then he obtains peace, O Siblings of Destiny; his comings and goings are ended. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saach sahaj gur te oopajai bhaaee man niramal saach samaaee ||
english: True celestial peace comes from the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny; the immaculate mind is absorbed into the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur seve so boojhai bhaaee gur bin mag na paaee ||
english: One who serves the Guru, understands, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Guru, the way is not found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jis a(n)tar lobh k karam kamaavai bhaaee kooR bol bikh khaaee ||4||
english: What can anyone do, with greed within? O Siblings of Destiny, by telling lies, they eat poison. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਦਹੀ ਵਿਲੋਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਤਥੁ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit dahee viloeeai bhaaee vichahu nikalai tath ||
english: O Pandit, by churning cream, butter is produced.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲੁ ਮਥੀਐ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਏਹਾ ਵਥੁ ॥
transliteration: jal matheeai jal dekheeai bhaaee ihu jag ehaa vath ||
english: By churning water, you shall only see water, O Siblings of Destiny; this world is like that.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਚੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਅਲਖੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur bin bharam vigoocheeai bhaaee ghat ghat deu alakh ||5||
english: Without the Guru, he is ruined by doubt, O Siblings of Destiny; the unseen Divine Lord is in each and every heart. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਤਾਗੋ ਸੂਤ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬਾਧੋ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu jag taago soot ko bhaaee dah dis baadho maai ||
english: This world is like a thread of cotton, O Siblings of Destiny, which Maya has tied on all ten sides.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਾਠਿ ਨ ਛੂਟਈ ਭਾਈ ਥਾਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur gaath na chhootaee bhaaee thaake karam kamaai ||
english: Without the Guru, the knots cannot be untied, O Siblings of Destiny; I am so tired of religious rituals.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ihu jag bharam bhulaaiaa bhaaee kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||6||
english: This world is deluded by doubt, O Siblings of Destiny; no one can say anything about it. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਭੈ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: gur miliai bhau man vasai bhaaee bhai maranaa sach lekh ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, the Fear of God comes to abide in the mind; to die in the Fear of God is one's true destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਜਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਭਾਈ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: majan daan cha(n)giaaeeaa bhaaee daragah naam visekh ||
english: In the Court of the Lord, the Naam is far superior to ritualistic cleansing baths, charity and good deeds, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੇਖੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur a(n)kas jin naam driRaaiaa bhaaee man vasiaa chookaa bhekh ||7||
english: One who implants the Naam within himself, through the Guru's halter - O Siblings of Destiny, the Lord dwells in his mind, and he is free of hypocrisy. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਾਟੁ ਸਰਾਫ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ihu tan haat saraaph ko bhaaee vakhar naam apaar ||
english: This body is the jeweller's shop, O Siblings of Destiny; the incomparable Naam is the merchandise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਸੋ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ihu vakhar vaapaaree so driRai bhaaee gur sabad kare veechaar ||
english: The merchant secures this merchandise, O Siblings of Destiny, by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਾਈ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: dhan vaapaaree naanakaa bhaaee mel kare vaapaar ||8||2||
english: Blessed is the merchant, O Nanak, who meets the Guru, and engages in this trade. ||8||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਸਾਥ ਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jinhee satigur seviaa piaare tinh ke saath tare ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru, O Beloved, their companions are saved as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਨ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tinhaa thaak na paaeeai piaare a(n)mrit rasan hare ||
english: No one blocks their way, O Beloved, and the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar is on their tongue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡੇ ਭਾਰੇ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: boode bhaare bhai binaa piaare taare nadar kare ||1||
english: Without the Fear of God, they are so heavy that they sink and drown, O Beloved; but the Lord, casting His Glance of Grace, carries them across. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
transliteration: bhee toohai saalaahanaa piaare bhee teree saalaah ||
english: I ever praise You, O Beloved, I ever sing Your Praises.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਭੈ ਡੁਬੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੰਧੀ ਪਾਇ ਕਹਾਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vin bohith bhai dubeeai piaare ka(n)dhee paai kahaah ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the boat, one is drowned in the sea of fear, O Beloved; how can I reach the distant shore? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saalaahee saalaahanaa piaare doojaa avar na koi ||
english: I praise the Praiseworthy Lord, O Beloved; there is no other one to praise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mere prabh saalaahan se bhale piaare sabad rate ra(n)g hoi ||
english: Those who praise my God are good, O Beloved; they are imbued with the Word of the Shabad, and His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਸੁ ਲੈ ਤਤੁ ਵਿਲੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis kee sa(n)gat je milai piaare ras lai tat viloi ||2||
english: If I join them, O Beloved, I can churn the essence and so find joy. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਸਾਚ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: pat paravaanaa saach kaa piaare naam sachaa neesaan ||
english: The gateway to honor is Truth, O Beloved; it bears the Insignia of the True Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aaiaa likh lai jaavanaa piaare hukamee hukam pachhaan ||
