english: We come into the world, and we depart, with our destiny written and pre-ordained, O Beloved; realize the Command of the Commander.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur bin hukam na boojheeai piaare saache saachaa taan ||3||
english: Without the Guru, this Command is not understood, O Beloved; True is the Power of the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਿੰਮਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: hukamai a(n)dar ni(n)miaa piaare hukamai udar majhaar ||
english: By His Command, we are conceived, O Beloved, and by His Command, we grow in the womb.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਊਧਉ ਸਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: hukamai a(n)dar ja(n)miaa piaare oodhau sir kai bhaar ||
english: By His Command, we are born, O Beloved, head-first, and upside-down.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚਲੈ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramukh daragah jaaneeai piaare chalai kaaraj saar ||4||
english: The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the Lord, O Beloved; he departs after resolving his affairs. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਦੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hukamai a(n)dar aaiaa piaare hukame jaado jaai ||
english: By His Command, one comes into the world, O Beloved, and by His Will, he goes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਬੰਨੑਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hukame ba(n)nhi chalaaeeai piaare manamukh lahai sajaai ||
english: By His Will, some are bound and gagged and driven away, O Beloved; the self-willed manmukhs suffer their punishment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: hukame sabad pachhaaneeai piaare daragah paidhaa jaai ||5||
english: By His Command, the Word of the Shabad, is realized, O Beloved, and one goes to the Court of the Lord robed in honor. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੋਇ ॥
transliteration: hukame ganat ganaaeeai piaare hukame haumai doi ||
english: By His Command, some accounts are accounted for, O Beloved; by His Command, some suffer in egotism and duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਭਵੈ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: hukame bhavai bhavaaeeai piaare avagan muthee roi ||
english: By His Command, one wanders in reincarnation, O Beloved; deceived by sins and demerits, he cries out in his suffering.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: hukam sinjaapai saah kaa piaare sach milai vadiaaee hoi ||6||
english: If he comes to realize the Command of the Lord's Will, O Beloved, then he is blessed with Truth and Honor. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aakhan aukhaa aakheeai piaare kiu suneeai sach naau ||
english: It is so difficult to speak it, O Beloved; how can we speak, and hear, the True Name?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jinhee so saalaahiaa piaare hau tinh balihaarai jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who praise the Lord, O Beloved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naau milai sa(n)tokheeaa(n) piaare nadaree mel milaau ||7||
english: I have obtained the Name, and I am satisfied, O Beloved; by His Grace, I am united in His Union. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kaagad je theeai piaare man masavaanee dhaar ||
english: If my body were to become the paper, O Beloved, and my mind the inkpot;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਲਤਾ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਲਿਖਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: lalataa lekhan sach kee piaare har gun likhahu veechaar ||
english: and if my tongue became the pen, O Beloved, I would write, and contemplate, the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਲਿਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: dhan lekhaaree naanakaa piaare saach likhai ur dhaar ||8||3||
english: Blessed is that scribe, O Nanak, who writes the True Name, and enshrines it within his heart. ||8||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਦੁਤੁਕੀ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 pahilaa dutukee ||
english: Sorat'h, First Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਗੁਣਦਾਤੌ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: too gunadaatau niramalo bhaaee niramal naa man hoi ||
english: You are the Giver of virtue, O Immaculate Lord, but my mind is not immaculate, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੇ ਭਾਈ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਗੁਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ham aparaadhee niragune bhaaee tujh hee te gun soi ||1||
english: I am a worthless sinner, O Siblings of Destiny; virtue is obtained from You alone, Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: mere preetamaa too karataa kar vekh ||
english: O my Beloved Creator Lord, You create, and You behold.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੀਆ ਭਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau paapee paakha(n)deeaa bhaaee man tan naam visekh || rahaau ||
english: I am a hypocritical sinner, O Siblings of Destiny. Bless my mind and body with Your Name, O Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bikh maaiaa chit mohiaa bhaaee chaturaaee pat khoi ||
english: The poisonous Maya has enticed the consciousness, O Siblings of Destiny; through clever tricks, one loses his honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਮੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chit mahi thaakur sach vasai bhaaee je gur giaan samoi ||2||
english: The True Lord and Master abides in the consciousness, O Siblings of Destiny, if the Guru's spiritual wisdom permeates it. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੂੜੌ ਰੂੜੌ ਆਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਰੂੜੌ ਲਾਲ ਚਲੂਲੁ ॥
transliteration: rooRau rooRau aakheeai bhaaee rooRau laal chalool ||
english: Beautiful, beautiful, the Lord is called, O Siblings of Destiny; beautiful, like the deep crimson color of the poppy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਭੂਲੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je man har siu bairaageeai bhaaee dar ghar saach abhool ||3||
english: If man loves the Lord with detachment, O Siblings of Destiny, he is judged to be true and infallible in the Lord's court and home. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਤੂ ਭਾਈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: paataalee aakaas too bhaaee ghar ghar too gun giaan ||
english: You are pervading the realms of the underworld and the heavenly skies; Your wisdom and glories are in each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur miliai sukh paaiaa bhaaee chookaa manahu gumaan ||4||
english: Meeting with the Guru, one finds peace, O Siblings of Destiny, and pride is dispelled from the mind. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਭੀ ਮੈਲਾ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jal mal kaaiaa maajeeai bhaaee bhee mailaa tan hoi ||
english: Scrubbing with water, the body can be cleaned, O Siblings of Destiny, but the body becomes dirty again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸਿ ਨਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: giaan mahaa ras naaeeai bhaaee man tan niramal hoi ||5||
english: Bathing in the supreme essence of spiritual wisdom, O Siblings of Destiny, the mind and body become pure. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਆ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: devee devaa poojeeai bhaaee kiaa maagau kiaa dehi ||
english: Why worship gods and goddesses, O Siblings of Destiny? What can we ask of them? What can they give us?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਹਣੁ ਨੀਰਿ ਪਖਾਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਬੂਡਹਿ ਤੇਹਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: paahan neer pakhaaleeai bhaaee jal mahi boodahi tehi ||6||
english: The stone gods are washed with water, O Siblings of Destiny, but they just sink in the water. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਗੁ ਬੂਡੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur bin alakh na lakheeai bhaaee jag boodai pat khoi ||
english: Without the Guru, the unseen Lord cannot be seen, O Siblings of Destiny; the world is drowning, having lost its honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਭਾਈ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: mere thaakur haath vadaaeeaa bhaaee jai bhaavai tai dei ||7||
english: Greatness is in the hands of my Lord and Master, O Siblings of Destiny; as He is pleased, He gives. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਈਅਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਮੀਠੁਲੀ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baeear bolai meethulee bhaaee saach kahai pir bhaai ||
english: That soul-bride, who talks sweetly and speaks the Truth, O Siblings of Destiny, becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਹੈ ਬੇਧੀ ਸਚਿ ਵਸੀ ਭਾਈ ਅਧਿਕ ਰਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: birahai bedhee sach vasee bhaaee adhik rahee har naai ||8||
english: Pierced by His Love, she abides in Truth, O Siblings of Destiny, deeply imbued with the Lord's Name. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko aakhai aapanaa bhaaee gur te bujhai sujaan ||
english: Everyone calls God his own, O Siblings of Destiny, but the all-knowing Lord is known only through the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬੀਧੇ ਸੇ ਊਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੯॥
transliteration: jo beedhe se oobare bhaaee sabad sachaa neesaan ||9||
english: Those who are pierced by His Love are saved, O Siblings of Destiny; they bear the Insignia of the True Word of the Shabad. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਈਧਨੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਸਕੇਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਰੰਚਕ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: eedhan adhik sakeleeai bhaaee paavak ra(n)chak paai ||
english: A large pile of firewood, O Siblings of Destiny, will burn if a small fire is applied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੪॥
transliteration: khin pal naam ridai vasai bhaaee naanak milan subhaai ||10||4||
english: In the same way, if the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells in the heart for a moment, even for an instant, O Siblings of Destiny, then one meets the Lord with ease, O Nanak. ||10||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਤਿਤੁਕੀ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ghar 1 titukee ||
english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, First House, Thi-Thukay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਦੀ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਰਖਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਤੂ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa dee sadaa too rakhadaa har jeeu dhur too rakhadaa aaiaa ||
english: You always preserve the honor of Your devotees, O Dear Lord; You have protected them from the very beginning of time.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਜਨ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: prahilaad jan tudh raakh lae har jeeu haranaakhas maar pachaaiaa ||
english: You protected Your servant Prahlaad, O Dear Lord, and annihilated Harnaakhash.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukhaa no parateet hai har jeeu manamukh bharam bhulaaiaa ||1||
english: The Gurmukhs place their faith in the Dear Lord, but the self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: har jee eh teree vadiaaee ||
english: O Dear Lord, this is Your Glory.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa kee paij rakh too suaamee bhagat teree saranaaee || rahaau ||
english: You preserve the honor of Your devotees, O Lord Master; Your devotees seek Your Sanctuary. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਨੇੜੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa no jam johi na saakai kaal na neRai jaaee ||
english: The Messenger of Death cannot touch Your devotees; death cannot even approach them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: keval raam naam man vasiaa naame hee mukat paaee ||
english: The Name of the Lord alone abides in their minds; through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they find liberation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਭ ਭਗਤਾ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ridh sidh sabh bhagataa charanee laagee gur kai sahaj subhaaee ||2||
english: Wealth and all the spiritual powers of the Siddhis fall at the feet of the Lord's devotees; they obtain peace and poise from the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: manamukhaa no parateet na aavee a(n)tar lobh suaau ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs have no faith; they are filled with greed and self-interest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭੇਦਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hiradai sabad na bhedio har naam na laagaa bhaau ||
english: They are not Gurmukh - they do not understand the Word of the Shabad in their hearts; they do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜ ਕਪਟ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫੀਕਾ ਅਲਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kooR kapat paaj lahi jaasee manamukh pheekaa alaau ||3||
english: Their masks of falsehood and hypocrisy shall fall off; the self-willed manmukhs speak with insipid words. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਹੂ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa vich aap varatadaa prabh jee bhagatee hoo too jaataa ||
english: You are pervading through Your devotees, O Dear God; through Your devotees, You are known.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸਭ ਲੋਕ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa moh sabh lok hai teree too eko purakh bidhaataa ||
english: All the people are enticed by Maya; they are Yours, Lord - You alone are the Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: haumai maar manasaa manahi samaanee gur kai sabad pachhaataa ||4||
english: Overcoming my egotism and quieting the desires within my mind, I have come to realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t ka(n)m karahi prabh tin ke jin har kaa naam piaaraa ||
english: God automatically does the work of those who love the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad sadaa man vasiaa sabh kaaj savaaranahaaraa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, he ever dwells in their minds, and He resolves all their affairs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਵਿਗੁਚੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: onaa kee rees kare s viguchai jin har prabh hai rakhavaaraa ||5||
english: Whoever challenges them is destroyed; they have the Lord God as their Savior. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve kinai na paaiaa manamukh bhauk mue bilalaaee ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds the Lord; the self-willed manmukhs die crying out in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aavahi jaavahi thaur na paavahi dukh mahi dukh samaaee ||
english: They come and go, and find no place of rest; in pain and suffering, they perish.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s a(n)mrit peevai sahaje saach samaaee ||6||
english: But one who becomes Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, and is easily absorbed in the True Name. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਜੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve janam na chhodai je anek karam karai adhikaaee ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, one cannot escape reincarnation, even by performing numerous rituals.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਤੈ ਵਾਦ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ved paRahi tai vaad vakhaanahi bin har pat gavaaee ||
english: Those who read the Vedas, and argue and debate without the Lord, lose their honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਜਿ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sachaa satigur saachee jis baanee bhaj chhootahi gur saranaaee ||7||
english: True is the True Guru, and True is the Word of His Bani; in the Guru's Sanctuary, one is saved. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jin har man vasiaa se dar saache dar saachai sachiaaraa ||
english: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord are judged as true in the Court of the Lord; they are hailed as true in the True Court.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਦੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਹੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: onaa dee sobhaa jug jug hoee koi na metanahaaraa ||
english: Their praises echo throughout the ages, and no one can erase them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tin kai sad balihaarai jin har raakhiaa ur dhaaraa ||8||1||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who enshrine the Lord within their hearts. ||8||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਦੁਤੁਕੀ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 dutukee ||
english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਗੁਣਿਆ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਭਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: niguniaa no aape bakhas lae bhaaee satigur kee sevaa laai ||
english: He Himself forgives the worthless, O Siblings of Destiny; He commits them to the service of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਊਤਮ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur kee sevaa ootam hai bhaaee raam naam chit laai ||1||
english: Service to the True Guru is sublime, O Siblings of Destiny; through it, one's consciousness is attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu aape bakhas milaai ||
english: The Dear Lord forgives, and unites with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਹੀਣ ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਲਏ ਰਲਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gunaheen ham aparaadhee bhaaee poorai satigur lae ralaai || rahaau ||
english: I am a sinner, totally without virtue, O Siblings of Destiny; the Perfect True Guru has blended me. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣ ਕਉਣ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਬਖਸਿਅਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kaun kaun aparaadhee bakhasian piaare saachai sabad veechaar ||
english: So many, so many sinners have been forgiven, O beloved one, by contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਭਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੇੜੈ ਚਾੜਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhaujal paar utaarian bhaaee satigur beRai chaaR ||2||
english: They got on board the boat of the True Guru, who carried them across the terrifying world-ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਰੈ ਤੇ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manoorai te ka(n)chan bhae bhaaee gur paaras mel milaai ||
english: I have been transformed from rusty iron into gold, O Siblings of Destiny, united in Union with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap chhod naau man vasiaa bhaaee jotee jot milaai ||3||
english: Eliminating my self-conceit, the Name has come to dwell within my mind, O Siblings of Destiny; my light has merged in the Light. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਭਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree hau vaaranai bhaaee satigur kau sad balihaarai jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice, O Siblings of Destiny, I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan jin ditaa bhaaee guramat sahaj samaau ||4||
english: He has given me the treasure of the Naam; O Siblings of Destiny, through the Guru's Teachings, I am absorbed in celestial bliss. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur bin sahaj na oopajai bhaaee poochhahu giaaneeaa jaai ||
english: Without the Guru, celestial peace is not produced, O Siblings of Destiny; go and ask the spiritual teachers about this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: satigur kee sevaa sadaa kar bhaaee vichahu aap gavaai ||5||
english: Serve the True Guru forever, O Siblings of Destiny, and eradicate self-conceit from within. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਭਉ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramatee bhau oopajai bhaaee bhau karanee sach saar ||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, the Fear of God is produced, O Siblings of Destiny; true and excellent are the deeds done in the Fear of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: prem padaarath paaeeai bhaaee sach naam aadhaar ||6||
english: Then, one is blessed with the treasure of the Lord's Love, O Siblings of Destiny, and the Support of the True Name. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo satigur sevahi aapanaa bhaaee tin kai hau laagau paai ||
english: I fall at the feet of those who serve their True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਕੁਲੁ ਭੀ ਲਈ ਬਖਸਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: janam savaaree aapanaa bhaaee kul bhee laee bakhasaai ||7||
english: I have fulfilled my life, O Siblings of Destiny, and my family has been saved as well. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sach baanee sach sabad hai bhaaee gur kirapaa te hoi ||
english: The True Word of the Guru's Bani, and the True Word of the Shabad, O Siblings of Destiny, are obtained only by Guru's Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam har man vasai bhaaee tis bighan na laagai koi ||8||2||
english: O Nanak, with the Name of the Lord abiding in one's mind, no obstacles stand in one's way, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ||
english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੇ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu sabade jaapadaa bhaaee poorai bhaag milaai ||
english: The Dear Lord is realized through the Word of His Shabad, O Siblings of Destiny, which is found only by perfect destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਤੀਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa sukh sohaaganee bhaaee anadin rateeaa ra(n)g laai ||1||
english: The happy soul-brides are forever in peace, O Siblings of Destiny; night and day, they are attuned to the Lord's Love. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har jee too aape ra(n)g chaRaai ||
english: O Dear Lord, You Yourself color us in Your Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਿਹੋ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gaavahu gaavahu ra(n)g raatiho bhaaee har setee ra(n)g laai || rahaau ||
english: Sing, continually sing His Praises, imbued with His Love, O Siblings of Destiny; be in love with the Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kee kaar kamaavanee bhaaee aap chhod chit laai ||
english: Work to serve the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny; abandon self-conceit, and focus your consciousness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa sahaj phir dukh na lagaee bhaaee har aap vasai man aai ||2||
english: You shall be in peace forever, and you shall not suffer in pain any longer, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord Himself shall come and abide in your mind. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਭਾਈ ਸਾ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਕੁਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: pir kaa hukam na jaanaee bhaaee saa kulakhanee kunaar ||
english: She who does not know the Will of her Husband Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, is an ill-mannered and bitter bride.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: manahath kaar kamaavanee bhaaee vin naavai kooRiaar ||3||
english: She does things with a stubborn mind, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Name, she is false. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਭਾਇ ਸਚੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: se gaavahi jin masatak bhaag hai bhaaee bhaai sachai bairaag ||
english: They alone sing the Lord's Praises, who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads, O Siblings of Destiny; through the Love of the True Lord, they find detachment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: anadin raate gun ravahi bhaaee nirabhau gur liv laag ||4||
english: Night and day, they are imbued with His Love; they utter His Glorious Praises, O Siblings of Destiny, and they lovingly focus their consciousness on the Fearless Guru. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa maar jeevaaladaa bhaaee so sevahu din raat ||
english: He kills and revives all, O Siblings of Destiny; serve Him, day and night.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: so kiu manahu visaareeai bhaaee jis dee vadee hai daat ||5||
english: How can we forget Him from our minds, O Siblings of Destiny? His gifts are glorious and great. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੀ ਡੁੰਮਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mailee du(n)manee bhaaee daragah naahee thaau ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is filthy and double-minded, O Siblings of Destiny; the finds no place of rest in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai ta gun ravai bhaaee mil preetam saach samaau ||6||
english: But if she becomes Gurmukh, then she chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny; the meets her True Beloved, and merges in Him. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਤੁ ਜਨਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਭਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: et janam har na chetio bhaaee kiaa muhu desee jaai ||
english: In this life, she has not focused her consciousness on the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny; how can she show her face when she leaves?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿੜੀ ਪਵੰਦੀ ਮੁਹਾਇਓਨੁ ਭਾਈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨੋ ਲੋਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kiRee pava(n)dee muhaaion bhaaee bikhiaa no lobhaai ||7||
english: In spite of the warning calls which were sounded, she has been plundered, O Siblings of Destiny; she yearned only for corruption. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਭਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
transliteration: naam samaalahi sukh vasahi bhaaee sadaa sukh saa(n)t sareer ||
english: Those who dwell upon the Naam, O Siblings of Destiny, their bodies are ever peaceful and tranquil.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਭਾਈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam samaal too bhaaee apara(n)par gunee gaheer ||8||3||
english: O Nanak, dwell upon the Naam; the Lord is infinite, virtuous and unfathomable, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ghar 1 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag jinahi upaaiaa bhaaee karan kaaran samarath ||
english: The One who created the whole world, O Siblings of Destiny, is the Almighty Lord, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਵਥੁ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d jin saajiaa bhaaee de kar apanee vath ||
english: He fashioned the soul and the body, O Siblings of Destiny, by His own power.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਅਕਥੁ ॥
transliteration: kin kaheeai kiu dekheeai bhaaee karataa ek akath ||
english: How can He be described? How can He be seen, O Siblings of Destiny? The Creator is One; He is indescribable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਥੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur govi(n)d salaaheeai bhaaee jis te jaapai tath ||1||
english: Praise the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, O Siblings of Destiny; through Him, the essence is known. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man japeeai har bhagava(n)taa ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਕਾ ਹੰਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam daan dei jan apane dookh darad kaa ha(n)taa || rahaau ||
english: He blesses His servant with the gift of the Naam; He is the Destroyer of pain and suffering. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai ghar sabh kichh hai bhaaee nau nidh bhare bha(n)daar ||
english: Everything is in His home, O Siblings of Destiny; His warehouse is overflowing with the nine treasures.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tis kee keemat naa pavai bhaaee oochaa agam apaar ||
english: His worth cannot be estimated, O Siblings of Destiny; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t pratipaaladaa bhaaee nit nit karadaa saar ||
english: He cherishes all beings and creatures, O Siblings of Destiny; he continually takes care of them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur pooraa bheteeai bhaaee sabad milaavanahaar ||2||
english: So meet with the Perfect True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, and merge in the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵੀਅਹਿ ਭਾਈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sache charan sareveeahi bhaaee bhram bhau hovai naas ||
english: Adoring the feet of the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, doubt and fear are dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਂਜੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)t sabhaa man maa(n)jeeai bhaaee har kai naam nivaas ||
english: Joining the Society of the Saints, cleanse your mind, O Siblings of Destiny, and dwell in the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਅਗਿਆਨਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਕਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: mitai a(n)dheraa agiaanataa bhaaee kamal hovai paragaas ||
english: The darkness of ignorance shall be dispelled, O Siblings of Destiny, and the lotus of your heart shall blossom forth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur bachanee sukh oopajai bhaaee sabh phal satigur paas ||3||
english: By the Guru's Word, peace wells up, O Siblings of Destiny; all fruits are with the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਹੋਈਐ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: meraa teraa chhodeeai bhaaee hoeeai sabh kee dhoor ||
english: Give up your sense of mine and yours, O Siblings of Destiny, and become the dust of the feet of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਪੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat braham pasaariaa bhaaee pekhai sunai hajoor ||
english: In each and every heart, God is contained, O Siblings of Destiny; He sees, and hears, and is ever-present with us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਮਰੀਐ ਝੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jit din visarai paarabraham bhaaee tit din mareeai jhoor ||
english: On that day when one forgets the Supreme Lord God, O Siblings of Destiny, on that day, one ought to die crying out in pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਮਰਥੋ ਭਾਈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: karan karaavan samaratho bhaaee sarab kalaa bharapoor ||4||
english: He is the all-powerful Cause of Causes, O Siblings of Destiny; he is totally filled with all powers. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: prem padaarath naam hai bhaaee maaiaa moh binaas ||
english: The Love of the Name is the greatest treasure, O Siblings of Destiny; through it, emotional attachment to Maya is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਭਾਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: tis bhaavai taa mel lae bhaaee hiradai naam nivaas ||
english: If it is pleasing to His Will, then He unites us in His Union, O Siblings of Destiny; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide in the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਰਿਦੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh kamal pragaaseeai bhaaee ridai hovai paragaas ||
english: The heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth, O Siblings of Destiny, and the heart is illumined.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: pragat bhaiaa parataap prabh bhaaee mauliaa dharat akaas ||5||
english: The Glory of God has been revealed, O Siblings of Destiny, and the earth and sky have blossomed forth. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai sa(n)tokhiaa bhaaee ahinis laagaa bhaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with contentment, O Siblings of Destiny; day and night, I remain attached to the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa raam ravai sadaa bhaaee saachaa saad suaau ||
english: My tongue continually chants the Lord's Name, O Siblings of Destiny; this is the true taste, and the object of human life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karanee sun sun jeeviaa bhaaee nihachal paaiaa thaau ||
english: Listening with my ears, I hear and so I live, O Siblings of Destiny; I have obtained the unchanging, unmoving state.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਭਾਈ ਸੋ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jis parateet na aavaee bhaaee so jeeaRaa jal jaau ||6||
english: That soul,which does not place its faith in the Lord shall burn, O Siblings of Destiny. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬੈ ਭਾਈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bahu gun mere saahibai bhaaee hau tis kai bal jaau ||
english: My Lord and Master has so many virtues, O Siblings of Destiny; I am a sacrifice to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀਆਰੇ ਪਾਲਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ohu niraguneeaare paaladaa bhaaee dei nithaave thaau ||
english: He nurtures even the most worthless, O Siblings of Destiny, and gives home to the homeless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਭਾਈ ਗੂੜਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rijak sa(n)baahe saas saas bhaaee gooRaa jaa kaa naau ||
english: He gives us nourishment with each and every breath, O Siblings of Destiny; His Name is everlasting.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਮਾਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jis gur saachaa bheteeai bhaaee pooraa tis karamaau ||7||
english: One who meets with the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, does so only by perfect destiny. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tis bin ghaRee na jeeveeai bhaaee sarab kalaa bharapoor ||
english: Without Him, I cannot live, even for an instant, O Siblings of Destiny; He is totally filled with all powers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਭਾਈ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saas giraas na visarai bhaaee pekhau sadaa hajoor ||
english: With every breath and morsel of food, I will not forget Him, O Siblings of Destiny; I behold Him ever-present.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g milaaiaa bhaaee sarab rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meet Him, O Siblings of Destiny; He is totally pervading and permeating everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਗੀਆ ਭਾਈ ਸੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮਰਦੇ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jinaa preet na lageeaa bhaaee se nit nit marade jhoor ||8||
english: Those who do not embrace love for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, always die crying out in pain. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਾਇ ਤਰਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)chal laai taraaiaa bhaaee bhaujal dukh sa(n)saar ||
english: Grasping hold of the hem of His robe, O Siblings of Destiny, we are carried across the world-ocean of fear and pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਅੰਗੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa nadar nihaaliaa bhaaee keeton a(n)g apaar ||
english: By His Glance of Grace, He has blessed us, O Siblings of Destiny; He shall be with us until the very end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man tan seetal hoiaa bhaaee bhojan naam adhaar ||
english: My mind and body are soothed and calmed, O Siblings of Destiny, nourished by the food of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਭਾਈ ਜਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੯॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tis saranaagatee bhaaee j kilabikh kaatanahaar ||9||1||
english: Nanak has entered His Sanctuary, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord is the Destroyer of sins. ||9||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਹ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maat garabh dukh saagaro piaare tah apanaa naam japaaiaa ||
english: The womb of the mother is an ocean of pain, O Beloved; even there, the Lord causes His Name to be chanted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਪਸਰੀਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: baahar kaadh bikh pasareeaa piaare maaiaa mohu vadhaaiaa ||
english: When he emerges, he finds corruption pervading everywhere, O Beloved, and he becomes increasingly attached to Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕੀਤੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis no keeto karam aap piaare tis pooraa guroo milaaiaa ||
english: One whom the Lord blesses with His kind favor, O Beloved, meets the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so aaraadhe saas saas piaare raam naam liv laaiaa ||1||
english: He worships the Lord in adoration with each and every breath, O Beloved; he is lovingly attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: man tan teree tek hai piaare man tan teree tek ||
english: You are the support of my mind and body, O Beloved; You are the support of my mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਨਹਾਰੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਏਕ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tudh bin avar na karanahaar piaare a(n)tarajaamee ek || rahaau ||
english: There is no other Creator except for You, O Beloved; You alone are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kot janam bhram aaiaa piaare anik jon dukh paai ||
english: After wandering in doubt for millions of incarnations, he comes into the world, O Beloved; for uncounted lifetimes, he has suffered in pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahib visariaa piaare bahutee milai sajaai ||
english: He has forgotten his True Lord and Master, O Beloved, and so he suffers terrible punishment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jin bhetai pooraa satiguroo piaare se laage saachai naai ||
english: Those who meet with the Perfect True Guru, O Beloved, are attached to the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੋ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tinaa pichhai chhuteeai piaare jo saachee saranaai ||2||
english: We are saved by following those, O Beloved, who seek the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਇਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: mithaa kar kai khaaiaa piaare tin tan keetaa rog ||
english: He thinks that his food is so sweet, O Beloved, but it makes his body ill.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉੜਾ ਹੋਇ ਪਤਿਸਟਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kauRaa hoi patisatiaa piaare tis te upajiaa sog ||
english: It turns out to be bitter, O Beloved, and it produces only sadness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੋਗ ਭੁੰਚਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: bhog bhu(n)chaai bhulaaian piaare utarai nahee vijog ||
english: The Lord leads him astray in the enjoyment of pleasures, O Beloved, and so his sense of separation does not depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਧੁਰੇ ਪਇਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo gur mel udhaariaa piaare tin dhure paiaa sa(n)jog ||3||
english: Those who meet the Guru are saved, O Beloved; this is their pre-ordained destiny. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa laalach atiaa piaare chit na aavahi mool ||
english: He is filled with longing for Maya, O Beloved, and so the Lord does not ever come into his mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਏ ਧੂੜਿ ॥
transliteration: jin too visarahi paarabraham suaamee se tan hoe dhooR ||
english: Those who forget You, O Supreme Lord Master, their bodies turn to dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਲਾਟ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੂਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bilalaat karahi bahuteriaa piaare utarai naahee sool ||
english: They cry out and scream horribly, O Beloved, but their torment does not end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਮੂਲੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jo gur mel savaariaa piaare tin kaa rahiaa mool ||4||
english: Those who meet the Guru, and reform themselves, O Beloved, their capital remains intact. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੇ ਕਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saakat sa(n)g na keejaee piaare je kaa paar vasaai ||
english: As far as possible, do not associate with the faithless cynics, O Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis miliai har visarai piaare sou muhi kaalai uth jaai ||
english: Meeting with them, the Lord is forgotten, O Beloved, and you rise and depart with a blackened face.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh dhoee nah milai piaare daragah milai sajaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh finds no rest or shelter, O Beloved; in the Court of the Lord, they are punished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jo gur mel savaariaa piaare tinaa pooree paai ||5||
english: Those who meet with the Guru, and reform themselves, O Beloved, their affairs are resolved. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਜਮ ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)jam sahas siaanapaa piaare ik na chalee naal ||
english: One may have thousands of clever tricks and techniques of austere self-discipline, O Beloved, but not even one of them will go with him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਲਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਗਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jo bemukh gobi(n)d te piaare tin kul laagai gaal ||
english: Those who turn their backs on the Lord of the Universe, O Beloved, their families are stained with disgrace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਦੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਤੀਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਚਲੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: hodee vasat na jaateeaa piaare kooR na chalee naal ||
english: They do not realize that they do have Him , O Beloved; falsehood will not go with them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: satigur jinaa milaaion piaare saachaa naam samaal ||6||
english: Those who meet with the True Guru, O Beloved, dwell upon the True Name. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh giaan dhiaan piaare jis no nadar kare ||
english: When the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, O Beloved, one is blessed with Truth, contentment, wisdom and meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੂਰ ਭਰੇ ॥
transliteration: anadin keeratan gun ravai piaare a(n)mrit poor bhare ||
english: Night and day, he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, O Beloved, totally filled with Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਲੰਘਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dukh saagar tin la(n)ghiaa piaare bhavajal paar pare ||
english: He crosses over the sea of pain, O Beloved, and swims across the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੇਈ ਸਦਾ ਖਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jis bhaavai tis mel laihi piaare seee sadaa khare ||7||
english: One who is pleasing to His Will, He unites with Himself, O Beloved; he is forever true. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਗਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)mrath purakh daiaal deu piaare bhagataa tis kaa taan ||
english: The all-powerful Divine Lord is compassionate, O Beloved; He is the Support of His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਢਹਿ ਪਏ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: tis saranaaee dhahi pae piaare j a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||
english: I seek His Sanctuary, O Beloved; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: halat palat savaariaa piaare masatak sach neesaan ||
english: He has adorned me in this world and the next, O Beloved; He has placed the Emblem of Truth upon my forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: so prabh kade na veesarai piaare naanak sad kurabaan ||8||2||
english: I shall never forget that God, O Beloved; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||8||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ghar 2 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਨਿਵਲਿ ਭੁਅੰਗਮ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: paath paRio ar bed beechaario nival bhua(n)gam saadhe ||
english: They read scriptures, and contemplate the Vedas; they practice the inner cleansing techniques of Yoga, and control of the breath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਛੁਟਕਿਓ ਅਧਿਕ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch janaa siu sa(n)g na chhutakio adhik aha(n)budh baadhe ||1||
english: But they cannot escape from the company of the five passions; they are increasingly bound to egotism. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਆਰੇ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਮੈ ਕੀਏ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
transliteration: piaare in bidh milan na jaaee mai keee karam anekaa ||
english: O Beloved, this is not the way to meet the Lord; I have performed these rituals so many times.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: haar pario suaamee kai duaarai deejai budh bibekaa || rahaau ||
english: I have collapsed, exhausted, at the Door of my Lord Master; I pray that He may grant me a discerning intellect. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਨਿ ਭਇਓ ਕਰਪਾਤੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਬਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: mon bhaio karapaatee rahio nagan phirio ban maahee ||
english: One may remain silent and use his hands as begging bowls, and wander naked in the forest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tat teerath sabh dharatee bhramio dubidhaa chhutakai naahee ||2||
english: He may make pilgrimages to river banks and sacred shrines all over the world, but his sense of duality will not leave him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਇ ਬਸਿਓ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤ ਧਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: man kaamanaa teerath jaai basio sir karavat dharaae ||
english: His mind's desires may lead him to go and dwell at sacred places of pilgrimage, and offer his head to be sawn off;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੇ ਲਖ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man kee mail na utarai ih bidh je lakh jatan karaae ||3||
english: but this will not cause the filth of his mind to depart, even though he may make thousands of efforts. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kanik kaaminee haivar gaivar bahu bidh daan daataaraa ||
english: He may give gifts of all sorts - gold, women, horses and elephants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਨ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਭੂਮਿ ਬਹੁ ਅਰਪੇ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: a(n)n basatr bhoom bahu arape nah mileeai har duaaraa ||4||
english: He may make offerings of corn, clothes and land in abundance, but this will not lead him to the Lord's Door. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਰਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
transliteration: poojaa arachaa ba(n)dan da(n)daut khat karamaa rat rahataa ||
english: He may remain devoted to worship and adoration, bowing his forehead to the floor, practicing the six religious rituals.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: hau hau karat ba(n)dhan mahi pariaa nah mileeai ih jugataa ||5||
english: He indulges in egotism and pride, and falls into entanglements, but he does not meet the Lord by these devices. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਸਿਧ ਆਸਣ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਏ ਭੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jog sidh aasan chauraaseeh e bhee kar kar rahiaa ||
english: He practices the eighty-four postures of Yoga, and acquires the supernatural powers of the Siddhas, but he gets tired of practicing these.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਗਹਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: vadee aarajaa phir phir janamai har siu sa(n)g na gahiaa ||6||
english: He lives a long life, but is reincarnated again and again; he has not met with the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਲੀਲਾ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਕਰਿਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: raaj leelaa raajan kee rachanaa kariaa hukam aphaaraa ||
english: He may enjoy princely pleasures, and regal pomp and ceremony, and issue unchallenged commands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹਨੀ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਚੋਆ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਕਾ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sej sohanee cha(n)dan choaa narak ghor kaa duaaraa ||7||
english: He may lie on beautiful beds, perfumed with sandalwood oil, but this will led him only to the gates of the most horrible hell. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: har keerat saadhasa(n)gat hai sir karaman kai karamaa ||
english: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is the highest of all actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਨਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tis bhaio paraapat jis purab likhe kaa lahanaa ||8||
english: Says Nanak, he alone obtains it, who is pre-destined to receive it. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਇਹ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tero sevak ih ra(n)g maataa ||
english: Your slave is intoxicated with this Love of Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: bhaio kripaal deen dukh bha(n)jan har har keeratan ihu man raataa || rahaau doojaa ||1||3||
english: The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful to me, and this mind is imbued with the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||Second Pause||1||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲੇ ੪ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag sorath vaar mahale 4 kee ||
english: Vaar Of Raag Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜੇ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sorath sadaa suhaavanee je sachaa man hoi ||
english: Sorat'h is always beautiful, if it brings the True Lord to dwell in the mind of the soul-bride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੰਦੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਭੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: da(n)dee mail na kat man jeebhai sachaa soi ||
english: Her teeth are clean and her mind is not split by duality; the Name of the True Lord is on her tongue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਭੈ ਵਸੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗ ॥
transliteration: sasurai peeeai bhai vasee satigur sev nisa(n)g ||
english: Here and hereafter, she abides in the Fear of God, and serves the True Guru without hesitation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਪੜੁ ਜੇ ਪਿਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਰਾਵੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: parahar kapaR je pir milai khusee raavai pir sa(n)g ||
english: Discarding worldly adornments, she meets her Husband Lord, and she celebrates joyfully with Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa seegaaree naau man kade na mail pata(n)g ||
english: She is adorned forever with the Name in her mind, and she does not have even an iota of filth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਰ ਜੇਠ ਮੁਏ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਸੂ ਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ॥
transliteration: devar jeth mue dukh sasoo kaa dar kis ||
english: Her husband's younger and elder brothers, the corrupt desires, have died, suffering in pain; and now, who fears Maya, the mother-in-law?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਰਮ ਮਣੀ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: je pir bhaavai naanakaa karam manee sabh sach ||1||
english: If she becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord, O Nanak, she bears the jewel of good karma upon her forehead, and everything is Truth to her. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਤਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਢੰਢੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: sorath taam suhaavanee jaa har naam dha(n)dhole ||
english: Sorat'h is beautiful only when it leads the soul-bride to seek the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gur purakh manaavai aapanaa guramatee har har bole ||
english: She pleases her Guru and God; under Guru's Instruction, she speaks the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਕਸਾਈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: har prem kasaaee dinas raat har ratee har ra(n)g chole ||
english: She is attracted to the Lord's Name, day and night, and her body is drenched in the color of the Love of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੈ ਟੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: har jaisaa purakh na labhaee sabh dekhiaa jagat mai tole ||
english: No other being like the Lord God can be found; I have looked and searched over the whole world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਡੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur naam driRaaiaa man anat na kaahoo dole ||
english: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam within me; my mind does not waver any more.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੋਲ ਗੋਲੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai gur satigur ke gol gole ||2||
english: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave, the slave of the slaves of the Guru, the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: too aape sisat karataa sirajanahaariaa ||
english: You Yourself are the Creator, the Fashioner of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape khel rachaai tudh aap savaariaa ||
english: You Yourself have arranged the play, and You Yourself arrange it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: daataa karataa aap aap bhoganahaariaa ||
english: You Yourself are the Giver and the Creator; You Yourself are the Enjoyer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh teraa sabad varatai upaavanahaariaa ||
english: The Word of Your Shabad is pervading everywhere, O Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hau guramukh sadaa salaahee gur kau vaariaa ||1||
english: As Gurmukh, I ever praise the Lord; I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲਤੇ ਜਲਿ ਮੁਏ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਏ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai jalate jal mue bhram aae doojai bhaai ||
english: In the flames of egotism, he is burnt to death; he wanders in doubt and the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਆਪਣੈ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: poorai satigur raakh leee aapanai pa(n)nai paai ||
english: The Perfect True Guru saves him, making him His own.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu jag jalataa nadaree aaiaa gur kai sabad subhaai ||
english: This world is burning; through the Sublime Word of the Guru's Shabad, this comes to be seen.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabad rate se seetal bhae naanak sach kamaai ||1||
english: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are cooled and soothed; O Nanak, they practice Truth. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: saphalio satigur seviaa dha(n)n janam paravaan ||
english: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding; blessed and acceptable is such a life.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮੁਇਆ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਣ ॥
transliteration: jinaa satigur jeevadiaa muiaa na visarai seee purakh sujaan ||
english: Those who do not forget the True Guru, in life and in death, are truly wise people.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: kul udhaare aapanaa so jan hovai paravaan ||
english: Their families are saved, and they are approved by the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh mue jeevade paravaan hahi manamukh janam maraahi ||
english: The Gurmukhs are approved in death as in life, while the self-willed manmukhs continue the cycle of birth and death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਏ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak mue na aakheeahi j gur kai sabad samaahi ||2||
english: O Nanak, they are not described as dead, who are absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: har purakh nira(n)jan sev har naam dhiaaeeai ||
english: Serve the Immaculate Lord God, and meditate on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਲਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat saadhoo lag har naam samaaeeai ||
english: Join the Society of the Holy Saints, and be absorbed in the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡੀ ਕਾਰ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: har teree vadee kaar mai moorakh laaeeai ||
english: O Lord, glorious and great is service to You; I am so foolish

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੋਲਾ ਲਾਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਮੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: hau golaa laalaa tudh mai hukam phuramaaeeai ||
english: - please, commit me to it. I am Your servant and slave; command me, according to Your Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hau guramukh kaar kamaavaa j gur samajhaaeeai ||2||
english: As Gurmukh, I shall serve You, as Guru has instructed me. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਜਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa j karatai aap likhiaas ||
english: He acts according to pre-ordained destiny, written by the Creator Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: moh thagaulee paaeean visariaa gunataas ||
english: Emotional attachment has drugged him, and he has forgotten the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਵਦਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮੁਇਆਸੁ ॥
transliteration: mat jaanahu jag jeevadaa doojai bhaai muiaas ||
english: Don't think that he is alive in the world - he is dead, through the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੇ ਬਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲਨੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee guramukh naam na chetio se bahan na milanee paas ||
english: Those who do not meditate on the Lord, as Gurmukh, are not permitted to sit near the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਬਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਘਣਾ ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਨ ਸਾਥਿ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: dukh laagaa bahu at ghanaa put kalat na saath koee jaas ||
english: They suffer the most horrible pain and suffering, and neither their sons nor their wives go along with them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਉਭੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
transliteration: lokaa vich muhu kaalaa hoaa a(n)dar ubhe saas ||
english: Their faces are blackened among men, and they sigh in deep regret.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਵਿਸਹੀ ਚੁਕਿ ਗਇਆ ਵੇਸਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukhaa no ko na visahee chuk gaiaa vesaas ||
english: No one places any reliance in the self-willed manmukhs; trust in them is lost.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukhaa no sukh agalaa jinaa a(n)tar naam nivaas ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs live in absolute peace; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within them. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸੈਣ ਸੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: se sain se sajanaa j guramukh milahi subhaai ||
english: They alone are relatives, and they alone are friends, who, as Gurmukh, join together in love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kaa bhaanaa anadin karahi se sach rahe samaai ||
english: Night and day, they act according to the True Guru's Will; they remain absorbed in the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਗੇ ਸਜਣ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai lage sajan na aakheeahi j abhimaan karahi vekaar ||
english: Those who are attached to the love of duality are not called friends; they practice egotism and corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਪ ਸੁਆਰਥੀ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh aap suaarathee kaaraj na sakahi savaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are selfish; they cannot resolve anyone's affairs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa koi na metanahaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, they act according to their pre-ordained destiny; no one can erase it. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape jagat upaai kai aap khel rachaaiaa ||
english: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself arranged the play of it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰਜਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: trai gun aap sirajiaa maaiaa mohu vadhaaiaa ||
english: You Yourself created the three qualities, and fostered emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vich haumai lekhaa ma(n)geeai phir aavai jaaiaa ||
english: He is called to account for his deeds done in egotism; he continues coming and going in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jinaa har aap kripaa kare se gur samajhaaiaa ||
english: The Guru instructs those whom the Lord Himself blesses with Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane sadaa sadaa ghumaaiaa ||3||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਦੰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mamataa mohanee jin vin da(n)taa jag khaaiaa ||
english: The love of Maya is enticing; without teeth, it has eaten up the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖਾਧੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh khaadhe guramukh ubare jinee sach naam chit laaiaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are eaten away, while the Gurmukhs are saved; they focus their consciousness on the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਗੁ ਕਮਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai jag kamalaa phirai guramukh nadaree aaiaa ||
english: Without the Name, the world wanders around insane; the Gurmukhs come to see this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa karatiaa nihaphal janam gavaaiaa sukhadaataa man na vasaaiaa ||
english: Involved in worldly affairs, he wastes his life in vain; the peace-giving Lord does not come to abide in his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam tinaa kau miliaa jin kau dhur likh paaiaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, they alone obtain the Name, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ghar hee mahi a(n)mrit bharapoor hai manamukhaa saad na paaiaa ||
english: The home within is filled with Ambrosial Nectar, but the self-willed manmukh does not get to taste it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਸਤੂਰੀ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਦਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jiu kasatooree mirag na jaanai bhramadaa bharam bhulaaiaa ||
english: He is like the deer, who does not recognize its own musk-scent; it wanders around, deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਜਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit taj bikh sa(n)grahai karatai aap khuaaiaa ||
english: The manmukh forsakes the Ambrosial Nectar, and instead gathers poison; the Creator Himself has fooled him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਤਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh virale sojhee paee tinaa a(n)dar braham dikhaaiaa ||
english: How rare are the Gurmukhs, who obtain this understanding; they behold the Lord God within themselves.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tan man seetal hoiaa rasanaa har saad aaiaa ||
english: Their minds and bodies are cooled and soothed, and their tongues enjoy the sublime taste of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabade hee naau oopajai sabade mel milaaiaa ||
english: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Name wells up; through the Shabad, we are united in the Lord's Union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai sabh jag bauraanaa birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||
english: Without the Shabad, the whole world is insane, and it loses its life in vain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit eko sabad hai naanak guramukh paaiaa ||2||
english: The Shabad alone is Ambrosial Nectar; O Nanak, the Gurmukhs obtain it. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: so har purakh aga(n)m hai kahu kit bidh paaeeai ||
english: The Lord God is inaccessible; tell me, how can we find Him?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਕਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਿਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: tis roop na rekh adrisat kahu jan kiu dhiaaeeai ||
english: He has no form or feature, and He cannot be seen; tell me, how can we meditate on Him?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: nira(n)kaar nira(n)jan har agam kiaa kahi gun gaaeeai ||
english: The Lord is formless, immaculate and inaccessible; which of His Virtues should we speak of and sing?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jis aap bujhaae aap s har maarag paaeeai ||
english: They alone walk on the Lord's Path, whom the Lord Himself instructs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur poorai vekhaaliaa gur sevaa paaeeai ||4||
english: The Perfect Guru has revealed Him to me; serving the Guru, He is found. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤਨੁ ਕੋਲੂ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਭੋਰੀ ਡੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jiu tan koloo peeReeai rat na bhoree dehi ||
english: It is as if my body has been crushed in the oil-press, without yielding even a drop of blood;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਵੰਞੈ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਸੰਦੜੈ ਨੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jeeu va(n)njai chau kha(n)neeai sache sa(n)daRai nehi ||
english: it is as if my soul has been cut apart into pieces for the sake of the Love of the True Lord;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਤੈ ਡੇਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak mel na chukaee raatee atai deh ||1||
english: O Nanak, still, night and day, my Union with the Lord is not broken. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ਮਨੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: sajan maidaa ra(n)gulaa ra(n)g laae man lei ||
english: My Friend is so full of joy and love; He colors my mind with the color of His Love,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਾਜੀਠੈ ਕਪੜੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਭੀ ਪਾਹੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jiu maajeethai kapaRe ra(n)ge bhee paahehi ||
english: like the fabric which is treated to retain the color of the dye.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਬਿਆ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕੇਹ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak ra(n)g na utarai biaa na lagai keh ||2||
english: O Nanak, this color does not depart, and no other color can be imparted to this fabric. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: har aap varatai aap har aap bulaaidaa ||
english: The Lord Himself is pervading everywhere; the Lord Himself causes us to chant His Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: har aape srisat savaar sir dha(n)dhai laaidaa ||
english: The Lord Himself created the creation; He commits all to their tasks.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇ ਇਕਿ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa bhagatee laai ik aap khuaaidaa ||
english: He engages some in devotional worship, and others, He causes to stray.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇ ਇਕਿ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa maarag paai ik ujhaR paaidaa ||
english: He places some on the Path, while He leads others into the wilderness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaae guramukh gun gaaidaa ||5||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee sevaa saphal hai je ko kare chit laai ||
english: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding, if one performs it with his mind focused on it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਣਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man chi(n)diaa phal paavanaa haumai vichahu jaai ||
english: The fruits of the mind's desires are obtained, and egotism departs from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan toRai mukat hoi sache rahai samaai ||
english: His bonds are broken, and he is liberated; he remains absorbed in the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਲਭੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: is jag mahi naam alabh hai guramukh vasai man aai ||
english: It is so difficult to obtain the Naam in this world; it comes to dwell in the mind of the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jo gur sevahi aapanaa hau tin balihaarai jaau ||1||
english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to one who serves his True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੰਨੁ ਅਜਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh ma(n)n ajit hai doojai lagai jaai ||
english: The mind of the self-willed manmukh is so very stubborn; it is stuck in the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tis no sukh supanai nahee dukhe dukh vihaai ||
english: He does not find peace, even in dreams; he passes his life in misery and suffering.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਥਕੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ghar ghar paR paR pa(n)dit thake sidh samaadh lagaai ||
english: The Pandits have grown weary of going door to door, reading and reciting their scriptures; the Siddhas have gone into their trances of Samaadhi.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu man vas na aavaee thake karam kamaai ||
english: This mind cannot be controlled; they are tired of performing religious rituals.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਅਠਿਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhekhadhaaree bhekh kar thake athisath teerath naai ||
english: The impersonators have grown weary of wearing false costumes, and bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man kee saar na jaananee haumai bharam bhulaai ||
english: They do not know the state of their own minds; they are deluded by doubt and egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਭਉ ਪਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee bhau paiaa vadabhaag vasiaa man aai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Fear of God is obtained; by great good fortune, the Lord comes to abide in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਹੋਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhai paiai man vas hoaa haumai sabad jalaai ||
english: When the Fear of God comes, the mind is restrained, and through the Word of the Shabad, the ego is burnt away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sach rate se niramale jotee jot milaai ||
english: Those who are imbued with Truth are immaculate; their light merges in the Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur miliai naau paaiaa naanak sukh samaai ||2||
english: Meeting the True Guru, one obtains the Name; O Nanak, he is absorbed in peace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਰਾਣੇ ਰੰਗ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: eh bhoopat raane ra(n)g din chaar suhaavanaa ||
english: The pleasures of kings and emperors are pleasing, but they last for only a few days.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ehu maaiaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh khin mahi lahi jaavanaa ||
english: These pleasures of Maya are like the color of the safflower, which wears off in a moment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਾਪ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: chaladiaa naal na chalai sir paap lai jaavanaa ||
english: They do not go with him when he departs; instead, he carries the load of sins upon his head.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਕਾਲਿ ਤਾਂ ਖਰਾ ਡਰਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) pakaR chalaaiaa kaal taa(n) kharaa daraavanaa ||
english: When death seizes him, and marches him away, then he looks absolutely hideous.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: oh velaa hath na aavai phir pachhutaavanaa ||6||
english: That lost opportunity will not come into his hands again, and in the end, he regrets and repents. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫਿਰੇ ਸੇ ਬਧੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur te jo muh phire se badhe dukh sahaahi ||
english: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru, suffer in sorrow and bondage.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਤੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: phir phir milan na paainee ja(n)mahi tai mar jaahi ||
english: Again and again, they are born only to die; they cannot meet their Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sahasaa rog na chhodaee dukh hee mahi dukh paahi ||
english: The disease of doubt does not depart, and they find only pain and more pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree bakhas lehi sabade mel milaahi ||1||
english: O Nanak, if the Gracious Lord forgives, then one is united in Union with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਹ ਫਿਰੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo satigur te muh phire tinaa thaur na thaau ||
english: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru, shall find no place of rest or shelter.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਛੁਟੜਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਦੁਹਚਾਰਣਿ ਬਦਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu chhutaR ghar ghar phirai duhachaaran badanaau ||
english: They wander around from door to door, like a woman forsaken, with a bad character and a bad reputation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਖਸੀਅਹਿ ਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh bakhaseeahi se satigur mel milaau ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are forgiven, and united in Union with the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਸੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jo sevahi sat muraar se bhavajal tar gaiaa ||
