english: Those who serve the True Lord, the Destroyer of ego, cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਛਡਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jo bolahi har har naau tin jam chhad gaiaa ||
english: Those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are passed over by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: se daragah paidhe jaahi jinaa har jap laiaa ||
english: Those who meditate on the Lord, go to His Court in robes of honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har sevahi seee purakh jinaa har tudh maiaa ||
english: They alone serve You, O Lord, whom You bless with Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gun gaavaa piaare nit guramukh bhram bhau gaiaa ||7||
english: I sing continually Your Glorious Praises, O Beloved; as Gurmukh, my doubts and fears have been dispelled. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਥਾਲੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੈ ਵਸਤੂ ਪਈਓ ਹਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: thaalai vich tai vasatoo paeeo har bhojan a(n)mrit saar ||
english: Upon the plate, three things have been placed; this is the sublime, ambrosial food of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jit khaadhai man tripateeai paaeeai mokh duaar ||
english: Eating this, the mind is satisfied, and the Door of Salvation is found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਅਲਭੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਲਭੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ihu bhojan alabh hai sa(n)tahu labhai gur veechaar ||
english: It is so difficult to obtain this food, O Saints; it is obtained only by contemplating the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਮੁਦਾਵਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਢੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਰਖੀਐ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: eh mudaavanee kiu vichahu kadheeai sadaa rakheeai ur dhaar ||
english: Why should we cast this riddle out of our minds? We should keep it ever enshrined in our hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਮੁਦਾਵਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਲਧੀ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: eh mudaavanee satiguroo paaee gurasikhaa ladhee bhaal ||
english: The True Guru has posed this riddle. The Guru's Sikhs have found its solution.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੁ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jis bujhaae s bujhasee har paaiaa guramukh ghaal ||1||
english: O Nanak, he alone understands this, whom the Lord inspires to understand. The Gurmukhs work hard, and find the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo dhur mele se mil rahe satigur siu chit laai ||
english: Those whom the Primal Lord unites, remain in Union with Him; they focus their consciousness on the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇਨੁ ਸੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
transliteration: aap vichhoRen se vichhuRe doojai bhaai khuaai ||
english: Those whom the Lord Himself separates, remain separated; in the love of duality, they are ruined.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak vin karamaa kiaa paaeeai poorab likhiaa kamaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, without good karma, what can anyone obtain? He earns what he is pre-destined to receive. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: bahi sakheeaa jas gaavahi gaavanahaareeaa ||
english: Sitting together, the companions sing the Songs of the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har naam salaahihu nit har kau balihaareeaa ||
english: They praise the Lord's Name continually; they are a sacrifice to the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jinee sun ma(n)niaa har naau tinaa hau vaareeaa ||
english: Those who hear, and believe in the Lord's Name, to them I am a sacrifice.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukheeaa har mel milaavanahaareeaa ||
english: O Lord, let me unite with the Gurmukhs, who are united with You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: hau bal jaavaa din raat gur dekhanahaareeaa ||8||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who, day and night, behold their Guru. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਜਗਿ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai sabh bharamade nit jag totaa saisaar ||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, everyone wanders around the world, losing.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh karam kamaavane haumai a(n)dh gubaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in the pitch black darkness of egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh a(n)mrit peevanaa naanak sabad veechaar ||1||
english: The Gurmukhs drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak, contemplating the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sahaje jaagai sahaje sovai ||
english: He wakes in peace, and he sleeps in peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh anadin usatat hovai ||
english: The Gurmukh praises the Lord night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bharamai sahasaa hovai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh remains deluded by his doubts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar chi(n)taa need na sovai ||
english: He is filled with anxiety, and he cannot even sleep.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਸਵਹਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: giaanee jaagahi savahi subhaai ||
english: The spiritually wise wake and sleep in peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam ratiaa bal jaau ||2||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: se har naam dhiaavahi jo har ratiaa ||
english: They alone meditate on the Lord's Name, who are imbued with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har ik dhiaavahi ik iko har satiaa ||
english: They meditate on the One Lord; the One and Only Lord is True.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਉਤਪਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har iko varatai ik iko utapatiaa ||
english: The One Lord is pervading everywhere; the One Lord created the Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਡਰੁ ਸਟਿ ਘਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jo har naam dhiaavahi tin dar sat ghatiaa ||
english: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name, cast out their fears.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: guramatee devai aap guramukh har japiaa ||9||
english: The Lord Himself blesses them with Guru's Instruction; the Gurmukh meditates on the Lord. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar giaan na aaio jit kichh sojhee paai ||
english: Spiritual wisdom, which would bring understanding, does not enter into his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vin dithaa kiaa saalaaheeai a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamaai ||
english: Without seeing, how can he praise the Lord? The blind act in blindness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sabad pachhaaneeai naam vasai man aai ||1||
english: O Nanak, when one realizes the Word of the Shabad, then the Naam comes to abide in the mind. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ikaa baanee ik gur iko sabad veechaar ||
english: There is One Bani; there is One Guru; there is one Shabad to contemplate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਹਟੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saudaa hat sach ratanee bhare bha(n)daar ||
english: True is the merchandise, and true is the shop; the warehouses are overflowing with jewels.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਜੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te paaeean je devai devanahaar ||
english: By Guru's Grace, they are obtained, if the Great Giver gives them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਖਟਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saudaa laabh sadaa khatiaa naam apaar ||
english: Dealing in this true merchandise, one earns the profit of the incomparable Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਖੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪੀਆਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: vikh vich a(n)mrit pragatiaa karam peeaavanahaar ||
english: In the midst of poison, the Ambrosial Nectar is revealed; by His Mercy, one drinks it in.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sach salaaheeai dha(n)n savaaranahaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, praise the True Lord; blessed is the Creator, the Embellisher. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ॥
transliteration: jinaa a(n)dar kooR varatai sach na bhaavaee ||
english: Those who are permeated by falsehood, do not love the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਕੂੜਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਈ ॥
transliteration: je ko bolai sach kooRaa jal jaavaee ||
english: If someone speaks the Truth, falsehood is burnt away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀ ਰਜੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਜਿਉ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਾਗੁ ਖਾਵਈ ॥
transliteration: kooRiaaree rajai kooR jiu visataa kaag khaavaee ||
english: The false are satisfied by falsehood, like the crows who eat manure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਈ ॥
transliteration: jis har hoi kripaal so naam dhiaavaee ||
english: When the Lord grants His Grace, then one meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵਈ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: har guramukh naam araadh kooR paap lahi jaavaee ||10||
english: As Gurmukh, worship the Lord's Name in adoration; fraud and sin shall disappear. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਖਾ ਚਉਚਕਿਆ ਚਉਵਾਇਆ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣਿ ॥
transliteration: sekhaa chauchakiaa chauvaaiaa ehu man ikat ghar aan ||
english: O Shaykh, you wander in the four directions, blown by the four winds; bring your mind back to the home of the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੜ ਤੇਹੜ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: ehaR tehaR chhad too gur kaa sabad pachhaan ||
english: Renounce your petty arguments, and realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਢਹਿ ਪਉ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur agai dhahi pau sabh kichh jaanai jaan ||
english: Bow in humble respect before the True Guru; He is the Knower who knows everything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਜਲਾਇ ਤੂ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa jalaai too hoi rahu mihamaan ||
english: Burn away your hopes and desires, and live like a guest in this world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਭੀ ਚਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai bhee chalahi taa daragah paavahi maan ||
english: If you walk in harmony with the True Guru's Will, then you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਧਿਗੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਧਿਗੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak j naam na chetanee tin dhig painan dhig khaan ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who do not contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord - cursed are their clothes, and cursed is their food. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har gun tot na aavaee keemat kahan na jaai ||
english: There is no end to the Lord's Glorious Praises; His worth cannot be described.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh har gun ravahi gun mahi rahai samaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord; they are absorbed in His Glorious Virtues. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੋਲੀ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਕਢਿ ਪੈਧੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har cholee deh savaaree kadh paidhee bhagat kar ||
english: The Lord has adorned the coat of the body; He has embroidered it with devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਟੁ ਲਗਾ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har paat lagaa adhikaaee bahu bahu bidh bhaat kar ||
english: The Lord has woven His silk into it, in so many ways and fashions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਣਹਾਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
transliteration: koee boojhai boojhanahaaraa a(n)tar bibek kar ||
english: How rare is that man of understanding, who understands, and deliberates within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: so boojhai ehu bibek jis bujhaae aap har ||
english: He alone understands these deliberations, whom the Lord Himself inspires to understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak kahai vichaaraa guramukh har sat har ||11||
english: Poor servant Nanak speaks: the Gurmukhs know the Lord, the Lord is True. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਥਾਇ ਸਾਖੀ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸਾਝੀ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: parathaai saakhee mahaa purakh bolade saajhee sagal jahaanai ||
english: Great men speak the teachings by relating them to individual situations, but the whole world shares in them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਉ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hoi s bhau kare aapanaa aap pachhaanai ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh knows the Fear of God, and realizes his own self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee jeevat marai taa man hee te man maanai ||
english: If, by Guru's Grace, one remains dead while yet alive, the mind becomes content in itself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਥਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin kau man kee parateet naahee naanak se kiaa kathahi giaanai ||1||
english: Those who have no faith in their own minds, O Nanak - how can they speak of spiritual wisdom? ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ਅੰਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਹੁਤਾ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh chit na laaio a(n)t dukh pahutaa aai ||
english: Those who do not focus their consciousness on the Lord, as Gurmukh, suffer pain and grief in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਅੰਧਿਆਂ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)darahu baaharahu a(n)dhiaa(n) sudh na kaaee paai ||
english: They are blind, inwardly and outwardly, and they do not understand anything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਤੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਖਾਇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit tin kee barakatee sabh jagat khaai jo rate har naai ||
english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, the whole world is fed for the sake of those who are attuned to the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jin gur kai sabad salaahiaa har siu rahe samaai ||
english: Those who praise the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remain blended with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit doojai bhaai barakat na hovaee naa dhan palai paai ||
english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, no one is satisfied, and no one finds true wealth through the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paR thake sa(n)tokh na aaio anadin jalat vihaai ||
english: They have grown weary of reading scriptures, but still, they do not find contentment, and they pass their lives burning, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂਕ ਪੂਕਾਰ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਨਾ ਸੰਸਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kook pookaar na chukaee naa sa(n)saa vichahu jaai ||
english: Their cries and complaints never end, and doubt does not depart from within them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam vihooniaa muhi kaalai uth jaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they rise up and depart with blackened faces. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har sajan mel piaare mil pa(n)th dasaaee ||
english: O Beloved, lead me to meet my True Friend; meeting with Him, I shall ask Him to show me the Path.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਦਸੇ ਮਿਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo har dase mit tis hau bal jaaee ||
english: I am a sacrifice to that Friend, who shows it to me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝੀ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: gun saajhee tin siu karee har naam dhiaaee ||
english: I share His Virtues with Him, and meditate on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har sevee piaaraa nit sev har sukh paaee ||
english: I serve my Beloved Lord forever; serving the Lord, I have found peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: balihaaree satigur tis jin sojhee paaee ||12||
english: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has imparted this understanding to me. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਜੇ ਵੇਦ ਪੜੈ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit mail na chukaee je ved paRai jug chaar ||
english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, your filth shall not be erased, even if you read the Vedas for four ages.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: trai gun maaiaa mool hai vich haumai naam visaar ||
english: The three qualities are the roots of Maya; in egotism, one forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਭੂਲੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit bhoole doojai laage maaiaa kai vaapaar ||
english: The Pandits are deluded, attached to duality, and they deal only in Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਭੁਖਿਆ ਮੁਏ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar trisanaa bhukh hai moorakh bhukhiaa mue gavaar ||
english: They are filled with thirst and hunger; the ignorant fools starve to death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur seviai sukh paaiaa sachai sabad veechaar ||
english: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)darahu trisanaa bhukh gaee sachai naai piaar ||
english: Hunger and thirst have departed from within me; I am in love with the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਜੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate sahaje raje jinaa har rakhiaa ur dhaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam, who keep the Lord clasped tightly to their hearts, are automatically satisfied. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗਾ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh har naam na seviaa dukh lagaa bahutaa aai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh does not serve the Lord's Name, and so he suffers in horrible pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar agiaan a(n)dher hai sudh na kaaee paai ||
english: He is filled with the darkness of ignorance, and he does not understand anything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਨ ਬੀਜਿਓ ਭੁਖਾ ਕਿ ਅਗੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manahath sahaj na beejio bhukhaa k agai khaai ||
english: Because of his stubborn mind, he does not plant the seeds of intuitive peace; what will he eat in the world hereafter, to satisfy his hunger?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan visaariaa doojai lagaa jaai ||
english: He has forgotten the treasure of the Naam; he is caught in the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh milahi vadiaaeeaa je aape mel milaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are honored with glory, when the Lord Himself unites them in His Union. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har rasanaa har jas gaavai kharee suhaavanee ||
english: The tongue which sings the Lord's Praises, is so very beautiful.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jo man tan mukh har bolai saa har bhaavanee ||
english: One who speaks the Lord's Name, with mind, body and mouth, is pleasing to the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਖੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਸਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jo guramukh chakhai saad saa tripataavanee ||
english: That Gurmukh tastes the the sublime taste of the Lord, and is satisfied.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavai piaare nit gun gaai gunee samajhaavanee ||
english: She sings continually the Glorious Praises of her Beloved; singing His Glorious Praises, she is uplifted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਬੁਲਾਵਣੀ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jis hovai aap daiaal saa satiguroo guroo bulaavanee ||13||
english: She is blessed with the Lord's Mercy, and she chants the Words of the Guru, the True Guru. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਹੈ ਅਹਰਣਿ ਜਿਉ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: hasatee sir jiu a(n)kas hai aharan jiu sir dei ||
english: The elephant offers its head to the reins, and the anvil offers itself to the hammer;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਿ ਕੈ ਊਭੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan aagai raakh kai oobhee sev karei ||
english: just so, we offer our minds and bodies to our Guru; we stand before Him, and serve Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: iu guramukh aap nivaareeai sabh raaj srisat kaa lei ||
english: This is how the Gurmukhs eliminate their self-conceit, and come to rule the whole world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh bujheeai jaa aape nadar karei ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jin guramukh naam dhiaaiaa aae te paravaan ||
english: Blessed and approved is the coming into the world, of those Gurmukhs who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kul udhaarahi aapanaa daragah paavahi maan ||2||
english: O Nanak, they save their families, and they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੇਲਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sakheeaa sikh guroo melaaeeaa ||
english: The Guru unites His Sikhs, the Gurmukhs, with the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਇਕਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: ik sevak gur paas ik gur kaarai laaeeaa ||
english: The Guru keeps some of them with Himself, and engages others in His Service.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇਵਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: jinaa gur piaaraa man chit tinaa bhaau guroo devaaeeaa ||
english: Those who cherish their Beloved in their conscious minds, the Guru blesses them with His Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਾ ਇਕੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਤਾ ਪੁਤਾ ਭਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: gur sikhaa iko piaar gur mitaa putaa bhaaeeaa ||
english: The Guru loves all of His Gursikhs equally well, like friends, children and siblings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀਵਾਈਆ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: gur satigur bolahu sabh gur aakh guroo jeevaaeeaa ||14||
english: So chant the Name of the Guru, the True Guru, everyone! Chanting the Name of the Guru, Guru, you shall be rejuvenated. ||14||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਅਵਰੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak naam na chetanee agiaanee a(n)dhule avare karam kamaahi ||
english: O Nanak, the blind, ignorant fools do not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they involve themselves in other activities.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jam dar badhe maareeahi phir visataa maahi pachaahi ||1||
english: They are bound and gagged at the door of the Messenger of Death; they are punished, and in the end, they rot away in manure. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak satigur sevahi aapanaa se jan sache paravaan ||
english: O Nanak, those humble beings are true and approved, who serve their True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har kai naai samaai rahe chookaa aavan jaan ||2||
english: They remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord, and their comings and goings cease. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਅੰਤੇ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dhan sa(n)pai maaiaa sa(n)cheeai a(n)te dukhadaaee ||
english: Gathering the wealth and property of Maya, brings only pain in the end.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲ ਸਵਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ghar ma(n)dar mahal savaareeahi kichh saath na jaaee ||
english: Homes, mansions and adorned palaces will not go with anyone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰ ਰੰਗੀ ਤੁਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)gee ture nit paaleeahi kitai kaam na aaee ||
english: He may breed horses of various colors, but these will not be of any use to him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jan laavahu chit har naam siu a(n)t hoi sakhaaee ||
english: O human, link your consciousness to the Lord's Name, and in the end, it shall be your companion and helper.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa guramukh sukh paaee ||15||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukh is blessed with peace. ||15||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin karamai naau na paaeeai poorai karam paaiaa jaai ||
english: Without the karma of good actions, the Name is not obtained; it can be obtained only by perfect good karma.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak nadar kare je aapanee taa guramat mel milaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, if the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then under Guru's Instruction, one is united in His Union. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਦਝਹਿ ਇਕ ਦਬੀਅਹਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਕੁਤੇ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik dajhahi ik dabeeahi ikanaa kute khaahi ||
english: Some are cremated, and some are buried; some are eaten by dogs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਸਟੀਅਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਸਣਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik paanee vich usateeahi ik bhee phir hasan paahi ||
english: Some are thrown into water, while others are thrown into wells.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak ev na jaapaee kithai jaai samaahi ||2||
english: O Nanak, it is not known, where they go and into what they merge. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਖਾਧਾ ਪੈਧਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: tin kaa khaadhaa paidhaa maaiaa sabh pavit hai jo naam har raate ||
english: The food and clothes, and all the worldly possessions of those who are attuned to the Lord's Name are sacred.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲ ਸਰਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਖ ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਜਾਇ ਵਰਸਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: tin ke ghar ma(n)dar mahal saraaee sabh pavit hahi jinee guramukh sevak sikh abhiaagat jaai varasaate ||
english: All the homes, temples, palaces and way-stations are sacred, where the Gurmukhs, the selfless servants, the Sikhs and the renouncers of the world, go and take their rest.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਤੁਰੇ ਜੀਨ ਖੁਰਗੀਰ ਸਭਿ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਚੜਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: tin ke ture jeen khurageer sabh pavit hahi jinee guramukh sikh saadh sa(n)t chaR jaate ||
english: All the horses, saddles and horse blankets are sacred, upon which the Gurmukhs, the Sikhs, the Holy and the Saints, mount and ride.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਜੋ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: tin ke karam dharam kaaraj sabh pavit hahi jo bolahi har har raam naam har saate ||
english: All the rituals and Dharmic practices and deeds are sacred, for those who utter the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the True Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: jin kai potai pu(n)n hai se guramukh sikh guroo pahi jaate ||16||
english: Those Gurmukhs, those Sikhs, who have purity as their treasure, go to their Guru. ||16||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਘੁਥਿਆ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak naavahu ghuthiaa halat palat sabh jaai ||
english: O Nanak, forsaking the Name, he loses everything, in this world and the next.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਇਆ ਮੁਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam sabh hir laiaa muthee doojai bhaai ||
english: Chanting, deep meditation and austere self-disciplined practices are all wasted; he is deceived by the love of duality.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jam dar badhe maareeahi bahutee milai sajaai ||1||
english: He is bound and gagged at the door of the Messenger of Death. He is beaten, and receives terrible punishment. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦੁਸਟਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa naal vair kamaavade dusataa naal mohu piaar ||
english: They inflict their hatred upon the Saints, and they love the wicked sinners.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: agai pichhai sukh nahee mar ja(n)mahi vaaro vaar ||
english: They find no peace in either this world or the next; they are born only to die, again and again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa kade na bujhaee dubidhaa hoi khuaar ||
english: Their hunger is never satisfied, and they are ruined by duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: muh kaale tinaa ni(n)dakaa tit sachai darabaar ||
english: The faces of these slanderers are blackened in the Court of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam vihooniaa naa uravaar na paar ||2||
english: O Nanak, without the Naam, they find no shelter on either this shore, or the one beyond. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jo har naam dhiaaide se har har naam rate man maahee ||
english: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name, are imbued with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਇਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jinaa man chit ik araadhiaa tinaa ikas bin doojaa ko naahee ||
english: For those who worship the One Lord in their conscious minds, there is no other than the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: seee purakh har sevade jin dhur masatak lekh likhaahee ||
english: They alone serve the Lord, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is written.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਝਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke gun nit gaavade har gun gaai gunee samajhaahee ||
english: They continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and singing the Glories of the Glorious Lord, they are uplifted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: vadiaaee vadee guramukhaa gur poorai har naam samaahee ||17||
english: Great is the greatness of the Gurmukhs, who, through the Perfect Guru, remain absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee sevaa gaakhaRee sir deejai aap gavaai ||
english: It is very difficult to serve the True Guru; offer your head, and eradicate self-conceit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾ ਮਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad marahi phir naa marahi taa sevaa pavai sabh thaai ||
english: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad shall never have to die again; his service is totally approved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paaras parasiai paaras hovai sach rahai liv laai ||
english: Touching the philosopher's stone, one becomes the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold; remain lovingly attached to the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jis poorab hovai likhiaa tis satigur milai prabh aai ||
english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny, comes to meet the True Guru and God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਣਤੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ganatai sevak naa milai jis bakhase so pavai thaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Lord's servant does not meet Him because of his own account; he alone is acceptable, whom the Lord forgives. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੁ ਕੁਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
transliteration: mahal kumahal na jaananee moorakh apanai suaai ||
english: The fools do not know the difference between good and bad; they are deceived by their self-interests.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਤਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad cheenahi taa mahal lahahi jotee jot samaai ||
english: But if they contemplate the Word of the Shabad, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and their light merges in the Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਸਭਾ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sache kaa bhau man vasai taa sabhaa sojhee paai ||
english: The Fear of God is always on their minds, and so they come to understand everything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur apanai ghar varatadaa aape lae milaai ||
english: The True Guru is pervading the homes within; He Himself blends them with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak satigur miliai sabh pooree paee jis no kirapaa kare rajaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, they meet the True Guru, and all their desires are fulfilled, if the Lord grants His Grace and so wills. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dhan bhaag tinaa bhagat janaa jo har naamaa har mukh kahatiaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those devotees, who, with their mouths, utter the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa sa(n)t janaa jo har jas sravanee sunatiaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those Saints, who, with their ears, listen to the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ ਜਨ ਬਣਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa saadh janaa har keeratan gaai gunee jan banatiaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those holy people, who sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and so become virtuous.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa guramukhaa jo gurasikh lai man jinatiaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those Gurmukhs, who live as Gursikhs, and conquer their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਸਿਖ ਪੜਤਿਆ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: sabh doo vade bhaag gurasikhaa ke jo gur charanee sikh paRatiaa ||18||
english: But the greatest good fortune of all, is that of the Guru's Sikhs, who fall at the Guru's feet. ||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: braham bi(n)dai tis daa brahamat rahai ek sabad liv laai ||
english: One who knows God, and who lovingly focuses his attention on the One Word of the Shabad, keeps his spirituality intact.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਨਿਧੀ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਸਿਧੀ ਪਿਛੈ ਲਗੀਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦਾ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: nav nidhee athaarah sidhee pichhai lageeaa phirahi jo har hiradai sadaa vasaai ||
english: The nine treasures and the eighteen spiritual powers of the Siddhas follow him, who keeps the Lord enshrined in his heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬੁਝਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur naau na paaeeai bujhahu kar veechaar ||
english: Without the True Guru, the Name is not found; understand this, and reflect upon it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak poorai bhaag satigur milai sukh paae jug chaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, through perfect good destiny, one meets the True Guru, and finds peace, throughout the four ages. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਗਭਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kiaa gabharoo kiaa biradh hai manamukh trisanaa bhukh na jaai ||
english: Whether he is young or old, the self-willed manmukh cannot escape hunger and thirst.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਏ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sabade ratiaa seetal hoe aap gavaai ||
english: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the Word of the Shabad; they are at peace, having lost their self-conceit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar tripat sa(n)tokhiaa phir bhukh na lagai aai ||
english: They are satisfied and satiated within; they never feel hungry again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak j guramukh karahi so paravaan hai jo naam rahe liv laai ||2||
english: O Nanak, whatever the Gurmukhs do is acceptable; they remain lovingly absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨ ਕੰਉ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖਾ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree ti(n)n ka(n)u jo guramukh sikhaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those Sikhs who are Gurmukhs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਿਖਾ ॥
transliteration: jo har naam dhiaaide tin darasan pikhaa ||
english: I behold the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of those who meditate on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਲਿਖਾ ॥
transliteration: sun keeratan har gun ravaa har jas man likhaa ||
english: Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, I contemplate His virtues; I write His Praises on the fabric of my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕ੍ਰਿਖਾ ॥
transliteration: har naam salaahee ra(n)g siu sabh kilavikh krikhaa ||
english: I praise the Lord's Name with love, and eradicate all my sins.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸੋ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਰੇ ਵਿਖਾ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n suhaavaa so sareer thaan hai jithai meraa gur dhare vikhaa ||19||
english: Blessed, blessed and beauteous is that body and place, where my Guru places His feet. ||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: gur bin giaan na hovaee naa sukh vasai man aai ||
english: Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained, and peace does not come to abide in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam vihoone manamukhee jaasan janam gavaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the self-willed manmukhs depart, after having wasted their lives. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਜਦੇ ਥਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik naavai no sabh khojade thak rahe liv laai ||
english: All the Siddhas, spiritual masters and seekers search for the Name; they have grown weary of concentrating and focusing their attention.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur kinai na paaio guramukh milai milaai ||
english: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Name; the Gurmukhs unite in Union with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਧਿਗੁ ਸਿਧੀ ਧਿਗੁ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai painan khaan sabh baad hai dhig sidhee dhig karamaat ||
english: Without the Name, all food and clothes are worthless; cursed is such spirituality, and cursed are such miraculous powers.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: saa sidh saa karamaat hai achi(n)t kare jis daat ||
english: That alone is spirituality, and that alone is miraculous power, which the Carefree Lord spontaneously bestows.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਏਹਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh har naam man vasai ehaa sidh ehaa karamaat ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Lord's Name abides in the mind of the Gurmukh; this is spirituality, and this is miraculous power. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਢਾਢੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਸਮ ਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਛੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ham dhaadhee har prabh khasam ke nit gaavah har gun chha(n)taa ||
english: I am a minstrel of God, my Lord and Master; every day, I sing the songs of the Lord's Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਹ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣਹ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਵਲਾ ਕੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har keeratan karah har jas sunah tis kavalaa ka(n)taa ||
english: I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and I listen to the Praises of the Lord, the Master of wealth and Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਿਖਾਰੀਆ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har daataa sabh jagat bhikhaareeaa ma(n)gat jan ja(n)taa ||
english: The Lord is the Great Giver; all the world is begging; all beings and creatures are beggars.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har devahu daan daiaal hoi vich paathar krim ja(n)taa ||
english: O Lord, You are kind and compassionate; You give Your gifts to even worms and insects among the rocks.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa guramukh dhanava(n)taa ||20||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, he has become truly wealthy. ||20||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਣਾ ਗੁੜਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: paRanaa guRanaa sa(n)saar kee kaar hai a(n)dar trisanaa vikaar ||
english: Reading and studying are just worldly pursuits, if there is thirst and corruption within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: haumai vich sabh paR thake doojai bhaai khuaar ||
english: Reading in egotism, all have grown weary; through the love of duality, they are ruined.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: so paRiaa so pa(n)dit beenaa gur sabad kare veechaar ||
english: He alone is educated, and he alone is a wise Pandit, who contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਜੈ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar khojai tat lahai paae mokh duaar ||
english: He searches within himself, and finds the true essence; he finds the Door of Salvation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan har paaiaa sahaj kare veechaar ||
english: He finds the Lord, the treasure of excellence, and peacefully contemplates Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dha(n)n vaapaaree naanakaa jis guramukh naam adhaar ||1||
english: Blessed is the trader, O Nanak, who, as Gurmukh, takes the Name as his only Support. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਿਝਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vin man maare koi na sijhaee vekhahu ko liv laai ||
english: Without conquering his mind, no one can be successful. See this, and concentrate on it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਤੀਰਥੀ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhekhadhaaree teerathee bhav thake naa ehu man maariaa jaai ||
english: The wandering holy men are tired of of making pilgrimages to sacred shrines; they have not been able to conquer their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ehu man jeevat marai sach rahai liv laai ||
english: The Gurmukh has conquered his mind, and he remains lovingly absorbed in the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਇਉ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak is man kee mal iu utarai haumai sabad jalaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, this is how the filth of the mind is removed; the Word of the Shabad burns away the ego. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਹੁ ਇਕ ਕਿਨਕਾ ॥
transliteration: har har sa(n)t milahu mere bhaaee har naam driRaavahu ik kinakaa ||
english: O Saints of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny, please meet with me, and implant the Name of the One Lord within me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਨਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਪਹਿਰਹੁ ਖਿਮ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: har har seegaar banaavahu har jan har kaapaR pahirahu khim kaa ||
english: O humble servants of the Lord, adorn me with the decorations of the Lord, Har, Har; let me wear the robes of the Lord's forgiveness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਮ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: aisaa seegaar mere prabh bhaavai har laagai piaaraa prim kaa ||
english: Such decorations are pleasing to my God; such love is dear to the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਇਕ ਪਲਕਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam bolahu din raatee sabh kilabikh kaatai ik palakaa ||
english: I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night; in an instant, all sins are eradicated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਿਣਕਾ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: har har daiaal hovai jis upar so guramukh har jap jinakaa ||21||
english: That Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord becomes merciful, chants the Lord's Name, and wins the game of life. ||21||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਕਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਸਿਆਹੁ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kee is man kau mal laagee kaalaa hoaa siaahu ||
english: The filth of countless incarnations sticks to this mind; it has become pitch black.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖੰਨਲੀ ਧੋਤੀ ਉਜਲੀ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣਿ ਪਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)nalee dhotee ujalee na hovaee je sau dhovan paahu ||
english: The oily rag cannot be cleaned by merely washing it, even if it is washed a hundred times.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਤਿ ਬਦਲਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee jeevat marai ulatee hovai mat badalaahu ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one remains dead while yet alive; his intellect is transformed, and he becomes detached from the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak mail na lagaee naa phir jonee paahu ||1||
english: O Nanak, no filth sticks to him, and he does not fall into the womb again. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲੀ ਕਾਂਢੀ ਇਕ ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: chahu jugee kal kaalee kaa(n)dhee ik utam padavee is jug maahi ||
english: Kali Yuga is called the Dark Age, but the most sublime state is attained in this age.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har keerat phal paaeeai jin kau har likh paahi ||
english: The Gurmukh obtains the fruit, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; this is his destiny, ordained by the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak gur parasaadee anadin bhagat har ucharahi har bhagatee maahi samaahi ||2||
english: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, he worships the Lord night and day; he chants the Lord's Name, and remains absorbed in the Lord's devotional worship. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਲੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: har har mel saadh jan sa(n)gat mukh bolee har har bhalee baan ||
english: O Lord, unite me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, so that with my mouth, I may speak the sublime Word of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਚਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavaa har nit chavaa guramatee har ra(n)g sadaa maan ||
english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and constantly chant the Lord's Name; through the Guru's Teachings, I enjoy the Lord's Love constantly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਉਖਧ ਖਾਧਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਤੇ ਦੁਖਾ ਘਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: har jap jap aukhadh khaadhiaa sabh rog gavaate dukhaa ghaan ||
english: I take the medicine of meditation on the Lord's Name, which has cured all diseases and multitudes of sufferings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਹੀ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: jinaa saas giraas na visarai se har jan poore sahee jaan ||
english: Those who do not forget the Lord, while breathing or eating - know them to be the perfect servants of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਚੂਕੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜਗਤ ਕਾਣਿ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: jo guramukh har aaraadhade tin chookee jam kee jagat kaan ||22||
english: Those Gurmukhs who worship the Lord in adoration end their subservience to the Messenger of Death, and to the world. ||22||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਜਨ ਉਥਾਰੈ ਦਬਿਓਹੁ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਗਈ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: re jan uthaarai dabiohu sutiaa gaee vihaai ||
english: O man, you have been tormented by a nightmare, and you have passed your life in sleep.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਗਿਓ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur kaa sabad sun na jaagio a(n)tar na upajio chaau ||
english: You did not wake to hear the Word of the True Guru's Shabad; you have no inspiration within yourself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜਲਉ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sareer jalau gun baaharaa jo gur kaar na kamaai ||
english: That body burns, which has no virtue, and which does not serve the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲੰਦਾ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jagat jala(n)daa dith mai haumai doojai bhaai ||
english: I have seen that the world is burning, in egotism and the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak gur saranaaee ubare sach man sabad dhiaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who seek the Guru's Sanctuary are saved; within their minds, they meditate on the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabad rate haumai gaee sobhaava(n)tee naar ||
english: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, the soul-bride is rid of egotism, and she is glorified.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਚਲੈ ਤਾ ਬਨਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pir kai bhaanai sadaa chalai taa baniaa seegaar ||
english: If she walks steadily in the way of His Will, then she is adorned with decorations.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sej suhaavee sadaa pir raavai har var paaiaa naar ||
english: Her couch becomes beautiful, and she constantly enjoys her Husband Lord; she obtains the Lord as her Husband.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naa har marai na kade dukh laagai sadaa suhaagan naar ||
english: The Lord does not die, and she never suffers pain; she is a happy soul-bride forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak har prabh mel laee gur kai het piaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Lord God unites her with Himself; she enshrines love and affection for the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jinaa gur gopiaa aapanaa te nar buriaaree ||
english: Those who conceal and deny their Guru, are the most evil people.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਾਪਿਸਟ ਹਤਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu tin kaa darasan naa karahu paapisat hatiaaree ||
english: O Dear Lord, let me not even see them; they are the worst sinners and murderers.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਮਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਧਰਕਟ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ohi ghar ghar phirahi kusudh man jiu dharakat naaree ||
english: They wander from house to house, with impure minds, like wicked, forsaken women.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee sa(n)gat mile guramukh savaaree ||
english: But by great good fortune, they may meet the Company of the Holy; as Gurmukhs, they are reformed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: har melahu satigur daiaa kar gur kau balihaaree ||23||
english: O Lord, please be kind and let me meet the True Guru; I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||23||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te sukh oopajai phir dukh na lagai aai ||
english: Serving the Guru, peace is produced, and then, one does not suffer in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਕਾਲੈ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa mit gaiaa kaalai kaa kichh na basaai ||
english: The cycle of birth and death is brought to an end, and death has no power over at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har setee man rav rahiaa sache rahiaa samaai ||
english: His mind is imbued with the Lord, and he remains merged in the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਚਲਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak hau balihaaree ti(n)n kau jo chalan satigur bhaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who walk in the Way of the True Guru's Will. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰੈ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai sudh na hovaee je anek karai seegaar ||
english: Without the Word of the Shabad, purity is not obtained, even though the soul-bride may adorn herself with all sorts of decorations.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pir kee saar na jaanaee doojai bhaai piaar ||
english: She does not know the value of her Husband Lord; she is attached to the love of duality.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਸਾ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਨਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saa kusudh saa kulakhanee naanak naaree vich kunaar ||2||
english: She is impure, and ill-mannered, O Nanak; among women, she is the most evil woman. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਬੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har har apanee daiaa kar har bolee bainee ||
english: Be kind to me, Lord, that I might chant the Word of Your Bani.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har naam dhiaaee har ucharaa har laahaa lainee ||
english: May I meditate on the Lord's Name, chant the Lord's Name, and obtain the profit of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਪਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jo japade har har dinas raat tin hau kurabainee ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਾ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jinaa satigur meraa piaaraa araadhiaa tin jan dekhaa nainee ||
english: May I behold with my eyes those who worship and adore my Beloved True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਅਪਣੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਸੈਣੀ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: hau vaariaa apane guroo kau jin meraa har sajan meliaa sainee ||24||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has united me with my Lord, my friend, my very best friend. ||24||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: har daasan siu preet hai har daasan ko mit ||
english: The Lord loves His slaves; the Lord is the friend of His slaves.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਜੰਤੀ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਜੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: har daasan kai vas hai jiu ja(n)tee kai vas ja(n)t ||
english: The Lord is under the control of His slaves, like the musical instrument under the control of the musician.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: har ke daas har dhiaaide kar preetam siu nehu ||
english: The Lord's slaves meditate on the Lord; they love their Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਸੈ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa kar kai sunahu prabh sabh jag mahi varasai mehu ||
english: Please, hear me, O God - let Your Grace rain over the whole world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jo har daasan kee usatat hai saa har kee vadiaaee ||
english: The praise of the Lord's slaves is the Glory of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਭਾਵਦੀ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har aapanee vadiaaee bhaavadee jan kaa jaikaar karaaee ||
english: The Lord loves His Own Glory, and so His humble servant is celebrated and hailed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਇਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: so har jan naam dhiaaidaa har har jan ik samaan ||
english: That humble servant of the Lord meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Lord, and the Lord's humble servant, are one and the same.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai har paij rakhahu bhagavaan ||1||
english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; O Lord, O God, please, preserve his honor. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naanak preet laaee tin saachai tis bin rahan na jaaee ||
english: Nanak loves the True Lord; without Him, he cannot even survive.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta pooraa paaeeai har ras rasan rasaaee ||2||
english: Meeting the True Guru, one finds the Perfect Lord, and the tongue enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੀ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: rain dinas parabhaat toohai hee gaavanaa ||
english: Night and day, morning and night, I sing to You, Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਰਬਤ ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਧਿਆਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sarabat naau teraa dhiaavanaa ||
english: All beings and creatures meditate on Your Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਖਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: too daataa daataar teraa ditaa khaavanaa ||
english: You are the Giver, the Great Giver; we eat whatever You give us.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kai sa(n)g paap gavaavanaa ||
english: In the congregation of the devotees, sins are eradicated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak sad balihaarai bal bal jaavanaa ||25||
english: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, O Lord. ||25||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਮਧਿਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar agiaan bhaee mat madhim satigur kee parateet naahee ||
english: He has spiritual ignorance within, and his intellect is dull and dim; he does not place his faith in the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਪਟੋ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਪਟੇ ਖਪਹਿ ਖਪਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar kapat sabh kapato kar jaanai kapate khapahi khapaahee ||
english: He has deceit within himself, and so he sees deception in all others; through his deceptions, he is totally ruined.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur kaa bhaanaa chit na aavai aapanai suaai phiraahee ||
english: The True Guru's Will does not enter into his consciousness, and so he wanders around, pursuing his own interests.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kirapaa kare je aapanee taa naanak sabad samaahee ||1||
english: If He grants His Grace, then Nanak is absorbed into the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh maaiaa mohi viaape doojai bhaai manooaa thir naahi ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya; in the love of duality, their minds are unsteady.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਖਪਹਿ ਖਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: anadin jalat rahahi din raatee haumai khapahi khapaahi ||
english: Night and day, they are burning; day and night, they are totally ruined by their egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar lobh mahaa gubaaraa tin kai nikat na koee jaahi ||
english: Within them, is the total pitch darkness of greed, and no one even approaches them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਦੁਖੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: oi aap dukhee sukh kabahoo na paavahi janam marahi mar jaahi ||
english: They themselves are miserable, and they never find peace; they are born, only to die, and die again.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak bakhas lae prabh saachaa j gur charanee chit laahi ||2||
english: O Nanak, the True Lord God forgives those, who focus their consciousness on the Guru's feet. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t bhagat paravaan jo prabh bhaaiaa ||
english: That Saint, that devotee, is acceptable, who is loved by God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਬਿਚਖਣ ਜੰਤ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: seee bichakhan ja(n)t jinee har dhiaaiaa ||
english: Those beings are wise, who meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan bhojan khaaiaa ||
english: They eat the food, the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee dhoor masatak laaiaa ||
english: They apply the dust of the feet of the Saints to their foreheads.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਹਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: naanak bhae puneet har teerath naaiaa ||26||
english: O Nanak, they are purified, bathing in the sacred shrine of the Lord. ||26||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh a(n)tar saa(n)t hai man tan naam samaai ||
english: Within the Gurmukh is peace and tranquility; his mind and body are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naamo chitavai naam paRai naam rahai liv laai ||
english: He contemplates the Naam, he studies the Naam, and he remains lovingly absorbed in the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਈ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naam padaarath paaiaa chi(n)taa gaee bilaai ||
english: He obtains the treasure of the Naam, and his anxiety is dispelled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai naam oopajai tisanaa bhukh sabh jaai ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, the Naam wells up, and his thirst and hunger are completely relieved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naame ratiaa naamo palai paai ||1||
english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, he gathers in the Naam. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਜਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh j maariaa bhram bhramiaa ghar chhod gaiaa ||
english: One who is cursed by the True Guru, abandons his home, and wanders around aimlessly.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਵਜੈ ਫਕੜੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਆਗੈ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: os pichhai vajai phakaRee muhu kaalaa aagai bhaiaa ||
english: He is jeered at, and his face is blackened in the world hereafter.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਅਰਲੁ ਬਰਲੁ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਨਿਤ ਝਗੂ ਸੁਟਦਾ ਮੁਆ ॥
transliteration: os aral baral muhahu nikalai nit jhagoo sutadaa muaa ||
english: He babbles incoherently, and foaming at the mouth, he dies.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਦੈ ਕੀਤੈ ਜਾਂ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਏਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kiaa hovai kisai hee dai keetai jaa(n) dhur kirat os daa eho jehaa paiaa ||
english: What can anyone do? Such is his destiny, according to his past deeds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jithai ohu jaai tithai ohu jhoothaa kooR bole kisai na bhaavai ||
english: Wherever he goes, he is a liar, and by telling lies, he not liked by anyone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵੇਖਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਜੈਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: vekhahu bhaaee vadiaaee har sa(n)tahu suaamee apune kee jaisaa koee karai taisaa koee paavai ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, behold this, the glorious greatness of our Lord and Master, O Saints; as one behaves, so does he receive.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ehu braham beechaar hovai dar saachai ago de jan naanak aakh sunaavai ||2||
english: This shall be God's determination in His True Court; servant Nanak predicts and proclaims this. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਬਧਾ ਥੇਹੁ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤੇ ॥
transliteration: gur sachai badhaa thehu rakhavaale gur dite ||
english: The True Guru has established the village; the Guru has appointed its guards and protectors.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨ ਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: pooran hoee aas gur charanee man rate ||
english: My hopes are fulfilled, and my mind is imbued with the love of the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਹਤੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kripaal bea(n)t avagun sabh hate ||
english: The Guru is infinitely merciful; He has erased all my sins.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਪਣੇ ਕਰਿ ਲਿਤੇ ॥
transliteration: gur apanee kirapaa dhaar apane kar lite ||
english: The Guru has showered me with His Mercy, and He has made me His own.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਇਤੇ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak sad balihaar jis gur ke gun ite ||27||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has countless virtues. ||27||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ਲੇਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਪਾਂਡੇ ॥
transliteration: taa kee rajaai lekhiaa paai ab kiaa keejai paa(n)de ||
english: By His Command, we receive our pre-ordained rewards; so what can we do now, O Pandit?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਾਸਲੁ ਤਦੇ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੜਿਆ ਹੰਢਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਕਮਾਂਦੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hukam hoaa haasal tade hoi nibaRiaa ha(n)dhahi jee kamaa(n)de ||1||
english: When His Command is received, then it is decided; all beings move and act accordingly. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਕਿ ਨਥ ਖਸਮ ਹਥ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਧਕੇ ਦੇ ॥
transliteration: nak nath khasam hath kirat dhake de ||
english: The string through the nose is in the hands of the Lord Master; one's own actions drive him on.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਦਾਣੇ ਤਹਾਂ ਖਾਣੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jahaa daane tahaa(n) khaane naanakaa sach he ||2||
english: Wherever his food is, there he eats it; O Nanak, this is the Truth. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਆਪਿ ਥਾਟਿ ਬਹਾਲੀਓਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sabhe galaa aap thaat bahaaleeon ||
english: The Lord Himself puts everything in its proper place.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਘਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aape rachan rachaai aape hee ghaalion ||
english: He Himself created the creation, and He Himself destroys it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aape ja(n)t upaai aap pratipaalion ||
english: He Himself fashions His creatures, and He Himself nourishes them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥
transliteration: daas rakhe ka(n)th laai nadar nihaalion ||
english: He hugs His slaves close in His embrace, and blesses them with His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: naanak bhagataa sadaa ana(n)d bhaau doojaa jaalion ||28||
english: O Nanak, His devotees are forever in bliss; they have burnt away the love of duality. ||28||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: e man har jee dhiaai too ik man ik chit bhaai ||
english: O mind, meditate on the Dear Lord, with single-minded conscious concentration.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har keeaa sadaa sadaa vadiaaeeaa dei na pachhotaai ||
english: The glorious greatness of the Lord shall last forever and ever; He never regrets what He gives.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hau har kai sad balihaaranai jit seviai sukh paai ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to the Lord; serving Him, peace is obtained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh mil rahai haumai sabad jalaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains merged with the Lord; he burns away his ego through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aape sevaa laaian aape bakhas karei ||
english: He Himself enjoins us to serve Him, and He Himself blesses us with forgiveness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮਾ ਪਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa kaa maa piu aap hai aape saar karei ||
english: He Himself is the father and mother of all; He Himself cares for us.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaain tin nij ghar vaas hai jug jug sobhaa hoi ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abide in the home of their inner being; they are honored throughout the ages. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: too karan kaaran samarath hahi karate mai tujh bin avar na koee ||
english: You are the Creator, all-powerful, able to do anything. Without You, there is no other at all.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਿਰਜੀਆ ਆਪੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape sisat sirajeeaa aape phun goee ||
english: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself shall destroy it in the end.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh iko sabad varatadaa jo kare s hoee ||
english: The Word of Your Shabad alone is pervading everywhere; whatever You do, comes to pass.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: vadiaaee guramukh dei prabh har paavai soee ||
english: God blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness, and then, he finds the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਆਖਹੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨੯॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
transliteration: guramukh naanak aaraadhiaa sabh aakhahu dha(n)n dha(n)n dha(n)n gur soee ||29||1|| sudh
english: As Gurmukh, Nanak worships and adores the Lord; let everyone proclaim, "Blessed, blessed, blessed is He, the Guru!" ||29||1||Sudh||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag sorath baanee bhagat kabeer jee kee ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee, First House:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੁਤ ਪੂਜਿ ਪੂਜਿ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੂਏ ਤੁਰਕ ਮੂਏ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: but pooj pooj hi(n)doo mooe turak mooe sir naaee ||
english: Worshipping their idols, the Hindus die; the Muslims die bowing their heads.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਲੇ ਜਾਰੇ ਓਇ ਲੇ ਗਾਡੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਦੁਹੂ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: oi le jaare oi le gaade teree gat duhoo na paaee ||1||
english: The Hindus cremate their dead, while the Muslims bury theirs; neither finds Your true state, Lord. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਅੰਧ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man re sa(n)saar a(n)dh gaheraa ||
english: O mind, the world is a deep, dark pit.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਜਮ ਜੇਵਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chahu dis pasario hai jam jevaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: On all four sides, Death has spread his net. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬਿਤ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਕਬਿਤਾ ਮੂਏ ਕਪੜ ਕੇਦਾਰੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kabit paRe paR kabitaa mooe kapaR kedaarai jaaee ||
