english: Reciting their poems, the poets die; the mystical ascetics die while journeying to Kaydaar Naat'h.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਟਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਮੂਏ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਇਨਹਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jataa dhaar dhaar jogee mooe teree gat inahi na paaee ||2||
english: The Yogis die, with their matted hair, but even they do not find Your state, Lord. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਰਬੁ ਸੰਚਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਮੂਏ ਗਡਿ ਲੇ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: darab sa(n)ch sa(n)ch raaje mooe gad le ka(n)chan bhaaree ||
english: The kings die, gathering and hoarding their money, burying great quantities of gold.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੂਏ ਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bed paRe paR pa(n)dit mooe roop dekh dekh naaree ||3||
english: The Pandits die, reading and reciting the Vedas; women die, gazing at their own beauty. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਗੂਤੇ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਿਰਖਿ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam bin sabhai bigoote dekhahu nirakh sareeraa ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, all come to ruin; behold, and know this, O body.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਹਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: har ke naam bin kin gat paaee kahi upades kabeeraa ||4||1||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, who can find salvation? Kabeer speaks the Teachings. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਜਰੀਐ ਤਬ ਹੋਇ ਭਸਮ ਤਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਕਿਰਮ ਦਲ ਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jab jareeai tab hoi bhasam tan rahai kiram dal khaaee ||
english: When the body is burnt, it turns to ashes; if it is not cremated, then it is eaten by armies of worms.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਨੀਰੁ ਪਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਇਆ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਇਹੈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaachee gaagar neer parat hai iaa tan kee ihai badaaee ||1||
english: The unbaked clay pitcher dissolves, when water is poured into it; this is also the nature of the body. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਭਈਆ ਫਿਰਤੌ ਫੂਲਿਆ ਫੂਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kaahe bhaeeaa phiratau phooliaa phooliaa ||
english: Why, O Siblings of Destiny, do you strut around, all puffed up with pride?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਦਸ ਮਾਸ ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਰਹਤਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਭੂਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab das maas uradh mukh rahataa so din kaise bhooliaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Have you forgotten those days, when you were hanging, face down, for ten months? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਧੁ ਮਾਖੀ ਤਿਉ ਸਠੋਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜੋਰਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jiu madh maakhee tiu sathor ras jor jor dhan keeaa ||
english: Like the bee which collects honey, the fool eagerly gathers and collects wealth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਲੇਹੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਕਰੀਐ ਭੂਤੁ ਰਹਨ ਕਿਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maratee baar lehu lehu kareeai bhoot rahan kiu deeaa ||2||
english: At the time of death, they shout, "Take him away, take him away! Why leave a ghost lying around?" ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਲਉ ਬਰੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਈ ਆਗੈ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: dehuree lau baree naar sa(n)g bhaee aagai sajan suhelaa ||
english: His wife accompanies him to the threshold, and his friends and companions beyond.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਘਟ ਲਉ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਭਇਓ ਆਗੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਅਕੇਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maraghat lau sabh log kuta(n)b bhaio aagai ha(n)s akelaa ||3||
english: All the people and relatives go as far as the cremation grounds, and then, the soul-swan goes on alone. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਪਰੇ ਕਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਸ ਕੂਆ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re praanee pare kaal gras kooaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O mortal being: you have been seized by Death, and you have fallen into the deep, dark pit.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਇਆ ਜਿਉ ਨਲਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੂਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: jhoothee maaiaa aap ba(n)dhaaiaa jiu nalanee bhram sooaa ||4||2||
english: You have entangled yourself in the false wealth of Maya, like the parrot caught in the trap. ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਭੈ ਮਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਕਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan sabhai mat sun kai karee karam kee aasaa ||
english: Listening to all the teachings of the Vedas and the Puraanas, I wanted to perform the religious rituals.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਸਭ ਲੋਗ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਉਠਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੈ ਚਲੇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaal grasat sabh log siaane uth pa(n)dit pai chale niraasaa ||1||
english: But seeing all the wise men caught by Death, I arose and left the Pandits; now I am free of this desire. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਰਿਓ ਨ ਏਕੈ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: man re sario na ekai kaajaa ||
english: O mind, you have not completed the only task you were given;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਜਿਓ ਨ ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhajio na raghupat raajaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: you have not meditated on the Lord, your King. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਨ ਖੰਡ ਜਾਇ ਜੋਗੁ ਤਪੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਚੁਨਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ban kha(n)d jaai jog tap keeno ka(n)d mool chun khaaiaa ||
english: Going to the forests, they practice Yoga and deep, austere meditation; they live on roots and the fruits they gather.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਦੀ ਬੇਦੀ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੋਨੀ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਪਟੈ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naadee bedee sabadee monee jam ke patai likhaaiaa ||2||
english: The musicians, the Vedic scholars, the chanters of one word and the men of silence, all are listed on the Register of Death. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਰਦੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਆਈ ਕਾਛਿ ਕੂਛਿ ਤਨੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagat naaradee ridai na aaee kaachh koochh tan deenaa ||
english: Loving devotional worship does not enter into your heart; pampering and adorning your body, you must still give it up.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਡਿੰਭ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਉਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raag raaganee di(n)bh hoi baithaa un har pahi kiaa leenaa ||3||
english: You sit and play music, but you are still a hypocrite; what do you expect to receive from the Lord? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਰਿਓ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਭੈ ਜਗ ਊਪਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: pario kaal sabhai jag oopar maahi likhe bhram giaanee ||
english: Death has fallen on the whole world; the doubting religious scholars are also listed on the Register of Death.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਖਾਲਸੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer jan bhae khaalase prem bhagat jih jaanee ||4||3||
english: Says Kabeer, those humble people become pure - they become Khalsa - who know the Lord's loving devotional worship. ||4||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: ghar 2 ||
english: Second House||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਦੁਇ ਲੋਚਨ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: dui dui lochan pekhaa ||
english: With both of my eyes, I look around;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: hau har bin aur na dekhaa ||
english: I don't see anything except the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਰਹੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: nain rahe ra(n)g laaee ||
english: My eyes gaze lovingly upon Him,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਬੇ ਗਲ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ab be gal kahan na jaaee ||1||
english: and now, I cannot speak of anything else. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: hamaraa bharam gaiaa bhau bhaagaa ||
english: My doubts were removed, and my fear ran away,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab raam naam chit laagaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: when my consciousness became attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਡੰਕ ਬਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: baajeegar da(n)k bajaaee ||
english: When the magician beats his tambourine,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਖਲਕ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh khalak tamaase aaee ||
english: everyone comes to see the show.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਗੁ ਸਕੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: baajeegar svaa(n)g sakelaa ||
english: When the magician winds up his show,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਵੈ ਅਕੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: apane ra(n)g ravai akelaa ||2||
english: then he enjoys its play all alone. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਕਹਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kathanee kahi bharam na jaaee ||
english: By preaching sermons, one's doubt is not dispelled.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਰਹੀ ਲੁਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh kath kath rahee lukaaee ||
english: Everyone is tired of preaching and teaching.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau guramukh aap bujhaaee ||
english: The Lord causes the Gurmukh to understand;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa ke hiradai rahiaa samaaee ||3||
english: his heart remains permeated with the Lord. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: gur ki(n)chat kirapaa keenee ||
english: When the Guru grants even a bit of His Grace,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh tan man deh har leenee ||
english: one's body, mind and entire being are absorbed into the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer ra(n)g raataa ||
english: Says Kabeer, I am imbued with the Lord's Love;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: milio jagajeevan daataa ||4||4||
english: I have met with the Life of the world, the Great Giver. ||4||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਗਮ ਦੂਧ ਕੇ ਠਾਟਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa ke nigam doodh ke thaataa ||
english: Let the sacred scriptures be your milk and cream,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਬਿਲੋਵਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਟਾ ॥
transliteration: samu(n)d bilovan kau maataa ||
english: and the ocean of the mind the churning vat.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਹੁ ਬਿਲੋਵਨਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: taa kee hohu bilovanahaaree ||
english: Be the butter-churner of the Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਮੇਟੈ ਗੋ ਛਾਛਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kiu metai go chhaachh tuhaaree ||1||
english: and your buttermilk shall not be wasted. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਸਿ ਭਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: cheree too raam na karas bhataaraa ||
english: O soul-bride slave, why don't you take the Lord as your Husband?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan praan adhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Life of the world, the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗਲਹਿ ਤਉਕੁ ਪਗ ਬੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tere galahi tauk pag beree ||
english: The chain is around your neck, and the cuffs are on your feet.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਘਰ ਘਰ ਰਮਈਐ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: too ghar ghar ramaeeai pheree ||
english: The Lord has sent you wandering around from house to house.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਜਹੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਚੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: too ajahu na chetas cheree ||
english: And still, you do not meditate on the Lord, O soul-bride, slave.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਮਿ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਹੈ ਹੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too jam bapuree hai heree ||2||
english: Death is watching you, O wretched woman. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh karan karaavanahaaree ||
english: The Lord God is the Cause of causes.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਚੇਰੀ ਹਾਥ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kiaa cheree haath bichaaree ||
english: What is in the hands of the poor soul-bride, the slave?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: soee soee jaagee ||
english: She awakens from her slumber,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jit laaee tit laagee ||3||
english: and she becomes attached to whatever the Lord attaches her. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੇਰੀ ਤੈ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: cheree tai sumat kahaa(n) te paaee ||
english: O soul-bride, slave, where did you obtain that wisdom,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਲੀਕ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa te bhram kee leek mitaaee ||
english: by which you erased your inscription of doubt?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਕਬੀਰੈ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: s ras kabeerai jaaniaa ||
english: Kabeer has tasted that subtle essence;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੋ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: mero gur prasaad man maaniaa ||4||5||
english: by Guru's Grace, his mind is reconciled with the Lord. ||4||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਜੀਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jih baajh na jeeaa jaaee ||
english: Without Him, we cannot even live;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਘਾਲ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jau milai ta ghaal aghaaee ||
english: when we meet Him, then our task is completed.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਭਲੋ ਕਹਾਂਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sad jeevan bhalo kahaa(n)hee ||
english: People say it is good to live forever,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੂਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mooe bin jeevan naahee ||1||
english: but without dying, there is no life. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ab kiaa katheeai giaan beechaaraa ||
english: So now, what sort wisdom should I contemplate and preach?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਗਤ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nij nirakhat gat biuhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As I watch, worldly things dissipate. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਸਿ ਕੁੰਕਮ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਗਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ghas ku(n)kam cha(n)dan gaariaa ||
english: Saffron is ground up, and mixed with sandalwood;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bin nainahu jagat nihaariaa ||
english: without eyes, the world is seen.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੂਤਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poot pitaa ik jaaiaa ||
english: The son has given birth to his father;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਠਾਹਰ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਸਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin thaahar nagar basaaiaa ||2||
english: without a place, the city has been established. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਕ ਜਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaachak jan daataa paaiaa ||
english: The humble beggar has found the Great Giver,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦੀਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: so deeaa na jaaee khaaiaa ||
english: but he is unable to eat what he has been given.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿਆ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਮੂਕਾ ॥
transliteration: chhodiaa jaai na mookaa ||
english: He cannot leave it alone, but it is never exhausted.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਉਰਨ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਨਾ ਚੂਕਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: auran pahi jaanaa chookaa ||3||
english: He shall not go to beg from others any longer. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੀਵਨ ਮਰਨਾ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jo jeevan maranaa jaanai ||
english: Those select few, who know how to die while yet alive,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੰਚ ਸੈਲ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: so pa(n)ch sail sukh maanai ||
english: Enjoy great peace.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kabeerai so dhan paaiaa ||
english: Kabeer has found that wealth;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਤ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: har bhetat aap mitaaiaa ||4||6||
english: meeting with the Lord, he has erased his self-conceit. ||4||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਪੜੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਨੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kiaa paReeai kiaa guneeai ||
english: What use is it to read, and what use is it to study?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ਸੁਨੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kiaa bed puraanaa(n) suneeai ||
english: What use is it to listen to the Vedas and the Puraanas?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੜੇ ਸੁਨੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: paRe sune kiaa hoee ||
english: What use is reading and listening,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸਹਜ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jau sahaj na milio soee ||1||
english: if celestial peace is not attained? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਸਿ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam na japas gavaaraa ||
english: The fool does not chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਸੋਚਹਿ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kiaa sochahi baara(n) baaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: So what does he think of, over and over again? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਿਆਰੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਚਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhiaare deepak chaheeai ||
english: In the darkness, we need a lamp

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: ik basat agochar laheeai ||
english: to find the incomprehensible thing.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: basat agochar paaee ||
english: I have found this incomprehensible thing;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghat deepak rahiaa samaaee ||2||
english: my mind is illuminated and enlightened. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer ab jaaniaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, now I know Him;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jab jaaniaa tau man maaniaa ||
english: since I know Him, my mind is pleased and appeased.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਲੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਤੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: man maane log na pateejai ||
english: My mind is pleased and appeased, and yet, people do not believe it.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਤਉ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੭॥
transliteration: na pateejai tau kiaa keejai ||3||7||
english: They do not believe it, so what can I do? ||3||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਮੁਖ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: hridai kapat mukh giaanee ||
english: In his heart there is deception, and yet in his mouth are words of wisdom.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੇ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਸਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jhoothe kahaa bilovas paanee ||1||
english: You are false - why are you churning water? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਮਾਂਜਸਿ ਕਉਨ ਗੁਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: kaa(n)iaa maa(n)jas kaun gunaa(n) ||
english: Why do you bother to wash your body?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਮਲਨਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jau ghat bheetar hai malanaa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your heart is still full of filth. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਉਕੀ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨੑਾਈ ॥
transliteration: laukee athasath teerath nhaaee ||
english: The gourd may be washed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਉਰਾਪਨੁ ਤਊ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kauraapan taoo na jaaee ||2||
english: but even then, its bitterness is not removed. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer beechaaree ||
english: Says Kabeer after deep contemplation,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਾਰਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੮॥
transliteration: bhav saagar taar muraaree ||3||8||
english: please help me cross over the terrifying world-ocean, O Lord, O Destroyer of ego. ||3||8||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ॥
transliteration: sorath ||
english: Sorat'h:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਕਰਿ ਪਰ ਧਨੁ ਲਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bahu parapa(n)ch kar par dhan liaavai ||
english: Practicing great hypocrisy, he acquires the wealth of others.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਪਹਿ ਆਨਿ ਲੁਟਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sut daaraa pahi aan lutaavai ||1||
english: Returning home, he squanders it on his wife and children. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਕਪਟੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: man mere bhoole kapat na keejai ||
english: O my mind, do not practice deception, even inadvertently.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਹਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t niberaa tere jee pahi leejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the end, your own soul shall have to answer for its account. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ਜਰਾ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: chhin chhin tan chheejai jaraa janaavai ||
english: Moment by moment, the body is wearing away, and old age is asserting itself.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਤੇਰੀ ਓਕ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਨੀਓ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tab teree ok koee paaneeo na paavai ||2||
english: And then, when you are old, no one shall pour water into your cup. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਹੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer koee nahee teraa ||
english: Says Kabeer, no one belongs to you.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੩॥੯॥
transliteration: hiradai raam kee na japahi saveraa ||3||9||
english: Why not chant the Lord's Name in your heart, when you are still young? ||3||9||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਨ ਪਵਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu man pavanai sukh baniaa ||
english: O Saints, my windy mind has now become peaceful and still.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗਨਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kichh jog paraapat ganiaa || rahaau ||
english: It seems that I have learned something of the science of Yoga. ||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਈ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gur dikhalaaee moree ||
english: The Guru has shown me the hole,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਰਗ ਪੜਤ ਹੈ ਚੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jit mirag paRat hai choree ||
english: through which the deer carefully enters.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੂੰਦਿ ਲੀਏ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: moo(n)d leee daravaaje ||
english: I have now closed off the doors,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜੀਅਲੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਜੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baajeeale anahad baaje ||1||
english: and the unstruck celestial sound current resounds. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਭ ਕਮਲੁ ਜਲਿ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ku(n)bh kamal jal bhariaa ||
english: The pitcher of my heart-lotus is filled with water;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਲੁ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਊਭਾ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jal metiaa oobhaa kariaa ||
english: I have spilled out the water, and set it upright.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer jan jaaniaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, the Lord's humble servant, this I know.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥੧੦॥
transliteration: jau jaaniaa tau man maaniaa ||2||10||
english: Now that I know this, my mind is pleased and appeased. ||2||10||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ॥
transliteration: raag sorath ||
english: Raag Sorat'h:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭੂਖੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: bhookhe bhagat na keejai ||
english: I am so hungry, I cannot perform devotional worship service.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਯਹ ਮਾਲਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: yah maalaa apanee leejai ||
english: Here, Lord, take back Your mala.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਰੇਨਾ ॥
transliteration: hau maa(n)gau sa(n)tan renaa ||
english: I beg for the dust of the feet of the Saints.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੀ ਕਾ ਦੇਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mai naahee kisee kaa denaa ||1||
english: I do not owe anyone anything. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧੋ ਕੈਸੀ ਬਨੈ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
transliteration: maadho kaisee banai tum sa(n)ge ||
english: O Lord, how can I be with You?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਦੇਹੁ ਤ ਲੇਵਉ ਮੰਗੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aap na dehu ta levau ma(n)ge || rahaau ||
english: If You do not give me Yourself, then I shall beg until I get You. ||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਸੇਰ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਚੂਨਾ ॥
transliteration: dui ser maa(n)gau choonaa ||
english: I ask for two kilos of flour,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਉ ਘੀਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੂਨਾ ॥
transliteration: paau gheeu sa(n)g loonaa ||
english: and half a pound of ghee, and salt.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਧ ਸੇਰੁ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਦਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: adh ser maa(n)gau daale ||
english: I ask for a pound of beans,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੋਨਉ ਵਖਤ ਜਿਵਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mo kau donau vakhat jivaale ||2||
english: which I shall eat twice a day. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਾਟ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਚਉਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: khaat maa(n)gau chaupaaee ||
english: I ask for a cot, with four legs,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਹਾਨਾ ਅਵਰ ਤੁਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sirahaanaa avar tulaaee ||
english: and a pillow and mattress.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਊਪਰ ਕਉ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਖੀਂਧਾ ॥
transliteration: oopar kau maa(n)gau khee(n)dhaa ||
english: I ask for a quilt to cover myself.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਥਂੀਧਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: teree bhagat karai jan tha(n)eedhaa ||3||
english: Your humble servant shall perform Your devotional worship service with love. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਲਬੋ ॥
transliteration: mai naahee keetaa labo ||
english: I have no greed;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੈ ਫਬੋ ॥
transliteration: ik naau teraa mai phabo ||
english: Your Name is the only ornament I wish for.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer man maaniaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, my mind is pleased and appeased;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: man maaniaa tau har jaaniaa ||4||11||
english: now that my mind is pleased and appeased, I have come to know the Lord. ||4||11||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag sorath baanee bhagat naamade jee kee ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee, Second House:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਬ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jab dekhaa tab gaavaa ||
english: When I see Him, I sing His Praises.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਜਨ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tau jan dheeraj paavaa ||1||
english: Then I, his humble servant, become patient. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਲੋ ਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਲੇ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naad samaailo re satigur bhetile devaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting the Divine True Guru, I merge into the sound current of the Naad. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਝਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਰੁ ਦਿਸੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jah jhil mil kaar disa(n)taa ||
english: Where the dazzling white light is seen,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਬਜੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tah anahad sabad baja(n)taa ||
english: there the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jotee jot samaanee ||
english: One's light merges in the Light;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mai gur parasaadee jaanee ||2||
english: by Guru's Grace, I know this. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੋਠਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ratan kamal kotharee ||
english: The jewels are in the treasure chamber of the heart-lotus.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਚਮਕਾਰ ਬੀਜੁਲ ਤਹੀ ॥
transliteration: chamakaar beejul tahee ||
english: They sparkle and glitter like lightning.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨੇਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: nerai naahee door ||
english: The Lord is near at hand, not far away.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਆਤਮੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nij aatamai rahiaa bharapoor ||3||
english: He is totally permeating and pervading in my soul. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਅਨਹਤ ਸੂਰ ਉਜੵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jah anahat soor ujyaaraa ||
english: Where the light of the undying sun shines,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਦੀਪਕ ਜਲੈ ਛੰਛਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tah deepak jalai chha(n)chhaaraa ||
english: the light of burning lamps seems insignificant.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee jaaniaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I know this.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naamaa sahaj samaaniaa ||4||1||
english: Servant Naam Dayv is absorbed in the Celestial Lord. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ੪ ਸੋਰਠਿ ॥
transliteration: ghar 4 sorath ||
english: Fourth House, Sorat'h:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਾੜ ਪੜੋਸਣਿ ਪੂਛਿ ਲੇ ਨਾਮਾ ਕਾ ਪਹਿ ਛਾਨਿ ਛਵਾਈ ਹੋ ॥
transliteration: paaR paRosan poochh le naamaa kaa pahi chhaan chhavaaee ho ||
english: The woman next door asked Naam Dayv, "Who built your house?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤੋ ਪਹਿ ਦੁਗਣੀ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਦੈਹਉ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬੇਢੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਬਤਾਈ ਹੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: to pahi duganee majooree daihau mo kau bedhee dehu bataaee ho ||1||
english: I shall pay him double wages. Tell me, who is your carpenter?" ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰੀ ਬਾਈ ਬੇਢੀ ਦੇਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ree baaee bedhee den na jaaee ||
english: O sister, I cannot give this carpenter to you.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੁ ਬੇਢੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dekh bedhee rahio samaaee ||
english: Behold, my carpenter is pervading everywhere.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਮਾਰੈ ਬੇਢੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hamaarai bedhee praan adhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My carpenter is the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬੇਢੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਊ ਛਾਨਿ ਛਵਾਵੈ ਹੋ ॥
transliteration: bedhee preet majooree maa(n)gai jau kooo chhaan chhavaavai ho ||
english: This carpenter demands the wages of love, if someone wants Him to build their house.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਲੋਗ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭਹੁ ਤੇ ਤੋਰੈ ਤਉ ਆਪਨ ਬੇਢੀ ਆਵੈ ਹੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: log kuta(n)b sabhahu te torai tau aapan bedhee aavai ho ||2||
english: When one breaks his ties with all the people and relatives, then the carpenter comes of His own accord. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਬੇਢੀ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰ ਸਭ ਠਾਂਈ ਹੋ ॥
transliteration: aiso bedhee baran na saakau sabh a(n)tar sabh thaa(n)ee ho ||
english: I cannot describe such a carpenter, who is contained in everything, everywhere.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੂੰਗੈ ਮਹਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪੂਛੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: goo(n)gai mahaa a(n)mrit ras chaakhiaa poochhe kahan na jaaee ho ||3||
english: The mute tastes the most sublime ambrosial nectar, but if you ask him to describe it, he cannot. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬੇਢੀ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੀ ਬਾਈ ਜਲਧਿ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਥਾਪਿਓ ਹੋ ॥
transliteration: bedhee ke gun sun ree baaee jaladh baa(n)dh dhroo thaapio ho ||
english: Listen to the virtues of this carpenter, O sister; He stopped the oceans, and established Dhroo as the pole star.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੀਅ ਬਹੋਰੀ ਲੰਕ ਭਭੀਖਣ ਆਪਿਓ ਹੋ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naame ke suaamee see bahoree la(n)k bhabheekhan aapio ho ||4||2||
english: Naam Dayv's Lord Master brought Sita back, and gave Sri Lanka to Bhabheekhan. ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: sorath ghar 3 ||
english: Sorat'h, Third House:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਣਮੜਿਆ ਮੰਦਲੁ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: anamaRiaa ma(n)dal baajai ||
english: The skinless drum plays.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਵਣ ਘਨਹਰੁ ਗਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: bin saavan ghanahar gaajai ||
english: Without the rainy season, the clouds shake with thunder.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਾਦਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਰਖਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: baadal bin barakhaa hoee ||
english: Without clouds, the rain falls,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jau tat bichaarai koee ||1||
english: if one contemplates the essence of reality. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: mo kau milio raam sanehee ||
english: I have met my Beloved Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਦੇਹ ਸੁਦੇਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jih miliai deh sudehee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting with Him, my body is made beauteous and sublime. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mil paaras ka(n)chan hoiaa ||
english: Touching the philosopher's stone, I have been transformed into gold.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਮਨਸਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mukh manasaa ratan paroiaa ||
english: I have threaded the jewels into my mouth and mind.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਭਾਉ ਭਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: nij bhaau bhaiaa bhram bhaagaa ||
english: I love Him as my own, and my doubt has been dispelled.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur poochhe man pateeaagaa ||2||
english: Seeking the Guru's guidance, my mind is content. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕੁੰਭ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jal bheetar ku(n)bh samaaniaa ||
english: The water is contained within the pitcher;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਰਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh raam ek kar jaaniaa ||
english: I know that the One Lord is contained in all.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur chele hai man maaniaa ||
english: The mind of the disciple has faith in the Guru.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਮੈ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naamai tat pachhaaniaa ||3||3||
english: Servant Naam Dayv understands the essence of reality. ||3||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag sorath baanee bhagat ravidaas jee kee ||
english: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Ravi Daas Jee:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਹੋਤੇ ਤਬ ਤੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਬ ਤੂਹੀ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jab ham hote tab too naahee ab toohee mai naahee ||
english: When I am in my ego, then You are not with me. Now that You are with me, there is no egotism within me.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਨਲ ਅਗਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਲਹਰਿ ਮਇ ਓਦਧਿ ਜਲ ਕੇਵਲ ਜਲ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anal agam jaise lahar mai odadh jal keval jal maa(n)hee ||1||
english: The wind may raise up huge waves in the vast ocean, but they are just water in water. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਐਸਾ ॥
transliteration: maadhave kiaa kaheeai bhram aisaa ||
english: O Lord, what can I say about such an illusion?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਤੈਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa maaneeai hoi na taisaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Things are not as they seem. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨਿ ਸੋਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਭਇਆ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: narapat ek si(n)ghaasan soiaa supane bhaiaa bhikhaaree ||
english: It is like the king, who falls asleep upon his throne, and dreams that he is a beggar.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਛਤ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: achhat raaj bichhurat dukh paaiaa so gat bhaee hamaaree ||2||
english: His kingdom is intact, but separated from it, he suffers in sorrow. Such is my own condition. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਭੁਇਅੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਹਿ ਅਬ ਕਛੁ ਮਰਮੁ ਜਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: raaj bhuia(n)g prasa(n)g jaise hahi ab kachh maram janaaiaa ||
english: Like the story of the rope mistaken for a snake, the mystery has now been explained to me.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਟਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਅਬ ਕਹਤੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anik katak jaise bhool pare ab kahate kahan na aaiaa ||3||
english: Like the many bracelets, which I mistakenly thought were gold; now, I do not say what I said then. ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੋੁਗਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sarabe ek anekai suaamee sabh ghat bhougavai soee ||
english: The One Lord is pervading the many forms; He enjoys Himself in all hearts.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਹਾਥ ਪੈ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas haath pai nerai sahaje hoi s hoee ||4||1||
english: Says Ravi Daas, the Lord is nearer than our own hands and feet. Whatever will be, will be. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਮੋਹ ਫਾਸ ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਧਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: jau ham baa(n)dhe moh phaas ham prem badhan tum baadhe ||
english: If I am bound by the noose of emotional attachment, then I shall bind You, Lord, with the bonds of love.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਛੂਟਨ ਕੋ ਜਤਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਛੂਟੇ ਤੁਮ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apane chhootan ko jatan karahu ham chhoote tum aaraadhe ||1||
english: Go ahead and try to escape, Lord; I have escaped by worshipping and adoring You. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਜਾਨਤ ਹਹੁ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੈਸੀ ॥
transliteration: maadhave jaanat hahu jaisee taisee ||
english: O Lord, You know my love for You.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਹੁਗੇ ਐਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ab kahaa karahuge aisee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Now, what will You do? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੀਨੁ ਪਕਰਿ ਫਾਂਕਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਓ ਰਾਂਧਿ ਕੀਓ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: meen pakar phaa(n)kio ar kaatio raa(n)dh keeo bahu baanee ||
english: A fish is caught, cut up, and cooked it in many different ways.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਊ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kha(n)d kha(n)d kar bhojan keeno taoo na bisario paanee ||2||
english: Bit by bit, it is eaten, but still, it does not forget the water. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਬਾਪੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਨ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: aapan baapai naahee kisee ko bhaavan ko har raajaa ||
english: The Lord, our King, is father to no one, except those who love Him.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਪਟਲ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਭਗਤ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: moh patal sabh jagat biaapio bhagat nahee sa(n)taapaa ||3||
english: The veil of emotional attachment has been cast over the entire world, but it does not bother the Lord's devotee. ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਕ ਬਾਢੀ ਅਬ ਇਹ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas bhagat ik baadhee ab ih kaa siu kaheeai ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, my devotion to the One Lord is increasing; now, who can I tell this to?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਜਹੂ ਸਹੀਐ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa kaaran ham tum aaraadhe so dukh ajahoo saheeai ||4||2||
english: That which brought me to worship and adore You - I am still suffering that pain. ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਅਬਿਬੇਕੈ ॥
transliteration: dulabh janam pu(n)n phal paaio birathaa jaat abibekai ||
english: I obtained this precious human life as a reward for my past actions, but without discriminating wisdom, it is wasted in vain.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਸਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਹ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raaje i(n)dr samasar grih aasan bin har bhagat kahahu kih lekhai ||1||
english: Tell me, without devotional worship of the Lord, of what use are mansions and thrones like those of King Indra? ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ ॥
transliteration: na beechaario raajaa raam ko ras ||
english: You have not considered the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, our King;

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਰਸ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਬੀਸਰਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jih ras an ras beesar jaahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: this sublime essence shall cause you to forget all other essences. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨਿ ਅਜਾਨ ਭਏ ਹਮ ਬਾਵਰ ਸੋਚ ਅਸੋਚ ਦਿਵਸ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jaan ajaan bhae ham baavar soch asoch divas jaahee ||
english: We do not know what we need to know, and we have become insane. We do not consider what we should consider; our days are passing away.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਸਬਲ ਨਿਬਲ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: i(n)dree sabal nibal bibek budh paramaarath paraves nahee ||2||
english: Our passions are strong, and our discriminating intellect is weak; we have no access to the supreme objective. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੀਅਤ ਆਨ ਅਚਰੀਅਤ ਅਨ ਕਛੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kaheeat aan achareeat an kachh samajh na parai apar maaiaa ||
english: We say one thing, and do something else; entangled in endless Maya, we do not understand anything.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕੋਪੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas udaas daas mat parahar kop karahu jee daiaa ||3||3||
english: Says Ravi Daas, Your slave, O Lord, I am disillusioned and detached; please, spare me Your anger, and have mercy on my soul. ||3||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੁਰਤਰ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar suratar chi(n)taaman kaamadhen bas jaa ke ||
english: He is the ocean of peace; the miraculous tree of life, the wish-fulfilling jewel, and the Kaamadhayna, the cow which fulfills all desires, all are in His power.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਦਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chaar padaarath asat dasaa sidh nav nidh kar tal taa ke ||1||
english: The four great blessings, the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, and the nine treasures, are all in the palm of His hand. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har har har na japahi rasanaa ||
english: You do not chant with your tongue the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਚਨ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avar sabh tiaag bachan rachanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Abandon your involvement in all other words. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਖਿਆਨ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਉਤੀਸ ਅਖਰ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥
transliteration: naanaa khiaan puraan bed bidh chautees akhar maa(n)hee ||
english: The various Shaastras, Puranaas, and the Vedas of Brahma, are made up of thirty-four letters.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਸ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕਹਿਓ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: biaas bichaar kahio paramaarath raam naam sar naahee ||2||
english: After deep contemplation, Vyaas spoke of the supreme objective; there is nothing equal to the Lord's Name. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਫੁਨਿ ਬਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaj samaadh upaadh rahat phun badai bhaag liv laagee ||
english: Very fortunate are those who are absorbed in celestial bliss, and released from their entanglements; they are lovingly attached to the Lord.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਰਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਭੈ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥੪॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas pragaas ridai dhar janam maran bhai bhaagee ||3||4||
english: Says Ravi Daas, enshrine the Lord's Light within your heart, and your fear of birth and death shall run away from you. ||3||4||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਗਿਰਿਵਰ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jau tum girivar tau ham moraa ||
english: If You are the mountain, Lord, then I am the peacock.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਚੰਦ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਚਕੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jau tum cha(n)d tau ham bhae hai chakoraa ||1||
english: If You are the moon, then I am the partridge in love with it. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਤੁਮ ਨ ਤੋਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਤੋਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: maadhave tum na torahu tau ham nahee torahi ||
english: O Lord, if You will not break with me, then I will not break with You.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਤੋਰਿ ਕਵਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tum siu tor kavan siu jorahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: For, if I were to break with You, with whom would I then join? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਦੀਵਰਾ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: jau tum deevaraa tau ham baatee ||
english: If You are the lamp, then I am the wick.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਤੀਰਥ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jau tum teerath tau ham jaatee ||2||
english: If You are the sacred place of pilgrimage, then I am the pilgrim. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saachee preet ham tum siu joree ||
english: I am joined in true love with You, Lord.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tum siu jor avar sa(n)g toree ||3||
english: I am joined with You, and I have broken with all others. ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਜਾਉ ਤਹਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jah jah jaau tahaa teree sevaa ||
english: Wherever I go, there I serve You.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tum so thaakur aur na devaa ||4||
english: There is no other Lord Master than You, O Divine Lord. ||4||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਭਜਨ ਕਟਹਿ ਜਮ ਫਾਂਸਾ ॥
transliteration: tumare bhajan katahi jam phaa(n)saa ||
english: Meditating, vibrating upon You, the noose of death is cut away.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥੫॥
transliteration: bhagat het gaavai ravidaasaa ||5||5||
english: To attain devotional worship, Ravi Daas sings to You, Lord. ||5||5||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਪਵਨ ਕਾ ਥੰਭਾ ਰਕਤ ਬੁੰਦ ਕਾ ਗਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jal kee bheet pavan kaa tha(n)bhaa rakat bu(n)d kaa gaaraa ||
english: The body is a wall of water, supported by the pillars of air; the egg and sperm are the mortar.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਾਡ ਮਾਸ ਨਾੜਂੀ ਕੋ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਬਸੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haad maas naaRa(n)ee ko pi(n)jar pa(n)khee basai bichaaraa ||1||
english: The framework is made up of bones, flesh and veins; the poor soul-bird dwells within it. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: praanee kiaa meraa kiaa teraa ||
english: O mortal, what is mine, and what is yours?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਰਵਰ ਪੰਖਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaise taravar pa(n)kh baseraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The soul is like a bird perched upon a tree. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕੰਧ ਉਸਾਰਹੁ ਨੀਵਾਂ ॥
transliteration: raakhahu ka(n)dh usaarahu neevaa(n) ||
english: You lay the foundation and build the walls.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਢੇ ਤੀਨਿ ਹਾਥ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੀਵਾਂ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhe teen haath teree seevaa(n) ||2||
english: But in the end, three and a half cubits will be your measured space. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬੰਕੇ ਬਾਲ ਪਾਗ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)ke baal paag sir deree ||
english: You make your hair beautiful, and wear a stylish turban on your head.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਭਸਮ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ihu tan hoigo bhasam kee dheree ||3||
english: But in the end, this body shall be reduced to a pile of ashes. ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ooche ma(n)dar su(n)dar naaree ||
english: Your palaces are lofty, and your brides are beautiful.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: raam naam bin baajee haaree ||4||
english: But without the Lord's Name, you shall lose the game entirely. ||4||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਕਮੀਨੀ ਪਾਂਤਿ ਕਮੀਨੀ ਓਛਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: meree jaat kameenee paa(n)t kameenee ochhaa janam hamaaraa ||
english: My social status is low, my ancestry is low, and my life is wretched.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਚੰਦ ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥
transliteration: tum saranaagat raajaa raam cha(n)d kahi ravidaas chamaaraa ||5||6||
english: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Luminous Lord, my King; so says Ravi Daas, the shoemaker. ||5||6||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਚਮਰਟਾ ਗਾਂਠਿ ਨ ਜਨਈ ॥
transliteration: chamarataa gaa(n)th na janaee ||
english: I am a shoemaker, but I do not know how to mend shoes.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਗੁ ਗਠਾਵੈ ਪਨਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: log gathaavai panahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: People come to me to mend their shoes. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਆਰ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਹ ਤੋਪਉ ॥
transliteration: aar nahee jih topau ||
english: I have no awl to stitch them;

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਰਾਂਬੀ ਠਾਉ ਰੋਪਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nahee raa(n)bee thaau ropau ||1||
english: I have no knife to patch them. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਗੁ ਗੰਠਿ ਗੰਠਿ ਖਰਾ ਬਿਗੂਚਾ ॥
transliteration: log ga(n)th ga(n)th kharaa bigoochaa ||
english: Mending, mending, people waste their lives and ruin themselves.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਾਂਠੇ ਜਾਇ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hau bin gaa(n)the jaai pahoochaa ||2||
english: Without wasting my time mending, I have found the Lord. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਜਪੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: ravidaas japai raam naamaa ||
english: Ravi Daas chants the Lord's Name;

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੩॥੭॥
transliteration: mohi jam siu naahee kaamaa ||3||7||
english: he is not concerned with the Messenger of Death. ||3||7||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਭੀਖਨ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag sorath baanee bhagat bheekhan kee ||
english: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Bheekhan Jee:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਹੈ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਨਾ ਭਏ ਕੇਸ ਦੁਧ ਵਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: nainahu neer bahai tan kheenaa bhae kes dudh vaanee ||
english: Tears well up in my eyes, my body has become weak, and my hair has become milky-white.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰੂਧਾ ਕੰਠੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਉਚਰੈ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: roodhaa ka(n)th sabad nahee ucharai ab kiaa karahi paraanee ||1||
english: My throat is tight, and I cannot utter even one word; what can I do now? I am a mere mortal. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੋਹਿ ਬੈਦ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: raam raai hohi baid banavaaree ||
english: O Lord, my King, Gardener of the world-garden, be my Physician,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੰਤਹ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: apane sa(n)tah lehu ubaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and save me, Your Saint. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਥੇ ਪੀਰ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਜਲਨਿ ਹੈ ਕਰਕ ਕਰੇਜੇ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: maathe peer sareer jalan hai karak kareje maahee ||
english: My head aches, my body is burning, and my heart is filled with anguish.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਬੇਦਨ ਉਪਜਿ ਖਰੀ ਭਈ ਵਾ ਕਾ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aisee bedan upaj kharee bhaee vaa kaa aukhadh naahee ||2||
english: Such is the disease that has struck me; there is no medicine to cure it. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਗਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam a(n)mrit jal niramal ihu aukhadh jag saaraa ||
english: The Name of the Lord, the ambrosial, immaculate water, is the best medicine in the world.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਭੀਖਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaad kahai jan bheekhan paavau mokh duaaraa ||3||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, says servant Bheekhan, I have found the Door of Salvation. ||3||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aisaa naam ratan niramolak pu(n)n padaarath paaiaa ||
english: Such is the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the invaluable jewel, the most sublime wealth, which I have found through good deeds.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਰਤਨੁ ਨ ਛਪੈ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik jatan kar hiradai raakhiaa ratan na chhapai chhapaaiaa ||1||
english: By various efforts, I have enshrined it within my heart; this jewel cannot be hidden by hiding it. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਕਹਤੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har gun kahate kahan na jaaee ||
english: The Glorious Praises of the Lord cannot be spoken by speaking.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਗੂੰਗੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaise goo(n)ge kee mithiaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They are like the sweet candies given to a mute. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਾ ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa ramat sunat sukh sravanaa chit chete sukh hoee ||
english: The tongue speaks, the ears listen, and the mind contemplates the Lord; they find peace and comfort.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਭੀਖਨ ਦੁਇ ਨੈਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu bheekhan dui nain sa(n)tokhe jah dekhaa(n) tah soee ||2||2||
english: Says Bheekhan, my eyes are content; wherever I look, there I see the Lord. ||2||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ghar 1 chaupade ||
english: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਡਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jeeu darat hai aapanaa kai siu karee pukaar ||
english: My soul is afraid; to whom should I complain?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dookh visaaran seviaa sadaa sadaa daataar ||1||
english: I serve Him, who makes me forget my pains; He is the Giver, forever and ever. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਨੀਤ ਨਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saahib meraa neet navaa sadaa sadaa daataar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My Lord and Master is forever new; He is the Giver, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin saahib seveeai a(n)t chhadaae soi ||
english: Night and day, I serve my Lord and Master; He shall save me in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sun sun meree kaamanee paar utaaraa hoi ||2||
english: Hearing and listening, O my dear sister, I have crossed over. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾ ॥
transliteration: daiaal terai naam taraa ||
english: O Merciful Lord, Your Name carries me across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sad kurabaanai jaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੰ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saraba(n) saachaa ek hai doojaa naahee koi ||
english: In all the world, there is only the One True Lord; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa kee sevaa so kare jaa kau nadar kare ||3||
english: He alone serves the Lord, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੇਵ ਰਹਾ ॥
transliteration: tudh baajh piaare kev rahaa ||
english: Without You, O Beloved, how could I even live?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾਂ ॥
transliteration: saa vadiaaee dehi jit naam tere laag rahaa(n) ||
english: Bless me with such greatness, that I may remain attached to Your Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਾਇ ਕਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: doojaa naahee koi jis aagai piaare jaai kahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: There is no other, O Beloved, to whom I can go and speak. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਚੰਉ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sevee saahib aapanaa avar na jaacha(n)u koi ||
english: I serve my Lord and Master; I ask for no other.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਬਿੰਦ ਬਿੰਦ ਚੁਖ ਚੁਖ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak taa kaa daas hai bi(n)d bi(n)d chukh chukh hoi ||4||
english: Nanak is His slave; moment by moment, bit by bit, he is a sacrifice to Him. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਿੰਦ ਬਿੰਦ ਚੁਖ ਚੁਖ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: saahib tere naam vitahu bi(n)d bi(n)d chukh chukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||4||1||
english: O Lord Master, I am a sacrifice to Your Name, moment by moment, bit by bit. ||1||Pause||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਆਦਮੀ ਹਾਂ ਇਕ ਦਮੀ ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ham aadamee haa(n) ik damee muhalat muhat na jaanaa ||
english: We are human beings of the briefest moment; we do not know the appointed time of our departure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak binavai tisai sarevahu jaa ke jee paraanaa ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, serve the One, to whom our soul and breath of life belong. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇ ਦਿਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe jeevanaa veechaar dekh kete ke dinaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are blind - see and consider, how many days your life shall last. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਖਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saas maas sabh jeeu tumaaraa too mai kharaa piaaraa ||
english: My breath, my flesh and my soul are all Yours, Lord; You are so very dear to me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਏਵ ਕਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saair ev kahat hai sache paravadagaaraa ||2||
english: Nanak, the poet, says this, O True Lord Cherisher. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਢੈ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
transliteration: je too kisai na dehee mere saahibaa kiaa ko kadhai gahanaa ||
english: If you gave nothing, O my Lord and Master, what could anyone pledge to You?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak binavai so kichh paaeeai purab likhe kaa lahanaa ||3||
english: Nanak prays, we receive that which we are pre-destined to receive. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਪਟੀ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: naam khasam kaa chit na keeaa kapatee kapat kamaanaa ||
english: The deceitful person does not remember the Lord's Name; he practices only deceit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜਾ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਚਲਦਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jam duaar jaa pakaR chalaaiaa taa chaladaa pachhutaanaa ||4||
english: When he is marched in chains to Death's door, then, he regrets his actions. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਰਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jab lag duneeaa raheeai naanak kichh suneeai kichh kaheeai ||
english: As long as we are in this world, O Nanak, we should listen, and speak of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਮ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੫॥੨॥
transliteration: bhaal rahe ham rahan na paaiaa jeevatiaa mar raheeai ||5||2||
english: I have searched, but I have found no way to remain here; so, remain dead while yet alive. ||5||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ghar doojaa ||
english: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਸਿਵਰਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kiu simaree sivariaa nahee jaai ||
english: How can I remember the Lord in meditation? I cannot meditate on Him in remembrance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਪੈ ਹਿਆਉ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tapai hiaau jeeaRaa bilalaai ||
english: My heart is burning, and my soul is crying out in pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: siraj savaare saachaa soi ||
english: The True Lord creates and adorns.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਚੰਗਾ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis visariai cha(n)gaa kiu hoi ||1||
english: Forgetting Him, how can one be good? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hikamat hukam na paaiaa jaai ||
english: By clever tricks and commands, He cannot be found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kiu kar saach milau meree maai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How am I to meet my True Lord, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਖਣ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vakhar naam dekhan koee jaai ||
english: How rare is the one who goes out, and searches for the merchandise of the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਚਾਖੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naa ko chaakhai naa ko khaai ||
english: No one tastes it, and no one eats it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਿ ਪਤੀਣੈ ਨਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: lok pateenai naa pat hoi ||
english: Honor is not obtained by trying to please other people.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਰਹੈ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa pat rahai raakhai jaa soi ||2||
english: One's honor is preserved, only if the Lord preserves it. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah rahiaa samaai ||
english: Wherever I look, there I see Him, pervading and permeating.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tudh bin doojee naahee jaai ||
english: Without You, I have no other place of rest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਕੀਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: je ko kare keetai kiaa hoi ||
english: He may try, but what can anyone do by his own doing?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis no bakhase saachaa soi ||3||
english: He alone is blessed, whom the True Lord forgives. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਣਿ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਤਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: hun uth chalanaa muhat k taal ||
english: Now, I shall have to get up and depart, in an instant, in the clapping of hands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: kiaa muhu desaa gun nahee naal ||
english: What face will I show the Lord? I have no virtue at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaisee nadar kare taisaa hoi ||
english: As is the Lord's Glance of Grace, so it is.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: vin nadaree naanak nahee koi ||4||1||3||
english: Without His Glance of Grace, O Nanak, no one is blessed. ||4||1||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa simariaa jaai ||
english: If the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then one remembers Him in meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮਾ ਦ੍ਰਵੈ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aatamaa dravai rahai liv laai ||
english: The soul is softened, and he remains absorbed in the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮਾ ਪਰਾਤਮਾ ਏਕੋ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aatamaa paraatamaa eko karai ||
english: His soul and the Supreme Soul become one.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kee dubidhaa a(n)tar marai ||1||
english: The duality of the inner mind is overcome. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee paaiaa jaai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, God is found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har siu chit laagai phir kaal na khaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One's consciousness is attached to the Lord, and so Death does not devour him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਸਿਮਰਿਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sach simariai hovai paragaas ||
english: Remembering the True Lord in meditation, one is enlightened.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: taa te bikhiaa mahi rahai udaas ||
english: Then, in the midst of Maya, he remains detached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਐਸੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee aisee vadiaaee ||
english: Such is the Glory of the True Guru;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਵਿਚੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: putr kalatr viche gat paaee ||2||
english: in the midst of children and spouses, they attain emancipation. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aisee sevak sevaa karai ||
english: Such is the service which the Lord's servant performs,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa jeeu tis aagai dharai ||
english: that he dedicates his soul to the Lord, to whom it belongs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: saahib bhaavai so paravaan ||
english: One who is pleasing to the Lord and Master is acceptable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so sevak daragah paavai maan ||3||
english: Such a servant obtains honor in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee moorat hiradai vasaae ||
english: He enshrines the image of the True Guru in his heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jo ichhai soee phal paae ||
english: He obtains the rewards which he desires.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahib kirapaa karai ||
english: The True Lord and Master grants His Grace;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕੈਸਾ ਡਰੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: so sevak jam te kaisaa darai ||4||
english: how can such a servant be afraid of death? ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak kare veechaar ||
english: Prays Nanak, practice contemplation,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saachee baanee siu dhare piaar ||
english: and enshrine love for the True Word of His Bani.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: taa ko paavai mokh duaar ||
english: Then, you shall find the Gate of Salvation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੫॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: jap tap sabh ihu sabad hai saar ||5||2||4||
english: This Shabad is the most excellent of all chanting and austere meditations. ||5||2||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਤਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jeeu tapat hai baaro baar ||
english: My soul burns, over and over again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਪਿ ਤਪਿ ਖਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੇਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tap tap khapai bahut bekaar ||
english: Burning and burning, it is ruined, and it falls into evil.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਤਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jai tan baanee visar jaai ||
english: That body, which forgets the Word of the Guru's Bani,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪਕਾ ਰੋਗੀ ਵਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu pakaa rogee vilalaai ||1||
english: cries out in pain, like a chronic patient. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਝਖਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bahutaa bolan jhakhan hoi ||
english: To speak too much and babble is useless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vin bole jaanai sabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Even without our speaking, He knows everything. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਨ ਕੀਤੇ ਅਖੀ ਨਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: jin kan keete akhee naak ||
english: He created our ears, eyes and nose.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਦਿਤੀ ਬੋਲੇ ਤਾਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jin jihavaa ditee bole taat ||
english: He gave us our tongue to speak so fluently.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jin man raakhiaa aganee paai ||
english: He preserved the mind in the fire of the womb;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੈ ਪਵਣੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vaajai pavan aakhai sabh jaai ||2||
english: at His Command, the wind blows everywhere. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਆਦ ॥
transliteration: jetaa mohu pareet suaad ||
english: These worldly attachments, loves and pleasurable tastes,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਾ ਕਾਲਖ ਦਾਗਾ ਦਾਗ ॥
transliteration: sabhaa kaalakh daagaa daag ||
english: all are just black stains.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਾਗ ਦੋਸ ਮੁਹਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: daag dos muhi chaliaa laai ||
english: One who departs, with these black stains of sin on his face

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: daragah baisan naahee jaai ||3||
english: shall find no place to sit in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਖਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karam milai aakhan teraa naau ||
english: By Your Grace, we chant Your Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਣਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit lag taranaa hor nahee thaau ||
english: Becoming attached to it, one is saved; there is no other way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਡੂਬੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: je ko doobai phir hovai saar ||
english: Even if one is drowning, still, he may be saved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਰਬ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak saachaa sarab daataar ||4||3||5||
english: O Nanak, the True Lord is the Giver of all. ||4||3||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੋਰੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਚੀਤੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: chor salaahe cheet na bheejai ||
english: If a thief praises someone, his mind is not pleased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਬਦੀ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਤਸੂ ਨ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: je badee kare taa tasoo na chheejai ||
english: If a thief curses him, no damage is done.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੋਰ ਕੀ ਹਾਮਾ ਭਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: chor kee haamaa bhare na koi ||
english: No one will take responsibility for a thief.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੋਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਚੰਗਾ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chor keeaa cha(n)gaa kiu hoi ||1||
english: How can a thief's actions be good? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਅੰਧੇ ਕੁਤੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: sun man a(n)dhe kute kooRiaar ||
english: Listen, O mind, you blind, false dog!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin bole boojheeai sachiaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Even without your speaking, the Lord knows and understands. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੋਰੁ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਚੋਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
transliteration: chor suaaliu chor siaanaa ||
english: A thief may be handsome, and a thief may be wise,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਕਾ ਮੁਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਦੁਗਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: khote kaa mul ek dugaanaa ||
english: but he is still just a counterfeit coin, worth only a shell.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਾਥਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je saath rakheeai deejai ralaai ||
english: If it is kept and mixed with other coins,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਪਰਖੀਐ ਖੋਟਾ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa parakheeai khotaa hoi jaai ||2||
english: it will be found to be false, when the coins are inspected. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa kare s taisaa paavai ||
english: As one acts, so does he receive.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aap beej aape hee khaavai ||
english: As he plants, so does he eat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਆਪੇ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je vadiaaeeaa aape khaai ||
english: He may praise himself gloriously,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਤੇਹੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jehee surat tehai raahi jaai ||3||
english: but still, according to his understanding, so is the path he must follow. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਬਾੜੁ ॥
transliteration: je sau kooReeaa kooR kabaaR ||
english: He may tell hundreds of lies to conceal his falsehood,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਖਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhaavai sabh aakhau sa(n)saar ||
english: and all the world may call him good.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਅਧੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: tudh bhaavai adhee paravaan ||
english: If it pleases You, Lord, even the foolish are approved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak jaanai jaan sujaan ||4||4||6||
english: O Nanak, the Lord is wise, knowing, all-knowing. ||4||4||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kaagad man paravaanaa ||
english: The body is the paper, and the mind is the inscription written upon it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਕੇ ਲੇਖ ਨ ਪੜੈ ਇਆਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sir ke lekh na paRai iaanaa ||
english: The ignorant fool does not read what is written on his forehead.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਘੜੀਅਹਿ ਤੀਨੇ ਲੇਖ ॥
transliteration: daragah ghaReeahi teene lekh ||
english: In the Court of the Lord, three inscriptions are recorded.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khotaa kaam na aavai vekh ||1||
english: Behold, the counterfeit coin is worthless there. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੁਪਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak je vich rupaa hoi ||
english: O Nanak, if there is silver in it,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਰਾ ਖਰਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kharaa kharaa aakhai sabh koi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: then everyone proclaims, "It is genuine, it is genuine." ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਦੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਮਲੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaadee kooR bol mal khaai ||
english: The Qazi tells lies and eats filth;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਆ ਘਾਇ ॥
transliteration: braahaman naavai jeeaa ghaai ||
english: the Brahmin kills and then takes cleansing baths.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: jogee jugat na jaanai a(n)dh ||
english: The Yogi is blind, and does not know the Way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨੇ ਓਜਾੜੇ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: teene ojaaRe kaa ba(n)dh ||2||
english: The three of them devise their own destruction. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੋ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: so jogee jo jugat pachhaanai ||
english: He alone is a Yogi, who understands the Way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee eko jaanai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, he knows the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਸੋ ਜੋ ਉਲਟੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kaajee so jo ulatee karai ||
english: He alone is a Qazi, who turns away from the world,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee jeevat marai ||
english: and who, by Guru's Grace, remains dead while yet alive.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਜੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so braahaman jo braham beechaarai ||
english: He alone is a Brahmin, who contemplates God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap tarai sagale kul taarai ||3||
english: He saves himself, and saves all his generations as well. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨਸਬੰਦੁ ਸੋਈ ਦਿਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: daanasaba(n)d soee dil dhovai ||
english: One who cleanses his own mind is wise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: musalamaan soee mal khovai ||
english: One who cleanses himself of impurity is a Muslim.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿਆ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: paRiaa boojhai so paravaan ||
english: One who reads and understands is acceptable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
transliteration: jis sir daragah kaa neesaan ||4||5||7||
english: Upon his forehead is the Insignia of the Court of the Lord. ||4||5||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ghar 3 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤ ਕਾ ਢਬੁ ॥
transliteration: kaal naahee jog naahee naahee sat kaa dhab ||
english: No, no, this is not the time, when people know the way to Yoga and Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨਸਟ ਜਗ ਭਰਿਸਟ ਹੋਏ ਡੂਬਤਾ ਇਵ ਜਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: thaanasat jag bharisat hoe doobataa iv jag ||1||
english: The holy places of worship in the world are polluted, and so the world is drowning. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kal mahi raam naam saar ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the most sublime.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਤ ਮੀਟਹਿ ਨਾਕ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਠਗਣ ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: akhee ta meetahi naak pakaRahi thagan kau sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Some people try to deceive the world by closing their eyes and holding their nostrils closed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਂਟ ਸੇਤੀ ਨਾਕੁ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਸੂਝਤੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਅ ॥
transliteration: aa(n)t setee naak pakaRahi soojhate tin lo ||
english: They close off their nostrils with their fingers, and claim to see the three worlds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਗਰ ਪਾਛੈ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਏਹੁ ਪਦਮੁ ਅਲੋਅ ॥੨॥
transliteration: magar paachhai kachh na soojhai ehu padam alo ||2||
english: But they cannot even see what is behind them. What a strange lotus pose this is! ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀਆ ਤ ਧਰਮੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਲੇਛ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਗਹੀ ॥
transliteration: khatreeaa ta dharam chhodiaa malechh bhaakhiaa gahee ||
english: The K'shatriyas have abandoned their religion, and have adopted a foreign language.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਰਹੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: srisat sabh ik varan hoee dharam kee gat rahee ||3||
english: The whole world has been reduced to the same social status; the state of righteousness and Dharma has been lost. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਸਾਜ ਸਾਜਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸੋਧਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੇਦ ਅਭਿਆਸੁ ॥
transliteration: asat saaj saaj puraan sodhahi karahi bed abhiaas ||
english: They analyze eight chapters of (Panini's) grammar and the Puraanas. They study the Vedas,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥੮॥
transliteration: bin naam har ke mukat naahee kahai naanak daas ||4||1||6||8||
english: but without the Lord's Name, no one is liberated; so says Nanak, the Lord's slave. ||4||1||6||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਆਰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 aaratee ||
english: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Aartee:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਗਨ ਮੈ ਥਾਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਕ ਬਨੇ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਨਕ ਮੋਤੀ ॥
transliteration: gagan mai thaal rav cha(n)d deepak bane taarikaa ma(n)dal janak motee ||
english: In the bowl of the sky, the sun and moon are the lamps; the stars in the constellations are the pearls.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੂਪੁ ਮਲਆਨਲੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਚਵਰੋ ਕਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬਨਰਾਇ ਫੂਲੰਤ ਜੋਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhoop malaaanalo pavan chavaro kare sagal banaraai phoola(n)t jotee ||1||
english: The fragrance of sandalwood is the incense, the wind is the fan, and all the vegetation are flowers in offering to You, O Luminous Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੈਸੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: kaisee aaratee hoi bhav kha(n)danaa teree aaratee ||
english: What a beautiful lamp-lit worship service this is! O Destroyer of fear, this is Your Aartee, Your worship service.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਤਾ ਸਬਦ ਵਾਜੰਤ ਭੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anahataa sabad vaaja(n)t bheree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The sound current of the Shabad is the sounding of the temple drums. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਨੈਨ ਨਨ ਨੈਨ ਹੈ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਉ ਸਹਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਨਾ ਏਕ ਤੋਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sahas tav nain nan nain hai tohi kau sahas moorat nanaa ek tohee ||
