english: Thousands are Your eyes, and yet You have no eyes. Thousands are Your forms, and yet You have not even one form.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਪਦ ਬਿਮਲ ਨਨ ਏਕ ਪਦ ਗੰਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਗੰਧ ਇਵ ਚਲਤ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sahas pad bimal nan ek pad ga(n)dh bin sahas tav ga(n)dh iv chalat mohee ||2||
english: Thousands are Your lotus feet, and yet You have no feet. Without a nose, thousands are Your noses. I am enchanted with Your play! ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi jot jot hai soi ||
english: The Divine Light is within everyone; You are that Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis kai chaanan sabh mahi chaanan hoi ||
english: Yours is that Light which shines within everyone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur saakhee jot paragat hoi ||
english: By the Guru's Teachings, this Divine Light is revealed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai s aaratee hoi ||3||
english: That which pleases the Lord is the true worship service. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਲੋਭਿਤ ਮਨੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਹੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: har charan kamal makara(n)d lobhit mano anadino mohi aahee piaasaa ||
english: My soul is enticed by the honey-sweet lotus feet of the Lord; night and day, I thirst for them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੯॥
transliteration: kripaa jal dehi naanak saari(n)g kau hoi jaa te terai naam vaasaa ||4||1||7||9||
english: Bless Nanak, the thirsty song-bird, with the water of Your Mercy, that he may come to dwell in Your Name. ||4||1||7||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 ghar 2 chaupade ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu dhan akhut na nikhutai na jaai ||
english: This wealth is inexhaustible. It shall never be exhausted, and it shall never be lost.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: poorai satigur deeaa dikhaai ||
english: The Perfect True Guru has revealed it to me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: apune satigur kau sad bal jaaee ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te har ma(n)n vasaaee ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: se dhanava(n)t har naam liv laai ||
english: They alone are wealthy, who lovingly attune themselves to the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai har dhan paragaasiaa har kirapaa te vasai man aai || rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has revealed to me the Lord's treasure; by the Lord's Grace, it has come to abide in my mind. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਾਟਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: avagun kaat gun ridai samaai ||
english: He is rid of his demerits, and his heart is permeated with merit and virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kai sahaj subhaai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, he naturally dwells in celestial peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kee saachee baanee ||
english: True is the Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sukh man a(n)tar sahaj samaanee ||2||
english: They bring peace to the mind, and celestial peace is absorbed within. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ek acharaj jan dekhahu bhaaee ||
english: O my humble Siblings of Destiny, behold this strange and wonderful thing:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa maar har ma(n)n vasaaee ||
english: duality is overcome, and the Lord dwells within his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naam amolak na paaiaa jaai ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless; it cannot be taken.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur parasaad vasai man aai ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, it comes to abide in the mind. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi vasai prabh eko soi ||
english: He is the One God, abiding within all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramatee ghat paragat hoi ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, He is revealed in the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sahaje jin prabh jaan pachhaaniaa ||
english: One who intuitively knows and realizes God,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai man maaniaa ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, obtains the Naam; his mind is pleased and appeased. ||4||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har naam dhan niramal at apaaraa ||
english: The wealth of the Lord's Name is immaculate, and absolutely infinite.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is over-flowing with treasure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਧਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰ ਸਭ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naam dhan bin hor sabh bikh jaan ||
english: Know that, except for the wealth of the Name, all other wealth is poison.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਲੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi jalai abhimaan ||1||
english: The egotistical people are burning in their attachment to Maya. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har ras chaakhai koi ||
english: How rare is that Gurmukh who tastes the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tis sadaa ana(n)d hovai din raatee poorai bhaag paraapat hoi || rahaau ||
english: He is always in bliss, day and night; through perfect good destiny, he obtains the Name. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad deepak varatai tihu loi ||
english: The Word of the Shabad is a lamp, illuminating the three worlds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਚਾਖੈ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo chaakhai so niramal hoi ||
english: One who tastes it, becomes immaculate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
transliteration: niramal naam haumai mal dhoi ||
english: The immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, washes off the filth of ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saachee bhagat sadaa sukh hoi ||2||
english: True devotional worship brings lasting peace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jin har ras chaakhiaa so har jan log ||
english: One who tastes the sublime essence of the Lord is the Lord's humble servant.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: tis sadaa harakh naahee kade sog ||
english: He is forever happy; he is never sad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਅਵਰਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aap mukat avaraa mukat karaavai ||
english: He himself is liberated, and he liberates others as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har naam japai har te sukh paavai ||3||
english: He chants the Lord's Name, and through the Lord, he finds peace. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭ ਮੁਈ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur sabh muee bilalaai ||
english: Without the True Guru, everyone dies, crying out in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦਾਝਹਿ ਸਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin daajhahi saat na paai ||
english: Night and day, they burn, and find no peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai sabh trisan bujhaae ||
english: But meeting the True Guru, all thirst is quenched.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam saa(n)t sukh paae ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, one finds peace and tranquility. ||4||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa dhan a(n)tar naam samaale ||
english: Gather in and cherish forever the wealth of the Lord's Name, deep within;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t jinahi pratipaale ||
english: He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mukat padaarath tin kau paae ||
english: They alone obtain the treasure of Liberation,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kai naam rate liv laae ||1||
english: who are lovingly imbued with, and focused on the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te har naam dhan paavai ||
english: Serving the Guru, one obtains the wealth of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar paragaas har naam dhiaavai || rahaau ||
english: He is illumined and enlightened within, and he meditates on the Lord's Name. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਗੂੜਾ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu har ra(n)g gooRaa dhan pir hoi ||
english: This love for the Lord is like the love of the bride for her husband.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)t seegaar raave prabh soi ||
english: God ravishes and enjoys the soul-bride who is adorned with peace and tranquility.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: haumai vich prabh koi na paae ||
english: No one finds God through egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: moolahu bhulaa janam gavaae ||2||
english: Wandering away from the Primal Lord, the root of all, one wastes his life in vain. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gur te saat sahaj sukh baanee ||
english: Tranquility, celestial peace, pleasure and the Word of His Bani come from the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sevaa saachee naam samaanee ||
english: True is that service, which leads one to merge in the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: sabad milai preetam sadaa dhiaae ||
english: Blessed with the Word of the Shabad, he meditates forever on the Lord, the Beloved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saach naam vadiaaee paae ||3||
english: Through the True Name, glorious greatness is obtained. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa jug jug soi ||
english: The Creator Himself abides throughout the ages.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare melaavaa hoi ||
english: If He casts His Glance of Grace, then we meet Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gurabaanee te har ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: Through the Word of Gurbani, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak saach rate prabh aap milaae ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, God unites with Himself those who are imbued with Truth. ||4||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਤੀਜਾ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 teejaa ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਮੈਲੋ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jag mailaa mailo hoi jaai ||
english: The world is polluted, and those in the world become polluted as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aavai jaai doojai lobhaai ||
english: In attachment to duality, it comes and goes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਭ ਪਰਜ ਵਿਗੋਈ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai sabh paraj vigoee ||
english: This love of duality has ruined the entire world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: manamukh chotaa khaai apunee pat khoee ||1||
english: The self-willed manmukh suffers punishment, and forfeits his honor. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te jan niramal hoi ||
english: Serving the Guru, one becomes immaculate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਪਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar naam vasai pat ootam hoi || rahaau ||
english: He enshrines the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within, and his state becomes exalted. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ubare har saranaaee ||
english: The Gurmukhs are saved, taking to the Lord's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam raate bhagat driRaaee ||
english: Attuned to the Lord's Name, they commit themselves to devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਨੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhagat kare jan vadiaaee paae ||
english: The Lord's humble servant performs devotional worship, and is blessed with greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saach rate sukh sahaj samaae ||2||
english: Attuned to Truth, he is absorbed in celestial peace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: saache kaa gaahak viralaa ko jaan ||
english: Know that one who purchases the True Name is very rare.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad aap pachhaan ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he comes to understand himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saachee raas saachaa vaapaar ||
english: True is his capital, and true is his trade.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so dha(n)n purakh jis naam piaar ||3||
english: Blessed is that person, who loves the Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਇਕਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tin prabh saachai ik sach laae ||
english: God, the True Lord, has attached some to His True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ootam baanee sabad sunaae ||
english: They listen to the most sublime Word of His Bani, and the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: prabh saache kee saachee kaar ||
english: True is service to the True Lord God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam savaaranahaar ||4||4||
english: O Nanak, the Naam is the Embellisher. ||4||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo har sevahi tin bal jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who serve the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tin hiradai saach sachaa mukh naau ||
english: The Truth is in their hearts, and the True Name is on their lips.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saacho saach samaalihu dukh jaai ||
english: Dwelling upon the Truest of the True, their pains are dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saachai sabad vasai man aai ||1||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, the Lord comes to dwell in their minds. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gurabaanee sun mail gavaae ||
english: Listening to the Word of Gurbani, filth is washed off,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sahaje har naam ma(n)n vasaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and they naturally enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kooR kusat trisanaa agan bujhaae ||
english: One who conquers fraud, deceit and the fire of desire

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar saa(n)t sahaj sukh paae ||
english: finds tranquility, peace and pleasure within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਤਾ ਆਪੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bhaanai chalai taa aap jaai ||
english: If one walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, he eliminates his self-conceit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saach mahal paae har gun gaai ||2||
english: He finds the True Mansion of the Lord's Presence, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: na sabad boojhai na jaanai baanee ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukh does not understand the Shabad; he does not know the Word of the Guru's Bani,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhe dukh vihaanee ||
english: and so he passes his life in misery.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhete taa sukh paae ||
english: But if he meets the True Guru, then he finds peace,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: haumai vichahu thaak rahaae ||3||
english: and the ego within is silenced. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਦਾਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kis no kaheeai daataa ik soi ||
english: Who else should I speak to? The One Lord is the Giver of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa kare sabad milaavaa hoi ||
english: When He grants His Grace, then we obtain the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: mil preetam saache gun gaavaa ||
english: Meeting with my Beloved, I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak saache saachaa bhaavaa ||4||5||
english: O Nanak, becoming truthful, I have become pleasing to the True Lord. ||4||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਧਾਤੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man marai dhaat mar jaai ||
english: When the mind is conquered, its turbulent wanderings are stopped.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਨ ਮੂਏ ਕੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin man mooe kaise har paai ||
english: Without conquering the mind, how can the Lord be found?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu man marai daaroo jaanai koi ||
english: Rare is the one who knows the medicine to conquer the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man sabad marai boojhai jan soi ||1||
english: The mind is conquered through the Word of the Shabad; this is known to the Lord's humble servant. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jis no bakhase har de vadiaaee ||
english: The Lord forgives him, and blesses him with glory.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad vasai man aaee || rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh karanee kaar kamaavai ||
english: The Gurmukh does good deeds,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: taa is man kee sojhee paavai ||
english: and so, he comes to understand this mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਮਤੁ ਮੈਗਲ ਮਿਕਦਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man mai mat maigal mikadaaraa ||
english: The mind is intoxicated, like the elephant with wine.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur a(n)kas maar jeevaalanahaaraa ||2||
english: The Guru places the harness upon it, and rejuvenates it. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਸਾਧੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: man asaadh saadhai jan koee ||
english: The mind is undisciplined; only a rare few can discipline it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: achar charai taa niramal hoee ||
english: If someone eats the uneatable, then he becomes immaculate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਇਆ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ihu man laiaa savaar ||
english: As Gurmukh, his mind is embellished.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਤਜੈ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: haumai vichahu tajai vikaar ||3||
english: Egotism and corruption are eradicated from within. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo dhur rakhian mel milaai ||
english: Those whom the Primal Lord keeps united in His Union,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kade na vichhuRahi sabad samaai ||
english: shall never be separated from Him; they are merged in the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਕਲਾ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: aapanee kalaa aape prabh jaanai ||
english: Only God Himself knows His own power.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh naam pachhaanai ||4||6||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kaachaa dhan sa(n)chahi moorakh gaavaar ||
english: The ignorant fools amass false wealth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਅੰਧ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhoole a(n)dh gaavaar ||
english: The blind, foolish, self-willed manmukhs have gone astray.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੈ ਧਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa kai dhan sadaa dukh hoi ||
english: Poisonous wealth brings constant pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਸਾਥਿ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naa saath jaai na paraapat hoi ||1||
english: It will not go with you, and it will not yield any profit. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saachaa dhan guramatee paae ||
english: True wealth is obtained through the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaachaa dhan phun aavai jaae || rahaau ||
english: False wealth continues coming and going. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhoole sabh marahi gavaar ||
english: The foolish self-willed manmukhs all go astray and die.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੂਬੇ ਨ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhavajal doobe na uravaar na paar ||
english: They drown in the terrifying world-ocean, and they cannot reach either this shore, or the one beyond.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhete poorai bhaag ||
english: But by perfect destiny, they meet the True Guru;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saach rate ahinis bairaag ||2||
english: imbued with the True Name, day and night, they remain detached from the world. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: chahu jug mahi a(n)mrit saachee baanee ||
english: Throughout the four ages, the True Bani of His Word is Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag har naam samaanee ||
english: By perfect destiny, one is absorbed in the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਤਰਸਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik tarasahi sabh loi ||
english: The Siddhas, the seekers and all men long for the Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag paraapat hoi ||3||
english: It is obtained only by perfect destiny. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh saachaa saachaa hai soi ||
english: The True Lord is everything; He is True.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ootam braham pachhaanai koi ||
english: Only a few realize the exalted Lord God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਆਪਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sach saachaa sach aap driRaae ||
english: He is the Truest of the True; He Himself implants the True Name within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak aape vekhai aape sach laae ||4||7||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself sees all; He Himself links us to the Truth. ||4||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naavai kee keemat mit kahee na jaai ||
english: The value and worth of the Lord's Name cannot be described.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: se jan dha(n)n jin ik naam liv laai ||
english: Blessed are those humble beings, who lovingly focus their minds on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramat saachee saachaa veechaar ||
english: True are the Guru's Teachings, and True is contemplative meditation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape bakhase de veechaar ||1||
english: God Himself forgives, and bestows contemplative meditation. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har naam acharaj prabh aap sunaae ||
english: The Lord's Name is wonderful! God Himself imparts it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kalee kaal vich guramukh paae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Gurmukhs obtain it. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ham moorakh moorakh man maahi ||
english: We are ignorant; ignorance fills our minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: haumai vich sabh kaar kamaahi ||
english: We do all our deeds in ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ha(n)umai jaai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, egotism is eradicated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape bakhase lae milaai ||2||
english: Forgiving us, the Lord blends us with Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa kaa dhan bahut abhimaan ||
english: Poisonous wealth gives rise to great arrogance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਡੂਬੈ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)kaar doobai na paavai maan ||
english: Drowning in egotism, no one is honored.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aap chhod sadaa sukh hoee ||
english: Forsaking self-conceit, one finds lasting peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramat saalaahee sach soee ||3||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, he praises the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape saaje karataa soi ||
english: The Creator Lord Himself fashions all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na koi ||
english: Without Him, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jis sach laae soee laagai ||
english: He alone is attached to Truth, whom the Lord Himself so attaches.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak naam sadaa sukh aagai ||4||8||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, lasting peace is attained in the hereafter. ||4||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਿਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag dhanaasiree mahalaa 3 ghar 4 ||
english: Raag Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਭੀਖਕ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਨਿਜ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ham bheekhak bhekhaaree tere too nij pat hai daataa ||
english: I am just a poor beggar of Yours; You are Your Own Lord Master, You are the Great Giver.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦੈਆਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਕੰਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hohu daiaal naam dehu ma(n)gat jan ka(n)u sadaa rahau ra(n)g raataa ||1||
english: Be Merciful, and bless me, a humble beggar, with Your Name, so that I may forever remain imbued with Your Love. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੰਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)u balihaarai jaau saache tere naam vitahu ||
english: I am a sacrifice to Your Name, O True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran sabhanaa kaa eko avar na doojaa koee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The One Lord is the Cause of causes; there is no other at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਫੇਰ ਪਏ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਉ ਅਬ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: bahute pher pae kirapan kau ab kichh kirapaa keejai ||
english: I was wretched; I wandered through so many cycles of reincarnation. Now, Lord, please bless me with Your Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਐਸੀ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hohu daiaal darasan dehu apunaa aisee bakhas kareejai ||2||
english: Be merciful, and grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please grant me such a gift. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮ ਪਟ ਖੂਲੑੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak bharam pat khoolhe gur parasaadee jaaniaa ||
english: Prays Nanak, the shutters of doubt have been opened wide; by Guru's Grace, I have come to know the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥੧॥੯॥
transliteration: saachee liv laagee hai bheetar satigur siu man maaniaa ||3||1||9||
english: I am filled to overflowing with true love; my mind is pleased and appeased by the True Guru. ||3||1||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ghar 1 chaupade ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jo har sevahi sa(n)t bhagat tin ke sabh paap nivaaree ||
english: Those Saints and devotees who serve the Lord have all their sins washed away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਖੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਜੁ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ham oopar kirapaa kar suaamee rakh sa(n)gat tum j piaaree ||1||
english: Have Mercy on me, O Lord and Master, and keep me in the Sangat, the Congregation that You love. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har gun kahi na sakau banavaaree ||
english: I cannot even speak the Praises of the Lord, the Gardener of the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਥਰ ਨੀਰਿ ਡੁਬਤ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਖਣ ਹਮ ਤਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham paapee paathar neer dubat kar kirapaa paakhan ham taaree || rahaau ||
english: We are sinners, sinking like stones in water; grant Your Grace, and carry us stones across. ||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੋਰਚਾ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke laage bikh morachaa lag sa(n)gat saadh savaaree ||
english: The rust of poison and corruption from countless incarnations sticks to us; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, it is cleaned away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਤਾਇਓ ਮਲੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਟਿਤ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu ka(n)chan baisa(n)tar taaio mal kaatee katit utaaree ||2||
english: It is just like gold, which is heated in the fire, to remove the impurities from it. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਜਪਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har har japan japau din raatee jap har har har ur dhaaree ||
english: I chant the chant of the Name of the Lord, day and night; I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and enshrine it within my heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਗਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har har aukhadh jag pooraa jap har har haumai maaree ||3||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, is the most perfect medicine in this world; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have conquered my ego. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har har agam agaadh bodh apara(n)par purakh apaaree ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is unapproachable, of unfathomable wisdom, unlimited, all-powerful and infinite.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jan kau kripaa karahu jagajeevan jan naanak paij savaaree ||4||1||
english: Show Mercy to Your humble servant, O Life of the world, and save the honor of servant Nanak. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t janaa har japio tin kaa dookh bharam bhau bhaagee ||
english: The humble Saints of the Lord meditate on the Lord; their pain, doubt and fear have run away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apanee sevaa aap karaaee guramat a(n)tar jaagee ||1||
english: The Lord Himself inspires them to serve Him; they are awakened within to the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: har kai naam rataa bairaagee ||
english: Imbued with the Lord's Name, they are unattached to the world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har kathaa sunee man bhaaee guramat har liv laagee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Listening to the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, their minds are pleased; through Guru's Instruction, they enshrine love for the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਸਾਂਗੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee jaat har suaamee tumh thaakur ham saa(n)gee ||
english: God, the Lord and Master, is the caste and social status of His humble Saints. You are the Lord and Master; I am just Your puppet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਤੈਸੇ ਬੁਲਗ ਬੁਲਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaisee mat devahu har suaamee ham taise bulag bulaagee ||2||
english: As is the understanding You bless us with, so are the words we speak. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਕਿਰਮ ਨਾਨੑ ਨਿਕ ਕੀਰੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: kiaa ham kiram naanh nik keere tumh vad purakh vadaagee ||
english: What are we? Tiny worms, and microscopic germs. You are our great and glorious Lord and Master.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਅਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tumhree gat mit kahi na sakah prabh ham kiu kar milah abhaagee ||3||
english: I cannot describe Your state and extent. O God, how can we unfortunate ones meet with You? ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: har prabh suaamee kirapaa dhaarahu ham har har sevaa laagee ||
english: O God, my Lord and Master, shower me with Your Mercy, and commit me to Your service.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਥਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak daasan daas karahu prabh ham har kathaa kathaagee ||4||2||
english: Make Nanak the slave of Your slaves, God; I speak the speech of the Lord's sermon. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: har kaa sa(n)t satagur sat purakhaa jo bolai har har baanee ||
english: The True Guru is the Lord's Saint, the True Being, who chants the Bani of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo jo kahai sunai so mukataa ham tis kai sad kurabaanee ||1||
english: Whoever chants it, and listens to it, is liberated; I am forever a sacrifice to him. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t sunahu jas kaanee ||
english: O Saints of the Lord, listen to the Lord's Praises with your ears.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਲ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har kathaa sunahu ik nimakh pal sabh kilavikh paap lahi jaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Listen to the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, for a moment, for even an instant, and all your sins and mistakes shall be erased. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: aisaa sa(n)t saadh jin paaiaa te vad purakh vadaanee ||
english: Those who find such humble, Holy Saints, are the greatest of the great persons.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੰਗਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਚ ਲੁਚਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin kee dhoor ma(n)gah prabh suaamee ham har loch luchaanee ||2||
english: I beg for the dust of their feet; I long for the longing for God, my Lord and Master. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਓ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: har har saphalio birakh prabh suaamee jin japio se tripataanee ||
english: The Name of God, the Lord and Master, Har, Har, is the fruit-bearing tree; those who meditate on it are satisfied.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਭੁਖਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har a(n)mrit pee tripataase sabh laathee bhookh bhukhaanee ||3||
english: Drinking in the ambrosia of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am satisfied; all my hunger and thirst is quenched. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਜਪਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jin ke vade bhaag vad ooche tin har japio japaanee ||
english: Those who are blessed with the highest, loftiest destiny, chant and meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: tin har sa(n)gat mel prabh suaamee jan naanak daas dasaanee ||4||3||
english: Let me join their congregation, O God, my Lord and Master; Nanak is the slave of their slaves. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਅੰਧ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਕਿਉ ਚਾਲਹ ਗੁਰ ਚਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: ham a(n)dhule a(n)dh bikhai bikh raate kiu chaalah gur chaalee ||
english: I am blind, totally blind, entangled in corruption and poison. How can I walk on the Guru's Path?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਮ ਲਾਵੈ ਆਪਨ ਪਾਲੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satagur daiaa kare sukhadaataa ham laavai aapan paalee ||1||
english: If the True Guru, the Giver of peace, shows His kindness, He attaches us to the hem of His robe. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੀਤ ਚਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: gurasikh meet chalahu gur chaalee ||
english: O Sikhs of the Guru, O friends, walk on the Guru's Path.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo gur kahai soee bhal maanahu har har kathaa niraalee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever the Guru says, accept that as good; the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is unique and wonderful. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਬੇਗਿ ਬੇਗਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t sunahu jan bhaaee gur sevihu beg begaalee ||
english: O Saints of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, listen: serve the Guru, quickly now!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਧਹੁ ਮਤ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਆਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਾਲੑੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satagur sev kharach har baadhahu mat jaanahu aaj k kaalhee ||2||
english: Let your service to the True Guru be your supplies on the Lord's Path; pack them up, and don't think of today or tomorrow. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਚਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t japahu har japanaa har sa(n)t chalai har naalee ||
english: O Saints of the Lord, chant the chant of the Lord's Name; the Lord's Saints walk with the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕੇਲ ਕੇਲਾਲੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin har japiaa se har hoe har miliaa kel kelaalee ||3||
english: Those who meditate on the Lord, become the Lord; the playful, wondrous Lord meets them. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਲੋਚ ਲੋੁਚਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: har har japan jap loch louchaanee har kirapaa kar banavaalee ||
english: To chant the chant of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is the longing I long for; have Mercy upon me, O Lord of the world-forest.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਮ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਰਾਲੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak sa(n)gat saadh har melahu ham saadh janaa pag raalee ||4||4||
english: O Lord, unite servant Nanak with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; make me the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: har har boo(n)d bhae har suaamee ham chaatrik bilal bilalaatee ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is the rain-drop; I am the song-bird, crying, crying out for it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਖਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har kripaa karahu prabh apanee mukh devahu har nimakhaatee ||1||
english: O Lord God, please bless me with Your Mercy, and pour Your Name into my mouth, even if for only an instant. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਇਕ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: har bin rahi na sakau ik raatee ||
english: Without the Lord, I cannot live for even a second.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਮਲੈ ਅਮਲੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਹੈ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਮ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu bin amalai amalee mar jaaee hai tiu har bin ham mar jaatee || rahaau ||
english: Like the addict who dies without his drug, I die without the Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਵਰ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਾਹ ਹਮ ਲਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: tum har saravar at agaah ham lahi na sakahi a(n)t maatee ||
english: You, Lord, are the deepest, most unfathomable ocean; I cannot find even a trace of Your limits.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਗਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too parai parai apara(n)par suaamee mit jaanahu aapan gaatee ||2||
english: You are the most remote of the remote, limitless and transcendent; O Lord Master, You alone know Your state and extent. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t janaa har japio gur ra(n)g chaloolai raatee ||
english: The Lord's humble Saints meditate on the Lord; they are imbued with the deep crimson color of the Guru's Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਅਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਊਤਮ ਪਾਤੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har bhagat banee at sobhaa har japio ootam paatee ||3||
english: Meditating on the Lord, they attain great glory, and the most sublime honor. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਵੈ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: aape thaakur aape sevak aap banaavai bhaatee ||
english: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the servant; He Himself creates His environments.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਭਗਾਤੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak jan tumaree saranaaee har raakhahu laaj bhagaatee ||4||5||
english: Servant Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, O Lord; protect and preserve the honor of Your devotee. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ ਕਿਵ ਛੂਟਹ ਹਮ ਛੁਟਕਾਕੀ ॥
transliteration: kalijug kaa dharam kahahu tum bhaaee kiv chhootah ham chhutakaakee ||
english: Tell me, O Siblings of Destiny, the religion for this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. I seek emancipation - how can I be emancipated?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਤਰੈ ਤਰਾਕੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har jap beRee har tulahaa har japio tarai taraakee ||1||
english: Meditation on the Lord, Har, Har, is the boat, the raft; meditating on the Lord, the swimmer swims across. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: har jee laaj rakhahu har jan kee ||
english: O Dear Lord, protect and preserve the honor of Your humble servant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਹਮ ਮਾਗੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਕਾਕੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har japan japaavahu apanaa ham maagee bhagat ikaakee || rahaau ||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, please make me chant the chant of Your Name; I beg only for Your devotional worship. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਬਚਨਾਕੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke sevak se har piaare jin japio har bachanaakee ||
english: The Lord's servants are very dear to the Lord; they chant the Word of the Lord's Bani.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤਿ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਭ ਛੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: lekhaa chitr gupat jo likhiaa sabh chhootee jam kee baakee ||2||
english: The account of the recording angels, Chitr and Gupt, and the account with the Messenger of Death is totally erased. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਪਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t japio man har har lag sa(n)gat saadh janaa kee ||
english: The Saints of the Lord meditate on the Lord in their minds; they join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ਸਿਵ ਚਰਿਓ ਚੰਦੁ ਚੰਦਾਕੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dineear soor trisanaa agan bujhaanee siv chario cha(n)d cha(n)daakee ||3||
english: The piercing sun of desires has set, and the cool moon has risen. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਾਕੀ ॥
transliteration: tum vad purakh vad agam agochar tum aape aap apaakee ||
english: You are the Greatest Being, absolutely unapproachable and unfathomable; You created the Universe from Your Own Being.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਕੀ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau prabh kirapaa keejai kar daasan daas dasaakee ||4||6||
english: O God, take pity on servant Nanak, and make him the slave of the slave of Your slaves. ||4||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ghar 5 dupade ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl, Fifth House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਰਮੋ ਰਮੁ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: ur dhaar beechaar muraar ramo ram manamohan naam japeene ||
english: Enshrine the Lord within your heart, and contemplate Him. Dwell upon Him, reflect upon Him, and chant the Name of the Lord, the Enticer of hearts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: adrisat agochar apara(n)par suaamee gur poorai pragat kar deene ||1||
english: The Lord Master is unseen, unfathomable and unreachable; through the Perfect Guru, He is revealed. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਪਾਰਸ ਚੰਦਨ ਹਮ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਸਟ ॥
transliteration: raam paaras cha(n)dan ham kaasat losat ||
english: The Lord is the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold, and sandalwood, while I am just dry wood and iron.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰੀ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਕੀਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)g haree satasa(n)g bhae har ka(n)chan cha(n)dan keene ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Associating with the Lord, and the Sat Sangat, the Lord's True Congregation, the Lord has transformed me into gold and sandalwood. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਛਿਅ ਖਟੁ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਮੁਖ ਆਗਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਵ ਨ ਪਤੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: nav chhi khat bolahi mukh aagar meraa har prabh iv na pateene ||
english: One may repeat, verbatim, the nine grammars and the six Shaastras, but my Lord God is not pleased by this.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਇਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭੀਨੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
transliteration: jan naanak har hiradai sad dhiaavahu iu har prabh meraa bheene ||2||1||7||
english: O servant Nanak, meditate forever on the Lord in your heart; this is what pleases my Lord God. ||2||1||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਕਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਇਵ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: gun kahu har lahu kar sevaa satigur iv har har naam dhiaaee ||
english: Chant His Praises, learn of the Lord, and serve the True Guru; in this way, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har daragah bhaavahi phir janam na aavahi har har har jot samaaee ||1||
english: In the Court of the Lord, He shall be pleased with you, and you shall not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again; you shall merge in the Divine Light of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
transliteration: jap man naam haree hohi sarab sukhee ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, O my mind, and you shall be totally at peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਊਚ ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਛਡਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jas ooch sabhanaa te oopar har har har sev chhadaaee || rahaau ||
english: The Lord's Praises are the most sublime, the most exalted; serving the Lord, Har, Har, Har, you shall be emancipated. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਤਬ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: har kripaa nidh keenee gur bhagat har deenee tab har siu preet ban aaee ||
english: The Lord, the treasure of mercy, blessed me, and so the Guru blessed me with the Lord's devotional worship; I have come to be in love with the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੮॥
transliteration: bahu chi(n)t visaaree har naam ur dhaaree naanak har bhae hai sakhaaee ||2||2||8||
english: I have forgotten my cares and anxieties, and enshrined the Lord's Name in my heart; O Nanak, the Lord has become my friend and companion. ||2||2||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੜੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har paR har likh har jap har gaau har bhaujal paar utaaree ||
english: Read about the Lord, write about the Lord, chant the Lord's Name, and sing the Lord's Praises; the Lord will carry you across the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਇਵ ਭਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man bachan ridai dhiaai har hoi sa(n)tusat iv bhan har naam muraaree ||1||
english: In your mind, by your words, and within your heart, meditate on the Lord, and He will be pleased. In this way, repeat the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
transliteration: man japeeai har jagadees ||
english: O mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)gat saadhoo meet ||
english: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O friend.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d hovai din raatee har keerat kar banavaaree || rahaau ||
english: You shall be happy forever, day and night; sing the Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the world-forest. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤਬ ਭਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har har karee drisat tab bhaio man udam har har naam japio gat bhaee hamaaree ||
english: When the Lord, Har, Har, casts His Glance of Grace, then I made the effort in my mind; meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been emancipated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੯॥
transliteration: jan naanak kee pat raakh mere suaamee har aai pario hai saran tumaaree ||2||3||9||
english: Preserve the honor of servant Nanak, O my Lord and Master; I have come seeking Your Sanctuary. ||2||3||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕੋਟਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸਭਿ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chauraaseeh sidh budh tetees kot mun jan sabh chaahahi har jeeu tero naau ||
english: The eighty-four Siddhas, the spiritual masters, the Buddhas, the three hundred thirty million gods and the silent sages, all long for Your Name, O Dear Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur prasaad ko viralaa paavai jin kau lilaat likhiaa dhur bhaau ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, a rare few obtain it; upon their foreheads, the pre-ordained destiny of loving devotion is written. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jap man raamai naam har jas ootam kaam ||
english: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord; singing the Lord's Praises is the most exalted activity.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo gaavahi sunahi teraa jas suaamee hau tin kai sad balihaarai jaau || rahaau ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who sing, and hear Your Praises, O Lord and Master. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saranaagat pratipaalak har suaamee jo tum dehu soee hau paau ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Cherisher God, my Lord and Master; whatever You give me, I accept.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਚਾਉ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: deen daiaal kripaa kar deejai naanak har simaran kaa hai chaau ||2||4||10||
english: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, give me this blessing; Nanak longs for the Lord's meditative remembrance. ||2||4||10||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਖ ਪੂਜਣ ਸਭਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sevak sikh poojan sabh aavahi sabh gaavahi har har ootam baanee ||
english: All the Sikhs and servants come to worship and adore You; they sing the sublime Bani of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਿਆ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gaaviaa suniaa tin kaa har thaai paavai jin satigur kee aagiaa sat sat kar maanee ||1||
english: Their singing and listening is approved by the Lord; they accept the Order of the True Guru as True, totally True. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਵਜਲ ਤੀਰਥਿ ॥
transliteration: bolahu bhaaee har keerat har bhavajal teerath ||
english: Chant the Lord's Praises, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage in the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਤ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਜਿਨ ਜਨਹੁ ਜਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har dar tin kee ootam baat hai sa(n)tahu har kathaa jin janahu jaanee || rahaau ||
english: They alone are praised in the Court of the Lord, O Saints, who know and understand the Lord's sermon. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: aape gur chelaa hai aape aape har prabh choj vidaanee ||
english: He Himself is the Guru, and He Himself is the disciple; the Lord God Himself plays His wondrous games.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਸੀ ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਓਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak aap milaae soee har milasee avar sabh tiaag ohaa har bhaanee ||2||5||11||
english: O servant Nanak, he alone merges with the Lord, whom the Lord Himself merges; all the others are forsaken, but the Lord loves him. ||2||5||11||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰਕੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਕਾਮਧੇਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ichhaa poorak sarab sukhadaataa har jaa kai vas hai kaamadhenaa ||
english: The Lord is the Fulfiller of desires, the Giver of total peace; the Kaamadhaynaa, the wish-fulfilling cow, is in His power.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਤਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so aisaa har dhiaaeeai mere jeeaRe taa sarab sukh paavahi mere manaa ||1||
english: So meditate on such a Lord, O my soul. Then, you shall obtain total peace, O my mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jap man sat naam sadaa sat naam ||
english: Chant, O my mind, the True Name, Sat Naam, the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: halat palat mukh oojal hoee hai nit dhiaaeeai har purakh nira(n)janaa || rahaau ||
english: In this world, and in the world beyond, your face shall be radiant, by meditating continually on the immaculate Lord God. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਹ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਗਤੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jah har simaran bhaiaa tah upaadh gat keenee vadabhaagee har japanaa ||
english: Wherever anyone remembers the Lord in meditation, disaster runs away from that place. By great good fortune, we meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਨਾ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau gur ih mat deenee jap har bhavajal taranaa ||2||6||12||
english: The Guru has blessed servant Nanak with this understanding, that by meditating on the Lord, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||6||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mere saahaa mai har darasan sukh hoi ||
english: O my King, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, I am at peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੀ ਬੇਦਨਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਨਤਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hamaree bedan too jaanataa saahaa avar kiaa jaanai koi || rahaau ||
english: You alone know my inner pain, O King; what can anyone else know? ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahib sach too mere saahaa teraa keeaa sach sabh hoi ||
english: O True Lord and Master, You are truly my King; whatever You do, all that is True.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਾਹਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jhoothaa kis kau aakheeai saahaa doojaa naahee koi ||1||
english: Who should I call a liar? There is no other than You, O King. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa vich too varatadaa saahaa sabh tujhahi dhiaavahi din raat ||
english: You are pervading and permeating in all; O King, everyone meditates on You, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਕ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh tujh hee thaavahu ma(n)gade mere saahaa too sabhanaa karahi ik daat ||2||
english: Everyone begs of You, O my King; You alone give gifts to all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko tujh hee vich hai mere saahaa tujh te baahar koee naahi ||
english: All are under Your Power, O my King; none at all are beyond You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh jee tere too sabhas daa mere saahaa sabh tujh hee maahi samaahi ||3||
english: All beings are Yours-You belong to all, O my King. All shall merge and be absorbed in You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਆਸ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa kee too aas hai mere piaare sabh tujhahi dhiaavahi mere saah ||
english: You are the hope of all, O my Beloved; all meditate on You, O my King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu rakh too mere piaare sach naanak ke paatisaah ||4||7||13||
english: As it pleases You, protect and preserve me, O my Beloved; You are the True King of Nanak. ||4||7||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 1 chaupade ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bhav kha(n)dan dukh bha(n)jan svaamee bhagat vachhal nira(n)kaare ||
english: O Destroyer of fear, Remover of suffering, Lord and Master, Lover of Your devotees, Formless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਮਿਟੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਾਂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kot paraadh mite khin bheetar jaa(n) guramukh naam samaare ||1||
english: Millions of sins are eradicated in an instant when, as Gurmukh, one contemplates the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: meraa man laagaa hai raam piaare ||
english: My mind is attached to my Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal karee prabh kirapaa vas keene pa(n)ch dootaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God, Merciful to the meek, granted His Grace, and placed the five enemies under my control. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: teraa thaan suhaavaa roop suhaavaa tere bhagat sohahi darabaare ||
english: Your place is so beautiful; Your form is so beautiful; Your devotees look so beautiful in Your Court.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sarab jeeaa ke daate suaamee kar kirapaa lehu ubaare ||2||
english: O Lord and Master, Giver of all beings, please, grant Your Grace, and save me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: teraa varan na jaapai roop na lakheeai teree kudarat kaun beechaare ||
english: Your color is not known, and Your form is not seen; who can contemplate Your Almighty Creative Power?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪ ਗਿਰਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal raviaa srab thaaee agam roop giradhaare ||3||
english: You are contained in the water, the land and the sky, everywhere, O Lord of unfathomable form, Holder of the mountain. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: keerat karahi sagal jan teree too abinaasee purakh muraare ||
english: All beings sing Your Praises; You are the imperishable Primal Being, the Destroyer of ego.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakhahu suaamee jan naanak saran duaare ||4||1||
english: As it pleases You, please protect and preserve me; servant Nanak seeks Sanctuary at Your Door. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਜੇ ਹੈ ਮੀਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਲ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਬਢਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: bin jal praan taje hai meenaa jin jal siu het badhaaio ||
english: The fish out of water loses its life; it is deeply in love with the water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਮਲ ਹੇਤਿ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਹੈ ਭਵਰਾ ਉਨਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਨਿਕਸਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kamal het binasio hai bhavaraa un maarag nikas na paaio ||1||
english: The bumble bee, totally in love with the lotus flower, is lost in it; it cannot find the way to escape from it. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮਨ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਮੋਹੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ab man ekas siu mohu keenaa ||
english: Now, my mind has nurtured love for the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: marai na jaavai sad hee sa(n)ge satigurasabadee cheenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He does not die, and is not born; He is always with me. Through the Word of the True Guru's Shabad, I know Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਹੇਤਿ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਲੈ ਫਾਂਕਿਓ ਓਹੁ ਪਰ ਵਸਿ ਭਇਓ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam het ku(n)char lai phaa(n)kio ohu par vas bhaio bichaaraa ||
english: Lured by sexual desire, the elephant is trapped; the poor beast falls into the power of another.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਦ ਹੇਤਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਕੁਰੰਕਾ ਉਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਤ ਬਿਦਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naad het sir daario kura(n)kaa us hee het bidaaraa ||2||
english: Lured by the sound of the hunter's bell, the deer offers its head; because of this enticement, it is killed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: dekh kuta(n)b lobh mohio praanee maaiaa kau lapataanaa ||
english: Gazing upon his family, the mortal is enticed by greed; he clings in attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਉਨਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਰਾਪਰ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: at rachio kar leeno apunaa un chhod saraapar jaanaa ||3||
english: Totally engrossed in worldly things, he considers them to be his own; but in the end, he shall surely have to leave them behind. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੇਹਾ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: bin gobi(n)d avar sa(n)g nehaa ohu jaanahu sadaa duhelaa ||
english: Know it well, that anyone who loves any other than God, shall be miserable forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਇਹੈ ਬੁਝਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur ihai bujhaaio preet prabhoo sad kelaa ||4||2||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has explained this to me, that love for God brings lasting bliss. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mah 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa deeo mohi naamaa ba(n)dhan te chhutakaae ||
english: Granting His Grace, God has blessed me with His Name, and released me of my bonds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਸਗਲੋ ਧੰਧਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man te bisario sagalo dha(n)dhaa gur kee charanee laae ||1||
english: I have forgotten all worldly entanglements, and I am attached to the Guru's feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਚਿੰਤ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ ਛਾਡੀ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g chi(n)t biraanee chhaadee ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have renounced my other cares and anxieties.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮੋਹ ਮਨ ਬਾਸਨ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਗਡਹਾ ਗਾਡੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)budh moh man baasan de kar gadahaa gaadee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I dug a deep pit, and buried my egotistical pride, emotional attachment and the desires of my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕਿਸ ਕੇ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naa ko meraa dusaman rahiaa naa ham kis ke bairaaee ||
english: No one is my enemy, and I am no one's enemy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਾਰੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਓ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: braham pasaar pasaario bheetar satigur te sojhee paaee ||2||
english: God, who expanded His expanse, is within all; I learned this from the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮ ਆਪਨ ਕੀਨਾ ਹਮ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਸਾਜਨ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko meet ham aapan keenaa ham sabhanaa ke saajan ||
english: I am a friend to all; I am everyone's friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਓ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਤਾ ਮੇਲੁ ਕੀਓ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਾਜਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: door paraaio man kaa birahaa taa mel keeo merai raajan ||3||
english: When the sense of separation was removed from my mind, then I was united with the Lord, my King. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਢੀਠਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੂਠਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਗੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: binasio dheethaa a(n)mrit voothaa sabad lago gur meethaa ||
english: My stubbornness is gone, Ambrosial Nectar rains down, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad seems so sweet to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਮਈਆ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal sarab nivaasee naanak ramaeeaa deethaa ||4||3||
english: He is pervading everywhere, in the water, on the land and in the sky; Nanak beholds the all-pervading Lord. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mah 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਲੇ ਦਿਨਸ ਓਇ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: jab te darasan bhete saadhoo bhale dinas oi aae ||
english: Ever since I obtained the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy, my days have been blessed and prosperous.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mahaa ana(n)d sadaa kar keeratan purakh bidhaataa paae ||1||
english: I have found lasting bliss, singing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Primal Lord, the Architect of destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਸੋ ਮਨਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: ab mohi raam jaso man gaaio ||
english: Now, I sing the Praises of the Lord within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaio pragaas sadaa sukh man mahi satigur pooraa paaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind has been illumined and enlightened, and it is always at peace; I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਰਿਦ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan rid bheetar vasiaa taa dookh bharam bhau bhaagaa ||
english: The Lord, the treasure of virtue, abides deep within the heart, and so pain, doubt and fear have been dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhaee paraapat vasat agochar raam naam ra(n)g laagaa ||2||
english: I have obtained the most incomprehensible thing, enshrining love for the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਸੋਚ ਅਸੋਚਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਥਾਕਾ ॥
transliteration: chi(n)t achi(n)taa soch asochaa sog lobh mohu thaakaa ||
english: I was anxious, and now I am free of anxiety; I was worried, and now I am free of worry; my grief, greed and emotional attachments are gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਬਿਬਾਕਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: haumai rog mite kirapaa te jam te bhae bibaakaa ||3||
english: By His Grace, I am cured of the disease of egotism, and the Messenger of Death no longer terrifies me. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kee tahal guroo kee sevaa gur kee aagiaa bhaanee ||
english: Working for the Guru, serving the Guru and the Guru's Command, all are pleasing to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jin jam te kaadhe tis gur kai kurabaanee ||4||4||
english: Says Nanak, He has released me from the clutches of Death; I am a sacrifice to that Guru. ||4||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa tan man dhan sabh tis kaa soee sughaR sujaanee ||
english: Body, mind, wealth and everything belong to Him; He alone is all-wise and all-knowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਉ ਬਿਧਿ ਨੀਕੀ ਖਟਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin hee suniaa dukh sukh meraa tau bidh neekee khataanee ||1||
english: He listens to my pains and pleasures, and then my condition improves. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਏਕੈ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jee kee ekai hee pahi maanee ||
english: My soul is satisfied with the One Lord alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avar jatan kar rahe bahutere tin til nahee keemat jaanee || rahaau ||
english: People make all sorts of other efforts, but they have no value at all. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਮੰਤਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam niramolak heeraa gur deeno ma(n)taanee ||
english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel. The Guru has given me this advice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਿਗੈ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: digai na dolai driR kar rahio pooran hoi tripataanee ||2||
english: It cannot be lost, and it cannot be shaken off; it remains steady, and I am perfectly satisfied with it. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜੁ ਬੀਚ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਬਿਲਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: oi j beech ham tum kachh hote tin kee baat bilaanee ||
english: Those things which tore me away from You, Lord, are now gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਲੰਕਾਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਥੈਲੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ala(n)kaar mil thailee hoee hai taa te kanik vakhaanee ||3||
english: When golden ornaments are melted down into a lump, they are still said to be gold. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਸੋਭਾ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: pragatio jot sahaj sukh sobhaa baaje anahat baanee ||
english: The Divine Light has illuminated me, and I am filled with celestial peace and glory; the unstruck melody of the Lord's Bani resounds within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਬੰਧਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak nihachal ghar baadhio gur keeo ba(n)dhaanee ||4||5||
english: Says Nanak, I have built my eternal home; the Guru has constructed it for me. ||4||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਰਾਜਨ ਅਰੁ ਭੂਮਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੀ ॥
transliteration: vade vade raajan ar bhooman taa kee trisan na boojhee ||
english: The desires of the greatest of the great kings and landlords cannot be satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਤੇ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lapat rahe maaiaa ra(n)g maate lochan kachhoo na soojhee ||1||
english: They remain engrossed in Maya, intoxicated with the pleasures of their wealth; their eyes see nothing else at all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa mahi kin hee tripat na paaee ||
english: No one has ever found satisfaction in sin and corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਈਧਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਅਘਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu paavak eedhan nahee dhraapai bin har kahaa aghaaee || rahaau ||
english: The flame is not satisfied by more fuel; how can one be satisfied without the Lord? ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਤ ਭੋਜਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਭੂਖਾ ॥
transliteration: din din karat bhojan bahu bi(n)jan taa kee mitai na bhookhaa ||
english: Day after day, he eats his meals with many different foods, but his hunger is not eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਆਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਟਾ ਘੋਖਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: udam karai suaan kee niaaee chaare ku(n)taa ghokhaa ||2||
english: He runs around like a dog, searching in the four directions. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਵੰਤ ਕਾਮੀ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਹ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ॥
transliteration: kaamava(n)t kaamee bahu naaree par grih joh na chookai ||
english: The lustful, lecherous man desires many women, and he never stops peeking into the homes of others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਕਰੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਪੈ ਸੋਗ ਲੋਭ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਕੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: din prat karai karai pachhutaapai sog lobh mahi sookai ||3||
english: Day after day, he commits adultery again and again, and then he regrets his actions; he wastes away in misery and greed. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam apaar amolaa a(n)mrit ek nidhaanaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is incomparable and priceless; it is the treasure of Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d sa(n)tan kai naanak gur te jaanaa ||4||6||
english: The Saints abide in peace, poise and bliss; O Nanak, through the Guru, this is known. ||4||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mah 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਕਛੂਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: lavai na laagan kau hai kachhooai jaa kau phir ihu dhaavai ||
english: Nothing which this mortal being runs after, can compare to it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਇਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
