transliteration: jaa kau gur deeno ihu a(n)mrit tis hee kau ban aavai ||1||
english: He alone comes to have it, whom the Guru blesses with this Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਇਓ ਏਕੁ ਰਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau aaio ek rasaa ||
english: The desire to eat, to wear new clothes, and all other desires,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਖੁਧਿਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਬਸਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khaan paan aan nahee khudhiaa taa kai chit na basaa || rahaau ||
english: Do not abide in the mind of one who comes to know the subtle essence of the One Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਉਲਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਹਰਿਆ ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maulio man tan hoio hariaa ek boo(n)d jin paaee ||
english: The mind and body blossom forth in abundance, when one receives even a drop of this Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: baran na saakau usatat taa kee keemat kahan na jaaee ||2||
english: I cannot express His glory; I cannot describe His worth. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਾਲ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਆਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ghaal na milio sev na milio milio aai achi(n)taa ||
english: We cannot meet the Lord by our own efforts, nor can we meet Him through service; He comes and meets us spontaneously.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਮੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kau daiaa karee merai thaakur tin gurahi kamaano ma(n)taa ||3||
english: One who is blessed by my Lord Master's Grace, practices the Teachings of the Guru's Mantra. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal sadaa kirapaalaa sarab jeeaa pratipaalaa ||
english: He is merciful to the meek, always kind and compassionate; He cherishes and nurtures all beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਲ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: ot pot naanak sa(n)g raviaa jiu maataa baal goupaalaa ||4||7||
english: The Lord is mingled with Nanak, through and through; He cherishes him, like the mother her child. ||4||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਾਯਾ ॥
transliteration: baar jaau gur apune oopar jin har har naam driRhaayaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has implanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੀਧਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਯਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mahaa udiaan a(n)dhakaar mahi jin seedhaa maarag dikhaayaa ||1||
english: In the utter darkness of the wilderness, He showed me the straight path. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: hamare praan gupaal gobi(n)d ||
english: The Lord of the universe, the Cherisher of the world, He is my breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਕੀ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: eehaa oohaa sarab thok kee jisahi hamaaree chi(n)d ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Here and hereafter, he takes care of everything for me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran sarab nidhaanaa maan mahat pat pooree ||
english: Meditating on Him in remembrance, I have found all treasures, respect, greatness and perfect honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਨਾਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਧੂਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam lait kot agh naase bhagat baachhahi sabh dhooree ||2||
english: Remembering His Name, millions of sins are erased; all His devotees long for the dust of His feet. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਚਾਹੈ ਸੇਵੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab manorath je ko chaahai sevai ek nidhaanaa ||
english: If someone wishes for the fulfillment of all his hopes and desires, he should serve the one supreme treasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paarabraham apara(n)par suaamee simarat paar paraanaa ||3||
english: He is the Supreme Lord God, infinite Lord and Master; meditating on Him in remembrance, one is carried across. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਓਲੑਾ ॥
transliteration: seetal saa(n)t mahaa sukh paaiaa sa(n)tasa(n)g rahio olhaa ||
english: I have found total peace and tranquility in the Society of the Saints; my honor has been preserved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਨੋ ਚੋਲੑਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: har dhan sa(n)chan har naam bhojan ihu naanak keeno cholhaa ||4||8||
english: To gather in the Lord's wealth, and to taste the food of the Lord's Name - Nanak has made this his feast. ||4||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸਰਮਿੰਦਾ ਇਹਾ ਕਮਾਨੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jih karanee hovahi sarami(n)daa ihaa kamaanee reet ||
english: You have made it your habit to practice those deeds which will bring you shame.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਐਸੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੀ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kee ni(n)daa saakat kee poojaa aisee driRhee bipareet ||1||
english: You slander the Saints, and you worship the faithless cynics; such are the corrupt ways you have adopted. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਭੂਲੋ ਅਵਰੈ ਹੀਤ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa moh bhoolo avarai heet ||
english: Deluded by your emotional attachment to Maya, you love other things,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਬਨ ਹਰ ਪਾਤ ਰੇ ਇਹੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਬੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: haricha(n)dauree ban har paat re ihai tuhaaro beet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: like the enchanted city of Hari-chandauree, or the green leaves of the forest - such is your way of life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪ ਹੋਤ ਦੇਹ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਗਰਧਭ ਭਸਮ ਸੰਗੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)dan lep hot deh kau sukh garadhabh bhasam sa(n)geet ||
english: Its body may be anointed with sandalwood oil, but the donkey still loves to roll in the mud.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਰੁਚ ਆਵਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit sa(n)g naahi ruch aavat bikhai thagauree preet ||2||
english: He is not fond of the Ambrosial Nectar; instead, he loves the poisonous drug of corruption. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਤਮ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਵਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: utam sa(n)t bhale sa(n)jogee is jug mahi pavit puneet ||
english: The Saints are noble and sublime; they are blessed with good fortune. They alone are pure and holy in this world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਕਾਚ ਬਾਦਰੈ ਜੀਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaat akaarath janam padaarath kaach baadarai jeet ||3||
english: The jewel of this human life is passing away uselessly, lost in exchange for mere glass. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਦੀਤ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh dukh bhaage gur giaan a(n)jan netr deet ||
english: The sins and sorrows of uncounted incarnations run away, when the Guru applies the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom to the eyes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਇਨ ਦੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਪਰੀਤ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g in dukh te nikasio naanak ek pareet ||4||9||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have escaped from these troubles; Nanak loves the One Lord. ||4||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਨੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: paanee pakhaa peesau sa(n)t aagai gun govi(n)d jas gaaee ||
english: I carry the water, wave the fan, and grind the corn for the Saints; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saas saas man naam samhaarai ihu bisraam nidh paaee ||1||
english: With each and every breath, my mind remembers the Naam, the Name of the Lord; in this way, it finds the treasure of peace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tumh karahu daiaa mere saaee ||
english: Have pity on me, O my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aisee mat deejai mere thaakur sadaa sadaa tudh dhiaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Bless me with such understanding, O my Lord and Master, that I may forever and ever meditate on You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tumhree kripaa te mohu maan chhootai binas jaai bharamaaee ||
english: By Your Grace, emotional attachment and egotism are eradicated, and doubt is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਰਵਿਓ ਸਭ ਮਧੇ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anad roop ravio sabh madhe jat kat pekhau jaaee ||2||
english: The Lord, the embodiment of bliss, is pervading and permeating in all; wherever I go, there I see Him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tumh daiaal kirapaal kripaa nidh patit paavan gosaaee ||
english: You are kind and compassionate, the treasure of mercy, the Purifier of sinners, Lord of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਾਜ ਪਾਏ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਬੁਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kot sookh aana(n)d raaj paae mukh te nimakh bulaaee ||3||
english: I obtain millions of joys, comforts and kingdoms, if You inspire me to chant Your Name with my mouth, even for an instant. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaap taap bhagat saa pooree jo prabh kai man bhaaee ||
english: That alone is perfect chanting, meditation, penance and devotional worship service, which is pleasing to God's Mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਭ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naam japat trisanaa sabh bujhee hai naanak tripat aghaaee ||4||10||
english: Chanting the Naam, all thirst and desire is satisfied; Nanak is satisfied and fulfilled. ||4||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਵਸਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਵਣ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jin keene vas apunai trai gun bhavan chatur sa(n)saaraa ||
english: She controls the three qualities and the four directions of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਤਾਪ ਥਾਨ ਖੰਡੇ ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jag isanaan taap thaan kha(n)de kiaa ihu ja(n)t vichaaraa ||1||
english: She destroys sacrificial feasts, cleansing baths, penances and sacred places of pilgrimage; what is this poor person to do? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਤਉ ਛੂਟੋ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee ot gahee tau chhooto ||
english: I grasped God's Support and Protection, and then I was emancipated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਏ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਤਬ ਹੂਟੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadh prasaad har har har gaae bikhai biaadh tab hooto ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By the Grace of the Holy Saints, I sang the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and my sins and afflictions were taken away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਨਹ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬਕੀਐ ਨਹ ਮੋਹੈ ਉਹ ਡੀਠੀ ॥
transliteration: nah suneeai nah mukh te bakeeai nah mohai uh deethee ||
english: She is not heard - she does not speak with a mouth; she is not seen enticing mortals.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੀਠੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aisee thagauree paai bhulaavai man sabh kai laagai meethee ||2||
english: She administers her intoxicating drug, and so confuses them; thus she seems sweet to everyone's mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਪੂਤ ਹਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ਉਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਦੂਆ ॥
transliteration: maai baap poot hit bhraataa un ghar ghar melio dooaa ||
english: In each and every home, she has implanted the sense of duality in mother, father, children, friends and siblings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਵਾਧਿ ਘਾਟਿ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਰਿ ਲਰਿ ਮੂਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kis hee vaadh ghaat kis hee pahi sagale lar lar mooaa ||3||
english: Some have more, and some have less; they fight and fight, to the death. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur apune jin ihu chalat dikhaaiaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has shown me this wondrous play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂਝੀ ਭਾਹਿ ਜਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਭਗਤ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: goojhee bhaahi jalai sa(n)saaraa bhagat na biaapai maaiaa ||4||
english: The world is being consumed by this hidden fire, but Maya does not cling to the Lord's devotees. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad mahaa sukh paaiaa sagale ba(n)dhan kaate ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, I have obtained supreme bliss, and all my bonds have been broken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਖਾਟੇ ॥੫॥੧੧॥
transliteration: har har naam naanak dhan paaiaa apunai ghar lai aaiaa khaate ||5||11||
english: Nanak has obtained the wealth of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; having earned his profits, he has now returned home. ||5||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਨਾਇਕ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tum daate thaakur pratipaalak naaik khasam hamaare ||
english: You are the Giver, O Lord, O Cherisher, my Master, my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹੁ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nimakh nimakh tum hee pratipaalahu ham baarik tumare dhaare ||1||
english: Each and every moment, You cherish and nurture me; I am Your child, and I rely upon You alone. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਏਕ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa ek kavan gun kaheeai ||
english: I have only one tongue - which of Your Glorious Virtues can I describe?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: besumaar bea(n)t suaamee tero a(n)t na kin hee laheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Unlimited, infinite Lord and Master - no one knows Your limits. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਖੰਡਹੁ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧੀ ਸਮਝਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kot paraadh hamaare kha(n)dahu anik bidhee samajhaavahu ||
english: You destroy millions of my sins, and teach me in so many ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅਲਪ ਮਤਿ ਥੋਰੀ ਤੁਮ ਆਪਨ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ham agiaan alap mat thoree tum aapan birad rakhaavahu ||2||
english: I am so ignorant - I understand nothing at all. Please honor Your innate nature, and save me! ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: tumaree saran tumaaree aasaa tum hee sajan suhele ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary - You are my only hope. You are my companion, and my best friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਗੋਲੇ ॥੩॥੧੨॥
transliteration: raakhahu raakhanahaar daiaalaa naanak ghar ke gole ||3||12||
english: Save me, O Merciful Saviour Lord; Nanak is the slave of Your home. ||3||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਵਰਤ ਤਿਲਕ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਬਹੁ ਦੈਨ ॥
transliteration: poojaa varat tilak isanaanaa pu(n)n daan bahu dain ||
english: Worship, fasting, ceremonial marks on one's forehead, cleansing baths, generous donations to charities and self-mortification

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੰਜਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਮੀਠੇ ਬੈਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahoo(n) na bheejai sa(n)jam suaamee bolahi meethe bain ||1||
english: - the Lord Master is not pleased with any of these rituals, no matter how sweetly one may speak. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨ ਚੈਨ ॥
transliteration: prabh jee ko naam japat man chain ||
english: Chanting the Name of God, the mind is soothed and pacified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲੈਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bahu prakaar khojahi sabh taa kau bikham na jaaee lain ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Everyone searches for Him in different ways, but the search is so difficult, and He cannot be found. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਭ੍ਰਮਨ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕਰਿ ਉਰਧ ਤਾਪ ਲੈ ਗੈਨ ॥
transliteration: jaap taap bhraman basudhaa kar uradh taap lai gain ||
english: Chanting, deep meditation and penance, wandering over the face of the earth, the performance of austerities with the arms stretched up to the sky

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਆਨੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਨ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ih bidh nah pateeaano thaakur jog jugat kar jain ||2||
english: - the Lord is not pleased by any of these means, though one may follow the path of Yogis and Jains. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪੈਨ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam niramolak har jas tin paaio jis kirapain ||
english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the Praises of the Lord are priceless; he alone obtains them, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਜਨ ਰੈਨ ॥੩॥੧੩॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g ra(n)g prabh bhete naanak sukh jan rain ||3||13||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak lives in the Love of God; his life-night passes in peace. ||3||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan te chhutakaavai prabhoo milaavai har har naam sunaavai ||
english: Is there anyone who can release me from my bondage, unite me with God, recite the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: asathir kare nihachal ihu manooaa bahur na katahoo dhaavai ||1||
english: and make this mind steady and stable, so that it no longer wanders around? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਕੋਊ ਐਸੋ ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: hai kooo aiso hamaraa meet ||
english: Do I have any such friend?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਹੀਉ ਦੇਉ ਅਰਪਉ ਅਪਨੋ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal samagree jeeu heeu deu arapau apano cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I would give him all my property, my soul and my heart; I would devote my consciousness to him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: par dhan par tan par kee ni(n)daa in siu preet na laagai ||
english: Others' wealth, others' bodies, and the slander of others - do not attach your love to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਭਾਖਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)tah sa(n)g sa(n)t sa(n)bhaakhan har keeratan man jaagai ||2||
english: Associate with the Saints, speak with the Saints, and keep your mind awake to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan daiaal purakh prabh sarab sookh daiaalaa ||
english: God is the treasure of virtue, kind and compassionate, the source of all comfort.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥੧੪॥
transliteration: maagai daan naam tero naanak jiu maataa baal gupaalaa ||3||14||
english: Nanak begs for the gift of Your Name; O Lord of the world, love him, like the mother loves her child. ||3||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸੰਤ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har har leene sa(n)t ubaar ||
english: The Lord saves His Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ke daas kee chitavai buriaaee tis hee kau phir maar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who wishes misfortune upon the Lord's slaves, shall be destroyed by the Lord eventually. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਆ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਭਾਗੇ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jan kaa aap sahaaee hoaa ni(n)dak bhaage haar ||
english: He Himself is the help and support of His humble servants; He defeats the slanderers, and chases them away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਊਹਾਂ ਹੀ ਮੂਏ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਨ ਮੰਝਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhramat bhramat oohaa(n) hee mooe baahuR grihi na ma(n)jhaar ||1||
english: Wandering around aimlessly, they die out there; they never return to their homes again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak saran pario dukh bha(n)jan gun gaavai sadaa apaar ||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of pain; he sings the Glorious Praises of the infinite Lord forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੫॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kaa mukh kaalaa hoaa deen duneeaa kai darabaar ||2||15||
english: The faces of the slanderers are blackened in the courts of this world, and the world beyond. ||2||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਿਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasiree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਚਿਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ab har raakhanahaar chitaariaa ||
english: Now, I contemplate and meditate on the Lord, the Saviour Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: patit puneet keee khin bheetar sagalaa rog bidaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He purifies sinners in an instant, and cures all diseases. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਸਟਿ ਭਈ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਮਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gosat bhaee saadh kai sa(n)gam kaam krodh lobh maariaa ||
english: Talking with the Holy Saints, my sexual desire, anger and greed have been eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: simar simar pooran naaraain sa(n)gee sagale taariaa ||1||
english: Remembering, remembering the Perfect Lord in meditation, I have saved all my companions. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲ ਮਨ ਏਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aukhadh ma(n)tr mool man ekai man bisvaas prabh dhaariaa ||
english: The Mul Mantra, the Root Mantra, is the only cure for the mind; I have installed faith in God in my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੧੬॥
transliteration: charan ren baa(n)chhai nit naanak punah punah balihaariaa ||2||16||
english: Nanak ever longs for the dust of the Lord's feet; again and again, he is a sacrifice to the Lord. ||2||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਲਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: meraa laago raam siu het ||
english: I have fallen in love with the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਕੇਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur meraa sadaa sahaaee jin dukh kaa kaatiaa ket ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My True Guru is always my help and support; He has torn down the banner of pain. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: haath dei raakhio apunaa kar birathaa sagal mitaaee ||
english: Giving me His hand, He has protected me as His own, and removed all my troubles.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak ke mukh kaale keene jan kaa aap sahaaee ||1||
english: He has blackened the faces of the slanderers, and He Himself has become the help and support of His humble servant. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahib hoaa rakhavaalaa raakh leee ka(n)th laai ||
english: The True Lord and Master has become my Saviour; hugging me close in His embrace, He has saved me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥੧੭॥
transliteration: nirabhau bhae sadaa sukh maane naanak har gun gaai ||2||17||
english: Nanak has become fearless, and he enjoys eternal peace, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਿਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasiree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: aukhadh tero naam daiaal ||
english: Your Name is the medicine, O Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਆਤੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mohi aatur teree gat nahee jaanee too(n) aap karahi pratipaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am so miserable, I do not know Your state; You Yourself cherish me, Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dhaar anugrahu suaamee mere duteeaa bhaau nivaar ||
english: Take pity on me, O my Lord and Master, and remove the love of duality from within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਆਵਹ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan kaat lehu apune kar kabahoo na aavah haar ||1||
english: Break my bonds, and take me as Your own, so that I may never come to lose. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: teree saran paiaa hau jeevaa(n) too(n) sa(n)mrath purakh miharavaan ||
english: Seeking Your Sanctuary, I live, almighty and merciful Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਆਰਾਧੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੧੮॥
transliteration: aath pahar prabh kau aaraadhee naanak sad kurabaan ||2||18||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I worship God; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: haa haa prabh raakh lehu ||
english: O God, please save me!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham te kichhoo na hoi mere svaamee kar kirapaa apunaa naam dehu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By myself, I cannot do anything, O my Lord and Master; by Your Grace, please bless me with Your Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: agan kuta(n)b saagar sa(n)saar ||
english: Family and worldly affairs are an ocean of fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bharam moh agiaan a(n)dhaar ||1||
english: Through doubt, emotional attachment and ignorance, we are enveloped in darkness. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ॥
transliteration: ooch neech sookh dookh ||
english: High and low, pleasure and pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਾਪਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhraapas naahee trisanaa bhookh ||2||
english: Hunger and thirst are not satisfied. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਰਚਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ॥
transliteration: man baasanaa rach bikhai biaadh ||
english: The mind is engrossed in passion, and the disease of corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਅਸਾਧ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch doot sa(n)g mahaa asaadh ||3||
english: The five thieves, the companions, are totally incorrigible. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜਹਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jee jahaan praan dhan teraa ||
english: The beings and souls and wealth of the world are all Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak jaan sadaa har neraa ||4||1||19||
english: O Nanak, know that the Lord is always near at hand. ||4||1||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: deen darad nivaar thaakur raakhai jan kee aap ||
english: The Lord and Master destroys the pain of the poor; He preserves and protects the honor of His servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਰਣ ਤਾਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taran taaran har nidh dookh na sakai biaap ||1||
english: The Lord is the ship to carry us across; He is the treasure of virtue - pain cannot touch Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g bhajahu gupaal ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਇਹ ਜਤਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aan sa(n)jam kichh na soojhai ih jatan kaat kal kaal || rahaau ||
english: I cannot think of any other way; make this effort, and make it in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aad a(n)t daiaal pooran tis binaa nahee koi ||
english: In the beginning, and in the end, there is none other than the perfect, merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: janam maran nivaar har jap simar suaamee soi ||2||
english: The cycle of birth and death is ended, chanting the Lord's Name, and remembering the Lord Master in meditation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕਥੈ ਸਾਸਤ ਭਗਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bed si(n)mrit kathai saasat bhagat karahi beechaar ||
english: The Vedas, the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Lord's devotees contemplate Him;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mukat paaeeai saadhasa(n)gat binas jaai a(n)dhaar ||3||
english: liberation is attained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal adhaar jan kaa raas poo(n)jee ek ||
english: The lotus feet of the Lord are the support of His humble servants. They are his only capital and investment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਣੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਟੇਕ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੦॥
transliteration: taan maan deebaan saachaa naanak kee prabh tek ||4||2||20||
english: The True Lord is Nanak's strength, honor and support; He alone is his protection. ||4||2||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਭੇਟੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: phirat phirat bhete jan saadhoo poorai gur samajhaaiaa ||
english: Wandering and roaming around, I met the Holy Perfect Guru, who has taught me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਾਂਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aan sagal bidh kaa(n)m na aavai har har naam dhiaaiaa ||1||
english: All other devices did not work, so I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਓਟ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: taa te mohi dhaaree ot gopaal ||
english: For this reason, I sought the Protection and Support of my Lord, the Cherisher of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saran pario pooran paramesur binase sagal ja(n)jaal || rahaau ||
english: I sought the Sanctuary of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, and all my entanglements were dissolved. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਗ ਮਿਰਤ ਪਇਆਲ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: surag mirat paiaal bhoo ma(n)dal sagal biaape maai ||
english: Paradise, the earth, the nether regions of the underworld, and the globe of the world - all are engrossed in Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jee udhaaran sabh kul taaran har har naam dhiaai ||2||
english: To save your soul, and liberate all your ancestors, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naanak naam nira(n)jan gaaeeai paaeeai sarab nidhaanaa ||
english: O Nanak, singing the Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord, all treasures are obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੩॥੩॥੨੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis dei suaamee birale kaahoo jaanaa ||3||3||21||
english: Only that rare person, whom the Lord and Master blesses with His Grace, comes to know this. ||3||3||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 2 chaupade ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਸੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਲ ॥
transliteration: chhod jaahi se karahi paraal ||
english: You shall have to abandon the straw which you have collected.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kaam na aavahi se ja(n)jaal ||
english: These entanglements shall be of no use to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਹੀਤ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g na chaalahi tin siu heet ||
english: You are in love with those things that will not go with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਸੇਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo bairaaee seee meet ||1||
english: You think that your enemies are friends. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aise bharam bhule sa(n)saaraa ||
english: In such confusion, the world has gone astray.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam padaarath khoi gavaaraa || rahaau ||
english: The foolish mortal wastes this precious human life. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵੈ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: saach dharam nahee bhaavai deethaa ||
english: He does not like to see Truth and righteousness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠ ਧੋਹ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਿਓ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: jhooth dhoh siu rachio meethaa ||
english: He is attached to falsehood and deception; they seem sweet to him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: daat piaaree visariaa daataaraa ||
english: He loves gifts, but he forgets the Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaanai naahee maran vichaaraa ||2||
english: The wretched creature does not even think of death. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ਕਉ ਉਠਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: vasat paraaee kau uth rovai ||
english: He cries for the possessions of others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਗਲਾ ਈ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam sagalaa ee khovai ||
english: He forfeits all the merits of his good deeds and religion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: hukam na boojhai aavan jaane ||
english: He does not understand the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and so he continues coming and going in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੈ ਤਾ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paap karai taa pachhotaane ||3||
english: He sins, and then regrets and repents. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so paravaan ||
english: Whatever pleases You, Lord, that alone is acceptable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਨੋ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: tere bhaane no kurabaan ||
english: I am a sacrifice to Your Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naanak gareeb ba(n)daa jan teraa ||
english: Poor Nanak is Your slave, Your humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਇ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੨॥
transliteration: raakh lei saahib prabh meraa ||4||1||22||
english: Save me, O my Lord God Master! ||4||1||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mohi masakeen prabh naam adhaar ||
english: I am meek and poor; the Name of God is my only Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਟਣ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੋਜਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: khaatan kau har har rojagaar ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my occupation and earnings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਚਣ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)chan kau har eko naam ||
english: I gather only the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: halat palat taa kai aavai kaam ||1||
english: It is useful in both this world and the next. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naam rate prabh ra(n)g apaar ||
english: Imbued with the Love of the Lord God's Infinite Name,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਏਕ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadh gaavahi gun ek nira(n)kaar || rahaau ||
english: the Holy Saints sing the Glorious Praises of the One Lord, the Formless Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਅਤਿ ਮਸਕੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: saadh kee sobhaa at masakeenee ||
english: The Glory of the Holy Saints comes from their total humility.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਚੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t vadaaee har jas cheenee ||
english: The Saints realize that their greatness rests in the Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: anad sa(n)tan kai bhagat govi(n)d ||
english: Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, the Saints are in bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sookh sa(n)tan kai binasee chi(n)d ||2||
english: The Saints find peace, and their anxieties are dispelled. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ॥
transliteration: jah saadh sa(n)tan hovahi ikatr ||
english: Wherever the Holy Saints gather,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਦ ਕਵਿਤ ॥
transliteration: tah har jas gaavahi naad kavit ||
english: there they sing the Praises of the Lord, in music and poetry.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saadh sabhaa mahi anad bisraam ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, there is bliss and peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਸੰਗੁ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: un sa(n)g so paae jis masatak karaam ||3||
english: They alone obtain this Society, upon whose foreheads such destiny is written. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: dui kar joR karee aradaas ||
english: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
transliteration: charan pakhaar kahaa(n) gunataas ||
english: I wash their feet, and chant the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh daiaal kirapaal hajoor ||
english: O God, merciful and compassionate, let me remain in Your Presence.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak jeevai sa(n)taa dhoor ||4||2||23||
english: Nanak lives, in the dust of the Saints. ||4||2||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mah 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਤ ਡਰੈ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so kat darai j khasam samhaarai ||
english: One who contemplates his Lord and Master - why should he be afraid?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਪਚੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dar dar pache manamukh vechaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The wretched self-willed manmukhs are ruined through fear and dread. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sir oopar maat pitaa guradev ||
english: The Divine Guru, my mother and father, is over my head.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: saphal moorat jaa kee niramal sev ||
english: His image brings prosperity; serving Him, we become pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: ek nira(n)jan jaa kee raas ||
english: The One Lord, the Immaculate Lord, is our capital.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)gat hovat paragaas ||1||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, we are illumined and enlightened. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jeean kaa daataa pooran sabh thaai ||
english: The Giver of all beings is totally pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kot kales mitahi har naai ||
english: Millions of pains are removed by the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸੈ ॥
transliteration: janam maran sagalaa dukh naasai ||
english: All the pains of birth and death are taken away

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਾਸੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh jaa kai man tan baasai ||2||
english: from the Gurmukh, within whose mind and body the Lord dwells. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis no aap lae laR laai ||
english: He alone, whom the Lord has attached to the hem of His robe,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: daragah milai tisai hee jaai ||
english: obtains a place in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਜਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: seee bhagat j saache bhaane ||
english: They alone are devotees, who are pleasing to the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਕਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jamakaal te bhae nikaane ||3||
english: They are freed from the Messenger of Death. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahib sach darabaar ||
english: True is the Lord, and True is His Court.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: keemat kaun kahai beechaar ||
english: Who can contemplate and describe His value?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar sagal adhaar ||
english: He is within each and every heart, the Support of all.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak jaachai sa(n)t renaar ||4||3||24||
english: Nanak begs for the dust of the Saints. ||4||3||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੂ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: ghar baahar teraa bharavaasaa too jan kai hai sa(n)g ||
english: At home, and outside, I place my trust in You; You are always with Your humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa preetam prabh apune naam japau har ra(n)g ||1||
english: Bestow Your Mercy, O my Beloved God, that I may chant the Lord's Name with love. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jan kau prabh apane kaa taan ||
english: God is the strength of His humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਾ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo too karahi karaavahi suaamee saa masalat paravaan || rahaau ||
english: Whatever You do, or cause to be done, O Lord and Master, that outcome is acceptable to me. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗਤਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: pat paramesar gat naaraain dhan gupaal gun saakhee ||
english: The Transcendent Lord is my honor; the Lord is my emancipation; the glorious sermon of the Lord is my wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੀ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੫॥
transliteration: charan saran naanak daas har har sa(n)tee ih bidh jaatee ||2||1||25||
english: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's feet; from the Saints, he has learned this way of life. ||2||1||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
transliteration: sagal manorath prabh te paae ka(n)th laai gur raakhe ||
english: God has fulfilled all my desires. Holding me close in His embrace, the Guru has saved me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਜਲਨਿ ਨ ਦੀਨੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਭਾਖੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar mahi jalan na deene kinai na dutar bhaakhe ||1||
english: He has saved me from burning in the ocean of fire, and now, no one calls it impassible. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jin kai man saachaa bisvaas ||
english: Those who have true faith in their minds,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਆਨਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਉਲਾਸੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pekh pekh suaamee kee sobhaa aanad sadaa ulaas || rahaau ||
english: continually behold the Glory of the Lord; they are forever happy and blissful. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਾਖਿਓ ॥
transliteration: charan saran pooran paramesur a(n)tarajaamee saakhio ||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of the feet of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, the Searcher of hearts; I behold Him ever-present.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਓ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੬॥
transliteration: jaan boojh apanaa keeo naanak bhagatan kaa a(n)kur raakhio ||2||2||26||
english: In His wisdom, the Lord has made Nanak His own; He has preserved the roots of His devotees. ||2||2||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jah jah pekhau tah hajoor door katahu na jaaee ||
english: Wherever I look, there I see Him present; He is never far away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rav rahiaa sarabatr mai man sadaa dhiaaee ||1||
english: He is all-pervading, everywhere; O my mind, meditate on Him forever. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਨਹੀ ਬੀਛੁੜੈ ਸੋ ਸੰਗੀ ਗਨੀਐ ॥
transliteration: eet oot nahee beechhuRai so sa(n)gee ganeeai ||
english: He alone is called your companion, who will not be separated from you, here or hereafter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੋ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਹਿ ਸੋ ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਨੀਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: binas jaai jo nimakh mahi so alap sukh bhaneeai || rahaau ||
english: That pleasure, which passes away in an instant, is trivial. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਅਪਿਆਉ ਦੇਇ ਕਛੁ ਊਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: pratipaalai apiaau dei kachh oon na hoee ||
english: He cherishes us, and gives us sustenance; He does not lack anything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸੰਮਾਲਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saas saas sa(n)maalataa meraa prabh soee ||2||
english: With each and every breath, my God takes care of His creatures. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: achhal achhed apaar prabh oochaa jaa kaa roop ||
english: God is undeceiveable, impenetrable and infinite; His form is lofty and exalted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਜਨ ਅਚਰਜ ਆਨੂਪੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jap jap karahi ana(n)d jan acharaj aanoop ||3||
english: Chanting and meditating on the embodiment of wonder and beauty, His humble servants are in bliss. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: saa mat dehu daiaal prabh jit tumahi araadhaa ||
english: Bless me with such understanding, O Merciful Lord God, that I might remember You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੇਨ ਪਗ ਸਾਧਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak ma(n)gai daan prabh ren pag saadhaa ||4||3||27||
english: Nanak begs God for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||3||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਭੇਜੇ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਉ ॥
transliteration: jin tum bheje tinahi bulaae sukh sahaj setee ghar aau ||
english: The One who sent you, has now recalled you; return to your home now in peace and pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anad ma(n)gal gun gaau sahaj dhun nihachal raaj kamaau ||1||
english: In bliss and ecstasy, sing His Glorious Praises; by this celestial tune, you shall acquire your everlasting kingdom. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: tum ghar aavahu mere meet ||
english: Come back to your home, O my friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਅਪਦਾ ਭਈ ਬਿਤੀਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tumare dokhee har aap nivaare apadaa bhaee biteet || rahaau ||
english: The Lord Himself has eliminated your enemies, and your misfortunes are past. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਕੀਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਨੇਹਾਰੇ ਨਾਸਨ ਭਾਜਨ ਥਾਕੇ ॥
transliteration: pragat keene prabh karanehaare naasan bhaajan thaake ||
english: God, the Creator Lord, has glorified you, and your running and rushing around has ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਖਸਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghar ma(n)gal vaajahi nit vaaje apunai khasam nivaaje ||2||
english: In your home, there is rejoicing; the musical instruments continually play, and your Husband Lord has exalted you. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਰਹਹੁ ਡੋਲਹੁ ਮਤ ਕਬਹੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: asathir rahahu dolahu mat kabahoo gur kai bachan adhaar ||
english: Remain firm and steady, and do not ever waver; take the Guru's Word as your Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar sagal bhoo ma(n)dal mukh oojal darabaar ||3||
english: You shall be applauded and congratulated all over the world, and your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨੈ ਹੀ ਫੇਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin ke jee tinai hee phere aape bhaiaa sahaaee ||
english: All beings belong to Him; He Himself transforms them, and He Himself becomes their help and support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੮॥
transliteration: acharaj keeaa karanaihaarai naanak sach vadiaaee ||4||4||28||
english: The Creator Lord has worked a wondrous miracle; O Nanak, His glorious greatness is true. ||4||4||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 6 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਿਨਉ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sunahu sa(n)t piaare binau hamaare jeeu ||
english: Listen, O Dear Beloved Saints, to my prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bin mukat na kaahoo jeeu || rahaau ||
english: Without the Lord, no one is liberated. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਰਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਕਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: man niramal karam kar taaran taran har avar ja(n)jaal terai kaahoo na kaam jeeu ||
english: O mind, do only deeds of purity; the Lord is the only boat to carry you across. Other entanglements shall be of no use to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੇਵਾ ਇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeevan devaa paarabraham sevaa ihu upades mo kau gur deenaa jeeu ||1||
english: True living is serving the Divine, Supreme Lord God; the Guru has imparted this teaching to me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਨ ਲਾਈਐ ਹੀਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੀਤੁ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਓਹੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: tis siu na laaeeai heet jaa ko kichh naahee beet a(n)t kee baar ohu sa(n)g na chaalai ||
english: Do not fall in love with trivial things; in the end, they shall not go along with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੂ ਆਰਾਧ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਧ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man tan too aaraadh har ke preetam saadh jaa kai sa(n)g tere ba(n)dhan chhootai ||2||
english: Worship and adore the Lord with your mind and body, O Beloved Saint of the Lord; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be released from bondage. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲ ਚਰਨ ਅਵਰ ਆਸ ਕਛੁ ਪਟਲੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: gahu paarabraham saran hiradai kamal charan avar aas kachh patal na keejai ||
english: In your heart, hold fast to the Sanctuary of the lotus feet of the Supreme Lord God; do not place your hopes in any other support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਤਪਾ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੧॥੨੯॥
transliteration: soee bhagat giaanee dhiaanee tapaa soee naanak jaa kau kirapaa keejai ||3||1||29||
english: He alone is a devotee, spiritually wise, a meditator, and a penitent, O Nanak, who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy. ||3||1||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਭਲੋ ਰੇ ਭਲੋ ਰੇ ਭਲੋ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mere laal bhalo re bhalo re bhalo har ma(n)ganaa ||
english: O my dear beloved, it is good, it is better, it is best, to ask for the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਨੈਨ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੇ ਬੈਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਮਰਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dekhahu pasaar nain sunahu saadhoo ke bain praanapat chit raakh sagal hai maranaa || rahaau ||
english: Behold, with your eyes wide-open, and listen to the Words of the Holy Saints; enshrine in your consciousness the Lord of Life - remember that all must die. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਚੋਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਤ ਅਨੇਕੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਫੀਕੇ ਏਕੈ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਕੋ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)dan choaa ras bhog karat anekai bikhiaa bikaar dekh sagal hai pheeke ekai gobid ko naam neeko kahat hai saadh jan ||
english: The application of sandalwood oil, the enjoyment of pleasures and the practice of many corrupt sins - look upon all of these as insipid and worthless. The Name of the Lord of the Universe alone is sublime; so say the Holy Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਆਪਨ ਥਾਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਨ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਾਪਿਓ ਅਰਥੁ ਦ੍ਰਬੁ ਦੇਖੁ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਲਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tan dhan aapan thaapio har jap na nimakh jaapio arath drab dekh kachh sa(n)g naahee chalanaa ||1||
english: You claim that your body and wealth are your own; you do not chant the Lord's Name even for an instant. Look and see, that none of your possessions or riches shall go along with you. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ਕਰਮੁ ਭਲਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਲਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa ko re karam bhalaa tin ot gahee sa(n)t palaa tin naahee re jam sa(n)taavai saadhoo kee sa(n)ganaa ||
english: One who has good karma, grasps the Protection of the hem of the Saint's robe; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Messenger of Death cannot threaten him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਹੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਏਕੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੦॥
transliteration: paaio re param nidhaan mitio hai abhimaan ekai nira(n)kaar naanak man laganaa ||2||2||30||
english: I have obtained the supreme treasure, and my egotism has been eradicated; Nanak's mind is attached to the One Formless Lord. ||2||2||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 7 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har ek simar ek simar ek simar piaare ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the One Lord; meditate in remembrance on the One Lord; meditate in remembrance on the One Lord, O my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kal kales lobh moh mahaa bhaujal taare || rahaau ||
english: He shall save you from strife, suffering, greed, attachment, and the most terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saas saas nimakh nimakh dinas rain chitaare ||
english: With each and every breath, each and every instant, day and night, dwell upon Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jap nisa(n)g man nidhaan dhaare ||1||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him fearlessly, and enshrine the treasure of His Name in your mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal namasakaar gun gobid beechaare ||
english: Worship His lotus feet, and contemplate the glorious virtues of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਸਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
transliteration: saadh janaa kee ren naanak ma(n)gal sookh sadhaare ||2||1||31||
english: O Nanak, the dust of the feet of the Holy shall bless you with pleasure and peace. ||2||1||31||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 8 dupade ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Eighth House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: simarau simar simar sukh paavau saas saas samaale ||
english: Remembering, remembering, remembering Him in meditation, I find peace; with each and every breath, I dwell upon Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਲੋਕਿ ਪਰਲੋਕਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ih lok paralok sa(n)g sahaaee jat kat mohi rakhavaale ||1||
english: In this world, and in the world beyond, He is with me, as my help and support; wherever I go, He protects me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa bachan basai jee naale ||
english: The Guru's Word abides with my soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਲੇਵੈ ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜਾਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jal nahee doobai tasakar nahee levai bhaahi na saakai jaale ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It does not sink in water; thieves cannot steal it, and fire cannot burn it. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕਉ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਉ ਟਿਕ ਮਾਤ ਦੂਧੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: niradhan kau dhan a(n)dhule kau tik maat doodh jaise baale ||
english: It is like wealth to the poor, a cane for the blind, and mother's milk for the infant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੨॥
transliteration: saagar mahi bohith paaio har naanak karee kripaa kirapaale ||2||1||32||
english: In the ocean of the world, I have found the boat of the Lord; the Merciful Lord has bestowed His Mercy upon Nanak. ||2||1||32||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਿੰਚਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhae kripaal daiaal gobi(n)daa a(n)mrit ridai si(n)chaaee ||
english: The Lord of the Universe has become kind and merciful; His Ambrosial Nectar permeates my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਜਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nav nidh ridh sidh har laag rahee jan paaee ||1||
english: The nine treasures, riches and the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas cling to the feet of the Lord's humble servant. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਦੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੀ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kau anad sagal hee jaaee ||
english: The Saints are in ecstasy everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: grihi baahar thaakur bhagatan kaa rav rahiaa srab thaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Within the home, and outside as well, the Lord and Master of His devotees is totally pervading and permeating everywhere. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਗਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: taa kau koi na pahuchanahaaraa jaa kai a(n)g gusaaee ||
english: No one can equal one who has the Lord of the Universe on his side.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੩॥
transliteration: jam kee traas mitai jis simarat naanak naam dhiaaee ||2||2||33||
english: The fear of the Messenger of Death is eradicated, remembering Him in meditation; Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||2||33||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਬਵੰਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਰਬੈ ਭੂਮਵੰਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: darabava(n)t darab dekh garabai bhoomava(n)t abhimaanee ||
english: The rich man gazes upon his riches, and is proud of himself; the landlord takes pride in his lands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਗਲ ਰਾਜੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਟੇਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raajaa jaanai sagal raaj hamaraa tiu har jan tek suaamee ||1||
english: The king believes that the whole kingdom belongs to him; in the same way, the humble servant of the Lord looks upon the support of his Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋਊ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਓਟ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: je kooo apunee ot samaarai ||
english: When one considers the Lord to be his only support,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਬਿਤੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਬਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa bit taisaa hoi varatai apunaa bal nahee haarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: then the Lord uses His power to help him; this power cannot be defeated. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਏ ਇਕ ਆਸਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: aan tiaag bhae ik aasar saran saran kar aae ||
english: Renouncing all others, I have sought the Support of the One Lord; I have come to Him, pleading, "Save me, save me!"

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੪॥
transliteration: sa(n)t anugrah bhae man niramal naanak har gun gaae ||2||3||34||
english: By the kindness and the Grace of the Saints, my mind has been purified; Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||3||34||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau har ra(n)g laago is jug mahi so kaheeat hai sooraa ||
english: He alone is called a warrior, who is attached to the Lord's Love in this age.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਜਿਣੈ ਸਗਲ ਵਸਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aatam jinai sagal vas taa kai jaa kaa satigur pooraa ||1||
english: Through the Perfect True Guru, he conquers his own soul, and then everything comes under his control. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਆਤਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: thaakur gaaeeai aatam ra(n)g ||
english: Sing the Praises of the Lord and Master, with the love of your soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਵਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਨ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saranee paavan naam dhiaavan sahaj samaavan sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who seek His Sanctuary, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are blended with the Lord in celestial peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਵਸਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jan ke charan vasahi merai heearai sa(n)g puneetaa dehee ||
english: The feet of the Lord's humble servant abide in my heart; with them, my body is made pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਏਹੀ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੫॥
transliteration: jan kee dhoor dehu kirapaa nidh naanak kai sukh ehee ||2||4||35||
english: O treasure of mercy, please bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of Your humble servants; this alone brings peace. ||2||4||35||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਡਹਕਾਵੈ ਓਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jatan karai maanukh dahakaavai ohu a(n)tarajaamee jaanai ||
english: People try to deceive others, but the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਕਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paap kare kar mookar paavai bhekh karai nirabaanai ||1||
english: They commit sins, and then deny them, while they pretend to be in Nirvaanaa. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨਤ ਦੂਰਿ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨੇਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jaanat door tumahi prabh ner ||
english: They believe that You are far away, but You, O God, are near at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਤ ਤਾਕੈ ਉਤ ਤੇ ਉਤ ਪੇਖੈ ਆਵੈ ਲੋਭੀ ਫੇਰਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ut taakai ut te ut pekhai aavai lobhee pher || rahaau ||
english: Looking around, this way and that, the greedy people come and go. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨ ਭਰਮਾ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jab lag tutai naahee man bharamaa tab lag mukat na koee ||
english: As long as the doubts of the mind are not removed, liberation is not found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੩੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak daiaal suaamee sa(n)t bhagat jan soee ||2||5||36||
english: Says Nanak, he alone is a Saint, a devotee, and a humble servant of the Lord, to whom the Lord and Master is merciful. ||2||5||36||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਹੈ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: naam gur deeo hai apunai jaa kai masatak karamaa ||
english: My Guru gives the Naam, the Name of the Lord, to those who have such karma written on their foreheads.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam driRaavai naam japaavai taa kaa jug mahi dharamaa ||1||
english: He implants the Naam, and inspires us to chant the Naam; this is Dharma, true religion, in this world. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਸੋਭ ॥
transliteration: jan kau naam vadaaee sobh ||
english: The Naam is the glory and greatness of the Lord's humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਤਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੈ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੋਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naamo gat naamo pat jan kee maanai jo jo hog ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Naam is his salvation, and the Naam is his honor; he accepts whatever comes to pass. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: naam dhan jis jan kai paalai soee pooraa saahaa ||
english: That humble servant, who has the Naam as his wealth, is the perfect banker.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੨॥੬॥੩੭॥
transliteration: naam biuhaaraa naanak aadhaaraa naam paraapat laahaa ||2||6||37||
english: The Naam is his occupation, O Nanak, and his only support; the Naam is the profit he earns. ||2||6||37||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਏ ਦਰਸ ਪੇਖੇ ਮਾਥੈ ਪਰਉ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
transliteration: netr puneet bhae daras pekhe maathai parau ravaal ||
english: My eyes have been purified, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, and touching my forehead to the dust of His feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਮੋਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ras ras gun gaavau thaakur ke morai hiradai basahu gopaal ||1||
english: With joy and happiness, I sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord and Master; the Lord of the World abides within my heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਤਉ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: tum tau raakhanahaar daiaal ||
english: You are my Merciful Protector, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar sughar bea(n)t pitaa prabh hohu prabhoo kirapaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O beautiful, wise, infinite Father God, be Merciful to me, God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਰਸਾਲ ॥
transliteration: mahaa ana(n)d ma(n)gal roop tumare bachan anoop rasaal ||
english: O Lord of supreme ecstasy and blissful form, Your Word is so beautiful, so drenched with Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਚਰਣ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਂਧਿਓ ਪਾਲ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੮॥
transliteration: hiradai charan sabad satigur ko naanak baa(n)dhio paal ||2||7||38||
english: With the Lord's lotus feet enshrined in his heart, Nanak has tied the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, to the hem of his robe. ||2||7||38||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਉਕਤਿ ਖਲਾਵੈ ਭੋਜਨ ਅਪਨੀ ਉਕਤਿ ਖੇਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: apanee ukat khalaavai bhojan apanee ukat khelaavai ||
english: In His own way, He provides us with our food; in His own way, He plays with us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarab sookh bhog ras devai man hee naal samaavai ||1||
english: He blesses us with all comforts, enjoyments and delicacies, and he permeates our minds. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: hamare pitaa gopaal daiaal ||
english: Our Father is the Lord of the World, the Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu raakhai mahataaree baarik kau taise hee prabh paal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Just as the mother protects her children, God nurtures and cares for us. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਇਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: meet saajan sarab gun naaik sadaa salaamat devaa ||
english: You are my friend and companion, the Master of all excellences, O eternal and permanent Divine Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੨॥੮॥੩੯॥
transliteration: eet oot jat kat tat tum hee milai naanak sa(n)t sevaa ||2||8||39||
english: Here, there and everywhere, You are pervading; please, bless Nanak to serve the Saints. ||2||8||39||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kripaal daiaal damodar kaam krodh bikh jaare ||
english: The Saints are kind and compassionate; they burn away their sexual desire, anger and corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਇਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਲੈ ਬਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raaj maal joban tan jeearaa in oopar lai baare ||1||
english: My power, wealth, youth, body and soul are a sacrifice to them. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man tan raam naam hitakaare ||
english: With my mind and body, I love the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਹਿਤ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ma(n)gal sahit bhav nidh paar utaare || rahaau ||
english: With peace, poise, pleasure and joy, He has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਧੰਨਿ ਓਇ ਭਵਨਾ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਬਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s thaan dha(n)n oi bhavanaa jaa mahi sa(n)t basaare ||
english: Blessed is that place, and blessed is that house, in which the Saints dwell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੪੦॥
transliteration: jan naanak kee saradhaa poorahu thaakur bhagat tere namasakaare ||2||9||40||
english: Fulfill this desire of servant Nanak, O Lord Master, that he may bow in reverence to Your devotees. ||2||9||40||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਡਾਇ ਲੀਓ ਮਹਾ ਬਲੀ ਤੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: chhadaai leeo mahaa balee te apane charan paraat ||
english: He has saved me from the awful power of Maya, by attaching me to His feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਮਨ ਮੰਤਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek naam deeo man ma(n)taa binas na katahoo jaat ||1||
english: He gave my mind the Mantra of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord, which shall never perish or leave me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur poorai keenee daat ||
english: The Perfect True Guru has given this gift.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਕਉ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗਾਤਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam deeo keeratan kau bhaee hamaaree gaat || rahaau ||
english: He has blessed me with the Kirtan of the Praises of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and I am emancipated. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeo prabh apunai bhagatan kee raakhee paat ||
english: My God has made me His own, and saved the honor of His devotee.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੪੧॥
transliteration: naanak charan gahe prabh apane sukh paaio din raat ||2||10||41||
english: Nanak has grasped the feet of his God, and has found peace, day and night. ||2||10||41||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਹਰਨਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਝੂਠ ਨਿੰਦ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਕਰਤ ਗੁਦਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: par haranaa lobh jhooth ni(n)d iv hee karat gudaaree ||
english: Stealing the property of others, acting in greed, lying and slandering - in these ways, he passes his life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਆਸ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੀਠੀ ਇਹ ਟੇਕ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਾਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mrig trisanaa aas mithiaa meethee ih tek manahi saadhaaree ||1||
english: He places his hopes in false mirages, believing them to be sweet; this is the support he installs in his mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਆਵਰਦਾ ਜਾਇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saakat kee aavaradaa jaai brithaaree ||
english: The faithless cynic passes his life uselessly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਗਦ ਕੇ ਭਾਰ ਮੂਸਾ ਟੂਕਿ ਗਵਾਵਤ ਕਾਮਿ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaise kaagad ke bhaar moosaa took gavaavat kaam nahee gaavaaree || rahaau ||
english: He is like the mouse, gnawing away at the pile of paper, making it useless to the poor wretch. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੁਟਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa paarabraham suaamee ih ba(n)dhan chhutakaaree ||
english: Have mercy on me, O Supreme Lord God, and release me from these bonds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਅੰਧ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਢਤ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਸੰਗਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੪੨॥
transliteration: boodat a(n)dh naanak prabh kaadhat saadh janaa sa(n)gaaree ||2||11||42||
english: The blind are sinking, O Nanak; God saves them, uniting them with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||11||42||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸੀਤਲ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਛਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: simar simar suaamee prabh apanaa seetal tan man chhaatee ||
english: Remembering, remembering God, the Lord Master in meditation, my body, mind and heart are cooled and soothed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸੂਖ ਧਨੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੋਰੈ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: roop ra(n)g sookh dhan jee kaa paarabraham morai jaatee ||1||
english: The Supreme Lord God is my beauty, pleasure, peace, wealth, soul and social status. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨਿ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa raam rasaain maatee ||
english: My tongue is intoxicated with the Lord, the source of nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੀ ਰਾਮ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਥਾਤੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g ra(n)gee raam apane kai charan kamal nidh thaatee || rahaau ||
english: I am in love, in love with the Lord's lotus feet, the treasure of riches. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa saa tin hee rakh leeaa pooran prabh kee bhaatee ||
english: I am His - He has saved me; this is God's perfect way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਓ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਾਤੀ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੪੩॥
transliteration: mel leeo aape sukhadaatai naanak har raakhee paatee ||2||12||43||
english: The Giver of peace has blended Nanak with Himself; the Lord has preserved his honor. ||2||12||43||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਨਿਵਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: doot dusaman sabh tujh te nivarahi pragat prataap tumaaraa ||
english: All demons and enemies are eradicated by You, Lord; Your glory is manifest and radiant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਦੁਖਾਏ ਓਹੁ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo jo tere bhagat dukhaae ohu tatakaal tum maaraa ||1||
english: Whoever harms Your devotees, You destroy in an instant. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਖਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: nirakhau tumaree or har neet ||
english: I look to You continually, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਸਹਾਇ ਹੋਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਉਧਰਹੁ ਮੀਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: muraar sahaai hohu daas kau kar gahi udharahu meet || rahaau ||
english: O Lord, Destroyer of ego, please, be the helper and companion of Your slaves; take my hand, and save me, O my Friend! ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: sunee benatee thaakur merai khasamaanaa kar aap ||
english: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer, and given me His protection.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦ ਭਏ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੪੪॥
transliteration: naanak anad bhae dukh bhaage sadaa sadaa har jaap ||2||13||44||
english: Nanak is in ecstasy, and his pains are gone; he meditates on the Lord, forever and ever. ||2||13||44||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰ ਦਿਸਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਬਲੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੁ ਧਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: chatur disaa keeno bal apanaa sir oopar kar dhaario ||
english: He has extended His power in all four directions, and placed His hand upon my head.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਟਾਖੵ ਅਵਲੋਕਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
