transliteration: kripaa kataakhy avalokan keeno daas kaa dookh bidaario ||1||
english: Gazing upon me with his Eye of Mercy, He has dispelled the pains of His slave. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: har jan raakhe gur govi(n)d ||
english: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, has saved the Lord's humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਮੇਟੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਖਸੰਦ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)th laai avagun sabh mete daiaal purakh bakhasa(n)d || rahaau ||
english: Hugging me close in His embrace, the merciful, forgiving Lord has erased all my sins. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਤੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo maagahi thaakur apune te soee soee devai ||
english: Whatever I ask for from my Lord and Master, he gives that to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੪੫॥
transliteration: naanak daas mukh te jo bolai eehaa oohaa sach hovai ||2||14||45||
english: Whatever the Lord's slave Nanak utters with his mouth, proves to be true, here and hereafter. ||2||14||45||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਖੀ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਦੇਖਣ ਦੇਈ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: aukhee ghaRee na dekhan deee apanaa birad samaale ||
english: He does not let His devotees see the difficult times; this is His innate nature.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haath dei raakhai apane kau saas saas pratipaale ||1||
english: Giving His hand, He protects His devotee; with each and every breath, He cherishes him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh siu laag rahio meraa cheet ||
english: My consciousness remains attached to God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਧੰਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aad a(n)t prabh sadaa sahaaee dha(n)n hamaaraa meet || rahaau ||
english: In the beginning, and in the end, God is always my helper and companion; blessed is my friend. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਭਏ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man bilaas bhae saahib ke acharaj dekh badaaee ||
english: My mind is delighted, gazing upon the marvellous, glorious greatness of the Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਆਨਦ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੪੬॥
transliteration: har simar simar aanad kar naanak prabh pooran paij rakhaaee ||2||15||46||
english: Remembering, remembering the Lord in meditation, Nanak is in ecstasy; God, in His perfection, has protected and preserved his honor. ||2||15||46||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਗਨਹੁ ਅਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jis kau bisarai praanapat daataa soee ganahu abhaagaa ||
english: One who forgets the Lord of life, the Great Giver - know that he is most unfortunate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਗਿਓ ਅਮਿਅ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਪਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charan kamal jaa kaa man raagio ami sarovar paagaa ||1||
english: One whose mind is in love with the Lord's lotus feet, obtains the pool of ambrosial nectar. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: teraa jan raam naam ra(n)g jaagaa ||
english: Your humble servant awakes in the Love of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਲਸੁ ਛੀਜਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aalas chheej gaiaa sabh tan te preetam siu man laagaa || rahaau ||
english: All laziness has departed from his body, and his mind is attached to the Beloved Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jah jah pekhau tah naaraain sagal ghataa mahi taagaa ||
english: Wherever I look, the Lord is there; He is the string, upon which all hearts are strung.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਉਦਕੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਸਭਿ ਅਨੁਰਾਗਾ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੪੭॥
transliteration: naam udak peevat jan naanak tiaage sabh anuraagaa ||2||16||47||
english: Drinking in the water of the Naam, servant Nanak has renounced all other loves. ||2||16||47||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jan ke pooran hoe kaam ||
english: All the affairs of the Lord's humble servant are perfectly resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਲਜਾ ਰਾਖੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kalee kaal mahaa bikhiaa mahi lajaa raakhee raam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the utterly poisonous Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord preserves and protects his honor. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਮ ॥
transliteration: simar simar suaamee prabh apunaa nikat na aavai jaam ||
english: Remembering, remembering God, his Lord and Master in meditation, the Messenger of Death does not approach him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਧਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mukat baiku(n)th saadh kee sa(n)gat jan paaio har kaa dhaam ||1||
english: Liberation and heaven are found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; his humble servant finds the home of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਥਾਤੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal har jan kee thaatee kot sookh bisraam ||
english: The Lord's lotus feet are the treasure of His humble servant; in them, he finds millions of pleasures and comforts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨ ਰੈਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੪੮॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d damodar simarau din rain naanak sad kurabaan ||2||17||48||
english: He remembers the Lord God in meditation, day and night; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to him. ||2||17||48||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਂਗਉ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: maa(n)gau raam te ik daan ||
english: I beg for one gift only from the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal manorath pooran hovahi simarau tumaraa naam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: May all my desires be fulfilled, meditating on, and remembering Your Name, O Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਾਸਹਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: charan tumhaare hiradai vaasahi sa(n)tan kaa sa(n)g paavau ||
english: May Your feet abide within my heart, and may I find the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਗ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sog agan mahi man na viaapai aath pahar gun gaavau ||1||
english: May my mind not be afflicted by the fire of sorrow; may I sing Your Glorious Praises, twenty-four hours a day. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਵਸਤਿ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਧੵੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਪਣ ॥
transliteration: svasat bivasathaa har kee sevaa madhy(n)t prabh jaapan ||
english: May I serve the Lord in my childhood and youth, and meditate on God in my middle and old age.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਛਾਪਣ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੪੯॥
transliteration: naanak ra(n)g lagaa paramesar baahuR janam na chhaapan ||2||18||49||
english: O Nanak, one who is imbued with the Love of the Transcendent Lord, is not reincarnated again to die. ||2||18||49||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਂਗਉ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਥੋਕ ॥
transliteration: maa(n)gau raam te sabh thok ||
english: I beg only from the Lord for all things.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕਉ ਜਾਚਤ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੋਖ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maanukh kau jaachat sram paaeeai prabh kai simaran mokh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I would hesitate to beg from other people. Remembering God in meditation, liberation is obtained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੋਖੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਘੋਖ ॥
transliteration: ghokhe mun jan si(n)mrit puraanaa(n) bed pukaarahi ghokh ||
english: I have studied with the silent sages, and carefully read the Simritees, the Puraanas and the Vedas; they all proclaim that,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੋਵੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਲੋਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kripaa si(n)dh sev sach paaeeai dovai suhele lok ||1||
english: by serving the Lord, the ocean of mercy, Truth is obtained, and both this world and the next are embellished. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਅਚਾਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਫੋਕ ॥
transliteration: aan achaar biuhaar hai jete bin har simaran phok ||
english: All other rituals and customs are useless, without remembering the Lord in meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੋਕ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੫੦॥
transliteration: naanak janam maran bhai kaate mil saadhoo binase sok ||2||19||50||
english: O Nanak, the fear of birth and death has been removed; meeting the Holy Saint, sorrow is dispelled. ||2||19||50||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa bujhai har kai naam ||
english: Desire is quenched, through the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mahaa sa(n)tokh hovai gur bachanee prabh siu laagai pooran dhiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Great peace and contentment come through the Guru's Word, and one's meditation is perfectly focused upon God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਕਲੋਲ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: mahaa kalol bujhahi maaiaa ke kar kirapaa mere deen daiaal ||
english: Please shower Your Mercy upon me, and permit me to ignore the great enticements of Maya, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apanaa naam dehi jap jeevaa pooran hoi daas kee ghaal ||1||
english: Give me Your Name - chanting it, I live; please bring the efforts of Your slave to fruition. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਰਾਜ ਸੂਖ ਰਸ ਸਦ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sarab manorath raaj sookh ras sad khuseeaa keeratan jap naam ||
english: All desires, power, pleasure, joy and lasting bliss, are found by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and singing the Kirtan of His Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੫੧॥
transliteration: jis kai karam likhiaa dhur karatai naanak jan ke pooran kaam ||2||20||51||
english: That humble servant of the Lord, who has such karma pre-ordained by the Creator Lord, O Nanak - his efforts are brought to perfect fruition. ||2||20||51||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mah 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jan kee keenee paarabraham saar ||
english: The Supreme Lord God takes care of His humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਟਿਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਨਿ ਮੂਲੇ ਊਡਿ ਗਏ ਬੇਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak tikan na paavan moole ood gae bekaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The slanderers are not allowed to stay; they are pulled out by their roots, like useless weeds. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jah jah dekhau tah tah suaamee koi na pahuchanahaar ||
english: Wherever I look, there I see my Lord and Master; no one can harm me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ਤਤ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo jo karai avagiaa jan kee hoi gaiaa tat chhaar ||1||
english: Whoever shows disrespect to the Lord's humble servant, is instantly reduced to ashes. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਹਾਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: karanahaar rakhavaalaa hoaa jaa kaa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: The Creator Lord has become my protector; He has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੫੨॥
transliteration: naanak daas rakhe prabh apunai ni(n)dak kaadhe maar ||2||21||52||
english: O Nanak, God has protected and saved His slaves; He has driven out and destroyed the slanderers. ||2||21||52||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੯ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 9 paRataal ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Ninth House, Partaal:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: har charan saran gobi(n)d dukh bha(n)janaa daas apune kau naam devahu ||
english: O Lord, I seek the Sanctuary of Your feet; Lord of the Universe, Destroyer of pain, please bless Your slave with Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਭੁਜਾ ਗਹਿ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: drisat prabh dhaarahu kripaa kar taarahu bhujaa gahi koop te kaadh levahu || rahaau ||
english: Be Merciful, God, and bless me with Your Glance of Grace; take my arm and save me - pull me up out of this pit! ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੰਧ ਅਨਿਕ ਦੋਖਾ ਤਨਿ ਛਾਦਿ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh kar a(n)dh maaiaa ke ba(n)dh anik dokhaa tan chhaad poore ||
english: He is blinded by sexual desire and anger, bound by Maya; his body and clothes are filled with countless sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਾਵਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh binaa aan na raakhanahaaraa naam simaraavahu saran soore ||1||
english: Without God, there is no other protector; help me to chant Your Name, Almighty Warrior, Sheltering Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤਾਰਣਾ ਬੇਦ ਉਚਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: patit udhaaranaa jee ja(n)t taaranaa bed uchaar nahee a(n)t paaio ||
english: Redeemer of sinners, Saving Grace of all beings and creatures, even those who recite the Vedas have not found Your limit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਹ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰਤਨਾਗਰਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੩॥
transliteration: gunah sukh saagaraa braham ratanaagaraa bhagat vachhal naanak gaaio ||2||1||53||
english: God is the ocean of virtue and peace, the source of jewels; Nanak sings the Praises of the Lover of His devotees. ||2||1||53||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: halat sukh palat sukh nit sukh simarano naam gobi(n)d kaa sadaa leejai ||
english: Peace in this world, peace in the next world and peace forever, remembering Him in meditation. Chant forever the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਪਾਪ ਚਿਰਾਣੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੁਆ ਜੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mitahi kamaane paap chiraane saadhasa(n)gat mil muaa jeejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The sins of past lives are erased, by joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; new life is infused into the dead. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨ ਬਿਸਰੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਏਹੁ ਮਹਾਂਤ ਕਹੈ ॥
transliteration: raaj joban bisara(n)t har maaiaa mahaa dukh ehu mahaa(n)t kahai ||
english: In power, youth and Maya, the Lord is forgotten; this is the greatest tragedy - so say the spiritual sages.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਰਮਣ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਏਹੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਭਾਗਵੰਤੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aas piaas raman har keeratan ehu padaarath bhaagava(n)t lahai ||1||
english: Hope and desire to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - this is the treasure of the most fortunate devotees. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saran samarath akath agocharaa patit udhaaran naam teraa ||
english: O Lord of Sanctuary, all-powerful, imperceptible and unfathomable - Your Name is the Purifier of sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੫੪॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee naanak ke suaamee sarabat pooran thaakur meraa ||2||2||54||
english: The Inner-knower, the Lord and Master of Nanak is totally pervading and permeating everywhere; He is my Lord and Master. ||2||2||54||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੨ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 12 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Twelfth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਦਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)danaa har ba(n)danaa gun gaavahu gopaal raai || rahaau ||
english: I bow in reverence to the Lord, I bow in reverence. I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my King. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag bhete guradevaa ||
english: By great good fortune, one meets the Divine Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਮਿਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kot paraadh mite har sevaa ||1||
english: Millions of sins are erased by serving the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal jaa kaa man raapai ||
english: One whose mind is imbued with the Lord's lotus feet

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਗ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sog agan tis jan na biaapai ||2||
english: is not afflicted by the fire of sorrow. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
transliteration: saagar tariaa saadhoo sa(n)ge ||
english: He crosses over the world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nirabhau naam japahu har ra(n)ge ||3||
english: He chants the Name of the Fearless Lord, and is imbued with the Lord's Love. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਦੋਖ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਪ ਨ ਫੇੜੇ ॥
transliteration: par dhan dokh kichh paap na pheRe ||
english: One who does not steal the wealth of others, who does not commit evil deeds or sinful acts

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jam ja(n)daar na aavai neRe ||4||
english: - the Messenger of Death does not even approach him. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa agan prabh aap bujhaaee ||
english: God Himself quenches the fires of desire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੫॥੧॥੫੫॥
transliteration: naanak udhare prabh saranaaee ||5||1||55||
english: O Nanak, in God's Sanctuary, one is saved. ||5||1||55||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭਈ ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tripat bhaee sach bhojan khaaiaa ||
english: I am satisfied and satiated, eating the food of Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man tan rasanaa naam dhiaaiaa ||1||
english: With my mind, body and tongue, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਵਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jeevanaa har jeevanaa ||
english: Life, spiritual life, is in the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jeevan har jap saadhasa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Spiritual life consists of chanting the Lord's Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੀ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਓਢਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anik prakaaree basatr odhaae ||
english: He is dressed in robes of all sorts,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anadin keeratan har gun gaae ||2||
english: if he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Glorious Praises, day and night. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤੀ ਰਥ ਅਸੁ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: hasatee rath as asavaaree ||
english: He rides upon elephants, chariots and horses,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har kaa maarag ridai nihaaree ||3||
english: if he sees the Lord's Path within his own heart. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar charan dhiaaiaa ||
english: Meditating on the Lord's Feet, deep within his mind and body,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੬॥
transliteration: har sukh nidhaan naanak daas paaiaa ||4||2||56||
english: slave Nanak has found the Lord, the treasure of peace. ||4||2||56||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan jee kaa nisataaraa ||
english: The Guru's feet emancipate the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: samu(n)d saagar jin khin mahi taaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: They carry it across the world-ocean in an instant. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਰਤੁ ਕੋਈ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: koee hoaa kram rat koee teerath naaiaa ||
english: Some love rituals, and some bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸੀੰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daasee(n) har kaa naam dhiaaiaa ||1||
english: The Lord's slaves meditate on His Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan kaatanahaar suaamee ||
english: The Lord Master is the Breaker of bonds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੫੭॥
transliteration: jan naanak simarai a(n)tarajaamee ||2||3||57||
english: Servant Nanak meditates in remembrance on the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||2||3||57||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰਿ ਨ ਤੂਟਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kitai prakaar na tootau preet ||
english: The lifestyle of Your slave is so pure,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: daas tere kee niramal reet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: That nothing can break his love for You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jee praan man dhan te piaaraa ||
english: He is more dear to me than my soul, my breath of life, my mind and my wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haumai ba(n)dh har devanahaaraa ||1||
english: The Lord is the Giver, the Restrainer of the ego. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu laagau nehu ||
english: I am in love with the Lord's lotus feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਏਹ ॥੨॥੪॥੫੮॥
transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)tee eh ||2||4||58||
english: This alone is Nanak's prayer. ||2||4||58||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 9 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਬਨ ਖੋਜਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaahe re ban khojan jaaee ||
english: Why do you go looking for Him in the forest?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਦਾ ਅਲੇਪਾ ਤੋਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab nivaasee sadaa alepaa tohee sa(n)g samaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Although he is unattached, he dwells everywhere. He is always with you as your companion. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਹਪ ਮਧਿ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਛਾਈ ॥
transliteration: puhap madh jiu baas basat hai mukar maahi jaise chhaaee ||
english: Like the fragrance which remains in the flower, and like the reflection in the mirror,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਸੇ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taise hee har base nira(n)tar ghat hee khojahu bhaaee ||1||
english: the Lord dwells deep within; search for Him within your own heart, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: baahar bheetar eko jaanahu ihu gur giaan bataaee ||
english: Outside and inside, know that there is only the One Lord; the Guru has imparted this wisdom to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਪਾ ਚੀਨੈ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak bin aapaa cheenai mitai na bhram kee kaaee ||2||1||
english: O servant Nanak, without knowing one's own self, the moss of doubt is not removed. ||2||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 9 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੋ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: saadho ihu jag bharam bhulaanaa ||
english: O Holy people, this world is deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam kaa simaran chhodiaa maaiaa haath bikaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It has forsaken the meditative remembrance of the Lord's Name, and sold itself out to Maya. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut banitaa taa kai ras lapataanaa ||
english: Mother, father, siblings, children and spouse - he is entangled in their love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਦ ਮੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: joban dhan prabhataa kai mad mai ahinis rahai divaanaa ||1||
english: In the pride of youth, wealth and glory, day and night, he remains intoxicated. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal sadaa dukh bha(n)jan taa siu man na lagaanaa ||
english: God is merciful to the meek, and forever the Destroyer of pain, but the mortal does not center his mind on Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਨ ਮੈ ਕਿਨਹੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak kotan mai kinahoo guramukh hoi pachhaanaa ||2||2||
english: O servant Nanak, among millions, only a rare few, as Gurmukh, realize God. ||2||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 9 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
transliteration: tih jogee kau jugat na jaanau ||
english: That Yogi does not know the way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: lobh moh maaiaa mamataa phun jih ghat maahi pachhaanau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Understand that his heart is filled with greed, emotional attachment, Maya and egotism. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਹ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਲੋਹ ਸਮਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: par ni(n)daa usatat nah jaa kai ka(n)chan loh samaano ||
english: One who does not slander or praise others, who looks upon gold and iron alike,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਖਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: harakh sog te rahai ateetaa jogee taahi bakhaano ||1||
english: who is free from pleasure and pain - he alone is called a true Yogi. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲ ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਤ ਅਚਲ ਜਾਹਿ ਠਹਰਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)chal man dah dis kau dhaavat achal jaahi thaharaano ||
english: The restless mind wanders in the ten directions - it needs to be pacified and restrained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ih bidh ko jo nar mukat taahi tum maano ||2||3||
english: Says Nanak, whoever knows this technique is judged to be liberated. ||2||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 9 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਪਾਉ ਕਰਉ ॥
transliteration: ab mai kaun upaau karau ||
english: Now, what efforts should I make?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਸੰਸਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਭਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jih bidh man ko sa(n)saa chookai bhau nidh paar parau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How can I dispel the anxieties of my mind? How can I cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਕਛੁ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅਧਿਕ ਡਰਉ ॥
transliteration: janam paai kachh bhalo na keeno taa te adhik darau ||
english: Obtaining this human incarnation, I have done no good deeds; this makes me very afraid!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਏ ਯਹ ਜੀਅ ਸੋਚ ਧਰਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man bach kram har gun nahee gaae yah jee soch dharau ||1||
english: In thought, word and deed, I have not sung the Lord's Praises; this thought worries my mind. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਪਸੁ ਜਿਉ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਉ ॥
transliteration: guramat sun kachh giaan na upajio pas jiu udar bharau ||
english: I listened to the Guru's Teachings, but spiritual wisdom did not well up within me; like a beast, I fill my belly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਨਉ ਤਬ ਹਉ ਪਤਿਤ ਤਰਉ ॥੨॥੪॥੯॥੯॥੧੩॥੫੮॥੪॥੯੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh birad pachhaanau tab hau patit tarau ||2||4||9||9||13||58||4||93||
english: Says Nanak, O God, please confirm Your Law of Grace; for only then can I, the sinner, be saved. ||2||4||9||9||13||58||4||93||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ghar 2 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Second House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur saagar ratanee bharapoore ||
english: The Guru is the ocean, filled with pearls.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਤ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit sa(n)t chugahi nahee doore ||
english: The Saints gather in the Ambrosial Nectar; they do not go far away from there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har ras chog chugahi prabh bhaavai ||
english: They taste the subtle essence of the Lord; they are loved by God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰ ਮਹਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saravar mahi ha(n)s praanapat paavai ||1||
english: Within this pool, the swans find their Lord, the Lord of their souls. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਬਗੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਛਪੜੀ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kiaa bag bapuRaa chhapaRee naai ||
english: What can the poor crane accomplish by bathing in the mud puddle?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਚੜਿ ਡੂਬੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: keechaR doobai mail na jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It sinks into the mire, and its filth is not washed away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਚਰਨ ਧਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: rakh rakh charan dhare veechaaree ||
english: After careful deliberation, the thoughtful person takes a step.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa chhod bhae nira(n)kaaree ||
english: Forsaking duality, he becomes a devotee of the Formless Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਚਾਖੇ ॥
transliteration: mukat padaarath har ras chaakhe ||
english: He obtains the treasure of liberation, and enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aavan jaan rahe gur raakhe ||2||
english: His comings and goings end, and the Guru protects him. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰ ਹੰਸਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saravar ha(n)saa chhod na jaai ||
english: The swan do not leave this pool.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: prem bhagat kar sahaj samaai ||
english: In loving devotional worship, they merge in the Celestial Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰ ਮਹਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੰਸ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saravar mahi ha(n)s ha(n)s mahi saagar ||
english: The swans are in the pool, and the pool is in the swans.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਆਦਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: akath kathaa gur bachanee aadar ||3||
english: They speak the Unspoken Speech, and they honor and revere the Guru's Word. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਇਕੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਬੈਸੇ ॥
transliteration: su(n)n ma(n)dal ik jogee baise ||
english: The Yogi, the Primal Lord, sits within the celestial sphere of deepest Samaadhi.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋਊ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
transliteration: naar na purakh kahahu kooo kaise ||
english: He is not male, and He is not female; how can anyone describe Him?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tribhavan jot rahe liv laaee ||
english: The three worlds continue to center their attention on His Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਸਚੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sur nar naath sache saranaaee ||4||
english: The silent sages and the Yogic masters seek the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aana(n)d mool anaath adhaaree ||
english: The Lord is the source of bliss, the support of the helpless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat sahaj beechaaree ||
english: The Gurmukhs worship and contemplate the Celestial Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal bhai kaatanahaare ||
english: God is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਗੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: haumai maar mile pag dhaare ||5||
english: Subduing ego, one meets the Lord, and places his feet on the Path. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anik jatan kar kaal sa(n)taae ||
english: He makes many efforts, but still, the Messenger of Death tortures him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: maran likhaai ma(n)dal mahi aae ||
english: Destined only to die, he comes into the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: janam padaarath dubidhaa khovai ||
english: He wastes this precious human life through duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aap na cheenas bhram bhram rovai ||6||
english: He does not know his own self, and trapped by doubts, he cries out in pain. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤਉ ਪੜਤਉ ਸੁਣਤਉ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: kahatau paRatau sunatau ek ||
english: Speak, read and hear of the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੀਰਜ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: dheeraj dharam dharaneedhar tek ||
english: The Support of the earth shall bless you with courage, righteousness and protection.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jat sat sa(n)jam ridai samaae ||
english: Chastity, purity and self-restraint are infused into the heart,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਕਉ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: chauthe pad kau je man pateeaae ||7||
english: when one centers his mind in the fourth state. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: saache niramal mail na laagai ||
english: They are immaculate and true, and filth does not stick to them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad bharam bhau bhaagai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, their doubt and fear depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਤਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਆਦਿ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: soorat moorat aad anoop ||
english: The form and personality of the Primal Lord are incomparably beautiful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jaachai saach saroop ||8||1||
english: Nanak begs for the Lord, the Embodiment of Truth. ||8||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sahaj milai miliaa paravaan ||
english: That union with the Lord is acceptable, which is united in intuitive poise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naa tis maran na aavan jaan ||
english: Thereafter, one does not die, and does not come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: thaakur mahi daas daas mahi soi ||
english: The Lord's slave is in the Lord, and the Lord is in His slave.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah avar na koi ||1||
english: Wherever I look, I see none other than the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat sahaj ghar paaeeai ||
english: The Gurmukhs worship the Lord, and find His celestial home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਰਿ ਆਈਐ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin gur bhete mar aaeeai jaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without meeting the Guru, they die, and come and go in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਉ ਜਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so gur karau j saach driRaavai ||
english: So make Him your Guru, who implants the Truth within you,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਾਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: akath kathaavai sabad milaavai ||
english: who leads you to speak the Unspoken Speech, and who merges you in the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har ke log avar nahee kaaraa ||
english: God's people have no other work to do;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saachau thaakur saach piaaraa ||2||
english: they love the True Lord and Master, and they love the Truth. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: tan mahi manooaa man mahi saachaa ||
english: The mind is in the body, and the True Lord is in the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਰਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: so saachaa mil saache raachaa ||
english: Merging into the True Lord, one is absorbed into Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sevak prabh kai laagai paai ||
english: God's servant bows at His feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur pooraa milai milaai ||3||
english: Meeting the True Guru, one meets with the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: aap dikhaavai aape dekhai ||
english: He Himself watches over us, and He Himself makes us see.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਠਿ ਨ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: hath na pateejai naa bahu bhekhai ||
english: He is not pleased by stubborn-mindedness, nor by various religious robes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘੜਿ ਭਾਡੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ghaR bhaade jin a(n)mrit paaiaa ||
english: He fashioned the body-vessels, and infused the Ambrosial Nectar into them;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: prem bhagat prabh man pateeaaiaa ||4||
english: God's Mind is pleased only by loving devotional worship. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭੂਲਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: paR paR bhoolahi chotaa khaahi ||
english: Reading and studying, one becomes confused, and suffers punishment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bahut siaanap aavahi jaahi ||
english: By great cleverness, one is consigned to coming and going in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਭਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naam japai bhau bhojan khaai ||
english: One who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and eats the food of the Fear of God

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramukh sevak rahe samaai ||5||
english: becomes Gurmukh, the Lord's servant, and remains absorbed in the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਿ ਸਿਲਾ ਤੀਰਥ ਬਨ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: pooj silaa teerath ban vaasaa ||
english: He worships stones, dwells at sacred shrines of pilgrimage and in the jungles,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਤ ਡੋਲਤ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: bharamat dolat bhae udaasaa ||
english: wanders, roams around and becomes a renunciate.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਸੂਚਾ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man mailai soochaa kiu hoi ||
english: But his mind is still filthy - how can he become pure?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saach milai paavai pat soi ||6||
english: One who meets the True Lord obtains honor. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਚਾਰਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aachaaraa veechaar sareer ||
english: One who embodies good conduct and contemplative meditation,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aad jugaad sahaj man dheer ||
english: his mind abides in intuitive poise and contentment, since the beginning of time, and throughout the ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਲ ਪੰਕਜ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: pal pa(n)kaj mahi kot udhaare ||
english: In the twinkling of an eye, he saves millions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa gur mel piaare ||7||
english: Have mercy on me, O my Beloved, and let me meet the Guru. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kis aagai prabh tudh saalaahee ||
english: Unto whom, O God, should I praise You?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਮੈ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: tudh bin doojaa mai ko naahee ||
english: Without You, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jiu tudh bhaavai tiu raakh rajaai ||
english: As it pleases You, keep me under Your Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਭਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sahaj bhaai gun gaai ||8||2||
english: Nanak, with intuitive poise and natural love, sings Your Glorious Praises. ||8||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 6 asatapadee ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House, Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਇਓ ਤਿਹ ਤਿਹ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jo jo joonee aaio tih tih urajhaaio maanas janam sa(n)jog paaiaa ||
english: Whoever is born into the world, is entangled in it; human birth is obtained only by good destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਓਟ ਸਾਧ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa kee hai ot saadh raakhahu de kar haath kar kirapaa melahu har raaiaa ||1||
english: I look to Your support, O Holy Saint; give me Your hand, and protect me. By Your Grace, let me meet the Lord, my King. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: anik janam bhram thit nahee paaee ||
english: I wandered through countless incarnations, but I did not find stability anywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਉ ਚਰਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜੀ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karau sevaa gur laagau charan govi(n)d jee kaa maarag dehu jee bataaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I serve the Guru, and I fall at His feet, praying, "O Dear Lord of the Universe, please, show me the way." ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਬਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: anik upaav karau maaiaa kau bachit dharau meree meree karat sad hee vihaavai ||
english: I have tried so many things to acquire the wealth of Maya, and to cherish it in my mind; I have passed my life constantly crying out, "Mine, mine!"

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਲਾਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਚਿੰਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: koee aiso re bhetai sa(n)t meree laahai sagal chi(n)t thaakur siu meraa ra(n)g laavai ||2||
english: Is there any such Saint, who would meet with me, take away my anxiety, and lead me to enshrine love for my Lord and Master. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੜੇ ਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬੇਦ ਨਹ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਭੇਦ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਧੀਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
transliteration: paRe re sagal bed nah chookai man bhed ik khin na dheerahi mere ghar ke pa(n)chaa ||
english: I have read all the Vedas, and yet the sense of separation in my mind still has not been removed; the five thieves of my house are not quieted, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਭਗਤੁ ਜੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਿੰਚਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: koee aiso re bhagat j maaiaa te rahat ik a(n)mrit naam merai ridai si(n)chaa ||3||
english: Is there any devotee, who is unattached to Maya, who may irrigate my mind with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the One Lord? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਰੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਏ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਏ ਘਰ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jete re teerath naae aha(n)budh mail laae ghar ko thaakur ik til na maanai ||
english: In spite of the many places of pilgrimage for people to bathe in, their minds are still stained by their stubborn ego; the Lord Master is not pleased by this at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਦਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kad paavau saadhasa(n)g har har sadaa aana(n)d giaan a(n)jan meraa man isanaanai ||4||
english: When will I find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy? There, I shall be always in the ecstasy of the Lord, Har, Har, and my mind shall take its cleansing bath in the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਅਸ੍ਰਮ ਕੀਨੇ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਨੇ ਬਿਬੇਕਹੀਨ ਦੇਹੀ ਧੋਏ ॥
transliteration: sagal asram keene manooaa nah pateene bibekaheen dehee dhoe ||
english: I have followed the four stages of life, but my mind is not satisfied; I wash my body, but it is totally lacking in understanding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਰੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: koee paaeeai re purakh bidhaataa paarabraham kai ra(n)g raataa mere man kee duramat mal khoe ||5||
english: If only I could meet some devotee of the Supreme Lord God, imbued with the Lord's Love, who could eradicate the filthy evil-mindedness from my mind. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਪੜੈ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam jugataa nimakh na het karataa garab garab paRai kahee na lekhai ||
english: One who is attached to religious rituals, does not love the Lord, even for an instant; he is filled with pride, and he is of no account.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋਊ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਪੇਖੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jis bheteeai saphal moorat karai sadaa keerat gur parasaad kooo netrahu pekhai ||6||
english: One who meets with the rewarding personality of the Guru, continually sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. By Guru's Grace, such a rare one beholds the Lord with his eyes. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜੋ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਗੁਲ ਜਿਉ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੇ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: manahath jo kamaavai til na lekhai paavai bagul jiu dhiaan laavai maaiaa re dhaaree ||
english: One who acts through stubbornness is of no account at all; like a crane, he pretends to meditate, but he is still stuck in Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: koee aiso re sukhah daaee prabh kee kathaa sunaaee tis bhete gat hoi hamaaree ||7||
english: Is there any such Giver of peace, who can recite to me the sermon of God? Meeting him, I would be emancipated. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਕਾਟੈ ਰੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: suprasa(n)n gopaal raai kaatai re ba(n)dhan maai gur kai sabad meraa man raataa ||
english: When the Lord, my King, is totally pleased with me, He will break the bonds of Maya for me; my mind is imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa aana(n)d bhetio nirabhai gobi(n)d sukh naanak laadhe har charan paraataa ||8||
english: I am in ecstasy, forever and ever, meeting the Fearless Lord, the Lord of the Universe. Falling at the Lord's Feet, Nanak has found peace. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਭਈ ਸਫਲ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saphal saphal bhaee saphal jaatraa ||
english: My Yatra, my life pilgrimage, has become fruitful, fruitful, fruitful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: aavan jaan rahe mile saadhaa ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||1||3||
english: My comings and goings have ended, since I met the Holy Saint. ||1||Second Pause||1||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 chha(n)t ||
english: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਣ ਜਾਉ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: teerath naavan jaau teerath naam hai ||
english: Why should I bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage? The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: teerath sabad beechaar a(n)tar giaan hai ||
english: My sacred shrine of pilgrimage is spiritual wisdom within, and contemplation on the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਦਸ ਪੁਰਬ ਸਦਾ ਦਸਾਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur giaan saachaa thaan teerath das purab sadaa dasaaharaa ||
english: The spiritual wisdom given by the Guru is the True sacred shrine of pilgrimage, where the ten festivals are always observed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਚਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਰਣੀਧਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hau naam har kaa sadaa jaachau dehu prabh dharaneedharaa ||
english: I constantly beg for the Name of the Lord; grant it to me, O God, Sustainer of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar rogee naam daaroo mail laagai sach binaa ||
english: The world is sick, and the Naam is the medicine to cure it; without the True Lord, filth sticks to it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਮਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur vaak niramal sadaa chaanan nit saach teerath majanaa ||1||
english: The Guru's Word is immaculate and pure; it radiates a steady Light. Constantly bathe in such a true shrine of pilgrimage. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਈਐ ॥
transliteration: saach na laagai mail kiaa mal dhoeeai ||
english: Filth does not stick to the true ones; what filth do they have to wash off?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਹਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਇ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਰੋਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gunahi haar paroi kis kau roeeai ||
english: If one strings a garland of virtues for oneself, what is there to cry for?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਰੈ ਤਰੈ ਤਾਰੈ ਉਲਟਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
transliteration: veechaar maarai tarai taarai ulat jon na aavae ||
english: One who conquers his own self through contemplation is saved, and saves others as well; he does not come to be born again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਮ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: aap paaras param dhiaanee saach saache bhaavae ||
english: The supreme meditator is Himself the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold. The true man is pleasing to the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੂਖ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਰਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aana(n)d anadin harakh saachaa dookh kilavikh parahare ||
english: He is in ecstasy, truly happy, night and day; his sorrows and sins are taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਚ ਮਨੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sach naam paaiaa gur dikhaaiaa mail naahee sach mane ||2||
english: He finds the True Name, and beholds the Guru; with the True Name in his mind, no filth sticks to him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੀਤ ਮਿਲਾਪੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਵਣੋ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)gat meet milaap pooraa naavano ||
english: O friend, association with the Holy is the perfect cleansing bath.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੋ ॥
transliteration: gaavai gaavanahaar sabad suhaavano ||
english: The singer who sings the Lord's Praises is adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਦਇਆ ਮਤੇ ॥
transliteration: saalaahi saache ma(n)n satigur pu(n)n daan daiaa mate ||
english: Worship the True Lord, and believe in the True Guru; this brings the merit of making donations to charity, kindness and compassion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਬੇਣੀ ਤ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਸਤ ਸਤੇ ॥
transliteration: pir sa(n)g bhaavai sahaj naavai benee ta sa(n)gam sat sate ||
english: The soul-bride who loves to be with her Husband Lord bathes at the true Triveni of the soul, which she regards as the sacred place where the Ganges, Jamuna and Saraswaati Rivers converge.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਰਾਧਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਇ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aaraadh eka(n)kaar saachaa nit dei chaRai savaaiaa ||
english: Worship and adore the One Creator, the True Lord, who constantly gives, whose gifts continually increase.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gat sa(n)g meetaa sa(n)tasa(n)gat kar nadar mel milaaiaa ||3||
english: Salvation is attained by associating with the Society of the Saints, O friend; granting His Grace, God unites us in His Union. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kahan kahai sabh koi kevad aakheeai ||
english: Everyone speaks and talks; how great should I say He is?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਸਮਝਾ ਸਾਖੀਐ ॥
transliteration: hau moorakh neech ajaan samajhaa saakheeai ||
english: I am foolish, lowly and ignorant; it is only through the Guru's Teachings that I understand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਖੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sach gur kee saakhee a(n)mrit bhaakhee tit man maaniaa meraa ||
english: True are the Teachings of the Guru. His Words are Ambrosial Nectar; my mind is pleased and appeased by them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂਚੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kooch karahi aavahi bikh laade sabad sachai gur meraa ||
english: Loaded down with corruption and sin, people depart, and then come back again; the True Shabad is found through my Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aakhan tot na bhagat bha(n)daaree bharipur rahiaa soee ||
english: There is no end to the treasure of devotion; the Lord is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਂਜੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saach kahai bena(n)tee man maa(n)jai sach soee ||4||1||
english: Nanak utters this true prayer; one who purifies his mind is True. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jeevaa terai naai man aana(n)d hai jeeu ||
english: I live by Your Name; my mind is in ecstasy, Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: saacho saachaa naau gun govi(n)d hai jeeu ||
english: True is the Name of the True Lord. Glorious are the Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur giaan apaaraa sirajanahaaraa jin sirajee tin goee ||
english: Infinite is the spiritual wisdom imparted by the Guru. The Creator Lord who created, shall also destroy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: paravaanaa aaiaa hukam pathaaiaa pher na sakai koee ||
english: The call of death is sent out by the Lord's Command; no one can challenge it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aape kar vekhai sir sir lekhai aape surat bujhaaee ||
english: He Himself creates, and watches; His written command is above each and every head. He Himself imparts understanding and awareness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saahib agam agochar jeevaa sachee naaee ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Master is inaccessible and unfathomable; I live by His True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tum sar avar na koi aaiaa jaaisee jeeu ||
english: No one can compare to You, Lord; all come and go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਸੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: hukamee hoi nibeR bharam chukaaisee jeeu ||
english: By Your Command, the account is settled, and doubt is dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਹਾਏ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gur bharam chukaae akath kahaae sach mahi saach samaanaa ||
english: The Guru dispels doubt, and makes us speak the Unspoken Speech; the true ones are absorbed into Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: aap upaae aap samaae hukamee hukam pachhaanaa ||
english: He Himself creates, and He Himself destroys; I accept the Command of the Commander Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਤੂ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sachee vadiaaee gur te paaee too man a(n)t sakhaaee ||
english: True greatness comes from the Guru; You alone are the mind's companion in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saahib avar na doojaa naam terai vadiaaee ||2||
english: O Nanak, there is no other than the Lord and Master; greatness comes from Your Name. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਸਿਰੰਦਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: too sachaa sirajanahaar alakh sira(n)diaa jeeu ||
english: You are the True Creator Lord, the unknowable Maker.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਵਾਦ ਵਧੰਦਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ek saahib dui raah vaad vadha(n)diaa jeeu ||
english: There is only the One Lord and Master, but there are two paths, by which conflict increases.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਏ ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dui raah chalaae hukam sabaae janam muaa sa(n)saaraa ||
english: All follow these two paths, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command; the world is born, only to die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa naahee ko belee bikh laadee sir bhaaraa ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal has no friend at all; he carries loads of sin on his head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hukamee aaiaa hukam na boojhai hukam savaaranahaaraa ||
english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he comes, but he does not understand this Hukam; the Lord's Hukam is the Embellisher.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak saahib sabad sinjaapai saachaa sirajanahaaraa ||3||
english: O Nanak, through the Shabad, the Word of the Lord and Master, the True Creator Lord is realized. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਵਾਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bhagat sohahi daravaar sabad suhaaiaa jeeu ||
english: Your devotees look beautiful in Your Court, embellished with the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bolahi a(n)mrit baan rasan rasaaiaa jeeu ||
english: They chant the Ambrosial Word of His Bani, savoring it with their tongues.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਏ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਿਸਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਕਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: rasan rasaae naam tisaae gur kai sabad vikaane ||
english: Savoring it with their tongues, they thirst for the Naam; they are a sacrifice to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਏ ਜਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: paaras parasiai paaras hoe jaa terai man bhaane ||
english: Touching the philosopher's stone, they become the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold; O Lord, they become pleasing to your mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: amaraa pad paaiaa aap gavaaiaa viralaa giaan veechaaree ||
english: They attain the immortal status and eradicate their self-conceit; how rare is that person, who contemplates spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak bhagat sohan dar saachai saache ke vaapaaree ||4||
english: O Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in the Court of the True Lord; they are dealers in the Truth. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸੋ ਆਥਿ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bhookh piaaso aath kiu dar jaaisaa jeeu ||
english: I am hungry and thirsty for wealth; how will I be able to go to the Lord's Court?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur poochhau jaai naam dhiaaisaa jeeu ||
english: I shall go and ask the True Guru, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਸਾਚੁ ਚਵਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sach naam dhiaaee saach chavaaee guramukh saach pachhaanaa ||
english: I meditate on the True Name, chant the True Name, and as Gurmukh, I realize the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: deenaa naath daiaal nira(n)jan anadin naam vakhaanaa ||
english: Night and day, I chant the Name of the merciful, immaculate Lord, the Master of the poor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: karanee kaar dhurahu phuramaaee aap muaa man maaree ||
english: The Primal Lord has ordained the tasks to be done; self-conceit is overcome, and the mind is subdued.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam mahaa ras meethaa trisanaa naam nivaaree ||5||2||
english: O Nanak, the Naam is the sweetest essence; through the Naam, thirst and desire are stilled. ||5||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree chha(n)t mahalaa 1 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Chhant, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੂਠੜੀਏ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: pir sa(n)g moothaReee khabar na paaeeaa jeeu ||
english: Your Husband Lord is with you, O deluded soul-bride, but you do are not aware of Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਅੜਾ ਲੇਖੁ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: masatak likhiaRaa lekh purab kamaaiaa jeeu ||
english: Your destiny is written on your forehead, according to your past actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
transliteration: lekh na mitaee purab kamaaiaa kiaa jaanaa kiaa hosee ||
english: This inscription of past deeds cannot be erased; what do I know about what will happen?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣੀ ਅਚਾਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਸੀ ॥
transliteration: gunee achaar nahee ra(n)g raatee avagun bahi bahi rosee ||
english: You have not adopted a virtuous lifestyle, and you are not attuned to the Lord's Love; you sit there, crying over your past misdeeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਆਕ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਏ ਦਿਨ ਪੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dhan joban aak kee chhaaiaa biradh bhae din pu(n)niaa ||
english: Wealth and youth are like the shade of the bitter swallow-wort plant; you are growing old, and your days are coming to their end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਛੂਟੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam binaa dohaagan chhootee jhooth vichhu(n)niaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall end up as a discarded, divorced bride; your own falsehood shall separate you from the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡੀ ਘਰੁ ਘਾਲਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੋ ॥
transliteration: boodee ghar ghaalio gur kai bhaai chalo ||
english: You have drowned, and your house is ruined; walk in the Way of the Guru's Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਹਲੋ ॥
transliteration: saachaa naam dhiaai paavahi sukh mahalo ||
english: Meditate on the True Name, and you shall find peace in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har naam dhiaae taa sukh paae peeeaRai din chaare ||
english: Meditate on the Lord's Name, and you shall find peace; your stay in this world shall last only four days.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: nij ghar jaai bahai sach paae anadin naal piaare ||
english: Sit in the home of your own being, and you shall find Truth; night and day, be with your Beloved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
transliteration: vin bhagatee ghar vaas na hovee suniahu lok sabaae ||
english: Without loving devotion, you cannot dwell in your own home - listen, everyone!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਸੀ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sarasee taa pir paae raatee saachai naae ||2||
english: O Nanak, she is happy, and she obtains her Husband Lord, if she is attuned to the True Name. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਧਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: pir dhan bhaavai taa pir bhaavai naaree jeeu ||
english: If the soul-bride is pleasing to her Husband Lord, then the Husband Lord will love His bride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g preetam raatee gur kai sabad veechaaree jeeu ||
english: Imbued with the love of her Beloved, she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
transliteration: gur sabad veechaaree naah piaaree niv niv bhagat kareee ||
english: She contemplates the Guru's Shabads, and her Husband Lord loves her; in deep humility, she worships Him in loving devotion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਏ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu jalaae preetam ras mahi ra(n)g kareee ||
english: She burns away her emotional attachment to Maya, and in love, she loves her Beloved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੇਤੀ ਲਾਲ ਭਈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh saache setee ra(n)g ra(n)getee laal bhaee man maaree ||
english: She is imbued and drenched with the Love of the True Lord; she has become beautiful, by conquering her mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਵਸੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਪਿਰ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak saach vasee sohaagan pir siu preet piaaree ||3||
english: O Nanak, the happy soul-bride abides in Truth; she loves to love her Husband Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਨਾਰਿ ਜੇ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: pir ghar sohai naar je pir bhaavae jeeu ||
english: The soul-bride looks so beautiful in the home of her Husband Lord, if she is pleasing to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੇ ਵੈਣ ਚਵੇ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jhoothe vain chave kaam na aavae jeeu ||
english: It is of no use at all to speak false words.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੁ ਅਲਾਵੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jhooth alaavai kaam na aavai naa pir dekhai nainee ||
english: If she speaks false, it is of no use to her, and she does not see her Husband Lord with her eyes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਛੂਟੀ ਵਿਧਣ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: avaguniaaree ka(n)t visaaree chhootee vidhan rainee ||
english: Worthless, forgotten and abandoned by her Husband Lord, she passes her life-night without her Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੀ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gurasabad na maanai phaahee phaathee saa dhan mahal na paae ||
english: Such a wife does not believe in the Word of the Guru's Shabad; she is caught in the net of the world, and does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak aape aap pachhaanai guramukh sahaj samaae ||4||
english: O Nanak, if she understands her own self, then, as Gurmukh, she merges in celestial peace. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: dhan sohaagan naar jin pir jaaniaa jeeu ||
english: Blessed is that soul-bride, who knows her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਣਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa kooRiaar kooR kamaaniaa jeeu ||
english: Without the Naam, she is false, and her actions are false as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੀ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: har bhagat suhaavee saache bhaavee bhaai bhagat prabh raatee ||
english: Devotional worship of the Lord is beautiful; the True Lord loves it. So immerse yourself in loving devotional worship of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਲੀਆਲਾ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: pir raleeaalaa joban baalaa tis raave ra(n)g raatee ||
english: My Husband Lord is playful and innocent; imbued with His Love, I enjoy Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਾਸੀ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gur sabad vigaasee sahu raavaasee phal paaiaa gunakaaree ||
english: She blossoms forth through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; she ravishes her Husband Lord, and obtains the most noble reward.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਿਰ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak saach milai vadiaaee pir ghar sohai naaree ||5||3||
english: O Nanak, in Truth, she obtains glory; in her Husband's home, the soul-bride looks beautiful. ||5||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree chha(n)t mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu kripaa kare taa naam dhiaaeeai jeeu ||
english: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, one meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai subhaai sahaj gun gaaeeai jeeu ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, through loving faith and devotion, one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: gun gaai vigasai sadaa anadin jaa aap saache bhaavae ||
english: Singing His Glorious Praises continually, night and day, one blossoms forth, when it is pleasing to the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)kaar haumai tajai maaiaa sahaj naam samaavae ||
english: Egotism, self-conceit and Maya are forsaken, and he is intuitively absorbed into the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: aap karataa kare soee aap dei ta paaeeai ||
english: The Creator Himself acts; when He gives, then we receive.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har jeeu kripaa kare taa naam dhiaaeeai jeeu ||1||
english: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, we meditate on the Naam. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar saachaa nehu poore satigurai jeeu ||
english: Deep within, I feel true love for the Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: hau tis sevee din raat mai kade na veesarai jeeu ||
english: I serve Him day and night; I never forget Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਈ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
transliteration: kade na visaaree anadin samhaaree jaa naam laee taa jeevaa ||
english: I never forget Him; I remember Him night and day. When I chant the Naam, then I live.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sravanee sunee ta ihu man tripatai guramukh a(n)mrit peevaa ||
english: With my ears, I hear about Him, and my mind is satisfied. As Gurmukh, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa satigur mele anadin bibek budh bicharai ||
english: If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then I shall meet the True Guru; my discriminating intellect would contemplate Him, night and day.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)dar saachaa nehu poore satigurai ||2||
english: Deep within, I feel true love for the Perfect True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat milai vadabhaag taa har ras aavae jeeu ||
english: By great good fortune, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; then, one comes to savor the subtle essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਤ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: anadin rahai liv laai ta sahaj samaavae jeeu ||
english: Night and day, he remains lovingly focused on the Lord; he merges in celestial peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaj samaavai taa har man bhaavai sadaa ateet bairaagee ||
english: Merging in celestial peace, he becomes pleasing to the Lord's Mind; he remains forever unattached and untouched.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: halat palat sobhaa jag a(n)tar raam naam liv laagee ||
english: He receives honor in this world and the next, lovingly focused on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਹਾ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: harakh sog duhaa te mukataa jo prabh kare s bhaavae ||
english: He is liberated from both pleasure and pain; he is pleased by whatever God does.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat milai vadabhaag taa har ras aavae jeeu ||3||
english: By great good fortune, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and then, one comes to savor the subtle essence of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai dukh hoi manamukh jam johiaa jeeu ||
english: In the love of duality, there is pain and suffering; the Messenger of Death eyes the self-willed manmukhs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਾਇ ਹਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੁਖਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: haai haai kare din raat maaiaa dukh mohiaa jeeu ||
english: They cry and howl, day and night, caught by the pain of Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਦੁਖਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਹਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa dukh mohiaa haumai rohiaa meree meree karat vihaavae ||
english: Caught by the pain of Maya, provoked by his ego, he passes his life crying out, "Mine, mine!".

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: jo prabh dei tis chetai naahee a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaavae ||
english: He does not remember God, the Giver, and in the end, he departs regretting and repenting.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੋਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai ko saath na chaalai putr kalatr maaiaa dhohiaa ||
english: Without the Name, nothing shall go along with him; not his children, spouse or the enticements of Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai dukh hoi manamukh jam johiaa jeeu ||4||
english: In the love of duality, there is pain and suffering; the Messenger of Death eyes the self-willed manmukhs. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa lehu milaai mahal har paaiaa jeeu ||
english: Granting His Grace, the Lord has merged me with Himself; I have found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa rahai kar joR prabh man bhaaiaa jeeu ||
english: I remain standing with my palms pressed together; I have become pleasing to God's Mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh man bhaavai taa hukam samaavai hukam ma(n)n sukh paaiaa ||
english: When one is pleasing to God's Mind, then he merges in the Hukam of the Lord's Command; surrendering to His Hukam, he finds peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anadin japat rahai din raatee sahaje naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: Night and day, he chants the Lord's Name, day and night; intuitively, naturally, he meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: naamo naam milee vadiaaee naanak naam man bhaavae ||
english: Through the Naam, the glorious greatness of the Naam is obtained; the Naam is pleasing to Nanak's mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa lehu milaai mahal har paavae jeeu ||5||1||
english: Granting His Grace, the Lord has merged me with Himself; I have found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||5||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur deen daiaal jis sa(n)g har gaaveeai jeeu ||
english: The True Guru is merciful to the meek; in His Presence, the Lord's Praises are sung.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਵੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naam saadhasa(n)g raaveeai jeeu ||
english: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is chanted in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧੂ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਏ ॥
transliteration: bhaj sa(n)g saadhoo ik araadhoo janam maran dukh naasae ||
english: Vibrating, and worshipping the One Lord in the Company of the Holy, the pains of birth and death are removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਿਖਿਆ ਕਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਏ ॥
transliteration: dhur karam likhiaa saach sikhiaa katee jam kee phaasae ||
