english: Those who have such karma pre-ordained, study and learn the Truth; the noose of Death is removed from their necks.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਨਾਠੇ ਛੁਟੀ ਗਾਠੇ ਜਮ ਪੰਥਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵੀਐ ॥
transliteration: bhai bharam naathe chhutee gaathe jam pa(n)th mool na aaveeai ||
english: Their fears and doubts are dispelled, the knot of death is untied, and they never have to walk on Death's path.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa sadaa har gun gaaveeai ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord; let me sing Your Glorious Praises forever. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: nidhariaa dhar ek naam nira(n)jano jeeu ||
english: The Name of the One, Immaculate Lord is the Support of the unsupported.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: too daataa daataar sarab dukh bha(n)jano jeeu ||
english: You are the Giver, the Great Giver, the Dispeller of all sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੁਖਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dukh harat karataa sukhah suaamee saran saadhoo aaiaa ||
english: O Destroyer of pain, Creator Lord, Master of peace and bliss, I have come seeking the Sanctuary of the Holy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਪਲ ਏਕ ਮਾਹਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar mahaa bikhaRaa pal ek maahi taraaiaa ||
english: please, help me to cross over the terrifying and difficult world-ocean in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਅੰਜਨੋ ॥
transliteration: poor rahiaa sarab thaaee gur giaan netree a(n)jano ||
english: I saw the Lord pervading and permeating everywhere, when the healing ointment of the Guru's wisdom was applied to my eyes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sadaa simaree sarab dukh bhai bha(n)jano ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, remember Him forever in meditation, the Destroyer of all sorrow and fear. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aap leee laR laai kirapaa dhaareeaa jeeu ||
english: He Himself has attached me to the hem of His robe; He has showered me with His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: mohi niragun neech anaath prabh agam apaareeaa jeeu ||
english: I am worthless, lowly and helpless; God is unfathomable and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨੀਚ ਥਾਪਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: daiaal sadaa kripaal suaamee neech thaapanahaariaa ||
english: My Lord and Master is always merciful, kind and compassionate; He uplifts and establishes the lowly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਵਸਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh vas terai sagal teree saariaa ||
english: All beings and creatures are under Your power; You take care of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਗਲ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aap karataa aap bhugataa aap sagal beechaareeaa ||
english: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer; He Himself is the Contemplator of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak gun gaai jeevaa har jap japau banavaareeaa ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, singing Your Glorious Praises, I live, chanting the Chant of the Lord, the Lord of the world-forest. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: teraa daras apaar naam amolaee jeeu ||
english: The Blessed Vision of Your Darshan is incomparable; Your Name is utterly priceless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਤੋਲਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: nit japahi tere daas purakh atolaee jeeu ||
english: O my Incomputable Lord, Your humble servants ever meditate on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਵੂਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਮਾਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t rasan voothaa aap toothaa har rasahi seee maatiaa ||
english: You dwell on the tongues of the Saints, by Your own pleasure; they are intoxicated with Your sublime essence, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਮਹਾ ਭਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur charan laage mahaa bhaage sadaa anadin jaagiaa ||
english: Those who are attached to Your feet are very blessed; night and day, they remain always awake and aware.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਬੵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਈ ॥
transliteration: sad sadaa si(n)mrataby suaamee saas saas gun bolaee ||
english: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master; with each and every breath, speak His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਅਮੋਲਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak dhoor saadhoo naam prabhoo amolaee ||4||1||
english: Prays Nanak, let me become the dust of the feet of the Saints. God's Name is invaluable. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag dhanaasaree baanee bhagat kabeer jee kee ||
english: Raag Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: sanak sana(n)d mahes samaanaa(n) ||
english: Beings like Sanak, Sanand, Shiva and Shaysh-naaga

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਖਨਾਗਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sekhanaag tero maram na jaanaa(n) ||1||
english: - none of them know Your mystery, Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)gat raam ridai basaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, the Lord dwells within the heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਨੂਮਾਨ ਸਰਿ ਗਰੁੜ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: hanoomaan sar garuR samaanaa(n) ||
english: Beings like Hanumaan, Garura, Indra the King of the gods and the rulers of humans

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਪਤਿ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੨॥
transliteration: surapat narapat nahee gun jaanaa(n) ||2||
english: - none of them know Your Glories, Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਅਰੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: chaar bed ar si(n)mrit puraanaa(n) ||
english: The four Vedas, the Simritees and the Puraanas, Vishnu the Lord of Lakshmi

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਮਲਾਪਤਿ ਕਵਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kamalaapat kavalaa nahee jaanaa(n) ||3||
english: And Lakshmi herself - none of them know the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੋ ਭਰਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer so bharamai naahee ||
english: Says Kabeer, one who falls at the Lord's feet,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਗ ਲਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਹੈ ਸਰਨਾਂਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: pag lag raam rahai saranaa(n)hee ||4||1||
english: And remains in His Sanctuary, does not wander around lost. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਪਹਰ ਪਹਰ ਤੇ ਘਰੀਆਂ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: din te pahar pahar te ghareeaa(n) aav ghatai tan chheejai ||
english: Day by day, hour by hour, life runs its course, and the body withers away.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਅਹੇਰੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਧਿਕ ਜਿਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaal aheree phirai badhik jiu kahahu kavan bidh keejai ||1||
english: Death, like a hunter, a butcher, is on the prowl; tell me, what can we do? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਆਵਨ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: so din aavan laagaa ||
english: That day is rapidly approaching.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋਊ ਹੈ ਕਾ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut banitaa kahahu kooo hai kaa kaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Mother, father, siblings, children and spouse - tell me, who belongs to whom? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਬਰਤੈ ਆਪਾ ਪਸੂ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: jab lag jot kaaiaa mahi baratai aapaa pasoo na boojhai ||
english: As long as the light remains in the body, the beast does not understand himself.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚ ਕਰੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: laalach karai jeevan pad kaaran lochan kachhoo na soojhai ||2||
english: He acts in greed to maintain his life and status, and sees nothing with his eyes. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re praanee chhodahu man ke bharamaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O mortal: Renounce the doubts of your mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਪਰਹੁ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਂ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: keval naam japahu re praanee parahu ek kee saranaa(n) ||3||2||
english: Chant only the One Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mortal, and seek the Sanctuary of the One Lord. ||3||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕਾਹੋ ॥
transliteration: jo jan bhaau bhagat kachh jaanai taa kau acharaj kaaho ||
english: That humble being, who knows even a little about loving devotional worship - what surprises are there for him?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲੁ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਪੈਸਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਤਿਉ ਢੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu jal jal mahi pais na nikasai tiu dhur milio julaaho ||1||
english: Like water, dripping into water, which cannot be separated out again, so is the weaver Kabeer, with softened heart, merged into the Lord. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗਾ ਮੈ ਤਉ ਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਭੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har ke logaa mai tau mat kaa bhoraa ||
english: O people of the Lord, I am just a simple-minded fool.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਸੀ ਤਜਹਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਰਮਈਐ ਕਹਾ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jau tan kaasee tajahi kabeeraa ramaeeai kahaa nihoraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If Kabeer were to leave his body at Benares, and so liberate himself, what obligation would he have to the Lord? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਈ ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re loee bharam na bhoolahu koee ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O people - do not be deluded by doubt.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਾਸੀ ਕਿਆ ਊਖਰੁ ਮਗਹਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਉ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: kiaa kaasee kiaa ookhar magahar raam ridai jau hoee ||2||3||
english: What is the difference between Benares and the barren land of Maghar, if the Lord is within one's heart? ||2||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਸਿਵ ਲੋਕਹਿ ਜੈਬੋ ॥
transliteration: i(n)dr lok siv lokahi jaibo ||
english: Mortals may go to the Realm of Indra, or the Realm of Shiva,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਓਛੇ ਤਪ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਹੁਰਿ ਐਬੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ochhe tap kar baahur aibo ||1||
english: but because of their hypocrisy and false prayers, they must leave again. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kiaa maa(n)gau kichh thir naahee ||
english: What should I ask for? Nothing lasts forever.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam rakh man maahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Enshrine the Lord's Name within your mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਭੈ ਬਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sobhaa raaj bibhai badiaaee ||
english: Fame and glory, power, wealth and glorious greatness

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)t na kaahoo sa(n)g sahaaee ||2||
english: - none of these will go with you or help you in the end. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਲਛਮੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr lachhamee maaiaa ||
english: Children, spouse, wealth and Maya

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਵਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: in te kahu kavanai sukh paaiaa ||3||
english: - who has ever obtained peace from these? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer avar nahee kaamaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, nothing else is of any use.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨ ਧਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: hamarai man dhan raam ko naamaa ||4||4||
english: Within my mind is the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||4||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raam simar raam simar raam simar bhaaee ||
english: Remember the Lord, remember the Lord, remember the Lord in meditation, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਡਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam simaran bin boodate adhikaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without remembering the Lord's Name in meditation, a great many are drowned. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਦੇਹ ਗ੍ਰੇਹ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: banitaa sut deh greh sa(n)pat sukhadaaee ||
english: Your spouse, children, body, house and possessions - you think these will give you peace.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਨੑ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਕਾਲ ਅਵਧ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: inh mai kachh naahi tero kaal avadh aaee ||1||
english: But none of these shall be yours, when the time of death comes. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਜਾਮਲ ਗਜ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: ajaamal gaj ganikaa patit karam keene ||
english: Ajaamal, the elephant, and the prostitute committed many sins,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇਊ ਉਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: teoo utar paar pare raam naam leene ||2||
english: but still, they crossed over the world-ocean, by chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੂਕਰ ਕੂਕਰ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਤਊ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sookar kookar jon bhrame taoo laaj na aaee ||
english: You have wandered in reincarnation, as pigs and dogs - did you feel no shame?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਛਾਡਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam naam chhaad a(n)mrit kaahe bikh khaaee ||3||
english: Forsaking the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, why do you eat poison? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਭਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਿਖੇਧ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: taj bharam karam bidh nikhedh raam naam lehee ||
english: Abandon your doubts about do's and dont's, and take to the Lord's Name.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਨ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: gur prasaad jan kabeer raam kar sanehee ||4||5||
english: By Guru's Grace, O servant Kabeer, love the Lord. ||4||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree baanee bhagat naamadev jee kee ||
english: Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਹਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਨੀਵ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਊਪਰਿ ਮੰਡਪ ਛਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gaharee kar kai neev khudaaee oopar ma(n)dap chhaae ||
english: They dig deep foundations, and build lofty palaces.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਕੰਡੇ ਤੇ ਕੋ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਧਰਿ ਮੂੰਡ ਬਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maaraka(n)de te ko adhikaaee jin trin dhar moo(n)d balaae ||1||
english: Can anyone live longer than Markanda, who passed his days with only a handful of straw upon his head? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: hamaro karataa raam sanehee ||
english: The Creator Lord is our only friend.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਨਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰਤ ਹਹੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਝੂਠੀ ਦੇਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaahe re nar garab karat hahu binas jaai jhoothee dehee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O man, why are you so proud? This body is only temporary - it shall pass away. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕੈਰਉ ਕਰਤੇ ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨ ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: meree meree kairau karate durajodhan se bhaaee ||
english: The Kaurvas, who had brothers like Duryodhan, used to proclaim, "This is ours! This is ours!"

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਜੋਜਨ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਚਲੈ ਥਾ ਦੇਹੀ ਗਿਰਝਨ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: baarah jojan chhatr chalai thaa dehee girajhan khaaee ||2||
english: Their royal procession extended over sixty miles, and yet their bodies were eaten by vultures. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੋੁਇਨ ਕੀ ਲੰਕਾ ਹੋਤੀ ਰਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sarab souin kee la(n)kaa hotee raavan se adhikaaee ||
english: Sri Lanka was totally rich with gold; was anyone greater than its ruler Raavan?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਹਾਥੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahaa bhaio dar baa(n)dhe haathee khin mahi bhaee paraaee ||3||
english: What happened to the elephants, tethered at his gate? In an instant, it all belonged to someone else. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਬਾਸਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਤ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਜਾਦਵ ਏ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: durabaasaa siu karat thagauree jaadav e phal paae ||
english: The Yaadvas deceived Durbaasaa, and received their rewards.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਊਪਰ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kripaa karee jan apune oopar naamadeu har gun gaae ||4||1||
english: The Lord has shown mercy to His humble servant, and now Naam Dayv sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਕਾ ਮਿਟ ਨਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: das bairaagan mohi bas keenhee pa(n)chahu kaa mit naavau ||
english: I have brought the ten sensory organs under my control, and erased every trace of the five thieves.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਤਰਿ ਦੋਇ ਭਰੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satar doi bhare a(n)mrit sar bikh kau maar kadhaavau ||1||
english: I have filled the seventy-two thousand nerve channels with Ambrosial Nectar, and drained out the poison. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: paachhai bahur na aavan paavau ||
english: I shall not come into the world again.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਘਟ ਤੇ ਉਚਰਉ ਆਤਮ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee ghat te ucharau aatam kau samajhaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I chant the Ambrosial Bani of the Word from the depths of my heart, and I have instructed my soul. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਜਰ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਹੈ ਛੀਨਾਂ ਕਰਿ ਮਿੰਨਤਿ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: bajar kuthaar mohi hai chheenaa(n) kar mi(n)nat lag paavau ||
english: I fell at the Guru's feet and begged of Him; with the mighty axe, I have chopped off emotional attachment.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਉਲਟੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਤੇ ਡਰਪਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan ke ham ulate sevak bhagatan te darapaavau ||2||
english: Turning away from the world, I have become the servant of the Saints; I fear no one except the Lord's devotees. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤੇ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਛੂਟਉ ਜਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਹ ਲਪਟਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: ih sa(n)saar te tab hee chhootau jau maaiaa nah lapataavau ||
english: I shall be released from this world, when I stop clinging to Maya.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਾ ਤਿਹ ਤਜਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maaiaa naam garabh jon kaa tih taj darasan paavau ||3||
english: Maya is the name of the power which causes us to be born; renouncing it, we obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਤਿਨ ਭਉ ਸਗਲ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: it kar bhagat karahi jo jan tin bhau sagal chukaaeeai ||
english: That humble being, who performs devotional worship in this way, is rid of all fear.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਭਰਮਹੁ ਇਹ ਸੰਜਮ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: kahat naamadeu baahar kiaa bharamahu ih sa(n)jam har paaeeai ||4||2||
english: Says Naam Dayv, why are you wandering around out there? This is the way to find the Lord. ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਵਾੜਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਬੇਲਿ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਕਰਹਲਾ ॥
transliteration: maaravaaR jaise neer baalahaa bel baalahaa karahalaa ||
english: As water is very precious in the desert, and the creeper weeds are dear to the camel,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਦੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu kura(n)k nis naad baalahaa tiu merai man raamaeeaa ||1||
english: and the tune of the hunter's bell at night is enticing to the deer, so is the Lord to my mind. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰੂੜੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਰੂੜੋ ਅਤਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੂੜੋ ਮੇਰੋ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teraa naam rooRo roop rooRo at ra(n)g rooRo mero raamaeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your Name is so beautiful! Your form is so beautiful! Your Love is so very beautiful, O my Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਧਰਣੀ ਕਉ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਵਰਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu dharanee kau i(n)dr baalahaa kusam baas jaise bhavaralaa ||
english: As rain is dear to the earth, and the flower's fragrance is dear to the bumble bee,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਕਉ ਅੰਬੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu kokil kau a(n)b baalahaa tiu merai man raamaeeaa ||2||
english: and the mango is dear to the cuckoo, so is the Lord to my mind. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਚਕਵੀ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੂਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਹੰਸੁਲਾ ॥
transliteration: chakavee kau jaise soor baalahaa maan sarovar ha(n)sulaa ||
english: As the sun is dear to the chakvi duck, and the lake of Man Sarovar is dear to the swan,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤਰੁਣੀ ਕਉ ਕੰਤੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu tarunee kau ka(n)t baalahaa tiu merai man raamaeeaa ||3||
english: and the husband is dear to his wife, so is the Lord to my mind. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਖੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੁਖ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲਧਰਾ ॥
transliteration: baarik kau jaise kheer baalahaa chaatrik mukh jaise jaladharaa ||
english: As milk is dear to the baby, and the raindrop is dear to the mouth of the rainbird,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: machhulee kau jaise neer baalahaa tiu merai man raamaeeaa ||4||
english: and as water is dear to the fish, so is the Lord to my mind. ||4||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਮੁਨਿ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਡੀਠੁਲਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhik sidh sagal mun chaahahi birale kaahoo deethulaa ||
english: All the seekers, Siddhas and silent sages seek Him, but only a rare few behold Him.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਣ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੇ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੫॥੩॥
transliteration: sagal bhavan tero naam baalahaa tiu naame man beethulaa ||5||3||
english: Just as Your Name is dear to all the Universe, so is the Lord dear to Naam Dayv's mind. ||5||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲ ਪੁਰੀਏ ਪੁੰਡਰਕ ਵਨਾ ॥
transliteration: pahil pureee pu(n)darak vanaa ||
english: First of all, the lotuses bloomed in the woods;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਚੇ ਹੰਸਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਜਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: taa che ha(n)saa sagale janaa(n) ||
english: from them, all the swan-souls came into being.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਨਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਊ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਚੰਤੀ ਨਾਚਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: krisnaa te jaanaoo har har naacha(n)tee naachanaa ||1||
english: Know that, through Krishna, the Lord, Har, Har, the dance of creation dances. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲ ਪੁਰਸਾਬਿਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pahil purasaabiraa ||
english: First of all, there was only the Primal Being.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਥੋਨ ਪੁਰਸਾਦਮਰਾ ॥
transliteration: athon purasaadamaraa ||
english: From that Primal Being, Maya was produced.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਸਗਾ ਅਸ ਉਸਗਾ ॥
transliteration: asagaa as usagaa ||
english: All that is, is His.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਾਗਰਾ ਨਾਚੈ ਪਿੰਧੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਗਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har kaa baagaraa naachai pi(n)dhee mahi saagaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In this Garden of the Lord, we all dance, like water in the pots of the Persian wheel. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਚੰਤੀ ਗੋਪੀ ਜੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naacha(n)tee gopee ja(n)naa ||
english: Women and men both dance.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਈਆ ਤੇ ਬੈਰੇ ਕੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naeeaa te baire ka(n)naa ||
english: There is no other than the Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤਰਕੁ ਨ ਚਾ ॥
transliteration: tarak na chaa ||
english: Don't dispute this,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੀਆ ਚਾ ॥
transliteration: bhrameeaa chaa ||
english: and don't doubt this.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕੇਸਵਾ ਬਚਉਨੀ ਅਈਏ ਮਈਏ ਏਕ ਆਨ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kesavaa bachaunee aeee maeee ek aan jeeu ||2||
english: The Lord says, "This creation and I are one and the same." ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪਿੰਧੀ ਉਭਕਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pi(n)dhee ubhakale sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Like the pots on the Persian wheel, sometimes the world is high, and sometimes it is low.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਏ ਤੁਮ ਚੇ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhram bhram aae tum che duaaraa ||
english: Wandering and roaming around, I have come at last to Your Door.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕੁਨੁ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: too kun re ||
english: "Who are you?"

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਜੀ ॥ ਨਾਮਾ ॥ ਹੋ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: mai jee || naamaa || ho jee ||
english: "I am Naam Dayv, Sir."

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਆਲਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਾ ਜਮ ਕਾਰਣਾ ॥੩॥੪॥
transliteration: aalaa te nivaaranaa jam kaaranaa ||3||4||
english: O Lord, please save me from Maya, the cause of death. ||3||4||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਮਾਧਉ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan maadhau birad teraa ||
english: O Lord, You are the Purifier of sinners - this is Your innate nature.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਵੈ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dha(n)n te vai mun jan jin dhiaaio har prabh meraa ||1||
english: Blessed are those silent sages and humble beings, who meditate on my Lord God. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਲੇ ਧੂਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਚਰਨਨ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: merai maathai laagee le dhoor gobi(n)d charanan kee ||
english: I have applied to my forehead the dust of the feet of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਤਿਨਹੂ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sur nar mun jan tinahoo te door ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This is something which is far away from the gods, mortal men and silent sages. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਕਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮਾਧੌ ਗਰਬ ਪਰਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: deen kaa daiaal maadhau garab parahaaree ||
english: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pride

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: charan saran naamaa bal tihaaree ||2||5||
english: - Naam Dayv seeks the Sanctuary of Your feet; he is a sacrifice to You. ||2||5||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਭਗਤ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree bhagat ravidaas jee kee ||
english: Dhanaasaree, Devotee Ravi Daas Jee:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਸਰਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਬ ਪਤੀਆਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: ham sar deen daiaal na tum sar ab pateeaar kiaa keejai ||
english: There is none as forlorn as I am, and none as Compassionate as You; what need is there to test us now?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਚਨੀ ਤੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bachanee tor mor man maanai jan kau pooran deejai ||1||
english: May my mind surrender to Your Word; please, bless Your humble servant with this perfection. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਰਮਈਆ ਕਾਰਨੇ ॥
transliteration: hau bal bal jaau ramaeeaa kaarane ||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Lord.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਵਨ ਅਬੋਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaaran kavan abol || rahaau ||
english: O Lord, why are You silent? ||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਛੁਰੇ ਥੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਲੇਖੇ ॥
transliteration: bahut janam bichhure the maadhau ihu janam tumhaare lekhe ||
english: For so many incarnations, I have been separated from You, Lord; I dedicate this life to You.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਆਸ ਲਗਿ ਜੀਵਉ ਚਿਰ ਭਇਓ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas aas lag jeevau chir bhaio darasan dekhe ||2||1||
english: Says Ravi Daas: placing my hopes in You, I live; it is so long since I have gazed upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਉ ਨੈਨ ਅਵਿਲੋਕਨੋ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਾਨੀ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਾਖਉ ॥
transliteration: chit simaran karau nain avilokano sravan baanee sujas poor raakhau ||
english: In my consciousness, I remember You in meditation; with my eyes, I behold You; I fill my ears with the Word of Your Bani, and Your Sublime Praise.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਧੁਕਰੁ ਕਰਉ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਧਰਉ ਰਸਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਭਾਖਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man s madhukar karau charan hirade dharau rasan a(n)mrit raam naam bhaakhau ||1||
english: My mind is the bumble bee; I enshrine Your feet within my heart, and with my tongue, I chant the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਘਟੈ ॥
transliteration: meree preet gobi(n)d siu jin ghatai ||
english: My love for the Lord of the Universe does not decrease.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਤਉ ਮੋਲਿ ਮਹਗੀ ਲਈ ਜੀਅ ਸਟੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mai tau mol mahagee laee jee satai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I paid for it dearly, in exchange for my soul. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਭਾਉ ਨਹੀ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਵ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat binaa bhaau nahee oopajai bhaav bin bhagat nahee hoi teree ||
english: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, love for the Lord does not well up; without this love, Your devotional worship cannot be performed.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: kahai ravidaas ik benatee har siu paij raakhahu raajaa raam meree ||2||2||
english: Ravi Daas offers this one prayer unto the Lord: please preserve and protect my honor, O Lord, my King. ||2||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਆਰਤੀ ਮਜਨੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naam tero aaratee majan muraare ||
english: Your Name, Lord, is my adoration and cleansing bath.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਗਲ ਪਾਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam bin jhoothe sagal paasaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, all ostentatious displays are useless. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਆਸਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਉਰਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਸਰੋ ਲੇ ਛਿਟਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naam tero aasano naam tero urasaa naam teraa kesaro le chhitakaare ||
english: Your Name is my prayer mat, and Your Name is the stone to grind the sandalwood. Your Name is the saffron which I take and sprinkle in offering to You.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਭੁਲਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਚੰਦਨੋ ਘਸਿ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਕਉ ਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam teraa a(n)bhulaa naam tero cha(n)dano ghas jape naam le tujhahi kau chaare ||1||
english: Your Name is the water, and Your Name is the sandalwood. The chanting of Your Name is the grinding of the sandalwood. I take it and offer all this to You. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਬਾਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਤੇਲੁ ਲੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naam teraa deevaa naam tero baatee naam tero tel le maahi pasaare ||
english: Your Name is the lamp, and Your Name is the wick. Your Name is the oil I pour into it.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਭਇਓ ਉਜਿਆਰੋ ਭਵਨ ਸਗਲਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam tere kee jot lagaaee bhaio ujiaaro bhavan sagalaare ||2||
english: Your Name is the light applied to this lamp, which enlightens and illuminates the entire world. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਤਾਗਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਫੂਲ ਮਾਲਾ ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਸਗਲ ਜੂਠਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naam tero taagaa naam phool maalaa bhaar athaarah sagal joothaare ||
english: Your Name is the thread, and Your Name is the garland of flowers. The eighteen loads of vegetation are all too impure to offer to You.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਅਰਪਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਚਵਰ ਢੋਲਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tero keeaa tujhahi kiaa arapau naam teraa tuhee chavar dholaare ||3||
english: Why should I offer to You, that which You Yourself created? Your Name is the fan, which I wave over You. ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਠਾ ਅਠਸਠੇ ਚਾਰੇ ਖਾਣੀ ਇਹੈ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: das athaa athasathe chaare khaanee ihai varatan hai sagal sa(n)saare ||
english: The whole world is engrossed in the eighteen Puraanas, the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and the four sources of creation.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਆਰਤੀ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਭੋਗ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: kahai ravidaas naam tero aaratee sat naam hai har bhog tuhaare ||4||3||
english: Says Ravi Daas, Your Name is my Aartee, my lamp-lit worship-service. The True Name, Sat Naam, is the food which I offer to You. ||4||3||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ॥
transliteration: dhanaasaree baanee bhagataa(n) kee trilochan ||
english: Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Trilochan Jee:

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਿੰਦਸਿ ਕਾਇ ਭੂਲੀ ਗਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: naaraain ni(n)das kaai bhoolee gavaaree ||
english: Why do you slander the Lord? You are ignorant and deluded.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਥਾਰੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dukrit sukrit thaaro karam ree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Pain and pleasure are the result of your own actions. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਕਰਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਬਸਤਾ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)karaa masatak basataa surasaree isanaan re ||
english: The moon dwells in Shiva's forehead; it takes its cleansing bath in the Ganges.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਲ ਜਨ ਮਧੇ ਮਿਲੵਿੋ ਸਾਰਗ ਪਾਨ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kul jan madhe milyio saarag paan re ||
english: Among the men of the moon's family, Krishna was born;

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਲੰਕੁ ਮਫੀਟਸਿ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karam kar kala(n)k mapheetas ree ||1||
english: even so, the stains from its past actions remain on the moon's face. ||1||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਕਾ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਤਾ ਚੇ ਰੇ ਸੁਆਰਥੀ ਪੰਖੀ ਰਾਇ ਗਰੁੜ ਤਾ ਚੇ ਬਾਧਵਾ ॥
transliteration: bisv kaa deepak svaamee taa che re suaarathee pa(n)khee raai garuR taa che baadhavaa ||
english: Aruna was a charioteer; his master was the sun, the lamp of the world. His brother was Garuda, the king of birds;

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਅਰੁਣ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karam kar arun pi(n)gulaa ree ||2||
english: and yet, Aruna was made a cripple, because of the karma of his past actions. ||2||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਹਰਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਨਾਥੁ ਰੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਾ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: anik paatik harataa tribhavan naath ree teerath teerath bhramataa lahai na paar ree ||
english: Shiva, the destroyer of countless sins, the Lord and Master of the three worlds, wandered from sacred shrine to sacred shrine; he never found an end to them.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਪਾਲੁ ਮਫੀਟਸਿ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karam kar kapaal mapheetas ree ||3||
english: And yet, he could not erase the karma of cutting off Brahma's head. ||3||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਸੀਅ ਧੇਨ ਲਛਿਮੀ ਕਲਪਤਰ ਸਿਖਰਿ ਸੁਨਾਗਰ ਨਦੀ ਚੇ ਨਾਥੰ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit sasee dhen lachhimee kalapatar sikhar sunaagar nadee che naatha(n) ||
english: Through the nectar, the moon, the wish-fulfilling cow, Lakshmi, the miraculous tree of life, Sikhar the sun's horse, and Dhanavantar the wise physician - all arose from the ocean, the lord of rivers;

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਰੁ ਮਫੀਟਸਿ ਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: karam kar khaar mapheetas ree ||4||
english: and yet, because of its karma, its saltiness has not left it. ||4||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਧੀਲੇ ਲੰਕਾ ਗੜੁ ਉਪਾੜੀਲੇ ਰਾਵਣ ਬਣੁ ਸਲਿ ਬਿਸਲਿ ਆਣਿ ਤੋਖੀਲੇ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: daadheele la(n)kaa gaR upaaReele raavan ban sal bisal aan tokheele haree ||
english: Hanuman burnt the fortress of Sri Lanka, uprooted the garden of Raawan, and brought healing herbs for the wounds of Lachhman, pleasing Lord Raamaa;

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਛਉਟੀ ਮਫੀਟਸਿ ਰੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: karam kar kachhautee mapheetas ree ||5||
english: and yet, because of his karma, he could not be rid of his loin cloth. ||5||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਲੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਰੀ ਘਰ ਗੇਹਣਿ ਤਾ ਚੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਾਪੀਅਲੇ ਰਾਮ ਚੇ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
transliteration: poorabalo krit karam na mitai ree ghar gehan taa che mohi jaapeeale raam che naama(n) ||
english: The karma of past actions cannot be erased, O wife of my house; this is why I chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਬਦਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਰਾਮ ਜੀ ॥੬॥੧॥
transliteration: badat trilochan raam jee ||6||1||
english: So prays Trilochan, Dear Lord. ||6||1||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸੈਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sree sain ||
english: Sri Sain:

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਾਜਿ ਆਰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: dhoop deep ghrit saaj aaratee ||
english: With incense, lamps and ghee, I offer this lamp-lit worship service.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰਨੇ ਜਾਉ ਕਮਲਾ ਪਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vaarane jaau kamalaa patee ||1||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Lord of Lakshmi. ||1||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)galaa har ma(n)galaa ||
english: Hail to You, Lord, hail to You!

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nit ma(n)gal raajaa raam raai ko ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Again and again, hail to You, Lord King, Ruler of all! ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮੁ ਦੀਅਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: ootam deearaa niramal baatee ||
english: Sublime is the lamp, and pure is the wick.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਹਂੀ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਕਮਲਾ ਪਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tuha(n)ee nira(n)jan kamalaa paatee ||2||
english: You are immaculate and pure, O Brilliant Lord of Wealth! ||2||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: raamaa bhagat raamaana(n)d jaanai ||
english: Raamaanand knows the devotional worship of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pooran paramaana(n)d bakhaanai ||3||
english: He says that the Lord is all-pervading, the embodiment of supreme joy. ||3||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਮਦਨ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਭੈ ਤਾਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: madan moorat bhai taar gobi(n)de ||
english: The Lord of the world, of wondrous form, has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਸੈਨੁ ਭਣੈ ਭਜੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: sain bhanai bhaj paramaana(n)de ||4||2||
english: Says Sain, remember the Lord, the embodiment of supreme joy! ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਪਾ ॥
transliteration: peepaa ||
english: Peepaa:

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਯਉ ਦੇਵਾ ਕਾਇਅਉ ਦੇਵਲ ਕਾਇਅਉ ਜੰਗਮ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: kaayau devaa kaaiau deval kaaiau ja(n)gam jaatee ||
english: Within the body, the Divine Lord is embodied. The body is the temple, the place of pilgrimage, and the pilgrim.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਅਉ ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਨਈਬੇਦਾ ਕਾਇਅਉ ਪੂਜਉ ਪਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaaiau dhoop deep naeebedaa kaaiau poojau paatee ||1||
english: Within the body are incense, lamps and offerings. Within the body are the flower offerings. ||1||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਬਹੁ ਖੰਡ ਖੋਜਤੇ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa bahu kha(n)d khojate nav nidh paaee ||
english: I searched throughout many realms, but I found the nine treasures within the body.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਆਇਬੋ ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਇਬੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਦੁਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naa kachh aaibo naa kachh jaaibo raam kee duhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Nothing comes, and nothing goes; I pray to the Lord for Mercy. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੇ ਸੋਈ ਪਿੰਡੇ ਜੋ ਖੋਜੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo brahama(n)de soee pi(n)de jo khojai so paavai ||
english: The One who pervades the Universe also dwells in the body; whoever seeks Him, finds Him there.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: peepaa pranavai param tat hai satigur hoi lakhaavai ||2||3||
english: Peepaa prays, the Lord is the supreme essence; He reveals Himself through the True Guru. ||2||3||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)naa ||
english: Dhannaa:

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gopaal teraa aarataa ||
english: O Lord of the world, this is Your lamp-lit worship service.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo jan tumaree bhagat kara(n)te tin ke kaaj savaarataa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are the Arranger of the affairs of those humble beings who perform Your devotional worship service. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਲਿ ਸੀਧਾ ਮਾਗਉ ਘੀਉ ॥
transliteration: daal seedhaa maagau gheeu ||
english: Lentils, flour and ghee - these things, I beg of You.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: hamaraa khusee karai nit jeeu ||
english: My mind shall ever be pleased.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਪਨੑੀਆ ਛਾਦਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ॥
transliteration: panheeaa chhaadan neekaa ||
english: Shoes, fine clothes,

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਜੁ ਮਗਉ ਸਤ ਸੀ ਕਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anaaj magau sat see kaa ||1||
english: And grain of seven kinds - I beg of You. ||1||

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਗਊ ਭੈਸ ਮਗਉ ਲਾਵੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gaoo bhais magau laaveree ||
english: A milk cow, and a water buffalo, I beg of You,

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਤਾਜਨਿ ਤੁਰੀ ਚੰਗੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ik taajan turee cha(n)geree ||
english: and a fine Turkestani horse.

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਗੀਹਨਿ ਚੰਗੀ ॥
transliteration: ghar kee geehan cha(n)gee ||
english: A good wife to care for my home

author: Bhagat Trilochan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ ਲੇਵੈ ਮੰਗੀ ॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: jan dha(n)naa levai ma(n)gee ||2||4||
english: - Your humble servant Dhanna begs for these things, Lord. ||2||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 ghar 1 chaupade ||
english: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥਾ ॥
transliteration: merai heearai ratan naam har basiaa gur haath dhario merai maathaa ||
english: The Jewel of the Lord's Name abides within my heart; the Guru has placed His hand on my forehead.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਉਤਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਰਿਨੁ ਲਾਥਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh dukh utare gur naam deeo rin laathaa ||1||
english: The sins and pains of countless incarnations have been cast out. The Guru has blessed me with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and my debt has been paid off. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭਿ ਅਰਥਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man bhaj raam naam sabh arathaa ||
english: O my mind, vibrate the Lord's Name, and all your affairs shall be resolved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai har naam driRaaiaa bin naavai jeevan birathaa || rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me; without the Name, life is useless. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੂੜ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਫਾਥਾ ॥
transliteration: bin gur mooR bhae hai manamukh te moh maaiaa nit phaathaa ||
english: Without the Guru, the self-willed manmukhs are foolish and ignorant; they are forever entangled in emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਤਿਨ ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਥਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin saadhoo charan na seve kabahoo tin sabh janam akaathaa ||2||
english: They never serve the feet of the Holy; their lives are totally useless. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਨਾਥਾ ॥
transliteration: jin saadhoo charan saadh pag seve tin saphalio janam sanaathaa ||
english: Those who serve at the feet of the Holy, the feet of the Holy, their lives are made fruitful, and they belong to the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mo kau keejai daas daas daasan ko har daiaa dhaar jaga(n)naathaa ||3||
english: Make me the slave of the slave of the slaves of the Lord; bless me with Your Mercy, O Lord of the Universe. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਗਿਆਨਹੀਨ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਿਉ ਚਾਲਹ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਾ ॥
transliteration: ham a(n)dhule giaanaheen agiaanee kiu chaalah maarag pa(n)thaa ||
english: I am blind, ignorant and totally without wisdom; how can I walk on the Path?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਚਲੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਲਹ ਮਿਲੰਥਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: ham a(n)dhule kau gur a(n)chal deejai jan naanak chalah mila(n)thaa ||4||1||
english: I am blind - O Guru, please let me grasp the hem of Your robe, so that servant Nanak may walk in harmony with You. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੀਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਾਹਕ ਮੀਕਾ ਕਾਖਾ ॥
transliteration: heeraa laal amolak hai bhaaree bin gaahak meekaa kaakhaa ||
english: A jewel or a diamond may be very valuable and heavy, but without a purchaser, it is worth only straw.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਤਬ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਿਕਾਨੋ ਲਾਖਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ratan gaahak gur saadhoo dekhio tab ratan bikaano laakhaa ||1||
english: When the Holy Guru, the Purchaser, saw this jewel, He purchased it for hundreds of thousands of dollars. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਪਤ ਹੀਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਾ ॥
transliteration: merai man gupat heer har raakhaa ||
english: The Lord has kept this jewel hidden within my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹੀਰੁ ਪਰਾਖਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal milaaio gur saadhoo gur miliai heer paraakhaa || rahaau ||
english: The Lord, merciful to the meek, led me to meet the Holy Guru; meeting the Guru, I came to appreciate this jewel. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕੋਠੀ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਘਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਖਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kothee agiaan a(n)dheraa tin ghar ratan na laakhaa ||
english: The rooms of the self-willed manmukhs are dark with ignorance; in their homes, the jewel is not visible.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਊਝੜਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਮੁਏ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਭੁਅੰਗ ਬਿਖੁ ਚਾਖਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: te oojhaR bharam mue gaavaaree maaiaa bhua(n)g bikh chaakhaa ||2||
english: Those fools die, wandering in the wilderness, eating the poison of the snake, Maya. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਹਮ ਰਾਖਾ ॥
transliteration: har har saadh melahu jan neeke har saadhoo saran ham raakhaa ||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, let me meet the humble, holy beings; O Lord, keep me in the Sanctuary of the Holy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਪਰੇ ਭਾਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਖਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har a(n)geekaar karahu prabh suaamee ham pare bhaag tum paakhaa ||3||
english: O Lord, make me Your own; O God, Lord and Master, I have hurried to Your side. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਹ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖਾ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa kiaa gun aakh vakhaanah tum vad agam vad purakhaa ||
english: What Glorious Virtues of Yours can I speak and describe? You are great and unfathomable, the Greatest Being.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਪਾਖਾਣੁ ਡੁਬਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kirapaa dhaaree paakhaan dubat har raakhaa ||4||2||
english: The Lord has bestowed His Mercy on servant Nanak; He has saved the sinking stone. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mah 4 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਛੂਅ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ham baarik kachhoo na jaanah gat mit tere moorakh mugadh iaanaa ||
english: I am Your child; I know nothing about Your state and extent; I am foolish, idiotic and ignorant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਸਿਆਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kirapaa dhaar deejai mat ootam kar leejai mugadh siaanaa ||1||
english: O Lord, shower me with Your Mercy; bless me with an enlightened intellect; I am foolish - make me clever. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਲਸੀਆ ਉਘਲਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa man aalaseeaa ughalaanaa ||
english: My mind is lazy and sleepy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har aan milaaio gur saadhoo mil saadhoo kapat khulaanaa || rahaau ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, has led me to meet the Holy Guru; meeting the Holy, the shutters have been opened wide. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: gur khin khin preet lagaavahu merai heearai mere preetam naam paraanaa ||
english: O Guru, each and every instant, fill my heart with love; the Name of my Beloved is my breath of life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜਿਉ ਅਮਲੀ ਅਮਲਿ ਲੁਭਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin naavai mar jaaeeai mere thaakur jiu amalee amal lubhaanaa ||2||
english: Without the Name, I would die; the Name of my Lord and Master is to me like the drug to the addict. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jin man preet lagee har keree tin dhur bhaag puraanaa ||
english: Those who enshrine love for the Lord within their minds fulfill their pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹਮ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਹ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tin ham charan sarevah khin khin jin har meeth lagaanaa ||3||
english: I worship their feet, each and every instant; the Lord seems very sweet to them. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਛੁਰਿਆ ਚਿਰੀ ਮਿਲਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har har kripaa dhaaree merai thaakur jan bichhuriaa chiree milaanaa ||
english: My Lord and Master, Har, Har, has showered His Mercy upon His humble servant; separated for so long, he is now re-united with the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: dhan dhan satigur jin naam driRaaiaa jan naanak tis kurabaanaa ||4||3||
english: Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, who has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord within me; servant Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਡ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਫਲ ਲਾਗਿਬਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur saajan purakh vad paaiaa har rasak rasak phal laagibaa ||
english: I have found the True Guru, my Friend, the Greatest Being. Love and affection for the Lord has blossomed forth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਭੁਇਅੰਗ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਢਿਬਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maaiaa bhuia(n)g grasio hai praanee gur bachanee bis har kaadhibaa ||1||
english: Maya, the snake, has seized the mortal; through the Word of the Guru, the Lord neutralizes the venom. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗਿਬਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa man raam naam ras laagibaa ||
english: My mind is attached to the sublime essence of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਬਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har keee patit pavitr mil saadh gur har naamai har ras chaakhibaa || rahaau ||
english: The Lord has purified the sinners, uniting them with the Holy Guru; now, they taste the Lord's Name, and the sublime essence of the Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਲਿਵ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਿਬਾ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan vadabhaag milio gur saadhoo mil saadhoo liv unaman laagibaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those who meet the Holy Guru; meeting with the Holy, they lovingly center themselves in the state of absolute absorption.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਬਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: trisanaa agan bujhee saa(n)t paaee har niramal niramal gun gaaibaa ||2||
english: The fire of desire within them is quenched, and they find peace; they sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਭਾਗ ਖੀਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਬਾ ॥
transliteration: tin ke bhaag kheen dhur paae jin satigur daras na paaibaa ||
english: Those who do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, have misfortune pre-ordained for them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਵਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਇਬਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: te doojai bhaai pavahi grabh jonee sabh birathaa janam tin jaaibaa ||3||
english: In the love of duality, they are consigned to reincarnation through the womb, and they pass their lives totally uselessly. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਬਿਮਲ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਸੇਵਹ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਇਬਾ ॥
transliteration: har dehu bimal mat gur saadh pag sevah ham har meeth lagaaibaa ||
english: O Lord, please, bless me with pure understanding, that I may serve the Feet of the Holy Guru; the Lord seems sweet to me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰੇਣ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਮਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਬਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak ren saadh pag maagai har hoi daiaal divaaibaa ||4||4||
english: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy; O Lord, be Merciful, and bless me with it. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬਸਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਮਾਤ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਂਝਾ ॥
transliteration: jin har hiradai naam na basio tin maat keejai har baa(n)jhaa ||
english: The Lord's Name does not abide within their hearts - their mothers should have been sterile.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਦੇਹ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਓਇ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਕਰਾਂਝਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin su(n)njee deh phirahi bin naavai oi khap khap mue karaa(n)jhaa ||1||
english: These bodies wander around, forlorn and abandoned, without the Name; their lives waste away, and they die, crying out in pain. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਝਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man jap raam naam har maajhaa ||
english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord within you.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har kripaal kripaa prabh dhaaree gur giaan deeo man samajhaa || rahaau ||
english: The Merciful Lord God, Har, Har, has showered me with His Mercy; the Guru has imparted spiritual wisdom to me, and my mind has been instructed. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਪਦੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਝਾ ॥
transliteration: har keerat kalajug pad ootam har paaeeai satigur maajhaa ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise brings the most noble and exalted status; the Lord is found through the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਝਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur apune jin gupat naam paragaajhaa ||2||
english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has revealed the Lord's hidden Name to me. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗਏ ਗਵਾਝਾ ॥
transliteration: darasan saadh milio vadabhaagee sabh kilabikh gae gavaajhaa ||
english: By great good fortune, I obtained the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy; it removes all stains of sin.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur saahu paaiaa vad daanaa har keee bahu gun saajhaa ||3||
english: I have found the True Guru, the great, all-knowing King; He has shared with me the many Glorious Virtues of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਾਝਾ ॥
transliteration: jin kau kripaa karee jagajeevan har ur dhaario man maajhaa ||
english: Those, unto whom the Lord, the Life of the world, has shown Mercy, enshrine Him within their hearts, and cherish Him in their minds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਦਰਿ ਕਾਗਦ ਫਾਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਮਝਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: dharam raai dar kaagad phaare jan naanak lekhaa samajhaa ||4||5||
english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma, in the Court of the Lord, has torn up my papers; servant Nanak's account has been settled. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਾਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਚਲਤੌ ਭਇਓ ਅਰੂੜਾ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat saadh paaee vadabhaagee man chalatau bhaio arooRaa ||
english: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I found the Holy, by great good fortune; my restless mind has been quieted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਤ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ਰਸਿ ਲੀੜਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anahat dhun vaajahi nit vaaje har a(n)mrit dhaar ras leeRaa ||1||
english: The unstruck melody ever vibrates and resounds; I have taken in the sublime essence of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, showering down. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੂੜਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man jap raam naam har rooRaa ||
english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the beauteous Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਲਾਇ ਝਪੀੜਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: merai man tan preet lagaaee satigur har milio laai jhapeeRaa || rahaau ||
english: The True Guru has drenched my mind and body with the Love of the Lord, who has met me and lovingly embraced me. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਬੰਧ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਲਾਇ ਜਕੀੜਾ ॥
transliteration: saakat ba(n)dh bhae hai maaiaa bikh sa(n)chahi laai jakeeRaa ||
english: The faithless cynics are bound and gagged in the chains of Maya; they are actively engaged, gathering in the poisonous wealth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਅਰਥਿ ਖਰਚਿ ਨਹ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਪੀੜਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har kai arath kharach nah saakahi jamakaal sahahi sir peeRaa ||2||
english: They cannot spend this in harmony with the Lord, and so they must endure the pain which the Messenger of Death inflicts upon their heads. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਅਰਥਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਲਗਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਬਹੁ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਇ ਮੁਖਿ ਧੂੜਾ ॥
transliteration: jin har arath sareer lagaaiaa gur saadhoo bahu saradhaa laai mukh dhooRaa ||
english: The Holy Guru has dedicated His Being to the Lord's service; with great devotion, apply the dust of His feet to your face.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਮਨਿ ਗੂੜਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: halat palat har sobhaa paavahi har ra(n)g lagaa man gooRaa ||3||
english: In this world and the next, you shall receive the Lord's honor, and your mind shall be imbued with the permanent color of the Lord's Love. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਮ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ॥
transliteration: har har mel mel jan saadhoo ham saadh janaa kaa keeRaa ||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, please unite me with the Holy; compared to these Holy people, I am just a worm.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਪਗ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਖਾਣੁ ਹਰਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਮੂੜਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak preet lagee pag saadh gur mil saadhoo paakhaan hario man mooRaa ||4||6||
english: Servant Nanak has enshrined love for the feet of the Holy Guru; meeting with this Holy One, my foolish, stone-like mind has blossomed forth in lush profusion. ||4||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har har simarahu agam apaaraa ||
english: Remember in meditation the Lord, Har, Har, the unfathomable, infinite Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat dukh mitai hamaaraa ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, pains are dispelled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har satigur purakh milaavahu gur miliai sukh hoee raam ||1||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, lead me to meet the True Guru; meeting the Guru, I am at peace. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavahu meet hamaare ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O my friend.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam rakhahu ur dhaare ||
english: Cherish the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in your heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har har a(n)mrit bachan sunaavahu gur miliai paragat hoee raam ||2||
english: Read the Ambrosial Words of the Lord, Har, Har; meeting with the Guru, the Lord is revealed. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਧੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: madhusoodan har maadho praanaa ||
english: The Lord, the Slayer of demons, is my breath of life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: merai man tan a(n)mrit meeth lagaanaa ||
english: His Ambrosial Amrit is so sweet to my mind and body.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har daiaa karahu gur melahu purakh nira(n)jan soee raam ||3||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, have mercy upon me, and lead me to meet the Guru, the immaculate Primal Being. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam sadaa sukhadaataa ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is forever the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har kai ra(n)g meraa man raataa ||
english: My mind is imbued with the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥
transliteration: har har mahaa purakh gur melahu gur naanak naam sukh hoee raam ||4||1||7||
english: O Lord Har, Har, lead me to meet the Guru, the Greatest Being; through the Name of Guru Nanak, I have found peace. ||4||1||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mah 4 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: har har har har naam japaahaa ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam sadaa lai laahaa ||
english: As Gurmukh, ever earn the profit of the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har har har bhagat driRaavahu har har naam oumaahaa raam ||1||
english: Implant within yourself devotion to the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har; sincerely dedicate yourself to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਧਿਆਹਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam daiaal dhiaahaa ||
english: Meditate on the Name of the Merciful Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: har kai ra(n)g sadaa gun gaahaa ||
english: WIth love, forever sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਘੂਮਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har har har jas ghoomar paavahu mil satasa(n)g oumaahaa raam ||2||
english: Dance to the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; meet with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, with sincerity. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aau sakhee har mel milaahaa ||
english: Come, O companions - let us unite in the Lord's Union.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: sun har kathaa naam lai laahaa ||
english: Listening to the sermon of the Lord, earn the profit of the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har kripaa dhaar gur melahu gur miliai har oumaahaa raam ||3||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, be merciful to me, and lead me to meet the Guru; meeting the Guru, a sincere yearning for the Lord wells up in me. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਸੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: kar keerat jas agam athaahaa ||
english: Praise Him, the unfathomable and inaccessible Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਾਵਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: khin khin raam naam gaavaahaa ||
english: Each and every moment, sing the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥੮॥
transliteration: mo kau dhaar kripaa mileeai gur daate har naanak bhagat oumaahaa raam ||4||2||8||
english: Be merciful, and meet me, O Guru, Great Giver; Nanak yearns for the Lord's devotional worship. ||4||2||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mah 4 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਸਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: ras ras raam rasaal salaahaa ||
english: With love and energetic affection, praise the Lord, the storehouse of Nectar.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਭੀਨਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: man raam naam bheenaa lai laahaa ||
english: My mind is drenched with the Lord's Name, and so it earns this profit.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khin khin bhagat karah din raatee guramat bhagat oumaahaa raam ||1||
english: Each and every moment, worship Him in devotion, day and night; through the Guru's Teachings, sincere love and devotion well up. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: har har gun govi(n)d japaahaa ||
english: Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan jeet sabad lai laahaa ||
english: Conquering mind and body, I have earned the profit of the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਵਸਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramat pa(n)ch doot vas aavahi man tan har omaahaa raam ||2||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the five demons are over-powered, and the mind and body are filled with a sincere yearning for the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: naam ratan har naam japaahaa ||
english: The Name is a jewel - chant the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaai sadaa lai laahaa ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and forever earn this profit.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਧੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: deen daiaal kripaa kar maadho har har naam oumaahaa raam ||3||
english: O Lord, merciful to the meek, be kind to me, and bless me with sincere longing for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਜਪਉ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jap jagadees japau man maahaa ||
english: Meditate on the Lord of the world - meditate within your mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਜਗਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: har har jaga(n)naath jag laahaa ||
english: The Lord of the Universe, Har, Har, is the only real profit in this world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੩॥੯॥
transliteration: dhan dhan vade thaakur prabh mere jap naanak bhagat omaahaa raam ||4||3||9||
english: Blessed, blessed, is my Great Lord and Master God; O Nanak, meditate on Him, worship Him with sincere love and devotion. ||4||3||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aape jogee jugat jugaahaa ||
english: He Himself is the Yogi, and the way throughout the ages.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aape nirabhau taaRee laahaa ||
english: The Fearless Lord Himself is absorbed in Samaadhi.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape hee aap aap varatai aape naam oumaahaa raam ||1||
english: He Himself, all by Himself, is all-pervading; He Himself blesses us with sincere love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਦੀਪਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aape deep lo deepaahaa ||
english: He Himself is the lamp, and the Light pervading all the worlds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਮਥਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aape satigur samu(n)d mathaahaa ||
english: He Himself is the True Guru; He Himself churns the ocean.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਥਿ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢਾਏ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape math math tat kadhaae jap naam ratan oumaahaa raam ||2||
english: He Himself churns it, churning up the essence; meditating on the jewel of the Naam, sincere love comes to the surface. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: sakhee milahu mil gun gaavaahaa ||
english: O my companions, let us meet and join together, and sing His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam japahu har laahaa ||
english: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, and earn the profit of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har bhagat driRee man bhaaee har har naam oumaahaa raam ||3||
english: Devotional worship of the Lord, Har, Har, has been implanted within me; it is pleasing to my mind. The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, brings a sincere love. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ਵਡ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aape vad daanaa vad saahaa ||
english: He Himself is supremely wise, the greatest King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh poo(n)jee naam visaahaa ||
english: As Gurmukh, purchase the merchandise of the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: har har daat karahu prabh bhaavai gun naanak naam oumaahaa raam ||4||4||10||
english: O Lord God, Har, Har, bless me with such a gift, that Your Glorious Virtues seem pleasing to me; Nanak is filled with sincere love and yearning for the Lord. ||4||4||10||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat sa(n)g guraahaa ||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and associating with the Guru,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਸਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: poo(n)jee naam guramukh vesaahaa ||
english: the Gurmukh gathers in the merchandise of the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har kripaa dhaar madhusoodan mil satasa(n)g oumaahaa raam ||1||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, Destroyer of demons, have mercy upon me; bless me with a sincere yearning to join the Sat Sangat. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਿ ਸੁਣਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: har gun baanee sravan sunaahaa ||
english: Let me hear with my ears the Banis, the Hymns, in praise of the Lord;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa satiguroo milaahaa ||
english: be merciful, and let me meet the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਪਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gun gaavah gun bolah baanee har gun jap oumaahaa raam ||2||
english: I sing His Glorious Praises, I speak the Bani of His Word; chanting His Glorious Praises, a sincere yearning for the Lord wells up. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਜਗ ਪੁੰਨ ਤੋੁਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh teerath varat jag pu(n)n toulaahaa ||
english: I have tried visiting all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, fasting, ceremonial feasts and giving to charities.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਹਿ ਪੁਜਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam na pujahi pujaahaa ||
english: They do not measure up to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਤੋਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har atul tol at bhaaree guramat jap oumaahaa raam ||3||
english: The Lord's Name is unweighable, utterly heavy in weight; through the Guru's Teachings, a sincere yearning to chant the Name has welled up in me. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh karam dharam har naam japaahaa ||
english: All good karma and righteous living are found in meditation on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਾਪ ਧੋਵਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: kilavikh mail paap dhovaahaa ||
english: It washes away the stains of sins and mistakes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਹੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੧॥
transliteration: deen daiaal hohu jan oopar dehu naanak naam omaahaa raam ||4||5||11||
english: Be merciful to meek, humble Nanak; bless him with sincere love and yearning for the Lord. ||4||5||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਈਹਾ ਜਗਿ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: koee jaanai kavan eehaa jag meet ||
english: Does anyone know, who is our friend in this world?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis hoi kripaal soee bidh boojhai taa kee niramal reet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He alone understands this, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy. Immaculate and unstained is his way of life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਇਸਟ ਮੀਤ ਅਰੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa banitaa sut ba(n)dhap isat meet ar bhaaee ||
english: Mother, father, spouse, children, relatives, lovers, friends and siblings meet,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਅੰਤਹਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poorab janam ke mile sa(n)jogee a(n)tahi ko na sahaaee ||1||
english: Having been associated in previous lives; but none of them will be your companion and support in the end. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮਾਲ ਕਨਿਕ ਲਾਲ ਹੀਰਾ ਮਨ ਰੰਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mukat maal kanik laal heeraa man ra(n)jan kee maaiaa ||
english: Pearl necklaces, gold, rubies and diamonds please the mind, but they are only Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ਅਵਧਹਿ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: haa haa karat bihaanee avadhahi taa mahi sa(n)tokh na paaiaa ||2||
english: Possessing them, one passes his life in agony; he obtains no contentment from them. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤਿ ਰਥ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਪਵਨ ਤੇਜ ਧਣੀ ਭੂਮਨ ਚਤੁਰਾਂਗਾ ॥
transliteration: hasat rath asv pavan tej dhanee bhooman chaturaa(n)gaa ||
english: Elephants, chariots, horses as fast as the wind, wealth, land, and armies of four kinds

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਿਓ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਛੂਐ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਓ ਨਾਂਗਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)g na chaalio in mahi kachhooai ooth sidhaaio naa(n)gaa ||3||
english: - none of these will go with him; he must get up and depart, naked. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t pri preetam prabh ke taa kai har har gaaeeai ||
english: The Lord's Saints are the beloved lovers of God; sing of the Lord, Har, Har, with them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak eehaa sukh aagai mukh oojal sa(n)g sa(n)tan kai paaeeai ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, in the Society of the Saints, you shall obtain peace in this world, and in the next world, your face shall be radiant and bright. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 3 dupade ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਸੰਦੇਸਰੋ ਕਹੀਅਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕਹੀਅਉ ॥
transliteration: dehu sa(n)desaro kaheeau pri kaheeau ||
english: Give me a message from my Beloved - tell me, tell me!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮੁ ਭਈ ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਸਹੀਅਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bisam bhaee mai bahu bidh sunate kahahu suhaagan saheeau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am wonder-struck, hearing the many reports of Him; tell them to me, O my happy sister soul-brides. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਕਹਤੋ ਸਭ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਕਹਤੋ ਸਭ ਮਹੀਅਉ ॥
transliteration: ko kahato sabh baahar baahar ko kahato sabh maheeau ||
english: Some say that He is beyond the world - totally beyond it, while others say that He is totally within it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਨੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਸਾਤਿ ਬੁਝਹੀਅਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baran na deesai chihan na lakheeai suhaagan saat bujhaheeau ||1||
english: His color cannot be seen, and His pattern cannot be discerned. O happy soul-brides, tell me the truth! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਸੀ ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਅਲਪਹੀਅਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab nivaasee ghat ghat vaasee lep nahee alapaheeau ||
english: He is pervading everywhere, and He dwells in each and every heart; He is not stained - He is unstained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਗਾ ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਕੋ ਬਸਹੀਅਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kahat sunahu re logaa sa(n)t rasan ko basaheeau ||2||1||2||
english: Says Nanak, listen, O people: He dwells upon the tongues of the Saints. ||2||1||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mah 5 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੀਰਉ ਸੁਨਿ ਧੀਰਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dheerau sun dheerau prabh kau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am calmed, calmed and soothed, hearing of God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਨੀਰਉ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਨੀਰਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jee praan man tan sabh arapau neerau pekh prabh kau neerau ||1||
english: I dedicate my soul, my breath of life, my mind, body and everything to Him: I behold God near, very near. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬਡ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਗਹੀਰਉ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੨॥
