transliteration: besumaar bea(n)t bad daataa manahi gaheerau pekh prabh kau ||2||
english: Beholding God, the inestimable, infinite and Great Giver, I cherish Him in my mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਉ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਉ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਉ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo chaahau soee soee paavau aasaa manasaa poorau jap prabh kau ||3||
english: Whatever I wish for, I receive; my hopes and desires are fulfilled, meditating on God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਦੂਖਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਝੂਰਉ ਬੁਝਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak man vasiaa dookh na kabahoo jhoorau bujh prabh kau ||4||2||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, God dwells in Nanak's mind; he never suffers or grieves, having realized God. ||4||2||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋੜੀਦੜਾ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: loReedaRaa saajan meraa ||
english: I seek my Friend the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨੀਕੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ghar ghar ma(n)gal gaavahu neeke ghat ghat tisahi baseraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In each and every home, sing the sublime songs of rejoicing; He abides in each and every heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖਿ ਅਰਾਧਨੁ ਦੂਖਿ ਅਰਾਧਨੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sookh araadhan dookh araadhan bisarai na kaahoo beraa ||
english: In good times, worship and adore Him; in bad times, worship and adore Him; do not ever forget Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਰ ਉਜਾਰਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam japat kot soor ujaaraa binasai bharam a(n)dheraa ||1||
english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the light of millions of suns shines forth, and the darkness of doubt is dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar sabhanee jaaee jo deesai so teraa ||
english: In all the spaces and interspaces, everywhere, whatever we see is Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੩॥੪॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g paavai jo naanak tis bahur na hoee hai pheraa ||2||3||4||
english: One who finds the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, is not consigned to reincarnation again. ||2||3||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 4 dupade ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੵਿ ॥
transliteration: ab mai sukh paaio gur aagy ||
english: Now, I have found peace, bowing before the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜੀ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਚਿੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਅਹੰ ਛੋਡਿਓ ਹੈ ਤਿਆਗੵਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tajee siaanap chi(n)t visaaree aha(n) chhodio hai tiaagy ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have abandoned cleverness, quieted my anxiety, and renounced my egotism. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਉ ਸਗਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹੀਅਉ ਤਉ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: jau dekhau tau sagal mohi moheeau tau saran pario gur bhaag ||
english: When I looked, I saw that everyone was enticed by emotional attachment; then, I hurried to the Guru's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਟਹਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਜਮਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਮੋਰੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa tahal har laaio tau jam chhodee moree laag ||1||
english: In His Grace, the Guru engaged me in the Lord's service, and then, the Messenger of Death gave up pursuing me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਰਿਓ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਵਕ ਕੋ ਜਉ ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: tario saagar paavak ko jau sa(n)t bhete vad bhaag ||
english: I swam across the ocean of fire, when I met the Saints, through great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਰੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੨॥੧॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak sarab sukh paae moro har charanee chit laag ||2||1||5||
english: O servant Nanak, I have found total peace; my consciousness is attached to the Lord's feet. ||2||1||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man mahi satigur dhiaan dharaa ||
english: Within my mind, I cherish and meditate on the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਿਓ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: driRhio giaan ma(n)tr har naamaa prabh jeeu maiaa karaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He has implanted within me spiritual wisdom and the Mantra of the Lord's Name; Dear God has shown mercy to me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਜਾਲ ਅਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ਛੁਟਕੇ ਜਮਹਿ ਡਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaal jaal ar mahaa ja(n)jaalaa chhutake jamahi daraa ||
english: Death's noose and its mighty entanglements have vanished, along with the fear of death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇਓ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤਿ ਗਹਿਓ ਚਰਣ ਆਸਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aaio dukh haran saran karunaapat gahio charan aasaraa ||1||
english: I have come to the Sanctuary of the Merciful Lord, the Destroyer of pain; I am holding tight to the Support of His feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵ ਰੂਪ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naav roop bhaio saadhasa(n)g bhav nidh paar paraa ||
english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, has assumed the form of a boat, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਓ ਗਤੁ ਥੀਓ ਭਰਮਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੬॥
transliteration: apiu peeo gat theeo bharamaa kahu naanak ajar jaraa ||2||2||6||
english: I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, and my doubts are shattered; says Nanak, I can bear the unbearable. ||2||2||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau bhae govi(n)d sahaaee ||
english: One who has the Lord of the Universe as his help and support

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਵਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d sagal siu vaa kau biaadh na kaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: is blessed with all peace, poise and bliss; no afflictions cling to him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਅਲੇਪਾ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਉਨ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: deesahi sabh sa(n)g rahahi alepaa nah viaapai un maaee ||
english: He appears to keep company with everyone, but he remains detached, and Maya does not cling to him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਤਤ ਕੇ ਬੇਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ekai ra(n)g tat ke bete satigur te budh paaee ||1||
english: He is absorbed in love of the One Lord; he understands the essence of reality, and he is blessed with wisdom by the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਈ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: daiaa maiaa kirapaa thaakur kee seee sa(n)t subhaaee ||
english: Those whom the Lord and Master blesses with His kindness, compassion and mercy are the sublime and sanctified Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੭॥
transliteration: tin kai sa(n)g naanak nisatareeai jin ras ras har gun gaaee ||2||3||7||
english: Associating with them, Nanak is saved; with love and exuberant joy, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||3||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d jeevan praan dhan roop ||
english: The Lord of the Universe is my existence, my breath of life, wealth and beauty.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਮਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੇ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: agiaan moh magan mahaa praanee a(n)dhiaare mahi deep ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The ignorant are totally intoxicated with emotional attachment; in this darkness, the Lord is the only lamp. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਨੂਪ ॥
transliteration: saphal darasan tumaraa prabh preetam charan kamal aanoop ||
english: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Beloved God; Your lotus feet are incomparably beautiful!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਕਰਉ ਤਿਹ ਬੰਦਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਚਰ੍ਹਾਵਉ ਧੂਪ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik baar karau tih ba(n)dan manahi charhaavau dhoop ||1||
english: So many times, I bow in reverence to Him, offering my mind as incense to Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਹੀ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਲੂਕ ॥
transliteration: haar pario tumhrai prabh duaarai driRh kar gahee tumhaaree look ||
english: Exhausted, I have fallen at Your Door, O God; I am holding tight to Your Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਪਾਵਕ ਕੇ ਕੂਪ ॥੨॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: kaadh lehu naanak apune kau sa(n)saar paavak ke koop ||2||4||8||
english: Please, lift Your humble servant Nanak up, out of the pit of fire of the world. ||2||4||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਦੇਵੈ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
transliteration: koee jan har siu devai jor ||
english: If only someone would unite me with the Lord!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਗਹਉ ਬਕਉ ਸੁਭ ਰਸਨਾ ਦੀਜਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਕੋਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: charan gahau bakau subh rasanaa deejahi praan akor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I hold tight to His feet, and utter sweet words with my tongue; I make my breath of life an offering to Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਤ ਕਿਆਰੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਿੰਚੈ ਸੁਧਾ ਸੰਜੋਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man tan niramal karat kiaaro har si(n)chai sudhaa sa(n)jor ||
english: I make my mind and body into pure little gardens, and irrigate them with the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਹੋਤ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਤੋਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: iaa ras mahi magan hot kirapaa te mahaa bikhiaa te tor ||1||
english: I am drenched with this sublime essence by His Grace, and the powerful hold of Maya's corruption has been broken. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਓਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aaio saran deen dukh bha(n)jan chitavau tumhree or ||
english: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Destroyer of the suffering of the innocent; I keep my consciousness focused on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੋਰਿ ॥੨॥੫॥੯॥
transliteration: abhai pad daan simaran suaamee ko prabh naanak ba(n)dhan chhor ||2||5||9||
english: Bless me with the gifts of the state of fearlessness, and meditative remembrance, Lord and Master; O Nanak, God is the Breaker of bonds. ||2||5||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਬਰਸਤ ਮੇਂਹ ॥
transliteration: chaatrik chitavat barasat me(n)h ||
english: The rainbird longs for the rain to fall.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੋ ਨੇਂਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kripaa si(n)dh karunaa prabh dhaarahu har prem bhagat ko ne(n)h ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O God, ocean of mercy, shower Your mercy on me, that I may yearn for loving devotional worship of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸੂਖ ਚਕਵੀ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਹਤ ਅਨਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੇਖਿ ਦੇਂਹ ॥
transliteration: anik sookh chakavee nahee chaahat anad pooran pekh de(n)h ||
english: The chakvi duck does not desire many comforts, but it is filled with bliss upon seeing the dawn.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਨ ਜੀਵਤ ਮੀਨਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਰਨਾ ਤੇਂਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aan upaav na jeevat meenaa bin jal maranaa te(n)h ||1||
english: The fish cannot survive any other way - without water, it dies. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇਂਹ ॥
transliteration: ham anaath naath har saranee apunee kripaa kare(n)h ||
english: I am a helpless orphan - I seek Your Sanctuary, O My Lord and Master; please bless me with Your mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਕੇਂਹ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੦॥
transliteration: charan kamal naanak aaraadhai tis bin aan na ke(n)h ||2||6||10||
english: Nanak worships and adores the Lord's lotus feet; without Him, there is no other at all. ||2||6||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: man tan bas rahe mere praan ||
english: The Lord, my very breath of life, abides in my mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa saadhoo sa(n)g bhete pooran purakh sujaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Bless me with Your mercy, and unite me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O perfect, all-knowing Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਅਉ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: prem thagauree jin kau paaee tin ras peeau bhaaree ||
english: Those, unto whom You give the intoxicating herb of Your Love, drink in the supreme sublime essence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਨ ਹਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa kee keemat kahan na jaaee kudarat kavan hamhaaree ||1||
english: I cannot describe their value; what power do I have? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਲੜਿ ਦਾਸ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਉਧਰਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: laai lae laR daas jan apune udhare udharanahaare ||
english: The Lord attaches His humble servants to the hem of His robe, and they swim across the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੧॥
transliteration: prabh simar simar simar sukh paaio naanak saran duaare ||2||7||11||
english: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, peace is obtained; Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Door. ||2||7||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਏ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aae anik janam bhram saranee ||
english: After wandering through so many incarnations, I have come to Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਧਰੁ ਦੇਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: udhar deh a(n)dh koop te laavahu apunee charanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Save me - lift my body up out of the deep, dark pit of the world, and attach me to Your feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan kichh karam na jaanaa naahin niramal karanee ||
english: I do not know anything about spiritual wisdom, meditation or karma, and my way of life is not clean and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਬਿਖਮ ਨਦੀ ਜਾਇ ਤਰਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kai a(n)chal laavahu bikham nadee jaai taranee ||1||
english: Please attach me to the hem of the robe of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; help me to cross over the terrible river. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਸ ਮੀਠੇ ਇਹ ਨਹੀ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਧਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sukh sa(n)pat maaiaa ras meethe ih nahee man mahi dharanee ||
english: Comforts, riches and the sweet pleasures of Maya - do not implant these within your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਪਾਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਆਭਰਣੀ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨॥
transliteration: har darasan tripat naanak daas paavat har naam ra(n)g aabharanee ||2||8||12||
english: Slave Nanak is satisfied and satiated by the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; his only ornamentation is the love of the Lord's Name. ||2||8||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har jan simarahu hiradai raam ||
english: O humble servants of the Lord, remember the Lord in meditation within your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਅਪਦਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jan kau apadaa nikat na aavai pooran daas ke kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Misfortune does not even approach the Lord's humble servant; the works of His slave are perfectly fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਧਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kot bighan binasahi har sevaa nihachal govid dhaam ||
english: Millions of obstacles are removed, by serving the Lord, and one enters into the eternal dwelling of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਆਦਰੁ ਦੇਵਤ ਜਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhagava(n)t bhagat kau bhau kichh naahee aadar devat jaam ||1||
english: The Lord's devotee is very fortunate; he has absolutely no fear. Even the Messenger of Death pays homage to him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਆਨ ਜੋ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਖਾਮ ॥
transliteration: taj gopaal aan jo karanee soee soee binasat khaam ||
english: Forsaking the Lord of the world, he does other deeds, but these are temporary and transitory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਬਿਸਰਾਮ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੩॥
transliteration: charan kamal hiradai gahu naanak sukh samooh bisaraam ||2||9||13||
english: Grasp the Lord's lotus feet, and hold them in your heart, O Nanak; you shall obtain absolute peace and bliss. ||2||9||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 9 ||
english: Jaitsree, Ninth Mehl: One Universal Creator God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: bhoolio man maaiaa urajhaaio ||
english: My mind is deluded, entangled in Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਓ ਲਾਲਚ ਲਗਿ ਤਿਹ ਤਿਹ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo jo karam keeo laalach lag tih tih aap ba(n)dhaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever I do, while engaged in greed, only serves to bind me down. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਮਝ ਨ ਪਰੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਰਚਿਓ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: samajh na paree bikhai ras rachio jas har ko bisaraaio ||
english: I have no understanding at all; I am engrossed in the pleasures of corruption, and I have forgotten the Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਬਨੁ ਖੋਜਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)g suaamee so jaanio naahin ban khojan kau dhaaio ||1||
english: The Lord and Master is with me, but I do not know Him. Instead, I run into the forest, looking for Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: ratan raam ghat hee ke bheetar taa ko giaan na paaio ||
english: The Jewel of the Lord is deep within my heart, but I do not have any knowledge of Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak bhagava(n)t bhajan bin birathaa janam gavaaio ||2||1||
english: O servant Nanak, without vibrating, meditating on the Lord God, human life is uselessly wasted and lost. ||2||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 9 ||
english: Jaitsree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har joo raakh lehu pat meree ||
english: O Dear Lord, please, save my honor!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਭਇਓ ਉਰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jam ko traas bhaio ur a(n)tar saran gahee kirapaa nidh teree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The fear of death has entered my heart; I cling to the Protection of Your Sanctuary, O Lord, ocean of mercy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਲੋਭੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਰਤ ਪਾਪ ਅਬ ਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mahaa patit mugadh lobhee phun karat paap ab haaraa ||
english: I am a great sinner, foolish and greedy; but now, at last, I have grown weary of committing sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਮਰਬੇ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਤਿਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhai marabe ko bisarat naahin tih chi(n)taa tan jaaraa ||1||
english: I cannot forget the fear of dying; this anxiety is consuming my body. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਏ ਉਪਾਵ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਕਉ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: keee upaav mukat ke kaaran dah dis kau uth dhaaiaa ||
english: I have been trying to liberate myself, running around in the ten directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghat hee bheetar basai nira(n)jan taa ko maram na paaiaa ||2||
english: The pure, immaculate Lord abides deep within my heart, but I do not understand the secret of His mystery. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਹਿਨ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਕਛੁ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਅਬ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: naahin gun naahin kachh jap tap kaun karam ab keejai ||
english: I have no merit, and I know nothing about meditation or austerities; what should I do now?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਿ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak haar pario saranaagat abhai daan prabh deejai ||3||2||
english: O Nanak, I am exhausted; I seek the shelter of Your Sanctuary; O God, please bless me with the gift of fearlessness. ||3||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 9 ||
english: Jaitsree, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਗਹੋ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man re saachaa gaho bichaaraa ||
english: O mind, embrace true contemplation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮਾਨੋ ਸਗਰੋ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam bin mithiaa maano sagaro ihu sa(n)saaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, know that this whole world is false. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜੋਗੀ ਖੋਜਤ ਹਾਰੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਹਿ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau jogee khojat haare paaio naahi tih paaraa ||
english: The Yogis are tired of searching for Him, but they have not found His limit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਪਛਾਨੋ ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so suaamee tum nikat pachhaano roop rekh te niaaraa ||1||
english: You must understand that the Lord and Master is near at hand, but He has no form or feature. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਾਹਿ ਸੰਭਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: paavan naam jagat mai har ko kabahoo naahi sa(n)bhaaraa ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord is purifying in the world, and yet you never remember it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਜਗ ਬੰਦਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak saran pario jag ba(n)dan raakhahu birad tuhaaraa ||2||3||
english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the One, before whom the whole world bows down; please, preserve and protect me, by Your innate nature. ||2||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ghar 1 ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: darasan piaasee dinas raat chitavau anadin neet ||
english: I am thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, day and night; I yearn for Him constantly, night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਲੑਿ ਕਪਟ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kholhi kapat gur meleeaa naanak har sa(n)g meet ||1||
english: Opening the door, O Nanak, the Guru has led me to meet with the Lord, my Friend. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਯਾਰ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸਜਣ ਇਕ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sun yaar hamaare sajan ik karau bena(n)teeaa ||
english: Listen, O my intimate friend - I have just one prayer to make.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਮੋਹਨ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਉ ਖੋਜੰਤੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tis mohan laal piaare hau phirau khoja(n)teeaa ||
english: I have been wandering around, searching for that enticing, sweet Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਦਸਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਧਰੀ ਉਤਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: tis das piaare sir dharee utaare ik bhoree darasan deejai ||
english: Whoever leads me to my Beloved - I would cut off my head and offer it to him, even if I were granted the Blessed Vision of His Darshan for just an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਾਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਭੀ ਨਾ ਧੀਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: nain hamaare pri ra(n)g ra(n)gaare ik til bhee naa dheereejai ||
english: My eyes are drenched with the Love of my Beloved; without Him, I do not have even a moment's peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨਾ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਜਿਵੈ ਤਿਸੰਤੀਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh siu man leenaa jiu jal meenaa chaatrik jivai tisa(n)teeaa ||
english: My mind is attached to the Lord, like the fish to the water, and the rainbird, thirsty for the raindrops.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝੰਤੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak gur pooraa paaiaa sagalee tikhaa bujha(n)teeaa ||1||
english: Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru; his thirst is totally quenched. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਹਭੇ ਸਖੀਆ ਮੂ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜੇਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: yaar ve pri habhe sakheeaa moo kahee na jeheeaa ||
english: O intimate friend, my Beloved has all these loving companions; I cannot compare to any of them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਹਿਕ ਡੂੰ ਹਿਕਿ ਚਾੜੈ ਹਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਚਿਤੇਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: yaar ve hik doo(n) hik chaaRai hau kis chiteheeaa ||
english: O intimate friend, each of them is more beautiful than the others; who could consider me?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਕ ਦੂੰ ਹਿਕਿ ਚਾੜੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਦੇ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: hik doo(n) hik chaaRe anik piaare nit karade bhog bilaasaa ||
english: Each of them is more beautiful than the others; countless are His lovers, constantly enjoying bliss with Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਉਠੰਦਾ ਹਉ ਕਦਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: tinaa dekh man chaau utha(n)daa hau kad paaee gunataasaa ||
english: Beholding them, desire wells up in my mind; when will I obtain the Lord, the treasure of virtue?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਮੈਡਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਰੀਝਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਨੁ ਡੇਂਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jinee maidaa laal reejhaaiaa hau tis aagai man de(n)heeaa ||
english: I dedicate my mind to those who please and attract my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਮੂ ਦਸਿ ਡਿਖਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਕੇਹੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kahai sun binau suhaagan moo das dikhaa pir keheeaa ||2||
english: Says Nanak, hear my prayer, O happy soul-brides; tell me, what does my Husband Lord look like? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨੀਸੀ ਛੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: yaar ve pir aapan bhaanaa kichh neesee chha(n)daa ||
english: O intimate friend, my Husband Lord does whatever He pleases; He is not dependent on anyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਤੈ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਮੂ ਦਸਿ ਦਸੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: yaar ve tai raaviaa laalan moo das dasa(n)daa ||
english: O intimate friend, you have enjoyed your Beloved; please, tell me about Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਨੁ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਜੈ ਧਨ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: laalan tai paaiaa aap gavaaiaa jai dhan bhaag mathaane ||
english: They alone find their Beloved, who eradicate self-conceit; such is the good destiny written on their foreheads.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਂਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਹਉ ਘਿਧੀ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: baa(n)h pakaR thaakur hau ghidhee gun avagan na pachhaane ||
english: Taking me by the arm, the Lord and Master has made me His own; He has not considered my merits or demerits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਹਾਰੁ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਭੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: gun haar tai paaiaa ra(n)g laal banaaiaa tis habho kichh suha(n)daa ||
english: She, whom You have adorned with the necklace of virtue, and dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love - everything looks beautiful on her.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਵਸੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak dha(n)n suhaagan saaee jis sa(n)g bhataar vasa(n)daa ||3||
english: O servant Nanak, blessed is that happy soul-bride, who dwells with her Husband Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਖੇਦੀ ਸਾ ਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: yaar ve nit sukh sukhedee saa mai paaee ||
english: O intimate friend, I have found that peace which I sought.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰੁ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
transliteration: var loReedaa aaiaa vajee vaadhaaee ||
english: My sought-after Husband Lord has come home, and now, congratulations are pouring in.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਥੀਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦ ਨਵ ਰੰਗੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa ma(n)gal rahas theeaa pir daiaal sad nav ra(n)geeaa ||
english: Great joy and happiness welled up, when my Husband Lord, of ever-fresh beauty, showed mercy to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸਤਸੰਗੀਆ ॥
transliteration: vad bhaag paaiaa gur milaaiaa saadh kai satasa(n)geeaa ||
english: By great good fortune, I have found Him; the Guru has united me with Him, through the Saadh Sangat, the True Congregation of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਪੂਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਅੰਕਿ ਅੰਕੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa sagal pooree pri a(n)k a(n)k milaaee ||
english: My hopes and desires have all been fulfilled; my Beloved Husband Lord has hugged me close in His embrace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਖੇਦੀ ਸਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sukh sukhedee saa mai gur mil paaee ||4||1||
english: Prays Nanak, I have found that peace which I sought, meeting with the Guru. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 2 chha(n)t ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਕਥੁ ॥
transliteration: oochaa agam apaar prabh kathan na jaai akath ||
english: God is lofty, unapproachable and infinite. He is indescribable - He cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee raakhan kau samarath ||1||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, who is all-powerful to save us. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jiu jaanahu tiu raakh har prabh teriaa ||
english: Save me, any way You can; O Lord God, I am Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਗਨਉ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੇਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kete ganau asa(n)kh avagan meriaa ||
english: My demerits are uncountable; how many of them should I count?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਅਵਗਣ ਖਤੇ ਫੇਰੇ ਨਿਤਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਸਦ ਭੂਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: asa(n)kh avagan khate phere nitaprat sad bhooleeai ||
english: The sins and crimes I committed are countless; day by day, I continually make mistakes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਘੂਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: moh magan bikaraal maaiaa tau prasaadee ghooleeai ||
english: I am intoxicated by emotional attachment to Maya, the treacherous one; by Your Grace alone can I be saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੂਕ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨੇਰ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: look karat bikaar bikhaRe prabh ner hoo te neriaa ||
english: Secretly, I commit hideous sins of corruption, even though God is the nearest of the near.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਭਵਜਲ ਫੇਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak daiaa dhaarahu kaadh bhavajal pheriaa ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord, and lift me up, out of the whirlpool of the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਅਸੰਖ ਗੁਣ ਊਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nirat na pavai asa(n)kh gun oochaa prabh kaa naau ||
english: Countless are His virtues; they cannot be enumerated. God's Name is lofty and exalted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)teeaa milai nithaave thaau ||2||
english: This is Nanak's humble prayer, to bless the homeless with a home. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ਕਾ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: doosar naahee thaau kaa pahi jaaeeai ||
english: There is no other place at all - where else should I go?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar kar joR so prabh dhiaaeeai ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, with my palms pressed together, I meditate on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: dhiaai so prabh sadaa apunaa manahi chi(n)diaa paaeeai ||
english: Meditating forever on my God, I receive the fruits of my mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: taj maan mohu vikaar doojaa ek siu liv laaeeai ||
english: Renouncing pride, attachment, corruption and duality, I lovingly center my attention on the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਰਪਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਗੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: arap man tan prabhoo aagai aap sagal mitaaeeai ||
english: Dedicate your mind and body to God; eradicate all your self-conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa saach naam samaaeeai ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your mercy, Lord, that I may be absorbed in Your True Name. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: re man taa kau dhiaaeeai sabh bidh jaa kai haath ||
english: O mind, meditate on the One, who holds everything in His hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam naam dhan sa(n)cheeai naanak nibahai saath ||3||
english: Gather the wealth of the Lord's Name; O Nanak, it shall always be with You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਥੀਅੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saatheeaRaa prabh ek doosar naahi koi ||
english: God is our only True Friend; there is not any other.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar aap jal thal poor soi ||
english: In the places and interspaces, in the water and on the land, He Himself is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal poor rahiaa sarab daataa prabh dhanee ||
english: He is totally permeating the water, the land and the sky; God is the Great Giver, the Lord and Master of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: gopaal gobi(n)d a(n)t naahee bea(n)t gun taa ke kiaa ganee ||
english: The Lord of the world, the Lord of the universe has no limit; His Glorious Virtues are unlimited - how can I count them?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਅਨ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaj saran suaamee sukhah gaamee tis binaa an naahi koi ||
english: I have hurried to the Sanctuary of the Lord Master, the Bringer of peace; without Him, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak daiaa dhaarahu tis paraapat naam hoi ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, that being, unto whom the Lord shows mercy - he alone obtains the Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਜਿ ਚਿਤਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: chit j chitaviaa so mai paaiaa ||
english: Whatever I wish for, that I receive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaai sukh sabaaiaa ||4||
english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Nanak has found total peace. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮਨੁ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥
transliteration: ab man chhoot gaiaa saadhoo sa(n)g mile ||
english: My mind is now emancipated; I have joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਲੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam laiaa jotee jot rale ||
english: As Gurmukh, I chant the Naam, and my light has merged into the Light.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਿਟੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਬੁਝੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har naam simarat mite kilabikh bujhee tapat aghaaniaa ||
english: Remembering the Lord's Name in meditation, my sins have been erased; the fire has been extinguished, and I am satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਦਇਆ ਕੀਨੇ ਆਪਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gahi bhujaa leene daiaa keene aapane kar maaniaa ||
english: He has taken me by the arm, and blessed me with His kind mercy; He has accepted me His own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣਾ ਦੁਖ ਜਲੇ ॥
transliteration: lai a(n)k laae har milaae janam maranaa dukh jale ||
english: The Lord has hugged me in His embrace, and merged me with Himself; the pains of birth and death have been burnt away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਇਕ ਪਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak daiaa dhaaree mel leene ik pale ||4||2||
english: Prays Nanak, He has blessed me with His kind mercy; in an instant, He unites me with Himself. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree chha(n)t mah 5 ||
english: Jaitsree, Chhant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਧਾਣੂ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਅਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paadhaanoo sa(n)saar gaarab atiaa ||
english: The world is like a temporary way-station, but it is filled with pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੇ ਪਾਪ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਰਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: karate paap anek maaiaa ra(n)g ratiaa ||
english: People commit countless sins; they are dyed in the color of the love of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ਬੂਡੇ ਮਰਣੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
transliteration: lobh mohi abhimaan boode maran cheet na aavae ||
english: In greed, emotional attachment and egotism, they are drowning; they do not even think of dying.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਏਹ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: putr mitr biuhaar banitaa eh karat bihaavae ||
english: Children, friends, worldly occupations and spouses - they talk of these things, while their lives are passing away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਜਿ ਦਿਵਸ ਆਏ ਲਿਖੇ ਮਾਏ ਦੁਖੁ ਧਰਮ ਦੂਤਹ ਡਿਠਿਆ ॥
transliteration: puj divas aae likhe maae dukh dharam dootah dithiaa ||
english: When their pre-ordained days have run their course, O mother, they behold the Messengers of the Righteous Judge of Dharma, and they suffer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਖਟਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kirat karam na mitai naanak har naam dhan nahee khatiaa ||1||
english: The karma of their past deeds cannot be erased, O Nanak, if they have not earned the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: udam karahi anek har naam na gaavahee ||
english: He makes all sorts of efforts, but he does not sing the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਹਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: bharamahi jon asa(n)kh mar janamahi aavahee ||
english: He wanders around in countless incarnations; he dies, only to be born again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਪੰਖੀ ਸੈਲ ਤਰਵਰ ਗਣਤ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
transliteration: pasoo pa(n)khee sail taravar ganat kachhoo na aavae ||
english: As beasts, birds, stones and trees - their number cannot be known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੀਜੁ ਬੋਵਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: beej bovas bhog bhogahi keeaa apanaa paavae ||
english: As are the seeds he plants, so are the pleasures he enjoys; he receives the consequences of his own actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਾਰੰਤ ਜੂਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ratan janam haara(n)t jooai prabhoo aap na bhaavahee ||
english: He loses the jewel of this human life in the gamble, and God is not pleased with him at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਏ ਖਿਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਟਿਕਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak bharamahi bhramaae khin ek tikan na paavahee ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, wandering in doubt, he does not find any rest, even for an instant. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਤੀਤਿ ਜਰੁ ਮਲਿ ਬੈਠੀਆ ॥
transliteration: joban gaiaa biteet jar mal baitheeaa ||
english: Youth has passed, and old age has taken its place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਕੰਪਹਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਡੋਲ ਨੈਣ ਨ ਡੀਠਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kar ka(n)pahi sir dol nain na deethiaa ||
english: The hands tremble, the head shakes, and the eyes do not see.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਨੈਣ ਦੀਸੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ ਈਸੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: nah nain deesai bin bhajan eesai chhod maaiaa chaaliaa ||
english: The eyes do not see, without vibrating and meditating on the Lord; he must leave behind the attractions of Maya, and depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਖਾਕੁ ਛਾਨਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kahiaa na maanahi sir khaak chhaanahi jin sa(n)g man tan jaaliaa ||
english: He burnt his mind and body for his relatives, but now, they do not listen to him, and they throw dust on his head.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਅਪਾਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਹ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਵੂਠਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sreeraam ra(n)g apaar pooran nah nimakh man mahi voothiaa ||
english: Love for the infinite, Perfect Lord does not abide in his mind, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਾਗਰ ਬਿਨਸ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਝੂਠਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak kot kaagar binas baar na jhoothiaa ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, the fort of paper is false - it is destroyed in an instant. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal saranaai naanak aaiaa ||
english: Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Lord's lotus feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤਰੁ ਭੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dutar bhai sa(n)saar prabh aap taraaiaa ||
english: God Himself has carried Him across the impassable, terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਭਜੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)ge bhaje sreedhar kar a(n)g prabh jee taariaa ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I vibrate and meditate on the Lord; God has made me His own, and saved me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੀਏ ਨਾਮ ਦੀਏ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har maan leee naam deee avar kachh na beechaariaa ||
english: The Lord has approved of me, and blessed me with His Name; He did not take anything else into consideration.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਪਾਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan apaar thaakur man loReedaa paaiaa ||
english: I have found the infinite Lord and Master, the treasure of virtue, which my mind had yearned for.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sadaa tripate har naam bhojan khaaiaa ||4||2||3||
english: Prays Nanak, I am satisfied forever; I have eaten the food of the Lord's Name. ||4||2||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਵਾਰ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 vaar salokaa naal ||
english: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Vaar With Saloks:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥
transliteration: aad pooran madh pooran a(n)t pooran paramesurah ||
english: In the beginning, He was pervading; in the middle, He is pervading; in the end, He will be pervading. He is the Transcendent Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਰਮਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਘਨਾਸਨ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: simara(n)t sa(n)t sarabatr ramana(n) naanak aghanaasan jagadeesurah ||1||
english: The Saints remember in meditation the all-pervading Lord God. O Nanak, He is the Destroyer of sins, the Lord of the universe. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਨ ਸੁਨਨ ਸੁਨਾਵਨੋ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਐ ਸਾਚੁ ॥
transliteration: pekhan sunan sunaavano man mahi driReeai saach ||
english: See, hear, speak and implant the True Lord within your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: poor rahio sarabatr mai naanak har ra(n)g raach ||2||
english: He is all-pervading, permeating everywhere; O Nanak, be absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har ek nira(n)jan gaaeeai sabh a(n)tar soee ||
english: Sing the Praise of the One, the Immaculate Lord; He is contained within all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath prabh jo kare s hoee ||
english: The Cause of causes, the Almighty Lord God; whatever He wills, comes to pass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi thaap uthaapadaa tis bin nahee koee ||
english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; without Him, there is no other.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਦੀਪ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)d brahama(n)d paataal deep raviaa sabh loee ||
english: He pervades the continents, solar systems, nether worlds, islands and all worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis aap bujhaae so bujhasee niramal jan soee ||1||
english: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself instructs; he alone is a pure and unstained being. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਚੰਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਰਚਨਾ ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਅਸਥਾਪਨੰ ॥
transliteration: racha(n)t jee rachanaa maat garabh asathaapana(n) ||
english: Creating the soul, the Lord places this creation in the womb of the mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saas saas simara(n)t naanak mahaa agan na binaasana(n) ||1||
english: With each and every breath, it meditates in remembrance on the Lord, O Nanak; it is not consumed by the great fire. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖੁ ਤਲੈ ਪੈਰ ਉਪਰੇ ਵਸੰਦੋ ਕੁਹਥੜੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mukh talai pair upare vasa(n)do kuhathaRai thaai ||
english: With its head down, and feet up, it dwells in that slimy place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak so dhanee kiu visaario udharahi jis dai naai ||2||
english: O Nanak, how could we forget the Master? Through His Name, we are saved. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿੰਮਿਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: rakat bi(n)d kar ni(n)miaa agan udar majhaar ||
english: From egg and sperm, you were conceived, and placed in the fire of the womb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖੁ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਬਿਕਲੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਘੋਰਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: uradh mukh kucheel bikal narak ghor gubaar ||
english: Head downwards, you abided restlessly in that dark, dismal, terrible hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤੂ ਨਾ ਜਲਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har simarat too naa jalahi man tan ur dhaar ||
english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, you were not burnt; enshrine Him in your heart, mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਮ ਥਾਨਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bikham thaanahu jin rakhiaa tis til na visaar ||
english: In that treacherous place, He protected and preserved you; do not forget Him, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਾਸਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prabh bisarat sukh kade naahi jaasahi janam haar ||2||
english: Forgetting God, you shall never find peace; you shall forfeit your life, and depart. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛਾ ਦਾਨ ਕਰਣੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
transliteration: man ichhaa daan karana(n) sarabatr aasaa pooranah ||
english: He grants our hearts' desires, and fulfills all our hopes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡਣੰ ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਦੂਰਣਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kha(n)dana(n) kal kalesah prabh simar naanak nah dooranah ||1||
english: He destroys pain and suffering; remember God in meditation, O Nanak - He is not far away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੈ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਈਐ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: habh ra(n)g maanahi jis sa(n)g tai siu laaeeai nehu ||
english: Love Him, with whom you enjoy all pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਰਚਿਆ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so sahu bi(n)d na visarau naanak jin su(n)dar rachiaa dehu ||2||
english: Do not forget that Lord, even for an instant; O Nanak, He fashioned this beautiful body. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਦੀਨੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
transliteration: jeeu praan tan dhan deeaa deene ras bhog ||
english: He gave you your soul, breath of life, body and wealth; He gave you pleasures to enjoy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੰਦਰ ਰਥ ਅਸੁ ਦੀਏ ਰਚਿ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: grih ma(n)dar rath as deee rach bhale sa(n)jog ||
english: He gave you households, mansions, chariots and horses; He ordained your good destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਦੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਵਨ ਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: sut banitaa saajan sevak deee prabh devan jog ||
english: He gave you your children, spouse, friends and servants; God is the all-powerful Great Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: har simarat tan man hariaa lahi jaahi vijog ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the body and mind are rejuvenated, and sorrow departs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਹੁ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har gun ramahu binase sabh rog ||3||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Praises of the Lord, and all your sickness shall vanish. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਟੰਬ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਣੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਨੇਕ ਉਦਮਹ ॥
transliteration: kuta(n)b jatan karana(n) maaiaa anek udamah ||
english: For his family, he works very hard; for the sake of Maya, he makes countless efforts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵ ਹੀਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਤਤਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har bhagat bhaav heena(n) naanak prabh bisarat te pretatah ||1||
english: But without loving devotional worship of the Lord, O Nanak, he forgets God, and then, he is a mere ghost. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਟੜੀਆ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜੋ ਲਾਈ ਬਿਅੰਨ ਸਿਉ ॥
transliteration: tutaReeaa saa preet jo laaee bia(n)n siu ||
english: That love shall break, which is established with any other than the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sachee reet saa(n)ee setee ratiaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, that way of life is true, which inspires love of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮ ਹੋਇ ਕਹਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jis bisarat tan bhasam hoi kahate sabh pret ||
english: Forgetting Him, one's body turns to dust, and everyone calls him a ghost.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਨ ਨ ਦੇਵਹੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੋਈ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: khin grih mahi basan na devahee jin siu soee het ||
english: And those, with whom he was so much in love - they do not let him stay in their home, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਨਰਥ ਦਰਬੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਸੋ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਕੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kar anarath darab sa(n)chiaa so kaaraj ket ||
english: Practicing exploitation, he gathers wealth, but what use will it be in the end?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕਰਮ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa beejai so lunai karam ihu khet ||
english: As one plants, so does he harvest; the body is the field of actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮੇਤੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: akirataghanaa har visariaa jonee bharamet ||4||
english: The ungrateful wretches forget the Lord, and wander in reincarnation. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੰ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੋਧਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਤਹ ॥
transliteration: kot daan isanaana(n) anik sodhan pavitratah ||
english: The benefits of millions of charitable donations and cleansing baths, and countless ceremonies of purification and piety,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਚਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਮੁਚਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: uchara(n)t naanak har har rasanaa sarab paap bimuchate ||1||
english: O Nanak, are obtained by chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har with one's tongue; all sins are washed away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਧਣੁ ਕੀਤੋਮੂ ਘਣਾ ਭੋਰੀ ਦਿਤੀਮੁ ਭਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: eedhan keetomoo ghanaa bhoree diteem bhaahi ||
english: I gathered together a great stack of firewood, and applied a tiny flame to light it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਵਸੰਦੜੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਭੇ ਡੁਖੜੇ ਉਲਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man vasa(n)daRo sach sahu naanak habhe dukhaRe ulaahi ||2||
english: When the True Lord and Master abides in one's mind, O Nanak, all sins are dispelled. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘਾ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot aghaa sabh naas hohi simarat har naau ||
english: Millions of sins are totally erased, by meditating on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man chi(n)de phal paaeeahi har ke gun gaau ||
english: The fruits of one's heart's desires are obtained, by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam maran bhai kateeahi nihachal sach thaau ||
english: The fear of birth and death is eradicated, and one's eternal, unchanging true home is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poorab hovai likhiaa har charan samaau ||
english: If it is so pre-ordained, one is absorbed in the Lord's lotus feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh raakh lehu naanak bal jaau ||5||
english: Bless me with Your mercy, God - please preserve and save me! Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਚਨਾ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਸੁਆਦੰ ਰਸਹ ॥
transliteration: grih rachanaa apaara(n) man bilaas suaada(n) rasah ||
english: They are involved in their beautiful houses, and the pleasures of the mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਦਾਂਚ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜੰਤ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਮਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kadaa(n)ch nah simara(n)t naanak te ja(n)t bisataa krimah ||1||
english: They never remember the Lord in meditation; O Nanak, they are like maggots in manure. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਚੁ ਅਡੰਬਰੁ ਹਭੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਮੰਝਿ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਨੇਹ ॥
transliteration: much ada(n)bar habh kihu ma(n)jh muhabat neh ||
english: They are engrossed in ostentatious displays, lovingly attached to all their possessions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਂਈ ਜੈਂ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so saa(n)ee jai(n) visarai naanak so tan kheh ||2||
english: That body which forgets the Lord, O Nanak, shall be reduced to ashes. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੇਜ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੁਖ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar sej anek sukh ras bhogan poore ||
english: He may enjoy a beautiful bed, countless pleasures and all sorts of enjoyments.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੋਇਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਲਾਇ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰੇ ॥
transliteration: grih soin cha(n)dan suga(n)dh laai motee heere ||
english: He may possess mansions of gold, studded with pearls and rubies, plastered with fragrant sandalwood oil.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣਦਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man ichhe sukh maanadaa kichh naahi visoore ||
english: He may relish in the pleasures of his mind's desires, and have no anxiety at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀਰੇ ॥
transliteration: so prabh chit na aavaee visataa ke keere ||
english: But if he does not remember God, he is like a maggot in manure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bin har naam na saa(n)t hoi kit bidh man dheere ||6||
english: Without the Lord's Name, there is no peace at all. How can the mind be comforted? ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਰਹੰ ਖੋਜੰਤ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਹ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal biraha(n) khoja(n)t bairaagee dah disah ||
english: One who loves the Lord's lotus feet searches for Him in the ten directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗੰਤ ਕਪਟ ਰੂਪ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tiaaga(n)t kapat roop maaiaa naanak aana(n)d roop saadh sa(n)gamah ||1||
english: He renounces the deceptive illusion of Maya, and joins the blissful form of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਉਚਰਾ ਵਤਾ ਹਭੇ ਲੋਅ ॥
transliteration: man saa(n)ee mukh ucharaa vataa habhe lo ||
english: The Lord is in my mind, and with my mouth I chant His Name; I seek Him in all the lands of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਭਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਕੂੜਿਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak habh ada(n)bar kooRiaa sun jeevaa sachee soi ||2||
english: O Nanak, all ostentatious displays are false; hearing the Praises of the True Lord, I live. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸਤਾ ਤੂਟੀ ਝੁੰਪੜੀ ਚੀਰ ਸਭਿ ਛਿੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: basataa tootee jhu(n)paRee cheer sabh chhi(n)naa ||
english: He dwells in a broken-down shack, in tattered clothes,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਦਰੋ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਿੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jaat na pat na aadaro udiaan bhrami(n)naa ||
english: with no social status, no honor and no respect; he wanders in the wilderness,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਇਠ ਧਨ ਰੂਪਹੀਣ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਕੁ ਨ ਸਿੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mitr na ith dhan roopaheen kichh saak na si(n)naa ||
english: with no friend or lover, without wealth, beauty, relatives or relations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਸਗਲੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: raajaa sagalee srisat kaa har naam man bhi(n)naa ||
english: Even so, he is the king of the whole world, if his mind is imbued with the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਮਨੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tis kee dhooR man udharai prabh hoi suprasa(n)naa ||7||
english: With the dust of his feet, men are redeemed, because God is very pleased with him. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਲੀਲਾ ਰਾਜ ਰਸ ਰੂਪੰ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਚਮਰ ਤਖਤ ਆਸਨੰ ॥
transliteration: anik leelaa raaj ras roopa(n) chhatr chamar takhat aasana(n) ||
english: The various sorts of pleasures, powers, joys, beauty, canopies, cooling fans and thrones to sit on

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਚੰਤਿ ਮੂੜ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਪਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: racha(n)t mooR agiaan a(n)dhah naanak supan manorath maaiaa ||1||
english: - the foolish, ignorant and blind are engrossed in these things. O Nanak, desire for Maya is just a dream. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਹਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਆ ਮਿਠਾ ਲਗੜਾ ਮੋਹੁ ॥
transliteration: supanai habh ra(n)g maaniaa mithaa lagaRaa mohu ||
english: In a dream, he enjoys all sorts of pleasures, and emotional attachment seems so sweet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam vihooneeaa su(n)dar maaiaa dhrohu ||2||
english: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the beauty of Maya's illusion is fake. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਮੂਰਖਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: supane setee chit moorakh laaiaa ||
english: The fool attaches his consciousness to the dream.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰੇ ਰਾਜ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਜਾਗਤ ਭਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bisare raaj ras bhog jaagat bhakhalaaiaa ||
english: When he awakes, he forgets the power, pleasures and enjoyments, and he is sad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਰਜਾ ਗਈ ਵਿਹਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aarajaa gaee vihaai dha(n)dhai dhaaiaa ||
english: He passes his life chasing after worldly affairs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਏ ਨ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pooran bhae na kaam mohiaa maaiaa ||
english: His works are not completed, because he is enticed by Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: kiaa vechaaraa ja(n)t jaa aap bhulaaiaa ||8||
english: What can the poor helpless creature do? The Lord Himself has deluded him. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤਿ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਲੋਕਹ ਜਿਤਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀ ਨਵ ਖੰਡਣਹ ॥
transliteration: basa(n)t svarag lokah jitate prithavee nav kha(n)danah ||
english: They may live in heavenly realms, and conquer the nine regions of the world,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭਰਮਣਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bisara(n)t har gopaalah naanak te praanee udiaan bharamanah ||1||
english: but if they forget the Lord of the world, O Nanak, they are just wanderers in the wilderness. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਤਕ ਕੋਡ ਤਮਾਸਿਆ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਸੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kautak kod tamaasiaa chit na aavas naau ||
english: In the midst of millions of games and entertainments, the Lord's Name does not come to their minds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋੜੀ ਨਰਕ ਬਰਾਬਰੇ ਉਜੜੁ ਸੋਈ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak koRee narak baraabare ujaR soee thaau ||2||
english: O Nanak, their home is like a wilderness, in the depths of hell. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਨਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa bhaiaan udiaan nagar kar maaniaa ||
english: He sees the terrible, awful wilderness as a city.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jhooth samagree pekh sach kar jaaniaa ||
english: Gazing upon the false objects, he believes them to be real.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਦੇਵਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar phirahi devaaniaa ||
english: Engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism, he wanders around insane.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਤਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sir lagaa jam da(n)d taa pachhutaaniaa ||
english: When the Messenger of Death hits him on the head with his club, then he regrets and repents.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੈਤਾਨਿਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: bin poore guradev phirai saitaaniaa ||9||
english: Without the Perfect, Divine Guru, he roams around like Satan. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਕਪਟੰ ਰੂਪ ਕਪਟੰ ਧਨ ਕਪਟੰ ਕੁਲ ਗਰਬਤਹ ॥
transliteration: raaj kapata(n) roop kapata(n) dhan kapata(n) kul garabatah ||
english: Power is fraudulent, beauty is fraudulent, and wealth is fraudulent, as is pride of ancestry.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਚੰਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਛਲੰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)cha(n)t bikhiaa chhala(n) chhidra(n) naanak bin har sa(n)g na chaalate ||1||
english: One may gather poison through deception and fraud, O Nanak, but without the Lord, nothing shall go along with him in the end. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖੰਦੜੋ ਕੀ ਭੁਲੁ ਤੁੰਮਾ ਦਿਸਮੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ॥
transliteration: pekha(n)daRo kee bhul tu(n)maa disam sohanaa ||
english: Beholding the bitter melon, he is deceived, since it appears so pretty

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਢੁ ਨ ਲਹੰਦੜੋ ਮੁਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜੁਲਈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: adh na laha(n)daRo mul naanak saath na julaee maaiaa ||2||
english: But it is not worth even a shell, O Nanak; the riches of Maya will not go along with anyone. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਸੰਜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: chaladiaa naal na chalai so kiu sa(n)jeeai ||
english: It shall not go along with you when you depart - why do you bother to collect it?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਤਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਵੰਜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa kahu kiaa jatan jis te va(n)jeeai ||
english: Tell me, why do you try so hard to acquire that which you must leave behind in the end?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿਐ ਕਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har bisariai kiu tripataavai naa man ra(n)jeeai ||
english: Forgetting the Lord, how can you be satisfied? Your mind cannot be pleased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਰਕਿ ਸਮੰਜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: prabhoo chhod an laagai narak sama(n)jeeai ||
english: One who forsakes God, and attaches himself to another, shall be immersed in hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਉ ਭੰਜੀਐ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: hohu kripaal daiaal naanak bhau bha(n)jeeai ||10||
english: Be kind and compassionate to Nanak, O Lord, and dispel his fear. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਖ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਨਚ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਨਚ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nach raaj sukh misata(n) nach bhog ras misata(n) nach misata(n) sukh maaiaa ||
english: Princely pleasures are not sweet; sensual enjoyments are not sweet; the pleasures of Maya are not sweet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਸਟੰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨੰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: misata(n) saadhasa(n)g har naanak daas misata(n) prabh darasana(n) ||1||
english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is sweet, O slave Nanak; the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan is sweet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਗੜਾ ਸੋ ਨੇਹੁ ਮੰਨ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: lagaRaa so nehu ma(n)n majhaahoo ratiaa ||
english: I have enshrined that love which drenches my soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਧੜੋ ਸਚ ਥੋਕਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਠੜਾ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vidhaRo sach thok naanak mithaRaa so dhanee ||2||
english: I have been pierced by the Truth, O Nanak; the Master seems so sweet to me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: har bin kachhoo na laagaee bhagatan kau meethaa ||
english: Nothing seems sweet to His devotees, except the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਸੁਆਦ ਸਭਿ ਫੀਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਨਉ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: aan suaad sabh pheekiaa kar niranau deethaa ||
english: All other tastes are bland and insipid; I have tested them and seen them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: agiaan bharam dukh katiaa gur bhae baseethaa ||
english: Ignorance, doubt and suffering are dispelled, when the Guru becomes one's advocate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal man bedhiaa jiu ra(n)g majeethaa ||
english: The Lord's lotus feet have pierced my mind, and I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਭਿ ਝੂਠਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: jeeu praan tan man prabhoo binase sabh jhoothaa ||11||
english: My soul, breath of life, body and mind belong to God; all falsehood has left me. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਅਕਤ ਜਲੰ ਨਹ ਜੀਵ ਮੀਨੰ ਨਹ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੇਘ ਮੰਡਲਹ ॥
transliteration: tiakat jala(n) nah jeev meena(n) nah tiaag chaatrik megh ma(n)dalah ||
english: Leaving the water, the fish cannot live; the rainbird cannot live without the raindrops from the clouds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣ ਬੇਧੰਚ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਾਦੰ ਅਲਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸਨਹ ॥
transliteration: baan bedha(n)ch kura(n)k naada(n) al ba(n)dhan kusam baasanah ||
english: The deer is enticed by the sound of the hunter's bell, and shot through with the arrow; the bumble bee is entangled in the fragrance of the flowers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਚੰਤਿ ਸੰਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਨ ਨ ਰੁਚਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charan kamal racha(n)t sa(n)tah naanak aan na ruchate ||1||
english: The Saints are entranced by the Lord's lotus feet; O Nanak, they desire nothing else. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖੁ ਡੇਖਾਊ ਪਲਕ ਛਡਿ ਆਨ ਨ ਡੇਊ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: mukh dekhaaoo palak chhad aan na deoo chit ||
english: Show me Your face, for even an instant, Lord, and I will not give my consciousness to any other.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਣ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਾਂ ਮਿਤੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jeevan sa(n)gam tis dhanee har naanak sa(n)taa(n) mit ||2||
english: My life is with the Lord Master, O Nanak, the Friend of the Saints. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu machhulee bin paaneeai kiu jeevan paavai ||
english: How can the fish live without water?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂੰਦ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੋ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: boo(n)d vihoonaa chaatriko kiu kar tripataavai ||
english: Without the raindrops, how can the rainbird be satisfied?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਦ ਕੁਰੰਕਹਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naad kura(n)kahi bedhiaa sanamukh uth dhaavai ||
english: The deer, entranced by the sound of the hunter's bell, runs straight to him;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵਰੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸੁ ਕਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bhavar lobhee kusam baas kaa mil aap ba(n)dhaavai ||
english: the bumble bee is greedy for the flower's fragrance; finding it, he traps himself in it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਅਘਾਵੈ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: tiu sa(n)t janaa har preet hai dekh daras aghaavai ||12||
english: Just so, the humble Saints love the Lord; beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, they are satisfied and satiated. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵੰਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲੰ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਅਰਾਧਨਹ ॥
transliteration: chitava(n)t charan kamala(n) saas saas araadhanah ||
english: They contemplate the Lord's lotus feet; they worship and adore Him with each and every breath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਬਿਸਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਚੁਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nah bisara(n)t naam achut naanak aas pooran paramesurah ||1||
english: They do not forget the Name of the imperishable Lord; O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord fulfills their hopes. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤੜਾ ਮੰਨ ਮੰਝਾਹਿ ਪਲਕ ਨ ਥੀਵੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: seetaRaa ma(n)n ma(n)jhaahi palak na theevai baaharaa ||
english: He is woven into the fabric of my mind; He is not outside of it, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸੜੀ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਪੇਖੰਦੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak aasaRee nibaahi sadaa pekha(n)do sach dhanee ||2||
english: O Nanak, the True Lord and Master fulfills my hopes, and always watches over me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾਵੰਤੀ ਆਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਪੂਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: aasaava(n)tee aas gusaaee pooreeai ||
english: My hopes rest in You, O Lord of the universe; please, fulfill them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: mil gopaal gobi(n)d na kabahoo jhooreeai ||
english: Meeting with the Lord of the world, the Lord of the universe, I shall never grieve.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਸੂਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: dehu daras man chaau lahi jaahi visooreeai ||
english: Grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the desire of my mind, and my worries shall be over.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਚਰਨਾ ਧੂਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: hoi pavitr sareer charanaa dhooreeai ||
english: By body is sanctified, by the dust of Your feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੀਐ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: paarabraham guradev sadaa hajooreeai ||13||
english: O Supreme Lord God, Divine Guru, You are always with me, ever-present. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਮੰ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੰ ਸੁਨੰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਹ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa uchara(n)t naama(n) sravana(n) suna(n)t sabad a(n)mritah ||
english: With my tongue, I chant the Lord's Name; with my ears, I listen to the Ambrosial Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੰ ਜਿਨਾ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਣਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tin sad balihaara(n) jinaa dhiaan paarabrahamanah ||1||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਭਿ ਕੂੜਾਵੇ ਕੰਮ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਾਈ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: habh kooRaave ka(n)m ikas saaee baahare ||
english: All concerns are false, except those of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak seee dha(n)n jinaa pirahaRee sach siu ||2||
english: O Nanak, blessed are those, who are in love with their True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਜਿ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ॥
transliteration: sad balihaaree tinaa j sunate har kathaa ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who listen to the sermon of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਨਿਵਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਥਾ ॥
transliteration: poore te paradhaan nivaavahi prabh mathaa ||
english: Those who bow their heads before God are perfect and distinguished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸੇ ਹਥਾ ॥
transliteration: har jas likhahi bea(n)t sohahi se hathaa ||
english: Those hands, which write the Praises of the infinite Lord are beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਥਾ ॥
transliteration: charan puneet pavitr chaalahi prabh pathaa ||
english: Those feet which walk on God's Path are pure and holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਥਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa(n) sa(n)g udhaar sagalaa dukh lathaa ||14||
english: In the Society of the Saints, they are emancipated; all their sorrows depart. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਵੀ ਉਦੋਤ ਕਰਣੰ ਹਰਿ ਰਮਣੰ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
transliteration: bhaavee udot karana(n) har ramana(n) sa(n)jog pooranah ||
english: One's destiny is activated, when one chants the Lord's Name, through perfect good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਰਸ ਭੇਟੰ ਸਫਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਮਹੂਰਤਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gopaal daras bheta(n) saphal naanak so mahooratah ||1||
english: Fruitful is that moment, O Nanak, when one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਪਾਇ ਸੁਖ ਮਿਤੀ ਹੂ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: keem na sakaa paai sukh mitee hoo baahare ||
english: Its value cannot be estimated; it brings peace beyond measure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਵੇਲੜੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੰਦੜੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saa velaRee paravaan jit mila(n)daRo maa piree ||2||
english: O Nanak, that time alone is approved, when my Beloved meets with me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saa velaa kahu kaun hai jit prabh kau paaee ||
english: Tell me, what is that time, when I shall find God?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: so moorat bhalaa sa(n)jog hai jit milai gusaaee ||
english: Blessed and auspicious is that moment, and that destiny, when I shall find the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਕੈ ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar har dhiaai kai man ichh pujaaee ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, twenty-four hours a day, my mind's desires are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag satasa(n)g hoi niv laagaa paaee ||
english: By great good fortune, I have found the Society of the Saints; I bow and touch their feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: man darasan kee piaas hai naanak bal jaaee ||15||
english: My mind thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹ ॥
transliteration: patit puneet gobi(n)dah sarab dokh nivaaranah ||
english: The Lord of the Universe is the Purifier of sinners; He is the Dispeller of all distress.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰ ਭਗਵਾਨਹ ਜਪੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saran soor bhagavaanah japa(n)t naanak har har hare ||1||
english: The Lord God is Mighty, giving His Protective Sanctuary; Nanak chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਡਿਓ ਹਭੁ ਆਪੁ ਲਗੜੋ ਚਰਣਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: chhadio habh aap lagaRo charanaa paas ||
english: Renouncing all self-conceit, I hold tight to the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਠੜੋ ਦੁਖ ਤਾਪੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੇਖੰਦਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nathaRo dukh taap naanak prabh pekha(n)diaa ||2||
english: My sorrows and troubles have departed, O Nanak, beholding God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਢਹਿ ਪਏ ਦੁਆਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mel laihu daiaal dhahi pae duaariaa ||
english: Unite with me, O Merciful Lord; I have fallen at Your Door.

author: Guru Arjan
