gurmukhi: ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਬਹੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: rakh levahu deen daiaal bhramat bahu haariaa ||
english: O Merciful to the meek, save me. I have wandered enough; now I am tired.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal teraa birad har patit udhaariaa ||
english: It is Your very nature to love Your devotees, and save sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਬਿਨਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin naahee koi binau mohi saariaa ||
english: Without You, there is no other at all; I offer this prayer to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: kar gahi lehu daiaal saagar sa(n)saariaa ||16||
english: Take me by the hand, O Merciful Lord, and carry me across the world-ocean. ||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਉਧਰਣ ਦਇਆਲੰ ਆਸਰੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t udharan daiaala(n) aasara(n) gopaal keeratanah ||
english: The Merciful Lord is the Savior of the Saints; their only support is to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੰ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: niramala(n) sa(n)t sa(n)gen ot naanak paramesurah ||1||
english: One becomes immaculate and pure, by associating with the Saints, O Nanak, and taking the Protection of the Transcendent Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸਰਦ ਰੁਤਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਘਾਂਮ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)dan cha(n)d na sarad rut mool na mitaee ghaa(n)m ||
english: The burning of the heart is not dispelled at all, by sandalwood paste, the moon, or the cold season.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲੁ ਥੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਪੰਦੜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: seetal theevai naanakaa japa(n)daRo har naam ||2||
english: It only becomes cool, O Nanak, by chanting the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਜਨ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal kee ot udhare sagal jan ||
english: Through the Protection and Support of the Lord's lotus feet, all beings are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਮਨ ॥
transliteration: sun parataap govi(n)d nirabhau bhae man ||
english: Hearing of the Glory of the Lord of the Universe, the mind becomes fearless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨ ॥
transliteration: tot na aavai mool sa(n)chiaa naam dhan ||
english: Nothing at all is lacking, when one gathers the wealth of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡੈ ਪੁਨ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa siu sa(n)g paaeeai vadai pun ||
english: The Society of the Saints is obtained, by very good deeds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਨ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: aath pahar har dhiaai har jas nit sun ||17||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on the Lord, and listen continually to the Lord's Praises. ||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਣੰ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਣੰ ਉਚਰਣੰ ਨਾਮ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
transliteration: daiaa karana(n) dukh harana(n) ucharana(n) naam keeratanah ||
english: The Lord grants His Grace, and dispels the pains of those who sing the Kirtan of the Praises of His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਪਤ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daiaal purakh bhagavaanah naanak lipat na maaiaa ||1||
english: When the Lord God shows His Kindness, O Nanak, one is no longer engrossed in Maya. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਦੜੀ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਰਖੰਦੜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: bhaahi bala(n)daRee bujh gaee rakha(n)daRo prabh aap ||
english: The burning fire has been put out; God Himself has saved me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin upaaee medanee naanak so prabh jaap ||2||
english: Meditate on that God, O Nanak, who created the universe. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa prabh bhae daiaal na biaapai maaiaa ||
english: When God becomes merciful, Maya does not cling.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘਾ ਗਏ ਨਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kot aghaa gae naas har ik dhiaaiaa ||
english: Millions of sins are eliminated, by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਸਰੀਰ ਜਨ ਧੂਰੀ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: niramal bhae sareer jan dhooree naaiaa ||
english: The body is made immaculate and pure, bathing in the dust of the feet of the Lord's humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man tan bhae sa(n)tokh pooran prabh paaiaa ||
english: The mind and body become contented, finding the Perfect Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਰੇ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੋਗ ਕੁਲ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: tare kuta(n)b sa(n)g log kul sabaaiaa ||18||
english: One is saved, along with his family, and all his ancestors. ||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਹ ॥
transliteration: gur gobi(n)d gopaal gur gur pooran naaraainah ||
english: The Guru is the Lord of the Universe; the Guru is the Lord of the world; the Guru is the Perfect Pervading Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur daiaal samarath gur gur naanak patit udhaaranah ||1||
english: The Guru is compassionate; the Guru is all-powerful; the Guru, O Nanak, is the Saving Grace of sinners. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਤਾਰਿਅਮੁ ॥
transliteration: bhaujal bikham asagaahu gur bohithai taariam ||
english: The Guru is the boat, to cross over the dangerous, treacherous, unfathomable world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak poor kara(n)m satigur charanee lagiaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, by perfect good karma, one is attached to the feet of the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੇ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n guradev jis sa(n)g har jape ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the Divine Guru; associating with Him, one meditates on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਤ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਛਪੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kripaal jab bhae ta avagun sabh chhape ||
english: When the Guru becomes merciful, then all one's demerits are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਨੀਚਹੁ ਉਚ ਥਪੇ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham guradev neechahu uch thape ||
english: The Supreme Lord God, the Divine Guru, uplifts and exalts the lowly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਦੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਅਪ ਦਸੇ ॥
transliteration: kaat silak dukh maaiaa kar leene ap dase ||
english: Cutting away the painful noose of Maya, He makes us His own slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੇ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: gun gaae bea(n)t rasanaa har jase ||19||
english: With my tongue, I sing the Glorious Praises of the infinite Lord God. ||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰਤ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਨੀਅੰਤ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੰਤ ਏਕੋ ਨਰਹਰਹ ॥
transliteration: drisata(n)t eko suneea(n)t eko varata(n)t eko naraharah ||
english: I see only the One Lord; I hear only the One Lord; the One Lord is all-pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਜਾਚੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam daan jaacha(n)t naanak daiaal purakh kripaa karah ||1||
english: Nanak begs for the gift of the Naam; O Merciful Lord God, please grant Your Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਕੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਹਿਕੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: hik sevee hik sa(n)malaa har ikas pahi aradaas ||
english: I serve the One Lord, I contemplate the One Lord, and to the One Lord, I offer my prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam vakhar dhan sa(n)chiaa naanak sachee raas ||2||
english: Nanak has gathered in the wealth, the merchandise of the Naam; this is the true capital. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਇਕੁ ਏਹੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh daiaal bea(n)t pooran ik ehu ||
english: God is merciful and infinite. The One and Only is all-pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹਾ ਕੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap doojaa kahaa kehu ||
english: He Himself is all-in-all. Who else can we speak of?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aap karahu prabh daan aape aap lehu ||
english: God Himself grants His gifts, and He Himself receives them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਥੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa hukam sabh nihachal tudh thehu ||
english: Coming and going are all by the Hukam of Your Will; Your place is steady and unchanging.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੨੦॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ma(n)gai daan kar kirapaa naam dehu ||20||1||
english: Nanak begs for this gift; by Your Grace, Lord, please grant me Your Name. ||20||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: jaitasaree baanee bhagataa kee ||
english: Jaitsree, The Word Of The Devotees:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਥ ਕਛੂਅ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
transliteration: naath kachhoo na jaanau ||
english: O my Lord and Master, I know nothing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man maaiaa kai haath bikaanau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind has sold out, and is in Maya's hands. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੌ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: tum kaheeat hau jagat gur suaamee ||
english: You are called the Lord and Master, the Guru of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਕੇ ਕਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ham kaheeat kalijug ke kaamee ||1||
english: I am called a lustful being of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਪੰਚਨ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਜੁ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: in pa(n)chan mero man j bigaario ||
english: The five vices have corrupted my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੇ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pal pal har jee te a(n)tar paario ||2||
english: Moment by moment, they lead me further away from the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਦੁਖ ਕੀ ਰਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jat dekhau tat dukh kee raasee ||
english: Wherever I look, I see loads of pain and suffering.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਜੌਂ ਨ ਪਤੵਾਇ ਨਿਗਮ ਭਏ ਸਾਖੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ajau(n) na patyaai nigam bhae saakhee ||3||
english: I do not have faith, even though the Vedas bear witness to the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਤਮ ਨਾਰਿ ਉਮਾਪਤਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: gotam naar umaapat svaamee ||
english: Shiva cut off Brahma's head, and Gautam's wife and the Lord Indra mated;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਨਿ ਸਹਸ ਭਗ ਗਾਂਮੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sees dharan sahas bhag gaa(n)mee ||4||
english: Brahma's head got stuck to Shiva's hand, and Indra came to bear the marks of a thousand female organs. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਦੂਤਨ ਖਲੁ ਬਧੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: in dootan khal badh kar maario ||
english: These demons have fooled, bound and destroyed me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਡੋ ਨਿਲਾਜੁ ਅਜਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰਿਓ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bado nilaaj ajahoo nahee haario ||5||
english: I am very shameless - even now, I am not tired of them. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਕਹਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas kahaa kaise keejai ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, what am I to do now?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ਸਰਨਿ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੬॥੧॥
transliteration: bin raghunaath saran kaa kee leejai ||6||1||
english: Without the Sanctuary of the Lord's Protection, who else's should I seek? ||6||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag todee mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Todee, Chau-Padhay, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har bin rahi na sakai man meraa ||
english: Without the Lord, my mind cannot survive.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mere preetam praan har prabh gur mele bahur na bhavajal pheraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If the Guru unites me with my Beloved Lord God, my breath of life, then I shall not have to face the wheel of reincarnation again in the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਲੋਚ ਲਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: merai heearai loch lagee prabh keree har nainahu har prabh heraa ||
english: My heart is gripped by a yearning for my Lord God, and with my eyes, I behold my Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur daiaal har naam driRaaiaa har paadhar har prabh keraa ||1||
english: The merciful True Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me; this is the Path leading to my Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)gee har naam prabh paaiaa har govi(n)d har prabh keraa ||
english: Through the Lord's Love, I have found the Naam, the Name of my Lord God, the Lord of the Universe, the Lord my God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਚੰਗੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har hiradai man tan meethaa laagaa mukh masatak bhaag cha(n)geraa ||2||
english: The Lord seems so very sweet to my heart, mind and body; upon my face, upon my forehead, my good destiny is inscribed. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਚੰਗੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: lobh vikaar jinaa man laagaa har visariaa purakh cha(n)geraa ||
english: Those whose minds are attached to greed and corruption forget the Lord, the good Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਮੰਦੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: oi manamukh mooR agiaanee kaheeahi tin masatak bhaag ma(n)deraa ||3||
english: Those self-willed manmukhs are called foolish and ignorant; misfortune and bad destiny are written on their foreheads. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bibek budh satigur te paaee gur giaan guroo prabh keraa ||
english: From the True Guru, I have obtained a discriminating intellect; the Guru has revealed the spiritual wisdom of God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਲਿਖੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam guroo te paaiaa dhur masatak bhaag likheraa ||4||1||
english: Servant Nanak has obtained the Naam from the Guru; such is the destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ghar 1 dupade ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl, First House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan avar na kaahoo jaanee ||
english: The Saints do not know any other.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: beparavaah sadaa ra(n)g har kai jaa ko paakh suaamee || rahaau ||
english: They are carefree, ever in the Lord's Love; the Lord and Master is on their side. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੋ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਤਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ooch samaanaa thaakur tero avar na kaahoo taanee ||
english: Your canopy is so high, O Lord and Master; no one else has any power.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਅਮਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aiso amar milio bhagatan kau raach rahe ra(n)g giaanee ||1||
english: Such is the immortal Lord and Master the devotees have found; the spiritually wise remain absorbed in His Love. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਖ ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਕਟਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: rog sog dukh jaraa maraa har janahi nahee nikataanee ||
english: Disease, sorrow, pain, old age and death do not even approach the humble servant of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਏਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: nirabhau hoi rahe liv ekai naanak har man maanee ||2||1||
english: They remain fearless, in the Love of the One Lord; O Nanak, they have surrendered their minds to the Lord. ||2||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har bisarat sadaa khuaaree ||
english: Forgetting the Lord, one is ruined forever.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਧੋਖਾ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਓਟ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taa kau dhokhaa kahaa biaapai jaa kau ot tuhaaree || rahaau ||
english: How can anyone be deceived, who has Your Support, O Lord? ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਜੋ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਬਲਨਾ ਸਰਪ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਰਜਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bin simaran jo jeevan balanaa sarap jaise arajaaree ||
english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, life is like a burning fire, even if one lives long, like a snake.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਖੰਡਨ ਕੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਚਲੈਗੋ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nav kha(n)dan ko raaj kamaavai a(n)t chalaigo haaree ||1||
english: One may rule over the nine regions of the earth, but in the end, he shall have to depart, losing the game of life. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਗਾਏ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan gun tin hee gaae jaa kau kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: He alone sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue, upon whom the Lord showers His Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਉਸੁ ਜਨਮਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: so sukheeaa dha(n)n us janamaa naanak tis balihaaree ||2||2||
english: He is at peace, and his birth is blessed; Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ||2||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ghar 2 chaupade ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: dhaaio re man dah dis dhaaio ||
english: The mind wanders, wandering in the ten directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨ ਸੁਆਦਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa magan suaad lobh mohio tin prabh aap bhulaaio || rahaau ||
english: It is intoxicated by Maya, enticed by the taste of greed. God Himself has deluded it. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਇਕੁ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: har kathaa har jas saadhasa(n)gat siu ik muhat na ihu man laaio ||
english: He does not focus his mind, even for a moment, on the Lord's sermon, or the Lord's Praises, or the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਗਸਿਓ ਪੇਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕੋ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਹਨਿ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bigasio pekh ra(n)g kasu(n)bh ko par grih johan jaaio ||1||
english: He is excited, gazing on the transitory color of the safflower, and looking at other men's wives. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਨਹ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu bhaau na keeno nah sat purakh manaaio ||
english: He does not love the Lord's lotus feet, and he does not please the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਲੀ ਬਲਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhaavat kau dhaavahi bahu bhaatee jiu telee balad bhramaaio ||2||
english: He runs around chasing the fleeting objects of the world, in all directions, like the ox around the oil press. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਓ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: naam daan isanaan na keeo ik nimakh na keerat gaaio ||
english: He does not practice the Naam, the Name of the Lord; nor does he practice charity or inner cleansing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਝੂਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਖਿਓ ਨਹ ਬੂਝਿਓ ਅਪਨਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanaa jhooth laai man tokhio nah boojhio apanaaio ||3||
english: He does not sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, even for an instant. Clinging to his many falsehoods, he does not please his own mind, and he does not understand his own self. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਕੀਏ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: paraupakaar na kabahoo keee nahee satigur sev dhiaaio ||
english: He never does good deeds for others; he does not serve or meditate on the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਰਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਮਦ ਮਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch doot rach sa(n)gat gosat matavaaro mad maaio ||4||
english: He is entangled in the company and the advice of the five demons, intoxicated by the wine of Maya. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: karau benatee saadhasa(n)gat har bhagat vachhal sun aaio ||
english: I offer my prayer in the Saadh Sangat; hearing that the Lord is the Lover of His devotees, I have come.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪੁਨਾਇਓ ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak bhaag pario har paachhai raakh laaj apunaaio ||5||1||3||
english: Nanak runs after the Lord, and pleads, "Protect my honor, Lord, and make me Your own." ||5||1||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maanukh bin boojhe birathaa aaiaa ||
english: Without understanding, his coming into the world is useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਜ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਓਢਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anik saaj seegaar bahu karataa jiu miratak odhaaiaa || rahaau ||
english: He puts on various ornaments and many decorations, but it is like dressing a corpse. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਨ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੀ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhaai dhaai kripan sram keeno ikatr karee hai maaiaa ||
english: With great effort and exertion, the miser works to gather in the riches of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daan pu(n)n nahee sa(n)tan sevaa kit hee kaaj na aaiaa ||1||
english: He does not give anything in charity or generosity, and he does not serve the Saints; his wealth does not do him any good at all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਆਭਰਣ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸੇਜਾ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar aabharan savaaree sejaa kaaman thaat banaaiaa ||
english: The soul-bride puts on her ornaments, embellishes her bed, and fashions decorations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਰਤੇ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)g na paaio apune bharate pekh pekh dukh paaiaa ||2||
english: But if she does not obtain the company of her Husband Lord, the sight of these decorations only brings her pain. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੋ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੁਹੁ ਮੂਸਲਹਿ ਛਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saaro dinas majooree karataa tuhu moosalahi chharaaiaa ||
english: The man works all day long, threshing the husks with the pestle.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਦੁ ਭਇਓ ਬੇਗਾਰੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khed bhaio begaaree niaaee ghar kai kaam na aaiaa ||3||
english: He is depressed, like a forced laborer, and so he is of no use to his own home. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaio anugrahu jaa kau prabh ko tis hiradai naam vasaaiaa ||
english: But when God shows His Mercy and Grace, He implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within the heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰਿਅਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kai paachhai pariau jan naanak har ras paaiaa ||4||2||4||
english: Search the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, and find the sublime essence of the Lord. ||4||2||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਬਸਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: kripaa nidh basahu ridai har neet ||
english: O Lord, ocean of mercy, please abide forever in my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taisee budh karahu paragaasaa laagai prabh sa(n)g preet || rahaau ||
english: Please awaken such understanding within me, that I may be in love with You, God. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਕੀ ਪਾਵਉ ਧੂਰਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇ ਲੇ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: daas tumaare kee paavau dhooraa masatak le le laavau ||
english: Please, bless me with the dust of the feet of Your slaves; I touch it to my forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਤੇ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mahaa patit te hot puneetaa har keeratan gun gaavau ||1||
english: I was a great sinner, but I have been made pure, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗਉ ਕੀਓ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: aagiaa tumaree meethee laagau keeo tuhaaro bhaavau ||
english: Your Will seems so sweet to me; whatever You do, is pleasing to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਆਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo too dehi tahee ihu tripatai aan na katahoo dhaavau ||2||
english: Whatever You give me, with that I am satisfied; I shall chase after no one else. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜਾਨਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਗਲ ਰੇਣ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sad hee nikat jaanau prabh suaamee sagal ren hoi raheeai ||
english: I know that my Lord and Master God is always with me; I am the dust of all men's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat hoi paraapat taa prabh apunaa laheeai ||3||
english: If I find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I shall obtain God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਮ ਛੋਹਰੇ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮਰੋ ਮੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa ham chhohare tumare too prabh hamaro meeraa ||
english: Forever and ever, I am Your child; You are my God, my King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰੋ ਖੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak baarik tum maat pitaa mukh naam tumaaro kheeraa ||4||3||5||
english: Nanak is Your child; You are my mother and father; please, give me Your Name, like milk in my mouth. ||4||3||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ghar 2 dupade ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: maagau daan thaakur naam ||
english: I beg for the Gift of Your Name, O my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਕਛੂ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avar kachhoo merai sa(n)g na chaalai milai kripaa gun gaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Nothing else shall go along with me in the end; by Your Grace, please allow me to sing Your Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਸਗਲ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਮ ॥
transliteration: raaj maal anek bhog ras sagal taravar kee chhaam ||
english: Power, wealth, various pleasures and enjoyments, all are just like the shadow of a tree.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਉ ਧਾਵੈ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਰਾਰਥ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhaai dhaai bahu bidh kau dhaavai sagal niraarath kaam ||1||
english: He runs, runs, runs around in many directions, but all of his pursuits are useless. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਵਰੁ ਜੇ ਚਾਹਉ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਗਲ ਬਾਤ ਹੈ ਖਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bin govi(n)d avar je chaahau deesai sagal baat hai khaam ||
english: Except for the Lord of the Universe, everything he desires appears transitory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨ ਮਾਗਉ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥੧॥੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sa(n)t ren maagau mero man paavai bisraam ||2||1||6||
english: Says Nanak, I beg for the dust of the feet of the Saints, so that my mind may find peace and tranquility. ||2||1||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh jee ko naam manahi saadhaarai ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Dear Lord, is the Support of my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੂਖ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਬਰਤਨਿ ਏਹ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jee praan sookh is man kau baratan eh hamaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It is my life, my breath of life, my peace of mind; for me, it is an article of daily use. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: naam jaat naam meree pat hai naam merai paravaarai ||
english: The Naam is my social status, the Naam is my honor; the Naam is my family.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam sakhaaee sadaa merai sa(n)g har naam mo kau nisataarai ||1||
english: The Naam is my companion; it is always with me. The Lord's Name is my emancipation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਚਲਤ ਨ ਕਛੂ ਸੰਗਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: bikhai bilaas kaheeat bahutere chalat na kachhoo sa(n)gaarai ||
english: Sensual pleasures are talked about a lot, but none of them goes along with anyone in the end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸਟੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੭॥
transliteration: isat meet naam naanak ko har naam merai bha(n)daarai ||2||2||7||
english: The Naam is Nanak's dearest friend; the Lord's Name is my treasure. ||2||2||7||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: todee mah 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਮਿਟਹੀ ਰੋਗ ॥
transliteration: neeke gun gaau mitahee rog ||
english: Sing the sublime Praises of the Lord, and your disease shall be eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਰਹੈ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mukh oojal man niramal hoee hai tero rahai eehaa oohaa log ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your face shall become radiant and bright, and your mind shall be immaculately pure. You shall be saved here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਚਰਾਵਉ ਭੋਗ ॥
transliteration: charan pakhaar karau gur sevaa manahi charaavau bhog ||
english: I wash the Guru's feet and serve Him; I dedicate my mind as an offering to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਆਪਤੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਜੋ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chhod aapat baad aha(n)kaaraa maan soee jo hog ||1||
english: Renounce self-conceit, negativity and egotism, and accept what comes to pass. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t tahal soee hai laagaa jis masatak likhiaa likhog ||
english: He alone commits himself to the service of the Saints, upon whose forehead such destiny is inscribed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ek bin doojaa avar na karanai jog ||2||3||8||
english: Says Nanak, other than the One Lord, there is not any other able to act. ||2||3||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur aaio saran tuhaaree ||
english: O True Guru, I have come to Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੈ ਸੂਖੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਲਾਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: milai sookh naam har sobhaa chi(n)taa laahi hamaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Grant me the peace and glory of the Lord's Name, and remove my anxiety. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਠਾਹਰ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਤਉ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: avar na soojhai doojee thaahar haar pario tau duaaree ||
english: I cannot see any other place of shelter; I have grown weary, and collapsed at Your door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਲੇਖੈ ਛੂਟਹ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lekhaa chhod alekhai chhootah ham niragun lehu ubaaree ||1||
english: Please ignore my account; only then may I be saved. I am worthless - please, save me! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sad bakhasi(n)d sadaa miharavaanaa sabhanaa dei adhaaree ||
english: You are always forgiving, and always merciful; You give support to all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰਿਓ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਇਹ ਬਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak daas sa(n)t paachhai pario raakh lehu ih baaree ||2||4||9||
english: Slave Nanak follows the Path of the Saints; save him, O Lord, this time. ||2||4||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa gun gopaal nidh gaain ||
english: My tongue sings the Praises of the Lord of the world, the ocean of virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਪਲਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)t sahaj rahas man upajio sagale dookh palaain ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Peace, tranquility, poise and delight well up in my mind, and all sorrows run away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਸਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: jo maagahi soee soee paavahi sev har ke charan rasaain ||
english: Whatever I ask for, I receive; I serve at the Lord's feet, the source of nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਹਹੂ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਣ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam maran duhahoo te chhootahi bhavajal jagat taraain ||1||
english: I am released from the bondage of birth and death, and so I cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਦਾਸ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat tat beechaario daas govi(n)d paraain ||
english: Searching and seeking, I have come to understand the essence of reality; the slave of the Lord of the Universe is dedicated to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਖੇਮ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੦॥
transliteration: abinaasee khem chaahahi je naanak sadaa simar naaraain ||2||5||10||
english: If you desire eternal bliss, O Nanak, ever remember the Lord in meditation. ||2||5||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਾਟਿਓ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak gur kirapaa te haatio ||
english: The slanderer, by Guru's Grace, has been turned away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸਿਵ ਕੈ ਬਾਣਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh bhae daiaalaa siv kai baan sir kaatio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has become merciful; with Shiva's arrow, He shot his head off. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਚ ਕਾ ਪੰਥਾ ਥਾਟਿਓ ॥
transliteration: kaal jaal jam johi na saakai sach kaa pa(n)thaa thaatio ||
english: Death, and the noose of death, cannot see me; I have adopted the Path of Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਿਖੁਟਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khaat kharachat kichh nikhutat naahee raam ratan dhan khaatio ||1||
english: I have earned the wealth, the jewel of the Lord's Name; eating and spending, it is never used up. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਸਮਾ ਭੂਤ ਹੋਆ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhasamaa bhoot hoaa khin bheetar apanaa keeaa paaiaa ||
english: In an instant, the slanderer was reduced to ashes; he received the rewards of his own actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਮ ਨਿਗਮੁ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੧॥
transliteration: aagam nigam kahai jan naanak sabh dekhai lok sabaaiaa ||2||6||11||
english: Servant Nanak speaks the truth of the scriptures; the whole world is witness to it. ||2||6||11||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: todee mah 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਨ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਭਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kirapan tan man kilavikh bhare ||
english: O miser, your body and mind are full of sin.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਢਾਕਨ ਕਉ ਇਕੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g bhajan kar suaamee dhaakan kau ik hare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, vibrate, meditate on the Lord and Master; He alone can cover your sins. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਕੇ ਛੁਟਕਤ ਥਾਮ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: anik chhidr bohith ke chhutakat thaam na jaahee kare ||
english: When many holes appear in your boat, you cannot plug them with your hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਖੋਟੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis kaa bohith tis aaraadhe khote sa(n)g khare ||1||
english: Worship and adore the One, to whom your boat belongs; He saves the counterfeit along with the genuine. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਲੀ ਸੈਲ ਉਠਾਵਤ ਚਾਹੈ ਓਇ ਊਹਾ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਧਰੇ ॥
transliteration: galee sail uthaavat chaahai oi oohaa hee hai dhare ||
english: People want to lift up the mountain with mere words, but it just stays there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਰੁ ਸਕਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨॥
transliteration: jor sakat naanak kichh naahee prabh raakhahu saran pare ||2||7||12||
english: Nanak has no strength or power at all; O God, please protect me - I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||7||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
transliteration: har ke charan kamal man dhiaau ||
english: Meditate on the lotus feet of the Lord within your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਪਿਤ ਬਾਤ ਹੰਤਾ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaadh kuthaar pit baat ha(n)taa aukhadh har ko naau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the medicine; it is like an axe, which destroys the diseases caused by anger and egotism. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨੇ ਤਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਦੁਖ ਹੰਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: teene taap nivaaranahaaraa dukh ha(n)taa sukh raas ||
english: The Lord is the One who removes the three fevers; He is the Destroyer of pain, the warehouse of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa kau bighan na kooo laagai jaa kee prabh aagai aradaas ||1||
english: No obstacles block the path of one who prays before God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਬੈਦ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad baid naaraain karan kaaran prabh ek ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, the Lord has become my physician; God alone is the Doer, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੩॥
transliteration: baal budh pooran sukhadaataa naanak har har tek ||2||8||13||
english: He is the Giver of perfect peace to the innocent-minded people; O Nanak, the Lord, Har, Har, is my support. ||2||8||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: har har naam sadaa sad jaap ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਸਦੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhaar anugrahu paarabraham suaamee vasadee keenee aap ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Showering His Kind Mercy, the Supreme Lord God Himself has blessed the town. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: jis ke se phir tin hee samhaale binase sog sa(n)taap ||
english: The One who owns me, has again taken care of me; my sorrow and suffering is past.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਏ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haath dei raakhe jan apane har hoe maaee baap ||1||
english: He gave me His hand, and saved me, His humble servant; the Lord is my mother and father. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਹੋਏ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਦਯਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t hoe miharavaanaa dayaa dhaaree har naath ||
english: All beings and creatures have become kind to me; my Lord and Master blessed me with His Kind Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak saran pare dukh bha(n)jan jaa kaa bad parataap ||2||9||14||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Destroyer of pain; His glory is so great! ||2||9||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: svaamee saran pario darabaare ||
english: O Lord and Master, I seek the Sanctuary of Your Court.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਖੰਡਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot aparaadh kha(n)dan ke daate tujh bin kaun udhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Destroyer of millions of sins, O Great Giver, other than You, who else can save me? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਅਰਥ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat bahu parakaare sarab arath beechaare ||
english: Searching, searching in so many ways, I have contemplated all the objects of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਚਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g param gat paaeeai maaiaa rach ba(n)dh haare ||1||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the supreme state is attained. But those who are engrossed in the bondage of Maya, lose the game of life. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੁਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal sa(n)g preet man laagee sur jan mile piaare ||
english: My mind is in love with the Lord's lotus feet; I have met the Beloved Guru, the noble, heroic being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak anad kare har jap jap sagale rog nivaare ||2||10||15||
english: Nanak celebrates in bliss; chanting and meditating on the Lord, all sickness has been cured. ||2||10||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ghar 3 chaupade ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਂ ਹਾਂ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਰੇ ਮੂੜੑੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: haa(n) haa(n) lapatio re mooRhe kachhoo na thoree ||
english: Oh! Oh! You cling to Maya, you fool; this is not a trivial matter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੋ ਨਹੀ ਸੁ ਜਾਨੀ ਮੋਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tero nahee s jaanee moree || rahaau ||
english: That which you consider to be yours, is not yours. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੋ ਖਿਨੂਆ ॥
transliteration: aapan raam na cheeno khinooaa ||
english: You do not remember your Lord, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪਰਾਈ ਸੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਮਨੂਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo paraaee s apanee manooaa ||1||
english: That which belongs to others, you believe to be your own. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਸੋ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਬਸਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: naam sa(n)gee so man na basaaio ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is always with you, but you do not enshrine it within your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਾਹੂ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chhod jaahi vaahoo chit laaio ||2||
english: You have attached your consciousness to that which you must eventually abandon. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੰਚਿਓ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੂਖ ਤਿਸਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: so sa(n)chio jit bhookh tisaaio ||
english: You collect that which will bring you only hunger and thirst.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੋਸਾ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam tosaa nahee paaio ||3||
english: You have not obtained the supplies of the Ambrosial Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮੋਹ ਕੂਪਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh moh koop pariaa ||
english: You have fallen into the pit of sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੬॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak ko tariaa ||4||1||16||
english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, a rare few are saved. ||4||1||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮਾਰੈ ਏਕੈ ਹਰੀ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: hamaarai ekai haree haree ||
english: I have only the One Lord, my God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਞਾਣਿ ਨ ਕਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aan avar sinjaan na karee || rahaau ||
english: I do not recognize any other. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag gur apunaa paaio ||
english: By great good fortune, I have found my Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur mo kau har naam driRaaio ||1||
english: The Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਨੇਮਾ ॥
transliteration: har har jaap taap brat nemaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my meditation, austerity, fasting and daily religious practice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਕੁਸਲ ਸਭਿ ਖੇਮਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har har dhiaai kusal sabh khemaa ||2||
english: Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, I have found total joy and bliss. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਚਾਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਜਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aachaar biuhaar jaat har guneeaa ||
english: The Praises of the Lord are my good conduct, occupation and social class.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਨੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mahaa ana(n)d keeratan har suneeaa ||3||
english: Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, I am in absolute ecstasy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jin thaakur paaiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, everything comes to the homes

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੭॥
transliteration: sabh kichh tis ke grih mahi aaiaa ||4||2||17||
english: Of those who have found their Lord and Master. ||4||2||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ghar 4 dupade ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂੜੋ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੋ ਲੋੜੈ ॥
transliteration: rooRo man har ra(n)go loRai ||
english: My beautiful mind longs for the Love of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gaalee har neehu na hoi || rahaau ||
english: By mere words, the Lord's Love does not come. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬੀਥੀ ਬੀਥੀ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: hau dhoodhedee darasan kaaran beethee beethee pekhaa ||
english: I have searched for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, looking in each and every street.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur mil bharam gavaaiaa he ||1||
english: Meeting with the Guru, my doubts have been dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੰਨਹੁ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਾਥੈ ॥
transliteration: ih budh paaee mai saadhoo ka(n)nahu lekh likhio dhur maathai ||
english: I have obtained this wisdom from the Holy Saints, according to the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon my forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਇ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੮॥
transliteration: ih bidh naanak har nain aloi ||2||1||18||
english: In this way, Nanak has seen the Lord with his eyes. ||2||1||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹਿਲੜੋ ਮੂੜੜੋ ਹੀਓ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: garab gahilaRo mooRaRo heeo re ||
english: My foolish heart is in the grip of pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੀਓ ਮਹਰਾਜ ਰੀ ਮਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: heeo maharaaj ree maaio ||
english: By the Will of my Lord God, Maya,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡੀਹਰ ਨਿਆਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਫਾਕਿਓ ਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: deehar niaaee mohi phaakio re || rahaau ||
english: Like a witch, has swallowed my soul. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਣੋ ਘਣੋ ਘਣੋ ਸਦ ਲੋੜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਲਹਣੇ ਕੈਠੈ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ghano ghano ghano sad loRai bin lahane kaithai paaio re ||
english: More and more, he continually yearns for more; but unless he is destined to receive, how can he obtain it?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਰਾਜ ਰੋ ਗਾਥੁ ਵਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਲੁਭੜਿਓ ਨਿਹਭਾਗੜੋ ਭਾਹਿ ਸੰਜੋਇਓ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maharaaj ro gaath vaahoo siu lubhaRio nihabhaagaRo bhaahi sa(n)joio re ||1||
english: He is entangled in wealth, bestowed by the Lord God; the unfortunate one attaches himself to the fire of desires. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਸੀਖ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਸਗਲੋ ਥਾਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਛਤ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sun man seekh saadhoo jan sagalo thaare sagale praachhat mitio re ||
english: Listen, O mind, to the Teachings of the Holy Saints, and all your sins shall be totally washed away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਲਹਣੋ ਮਹਰਾਜ ਰੀ ਗਾਠੜੀਓ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ਨ ਪਉੜਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੯॥
transliteration: jaa ko lahano maharaaj ree gaathaReeo jan naanak garabhaas na pauRio re ||2||2||19||
english: One who is destined to receive from the Lord, O servant Nanak, shall not be cast into the womb of reincarnation again. ||2||2||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ghar 5 dupade ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਗੁਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਕੀਨ ॥
transliteration: aiso gun mero prabh jee keen ||
english: Such is the blessing my God has bestowed upon me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਅਰੁ ਅਹੰ ਰੋਗ ਇਹ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch dokh ar aha(n) rog ih tan te sagal door keen || rahaau ||
english: He has totally banished the five evils and the illness of egotism from my body. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰਿ ਛੋਰਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਦੀਨ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan tor chhor bikhiaa te gur ko sabad merai heearai deen ||
english: Breaking my bonds, and releasing me from vice and corruption, He has enshrined the Word of the Guru's Shabad within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨਰੂਪੁ ਮੋਰੋ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਗਹਿਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਭੀਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: roop anaroop moro kachh na beechaario prem gahio mohi har ra(n)g bheen ||1||
english: The Lord has not considered my beauty or ugliness; instead, He has held me with love. I am drenched with His Love. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿਓ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਟ ਬੀਚ ਖੋਏ ਅਨਦ ਚਿਤਾ ਹਰਖੇ ਪਤੀਨ ॥
transliteration: pekhio laalan paat beech khoe anad chitaa harakhe pateen ||
english: I behold my Beloved, now that the curtain has been torn away. My mind is happy, pleased and satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਧੀਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੦॥
transliteration: tis hee ko grihu soee prabh naanak so thaakur tis hee ko dheen ||2||1||20||
english: My house is His; He is my God. Nanak is obedient to His Lord and Master. ||2||1||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: maaee mere man kee preet ||
english: O my mother, my mind is in love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹੀ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜਪ ਏਹੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਰੀਤਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ehee karam dharam jap ehee raam naam niramal hai reet || rahaau ||
english: This is my karma and my Dharma; this is my meditation. The Lord's Name is my immaculate, unstained way of life. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਧਨ ਮੋਰੈ ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: praan adhaar jeevan dhan morai dekhan kau darasan prabh neet ||
english: The Support of my breath of life, the wealth of my life, is to gaze upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਟ ਘਾਟ ਤੋਸਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੋਰੈ ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਖਾ ਕੀਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baat ghaat tosaa sa(n)g morai man apune kau mai har sakhaa keet ||1||
english: On the road, and on the river, these supplies are always with me. I have made my mind the Lord's companion. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਤ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad bhae man niramal kar kirapaa apune kar leet ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, my mind has become immaculate and pure. In His mercy, He has made me His own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੧॥
transliteration: simar simar naanak sukh paaiaa aad jugaad bhagatan ke meet ||2||2||21||
english: Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, Nanak has found peace. From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the friend of His devotees. ||2||2||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: prabh jee mil mere praan ||
english: Dear God, please meet me; You are my breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਮਖ ਹੀਅਰੇ ਤੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਾਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bisar nahee nimakh heeare te apane bhagat kau pooran daan || rahaau ||
english: Do not let me forget You from my heart, even for an instant; please, bless Your devotee with Your gift of perfection. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਵਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥
transliteration: khovahu bharam raakh mere preetam a(n)tarajaamee sughaR sujaan ||
english: Dispel my doubt, and save me, O my Beloved, all-knowing Lord, O Inner-knower, O Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਰਾਜ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kot raaj naam dhan merai a(n)mrit drisat dhaarahu prabh maan ||1||
english: The wealth of the Naam is worth millions of kingdoms to me; O God, please bless me with Your Ambrosial Glance of Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਜਸੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਅਘਾਵਹਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਕਾਨ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar rasanaa gun gaavai jas poor aghaavahi samarath kaan ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises. They totally satisfy my ears, O my all-powerful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੨॥
transliteration: teree saran jeean ke daate sadaa sadaa naanak kurabaan ||2||3||22||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Lord, O Giver of life to the soul; forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||2||3||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਗ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh tere pag kee dhoor ||
english: O God, I am the dust of Your feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal preetam manamohan kar kirapaa meree lochaa poor || rahaau ||
english: O merciful to the meek, Beloved mind-enticing Lord, by Your Kind Mercy, please fulfill my yearning. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਸੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dah dis rav rahiaa jas tumaraa a(n)tarajaamee sadaa hajoor ||
english: In the ten directions, Your Praises are permeating and pervading, O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, O Lord ever-present.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਮਰਤੇ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo tumaraa jas gaavahi karate se jan kabahu na marate jhoor ||1||
english: Those who sing Your Praises, O Creator Lord, those humble beings never die or grieve. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧ ਬੰਧ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਬਿਸੂਰ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dh ba(n)dh binase maaiaa ke saadhoo sa(n)gat mite bisoor ||
english: The worldly affairs and entanglements of Maya disappear, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; all sorrows are taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਭੋਗ ਇਸੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨੇ ਕੂਰ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੩॥
transliteration: sukh sa(n)pat bhog is jee ke bin har naanak jaane koor ||2||4||23||
english: The comforts of wealth and the enjoyments of the soul - O Nanak, without the Lord, know them to be false. ||2||4||23||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: todee mah 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: maaee mere man kee piaas ||
english: O my mother, my mind is so thirsty.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ik khin rahi na sakau bin preetam darasan dekhan kau dhaaree man aas || rahaau ||
english: I cannot survive, even for an instant, without my Beloved. My mind is filled with the desire to behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: simarau naam nira(n)jan karate man tan te sabh kilavikh naas ||
english: I meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the immaculate Creator Lord; all the sins and errors of my mind and body are washed away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pooran paarabraham sukhadaate abinaasee bimal jaa ko jaas ||1||
english: The Perfect Supreme Lord God, the eternal, imperishable Giver of peace - spotless and pure are His Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad mere poor manorath kar kirapaa bhete gunataas ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, my desires have been fulfilled; in His Mercy, the Lord, the treasure of virtue, has met me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੪॥
transliteration: saa(n)t sahaj sookh man upajio kot soor naanak paragaas ||2||5||24||
english: Peace and tranquility, poise and pleasure, have welled up within my mind; millions of suns, O Nanak, illuminate me. ||2||5||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ॥
transliteration: har har patit paavan ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is the Purifier of sinners;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jee praan maan sukhadaataa a(n)tarajaamee man ko bhaavan || rahaau ||
english: He is the soul, the breath of life, the Giver of peace and honor, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He is pleasing to my mind. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਬੇਤਾ ਰਿਦ ਦਾਸ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਭਗਤ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਨ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar sughaR chatur sabh betaa rid daas nivaas bhagat gun gaavan ||
english: He is beautiful and wise, clever and all-knowing. He dwells within the hearts of His slaves; His devotees sing His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮਿ ਬੀਜਨ ਸੋ ਖਾਵਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: niramal roop anoop suaamee karam bhoom beejan so khaavan ||1||
english: His form is immaculate and pure; He is the incomparable Lord and Master. Upon the field of actions and karma, whatever one plants, one eats. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਬੀਓ ਦੂਸਰ ਲਾਵਨ ॥
transliteration: bisaman bisam bhae bisamaadaa aan na beeo doosar laavan ||
english: I am amazed, and wonder-struck by His wonder. There is none other than Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਨ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੫॥
transliteration: rasanaa simar simar jas jeevaa naanak daas sadaa bal jaavan ||2||6||25||
english: Meditating in remembrance on His Praises with my tongue, I live; slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||6||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਛਲੁ ॥
transliteration: maaee maaiaa chhal ||
english: O my mother, Maya is so misleading and deceptive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੇਘ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੜ ਕਾ ਜਲੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: trin kee agan megh kee chhaaiaa gobid bhajan bin haR kaa jal || rahaau ||
english: Without meditating on the Lord of the Universe, it is like straw on fire, or the shadow of a cloud, or the running of the flood-waters. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸਾਧ ਮਗਿ ਚਲੁ ॥
transliteration: chhod siaanap bahu chaturaaee dui kar joR saadh mag chal ||
english: Renounce your cleverness and all your mental tricks; with your palms pressed together, walk on the Path of the Holy Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਊਤਮ ਫਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: simar suaamee a(n)tarajaamee maanukh deh kaa ihu ootam phal ||1||
english: Remember the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; this is the most sublime reward of this human incarnation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਬਖਿਆਨ ਕਰਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਸਮਝਤ ਨਹੀ ਖਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bed bakhiaan karat saadhoo jan bhaagaheen samajhat nahee khal ||
english: The Holy Saints preach the teachings of the Vedas, but the unfortunate fools do not understand them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਚੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦਹਨ ਭਏ ਮਲ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੬॥
transliteration: prem bhagat raache jan naanak har simaran dahan bhae mal ||2||7||26||
english: Servant Nanak is absorbed in loving devotional worship; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's dirt is burnt away. ||2||7||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਚਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠੇ ॥
transliteration: maaee charan gur meethe ||
english: O mother, the Guru's feet are so sweet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਫਲਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਗੁਰ ਡੀਠੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag devai paramesar kot phalaa darasan gur deethe || rahaau ||
english: By great good fortune, the Transcendent Lord has blessed me with them. Millions of rewards come from the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਦ ਢੀਠੇ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavat achut abinaasee kaam krodh binase mad dheethe ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the imperishable, indestructible Lord, sexual desire, anger and stubborn pride vanish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਭਏ ਸਾਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਬਾਹੁਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਪੀਠੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: asathir bhae saach ra(n)g raate janam maran baahur nahee peethe ||1||
english: Those who are imbued with the Love of the True Lord become permanent and eternal; birth and death do not grind them down any more. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਜੇਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਜਾਨੇ ਸਭਿ ਝੂਠੇ ॥
transliteration: bin har bhajan ra(n)g ras jete sa(n)t daiaal jaane sabh jhoothe ||
english: Without the Lord's meditation, all joys and pleasures are totally false and worthless; by the Kind Mercy of the Saints, I know this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਚਲੇ ਸਭਿ ਮੂਠੇ ॥੨॥੮॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naam ratan paaio jan naanak naam bihoon chale sabh moothe ||2||8||27||
english: Servant Nanak has found the jewel of the Naam; without the Naam, all must depart, cheated and plundered. ||2||8||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har har naam chitaaraa ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਭਲੋ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sahaj ana(n)d hovai din raatee a(n)kur bhalo hamaaraa || rahaau ||
english: I am in peaceful poise and bliss, day and night; the seed of my destiny has sprouted. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa bhetio badabhaagee jaa ko a(n)t na paaraavaaraa ||
english: I have met the True Guru, by great good fortune; He has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਓ ਜਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar gahi kaadh leeo jan apunaa bikh saagar sa(n)saaraa ||1||
english: Taking His humble servant by the hand, He pulls him out of the poisonous world-ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਸੰਕਟ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: janam maran kaate gur bachanee bahuR na sa(n)kat duaaraa ||
english: Birth and death are ended for me, by the Word of the Guru's Teachings; I shall no longer pass through the door of pain and suffering.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੮॥
transliteration: naanak saran gahee suaamee kee punah punah namasakaaraa ||2||9||28||
english: Nanak holds tight to the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master; again and again, he bows in humility and reverence to Him. ||2||9||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਸੁਖੁ ॥
transliteration: maaee mere man ko sukh ||
english: O my mother, my mind is at peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੁਗਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਭ ਦੁਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot ana(n)d raaj sukh bhugavai har simarat binasai sabh dukh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I enjoy the ecstasy of millions of princely pleasures; remembering the Lord in meditation, all pains have been dispelled. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਸੁਖ ॥
transliteration: kot janam ke kilabikh naasahi simarat paavan tan man sukh ||
english: The sins of millions of lifetimes are erased, by meditating on the Lord; becoming pure, my mind and body have found peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਭਈ ਆਸਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਉਤਰੀ ਭੁਖ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dekh saroop pooran bhaee aasaa darasan bhetat utaree bhukh ||1||
english: Gazing upon the Lord's form of perfect beauty, my hopes have been fulfilled; attaining the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my hunger has been appeased. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਮਹਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਪਾਰਜਾਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੁਖੁ ॥
transliteration: chaar padaarath asat mahaa sidh kaamadhen paarajaat har har rukh ||
english: The four great blessings, the eight supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, the wish-fulfilling Elysian cow, and the wish-fulfilling tree of life - all these come from the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਭ ਨ ਧੁਖੁ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੨੯॥
transliteration: naanak saran gahee sukh saagar janam maran phir garabh na dhukh ||2||10||29||
english: O Nanak, holding tight to the Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of peace, you shall not suffer the pains of birth and death, or fall into the womb of reincarnation again. ||2||10||29||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har charan ridai ur dhaare ||
english: I have enshrined the Lord's Feet within my heart.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਫਲ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: simar suaamee satigur apunaa kaaraj saphal hamaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Contemplating my Lord and Master, my True Guru, all my affairs have been resolved. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: pu(n)n daan poojaa paramesur har keerat tat beechaare ||
english: The merits of giving donations to charity and devotional worship come from the Kirtan of the Praises of the Transcendent Lord; this is the true essence of wisdom.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਤੁਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gun gaavat atul sukh paaiaa thaakur agam apaare ||1||
english: Singing the Praises of the unapproachable, infinite Lord and Master, I have found immeasurable peace. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਬਾਹੁਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jo jan paarabraham apane keene tin kaa baahur kachh na beechaare ||
english: The Supreme Lord God does not consider the merits and demerits of those humble beings whom He makes His own.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਠ ਮਝਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੦॥
transliteration: naam ratan sun jap jap jeevaa har naanak ka(n)th majhaare ||2||11||30||
english: Hearing, chanting and meditating on the jewel of the Naam, I live; Nanak wears the Lord as his necklace. ||2||11||30||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: todee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Todee, Ninth Mehl:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਉ ਕਹਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਅਧਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahau kahaa apanee adhamaaee ||
english: What can I say about my base nature?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿਓ ਕਨਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਕੇ ਰਸ ਨਹ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: urajhio kanak kaamanee ke ras nah keerat prabh gaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am entangled in the love of gold and women, and I have not sung the Kirtan of God's Praises. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਜਾਨਿ ਕੈ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਉਪਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jag jhoothe kau saach jaan kai taa siu ruch upajaaee ||
english: I judge the false world to be true, and I have fallen in love with it.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਹੋਤ ਜੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: deen ba(n)dh simario nahee kabahoo hot j sa(n)g sahaaee ||1||
english: I have never contemplated the friend of the poor, who shall be my companion and helper in the end. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਗਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਨਿਸ ਦਿਨਿ ਛੁਟੀ ਨ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: magan rahio maaiaa mai nis din chhutee na man kee kaaee ||
english: I remain intoxicated by Maya, night and day, and the filth of my mind will not depart.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਬ ਨਾਹਿ ਅਨਤ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
transliteration: kahi naanak ab naahi anat gat bin har kee saranaaee ||2||1||31||
english: Says Nanak, now, without the Lord's Sanctuary, I cannot find salvation in any other way. ||2||1||31||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਟੋਡੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: todee baanee bhagataa(n) kee ||
english: Todee, The Word Of The Devotees:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਿਰਵਾ ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: koee bolai niravaa koee bolai door ||
english: Some say that He is near, and others say that He is far away.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਚਰੈ ਖਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jal kee maachhulee charai khajoor ||1||
english: We might just as well say that the fish climbs out of the water, up the tree. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਇ ਰੇ ਬਕਬਾਦੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kaa(n)i re bakabaad laaio ||
english: Why do you speak such nonsense?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਛਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin har paaio tinahi chhapaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who has found the Lord, keeps quiet about it. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit hoi kai bed bakhaanai ||
english: Those who become Pandits, religious scholars, recite the Vedas,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: moorakh naamadeu raamahi jaanai ||2||1||
english: but foolish Naam Dayv knows only the Lord. ||2||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨ ਕੋ ਕਲੰਕੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਤ ਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kaun ko kala(n)k rahio raam naam let hee ||
english: Whose blemishes remain, when one chants the Lord's Name?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਭਏ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਤ ਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: patit pavit bhae raam kahat hee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Sinners become pure, chanting the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਗਿਆ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: raam sa(n)g naamadev jan kau pratagiaa aaee ||
english: With the Lord, servant Naam Dayv has come to have faith.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਈਁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ekaadasee brat rahai kaahe kau teerath jaaee(n) ||1||
english: I have stopped fasting on the eleventh day of each month; why should I bother to go on pilgrimages to sacred shrines? ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: bhanat naamadeu sukrit sumat bhae ||
english: Prays Naam Dayv, I have become a man of good deeds and good thoughts.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਗਏ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: guramat raam kahi ko ko na baiku(n)th gae ||2||2||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instructions, who has not gone to heaven? ||2||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਛੰਦੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਛੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teen chha(n)de khel aachhai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Here is a verse with a three-fold play on words. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਭਾਰ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਹਾਂਡੀ ਆਛੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਸਾਂਡੀ ਗੋ ॥
transliteration: ku(n)bhaar ke ghar haa(n)dee aachhai raajaa ke ghar saa(n)dee go ||
english: In the potter's home there are pots, and in the king's home there are camels.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਾਮਨ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਰਾਂਡੀ ਆਛੈ ਰਾਂਡੀ ਸਾਂਡੀ ਹਾਂਡੀ ਗੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baaman ke ghar raa(n)dee aachhai raa(n)dee saa(n)dee haa(n)dee go ||1||
english: In the Brahmin's home there are widows. So here they are: haandee, saandee, raandee. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀਏ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਹੀਂਗੁ ਆਛੈ ਭੈਸਰ ਮਾਥੈ ਸੀਂਗੁ ਗੋ ॥
transliteration: baaneee ke ghar hee(n)g aachhai bhaisar maathai see(n)g go ||
english: In the home of the grocer there is asafoetida; on the forehead of the buffalo there are horns.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਲ ਮਧੇ ਲੀਗੁ ਆਛੈ ਲੀਗੁ ਸੀਗੁ ਹੀਗੁ ਗੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: deval madhe leeg aachhai leeg seeg heeg go ||2||
english: In the temple of Shiva there are lingams. So here they are: heeng, seeng, leeng. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤੇਲੀ ਕੈ ਘਰ ਤੇਲੁ ਆਛੈ ਜੰਗਲ ਮਧੇ ਬੇਲ ਗੋ ॥
transliteration: telee kai ghar tel aachhai ja(n)gal madhe bel go ||
english: In the house of the oil-presser there is oil; in the forest there are vines.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਕੇਲ ਆਛੈ ਕੇਲ ਬੇਲ ਤੇਲ ਗੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maalee ke ghar kel aachhai kel bel tel go ||3||
english: In the gardener's home there are bananas. So here they are: tayl, bayl, kayl. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਮਧੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਆਛੈ ਗੋਕਲ ਮਧੇ ਸਿਆਮ ਗੋ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa(n) madhe gobi(n)d aachhai gokal madhe siaam go ||
english: The Lord of the Universe, Govind, is within His Saints; Krishna, Shyaam, is in Gokal.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਮਧੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਆਛੈ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਆਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naame madhe raam aachhai raam siaam gobi(n)d go ||4||3||
english: The Lord, Raam, is in Naam Dayv. So here they are: Raam, Shyaam, Govind. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: raag bairaaRee mahalaa 4 ghar 1 dupade ||
english: Raag Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl, First House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sun man akath kathaa har naam ||
english: Listen, O mind, to the Unspoken Speech of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਭਜੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ridh budh sidh sukh paavahi bhaj guramat har raam raam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Riches, wisdom, supernatural spiritual powers and peace are obtained, by vibrating, meditating on the Lord God, under Guru's Instruction. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਖਿਆਨ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: naanaa khiaan puraan jas ootam khat darasan gaavahi raam ||
english: Numerous legends, the Puraanas, and the six Shaastras, sing the sublime Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਕਰ ਕ੍ਰੋੜਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਮਰਮਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)kar kroR tetees dhiaaio nahee jaanio har maramaam ||1||
english: Shiva and the three hundred thirty million gods meditate on the Lord, but they do not know the secret of His mystery. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਭ ਗਾਵਤ ਜੇਤ ਉਪਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sur nar gan ga(n)dhrab jas gaavahi sabh gaavat jet upaam ||
english: The angelic and divine beings, and the celestial singers sing His Praises; all Creation sings of Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kripaa karee har jin kau te sa(n)t bhale har raam ||2||1||
english: O Nanak, those whom the Lord blesses with His Kind Mercy, become the good Saints of the Lord God. ||2||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bairaaRee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: man mil sa(n)t janaa jas gaaio ||
english: O mind, those who meet the Lord's humble servants, sing His Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਕੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har ratan ratan har neeko gur satigur daan divaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
