english: They are blessed with the gift of the jewel of the Lord, Har, Har, the sublime jewel of the Lord, by the Guru, the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: tis jan kau man tan sabh devau jin har har naam sunaaio ||
english: I offer my mind, body and everything to that humble being who recites the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਪੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhan maaiaa sa(n)pai tis devau jin har meet milaaio ||1||
english: I offer my wealth, the riches of Maya and my property to that one who leads me to meet the Lord, my friend. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਕਿੰਚਿਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸਰਿ ਤਬ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: khin ki(n)chit kripaa karee jagadeesar tab har har har jas dhiaaio ||
english: When the Lord of the world bestowed just a tiny bit of His Mercy, for just an instant, then I meditated on the Praise of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau har bhete suaamee dukh haumai rog gavaaio ||2||2||
english: The Lord and Master has met servant Nanak, and the pain of the sickness of egotism has been eliminated. ||2||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bairaaRee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har jan raam naam gun gaavai ||
english: The Lord's humble servant sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਨ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: je koee ni(n)d kare har jan kee apunaa gun na gavaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Even if someone slanders the Lord's humble servant, he does not give up his own goodness. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh kare s aape suaamee har aape kaar kamaavai ||
english: Whatever the Lord and Master does, He does by Himself; the Lord Himself does the deeds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har aape hee mat devai suaamee har aape bol bulaavai ||1||
english: The Lord and Master Himself imparts understanding; the Lord Himself inspires us to speak. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਾਤੂ ਪੰਚ ਆਪਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har aape pa(n)ch tat bisathaaraa vich dhaatoo pa(n)ch aap paavai ||
english: The Lord Himself directs the evolution of the world of the five elements; He Himself infuses the five senses into it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਝਗਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak satigur mele aape har aape jhagar chukaavai ||2||3||
english: O servant Nanak, the Lord Himself unites us with the True Guru; He Himself resolves the conflicts. ||2||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bairaaRee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jap man raam naam nisataaraa ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, O mind, and you shall be emancipated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot kota(n)tar ke paap sabh khovai har bhavajal paar utaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord shall destroy all the sins of millions upon millions of incarnations, and carry you across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਬਸਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa nagar basat har suaamee har nirabhau niravair nira(n)kaaraa ||
english: In the body-village, the Lord Master abides; the Lord is without fear, without vengeance, and without form.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸਤ ਕਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਧਾ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har nikat basat kachh nadar na aavai har laadhaa gur veechaaraa ||1||
english: The Lord is dwelling near at hand, but He cannot be seen. By the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har aape saahu saraaph ratan heeraa har aap keeaa paasaaraa ||
english: The Lord Himself is the banker, the jeweller, the jewel, the gem; the Lord Himself created the entire expanse of the creation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ ਸੋ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak jis kripaa kare s har naam vihaajhe so saahu sachaa vanajaaraa ||2||4||
english: O Nanak, one who is blessed by the Lord's Kind Mercy, trades in the Lord's Name; He alone is the true banker, the true trader. ||2||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bairaaRee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jap man har nira(n)jan nira(n)kaaraa ||
english: Meditate, O mind, on the immaculate, formless Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa har dhiaaeeai sukhadaataa jaa kaa a(n)t na paaraavaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Forever and ever, meditate on the Lord, the Giver of peace; He has no end or limitation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਦਰ ਮੰਝਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: agan ku(n)t mahi uradh liv laagaa har raakhai udar ma(n)jhaaraa ||
english: In the fiery pit of the womb, when you were hanging upside-down, the Lord absorbed You in His Love, and preserved You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so aisaa har sevahu mere man har a(n)t chhadaavanahaaraa ||1||
english: So serve such a Lord, O my mind; the Lord shall deliver you in the end. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai hiradai basiaa meraa har har tis jan kau karahu namasakaaraa ||
english: Bow down in reverence to that humble being, within whose heart the Lord, Har, Har, abides.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: har kirapaa te paaeeai har jap naanak naam adhaaraa ||2||5||
english: By the Lord's Kind Mercy, O Nanak, one obtains the Lord's meditation, and the support of the Naam. ||2||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bairaaRee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jap man har har naam nit dhiaai ||
english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; meditate on it continually.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo ichhahi soee phal paavahi phir dookh na laagai aai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall obtain the fruits of your heart's desires, and pain shall never touch you again. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਪੁ ਸੋ ਤਪੁ ਸਾ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: so jap so tap saa brat poojaa jit har siu preet lagaai ||
english: That is chanting, that is deep meditation and austerity, that is fasting and worship, which inspires love for the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੋਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਭ ਝੂਠੀ ਇਕ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin har preet hor preet sabh jhoothee ik khin mahi bisar sabh jaai ||1||
english: Without the Lord's Love, every other love is false; in an instant, it is all forgotten. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਸਰਬ ਕਲ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: too bea(n)t sarab kal pooraa kichh keemat kahee na jaai ||
english: You are infinite, the Master of all power; Your value cannot be described at all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak saran tumhaaree har jeeu bhaavai tivai chhadaai ||2||6||
english: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, O Dear Lord; as it pleases You, save him. ||2||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag bairaaRee mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Bairaaree, Fifth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil har jas gaaio ||
english: Meeting with the humble Saints, sing the Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot janam ke dookh gavaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The pains of millions of incarnations shall be eradicated. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਸੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: jo chaahat soee man paaio ||
english: Whatever your mind desires, that you shall obtain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa har naam divaaio ||1||
english: By His Kind Mercy, the Lord blesses us with His Name. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sarab sookh har naam vadaaee ||
english: All happiness and greatness are in the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak mat paaee ||2||1||7||
english: By Guru's Grace, Nanak has gained this understanding. ||2||1||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag tila(n)g mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Tilang, First Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਯਕ ਅਰਜ ਗੁਫਤਮ ਪੇਸਿ ਤੋ ਦਰ ਗੋਸ ਕੁਨ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: yak araj guphatam pes to dar gos kun karataar ||
english: I offer this one prayer to You; please listen to it, O Creator Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਕਾ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਰੀਮ ਤੂ ਬੇਐਬ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hakaa kabeer kareem too beaib paravadagaar ||1||
english: You are true, great, merciful and spotless, O Cherisher Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਮੁਕਾਮੇ ਫਾਨੀ ਤਹਕੀਕ ਦਿਲ ਦਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: duneeaa mukaame phaanee tahakeek dil daanee ||
english: The world is a transitory place of mortality - know this for certain in your mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਮ ਸਰ ਮੂਇ ਅਜਰਾਈਲ ਗਿਰਫਤਹ ਦਿਲ ਹੇਚਿ ਨ ਦਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mam sar mooi ajaraaeel giraphatah dil hech na daanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death, has caught me by the hair on my head, and yet, I do not know it at all in my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਪਿਸਰ ਪਦਰ ਬਿਰਾਦਰਾਂ ਕਸ ਨੇਸ ਦਸਤੰਗੀਰ ॥
transliteration: jan pisar padar biraadaraa(n) kas nes dasata(n)geer ||
english: Spouse, children, parents and siblings - none of them will be there to hold your hand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਿਰ ਬਿਅਫਤਮ ਕਸ ਨ ਦਾਰਦ ਚੂੰ ਸਵਦ ਤਕਬੀਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aakhir biaphatam kas na daarad choo(n) savad takabeer ||2||
english: And when at last I fall, and the time of my last prayer has come, there shall be no one to rescue me. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬ ਰੋਜ ਗਸਤਮ ਦਰ ਹਵਾ ਕਰਦੇਮ ਬਦੀ ਖਿਆਲ ॥
transliteration: sab roj gasatam dar havaa karadem badee khiaal ||
english: Night and day, I wandered around in greed, contemplating evil schemes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਹੇ ਨ ਨੇਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਮ ਮਮ ਈਁ ਚਿਨੀ ਅਹਵਾਲ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gaahe na nekee kaar karadam mam ee(n) chinee ahavaal ||3||
english: I never did good deeds; this is my condition. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਦਬਖਤ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਬਖੀਲ ਗਾਫਿਲ ਬੇਨਜਰ ਬੇਬਾਕ ॥
transliteration: badabakhat ham ch bakheel gaaphil benajar bebaak ||
english: I am unfortunate, miserly, negligent, shameless and without the Fear of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੁਗੋਯਦ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਰਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਾਕਰਾਂ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bugoyad jan turaa tere chaakaraa(n) paa khaak ||4||1||
english: Says Nanak, I am Your humble servant, the dust of the feet of Your slaves. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
english: Tilang, First Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਂਗ ਖਲੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: bhau teraa bhaa(n)g khalaRee meraa cheet ||
english: The Fear of You, O Lord God, is my marijuana; my consciousness is the pouch which holds it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਅਤੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: mai devaanaa bhaiaa ateet ||
english: I have become an intoxicated hermit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਕਾਸਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ॥
transliteration: kar kaasaa darasan kee bhookh ||
english: My hands are my begging bowl; I am so hungry for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mai dar maagau neetaa neet ||1||
english: I beg at Your Door, day after day. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਉ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tau darasan kee karau samaai ||
english: I long for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਗਤੁ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mai dar maagat bheekhiaa paai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a beggar at Your Door - please bless me with Your charity. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਸਰਿ ਕੁਸਮ ਮਿਰਗਮੈ ਹਰਣਾ ਸਰਬ ਸਰੀਰੀ ਚੜੑਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kesar kusam miragamai haranaa sarab sareeree chaRhnaa ||
english: Saffron, flowers, musk oil and gold embellish the bodies of all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਭਗਤਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਇਨੇਹੀ ਸਰਬੇ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: cha(n)dan bhagataa jot inehee sarabe paramal karanaa ||2||
english: The Lord's devotees are like sandalwood, which imparts its fragrance to everyone. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਿਅ ਪਟ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ghi pat bhaa(n)daa kahai na koi ||
english: No one says that ghee or silk are polluted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਵਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa bhagat varan mahi hoi ||
english: Such is the Lord's devotee, no matter what his social status is.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵੇ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: terai naam nive rahe liv laai ||
english: Those who bow in reverence to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, remain absorbed in Your Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak tin dar bheekhiaa paai ||3||1||2||
english: Nanak begs for charity at their door. ||3||1||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 1 ghar 3 ||
english: Tilang, First Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਹਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਲੀਤੜਾ ਲਬਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ihu tan maaiaa paahiaa piaare leetaRaa lab ra(n)gaae ||
english: This body fabric is conditioned by Maya, O beloved; this cloth is dyed in greed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਚੋਲੜਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਧਨ ਸੇਜੈ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: merai ka(n)t na bhaavai cholaRaa piaare kiu dhan sejai jaae ||1||
english: My Husband Lord is not pleased by these clothes, O Beloved; how can the soul-bride go to His bed? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)u kurabaanai jaau miharavaanaa ha(n)u kurabaanai jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice, O Dear Merciful Lord; I am a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਲੈਨਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)u kurabaanai jaau tinaa kai lain jo teraa naau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who take to Your Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੈਨਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਹੰਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: lain jo teraa naau tinaa kai ha(n)u sad kurabaanai jaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Unto those who take to Your Name, I am forever a sacrifice. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਰੰਙਣਿ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਉ ਮਜੀਠ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa ra(n)ngan je theeai piaare paaeeai naau majeeth ||
english: If the body becomes the dyer's vat, O Beloved, and the Name is placed within it as the dye,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਙਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਜੇ ਰੰਙੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਐਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਡੀਠ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ra(n)ngan vaalaa je ra(n)ngai saahib aisaa ra(n)g na deeth ||2||
english: and if the Dyer who dyes this cloth is the Lord Master - O, such a color has never been seen before! ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਚੋਲੇ ਰਤੜੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੰਤੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jin ke chole rataRe piaare ka(n)t tinaa kai paas ||
english: Those whose shawls are so dyed, O Beloved, their Husband Lord is always with them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੀ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੀ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhooR tinaa kee je milai jee kahu naanak kee aradaas ||3||
english: Bless me with the dust of those humble beings, O Dear Lord. Says Nanak, this is my prayer. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aape saaje aape ra(n)ge aape nadar karei ||
english: He Himself creates, and He Himself imbues us. He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੰਤੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਾਵੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak kaaman ka(n)tai bhaavai aape hee raavei ||4||1||3||
english: O Nanak, if the soul-bride becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord, He Himself enjoys her. ||4||1||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g mah 1 ||
english: Tilang, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਆਨੜੀਏ ਮਾਨੜਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: iaanaReee maanaRaa kaai karehi ||
english: O foolish and ignorant soul-bride, why are you so proud?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੋ ਕੀ ਨ ਮਾਣੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aapanaRai ghar har ra(n)go kee na maanehi ||
english: Within the home of your own self, why do you not enjoy the Love of your Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਧਨ ਕੰਮਲੀਏ ਬਾਹਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਢੂਢੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sahu neRai dhan ka(n)maleee baahar kiaa dhoodhehi ||
english: Your Husband Lord is so very near, O foolish bride; why do you search for Him outside?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਕੀਆ ਦੇਹਿ ਸਲਾਈਆ ਨੈਣੀ ਭਾਵ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: bhai keeaa dehi salaaeeaa nainee bhaav kaa kar seegaaro ||
english: Apply the Fear of God as the maascara to adorn your eyes, and make the Love of the Lord your ornament.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਲਾਗੀ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa sohaagan jaaneeai laagee jaa sahu dhare piaaro ||1||
english: Then, you shall be known as a devoted and committed soul-bride, when you enshrine love for your Husband Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਆਣੀ ਬਾਲੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: iaanee baalee kiaa kare jaa dhan ka(n)t na bhaavai ||
english: What can the silly young bride do, if she is not pleasing to her Husband Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: karan palaah kare bahutere saa dhan mahal na paavai ||
english: She may plead and implore so many times, but still, such a bride shall not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: vin karamaa kichh paaeeai naahee je bahuteraa dhaavai ||
english: Without the karma of good deeds, nothing is obtained, although she may run around frantically.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਬ ਲੋਭ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਕੀ ਮਾਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: lab lobh aha(n)kaar kee maatee maaiaa maahi samaanee ||
english: She is intoxicated with greed, pride and egotism, and engrossed in Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਨੀ ਬਾਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਇਆਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: inee baatee sahu paaeeai naahee bhaee kaaman iaanee ||2||
english: She cannot obtain her Husband Lord in these ways; the young bride is so foolish! ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਵਾਹੈ ਕਿਨੀ ਬਾਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jaai puchhahu sohaaganee vaahai kinee baatee sahu paaeeai ||
english: Go and ask the happy, pure soul-brides, how did they obtain their Husband Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh kare so bhalaa kar maaneeai hikamat hukam chukaaeeai ||
english: Whatever the Lord does, accept that as good; do away with your own cleverness and self-will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਉ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai prem padaarath paaeeai tau charanee chit laaeeai ||
english: By His Love, true wealth is obtained; link your consciousness to His lotus feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੋ ਦੀਜੈ ਐਸਾ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sahu kahai so keejai tan mano deejai aisaa paramal laaeeai ||
english: As your Husband Lord directs, so you must act; surrender your body and mind to Him, and apply this perfume to yourself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਵ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭੈਣੇ ਇਨੀ ਬਾਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ev kahahi sohaaganee bhaine inee baatee sahu paaeeai ||3||
english: So speaks the happy soul-bride, O sister; in this way, the Husband Lord is obtained. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਉਰੁ ਕੈਸੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aap gavaaeeai taa sahu paaeeai aur kaisee chaturaaee ||
english: Give up your selfhood, and so obtain your Husband Lord; what other clever tricks are of any use?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sahu nadar kar dekhai so din lekhai kaaman nau nidh paaee ||
english: When the Husband Lord looks upon the soul-bride with His Gracious Glance, that day is historic - the bride obtains the nine treasures.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਸਭਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aapane ka(n)t piaaree saa sohaagan naanak saa sabharaaee ||
english: She who is loved by her Husband Lord, is the true soul-bride; O Nanak, she is the queen of all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਮਾਤੀ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਾਇ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aisai ra(n)g raatee sahaj kee maatee ahinis bhaai samaanee ||
english: Thus she is imbued with His Love, intoxicated with delight; day and night, she is absorbed in His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਇ ਸਰੂਪ ਬਿਚਖਣਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਾ ਸਿਆਣੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: su(n)dar saai saroop bichakhan kaheeai saa siaanee ||4||2||4||
english: She is beautiful, glorious and brilliant; she is known as truly wise. ||4||2||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 1 ||
english: Tilang, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੈਸੜਾ ਕਰੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
transliteration: jaisee mai aavai khasam kee baanee taisaRaa karee giaan ve laalo ||
english: As the Word of the Forgiving Lord comes to me, so do I express it, O Lalo.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਕੀ ਜੰਞ ਲੈ ਕਾਬਲਹੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਜੋਰੀ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
transliteration: paap kee ja(n)nj lai kaabalahu dhaaiaa joree ma(n)gai daan ve laalo ||
english: Bringing the marriage party of sin, Babar has invaded from Kaabul, demanding our land as his wedding gift, O Lalo.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਇ ਛਪਿ ਖਲੋਏ ਕੂੜੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
transliteration: saram dharam dui chhap khaloe kooR phirai paradhaan ve laalo ||
english: Modesty and righteousness both have vanished, and falsehood struts around like a leader, O Lalo.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀਆ ਬਾਮਣਾ ਕੀ ਗਲ ਥਕੀ ਅਗਦੁ ਪੜੈ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
transliteration: kaajeeaa baamanaa kee gal thakee agad paRai saitaan ve laalo ||
english: The Qazis and the Brahmins have lost their roles, and Satan now conducts the marriage rites, O Lalo.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨੀਆ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਕਸਟ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
transliteration: musalamaaneeaa paRahi katebaa kasat mahi karahi khudaai ve laalo ||
english: The Muslim women read the Koran, and in their misery, they call upon God, O Lalo.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਸਨਾਤੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਹਿਦਵਾਣੀਆ ਏਹਿ ਭੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
transliteration: jaat sanaatee hor hidavaaneeaa ehi bhee lekhai laai ve laalo ||
english: The Hindu women of high social status, and others of lowly status as well, are put into the same category, O Lalo.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੂਨ ਕੇ ਸੋਹਿਲੇ ਗਾਵੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤੁ ਕਾ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਪਾਇ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khoon ke sohile gaaveeahi naanak rat kaa ku(n)goo paai ve laalo ||1||
english: The wedding songs of murder are sung, O Nanak, and blood is sprinkled instead of saffron, O Lalo. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਾਸ ਪੁਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਖੁ ਮਸੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: saahib ke gun naanak gaavai maas puree vich aakh masolaa ||
english: Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord and Master in the city of corpses, and voices this account.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵਾਈ ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਖਿ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jin upaaee ra(n)g ravaaee baithaa vekhai vakh ikelaa ||
english: The One who created, and attached the mortals to pleasures, sits alone, and watches this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰੇਗੁ ਮਸੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa so saahib sach tapaavas sachaRaa niaau kareg masolaa ||
english: The Lord and Master is True, and True is His justice. He issues His Commands according to His judgement.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਪੜੁ ਟੁਕੁ ਟੁਕੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਹਿਦੁਸਤਾਨੁ ਸਮਾਲਸੀ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kapaR tuk tuk hosee hidusataan samaalasee bolaa ||
english: The body-fabric will be torn apart into shreds, and then India will remember these words.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਨਿ ਅਠਤਰੈ ਜਾਨਿ ਸਤਾਨਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਭੀ ਉਠਸੀ ਮਰਦ ਕਾ ਚੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aavan athatarai jaan sataanavai hor bhee uthasee marad kaa chelaa ||
english: Coming in seventy-eight (1521 A.D.), they will depart in ninety-seven (1540 A.D.), and then another disciple of man will rise up.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਸੀ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥੨॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: sach kee baanee naanak aakhai sach sunaaisee sach kee belaa ||2||3||5||
english: Nanak speaks the Word of Truth; he proclaims the Truth at this, the right time. ||2||3||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
english: Tilang, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਆਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਖਸਮਾਹੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਭ ਵਰਤਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh aae hukam khasamaahu hukam sabh varatanee ||
english: Everyone comes by Command of the Lord and Master. The Hukam of His Command extends to all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sach saahib saachaa khel sabh har dhanee ||1||
english: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His play. The Lord is the Master of all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੀ ॥
transliteration: saalaahihu sach sabh oopar har dhanee ||
english: So praise the True Lord; the Lord is the Master over all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਹਉ ਗਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis naahee koi sareek kis lekhai hau ganee || rahaau ||
english: No one is equal to Him; am I of any account? ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਆਕਾਸੁ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਹਰਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
transliteration: paun paanee dharatee aakaas ghar ma(n)dar har banee ||
english: Air, water, earth and sky - the Lord has made these His home and temple.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: vich varatai naanak aap jhooth kahu kiaa ganee ||2||1||
english: He Himself is pervading everywhere, O Nanak. Tell me: what can be counted as false? ||2||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 4 ||
english: Tilang, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਬਫਾਵੈ ਦੁਰਮਤੀਆ ॥
transliteration: nit nihaphal karam kamaai baphaavai duramateeaa ||
english: The evil-minded person continually does fruitless deeds, all puffed up with pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਆਣੈ ਵਲਵੰਚ ਕਰਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਤਬ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਤੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jab aanai valava(n)ch kar jhooth tab jaanai jag jiteeaa ||1||
english: When he brings home what he has acquired, by practicing deception and falsehood, he thinks that he has conquered the world. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਬਾਜੀ ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: aisaa baajee saisaar na chetai har naamaa ||
english: Such is the drama of the world, that he does not contemplate the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ਰਾਮਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi binasai sabh jhooth mere man dhiaai raamaa || rahaau ||
english: In an instant, all this false play shall perish; O my mind, meditate on the Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਇ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਗ੍ਰਸੈ ॥
transliteration: saa velaa chit na aavai jit aai ka(n)tak kaal grasai ||
english: He does not think of that time, when Death, the Torturer, shall come and seize him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: tis naanak lae chhadaai jis kirapaa kar hiradai vasai ||2||2||
english: O Nanak, the Lord saves that one, within whose heart the Lord, in His Kind Mercy, dwells. ||2||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
english: Tilang, Fifth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਕ ਨੂਰ ਕਰਦੰ ਆਲਮ ਦੁਨੀਆਇ ॥
transliteration: khaak noor karada(n) aalam duneeaai ||
english: The Lord infused His Light into the dust, and created the world, the universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਮਾਨ ਜਿਮੀ ਦਰਖਤ ਆਬ ਪੈਦਾਇਸਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: asamaan jimee darakhat aab paidaais khudaai ||1||
english: The sky, the earth, the trees, and the water - all are the Creation of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਦੇ ਚਸਮ ਦੀਦੰ ਫਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)de chasam deeda(n) phanaai ||
english: O human being, whatever you can see with your eyes, shall perish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨਂੀਆ ਮੁਰਦਾਰ ਖੁਰਦਨੀ ਗਾਫਲ ਹਵਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: duna(n)eeaa muradaar khuradanee gaaphal havaai || rahaau ||
english: The world eats dead carcasses, living by neglect and greed. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੈਬਾਨ ਹੈਵਾਨ ਹਰਾਮ ਕੁਸਤਨੀ ਮੁਰਦਾਰ ਬਖੋਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gaibaan haivaan haraam kusatanee muradaar bakhoraai ||
english: Like a goblin, or a beast, they kill and eat the forbidden carcasses of meat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਲ ਕਬਜ ਕਬਜਾ ਕਾਦਰੋ ਦੋਜਕ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dil kabaj kabajaa kaadaro dojak sajaai ||2||
english: So control your urges, or else you will be seized by the Lord, and thrown into the tortures of hell. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਲੀ ਨਿਆਮਤਿ ਬਿਰਾਦਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰ ਮਿਲਕ ਖਾਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: valee niaamat biraadaraa darabaar milak khaanaai ||
english: Your benefactors, presents, companions, courts, lands and homes

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਬਸਤਨੀ ਤਬ ਚਿ ਕਾਰੇ ਬਿਦਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jab ajaraaeel basatanee tab ch kaare bidaai ||3||
english: - when Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death seizes you, what good will these be to you then? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਵਾਲ ਮਾਲੂਮੁ ਕਰਦੰ ਪਾਕ ਅਲਾਹ ॥
transliteration: havaal maaloom karada(n) paak alaah ||
english: The Pure Lord God knows your condition.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਗੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪੇਸਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਬੰਦਾਹ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: bugo naanak aradaas pes daraves ba(n)daah ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, recite your prayer to the holy people. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g ghar 2 mahalaa 5 ||
english: Tilang, Second House, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tudh bin doojaa naahee koi ||
english: There is no other than You, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: too karataar karahi so hoi ||
english: You are the Creator; whatever You do, that alone happens.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: teraa jor teree man tek ||
english: You are the strength, and You are the support of the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa jap naanak ek ||1||
english: Forever and ever, meditate, O Nanak, on the One. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh oopar paarabraham daataar ||
english: The Great Giver is the Supreme Lord God over all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teree tek teraa aadhaar || rahaau ||
english: You are our support, You are our sustainer. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂ ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hai toohai too hovanahaar ||
english: You are, You are, and You shall ever be,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਊਚ ਆਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: agam agaadh ooch aapaar ||
english: O inaccessible, unfathomable, lofty and infinite Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਭਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh sevahi tin bhau dukh naahi ||
english: Those who serve You, are not touched by fear or suffering.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur parasaad naanak gun gaahi ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai so teraa roop ||
english: Whatever is seen, is Your form, O treasure of virtue,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan govi(n)d anoop ||
english: O Lord of the Universe, O Lord of incomparable beauty.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: simar simar simar jan soi ||
english: Remembering, remembering, remembering the Lord in meditation, His humble servant becomes like Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak karam paraapat hoi ||3||
english: O Nanak, by His Grace, we obtain Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jin japiaa tis kau balihaar ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tis kai sa(n)g tarai sa(n)saar ||
english: Associating with them, the whole world is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh lochaa poor ||
english: Says Nanak, God fulfills our hopes and aspirations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਛਉ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee baachhau dhoor ||4||2||
english: I long for the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
english: Tilang, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: miharavaan saahib miharavaan || saahib meraa miharavaan ||
english: Merciful, the Lord Master is Merciful. My Lord Master is Merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਸਗਲ ਕਉ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਨੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jee sagal kau dei daan || rahaau ||
english: He gives His gifts to all beings. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਾਹੇ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਾਖੈਗਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: too kaahe dolahi praaneeaa tudh raakhaigaa sirajanahaar ||
english: Why do you waver, O mortal being? The Creator Lord Himself shall protect you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੈਦਾਇਸਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin paidaais too keeaa soee dei aadhaar ||1||
english: He who created you, will also give you nourishment. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jin upaaee medanee soee karadaa saar ||
english: The One who created the world, takes care of it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਾਲਕੁ ਦਿਲਾ ਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghat ghat maalak dilaa kaa sachaa paravadagaar ||2||
english: In each and every heart and mind, the Lord is the True Cherisher. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਵਡਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kudarat keem na jaaneeai vadaa veparavaahu ||
english: His creative potency and His value cannot be known; He is the Great and carefree Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦੇ ਤੂ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kar ba(n)de too ba(n)dagee jichar ghat mahi saahu ||3||
english: O human being, meditate on the Lord, as long as there is breath in your body. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਅਕਥੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: too samarath akath agochar jeeu pi(n)d teree raas ||
english: O God, You are all-powerful, inexpressible and imperceptible; my soul and body are Your capital.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਹਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: raham teree sukh paaiaa sadaa naanak kee aradaas ||4||3||
english: By Your Mercy, may I find peace; this is Nanak's lasting prayer. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
english: Tilang, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੇ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਮੁਸਤਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: karate kudaratee musataak ||
english: O Creator, through Your creative potency, I am in love with You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਏਕ ਤੂਹੀ ਸਭ ਖਲਕ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਾਕੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: deen duneeaa ek toohee sabh khalak hee te paak || rahaau ||
english: You alone are my spiritual and temporal Lord; and yet, You are detached from all Your creation. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਦਾ ਆਚਰਜ ਤੇਰੇ ਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: khin maahi thaap uthaapadaa aacharaj tere roop ||
english: In an instant, You establish and disestablish. Wondrous is Your form!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਚਲਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੇ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਪ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaun jaanai chalat tere a(n)dhiaare mahi deep ||1||
english: Who can know Your play? You are the Light in the darkness. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੁਦਿ ਖਸਮ ਖਲਕ ਜਹਾਨ ਅਲਹ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khud khasam khalak jahaan alah miharavaan khudaai ||
english: You are the Master of Your creation, the Lord of all the world, O Merciful Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਦੋਜਕਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dinas rain j tudh araadhe so kiu dojak jaai ||2||
english: One who worships You day and night - why should he have to go to hell? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਯਾਰੁ ਬੰਦੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ajaraaeel yaar ba(n)de jis teraa aadhaar ||
english: Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death, is the friend of the human being who has Your support, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨਹ ਉਸ ਕੇ ਸਗਲ ਆਫੂ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gunah us ke sagal aaphoo tere jan dekhahi deedaar ||3||
english: His sins are all forgiven; Your humble servant gazes upon Your Vision. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਚੀਜ ਫਿਲਹਾਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: duneeaa cheej philahaal sagale sach sukh teraa naau ||
english: All worldly considerations are for the present only. True peace comes only from Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਏਕਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: gur mil naanak boojhiaa sadaa ekas gaau ||4||4||
english: Meeting the Guru, Nanak understands; He sings only Your Praises forever, O Lord. ||4||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 5 ||
english: Tilang, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਰਾਂ ਦਾਨਾਂ ਦਿਲ ਸੋਚ ॥
transliteration: meeraa(n) daanaa(n) dil soch ||
english: Think of the Lord in your mind, O wise one.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਬਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਬੰਦੀ ਮੋਚ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: muhabate man tan basai sach saah ba(n)dee moch ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Enshrine love for the True Lord in your mind and body; He is the Liberator from bondage. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਦਨੇ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਮੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: deedane deedaar saahib kachh nahee is kaa mol ||
english: The value of seeing the Vision of the Lord Master cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਕ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰ ਤੂ ਖੁਦਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਡਾ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paak paravadagaar too khud khasam vadaa atol ||1||
english: You are the Pure Cherisher; You Yourself are the great and immeasurable Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ੍ਤਗੀਰੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਿਲਾਵਰ ਤੂਹੀ ਤੂਹੀ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: dastageeree dehi dilaavar toohee toohee ek ||
english: Give me Your help, O brave and generous Lord; You are the One, You are the Only Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਣ ਖਾਲਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: karataar kudarat karan khaalak naanak teree tek ||2||5||
english: O Creator Lord, by Your creative potency, You created the world; Nanak holds tight to Your support. ||2||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
english: Tilang, First Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin keeaa tin dekhiaa kiaa kaheeai re bhaaee ||
english: The One who created the world watches over it; what more can we say, O Siblings of Destiny?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਾੜੀ ਹੈ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape jaanai kare aap jin vaaRee hai laaee ||1||
english: He Himself knows, and He Himself acts; He laid out the garden of the world. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਇਸਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਾ ਰਾਇਸਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raaisaa piaare kaa raaisaa jit sadaa sukh hoee || rahaau ||
english: Savor the story, the story of the Beloved Lord, which brings a lasting peace. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸਾ ਪਛੋ ਰੇ ਤਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jin ra(n)g ka(n)t na raaviaa saa pachho re taanee ||
english: She who does not enjoy the Love of her Husband Lord, shall come to regret and repent in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਪਛੋੜੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਧੁਣੈ ਜਬ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: haath pachhoRai sir dhunai jab rain vihaanee ||2||
english: She wrings her hands, and bangs her head, when the night of her life has passed away. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਛੋਤਾਵਾ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਬ ਚੂਕੈਗੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pachhotaavaa naa milai jab chookaigee saaree ||
english: Nothing comes from repentance, when the game is already finished.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਵੀਐ ਜਬ ਆਵੈਗੀ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa phir piaaraa raaveeai jab aavaigee vaaree ||3||
english: She shall have the opportunity to enjoy her Beloved, only when her turn comes again. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੰਤੁ ਲੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੈ ਤੇ ਵਧਵੀ ਏਹ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)t leeaa sohaaganee mai te vadhavee eh ||
english: The happy soul-bride attains her Husband Lord - she is so much better than I am.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੁਝੈ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਕੈ ਜੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇਹ ॥੪॥
transliteration: se gun mujhai na aavanee kai jee dos dhareh ||4||
english: I have none of her merits or virtues; whom should I blame? ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਉਗੀ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jinee sakhee sahu raaviaa tin poochhaugee jaae ||
english: I shall go and ask those sisters who have enjoyed their Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਉ ਲੇਉਗੀ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: paai lagau benatee karau leugee pa(n)th bataae ||5||
english: I touch their feet, and ask them to show me the Path. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਉ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hukam pachhaanai naanakaa bhau cha(n)dan laavai ||
english: She who understands the Hukam of His Command, O Nanak, applies the Fear of God as her sandalwood oil;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਰੈ ਤਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gun kaaman kaaman karai tau piaare kau paavai ||6||
english: she charms her Beloved with her virtue, and so obtains Him. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਰੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jo dil miliaa s mil rahiaa miliaa kaheeai re soee ||
english: She who meets her Beloved in her heart, remains united with Him; this is truly called union.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਬਾਤੀ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: je bahuteraa locheeai baatee mel na hoee ||7||
english: As much as she may long for Him, she shall not meet Him through mere words. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਾਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਿਵੈ ਕਉ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dhaat milai phun dhaat kau liv livai kau dhaavai ||
english: As metal melts into metal again, so does love melt into love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਤਉ ਅਨਭਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee jaaneeai tau anabhau paavai ||8||
english: By Guru's Grace, this understanding is obtained, and then, one obtains the Fearless Lord. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਨਾ ਵਾੜੀ ਹੋਇ ਘਰਿ ਖਰੁ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: paanaa vaaRee hoi ghar khar saar na jaanai ||
english: There may be an orchard of betel nut trees in the garden, but the donkey does not appreciate its value.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸੀਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਸਕ ਕਾ ਤਬ ਫੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੯॥
transliteration: raseeaa hovai musak kaa tab phool pachhaanai ||9||
english: If someone savors a fragrance, then he can truly appreciate its flower. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: apiu peevai jo naanakaa bhram bhram samaavai ||
english: One who drinks in the ambrosia, O Nanak, abandons his doubts and wanderings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
transliteration: sahaje sahaje mil rahai amaraa pad paavai ||10||1||
english: Easily and intuitively, he remains blended with the Lord, and obtains the immortal status. ||10||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 4 ||
english: Tilang, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੀਤਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: har keeaa kathaa kahaaneeaa gur meet sunaaeeaa ||
english: The Guru, my friend, has told me the stories and the sermon of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane gur kau bal jaaeeaa ||1||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; to the Guru, I am a sacrifice. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aai mil gurasikh aai mil too mere guroo ke piaare || rahaau ||
english: Come, join with me, O Sikh of the Guru, come and join with me. You are my Guru's Beloved. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਸੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har ke gun har bhaavade se guroo te paae ||
english: The Glorious Praises of the Lord are pleasing to the Lord; I have obtained them from the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਘੁਮਿ ਘੁਮਿ ਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin gur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)niaa tin ghum ghum jaae ||2||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who surrender to, and obey the Guru's Will. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jin satigur piaaraa dekhiaa tin kau hau vaaree ||
english: I am dedicated and devoted to those who gaze upon the Beloved True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin gur kee keetee chaakaree tin sad balihaaree ||3||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who perform service for the Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har har teraa naam hai dukh metanahaaraa ||
english: Your Name, O Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of sorrow.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te paaeeai guramukh nisataaraa ||4||
english: Serving the Guru, it is obtained, and as Gurmukh, one is emancipated. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jo har naam dhiaaide te jan paravaanaa ||
english: Those humble beings who meditate on the Lord's Name, are celebrated and acclaimed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: tin vitahu naanak vaariaa sadaa sadaa kurabaanaa ||5||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice to them, forever and ever a devoted sacrifice. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saa har teree usatat hai jo har prabh bhaavai ||
english: O Lord, that alone is Praise to You, which is pleasing to Your Will, O Lord God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jo guramukh piaaraa sevade tin har phal paavai ||6||
english: Those Gurmukhs, who serve their Beloved Lord, obtain Him as their reward. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jinaa har setee pirahaRee tinaa jee prabh naale ||
english: Those who cherish love for the Lord, their souls are always with God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: oi jap jap piaaraa jeevade har naam samaale ||7||
english: Chanting and meditating on their Beloved, they live in, and gather in, the Lord's Name. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਘੁਮਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin guramukh piaaraa seviaa tin kau ghum jaaiaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those Gurmukhs who serve their Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟੇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਿਉ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: oi aap chhute paravaar siu sabh jagat chhadaaiaa ||8||
english: They themselves are saved, along with their families, and through them, all the world is saved. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੰਨੋ ॥
transliteration: gur piaarai har seviaa gur dha(n)n gur dha(n)no ||
english: My Beloved Guru serves the Lord. Blessed is the Guru, Blessed is the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵਡ ਪੁੰਨੋ ॥੯॥
transliteration: gur har maarag dasiaa gur pu(n)n vad pu(n)no ||9||
english: The Guru has shown me the Lord's Path; the Guru has done the greatest good deed. ||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਸੇ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jo gurasikh gur sevade se pu(n)n paraanee ||
english: Those Sikhs of the Guru, who serve the Guru, are the most blessed beings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: jan naanak tin kau vaariaa sadaa sadaa kurabaanee ||10||
english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them; He is forever and ever a sacrifice. ||10||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ ਸੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sakhee saheleeaa se aap har bhaaeeaa ||
english: The Lord Himself is pleased with the Gurmukhs, the fellowship of the companions.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਈਆ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: har daragah painaaeeaa har aap gal laaeeaa ||11||
english: In the Lord's Court, they are given robes of honor, and the Lord Himself hugs them close in His embrace. ||11||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jo guramukh naam dhiaaide tin darasan deejai ||
english: Please bless me with the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those Gurmukhs, who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਲਦੇ ਧੂੜਿ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੋਲਿ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: ham tin ke charan pakhaalade dhooR ghol ghol peejai ||12||
english: I wash their feet, and drink in the dust of their feet, dissolved in the wash water. ||12||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਖਾਤੀਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੀੜੀਆ ਲਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: paan supaaree khaateeaa mukh beeReeaa laaeeaa ||
english: Those who eat betel nuts and betel leaf and smoke intoxicants,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਈਆ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: har har kade na chetio jam pakaR chalaaeeaa ||13||
english: but do not contemplate the Lord, Har, Har - the Messenger of Death will seize them and take them away. ||13||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jin har naamaa har chetiaa hiradai ur dhaare ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: tin jam neR na aavaee gurasikh gur piaare ||14||
english: And keep Him enshrined in their hearts. The Guru's Sikhs are the Guru's Beloveds. ||14||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam nidhaan hai koee guramukh jaanai ||
english: The Name of the Lord is a treasure, known only to the few Gurmukhs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak jin satigur bhetiaa ra(n)g raleeaa maanai ||15||
english: O Nanak, those who meet with the True Guru, enjoy peace and pleasure. ||15||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਤੁਸਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਓ ॥
transliteration: satigur daataa aakheeai tus kare pasaao ||
english: The True Guru is called the Giver; in His Mercy, He grants His Grace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤੜਾ ਨਾਓ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: hau gur vitahu sad vaariaa jin ditaRaa naao ||16||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has blessed me with the Lord's Name. ||16||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਇ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: so dha(n)n guroo saabaas hai har dei sanehaa ||
english: Blessed, very blessed is the Guru, who brings the Lord's message.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵੇਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: hau vekh vekh guroo vigasiaa gur satigur dehaa ||17||
english: I gaze upon the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru embodied, and I blossom forth in bliss. ||17||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੋਲਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ॥
transliteration: gur rasanaa a(n)mrit boladee har naam suhaavee ||
english: The Guru's tongue recites Words of Ambrosial Nectar; He is adorned with the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਵੀ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: jin sun sikhaa gur ma(n)niaa tinaa bhukh sabh jaavee ||18||
english: Those Sikhs who hear and obey the Guru - all their desires depart. ||18||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: har kaa maarag aakheeai kahu kit bidh jaaeeai ||
english: Some speak of the Lord's Path; tell me, how can I walk on it?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: har har teraa naam hai har kharach lai jaaeeai ||19||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, Your Name is my supplies; I will take it with me and set out. ||19||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਵਡ ਦਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: jin guramukh har aaraadhiaa se saah vad daane ||
english: Those Gurmukhs who worship and adore the Lord, are wealthy and very wise.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: hau satigur kau sad vaariaa gur bachan samaane ||20||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru; I am absorbed in the Words of the Guru's Teachings. ||20||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too thaakur too saahibo toohai meraa meeraa ||
english: You are the Master, my Lord and Master; You are my Ruler and King.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਤੂ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: tudh bhaavai teree ba(n)dagee too gunee gaheeraa ||21||
english: If it is pleasing to Your Will, then I worship and serve You; You are the treasure of virtue. ||21||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
transliteration: aape har ik ra(n)g hai aape bahu ra(n)gee ||
english: The Lord Himself is absolute; He is The One and Only; but He Himself is also manifested in many forms.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਾਈ ਗਲ ਚੰਗੀ ॥੨੨॥੨॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa saaee gal cha(n)gee ||22||2||
english: Whatever pleases Him, O Nanak, that alone is good. ||22||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ਕਾਫੀ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 9 kaaphee ||
english: Tilang, Ninth Mehl, Kaafee:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਨਾ ਹੈ ਤਉ ਚੇਤ ਲੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨਿ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: chetanaa hai tau chet lai nis din mai praanee ||
english: If you are conscious, then be conscious of Him night and day, O mortal.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਫੂਟੈ ਘਟ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chhin chhin audh bihaat hai phootai ghat jiu paanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Each and every moment, your life is passing away, like water from a cracked pitcher. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਕਾਹਿ ਨ ਗਾਵਹੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har gun kaahi na gaavahee moorakh agiaanaa ||
english: Why do you not sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, you ignorant fool?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਕੈ ਨਹਿ ਮਰਨੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jhoothai laalach laag kai nahi maran pachhaanaa ||1||
english: You are attached to false greed, and you do not even consider death. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਜਹੂ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ajahoo kachh bigario nahee jo prabh gun gaavai ||
english: Even now, no harm has been done, if you will only sing God's Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਭਜਨ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tih bhajan te nirabhai pad paavai ||2||1||
english: Says Nanak, by meditating and vibrating upon Him, you shall obtain the state of fearlessness. ||2||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 9 ||
english: Tilang, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗ ਲੇਹੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਜਾਗ ਲੇਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਗਾਫਲ ਸੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaag lehu re manaa jaag lehu kahaa gaaphal soiaa ||
english: Wake up, O mind! Wake up! Why are you sleeping unaware?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਨੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੰਗ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਭੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਹੋਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo tan upajiaa sa(n)g hee so bhee sa(n)g na hoiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: That body, which you were born with, shall not go along with you in the end. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧ ਜਨ ਹਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa sut ba(n)dh jan hit jaa siu keenaa ||
english: Mother, father, children and relatives whom you love,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਛੂਟਿਓ ਜਬ ਦੇਹ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੈ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeeu chhootio jab deh te daar agan mai deenaa ||1||
english: will throw your body into the fire, when your soul departs from it. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਲਉ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
transliteration: jeevat lau biuhaar hai jag kau tum jaanau ||
english: Your worldly affairs exist only as long as you are alive; know this well.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਲੈ ਸਭ ਸੁਫਨ ਸਮਾਨਉ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak har gun gaai lai sabh suphan samaanau ||2||2||
english: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; everything is like a dream. ||2||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 9 ||
english: Tilang, Ninth Mehl:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਗਾਇ ਲੈ ਜੋ ਸੰਗੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੋ ॥
transliteration: har jas re manaa gaai lai jo sa(n)gee hai tero ||
english: Sing the Lord's Praises, O mind; He is your only true companion.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਉਸਰੁ ਬੀਤਿਓ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਿਓ ਮਾਨ ਲੈ ਮੇਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ausar beetio jaat hai kahio maan lai mero ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your time is passing away; listen carefully to what I say. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੰਪਤਿ ਰਥ ਧਨ ਰਾਜ ਸਿਉ ਅਤਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)pat rath dhan raaj siu at nehu lagaaio ||
english: You are so in love with property, chariots, wealth and power.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਜਬ ਗਲਿ ਪਰੀ ਸਭ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaal phaas jab gal paree sabh bhaio paraaio ||1||
english: When the noose of death tightens around your neck, they will all belong to others. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨਿ ਬੂਝ ਕੈ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਤੈ ਕਾਜੁ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: jaan boojh kai baavare tai kaaj bigaario ||
english: Know this well, O madman - you have ruined your affairs.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤ ਸੁਕਚਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਨਹ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paap karat sukachio nahee nah garab nivaario ||2||
english: You did not restrain yourself from committing sins, and you did not eradicate your ego. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਸੋ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jih bidh gur upadesiaa so sun re bhaaee ||
english: So listen to the Teachings imparted by the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਗਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak kahat pukaar kai gahu prabh saranaaee ||3||3||
english: Nanak proclaims: hold tight to the Protection and the Sanctuary of God. ||3||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: tila(n)g baanee bhagataa kee kabeer jee ||
english: Tilang, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਇਫਤਰਾ ਭਾਈ ਦਿਲ ਕਾ ਫਿਕਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bed kateb iphataraa bhaaee dil kaa phikar na jaai ||
english: The Vedas and the Scriptures are only make-believe, O Siblings of Destiny; they do not relieve the anxiety of the heart.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਟੁਕੁ ਦਮੁ ਕਰਾਰੀ ਜਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਾਜਿਰ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tuk dam karaaree jau karahu haajir hajoor khudaai ||1||
english: If you will only center yourself on the Lord, even for just a breath, then you shall see the Lord face-to-face, present before you. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬੰਦੇ ਖੋਜੁ ਦਿਲ ਹਰ ਰੋਜ ਨਾ ਫਿਰੁ ਪਰੇਸਾਨੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)de khoj dil har roj naa phir paresaanee maahi ||
english: O human being, search your own heart every day, and do not wander around in confusion.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਜੁ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸਿਹਰੁ ਮੇਲਾ ਦਸਤਗੀਰੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ih j duneeaa sihar melaa dasatageeree naahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This world is just a magic-show; no one will be holding your hand. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦਰੋਗੁ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਖੁਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਬੇਖਬਰ ਬਾਦੁ ਬਕਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: darog paR paR khusee hoi bekhabar baad bakaahi ||
english: Reading and studying falsehood, people are happy; in their ignorance, they speak nonsense.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਕੁ ਸਚੁ ਖਾਲਕੁ ਖਲਕ ਮਿਆਨੇ ਸਿਆਮ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hak sach khaalak khalak miaane siaam moorat naahi ||2||
english: The True Creator Lord is diffused into His creation; He is not just the dark-skinned Krishna of legends. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਸਮਾਨ ਮੵਿਾਨੇ ਲਹੰਗ ਦਰੀਆ ਗੁਸਲ ਕਰਦਨ ਬੂਦ ॥
transliteration: asamaan myiaane laha(n)g dareeaa gusal karadan bood ||
english: Through the Tenth Gate, the stream of nectar flows; take your bath in this.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਫਕਰੁ ਦਾਇਮ ਲਾਇ ਚਸਮੇ ਜਹ ਤਹਾ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kar phakar daaim laai chasame jah tahaa maujood ||3||
english: Serve the Lord forever; use your eyes, and see Him ever-present everywhere. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਲਾਹ ਪਾਕੰ ਪਾਕ ਹੈ ਸਕ ਕਰਉ ਜੇ ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: alaah paaka(n) paak hai sak karau je doosar hoi ||
english: The Lord is the purest of the pure; only through doubt could there be another.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੀਮ ਕਾ ਉਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਜਾਨੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kabeer karam kareem kaa uhu karai jaanai soi ||4||1||
english: O Kabeer, mercy flows from the Merciful Lord; He alone knows who acts. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: naamadev jee ||
english: Naam Dayv Jee:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁੰਦਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mai a(n)dhule kee tek teraa naam khu(n)dakaaraa ||
english: I am blind; Your Name, O Creator Lord, is my only anchor and support.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗਰੀਬ ਮੈ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mai gareeb mai masakeen teraa naam hai adhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am poor, and I am meek. Your Name is my only support. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਰੀਮਾਂ ਰਹੀਮਾਂ ਅਲਾਹ ਤੂ ਗਨਂੀ ॥
transliteration: kareemaa(n) raheemaa(n) alaah too gana(n)ee ||
english: O beautiful Lord, benevolent and merciful Lord, You are so wealthy and generous.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਾਜਰਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਪੇਸਿ ਤੂੰ ਮਨਂੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haajaraa hajoor dar pes too(n) mana(n)ee ||1||
english: You are ever-present in every presence, within and before me. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦਰੀਆਉ ਤੂ ਦਿਹੰਦ ਤੂ ਬਿਸੀਆਰ ਤੂ ਧਨੀ ॥
transliteration: dareeaau too diha(n)d too biseeaar too dhanee ||
english: You are the river of life, You are the Giver of all; You are so very wealthy.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਦਿਗਰ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dehi lehi ek too(n) digar ko nahee ||2||
english: You alone give, and You alone take away; there is no other at all. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਬੀਨਾਂ ਮੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) daanaa(n) too(n) beenaa(n) mai beechaar kiaa karee ||
english: You are wise, You are the supreme seer; how could I make You an object of thought?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਚੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਖਸੰਦ ਤੂੰ ਹਰੀ ॥੩॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: naame che suaamee bakhasa(n)d too(n) haree ||3||1||2||
english: O Lord and Master of Naam Dayv, You are the merciful Lord of forgiveness. ||3||1||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਲੇ ਯਾਰਾਂ ਹਲੇ ਯਾਰਾਂ ਖੁਸਿਖਬਰੀ ॥
transliteration: hale yaaraa(n) hale yaaraa(n) khusikhabaree ||
english: Hello, my friend, hello my friend. Is there any good news?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਉ ॥ ਨੀਕੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਿਗਾਰੀ ਆਲੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bal bal jaa(n)u hau bal bal jaa(n)u || neekee teree bigaaree aale teraa naau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice, a devoted sacrifice, a dedicated and devoted sacrifice, to You. Slavery to You is so sublime; Your Name is noble and exalted. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕੁਜਾ ਆਮਦ ਕੁਜਾ ਰਫਤੀ ਕੁਜਾ ਮੇ ਰਵੀ ॥
transliteration: kujaa aamad kujaa raphatee kujaa me ravee ||
english: Where did you come from? Where have You been? And where are You going?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਵਾਰਿਕਾ ਨਗਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਬੁਗੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dvaarikaa nagaree raas bugoee ||1||
english: Tell me the truth, in the holy city of Dwaarikaa. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਖੂਬੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਗਰੀ ਮੀਠੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਬੋਲ ॥
transliteration: khoob teree pagaree meethe tere bol ||
english: How handsome is your turban! And how sweet is your speech.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਵਾਰਿਕਾ ਨਗਰੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੇ ਮਗੋਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dvaarikaa nagaree kaahe ke magol ||2||
english: Why are there Moghals in the holy city of Dwaarikaa? ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਂੀ ਹਜਾਰ ਆਲਮ ਏਕਲ ਖਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)da(n)ee hajaar aalam ekal khaanaa(n) ||
english: You alone are the Lord of so many thousands of worlds.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਚਿਨੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਂਵਲੇ ਬਰਨਾਂ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ham chinee paatisaah saa(n)vale baranaa(n) ||3||
english: You are my Lord King, like the dark-skinned Krishna. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਸਪਤਿ ਗਜਪਤਿ ਨਰਹ ਨਰਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: asapat gajapat narah nari(n)d ||
english: You are the Lord of the sun, Lord Indra and Lord Brahma, the King of men.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਮੀਰ ਮੁਕੰਦ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: naame ke svaamee meer muka(n)d ||4||2||3||
english: You are the Lord and Master of Naam Dayv, the King, the Liberator of all. ||4||2||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 1 chaupade ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਧੋਇ ਬੈਸਿ ਧੂਪੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਦੂਧੈ ਕਉ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: bhaa(n)daa dhoi bais dhoop devahu tau doodhai kau jaavahu ||
english: Wash the vessel, sit down and anoint it with fragrance; then, go out and get the milk.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਧੁ ਕਰਮ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਜਮਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: doodh karam phun surat samaain hoi niraas jamaavahu ||1||
english: Add the rennet of clear consciousness to the milk of good deeds, and then, free of desire, let it curdle. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪਹੁ ਤ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: japahu ta eko naamaa ||
english: Chant the Name of the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਨਿਰਾਫਲ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avar niraaphal kaamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All other actions are fruitless. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਈਟੀ ਹਾਥਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਉ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu man eetee haath karahu phun netrau need na aavai ||
english: Let your mind be the handles, and then churn it, without sleeping.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਬ ਮਥੀਐ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: rasanaa naam japahu tab matheeai in bidh a(n)mrit paavahu ||2||
english: If you chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord ,with your tongue, then the curd will be churned. In this way, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸੰਪਟੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਭਾਵਨ ਪਾਤੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man sa(n)pat jit sat sar naavan bhaavan paatee tripat kare ||
english: Wash your mind in the pool of Truth, and let it be the vessel of the Lord; let this be your offering to please Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਸੇਵੇ ਇਨੑ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: poojaa praan sevak je seve inh bidh saahib ravat rahai ||3||
english: That humble servant who dedicates and offers his life, and who serves in this way, remains absorbed in his Lord and Master. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਦੇ ਕਹਹਿ ਕਹੇ ਕਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kahade kahahi kahe kahi jaavahi tum sar avar na koee ||
english: The speakers speak and speak and speak, and then they depart. There is no other to compare to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਜੰਪੈ ਹਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: bhagat heen naanak jan ja(n)pai hau saalaahee sachaa soee ||4||1||
english: Servant Nanak, lacking devotion, humbly prays: may I sing the Praises of the True Lord. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
english: Soohee, First Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar vasai na baahar jaai ||
english: Deep within the self, the Lord abides; do not go outside looking for Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit chhod kaahe bikh khaai ||1||
english: You have renounced the Ambrosial Nectar - why are you eating poison? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa giaan japahu man mere ||
english: Meditate on such spiritual wisdom, O my mind,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਵਹੁ ਚਾਕਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hovahu chaakar saache kere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and become the slave of the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਰਵੈ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan sabh koee ravai ||
english: Everyone speaks of wisdom and meditation;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਂਧਨਿ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: baa(n)dhan baa(n)dhiaa sabh jag bhavai ||2||
english: but bound in bondage, the whole world is wandering around in confusion. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਚਾਕਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sevaa kare s chaakar hoi ||
english: One who serves the Lord is His servant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal rav rahiaa soi ||3||
english: The Lord is pervading and permeating the water, the land, and the sky. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਚੰਗੇ ਬੁਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ham nahee cha(n)ge buraa nahee koi ||
english: I am not good; no one is bad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak taare soi ||4||1||2||
english: Prays Nanak, He alone saves us! ||4||1||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ghar 6 ||
english: Soohee, First Mehl, Sixth House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਜਲੁ ਕੈਹਾ ਚਿਲਕਣਾ ਘੋਟਿਮ ਕਾਲੜੀ ਮਸੁ ॥
transliteration: ujal kaihaa chilakanaa ghotim kaalaRee mas ||
english: Bronze is bright and shiny, but when it is rubbed, its blackness appears.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੋਤਿਆ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhotiaa jooth na utarai je sau dhovaa tis ||1||
english: Washing it, its impurity is not removed, even if it is washed a hundred times. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਜਣ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: sajan seee naal mai chaladiaa naal chala(n)nhi ||
english: They alone are my friends, who travel along with me;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਖੜੇ ਦਿਸੰਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeai tithai khaRe disa(n)n ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and in that place, where the accounts are called for, they appear standing with me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਵੀਆਹਾ ॥
transliteration: kothe ma(n)dap maaReeaa paasahu chitaveeaahaa ||
english: There are houses, mansions and tall buildings, painted on all sides;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਢਠੀਆ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੑੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਸਖਣੀਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhatheeaa ka(n)m na aavanhee vichahu sakhaneeaahaa ||2||
english: but they are empty within, and they crumble like useless ruins. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਗਾ ਬਗੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਮੰਝਿ ਵਸੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: bagaa bage kapaRe teerath ma(n)jh vasa(n)nhi ||
english: The herons in their white feathers dwell in the sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘੁਟਿ ਘੁਟਿ ਜੀਆ ਖਾਵਣੇ ਬਗੇ ਨਾ ਕਹੀਅਨੑਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ghut ghut jeeaa khaavane bage naa kaheeanhi ||3||
english: They tear apart and eat the living beings, and so they are not called white. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮਲ ਰੁਖੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਮੈ ਮੈਜਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: si(n)mal rukh sareer mai maijan dekh bhula(n)nhi ||
english: My body is like the simmal tree; seeing me, other people are fooled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਫਲ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੑੀ ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਹੰਨੑਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: se phal ka(n)m na aavanhee te gun mai tan ha(n)nhi ||4||
english: Its fruits are useless - just like the qualities of my body. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਇਆ ਡੂਗਰ ਵਾਟ ਬਹੁਤੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhulai bhaar uthaaiaa doogar vaat bahut ||
english: The blind man is carrying such a heavy load, and his journey through the mountains is so long.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਲੋੜੀ ਨਾ ਲਹਾ ਹਉ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਾ ਕਿਤੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: akhee loRee naa lahaa hau chaR la(n)ghaa kit ||5||
english: My eyes can see, but I cannot find the Way. How can I climb up and cross over the mountain? ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਕਰੀਆ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chaakareeaa cha(n)giaaeeaa avar siaanap kit ||
english: What good does it do to serve, and be good, and be clever?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਧਾ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ॥੬॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam samaal too(n) badhaa chhutahi jit ||6||1||3||
english: O Nanak, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall be released from bondage. ||6||1||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Soohee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ਬੇੜੁਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲੰਘਹਿ ਵਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jap tap kaa ba(n)dh beRulaa jit la(n)ghahi vahelaa ||
english: Build the raft of meditation and self-discipline, to carry you across the river.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਨਾ ਊਛਲੈ ਐਸਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naa saravar naa oochhalai aisaa pa(n)th suhelaa ||1||
english: There will be no ocean, and no rising tides to stop you; this is how comfortable your path shall be. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਜੀਠੜਾ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੋਲਾ ਸਦ ਰੰਗ ਢੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teraa eko naam ma(n)jeethaRaa rataa meraa cholaa sad ra(n)g dholaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your Name alone is the color, in which the robe of my body is dyed. This color is permanent, O my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਚਲੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: saajan chale piaariaa kiu melaa hoee ||
english: My beloved friends have departed; how will they meet the Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਗੰਠੜੀਐ ਮੇਲੇਗਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: je gun hovahi ga(n)thaReeai melegaa soee ||2||
english: If they have virtue in their pack, the Lord will unite them with Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਜੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: miliaa hoi na veechhuRai je miliaa hoee ||
english: Once united with Him, they will not be separated again, if they are truly united.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aavaa gaun nivaariaa hai saachaa soee ||3||
english: The True Lord brings their comings and goings to an end. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ਸੀਤਾ ਹੈ ਚੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar nivaariaa seetaa hai cholaa ||
english: One who subdues and eradicates egotism, sews the robe of devotion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹ ਕੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੋਲਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur bachanee phal paaiaa sah ke a(n)mrit bolaa ||4||
