english: Following the Word of the Guru's Teachings, she receives the fruits of her reward, the Ambrosial Words of the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਹੁ ਖਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naanak kahai saheleeho sahu kharaa piaaraa ||
english: Says Nanak, O soul-brides, our Husband Lord is so dear!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਸਹ ਕੇਰੀਆ ਦਾਸੀਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੫॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: ham sah kereeaa daaseeaa saachaa khasam hamaaraa ||5||2||4||
english: We are the servants, the hand-maidens of the Lord; He is our True Lord and Master. ||5||2||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Soohee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਭਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਵਾਰਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jin kau bhaa(n)dai bhaau tinaa savaarasee ||
english: Those whose minds are filled with love of the Lord, are blessed and exalted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖੀ ਕਰੈ ਪਸਾਉ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਸੀ ॥
transliteration: sookhee karai pasaau dookh visaarasee ||
english: They are blessed with peace, and their pains are forgotten.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਤਾਰਸੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sahasaa moole naahi sarapar taarasee ||1||
english: He will undoubtedly, certainly save them. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਇ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲੀਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tinhaa miliaa gur aai jin kau leekhiaa ||
english: The Guru comes to meet those whose destiny is so pre-ordained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੀਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naau devai deekhiaa ||
english: He blesses them with the Teachings of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਭਵਹਿ ਨ ਭੀਖਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chaalahi satigur bhaai bhavahi na bheekhiaa ||2||
english: Those who walk in the Will of the True Guru, never wander begging. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੂਜੇ ਨਿਵੈ ਕਿਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau mahal hajoor dooje nivai kis ||
english: And one who lives in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, why should he bow down to any other?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵਾਣੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਮੂਲੇ ਪੁਛ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
transliteration: dar daravaanee naahi moole puchh tis ||
english: The gate-keeper at the Lord's Gate shall not stop him to ask any questions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੁਟੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਨਦਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chhutai taa kai bol saahib nadar jis ||3||
english: And one who is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace - by his words, others are emancipated as well. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਲੇ ਆਣੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਮਤੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ghale aane aap jis naahee doojaa matai koi ||
english: The Lord Himself sends out, and recalls the mortal beings; no one else gives Him advice.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dhaahi usaare saaj jaanai sabh soi ||
english: He Himself demolishes, constructs and creates; He knows everything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: naau naanak bakhasees nadaree karam hoi ||4||3||5||
english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord is the blessing, given to those who receive His Mercy, and His Grace. ||4||3||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Soohee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਹਛਾ ਸੋਇ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
transliteration: bhaa(n)daa hachhaa soi jo tis bhaavasee ||
english: That vessel alone is pure, which is pleasing to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਅਤਿ ਮਲੀਣੁ ਧੋਤਾ ਹਛਾ ਨ ਹੋਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: bhaa(n)daa at maleen dhotaa hachhaa na hoisee ||
english: The filthiest vessel does not become pure, simply by being washed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: guroo duaarai hoi sojhee paaisee ||
english: Through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, one obtains understanding.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਧੋਇ ਹਛਾ ਹੋਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: et duaarai dhoi hachhaa hoisee ||
english: By being washed through this Gate, it becomes pure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੇ ਹਛੇ ਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: maile hachhe kaa veechaar aap varataaisee ||
english: The Lord Himself sets the standards to differentiate between the dirty and the pure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਇ ਅਗੈ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: mat ko jaanai jaai agai paaisee ||
english: Do not think that you will automatically find a place of rest hereafter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਤੇਹਾ ਹੋਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jehe karam kamaai tehaa hoisee ||
english: According to the actions one has committed, so does the mortal become.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naau aap varataaisee ||
english: He Himself bestows the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਲਿਆ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਜਾ ਵਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: chaliaa pat siu janam savaar vaajaa vaaisee ||
english: Such a mortal departs with honor and renown; his life is embellished and redeemed, and the trumpets resound with his glory.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣਾਇਸੀ ॥
transliteration: maanas kiaa vechaaraa tihu lok sunaaisee ||
english: Why speak of poor mortals? His glory shall echo throughout the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਸੀ ॥੧॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak aap nihaal sabh kul taarasee ||1||4||6||
english: O Nanak, he himself shall be enraptured, and he shall save his entire ancestry. ||1||4||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Soohee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਗਵੈ ਭੋਗੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jogee hovai jogavai bhogee hovai khaai ||
english: The Yogi practices yoga, and the pleasure-seeker practices eating.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਪੀਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tapeeaa hovai tap kare teerath mal mal naai ||1||
english: The austere practice austerities, bathing and rubbing themselves at sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦੜਾ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬਹੈ ਅਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teraa sadaRaa suneejai bhaaee je ko bahai alaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Let me hear some news of You, O Beloved; if only someone would come and sit with me, and tell me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੇ ਜੋ ਖਟੇ ਸੋੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa beejai so lune jo khate sou khaai ||
english: As one plants, so does he harvest; whatever he earns, he eats.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਪੁਛ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸਣੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: agai puchh na hovaee je san neesaanai jaai ||2||
english: In the world hereafter, his account is not called for, if he goes with the insignia of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੋ ਜੈਸਾ ਕਾਢੀਐ ਜੈਸੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: taiso jaisaa kaadheeai jaisee kaar kamaai ||
english: According to the actions the mortal commits, so is he proclaimed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਸੋ ਦਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo dam chit na aavaee so dam birathaa jaai ||3||
english: And that breath which is drawn without thinking of the Lord, that breath goes in vain. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਵੇਚੀ ਬੈ ਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਵਿਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu tan vechee bai karee je ko lae vikaai ||
english: I would sell this body, if someone would only purchase it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak ka(n)m na aavaee jit tan naahee sachaa naau ||4||5||7||
english: O Nanak, that body is of no use at all, if it does not enshrine the Name of the True Lord. ||4||5||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ghar 7 ||
english: Soohee, First Mehl, Seventh House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਡੰਡੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਭਸਮ ਚੜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jog na khi(n)thaa jog na da(n)dai jog na bhasam chaRaaeeai ||
english: Yoga is not the patched coat, Yoga is not the walking stick. Yoga is not smearing the body with ashes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਮੁੰਦੀ ਮੂੰਡਿ ਮੁਡਾਇਐ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਵਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jog na mu(n)dee moo(n)d mudaaiai jog na si(n)ngee vaaeeai ||
english: Yoga is not the ear-rings, and not the shaven head. Yoga is not the blowing of the horn.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan raheeai jog jugat iv paaeeai ||1||
english: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attain Yoga. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਲੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: galee jog na hoee ||
english: By mere words, Yoga is not attained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ek drisat kar samasar jaanai jogee kaheeai soee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who looks upon all with a single eye, and knows them to be one and the same - he alone is known as a Yogi. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jog na baahar maRee masaanee jog na taaRee laaeeai ||
english: Yoga is not wandering to the tombs of the dead; Yoga is not sitting in trances.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਦੇਸਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਭਵਿਐ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jog na des disa(n)tar bhaviai jog na teerath naaeeai ||
english: Yoga is not wandering through foreign lands; Yoga is not bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan raheeai jog jugat iv paaeeai ||2||
english: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attain Yoga. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਤੂਟੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhetai taa sahasaa tootai dhaavat varaj rahaaeeai ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, doubt is dispelled, and the wandering mind is restrained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: nijhar jharai sahaj dhun laagai ghar hee parachaa paaeeai ||
english: Nectar rains down, celestial music resounds, and deep within, wisdom is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan raheeai jog jugat iv paaeeai ||3||
english: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attain Yoga. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: naanak jeevatiaa mar raheeai aisaa jog kamaaeeai ||
english: O Nanak, remain dead while yet alive - practice such a Yoga.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੇ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਤਉ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: vaaje baajhahu si(n)ngee vaajai tau nirabhau pad paaeeai ||
english: When the horn is blown without being blown, then you shall attain the state of fearless dignity.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥
transliteration: a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan raheeai jog jugat tau paaeeai ||4||1||8||
english: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attain Yoga. ||4||1||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Soohee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣ ਤਰਾਜੀ ਕਵਣੁ ਤੁਲਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਵਣੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਬੁਲਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: kaun taraajee kavan tulaa teraa kavan saraaph bulaavaa ||
english: What scale, what weights, and what assayer shall I call for You, Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੇਵਾ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਮੁਲੁ ਕਰਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaun guroo kai pahi deekhiaa levaa kai pahi mul karaavaa ||1||
english: From what guru should I receive instruction? By whom should I have Your value appraised? ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: mere laal jeeu teraa a(n)t na jaanaa ||
english: O my Dear Beloved Lord, Your limits are not known.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) jal thal maheeal bharipur leenaa too(n) aape sarab samaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You pervade the water, the land, and the sky; You Yourself are All-pervading. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਾਰਾਜੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਤੁਲਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: man taaraajee chit tulaa teree sev saraaph kamaavaa ||
english: Mind is the scale, consciousness the weights, and the performance of Your service is the appraiser.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਤੋਲੀ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghat hee bheetar so sahu tolee in bidh chit rahaavaa ||2||
english: Deep within my heart, I weigh my Husband Lord; in this way I focus my consciousness. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੰਡਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਤਰਾਜੀ ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape ka(n)daa tol taraajee aape tolanahaaraa ||
english: You Yourself are the balance, the weights and the scale; You Yourself are the weigher.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape dekhai aape boojhai aape hai vanajaaraa ||3||
english: You Yourself see, and You Yourself understand; You Yourself are the trader. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhulaa neech jaat paradesee khin aavai til jaavai ||
english: The blind, low class wandering soul, comes for a moment, and departs in an instant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰਹਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੂੜਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੨॥੯॥
transliteration: taa kee sa(n)gat naanak rahadaa kiu kar mooRaa paavai ||4||2||9||
english: In its company, Nanak dwells; how can the fool attain the Lord? ||4||2||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: man raam naam aaraadhiaa gur sabad guroo gur ke ||
english: My mind worships and adores the Lord's Name, through the Guru, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਇਛਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਜਮ ਕੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh ichhaa man tan pooreeaa sabh chookaa dar jam ke ||1||
english: All the desires of my mind and body have been fulfilled; all fear of death has been dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: mere man gun gaavahu raam naam har ke ||
english: O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪੀਆ ਰਸੁ ਗਟਕੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur tuthai man parabodhiaa har peeaa ras gatake ||1|| rahaau ||
english: And when the Guru is pleased and satisfied, the mind is instructed; it then joyfully drinks in the subtle essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat ootam satigur keree gun gaavai har prabh ke ||
english: The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the True Guru, is sublime and exalted. They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਮ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਗ ਜਨ ਕੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har kirapaa dhaar melahu satasa(n)gat ham dhovah pag jan ke ||2||
english: Bless me with Your Mercy, Lord, and unite me with the Sat Sangat; I wash the feet of Your humble servants. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਕੇ ॥
transliteration: raam naam sabh hai raam naamaa ras guramat ras rasake ||
english: The Lord's Name is all. The Lord's Name is the essence of the Guru's Teachings, the juice, the sweetness of it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਤਿਸ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har a(n)mrit har jal paaiaa sabh laathee tis tis ke ||3||
english: I have found the Ambrosial Nectar, the Divine Water of the Lord's Name, and all my thirst for it is quenched. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਾਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਮ ਵੇਚਿਓ ਸਿਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: hamaree jaat paat gur satigur ham vechio sir gur ke ||
english: The Guru, the True Guru, is my social status and honor; I have sold my head to the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਜਨ ਕੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam pario gur chelaa gur raakhahu laaj jan ke ||4||1||
english: Servant Nanak is called the chaylaa, the disciple of the Guru; O Guru, save the honor of Your servant. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਜਿਓ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦਾਲਦ ਦਲਘਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam bhajio purakhotam sabh binase daalad dalaghaa ||
english: I chant and vibrate the Name of the Lord God, the Supreme Being, Har, Har; my poverty and problems have all been eradicated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣਾ ਮੇਟਿਓ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਘਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhau janam maranaa metio gurasabadee har asathir sev sukh samaghaa ||1||
english: The fear of birth and death has been erased, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; serving the Unmoving, Unchanging Lord, I am absorbed in peace. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਰਘਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man bhaj raam naam at piraghaa ||
english: O my mind, vibrate the Name of the most Beloved, Darling Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿ ਲੀਓ ਮੁਲਿ ਮਹਘਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mai man tan arap dhario gur aagai sir vech leeo mul mahaghaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have dedicated my mind and body, and placed them in offering before the Guru; I have sold my head to the Guru, for a very dear price. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਕੜਿ ਖੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਲਘਾ ॥
transliteration: narapat raaje ra(n)g ras maanahi bin naavai pakaR khaRe sabh kalaghaa ||
english: The kings and the rulers of men enjoy pleasures and delights, but without the Name of the Lord, death seizes and dispatches them all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡੁ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੇ ਹਥ ਫਲਘਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dharam raai sir da(n)d lagaanaa phir pachhutaane hath phalaghaa ||2||
english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma strikes them over the heads with his staff, and when the fruits of their actions come into their hands, then they regret and repent. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਜਨ ਕਿਰਮ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਲਘਾ ॥
transliteration: har raakh raakh jan kiram tumaare saranaagat purakh pratipalaghaa ||
english: Save me, save me, Lord; I am Your humble servant, a mere worm. I seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary, O Primal Lord, Cherisher and Nourisher.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲੋਚ ਪੂਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਘਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: darasan sa(n)t dehu sukh paavai prabh loch poor jan tumaghaa ||3||
english: Please bless me with the Blessed Vision of the Saint's Darshan, that I may find peace. O God, please fulfill the desires of Your humble servant. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਘਾ ॥
transliteration: tum samarath purakh vade prabh suaamee mo kau keejai daan har nimaghaa ||
english: You are the All-powerful, Great, Primal God, my Lord and Master. O Lord, please bless me with the gift of humility.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਮ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਘੁਮਘਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam milai sukh paavai ham naam vitahu sad ghumaghaa ||4||2||
english: Servant Nanak has found the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and is at peace; I am forever a sacrifice to the Naam. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਙੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਙੁ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਙੁ ॥
transliteration: har naamaa har ra(n)ng hai har ra(n)ng majeethai ra(n)ng ||
english: The Lord's Name is the Love of the Lord. The Lord's Love is the permanent color.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਾੜਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭੰਙੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur tuthai har ra(n)g chaaRiaa phir bahuR na hovee bha(n)ng ||1||
english: When the Guru is totally satisfied and pleased, He colors us with the Lord's Love; this color shall never fade away. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਕਰਿ ਰੰਙੁ ॥
transliteration: mere man har raam naam kar ra(n)ng ||
english: O my mind, enshrine love for the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਰਾਉ ਨਿਸੰਙੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur tuthai har upadesiaa har bhetiaa raau nisa(n)ng ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru, satisfied and pleased, taught me about the Lord, and my Sovereign Lord King met with me at once. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਅੰਙੁ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dh iaanee manamukhee phir aavan jaanaa a(n)ng ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is like the ignorant bride, who comes and goes again and again in reincarnation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਸਹਲੰਙੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har prabh chit na aaio man doojaa bhaau sahala(n)ng ||2||
english: The Lord God does not come into her consciousness, and her mind is stuck in the love of duality. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਦੁਹਚਾਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅੰਗੀ ਅੰਙੁ ॥
transliteration: ham mail bhare duhachaareeaa har raakhahu a(n)gee a(n)ng ||
english: I am full of filth, and I practice evil deeds; O Lord, save me, be with me, merge me into Your Being!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਵਲਾਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪੰਙੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur a(n)mrit sar navalaaiaa sabh laathe kilavikh pa(n)ng ||3||
english: The Guru has bathed me in the pool of Ambrosial Nectar, and all my dirty sins and mistakes have been washed away. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਙੁ ॥
transliteration: har deenaa deen daiaal prabh satasa(n)gat melahu sa(n)ng ||
english: O Lord God, Merciful to the meek and the poor, please unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੰਙੁ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)gat har ra(n)g paaiaa jan naanak man tan ra(n)ng ||4||3||
english: Joining the Sangat, servant Nanak has obtained the Lord's Love; my mind and body are drenched in it. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har har karahi nit kapat kamaavahi hiradaa sudh na hoee ||
english: One who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, while constantly practicing deception, shall never become pure of heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin karam karahi bahutere supanai sukh na hoee ||1||
english: He may perform all sorts of rituals, night and day, but he shall not find peace, even in dreams. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: giaanee gur bin bhagat na hoee ||
english: O wise ones, without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੜੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: korai ra(n)g kade na chaRai je lochai sabh koee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The untreated cloth does not take up the dye, no matter how much everyone may wish it. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਵਰਤ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਜਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam varat kare poojaa manamukh rog na jaaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukh may perform chants, meditations, austere self-discipline, fasts and devotional worship, but his sickness does not go away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)tar rog mahaa abhimaanaa doojai bhaai khuaaee ||2||
english: Deep within him is the sickness of excessive egotism; in the love of duality he is ruined. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: baahar bhekh bahut chaturaaee manooaa dah dis dhaavai ||
english: Outwardly, he wears religious robes and he is very clever, but his mind wanders in the ten directions.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: haumai biaapiaa sabad na cheenhai phir phir joonee aavai ||3||
english: Engrossed in ego, he does not remember the Word of the Shabad; over and over again, he is reincarnated. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: naanak nadar kare so boojhai so jan naam dhiaae ||
english: O Nanak, that mortal who is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, understands Him; that humble servant meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਕਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee eko boojhai ekas maahi samaae ||4||4||
english: By Guru's Grace, he understands the One Lord, and is absorbed into the One Lord. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਗਰੀ ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramat nagaree khoj khojaaee ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I searched and searched the body-village;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har naam padaarath paaee ||1||
english: I found the wealth of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: merai man har har saa(n)t vasaaee ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, has enshrined peace within my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਖਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tisanaa agan bujhee khin a(n)tar gur miliai sabh bhukh gavaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The fire of desire was extinguished in an instant, when I met the Guru; all my hunger has been satisfied. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavaa jeevaa meree maaee ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I live, O my mother.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur daiaal gun naam driRaaee ||2||
english: The Merciful True Guru implanted the Glorious Praises of the Naam within me. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਢੂਢਿ ਢੂਢਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hau har prabh piaaraa dhoodh dhoodhaaee ||
english: I search for and seek out my Beloved Lord God, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mil har ras paaee ||3||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have obtained the subtle essence of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖ ਲਿਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dhur masatak lekh likhe har paaee ||
english: By the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon my forehead, I have found the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
transliteration: gur naanak tuthaa melai har bhaaee ||4||1||5||
english: Guru Nanak, pleased and satisfied, has united me with the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||1||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har kripaa kare man har ra(n)g laae ||
english: Showering His Mercy, the Lord imbues the mind with His Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh har har naam samaae ||1||
english: The Gurmukh merges in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g raataa man ra(n)g maane ||
english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, the mortal enjoys the pleasure of His Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahai din raatee poore gur kai sabad samaane ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He remains always blissful, day and night, and he merges into the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਕਉ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g kau lochai sabh koee ||
english: Everyone longs for the Lord's Love;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਲੂਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh ra(n)g chaloolaa hoee ||2||
english: the Gurmukh is imbued with the deep red color of His Love. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਨਰੁ ਕੋਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mugadh nar koraa hoi ||
english: The foolish, self-willed manmukh is left pale and uncolored.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਲੋਚੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je sau lochai ra(n)g na hovai koi ||3||
english: Even if he wishes it a hundred times, he does not obtain the Lord's Love. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa satigur paavai ||
english: But if the Lord blesses him with His Glance of Grace, then he meets the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak har ras har ra(n)g samaavai ||4||2||6||
english: Nanak is absorbed into the subtle essence of the Lord's Love. ||4||2||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਹੀ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa har ras rahee aghaai ||
english: My tongue remains satisfied with the subtle essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh peevai sahaj samaai ||1||
english: The Gurmukh drinks it in, and merges in celestial peace. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜਨ ਚਾਖਹੁ ਜੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har ras jan chaakhahu je bhaaee ||
english: If you taste the subtle essence of the Lord, O humble Siblings of Destiny,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕਤ ਅਨਤ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tau kat anat saad lobhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: then how can you be enticed by other flavors? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramat ras raakhahu ur dhaar ||
english: Under Guru's Instructions, keep this subtle essence enshrined in your heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har ras raate ra(n)g muraar ||2||
english: Those who are imbued with the subtle essence of the Lord, are immersed in celestial bliss. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh har ras chaakhiaa na jaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh cannot even taste the subtle essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: haumai karai bahutee milai sajaai ||3||
english: He acts out in ego, and suffers terrible punishment. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa har ras paavai ||
english: But if he is blessed with the Lord's Kind Mercy, then he obtains the subtle essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੩॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak har ras har gun gaavai ||4||3||7||
english: O Nanak, absorbed in this subtle essence of the Lord, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||3||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ghar 6 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Sixth House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤਿਆ ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: neech jaat har japatiaa utam padavee paai ||
english: When someone of low social class chants the Lord's Name, he obtains the state of highest dignity.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਛਹੁ ਬਿਦਰ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤੈ ਕਿਸਨੁ ਉਤਰਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poochhahu bidar daasee sutai kisan utariaa ghar jis jaai ||1||
english: Go and ask Bidar, the son of a maid; Krishna himself stayed in his house. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har kee akath kathaa sunahu jan bhaaee jit sahasaa dookh bhookh sabh lahi jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Listen, O humble Siblings of Destiny, to the Unspoken Speech of the Lord; it removes all anxiety, pain and hunger. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਚਮਾਰੁ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਇਕ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ravidaas chamaar usatat kare har keerat nimakh ik gaai ||
english: Ravi Daas, the leather-worker, praised the Lord, and sang the Kirtan of His Praises each and every instant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਜਾਤਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਪਏ ਪਗਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: patit jaat utam bhaiaa chaar varan pae pag aai ||2||
english: Although he was of low social status, he was exalted and elevated, and people of all four castes came and bowed at his feet. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਦੇਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲੋਕੁ ਛੀਪਾ ਕਹੈ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naamade preet lagee har setee lok chheepaa kahai bulaai ||
english: Naam Dayv loved the Lord; the people called him a fabric dyer.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਪਿਠਿ ਦੇ ਛੋਡੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਲੀਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khatree braahaman pith de chhode har naamadeu leeaa mukh laai ||3||
english: The Lord turned His back on the high-class Kh'shaatriyas and Brahmins, and showed His face to Naam Dayv. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਤਿਨ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਕਢਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jitane bhagat har sevakaa mukh athasath teerath tin tilak kadhaai ||
english: All of the devotees and servants of the Lord have the tilak, the ceremonial mark, applied to their foreheads at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪਰਸੇ ਜੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥
transliteration: jan naanak tin kau anadin parase je kripaa kare har raai ||4||1||8||
english: Servant Nanak shall touch their feet night and day, if the Lord, the King, grants His Grace. ||4||1||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਲਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tinhee a(n)tar har aaraadhiaa jin kau dhur likhiaa likhat lilaaraa ||
english: They alone worship and adore the Lord deep within, who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny from the very beginning of time.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin kee bakheelee koee kiaa kare jin kaa a(n)g kare meraa har karataaraa ||1||
english: What can anyone do to undermine them? My Creator Lord is on their side. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har dhiaai man mere man dhiaai har janam janam ke sabh dookh nivaaranahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: So meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind. Meditate on the Lord, O mind; He is the Eliminator of all the pains of reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dhur bhagat janaa kau bakhasiaa har a(n)mrit bhagat bha(n)daaraa ||
english: In the very beginning, the Lord blessed His devotees with the Ambrosial Nectar, the treasure of devotion.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: moorakh hovai s un kee rees kare tis halat palat muhu kaaraa ||2||
english: Anyone who tries to compete with them is a fool; his face shall be blackened here and hereafter. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: se bhagat se sevakaa jinaa har naam piaaraa ||
english: They alone are devotees, and they alone are selfless servants, who love the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਪਵੈ ਛਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tin kee sevaa te har paaeeai sir ni(n)dak kai pavai chhaaraa ||3||
english: By their selfless service, they find the Lord, while ashes fall on the heads of the slanderers. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਿਰਤੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਛਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis ghar viratee soee jaanai jagat gur naanak poochh karahu beechaaraa ||
english: He alone knows this, who experiences it within the home of his own self. Ask Guru Nanak, the Guru of the world, and reflect upon it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਪੀੜੀ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੯॥
transliteration: chahu peeRee aad jugaad bakheelee kinai na paaio har sevak bhaai nisataaraa ||4||2||9||
english: Throughout the four generations of the Gurus, from the beginning of time and throughout the ages, no one has ever found the Lord by back-biting and undermining. Only by serving the Lord with love, is one emancipated. ||4||2||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਤੁ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jithai har aaraadheeai tithai har mit sahaaee ||
english: Wherever the Lord is worshipped in adoration, there the Lord becomes one's friend and helper.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te har man vasai horat bidh laiaa na jaaee ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind; He cannot be obtained in any other way. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har dhan sa(n)cheeai bhaaee ||
english: So gather in the wealth of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: j halat palat har hoi sakhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: so that in this world and the next, the Lord shall be your friend and companion. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟੀਐ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gatee sa(n)g har dhan khateeai hor thai horat upaai har dhan kitai na paaee ||
english: In the company of the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, you shall earn the wealth of the Lord; this wealth of the Lord is not obtained anywhere else, by any other means, at all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੈ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਧਨੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ ਕਚੈ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਵਾਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har ratanai kaa vaapaareeaa har ratan dhan vihaajhe kachai ke vaapaareee vaak har dhan laiaa na jaaee ||2||
english: The dealer in the Lord's Jewels purchases the wealth of the Lord's jewels; the dealer in cheap glass jewels cannot acquire the Lord's wealth by empty words. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਵੇਹਰੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੈ ਵਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har dhan ratan javehar maanak har dhanai naal a(n)mrit velai vatai har bhagatee har liv laaee ||
english: The Lord's wealth is like jewels, gems and rubies. At the appointed time in the Amrit Vaylaa, the ambrosial hours of the morning, the Lord's devotees lovingly center their attention on the Lord, and the wealth of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੈ ਵਤੈ ਕਾ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਭਗਤ ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੈ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har dhan a(n)mrit velai vatai kaa beejiaa bhagat khaai kharach rahe nikhutai naahee || halat palat har dhanai kee bhagataa kau milee vadiaaee ||3||
english: The devotees of the Lord plant the seed of the Lord's wealth in the ambrosial hours of the Amrit Vaylaa; they eat it, and spend it, but it is never exhausted. In this world and the next, the devotees are blessed with glorious greatness, the wealth of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਅਗਨੀ ਤਸਕਰੈ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਜਮਦੂਤੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har dhan nirabhau sadaa sadaa asathir hai saachaa ihu har dhan aganee tasakarai paaneeai jamadootai kisai kaa gavaaiaa na jaaee ||
english: The wealth of the Fearless Lord is permanent, forever and ever, and true. This wealth of the Lord cannot be destroyed by fire or water; neither thieves nor the Messenger of Death can take it away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਉਚਕਾ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਗਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har dhan kau uchakaa neR na aavaee jam jaagaatee da(n)d na lagaaee ||4||
english: Thieves cannot even approach the Lord's wealth; Death, the tax collector cannot tax it. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤੀ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਇਕ ਵਿਖ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saakatee paap kar kai bikhiaa dhan sa(n)chiaa tinaa ik vikh naal na jaaee ||
english: The faithless cynics commit sins and gather in their poisonous wealth, but it shall not go along with them for even a single step.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ ਭਏ ਹਥਹੁ ਛੁੜਕਿ ਗਇਆ ਅਗੈ ਪਲਤਿ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: halatai vich saakat duhele bhae hathahu chhuRak gaiaa agai palat saakat har daragah dhoee na paaee ||5||
english: In this world, the faithless cynics become miserable, as it slips away through their hands. In the world hereafter, the faithless cynics find no shelter in the Court of the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਲਦਿ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: is har dhan kaa saahu har aap hai sa(n)tahu jis no dei s har dhan lad chalaaee ||
english: The Lord Himself is the Banker of this wealth, O Saints; when the Lord gives it, the mortal loads it and takes it away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੈ ਕਾ ਤੋਟਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥੩॥੧੦॥
transliteration: is har dhanai kaa totaa kade na aavaee jan naanak kau gur sojhee paaee ||6||3||10||
english: This wealth of the Lord is never exhausted; the Guru has given this understanding to servant Nanak. ||6||3||10||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਰਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jis no har suprasa(n)n hoi so har gunaa ravai so bhagat so paravaan ||
english: That mortal, with whom the Lord is pleased, repeats the Glorious Praises of the Lord; he alone is a devotee, and he alone is approved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਵਰਨੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis kee mahimaa kiaa varaneeai jis kai hiradai vasiaa har purakh bhagavaan ||1||
english: How can his glory be described? Within his heart, the Primal Lord, the Lord God, abides. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਲਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: govi(n)d gun gaaeeai jeeu laai satiguroo naal dhiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe; focus your meditation on the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: so satiguroo saa sevaa satigur kee saphal hai jis te paaeeai param nidhaan ||
english: He is the True Guru - service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding. By this service, the greatest treasure is obtained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਅਰਥਿ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸਰੇਵਦੇ ਸੋ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਭੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo doojai bhaai saakat kaamanaa arath duraga(n)dh sarevade so nihaphal sabh agiaan ||2||
english: The faithless cynics in their love of duality and sensual desires, harbor foul-smelling urges. They are totally useless and ignorant. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਗਾਵਿਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jis no parateet hovai tis kaa gaaviaa thaai pavai so paavai daragah maan ||
english: One who has faith - his singing is approved. He is honored in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਰਤੀਤੀ ਕਪਟੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਅਖੀ ਮੀਟਦੇ ਉਨ ਕਾ ਉਤਰਿ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo bin parateetee kapatee kooRee kooRee akhee meetade un kaa utar jaaigaa jhooth gumaan ||3||
english: Those who lack faith may close their eyes, hypocritically pretending and faking devotion, but their false pretenses shall soon wear off. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jetaa jeeu pi(n)d sabh teraa too(n) a(n)tarajaamee purakh bhagavaan ||
english: My soul and body are totally Yours, Lord; You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, my Primal Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਾਇਹਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਹਉ ਕਰੀ ਵਖਿਆਨੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: daasan daas kahai jan naanak jehaa too(n) karaaihi tehaa hau karee vakhiaan ||4||4||11||
english: So speaks servant Nanak, the slave of Your slaves; as You make me speak, so do I speak. ||4||4||11||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ghar 7 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Seventh House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਗਾਵਾ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tere kavan kavan gun kahi kahi gaavaa too saahib gunee nidhaanaa ||
english: Which, which of Your Glorious Virtues should I sing and recount, Lord? You are my Lord and Master, the treasure of excellence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਊਚ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tumaree mahimaa baran na saakau too(n) thaakur ooch bhagavaanaa ||1||
english: I cannot express Your Glorious Praises. You are my Lord and Master, lofty and benevolent. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: mai har har naam dhar soee ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my only support.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakh mere saahib mai tujh bin avar na koee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If it pleases You, please save me, O my Lord and Master; without You, I have no other at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: mai taan deebaan toohai mere suaamee mai tudh aagai aradaas ||
english: You alone are my strength, and my Court, O my Lord and Master; unto You alone I pray.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mai hor thaau naahee jis pahi karau bena(n)tee meraa dukh sukh tujh hee paas ||2||
english: There is no other place where I can offer my prayers; I can tell my pains and pleasures only to You. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਚੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: viche dharatee viche paanee vich kaasat agan dhareejai ||
english: Water is locked up in the earth, and fire is locked up in wood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਕਰੀ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਇਕਤੈ ਥਾਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bakaree si(n)gh ikatai thaai raakhe man har jap bhram bhau door keejai ||3||
english: The sheep and the lions are kept in one place; O mortal, meditate on the Lord, and your doubts and fears shall be removed. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ਦੇਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har kee vadiaaee dekhahu sa(n)tahu har nimaaniaa maan devaae ||
english: So behold the glorious greatness of the Lord, O Saints; the Lord blesses the dishonored with honor.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਚਰਣ ਤਲੇ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਆਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥
transliteration: jiu dharatee charan tale te oopar aavai tiu naanak saadh janaa jagat aan sabh pairee paae ||4||1||12||
english: As dust rises from underfoot, O Nanak, so does the Lord make all people fall at the feet of the Holy. ||4||1||12||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: too(n) karataa sabh kichh aape jaanahi kiaa tudh pahi aakh sunaaeeai ||
english: You Yourself, O Creator, know everything; what can I possibly tell You?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: buraa bhalaa tudh sabh kichh soojhai jehaa ko kare tehaa ko paaeeai ||1||
english: You know all the bad and the good; as we act, so are we rewarded. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mere saahib too(n) a(n)tar kee bidh jaanahi ||
english: O my Lord and Master, You alone know the state of my inner being.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬੁਲਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: buraa bhalaa tudh sabh kichh soojhai tudh bhaavai tivai bulaavahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You know all the bad and the good; as it pleases You, so You make us speak. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh mohu maaiaa sareer har keeaa vich dehee maanukh bhagat karaaee ||
english: The Lord has infused the love of Maya into all bodies; through this human body, there comes the opportunity to worship the Lord with devotion.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ikanaa satigur mel sukh devahi ik manamukh dha(n)dh pitaaee ||2||
english: You unite some with the True Guru, and bless them with peace; while others, the self-willed manmukhs, are engrossed in worldly affairs. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko teraa too(n) sabhanaa kaa mere karate tudh sabhanaa sir likhiaa lekh ||
english: All belong to You, and You belong to all, O my Creator Lord; You wrote the words of destiny on the forehead of everyone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਭੇਖੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jehee too(n) nadar karahi tehaa ko hovai bin nadaree naahee ko bhekh ||3||
english: As You bestow Your Glance of Grace, so are mortals made; without Your Gracious Glance, no one assumes any form. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: teree vadiaaee too(n)hai jaanahi sabh tudhano nit dhiaae ||
english: You alone know Your Glorious Greatness; everyone constantly meditates on You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jis no tudh bhaavai tis no too(n) melahi jan naanak so thaai paae ||4||2||13||
english: That being, with whom You are pleased, is united with You; O servant Nanak, only such a mortal is accepted. ||4||2||13||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jin kai a(n)tar vasiaa meraa har har tin ke sabh rog gavaae ||
english: Those beings, within whose inner selves my Lord, Har, Har, dwells - all their diseases are cured.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: te mukat bhae jin har naam dhiaaiaa tin pavit param pad paae ||1||
english: They alone become liberated, who meditate on the Name of the Lord; they obtain the supreme status. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਆਰੋਗ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: mere raam har jan aarog bhae ||
english: O my Lord, the Lord's humble servants become healthy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਜਪਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur bachanee jinaa japiaa meraa har har tin ke haumai rog gae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who meditate on my Lord, Har, Har, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, are rid of the disease of ego. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਰੋਗੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahaadeu trai gun rogee vich haumai kaar kamaaee ||
english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva suffer from the disease of the three gunas - the three qualities; they do their deeds in egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin keee tisahi na chetahi bapuRe har guramukh sojhee paaee ||2||
english: The poor fools do not remember the One who created them; this understanding of the Lord is only obtained by those who become Gurmukh. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: haumai rog sabh jagat biaapiaa tin kau janam maran dukh bhaaree ||
english: The entire world is afflicted by the disease of egotism. They suffer the terrible pains of birth and death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਛੂਟੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ko viralaa chhootai tis jan kau hau balihaaree ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, a few rare ones are saved; I am a sacrifice to those humble beings. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: jin sisat saajee soee har jaanai taa kaa roop apaaro ||
english: The One who created the Universe, that Lord alone knows. His beauty is incomparable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak aape vekh har bigasai guramukh braham beechaaro ||4||3||14||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself gazes upon it, and is pleased. The Gurmukh contemplates God. ||4||3||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਸਰਬ ਰਜਾਈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਚੈ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੀਐ ॥
transliteration: keetaa karanaa sarab rajaaee kichh keechai je kar sakeeai ||
english: All that happens, and all that will happen, is by His Will. If we could do something by ourselves, we would.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aapanaa keetaa kichhoo na hovai jiu har bhaavai tiu rakheeai ||1||
english: By ourselves, we cannot do anything at all. As it pleases the Lord, He preserves us. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ॥
transliteration: mere har jeeu sabh ko terai vas ||
english: O my Dear Lord, everything is in Your power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਸਾਕਹ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬਖਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: asaa jor naahee je kichh kar ham saakah jiu bhaavai tivai bakhas ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have no power to do anything at all. As it pleases You, You forgive us. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh jeeu pi(n)d deeaa tudh aape tudh aape kaarai laaiaa ||
english: You Yourself bless us with soul, body and everything. You Yourself cause us to act.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਹੇ ਕੋ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jehaa too(n) hukam karahi tehe ko karam kamaavai jehaa tudh dhur likh paaiaa ||2||
english: As You issue Your Commands, so do we act, according to our pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀ ਕੋਈ ਛੇਵਾ ਕਰਿਉ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch tat kar tudh srisat sabh saajee koee chhevaa kariu je kichh keetaa hovai ||
english: You created the entire Universe out of the five elements; if anyone can create a sixth, let him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਬੁਝਾਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ikanaa satigur mel too(n) bujhaavahi ik manamukh karahi s rovai ||3||
english: You unite some with the True Guru, and cause them to understand, while others, the self-willed manmukhs, do their deeds and cry out in pain. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਉ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਾ ਹਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਨੀਚਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: har kee vadiaaee hau aakh na saakaa hau moorakh mugadh neechaan ||
english: I cannot describe the glorious greatness of the Lord; I am foolish, thoughtless, idiotic and lowly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪਇਆ ਅਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau har bakhas lai mere suaamee saranaagat paiaa ajaan ||4||4||15||24||
english: Please, forgive servant Nanak, O my Lord and Master; I am ignorant, but I have entered Your Sanctuary. ||4||4||15||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜੀਗਰਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: baajeegar jaise baajee paaee ||
english: The actor stages the play,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naanaa roop bhekh dikhalaaee ||
english: playing the many characters in different costumes;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਗੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਥੰਮੑਿਓ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)g utaar tha(n)mhio paasaaraa ||
english: but when the play ends, he takes off the costumes,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tab eko eka(n)kaaraa ||1||
english: and then he is one, and only one. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿਓ ਬਿਨਸਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kavan roop drisatio binasaaio ||
english: How many forms and images appeared and disappeared?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਤਹਿ ਗਇਓ ਉਹੁ ਕਤ ਤੇ ਆਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: katahi gaio uhu kat te aaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Where have they gone? Where did they come from? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਊਠਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jal te oothahi anik tara(n)gaa ||
english: Countless waves rise up from the water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਭੂਖਨ ਕੀਨੇ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: kanik bhookhan keene bahu ra(n)gaa ||
english: Jewels and ornaments of many different forms are fashioned from gold.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੀਜੁ ਬੀਜਿ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: beej beej dekhio bahu parakaaraa ||
english: I have seen seeds of all kinds being planted

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਪਾਕੇ ਤੇ ਏਕੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: phal paake te eka(n)kaaraa ||2||
english: - when the fruit ripens, the seeds appear in the same form as the original. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਘਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sahas ghataa mahi ek aakaas ||
english: The one sky is reflected in thousands of water jugs,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ ਤੇ ਓਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: ghat phoote te ohee pragaas ||
english: but when the jugs are broken, only the sky remains.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bharam lobh moh maaiaa vikaar ||
english: Doubt comes from greed, emotional attachment and the corruption of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਛੂਟੇ ਤੇ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhram chhoote te eka(n)kaar ||3||
english: Freed from doubt, one realizes the One Lord alone. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ohu abinaasee binasat naahee ||
english: He is imperishable; He will never pass away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: naa ko aavai naa ko jaahee ||
english: He does not come, and He does not go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai haumai mal dhoee ||
english: The Perfect Guru has washed away the filth of ego.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak meree param gat hoee ||4||1||
english: Says Nanak, I have obtained the supreme status. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: keetaa loRahi so prabh hoi ||
english: Whatever God wills, that alone happens.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin doojaa naahee koi ||
english: Without You, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਜ ॥
transliteration: jo jan seve tis pooran kaaj ||
english: The humble being serves Him, and so all his works are perfectly successful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daas apune kee raakhahu laaj ||1||
english: O Lord, please preserve the honor of Your slaves. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: teree saran pooran daiaalaa ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Perfect, Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin kavan kare pratipaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without You, who would cherish and love me? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: He is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: nikat vasai naahee prabh door ||
english: God dwells near at hand; He is not far away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਪਤੀਆਰੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: lok pateeaarai kachhoo na paaeeai ||
english: By trying to please other people, nothing is accomplished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਲਗੈ ਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saach lagai taa haumai jaaeeai ||2||
english: When someone is attached to the True Lord, his ego is taken away. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jis no laai lae so laagai ||
english: He alone is attached, whom the Lord Himself attaches.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: giaan ratan a(n)tar tis jaagai ||
english: The jewel of spiritual wisdom is awakened deep within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: duramat jaai param pad paae ||
english: Evil-mindedness is eradicated, and the supreme status is attained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee naam dhiaae ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: dui kar joR karau aradaas ||
english: Pressing my palms together, I offer my prayer;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਆਣਹਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: tudh bhaavai taa aanahi raas ||
english: if it pleases You, Lord, please bless me and fulfill me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apanee bhagatee laai ||
english: Grant Your Mercy, Lord, and bless me with devotion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak prabh sadaa dhiaai ||4||2||
english: Servant Nanak meditates on God forever. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: dhan sohaagan jo prabhoo pachhaanai ||
english: Blessed is that soul-bride, who realizes God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਜੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: maanai hukam tajai abhimaanai ||
english: She obeys the Hukam of His Order, and abandons her self-conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pri siu raatee raleeaa maanai ||1||
english: Imbued with her Beloved, she celebrates in delight. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਣ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sun sakheee prabh milan neesaanee ||
english: Listen, O my companions - these are the signs on the Path to meet God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਕਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man tan arap taj laaj lokaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Dedicate your mind and body to Him; stop living to please others. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sakhee sahelee kau samajhaavai ||
english: One soul-bride counsels another,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: soee kamaavai jo prabh bhaavai ||
english: to do only that which pleases God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saa sohaagan a(n)k samaavai ||2||
english: Such a soul-bride merges into the Being of God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹੇਲੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: garab gahelee mahal na paavai ||
english: One who is in the grip of pride does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈ ਜਬ ਰੈਣਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: phir pachhutaavai jab rain bihaavai ||
english: She regrets and repents, when her life-night passes away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਹੀਣਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karamaheen manamukh dukh paavai ||3||
english: The unfortunate self-willed manmukhs suffer in pain. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: binau karee je jaanaa door ||
english: I pray to God, but I think that He is far away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh abinaasee rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: God is imperishable and eternal; He is pervading and permeating everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak gaavai dekh hadoor ||4||3||
english: Servant Nanak sings of Him; I see Him Ever-present everywhere. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਵਸਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨਾ ਹਉ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: grihu vas gur keenaa hau ghar kee naar ||
english: The Giver has put this household of my being under my own control. I am now the mistress of the Lord's Home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਦਾਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਭਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: das daasee kar deenee bhataar ||
english: My Husband Lord has made the ten senses and organs of actions my slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਮੈ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਜੋੜੀ ॥
transliteration: sagal samagree mai ghar kee joRee ||
english: I have gathered together all the faculties and facilities of this house.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਪਿਰ ਕਉ ਲੋੜੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aas piaasee pir kau loRee ||1||
english: I am thirsty with desire and longing for my Husband Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਹਾ ਗੁਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kavan kahaa gun ka(n)t piaare ||
english: What Glorious Virtues of my Beloved Husband Lord should I describe?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਘੜ ਸਰੂਪ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sughaR saroop daiaal muraare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is All-knowing, totally beautiful and merciful; He is the Destroyer of ego. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਭਉ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sat seegaar bhau a(n)jan paaiaa ||
english: I am adorned with Truth, and I have applied the mascara of the Fear of God to my eyes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੰਬੋਲੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam ta(n)bol mukh khaaiaa ||
english: I have chewed the betel-leaf of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਗਨ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਗਹਨੇ ਬਨੇ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)gan basatr gahane bane suhaave ||
english: My bracelets, robes and ornaments beautifully adorn me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhan sabh sukh paavai jaa(n) pir ghar aavai ||2||
english: The soul-bride becomes totally happy, when her Husband Lord comes to her home. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਰੀਝਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gun kaaman kar ka(n)t reejhaaiaa ||
english: By the charms of virtue, I have enticed and fascinated my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vas kar leenaa gur bharam chukaaiaa ||
english: He is under my power - the Guru has dispelled my doubts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh te oochaa ma(n)dar meraa ||
english: My mansion is lofty and elevated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh kaaman tiaagee priu preetam meraa ||3||
english: Renouncing all other brides, my Beloved has become my lover. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਸੂਰੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pragatiaa soor jot ujeeaaraa ||
english: The sun has risen, and its light shines brightly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ਸਰਧ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sej vichhaaee saradh apaaraa ||
english: I have prepared my bed with infinite care and faith.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਰੰਗ ਲਾਲੁ ਸੇਜ ਰਾਵਣ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nav ra(n)g laal sej raavan aaiaa ||
english: My Darling Beloved is new and fresh; He has come to my bed to enjoy me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰ ਧਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak pir dhan mil sukh paaiaa ||4||4||
english: O Servant Nanak, my Husband Lord has come; the soul-bride has found peace. ||4||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਮਕਿਓ ਹੀਉ ਮਿਲਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: umakio heeu milan prabh taaee ||
english: An intense yearning to meet God has welled up in my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਚਰਿਓ ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: khojat chario dekhau pri jaaee ||
english: I have gone out searching to find my Beloved Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਤ ਸਦੇਸਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sunat sadesaro pri grihi sej vichhaaee ||
english: Hearing news of my Beloved, I have laid out my bed in my home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ਤਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhram bhram aaio tau nadar na paaee ||1||
english: Wandering, wandering all around, I came, but I did not even see Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੀਅਰੋ ਧੀਰੈ ਨਿਮਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: kin bidh heearo dheerai nimaano ||
english: How can this poor heart be comforted?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਜਨ ਹਉ ਤੁਝੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mil saajan hau tujh kurabaano ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Come and meet me, O Friend; I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛੀ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ekaa sej vichhee dhan ka(n)taa ||
english: One bed is spread out for the bride and her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਸੂਤੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਦ ਜਾਗੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: dhan sootee pir sad jaaga(n)taa ||
english: The bride is asleep, while her Husband Lord is always awake.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਓ ਮਦਰੋ ਧਨ ਮਤਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: peeo madaro dhan matava(n)taa ||
english: The bride is intoxicated, as if she has drunk wine.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਜਾਗੈ ਜੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਬੋਲੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhan jaagai je pir bola(n)taa ||2||
english: The soul-bride only awakens when her Husband Lord calls to her. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਨ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: bhaee niraasee bahut din laage ||
english: She has lost hope - so many days have passed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਮੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਝਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: des disa(n)tar mai sagale jhaage ||
english: I have travelled through all the lands and the countries.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਗ ਪਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: khin rahan na paavau bin pag paage ||
english: I cannot survive, even for an instant, without the feet of my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਹ ਸਭਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hoi kripaal prabh milah sabhaage ||3||
english: When God becomes Merciful, I become fortunate, and then I meet Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaio kripaal satasa(n)g milaaiaa ||
english: Becoming Merciful, He has united me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਘਰਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: boojhee tapat gharahi pir paaiaa ||
english: The fire has been quenched, and I have found my Husband Lord within my own home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਹੁਣਿ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sagal seegaar hun mujhahi suhaaiaa ||
english: I am now adorned with all sorts of decorations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur bharam chukaaiaa ||4||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਪਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah pir hai bhaaee ||
english: Wherever I look, I see my Husband Lord there, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਲੑਿਓ ਕਪਾਟੁ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kholhio kapaat taa man thaharaaee ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||5||
english: When the door is opened, then the mind is restrained. ||1||Second Pause||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kiaa gun tere saar samhaalee mohi niragun ke daataare ||
english: What virtues and excellences of Yours should I cherish and contemplate? I am worthless, while You are the Great Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਥਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bai khareed kiaa kare chaturaaee ihu jeeu pi(n)d sabh thaare ||1||
english: I am Your slave - what clever tricks could I ever try? This soul and body are totally Yours||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: laal ra(n)geele preetam manamohan tere darasan kau ham baare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O my Darling, Blissful Beloved, who fascinates my mind - I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਉਪਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh daataa mohi deen bhekhaaree tumh sadaa sadaa upakaare ||
english: O God, You are the Great Giver, and I am just a poor beggar; You are forever and ever benevolent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿ ਮੈ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so kichh naahee j mai te hovai mere thaakur agam apaare ||2||
english: I cannot accomplish anything by myself, O my Unapproachable and Infinite Lord and Master. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਰੀਝਾਵਉ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਦਰਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kiaa sev kamaavau kiaa kahi reejhaavau bidh kit paavau darasaare ||
english: What service can I perform? What should I say to please You? How can I gain the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਰਸੈ ਚਰਨਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mit nahee paaeeai a(n)t na laheeai man tarasai charanaare ||3||
english: Your extent cannot be found - Your limits cannot be found. My mind longs for Your Feet. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਢੀਠੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਗਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: paavau daan dheeth hoi maagau mukh laagai sa(n)t renaare ||
english: I beg with persistence to receive this gift, that the dust of the Saints might touch my face.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau gur kirapaa dhaaree prabh haath dei nisataare ||4||6||
english: The Guru has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; reaching out with His Hand, God has delivered him. ||4||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਥੋਰੀ ਮਾਗਨੁ ਬਹੁਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sevaa thoree maagan bahutaa ||
english: His service is insignificant, but his demands are very great.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕਹਤੋ ਪਹੁਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mahal na paavai kahato pahutaa ||1||
english: He does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, but he says that he has arrived there||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮਾਨੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਰੀਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jo pri maane tin kee reesaa ||
english: He competes with those who have been accepted by the Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੀ ਹਾਠੀਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kooRe moorakh kee haatheesaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This is how stubborn the false fool is! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bhekh dikhaavai sach na kamaavai ||
english: He wears religious robes, but he does not practice Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੋ ਮਹਲੀ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahato mahalee nikat na aavai ||2||
english: He says that he has found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, but he cannot even get near it. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤੀਤੁ ਸਦਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ateet sadaae maaiaa kaa maataa ||
english: He says that he is unattached, but he is intoxicated with Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man nahee preet kahai mukh raataa ||3||
english: There is no love in his mind, and yet he says that he is imbued with the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh binau suneejai ||
english: Says Nanak, hear my prayer, God:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਚਲੁ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਕਾਮੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kuchal kathor kaamee mukat keejai ||4||
english: I am silly, stubborn and filled with sexual desire - please, liberate me! ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: darasan dekhe kee vadiaaee ||
english: I gaze upon the glorious greatness of the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੭॥
transliteration: tumh sukhadaate purakh subhaaee ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||1||7||
english: You are the Giver of Peace, the Loving Primal Being. ||1||Second Pause||1||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰੇ ਕਾਮ ਕਉ ਊਠਿ ਖਲੋਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bure kaam kau ooth khaloiaa ||
english: He gets up early, to do his evil deeds,

author: Guru Arjan
