gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਸੋਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam kee belaa pai pai soiaa ||1||
english: but when it is time to meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, then he sleeps. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਸਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਨ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ausar apanaa boojhai na iaanaa ||
english: The ignorant person does not take advantage of the opportunity.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਰੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa moh ra(n)g lapataanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is attached to Maya, and engrossed in worldly delights. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਗਸਿ ਫੂਲਿ ਬੈਠਾ ॥
transliteration: lobh lahar kau bigas phool baithaa ||
english: He rides the waves of greed, puffed up with joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadh janaa kaa daras na deethaa ||2||
english: He does not see the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਸਮਝੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo na samajhai agiaan gavaaraa ||
english: The ignorant clown will never understand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਜੰਜਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bahur bahur lapatio ja(n)jaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Again and again, he becomes engrossed in entanglements. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਨਾਦ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਭੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bikhai naad karan sun bheenaa ||
english: He listens to the sounds of sin and the music of corruption, and he is pleased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਆਲਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har jas sunat aalas man keenaa ||3||
english: His mind is too lazy to listen to the Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਪੇਖਤ ਅੰਧੇ ॥
transliteration: drisat naahee re pekhat a(n)dhe ||
english: You do not see with your eyes - you are so blind!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਧੰਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chhod jaahi jhoothe sabh dha(n)dhe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall have to leave all these false affairs. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh bakhas kareejai ||
english: Says Nanak, please forgive me, God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi saadhasa(n)g deejai ||4||
english: Have Mercy upon me, and bless me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਉ ਹੋਈਐ ਰੇਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tau kichh paaeeai jau hoeeai renaa ||
english: He alone obtains something, who becomes the dust under the feet of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੨॥੮॥
transliteration: jisahi bujhaae tis naam lainaa ||1|| rahaau ||2||8||
english: And he alone repeats the Naam, whom God causes to understand. ||1||Pause||2||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ghar mahi thaakur nadar na aavai ||
english: Within the home of his own self, he does not even come to see his Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਲ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਹਣੁ ਲੈ ਲਟਕਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gal mahi paahan lai latakaavai ||1||
english: And yet, around his neck, he hangs a stone god. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਫਿਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bharame bhoolaa saakat phirataa ||
english: The faithless cynic wanders around, deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਰੁ ਬਿਰੋਲੈ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮਰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: neer birolai khap khap marataa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He churns water, and after wasting his life away, he dies. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਹਣ ਕਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਹਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jis paahan kau thaakur kahataa ||
english: That stone, which he calls his god,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਪਾਹਣੁ ਲੈ ਉਸ ਕਉ ਡੁਬਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ohu paahan lai us kau dubataa ||2||
english: that stone pulls him down and drowns him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰ ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: gunahagaar loon haraamee ||
english: O sinner, you are untrue to your own self;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਹਣ ਨਾਵ ਨ ਪਾਰਗਿਰਾਮੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paahan naav na paaragiraamee ||3||
english: a boat of stone will not carry you across. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gur mil naanak thaakur jaataa ||
english: Meeting the Guru, O Nanak, I know my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੯॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooran bidhaataa ||4||3||9||
english: The Perfect Architect of Destiny is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky. ||4||3||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਨੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਕਵਨ ਗਤੀ ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: laalan raaviaa kavan gatee ree ||
english: How have you enjoyed your Dear Beloved?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਮਤੀ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sakhee bataavahu mujhahi matee ree ||1||
english: O sister, please teach me, please show me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਬ ਸੂਹਬ ਸੂਹਵੀ ॥
transliteration: soohab soohab soohavee ||
english: Crimson, crimson, crimson

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: apane preetam kai ra(n)g ratee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - this is the color of the soul-bride who is imbued with the Love of her Beloved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੈਨ ਭਤੀਰੀ ॥
transliteration: paav malovau sa(n)g nain bhateeree ||
english: I wash Your Feet with my eye-lashes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਪਠਾਵਹੁ ਜਾਂਉ ਤਤੀ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jahaa pathaavahu jaa(n)u tatee ree ||2||
english: Wherever You send me, there I will go. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਦੇਉ ਜਤੀ ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam deu jatee ree ||
english: I would trade meditation, austerity, self-discipline and celibacy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੀ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ik nimakh milaavahu mohi praanapatee ree ||3||
english: if I could only meet the Lord of my life, for even an instant. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਹਤੀ ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maan taan aha(n)budh hatee ree ||
english: She who eradicates her self-conceit, power and arrogant intellect,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹਾਗਵਤੀ ਰੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: saa naanak sohaagavatee ree ||4||4||10||
english: O Nanak, is the true soul-bride. ||4||4||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) jeevan too(n) praan adhaaraa ||
english: You are my Life, the very Support of my breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tujh hee pekh pekh man saadhaaraa ||1||
english: Gazing upon You, beholding You, my mind is soothed and comforted. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) saajan too(n) preetam meraa ||
english: You are my Friend, You are my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chitahi na bisarahi kaahoo beraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I shall never forget You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ ਹਉ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bai khareed hau daasaro teraa ||
english: I am Your indentured servant; I am Your slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਭਾਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too(n) bhaaro thaakur gunee gaheraa ||2||
english: You are my Great Lord and Master, the treasure of excellence. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਸ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kot daas jaa kai darabaare ||
english: There are millions of servants in Your Court - Your Royal Darbaar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nimakh nimakh vasai tinh naale ||3||
english: Each and every instant, You dwell with them. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hau kichh naahee sabh kichh teraa ||
english: I am nothing; everything is Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੧॥
transliteration: ot pot naanak sa(n)g baseraa ||4||5||11||
english: Through and through, You abide with Nanak. ||4||5||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਮਹਲ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਊਚ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sookh mahal jaa ke ooch duaare ||
english: His Mansions are so comfortable, and His gates are so lofty.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸਹਿ ਭਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa mahi vaasahi bhagat piaare ||1||
english: Within them, His beloved devotees dwell. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaj kathaa prabh kee at meethee ||
english: The Natural Speech of God is so very sweet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਡੀਠੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: viralai kaahoo netrahu deethee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How rare is that person, who sees it with his eyes. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਅਖਾਰੇ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: tah geet naad akhaare sa(n)gaa ||
english: There, in the arena of the congregation, the divine music of the Naad, the sound current, is sung.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਹਾ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: oohaa sa(n)t karahi har ra(n)gaa ||2||
english: There, the Saints celebrate with their Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਹਰਖਾ ॥
transliteration: tah maran na jeevan sog na harakhaa ||
english: Neither birth nor death is there, neither pain nor pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਰਖਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saach naam kee a(n)mrit varakhaa ||3||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name rains down there. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਇਹ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: guhaj kathaa ih gur te jaanee ||
english: From the Guru, I have come to know the mystery of this speech.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak bolai har har baanee ||4||6||12||
english: Nanak speaks the Bani of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||6||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਪਾਪ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai daras paap kot utaare ||
english: By the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, millions of sins are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhetat sa(n)g ihu bhavajal taare ||1||
english: Meeting with them, this terrifying world-ocean is crossed over||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਸਾਜਨ ਓਇ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: oi saajan oi meet piaare ||
english: They are my companions, and they are my dear friends,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo ham kau har naam chitaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: who inspire me to remember the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa sabad sunat sukh saare ||
english: Hearing the Word of His Shabad, I am totally at peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa kee tahal jamadoot bidaare ||2||
english: When I serve Him, the Messenger of Death is chased away. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਧੀਰਕ ਇਸੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee dheerak is manahi sadhaare ||
english: His comfort and consolation soothes and supports my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran mukh ujalaare ||3||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, my face is radiant and bright. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh ke sevak prabh aap savaare ||
english: God embellishes and supports His servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੩॥
transliteration: saran naanak tinh sad balihaare ||4||7||13||
english: Nanak seeks the Protection of their Sanctuary; he is forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||7||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: rahan na paavahi sur nar devaa ||
english: The angelic beings and demi-gods are not permitted to remain here.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ooth sidhaare kar mun jan sevaa ||1||
english: The silent sages and humble servants also must arise and depart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਪੇਖੇ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jeevat pekhe jinhee har har dhiaaiaa ||
english: Only those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, are seen to live on.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g tinhee darasan paaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਮਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: baadisaah saah vaapaaree maranaa ||
english: Kings, emperors and merchants must die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਲਹਿ ਖਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo deesai so kaalahi kharanaa ||2||
english: Whoever is seen shall be consumed by death. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਿ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kooRai mohi lapat lapataanaa ||
english: Mortal beings are entangled, clinging to false worldly attachments.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chhod chaliaa taa phir pachhutaanaa ||3||
english: And when they must leave them behind, then they regret and grieve. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kripaa nidhaan naanak kau karahu daat ||
english: O Lord, O treasure of mercy, please bless Nanak with this gift,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naam teraa japee din raat ||4||8||14||
english: that he may chant Your Name, day and night. ||4||8||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਬਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar tumahi basaare ||
english: You dwell deep within the heart of each and every being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਸੂਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sagal samagree soot tumaare ||1||
english: The entire universe is strung on Your Thread. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: too(n) preetam too(n) praan adhaare ||
english: You are my Beloved, the Support of my breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tum hee pekh pekh man bigasaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Beholding You, gazing upon You, my mind blossoms forth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: anik jon bhram bhram bhram haare ||
english: Wandering, wandering, wandering through countless incarnations, I have grown so weary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਅਬ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ot gahee ab saadh sa(n)gaare ||2||
english: Now, I hold tight to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar alakh apaare ||
english: You are inaccessible, incomprehensible, invisible and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak simarai din rainaare ||3||9||15||
english: Nanak remembers You in meditation, day and night. ||3||9||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਾਜ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kavan kaaj maaiaa vadiaaee ||
english: What is the use of the glory of Maya?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kau binasat baar na kaaee ||1||
english: It disappears in no time at all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਸੋਵਤ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu supanaa sovat nahee jaanai ||
english: This is a dream, but the sleeper does not know it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚੇਤ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਮਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਨੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: achet bivasathaa mahi lapataanai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In his unconscious state, he clings to it. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mahaa mohi mohio gaavaaraa ||
english: The poor fool is enticed by the great attachments of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਤ ਪੇਖਤ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pekhat pekhat ooth sidhaaraa ||2||
english: Gazing upon them, watching them, he must still arise and depart. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ooch te ooch taa kaa darabaaraa ||
english: The Royal Court of His Darbaar is the highest of the high.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਜੰਤ ਬਿਨਾਹਿ ਉਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaee ja(n)t binaahi upaaraa ||3||
english: He creates and destroys countless beings. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: doosar hoaa naa ko hoee ||
english: There has never been any other, and there shall never be.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੬॥
transliteration: jap naanak prabh eko soee ||4||10||16||
english: O Nanak, meditate on the One God. ||4||10||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
transliteration: simar simar taa kau hau jeevaa ||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਤੇਰੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charan kamal tere dhoi dhoi peevaa ||1||
english: I wash Your Lotus Feet, and drink in the wash water. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: so har meraa a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: He is my Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kai sa(n)g suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My Lord and Master abides with His humble devotees. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sun sun a(n)mrit naam dhiaavaa ||
english: Hearing, hearing Your Ambrosial Naam, I meditate on it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aath pahar tere gun gaavaa ||2||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਲੀਲਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: pekh pekh leelaa man aana(n)daa ||
english: Beholding, beholding Your divine play, my mind is in bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gun apaar prabh paramaana(n)daa ||3||
english: Your Glorious Virtues are infinite, O God, O Lord of supreme bliss. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran kachh bhau na biaapai ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, fear cannot touch me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੭॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa naanak har jaapai ||4||11||17||
english: Forever and ever, Nanak meditates on the Lord. ||4||11||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bachan ridai dhiaan dhaaree ||
english: Within my heart, I meditate on the Word of the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rasanaa jaap japau banavaaree ||1||
english: With my tongue, I chant the Chant of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saphal moorat darasan balihaaree ||
english: The image of His vision is fruitful; I am a sacrifice to it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal man praan adhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: His Lotus Feet are the Support of the mind, the Support of the very breath of life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g janam maran nivaaree ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the cycle of birth and death is ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਰਨ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit kathaa sun karan adhaaree ||2||
english: To hear the Ambrosial Sermon is the support of my ears. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਤਜਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh moh tajaaree ||
english: I have renounced sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਸੁਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: driR naam daan isanaan suchaaree ||3||
english: I have enshrined the Naam within myself, with charity, true cleansing and righteous conduct. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ihu tat beechaaree ||
english: Says Nanak, I have contemplated this essence of reality;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੮॥
transliteration: raam naam jap paar utaaree ||4||12||18||
english: chanting the Name of the Lord, I am carried across. ||4||12||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਗਨ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ॥
transliteration: lobh mohi magan aparaadhee ||
english: The sinner is absorbed in greed and emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਸਾਧੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karanahaar kee sev na saadhee ||1||
english: He has not performed any service to the Creator Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan prabh naam tumaare ||
english: O God, Your Name is the Purifier of sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raakh lehu mohi niraguneeaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am worthless - please save me! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) daataa prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: O God, You are the Great Giver, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaachee deh maanukh abhimaanee ||2||
english: The body of the egotistical human is perishable. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਦ ਬਾਦ ਈਰਖ ਮਦ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: suaad baad eerakh mad maaiaa ||
english: Tastes and pleasures, conflicts and jealousy, and intoxication with Maya

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: in sa(n)g laag ratan janam gavaaiaa ||3||
english: - attached to these, the jewel of human life is wasted. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dukh bha(n)jan jagajeevan har raaiaa ||
english: The Sovereign Lord King is the Destroyer of pain, the Life of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੯॥
transliteration: sagal tiaag naanak saranaaiaa ||4||13||19||
english: Forsaking everything, Nanak has entered His Sanctuary. ||4||13||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਤ ਚਾਖਤ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਅੰਧਾ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: pekhat chaakhat kaheeat a(n)dhaa suneeat suneeai naahee ||
english: He sees with his eyes, but he is called blind; he hears, but he does not hear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਰੇ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nikat vasat kau jaanai doore paapee paap kamaahee ||1||
english: And the One who dwells near at hand, he thinks that He is far away; the sinner is committing sins. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: so kichh kar jit chhutahi paraanee ||
english: Do only those deeds which will save you, O mortal being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam jap a(n)mrit baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and the Ambrosial Word of His Bani. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੋਰ ਮਹਲ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ghor mahal sadaa ra(n)g raataa ||
english: You are forever imbued with the love of horses and mansions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)g tumhaarai kachhoo na jaataa ||2||
english: Nothing shall go along with you. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਖਹਿ ਪੋਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਕਾ ਭਾਂਡਾ ॥
transliteration: rakhahi pochaar maatee kaa bhaa(n)daa ||
english: You may clean and decorate the vessel of clay,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਮ ਡਾਂਡਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: at kucheel milai jam daa(n)daa ||3||
english: but it is so very filthy; it shall receive its punishment from the Messenger of Death. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohi baadhaa ||
english: You are bound by sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਗਰਤ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਘਰਤ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: mahaa garat mahi nigharat jaataa ||4||
english: You are sinking down into the great pit. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: naanak kee aradaas suneejai ||
english: Hear this prayer of Nanak, O Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡੂਬਤ ਪਾਹਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੫॥੧੪॥੨੦॥
transliteration: doobat paahan prabh mere leejai ||5||14||20||
english: I am a stone, sinking down - please, rescue me! ||5||14||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਬੁਝੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jeevat marai bujhai prabh soi ||
english: One who remains dead while yet alive understands God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis jan karam paraapat hoi ||1||
english: He meets that humble being according to the karma of his past actions. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਇਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sun saajan iu dutar tareeai ||
english: Listen, O friend - this is how to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhoo har naam uchareeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meet with the Holy, and chant the Lord's Name||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: ek binaa doojaa nahee jaanai ||
english: There is no other to know, except for the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar paarabraham pachhaanai ||2||
english: So realize that the Supreme Lord God is within each and every heart. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karai soee bhal maanai ||
english: Whatever He does, accept that as good.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aad a(n)t kee keemat jaanai ||3||
english: Know the value of the beginning and the end. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tis jan balihaaree ||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to that humble being,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: jaa kai hiradai vasahi muraaree ||4||15||21||
english: within whose heart the Lord dwells. ||4||15||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur paramesar karanaihaar ||
english: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਉ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sagal srisat kau de aadhaar ||1||
english: He gives His Support to the entire Universe. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan kamal man dhiaai ||
english: Meditate within your mind on the Lotus Feet of the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dookh darad is tan te jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Pain and suffering shall leave this body. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੂਬਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
transliteration: bhavajal doobat satigur kaadhai ||
english: The True Guru saves the drowning being from the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਟੂਟਾ ਗਾਢੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa tootaa gaadhai ||2||
english: He reunites those who were separated for countless incarnations. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa karahu din raat ||
english: Serve the Guru, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਮਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj man aavai saa(n)t ||3||
english: Your mind shall come to have peace, pleasure and poise. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee ren vadabhaagee paavai ||
english: By great good fortune, one obtains the dust of the feet of the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak gur kau sad bal jaavai ||4||16||22||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||4||16||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gur apune oopar bal jaaeeai ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aath pahar har har jas gaaeeai ||1||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: simarau so prabh apanaa suaamee ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on God, your Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal ghataa kaa a(n)tarajaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu laagee preet ||
english: So love the Lord's Lotus Feet,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saachee pooran niramal reet ||2||
english: and live a lifestyle which is true, perfect and spotless. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad vasai man maahee ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh jaahee ||3||
english: and the sins of countless incarnations are eradicated. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh deen daiaalaa ||
english: Please be Merciful, O God, O Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak maagai sa(n)t ravaalaa ||4||17||23||
english: Nanak begs for the dust of the Saints. ||4||17||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: darasan dekh jeevaa gur teraa ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pooran karam hoi prabh meraa ||1||
english: My karma is perfect, O my God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ih bena(n)tee sun prabh mere ||
english: Please, listen to this prayer, O my God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਣੇ ਚੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dehi naam kar apane chere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please bless me with Your Name, and make me Your chaylaa, Your disciple. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: apanee saran raakh prabh daate ||
english: Please keep me under Your Protection, O God, O Great Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur prasaad kinai viralai jaate ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, a few people understand this. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬਿਨਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sunahu binau prabh mere meetaa ||
english: Please hear my prayer, O God, my Friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਵਸਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: charan kamal vasahi merai cheetaa ||3||
english: May Your Lotus Feet abide within my consciousness. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਰੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak ek karai aradaas ||
english: Nanak makes one prayer:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੨੪॥
transliteration: visar naahee pooran gunataas ||4||18||24||
english: may I never forget You, O perfect treasure of virtue. ||4||18||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: meet saajan sut ba(n)dhap bhaaee ||
english: He is my friend, companion, child, relative and sibling.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jat kat pekhau har sa(n)g sahaaee ||1||
english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord as my companion and helper. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jat meree pat meree dhan har naam ||
english: The Lord's Name is my social status, my honor and wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਬਿਸਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d bisaraam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is my pleasure, poise, bliss and peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਸਨਾਹ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham jap pahir sanaah ||
english: I have strapped on the armor of meditation on the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਆਵਧ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੇਧਤ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kot aavadh tis bedhat naahi ||2||
english: It cannot be pierced, even by millions of weapons. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਣ ਗੜ ਕੋਟ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: har charan saran gaR kot hamaarai ||
english: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet is my fortress and battlement.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਜਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਬਿਦਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaal ka(n)tak jam tis na bidaarai ||3||
english: The Messenger of Death, the torturer, cannot demolish it. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak daas sadaa balihaaree ||
english: Slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੰਤ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੨੫॥
transliteration: sevak sa(n)t raajaa raam muraaree ||4||19||25||
english: to the selfless servants and Saints of the Sovereign Lord, the Destroyer of ego. ||4||19||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: gun gopaal prabh ke nit gaahaa ||
english: Where the Glorious Praises of God, the Lord of the world are continually sung,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਖ ਤਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anad binod ma(n)gal sukh taahaa ||1||
english: there is bliss, joy, happiness and peace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵਣ ਜਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: chal sakheee prabh raavan jaahaa ||
english: Come, O my companions - let us go and enjoy God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਪਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadh janaa kee charanee paahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Let us fall at the feet of the holy, humble beings. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਛਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: kar benatee jan dhoor baachhaahaa ||
english: I pray for the dust of the feet of the humble.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਲਾਹਾਂ ॥੨॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh laahaa(n) ||2||
english: It shall wash away the sins of countless incarnations. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਜੀਉ ਅਰਪਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan praan jeeu arapaahaa ||
english: I dedicate my mind, body, breath of life and soul to God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਟਾਹਾਂ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har simar simar maan mohu kataahaa(n) ||3||
english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, I have eradicated pride and emotional attachment. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਤਸਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal karahu utasaahaa ||
english: O Lord, O Merciful to the meek, please give me faith and confidence,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੨੬॥
transliteration: naanak daas har saran samaahaa ||4||20||26||
english: so that slave Nanak may remain absorbed in Your Sanctuary. ||4||20||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਨਗਰੁ ਜਹਾ ਸੰਤ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: baiku(n)th nagar jahaa sa(n)t vaasaa ||
english: The city of heaven is where the Saints dwell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh charan kamal rid maahi nivaasaa ||1||
english: They enshrine the Lotus Feet of God within their hearts. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਤੁਝੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਿਖਲਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: sun man tan tujh sukh dikhalaavau ||
english: Listen, O my mind and body, and let me show you the way to find peace,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਤੁਝੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੁੰਚਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har anik bi(n)jan tujh bhog bhu(n)chaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: so that you may eat and enjoy the various delicacies of the Lord||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੁੰਚੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam bhu(n)ch man maahee ||
english: Taste the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜ ਸਾਦ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਬਰਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: acharaj saad taa ke barane na jaahee ||2||
english: Its taste is wondrous - it cannot be described. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੁ ਮੂਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਥਾਕੀ ॥
transliteration: lobh mooaa trisanaa bujh thaakee ||
english: Your greed shall die, and your thirst shall be quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਨ ਤਾਕੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paarabraham kee saran jan taakee ||3||
english: The humble beings seek the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke bhai moh nivaare ||
english: The Lord dispels the fears and attachments of countless incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak daas prabh kirapaa dhaare ||4||21||27||
english: God has showered His Mercy and Grace upon slave Nanak. ||4||21||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬੀਂਗ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: anik bee(n)g daas ke parahariaa ||
english: God covers the many shortcomings of His slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh apanaa kariaa ||1||
english: Granting His Mercy, God makes them His own. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਛਡਾਇ ਲੀਓ ਜਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tumahi chhadaai leeo jan apanaa ||
english: You emancipate Your humble servant,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: urajh pario jaal jag supanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and rescue him from the noose of the world, which is just a dream. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਬਤ ਦੋਖ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਰਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: parabat dokh mahaa bikaraalaa ||
english: Even huge mountains of sin and corruption

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khin mahi door keee daiaalaa ||2||
english: are removed in an instant by the Merciful Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਗ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sog rog bipat at bhaaree ||
english: Sorrow, disease and the most terrible calamities

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਿ ਭਈ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: door bhaee jap naam muraaree ||3||
english: are removed by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: drisat dhaar leeno laR laai ||
english: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He attaches us to the hem of His robe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੨੮॥
transliteration: har charan gahe naanak saranaai ||4||22||28||
english: Grasping the Lord's Feet, O Nanak, we enter His Sanctuary. ||4||22||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨੁ ਛਡਾਇ ਦੁਨੀ ਜੋ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: deen chhadaai dunee jo laae ||
english: One who withdraws from God's Path, and attaches himself to the world,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੀ ਸਰਾਈ ਖੁਨਾਮੀ ਕਹਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: duhee saraaee khunaamee kahaae ||1||
english: is known as a sinner in both worlds. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so paravaan ||
english: He alone is approved, who pleases the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aapanee kudarat aape jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Only He Himself knows His creative omnipotence. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sachaa dharam pu(n)n bhalaa karaae ||
english: One who practices truth, righteous living, charity and good deeds,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਕੈ ਤੋਸੈ ਦੁਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: deen kai tosai dunee na jaae ||2||
english: has the supplies for God's Path. Worldly success shall not fail him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: sarab nira(n)tar eko jaagai ||
english: Within and among all, the One Lord is awake.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jit jit laaiaa tit tit ko laagai ||3||
english: As He attaches us, so are we attached. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar sach saahib meraa ||
english: You are inaccessible and unfathomable, O my True Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak bolai bolaaiaa teraa ||4||23||29||
english: Nanak speaks as You inspire him to speak. ||4||23||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਤਹਕਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: praatahakaal har naam uchaaree ||
english: In the early hours of the morning, I chant the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: eet oot kee ot savaaree ||1||
english: I have fashioned a shelter for myself, hear and hereafter. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa japeeai har naam ||
english: Forever and ever, I chant the Lord's Name,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pooran hovahi man ke kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and the desires of my mind are fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh abinaasee rain din gaau ||
english: Sing the Praises of the Eternal, Imperishable Lord God, night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਤ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jeevat marat nihachal paavahi thaau ||2||
english: In life, and in death, you shall find your eternal, unchanging home. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਹੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so saahu sev jit tot na aavai ||
english: So serve the Sovereign Lord, and you shall never lack anything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਸੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khaat kharachat sukh anad vihaavai ||3||
english: While eating and consuming, you shall pass your life in peace. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan purakh saadhasa(n)g paaiaa ||
english: O Life of the World, O Primal Being, I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੦॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak naam dhiaaiaa ||4||24||30||
english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||24||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: gur poore jab bhae daiaal ||
english: When the Perfect Guru becomes merciful,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dukh binase pooran bhaee ghaal ||1||
english: my pains are taken away, and my works are perfectly completed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pekh pekh jeevaa daras tumhaaraa ||
english: Gazing upon, beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਜਾਈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal jaaee balihaaraa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to Your Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਵਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin thaakur kavan hamaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without You, O my Lord and Master, who belongs to me? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat siu preet ban aaee ||
english: I have fallen in love with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: poorab karam likhat dhur paaee ||2||
english: by the karma of my past actions and my pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: jap har har naam acharaj parataap ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; how wondrous is His glory!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਲਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਤੀਨੇ ਤਾਪ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaal na saakahi teene taap ||3||
english: The three types of illness cannot consume it. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: nimakh na bisarahi har charan tumhaare ||
english: May I never forget, even for an instant, the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak maagai daan piaare ||4||25||31||
english: Nanak begs for this gift, O my Beloved. ||4||25||31||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: se sa(n)jog karahu mere piaare ||
english: May there be such an auspicious time, O my Beloved,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jit rasanaa har naam uchaare ||1||
english: when, with my tongue, I may chant the Lord's Name||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sun benatee prabh deen daiaalaa ||
english: Hear my prayer, O God, O Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਰਸਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadh gaavahi gun sadaa rasaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Holy Saints ever sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Source of Nectar. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jeevan roop simaran prabh teraa ||
english: Your meditation and remembrance is life-giving, God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis kripaa karahi basahi tis neraa ||2||
english: You dwell near those upon whom You show mercy. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jan kee bhookh teraa naam ahaar ||
english: Your Name is the food to satisfy the hunger of Your humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too(n) daataa prabh devanahaar ||3||
english: You are the Great Giver, O Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: raam ramat sa(n)tan sukh maanaa ||
english: The Saints take pleasure in repeating the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੩੨॥
transliteration: naanak devanahaar sujaanaa ||4||26||32||
english: O Nanak, the Lord, the Great Giver, is All-knowing. ||4||26||32||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹਤੀ ਜਾਤ ਕਦੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਧਾਰਤ ॥
transliteration: bahatee jaat kade drisat na dhaarat ||
english: Your life is slipping away, but you never even notice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹ ਬੰਧਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਰਚ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mithiaa moh ba(n)dhahi nit paarach ||1||
english: You are constantly entangled in false attachments and conflicts. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਭਜੁ ਦਿਨ ਨਿਤ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: maadhave bhaj din nit rainee ||
english: Meditate, vibrate constantly, day and night, on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam padaarath jeet har saranee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall be victorious in this priceless human life, in the Protection of the Lord's Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੋਊ ਕਰ ਝਾਰਤ ॥
transliteration: karat bikaar dooo kar jhaarat ||
english: You eagerly commit sins and practice corruption,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਰਿਦ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਧਾਰਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam ratan rid til nahee dhaarat ||2||
english: But you do not enshrine the jewel of the Lord's Name within your heart, even for an instant. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਣ ਪੋਖਣ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: bharan pokhan sa(n)g audh bihaanee ||
english: Feeding and pampering your body, your life is passing away,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jai jagadees kee gat nahee jaanee ||3||
english: but you do not experience the state of victory of the Lord of the Universe. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: saran samarath agochar suaamee ||
english: So enter the Sanctuary of the All-powerful, Unfathomable Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਧਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੩੩॥
transliteration: udhar naanak prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||4||27||33||
english: O God, O Searcher of hearts, please, save Nanak! ||4||27||33||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g tarai bhai saagar ||
english: Cross over the terrifying world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har naam simar ratanaagar ||1||
english: Remember in meditation the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the source of jewels. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: simar simar jeevaa naaraain ||
english: Remembering, remembering the Lord in meditation, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਪ ਤਜਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dookh rog sog sabh binase gur poore mil paap tajaain ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All pain, disease and suffering is dispelled, meeting the Perfect Guru; sin has been eradicated. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jeevan padavee har kaa naau ||
english: The immortal status is obtained through the Name of the Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man tan niramal saach suaau ||2||
english: the mind and body become spotless and pure, which is the true purpose of life. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar paarabraham dhiaaeeai ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: poorab likhat hoi taa paaeeai ||3||
english: By pre-ordained destiny, the Name is obtained. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਏ ਜਪਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: saran pae jap deen daiaalaa ||
english: I have entered His Sanctuary, and I meditate on the Lord, Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak jaachai sa(n)t ravaalaa ||4||28||34||
english: Nanak longs for the dust of the Saints. ||4||28||34||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਕਾ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਰੂੜਾ ॥
transliteration: ghar kaa kaaj na jaanee rooRaa ||
english: The beautiful one does not know the work of his own home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੈ ਧੰਧੈ ਰਚਿਓ ਮੂੜਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jhoothai dha(n)dhai rachio mooRaa ||1||
english: The fool is engrossed in false attachments. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jit too(n) laavahi tit tit laganaa ||
english: As You attach us, so we are attached.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa too(n) dehi teraa naau japanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When You bless us with Your Name, we chant it. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: har ke daas har setee raate ||
english: The Lord's slaves are imbued with the Love of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam rasaain anadin maate ||2||
english: They are intoxicated with the Lord, night and day. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਢੇ ॥
transliteration: baah pakar prabh aape kaadhe ||
english: Reaching out to grasp hold of our arms, God lifts us up.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਟੂਟੇ ਗਾਢੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam janam ke toote gaadhe ||3||
english: Separated for countless incarnations, we are united with Him again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਧਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: udhar suaamee prabh kirapaa dhaare ||
english: Save me, O God, O my Lord and Master - shower me with Your Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੩੫॥
transliteration: naanak daas har saran duaare ||4||29||35||
english: Slave Nanak seeks Sanctuary at Your Door, O Lord. ||4||29||35||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad nihachal ghar paaiaa ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, I have found my eternal home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਡੋੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarab sookh phir nahee doulaaiaa ||1||
english: I have found total peace, and I shall not waver again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਨੑੇ ॥
transliteration: guroo dhiaai har charan man cheenhe ||
english: I meditate on the Guru, and the Lord's Feet, within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਰਤੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕੀਨੑੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taa te karatai asathir keenhe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In this way, the Creator Lord has made me steady and stable. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavat achut abinaasee ||
english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the unchanging, eternal Lord God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa te kaatee jam kee phaasee ||2||
english: and the noose of death is snapped. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa leene laR laae ||
english: Showering His Mercy, he has attached me to the hem of His robe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥੩੦॥੩੬॥
transliteration: sadaa anad naanak gun gaae ||3||30||36||
english: In constant bliss, Nanak sings His Glorious Praises. ||3||30||36||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit bachan saadh kee baanee ||
english: The Words, the Teachings of the Holy Saints, are Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo jo japai tis kee gat hovai har har naam nit rasan bakhaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whoever meditates on the Lord's Name is emancipated; he chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with his tongue. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਕਲੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: kalee kaal ke mite kalesaa ||
english: The pains and sufferings of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga are eradicated,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: eko naam man mahi paravesaa ||1||
english: when the One Name abides within the mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo dhoor mukh masatak laaee ||
english: I apply the dust of the feet of the Holy to my face and forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥੩੧॥੩੭॥
transliteration: naanak udhare har gur saranaaee ||2||31||37||
english: Nanak has been saved, in the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord. ||2||31||37||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl: Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)daa gun gaau daiaalaa ||
english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: darasan dehu pooran kirapaalaa || rahaau ||
english: Please, bless me with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Perfect, Compassionate Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa tum hee pratipaalaa ||
english: Please, grant Your Grace, and cherish me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tumaraa maalaa ||1||
english: My soul and body are all Your property. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਲੈ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam chalai jap naalaa ||
english: Only meditation on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, will go along with you.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak jaachai sa(n)t ravaalaa ||2||32||38||
english: Nanak begs for the dust of the Saints. ||2||32||38||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na koee ||
english: Without Him, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਥੰਮੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape tha(n)mai sachaa soee ||1||
english: The True Lord Himself is our anchor. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har har naam meraa aadhaar ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is our only support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath apaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Creator, the Cause of causes, is All-powerful and Infinite. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਾਵੇ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh rog mitaave navaa niroaa ||
english: He has eradicated all illness, and healed me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਖਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਆ ॥੨॥੩੩॥੩੯॥
transliteration: naanak rakhaa aape hoaa ||2||33||39||
english: O Nanak, He Himself has become my Savior. ||2||33||39||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: darasan kau lochai sabh koee ||
english: Everyone longs for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag paraapat hoee || rahaau ||
english: By perfect destiny, it is obtained. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਆਮ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਜਿ ਨੀਦ ਕਿਉ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: siaam su(n)dar taj need kiu aaee ||
english: Forsaking the Beautiful Lord, how can they go to sleep?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਦੂਤਾ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mahaa mohanee dootaa laaee ||1||
english: The great enticer Maya has led them down the path of sin. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹਾ ਕਰਤ ਕਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: prem bichhohaa karat kasaaee ||
english: This butcher has separated them from the Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਦੈ ਜੰਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: niradai ja(n)t tis daiaa na paaee ||2||
english: This merciless one shows no mercy at all to the poor beings. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਬੀਤੀਅਨ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: anik janam beeteean bharamaaee ||
english: Countless lifetimes have passed away, wandering aimlessly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੁਤਰ ਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ghar vaas na devai dutar maaee ||3||
english: The terrible, treacherous Maya does not even allow them to dwell in their own home. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: din rain apanaa keeaa paaee ||
english: Day and night, they receive the rewards of their own actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਭਵਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kis dos na deejai kirat bhavaaee ||4||
english: Don't blame anyone else; your own actions lead you astray. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sun saajan sa(n)t jan bhaaee ||
english: Listen, O Friend, O Saint, O humble Sibling of Destiny:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥੩੪॥੪੦॥
transliteration: charan saran naanak gat paaee ||5||34||40||
english: in the Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet, Nanak has found Salvation. ||5||34||40||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 ghar 4 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਲੀ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਛਾਪਰੀ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhalee suhaavee chhaaparee jaa mahi gun gaae ||
english: Even a crude hut is sublime and beautiful, if the Lord's Praises are sung within it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਧਉਲਹਰ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kit hee kaam na dhaulahar jit har bisaraae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those mansions where the Lord is forgotten are useless. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: anad gareebee saadhasa(n)g jit prabh chit aae ||
english: Even poverty is bliss, if God comes to mind in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਏਹੁ ਬਡਪਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਪਟਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jal jaau ehu badapanaa maaiaa lapataae ||1||
english: This worldly glory might just as well burn; it only traps the mortals in Maya. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਸਨੁ ਪੀਸਿ ਓਢਿ ਕਾਮਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: peesan pees odh kaamaree sukh man sa(n)tokhaae ||
english: One may have to grind corn, and wear a coarse blanket, but still, one can find peace of mind and contentment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aiso raaj na kitai kaaj jit nah tripataae ||2||
english: Even empires are of no use at all, if they do not bring satisfaction. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nagan phirat ra(n)g ek kai ohu sobhaa paae ||
english: Someone may wander around naked, but if he loves the One Lord, he receives honor and respect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਬਿਰਥਿਆ ਜਿਹ ਰਚਿ ਲੋਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paat pata(n)bar birathiaa jih rach lobhaae ||3||
english: Silk and satin clothes are worthless, if they lead to greed. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh tumhrai haath prabh aap kare karaae ||
english: Everything is in Your Hands, God. You Yourself are the Doer, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੧॥
transliteration: saas saas simarat rahaa naanak daan paae ||4||1||41||
english: With each and every breath, may I continue to remember You. Please, bless Nanak with this gift. ||4||1||41||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਪਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਨਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa sa(n)t paraan dhan tis kaa panihaaraa ||
english: The Lord's Saint is my life and wealth. I am his water-carrier.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਸਗਲ ਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee meet sut sagal te jee hoo(n) te piaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is dearer to me than all my siblings, friends and children. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਸਾ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਜਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਚਉਰੁ ਢੁਲਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: kesaa kaa kar beejanaa sa(n)t chaur dhulaavau ||
english: I make my hair into a fan, and wave it over the Saint.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ਚਰਣ ਤਲਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sees nihaarau charan tal dhoor mukh laavau ||1||
english: I bow my head low, to touch his feet, and apply his dust to my face. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਸਟ ਬਚਨ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਉ ਦੀਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: misat bachan benatee karau deen kee niaaee ||
english: I offer my prayer with sweet words, in sincere humility.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taj abhimaan saranee parau har gun nidh paaee ||2||
english: Renouncing egotism, I enter His Sanctuary. I have found the Lord, the treasure of virtue. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਲੋਕਨ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਕਰਉ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: avalokan punah punah karau jan kaa darasaar ||
english: I gaze upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's humble servant, again and again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਚਉ ਬੰਦਉ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit bachan man mahi si(n)chau ba(n)dau baar baar ||3||
english: I cherish and gather in His Ambrosial Words within my mind; time and time again, I bow to Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਕਰਉ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਗਉ ॥
transliteration: chitavau man aasaa karau jan kaa sa(n)g maagau ||
english: In my mind, I wish, hope and beg for the Society of the Lord's humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੨॥
transliteration: naanak kau prabh daiaa kar daas charanee laagau ||4||2||42||
english: Be Merciful to Nanak, O God, and lead him to the feet of Your slaves. ||4||2||42||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਤਾਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin mohe brahama(n)d kha(n)d taahoo mahi paau ||
english: She has enticed the worlds and solar systems; I have fallen into her clutches.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਖਈ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raakh lehu ihu bikhaee jeeu dehu apunaa naau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Lord, please save this corrupt soul of mine; please bless me with Your Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਸੁਖੀ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa te naahee ko sukhee taa kai paachhai jaau ||
english: She has not brought anyone peace, but still, I chase after her.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਸਗਲ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਪਟਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chhod jaahi jo sagal kau phir phir lapataau ||1||
english: She forsakes everyone, but still, I cling to her, again and again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karahu kripaa karunaapate tere har gun gaau ||
english: Have Mercy on me, O Lord of Compassion; please let me sing Your Glorious Praises, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੨॥੩॥੪੩॥
transliteration: naanak kee prabh benatee saadhasa(n)g samaau ||2||3||43||
english: This is Nanak's prayer, O Lord, that he may join and merge with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||3||43||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 ghar 5 paRataal ||
english: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House, Partaal:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੁਰੀਆ ਮੋਹਨ ਲਾਲਨਾ ॥
transliteration: preet preet gureeaa mohan laalanaa ||
english: Love of the enticing Beloved Lord is the most glorious love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਏਕੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੈ ਸੰਤ ਲਾਗੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਛਾਡੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਕੀ ਕੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jap man gobi(n)d ekai avar nahee ko lekhai sa(n)t laag manahi chhaad dubidhaa kee kureeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditate, O mind, on the One Lord of the Universe - nothing else is of any account. Attach your mind to the Saints, and abandon the path of duality. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਹਰੀਆ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਧਰੀਆ ਅਨਿਕ ਕੋਠਰੀਆ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿਨ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: niragun hareeaa saragun dhareeaa anik kothareeaa bhi(n)n bhi(n)n bhi(n)n bhin kareeaa ||
english: The Lord is absolute and unmanifest; He has assumed the most sublime manifestation. He has fashioned countless body chambers of many, varied, different, myriad forms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਮਨ ਕੋਟਵਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: vich man kotavareeaa ||
english: Within them, the mind is the policeman;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਪਿਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: nij ma(n)dar pireeaa ||
english: my Beloved lives in the temple of my inner self.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹਾ ਆਨਦ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tahaa aanad kareeaa ||
english: He plays there in ecstasy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਮਰੀਆ ਨਹ ਜਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nah mareeaa nah jareeaa ||1||
english: He does not die, and he never grows old. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤਨਿ ਜੁਰੀਆ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਫਿਰੀਆ ਪਰ ਕਉ ਹਿਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kiratan jureeaa bahu bidh phireeaa par kau hireeaa ||
english: He is engrossed in worldly activities, wandering around in various ways. He steals the property of others,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਨਾ ਘਿਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: bikhanaa ghireeaa ||
english: and is surrounded by corruption and sin.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ab saadhoo sa(n)g pareeaa ||
english: But now, he joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਖਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har duaarai khareeaa ||
english: and stands before the Lord's Gate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: darasan kareeaa ||
english: He obtains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak gur mireeaa ||
english: Nanak has met the Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: bahur na phireeaa ||2||1||44||
english: he shall not be reincarnated again. ||2||1||44||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਸਿ ਮੰਡਲੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਆਖਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: raas ma(n)dal keeno aakhaaraa ||
english: The Lord has made this world a stage;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੋ ਸਾਜਿ ਰਖਿਓ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagalo saaj rakhio paasaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He fashioned the expanse of the entire creation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਆਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bahu bidh roop ra(n)g aapaaraa ||
english: He fashioned it in various ways, with limitless colors and forms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਭੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pekhai khusee bhog nahee haaraa ||
english: He watches over it with joy, and He never tires of enjoying it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਲੈਤ ਬਸਤ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh ras lait basat niraaraa ||1||
english: He enjoys all the delights, and yet He remains unattached. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਨ ਮਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: baran chihan naahee mukh na maasaaraa ||
english: He has no color, no sign, no mouth and no beard.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kahan na jaaee khel tuhaaraa ||
english: I cannot describe Your play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੇਣ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੪੫॥
transliteration: naanak ren sa(n)t charanaaraa ||2||2||45||
english: Nanak is the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||2||45||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਮੈ ਆਇਆ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tau mai aaiaa saranee aaiaa ||
english: I have come to You. I have come to Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰੋਸੈ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bharosai aaiaa kirapaa aaiaa ||
english: I have come to place my faith in You. I have come seeking Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakhahu suaamee maarag gurahi pathaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If it pleases You, save me, O my Lord and Master. The Guru has placed me upon the Path. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa dutar maaiaa ||
english: Maya is very treacherous and difficult to pass through.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaise pavan jhulaaiaa ||1||
english: It is like a violent wind-storm. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਹੀ ਡਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sun sun hee daraaiaa ||
english: I am so afraid to hear

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਰੋ ਧ੍ਰਮਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kararo dhramaraaiaa ||2||
english: that the Righteous Judge of Dharma is so strict and stern. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: grih a(n)dh koopaaiaa ||
english: The world is a deep, dark pit;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਕੁ ਸਗਰਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paavak sagaraaiaa ||3||
english: it is all on fire. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹੀ ਓਟ ਸਾਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gahee ot saadhaaiaa ||
english: I have grasped the Support of the Holy Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak har dhiaaiaa ||
english: Nanak meditates on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੬॥
transliteration: ab mai pooraa paaiaa ||4||3||46||
english: Now, I have found the Perfect Lord. ||4||3||46||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 ghar 6 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur paas bena(n)teeaa milai naam aadhaaraa ||
english: I offer this prayer to the True Guru, to bless me with the sustenance of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਠਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਤਾਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tuthaa sachaa paatisaahu taap gaiaa sa(n)saaraa ||1||
english: When the True King is pleased, the world is rid of its diseases. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa kee tek too(n) sa(n)taa kee ot too(n) sachaa sirajanahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are the Support of Your devotees, and the Shelter of the Saints, O True Creator Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਮਗਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sach teree saamagaree sach teraa darabaaraa ||
english: True are Your devices, and True is Your Court.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਖਾਜੀਨਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sach tere khaajeeniaa sach teraa paasaaraa ||2||
english: True are Your treasures, and True is Your expanse. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: teraa roop aga(n)m hai anoop teraa darasaaraa ||
english: Your Form is inaccessible, and Your Vision is incomparably beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hau kurabaanee teriaa sevakaa jinh har naam piaaraa ||3||
english: I am a sacrifice to Your servants; they love Your Name, O Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabhe ichhaa pooreeaa jaa paaiaa agam apaaraa ||
english: All desires are fulfilled, when the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਚਰਣਾ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੭॥
transliteration: gur naanak miliaa paarabraham teriaa charanaa kau balihaaraa ||4||1||47||
english: Guru Nanak has met the Supreme Lord God; I am a sacrifice to Your Feet. ||4||1||47||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 ghar 7 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਮਨਾਇਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: teraa bhaanaa toohai manaaihi jis no hohi daiaalaa ||
english: He alone obeys Your Will, O Lord, unto whom You are Merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saaee bhagat jo tudh bhaavai too(n) sarab jeeaa pratipaalaa ||1||
english: That alone is devotional worship, which is pleasing to Your Will. You are the Cherisher of all beings. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸੰਤਾ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: mere raam raai sa(n)taa tek tumhaaree ||
english: O my Sovereign Lord, You are the Support of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so paravaan man tan toohai adhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever pleases You, they accept. You are the sustenance of their minds and bodies. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too(n) daiaal kripaal kripaa nidh manasaa pooranahaaraa ||
english: You are kind and compassionate, the treasure of mercy, the fulfiller of our hopes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣਪਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤੂੰ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhagat tere sabh praanapat preetam too(n) bhagatan kaa piaaraa ||2||
