english: You are the Beloved Lord of life of all Your devotees; You are the Beloved of Your devotees. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: too athaahu apaar at oochaa koee avar na teree bhaate ||
english: You are unfathomable, infinite, lofty and exalted. There is no one else like You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ih aradaas hamaaree suaamee visar naahee sukhadaate ||3||
english: This is my prayer, O my Lord and Master; may I never forget You, O Peace-giving Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: din rain saas saas gun gaavaa je suaamee tudh bhaavaa ||
english: Day and night, with each and every breath, I sing Your Glorious Praises, if it is pleasing to Your Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੮॥
transliteration: naam teraa sukh naanak maagai saahib tuthai paavaa ||4||1||48||
english: Nanak begs for the peace of Your Name, O Lord and Master; as it is pleasing to Your Will, I shall attain it. ||4||1||48||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੂ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: visarahi naahee jit too kabahoo so thaan teraa kehaa ||
english: Where is that place, where You are never forgotten, Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aath pahar jit tudh dhiaaee niramal hovai dehaa ||1||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, they meditate on You, and their bodies become spotless and pure. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਉ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਭਾਲਣ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mere raam hau so thaan bhaalan aaiaa ||
english: O my Lord, I have come searching for that place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat bhaiaa saadhasa(n)g tinh saranaaee paaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: After seeking and searching, I found Sanctuary in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਹਾਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bed paRe paR brahame haare ik til nahee keemat paaee ||
english: Reading and reciting the Vedas, Brahma grew weary, but he did not find even a tiny bit of God's worth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੇ ਤੇ ਭੀ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhik sidh phirahi bilalaate te bhee mohe maaee ||2||
english: The seekers and Siddhas wander around bewailing; they too are enticed by Maya. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਉਤਾਰ ਰਾਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੇ ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਅਉਧੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: das autaar raaje hoi varate mahaadev audhootaa ||
english: There were ten regal incarnations of Vishnu; and then there was Shiva, the renunciate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਭੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਤੇਰਾ ਲਾਇ ਥਕੇ ਬਿਭੂਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tinh bhee a(n)t na paaio teraa laai thake bibhootaa ||3||
english: He did not find Your limits either, although he grew weary of smearing his body with ashes. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਰਸ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sahaj sookh aana(n)d naam ras har sa(n)tee ma(n)gal gaaiaa ||
english: Peace, poise and bliss are found in the subtle essence of the Naam. The Lord's Saints sing the songs of joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੯॥
transliteration: saphal darasan bhetio gur naanak taa man tan har har dhiaaiaa ||4||2||49||
english: I have obtained the Fruitful Vision of Guru Nanak's Darshan, and with my mind and body I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||2||49||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਜੋ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਲੂਟੈ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam paakha(n)d jo deesahi tin jam jaagaatee lootai ||
english: The religious rites, rituals and hypocrisies which are seen, are plundered by the Messenger of Death, the ultimate tax collector.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਿਤੁ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nirabaan keeratan gaavahu karate kaa nimakh simarat jit chhootai ||1||
english: In the state of Nirvaanaa, sing the Kirtan of the Creator's Praises; contemplating Him in meditation, even for an instant, one is saved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu saagar paar utareeai ||
english: O Saints, cross over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: je ko bachan kamaavai sa(n)tan kaa so gur parasaadee tareeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who practices the Teachings of the Saints, by Guru's Grace, is carried across. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kot teerath majan isanaanaa is kal mahi mail bhareejai ||
english: Millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage only fill the mortal with filth in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jo har gun gaavai so niramal kar leejai ||2||
english: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, becomes spotlessly pure. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਇਨੑ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bed kateb simrit sabh saasat inh paRiaa mukat na hoee ||
english: One may read all the books of the Vedas, the Bible, the Simritees and the Shaastras, but they will not bring liberation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ek akhar jo guramukh jaapai tis kee niramal soee ||3||
english: One who, as Gurmukh, chants the One Word, acquires a spotlessly pure reputation. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਝਾ ॥
transliteration: khatree braahaman sood vais upades chahu varanaa kau saajhaa ||
english: The four castes - the Kh'shaatriyas, Brahmins, Soodras and Vaishyas - are equal in respect to the teachings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਉਧਰੈ ਸੋ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਝਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੦॥
transliteration: guramukh naam japai udharai so kal mahi ghat ghat naanak maajhaa ||4||3||50||
english: One who, as Gurmukh, chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is saved. In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Nanak, God is permeating the hearts of each and every being. ||4||3||50||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਓਇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karai soee prabh maanahi oi raam naam ra(n)g raate ||
english: Whatever God causes to happen is accepted, by those who are attuned to the Love of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਜਿਨੑ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tinh kee sobhaa sabhanee thaaee jinh prabh ke charan paraate ||1||
english: Those who fall at the Feet of God are respected everywhere. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: mere raam har sa(n)taa jevad na koee ||
english: O my Lord, no one is as great as the Lord's Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਿਉ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa ban aaee prabh apane siu jal thal maheeal soee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The devotees are in harmony with their God; He is in the water, the land, and the sky. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧੀ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਜਮੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kot apraadhee sa(n)tasa(n)g udharai jam taa kai neR na aavai ||
english: Millions of sinners have been saved in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; the Messenger of Death does not even approach them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਬਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa bichhuRiaa hovai tinh har siu aan milaavai ||2||
english: Those who have been separated from the Lord, for countless incarnations, are reunited with the Lord again. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa moh bharam bhau kaatai sa(n)t saran jo aavai ||
english: Attachment to Maya, doubt and fear are eradicated, when one enters the Sanctuary of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸੋ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jehaa manorath kar aaraadhe so sa(n)tan te paavai ||3||
english: Whatever wishes one harbors, are obtained from the Saints. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕੇਤਕ ਬਰਨਉ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: jan kee mahimaa ketak baranau jo prabh apane bhaane ||
english: How can I describe the glory of the Lord's humble servants? They are pleasing to their God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਕਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੫੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jin satigur bhetiaa se sabh te bhae nikaane ||4||4||51||
english: Says Nanak, those who meet the True Guru, become independent of all obligations. ||4||4||51||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਏ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mahaa agan te tudh haath de raakhe pae teree saranaaee ||
english: Giving me Your Hand, You saved me from the terrible fire, when I sought Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਰ ਦੂਜੀ ਆਸ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: teraa maan taan rid a(n)tar hor doojee aas chukaaee ||1||
english: Deep within my heart, I respect Your strength; I have abandoned all other hopes. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਐ ਉਬਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mere raam raai tudh chit aaiai ubare ||
english: O my Sovereign Lord, when You enter my consciousness, I am saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਉਧਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teree tek bharavaasaa tumhraa jap naam tumhaaraa udhare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are my support. I count on You. Meditating on You, I am saved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਤੁਮੑ ਆਪਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop te kaadh leee tumh aap bhae kirapaalaa ||
english: You pulled me up out of the deep, dark pit. You have become merciful to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saar samhaal sarab sukh deee aap kare pratipaalaa ||2||
english: You care for me, and bless me with total peace; You Yourself cherish me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aapanee nadar kare paramesar ba(n)dhan kaat chhadaae ||
english: The Transcendent Lord has blessed me with His Glance of Grace; breaking my bonds, He has delivered me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aapanee bhagat prabh aap karaaee aape sevaa laae ||3||
english: God Himself inspires me to worship Him; He Himself inspires me to serve Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bharam gaiaa bhai moh binaase mitiaa sagal visooraa ||
english: My doubts have gone, my fears and infatuations have been dispelled, and all my sorrows are gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੈ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੫੨॥
transliteration: naanak daiaa karee sukhadaatai bhetiaa satigur pooraa ||4||5||52||
english: O Nanak, the Lord, the Giver of peace has been merciful to me. I have met the Perfect True Guru. ||4||5||52||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੀਓ ਤਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jab kachh na seeo tab kiaa karataa kavan karam kar aaiaa ||
english: When nothing existed, what deeds were being done? And what karma caused anyone to be born at all?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apanaa khel aap kar dekhai thaakur rachan rachaaiaa ||1||
english: The Lord Himself set His play in motion, and He Himself beholds it. He created the Creation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: mere raam raai mujh te kachhoo na hoee ||
english: O my Sovereign Lord, I cannot do anything at all by myself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa aap karaae sarab nira(n)tar soee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He Himself is the Creator, He Himself is the Cause. He is pervading deep within all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣੀ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਕਤਹੂ ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਇਆਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ganatee ganee na chhootai katahoo kaachee deh iaanee ||
english: If my account were to be judged, I would never be saved. My body is transitory and ignorant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kripaa karahu prabh karanaihaare teree bakhas niraalee ||2||
english: Take pity upon me, O Creator Lord God; Your Forgiving Grace is singular and unique. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh tere keete ghat ghat tuhee dhiaaeeai ||
english: You created all beings and creatures. Each and every heart meditates on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: teree gat mit toohai jaanahi kudarat keem na paaeeai ||3||
english: Your condition and expanse are known only to You; the value of Your creative omnipotence cannot be estimated. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: niragun mugadh ajaan agiaanee karam dharam nahee jaanaa ||
english: I am worthless, foolish, thoughtless and ignorant. I know nothing about good actions and righteous living.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਿਠਾ ਲਗੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੫੩॥
transliteration: daiaa karahu naanak gun gaavai mithaa lagai teraa bhaanaa ||4||6||53||
english: Take pity on Nanak, that he may sing Your Glorious Praises; and that Your Will may seem sweet to him. ||4||6||53||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਗਠੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਘਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaagathaRe har sa(n)t tumhaare jinh ghar dhan har naamaa ||
english: Your Saints are very fortunate; their homes are filled with the wealth of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਗਣੀ ਸੇਈ ਇਹ ਆਏ ਸਫਲ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paravaan ganee seee ih aae saphal tinaa ke kaamaa ||1||
english: Their birth is approved, and their actions are fruitful. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mere raam har jan kai hau bal jaaee ||
english: O my Lord, I am a sacrifice to the humble servants of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਸਾ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਚਵਰੁ ਢੁਲਾਵਾ ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kesaa kaa kar chavar dhulaavaa charan dhooR mukh laaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I make my hair into a fan, and wave it over them; I apply the dust of their feet to my face. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਹਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਨ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: janam maran duhahoo mahi naahee jan paraupakaaree aae ||
english: Those generous, humble beings are above both birth and death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲੈਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jee daan de bhagatee laain har siu lain milaae ||2||
english: They give the gift of the soul, and practice devotional worship; they inspire others to meet the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: sachaa amar sachee paatisaahee sache setee raate ||
english: True are their commands, and true are their empires; they are attuned to the Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sachaa sukh sachee vadiaaee jis ke se tin jaate ||3||
english: True is their happiness, and true is their greatness. They know the Lord, to whom they belong. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਢੋਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਪੀਸਣੁ ਪੀਸਿ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: pakhaa pheree paanee dhovaa har jan kai peesan pees kamaavaa ||
english: I wave the fan over them, carry water for them, and grind corn for the humble servants of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਣੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੪॥
transliteration: naanak kee prabh paas bena(n)tee tere jan dekhan paavaa ||4||7||54||
english: Nanak offers this prayer to God - please, grant me the sight of Your humble servants. ||4||7||54||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham paramesar satigur aape karanaihaaraa ||
english: The True Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God; He Himself is the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charan dhooR teree sevak maagai tere darasan kau balihaaraa ||1||
english: Your servant begs for the dust of Your feet. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: mere raam raai jiu raakhahi tiu raheeai ||
english: O my Sovereign Lord, as You keep me, so do I remain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tudh bhaavai taa naam japaavahi sukh teraa ditaa laheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When it pleases You, I chant Your Name. You alone can grant me peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mukat bhugat jugat teree sevaa jis too(n) aap karaaihi ||
english: Liberation, comfort and proper lifestyle come from serving You; You alone cause us to serve You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਜਹ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਇਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tahaa baiku(n)th jah keeratan teraa too(n) aape saradhaa laaihi ||2||
english: That place is heaven, where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung. You Yourself instill faith into us. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: simar simar simar naam jeevaa tan man hoi nihaalaa ||
english: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Naam, I live; my mind and body are enraptured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਤੇਰੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: charan kamal tere dhoi dhoi peevaa mere satigur deen daiaalaa ||3||
english: I wash Your Lotus Feet, and drink in this water, O my True Guru, O Merciful to the meek. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜਾਈ ਉਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kurabaan jaaee us velaa suhaavee jit tumarai duaarai aaiaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to that most wonderful time when I came to Your Door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੫੫॥
transliteration: naanak kau prabh bhae kripaalaa satigur pooraa paaiaa ||4||8||55||
english: God has become compassionate to Nanak; I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||4||8||55||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tudh chit aae mahaa ana(n)daa jis visarahi so mar jaae ||
english: When You come to mind, I am totally in bliss. One who forgets You might just as well be dead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daiaal hovahi jis oopar karate so tudh sadaa dhiaae ||1||
english: That being, whom You bless with Your Mercy, O Creator Lord, constantly meditates on You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: mere saahib too(n) mai maan nimaanee ||
english: O my Lord and Master, You are the honor of the dishonored such as me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਆਗੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aradaas karee prabh apane aagai sun sun jeevaa teree baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I offer my prayer to You, God; listening, listening to the Word of Your Bani, I live. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: charan dhooR tere jan kee hovaa tere darasan kau bal jaaee ||
english: May I become the dust of the feet of Your humble servants. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit bachan ridai ur dhaaree tau kirapaa te sa(n)g paaee ||2||
english: I enshrine Your Ambrosial Word within my heart. By Your Grace, I have found the Company of the Holy. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਹਿ ਸਾਰੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kee gat tudh pahi saaree tudh jevad avar na koee ||
english: I place the state of my inner being before You; there is no other as great as You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਲੈਹਿ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਗਤੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis no laai laihi so laagai bhagat tuhaaraa soee ||3||
english: He alone is attached, whom You attach; he alone is Your devotee. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: dui kar joR maagau ik daanaa saahib tuthai paavaa ||
english: With my palms pressed together, I beg for this one gift; O my Lord and Master, if it pleases You, I shall obtain it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੫੬॥
transliteration: saas saas naanak aaraadhe aath pahar gun gaavaa ||4||9||56||
english: With each and every breath, Nanak adores You; twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||9||56||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jis ke sir oopar too(n) suaamee so dukh kaisaa paavai ||
english: When You stand over our heads, O Lord and Master, how can we suffer in pain?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bol na jaanai maaiaa mad maataa maranaa cheet na aavai ||1||
english: The mortal being does not know how to chant Your Name - he is intoxicated with the wine of Maya, and the thought of death does not even enter his mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mere raam raai too(n) sa(n)taa kaa sa(n)t tere ||
english: O my Sovereign Lord, You belong to the Saints, and the Saints belong to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tere sevak kau bhau kichh naahee jam nahee aavai nere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your servant is not afraid of anything; the Messenger of Death cannot even approach him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jo terai ra(n)g raate suaamee tinh kaa janam maran dukh naasaa ||
english: Those who are attuned to Your Love, O my Lord and Master, are released from the pains of birth and death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: teree bakhas na metai koee satigur kaa dilaasaa ||2||
english: No one can erase Your Blessings; the True Guru has given me this assurance. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naam dhiaain sukh phal paain aath pahar aaraadhahi ||
english: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtain the fruits of peace. Twenty-four hours a day, they worship and adore You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਰਵਾਸੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੁਸਟ ਲੈ ਸਾਧਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: teree saran terai bharavaasai pa(n)ch dusat lai saadhahi ||3||
english: In Your Sanctuary, with Your Support, they subdue the five villains. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan kichh karam na jaanaa saar na jaanaa teree ||
english: I know nothing about wisdom, meditation and good deeds; I know nothing about Your excellence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਵਡਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੫੭॥
transliteration: sabh te vadaa satigur naanak jin kal raakhee meree ||4||10||57||
english: Guru Nanak is the greatest of all; He saved my honor in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||4||10||57||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sagal tiaag gur saranee aaiaa raakhahu raakhanahaare ||
english: Renouncing everything, I have come to the Guru's Sanctuary; save me, O my Savior Lord!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਹਮ ਲਾਗਹ ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jit too laavahi tit ham laagah kiaa ehi ja(n)t vichaare ||1||
english: Whatever You link me to, to that I am linked; what can this poor creature do? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: mere raam jee too(n) prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: O my Dear Lord God, You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa guradev daiaalaa gun gaavaa nit suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Be Merciful to me, O Divine, Compassionate Guru, that I may constantly sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਉ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar prabh apanaa dhiaaeeai gur prasaad bhau tareeai ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on my God; by Guru's Grace, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹੋਈਐ ਸਭ ਰੇਣਾ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਉ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap tiaag hoeeai sabh renaa jeevatiaa iu mareeai ||2||
english: Renouncing self-conceit, I have become the dust of all men's feet; in this way, I die, while I am still alive. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਉ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam tis kaa jag bheetar saadhasa(n)g naau jaape ||
english: How fruitful is the life of that being in this world, who chants the Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sagal manorath tis ke pooran jis daiaa kare prabh aape ||3||
english: All desires are fulfilled, for the one who is blessed with God's Kindness and Mercy. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal kripaal prabh suaamee teree saran daiaalaa ||
english: O Merciful to the meek, Kind and Compassionate Lord God, I seek Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੫੮॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apanaa naam deejai naanak saadh ravaalaa ||4||11||58||
english: Take pity upon me, and bless me with Your Name. Nanak is the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||11||58||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee asatapadeeaa mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Ashtapadee, First Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੈ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh avagan mai gun nahee koee ||
english: I am totally without virtue; I have no virtue at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kiu kar ka(n)t milaavaa hoee ||1||
english: How can I meet my Husband Lord? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਬੰਕੇ ਨੈਣਾ ॥
transliteration: naa mai roop na ba(n)ke nainaa ||
english: I have no beauty, no enticing eyes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੁਲ ਢੰਗੁ ਨ ਮੀਠੇ ਬੈਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naa kul dha(n)g na meethe bainaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I do not have a noble family, good manners or a sweet voice. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sahaj seegaar kaaman kar aavai ||
english: The soul-bride adorns herself with peace and poise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾ ਕੰਤੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa sohaagan jaa ka(n)tai bhaavai ||2||
english: But she is a happy soul-bride, only if her Husband Lord is pleased with her. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naa tis roop na rekhiaa kaaee ||
english: He has no form or feature;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਨ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)t na saahib simariaa jaaee ||3||
english: at the very last instant, he cannot suddenly be contemplated. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: surat mat naahee chaturaaee ||
english: I have no understanding, intellect or cleverness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh laavahu paaee ||4||
english: Have Mercy upon me, God, and attach me to Your Feet. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਰੀ ਸਿਆਣੀ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: kharee siaanee ka(n)t na bhaanee ||
english: She may be very clever, but this does not please her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: maaiaa laagee bharam bhulaanee ||5||
english: Attached to Maya, she is deluded by doubt. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈ ਤਾ ਕੰਤ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: haumai jaaee taa ka(n)t samaaee ||
english: But if she gets rid of her ego, then she merges in her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: tau kaaman piaare nav nidh paaee ||6||
english: Only then can the soul-bride obtain the nine treasures of her Beloved. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anik janam bichhurat dukh paaiaa ||
english: Separated from You for countless incarnations, I have suffered in pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kar gahi lehu preetam prabh raaiaa ||7||
english: Please take my hand, O my Beloved Sovereign Lord God. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹੁ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak sahu hai bhee hosee ||
english: Prays Nanak, the Lord is, and shall always be.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਤੈ ਰਾਵੇਸੀ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: jai bhaavai piaaraa tai raavesee ||8||1||
english: She alone is ravished and enjoyed, with whom the Beloved Lord is pleased. ||8||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੯ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ghar 9 ||
english: Soohee, First Mehl, Ninth House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਥੋੜੜਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kachaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kaa thoRaRiaa din chaar jeeu ||
english: The color of safflower is transitory; it lasts for only a few days.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀਆ ਠਗਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai bhram bhuleeaa thag muthee kooRiaar jeeu ||
english: Without the Name, the false woman is deluded by doubt and plundered by thieves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sache setee ratiaa janam na doojee vaar jeeu ||1||
english: But those who are attuned to the True Lord, are not reincarnated again. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੇ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਰੰਗੀਐ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)ge kaa kiaa ra(n)geeai jo rate ra(n)g laai jeeu ||
english: How can one who is already dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, be colored any other color?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)gan vaalaa seveeai sache siu chit laai jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: So serve God the Dyer, and focus your consciousness on the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਜੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa je bhavahi bin bhaagaa dhan naahi jeeu ||
english: You wander around in the four directions, but without the good fortune of destiny, you shall never obtain wealth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਧਿਕ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: avagan muthee je phirahi badhik thaai na paahi jeeu ||
english: If you are plundered by corruption and vice, you shall wander around, but like a fugitive, you shall find no place of rest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare sabad rate man maahi jeeu ||2||
english: Only those who are protected by the Guru are saved; their minds are attuned to the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਿਟੇ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਮੈਲੇ ਚਿਤ ਕਠੋਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: chite jin ke kapaRe maile chit kathor jeeu ||
english: Those who wear white clothes, but have filthy and stone-hearted minds,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਚੋਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tin mukh naam na oopajai doojai viaape chor jeeu ||
english: may chant the Lord's Name with their mouths, but they are engrossed in duality; they are thieves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਪਸੂਆ ਸੇ ਢੋਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mool na boojhahi aapanaa se pasooaa se dhor jeeu ||3||
english: They do not understand their own roots; they are beasts. They are just animals! ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮੰਗੈ ਸੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: nit nit khuseeaa man kare nit nit ma(n)gai sukh jeeu ||
english: Constantly, continually, the mortal seeks pleasures. Constantly, continually, he begs for peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਗਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: karataa chit na aavaee phir phir lagahi dukh jeeu ||
english: But he does not think of the Creator Lord, and so he is overtaken by pain, again and again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sukh dukh daataa man vasai tit tan kaisee bhukh jeeu ||4||
english: But one, within whose mind the Giver of pleasure and pain dwells - how can his body feel any need? ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਕੀ ਵਾਲਾ ਤਲਬੀਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: baakee vaalaa talabeeai sir maare ja(n)daar jeeu ||
english: One who has a karmic debt to pay off is summoned, and the Messenger of Death smashes his head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਦੇਵਣਾ ਪੁਛੈ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: lekhaa ma(n)gai devanaa puchhai kar beechaar jeeu ||
english: When his account is called for, it has to be given. After it is reviewed, payment is demanded.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਉਬਰੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sache kee liv ubarai bakhase bakhasanahaar jeeu ||5||
english: Only love for the True One will save you; the Forgiver forgives. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਕੋ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਿਤੜਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਰਲੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: an ko keejai mitaRaa khaak ralai mar jaai jeeu ||
english: If you make any friend other than God, you shall die and mingle with the dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਭੁਲਿ ਭੁਲਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bahu ra(n)g dekh bhulaaiaa bhul bhul aavai jaai jeeu ||
english: Gazing upon the many games of love, you are beguiled and bewildered; you come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: nadar prabhoo te chhuteeai nadaree mel milaai jeeu ||6||
english: Only by God's Grace can you be saved. By His Grace, He unites in His Union. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਫਲ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gaaphal giaan vihooniaa gur bin giaan na bhaal jeeu ||
english: O careless one, you are totally lacking any wisdom; do not seek wisdom without the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਚੋਤਾਣਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: khi(n)chotaan vigucheeai buraa bhalaa dui naal jeeu ||
english: By indecision and inner conflict, you shall come to ruin. Good and bad both pull at you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭੈ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਭ ਜੋਹੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin sabadai bhai ratiaa sabh johee jamakaal jeeu ||7||
english: Without being attuned to the Word of the Shabad and the Fear of God, all come under the gaze of the Messenger of Death. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jin kar kaaran dhaariaa sabhasai dei aadhaar jeeu ||
english: He who created the creation and sustains it, gives sustenance to all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: so kiu manahu visaareeai sadaa sadaa daataar jeeu ||
english: How can you forget Him from your mind? He is the Great Giver, forever and ever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai nidhaaraa aadhaar jeeu ||8||1||2||
english: Nanak shall never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Support of the unsupported. ||8||1||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਕਾਫੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 kaaphee ghar 10 ||
english: Soohee, First Mehl, Kaafee, Tenth House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maanas janam dula(n)bh guramukh paaiaa ||
english: For if you depart with virtue, then pain shall never afflict you. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਚੁਲੰਭੁ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man tan hoi chula(n)bh je satigur bhaaiaa ||1||
english: The mind and body are dyed in the deep red color of devotional love, if it pleases the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਲੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਲੈ ॥
transliteration: chalai janam savaar vakhar sach lai ||
english: He departs with his life embellished and successful, taking the merchandise of the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pat paae darabaar satigur sabad bhai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is honored in the Darbaar, the Royal Court, of the Lord, through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, and the Fear of God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man tan sach salaahi saache man bhaaiaa ||
english: One who praises the True Lord with his mind and body, pleases the Mind of the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: laal rataa man maaniaa gur pooraa paaiaa ||2||
english: Attuned to the Beloved Lord, the mind is appeased, and finds the Perfect Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂ ਵਸੈ ॥
transliteration: hau jeevaa gun saar a(n)tar too vasai ||
english: I live, by cherishing Your Glorious Virtues; You dwell deep within me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਵਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਸਿ ਰਸੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too(n) vasahi man maahi sahaje ras rasai ||3||
english: You dwell within my mind, and so it naturally celebrates in joyful delight. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਇ ਆਖਉ ਕੇਤੜਾ ॥
transliteration: moorakh man samajhaai aakhau ketaRaa ||
english: O my foolish mind, how can I teach and instruct you?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੇਤੜਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramukh har gun gaai ra(n)g ra(n)getaRaa ||4||
english: As Gurmukh, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and so become attuned to His Love. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਆਪਣਾ ॥
transliteration: nit nit ridai samaal preetam aapanaa ||
english: Continually, continuously, remember and cherish your Beloved Lord in your heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਲਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਪਣਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: je chalahi gun naal naahee dukh sa(n)taapanaa ||5||
english: For if you depart with virtue, then pain shall never afflict you. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bharam bhulaanaa naa tis ra(n)g hai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh wanders around, deluded by doubt; he does not enshrine love for the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ਹੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: marasee hoi vidaanaa man tan bha(n)g hai ||6||
english: He dies as a stranger to his own self, and his mind and body are spoiled. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ਲਾਹਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur kee kaar kamaai laahaa ghar aaniaa ||
english: Performing service to the Guru, you shall go home with the profit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gurabaanee nirabaan sabad pachhaaniaa ||7||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, and the Shabad, the Word of God, the state of Nirvaanaa is attained. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
transliteration: ik naanak kee aradaas je tudh bhaavasee ||
english: Nanak makes this one prayer: if it pleases Your Will,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਸੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: mai deejai naam nivaas har gun gaavasee ||8||1||3||
english: bless me with a home in Your Name, Lord, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises. ||8||1||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Soohee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਆਰਣਿ ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਇ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jiu aaran lohaa paai bha(n)n ghaRaaeeai ||
english: As iron is melted in the forge and re-shaped,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ਭਵੈ ਭਵਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tiu saakat jonee paai bhavai bhavaaeeai ||1||
english: so is the godless materialist reincarnated, and forced to wander aimlessly. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: bin boojhe sabh dukh dukh kamaavanaa ||
english: Without understanding, everything is suffering, earning only more suffering.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: haumai aavai jaai bharam bhulaavanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In his ego, he comes and goes, wandering in confusion, deluded by doubt. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: too(n) guramukh rakhanahaar har naam dhiaaeeai ||
english: You save those who are Gurmukh, O Lord, through meditation on Your Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਲਹਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਰਜਾਇ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: melahi tujhahi rajaai sabad kamaaeeai ||2||
english: You blend with Yourself, by Your Will, those who practice the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: too(n) kar kar vekhahi aap dehi s paaeeai ||
english: You created the Creation, and You Yourself gaze upon it; whatever You give, is received.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ਦਰਿ ਬੀਨਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too dekhahi thaap uthaap dar beenaaeeai ||3||
english: You watch, establish and disestablish; You keep all in Your vision at Your Door. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਹੋਵਗਿ ਖਾਕੁ ਪਵਣੁ ਉਡਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: dehee hovag khaak pavan udaaeeai ||
english: The body shall turn to dust, and the soul shall fly away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਕਿਥੈ ਘਰੁ ਅਉਤਾਕੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ihu kithai ghar autaak mahal na paaeeai ||4||
english: So where are their homes and resting places now? They do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, either. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਹੁ ਦੀਵੀ ਅੰਧ ਘੋਰੁ ਘਬੁ ਮੁਹਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: dihu deevee a(n)dh ghor ghab muhaaeeai ||
english: In the pitch darkness of broad daylight, their wealth is being plundered.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬਿ ਮੁਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਰੂਆਈਐ ॥੫॥
transliteration: garab musai ghar chor kis rooaaeeai ||5||
english: Pride is looting their homes like a thief; where can they file their complaint? ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: guramukh chor na laag har naam jagaaeeai ||
english: The thief does not break into the home of the Gurmukh; he is awake in the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਆਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੀਪਾਈਐ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sabad nivaaree aag jot deepaaeeai ||6||
english: The Word of the Shabad puts out the fire of desire; God's Light illuminates and enlightens. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: laal ratan har naam gur surat bujhaaeeai ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a jewel, a ruby; the Guru has taught me the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਹਕਾਮੁ ਜੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sadaa rahai nihakaam je guramat paaeeai ||7||
english: One who follows the Guru's Teachings remains forever free of desire. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: raat dihai har naau ma(n)n vasaaeeai ||
english: Night and day, enshrine the Lord's Name within your mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਈਐ ॥੮॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak mel milaai je tudh bhaaeeai ||8||2||4||
english: Please unite Nanak in Union, O Lord, if it is pleasing to Your Will. ||8||2||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Soohee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: manahu na naam visaar ahinis dhiaaeeai ||
english: Never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, from your mind; night and day, meditate on it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu raakhahi kirapaa dhaar tivai sukh paaeeai ||1||
english: As You keep me, in Your Merciful Grace, so do I find peace. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਕੁਟੀ ਟੋਹਣੀ ॥
transliteration: mai a(n)dhule har naam lakutee tohanee ||
english: I am blind, and the Lord's Name is my cane.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਮੋਹੈ ਮੋਹਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rahau saahib kee tek na mohai mohanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I remain under the Sheltering Support of my Lord and Master; I am not enticed by Maya the enticer. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhau tah naal gur dekhaaliaa ||
english: Wherever I look, there the Guru has shown me that God is always with me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਾਲਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar bhaal sabad nihaaliaa ||2||
english: Searching inwardly and outwardly as well, I came to see Him, through the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sevee satigur bhaai naam nira(n)janaa ||
english: So serve the True Guru with love, through the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਜਾਇ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tudh bhaavai tivai rajaai bharam bhau bha(n)janaa ||3||
english: As it pleases You, so by Your Will, You destroy my doubts and fears. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਤ ਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਇ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: janamat hee dukh laagai maranaa aai kai ||
english: At the very moment of birth, he is afflicted with pain, and in the end, he comes only to die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: janam maran paravaan har gun gaai kai ||4||
english: Birth and death are validated and approved, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੁਧ ਹੀ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau naahee too hovahi tudh hee saajiaa ||
english: When there is no ego, there You are; You fashioned all of this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aape thaap uthaap sabad nivaajiaa ||5||
english: You Yourself establish and disestablish; through the Word of Your Shabad, You elevate and exalt. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਭਸਮ ਰੁਲਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕਹ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dehee bhasam rulaai na jaapee kah gaiaa ||
english: When the body rolls in the dust, it is not known where the soul has gone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ਸੋ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aape rahiaa samaai so visamaad bhaiaa ||6||
english: He Himself is permeating and pervading; this is wonderful and amazing! ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੂਰਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੂ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: too(n) naahee prabh door jaanahi sabh too hai ||
english: You are not far away, God; You know everything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭੀ ਤੂ ਹੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramukh vekh hadoor a(n)tar bhee too hai ||7||
english: The Gurmukh sees You ever-present; You are deep within the nucleus of our inner self. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mai deejai naam nivaas a(n)tar saa(n)t hoi ||
english: Please, bless me with a home in Your Name; may my inner self be at peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: gun gaavai naanak daas satigur mat dei ||8||3||5||
english: May slave Nanak sing Your Glorious Praises; O True Guru, please share the Teachings with me. ||8||3||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 3 ghar 1 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Raag Soohee, Third Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: naamai hee te sabh kichh hoaa bin satigur naam na jaapai ||
english: Everything comes from the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the True Guru, the Naam is not experienced.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਾਖੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad mahaa ras meethaa bin chaakhe saad na jaapai ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is the sweetest and most sublime essence, but without tasting it, its flavor cannot be experienced.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: kaudee badalai janam gavaaiaa cheenas naahee aapai ||
english: He wastes this human life in exchange for a mere shell; he does not understand his own self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai taa eko jaanai haumai dukh na sa(n)taapai ||1||
english: But, if he becomes Gurmukh, then he comes to know the One Lord, and the disease of egotism does not afflict him. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪਣੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: balihaaree gur apane vitahu jin saache siu liv laaee ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has lovingly attached me to the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨੑਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabad cheenhi aatam paragaasiaa sahaje rahiaa samaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Concentrating on the Word of the Shabad, the soul is illumined and enlightened. I remain absorbed in celestial ecstasy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh gaavai guramukh boojhai guramukh sabad beechaare ||
english: The Gurmukh sings the Praises of the Lord; the Gurmukh understands. The Gurmukh contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh gur te upajai guramukh kaaraj savaare ||
english: Body and soul are totally rejuvenated through the Guru; the Gurmukh's affairs are resolved in his favor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamaavai bikh khate sa(n)saare ||
english: The blind self-willed manmukh acts blindly, and earns only poison in this world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi sadaa dukh paae bin gur at piaare ||2||
english: Enticed by Maya, he suffers in constant pain, without the most Beloved Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਚਾਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: soee sevak je satigur seve chaalai satigur bhaae ||
english: He alone is a selfless servant, who serves the True Guru, and walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saachaa sabad siphat hai saachee saachaa ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: The True Shabad, the Word of God, is the True Praise of God; enshrine the True Lord within your mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sachee baanee guramukh aakhai haumai vichahu jaae ||
english: The Gurmukh speaks the True Word of Gurbani, and egotism departs from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape daataa karam hai saachaa saachaa sabad sunaae ||3||
english: He Himself is the Giver, and True are His actions. He proclaims the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘਾਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖਟੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ghaale guramukh khate guramukh naam japaae ||
english: The Gurmukh works, and the Gurmukh earns; the Gurmukh inspires others to chant the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sadaa alipat saachai ra(n)g raataa gur kai sahaj subhaae ||
english: He is forever unattached, imbued with the Love of the True Lord, intuitively in harmony with the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਕੂੜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਬੀਜੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sad hee kooRo bolai bikh beejai bikh khaae ||
english: The self-willed manmukh always tells lies; he plants the seeds of poison, and eats only poison.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦਾਧਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਵਣੁ ਛਡਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jamakaal baadhaa trisanaa daadhaa bin gur kavan chhadaae ||4||
english: He is bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death, and burnt in the fire of desire; who can save him, except the Guru? ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sachaa teerath jit sat sar naavan guramukh aap bujhaae ||
english: True is that place of pilgrimage, where one bathes in the pool of Truth, and achieves self-realization as Gurmukh. The Gurmukh understands his own self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਤੈ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: athasath teerath gur sabad dikhaae tit naatai mal jaae ||
english: The Lord has shown that the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage; bathing in it, filth is washed away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sachaa sabad sachaa hai niramal naa mal lagai na laae ||
english: True and Immaculate is the True Word of His Shabad; no filth touches or clings to Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sachee siphat sachee saalaah poore gur te paae ||5||
english: True Praise, True Devotional Praise, is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tan man sabh kichh har tis keraa duramat kahan na jaae ||
english: Body, mind, everything belongs to the Lord; but the evil-minded ones cannot even say this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hukam hovai taa niramal hovai haumai vichahu jaae ||
english: If such is the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then one becomes pure and spotless, and the ego is taken away from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਚਾਖੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kee saakhee sahaje chaakhee trisanaa agan bujhaae ||
english: I have intuitively tasted the Guru's Teachings, and the fire of my desire has been quenched.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad raataa sahaje maataa sahaje rahiaa samaae ||6||
english: Attuned to the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is naturally intoxicated, merging imperceptibly into the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam sat kar jaanai gur kai bhaai piaare ||
english: The Name of the Lord is known as True, through the Love of the Beloved Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sachee vadiaaee gur te paaee sachai naai piaare ||
english: True Glorious Greatness is obtained from the Guru, through the Beloved True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: eko sachaa sabh mahi varatai viralaa ko veechaare ||
english: The One True Lord is permeating and pervading among all; how rare is the one who contemplates this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਤਾ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aape mel lae taa bakhase sachee bhagat savaare ||7||
english: The Lord Himself unites us in Union, and forgives us; He embellishes us with true devotional worship. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: sabho sach sach sach varatai guramukh koee jaanai ||
english: All is Truth; Truth, and Truth alone is pervading; how rare is the Gurmukh who knows this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa hukamo varatai guramukh aap pachhaanai ||
english: Birth and death occur by the Hukam of His Command; the Gurmukh understands his own self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਏ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naam dhiaae taa satigur bhaae jo ichhai so phal paae ||
english: He meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and so pleases the True Guru. He receives whatever rewards he desires.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tis daa sabh kichh hovai j vichahu aap gavaae ||8||1||
english: O Nanak, one who eradicates self-conceit from within, has everything. ||8||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Soohee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਆਲੑਿਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kaaman at suaalhiu pir vasai jis naale ||
english: The body-bride is very beautiful; she dwells with her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਸਚੇ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: pir sache te sadaa suhaagan gur kaa sabad samhaale ||
english: She becomes the happy soul-bride of her True Husband Lord, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kee bhagat sadaa ra(n)g raataa haumai vichahu jaale ||1||
english: The Lord's devotee is forever attuned to the Lord's Love; her ego is burnt away from within. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu poore gur kee baanee ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed, blessed is the Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poore gur te upajee saach samaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It wells up and springs forth from the Perfect Guru, and merges into Truth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸੈ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar sabh kichh vasai kha(n)d ma(n)dal paataalaa ||
english: Everything is within the Lord - the continents, worlds and nether regions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਸੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar jagajeevan daataa vasai sabhanaa kare pratipaalaa ||
english: The Life of the World, the Great Giver, dwells within the body; He is the Cherisher of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kaaman sadaa suhelee guramukh naam samhaalaa ||2||
english: The body-bride is eternally beautiful; the Gurmukh contemplates the Naam. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਸੈ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar aape vasai alakh na lakhiaa jaaee ||
english: The Lord Himself dwells within the body; He is invisible and cannot be seen.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਾਲਣਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mugadh boojhai naahee baahar bhaalan jaaee ||
english: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not understand; he goes out searching for the Lord externally.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਲਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur seve sadaa sukh paae satigur alakh ditaa lakhaaee ||3||
english: One who serves the True Guru is always at peace; the True Guru has shown me the Invisible Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar ratan padaarath bhagat bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
english: Within the body there are jewels and precious treasures, the over-flowing treasure of devotion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਉਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਹਾਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: is kaaiaa a(n)dar naukha(n)d prithamee haat patan baajaaraa ||
english: Within this body are the nine continents of the earth, its markets, cities and streets.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: is kaaiaa a(n)dar naam nau nidh paaeeai gur kai sabad veechaaraa ||4||
english: Within this body are the nine treasures of the Naam; contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is obtained. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar tol tulaavai aape tolanahaaraa ||
english: Within the body, the Lord estimates the weight; He Himself is the weigher.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮੋਲੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ihu man ratan javaahar maanak tis kaa mol aphaaraa ||
english: This mind is the jewel, the gem, the diamond; it is absolutely priceless.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਲਿ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: mol kit hee naam paaeeai naahee naam paaeeai gur beechaaraa ||5||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, cannot be purchased at any price; the Naam is obtained by contemplating the Guru. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਖੋਜੈ ਹੋਰ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s kaaiaa khojai hor sabh bharam bhulaaee ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh searches this body; all others just wander around in confusion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jis no dei soee jan paavai hor kiaa ko kare chaturaaee ||
english: That humble being alone obtains it, unto whom the Lord bestows it. What other clever tricks can anyone try?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar bhau bhaau vasai gur parasaadee paaee ||6||
english: Within the body, the Fear of God and Love for Him abides; by Guru's Grace, they are obtained. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸਾ ਸਭ ਓਪਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar brahamaa bisan mahesaa sabh opat jit sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Within the body, are Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, from whom the whole world emanated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachai aapanaa khel rachaaiaa aavaa gaun paasaaraa ||
english: The True Lord has staged and contrived His own play; the expanse of the Universe comes and goes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: poorai satigur aap dikhaaiaa sach naam nisataaraa ||7||
english: The Perfect True Guru Himself has made it clear, that emancipation comes through the True Name. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saa kaaiaa jo satigur sevai sachai aap savaaree ||
english: That body, which serves the True Guru, is embellished by the True Lord Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai dar dhoee naahee taa jam kare khuaaree ||
english: Without the Name, the mortal finds no place of rest in the Court of the Lord; he shall be tortured by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sach vadiaaee paae jis no har kirapaa dhaaree ||8||2||
english: O Nanak, true glory is bestowed, when the Lord showers His Mercy. ||8||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 3 ghar 10 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Third Mehl, Tenth House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਨ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਵੰਞਸੀ ॥
transliteration: duneeaa na saalaahi jo mar va(n)njasee ||
english: Do not praise the world; it shall simply pass away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਾ ਨ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਖਾਕੁ ਥੀਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lokaa na saalaahi jo mar khaak theeee ||1||
english: Do not praise other people; they shall die and turn to dust. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਵਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: vaahu mere saahibaa vaahu ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Hail, hail to my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sadaa salaaheeai sachaa veparavaahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As Gurmukh, forever praise the One who is forever True, Independent and Carefree. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਝਿ ਮਰੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: duneeaa keree dosatee manamukh dajh mara(n)n ||
english: Making worldly friendships, the self-willed manmukhs burn and die.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਨ ਲਾਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jam pur badhe maareeahi velaa na laaha(n)n ||2||
english: In the City of Death, they are bound and gagged and beaten; this opportunity shall never come again. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh janam sakaarathaa sachai sabad laga(n)n ||
english: The lives of the Gurmukhs are fruitful and blessed; they are committed to the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aatam raam pragaasiaa sahaje sukh raha(n)n ||3||
english: Their souls are illuminated by the Lord, and they dwell in peace and pleasure. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਰਚੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad visaariaa doojai bhaai racha(n)n ||
english: Those who forget the Word of the Guru's Shabad are engrossed in the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਫਿਰੰਨਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tisanaa bhukh na utarai anadin jalat phira(n)n ||4||
english: Their hunger and thirst never leave them, and night and day, they wander around burning. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: dusataa naal dosatee naal sa(n)taa vair kara(n)n ||
english: Those who make friendships with the wicked, and harbor animosity to the Saints,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੰਨਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aap dube kuta(n)b siu sagale kul doba(n)n ||5||
english: shall drown with their families, and their entire lineage shall be obliterated. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਭਲੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa bhalee kisai kee naahee manamukh mugadh kara(n)n ||
english: It is not good to slander anyone, but the foolish, self-willed manmukhs still do it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਨਰਕੇ ਘੋਰਿ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: muh kaale tin ni(n)dakaa narake ghor pava(n)n ||6||
english: The faces of the slanderers turn black, and they fall into the most horrible hell. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਜੈਸਾ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: e man jaisaa sevahi taisaa hovahi tehe karam kamaai ||
english: O mind, as you serve, so do you become, and so are the deeds that you do.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aap beej aape hee khaavanaa kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||7||
english: Whatever you yourself plant, that is what you shall have to eat; nothing else can be said about this. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਪਰਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mahaa purakhaa kaa bolanaa hovai kitai parathaai ||
english: The speech of the great spiritual beings has a higher purpose.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਰੇ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: oi a(n)mrit bhare bharapoor hahi onaa til na tamaai ||8||
english: They are filled to over-flowing with Ambrosial Nectar, and they have absolutely no greed at all. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਘਰੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: gunakaaree gun sa(n)gharai avaraa upadesen ||
english: The virtuous accumulate virtue, and teach others.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਓਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਨਿ ॥੯॥
transliteration: se vadabhaagee j onaa mil rahe anadin naam laen ||9||
english: Those who meet with them are so very fortunate; night and day, they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਸੀ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ॥
transliteration: desee rijak sa(n)baahi jin upaaee medanee ||
english: He who created the Universe, gives sustenance to it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਧਣੀ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: eko hai daataar sachaa aap dhanee ||10||
english: The One Lord alone is the Great Giver. He Himself is the True Master. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: so sach terai naal hai guramukh nadar nihaal ||
english: That True Lord is always with you; the Gurmukh is blessed with His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: aape bakhase mel lae so prabh sadaa samaal ||11||
english: He Himself shall forgive you, and merge you into Himself; forever cherish and contemplate God. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man mailaa sach niramalaa kiu kar miliaa jaai ||
english: The mind is impure; only the True Lord is pure. So how can it merge into Him?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: prabh mele taa mil rahai haumai sabad jalaai ||12||
english: God merges it into Himself, and then it remains merged; through the Word of His Shabad, the ego is burnt away. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: so sahu sachaa veesarai dhrig jeevan sa(n)saar ||
english: Cursed is the life in this world, of one who forgets her True Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: nadar kare naa veesarai guramatee veechaar ||13||
english: The Lord grants His Mercy, and she does not forget Him, if she contemplates the Guru's Teachings. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur mele taa mil rahaa saach rakhaa ur dhaar ||
english: The True Guru unites her, and so she remains united with Him, with the True Lord enshrined within her heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: miliaa hoi na veechhuRai gur kai het piaar ||14||
english: And so united, she will not be separated again; she remains in the love and affection of the Guru. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: pir saalaahee aapanaa gur kai sabad veechaar ||
english: I praise my Husband Lord, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: mil preetam sukh paaiaa sobhaava(n)tee naar ||15||
english: Meeting with my Beloved, I have found peace; I am His most beautiful and happy soul-bride. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ ਅਤਿ ਮੈਲੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਠੋਰ ॥
transliteration: manamukh man na bhijaee at maile chit kathor ||
english: The mind of the self-willed manmukh is not softened; his consciousness is totally polluted and stone-hearted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਪੈ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਆਈਐ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਿਸੁ ਨਿਕੋਰ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: sapai dudh peeaaeeai a(n)dar vis nikor ||16||
english: Even if the venomous snake is fed on milk, it shall still be filled with poison. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai aape bakhasanahaar ||
english: He Himself does - who else should I ask? He Himself is the Forgiving Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਬਣਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: gurasabadee mail utarai taa sach baniaa seegaar ||17||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, filth is washed away, and then, one is embellished with the ornament of Truth. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਓਥੈ ਕੂੜੇ ਨਾ ਟਿਕੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahu sache vanajaare othai kooRe naa tika(n)n ||
english: True is the Banker, and True are His traders. The false ones cannot remain there.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚੰਨਿ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: onaa sach na bhaavaee dukh hee maahi pacha(n)n ||18||
english: They do not love the Truth - they are consumed by their pain. ||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲਾ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: haumai mailaa jag phirai mar ja(n)mai vaaro vaar ||
english: The world wanders around in the filth of egotism; it dies, and is re-born, over and again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: paiai kirat kamaavanaa koi na metanahaar ||19||
english: He acts in accordance with the karma of his past actions, which no one can erase. ||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa sa(n)gat mil rahai taa sach lagai piaar ||
english: But if he joins the Society of the Saints, then he comes to embrace love for the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: sach salaahee sach man dar sachai sachiaar ||20||
english: Praising the True Lord with a truthful mind, he becomes true in the Court of the True Lord. ||20||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: gur poore pooree mat hai ahinis naam dhiaai ||
english: The Teachings of the Perfect Guru are perfect; meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: haumai meraa vad rog hai vichahu thaak rahaai ||21||
english: Egotism and self-conceit are terrible diseases; tranquility and stillness come from within. ||21||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur saalaahee aapanaa niv niv laagaa paai ||
english: I praise my Guru; bowing down to Him again and again, I fall at His Feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪੀ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: tan man saupee aagai dharee vichahu aap gavaai ||22||
english: I place my body and mind in offering unto Him, eradicating self-conceit from within. ||22||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਚੋਤਾਣਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khi(n)chotaan vigucheeai ekas siu liv laai ||
english: Indecision leads to ruin; focus your attention on the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: haumai meraa chhad too taa sach rahai samaai ||23||
english: Renounce egotism and self-conceit, and remain merged in Truth. ||23||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਿ ਭਾਇਰਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur no mile s bhaairaa sachai sabad laga(n)n ||
english: Those who meet with the True Guru are my Siblings of Destiny; they are committed to the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਦਿਸੰਨਿ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: sach mile se na vichhuRahi dar sachai disa(n)n ||24||
english: Those who merge with the True Lord shall not be separated again; they are judged to be True in the Court of the Lord. ||24||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਸੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਜੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: se bhaaee se sajanaa jo sachaa seva(n)n ||
english: They are my Siblings of Destiny, and they are my friends, who serve the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਿ ਪਲੑਰਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਸਾਝ ਕਰੰਨੑਿ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: avagan vikan palhran gun kee saajh kara(n)nhi ||25||
english: They sell off their sins and demerits like straw, and enter into the partnership of virtue. ||25||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਸਾਝ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: gun kee saajh sukh oopajai sachee bhagat karen ||
english: In the partnership of virtue, peace wells up, and they perform true devotional worship service.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਨਿ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: sach vana(n)jahi gurasabad siu laahaa naam laen ||26||
english: They deal in Truth, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and they earn the profit of the Naam. ||26||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: suinaa rupaa paap kar kar sa(n)cheeai chalai na chaladiaa naal ||
english: Gold and silver may be earned by committing sins, but they will not go with you when you die.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਸੀ ਸਭ ਮੁਠੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: vin naavai naal na chalasee sabh muthee jamakaal ||27||
english: Nothing will go with you in the end, except the Name; all are plundered by the Messenger of Death. ||27||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਹੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
