transliteration: man kaa tosaa har naam hai hiradai rakhahu samhaal ||
english: The Lord's Name is the nourishment of the mind; cherish it, and preserve it carefully within your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਖਰਚੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: ehu kharach akhut hai guramukh nibahai naal ||28||
english: This nourishment is inexhaustible; it is always with the Gurmukhs. ||28||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਜਾਸਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: e man moolahu bhuliaa jaasahi pat gavaai ||
english: O mind, if you forget the Primal Lord, you shall depart, having lost your honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: ihu jagat mohi doojai viaapiaa guramatee sach dhiaai ||29||
english: This world is engrossed in the love of duality; follow the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on the True Lord. ||29||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har kee keemat naa pavai har jas likhan na jaai ||
english: The Lord's value cannot be estimated; the Lord's Praises cannot be written down.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad man tan rapai har siu rahai samaai ||30||
english: When one's mind and body are attuned to the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one remains merged in the Lord. ||30||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਰੰਗੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: so sahu meraa ra(n)gulaa ra(n)ge sahaj subhaai ||
english: My Husband Lord is playful; He has imbued me with His Love, with natural ease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਤਾ ਚੜੈ ਜਾ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: kaaman ra(n)g taa chaRai jaa pir kai a(n)k samaai ||31||
english: The soul-bride is imbued with His Love, when her Husband Lord merges her into His Being. ||31||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਭੀ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: chiree vichhu(n)ne bhee milan jo satigur seva(n)n ||
english: Even those who have been separated for so very long, are reunited with Him, when they serve the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਖਾਨਿ ਖਰਚਨਿ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟਈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਵੰਨਿ ॥੩੨॥
transliteration: a(n)tar nav nidh naam hai khaan kharachan na nikhutaee har gun sahaj rava(n)n ||32||
english: The nine treasures of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are deep within the nucleus of the self; consuming them, they are still never exhausted. Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, with natural ease. ||32||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਨਾ ਮਰਹਿ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: naa oi janamahi naa marahi naa oi dukh saha(n)n ||
english: They are not born, and they do not die; they do not suffer in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥੩੩॥
transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare har siu kel kara(n)n ||33||
english: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved. They celebrate with the Lord. ||33||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: sajan mile na vichhuRahi j anadin mile raha(n)n ||
english: Those who are united with the Lord, the True Friend, are not separated again; night and day, they remain blended with Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਲਹੰਨਿ ॥੩੪॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: is jag mahi virale jaaneeahi naanak sach laha(n)n ||34||1||3||
english: In this world, only a rare few are known, O Nanak, to have obtained the True Lord. ||34||1||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Soohee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਸੂਖਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har jee sookham agam hai kit bidh miliaa jaai ||
english: The Dear Lord is subtle and inaccessible; how can we ever meet Him?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad bhram kateeai achi(n)t vasai man aai ||1||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, doubt is dispelled, and the Carefree Lord comes to abide in the mind. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har har naam japa(n)n ||
english: The Gurmukhs chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਰਵੰਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau tin kai balihaaranai man har gun sadaa rava(n)n ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord in their minds forever. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਲਹੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: gur saravar maan sarovar hai vadabhaagee purakh laha(n)nhi ||
english: The Guru is like the Mansarovar Lake; only the very fortunate beings find Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਸੇ ਹੰਸੁਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sevak guramukh khojiaa se ha(n)sule naam laha(n)n ||2||
english: The Gurmukhs, the selfless servants, seek out the Guru; the swan-souls feed there on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਨੑਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: naam dhiaainhi ra(n)g siu guramukh naam laga(n)nhi ||
english: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam, and remain linked to the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਏਨੑਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhur poorab hovai likhiaa gur bhaanaa ma(n)n laenhi ||3||
english: Whatever is pre-ordained, accept it as the Will of the Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਘਰੁ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee ghar khojiaa paaiaa naam nidhaan ||
english: By great good fortune, I searched my home, and found the treasure of the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur poorai vekhaaliaa prabh aatam raam pachhaan ||4||
english: The Perfect Guru has shown God to me; I have realized the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa kaa prabh ek hai doojaa avar na koi ||
english: There is One God of all; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee man vasai tit ghat paragat hoi ||5||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to abide in the mind; in the heart of such a one, He is revealed. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh a(n)tarajaamee braham hai braham vasai sabh thaai ||
english: God is the Inner-knower of all hearts; God dwells in every place.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ma(n)daa kis no aakheeai sabad vekhahu liv laai ||6||
english: So who should we call evil? Behold the Word of the Shabad, and lovingly dwell upon it. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਆਖਦਾ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: buraa bhalaa tichar aakhadaa jichar hai duhu maahi ||
english: He calls others bad and good, as long as he is in duality.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਏਕਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramukh eko bujhiaa ekas maahi samaai ||7||
english: The Gurmukh understands the One and Only Lord; He is absorbed in the One Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sevaa saa prabh bhaavasee jo prabh paae thaai ||
english: That is selfless service, which pleases God, and which is approved by God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: jan naanak har aaraadhiaa gur charanee chit laai ||8||2||4||9||
english: Servant Nanak worships the Lord in adoration; he focuses his consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||8||2||4||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee asatapadeeaa mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Ashtpadheeyaa, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: koee aan milaavai meraa preetam piaaraa hau tis pahi aap vechaaee ||1||
english: If only someone would come, and lead me to meet my Darling Beloved; I would sell myself to him. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: darasan har dekhan kai taaee ||
english: I long for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kripaa karahi taa satigur melahi har har naam dhiaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When the Lord shows Mercy unto me, then I meet the True Guru; I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਅਰਾਧੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਭੀ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: je sukh dehi ta tujhahi araadhee dukh bhee tujhai dhiaaee ||2||
english: If You will bless me with happiness, then I will worship and adore You. Even in pain, I will meditate on You. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਭੁਖ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਇਤ ਹੀ ਰਾਜਾ ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਖ ਮਨਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je bhukh dehi ta it hee raajaa dukh vich sookh manaaee ||3||
english: Even if You give me hunger, I will still feel satisfied; I am joyful, even in the midst of sorrow. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tan man kaat kaat sabh arapee vich aganee aap jalaaee ||4||
english: I would cut my mind and body apart into pieces, and offer them all to You; I would burn myself in fire. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਢੋਵਾ ਜੋ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਖਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: pakhaa pheree paanee dhovaa jo devahi so khaaee ||5||
english: I wave the fan over You, and carry water for You; whatever You give me, I take. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਢਹਿ ਪਇਆ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak gareeb dhahi paiaa duaarai har mel laihu vadiaaee ||6||
english: Poor Nanak has fallen at the Lord's Door; please, O Lord, unite me with Yourself, by Your Glorious Greatness. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਕਾਢਿ ਧਰੀ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਲਿ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਤ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: akhee kaadh dharee charanaa tal sabh dharatee phir mat paaee ||7||
english: Taking out my eyes, I place them at Your Feet; after travelling over the entire earth, I have come to understand this. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਹਾਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਅਰਾਧੀ ਜੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਹਿ ਭੀ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: je paas bahaalahi taa tujhahi araadhee je maar kadhahi bhee dhiaaee ||8||
english: If You seat me near You, then I worship and adore You. Even if You beat me and drive me out, I will still meditate on You. ||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਜੇ ਨਿੰਦੈ ਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੯॥
transliteration: je lok salaahe taa teree upamaa je ni(n)dai ta chhod na jaaee ||9||
english: If people praise me, the praise is Yours. Even if they slander me, I will not leave You. ||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਹੁ ਆਖਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: je tudh val rahai taa koee kihu aakhau tudh visariai mar jaaee ||10||
english: If You are on my side, then anyone can say anything. But if I were to forget You, then I would die. ||10||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਪੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: vaar vaar jaaee gur oopar pai pairee sa(n)t manaaee ||11||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my Guru; falling at His Feet, I surrender to the Saintly Guru. ||11||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ਭਇਆ ਦਿਵਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਤਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak vichaaraa bhaiaa divaanaa har tau darasan kai taaee ||12||
english: Poor Nanak has gone insane, longing for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||12||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਝਖੜੁ ਝਾਗੀ ਮੀਹੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਭੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਣ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jhakhaR jhaagee meehu varasai bhee gur dekhan jaaee ||13||
english: Even in violent storms and torrential rain, I go out to catch a glimpse of my Guru. ||13||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਖਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਲੰਘਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: samu(n)d saagar hovai bahu khaaraa gurasikh la(n)gh gur pahi jaaee ||14||
english: Even though the oceans and the salty seas are very vast, the GurSikh will cross over it to get to his Guru. ||14||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਰਤਾ ਤਿਉ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: jiu praanee jal bin hai marataa tiu sikh gur bin mar jaaee ||15||
english: Just as the mortal dies without water, so does the Sikh die without the Guru. ||15||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਸੋਭ ਕਰੇ ਜਲੁ ਬਰਸੈ ਤਿਉ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: jiu dharatee sobh kare jal barasai tiu sikh gur mil bigasaaee ||16||
english: Just as the earth looks beautiful when the rain falls, so does the Sikh blossom forth meeting the Guru. ||16||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਵਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੁਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: sevak kaa hoi sevak varataa kar kar binau bulaaee ||17||
english: I long to be the servant of Your servants; I call upon You reverently in prayer. ||17||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)tee har pahi gur mil gur sukh paaee ||18||
english: Nanak offers this prayer to the Lord, that he may meet the Guru, and find peace. ||18||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਚੁ ਦੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: too aape gur chelaa hai aape gur vich de tujhahi dhiaaee ||19||
english: You Yourself are the Guru, and You Yourself are the chaylaa, the disciple; through the Guru, I meditate on You. ||19||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: jo tudh sevahi so toohai hovahi tudh sevak paij rakhaaee ||20||
english: Those who serve You, become You. You preserve the honor of Your servants. ||20||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਾਈ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: bha(n)daar bhare bhagatee har tere jis bhaavai tis devaaee ||21||
english: O Lord, Your devotional worship is a treasure over-flowing. One who loves You, is blessed with it. ||21||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਹੋਰ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਭ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: jis too(n) dehi soee jan paae hor nihaphal sabh chaturaaee ||22||
english: That humble being alone receives it, unto whom You bestow it. All other clever tricks are fruitless. ||22||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: simar simar simar gur apunaa soiaa man jaagaaee ||23||
english: Remembering, remembering, remembering my Guru in meditation, my sleeping mind is awakened. ||23||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: ik daan ma(n)gai naanak vechaaraa har daasan daas karaaee ||24||
english: Poor Nanak begs for this one blessing, that he may become the slave of the slaves of the Lord. ||24||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਝਿੜਕੇ ਤ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਤ ਗੁਰ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: je gur jhiRake ta meethaa laagai je bakhase ta gur vadiaaee ||25||
english: Even if the Guru rebukes me, He still seems very sweet to me. And if He actually forgives me, that is the Guru's greatness. ||25||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: guramukh bolahi so thaai paae manamukh kichh thaai na paaee ||26||
english: That which Gurmukh speaks is certified and approved. Whatever the self-willed manmukh says is not accepted. ||26||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਲਾ ਕਕਰੁ ਵਰਫ ਵਰਸੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਣ ਜਾਈ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: paalaa kakar varaph varasai gurasikh gur dekhan jaaee ||27||
english: Even in the cold, the frost and the snow, the GurSikh still goes out to see his Guru. ||27||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਦੇਖਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਖੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰ ਧਰਾਈ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: sabh dinas rain dekhau gur apunaa vich akhee gur pair dharaaee ||28||
english: All day and night, I gaze upon my Guru; I install the Guru's Feet in my eyes. ||28||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: anek upaav karee gur kaaran gur bhaavai so thaai paaee ||29||
english: I make so many efforts for the sake of the Guru; only that which pleases the Guru is accepted and approved. ||29||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਅਰਾਧੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਈ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: rain dinas gur charan araadhee daiaa karahu mere saaee ||30||
english: Night and day, I worship the Guru's Feet in adoration; have Mercy upon me, O my Lord and Master. ||30||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: naanak kaa jeeu pi(n)d guroo hai gur mil tripat aghaaee ||31||
english: The Guru is Nanak's body and soul; meeting the Guru, he is satisfied and satiated. ||31||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤਤ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥੩੨॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kaa prabh poor rahio hai jat kat tat gosaaee ||32||1||
english: Nanak's God is perfectly permeating and all-pervading. Here and there and everywhere, the Lord of the Universe. ||32||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 4 asatapadeeaa ghar 10 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Tenth House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਆਪਣੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar sachaa nehu laaiaa preetam aapanai ||
english: Deep within myself, I have enshrined true love for my Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਜਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਸਾਮੑਣੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tan man hoi nihaal jaa gur dekhaa saamhne ||1||
english: My body and soul are in ecstasy; I see my Guru before me. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: mai har har naam visaahu ||
english: I have purchased the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poore te paaiaa a(n)mrit agam athaahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have obtained the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Ambrosial Nectar from the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hau satigur vekh vigaseeaa har naame lagaa piaar ||
english: Gazing upon the True Guru, I blossom forth in ecstasy; I am in love with the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kirapaa kar kai melian paaiaa mokh duaar ||2||
english: Through His Mercy, the Lord has united me with Himself, and I have found the Door of Salvation. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur birahee naam kaa je milai ta tan man deu ||
english: The True Guru is the Lover of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Meeting Him, I dedicate my body and mind to Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਏਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je poorab hovai likhiaa taa a(n)mrit sahaj peeeu ||3||
english: And if it is so pre-ordained, then I shall automatically drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਭੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਲਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sutiaa gur saalaaheeai uthadiaa bhee gur aalaau ||
english: Praise the Guru while you are asleep, and call on the Guru while you are up.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਧੋਵਾ ਪਾਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: koee aisaa guramukh je milai hau taa ke dhovaa paau ||4||
english: If only I could meet such a Gurmukh; I would wash His Feet. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: koee aisaa sajan loR lahu mai preetam dei milaai ||
english: I long for such a Friend, to unite me with my Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: satigur miliai har paaiaa miliaa sahaj subhaai ||5||
english: Meeting the True Guru, I have found the Lord. He has met me, easily and effortlessly. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਣ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur saagar gun naam kaa mai tis dekhan kaa chaau ||
english: The True Guru is the Ocean of Virtue of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I have such a yearning to see Him!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਊ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: hau tis bin ghaRee na jeevaoo bin dekhe mar jaau ||6||
english: Without Him, I cannot live, even for an instant. If I do not see Him, I die. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jiu machhulee vin paaneeai rahai na kitai upaai ||
english: As the fish cannot survive at all without water,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tiu har bin sa(n)t na jeevaee bin har naamai mar jaai ||7||
english: the Saint cannot live without the Lord. Without the Lord's Name, he dies. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਕਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਮਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mai satigur setee pirahaRee kiu gur bin jeevaa maau ||
english: I am so much in love with my True Guru! How could I even live without the Guru, O my mother?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੮॥
transliteration: mai gurabaanee aadhaar hai gurabaanee laag rahaau ||8||
english: I have the Support of the Word of the Guru's Bani. Attached to Gurbani, I survive. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam rata(n)n hai gur tuthaa devai maai ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is a jewel; by the Pleasure of His Will, the Guru has given it, O my mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: mai dhar sache naam kee har naam rahaa liv laai ||9||
english: The True Name is my only Support. I remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur giaan padaarath naam hai har naamo dei driRaai ||
english: The wisdom of the Guru is the treasure of the Naam. The Guru implants and enshrines the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: jis paraapat so lahai gur charanee laagai aai ||10||
english: He alone receives it, he alone gets it, who comes and falls at the Guru's Feet. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਆਖੈ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: akath kahaanee prem kee ko preetam aakhai aai ||
english: If only someone would come and tell me the Unspoken Speech of the Love of my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: tis devaa man aapanaa niv niv laagaa paai ||11||
english: I would dedicate my mind to him; I would bow down in humble respect, and fall at his feet. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sajan meraa ek too(n) karataa purakh sujaan ||
english: You are my only Friend, O my All-knowing, All-powerful Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੀਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: satigur meet milaaiaa mai sadaa sadaa teraa taan ||12||
english: You have brought me to meet with my True Guru. Forever and ever, You are my only strength. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur meraa sadaa sadaa naa aavai naa jaai ||
english: My True Guru, forever and ever, does not come and go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: ohu abinaasee purakh hai sabh mahi rahiaa samaai ||13||
english: He is the Imperishable Creator Lord; He is permeating and pervading among all. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: raam naam dhan sa(n)chiaa saabat poo(n)jee raas ||
english: I have gathered in the wealth of the Lord's Name. My facilities and faculties are intact, safe and sound.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੧੪॥੧॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak daragah ma(n)niaa gur poore saabaas ||14||1||2||11||
english: O Nanak, I am approved and respected in the Court of the Lord; the Perfect Guru has blessed me! ||14||1||2||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee asatapadeeaa mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Ashtpadheeyaa, Fifth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: urajh rahio bikhiaa kai sa(n)gaa ||
english: He is entangled in sinful associations;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: manahi biaapat anik tara(n)gaa ||1||
english: his mind is troubled by so very many waves. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ॥
transliteration: mere man agam agochar ||
english: O my mind, how can the Unapproachable and Incomprehensible Lord be found?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kat paaeeai pooran paramesar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Perfect Transcendent Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: moh magan mahi rahiaa biaape ||
english: He remains entangled in the intoxication of worldly love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: at trisanaa kabahoo nahee dhraape ||2||
english: His excessive thirst is never quenched. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸਇ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਚੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: basai karodh sareer cha(n)daaraa ||
english: Anger is the outcaste which hides within his body;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: agiaan na soojhai mahaa gubaaraa ||3||
english: he is in the utter darkness of ignorance, and he does not understand. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਜਰੇ ਕਿਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhramat biaapat jare kivaaraa ||
english: Afflicted by doubt, the shutters are shut tight;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jaan na paaeeai prabh darabaaraa ||4||
english: he cannot go to God's Court. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa a(n)desaa ba(n)dh paraanaa ||
english: The mortal is bound and gagged by hope and fear;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: mahal na paavai phirat bigaanaa ||5||
english: he cannot find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and so he wanders around like a stranger. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal biaadh kai vas kar deenaa ||
english: He falls under the power of all negative influences;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: phirat piaas jiu jal bin meenaa ||6||
english: he wanders around thirsty like a fish out of water. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਛੂ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kachhoo siaanap ukat na moree ||
english: I have no clever tricks or techniques;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਆਸ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ek aas thaakur prabh toree ||7||
english: You are my only hope, O my Lord God Master. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: karau benatee sa(n)tan paase ||
english: Nanak offers this prayer to the Saints

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਰਦਾਸੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: mel laihu naanak aradaase ||8||
english: - please let me merge and blend with You. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaio kripaal saadhasa(n)g paaiaa ||
english: God has shown Mercy, and I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tripate pooraa paaiaa ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||1||
english: Nanak is satisfied, finding the Perfect Lord. ||1||Second Pause||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਨ ਮੋਹ ਅਗਨਿ ਸੋਕ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
transliteration: mithan moh agan sok saagar ||
english: Attachment to sex is an ocean of fire and pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਉਧਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਗਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa udhar har naagar ||1||
english: By Your Grace, O Sublime Lord, please save me from it. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਨਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal saranaai naraain ||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਭਗਤ ਪਰਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: deenaa naath bhagat paraain ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Master of the meek, the Support of His devotees. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥ ਭਗਤ ਭੈ ਮੇਟਨ ॥
transliteration: anaathaa naath bhagat bhai metan ||
english: Master of the masterless, Patron of the forlorn, Eradicator of fear of His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਨ ਭੇਟਨ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jamadoot na bhetan ||2||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Messenger of Death cannot even touch them. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jeevan roop anoop daiaalaa ||
english: The Merciful, Incomparably Beautiful, Embodiment of Life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਵਣ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ravan gunaa kateeai jam jaalaa ||3||
english: Vibrating the Glorious Virtues of the Lord, the noose of the Messenger of Death is cut away. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam rasan nit jaapai ||
english: One who constantly chants the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam with his tongue,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਰੂਪ ਮਾਇਆ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: rog roop maaiaa na biaapai ||4||
english: is not touched or affected by Maya, the embodiment of disease. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jap gobi(n)d sa(n)gee sabh taare ||
english: Chant and meditate on God, the Lord of the Universe, and all of your companions shall be carried across;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੋਹਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: pohat naahee pa(n)ch batavaare ||5||
english: the five thieves will not even approach. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: man bach kram prabh ek dhiaae ||
english: One who meditates on the One God in thought, word and deed

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਫਲਾ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sarab phalaa soee jan paae ||6||
english: - that humble being receives the fruits of all rewards. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: dhaar anugrahu apanaa prabh keenaa ||
english: Showering His Mercy, God has made me His own;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: keval naam bhagat ras deenaa ||7||
english: He has blessed me with the unique and singular Naam, and the sublime essence of devotion. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aad madh a(n)t prabh soee ||
english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak tis bin avar na koee ||8||1||2||
english: O Nanak, without Him, there is no other at all. ||8||1||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੯ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 asatapadeeaa ghar 9 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Ninth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਡਿਠਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੰਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jin dithiaa man rahaseeai kiu paaeeai tinh sa(n)g jeeu ||
english: Gazing upon them, my mind is enraptured. How can I join them and be with them?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੇ ਲਾਇਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sajan man mitr se laain prabh siu ra(n)g jeeu ||
english: They are Saints and friends, good friends of my mind, who inspire me and help me tune in to God's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੰਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tinh siu preet na tutaee kabahu na hovai bha(n)g jeeu ||1||
english: My love for them shall never die; it shall never, ever be broken. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh kar daiaa gun gaavaa tere nit jeeu ||
english: O Supreme Lord God, please grant me Your Grace, that I might constantly sing Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਜਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aai milahu sa(n)t sajanaa naam japah man mit jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Come, and meet with me, O Saints, and good friends; let us chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Best Friend of my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: dekhai sune na jaanaee maaiaa mohiaa a(n)dh jeeu ||
english: He does not see, he does not hear, and he does not understand; he is blind, enticed and bewitched by Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹਾ ਵਿਣਸਣੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਧੰਧੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kaachee dehaa vinasanee kooR kamaavai dha(n)dh jeeu ||
english: His body is false and transitory; it shall perish. And still, he entangles himself in false pursuits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam dhiaavahi se jin chale gur poore sanaba(n)dh jeeu ||2||
english: They alone depart victorious, who have meditated on the Naam; they stick with the Perfect Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਚਲਣੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: hukame jug mahi aaiaa chalan hukam sa(n)jog jeeu ||
english: By the Hukam of God's Will, they come into this world, and they leave upon receipt of His Hukam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: hukame parapa(n)ch pasariaa hukam kare ras bhog jeeu ||
english: By His Hukam, the Expanse of the Universe is expanded. By His Hukam, they enjoy pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis no karataa visarai tisahi vichhoRaa sog jeeu ||3||
english: One who forgets the Creator Lord, suffers sorrow and separation. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aapanaRe prabh bhaaniaa daragah paidhaa jaai jeeu ||
english: One who is pleasing to his God, goes to His Court dressed in robes of honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aithai sukh mukh ujalaa iko naam dhiaai jeeu ||
english: One who meditates on the Naam, the One Name, finds peace in this world; his face is radiant and bright.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਰੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਤ ਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aadar ditaa paarabraham gur seviaa sat bhaai jeeu ||4||
english: The Supreme Lord confers honor and respect on those who serve the Guru with true love. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa sarab jeeaa pratipaal jeeu ||
english: He is pervading and permeating the spaces and interspaces; He loves and cherishes all beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sach khajaanaa sa(n)chiaa ek naam dhan maal jeeu ||
english: I have accumulated the true treasure, the wealth and riches of the One Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: man te kabahu na veesarai jaa aape hoi daiaal jeeu ||5||
english: I shall never forget Him from my mind, since He has been so merciful to me. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa rahi gae man vuthaa nira(n)kaar jeeu ||
english: My comings and goings have ended; the Formless Lord now dwells within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: taa kaa a(n)t na paaeeai oochaa agam apaar jeeu ||
english: His limits cannot be found; He is lofty and exalted, inaccessible and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jis prabh apanaa visarai so mar ja(n)mai lakh vaar jeeu ||6||
english: One who forgets His God, shall die and be reincarnated, hundreds of thousands of times. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਨੇਹੁ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: saach nehu tin preetamaa jin man vuthaa aap jeeu ||
english: They alone bear true love for their God, within whose minds He Himself dwells.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝੀ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੇ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਪਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gun saajhee tin sa(n)g base aath pahar prabh jaap jeeu ||
english: So dwell only with those who share their virtues; chant and meditate on God, twenty-four hours a day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ra(n)g rate paramesarai binase sagal sa(n)taap jeeu ||7||
english: They are attuned to the Love of the Transcendent Lord; all their sorrows and afflictions are dispelled. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: too(n) karataa too(n) karanahaar toohai ek anek jeeu ||
english: You are the Creator, You are the Cause of causes; You are the One and the many.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: too samarath too sarab mai toohai budh bibek jeeu ||
english: You are All-powerful, You are present everywhere; You are the subtle intellect, the clear wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam sadaa japee bhagat janaa kee tek jeeu ||8||1||3||
english: Nanak chants and meditates forever on the Naam, the Support of the humble devotees. ||8||1||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ਕਾਫੀ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 asatapadeeaa ghar 10 kaaphee ||
english: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Tenth House, Kaafee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਭੁਲੀ ਜੇ ਚੁਕੀ ਸਾਈਁ ਭੀ ਤਹਿੰਜੀ ਕਾਢੀਆ ॥
transliteration: je bhulee je chukee saaee(n) bhee tahi(n)jee kaadheeaa ||
english: Even though I have made mistakes, and even though I have been wrong, I am still called Yours, O my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਦੂਜਾਣੇ ਲਗਾ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਹੁ ਸੇ ਵਾਢੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jinhaa nehu doojaane lagaa jhoor marahu se vaadheeaa ||1||
english: Those who enshrine love for another, die regretting and repenting. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਨਾ ਛੋਡਉ ਕੰਤ ਪਾਸਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hau naa chhodau ka(n)t paasaraa ||
english: I shall never leave my Husband Lord's side.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਏਹੁ ਮਹਿੰਜਾ ਆਸਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ra(n)geelaa laal piaaraa ehu mahi(n)jaa aasaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My Beloved Lover is always and forever beautiful. He is my hope and inspiration. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਜਣੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਸੈਣੁ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਉਪਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sajan toohai sain too mai tujh upar bahu maaneeaa ||
english: You are my Best Friend; You are my relative. I am so proud of You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਮਾਣੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa too a(n)dar taa sukhe too(n) nimaanee maaneeaa ||2||
english: And when You dwell within me, I am at peace. I am without honor - You are my honor. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਤੁਠਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਵੇਖਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: je too tuthaa kripaa nidhaan naa doojaa vekhaal ||
english: And when You are pleased with me, O treasure of mercy, then I do not see any other.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਪਾਈ ਮੂ ਦਾਤੜੀ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ehaa paaee moo daataRee nit hiradai rakhaa samaal ||3||
english: Please grant me this blessing, that that I may forever dwell upon You and cherish You within my heart. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵ ਜੁਲਾਈ ਪੰਧ ਤਉ ਨੈਣੀ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: paav julaaee pa(n)dh tau nainee daras dikhaal ||
english: Let my feet walk on Your Path, and let my eyes behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਥੀਵੈ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sravanee sunee kahaaneeaa je gur theevai kirapaal ||4||
english: With my ears, I will listen to Your Sermon, if the Guru becomes merciful to me. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੀ ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਪਿਰੀਏ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਨਿ ਤੇਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kitee lakh karoR pireee rom na pujan teriaa ||
english: Hundreds of thousands and millions do not equal even one hair of Yours, O my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਾਹੀ ਹੂ ਸਾਹੁ ਹਉ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: too saahee hoo saahu hau kahi na sakaa gun teriaa ||5||
english: You are the King of kings; I cannot even describe Your Glorious Praises. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹੀਆ ਤਊ ਅਸੰਖ ਮੰਞਹੁ ਹਭਿ ਵਧਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: saheeaa taoo asa(n)kh ma(n)njahu habh vadhaaneeaa ||
english: Your brides are countless; they are all greater than I am.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: hik bhoree nadar nihaal dehi daras ra(n)g maaneeaa ||6||
english: Please bless me with Your Glance of Grace, even for an instant; please bless me with Your Darshan, that I may revel in Your Love. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਡਿਠੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੀਐ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਵੰਞਨੑਿ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jai dithe man dheereeai kilavikh va(n)njanhi doore ||
english: Seeing Him, my mind is comforted and consoled, and my sins and mistakes are far removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮਾਉ ਮੈ ਜੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: so kiu visarai maau mai jo rahiaa bharapoore ||7||
english: How could I ever forget Him, O my mother? He is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਢਹਿ ਪਈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hoi nimaanee dhahi paee miliaa sahaj subhaai ||
english: In humility, I bowed down in surrender to Him, and He naturally met me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa paaiaa naanak sa(n)t sahaai ||8||1||4||
english: I have received what was pre-ordained for me, O Nanak, with the help and assistance of the Saints. ||8||1||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੁਕਾਰਨਿ ਪੋਥੀਆ ॥
transliteration: simrit bed puraan pukaaran potheeaa ||
english: The Simritees, the Vedas, the Puraanas and the other holy scriptures proclaim

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਗਾਲੑੀ ਹੋਛੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam binaa sabh kooR gaalhee hochheeaa ||1||
english: that without the Naam, everything is false and worthless. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan apaar bhagataa man vasai ||
english: The infinite treasure of the Naam abides within the minds of the devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਮੋਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam maran mohu dukh saadhoo sa(n)g nasai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Birth and death, attachment and suffering, are erased in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਬਾਦਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਰੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mohi baad aha(n)kaar sarapar ru(n)niaa ||
english: Those who indulge in attachment, conflict and egotism shall surely weep and cry.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੑਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sukh na paainhi mool naam vichhu(n)niaa ||2||
english: Those who are separated from the Naam shall never find any peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਧਾਰਿ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬੰਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: meree meree dhaar ba(n)dhan ba(n)dhiaa ||
english: Crying out, Mine! Mine!, he is bound in bondage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੰਧਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: narak surag avataar maaiaa dha(n)dhiaa ||3||
english: Entangled in Maya, he is reincarnated in heaven and hell. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sodhat sodhat sodh tat beechaariaa ||
english: Searching, searching, searching, I have come to understand the essence of reality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naam binaa sukh naahi sarapar haariaa ||4||
english: Without the Naam, there is no peace at all, and the mortal will surely fail. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਤੇ ॥
transliteration: aavahi jaahi anek mar mar janamate ||
english: Many come and go; they die, and die again, and are reincarnated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭੁ ਵਾਦਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਤੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bin boojhe sabh vaad jonee bharamate ||5||
english: Without understanding, they are totally useless, and they wander in reincarnation. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jinh kau bhae daiaal tinh saadhoo sa(n)g bhaiaa ||
english: They alone join the Saadh Sangat, unto whom the Lord becomes Merciful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਜਨੀ ਜਪਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naam tinhee janee jap laiaa ||6||
english: They chant and meditate on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਹਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਨੰਤ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: khojahi kot asa(n)kh bahut ana(n)t ke ||
english: Uncounted millions, so many they are endless, search for Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਨੇੜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jis bujhaae aap neRaa tis he ||7||
english: But only that one, who understands his own self, sees God near at hand. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: visar naahee daataar aapanaa naam dehu ||
english: Never forget me, O Great Giver - please bless me with Your Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਉ ਏਹੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥੧੬॥
transliteration: gun gaavaa din raat naanak chaau ehu ||8||2||5||16||
english: To sing Your Glorious Praises day and night - O Nanak, this is my heart-felt desire. ||8||2||5||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਕੁਚਜੀ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 1 kuchajee ||
english: Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Kuchajee ~ The Ungraceful Bride:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਞੁ ਕੁਚਜੀ ਅੰਮਾਵਣਿ ਡੋਸੜੇ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)nj kuchajee a(n)maavan dosaRe hau kiu sahu raavan jaau jeeu ||
english: I am ungraceful and ill-mannered, full of endless faults. How can I go to enjoy my Husband Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਇਕਿ ਚੜੰਦੀਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ik doo ik chaRa(n)deeaa kaun jaanai meraa naau jeeu ||
english: Each of His soul-brides is better than the rest - who even knows my name?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਅੰਬੀ ਛਾਵੜੀਏਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jinhee sakhee sahu raaviaa se a(n)bee chhaavaReeehi jeeu ||
english: Those brides who enjoy their Husband Lord are very blessed, resting in the shade of the mango tree.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੰਞੁ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਜੀ ਦੋਸ ਧਰੇਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: se gun ma(n)nj na aavanee hau kai jee dos dhareu jeeu ||
english: I do not have their virtue - who can I blame for this?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿਥਰਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਘਿਨਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kiaa gun tere vitharaa hau kiaa kiaa ghinaa teraa naau jeeu ||
english: Which of Your Virtues, O Lord, should I speak of? Which of Your Names should I chant?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਟੋਲਿ ਨ ਅੰਬੜਾ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ikat tol na a(n)baRaa hau sad kurabaanai terai jaau jeeu ||
english: I cannot even reach one of Your Virtues. I am forever a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਮੋਤੀ ਤੈ ਮਾਣਿਕੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: suinaa rupaa ra(n)gulaa motee tai maanik jeeu ||
english: Gold, silver, pearls and rubies are pleasing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਸਤੂ ਸਹਿ ਦਿਤੀਆ ਮੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: se vasatoo sahi diteeaa mai tinh siu laaiaa chit jeeu ||
english: My Husband Lord has blessed me with these things, and I have focused my thoughts on them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਰ ਮਿਟੀ ਸੰਦੜੇ ਪਥਰ ਕੀਤੇ ਰਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)dar mitee sa(n)daRe pathar keete raas jeeu ||
english: Palaces of brick and mud are built and decorated with stones;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਏਨੀ ਟੋਲੀ ਭੁਲੀਅਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਬੈਠੀ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: hau enee tolee bhuleeas tis ka(n)t na baithee paas jeeu ||
english: I have been fooled by these decorations, and I do not sit near my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਰਿ ਕੂੰਜਾ ਕੁਰਲੀਆ ਬਗ ਬਹਿਠੇ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)bar koo(n)jaa kuraleeaa bag bahithe aai jeeu ||
english: The cranes shriek overhead in the sky, and the herons have come to rest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਚਲੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan chalee saahurai kiaa muhu desee agai jaai jeeu ||
english: The bride has gone to her father-in-law's house; in the world hereafter, what face will she show?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਝਾਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਭੁਲੀ ਵਾਟੜੀਆਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sutee sutee jhaal theeaa bhulee vaataReeaas jeeu ||
english: She kept sleeping as the day dawned; she forgot all about her journey.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਹੁ ਮੁਤੀਅਸੁ ਦੁਖਾ ਕੂੰ ਧਰੀਆਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tai sah naalahu muteeas dukhaa koo(n) dhareeaas jeeu ||
english: She separated herself from her Husband Lord, and now she suffers in pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਗੁਣ ਮੈ ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣਾ ਇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tudh gun mai sabh avaganaa ik naanak kee aradaas jeeu ||
english: Virtue is in You, O Lord; I am totally without virtue. This is Nanak's only prayer:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੈ ਡੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਕਾਈ ਰਾਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh raatee sohaaganee mai dohaagan kaaee raat jeeu ||1||
english: You give all Your nights to the virtuous soul-brides. I know I am unworthy, but isn't there a night for me as well? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਸੁਚਜੀ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 suchajee ||
english: Soohee, First Mehl, Suchajee ~ The Noble And Graceful Bride:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa too taa mai sabh ko too saahib meree raas jeeu ||
english: When I have You, then I have everything. O my Lord and Master, You are my wealth and capital.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tudh a(n)tar hau sukh vasaa too(n) a(n)tar saabaas jeeu ||
english: Within You, I abide in peace; within You, I am congratulated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਭਾਣੈ ਭੀਖ ਉਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai takhat vadaaeeaa bhaanai bheekh udaas jeeu ||
english: By the Pleasure of Your Will, You bestow thrones and greatness. And by the Pleasure of Your Will, You make us beggars and wanderers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਥਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਵਹੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਫੁਲੈ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai thal sir sar vahai kamal phulai aakaas jeeu ||
english: By the Pleasure of Your Will, the ocean flows in the desert, and the lotus blossoms in the sky.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਝਿ ਭਰੀਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai bhavajal la(n)gheeai bhaanai ma(n)jh bhareeaas jeeu ||
english: By the Pleasure of Your Will, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean; by the Pleasure of Your Will, he sinks down into it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਰਤਾ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai so sahu ra(n)gulaa siphat rataa gunataas jeeu ||
english: By the Pleasure of His Will, that Lord becomes my Husband, and I am imbued with the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਸਹੁ ਭੀਹਾਵਲਾ ਹਉ ਆਵਣਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਮੁਈਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai sahu bheehaavalaa hau aavan jaan mueeaas jeeu ||
english: By the Pleasure of Your Will, O my Husband Lord, I am afraid of You, and I come and go, and die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਤੋਲਵਾ ਹਉ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਈਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: too sahu agam atolavaa hau kahi kahi dhahi paeeaas jeeu ||
english: You, O my Husband Lord, are inaccessible and immeasurable; talking and speaking of You, I have fallen at Your Feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਮੈ ਦਰਸਨ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kiaa maagau kiaa kahi sunee mai darasan bhookh piaas jeeu ||
english: What should I beg for? What should I say and hear? I am hungry and thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gurasabadee sahu paaiaa sach naanak kee aradaas jeeu ||2||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, I have found my Husband Lord. This is Nanak's true prayer. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 gunava(n)tee ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Gunvantee ~ The Worthy And Virtuous Bride:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai gurasikhaRaa tis niv niv laagau paai jeeu ||
english: When I see a Sikh of the Guru, I humbly bow and fall at his feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aakhaa birathaa jee kee gur sajan dehi milaai jeeu ||
english: I tell to him the pain of my soul, and beg him to unite me with the Guru, my Best Friend.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਦਸਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: soee das upadesaRaa meraa man anat na kaahoo jaai jeeu ||
english: I ask that he impart to me such an understanding, that my mind will not go out wandering anywhere else.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੈ ਕੂੰ ਡੇਵਸਾ ਮੈ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਬਤਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ihu man tai koo(n) devasaa mai maarag dehu bataai jeeu ||
english: I dedicate this mind to you. Please, show me the Path to God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਆਇਆ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਚਲਿ ਕੈ ਮੈ ਤਕੀ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: hau aaiaa doorahu chal kai mai takee tau saranaai jeeu ||
english: I have come so far, seeking the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਆਸਾ ਰਖੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਭੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: mai aasaa rakhee chit mahi meraa sabho dukh gavaai jeeu ||
english: Within my mind, I place my hopes in You; please, take my pain and suffering away!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਭਾਈਅੜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: it maarag chale bhaaeeaRe gur kahai s kaar kamaai jeeu ||
english: So walk on this Path, O sister soul-brides; do that work which the Guru tells you to do.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗੇਂ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤੜੀ ਵਿਸਾਰੇਂ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tiaage(n) man kee mataRee visaare(n) doojaa bhaau jeeu ||
english: Abandon the intellectual pursuits of the mind, and forget the love of duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਾਵੜਾ ਨਹ ਲਗੈ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: iu paavahi har darasaavaRaa nah lagai tatee vaau jeeu ||
english: In this way, you shall obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; the hot winds shall not even touch you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਆਪਹੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੁਕਮਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: hau aapahu bol na jaanadaa mai kahiaa sabh hukamaau jeeu ||
english: By myself, I do not even know how to speak; I speak all that the Lord commands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਸਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har bhagat khajaanaa bakhasiaa gur naanak keeaa pasaau jeeu ||
english: I am blessed with the treasure of the Lord's devotional worship; Guru Nanak has been kind and compassionate to me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖੜੀ ਹਉ ਰਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: mai bahuR na trisanaa bhukhaRee hau rajaa tripat aghaai jeeu ||
english: I shall never again feel hunger or thirst; I am satisfied, satiated and fulfilled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਿਖੜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo gur deesai sikhaRaa tis niv niv laagau paai jeeu ||3||
english: When I see a Sikh of the Guru, I humbly bow and fall at his feet. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Chhant, First Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮੈ ਮਤ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਹੁਣੀ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bhar joban mai mat peeeaRai ghar paahunee bal raam jeeu ||
english: Intoxicated with the wine of youth, I did not realize that I was only a guest at my parents' home (in this world).

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੀ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਸਮਾਵਨੀ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: mailee avagan chit bin gur gun na samaavanee bal raam jeeu ||
english: My consciousness is polluted with faults and mistakes; without the Guru, virtue does not even enter into me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gun saar na jaanee bharam bhulaanee joban baad gavaaiaa ||
english: I have not known the value of virtue; I have been deluded by doubt. I have wasted away my youth in vain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: var ghar dar darasan nahee jaataa pir kaa sahaj na bhaaiaa ||
english: I have not known my Husband Lord, His celestial home and gate, or the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. I have not had the pleasure of my Husband Lord's celestial peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੀ ਸੂਤੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur poochh na maarag chaalee sootee rain vihaanee ||
english: After consulting the True Guru, I have not walked on the Path; the night of my life is passing away in sleep.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਲਤਣਿ ਰਾਡੇਪਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਧਨ ਕੁਮਲਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak baalatan raadepaa bin pir dhan kumalaanee ||1||
english: O Nanak, in the prime of my youth, I am a widow; without my Husband Lord, the soul-bride is wasting away. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮੈ ਵਰੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: baabaa mai var dehi mai har var bhaavai tis kee bal raam jeeu ||
english: O father, give me in marriage to the Lord; I am pleased with Him as my Husband. I belong to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: rav rahiaa jug chaar tribhavan baanee jis kee bal raam jeeu ||
english: He is pervading throughout the four ages, and the Word of His Bani permeates the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਕੰਤੁ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tribhavan ka(n)t ravai sohaagan avaganava(n)tee doore ||
english: The Husband Lord of the three worlds ravishes and enjoys His virtuous brides, but He keeps the ungraceful and unvirtuous ones far away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਆਸਾ ਤੈਸੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaisee aasaa taisee manasaa poor rahiaa bharapoore ||
english: As are our hopes, so are our minds' desires, which the All-pervading Lord brings to fulfillment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਰਾਂਡ ਨ ਮੈਲੈ ਵੇਸੇ ॥
transliteration: har kee naar s sarab suhaagan raa(n)d na mailai vese ||
english: The bride of the Lord is forever happy and virtuous; she shall never be a widow, and she shall never have to wear dirty clothes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਵਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤੈਸੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak mai var saachaa bhaavai jug jug preetam taise ||2||
english: O Nanak, I love my True Husband Lord; my Beloved is the same, age after age. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਲਗਨੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਹੰ ਭੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: baabaa lagan ganaai ha(n) bhee va(n)njaa saahurai bal raam jeeu ||
english: O Baba, calculate that auspicious moment, when I too shall be going to my in-laws' house.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਨ ਟਲੈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: saahaa hukam rajaai so na talai jo prabh karai bal raam jeeu ||
english: The moment of that marriage will be set by the Hukam of God's Command; His Will cannot be changed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kirat paiaa karatai kar paaiaa met na sakai koee ||
english: The karmic record of past deeds, written by the Creator Lord, cannot be erased by anyone.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਞੀ ਨਾਉ ਨਰਹ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jaanjee naau narah nihakeval rav rahiaa tihu loee ||
english: The most respected member of the marriage party, my Husband, is the independent Lord of all beings, pervading and permeating the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਰੋਇ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਬਾਲੀ ਬਾਲੈ ਹੇਤੇ ॥
transliteration: maai niraasee roi vichhu(n)nee baalee baalai hete ||
english: Maya, crying out in pain, leaves, seeing that the bride and the groom are in love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਹਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੇਤੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak saach sabad sukh mahalee gur charanee prabh chete ||3||
english: O Nanak, the peace of the Mansion of God's Presence comes through the True Word of the Shabad; the bride keeps the Guru's Feet enshrined in her mind. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੁਲਿ ਦਿਤੜੀ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਪੇਈਐ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: baabul ditaRee door naa aavai ghar peeeai bal raam jeeu ||
english: My father has given me in marriage far away, and I shall not return to my parents' home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹਸੀ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹੀਐ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: rahasee vekh hadoor pir raavee ghar soheeai bal raam jeeu ||
english: I am delighted to see my Husband Lord near at hand; in His Home, I am so beautiful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਪਿਰ ਲੋੜੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜੋੜੀ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: saache pir loRee preetam joRee mat pooree paradhaane ||
english: My True Beloved Husband Lord desires me; He has joined me to Himself, and made my intellect pure and sublime.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲਾ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)jogee melaa thaan suhelaa gunava(n)tee gur giaane ||
english: By good destiny I met Him, and was given a place of rest; through the Guru's Wisdom, I have become virtuous.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh sadaa sach palai sach bolai pir bhaae ||
english: I gather lasting Truth and contentment in my lap, and my Beloved is pleased with my truthful speech.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak vichhuR naa dukh paae guramat a(n)k samaae ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, I shall not suffer the pain of separation; through the Guru's Teachings, I merge into the loving embrace of the Lord's Being. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤੁ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 1 chha(n)t ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Chhant, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: ham ghar saajan aae ||
english: My friends have come into my home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saachai mel milaae ||
english: The True Lord has united me with them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sahaj milaae har man bhaae pa(n)ch mile sukh paaiaa ||
english: The Lord automatically united me with them when it pleased Him; uniting with the chosen ones, I have found peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saaee vasat paraapat hoee jis setee man laaiaa ||
english: I have obtained that thing, which my mind desired.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੋਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anadin mel bhaiaa man maaniaa ghar ma(n)dar sohaae ||
english: Meeting with them, night and day, my mind is pleased; my home and mansion are beautified.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch sabad dhun anahad vaaje ham ghar saajan aae ||1||
english: The unstruck sound current of the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, vibrates and resounds; my friends have come into my home. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aavahu meet piaare ||
english: So come, my beloved friends,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)gal gaavahu naare ||
english: And sing the songs of joy, O sisters.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sach ma(n)gal gaavahu taa prabh bhaavahu sohilaRaa jug chaare ||
english: Sing the true songs of joy and God will be pleased. You shall be celebrated throughout the four ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: apanai ghar aaiaa thaan suhaaiaa kaaraj sabad savaare ||
english: My Husband Lord has come into my home, and my place is adorned and decorated. Through the Shabad, my affairs have been resolved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: giaan mahaa ras netree a(n)jan tribhavan roop dikhaaiaa ||
english: Applying the ointment, the supreme essence, of divine wisdom to my eyes, I see the Lord's form throughout the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਰਸਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sakhee milahu ras ma(n)gal gaavahu ham ghar saajan aaiaa ||2||
english: So join with me, my sisters, and sing the songs of joy and delight; my friends have come into my home. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)mrit bhi(n)naa ||
english: My mind and body are drenched with Ambrosial Nectar;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਰਤੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar prem rata(n)naa ||
english: deep within the nucleus of my self, is the jewel of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar ratan padaarath merai param tat veechaaro ||
english: This invaluable jewel is deep within me; I contemplate the supreme essence of reality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੰਤ ਭੇਖ ਤੂ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)t bhekh too saphalio daataa sir sir devanahaaro ||
english: Living beings are mere beggars; You are the Giver of rewards; You are the Giver to each and every being.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਾਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: too jaan giaanee a(n)tarajaamee aape kaaran keenaa ||
english: You are Wise and All-knowing, the Inner-knower; You Yourself created the creation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਖੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sunahu sakhee man mohan mohiaa tan man a(n)mrit bheenaa ||3||
english: So listen, O my sisters - the Enticer has enticed my mind. My body and mind are drenched with Nectar. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aatam raam sa(n)saaraa ||
english: O Supreme Soul of the World,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saachaa khel tumhaaraa ||
english: Your play is true.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sach khel tumhaaraa agam apaaraa tudh bin kaun bujhaae ||
english: Your play is true, O Inaccessible and Infinite Lord; without You, who can make me understand?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik siaane kete tujh bin kavan kahaae ||
english: There are millions of Siddhas and enlightened seekers, but without You, who can call himself one?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਭਏ ਦੇਵਾਨੇ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਠਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaal bikaal bhae devaane man raakhiaa gur thaae ||
english: Death and rebirth drive the mind insane; only the Guru can hold it in its place.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak avagan sabad jalaae gun sa(n)gam prabh paae ||4||1||2||
english: O Nanak, one who burns away his demerits and faults with the Shabad, accumulates virtue, and finds God. ||4||1||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 1 ghar 3 ||
english: Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸਜਣਾ ਹਉ ਦੇਖਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aavahu sajanaa hau dekhaa darasan teraa raam ||
english: Come, my friend, so that I may behold the blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਆਪਨੜੈ ਖੜੀ ਤਕਾ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਘਨੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ghar aapanaRai khaRee takaa mai man chaau ghaneraa raam ||
english: I stand in my doorway, watching for You; my mind is filled with such a great yearning.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਘਨੇਰਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: man chaau ghaneraa sun prabh meraa mai teraa bharavaasaa ||
english: My mind is filled with such a great yearning; hear me, O God - I place my faith in You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: darasan dekh bhaee nihakeval janam maran dukh naasaa ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I have become free of desire; the pains of birth and death are taken away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਤੂ ਸੋਈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sagalee jot jaataa too soee miliaa bhaai subhaae ||
english: Your Light is in everyone; through it, You are known. Through love, You are easily met.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਜਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saajan kau bal jaaeeai saach mile ghar aae ||1||
english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to my Friend; He has come home to meet with those who are true. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਆਇਅੜੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਤਾ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸਰਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ghar aaiaRe saajanaa taa dhan kharee sarasee raam ||
english: When her Friend comes to her home, the bride is very pleased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੋਹਿਅੜੀ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹੰਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har mohiaRee saach sabad thaakur dekh raha(n)see raam ||
english: She is fascinated with the True Word of the Lord's Shabad; gazing upon her Lord and Master, she is filled with joy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹੰਸੀ ਖਰੀ ਸਰਸੀ ਜਾ ਰਾਵੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੈ ॥
transliteration: gun sa(n)g raha(n)see kharee sarasee jaa raavee ra(n)g raatai ||
english: She is filled with virtuous joy, and is totally pleased, when she is ravished and enjoyed by her Lord, and imbued with His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ॥
transliteration: avagan maar gunee ghar chhaaiaa poorai purakh bidhaatai ||
english: Her faults and demerits are eradicated, and she roofs her home with virtue, through the Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਸਕਰ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਸੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਣਿ ਅਦਲੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tasakar maar vasee pa(n)chaain adal kare veechaare ||
english: Conquering the thieves, she dwells as the mistress of her home, and administers justice wisely.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam nisataaraa guramat milahi piaare ||2||
english: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, she is emancipated; through the Guru's Teachings, she meets her Beloved. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: var paaiaRaa baalaReee aasaa manasaa pooree raam ||
english: The young bride has found her Husband Lord; her hopes and desires are fulfilled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵਿਅੜੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਲੀ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਹ ਦੂਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: pir raaviaRee sabad ralee rav rahiaa nah dooree raam ||
english: She enjoys and ravishes her Husband Lord, and blends into the Word of the Shabad, pervading and permeating everywhere; the Lord is not far away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੋਈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
transliteration: prabh door na hoee ghat ghat soee tis kee naar sabaaee ||
english: God is not far away; He is in each and every heart. All are His brides.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਵੇ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: aape raseeaa aape raave jiu tis dee vadiaaee ||
english: He Himself is the Enjoyer, He Himself ravishes and enjoys; this is His glorious greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: amar adol amol apaaraa gur poorai sach paaeeai ||
english: He is imperishable, immovable, invaluable and infinite. The True Lord is obtained through the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗ ਸਜੋਗੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak aape jog sajogee nadar kare liv laaeeai ||3||
english: O Nanak, He Himself unites in Union; by His Glance of Grace, He lovingly attunes them to Himself. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਉਚੜੀਐ ਮਾੜੜੀਐ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਆ ਸਿਰਤਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: pir uchaReeai maaRaReeai tihu loaa sirataajaa raam ||
english: My Husband Lord dwells in the loftiest balcony; He is the Supreme Lord of the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ਦੇਖਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਅਗਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: hau bisam bhaee dekh gunaa anahad sabad agaajaa raam ||
english: I am amazed, gazing upon His glorious excellence; the unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resonates.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੋ ॥
transliteration: sabad veechaaree karanee saaree raam naam neesaano ||
english: I contemplate the Shabad, and perform sublime deeds; I am blessed with the insignia, the banner of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਖੋਟੇ ਨਹੀ ਠਾਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa khote nahee thaahar naam ratan paravaano ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the false find no place of rest; only the jewel of the Naam brings acceptance and renown.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: pat mat pooree pooraa paravaanaa naa aavai naa jaasee ||
english: Perfect is my honor, perfect is my intellect and password. I shall not have to come or go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh aap pachhaanai prabh jaise avinaasee ||4||1||3||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands her own self; she becomes like her Imperishable Lord God. ||4||1||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa 1 ghar 4 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Chhant, First Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੜੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin keeaa tin dekhiaa jag dha(n)dhaRai laaiaa ||
english: The One who created the world, watches over it; He enjoins the people of the world to their tasks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਤਨਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: daan terai ghat chaananaa tan cha(n)d deepaaiaa ||
english: Your gifts, O Lord, illuminate the heart, and the moon casts its light on the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੋ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ ਦਾਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਉਠਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)do deepaaiaa daan har kai dukh a(n)dheraa uth gaiaa ||
english: The moon glows, by the Lord's gift, and the darkness of suffering is taken away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਜੰਞ ਲਾੜੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਪਰਖਿ ਮੋਹਣੀਐ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gun ja(n)nj laaRe naal sohai parakh mohaneeai laiaa ||
english: The marriage party of virtue looks beautiful with the Groom; He chooses His enticing bride with care.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੀਵਾਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਭ ਸੇਤੀ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: veevaahu hoaa sobh setee pa(n)ch sabadee aaiaa ||
english: The wedding is performed with glorious splendor; He has arrived, accompanied by the vibrations of the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੜੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin keeaa tin dekhiaa jag dha(n)dhaRai laaiaa ||1||
english: The One who created the world, watches over it; He enjoins the people of the world to their tasks. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਮੀਤਾ ਅਵਰੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree saajanaa meetaa avareetaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my pure friends, the immaculate Saints.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਗਾਡਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਅੜਾ ਦੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ihu tan jin siu gaadiaa man leeaRaa deetaa ||
english: This body is attached to them, and we have shared our minds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੀਆ ਤ ਦੀਆ ਮਾਨੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਸੇ ਸਜਨ ਕਿਉ ਵੀਸਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: leeaa ta deeaa maan jinh siu se sajan kiu veesarahi ||
english: We have shared our minds - how could I forget those friends?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਦਿਸਿ ਆਇਆ ਹੋਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਜੀਅ ਸੇਤੀ ਗਹਿ ਰਹਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jinh dis aaiaa hohi raleeaa jee setee gahi rahahi ||
english: Seeing them brings joy to my heart; I keep them clasped to my soul.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਹਿ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal gun avagan na koee hohi neetaa neetaa ||
english: They have all virtues and merits, forever and ever; they have no demerits or faults at all.

author: Guru Nanak
