gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਮੀਤਾ ਅਵਰੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree saajanaa meetaa avareetaa ||2||
english: I am a sacrifice to my pure friends, the immaculate Saints. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੁਲਾ ਕਢਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਲਈਜੈ ॥
transliteration: gunaa kaa hovai vaasulaa kadh vaas laeejai ||
english: One who has a basket of fragrant virtues, should enjoy its fragrance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਨੑਿ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਝ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: je gun hovanhi saajanaa mil saajh kareejai ||
english: If my friends have virtues, I will share in them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਝ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਗੁਣਹ ਕੇਰੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਚਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: saajh kareejai gunah keree chhod avagan chaleeai ||
english: Let us form a partnership, and share our virtues; let us abandon our faults, and walk on the Path.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰੇ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਕਰਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿੜੁ ਮਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: pahire pata(n)bar kar ada(n)bar aapanaa piR maleeai ||
english: Let us wear our virtues like silk clothes; let us decorate ourselves, and enter the arena.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੀਐ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਝੋਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jithai jaai baheeai bhalaa kaheeai jhol a(n)mrit peejai ||
english: Let us speak of goodness, wherever we go and sit; let us skim off the Ambrosial Nectar, and drink it in.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੁਲਾ ਕਢਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਲਈਜੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gunaa kaa hovai vaasulaa kadh vaas laeejai ||3||
english: One who has a basket of fragrant virtues, should enjoy its fragrance. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai hor kare na koee ||
english: He Himself acts; unto whom should we complain? No one else does anything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਭੂਲੜਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aakhan taa kau jaaeeai je bhoolaRaa hoee ||
english: Go ahead and complain to Him, if He makes a mistake.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਾਇ ਕਹੀਐ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਿਉ ਭੁਲੈ ॥
transliteration: je hoi bhoolaa jaai kaheeai aap karataa kiu bhulai ||
english: If He makes a mistake, go ahead and complain to Him; but how can the Creator Himself make a mistake?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣੇ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਾਝੁ ਕਹਿਐ ਦਾਨੁ ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਿਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sune dekhe baajh kahiai daan anama(n)giaa divai ||
english: He sees, He hears, and without our asking, without our begging, He gives His gifts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਗਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: daan dei daataa jag bidhaataa naanakaa sach soee ||
english: The Great Giver, the Architect of the Universe, gives His gifts. O Nanak, He is the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai hor kare na koee ||4||1||4||
english: He Himself acts; unto whom should we complain? No one else does anything. ||4||1||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Soohee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: meraa man raataa gun ravai man bhaavai soee ||
english: My mind is imbued with His Glorious Praises; I chant them, and He is pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਸਾਚ ਕੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur kee pauRee saach kee saachaa sukh hoee ||
english: Truth is the ladder to the Guru; climbing up to the True Lord, peace is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਚ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਟਲੈ ॥
transliteration: sukh sahaj aavai saach bhaavai saach kee mat kiu talai ||
english: Celestial peace comes; the Truth pleases me. How could these True Teachings ever be erased?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਛਲਿਓ ਕਿਉ ਛਲੈ ॥
transliteration: isanaan daan sugiaan majan aap achhalio kiu chhalai ||
english: He Himself is Undeceivable; how could He ever be deceived by cleansing baths, charity, spiritual wisdom or ritual bathings?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਨ ਦੋਈ ॥
transliteration: parapa(n)ch moh bikaar thaake kooR kapat na doee ||
english: Fraud, attachment and corruption are taken away, as are falsehood, hypocrisy and duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: meraa man raataa gun ravai man bhaavai soee ||1||
english: My mind is imbued with His Glorious Praises; I chant them, and He is pleasing to my mind. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: saahib so saalaaheeai jin kaaran keeaa ||
english: So praise your Lord and Master, who created the creation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲਿਐ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mail laagee man mailiai kinai a(n)mrit peeaa ||
english: Filth sticks to the polluted mind; how rare are those who drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਥਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੋਲੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: math a(n)mrit peeaa ihu man deeaa gur pahi mol karaaiaa ||
english: Churn this Ambrosial Nectar, and drink it in; dedicate this mind to the Guru, and He will value it highly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aapanaRaa prabh sahaj pachhaataa jaa man saachai laaiaa ||
english: I intuitively realized my God, when I linked my mind to the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tis naal gun gaavaa je tis bhaavaa kiu milai hoi paraaiaa ||
english: I will sing the Lord's Glorious Praises with Him, if it pleases Him; how could I meet Him by being a stranger to Him?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saahib so saalaaheeai jin jagat upaaiaa ||2||
english: So praise your Lord and Master, who created the creation. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਕੀ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਕਿਉ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aai gaiaa kee na aaio kiu aavai jaataa ||
english: When He comes, what else remains behind? How can there be any coming or going then?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: preetam siu man maaniaa har setee raataa ||
english: When the mind is reconciled with its Beloved Lord, it is blended with Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਿੰਬ ਕਾ ਕੋਟੁ ਉਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saahib ra(n)g raataa sach kee baataa jin bi(n)b kaa kot usaariaa ||
english: True is the speech of one who is imbued with the Love of his Lord and Master, who fashioned the body fortress from a mere bubble.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਨਾਇਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚ ਕਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch bhoo naaiko aap sira(n)daa jin sach kaa pi(n)d savaariaa ||
english: He is the Master of the five elements; He Himself is the Creator Lord. He embellished the body with Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ham avaganiaare too sun piaare tudh bhaavai sach soee ||
english: I am worthless; please hear me, O my Beloved! Whatever pleases You is True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa naa theeai saachee mat hoee ||3||
english: One who is blessed with true understanding, does not come and go. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਅੰਜੀਐ ਜੈਸਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)jan taisaa a(n)jeeai jaisaa pir bhaavai ||
english: Apply such an ointment to your eyes, which is pleasing to your Beloved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਮਝੈ ਸੂਝੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: samajhai soojhai jaaneeai je aap jaanaavai ||
english: I realize, understand and know Him, only if He Himself causes me to know Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਮਨੂਆ ਲੇਵਏ ॥
transliteration: aap jaanaavai maarag paavai aape manooaa levae ||
english: He Himself shows me the Way, and He Himself leads me to it, attracting my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਅਭੇਵਏ ॥
transliteration: karam sukaram karaae aape keemat kaun abhevae ||
english: He Himself causes us to do good and bad deeds; who can know the value of the Mysterious Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ta(n)t ma(n)t paakha(n)d na jaanaa raam ridai man maaniaa ||
english: I know nothing of Tantric spells, magical mantras and hypocritical rituals; enshrining the Lord within my heart, my mind is satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: a(n)jan naam tisai te soojhai gurasabadee sach jaaniaa ||4||
english: The ointment of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is only understood by one who realizes the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਪਣੇ ਕਿਉ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: saajan hovan aapane kiu par ghar jaahee ||
english: I have my own friends; why should I go to the home of a stranger?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚ ਕੇ ਸੰਗੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: saajan raate sach ke sa(n)ge man maahee ||
english: My friends are imbued with the True Lord; He is with them, in their minds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man maahi saajan karahi raleeaa karam dharam sabaaiaa ||
english: In their minds, these friends celebrate in happiness; all good karma, righteousness and Dharma,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁੰਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: athasath teerath pu(n)n poojaa naam saachaa bhaaiaa ||
english: The sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, charity and worship, are found in the love of the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸਾਜੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aap saaje thaap vekhai tisai bhaanaa bhaaiaa ||
english: He Himself creates, establishes and beholds all, by the Pleasure of His Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਰਾਂਗਿ ਰੰਗੀਲੜੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: saajan raa(n)g ra(n)geelaRe ra(n)g laal banaaiaa ||5||
english: My friends are happy in the Love of the Lord; they nurture love for their Beloved. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਆਗੂ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhaa aagoo je theeai kiu paadhar jaanai ||
english: If a blind man is made the leader, how will he know the way?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਸੈ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਛੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਰਾਹੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: aap musai mat hochheeai kiu raahu pachhaanai ||
english: He is impaired, and his understanding is inadequate; how will he know the way?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਰਾਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਅੰਧ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਅੰਧਲੀ ॥
transliteration: kiu raahi jaavai mahal paavai a(n)dh kee mat a(n)dhalee ||
english: How can he follow the path and reach the Mansion of the Lord's Presence? Blind is the understanding of the blind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਬੂਡੌ ਧੰਧਲੀ ॥
transliteration: vin naam har ke kachh na soojhai a(n)dh boodau dha(n)dhalee ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, they cannot see anything; the blind are drowned in worldly entanglements.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਚਾਉ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
transliteration: din raat chaanan chaau upajai sabad gur kaa man vasai ||
english: Day and night, the Divine Light shines forth and joy wells up, when the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides in the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਸੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kar joR gur pahi kar bina(n)tee raahu paadhar gur dasai ||6||
english: With your palms pressed together, pray to the Guru to show you the way. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man paradesee je theeai sabh des paraaiaa ||
english: If the man becomes a stranger to God, then all the world becomes a stranger to him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਖੋਲੑਉ ਗੰਠੜੀ ਦੂਖੀ ਭਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kis pahi kholh ga(n)thaRee dookhee bhar aaiaa ||
english: Unto whom should I tie up and give the bundle of my pains?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੀ ਭਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: dookhee bhar aaiaa jagat sabaaiaa kaun jaanai bidh mereeaa ||
english: The whole world is overflowing with pain and suffering; who can know the state of my inner self?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੇ ਜਾਵਣੇ ਖਰੇ ਡਰਾਵਣੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਫੇਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aavane jaavane khare daraavane tot na aavai phereeaa ||
english: Comings and goings are terrible and dreadful; there is no end to the rounds of reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਊਣੇ ਝੂਣੇ ਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naam vihoone oone jhoone naa gur sabad sunaaiaa ||
english: Without the Naam, he is vacant and sad; he does not listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: man paradesee je theeai sabh des paraaiaa ||7||
english: If the mind becomes a stranger to God, then all the world becomes a stranger to him. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੋ ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gur mahalee ghar aapanai so bharapur leenaa ||
english: One who finds the Guru's Mansion within the home of his own being, merges in the All-pervading Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਕਰੇ ਸਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sevak sevaa taa(n) kare sach sabad pateenaa ||
english: The sevadar performs selfless service when he is pleased, and confirmed in the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਅੰਕੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabade pateejai a(n)k bheejai s mahal mahalaa a(n)tare ||
english: Confirmed in the Shabad, with her being softened by devotion, the bride dwells in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, deep within her being.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aap karataa kare soee prabh aap a(n)t nira(n)tare ||
english: The Creator Himself creates; God Himself, in the end, is endless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਤਾਂ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਬਾਜੰਤ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੀਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gur sabad melaa taa(n) suhelaa baaja(n)t anahad beenaa ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mortal is united, and then embellished; the unstruck melody of the sound current resounds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੋ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: gur mahalee ghar aapanai so bharipur leenaa ||8||
english: One who finds the Guru's Mansion within the home of his own being, merges in the All-pervading Lord. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: keetaa kiaa saalaaheeai kar vekhai soee ||
english: Why praise that which is created? Praise instead the One who created it and watches over it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: taa kee keemat naa pavai je lochai koee ||
english: His value cannot be estimated, no matter how much one may wish.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਏ ॥
transliteration: keemat so paavai aap jaanaavai aap abhul na bhulae ||
english: He alone can estimate the Lord's value, whom the Lord Himself causes to know. He is not mistaken; He does not make mistakes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਮੁਲਏ ॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar karahi tudh bhaavahi gur kai sabad amulae ||
english: He alone celebrates victory, who is pleasing to You, through the Invaluable Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੀਣਉ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: heenau neech karau bena(n)tee saach na chhodau bhaaee ||
english: I am lowly and abject - I offer my prayer; may I never forsake the True Name, O Sibling of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੯॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak jin kar dekhiaa devai mat saaee ||9||2||5||
english: O Nanak, the One who created the creation, watches over it; He alone bestows understanding. ||9||2||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa 3 ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Third Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sukh sohilaRaa har dhiaavahu ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, and find peace and pleasure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har phal paavahu ||
english: As Gurmukh, obtain the Lord's fruitful rewards.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh phal paavahu har naam dhiaavahu janam janam ke dookh nivaare ||
english: As Gurmukh, obtain the fruit of the Lord, and meditate on the Lord's Name; the pains of countless lifetimes shall be erased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪਣੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: balihaaree gur apane vitahu jin kaaraj sabh savaare ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has arranged and resolved all my affairs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: har prabh kripaa kare har jaapahu sukh phal har jan paavahu ||
english: The Lord God will bestow His Grace, if you meditate on the Lord; O humble servant of the Lord, you shall obtain the fruit of peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਖ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kahai sunahu jan bhaaee sukh sohilaRaa har dhiaavahu ||1||
english: Says Nanak, listen O humble Sibling of Destiny: meditate on the Lord, and find peace and pleasure. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਭੀਨੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sun har gun bheene sahaj subhaae ||
english: Hearing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I am intuitively drenched with His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: guramat sahaje naam dhiaae ||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, I meditate intuitively on the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jin kau dhur likhiaa tin gur miliaa tin janam maran bhau bhaagaa ||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, meet the Guru, and their fears of birth and death leave them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਖੋਈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)darahu duramat doojee khoee so jan har liv laagaa ||
english: One who eliminates evil-mindedness and duality from within himself, that humble being lovingly focuses his mind on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jin kau kripaa keenee merai suaamee tin anadin har gun gaae ||
english: Those, upon whom my Lord and Master bestows His Grace, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਭੀਨੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sun man bheene sahaj subhaae ||2||
english: Hearing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I am intuitively drenched with His Love. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jug mahi raam naam nisataaraa ||
english: In this age, emancipation comes only from the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur te upajai sabad veechaaraa ||
english: Contemplative meditation on the Word of the Shabad emanates from the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gurasabad veechaaraa raam naam piaaraa jis kirapaa kare s paae ||
english: Contemplating the Guru's Shabad, one comes to love the Lord's Name; he alone obtains it, unto whom the Lord shows Mercy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sahaje gun gaavai din raatee kilavikh sabh gavaae ||
english: In peace and poise, he sings the Lord's Praises day and night, and all sins are eradicated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko teraa too sabhanaa kaa hau teraa too hamaaraa ||
english: All are Yours, and You belong to all. I am Yours, and You are mine.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jug mahi raam naam nisataaraa ||3||
english: In this age, emancipation comes only from the Lord's Name. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਆਇ ਵੁਠੇ ਘਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: saajan aai vuthe ghar maahee ||
english: The Lord, my Friend has come to dwell within the home of my heart;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavahi tripat aghaahee ||
english: singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is satisfied and fulfilled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaai sadaa tripataasee phir bhookh na laagai aae ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is satisfied forever, never to feel hunger again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਪੂਜ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: dah dis pooj hovai har jan kee jo har har naam dhiaae ||
english: That humble servant of the Lord, who meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is worshipped in the ten directions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak har aape joR vichhoRe har bin ko doojaa naahee ||
english: O Nanak, He Himself joins and separates; there is no other than the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਆਇ ਵੁਠੇ ਘਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: saajan aai vuthe ghar maahee ||4||1||
english: The Lord, my Friend has come to dwell within the home of my heart. ||4||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 3 ghar 3 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Third Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kee har jeeu raakhai jug jug rakhadaa aaiaa raam ||
english: The Dear Lord protects His humble devotees; throughout the ages, He has protected them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: so bhagat jo guramukh hovai haumai sabad jalaaiaa raam ||
english: Those devotees who become Gurmukh burn away their ego, through the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: haumai sabad jalaaiaa mere har bhaaiaa jis dee saachee baanee ||
english: Those who burn away their ego through the Shabad, become pleasing to my Lord; their speech becomes True.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sachee bhagat karahi din raatee guramukh aakh vakhaanee ||
english: They perform the Lord's true devotional service, day and night, as the Guru has instructed them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਾਲ ਸਚੀ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa kee chaal sachee at niramal naam sachaa man bhaaiaa ||
english: The devotees' lifestyle is true, and absolutely pure; the True Name is pleasing to their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bhagat sohahi dar saachai jinee sacho sach kamaaiaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, the those devotees, who practice Truth, and only Truth, look beauteous in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har bhagataa kee jaat pat hai bhagat har kai naam samaane raam ||
english: The Lord is the social class and honor of His devotees; the Lord's devotees merge in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har bhagat karahi vichahu aap gavaavahi jin gun avagan pachhaane raam ||
english: They worship the Lord in devotion, and eradicate self-conceit from within themselves; they understand merits and demerits.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਭੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: gun augan pachhaanai har naam vakhaanai bhai bhagat meethee laagee ||
english: They understand merits and demerits, and chant the Lord's Name; devotional worship is sweet to them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat karahi din raatee ghar hee mahi bairaagee ||
english: Night and day, they perform devotional worship, day and night, and in the home of the self, they remain detached.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: bhagatee raate sadaa man niramal har jeeu vekhahi sadaa naale ||
english: Imbued with devotion, their minds remain forever immaculate and pure; they see their Dear Lord always with them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak se bhagat har kai dar saache anadin naam samhaale ||2||
english: O Nanak, those devotees are True in the Court of the Lord; night and day, they dwell upon the Naam. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhagat karahi bin satigur vin satigur bhagat na hoee raam ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs practice devotional rituals without the True Guru, but without the True Guru, there is no devotion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: haumai maaiaa rog viaape mar janamahi dukh hoee raam ||
english: They are afflicted with the diseases of egotism and Maya, and they suffer the pains of death and rebirth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਰਜ ਵਿਗੋਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mar janamahi dukh hoee doojai bhaai paraj vigoee vin gur tat na jaaniaa ||
english: The world suffers the pains of death and rebirth, and through the love of duality, it is ruined; without the Guru, the essence of reality is not known.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vihoonaa sabh jag bharamiaa a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaaniaa ||
english: Without devotional worship, everyone in the world is deluded and confused, and in the end, they depart with regrets.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kot madhe kinai pachhaaniaa har naamaa sach soee ||
english: Among millions, there is scarcely one who realizes the Name of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee doojai bhaai pat khoee ||3||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained; in the love of duality, all honor is lost. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa kai ghar kaaraj saachaa har gun sadaa vakhaane raam ||
english: In the home of the devotees, is the joy of true marriage; they chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੀਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhagat khajaanaa aape deeaa kaal ka(n)tak maar samaane raam ||
english: He Himself blesses them with the treasure of devotion; conquering the thorny pain of death, they merge in the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kaal ka(n)tak maar samaane har man bhaane naam nidhaan sach paaiaa ||
english: Conquering the thorny pain of death, they merge in the Lord; they are pleasing to the Lord's Mind, and they obtain the true treasure of the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sadaa akhut kade na nikhutai har deeaa sahaj subhaaiaa ||
english: This treasure is inexhaustible; it will never be exhausted. The Lord automatically blesses them with it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਊਚੇ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਊਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har jan ooche sad hee ooche gur kai sabad suhaaiaa ||
english: The humble servants of the Lord are exalted and elevated, forever on high; they are adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak aape bakhas milaae jug jug sobhaa paaiaa ||4||1||2||
english: O Nanak, He Himself forgives them, and merges them with Himself; throughout the ages, they are glorified. ||4||1||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Soohee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਜਿਥੈ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sabad sachai sach sohilaa jithai sache kaa hoi veechaaro raam ||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, true happiness prevails, there where the True Lord is contemplated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: haumai sabh kilavikh kaate saach rakhiaa ur dhaare raam ||
english: Egotism and all sins are eradicated, when one keeps the True Lord enshrined in the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sach rakhiaa ur dhaare dutar taare phir bhavajal taran na hoee ||
english: One who keeps the True Lord enshrined in the heart, crosses over the terrible and dreadful world-ocean; he shall not have to cross over it again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sachaa satigur sachee baanee jin sach vikhaaliaa soee ||
english: True is the True Guru, and True is the Word of His Bani; through it, the True Lord is seen.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: saache gun gaavai sach samaavai sach vekhai sabh soee ||
english: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord merges in Truth; he beholds the True Lord everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saachaa saahib saachee naaee sach nisataaraa hoee ||1||
english: O Nanak, True is the Lord and Master, and True is His Name; through Truth, comes emancipation. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saachai satigur saach bujhaaiaa pat raakhai sach soee raam ||
english: The True Guru reveals the True Lord; the True Lord preserves our honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sachaa bhojan bhaau sachaa hai sachai naam sukh hoee raam ||
english: The true food is love for the True Lord; through the True Name, peace is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: saachai naam sukh hoee marai na koee garabh na joonee vaasaa ||
english: Through the True Name, the mortal finds peace; he shall never die, and never again enter the womb of reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jotee jot milaaee sach samaaee sach naai paragaasaa ||
english: His light blends with the Light, and he merges into the True Lord; he is illuminated and enlightened with the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਹੋਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee sach jaataa se sache hoe anadin sach dhiaain ||
english: Those who know the Truth are True; night and day, they meditate on Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sach naam jin hiradai vasiaa naa veechhuR dukh paain ||2||
english: O Nanak, those whose hearts are filled with the True Name, never suffer the pains of separation. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sachee baanee sache gun gaavahi tit ghar sohilaa hoee raam ||
english: In that home, and in that heart, where the True Bani of the Lord's True Praises are sung, the songs of joy resound.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਚੇ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: niramal gun saache tan man saachaa vich saachaa purakh prabh soee raam ||
english: Through the immaculate virtues of the True Lord, the body and mind are rendered True, and God, the True Primal Being, dwells within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਜੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh sach varatai sacho bolai jo sach karai s hoee ||
english: Such a person practices only Truth, and speaks only Truth; whatever the True Lord does, that alone comes to pass.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸਚੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah sach pasariaa avar na doojaa koee ||
english: Wherever I look, there I see the True Lord pervading; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sache upajai sach samaavai mar janamai doojaa hoee ||
english: From the True Lord, we emanate, and into the True Lord, we shall merge; death and birth come from duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak sabh kichh aape karataa aap karaavai soee ||3||
english: O Nanak, He Himself does everything; He Himself is the Cause. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਵਾਰੇ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sache bhagat sohahi daravaare sacho sach vakhaane raam ||
english: The true devotees look beautiful in the Darbaar of the Lord's Court. They speak Truth, and only Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਚੋ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ghat a(n)tare saachee baanee saacho aap pachhaane raam ||
english: Deep within the nucleus of their heart, is the True Word of the Lord's Bani. Through the Truth, they understand themselves.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aap pachhaanahi taa sach jaanahi saache sojhee hoee ||
english: They understand themselves, and so know the True Lord, through their true intuition.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਹੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sachaa sabad sachee hai sobhaa saache hee sukh hoee ||
english: True is the Shabad, and True is its Glory; peace comes only from Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਭਗਤ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: saach rate bhagat ik ra(n)gee doojaa ra(n)g na koee ||
english: Imbued with Truth, the devotees love the One Lord; they do not love any other.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak jis kau masatak likhiaa tis sach paraapat hoee ||4||2||3||
english: O Nanak, he alone obtains the True Lord, who has such pre-ordained destiny written upon his forehead. ||4||2||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Soohee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਧਨ ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jug chaare dhan je bhavai bin satigur sohaag na hoee raam ||
english: The soul-bride may wander throughout the four ages, but still, without the True Guru, she will not find her True Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: nihachal raaj sadaa har keraa tis bin avar na koee raam ||
english: The Kingdom of the Lord is permanent, and forever unchanging; there is no other than Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tis bin avar na koee sadaa sach soee guramukh eko jaaniaa ||
english: There is no other than Him - He is True forever; the Gurmukh knows the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dhan pir melaavaa hoaa guramatee man maaniaa ||
english: That soul-bride, whose mind accepts the Guru's Teachings, meets her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliaa taa har paaiaa bin har naavai mukat na hoee ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, she finds the Lord; without the Lord's Name, there is no liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੰਤੈ ਰਾਵੇ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kaaman ka(n)tai raave man maaniai sukh hoee ||1||
english: O Nanak, the soul-bride ravishes and enjoys her Husband Lord; her mind accepts Him, and she finds peace. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਧਨ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev dhan baalaReee har var paavahi soee raam ||
english: Serve the True Guru, O young and innocent bride; thus you shall obtain the Lord as your Husband.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sadaa hovahi sohaaganee phir mailaa ves na hoee raam ||
english: You shall be the virtuous and happy bride of the True Lord forever; and you shall never again wear soiled clothes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: phir mailaa ves na hoee guramukh boojhai koee haumai maar pachhaaniaa ||
english: Your clothes shall never again be soiled; how rare are those few, who, as Gurmukh, recognize this, and conquer their ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: karanee kaar kamaavai sabad samaavai a(n)tar eko jaaniaa ||
english: So make your practice the practice of good deeds; merge into the Word of the Shabad, and deep within, come to know the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh prabh raave din raatee aapanaa saachee sobhaa hoee ||
english: The Gurmukh enjoys God, day and night, and so obtains true glory.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kaaman pir raave aapanaa rav rahiaa prabh soee ||2||
english: O Nanak, the soul-bride enjoys and ravishes her Beloved; God is pervading and permeating everywhere. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਧਨ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur kee kaar kare dhan baalaReee har var dei milaae raam ||
english: Serve the Guru, O young and innocent soul-bride, and he will lead to you meet your Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ਹੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har kai ra(n)g ratee hai kaaman mil preetam sukh paae raam ||
english: The bride is imbued with the Love of her Lord; meeting with her Beloved, she finds peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mil preetam sukh paae sach samaae sach varatai sabh thaaee ||
english: Meeting her Beloved, she finds peace, and merges in the True Lord; the True Lord is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sachaa seegaar kare din raatee kaaman sach samaaee ||
english: The bride makes Truth her decorations, day and night, and remains absorbed in the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਲਇਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har sukhadaataa sabad pachhaataa kaaman laiaa ka(n)th laae ||
english: The Lord, the Giver of peace, is realized through His Shabad; He hugs His bride close in His embrace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak mahalee mahal pachhaanai guramatee har paae ||3||
english: O Nanak, the bride obtains the Mansion of His Presence; through the Guru's Teachings, she finds her Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਬਾਲੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan baalee dhur melee merai prabh aap milaaee raam ||
english: The Primal Lord, my God, has united His young and innocent bride with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramatee ghat chaanan hoaa prabh rav rahiaa sabh thaaee raam ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, her heart is illumined and enlightened; God is permeating and pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh rav rahiaa sabh thaaee ma(n)n vasaaee poorab likhiaa paaiaa ||
english: God is permeating and pervading everywhere; He dwells in her mind, and she realizes her pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sej sukhaalee mere prabh bhaanee sach seegaar banaaiaa ||
english: On his cozy bed, she is pleasing to my God; she fashions her decorations of Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaaman niramal haumai mal khoee guramat sach samaaee ||
english: The bride is immaculate and pure; she washes away the filth of egotism, and through the Guru's Teachings, she merges in the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਕਰਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak aap milaaee karatai naam navai nidh paaee ||4||3||4||
english: O Nanak, the Creator Lord blends her into Himself, and she obtains the nine treasure of the Naam. ||4||3||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Soohee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har hare har gun gaavahu har guramukhe paae raam ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; the Gurmukh obtains the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵਹੁ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: anadino sabad ravahu anahad sabad vajaae raam ||
english: Night and day, chant the Word of the Shabad; night and day, the Shabad shall vibrate and resound.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: anahad sabad vajaae har jeeu ghar aae har gun gaavahu naaree ||
english: The unstruck melody of the Shabad vibrates, and the Dear Lord comes into the home of my heart; O ladies, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat karahi gur aagai saa dhan ka(n)t piaaree ||
english: That soul-bride, who performs devotional worship service to the Guru night and day, becomes the Beloved bride of her Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad vasiaa ghat a(n)tar se jan sabad suhaae ||
english: Those humble beings, whose hearts are filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, are adorned with the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਘਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tin ghar sad hee sohilaa har kar kirapaa ghar aae ||1||
english: O Nanak, their hearts are forever filled with happiness; the Lord, in His Mercy, enters into their hearts. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa man aana(n)d bhaiaa har naam rahe liv laae raam ||
english: The minds of the devotees are filled with bliss; they remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramukhe man niramal hoaa niramal har gun gaae raam ||
english: The mind of the Gurmukh is immaculate and pure; she sings the Immaculate Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: niramal gun gaae naam ma(n)n vasaae har kee a(n)mrit baanee ||
english: Singing His Immaculate Praises, she enshrines in her mind the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the Ambrosial Word of His Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jinh man vasiaa seee jan nisatare ghat ghat sabad samaanee ||
english: Those humble beings, within whose minds it abides, are emancipated; the Shabad permeates each and every heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tere gun gaavahi sahaj samaavahi sabade mel milaae ||
english: Singing Your Glorious Praises, they merge naturally into You, O Lord; through the Shabad, they are united in Union with You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੇਰਾ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saphal janam tin keraa j satigur har maarag paae ||2||
english: O Nanak, their lives are fruitful; the True Guru places them on the Lord's Path. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)gat siu mel bhaiaa har har naam samaae raam ||
english: Those who join the Society of the Saints are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad sad jeevan mukat bhae har kai naam liv laae raam ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are forever 'jivan mukta' - liberated while yet alive; they are lovingly absorbed in the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: har naam chit laae gur mel milaae manooaa rataa har naale ||
english: They center their consciousness on the Lord's Name; through the Guru, they are united in His Union. Their minds are imbued with the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: sukhadaataa paaiaa mohu chukaaiaa anadin naam samhaale ||
english: They find the Lord, the Giver of peace, and they eradicate attachments; night and day, they contemplate the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gurasabade raataa sahaje maataa naam man vasaae ||
english: They are imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and intoxicated with celestial peace; the Naam abides in their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਘਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak tin ghar sad hee sohilaa j satigur sev samaae ||3||
english: O Nanak, the homes of their hearts are filled with happiness, forever and always; they are absorbed in serving the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur jag bharam bhulaaiaa har kaa mahal na paaiaa raam ||
english: Without the True Guru, the world is deluded by doubt; it does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਇਕਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramukhe ik mel milaaiaa tin ke dookh gavaaiaa raam ||
english: As Gurmukh, some are united in the Lord's Union, and their pains are dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: tin ke dookh gavaaiaa jaa har man bhaaiaa sadaa gaavahi ra(n)g raate ||
english: Their pains are dispelled, when it is pleasing to the Lord's Mind; imbued with His Love, they sing His Praises forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: har ke bhagat sadaa jan niramal jug jug sad hee jaate ||
english: The Lord's devotees are pure and humble forever; throughout the ages, they are forever respected.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਪਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: saachee bhagat karahi dar jaapahi ghar dar sachaa soee ||
english: They perform true devotional worship service, and are honored in the Lord's Court; the True Lord is their hearth and home.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak sachaa sohilaa sachee sach baanee sabade hee sukh hoee ||4||4||5||
english: O Nanak, true are their songs of joy, and true is their word; through the Word of the Shabad, they find peace. ||4||4||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: je loRahi var baalaReee taa gur charanee chit laae raam ||
english: If you long for your Husband Lord, O young and innocent bride, then focus your consciousness on the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sadaa hovahi sohaaganee har jeeu marai na jaae raam ||
english: You shall be a happy soul bride of your Dear Lord forever; He does not die or leave.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu marai na jaae gur kai sahaj subhaae saa dhan ka(n)t piaaree ||
english: The Dear Lord does not die, and He does not leave; through the peaceful poise of the Guru, the soul bride becomes the lover of her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sach sa(n)jam sadaa hai niramal gur kai sabad seegaaree ||
english: Through truth and self-control, she is forever immaculate and pure; she is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa sad hee saachaa jin aape aap upaaiaa ||
english: My God is True, forever and ever; He Himself created Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sadaa pir raave aapanaa jin gur charanee chit laaiaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, she who focuses her consciousness on the Guru's feet, enjoys her Husband Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: pir paaiaRaa baalaReee anadin sahaje maatee raam ||
english: When the young, innocent bride finds her Husband Lord, she is automatically intoxicated with Him, night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramatee man anad bhaiaa tit tan mail na raatee raam ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, her mind becomes blissful, and her body is not tinged with filth at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tit tan mail na raatee har prabh raatee meraa prabh mel milaae ||
english: Her body is not tinged with filth at all, and she is imbued with her Lord God; my God unites her in Union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anadin raave har prabh apanaa vichahu aap gavaae ||
english: Night and day, she enjoys her Lord God; her egotism is banished from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਅਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: guramat paaiaa sahaj milaaiaa apane preetam raatee ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, she easily finds and meets Him. She is imbued with her Beloved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee prabh raave ra(n)g raatee ||2||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, she obtains glorious greatness. She ravishes and enjoys her God; she is imbued with His Love. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੜੀਏ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: pir raave ra(n)g raataReee pir kaa mahal tin paaiaa raam ||
english: Ravishing her Husband Lord, she is imbued with His Love; she obtains the Mansion of His Presence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਹੋ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: so saho at niramal daataa jin vichahu aap gavaaiaa raam ||
english: She is utterly immaculate and pure; the Great Giver banishes self-conceit from within her.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: vichahu mohu chukaaiaa jaa har bhaaiaa har kaaman man bhaanee ||
english: The Lord drives out attachment from within her, when it pleases Him. The soul bride becomes pleasing to the Lord's Mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: anadin gun gaavai nit saache kathe akath kahaanee ||
english: Night and day, she continually sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; she speaks the Unspoken Speech.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jug chaare saachaa eko varatai bin gur kinai na paaiaa ||
english: Throughout the four ages, the One True Lord is permeating and pervading; without the Guru, no one finds Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak ra(n)g ravai ra(n)g raatee jin har setee chit laaiaa ||3||
english: O Nanak, she revels in joy, imbued with His Love; she focuses her consciousness on the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kaaman man sohilaRaa saajan mile piaare raam ||
english: The mind of the soul bride is very happy, when she meets her Friend, her Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramatee man niramal hoaa har raakhiaa ur dhaare raam ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, her mind becomes immaculate; she enshrines the Lord within her heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har raakhiaa ur dhaare apanaa kaaraj savaare guramatee har jaataa ||
english: Keeping the Lord enshrined within her heart, her affairs are arranged and resolved; through the Guru's Teachings, she knows her Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: preetam mohi laiaa man meraa paaiaa karam bidhaataa ||
english: My Beloved has enticed my mind; I have obtained the Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੰਨਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaiaa har vasiaa ma(n)n muraare ||
english: Serving the True Guru, she finds lasting peace; the Lord, the Destroyer of pride, dwells in her mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak mel laee gur apunai gur kai sabad savaare ||4||5||6||
english: O Nanak, she merges with her Guru, embellished and adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||5||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sohilaRaa har raam naam gurasabadee veechaare raam ||
english: The song of joy is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; contemplate it, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har man tano guramukh bheejai raam naam piaare raam ||
english: The mind and body of the Gurmukh is drenched with the Lord, the Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: raam naam piaare sabh kul udhaare raam naam mukh baanee ||
english: Through the Name of the Beloved Lord, all one's ancestors and generations are redeemed; chant the Lord's Name with your mouth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaan rahe sukh paaiaa ghar anahad surat samaanee ||
english: Comings and goings cease, peace is obtained, and in the home of the heart, one's awareness is absorbed in the unstruck melody of the sound current.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har eko paaiaa har prabh naanak kirapaa dhaare ||
english: I have found the One and only Lord, Har, Har. The Lord God has showered His Mercy upon Nanak.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sohilaRaa har raam naam gurasabadee veechaare ||1||
english: The song of joy is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, contemplate it. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨੀਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ham neevee prabh at oochaa kiu kar miliaa jaae raam ||
english: I am lowly, and God is lofty and exalted. How will I ever meet Him?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਬਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur melee bahu kirapaa dhaaree har kai sabad subhaae raam ||
english: The Guru has very mercifully blessed me and united me with the Lord; through the Shabad, the Word of the Lord, I am lovingly embellished.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: mil sabad subhaae aap gavaae ra(n)g siu raleeaa maane ||
english: Merging in the Word of the Shabad, I am lovingly embellished; my ego is eradicated, and I revel in joyous love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: sej sukhaalee jaa prabh bhaaiaa har har naam samaane ||
english: My bed is so comfortable, since I became pleasing to God; I am absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naanak sohaagan saa vadabhaagee je chalai satigur bhaae ||
english: O Nanak, that soul bride is so very blessed, who walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨੀਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ham neevee prabh at oochaa kiu kar miliaa jaae raam ||2||
english: I am lowly, and God is lofty and exalted. How will I ever meet Him? ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghate sabhanaa vich eko eko raam bhataaro raam ||
english: In each and every heart, and deep within all, is the One Lord, the Husband Lord of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਇਕਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਧਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa prabh door vasai ikanaa man aadhaaro raam ||
english: God dwells far away from some, while for others, He is the Support of the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਨ ਆਧਾਰੋ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa man aadhaaro sirajanahaaro vadabhaagee gur paaiaa ||
english: For some, the Creator Lord is the Support of the mind; He is obtained by great good fortune, through the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat har prabh eko suaamee guramukh alakh lakhaaiaa ||
english: The One Lord God, the Master, is in each and every heart; the Gurmukh sees the unseen.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: sahaje anad hoaa man maaniaa naanak braham beechaaro ||
english: The mind is satisfied, in natural ecstasy, O Nanak, contemplating God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ghat ghate sabhanaa vich eko eko raam bhataaro raam ||3||
english: In each and every heart, and deep within all, is the One Lord, the Husband Lord of all. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur sevan satigur daataa har har naam samaaiaa raam ||
english: Those who serve the Guru, the True Guru, the Giver, merge in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧੂੜਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਮੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har dhooR devahu mai poore gur kee ham paapee mukat karaaiaa raam ||
english: O Lord, please bless me with the dust of the feet of the Perfect Guru, so that I, a sinner, may be liberated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: paapee mukat karaae aap gavaae nij ghar paaiaa vaasaa ||
english: Even sinners are liberated, by eradicating their egotism; they obtain a home within their own heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧੀ ਸੁਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: bibek budhee sukh rain vihaanee guramat naam pragaasaa ||
english: With clear unerstanding, the night of their lives passes peacefully; through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is revealed to them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har har anad bhaiaa din raatee naanak har meeth lagaae ||
english: Through the Lord, Har, Har, I am in ecstasy, day and night. O Nanak, the Lord seems sweet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੬॥੭॥੫॥੭॥੧੨॥
transliteration: gur sevan satigur daataa har har naam samaae ||4||6||7||5||7||12||
english: Those who serve the Guru, the True Guru, the Giver, merge in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||6||7||5||7||12||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 4 chha(n)t ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Chhant, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਅਵਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh milaai avagan vikanaa gun ravaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: If only I could meet the True Guru, the Primal Being. Discarding my faults and sins, I would chant the Lord's Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚਵਾ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam dhiaai gurabaanee nit nit chavaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Continuously, continually, I chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸਦ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਾਪ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gurabaanee sad meethee laagee paap vikaar gavaaiaa ||
english: Gurbani always seems so sweet; I have eradicated the sins from within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai rog gaiaa bhau bhaagaa sahaje sahaj milaaiaa ||
english: The disease of egotism is gone, fear has left, and I am absorbed in celestial peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੇਜ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa sej gur sabad sukhaalee giaan tat kar bhogo ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the bed of my body has become cozy and beautiful, and I enjoy the essence of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਾਣੇ ਨਿਤ ਰਲੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin sukh maane nit raleeaa naanak dhur sa(n)jogo ||1||
english: Night and day, I continually enjoy peace and pleasure. O Nanak, this is my pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਕੁੜਮੁ ਕੁੜਮਾਈ ਆਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh kar bhaau kuRam kuRamaaee aaiaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: The soul-bride is lovingly embellished with truth and contentment; her Father, the Guru, has come to engage her in marriage to her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਾਈਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kar mel gurabaanee gaavaaeeaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: Joining with the humble Saints, I sing Gurbani.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਗਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: baanee gur gaaee param gat paaee pa(n)ch mile sohaaiaa ||
english: Singing the Guru's Bani, I have obtained the supreme status; meeting with the Saints, the self-elect, I am blessed and adorned.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਇਆ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਠੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gaiaa karodh mamataa tan naathee paakha(n)d bharam gavaaiaa ||
english: Anger and attachment have left my body and run away; I have eradicated hypocrisy and doubt.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀਰ ਗਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਰੋਗਤ ਭਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai peer gaee sukh paaiaa aarogat bhae sareeraa ||
english: The pain of egotism is gone, and I have found peace; my body has become healthy and free of disease.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee braham pachhaataa naanak gunee gaheeraa ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, I have realized God, the ocean of virtue. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਦੂਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਬਲਿ ਗਈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: manamukh vichhuRee door mahal na paae bal gaee bal raam jeeu ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is separated, far away from God; she does not obtain the Mansion of His Presence, and she burns.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਮਤਾ ਕੂਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar mamataa koor kooR vihaajhe kooR laee bal raam jeeu ||
english: Egotism and falsehood are deep within her; deluded by falsehood, she deals only in falsehood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kooR kapat kamaavai mahaa dukh paavai vin satigur mag na paaiaa ||
english: Practicing fraud and falsehood, she suffers terrible pain; without the True Guru, she does not find the way.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਝੜ ਪੰਥਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਧਕੇ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ujhaR pa(n)th bhramai gaavaaree khin khin dhake khaaiaa ||
english: The foolish soul-bride wanders along dismal pathways; each and every moment, she is bumped and pushed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape daiaa kare prabh daataa satigur purakh milaae ||
english: God, the Great Giver, shows His Mercy, and leads her to meet the True Guru, the Primal Being.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam janam ke vichhuRe jan mele naanak sahaj subhaae ||3||
english: Those beings who have been separated for countless incarnations, O Nanak, are reunited with the Lord, with intuitive ease. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਲਗਨੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਨ ਓਮਾਹੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aaiaa lagan ganaai hiradai dhan omaaheeaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: Calculating the most auspicious moment, the Lord comes into the bride's home; her heart is filled with ecstasy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪਾਧੇ ਆਣਿ ਪਤੀ ਬਹਿ ਵਾਚਾਈਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit paadhe aan patee bahi vaachaaeeaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: The Pandits and astrologers have come, to sit and consult the almanacs.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਤੀ ਵਾਚਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਜਬ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: patee vaachaaee man vajee vadhaaee jab saajan sune ghar aae ||
english: They have consulted the almanacs, and the bride's mind vibrates with bliss, when she hears that her Friend is coming into the home of her heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣੀ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਹਿ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gunee giaanee bahi mataa pakaaiaa phere tat divaae ||
english: The virtuous and wise men sat down and decided to perform the marriage immediately.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: var paaiaa purakh aga(n)m agochar sad navatan baal sakhaaee ||
english: She has found her Husband, the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Primal Lord, who is forever young; He is her Best Friend from her earliest childhood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kirapaa kar kai mele vichhuR kade na jaaee ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, he has mercifully united the bride with Himself. She shall never be separated again. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿਲੜੀ ਲਾਵ ਪਰਵਿਰਤੀ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har pahilaRee laav paraviratee karam driRaaiaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: In the first round of the marriage ceremony, the Lord sets out His Instructions for performing the daily duties of married life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਵੇਦੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਹੁ ਪਾਪ ਤਜਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: baanee brahamaa ved dharam driRahu paap tajaaiaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: Instead of the hymns of the Vedas to Brahma, embrace the righteous conduct of Dharma, and renounce sinful actions.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dharam driRahu har naam dhiaavahu simrit naam driRaaiaa ||
english: Meditate on the Lord's Name; embrace and enshrine the contemplative remembrance of the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur gur pooraa aaraadhahu sabh kilavikh paap gavaaiaa ||
english: Worship and adore the Guru, the Perfect True Guru, and all your sins shall be dispelled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sahaj ana(n)d hoaa vadabhaagee man har har meethaa laaiaa ||
english: By great good fortune, celestial bliss is attained, and the Lord, Har, Har, seems sweet to the mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਾਵ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਆਰੰਭੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan kahai naanak laav pahilee aara(n)bh kaaj rachaaiaa ||1||
english: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the first round of the marriage ceremony, the marriage ceremony has begun. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੂਜੜੀ ਲਾਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har doojaRee laav satigur purakh milaaiaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: In the second round of the marriage ceremony, the Lord leads you to meet the True Guru, the Primal Being.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭੈ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau bhai man hoi haumai mail gavaaiaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: With the Fear of God, the Fearless Lord in the mind, the filth of egotism is eradicated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਭਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: niramal bhau paaiaa har gun gaaiaa har vekhai raam hadoore ||
english: In the Fear of God, the Immaculate Lord, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and behold the Lord's Presence before you.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har aatam raam pasaariaa suaamee sarab rahiaa bharapoore ||
english: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is the Lord and Master of the Universe; He is pervading and permeating everywhere, fully filling all spaces.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar har prabh eko mil har jan ma(n)gal gaae ||
english: Deep within, and outside as well, there is only the One Lord God. Meeting together, the humble servants of the Lord sing the songs of joy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜੀ ਲਾਵ ਚਲਾਈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak doojee laav chalaaee anahad sabad vajaae ||2||
english: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the second round of the marriage ceremony, the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੀਜੜੀ ਲਾਵ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਭਇਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har teejaRee laav man chaau bhaiaa bairaageeaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: In the third round of the marriage ceremony, the mind is filled with Divine Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa har mel har paaiaa vadabhaageeaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: Meeting with the humble Saints of the Lord, I have found the Lord, by great good fortune.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: niramal har paaiaa har gun gaaiaa mukh bolee har baanee ||
english: I have found the Immaculate Lord, and I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. I speak the Word of the Lord's Bani.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਥੀਐ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa vadabhaagee paaiaa har katheeai akath kahaanee ||
english: By great good fortune, I have found the humble Saints, and I speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: hiradai har har har dhun upajee har japeeai masatak bhaag jeeu ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, vibrates and resounds within my heart; meditating on the Lord, I have realized the destiny inscribed upon my forehead.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਤੀਜੀ ਲਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak bole teejee laavai har upajai man bairaag jeeu ||3||
english: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the third round of the marriage ceremony, the mind is filled with Divine Love for the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਉਥੜੀ ਲਾਵ ਮਨਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har chauthaRee laav man sahaj bhaiaa har paaiaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: In the fourth round of the marriage ceremony, my mind has become peaceful; I have found the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh miliaa subhaai har man tan meethaa laaiaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: As Gurmukh, I have met Him, with intuitive ease; the Lord seems so sweet to my mind and body.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har meethaa laaiaa mere prabh bhaaiaa anadin har liv laaee ||
english: The Lord seems so sweet; I am pleasing to my God. Night and day, I lovingly focus my consciousness on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man chi(n)diaa phal paaiaa suaamee har naam vajee vaadhaaee ||
english: I have obtained my Lord and Master, the fruit of my mind's desires. The Lord's Name resounds and resonates.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਧਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: har prabh thaakur kaaj rachaaiaa dhan hiradai naam vigaasee ||
english: The Lord God, my Lord and Master, blends with His bride, and her heart blossoms forth in the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਚਉਥੀ ਲਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak bole chauthee laavai har paaiaa prabh avinaasee ||4||2||
english: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the fourth round of the marriage ceremony, we have found the Eternal Lord God. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har gun gaae ||
english: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hiradai rasan rasaae ||
english: in their hearts, and on their tongues, they enjoy and savor His taste.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har rasan rasaae mere prabh bhaae miliaa sahaj subhaae ||
english: They enjoy and savor His taste, and are pleasing to my God, who meets them with natural ease.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhog bhoge sukh sovai sabad rahai liv laae ||
english: Night and day, they enjoy enjoyments, and they sleep in peace; they remain lovingly absorbed in the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag gur pooraa paaeeai anadin naam dhiaae ||
english: By great good fortune, one obtains the Perfect Guru; night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sahaje sahaj miliaa jagajeevan naanak su(n)n samaae ||1||
english: In absolute ease and poise, one meets the Life of the World. O Nanak, one is absorbed in the state of absolute absorption. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)gat sa(n)t milaae ||
english: Joining the Society of the Saints,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਨਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har sar niramal naae ||
english: I bathe in the Immaculate Pool of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਏ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: niramal jal naae mail gavaae bhae pavit sareeraa ||
english: Bathing in these Immaculate Waters, my filth is removed, and my body is purified and sanctified.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਨਠੀ ਪੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: duramat mail gaee bhram bhaagaa haumai binathee peeraa ||
english: The filth of intellectual evil-mindedness is removed, doubt is gone, and the pain of egotism is dispelled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: nadar prabhoo satasa(n)gat paaee nij ghar hoaa vaasaa ||
english: By God's Grace, I found the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. I dwell in the home of my own inner being.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har ma(n)gal ras rasan rasaae naanak naam pragaasaa ||2||
english: My tongue tastes the taste of the Lord's joyous song; O Nanak, the Naam shines forth brightly. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar ratan beechaare ||
english: The Gurmukh loves the Name of the Lord;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam piaare ||
english: Deep within, she contemplates the jewel of the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har naam piaare sabad nisataare agiaan adher gavaaiaa ||
english: Those who love the Lord's Name are emancipated through the Word of the Shabad. The darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: giaan pracha(n)d baliaa ghat chaanan ghar ma(n)dar sohaaiaa ||
english: Spiritual wisdom burns brilliantly, illuminating the heart; their homes and temples are embellished and blessed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਣਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tan man arap seegaar banaae har prabh saache bhaaiaa ||
english: I have made my body and mind into adornments, and dedicated them to the True Lord God, pleasing Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo prabh kahai soee par keejai naanak a(n)k samaaiaa ||3||
english: Whatever God says, I gladly do. O Nanak, I have merged into the fiber of His Being. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har prabh kaaj rachaaiaa ||
