english: The Lord God has arranged the marriage ceremony;

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੀਆਹਣਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh veeaahan aaiaa ||
english: He has come to marry the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵੀਆਹਣਿ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: veeaahan aaiaa guramukh har paaiaa saa dhan ka(n)t piaaree ||
english: He has come to marry the Gurmukh, who has found the Lord. That bride is very dear to her Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil ma(n)gal gaae har jeeu aap savaaree ||
english: The humble Saints join together and sing the songs of joy; the Dear Lord Himself has adorned the soul-bride.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਏ ਅਪੂਰਬ ਜੰਞ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sur nar gan ga(n)dharab mil aae apoorab ja(n)nj banaaee ||
english: The angels and mortal beings, the heavenly heralds and celestial singers, have come together and formed a wondrous wedding party.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak prabh paaiaa mai saachaa naa kade marai na jaaee ||4||1||3||
english: O Nanak, I have found my True Lord God, who never dies, and is not born. ||4||1||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa 4 ghar 3 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੋ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aavaho sa(n)t janahu gun gaavah govi(n)d kere raam ||
english: Come, humble Saints, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਸਬਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramukh mil raheeai ghar vaajahi sabad ghanere raam ||
english: Let us gather together as Gurmukh; within the home of our own heart, the Shabad vibrates and resonates.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabad ghanere har prabh tere too karataa sabh thaaee ||
english: The many melodies of the Shabad are Yours, O Lord God; O Creator Lord, You are everywhere.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ahinis japee sadaa saalaahee saach sabad liv laaee ||
english: Day and night, I chant His Praises forever, lovingly focusing on the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: anadin sahaj rahai ra(n)g raataa raam naam rid poojaa ||
english: Night and day, I remain intuitively attuned to the Lord's Love; in my heart, I worship the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh ek pachhaanai avar na jaanai doojaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, I have realized the One Lord; I do not know any other. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi rav rahiaa so prabh a(n)tarajaamee raam ||
english: He is contained amongst all; He is God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur sabad ravai rav rahiaa so prabh meraa suaamee raam ||
english: One who meditates and dwells upon God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, knows that God, my Lord and Master, is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: prabh meraa suaamee a(n)tarajaamee ghat ghat raviaa soee ||
english: God, my Lord and Master, is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He pervades and permeates each and every heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramat sach paaeeai sahaj samaaeeai tis bin avar na koee ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, Truth is obtained, and then, one merges in celestial bliss. There is no other than Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sahaje gun gaavaa je prabh bhaavaa aape lae milaae ||
english: I sing His Praises with intuitive ease. If it pleases God, He shall unite me with Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਜਾਪੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak so prabh sabade jaapai ahinis naam dhiaae ||2||
english: O Nanak, through the Shabad, God is known; meditate on the Naam, day and night. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੋ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ihu jago dutar manamukh paar na paaee raam ||
english: This world is treacherous and impassable; the self-willed manmukh cannot cross over.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tare haumai mamataa kaam krodh chaturaaee raam ||
english: Within him is egotism, self-conceit, sexual desire, anger and cleverness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar chaturaaee thaai na paaee birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||
english: Within him is cleverness; he is not approved, and his life is uselessly wasted and lost.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jam mag dukh paavai chotaa khaavai a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaaiaa ||
english: On the Path of Death, he suffers in pain, and must endure abuse; in the end, he departs regretfully.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੁਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸੁਤੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai ko belee naahee put kuta(n)b sut bhaaee ||
english: Without the Name, he has no friends, no children, family or relatives.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਆਗੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak maaiaa mohu pasaaraa aagai saath na jaaee ||3||
english: O Nanak, the wealth of Maya, attachment and ostentatious shows - none of them shall go along with him to the world hereafter. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਪੂਛਉ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: hau poochhau apanaa satigur daataa kin bidh dutar tareeai raam ||
english: I ask my True Guru, the Giver, how to cross over the treacherous and difficult world-ocean.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਚਲਹੁ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਵ ਮਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhaai chalahu jeevatiaa iv mareeai raam ||
english: Walk in harmony with the True Guru's Will, and remain dead while yet alive.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਮਰੀਐ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jeevatiaa mareeai bhaujal tareeai guramukh naam samaavai ||
english: Remaining dead while yet alive, cross over the terrifying world-ocean; as Gurmukh, merge in the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: pooraa purakh paaiaa vadabhaagee sach naam liv laavai ||
english: One obtains the Perfect Primal Lord, by great good fortune, lovingly focusing on the True Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: mat paragaas bhaee man maaniaa raam naam vadiaaee ||
english: The intellect is enlightened, and the mind is satisfied, through the glory of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak prabh paaiaa sabad milaaiaa jotee jot milaaee ||4||1||4||
english: O Nanak, God is found, merging in the Shabad, and one's light blends into the Light. ||4||1||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ghar 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Fifth House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੋ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈਆਸੇ ॥
transliteration: gur sa(n)t jano piaaraa mai miliaa meree trisanaa bujh gaeeaase ||
english: O humble Saints, I have met my Beloved Guru; the fire of my desire is quenched, and my yearning is gone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੈ ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: hau man tan devaa satigurai mai mele prabh gunataase ||
english: I dedicate my mind and body to the True Guru; I pray that may He unite me with God, the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਬਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n guroo vad purakh hai mai dase har saabaase ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Supreme Being, who tells me of the most blessed Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee har paaiaa jan naanak naam vigaase ||1||
english: By great good fortune, servant Nanak has found the Lord; he blossoms forth in the Naam. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: gur sajan piaaraa mai miliaa har maarag pa(n)th dasaahaa ||
english: I have met my Beloved Friend, the Guru, who has shown me the Path to the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: ghar aavahu chiree vichhu(n)niaa mil sabad guroo prabh naahaa ||
english: Come home - I have been separated from You for so long! Please, let me merge with You, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, O my Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤੁਝੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਖਰੀ ਉਡੀਣੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: hau tujh baajhahu kharee udeeneeaa jiu jal bin meen maraahaa ||
english: Without You, I am so sad; like a fish out of water, I shall die.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee har dhiaaiaa jan naanak naam samaahaa ||2||
english: The very fortunate ones meditate on the Lord; servant Nanak merges into the Naam. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਭਰਮਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man dah dis chal chal bharamiaa manamukh bharam bhulaaiaa ||
english: The mind runs around in the ten directions; the self-willed manmukh wanders around, deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਮਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nit aasaa man chitavai man trisanaa bhukh lagaaiaa ||
english: In his mind, he continually conjures up hopes; his mind is gripped by hunger and thirst.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਦਬਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਾਲਣ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anataa dhan dhar dabiaa phir bikh bhaalan gaiaa ||
english: There is an infinite treasure buried within the mind, but still, he goes out, searching for poison.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam salaahi too bin naavai pach pach muiaa ||3||
english: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the Name, he rots away, and wastes away to death. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਪਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur su(n)dar mohan paai kare har prem baanee man maariaa ||
english: Finding the beautiful and fascinating Guru, I have conquered my mind, through the Bani, the Word of my Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੁਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਈ ਮਨ ਆਸਾ ਚਿੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: merai hiradai sudh budh visar gaee man aasaa chi(n)t visaariaa ||
english: My heart has forgotten its common sense and wisdom; my mind has forgotten its hopes and cares.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵੇਦਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਤ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mai a(n)tar vedan prem kee gur dekhat man saadhaariaa ||
english: Deep within my self, I feel the pains of divine love. Beholding the Guru, my mind is comforted and consoled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee prabh aai mil jan naanak khin khin vaariaa ||4||1||5||
english: Awaken my good destiny, O God - please, come and meet me! Each and every instant, servant Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: soohee chha(n)t mahalaa 4 ||
english: Soohee, Chhant, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੇਹਿਸੁ ਵੇ ਜਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਣ ਨ ਦਿਤੀਆ ॥
transliteration: maarehis ve jan haumai bikhiaa jin har prabh milan na diteeaa ||
english: Eradicate the poison of egotism, O human being; it is holding you back from meeting your Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਕੰਚਨ ਵੇ ਵੰਨੀਆ ਇਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀਆ ॥
transliteration: deh ka(n)chan ve va(n)neeaa in haumai maar viguteeaa ||
english: This golden-colored body has been disfigured and ruined by egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਵੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਲਖਾ ਇਨਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੂੜਿ ਸਜੁਤੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mohu maaiaa ve sabh kaalakhaa in manamukh mooR sajuteeaa ||
english: Attachment to Maya is total darkness; this foolish, self-willed manmukh is attached to it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੁਟੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak guramukh ubare gurasabadee haumai chhuteeaa ||1||
english: O servant Nanak, the Gurmukh is saved; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is released from egotism. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਸਿ ਆਣਿਹੁ ਵੇ ਜਨ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸੇ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਤ ਭਉਦਿਆ ॥
transliteration: vas aanihu ve jan is man kau man baase jiu nit bhaudiaa ||
english: Overcome and subdue this mind; your mind wanders around continually, like a falcon.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਵੇ ਵਿਹਾਣੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੇਦਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dukh rain ve vihaaneeaa nit aasaa aas karediaa ||
english: The mortal's life-night passes painfully, in constant hope and desire.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੋ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਚਉਦਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur paaiaa ve sa(n)t jano man aas pooree har chaudiaa ||
english: I have found the Guru, O humble Saints; my mind's hopes are fulfilled, chanting the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਛਡਿ ਆਸਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਉਦਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak prabh dehu matee chhad aasaa nit sukh saudiaa ||2||
english: Please bless servant Nanak, O God, with such understanding, that abandoning false hopes, he may always sleep in peace. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਆਸਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਜੜੀਐ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan aasaa chit kare raam raajiaa har prabh sejaReeai aaee ||
english: The bride hopes in her mind, that her Sovereign Lord God will come to her bed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: meraa thaakur agam daiaal hai raam raajiaa kar kirapaa lehu milaaee ||
english: My Lord and Master is infinitely compassionate; O Sovereign Lord, be merciful, and merge me into Yourself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ॥
transliteration: merai man tan lochaa guramukhe raam raajiaa har saradhaa sej vichhaaee ||
english: My mind and body long to behold the Guru's face. O Sovereign Lord, I have spread out my bed of loving faith.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak har prabh bhaaneeaa raam raajiaa miliaa sahaj subhaaee ||3||
english: O servant Nanak, when the bride pleases her Lord God, her Sovereign Lord meets her with natural ease. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੋ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇਈ ॥
transliteration: ikat sejai har prabho raam raajiaa gur dase har meleee ||
english: My Lord God, my Sovereign Lord, is on the one bed. The Guru has shown me how to meet my Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
transliteration: mai man tan prem bairaag hai raam raajiaa gur mele kirapaa kareee ||
english: My mind and body are filled with love and affection for my Sovereign Lord. In His Mercy, the Guru has united me with Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਈ ॥
transliteration: hau gur vitahu ghol ghumaaiaa raam raajiaa jeeu satigur aagai deee ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, O my Sovereign Lord; I surrender my soul to the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥੫॥੭॥੬॥੧੮॥
transliteration: gur tuthaa jeeu raam raajiaa jan naanak har meleee ||4||2||6||5||7||6||18||
english: When the Guru is totally pleased, O servant Nanak, he unites the soul with the Lord, the Sovereign Lord. ||4||2||6||5||7||6||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fifth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਾਏ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sun baavare too kaae dekh bhulaanaa ||
english: Listen, madman: gazing upon the world, why have you gone crazy?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਨੇਹੁ ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਇਓ ਕੁਸੰਭ ਰੰਗਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sun baavare nehu kooRaa laaio kusa(n)bh ra(n)gaanaa ||
english: Listen, madman: you have been trapped by false love, which is transitory, like the fading color of the safflower.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੀ ਡੇਖਿ ਭੁਲੋ ਅਢੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਮੁਲੋ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਜੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: kooRee dekh bhulo adh lahai na mulo govid naam majeethaa ||
english: Gazing upon the false world, you are fooled. It is not worth even half a shell. Only the Name of the Lord of the Universe is permanent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥੀਵਹਿ ਲਾਲਾ ਅਤਿ ਗੁਲਾਲਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: theevahi laalaa at gulaalaa sabad cheen gur meethaa ||
english: You shall take on the deep and lasting red color of the poppy, contemplating the sweet Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਥੀ ਰਹਿਆ ਝੂਠ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa mohi magan thee rahiaa jhooth sa(n)g lapataanaa ||
english: You remain intoxicated with false emotional attachment; you are attached to falsehood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਭਗਤਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak deen saran kirapaa nidh raakh laaj bhagataanaa ||1||
english: Nanak, meek and humble, seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the treasure of mercy. He preserves the honor of His devotees. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਸੇਵਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਥੁ ਪਰਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sun baavare sev thaakur naath paraanaa ||
english: Listen, madman: serve your Lord, the Master of the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sun baavare jo aaiaa tis jaanaa ||
english: Listen, madman: whoever comes, shall go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਭ ਵੈਸੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: nihachal habh vaisee sun paradesee sa(n)tasa(n)g mil raheeai ||
english: Listen, O wandering stranger: that which you believe to be permanent, shall all pass away; so remain in the Saints' Congregation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਗੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਚਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har paaeeai bhaagee sun bairaagee charan prabhoo gahi raheeai ||
english: Listen, renunciate: by your good destiny, obtain the Lord, and remain attached to God's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਸੰਕ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਜਿ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ehu man deejai sa(n)k na keejai guramukh taj bahu maanaa ||
english: Dedicate and surrender this mind to the Lord, and have no doubts; as Gurmukh, renounce your great pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਭਗਤ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak deen bhagat bhav taaran tere kiaa gun aakh vakhaanaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Lord carries the meek and humble devotees across the terrifying world-ocean. What Glorious Virtues of Your should I chant and recite? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਚੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: sun baavare kiaa keechai kooRaa maano ||
english: Listen, madman: why do you harbor false pride?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਹਭੁ ਵੈਸੀ ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: sun baavare habh vaisee garab gumaano ||
english: Listen, madman: all your egotism and pride shall be overcome.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਭ ਜਾਣਾ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮਾਣਾ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: nihachal habh jaanaa mithiaa maanaa sa(n)t prabhoo hoi daasaa ||
english: What you think is permanent, shall all pass away. Pride is false, so become the slave of God's Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੀਐ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਜੇ ਥੀਵੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jeevat mareeai bhaujal tareeai je theevai karam likhiaasaa ||
english: Remain dead while still alive, and you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, if it is your pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੋ ॥
transliteration: gur seveejai a(n)mrit peejai jis laavahi sahaj dhiaano ||
english: One whom the Lord causes to meditate intuitively, serves the Guru, and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak saran paiaa har duaarai hau bal bal sad kurabaano ||3||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਮਤੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sun baavare mat jaanahi prabh mai paaiaa ||
english: Listen, madman: do not think that you have found God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਥੀਉ ਰੇਣੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sun baavare theeu ren jinee prabh dhiaaiaa ||
english: Listen, madman: be the dust under the feet of those who meditate on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jin prabh dhiaaiaa tin sukh paaiaa vadabhaagee darasan paaeeai ||
english: Those who meditate on God find peace. By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of their Darshan is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥੀਉ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ਸਗਲਾ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: theeu nimaanaa sad kurabaanaa sagalaa aap mitaaeeai ||
english: Be humble, and be forever a sacrifice, and your self-conceit shall be totally eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਸੁਧਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਧਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ohu dhan bhaag sudhaa jin prabh ladhaa ham tis pahi aap vechaaiaa ||
english: One who has found God is pure, with blessed destiny. I would sell myself to him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak deen saran sukh saagar raakh laaj apanaaiaa ||4||1||
english: Nanak, the meek and humble, seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of peace. Make him Your own, and preserve his honor. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਤੁਸਿ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har charan kamal kee tek satigur ditee tus kai bal raam jeeu ||
english: The True Guru was satisfied with me, and blessed me with the Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਘਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)mrit bhare bha(n)daar sabh kichh hai ghar tis kai bal raam jeeu ||
english: The Lord's Ambrosial Nectar is an overflowing treasure; everything is in His Home. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੁਲੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: baabul meraa vad samarathaa karan kaaran prabh haaraa ||
english: My Father is absolutely all-powerful. God is the Doer, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat dukh koee na laagai bhaujal paar utaaraa ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, pain does not touch me; thus I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
transliteration: aad jugaad bhagatan kaa raakhaa usatat kar kar jeevaa ||
english: In the beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the Protector of His devotees. Praising Him continually, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam mahaa ras meethaa anadin man tan peevaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the sweetest and most sublime essence. Night and day, I drink it in with my mind and body. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਕਿਉ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਥੀਵਈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har aape lae milaai kiu vechhoRaa theevaee bal raam jeeu ||
english: The Lord unites me with Himself; how could I feel any separation? I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jis no teree tek so sadaa sad jeevaee bal raam jeeu ||
english: One who has Your Support lives forever and ever. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਝੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: teree tek tujhai te paaee saache sirajanahaaraa ||
english: I take my support from You alone, O True Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis te khaalee koee naahee aisaa prabhoo hamaaraa ||
english: No one lacks this Support; such is my God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਆਸ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil ma(n)gal gaaiaa din rain aas tumhaaree ||
english: Meeting with the humble Saints, I sing the songs of joy; day and night, I place my hopes in You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saphal daras bhetiaa gur pooraa naanak sad balihaaree ||2||
english: I have obtained the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Perfect Guru. Nanak is forever a sacrifice. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਮੑਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)mhliaa sach thaan maan mahat sach paaiaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: Contemplating, dwelling upon the Lord's true home, I receive honor, greatness and truth. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਗੁਣ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਗਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliaa daiaal gun abinaasee gaaiaa bal raam jeeu ||
english: Meeting the Merciful True Guru, I sing the Praises of the Imperishable Lord. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਉ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਆਮੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gun govi(n)d gaau nit nit praan preetam suaameeaa ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, continually, continuously; He is the Beloved Master of the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਆਏ ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਮਿਲੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀਆ ॥
transliteration: subh divas aae gahi ka(n)th laae mile a(n)tarajaameeaa ||
english: Good times have come; the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, has met me, and hugged me close in His Embrace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦਾ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh vajahi vaaje anahadaa jhunakaare ||
english: The musical instruments of truth and contentment vibrate, and the unstruck melody of the sound current resounds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sun bhai binaase sagal naanak prabh purakh karanaihaare ||3||
english: Hearing this, all my fears have been dispelled; O Nanak, God is the Primal Being, the Creator Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਪਜਿਆ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: upajiaa tat giaan saahurai peeeai ik har bal raam jeeu ||
english: The essence of spiritual wisdom has welled up; in this world, and the next, the One Lord is pervading. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਭਿੰਨ ਕਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: brahamai braham miliaa koi na saakai bhi(n)n kar bal raam jeeu ||
english: When God meets the God within the self, no one can separate them. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮੁ ਪੇਖੈ ਬਿਸਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bisam pekhai bisam suneeai bisamaad nadaree aaiaa ||
english: I gaze upon the Wondrous Lord, and listen to the Wondrous Lord; the Wondrous Lord has come into my vision.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooran suaamee ghat ghat rahiaa samaaiaa ||
english: The Perfect Lord and Master is pervading the water, the land and the sky, in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis te upajiaa tis maahi samaaiaa keemat kahan na jaae ||
english: I have merged again into the One from whom I originated. The value of this cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਲਤ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਲਖਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: jis ke chalat na jaahee lakhane naanak tisahi dhiaae ||4||2||
english: Nanak meditates on Him. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d gun gaavan laage ||
english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g anadin jaage ||
english: I am awake, night and day, in the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਪਾਪ ਭਾਗੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g jaage paap bhaage mile sa(n)t piaariaa ||
english: Awake to the Lord's Love, my sins have left me. I meet with the Beloved Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਭਰਮ ਭਾਗੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur charan laage bharam bhaage kaaj sagal savaariaa ||
english: Attached to the Guru's Feet, my doubts are dispelled, and all my affairs are resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਜਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: sun sravan baanee sahaj jaanee har naam jap vadabhaagai ||
english: Listening to the Word of the Guru's Bani with my ears, I know celestial peace. By great good fortune, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee jeeu pi(n)d prabh aagai ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, I have entered my Lord and Master's Sanctuary. I dedicate my body and soul to God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਤ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: anahat sabad suhaavaa ||
english: The unstruck melody of the Shabad, the Word of God is so very beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sach ma(n)gal har jas gaavaa ||
english: True joy comes from singing the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸੇ ਰਹਸੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਘਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gun gaai har har dookh naase rahas upajai man ghanaa ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, pain is dispelled, and my mind is filled with tremendous joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤੰਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣਾ ॥
transliteration: man ta(n)n niramal dekh darasan naam prabh kaa mukh bhanaa ||
english: My mind and body have become immaculate and pure, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; I chant the Name of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਰੇਣ ਸਾਧੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਰਾਧੂ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: hoi ren saadhoo prabh araadhoo aapane prabh bhaavaa ||
english: I am the dust of the feet of the Holy. Worshipping God in adoration, my God is pleased with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak daiaa dhaarahu sadaa har gun gaavaa ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises forever. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur mil saagar tariaa ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, I cross over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਜਪਤ ਨਿਸਤਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har charan japat nisatariaa ||
english: Meditating on the Lord's Feet, I am emancipated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਮਿਟੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: har charan dhiaae sabh phal paae mite aavan jaanaa ||
english: Meditating on the Lord's Feet, I have obtained the fruits of all rewards, and my comings and goings have ceased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaai bhagat subhaai har jap aapane prabh bhaavaa ||
english: With loving devotional worship, I meditate intuitively on the Lord, and my God is pleased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jap ek alakh apaar pooran tis binaa nahee koee ||
english: Meditate on the One, Unseen, Infinite, Perfect Lord; there is no other than Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਤ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak gur bharam khoiaa jat dekhaa tat soee ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, the Guru has erased my doubts; wherever I look, there I see Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan har naamaa ||
english: The Lord's Name is the Purifier of sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: pooran sa(n)t janaa ke kaamaa ||
english: It resolves the affairs of the humble Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gur sa(n)t paaiaa prabh dhiaaiaa sagal ichhaa pu(n)neeaa ||
english: I have found the Saintly Guru, meditating on God. All my desires have been fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਾਪ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hau taap binase sadaa sarase prabh mile chiree vichhu(n)niaa ||
english: The fever of egotism has been dispelled, and I am always happy. I have met God, from whom I was separated for so long.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਤਿ ਆਈ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਮਨਹੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: man saat aaee vajee vadhaaee manahu kade na veesarai ||
english: My mind has found peace and tranquility; congratulations are pouring in. I shall never forget Him from my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਭਜੁ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak satigur driRaaiaa sadaa bhaj jagadeesarai ||4||1||3||
english: Prays Nanak, the True Guru has taught me this, to vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord of the Universe. ||4||1||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
english: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੋ ਬੈਰਾਗਰੋ ਮੈ ਜੇਹੀ ਘਣ ਚੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: too thaakuro bairaagaro mai jehee ghan cheree raam ||
english: O my Lord and Master, You are unattached; You have so many hand-maidens like me, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੋ ਹਉ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: too(n) saagaro ratanaagaro hau saar na jaanaa teree raam ||
english: You are the ocean, the source of jewels; I do not know Your value, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਹਰੰਮਤਿ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
transliteration: saar na jaanaa too vad daanaa kar mihara(n)mat saa(n)ee ||
english: I do not know Your value; You are the wisest of all; please show Mercy unto me, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa keejai saa mat deejai aath pahar tudh dhiaaee ||
english: Show Your Mercy, and bless me with such understanding, that I may meditate on You, twenty-four hours a day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੇਣ ਹੋਵੀਜੈ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: garab na keejai ren hoveejai taa gat jeeare teree ||
english: O soul, don't be so arrogant - become the dust of all, and you shall be saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੈ ਜੇਹੀ ਘਣ ਚੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh oopar naanak kaa thaakur mai jehee ghan cheree raam ||1||
english: Nanak's Lord is the Master of all; He has so many hand-maidens like me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਗਉਹਰ ਅਤਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਰ ਹਮ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tumh gauhar at gahir ga(n)bheeraa tum pir ham bahureeaa raam ||
english: Your depth is profound and utterly unfathomable; You are my Husband Lord, and I am Your bride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਹਉ ਇਤਨੀਕ ਲਹੁਰੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tum vade vade vad ooche hau itaneek lahureeaa raam ||
english: You are the greatest of the great, exalted and lofty on high; I am infinitesimally small.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਕੋ ਤੂਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: hau kichh naahee eko toohai aape aap sujaanaa ||
english: I am nothing; You are the One and only. You Yourself are All-knowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਰਬ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit drisat nimakh prabh jeevaa sarab ra(n)g ras maanaa ||
english: With just a momentary Glance of Your Grace, God, I live; I enjoy all pleasures and delights.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣਹ ਸਰਨੀ ਦਾਸਹ ਦਾਸੀ ਮਨਿ ਮਉਲੈ ਤਨੁ ਹਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: charanah saranee daasah daasee man maulai tan hareeaa ||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet; I am the slave of Your slaves. My mind has blossomed forth, and my body is rejuvenated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਆਪਨ ਭਾਵਨ ਕਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak thaakur sarab samaanaa aapan bhaavan kareeaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is contained amongst all; He does just as He pleases. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਮਾਣਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tujh oopar meraa hai maanaa toohai meraa taanaa raam ||
english: I take pride in You; You are my only Strength, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: surat mat chaturaaee teree too jaanaaihi jaanaa raam ||
english: You are my understanding, intellect and knowledge. I know only what You cause me to know, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਿਰੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: soee jaanai soee pachhaanai jaa kau nadar sira(n)de ||
english: He alone knows, and he alone understands, upon whom the Creator Lord bestows His Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਰਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhoolee bahutee raahee phaathee maaiaa pha(n)de ||
english: The self-willed manmukh wanders along many paths, and is trapped in the net of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਣੀ ਸਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: thaakur bhaanee saa gunava(n)tee tin hee sabh ra(n)g maanaa ||
english: She alone is virtuous, who is pleasing to her Lord and Master. She alone enjoys all the pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਧਰ ਤੂਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak kee dhar toohai thaakur too naanak kaa maanaa ||3||
english: You, O Lord, are Nanak's only support. You are Nanak's only pride. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਘੋਲੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਤੂ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਓਲੑਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: hau vaaree va(n)njaa gholee va(n)njaa too parabat meraa olhaa raam ||
english: I am a sacrifice, devoted and dedicated to You; You are my sheltering mountain, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਰਦਾ ਖੋਲੑਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: hau bal jaaee lakh lakh lakh bareeaa jin bhram paradaa kholhaa raam ||
english: I am a sacrifice, thousands, hundreds of thousands of times, to the Lord. He has torn away the veil of doubt;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਧਾਰੇ ਤਜੇ ਬਿਕਾਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mite a(n)dhaare taje bikaare thaakur siu man maanaa ||
english: darkness has been eliminated, and I have renounced corruption and sin. My mind is reconciled with my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਭਾਣੀ ਭਈ ਨਿਕਾਣੀ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh jee bhaanee bhaee nikaanee saphal janam paravaanaa ||
english: I have become pleasing to my Dear God, and I have become carefree. My life is fulfilled and approved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਅਮੋਲੀ ਭਾਰਾ ਤੋਲੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਦਰੁ ਖੋਲੑਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaee amolee bhaaraa tolee mukat jugat dar kholhaa ||
english: I have become invaluable, of tremendous weight and value. The Door, and the Path of liberation are open to me now.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਓਲੑਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak hau nirabhau hoee so prabh meraa olhaa ||4||1||4||
english: Says Nanak, I am fearless; God has become my Shelter and Shield. ||4||1||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saajan purakh satigur meraa pooraa tis bin avar na jaanaa raam ||
english: My Perfect True Guru is my Best Friend, the Primal Being. I do not know any other than Him, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut ba(n)dhap jee praan man bhaanaa raam ||
english: He is my mother, father, sibling, child, relative, soul and breath of life. He is so pleasing to my mind, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੀਆ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis kaa deeaa sarab gunaa bharapoore ||
english: My body and soul are all His blessings. He is overflowing with every quality of virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee so prabh meraa sarab rahiaa bharapoore ||
english: My God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. He is totally permeating and pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਹੋਏ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣਾ ॥
transliteration: taa kee saran sarab sukh paae hoe sarab kaliaanaa ||
english: In His Sanctuary, I receive every comfort and pleasure. I am totally, completely happy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa prabh kau balihaarai naanak sad kurabaanaa ||1||
english: Forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice to God, forever, a devoted sacrifice. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aisaa gur vadabhaagee paaeeai jit miliai prabh jaapai raam ||
english: By great good fortune, one finds such a Guru, meeting whom, the Lord God is known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਧੂੜੀ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh utarahi har sa(n)t dhooRee nit naapai raam ||
english: The sins of countless lifetimes are erased, bathing continually in the dust of the feet of God's Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧੂੜੀ ਨਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: har dhooRee naaeeai prabhoo dhiaaeeai baahuR jon na aaeeai ||
english: Bathing in the dust of the feet of the Lord, and meditating on God, you shall not have to enter into the womb of reincarnation again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gur charanee laage bhram bhau bhaage man chi(n)diaa phal paaeeai ||
english: Grasping hold of the Guru's Feet, doubt and fear are dispelled, and you receive the fruits of your mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਸੋਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: har gun nit gaae naam dhiaae phir sog naahee sa(n)taapai ||
english: Continually singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall no longer suffer in pain and sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak so prabh jee kaa daataa pooraa jis parataapai ||2||
english: O Nanak, God is the Giver of all souls; His radiant glory is perfect! ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har hare har gun nidhe har sa(n)tan kai vas aae raam ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is the treasure of virtue; the Lord is under the power of His Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਣ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t charan gur sevaa laage tinee param pad paae raam ||
english: Those who are dedicated to the feet of the Saints, and to serving the Guru, obtain the supreme status, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: param pad paaiaa aap mitaaiaa har pooran kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: They obtain the supreme status, and eradicate self-conceit; the Perfect Lord showers His Grace upon them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam hoaa bhau bhaagaa har bhetiaa ek muraaree ||
english: Their lives are fruitful, their fears are dispelled, and they meet the One Lord, the Destroyer of ego.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa saa tin hee mel leeaa jotee jot samaaiaa ||
english: He blends into the One, to whom he belongs; his light merges into the Light.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam nira(n)jan japeeai mil satigur sukh paaiaa ||3||
english: O Nanak, chant the Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord; meeting the True Guru, peace is obtained. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਉ ਮੰਗਲੋ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਹੁ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਇਛ ਸਬਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gaau ma(n)galo nit har janahu pu(n)nee ichh sabaaee raam ||
english: Sing continually the songs of joy, O humble beings of the Lord; all your desires shall be fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g rate apune suaamee setee marai na aavai jaaee raam ||
english: Those who are imbued with the Love of their Lord and Master do not die, or come or go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: abinaasee paaiaa naam dhiaaiaa sagal manorath paae ||
english: The Imperishable Lord is obtained, meditating on the Naam, and all one's wishes are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)t sahaj aana(n)d ghanere gur charanee man laae ||
english: Peace, poise, and all ecstasy are obtained, attaching one's mind to the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: poor rahiaa ghat ghat abinaasee thaan thana(n)tar saaee ||
english: The Imperishable Lord is permeating and pervading each and every heart; He is in all places and interspaces.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak kaaraj sagale poore gur charanee man laaee ||4||2||5||
english: Says Nanak, all affairs are perfectly resolved, focusing one's mind on the Guru's Feet. ||4||2||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mere preetam suaamee netr dekhahi daras teraa raam ||
english: Be Merciful, O my Beloved Lord and Master, that I may behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan with my eyes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੁਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: laakh jihavaa dehu mere piaare mukh har aaraadhe meraa raam ||
english: Please bless me, O my Beloved, with thousands of tongues, to worship and adore You with my mouth, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਸਾਧੇ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har aaraadhe jam pa(n)th saadhe dookh na viaapai koee ||
english: Worshipping the Lord in adoration, the Path of Death is overcome, and no pain or suffering will afflict you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਤ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooran suaamee jat dekhaa tat soee ||
english: The Lord and Master is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; wherever I look, there He is.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਠੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bharam moh bikaar naathe prabh ner hoo te neraa ||
english: Doubt, attachment and corruption are gone. God is the nearest of the near.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kau prabh kirapaa keejai netr dekhahi daras teraa ||1||
english: Please bless Nanak with Your Merciful Grace, O God, that his eyes may behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਨ ਦੀਜਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਣੀਅਹਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kot karan deejahi prabh preetam har gun suneeahi abinaasee raam ||
english: Please bless me, O Beloved God, with millions of ears, with which I may hear the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਟੀਐ ਕਾਲ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sun sun ihu man niramal hovai kateeai kaal kee phaasee raam ||
english: Listening, listening to these, this mind becomes spotless and pure, and the noose of Death is cut.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਗਲ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kateeai jam phaasee simar abinaasee sagal ma(n)gal sugiaanaa ||
english: The noose of Death is cut, meditating on the Imperishable Lord, and all happiness and wisdom are obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har har jap japeeai din raatee laagai sahaj dhiaanaa ||
english: Chant, and meditate, day and night, on the Lord, Har, Har. Focus your meditation on the Celestial Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਮਲ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: kalamal dukh jaare prabhoo chitaare man kee duramat naasee ||
english: The painful sins are burnt away, by keeping God in one's thoughts; evil-mindedness is erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਣੀਅਹਿ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh kirapaa keejai har gun suneeahi avinaasee ||2||
english: Says Nanak, O God, please be Merciful to me, that I may listen to Your Glorious Praises, O Imperishable Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੋੜਿ ਹਸਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਚਰਣ ਚਲਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: karoR hasat teree tahal kamaavahi charan chalahi prabh maarag raam ||
english: Please give me millions of hands to serve You, God, and let my feet walk on Your Path.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਾਵ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਚੜੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਾਰਗਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhav saagar naav har sevaa jo chaRai tis taarag raam ||
english: Service to the Lord is the boat to carry us across the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bhavajal tariaa har har simariaa sagal manorath poore ||
english: So cross over the terrifying world-ocean, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har; all wishes shall be fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਗਏ ਸੁਖ ਉਪਜੇ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mahaa bikaar gae sukh upaje baaje anahad toore ||
english: Even the worst corruption is taken away; peace wells up, and the unstruck celestial harmony vibrates and resounds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਅਪਾਰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: man baa(n)chhat phal paae sagale kudarat keem apaarag ||
english: All the fruits of the mind's desires are obtained; His creative power is infinitely valuable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh kirapaa keejai man sadaa chalai terai maarag ||3||
english: Says Nanak, please be Merciful to me, God, that my mind may follow Your Path forever. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹੋ ਵਰੁ ਏਹਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: eho var ehaa vadiaaee ihu dhan hoi vadabhaagaa raam ||
english: This opportunity, this glorious greatness, this blessing and wealth, come by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹੋ ਰੰਗੁ ਏਹੋ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: eho ra(n)g eho ras bhogaa har charanee man laagaa raam ||
english: These pleasures, these delightful enjoyments, come when my mind is attached to the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਚਰਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੇ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: man laagaa charane prabh kee sarane karan kaaran gopaalaa ||
english: My mind is attached to God's Feet; I seek His Sanctuary. He is the Creator, the Cause of causes, the Cherisher of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh teraa too prabh meraa mere thaakur deen daiaalaa ||
english: Everything is Yours; You are my God, O my Lord and Master, Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: mohi niragun preetam sukh saagar sa(n)tasa(n)g man jaagaa ||
english: I am worthless, O my Beloved, ocean of peace. In the Saints' Congregation, my mind is awakened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh kirapaa keenhee charan kamal man laagaa ||4||3||6||
english: Says Nanak, God has been Merciful to me; my mind is attached to His Lotus Feet. ||4||3||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har jape har ma(n)dar saajiaa sa(n)t bhagat gun gaavahi raam ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, the Lord's Temple has been built; the Saints and devotees sing the Lord's Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਪਾਪ ਤਜਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: simar simar suaamee prabh apanaa sagale paap tajaavahi raam ||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance of God, their Lord and Master, they discard and renounce all their sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaai param pad paaiaa prabh kee ootam baanee ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the supreme status is obtained. The Word of God's Bani is sublime and exalted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਕਥੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaj kathaa prabh kee at meethee kathee akath kahaanee ||
english: God's Sermon is so very sweet. It brings celestial peace. It is to speak the Unspoken Speech.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਲਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਪਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhalaa sa(n)jog moorat pal saachaa abichal neev rakhaaee ||
english: The time and the moment were auspicious, blessed and true, when the eternal foundation of this Temple was placed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak prabh bhae daiaalaa sarab kalaa ban aaee ||1||
english: O servant Nanak, God has been kind and compassionate; with all His powers, He has blessed me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦਾ ਵਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aana(n)daa vajahi nit vaaje paarabraham man voothaa raam ||
english: The sounds of ecstasy vibrate through me continuously. I have enshrined the Supreme Lord within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਝੂਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramukhe sach karanee saaree binase bhram bhai jhoothaa raam ||
english: As Gurmukh, my lifestyle is excellent and true; my false hopes and doubts are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: anahad baanee guramukh vakhaanee jas sun sun man tan hariaa ||
english: The Gurmukh chants the Bani of the unstruck melody; hearing it, listening to it, my mind and body are rejuvenated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਬਣਿ ਆਏ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa tis hee ban aae jo prabh apanaa kariaa ||
english: All pleasures are obtained, by that one whom God makes His Own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: ghar mahi nav nidh bhare bha(n)daaraa raam naam ra(n)g laagaa ||
english: Within the home of the heart are the nine treasures, filled to overflowing. He has fallen in love with the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jan prabh kade na visarai pooran jaa ke bhaagaa ||2||
english: Servant Nanak shall never forget God; his destiny is perfectly fulfilled. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: chhaaiaa prabh chhatrapat keenhee sagalee tapat binaasee raam ||
english: God, the King, has given me shade under His canopy, and the fire of desire has been totally extinguished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਾਠਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dookh paap kaa deraa dhaathaa kaaraj aaiaa raasee raam ||
english: The home of sorrow and sin has been demolished, and all affairs have been resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਮਿਟੀ ਬਲਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਫਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har prabh phuramaaiaa mitee balaaiaa saach dharam pu(n)n phaliaa ||
english: When the Lord God so commands, misfortune is averted; true righteousness, Dharma and charity flourish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੋਵਤ ਬੈਸਤ ਖਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: so prabh apunaa sadaa dhiaaeeai sovat baisat khaliaa ||
english: Meditate forever on your God, when you sleep and sit and stand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan sukh saagar suaamee jal thal maheeal soee ||
english: The Lord and Master is the treasure of virtue, the ocean of peace; He pervades the water, the land and the sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak prabh kee saranaaee tis bin avar na koee ||3||
english: Servant Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary; there is no other than Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਘਰੁ ਬਨਿਆ ਬਨੁ ਤਾਲੁ ਬਨਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: meraa ghar baniaa ban taal baniaa prabh parase har raaiaa raam ||
english: My home is made, the garden and pool are made, and my Sovereign Lord God has met me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਰਸੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੰਗਲ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: meraa man sohiaa meet saajan sarase gun ma(n)gal har gaaiaa raam ||
english: My mind is adorned, and my friends rejoice; I sing the songs of joy, and the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਗਲ ਇਛਾ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: gun gaai prabhoo dhiaai saachaa sagal ichhaa paaeeaa ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord God, all desires are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀਆ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: gur charan laage sadaa jaage man vajeeaa vaadhaaeeaa ||
english: Those who are attached to the Guru's Feet are always awake and aware; His Praises resound and resonate through their minds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: karee nadar suaamee sukhah gaamee halat palat savaariaa ||
english: My Lord and Master, the bringer of peace, has blessed me with His Grace; He has arranged this world, and the world hereafter for me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak nit naam japeeai jeeu pi(n)d jin dhaariaa ||4||4||7||
english: Prays Nanak, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord forever; He is the Support of the body and soul. ||4||4||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhai saagaro bhai saagar tariaa har har naam dhiaae raam ||
english: The terrifying world-ocean, the terrifying world-ocean - I have crossed over it, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਹਿਥੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bohithaRaa har charan araadhe mil satigur paar laghaae raam ||
english: I worship and adore the Lord's Feet, the boat to carry me across. Meeting the True Guru, I am carried over.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਤਰੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਰੀਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee tareeai bahuR na mareeai chookai aavan jaanaa ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I cross over, and I shall not die again; my comings and goings are ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਉ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karai soee bhal maanau taa man sahaj samaanaa ||
english: Whatever He does, I accept as good, and my mind merges in celestial peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਨ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dookh na bhookh na rog na biaapai sukh saagar saranee paae ||
english: Neither pain, nor hunger, nor disease afflicts me. I have found the Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਮਿਟਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har simar simar naanak ra(n)g raataa man kee chi(n)t mitaae ||1||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Nanak is imbued with His Love; his mind's anxieties are dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa har ma(n)tr driRaaiaa har saajan vasagat keene raam ||
english: The humble Saints have implanted the Lord's Mantra within me, and the Lord, my Best Friend, has come under my power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਧਰਿਆ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aapanaRaa man aagai dhariaa sarabas thaakur deene raam ||
english: I have dedicated my mind to my Lord and Master, and offered it to Him, and He has blessed me with everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kar apunee daasee mitee udaasee har ma(n)dar thit paaee ||
english: He has made me His hand-maiden and slave; my sadness is dispelled, and in the Lord's Temple, I have found stability.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: anad binod simarahu prabh saachaa vichhuR kabahoo na jaaee ||
english: My joy and bliss are in meditating on my True God; I shall never be separated from Him again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਚੀਨੑੇ ॥
transliteration: saa vadabhaagan sadaa sohaagan raam naam gun cheenhe ||
english: She alone is very fortunate, and a true soul-bride, who contemplates the Glorious Vision of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸਿ ਭੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ravahi ra(n)g raate prem mahaa ras bheene ||2||
english: Says Nanak, I am imbued with His Love, drenched in the supreme, sublime essence of His Love. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਭਏ ਨਿਤ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਦਾ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: anad binod bhae nit sakheee ma(n)gal sadaa hamaarai raam ||
english: I am in continual bliss and ecstasy, O my companions; I sing the songs of joy forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aapanaRai prabh aap seegaaree sobhaava(n)tee naare raam ||
english: God Himself has embellished her, and she has become His virtuous soul-bride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sahaj subhaai bhae kirapaalaa gun avagan na beechaariaa ||
english: With natural ease, He has become Merciful to her. He does not consider her merits or demerits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਲੀਏ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)th lagaai leee jan apune raam naam ur dhaariaa ||
english: He hugs His humble servants close in His Loving Embrace; they enshrine the Lord's Name in their hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਦ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਪੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maan moh mad sagal biaapee kar kirapaa aap nivaare ||
english: Everyone is engrossed in arrogant pride, attachment and intoxication; in His Mercy, He has freed me of them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਜ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bhai saagar tariaa pooran kaaj hamaare ||3||
english: Says Nanak, I have crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, and all my affairs are perfectly resolved. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਖੀਹੋ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gun gopaal gaavahu nit sakheeho sagal manorath paae raam ||
english: Continually sing the Glorious Praises of the World-Lord, O my companions; all your wishes shall be granted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam hoaa mil saadhoo eka(n)kaar dhiaae raam ||
english: Life becomes fruitful, meeting with the Holy Saints, and meditating on the One God, the Creator of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਏਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jap ek prabhoo anek raviaa sarab ma(n)dal chhaaiaa ||
english: Chant, and meditate on the One God, who permeates and pervades the many beings of the whole Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੋ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: brahamo pasaaraa braham pasariaa sabh braham drisatee aaiaa ||
english: God created it, and God spreads through it everywhere. Everywhere I look, I see God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal poor pooran tis binaa nahee jaae ||
english: The Perfect Lord is perfectly pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; there is no place without Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸੇ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥੮॥
transliteration: pekh darasan naanak bigase aap lae milaae ||4||5||8||
english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, Nanak has blossomed forth; the Lord has united him in Union. ||4||5||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨਗਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: abichal nagar gobi(n)d guroo kaa naam japat sukh paaiaa raam ||
english: Eternal and immovable is the City of God and Guru; chanting His Name, I have found peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: man ichhe seee phal paae karatai aap vasaaiaa raam ||
english: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires; the Creator Himself established it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਸਿਖ ਬਿਗਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: karatai aap vasaaiaa sarab sukh paaiaa put bhaaee sikh bigaase ||
english: The Creator Himself established it. I have found total peace; my children, siblings and Sikhs have all blossomed forth in bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavahi pooran paramesur kaaraj aaiaa raase ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, my affairs have come to be resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਖਾ ਆਪਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh aap suaamee aape rakhaa aap pitaa aap maaiaa ||
english: God Himself is my Lord and Master. He Himself is my Saving Grace; He Himself is my father and mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak satigur balihaaree jin ehu thaan suhaaiaa ||1||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has embellished and adorned this place. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ਸੋਹੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ghar ma(n)dar hatanaale sohe jis vich naam nivaasee raam ||
english: Homes, mansions, stores and markets are beautiful, when the Lord's Name abides within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t bhagat har naam araadhahi kateeai jam kee phaasee raam ||
english: The Saints and devotees worship the Lord's Name in adoration, and the noose of Death is cut away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: kaatee jam phaasee prabh abinaasee har har naam dhiaae ||
english: The noose of Death is cut away, meditating on the Name of the Eternal, Unchanging Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sagal samagree pooran hoee man ichhe phal paae ||
english: Everything is perfect for them, and they obtain the fruits of their mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sajan sukh maanahi raleeaa dookh darad bhram naasee ||
english: The Saints and friends enjoy peace and pleasure; their pain, suffering and doubts are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabad savaare satigur poorai naanak sad bal jaasee ||2||
english: The Perfect True Guru has embellished them with the Word of the Shabad; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਿ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: daat khasam kee pooree hoee nit nit chaRai savaaee raam ||
english: The gift of our Lord and Master is perfect; it increases day by day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham khasamaanaa keeaa jis dee vadee vadiaaee raam ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has made me His own; His Glorious Greatness is so great!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਇਆ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aad jugaad bhagatan kaa raakhaa so prabh bhaiaa daiaalaa ||
english: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the Protector of His devotees; God has become merciful to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh sukhee vasaae prabh aape kar pratipaalaa ||
english: All beings and creatures now dwell in peace; God Himself cherishes and cares for them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dah dis poor rahiaa jas suaamee keemat kahan na jaaee ||
english: The Praises of the Lord and Master are totally pervading in the ten directions; I cannot express His worth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak satigur balihaaree jin abichal neev rakhaaee ||3||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has laid this eternal foundation. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan pooran paramesur har har kathaa nit suneeai raam ||
english: The spiritual wisdom and meditation of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, and the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, are continually heard there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਚੋਜ ਭਗਤ ਭਵ ਭੰਜਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਧੁਨੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: anahad choj bhagat bhav bha(n)jan anahad vaaje dhuneeai raam ||
english: The devotees of the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, play endlessly there, and the unstruck melody resounds and vibrates there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: anahad jhunakaare tat beechaare sa(n)t gosat nit hovai ||
english: The unstruck melody resounds and resonates, and the Saints contemplate the essence of reality; this discourse is their daily routine.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਭ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har naam araadhahi mail sabh kaatahi kilavikh sagale khovai ||
english: They worship the Lord's Name, and all their filth is washed away; they rid themselves of all sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੋੁਨੀਐ ॥
transliteration: tah janam na maranaa aavan jaanaa bahuR na paaeeai jouneeai ||
english: There is no birth or death there, no coming or going, and no entering into the womb of reincarnation again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀਐ ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak gur paramesar paaiaa jis prasaad ichh puneeai ||4||6||9||
english: Nanak has found the Guru, the Transcendent Lord; by His Grace, desires are fulfilled. ||4||6||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਖਲੋਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa ke kaaraj aap khaloiaa har ka(n)m karaavan aaiaa raam ||
english: The Lord Himself has stood up to resolve the affairs of the Saints; He has come to complete their tasks.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਤਾਲੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dharat suhaavee taal suhaavaa vich a(n)mrit jal chhaaiaa raam ||
english: The land is beautiful, and the pool is beautiful; within it is contained the Ambrosial Water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਜੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit jal chhaaiaa pooran saaj karaaiaa sagal manorath poore ||
english: The Ambrosial Water is filling it, and my job is perfectly complete; all my desires are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਥੇ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar bhaiaa jag a(n)tar laathe sagal visoore ||
english: Congratulations are pouring in from all over the world; all my sorrows are eliminated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਜਸੁ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pooran purakh achut abinaasee jas ved puraanee gaaiaa ||
english: The Vedas and the Puraanas sing the Praises of the Perfect, Unchanging, Imperishable Primal Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apanaa birad rakhiaa paramesar naanak naam dhiaaiaa ||1||
english: The Transcendent Lord has kept His promise, and confirmed His nature; Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: nav nidh sidh ridh deene karate tot na aavai kaaee raam ||
english: The Creator has given me the nine treasures, wealth and spiritual powers, and I do not lack anything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਵਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: khaat kharachat bilachhat sukh paaiaa karate kee daat savaaee raam ||
english: Eating, spending and enjoying, I have found peace; the gifts of the Creator Lord continually increase.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਿ ਸਵਾਈ ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: daat savaaee nikhut na jaaee a(n)tarajaamee paaiaa ||
english: His gifts increase and shall never be exhausted; I have found the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਉਠਿ ਨਾਠੇ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kot bighan sagale uth naathe dookh na neRai aaiaa ||
english: Millions of obstacles have all been removed, and pain does not even approach me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਭੂਖ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)t sahaj aana(n)d ghanere binasee bhookh sabaaee ||
english: Tranquility, peace, poise and bliss in abundance prevail, and all my hunger is satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੇ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak gun gaavahi suaamee ke acharaj jis vadiaaee raam ||2||
english: Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of his Lord and Master, whose Glorious Greatness is wonderful and amazing. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਮਾਣਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa kaaraj tin hee keeaa maanas kiaa vechaaraa raam ||
english: It was His job, and He has done it; what can the mere mortal being do?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੈਕਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhagat sohan har ke gun gaavahi sadaa karahi jaikaaraa raam ||
english: The devotees are adorned, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; they proclaim His eternal victory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅਨਦ ਉਪਜੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
transliteration: gun gaai gobi(n)d anad upaje saadhasa(n)gat sa(n)g banee ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, bliss wells up, and we are friends with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਤਾਲ ਕੇਰਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jin udam keeaa taal keraa tis kee upamaa kiaa ganee ||
english: He who made the effort to construct this sacred pool - how can his praises be recounted?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁੰਨ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: athasath teerath pu(n)n kiriaa mahaa niramal chaaraa ||
english: The merits of the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, charity, good deeds and immaculate lifestyle, are found in this sacred pool.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: patit paavan birad suaamee naanak sabad adhaaraa ||3||
english: It is the natural way of the Lord and Master to purify sinners; Nanak takes the Support of the Word of the Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan meraa prabh karataa usatat kaun kareejai raam ||
english: The treasure of virtue is my God, the Creator Lord; what Praises of Yours should I sing, O Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa kee bena(n)tee suaamee naam mahaa ras deejai raam ||
english: The prayer of the Saints is, "O Lord and Master, please bless us with the supreme, sublime essence of Your Name."

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕ ਖਿਨੋ ॥
transliteration: naam deejai daan keejai bisar naahee ik khino ||
english: Please, grant us Your Name, grant us this blessing, and do not forget us, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਉਚਰੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ॥
transliteration: gun gopaal uchar rasanaa sadaa gaaeeai anadino ||
english: Chant the Glorious Praises of the World-Lord, O my tongue; sing them forever, night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਨਾਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: jis preet laagee naam setee man tan a(n)mrit bheejai ||
