english: One who enshrines love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord, his mind and body are drenched with Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੦॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak ichh pu(n)nee pekh darasan jeejai ||4||7||10||
english: Prays Nanak, my desires have been fulfilled; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord, I live. ||4||7||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ||
english: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਠ ਬੋਲੜਾ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mith bolaRaa jee har sajan suaamee moraa ||
english: My Dear Lord and Master, my Friend, speaks so sweetly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸੰਮਲਿ ਥਕੀ ਜੀ ਓਹੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਕਉਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hau sa(n)mal thakee jee ohu kade na bolai kauraa ||
english: I have grown weary of testing Him, but still, He never speaks harshly to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉੜਾ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨੈ ਅਉਗਣੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kauRaa bol na jaanai pooran bhagavaanai augan ko na chitaare ||
english: He does not know any bitter words; the Perfect Lord God does not even consider my faults and demerits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਦਾਏ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੰਨੈ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan har birad sadaae ik til nahee bha(n)nai ghaale ||
english: It is the Lord's natural way to purify sinners; He does not overlook even an iota of service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਨੇਰੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat vaasee sarab nivaasee nerai hee te neraa ||
english: He dwells in each and every heart, pervading everywhere; He is the nearest of the near.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak daas sadaa saranaagat har a(n)mrit sajan meraa ||1||
english: Slave Nanak seeks His Sanctuary forever; the Lord is my Ambrosial Friend. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਿਸਮੁ ਭਈ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hau bisam bhaee jee har darasan dekh apaaraa ||
english: I am wonder-struck, gazing upon the incomparable Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀ ਹਉ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪਗ ਛਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa su(n)dar suaamee jee hau charan kamal pag chhaaraa ||
english: My Dear Lord and Master is so beautiful; I am the dust of His Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਤ ਜੀਵਾ ਠੰਢੀ ਥੀਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: prabh pekhat jeevaa tha(n)dhee theevaa tis jevad avar na koee ||
english: Gazing upon God, I live, and I am at peace; no one else is as great as He is.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aad a(n)t madh prabh raviaa jal thal maheeal soee ||
english: Present at the beginning, end and middle of time, He pervades the sea, the land and the sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਭਵਜਲ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal jap saagar tariaa bhavajal utare paaraa ||
english: Meditating on His Lotus Feet, I have crossed over the sea, the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saran pooran paramesur teraa a(n)t na paaraavaaraa ||2||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Perfect Transcendent Lord; You have no end or limitation, Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: hau nimakh na chhodaa jee har preetam praan adhaaro ||
english: I shall not forsake, even for an instant, my Dear Beloved Lord, the Support of the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਹਿਆ ਜੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur kahiaa jee saachaa agam beechaaro ||
english: The Guru, the True Guru, has instructed me in the contemplation of the True, Inaccessible Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੀਨਾ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhoo deenaa taa naam leenaa janam maran dukh naathe ||
english: Meeting with the humble, Holy Saint, I obtained the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the pains of birth and death left me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਨਠੀ ਗਾਠੇ ॥
transliteration: sahaj sookh aana(n)d ghanere haumai binathee gaathe ||
english: I have been blessed with peace, poise and abundant bliss, and the knot of egotism has been untied.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ ਸਭ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਾਗ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਆਰੋ ॥
transliteration: sabh kai madh sabh hoo te baahar raag dokh te niaaro ||
english: He is inside all, and outside of all; He is untouched by love or hate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਧਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak daas gobi(n)d saranaaee har preetam manahi sadhaaro ||3||
english: Slave Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe; the Beloved Lord is the Support of the mind. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mai khojat khojat jee har nihachal s ghar paaiaa ||
english: I searched and searched, and found the immovable, unchanging home of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਅਧ੍ਰੁਵ ਡਿਠੇ ਜੀਉ ਤਾ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh adhruv dithe jeeu taa charan kamal chit laaiaa ||
english: I have seen that everything is transitory and perishable, and so I have linked my consciousness to the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: prabh abinaasee hau tis kee daasee marai na aavai jaae ||
english: God is eternal and unchanging, and I am just His hand-maiden; He does not die, or come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਕਾਮ ਸਭਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dharam arath kaam sabh pooran man chi(n)dee ichh pujaae ||
english: He is overflowing with Dharmic faith, wealth and success; He fulfills the desires of the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: srut simrit gun gaavahi karate sidh saadhik mun jan dhiaaiaa ||
english: The Vedas and the Simritees sing the Praises of the Creator, while the Siddhas, seekers and silent sages meditate on Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak saran kripaa nidh suaamee vadabhaagee har har gaaiaa ||4||1||11||
english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master, the treasure of mercy; by great good fortune, he sings the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||1||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰ ਸੂਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: vaar soohee kee salokaa naal mahalaa 3 ||
english: Vaar Of Soohee, With Saloks Of The Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਰ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: soohai ves dohaaganee par pir raavan jaai ||
english: In her red robes, the discarded bride goes out, seeking enjoyment with another's husband.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਮੋਹੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pir chhodiaa ghar aapanai mohee doojai bhaai ||
english: She leaves the husband of her own home, enticed by her love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਇਆ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਦਹੁ ਵਧਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: mithaa kar kai khaaiaa bahu saadahu vadhiaa rog ||
english: She finds it sweet, and eats it up; her excessive sensuality only makes her disease worse.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਧੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਜਾਇ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: sudh bhataar har chhodiaa phir lagaa jaai vijog ||
english: She forsakes the Lord, her sublime Husband, and then later, she suffers the pain of separation from Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਲਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s palatiaa har raatee saaj seegaar ||
english: But she who becomes Gurmukh, turns away from corruption and adorns herself, attuned to the Love of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sahaj sach pir raaviaa har naamaa ur dhaar ||
english: She enjoys her celestial Husband Lord, and enshrines the Lord's Name within her heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aagiaakaaree sadaa souhaagan aap melee karataar ||
english: She is humble and obedient; she is His virtuous bride forever; the Creator unites her with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak pir paaiaa har saachaa sadaa souhaagan naar ||1||
english: O Nanak, she who has obtained the True Lord as her husband, is a happy soul-bride forever. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਵੀਏ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਏ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: soohaveee nimaaneee so sahu sadaa samhaal ||
english: O meek, red-robed bride, keep your Husband Lord always in your thoughts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੁਲੁ ਭੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak janam savaarahi aapanaa kul bhee chhutee naal ||2||
english: O Nanak, your life shall be embellished, and your generations shall be saved along with you. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਆਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aape takhat rachaaion aakaas pataalaa ||
english: He Himself established His throne, in the Akaashic ethers and the nether worlds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: hukame dharatee saajeean sachee dharamasaalaa ||
english: By the Hukam of His Command, He created the earth, the true home of Dharma.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aap upaai khapaaidaa sache deen daiaalaa ||
english: He Himself created and destroys; He is the True Lord, merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa rijak sa(n)baahidaa teraa hukam niraalaa ||
english: You give sustenance to all; how wonderful and unique is the Hukam of Your Command!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape aap varatadaa aape pratipaalaa ||1||
english: You Yourself are permeating and pervading; You Yourself are the Cherisher. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਬ ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: soohab taa sohaaganee jaa ma(n)n laihi sach naau ||
english: The red-robed woman becomes a happy soul-bride, only when she accepts the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਮਨਾਇ ਲੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਚੜੀ ਤਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur apanaa manaai lai roop chaRee taa agalaa doojaa naahee thaau ||
english: Become pleasing to your True Guru, and you shall be totally beautified; otherwise, there is no place of rest.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ਤੂ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aisaa seegaar banaai too mailaa kade na hovaee ahinis laagai bhaau ||
english: So decorate yourself with the decorations that will never stain, and love the Lord day and night.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sohaagan kaa kiaa chihan hai a(n)dar sach mukh ujalaa khasamai maahi samaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, what is the character of the happy soul-bride? Within her, is Truth; her face is bright and radiant, and she is absorbed in her Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਾ ਵੇ ਹਉ ਸੂਹਵੀ ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: lokaa ve hau soohavee soohaa ves karee ||
english: O people: I am in red, dressed in a red robe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵੇਸੀ ਸਹੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਸ ਰਹੀ ॥
transliteration: vesee sahu na paaeeai kar kar ves rahee ||
english: But my Husband Lord is not obtained by any robes; I have tried and tried, and given up wearing robes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak tinee sahu paaiaa jinee gur kee sikh sunee ||
english: O Nanak, they alone obtain their Husband Lord, who listen to the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai in bidh ka(n)t milee ||2||
english: Whatever pleases Him, happens. In this way, the Husband Lord is met. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਿਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hukamee srisat saajeean bahu bhit sa(n)saaraa ||
english: By His Command, He created the creation, the world with its many species of beings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਸਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: teraa hukam na jaapee ketaRaa sache alakh apaaraa ||
english: I do not know how great Your Command is, O Unseen and Infinite True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa no too mel laihi gur sabad beechaaraa ||
english: You join some with Yourself; they reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sach rate se niramale haumai taj vikaaraa ||
english: Those who are imbued with the True Lord are immaculate and pure; they conquer egotism and corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis too melahi so tudh milai soee sachiaaraa ||2||
english: He alone is united with You, whom You unite with Yourself; he alone is true. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਵੀਏ ਸੂਹਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: soohaveee soohaa sabh sa(n)saar hai jin duramat doojaa bhaau ||
english: O red-robed woman, the whole world is red, engrossed in evil-mindedness and the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਜਿਉ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਬਿਰਖ ਕੀ ਛਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi jhooth sabh binas jaai jiu tikai na birakh kee chhaau ||
english: In an instant, this falsehood totally vanishes; like the shade of a tree, it is gone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਲੋ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਜੀਠ ਸਚੜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh laalo laal hai jiu ra(n)g majeeth sachaRaau ||
english: The Gurmukh is the deepest crimson of crimson, dyed in the permanent color of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਉਲਟੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ulatee sakat sivai ghar aaee man vasiaa har a(n)mrit naau ||
english: She turns away from Maya, and enters the celestial home of the Lord; the Ambrosial Name of the Lord dwells within her mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak balihaaree gur aapane jit miliai har gun gaau ||1||
english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to my Guru; meeting Him, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: soohaa ra(n)g vikaar hai ka(n)t na paaiaa jaai ||
english: The red color is vain and useless; it cannot help you obtain your Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਲਹਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: is lahade bilam na hovaee ra(n)d baithee doojai bhaai ||
english: This color does not take long to fade; she who loves duality, ends up a widow.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਦੁੰਮਣੀ ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਲੋੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dh iaanee du(n)manee soohai ves loubhaai ||
english: She who loves to wear her red dress is foolish and double-minded.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabad sachai ra(n)g laal kar bhai bhaai seegaar banaai ||
english: So make the True Word of the Shabad your red dress, and let the Fear of God, and the Love of God, be your ornaments and decorations.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿ ਚਲਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sadaa sohaaganee j chalan satigur bhaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, she is a happy soul-bride forever, who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aape aap upaaian aap keemat paaee ||
english: He Himself created Himself, and He Himself evaluates Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tis daa a(n)t na jaapaee gur sabad bujhaaee ||
english: His limits cannot be known; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is understood.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu gubaar hai doojai bharamaaee ||
english: In the darkness of attachment to Maya, the world wanders in duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੑੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh thaur na paainhee phir aavai jaaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs find no place of rest; they continue coming and going.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਸਭ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai sabh chalai rajaaee ||3||
english: Whatever pleases Him, that alone happens. All walk according to His Will. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: soohai ves kaaman kulakhanee jo prabh chhod par purakh dhare piaar ||
english: The red-robed bride is vicious; she forsakes God, and cultivates love for another man.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਸੀਲੁ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: os seel na sa(n)jam sadaa jhooth bolai manamukh karam khuaar ||
english: She has neither modesty or self-discipline; the self-willed manmukh constantly tells lies, and is ruined by the bad karma of evil deeds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jis poorab hovai likhiaa tis satigur milai bhataar ||
english: She who has such pre-ordained destiny, obtains the True Guru has her Husband.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਧਰੇ ਗਲਿ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: soohaa ves sabh utaar dhare gal pahirai khimaa seegaar ||
english: She discards all her red dresses, and wears the ornaments of mercy and forgiveness around her neck.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਐ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: peeeai saahurai bahu sobhaa paae tis pooj kare sabh saisaar ||
english: In this world and the next, she receives great honor, and the whole world worships her.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਰਲਾਈ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: oh ralaaee kisai dee naa ralai jis raave sirajanahaar ||
english: She who is enjoyed by her Creator Lord stands out, and does not blend in with the crowd.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh sadaa suhaaganee jis avinaasee purakh bharataar ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is the happy soul-bride forever; she has the Imperishable Lord God as her Husband. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਿਸੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਗੇ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: soohaa ra(n)g supanai nisee bin taage gal haar ||
english: The red color is like a dream in the night; it is like a necklace without a string.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਕਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sachaa ra(n)g majeeth kaa guramukh braham beechaar ||
english: The Gurmukhs take on the permanent color, contemplating the Lord God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੀ ਸਭਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak prem mahaa rasee sabh buriaaeeaa chhaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, with the supreme sublime essence of the Lord's Love, all sins and evil deeds are turned to ashes. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ihu jag aap upaaion kar choj vidaan ||
english: He Himself created this world, and staged this wondrous play.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch dhaat vich paaeean mohu jhooth gumaan ||
english: Into the body of the five elements, He infused attachment, falsehood and self-conceit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aavai jaai bhavaaeeai manamukh agiaan ||
english: The ignorant, self-willed manmukh comes and goes, wandering in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa aap bujhaaion guramukh har giaan ||
english: He Himself teaches some to become Gurmukh, through the spiritual wisdom of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bhagat khajaanaa bakhasion har naam nidhaan ||4||
english: He blesses them with the treasure of devotional worship, and the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਵੀਏ ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਪਿਰ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: soohaveee soohaa ves chhad too taa pir lagee piaar ||
english: O red-robed woman, discard your red dress, and then, you shall come to love your Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦਝਿ ਮੁਈ ਗਾਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: soohai ves pir kinai na paaio manamukh dajh muee gaavaar ||
english: By wearing her red dress, no one has found her Husband Lord; the self-willed manmukh is burnt to death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai soohaa ves gaiaa haumai vichahu maar ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, she discards her red dress, and eradicates egotism from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man tan rataa laal hoaa rasanaa ratee gun saar ||
english: Her mind and body are imbued with the deep red color of His Love, and her tongue is imbued, singing His Praises and excellences.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sohaagan sabad man bhai bhaai kare seegaar ||
english: She becomes His soul-bride forever, with the Word of the Shabad in her mind; she makes the Fear of God and the Love of God her ornaments and decorations.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak karamee mahal paaiaa pir raakhiaa ur dhaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, by His Merciful Grace, she obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and keeps Him enshrined in her heart. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਸੂਹਾ ਪਰਹਰਹੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dhe soohaa paraharahu laal karahu seegaar ||
english: O bride, forsake your red dress, and decorate yourself with the crimson color of His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa veesarai gurasabadee veechaar ||
english: Your comings and goings shall be forgotten, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dh suhaavee sohanee jis ghar sahaj bhataar ||
english: The soul-bride is adorned and beautiful; the Celestial Lord, her Husband, abides in her home.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰਾਵੀਐ ਰਾਵੇ ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saa dhan raaveeai raave raavanahaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, the bride ravishes and enjoys Him; and He, the Ravisher, ravishes and enjoys her. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: mohu kooR kuta(n)b hai manamukh mugadh rataa ||
english: The foolish, self-willed manmukh is engrossed in false attachment to family.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਲਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai meraa kar mue kichh saath na litaa ||
english: Practicing egotism and self-conceit, he dies and departs, taking nothing along with him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sir upar jamakaal na sujhaee doojai bharamitaa ||
english: He does not understand that the Messenger of Death is hovering over his head; he is deluded by duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: phir velaa hath na aavaee jamakaal vas kitaa ||
english: This opportunity will not come into his hands again; the Messenger of Death will seize him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਿਤਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jehaa dhur likh paaion se karam kamitaa ||5||
english: He acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤੀਆ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜੋ ਮੜਿਆ ਲਗਿ ਜਲੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: sateeaa ehi na aakheean jo maRiaa lag jala(n)nhi ||
english: Do not call them 'satee', who burn themselves along with their husbands' corpses.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤੀਆ ਜਾਣੀਅਨੑਿ ਜਿ ਬਿਰਹੇ ਚੋਟ ਮਰੰਨੑਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sateeaa jaaneeanhi j birahe chot mara(n)nhi ||1||
english: O Nanak, they alone are known as 'satee', who die from the shock of separation. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਸੋ ਸਤੀਆ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਰਹੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: bhee so sateeaa jaaneean seel sa(n)tokh raha(n)nhi ||
english: They are also known as 'satee', who abide in modesty and contentment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਾਈ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਸੰਮੑਾਲੰਨੑਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sevan saaee aapanaa nit uth sa(n)mhaala(n)nhi ||2||
english: They serve their Lord, and rise in the early hours to contemplate Him. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੰਤਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਹੇਲੀਆ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਗਿ ਜਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)taa naal maheleeaa setee ag jalaahi ||
english: The widows burn themselves in the fire, along with their husbands' corpses.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: je jaanahi pir aapanaa taa tan dukh sahaahi ||
english: If they truly knew their husbands, then they suffer terrible bodily pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਅਗਿ ਜਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak ka(n)t na jaananee se kiu ag jalaahi ||
english: O Nanak, if they did not truly know their husbands, why should they burn themselves in the fire?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਉ ਕੈ ਮਰਉ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhaavai jeevau kai marau doorahu hee bhaj jaahi ||3||
english: Whether their husbands are alive or dead, those wives remain far away from them. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh dukh sukh naal upaaiaa lekh karatai likhiaa ||
english: You created pain along with pleasure; O Creator, such is the writ You have written.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡ ਹੋਰ ਦਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰਿਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naavai jevad hor daat naahee tis roop na rikhiaa ||
english: There is no other gift as great as the Name; it has no form or sign.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naam akhut nidhaan hai guramukh man vasiaa ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is an inexhaustible treasure; it abides in the mind of the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa naam devasee phir lekh na likhiaa ||
english: In His Mercy, He blesses us with the Naam, and then, the writ of pain and pleasure is not written.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sevak bhaai se jan mile jin har jap japiaa ||6||
english: Those humble servants who serve with love, meet the Lord, chanting the Chant of the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਥਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jinee chalan jaaniaa se kiu karahi vithaar ||
english: They know that they will have to depart, so why do they make such ostentatious displays?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਲਣ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chalan saar na jaananee kaaj savaaranahaar ||1||
english: Those who do not know that they will have to depart, continue to arrange their affairs. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਭਲਕੇ ਚਲਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: raat kaaran dhan sa(n)cheeai bhalake chalan hoi ||
english: He accumulates wealth during the night of his life, but in the morning, he must depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naal na chalaee phir pachhutaavaa hoi ||2||
english: O Nanak, it shall not go along with him, and so he regrets. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਧਾ ਚਟੀ ਜੋ ਭਰੇ ਨਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾ ਉਪਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: badhaa chatee jo bhare naa gun naa upakaar ||
english: Paying a fine under pressure, does not bring either merit or goodness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਤੀ ਖੁਸੀ ਸਵਾਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: setee khusee savaareeai naanak kaaraj saar ||3||
english: That alone is a good deed, O Nanak, which is done by one's own free will. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਤਰਫ ਨ ਜਿਪਈ ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: manahath taraph na jipaee je bahutaa ghaale ||
english: Stubborn-mindedness will not win the Lord to one's side, no matter how much it is tried.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਰਫ ਜਿਣੈ ਸਤ ਭਾਉ ਦੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: taraph jinai sat bhaau de jan naanak sabad veechaare ||4||
english: The Lord is won over to your side, by offering Him your true love, O servant Nanak, and contemplating the Word of the Shabad. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: karatai kaaran jin keeaa so jaanai soee ||
english: The Creator created the world; He alone understands it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape srisat upaaeean aape phun goee ||
english: He Himself created the Universe, and He Himself shall destroy it afterwards.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਸਭ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੀ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jug chaare sabh bhav thakee kin keemat hoee ||
english: All have grown weary of wandering throughout the four ages, but none know the Lord's worth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur ek vikhaaliaa man tan sukh hoee ||
english: The True Guru has shown me the One Lord, and my mind and body are at peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramukh sadaa salaaheeai karataa kare s hoee ||7||
english: The Gurmukh praises the Lord forever; that alone happens, which the Creator Lord does. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਭਉ ਤਿਨੑ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਉ ਮੁਚੁ ਭਉ ਨਿਭਵਿਆਹ ॥
transliteration: jinaa bhau tinh naahi bhau much bhau nibhaviaah ||
english: Those who have the Fear of God, have no other fears; those who do not have the Fear of God, are very afraid.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਹੁ ਪਟੰਤਰਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਗਇਆਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ehu pata(n)taraa tit deebaan gaiaah ||1||
english: O Nanak, this mystery is revealed at the Court of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਰਦੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਰਦਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਉਡਤੇ ਕਉ ਉਡਤਾ ॥
transliteration: turade kau turadaa milai udate kau udataa ||
english: That which flows, mingles with that which flows; that which blows, mingles with that which blows.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੇ ਕਉ ਜੀਵਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਮੂਆ ॥
transliteration: jeevate kau jeevataa milai mooe kau mooaa ||
english: The living mingle with the living, and the dead mingle with the dead.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak so saalaaheeai jin kaaran keeaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, praise the One who created the creation. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sach dhiaain se sache gur sabad veechaaree ||
english: Those who meditate on the True Lord are true; they contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar man niramalaa har naam ur dhaaree ||
english: They subdue their ego, purify their minds, and enshrine the Lord's Name within their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਲਗਿ ਪਏ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kothe ma(n)dap maaReeaa lag pae gaavaaree ||
english: The fools are attached to their homes, mansions and balconies.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਿ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਬਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jinhi keee tisahi na jaananee manamukh gubaaree ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are caught in darkness; they do not know the One who created them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਹਿ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਸਚਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jis bujhaaihi so bujhasee sachiaa kiaa ja(n)t vichaaree ||8||
english: He alone understands, whom the True Lord causes to understand; what can the helpless creatures do? ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕੰਤੁ ਮਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaaman tau seegaar kar jaa pahilaa(n) ka(n)t manaai ||
english: O bride, decorate yourself, after you surrender and accept your Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਏਵੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mat sejai ka(n)t na aavaee evai birathaa jaai ||
english: Otherwise, your Husband Lord will not come to your bed, and your ornaments will be useless.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਉ ਬਣਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kaaman pir man maaniaa tau baniaa seegaar ||
english: O bride, your decorations will adorn you, only when your Husband Lord's Mind is pleased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੀਆ ਤਉ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: keeaa tau paravaan hai jaa sahu dhare piaar ||
english: Your ornaments will be acceptable and approved, only when your Husband Lord loves you.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਤਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: bhau seegaar tabol ras bhojan bhaau karei ||
english: So make the Fear of God your ornaments, joy your betel nuts to chew, and love your food.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਕੰਤ ਕਉ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tan man saupe ka(n)t kau tau naanak bhog karei ||1||
english: Surrender your body and mind to your Husband Lord, and then, O Nanak, He will enjoy you. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜਲ ਫੂਲ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਲੇ ਧਨ ਕੀਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kaajal phool ta(n)bol ras le dhan keeaa seegaar ||
english: The wife takes flowers, and fragrance of betel, and decorates herself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਏਵੈ ਭਇਆ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sejai ka(n)t na aaio evai bhaiaa vikaar ||2||
english: But her Husband Lord does not come to her bed, and so these efforts are useless. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਿਰੁ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਬਹਨਿ ਇਕਠੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dhan pir ehi na aakheean bahan ikathe hoi ||
english: They are not said to be husband and wife, who merely sit together.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਮੂਰਤੀ ਧਨ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ek jot dui mooratee dhan pir kaheeai soi ||3||
english: They alone are called husband and wife, who have one light in two bodies. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhai bin bhagat na hovaee naam na lagai piaar ||
english: Without the Fear of God, there is no devotional worship, and no love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai bhau oopajai bhai bhaai ra(n)g savaar ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, the Fear of God wells up, and one is embellished with the Fear and the Love of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tan man rataa ra(n)g siu haumai trisanaa maar ||
english: When the body and mind are imbued with the Lord's Love, egotism and desire are conquered and subdued.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man tan niramal at sohanaa bhetiaa krisan muraar ||
english: The mind and body become immaculately pure and very beautiful, when one meets the Lord, the Destroyer of ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੯॥
transliteration: bhau bhaau sabh tis daa so sach varatai sa(n)saar ||9||
english: Fear and love all belong to Him; He is the True Lord, permeating and pervading the Universe. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਖਸਮ ਤੂ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਨਾ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ॥
transliteration: vaahu khasam too vaahu jin rach rachanaa ham keee ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! You are wonderful and great, O Lord and Master; You created the creation, and made us.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਰ ਵੇਲਿ ਵਰਸ ਵਰਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: saagar lahar samu(n)d sar vel varas varaahu ||
english: You made the waters, waves, oceans, pools, plants, clouds and mountains.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਖੜੋਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਪੀਣੈ ਆਪਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aap khaRovahi aap kar aapeenai aapaahu ||
english: You Yourself stand in the midst of what You Yourself created.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਮਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sevaa thaai pavai unaman tat kamaahu ||
english: The selfless service of the Gurmukhs is approved; in celestial peace, they live the essence of reality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਸਕਤਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਮਜੂਰੀਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਖਸਮ ਦਰਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: masakat lahahu majooreeaa ma(n)g ma(n)g khasam daraahu ||
english: They receive the wages of their labor, begging at the Door of their Lord and Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੁਰ ਦਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਤਉ ਦਰਿ ਊਣਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak pur dar veparavaah tau dar oonaa naahi ko sachaa veparavaahu ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Court of the Lord is overflowing and carefree; O my True Carefree Lord, no one returns empty-handed from Your Court. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਉਜਲ ਮੋਤੀ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਰਤਨਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੁੜੰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: ujal motee sohane ratanaa naal juRa(n)n ||
english: The teeth are like brilliant, beautiful pearls, and the eyes are like sparkling jewels.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਰੁ ਵੈਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਬੁਢੇ ਥੀਇ ਮਰੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin jar vairee naanakaa j budhe theei mara(n)n ||2||
english: Old age is their enemy, O Nanak; when they grow old, they waste away. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har saalaahee sadaa sadaa tan man saup sareer ||
english: Praise the Lord, forever and ever; dedicate your body and mind to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee sach paaiaa sachaa gahir ga(n)bheer ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have found the True, Profound and Unfathomable Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man tan hiradai rav rahiaa har heeraa heer ||
english: The Lord, the jewel of jewels, is permeating my mind, body and heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਵੈ ਨ ਫੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: janam maran kaa dukh gaiaa phir pavai na pheer ||
english: The pains of birth and death are gone, and I shall never again be consigned to the cycle of reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam salaahi too har gunee gaheer ||10||
english: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the ocean of excellence. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਲਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak ihu tan jaal jin jaliai naam visaariaa ||
english: O Nanak, burn this body; this burnt body has forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਦੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਾਲਿ ਪਿਛੈ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਅੰਬੜੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਨਿਵੰਧੈ ਤਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paudee jaai paraal pichhai hath na a(n)baRai tit niva(n)dhai taal ||1||
english: The dirt is piling up, and in the world hereafter, your hand shall not be able to reach down into this stagnant pond to clean it out. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਕੰਮ ਫਿਟਿਆ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak man ke ka(n)m phitiaa ganat na aavahee ||
english: O Nanak, wicked are the uncountable actions of the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੀ ਲਹਾ ਸਹੰਮ ਜਾ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਾ ਧਕਾ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kitee lahaa saha(n)m jaa bakhase taa dhakaa nahee ||2||
english: They bring terrible and painful retributions, but if the Lord forgives me, then I will be spared this punishment. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਚਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sachaa amar chalaaion kar sach phuramaan ||
english: True is the Command He sends forth, and True are the Orders He issues.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa nihachal rav rahiaa so purakh sujaan ||
english: Forever unmoving and unchanging, permeating and pervading everywhere, He is the All-knowing Primal Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee seveeai sach sabad neesaan ||
english: By Guru's Grace, serve Him, through the True Insignia of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: pooraa thaat banaaiaa ra(n)g guramat maan ||
english: That which He makes is perfect; through the Guru's Teachings, enjoy His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: agam agochar alakh hai guramukh har jaan ||11||
english: He is inaccessible, unfathomable and unseen; as Gurmukh, know the Lord. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਦਰਾ ਮਾਲ ਕਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ਆਣਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak badaraa maal kaa bheetar dhariaa aan ||
english: O Nanak, the bags of coins are brought in

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖੀਅਨਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khote khare parakheean saahib kai deebaan ||1||
english: and placed in the Court of our Lord and Master, and there, the genuine and the counterfeit are separated. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਣ ਚਲੇ ਤੀਰਥੀ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੈ ਤਨਿ ਚੋਰ ॥
transliteration: naavan chale teerathee man khotai tan chor ||
english: They go and bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, but their minds are still evil, and their bodies are thieves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਭਾਉ ਲਥੀ ਨਾਤਿਆ ਦੁਇ ਭਾ ਚੜੀਅਸੁ ਹੋਰ ॥
transliteration: ik bhaau lathee naatiaa dui bhaa chaReeas hor ||
english: Some of their filth is washed off by these baths, but they only accumulate twice as much.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਧੋਤੀ ਤੂਮੜੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਿਸੁ ਨਿਕੋਰ ॥
transliteration: baahar dhotee toomaRee a(n)dar vis nikor ||
english: Like a gourd, they may be washed off on the outside, but on the inside, they are still filled with poison.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਭਲੇ ਅਣਨਾਤਿਆ ਚੋਰ ਸਿ ਚੋਰਾ ਚੋਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadh bhale ananaatiaa chor s choraa chor ||2||
english: The holy man is blessed, even without such bathing, while a thief is a thief, no matter how much he bathes. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape hukam chalaaidaa jag dha(n)dhai laaiaa ||
english: He Himself issues His Commands, and links the people of the world to their tasks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ik aape hee aap laaian gur te sukh paaiaa ||
english: He Himself joins some to Himself, and through the Guru, they find peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dah dis ihu man dhaavadaa gur thaak rahaaiaa ||
english: The mind runs around in the ten directions; the Guru holds it still.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਲੋਚਦੀ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naavai no sabh lochadee guramatee paaiaa ||
english: Everyone longs for the Name, but it is only found through the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: dhur likhiaa met na sakeeai jo har likh paaiaa ||12||
english: Your pre-ordained destiny, written by the Lord in the very beginning, cannot be erased. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਦੀਵੇ ਚਉਦਹ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: dui deeve chaudah hatanaale ||
english: The two lamps light the fourteen markets.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਤੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jete jee tete vanajaare ||
english: There are just as many traders as there are living beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੁਲੑੇ ਹਟ ਹੋਆ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: khulhe hat hoaa vaapaar ||
english: The shops are open, and trading is going on;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਸੋ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jo pahuchai so chalanahaar ||
english: whoever comes there, is bound to depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੁ ਦਲਾਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: dharam dalaal paae neesaan ||
english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is the broker, who gives his sign of approval.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak naam laahaa paravaan ||
english: O Nanak, those who earn the profit of the Naam are accepted and approved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ghar aae vajee vaadhaaee ||
english: And when they return home, they are greeted with cheers;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sach naam kee milee vadiaaee ||1||
english: they obtain the glorious greatness of the True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਕਾਲੀਆ ਸੁਪੇਦਾ ਸੇ ਵੰਨ ॥
transliteration: raatee hovan kaaleeaa supedaa se va(n)n ||
english: Even when the night is dark, whatever is white retains its white color.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਹੁ ਬਗਾ ਤਪੈ ਘਣਾ ਕਾਲਿਆ ਕਾਲੇ ਵੰਨ ॥
transliteration: dihu bagaa tapai ghanaa kaaliaa kaale va(n)n ||
english: And even when the light of day is dazzlingly bright, whatever is black retains its black color.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਅਕਲੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe akalee baahare moorakh a(n)dh giaan ||
english: The blind fools have no wisdom at all; their understanding is blind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree baahare kabahi na paavahi maan ||2||
english: O Nanak, without the Lord's Grace, they will never receive honor. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kot rachaaiaa har sachai aape ||
english: The True Lord Himself created the body-fortress.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: ik doojai bhaai khuaaian haumai vich viaape ||
english: Some are ruined through the love of duality, engrossed in egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਸਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: ihu maanas janam dula(n)bh saa manamukh sa(n)taape ||
english: This human body is so difficult to obtain; the self-willed manmukhs suffer in pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: jis aap bujhaae so bujhasee jis satigur thaape ||
english: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself causes to understand; he is blessed by the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਸਭ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: sabh jag khel rachaaion sabh varatai aape ||13||
english: He created the entire world for His play; He is pervading amongst all. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੋਰਾ ਜਾਰਾ ਰੰਡੀਆ ਕੁਟਣੀਆ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: choraa jaaraa ra(n)deeaa kutaneeaa deebaan ||
english: Thieves, adulterers, prostitutes and pimps,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਦੀਨਾ ਕੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਵੇਦੀਨਾ ਕਾ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: vedeenaa kee dosatee vedeenaa kaa khaan ||
english: Make friendships with the unrighteous, and eat with the unrighteous.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਵਸੈ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: siphatee saar na jaananee sadaa vasai saitaan ||
english: They do not know the value of the Lord's Praises, and Satan is always with them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਦਹੁ ਚੰਦਨਿ ਖਉਲੀਐ ਭੀ ਸਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਪਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: gadahu cha(n)dan khauleeai bhee saahoo siu paan ||
english: If a donkey is anointed with sandalwood paste, he still loves to roll in the dirt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੂੜੈ ਕਤਿਐ ਕੂੜਾ ਤਣੀਐ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak kooRai katiai kooRaa taneeai taan ||
english: O Nanak, by spinning falsehood, a fabric of falsehood is woven.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਕਛੀਐ ਕੂੜਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kooRaa kapaR kachheeai kooRaa painan maan ||1||
english: False is the cloth and its measurement, and false is pride in such a garment. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਂਗਾ ਬੁਰਗੂ ਸਿੰਙੀਆ ਨਾਲੇ ਮਿਲੀ ਕਲਾਣ ॥
transliteration: baa(n)gaa buragoo si(n)ngeeaa naale milee kalaan ||
english: The callers to prayer, the flute-players, the horn-blowers, and also the singers

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: ik daate ik ma(n)gate naam teraa paravaan ||
english: - some are givers, and some are beggars; they become acceptable only through Your Name, Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jinhee sun kai ma(n)niaa hau tinaa vitahu kurabaan ||2||
english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who hear and accept the Name. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabh kooR hai kooRo hoi gaiaa ||
english: Attachment to Maya is totally false, and false are those who go that way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਝਗੜਾ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਝਗੜੈ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai jhagaRaa paaion jhagaRai jag muiaa ||
english: Through egotism, the world is caught in conflict and strife, and it dies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਝਗੜੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਓਨੁ ਇਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jhagaR chukaaion iko rav rahiaa ||
english: The Gurmukh is free of conflict and strife, and sees the One Lord, pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa bhaujal tar gaiaa ||
english: Recognizing that the Supreme Soul is everywhere, he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: jot samaanee jot vich har naam samaiaa ||14||
english: His light merges into the Light, and he is absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਦੇਹਿ ਮੈ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur bheekhiaa dehi mai too(n) sa(n)mrath daataar ||
english: O True Guru, bless me with Your charity; You are the All-powerful Giver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: haumai garab nivaareeai kaam krodh aha(n)kaar ||
english: May I subdue and quiet my egotism, pride, sexual desire, anger and self-conceit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਪਰਜਾਲੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: lab lobh parajaaleeai naam milai aadhaar ||
english: Burn away all my greed, and give me the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਵਤਨ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ahinis navatan niramalaa mailaa kabahoo(n) na hoi ||
english: Day and night, keep me ever-fresh and new, spotless and pure; let me never be soiled by sin.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ih bidh chhuteeai nadar teree sukh hoi ||1||
english: O Nanak, in this way I am saved; by Your Grace, I have found peace. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕੋ ਕੰਤੁ ਸਬਾਈਆ ਜਿਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਖੜੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: iko ka(n)t sabaaeeaa jitee dar khaReeaah ||
english: There is only the one Husband Lord, for all who stand at His Door.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਤੈ ਰਤੀਆ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਬਾਤੜੀਆਹ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak ka(n)tai rateeaa puchhahi baataReeaah ||2||
english: O Nanak, they ask for news of their Husband Lord, from those who are imbued with His Love. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਕੰਤੈ ਰਤੀਆ ਮੈ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਕਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: sabhe ka(n)tai rateeaa mai dohaagan kit ||
english: All are imbued with love for their Husband Lord; I am a discarded bride - what good am I?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਏਤੜੇ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਫੇਰੇ ਚਿਤੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mai tan avagan etaRe khasam na phere chit ||3||
english: My body is filled with so many faults; my Lord and Master does not even turn His thoughts to me. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਦੈ ਵਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree tin kau siphat jinaa dai vaat ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who praise the Lord with their mouths.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਇਕ ਮੈ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sabh raatee sohaaganee ik mai dohaagan raat ||4||
english: All the nights are for the happy soul-brides; I am a discarded bride - if only I could have even one night with Him! ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਮੰਗਤੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dar ma(n)gat jaachai daan har deejai kripaa kar ||
english: I am a beggar at Your Door, begging for charity; O Lord, please grant me Your Mercy, and give to me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh lehu milaai jan paavai naam har ||
english: As Gurmukh, unite me, your humble servant, with You, that I may receive Your Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
transliteration: anahad sabad vajaai jotee jot dhar ||
english: Then, the unstruck melody of the Shabad will vibrate and resound, and my light will blend with the Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: hiradai har gun gaai jai jai sabad har ||
english: Within my heart, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and celebrate the Word of the Lord's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: jag mahi varatai aap har setee preet kar ||15||
english: The Lord Himself is pervading and permeating the world; so fall in love with Him! ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jinee na paaio prem ras ka(n)t na paaio saau ||
english: Those who do not obtain the sublime essence, the love and delight of their Husband Lord,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਞੇ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: su(n)nje ghar kaa paahunaa jiu aaiaa tiu jaau ||1||
english: are like guests in a deserted house; they leave just as they have come, empty-handed. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਉ ਓਲਾਮੑੇ ਦਿਨੈ ਕੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਨੑਿ ਸਹੰਸ ॥
transliteration: sau olaamhe dinai ke raatee milanhi saha(n)s ||
english: He receives hundreds and thousands of reprimands, day and night;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਕਰੰਗੀ ਲਗਾ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
transliteration: siphat salaahan chhad kai kara(n)gee lagaa ha(n)s ||
english: the swan-soul has renounced the Lord's Praises, and attached itself to a rotting carcass.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਿਟੁ ਇਵੇਹਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਇ ਵਧਾਇਆ ਪੇਟੁ ॥
transliteration: phit ivehaa jeeviaa jit khaai vadhaaiaa pet ||
english: Cursed is that life, in which one only eats to fill his belly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਭੋ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਹੇਤੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sache naam vin sabho dusaman het ||2||
english: O Nanak, without the True Name, all one's friends turn to enemies. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dhaadhee gun gaavai nit janam savaariaa ||
english: The minstrel continually sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, to embellish his life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sev salaahi sachaa ur dhaariaa ||
english: The Gurmukh serves and praises the True Lord, enshrining Him within his heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਹਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ghar dar paavai mahal naam piaariaa ||
english: He obtains his own home and mansion, by loving the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh paaiaa naam hau gur kau vaariaa ||
english: As Gurmukh, I have obtained the Naam; I am a sacrifice to the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: too aap savaarahi aap sirajanahaariaa ||16||
english: You Yourself embellish and adorn us, O Creator Lord. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਵਾ ਬਲੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: deevaa balai a(n)dheraa jaai ||
english: When the lamp is lit, the darkness is dispelled;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bed paath mat paapaa khaai ||
english: reading the Vedas, sinful intellect is destroyed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਉਗਵੈ ਸੂਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਚੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: ugavai soor na jaapai cha(n)d ||
english: When the sun rises, the moon is not visible.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਿਟੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jah giaan pragaas agiaan mita(n)t ||
english: Wherever spiritual wisdom appears, ignorance is dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bed paath sa(n)saar kee kaar ||
english: Reading the Vedas is the world's occupation;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜੑਿ ਪੜੑਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: paRhi paRhi pa(n)dit karahi beechaar ||
english: the Pandits read them, study them and contemplate them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: bin boojhe sabh hoi khuaar ||
english: Without understanding, all are ruined.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh utaras paar ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is carried across. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabadai saad na aaio naam na lago piaar ||
english: Those who do not savor the Word of the Shabad, do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa phikaa bolanaa nit nit hoi khuaar ||
english: They speak insipidly with their tongues, and are continually disgraced.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak paiai kirat kamaavanaa koi na metanahaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, they act according to the karma of their past actions, which no one can erase. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: j prabh saalaahe aapanaa so sobhaa paae ||
english: One who praises his God, receives honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: haumai vichahu door kar sach ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: He drives out egotism from within himself, and enshrines the True Name within his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sach baanee gun ucharai sachaa sukh paae ||
english: Through the True Word of the Guru's Bani, he chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and finds true peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mel bhaiaa chiree vichhu(n)niaa gur purakh milaae ||
english: He is united with the Lord, after being separated for so long; the Guru, the Primal Being, unites him with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਇਵ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: man mailaa iv sudh hai har naam dhiaae ||17||
english: In this way, his filthy mind is cleansed and purified, and he meditates on the Name of the Lord. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂਮਲ ਫੁਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਪਸਿ ਮਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa koomal phul gun naanak gupas maal ||
english: With the fresh leaves of the body, and the flowers of virtue, Nanak has weaved his garland.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਨੀ ਫੁਲੀ ਰਉ ਕਰੇ ਅਵਰ ਕਿ ਚੁਣੀਅਹਿ ਡਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: enee phulee rau kare avar k chuneeahi daal ||1||
english: The Lord is pleased with such garlands, so why pick any other flowers? ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਾ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak tinaa basa(n)t hai jinh ghar vasiaa ka(n)t ||
english: O Nanak, it is the spring season for those, within whose homes their Husband Lord abides.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਕੰਤ ਦਿਸਾਪੁਰੀ ਸੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜਲੰਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin ke ka(n)t disaapuree se ahinis phirahi jala(n)t ||2||
english: But those, whose Husband Lord is far away in distant lands, continue burning, day and night. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ॥
transliteration: aape bakhase daiaa kar gur satigur bachanee ||
english: The Merciful Lord Himself forgives those who dwell upon the Word of the Guru, the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚੈ ਰਚਨੀ ॥
transliteration: anadin sevee gun ravaa man sachai rachanee ||
english: Night and day, I serve the True Lord, and chant His Glorious Praises; my mind merges into Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਲਖਨੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh meraa bea(n)t hai a(n)t kinai na lakhanee ||
english: My God is infinite; no one knows His limit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਨੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur charanee lagiaa har naam nit japanee ||
english: Grasping hold of the feet of the True Guru, meditate continually on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਸਭਿ ਘਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਚਨੀ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: jo ichhai so phal paaisee sabh gharai vich jachanee ||18||
english: Thus you shall obtain the fruits of your desires, and all wishes shall be fulfilled within your home. ||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲ ਬਸੰਤੈ ਆਗਮਨਿ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਮਉਲਿਓ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: pahil basa(n)tai aagaman pahilaa maulio soi ||
english: Spring brings forth the first blossoms, but the Lord blossoms earlier still.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਉਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਮਉਲੀਐ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਮਉਲਿਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jit mauliai sabh mauleeai tisahi na maulihu koi ||1||
english: By His blossoming, everything blossoms; no one else causes Him to blossom forth. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲ ਬਸੰਤੈ ਆਗਮਨਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pahil basa(n)tai aagaman tis kaa karahu beechaar ||
english: He blossoms forth even earlier than the spring; reflect upon Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak so saalaaheeai j sabhasai de aadhaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, praise the One who gives Support to all. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: miliai miliaa naa milai milai miliaa je hoi ||
english: By uniting, the united one is not united; he unites, only if he is united.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੈ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)tar aatamai jo milai miliaa kaheeai soi ||3||
english: But if he unites deep within his soul, then he is said to be united. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har har naam salaaheeai sach kaar kamaavai ||
english: Praise the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and practice truthful deeds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: doojee kaarai lagiaa phir jonee paavai ||
english: Attached to other deeds, one is consigned to wander in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naam ratiaa naam paaeeai naame gun gaavai ||
english: Attuned to the Name, one obtains the Name, and through the Name, sings the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad salaaheeai har naam samaavai ||
english: Praising the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he merges in the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: satigur sevaa saphal hai seviai phal paavai ||19||
english: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding; serving Him, the fruits are obtained. ||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਮੰਞੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਇਕੁ ਤੂ ॥
transliteration: kis hee koee koi ma(n)nj nimaanee ik too ||
english: Some people have others, but I am forlorn and dishonored; I have only You, Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਮਰੀਜੈ ਰੋਇ ਜਾ ਲਗੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kiu na mareejai roi jaa lag chit na aavahee ||1||
english: I might as well just die crying, if You will not come into my mind. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਓ ਦੁਖਿ ਭੀ ਸੰਮੑਾਲਿਓਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) sukh taa sahu raavio dukh bhee sa(n)mhaalioi ||
english: When there is peace and pleasure, that is the time to remember your Husband Lord. In times of suffering and pain, remember Him then as well.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਿਆਣੀਏ ਇਉ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kahai siaaneee iu ka(n)t milaavaa hoi ||2||
english: Says Nanak, O wise bride, this is the way to meet your Husband Lord. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਕਿਰਮ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਡੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: hau kiaa saalaahee kiram ja(n)t vadee teree vadiaaee ||
english: I am a worm - how can I praise You, O Lord; Your glorious greatness is so great!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: too agam daiaal aga(n)m hai aap laihi milaaee ||
english: You are inaccessible, merciful and unapproachable; You Yourself unite us with Yourself.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਤੂ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mai tujh bin belee ko nahee too a(n)t sakhaaee ||
english: I have no other friend except You; in the end, You alone will be my Companion and Support.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਤਿਨ ਲੈਹਿ ਛਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo teree saranaagatee tin laihi chhadaaee ||
english: You save those who enter Your Sanctuary.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ॥੨੦॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak veparavaahu hai tis til na tamaaee ||20||1||
english: O Nanak, He is care-free; He has no greed at all. ||20||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਤਥਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee baanee sree kabeer jeeu tathaa sabhanaa bhagataa kee || kabeer ke ||
english: Raag Soohee, The Word Of Kabeer Jee, And Other Devotees. Of Kabeer

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਵਤਰਿ ਆਇ ਕਹਾ ਤੁਮ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: avatar aai kahaa tum keenaa ||
english: Since your birth, what have you done?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam ko naam na kabahoo leenaa ||1||
english: You have never even chanted the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨ ਜਪਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਮਤਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: raam na japahu kavan mat laage ||
english: You have not meditated on the Lord; what thoughts are you attached to?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਜਇਬੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mar jaibe kau kiaa karahu abhaage ||1|| rahaau ||
english: What preparations are you making for your death, O unfortunate one? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh kar kai kuta(n)b jeevaaiaa ||
english: Through pain and pleasure, you have taken care of your family.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਇਕਸਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maratee baar ikasar dukh paaiaa ||2||
english: But at the time of death, you shall have to endure the agony all alone. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੰਠ ਗਹਨ ਤਬ ਕਰਨ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)th gahan tab karan pukaaraa ||
english: When you are seized by the neck, then you shall cry out.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਆਗੇ ਤੇ ਨ ਸੰਮੑਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer aage te na sa(n)mhaaraa ||3||1||
english: Says Kabeer, why didn't you remember the Lord before this? ||3||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
transliteration: soohee kabeer jee ||
english: Soohee, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਥਰਹਰ ਕੰਪੈ ਬਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tharahar ka(n)pai baalaa jeeu ||
english: My innocent soul trembles and shakes.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਸੀ ਪੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naa jaanau kiaa karasee peeu ||1||
english: I do not know how my Husband Lord will deal with me. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੈਨਿ ਗਈ ਮਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: rain gaee mat din bhee jaai ||
english: The night of my youth has passed away; will the day of old age also pass away?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਵਰ ਗਏ ਬਗ ਬੈਠੇ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhavar gae bag baithe aai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My dark hairs, like bumble bees, have gone away, and grey hairs, like cranes, have settled upon my head. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੈ ਕਰਵੈ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kaachai karavai rahai na paanee ||
english: Water does not remain in the unbaked clay pot;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਿਆ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੁਮਲਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ha(n)s chaliaa kaaiaa kumalaanee ||2||
english: when the soul-swan departs, the body withers away. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੁਆਰ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਤ ਸੀਗਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kuaar ka(n)niaa jaise karat seegaaraa ||
english: I decorate myself like a young virgin;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਨੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਭਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kiu raleeaa maanai baajh bhataaraa ||3||
english: but how can I enjoy pleasures, without my Husband Lord? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਗ ਉਡਾਵਤ ਭੁਜਾ ਪਿਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kaag udaavat bhujaa piraanee ||
english: My arm is tired, driving away the crows.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹ ਕਥਾ ਸਿਰਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer ih kathaa siraanee ||4||2||
english: Says Kabeer, this is the way the story of my life ends. ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: soohee kabeer jeeu ||
english: Soohee, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਮਲੁ ਸਿਰਾਨੋ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਨਾ ॥
transliteration: amal siraano lekhaa denaa ||
english: Your time of service is at its end, and you will have to give your account.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਏ ਕਠਿਨ ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਲੇਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aae kathin doot jam lenaa ||
english: The hard-hearted Messenger of Death has come to take you away.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਤੈ ਖਟਿਆ ਕਹਾ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kiaa tai khatiaa kahaa gavaaiaa ||
english: What have you earned, and what have you lost?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਲਹੁ ਸਿਤਾਬ ਦੀਬਾਨਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chalahu sitaab deebaan bulaaiaa ||1||
english: Come immediately! You are summoned to His Court! ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਲੁ ਦਰਹਾਲੁ ਦੀਵਾਨਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: chal darahaal deevaan bulaaiaa ||
english: Get going! Come just as you are! You have been summoned to His Court.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har phuramaan daragah kaa aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Order has come from the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਗਾਵ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਾਕੀ ॥
transliteration: karau aradaas gaav kichh baakee ||
english: I pray to the Messenger of Death: please, I still have some outstanding debts to collect in the village.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੇਉ ਨਿਬੇਰਿ ਆਜੁ ਕੀ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: leu niber aaj kee raatee ||
english: I will collect them tonight;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਭੀ ਖਰਚੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਸਾਰਉ ॥
transliteration: kichh bhee kharach tumhaaraa saarau ||
english: I will also pay you something for your expenses,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਬਹ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਸਰਾਇ ਗੁਜਾਰਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: subah nivaaj saraai gujaarau ||2||
english: and I will recite my morning prayers on the way. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jaa kau har ra(n)g laagaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the most fortunate servant of the Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan so jan purakh sabhaagaa ||
english: Who is imbued with the Lord's Love, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: eet oot jan sadaa suhele ||
english: Here and there, the humble servants of the Lord are always happy.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਅਮੋਲੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam padaarath jeet amole ||3||
english: They win the priceless treasure of this human life. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaagat soiaa janam gavaaiaa ||
english: When he is awake, he is sleeping, and so he loses this life.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਰਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maal dhan joriaa bhaiaa paraaiaa ||
english: The property and wealth he has accumulated passes on to someone else.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇਈ ਨਰ ਭੂਲੇ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer teee nar bhoole ||
english: Says Kabeer, those people are deluded,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੂਲੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: khasam bisaar maatee sa(n)g roole ||4||3||
english: who forget their Lord and Master, and roll in the dust. ||4||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਲਲਿਤ ॥
transliteration: soohee kabeer jeeu lalit ||
english: Soohee, Kabeer Jee, Lallit:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਥਾਕੇ ਨੈਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਥਾਕੀ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: thaake nain sravan sun thaake thaakee su(n)dar kaaiaa ||
english: My eyes are exhausted, and my ears are tired of hearing; my beautiful body is exhausted.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਰਾ ਹਾਕ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਮਤਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਏਕ ਨ ਥਾਕਸਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
