transliteration: jaraa haak dee sabh mat thaakee ek na thaakas maaiaa ||1||
english: Driven forward by old age, all my senses are exhausted; only my attachment to Maya is not exhausted. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਰੇ ਤੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: baavare tai giaan beechaar na paaiaa ||
english: O mad man, you have not obtained spiritual wisdom and meditation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You have wasted this human life, and lost. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: tab lag praanee tisai sarevahu jab lag ghat mahi saasaa ||
english: O mortal, serve the Lord, as long as the breath of life remains in the body.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਘਟੁ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: je ghat jaai ta bhaau na jaasee har ke charan nivaasaa ||2||
english: And even when your body dies, your love for the Lord shall not die; you shall dwell at the Feet of the Lord. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਬਸਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jis kau sabad basaavai a(n)tar chookai tisahi piaasaa ||
english: When the Word of the Shabad abides deep within, thirst and desire are quenched.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਖੇਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਢਾਲੇ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hukamai boojhai chaupaR khelai man jin dhaale paasaa ||3||
english: When one understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he plays the game of chess with the Lord; throwing the dice, he conquers his own mind. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਭਜਹਿ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਕਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jo jan jaan bhajahi abigat kau tin kaa kachhoo na naasaa ||
english: Those humble beings, who know the Imperishable Lord and meditate on Him, are not destroyed at all.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਹਿ ਢਾਲਿ ਜੁ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer te jan kabahu na haarahi dhaal j jaanahi paasaa ||4||4||
english: Says Kabeer, those humble beings who know how to throw these dice, never lose the game of life. ||4||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਲਲਿਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: soohee lalit kabeer jeeu ||
english: Soohee, Lalit, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਪੰਚ ਸਿਕਦਾਰਾ ਪੰਚੇ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ek kot pa(n)ch sikadaaraa pa(n)che maagahi haalaa ||
english: In the one fortress of the body, there are five rulers, and all five demand payment of taxes.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਮੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੀ ਬੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਦੇਨੁ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jimee naahee mai kisee kee boee aisaa den dukhaalaa ||1||
english: I have not farmed anyone's land, so such payment is difficult for me to pay. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨੀਤਿ ਡਸੈ ਪਟਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke logaa mo kau neet dasai patavaaree ||
english: O people of the Lord, the tax-collector is constantly torturing me!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਲੀਆ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: oopar bhujaa kar mai gur pahi pukaariaa tin hau leeaa ubaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Raising my arms up, I complained to my Guru, and He has saved me. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਡਾਡੀ ਦਸ ਮੁੰਸਫ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਰਈਅਤਿ ਬਸਨ ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: nau daadee das mu(n)saph dhaavahi raeeat basan na dehee ||
english: The nine tax-assessors and the ten magistrates go out; they do not allow their subjects to live in peace.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਡੋਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਾਪਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਸਟਾਲਾ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: doree pooree maapahi naahee bahu bisataalaa lehee ||2||
english: They do not measure with a full tape, and they take huge amounts in bribes. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਹਤਰਿ ਘਰ ਇਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਉਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bahatar ghar ik purakh samaaiaa un deeaa naam likhaaee ||
english: The One Lord is contained in the seventy-two chambers of the body, and He has written off my account.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਦਫਤਰੁ ਸੋਧਿਆ ਬਾਕੀ ਰਿਜਮ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dharam raai kaa daphatar sodhiaa baakee rijam na kaaee ||3||
english: The records of the Righteous Judge of Dharma have been searched, and I owe absolutely nothing. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਤਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਏਕੋੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa kau mat koee ni(n)dahu sa(n)t raam hai ekou ||
english: Let no one slander the Saints, because the Saints and the Lord are as one.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਬਿਬੇਕੋੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer mai so gur paaiaa jaa kaa naau bibekou ||4||5||
english: Says Kabeer, I have found that Guru, whose Name is Clear Understanding. ||4||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee baanee sree ravidaas jeeu kee ||
english: Raag Soohee, The Word Of Sree Ravi Daas Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਹ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: sah kee saar suhaagan jaanai ||
english: The happy soul-bride knows the worth of her Husband Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: taj abhimaan sukh raleeaa maanai ||
english: Renouncing pride, she enjoys peace and pleasure.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: tan man dei na a(n)tar raakhai ||
english: She surrenders her body and mind to Him, and does not remain separate from Him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਸੁਨੈ ਅਭਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: avaraa dekh na sunai abhaakhai ||1||
english: She does not see or hear, or speak to another. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਤ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: so kat jaanai peer paraaee ||
english: How can anyone know the pain of another,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai a(n)tar darad na paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: if there is no compassion and sympathy within? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਦੁਇ ਪਖ ਹੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: dukhee duhaagan dui pakh heenee ||
english: The discarded bride is miserable, and loses both worlds;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਹ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jin naah nira(n)tar bhagat na keenee ||
english: she does not worship her Husband Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰ ਸਲਾਤ ਕਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: pur salaat kaa pa(n)th duhelaa ||
english: The bridge over the fire of hell is difficult and treacherous.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸਾਥੀ ਗਵਨੁ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)g na saathee gavan ikelaa ||2||
english: No one will accompany you there; you will have to go all alone. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦਰਦਵੰਦੁ ਦਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dukheeaa daradava(n)d dar aaiaa ||
english: Suffering in pain, I have come to Your Door, O Compassionate Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bahut piaas jabaab na paaiaa ||
english: I am so thirsty for You, but You do not answer me.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas saran prabh teree ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, I seek Your Sanctuary, God;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਕਰੁ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu jaanahu tiu kar gat meree ||3||1||
english: as You know me, so will You save me. ||3||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ॥
transliteration: soohee ||
english: Soohee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦਿਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਦਿਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jo din aavahi so din jaahee ||
english: That day which comes, that day shall go.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਾ ਕੂਚੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: karanaa kooch rahan thir naahee ||
english: You must march on; nothing remains stable.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗੁ ਚਲਤ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਭੀ ਚਲਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g chalat hai ham bhee chalanaa ||
english: Our companions are leaving, and we must leave as well.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: door gavan sir oopar maranaa ||1||
english: We must go far away. Death is hovering over our heads. ||1||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗੁ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kiaa too soiaa jaag iaanaa ||
english: Why are you asleep? Wake up, you ignorant fool!

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tai jeevan jag sach kar jaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You believe that your life in the world is true. ||1||Pause||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਦੀਆ ਸੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਅੰਬਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jin jeeu deeaa s rijak a(n)baraavai ||
english: The One who gave you life shall also provide you with nourishment.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਾਟੁ ਚਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh ghat bheetar haat chalaavai ||
english: In each and every heart, He runs His shop.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਿਗੀ ਛਾਡਿ ਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kar ba(n)digee chhaad mai meraa ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, and renounce your egotism and self-conceit.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hiradai naam samhaar saveraa ||2||
english: Within your heart, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord, sometime. ||2||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਨੋ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: janam siraano pa(n)th na savaaraa ||
english: Your life has passed away, but you have not arranged your path.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਝ ਪਰੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)jh paree dah dis a(n)dhiaaraa ||
english: Evening has set in, and soon there will be darkness on all sides.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas nidaan divaane ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, O ignorant mad-man,

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਫਨ ਖਾਨੇ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: chetas naahee duneeaa phan khaane ||3||2||
english: don't you realize, that this world is the house of death?! ||3||2||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ॥
transliteration: soohee ||
english: Soohee:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਸਾਲ ਰਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ooche ma(n)dar saal rasoee ||
english: You may have lofty mansions, halls and kitchens.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek gharee phun rahan na hoee ||1||
english: But you cannot stay in them, even for an instant, after death. ||1||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਸ ਕੀ ਟਾਟੀ ॥
transliteration: ihu tan aisaa jaise ghaas kee taatee ||
english: This body is like a house of straw.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਘਾਸੁ ਰਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jal gaio ghaas ral gaio maatee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When it is burnt, it mixes with dust. ||1||Pause||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਬੰਧ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee ba(n)dh kuta(n)b saheraa ||
english: Even relatives, family and friends begin to say,

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਭੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਾਢੁ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: oi bhee laage kaadh saveraa ||2||
english: "Take his body out, immediately!" ||2||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਉਰਹਿ ਤਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: ghar kee naar urahi tan laagee ||
english: And the wife of his house, who was so attached to his body and heart,

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਉਹ ਤਉ ਭੂਤੁ ਭੂਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: uh tau bhoot bhoot kar bhaagee ||3||
english: runs away, crying out, "Ghost! Ghost!" ||3||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਭੈ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas sabhai jag lootiaa ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, the whole world has been plundered,

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿ ਛੂਟਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: ham tau ek raam kahi chhootiaa ||4||3||
english: but I have escaped, chanting the Name of the One Lord. ||4||3||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: Raag Soohee, The Word Of Shaykh Fareed Jee:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag soohee baanee sekh phareed jee kee ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਤਪਿ ਤਪਿ ਲੁਹਿ ਲੁਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਮਰੋਰਉ ॥
transliteration: tap tap luhi luhi haath marorau ||
english: Burning and burning, writhing in pain, I wring my hands.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਲਿ ਹੋਈ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਲੋਰਉ ॥
transliteration: baaval hoee so sahu lorau ||
english: I have gone insane, seeking my Husband Lord.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
transliteration: tai sahi man mahi keeaa ros ||
english: O my Husband Lord, You are angry with me in Your Mind.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਮੁਝੁ ਅਵਗਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੋਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mujh avagan sah naahee dos ||1||
english: The fault is with me, and not with my Husband Lord. ||1||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: tai saahib kee mai saar na jaanee ||
english: O my Lord and Master, I do not know Your excellence and worth.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਖੋਇ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: joban khoi paachhai pachhutaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Having wasted my youth, now I come to regret and repent. ||1||Pause||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੀ ਕੋਇਲ ਤੂ ਕਿਤ ਗੁਨ ਕਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: kaalee koil too kit gun kaalee ||
english: O black bird, what qualities have made you black?

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਬਿਰਹੈ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: apane preetam ke hau birahai jaalee ||
english: "I have been burnt by separation from my Beloved."

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pirahi bihoon katahi sukh paae ||
english: Without her Husband Lord, how can the soul-bride ever find peace?

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa hoi kripaal taa prabhoo milaae ||2||
english: When He becomes merciful, then God unites us with Himself. ||2||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਵਿਧਣ ਖੂਹੀ ਮੁੰਧ ਇਕੇਲੀ ॥
transliteration: vidhan khoohee mu(n)dh ikelee ||
english: The lonely soul-bride suffers in the pit of the world.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ॥
transliteration: naa ko saathee naa ko belee ||
english: She has no companions, and no friends.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੀ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh saadhasa(n)g melee ||
english: In His Mercy, God has united me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਲਹੁ ਬੇਲੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa phir dekhaa taa meraa alahu belee ||3||
english: And when I look again, then I find God as my Helper. ||3||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਵਾਟ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਖਰੀ ਉਡੀਣੀ ॥
transliteration: vaat hamaaree kharee udeenee ||
english: The path upon which I must walk is very depressing.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਖੰਨਿਅਹੁ ਤਿਖੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)niahu tikhee bahut pieenee ||
english: It is sharper than a two-edged sword, and very narrow.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਉਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਹੈ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: us oopar hai maarag meraa ||
english: That is where my path lies.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: sekh phareedaa pa(n)th samhaar saveraa ||4||1||
english: O Shaykh Fareed, think of that path early on. ||4||1||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਲਲਿਤ ॥
transliteration: soohee lalit ||
english: Soohee, Lalit:

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਬੇੜਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਨ ਸਕਿਓ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੀ ਵੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: beRaa ba(n)dh na sakio ba(n)dhan kee velaa ||
english: You were not able to make yourself a raft when you should have.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਭਰਿ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਜਬ ਊਛਲੈ ਤਬ ਤਰਣੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhar saravar jab oochhalai tab taran duhelaa ||1||
english: When the ocean is churning and over-flowing, then it is very difficult to cross over it. ||1||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਹਥੁ ਨ ਲਾਇ ਕਸੁੰਭੜੈ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਢੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hath na laai kasu(n)bhaRai jal jaasee dholaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Do not touch the safflower with your hands; its color will fade away, my dear. ||1||Pause||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਪਤਲੀ ਸਹ ਕੇਰੇ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ik aapeenhai patalee sah kere bolaa ||
english: First, the bride herself is weak, and then, her Husband Lord's Order is hard to bear.

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਦੁਧਾ ਥਣੀ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dudhaa thanee na aavaee phir hoi na melaa ||2||
english: Milk does not return to the breast; it will not be collected again. ||2||

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਫਰੀਦੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਹੁ ਅਲਾਏਸੀ ॥
transliteration: kahai phareed saheleeho sahu alaaesee ||
english: Says Fareed, O my companions, when our Husband Lord calls,

author: Sheikh Farid
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਸੀ ਡੁੰਮਣਾ ਅਹਿ ਤਨੁ ਢੇਰੀ ਥੀਸੀ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: ha(n)s chalasee du(n)manaa ahi tan dheree theesee ||3||2||
english: the soul departs, sad at heart, and this body returns to dust. ||3||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 1 chaupade ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਹਉ ਮੀਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: too sulataan kahaa hau meeaa teree kavan vadaaee ||
english: You are the Emperor, and I call You a chief - how does this add to Your greatness?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo too dehi s kahaa suaamee mai moorakh kahan na jaaee ||1||
english: As You permit me, I praise You, O Lord and Master; I am ignorant, and I cannot chant Your Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tere gun gaavaa dehi bujhaaee ||
english: Please bless me with such understanding, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਉ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaise sach mahi rahau rajaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: May I dwell in Truth, according to Your Will. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਅਸਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh hoaa sabh kichh tujh te teree sabh asanaaee ||
english: Whatever has happened, has all come from You. You are All-knowing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: teraa a(n)t na jaanaa mere saahib mai a(n)dhule kiaa chaturaaee ||2||
english: Your limits cannot be known, O my Lord and Master; I am blind - what wisdom do I have? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਕਥੀ ਕਥੇ ਕਥਿ ਦੇਖਾ ਮੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਨ ਕਥਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa hau kathee kathe kath dekhaa mai akath na kathanaa jaaee ||
english: What should I say? While talking, I talk of seeing, but I cannot describe the indescribable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਆਖਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai soee aakhaa til teree vadiaaee ||3||
english: As it pleases Your Will, I speak; it is just the tiniest bit of Your greatness. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਕੂਕਰ ਹਉ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ਭਉਕਾ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ete kookar hau begaanaa bhaukaa is tan taaee ||
english: Among so many dogs, I am an outcast; I bark for my body's belly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੇ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: bhagat heen naanak je hoigaa taa khasamai naau na jaaee ||4||1||
english: Without devotional worship, O Nanak, even so, still, my Master's Name does not leave me. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 ||
english: Bilaawal, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਨੁ ਵੇਸ ਕਲੰਦਰੁ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: man ma(n)dar tan ves kala(n)dar ghat hee teerath naavaa ||
english: My mind is the temple, and my body is the simple cloth of the humble seeker; deep within my heart, I bathe at the sacred shrine.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek sabad merai praan basat hai baahuR janam na aavaa ||1||
english: The One Word of the Shabad abides within my mind; I shall not come to be born again. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man bedhiaa daiaal setee meree maaee ||
english: My mind is pierced through by the Merciful Lord, O my mother!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaun jaanai peer paraaee ||
english: Who can know the pain of another?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham naahee chi(n)t paraaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I think of none other than the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar alakh apaaraa chi(n)taa karahu hamaaree ||
english: O Lord, inaccessible, unfathomable, invisible and infinite: please, take care of me!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal bharipur leenaa ghat ghat jot tumhaaree ||2||
english: In the water, on the land and in sky, You are totally pervading. Your Light is in each and every heart. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਮਤਿ ਸਭ ਬੁਧਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਮੰਦਿਰ ਛਾਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sikh mat sabh budh tumhaaree ma(n)dir chhaavaa tere ||
english: All teachings, instructions and understandings are Yours; the mansions and sanctuaries are Yours as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tujh bin avar na jaanaa mere saahibaa gun gaavaa nit tere ||3||
english: Without You, I know no other, O my Lord and Master; I continually sing Your Glorious Praises. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਚਿੰਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh saran tumhaaree sarab chi(n)t tudh paase ||
english: All beings and creatures seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary; all thought of their care rests with You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਚੰਗਾ ਇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai soee cha(n)gaa ik naanak kee aradaase ||4||2||
english: That which pleases Your Will is good; this alone is Nanak's prayer. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 ||
english: Bilaawal, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਆਪੇ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aape sabad aape neesaan ||
english: He Himself is the Word of the Shabad, and He Himself is the Insignia.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aape surataa aape jaan ||
english: He Himself is the Listener, and He Himself is the Knower.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aape kar kar vekhai taan ||
english: He Himself created the creation, and He Himself beholds His almighty power.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too daataa naam paravaan ||1||
english: You are the Great Giver; Your Name alone is approved. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥
transliteration: aisaa naam nira(n)jan deu ||
english: Such is the Name of the Immaculate, Divine Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਤੂ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau jaachik too alakh abheu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am just a beggar; You are invisible and unknowable. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਧਰਕਟੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu dharakatee naar ||
english: Love of Maya is like a cursed woman,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂੰਡੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਾਮਣਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhoo(n)dee kaaman kaamaniaar ||
english: Ugly, dirty and promiscuous.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: raaj roop jhoothaa din chaar ||
english: Power and beauty are false, and last for only a few days.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam milai chaanan a(n)dhiaar ||2||
english: But when one is blessed with the Naam, the darkness within is illuminated. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਖਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: chakh chhodee sahasaa nahee koi ||
english: I tasted Maya and renounced it, and now, I have no doubts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਪੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਵੇਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: baap disai vejaat na hoi ||
english: One whose father is known, cannot be illegitimate.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: eke kau naahee bhau koi ||
english: One who belongs to the One Lord, has no fear.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karataa kare karaavai soi ||3||
english: The Creator acts, and causes all to act. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮੁਏ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabad mue man man te maariaa ||
english: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad conquers his mind, through his mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: thaak rahe man saachai dhaariaa ||
english: Keeping his mind restrained, he enshrines the True Lord within his heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: avar na soojhai gur kau vaariaa ||
english: He does not know any other, and he is a sacrifice to the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate nisataariaa ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, he is emancipated. ||4||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 ||
english: Bilaaval, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨੇ ॥
transliteration: gur bachanee man sahaj dhiaane ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, the mind intuitively meditates on the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: har kai ra(n)g rataa man maane ||
english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, the mind is satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਬਉਰਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bharam bhule bauraane ||
english: The insane, self-willed manmukhs wander around, deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har bin kiu raheeai gur sabad pachhaane ||1||
english: Without the Lord, how can anyone survive? Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਵਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin darasan kaise jeevau meree maaee ||
english: Without the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, how can I live, O my mother?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bin jeearaa rahi na sakai khin satigur boojh bujhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive, even for an instant; the True Guru has helped me understand this. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਹਉ ਮਰਉ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh bisarai hau marau dukhaalee ||
english: Forgetting my God, I die in pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਜਪਉ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: saas giraas japau apune har bhaalee ||
english: With each breath and morsel of food, I meditate on my Lord, and seek Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: sad bairaagan har naam nihaalee ||
english: I remain always detached, but I am enraptured with the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਜਾਨੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ab jaane guramukh har naalee ||2||
english: Now, as Gurmukh, I know that the Lord is always with me. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: akath kathaa kaheeai gur bhaai ||
english: The Unspoken Speech is spoken, by the Will of the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh agam agochar dei dikhaai ||
english: He shows us that God is unapproachable and unfathomable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur karanee kiaa kaar kamaai ||
english: Without the Guru, what lifestyle could we practice, and what work could we do?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਚਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: haumai met chalai gur sabad samaai ||3||
english: Eradicating egotism, and walking in harmony with the Guru's Will, I am absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh vichhuRai khotee raas ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are separated from the Lord, gathering false wealth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam milai saabaas ||
english: The Gurmukhs are celebrated with the glory of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: har kirapaa dhaaree daasan daas ||
english: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon me, and made me the slave of His slaves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak har naam dhan raas ||4||4||
english: The Name of the Lord is the wealth and capital of servant Nanak. ||4||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
english: Bilaaval, Third Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhrig dhrig khaaiaa dhrig dhrig soiaa dhrig dhrig kaapaR a(n)g chaRaaiaa ||
english: Cursed, cursed is the food; cursed, cursed is the sleep; cursed, cursed are the clothes worn on the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੁਣਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhrig sareer kuta(n)b sahit siu jit hun khasam na paaiaa ||
english: Cursed is the body, along with family and friends, when one does not find his Lord and Master in this life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pauRee chhuRakee phir haath na aavai ahilaa janam gavaaiaa ||1||
english: He misses the step of the ladder, and this opportunity will not come into his hands again; his life is wasted, uselessly. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਣਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: doojaa bhaau na deee liv laagan jin har ke charan visaare ||
english: The love of duality does not allow him to lovingly focus his attention on the Lord; he forgets the Feet of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਤੈ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan daataa jan sevak tere tin ke tai dookh nivaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Life of the World, O Great Giver, you eradicate the sorrows of your humble servants. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: too daiaal daiaapat daataa kiaa ehi ja(n)t vichaare ||
english: You are Merciful, O Great Giver of Mercy; what are these poor beings?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤ ਬੰਧ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਐਸਾ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: mukat ba(n)dh sabh tujh te hoe aisaa aakh vakhaane ||
english: All are liberated or placed into bondage by You; this is all one can say.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੰਧ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai so mukat kaheeai manamukh ba(n)dh vichaare ||2||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh is said to be liberated, while the poor self-willed manmukhs are in bondage. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: so jan mukat jis ek liv laagee sadaa rahai har naale ||
english: He alone is liberated, who lovingly focuses his attention on the One Lord, always dwelling with the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tin kee gahan gat kahee na jaaee sachai aap savaare ||
english: His depth and condition cannot be described. The True Lord Himself embellishes him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੇ ਸਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bharam bhulaane s manamukh kaheeahi naa uravaar na paare ||3||
english: Those who wander around, deluded by doubt, are called manmukhs; they are neither on this side, nor on the other side. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jis no nadar kare soee jan paae gur kaa sabad samhaale ||
english: That humble being, who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace obtains Him, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har jan maaiaa maahi nisataare ||
english: In the midst of Maya, the Lord's servant is emancipated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਾਲਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bhaag hovai jis masatak kaalahi maar bidaare ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, one who has such destiny inscribed upon his forehead, conquers and destroys death. ||4||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਤੁਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤੋਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: atul kiu toliaa jaai ||
english: How can the unweighable be weighed?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doojaa hoi ta sojhee paai ||
english: If there is anyone else as great, then he alone could understand the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis te doojaa naahee koi ||
english: There is no other than Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਕੂ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis dee keemat kikoo hoi ||1||
english: How can His value be estimated? ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad vasai man aai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taa ko jaanai dubidhaa jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One comes to know Him, when duality departs. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aap saraaph kasavatee laae ||
english: He Himself is the Assayer, applying the touch-stone to test it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape parakhe aap chalaae ||
english: He Himself analyzes the coin, and He Himself approves it as currency.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape tole pooraa hoi ||
english: He Himself weights it perfectly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape jaanai eko soi ||2||
english: He alone knows; He is the One and Only Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa kaa roop sabh tis te hoi ||
english: All the forms of Maya emanate from Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis no mele s niramal hoi ||
english: He alone becomes pure and immaculate, who is united with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਲਗੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jis no laae lagai tis aai ||
english: He alone is attached, whom the Lord attaches.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh sach dikhaale taa sach samaai ||3||
english: All Truth is revealed to him, and then, he merges in the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲਿਵ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aape liv dhaat hai aape ||
english: He Himself leads the mortals to focus on Him, and He Himself causes them to chase after Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aap bujhaae aape jaape ||
english: He Himself imparts understanding, and He reveals Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aape satigur sabad hai aape ||
english: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak aakh sunaae aape ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, He Himself speaks and teaches. ||4||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬਹਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: saahib te sevak sev saahib te kiaa ko kahai bahaanaa ||
english: My Lord and Master has made me His servant, and blessed me with His service; how can anyone argue about this?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਇਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਬਨਿਆ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aisaa ik teraa khel baniaa hai sabh mahi ek samaanaa ||1||
english: Such is Your play, One and Only Lord; You are the One, contained among all. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur parachai har naam samaanaa ||
english: When the True Guru is pleased and appeased, one is absorbed in the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis karam hovai so satigur paae anadin laagai sahaj dhiaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy, finds the True Guru; night and day, he automatically remains focused on the Lord's meditation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kiaa koee teree sevaa kare kiaa ko kare abhimaanaa ||
english: How can I serve You? How can I be proud of this?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਖਿੰਚਹਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਬ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਉ ਦਿਖਾ ਵਖਿਆਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jab apunee jot khi(n)chahi too suaamee tab koee karau dikhaa vakhiaanaa ||2||
english: When You withdraw Your Light, O Lord and Master, then who can speak and teach? ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aape gur chelaa hai aape aape gunee nidhaanaa ||
english: You Yourself are the Guru, and You Yourself are the chaylaa, the humble disciple; You Yourself are the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਚਾਲੈ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu aap chalaae tivai koee chaalai jiu har bhaavai bhagavaanaa ||3||
english: As You cause us to move, so do we move, according to the Pleasure of Your Will, O Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੂ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਾਮਾਂ ॥
transliteration: kahat naanak too saachaa saahib kaun jaanai tere kaamaa(n) ||
english: Says Nanak, You are the True Lord and Master; who can know Your actions?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: ikanaa ghar mahi de vadiaaee ik bharam bhavahi abhimaanaa ||4||3||
english: Some are blessed with glory in their own homes, while others wander in doubt and pride. ||4||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: pooraa thaat banaaiaa poorai vekhahu ek samaanaa ||
english: The perfect Lord has fashioned the Perfect Creation. Behold the Lord pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮਤੁ ਕੋ ਧਰਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: is parapa(n)ch mahi saache naam kee vadiaaee mat ko dharahu gumaanaa ||1||
english: In this play of the world, is the glorious greatness of the True Name. No one should take pride in himself. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee jis no mat aavai so satigur maahi samaanaa ||
english: One who accepts the wisdom of the True Guru's Teachings, is absorbed into the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ih baanee jo jeeahu jaanai tis a(n)tar ravai har naamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord's Name abides deep within the nucleus of one who realizes the Bani of the Guru's Word within his soul. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਣਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਨਰ ਮਨੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: chahu jugaa kaa hun nibeRaa nar manukhaa no ek nidhaanaa ||
english: Now, this is the essence of the teachings of the four ages: for the human race, the Name of the One Lord is the greatest treasure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਤੀਰਥ ਓਨਾ ਜੁਗਾ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jat sa(n)jam teerath onaa jugaa kaa dharam hai kal mahi keerat har naamaa ||2||
english: Celibacy, self-discipline and pilgrimages were the essence of Dharma in those past ages; but in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Praise of the Lord's Name is the essence of Dharma. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jug jug aapo aapanaa dharam hai sodh dekhahu bed puraanaa ||
english: Each and every age has its own essence of Dharma; study the Vedas and the Puraanas, and see this as true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਿ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh jinee dhiaaiaa har har jag te poore paravaanaa ||3||
english: They are Gurmukh, who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; in this world, they are perfect and approved. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਏ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kahat naanak sache siu preet laae chookai man abhimaanaa ||
english: Says Nanak, loving the True Lord, the mind's egotism and self-conceit is eradicated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਸਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨਤ ਪਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: kahat sunat sabhe sukh paavahi maanat paahi nidhaanaa ||4||4||
english: Those who speak and listen to the Lord's Name, all find peace. Those who believe in it, obtain the supreme treasure. ||4||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh preet jis no aape laae ||
english: The Lord Himself attaches the Gurmukh to His Love;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tit ghar bilaaval gur sabad suhaae ||
english: joyful melodies permeate his home, and he is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਲੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)gal naaree gaavahi aae ||
english: The women come and sing the songs of joy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mil preetam sadaa sukh paae ||1||
english: Meeting with their Beloved, lasting peace is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hau tin balihaarai jinh har ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those, whose minds are filled with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jan kau miliaa sukh paaeeai har gun gaavai sahaj subhaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting with the humble servant of the Lord, peace is obtained, and one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ra(n)g raate terai chaae ||
english: They are always imbued with Your Joyful Love;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu aap vasai man aae ||
english: O Dear Lord, You Yourself come to dwell in their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape sobhaa sad hee paae ||
english: They obtain eternal glory.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh melai mel milaae ||2||
english: The Gurmukhs are united in the Lord's Union. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh raate sabad ra(n)gaae ||
english: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the love of the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa har gun gaae ||
english: They abide in the home of their own being, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g chaloolai har ras bhaae ||
english: They are dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love; they look so beautiful.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ihu ra(n)g kade na utarai saach samaae ||3||
english: This dye never fades away; they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar sabad mitiaa agiaan a(n)dheraa ||
english: The Shabad deep within the nucleus of the self dispels the darkness of ignorance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur giaan miliaa preetam meraa ||
english: Meeting with my Friend, the True Guru, I have obtained spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jo sach raate tin bahuR na pheraa ||
english: Those who are attuned to the True Lord, do not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam driRaae pooraa gur meraa ||4||5||
english: O Nanak, my Perfect Guru implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, deep within. ||4||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: poore gur te vadiaaee paaee ||
english: From the Perfect Guru, I have obtained glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: achi(n)t naam vasiaa man aaee ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, has spontaneously come to abide in my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: haumai maaiaa sabad jalaaee ||
english: Through the Word of the Shabad, I have burnt away egotism and Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dar saachai gur te sobhaa paaee ||1||
english: Through the Guru, I have obtained honor in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਦੀਸ ਸੇਵਉ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: jagadees sevau mai avar na kaajaa ||
english: I serve the Lord of the Universe; I have no other work to do.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anadin anad hovai man merai guramukh maagau teraa naam nivaajaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Night and day, my mind is in ecstasy; as Gurmukh, I beg for the bliss-giving Naam. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man kee parateet man te paaee ||
english: From the mind itself, mental faith is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: poore gur te sabad bujhaaee ||
english: Through the Guru, I have realized the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਣ ਮਰਣੁ ਕੋ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: jeevan maran ko samasar vekhai ||
english: How rare is that person, who looks upon life and death alike.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਜਮੁ ਪੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bahuR na marai naa jam pekhai ||2||
english: She shall never die again, and shall not have to see the Messenger of Death. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਕੋਟ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: ghar hee mahi sabh kot nidhaan ||
english: Within the home of the self are all the millions of treasures.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਗਇਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur dikhaae gaiaa abhimaan ||
english: The True Guru has revealed them, and my egotistical pride is gone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: sad hee laagaa sahaj dhiaan ||
english: I keep my meditation always focused on the Cosmic Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anadin gaavai eko naam ||3||
english: Night and day, I sing the One Name. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: is jug mahi vadiaaee paaee ||
english: I have obtained glorious greatness in this age,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: poore gur te naam dhiaaee ||
english: from the Perfect Guru, meditating on the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah rahiaa samaaee ||
english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord permeating and pervading.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sadaa sukhadaataa keemat nahee paaee ||4||
english: He is forever the Giver of peace; His worth cannot be estimated. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag gur pooraa paaiaa ||
english: By perfect destiny, I have found the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar naam nidhaan dikhaaiaa ||
english: He has revealed to me the treasure of the Naam, deep within the nucleus of my self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad at meethaa laaiaa ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is so very sweet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੬॥੪॥੬॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak trisan bujhee man tan sukh paaiaa ||5||6||4||6||10||
english: O Nanak, my thirst is quenched, and my mind and body have found peace. ||5||6||4||6||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 4 ghar 3 ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮ ਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਰੇ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: udam mat prabh a(n)tarajaamee jiu prere tiu karanaa ||
english: Effort and intelligence come from God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; as He wills, they act.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਨਟੂਆ ਤੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਤੰਤੀ ਤਿਉ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu natooaa ta(n)t vajaae ta(n)tee tiu vaajahi ja(n)t janaa ||1||
english: As the violinist plays upon the strings of the violin, so does the Lord play the living beings. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jap man raam naam rasanaa ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord with your tongue, O mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: masatak likhat likhe gur paaiaa har hiradai har basanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: According to the pre-ordained destiny written upon my forehead, I have found the Guru, and the Lord abides within my heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਗਿਰਸਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਜਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa girasat bhramat hai praanee rakh levahu jan apanaa ||
english: Entangled in Maya, the mortal wanders around. Save Your humble servant, O Lord,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਹਰਣਾਖਸਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu prahilaad haranaakhas grasio har raakhio har saranaa ||2||
english: as you saved Prahlaad from the clutches of Harnaakash; keep him in Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kavan kavan kee gat mit kaheeai har keee patit pava(n)naa ||
english: How can I describe the state and the condition, O Lord, of those many sinners you have purified?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਢੋਵੈ ਢੋਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਚਮੁ ਚਮਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ohu dhovai dhor haath cham chamare har udhario pario saranaa ||3||
english: Ravi Daas, the leather-worker, who worked with hides and carried dead animals was saved, by entering the Lord's Sanctuary. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਗਤ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਨ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਪਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh deen daiaal bhagat bhav taaran ham paapee raakh papanaa ||
english: O God, Merciful to the meek, carry Your devotees across the world-ocean; I am a sinner - save me from sin!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਹਮ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੰਨਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: har daasan daas daas ham kareeahu jan naanak daas daasa(n)naa ||4||1||
english: O Lord, make me the slave of the slave of Your slaves; servant Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਜਨਮਾ ॥
transliteration: ham moorakh mugadh agiaan matee saranaagat purakh ajanamaa ||
english: I am foolish, idiotic and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary, O Primal Being, O Lord beyond birth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਹੀਨ ਅਕਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa rakh levahu mere thaakur ham paathar heen akaramaa ||1||
english: Have Mercy upon me, and save me, O my Lord and Master; I am a lowly stone, with no good karma at all. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man bhaj raam naamai raamaa ||
english: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Lord, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramat har ras paaeeai hor tiaagahu nihaphal kaamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Under Guru's Instructions, obtain the sublime, subtle essence of the Lord; renounce other fruitless actions. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਰਾਖੁ ਉਪਮਾ ॥
transliteration: har jan sevak se har taare ham niragun raakh upamaa ||
english: The humble servants of the Lord are saved by the Lord; I am worthless - it is Your glory to save me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਵਡੇ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tujh bin avar na koee mere thaakur har japeeai vade kara(n)maa ||2||
english: I have no other than You, O my Lord and Master; I meditate on the Lord, by my good karma. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਵਡ ਦੂਖ ਸਹੰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: naamaheen dhrig jeevate tin vad dookh saha(n)maa ||
english: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, their lives are cursed, and they must endure terrible pain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀ ਮੂੜ ਅਕਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: oi phir phir jon bhavaaeeahi ma(n)dabhaagee mooR akaramaa ||3||
english: They are consigned to reincarnation over and over again; they are the most unfortunate fools, with no good karma at all. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਵਡ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: har jan naam adhaar hai dhur poorab likhe vad karamaa ||
english: The Naam is the Support of the Lord's humble servants; their good karma is pre-ordained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨੰਮਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: gur satigur naam driRaaiaa jan naanak saphal jana(n)maa ||4||2||
english: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam within servant Nanak, and his life is fruitful. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲੁਭਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hamaraa chit lubhat mohi bikhiaa bahu duramat mail bharaa ||
english: My consciousness is lured by emotional attachment and corruption; is is filled with evil-minded filth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਨ ਸਕਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਤਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tumhree sevaa kar na sakah prabh ham kiu kar mugadh taraa ||1||
english: I cannot serve You, O God; I am ignorant - how can I cross over? ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਨਰਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man jap narahar naam naraharaa ||
english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord, the Lord of man.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jan oopar kirapaa prabh dhaaree mil satigur paar paraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God has showered His Mercy upon His humble servant; meeting with the True Guru, he is carried across. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hamare pitaa thaakur prabh suaamee har dehu matee jas karaa ||
english: O my Father, my Lord and Master, Lord God, please bless me with such understanding, that I may sing Your Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹ ਤਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tumhrai sa(n)g lage se udhare jiu sa(n)g kaasat loh taraa ||2||
english: Those who are attached to You are saved, like iron which is carried across with wood. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਹੋਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਮਧਿਮ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saakat nar hochhee mat madhim jinh har har sev na karaa ||
english: The faithless cynics have little or no understanding; they do not serve the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਦੁਹਚਾਰੀ ਓਇ ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: te nar bhaagaheen duhachaaree oi janam mue phir maraa ||3||
english: Those beings are unfortunate and vicious; they die, and are consigned to reincarnation, over and over again. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇ ਨੑਾਏ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jin kau tumh har melahu suaamee te nhaae sa(n)tokh gur saraa ||
english: Those whom You unite with Yourself, O Lord and Master, bathe in the Guru's cleansing pool of contentment.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: duramat mail gaee har bhajiaa jan naanak paar paraa ||4||3||
english: Vibrating upon the Lord, the filth of their evil-mindedness is washed away; servant Nanak is carried across. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aavahu sa(n)t milahu mere bhaaee mil har har kathaa karahu ||
english: Come, O Saints, and join together, O my Siblings of Destiny; let us tell the Stories of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਹੈ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har naam bohith hai kalajug khevat gur sabad tarahu ||1||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the boat in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the boatman to ferry us across. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: mere man har gun har ucharahu ||
english: O my mind, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: masatak likhat likhe gun gaae mil sa(n)gat paar parahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: According to the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon your forehead, sing the Praises of the Lord; join the Holy Congregation, and cross over the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa nagar mahi raam ras ootam kiu paaeeai upades jan karahu ||
english: Within the body-village is the Lord's supreme, sublime essence. How can I obtain it? Teach me, O humble Saints.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਅਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur sev saphal har darasan mil a(n)mrit har ras peeahu ||2||
english: Serving the True Guru, you shall obtain the Fruitful Vision of the Lord's Darshan; meeting Him, drink in the ambrosial essence of the Lord's Nectar. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਦਿਖਹੁ ॥
transliteration: har har naam a(n)mrit har meethaa har sa(n)tahu chaakh dikhahu ||
english: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is so sweet; O Saints of the Lord, taste it, and see.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਨ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਖ ਰਸਹੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramat har ras meethaa laagaa tin bisare sabh bikh rasahu ||3||
english: Under Guru's Instruction, the Lord's essence seems so sweet; through it, all corrupt sensual pleasures are forgotten. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ॥
transliteration: raam naam ras raam rasaain har sevahu sa(n)t janahu ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the medicine to cure all diseases; so serve the Lord, O humble Saints.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਚਾਰੇ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: chaar padaarath chaare paae guramat naanak har bhajahu ||4||4||
english: The four great blessings are obtained, O Nanak, by vibrating upon the Lord, under Guru's Instruction. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਪੈਨੀ ॥
transliteration: khatree braahaman sood vais ko jaapai har ma(n)tr japainee ||
english: Anyone, from any class - Kh'shaatriya, Brahman, Soodra or Vaishya - can chant, and meditate on the Mantra of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਭ ਰੈਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur satigur paarabraham kar poojahu nit sevahu dinas sabh rainee ||1||
english: Worship the Guru, the True Guru, as the Supreme Lord God; serve Him constantly, all day and night. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨੈਨੀ ॥
transliteration: har jan dekhahu satigur nainee ||
english: O humble servants of the Lord, behold the True Guru with your eyes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੈਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo ichhahu soee phal paavahu har bolahu guramat bainee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever you wish for, you shall receive, chanting the Word of the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instruction. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਚਿਤਵੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਬਾਤ ਹੋਵੈਨੀ ॥
transliteration: anik upaav chitaveeahi bahutere saa hovai j baat hovainee ||
english: People think of many and various efforts, but that alone happens, which is to happen.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਛੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਚਿਤੈਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: apanaa bhalaa sabh koee baachhai so kare j merai chit na chitainee ||2||
english: All beings seek goodness for themselves, but what the Lord does - that may not be what we think and expect. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਏਹਾ ਬਾਤ ਕਠੈਨੀ ॥
transliteration: man kee mat tiaagahu har jan ehaa baat kathainee ||
english: So renounce the clever intellect of your mind, O humble servants of the Lord, no matter how hard this may be.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੈਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anadin har har naam dhiaavahu gur satigur kee mat lainee ||3||
english: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; accept the wisdom of the Guru, the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜੰਤੈਨੀ ॥
transliteration: mat sumat terai vas suaamee ham ja(n)t too purakh ja(n)tainee ||
english: Wisdom, balanced wisdom is in Your power, O Lord and Master; I am the instrument, and You are the player, O Primal Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬੁਲੈਨੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak ke prabh karate suaamee jiu bhaavai tivai bulainee ||4||5||
english: O God, O Creator, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, as You wish, so do I speak. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦ ਅਨੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: anad mool dhiaaio purakhotam anadin anad ana(n)de ||
english: I meditate on the source of bliss, the Sublime Primal Being; night and day, I am in ecstasy and bliss.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਚੂਕੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਛੰਦੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dharam raai kee kaan chukaaee sabh chooke jam ke chha(n)de ||1||
english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma has no power over me; I have cast off all subservience to the Messenger of Death. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: jap man har har naam goubi(n)de ||
english: Meditate, O mind, on the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee gur satigur paaiaa gun gaae paramaana(n)de ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, the True Guru; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬਧਿਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: saakat mooR maaiaa ke badhik vich maaiaa phirahi phira(n)de ||
english: The foolish faithless cynics are held captive by Maya; in Maya, they continue wandering, wandering around.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਕਿਰਤ ਕੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਲੀ ਬਲਦ ਭਵੰਦੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: trisanaa jalat kirat ke baadhe jiu telee balad bhava(n)de ||2||
english: Burnt by desire, and bound by the karma of their past actions, they go round and round, like the ox at the mill press. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sev lage se udhare vadabhaagee sev kara(n)de ||
english: The Gurmukhs, who focus on serving the Guru, are saved; by great good fortune, they perform service.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਤੂਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੰਦੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin har japiaa tin phal paaiaa sabh toote maaiaa pha(n)de ||3||
english: Those who meditate on the Lord obtain the fruits of their rewards, and the bonds of Maya are all broken. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: aape thaakur aape sevak sabh aape aap govi(n)de ||
english: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the servant. The Lord of the Universe Himself is all by Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਹੰਦੇ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak aape aap sabh varatai jiu raakhai tivai raha(n)de ||4||6||
english: O servant Nanak, He Himself is All-pervading; as He keeps us, we remain. ||4||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੧੩ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 4 paRataal ghar 13 ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Partaal, Thirteenth House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਈਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੋ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਤਾਰਨੋ ॥
transliteration: bolahu bhaeeaa raam naam patit paavano || har sa(n)t bhagat taarano ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Name of the Lord, the Purifier of sinners. The Lord emancipates his Saints and devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰੇ ਰਹਿਆ ॥ ਜਲਿ ਥਲੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ॥ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bharipure rahiaa || jal thale raam naam || nit gaaeeai har dookh bisaarano ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere; The Name of the Lord is pervading the water and the land. So sing continuously of the Lord, the Dispeller of pain. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਹੈ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har keeaa hai saphal janam hamaaraa ||
english: The Lord has made my life fruitful and rewarding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har japiaa har dookh bisaaranahaaraa ||
english: I meditate on the Lord, the Dispeller of pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gur bhetiaa hai mukat daataa ||
english: I have met the Guru, the Giver of liberation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸਫਲ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har keeee hamaaree saphal jaataa ||
english: The Lord has made my life's journey fruitful and rewarding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਨੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)gatee gun gaavano ||1||
english: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: man raam naam kar aasaa ||
english: O mortal, place your hopes in the Name of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaau doojaa binas binaasaa ||
english: and your love of duality shall simply vanish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਆਸਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: vich aasaa hoi niraasee ||
english: One who, in hope, remains unattached to hope,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: so jan miliaa har paasee ||
english: such a humble being meets with his Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਨੋ ॥
transliteration: koee raam naam gun gaavano ||
english: And one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: jan naanak tis pag laavano ||2||1||7||4||6||7||17||
english: - servant Nanak falls at his feet. ||2||1||7||4||6||7||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮੋਹੁ ॥
transliteration: nadaree aavai tis siu mohu ||
english: He is attached to what he sees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kiu mileeai prabh abinaasee tohi ||
english: How can I meet You, O Imperishable God?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi maarag paavahu ||
english: Have Mercy upon me, and place me upon the Path;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kai a(n)chal laavahu ||1||
english: let me be attached to the hem of the robe of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kiu tareeai bikhiaa sa(n)saar ||
english: How can I cross over the poisonous world-ocean?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur bohith paavai paar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru is the boat to carry us across. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਵਨ ਝੁਲਾਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: pavan jhulaare maaiaa dei ||
english: The wind of Maya blows and shakes us,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੇਇ ॥
transliteration: har ke bhagat sadaa thir sei ||
english: but the Lord's devotees remain ever-stable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: harakh sog te rahahi niraaraa ||
english: They remain unaffected by pleasure and pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sir oopar aap guroo rakhavaaraa ||2||
english: The Guru Himself is the Savior above their heads. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਵੇੜੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਰਬ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: paaiaa veR maaiaa sarab bhuia(n)gaa ||
english: Maya, the snake, holds all in her coils.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚੇ ਦੀਪਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai pache deepak dekh pata(n)gaa ||
english: They burn to death in egotism, like the moth lured by seeing the flame.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sagal seegaar kare nahee paavai ||
english: They make all sorts of decorations, but they do not find the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa hoi kripaal taa guroo milaavai ||3||
english: When the Guru becomes Merciful, He leads them to meet the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਫਿਰਉ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਮੈ ਇਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਦਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hau phirau udaasee mai ik ratan dasaaiaa ||
english: I wander around, sad and depressed, seeking the jewel of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: niramolak heeraa milai na upaaiaa ||
english: This priceless jewel is not obtained by any efforts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: har kaa ma(n)dar tis mahi laal ||
english: That jewel is within the body, the Temple of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur kholiaa paRadaa dekh bhaee nihaal ||4||
english: The Guru has torn away the veil of illusion, and beholding the jewel, I am delighted. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jin chaakhiaa tis aaiaa saad ||
english: One who has tasted it, comes to know its flavor;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu goo(n)gaa man mahi bisamaad ||
english: he is like the mute, whose mind is filled with wonder.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aanad roop sabh nadaree aaiaa ||
english: I see the Lord, the source of bliss, everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak har gun aakh samaaiaa ||5||1||
english: Servant Nanak speaks the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and merges in Him. ||5||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਕੀਏ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sarab kaliaan keee guradev ||
english: The Divine Guru has blessed me with total happiness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਲਾਇਓ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sevak apanee laaio sev ||
english: He has linked His servant to His service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਪਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bighan na laagai jap alakh abhev ||1||
english: No obstacles block my path, meditating on the incomprehensible, inscrutable Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਈ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dharat puneet bhaee gun gaae ||
english: The soil has been sanctified, singing the Glories of His Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: durat gaiaa har naam dhiaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The sins are eradicated, meditating on the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਂਈ ਰਵਿਆ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: sabhanee thaa(n)ee raviaa aap ||
english: He Himself is pervading everywhere;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: aad jugaad jaa kaa vad parataap ||
english: from the very beginning, and throughout the ages, His Glory has been radiantly manifest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur parasaad na hoi sa(n)taap ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, sorrow does not touch me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਲਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠੇ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan lage man meethe ||
english: The Guru's Feet seem so sweet to my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਭ ਥਾਂਈ ਵੂਠੇ ॥
transliteration: nirabighan hoi sabh thaa(n)ee voothe ||
english: He is unobstructed, dwelling everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੂਠੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh sukh paae satigur toothe ||3||
english: I found total peace, when the Guru was pleased. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh bhae rakhavaale ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has become my Savior.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਕਿਥੈ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jithai kithai deesahi naale ||
english: Wherever I look, I see Him there with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਖਸਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak daas khasam pratipaale ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, the Lord and Master protects and cherishes His slaves. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sukh nidhaan preetam prabh mere ||
english: You are the treasure of peace, O my Beloved God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਤ ਗੁਣ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aganat gun thaakur prabh tere ||
english: Your Glories are uncounted, O God, my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mohi anaath tumaree saranaaee ||
english: I am an orphan, entering Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa har charan dhiaaee ||1||
english: Have Mercy on me, O Lord, that I may meditate on Your Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਸਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: daiaa karahu basahu man aai ||
english: Take pity upon me, and abide within my mind;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਲੀਜੈ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mohi niragun leejai laR laai || rahaau ||
english: I am worthless - please let me grasp hold of the hem of Your robe. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੀੜ ॥
transliteration: prabh chit aavai taa kaisee bheeR ||
english: When God comes into my consciousness, what misfortune can strike me?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਪੀੜ ॥
transliteration: har sevak naahee jam peeR ||
english: The Lord's servant does not suffer pain from the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਦੂਖ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਸੇ ॥
transliteration: sarab dookh har simarat nase ||
english: All pains are dispelled, when one remembers the Lord in meditation;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa kai sa(n)g sadaa prabh basai ||2||
english: God abides with him forever. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh kaa naam man tan aadhaar ||
english: The Name of God is the Support of my mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bisarat naam hovat tan chhaar ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the body is reduced to ashes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਕਾਜ ॥
transliteration: prabh chit aae pooran sabh kaaj ||
english: When God comes into my consciousness, all my affairs are resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
