gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸਭ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har bisarat sabh kaa muhataaj ||3||
english: Forgetting the Lord, one becomes subservient to all. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal sa(n)g laagee preet ||
english: I am in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bisar gaee sabh duramat reet ||
english: I am rid of all evil-minded ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ ॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar har har ma(n)t ||
english: The Mantra of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is deep within my mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak bhagatan kai ghar sadaa ana(n)d ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, eternal bliss fills the home of the Lord's devotees. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਯਾਨੜੀਏ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 ghar 2 yaanaReee kai ghar gaavanaa ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Second House, To Be Sung To The Tune Of Yaan-Ree-Ay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: mai man teree tek mere piaare mai man teree tek ||
english: You are the Support of my mind, O my Beloved, You are the Support of my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਬਿਰਥੀਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avar siaanapaa biratheeaa piaare raakhan kau tum ek ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All other clever tricks are useless, O Beloved; You alone are my Protector. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur pooraa je milai piaare so jan hot nihaalaa ||
english: One who meets with the Perfect True Guru, O Beloved, that humble person is enraptured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa so kare piaare jis no hoi daiaalaa ||
english: He alone serves the Guru, O Beloved, unto whom the Lord becomes merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saphal moorat guradeu suaamee sarab kalaa bharapoore ||
english: Fruitful is the form of the Divine Guru, O Lord and Master; He is overflowing with all powers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak gur paarabraham paramesar sadaa sadaa hajoore ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; He is ever-present, forever and ever. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੋਇ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sun sun jeevaa soi tinaa kee jinh apunaa prabh jaataa ||
english: I live by hearing, hearing of those who know their God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har naam araadhahi naam vakhaanahi har naame hee man raataa ||
english: They contemplate the Lord's Name, they chant the Lord's Name, and their minds are imbued with the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sevak jan kee sevaa maagai poorai karam kamaavaa ||
english: I am Your servant; I beg to serve Your humble servants. By the karma of perfect destiny, I do this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਣੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)tee suaamee tere jan dekhan paavaa ||2||
english: This is Nanak's prayer: O my Lord and Master, may I obtain the Blessed Vision of Your humble servants. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੇ ਕਾਢੀਅਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee se kaadheeahi piaare sa(n)tasa(n)gat jinaa vaaso ||
english: They are said to be very fortunate, O Beloved, who dwell in the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੋ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam araadheeai niramal manai hovai paragaaso ||
english: They contemplate the Immaculate, Ambrosial Naam, and their minds are illuminated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh kaateeai piaare chookai jam kee kaane ||
english: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, O Beloved, and the fear of the Messenger of Death is ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਣੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tinaa paraapat darasan naanak jo prabh apane bhaane ||3||
english: They alone obtain the Blessed Vision of this Darshan, O Nanak, who are pleasing to their God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ooch apaar bea(n)t suaamee kaun jaanai gun tere ||
english: O my lofty, incomparable and infinite Lord and Master, who can know Your Glorious Virtues?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਤੇ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਸੁਣਤੇ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavate udharahi sunate udharahi binasahi paap ghanere ||
english: Those who sing them are saved, and those who listen to them are saved; all their sins are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਉ ਤਾਰੇ ਪਾਹਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: pasoo paret mugadh kau taare paahan paar utaarai ||
english: You save the beasts, demons and fools, and even stones are carried across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaaee sadaa sadaa balihaarai ||4||1||4||
english: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; he is forever and ever a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਰੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਓ ॥
transliteration: bikhai ban pheekaa tiaag ree sakheee naam mahaa ras peeo ||
english: Renounce the tasteless water of corruption, O my companion, and drink in the supreme nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਚਾਖੇ ਬੁਡਿ ਗਈ ਸਗਲੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਜੀਓ ॥
transliteration: bin ras chaakhe bud gaee sagalee sukhee na hovat jeeo ||
english: Without the taste of this nectar, all have drowned, and their souls have not found happiness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਨ ਸਕਤਿ ਹੀ ਕਾਈ ਸਾਧਾ ਦਾਸੀ ਥੀਓ ॥
transliteration: maan mahat na sakat hee kaaee saadhaa daasee theeo ||
english: You have no honor, glory or power - become the slave of the Holy Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕੀਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak se dar sobhaava(n)te jo prabh apunai keeo ||1||
english: O Nanak, they alone look beautiful in the Court of the Lord, whom the Lord has made His Own. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਚਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haricha(n)dauree chit bhram sakheee mrig trisanaa drum chhaaiaa ||
english: Maya is a mirage, which deludes the mind, O my companion, like the scent-crazed deer, or the transitory shade of a tree.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਤੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਵਤ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)chal sa(n)g na chaalatee sakheee a(n)t taj jaavat maaiaa ||
english: Maya is fickle, and does not go with you, O my companion; in the end, it will leave you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗਣ ਅਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਇਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ras bhogan at roop ras maate in sa(n)g sookh na paaiaa ||
english: He may enjoy pleasures and sensual delights with supremely beautiful women, but no one finds peace in this way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸਖੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n har saadh jan sakheee naanak jinee naam dhiaaiaa ||2||
english: Blessed, blessed are the humble, Holy Saints of the Lord, O my companion. O Nanak, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਬਸਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਣੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jaai basahu vadabhaaganee sakheee sa(n)taa sa(n)g samaaeeai ||
english: Go, O my very fortunate companion: dwell in the Company of the Saints, and merge with the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: tah dookh na bhookh na rog biaapai charan kamal liv laaeeai ||
english: There, neither pain nor hunger nor disease will afflict you; enshrine love for the Lord's Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: tah janam na maran na aavan jaanaa nihachal saranee paaeeai ||
english: There is no birth or death there, no coming or going in reincarnation, when you enter the Sanctuary of the Eternal Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: prem bichhohu na mohu biaapai naanak har ek dhiaaeeai ||3||
english: Love does not end, and attachment does not grip you, O Nanak, when you meditate on the One Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਤੜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: drisat dhaar man bedhiaa piaare rataRe sahaj subhaae ||
english: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, my Beloved has pierced my mind, and I am intuitively attuned to His Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sej suhaavee sa(n)g mil preetam anad ma(n)gal gun gaae ||
english: My bed is embellished, meeting with my Beloved; in ecstasy and bliss, I sing His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sakhee sahelee raam ra(n)g raatee man tan ichh pujaae ||
english: O my friends and companions, I am imbued with the Lord's Love; the desires of my mind and body are satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਅਚਰਜ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak acharaj acharaj siu miliaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaae ||4||2||5||
english: O Nanak, the wonder-struck soul blends with the Wonderful Lord; this state cannot be described. ||4||2||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 ghar 4 ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਸਗਲੋ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ek roop sagalo paasaaraa ||
english: The entire Universe is the form of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਨਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape banaj aap biuhaaraa ||1||
english: He Himself is the trade, and He Himself is the trader. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਈ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aiso giaan biralo ee paae ||
english: How rare is that one who is blessed with such spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਜਤ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jat jat jaaeeai tat drisataae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Wherever I go, there I see Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: anik ra(n)g niragun ik ra(n)gaa ||
english: He manifests many forms, while still unmanifest and absolute, and yet He has One Form.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape jal aap hee tara(n)gaa ||2||
english: He Himself is the water, and He Himself is the waves. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: aap hee ma(n)dar aapahi sevaa ||
english: He Himself is the temple, and He Himself is selfless service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap hee poojaaree aap hee devaa ||3||
english: He Himself is the worshipper, and He Himself is the idol. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਜੋਗ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aapahi jog aap hee jugataa ||
english: He Himself is the Yoga; He Himself is the Way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak ke prabh sad hee mukataa ||4||1||6||
english: Nanak's God is forever liberated. ||4||1||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਨ ਆਪਿ ਸਧਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aap upaavan aap sadharanaa ||
english: He Himself creates, and He Himself supports.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਲੈਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aap karaavan dos na lainaa ||1||
english: He Himself causes all to act; He takes no blame Himself. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਬਚਨੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aapan bachan aap hee karanaa ||
english: He Himself is the teaching, and He Himself is the teacher.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਬਿਭਉ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aapan bibhau aap hee jaranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He Himself is the splendor, and He Himself is the experiencer of it. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਮਸਟਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਬੁਲਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aap hee masat aap hee bulanaa ||
english: He Himself is silent, and He Himself is the speaker.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਅਛਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਛਲਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap hee achhal na jaaee chhalanaa ||2||
english: He Himself is undeceivable; He cannot be deceived. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਗੁਪਤ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਗਟਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aap hee gupat aap paragatanaa ||
english: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is manifest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap hee ghat ghat aap alipanaa ||3||
english: He Himself is in each and every heart; He Himself is unattached. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਆਪ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aape avigat aap sa(n)g rachanaa ||
english: He Himself is absolute, and He Himself is with the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਚਨਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh ke sabh jachanaa ||4||2||7||
english: Says Nanak, all are beggars of God. ||4||2||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhoole maarag jinahi bataaiaa ||
english: He places the one who strays back on the Path;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aisaa gur vadabhaagee paaiaa ||1||
english: such a Guru is found by great good fortune. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: simar manaa raam naam chitaare ||
english: Meditate, contemplate the Name of the Lord, O mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bas rahe hiradai gur charan piaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Beloved Feet of the Guru abide within my heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohi man leenaa ||
english: The mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan kaat mukat gur keenaa ||2||
english: Breaking my bonds, the Guru has liberated me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਤ ਜਨਮਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਮੂਆ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh karat janam phun mooaa ||
english: Experiencing pain and pleasure, one is born, only to die again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: charan kamal gur aasram deeaa ||3||
english: The Lotus Feet of the Guru bring peace and shelter. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਬੂਡਤ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: agan saagar boodat sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The world is drowning in the ocean of fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak baah pakar satigur nisataaraa ||4||3||8||
english: O Nanak, holding me by the arm, the True Guru has saved me. ||4||3||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tan man dhan arapau sabh apanaa ||
english: Body, mind, wealth and everything, I surrender to my Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kavan s mat jit har har japanaa ||1||
english: What is that wisdom, by which I may come to chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਆਸਾ ਆਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਗਨਿ ॥
transliteration: kar aasaa aaio prabh maagan ||
english: Nurturing hope, I have come to beg from God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਪੇਖਤ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਆਗਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tumh pekhat sobhaa merai aagan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Gazing upon You, the courtyard of my heart is embellished. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਉ ॥
transliteration: anik jugat kar bahut beechaarau ||
english: Trying several methods, I reflect deeply upon the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਇਸੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਉਧਾਰਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g is manahi udhaarau ||2||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, this mind is saved. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mat budh surat naahee chaturaaee ||
english: I have neither intelligence, wisdom, common sense nor cleverness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਜਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa mileeai jaa lae milaaee ||3||
english: I meet You, only if You lead me to meet You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nain sa(n)tokhe prabh darasan paaiaa ||
english: My eyes are content, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲੁ ਸੋ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak saphal so aaiaa ||4||4||9||
english: Says Nanak, such a life is fruitful and rewarding. ||4||4||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa sut saath na maaiaa ||
english: Mother, father, children and the wealth of Maya, will not go along with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g sabh dookh mitaaiaa ||1||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all pain is dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: rav rahiaa prabh sabh mahi aape ||
english: God Himself is pervading, and permeating all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har jap rasanaa dukh na viaape ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord with your tongue, and pain will not afflict you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਖਾ ਭੂਖ ਬਹੁ ਤਪਤਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tikhaa bhookh bahu tapat viaapiaa ||
english: One who is afflicted by the terrible fire of thirst and desire,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: seetal bhae har har jas jaapiaa ||2||
english: becomes cool, chanting the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kot jatan sa(n)tokh na paaiaa ||
english: By millions of efforts, peace is not obtained;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man tripataanaa har gun gaaiaa ||3||
english: the mind is satisfied only by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: dehu bhagat prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: Please bless me with devotion, O God, O Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)tee suaamee ||4||5||10||
english: This is Nanak's prayer, O Lord and Master. ||4||5||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa vadabhaagee paaeeai ||
english: By great good fortune, the Perfect Guru is found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mil saadhoo har naam dhiaaeeai ||1||
english: Meeting with the Holy Saints, meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh teree saranaa ||
english: O Supreme Lord God, I seek Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਭਜੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kilabikh kaatai bhaj gur ke charanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating on the Guru's Feet, sinful mistakes are erased. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਕਾਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: avar karam sabh lokaachaar ||
english: All other rituals are just worldly affairs;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mil saadhoo sa(n)g hoi udhaar ||2||
english: joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: si(n)mrit saasat bed beechaare ||
english: One may contemplate the Simritees, Shaastras and Vedas,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: japeeai naam jit paar utaare ||3||
english: but only by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is one saved and carried across. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau prabh kirapaa kareeai ||
english: Have Mercy upon servant Nanak, O God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੧॥
transliteration: saadhoo dhoor milai nisatareeai ||4||6||11||
english: and bless him with the dust of the feet of the Holy, that he may be emancipated. ||4||6||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad ride mahi cheenaa ||
english: I contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad within my heart;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sagal manorath pooran aaseenaa ||1||
english: all my hopes and desires are fulfilled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kaa mukh oojal keenaa ||
english: The faces of the humble Saints are radiant and bright;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apunaa naam deenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: the Lord has mercifully blessed them with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop te kar gahi leenaa ||
english: Holding them by the hand, He has lifted them up out of the deep, dark pit,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar jagat pragateenaa ||2||
english: and their victory is celebrated throughout the world. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਚਾ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਊਨ ਪੂਰੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: neechaa te ooch oon pooreenaa ||
english: He elevates and exalts the lowly, and fills the empty.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam mahaa ras leenaa ||3||
english: They receive the supreme, sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਜਲਿ ਖੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan niramal paap jal kheenaa ||
english: The mind and body are made immaculate and pure, and sins are burnt to ashes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਸੀਨਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh bhae praseenaa ||4||7||12||
english: Says Nanak, God is pleased with me. ||4||7||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal manorath paaeeahi meetaa ||
english: All desires are fulfilled, O my friend,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਈਐ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu laaeeai cheetaa ||1||
english: lovingly centering your consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਵਤ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree jo prabhoo dhiaavat ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jalan bujhai har har gun gaavat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The fire of desire is quenched, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam hovat vadabhaagee ||
english: One's life become fruitful and rewarding, by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g raamahi liv laagee ||2||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, enshrine love for the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: mat pat dhan sukh sahaj ana(n)daa ||
english: Wisdom, honor, wealth, peace and celestial bliss are attained,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਹੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ik nimakh na visarahu paramaana(n)daa ||3||
english: If one does not forget the Lord of supreme bliss, even for an instant. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har darasan kee man piaas ghaneree ||
english: My mind is so very thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੩॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak saran prabh teree ||4||8||13||
english: Prays Nanak, O God, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||4||8||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਭ ਗੁਣਹ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mohi niragun sabh gunah bihoonaa ||
english: I am worthless, totally lacking all virtues.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daiaa dhaar apunaa kar leenaa ||1||
english: Bless me with Your Mercy, and make me Your Own. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: meraa man tan har gopaal suhaaiaa ||
english: My mind and body are embellished by the Lord, the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh ghar mahi aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Granting His Mercy, God has come into the home of my heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal bhai kaatanahaare ||
english: He is the Lover and Protector of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਬ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar ab utare paare ||2||
english: Now, I have been carried across the world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬੇਦਿ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan prabh birad bed lekhiaa ||
english: It is God's Way to purify sinners, say the Vedas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੋ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਪੇਖਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paarabraham so nainahu pekhiaa ||3||
english: I have seen the Supreme Lord with my eyes. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g pragate naaraain ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord becomes manifest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਪਲਾਇਣ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak daas sabh dookh palaain ||4||9||14||
english: O slave Nanak, all pains are relieved. ||4||9||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: kavan jaanai prabh tumhree sevaa ||
english: Who can know the value of serving You, God?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh avinaasee alakh abhevaa ||1||
english: God is imperishable, invisible and incomprehensible. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gun bea(n)t prabh gahir ga(n)bheere ||
english: His Glorious Virtues are infinite; God is profound and unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਮਹਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ooch mahal suaamee prabh mere ||
english: The Mansion of God, my Lord and Master, is lofty and high.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too apara(n)par thaakur mere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are unlimited, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: ekas bin naahee ko doojaa ||
english: There is no other than the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਪੂਜਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tumh hee jaanahu apanee poojaa ||2||
english: You alone know Your worship and adoration. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aapahu kachhoo na hovat bhaaee ||
english: No one can do anything by himself, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis prabh devai so naam paaee ||3||
english: He alone obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord, unto whom God bestows it. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jo jan prabh bhaaiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, that humble being who pleases God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੫॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan prabh tin hee paaiaa ||4||10||15||
english: he alone finds God, the treasure of virtue. ||4||10||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: maat garabh mahi haath de raakhiaa ||
english: Extending His Hand, the Lord protected you in your mother's womb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har ras chhod bikhiaa phal chaakhiaa ||1||
english: Renouncing the sublime essence of the Lord, you have tasted the fruit of poison. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
transliteration: bhaj gobid sabh chhod ja(n)jaal ||
english: Meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe, and renounce all entanglements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਮੂੜੇ ਤਬ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਬੇਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab jam aai sa(n)ghaarai mooRe tab tan binas jaai behaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When the Messenger of Death comes to murder you, O fool, then your body will be shattered and helplessly crumble. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tan man dhan apanaa kar thaapiaa ||
english: You hold onto your body, mind and wealth as your own,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਹਾਰੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karanahaar ik nimakh na jaapiaa ||2||
english: and you do not meditate on the Creator Lord, even for an instant. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa moh a(n)dh koop pariaa ||
english: You have fallen into the deep, dark pit of great attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਟਲਿ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paarabraham maaiaa patal bisariaa ||3||
english: Caught in the illusion of Maya, you have forgotten the Supreme Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag prabh keeratan gaaiaa ||
english: By great good fortune, one sings the Kirtan of God's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੬॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g naanak prabh paaiaa ||4||11||16||
english: In the Society of the Saints, Nanak has found God. ||4||11||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa sut ba(n)dhap bhaaee ||
english: Mother, father, children, relatives and siblings

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak hoaa paarabraham sahaaee ||1||
english: - O Nanak, the Supreme Lord is our help and support. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਣੇ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ghane ||
english: He blesses us with peace, and abundant celestial bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਣਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨ ਗਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa pooree jaa kee baanee anik gunaa jaa ke jaahi na gane ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Perfect is the Bani, the Word of the Perfect Guru. His Virtues are so many, they cannot be counted. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਰੰਜਾਮ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: sagal sara(n)jaam kare prabh aape ||
english: God Himself makes all arrangements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhae manorath so prabh jaape ||2||
english: Meditating on God, desires are fulfilled. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਰਥ ਧਰਮ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: arath dharam kaam mokh kaa daataa ||
english: He is the Giver of wealth, Dharmic faith, pleasure and liberation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੀ ਭਈ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pooree bhaee simar simar bidhaataa ||3||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny, I am fulfilled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak ra(n)g maaniaa ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak enjoys the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਣਿਆ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੭॥
transliteration: ghar aaiaa poorai gur aaniaa ||4||12||17||
english: He has returned home, with the Perfect Guru. ||4||12||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: srab nidhaan pooran guradev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All treasures come from the Perfect Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਰ ਜੀਵੇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japat nar jeeve ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the man lives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਥੀਵੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mar khuaar saakat nar theeve ||1||
english: The faithless cynic dies in shame and misery. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam hoaa rakhavaaraa ||
english: The Name of the Lord has become my Protector.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝਖ ਮਾਰਉ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jhakh maarau saakat vechaaraa ||2||
english: The wretched, faithless cynic makes only useless efforts. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਚਹਿ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa kar kar pachahi ghanere ||
english: Spreading slander, many have been ruined.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਫਾਸ ਗਲੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਪੈਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: miratak phaas galai sir paire ||3||
english: Their necks, heads and feet are tied by death's noose. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak japahi jan naam ||
english: Says Nanak, the humble devotees chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਮ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੮॥
transliteration: taa ke nikat na aavai jaam ||4||13||18||
english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach them. ||4||13||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 ghar 4 dupade ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਮਿਲਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
transliteration: kavan sa(n)jog milau prabh apane ||
english: What blessed destiny will lead me to meet my God?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pal pal nimakh sadaa har japane ||1||
english: Each and every moment and instant, I continually meditate on the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal prabh ke nit dhiaavau ||
english: I meditate continually on the Lotus Feet of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kavan s mat jit preetam paavau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: What wisdom will lead me to attain my Beloved? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aisee kripaa karahu prabh mere ||
english: Please, bless me with such Mercy, O my God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੯॥
transliteration: har naanak bisar na kaahoo bere ||2||1||19||
english: that Nanak may never, ever forget You. ||2||1||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal prabh hiradai dhiaae ||
english: Within my heart, I meditate on the Lotus Feet of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rog gae sagale sukh paae ||1||
english: Disease is gone, and I have found total peace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur dukh kaatiaa deeno daan ||
english: The Guru relieved my sufferings, and blessed me with the gift.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam jeevan paravaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My birth has been rendered fruitful, and my life is approved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: akath kathaa a(n)mrit prabh baanee ||
english: The Ambrosial Bani of God's Word is the Unspoken Speech.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jap jeeve giaanee ||2||2||20||
english: Says Nanak, the spiritually wise live by meditating on God. ||2||2||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)t paaee gur satigur poore ||
english: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, has blessed me with peace and tranquility.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਉਪਜੇ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukh upaje baaje anahad toore ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Peace and joy have welled up, and the mystical trumpets of the unstruck sound current vibrate. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: taap paap sa(n)taap binaase ||
english: Sufferings, sins and afflictions have been dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har simarat kilavikh sabh naase ||1||
english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, all sinful mistakes have been erased. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: anad karahu mil su(n)dar naaree ||
english: Joining together, O beautiful soul-brides, celebrate and make merry.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੧॥
transliteration: gur naanak meree paij savaaree ||2||3||21||
english: Guru Nanak has saved my honor. ||2||3||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
transliteration: mamataa moh dhroh mad maataa ba(n)dhan baadhiaa at bikaraal ||
english: Intoxicated with the wine of attachment, love of worldly possessions and deceit, and bound in bondage, he is wild and hideous.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਛਿਜਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕਰਤ ਅਉਧ ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥਾ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਜਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: din din chhijat bikaar karat audh phaahee phaathaa jam kai jaal ||1||
english: Day by day, his life is winding down; practicing sin and corruption, he is trapped by the noose of Death. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: teree saran prabh deen daiaalaa ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O God, Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਉਧਰਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mahaa bikham saagar at bhaaree udharahu saadhoo sa(n)g ravaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have crossed over the terrible, treacherous, enormous world-ocean, with the dust of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਾਲ ॥
transliteration: prabh sukhadaate samarath suaamee jeeu pi(n)d sabh tumaraa maal ||
english: O God, Giver of peace, All-powerful Lord and Master, my soul, body and all wealth are Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੨॥
transliteration: bhram ke ba(n)dhan kaatahu paramesar naanak ke prabh sadaa kripaal ||2||4||22||
english: Please, break my bonds of doubt, O Transcendent Lord, forever Merciful God of Nanak. ||2||4||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਕੀਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sagal ana(n)d keeaa paramesar apanaa birad samhaariaa ||
english: The Transcendent Lord has brought bliss to all; He has confirmed His Natural Way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਹੋਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਬਿਗਸੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਰਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadh janaa hoe kirapaalaa bigase sabh paravaariaa ||1||
english: He has become Merciful to the humble, holy Saints, and all my relatives blossom forth in joy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kaaraj satigur aap savaariaa ||
english: The True Guru Himself has resolved my affairs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vadee aarajaa har gobi(n)d kee sookh ma(n)gal kaliaan beechaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He has blessed Hargobind with long life, and taken care of my comfort, happiness and well-being. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਣ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: van trin tribhavan hariaa hoe sagale jee saadhaariaa ||
english: The forests, meadows and the three worlds have blossomed forth in greenery; He gives His Support to all beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੩॥
transliteration: man ichhe naanak phal paae pooran ichh pujaariaa ||2||5||23||
english: Nanak has obtained the fruits of his mind's desires; his desires are totally fulfilled. ||2||5||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jis oopar hovat daiaal ||
english: One who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har simarat kaatai so kaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: passes his time in contemplative meditation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਜੀਐ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g bhajeeai gopaal ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate, and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਤੂਟੈ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gun gaavat tootai jam jaal ||1||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the noose of death is cut away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: aape satigur aape pratipaal ||
english: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Cherisher.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੪॥
transliteration: naanak jaachai saadh ravaal ||2||6||24||
english: Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||2||6||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: man mahi si(n)chahu har har naam ||
english: Irrigate your mind with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin keeratan har gun gaam ||1||
english: Night and day, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aisee preet karahu man mere ||
english: Enshrine such love, O my mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar prabh jaanahu nere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: that twenty-four hours a day, God will seem near to you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਾਗ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jaa ke niramal bhaag ||
english: Says Nanak, one who has such immaculate destiny

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੫॥
transliteration: har charanee taa kaa man laag ||2||7||25||
english: - his mind is attached to the Lord's Feet. ||2||7||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: rog gaiaa prabh aap gavaaiaa ||
english: The disease is gone; God Himself took it away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਦ ਪਈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: need paee sukh sahaj ghar aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I sleep in peace; peaceful poise has come to my home. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਜਿ ਰਜਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raj raj bhojan khaavahu mere bhaaee ||
english: Eat to your fill, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam rid maahi dhiaaee ||1||
english: Meditate on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naanak gur poore saranaaee ||
english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੮॥੨੬॥
transliteration: jin apane naam kee paij rakhaaee ||2||8||26||
english: who has preserved the honor of His Name. ||2||8||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur kar deene asathir ghar baar || rahaau ||
english: The True Guru has protected my hearth and home, and made them permanent. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੈ ਇਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਹੀ ਮਾਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo jo ni(n)d karai in grihan kee tis aagai hee maarai karataar ||1||
english: Whoever slanders these homes, is pre-destined by the Creator Lord to be destroyed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਖੰਡ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak daas taa kee saranaaee jaa ko sabad akha(n)d apaar ||2||9||27||
english: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; the Word of His Shabad is unbreakable and infinite. ||2||9||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਸਗਲੇ ਗਏ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤੇ ਰੋਗ ॥
transliteration: taap sa(n)taap sagale gae binase te rog ||
english: The fever and sickness are gone, and the diseases are all dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਤੂ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham too bakhasiaa sa(n)tan ras bhog || rahaau ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has forgiven you, so enjoy the happiness of the Saints. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਰੋਗ ॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa teree ma(n)dalee teraa man tan aarog ||
english: All joys have entered your world, and your mind and body are free of disease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਇਹ ਅਵਖਦ ਜੋਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gun gaavahu nit raam ke ih avakhad jog ||1||
english: So chant continuously the Glorious Praises of the Lord; this is the only potent medicine. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਬਸਹੁ ਘਰ ਦੇਸ ਮਹਿ ਇਹ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: aai basahu ghar des mahi ih bhale sa(n)jog ||
english: So come, and dwell in your home and native land; this is such a blessed and auspicious occasion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਲਹਿ ਗਏ ਬਿਓਗ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੨੮॥
transliteration: naanak prabh suprasa(n)n bhae lahi gae biog ||2||10||28||
english: O Nanak, God is totally pleased with you; your time of separation has come to an end. ||2||10||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo sa(n)g na chaalahee maaiaa ja(n)jaal ||
english: The entanglements of Maya do not go along with anyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਖਿਆਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ooth sidhaare chhatrapat sa(n)tan kai khiaal || rahaau ||
english: Even kings and rulers must arise and depart, according to the wisdom of the Saints. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਨਸਨਾ ਇਹ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਢਾਲ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)budh kau binasanaa ih dhur kee dhaal ||
english: Pride goes before the fall - this is a primal law.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bahu jonee janamahi marahi bikhiaa bikaraal ||1||
english: Those who practice corruption and sin, are born into countless incarnations, only to die again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਹਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਹਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sat bachan saadhoo kahahi nit japahi gupaal ||
english: The Holy Saints chant Words of Truth; they meditate continually on the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਲਾਲ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੨੯॥
transliteration: simar simar naanak tare har ke ra(n)g laal ||2||11||29||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, O Nanak, those who are imbued with the color of the Lord's Love are carried across. ||2||11||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੂਖ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨ ॥
transliteration: sahaj samaadh ana(n)d sookh poore gur deen ||
english: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with celestial Samaadhi, bliss and peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਚੀਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sahaaee sa(n)g prabh a(n)mrit gun cheen || rahaau ||
english: God is always my Helper and Companion; I contemplate His Ambrosial Virtues. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਚਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar jagatr mahi lochahi sabh jeeaa ||
english: Triumphant cheers greet me all across the world, and all beings yearn for me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: suprasa(n)n bhae satigur prabhoo kachh bighan na theeaa ||1||
english: The True Guru and God are totally pleased with me; no obstacle blocks my way. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa a(n)g daiaal prabh taa ke sabh daas ||
english: One who has the Merciful Lord God on his side - everyone becomes his slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੩੦॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa vadiaaeeaa naanak gur paas ||2||12||30||
english: Forever and ever, O Nanak, glorious greatness rests with the Guru. ||2||12||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 ghar 5 chaupade ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: mrit ma(n)dal jag saajiaa jiu baaloo ghar baar ||
english: This perishable realm and world has been made like a house of sand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਜਿਉ ਕਾਗਦ ਬੂੰਦਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binasat baar na laagaee jiu kaagad boo(n)daar ||1||
english: In no time at all, it is destroyed, like the paper drenched with water. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sun meree manasaa manai maahi sat dekh beechaar ||
english: Listen to me, people: behold, and consider this within your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik girahee jogee taj gae ghar baar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Siddhas, the seekers, house-holders and Yogis have forsaken their homes and left. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਰੈਨਿ ਕਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa supanaa rain kaa taisaa sa(n)saar ||
english: This world is like a dream in the night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿਮਾਨ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਨਸੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਲਗਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: drisatimaan sabh binaseeai kiaa lagahi gavaar ||2||
english: All that is seen shall perish. Why are you attached to it, you fool? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਹੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਨੈਨ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kahaa s bhaaee meet hai dekh nain pasaar ||
english: Where are your brothers and friends? Open your eyes and see!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਚਾਲੇ ਇਕਿ ਚਾਲਸਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਵਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ik chaale ik chaalasahi sabh apanee vaar ||3||
english: Some have gone, and some will go; everyone must take his turn. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jin pooraa satigur seviaa se asathir har duaar ||
english: Those who serve the Perfect True Guru, remain ever-stable at the Door of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਖੁ ਪੈਜ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai raakh paij muraar ||4||1||31||
english: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave; preserve his honor, O Lord, Destroyer of ego. ||4||1||31||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਗਉ ॥
transliteration: lokan keeaa vadiaaeeaa baisa(n)tar paagau ||
english: The glories of the world, I cast into the fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਨਾ ਤੇ ਬੋਲ ਕਰਾਗਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu milai piaaraa aapanaa te bol karaagau ||1||
english: I chant those words, by which I may meet my Beloved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਇ ਤਉ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਗਉ ॥
transliteration: jau prabh jeeu daiaal hoi tau bhagatee laagau ||
english: When God becomes Merciful, then He enjoins me to His devotional service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਹ ਤਿਆਗਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: lapat rahio man baasanaa gur mil ih tiaagau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind clings to worldly desires; meeting with the Guru, I have renounced them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਅਤਿ ਘਨੀ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਹੋਮਾਗਉ ॥
transliteration: karau benatee at ghanee ihu jeeu homaagau ||
english: I pray with intense devotion, and offer this soul to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਰਥ ਆਨ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਿਮਖ ਸੋਹਾਗਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: arath aan sabh vaariaa pri nimakh sohaagau ||2||
english: I would sacrifice all other riches, for a moment's union with my Beloved. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸੰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੇ ਦੋਖ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਗਉ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch sa(n)g gur te chhute dokh ar raagau ||
english: Through the Guru, I am rid of the five villains, as well as emotional love and hate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਜਾਗਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ridai pragaas pragat bhaiaa nis baasur jaagau ||3||
english: My heart is illumined, and the Lord has become manifest; night and day, I remain awake and aware. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਉ ॥
transliteration: saran sohaagan aaiaa jis masatak bhaagau ||
english: The blessed soul-bride seeks His Sanctuary; her destiny is recorded on her forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਗਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tin paaiaa tan man seetalaagau ||4||2||32||
english: Says Nanak, she obtains her Husband Lord; her body and mind are cooled and soothed. ||4||2||32||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਲਗਾ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: laal ra(n)g tis kau lagaa jis ke vadabhaagaa ||
english: One is dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਹ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mailaa kade na hovaee nah laagai daagaa ||1||
english: This color is never muddied; no stain ever sticks to it. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਈਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh paaiaa sukhadaaeeaa miliaa sukh bhaai ||
english: He finds God, the Giver of peace, with feelings of joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਭੀਤਰੇ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sahaj samaanaa bheetare chhodiaa nah jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Celestial Lord blends into his soul, and he can never leave Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaraa maraa nah viaapaee phir dookh na paaiaa ||
english: Old age and death cannot touch him, and he shall not suffer pain again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਆਘਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pee a(n)mrit aaghaaniaa gur amar karaaiaa ||2||
english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, he is satisfied; the Guru makes him immortal. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: so jaanai jin chaakhiaa har naam amolaa ||
english: He alone knows its taste, who tastes the Priceless Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: keemat kahee na jaaeeai kiaa kahi mukh bolaa ||3||
english: Its value cannot be estimated; what can I say with my mouth? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: saphal daras teraa paarabraham gun nidh teree baanee ||
english: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Supreme Lord God. The Word of Your Bani is the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਉ ਧੂਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੩॥੩੩॥
transliteration: paavau dhoor tere daas kee naanak kurabaanee ||4||3||33||
english: Please bless me with the dust of the feet of Your slaves; Nanak is a sacrifice. ||4||3||33||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raakhahu apanee saran prabh mohi kirapaa dhaare ||
english: Keep me under Your Protection, God; shower me with Your Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਊ ਨੀਚੁ ਮੂਰਖਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sevaa kachhoo na jaanaoo neech moorakhaare ||1||
english: I do not know how to serve You; I am just a low-life fool. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਊਪਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maan karau tudh oopare mere preetam piaare ||
english: I take pride in You, O my Darling Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਸਦ ਭੂਲਤੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham aparaadhee sad bhoolate tumh bakhasanahaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sinner, continuously making mistakes; You are the Forgiving Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਵਗਨ ਕਰਹ ਅਸੰਖ ਨੀਤਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਦਾਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ham avagan karah asa(n)kh neet tumh niragun daataare ||
english: I make mistakes each and every day. You are the Great Giver;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਏ ਕਰਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: daasee sa(n)gat prabhoo tiaag e karam hamaare ||2||
english: I am worthless. I associate with Maya, your hand-maiden, and I renounce You, God; such are my actions. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਹਮ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਨਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tumh devahu sabh kichh daiaa dhaar ham akirataghanaare ||
english: You bless me with everything, showering me with Mercy; And I am such an ungrateful wretch!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨ ਸਿਉ ਨਹ ਚਿਤਿ ਖਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: laag pare tere daan siu nah chit khasamaare ||3||
english: I am attached to Your gifts, but I do not even think of You, O my Lord and Master. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਵ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tujh te baahar kichh nahee bhav kaatanahaare ||
english: There is none other than You, O Lord, Destroyer of fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਰ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੁਗਧ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak saran daiaal gur lehu mugadh udhaare ||4||4||34||
english: Says Nanak, I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Merciful Guru; I am so foolish - please, save me! ||4||4||34||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੀਜੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: dos na kaahoo deejeeai prabh apanaa dhiaaeeai ||
english: Don't blame anyone else; meditate on your God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਨਾ ਮਨ ਸੋਈ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jit seviai sukh hoi ghanaa man soee gaaeeai ||1||
english: Serving Him, great peace is obtained; O mind, sing His Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੀਐ ਕਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਝੁ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kaheeai kaai piaare tujh binaa ||
english: O Beloved, other than You, who else should I ask?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਅਵਗਨ ਹਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tumh daiaal suaamee sabh avagan hamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are my Merciful Lord and Master; I am filled with all faults. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu tumh raakhahu tiu rahaa avar nahee chaaraa ||
english: As You keep me, I remain; there is no other way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: needhariaa dhar tereeaa ik naam adhaaraa ||2||
english: You are the Support of the unsupported; You Name is my only Support. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਿ ਲੇਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jo tumh karahu soee bhalaa man letaa mukataa ||
english: One who accepts whatever You do as good - that mind is liberated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sagal samagree tereeaa sabh teree jugataa ||3||
english: The entire creation is Yours; all are subject to Your Ways. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: charan pakhaarau kar sevaa je thaakur bhaavai ||
english: I wash Your Feet and serve You, if it pleases You, O Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੫॥
transliteration: hohu kripaal daiaal prabh naanak gun gaavai ||4||5||35||
english: Be Merciful, O God of Compassion, that Nanak may sing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||5||35||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਹਸੈ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰੇ ਪਸੂਆ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: mirat hasai sir oopare pasooaa nahee boojhai ||
english: Death hovers over his head, laughing, but the beast does not understand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਦ ਸਾਦ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਰਣਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baad saad aha(n)kaar mahi maranaa nahee soojhai ||1||
english: Entangled in conflict, pleasure and egotism, he does not even think of death. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਫਿਰਹੁ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahu aapanaa kaahe phirahu abhaage ||
english: So serve your True Guru; why wander around miserable and unfortunate?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਕਸੁੰਭਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dekh kasu(n)bhaa ra(n)gulaa kaahe bhool laage ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You gaze upon the transitory, beautiful safflower, but why do you get attached to it? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਪ ਦਰਬੁ ਕੀਆ ਵਰਤਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kar kar paap darab keeaa varatan kai taaee ||
english: You commit sins again and again, to gather wealth to spend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਸਿਉ ਮਾਟੀ ਰਲੀ ਨਾਗਾ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maatee siu maatee ralee naagaa uth jaaee ||2||
english: But your dust shall mix with dust; you shall arise and depart naked. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੀਐ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰੈ ਤੇ ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai keeai sram karai te bair birodhee ||
english: Those for whom you work, will become your spiteful enemies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਲਹੁ ਕਰੋਧੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal bhaj jaahige kaahe jalahu karodhee ||3||
english: In the end, they will run away from you; why do you burn for them in anger? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਰੇਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: daas ren soee hoaa jis masatak karamaa ||
english: He alone becomes the dust of the Lord's slaves, who has such good karma upon his forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੁਟੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੩੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ba(n)dhan chhute satigur kee saranaa ||4||6||36||
english: Says Nanak, he is released from bondage, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||4||6||36||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿੰਗੁਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਖਲ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਕੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: pi(n)gul parabat paar pare khal chatur bakeetaa ||
english: The cripple crosses over the mountain, the fool becomes a wise man,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੂਝਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)dhule tribhavan soojhiaa gur bhet puneetaa ||1||
english: and the blind man sees the three worlds, by meeting with the True Guru and being purified. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ਕੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: mahimaa saadhoo sa(n)g kee sunahu mere meetaa ||
english: This is the Glory of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; listen, O my friends.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੁ ਖੋਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਹਰੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mail khoee kot agh hare niramal bhae cheetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Filth is washed away, millions of sins are dispelled, and the consciousness becomes immaculate and pure. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਕੀਟਿ ਹਸਤੀ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aisee bhagat govi(n)d kee keet hasatee jeetaa ||
english: Such is devotional worship of the Lord of the Universe, that the ant can overpower the elephant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਆਪਨੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo jo keeno aapano tis abhai daan deetaa ||2||
english: Whoever the Lord makes His own, is blessed with the gift of fearlessness. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਘੁ ਬਿਲਾਈ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਓ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਮੇਰੁ ਦਿਖੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: si(n)gh bilaaee hoi gaio trin mer dikheetaa ||
english: The lion becomes a cat, and the mountain looks like a blade of grass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਦਮ ਆਢ ਕਉ ਤੇ ਗਨੀ ਧਨੀਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sram karate dam aadh kau te ganee dhaneetaa ||3||
english: Those who worked for half a shell, will be judged very wealthy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ਕਹਿ ਸਕਉ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kavan vadaaee kahi sakau bea(n)t guneetaa ||
english: What glorious greatness of Yours can I describe, O Lord of infinite excellences?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਰੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੩੭॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi naam dehu naanak daras reetaa ||4||7||37||
english: Please bless me with Your Mercy, and grant me Your Name; O Nanak, I am lost without the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||4||7||37||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਬਾਦ ਨੀਤ ਲੋਭ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)budh parabaad neet lobh rasanaa saad ||
english: He is constantly entangled in pride, conflict, greed and tasty flavors.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਪਟਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਬਿਖਿਆਦਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lapat kapat grihi bedhiaa mithiaa bikhiaad ||1||
english: He is involved in deception, fraud, household affairs and corruption. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਪੇਖੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: aisee pekhee netr mahi poore gur parasaad ||
english: I have seen this with my eyes, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨਾ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raaj milakh dhan jobanaa naamai bin baad ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Power, property, wealth and youth are useless, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਸੋਗੰਧਤਾ ਕਾਪਰ ਭੋਗਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: roop dhoop soga(n)dhataa kaapar bhogaad ||
english: Beauty, incense, scented oils, beautiful clothes and foods

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪਿਸਟ ਤਨ ਹੋਏ ਦੁਰਗਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: milat sa(n)g paapisat tan hoe duragaad ||2||
english: - when they come into contact with the body of the sinner, they stink. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਖਿਨ ਭੰਗਨ ਦੇਹਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: phirat phirat maanukh bhaiaa khin bha(n)gan dehaad ||
english: Wandering, wandering around, the soul is reincarnated as a human, but this body lasts only for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਅਉਸਰ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਦਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ih ausar te chookiaa bahu jon bhramaad ||3||
english: Losing this opportunity, he must wander again through countless incarnations. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
transliteration: prabh kirapaa te gur mile har har bisamaad ||
english: By God's Grace, he meets the Guru; contemplating the Lord, Har, Har, he is wonderstruck.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨੰਦ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਦ ॥੪॥੮॥੩੮॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj naanak ana(n)d taa kai pooran naad ||4||8||38||
english: He is blessed with peace, poise and bliss, O Nanak, through the perfect sound current of the Naad. ||4||8||38||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਭਏ ਸੰਤ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਤਰੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜੇਤ ॥
transliteration: charan bhae sa(n)t bohithaa tare saagar jet ||
english: The feet of the Saints are the boat, to cross over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗ ਪਾਏ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਸੇ ਭੇਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maarag paae udiaan mahi gur dase bhet ||1||
english: In the wilderness, the Guru places them on the Path, and reveals the secrets of the Lord's Mystery. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੇਤ ॥
transliteration: har har har har har hare har har har het ||
english: O Lord, Har Har Har, Har Har Haray, Har Har Har, I love You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat sovate har har har chet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, think of the Lord, Har Har Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਆਗੈ ਭਗੇ ਜਬ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇਤ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch chor aagai bhage jab saadhasa(n)get ||
english: The five thieves run away, when one joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਘਣੋ ਲਾਭੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: poo(n)jee saabat ghano laabh grihi sobhaa set ||2||
english: His investment is intact, and he earns great profits; his household is blessed with honor. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਣੁ ਮਿਟੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੋਲੇਤ ॥
transliteration: nihachal aasan mitee chi(n)t naahee dolet ||
english: His position is unmoving and eternal, his anxiety is ended, and he wavers no more.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਤ ਨੇਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bharam bhulaavaa mit gaiaa prabh pekhat net ||3||
english: His doubts and misgivings are dispelled, and he sees God everywhere. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਭੀਰ ਗੁਨ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤ ॥
transliteration: gun gabheer gun naaikaa gun kaheeahi ket ||
english: The Virtues of our Virtuous Lord and Master are so profound; how many of His Glorious Virtues should I speak?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰੇਤ ॥੪॥੯॥੩੯॥
transliteration: naanak paaiaa saadhasa(n)g har har a(n)mret ||4||9||39||
english: Nanak has obtained the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of the Holy. ||4||9||39||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਜੋ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਤੇਤੋ ਬਿਰਥਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bin saadhoo jo jeevanaa teto birathaaree ||
english: That life, which has no contact with the Holy, is useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਭਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮਿਟੇ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: milat sa(n)g sabh bhram mite gat bhaee hamaaree ||1||
english: Joining their congregation, all doubts are dispelled, and I am emancipated. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਆ ਦਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa din bhete saadh mohi uaa din balihaaree ||
english: That day, when I meet with the Holy - I am a sacrifice to that day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨੋ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan man apano jeearaa phir phir hau vaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Again and again, I sacrifice my body, mind and soul to them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਤ ਛਡਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੇ ਇਤਨੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: et chhadaaee mohi te itanee driRataaree ||
english: They have helped me renounce this ego, and implant this humility within myself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਰੇਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਅਪਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sagal ren ihu man bhaiaa binasee apadhaaree ||2||
english: This mind has become the dust of all men's feet, and my self-conceit has been dispelled. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਪਰ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਏ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)d chi(n)d par dookhanaa e khin mahi jaaree ||
english: In an instant, I burnt away the ideas of slander and ill-will towards others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਅਰੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਪੇਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: daiaa maiaa ar nikat pekh naahee dooraaree ||3||
english: I see close at hand, the Lord of mercy and compassion; He is not far away at all. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਅਬ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tan man seetal bhae ab mukate sa(n)saaree ||
english: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, and now, I am liberated from the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੀਤ ਚੀਤ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੦॥
transliteration: heet cheet sabh praan dhan naanak darasaaree ||4||10||40||
english: Love, consciousness, the breath of life, wealth and everything, O Nanak, are in the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||4||10||40||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਟਹਲ ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਉ ਬਾਲ ॥
transliteration: tahal karau tere daas kee pag jhaarau baal ||
english: I perform service for Your slave, O Lord, and wipe his feet with my hair.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਭੇਟ ਦੇਉ ਗੁਨ ਸੁਨਉ ਰਸਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: masatak apanaa bhet deu gun sunau rasaal ||1||
english: I offer my head to him, and listen to the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the source of bliss. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਓ ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: tumh milate meraa man jeeo tumh milahu daiaal ||
english: Meeting You, my mind is rejuvenated, so please meet me, O Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nis baasur man anad hot chitavat kirapaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Night and day, my mind enjoys bliss, contemplating the Lord of Compassion. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਨੑ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jagat udhaaran saadh prabh tinh laagahu paal ||
english: God's Holy people are the saviors of the world; I grab hold of the hem of their robes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਗ ਰਾਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mo kau deejai daan prabh sa(n)tan pag raal ||2||
english: Bless me, O God, with the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
transliteration: ukat siaanap kachh nahee naahee kachh ghaal ||
english: I have no skill or wisdom at all, nor any work to my credit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੋਹ ਤੇ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhram bhai raakhahu moh te kaatahu jam jaal ||3||
english: Please, protect me from doubt, fear and emotional attachment, and cut away the noose of Death from my neck. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: binau karau karunaapate pitaa pratipaal ||
english: I beg of You, O Lord of Mercy, O my Father, please cherish me!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੪੧॥
transliteration: gun gaavau tere saadhasa(n)g naanak sukh saal ||4||11||41||
english: I sing Your Glorious Praises, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Lord, Home of peace. ||4||11||41||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: keetaa loRahi so karahi tujh bin kachh naahi ||
english: Whatever You wish, You do. Without You, there is nothing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: parataap tumhaaraa dekh kai jamadoot chhad jaahi ||1||
english: Gazing upon Your Glory, the Messenger of Death leaves and goes away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
transliteration: tumhree kripaa te chhooteeai binasai aha(n)mev ||
english: By Your Grace, one is emancipated, and egotism is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab kalaa samarath prabh poore guradev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God is omnipotent, possessing all powers; He is obtained through the Perfect, Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat khojiaa naamai bin koor ||
english: Searching, searching, searching - without the Naam, everything is false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jeevan sukh sabh saadhasa(n)g prabh manasaa poor ||2||
