english: All the comforts of life are found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; God is the Fulfiller of desires. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਭ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: jit jit laavahu tit tit lagahi siaanap sabh jaalee ||
english: Whatever You attach me to, to that I am attached; I have burnt away all my cleverness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤੁਮੑ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jat kat tumh bharapoor hahu mere deen daiaalee ||3||
english: You are permeating and pervading everywhere, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਮਾਗਨਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh tum te maaganaa vadabhaagee paae ||
english: I ask for everything from You, but only the very fortunate ones obtain it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੪੨॥
transliteration: naanak kee aradaas prabh jeevaa gun gaae ||4||12||42||
english: This is Nanak's prayer, O God, I live by singing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||12||42||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਬਾਸਬੈ ਕਲਮਲ ਸਭਿ ਨਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kai baasabai kalamal sabh nasanaa ||
english: Dwelling in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all sins are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਿਆ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh setee ra(n)g raatiaa taa te garabh na grasanaa ||1||
english: One who is attuned to the Love of God, is not cast into the womb of reincarnation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਸੂਚੀ ਭਈ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naam kahat govi(n)d kaa soochee bhaee rasanaa ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, the tongue becomes holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man tan niramal hoee hai gur kaa jap japanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The mind and body become immaculate and pure, chanting the Chant of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਤ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਲੈ ਹਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har ras chaakhat dhraapiaa man ras lai hasanaa ||
english: Tasting the subtle essence of the Lord, one is satisfied; receiving this essence, the mind becomes happy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਈ ਉਲਟਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: budh pragaas pragat bhaee ulat kamal bigasanaa ||2||
english: The intellect is brightened and illuminated; turning away from the world, the heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਭ ਬੂਝੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: seetal saa(n)t sa(n)tokh hoi sabh boojhee trisanaa ||
english: He is cooled and soothed, peaceful and content; all his thirst is quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਤ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਨਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dah dis dhaavat mit gae niramal thaan basanaa ||3||
english: The mind's wandering in the ten directions is stopped, and one dwells in the immaculate place. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਭਏ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: raakhanahaarai raakhiaa bhae bhram bhasanaa ||
english: The Savior Lord saves him, and his doubts are burnt to ashes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਰਸਨਾ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੪੩॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan naanak sukhee pekh saadh darasanaa ||4||13||43||
english: Nanak is blessed with the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. He finds peace, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan. ||4||13||43||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਕੈ ਤਬ ਹੋਹਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: paanee pakhaa pees daas kai tab hohi nihaal ||
english: Carry water for the Lord's slave, wave the fan over him, and grind his corn; then, you shall be happy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀਆ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raaj milakh sikadaareeaa aganee mahi jaal ||1||
english: Burn in the fire your power, property and authority. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਛੋਹਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kaa chhoharaa tis charanee laag ||
english: Grasp hold of the feet of the servant of the humble Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਛੋਡਉ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maaiaadhaaree chhatrapat tinh chhodau tiaag ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Renounce and abandon the wealthy, the regal overlords and kings. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਨਾ ਰੂਖਾ ਸੋ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kaa daanaa rookhaa so sarab nidhaan ||
english: The dry bread of the Saints is equal to all treasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਛਤੀਹ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਬਿਖੂ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੨॥
transliteration: grihi saakat chhateeh prakaar te bikhoo samaan ||2||
english: The thirty-six tasty dishes of the faithless cynic, are just like poison. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਲੂਗਰਾ ਓਢਿ ਨਗਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kaa loogaraa odh nagan na hoee ||
english: Wearing the old blankets of the humble devotees, one is not naked.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਰੇਸਮੀ ਪਹਿਰਤ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saakat sirapaau resamee pahirat pat khoee ||3||
english: But by putting on the silk clothes of the faithless cynic, one loses one's honor. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਰਿਐ ਅਧ ਵੀਚਹੁ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
transliteration: saakat siu mukh joriai adh veechahu tootai ||
english: Friendship with the faithless cynic breaks down mid-way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਇਤ ਊਤਹਿ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har jan kee sevaa jo kare it ootahi chhootai ||4||
english: But whoever serves the humble servants of the Lord, is emancipated here and hereafter. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh tumh hee te hoaa aap banat banaaee ||
english: Everything comes from You, O Lord; You Yourself created the creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੫॥੧੪॥੪੪॥
transliteration: darasan bhetat saadh kaa naanak gun gaaee ||5||14||44||
english: Blessed with the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||14||44||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਸੁਨਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: sravanee sunau har har hare thaakur jas gaavau ||
english: With my ears, I listen to the Lord, Har, Har; I sing the Praises of my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t charan kar sees dhar har naam dhiaavau ||1||
english: I place my hands and my head upon the feet of the Saints, and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਇਹ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa daiaal prabh ih nidh sidh paavau ||
english: Be kind to me, O Merciful God, and bless me with this wealth and success.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਲੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee renukaa lai maathai laavau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Obtaining the dust of the feet of the Saints, I apply it to my forehead. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਚ ਤੇ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: neech te neech at neech hoi kar binau bulaavau ||
english: I am the lowest of the low, absolutely the lowest; I offer my humble prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paav malovaa aap tiaag sa(n)tasa(n)g samaavau ||2||
english: I wash their feet, and renounce my self-conceit; I merge in the Saints' Congregation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਹ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਧਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: saas saas nah veesarai an katahi na dhaavau ||
english: With each and every breath, I never forget the Lord; I never go to another.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਟਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saphal darasan gur bheteeai maan mohu mitaavau ||3||
english: Obtaining the Fruitful Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I discard my pride and attachment. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਨਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh daiaa dharam seegaar banaavau ||
english: I am embellished with truth, contentment, compassion and Dharmic faith.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਉ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੪੫॥
transliteration: saphal suhaagan naanakaa apune prabh bhaavau ||4||15||45||
english: My spiritual marriage is fruitful, O Nanak; I am pleasing to my God. ||4||15||45||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਟਲ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: atal bachan saadhoo janaa sabh mahi pragataaiaa ||
english: The words of the Holy are eternal and unchanging; this is apparent to everyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis jan hoaa saadhasa(n)g tis bhetai har raaiaa ||1||
english: That humble being, who joins the Saadh Sangat, meets the Sovereign Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ih parateet govi(n)d kee jap har sukh paaiaa ||
english: This faith in the Lord of the Universe, and peace, are found by meditating on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anik baataa sabh kar rahe gur ghar lai aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Everyone is speaking in various ways, but the Guru has brought the Lord into the home of my self. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਤਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saran pare kee raakhataa naahee sahasaaiaa ||
english: He preserves the honor of those who seek His Sanctuary; there is no doubt about this at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਇ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਦੁਲਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karam bhoom har naam boi ausar dulabhaaiaa ||2||
english: In the field of actions and karma, plant the Lord's Name; this opportunity is so difficult to obtain! ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee aap prabh sabh kare karaaiaa ||
english: God Himself is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He does, and causes everything to be done.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਘਣੇ ਕਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: patit puneet ghane kare thaakur biradaaiaa ||3||
english: He purifies so many sinners; this is the natural way of our Lord and Master. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਜਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mat bhoolahu maanukh jan maaiaa bharamaaiaa ||
english: Don't be fooled, O mortal being, by the illusion of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਸੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੪੬॥
transliteration: naanak tis pat raakhasee jo prabh pahiraaiaa ||4||16||46||
english: O Nanak, God saves the honor of those of whom He approves. ||4||16||46||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਤੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: maatee te jin saajiaa kar duralabh deh ||
english: He fashioned you from clay, and made your priceless body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik chhidr man mahi dhake niramal drisateh ||1||
english: He covers the many faults in your mind, and makes you look immaculate and pure. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨੈ ਤੇ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਏਹ ॥
transliteration: kiu bisarai prabh manai te jis ke gun eh ||
english: So why do you forget God from your mind? He has done so many good things for you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਜਿ ਰਚੇ ਜਿ ਆਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੋ ਰਲੀਐ ਖੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh taj rache j aan siu so raleeai kheh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who forsakes God, and blends himself with another, in the end is blended with dust. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਮਤ ਬਿਲਮ ਕਰੇਹ ॥
transliteration: simarahu simarahu saas saas mat bilam kareh ||
english: Meditate, meditate in remembrance with each and every breath - do not delay!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਪ੍ਰਪੰਚੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਕੂੜੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chhod prapa(n)ch prabh siu rachahu taj kooRe neh ||2||
english: Renounce worldly affairs, and merge yourself into God; forsake false loves. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਏਕ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਕੀਏ ਹੈ ਹੋਸੀ ਏਹ ॥
transliteration: jin anik ek bahu ra(n)g keee hai hosee eh ||
english: He is many, and He is One; He takes part in the many plays. This is as He is, and shall be.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਲੇਹ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kar sevaa tis paarabraham gur te mat leh ||3||
english: So serve that Supreme Lord God, and accept the Guru's Teachings. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਵਡਾ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਰਨੇਹ ॥
transliteration: ooche te oochaa vadaa sabh sa(n)g baraneh ||
english: God is said to be the highest of the high, the greatest of all, our companion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਦਾਸਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਲੇਹ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੪੭॥
transliteration: daas daas ko daasaraa naanak kar leh ||4||17||47||
english: Please, let Nanak be the slave of the slave of Your slaves. ||4||17||47||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਅਨ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: ek tek govi(n)d kee tiaagee an aas ||
english: The Lord of the Universe is my only Support. I have renounced all other hopes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh oopar samarath prabh pooran gunataas ||1||
english: God is All-powerful, above all; He is the perfect treasure of virtue. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jan kaa naam adhaar hai prabh saranee paahi ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of the humble servant who seeks God's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paramesar kaa aasaraa sa(n)tan man maahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In their minds, the Saints take the Support of the Transcendent Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aap rakhai aap devasee aape pratipaarai ||
english: He Himself preserves, and He Himself gives. He Himself cherishes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧੇ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: deen daiaal kripaa nidhe saas saas samhaarai ||2||
english: Merciful to the meek, the treasure of mercy, He remembers and protects us with each and every breath. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਾਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: karanahaar jo kar rahiaa saaee vadiaaee ||
english: Whatever the Creator Lord does is glorious and great.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur poorai upadesiaa sukh khasam rajaaee ||3||
english: The Perfect Guru has instructed me, that peace comes by the Will of our Lord and Master. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਗਣਤ ਤਜਿ ਜਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: chi(n)t a(n)desaa ganat taj jan hukam pachhaataa ||
english: Anxieties, worries and calculations are dismissed; the Lord's humble servant accepts the Hukam of His Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਹ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੪੮॥
transliteration: nah binasai nah chhod jaai naanak ra(n)g raataa ||4||18||48||
english: He does not die, and He does not leave; Nanak is attuned to His Love. ||4||18||48||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਤਪਤਿ ਤੇ ਭਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਰਸਤ ਪਾਪ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
transliteration: mahaa tapat te bhaee saa(n)t parasat paap naathe ||
english: The great fire is put out and cooled; meeting with the Guru, sins run away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਗਲਤ ਥੇ ਕਾਢੇ ਦੇ ਹਾਥੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop mahi galat the kaadhe de haathe ||1||
english: I fell into the deep dark pit; giving me His Hand, He pulled me out. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਹਮ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ॥
transliteration: oi hamaare saajanaa ham un kee ren ||
english: He is my friend; I am the dust of His Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੁਖੀ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin bhetat hovat sukhee jee daan den ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting with Him, I am at peace; He blesses me with the gift of the soul. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਅਬ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: paraa poorabalaa leekhiaa miliaa ab aai ||
english: I have now received my pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: basat sa(n)g har saadh kai pooran aasaai ||2||
english: Dwelling with the Lord's Holy Saints, my hopes are fulfilled. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਕੇ ਪਾਏ ਸੁਖ ਥਾਨ ॥
transliteration: bhai binase tihu lok ke paae sukh thaan ||
english: The fear of the three worlds is dispelled, and I have found my place of rest and peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: daiaa karee samarath gur basiaa man naam ||3||
english: The all-powerful Guru has taken pity upon me, and the Naam has come to dwell in my mind. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਟੇਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naanak kee too tek prabh teraa aadhaar ||
english: O God, You are the Anchor and Support of Nanak.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੪੯॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath prabh har agam apaar ||4||19||49||
english: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes; the All-powerful Lord God is inaccessible and infinite. ||4||19||49||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਮਲੀਨੁ ਦੀਨੁ ਹੀਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: soee maleen deen heen jis prabh bisaraanaa ||
english: One who forgets God is filthy, poor and low.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਈ ਆਪੁ ਗਨੈ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karanaihaar na boojhaee aap ganai bigaanaa ||1||
english: The fool does not understand the Creator Lord; instead, he thinks that he himself is the doer. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਤਦੇ ਜਦਿ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: dookh tade jad veesarai sukh prabh chit aae ||
english: Pain comes, when one forgets Him. Peace comes when one remembers God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kai aana(n)d ehu nit har gun gaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This is the way the Saints are in bliss - they continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਨੀਚਾ ਕਰੈ ਨੀਚ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: ooche te neechaa karai neech khin mahi thaapai ||
english: The high, He makes low, and the low, he elevates in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: keemat kahee na jaaeeai thaakur parataapai ||2||
english: The value of the glory of our Lord and Master cannot be estimated. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਤ ਲੀਲਾ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਚਲਨੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pekhat leelaa ra(n)g roop chalanai din aaiaa ||
english: While he gazes upon beautiful dramas and plays, the day of his departure dawns.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੇ ਕਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: supane kaa supanaa bhaiaa sa(n)g chaliaa kamaaiaa ||3||
english: The dream becomes the dream, and his actions do not go along with him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath prabh teree saranaaee ||
english: God is All-powerful, the Cause of causes; I seek Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਪੈ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੫੦॥
transliteration: har dinas rain naanak japai sad sad bal jaaee ||4||20||50||
english: Day and night, Nanak meditates on the Lord; forever and ever he is a sacrifice. ||4||20||50||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲੁ ਢੋਵਉ ਇਹ ਸੀਸ ਕਰਿ ਕਰ ਪਗ ਪਖਲਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: jal dhovau ih sees kar kar pag pakhalaavau ||
english: I carry water on my head, and with my hands I wash their feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਲਖ ਬੇਰੀਆ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baar jaau lakh bereeaa daras pekh jeevaavau ||1||
english: Tens of thousands of times, I am a sacrifice to them; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, I live. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: karau manorath manai maahi apane prabh te paavau ||
english: The hopes which I cherish in my mind - my God fulfills them all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਉ ਸੂਹਨੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਬੀਜਨੁ ਢੋਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: deu soohanee saadh kai beejan dholaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: With my broom, I sweep the homes of the Holy Saints, and wave the fan over them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਤ ਬੋਲਤੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨਹਿ ਪੀਲਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit gun sa(n)t bolate sun manahi peelaavau ||
english: The Saints chant the Ambrosial Praises of the Lord; I listen, and my mind drinks it in.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: uaa ras mahi saa(n)t tripat hoi bikhai jalan bujhaavau ||2||
english: That sublime essence calms and soothes me, and quenches the fire of sin and corruption. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: jab bhagat karahi sa(n)t ma(n)dalee tinh mil har gaavau ||
english: When the galaxy of Saints worship the Lord in devotion, I join them, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karau namasakaar bhagat jan dhoor mukh laavau ||3||
english: I bow in reverence to the humble devotees, and apply the dust of their feet to my face. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਜਪਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਹੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat japau naam ihu karam kamaavau ||
english: Sitting down and standing up, I chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is what I do.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੫੧॥
transliteration: naanak kee prabh benatee har saran samaavau ||4||21||51||
english: This is Nanak's prayer to God, that he may merge in the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||21||51||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ihu saagar soee tarai jo har gun gaae ||
english: He alone crosses over this world-ocean, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kai sa(n)g vasai vadabhaagee paae ||1||
english: He dwells with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; by great good fortune, he finds the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਨ ਆਖੀ ॥
transliteration: sun sun jeevai daas tumh baanee jan aakhee ||
english: Your slave lives by hearing, hearing the Word of Your Bani, chanted by Your humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਈ ਸਭ ਲੋਅ ਮਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pragat bhaee sabh lo mahi sevak kee raakhee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru is revealed in all the worlds; He saves the honor of His servant. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: agan saagar te kaadhiaa prabh jalan bujhaaee ||
english: God has pulled me out of the ocean of fire, and quenched my burning thirst.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਲੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam jal sa(n)chiaa gur bhae sahaaee ||2||
english: The Guru has sprinkled the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He has become my Helper. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh kaatiaa sukh kaa thaan paaiaa ||
english: The pains of birth and death are removed, and I have obtained a resting place of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੀ ਸਿਲਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਕੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaatee silak bhram moh kee apane prabh bhaaiaa ||3||
english: The noose of doubt and emotional attachment has been snapped; I have become pleasing to my God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਛੁ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: mat koee jaanahu avar kachh sabh prabh kai haath ||
english: Let no one think that there is any other at all; everything is in the Hands of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਏ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੫੨॥
transliteration: sarab sookh naanak paae sa(n)g sa(n)tan saath ||4||22||52||
english: Nanak has found total peace, in the Society of the Saints. ||4||22||52||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan kaate aap prabh hoaa kirapaal ||
english: My bonds have been snapped; God Himself has become compassionate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: deen daiaal prabh paarabraham taa kee nadar nihaal ||1||
english: The Supreme Lord God is Merciful to the meek; by His Glance of Grace, I am in ecstasy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai kirapaa karee kaatiaa dukh rog ||
english: The Perfect Guru has shown mercy to me, and eradicated my pains and illnesses.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man tan seetal sukhee bhaiaa prabh dhiaavan jog ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed, meditating on God, most worthy of meditation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: aukhadh har kaa naam hai jit rog na viaapai ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the medicine to cure all disease; with it, no disease afflicts me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਿਤੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g man tan hitai phir dookh na jaapai ||2||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the mind and body are tinged with the Lord's Love, and I do not suffer pain any longer. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har har har har jaapeeai a(n)tar liv laaee ||
english: I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, lovingly centering my inner being on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kilavikh utarahi sudh hoi saadhoo saranaaee ||3||
english: Sinful mistakes are erased and I am sanctified, in the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਤ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਦੂਰਿ ਬਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sunat japat har naam jas taa kee door balaaee ||
english: Misfortune is kept far away from those who hear and chant the Praises of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੫੩॥
transliteration: mahaa ma(n)tr naanak kathai har ke gun gaaee ||4||23||53||
english: Nanak chants the Mahaa Mantra, the Great Mantra, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||23||53||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bhai te upajai bhagat prabh a(n)tar hoi saa(n)t ||
english: From the Fear of God, devotion wells up, and deep within, there is peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam japat govi(n)d kaa binasai bhram bhraa(n)t ||1||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, doubt and delusions are dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa jis bhetiaa taa kai sukh paraves ||
english: One who meets with the Perfect Guru, is blessed with peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man kee mat tiaageeai suneeai upades ||1|| rahaau ||
english: So renounce the intellectual cleverness of your mind, and listen to the Teachings. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: simarat simarat simareeai so purakh daataar ||
english: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Primal Lord, the Great Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man te kabahu na veesarai so purakh apaar ||2||
english: May I never forget that Primal, Infinite Lord from my mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu ra(n)g lagaa acharaj guradev ||
english: I have enshrined love for the Lotus Feet of the Wondrous Divine Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kau kirapaa karahu prabh taa kau laavahu sev ||3||
english: One who is blessed by Your Mercy, God, is committed to Your service. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: nidh nidhaan a(n)mrit peeaa man tan aana(n)d ||
english: I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, the treasure of wealth, and my mind and body are in bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੫੪॥
transliteration: naanak kabahu na veesarai prabh paramaana(n)d ||4||24||54||
english: Nanak never forgets God, the Lord of supreme bliss. ||4||24||54||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਗਈ ਨਾਠੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: trisan bujhee mamataa gaee naathe bhai bharamaa ||
english: Desire is stilled, and egotism is gone; fear and doubt have run away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਆਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: thit paaee aanad bhaiaa gur keene dharamaa ||1||
english: I have found stability, and I am in ecstasy; the Guru has blessed me with Dharmic faith. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੀਰ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadhiaa binasee meree peer ||
english: Worshipping the Perfect Guru in adoration, my anguish is eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਬੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan man sabh seetal bhaiaa paaiaa sukh beer ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My body and mind are totally cooled and soothed; I have found peace, O my brother. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: sovat har jap jaagiaa pekhiaa bisamaad ||
english: I have awakened from sleep, chanting the Name of the Lord; gazing upon Him, I am filled with wonder.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਸੁਆਦੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pee a(n)mrit tripataasiaa taa kaa acharaj suaad ||2||
english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, I am satisfied. How wondrous is its taste! ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਤਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aap mukat sa(n)gee tare kul kuta(n)b udhaare ||
english: I myself am liberated, and my companions swim across; my family and ancestors are also saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saphal sevaa guradev kee niramal darabaare ||3||
english: Service to the Divine Guru is fruitful; it has made me pure in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਚੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜਾਨੁ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਗੁਣਹੀਨੁ ॥
transliteration: neech anaath ajaan mai niragun gunaheen ||
english: I am lowly, without a master, ignorant, worthless and without virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਨੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੫੫॥
transliteration: naanak kau kirapaa bhaee daas apanaa keen ||4||25||55||
english: Nanak has been blessed with God's Mercy; God has made him His Slave. ||4||25||55||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਅਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bhagataa kaa aasaraa an naahee thaau ||
english: The Lord is the Hope and Support of His devotees; there is nowhere else for them to go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taan deebaan paravaar dhan prabh teraa naau ||1||
english: O God, Your Name is my power, realm, relatives and riches. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee apane daas rakh leee ||
english: God has granted His Mercy, and saved His slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਚੇ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਗ੍ਰਸੀਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak ni(n)daa kar pache jamakaal graseee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The slanderers rot in their slander; they are seized by the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਨਾ ਦੂਸਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa ek dhiaavanaa doosar ko naahi ||
english: The Saints meditate on the One Lord, and no other.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ekas aagai benatee raviaa srab thaai ||2||
english: They offer their prayers to the One Lord, who is pervading and permeating all places. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਥਾ ਪੁਰਾਤਨ ਇਉ ਸੁਣੀ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kathaa puraatan iu sunee bhagatan kee baanee ||
english: I have heard this old story, spoken by the devotees,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਦੁਸਟ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਏ ਜਨ ਲੀਏ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sagal dusat kha(n)d kha(n)d keee jan leee maanee ||3||
english: that all the wicked are cut apart into pieces, while His humble servants are blessed with honor. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਪਰਗਟ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sat bachan naanak kahai paragat sabh maahi ||
english: Nanak speaks the true words, which are obvious to all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੫੬॥
transliteration: prabh ke sevak saran prabh tin kau bhau naahi ||4||26||56||
english: God's servants are under God's Protection; they have absolutely no fear. ||4||26||56||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਲ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan kaatai so prabhoo jaa kai kal haath ||
english: God breaks the bonds which hold us; He holds all power in His hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਕਰਮ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥੧॥
transliteration: avar karam nahee chhooteeai raakhahu har naath ||1||
english: No other actions will bring release; save me, O my Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਮਾਧਵੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: tau saranaagat maadhave pooran daiaal ||
english: I have entered Your Sanctuary, O Perfect Lord of Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੂਟਿ ਜਾਇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chhoot jaai sa(n)saar te raakhai gopaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those whom You preserve and protect, O Lord of the Universe, are saved from the trap of the world. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aasaa bharam bikaar moh in mahi lobhaanaa ||
english: Hope, doubt, corruption and emotional attachment - in these, he is engrossed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੁ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jhooth samagree man vasee paarabraham na jaanaa ||2||
english: The false material world abides in his mind, and he does not understand the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: param jot pooran purakh sabh jee tumhaare ||
english: O Perfect Lord of Supreme Light, all beings belong to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu too raakhahi tiu rahaa prabh agam apaare ||3||
english: As You keep us, we live, O infinite, inaccessible God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath prabh dehi apanaa naau ||
english: Cause of causes, All-powerful Lord God, please bless me with Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੫੭॥
transliteration: naanak tareeai saadhasa(n)g har har gun gaau ||4||27||57||
english: Nanak is carried across in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||27||57||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਤਰਿਆ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kavan kavan nahee patariaa tumhree parateet ||
english: Who? Who has not fallen, by placing their hopes in you?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਨਰਕ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mahaa mohanee mohiaa narak kee reet ||1||
english: You are enticed by the great enticer - this is the way to hell! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਖੁਟਹਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ਤੂ ਮਹਾ ਉਦਮਾਦਾ ॥
transliteration: man khutahar teraa nahee bisaas too mahaa udamaadaa ||
english: O vicious mind, no faith can be placed in you; you are totally intoxicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਰ ਕਾ ਪੈਖਰੁ ਤਉ ਛੁਟੈ ਜਉ ਊਪਰਿ ਲਾਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khar kaa paikhar tau chhutai jau oopar laadaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The donkey's leash is only removed, after the load is placed on his back. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਤੁਮੑ ਖੰਡੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਡਾਂਡ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam tumh kha(n)de jam ke dukh daa(n)d ||
english: You destroy the value of chanting, intensive meditation and self-discipline; you shall suffer in pain, beaten by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਿਰਲਜੇ ਭਾਂਡ ॥੨॥
transliteration: simarahi naahee jon dukh niralaje bhaa(n)d ||2||
english: You do not meditate, so you shall suffer the pains of reincarnation, you shameless buffoon! ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਮਹਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)g sahaaee mahaa meet tis siu teraa bhed ||
english: The Lord is your Companion, your Helper, your Best Friend; but you disagree with Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੀਧਾ ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰਈ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਮਹਾ ਖੇਦੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: beedhaa pa(n)ch batavaaraee upajio mahaa khed ||3||
english: You are in love with the five thieves; this brings terrible pain. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਿਨ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naanak tin sa(n)tan saranaagatee jin man vas keenaa ||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints, who have conquered their minds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੫੮॥
transliteration: tan dhan sarabas aapanaa prabh jan kau deenhaa ||4||28||58||
english: He gives body, wealth and everything to the slaves of God. ||4||28||58||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਆਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: udam karat aanad bhaiaa simarat sukh saar ||
english: Try to meditate, and contemplate the source of peace, and bliss will come to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jap jap naam gobi(n)d kaa pooran beechaar ||1||
english: Chanting, and meditating on the Name of the Lord of the Universe, perfect understanding is achieved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal gur ke japat har jap hau jeevaa ||
english: Meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Guru, and chanting the Name of the Lord, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਰਾਧਤੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham aaraadhate mukh a(n)mrit peevaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Worshipping the Supreme Lord God in adoration, my mouth drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬਸੇ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲੋਚ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh sukh base sabh kai man loch ||
english: All beings and creatures dwell in peace; the minds of all yearn for the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਚਿਤਵਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਪੋਚ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paraupakaar nit chitavate naahee kachh poch ||2||
english: Those who continually remember the Lord, do good deeds for others; they harbor no ill will towards anyone. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਬਸੰਤ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਹ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s thaan basa(n)t dha(n)n jah japeeai naam ||
english: Blessed is that place, and blessed are those who dwell there, where they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਤਿ ਘਨਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kathaa keeratan har at ghanaa sukh sahaj bisraam ||3||
english: The Sermon and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung there very often; there is peace, poise and tranquility. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: man te kade na veesarai anaath ko naath ||
english: In my mind, I never forget the Lord; He is the Master of the masterless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੫੯॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee jaa kai sabh kichh haath ||4||29||59||
english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; everything is in His hands. ||4||29||59||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਬੰਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin too ba(n)dh kar chhodiaa phun sukh mahi paaiaa ||
english: The One who bound you in the womb and then released you, placed you in the world of joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਸੀਤਲ ਹੋਤਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa simar charanaarabi(n)d seetal hotaaiaa ||1||
english: Contemplate His Lotus Feet forever, and you shall be cooled and soothed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਅਥਵਾ ਮੁਇਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jeevatiaa athavaa muiaa kichh kaam na aavai ||
english: In life and in death, this Maya is of no use.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਕੋਊ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin ehu rachan rachaaiaa kooo tis siu ra(n)g laavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He created this creation, but rare are those who enshrine love for Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਘਾਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
transliteration: re praanee usan seet karataa karai ghaam te kaadhai ||
english: O mortal, the Creator Lord made summer and winter; He saves you from the heat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਰੀ ਤੇ ਹਸਤੀ ਕਰੈ ਟੂਟਾ ਲੇ ਗਾਢੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: keeree te hasatee karai tootaa le gaadhai ||2||
english: From the ant, He makes an elephant; He reunites those who have been separated. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਕਿਰਤਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)daj jeraj setaj utabhujaa prabh kee ih kirat ||
english: Eggs, wombs, sweat and earth - these are God's workshops of creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਰਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kirat kamaavan sarab phal raveeai har nirat ||3||
english: It is fruitful for all to practice contemplation of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵਨਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਧ ॥
transliteration: ham te kachhoo na hovanaa saran prabh saadh ||
english: I cannot do anything; O God, I seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਕੂਪ ਅੰਧ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਢ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੦॥
transliteration: moh magan koop a(n)dh te naanak gur kaadh ||4||30||60||
english: Guru Nanak pulled me up, out of the deep, dark pit, the intoxication of attachment. ||4||30||60||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਾ ਖੋਜਉ ਬਨ ਥਾਨ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat mai phiraa khojau ban thaan ||
english: Searching, searching, I wander around searching, in the woods and other places.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਐਸੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: achhal achhed abhed prabh aise bhagavaan ||1||
english: He is undeceivable, imperishable, inscrutable; such is my Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬ ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਆਤਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: kab dekhau prabh aapanaa aatam kai ra(n)g ||
english: When shall I behold my God, and delight my soul?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਨ ਤੇ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਭਲਾ ਬਸੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaagan te supanaa bhalaa baseeai prabh sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Even better than being awake, is the dream in which I dwell with God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਨ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਨਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: baran aasram saasatr sunau darasan kee piaas ||
english: Listening to the Shaastras teaching about the four social classes and the four stages of life, I grow thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਬਿਨਾਸ ॥੨॥
transliteration: roop na rekh na pa(n)ch tat thaakur abinaas ||2||
english: He has no form or outline, and He is not made of the five elements; our Lord and Master is imperishable. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ॥
transliteration: ohu saroop sa(n)tan kahahi virale jogeesur ||
english: How rare are those Saints and great Yogis, who describe the beautiful form of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੇ ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਤੇ ਈਸੁਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jaa kau mile dhan dhan te eesur ||3||
english: Blessed, blessed are they, whom the Lord meets in His Mercy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤਹ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: so a(n)tar so baahare binase tah bharamaa ||
english: They know that He is deep within, and outside as well; their doubts are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮਾ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੬੧॥
transliteration: naanak tis prabh bhetiaa jaa ke pooran karamaa ||4||31||61||
english: O Nanak, God meets those, whose karma is perfect. ||4||31||61||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t suprasa(n)n bhae dekh prabh parataap ||
english: All beings and creatures are totally pleased, gazing on God's glorious radiance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਜੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਰਿ ਆਹਰੁ ਆਪ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karaj utaariaa satiguroo kar aahar aap ||1||
english: The True Guru has paid off my debt; He Himself did it. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਨਿਬਹਤ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਅਖੂਟ ॥
transliteration: khaat kharachat nibahat rahai gurasabad akhoot ||
english: Eating and expending it, it is always available; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is inexhaustible.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਸਮਗਰੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਤੂਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pooran bhaee samagaree kabahoo nahee toot ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Everything is perfectly arranged; it is never exhausted. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਆਰਾਧਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਆਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g aaraadhanaa har nidh aapaar ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I worship and adore the Lord, the infinite treasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਦੇਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dharam arath ar kaam mokh dete nahee baar ||2||
english: He does not hesitate to bless me with Dharmic faith, wealth, fulfilment of desires and liberation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਏਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: bhagat araadhahi ek ra(n)g gobi(n)d gupaal ||
english: The devotees worship and adore the Lord of the Universe with single-minded love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam naam dhan sa(n)chiaa jaa kaa nahee sumaar ||3||
english: They gather in the wealth of the Lord's Name, which cannot be estimated. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: saran pare prabh tereeaa prabh kee vadiaaee ||
english: O God, I seek Your Sanctuary, the glorious greatness of God. Nanak:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੬੨॥
transliteration: naanak a(n)t na paaeeai bea(n)t gusaaee ||4||32||62||
english: Your end or limitation cannot be found, O Infinite World-Lord. ||4||32||62||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਾਰਜ ਭਏ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: simar simar pooran prabhoo kaaraj bhae raas ||
english: Meditate, meditate in remembrance of the Perfect Lord God, and your affairs shall be perfectly resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਪੁਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਵਸੈ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karataar pur karataa vasai sa(n)tan kai paas ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In Kartaarpur, the City of the Creator Lord, the Saints dwell with the Creator. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: bighan na kooo laagataa gur pahi aradaas ||
english: No obstacles will block your way, when you offer your prayers to the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਾਇ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rakhavaalaa gobi(n)d raai bhagatan kee raas ||1||
english: The Sovereign Lord of the Universe is the Saving Grace, the Protector of the capital of His devotees. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਦੇ ਮੂਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tot na aavai kade mool pooran bha(n)daar ||
english: There is never any deficiency at all; the Lord's treasures are over-flowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: charan kamal man tan base prabh agam apaar ||2||
english: His Lotus Feet are enshrined within my mind and body; God is inaccessible and infinite. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸਤ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਊਨ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
transliteration: basat kamaavat sabh sukhee kichh oon na deesai ||
english: All those who work for Him dwell in peace; you can see that they lack nothing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad bhete prabhoo pooran jagadeesai ||3||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, I have met God, the Perfect Lord of the Universe. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸਭੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar sabhai karahi sach thaan suhaaiaa ||
english: Everyone congratulates me, and celebrates my victory; the home of the True Lord is so beautiful!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੬੩॥
transliteration: jap naanak naam nidhaan sukh pooraa gur paaiaa ||4||33||63||
english: Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the treasure of peace; I have found the Perfect Guru. ||4||33||63||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਹੋਈਐ ਆਰੋਗ ॥
transliteration: har har har aaraadheeai hoeeai aarog ||
english: Worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and you shall be free of disease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਚੰਦ ਕੀ ਲਸਟਿਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raamacha(n)d kee lasatikaa jin maariaa rog ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This is the Lord's healing rod, which eradicates all disease. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਕੀਚੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa har jaapeeai nit keechai bhog ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, through the Perfect Guru, he constantly enjoys pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kai vaaranai miliaa sa(n)jog ||1||
english: I am devoted to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I have been united with my Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat sukh paaeeai binasai biog ||
english: Contemplating Him, peace is obtained, and separation is ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥੩੪॥੬੪॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee karan kaaran jog ||2||34||64||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the All-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes. ||2||34||64||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 dupade ghar 5 ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay, Fifth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ਦਾਰੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: avar upaav sabh tiaagiaa daaroo naam laiaa ||
english: I have given up all other efforts, and have taken the medicine of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਰੋਗ ਸੀਤਲ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taap paap sabh mite rog seetal man bhaiaa ||1||
english: Fevers, sins and all diseases are eradicated, and my mind is cooled and soothed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadhiaa sagalaa dukh gaiaa ||
english: Worshipping the Perfect Guru in adoration, all pains are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raakhanahaarai raakhiaa apanee kar maiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Savior Lord has saved me; He has blessed me with His Kind Mercy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਕੀਨਾ ਅਪਨਇਆ ॥
transliteration: baah pakaR prabh kaadhiaa keenaa apanaiaa ||
english: Grabbing hold of my arm, God has pulled me up and out; He has made me His own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਇਆ ॥੨॥੧॥੬੫॥
transliteration: simar simar man tan sukhee naanak nirabhaiaa ||2||1||65||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, my mind and body are at peace; Nanak has become fearless. ||2||1||65||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਧਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: kar dhar masatak thaapiaa naam deeno daan ||
english: Placing His Hand upon my forehead, God has given me the gift of His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saphal sevaa paarabraham kee taa kee nahee haan ||1||
english: One who performs fruitful service for the Supreme Lord God, never suffers any loss. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖਤਾ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਆਨਿ ॥
transliteration: aape hee prabh raakhataa bhagatan kee aan ||
english: God Himself saves the honor of His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੋ ਲੇਤਾ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo jo chitavahi saadh jan so letaa maan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever God's Holy servants wish for, He grants to them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: saran pare charanaarabi(n)d jan prabh ke praan ||
english: God's humble servants seek the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet; they are God's very breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੨॥੨॥੬੬॥
transliteration: sahaj subhaai naanak mile jotee jot samaan ||2||2||66||
english: O Nanak, they automatically, intuitively meet God; their light merges into the Light. ||2||2||66||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਦੀਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal kaa aasaraa deeno prabh aap ||
english: God Himself has given me the Support of His Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਪਰੇ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸਦ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh saranaagat jan pare taa kaa sad parataap ||1||
english: God's humble servants seek His Sanctuary; they are respected and famous forever. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: raakhanahaar apaar prabh taa kee niramal sev ||
english: God is the unparalleled Savior and Protector; service to Him is immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਪੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam raaj raamadaas pur keenhe guradev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Divine Guru has built the City of Ramdaspur, the royal domain of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa har dhiaaeeai kichh bighan na laagai ||
english: Forever and ever, meditate on the Lord, and no obstacles will obstruct you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਇ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੨॥੩॥੬੭॥
transliteration: naanak naam salaaheeai bhai dusaman bhaagai ||2||3||67||
english: O Nanak, praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the fear of enemies runs away. ||2||3||67||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਮਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: man tan prabh aaraadheeai mil saadh samaagai ||
english: Worship and adore God in your mind and body; join the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਚਰਤ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਜਸੁ ਦੂਰ ਤੇ ਜਮੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ucharat gun gopaal jas door te jam bhaagai ||1||
english: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Messenger of Death runs far away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam jo jan japai anadin sad jaagai ||
english: That humble being who chants the Lord's Name, remains always awake and aware, night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਹ ਜੋਹਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ta(n)t ma(n)t nah johaee tit chaakh na laagai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is not affected by charms and spells, nor is he harmed by the evil eye. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਦ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਅਨਰਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh mad maan moh binase anaraagai ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, the intoxication of egotism and emotional attachment are dispelled, by loving devotion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਮਗਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਾਗੈ ॥੨॥੪॥੬੮॥
transliteration: aana(n)d magan ras raam ra(n)g naanak saranaagai ||2||4||68||
english: One who enters the Lord's Sanctuary, O Nanak, remains merged in ecstasy in the subtle essence of the Lord's Love. ||2||4||68||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੈ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jee jugat vas prabhoo kai jo kahai s karanaa ||
english: The living creatures and their ways are in God's power. Whatever He says, they do.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਭਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhae prasa(n)n gopaal raai bhau kichh nahee karanaa ||1||
english: When the Sovereign Lord of the Universe is pleased, there is nothing at all to fear. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਦੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dookh na laagai kade tudh paarabraham chitaare ||
english: Pain shall never afflict you, if you remember the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jamaka(n)kar neR na aavaee gurasikh piaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach the beloved Sikhs of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath hai tis bin nahee hor ||
english: The All-powerful Lord is the Cause of causes; there is no other than Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੨॥੫॥੬੯॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee saachaa man jor ||2||5||69||
english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; the True Lord has given strength to the mind. ||2||5||69||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਨਾਠਾ ਦੁਖ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: simar simar prabh aapanaa naathaa dukh thaau ||
english: Remembering, remembering my God in meditation, the house of pain is removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਪਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਧਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bisraam paae mil saadhasa(n)g taa te bahuR na dhaau ||1||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have found peace and tranquility; I shall not wander away from there again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਨੇ ਚਰਨਨੑ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane charananh bal jaau ||
english: I am devoted to my Guru; I am a sacrifice to His Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਬਨੇ ਪੇਖਤ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anad sookh ma(n)gal bane pekhat gun gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am blessed with ecstasy, peace and happiness, gazing upon the Guru, and singing the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਨਿਓ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: kathaa keeratan raag naad dhun ihu banio suaau ||
english: This is my life's purpose, to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and listen to the vibrations of the sound current of the Naad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥੬॥੭੦॥
transliteration: naanak prabh suprasa(n)n bhae baa(n)chhat phal paau ||2||6||70||
english: O Nanak, God is totally pleased with me; I have obtained the fruits of my desires. ||2||6||70||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਰਿਦ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: daas tere kee benatee rid kar paragaas ||
english: This is the prayer of Your slave: please enlighten my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦੋਖਨ ਕੋ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tumhree kripaa te paarabraham dokhan ko naas ||1||
english: By Your Mercy, O Supreme Lord God, please erase my sins. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal kaa aasaraa prabh purakh gunataas ||
english: I take the Support of Your Lotus Feet, O God, Primal Lord, treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਉ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: keeratan naam simarat rahau jab lag ghat saas ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I shall meditate in remembrance on the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, as long as there is breath in my body. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬੰਧਪ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa ba(n)dhap toohai too sarab nivaas ||
english: You are my mother, father and relative; You are abiding within all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੭੧॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee jaa ko niramal jaas ||2||7||71||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; His Praise is immaculate and pure. ||2||7||71||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ਸਭਿ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sarab sidh har gaaeeai sabh bhalaa manaavahi ||
english: All perfect spiritual powers are obtained, when one sings the Lord's Praises; everyone wishes him well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਦਾਸ ਮਿਲਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadh saadh mukh te kahahi sun daas milaavahi ||1||
english: Everyone calls him holy and spiritual; hearing of him, the Lord's slaves come to meet him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਰਸ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੑ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj kaliaan ras poorai gur keenh ||
english: The Perfect Guru blesses him with peace, poise, salvation and happiness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਸਗਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੀਨੑ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jee sagal daiaal bhae har har naam cheenh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All living beings become compassionate to him; he remembers the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥
transliteration: poor rahio sarabatr mahi prabh gunee gaheer ||
english: He is permeating and pervading everywhere; God is the ocean of virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਧੀਰ ॥੨॥੮॥੭੨॥
transliteration: naanak bhagat aana(n)d mai pekh prabh kee dheer ||2||8||72||
english: O Nanak, the devotees are in bliss, gazing upon God's abiding stability. ||2||8||72||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਦਾਤਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹੋਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: aradaas sunee daataar prabh hoe kirapaal ||
english: God, the Great Giver, has become merciful; He has listened to my prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਆ ਅਪਨਾ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raakh leeaa apanaa sevako mukh ni(n)dak chhaar ||1||
english: He has saved His servant, and put ashes into the mouth of the slanderer. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝਹਿ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ਕੋ ਮੀਤ ਜਨ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: tujhahi na johai ko meet jan too(n) gur kaa daas ||
english: No one can threaten you now, O my humble friend, for you are the slave of the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਦੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham too raakhiaa de apane haath ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Supreme Lord God reached out with His Hand and saved you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਬੀਆ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jeean kaa daataa ek hai beeaa nahee hor ||
english: The One Lord is the Giver of all beings; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਮੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੨॥੯॥੭੩॥
transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)teeaa mai teraa jor ||2||9||73||
english: Nanak prays, You are my only strength, God. ||2||9||73||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: meet hamaare saajanaa raakhe govi(n)d ||
english: The Lord of the Universe has saved my friends and companions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਹੋਇ ਗਏ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੋਹੁ ਨਿਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak miratak hoi gae tumh hohu nichi(n)d ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The slanderers have died, so do not worry. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਏ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sagal manorath prabh keee bhete guradev ||
english: God has fulfilled all hopes and desires; I have met the Divine Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਸਫਲ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar jagat mahi saphal jaa kee sev ||1||
english: God is celebrated and acclaimed all over the world; it is fruitful and rewarding to serve Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗਨਤ ਹਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: ooch apaar aganat har sabh jee jis haath ||
english: Lofty, infinite and immeasurable is the Lord; all beings are in His Hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੭੪॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee jat kat merai saath ||2||10||74||
english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; He is with me everywhere. ||2||10||74||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਹੋਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadhiaa hoe kirapaal ||
english: I worship the Perfect Guru in adoration; He has become merciful to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤਿ ਬਤਾਇਆ ਤੂਟੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maarag sa(n)t bataaiaa toote jam jaal ||1||
english: The Saint has shown me the Way, and the noose of Death has been cut away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸੰਸਾ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਗਾਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dookh bhookh sa(n)saa mitiaa gaavat prabh naam ||
english: Pain, hunger and scepticism have been dispelled, singing the Name of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sahaj sookh aana(n)d ras pooran sabh kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am blessed with celestial peace, poise, bliss and pleasure, and all my affairs have been perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਰਾਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪ ॥
transliteration: jalan bujhee seetal bhae raakhe prabh aap ||
english: The fire of desire has been quenched, and I am cooled and soothed; God Himself saved me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੭੫॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee jaa kaa vad parataap ||2||11||75||
english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; His glorious radiance is so great! ||2||11||75||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਫਲ ਥਾਨੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dharat suhaavee saphal thaan pooran bhae kaam ||
english: The earth is beautified, all places are fruitful, and my affairs are perfectly resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਨਾਠਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਰਵਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhau naathaa bhram mit gaiaa raviaa nit raam ||1||
english: Fear runs away, and doubt is dispelled, dwelling constantly upon the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saadh janaa kai sa(n)g basat sukh sahaj bisraam ||
english: Dwelling with the humble Holy people, one finds peace, poise and tranquility.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਘੜੀ ਸੁਲਖਣੀ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saaee ghaRee sulakhanee simarat har naam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Blessed and auspicious is that time, when one meditates in remembrance on the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਤੇ ਪਹਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: pragat bhae sa(n)saar mahi phirate pahanaam ||
english: They have become famous throughout the world; before this, no one even knew their names.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਸਭ ਜਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੭੬॥
transliteration: naanak tis saranaagatee ghat ghat sabh jaan ||2||12||76||
english: Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the One who knows each and every heart. ||2||12||76||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: rog mitaaiaa aap prabh upajiaa sukh saa(n)t ||
english: God Himself eradicated the disease; peace and tranquility have welled up.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vad parataap acharaj roop har keenhee daat ||1||
english: The Lord blessed me with the gifts of great, glorious radiance and wondrous form. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur govi(n)d kripaa karee raakhiaa meraa bhaaee ||
english: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, has shown mercy to me, and saved my brother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham tis kee saranaagatee jo sadaa sahaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am under His Protection; He is always my help and support. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: birathee kade na hovaee jan kee aradaas ||
english: The prayer of the Lord's humble servant is never offered in vain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੭੭॥
transliteration: naanak jor govi(n)d kaa pooran gunataas ||2||13||77||
english: Nanak takes the strength of the Perfect Lord of the Universe, the treasure of excellence. ||2||13||77||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਜਿਨ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਜੀਵਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: mar mar janame jin bisariaa jeevan kaa daataa ||
english: Those who forget the Giver of life, die, over and over again, only to be reborn and die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paarabraham jan seviaa anadin ra(n)g raataa ||1||
english: The humble servant of the Supreme Lord God serves Him; night and day, he remains imbued with His Love. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਆਨਦੁ ਘਨਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)t sahaj aanad ghanaa pooran bhaee aas ||
english: I have found peace, tranquility and great ecstasy; my hopes have been fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukh paaiaa har saadhasa(n)g simarat gunataas ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have found peace in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I meditate in remembrance on the Lord, the treasure of virtue. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜਨ ਤੁਮੑ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: sun suaamee aradaas jan tumh a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: O my Lord and Master, please listen to the prayer of Your humble servant; You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੭੮॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahe naanak ke suaamee ||2||14||78||
english: Nanak's Lord and Master is permeating and pervading all places and interspaces. ||2||14||78||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: taatee vaau na lagaee paarabraham saranaaee ||
english: The hot wind does not even touch one who is under the Protection of the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਉਗਿਰਦ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਾਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chaugirad hamaarai raam kaar dukh lagai na bhaaee ||1||
english: On all four sides I am surrounded by the Lord's Circle of Protection; pain does not afflict me, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur pooraa bhetiaa jin banat banaaee ||
english: I have met the Perfect True Guru, who has done this deed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਦੀਆ ਏਕਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam aukhadh deeaa ekaa liv laaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He has given me the medicine of the Lord's Name, and I enshrine love for the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਖਨਹਾਰਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raakh leee tin rakhanahaar sabh biaadh mitaaee ||
english: The Savior Lord has saved me, and eradicated all my sickness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੭੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak kirapaa bhaee prabh bhae sahaaee ||2||15||79||
english: Says Nanak, God has showered me with His Mercy; He has become my help and support. ||2||15||79||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਆਪਿ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: apane baalak aap rakhian paarabraham guradev ||
english: The Supreme Lord God, through the Divine Guru, has Himself protected and preserved His children.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukh saa(n)t sahaj aanad bhae pooran bhaee sev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Celestial peace, tranquility and bliss have come to pass; my service has been perfect. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kee benatee sunee prabh aap ||
english: God Himself has heard the prayers of His humble devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਜੀਵਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rog mitaai jeevaalian jaa kaa vad parataap ||1||
english: He dispelled my disease, and rejuvenated me; His glorious radiance is so great! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੋਖ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਬਖਸਿਅਨੁ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: dokh hamaare bakhasian apanee kal dhaaree ||
english: He has forgiven me for my sins, and interceded with His power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਦਿਤਿਅਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੮੦॥
transliteration: man baa(n)chhat phal ditian naanak balihaaree ||2||16||80||
english: I have been blessed with the fruits of my mind's desires; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||2||16||80||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 chaupade dupade ghar 6 ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay And Dho-Padhay, Sixth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੋਹਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਇਹ ਨ ਸੁਨਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mere mohan sravanee ih na sunaae ||
english: O my fascinating Lord, let me not listen to the faithless cynic,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਬੋਲਤ ਬੋਲ ਅਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saakat geet naad dhun gaavat bolat bol ajaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Singing his songs and tunes, and chanting his useless words. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਤ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵਉ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਉ ਕਿਰਤਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sevat sev sev saadh sevau sadaa karau kirataae ||
english: I serve, serve, serve, serve the Holy Saints; forever and ever, I do this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਾਤੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: abhai daan paavau purakh daate mil sa(n)gat har gun gaae ||1||
english: The Primal Lord, the Great Giver, has blessed me with the gift of fearlessness. Joining the Company of the Holy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਅਗਹ ਅਗਹ ਗੁਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa agah agah gun raatee nain daras ra(n)g laae ||
english: My tongue is imbued with the Praises of the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord, and my eyes are drenched with the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hohu kripaal deen dukh bha(n)jan mohi charan ridai vasaae ||2||
english: Be Merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the meek, that I may enshrine Your Lotus Feet within my heart. ||2||
