author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਹੂ ਤਲੈ ਤਲੈ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਏਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabhahoo talai talai sabh oopar eh drisat drisataae ||
english: Beneath all, and above all; this is the vision I saw.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਈ ਹਉ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: abhimaan khoi khoi khoi khoee hau mo kau satigur ma(n)tr driRaae ||3||
english: I have destroyed, destroyed, destroyed my pride, since the True Guru implanted His Mantra within me. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤੁਲੁ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨਹ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: atul atul atul nah tuleeai bhagat vachhal kirapaae ||
english: Immeasurable, immeasurable, immeasurable is the Merciful Lord; he cannot be weighed. He is the Lover of His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੮੧॥
transliteration: jo jo saran pario gur naanak abhai daan sukh paae ||4||1||81||
english: Whoever enters the Sanctuary of Guru Nanak, is blessed with the gifts of fearlessness and peace. ||4||||1||81||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh jee too mere praan adhaarai ||
english: O Dear God, You are the Support of my breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਜਾਉ ਬਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: namasakaar da(n)daut ba(n)danaa anik baar jaau baarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I bow in humility and reverence to You; so many times, I am a sacrifice. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat sovat jaagat ihu man tujhahi chitaarai ||
english: Sitting down, standing up, sleeping and waking, this mind thinks of You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਆਗੈ ਸਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sookh dookh is man kee birathaa tujh hee aagai saarai ||1||
english: I describe to You my pleasure and pain, and the state of this mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: too meree ot bal budh dhan tum hee tumahi merai paravaarai ||
english: You are my shelter and support, power, intellect and wealth; You are my family.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਹਮਰੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਚਰਨਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੮੨॥
transliteration: jo tum karahu soee bhal hamarai pekh naanak sukh charanaarai ||2||2||82||
english: Whatever You do, I know that is good. Gazing upon Your Lotus Feet, Nanak is at peace. ||2||2||82||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਉ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰਨ ॥
transliteration: suneeat prabh tau sagal udhaaran ||
english: I have heard that God is the Savior of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਐਸੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: moh magan patit sa(n)g praanee aise manahi bisaaran ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Intoxicated by attachment, in the company of sinners, the mortal has forgotten such a Lord from his mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਚਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੇ ਗ੍ਰਾਹਜੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਨ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)ch bikhiaa le graahaj keenee a(n)mrit man te daaran ||
english: He has collected poison, and grasped it firmly. But he has cast out the Ambrosial Nectar from his mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh rat ni(n)daa sat sa(n)tokh bidaaran ||1||
english: He is imbued with sexual desire, anger, greed and slander; he has abandoned truth and contentment. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਾਰਨ ॥
transliteration: in te kaadh lehu mere suaamee haar pare tumh saaran ||
english: Lift me up, and pull me out of these, O my Lord and Master. I have entered Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਕ ਤਾਰਨ ॥੨॥੩॥੮੩॥
transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)tee prabh pahi saadhasa(n)g ra(n)k taaran ||2||3||83||
english: Nanak prays to God: I am a poor beggar; carry me across, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||3||83||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kai suneeat prabh kee baat ||
english: I listen to God's Teachings from the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਧੁਨਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kathaa keeratan aana(n)d ma(n)gal dhun poor rahee dinas ar raat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord's Sermon, the Kirtan of His Praises and the songs of bliss perfectly resonate, day and night. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apane prabh keene naam apune kee keenee daat ||
english: In His Mercy, God has made them His own, and blessed them with the gift of His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aath pahar gun gaavat prabh ke kaam krodh is tan te jaat ||1||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of God. Sexual desire and anger have left this body. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਤ ॥
transliteration: tripat aghaae pekh prabh darasan a(n)mrit har ras bhojan khaat ||
english: I am satisfied and satiated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. I eat the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's sublime food.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਤ ॥੨॥੪॥੮੪॥
transliteration: charan saran naanak prabh teree kar kirapaa sa(n)tasa(n)g milaat ||2||4||84||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O God; in Your Mercy, unite him with the Society of the Saints. ||2||4||84||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਆਪ ॥
transliteration: raakh leee apane jan aap ||
english: He Himself has saved His humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa har har naam deeno binas gae sabh sog sa(n)taap ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In His Mercy, the Lord, Har, Har, has blessed me with His Name, and all my pains and afflictions have been dispelled. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਆਲਾਪ ॥
transliteration: gun govi(n)d gaavahu sabh har jan raag ratan rasanaa aalaap ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, all you humble servants of the Lord; chant the jewels, the songs of the Lord with your tongue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਆਤਮ ਧ੍ਰਾਪ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kot janam kee trisanaa nivaree raam rasaain aatam dhraap ||1||
english: The desires of millions of incarnations shall be quenched, and your soul shall be satisfied with the sweet, sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪ ॥
transliteration: charan gahe saran sukhadaate gur kai bachan jape har jaap ||
english: I have grasped the Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet; He is the Giver of peace; through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, I meditate and chant the Chant of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰੇ ਭਰਮ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੫॥੮੫॥
transliteration: saagar tare bharam bhai binase kahu naanak thaakur parataap ||2||5||85||
english: I have crossed over the world-ocean, and my doubt and fear are dispelled, says Nanak, through the glorious granduer of our Lord and Master. ||2||5||85||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਪੁ ਲਾਹਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: taap laahiaa gur sirajanahaar ||
english: Through the Guru, the Creator Lord has subdued the fever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੀ ਸਾਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur apane kau bal jaaee jin paij rakhee saarai sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has saved the honor of the whole world. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਬਾਲਿਕੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ॥
transliteration: kar masatak dhaar baalik rakh leeno ||
english: Placing His Hand on the child's forehead, He saved him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਨੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh a(n)mrit naam mahaa ras deeno ||1||
english: God blessed me with the supreme, sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਖੈ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: daas kee laaj rakhai miharavaan ||
english: The Merciful Lord saves the honor of His slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੬॥੮੬॥
transliteration: gur naanak bolai daragah paravaan ||2||6||86||
english: Guru Nanak speaks - it is confirmed in the Court of the Lord. ||2||6||86||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 chaupade dupade ghar 7 ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay And Dho-Padhay, Seventh House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਜਾਰੋ ਦੀਪਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur sabad ujaaro deepaa ||
english: The Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, is the light of the lamp.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਤਿਹ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਖੁਲੑੀ ਅਨੂਪਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: binasio a(n)dhakaar tih ma(n)dar ratan kothaRee khulhee anoopaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It dispels the darkness from the body-mansion, and opens the beautiful chamber of jewels. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਜਉ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: bisaman bisam bhae jau pekhio kahan na jaai vadiaaee ||
english: I was wonderstruck and astonished, when I looked inside; I cannot even describe its glory and grandeur.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਊਹਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਲਪਟਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: magan bhae oohaa sa(n)g maate ot pot lapataaee ||1||
english: I am intoxicated and enraptured with it, and I am wrapped in it, through and through. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੂ ਜੰਜਾਰਾ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਭੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aal jaal nahee kachhoo ja(n)jaaraa aha(n)budh nahee bhoraa ||
english: No worldly entanglements or snares can trap me, and no trace of egotistical pride remains.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚਨ ਊਚਾ ਬੀਚੁ ਨ ਖੀਚਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: oochan oochaa beech na kheechaa hau teraa too(n) moraa ||2||
english: You are the highest of the high, and no curtain separates us; I am Yours, and You are mine. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ਏਕੈ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: eka(n)kaar ek paasaaraa ekai apar apaaraa ||
english: The One Creator Lord created the expanse of the one universe; the One Lord is unlimited and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਸੰਪੂਰਨੁ ਏਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ek bisatheeran ek sa(n)pooran ekai praan adhaaraa ||3||
english: The One Lord pervades the one universe; the One Lord is totally permeating everywhere; the One Lord is the Support of the breath of life. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੂਚੋ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੂਚੋ ਸੂਚਾ ॥
transliteration: niramal niramal soochaa soocho soochaa soocho soochaa ||
english: He is the most immaculate of the immaculate, the purest of the pure, so pure, so pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੮੭॥
transliteration: a(n)t na a(n)taa sadaa bea(n)taa kahu naanak oocho oochaa ||4||1||87||
english: He has no end or limitation; He is forever unlimited. Says Nanak, He is the highest of the high. ||4||1||87||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: bin har kaam na aavat he ||
english: Without the Lord, nothing is of any use.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚਿ ਮਾਚਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਲਾਗੇ ਓਹ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa siu raach maach tumh laage oh mohanee mohaavat he ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are totally attached to that Enticer Maya; she is enticing you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹਨੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: kanik kaaminee sej sohanee chhod khinai mahi jaavat he ||
english: You shall have to leave behind your gold, your woman and your beautiful bed; you shall have to depart in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਓ ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਖਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: urajh rahio i(n)dree ras prerio bikhai thagauree khaavat he ||1||
english: You are entangled in the lures of sexual pleasures, and you are eating poisonous drugs. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਲੈ ਜਰਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: trin ko ma(n)dar saaj savaario paavak talai jaraavat he ||
english: You have built and adorned a palace of straw, and under it, you light a fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਐਠਿ ਹਠੀਲੋ ਫੂਲਿ ਫੂਲਿ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aise gaR mahi aith hatheelo phool phool kiaa paavat he ||2||
english: Sitting all puffed-up in such a castle, you stubborn-minded fool, what do you think you will gain? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਮੂਡ ਪਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਕੇਸ ਗਹੇ ਫੇਰਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch doot mood par thaadhe kes gahe pheraavat he ||
english: The five thieves stand over your head and seize you. Grabbing you by your hair, they will drive you on.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਅੰਧ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਦ ਮਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: drisat na aavahi a(n)dh agiaanee soi rahio mad maavat he ||3||
english: You do not see them, you blind and ignorant fool; intoxicated with ego, you just keep sleeping. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਲੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਚੋਗ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੀ ਪੰਖੀ ਜਿਉ ਫਾਹਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: jaal pasaar chog bisathaaree pa(n)khee jiu phaahaavat he ||
english: The net has been spread out, and the bait has been scattered; like a bird, you are being trapped.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਨ ਕਉ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੮੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ba(n)dhan kaatan kau mai satigur purakh dhiaavat he ||4||2||88||
english: Says Nanak, my bonds have been broken; I meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being. ||4||2||88||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਮੋਲੀ ॥
transliteration: har har naam apaar amolee ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is infinite and priceless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਧਾਰੋ ਚੀਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਨ ਤੰਬੋਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: praan piaaro manahi adhaaro cheet chitavau jaise paan ta(n)bolee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It is the Beloved of my breath of life, and the Support of my mind; I remember it, as the betel leaf chewer remembers the betel leaf. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਚੋਲੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaj samaaio gurahi bataaio ra(n)g ra(n)gee mere tan kee cholee ||
english: I have been absorbed in celestial bliss, following the Guru's Teachings; my body-garment is imbued with the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੋ ਜਉ ਵਡਭਾਗੋ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਡੋਲੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pri mukh laago jau vadabhaago suhaag hamaaro katahu na dolee ||1||
english: I come face to face with my Beloved, by great good fortune; my Husband Lord never wavers. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਨ ਧੂਪ ਨ ਗੰਧ ਨ ਦੀਪਾ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਉਲੀ ॥
transliteration: roop na dhoop na ga(n)dh na deepaa ot pot a(n)g a(n)g sa(n)g maulee ||
english: I do not need any image, or incense, or perfume, or lamps; through and through, He is blossoming forth, with me, life and limb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰਵੀ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਨੀ ਖਟੋਲੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੮੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak pri ravee suhaagan at neekee meree banee khatolee ||2||3||89||
english: Says Nanak, my Husband Lord has ravished and enjoyed His soul-bride; my bed has become very beautiful and sublime. ||2||3||89||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਈ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d gobi(n)d gobi(n)d maee ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, Gobind, Gobind, Gobind, we become like Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆਰਾ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਭਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab te bhete saadh daiaaraa tab te duramat door bhaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Since I met the compassionate, Holy Saints, my evil-mindedness has been driven far away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਈ ॥
transliteration: pooran poor rahio sa(n)pooran seetal saa(n)t daiaal daee ||
english: The Perfect Lord is perfectly pervading everywhere. He is cool and calm, peaceful and compassionate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲ ਖਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaam krodh trisanaa aha(n)kaaraa tan te hoe sagal khaee ||1||
english: Sexual desire, anger and egotistical desires have all been eliminated from my body. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਲਈ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh daiaa dharam such sa(n)tan te ihu ma(n)t laee ||
english: Truth, contentment, compassion, Dharmic faith and purity - I have received these from the Teachings of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਗਲੀ ਸੋਝ ਪਈ ॥੨॥੪॥੯੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jin manahu pachhaaniaa tin kau sagalee sojh paee ||2||4||90||
english: Says Nanak, one who realizes this in his mind, achieves total understanding. ||2||4||90||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਬੇਚਾਰੇ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹ ਏਕ ਰੋਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa ham jee ja(n)t bechaare baran na saakah ek romaaee ||
english: What am I? Just a poor living being. I cannot even describe one of Your hairs, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਿਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: braham mahes sidh mun i(n)draa bea(n)t thaakur teree gat nahee paaee ||1||
english: Even Brahma, Shiva, the Siddhas and the silent sages do not know Your State, O Infinite Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa katheeai kichh kathan na jaaee ||
english: What can I say? I cannot say anything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jah jah dekhaa tah rahiaa samaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord pervading. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਦੂਖ ਜਮ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਤਹ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jah mahaa bhaiaan dookh jam suneeai tah mere prabh toohai sahaaee ||
english: And there, where the most terrible tortures are heard to be inflicted by the Messenger of Death, You are my only help and support, O my God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੯੧॥
transliteration: saran pario har charan gahe prabh gur naanak kau boojh bujhaaee ||2||5||91||
english: I have sought His Sanctuary, and grasped hold of the Lord's Lotus Feet; God has helped Guru Nanak to understand this understanding. ||2||5||91||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: agam roop abinaasee karataa patit pavit ik nimakh japaaeeai ||
english: O Inaccessible, Beautiful, Imperishable Creator Lord, Purifier of sinners, let me meditate on You, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਭੇਟੁਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਚਰਨ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: acharaj sunio paraapat bhetule sa(n)t charan charan man laaeeai ||1||
english: O Wondrous Lord, I have heard that You are found by meeting the Saints, and focusing the mind on their feet, their holy feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧੀਐ ਕਿਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kit bidheeai kit sa(n)jam paaeeai ||
english: In what way, and by what discipline, is He obtained?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਸੁਰਜਨ ਕਿਤੁ ਜੁਗਤੀ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kahu surajan kit jugatee dhiaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Tell me, O good man, by what means can we meditate on Him? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਓਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਲਈ ਲਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jo maanukh maanukh kee sevaa ohu tis kee laee laee phun jaaeeai ||
english: If one human being serves another human being, the one served stands by him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰੋ ਇਕ ਨਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੬॥੯੨॥
transliteration: naanak saran saran sukh saagar mohi tek tero ik naaeeai ||2||6||92||
english: Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary and Protection, O Lord, ocean of peace; He takes the Support of Your Name alone. ||2||6||92||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t saran sa(n)t tahal karee ||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of the Saints, and I serve the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧੁ ਬੰਧੁ ਅਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਰੋ ਅਵਰ ਕਾਜ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿ ਪਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dh ba(n)dh ar sagal ja(n)jaaro avar kaaj te chhoot paree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am rid of all worldly concerns, bonds, entanglements and other affairs. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਰੁ ਘਨੋ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj ar ghano ana(n)daa gur te paaio naam haree ||
english: I have obtained peace, poise and great bliss from the Guru, through the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਉਲਟਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aiso har ras baran na saakau gur poorai meree ulat dharee ||1||
english: Such is the sublime essence of the Lord, that I cannot describe it. The Perfect Guru has turned me away from the world. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿਓ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਗਲ ਭਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pekhio mohan sabh kai sa(n)ge oon na kaahoo sagal bharee ||
english: I behold the Fascinating Lord with everyone. No one is without Him - He is pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰੀ ॥੨॥੭॥੯੩॥
transliteration: pooran poor rahio kirapaa nidh kahu naanak meree pooree paree ||2||7||93||
english: The Perfect Lord, the treasure of mercy, is permeating everywhere. Says Nanak, I am fully fulfilled. ||2||7||93||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਤਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਤਾ ॥
transliteration: man kiaa kahataa hau kiaa kahataa ||
english: What does the mind say? What can I say?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaan prabeen thaakur prabh mere tis aagai kiaa kahataa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are wise and all-knowing, O God, my Lord and Master; what can I say to You? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਬੋਲੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਹੀ ਪਛਾਨਹਿ ਜੋ ਜੀਅਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
transliteration: anabole kau tuhee pachhaanahi jo jeean mahi hotaa ||
english: You know even what is not said, whatever is in the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾਇ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਡਹਕਹਿ ਜਉ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਨਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: re man kaai kahaa lau dahakahi jau pekhat hee sa(n)g sunataa ||1||
english: O mind, why do you deceive others? How long will you do this? The Lord is with you; He hears and sees everything. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਜਾਨਿ ਭਏ ਮਨਿ ਆਨਦ ਆਨ ਨ ਬੀਓ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aiso jaan bhae man aanad aan na beeo karataa ||
english: Knowing this, my mind has become blissful; there is no other Creator.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਲਹਤਾ ॥੨॥੮॥੯੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur bhae daiaaraa har ra(n)g na kabahoo lahataa ||2||8||94||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has become kind to me; my love for the Lord shall never wear off. ||2||8||94||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਐਸੇ ਹੀ ਝਰਿ ਪਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak aise hee jhar pareeai ||
english: Thus, the slanderer crumbles away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਕਾਲਰ ਭੀਤਿ ਗਿਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ih neesaanee sunahu tum bhaaee jiu kaalar bheet gireeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This is the distinctive sign - listen, O Siblings of Destiny: he collapses like a wall of sand. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਤਉ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਉਮਾਹੈ ਭਲੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਭਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jau dekhai chhidr tau ni(n)dak umaahai bhalo dekh dukh bhareeai ||
english: When the slanderer sees a fault in someone else, he is pleased. Seeing goodness, he is depressed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aath pahar chitavai nahee pahuchai buraa chitavat chitavat mareeai ||1||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, he plots, but nothing works. The evil man dies, constantly thinking up evil plans. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਨੇਰੈ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਦੁ ਉਠਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak prabhoo bhulaaiaa kaal nerai aaiaa har jan siu baad uthareeai ||
english: The slanderer forgets God, death approaches him, and he starts to argue with the humble servant of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਨਸ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਰੀਐ ॥੨॥੯॥੯੫॥
transliteration: naanak kaa raakhaa aap prabh suaamee kiaa maanas bapure kareeai ||2||9||95||
english: God Himself, the Lord and Master, is Nanak's protector. What can any wretched person do to him? ||2||9||95||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aise kaahe bhool pare ||
english: Why do you wander in delusion like this?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਮੂਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karahi karaavahi mookar paavahi pekhat sunat sadaa sa(n)g hare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You act, and incite others to act, and then deny it. The Lord is always with you; He sees and hears everything. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚ ਬਿਹਾਝਨ ਕੰਚਨ ਛਾਡਨ ਬੈਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਸਾਜਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaach bihaajhan ka(n)chan chhaadan bairee sa(n)g het saajan tiaag khare ||
english: You purchase glass, and discard gold; you are in love with your enemy, while you renounce your true friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਵਨੁ ਕਉਰਾ ਅਨਹੋਵਨੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਇ ਜਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hovan kauraa anahovan meethaa bikhiaa mahi lapataai jare ||1||
english: That which exists, seems bitter; that which does not exist, seems sweet to you. Engrossed in corruption, you are burning away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਪਰਾਨੀ ਭਰਮ ਗੁਬਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop mahi pario paraanee bharam gubaar moh ba(n)dh pare ||
english: The mortal has fallen into the deep, dark pit, and is entangled in the darkness of doubt, and the bondage of emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਤ ਦਇਆਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਕਾਢੈ ਬਾਹ ਫਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੯੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh hot daiaaraa gur bhetai kaadhai baah phare ||2||10||96||
english: Says Nanak, when God becomes merciful, one meets with the Guru, who takes him by the arm, and lifts him out. ||2||10||96||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਚੀਨੑਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan rasanaa har cheenhaa ||
english: With my mind, body and tongue, I remember the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhae ana(n)daa mite a(n)dese sarab sookh mo kau gur deenhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am in ecstasy, and my anxieties are dispelled; the Guru has blessed me with total peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਆਨਪ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਭਈ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: iaanap te sabh bhaee siaanap prabh meraa daanaa beenaa ||
english: My ignorance has been totally transformed into wisdom. My God is wise and all-knowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਖੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haath dei raakhai apane kau kaahoo na karate kachh kheenaa ||1||
english: Giving me His Hand, He saved me, and now no one can harm me at all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bal jaavau darasan saadhoo kai jih prasaad har naam leenaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Holy; by their Grace, I contemplate the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਰੋਸੈ ਕਹੂ ਨ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਛੀਨਾ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੯੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak thaakur bhaarosai kahoo na maanio man chheenaa ||2||11||97||
english: Says Nanak, I place my faith in my Lord and Master; within my mind, I do not believe in any other, even for an instant. ||2||11||97||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਖਿ ਲਈ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai meree raakh laee ||
english: The Perfect Guru has has saved me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam ride mahi deeno janam janam kee mail gaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He has enshrined the Ambrosial Name of the Lord within my heart, and the filth of countless incarnations has been washed away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਵਰੇ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾ ਜਪਿਆ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: nivare doot dusat bairaaee gur poore kaa japiaa jaap ||
english: The demons and wicked enemies are driven out, by meditating, and chanting the Chant of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾ ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahaa karai koee bechaaraa prabh mere kaa bad parataap ||1||
english: What can any wretched creature do to me? The radiance of my God is gloriously great. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: simar simar simar sukh paaiaa charan kamal rakh man maahee ||
english: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance, I have found peace; I have enshrined His Lotus Feet within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੯੮॥
transliteration: taa kee saran pario naanak daas jaa te oopar ko naahee ||2||12||98||
english: Slave Nanak has entered His Sanctuary; there is none above Him. ||2||12||98||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa japeeai prabh naam ||
english: Forever and ever, chant the Name of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaraa maraa kachh dookh na biaapai aagai daragah pooran kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The pains of old age and death shall not afflict you, and in the Court of the Lord hereafter, your affairs shall be perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਪਰੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਸਰਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aap tiaag pareeai nit saranee gur te paaeeai ehu nidhaan ||
english: So forsake your self-conceit, and ever seek Sanctuary. This treasure is obtained only from the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਾਸੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam maran kee kateeai phaasee saachee daragah kaa neesaan ||1||
english: The noose of birth and death is snapped; this is the insignia, the hallmark, of the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਉ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ਸਗਲ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jo tumh karahu soee bhal maanau man te chhootai sagal gumaan ||
english: Whatever You do, I accept as good. I have eradicated all egotistical pride from my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੯੯॥
transliteration: kahu naanak taa kee saranaaee jaa kaa keeaa sagal jahaan ||2||13||99||
english: Says Nanak, I am under His protection; He created the entire Universe. ||2||13||99||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਹੀ ॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar prabh aahee ||
english: Deep within the nucleus of his mind and body, is God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਨਿਤ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੋਲੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavat paraupakaar nit tis rasanaa kaa mol kichh naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He continually sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and always does good for others; his tongue is priceless. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kul samooh udhare khin bheetar janam janam kee mal laahee ||
english: All his generations are redeemed and saved in an instant, and the filth of countless incarnations is washed away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਨੁ ਗਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: simar simar suaamee prabh apanaa anad setee bikhiaa ban gaahee ||1||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, his Lord and Master, he passes blissfully through the forest of poison. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੇ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: charan prabhoo ke bohith paae bhav saagar paar paraahee ||
english: I have obtained the boat of God's Feet, to carry me across the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੧੦੦॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sevak bhagat har taa ke naanak man laagaa hai taahee ||2||14||100||
english: The Saints, servants and devotees belong to the Lord; Nanak's mind is attached to Him. ||2||14||100||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੀਰਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: dheerau dekh tumhaare ra(n)gaa ||
english: I am reassured, gazing upon Your wondrous play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਹੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਤੂਹੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tuhee suaamee a(n)tarajaamee toohee vasahi saadh kai sa(n)gaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are my Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; You dwell with the Holy Saints. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨੀਚ ਕੀਟ ਤੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਾਜੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khin mahi thaap nivaaje thaakur neech keet te karahi raaja(n)gaa ||1||
english: In an instant, our Lord and Master establishes and exalts. From a lowly worm, He creates a king. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਹੀਏ ਮੋਰੇ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਇਹੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੧੦੧॥
transliteration: kabahoo na bisarai heee more te naanak daas ihee daan ma(n)gaa ||2||15||101||
english: May I never forget You from my heart; slave Nanak prays for this blessing. ||2||15||101||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚੁਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੋਗ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: achut poojaa jog gopaal ||
english: The imperishable Lord God is worthy of worship and adoration.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਰਖਉ ਹਰਿ ਆਗੈ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man tan arap rakhau har aagai sarab jeeaa kaa hai pratipaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Dedicating my mind and body, I place them before the Lord, the Cherisher of all beings. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਸਮ੍ਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਬਡੋ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: saran samrath akath sukhadaataa kirapaa si(n)dh bado daiaal ||
english: His Sanctuary is All-powerful; He cannot be described; He is the Giver of peace, the ocean of mercy, supremely compassionate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਾਤੀ ਬਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ka(n)th laai raakhai apane kau tis no lagai na taatee baal ||1||
english: Holding him close in His embrace, the Lord protects and saves him, and then even the hot wind cannot touch him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥
transliteration: daamodar daiaal suaamee sarabas sa(n)t janaa dhan maal ||
english: Our Merciful Lord and Master is wealth, property and everything to His humble Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਗੈ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੧੦੨॥
transliteration: naanak jaachik daras prabh maagai sa(n)t janaa kee milai ravaal ||2||16||102||
english: Nanak, a beggar, asks for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; please, bless him with the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||16||102||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: simarat naam kot jatan bhae ||
english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is equal to millions of efforts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਜਮਦੂਤਨ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਅਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mil har gun gaae jamadootan kau traas ahe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and the Messenger of Death will be frightened away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨ ਸੇ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ॥
transliteration: jete punahacharan se keenhe man tan prabh ke charan gahe ||
english: To enshrine the Feet of God in one's mind and body, is to perform all sorts of acts of atonement.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਨਾਠਾ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aavan jaan bharam bhau naathaa janam janam ke kilavikh dahe ||1||
english: Coming and going, doubt and fear have run away, and the sins of countless incarnations are burnt away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਭਜਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ਏਹੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਲਹੇ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau hoi bhajahu jagadeesai ehu padaarath vadabhaag lahe ||
english: So become fearless, and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe. This is true wealth, obtained only by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕਹੇ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੧੦੩॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa pooran prabh daate niramal jas naanak daas kahe ||2||17||103||
english: Be merciful, O Perfect God, Great Giver, that slave Nanak may chant Your immaculate Praises. ||2||17||103||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਲਹੀ ਤੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: sulahee te naaraain raakh ||
english: The Lord saved me from Sulhi Khan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਲਹੀ ਕਾ ਹਾਥੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਸੁਲਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਮੂਆ ਨਾਪਾਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sulahee kaa haath kahee na pahuchai sulahee hoi mooaa naapaak ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The emperor did not succeed in his plot, and he died in disgrace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਖਸਮਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: kaadh kuthaar khasam sir kaatiaa khin mahi hoi gaiaa hai khaak ||
english: The Lord and Master raised His axe, and chopped off his head; in an instant, he was reduced to dust. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਪਚਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਧਾਕੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ma(n)daa chitavat chitavat pachiaa jin rachiaa tin deenaa dhaak ||1||
english: Plotting and planning evil, he was destroyed. The One who created him, gave him a push.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮੀਤ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਭ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: putr meet dhan kichhoo na rahio s chhod gaiaa sabh bhaaee saak ||
english: Of his sons, friends and wealth, nothing remains; he departed, leaving behind all his brothers and relatives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਪੂਰਨ ਵਾਕੁ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੧੦੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tis prabh balihaaree jin jan kaa keeno pooran vaak ||2||18||104||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to God, who fulfilled the word of His slave. ||2||18||104||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kee pooree sev ||
english: Perfect is service to the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aape aap varatai suaamee kaaraj raas keeaa guradev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Our Lord and Master Himself is Himself all-pervading. The Divine Guru has resolved all my affairs. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਨਾਇਓ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aad madh prabh a(n)t suaamee apanaa thaat banaaio aap ||
english: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, God is our only Lord and Master. He Himself fashioned His Creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੋ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apane sevak kee aape raakhai prabh mere ko vad parataap ||1||
english: He Himself saves His servant. Great is the glorious grandeur of my God! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੰਤ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham paramesur satigur vas keenhe jin sagale ja(n)t ||
english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord is the True Guru; all beings are in His power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੧੦੫॥
transliteration: charan kamal naanak saranaaee raam naam jap niramal ma(n)t ||2||19||105||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet, chanting the Lord's Name, the immaculate Mantra. ||2||19||105||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਆਪ ॥
transliteration: taap paap te raakhe aap ||
english: He Himself protects me from suffering and sin.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: seetal bhae gur charanee laage raam naam hirade mahi jaap ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Falling at the Guru's Feet, I am cooled and soothed; I meditate on the Lord's Name within my heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਸਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa hasat prabh deene jagat udhaar nav kha(n)d prataap ||
english: Granting His Mercy, God has extended His Hands. He is the Emancipator of the World; His glorious radiance pervades the nine continents.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਅਨਦ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸਚੁ ਧ੍ਰਾਪ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dukh binase sukh anad pravesaa trisan bujhee man tan sach dhraap ||1||
english: My pain has been dispelled, and peace and pleasure have come; my desire is quenched, and my mind and body are truly satisfied. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੋ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: anaath ko naath saran samarathaa sagal srisat ko maaee baap ||
english: He is the Master of the masterless, All-powerful to give Sanctuary. He is the Mother and Father of the whole Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਲਾਪ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੧੦੬॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal bhai bha(n)jan suaamee gun gaavat naanak aalaap ||2||20||106||
english: He is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear; Nanak sings and chants the Glorious Praises of his Lord and Master. ||2||20||106||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jis te upajiaa tisahi pachhaan ||
english: Acknowledge the One, from whom You originated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਹੋਏ ਕਲਿਆਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham paramesar dhiaaiaa kusal khem hoe kaliaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating on the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, I have found peace, pleasure and salvation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਬਡ ਭਾਗੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa bhetio bad bhaagee a(n)tarajaamee sughaR sujaan ||
english: I met the Perfect Guru, by great good fortune, and so found the wise and all-knowing Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਬਡ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haath dei raakhe kar apane bad samarath nimaaniaa ko maan ||1||
english: He gave me His Hand, and making me His own, He saved me; He is absolutely all-powerful, the honor of the dishonored. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਚਾਨਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: bhram bhai binas gae khin bheetar a(n)dhakaar pragate chaanaan ||
english: Doubt and fear have been dispelled in an instant, and in the darkness, the Divine Light shines forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੧੦੭॥
transliteration: saas saas aaraadhai naanak sadaa sadaa jaaeeai kurabaan ||2||21||107||
english: With each and every breath, Nanak worships and adores the Lord; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||2||21||107||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੋਵੈ ਥਾਵ ਰਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dovai thaav rakhe gur soore ||
english: Both here and hereafter, the Mighty Guru protects me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤ ਪਲਤ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: halat palat paarabraham savaare kaaraj hoe sagale poore ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God has embellished this world and the next for me, and all my affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਜਨੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japat sukh sahaje majan hovat saadhoo dhoore ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have found peace and poise, bathing in the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਬਿਸੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aavan jaan rahe thit paaee janam maran ke mite bisoore ||1||
english: Comings and goings have ceased, and I have found stability; the pains of birth and death are eradicated. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਤਰੇ ਛੁਟੇ ਭੈ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਏਕੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bhram bhai tare chhute bhai jam ke ghat ghat ek rahiaa bharapoore ||
english: I cross over the ocean of doubt and fear, and the fear of death is gone; the One Lord is permeating and pervading in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥੨॥੨੨॥੧੦੮॥
transliteration: naanak saran pario dukh bha(n)jan a(n)tar baahar pekh hajoore ||2||22||108||
english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of pain; I behold His Presence deep within, and all around as well. ||2||22||108||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਤ ਦੋਖ ਨਸੇ ॥
transliteration: darasan dekhat dokh nase ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, all pains run away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kabahu na hovahu drisat agochar jee kai sa(n)g base ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please, never leave my vision, O Lord; please abide with my soul. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: preetam praan adhaar suaamee ||
english: My Beloved Lord and Master is the Support of the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poor rahe prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||1||
english: God, the Inner-knower, is all-pervading. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kiaa gun tere saar samhaaree ||
english: Which of Your Glorious Virtues should I contemplate and remember?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saas saas prabh tujhahi chitaaree ||2||
english: With each and every breath, O God, I remember You. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa nidh prabh deen daiaalaa ||
english: God is the ocean of mercy, merciful to the meek;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t kee karahu pratipaalaa ||3||
english: He cherishes all beings and creatures. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar teraa naam jan jaape ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, Your humble servant chants Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੧੦੯॥
transliteration: naanak preet laaee prabh aape ||4||23||109||
english: You Yourself, O God, have inspired Nanak to love You. ||4||23||109||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਚਲਤ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tan dhan joban chalat gaiaa ||
english: Body, wealth and youth pass away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਭਜਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam kaa bhajan na keeno karat bikaar nis bhor bhaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You have not meditated and vibrated upon the Lord's Name; while you commit your sins of corruption in the night, the light of day dawns upon you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਭੋਜਨ ਨਿਤ ਖਾਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਦੰਤਾ ਘਸਿ ਖੀਨ ਖਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anik prakaar bhojan nit khaate mukh da(n)taa ghas kheen khaiaa ||
english: Continually eating all sorts of foods, the teeth in your mouth crumble, decay and fall out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਠਉ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤ ਨਹ ਪਰੀ ਦਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: meree meree kar kar moothau paap karat nah paree daiaa ||1||
english: Living in egotism and possessiveness, you are deluded; committing sins, you have no kindness for others. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਘੋਰ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗਲਤੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa bikaar ghor dukh saagar tis mahi praanee galat paiaa ||
english: The great sins are the terrible ocean of pain; the mortal is engrossed in them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੨॥੨੪॥੧੧੦॥
transliteration: saran pare naanak suaamee kee baah pakar prabh kaadh laiaa ||2||24||110||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master; taking him by the arm, God has lifted him up and out. ||2||24||110||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇਆ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa prabh aaiaa cheet ||
english: God Himself has come into my consciousness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੁਸਟ ਰਹੇ ਝਖ ਮਾਰਤ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dusaman dusat rahe jhakh maarat kusal bhaiaa mere bhaaee meet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My enemies and opponents have grown weary of attacking me, and now, I have become happy, O my friends and Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੀ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gaee biaadh upaadh sabh naasee a(n)geekaar keeo karataar ||
english: The disease is gone, and all misfortunes have been averted; the Creator Lord has made me His own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਅਰੁ ਅਨਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saa(n)t sookh ar anad ghanere preetam naam ridai ur haar ||1||
english: I have found peace, tranquility and total bliss, enshrining the Name of my Beloved Lord within my heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d dhan raas prabh teree too(n) samarath suaamee meraa ||
english: My soul, body and wealth are all Your capital; O God, You are my All-powerful Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਚੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੨੫॥੧੧੧॥
transliteration: daas apune kau raakhanahaaraa naanak daas sadaa hai cheraa ||2||25||111||
english: You are the Saving Grace of Your slaves; slave Nanak is forever Your slave. ||2||25||111||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਕਲਿਆਣੁ ॥
transliteration: gobid simar hoaa kaliaan ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe, I am emancipated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੀ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mitee upaadh bhaiaa sukh saachaa a(n)tarajaamee simariaa jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Suffering is eradicated, and true peace has come, meditating on the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਸੁਖਾਲੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jis ke jee tin keee sukhaale bhagat janaa kau saachaa taan ||
english: All beings belong to Him - He makes them happy. He is the true power of His humble devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੀ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daas apune kee aape raakhee bhai bha(n)jan oopar karate maan ||1||
english: He Himself saves and protects His slaves, who believe in their Creator, the Destroyer of fear. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ਮਿਟੀ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਦ੍ਰੁਸਟ ਦੂਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਛਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: bhaee mitraaee mitee buraaee drusat doot har kaadhe chhaan ||
english: I have found friendship, and hatred has been eradicated; the Lord has rooted out the enemies and villains.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਹ ਵਖਾਣਿ ॥੨॥੨੬॥੧੧੨॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ghanere naanak jeevai har gunah vakhaan ||2||26||112||
english: Nanak has been blessed with celestial peace and poise and total bliss; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, he lives. ||2||26||112||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh bhae kripaal ||
english: The Supreme Lord God has become Merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaaraj sagal savaare satigur jap jap saadhoo bhae nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru has arranged all my affairs; chanting and meditating with the Holy Saints, I have become happy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਭਏ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeaa prabh apanai dokhee sagale bhae ravaal ||
english: God has made me His own, and all my enemies have been reduced to dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਉਧਰਿ ਲੀਏ ਲਾਇ ਅਪਨੈ ਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ka(n)th laai raakhe jan apane udhar leee laai apanai paal ||1||
english: He hugs us close in His embrace, and protects His humble servants; attaching us to the hem of His robe, he saves us. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sahee salaamat mil ghar aae ni(n)dak ke mukh hoe kaal ||
english: Safe and sound, we have returned home, while the slanderer's face is blackened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੨੭॥੧੧੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak meraa satigur pooraa gur prasaad prabh bhae nihaal ||2||27||113||
english: Says Nanak, my True Guru is Perfect; by the Grace of God and Guru, I am so happy. ||2||27||113||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂ ਲਾਲਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: moo laalan siu preet banee || rahaau ||
english: I have fallen in love with my Beloved Lord. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੋਰੀ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਛੋਰੀ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਐਸੀ ਮਾਧੋ ਖਿੰਚ ਤਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: toree na tootai chhoree na chhootai aisee maadho khi(n)ch tanee ||1||
english: Cutting it, it does not break, and releasing it, it does not let go. Such is the string the Lord has tied me with. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dinas rain man maahi basat hai too kar kirapaa prabh apanee ||2||
english: Day and night, He dwells within my mind; please bless me with Your Mercy, O my God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਸਿਆਮ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਕਉ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bal bal jaau siaam su(n)dar kau akath kathaa jaa kee baat sunee ||3||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my beauteous Lord; I have heard his Unspoken Speech and Story. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੀ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੧੧੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak daasan daas kaheeat hai mohi karahu kripaa thaakur apunee ||4||28||114||
english: Servant Nanak is said to be the slave of His slaves; O my Lord and Master, please bless me with Your Mercy. ||4||28||114||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਂਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: har ke charan jap jaa(n)u kurabaan ||
english: I meditate on the Lord's Feet; I am a sacrifice to Them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਰਿ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur meraa paarabraham paramesur taa kaa hiradai dhar man dhiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; I enshrine Him within my heart, and meditate on Him within my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: simar simar simar sukhadaataa jaa kaa keeaa sagal jahaan ||
english: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Giver of peace, who created the whole Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਵਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rasanaa ravahu ek naaraain saachee daragah paavahu maan ||1||
english: With your tongue, savor the One Lord, and you shall be honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g paraapat jaa kau tin hee paaiaa ehu nidhaan ||
english: He alone obtains this treasure, who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੨੯॥੧੧੫॥
transliteration: gaavau gun keeratan nit suaamee kar kirapaa naanak deejai daan ||2||29||115||
english: O Lord and Master, mercifully bless Nanak with this gift, that he may ever sing the Glorious Praises of Your Kirtan. ||2||29||115||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣ ॥
transliteration: raakh leee satigur kee saran ||
english: I have been saved, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar hoaa jag a(n)tar paarabraham mero taaran taran ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am cheered and applauded throughout the world; my Supreme Lord God carries me across. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸ੍ਵੰਭਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਪੋਖਣ ਭਰਣ ॥
transliteration: bisva(n)bhar pooran sukhadaataa sagal samagree pokhan bharan ||
english: The Perfect Lord fills the Universe; He is the Giver of peace; He cherishes and fulfills the whole Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ॥੧॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar bal bal jaa(n)ee har ke charan ||1||
english: He is completely filling all places and interspaces; I am a devoted sacrifice to the Lord's Feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ॥
transliteration: jee jugat vas mere suaamee sarab sidh tum kaaran karan ||
english: The ways of all beings are in Your Power, O my Lord and Master. All supernatural spiritual powers are Yours; You are the Creator, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਡਰਣ ॥੨॥੩੦॥੧੧੬॥
transliteration: aad jugaad prabh rakhadaa aaiaa har simarat naanak nahee daran ||2||30||116||
english: In the beginning, and throughout the ages, God is our Savior and Protector; remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak, fear is eliminated. ||2||30||116||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੮ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 dupade ghar 8 ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay, Eighth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mai naahee prabh sabh kichh teraa ||
english: I am nothing, God; everything is Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਘੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਊਘੈ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਕੇਲ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਚਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: eeghai niragun ooghai saragun kel karat bich suaamee meraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In this world, You are the absolute, formless Lord; in the world hereafter, You are the related Lord of form. You play it both ways, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਪਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੋ ਸਗਲ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: nagar mahi aap baahar phun aapan prabh mere ko sagal baseraa ||
english: You exist within the city, and beyond it as well; O my God, You are everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਾਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਾਇਆ ਕਹ ਕਹ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਹ ਕਹ ਚੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape hee raajan aape hee raaiaa kah kah thaakur kah kah cheraa ||1||
english: You Yourself are the King, and You Yourself are the subject. In one place, You are the Lord and Master, and in another place, You are the slave. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੁਰਾਉ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਲਬੰਚਾ ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaa kau duraau kaa siu balaba(n)chaa jah jah pekhau tah tah neraa ||
english: From whom should I hide? Whom should I try to deceive? Wherever I look, I see Him near at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਨਹੀ ਅਨ ਹੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੧੭॥
transliteration: saadh moorat gur bhetio naanak mil saagar boo(n)d nahee an heraa ||2||1||117||
english: I have met with Guru Nanak, the Embodiment of the Holy Saints. When the drop of water merges into the ocean, it cannot be distinguished as separate again. ||2||1||117||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ॥
transliteration: tumh samarathaa kaaran karan ||
english: You are the all-powerful Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਢਾਕਨ ਢਾਕਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਸਰਨ ਚਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhaakan dhaak gobid gur mere mohi aparaadhee saran charan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please cover my faults, Lord of the Universe, O my Guru; I am a sinner - I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਠਉਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਢੀਠ ਮੁਕਰਨ ॥
transliteration: jo jo keeno so tumh jaanio pekhio thaur naahee kachh dheeth mukaran ||
english: Whatever we do, You see and know; there is no way anyone can stubbornly deny this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑਰੋ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘਾ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bad parataap sunio prabh tumhro kot aghaa tero naam haran ||1||
english: Your glorious radiance is great! So I have heard, O God. Millions of sins are destroyed by Your Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੋ ਸਹਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਭੂਲਨ ਤੁਮੑਰੋ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰਨ ॥
transliteration: hamaro sahaau sadaa sad bhoolan tumhro birad patit udharan ||
english: It is my nature to make mistakes, forever and ever; it is Your Natural Way to save sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧੮॥
transliteration: karunaa mai kirapaal kripaa nidh jeevan pad naanak har darasan ||2||2||118||
english: You are the embodiment of kindness, and the treasure of compassion, O Merciful Lord; through the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, Nanak has found the state of redemption in life. ||2||2||118||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aisee kirapaa mohi karahu ||
english: Bless me with such mercy, Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਚਰਣ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਮਾਥਾ ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸੁ ਤਨਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tah charan hamaaro maathaa nain daras tan dhoor parahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: that my forehead may touch the feet of the Saints, and my eyes may behold the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, and my body may fall at the dust of their feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਬਾਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: gur ko sabad merai heearai baasai har naamaa man sa(n)g dharahu ||
english: May the Word of the Guru's Shabad abide within my heart, and the Lord's Name be enshrined within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਨਿਵਾਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਗਲੋ ਭਰਮਾ ਹੋਮਿ ਜਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tasakar pa(n)ch nivaarahu thaakur sagalo bharamaa hom jarahu ||1||
english: Drive out the five thieves, O my Lord and Master, and let my doubts all burn like incense. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ਭਾਵਨੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਟਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jo tumh karahu soee bhal maanai bhaavan dubidhaa door tarahu ||
english: Whatever You do, I accept as good; I have driven out the sense of duality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਦਾਤੇ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਧਰਹੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak ke prabh tum hee daate sa(n)tasa(n)g le mohi udharahu ||2||3||119||
english: You are Nanak's God, the Great Giver; in the Congregation of the Saints, emancipate me. ||2||3||119||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਮੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: aisee deekhiaa jan siu ma(n)gaa ||
english: I ask for such advice from Your humble servants,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: tumhro dhiaan tumhaaro ra(n)gaa ||
english: that I may meditate on You, and love You,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਅੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tumhree sevaa tumhaare a(n)gaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and serve You, and become part and parcel of Your Being. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਸੰਭਾਖਨੁ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਊਠਨੁ ਬੈਠਨੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jan kee tahal sa(n)bhaakhan jan siu oothan baithan jan kai sa(n)gaa ||
english: I serve His humble servants, and speak with them, and abide with them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਚਰ ਰਜ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਨੰਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan char raj mukh maathai laagee aasaa pooran ana(n)t tara(n)gaa ||1||
english: I apply the dust of the feet of His humble servants to my face and forehead; my hopes, and the many waves of desire, are fulfilled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੋਟਿ ਗੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jan paarabraham jaa kee niramal mahimaa jan ke charan teerath kot ga(n)gaa ||
english: Immaculate and pure are the praises of the humble servants of the Supreme Lord God; the feet of His humble servants are equal to millions of sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਹਰੇ ਕਲੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੨੦॥
transliteration: jan kee dhoor keeo majan naanak janam janam ke hare kala(n)gaa ||2||4||120||
english: Nanak bathes in the dust of the feet of His humble servants; the sinful resides of countless incarnations have been washed away. ||2||4||120||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu mohi pratipaal ||
english: If it pleases You, then cherish me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮੑ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham paramesar satigur ham baarik tumh pitaa kirapaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Supreme Lord God, Transcendent Lord, O True Guru, I am Your child, and You are my Merciful Father. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਘਾਲ ॥
transliteration: mohi niragun gun naahee koee pahuch na saakau tumhree ghaal ||
english: I am worthless; I have no virtues at all. I cannot understand Your actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਮਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tumaree gat mit tum hee jaanahu jeeu pi(n)d sabh tumaro maal ||1||
english: You alone know Your state and extent. My soul, body and property are all Yours. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਨਬੋਲਤ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee purakh suaamee anabolat hee jaanahu haal ||
english: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Primal Lord and Master; You know even what is unspoken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੨੧॥
transliteration: tan man seetal hoi hamaaro naanak prabh jeeu nadar nihaal ||2||5||121||
english: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, O Nanak, by God's Glance of Grace. ||2||5||121||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੈ ਸਾਥ ॥
transliteration: raakh sadaa prabh apanai saath ||
english: Keep me with You forever, O God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਹਮਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਮੋਹਨੁ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too hamaro preetam manamohan tujh bin jeevan sagal akaath ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are my Beloved, the Enticer of my mind; without You, my life is totally useless. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਕ ਤੇ ਰਾਉ ਕਰਤ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)k te raau karat khin bheetar prabh mero anaath ko naath ||
english: In an instant, You transform the beggar into a king; O my God, You are the Master of the masterless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਤ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jalat agan mahi jan aap udhaare kar apune de raakhe haath ||1||
english: You save Your humble servants from the burning fire; You make them Your own, and with Your Hand, You protect them. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਾਥ ॥
transliteration: seetal sukh paaio man tripate har simarat sram sagale laath ||
english: I have found peace and cool tranquility, and my mind is satisfied; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, all struggles are ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਥ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨੨॥
transliteration: nidh nidhaan naanak har sevaa avar siaanap sagal akaath ||2||6||122||
english: Service to the Lord, O Nanak, is the treasure of treasures; all other clever tricks are useless. ||2||6||122||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: apane sevak kau kabahu na bisaarahu ||
english: Never forget Your servant, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਰਿ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ur laagahu suaamee prabh mere poorab preet gobi(n)d beechaarahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Hug me close in Your embrace, O God, my Lord and Master; consider my primal love for You, O Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਹਮਰੇ ਦੋਖ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਤ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan prabh birad tumhaaro hamare dokh ridai mat dhaarahu ||
english: It is Your Natural Way, God, to purify sinners; please do not keep my errors in Your Heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਟਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeevan praan har dhan sukh tum hee haumai patal kripaa kar jaarahu ||1||
english: You are my life, my breath of life, O Lord, my wealth and peace; be merciful to me, and burn away the curtain of egotism. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਮੀਨ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੂਧ ਬਿਨਾ ਰਹਨੁ ਕਤ ਬਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: jal bihoon meen kat jeevan doodh binaa rahan kat baaro ||
english: Without water, how can the fish survive? Without milk, how can the baby survive?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਨੑ ਕੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak piaas charan kamalanh kee pekh daras suaamee sukh saaro ||2||7||123||
english: Servant Nanak thirsts for the Lord's Lotus Feet; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of his Lord and Master's Darshan, he finds the essence of peace. ||2||7||123||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aagai paachhai kusal bhaiaa ||
english: Here, and hereafter, there is happiness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai pooree sabh raakhee paarabraham prabh keenee maiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has perfectly, totally saved me; the Supreme Lord God has been kind to me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਸਗਲਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man tan rav rahiaa har preetam dookh darad sagalaa mit gaiaa ||
english: The Lord, my Beloved, is pervading and permeating my mind and body; all my pains and sufferings are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਏ ਖਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saa(n)t sahaj aanad gun gaae doot dusat sabh hoe khaiaa ||1||
english: In celestial peace, tranquility and bliss, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; my enemies and adversaries have been totally destroyed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗੁਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gun avagun prabh kachh na beechaario kar kirapaa apunaa kar laiaa ||
english: God has not considered my merits and demerits; in His Mercy, He has made me His own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤੁਲ ਬਡਾਈ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਜਇਆ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨੪॥
transliteration: atul badaaee achut abinaasee naanak ucharai har kee jaiaa ||2||8||124||
english: Unweighable is the greatness of the immovable and imperishable Lord; Nanak proclaims the victory of the Lord. ||2||8||124||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਤਰਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
transliteration: bin bhai bhagatee taran kaise ||
english: Without the Fear of God, and devotional worship, how can anyone cross over the world-ocean?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪ ਭਰੋਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karahu anugrahu patit udhaaran raakh suaamee aap bharose ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Be kind to me, O Saving Grace of sinners; preserve my faith in You, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਮਦ ਮਾਵਤ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੁਆਨ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
transliteration: simaran nahee aavat phirat mad maavat bikhiaa raataa suaan jaise ||
english: The mortal does not remember the Lord in meditation; he wanders around intoxicated by egotism; he is engrossed in corruption like a dog.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਵਤ ਅਧਿਕ ਮੋਹਾਵਤ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਬੁਡੇ ਐਸੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: audh bihaavat adhik mohaavat paap kamaavat bude aise ||1||
english: Utterly cheated, his life is slipping away; committing sins, he is sinking away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਵਣੁ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
transliteration: saran dukh bha(n)jan purakh nira(n)jan saadhoo sa(n)gat ravan jaise ||
english: I have come to Your Sanctuary, Destroyer of pain; O Primal Immaculate Lord, may I dwell upon You in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਸਵ ਕਲੇਸ ਨਾਸ ਅਘ ਖੰਡਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਸੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੨੫॥
transliteration: kesav kales naas agh kha(n)dan naanak jeevat daras dise ||2||9||125||
english: O Lord of beautiful hair, Destroyer of pain, Eradicator of sins, Nanak lives, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||9||125||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੯ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 dupade ghar 9 ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay, Ninth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ॥
transliteration: aapahi mel lae ||
english: He Himself merges us with Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਆਏ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab te saran tumaaree aae tab te dokh gae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When I came to Your Sanctuary, my sins vanished. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਚਿੰਤ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ ਸਾਧਹ ਸਰਨ ਪਏ ॥
transliteration: taj abhimaan ar chi(n)t biraanee saadhah saran pae ||
english: Renouncing egotistical pride and other anxieties, I have sought the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਰੋਗ ਖਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jap jap naam tumhaaro preetam tan te rog khae ||1||
english: Chanting, meditating on Your Name, O my Beloved, disease is eradicated from my body. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਨ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਰਾਖੇ ਧਾਰਿ ਦਏ ॥
transliteration: mahaa mugadh ajaan agiaanee raakhe dhaar dae ||
english: Even utterly foolish, ignorant and thoughtless persons have been saved by the Kind Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨ ਰਹੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੨੬॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur pooraa bhetio aavan jaan rahe ||2||1||126||
english: Says Nanak, I have met the Perfect Guru; my comings and goings have ended. ||2||1||126||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
