author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jeevau naam sunee ||
english: Hearing Your Name, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤਬ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jau suprasa(n)n bhae gur poore tab meree aas punee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When the Perfect Guru became pleased with me, then my hopes were fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਗਈ ਬਾਧੀ ਮਨਿ ਧੀਰਾ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਅਨਦ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
transliteration: peer gaee baadhee man dheeraa mohio anad dhunee ||
english: Pain is gone, and my mind is comforted; the music of bliss fascinates me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਪਜਿਓ ਚਾਉ ਮਿਲਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਖਿਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: upajio chaau milan prabh preetam rahan na jaai khinee ||1||
english: The yearning to meet my Beloved God has welled up within me. I cannot live without Him, even for an instant. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਮੁਨੀ ॥
transliteration: anik bhagat anik jan taare simarahi anik munee ||
english: You have saved so many devotees, so many humble servants; so many silent sages contemplate You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟਿਕ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੨੭॥
transliteration: a(n)dhule tik niradhan dhan paaio prabh naanak anik gunee ||2||2||127||
english: The support of the blind, the wealth of the poor; Nanak has found God, of endless virtues. ||2||2||127||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੩ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 ghar 13 paRataal ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Thirteenth House, Partaal:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਵੈ ਹਾਰ ਕਜਰ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਭਰਨ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: mohan need na aavai haavai haar kajar basatr abharan keene ||
english: O Enticing Lord, I cannot sleep; I sigh. I am adorned with necklaces, gowns, ornaments and make-up.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਡੀਨੀ ਉਡੀਨੀ ਉਡੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: udeenee udeenee udeenee ||
english: I am sad, sad and depressed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kab ghar aavai ree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When will You come home? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saran suhaagan charan sees dhar ||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of the happy soul-brides; I place my head upon their feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: laalan mohi milaavahu ||
english: Unite me with my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kab ghar aavai ree ||1||
english: When will He come to my home? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਹੇਰੀ ਮਿਲਨ ਬਾਤ ਕਹਉ ਸਗਰੋ ਅਹੰ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sunahu saheree milan baat kahau sagaro aha(n) mitaavahu tau ghar hee laalan paavahu ||
english: Listen, my companions: tell me how to meet Him. Eradicate all egotism, and then you shall find your Beloved Lord within the home of your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਰਸ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: tab ras ma(n)gal gun gaavahu ||
english: Then, in delight, you shall sing the songs of joy and praise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: aanad roop dhiaavahu ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, the embodiment of bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: naanak duaarai aaio ||
english: O Nanak, I came to the Lord's Door,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਮੈ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tau mai laalan paaio ree ||2||
english: and then, I found my Beloved. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mohan roop dikhaavai ||
english: The Enticing Lord has revealed His form to me,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਨੀਦ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ab mohi need suhaavai ||
english: and now, sleep seems sweet to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh meree tikhaa bujhaanee ||
english: My thirst is totally quenched,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ab mai sahaj samaanee ||
english: and now, I am absorbed in celestial bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਠੀ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: meethee pirahi kahaanee ||
english: How sweet is the story of my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨੁ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੧੨੮॥
transliteration: mohan laalan paaio ree || rahaau doojaa ||1||128||
english: I have found my Beloved, Enticing Lord. ||Second Pause||1||128||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਰੀ ਅਹੰ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
transliteration: moree aha(n) jaai darasan paavat he ||
english: My ego is gone; I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਚਹੁ ਨਾਥ ਹੀ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਤਨਾ ॥ ਅਬ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raachahu naath hee sahaaee sa(n)tanaa || ab charan gahe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am absorbed in my Lord and Master, the help and support of the Saints. Now, I hold tight to His Feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਹੇ ਮਨ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਚਰਨਾਵੈ ਚਰਨਾਵੈ ਉਲਝਿਓ ਅਲਿ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਕਮਲ ਜਿਉ ॥
transliteration: aahe man avar na bhaavai charanaavai charanaavai ulajhio al makara(n)d kamal jiu ||
english: My mind longs for Him, and does not love any other. I am totally absorbed, in love with His Lotus Feet, like the bumble bee attached to the honey of the lotus flower.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਹੈ ਏਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: an ras nahee chaahai ekai har laahai ||1||
english: I do not desire any other taste; I seek only the One Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੀਐ ਰਿਖ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: an te tooteeai rikh te chhooteeai ||
english: I have broken away from the others, and I have been released from the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਘੂਟੀਐ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਉਲਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: man har ras ghooteeai sa(n)g saadhoo ulateeai ||
english: O mind, drink in the subtle essence of the Lord; join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and turn away from the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: an naahee naahee re ||
english: There is no other, none other than the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਚਰਨ ਹੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੨੯॥
transliteration: naanak preet charan charan he ||2||2||129||
english: O Nanak, love the Feet, the Feet of the Lord. ||2||2||129||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 9 dupade ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, Ninth Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: dukh harataa har naam pachhaano ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the Dispeller of sorrow - realize this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ajaamal ganikaa jih simarat mukat bhae jee jaano ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, even Ajaamal the robber and Ganikaa the prostitute were liberated; let your soul know this. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਜ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੀ ਛਿਨਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਜਬ ਹੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਖਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: gaj kee traas mitee chhinahoo mahi jab hee raam bakhaano ||
english: The elephant's fear was taken away in an instant, as soon as he chanted the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਭਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naarad kahat sunat dhroo baarik bhajan maahi lapataano ||1||
english: Listening to Naarad's teachings, the child Dhroo was absorbed in deep meditation. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਲ ਅਮਰ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਗਤ ਜਾਹਿ ਹੈਰਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: achal amar nirabhai pad paaio jagat jaahi hairaano ||
english: He obtained the immovable, eternal state of fearlessness, and all the world was amazed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਭਗਤ ਰਛਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kahat bhagat rachhak har nikat taahi tum maano ||2||1||
english: Says Nanak, the Lord is the Saving Grace and the Protector of His devotees; believe it - He is close to you. ||2||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 9 ||
english: Bilaaval, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam binaa dukh paavai ||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, you shall only find pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਨਹ ਚੂਕੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhagat binaa sahasaa nah chookai gur ihu bhed bataavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without devotional worship, doubt is not dispelled; the Guru has revealed this secret. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਤੀਰਥ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਕੀਏ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kahaa bhaio teerath brat keee raam saran nahee aavai ||
english: Of what use are sacred shrines of pilgrimage, if one does not enter the Sanctuary of the Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਜਗ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਤਿਹ ਮਾਨਉ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jog jag nihaphal tih maanau jo prabh jas bisaraavai ||1||
english: Know that Yoga and sacrificial feasts are fruitless, if one forgets the Praises of God. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਦੋਨੋ ਕਉ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: maan moh dono kau parahar gobi(n)d ke gun gaavai ||
english: One who lays aside both pride and attachment, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ih bidh ko praanee jeevan mukat kahaavai ||2||2||
english: Says Nanak, the mortal who does this is said to be 'jivan mukta' - liberated while yet alive. ||2||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 9 ||
english: Bilaaval, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਮੈ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa mai bhajan raam ko naahee ||
english: There is no meditation on the Lord within him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਨਰ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਯਹ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tih nar janam akaarath khoiaa yah raakhahu man maahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: That man wastes his life uselessly - keep this in mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰੈ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਫੁਨਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਹ ਮਨੂਆ ਬਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੋ ॥
transliteration: teerath karai brat phun raakhai nah manooaa bas jaa ko ||
english: He bathes at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and adheres to fasts, but he has no control over his mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਫਲ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਤ ਮੈ ਯਾ ਕਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nihaphal dharam taahi tum maanahu saach kahat mai yaa kau ||1||
english: Know that such religion is useless to him. I speak the Truth for his sake. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਹਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਭੇਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jaise paahan jal mahi raakhio bhedai naahi tih paanee ||
english: It's like a stone, kept immersed in water; still, the water does not penetrate it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਤਾਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਹੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taise hee tum taahi pachhaanahu bhagat heen jo praanee ||2||
english: So, understand it: that mortal being who lacks devotional worship is just like that. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲ ਮੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਯਹ ਭੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kal mai mukat naam te paavat gur yah bhed bataavai ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, liberation comes from the Naam. The Guru has revealed this secret.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਗਰੂਆ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak soee nar garooaa jo prabh ke gun gaavai ||3||3||
english: Says Nanak, he alone is a great man, who sings the Praises of God. ||3||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval asatapadeeaa mahalaa 1 ghar 10 ||
english: Bilaaval, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, Tenth House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: nikat vasai dekhai sabh soee ||
english: He dwells close at hand, and sees all,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koee ||
english: but how rare is the Gurmukh who understands this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: vin bhai paiai bhagat na hoee ||
english: Without the Fear of God, there is no devotional worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabad rate sadaa sukh hoee ||1||
english: Imbued with the Word of the Shabad, eternal peace is attained. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: aisaa giaan padaarath naam ||
english: Such is the spiritual wisdom, the treasure of the Naam;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh paavas ras ras maan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: obtaining it, the Gurmukhs enjoy the subtle essence of this nectar. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਥੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: giaan giaan kathai sabh koee ||
english: Everyone talks about spiritual wisdom and spiritual knowledge.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kath kath baad kare dukh hoee ||
english: Talking, talking, they argue, and suffer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਥਿ ਕਹਣੈ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kath kahanai te rahai na koee ||
english: No one can stop talking and discussing it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin ras raate mukat na hoee ||2||
english: Without being imbued with the subtle essence, there is no liberation. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan sabh gur te hoee ||
english: Spiritual wisdom and meditation all come from the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਰਹਤ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: saachee rahat saachaa man soee ||
english: Through the lifestyle of Truth, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਥਨੀ ਹੈ ਪਰੁ ਰਹਤ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kathanee hai par rahat na hoee ||
english: The self-willed manmukh talks about it, but does not practice it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naavahu bhoole thaau na koee ||3||
english: Forgetting the Name, he finds no place of rest. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧਿਓ ਸਰ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: man maaiaa ba(n)dhio sar jaal ||
english: Maya has caught the mind in the trap of the whirlpool.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਖੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat biaap rahio bikh naal ||
english: Each and every heart is trapped by this bait of poison and sin.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਆਂਜੈ ਸੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਕਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jo aa(n)jai so deesai kaal ||
english: See that whoever has come, is subject to death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੀਧੋ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kaaraj seedho ridai samhaal ||4||
english: Your affairs shall be adjusted, if you contemplate the Lord in your heart. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: so giaanee jin sabad liv laaee ||
english: He alone is a spiritual teacher, who lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh haumai pat gavaaee ||
english: The self-willed, egotistical manmukh loses his honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aape karatai bhagat karaaee ||
english: The Creator Lord Himself inspires us to His devotional worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramukh aape de vadiaaee ||5||
english: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: rain a(n)dhaaree niramal jot ||
english: The life-night is dark, while the Divine Light is immaculate.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਕੁਚਲ ਕਛੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa jhoothe kuchal kachhot ||
english: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are false, filthy and untouchable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰੋਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bed pukaarai bhagat sarot ||
english: The Vedas preach sermons of devotional worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਵੇਖੈ ਜੋਤਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sun sun maanai vekhai jot ||6||
english: Listening, hearing and believing, one beholds the Divine Light. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਮੰ ॥
transliteration: saasatr simrit naam driRaama(n) ||
english: The Shaastras and Simritees implant the Naam within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਰਾਮੰ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saa(n)t ootam karaama(n) ||
english: The Gurmukh lives in peace and tranquility, doing deeds of sublime purity.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਮੰ ॥
transliteration: manamukh jonee dookh sahaama(n) ||
english: The self-willed manmukh suffers the pains of reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੇ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਮੰ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan toote ik naam vasaama(n) ||7||
english: His bonds are broken, enshrining the Name of the One Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੀ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)ne naam sachee pat poojaa ||
english: Believing in the Naam, one obtains true honor and adoration.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: kis vekhaa naahee ko doojaa ||
english: Who should I see? There is none other than the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਕਹਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dekh kahau bhaavai man soi ||
english: I see, and I say, that He alone is pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak kahai avar nahee koi ||8||1||
english: Says Nanak, there is no other at all. ||8||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 ||
english: Bilaaval, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਨਸਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: man kaa kahiaa manasaa karai ||
english: The human acts according to the wishes of the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu man pu(n)n paap ucharai ||
english: This mind feeds on virtue and vice.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mad maate tripat na aavai ||
english: Intoxicated with the wine of Maya, satisfaction never comes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tripat mukat man saachaa bhaavai ||1||
english: Satisfaction and liberation come, only to one whose mind is pleasing to the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tan dhan kalat sabh dekh abhimaanaa ||
english: Gazing upon his body, wealth, wife and all his possessions, he is proud.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai kichh sa(n)g na jaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: But without the Name of the Lord, nothing shall go along with him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਚਹਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: keechahi ras bhog khuseeaa man keree ||
english: He enjoys tastes, pleasures and joys in his mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮੈ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: dhan lokaa(n) tan bhasamai dheree ||
english: But his wealth will pass on to other people, and his body will be reduced to ashes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਕੂ ਖਾਕੁ ਰਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਫੈਲੁ ॥
transliteration: khaakoo khaak ralai sabh phail ||
english: The entire expanse, like dust, shall mix with dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਨਹੀ ਉਤਰੈ ਮੈਲੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin sabadai nahee utarai mail ||2||
english: Without the Word of the Shabad, his filth is not removed. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੀਤ ਰਾਗ ਘਨ ਤਾਲ ਸਿ ਕੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: geet raag ghan taal s koore ||
english: The various songs, tunes and rhythms are false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: trihu gun upajai binasai doore ||
english: Trapped by the three qualities, people come and go, far from the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doojee duramat darad na jaai ||
english: In duality, the pain of their evil-mindedness does not leave them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਾਰੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chhootai guramukh daaroo gun gaai ||3||
english: But the Gurmukh is emancipated by taking the medicine, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੋਤੀ ਊਜਲ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਗਲਿ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: dhotee oojal tilak gal maalaa ||
english: He may wear a clean loin-cloth, apply the ceremonial mark to his forehead, and wear a mala around his neck;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪੜਹਿ ਨਾਟ ਸਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar krodh paRahi naat saalaa ||
english: but if there is anger within him, he is merely reading his part, like an actor in a play.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
transliteration: naam visaar maaiaa mad peeaa ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he drinks in the wine of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bin gur bhagat naahee sukh theeaa ||4||
english: Without devotional worship to the Guru, there is no peace. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਕਰ ਸੁਆਨ ਗਰਧਭ ਮੰਜਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sookar suaan garadhabh ma(n)jaaraa ||
english: The human is a pig, a dog, a donkey, a cat,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਮਲੇਛ ਨੀਚ ਚੰਡਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: pasoo malechh neech cha(n)daalaa ||
english: a beast, a filthy, lowly wretch, an outcast,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gur te muhu phere tinh jon bhavaaeeai ||
english: if he turns his face away from the Guru. He shall wander in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਆਈਐ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan baadhiaa aaeeai jaaeeai ||5||
english: Bound in bondage, he comes and goes. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੈ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te lahai padaarath ||
english: Serving the Guru, the treasure is found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਤਾਰਥੁ ॥
transliteration: hiradai naam sadaa kirataarath ||
english: With the Naam in the heart, one always prospers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saachee daragah poochh na hoi ||
english: And in the Court of the True Lord, you shall not called to account.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੀਝੈ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: maane hukam seejhai dar soi ||6||
english: One who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, is approved at the Lord's Door. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta tis kau jaanai ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, one knows the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: rahai rajaaee hukam pachhaanai ||
english: Understanding the Hukam of His Command, one acts according to His Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: hukam pachhaan sachai dar vaas ||
english: Understanding the Hukam of His Command, he dwells in the Court of the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਲ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਏ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kaal bikaal sabad bhae naas ||7||
english: Through the Shabad, death and birth are ended. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: rahai ateet jaanai sabh tis kaa ||
english: He remains detached, knowing that everything belongs to God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੈ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: tan man arapai hai ihu jis kaa ||
english: He dedicates his body and mind unto the One who owns them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naa ohu aavai naa ohu jaai ||
english: He does not come, and he does not go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saache saach samaai ||8||2||
english: O Nanak, absorbed in Truth, he merges in the True Lord. ||8||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 asatapadee ghar 10 ||
english: Bilaaval, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Tenth House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਕਊਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੁੰਚ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jag kaooaa mukh chu(n)ch giaan ||
english: The world is like a crow; with its beak, it croaks spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar lobh jhooth abhimaan ||
english: But deep within there is greed, falsehood and pride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਗੁ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin naavai paaj lahag nidaan ||1||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, your thin outer covering shall wear off, you fool. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev naam vasai man cheet ||
english: Serving the True Guru, the Naam shall dwell in your conscious mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur bhete har naam chetaavai bin naavai hor jhooth pareet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, the Name of the Lord comes to mind. Without the Name, other loves are false. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kahiaa saa kaar kamaavahu ||
english: So do that work, which the Guru tells you to do.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨੑਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sabad cheenhi sahaj ghar aavahu ||
english: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, you shall come to the home of celestial bliss.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਵਡਾਈ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saachai naai vadaaee paavahu ||2||
english: Through the True Name, you shall obtain glorious greatness. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਲੋਕ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aap na boojhai lok bujhaavai ||
english: One who does not understand his own self, but still tries to instruct others,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: man kaa a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamaavai ||
english: is mentally blind, and acts in blindness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਠਉਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dar ghar mahal thaur kaise paavai ||3||
english: How can he ever find a home and a place of rest, in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu seveeai a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: Serve the Dear Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar jis kee jot samaanee ||
english: deep within each and every heart, His Light is shining forth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਪਹਨਾਮੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tis naal kiaa chalai pahanaamee ||4||
english: How can anyone hide anything from Him? ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: saachaa naam saachai sabad jaanai ||
english: The True Name is known through the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: aapai aap milai chookai abhimaanai ||
english: The Lord Himself meets that one who eradicates egotistical pride.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramukh naam sadaa sadaa vakhaanai ||5||
english: The Gurmukh chants the Naam, forever and ever. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur seviai doojee duramat jaaee ||
english: Serving the True Guru, duality and evil-mindedness are taken away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣ ਕਾਟਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਮਤਿ ਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: augan kaat paapaa mat khaaee ||
english: Guilty mistakes are erased, and the sinful intellect is cleansed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ka(n)chan kaaiaa jotee jot samaaee ||6||
english: One's body sparkles like gold, and one's light merges into the Light. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai vadee vadiaaee ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, one is blessed with glorious greatness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dukh kaatai hiradai naam vasaaee ||
english: Pain is taken away, and the Naam comes to dwell within the heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naam rate sadaa sukh paaee ||7||
english: Imbued with the Naam, one finds eternal peace. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramat maaniaa karanee saar ||
english: Obeying the Gur's instructions, one's actions are purified.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramat maaniaa mokh duaar ||
english: Obeying the Guru's Instructions, one finds the state of salvation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak guramat maaniaa paravaarai saadhaar ||8||1||3||
english: O Nanak, those who follow the Guru's Teachings are saved, along with their families. ||8||1||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧੧ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 asatapadeeaa ghar 11 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Eleventh House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇ ਹਉ ਮੇਟੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਗੀਤ ਗਵਈਆ ॥
transliteration: aapai aap khaai hau metai anadin har ras geet gavaeeaa ||
english: One who eliminates his self-centeredness, and eradicates his ego, night and day sings the songs of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਈਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh parachai ka(n)chan kaaiaa nirabhau jotee jot milaeeaa ||1||
english: The Gurmukh is inspired, his body is golden, and his light merges into the Light of the Fearless Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਰਮਈਆ ॥
transliteration: mai har har naam adhaar ramaeeaa ||
english: I take the Support of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khin pal rahi na sakau bin naavai guramukh har har paath paRaeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I cannot live, for a moment, even for an instant, without the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukh reads the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਗਿਰਹੁ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
transliteration: ek girahu das duaar hai jaa ke ahinis tasakar pa(n)ch chor lagaeeaa ||
english: In the one house of the body, there are ten gates; night and day, the five thieves break in.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dharam arath sabh hir le jaavahi manamukh a(n)dhule khabar na paeeaa ||2||
english: They steal the entire wealth of one's Dharmic faith, but the blind, self-willed manmukh does not know it. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟੁ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਕਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਜਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਈਆ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)chan kot bahu maanak bhariaa jaage giaan tat liv laeeaa ||
english: The fortress of the body is overflowing with gold and jewels; when it is awakened by spiritual wisdom, one enshrines love for the essence of reality.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਸਕਰ ਹੇਰੂ ਆਇ ਲੁਕਾਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tasakar heroo aai lukaane gur kai sabad pakaR ba(n)dh paeeaa ||3||
english: The thieves and robbers hide out in the body; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are arrested and locked up. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੋਤੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਈਆ ॥
transliteration: har har naam pot bohithaa khevat sabad gur paar la(n)ghaeeaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the boat, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the boatman, to carry us across.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਲਗਈਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jam jaagaatee neR na aavai naa ko tasakar chor lagaeeaa ||4||
english: The Messenger of Death, the tax collector, does not even come close, and no thieves or robbers can plunder you. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavai sadaa din raatee mai har jas kahate a(n)t na laheeaa ||
english: I continuously sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night; singing the Lord's Praises, I cannot find His limits.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਿਲਉ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਬਜਈਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramukh manooaa ikat ghar aavai milau goupaal neesaan bajaeeaa ||5||
english: The mind of the Gurmukh returns to its own home; it meets the Lord of the Universe, to the beat of the celestial drum. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਈਆ ॥
transliteration: nainee dekh daras man tripatai sravan baanee gurasabad sunaeeaa ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan with my eyes, my mind is satisfied; with my ears, I listen to the Guru's Bani, and the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਆਤਮ ਦੇਵ ਹੈ ਭੀਨੇ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਵਈਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sun sun aatam dev hai bheene ras ras raam gopaal ravaeeaa ||6||
english: Listening, listening, my soul is softened, delighted by His subtle essence, chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: trai gun maaiaa mohi viaape tureeaa gun hai guramukh laheeaa ||
english: In the grip of the three qualities, they are engrossed in love and attachment to Maya; only as Gurmukh do they find the absolute quality, absorption in bliss.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਰਈਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ek drisat sabh sam kar jaanai nadaree aavai sabh braham pasaraeeaa ||7||
english: With a single, impartial eye, look upon all alike, and see God pervading all. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਈਆ ॥
transliteration: raam naam hai jot sabaaee guramukh aape alakh lakhaeeaa ||
english: The Light of the Lord's Name permeates all; the Gurmukh knows the unknowable.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak deen daiaal bhae hai bhagat bhaai har naam samaeeaa ||8||1||4||
english: O Nanak, the Lord has become merciful to the meek; through loving adoration, he merges in the Lord's Name. ||8||1||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਲੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਗੰਧਈਆ ॥
transliteration: har har naam seetal jal dhiaavahu har cha(n)dan vaas suga(n)dh ga(n)dhaeeaa ||
english: Meditate on the cool water of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Perfume yourself with the fragrant scent of the Lord, the sandalwood tree.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਹਿਰਡ ਪਲਾਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਹੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat param pad paaiaa mai hirad palaas sa(n)g har buheeaa ||1||
english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I have obtained the supreme status. I am just a castor-oil tree, made fragrant by their association. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਈਆ ॥
transliteration: jap jaga(n)naath jagadees gusaeeaa ||
english: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Master of the world, the Lord of creation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saran pare seee jan ubare jiu prahilaad udhaar samaeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those humble beings who seek the Lord's Sanctuary are saved, like Prahlaad; they are emancipated and merge with the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮਹਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਊਤਮ ਚੰਦਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਸਭ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੁਈਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaar athaarah mahi cha(n)dan ootam cha(n)dan nikat sabh cha(n)dan hueeaa ||
english: Of all plants, the sandalwood tree is the most sublime. Everything near the sandalwood tree becomes fragrant like sandalwood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜੇ ਊਭ ਸੁਕ ਹੂਏ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਗਈਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saakat kooRe oobh suk hooe man abhimaan vichhuR door gaeeaa ||2||
english: The stubborn, false faithless cynics are dried up; their egotistical pride separates them far from the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਈਆ ॥
transliteration: har gat mit karataa aape jaanai sabh bidh har har aap banaeeaa ||
english: Only the Creator Lord Himself knows the state and condition of everyone; the Lord Himself makes all the arrangements.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਮਿਟਈਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis satigur bhete s ka(n)chan hovai jo dhur likhiaa s mitai na mitaeeaa ||3||
english: One who meets the True Guru is transformed into gold. Whatever is pre-ordained, is not erased by erasing. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਖੁਲੑਈਆ ॥
transliteration: ratan padaarath guramat paavai saagar bhagat bha(n)daar khulheeaa ||
english: The treasure of jewels is found in the ocean of the Guru's Teachings. The treasure of devotional worship is opened to me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਇਕ ਸਰਧਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਭਈਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur charanee ik saradhaa upajee mai har gun kahate tripat na bhaeeaa ||4||
english: Focused on the Guru's Feet, faith wells up within me; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I hunger for more. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਤੇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਕਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: param bairaag nit nit har dhiaae mai har gun kahate bhaavanee kaheeaa ||
english: I am totally detached, continually, continuously meditating on the Lord; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I express my love for Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਈਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: baar baar khin khin pal kaheeai har paar na paavai parai paraeeaa ||5||
english: Time and time again, each and every moment and instant, I express it. I cannot find the Lord's limits; He is the farthest of the far. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
transliteration: saasat bed puraan pukaarahi dharam karahu khat karam driRaeeaa ||
english: The Shaastras, the Vedas and the Puraanas advise righteous actions, and the performance of the six religious rituals.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਨਾਵ ਭਾਰਿ ਬੁਡਈਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: manamukh paakha(n)d bharam vigoote lobh lahar naav bhaar budaeeaa ||6||
english: The hypocritical, self-willed manmukhs are ruined by doubt; in the waves of greed, their boat is heavily loaded, and it sinks. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
transliteration: naam japahu naame gat paavahu simrit saasatr naam driRaeeaa ||
english: So chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and through the Naam, find emancipation. The Simritees and Shaastras recommend the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: haumai jaai ta niramal hovai guramukh parachai param pad paeeaa ||7||
english: Eradicating egotism, one becomes pure. The Gurmukh is inspired, and obtains the supreme status. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਨੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਈਆ ॥
transliteration: ihu jag varan roop sabh teraa jit laavahi se karam kamaeeaa ||
english: This world, with its colors and forms, is all Yours, O Lord; as You attach us, so do we do our deeds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਜਾਏ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਚਲਈਆ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak ja(n)t vajaae vaajahi jit bhaavai tit raahi chalaeeaa ||8||2||5||
english: O Nanak, we are the instruments upon which He plays; as He wills, so is the path we take. ||8||2||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖਈਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh agam agochar dhiaaiaa hau bal bal satigur sat purakhaeeaa ||
english: The Gurmukh meditates on the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the True Guru, the True Primal Being.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam merai praan vasaae satigur paras har naam samaeeaa ||1||
english: He has brought the Lord's Name to dwell upon my breath of life; meeting with the True Guru, I am absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਟਿਕਈਆ ॥
transliteration: jan kee tek har naam tikaeeaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the only Support of His humble servants.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧਰ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee dhar laagaa jaavaa gur kirapaa te har dar laheeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I shall live under the protection of the True Guru. By Guru's Grace, I shall attain the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਥਿ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢਈਆ ॥
transliteration: ihu sareer karam kee dharatee guramukh math math tat kadhaeeaa ||
english: This body is the field of karma; the Gurmukhs plow and work it, and harvest the essence.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੁ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਭਾਉ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਅਈਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: laal javehar naam pragaasiaa bhaa(n)dai bhaau pavai tit aeeaa ||2||
english: The priceless jewel of the Naam becomes manifest, and it pours into their vessels of love. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਜ ਭਈਆ ॥
transliteration: daasan daas daas hoi raheeai jo jan raam bhagat nij bhaeeaa ||
english: Become the slave of the slave of the slave, of that humble being who has become the devotee of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਈਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man budh arap dharau gur aagai gur parasaadee mai akath kathaeeaa ||3||
english: I dedicate my mind and intellect, and place them in offering before my Guru; by Guru's Grace, I speak the Unspoken. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਤਿਖਈਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh maaiaa mohi viaape ihu man trisanaa jalat tikhaeeaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in attachment to Maya; their minds are thirsty, burning with desire.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਈਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramat naam a(n)mrit jal paaiaa agan bujhee gur sabad bujhaeeaa ||4||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, and the fire has been put out. The Word of the Guru's Shabad has put it out. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਤੂਰ ਵਜਈਆ ॥
transliteration: ihu man naachai satigur aagai anahad sabad dhun toor vajaeeaa ||
english: This mind dances before the True Guru. The unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds, vibrating the celestial melody.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਲ ਪੂਰਈਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: har har usatat karai din raatee rakh rakh charan har taal pooraeeaa ||5||
english: I praise the Lord, day and night, moving my feet to the beat of the drum. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਾਲ ਰਸਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਈਆ ॥
transliteration: har kai ra(n)g rataa man gaavai ras rasaal ras sabad ravaeeaa ||
english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, my mind sings His Praise, joyfully chanting the Shabad, the source of nectar and bliss.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: nij ghar dhaar chuai at niramal jin peeaa tin hee sukh laheeaa ||6||
english: The stream of immaculate purity flows through the home of the self within; one who drinks it in, finds peace. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕ ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਉਸਰਈਆ ॥
transliteration: manahath karam karai abhimaanee jiu baalak baaloo ghar usaraeeaa ||
english: The stubborn-minded, egotistical, proud-minded person performs rituals, but these are like sand castles built by children.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਢਹਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aavai lahar samu(n)d saagar kee khin mahi bhi(n)n bhi(n)n dhahi paeeaa ||7||
english: When the waves of the ocean come in, they crumble and dissolve in an instant. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਈਆ ॥
transliteration: har sar saagar har hai aape ihu jag hai sabh khel khelaeeaa ||
english: The Lord is the pool, and the Lord Himself is the ocean; this world is all a play which He has staged.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਰਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੬॥
transliteration: jiu jal tara(n)g jal jalahi samaavahi naanak aape aap ramaeeaa ||8||3||6||
english: As the waves of water merge into the water again, O Nanak, so does He merge into Himself. ||8||3||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਚੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਨਿ ਭਸਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur parachai man mu(n)draa paaee gur kaa sabad tan bhasam driRaeeaa ||
english: My mind wears the ear-rings of the True Guru's acquaintance; I apply the ashes of the Word of the Guru's Shabad to my body.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰ ਪਿੰਡ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਊ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: amar pi(n)d bhae saadhoo sa(n)g janam maran dooo mit gaeeaa ||1||
english: My body has become immortal, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Both birth and death have come to an end for me. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mere man saadhasa(n)gat mil raheeaa ||
english: O my mind, remain united with the Saadh Sangat.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਧਸੂਦਨ ਮਾਧਉ ਮੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kripaa karahu madhasoodan maadhau mai khin khin saadhoo charan pakhaeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Be merciful to me, O Lord; each and every instant, let me wash the Feet of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਜੈ ਗਿਰਸਤੁ ਭਇਆ ਬਨ ਵਾਸੀ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਟਿਕਈਆ ॥
transliteration: tajai girasat bhaiaa ban vaasee ik khin manooaa tikai na tikaeeaa ||
english: Forsaking family life, he wanders in the forest, but his mind does not remain at rest, even for an instant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਧਾਇ ਤਦੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਈਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhaavat dhaai tade ghar aavai har har saadhoo saran pavaeeaa ||2||
english: The wandering mind returns home, only when it seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy people. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੀਆ ਪੂਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
transliteration: dheeaa poot chhod sa(n)niaasee aasaa aas man bahut karaeeaa ||
english: The Sannyaasi renounces his daughters and sons, but his mind still conjures up all sorts of hopes and desires.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aasaa aas karai nahee boojhai gur kai sabad niraas sukh laheeaa ||3||
english: With these hopes and desires, he still does not understand, that only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad does one become free of desires, and find peace. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਪਜੀ ਤਰਕ ਦਿਗੰਬਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
transliteration: upajee tarak diga(n)bar hoaa man dah dis chal chal gavan karaeeaa ||
english: When detachment from the world wells up within, he become a naked hermit, but still, his mind roams, wanders and rambles in the ten directions.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਵਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: prabhavan karai boojhai nahee trisanaa mil sa(n)g saadh daiaa ghar laheeaa ||4||
english: He wanders around, but his desires are not satisfied; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he finds the house of kindness and compassion. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਣ ਸਿਧ ਸਿਖਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਚੇਟਕ ਚੇਟਕਈਆ ॥
transliteration: aasan sidh sikhahi bahutere man maagahi ridh sidh chetak chetakaeeaa ||
english: The Siddhas learn many Yogis postures, but their minds still yearn for riches, miraculous powers and energy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: tripat sa(n)tokh man saa(n)t na aavai mil saadhoo tripat har naam sidh paeeaa ||5||
english: Satisfaction, contentment and tranquility do not come to their minds; but meeting the Holy Saints, they are satisfied, and through the Name of the Lord, spiritual perfection is attained. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਸਭਿ ਵਰਨ ਰੂਪ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਈਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)daj jeraj setaj utabhuj sabh varan roop jee ja(n)t upaeeaa ||
english: Life is born from the egg, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth; God created the beings and creatures of all colors and forms.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ ਚੰਡਈਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saadhoo saran parai so ubarai khatree braahaman sood vais cha(n)daal cha(n)daeeaa ||6||
english: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Holy is saved, whether he is a Kh'shaatriya, a Brahmin, a Soodra, a Vaishya or the most untouchable of the untouchables. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਕੰਬੀਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਅਉਜਾਤਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਚਮਿਆਰੁ ਚਮਈਆ ॥
transliteration: naamaa jaideu ka(n)beer trilochan aujaat ravidaas chamiaar chamaeeaa ||
english: Naam Dayv, Jai Dayv, Kabeer, Trilochan and Ravi Daas the low-caste leather-worker,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ ਸੈਣੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਈਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jo jo milai saadhoo jan sa(n)gat dhan dha(n)naa jat sain miliaa har daeeaa ||7||
english: blessed Dhanna and Sain; all those who joined the humble Saadh Sangat, met the Merciful Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee har paij rakhaaee bhagat vachhal a(n)geekaar karaeeaa ||
english: The Lord protects the honor of His humble servants; He is the Lover of His devotees - He makes them His own.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਖਈਆ ॥੮॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak saran pare jagajeevan har har kirapaa dhaar rakhaeeaa ||8||4||7||
english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Life of the world, who has showered His Mercy upon him, and saved him. ||8||||4||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਉਠੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਮਨਿ ਤੀਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar piaas uthee prabh keree sun gur bachan man teer lagaeeaa ||
english: The thirst for God has welled up deep within me; hearing the Word of the Guru's Teachings, my mind is pierced by His arrow.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਈਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man kee birathaa man hee jaanai avar k jaanai ko peer paraeeaa ||1||
english: The pain of my mind is known only to my own mind; who can know the pain of another? ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਈਆ ॥
transliteration: raam gur mohan mohi man laeeaa ||
english: The Lord, the Guru, the Enticer, has enticed my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਆਕਲ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਈ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਉ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਟ ਹੋਇ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau aakal bikal bhaee gur dekhe hau lot pot hoi paeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am stunned and amazed, gazing upon my Guru; I have entered the realm of wonder and bliss. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਫਿਰਉ ਸਭਿ ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖਨ ਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਈਆ ॥
transliteration: hau nirakhat phirau sabh des disa(n)tar mai prabh dekhan ko bahut man chaeeaa ||
english: I wander around, exploring all lands and foreign countries; within my mind, I have such a great longing to see my God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਈਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man tan kaat deu gur aagai jin har prabh maarag pa(n)th dikhaeeaa ||2||
english: I sacrifice my mind and body to the Guru, who has shown me the Way, the Path to my Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਸਦੇਸਾ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰਾ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
transliteration: koee aan sadesaa dei prabh keraa rid a(n)tar man tan meeth lagaeeaa ||
english: If only someone would bring me news of God; He seems so sweet to my heart, mind and body.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਲਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਈਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: masatak kaat deu charanaa tal jo har prabh mele mel milaeeaa ||3||
english: I would cut off my head and place it under the feet of that one who leads me to meet and unite with my Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਲੁ ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: chal chal sakhee ham prabh parabodhah gun kaaman kar har prabh laheeaa ||
english: Let us go, O my companions, and understand our God; with the spell of virtue, let us obtain our Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਈਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal uaa ko naam kaheeat hai saran prabhoo tis paachhai paeeaa ||4||
english: He is called the Lover of His devotees; let us follow in the footsteps of those who seek God's Sanctuary. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਲਈਆ ॥
transliteration: khimaa seegaar kare prabh khuseeaa man deepak gur giaan balaeeaa ||
english: If the soul-bride adorns herself with compassion and forgiveness, God is pleased, and her mind is illumined with the lamp of the Guru's wisdom.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਕਟਿ ਕਟਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ras ras bhog kare prabh meraa ham tis aagai jeeu kat kat paeeaa ||5||
english: With happiness and ecstasy, my God enjoys her; I offer each and every bit of my soul to Him. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਹੈ ਬਨਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀਚੂਰੁ ਵਡ ਗਹਨ ਗਹਨਈਆ ॥
transliteration: har har haar ka(n)th hai baniaa man moteechoor vad gahan gahanaeeaa ||
english: I have made the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, my necklace; my mind tinged with devotion is the intricate ornament of crowning glory.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਈਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: har har saradhaa sej vichhaaee prabh chhod na sakai bahut man bhaeeaa ||6||
english: I have spread out my bed of faith in the Lord, Har, Har. I cannot abandon Him - my mind is filled with such a great love for Him. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਫੋਕਟ ਫੋਕਟਈਆ ॥
transliteration: kahai prabh avar avar kichh keejai sabh baad seegaar phokat phokataeeaa ||
english: If God says one thing, and the soul-bride does something else, then all her decorations are useless and false.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੀਓ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੀਓ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਥੂਕ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: keeo seegaar milan kai taaee prabh leeo suhaagan thook mukh paeeaa ||7||
english: She may adorn herself to meet her Husband Lord, but still, only the virtuous soul-bride meets God, and the other's face is spat upon. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਚੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਪਈਆ ॥
transliteration: ham cheree too agam gusaaee kiaa ham karah terai vas paeeaa ||
english: I am Your hand-maiden, O Inaccessible Lord of the Universe; what can I do by myself? I am under Your power.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਦੀਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੫॥੮॥
transliteration: daiaa deen karahu rakh levahu naanak har gur saran samaeeaa ||8||5||8||
english: Be merciful, Lord, to the meek, and save them; Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, and the Guru. ||8||5||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਠਈਆ ॥
transliteration: mai man tan prem agam thaakur kaa khin khin saradhaa man bahut uthaeeaa ||
english: My mind and body are filled with love for my Inaccessible Lord and Master. Each and every instant, I am filled with immense faith and devotion.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur dekhe saradhaa man pooree jiu chaatrik priu priu boo(n)d mukh paeeaa ||1||
english: Gazing upon the Guru, my mind's faith is fulfilled, like the song-bird, which cries and cries, until the rain-drop falls into its mouth. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਈਆ ॥
transliteration: mil mil sakhee har kathaa sunaeeaa ||
english: Join with me, join with me, O my companions, and teach me the Sermon of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਟਿ ਕਟਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur daiaa kare prabh mele mai tis aagai sir kat kat paeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru has mercifully united me with God. Cutting off my head, and chopping it into pieces, I offer it to Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਇਕ ਬੇਦਨ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥
transliteration: rom rom man tan ik bedan mai prabh dekhe bin need na paeeaa ||
english: Each and every hair on my head, and my mind and body, suffer the pains of separation; without seeing my God, I cannot sleep.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੈਦਕ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਮੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੀਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: baidak naatik dekh bhulaane mai hiradai man tan prem peer lagaeeaa ||2||
english: The doctors and healers look at me, and are perplexed. Within my heart, mind and body, I feel the pain of divine love. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਮਲੈ ਅਮਲੀ ਮਰਿ ਗਈਆ ॥
transliteration: hau khin pal rahi na sakau bin preetam jiu bin amalai amalee mar gaeeaa ||
english: I cannot live for a moment, for even an instant, without my Beloved, like the opium addict who cannot live without opium.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਦੁਈਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin kau piaas hoi prabh keree tinh avar na bhaavai bin har ko dueeaa ||3||
english: Those who thirst for God, do not love any other. Without the Lord, there is no other at all. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਆਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਘੁਮਿ ਗਈਆ ॥
transliteration: koee aan aan meraa prabhoo milaavai hau tis vitahu bal bal ghum gaeeaa ||
english: If only someone would come and unite me with God; I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਜਾ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਈਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: anek janam ke vichhuRe jan mele jaa sat sat satigur saran pavaeeaa ||4||
english: After being separated from the Lord for countless incarnations, I am re-united with Him, entering the Sanctuary of the True, True, True Guru. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਈਆ ॥
transliteration: sej ek eko prabh thaakur mahal na paavai manamukh bharamaeeaa ||
english: There is one bed for the soul-bride, and the same bed for God, her Lord and Master. The self-willed manmukh does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; she wanders around, in limbo.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੇ ਆਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਢੀਲ ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur gur karat saran je aavai prabh aai milai khin dheel na paeeaa ||5||
english: Uttering, "Guru, Guru", she seeks His Sanctuary; so God comes to meet her, without a moment's delay. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆਚਾਰ ਵਧਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਪਟ ਲੋਭਈਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kar kiriaachaar vadhaae man paakha(n)d karam kapat lobhaeeaa ||
english: One may perform many rituals, but the mind is filled with hypocrisy, evil deeds and greed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਆ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੇਟਾ ਜਨਮਿਆ ਪਿਤਾ ਤਾਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਈਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: besuaa kai ghar betaa janamiaa pitaa taahi kiaa naam sadaeeaa ||6||
english: When a son is born in the house of a prostitute, who can tell the name of his father? ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਮਈਆ ॥
transliteration: poorab janam bhagat kar aae gur har har har har bhagat jamaeeaa ||
english: Because of devotional worship in my past incarnations, I have been born into this life. The Guru has inspired me to worship the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bhagat bhagat karate har paaiaa jaa har har har har naam samaeeaa ||7||
english: Worshipping, worshipping Him with devotion, I found the Lord, and then I merged into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਣਿ ਆਣਿ ਮਹਿੰਦੀ ਪੀਸਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੋਲਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਲਈਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh aan aan mahi(n)dee peesaaee aape ghol ghol a(n)g laeeaa ||
english: God Himself came and ground the henna leaves into powder, and applied it to my body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਢਿ ਲਈਆ ॥੮॥੬॥੨॥੧॥੬॥੯॥
transliteration: jin kau thaakur kirapaa dhaaree baah pakar naanak kadh laeeaa ||8||6||2||1||6||9||
english: Our Lord and Master showers His Mercy upon us, and grasps hold of our arms; O Nanak, He lifts us up and saves us. ||8||6||9||2||1||6||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੨ ॥
transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 asatapadee ghar 12 ||
english: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Twelfth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥
transliteration: upamaa jaat na kahee mere prabh kee upamaa jaat na kahee ||
english: I cannot express the Praises of my God; I cannot express His Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਆਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taj aan saran gahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have abandoned all others, seeking His Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: prabh charan kamal apaar ||
english: God's Lotus Feet are Infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਜਾਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hau jaau sad balihaar ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to Them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: man preet laagee taahi ||
english: My mind is in love with Them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਆਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taj aan katahi na jaahi ||1||
english: If I were to abandon Them, there is nowhere else I could go. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਨ ॥
transliteration: har naam rasanaa kahan ||
english: I chant the Lord's Name with my tongue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਕਲਮਲ ਦਹਨ ॥
transliteration: mal paap kalamal dahan ||
english: The filth of my sins and evil mistakes is burnt off.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੜਿ ਨਾਵ ਸੰਤ ਉਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: chaR naav sa(n)t udhaar ||
english: Climbing aboard the Boat of the Saints, I am emancipated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤਰੇ ਸਾਗਰ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhai tare saagar paar ||2||
english: I have been carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਡੋਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: man dor prem pareet ||
english: My mind is tied to the Lord with the string of love and devotion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਸੰਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ih sa(n)t niramal reet ||
english: This is the Immaculate Way of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: taj gae paap bikaar ||
english: They forsake sin and corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har mile prabh nira(n)kaar ||3||
english: They meet the Formless Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖੀਐ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
transliteration: prabh pekheeai bisamaad ||
english: Gazing upon God, I am wonderstruck.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਖਿ ਅਨਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਦ ॥
transliteration: chakh anad pooran saad ||
english: I taste the Perfect Flavor of Bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਡੋਲੀਐ ਇਤ ਊਤ ॥
transliteration: nah doleeai it oot ||
english: I do not waver or wander here or there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੀਤ ॥੪॥
transliteration: prabh base har har cheet ||4||
english: The Lord God, Har, Har, dwells within my consciousness. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਨਾਹਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: tinh naahi narak nivaas ||
english: Those who constantly remember God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: nit simar prabh gunataas ||
english: The treasure of virtue, will never go to hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਪੇਖਹਿ ਨੈਨ ॥
transliteration: te jam na pekhahi nain ||
english: Those who listen, fascinated, to the Unstruck Sound-Current of the Word,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਅਨਹਤ ਬੈਨ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sun mohe anahat bain ||5||
english: Will never have to see the Messenger of Death with their eyes. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: har saran soor gupaal ||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Heroic Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਗਤ ਵਸਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: prabh bhagat vas daiaal ||
english: The Merciful Lord God is under the power of His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਗਮ ਲਹਹਿ ਨ ਭੇਵ ॥
transliteration: har nigam lahahi na bhev ||
english: The Vedas do not know the Mystery of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵ ॥੬॥
transliteration: nit karahi mun jan sev ||6||
english: The silent sages constantly serve Him. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: dukh deen darad nivaar ||
english: He is the Destroyer of the pains and sorrows of the poor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੜੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee mahaa bikhaRee kaar ||
english: It is so very difficult to serve Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: taa kee mit na jaanai koi ||
english: No one knows His limits.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal soi ||7||
english: He is pervading the water, the land and the sky. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਲਖ ਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kar ba(n)danaa lakh baar ||
english: Hundreds of thousands of times, I humbly bow to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਕਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਬਾਰ ॥
transliteration: thak pario prabh darabaar ||
english: I have grown weary, and I have collapsed at God's Door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh karahu saadhoo dhoor ||
english: O God, make me the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak manasaa poor ||8||1||
english: Please fulfill this, Nanak's wish. ||8||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh janam maran nivaar ||
english: God, please release me from birth and death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: haar pario duaar ||
english: I have grown weary, and collapsed at Your door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
transliteration: gahi charan saadhoo sa(n)g ||
english: I grasp Your Feet, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਿਸਟ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ॥
transliteration: man misat har har ra(n)g ||
english: The Love of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet to my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਲੇਹੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kar daiaa lehu laR laai ||
english: Be Merciful, and attach me to the hem of Your robe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanakaa naam dhiaai ||1||
english: Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: deenaa naath daiaal mere suaamee deenaa naath daiaal ||
english: O Merciful Master of the meek, You are my Lord and Master, O Merciful Master of the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਉ ਸੰਤ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaachau sa(n)t ravaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I yearn for the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੂਪ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar bikhiaa koop ||
english: The world is a pit of poison,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਮ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮੋਹਤ ਘੂਪ ॥
transliteration: tam agiaan mohat ghoop ||
english: filled with the utter darkness of ignorance and emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: gahi bhujaa prabh jee lehu ||
english: Please take my hand, and save me, Dear God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: har naam apunaa dehu ||
english: Please bless me with Your Name, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh tujh binaa nahee thaau ||
english: Without You, God, I have no place at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanakaa bal bal jaau ||2||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਾਧੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: lobh mohi baadhee deh ||
english: The human body is in the grip of greed and attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਖੇਹ ॥
transliteration: bin bhajan hovat kheh ||
english: Without meditating and vibrating upon the Lord, it is reduced to ashes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮਦੂਤ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ॥
transliteration: jamadoot mahaa bhaiaan ||
english: The Messenger of Death is dreadful and horrible.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ ਗੁਪਤ ਕਰਮਹਿ ਜਾਨ ॥
transliteration: chit gupat karamahi jaan ||
english: The recording scribes of the conscious and the unconscious, Chitr and Gupt, know all actions and karma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਖਿ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: din rain saakh sunaai ||
english: Day and night, they bear witness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanakaa har saranaai ||3||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhai bha(n)janaa muraar ||
english: O Lord, Destroyer of fear and egotism,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kar daiaa patit udhaar ||
english: be merciful, and save the sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਦੋਖ ਗਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mere dokh gane na jaahi ||
english: My sins cannot even be counted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਤਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: har binaa katahi samaahi ||
english: Without the Lord, who can hide them?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਓਟ ਚਿਤਵੀ ਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: gahi ot chitavee naath ||
english: I thought of Your Support, and seized it, O my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਦੇ ਰਖੁ ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanakaa de rakh haath ||4||
english: Please, give Nanak Your hand and save him, Lord! ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: har gun nidhe gopaal ||
english: The Lord, the treasure of virtue, the Lord of the world,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਘਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sarab ghat pratipaal ||
english: cherishes and and sustains every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: man preet darasan piaas ||
english: My mind is thirsty for Your Love, and the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d pooran aas ||
english: O Lord of the Universe, please fulfill my hopes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik nimakh rahan na jaai ||
english: I cannot survive, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: vad bhaag naanak paai ||5||
english: By great good fortune, Nanak has found the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰ ॥
transliteration: prabh tujh binaa nahee hor ||
english: Without You, God, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚੰਦ ਚਕੋਰ ॥
transliteration: man preet cha(n)d chakor ||
english: My mind loves You, as the partridge loves the moon,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨ ਜਲ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu meen jal siu het ||
english: as the fish loves the water,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਭਿੰਨੁ ਨ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: al kamal bhi(n)n na bhet ||
english: as the bee and the lotus cannot be separated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰਜ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: jiu chakavee sooraj aas ||
english: As the chakvi bird longs for the sun,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਨ ਪਿਆਸ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak charan piaas ||6||
english: so does Nanak thirst for the Lord's feet. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤਰੁਨਿ ਭਰਤ ਪਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jiu tarun bharat paraan ||
english: As the young bride places the hopes of her life in her husband,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਲੋਭੀਐ ਧਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu lobheeai dhan daan ||
english: as the greedy person looks upon the gift of wealth,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਦੂਧ ਜਲਹਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu doodh jalahi sa(n)jog ||
english: as milk is joined to water,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਹਾ ਖੁਧਿਆਰਥ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu mahaa khudhiaarath bhog ||
english: as food is to the very hungry man,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤ ਪੂਤਹਿ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu maat pootahi het ||
english: and as the mother loves her son,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੇਤ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har simar naanak net ||7||
english: so does Nanak constantly remember the Lord in meditation. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਦੀਪ ਪਤਨ ਪਤੰਗ ॥
transliteration: jiu deep patan pata(n)g ||
english: As the moth falls into the lamp,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਚੋਰੁ ਹਿਰਤ ਨਿਸੰਗ ॥
transliteration: jiu chor hirat nisa(n)g ||
english: as the thief steals without hesitation,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈਗਲਹਿ ਕਾਮੈ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: maigalahi kaamai ba(n)dh ||
english: as the elephant is trapped by its sexual urges,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਬਿਖਈ ਧੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu grasat bikhaee dha(n)dh ||
english: as the sinner is caught in his sins,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜੂਆਰ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jiu jooaar bisan na jaai ||
english: as the gambler's addiction does not leave him,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: har naanak ihu man laai ||8||
english: so is this mind of Nanak's attached to the Lord. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਾਦੈ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kura(n)k naadai nehu ||
english: As the deer loves the sound of the bell,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਚਾਹਤ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: chaatrik chaahat mehu ||
english: and as the song-bird longs for the rain,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: jan jeevanaa satasa(n)g ||
english: the Lord's humble servant lives in the Society of the Saints,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਭਜਨਾ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: gobid bhajanaa ra(n)g ||
english: lovingly meditating and vibrating upon the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa bakhaanai naam ||
english: My tongue chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਨ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak darasan daan ||9||
english: Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਸੁਨਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: gun gaai sun likh dei ||
english: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and hears them, and writes them,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: so sarab phal har lei ||
english: receives all fruits and rewards from the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹ ਕਰਤ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kul samooh karat udhaar ||
english: He saves all his ancestors and generations,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar utaras paar ||
english: and crosses over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: har charan bohith taahi ||
english: The Lord's Feet are the boat to carry him across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)g jas gaahi ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har paij rakhai muraar ||
english: The Lord protects his honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
transliteration: har naanak saran duaar ||10||2||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's door. ||10||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਥਿਤੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ਜਤਿ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 thitee ghar 10 jat ||
english: Bilaaval, First Mehl, T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days, Tenth House, To The Drum-Beat Jat:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਮ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ekam eka(n)kaar niraalaa ||
english: The First Day: The One Universal Creator is unique,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: amar ajonee jaat na jaalaa ||
english: immortal, unborn, beyond social class or involvement.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar roop na rekhiaa ||
english: He is inaccessible and unfathomable, with no form or feature.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat ghat ghat dekhiaa ||
english: Searching, searching, I have seen Him in each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
