gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo dekh dikhaavai tis kau bal jaaee ||
english: I am a sacrifice to one who sees, and inspires others to see Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paaee ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa jap jaapau bin jagadeesai ||
english: Whose Name should I chant, and meditate on, except the Lord of the Universe?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਦੀਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad mahal ghar deesai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is revealed within the home of one's own heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਗੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai lage pachhutaane ||
english: The Second Day: Those who are in love with another, come to regret and repent.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: jam dar baadhe aavan jaane ||
english: The are tied up at Death's door, and continue coming and going.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਵਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kiaa lai aavahi kiaa le jaahi ||
english: What have they brought, and what will they take with them when they go?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sir jamakaal s chotaa khaahi ||
english: The Messenger of Death looms over their heads, and they endure his beating.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bin gurasabad na chhootas koi ||
english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, no one finds release.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਕੀਨੑੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d keenhai mukat na hoi ||2||
english: Practicing hypocrisy, no one finds liberation. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ॥
transliteration: aape sach keeaa kar joR ||
english: The True Lord Himself created the universe, joining the elements together.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਡਜ ਫੋੜਿ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)daj phoR joR vichhoR ||
english: Breaking the cosmic egg, He united, and separated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਕੀਏ ਬੈਸਣ ਕਉ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dharat akaas keee baisan kau thaau ||
english: He made the earth and the sky into places to live.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨੰਤੁ ਕੀਏ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raat dina(n)t keee bhau bhaau ||
english: He created day and night, fear and love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jin keee kar vekhanahaaraa ||
english: The One who created the Creation, also watches over it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: avar na doojaa sirajanahaaraa ||3||
english: There is no other Creator Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: triteeaa brahamaa bisan mahesaa ||
english: The Third Day: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਉਪਾਏ ਵੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: devee dev upaae vesaa ||
english: the gods, goddesses and various manifestations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜਾਤੀ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jotee jaatee ganat na aavai ||
english: The lights and forms cannot be counted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸੋ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jin saajee so keemat paavai ||
english: The One who fashioned them, knows their value.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: keemat paai rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: He evaluates them, and totally pervades them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kis neRai kis aakhaa door ||4||
english: Who is close, and who is far away? ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: chauth upaae chaare bedaa ||
english: The Fourth Day: He created the four Vedas,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ਬਾਣੀ ਭੇਦਾ ॥
transliteration: khaanee chaare baanee bhedaa ||
english: the four sources of creation, and distinct forms of speech.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਦਸਾ ਖਟੁ ਤੀਨਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: asat dasaa khat teen upaae ||
english: He created the eighteen Puraanas, the six Shaastras and the three qualities.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: so boojhai jis aap bujhaae ||
english: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: teen samaavai chauthai vaasaa ||
english: One who overcomes the three qualities, dwells in the fourth state.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak ham taa ke daasaa ||5||
english: Prays Nanak, I am his slave. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚਮੀ ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)chamee pa(n)ch bhoot betaalaa ||
english: The Fifth Day: The five elements are demons.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aap agochar purakh niraalaa ||
english: The Lord Himself is unfathomable and detached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਖੇ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸੇ ॥
transliteration: ik bhram bhookhe moh piaase ||
english: Some are gripped by doubt, hunger, emotional attachment and desire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: ik ras chaakh sabad tripataase ||
english: Some taste the sublime essence of the Shabad, and are satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਮਰਿ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ik ra(n)g raate ik mar dhoor ||
english: Some are imbued with the Lord's Love, while some die, and are reduced to dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ik dar ghar saachai dekh hadoor ||6||
english: Some attain the Court and the Mansion of the True Lord, and behold Him, ever-present. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jhoothe kau naahee pat naau ||
english: The false one has no honor or fame;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਸੂਚਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਕਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kabahu na soochaa kaalaa kaau ||
english: like the black crow, he never becomes pure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿੰਜਰਿ ਪੰਖੀ ਬੰਧਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: pi(n)jar pa(n)khee ba(n)dhiaa koi ||
english: He is like the bird, imprisoned in a cage;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੇਰੀਂ ਭਰਮੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: chheree(n) bharamai mukat na hoi ||
english: he paces back and forth behind the bars, but he is not released.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਛੂਟੈ ਜਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tau chhootai jaa khasam chhadaae ||
english: He alone is emancipated, whom the Lord and Master emancipates.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramat mele bhagat driRaae ||7||
english: He follows the Guru's Teachings, and enshrines devotional worship. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਟੀ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: khasatee khat darasan prabh saaje ||
english: The Sixth Day: God organized the six systems of Yoga.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਵਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: anahad sabad niraalaa vaaje ||
english: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates of itself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je prabh bhaavai taa mahal bulaavai ||
english: If God wills it so, then one is summoned to the Mansion of His Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਭੇਦੇ ਤਉ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sabade bhede tau pat paavai ||
english: One who is pierced through by the Shabad, obtains honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਸ ਖਪਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kar kar ves khapahi jal jaavahi ||
english: Those who wear religious robes burn, and are ruined.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥੮॥
transliteration: saachai saache saach samaavahi ||8||
english: Through Truth, the truthful ones merge into the True Lord. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਪਤਮੀ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sapatamee sat sa(n)tokh sareer ||
english: The Seventh Day: When the body is imbued with Truth and contentment,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਭਰੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨੀਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saat samu(n)d bhare niramal neer ||
english: the seven seas within are filled with the Immaculate Water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਜਨੁ ਸੀਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: majan seel sach ridai veechaar ||
english: Bathing in good conduct, and contemplating the True Lord within the heart,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad paavai sabh paar ||
english: one obtains the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and carries everyone across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਉ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man saachaa mukh saachau bhaai ||
english: With the True Lord in the mind, and the True Lord lovingly on one's lips,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: sach neesaanai thaak na paai ||9||
english: one is blessed with the banner of Truth, and meets with no obstructions. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਮੀ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਾਧੈ ॥
transliteration: asatamee asat sidh budh saadhai ||
english: The Eighth Day: The eight miraculous powers come when one subdues his own mind,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਅਰਾਧੈ ॥
transliteration: sach nihakeval karam araadhai ||
english: and contemplates the True Lord through pure actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਬਿਸਰਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paun paanee aganee bisaraau ||
english: Forget the three qualities of wind, water and fire,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਹੀ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tahee nira(n)jan saacho naau ||
english: and concentrate on the pure True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tis mahi manooaa rahiaa liv laai ||
english: That human who remains lovingly focused on the Lord,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak kaal na khaai ||10||
english: prays Nanak, shall not be consumed by death. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਨਉਮੀ ਨਵੇ ਨਾਥ ਨਵ ਖੰਡਾ ॥
transliteration: naau naumee nave naath nav kha(n)daa ||
english: The Ninth Day: The Name is the supreme almighty Master of the nine masters of Yoga,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਲਵੰਡਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat naath mahaa balava(n)daa ||
english: The nine realms of the earth, and each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਈ ਪੂਤਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aaee pootaa ihu jag saaraa ||
english: This whole world is the child of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਆਦਿ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh aades aad rakhavaaraa ||
english: I bow in submission to God, my Protector from the very beginning of time.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: aad jugaadee hai bhee hog ||
english: He was in the beginning, He has been throughout the ages, He is now, and He shall always be.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: ohu apara(n)par karanai jog ||11||
english: He is unlimited, and capable of doing everything. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਸਮੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: dasamee naam daan isanaan ||
english: The Tenth Day: Meditate on the Naam, give to charity, and purify yourself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: anadin majan sachaa gun giaan ||
english: Night and day, bathe in spiritual wisdom and the Glorious Virtues of the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: sach mail na laagai bhram bhau bhaagai ||
english: Truth cannot be polluted; doubt and fear run away from it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਕਾਚੈ ਤਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: bilam na tootas kaachai taagai ||
english: The flimsy thread breaks in an instant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤਾਗਾ ਜਗੁ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu taagaa jag evai jaanahu ||
english: Know that the world is just like this thread.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਹੁ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: asathir cheet saach ra(n)g maanahu ||12||
english: Your consciousness shall become steady and stable, enjoying the Love of the True Lord. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਇਕੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ekaadasee ik ridai vasaavai ||
english: The Eleventh Day: Enshrine the One Lord within your heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਸਾ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hi(n)saa mamataa mohu chukaavai ||
english: Eradicate cruelty, egotism and emotional attachment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਆਤਮ ਚੀਨੈ ॥
transliteration: phal paavai brat aatam cheenai ||
english: Earn the fruitful rewards, by observing the fast of knowing your own self.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਰਾਚਿ ਤਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੀਨੈ ॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d raach tat nahee beenai ||
english: One who is engrossed in hypocrisy, does not see the true essence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ॥
transliteration: niramal niraahaar nihakeval ||
english: The Lord is immaculate, self-sustaining and unattached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਮਲੁ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: soochai saache naa laagai mal ||13||
english: The Pure, True Lord cannot be polluted. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਏਕੋ ਏਕਾ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhau tah eko ekaa ||
english: Wherever I look, I see the One Lord there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਏ ਵੇਕੋ ਵੇਕਾ ॥
transliteration: hor jee upaae veko vekaa ||
english: He created the other beings, of many and various kinds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਲੋਹਾਰ ਕੀਏ ਫਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: phalohaar keee phal jaai ||
english: Eating only fruits, one loses the fruits of life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਖਾਏ ਸਾਦੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ras kas khaae saad gavaai ||
english: Eating only delicacies of various sorts, one loses the true taste.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਪਟੈ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kooRai laalach lapatai lapataai ||
english: In fraud and greed, people are engrossed and entangled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: chhootai guramukh saach kamaai ||14||
english: The Gurmukh is emancipated, practicing Truth. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਦਸਿ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਅਉਧੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: duaadas mudraa man audhootaa ||
english: The Twelfth Day: One whose mind is not attached to the twelve signs,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਸੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ahinis jaagahi kabahi na sootaa ||
english: remains awake day and night, and never sleeps.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaagat jaag rahai liv laai ||
english: He remains awake and aware, lovingly centered on the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parachai tis kaal na khaai ||
english: With faith in the Guru, he is not consumed by death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਤੀਤ ਭਏ ਮਾਰੇ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ateet bhae maare bairaaee ||
english: Those who become detached, and conquer the five enemies

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਹ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak tah liv laaee ||15||
english: - prays Nanak, they are lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਦਸੀ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: duaadasee daiaa daan kar jaanai ||
english: The Twelfth Day: Know, and practice, compassion and charity.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਤੋ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਆਣੈ ॥
transliteration: baahar jaato bheetar aanai ||
english: Bring your out-going mind back home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਰਤੀ ਬਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: baratee barat rahai nihakaam ||
english: Observe the fast of remaining free of desire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਜਪਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ajapaa jaap japai mukh naam ||
english: Chant the unchanted Chant of the Naam with your mouth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: teen bhavan mahi eko jaanai ||
english: Know that the One Lord is contained in the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: sabh such sa(n)jam saach pachhaanai ||16||
english: Purity and self-discipline are all contained in knowing the Truth. ||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਸਿ ਤਰਵਰ ਸਮੁਦ ਕਨਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: teras taravar samud kanaarai ||
english: The Thirteenth Day: He is like a tree on the sea-shore.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਿਖਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit mool sikhar liv taarai ||
english: But his roots can become immortal, if his mind is attuned to the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡਰ ਡਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਬੂਡੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dar dar marai na boodai koi ||
english: Then, he will not die of fear or anxiety, and he will never drown.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਡਰੁ ਬੂਡਿ ਮਰੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: nidar bood marai pat khoi ||
english: Without the Fear of God, he drowns and dies, and loses his honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡਰ ਮਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: dar mahi ghar ghar mahi dar jaanai ||
english: With the Fear of God in his heart, and his heart in the Fear of God, he knows God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੈ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: takhat nivaas sach man bhaanai ||17||
english: He sits on the throne, and becomes pleasing to the Mind of the True Lord. ||17||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਦਸਿ ਚਉਥੇ ਥਾਵਹਿ ਲਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: chaudas chauthe thaavahi lahi paavai ||
english: The Fourteenth Day: One who enters into the fourth state,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਸ ਤਾਮਸ ਸਤ ਕਾਲ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: raajas taamas sat kaal samaavai ||
english: overcomes time, and the three qualities of raajas, taamas and satva.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਸੀਅਰ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saseear kai ghar soor samaavai ||
english: Then the sun enters into the house of the moon,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jog jugat kee keemat paavai ||
english: and one knows the value of the technology of Yoga.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਦਸਿ ਭਵਨ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: chaudas bhavan paataal samaae ||
english: He remains lovingly focused on God, who is permeating the fourteen worlds,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: kha(n)d brahama(n)d rahiaa liv laae ||18||
english: The nether regions of the underworld, the galaxies and solar systems. ||18||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮਾਵਸਿਆ ਚੰਦੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਗੈਣਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: amaavasiaa cha(n)d gupat gainaar ||
english: Amaavas - The Night of the New Moon: The moon is hidden in the sky.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: boojhahu giaanee sabad beechaar ||
english: O wise one, understand and contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਸੀਅਰੁ ਗਗਨਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: saseear gagan jot tihu loee ||
english: The moon in the sky illuminates the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kar kar vekhai karataa soee ||
english: Creating the creation, the Creator beholds it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur te deesai so tis hee maahi ||
english: One who sees, through the Guru, merges into Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: manamukh bhoole aavahi jaahi ||19||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, coming and going in reincarnation. ||19||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ghar dar thaap thir thaan suhaavai ||
english: One who establishes his home within his own heart, obtains the most beautiful, permanent place.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aap pachhaanai jaa satigur paavai ||
english: One comes to understand his own self, when he finds the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਆਸਾ ਤਹ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jah aasaa tah binas binaasaa ||
english: Wherever there is hope, there is destruction and desolation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫੂਟੈ ਖਪਰੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਨਸਾ ॥
transliteration: phootai khapar dubidhaa manasaa ||
english: The bowl of duality and selfishness breaks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: mamataa jaal te rahai udaasaa ||
english: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of that one,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੨੦॥੧॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak ham taa ke daasaa ||20||1||
english: Who remains detached amidst the traps of attachment. ||20||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਵਾਰ ਸਤ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 vaar sat ghar 10 ||
english: Bilaaval, Third Mehl, The Seven Days, Tenth House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿਤ ਵਾਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aadit vaar aad purakh hai soee ||
english: Sunday: He, the Lord, is the Primal Being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape varatai avar na koee ||
english: He Himself is the Pervading Lord; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜਗੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਰੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ot pot jag rahiaa paroee ||
english: Through and through, He is woven into the fabric of the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa karai s hoee ||
english: Whatever the Creator Himself does, that alone happens.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: naam rate sadaa sukh hoee ||
english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is forever in peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koee ||1||
english: But how rare is the one, who, as Gurmukh, understands this. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਪਨੀ ਜਪਉ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: hiradai japanee japau gunataasaa ||
english: Within my heart, I chant the Chant of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਪਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har agam agochar apara(n)par suaamee jan pag lag dhiaavau hoi daasan daasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord, my Lord and Master, is inaccessible, unfathomable and unlimited. Grasping the feet of the Lord's humble servants, I meditate on Him, and become the slave of His slaves. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਮਵਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: somavaar sach rahiaa samaai ||
english: Monday: The True Lord is permeating and pervading.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tis kee keemat kahee na jaai ||
english: His value cannot be described.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aakh aakh rahe sabh liv laai ||
english: Talking and speaking about Him, all keep themselves lovingly focused on Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis devai tis palai paai ||
english: Devotion falls into the laps of those whom He so blesses.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਲਖਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar lakhiaa na jaai ||
english: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; He cannot be seen.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad har rahiaa samaai ||2||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is seen to be permeating and pervading everywhere. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)gal maaiaa mohu upaaiaa ||
english: Tuesday: The Lord created love and attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape sir sir dha(n)dhai laaiaa ||
english: He Himself has enjoined each and every being to their tasks.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: aap bujhaae soee boojhai ||
english: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad dar ghar soojhai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one understands his heart and home.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: prem bhagat kare liv laai ||
english: He worships the Lord in loving devotion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa sabad jalaai ||3||
english: His egotism and self-conceit are burnt away by the Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੁਧਵਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: budhavaar aape budh saar ||
english: Wednesday: He Himself bestows sublime understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh karanee sabad veechaar ||
english: The Gurmukh does good deeds, and contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naam rate man niramal hoi ||
english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind become pure and immaculate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavai haumai mal khoi ||
english: He sings the Glorious Glorious Praises of the Lord, and washes off the filth of egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਦ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dar sachai sad sobhaa paae ||
english: In the Court of the True Lord, he obtains lasting glory.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naam rate gur sabad suhaae ||4||
english: Imbued with the Naam, he is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: laahaa naam paae gur duaar ||
english: The profit of the Naam is obtained through the Door of the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape devai devanahaar ||
english: The Great Giver Himself gives it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jo devai tis kau bal jaaeeai ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the One who gives it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee aap gavaaeeai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, self-conceit is eradicated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak naam rakhahu ur dhaar ||
english: O Nanak, enshrine the Naam within your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੇ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: devanahaare kau jaikaar ||5||
english: I celebrate the victory of the Lord, the Great Giver. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵੀਰਵਾਰਿ ਵੀਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: veeravaar veer bharam bhulaae ||
english: Thursday: The fifty-two warriors were deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਭੂਤ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pret bhoot sabh doojai laae ||
english: All the goblins and demons are attached to duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਵੇਕਾ ॥
transliteration: aap upaae kar vekhai vekaa ||
english: God Himself created them, and sees each one distinct.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕਾ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa karate teree tekaa ||
english: O Creator Lord, You are the Support of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t teree saranaaee ||
english: The beings and creatures are under Your protection.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: so milai jis laihi milaaee ||6||
english: He alone meets You, whom You Yourself meet. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਵਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sukravaar prabh rahiaa samaaee ||
english: Friday: God is permeating and pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਭ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aap upaai sabh keemat paaee ||
english: He Himself created all, and appraises the value of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s karai beechaar ||
english: One who become Gurmukh, contemplates the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sach sa(n)jam karanee hai kaar ||
english: He practices truth and self-restraint.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਰਤੁ ਨੇਮੁ ਨਿਤਾਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: varat nem nitaaprat poojaa ||
english: Without genuine understanding, all fasts,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭੁ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin boojhe sabh bhaau hai doojaa ||7||
english: Religious rituals and daily worship services lead only to the love of duality. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਛਨਿਛਰਵਾਰਿ ਸਉਣ ਸਾਸਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: chhanichharavaar saun saasat beechaar ||
english: Saturday: Contemplating good omens and the Shaastras,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਮੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: haumai meraa bharamai sa(n)saar ||
english: in egotism and self-conceit, the world wanders in delusion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhaa doojai bhaai ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukh in engrossed in the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jam dar baadhaa chotaa khaai ||
english: Bound and gagged at death's door, he is beaten and punished.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sadaa sukh paae ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one finds lasting peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੮॥
transliteration: sach karanee saach liv laae ||8||
english: He practices Truth, and lovingly focuses on the Truth. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi se vadabhaagee ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar sach liv laagee ||
english: Conquering their ego, they embrace love for the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: terai ra(n)g raate sahaj subhaai ||
english: They are automatically imbued with Your Love, O Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: too sukhadaataa laihi milaai ||
english: You are the Giver of peace; You merge them into Yourself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ekas te doojaa naahee koi ||
english: Everything comes from the One and only Lord; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: guramukh boojhai sojhee hoi ||9||
english: The Gurmukh realizes this, and understands. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਦ੍ਰਹ ਥਿਤਂੀ ਤੈ ਸਤ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)drah thita(n)ee tai sat vaar ||
english: The fifteen lunar days, the seven days of the week,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਹਾ ਰੁਤੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਾਰ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: maahaa rutee aavahi vaar vaar ||
english: the months, seasons, days and nights, come over and over again;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dinas rain tivai sa(n)saar ||
english: so the world goes on.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aavaa gaun keeaa karataar ||
english: Coming and going were created by the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਕਲ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: nihachal saach rahiaa kal dhaar ||
english: The True Lord remains steady and stable, by His almighty power.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh boojhai ko sabad veechaar ||10||1||
english: O Nanak, how rare is that Gurmukh who understands, and contemplates the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: aad purakh aape srisat saaje ||
english: The Primal Lord Himself formed the Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t maaiaa mohi paaje ||
english: The beings and creatures are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਰਪੰਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai parapa(n)ch laage ||
english: In the love of duality, they are attached to the illusory material world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: aavahi jaavahi marahi abhaage ||
english: The unfortunate ones die, and continue to come and go.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhetiai sojhee paai ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, understanding is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: parapa(n)ch chookai sach samaai ||1||
english: Then, the illusion of the material world is shattered, and one merges in Truth. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai masatak likhiaa lekh ||
english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taa kai man vasiaa prabh ek ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - the One God abides within his mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: srisat upaai aape sabh vekhai ||
english: He created the Universe, and He Himself beholds all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: koi na metai terai lekhai ||
english: No one can erase Your record, Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik je ko kahai kahaae ||
english: If someone calls himself a Siddha or a seeker,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bharame bhoolaa aavai jaae ||
english: he is deluded by doubt, and will continue coming and going.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevai so jan boojhai ||
english: That humble being alone understands, who serves the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: haumai maare taa dar soojhai ||2||
english: Conquering his ego, he finds the Lord's Door. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੂਆ ॥
transliteration: ekas te sabh doojaa hooaa ||
english: From the One Lord, all others were formed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
transliteration: eko varatai avar na beeaa ||
english: The One Lord is pervading everywhere; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੇ ਤੇ ਜੇ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: dooje te je eko jaanai ||
english: Renouncing duality, one comes to know the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad har dar neesaanai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one knows the Lord's Door, and His Banner.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਏਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhete taa eko paae ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, one finds the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vichahu doojaa thaak rahaae ||3||
english: Duality is subdued within. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਡਾਢਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis daa saahib daadhaa hoi ||
english: One who belongs to the All-powerful Lord and Master

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis no maar na saakai koi ||
english: no one can destroy him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saahib kee sevak rahai saranaaee ||
english: The Lord's servant remains under His protection;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: aape bakhase de vadiaaee ||
english: The Lord Himself forgives him, and blesses him with glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis te oopar naahee koi ||
english: There is none higher than Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਡਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kaun darai dar kis kaa hoi ||4||
english: Why should he be afraid? What should he ever fear? ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
transliteration: guramatee saa(n)t vasai sareer ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, peace and tranquility abide within the body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨੑਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
transliteration: sabad cheenhi phir lagai na peer ||
english: Remember the Word of the Shabad, and you shall never suffer pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aavai na jaai naa dukh paae ||
english: You shall not have to come or go, or suffer in sorrow.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naame raate sahaj samaae ||
english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall merge in celestial peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh vekhai hadoor ||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh beholds Him ever-present, close at hand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੫॥
transliteration: meraa prabh sad rahiaa bharapoor ||5||
english: My God is always fully pervading everywhere. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ik sevak ik bharam bhulaae ||
english: Some are selfless servants, while others wander, deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape kare har aap karaae ||
english: The Lord Himself does, and causes everything to be done.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: eko varatai avar na koi ||
english: The One Lord is all-pervading; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man ros keejai je doojaa hoi ||
english: The mortal might complain, if there were any other.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve karanee saaree ||
english: Serve the True Guru; this is the most excellent action.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: dar saachai saache veechaaree ||6||
english: In the Court of the True Lord, you shall be judged true. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਸਭਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: thitee vaar sabh sabad suhaae ||
english: All the lunar days, and the days of the week are beautiful, when one contemplates the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve taa phal paae ||
english: If one serves the True Guru, he obtains the fruits of his rewards.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਸਭਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: thitee vaar sabh aavahi jaahi ||
english: The omens and days all come and go.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gurasabad nihachal sadaa sach samaahi ||
english: But the Word of the Guru's Shabad is eternal and unchanging. Through it, one merges in the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: thitee vaar taa jaa sach raate ||
english: The days are auspicious, when one is imbued with Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਕਾਚੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin naavai sabh bharamahi kaache ||7||
english: Without the Name, all the false ones wander deluded. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਬਿਗਤੀ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh marahi mar bigatee jaahi ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs die, and dead, they fall into the most evil state.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ek na chetahi doojai lobhaahi ||
english: They do not remember the One Lord; they are deluded by duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਚੇਤ ਪਿੰਡੀ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: achet pi(n)dee agiaan a(n)dhaar ||
english: The human body is unconscious, ignorant and blind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਏ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai kiu paae paar ||
english: Without the Word of the Shabad, how can anyone cross over?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aap upaae upaavanahaar ||
english: The Creator Himself creates.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੮॥
transliteration: aape keeton gur veechaar ||8||
english: He Himself contemplates the Guru's Word. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bahute bhekh karahi bhekhadhaaree ||
english: The religious fanatics wear all sorts of religious robes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਵਿ ਭਵਿ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਕਾਚੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bhav bhav bharamahi kaachee saaree ||
english: They roll around and wander around, like the false dice on the board.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਆਗੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aithai sukh na aagai hoi ||
english: They find no peace, here or hereafter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ ਅਪਣਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mue apanaa janam khoi ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs waste away their lives, and die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve bharam chukaae ||
english: Serving the True Guru, doubt is driven away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੯॥
transliteration: ghar hee a(n)dar sach mahal paae ||9||
english: Deep within the home of the heart, one finds the Mansion of the True Lord's Presence. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape pooraa kare s hoi ||
english: Whatever the Perfect Lord does, that alone happens.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹਿ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ehi thitee vaar doojaa doi ||
english: Concern with these omens and days leads only to duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur baajhahu a(n)dh gubaar ||
english: Without the True Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: thitee vaar sevahi mugadh gavaar ||
english: Only idiots and fools worry about these omens and days.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh boojhai sojhee paai ||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains understanding and realization;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
transliteration: ikat naam sadaa rahiaa samaai ||10||2||
english: he remains forever merged in the Name of the One Lord. ||10||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 chha(n)t dakhanee ||
english: Bilaaval, First Mehl, Chhant, Dakhnee:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਨਵੇਲੜੀਆ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dh navelaReeaa goil aaee raam ||
english: The young, innocent soul-bride has come to the pasture lands of the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਟੁਕੀ ਡਾਰਿ ਧਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: matukee daar dharee har liv laaee raam ||
english: Laying aside her pitcher of worldly concern, she lovingly attunes herself to her Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੀ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: liv laai har siu rahee goil sahaj sabad seegaareeaa ||
english: She remains lovingly absorbed in the pasture of the Lord, automatically embellished with the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kar joR gur pahi kar bina(n)tee milahu saach piaareeaa ||
english: With her palms pressed together, she prays to the Guru, to unite her with her True Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dhan bhaai bhagatee dekh preetam kaam krodh nivaariaa ||
english: Seeing His bride's loving devotion, the Beloved Lord eradicates unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁੰਧ ਨਵੇਲ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak mu(n)dh navel su(n)dar dekh pir saadhaariaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, the young, innocent bride is so beautiful; seeing her Husband Lord, she is comforted. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਨਵੇਲੜੀਏ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sach navelaReee joban baalee raam ||
english: Truthfully, O young soul-bride, your youth keeps you innocent.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਉ ਕਹੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਹ ਨਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aau na jaau kahee apane sah naalee raam ||
english: Do not come and go anywhere; stay with your Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਹ ਅਪਨੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਾਸੀ ਮੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: naah apane sa(n)g daasee mai bhagat har kee bhaavae ||
english: I will stay with my Husband Lord; I am His hand-maiden. Devotional worship to the Lord is pleasing to me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਐ ਸਹਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: agaadh bodh akath katheeai sahaj prabh gun gaavae ||
english: I know the unknowable, and speak the unspoken; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Celestial Lord God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਾਲ ਰਸੀਆ ਰਵੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: raam naam rasaal raseeaa ravai saach piaareeaa ||
english: She who chants and savors the taste of the Lord's Name is loved by the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੀਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur sabad deeaa daan keeaa naanakaa veechaareeaa ||2||
english: The Guru grants her the gift of the Shabad; O Nanak, she contemplates and reflects upon it. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਮੋਹਿਅੜੀ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sreedhar mohiaRee pir sa(n)g sootee raam ||
english: She who is fascinated by the Supreme Lord, sleeps with her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਗੂਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bhaai chalo saach sa(n)gootee raam ||
english: She walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, attuned to the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਗੂਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: dhan saach sa(n)gootee har sa(n)g sootee sa(n)g sakhee saheleeaa ||
english: The soul-bride is attuned to the Truth, and sleeps with the Lord, along with her companions and sister soul-brides.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਭਾਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮ ਮੇਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ik bhaai ik man naam vasiaa satiguroo ham meleeaa ||
english: Loving the One Lord, with one-pointed mind, the Naam dwells within; I am united with the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
transliteration: din rain ghaRee na chasaa visarai saas saas nira(n)jano ||
english: Day and night, with each and every breath, I do not forget the Immaculate Lord, for a moment, even for an instant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabad jot jagaai deepak naanakaa bhau bha(n)jano ||3||
english: So light the lamp of the Shabad, O Nanak, and burn away your fear. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਇੜੀਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jot sabaaiReee tribhavan saare raam ||
english: O soul-bride, the Lord's Light pervades all the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat rav rahiaa alakh apaare raam ||
english: He is pervading each and every heart, the Invisible and Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: alakh apaar apaar saachaa aap maar milaaeeai ||
english: He is Invisible and Infinite, Infinite and True; subduing his self-conceit, one meets Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਜਾਲਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa lobh jaalahu sabad mail chukaaeeai ||
english: So burn away your egotistical pride, attachment and greed, with the Word of the Shabad; wash away your filth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਰੀ ਭਾਣੈ ਤਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dar jaai darasan karee bhaanai taar taaranahaariaa ||
english: When you go to the Lord's Door, you shall receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; by His Will, the Savior will carry you across and save you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: har naam a(n)mrit chaakh tripatee naanakaa ur dhaariaa ||4||1||
english: Tasting the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, the soul-bride is satisfied; O Nanak, she enshrines Him in her heart. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 ||
english: Bilaaval, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਘਣਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mai man chaau ghanaa saach vigaasee raam ||
english: My mind is filled with such a great joy; I have blossomed forth in Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mohee prem pire prabh abinaasee raam ||
english: I am enticed by the love of my Husband Lord, the Eternal, Imperishable Lord God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਿਗਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਥਹ ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ॥
transliteration: avigato har naath naathah tisai bhaavai so theeai ||
english: The Lord is everlasting, the Master of masters. Whatever He wills, happens.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kirapaal sadaa daiaal daataa jeeaa a(n)dar too(n) jeeai ||
english: O Great Giver, You are always kind and compassionate. You infuse life into all living beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
transliteration: mai avar giaan na dhiaan poojaa har naam a(n)tar vas rahe ||
english: I have no other spiritual wisdom, meditation or worship; the Name of the Lord alone dwells deep within me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੇਖੁ ਭਵਨੀ ਹਠੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhekh bhavanee hath na jaanaa naanakaa sach gahi rahe ||1||
english: I know nothing about religious robes, pilgrimages or stubborn fanaticism; O Nanak, I hold tight to the Truth. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਿੰਨੜੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਭਲੀ ਦਿਨਸ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhi(n)naRee rain bhalee dinas suhaae raam ||
english: The night is beautiful, drenched with dew, and the day is delightful,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਤੜੀਏ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਜਗਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: nij ghar sootaReee piram jagaae raam ||
english: when her Husband Lord wakes the sleeping soul-bride, in the home of the self.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਹਾਣਿ ਨਵ ਧਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਾਗੀ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: nav haan nav dhan sabad jaagee aapane pir bhaaneeaa ||
english: The young bride has awakened to the Word of the Shabad; she is pleasing to her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਲੋਕਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: taj kooR kapat subhaau doojaa chaakaree lokaaneeaa ||
english: So renounce falsehood, fraud, love of duality and working for people.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠੇ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mai naam har kaa haar ka(n)the saach sabad neesaaniaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord is my necklace, and I am anointed with the True Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kar joR naanak saach maagai nadar kar tudh bhaaniaa ||2||
english: With his palms pressed together, Nanak begs for the gift of the True Name; please, bless me with Your Grace, through the pleasure of Your Will. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗੁ ਸਲੋਨੜੀਏ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jaag salonaReee bolai gurabaanee raam ||
english: Awake, O bride of splendored eyes, and chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਅੜੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jin sun ma(n)niaRee akath kahaanee raam ||
english: Listen, and place your faith in the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਏ ॥
transliteration: akath kahaanee pad nirabaanee ko viralaa guramukh boojhae ||
english: The Unspoken Speech, the state of Nirvaanaa - how rare is the Gurmukh who understands this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਸੂਝਏ ॥
transliteration: ohu sabad samaae aap gavaae tribhavan sojhee soojhae ||
english: Merging in the Word of the Shabad, self-conceit is eradicated, and the three worlds are revealed to her understanding.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: rahai ateet apara(n)par raataa saach man gun saariaa ||
english: Remaining detached, with infinity infusing, the true mind cherishes the virtues of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ohu poor rahiaa sarab thaaee naanakaa ur dhaariaa ||3||
english: He is fully pervading and permeating all places; Nanak has enshrined Him within his heart. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇੜੀਏ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mahal bulaaiReee bhagat sanehee raam ||
english: The Lord is calling you to the Mansion of His Presence; O soul-bride, He is the Lover of His devotees.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਹਸੀ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramat man rahasee seejhas dehee raam ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, your mind shall be delighted, and your body shall be fulfilled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਰੀਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਝੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਕ ਨਾਥੁ ਪਛਾਣਏ ॥
transliteration: man maar reejhai sabad seejhai trai lok naath pachhaanae ||
english: Conquer and subdue your mind, and love the Word of the Shabad; reform yourself, and realize the Lord of the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਡੀਗਿ ਡੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣਏ ॥
transliteration: man deeg dol na jaai kat hee aapanaa pir jaanae ||
english: Her mind shall not waver or wander anywhere else, when she comes to know her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਖਸਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਤਕੀਆ ਤੇਰਓ ॥
transliteration: mai aadhaar teraa too khasam meraa mai taan takeeaa terao ||
english: You are my only Support, You are my Lord and Master. You are my strength and anchor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਸੂਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਝਗਰੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਓ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: saach soochaa sadaa naanak gur sabad jhagar niberao ||4||2||
english: She is forever truthful and pure, O Nanak; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, conflicts are resolved. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਮੰਗਲ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t bilaaval mahalaa 4 ma(n)gal ||
english: Chhant, Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Mangal ~ The Song Of Joy:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: meraa har prabh sejai aaiaa man sukh samaanaa raam ||
english: My Lord God has come to my bed, and my mind is merged with the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur tuthai har prabh paaiaa ra(n)g raleeaa maanaa raam ||
english: As it pleases the Guru, I have found the Lord God, and I revel and delight in His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaageeaa sohaaganee har masatak maanaa raam ||
english: Very fortunate are those happy soul-brides, who have the jewel of the Naam upon their foreheads.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har prabh har sohaag hai naanak man bhaanaa raam ||1||
english: The Lord, the Lord God, is Nanak's Husband Lord, pleasing to his mind. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਮਾਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)maaniaa har maan hai har prabh har aapai raam ||
english: The Lord is the honor of the dishonored. The Lord, the Lord God is Himself by Himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramukh aap gavaaiaa nit har har jaapai raam ||
english: The Gurmukh eradicates self-conceit, and constantly chants the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mere har prabh bhaavai so karai har ra(n)g har raapai raam ||
english: My Lord God does whatever He pleases; the Lord imbues mortal beings with the color of His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak sahaj milaaiaa har ras har dhraapai raam ||2||
english: Servant Nanak is easily merged into the Celestial Lord. He is satisfied with the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵਣ ਵੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: maanas janam har paaeeai har raavan veraa raam ||
english: The Lord is found only through this human incarnation. This is the time to contemplate the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਣੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramukh mil sohaaganee ra(n)g hoi ghaneraa raam ||
english: As Gurmukhs, the happy soul-brides meet Him, and their love for Him is abundant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਭਾਗੁ ਮੰਦੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jin maanas janam na paaiaa tinh bhaag ma(n)deraa raam ||
english: Those who have not attained human incarnation, are cursed by evil destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har har har har raakh prabh naanak jan teraa raam ||3||
english: O Lord, God, Har, Har, Har, Har, save Nanak; he is Your humble servant. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur har prabh agam driRaaiaa man tan ra(n)g bheenaa raam ||
english: The Guru has implanted within me the Name of the Inaccessible Lord God; my mind and body are drenched with the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal har naam hai guramukh har leenaa raam ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the Lover of His devotees; the Gurmukhs attain the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bin har naam na jeevade jiu jal bin meenaa raam ||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, they cannot even live, like the fish without water.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: saphal janam har paaiaa naanak prabh keenaa raam ||4||1||3||
english: Finding the Lord, my life has become fruitful; O Nanak, the Lord God has fulfilled me. ||4||1||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 salok ||
english: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Salok:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: har prabh sajan loR lahu man vasai vadabhaag ||
english: Seek out the Lord God, your only true Friend. He shall dwell in your mind, by great good fortune.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur poorai vekhaaliaa naanak har liv laag ||1||
english: The True Guru shall reveal Him to you; O Nanak, lovingly focus yourself on the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਆਈਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਝਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: meraa har prabh raavan aaeeaa haumai bikh jhaage raam ||
english: The soul-bride has come to ravish and enjoy her Lord God, after eradicating the poison of egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramat aap mitaaiaa har har liv laage raam ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, she has eliminated her self-conceit; she is lovingly attuned to her Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kamal paragaasiaa gur giaanee jaage raam ||
english: Her heart-lotus deep within has blossomed forth, and through the Guru, spiritual wisdom has been awakened within her.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak har prabh paaiaa poorai vadabhaage raam ||1||
english: Servant Nanak has found the Lord God, by perfect, great good fortune. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਧਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har prabh har man bhaaiaa har naam vadhaaee raam ||
english: The Lord, the Lord God, is pleasing to her mind; the Lord's Name resounds within her.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai prabh paaiaa har har liv laaee raam ||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, God is obtained; she is lovingly focused on the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: agiaan a(n)dheraa katiaa jot paragatiaaee raam ||
english: The darkness of ignorance is dispelled, and the Divine Light radiantly shines forth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam adhaar hai har naam samaaee raam ||2||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Nanak's only Support; he merges into the Lord's Name. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਰਾਵੀਆ ਜਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dhan har prabh piaarai raaveeaa jaa(n) har prabh bhaaee raam ||
english: The soul-bride is ravished and enjoyed by her Beloved Lord God, when the Lord God is pleased with her.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਸਾਈਆ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਲਕ ਮਸਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: akhee prem kasaaeeaa jiu bilak masaaee raam ||
english: My eyes are drawn to His Love, like the cat to the mouse.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਆਘਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai har meliaa har ras aaghaaee raam ||
english: The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord; I am satisfied by the subtle essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam vigasiaa har har liv laaee raam ||3||
english: Servant Nanak blossoms forth in the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he is lovingly attuned to the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ham moorakh mugadh milaaiaa har kirapaa dhaaree raam ||
english: I am a fool and an idiot, but the Lord showered me with His Mercy, and united me with Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n guroo saabaas hai jin haumai maaree raam ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the most wonderful Guru, who has conquered egotism.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jinh vadabhaageeaa vadabhaag hai har har ur dhaaree raam ||
english: Very fortunate, of blessed destiny are those, who enshrine the Lord, Har, Har, in their hearts.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam salaahi too naame balihaaree raam ||4||2||4||
english: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, and be a sacrifice to the Naam. ||4||2||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਲ ਸਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)gal saaj bhaiaa prabh apanaa gaaiaa raam ||
english: The time of rejoicing has come; I sing of my Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਵਰੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਚਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: abinaasee var suniaa man upajiaa chaaiaa raam ||
english: I have heard of my Imperishable Husband Lord, and happiness fills my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗੈ ਕਬ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਤੇ ॥
transliteration: man preet laagai vadai bhaagai kab mileeai pooran pate ||
english: My mind is in love with Him; when shall I realize my great good fortune, and meet with my Perfect Husband?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਤੇ ॥
transliteration: sahaje samaaeeai govi(n)d paaeeai dehu sakheee mohi mate ||
english: If only I could meet the Lord of the Universe, and be automatically absorbed into Him; tell me how, O my companions!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਠਾਢੀ ਕਰਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: din rain thaadhee karau sevaa prabh kavan jugatee paaiaa ||
english: Day and night, I stand and serve my God; how can I attain Him?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੈਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa laihu mohi laR laaiaa ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, have mercy on me, and attach me to the hem of Your robe, O Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਇਆ ਸਮਾਹੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhaiaa samaahaRaa har ratan visaahaa raam ||
english: Joy has come! I have purchased the jewel of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: khojee khoj ladhaa har sa(n)tan paahaa raam ||
english: Searching, the seeker has found the Lord with the Saints.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੇ ਕਥਹਿ ਅਕਥ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: mile sa(n)t piaare daiaa dhaare kathahi akath beechaaro ||
english: I have met the Beloved Saints, and they have blessed me with their kindness; I contemplate the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
transliteration: ik chit ik man dhiaai suaamee laai preet piaaro ||
english: With my consciousness centered, and my mind one-pointed, I meditate on my Lord and Master, with love and affection.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: kar joR prabh pahi kar bina(n)tee milai har jas laahaa ||
english: With my palms pressed together, I pray unto God, to bless me with the profit of the Lord's Praise.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak daas teraa meraa prabh agam athaahaa ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, I am Your slave. My God is inaccessible and unfathomable. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਾ ਅਟਲੁ ਗਣਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੰਜੋਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: saahaa atal ganiaa pooran sa(n)jogo raam ||
english: The date for my wedding is set, and cannot be changed; my union with the Lord is perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਹ ਸਮੂਹ ਭਇਆ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਜੋਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sukhah samooh bhaiaa gaiaa vijogo raam ||
english: I am totally at peace, and my separation from Him has ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਏ ਬਣੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਜਾਞੀਆਂ ॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)t aae prabh dhiaae bane acharaj jaanjeeaa(n) ||
english: The Saints meet and come together, and meditate on God; they form a wondrous wedding party.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਢੋਏ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਮਾਞੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mil ikatr hoe sahaj dhoe man preet upajee maanjeeaa ||
english: Gathering together, they arrive with poise and grace, and love fills the minds of the bride's family.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
transliteration: mil jot jotee ot potee har naam sabh ras bhogo ||
english: Her light blends with His Light, through and through, and everyone enjoys the Nectar of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਸੰਤਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sabh sa(n)t melee prabh karan kaaran jogo ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, the Saints have totally united me with God, the All-powerful Cause of causes. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਸਭਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhavan suhaavaRaa dharat sabhaagee raam ||
english: Beautiful is my home, and beauteous is the earth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਅੜਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: prabh ghar aaiaRaa gur charanee laagee raam ||
english: God has entered the home of my heart; I touch the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਜਾਗੀ ਸਗਲ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gur charan laagee sahaj jaagee sagal ichhaa pu(n)neeaa ||
english: Grasping the Guru's feet, I awake in peace and poise. All my desires are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: meree aas pooree sa(n)t dhooree har mile ka(n)t vichhu(n)niaa ||
english: My hopes are fulfilled, through the dust of the feet of the Saints. After such a long separation, I have met my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਹੰ ਮਤਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
transliteration: aana(n)d anadin vajahi vaaje aha(n) mat man kee tiaagee ||
english: Night and day, the sounds of ecstasy resound and resonate; I have forsaken my stubborn-minded intellect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee sa(n)tasa(n)g liv laagee ||4||1||
english: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of my Lord and Master; in the Society of the Saints, I am lovingly attuned to Him. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਗ ਸੁਲਖਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhaag sulakhanaa har ka(n)t hamaaraa raam ||
english: By blessed destiny, I have found my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਜਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: anahad baajitraa tis dhun darabaaraa raam ||
english: The unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਉਮਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: aana(n)d anadin vajahi vaaje dinas rain umaahaa ||
english: Night and day, the sounds of ecstasy resound and resonate; day and night, I am enraptured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: tah rog sog na dookh biaapai janam maran na taahaa ||
english: Disease, sorrow and suffering do not afflict anyone there; there is no birth or death there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ridh sidh sudhaa ras a(n)mrit bhagat bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
english: There are treasures overflowing there - wealth, miraculous powers, ambrosial nectar and devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਵੰਞਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak balihaar va(n)njaa paarabraham praan adhaaraa ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, I am a sacrifice, devoted to the Supreme Lord God, the Support of the breath of life. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਅ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sun sakhee sahelaReeho mil ma(n)gal gaavah raam ||
english: Listen, O my companions, and sister soul-brides, let's join together and sing the songs of joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਰਾਵਹ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: man tan prem kare tis prabh kau raavah raam ||
english: Loving our God with mind and body, let's ravish and enjoy Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਰਾਵਹ ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਵਹ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਲਕ ਨ ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kar prem raavah tisai bhaavah ik nimakh palak na tiaageeai ||
english: Lovingly enjoying Him, we become pleasing to Him; let's not reject Him, for a moment, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਈਐ ਨਹ ਲਜਾਈਐ ਚਰਨ ਰਜ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਗੀਐ ॥
transliteration: gahi ka(n)th laaeeai nah lajaaeeai charan raj man paageeai ||
english: Let's hug Him close in our embrace, and not feel shy; let's bathe our minds in the dust of His feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਮੋਹਹ ਅਨਤ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਧਾਵਹ ॥
transliteration: bhagat thagauree paai mohah anat katahoo na dhaavah ||
english: With the intoxicating drug of devotional worship, let's entice Him, and not wander anywhere else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਅਮਰ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵਹ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak mil sa(n)g saajan amar padavee paavah ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, meeting with our True Friend, we attain the immortal status. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ਪੇਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bisaman bisam bhaee pekh gun abinaasee raam ||
english: I am wonder-struck and amazed, gazing upon the Glories of my Imperishable Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਗਹੀ ਕਟਿ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kar gahi bhujaa gahee kat jam kee phaasee raam ||
english: He took my hand, and held my arm, and cut away the noose of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੑੀ ਦਾਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਅੰਕੁਰਿ ਉਦੋਤੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gahi bhujaa leenhee daas keenhee a(n)kur udot janaaiaa ||
english: Holding me by the arm, He made me His slave; the branch has sprouted in abundance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਲਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਠੇ ਦਿਵਸ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: malan moh bikaar naathe divas niramal aaiaa ||
english: Pollution, attachment and corruption have run away; the immaculate day has dawned.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: drisat dhaaree man piaaree mahaa duramat naasee ||
english: Casting His Glance of Grace, the Lord loves me with His Mind; my immense evil-mindedness is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak bhaee niramal prabh mile abinaasee ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, I have become immaculate and pure; I have met the Imperishable Lord God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਜਲੁ ਹੂਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sooraj kiran mile jal kaa jal hooaa raam ||
english: The rays of light merge with the sun, and water merges with water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਲੀ ਸੰਪੂਰਨੁ ਥੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jotee jot ralee sa(n)pooran theeaa raam ||
english: One's light blends with the Light, and one becomes totally perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: braham deesai braham suneeai ek ek vakhaaneeai ||
english: I see God, hear God, and speak of the One and only God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਕਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: aatam pasaaraa karanahaaraa prabh binaa nahee jaaneeai ||
english: The soul is the Creator of the expanse of creation. Without God, I know no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aap karataa aap bhugataa aap kaaran keeaa ||
english: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer. He created the Creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak seee jaanahi jinhee har ras peeaa ||4||2||
english: Prays Nanak, they alone know this, who drink in the subtle essence of the Lord. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਵਸਿ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਅਸੀ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹ ॥
transliteration: sakhee aau sakhee vas aau sakhee asee pir kaa ma(n)gal gaavah ||
english: Come, O my sisters, come, O my companions, and let us remain under the Lord's control. Let's sing the Songs of Bliss of our Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਮਤੁ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਵਹ ॥
transliteration: taj maan sakhee taj maan sakhee mat aapane preetam bhaavah ||
english: Renounce your pride, O my companions, renounce your egotistical pride, O my sisters, so that you may become pleasing to your Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
transliteration: taj maan mohu bikaar doojaa sev ek nira(n)jano ||
english: Renounce pride, emotional attachment, corruption and duality, and serve the One Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਗੁ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਰਤ ਬਿਖੰਡਨੋ ॥
transliteration: lag charan saran daiaal preetam sagal durat bikha(n)dano ||
english: Hold tight to the Sanctuary of the Feet of the Merciful Lord, your Beloved, the Destroyer of all sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੀ ਤਜਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਿਧੀ ਨ ਧਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: hoi daas daasee taj udaasee bahuR bidhee na dhaavaa ||
english: Be the slave of His slaves, forsake sorrow and sadness, and do not bother with other devices.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਾਮਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai karahu kirapaa taam ma(n)gal gaavaa ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, O Lord, please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may sing Your songs of bliss. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟੋਹਨੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit pri kaa naam mai a(n)dhule tohanee ||
english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of my Beloved, is like a cane to a blind man.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਜੋਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਮੋਹਨੀ ॥
transliteration: oh johai bahu parakaar su(n)dar mohanee ||
english: Maya seduces in so many ways, like a beautiful enticing woman.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰਿ ਚੰਚਲਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਵ ਦਿਖਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: mohanee mahaa bachitr cha(n)chal anik bhaav dikhaavae ||
english: This enticer is so incredibly beautiful and clever; she entices with countless suggestive gestures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਢੀਠ ਮੀਠੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਣ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
transliteration: hoi dheeth meethee manahi laagai naam lain na aavae ||
english: Maya is stubborn and persistent; she seems so sweet to the mind, and then he does not chant the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਹਿ ਤੀਰੈ ਬਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਾਟ ਘਾਟੈ ਜੋਹਨੀ ॥
transliteration: grih banahi teerai barat poojaa baat ghaatai johanee ||
english: At home, in the forest, on the banks of sacred rivers, fasting, worshipping, on the roads and on the shore, she is spying.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟੋਹਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai daiaa dhaarahu mai naam a(n)dhule tohanee ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, please bless me with Your Kindness, Lord; I am blind, and Your Name is my cane. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਾਥ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ॥
transliteration: mohi anaath pri naath jiu jaanahu tiu rakhahu ||
english: I am helpless and masterless; You, O my Beloved, are my Lord and Master. As it pleases You, so do You protect me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਰੀਝਾਵਉ ਕਹਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ॥
transliteration: chaturaaee mohi naahi reejhaavau kahi mukhahu ||
english: I have no wisdom or cleverness; what face should I put on to please You?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਚਤੁਰਿ ਸੁਘਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਬੇਤੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
transliteration: nah chatur sughar sujaan betee mohi niragun gun nahee ||
