english: I am not clever, skillful or wise; I am worthless, without any virtue at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਨ ਨੈਣ ਬੰਕੇ ਜਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਰਖੁ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
transliteration: nah roop dhoop na nain ba(n)ke jah bhaavai tah rakh tuhee ||
english: I have no beauty or pleasing smell, no beautiful eyes. As it pleases You, please preserve me, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਜਇਅੰਪਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਕਿਨਿ ਲਖਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jai jai jaia(n)pahi sagal jaa kau karunaapat gat kin lakhahu ||
english: His victory is celebrated by all; how can I know the state of the Lord of Mercy?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਖਹੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai sev sevak jiu jaanahu tiu mohi rakhahu ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, I am the servant of Your servants; as it pleases You, please preserve me. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤੁਮ ਨੀਰ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: mohi machhulee tum neer tujh bin kiu sarai ||
english: I am the fish, and You are the water; without You, what can I do?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤੁਮੑ ਬੂੰਦ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਰੈ ॥
transliteration: mohi chaatrik tumh boo(n)d tripatau mukh parai ||
english: I am the rainbird, and You are the rain-drop; when it falls into my mouth, I am satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਪਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੇਰੀ ਜੀਅ ਹੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੇ ॥
transliteration: mukh parai harai piaas meree jee heeaa praanapate ||
english: When it falls into my mouth, my thirst is quenched; You are the Lord of my soul, my heart, my breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਡਿਲੇ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਇ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਗਤੇ ॥
transliteration: laadile laad ladaai sabh mahi mil hamaaree hoi gate ||
english: Touch me, and caress me, O Lord, You are in all; let me meet You, so that I may be emancipated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਮਿਟੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਆਸ ਚਕਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: cheet chitavau mit a(n)dhaare jiu aas chakavee din charai ||
english: In my consciousness I remember You, and the darkness is dispelled, like the chakvi duck, which longs to see the dawn.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai pri sa(n)g melee machhulee neer na veesarai ||4||
english: Prays Nanak, O my Beloved, please unite me with Yourself; the fish never forgets the water. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਭਾਗ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n hamaare bhaag ghar aaiaa pir meraa ||
english: Blessed, blessed is my destiny; my Husband Lord has come into my home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ਸਗਲਾ ਬਨੁ ਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sohe ba(n)k duaar sagalaa ban haraa ||
english: The gate of my mansion is so beautiful, and all my gardens are so green and alive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰ ਹਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
transliteration: har haraa suaamee sukhah gaamee anad ma(n)gal ras ghanaa ||
english: My peace-giving Lord and Master has rejuvenated me, and blessed me with great joy, bliss and love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਵਲ ਨਵਤਨ ਨਾਹੁ ਬਾਲਾ ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਭਣਾ ॥
transliteration: naval navatan naahu baalaa kavan rasanaa gun bhanaa ||
english: My Young Husband Lord is eternally young, and His body is forever youthful; what tongue can I use to chant His Glorious Praises?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਸਗਲ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: meree sej sohee dekh mohee sagal sahasaa dukh haraa ||
english: My bed is beautiful; gazing upon Him, I am fascinated, and all my doubts and pains are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai meree aas pooree mile suaamee apara(n)paraa ||5||1||3||
english: Prays Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; my Lord and Master is unlimited. ||5||1||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਮੰਗਲ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ma(n)gal ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Mangal ~ The Song Of Joy:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੀਉ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar saa(n)t daiaal prabh sarab sukhaa nidh peeu ||
english: God is beautiful, tranquil and merciful; He is the treasure of absolute peace, my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਤ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sukh saagar prabh bhetiai naanak sukhee hot ihu jeeu ||1||
english: Meeting with God, the Ocean of Peace, O Nanak, this soul becomes happy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਬ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar prabh paaeeai jab hovai bhaago raam ||
english: One finds God, the Ocean of Peace, when destiny is activated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਨਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਵਞਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: maanan maan vanjaaeeai har charanee laago raam ||
english: Abandoning the distinctions of honor and dishonor, grasp the Feet of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਚਾਤੁਰੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਿਆਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: chhod siaanap chaaturee duramat budh tiaago raam ||
english: Renounce cleverness and trickery, and forsake your evil-minded intellect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਹਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak pau saranaaee raam raai thir hoi suhaago raam ||1||
english: O Nanak, seek the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord, Your King, and your marriage will be permanent and stable. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਜਿ ਕਤ ਲਾਗੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: so prabh taj kat laageeai jis bin mar jaaeeai raam ||
english: Why forsake God, and attach yourself to another? Without the Lord, you cannot even live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਜ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਬਿਰਮਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: laaj na aavai agiaan matee durajan biramaaeeai raam ||
english: The ignorant fool does not feel any shame; the evil man wanders around deluded.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਤ ਠਹਰਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan prabh tiaag kare kahu kat thaharaaeeai raam ||
english: God is the Purifier of sinners; if he forsakes God, tell me, where he can find a place of rest?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak bhagat bhaau kar daiaal kee jeevan pad paaeeai raam ||2||
english: O Nanak, by loving devotional worship of the Merciful Lord, he attains the state of eternal life. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ਨ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਬਲਿ ਗਈਏ ਦੁਹਚਾਰਣਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sree gopaal na ucharahi bal gaeee duhachaaran rasanaa raam ||
english: May that vicious tongue that does not chant the Name of the Great Lord of the World, be burnt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਨਹ ਸੇਵਹੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਕ ਗ੍ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: prabh bhagat vachhal nah sevahee kaaiaa kaak grasanaa raam ||
english: One who does not serve God, the Lover of His devotees, shall have his body eaten by crows.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਬਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bhram mohee dookh na jaanahee kot jonee basanaa raam ||
english: Enticed by doubt, he does not understand the pain it brings; he wanders through millions of incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਜਿ ਚਾਹਨਾ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਭਸਮਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak bin har avar j chaahanaa bisataa krim bhasamaa raam ||3||
english: O Nanak, if you desire anything other than the Lord, you shall be consumed, like a maggot in manure. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਇ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਸੰਗੇ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: laai birahu bhagava(n)t sa(n)ge hoi mil bairaagan raam ||
english: Embrace love for the Lord God, and in detachment, unite with Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਚੀਰ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਰਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)dan cheer suga(n)dh rasaa haumai bikh tiaagan raam ||
english: Give up your sandalwood oil, expensive clothes, perfumes, tasty flavors and the poison of egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਨਹ ਡੋਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਾਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: eet oot nah doleeai har sevaa jaagan raam ||
english: Do not waver this way or that, but remain wakeful in the service of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾ ਅਟਲ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak jin prabh paaiaa aapanaa saa atal suhaagan raam ||4||1||4||
english: O Nanak, she who has obtained her God, is a happy soul-bride forever. ||4||1||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: har khojahu vadabhaageeho mil saadhoo sa(n)ge raam ||
english: Seek the Lord, O fortunate ones, and join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਸਦ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gun govid sad gaaeeahi paarabraham kai ra(n)ge raam ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe forever, imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਫਲ ਮੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: so prabh sad hee seveeai paaeeahi phal ma(n)ge raam ||
english: Serving God forever, you shall obtain the fruitful rewards you desire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee jap anat tara(n)ge raam ||1||
english: O Nanak, seek the Sanctuary of God; meditate on the Lord, and ride the many waves of the mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ik til prabhoo na veesarai jin sabh kichh deenaa raam ||
english: I shall not forget God, even for an instant; He has blessed me with everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮੇਲਾਵੜਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਚੀਨੑਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee melaavaRaa guramukh pir cheenhaa raam ||
english: By great good fortune, I have met Him; as Gurmukh, I contemplate my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਤਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਲੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: baah pakaR tam te kaadhiaa kar apunaa leenaa raam ||
english: Holding me by the arm, He has lifted me up and pulled me out of the darkness, and made me His own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam japat naanak jeevai seetal man seenaa raam ||2||
english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Nanak lives; his mind and heart are cooled and soothed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਹਿ ਸਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kiaa gun tere kahi sakau prabh a(n)tarajaamee raam ||
english: What virtues of Yours can I speak, O God, O Searcher of hearts?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਭਏ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: simar simar naaraainai bhae paaragaraamee raam ||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I have crossed over to the other shore.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavat govi(n)d ke sabh ichh pujaamee raam ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, all my desires are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੇ ਸਭਹੂ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak udhare jap hare sabhahoo kaa suaamee raam ||3||
english: Nanak is saved, meditating on the Lord, the Lord and Master of all. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਭਿੰਨਿਅੜੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਸੰਗੇ ਸੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਨੀਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ras bhi(n)niaRe apune raam sa(n)ge se loin neeke raam ||
english: Sublime are those eyes, which are drenched with the Love of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਤ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: prabh pekhat ichhaa pu(n)neeaa mil saajan jee ke raam ||
english: Gazing upon God, my desires are fulfilled; I have met the Lord, the Friend of my soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਫੀਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit ras har paaiaa bikhiaa ras pheeke raam ||
english: I have obtained the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Love, and now the taste of corruption is insipid and tasteless to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੀਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak jal jalahi samaaiaa jotee jot meeke raam ||4||2||5||9||
english: O Nanak, as water mingles with water, my light has merged into the Light. ||4||2||5||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval kee vaar mahalaa 4 ||
english: Vaar Of Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
english: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਵਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਦੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਰਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: har utam har prabh gaaviaa kar naad bilaaval raag ||
english: I sing of the sublime Lord, the Lord God, in the melody of Raag Bilaaval.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: upades guroo sun ma(n)niaa dhur masatak pooraa bhaag ||
english: Hearing the Guru's Teachings, I obey them; this is the pre-ordained destiny written upon my forehead.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh dinas rain gun ucharai har har har ur liv laag ||
english: All day and night, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; within my heart, I am lovingly attuned to Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਖਿੜਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਬਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh tan man hariaa hoiaa man khiRiaa hariaa baag ||
english: My body and mind are totally rejuvenated, and the garden of my mind has blossomed forth in lush abundance.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਚਰਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: agiaan a(n)dheraa mit gaiaa gur chaanan giaan charaag ||
english: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled, with the light of the lamp of the Guru's wisdom. Servant Nanak lives by beholding the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak jeevai dekh har ik nimakh ghaRee mukh laag ||1||
english: Let me behold Your face, for a moment, even an instant! ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਜਬ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval tab hee keejeeai jab mukh hovai naam ||
english: Be happy and sing in Bilaaval, when the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is in your mouth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: raag naad sabad sohane jaa laagai sahaj dhiaan ||
english: The melody and music, and the Word of the Shabad are beautiful, when one focuses his meditation on the celestial Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਛੋਡਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: raag naad chhod har seveeai taa daragah paaeeai maan ||
english: So leave behind the melody and music, and serve the Lord; then, you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh braham beechaareeai chookai man abhimaan ||2||
english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, contemplate God, and rid your mind of egotistical pride. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: too har prabh aap aga(n)m hai sabh tudh upaaiaa ||
english: O Lord God, You Yourself are inaccessible; You formed everything.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: too aape aap varatadaa sabh jagat sabaaiaa ||
english: You Yourself are totally permeating and pervading the entire universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape taaRee laaeeai aape gun gaaiaa ||
english: You Yourself are absorbed in the state of deep meditation; You Yourself sing Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har dhiaavahu bhagatahu dinas raat a(n)t lae chhadaaiaa ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, O devotees, day and night; He shall deliver you in the end.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin seviaa tin sukh paaiaa har naam samaaiaa ||1||
english: Those who serve the Lord, find peace; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai bilaaval na hovaee manamukh thaai na paai ||
english: In the love of duality, the happiness of Bilaaval does not come; the self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d bhagat na hovaee paarabraham na paaiaa jaai ||
english: Through hypocrisy, devotional worship does not come, and the Supreme Lord God is not found.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manahath karam kamaavane thaai na koee paai ||
english: By stubborn-mindedly performing religious rituals, no one obtains the approval of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh aap beechaareeai vichahu aap gavaai ||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands himself, and eradicates self-conceit from within.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: aape aap paarabraham hai paarabraham vasiaa man aai ||
english: He Himself is the Supreme Lord God; the Supreme Lord God comes to dwell in his mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa katiaa jotee jot milaai ||1||
english: Birth and death are erased, and his light blends with the Light. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਕਰਿਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval karihu tumh piaariho ekas siu liv laai ||
english: Be happy in Bilaaval, O my beloveds, and embrace love for the One Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh kateeai sache rahai samaai ||
english: The pains of birth and death shall be eradicated, and you shall remain absorbed in the True Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa bilaaval ana(n)d hai je chalahi satigur bhaai ||
english: You shall be blissful forever in Bilaaval, if you walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਬਹਿ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gatee bahi bhaau kar sadaa har ke gun gaai ||
english: Sitting in the Saints' Congregation, sing with love the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak se jan sohane j guramukh mel milaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, beautiful are those humble beings, who, as Gurmukh, are united in the Lord's Union. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸੋ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa jeeaa vich har aap so bhagataa kaa mit har ||
english: The Lord Himself is within all beings. The Lord is the friend of His devotees.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਘਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh koee har kai vas bhagataa kai ana(n)d ghar ||
english: Everyone is under the Lord's control; in the home of the devotees there is bliss.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੀ ਸਰਬਤ ਸਉ ਨਿਸੁਲ ਜਨ ਟੰਗ ਧਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har bhagataa kaa melee sarabat sau nisul jan ta(n)g dhar ||
english: The Lord is the friend and companion of His devotees; all His humble servants stretch out and sleep in peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੋ ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har sabhanaa kaa hai khasam so bhagat jan chit kar ||
english: The Lord is the Lord and Master of all; O humble devotee, remember Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸਭ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਪਵੈ ਝੜਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tudh apaR koi na sakai sabh jhakh jhakh pavai jhaR ||2||
english: No one can equal You, Lord. Those who try, struggle and die in frustration. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣਾ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: braham bi(n)dahi te braahamanaa je chalahi satigur bhaai ||
english: He alone knows God, and he alone is a Brahmin, who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jin kai hiradai har vasai haumai rog gavaai ||
english: One whose heart is filled with the Lord, is freed of egotism and disease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਹਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gun ravahi gun sa(n)grahahi jotee jot milaai ||
english: He chants the Lord's Praises, gathers virtue, and his light merges into the Light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: is jug mahi virale braahaman braham bi(n)dahi chit laai ||
english: How rare are those Brahmins who, in this age, come to know God, by lovingly focusing their consciousness on Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jinh kau nadar kare har sachaa se naam rahe liv laai ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who are blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace, remain lovingly attuned to the Name of the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਤੀਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee sev na keeteeaa sabad na lago bhaau ||
english: One who does not serve the True Guru, and who does not love the Word of the Shabad,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਅਤਿ ਦੀਰਘੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: haumai rog kamaavanaa at deeragh bahu suaau ||
english: earns the very painful disease of egotism; he is so very selfish.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manahath karam kamaavane phir phir jonee paai ||
english: Acting stubborn-mindedly, he is reincarnated over and over again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh janam saphal hai jis no aape lae milaai ||
english: The birth of the Gurmukh is fruitful and auspicious. The Lord unites him with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree nadar kare taa naam dhan palai paai ||2||
english: O Nanak, when the Merciful Lord grants His Mercy, one obtains the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sabh vadiaaeeaa har naam vich har guramukh dhiaaeeai ||
english: All glorious greatness is in the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸਾਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: j vasat ma(n)geeai saaee paaeeai je naam chit laaeeai ||
english: One obtains all that he asks for, if he keeps his consciousness focused on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਹਜ ਗਲ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕੀਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਸਿ ਤਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: guhaj gal jee kee keechai satiguroo paas taa sarab sukh paaeeai ||
english: If he tells the secrets of his soul to the True Guru, then he finds absolute peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa har upades dei sabh bhukh lahi jaaeeai ||
english: When the Perfect Guru bestows the Lord's Teachings, then all hunger departs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis poorab hovai likhiaa so har gun gaaeeai ||3||
english: One who is blessed with such pre-ordained destiny, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur te khaalee ko nahee merai prabh mel milaae ||
english: No one goes away empty-handed from the True Guru; He unites me in Union with my God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਇਛੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur kaa darasan saphal hai jehaa ko ichhe tehaa phal paae ||
english: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the True Guru; through it, one obtains whatever fruitful rewards he desires.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad a(n)mrit hai sabh trisanaa bhukh gavaae ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar. It banishes all hunger and thirst.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: har ras pee sa(n)tokh hoaa sach vasiaa man aae ||
english: Drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord brings contentment; the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sach dhiaai amaraa pad paaiaa anahad sabad vajaae ||
english: Meditating on the True Lord, the status of immortality is obtained; the Unstruck Word of the Shabad vibrates and resounds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sacho dah dis pasariaa gur kai sahaj subhaae ||
english: The True Lord is pervading in the ten directions; through the Guru, this is intuitively known.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਛਪਹਿ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ ਛਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jin a(n)dar sach hai se jan chhapahi na kisai de chhapaae ||1||
english: O Nanak, those humble beings who have the Truth deep within, are never hidden, even if others try to hide them. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te har paaeeai jaa kau nadar karei ||
english: Serving the Guru, one finds the Lord, when the Lord blesses him with His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਤੇ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਭਏ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: maanas te devate bhae sachee bhagat jis dei ||
english: Human beings become angels, when the Lord blesses them with true devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਚੇਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar milaaian gur kai sabad suchei ||
english: Conquering egotism, they are blended with the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are purified.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sahaje mil rahe naam vadiaaee dei ||2||
english: O Nanak, they remain merged with the Lord; they are blessed with the glorious greatness of the Naam. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur vich naavai kee vadee vadiaaee har karatai aap vadhaaee ||
english: Within the Guru, the True Guru, is the glorious greatness of the Name. The Creator Lord Himself has magnified it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਨੑਿ ਓਨੑਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sevak sikh sabh vekh vekh jeevanhi onhaa a(n)dar hiradai bhaaee ||
english: All His servants and Sikhs live by gazing, gazing upon it. It is pleasing to their hearts deep within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਨਿ ਓਨੑਾ ਪਰਾਇਆ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak dusat vadiaaee vekh na sakan onhaa paraaiaa bhalaa na sukhaaee ||
english: The slanderers and evil-doers cannot see this glorious greatness; they do not appreciate the goodness of others.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਝਖ ਮਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa hovai kis hee kee jhakh maaree jaa sache siu ban aaee ||
english: What can be achieved by anyone babbling? The Guru is in love with the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਗਲ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ਸਭ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਲੋਕਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: j gal karate bhaavai saa nit nit chaRai savaaee sabh jhakh jhakh marai lokaaee ||4||
english: That which is pleasing to the Creator Lord, increases day by day, while all the people babble uselessly. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਏਹ ਆਸਾ ਦੂਜੇ ਭਾਵ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dhrig eh aasaa dooje bhaav kee jo mohi maaiaa chit laae ||
english: Cursed are the hopes in the love of duality; they tie the consciousness to love and attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਲੑਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har sukh palhr tiaagiaa naam visaar dukh paae ||
english: One who forsakes the peace of the Lord in exchange for straw, and forgets the Naam, suffers in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh agiaanee a(n)dhule janam marahi phir aavai jaae ||
english: The ignorant self-willed manmukhs are blind. They are born, only to die again, and continue coming and going.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਨੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaaraj sidh na hovanee a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaae ||
english: Their affairs are not resolved, and in the end, they depart, regretting and repenting.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: jis karam hovai tis satigur milai so har har naam dhiaae ||
english: One who is blessed with the Lord's Grace, meets the True Guru; he alone meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨੑਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam rate jan sadaa sukh paainhi jan naanak tin bal jaae ||1||
english: Imbued with the Naam, the humble servants of the Lord find a lasting peace; servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਜਗਿ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa jag mohanee jin mohiaa sa(n)saar ||
english: Hope and desire entice the world; they entice the whole universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਚੀਰੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko jam ke cheere vich hai jetaa sabh aakaar ||
english: Everyone, and all that has been created, is under the domination of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਲਗਦਾ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hukamee hee jam lagadaa so ubarai jis bakhasai karataar ||
english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, Death seizes the mortal; he alone is saved, whom the Creator Lord forgives.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਾਂ ਤਰੈ ਜਾ ਛੋਡੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak gur parasaadee ehu man taa(n) tarai jaa chhodai aha(n)kaar ||
english: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, this mortal swims across, if he abandons his ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa maare niraas hoi gurasabadee veechaar ||2||
english: Conquer hope and desire, and remain unattached; contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਈਐ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jithai jaaeeai jagat mahi tithai har saaee ||
english: Wherever I go in this world, I see the Lord there.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: agai sabh aape varatadaa har sachaa niaaee ||
english: In the world hereafter as well, the Lord, the True Judge Himself, is pervading and permeating everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਫਿਟਕੀਅਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kooRiaaraa ke muh phitakeeahi sach bhagat vadiaaee ||
english: The faces of the false are cursed, while the true devotees are blessed with glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਛਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sach saahib sachaa niaau hai sir ni(n)dak chhaaee ||
english: True is the Lord and Master, and true is His justice. The heads of the slanderers are covered with ashes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak sach araadhiaa guramukh sukh paaee ||5||
english: Servant Nanak worships the True Lord in adoration; as Gurmukh, he finds peace. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag satigur paaeeai je har prabh bakhas karei ||
english: By perfect destiny, one finds the True Guru, if the Lord God grants forgiveness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਪਾਵਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਓਪਾਉ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: opaavaa sir opaau hai naau paraapat hoi ||
english: Of all efforts, the best effort is to attain the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar seetal saa(n)t hai hiradai sadaa sukh hoi ||
english: It brings a cooling, soothing tranquility deep within the heart, and eternal peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੈਨੑਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit khaanaa painhnaa naanak naai vadiaaee hoi ||1||
english: Then, one eats and wears the Ambrosial Nectar; O Nanak, through the Name, comes glorious greatness. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: e man gur kee sikh sun paaihi gunee nidhaan ||
english: O mind, listening to the Guru's Teachings, you shall obtain the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sukhadaataa terai man vasai haumai jaai abhimaan ||
english: The Giver of peace shall dwell in your mind; you shall be rid of egotism and pride.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai a(n)mrit gunee nidhaan ||2||
english: O Nanak, by His Grace, one is blessed with the Ambrosial Nectar of the treasure of virtue. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ਰਾਜੇ ਖਾਨ ਉਮਰਾਵ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਹਹਿ ਤਿਤਨੇ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ॥
transliteration: jitane paatisaah saah raaje khaan umaraav sikadaar hahi titane sabh har ke keee ||
english: The kings, emperors, rulers, lords, nobles and chiefs, are all created by the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਓਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਅਰਥੀਏ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh har karaavai s oi karahi sabh har ke aratheee ||
english: Whatever the Lord causes them to do, they do; they are all beggars, dependent on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਵਲਿ ਹੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਵਰਨ ਚਾਰੇ ਖਾਣੀ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਗੋਲੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ॥
transliteration: so aisaa har sabhanaa kaa prabh satigur kai val hai tin sabh varan chaare khaanee sabh srisat gole kar satigur agai kaar kamaavan kau deee ||
english: Such is God, the Lord of all; He is on the True Guru's side. All castes and social classes, the four sources of creation, and the whole universe are slaves of the True Guru; God makes them work for Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਕੀ ਐਸੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਤ ਸਭਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੀਏ ॥
transliteration: har seve kee aisee vadiaaee dekhahu har sa(n)tahu jin vichahu kaaiaa nagaree dusaman doot sabh maar kadheee ||
english: See the glorious greatness of serving the Lord, O Saints of the Lord; He has conquered and driven all the enemies and evil-doers out of the body-village.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਏ ॥੬॥
transliteration: har har kirapaal hoaa bhagat janaa upar har aapanee kirapaa kar har aap rakh leee ||6||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is Merciful to His humble devotees; granting His Grace, the Lord Himself protects and preserves them. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar kapat sadaa dukh hai manamukh dhiaan na laagai ||
english: Fraud and hypocrisy within bring constant pain; the self-willed manmukh does not practice meditation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ॥
transliteration: dukh vich kaar kamaavanee dukh varatai dukh aagai ||
english: Suffering in pain, he does his deeds; he is immersed in pain, and he shall suffer in pain hereafter.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: karamee satigur bheteeai taa sach naam liv laagai ||
english: By his karma, he meets the True Guru, and then, he is lovingly attuned to the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sahaje sukh hoi a(n)darahu bhram bhau bhaagai ||1||
english: O Nanak, he is naturally at peace; doubt and fear run away and leave him. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sadaa har ra(n)g hai har kaa naau man bhaaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukh is in love with the Lord forever. The Name of the Lord is pleasing to his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh vekhan bolanaa naam japat sukh paaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukh beholds and speaks the Naam, the Name of the Lord; chanting the Naam, he finds peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਤਿਮਰ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh giaan pragaasiaa timar agiaan a(n)dher chukaaiaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, the spiritual wisdom of the Gurmukh shines forth; the black darkness of ignorance is dispelled. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: manamukh maile marahi gavaar ||
english: The filthy, foolish, self-willed manmukhs die.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh niramal har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
english: The Gurmukhs are immaculate and pure; they keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak sunahu jan bhaaee ||
english: Prays Nanak, listen, O Siblings of Destiny!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevihu haumai mal jaaee ||
english: Serve the True Guru, and the filth of your ego shall be gone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧਾ ਨਿਤ ਮਾਰ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar sa(n)saa dookh viaape sir dha(n)dhaa nit maar ||
english: Deep within, the pain of skepticism afflicts them; their heads are constantly assaulted by worldly entanglements.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੂਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai soote kabahu na jaagahi maaiaa moh piaar ||
english: Asleep in the love of duality, they never wake up; they are attached to the love of Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naam na chetahi sabad na veechaarahi ihu manamukh kaa beechaar ||
english: They do not remember the Name, and they do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad; this is the view of the self-willed manmukhs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har naam na bhaaiaa birathaa janam gavaaiaa naanak jam maar kare khuaar ||3||
english: They do not love the Lord's Name, and they lose their life uselessly. O Nanak, the Messenger of Death attacks them, and humiliates them. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jis no har bhagat sach bakhaseean so sachaa saahu ||
english: He alone is a true king, whom the Lord blesses with true devotion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਲੋਕੁ ਕਢਦਾ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਹਟਿ ਨ ਵਥੁ ਨ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: tis kee muhataajee lok kadhadaa horat hat na vath na vesaahu ||
english: People pledge their allegiance to him; no other store stocks this merchandise, nor deals in this trade.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਲਏ ਵੇਮੁਖ ਭਸੁ ਪਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kau sanamukh hovai s har raas lae vemukh bhas paahu ||
english: That humble devotee who turns his face towards the Guru and becomes sunmukh, receives the Lord's wealth; the faithless baymukh, who turns his face away from the Guru, gathers only ashes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਹਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam ke vaapaaree har bhagat hahi jam jaagaatee tinaa neR na jaahu ||
english: The Lord's devotees are dealers in the Name of the Lord. The Messenger of Death, the tax-collector, does not even approach them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jan naanak har naam dhan ladiaa sadaa veparavaahu ||7||
english: Servant Nanak has loaded the wealth of the Name of the Lord, who is forever independent and care-free. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: is jug mahi bhagatee har dhan khatiaa hor sabh jagat bharam bhulaaiaa ||
english: In this age, the devotee earns the wealth of the Lord; all the rest of the world wanders deluded in doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee naam man vasiaa anadin naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell in his mind; night and day, he meditates on the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa maahi udaas hai haumai sabad jalaaiaa ||
english: In the midst of corruption, he remains detached; through the Word of the Shabad, he burns away his ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aap tariaa kul udhare dha(n)n janedee maaiaa ||
english: He crosses over, and saves his relatives as well; blessed is the mother who gave birth to him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sahaj sukh man vasiaa sache siu liv laaiaa ||
english: Peace and poise fill his mind forever, and he embraces love for the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭੁਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahaadeu trai gun bhule haumai mohu vadhaaiaa ||
english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva wander in the three qualities, while their egotism and desire increase.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਮੋਨੀ ਭੁਲੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit paR paR monee bhule doojai bhaai chit laaiaa ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars and the silent sages read and debate in confusion; their consciousness is centered on the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਭੁਲੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jogee ja(n)gam sa(n)niaasee bhule vin gur tat na paaiaa ||
english: The Yogis, wandering pilgrims and Sanyaasees are deluded; without the Guru, they do not find the essence of reality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh dukheee sadaa bhram bhule tinhee birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||
english: The miserable self-willed manmukhs are forever deluded by doubt; they waste away their lives uselessly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਸਮਧੇ ਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate seee jan samadhe j aape bakhas milaaiaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam are balanced and poised; forgiving them, the Lord blends them with Himself. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਸਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak so saalaaheeai jis vas sabh kichh hoi ||
english: O Nanak, praise Him, who has control over everything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਹੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tisahi sarevahu praaneeho tis bin avar na koi ||
english: Remember Him, O mortals - without Him, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh a(n)tar man vasai sadaa sadaa sukh hoi ||2||
english: He dwells deep within those who are Gurmukh; forever and ever, they are at peace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਨ ਖਟਿਓ ਸੇ ਦੇਵਾਲੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee guramukh har naam dhan na khatio se devaaleee jug maahi ||
english: Those who do not become Gurmukh and earn the wealth of the Lord's Name, are bankrupt in this age.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਭ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਮੁਹਿ ਥੁਕ ਨ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: oi ma(n)gade phirahi sabh jagat mahi koee muhi thuk na tin kau paahi ||
english: They wander around begging all over the world, but no one even spits in their faces.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਾਈ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਖੋਵਨਿ ਸਗਵਾ ਭੀ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: paraaee bakheelee karahi aapanee parateet khovan sagavaa bhee aap lakhaahi ||
english: They gossip about others, and lose their credit, and expose themselves as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਓਇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jis dhan kaaran chugalee karahi so dhan chugalee hath na aavai oi bhaavai tithai jaahi ||
english: That wealth, for which they slander others, does not come into their hands, no matter where they go.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਥਹੁ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਲੈ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੮॥
transliteration: guramukh sevak bhaai har dhan milai tithahu karamaheen lai na sakahi hor thai des disa(n)tar har dhan naahi ||8||
english: Through loving service, the Gurmukhs receive the wealth of the Naam, but the unfortunate ones cannot receive it. This wealth is not found anywhere else, in this country or in any other. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sa(n)saa mool na hovaee chi(n)taa vichahu jaai ||
english: The Gurmukh does not have an iota of skepticism or doubt; worries depart from within him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh hoi s sahaje hoi kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||
english: Whatever he does, he does with grace and poise. Nothing else can be said about him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣੇ ਜਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tin kaa aakhiaa aap sune j laian pa(n)nai paai ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself hears the speech of those whom He makes His own. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaal maar manasaa manahi samaanee a(n)tar niramal naau ||
english: He conquers death, and subdues the desires of his mind; the Immaculate Name abides deep within him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਿਆਉ ॥
transliteration: anadin jaagai kade na sovai sahaje a(n)mrit piaau ||
english: Night and day, he remains awake and aware; he never sleeps, and he intuitively drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੀਠਾ ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: meethaa bole a(n)mrit baanee anadin har gun gaau ||
english: His speech is sweet, and his words are nectar; night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa sadaa sohade naanak tin miliaa sukh paau ||2||
english: He dwells in the home of his own self, and appears beautiful forever; meeting him, Nanak finds peace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰੀ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਦੇਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har dhan ratan javeharee so gur har dhan har paasahu devaaiaa ||
english: The wealth of the Lord is a jewel, a gem; the Guru has caused the Lord to grant that wealth of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਿਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਹੁ ਮੰਗਿ ਲਏ ਅਕੈ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਹੁ ਦੇਵਾਏ ਏਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਰਿ ਕੀਤੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਵੰਡਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: je kisai kihu dis aavai taa koee kihu ma(n)g lae akai koee kihu devaae ehu har dhan jor keetai kisai naal na jaai va(n)daaiaa ||
english: If someone sees something, he may ask for it; or, someone may cause it to be given to him. But no one can take a share of this wealth of the Lord by force.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਵੰਡ ਹਥਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਤੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jis no satigur naal har saradhaa laae tis har dhan kee va(n)d hath aavai jis no karatai dhur likh paaiaa ||
english: He alone obtains a share of the wealth of the Lord, who is blessed by the Creator with faith and devotion to the True Guru, according to his pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਖਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਸੀਵ ਬੰਨੈ ਰੋਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮੁਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਲਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: is har dhan kaa koee sareek naahee kisai kaa khat naahee kisai kai seev ba(n)nai rol naahee je ko har dhan kee bakheelee kare tis kaa muhu har chahu ku(n)daa vich kaalaa karaaiaa ||
english: No one is a share-holder in this wealth of the Lord, and no one owns any of it. It has no boundaries or borders to be disputed. If anyone speaks ill of the wealth of the Lord, his face will be blackened in the four directions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਿਤੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਜੋਰੁ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਦਿਹੁ ਦਿਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: har ke dite naal kisai jor bakheelee na chalaee dihu dihu nit nit chaRai savaaiaa ||9||
english: No one's power or slander can prevail against the gifts of the Lord; day by day they continually, continuously increase. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲੰਦਾ ਰਖਿ ਲੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jagat jala(n)daa rakh lai aapanee kirapaa dhaar ||
english: The world is going up in flames - shower it with Your Mercy, and save it!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਉਬਰੈ ਤਿਤੈ ਲੈਹੁ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jit duaarai ubarai titai laihu ubaar ||
english: Save it, and deliver it, by whatever method it takes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur sukh vekhaaliaa sachaa sabad beechaar ||
english: The True Guru has shown the way to peace, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak avar na sujhaee har bin bakhasanahaar ||1||
english: Nanak knows no other than the Lord, the Forgiving Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai maaiaa mohanee doojai lagai jaai ||
english: Through egotism, fascination with Maya has trapped them in duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਹ ਮਾਰੀ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਇਹ ਹਟਿ ਵਿਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naa ih maaree na marai naa ih hat vikaai ||
english: It cannot be killed, it does not die, and it cannot be sold in a store.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰਜਾਲੀਐ ਤਾ ਇਹ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad parajaaleeai taa ih vichahu jaai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is burnt away, and then it departs from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਜਲਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: tan man hovai ujalaa naam vasai man aai ||
english: The body and mind become pure, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਣੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak maaiaa kaa maaran sabad hai guramukh paaiaa jaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Shabad is the killer of Maya; the Gurmukh obtains it. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee vadiaaee satigur ditee dhurahu hukam bujh neesaan ||
english: The glorious greatness of the True Guru was bestowed by the True Guru; He understood this as the Insignia, the Mark of the Primal Lord's Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤੀ ਭਾਤੀਈ ਜਾਵਾਈ ਸਕੀ ਅਗਹੁ ਪਿਛਹੁ ਟੋਲਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਲਾਹਿਓਨੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: putee bhaateeee jaavaaee sakee agahu pichhahu tol dithaa laahion sabhanaa kaa abhimaan ||
english: He tested His sons, nephews, sons-in-law and relatives, and subdued the egotistical pride of them all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਓਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jithai ko vekhai tithai meraa satiguroo har bakhasios sabh jahaan ||
english: Wherever anyone looks, my True Guru is there; the Lord blessed Him with the whole world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੁ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸਿਝੈ ਜਿ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਭਰਿਸਟ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: j satigur no mil ma(n)ne s halat palat sijhai j vemukh hovai s phirai bharisat thaan ||
english: One who meets with, and believes in the True Guru, is embellished here and hereafter. Whoever turns his back on the Guru and becomes baymukh, shall wander in cursed and evil places.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਵਲਿ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak kai val hoaa meraa suaamee har sajan purakh sujaan ||
english: My Lord and Master is on the side of servant Nanak. The All-powerful and All-knowing Lord God is my Best Friend.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉਦੀ ਭਿਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਸਭਿ ਆਇ ਪਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਲਾਹਿਓਨੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਿਅਹੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: paudee bhit dekh kai sabh aai pae satigur kee pairee laahion sabhanaa kiahu manahu gumaan ||10||
english: Seeing the food being distributed, everyone came and fell at the feet of the True Guru, who cleansed the minds of all of their egotistical pride. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਵਾਹੇ ਕੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ਖਲਿਹਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: koee vaahe ko lunai ko paae khalihaan ||
english: One plants the seed, another harvests the crop, and still another beats the grain from the chaff.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਕੋਈ ਖਾਇ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ev na jaapaee koee khaai nidaan ||1||
english: O Nanak, it is not known, who will ultimately eat the grain. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis man vasiaa tariaa soi ||
english: He alone is carried across, within whose mind the Lord abides.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jo bhaavai so hoi ||2||
english: O Nanak, that alone happens, which is pleasing to His Will. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham daiaal saagar taariaa ||
english: The Merciful Supreme Lord God has carried me across the world-ocean.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai miharavaan bharam bhau maariaa ||
english: The compassionate perfect Guru has eradicated my doubts and fears.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਕਰਾਲੁ ਦੂਤ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh bikaraal doot sabh haariaa ||
english: Unsatisfied sexual desire and unresolved anger, the horrible demons, have been totally destroyed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan ka(n)th ur dhaariaa ||
english: I have enshrined the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam within my throat and heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak saadhoo sa(n)g janam maran savaariaa ||11||
english: O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my birth and death have been adorned and redeemed. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਕੂੜੇ ਕਹਣ ਕਹੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: jinhee naam visaariaa kooRe kahan kaha(n)nhi ||
english: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are said to be false.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਤਿਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਹਨੑਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch chor tinaa ghar muhanhi haumai a(n)dar sa(n)nhi ||
english: The five thieves plunder their homes, and egotism breaks in.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਮੁਠੇ ਦੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: saakat muthe duramatee har ras na jaana(n)nhi ||
english: The faithless cynics are defrauded by their own evil-mindedness; they do not know the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਲੁਟਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਹਿ ਰਚੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: jinhee a(n)mrit bharam lutaaiaa bikh siu rachahi racha(n)nhi ||
english: Those who lose the Ambrosial Nectar through doubt, remain engrossed and entangled in corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਵਾਦੁ ਕਰੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: dusataa setee pirahaRee jan siu vaad kara(n)nhi ||
english: They make friends with the wicked, and argue with the humble servants of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਜਮਿ ਬਧੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੰਨੑਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak saakat narak mahi jam badhe dukh saha(n)nhi ||
english: O Nanak, the faithless cynics are bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death, and suffer agony in hell.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਜਿਵ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਹੰਨੑਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paiai kirat kamaavade jiv raakhahi tivai raha(n)nhi ||1||
english: They act according to the karma of the actions they committed before; as the Lord keeps them, so do they live. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਾਣੁ ਨਿਤਾਣੇ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jinhee satigur seviaa taan nitaane tis ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru, are transformed from powerless into powerful.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
transliteration: saas giraas sadaa man vasai jam johi na sakai tis ||
english: With every breath and morsel of food, the Lord abides in their minds forever, and the Messenger of Death cannot even see them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਕਵਲਾ ਸੇਵਕਿ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
transliteration: hiradai har har naam ras kavalaa sevak tis ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, fills their hearts, and Maya is their servant.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
transliteration: har daasaa kaa daas hoi param padaarath tis ||
english: One who becomes the slave of the Lord's slaves, obtains the greatest treasure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak man tan jis prabh vasai hau sad kurabaanai tis ||
english: O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to that one, within whose mind and body God dwells.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਰਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jinh kau poorab likhiaa ras sa(n)t janaa siu tis ||2||
english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny, he alone is in love with the humble Saints. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬੋਲੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jo bole pooraa satiguroo so paramesar suniaa ||
english: Whatever the Perfect True Guru says, the Transcendent Lord hears.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: soee varatiaa jagat mahi ghat ghat mukh bhaniaa ||
english: It pervades and permeates the whole world, and it is on the mouth of each and every being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਸਾਹਿਬੈ ਨਹ ਜਾਹੀ ਗਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: bahut vadiaaeeaa saahibai nah jaahee ganeeaa ||
english: So numerous are the great glories of the Lord, they cannot even be counted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਸਿ ਸਚੀ ਗੁਰ ਮਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sach sahaj anad satiguroo paas sachee gur maneeaa ||
english: Truth, poise and bliss rest in the True Guru; the Guru bestows the jewel of Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਚੇ ਜਿਉ ਬਣਿਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)t savaare paarabraham sache jiu baniaa ||12||
english: O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God embellishes the Saints, who become like the True Lord. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: apanaa aap na pachhaanaee har prabh jaataa door ||
english: He does not understand himself; he believes the Lord God to be far away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਵਿਸਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa visaree kiu man rahai hajoor ||
english: He forgets to serve the Guru; how can his mind remain in the Lord's Presence?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਝੂਠੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਕੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh janam gavaaiaa jhoothai laalach koor ||
english: The self-willed manmukh wastes away his life in worthless greed and falsehood.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak bakhas milaaian sachai sabad hadoor ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Lord forgives, and blends them with Himself; through the True Word of the Shabad, He is ever-present. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: har prabh sachaa sohilaa guramukh naam govi(n)d ||
english: True is the Praise of the Lord God; the Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: anadin naam salaahanaa har japiaa man aana(n)d ||
english: Praising the Naam night and day, and meditating on the Lord, the mind becomes blissful.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee har paaiaa pooran paramaana(n)d ||
english: By great good fortune, I have found the Lord, the perfect embodiment of supreme bliss.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam salaahiaa bahuR na man tan bha(n)g ||2||
english: Servant Nanak praises the Naam; his mind and body shall never again be shattered. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: koee ni(n)dak hovai satiguroo kaa phir saran gur aavai ||
english: If someone slanders the True Guru, and then comes seeking the Guru's Protection,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: pichhale gunah satigur bakhas lae satasa(n)gat naal ralaavai ||
english: the True Guru forgives him for his past sins, and unites him with the Saints' Congregation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਹਿ ਵੁਠੈ ਗਲੀਆ ਨਾਲਿਆ ਟੋਭਿਆ ਕਾ ਜਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਮਿਲਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu meehi vuthai galeeaa naaliaa tobhiaa kaa jal jaai pavai vich surasaree surasaree milat pavitr paavan hoi jaavai ||
english: When the rain falls, the water in the streams, rivers and ponds flows into the Ganges; flowing into the Ganges, it is made sacred and pure.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਤੜ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: eh vadiaaee satigur niravair vich jit miliai tisanaa bhukh utarai har saa(n)t taR aavai ||
english: Such is the glorious greatness of the True Guru, who has no vengeance; meeting with Him, thirst and hunger are quenched, and instantly, one attains celestial peace.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਮੰਨੈ ਸੁ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧੩॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak ihu acharaj dekhahu mere har sache saah kaa j satiguroo no ma(n)nai s sabhanaa(n) bhaavai ||13||1|| sudh ||
english: O Nanak, behold this wonder of the Lord, my True King! Everyone is pleased with one who obeys and believes in the True Guru. ||13||1|| Sudh||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval baanee bhagataa kee || kabeer jeeu kee ||
english: Bilaaval, The Word Of The Devotees. Of Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified By Guru's Grace:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਪੇਖਨਾ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਈਹੈ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aiso ihu sa(n)saar pekhanaa rahan na kooo paeehai re ||
english: This world is a drama; no one can remain here.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੂਧੇ ਸੂਧੇ ਰੇਗਿ ਚਲਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਨਤਰ ਕੁਧਕਾ ਦਿਵਈਹੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: soodhe soodhe reg chalahu tum natar kudhakaa divaeehai re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Walk the straight path; otherwise, you will be pushed around. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰੇ ਬੂਢੇ ਤਰੁਨੇ ਭਈਆ ਸਭਹੂ ਜਮੁ ਲੈ ਜਈਹੈ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: baare boodhe tarune bhaeeaa sabhahoo jam lai jaeehai re ||
english: The children, the young and the old, O Siblings of Destiny, will be taken away by the Messenger of Death.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਮੂਸਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਮੀਚੁ ਬਿਲਈਆ ਖਈਹੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maanas bapuraa moosaa keeno meech bilaeeaa khaeehai re ||1||
english: The Lord has made the poor man a mouse, and the cat of Death is eating him up. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਅਰੁ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਮਨਈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਕਾਨੀ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dhanava(n)taa ar niradhan manaee taa kee kachhoo na kaanee re ||
english: It gives no special consideration to either the rich or the poor.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਪਰਜਾ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਰੈ ਐਸੋ ਕਾਲੁ ਬਡਾਨੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raajaa parajaa sam kar maarai aiso kaal badaanee re ||2||
english: The king and his subjects are equally killed; such is the power of Death. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਏ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har ke sevak jo har bhaae tinh kee kathaa niraaree re ||
english: Those who are pleasing to the Lord are the servants of the Lord; their story is unique and singular.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਮਰਤੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੰਗਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aavahi na jaahi na kabahoo marate paarabraham sa(n)gaaree re ||3||
english: They do not come and go, and they never die; they remain with the Supreme Lord God. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਲਛਿਮੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਇਹੈ ਤਜਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨੀ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr lachhimee maaiaa ihai tajahu jee jaanee re ||
english: Know this in your soul, that by renouncing your children, spouse, wealth and property

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਿਲਿਹੈ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨੀ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu milihai saarigapaanee re ||4||1||
english: - says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - you shall be united with the Lord of the Universe. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval ||
english: Bilaaval:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਨ ਪਰਉ ਬਾਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
transliteration: bidiaa na parau baad nahee jaanau ||
english: I do not read books of knowledge, and I do not understand the debates.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਕਥਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਬਉਰਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har gun kathat sunat bauraano ||1||
english: I have gone insane, chanting and hearing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬਾ ਮੈ ਬਉਰਾ ਸਭ ਖਲਕ ਸੈਆਨੀ ਮੈ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mere baabaa mai bauraa sabh khalak saiaanee mai bauraa ||
english: O my father, I have gone insane; the whole world is sane, and I am insane.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਬਿਗਰੈ ਮਤਿ ਅਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mai bigario bigarai mat auraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am spoiled; let no one else be spoiled like me. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀਓ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aap na bauraa raam keeo bauraa ||
english: I have not made myself go insane - the Lord made me go insane.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਰਿ ਗਇਓ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur jaar gaio bhram moraa ||2||
english: The True Guru has burnt away my doubt. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਬਿਗਰੇ ਅਪਨੀ ਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: mai bigare apanee mat khoee ||
english: I am spoiled; I have lost my intellect.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਉ ਮਤਿ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mere bharam bhoolau mat koee ||3||
english: Let no one go astray in doubt like me. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬਉਰਾ ਜੋ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: so bauraa jo aap na pachhaanai ||
english: He alone is insane, who does not understand himself.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ਤ ਏਕੈ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aap pachhaanai ta ekai jaanai ||4||
english: When he understands himself, then he knows the One Lord. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬਹਿ ਨ ਮਾਤਾ ਸੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: abahi na maataa s kabahu na maataa ||
english: One who is not intoxicated with the Lord now, shall never be intoxicated.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੫॥੨॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer raamai ra(n)g raataa ||5||2||
english: Says Kabeer, I am imbued with the Lord's Love. ||5||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval ||
english: Bilaaval:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਬਨ ਖੰਡ ਜਾਈਐ ਚੁਨਿ ਖਾਈਐ ਕੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: grihu taj ban kha(n)d jaaeeai chun khaaeeai ka(n)daa ||
english: Abandoning his household, he may go to the forest, and live by eating roots;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਜਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਪਾਪੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ajahu bikaar na chhodaee paapee man ma(n)daa ||1||
english: but even so, his sinful, evil mind does not renounce corruption. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਉ ਕੈਸੇ ਤਰਉ ਭਵਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kiu chhootau kaise tarau bhavajal nidh bhaaree ||
english: How can anyone be saved? How can anyone cross over the terrifying world-ocean?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਜਨੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raakh raakh mere beethulaa jan saran tumhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Save me, save me, O my Lord! Your humble servant seeks Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਤਜੀਅ ਨਹ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bikhai bikhai kee baasanaa tajee nah jaaee ||
english: I cannot escape my desire for sin and corruption.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਪਟਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anik jatan kar raakheeai phir phir lapataaee ||2||
english: I make all sorts of efforts to hold back from this desire, but it clings to me, again and again. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਰਾ ਜੀਵਨ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਨ ਨੀਕਾ ॥
transliteration: jaraa jeevan joban gaiaa kichh keeaa na neekaa ||
english: Youth and old age - my entire life has passed, but I haven't done any good.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੋ ਕਉਡੀ ਲਗਿ ਮੀਕਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ihu jeearaa niramolako kaudee lag meekaa ||3||
english: This priceless soul has been treated as if if were worth no more than a shell. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਵਾ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਆਪੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer mere maadhavaa too sarab biaapee ||
english: Says Kabeer, O my Lord, You are contained in all.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਪਾਪੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: tum samasar naahee daiaal mohi samasar paapee ||4||3||
english: There is none as merciful as You are, and none as sinful as I am. ||4||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval ||
english: Bilaaval:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਕੋਰੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਆਨੈ ਲੀਪਤ ਜੀਉ ਗਇਓ ॥
transliteration: nit uth koree gaagar aanai leepat jeeu gaio ||
english: Every day, he rises early, and brings a fresh clay pot; he passes his life embellishing and glazing it.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾਨਾ ਬਾਨਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taanaa baanaa kachhoo na soojhai har har ras lapatio ||1||
english: He does not think at all of worldly weaving; he is absorbed in the subtle essence of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮਾਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਕਉਨੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿਓ ॥
transliteration: hamaare kul kaune raam kahio ||
english: Who in our family has ever chanted the Name of the Lord?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਲਈ ਨਿਪੂਤੇ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਭਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab kee maalaa laee nipoote tab te sukh na bhaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Ever since this worthless son of mine began chanting with his mala, we have had no peace at all! ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਿਠਾਨੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਦਿਰਾਨੀ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਏਕੁ ਭਇਓ ॥
transliteration: sunahu jithaanee sunahu diraanee acharaj ek bhaio ||
english: Listen, O my sisters-in-law, a wondrous thing has happened!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਤ ਸੂਤ ਇਨਿ ਮੁਡੀਂਏ ਖੋਏ ਇਹੁ ਮੁਡੀਆ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਮੁਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saat soot in mudee(n)e khoe ihu mudeeaa kiu na muio ||2||
english: This boy has ruined our weaving business. Why didn't he simply die? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਏਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
transliteration: sarab sukhaa kaa ek har suaamee so gur naam daio ||
english: O mother, the One Lord, the Lord and Master, is the source of all peace. The Guru has blessed me with His Name.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ ਨਖ ਬਿਦਰਿਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prahalaad kee paij jin raakhee haranaakhas nakh bidario ||3||
english: He preserved the honor of Prahlaad, and destroyed Harnaakhash with his nails. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਕੇ ਦੇਵ ਪਿਤਰ ਕੀ ਛੋਡੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਇਓ ॥
transliteration: ghar ke dev pitar kee chhodee gur ko sabad laio ||
english: I have renounced the gods and ancestors of my house, for the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਸੰਤਹ ਲੈ ਉਧਰਿਓ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sagal paap kha(n)dan sa(n)tah lai udhario ||4||4||
english: Says Kabeer, God is the Destroyer of all sins; He is the Saving Grace of His Saints. ||4||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval ||
english: Bilaaval:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋਊ ਹਰਿ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: kooo har samaan nahee raajaa ||
english: There is no king equal to the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਸਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਰਤ ਦਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: e bhoopat sabh divas chaar ke jhoothe karat divaajaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All these lords of the world last for only a few days, putting on their false displays. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਇ ਕਤ ਡੋਲੈ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਪਰ ਛਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: tero jan hoi soi kat dolai teen bhavan par chhaajaa ||
english: How can Your humble servant waver? You spread Your shadow over the three worlds.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਸਕੈ ਕੋ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਅੰਦਾਜਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: haath pasaar sakai ko jan kau bol sakai na a(n)daajaa ||1||
english: Who can raise his hand against Your humble servant? No one can describe the Lord's expanse. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਮੂੜ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: chet achet mooR man mere baaje anahad baajaa ||
english: Remember Him, O my thoughtless and foolish mind, and the unstruck melody of the sound current will resonate and resound.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਸਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕੋ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer sa(n)saa bhram chooko dhroo prahilaad nivaajaa ||2||5||
english: Says Kabeer, my skepticism and doubt have been dispelled; the Lord has exalted me, as He did Dhroo and Prahlaad. ||2||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval ||
english: Bilaaval:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਮ ਤੇ ਬਿਗਰੀ ॥
transliteration: raakh lehu ham te bigaree ||
english: Save me! I have disobeyed You.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੀਲੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਜਪੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਹਉ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਟੇਢ ਪਗਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: seel dharam jap bhagat na keenee hau abhimaan tedh pagaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have not practiced humility, righteousness or devotional worship; I am proud and egotistical, and I have taken a crooked path. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰ ਜਾਨਿ ਸੰਚੀ ਇਹ ਕਾਇਆ ਇਹ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਾਚੀ ਗਗਰੀ ॥
transliteration: amar jaan sa(n)chee ih kaaiaa ih mithiaa kaachee gagaree ||
english: Believing this body to be immortal, I pampered it, but it is a fragile and perishable vessel.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਲਗਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jinahi nivaaj saaj ham keee tisahi bisaar avar lagaree ||1||
