english: Forgetting the Lord who formed, fashioned and embellished me, I have become attached to another. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਧਿਕ ਤੋਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਨਹੀ ਕਹੀਅਉ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਪਗਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)dhik tohi saadh nahee kaheeau saran pare tumaree pagaree ||
english: I am Your thief; I cannot be called holy. I have fallen at Your feet, seeking Your Sanctuary.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਸੁਨੀਅਹੁ ਮਤ ਘਾਲਹੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਖਬਰੀ ॥੨॥੬॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer ih binatee suneeahu mat ghaalahu jam kee khabaree ||2||6||
english: Says Kabeer, please listen to this prayer of mine, O Lord; please do not send me sommons of the Messenger of Death. ||2||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval ||
english: Bilaaval:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਰਮਾਦੇ ਠਾਢੇ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: daramaade thaadhe darabaar ||
english: I stand humbly at Your Court.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਕੋ ਮੇਰੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਖੋਲੑਿ ਕਿਵਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin surat karai ko meree darasan deejai kholhi kivaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Who else can take care of me, other than You? Please open Your door, and grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਧਨ ਧਨੀ ਉਦਾਰ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨੑ ਸੁਨੀਅਤੁ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tum dhan dhanee udaar tiaagee sravananh suneeat sujas tumhaar ||
english: You are the richest of the rich, generous and unattached. With my ears, I listen to Your Praises.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਗਉ ਕਾਹਿ ਰੰਕ ਸਭ ਦੇਖਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮੇਰੋ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maagau kaahi ra(n)k sabh dekhau tumh hee te mero nisataar ||1||
english: From whom should I beg? I see that all are beggars. My salvation comes only from You. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੈਦੇਉ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਪ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jaideu naamaa bip sudaamaa tin kau kripaa bhaee hai apaar ||
english: You blessed Jai Dayv, Naam Dayv and Sudaamaa the Brahmin with Your infinite mercy.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਦਾਤੇ ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਦੇਤ ਨ ਬਾਰ ॥੨॥੭॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer tum sa(n)mrath daate chaar padaarath det na baar ||2||7||
english: Says Kabeer, You are the All-powerful Lord, the Great Giver; in an instant, You bestow the four great blessings. ||2||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval ||
english: Bilaaval:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਡੰਡਾ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: da(n)daa mu(n)draa khi(n)thaa aadhaaree ||
english: He has a walking stick, ear-rings, a patched coat and a begging bowl.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਵੈ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhram kai bhaai bhavai bhekhadhaaree ||1||
english: Wearing the robes of a beggar, he wanders around, deluded by doubt. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਸਨੁ ਪਵਨ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਵਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aasan pavan door kar bavare ||
english: Abandon your Yogic postures and breath control exercises, O madman.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਬਵਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chhod kapat nit har bhaj bavare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Renounce fraud and deception, and meditate continuously on the Lord, O madman. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਤੂ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: jih too jaachahi so tribhavan bhogee ||
english: That which you beg for, has been enjoyed in the three worlds.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੇਸੌ ਜਗਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥੨॥੮॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer kesau jag jogee ||2||8||
english: Says Kabeer, the Lord is the only Yogi in the world. ||2||8||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval ||
english: Bilaaval:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਨੑਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: inhi maaiaa jagadees gusaaee tumhre charan bisaare ||
english: This Maya has made me forget Your feet, O Lord of the World, Master of the Universe.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿੰਚਤ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਨ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੇਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ki(n)chat preet na upajai jan kau jan kahaa karahi bechaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Not even a bit of love wells up in Your humble servant; what can Your poor servant do? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਫੰਨੀ ॥
transliteration: dhrig tan dhrig dhan dhrig ih maaiaa dhrig dhrig mat budh pha(n)nee ||
english: Cursed is the body, cursed is the wealth, and cursed is this Maya; cursed, cursed is the clever intellect and understanding.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਆਪ ਬਚੰਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: is maaiaa kau driR kar raakhahu baa(n)dhe aap bacha(n)nee ||1||
english: Restrain and hold back this Maya; overcome it, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਖੇਤੀ ਕਿਆ ਲੇਵਾ ਦੇਈ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਝੂਠੁ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kiaa khetee kiaa levaa deee parapa(n)ch jhooth gumaanaa ||
english: What good is farming, and what good is trading? Worldly entanglements and pride are false.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਬਿਗੂਤੇ ਆਇਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਦਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੯॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer te a(n)t bigoote aaiaa kaal nidaanaa ||2||9||
english: Says Kabeer, in the end, they are ruined; ultimately, Death will come for them. ||2||9||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval ||
english: Bilaaval:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਰੀਰ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਭੀਤਰੇ ਆਛੈ ਕਮਲ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
transliteration: sareer sarovar bheetare aachhai kamal anoop ||
english: Within the pool of the body, there is an incomparably beautiful lotus flower.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੋ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪ ॥੧॥
transliteration: param jot purakhotamo jaa kai rekh na roop ||1||
english: Within it, is the Supreme Light, the Supreme Soul, who has no feature or form. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: re man har bhaj bhram tajahu jagajeevan raam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O my mind, vibrate, meditate on the Lord, and forsake your doubt. The Lord is the Life of the World. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਦੀਸਈ ਨਹ ਦੀਸੈ ਜਾਤ ॥
transliteration: aavat kachhoo na deesaee nah deesai jaat ||
english: Nothing is seen coming into the world, and nothing is seen leaving it.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਤਹੀ ਜੈਸੇ ਪੁਰਿਵਨ ਪਾਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jah upajai binasai tahee jaise purivan paat ||2||
english: Where the body is born, there it dies, like the leaves of the water-lily. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਜੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa kar maaiaa tajee sukh sahaj beechaar ||
english: Maya is false and transitory; forsaking it, one obtains peaceful, celestial contemplation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੰਝਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੩॥੧੦॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer sevaa karahu man ma(n)jh muraar ||3||10||
english: Says Kabeer, serve Him within your mind; He is the Enemy of ego, the Destroyer of demons. ||3||10||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval ||
english: Bilaaval:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: janam maran kaa bhram gaiaa gobid liv laagee ||
english: The illusion of birth and death is gone; I lovingly focus on the Lord of the Universe.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jeevat su(n)n samaaniaa gur saakhee jaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In my life, I am absorbed in deep silent meditation; the Guru's Teachings have awakened me. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਸੀ ਤੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਾਸੀ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaasee te dhun oopajai dhun kaasee jaaee ||
english: The sound made from bronze, that sound goes into the bronze again.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਸੀ ਫੂਟੀ ਪੰਡਿਤਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaasee phootee pa(n)ditaa dhun kahaa(n) samaaee ||1||
english: But when the bronze is broken, O Pandit, O religious scholar, where does the sound go then? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਸੰਧਿ ਮੈ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਘਟ ਹੂ ਘਟ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: trikutee sa(n)dh mai pekhiaa ghat hoo ghat jaagee ||
english: I gaze upon the world, the confluence of the three qualities; God is awake and aware in each and every heart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਮਾਚਰੀ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aisee budh samaacharee ghat maahi tiaagee ||2||
english: Such is the understanding revealed to me; within my heart, I have become a detached renunciate. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਆਪ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤੇਜ ਤੇਜੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aap aap te jaaniaa tej tej samaanaa ||
english: I have come to know my own self, and my light has merged in the Light.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੩॥੧੧॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer ab jaaniaa gobid man maanaa ||3||11||
english: Says Kabeer, now I know the Lord of the Universe, and my mind is satisfied. ||3||11||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval ||
english: Bilaaval:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਹਿ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਡੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal jaa kai ridai basahi so jan kiu dolai dev ||
english: When Your Lotus Feet dwell within one's heart, why should that person waver, O Divine Lord?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੌ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਜਸੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maanau sabh sukh nau nidh taa kai sahaj sahaj jas bolai dev || rahaau ||
english: I know that all comforts, and the nine treasures, come to one who intuitively, naturally, chants the Praise of the Divine Lord. ||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਜਉ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖੈ ਕੁਟਿਲ ਗਾਂਠਿ ਜਬ ਖੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: tab ih mat jau sabh mahi pekhai kutil gaa(n)th jab kholai dev ||
english: Such wisdom comes, only when one sees the Lord in all, and unties the knot of hypocrisy.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਅਟਕੈ ਲੈ ਨਰਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
transliteration: baara(n) baar maaiaa te atakai lai narajaa man tolai dev ||1||
english: Time and time again, he must hold himself back from Maya; let him take the scale of the Lord, and weigh his mind. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਉਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਾਸੁ ਨ ਝੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: jah uhu jaai tahee sukh paavai maaiaa taas na jholai dev ||
english: Then wherever he goes, he will find peace, and Maya will not shake him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀਓ ਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥੨॥੧੨॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer meraa man maaniaa raam preet keeo lai dev ||2||12||
english: Says Kabeer, my mind believes in the Lord; I am absorbed in the Love of the Divine Lord. ||2||12||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval baanee bhagat naamadev jee kee ||
english: Bilaaval, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam mo kau gur keenaa ||
english: The Guru has made my life fruitful.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dukh bisaar sukh a(n)tar leenaa ||1||
english: My pain is forgotten, and I have found peace deep within myself. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: giaan a(n)jan mo kau gur deenaa ||
english: The Guru has blessed me with the ointment of spiritual wisdom.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮਨ ਹੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam bin jeevan man heenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, life is mindless. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਦੇਇ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: naamadei simaran kar jaanaa(n) ||
english: Meditating in remembrance, Naam Dayv has come to know the Lord.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੀਉ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: jagajeevan siu jeeu samaanaa(n) ||2||1||
english: His soul is blended with the Lord, the Life of the World. ||2||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval baanee ravidaas bhagat kee ||
english: Bilaaval, The Word Of Devotee Ravi Daas:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਦਾਰਿਦੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਹਸੈ ਐਸੀ ਦਸਾ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: daarid dekh sabh ko hasai aisee dasaa hamaaree ||
english: Seeing my poverty, everyone laughed. Such was my condition.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਦਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਰ ਤਲੈ ਸਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: asat dasaa sidh kar talai sabh kripaa tumaaree ||1||
english: Now, I hold the eighteen miraculous spiritual powers in the palm of my hand; everything is by Your Grace. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਾਨਤ ਮੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: too jaanat mai kichh nahee bhav kha(n)dan raam ||
english: You know, and I am nothing, O Lord, Destroyer of fear.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜੀਅ ਸਰਨਾਗਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal jee saranaagatee prabh pooran kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All beings seek Your Sanctuary, O God, Fulfiller, Resolver of our affairs. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jo teree saranaagataa tin naahee bhaar ||
english: Whoever enters Your Sanctuary, is relieved of his burden of sin.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਤਰੇ ਆਲਜੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ooch neech tum te tare aalaj sa(n)saar ||2||
english: You have saved the high and the low from the shameless world. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਹੁ ਕਾਇ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas akath kathaa bahu kaai kareejai ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, what more can be said about the Unspoken Speech?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂ ਤੈਸਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: jaisaa too taisaa tuhee kiaa upamaa deejai ||3||1||
english: Whatever You are, You are, O Lord; how can anything compare with Your Praises? ||3||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval ||
english: Bilaaval:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਕੁਲ ਸਾਧੁ ਬੈਸਨੌ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jih kul saadh baisanau hoi ||
english: That family, into which a holy person is born,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਰਨ ਅਬਰਨ ਰੰਕੁ ਨਹੀ ਈਸੁਰੁ ਬਿਮਲ ਬਾਸੁ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਜਗਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: baran abaran ra(n)k nahee eesur bimal baas jaaneeai jag soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: whether of high or low social class, whether rich or poor, shall have its pure fragrance spread all over the world. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨ ਬੈਸ ਸੂਦ ਅਰੁ ਖੵਤ੍ਰੀ ਡੋਮ ਚੰਡਾਰ ਮਲੇਛ ਮਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: brahaman bais sood ar khytree dom cha(n)daar malechh man soi ||
english: Whether he is a Brahmin, a Vaishya, a Soodra, or a Kh'shaatriya; whether he is a poet, an outcaste, or a filthy-minded person,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਜਨ ਤੇ ਆਪੁ ਤਾਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਦੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hoi puneet bhagava(n)t bhajan te aap taar taare kul doi ||1||
english: he becomes pure, by meditating on the Lord God. He saves himself, and the families of both his parents. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁ ਗਾਉ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੋ ਠਾਉ ਧੰਨਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s gaau dha(n)n so thaau dha(n)n puneet kuta(n)b sabh loi ||
english: Blessed is that village, and blessed is the place of his birth; blessed is his pure family, throughout all the worlds.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਸਾਰ ਰਸੁ ਤਜੇ ਆਨ ਰਸ ਹੋਇ ਰਸ ਮਗਨ ਡਾਰੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin peeaa saar ras taje aan ras hoi ras magan daare bikh khoi ||2||
english: One who drinks in the sublime essence abandons other tastes; intoxicated with this divine essence, he discards sin and corruption. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੂਰ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਭਗਤ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit soor chhatrapat raajaa bhagat baraabar aur na koi ||
english: Among the religious scholars, warriors and kings, there is no other equal to the Lord's devotee.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪੁਰੈਨ ਪਾਤ ਰਹੈ ਜਲ ਸਮੀਪ ਭਨਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜਨਮੇ ਜਗਿ ਓਇ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: jaise purain paat rahai jal sameep bhan ravidaas janame jag oi ||3||2||
english: As the leaves of the water lily float free in the water, says Ravi Daas, so is their life in the world. ||3||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਸਧਨੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
transliteration: baanee sadhane kee raag bilaaval ||
english: The Word Of Sadhana, Raag Bilaaval:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਨੈ ਇਕੁ ਭਇਆ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: nrip ka(n)niaa ke kaaranai ik bhaiaa bhekhadhaaree ||
english: For a king's daughter, a man disguised himself as Vishnu.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਾਰਥੀ ਸੁਆਰਥੀ ਵਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaamaarathee suaarathee vaa kee paij savaaree ||1||
english: He did it for sexual exploitation, and for selfish motives, but the Lord protected his honor. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤਵ ਗੁਨ ਕਹਾ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰਾ ਜਉ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਨਾਸੈ ॥
transliteration: tav gun kahaa jagat guraa jau karam na naasai ||
english: What is Your value, O Guru of the world, if You will not erase the karma of my past actions?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਘ ਸਰਨ ਕਤ ਜਾਈਐ ਜਉ ਜੰਬੁਕੁ ਗ੍ਰਾਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: si(n)gh saran kat jaaeeai jau ja(n)buk graasai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Why seek safety from a lion, if one is to be eaten by a jackal? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਲ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ek boo(n)d jal kaarane chaatrik dukh paavai ||
english: For the sake of a single rain-drop, the rainbird suffers in pain.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗਏ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: praan gae saagar milai phun kaam na aavai ||2||
english: When its breath of life is gone, even an ocean is of no use to it. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜੁ ਥਾਕੇ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਿਰਮਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: praan j thaake thir nahee kaise biramaavau ||
english: Now, my life has grown weary, and I shall not last much longer; how can I be patient?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਿ ਮੂਏ ਨਉਕਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਹੁ ਕਾਹਿ ਚਢਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bood mooe naukaa milai kahu kaahi chadhaavau ||3||
english: If I drown and die, and then a boat comes along, tell me, how shall I climb aboard? ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਹਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਹਿ ਨ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mai naahee kachh hau nahee kichh aahi na moraa ||
english: I am nothing, I have nothing, and nothing belongs to me.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਉਸਰ ਲਜਾ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਧਨਾ ਜਨੁ ਤੋਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: ausar lajaa raakh lehu sadhanaa jan toraa ||4||1||
english: Now, protect my honor; Sadhana is Your humble servant. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag go(n)d chaupade mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Gond, Chau-Padhay, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਸ ਰਖਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਤਾ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਫਲ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: je man chit aas rakhahi har oopar taa man chi(n)de anek anek phal paaee ||
english: If, in his conscious mind, he places his hopes in the Lord, then he shall obtain the fruits of all the many desires of his mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜੋ ਜੀਇ ਵਰਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਾਲਿਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har jaanai sabh kichh jo jeei varatai prabh ghaaliaa kisai kaa ik til na gavaaee ||
english: The Lord knows everything which happens to the soul. Not even an iota of one's effort goes to waste.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har tis kee aas keejai man mere jo sabh mahi suaamee rahiaa samaaee ||1||
english: Place your hopes in the Lord, O my mind; the Lord and Master is pervading and permeating all. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਆਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mere man aasaa kar jagadees gusaaee ||
english: O my mind, place your hopes in the Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਅਵਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਾ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਆਸ ਸਭ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo bin har aas avar kaahoo kee keejai saa nihaphal aas sabh birathee jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: That hope which is placed in any other than the Lord - that hope is fruitless, and totally useless. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਭੁ ਮਤ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਲਗਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai maaiaa moh kuta(n)b sabh mat tis kee aas lag janam gavaaee ||
english: That which you can see, Maya, and all attachment to family - don't place your hopes in them, or your life will be wasted and lost.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਨੑ ਕੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਇਨੑ ਕਾ ਵਾਹਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: inh kai kichh haath nahee kahaa karahi ihi bapuRe inh kaa vaahiaa kachh na vasaaee ||
english: Nothing is in their hands; what can these poor creatures do? By their actions, nothing can be done.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਆਸ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਤੁਝੁ ਤਾਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਭੁ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mere man aas kar har preetam apune kee jo tujh taarai teraa kuta(n)b sabh chhadaaee ||2||
english: O my mind, place your hopes in the Lord, your Beloved, who shall carry you across, and save your whole family as well. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਸ ਅਵਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਮਿਤ੍ਰੀ ਮਤ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: je kichh aas avar karahi paramitree mat too(n) jaanahi terai kitai ka(n)m aaee ||
english: If you place your hopes in any other, in any friend other than the Lord, then you shall come to know that it is of no use at all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਆਸ ਪਰਮਿਤ੍ਰੀ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ih aas paramitree bhaau doojaa hai khin mahi jhooth binas sabh jaaee ||
english: This hope placed in other friends comes from the love of duality. In an instant, it is gone; it is totally false.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਆਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਘਾਲਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mere man aasaa kar har preetam saache kee jo teraa ghaaliaa sabh thaai paaee ||3||
english: O my mind, place your hopes in the Lord, your True Beloved, who shall approve and reward you for all your efforts. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੂ ਆਸ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਕੋ ਆਸ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa sabh teree mere suaamee jaisee too aas karaavahi taisee ko aas karaaee ||
english: Hope and desire are all Yours, O my Lord and Master. As You inspire hope, so are the hopes held.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੈ ਹਥਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਐਸੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kichh kisee kai hath naahee mere suaamee aisee merai satigur boojh bujhaaee ||
english: Nothing is in the hands of anyone, O my Lord and Master; such is the understanding the True Guru has given me to understand.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak kee aas too jaanahi har darasan dekh har darasan tripataaee ||4||1||
english: You alone know the hope of servant Nanak, O Lord; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, he is satisfied. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gond, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੋ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aisaa har seveeai nit dhiaaeeai jo khin mahi kilavikh sabh kare binaasaa ||
english: Serve such a Lord, and ever meditate on Him, who in an instant erases all sins and mistakes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਭ ਘਾਲ ਗਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: je har tiaag avar kee aas keejai taa har nihaphal sabh ghaal gavaasaa ||
english: If someone forsakes the Lord and places his hopes in another, then all his service to the Lord is rendered fruitless.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mere man har sevihu sukhadaataa suaamee jis seviai sabh bhukh lahaasaa ||1||
english: O my mind, serve the Lord, the Giver of peace; serving Him, all your hunger shall depart. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man har oopar keejai bharavaasaa ||
english: O my mind, place your faith in the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਜਨ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jah jaaeeai tah naal meraa suaamee har apanee paij rakhai jan daasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Wherever I go, my Lord and Master is there with me. The Lord saves the honor of His humble servants and slaves. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਅਪਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਅਵਰਾ ਪਹਿ ਤਾ ਆਗੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਢਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: je apanee birathaa kahahu avaraa pahi taa aagai apanee birathaa bahu bahut kadhaasaa ||
english: If you tell your sorrows to another, then he, in return, will tell you of his greater sorrows.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਦੂਖ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਕਟਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: apanee birathaa kahahu har apune suaamee pahi jo tumhre dookh tatakaal kataasaa ||
english: So tell your sorrows to the Lord, your Lord and Master, who shall instantly dispel your pain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅਵਰਾ ਪਹਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਅਵਰਾ ਪਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਮਨ ਲਾਜ ਮਰਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so aisaa prabh chhod apanee birathaa avaraa pahi kaheeai avaraa pahi kahi man laaj maraasaa ||2||
english: Forsaking such a Lord God, if you tell your sorrows to another, then you shall die of shame. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ਕੇ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਭਾਈ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਮਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jo sa(n)saarai ke kuta(n)b mitr bhaaee deesahi man mere te sabh apanai suaai milaasaa ||
english: The relatives, friends and siblings of the world that you see, O my mind, all meet with you for their own purposes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਉਨੑ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੋ ਨ ਢੁਕਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jit din unh kaa suaau hoi na aavai tit din neRai ko na dhukaasaa ||
english: And that day, when their self-interests are not served, on that day, they shall not come near you.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਕਰੈ ਦੂਖਿ ਸੁਖਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man mere apanaa har sev din raatee jo tudh upakarai dookh sukhaasaa ||3||
english: O my mind, serve your Lord, day and night; He shall help you in good times and bad. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਅੰਤੀ ਅਉਸਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa bharavaasaa kiu keejai man mere jo a(n)tee ausar rakh na sakaasaa ||
english: Why place your faith in anyone, O my mind, who cannot come to your rescue at the last instant?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਿਤਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: har jap ma(n)t gur upades lai jaapahu tinh a(n)t chhadaae jinh har preet chitaasaa ||
english: Chant the Lord's Mantra, take the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on Him. In the end, the Lord saves those who love Him in their consciousness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਛੂਟਣ ਕਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak anadin naam japahu har sa(n)tahu ihu chhootan kaa saachaa bharavaasaa ||4||2||
english: Servant Nanak speaks: night and day, chant the Lord's Name, O Saints; this is the only true hope for emancipation. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gond, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੀਤਲ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har simarat sadaa hoi ana(n)d sukh a(n)tar saa(n)t seetal man apanaa ||
english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, you shall find bliss and peace forever deep within, and your mind will become tranquil and cool.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਸਕਤਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਜਲਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਸਿ ਦੇਖੇ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਭ ਤਪਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaise sakat soor bahu jalataa gur sas dekhe lahi jaai sabh tapanaa ||1||
english: It is like the harsh sun of Maya, with its burning heat; seeing the moon, the Guru, its heat totally vanishes. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man anadin dhiaai naam har japanaa ||
english: O my mind, night and day, meditate, and chant the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਕਹਾ ਤੁਝੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਅਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jahaa kahaa tujh raakhai sabh thaaee so aisaa prabh sev sadaa too apanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Here and hereafter, He shall protect you, everywhere; serve such a God forever. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa mahi sabh nidhaan so har jap man mere guramukh khoj lahahu har ratanaa ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, who contains all treasures, O my mind; as Gurmukh, search for the jewel, the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਮਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin har dhiaaiaa tin har paaiaa meraa suaamee tin ke charan malahu har dasanaa ||2||
english: Those who meditate on the Lord, find the Lord, my Lord and Master; I wash the feet of those slaves of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਓਹੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਬਡ ਬਡਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad pachhaan raam ras paavahu ohu ootam sa(n)t bhaio bad badanaa ||
english: One who realizes the Word of the Shabad, obtains the sublime essence of the Lord; such a Saint is lofty and sublime, the greatest of the great.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਧਾਈ ਓਹੁ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਘਟਾਈ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis jan kee vadiaaee har aap vadhaaee ohu ghatai na kisai kee ghataaee ik til til tilanaa ||3||
english: The Lord Himself magnifies the glory of that humble servant. No one can lessen or decrease that glory, not even a bit. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਨਿਤ ਕਰ ਜੁਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jis te sukh paavahi man mere so sadaa dhiaai nit kar juranaa ||
english: He shall give you peace, O my mind; meditate forever, every day on Him, with your palms pressed together.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਬਸਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau har daan ik deejai nit basahi ridai haree mohi charanaa ||4||3||
english: Please bless servant Nanak with this one gift, O Lord, that Your feet may dwell within my heart forever. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gond, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਸਾਹ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਉਮਰਾਵ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਝੂਠੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jitane saah paatisaah umaraav sikadaar chaudharee sabh mithiaa jhooth bhaau doojaa jaan ||
english: All the kings, emperors, nobles, lords and chiefs are false and transitory, engrossed in duality - know this well.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har abinaasee sadaa thir nihachal tis mere man bhaj paravaan ||1||
english: The eternal Lord is permanent and unchanging; meditate on Him, O my mind, and you shall be approved. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: mere man naam haree bhaj sadaa deebaan ||
english: O my mind, vibrate, and meditate on the Lord's Name, which shall be your defender forever.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo har mahal paavai gur bachanee tis jevad avar naahee kisai daa taan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings - no one else's power is as great as his. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਕੁਲਵੰਤ ਮਿਲਖਵੰਤ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਚਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jitane dhanava(n)t kulava(n)t milakhava(n)t deesahi man mere sabh binas jaahi jiu ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kachaan ||
english: All the wealthy, high class property owners which you see, O my mind, shall vanish, like the fading color of the safflower.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har sat nira(n)jan sadaa sev man mere jit har daragah paavahi too maan ||2||
english: Serve the True, Immaculate Lord forever, O my mind, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਹਹਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: braahaman khatree sood vais chaar varan chaar aasram hahi jo har dhiaavai so paradhaan ||
english: There are four castes: Brahmin, Kh'shaatriya, Soodra and Vaishya, and there are four stages of life. One who meditates on the Lord, is the most distinguished and renowned.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਚੰਦਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਿਰਡੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਤਿਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu cha(n)dan nikat vasai hirad bapuRaa tiu satasa(n)gat mil patit paravaan ||3||
english: The poor castor oil plant, growing near the sandalwood tree, becomes fragrant; in the same way, the sinner, associating with the Saints, becomes acceptable and approved. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਸੂਚਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ohu sabh te oochaa sabh te soochaa jaa kai hiradai vasiaa bhagavaan ||
english: He, within whose heart the Lord abides, is the highest of all, and the purest of all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਸੇਵਕਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak tis ke charan pakhaalai jo har jan neech jaat sevakaan ||4||4||
english: Servant Nanak washes the feet of that humble servant of the Lord; he may be from a low class family, but he is now the Lord's servant. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gond, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭਤੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਕਰਈਐ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)tarajaamee sabhatai varatai jehaa har karaae tehaa ko karaeeai ||
english: The Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is all-pervading. As the Lord causes them to act, so do they act.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਰਖਿ ਲਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so aisaa har sev sadaa man mere jo tudhano sabh doo rakh laeeai ||1||
english: So serve forever such a Lord, O my mind, who will protect you from everything. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਪੜਈਐ ॥
transliteration: mere man har jap har nit paRaeeai ||
english: O my mind, meditate on the Lord, and read about the Lord every day.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਤਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਕੜਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bin ko maar jeevaal na saakai taa mere man kaait kaRaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Other than the Lord, no one can kill you or save you; so why do you worry, O my mind? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰਈਐ ॥
transliteration: har parapa(n)ch keeaa sabh karatai vich aape aapanee jot dharaeeai ||
english: The Creator created the entire universe, and infused His Light into it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har eko bolai har ek bulaae gur poorai har ek dikhaeeai ||2||
english: The One Lord speaks, and the One Lord causes all to speak.The Perfect Guru has revealed the One Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ਕਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮਨ ਕਿਆ ਚੋਰਈਐ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)tar naale baahar naale kahu tis paasahu man kiaa choraeeai ||
english: The Lord is with you, inside and out; tell me, O mind, how can You hide anything from Him?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਕਪਟ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ਤਾਂ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nihakapat sevaa keejai har keree taa(n) mere man sarab sukh paeeai ||3||
english: Serve the Lord open-heartedly, and then, O my mind, you shall find total peace. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਵਸਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡਾ ਸੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਅਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jis dai vas sabh kichh so sabh doo vadaa so mere man sadaa dhiaeeai ||
english: Everything is under His control; He is the greatest of all. O my mind, meditate forever on Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਏ ਛਡਈਐ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak so har naal hai terai har sadaa dhiaai too tudh lae chhadaeeai ||4||5||
english: O Servant Nanak, that Lord is always with you. Meditate forever on your Lord, and He shall emancipate you. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 4 ||
english: Gond, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਤਪਤੈ ਜਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har darasan kau meraa man bahu tapatai jiu trikhaava(n)t bin neer ||1||
english: My mind yearns so deeply for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, like the thirsty man without water. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗੋ ਹਰਿ ਤੀਰ ॥
transliteration: merai man prem lago har teer ||
english: My mind is pierced through by the arrow of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੀ ਬੇਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hamaree bedan har prabh jaanai mere man a(n)tar kee peer ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord God knows my anguish, and the pain deep within my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੀ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਾਈ ਸੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੀਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mere har preetam kee koee baat sunaavai so bhaaee so meraa beer ||2||
english: Whoever tells me the Stories of my Beloved Lord is my Sibling of Destiny, and my friend. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਧੀਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mil mil sakhee gun kahu mere prabh ke le satigur kee mat dheer ||3||
english: Come, and join together, O my companions; let's sing the Glorious Praises of my God, and follow the comforting advice of the True Guru.. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੪॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak kee har aas pujaavahu har darasan saa(n)t sareer ||4||6|| chhakaa 1 ||
english: Please fulfill the hopes of servant Nanak, O Lord; his body finds peace and tranquility in the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||4||6|| First set of six. ||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag go(n)d mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Gond, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਭੁਗਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh karataa sabh bhugataa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Creator of all, He is the Enjoyer of all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਤੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੇਖਤ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sunato karataa pekhat karataa ||
english: The Creator listens, and the Creator sees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੋ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: adrisato karataa drisato karataa ||
english: The Creator is unseen, and the Creator is seen.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਪਤਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਰਲਉ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: opat karataa paralau karataa ||
english: The Creator forms, and the Creator destroys.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਕਰਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: biaapat karataa alipato karataa ||1||
english: The Creator touches, and the Creator is detached. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਕਤੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਬੂਝਤ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bakato karataa boojhat karataa ||
english: The Creator is the One who speaks, and the Creator is the One who understands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਾਤੁ ਭੀ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aavat karataa jaat bhee karataa ||
english: The Creator comes, and the Creator also goes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: niragun karataa saragun karataa ||
english: The Creator is absolute and without qualities; the Creator is related, with the most excellent qualities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਮਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak samadrisataa ||2||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, Nanak looks upon all the same. ||2||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਾਕਿਓ ਮੀਨ ਕਪਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਤੂ ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਕੁਸੰਭਾਇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: phaakio meen kapik kee niaaee too urajh rahio kusa(n)bhaaile ||
english: You are caught, like the fish and the monkey; you are entangled in the transitory world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਗ ਧਾਰਹਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਲੈ ਤਉ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pag dhaarahi saas lekhai lai tau udharahi har gun gaaile ||1||
english: Your foot-steps and your breaths are numbered; only by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord will you be saved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਮਝੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਆਵਾਇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: man samajh chhod aavaaile ||
english: O mind, reform yourself, and forsake your aimless wandering.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਰਹਨ ਕਉ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਾਏ ਪਰ ਕੈ ਜਾਇਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: apane rahan kau thaur na paavahi kaae par kai jaaile ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You have found no place of rest for yourself; so why do you try to teach others? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਓ ਤੂ ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਕੁਟੰਬਾਇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jiu maigal i(n)dree ras prerio too laag pario kuta(n)baaile ||
english: Like the elephant, driven by sexual desire, you are attached to your family.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪੰਖੀ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਛੁਰੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਲੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu pa(n)khee ikatr hoi phir bichhurai thir sa(n)gat har har dhiaaile ||2||
english: People are like birds that come together, and fly apart again; you shall become stable and steady, only when you meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of the Holy. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਨੁ ਰਸਨ ਸਾਦਿ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਓਹੁ ਮੂਠੌ ਮੂੜ ਲੋਭਾਇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jaise meen rasan saad binasio ohu moothau mooR lobhaaile ||
english: Like the fish, which perishes because of its desire to taste, the fool is ruined by his greed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਹੋਆ ਪੰਚ ਵਾਸਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਕੈ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਪਰੁ ਸਰਨਾਇਲੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too hoaa pa(n)ch vaas vairee kai chhootahi par saranaaile ||3||
english: You have fallen under the power of the five thieves; escape is only possible in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤਾਇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: hohu kripaal deen dukh bha(n)jan sabh tumhre jee ja(n)taaile ||
english: Be Merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the meek; all beings and creatures belong to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: paavau daan sadaa daras pekhaa mil naanak daas dasaaile ||4||2||
english: May I obtain the gift of always seeing the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; meeting with You, Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag go(n)d mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Gond, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੀਏ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿ ॥
transliteration: jee praan keee jin saaj ||
english: He fashioned the soul and the breath of life,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਖੀ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ॥
transliteration: maatee mahi jot rakhee nivaaj ||
english: and infused His Light into the dust;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਤਨ ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਭੋਜਨ ਭੋਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baratan kau sabh kichh bhojan bhogaai ||
english: He exalted you and gave you everything to use, and food to eat and enjoy

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਜਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਤ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so prabh taj mooRe kat jaai ||1||
english: - how can you forsake that God, you fool! Where else will you go? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਉ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham kee laagau sev ||
english: Commit yourself to the service of the Transcendent Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਝੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur te sujhai nira(n)jan dev ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Guru, one understands the Immaculate, Divine Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਰੰਗ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jin keee ra(n)g anik parakaar ||
english: He created plays and dramas of all sorts;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਝਾਰ ॥
transliteration: opat paralau nimakh majhaar ||
english: He creates and destroys in an instant;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee gat mit kahee na jaai ||
english: His state and condition cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so prabh man mere sadaa dhiaai ||2||
english: Meditate forever on that God, O my mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਧਨੀ ॥
transliteration: aai na jaavai nihachal dhanee ||
english: The unchanging Lord does not come or go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਨਾ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕੇਤਕ ਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: bea(n)t gunaa taa ke ketak ganee ||
english: His Glorious Virtues are infinite; how many of them can I count?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਨਾਮ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: laal naam jaa kai bhare bha(n)daar ||
english: His treasure is overflowing with the rubies of the Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਧਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sagal ghataa devai aadhaar ||3||
english: He gives Support to all hearts. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sat purakh jaa ko hai naau ||
english: The Name is the True Primal Being;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mitahi kot agh nimakh jas gaau ||
english: millions of sins are washed away in an instant, singing His Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੋ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: baal sakhaaee bhagatan ko meet ||
english: The Lord God is your best friend, your playmate from earliest childhood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਤ ਚੀਤ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: praan adhaar naanak hit cheet ||4||1||3||
english: He is the Support of the breath of life; O Nanak, He is love, He is consciousness. ||4||1||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naam sa(n)g keeno biuhaar ||
english: I trade in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋੁ ਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naamou hee is man kaa adhaar ||
english: The Naam is the Support of the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਓਟ ॥
transliteration: naamo hee chit keenee ot ||
english: My consciousness takes to the Shelter of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਕੋਟਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam japat mitahi paap kot ||1||
english: Chanting the Naam, millions of sins are erased. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਸਿ ਦੀਈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: raas deeee har eko naam ||
english: The Lord has blessed me with the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਇਸਟੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man kaa isat gur sa(n)g dhiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The wish of my mind is to meditate on the Naam, in association with the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaare jee kee raas ||
english: The Naam is the wealth of my soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੰਗੀ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਜਾਤ ॥
transliteration: naamo sa(n)gee jat kat jaat ||
english: Wherever I go, the Naam is with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: naamo hee man laagaa meethaa ||
english: The Naam is sweet to my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jal thal sabh mahi naamo deethaa ||2||
english: In the water, on the land, and everywhere, I see the Naam. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ॥
transliteration: naame daragah mukh ujale ||
english: Through the Naam, one's face becomes radiant in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naame sagale kul udhare ||
english: Through the Naam, all one's generations are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸੀਧ ॥
transliteration: naam hamaare kaaraj seedh ||
english: Through the Naam, my affairs are resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਗੀਧ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam sa(n)g ihu manooaa geedh ||3||
english: My mind is accustomed to the Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: naame hee ham nirabhau bhae ||
english: Through the Naam, I have become fearless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਵਨ ਰਹੇ ॥
transliteration: naame aavan jaavan rahe ||
english: Through the Naam, my comings and goings have ceased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai mele gunataas ||
english: The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sukh sahaj nivaas ||4||2||4||
english: Says Nanak, I dwell in celestial peace. ||4||2||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਦੇਤੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: nimaane kau jo deto maan ||
english: He grants honor to the dishonored,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭੂਖੇ ਕਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sagal bhookhe kau karataa daan ||
english: and gives gifts to all the hungry;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: garabh ghor mahi raakhanahaar ||
english: he protects those in the terrible womb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis thaakur kau sadaa namasakaar ||1||
english: So humbly bow forever to that Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: aiso prabh man maahi dhiaai ||
english: Meditate on such a God in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਜਤ ਕਤਹਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ghat avaghat jat katahi sahaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He shall be your help and support everywhere, in good times and bad. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਕੁ ਰਾਉ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)k raau jaa kai ek samaan ||
english: The beggar and the king are all the same to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਪੂਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: keet hasat sagal pooraan ||
english: He sustains and fulfills both the ant and the elephant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੀਓ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
transliteration: beeo poochh na masalat dharai ||
english: He does not consult or seek anyone's advice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo kichh karai s aapahi karai ||2||
english: Whatever He does, He does Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa a(n)t na jaanas koi ||
english: No one knows His limit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape aap nira(n)jan soi ||
english: He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aap akaar aap nira(n)kaar ||
english: He Himself is formed, and He Himself is formless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਘਟਿ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ghat ghat ghat sabh ghat aadhaar ||3||
english: In the heart, in each and every heart, He is the Support of all hearts. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਭਗਤ ਭਏ ਲਾਲ ॥
transliteration: naam ra(n)g bhagat bhae laal ||
english: Through the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the devotees become His Beloveds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਸੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jas karate sa(n)t sadaa nihaal ||
english: Singing the Praises of the Creator, the Saints are forever in bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਨ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naam ra(n)g jan rahe aghaai ||
english: Through the Love of the Naam, the Lord's humble servants remain satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak tin jan laagai paai ||4||3||5||
english: Nanak falls at the feet of those humble servants of the Lord. ||4||3||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai sa(n)g ihu man niramal ||
english: Associating with them, this mind becomes immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai sa(n)g har har simaran ||
english: Associating with them, one meditates in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai sa(n)g kilabikh hohi naas ||
english: Associating with them, all the sins are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kai sa(n)g ridai paragaas ||1||
english: Associating with them, the heart is illumined. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: se sa(n)tan har ke mere meet ||
english: Those Saints of the Lord are my friends.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: keval naam gaaeeai jaa kai neet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It is their custom to sing only the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai ma(n)tr har har man vasai ||
english: By their mantra, the Lord, Har, Har, dwells in the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਨਸੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai upades bharam bhau nasai ||
english: By their teachings, doubt and fear are dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai keerat niramal saar ||
english: By their kirtan, they become immaculate and sublime.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa kee ren baa(n)chhai sa(n)saar ||2||
english: The world longs for the dust of their feet. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kot patit jaa kai sa(n)g udhaar ||
english: Millions of sinners are saved by associating with them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ek nira(n)kaar jaa kai naam adhaar ||
english: They have the Support of the Name of the One Formless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆਂ ਕਾ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab jeeaa(n) kaa jaanai bheu ||
english: He knows the secrets of all beings;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kripaa nidhaan nira(n)jan deu ||3||
english: He is the treasure of mercy, the divine immaculate Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham jab bhae kripaal ||
english: When the Supreme Lord God becomes merciful,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: tab bhete gur saadh daiaal ||
english: then one meets the Merciful Holy Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: din rain naanak naam dhiaae ||
english: Day and night, Nanak meditates on the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d har naae ||4||4||6||
english: Through the Lord's Name, he is blessed with peace, poise and bliss. ||4||4||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kee moorat man mahi dhiaan ||
english: Meditate on the image of the Guru within your mind;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad ma(n)tr man maan ||
english: let your mind accept the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and His Mantra.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਧਾਰਉ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan ridai lai dhaarau ||
english: Enshrine the Guru's feet within your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur paarabraham sadaa namasakaarau ||1||
english: Bow in humility forever before the Guru, the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤ ਕੋ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: mat ko bharam bhulai sa(n)saar ||
english: Let no one wander in doubt in the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur bin koi na utaras paar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Guru, no one can cross over. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhoole kau gur maarag paaiaa ||
english: The Guru shows the Path to those who have wandered off.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: avar tiaag har bhagatee laaiaa ||
english: He leads them to renounce others, and attaches them to devotional worship of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: janam maran kee traas mitaaee ||
english: He obliterates the fear of birth and death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur poore kee bea(n)t vadaaee ||2||
english: The glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru is endless. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਊਰਧ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad ooradh kamal bigaas ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the inverted heart-lotus blossoms forth,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhakaar mahi bhaiaa pragaas ||
english: and the Light shines forth in the darkness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jin keeaa so gur te jaaniaa ||
english: Through the Guru, know the One who created you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮੁਗਧ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te mugadh man maaniaa ||3||
english: By the Guru's Mercy, the foolish mind comes to believe. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: gur karataa gur karanai jog ||
english: The Guru is the Creator; the Guru has the power to do everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: gur paramesar hai bhee hog ||
english: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord; He is, and always shall be.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਇਹੈ ਜਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh ihai janaaee ||
english: Says Nanak, God has inspired me to know this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
transliteration: bin gur mukat na paaeeai bhaaee ||4||5||7||
english: Without the Guru, liberation is not obtained, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||5||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੋਰ ॥
transliteration: guroo guroo gur kar man mor ||
english: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, O my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰ ॥
transliteration: guroo binaa mai naahee hor ||
english: I have no other than the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਹਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kee tek rahahu din raat ||
english: I lean upon the Support of the Guru, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kee koi na metai daat ||1||
english: No one can decrease His bounty. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: gur paramesar eko jaan ||
english: Know that the Guru and the Transcendent Lord are One.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so paravaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever pleases Him is acceptable and approved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: gur charanee jaa kaa man laagai ||
english: One whose mind is attached to the Guru's feet

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: dookh darad bhram taa kaa bhaagai ||
english: his pains, sufferings and doubts run away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa paae maan ||
english: Serving the Guru, honor is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur oopar sadaa kurabaan ||2||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa darasan dekh nihaal ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I am exalted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ॥
transliteration: gur ke sevak kee pooran ghaal ||
english: The work of the Guru's servant is perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: gur ke sevak kau dukh na biaapai ||
english: Pain does not afflict the Guru's servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kaa sevak dah dis jaapai ||3||
english: The Guru's servant is famous in the ten directions. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kee mahimaa kathan na jaai ||
english: The Guru's glory cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham gur rahiaa samaai ||
english: The Guru remains absorbed in the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਗ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jaa ke poore bhaag ||
english: Says Nanak, one who is blessed with perfect destiny

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੪॥੬॥੮॥
transliteration: gur charanee taa kaa man laag ||4||6||8||
english: - his mind is attached to the Guru's feet. ||4||6||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: gur meree poojaa gur gobi(n)d ||
english: I worship and adore my Guru; the Guru is the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: gur meraa paarabraham gur bhagava(n)t ||
english: My Guru is the Supreme Lord God; the Guru is the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੇਉ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ॥
transliteration: gur meraa deu alakh abheu ||
english: My Guru is divine, invisible and mysterious.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਪੂਜ ਚਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarab pooj charan gur seu ||1||
english: I serve at the Guru's feet, which are worshipped by all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur bin avar naahee mai thaau ||
english: Without the Guru, I have no other place at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anadin japau guroo gur naau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Night and day, I chant the Name of Guru, Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur meraa giaan gur ridai dhiaan ||
english: The Guru is my spiritual wisdom, the Guru is the meditation within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur gopaal purakh bhagavaan ||
english: The Guru is the Lord of the World, the Primal Being, the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਰਹਉ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kee saran rahau kar jor ||
english: With my palms pressed together, I remain in the Guru's Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guroo binaa mai naahee hor ||2||
english: Without the Guru, I have no other at all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਭਵ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur bohith taare bhav paar ||
english: The Guru is the boat to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa jam te chhutakaar ||
english: Serving the Guru, one is released from the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਉਜਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhakaar mahi gur ma(n)tr ujaaraa ||
english: In the darkness, the Guru's Mantra shines forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kai sa(n)g sagal nisataaraa ||3||
english: With the Guru, all are saved. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa paaeeai vadabhaagee ||
english: The Perfect Guru is found, by great good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa dookh na laagee ||
english: Serving the Guru, pain does not afflict anyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad na metai koi ||
english: No one can erase the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੭॥੯॥
transliteration: gur naanak naanak har soi ||4||7||9||
english: Nanak is the Guru; Nanak is the Lord Himself. ||4||7||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: raam raam sa(n)g kar biuhaar ||
english: Deal and trade only with the Lord, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: raam raam raam praan adhaar ||
english: The Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, is the Support of the breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raam raam raam keeratan gaai ||
english: Sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਭ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ramat raam sabh rahio samaai ||1||
english: The Lord is ever-present, all-pervading. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil bolahu raam ||
english: Joining the humble Saints, chant the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh te niramal pooran kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This is the most immaculate and perfect occupation of all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: raam raam dhan sa(n)ch bha(n)daar ||
english: Gather the treasure, the wealth of the Lord, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕਰਿ ਆਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: raam raam raam kar aahaar ||
english: Let your sustenance be the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਵੀਸਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raam raam veesar nahee jaai ||
english: Never forget the Lord, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬਤਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa gur deeaa bataai ||2||
english: In His Mercy, the Guru has revealed this to me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raam raam raam sadaa sahaai ||
english: The Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, is always our help and support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raam raam raam liv laai ||
english: Embrace love for the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: raam raam jap niramal bhae ||
english: Through the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, I have become immaculate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh gae ||3||
english: The sins of countless incarnations have been taken away. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ramat raam janam maran nivaarai ||
english: Uttering the Lord's Name, birth and death are finished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਚਰਤ ਰਾਮ ਭੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ucharat raam bhai paar utaarai ||
english: Repeating the Lord's Name, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: sabh te ooch raam paragaas ||
english: The Luminous Lord is the highest of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੦॥
transliteration: nis baasur jap naanak daas ||4||8||10||
english: Night and day, servant Nanak meditates on Him. ||4||8||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਕਉ ਖਸਮਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਠਾਕਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: un kau khasam keenee thaakahaare ||
english: My Lord and Master has held back the five demons.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਸੰਗ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: daas sa(n)g te maar bidaare ||
english: He conquered them, and scared them away from the Lord's slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d bhagat kaa mahal na paaiaa ||
english: They cannot find the mansion of the Lord's devotee.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam janaa mil ma(n)gal gaaiaa ||1||
english: Joining together, the Lord's humble servants sing the songs of joy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੇ ਪੰਚ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sagal srisat ke pa(n)ch sikadaar ||
english: The five demons are the rulers of the whole world,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤ ਕੇ ਪਾਨੀਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam bhagat ke paaneehaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: but they are just water-carriers for the Lord's devotee. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਪਾਸ ਤੇ ਲੇਤੇ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jagat paas te lete daan ||
english: They collect taxes from the world,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d bhagat kau karahi salaam ||
english: but they bow in subservience to God's devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੂਟਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: loot lehi saakat pat khovahi ||
english: They plunder and dishonor the faithless cynics,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadh janaa pag mal mal dhovahi ||2||
english: but they massage and wash the feet of the Holy. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਪੂਤ ਜਣੇ ਇਕ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch poot jane ik maai ||
english: The One Mother gave birth to the five sons,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਤਭੁਜ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: utabhuj khel kar jagat viaai ||
english: and began the play of the created world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਸੇ ॥
transliteration: teen gunaa kai sa(n)g rach rase ||
english: With the three qualities joined together, they celebrate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਕਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਸੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: in kau chhod oopar jan base ||3||
english: Renouncing these three qualities, the Lord's humble servants rise above them. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਨ ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jan leee chhadaai ||
english: In His Mercy, He saves His humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਖੇ ਹਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis ke se tin rakhe hataai ||
english: They belong to Him, and so He saves them by driving out the five.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bhagat prabh saar ||
english: Says Nanak, devotion to God is noble and sublime.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੧॥
transliteration: bin bhagatee sabh hoi khuaar ||4||9||11||
english: Without devotion, all just waste away uselessly. ||4||9||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kal kales mite har naai ||
english: Suffering and troubles are eradicated by the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਨੋ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dukh binase sukh keeno thaau ||
english: Pain is dispelled, and peace takes its place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jap jap a(n)mrit naam aghaae ||
english: Meditating, chanting the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਗਲ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad sagal phal paae ||1||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, I have received all fruitful rewards. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਜਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raam japat jan paar pare ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, His humble servant is carried across,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke paap hare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and the sins of countless incarnations are taken away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan ridai ur dhaare ||
english: I have enshrined the Guru's feet within my heart,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: agan saagar te utare paare ||
english: and crossed over the ocean of fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਸਭ ਮਿਟੀ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥
transliteration: janam maran sabh mitee upaadh ||
english: All the painful diseases of birth and death have been eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prabh siu laagee sahaj samaadh ||2||
english: I am attached to God in celestial Samaadhi. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar eko suaamee ||
english: In all places and interspaces, the One, our Lord and Master is contained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: sagal ghataa kaa a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: He is the Inner-knower of all hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jaa kau mat dei ||
english: One whom the Lord blesses with understanding,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਲੇਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aath pahar prabh kaa naau lei ||3||
english: chants the Name of God, twenty-four hours a day. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai a(n)tar vasai prabh aap ||
english: Deep within, God Himself abides;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: taa kai hiradai hoi pragaas ||
english: within his heart, the Divine Light shines forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: bhagat bhaai har keeratan kareeai ||
english: With loving devotion, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੨॥
transliteration: jap paarabraham naanak nisatareeai ||4||10||12||
english: Meditate on the Supreme Lord God, O Nanak, and you shall be saved. ||4||10||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan kamal namasakaar ||
english: Bow in humility to the lotus feet of the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh is tan te maar ||
english: Eliminate sexual desire and anger from this body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: hoi raheeai sagal kee reenaa ||
english: Be the dust of all,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ghat ghat ramaeeaa sabh mahi cheenaa ||1||
english: and see the Lord in each and every heart, in all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਮਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: in bidh ramahu gopaal goubi(n)d ||
english: In this way, dwell upon the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan dhan prabh kaa prabh kee ji(n)d ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My body and wealth belong to God; my soul belongs to God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar har ke gun gaau ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: jee praan ko ihai suaau ||
english: This is the purpose of human life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: taj abhimaan jaan prabh sa(n)g ||
english: Renounce your egotistical pride, and know that God is with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadh prasaad har siu man ra(n)g ||2||
english: By the Grace of the Holy, let your mind be imbued with the Lord's Love. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jin too(n) keeaa tis kau jaan ||
english: Know the One who created you,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aagai daragah paavai maan ||
english: and in the world hereafter you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: man tan niramal hoi nihaal ||
english: Your mind and body will be immaculate and blissful;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੩॥
transliteration: rasanaa naam japat gopaal ||3||
english: chant the Name of the Lord of the Universe with your tongue. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mere deen daiaalaa ||
english: Grant Your Kind Mercy, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo kee man ma(n)gai ravaalaa ||
english: My mind begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: hohu daiaal dehu prabh daan ||
english: Be merciful, and bless me with this gift,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak jap jeevai prabh naam ||4||11||13||
english: that Nanak may live, chanting God's Name. ||4||11||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
