transliteration: dhoop deep sevaa gopaal ||
english: My incense and lamps are my service to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਬੰਦਨ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: anik baar ba(n)dan karataar ||
english: Time and time again, I humbly bow to the Creator.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee saran gahee sabh tiaag ||
english: I have renounced everything, and grasped the Sanctuary of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur suprasa(n)n bhae vadabhaag ||1||
english: By great good fortune, the Guru has become pleased and satisfied with me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗਾਈਐ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar gaaeeai gobi(n)d ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan dhan prabh kaa prabh kee ji(n)d ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My body and wealth belong to God; my soul belongs to God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਤ ਭਏ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: har gun ramat bhae aana(n)d ||
english: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I am in bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਖਸੰਦ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham pooran bakhasa(n)d ||
english: The Supreme Lord God is the Perfect Forgiver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jan sevaa laae ||
english: Granting His Mercy, He has linked His humble servants to His service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh met milaae ||2||
english: He has rid me of the pains of birth and death, and merged me with Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਇਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam ihu tat giaan ||
english: This is the essence of karma, righteous conduct and spiritual wisdom,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g japeeai har naam ||
english: to chant the Lord's Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣ ॥
transliteration: saagar tar bohith prabh charan ||
english: God's Feet are the boat to cross over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee prabh kaaran karan ||3||
english: God, the Inner-knower, is the Cause of causes. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: raakh leee apanee kirapaa dhaar ||
english: Showering His Mercy, He Himself has saved me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਭਾਗੇ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch doot bhaage bikaraal ||
english: The five hideous demons have run away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jooai janam na kabahoo haar ||
english: Do not lose your life in the gamble.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak kaa a(n)g keeaa karataar ||4||12||14||
english: The Creator Lord has taken Nanak's side. ||4||12||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੁਖ ਅਨਦ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa sukh anad karei ||
english: In His Mercy, He has blessed me with peace and bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲਕ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਿ ॥
transliteration: baalak raakh leee guradev ||
english: The Divine Guru has saved His child.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: prabh kirapaal daiaal goubi(n)d ||
english: God is kind and compassionate; He is the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਬਖਸਿੰਦ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sagale bakhasi(n)d ||1||
english: He forgives all beings and creatures. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: teree saran prabh deen daiaal ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O God, O Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham jap sadaa nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating on the Supreme Lord God, I am forever in ecstasy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੂਸਰ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh daiaal doosar koee naahee ||
english: There is no other like the Merciful Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar sarab samaahee ||
english: He is contained deep within each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: apane daas kaa halat palat savaarai ||
english: He embellishes His slave, here and hereafter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: patit paavan prabh birad tumhaarai ||2||
english: It is Your nature, God, to purify sinners. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧ ਕੋਟਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: aukhadh kot simar gobi(n)d ||
english: Meditation on the Lord of the Universe is the medicine to cure millions of illnesses.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਭਜੀਐ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: ta(n)t ma(n)t bhajeeai bhagava(n)t ||
english: My Tantra and Mantra is to meditate, to vibrate upon the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਮਿਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: rog sog mite prabh dhiaae ||
english: Illnesses and pains are dispelled, meditating on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man baa(n)chhat pooran phal paae ||3||
english: The fruits of the mind's desires are fulfilled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਦਇਆਰ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath daiaar ||
english: He is the Cause of causes, the All-powerful Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਹਾ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan mahaa beechaar ||
english: Contemplating Him is the greatest of all treasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak bakhas leee prabh aap ||
english: God Himself has forgiven Nanak;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਏਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੫॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa eko har jaap ||4||13||15||
english: forever and ever, he chants the Name of the One Lord. ||4||13||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu mere meet ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਚੀਤ ॥
transliteration: niramal hoi tumhaaraa cheet ||
english: Your consciousness shall become immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਮਿਟੈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan kee sabh mitai balaai ||
english: All the misfortunes of your mind and body shall be taken away,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਸਗਲਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dookh a(n)dheraa sagalaa jaai ||1||
english: and all your pain and darkness will be dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਤਰੀਐ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavat tareeai sa(n)saar ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, cross over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee paaeeai purakh apaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By great good fortune, one attains the Infinite Lord, the Primal Being. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jo jan karai keeratan gopaal ||
english: The Messenger of Death cannot even touch that humble being,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: tis kau pohi na sakai jamakaal ||
english: Who sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jag mahi aaiaa so paravaan ||
english: The Gurmukh realizes his Lord and Master;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh apanaa khasam pachhaan ||2||
english: His coming into this world is approved. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavai sa(n)t prasaad ||
english: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, by the Grace of the Saints;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਉਨਮਾਦ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh mitahi unamaad ||
english: his sexual desire, anger and madness are eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: sadaa hajoor jaan bhagava(n)t ||
english: He knows the Lord God to be ever-present.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਮੰਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: poore gur kaa pooran ma(n)t ||3||
english: This is the Perfect Teaching of the Perfect Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: har dhan khaat keee bha(n)daar ||
english: He earns the treasure of the Lord's wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: mil satigur sabh kaaj savaar ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, all his affairs are resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam ra(n)g sa(n)g jaagaa ||
english: He is awake and aware in the Love of the Lord's Name;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੬॥
transliteration: har charanee naanak man laagaa ||4||14||16||
english: O Nanak, his mind is attached to the Lord's Feet. ||4||14||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ॥
transliteration: bhav saagar bohith har charan ||
english: The Lord's Feet are the boat to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣ ॥
transliteration: simarat naam naahee phir maran ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he does not die again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਪੰਥ ॥
transliteration: har gun ramat naahee jam pa(n)th ||
english: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, he does not have to walk on the Path of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਹ ਮੰਥ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mahaa beechaar pa(n)ch dootah ma(n)th ||1||
english: Contemplating the Supreme Lord, the five demons are conquered. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: tau saranaaee pooran naath ||
english: I have entered Your Sanctuary, O Perfect Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੰਤ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਜਹਿ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)t apane kau deejahi haath ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please give Your hand to Your creatures. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
transliteration: simrit saasatr bed puraan ||
english: The Simritees, Shaastras, Vedas and Puraanas

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਖਿਆਣ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham kaa karahi vakhiaan ||
english: expound upon the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jogee jatee baisano raamadaas ||
english: The Yogis, celibates, Vaishnavs and followers of Ram Das

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਬਿਨਾਸ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mit naahee braham abinaas ||2||
english: cannot find the limits of the Eternal Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਿਵ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: karan palaah karahi siv dev ||
english: Shiva and the gods lament and moan,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥
transliteration: til nahee boojhahi alakh abhev ||
english: but they do not understand even a tiny bit of the unseen and unknown Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: prem bhagat jis aape dei ||
english: One whom the Lord Himself blesses with loving devotional worship,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jag mahi virale keee kei ||3||
english: is very rare in this world. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਿਛਹੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mohi niragun gun kichhahoo naahi ||
english: I am worthless, with absolutely no virtue at all;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sarab nidhaan teree drisatee maahi ||
english: all treasures are in Your Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੀਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: naanak deen jaachai teree sev ||
english: Nanak, the meek, desires only to serve You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੭॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa deejai guradev ||4||15||17||
english: Please be merciful, and grant him this blessing, O Divine Guru. ||4||15||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਲੀਆ ਧਰਤਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa leeaa dharat bidaarau ||
english: One who is cursed by the Saints, is thrown down on the ground.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਅਕਾਸ ਤੇ ਟਾਰਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dak akaas te taarau ||
english: The slanderer of the Saints is thrown down from the skies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਉ ਅਪਨੇ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kau raakhau apane jee naal ||
english: I hold the Saints close to my soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਉਧਾਰਉ ਤਤਖਿਣ ਤਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t udhaarau tatakhin taal ||1||
english: The Saints are saved instantaneously. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਜਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: soee sa(n)t j bhaavai raam ||
english: He alone is a Saint, who is pleasing to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t gobi(n)d kai ekai kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Saints, and God, have only one job to do. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਾਥ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai oopar dei prabh haath ||
english: God gives His hand to shelter the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai sa(n)g basai din raat ||
english: He dwells with His Saints, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸੰਤਹ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: saas saas sa(n)tah pratipaal ||
english: With each and every breath, He cherishes His Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਟਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kaa dokhee raaj te taal ||2||
english: He takes the power away from the enemies of the Saints. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kee ni(n)daa karahu na koi ||
english: Let no one slander the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo ni(n)dai tis kaa patan hoi ||
english: Whoever slanders them, will be destroyed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jis kau raakhai sirajanahaar ||
english: One who is protected by the Creator Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝਖ ਮਾਰਉ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jhakh maarau sagal sa(n)saar ||3||
english: cannot be harmed, no matter how much the whole world may try. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਾ ਭਇਆ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh apane kaa bhaiaa bisaas ||
english: I place my faith in my God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis kee raas ||
english: My soul and body all belong to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਉਪਜੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak kau upajee parateet ||
english: This is the faith which inspires Nanak:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਾਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਜੀਤਿ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੧੮॥
transliteration: manamukh haar guramukh sad jeet ||4||16||18||
english: the self-willed manmukhs will fail, while the Gurmukhs will always win. ||4||16||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨੀਰਿ ਨਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: naam nira(n)jan neer naraain ||
english: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is the Ambrosial Water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਲਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa simarat paap bilaain ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chanting it with the tongue, sins are washed away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
transliteration: naaraain sabh maahi nivaas ||
english: The Lord abides in everyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: naaraain ghat ghat paragaas ||
english: The Lord illumines each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਕਹਤੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naaraain kahate narak na jaahi ||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name, one does not fall into hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਗਲ ਫਲ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naaraain sev sagal phal paahi ||1||
english: Serving the Lord, all fruitful rewards are obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naaraain man maahi adhaar ||
english: Within my mind is the Support of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naaraain bohith sa(n)saar ||
english: The Lord is the boat to cross over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਕਹਤ ਜਮੁ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਲਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: naaraain kahat jam bhaag palaain ||
english: Chant the Lord's Name, and the Messenger of Death will run away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਦੰਤ ਭਾਨੇ ਡਾਇਣ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naaraain da(n)t bhaane daain ||2||
english: The Lord breaks the teeth of Maya, the witch. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਬਖਸਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: naaraain sad sad bakhasi(n)d ||
english: The Lord is forever and ever the Forgiver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਕੀਨੇ ਸੂਖ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: naaraain keene sookh ana(n)d ||
english: The Lord blesses us with peace and bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਕੀਨੋ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: naaraain pragat keeno parataap ||
english: The Lord has revealed His glory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਸੰਤ ਕੋ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naaraain sa(n)t ko maaee baap ||3||
english: The Lord is the mother and father of His Saint. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: naaraain saadhasa(n)g naraain ||
english: The Lord, the Lord, is in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਨਰਾਇਣ ਗਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: baara(n) baar naraain gaain ||
english: Time and time again, I sing the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਹੀ ॥
transliteration: basat agochar gur mil lahee ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, I have attained the incomprehensible object.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਗਹੀ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naaraain ot naanak daas gahee ||4||17||19||
english: Slave Nanak has grasped the Support of the Lord. ||4||17||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau raakhai raakhanahaar ||
english: One who is protected by the Protector Lord

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa a(n)g kare nira(n)kaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - the Formless Lord is on his side. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: maat garabh mahi agan na johai ||
english: In the mother's womb, the fire does not touch him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu na pohai ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment do not affect him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g japai nira(n)kaar ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he meditates on the Formless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kai muhi laagai chhaar ||1||
english: Dust is thrown into the faces of the slanderers. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕਵਚੁ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਸੰਨਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: raam kavach daas kaa sa(n)naahu ||
english: The Lord's protective spell is the armor of His slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੋਹਤ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: doot dusat tis pohat naahi ||
english: The wicked, evil demons cannot even touch him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo jo garab kare so jaai ||
english: Whoever indulges in egotistical pride, shall waste away to ruin.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰੀਬ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gareeb daas kee prabh saranaai ||2||
english: God is the Sanctuary of His humble slave. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo jo saran paiaa har raai ||
english: Whoever enters the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਅਪਣੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: so daas rakhiaa apanai ka(n)th laai ||
english: - He saves that slave, hugging him close in His embrace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: je ko bahut kare aha(n)kaar ||
english: Whoever takes great pride in himself,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੁਲਤਾ ਖਾਕੂ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ohu khin mahi rulataa khaakoo naal ||3||
english: in an instant, shall be like dust mixing with dust. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੋਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hai bhee saachaa hovanahaar ||
english: The True Lord is, and shall always be.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈਁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa jaaee(n) balihaar ||
english: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: apane daas rakhe kirapaa dhaar ||
english: Granting His Mercy, He saves His slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak ke prabh praan adhaar ||4||18||20||
english: God is the Support of Nanak's breath of life. ||4||18||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜ ਕਥਾ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
transliteration: acharaj kathaa mahaa anoop ||
english: Wondrous and beautiful is the description of the beauty of the Supreme Soul,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਤਮਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: praatamaa paarabraham kaa roop || rahaau ||
english: The Supreme Lord God. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬੂਢਾ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: naa ihu boodhaa naa ihu baalaa ||
english: He is not old; He is not young.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: naa is dookh nahee jam jaalaa ||
english: He is not in pain; He is not caught in Death's noose.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naa ihu binasai naa ihu jaai ||
english: He does not die; He does not go away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aad jugaadee rahiaa samaai ||1||
english: In the beginning, and throughout the ages, He is permeating everywhere. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਉਸਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਸੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: naa is usan nahee is seet ||
english: He is not hot; He is not cold.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: naa is dusaman naa is meet ||
english: He has no enemy; He has no friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਹਰਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: naa is harakh nahee is sog ||
english: He is not happy; He is not sad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh kichh is kaa ihu karanai jog ||2||
english: Everything belongs to Him; He can do anything. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naa is baap nahee is maaiaa ||
english: He has no father; He has no mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਹੋਤਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ihu apara(n)par hotaa aaiaa ||
english: He is beyond the beyond, and has always been so.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕਾ ਇਸੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: paap pu(n)n kaa is lep na laagai ||
english: He is not affected by virtue or vice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar sad hee jaagai ||3||
english: Deep within each and every heart, He is always awake and aware. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਇਕ ਸਕਤਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: teen gunaa ik sakat upaaiaa ||
english: From the three qualities, the one mechanism of Maya was produced.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa maaiaa taa kee hai chhaaiaa ||
english: The great Maya is only His shadow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: achhal achhed abhed daiaal ||
english: He is undeceivable, impenetrable, unfathomable and merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal sadaa kirapaal ||
english: He is merciful to the meek, forever compassionate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: taa kee gat mit kachhoo na paai ||
english: His state and limits cannot ever be known.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak taa kai bal bal jaai ||4||19||21||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||4||19||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d mahalaa 5 ||
english: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kai balihaarai jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kai sa(n)g raam gun gaau ||
english: Associating with the Saints, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਗਏ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad kilavikh sabh gae ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, all the sins are taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t saran vadabhaagee pae ||1||
english: By great good fortune, one finds the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: raam japat kachh bighan na viaapai ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, no obstacles will block your way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad apunaa prabh jaapai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, meditate on God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਬ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham jab hoi daiaal ||
english: When the Supreme Lord God becomes merciful,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਕਰੈ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo jan kee karai ravaal ||
english: he makes me the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh is tan te jaai ||
english: Sexual desire and anger leave his body,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam ratan vasai man aai ||2||
english: and the Lord, the jewel, comes to dwell in his mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਾਂ ਕਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam taa(n) kaa paravaan ||
english: Fruitful and approved is the life of one

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham nikat kar jaan ||
english: who knows the Supreme Lord God to be close.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: bhaai bhagat prabh keeratan laagai ||
english: One who is committed to loving devotional worship of God, and the Kirtan of His Praises,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa soiaa jaagai ||3||
english: awakens from the sleep of countless incarnations. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal jan kaa aadhaar ||
english: The Lord's Lotus Feet are the Support of His humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਰਉਂ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gun govi(n)d rau(n) sach vaapaar ||
english: To chant the Praises of the Lord of the Universe is the true trade.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: daas janaa kee manasaa poor ||
english: Please fulfill the hopes of Your humble slave.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak sukh paavai jan dhoor ||4||20||22||6||28||
english: Nanak finds peace in the dust of the feet of the humble. ||4||20||22||6||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag go(n)d asatapadeeaa mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Gond, Ashtpadheeyaa, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: kar namasakaar poore guradev ||
english: Humbly bow to the Perfect Divine Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਫਲ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: saphal moorat saphal jaa kee sev ||
english: Fruitful is His image, and fruitful is service to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee purakh bidhaataa ||
english: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aath pahar naam ra(n)g raataa ||1||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, he remains imbued with the love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: gur gobi(n)d guroo gopaal ||
english: The Guru is the Lord of the Universe, the Guru is the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: apane daas kau raakhanahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Saving Grace of His slaves. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ਉਮਰਾਉ ਪਤੀਆਏ ॥
transliteration: paatisaah saah umaraau pateeaae ||
english: He satisfies the kings, emperors and nobles.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dusat aha(n)kaaree maar pachaae ||
english: He destroys the egotistical villains.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kai mukh keeno rog ||
english: He puts illness into the mouths of the slanderers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar karai sabh log ||2||
english: All the people celebrate His victory. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kai man mahaa ana(n)d ||
english: Supreme bliss fills the minds of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਪਹਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t japahi guradeu bhagava(n)t ||
english: The Saints meditate on the Divine Guru, the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)gat ke mukh oojal bhae ||
english: The faces of His companions become radiant and bright.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਥਾਨ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੇ ਗਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sagal thaan ni(n)dak ke gae ||3||
english: The slanderers lose all places of rest. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਜਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: saas saas jan sadaa salaahe ||
english: With each and every breath, the Lord's humble slaves praise Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham gur beparavaahe ||
english: The Supreme Lord God and the Guru are care-free.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਮਿਟੇ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ॥
transliteration: sagal bhai mite jaa kee saran ||
english: All fears are eradicated, in His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਨਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak maar paae sabh dharan ||4||
english: Smashing all the slanderers, the Lord knocks them to the ground. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jan kee ni(n)daa karai na koi ||
english: Let no one slander the Lord's humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਸੋ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo karai so dukheeaa hoi ||
english: Whoever does so, will be miserable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar jan ek dhiaae ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, the Lord's humble servant meditates on Him alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮੂਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jamooaa taa kai nikat na jaae ||5||
english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach him. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jan niravair ni(n)dak aha(n)kaaree ||
english: The Lord's humble servant has no vengeance. The slanderer is egotistical.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jan bhal maanahi ni(n)dak vekaaree ||
english: The Lord's humble servant wishes well, while the slanderer dwells on evil.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਿਖਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sikh satiguroo dhiaaiaa ||
english: The Sikh of the Guru meditates on the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਰਕਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jan ubare ni(n)dak narak paaiaa ||6||
english: The Lord's humble servants are saved, while the slanderer is cast into hell. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sun saajan mere meet piaare ||
english: Listen, O my beloved friends and companions:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sat bachan varatahi har duaare ||
english: these words shall be true in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa kare s taisaa paae ||
english: As you plant, so shall you harvest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਕੀ ਜੜ ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: abhimaanee kee jaR sarapar jaae ||7||
english: The proud, egotistical person will surely be uprooted. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਧਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਧਰ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: needhariaa satigur dhar teree ||
english: O True Guru, You are the Support of the unsupported.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhahu jan keree ||
english: Be merciful, and save Your humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tis gur balihaaree ||
english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੨੯॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran paij savaaree ||8||1||29||
english: remembering Him in meditation, my honor has been saved. ||8||1||29||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag go(n)d baanee bhagataa kee || kabeer jee ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Gond, The Word Of The Devotees. Kabeer Jee, First House:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t milai kichh suneeai kaheeai ||
english: When you meet a Saint, talk to him and listen.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੈ ਅਸੰਤੁ ਮਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: milai asa(n)t masat kar raheeai ||1||
english: Meeting with an unsaintly person, just remain silent. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਬੋਲਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: baabaa bolanaa kiaa kaheeai ||
english: O father, if I speak, what words should I utter?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaise raam naam rav raheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Speak such words, by which you may remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਬੋਲੇ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan siu bole upakaaree ||
english: Speaking with the Saints, one becomes generous.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਸਿਉ ਬੋਲੇ ਝਖ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: moorakh siu bole jhakh maaree ||2||
english: To speak with a fool is to babble uselessly. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਤ ਬੋਲਤ ਬਢਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bolat bolat badhahi bikaaraa ||
english: By speaking and only speaking, corruption only increases.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin bole kiaa karahi beechaaraa ||3||
english: If I do not speak, what can the poor wretch do? ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਛੂਛਾ ਘਟੁ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer chhoochhaa ghat bolai ||
english: Says Kabeer, the empty pitcher makes noise,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: bhariaa hoi s kabahu na dolai ||4||1||
english: but that which is full makes no sound. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d ||
english: Gond:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਰੂ ਮਰੈ ਨਰੁ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naroo marai nar kaam na aavai ||
english: When a man dies, he is of no use to anyone.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਮਰੈ ਦਸ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pasoo marai das kaaj savaarai ||1||
english: But when an animal dies, it is used in ten ways. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
transliteration: apane karam kee gat mai kiaa jaanau ||
english: What do I know, about the state of my karma?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ ਬਾਬਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mai kiaa jaanau baabaa re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: What do I know, O Baba? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਾਡ ਜਲੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਲਕਰੀ ਕਾ ਤੂਲਾ ॥
transliteration: haad jale jaise lakaree kaa toolaa ||
english: His bones burn, like a bundle of logs;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੇਸ ਜਲੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਸ ਕਾ ਪੂਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kes jale jaise ghaas kaa poolaa ||2||
english: his hair burns like a bale of hay. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਨਰੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer tab hee nar jaagai ||
english: Says Kabeer, the man wakes up,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਮੂੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: jam kaa da(n)d moo(n)d mahi laagai ||3||2||
english: only when the Messenger of Death hits him over the head with his club. ||3||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d ||
english: Gond:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਕਾਸਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਹੈ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਰਹਾਇਲੇ ॥
transliteration: aakaas gagan paataal gagan hai chahu dis gagan rahaaile ||
english: The Celestial Lord is in the Akaashic ethers of the skies, the Celestial Lord is in the nether regions of the underworld; in the four directions, the Celestial Lord is pervading.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਘਟੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਗਗਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aanad mool sadaa purakhotam ghat binasai gagan na jaaile ||1||
english: The Supreme Lord God is forever the source of bliss. When the vessel of the body perishes, the Celestial Lord does not perish. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਓ ॥
transliteration: mohi bairaag bhaio ||
english: I have become sad,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਆਇ ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ihu jeeu aai kahaa gaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: wondering where the soul comes from, and where it goes. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਤਤੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਕੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch tat mil kaaiaa keenhee tat kahaa te keen re ||
english: The body is formed from the union of the five tatvas; but where were the five tatvas created?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਬਧ ਤੁਮ ਜੀਉ ਕਹਤ ਹੌ ਕਰਮਹਿ ਕਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਦੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karam badh tum jeeu kahat hau karamahi kin jeeu deen re ||2||
english: You say that the soul is tied to its karma, but who gave karma to the body? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਇ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har mahi tan hai tan mahi har hai sarab nira(n)tar soi re ||
english: The body is contained in the Lord, and the Lord is contained in the body. He is permeating within all.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਰੇ ॥੩॥੩॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer raam naam na chhodau sahaje hoi s hoi re ||3||3||
english: Says Kabeer, I shall not renounce the Lord's Name. I shall accept whatever happens. ||3||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag go(n)d baanee kabeer jeeu kee ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Gond, The Word Of Kabeer Jee, Second House:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭੁਜਾ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਭਿਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: bhujaa baa(n)dh bhilaa kar daario ||
english: They tied my arms, bundled me up, and threw me before an elephant.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤੀ ਕ੍ਰੋਪਿ ਮੂੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: hasatee krop moo(n)d mahi maario ||
english: The elephant driver struck him on the head, and infuriated him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤਿ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੈ ਚੀਸਾ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: hasat bhaag kai cheesaa maarai ||
english: But the elephant ran away, trumpeting,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: iaa moorat kai hau balihaarai ||1||
english: "I am a sacrifice to this image of the Lord." ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aahi mere thaakur tumaraa jor ||
english: O my Lord and Master, You are my strength.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਬਕਿਬੋ ਹਸਤੀ ਤੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaajee bakibo hasatee tor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Qazi shouted at the driver to drive the elephant on. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਹਾਵਤ ਤੁਝੁ ਡਾਰਉ ਕਾਟਿ ॥
transliteration: re mahaavat tujh daarau kaat ||
english: He yelled out, "O driver, I shall cut you into pieces.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸਹਿ ਤੁਰਾਵਹੁ ਘਾਲਹੁ ਸਾਟਿ ॥
transliteration: isahi turaavahu ghaalahu saat ||
english: Hit him, and drive him on!"

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤਿ ਨ ਤੋਰੈ ਧਰੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: hasat na torai dharai dhiaan ||
english: But the elephant did not move; instead, he began to meditate.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਵਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vaa kai ridai basai bhagavaan ||2||
english: The Lord God abides within his mind. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਅਪਰਾਧੁ ਸੰਤ ਹੈ ਕੀਨੑਾ ॥
transliteration: kiaa aparaadh sa(n)t hai keenhaa ||
english: What sin has this Saint committed,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਂਧਿ ਪੋਟ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥
transliteration: baa(n)dh pot ku(n)char kau deenhaa ||
english: that you have made him into a bundle and thrown him before the elephant?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਪੋਟ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ku(n)char pot lai lai namasakaarai ||
english: Lifting up the bundle, the elephant bows down before it.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝੀ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਜੀ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: boojhee nahee kaajee a(n)dhiaarai ||3||
english: The Qazi could not understand it; he was blind. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਬਾਰ ਪਤੀਆ ਭਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: teen baar pateeaa bhar leenaa ||
english: Three times, he tried to do it.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਅਜਹੂ ਨ ਪਤੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man kathor ajahoo na pateenaa ||
english: Even then, his hardened mind was not satisfied.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਮਰਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer hamaraa gobi(n)d ||
english: Says Kabeer, such is my Lord and Master.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: chauthe pad mahi jan kee ji(n)d ||4||1||4||
english: The soul of His humble servant dwells in the fourth state. ||4||1||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d ||
english: Gond:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਨਸੁ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਦੇਉ ॥
transliteration: naa ihu maanas naa ihu deu ||
english: It is not human, and it is not a god.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਤੀ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੇਉ ॥
transliteration: naa ihu jatee kahaavai seu ||
english: It is not called celibate, or a worshipper of Shiva.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾ ਅਵਧੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: naa ihu jogee naa avadhootaa ||
english: It is not a Yogi, and it is not a hermit.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਇ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਪੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naa is maai na kaahoo pootaa ||1||
english: It is not a mother, or anyone's son. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਕੌਨ ਬਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: iaa ma(n)dar mahi kaun basaaee ||
english: Then what is it, which dwells in this temple of the body?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taa kaa a(n)t na kooo paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: No one can find its limits. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਨਾ ਓਦਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: naa ihu girahee naa odaasee ||
english: It is not a house-holder, and it is not a renouncer of the world.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਨ ਭੀਖ ਮੰਗਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: naa ihu raaj na bheekh ma(n)gaasee ||
english: It is not a king, and it is not a beggar.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਨ ਰਕਤੂ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: naa is pi(n)d na rakatoo raatee ||
english: It has no body, no drop of blood.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨੁ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਖਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naa ihu brahaman naa ihu khaatee ||2||
english: It is not a Brahmin, and it is not a Kh'shaatriya. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਪਾ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: naa ihu tapaa kahaavai sekh ||
english: It is not called a man of austere self-discipline, or a Shaykh.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨ ਮਰਤਾ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: naa ihu jeevai na marataa dekh ||
english: It does not live, and it is not seen to die.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਰਤੇ ਕਉ ਜੇ ਕੋਊ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: is marate kau je kooo rovai ||
english: If someone cries over its death,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਰੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo rovai soee pat khovai ||3||
english: that person loses his honor. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੈ ਡਗਰੋ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad mai dagaro paaiaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have found the Path.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮਰਨੁ ਦੋਊ ਮਿਟਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jeevan maran dooo mitavaaiaa ||
english: Birth and death have both been erased.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਅੰਸੁ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer ihu raam kee a(n)s ||
english: Says Kabeer, this is formed of the same essence as the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਸ ਕਾਗਦ ਪਰ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਮੰਸੁ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: jas kaagad par mitai na ma(n)s ||4||2||5||
english: It is like the ink on the paper which cannot be erased. ||4||2||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d ||
english: Gond:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੂਟੇ ਤਾਗੇ ਨਿਖੁਟੀ ਪਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: toote taage nikhutee paan ||
english: The threads are broken, and the starch has run out.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਝਿਲਕਾਵਹਿ ਕਾਨ ॥
transliteration: duaar oopar jhilakaavahi kaan ||
english: Bare reeds glisten at the front door.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੂਚ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ਫੂਏ ਫਾਲ ॥
transliteration: kooch bichaare phooe phaal ||
english: The poor brushes are scattered in pieces.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਮੁੰਡੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਚਢਿਬੋ ਕਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: iaa mu(n)deeaa sir chadhibo kaal ||1||
english: Death has entered this shaven head. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮੁੰਡੀਆ ਸਗਲੋ ਦ੍ਰਬੁ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ihu mu(n)deeaa sagalo drab khoee ||
english: This shaven-headed mendicant has wasted all his wealth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਨਾਕ ਸਰ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aavat jaat naak sar hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: All this coming and going has irritated him. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਰੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਕੀ ਛੋਡੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: turee naar kee chhodee baataa ||
english: He has given up all talk of his weaving equipment.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਵਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam vaa kaa man raataa ||
english: His mind is attuned to the Lord's Name.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਰਿਕੀ ਲਰਿਕਨ ਖੈਬੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: larikee larikan khaibo naahi ||
english: His daughters and sons have nothing to eat,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਡੀਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧਾਪੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mu(n)deeaa anadin dhaape jaahi ||2||
english: while the shaven-headed mendicants night and day eat their fill. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਦੁਇ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਇਕ ਦੁਇ ਬਾਟ ॥
transliteration: ik dui ma(n)dar ik dui baat ||
english: One or two are in the house, and one or two more are on the way.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਾਥਰੁ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਖਾਟ ॥
transliteration: ham kau saathar un kau khaat ||
english: We sleep on the floor, while they sleep in the beds.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੂਡ ਪਲੋਸਿ ਕਮਰ ਬਧਿ ਪੋਥੀ ॥
transliteration: mood palos kamar badh pothee ||
english: They rub their bare heads, and carry prayer-books in their waist-bands.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕਉ ਚਾਬਨੁ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਰੋਟੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ham kau chaaban un kau rotee ||3||
english: We get dry grains, while they get loaves of bread. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਡੀਆ ਮੁੰਡੀਆ ਹੂਏ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)deeaa mu(n)deeaa hooe ek ||
english: He will become one of these shaven-headed mendicants.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮੁੰਡੀਆ ਬੂਡਤ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: e mu(n)deeaa boodat kee tek ||
english: They are the support of the drowning.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਅੰਧਲੀ ਲੋਈ ਬੇਪੀਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sun a(n)dhalee loee bepeer ||
english: Listen, O blind and unguided Loi:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਨੑ ਮੁੰਡੀਅਨ ਭਜਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਕਬੀਰ ॥੪॥੩॥੬॥
transliteration: inh mu(n)deean bhaj saran kabeer ||4||3||6||
english: Kabeer has taken shelter with these shaven-headed mendicants. ||4||3||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d ||
english: Gond:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: khasam marai tau naar na rovai ||
english: When her husband dies, the woman does not cry.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਸੁ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ਅਉਰੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: us rakhavaaraa auro hovai ||
english: Someone else becomes her protector.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: rakhavaare kaa hoi binaas ||
english: When this protector dies,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਨਰਕੁ ਈਹਾ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aagai narak eehaa bhog bilaas ||1||
english: he falls into the world of hell hereafter, for the sexual pleasures he enjoyed in this world. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ek suhaagan jagat piaaree ||
english: The world loves only the one bride, Maya.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagale jee ja(n)t kee naaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: She is the wife of all beings and creatures. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਗਲਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sohaagan gal sohai haar ||
english: With her necklace around her neck, this bride looks beautiful.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kau bikh bigasai sa(n)saar ||
english: She is poison to the Saint, but the world is delighted with her.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਹੈ ਪਖਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kar seegaar bahai pakhiaaree ||
english: Adorning herself, she sits like a prostitute.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਠਿਠਕੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kee thithakee phirai bichaaree ||2||
english: Cursed by the Saints, she wanders around like a wretch. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਭਾਗਿ ਓਹ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t bhaag oh paachhai parai ||
english: She runs around, chasing after the Saints.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਾਰਹੁ ਡਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee maarahu darai ||
english: She is afraid of being beaten by those blessed with the Guru's Grace.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਓਹ ਪਿੰਡ ਪਰਾਇਣਿ ॥
transliteration: saakat kee oh pi(n)d paraain ||
english: She is the body, the breath of life, of the faithless cynics.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਖਿ ਡਾਇਣਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ham kau drisat parai trakh daain ||3||
english: She appears to me like a blood-thirsty witch. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਬਹੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਭੇਉ ॥
transliteration: ham tis kaa bahu jaaniaa bheu ||
english: I know her secrets well

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹੂਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ॥
transliteration: jab hooe kripaal mile guradeu ||
english: in His Mercy, the Divine Guru met me.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer ab baahar paree ||
english: Says Kabeer, now I have thrown her out.

author: Bhagat Kabir
transliteration: sa(n)saarai kai a(n)chal laree ||4||4||7||
english: She clings to the skirt of the world. ||4||4||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d ||
english: Gond:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: grihi sobhaa jaa kai re naahi ||
english: When someone's household has no glory,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਪਹੀਆ ਖੂਧੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aavat paheeaa khoodhe jaahi ||
english: the guests who come there depart still hungry.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਵਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
transliteration: vaa kai a(n)tar nahee sa(n)tokh ||
english: Deep within, there is no contentment.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਦੋਖੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin sohaagan laagai dokh ||1||
english: Without his bride, the wealth of Maya, he suffers in pain. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਪਵੀਤ ॥
transliteration: dhan sohaagan mahaa paveet ||
english: So praise this bride, which can shake the consciousness

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਪੇ ਤਪੀਸਰ ਡੋਲੈ ਚੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tape tapeesar dolai cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Of even the most dedicated ascetics and sages. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਤੀ ॥
transliteration: sohaagan kirapan kee pootee ||
english: This bride is the daughter of a wretched miser.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਤਜਿ ਜਗਤ ਸਿਉ ਸੂਤੀ ॥
transliteration: sevak taj jagat siu sootee ||
english: Abandoning the Lord's servant, she sleeps with the world.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਠਾਢੀ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo kai thaadhee darabaar ||
english: Standing at the door of the holy man,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saran teree mo kau nisataar ||2||
english: she says, "I have come to your sanctuary; now save me!" ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sohaagan hai at su(n)daree ||
english: This bride is so beautiful.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਗ ਨੇਵਰ ਛਨਕ ਛਨਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pag nevar chhanak chhanaharee ||
english: The bells on her ankles make soft music.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਊ ਲਗੁ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
transliteration: jau lag praan taoo lag sa(n)ge ||
english: As long as there is the breath of life in the man, she remains attached to him.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਚਲੀ ਬੇਗਿ ਉਠਿ ਨੰਗੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naahi ta chalee beg uth na(n)ge ||3||
english: But when it is no more, she quickly gets up and departs, bare-footed. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sohaagan bhavan trai leeaa ||
english: This bride has conquered the three worlds.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਤੀਰਥ ਰਸ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: das ath puraan teerath ras keeaa ||
english: The eighteen Puraanas and the sacred shrines of pilgrimage love her as well.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸਰ ਬੇਧੇ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahesar bedhe ||
english: She pierced the hearts of Brahma, Shiva and Vishnu.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਡੇ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਹੈ ਛੇਧੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bade bhoopat raaje hai chhedhe ||4||
english: She destroyed the great emperors and kings of the world. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sohaagan uravaar na paar ||
english: This bride has no restraint or limits.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚ ਨਾਰਦ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਧਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: paa(n)ch naarad kai sa(n)g bidhavaar ||
english: She is in collusion with the five thieving passions.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚ ਨਾਰਦ ਕੇ ਮਿਟਵੇ ਫੂਟੇ ॥
transliteration: paa(n)ch naarad ke mitave phoote ||
english: When the clay pot of these five passions bursts,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੫॥੫॥੮॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer gur kirapaa chhoote ||5||5||8||
english: then, says Kabeer, by Guru's Mercy, one is released. ||5||5||8||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d ||
english: Gond:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਬਲਹਰ ਨਾ ਠਾਹਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jaise ma(n)dar mahi balahar naa thaaharai ||
english: As the house will not stand when the supporting beams are removed from within it,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa kaise paar utarai ||
english: just so, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can anyone be carried across?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਨਾ ਟੀਕਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ku(n)bh binaa jal naa teekaavai ||
english: Without the pitcher, the water is not contained;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਐਸੇ ਅਬਗਤੁ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhoo bin aise abagat jaavai ||1||
english: just so, without the Holy Saint, the mortal departs in misery. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾਰਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਜੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ॥
transliteration: jaarau tisai j raam na chetai ||
english: One who does not remember the Lord - let him burn;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਰਮਤ ਰਹੈ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਤੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan man ramat rahai mahi khetai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: his body and mind have remained absorbed in this field of the world. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਹਲਹਰ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਿਮੀ ਨਹੀ ਬੋਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jaise halahar binaa jimee nahee boeeai ||
english: Without a farmer, the land is not planted;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੂਤ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਣੀ ਪਰੋਈਐ ॥
transliteration: soot binaa kaise manee paroeeai ||
english: without a thread, how can the beads be strung?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘੁੰਡੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਗੰਠਿ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: ghu(n)dee bin kiaa ga(n)th chaRhaaeeai ||
english: Without a loop, how can the knot be tied?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੈਸੇ ਅਬਗਤੁ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhoo bin taise abagat jaaeeai ||2||
english: Just so, without the Holy Saint, the mortal departs in misery. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jaise maat pitaa bin baal na hoee ||
english: Without a mother or father there is no child;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿੰਬ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਕਪਰੇ ਧੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bi(n)b binaa kaise kapare dhoee ||
english: just so, without water, how can the clothes be washed?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘੋਰ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਅਸਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ghor binaa kaise asavaar ||
english: Without a horse, how can there be a rider?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਰਵਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhoo bin naahee daravaar ||3||
english: Without the Holy Saint, one cannot reach the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਜੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jaise baaje bin nahee leejai pheree ||
english: Just as without music, there is no dancing,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮਿ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਤਜਿ ਅਉਹੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: khasam duhaagan taj auheree ||
english: the bride rejected by her husband is dishonored.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਏਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kahai kabeer ekai kar karanaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, do this one thing:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
transliteration: guramukh hoi bahur nahee maranaa ||4||6||9||
english: become Gurmukh, and you shall never die again. ||4||6||9||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d ||
english: Gond:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੂਟਨੁ ਸੋਇ ਜੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਕੂਟੈ ॥
transliteration: kootan soi j man kau kootai ||
english: He alone is a pimp, who pounds down his mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੂਟੈ ਤਉ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
transliteration: man kootai tau jam te chhootai ||
english: Pounding down his mind, he escapes from the Messenger of Death.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੁਟਿ ਕੁਟਿ ਮਨੁ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kut kut man kasavatee laavai ||
english: Pounding and beating his mind, he puts it to the test;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕੂਟਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so kootan mukat bahu paavai ||1||
english: such a pimp attains total liberation. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੂਟਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਹਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kootan kisai kahahu sa(n)saar ||
english: Who is called a pimp in this world?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਬੋਲਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal bolan ke maahi beechaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In all speech, one must carefully consider. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਚਨੁ ਸੋਇ ਜੁ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਚੈ ॥
transliteration: naachan soi j man siu naachai ||
english: He alone is a dancer, who dances with his mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਿ ਨ ਪਤੀਐ ਪਰਚੈ ਸਾਚੈ ॥
transliteration: jhooth na pateeai parachai saachai ||
english: The Lord is not satisfied with falsehood; He is pleased only with Truth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਆਗੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: is man aage poorai taal ||
english: So play the beat of the drum in the mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਨਾਚਨ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਰਖਵਾਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: is naachan ke man rakhavaal ||2||
english: The Lord is the Protector of the dancer with such a mind. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਜਾਰੀ ਸੋ ਜੁ ਬਜਾਰਹਿ ਸੋਧੈ ॥
transliteration: bajaaree so j bajaarahi sodhai ||
english: She alone is a street-dancer, who cleanses her body-street,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚ ਪਲੀਤਹ ਕਉ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ॥
transliteration: paa(n)ch paleetah kau parabodhai ||
english: and educates the five passions.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਾਇਕ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: nau naaik kee bhagat pachhaanai ||
english: She who embraces devotional worship for the Lord

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so baajaaree ham gur maane ||3||
english: - I accept such a street-dancer as my Guru. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਸਕਰੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿ ਤਾਤਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: tasakar soi j taat na karai ||
english: He alone is a thief, who is above envy,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕੈ ਜਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: i(n)dree kai jatan naam ucharai ||
english: and who uses his sense organs to chant the Lord's Name.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਮ ਐਸੇ ਲਖਨ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer ham aise lakhan ||
english: Says Kabeer, these are the qualities of the one

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਅਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਬਿਚਖਨ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੦॥
transliteration: dha(n)n guradev at roop bichakhan ||4||7||10||
english: I know as my Blessed Divine Guru, who is the most beautiful and wise. ||4||7||10||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d ||
english: Gond:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n gupaal dha(n)n guradev ||
english: Blessed is the Lord of the World. Blessed is the Divine Guru.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਭੂਖੇ ਕਵਲੁ ਟਹਕੇਵ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n anaad bhookhe kaval tahakev ||
english: Blessed is that grain, by which the heart-lotus of the hungry blossoms forth.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਓਇ ਸੰਤ ਜਿਨ ਐਸੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: dhan oi sa(n)t jin aisee jaanee ||
english: Blessed are those Saints, who know this.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਬੋ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin kau milibo saari(n)gapaanee ||1||
english: Meeting with them, one meets the Lord, the Sustainer of the World. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: aad purakh te hoi anaad ||
english: This grain comes from the Primal Lord God.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਨ ਕੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: japeeai naam a(n)n kai saad ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, only when he tastes this grain. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਨੁ ॥
transliteration: japeeai naam japeeai a(n)n ||
english: Meditate on the Naam, and meditate on this grain.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅੰਭੈ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੀਕਾ ਵੰਨੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)bhai kai sa(n)g neekaa va(n)n ||
english: Mixed with water, its taste becomes sublime.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜੋ ਨਰ ਹੋਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)nai baahar jo nar hovahi ||
english: One who abstains from this grain,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਖੋਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: teen bhavan mahi apanee khovahi ||2||
english: loses his honor in the three worlds. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਹਿ ਅੰਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ॥
transliteration: chhodahi a(n)n karahi paakha(n)d ||
english: One who discards this grain, is practicing hypocrisy.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਨਾ ਓਹਿ ਰੰਡ ॥
transliteration: naa sohaagan naa ohi ra(n)d ||
english: She is neither a happy soul-bride, nor a widow.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਕਤੇ ਦੂਧਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jag mahi bakate doodhaadhaaree ||
english: Those who claim in this world that they live on milk alone,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤੀ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਵਟਿਕਾ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gupatee khaavahi vatikaa saaree ||3||
english: secretly eat whole loads of food. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੈ ਬਿਨਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)nai binaa na hoi sukaal ||
english: Without this grain, time does not pass in peace.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿਐ ਅੰਨਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਪਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: tajiai a(n)n na milai gupaal ||
english: Forsaking this grain, one does not meet the Lord of the World.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਮ ਐਸੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer ham aise jaaniaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, this I know:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੧॥
transliteration: dha(n)n anaad thaakur man maaniaa ||4||8||11||
english: blessed is that grain, which brings faith in the Lord and Master to the mind. ||4||8||11||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag go(n)d baanee naamadeu jee kee ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Gond, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, First House:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਸੁਮੇਧ ਜਗਨੇ ॥
transliteration: asumedh jagane ||
english: The ritual sacrifice of horses,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤੁਲਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: tulaa purakh daane ||
english: giving one's weight in gold to charities,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਗ ਇਸਨਾਨੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: praag isanaane ||1||
english: and ceremonial cleansing baths -||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਨ ਪੁਜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: tau na pujahi har keerat naamaa ||
english: These are not equal to singing the Praises of the Lord's Name.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਭਜੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਆਲਸੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: apune raamahi bhaj re man aalaseeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditate on your Lord, you lazy man! ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗਇਆ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਭਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gaiaa pi(n)d bharataa ||
english: Offering sweet rice at Gaya,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਨਾਰਸਿ ਅਸਿ ਬਸਤਾ ॥
transliteration: banaaras as basataa ||
english: living on the river banks at Benares,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਬੇਦ ਚਤੁਰ ਪੜਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mukh bed chatur paRataa ||2||
english: reciting the four Vedas by heart;||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਅਛਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal dharam achhitaa ||
english: Completing all religious rituals,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gur giaan i(n)dree driRataa ||
english: restraining sexual passion by the spiritual wisdom given by the Guru,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਰਹਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khat karam sahit rahataa ||3||
english: and performing the six rituals;||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵਾ ਸਕਤਿ ਸੰਬਾਦੰ ॥
transliteration: sivaa sakat sa(n)baada(n) ||
english: Expounding on Shiva and Shakti

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਛੋਡਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਭੇਦੰ ॥
transliteration: man chhod chhod sagal bheda(n) ||
english: O man, renounce and abandon all these things.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੰ ॥
transliteration: simar simar gobi(n)da(n) ||
english: Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਨਾਮਾ ਤਰਸਿ ਭਵ ਸਿੰਧੰ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: bhaj naamaa taras bhav si(n)dha(n) ||4||1||
english: Meditate, O Naam Dayv, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d ||
english: Gond:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਦ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਮਿਰਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naad bhrame jaise miragaae ||
english: The deer is lured by the sound of the hunter's bell;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਜੇ ਵਾ ਕੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: praan taje vaa ko dhiaan na jaae ||1||
english: it loses its life, but it cannot stop thinking about it. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਰਾਮਾ ਐਸੇ ਹੇਰਉ ॥
transliteration: aise raamaa aise herau ||
english: In the same way, I look upon my Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਫੇਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam chhod chit anat na pherau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I will not abandon my Lord, and turn my thoughts to another. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨਾ ਹੇਰੈ ਪਸੂਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jiu meenaa herai pasooaaraa ||
english: As the fisherman looks upon the fish,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੋਨਾ ਗਢਤੇ ਹਿਰੈ ਸੁਨਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sonaa gadhate hirai sunaaraa ||2||
english: and the goldsmith looks upon the gold he fashions;||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਿਖਈ ਹੇਰੈ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jiu bikhaee herai par naaree ||
english: As the man driven by sex looks upon another man's wife,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਉਡਾ ਡਾਰਤ ਹਿਰੈ ਜੁਆਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaudaa daarat hirai juaaree ||3||
english: and the gambler looks upon the throwing of the dice -||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: jah jah dekhau tah tah raamaa ||
english: In the same way, wherever Naam Dayv looks, he sees the Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: har ke charan nit dhiaavai naamaa ||4||2||
english: Naam Dayv meditates continuously on the Feet of the Lord. ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d ||
english: Gond:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਤਾਰਿ ਲੇ ਰਾਮਾ ਤਾਰਿ ਲੇ ॥
transliteration: mo kau taar le raamaa taar le ||
english: Carry me across, O Lord, carry me across.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅਜਾਨੁ ਜਨੁ ਤਰਿਬੇ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ਬਾਪ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਬਾਹ ਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mai ajaan jan taribe na jaanau baap beethulaa baah de ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am ignorant, and I do not know how to swim. O my Beloved Father, please give me Your arm. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਰ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਤ ਨਿਮਖ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਖਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: nar te sur hoi jaat nimakh mai satigur budh sikhalaaee ||
english: I have been transformed from a mortal being into an angel, in an instant; the True Guru has taught me this.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿ ਸੁਰਗ ਕਉ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਸੋ ਅਵਖਧ ਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nar te upaj surag kau jeetio so avakhadh mai paaee ||1||
english: Born of human flesh, I have conquered the heavens; such is the medicine I was given. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਧੂਅ ਨਾਰਦੁ ਟੇਕੇ ਨੈਕੁ ਟਿਕਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jahaa jahaa dhoo naarad teke naik tikaavahu mohi ||
english: Please place me where You placed Dhroo and Naarad, O my Master.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਵਿਲੰਬਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਨ ਉਧਰੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਕੀ ਨਿਜ ਮਤਿ ਏਹ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: tere naam avila(n)b bahut jan udhare naame kee nij mat eh ||2||3||
english: With the Support of Your Name, so many have been saved; this is Naam Dayv's understanding. ||2||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d ||
english: Gond:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਲਾਗਤੀ ਤਾਲਾਬੇਲੀ ॥
transliteration: mohi laagatee taalaabelee ||
english: I am restless and unhappy.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਛਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਾਇ ਅਕੇਲੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bachhare bin gaai akelee ||1||
english: Without her calf, the cow is lonely. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਾਨੀਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨੁ ਤਲਫੈ ॥
transliteration: paaneeaa bin meen talaphai ||
english: Without water, the fish writhes in pain.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਪੁਰੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aise raam naamaa bin baapuro naamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: So is poor Naam Dayv without the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਗਾਇ ਕਾ ਬਾਛਾ ਛੂਟਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jaise gaai kaa baachhaa chhootalaa ||
english: Like the cow's calf, which, when let loose,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਥਨ ਚੋਖਤਾ ਮਾਖਨੁ ਘੂਟਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: than chokhataa maakhan ghootalaa ||2||
english: sucks at her udders and drinks her milk -||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naamadeu naaraain paaiaa ||
english: So has Naam Dayv found the Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur bhetat alakh lakhaaiaa ||3||
english: Meeting the Guru, I have seen the Unseen Lord. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਹੇਤ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jaise bikhai het par naaree ||
english: As the man driven by sex wants another man's wife,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aise naame preet muraaree ||4||
english: so does Naam Dayv love the Lord. ||4||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਾਪਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਘਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: jaise taapate niramal ghaamaa ||
english: As the earth burns in the dazzling sunlight,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਪੁਰੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੫॥੪॥
transliteration: taise raam naamaa bin baapuro naamaa ||5||4||
english: so does poor Naam Dayv burn without the Lord's Name. ||5||4||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag go(n)d baanee naamadeu jeeu kee ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Gond, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, Second House:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: har har karat mite sabh bharamaa ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, all doubts are dispelled.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਊਤਮ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: har ko naam lai ootam dharamaa ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord is the highest religion.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har har karat jaat kul haree ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, erases social classes and ancestral pedigrees.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕੀ ਲਾਕਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so har a(n)dhule kee laakaree ||1||
english: The Lord is the walking stick of the blind. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਏ ਨਮਸਤੇ ਹਰਏ ਨਮਹ ॥
transliteration: harae namasate harae namah ||
english: I bow to the Lord, I humbly bow to the Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਮਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har karat nahee dukh jamah ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, you will not be tormented by the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਨਾਕਸ ਹਰੇ ਪਰਾਨ ॥
transliteration: har haranaakas hare paraan ||
english: The Lord took the life of Harnaakhash,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਜੈਮਲ ਕੀਓ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਹਿ ਥਾਨ ॥
transliteration: ajaimal keeo baiku(n)thahi thaan ||
english: and gave Ajaamal a place in heaven.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੂਆ ਪੜਾਵਤ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਤਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sooaa paRaavat ganikaa taree ||
english: Teaching a parrot to speak the Lord's Name, Ganika the prostitute was saved.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਕੀ ਪੂਤਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so har nainahu kee pootaree ||2||
english: That Lord is the light of my eyes. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਪੂਤਨਾ ਤਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har har karat pootanaa taree ||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Pootna was saved,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਘਾਤਨੀ ਕਪਟਹਿ ਭਰੀ ॥
transliteration: baal ghaatanee kapatahi bharee ||
english: even though she was a deceitful child-killer.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਨ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਦ ਸੁਤ ਉਧਰੀ ॥
transliteration: simaran dropad sut udharee ||
english: Contemplating the Lord, Dropadi was saved.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗਊਤਮ ਸਤੀ ਸਿਲਾ ਨਿਸਤਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gaootam satee silaa nisataree ||3||
english: Gautam's wife, turned to stone, was saved. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕੇਸੀ ਕੰਸ ਮਥਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kesee ka(n)s mathan jin keeaa ||
english: The Lord, who killed Kaysee and Kans,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਾਲੀ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jee daan kaalee kau deeaa ||
english: gave the gift of life to Kali.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਐਸੋ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pranavai naamaa aiso haree ||
english: Prays Naam Dayv, such is my Lord;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਭੈ ਅਪਦਾ ਟਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
transliteration: jaas japat bhai apadaa taree ||4||1||5||
english: meditating on Him, fear and suffering are dispelled. ||4||1||5||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d ||
english: Gond:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਭੂਤ ਸੀਤਲਾ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bhairau bhoot seetalaa dhaavai ||
english: One who chases after the god Bhairau, evil spirits and the goddess of smallpox,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਖਰ ਬਾਹਨੁ ਉਹੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਉਡਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khar baahan uhu chhaar udaavai ||1||
english: is riding on a donkey, kicking up the dust. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਉ ਏਕੁ ਰਮਈਆ ਲੈਹਉ ॥
transliteration: hau tau ek ramaeeaa laihau ||
english: I take only the Name of the One Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਬਦਲਾਵਨਿ ਦੈਹਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aan dev badalaavan daihau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have given away all other gods in exchange for Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਕਰਤੇ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: siv siv karate jo nar dhiaavai ||
english: That man who chants "Shiva, Shiva", and meditates on him,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਰਦ ਚਢੇ ਡਉਰੂ ਢਮਕਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: barad chadhe dauroo dhamakaavai ||2||
english: is riding on a bull, shaking a tambourine. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮਾਈ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: mahaa maaee kee poojaa karai ||
english: One who worships the Great Goddess Maya
