author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਰ ਸੈ ਨਾਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nar sai naar hoi autarai ||3||
english: will be reincarnated as a woman, and not a man. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੀ ਆਦਿ ਭਵਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: too kaheeat hee aad bhavaanee ||
english: You are called the Primal Goddess.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੀ ਬਰੀਆ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਨੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: mukat kee bareeaa kahaa chhapaanee ||4||
english: At the time of liberation, where will you hide then? ||4||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: guramat raam naam gahu meetaa ||
english: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and hold tight to the Lord's Name, O friend.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਗੀਤਾ ॥੫॥੨॥੬॥
transliteration: pranavai naamaa iu kahai geetaa ||5||2||6||
english: Thus prays Naam Dayv, and so says the Gita as well. ||5||2||6||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਗੋਂਡ ॥
transliteration: bilaaval go(n)d ||
english: Bilaaval Gond:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੋ ਸਮਝਾਊ ਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aaj naame beethal dekhiaa moorakh ko samajhaaoo re || rahaau ||
english: Today, Naam Dayv saw the Lord, and so I will instruct the ignorant. ||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਲੋਧੇ ਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਖਾਤੀ ਥੀ ॥
transliteration: paa(n)de tumaree gaaitree lodhe kaa khet khaatee thee ||
english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, your Gayatri was grazing in the fields.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਕਰਿ ਠੇਗਾ ਟਗਰੀ ਤੋਰੀ ਲਾਂਗਤ ਲਾਂਗਤ ਜਾਤੀ ਥੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lai kar thegaa tagaree toree laa(n)gat laa(n)gat jaatee thee ||1||
english: Taking a stick, the farmer broke its leg, and now it walks with a limp. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਧਉਲੇ ਬਲਦ ਚੜਿਆ ਆਵਤੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਥਾ ॥
transliteration: paa(n)de tumaraa mahaadeu dhaule balad chaRiaa aavat dekhiaa thaa ||
english: O Pandit, I saw your great god Shiva, riding along on a white bull.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੋਦੀ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਖਾਣਾ ਪਾਕਾ ਵਾ ਕਾ ਲੜਕਾ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਥਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: modee ke ghar khaanaa paakaa vaa kaa laRakaa maariaa thaa ||2||
english: In the merchant's house, a banquet was prepared for him - he killed the merchant's son. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਰਾਮਚੰਦੁ ਸੋ ਭੀ ਆਵਤੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਥਾ ॥
transliteration: paa(n)de tumaraa raamacha(n)d so bhee aavat dekhiaa thaa ||
english: O Pandit, I saw your Raam Chand coming too

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਵਨ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਰਬਰ ਹੋਈ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਜੋਇ ਗਵਾਈ ਥੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raavan setee sarabar hoee ghar kee joi gavaaee thee ||3||
english: ; he lost his wife, fighting a war against Raawan. ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਅੰਨੑਾ ਤੁਰਕੂ ਕਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: hi(n)doo a(n)nhaa turakoo kaanaa ||
english: The Hindu is sightless; the Muslim has only one eye.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
transliteration: duhaa(n) te giaanee siaanaa ||
english: The spiritual teacher is wiser than both of them.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਪੂਜੈ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਮਸੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: hi(n)doo poojai dehuraa musalamaan maseet ||
english: The Hindu worships at the temple, the Muslim at the mosque.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਹ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਨ ਮਸੀਤਿ ॥੪॥੩॥੭॥
transliteration: naame soee seviaa jah dehuraa na maseet ||4||3||7||
english: Naam Dayv serves that Lord, who is not limited to either the temple or the mosque. ||4||3||7||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag go(n)d baanee ravidaas jeeu kee ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Gond, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee, Second House:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕੰਦ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: muka(n)d muka(n)d japahu sa(n)saar ||
english: Meditate on the Lord Mukanday, the Liberator, O people of the world.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਉਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bin muka(n)d tan hoi auhaar ||
english: Without Mukanday, the body shall be reduced to ashes.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: soee muka(n)d mukat kaa daataa ||
english: Mukanday is the Giver of liberation.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: soee muka(n)d hamaraa pit maataa ||1||
english: Mukanday is my father and mother. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮੁਕੰਦੇ ਮਰਤ ਮੁਕੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: jeevat muka(n)de marat muka(n)de ||
english: Meditate on Mukanday in life, and meditate on Mukanday in death.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taa ke sevak kau sadaa ana(n)de ||1|| rahaau ||
english: His servant is blissful forever. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕੰਦ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੰ ॥
transliteration: muka(n)d muka(n)d hamaare praana(n) ||
english: The Lord, Mukanday, is my breath of life.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਨੀਸਾਨੰ ॥
transliteration: jap muka(n)d masatak neesaana(n) ||
english: Meditating on Mukanday, one's forehead will bear the Lord's insignia of approval.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਕਰੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: sev muka(n)d karai bairaagee ||
english: The renunciate serves Mukanday.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ ਦੁਰਬਲ ਧਨੁ ਲਾਧੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: soee muka(n)d durabal dhan laadhee ||2||
english: Mukanday is the wealth of the poor and forlorn. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ ਕਰੈ ਉਪਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ek muka(n)d karai upakaar ||
english: When the One Liberator does me a favor,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hamaraa kahaa karai sa(n)saar ||
english: then what can the world do to me?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਟੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੂਏ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: metee jaat hooe darabaar ||
english: Erasing my social status, I have entered His Court.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਹੀ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗ ਤਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tuhee muka(n)d jog jug taar ||3||
english: You, Mukanday, are potent throughout the four ages. ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਉਪਜਿਓ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੂਆ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: upajio giaan hooaa paragaas ||
english: Spiritual wisdom has welled up, and I have been enlightened.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਕੀਟ ਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa leene keet daas ||
english: In His Mercy, the Lord has made this worm His slave.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਅਬ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਚੂਕੀ ॥
transliteration: kahu ravidaas ab trisanaa chookee ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, now my thirst is quenched;

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jap muka(n)d sevaa taahoo kee ||4||1||
english: I meditate on Mukanday the Liberator, and I serve Him. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
transliteration: go(n)d ||
english: Gond:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਓਹੁ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨੑਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je ohu athasath teerath nhaavai ||
english: Someone may bathe at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਓਹੁ ਦੁਆਦਸ ਸਿਲਾ ਪੂਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je ohu duaadas silaa poojaavai ||
english: and worship the twelve Shiva-lingam stones,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਓਹੁ ਕੂਪ ਤਟਾ ਦੇਵਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je ohu koop tataa devaavai ||
english: and dig wells and pools,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਰੈ ਨਿੰਦ ਸਭ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karai ni(n)d sabh birathaa jaavai ||1||
english: but if he indulges in slander, then all of this is useless. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saadh kaa ni(n)dak kaise tarai ||
english: How can the slanderer of the Holy Saints be saved?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਨਰਕ ਹੀ ਪਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarapar jaanahu narak hee parai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Know for certain, that he shall go to hell. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਓਹੁ ਗ੍ਰਹਨ ਕਰੈ ਕੁਲਖੇਤਿ ॥
transliteration: je ohu grahan karai kulakhet ||
english: Someone may bathe at Kuruk-shaytra during a solar eclipse,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਰਪੈ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਸਮੇਤਿ ॥
transliteration: arapai naar seegaar samet ||
english: and give his decorated wife in offering,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਸੁਨੈ ॥
transliteration: sagalee si(n)mrit sravanee sunai ||
english: and listen to all the Simritees,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਰੈ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਵਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਨੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karai ni(n)d kavanai nahee gunai ||2||
english: but if he indulges in slander, these are of no account. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਓਹੁ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je ohu anik prasaad karaavai ||
english: Someone may give countless feasts,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੰਡਪਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bhoom daan sobhaa ma(n)dap paavai ||
english: and donate land, and build splendid buildings;

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਗਾਰਿ ਬਿਰਾਂਨਾ ਸਾਂਢੈ ॥
transliteration: apanaa bigaar biraa(n)naa saa(n)dhai ||
english: he may neglect his own affairs to work for others,

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਰੈ ਨਿੰਦ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਹਾਂਢੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karai ni(n)d bahu jonee haa(n)dhai ||3||
english: but if he indulges in slander, he shall wander in countless incarnations. ||3||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa kahaa karahu sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Why do you indulge in slander, O people of the world?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਪਰਗਟਿ ਪਾਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak kaa paragat paahaaraa ||
english: The emptiness of the slanderer is soon exposed.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਸੋਧਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)dak sodh saadh beechaariaa ||
english: I have thought, and determined the fate of the slanderer.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
transliteration: kahu ravidaas paapee narak sidhaariaa ||4||2||11||7||2||49|| joR ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, he is a sinner; he shall go to hell. ||4||2||11||7||2||49|| Total||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ghar 1 chaupade ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਪੜਤਾ ਸਹਸਾਕਿਰਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਪੜੈ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: koee paRataa sahasaakirataa koee paRai puraanaa ||
english: Some read the Sanskrit scriptures, and some read the Puraanas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: koee naam japai japamaalee laagai tisai dhiaanaa ||
english: Some meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and chant it on their malas, focusing on it in meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਹੀ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ab hee kab hee kichhoo na jaanaa teraa eko naam pachhaanaa ||1||
english: I know nothing, now or ever; I recognize only Your One Name, Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਹਰੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਗਤੇ ॥
transliteration: na jaanaa hare meree kavan gate ||
english: I do not know, Lord, what my condition shall be.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਲਾਜ ਪਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham moorakh agiaan saran prabh teree kar kirapaa raakhahu meree laaj pate ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am foolish and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary, God. Please, save my honor and my self-respect. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਊਭਿ ਚੜਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo jeeaRaa oobh chaRat hai kabahoo jaai paiaale ||
english: Sometimes, the soul soars high in the heavens, and sometimes it falls to the depths of the nether regions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੀ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: lobhee jeeaRaa thir na rahat hai chaare ku(n)daa bhaale ||2||
english: The greedy soul does not remain stable; it searches in the four directions. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸਾਜਹਿ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maran likhaai ma(n)dal mahi aae jeevan saajahi maaee ||
english: With death pre-ordained, the soul comes into the world, gathering the riches of life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਤੀ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ek chale ham dekhah suaamee bhaahi bala(n)tee aaee ||3||
english: I see that some have already gone, O my Lord and Master; the burning fire is coming closer! ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਕਿਸੀ ਕਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਸੀ ਕਾ ਭਾਈ ਨਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: na kisee kaa meet na kisee kaa bhaaee naa kisai baap na maaee ||
english: No one has any friend, and no one has any brother; no one has any father or mother.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak je too devahi a(n)te hoi sakhaaee ||4||1||
english: Prays Nanak, if You bless me with Your Name, it shall be my help and support in the end. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਸਰਿ ਰਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sarab jot teree pasar rahee ||
english: Your Light is prevailing everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਨਰਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jah jah dekhaa tah naraharee ||1||
english: Wherever I look, there I see the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਤਲਬ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: jeevan talab nivaar suaamee ||
english: Please rid me of the desire to live, O my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਗਾਡਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਉਤਰਉ ਪਾਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop maaiaa man gaadiaa kiu kar utarau paar suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind is entangled in the deep dark pit of Maya. How can I cross over, O Lord and Master? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jah bheetar ghat bheetar basiaa baahar kaahe naahee ||
english: He dwells deep within, inside the heart; how can He not be outside as well?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਿੰਤ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin kee saar kare nit saahib sadaa chi(n)t man maahee ||2||
english: Our Lord and Master always takes care of us, and keeps us in His thoughts. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aape neRai aape door ||
english: He Himself is near at hand, and He is far away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aape sarab rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: He Himself is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satagur milai a(n)dheraa jaai ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, the darkness is dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah rahiaa samaai ||3||
english: Wherever I look, there I see Him pervading. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੈਣੀ ਲਾਗਸਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar sahasaa baahar maaiaa nainee laagas baanee ||
english: There is doubt within me, and Maya is outside; it hits me in the eyes like an arrow.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਪਰਤਾਪਹਿਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak daasan daasaa parataapahigaa praanee ||4||2||
english: Prays Nanak, the slave of the Lord's slaves: such a mortal suffers terribly. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਕਵਨੁ ਦਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਦਰਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jit dar vasahi kavan dar kaheeai daraa bheetar dar kavan lahai ||
english: Where is that door, where You live, O Lord? What is that door called? Among all doors, who can find that door?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਦਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਫਿਰਾ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਆਇ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis dar kaaran phiraa udaasee so dar koee aai kahai ||1||
english: For the sake of that door, I wander around sadly, detached from the world; if only someone would come and tell me about that door. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kin bidh saagar tareeai ||
english: How can I cross over the world-ocean?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਨਹ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jeevatiaa nah mareeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: While I am living, I cannot be dead. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ਰੋਹੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਦੁਇ ਪਟ ਜੜੇ ॥
transliteration: dukh daravaajaa rohu rakhavaalaa aasaa a(n)desaa dui pat jaRe ||
english: Pain is the door, and anger is the guard; hope and anxiety are the two shutters.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਜਲੁ ਖਾਈ ਪਾਣੀ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਸਤ ਕੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maaiaa jal khaaee paanee ghar baadhiaa sat kai aasan purakh rahai ||2||
english: Maya is the water in the moat; in the middle of this moat, he has built his home. The Primal Lord sits in the Seat of Truth. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿੰਤੇ ਨਾਮਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ki(n)te naamaa a(n)t na jaaniaa tum sar naahee avar hare ||
english: You have so many Names, Lord, I do not know their limit. There is no other equal to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: oochaa nahee kahanaa man mahi rahanaa aape jaanai aap kare ||3||
english: Do not speak out loud - remain in your mind. The Lord Himself knows, and He Himself acts. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਕਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jab aasaa a(n)desaa tab hee kiu kar ek kahai ||
english: As long as there is hope, there is anxiety; so how can anyone speak of the One Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aasaa bheetar rahai niraasaa tau naanak ek milai ||4||
english: In the midst of hope, remain untouched by hope; then, O Nanak, you shall meet the One Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: in bidh saagar tareeai ||
english: In this way, you shall cross over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਉ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jeevatiaa iu mareeai ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||3||
english: This is the way to remain dead while yet alive. ||1||Second Pause||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਖੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਬਾਜੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
transliteration: surat sabad saakhee meree si(n)ngee baajai lok sune ||
english: Awareness of the Shabad and the Teachings is my horn; the people hear the sound of its vibrations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ ਮੰਗਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pat jholee ma(n)gan kai taaee bheekhiaa naam paRe ||1||
english: Honor is my begging-bowl, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the charity I receive. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: baabaa gorakh jaagai ||
english: O Baba, Gorakh is the Lord of the Universe; He is always awake and aware.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੋਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gorakh so jin goi uthaalee karate baar na laagai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He alone is Gorakh, who sustains the earth; He created it in an instant. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪਵਣਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਏ ॥
transliteration: paanee praan pavan ba(n)dh raakhe cha(n)d sooraj mukh deee ||
english: Binding together water and air, He infused the breath of life into the body, and made the lamps of the sun and the moon.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਦੀਨੀ ਏਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਸਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maran jeevan kau dharatee deenee ete gun visare ||2||
english: To die and to live, He gave us the earth, but we have forgotten these blessings. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਪੀਰ ਪੁਰਸ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik ar jogee ja(n)gam peer puras bahutere ||
english: There are so many Siddhas, seekers, Yogis, wandering pilgrims, spiritual teachers and good people.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਾ ਤ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖਾ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je tin milaa ta keerat aakhaa taa man sev kare ||3||
english: If I meet them, I chant the Lord's Praises, and then, my mind serves Him. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਗਦੁ ਲੂਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਗੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਮਲੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: kaagad loon rahai ghrit sa(n)ge paanee kamal rahai ||
english: Paper and salt, protected by ghee, remain untouched by water, as the lotus remains unaffected in water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: aise bhagat milahi jan naanak tin jam kiaa karai ||4||4||
english: Those who meet with such devotees, O servant Nanak - what can death do to them? ||4||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਾਛਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: sun maachhi(n)draa naanak bolai ||
english: Listen, Machhindra, to what Nanak says.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਸਗਤਿ ਪੰਚ ਕਰੇ ਨਹ ਡੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: vasagat pa(n)ch kare nah dolai ||
english: One who subdues the five passions does not waver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੋਗ ਕਉ ਪਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: aisee jugat jog kau paale ||
english: One who practices Yoga in such a way,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aap tarai sagale kul taare ||1||
english: saves himself, and saves all his generations. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਅਉਧੂਤੁ ਐਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so audhoot aisee mat paavai ||
english: He alone is a hermit, who attains such understanding.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ahinis su(n)n samaadh samaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Day and night, he remains absorbed in deepest Samaadhi. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਚਲੈ ॥
transliteration: bhikhiaa bhaai bhagat bhai chalai ||
english: He begs for loving devotion to the Lord, and lives in the Fear of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਅਮੁਲੈ ॥
transliteration: hovai s tripat sa(n)tokh amulai ||
english: He is satisfied, with the priceless gift of contentment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਨ ਰੂਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਆਸਣੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dhiaan roop hoi aasan paavai ||
english: Becoming the embodiment of meditation, he attains the true Yogic posture.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sach naam taaRee chit laavai ||2||
english: He focuses his consciousness in the deep trance of the True Name. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak bolai a(n)mrit baanee ||
english: Nanak chants the Ambrosial Bani.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਾਛਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਅਉਧੂ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sun maachhi(n)draa audhoo neesaanee ||
english: Listen, O Machhindra: this is the insignia of the true hermit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਵਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aasaa maahi niraas valaae ||
english: One who, in the midst of hope, remains untouched by hope,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nihachau naanak karate paae ||3||
english: shall truly find the Creator Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak agam sunaae ||
english: Prays Nanak, I share the mysterious secrets of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਕੀ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur chele kee sa(n)dh milaae ||
english: The Guru and His disciple are joined together!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਖਿਆ ਦਾਰੂ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: deekhiaa daaroo bhojan khaai ||
english: One who eats this food, this medicine of the Teachings,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: chhi darasan kee sojhee paai ||4||5||
english: has the wisdom of the six Shaastras. ||4||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਡੋਲਤ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਪ ਭਰੀ ਹੈ ਪਵਣੁ ਲਗੈ ਮਤੁ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ham dolat beRee paap bharee hai pavan lagai mat jaaee ||
english: My boat is wobbly and unsteady; it is filled with sins. The wind is rising - what if it tips over?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਿਧ ਭੇਟਣ ਕਉ ਆਏ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sanamukh sidh bhetan kau aae nihachau dehi vadiaaee ||1||
english: As sunmukh, I have turned to the Guru; O my Perfect Master; please be sure to bless me with Your glorious greatness. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur taar taaranahaariaa ||
english: O Guru, my Saving Grace, please carry me across the world-ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਝ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dehi bhagat pooran avinaasee hau tujh kau balihaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Bless me with devotion to the perfect, imperishable Lord God; I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਜੋਗੀ ਅਰੁ ਜੰਗਮ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਧੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik jogee ar ja(n)gam ek sidh jinee dhiaaiaa ||
english: He alone is a Siddha, a seeker, a Yogi, a wandering pilgrim, who meditates on the One Perfect Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਸਤ ਪੈਰ ਸਿਝਤ ਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: parasat pair sijhat te suaamee akhar jin kau aaiaa ||2||
english: Touching the feet of the Lord Master, they are emancipated; they come to receive the Word of the Teachings. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam karam na jaanaa naam japee prabh teraa ||
english: I know nothing of charity, meditation, self-discipline or religious rituals; I only chant Your Name, God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੩॥੬॥
transliteration: gur paramesar naanak bhetio saachai sabad niberaa ||3||6||
english: Nanak has met the Guru, the Transcendent Lord God; through the True Word of His Shabad, he is set free. ||3||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਰਲਾਈਐ ਏਤੁ ॥
transliteration: suratee surat ralaaeeai et ||
english: Focus your consciousness in deep absorption on the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਲੰਘਹਿ ਜੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: tan kar tulahaa la(n)ghahi jet ||
english: Make your body a raft, to cross over.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਾਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੂ ਰਖੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar bhaahi tisai too rakh ||
english: Deep within is the fire of desire; keep it in check.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਲੈ ਅਥਕੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ahinis deevaa balai athak ||1||
english: Day and night, that lamp shall burn unceasingly. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਦੀਵਾ ਨੀਰਿ ਤਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa deevaa neer taraai ||
english: Float such a lamp upon the water;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦੀਵੈ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit deevai sabh sojhee paai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: this lamp will bring total understanding. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਛੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: hachhee mitee sojhee hoi ||
english: This understanding is good clay;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਮਾਨੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: taa kaa keeaa maanai soi ||
english: a lamp made of such clay is acceptable to the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਚਕਹੁ ਢਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: karanee te kar chakahu dhaal ||
english: So shape this lamp on the wheel of good actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aithai othai nibahee naal ||2||
english: In this world and in the next, this lamp shall be with you. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape nadar kare jaa soi ||
english: When He Himself grants His Grace,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koi ||
english: then, as Gurmukh, one may understand Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਦੀਵਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tit ghat deevaa nihachal hoi ||
english: Within the heart, this lamp is permanently lit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paanee marai na bujhaaiaa jaai ||
english: It is not extinguished by water or wind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਦੀਵਾ ਨੀਰਿ ਤਰਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aisaa deevaa neer taraai ||3||
english: Such a lamp will carry you across the water. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡੋਲੈ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dolai vaau na vadaa hoi ||
english: Wind does not shake it, or put it out.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਪੈ ਜਿਉ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਣਿ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaapai jiu si(n)ghaasan loi ||
english: Its light reveals the Divine Throne.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਕਿ ਵੈਸੁ ॥
transliteration: khatree braahaman sood k vais ||
english: The Kh'shaatriyas, Brahmins, Soodras and Vaishyas

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਗਣੀ ਸਹੰਸ ॥
transliteration: nirat na paaeeaa ganee saha(n)s ||
english: cannot find its value, even by thousands of calculations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਾਲੇ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa deevaa baale koi ||
english: If any of them lights such a lamp,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪਾਰੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak so paara(n)gat hoi ||4||7||
english: O Nanak, he is emancipated. ||4||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧਨੋ ਨਿਵਣੁ ਮੰਨਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tudhano nivan ma(n)nan teraa naau ||
english: To place one's faith in Your Name, Lord, is true worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਭੇਟ ਬੈਸਣ ਕਉ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saach bhet baisan kau thaau ||
english: With an offering of Truth, one obtains a place to sit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh hovai aradaas ||
english: If a prayer is offered with truth and contentment,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਦਿ ਬਹਾਲੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa sun sad bahaale paas ||1||
english: the Lord will hear it, and call him in to sit by Him. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak birathaa koi na hoi ||
english: O Nanak, no one returns empty-handed;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aisee daragah saachaa soi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: such is the Court of the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਪੋਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
transliteration: praapat potaa karam pasaau ||
english: The treasure I seek is the gift of Your Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too devahi ma(n)gat jan chaau ||
english: Please bless this humble beggar - this is what I seek.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਡੈ ਭਾਉ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaadai bhaau pavai tit aai ||
english: Please, pour Your Love into the cup of my heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਤੈ ਛੋਡੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhur tai chhodee keemat paai ||2||
english: This is Your pre-determined value. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jin kichh keeaa so kichh karai ||
english: The One who created everything, does everything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਧਰੈ ॥
transliteration: apanee keemat aape dharai ||
english: He Himself appraises His own value.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh paragat hoaa har raai ||
english: The Sovereign Lord King becomes manifest to the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naa ko aavai naa ko jaai ||3||
english: He does not come, and He does not go. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕੁ ਧਿਕਾਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਮਾਗਤ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: lok dhikaar kahai ma(n)gat jan maagat maan na paaiaa ||
english: People curse at the beggar; by begging, he does not receive honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹ ਕੀਆ ਗਲਾ ਦਰ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ ਤੈ ਤਾ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: sah keeaa galaa dar keeaa baataa tai taa kahan kahaaiaa ||4||8||
english: O Lord, You inspire me to speak Your Words, and tell the Story of Your Court. ||4||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਬੂੰਦ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: saagar mahi boo(n)d boo(n)d mahi saagar kavan bujhai bidh jaanai ||
english: The drop is in the ocean, and the ocean is in the drop. Who understands, and knows this?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਤਭੁਜ ਚਲਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੇ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: utabhuj chalat aap kar cheenai aape tat pachhaanai ||1||
english: He Himself creates the wondrous play of the world. He Himself contemplates it, and understands its true essence. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aisaa giaan beechaarai koee ||
english: How rare are those who contemplate this spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tis te mukat param gat hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through this, the supreme state of liberation is attained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਮਹਿ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: din mahi rain rain mahi dineear usan seet bidh soee ||
english: The night is in the day, and the day is in the night. The same is true of hot and cold.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa kee gat mit avar na jaanai gur bin samajh na hoee ||2||
english: No one else knows His state and extent; without the Guru, this is not understood. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: purakh mahi naar naar mahi purakhaa boojhahu braham giaanee ||
english: The female is in the male, and the male is in the female. Understand this, O God-realized being!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੁਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhun mahi dhiaan dhiaan mahi jaaniaa guramukh akath kahaanee ||3||
english: The meditation is in the music, and knowledge is in meditation. Become Gurmukh, and speak the Unspoken Speech. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man mahi jot jot mahi manooaa pa(n)ch mile gur bhaaee ||
english: The Light is in the mind, and the mind is in the Light. The Guru brings the five senses together, like brothers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak tin kai sad balihaaree jin ek sabad liv laaee ||4||9||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who enshrine love for the One Word of the Shabad. ||4||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa har prabh kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: When the Lord God showered His Mercy,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: taa haumai vichahu maaree ||
english: egotism was eradicated from within me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕਿ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: so sevak raam piaaree ||
english: That humble servant who contemplates the

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo gurasabadee beechaaree ||1||
english: Word of the Guru's Shabad, is very dear to the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so har jan har prabh bhaavai ||
english: That humble servant of the Lord is pleasing to his Lord God;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਲਾਜ ਛੋਡਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ahinis bhagat kare din raatee laaj chhod har ke gun gaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: day and night, he performs devotional worship, day and night. Disregarding his own honor, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੁਨਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਘੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dhun vaaje anahad ghoraa ||
english: The unstruck melody of the sound current resonates and resounds;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man maaniaa har ras moraa ||
english: my mind is appeased by the subtle essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai sach samaaiaa ||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, I am absorbed in Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur aad purakh har paaiaa ||2||
english: Through the Guru, I have found the Lord, the Primal Being. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਨਾਦ ਬੇਦ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh naad bed gurabaanee ||
english: Gurbani is the sound current of the Naad, the Vedas, everything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: man raataa saarigapaanee ||
english: My mind is attuned to the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਤਪ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tah teerath varat tap saare ||
english: He is my sacred shrine of pilgrimage, fasting and austere self-discipline.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur miliaa har nisataare ||3||
english: The Lord saves, and carries across, those who meet with the Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jah aap gaiaa bhau bhaagaa ||
english: One whose self-conceit is gone, sees his fears run away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: gur charanee sevak laagaa ||
english: That servant grasps the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur bharam chukaaiaa ||
english: The Guru, the True Guru, has expelled my doubts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sabad milaaiaa ||4||10||
english: Says Nanak, I have merged into the Word of the Shabad. ||4||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛਾਦਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਮਾਗਤੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: chhaadan bhojan maagat bhaagai ||
english: He runs around, begging for clothes and food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੁਧਿਆ ਦੁਸਟ ਜਲੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ॥
transliteration: khudhiaa dusat jalai dukh aagai ||
english: He burns with hunger and corruption, and will suffer in the world hereafter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਲੀਨੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramat nahee leenee duramat pat khoee ||
english: He does not follow the Guru's Teachings; through his evil-mindedness, he loses his honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramat bhagat paavai jan koee ||1||
english: Only through the Guru's Teachings will such a person become devoted. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੈ ॥
transliteration: jogee jugat sahaj ghar vaasai ||
english: The way of the Yogi is to dwell in the celestial home of bliss.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਏਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ek drisat eko kar dekhiaa bheekhiaa bhaai sabad tripataasai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He looks impartially, equally upon all. He receives the charity of the Lord's Love, and the Word of the Shabad, and so he is satisfied. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਬੈਲ ਗਡੀਆ ਦੇਹ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch bail gadeeaa deh dhaaree ||
english: The five bulls, the senses, pull the wagon of the body around.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕਲਾ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: raam kalaa nibahai pat saaree ||
english: By the Lord's power, one's honor is preserved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰ ਤੂਟੀ ਗਾਡੋ ਸਿਰ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dhar tootee gaado sir bhaar ||
english: But when the axle breaks, the wagon falls and crashes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਕਰੀ ਬਿਖਰਿ ਜਰੀ ਮੰਝ ਭਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: lakaree bikhar jaree ma(n)jh bhaar ||2||
english: It falls apart, like a pile of logs. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad veechaar jogee ||
english: Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, Yogi.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਓਗੀ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh sam karanaa sog biogee ||
english: Look upon pain and pleasure as one and the same, sorrow and separation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bhugat naam gur sabad beechaaree ||
english: Let your food be contemplative meditation upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕੰਧੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: asathir ka(n)dh japai nira(n)kaaree ||3||
english: Your wall shall be permanent, by meditating on the Formless Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਜਗੋਟਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
transliteration: sahaj jagotaa ba(n)dhan te chhootaa ||
english: Wear the loin-cloth of poise, and be free of entanglements.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਲੂਟਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh gurasabadee lootaa ||
english: The Guru's Word shall release you from sexual desire and anger.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: man mahi mu(n)draa har gur saranaa ||
english: In your mind, let your ear-rings be the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak raam bhagat jan taranaa ||4||11||
english: O Nanak, worshipping the Lord in deep devotion, the humble are carried across. ||4||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, Third Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: satajug sach kahai sabh koee ||
english: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone spoke the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ghar ghar bhagat guramukh hoee ||
english: In each and every home, devotional worship was performed by the people, according to the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਪੈਰ ਹੈ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satajug dharam pair hai chaar ||
english: In that Golden Age, Dharma had four feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh boojhai ko beechaar ||1||
english: How rare are those people who, as Gurmukh, contemplate this and understand. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jug chaare naam vadiaaee hoee ||
english: In all four ages, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glory and greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: j naam laagai so mukat hovai gur bin naam na paavai koee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who holds tight to the Naam is liberated; without the Guru, no one obtains the Naam. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਇਕ ਕਲ ਕੀਨੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tretai ik kal keenee door ||
english: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, one leg was removed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d varatiaa har jaanan door ||
english: Hypocrisy became prevalent, and people thought that the Lord was far away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh boojhai sojhee hoee ||
english: The Gurmukhs still understood and realized;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)tar naam vasai sukh hoee ||2||
english: the Naam abided deep within them, and they were at peace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: duaapur doojai dubidhaa hoi ||
english: In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, duality and double-mindedness arose.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bharam bhulaane jaanahi doi ||
english: Deluded by doubt, they knew duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਧਰਮਿ ਦੁਇ ਪੈਰ ਰਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: duaapur dharam dui pair rakhaae ||
english: In this Brass Age, Dharma was left with only two feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai ta naam driRaae ||3||
english: Those who became Gurmukh implanted the Naam deep within. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਧਰਮ ਕਲਾ ਇਕ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kalajug dharam kalaa ik rahaae ||
english: In the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, Dharma was left with only one power.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਪੈਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ik pair chalai maaiaa mohu vadhaae ||
english: It walks on just one foot; love and emotional attachment to Maya have increased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu at gubaar ||
english: Love and emotional attachment to Maya bring total darkness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: satagur bhetai naam udhaar ||4||
english: If someone meets the True Guru, he is saved, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh jug mahi saachaa eko soee ||
english: Throughout the ages, there is only the One True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi sach doojaa nahee koee ||
english: Among all, is the True Lord; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: saachee keerat sach sukh hoee ||
english: Praising the True Lord, true peace is attained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramukh naam vakhaanai koee ||5||
english: How rare are those, who as Gurmukh, chant the Naam. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh jug mahi naam ootam hoee ||
english: Throughout all the ages, the Naam is the ultimate, the most sublime.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koee ||
english: How rare are those, who as Gurmukh, understand this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har naam dhiaae bhagat jan soee ||
english: One who meditates on the Lord's Name is a humble devotee.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jug jug naam vadiaaee hoee ||6||1||
english: O Nanak, in each and every age, the Naam is glory and greatness. ||6||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je vadabhaag hovahi vadabhaagee taa har har naam dhiaavai ||
english: If someone is very fortunate, and is blessed with great high destiny, then he meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam japat naame sukh paavai har naame naam samaavai ||1||
english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he finds peace, and merges in the Naam. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat karahu sad praanee ||
english: O mortal, as Gurmukh, worship the Lord in devotion forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hiradai pragaas hovai liv laagai guramat har har naam samaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your heart shall be illumined; through the Guru's Teachings, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord. You shall merge in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੀਰਾ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: heeraa ratan javehar maanak bahu saagar bharapoor keeaa ||
english: The Great Giver is filled with diamonds, emeralds, rubies and pearls;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਡ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਢਿ ਕਢਿ ਲੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis vadabhaag hovai vad masatak tin guramat kadh kadh leeaa ||2||
english: one who has good fortune and great destiny inscribed upon his forehead, digs them out, by following the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਜਵੇਹਰੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਤਲੀ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ratan javehar laal har naamaa gur kaadh talee dikhalaaiaa ||
english: The Lord's Name is the jewel, the emerald, the ruby; digging it out, the Guru has placed it in your palm.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਹੀ ਲੀਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਓਲੈ ਲਾਖੁ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhaagaheen manamukh nahee leeaa trin olai laakh chhapaaiaa ||3||
english: The unfortunate, self-willed manmukh does not obtain it; this priceless jewel remains hidden behind a curtain of straw. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: masatak bhaag hovai dhur likhiaa taa satagur sevaa laae ||
english: If such pre-ordained destiny is written upon one's forehead, then the True Guru enjoins him to serve Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਪਾਵੈ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ratan javehar paavai dhan dhan guramat har paae ||4||1||
english: O Nanak, then he obtains the jewel, the gem; blessed, blessed is that one who follows the Guru's Teachings, and finds the Lord. ||4||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raam janaa mil bhaiaa ana(n)daa har neekee kathaa sunaai ||
english: Meeting with the humble servants of the Lord, I am in ecstasy; they preach the sublime sermon of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: duramat mail gaee sabh neekal satasa(n)gat mil budh paai ||1||
english: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away; joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, one is blessed with understanding. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੋਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raam jan guramat raam bolaai ||
english: O humble servant of the Lord, follow the Guru's Teachings, and chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਸੋਹਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo jo sunai kahai so mukataa raam japat sohaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whoever hears and speaks it is liberated; chanting the Lord's Name, one is embellished with beauty. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਭੇਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je vadabhaag hovahi mukh masatak har raam janaa bhetaai ||
english: If someone has supremely high destiny written on his forehead, the Lord leads him to meet the humble servants of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਭੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: darasan sa(n)t dehu kar kirapaa sabh daalad dukh lahi jaai ||2||
english: Be merciful, and grant me the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan, which shall rid me of all poverty and pain. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har ke log raam jan neeke bhaagaheen na sukhaai ||
english: The Lord's people are good and sublime; the unfortunate ones do not like them at all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਹਿ ਜਨ ਊਚੇ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਡੰਸੁ ਲਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu jiu raam kahahi jan ooche nar ni(n)dak da(n)s lagaai ||3||
english: The more the Lord's exalted servants speak of Him, the more the slanderers attack and sting them. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਜਿਨ ਜਨ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਸਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhrig dhrig nar ni(n)dak jin jan nahee bhaae har ke sakhaa sakhaai ||
english: Cursed, cursed are the slanderers who do not like the humble, the friends and companions of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚੋਰ ਵੇਮੁਖ ਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਨ ਭਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: se har ke chor vemukh mukh kaale jin gur kee paij na bhaai ||4||
english: Those who do not like the honor and glory of the Guru are faithless, black-faced thieves, who have turned their backs on the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: daiaa daiaa kar raakhahu har jeeu ham deen teree saranaai ||
english: Have mercy, have mercy, please save me, Dear Lord. I am meek and humble - I seek Your protection.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥
transliteration: ham baarik tum pitaa prabh mere jan naanak bakhas milaai ||5||2||
english: I am Your child, and You are my father, God. Please forgive servant Nanak and merge him with Yourself. ||5||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਤਿਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਵਤਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har ke sakhaa saadh jan neeke tin oopar haath vataavai ||
english: The friends of the Lord, the humble, Holy Saints are sublime; the Lord spreads out His protecting hands above them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh saadh seee prabh bhaae kar kirapaa aap milaavai ||1||
english: The Gurmukhs are the Holy Saints, pleasing to God; in His mercy, He blends them with Himself. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: raam mo kau har jan mel man bhaavai ||
english: O Lord, my mind longs to meet with the humble servants of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਮਿਉ ਅਮਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: amiu amiu har ras hai meethaa mil sa(n)t janaa mukh paavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The sweet, subtle essence of the Lord is immortalizing ambrosia. Meeting the Saints, I drink it in. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਮਿਲਿ ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har ke log raam jan ootam mil ootam padavee paavai ||
english: The Lord's people are the most lofty and exalted. Meeting with them, the most exalted status is obtained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਹੋਵਤ ਚੇਰੀ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ham hovat cheree daas daasan kee meraa thaakur khusee karaavai ||2||
english: I am the slave of the slave of the Lord's slaves; my Lord and Master is pleased with me. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਰਿਦ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sevak jan sevahi se vadabhaagee rid man tan preet lagaavai ||
english: The humble servant serves; one who enshrines love for the Lord in his heart, mind and body is very fortunate.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕੂੜੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin preetee karahi bahu baataa kooR bol kooRo phal paavai ||3||
english: One who talks too much without love, speaks falsely, and obtains only false rewards. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਗੀ ਲੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mo kau dhaar kripaa jagajeevan daate har sa(n)t pagee le paavai ||
english: Take pity on me, O Lord of the World, O Great Giver; let me fall at the feet of the Saints.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਾਟਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਾਢਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤੁ ਚੜਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: hau kaatau kaat baadh sir raakhau jit naanak sa(n)t chaR aavai ||4||3||
english: I would cut off my head, and cut it into pieces, O Nanak, and set it down for the Saints to walk upon. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਵਡ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਦਿਆ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: je vadabhaag hovahi vad mere jan miladiaa dhil na laaeeai ||
english: If I am blessed with supreme high destiny, I will meet the humble servants of the Lord, without delay.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੁੰਟ ਸਰ ਨੀਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਵਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har jan a(n)mrit ku(n)t sar neeke vadabhaagee tit naavaaeeai ||1||
english: The Lord's humble servants are pools of ambrosial nectar; by great good fortune, one bathes in them. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: raam mo kau har jan kaarai laaeeai ||
english: O Lord, let me work for the humble servants of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ ਪਗ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau paanee pakhaa peesau sa(n)t aagai pag mal mal dhoor mukh laaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I carry water, wave the fan and grind the corn for them; I massage and wash their feet. I apply the dust of their feet to my forehead. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਜੋ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: har jan vade vade vad ooche jo satagur mel milaaeeai ||
english: The Lord's humble servants are great, very great, the greatest and most exalted; they lead us to meet the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satagur jevad avar na koee mil satagur purakh dhiaaeeai ||2||
english: No one else is as great as the True Guru; meeting the True Guru, I meditate on the Lord, the Primal Being. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: satagur saran pare tin paaiaa mere thaakur laaj rakhaaeeai ||
english: Those who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru find the Lord. My Lord and Master saves their honor.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਅਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਆਇ ਬਹਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ik apanai suaai aai bahahi gur aagai jiu bagul samaadh lagaaeeai ||3||
english: Some come for their own purposes, and sit before the Guru; they pretend to be in Samaadhi, like storks with their eyes closed. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਗ ਨੀਚ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਕਰੰਗ ਬਿਖੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: bagulaa kaag neech kee sa(n)gat jaai kara(n)g bikhoo mukh laaeeai ||
english: Associating with the wretched and the lowly, like the stork and the crow, is like feeding on a carcass of poison.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak mel mel prabh sa(n)gat mil sa(n)gat ha(n)s karaaeeai ||4||4||
english: Nanak: O God, unite me with the Sangat, the Congregation. United with the Sangat, I will become a swan. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satagur daiaa karahu har melahu mere preetam praan har raaiaa ||
english: O True Guru, please be kind, and unite me with the Lord. My Sovereign Lord is the Beloved of my breath of life.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਚੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਲਗਹ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ham cheree hoi lagah gur charanee jin har prabh maarag pa(n)th dikhaaiaa ||1||
english: I am a slave; I fall at the Guru's feet. He has shown me the Path, the Way to my Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: raam mai har har naam man bhaaiaa ||
english: The Name of my Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਲੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਖਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mai har bin avar na koee belee meraa pitaa maataa har sakhaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have no friend except the Lord; the Lord is my father, my mother, my companion. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mere ik khin praan na rahahi bin preetam bin dekhe marahi meree maaiaa ||
english: My breath of life will not survive for an instant, without my Beloved; unless I see Him, I will die, O my mother!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhan dhan vadabhaag gur saranee aae har gur mil darasan paaiaa ||2||
english: Blessed, blessed is my great, high destiny, that I have come to the Guru's Sanctuary. Meeting with the Guru, I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸੂਝੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mai avar na koee soojhai boojhai man har jap japau japaaiaa ||
english: I do not know or understand any other within my mind; I meditate and chant the Lord's Chant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਹੀਣ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਨਕਟੇ ਤਿਨ ਘਸਿ ਘਸਿ ਨਕ ਵਢਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naamaheen phirahi se nakate tin ghas ghas nak vadhaaiaa ||3||
english: Those who lack the Naam, wander in shame; their noses are chopped off, bit by bit. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਵਾਲਿ ਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mo kau jagajeevan jeevaal lai suaamee rid a(n)tar naam vasaaiaa ||
english: O Life of the World, rejuvenate me! O my Lord and Master, enshrine Your Name deep within my heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak guroo guroo hai pooraa mil satigur naam dhiaaiaa ||4||5||
english: O Nanak, perfect is the Guru, the Guru. Meeting the True Guru, I meditate on the Naam. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 4 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਡਾ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satagur daataa vadaa vad purakh hai jit miliai har ur dhaare ||
english: The True Guru, the Great Giver, is the Great, Primal Being; meeting Him, the Lord is enshrined within the heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jee daan gur poorai deeaa har a(n)mrit naam samaare ||1||
english: The Perfect Guru has granted me the life of the soul; I meditate in remembrance on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raam gur har har naam ka(n)th dhaare ||
english: O Lord, the Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within my heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh kathaa sunee man bhaaee dhan dhan vadabhaag hamaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As Gurmukh, I have heard His sermon, which pleases my mind; blessed, blessed is my great destiny. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kot kot tetees dhiaavahi taa kaa a(n)t na paavahi paare ||
english: Millions, three hundred thirty millions of gods meditate on Him, but they cannot find His end or limitation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਾਮ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hiradai kaam kaamanee maagahi ridh maagahi haath pasaare ||2||
english: With sexual urges in their hearts, they beg for beautiful women; stretching out their hands, they beg for riches. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਪਿ ਜਪੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡੇਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਖਉ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har jas jap jap vadaa vaderaa guramukh rakhau ur dhaare ||
english: One who chants the Praises of the Lord is the greatest of the great; the Gurmukh keeps the Lord clasped to his heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je vadabhaag hovahi taa japeeai har bhaujal paar utaare ||3||
english: If one is blessed with high destiny, he meditates on the Lord, who carries him across the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਨ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har jan nikat nikat har jan hai har raakhai ka(n)th jan dhaare ||
english: The Lord is close to His humble servant, and His humble servant is close to the Lord; He keeps His humble servant clasped to His Heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak pitaa maataa hai har prabh ham baarik har pratipaare ||4||6||18||
english: O Nanak, the Lord God is our father and mother. I am His child; the Lord cherishes me. ||4||6||18||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag raamakalee mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa karahu deen ke daate meraa gun avagan na beechaarahu koee ||
english: Have mercy on me, O Generous Giver, Lord of the meek; please do not consider my merits and demerits.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਧੋਪੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਾਣਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਏਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maatee kaa kiaa dhopai suaamee maanas kee gat ehee ||1||
english: How can dust be washed? O my Lord and Master, such is the state of mankind. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: mere man satigur sev sukh hoee ||
english: O my mind, serve the True Guru, and be at peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo ichhahu soee phal paavahu phir dookh na viaapai koee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever you desire, you shall receive that reward, and you shall not be afflicted by pain any longer. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੇ ਭਾਡੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaache bhaade saaj nivaaje a(n)tar jot samaaee ||
english: He creates and adorns the earthen vessels; He infuses His Light within them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਹਮ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaisaa likhat likhiaa dhur karatai ham taisee kirat kamaaee ||2||
english: As is the destiny pre-ordained by the Creator, so are the deeds we do. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਏਹੋ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan thaap keeaa sabh apanaa eho aavan jaanaa ||
english: He believes the mind and body are all his own; this is the cause of his coming and going.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਲਪਟਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jin deeaa so chit na aavai mohi a(n)dh lapataanaa ||3||
english: He does not think of the One who gave him these; he is blind, entangled in emotional attachment. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jin keeaa soee prabh jaanai har kaa mahal apaaraa ||
english: One who knows that God created him, reaches the Incomparable Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: bhagat karee har ke gun gaavaa naanak daas tumaaraa ||4||1||
english: Worshipping the Lord, I sing His Glorious Praises. Nanak is Your slave. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਵਹੁ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਲਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: pavahu charanaa tal oopar aavahu aisee sev kamaavahu ||
english: Place yourself beneath all men's feet, and you will be uplifted; serve Him in this way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aapas te oopar sabh jaanahu tau daragah sukh paavahu ||1||
english: Know that all are above you, and you shall find peace in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਕਥਹੁ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu aisee kathahu kahaanee ||
english: O Saints, speak that speech which purifies the gods and sanctifies the divine beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sur pavitr nar dev pavitraa khin bolahu guramukh baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As Gurmukh, chant the Word of His Bani, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: parapa(n)ch chhod sahaj ghar baisahu jhoothaa kahahu na koee ||
english: Renounce your fraudulent plans, and dwell in the celestial palace; do not call anyone else false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਲੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur milahu navai nidh paavahu in bidh tat biloee ||2||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, you shall receive the nine treasures; in this way, you shall find the essence of reality. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bharam chukaavahu guramukh liv laavahu aatam cheenahu bhaaee ||
english: Eradicate doubt, and as Gurmukh, enshrine love for the Lord; understand your own soul, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੁਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nikat kar jaanahu sadaa prabh haajar kis siu karahu buraaee ||3||
english: Know that God is near at hand, and ever-present. How could you try to hurt anyone else? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai maarag mukataa sahaje mile suaamee ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, your path shall be clear, and you shall easily meet your Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨੀ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: dhan dhan se jan jinee kal mahi har paaiaa jan naanak sad kurabaanee ||4||2||
english: Blessed, blessed are those humble beings, who, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, find the Lord. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਹਰਖ ਨ ਜਾਵਤ ਦੂਖਾ ਨਹ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਨ ਰੋਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: aavat harakh na jaavat dookhaa nah biaapai man roganee ||
english: Coming does not please me, and going does not bring me pain, and so my mind is not afflicted by disease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਉ ਉਤਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਓਗਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d gur pooraa paaiaa tau utaree sagal bioganee ||1||
english: I am in bliss forever, for I have found the Perfect Guru; my separation from the Lord is totally ended. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ih bidh hai man joganee ||
english: This is how I have joined my mind to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mohu sog rog log na biaapai tah har har har ras bhoganee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Attachment, sorrow, disease and public opinion do not affect me, and so, I enjoy the subtle essence of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਗ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਿਰਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਪਇਆਲ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਲੋਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: surag pavitraa mirat pavitraa paiaal pavitr aloganee ||
english: I am pure in the heavenly realm, pure on this earth, and pure in the nether regions of the underworld. I remain apart from the people of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੁੰਚੈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aagiaakaaree sadaa sukh bhu(n)chai jat kat pekhau har gunee ||2||
english: Obedient to the Lord, I enjoy peace forever; wherever I look, I see the Lord of glorious virtues. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਜਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਵਨਾ ਤਹ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਦਨੀ ॥
transliteration: nah siv sakatee jal nahee pavanaa tah akaar nahee medanee ||
english: There is no Shiva or Shakti, no energy or matter, no water or wind, no world of form there,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੋਗ ਕਾ ਤਹਾ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਜਹ ਅਵਿਗਤ ਨਾਥੁ ਅਗਮ ਧਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur jog kaa tahaa nivaasaa jah avigat naath agam dhanee ||3||
english: where the True Guru, the Yogi, dwells, where the Imperishable Lord God, the Unapproachable Master abides. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
transliteration: tan man har kaa dhan sabh har kaa har ke gun hau kiaa ganee ||
english: Body and mind belong to the Lord; all wealth belongs to the Lord; what glorious virtues of the Lord can I describe?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਹੈ ਅੰਭੈ ਅੰਭੁ ਮਿਲੋਗਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ham tum gur khoee hai a(n)bhai a(n)bh miloganee ||4||3||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has destroyed my sense of 'mine and yours'. Like water with water, I am blended with God. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਰਹਤ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: trai gun rahat rahai niraaree saadhik sidh na jaanai ||
english: It is beyond the three qualities; it remains untouched. The seekers and Siddhas do not know it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ratan kothaRee a(n)mrit sa(n)pooran satigur kai khajaanai ||1||
english: There is a chamber filled with jewels, overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar, in the Guru's Treasury. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: acharaj kichh kahan na jaaee ||
english: This thing is wonderful and amazing! It cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: basat agochar bhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It is an unfathomable object, O Siblings of Destiny! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mol naahee kachh karanai jogaa kiaa ko kahai sunaavai ||
english: Its value cannot be estimated at all; what can anyone say about it?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨ ਕਹਣ ਕਉ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋ ਪੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kathan kahan kau sojhee naahee jo pekhai tis ban aavai ||2||
english: By speaking and describing it, it cannot be understood; only one who sees it realizes it. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: soee jaanai karanaihaaraa keetaa kiaa bechaaraa ||
english: Only the Creator Lord knows it; what can any poor creature do?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aapanee gat mit aape jaanai har aape poor bha(n)daaraa ||3||
english: Only He Himself knows His own state and extent. The Lord Himself is the treasure overflowing. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aisaa ras a(n)mrit man chaakhiaa tripat rahe aaghaaee ||
english: Tasting such Ambrosial Nectar, the mind remains satisfied and satiated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak meree aasaa pooree satigur kee saranaaee ||4||4||
english: Says Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; I have found the Guru's Sanctuary. ||4||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਬੈਰੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeaa prabh apanai bairee sagale saadhe ||
english: God has made me His own, and vanquished all my enemies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਬੈਰੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ ਤੇ ਬੈਰੀ ਲੈ ਬਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin bairee hai ihu jag lootiaa te bairee lai baadhe ||1||
english: Those enemies who have plundered this world, have all been placed in bondage. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur paramesar meraa ||
english: The True Guru is my Transcendent Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੀ ਨਾਉ ਜਪੀ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anik raaj bhog ras maanee naau japee bharavaasaa teraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I enjoy countless pleasures of power and tasty delights, chanting Your Name, and placing my faith in You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਬਾਤਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: cheet na aavas doojee baataa sir oopar rakhavaaraa ||
english: I do not think of any other at all. The Lord is my protector, above my head.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਰਹਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: beparavaahu rahat hai suaamee ik naam kai aadhaaraa ||2||
english: I am carefree and independent, when I have the Support of Your Name, O my Lord and Master. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: pooran hoi milio sukhadaaee oon na kaaee baataa ||
english: I have become perfect, meeting with the Giver of peace, and now, I lack nothing at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tat saar param pad paaiaa chhod na katahoo jaataa ||3||
english: I have obtained the essence of excellence, the supreme status; I shall not forsake it to go anywhere else. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: baran na saakau jaisaa too hai saache alakh apaaraa ||
english: I cannot describe how You are, O True Lord, unseen, infinite,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਤੁਲ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਡੋਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: atul athaah adol suaamee naanak khasam hamaaraa ||4||5||
english: immeasurable, unfathomable and unmoving Lord. O Nanak, He is my Lord and Master. ||4||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂ ਅਬਿਚਲੁ ਤੂਹੀ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: too daanaa too abichal toohee too jaat meree paatee ||
english: You are wise; You are eternal and unchanging. You are my social class and honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਹਮ ਕੈਸੀ ਤਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too adol kade dolahi naahee taa ham kaisee taatee ||1||
english: You are unmoving - You never move at all. How can I be worried? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਏਕ ਤੂਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ekai ekai ek toohee ||
english: You alone are the One and only Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਤੂ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ekai ekai too raaiaa ||
