english: You alone are the king.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tau kirapaa te sukh paaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Your Grace, I have found peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਮ ਹੰਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: too saagar ham ha(n)s tumaare tum mahi maanak laalaa ||
english: You are the ocean, and I am Your swan; the pearls and rubies are in You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਸੰਕ ਨ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਭੁੰਚਹ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tum devahu til sa(n)k na maanahu ham bhu(n)chah sadaa nihaalaa ||2||
english: You give, and You do not hesitate for an instant; I receive, forever enraptured. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਖੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ham baarik tum pitaa hamaare tum mukh devahu kheeraa ||
english: I am Your child, and You are my father; You place the milk in my mouth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਖੇਲਹ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਵਹ ਤੁਮ ਸਦ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ham khelah sabh laad ladaavah tum sad gunee gaheeraa ||3||
english: I play with You, and You caress me in every way. You are forever the ocean of excellence. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਹਮ ਭੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tum pooran poor rahe sa(n)pooran ham bhee sa(n)g aghaae ||
english: You are perfect, perfectly all-pervading; I am fulfilled with You as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: milat milat milat mil rahiaa naanak kahan na jaae ||4||6||
english: I am merged, merged, merged and remain merged; O Nanak, I cannot describe it! ||4||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਲ ਪਖਾਵਜੁ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਮਾਥੈ ਵਜਹਿ ਰਬਾਬਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kar taal pakhaavaj nainahu maathai vajahi rabaabaa ||
english: Make your hands the cymbals, your eyes the tambourines, and your forehead the guitar you play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਹੁ ਮਧੁ ਬਾਸੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਗਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: karanahu madh baasuree baajai jihavaa dhun aagaajaa ||
english: Let the sweet flute music resound in your ears, and with your tongue, vibrate this song.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਚੈ ਆਣੇ ਘੂਘਰ ਸਾਜਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nirat kare kar manooaa naachai aane ghooghar saajaa ||1||
english: Move your mind like the rhythmic hand-motions; do the dance, and shake your ankle bracelets. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਤਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: raam ko niratikaaree ||
english: This is the rhythmic dance of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖੈ ਪੇਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਸਾਜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pekhai pekhanahaar daiaalaa jetaa saaj seegaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Merciful Audience, the Lord, sees all your make-up and decorations. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਖਾਰ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਧਰਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਊਪਰਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਚੰਦੋਆ ॥
transliteration: aakhaar ma(n)dalee dharan sabaaee oopar gagan cha(n)doaa ||
english: The whole earth is the stage, with the canopy of the sky overhead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਵਨੁ ਵਿਚੋਲਾ ਕਰਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਆ ॥
transliteration: pavan vicholaa karat ikelaa jal te opat hoaa ||
english: The wind is the director; people are born of water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਤਰਾ ਕੀਨਾ ਕਿਰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch tat kar putaraa keenaa kirat milaavaa hoaa ||2||
english: From the five elements, the puppet was created with its actions. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਜਰੇ ਚਰਾਗਾ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)d sooraj dui jare charaagaa chahu ku(n)t bheetar raakhe ||
english: The sun and the moon are the two lamps which shine, with the four corners of the world placed between them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਪਾਤਉ ਪੰਚ ਸੰਗੀਤਾ ਏਕੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: das paatau pa(n)ch sa(n)geetaa ekai bheetar saathe ||
english: The ten senses are the dancing girls, and the five passions are the chorus; they sit together within the one body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਹੋਇ ਭਾਵ ਦਿਖਾਵਹਿ ਸਭਹੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਭਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhi(n)n bhi(n)n hoi bhaav dikhaavahi sabhahu niraaree bhaakhe ||3||
english: They all put on their own shows, and speak in different languages. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਤੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ghar ghar nirat hovai din raatee ghat ghat vaajai tooraa ||
english: In each and every home there is dancing, day and night; in each and every home, the bugles blow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਿ ਨਚਾਵਹਿ ਏਕਿ ਭਵਾਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਹੋਇ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ek nachaavahi ek bhavaavahi ik aai jaai hoi dhooraa ||
english: Some are made to dance, and some are whirled around; some come and some go, and some are reduced to dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਨਾਚੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak so bahur na naachai jis gur bhetai pooraa ||4||7||
english: Says Nanak, one who meets with the True Guru, does not have to dance the dance of reincarnation again. ||4||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਧੁਨਿ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਰਾਗੁ ਅਲਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: oa(n)kaar ek dhun ekai ekai raag alaapai ||
english: He sings the song of the One Universal Creator; he sings the tune of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਦੇਸੀ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਏਕੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: ekaa desee ek dikhaavai eko rahiaa biaapai ||
english: He lives in the land of the One Lord, shows the way to the One Lord, and remains attuned to the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਹੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ekaa surat ekaa hee sevaa eko gur te jaapai ||1||
english: He centers his consciousness on the One Lord, and serves only the One Lord, who is known through the Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਲੋ ਭਲੋ ਰੇ ਕੀਰਤਨੀਆ ॥
transliteration: bhalo bhalo re keerataneeaa ||
english: Blessed and good is such a kirtanee, who sings such Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਾ ਰਾਮਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam ramaa raamaa gun gaau ||
english: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਧੰਧ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chhod maaiaa ke dha(n)dh suaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and renounces the entanglements and pursuits of Maya. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਬਜਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਤੋਖਾ ਸਾਤ ਸੁਰਾ ਲੈ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch bajitr kare sa(n)tokhaa saat suraa lai chaalai ||
english: He makes the five virtues, like contentment, his musical instruments, and plays the seven notes of the love of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਤਜਿ ਤਾਨਾ ਪਾਉ ਨ ਬੀਗਾ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: baajaa maan taan taj taanaa paau na beegaa ghaalai ||
english: The notes he plays are the renunciation of pride and power; his feet keep the beat on the straight path.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫੇਰੀ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਾਲੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pheree pher na hovai kab hee ek sabad ba(n)dh paalai ||2||
english: He does not enter the cycle of reincarnation ever again; he keeps the One Word of the Shabad tied to the hem of his robe. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦੀ ਨਰਹਰ ਜਾਣਿ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naaradee narahar jaan hadoore ||
english: To play like Naarad, is to know that the Lord is ever-present.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੂੰਘਰ ਖੜਕੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ghoo(n)ghar khaRak tiaag visoore ||
english: The tinkling of the ankle bells is the shedding of sorrows and worries.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sahaj ana(n)d dikhaavai bhaavai ||
english: The dramatic gestures of acting are celestial bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਨਿਰਤਿਕਾਰੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ehu niratikaaree janam na aavai ||3||
english: Such a dancer is not reincarnated again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਅਪਨੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je ko apane thaakur bhaavai ||
english: If anyone, out of millions of people, becomes pleasing to his Lord and Master,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧਿ ਏਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kot madh ehu keeratan gaavai ||
english: He sings the Lord's Praises in this way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਜਾਵਉ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kee jaavau tek ||
english: I have taken the Support of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਏਕ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tis keeratan ek ||4||8||
english: Says Nanak, the Kirtan of the One Lord's Praises are sung there. ||4||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕੋਈ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
transliteration: koee bolai raam raam koee khudaai ||
english: Some call Him, 'Raam, Raam', and some call Him, 'Khudaa-i'.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਸੇਵੈ ਗੁਸਈਆ ਕੋਈ ਅਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: koee sevai gusaeeaa koee alaahi ||1||
english: Some serve Him as 'Gusain', others as 'Allaah'. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੀਮ ॥
transliteration: kaaran karan kareem ||
english: He is the Cause of causes, the Generous Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹੀਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa dhaar raheem ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He showers His Grace and Mercy upon us. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਨਾਵੈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਕੋਈ ਹਜ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: koee naavai teerath koee haj jaai ||
english: Some bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and some make the pilgrimage to Mecca.|

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: koee karai poojaa koee sir nivaai ||2||
english: Some perform devotional worship services, and some bow their heads in prayer. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਪੜੈ ਬੇਦ ਕੋਈ ਕਤੇਬ ॥
transliteration: koee paRai bed koee kateb ||
english: Some read the Vedas, and some the Koran.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਓਢੈ ਨੀਲ ਕੋਈ ਸੁਪੇਦ ॥੩॥
transliteration: koee odhai neel koee suped ||3||
english: Some wear blue robes, and some wear white. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ਤੁਰਕੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ਹਿੰਦੂ ॥
transliteration: koee kahai turak koee kahai hi(n)doo ||
english: Some call themselves Muslim, and some call themselves Hindu.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਬਾਛੈ ਭਿਸਤੁ ਕੋਈ ਸੁਰਗਿੰਦੂ ॥੪॥
transliteration: koee baachhai bhisat koee suragi(n)doo ||4||
english: Some yearn for paradise, and others long for heaven. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jin hukam pachhaataa ||
english: Says Nanak, one who realizes the Hukam of God's Will,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੫॥੯॥
transliteration: prabh saahib kaa tin bhed jaataa ||5||9||
english: knows the secrets of his Lord and Master. ||5||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਵਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pavanai mahi pavan samaaiaa ||
english: The wind merges into the wind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jotee mahi jot ral jaaiaa ||
english: The light blends into the light.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਮਾਟੀ ਹੋਈ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: maatee maatee hoee ek ||
english: The dust becomes one with the dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰੇ ਕੀ ਕਵਨ ਟੇਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rovanahaare kee kavan tek ||1||
english: What support is there for the one who is lamenting? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਮੂਆ ਰੇ ਕਉਨੁ ਮੂਆ ॥
transliteration: kaun mooaa re kaun mooaa ||
english: Who has died? O, who has died?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਉ ਚਲਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: braham giaanee mil karahu beechaaraa ihu tau chalat bhaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O God-realized beings, meet together and consider this. What a wondrous thing has happened! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਲੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: agalee kichh khabar na paaee ||
english: No one knows what happens after death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਭਿ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਈ ॥
transliteration: rovanahaar bh ooth sidhaaee ||
english: The one who is lamenting will also arise and depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਕੇ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਬੰਧ ॥
transliteration: bharam moh ke baa(n)dhe ba(n)dh ||
english: Mortal beings are bound by the bonds of doubt and attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਭਖਲਾਏ ਅੰਧ ॥੨॥
transliteration: supan bhaiaa bhakhalaae a(n)dh ||2||
english: When life becomes a dream, the blind man babbles and grieves in vain. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਉ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ihu tau rachan rachiaa karataar ||
english: The Creator Lord created this creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aavat jaavat hukam apaar ||
english: It comes and goes, subject to the Will of the Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਕੋ ਮੂਆ ਨ ਮਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: nah ko mooaa na maranai jog ||
english: No one dies; no one is capable of dying.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nah binasai abinaasee hog ||3||
english: The soul does not perish; it is imperishable. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਸੋ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jo ihu jaanahu so ihu naahi ||
english: That which is known, does not exist.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰੇ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaananahaare kau bal jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the one who knows this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur bharam chukaaiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naa koee marai na aavai jaaiaa ||4||10||
english: No one dies; no one comes or goes. ||4||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jap gobi(n)d gopaal laal ||
english: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Beloved Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤੂ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਖਾਈ ਮਹਾ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam simar too jeevahi phir na khaaee mahaa kaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord's Name, you shall live, and the Great Death shall not consume you ever again. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kot janam bhram bhram bhram aaio ||
english: Through millions of incarnations, you have come, wandering, wandering, wandering.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: badai bhaag saadhasa(n)g paaio ||1||
english: By the highest destiny, you found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin gur poore naahee udhaar ||
english: Without the Perfect Guru, no one is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: baabaa naanak aakhai ehu beechaar ||2||11||
english: This is what Baba Nanak says, after deep reflection. ||2||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag raamakalee mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਨਾ ਤੂ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥
transliteration: chaar pukaarahi naa too maanahi ||
english: The four Vedas proclaim it, but you don't believe them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਭੀ ਏਕਾ ਬਾਤ ਵਖਾਨਹਿ ॥
transliteration: khat bhee ekaa baat vakhaanahi ||
english: The six Shaastras also say one thing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਸਟੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕੋ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: das asatee mil eko kahiaa ||
english: The eighteen Puraanas all speak of the One God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਭੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa bhee jogee bhed na lahiaa ||1||
english: Even so, Yogi, you do not understand this mystery. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿੰਕੁਰੀ ਅਨੂਪ ਵਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: ki(n)kuree anoop vaajai ||
english: The celestial harp plays the incomparable melody,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀਆ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jogeeaa matavaaro re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: but in your intoxication, you do not hear it, O Yogi. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਤ ਕਾ ਖੇੜਾ ॥
transliteration: prathame vasiaa sat kaa kheRaa ||
english: In the first age, the Golden Age, the village of truth was inhabited.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਏ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਤੇੜਾ ॥
transliteration: triteee mahi kichh bhaiaa duteRaa ||
english: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, things began to decline.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਅਰਧੋ ਅਰਧਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: duteeaa aradho aradh samaaiaa ||
english: In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, half of it was gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ek rahiaa taa ek dikhaaiaa ||2||
english: Now, only one leg of Truth remains, and the One Lord is revealed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਏ ਮਣੀਏ ॥
transliteration: ekai soot paroe maneee ||
english: The beads are strung upon the one thread.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਠੀ ਭਿਨਿ ਭਿਨਿ ਭਿਨਿ ਭਿਨਿ ਤਣੀਏ ॥
transliteration: gaathee bhin bhin bhin bhin taneee ||
english: By means of many, various, diverse knots, they are tied, and kept separate on the string.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: phiratee maalaa bahu bidh bhaai ||
english: The beads of the mala are lovingly chanted upon in many ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਚਿਆ ਸੂਤੁ ਤ ਆਈ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khi(n)chiaa soot ta aaee thaai ||3||
english: When the thread is pulled out, the beads come together in one place. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੈ ਮਟੁ ਹੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: chahu mahi ekai mat hai keeaa ||
english: Throughout the four ages, the One Lord made the body His temple.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਥਾਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਖਿੜਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tah bikhaRe thaan anik khiRakeeaa ||
english: It is a treacherous place, with several windows.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat duaare aaiaa ||
english: Searching and searching, one comes to the Lord's door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਗੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: taa naanak jogee mahal ghar paaiaa ||4||
english: Then, O Nanak, the Yogi attains a home in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਿੰਕੁਰੀ ਆਨੂਪ ਵਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: iu ki(n)kuree aanoop vaajai ||
english: Thus, the celestial harp plays the incomparable melody;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੧੨॥
transliteration: sun jogee kai man meethee laagai ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||1||12||
english: hearing it, the Yogi's mind finds it sweet. ||1||Second Pause||1||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਗਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਾਈ ਥਿਗਲੀ ॥
transliteration: taagaa kar kai laaee thigalee ||
english: The body is a patch-work of threads.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਉ ਨਾੜੀ ਸੂਆ ਹੈ ਅਸਤੀ ॥
transliteration: lau naaRee sooaa hai asatee ||
english: The muscles are stitched together with the needles of the bones.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਭੈ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)bhai kaa kar da(n)daa dhariaa ||
english: The Lord has erected a pillar of water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਜੋਗੀ ਗਰਬਹਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kiaa too jogee garabahi pariaa ||1||
english: O Yogi, why are you so proud? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jap naath din rainaaee ||
english: Meditate on your Lord Master, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਦੋ ਦਿਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teree khi(n)thaa do dihaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The patched coat of the body shall last for only a few days. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਰੀ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਲਾਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਤਾੜੀ ॥
transliteration: gaharee bibhoot laai baithaa taaRee ||
english: Smearing ashes on your body, you sit in a deep meditative trance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: meree teree mu(n)draa dhaaree ||
english: You wear the ear-rings of 'mine and yours'.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਗਹਿ ਟੂਕਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: maagahi tookaa tripat na paavai ||
english: You beg for bread, but you are not satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਥੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naath chhod jaachahi laaj na aavai ||2||
english: Abandoning your Lord Master, you beg from others; you should feel ashamed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਜੋਗੀ ਆਸਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: chal chit jogee aasan teraa ||
english: Your consciousness is restless, Yogi, as you sit in your Yogic postures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਙੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਉਦਾਸੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: si(n)ngee vaajai nit udaaseraa ||
english: You blow your horn, but still feel sad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਰਖ ਕੀ ਤੈ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur gorakh kee tai boojh na paaee ||
english: You do not understand Gorakh, your guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: phir phir jogee aavai jaaee ||3||
english: Again and again, Yogi, you come and go. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਆ ਨਾਥੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jis no hoaa naath kripaalaa ||
english: He, unto whom the Master shows Mercy

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: raharaas hamaaree gur gopaalaa ||
english: unto Him, the Guru, the Lord of the World, I offer my prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੈ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਸਤਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naamai khi(n)thaa naamai basatar ||
english: One who has the Name as his patched coat, and the Name as his robe,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਗੀ ਹੋਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak jogee hoaa asathir ||4||
english: O servant Nanak, such a Yogi is steady and stable. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਾਥੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: iu japiaa naath din rainaaee ||
english: One who meditates on the Master in this way, night and day,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਣਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥੧੩॥
transliteration: hun paaiaa gur gosaaee ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||2||13||
english: finds the Guru, the Lord of the World, in this life. ||1||Second Pause||2||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan soee ||
english: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aan na deesai koee ||
english: I do not see any other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: thaakur meraa sughaR sujaanaa ||
english: My Lord and Master is wise and all-knowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh miliaa ra(n)g maanaa ||1||
english: Meeting with the Gurmukh, I enjoy His Love. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: aiso re har ras meethaa ||
english: Such is the sweet, subtle essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh kinai viralai deethaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, taste it. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: niramal jot a(n)mrit har naam ||
english: The Light of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord is immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਤ ਅਮਰ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: peevat amar bhae nihakaam ||
english: Drinking it in, one becomes immortal and free of desire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tan man seetal agan nivaaree ||
english: The body and mind are cooled and soothed, and the fire is extinguished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anad roop pragate sa(n)saaree ||2||
english: Such a being is the embodiment of bliss, famous throughout the world. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਦੇਵਉ ਜਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kiaa devau jaa sabh kichh teraa ||
english: What can I offer You, Lord? Everything belongs to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਲਖ ਬੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sad balihaar jaau lakh beraa ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to You, hundreds of thousands of times.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tan man jeeu pi(n)d de saajiaa ||
english: You blessed me, and fashioned my body, mind and soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨੀਚੁ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te neech nivaajiaa ||3||
english: By Guru's Grace, this lowly being was exalted. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਲਿ ਕਿਵਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: khol kivaaraa mahal bulaaiaa ||
english: Opening the door, You summoned me to the Mansion of Your Presence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਸਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa saa taisaa dikhalaaiaa ||
english: As You are, so You have revealed Yourself to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਪੜਦਾ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sabh paRadaa tootaa ||
english: Says Nanak, the screen is totally torn away;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪॥
transliteration: hau teraa too mai man voothaa ||4||3||14||
english: I am Yours, and You are enshrined within my mind. ||4||3||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਲਾਇਓ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sevak laaio apunee sev ||
english: He has linked His servant to His service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam deeo mukh dev ||
english: The Divine Guru has poured the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, into his mouth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sagalee chi(n)taa aap nivaaree ||
english: He has subdued all his anxiety.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis gur kau hau sad balihaaree ||1||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਗੁਰ ॥
transliteration: kaaj hamaare poore satagur ||
english: The True Guru has perfectly resolved my affairs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ਸਤਗੁਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: baaje anahad toore satagur ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Guru vibrates the unstruck melody of the sound current. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ॥
transliteration: mahimaa jaa kee gahir ga(n)bheer ||
english: His Glory is profound and unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਦੇਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੀਰ ॥
transliteration: hoi nihaal dei jis dheer ||
english: One whom He blesses with patience becomes blissful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa ke ba(n)dhan kaate raai ||
english: One whose bonds are shattered by the Sovereign Lord

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so nar bahur na jonee paai ||2||
english: is not cast into the womb of reincarnation again. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਆਪ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai a(n)tar pragatio aap ||
english: One who is illuminated by the Lord's radiance within,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: taa kau naahee dookh sa(n)taap ||
english: is not touched by pain and sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਲੈ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: laal ratan tis paalai pariaa ||
english: He holds in his robe the gems and jewels.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਓਹੁ ਜਨੁ ਲੈ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sagal kuta(n)b ohu jan lai tariaa ||3||
english: That humble being is saved, along with all his generations. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: naa kichh bharam na dubidhaa doojaa ||
english: He has no doubt, double-mindedness or duality at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: eko ek nira(n)jan poojaa ||
english: He worships and adores the One Immaculate Lord alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: jat kat dekhau aap daiaal ||
english: Wherever I look, I see the Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਸਾਲ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak prabh mile rasaal ||4||4||15||
english: Says Nanak, I have found God, the source of nectar. ||4||4||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tan te chhutakee apanee dhaaree ||
english: My self-conceit has been eliminated from my body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee aagiaa lagee piaaree ||
english: The Will of God is dear to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karai s man merai meethaa ||
english: Whatever He does, seems sweet to my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਇਹੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa ihu acharaj nainahu deethaa ||1||
english: And then, these eyes behold the wondrous Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਾਨੀ ਰੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ab mohi jaanee re meree gaee balaai ||
english: Now, I have become wise and my demons are gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੀਓ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bujh gaee trisan nivaaree mamataa gur poorai leeo samajhaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My thirst is quenched, and my attachment is dispelled. The Perfect Guru has instructed me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhio gur saranaa ||
english: In His Mercy, the Guru has kept me under His protection.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪਕਰਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: gur pakaraae har ke charanaa ||
english: The Guru has attached me to the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸੁਏ ਜਾ ਮਨ ਠਹਰਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: bees bisue jaa man thaharaane ||
english: When the mind is totally held in check,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਏਕੈ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur paarabraham ekai hee jaane ||2||
english: one sees the Guru and the Supreme Lord God as one and the same. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jo jo keeno ham tis ke daas ||
english: Whoever You have created, I am his slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੋ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
transliteration: prabh mere ko sagal nivaas ||
english: My God dwells in all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੂਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naa ko doot nahee bairaaee ||
english: I have no enemies, no adversaries.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਚਾਲੇ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gal mil chaale ekai bhaaee ||3||
english: I walk arm in arm, like brothers, with all. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਏ ਸੂਖਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau gur har deee sookhaa ||
english: One whom the Guru, the Lord, blesses with peace,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਦੂਖਾ ॥
transliteration: taa kau bahur na laagahi dookhaa ||
english: does not suffer in pain any longer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: aape aap sarab pratipaal ||
english: He Himself cherishes all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਤਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak raatau ra(n)g gopaal ||4||5||16||
english: Nanak is imbued with the love of the Lord of the World. ||4||5||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਪੜਤਾ ਟੀਕਾ ਸਹਿਤ ॥
transliteration: mukh te paRataa teekaa sahit ||
english: You read the scriptures, and the commentaries,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਹਤ ॥
transliteration: hiradai raam nahee pooran rahat ||
english: but the Perfect Lord does not dwell in your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਲੋਕ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: upades kare kar lok driRaavai ||
english: You preach to others to have faith,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apanaa kahiaa aap na kamaavai ||1||
english: but you do not practice what you preach. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬੇਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit bed beechaar pa(n)dit ||
english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, contemplate the Vedas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man kaa krodh nivaar pa(n)dit ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Eradicate anger from your mind, O Pandit. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਸਾਲ ਗਿਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: aagai raakhio saal giraam ||
english: You place your stone god before yourself,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: man keeno dah dis bisraam ||
english: but your mind wanders in the ten directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲਕੁ ਚਰਾਵੈ ਪਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tilak charaavai paaee paai ||
english: You apply a ceremonial tilak mark to its forehead, and fall at its feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਪਚਾਰਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: lok pachaaraa a(n)dh kamaai ||2||
english: You try to appease the people, and act blindly. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਅਰੁ ਆਸਣੁ ਧੋਤੀ ॥
transliteration: khat karamaa ar aasan dhotee ||
english: You perform the six religious rituals, and sit wearing your loin-cloth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਗਠਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੜੈ ਨਿਤ ਪੋਥੀ ॥
transliteration: bhaagath grihi paRai nit pothee ||
english: In the homes of the wealthy, you read the prayer book.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲਾ ਫੇਰੈ ਮੰਗੈ ਬਿਭੂਤ ॥
transliteration: maalaa pherai ma(n)gai bibhoot ||
english: You chant on your mala, and beg for money.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਤਰਿਓ ਮੀਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ih bidh koi na tario meet ||3||
english: No one has ever been saved in this way, friend. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: so pa(n)dit gurasabad kamaai ||
english: He alone is a Pandit, who lives the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਓਸੁ ਉਤਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: trai gun kee os utaree maai ||
english: Maya, of the three qualities, leaves him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chatur bed pooran har naai ||
english: The four Vedas are completely contained within the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak tis kee saranee paai ||4||6||17||
english: Nanak seeks His Sanctuary. ||4||6||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਨੇਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kot bighan nahee aavahi ner ||
english: Millions of troubles do not come near him;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚੇਰਿ ॥
transliteration: anik maaiaa hai taa kee cher ||
english: the many manifestations of Maya are his hand-maidens;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਪ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪਾਨੀਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: anik paap taa ke paaneehaar ||
english: countless sins are his water-carriers;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਇਆ ਭਈ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kau maiaa bhaee karataar ||1||
english: he is blessed with the Grace of the Creator Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jisahi sahaaee hoi bhagavaan ||
english: One who has the Lord God as his help and support

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਉਆ ਕੈ ਸਰੰਜਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: anik jatan uaa kai sara(n)jaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - all his efforts are fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਉਨੁ ॥
transliteration: karataa raakhai keetaa kaun ||
english: He is protected by the Creator Lord; what harm can anyone do to him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਰੀ ਜੀਤੋ ਸਗਲਾ ਭਵਨੁ ॥
transliteration: keeree jeeto sagalaa bhavan ||
english: Even an ant can conquer the whole world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਬਰਨ ॥
transliteration: bea(n)t mahimaa taa kee ketak baran ||
english: His glory is endless; how can I describe it?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bal bal jaaeeai taa ke charan ||2||
english: I am a sacrifice, a devoted sacrifice, to His feet. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tin hee keeaa jap tap dhiaan ||
english: He alone performs worship, austerities and meditation;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: anik prakaar keeaa tin daan ||
english: he alone is a giver to various charities;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: bhagat soee kal mahi paravaan ||
english: he alone is approved in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kau thaakur deeaa maan ||3||
english: whom the Lord Master blesses with honor. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mil bhae pragaas ||
english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am enlightened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਸ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
transliteration: sahaj sookh aas nivaas ||
english: I have found celestial peace, and my hopes are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬਿਸਾਸ ॥
transliteration: poorai satigur deeaa bisaas ||
english: The Perfect True Guru has blessed me with faith.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਏ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak hoe daasan daas ||4||7||18||
english: Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ||4||7||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਲੋਗ ॥
transliteration: dos na deejai kaahoo log ||
english: Don't blame others, O people;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਮਾਵਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਭੋਗ ॥
transliteration: jo kamaavan soee bhog ||
english: as you plant, so shall you harvest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਕਰਮ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬੰਧ ॥
transliteration: aapan karam aape hee ba(n)dh ||
english: By your actions, you have bound yourself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਵਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੰਧ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aavan jaavan maaiaa dha(n)dh ||1||
english: You come and go, entangled in Maya. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੀ ॥
transliteration: aisee jaanee sa(n)t janee ||
english: Such is the understanding of the Saintly people.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paragaas bhaiaa poore gur bachanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall be enlightened, through the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tan dhan kalat mithiaa bisathaar ||
english: Body, wealth, spouse and ostentatious displays are false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਚਾਲਨਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: haivar gaivar chaalanahaar ||
english: Horses and elephants will pass away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਸਭਿ ਕੂਰ ॥
transliteration: raaj ra(n)g roop sabh koor ||
english: Power, pleasures and beauty are all false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਸੀ ਧੂਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam binaa hoi jaasee dhoor ||2||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, everything is reduced to dust. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਾਦਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bharam bhoole baad aha(n)kaaree ||
english: The egotistical people are deluded by useless doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g naahee re sagal pasaaree ||
english: Of all this expanse, nothing shall go along with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਮਹਿ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਰਧਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sog harakh mahi deh biradhaanee ||
english: Through pleasure and pain, the body is growing old.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saakat iv hee karat bihaanee ||3||
english: Doing these things, the faithless cynics are passing their lives. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਲਿ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam a(n)mrit kal maahi ||
english: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ehu nidhaanaa saadhoo paahi ||
english: This treasure is obtained from the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂਠਾ ॥
transliteration: naanak gur govid jis toothaa ||
english: O Nanak, whoever pleases the Guru,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੯॥
transliteration: ghat ghat ramaeeaa tin hee deethaa ||4||8||19||
english: the Lord of the Universe, beholds the Lord in each and every heart. ||4||8||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਤਹ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਦ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch sabad tah pooran naad ||
english: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, echo the perfect sound current of the Naad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
transliteration: anahad baaje acharaj bisamaad ||
english: The wondrous, amazing unstruck melody vibrates.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਗ ॥
transliteration: kel karahi sa(n)t har log ||
english: The Saintly people play there with the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਿਰਜੋਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paarabraham pooran nirajog ||1||
english: They remain totally detached, absorbed in the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਭਵਨ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d bhavan ||
english: It is the realm of celestial peace and bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਹ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g bais gun gaavahi tah rog sog nahee janam maran ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sits and sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. There is no disease or sorrow there, no birth or death. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਹਾ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: oohaa simarahi keval naam ||
english: There, they meditate only on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਓਹੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: birale paavahi ohu bisraam ||
english: How rare are those who find this place of rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bhojan bhaau keeratan aadhaar ||
english: The love of God is their food, and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is their support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਨੁ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nihachal aasan besumaar ||2||
english: They obtain a permanent seat in the infinite. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਿਗਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dig na dolai katahoo na dhaavai ||
english: No one falls there, or wavers, or goes anywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad ko ihu mahal paavai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, some find this mansion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲ ॥
transliteration: bhram bhai moh na maaiaa jaal ||
english: They are not touched by doubt, fear, attachment or the traps of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੩॥
transliteration: su(n)n samaadh prabhoo kirapaal ||3||
english: They enter the deepest state of Samaadhi, through the kind mercy of God. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: taa kaa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: He has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape gupat aape paasaar ||
english: He Himself is unmanifest, and He Himself is manifest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai a(n)tar har har suaad ||
english: One who enjoys the taste of the Lord, Har, Har, deep within himself,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੦॥
transliteration: kahan na jaaee naanak bisamaad ||4||9||20||
english: O Nanak, his wondrous state cannot be described. ||4||9||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhetat sa(n)g paarabraham chit aaiaa ||
english: Meeting with the Sangat, the Congregation, the Supreme Lord God has come into my consciousness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਤ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)gat karat sa(n)tokh man paaiaa ||
english: In the Sangat, my mind has found contentment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਚਰਨ ਮਾਥਾ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਉਤ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tah charan maathaa mero paut ||
english: I touch my forehead to the feet of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਸੰਤਹ ਡੰਡਉਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anik baar sa(n)tah da(n)daut ||1||
english: Countless times, I humbly bow to the Saints. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ihu man sa(n)tan kai balihaaree ||
english: This mind is a sacrifice to the Saints;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee ot gahee sukh paaiaa raakhe kirapaa dhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: holding tight to their support, I have found peace, and in their mercy, they have protected me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tah charan dhoi dhoi peevaa ||
english: I wash the feet of the Saints, and drink in that water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tah daras pekh pekh jeevaa ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tah kee merai man aas ||
english: My mind rests its hopes in the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)t hamaaree niramal raas ||2||
english: The Saints are my immaculate wealth. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t hamaaraa raakhiaa paRadaa ||
english: The Saints have covered my faults.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਕੜਦਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad mohi kabahoo na kaRadaa ||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, I am no longer tormented.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗੁ ਦੀਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tah sa(n)g deeaa kirapaal ||
english: The Merciful Lord has blessed me with the Saints' Congregation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sahaaee bhae daiaal ||3||
english: The Compassionate Saints have become my help and support. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: surat mat budh paragaas ||
english: My consciousness, intellect and wisdom have been enlightened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: gahir ga(n)bheer apaar gunataas ||
english: The Lord is profound, unfathomable, infinite, the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sagale pratipaal ||
english: He cherishes all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)tah dekh nihaal ||4||10||21||
english: Nanak is enraptured, seeing the Saints. ||4||10||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: terai kaaj na grihu raaj maal ||
english: Your home, power and wealth will be of no use to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: terai kaaj na bikhai ja(n)jaal ||
english: Your corrupt worldly entanglements will be of no use to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸਟ ਮੀਤ ਜਾਣੁ ਸਭ ਛਲੈ ॥
transliteration: isat meet jaan sabh chhalai ||
english: Know that all your dear friends are fake.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har naam sa(n)g terai chalai ||1||
english: Only the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, will go along with you. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਲੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam gun gaai le meetaa har simarat teree laaj rahai ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, O friend; remembering the Lord in meditation, your honor shall be saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਮੁ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har simarat jam kachh na kahai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, the Messenger of Death will not touch you. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਰਾਰਥ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: bin har sagal niraarath kaam ||
english: Without the Lord, all pursuits are useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਦਾਮ ॥
transliteration: suinaa rupaa maatee daam ||
english: Gold, silver and wealth are just dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਮਨ ਸੁਖਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad jaap man sukhaa ||
english: Chanting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, your mind shall be at peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਤੇਰੋ ਊਜਲ ਮੁਖਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: eehaa oohaa tero oojal mukhaa ||2||
english: Here and hereafter, your face shall be radiant and bright. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kar kar thaake vade vadere ||
english: Even the greatest of the great worked and worked until they were exhausted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਨ ਕੀਏ ਕਾਜ ਮਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kin hee na keee kaaj maaiaa poore ||
english: None of them ever accomplished the tasks of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japai jan koi ||
english: Any humble being who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa kee aasaa pooran hoi ||3||
english: will have all his hopes fulfilled. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har bhagatan ko naam adhaar ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the anchor and support of the Lord's devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤੀ ਜੀਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tee jeetaa janam apaar ||
english: The Saints are victorious in this priceless human life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)t kare soee paravaan ||
english: Whatever the Lord's Saint does, is approved and accepted.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak daas taa kai kurabaan ||4||11||22||
english: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ||4||11||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਚਹਿ ਦਰਬੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲੋਗ ॥
transliteration: si(n)chahi darab dehi dukh log ||
english: You gather wealth by exploiting people.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਅਵਰਾ ਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: terai kaaj na avaraa jog ||
english: It is of no use to you; it was meant for others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਅੰਧ ॥
transliteration: kar aha(n)kaar hoi varatahi a(n)dh ||
english: You practice egotism, and act like a blind man.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਤੂ ਆਗੈ ਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jam kee jevaRee too aagai ba(n)dh ||1||
english: In the world hereafter, you shall be tied to the leash of the Messenger of Death. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਤਾਤਿ ਮੂੜੇ ॥
transliteration: chhaad vidaanee taat mooRe ||
english: Give up your envy of others, you fool!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਬਸਨਾ ਰਾਤਿ ਮੂੜੇ ॥
transliteration: eehaa basanaa raat mooRe ||
english: You only live here for a night, you fool!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਤੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਨਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa ke maate tai uth chalanaa ||
english: You are intoxicated with Maya, but you must soon arise and depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਤੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raach rahio too sa(n)g supanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are totally involved in the dream. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਅੰਧ ॥
transliteration: baal bivasathaa baarik a(n)dh ||
english: In his childhood, the child is blind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ॥
transliteration: bhar joban laagaa duraga(n)dh ||
english: In the fullness of youth, he is involved in foul-smelling sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਅ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਸਿੰਚੇ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tritee bivasathaa si(n)che maai ||
english: In the third stage of life, he gathers the wealth of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: biradh bhaiaa chhod chalio pachhutaai ||2||
english: And when he grows old, he must leave all this; he departs regretting and repenting. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਪਾਈ ਦ੍ਰੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: chira(n)kaal paaee drulabh deh ||
english: After a very long time, one obtains this precious human body, so difficult to obtain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਣੀ ਹੋਈ ਖੇਹ ॥
transliteration: naam bihoonee hoee kheh ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, it is reduced to dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਤੇ ਬੁਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pasoo paret mugadh te buree ||
english: Worse than a beast, a demon or an idiot,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਸਿਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tisahi na boojhai jin eh siree ||3||
english: is that one who does not understand who created him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sun karataar govi(n)d gopaal ||
english: Listen, O Creator Lord, Lord of the Universe, Lord of the World,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal sadaa kirapaal ||
english: Merciful to the meek, forever compassionate

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਛਡਾਵਹੁ ਛੁਟਕਹਿ ਬੰਧ ॥
transliteration: tumahi chhadaavahu chhutakahi ba(n)dh ||
english: If You emancipate the human, then his bonds are broken.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗ ਅੰਧ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੩॥
transliteration: bakhas milaavahu naanak jag a(n)dh ||4||12||23||
english: O Nanak, the people of world are blind; please, Lord, forgive them, and unite them with Yourself. ||4||12||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਬਨਾਈ ਕਾਛਿ ॥
transliteration: kar sa(n)jog banaaee kaachh ||
english: Joining the elements together, the robe of the body is fashioned.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਇਆਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ ॥
transliteration: tis sa(n)g rahio iaanaa raach ||
english: The ignorant fool is engrossed in it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: pratipaarai nit saar samaarai ||
english: He cherishes it, and constantly takes care of it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)t kee baar ooth sidhaarai ||1||
english: But at the very last moment, he must arise and depart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa sabh jhooth paraanee ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, everything is false, O mortal.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਠੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: govid bhajan bin avar sa(n)g raate te sabh maaiaa mooth paraanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who do not vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe, but instead are imbued with other things, - all those mortals are plundered by Maya. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ਨ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
transliteration: teerath naai na utaras mail ||
english: Bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, filth is not washed off.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਭਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਫੈਲੁ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam sabh haumai phail ||
english: Religious rituals are all just egotistical displays.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਪਚਾਰੈ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: lok pachaarai gat nahee hoi ||
english: By pleasing and appeasing people, no one is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਣੇ ਚਲਸਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam bihoone chalasahi roi ||2||
english: Without the Naam, they shall depart weeping. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਟੂਟਸਿ ਪਟਲ ॥
transliteration: bin har naam na tootas patal ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, the screen is not torn away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਧੇ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਗਲ ॥
transliteration: sodhe saasatr simrit sagal ||
english: I have studied all the Shaastras and Simritees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: so naam japai jis aap japaae ||
english: He alone chants the Naam, whom the Lord Himself inspires to chant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਫਲਾ ਸੇ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sagal phalaa se sookh samaae ||3||
english: He obtains all fruits and rewards, and merges in peace. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: raakhanahaare raakhahu aap ||
english: O Savior Lord, please save me!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸੁਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: sagal sukhaa prabh tumarai haath ||
english: All peace and comforts are in Your Hand, God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: jit laavahi tit laagah suaamee ||
english: Whatever you attach me to, to that I am attached, O my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੪॥
transliteration: naanak saahib a(n)tarajaamee ||4||13||24||
english: O Nanak, the Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||13||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karai soee sukh jaanaa ||
english: Whatever He does makes me happy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਅਸਮਝੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man asamajh saadhasa(n)g pateeaanaa ||
english: The ignorant mind is encouraged, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਠਹਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dolan te chookaa thaharaaiaa ||
english: Now, it does not waver at all; it has become stable and steady.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਲੇ ਸਤਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sat maahi le sat samaaiaa ||1||
english: Receiving Truth, it is merged in the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dookh gaiaa sabh rog gaiaa ||
english: Pain is gone, and all illness is gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee aagiaa man mahi maanee mahaa purakh kaa sa(n)g bhaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have accepted the Will of God in my mind, associating with the Great Person, the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal pavitr sarab niramalaa ||
english: All is pure; all is immaculate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਵਰਤਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਭਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jo varataae soee bhalaa ||
english: Whatever exists is good.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋਈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jah raakhai soee mukat thaan ||
english: Wherever He keeps me, that is the place of liberation for me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਪਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo japaae soee naam ||2||
english: Whatever He makes me chant, is His Name. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਹ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਧਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: athasath teerath jah saadh pag dharahi ||
english: That is the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where the Holy place their feet,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਜਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tah baiku(n)th jah naam ucharahi ||
english: and that is heaven, where the Naam is chanted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਅਨੰਦ ਜਬ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sarab ana(n)d jab darasan paaeeai ||
english: All bliss comes, when one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam gunaa nit nit har gaaeeai ||3||
english: I sing continuously, continually, the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aape ghat ghat rahiaa biaap ||
english: The Lord Himself is pervading in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਗਟ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: daiaal purakh paragat parataap ||
english: The glory of the Merciful Lord is radiant and manifest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਨੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਨਾਠੇ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kapat khulaane bhram naathe doore ||
english: The shutters are opened, and doubts have run away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੨੫॥
transliteration: naanak kau gur bhete poore ||4||14||25||
english: Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru. ||4||14||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kot jaap taap bisraam ||
english: Millions of meditations and austerities rest in him,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: ridh budh sidh sur giaan ||
english: along with wealth, wisdom, miraculous spiritual powers and angelic spiritual insight.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਭੋਗ ਰਸੈ ॥
transliteration: anik roop ra(n)g bhog rasai ||
english: He enjoys the various shows and forms, pleasures and delicacies;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh naam nimakh ridai vasai ||1||
english: the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells within the heart of the Gurmukh. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam kee vadiaaee ||
english: Such is the glorious greatness of the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: keemat kahan na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Its value cannot be described. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਧੀਰਜ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: soorabeer dheeraj mat pooraa ||
english: He alone is brave, patient and perfectly wise;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sahaj samaadh dhun gahir ga(n)bheeraa ||
english: he is intuitively in Samaadhi, profound and unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sadaa mukat taa ke poore kaam ||
english: He is liberated forever and all his affairs are perfectly resolved;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa kai ridai vasai har naam ||2||
english: the Lord's Name abides within his heart. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਅਰੋਗ ॥
transliteration: sagal sookh aana(n)d arog ||
english: He is totally peaceful, blissful and healthy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਿਰਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: samadarasee pooran nirajog ||
english: he looks upon all impartially, and is perfectly detached.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਡੋਲੈ ਕਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: aai na jaai dolai kat naahee ||
english: He does not come and go, and he never wavers;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kai naam basai man maahee ||3||
english: the Naam abides in his mind. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal goupaal govi(n)d ||
english: God is Merciful to the meek; He is the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਉਤਰੈ ਚਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: guramukh japeeai utarai chi(n)d ||
english: The Gurmukh meditates on Him, and his worries are gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak kau gur deeaa naam ||
english: The Guru has blessed Nanak with the Naam;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੬॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kee tahal sa(n)t kaa kaam ||4||15||26||
english: he serves the Saints, and works for the Saints. ||4||15||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੀਜ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: beej ma(n)tr har keeratan gaau ||
english: Sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and the Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aagai milee nithaave thaau ||
english: Even the homeless find a home in the world hereafter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kee charanee laag ||
english: Fall at the feet of the Perfect Guru;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa soiaa jaag ||1||
english: you have slept for so many incarnations - wake up! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਲਾ ॥
transliteration: har har jaap japalaa ||
english: Chant the Chant of the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਾਸੈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te hiradai vaasai bhaujal paar paralaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, it shall be enshrined within your heart, and you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨ ਅਟਲ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan dhiaai man atal ||
english: Meditate on the eternal treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਪਟਲ ॥
transliteration: taa chhootahi maaiaa ke patal ||
english: and then, the screen of Maya shall be torn away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad a(n)mrit ras peeu ||
english: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Guru's Shabad,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa teraa hoi niramal jeeu ||2||
english: and then your soul shall be rendered immaculate and pure. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sodhat sodhat sodh beechaaraa ||
english: Searching, searching, searching, I have realized

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bin har bhagat nahee chhutakaaraa ||
english: that without devotional worship of the Lord, no one is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: so har bhajan saadh kai sa(n)g ||
english: So vibrate, and meditate on that Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man tan raapai har kai ra(n)g ||3||
english: your mind and body shall be imbued with love for the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: chhod siaanap bahu chaturaaee ||
english: Renounce all your cleverness and trickery.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man bin har naavai jaai na kaaee ||
english: O mind, without the Lord's Name, there is no place of rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਗੋੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: daiaa dhaaree govid gousaaee ||
english: The Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the World, has taken pity on me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੭॥
transliteration: har har naanak tek tikaaee ||4||16||27||
english: Nanak seeks the protection and support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||16||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਕੇਲ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kai sa(n)g raam ra(n)g kel ||
english: In the Saints' Congregation, play joyfully with the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਲ ॥
transliteration: aagai jam siu hoi na mel ||
english: and you will not have to meet the Messenger of Death hereafter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਾ ਭਇਆ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)budh kaa bhaiaa binaas ||
english: Your egotistical intellect shall be dispelled,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਸਗਲੀ ਨਾਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: duramat hoee sagalee naas ||1||
english: and your evil-mindedness will be totally taken away. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥
transliteration: raam naam gun gaai pa(n)dit ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, O Pandit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਾਂਡ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਜੈ ਕੁਸਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karam kaa(n)d aha(n)kaar na kaajai kusal setee ghar jaahi pa(n)dit ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Religious rituals and egotism are of no use at all. You shall go home with happiness, O Pandit. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਨਿਧਿ ਲੀਆ ਲਾਭ ॥
transliteration: har kaa jas nidh leeaa laabh ||
english: I have earned the profit, the wealth of the Lord's praise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸਾਭ ॥
transliteration: pooran bhae manorath saabh ||
english: All my hopes have been fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਠਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dukh naathaa sukh ghar mahi aaiaa ||
english: Pain has left me, and peace has come to my home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad kamal bigasaaiaa ||2||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, my heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: naam ratan jin paaiaa daan ||
english: One who is blessed with the gift of the jewel of the Name,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: tis jan hoe sagal nidhaan ||
english: obtains all treasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਆਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tokh aaiaa man pooraa paai ||
english: His mind becomes content, finding the Perfect Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਾਗਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: phir phir maagan kaahe jaai ||3||
english: Why should he ever go begging again? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਤ ਪਵਿਤ ॥
transliteration: har kee kathaa sunat pavit ||
english: Hearing the Lord's sermon, he becomes pure and holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਬਕਤ ਪਾਈ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa bakat paaee gat mat ||
english: Chanting it with his tongue, he finds the way to salvation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: so paravaan jis ridai vasaaee ||
english: He alone is approved, who enshrines the Lord within his heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੨੮॥
transliteration: naanak te jan ootam bhaaee ||4||17||28||
english: Nanak: such a humble being is exalted, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||17||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਕਰੀ ਨ ਆਈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: gahu kar pakaree na aaee haath ||
english: No matter how hard you try to grab it, it does not come into your hands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਚਾਲੀ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: preet karee chaalee nahee saath ||
english: No matter how much you may love it, it does not go along with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਉ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਦਈ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jau tiaag daee ||
english: Says Nanak, when you abandon it,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਓਹ ਚਰਣੀ ਆਇ ਪਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tab oh charanee aai paee ||1||
english: then it comes and falls at your feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sun sa(n)tahu niramal beechaar ||
english: Listen, O Saints: this is the pure philosophy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam bin gat nahee kaaee gur pooraa bhetat udhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, there is no salvation. Meeting with the Perfect Guru, one is saved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਉਸ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jab us kau koee devai maan ||
english: When someone tries to appease her,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਆਪਸ ਊਪਰਿ ਰਖੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tab aapas oopar rakhai gumaan ||
english: then she takes pride in herself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਉਸ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jab us kau koee man paraharai ||
english: But when someone puts her out of his thoughts,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਓਹ ਸੇਵਕਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tab oh sevak sevaa karai ||2||
english: then she serves him like a slave. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਬੇਰਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਠਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mukh beraavai a(n)t thagaavai ||
english: She seems to please, but in the end, she deceives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਠਉਰ ਓਹ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ikat thaur oh kahee na samaavai ||
english: She does not remain in any one place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ॥
transliteration: un mohe bahute brahama(n)d ||
english: She has bewitched a great many worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਜਨੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam janee keenee kha(n)d kha(n)d ||3||
english: The Lord's humble servants cut her apart into pieces. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਭੂਖਾ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jo maagai so bhookhaa rahai ||
english: Whoever begs from her remains hungry.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੈ ਸੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥
transliteration: is sa(n)g raachai s kachhoo na lahai ||
english: Whoever is infatuated with her obtains nothing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: isahi tiaag satasa(n)gat karai ||
english: But one who renounces her, and joins the Society of the Saints,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੁ ਤਰੈ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੨੯॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee naanak ohu tarai ||4||18||29||
english: by great good fortune, O Nanak, is saved. ||4||18||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: aatam raam sarab mahi pekh ||
english: See the Lord, the Universal Soul, in all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੁ ॥
transliteration: pooran poor rahiaa prabh ek ||
english: The One God is perfect, and all-pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ratan amol ride mahi jaan ||
english: Know that the priceless jewel is within your own heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apanee vasat too aap pachhaan ||1||
english: Realize that your essence is within your own self. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: pee a(n)mrit sa(n)tan parasaad ||
english: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, by the Grace of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੁਆਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vade bhaag hovahi tau paaeeai bin jihavaa kiaa jaanai suaad ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who is blessed with high destiny, obtains it. Without a tongue, how can one know the taste? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਠ ਦਸ ਬੇਦ ਸੁਨੇ ਕਹ ਡੋਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ath das bed sune kah doraa ||
english: How can a deaf person listen to the eighteen Puraanas and the Vedas?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kot pragaas na disai a(n)dheraa ||
english: The blind man cannot see even a million lights.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਘਾਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚੈ ॥
transliteration: pasoo pareet ghaas sa(n)g rachai ||
english: The beast loves grass, and remains attached to it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੁਝੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis nahee bujhaavai so kit bidh bujhai ||2||
english: One who has not been taught - how can he understand? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: jaananahaar rahiaa prabh jaan ||
english: God, the Knower, knows all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਸੰਗਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: ot pot bhagatan sa(n)gaan ||
english: He is with His devotees, through and through.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਗਸਿ ਬਿਗਸਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bigas bigas apunaa prabh gaavahi ||
english: Those who sing God's Praises with joy and delight,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ॥੩॥੧੯॥੩੦॥
transliteration: naanak tin jam neR na aavahi ||3||19||30||
english: O Nanak - the Messenger of Death does not even approach them. ||3||19||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਓ ਪਵਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: deeno naam keeo pavit ||
english: Blessing me with His Name, He has purified and sanctified me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਇਹ ਬਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: har dhan raas niraas ih bit ||
english: The Lord's wealth is my capital. False hope has left me; this is my wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੀ ਬੰਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaatee ba(n)dh har sevaa laae ||
english: Breaking my bonds, the Lord has linked me to His service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har bhagat raam gun gaae ||1||
english: I am a devotee of the Lord, Har, Har; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: baaje anahad baajaa ||
english: The unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rasak rasak gun gaavahi har jan apanai guradev nivaajaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord's humble servants sing His Glorious Praises with love and delight; they are honored by the Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਬਨਿਓ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: aai banio poorabalaa bhaag ||
english: My pre-ordained destiny has been activated;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa soiaa jaag ||
english: I have awakened from the sleep of countless incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਈ ਗਿਲਾਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: gaee gilaan saadh kai sa(n)g ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my aversion is gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
