transliteration: man tan raato har kai ra(n)g ||2||
english: My mind and body are imbued with love for the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: raakhe raakhanahaar daiaal ||
english: The Merciful Savior Lord has saved me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
transliteration: naa kichh sevaa naa kichh ghaal ||
english: I have no service or work to my credit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh keenee daiaa ||
english: In His Mercy, God has taken pity on me;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: boodat dukh mahi kaadh laiaa ||3||
english: He lifted me up and pulled me out, when I was suffering in pain. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sun sun upajio man mahi chaau ||
english: Listening, listening to His Praises, joy has welled up within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar har ke gun gaau ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gaavat gaavat param gat paaee ||
english: Singing, singing His Praises, I have obtained the supreme status.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੩੧॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak liv laaee ||4||20||31||
english: By Guru's Grace, Nanak is lovingly focused on the Lord. ||4||20||31||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਰਤਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kaudee badalai tiaagai ratan ||
english: In exchange for a shell, he gives up a jewel.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਤਾਹੂ ਕਾ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
transliteration: chhod jaai taahoo kaa jatan ||
english: He tries to get what he must give up.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੰਚੈ ਜੋ ਹੋਛੀ ਬਾਤ ॥
transliteration: so sa(n)chai jo hochhee baat ||
english: He collects those things which are worthless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਟੇਢਉ ਜਾਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohiaa tedhau jaat ||1||
english: Enticed by Maya, he takes the crooked path. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਭਾਗੇ ਤੈ ਲਾਜ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: abhaage tai laaj naahee ||
english: You unfortunate man - have you no shame?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar pooran paramesar har na chetio man maahee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You do not remember in your mind the ocean of peace, the perfect Transcendent Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਉਰਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit kauraa bikhiaa meethee ||
english: Nectar seems bitter to you, and poison is sweet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਡੀਠੀ ॥
transliteration: saakat kee bidh nainahu deethee ||
english: Such is your condition, you faithless cynic, which I have seen with my own eyes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਰੀਝਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kooR kapat aha(n)kaar reejhaanaa ||
english: You are fond of falsehood, fraud and egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਛੂਅ ਡਸਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam sunat jan bichhoo dasaanaa ||2||
english: If you hear the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you feel like you have been stung by a scorpion. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਝੂਰੈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa kaaran sad hee jhoorai ||
english: You continually yearn for Maya,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: man mukh kabahi na usatat karai ||
english: and you never chant the Lord's Praises with your mouth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau nira(n)kaar daataar ||
english: The Lord is fearless and formless; He is the Great Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis siu preet na karai gavaar ||3||
english: But you do not love Him, you fool! ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸਾਹਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh saahaa sir saachaa saahu ||
english: God, the True King, is above the heads of all kings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੇਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: vemuhataaj pooraa paatisaahu ||
english: He is the independent, perfect Lord King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਗਿਰਹ ॥
transliteration: moh magan lapatio bhram girah ||
english: People are intoxicated by emotional attachment, entangled in doubt and family life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਹਰ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੩੨॥
transliteration: naanak tareeai teree mihar ||4||21||32||
english: Nanak: they are saved only by Your Mercy, Lord. ||4||21||32||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਜਪਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: rain dinas japau har naau ||
english: Night and day, I chant the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਉ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aagai daragah paavau thaau ||
english: Hereafter, I shall obtain a seat in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d na hovee sog ||
english: I am in bliss forever; I have no sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kabahoo na biaapai haumai rog ||1||
english: The disease of ego never afflicts me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: khojahu sa(n)tahu har braham giaanee ||
english: O Saints of the Lord, seek out those who know God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਾ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bisaman bisam bhae bisamaadaa param gat paavahi har simar paraanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall be wonderstruck with wonder at the wonderful Lord; meditate in remembrance on the Lord, O mortal, and obtain the supreme status. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਨਿ ਮਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gan min dekhahu sagal beechaar ||
english: Calculating, measuring, and thinking in every way,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa ko sakai na taar ||
english: see that without the Naam, no one can be carried across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਵ ਨ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: sagal upaav na chaalahi sa(n)g ||
english: Of all your efforts, none will go along with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhavajal tareeai prabh kai ra(n)g ||2||
english: You can cross over the terrifying world-ocean only through the love of God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਧੋਇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
transliteration: dehee dhoi na utarai mail ||
english: By merely washing the body, one's filth is not removed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਫੈਲੁ ॥
transliteration: haumai biaapai dubidhaa phail ||
english: Afflicted by egotism, duality only increases.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har har aukhadh jo jan khaai ||
english: That humble being who takes the medicine of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa kaa rog sagal mit jaai ||3||
english: - all his diseases are eradicated. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa paarabraham daiaal ||
english: Take pity on me, O merciful, Supreme Lord God;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: man te kabahu na bisar goupaal ||
english: let me never forget the Lord of the World from my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tere daas kee hovaa dhoor ||
english: Let me be the dust of the feet of Your slaves;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੩੩॥
transliteration: naanak kee prabh saradhaa poor ||4||22||33||
english: O God, please fulfill Nanak's hope. ||4||22||33||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: teree saran poore guradev ||
english: You are my Protection, O perfect Divine Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tudh bin doojaa naahee koi ||
english: There is no other than You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
transliteration: too samarath pooran paarabraham ||
english: You are all-powerful, O perfect Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧਿਆਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so dhiaae pooraa jis karam ||1||
english: He alone meditates on You, whose karma is perfect. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਰਣ ਤਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taran taaran prabh tero naau ||
english: You Name, God, is the boat to carry us across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ekaa saran gahee man merai tudh bin doojaa naahee thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind has grasped Your protection alone. Other than You, I have no place of rest at all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jap jap jeevaa teraa naau ||
english: Chanting, meditating on Your Name, I live,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਉ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aagai daragah paavau thaau ||
english: and hereafter, I will obtain a seat in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dookh a(n)dheraa man te jaai ||
english: Pain and darkness are gone from my mind;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਰਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: duramat binasai raachai har naai ||2||
english: my evil-mindedness is dispelled, and I am absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu laagee preet ||
english: I have enshrined love for the Lord's lotus feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kee niramal reet ||
english: The lifestyle of the Perfect Guru is immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ॥
transliteration: bhau bhaagaa nirabhau man basai ||
english: My fear has run away, and the fearless Lord dwells within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਿਤ ਜਪੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam rasanaa nit japai ||3||
english: My tongue continually chants the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਫਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: kot janam ke kaate phaahe ||
english: The nooses of millions of incarnations are cut away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਲਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: paaiaa laabh sachaa dhan laahe ||
english: I have obtained the profit of the true wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: tot na aavai akhut bha(n)daar ||
english: This treasure is inexhaustible; it will never run out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੩੪॥
transliteration: naanak bhagat sohahi har duaar ||4||23||34||
english: O Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in the Court of the Lord. ||4||23||34||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ratan javehar naam ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a jewel, a ruby.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh giaan ||
english: It brings Truth, contentment and spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਦਇਆ ਕਾ ਪੋਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj daiaa kaa potaa ||
english: The Lord entrusts the treasures of peace,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਵਾਲੈ ਹੋਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har bhagataa havaalai hotaa ||1||
english: Intuition and kindness to His devotees. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mere raam ko bha(n)daar ||
english: This is the treasure of my Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਿ ਕਛੁ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khaat kharach kachh tot na aavai a(n)t nahee har paaraavaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Consuming and expending it, it is never used up. The Lord has no end or limitation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: keeratan niramolak heeraa ||
english: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is a priceless diamond.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aana(n)d gunee gaheeraa ||
english: It is the ocean of bliss and virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ॥
transliteration: anahad baanee poo(n)jee ||
english: In the Word of the Guru's Bani is the wealth of the unstruck sound current.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਹਥਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਕੂੰਜੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan hath raakhee koo(n)jee ||2||
english: The Saints hold the key to it in their hands. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਗੁਫਾ ਤਹ ਆਸਨੁ ॥
transliteration: su(n)n samaadh guphaa tah aasan ||
english: They sit there, in the cave of deep Samaadhi;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਹ ਬਾਸਨੁ ॥
transliteration: keval braham pooran tah baasan ||
english: the unique, perfect Lord God dwells there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਕਰਤ ॥
transliteration: bhagat sa(n)g prabh gosat karat ||
english: God holds conversations with His devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਹਰਖ ਨ ਸੋਗ ਨ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਰਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tah harakh na sog na janam na marat ||3||
english: There is no pleasure or pain, no birth or death there. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis aap divaaiaa ||
english: One whom the Lord Himself blesses with His Mercy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g tin har dhan paaiaa ||
english: obtains the Lord's wealth in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: daiaal purakh naanak aradaas ||
english: Nanak prays to the merciful Primal Lord;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੫॥
transliteration: har meree varatan har meree raas ||4||24||35||
english: the Lord is my merchandise, and the Lord is my capital. ||4||24||35||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਬੇਦ ॥
transliteration: mahimaa na jaanahi bed ||
english: The Vedas do not know His greatness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਭੇਦ ॥
transliteration: brahame nahee jaanahi bhed ||
english: Brahma does not know His mystery.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਤਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: avataar na jaanahi a(n)t ||
english: Incarnated beings do not know His limit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paramesar paarabraham bea(n)t ||1||
english: The Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God, is infinite. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਗਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: apanee gat aap jaanai ||
english: Only He Himself knows His own state.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਅਵਰ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sun sun avar vakhaanai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Others speak of Him only by hearsay. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਕਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਭੇਵ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)karaa nahee jaanahi bhev ||
english: Shiva does not know His mystery.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਹਾਰੇ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: khojat haare dev ||
english: The gods gave grown weary of searching for Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀਆ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਮਰਮ ॥
transliteration: deveeaa nahee jaanai maram ||
english: The goddesses do not know His mystery.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh oopar alakh paarabraham ||2||
english: Above all is the unseen, Supreme Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੇਲ ॥
transliteration: apanai ra(n)g karataa kel ||
english: The Creator Lord plays His own plays.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬਿਛੋਰੈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲ ॥
transliteration: aap bichhorai aape mel ||
english: He Himself separates, and He Himself unites.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮੇ ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ik bharame ik bhagatee laae ||
english: Some wander around, while others are linked to His devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਜਣਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: apanaa keeaa aap janaae ||3||
english: By His actions, He makes Himself known. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kee sun saachee saakhee ||
english: Listen to the true story of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਜੋ ਪੇਖਹਿ ਆਖੀ ॥
transliteration: so bolahi jo pekhahi aakhee ||
english: They speak only of what they see with their eyes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਲੇਪੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: nahee lep tis pu(n)n na paap ||
english: He is not involved with virtue or vice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੩੬॥
transliteration: naanak kaa prabh aape aap ||4||25||36||
english: Nanak's God is Himself all-in-all. ||4||25||36||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਛਹੂ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਕੀਓ ਜਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: kichhahoo kaaj na keeo jaan ||
english: I have not tried to do anything through knowledge.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਿ ॥
transliteration: surat mat naahee kichh giaan ||
english: I have no knowledge, intelligence or spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਸੀਲ ਨਹੀ ਧਰਮ ॥
transliteration: jaap taap seel nahee dharam ||
english: I have not practiced chanting, deep meditation, humility or righteousness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਕਰਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kichhoo na jaanau kaisaa karam ||1||
english: I know nothing of such good karma. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: thaakur preetam prabh mere ||
english: O my Beloved God, my Lord and Master,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਭੂਲਹ ਚੂਕਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin doojaa avar na koee bhoolah chookah prabh tere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: there is none other than You. Even though I wander and make mistakes, I am still Yours, God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: ridh na budh na sidh pragaas ||
english: I have no wealth, no intelligence, no miraculous spiritual powers; I am not enlightened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੇ ਗਾਵ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: bikhai biaadh ke gaav mahi baas ||
english: I dwell in the village of corruption and sickness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: karanahaar mere prabh ek ||
english: O my One Creator Lord God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਟੇਕ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam tere kee man mahi tek ||2||
english: Your Name is the support of my mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਉ ਮਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sun sun jeevau man ihu bisraam ||
english: Hearing, hearing Your Name, I live; this is my mind's consolation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: paap kha(n)dan prabh tero naam ||
english: Your Name, God, is the Destroyer of sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਗਨਤੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: too aganat jee kaa daataa ||
english: You, O Limitless Lord, are the Giver of the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਣਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jisahi janaavahi tin too jaataa ||3||
english: He alone knows You, unto whom You reveal Yourself. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਪਾਇਓ ਤਿਸੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: jo upaaio tis teree aas ||
english: Whoever has been created, rests his hopes in You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
transliteration: sagal araadhahi prabh gunataas ||
english: All worship and adore You, God, O treasure of excellence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak daas terai kurabaan ||
english: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੩੭॥
transliteration: bea(n)t saahib meraa miharavaan ||4||26||37||
english: My merciful Lord and Master is infinite. ||4||26||37||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: raakhanahaar daiaal ||
english: The Savior Lord is merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਭਵ ਖੰਡੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਖਿਆਲ ॥
transliteration: kot bhav kha(n)de nimakh khiaal ||
english: Millions of incarnations are eradicated in an instant, contemplating the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਜੰਤ ॥
transliteration: sagal araadhahi ja(n)t ||
english: All beings worship and adore Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mileeai prabh gur mil ma(n)t ||1||
english: Receiving the Guru's Mantra, one meets God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ॥
transliteration: jeean ko daataa meraa prabh ||
english: My God is the Giver of souls.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pooran paramesur suaamee ghat ghat raataa meraa prabh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Transcendent Lord Master, my God, imbues each and every heart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਹੀ ਮਨ ਓਟ ॥
transliteration: taa kee gahee man ot ||
english: My mind has grasped His Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ਛੋਟ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan te hoee chhot ||
english: My bonds have been shattered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਪਿ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: hiradai jap paramaana(n)d ||
english: Within my heart, I meditate on the Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man maahi bhae ana(n)d ||2||
english: My mind is filled with ecstasy. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣ ॥
transliteration: taaran taran har saran ||
english: The Lord's Sanctuary is the boat to carry us across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ॥
transliteration: jeevan roop har charan ||
english: The Lord's Feet are the embodiment of life itself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan ke praan adhaar ||
english: They are the Support of the breath of life of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ooche te ooch apaar ||3||
english: God is infinite, the highest of the high. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: s mat saar jit har simareejai ||
english: That mind is excellent and sublime, which meditates in remembrance on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis aape deejai ||
english: In His Mercy, the Lord Himself bestows it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d har naau ||
english: Peace, intuitive poise and bliss are found in the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੩੮॥
transliteration: naanak japiaa gur mil naau ||4||27||38||
english: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak chants the Name. ||4||27||38||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਛਾਡਿ ॥
transliteration: sagal siaanap chhaad ||
english: Abandon all your clever tricks.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਜਿ ॥
transliteration: kar sevaa sevak saaj ||
english: Become His servant, and serve Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: apanaa aap sagal mitaai ||
english: Totally erase your self-conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man chi(n)de seee phal paai ||1||
english: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ॥
transliteration: hohu saavadhaan apune gur siu ||
english: Be awake and aware with your Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa pooran hovai paavahi sagal nidhaan gur siu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your hopes and desires shall be fulfilled, and you shall obtain all treasures from the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: doojaa nahee jaanai koi ||
english: Let no one think that God and Guru are separate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satagur nira(n)jan soi ||
english: The True Guru is the Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: maanukh kaa kar roop na jaan ||
english: Do not believe that He is a mere human being;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੀ ਨਿਮਾਨੇ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: milee nimaane maan ||2||
english: He gives honor to the dishonored. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kee har tek tikaai ||
english: Hold tight to the Support of the Guru, the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਆਸਾ ਸਭ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: avar aasaa sabh laahi ||
english: Give up all other hopes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਾਗੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam maag nidhaan ||
english: Ask for the treasure of the Name of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: taa daragah paavahi maan ||3||
english: and then you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa bachan jap ma(n)t ||
english: Chant the Mantra of the Guru's Word.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਾਰ ਤਤੁ ॥
transliteration: ehaa bhagat saar tat ||
english: This is the essence of true devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhae daiaal ||
english: When the True Guru becomes merciful,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak daas nihaal ||4||28||39||
english: slave Nanak is enraptured. ||4||28||39||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: hovai soee bhal maan ||
english: Whatever happens, accept that as good.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨਾ ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa taj abhimaan ||
english: Leave your egotistical pride behind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: din rain sadaa gun gaau ||
english: Day and night, continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਏਹੀ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pooran ehee suaau ||1||
english: This is the perfect purpose of human life. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aana(n)d kar sa(n)t har jap ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, O Saints, and be in bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪਿ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chhaad siaanap bahu chaturaaee gur kaa jap ma(n)t niramal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Renounce your cleverness and all your tricks. Chant the Immaculate Chant of the Guru's Mantra. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਭੀਤਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ek kee kar aas bheetar ||
english: Place the hopes of your mind in the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: niramal jap naam har har ||
english: Chant the Immaculate Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan namasakaar ||
english: Bow down to the Guru's Feet,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhavajal utarahi paar ||2||
english: and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥
transliteration: devanahaar daataar ||
english: The Lord God is the Great Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: He has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai ghar sarab nidhaan ||
english: All treasures are in His home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raakhanahaar nidaan ||3||
english: He will be your Saving Grace in the end. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: naanak paaiaa ehu nidhaan ||
english: Nanak has obtained this treasure,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: hare har niramal naam ||
english: the immaculate Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo japai tis kee gat hoi ||
english: Whoever chants it, is emancipated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੪੦॥
transliteration: naanak karam paraapat hoi ||4||29||40||
english: It is obtained only by His Grace. ||4||29||40||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dulabh deh savaar ||
english: Make this invaluable human life fruitful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਹਿ ਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jaahi na daragah haar ||
english: You shall not be destroyed when you go to the Lord's Court.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: halat palat tudh hoi vadiaaee ||
english: In this world and the next, you shall obtain honor and glory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)t kee belaa lae chhadaaee ||1||
english: At the very last moment, He will save you. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam ke gun gaau ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਦੋਵੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: halat palat hohi dovai suhele acharaj purakh dhiaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In both this world and the next, you shall be embellished with beauty, meditating on the wondrous Primal Lord God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat har jaap ||
english: While standing up and sitting down, meditate on the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: binasai sagal sa(n)taap ||
english: and all your troubles shall depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰੀ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: bairee sabh hovahi meet ||
english: All your enemies will become friends.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੀਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: niramal teraa hovai cheet ||2||
english: Your consciousness shall be immaculate and pure. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਇਹੁ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh te ootam ihu karam ||
english: This is the most exalted deed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਮਹਿ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sagal dharam mahi sresat dharam ||
english: Of all faiths, this is the most sublime and excellent faith.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har simaran teraa hoi udhaar ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, you shall be saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਉਤਰੈ ਭਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa utarai bhaar ||3||
english: You shall be rid of the burden of countless incarnations. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: pooran teree hovai aas ||
english: Your hopes shall be fulfilled,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jam kee kateeai teree phaas ||
english: and the noose of the Messenger of Death will be cut away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਨੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa upades suneejai ||
english: So listen to the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੪੧॥
transliteration: naanak sukh sahaj sameejai ||4||30||41||
english: O Nanak, you shall be absorbed in celestial peace. ||4||30||41||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jis kee tis kee kar maan ||
english: Honor the One, to whom everything belongs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਲਾਹਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aapan laahi gumaan ||
english: Leave your egotistical pride behind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਤੂ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa too tis kaa sabh koi ||
english: You belong to Him; everyone belongs to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tisahi araadh sadaa sukh hoi ||1||
english: Worship and adore Him, and you shall be at peace forever. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਹਿ ਬਿਗਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: kaahe bhram bhramahi bigaane ||
english: Why do you wander in doubt, you fool?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa kichh kaam na aavai meraa meraa kar bahut pachhutaane ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, nothing is of any use at all. Crying out, 'Mine, mine', a great many have departed, regretfully repenting. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jo jo karai soee maan lehu ||
english: Whatever the Lord has done, accept that as good.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਾਨੇ ਰਲਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਖੇਹ ॥
transliteration: bin maane ral hovahi kheh ||
english: Without accepting, you shall mingle with dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: tis kaa bhaanaa laagai meethaa ||
english: His Will seems sweet to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur prasaad virale man voothaa ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: veparavaahu agochar aap ||
english: He Himself is carefree and independent, imperceptible.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar man taa kau jaap ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, O mind, meditate on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਦੁਖਾ ॥
transliteration: jis chit aae binasahi dukhaa ||
english: When He comes into the consciousness, pain is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਊਜਲ ਮੁਖਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: halat palat teraa oojal mukhaa ||3||
english: Here and hereafter, your face shall be radiant and bright. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਉਧਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaun kaun udhare gun gaai ||
english: Who, and how many have been saved, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਨਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ganan na jaaee keem na paai ||
english: They cannot be counted or evaluated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਲੋਹ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: boodat loh saadhasa(n)g tarai ||
english: Even the sinking iron is saved, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੪੨॥
transliteration: naanak jisahi paraapat karai ||4||31||42||
english: O Nanak, as His Grace is received. ||4||31||42||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਾਪਿ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: man maahi jaap bhagava(n)t ||
english: In your mind, meditate on the Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਇਹੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai ihu deeno ma(n)t ||
english: This is the Teaching given by the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੇ ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
transliteration: mite sagal bhai traas ||
english: All fears and terrors are taken away,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pooran hoee aas ||1||
english: and your hopes shall be fulfilled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: saphal sevaa guradevaa ||
english: Service to the Divine Guru is fruitful and rewarding.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: keemat kichh kahan na jaaee saache sach alakh abhevaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: His value cannot be described; the True Lord is unseen and mysterious. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan aap ||
english: He Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: tis kau sadaa man jaap ||
english: Meditate on Him forever, O my mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: tis kee sevaa kar neet ||
english: And continually serve Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sach sahaj sukh paavahi meet ||2||
english: You shall be blessed with truth, intuition and peace, O my friend. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saahib meraa at bhaaraa ||
english: My Lord and Master is so very great.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi thaap uthaapanahaaraa ||
english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tis bin avar na koee ||
english: There is no other than Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jan kaa raakhaa soee ||3||
english: He is the Saving Grace of His humble servant. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa aradaas suneejai ||
english: Please take pity on me, and hear my prayer,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: apane sevak kau darasan deejai ||
english: that Your servant may behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਪੀ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak jaapee jap jaap ||
english: Nanak chants the Chant of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੪੩॥
transliteration: sabh te ooch jaa kaa parataap ||4||32||43||
english: whose glory and radiance are the highest of all. ||4||32||43||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: birathaa bharavaasaa lok ||
english: Reliance on mortal man is useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: thaakur prabh teree tek ||
english: O God, my Lord and Master, You are my only Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਛੂਟੀ ਸਭ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: avar chhootee sabh aas ||
english: I have discarded all other hopes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: achi(n)t thaakur bhete gunataas ||1||
english: I have met with my carefree Lord and Master, the treasure of virtue. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: eko naam dhiaai man mere ||
english: Meditate on the Name of the Lord alone, O my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaaraj teraa hovai pooraa har har har gun gaai man mere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your affairs shall be perfectly resolved; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ॥
transliteration: tum hee kaaran karan ||
english: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal har saran ||
english: Your lotus feet, Lord, are my Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਓਹੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: man tan har ohee dhiaaiaa ||
english: I meditate on the Lord in my mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aana(n)d har roop dikhaaiaa ||2||
english: The blissful Lord has revealed His form to me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਸਦੀਵ ॥
transliteration: tis hee kee ot sadeev ||
english: I seek His eternal support;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਹੈ ਜੀਵ ॥
transliteration: jaa ke keene hai jeev ||
english: He is the Creator of all beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: simarat har karat nidhaan ||
english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, the treasure is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raakhanahaar nidaan ||3||
english: At the very last instant, He shall be your Savior. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕੀ ਰੇਣ ਹੋਵੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: sarab kee ren hoveejai ||
english: Be the dust of all men's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: aap mitaai mileejai ||
english: Eradicate self-conceit, and merge in the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: anadin dhiaaeeai naam ||
english: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੪੪॥
transliteration: saphal naanak ihu kaam ||4||33||44||
english: O Nanak, this is the most rewarding activity. ||4||33||44||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਕਰੀਮ ॥
transliteration: kaaran karan kareem ||
english: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the bountiful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਰਹੀਮ ॥
transliteration: sarab pratipaal raheem ||
english: The merciful Lord cherishes all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਲਹ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: alah alakh apaar ||
english: The Lord is unseen and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੁਦਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਵਡ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khud khudaai vad besumaar ||1||
english: God is great and endless. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓੁਂ ਨਮੋ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ou(n) namo bhagava(n)t gusaaee ||
english: I humbly pray to invoke the Universal Lord God, the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਲਕੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khaalak rav rahiaa sarab thaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Creator Lord is all-pervading, everywhere. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਮਾਧੋ ॥
transliteration: jaga(n)naath jagajeevan maadho ||
english: He is the Lord of the Universe, the Life of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਰਾਧੋ ॥
transliteration: bhau bha(n)jan rid maahi araadho ||
english: Within your heart, worship and adore the Destroyer of fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਿਖੀਕੇਸ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋੁਵਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: rikheekes gopaal gouvi(n)d ||
english: The Master Rishi of the senses, Lord of the World, Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੁਕੰਦ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pooran sarabatr muka(n)d ||2||
english: He is perfect, ever-present everywhere, the Liberator. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਮਉਲਾ ਤੂਹੀ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: miharavaan maulaa toohee ek ||
english: You are the One and only merciful Master,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਪੈਕਾਂਬਰ ਸੇਖ ॥
transliteration: peer paikaa(n)bar sekh ||
english: spiritual teacher, prophet, religious teacher.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਲਾ ਕਾ ਮਾਲਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: dilaa kaa maalak kare haak ||
english: Master of hearts, Dispenser of justice,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਰਾਨ ਕਤੇਬ ਤੇ ਪਾਕੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kuraan kateb te paak ||3||
english: more sacred than the Koran and the Bible. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਰਹਰ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: naaraain narahar daiaal ||
english: The Lord is powerful and merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ramat raam ghat ghat aadhaar ||
english: The all-pervading Lord is the support of each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਬਸਤ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: baasudev basat sabh thaai ||
english: The luminous Lord dwells everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੀਲਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: leelaa kichh lakhee na jaai ||4||
english: His play cannot be known. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: mihar daiaa kar karanaihaar ||
english: Be kind and compassionate to me, O Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: bhagat ba(n)dagee dehi sirajanahaar ||
english: Bless me with devotion and meditation, O Lord Creator.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਏ ਭਰਮ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur khoe bharam ||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has rid me of doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਅਲਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥੫॥੩੪॥੪੫॥
transliteration: eko alahu paarabraham ||5||34||45||
english: The Muslim God Allah and the Hindu God Paarbrahm are one and the same. ||5||34||45||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਪਾਪ ॥
transliteration: kot janam ke binase paap ||
english: The sins of millions of incarnations are eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
transliteration: har har japat naahee sa(n)taap ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, pain will not afflict you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੇ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan kamal man vase ||
english: When the Lord's lotus feet are enshrined in the mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਨਸੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mahaa bikaar tan te sabh nase ||1||
english: all terrible evils are taken away from the body. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gopaal ko jas gaau praanee ||
english: Sing the Praise of the Lord of the World, O mortal being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: akath kathaa saachee prabh pooran jotee jot samaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Unspoken Speech of the True Lord God is perfect. Dwelling upon it, one's light merges into the Light. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa bhookh sabh naasee ||
english: Hunger and thirst are totally quenched;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad japiaa abinaasee ||
english: by the Grace of the Saints, meditate on the immortal Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੈਨਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: rain dinas prabh sev kamaanee ||
english: Night and day, serve God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਕੀ ਏਹ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har milanai kee eh neesaanee ||2||
english: This is the sign that one has met with the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੇ ਜੰਜਾਲ ਹੋਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: mite ja(n)jaal hoe prabh daiaal ||
english: Worldly entanglements are ended, when God becomes merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa darasan dekh nihaal ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I am enraptured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਬਣਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paraa poorabalaa karam ban aaiaa ||
english: My perfect pre-destined karma has been activated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har ke gun nit rasanaa gaaiaa ||3||
english: With my tongue, I continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t sadaa paravaan ||
english: The Saints of the Lord are accepted and approved forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa masatak neesaan ||
english: The foreheads of the Saintly people are marked with the Lord's insignia.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੇ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: daas kee ren paae je koi ||
english: One who is blessed with the dust of the feet of the Lord's slave,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੪੬॥
transliteration: naanak tis kee param gat hoi ||4||35||46||
english: O Nanak, obtains the supreme status. ||4||35||46||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: darasan kau jaaeeai kurabaan ||
english: Let yourself be a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਰਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal hiradai dhar dhiaan ||
english: Focus your heart's meditation on the Lord's lotus feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੂਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dhoor sa(n)tan kee masatak laai ||
english: Apply the dust of the feet of the Saints to your forehead,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam janam kee duramat mal jaai ||1||
english: and the filthy evil-mindedness of countless incarnations will be washed off. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jis bhetat mitai abhimaan ||
english: Meeting Him, egotistical pride is eradicated,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham sabh nadaree aavai kar kirapaa pooran bhagavaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and you will come to see the Supreme Lord God in all. The Perfect Lord God has showered His Mercy. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kee keerat japeeai har naau ||
english: This is the Guru's Praise, to chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kee bhagat sadaa gun gaau ||
english: This is devotion to the Guru, to sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kee surat nikat kar jaan ||
english: This is contemplation upon the Guru, to know that the Lord is close at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad sat kar maan ||2||
english: Accept the Word of the Guru's Shabad as Truth. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਦੂਖ ॥
transliteration: gur bachanee samasar sukh dookh ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, look upon pleasure and pain as one and the same.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ॥
transliteration: kade na biaapai trisanaa bhookh ||
english: Hunger and thirst shall never afflict you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: man sa(n)tokh sabad gur raaje ||
english: The mind becomes content and satisfied through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਪੜਦੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jap gobi(n)d paRade sabh kaaje ||3||
english: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, and He will cover all your faults. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: gur paramesar gur govi(n)d ||
english: The Guru is the Supreme Lord God; the Guru is the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: gur daataa daiaal bakhasi(n)d ||
english: The Guru is the Great Giver, merciful and forgiving.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: gur charanee jaa kaa man laagaa ||
english: One whose mind is attached to the Guru's feet,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੩੬॥੪੭॥
transliteration: naanak daas tis pooran bhaagaa ||4||36||47||
english: O slave Nanak, is blessed with perfect destiny. ||4||36||47||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਭਰਵਾਸੈ ਬਿਚਰਹਿ ਭਵਨ ॥
transliteration: kis bharavaasai bicharahi bhavan ||
english: What supports you in this world?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਕਵਨ ॥
transliteration: mooR mugadh teraa sa(n)gee kavan ||
english: You ignorant fool, who is your companion?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
transliteration: raam sa(n)gee tis gat nahee jaanahi ||
english: The Lord is your only companion; no one knows His condition.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰੇ ਸੇ ਮੀਤ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch batavaare se meet kar maanahi ||1||
english: You look upon the five thieves as your friends. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: so ghar sev jit udharahi meet ||
english: Serve that home, which will save you, my friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਰਵੀਅਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gun govi(n)d raveeahi din raatee saadhasa(n)g kar man kee preet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, day and night; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, love Him in your mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਹਾਨੋ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਰੁ ਵਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: janam bihaano aha(n)kaar ar vaad ||
english: This human life is passing away in egotism and conflict.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: tripat na aavai bikhiaa saad ||
english: You are not satisfied; such is the flavor of sin.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਤ ਭਰਮਤ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bharamat bharamat mahaa dukh paaiaa ||
english: Wandering and roaming around, you suffer terrible pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਰੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਦੁਤਰ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taree na jaaee dutar maaiaa ||2||
english: You cannot cross over the impassable sea of Maya. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kaam na aavai s kaar kamaavai ||
english: You do the deeds which do not help you at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aap beej aape hee khaavai ||
english: As you plant, so shall you harvest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: raakhan kau doosar nahee koi ||
english: There is none other than the Lord to save you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ਜਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tau nisatarai jau kirapaa hoi ||3||
english: You will be saved, only if God grants His Grace. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: patit puneet prabh tero naam ||
english: Your Name, God, is the Purifier of sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: apane daas kau keejai daan ||
english: Please bless Your slave with that gift.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh gat kar meree ||
english: Please grant Your Grace, God, and emancipate me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੪੮॥
transliteration: saran gahee naanak prabh teree ||4||37||48||
english: Nanak has grasped Your Sanctuary, God. ||4||37||48||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਲੋਕੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ih loke sukh paaiaa ||
english: I have found peace in this world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਭੇਟਤ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nahee bhetat dharam raaiaa ||
english: I will not have to appear before the Righteous Judge of Dharma to give my account.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ॥
transliteration: har daragah sobhaava(n)t ||
english: I will be respected in the Court of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਸੰਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: phun garabh naahee basa(n)t ||1||
english: and I will not have to enter the womb of reincarnation ever again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨੀ ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaanee sa(n)t kee mitraaee ||
english: Now, I know the value of friendship with the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa deeno har naamaa poorab sa(n)jog milaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In His Mercy, the Lord has blessed me with His Name. My pre-ordained destiny has been fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਚਰਣਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kai charan chit laagaa ||
english: My consciousness is attached to the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n sa(n)jog sabhaagaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed is this fortunate time of union.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kee dhoor laagee merai maathe ||
english: I have applied the dust of the Saints' feet to my forehead,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kilavikh dukh sagale mere laathe ||2||
english: and all my sins and pains have been eradicated. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: saadh kee sach tahal kamaanee ||
english: Performing true service to the Holy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਹੋਏ ਮਨ ਸੁਧ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: tab hoe man sudh paraanee ||
english: the mortal's mind is purified.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: jan kaa saphal daras deethaa ||
english: I have seen the fruitful vision of the Lord's humble slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵੂਠਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam prabhoo kaa ghat ghat voothaa ||3||
english: God's Name dwells within each and every heart. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਾਨੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
transliteration: mitaane sabh kal kales ||
english: All my troubles and sufferings have been taken away;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
transliteration: jis te upaje tis mahi paraves ||
english: I have merged into the One, from whom I originated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਆਨੂਪ ਗੋੁਵਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: pragate aanoop gouvi(n)d ||
english: The Lord of the Universe, incomparably beautiful, has become merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿੰਦ ॥੪॥੩੮॥੪੯॥
transliteration: prabh poore naanak bakhasi(n)d ||4||38||49||
english: O Nanak, God is perfect and forgiving. ||4||38||49||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਊ ਕਉ ਚਾਰੇ ਸਾਰਦੂਲੁ ॥
transliteration: gaoo kau chaare saaradool ||
english: The tiger leads the cow to the pasture,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਡੀ ਕਾ ਲਖ ਹੂਆ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
transliteration: kaudee kaa lakh hooaa mool ||
english: the shell is worth thousands of dollars,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਕਰੀ ਕਉ ਹਸਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: bakaree kau hasatee pratipaale ||
english: and the elephant nurses the goat,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apanaa prabh nadar nihaale ||1||
english: when God bestows His Glance of Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kripaa nidhaan preetam prabh mere ||
english: You are the treasure of mercy, O my Beloved Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: baran na saakau bahu gun tere ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I cannot even describe Your many Glorious Virtues. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਸਤ ਮਾਸੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ਬਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: deesat maas na khaai bilaaee ||
english: The cat sees the meat, but does not eat it,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਕਸਾਬਿ ਛੁਰੀ ਸਟਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mahaa kasaab chhuree sat paaee ||
english: and the great butcher throws away his knife;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵੂਠਾ ॥
transliteration: karanahaar prabh hiradai voothaa ||
english: the Creator Lord God abides in the heart;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਾਥੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕਾ ਜਾਲਾ ਤੂਟਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: phaathee machhulee kaa jaalaa tootaa ||2||
english: the net holding the fish breaks apart. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਹਰੇ ਚਲੂਲ ॥
transliteration: sooke kaasat hare chalool ||
english: The dry wood blossoms forth in greenery and red flowers;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚੈ ਥਲਿ ਫੂਲੇ ਕਮਲ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
transliteration: oochai thal phoole kamal anoop ||
english: in the high desert, the beautiful lotus flower blooms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
transliteration: agan nivaaree satigur dev ||
english: The Divine True Guru puts out the fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਲਾਇਓ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sevak apanee laaio sev ||3||
english: He links His servant to His service. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣਾ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: akirataghanaa kaa kare udhaar ||
english: He saves even the ungrateful;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh meraa hai sadaa daiaar ||
english: my God is forever merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kaa sadaa sahaaee ||
english: He is forever the helper and support of the humble Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੫੦॥
transliteration: charan kamal naanak saranaaee ||4||39||50||
english: Nanak has found the Sanctuary of His lotus feet. ||4||39||50||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਿੰਘ ਰਾਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch si(n)gh raakhe prabh maar ||
english: God killed the five tigers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਬਿਘਿਆੜੀ ਲਈ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: das bighiaaRee laee nivaar ||
english: He has driven out the ten wolves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਆਵਰਤ ਕੀ ਚੂਕੀ ਘੇਰ ॥
transliteration: teen aavarat kee chookee gher ||
english: The three whirl-pools have stopped spinning.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਚੂਕੇ ਭੈ ਫੇਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g chooke bhai pher ||1||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the fear of reincarnation is gone. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: simar simar jeevaa govi(n)d ||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhio daas apanaa sadaa sadaa saachaa bakhasi(n)d ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In His Mercy, He protects His slave; the True Lord is forever and ever the forgiver. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਝਿ ਗਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਪਾਪ ਸੁਮੇਰ ॥
transliteration: daajh gae trin paap sumer ||
english: The mountain of sin is burnt down, like straw,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੂਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੈਰ ॥
transliteration: jap jap naam pooje prabh pair ||
english: by chanting and meditating on the Name, and worshipping God's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਸਭ ਥਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: anad roop pragatio sabh thaan ||
english: God, the embodiment of bliss, becomes manifest everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੋਰੀ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prem bhagat joree sukh maan ||2||
english: Linked to His loving devotional worship, I enjoy peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਬਾਛਰ ਖੋਜ ॥
transliteration: saagar tario baachhar khoj ||
english: I have crossed over the world-ocean, as if it were no bigger than a calf's footprint on the ground.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਹ ਫੁਨਿ ਰੋਜ ॥
transliteration: khed na paaio nah phun roj ||
english: I shall never again have to endure suffering or grief.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਧੁ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਘਟੁਕੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: si(n)dh samaaio ghatuke maahi ||
english: The ocean is contained in the pitcher.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ਕਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karanahaar kau kichh acharaj naahi ||3||
english: This is not such an amazing thing for the Creator to do. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਛੂਟਉ ਤਉ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: jau chhootau tau jaai paiaal ||
english: When I am separated from Him, then I am consigned to the nether regions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਕਾਢਿਓ ਤਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jau kaadhio tau nadar nihaal ||
english: When He lifts me up and pulls me out, then I am enraptured by His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਹਮਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: paap pu(n)n hamarai vas naahi ||
english: Vice and virtue are not under my control.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੫੧॥
transliteration: rasak rasak naanak gun gaahi ||4||40||51||
english: With love and affection, Nanak sings His Glorious Praises. ||4||40||51||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naa tan teraa naa man tohi ||
english: Neither your body nor your mind belong to you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਧੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi biaapiaa dhohi ||
english: Attached to Maya, you are entangled in fraud.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਮ ਕਰੈ ਗਾਡਰ ਜਿਉ ਛੇਲ ॥
transliteration: kudam karai gaadar jiu chhel ||
english: You play like a baby lamb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਚਕ੍ਰੁ ਪੇਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: achi(n)t jaal kaal chakr pel ||1||
english: But suddenly, Death will catch you in its noose. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਾਇ ਮਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har charan kamal saranaai manaa ||
english: Seek the Sanctuary of the Lord's lotus feet, O my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam jap sa(n)g sahaaee guramukh paavahi saach dhanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, which will be your help and support. As Gurmukh, you shall obtain the true wealth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਨੇ ਕਾਜ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: oone kaaj na hovat poore ||
english: Your unfinished worldly affairs will never be resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮਦਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh mad sad hee jhoore ||
english: You shall always regret your sexual desire, anger and pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: karai bikaar jeeare kai taaee ||
english: You act in corruption in order to survive,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਫਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਤਸੂਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gaaphal sa(n)g na tasooaa jaaee ||2||
english: but not even an iota will go along with you, you ignorant fool! ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤ ਧੋਹ ਅਨਿਕ ਛਲ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: dharat dhoh anik chhal jaanai ||
english: You practice deception, and you know many tricks;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉ ਖਾਕੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: kaudee kaudee kau khaak sir chhaanai ||
english: for the sake of mere shells, you throw dust upon your head.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jin deeaa tisai na chetai mool ||
english: You never even think of the One who gave you life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਲੋਭੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸੂਲੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mithiaa lobh na utarai sool ||3||
english: The pain of false greed never leaves you. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham jab bhae daiaal ||
english: When the Supreme Lord God becomes merciful,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
transliteration: ihu man hoaa saadh ravaal ||
english: this mind becomes the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਕਮਲ ਲੜਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hasat kamal laR leeno laai ||
english: With His lotus hands, He has attached us to the hem of His robe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੪੧॥੫੨॥
transliteration: naanak saachai saach samaai ||4||41||52||
english: Nanak merges in the Truest of the True. ||4||41||52||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raajaa raam kee saranaai ||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau bhae gobi(n)d gun gaavat saadhasa(n)g dukh jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have become fearless, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my pains have been taken away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai raam basai man maahee ||
english: That person, within whose mind the Lord abides,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: so jan dutar pekhat naahee ||
english: does not see the impassible world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
transliteration: sagale kaaj savaare apane ||
english: All one's affairs are resolved,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har naam rasan nit japane ||1||
english: by chanting continually the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jis kai masatak haath gur dharai ||
english: Why should His slave feel any anxiety?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਦੇਸਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so daas adesaa kaahe karai ||
english: The Guru places His hand upon my forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: janam maran kee chookee kaan ||
english: The fear of birth and death is dispelled;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਣ ॥੨॥
transliteration: poore gur oopar kurabaan ||2||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
transliteration: gur paramesar bhet nihaal ||
english: I am enraptured, meeting with the Guru, the Transcendent Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
transliteration: so darasan paae jis hoi daiaal ||
english: He alone obtains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, who is blessed by His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham jis kirapaa karai ||
english: One who is blessed by the Grace of the Supreme Lord God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g so bhavajal tarai ||3||
english: crosses over the terrifying world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit peevahu saadh piaare ||
english: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, O Beloved Holy people.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mukh oojal saachai darabaare ||
english: Your face shall be radiant and bright in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: anad karahu taj sagal bikaar ||
english: Celebrate and be blissful, and abandon all corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਤਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੪੨॥੫੩॥
transliteration: naanak har jap utarahu paar ||4||42||53||
english: O Nanak, meditate on the Lord and cross over. ||4||42||53||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: ee(n)dhan te baisa(n)tar bhaagai ||
english: The fire runs away from the fuel.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਕਉ ਜਲੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
transliteration: maatee kau jal dah dis tiaagai ||
english: The water runs away from the dust in all directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਤਲੈ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: oopar charan talai aakaas ||
english: The feet are above, and the sky is beneath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਕੀਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ghat mahi si(n)dh keeo paragaas ||1||
english: The ocean appears in the cup. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aisaa sa(n)mrath har jeeu aap ||
english: Such is our all-powerful dear Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜੀਅ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nimakh na bisarai jee bhagatan kai aath pahar man taa kau jaap ||1|| rahaau ||
english: His devotees do not forget Him, even for an instant. Twenty-four hours a day, O mind, meditate on Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਮਾਖਨੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਦੂਧੁ ॥
transliteration: prathame maakhan paachhai doodh ||
english: First comes the butter, and then the milk.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੂ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਾਬੁਨੁ ਸੂਧੁ ॥
transliteration: mailoo keeno saabun soodh ||
english: The dirt cleans the soap.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਡਰਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ ॥
transliteration: bhai te nirabhau darataa phirai ||
english: The fearless are afraid of fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਂਦੀ ਕਉ ਅਣਹੋਂਦੀ ਹਿਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ho(n)dee kau anaho(n)dee hirai ||2||
english: The living are killed by the dead. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਗੁਪਤ ਬਿਦੇਹੀ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
transliteration: dehee gupat bidehee deesai ||
english: The visible body is hidden, and the etheric body is seen.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਕਰਤ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥
transliteration: sagale saaj karat jagadeesai ||
english: The Lord of the world does all these things.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਗਣਹਾਰ ਅਣਠਗਦਾ ਠਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: thaganahaar anathagadaa thaagai ||
english: The one who is cheated, is not cheated by the cheat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਵਖਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin vakhar phir phir uth laagai ||3||
english: With no merchandise, the trader trades again and again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਖਿਆਣ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa mil karahu bakhiaan ||
english: So join the Society of the Saints, and chant the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
transliteration: si(n)mrit saasat bed puraan ||
english: So say the Simritees, Shaastras, Vedas and Puraanas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: braham beechaar beechaare koi ||
english: Rare are those who contemplate and meditate on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੪॥
transliteration: naanak taa kee param gat hoi ||4||43||54||
english: O Nanak, they attain the supreme status. ||4||43||54||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeaa ||
english: Whatever pleases Him happens.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਆਨ ਬੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa har kee saranaaee prabh bin naahee aan beeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Forever and ever, I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord.There is none other than God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਲਖਿਮੀ ਦੀਸੈ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: put kalatr lakhimee deesai in mahi kichhoo na sa(n)g leeaa ||
english: You look upon your children, spouse and wealth; none of these will go along with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਖਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bikhai thagauree khaai bhulaanaa maaiaa ma(n)dar tiaag gaiaa ||1||
english: Eating the poisonous potion, you have gone astray. You will have to go, and leave Maya and your mansions. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa kar kar bahut vigootaa garabh jon mahi kirat paiaa ||
english: Slandering others, you are totally ruined; because of your past actions, you shall be consigned to the womb of reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਬ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮਦੂਤਿ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਿਓ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: purab kamaane chhodahi naahee jamadoot graasio mahaa bhaiaa ||2||
english: Your past actions will not just go away; the most horrible Messenger of Death shall seize you. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bolai jhooth kamaavai avaraa trisan na boojhai bahut haiaa ||
english: You tell lies, and do not practice what you preach. Your desires are not satisfied - what a shame.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਾਧ ਰੋਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੰਤ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਹਾ ਖਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: asaadh rog upajiaa sa(n)t dookhan deh binaasee mahaa khaiaa ||3||
english: You have contracted an incurable disease; slandering the Saints, your body is wasting away; you are utterly ruined. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਾਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jinahi nivaaje tin hee saaje aape keene sa(n)t jaiaa ||
english: He embellishes those whom He has fashioned. He Himself gave life to the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਇਆ ॥੪॥੪੪॥੫੫॥
transliteration: naanak daas ka(n)th laai raakhe kar kirapaa paarabraham maiaa ||4||44||55||
english: O Nanak, He hugs His slaves close in His Embrace. Please grant Your Grace, O Supreme Lord God, and be kind to me as well. ||4||44||55||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aisaa pooraa guradeu sahaaee ||
english: Such is the Perfect Divine Guru, my help and support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa simaran birathaa na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditation on Him is not wasted. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: darasan pekhat hoi nihaal ||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I am enraptured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee dhoor kaatai jam jaal ||
english: The dust of His feet snaps the noose of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal base mere man ke ||
english: His lotus feet dwell within my mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਤਨ ਕੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaaraj savaare sagale tan ke ||1||
english: and so all the affairs of my body are arranged and resolved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai masatak raakhai haath ||
english: One upon whom He places His Hand, is protected.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh mero anaath ko naath ||
english: My God is the Master of the masterless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: patit udhaaran kripaa nidhaan ||
english: He is the Savior of sinners, the treasure of mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa jaaeeai kurabaan ||2||
english: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤੁ ਦੇਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
