transliteration: niramal ma(n)t dei jis daan ||
english: One whom He blesses with His Immaculate Mantra,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tajahi bikaar binasai abhimaan ||
english: renounces corruption; his egotistical pride is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
transliteration: ek dhiaaeeai saadh kai sa(n)g ||
english: Meditate on the One Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paap binaase naam kai ra(n)g ||3||
english: Sins are erased, through the love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
transliteration: gur paramesur sagal nivaas ||
english: The Guru, the Transcendent Lord, dwells among all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat rav rahiaa gunataas ||
english: The treasure of virtue pervades and permeates each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਧਾਰਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: daras dehi dhaarau prabh aas ||
english: Please grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪੫॥੫੬॥
transliteration: nit naanak chitavai sach aradaas ||4||45||56||
english: O God, I place my hopes in You. Nanak continually offers this true prayer. ||4||45||56||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: raag raamakalee mahalaa 5 ghar 2 dupade ||
english: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗੀਤ ॥
transliteration: gaavahu raam ke gun geet ||
english: Sing the songs of Praise of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam japat param sukh paaeeai aavaa gaun mitai mere meet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, total peace is obtained; coming and going is ended, my friend. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਹੋਵਤ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavat hovat paragaas ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is enlightened,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charan kamal mahi hoi nivaas ||1||
english: and comes to dwell in His lotus feet. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)gat mahi hoi udhaar ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, one is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੭॥
transliteration: naanak bhavajal utaras paar ||2||1||57||
english: O Nanak, he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||1||57||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa meraa gur pooraa ||
english: My Guru is perfect, my Guru is perfect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਰੋਗ ਕੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam jap sadaa suhele sagal binaase rog kooraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name, I am always at peace; all my illness and fraud is dispelled. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ek araadhahu saachaa soi ||
english: Worship and adore that One Lord alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kee saran sadaa sukh hoi ||1||
english: In His Sanctuary, eternal peace is obtained. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਦ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਭੂਖ ॥
transliteration: need suhelee naam kee laagee bhookh ||
english: One who feels hunger for the Naam sleeps in peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har simarat binase sabh dookh ||2||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, all pains are dispelled. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sahaj ana(n)d karahu mere bhaaee ||
english: Enjoy celestial bliss, O my Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur poorai sabh chi(n)t mitaaee ||3||
english: The Perfect Guru has eradicated all anxiety. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar prabh kaa jap jaap ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, chant God's Chant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖਾ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੮॥
transliteration: naanak raakhaa hoaa aap ||4||2||58||
english: O Nanak, He Himself shall save you. ||4||2||58||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raag raamakalee mahalaa 5 paRataal ghar 3 ||
english: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Partaal, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਨਰਹ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: naranarah namasakaara(n) ||
english: I humbly bow to the Lord, the Supreme Being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਨ ਥਲਨ ਬਸੁਧ ਗਗਨ ਏਕ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jalan thalan basudh gagan ek eka(n)kaara(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The One, the One and Only Creator Lord permeates the water, the land, the earth and the sky. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਨ ਧਰਨ ਪੁਨ ਪੁਨਹ ਕਰਨ ॥
transliteration: haran dharan pun punah karan ||
english: Over and over again, the Creator Lord destroys, sustains and creates.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਗਿਰਹ ਨਿਰੰਹਾਰੰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nah girah nira(n)haara(n) ||1||
english: He has no home; He needs no nourishment. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੰਭੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਨਾਮ ਹੀਰ ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)bheer dheer naam heer ooch mooch apaara(n) ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is deep and profound, strong, poised, lofty, exalted and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕੇਲ ਗੁਣ ਅਮੋਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੰ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੯॥
transliteration: karan kel gun amol naanak balihaara(n) ||2||1||59||
english: He stages His plays; His Virtues are priceless. Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||2||1||59||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਭੋਗ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਛਲੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: roop ra(n)g suga(n)dh bhog tiaag chale maaiaa chhale kanik kaaminee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You must abandon your beauty, pleasures, fragrances and enjoyments; beguiled by gold and sexual desire, you must still leave Maya behind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦਰਬ ਅਰਬ ਖਰਬ ਪੇਖਿ ਲੀਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: bha(n)daar darab arab kharab pekh leelaa man sadhaarai ||
english: You gaze upon billions and trillions of treasures and riches, which delight and comfort your mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਾਮਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nah sa(n)g gaamanee ||1||
english: but these will not go along with you. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਭਰਮਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਇਹ ਬਿਰਖ ਛਾਮਨੀ ॥
transliteration: sut kalatr bhraat meet urajh pario bharam mohio ih birakh chhaamanee ||
english: Entangled with children, spouse, siblings and friends, you are enticed and fooled; these pass like the shadow of a tree.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੬੦॥
transliteration: charan kamal saran naanak sukh sa(n)t bhaavanee ||2||2||60||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of His lotus feet; He has found peace in the faith of the Saints. ||2||2||60||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ਤਿਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: raag raamakalee mahalaa 9 tipade ||
english: Raag Raamkalee, Ninth Mehl, Thi-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਓਟ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: re man ot lehu har naamaa ||
english: O mind, take the sheltering support of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸੈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran duramat naasai paavahi pad nirabaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, evil-mindedness is dispelled, and the state of Nirvaanaa is obtained. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਹ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: badabhaagee tih jan kau jaanahu jo har ke gun gaavai ||
english: Know that one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord is very fortunate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਖੋਇ ਕੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam janam ke paap khoi kai phun baiku(n)th sidhaavai ||1||
english: The sins of countless incarnations are washed off, and he attains the heavenly realm. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅਜਾਮਲ ਕਉ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: ajaamal kau a(n)t kaal mahi naaraain sudh aaee ||
english: At the very last moment, Ajaamal became aware of the Lord;

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ਬਾਛਤ ਸੋ ਗਤਿ ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa(n) gat kau jogeesur baachhat so gat chhin mahi paaee ||2||
english: that state which even the supreme Yogis desire - he attained that state in an instant. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਹਿਨ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਗਜਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naahin gun naahin kachh bidiaa dharam kaun gaj keenaa ||
english: The elephant had no virtue and no knowledge; what religious rituals has he performed?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਤਿਹ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak birad raam kaa dekhahu abhai daan tih deenaa ||3||1||
english: O Nanak, behold the way of the Lord, who bestowed the gift of fearlessness. ||3||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Raamkalee, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੋ ਕਉਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਅਬ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: saadho kaun jugat ab keejai ||
english: Holy people: what way should I now adopt,

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa te duramat sagal binaasai raam bhagat man bheejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: by which all evil-mindedness may be dispelled, and the mind may vibrate in devotional worship to the Lord? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: man maaiaa mahi urajh rahio hai boojhai nah kachh giaanaa ||
english: My mind is entangled in Maya; it knows nothing at all of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaun naam jag jaa kai simarai paavai pad nirabaanaa ||1||
english: What is that Name, by which the world, contemplating it, might attain the state of Nirvaanaa? ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਤਬ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhae daiaal kripaal sa(n)t jan tab ih baat bataaee ||
english: When the Saints became kind and compassionate, they told me this.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਧਰਮ ਮਾਨੋ ਤਿਹ ਕੀਏ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sarab dharam maano tih keee jih prabh keerat gaaee ||2||
english: Understand, that whoever sings the Kirtan of God's Praises, has performed all religious rituals. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰੁ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਏਕ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam nar nis baasur mahi nimakh ek ur dhaarai ||
english: One who enshrines the Lord's Name in his heart night and day - even for an instant

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: jam ko traas mitai naanak tih apuno janam savaarai ||3||2||
english: - has his fear of Death eradicated. O Nanak, his life is approved and fulfilled. ||3||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 9 ||
english: Raamkalee, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: praanee naaraain sudh lehi ||
english: O mortal, focus your thoughts on the Lord.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chhin chhin audh ghatai nis baasur brithaa jaat hai deh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Moment by moment, your life is running out; night and day, your body is passing away in vain. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਰਨਾਪੋ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਖੋਇਓ ਬਾਲਪਨੁ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: taranaapo bikhian siu khoio baalapan agiaanaa ||
english: You have wasted your youth in corrupt pleasures, and your childhood in ignorance.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਓ ਅਜਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਸਮਝੈ ਕਉਨ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਉਰਝਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: biradh bhaio ajahoo nahee samajhai kaun kumat urajhaanaa ||1||
english: You have grown old, and even now, you do not understand, the evil-mindedness in which you are entangled. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਜਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਸੋ ਤੈ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: maanas janam deeo jih thaakur so tai kiu bisaraaio ||
english: Why have you forgotten your Lord and Master, who blessed you with this human life?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mukat hot nar jaa kai simarai nimakh na taa kau gaaio ||2||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, one is liberated. And yet, you do not sing His Praises, even for an instant. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਮਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa ko mad kahaa karat hai sa(n)g na kaahoo jaaee ||
english: Why are you intoxicated with Maya? It will not go along with you.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥੮੧॥
transliteration: naanak kahat chet chi(n)taaman hoi hai a(n)t sahaaee ||3||3||81||
english: Says Nanak, think of Him, remember Him in your mind. He is the Fulfiller of desires, who will be your help and support in the end. ||3||3||81||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਚੰਦੁ ਚੜਹਿ ਸੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਤਪਤ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: soee cha(n)d chaRahi se taare soee dineear tapat rahai ||
english: The same moon rises, and the same stars; the same sun shines in the sky.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਸੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਝੁਲਾਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਜੀਅ ਖੇਲੇ ਥਾਵ ਕੈਸੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saa dharatee so paun jhulaare jug jee khele thaav kaise ||1||
english: The earth is the same, and the same wind blows. The age in which we dwell affects living beings, but not these places. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਤਲਬ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jeevan talab nivaar ||
english: Give up your attachment to life.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਧਿਙਾਣਾ ਕਲਿ ਲਖਣ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hovai paravaanaa karahi dhingaanaa kal lakhan veechaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Those who act like tyrants are accepted and approved - recognize that this is the sign of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੈ ਦੇਸਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਤੀਰਥ ਪਾਸਿ ਨ ਬੈਠਾ ॥
transliteration: kitai des na aaiaa suneeai teerath paas na baithaa ||
english: Kali Yuga has not been heard to have come to any country, or to be sitting at any sacred shrine.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਹਲ ਉਸਾਰਿ ਨ ਬੈਠਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: daataa daan kare tah naahee mahal usaar na baithaa ||2||
english: It is not where the generous person gives to charities, nor seated in the mansion he has built. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਸਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਛੀਜੈ ਤਪ ਘਰਿ ਤਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: je ko sat kare so chheejai tap ghar tap na hoee ||
english: If someone practices Truth, he is frustrated; prosperity does not come to the home of the sincere.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਲਏ ਬਦਨਾਵੀ ਕਲਿ ਕੇ ਲਖਣ ਏਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je ko naau lae badanaavee kal ke lakhan eee ||3||
english: If someone chants the Lord's Name, he is scorned. These are the signs of Kali Yuga. ||3||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਚਾਕਰ ਕੇਹੇ ਡਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jis sikadaaree tisahi khuaaree chaakar kehe daranaa ||
english: Whoever is in charge, is humiliated. Why should the servant be afraid,

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੈ ਪਵੈ ਜੰਜੀਰੀ ਤਾ ਚਾਕਰ ਹਥਹੁ ਮਰਣਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jaa sikadaarai pavai ja(n)jeeree taa chaakar hathahu maranaa ||4||
english: when the master is put in chains? He dies at the hands of his servant. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖੁ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਲਿ ਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: aakh gunaa kal aaeeai ||
english: Chant the Praises of the Lord; Kali Yuga has come.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਕੇਰਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tihu jug keraa rahiaa tapaavas je gun dehi ta paaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The justice of the previous three ages is gone. One obtains virtue, only if the Lord bestows it. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ ਸਰਾ ਨਿਬੇੜੀ ਕਾਜੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
transliteration: kal kalavaalee saraa nibeRee kaajee krisanaa hoaa ||
english: In this turbulent age of Kali Yuga, Muslim law decides the cases, and the blue-robed Qazi is the judge.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬੇਦੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: baanee brahamaa bed atharaban karanee keerat lahiaa ||5||
english: The Guru's Bani has taken the place of Brahma's Veda, and the singing of the Lord's Praises are good deeds. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਸਤ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜਤ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਨੇਊ ॥
transliteration: pat vin poojaa sat vin sa(n)jam jat vin kaahe janeoo ||
english: Worship without faith; self-discipline without truthfulness; the ritual of the sacred thread without chastity - what good are these?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਧੋਵਹੁ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਚੜਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਚ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naavahu dhovahu tilak chaRaavahu such vin soch na hoee ||6||
english: You may bathe and wash, and apply a ritualistic tilak mark to your forehead, but without inner purity, there is no understanding. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: kal paravaan kateb kuraan ||
english: In Kali Yuga, the Koran and the Bible have become famous.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਰਹੇ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
transliteration: pothee pa(n)dit rahe puraan ||
english: The Pandit's scriptures and the Puraanas are not respected.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਉ ਭਇਆ ਰਹਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak naau bhaiaa rahamaan ||
english: O Nanak, the Lord's Name now is Rehmaan, the Merciful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kar karataa too eko jaan ||7||
english: Know that there is only One Creator of the creation. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਏਦੂ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee edoo upar karam nahee ||
english: Nanak has obtained the glorious greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. There is no action higher than this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੈ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਓਲਾਮਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਹੀ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: je ghar hodai ma(n)gan jaaeeai phir olaamaa milai tahee ||8||1||
english: If someone goes out to beg for what is already in his own home, then he should be chastised. ||8||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹਿ ਮੜੀ ਬਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jag parabodhahi maRee badhaavahi ||
english: You preach to the world, and set up your house.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਣੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aasan tiaag kaahe sach paavahi ||
english: Abandoning your Yogic postures, how will you find the True Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: mamataa mohu kaaman hitakaaree ||
english: You are attached to possessiveness and the love of sexual pleasure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਅਉਧੂਤੀ ਨਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naa audhootee naa sa(n)saaree ||1||
english: You are not a renunciate, nor a man of the world. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jogee bais rahahu dubidhaa dukh bhaagai ||
english: Yogi, remain seated, and the pain of duality will run away from you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਗਤ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ghar ghar maagat laaj na laagai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You beg from door to door, and you don't feel ashamed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੀਤ ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਆਪੁ ॥
transliteration: gaavahi geet na cheenahi aap ||
english: You sing the songs, but you do not understand your own self.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: kiu laagee nivarai parataap ||
english: How will the burning pain within be relieved?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਚੈ ਮਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad rachai man bhaai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, let your mind be absorbed in the Lord's Love,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਸਹਜ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhikhiaa sahaj veechaaree khaai ||2||
english: and you will intuitively experience the charity of contemplation. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਸਮ ਚੜਾਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ॥
transliteration: bhasam chaRaai karahi paakha(n)d ||
english: You apply ashes to your body, while acting in hypocrisy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਹਹਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi sahahi jam da(n)d ||
english: Attached to Maya, you will be beaten by Death's heavy club.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫੂਟੈ ਖਾਪਰੁ ਭੀਖ ਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: phootai khaapar bheekh na bhaai ||
english: Your begging bowl is broken; it will not hold the charity of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan baadhiaa aavai jaai ||3||
english: Bound in bondage, you come and go. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਜਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bi(n)d na raakhahi jatee kahaavahi ||
english: You do not control your seed and semen, and yet you claim to practice abstinence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮਾਗਤ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: maaee maagat trai lobhaavahi ||
english: You beg from Maya, lured by the three qualities.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਦਇਆ ਨਹੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: niradaiaa nahee jot ujaalaa ||
english: You have no compassion; the Lord's Light does not shine in you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਬੂਡੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: boodat boode sarab ja(n)jaalaa ||4||
english: You are drowned, drowned in worldly entanglements. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਬਹੁ ਥਟੂਆ ॥
transliteration: bhekh karahi khi(n)thaa bahu thatooaa ||
english: You wear religious robes, and your patched coat assumes many disguises.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੋ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਨਟੂਆ ॥
transliteration: jhootho khel khelai bahu natooaa ||
english: You play all sorts of false tricks, like a juggler.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਹੁ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar agan chi(n)taa bahu jaare ||
english: The fire of anxiety burns brightly within you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: vin karamaa kaise utaras paare ||5||
english: Without the karma of good actions, how can you cross over? ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਫਟਕ ਬਨਾਈ ਕਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)draa phatak banaaee kaan ||
english: You make ear-rings of glass to wear in your ears.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਗਿਆਨਿ ॥
transliteration: mukat nahee bidiaa bigiaan ||
english: But liberation does not come from learning without understanding.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋੁਭਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa i(n)dree saad loubhaanaa ||
english: You are lured by the tastes of the tongue and sex organs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਭਏ ਨਹੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਨੀਸਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: pasoo bhae nahee mitai neesaanaa ||6||
english: You have become a beast; this sign cannot be erased. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਲੋਗਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਜੋਗਾ ॥
transliteration: tribidh logaa tribidh jogaa ||
english: The people of the world are entangled in the three modes; the Yogis are entangled in the three modes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ਚੂਕਸਿ ਸੋਗਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad veechaarai chookas sogaa ||
english: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, sorrows are dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਜਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: oojal saach s sabad hoi ||
english: Through the Shabad, one becomes radiant, pure and truthful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jogee jugat veechaare soi ||7||
english: One who contemplates the true lifestyle is a Yogi. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਪਹਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੂ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: tujh pahi nau nidh too karanai jog ||
english: The nine treasures are with You, Lord; You are potent, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: thaap uthaape kare s hog ||
english: You establish and disestablish; whatever You do, happens.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਚੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: jat sat sa(n)jam sach sucheet ||
english: One who practices celibacy, chastity, self-control, truth and pure consciousness

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮੀਤੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jogee tribhavan meet ||8||2||
english: - O Nanak, that Yogi is the friend of the three worlds. ||8||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਮਟੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: khat mat dehee man bairaagee ||
english: Above the six chakras of the body dwells the detached mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: surat sabad dhun a(n)tar jaagee ||
english: Awareness of the vibration of the Word of the Shabad has been awakened deep within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੈ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
transliteration: vaajai anahad meraa man leenaa ||
english: The unstruck melody of the sound current resonates and resounds within; my mind is attuned to it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur bachanee sach naam pateenaa ||1||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, my faith is confirmed in the True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: praanee raam bhagat sukh paaeeai ||
english: O mortal, through devotion to the Lord, peace is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har har meethaa laagai har har naam samaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, seems sweet to the Gurmukh, who merges in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਵਰਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu bivaraj samaae ||
english: Eradicating attachment to Maya, one merges into the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhetai mel milaae ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, we unite in His Union.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naam ratan niramolak heeraa ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel, a diamond.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tit raataa meraa man dheeraa ||2||
english: Attuned to it, the mind is comforted and encouraged. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa rog na laagai ||
english: The diseases of egotism and possessiveness do not afflict

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: raam bhagat jam kaa bhau bhaagai ||
english: one who worships the Lord. Fear of the Messenger of Death runs away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jam ja(n)daar na laagai mohi ||
english: The Messenger of Death, the enemy of the soul, does not touch me at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: niramal naam ridai har sohi ||3||
english: The Immaculate Name of the Lord illuminates my heart. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sabad beechaar bhae nira(n)kaaree ||
english: Contemplating the Shabad, we become Nirankaari - we come to belong to the Formless Lord God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਰਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: guramat jaage duramat parahaaree ||
english: Awakening to the Guru's Teachings, evil-mindedness is taken away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: anadin jaag rahe liv laaee ||
english: Remaining awake and aware night and day, lovingly focused on the Lord,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jeevan mukat gat a(n)tar paaee ||4||
english: one becomes Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive. He finds this state deep within himself. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਲਿਪਤ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: alipat guphaa mahi rahahi niraare ||
english: In the secluded cave, I remain unattached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tasakar pa(n)ch sabad sa(n)ghaare ||
english: With the Word of the Shabad, I have killed the five thieves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: par ghar jaai na man dolaae ||
english: My mind does not waver or go to the home of any other.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਹਉ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sahaj nira(n)tar rahau samaae ||5||
english: I remain intuitively absorbed deep within. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਉਧੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jaag rahe audhootaa ||
english: As Gurmukh, I remain awake and aware, unattached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਤਤੁ ਪਰੋਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sad bairaagee tat parotaa ||
english: Forever detached, I am woven into the essence of reality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਸੂਤਾ ਮਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jag sootaa mar aavai jaai ||
english: The world is asleep; it dies, and comes and goes in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bin gurasabad na sojhee paai ||6||
english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it does not understand. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: anahad sabad vajai din raatee ||
english: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates day and night.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: avigat kee gat guramukh jaatee ||
english: The Gurmukh knows the state of the eternal, unchanging Lord God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਜਾਨੀ ਜਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: tau jaanee jaa sabad pachhaanee ||
english: When someone realizes the Shabad, then he truly knows.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: eko rav rahiaa nirabaanee ||7||
english: The One Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere in Nirvaanaa. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: su(n)n samaadh sahaj man raataa ||
english: My mind is intuitively absorbed in the state of deepest Samaadhi;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਹਉ ਲੋਭਾ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: taj hau lobhaa eko jaataa ||
english: renouncing egotism and greed, I have come to know the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur chele apanaa man maaniaa ||
english: When the disciple's mind accepts the Guru,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜਾ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak doojaa met samaaniaa ||8||3||
english: O Nanak, duality is eradicated, and he merges in the Lord. ||8||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਾ ਗਣਹਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saahaa ganahi na karahi beechaar ||
english: You calculate the auspicious days, but you do not understand

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saahe oopar eka(n)kaar ||
english: that the One Creator Lord is above these auspicious days.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jis gur milai soee bidh jaanai ||
english: He alone knows the way, who meets the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramat hoi ta hukam pachhaanai ||1||
english: When one follows the Guru's Teachings, then he realizes the Hukam of God's Command. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੁ ਨ ਬੋਲਿ ਪਾਡੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jhooth na bol paade sach kaheeai ||
english: Do not tell lies, O Pandit; O religious scholar, speak the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: haumai jaai sabad ghar laheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When egotism is eradicated through the Word of the Shabad, then one finds His home. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਣਿ ਗਣਿ ਜੋਤਕੁ ਕਾਂਡੀ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: gan gan jotak kaa(n)dee keenee ||
english: Calculating and counting, the astrologer draws the horoscope.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜੈ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: paRai sunaavai tat na cheenee ||
english: He studies it and announces it, but he does not understand reality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਸੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sabhasai oopar gurasabad beechaar ||
english: Understand, that the Word of the Guru's Shabad is above all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਉ ਨ ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hor kathanee badau na sagalee chhaar ||2||
english: Do not speak of anything else; it is all just ashes. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਹਿ ਧੋਵਹਿ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਸੈਲਾ ॥
transliteration: naavahi dhovahi poojahi sailaa ||
english: You bathe, wash, and worship stones.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮੈਲੋ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
transliteration: bin har raate mailo mailaa ||
english: But without being imbued with the Lord, you are the filthiest of the filthy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਰਥਿ ॥
transliteration: garab nivaar milai prabh saarath ||
english: Subduing your pride, you shall receive the supreme wealth of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਤਾਰਥਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mukat praan jap har kirataarath ||3||
english: The mortal is liberated and emancipated, meditating on the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਚੈ ਵਾਦੁ ਨ ਬੇਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: vaachai vaad na bed beechaarai ||
english: You study the arguments, but do not contemplate the Vedas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਿਤਰਾ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aap dubai kiu pitaraa taarai ||
english: You drown yourself - how will you save your ancestors?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat braham cheenai jan koi ||
english: How rare is that person who realizes that God is in each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta sojhee hoi ||4||
english: When one meets the True Guru, then he understands. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀਐ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: ganat ganeeai sahasaa dukh jeeai ||
english: Making his calculations, cynicism and suffering afflict his soul.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਥੀਐ ॥
transliteration: gur kee saran pavai sukh theeai ||
english: Seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru, peace is found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਸਰਣਿ ਹਮ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar aparaadh saran ham aaiaa ||
english: I sinned and made mistakes, but now I seek Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur har bhete purab kamaaiaa ||5||
english: The Guru led me to meet the Lord, according to my past actions. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gur saran na aaeeai braham na paaeeai ||
english: If one does not enter the Guru's Sanctuary, God cannot be found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈਐ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਿ ਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: bharam bhulaaeeai janam mar aaeeai ||
english: Deluded by doubt, one is born, only to die, and come back again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧਉ ਮਰੈ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jam dar baadhau marai bikaar ||
english: Dying in corruption, he is bound and gagged at Death's door.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naa ridai naam na sabad achaar ||6||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is not in his heart, and he does not act according to the Shabad. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਧੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮਿਸਰ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik paadhe pa(n)dit misar kahaavahi ||
english: Some call themselves Pandits, religious scholars and spiritual teachers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa raate mahal na paavahi ||
english: Tinged with double-mindedness, they do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jis gur parasaadee naam adhaar ||
english: One who takes the Support of the Naam, by Guru's Grace,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਜਨੁ ਆਪਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kot madhe ko jan aapaar ||7||
english: is a rare person, one among millions, incomparable. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਏਕੈ ॥
transliteration: ek buraa bhalaa sach ekai ||
english: One is bad, and another good, but the One True Lord is contained in all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਟੇਕੈ ॥
transliteration: boojh giaanee satagur kee tekai ||
english: Understand this, O spiritual teacher, through the support of the True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralee eko jaaniaa ||
english: rare indeed is that Gurmukh, who realizes the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa met samaaniaa ||8||
english: His comings and goings cease, and he merges in the Lord. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jin kai hiradai eka(n)kaar ||
english: Those who have the One Universal Creator Lord within their hearts,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sarab gunee saachaa beechaar ||
english: possess all virtues; they contemplate the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai bhaanai karam kamaavai ||
english: One who acts in harmony with the Guru's Will,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੯॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak saache saach samaavai ||9||4||
english: O Nanak, is absorbed in the Truest of the True. ||9||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਠੁ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: hath nigrahu kar kaaiaa chheejai ||
english: Practicing restraint by Hatha Yoga, the body wears away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਰਤੁ ਤਪਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: varat tapan kar man nahee bheejai ||
english: The mind is not softened by fasting or austerities.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam sar avar na poojai ||1||
english: Nothing else is equal to worship of the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: gur sev manaa har jan sa(n)g keejai ||
english: Serve the Guru, O mind, and associate with the humble servants of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਡਸਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jam ja(n)daar johi nahee saakai sarapan das na sakai har kaa ras peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The tyrannical Messenger of Death cannot touch you, and the serpent of Maya cannot sting you, when you drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਦੁ ਪੜੈ ਰਾਗੀ ਜਗੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: vaad paRai raagee jag bheejai ||
english: The world reads the arguments, and is softened only by music.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: trai gun bikhiaa janam mareejai ||
english: In the three modes and corruption, they are born and die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਸਹੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam naam bin dookh saheejai ||2||
english: Without the Lord's Name, they endure suffering and pain. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾੜਸਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: chaaRas pavan si(n)ghaasan bheejai ||
english: The Yogi draws the breath upwards, and opens the Tenth Gate.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਉਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: niulee karam khat karam kareejai ||
english: He practices inner cleansing and the six rituals of purification.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam naam bin birathaa saas leejai ||3||
english: But without the Lord's Name, the breath he draws is useless. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar pa(n)ch agan kiu dheeraj dheejai ||
english: The fire of the five passions burns within him; how can he be calm?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਦੁ ਲਹੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar chor kiu saad laheejai ||
english: The thief is within him; how can he taste the taste?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramukh hoi kaaiaa gaR leejai ||4||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh conquers the body-fortress. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਰਮੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar mail teerath bharameejai ||
english: With filth within, he wanders around at places of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਚਾ ਕਿਆ ਸੋਚ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: man nahee soochaa kiaa soch kareejai ||
english: His mind is not pure, so what is the use of performing ritual cleansings?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਦੋਸੁ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kirat paiaa dos kaa kau deejai ||5||
english: He carries the karma of his own past actions; who else can he blame? ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਹਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)n na khaahi dehee dukh deejai ||
english: He does not eat food; he tortures his body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਥੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: bin gur giaan tripat nahee theejai ||
english: Without the Guru's wisdom, he is not satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: manamukh janamai janam mareejai ||6||
english: The self-willed manmukh is born only to die, and be born again. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur poochh sa(n)gat jan keejai ||
english: Go, and ask the True Guru, and associate with the Lord's humble servants.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਚੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: man har raachai nahee janam mareejai ||
english: Your mind shall merge into the Lord, and you shall not be reincarnated to die again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: raam naam bin kiaa karam keejai ||7||
english: Without the Lord's Name, what can anyone do? ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਂਦਰ ਦੂੰਦਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: oo(n)dar doo(n)dar paas dhareejai ||
english: Silence the mouse scurrying around within you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: dhur kee sevaa raam raveejai ||
english: Serve the Primal Lord, by chanting the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai kirapaa prabh keejai ||8||5||
english: O Nanak, God blesses us with His Name, when He grants His Grace. ||8||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਤਭੁਜੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar utabhuj avar na koee ||
english: The created Universe emanated from within You; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jo kaheeai so prabh te hoee ||
english: Whatever is said to be, is from You, O God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jugah juga(n)tar saahib sach soee ||
english: He is the True Lord and Master, throughout the ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਤਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: utapat paralau avar na koee ||1||
english: Creation and destruction do not come from anyone else. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aisaa meraa thaakur gahir ga(n)bheer ||
english: Such is my Lord and Master, profound and unfathomable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਜਮ ਤੀਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin japiaa tin hee sukh paaiaa har kai naam na lagai jam teer ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whoever meditates on Him, finds peace. The arrow of the Messenger of Death does not strike one who has the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: naam ratan heeraa niramol ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel, a diamond.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: saachaa saahib amar atol ||
english: The True Lord Master is immortal and immeasurable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸੂਚੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa soochee saachaa bol ||
english: That tongue which chants the True Name is pure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੋਲੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghar dar saachaa naahee rol ||2||
english: The True Lord is in the home of the self; there is no doubt about it. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਡੂਗਰਿ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ik ban mahi baisahi doogar asathaan ||
english: Some sit in the forests, and some make their home in the mountains.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਪਚਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: naam bisaar pachahi abhimaan ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, they rot away in egotistical pride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa kiaa giaan dhiaan ||
english: Without the Naam, what is the use of spiritual wisdom and meditation?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh paavahi daragahi maan ||3||
english: The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਠੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hath aha(n)kaar karai nahee paavai ||
english: Acting stubbornly in egotism, one does not find the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਠ ਪੜੈ ਲੇ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: paath paRai le lok sunaavai ||
english: Studying the scriptures, reading them to other people,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭਰਮਸਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: teerath bharamas biaadh na jaavai ||
english: and wandering around at places of pilgrimage, the disease is not taken away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naam binaa kaise sukh paavai ||4||
english: Without the Naam, how can one find peace? ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਿਵੈ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jatan karai bi(n)d kivai na rahaaee ||
english: No matter how much he tries, he cannot control his semen and seed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਨਰਕੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manooaa dolai narake paaee ||
english: His mind wavers, and he falls into hell.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧੋ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jam pur baadho lahai sajaaee ||
english: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, he is tortured.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bin naavai jeeu jal bal jaaee ||5||
english: Without the Name, his soul cries out in agony. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik kete mun devaa ||
english: The many Siddhas and seekers, silent sages and demi-gods

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਹਿ ਭੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: hath nigrahi na tripataavahi bhevaa ||
english: cannot satisfy themselves by practicing restraint through Hatha Yoga.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਗਹਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad veechaar gahahi gur sevaa ||
english: One who contemplates the Word of the Shabad, and serves the Guru

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: man tan niramal abhimaan abhevaa ||6||
english: - his mind and body become immaculate, and his egotistical pride is obliterated. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karam milai paavai sach naau ||
english: Blessed with Your Grace, I obtain the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਰਹਉ ਸੁਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tum saranaagat rahau subhaau ||
english: I remain in Your Sanctuary, in loving devotion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tum te upajio bhagatee bhaau ||
english: Love for Your devotional worship has welled up within me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jap jaapau guramukh har naau ||7||
english: As Gurmukh, I chant and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਜਾਇ ਮਨ ਭੀਨੈ ॥
transliteration: haumai garab jaai man bheenai ||
english: When one is rid of egotism and pride, his mind is drenched in the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਕੀਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jhooth na paavas paakha(n)d keenai ||
english: Practicing fraud and hypocrisy, he does not find God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨਹੀ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin gurasabad nahee ghar baar ||
english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he cannot find the Lord's Door.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh tat beechaar ||8||6||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh contemplates the essence of reality. ||8||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਬਉਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਨਮੇ ਤਿਉ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jiu aaiaa tiu jaavahi baure jiu janame tiu maran bhaiaa ||
english: As you come, so will you leave, you fool; as you were born, so will you die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਕੀਏ ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu ras bhog keee tetaa dukh laagai naam visaar bhavajal paiaa ||1||
english: As you enjoy pleasures, so will you suffer pain. Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you will fall into the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਖਤ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tan dhan dekhat garab gaiaa ||
english: Gazing upon your body and wealth, you are so proud.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਵਧਾਇਹਿ ਕੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kanik kaamanee siu het vadhaaihi kee naam visaarahi bharam gaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Your love for gold and sexual pleasures increases; why have you forgotten the Naam, and why do you wander in doubt? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸੀਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਪਿੰਜਰ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਸਟੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jat sat sa(n)jam seel na raakhiaa pret pi(n)jar mahi kaasat bhaiaa ||
english: You do not practice truth, abstinence, self-discipline or humility; the ghost within your skeleton has turned to dry wood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਜਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pu(n)n daan isanaan na sa(n)jam saadhasa(n)gat bin baad jaiaa ||2||
english: You have not practiced charity, donations, cleansing baths or austerities. Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, your life has gone in vain. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: laalach laagai naam bisaario aavat jaavat janam gaiaa ||
english: Attached to greed, you have forgotten the Naam. Coming and going, your life has been ruined.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਜਮੁ ਧਾਇ ਕੇਸ ਗਹਿ ਮਾਰੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਲ ਗਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa jam dhaai kes gahi maarai surat nahee mukh kaal gaiaa ||3||
english: When the Messenger of Death grabs you by your hair, you will be punished. You are unconscious, and have fallen into Death's mouth. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ahinis ni(n)daa taat paraaee hiradai naam na sarab daiaa ||
english: Day and night, you jealously slander others; in your heart, you have neither the Naam, nor compassion for all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bin gurasabad na gat pat paavahi raam naam bin narak gaiaa ||4||
english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you will not find salvation or honor. Without the Lord's Name, you shall go to hell. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਵੇਸ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਟੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਮੋਹ ਪਾਪ ਮਹਿ ਗਲਤੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi ves karahi natooaa jiu moh paap mahi galat gaiaa ||
english: In an instant, you change into various costumes, like a juggler; you are entangled in emotional attachment and sin.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਸਾਰੀ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਮਗਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: it ut maaiaa dekh pasaaree moh maaiaa kai magan bhaiaa ||5||
english: You gaze here and there upon the expanse of Maya; you are intoxicated with attachment to Maya. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਵਿਥਾਰ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: karahi bikaar vithaar ghanere surat sabad bin bharam paiaa ||
english: You act in corruption, and put on ostentatious shows, but without awareness of the Shabad, you have fallen into confusion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: haumai rog mahaa dukh laagaa guramat levahu rog gaiaa ||6||
english: You suffer great pain from the disease of egotism. Following the Guru's Teachings, you shall be rid of this disease. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਕਉ ਆਵਤ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਾਕਤ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sukh sa(n)pat kau aavat dekhai saakat man abhimaan bhaiaa ||
english: Seeing peace and wealth come to him, the faithless cynic become proud in his mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jis kaa ihu tan dhan so phir levai a(n)tar sahasaa dookh paiaa ||7||
english: But He who owns this body and wealth, takes them back again, and then the mortal feels anxiety and pain deep within. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal kichh saath na chaalai jo deesai sabh tisahi maiaa ||
english: At the very last instant, nothing goes along with you; all is visible only by His Mercy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: aad purakh apara(n)par so prabh har naam ridai lai paar paiaa ||8||
english: God is our Primal and Infinite Lord; enshrining the Lord's Name in the heart, one crosses over. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਸਰਾਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mooe kau rovahi kisahi sunaavahi bhai saagar asaraal paiaa ||
english: You weep for the dead, but who hears you weeping? The dead have fallen to the serpent in the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: dekh kuta(n)b maaiaa grih ma(n)dar saakat ja(n)jaal paraal paiaa ||9||
english: Gazing upon his family, wealth, household and mansions, the faithless cynic is entangled in worthless worldly affairs. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਆਏ ਤਾ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਪਠਾਏ ਚਾਲੇ ਤਿਨੈ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa aae taa tinahi pathaae chaale tinai bulaai laiaa ||
english: He comes when the Lord sends him; when the Lord calls him back, he goes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੈ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa bakhasanahaarai bakhas laiaa ||10||
english: Whatever he does, the Lord is doing. The Forgiving Lord forgives him. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin ehu chaakhiaa raam rasaain tin kee sa(n)gat khoj bhaiaa ||
english: I seek to be with those who have tasted this sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: ridh sidh budh giaan guroo te paaiaa mukat padaarath saran paiaa ||11||
english: Wealth, miraculous spiritual powers, wisdom and spiritual knowledge, are obtained from the Guru. The treasure of liberation is obtained in His Sanctuary. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਾ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh guramukh sam kar jaanaa harakh sog te birakat bhaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukh looks upon pain and pleasure as one and the same; he remains untouched by joy and sorrow.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੨॥੭॥
transliteration: aap maar guramukh har paae naanak sahaj samaai laiaa ||12||7||
english: Conquering his self-conceit, the Gurmukh finds the Lord; O Nanak, he intuitively merges into the Lord. ||12||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਦਖਣੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee dakhanee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, Dakhanee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jat sat sa(n)jam saach driRaaiaa saach sabad ras leenaa ||1||
english: Abstinence, chastity, self-control and truthfulness have been implanted within me; I am imbued with the sublime essence of the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa gur daiaal sadaa ra(n)g leenaa ||
english: My Merciful Guru remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ahinis rahai ek liv laagee saache dekh pateenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Day and night, He remains lovingly focused on the One Lord; gazing upon the True Lord, He is pleased. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਗਗਨ ਪੁਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮੈਸਰਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗੀਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: rahai gagan pur drisat samaisar anahat sabad ra(n)geenaa ||2||
english: He abides in the Tenth Gate, and looks equally upon all; He is imbued with the unstruck sound current of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਬੰਧਿ ਕੁਪੀਨ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sat ba(n)dh kupeen bharipur leenaa jihavaa ra(n)g raseenaa ||3||
english: Wearing the loin-cloth of chastity, He remains absorbed in the all-pervading Lord; His tongue enjoys the taste of God's Love. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚੁ ਰਾਚੇ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: milai gur saache jin rach raache kirat veechaar pateenaa ||4||
english: The One who created the creation has met the True Guru; contemplating the Guru's lifestyle, He is pleased. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਮਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਏਕਾ ਏਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ek mahi sarab sarab mahi ekaa eh satigur dekh dikhaaee ||5||
english: All are in the One, and the One is in all. This is what the True Guru has shown me. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਖਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jin keee kha(n)d ma(n)dal brahama(n)daa so prabh lakhan na jaaee ||6||
english: He who created the worlds, solar systems and galaxies - that God cannot be known. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕ ਤੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: deepak te deepak paragaasiaa tribhavan jot dikhaaee ||7||
english: From the lamp of God, the lamp within is lit; the Divine Light illuminates the three worlds. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਸਚ ਮਹਲੀ ਬੈਠੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: sachai takhat sach mahalee baithe nirabhau taaRee laaee ||8||
english: The Guru sits on the true throne in the true mansion; He is attuned, absorbed in the Fearless Lord. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਈ ॥੯॥
transliteration: mohi gaiaa bairaagee jogee ghat ghat ki(n)guree vaaee ||9||
english: The Guru, the detached Yogi, has enticed the hearts of all; He plays His harp in each and every heart. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੀ ਛੂਟੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧੦॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak saran prabhoo kee chhoote satigur sach sakhaaee ||10||8||
english: O Nanak, in God's Sanctuary, one is emancipated; the True Guru becomes our true help and support. ||10||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਉਹਠਿ ਹਸਤ ਮੜੀ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: auhath hasat maRee ghar chhaaiaa dharan gagan kal dhaaree ||1||
english: He has made His home in the monastery of the heart; He has infused His power into the earth and the sky. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੇਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ketee sabad udhaaree sa(n)tahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Gurmukhs have saved so very many, O Saints. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mamataa maar haumai sokhai tribhavan jot tumaaree ||2||
english: He conquers attachment, and eradicates egotism, and sees Your Divine Light pervading the three worlds, Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: manasaa maar manai mahi raakhai satigur sabad veechaaree ||3||
english: He conquers desire, and enshrines the Lord within his mind; he contemplates the Word of the True Guru's Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: si(n)ngee surat anaahad vaajai ghat ghat jot tumaaree ||4||
english: The horn of consciousness vibrates the unstruck sound current; Your Light illuminates each and every heart, Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਪੰਚ ਬੇਣੁ ਤਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਰਜਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: parapa(n)ch ben tahee man raakhiaa braham agan parajaaree ||5||
english: He plays the flute of the universe in his mind, and lights the fire of God. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch tat mil ahinis deepak niramal jot apaaree ||6||
english: Bringing together the five elements, day and night, the Lord's lamp shines with the Immaculate Light of the Infinite. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਲਉਕੇ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: rav sas lauke ihu tan ki(n)guree vaajai sabad niraaree ||7||
english: The right and left nostrils, the sun and the moon channels, are the strings of the body-harp; they vibrate the wondrous melody of the Shabad. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਅਉਧੂ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
transliteration: siv nagaree mahi aasan audhoo alakh aga(n)m apaaree ||8||
english: The true hermit obtains a seat in the City of God, the invisible, inaccessible, infinite. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਪੰਚ ਵਸਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
transliteration: kaaiaa nagaree ihu man raajaa pa(n)ch vasahi veechaaree ||9||
english: The mind is the king of the city of the body; the five sources of knowledge dwell within it. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਅਦਲੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: sabad ravai aasan ghar raajaa adal kare gunakaaree ||10||
english: Seated in his home, this king chants the Shabad; he administers justice and virtue. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਕਹੇ ਕਹਿ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਜੀਵਤ ਮੂਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: kaal bikaal kahe kahi bapure jeevat mooaa man maaree ||11||
english: What can poor death or birth say to him? Conquering his mind, he remains dead while yet alive. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸ ਇਕ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes ik moorat aape karataa kaaree ||12||
english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are manifestations of the One God. He Himself is the Doer of deeds. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਧਿ ਤਰੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਤਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: kaaiaa sodh tarai bhav saagar aatam tat veechaaree ||13||
english: One who purifies his body, crosses over the terrifying world-ocean; he contemplates the essence of his own soul. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te sadaa sukh paaiaa a(n)tar sabad raviaa gunakaaree ||14||
english: Serving the Guru, he finds everlasting peace; deep within, the Shabad permeates him, coloring him with virtue. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: aape mel lae gunadaataa haumai trisanaa maaree ||15||
english: The Giver of virtue unites with Himself, one who conquers egotism and desire. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ ਚਉਥੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: trai gun mete chauthai varatai ehaa bhagat niraaree ||16||
english: Eradicating the three qualities, dwell in the fourth state. This is the unparalleled devotional worship. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: guramukh jog sabad aatam cheenai hiradai ek muraaree ||17||
english: This is the Yoga of the Gurmukh: Through the Shabad, he understands his own soul, and he enshrines within his heart the One Lord. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: manooaa asathir sabade raataa ehaa karanee saaree ||18||
english: Imbued with the Shabad, his mind becomes steady and stable; this is the most excellent action. ||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਅਉਧੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: bed baad na paakha(n)d audhoo guramukh sabad beechaaree ||19||
english: This true hermit does not enter into religious debates or hypocrisy; the Gurmukh contemplates the Shabad. ||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅਉਧੂ ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: guramukh jog kamaavai audhoo jat sat sabad veechaaree ||20||
english: The Gurmukh practices Yoga - he is the true hermit; he practices abstinence and truth, and contemplates the Shabad. ||20||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: sabad marai man maare audhoo jog jugat veechaaree ||21||
english: One who dies in the Shabad and conquers his mind is the true hermit; he understands the Way of Yoga. ||21||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਧੂ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu bhavajal hai avadhoo sabad tarai kul taaree ||22||
english: Attachment to Maya is the terrifying world-ocean; through the Shabad, the true hermit saves himself, and his ancestors as well. ||22||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੂਰ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: sabad soor jug chaare audhoo baanee bhagat veechaaree ||23||
english: Contemplating the Shabad, you shall be a hero throughout the four ages, O hermit; contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani in devotion. ||23||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਅਉਧੂ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: ehu man maaiaa mohiaa audhoo nikasai sabad veechaaree ||24||
english: This mind is enticed by Maya, O hermit; contemplating the Shabad, you shall find release. ||24||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨੫॥੯॥
transliteration: aape bakhase mel milaae naanak saran tumaaree ||25||9||
english: He Himself forgives, and unites in His Union; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||25||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Raamkalee, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਮੈ ਦੀਆ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕੰਨੀ ਪਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਕਰਿ ਤੂ ਦਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saramai deeaa mu(n)draa ka(n)nee paai jogee khi(n)thaa kar too daiaa ||
english: Make humility your ear-rings, Yogi, and compassion your patched coat.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਜਿਣਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aavan jaan bibhoot laai jogee taa teen bhavan jin laiaa ||1||
english: Let coming and going be the ashes you apply to your body, Yogi, and then you shall conquer the three worlds. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਜਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: aisee ki(n)guree vajaai jogee ||
english: Play that harp, Yogi,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jit ki(n)guree anahad vaajai har siu rahai liv laai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: which vibrates the unstruck sound current, and remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਝੋਲੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh pat kar jholee jogee a(n)mrit naam bhugat paaee ||
english: Make truth and contentment your plate and pouch, Yogi; take the Ambrosial Naam as your food.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dhiaan kaa kar da(n)daa jogee si(n)ngee surat vajaaee ||2||
english: Make meditation your walking stick, Yogi, and make higher consciousness the horn you blow. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਲਪਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man driR kar aasan bais jogee taa teree kalapanaa jaaee ||
english: Make your stable mind the Yogic posture you sit in, Yogi, and then you shall be rid of your tormenting desires.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaaiaa nagaree mahi ma(n)gan chaRahi jogee taa naam palai paaee ||3||
english: Go begging in the village of the body, Yogi, and then, you shall obtain the Naam in your lap. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: it ki(n)guree dhiaan na laagai jogee naa sach palai paai ||
english: This harp does not center you in meditation, Yogi, nor does it bring the True Name into your lap.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: it ki(n)guree saa(n)t na aavai jogee abhimaan na vichahu jaai ||4||
english: This harp does not bring you peace, Yogi, nor eliminate egotism from within you. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਇ ਪਤ ਲਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡੀ ॥
transliteration: bhau bhaau dui pat laai jogee ihu sareer kar da(n)dee ||
english: Make the Fear of God, and the Love of God, the two gourds of your lute, Yogi, and make this body its neck.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੰਤੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਖੰਡੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramukh hovahi taa ta(n)tee vaajai in bidh trisanaa kha(n)dee ||5||
english: Become Gurmukh, and then vibrate the strings; in this way, your desires shall depart. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hukam bujhai so jogee kaheeai ekas siu chit laae ||
english: One who understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command is called a Yogi; he links his consciousness to the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਤੂਟੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sahasaa tootai niramal hovai jog jugat iv paae ||6||
english: His cynicism is dispelled, and he becomes immaculately pure; this is how he finds the Way of Yoga. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: nadaree aavadaa sabh kichh binasai har setee chit laai ||
english: Everything that comes into view shall be destroyed; focus your consciousness on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਇਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: satigur naal teree bhaavanee laagai taa ih sojhee paai ||7||
english: Enshrine love for the True Guru, and then you shall obtain this understanding. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਭਵਣੁ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ehu jog na hovai jogee j kuta(n)b chhod parabhavan karahi ||
english: This is not Yoga, O Yogi, to abandon your family and wander around.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਰੀਰ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹਹਿ ॥੮॥
transliteration: grih sareer mahi har har naam gur parasaadee apanaa har prabh lahahi ||8||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is within the household of the body. By Guru's Grace, you shall find your Lord God. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਮਿਟੀ ਕਾ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ihu jagat mitee kaa putalaa jogee is mahi rog vadaa trisanaa maaiaa ||
english: This world is a puppet of clay, Yogi; the terrible disease, the desire for Maya is in it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਤਨ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: anek jatan bhekh kare jogee rog na jaai gavaaiaa ||9||
english: Making all sorts of efforts, and wearing religious robes, Yogi, this disease cannot be cured. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam aukhadh hai jogee jis no ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the medicine, Yogi; the Lord enshrines it in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai soee boojhai jog jugat so paae ||10||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh understands this; he alone finds the Way of Yoga. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੈ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jogai kaa maarag bikham hai jogee jis no nadar kare so paae ||
english: The Path of Yoga is very difficult, Yogi; he alone finds it, whom God blesses with His Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar eko vekhai vichahu bharam chukaae ||11||
english: Inside and outside, he sees the One Lord; he eliminates doubt from within himself. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਵਜਾਈ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਾ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vin vajaaee ki(n)guree vaajai jogee saa ki(n)guree vajaai ||
english: So play the harp which vibrates without being played, Yogi.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੨॥੧॥੧੦॥
transliteration: kahai naanak mukat hovahi jogee saache rahahi samaai ||12||1||10||
english: Says Nanak, thus you shall be liberated, Yogi, and remain merged in the True Lord. ||12||1||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Raamkalee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhagat khajaanaa guramukh jaataa satigur boojh bujhaaee ||1||
english: The treasure of devotional worship is revealed to the Gurmukh; the True Guru has inspired me to understand this understanding. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu guramukh dei vadiaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Saints, the Gurmukh is blessed with glorious greatness. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sach rahahu sadaa sahaj sukh upajai kaam krodh vichahu jaaee ||2||
english: Dwelling always in Truth, celestial peace wells up; sexual desire and anger are eliminated from within. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap chhod naam liv laagee mamataa sabad jalaaee ||3||
english: Eradicating self-conceit, remain lovingly focused on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Word of the Shabad, burn away possessiveness. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅੰਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jis te upajai tis te binasai a(n)te naam sakhaaee ||4||
english: By Him we are created, and by Him we are destroyed; in the end, the Naam will be our only help and support. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਹ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sadaa hajoor door nah dekhahu rachanaa jin rachaaee ||5||
english: He is ever-present; don't think that He is far away. He created the creation. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sachaa sabad ravai ghat a(n)tar sache siu liv laaee ||6||
english: Deep within your heart, chant the True Word of the Shabad; remain lovingly absorbed in the True Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mahi naam niramolak vadai bhaag paaiaa jaaee ||7||
english: The Priceless Naam is in the Society of the Saints; by great good fortune, it is obtained. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: bharam na bhoolahu satigur sevahu man raakhahu ik thaaee ||8||
english: Do not be deluded by doubt; serve the True Guru, and keep your mind steady in one place. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੯॥
transliteration: bin naavai sabh bhoolee phiradee birathaa janam gavaaee ||9||
english: Without the Name, everyone wanders around in confusion; they waste away their lives in vain. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਹੰਢੈ ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: jogee jugat gavaaee ha(n)dhai paakha(n)d jog na paaee ||10||
english: Yogi, you have lost the Way; you wander around confused. Through hypocrisy, Yoga is not attained. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: siv nagaree mahi aasan baisai gurasabadee jog paaee ||11||
english: Sitting in Yogic postures in the City of God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall find Yoga. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: dhaatur baajee sabad nivaare naam vasai man aaee ||12||
english: Restrain your restless wanderings through the Shabad, and the Naam will come to dwell in your mind. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: ehu sareer saravar hai sa(n)tahu isanaan kare liv laaee ||13||
english: This body is a pool, O Saints; bathe in it, and enshrine love for the Lord. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
