gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naam isanaan karahi se jan niramal sabade mail gavaaee ||14||
english: Those who cleanse themselves through the Naam, are the most immaculate people; through the Shabad, they wash off their filth. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਚੇਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: trai gun achet naam chetahi naahee bin naavai binas jaaee ||15||
english: Trapped by the three qualities, the unconscious person does not think of the Naam; without the Name, he wastes away. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes trai moorat trigun bharam bhulaaee ||16||
english: The three forms of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are trapped in the three qualities, lost in confusion. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee trikutee chhootai chauthai pad liv laaee ||17||
english: By Guru's Grace, this triad is eradicated, and one is lovingly absorbed in the fourth state. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਤਿੰਨਾ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit paRahi paR vaad vakhaanahi ti(n)naa boojh na paaee ||18||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read, study and discuss the arguments; they do not understand. ||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਤੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਹਹਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਭਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: bikhiaa maate bharam bhulaae upades kahahi kis bhaaee ||19||
english: Engrossed in corruption, they wander in confusion; who can they possibly instruct, O Siblings of Destiny? ||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kee ootam baanee jug jug rahee samaaee ||20||
english: The Bani, the Word of the humble devotee is the most sublime and exalted; it prevails throughout the ages. ||20||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: baanee laagai so gat paae sabade sach samaaee ||21||
english: One who is committed to this Bani is emancipated, and through the Shabad, merges in Truth. ||21||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੰ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: kaaiaa nagaree sabade khoje naam nava(n) nidh paaee ||22||
english: One who searches the village of the body, through the Shabad, obtains the nine treasures of the Naam. ||22||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: manasaa maar man sahaj samaanaa bin rasanaa usatat karaaee ||23||
english: Conquering desire, the mind is absorbed in intuitive ease, and then one chants the Lord's Praises without speaking. ||23||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਇਣ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਦਿਸਟਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: loin dekh rahe bisamaadee chit adisat lagaaee ||24||
english: Let your eyes gaze upon the Wondrous Lord; let your consciousness be attached to the Unseen Lord. ||24||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: adisat sadaa rahai niraalam jotee jot milaaee ||25||
english: The Unseen Lord is forever absolute and immaculate; one's light merges into the Light. ||25||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: hau gur saalaahee sadaa aapanaa jin saachee boojh bujhaaee ||26||
english: I praise my Guru forever, who has inspired me to understand this true understanding. ||26||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੭॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak ek kahai bena(n)tee naavahu gat pat paaee ||27||2||11||
english: Nanak offers this one prayer: through the Name, may I find salvation and honor. ||27||2||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Raamkalee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਦੁਲੰਭ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kee poojaa dula(n)bh hai sa(n)tahu kahanaa kachhoo na jaaee ||1||
english: It is so hard to obtain that devotional worship of the Lord, O Saints. It cannot be described at all. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu guramukh pooraa paaee ||
english: O Saints, as Gurmukh, find the Perfect Lord,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naamo pooj karaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: and worship the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har bin sabh kichh mailaa sa(n)tahu kiaa hau pooj chaRaaee ||2||
english: Without the Lord, everything is filthy, O Saints; what offering should I place before Him? ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har saache bhaavai saa poojaa hovai bhaanaa man vasaaee ||3||
english: Whatever pleases the True Lord is devotional worship; His Will abides in the mind. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: poojaa karai sabh lok sa(n)tahu manamukh thaai na paaee ||4||
english: Everyone worships Him, O Saints, but the self-willed manmukh is not accepted or approved. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਏਹ ਪੂਜਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sabad marai man niramal sa(n)tahu eh poojaa thaai paaee ||5||
english: If someone dies in the Word of the Shabad, his mind become immaculate, O Saints; such worship is accepted and approved. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: pavit paavan se jan saache ek sabad liv laaee ||6||
english: Sanctified and pure are those true beings, who enshrine love for the Shabad. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਲੋਕਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin naavai hor pooj na hovee bharam bhulee lokaaee ||7||
english: There is no worship of the Lord, other than the Name; the world wanders, deluded by doubt. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: guramukh aap pachhaanai sa(n)tahu raam naam liv laaee ||8||
english: The Gurmukh understands his own self, O Saints; he lolvingly centers his mind on the Lord's Name. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੯॥
transliteration: aape niramal pooj karaae gurasabadee thaai paaee ||9||
english: The Immaculate Lord Himself inspires worship of Him; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is accepted and approved. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: poojaa karahi par bidh nahee jaanahi doojai bhaai mal laaee ||10||
english: Those who worship Him, but do not know the Way, are polluted with the love of duality. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s poojaa jaanai bhaanaa man vasaaee ||11||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh, knows what worship is; the Lord's Will abides within his mind. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੇ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅੰਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: bhaane te sabh sukh paavai sa(n)tahu a(n)te naam sakhaaee ||12||
english: One who accepts the Lord's Will obtains total peace, O Saints; in the end, the Naam will be our help and support. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: apanaa aap na pachhaanahi sa(n)tahu kooR karahi vadiaaee ||13||
english: One who does not understand his own self, O Saints, falsely flatters himself. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਕੀਨੈ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਛੋਡੈ ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d keenai jam nahee chhodai lai jaasee pat gavaaee ||14||
english: The Messenger of Death does not give up on those who practices hypocrisy; they are dragged away in disgrace. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: jin a(n)tar sabad aap pachhaanahi gat mit tin hee paaee ||15||
english: Those who have the Shabad deep within, understand themselves; they find the way of salvation. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: ehu manooaa su(n)n samaadh lagaavai jotee jot milaaee ||16||
english: Their minds enter into the deepest state of Samaadhi, and their light is absorbed into the Light. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: sun sun guramukh naam vakhaanahi satasa(n)gat melaaee ||17||
english: The Gurmukhs listen constantly to the Naam, and chant it in the True Congregation. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: guramukh gaavai aap gavaavai dar saachai sobhaa paaee ||18||
english: The Gurmukhs sing the Lord's Praises, and erase self-conceit; they obtain true honor in the Court of the Lord. ||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: saachee baanee sach vakhaanai sach naam liv laaee ||19||
english: True are their words; they speak only the Truth; they lovingly focus on the True Name. ||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਖੰਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: bhai bha(n)jan at paap nikha(n)jan meraa prabh a(n)t sakhaaee ||20||
english: My God is the Destroyer of fear, the Destroyer of sin; in the end, He is our only help and support. ||20||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੧॥੩॥੧੨॥
transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap varatai naanak naam vadiaaee ||21||3||12||
english: He Himself pervades and permeates everything; O Nanak, glorious greatness is obtained through the Naam. ||21||3||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Raamkalee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕੁਚਲ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਅਤਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ham kuchal kucheel at abhimaanee mil sabade mail utaaree ||1||
english: I am filthy and polluted, proud and egotistical; receiving the Word of the Shabad, my filth is taken away. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu guramukh naam nisataaree ||
english: O Saints, the Gurmukhs are saved through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sachaa naam vasiaa ghat a(n)tar karatai aap savaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The True Name abides deep within their hearts. The Creator Himself embellishes them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paaras parase phir paaras hoe har jeeu apanee kirapaa dhaaree ||2||
english: Touching the philosopher's stone, they themselves become the philosopher's stone; the Dear Lord Himself blesses them with His Mercy. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ik bhekh karahi phirahi abhimaanee tin jooai baajee haaree ||3||
english: Some wear religious robes, and wander around in pride; they lose their life in the gamble. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ik anadin bhagat karahi din raatee raam naam ur dhaaree ||4||
english: Some worship the Lord in devotion, night and day; day and night, they keep the Lord's Name enshrined in their hearts. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: anadin raate sahaje maate sahaje haumai maaree ||5||
english: Those who are imbued with Him night and day, are spontaneously intoxicated with Him; they intuitively conquer their ego. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bhai bin bhagat na hoee kab hee bhai bhaai bhagat savaaree ||6||
english: Without the Fear of God, devotional worship is never performed; through the Love and the Fear of God, devotional worship is embellished. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਤਤਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabad jalaaiaa giaan tat beechaaree ||7||
english: The Shabad burns away emotional attachment to Maya, and then one contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
transliteration: aape aap karaae karataa aape bakhas bha(n)daaree ||8||
english: The Creator Himself inspires us to act; He Himself blesses us with His treasure. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਗਾਵਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
transliteration: tis kiaa gunaa kaa a(n)t na paaiaa hau gaavaa sabad veechaaree ||9||
english: The limits of His virtues cannot be found; I sing His Praises and contemplate the Word of the Shabad. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਪੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: har jeeu japee har jeeu saalaahee vichahu aap nivaaree ||10||
english: I chant the Lord's Name, and praise my Dear Lord; egotism is eradicated from within me. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਖੁਟ ਸਚੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naam padaarath gur te paaiaa akhut sache bha(n)daaree ||11||
english: The treasure of the Naam is obtained from the Guru; the treasures of the True Lord are inexhaustible. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਠਾ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: apaniaa bhagataa no aape tuthaa apanee kirapaa kar kal dhaaree ||12||
english: He Himself is pleased with His devotees; by His Grace, He infuses His strength within them. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸਦਾ ਭੁਖ ਲਾਗੀ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: tin saache naam kee sadaa bhukh laagee gaavan sabad veechaaree ||13||
english: They always feel hunger for the True Name; they sing and contemplate the Shabad. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh kichh hai tis kaa aakhan bikham beechaaree ||14||
english: Soul, body and everything are His; it is so difficult to speak of, and contemplate Him. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: sabad lage seee jan nisatare bhaujal paar utaaree ||15||
english: Those humble beings who are attached to the Shabad are saved; they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: bin har saache ko paar na paavai boojhai ko veechaaree ||16||
english: Without the True Lord, no one can cross over; how rare are those who contemplate and understand this. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa soee paaiaa mil har sabad savaaree ||17||
english: We obtain only that which is pre-ordained; receiving the Lord's Shabad, we are embellished. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: kaaiaa ka(n)chan sabade raatee saachai naai piaaree ||18||
english: Imbued with the Shabad, the body becomes golden, and loves only the True Name. ||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)mrit rahee bharapoore paaeeai sabad veechaaree ||19||
english: The body is then filled to overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar, obtained by contemplating the Shabad. ||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹੋਰਿ ਫੂਟਿ ਮੂਏ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: jo prabh khojahi seee paavahi hor phoot mooe aha(n)kaaree ||20||
english: Those who seek God, find Him; others burst and die from their own egotism. ||20||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਦੀ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: baadee binasahi sevak sevahi gur kai het piaaree ||21||
english: The debaters waste away, while the servants serve, with love and affection for the Guru. ||21||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: so jogee tat giaan beechaare haumai trisanaa maaree ||22||
english: He alone is a Yogi, who contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom, and conquers egotism and thirsty desire. ||22||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਤਿਨੈ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: satigur daataa tinai pachhaataa jis no kripaa tumaaree ||23||
english: The True Guru, the Great Giver, is revealed to those upon whom You bestow Your Grace, O Lord. ||23||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੇ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੂਏ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: satigur na sevahi maaiaa laage doob mooe aha(n)kaaree ||24||
english: Those who do not serve the True Guru, and who are attached to Maya, are drowned; they die in their own egotism. ||24||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਚੈ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਰਾਮ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: jichar a(n)dar saas tichar sevaa keechai jaai mileeai raam muraaree ||25||
english: As long as there is breath within you, so long you should serve the Lord; then, you will go and meet the Lord. ||25||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: anadin jaagat rahai din raatee apane pri preet piaaree ||26||
english: Night and day, she remains awake and aware, day and night; she is the darling bride of her Beloved Husband Lord. ||26||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਰੀ ਵਾਰਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: tan man vaaree vaar ghumaaee apane gur vitahu balihaaree ||27||
english: I offer my body and mind in sacrifice to my Guru; I am a sacrifice to Him. ||27||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu binas jaaigaa ubare sabad veechaaree ||28||
english: Attachment to Maya will end and go away; only by contemplating the Shabad will you be saved. ||28||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਜਗਾਏ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਗੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: aap jagaae seee jaage gur kai sabad veechaaree ||29||
english: They are awake and aware, whom the Lord Himself awakens; so contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||29||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਮੂਏ ਜਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਭਗਤ ਜੀਵੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩੦॥੪॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak seee mooe j naam na chetahi bhagat jeeve veechaaree ||30||4||13||
english: O Nanak, those who do not remember the Naam are dead. The devotees live in contemplative meditation. ||30||4||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 ||
english: Raamkalee, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam khajaanaa gur te paaiaa tripat rahe aaghaaee ||1||
english: Receiving the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, from the Guru, I remain satisfied and fulfilled. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu guramukh mukat gat paaee ||
english: O Saints, the Gurmukhs attain the state of liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ek naam vasiaa ghat a(n)tar poore kee vadiaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The One Name abides deep within my heart; such is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਬਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape karataa aape bhugataa dedaa rijak sabaaee ||2||
english: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer. He Himself gives sustenance to all. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa avar na karanaa jaaee ||3||
english: Whatever He wants to do, He is doing; no one else can do anything. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aape saaje srisat upaae sir sir dha(n)dhai laaee ||4||
english: He Himself fashions and creates the creation; He links each and every person to their task. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: tisahi sarevahu taa sukh paavahu satigur mel milaaee ||5||
english: If you serve Him, then you will find peace; the True Guru will unite you in His Union. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aapanaa aap aap upaae alakh na lakhanaa jaaee ||6||
english: The Lord Himself creates Himself; the Unseen Lord cannot be seen. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aape maar jeevaale aape tis no til na tamaaee ||7||
english: He Himself kills, and brings back to life; He does not have even an iota of greed. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: ik daate ik ma(n)gate keete aape bhagat karaaee ||8||
english: Some are made givers, and some are made beggars; He Himself inspires us to devotional worship. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੯॥
transliteration: se vadabhaagee jinee eko jaataa sache rahe samaaee ||9||
english: Those who know the One Lord are very fortunate; they remain absorbed in the True Lord. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: aap saroop siaanaa aape keemat kahan na jaaee ||10||
english: He Himself is beautiful, He Himself is wise and clever; His worth cannot be expressed. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: aape dukh sukh paae a(n)tar aape bharam bhulaaee ||11||
english: He Himself infuses pain and pleasure; He Himself makes them wander around in doubt. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਨਿਗੁਰੀ ਅੰਧ ਫਿਰੈ ਲੋਕਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: vadaa daataa guramukh jaataa niguree a(n)dh phirai lokaaee ||12||
english: The Great Giver is revealed to the Gurmukh; without the Guru, the world wanders in darkness. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jinee chaakhiaa tinaa saad aaiaa satigur boojh bujhaaee ||13||
english: Those who taste, enjoy the flavor; the True Guru imparts this understanding. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: ikanaa naavahu aap bhulaae ikanaa guramukh dei bujhaaee ||14||
english: Some, the Lord causes to forget and lose the Name; others become Gurmukh, and are granted this understanding. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa saalaahihu sa(n)tahu tis dee vadee vadiaaee ||15||
english: Forever and ever, praise the Lord, O Saints; how glorious is His greatness! ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਜਾ ਕਰਿ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: tis bin avar na koee raajaa kar tapaavas banat banaaee ||16||
english: There is no other King except Him; He administers justice, as He has made it. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਆਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਸਦ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: niaau tisai kaa hai sad saachaa virale hukam manaaee ||17||
english: His justice is always True; how rare are those who accept His Command. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: tis no praanee sadaa dhiaavahu jin guramukh banat banaaee ||18||
english: O mortal, meditate forever on the Lord, who has made the Gurmukh in His making. ||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੀਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: satigur bhetai so jan seejhai jis hiradai naam vasaaee ||19||
english: That humble being who meets with the True Guru is fulfilled; the Naam abides in his heart. ||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: sachaa aap sadaa hai saachaa baanee sabad sunaaee ||20||
english: The True Lord is Himself forever True; He announces His Bani, the Word of His Shabad. ||20||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਈ ॥੨੧॥੫॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak sun vekh rahiaa visamaad meraa prabh raviaa srab thaaee ||21||5||14||
english: Nanak is wonderstruck, hearing and seeing His Lord; my God is all-pervading, everywhere. ||21||5||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kinahee keeaa paravirat pasaaraa ||
english: Some make a big show of their worldly influence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kinahee keeaa poojaa bisathaaraa ||
english: Some make a big show of devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਨਿਵਲ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
transliteration: kinahee nival bhuia(n)gam saadhe ||
english: Some practice inner cleansing teahniques, and control the breath through Kundalini Yoga.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mohi deen har har aaraadhe ||1||
english: I am meek; I worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: teraa bharosaa piaare ||
english: I place my faith in You alone, O Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਵੇਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aan na jaanaa vesaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I do not know any other way. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kinahee grihu taj van kha(n)d paaiaa ||
english: Some abandon their homes, and live in the forests.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਮੋਨਿ ਅਉਧੂਤੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kinahee mon audhoot sadaaiaa ||
english: Some put themselves on silence, and call themselves hermits.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਕਹਤਉ ਅਨੰਨਿ ਭਗਉਤੀ ॥
transliteration: koee kahatau ana(n)n bhagautee ||
english: Some claim that they are devotees of the One Lord alone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਓਟ ਲੀਤੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mohi deen har har ot leetee ||2||
english: I am meek; I seek the shelter and support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਹਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: kinahee kahiaa hau teerath vaasee ||
english: Some say that they live at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਅੰਨੁ ਤਜਿ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: koee a(n)n taj bhaiaa udaasee ||
english: Some refuse food and become Udaasis, shaven-headed renunciates.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਭਵਨੁ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kinahee bhavan sabh dharatee kariaa ||
english: Some have wandered all across the earth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mohi deen har har dar pariaa ||3||
english: I am meek; I have fallen at the door of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਮੈ ਕੁਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kinahee kahiaa mai kulahi vadiaaee ||
english: Some say that they belong to great and noble families.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਬਾਹ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kinahee kahiaa baah bahu bhaaee ||
english: Some say that they have the arms of their many brothers to protect them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ਮੈ ਧਨਹਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: koee kahai mai dhanahi pasaaraa ||
english: Some say that they have great expanses of wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: mohi deen har har aadhaaraa ||4||
english: I am meek; I have the support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਘੂਘਰ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kinahee ghooghar nirat karaaee ||
english: Some dance, wearing ankle bells.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੂ ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਮਾਲਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kinahoo varat nem maalaa paaee ||
english: Some fast and take vows, and wear malas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਗੋਪੀ ਚੰਦਨ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kinahee tilak gopee cha(n)dan laaiaa ||
english: Some apply ceremonial tilak marks to their foreheads.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: mohi deen har har har dhiaaiaa ||5||
english: I am meek; I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਸਿਧ ਬਹੁ ਚੇਟਕ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kinahee sidh bahu chetak laae ||
english: Some work spells using the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁ ਥਾਟ ਬਨਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kinahee bhekh bahu thaat banaae ||
english: Some wear various religious robes and establish their authority.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਤੰਤ ਮੰਤ ਬਹੁ ਖੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: kinahee ta(n)t ma(n)t bahu khevaa ||
english: Some perform Tantric spells, and chant various mantras.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: mohi deen har har har sevaa ||6||
english: I am meek; I serve the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥
transliteration: koee chatur kahaavai pa(n)dit ||
english: One calls himself a wise Pandit, a religious scholar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਮੰਡਿਤ ॥
transliteration: ko khat karam sahit siu ma(n)dit ||
english: One performs the six rituals to appease Shiva.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਆਚਾਰ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: koee karai aachaar sukaranee ||
english: One maintains the rituals of pure lifestyle, and does good deeds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: mohi deen har har har saranee ||7||
english: I am meek; I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗ ਸੋਧੇ ॥
transliteration: sagale karam dharam jug sodhe ||
english: I have studied the religions and rituals of all the ages.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧੇ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai ihu man na prabodhe ||
english: Without the Name, this mind is not awakened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jau saadhasa(n)g paaiaa ||
english: Says Nanak, when I found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਹਾ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: boojhee trisanaa mahaa seetalaaiaa ||8||1||
english: my thirsty desires were satisfied, and I was totally cooled and soothed. ||8||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਪਾਨੀ ਤੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਘਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: is paanee te jin too ghariaa ||
english: He created you out of this water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਕਾ ਲੇ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: maatee kaa le dehuraa kariaa ||
english: From clay, He fashioned your body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਕਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਲੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰੀਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ukat jot lai surat pareekhiaa ||
english: He blessed you with the light of reason and clear consciousness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maat garabh mahi jin too raakhiaa ||1||
english: In your mother's womb, He preserved you. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰਿ ਜਨਾ ॥
transliteration: raakhanahaar samhaar janaa ||
english: Contemplate your Savior Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagale chhod beechaar manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Give up all others thoughts, O mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਪ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jin deee tudh baap mahataaree ||
english: He gave you your mother and father;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਪੁਤ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jin deee bhraat put haaree ||
english: he gave you your charming children and siblings;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਅਰੁ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jin deee tudh banitaa ar meetaa ||
english: he gave you your spouse and friends;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis thaakur kau rakh lehu cheetaa ||2||
english: enshrine that Lord and Master in your consciousness. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਵਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jin deeaa tudh pavan amolaa ||
english: He gave you the invaluable air;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jin deeaa tudh neer niramolaa ||
english: He gave you the priceless water;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਬਲਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jin deeaa tudh paavak balanaa ||
english: He gave you burning fire;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis thaakur kee rahu man saranaa ||3||
english: let your mind remain in the Sanctuary of that Lord and Master. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਿਨਿ ਭੋਜਨ ਦੀਏ ॥
transliteration: chhateeh a(n)mrit jin bhojan deee ||
english: He gave you the thirty-six varieties of tasty foods;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਥਾਨ ਠਹਰਾਵਨ ਕਉ ਕੀਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar thaan thaharaavan kau keee ||
english: He gave you a place within to hold them;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਦੀਓ ਬਰਤਨਿ ਬਲਨਾ ॥
transliteration: basudhaa deeo baratan balanaa ||
english: He gave you the earth, and things to use;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਰਖੁ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tis thaakur ke chit rakh charanaa ||4||
english: enshrine in your consciousness the feet of that Lord and Master. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਨਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: pekhan kau netr sunan kau karanaa ||
english: He gave you eyes to see, and ears to hear;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਬਾਸਨ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: hasat kamaavan baasan rasanaa ||
english: He gave you hands to work with, and a nose and a tongue;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਚਲਨ ਕਉ ਸਿਰੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: charan chalan kau sir keeno meraa ||
english: He gave you feet to walk upon, and the crowning glory of your head;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: man tis thaakur ke poojahu pairaa ||5||
english: O mind, worship the Feet of that Lord and Master. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: apavitr pavitr jin too kariaa ||
english: He transformed you from impure to pure;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਤੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sagal jon mahi too sir dhariaa ||
english: He installed you above the heads of all creatures;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਤੂ ਸੀਝੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਸੀਝੈ ॥
transliteration: ab too seejh bhaavai nahee seejhai ||
english: now, you may fulfill your destiny or not;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਵਰੈ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਜੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kaaraj savarai man prabh dhiaaeejai ||6||
english: Your affairs shall be resolved, O mind, meditating on God. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਏਕੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
transliteration: eehaa oohaa ekai ohee ||
english: Here and there, only the One God exists.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੋਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jat kat dekheeai tat tat tohee ||
english: Wherever I look, there You are.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਤ ਮਨਿ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: tis sevat man aalas karai ||
english: My mind is reluctant to serve Him;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਸਰੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jis visariai ik nimakh na sarai ||7||
english: forgetting Him, I cannot survive, even for an instant. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ham aparaadhee niraguneeaare ||
english: I am a sinner, without any virtue at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾ ਕਰਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naa kichh sevaa naa karamaare ||
english: I do not serve You, or do any good deeds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur bohith vadabhaagee miliaa ||
english: By great good fortune, I have found the boat - the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak daas sa(n)g paathar tariaa ||8||2||
english: Slave Nanak has crossed over, with Him. ||8||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਰੂਪ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai ra(n)g ras roop ||
english: Some pass their lives enjoying pleasures and beauty.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਪੂਤ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai maai baap poot ||
english: Some pass their lives with their mothers, fathers and children.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai raaj milakh vaapaaraa ||
english: Some pass their lives in power, estates and trade.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t bihaavai har naam adhaaraa ||1||
english: The Saints pass their lives with the support of the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਚਨਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਬਨੀ ॥
transliteration: rachanaa saach banee ||
english: The world is the creation of the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਾ ਏਕੁ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh kaa ek dhanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He alone is the Master of all. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਬੇਦ ਅਰੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai bed ar baad ||
english: Some pass their lives in arguments and debates about scriptures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai rasanaa saad ||
english: Some pass their lives tasting flavors.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਲਪਟਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai lapat sa(n)g naaree ||
english: Some pass their lives attached to women.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਰਚੇ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)t rache keval naam muraaree ||2||
english: The Saints are absorbed only in the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਖੇਲਤ ਜੂਆ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai khelat jooaa ||
english: Some pass their lives gambling.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਅਮਲੀ ਹੂਆ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai amalee hooaa ||
english: Some pass their lives getting drunk.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਚੋੁਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai par darab chouraae ||
english: Some pass their lives stealing the property of others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har jan bihaavai naam dhiaae ||3||
english: The humble servants of the Lord pass their lives meditating on the Naam. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਜੋਗ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai jog tap poojaa ||
english: Some pass their lives in Yoga, strict meditation, worship and adoration.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਭਰਮੀਜਾ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo rog sog bharameejaa ||
english: Some, in sickness, sorrow and doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਪਵਨ ਧਾਰ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo pavan dhaar jaat bihaae ||
english: Some pass their lives practicing control of the breath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sa(n)t bihaavai keeratan gaae ||4||
english: The Saints pass their lives singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਚਾਲਤ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai din rain chaalat ||
english: Some pass their lives walking day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਿੜੁ ਮਾਲਤ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai so piR maalat ||
english: Some pass their lives on the fields of battle.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਬਾਲ ਪੜਾਵਤ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai baal paRaavat ||
english: Some pass their lives teaching children.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sa(n)t bihaavai har jas gaavat ||5||
english: The Saints pass their lives singing the Lord's Praise. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਨਟ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਨਿਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai nat naatik nirate ||
english: Some pass their lives as actors, acting and dancing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਜੀਆਇਹ ਹਿਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai jeeaaih hirate ||
english: Some pass their lives taking the lives of others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਡਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai raaj mahi darate ||
english: Some pass their lives ruling by intimidation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਤੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sa(n)t bihaavai har jas karate ||6||
english: The Saints pass their lives chanting the Lord's Praises. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai mataa masoorat ||
english: Some pass their lives counseling and giving advice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਰੂਰਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai sevaa jaroorat ||
english: Some pass their lives forced to serve others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਧਤ ਜੀਵਤ ॥
transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai sodhat jeevat ||
english: Some pass their lives exploring life's mysteries.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਤ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sa(n)t bihaavai har ras peevat ||7||
english: The Saints pass their lives drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jit ko laaiaa tit hee lagaanaa ||
english: As the Lord attaches us, so we are attached.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੂੜੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਸਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naa ko mooR nahee ko siaanaa ||
english: No one is foolish, and no one is wise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis devai naau ||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who are blessed

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak taa kai bal bal jaau ||8||3||
english: By His Grace to receive His Name. ||8||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਵਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੂਟ ॥
transliteration: daavaa agan rahe har boot ||
english: Even in a forest fire, some trees remain green.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਸੰਕਟ ਤੇ ਛੂਟ ॥
transliteration: maat garabh sa(n)kat te chhoot ||
english: The infant is released from the pain of the mother's womb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kaa naam simarat bhau jaai ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, fear is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taise sa(n)t janaa raakhai har raai ||1||
english: Just so, the Sovereign Lord protects and saves the Saints. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: aise raakhanahaar daiaal ||
english: Such is the Merciful Lord, my Protector.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jat kat dekhau tum pratipaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Wherever I look, I see You cherishing and nurturing. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਖਾ ਮਿਟੰਤ ॥
transliteration: jal peevat jiu tikhaa mita(n)t ||
english: As thirst is quenched by drinking water;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਵਤ ਕੰਤ ॥
transliteration: dhan bigasai grihi aavat ka(n)t ||
english: as the bride blossoms forth when her husband comes home;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੀ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: lobhee kaa dhan praan adhaar ||
english: as wealth is the support of the greedy person

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tiu har jan har har naam piaar ||2||
english: - just so, the humble servant of the Lord loves the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਸਾਨੀ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kirasaanee jiu raakhai rakhavaalaa ||
english: As the farmer protects his fields;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਦਇਆ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa daiaa jiu baalaa ||
english: as the mother and father show compassion to their child;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: preetam dekh preetam mil jaai ||
english: as the lover merges on seeing the beloved;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tiu har jan raakhai ka(n)th laai ||3||
english: just so does the Lord hug His humble servant close in His Embrace. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: jiu a(n)dhule pekhat hoi ana(n)d ||
english: As the blind man is in ecstasy, when he can see again;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੂੰਗਾ ਬਕਤ ਗਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਛੰਦ ॥
transliteration: goo(n)gaa bakat gaavai bahu chha(n)d ||
english: and the mute, when he is able to speak and sing songs;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿੰਗੁਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਪਰਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: pi(n)gul parabat parate paar ||
english: and the cripple, being able to climb over the mountain

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har kai naam sagal udhaar ||4||
english: - just so, the Name of the Lord saves all. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੀਤ ਕੋ ਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jiu paavak sa(n)g seet ko naas ||
english: As cold is dispelled by fire,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਛਤ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: aise praachhat sa(n)tasa(n)g binaas ||
english: sins are driven out in the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਬੁਨਿ ਕਾਪਰ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਤ ॥
transliteration: jiu saabun kaapar oojal hot ||
english: As cloth is cleaned by soap,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਸਭੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਤ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naam japat sabh bhram bhau khot ||5||
english: just so, by chanting the Naam, all doubts and fears are dispelled. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: jiu chakavee sooraj kee aas ||
english: As the chakvi bird longs for the sun,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: jiu chaatrik boo(n)d kee piaas ||
english: as the rainbird thirsts for the rain drop,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਾਦ ਕਰਨ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: jiu kura(n)k naad karan samaane ||
english: as the deer's ears are attuned to the sound of the bell,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: tiu har naam har jan manahi sukhaane ||6||
english: the Lord's Name is pleasing to the mind of the Lord's humble servant. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: tumaree kripaa te laagee preet ||
english: By Your Grace, we love You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਤਾ ਆਏ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: daiaal bhae taa aae cheet ||
english: When You show Mercy, then You come into our minds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਧਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: daiaa dhaaree tin dhaaranahaar ||
english: When the Support of the earth granted His Grace,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ਛੁਟਕਾਰ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan te hoee chhutakaar ||7||
english: then I was released from my bonds. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh thaan dekhe nain aloi ||
english: I have seen all places with my eyes wide open.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na koi ||
english: There is no other than Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਛੂਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦ ॥
transliteration: bhram bhai chhoote gur parasaad ||
english: Doubt and fear are dispelled, by Guru's Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥੮॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak pekhio sabh bisamaad ||8||4||
english: Nanak sees the wondrous Lord everywhere. ||8||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਪੇਖੀਅਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਗਲ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਧਾਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh pekheeahi prabh sagal tumaaree dhaaranaa ||1||
english: All beings and creatures that are seen, God, depend on Your Support. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਾਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ihu man har kai naam udhaaranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This mind is saved through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khin mahi thaap uthaape kudarat sabh karate ke kaaranaa ||2||
english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes, by His Creative Power. All is the Creation of the Creator. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh jhooth ni(n)daa saadhoo sa(n)g bidaaranaa ||3||
english: Sexual desire, anger, greed, falsehood and slander are banished in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੂਖੇ ਸੂਖਿ ਗੁਦਾਰਨਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naam japat man niramal hovai sookhe sookh gudaaranaa ||4||
english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind becomes immaculate, and life is passed in absolute peace. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋ ਆਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਨ ਹਾਰਨਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bhagat saran jo aavai praanee tis eehaa oohaa na haaranaa ||5||
english: That mortal who enters the Sanctuary of the devotees, does not lose out, here or hereafter. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਆਗੈ ਸਾਰਨਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sookh dookh is man kee birathaa tum hee aagai saaranaa ||6||
english: Pleasure and pain, and the condition of this mind, I place before You, Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਲਨਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: too daataa sabhanaa jeeaa kaa aapan keeaa paalanaa ||7||
english: You are the Giver of all beings; You cherish what You have made. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਵਾਰਨਾ ॥੮॥੫॥
transliteration: anik baar kot jan oopar naanak va(n)njai vaaranaa ||8||5||
english: So many millions of times, Nanak is a sacrifice to Your humble servants. ||8||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 asatapadee ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Ashtapadee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: darasan bhetat paap sabh naasahi har siu dei milaaee ||1||
english: Receiving the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all sins are erased, and He unites me with the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: meraa gur paramesar sukhadaaee ||
english: My Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham kaa naam driRaae a(n)te hoi sakhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He implants the Naam, the Name of the Supreme Lord God within us; in the end, He is our help and support. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਦੂਖ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਭੰਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sagal dookh kaa deraa bha(n)naa sa(n)t dhoor mukh laaee ||2||
english: The source of all pain within is destroyed; I apply the dust of the feet of the Saints to my forehead. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਵੰਞਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: patit puneet keee khin bheetar agiaan a(n)dher va(n)njaaee ||3||
english: In an instant, He purifies the sinners, and dispels the darkness of ignorance. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath suaamee naanak tis saranaaee ||4||
english: The Lord is all-powerful, the Cause of causes. Nanak seeks His Sanctuary. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan toR charan kamal driRaae ek sabad liv laaee ||5||
english: Shattering the bonds, the Guru implants the Lord's lotus feet within, and lovingly attunes us to the One Word of the Shabad. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿਓ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop bikhiaa te kaadhio saach sabad ban aaee ||6||
english: He has lifted me up, and pulled me out of the deep, dark pit of sin; I am attuned to the True Shabad. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਧਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: janam maran kaa sahasaa chookaa baahuR katahu na dhaaee ||7||
english: The fear of birth and death is taken away; I shall never wander again. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: naam rasaain ihu man raataa a(n)mrit pee tripataaee ||8||
english: This mind is imbued with the sublime elixir of the Naam; drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, it is satisfied. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੯॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g mil keeratan gaaiaa nihachal vasiaa jaaee ||9||
english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; I dwell in the eternal, unchanging place. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: poorai gur pooree mat deenee har bin aan na bhaaee ||10||
english: The Perfect Guru has given me the perfect teachings; there is nothing except the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan paaiaa vadabhaagee naanak narak na jaaee ||11||
english: I have obtained the treasure of the Naam, by great good fortune; O Nanak, I shall not fall into hell. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਾਲ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: ghaal siaanap ukat na meree poorai guroo kamaaee ||12||
english: Clever tricks have not worked for me; I shall act according to the Instructions of the Perfect Guru. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam such hai soee aape kare karaaee ||13||
english: He is chanting, intense meditation, austere self-discipline and purification. He Himself acts, and causes us to act. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਾਇ ਤਰਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: putr kalatr mahaa bikhiaa mahi gur saachai laai taraaee ||14||
english: In the midst of children and spouse, and utter corruption, the True Guru has carried me across. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: apane jee tai aap samhaale aap leee laR laaee ||15||
english: You Yourself take care of Your beings; You Yourself attach them to the hem of Your robe. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਬੇੜਾ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: saach dharam kaa beRaa baa(n)dhiaa bhavajal paar pavaaee ||16||
english: I have built the boat of true Dharmic faith, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: besumaar bea(n)t suaamee naanak bal bal jaaee ||17||
english: The Lord Master is unlimited and endless; Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ਕਲਿ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਦੀਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: akaal moorat ajoonee sa(n)bhau kal a(n)dhakaar deepaaee ||18||
english: Being of Immortal Manifestation, He is not born; He is self-existent; He is the Light in the darkness of Kali Yuga. ||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਖਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee jeean kaa daataa dekhat tripat aghaaee ||19||
english: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Giver of souls; gazing upon Him, I am satisfied and fulfilled. ||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਭ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: eka(n)kaar nira(n)jan nirabhau sabh jal thal rahiaa samaaee ||20||
english: He is the One Universal Creator Lord, immaculate and fearless; He is permeating and pervading all the water and the land. ||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਮਾਈ ॥੨੧॥੧॥੬॥
transliteration: bhagat daan bhagataa kau deenaa har naanak jaachai maaee ||21||1||6||
english: He blesses His devotees with the Gift of devotional worship; Nanak longs for the Lord, O my mother. ||21||1||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: sikhahu sabad piaariho janam maran kee tek ||
english: Study the Word of the Shabad, O beloveds. It is your anchoring support in life and in death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਏਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mukh oojal sadaa sukhee naanak simarat ek ||1||
english: Your face shall be radiant, and you will be at peace forever, O Nanak, meditating in remembrance on the One Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man tan raataa raam piaare har prem bhagat ban aaee sa(n)tahu ||1||
english: My mind and body are imbued with my Beloved Lord; I have been blessed with loving devotion to the Lord, O Saints. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਖੇਪ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur khep nibaahee sa(n)tahu ||
english: The True Guru has approved my cargo, O Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਉਲਾਹੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har naam laahaa daas kau deeaa sagalee trisan ulaahee sa(n)tahu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He has blessed His slave with the profit of the Lord's Name; all my thirst is quenched, O Saints. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਲਾਲੁ ਇਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khojat khojat laal ik paaiaa har keemat kahan na jaaee sa(n)tahu ||2||
english: Searching and searching, I have found the One Lord, the jewel; I cannot express His value, O Saints. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਧਿਆਨਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: charan kamal siu laago dhiaanaa saachai daras samaaee sa(n)tahu ||3||
english: I focus my meditation on His Lotus Feet; I am absorbed in the True Vision of His Darshan, O Saints. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gun gaavat gaavat bhae nihaalaa har simarat tripat aghaaee sa(n)tahu ||4||
english: Singing, singing His Glorious Praises, I am enraptured; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I am satisfied and fulfilled, O Saints. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਤ ਆਵੈ ਕਤ ਜਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aatam raam raviaa sabh a(n)tar kat aavai kat jaaee sa(n)tahu ||5||
english: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is permeating within all; what comes, and what goes, O Saints? ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਭ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aad jugaadee hai bhee hosee sabh jeeaa kaa sukhadaaee sa(n)tahu ||6||
english: At the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, He is, and He shall always be; He is the Giver of peace to all beings, O Saints. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aap bea(n)t a(n)t nahee paaeeai poor rahiaa sabh thaaee sa(n)tahu ||7||
english: He Himself is endless; His end cannot be found. He is totally pervading and permeating everywhere, O Saints. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸੁਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਪੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੭॥
transliteration: meet saajan maal joban sut har naanak baap meree maaee sa(n)tahu ||8||2||7||
english: Nanak: the Lord is my friend, companion, wealth, youth, son, father and mother, O Saints. ||8||2||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: man bach kram raam naam chitaaree ||
english: In thought, word and deed, I contemplate the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰਿ ਮਹਾ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਖੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ghooman gher mahaa at bikhaRee guramukh naanak paar utaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The horrible world-ocean is very treacherous; O Nanak, the Gurmukh is carried across. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਮਲਨ ਭਏ ਦੁਸਟਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tar sookhaa baahar sookhaa har jap malan bhae dusataaree ||1||
english: Inwardly, peace, and outwardly, peace; meditating on the Lord, evil tendencies are crushed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis te laage tinahi nivaare prabh jeeu apanee kirapaa dhaaree ||2||
english: He has rid me of what was clinging to me; my Dear Lord God has blessed me with His Grace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਧਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਚਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਹਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: udhare sa(n)t pare har saranee pach binase mahaa aha(n)kaaree ||3||
english: The Saints are saved, in His Sanctuary; the very egotistical people rot away and die. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਇਕੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat ihu phal paaiaa ik keval naam adhaaree ||4||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained this fruit, the Support of the One Name alone. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸੂਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੀਣਾ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: na koee soor na koee heenaa sabh pragatee jot tumhaaree ||5||
english: No one is strong, and no one is weak; all are manifestations of Your Light, Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਰਵਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: tumh samarath akath agochar raviaa ek muraaree ||6||
english: You are the all-powerful, indescribable, unfathomable, all-pervading Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: keemat kaun kare teree karate prabh a(n)t na paaraavaaree ||7||
english: Who can estimate Your value, O Creator Lord? God has no end or limitation. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਰੇਣਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੩॥੮॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naam daan naanak vadiaaee teriaa sa(n)t janaa renaaree ||8||3||8||22||
english: Please bless Nanak with the glorious greatness of the gift of the Naam, and the dust of the feet of Your Saints. ||8||3||8||22||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 ana(n)d ||
english: Raamkalee, Third Mehl, Anand ~ The Song Of Bliss:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ana(n)d bhaiaa meree maae satiguroo mai paaiaa ||
english: I am in ecstasy, O my mother, for I have found my True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀਆ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur ta paaiaa sahaj setee man vajeeaa vaadhaaeeaa ||
english: I have found the True Guru, with intuitive ease, and my mind vibrates with the music of bliss.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਪਰੀਆ ਸਬਦ ਗਾਵਣ ਆਈਆ ॥
transliteration: raag ratan paravaar pareeaa sabad gaavan aaeeaa ||
english: The jewelled melodies and their related celestial harmonies have come to sing the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੋ ਤ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਰੀ ਕੇਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabado ta gaavahu haree keraa man jinee vasaaiaa ||
english: The Lord dwells within the minds of those who sing the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahai naanak ana(n)d hoaa satiguroo mai paaiaa ||1||
english: Says Nanak, I am in ecstasy, for I have found my True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: e man meriaa too sadaa rahu har naale ||
english: O my mind, remain always with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਹੁ ਤੂ ਮੰਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੂਖ ਸਭਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: har naal rahu too ma(n)n mere dookh sabh visaaranaa ||
english: Remain always with the Lord, O my mind, and all sufferings will be forgotten.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)geekaar ohu kare teraa kaaraj sabh savaaranaa ||
english: He will accept You as His own, and all your affairs will be perfectly arranged.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa galaa samarath suaamee so kiu manahu visaare ||
english: Our Lord and Master is all-powerful to do all things, so why forget Him from your mind?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahai naanak ma(n)n mere sadaa rahu har naale ||2||
english: Says Nanak, O my mind, remain always with the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saache saahibaa kiaa naahee ghar terai ||
english: O my True Lord and Master, what is there which is not in Your celestial home?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: ghar ta terai sabh kichh hai jis dehi s paavae ||
english: Everything is in Your home; they receive, unto whom You give.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: sadaa siphat salaah teree naam man vasaavae ||
english: Constantly singing Your Praises and Glories, Your Name is enshrined in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਵਾਜੇ ਸਬਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naam jin kai man vasiaa vaaje sabad ghanere ||
english: The divine melody of the Shabad vibrates for those, within whose minds the Naam abides.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahai naanak sache saahib kiaa naahee ghar terai ||3||
english: Says Nanak, O my True Lord and Master, what is there which is not in Your home? ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: saachaa naam meraa aadhaaro ||
english: The True Name is my only support.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਭੁਖਾ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: saach naam adhaar meraa jin bhukhaa sabh gavaaeeaa ||
english: The True Name is my only support; it satisfies all hunger.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਛਾ ਸਭਿ ਪੁਜਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: kar saa(n)t sukh man aai vasiaa jin ichhaa sabh pujaaeeaa ||
english: It has brought peace and tranquility to my mind; it has fulfilled all my desires.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਸ ਦੀਆ ਏਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
transliteration: sadaa kurabaan keetaa guroo vitahu jis deeaa ehi vadiaaeeaa ||
english: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who possesses such glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਰਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
transliteration: kahai naanak sunahu sa(n)tahu sabad dharahu piaaro ||
english: Says Nanak, listen, O Saints; enshrine love for the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥੪॥
transliteration: saachaa naam meraa aadhaaro ||4||
english: The True Name is my only support. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੇ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: vaaje pa(n)ch sabad tit ghar sabhaagai ||
english: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate in that blessed house.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਸਭਾਗੈ ਸਬਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਕਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ghar sabhaagai sabad vaaje kalaa jit ghar dhaareeaa ||
english: In that blessed house, the Shabad vibrates; He infuses His almighty power into it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch doot tudh vas keete kaal ka(n)tak maariaa ||
english: Through You, we subdue the five demons of desire, and slay Death, the torturer.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: dhur karam paaiaa tudh jin kau s naam har kai laage ||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny are attached to the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kahai naanak tah sukh hoaa tit ghar anahad vaaje ||5||
english: Says Nanak, they are at peace, and the unstruck sound current vibrates within their homes. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਲਿਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: saachee livai bin deh nimaanee ||
english: Without the true love of devotion, the body is without honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਲਿਵੈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: deh nimaanee livai baajhahu kiaa kare vechaareeaa ||
english: The body is dishonored without devotional love; what can the poor wretches do?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਮਰਥ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh baajh samarath koi naahee kripaa kar banavaareeaa ||
english: No one except You is all-powerful; please bestow Your Mercy, O Lord of all nature.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਸ ਨਉ ਹੋਰੁ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: es nau hor thaau naahee sabad laag savaareeaa ||
english: There is no place of rest, other than the Name; attached to the Shabad, we are embellished with beauty.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਿਵੈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰੀਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kahai naanak livai baajhahu kiaa kare vechaareeaa ||6||
english: Says Nanak, without devotional love, what can the poor wretches do? ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aana(n)d aana(n)d sabh ko kahai aana(n)d guroo te jaaniaa ||
english: Bliss, bliss - everyone talks of bliss; bliss is known only through the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਣਿਆ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jaaniaa aana(n)d sadaa gur te kripaa kare piaariaa ||
english: Eternal bliss in known only through the Guru, when the Beloved Lord grants His Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਟੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa kilavikh kate giaan a(n)jan saariaa ||
english: Granting His Grace, He cuts away our sins; He blesses us with the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੁਟਾ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੈ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)darahu jin kaa mohu tutaa tin kaa sabad sachai savaariaa ||
english: Those who eradicate attachment from within themselves, are adorned with the Shabad, the Word of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਹੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kahai naanak ehu ana(n)d hai aana(n)d gur te jaaniaa ||7||
english: Says Nanak, this alone is bliss - bliss which is known through the Guru. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: baabaa jis too dehi soee jan paavai ||
english: O Baba, he alone receives it, unto whom You give it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵੈ ਤ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੇਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: paavai ta so jan dehi jis no hor kiaa karahi vechaariaa ||
english: He alone receives it, unto whom You give it; what can the other poor wretched beings do?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਇਕਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ik bharam bhoole phirahi dah dis ik naam laag savaariaa ||
english: Some are deluded by doubt, wandering in the ten directions; some are adorned with attachment to the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee man bhaiaa niramal jinaa bhaanaa bhaavae ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the mind becomes immaculate and pure, for those who follow God's Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵਏ ॥੮॥
transliteration: kahai naanak jis dehi piaare soee jan paavae ||8||
english: Says Nanak, he alone receives it, unto whom You give it, O Beloved Lord. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਅਕਥ ਕੀ ਕਰਹ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aavahu sa(n)t piaariho akath kee karah kahaanee ||
english: Come, Beloved Saints, let us speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਅਕਥ ਕੇਰੀ ਕਿਤੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: karah kahaanee akath keree kit duaarai paaeeai ||
english: How can we speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord? Through which door will we find Him?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਉਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: tan man dhan sabh saup gur kau hukam ma(n)niai paaeeai ||
english: Surrender body, mind, wealth, and everything to the Guru; obey the Order of His Will, and you will find Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇਰਾ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: hukam ma(n)nihu guroo keraa gaavahu sachee baanee ||
english: Obey the Hukam of the Guru's Command, and sing the True Word of His Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਥਿਹੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੯॥
transliteration: kahai naanak sunahu sa(n)tahu kathihu akath kahaanee ||9||
english: Says Nanak, listen, O Saints, and speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਚੰਚਲਾ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: e man cha(n)chalaa chaturaaee kinai na paaiaa ||
english: O fickle mind, through cleverness, no one has found the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਨੈ ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: chaturaaee na paaiaa kinai too sun ma(n)n meriaa ||
english: Through cleverness, no one has found Him; listen, O my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: eh maaiaa mohanee jin et bharam bhulaaiaa ||
english: This Maya is so fascinating; because of it, people wander in doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਤ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਤਿਨੈ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa ta mohanee tinai keetee jin thagaulee paaeeaa ||
english: This fascinating Maya was created by the One who has administered this potion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kurabaan keetaa tisai vitahu jin mohu meethaa laaiaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the One who has made emotional attachment sweet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਨ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: kahai naanak man cha(n)chal chaturaaee kinai na paaiaa ||10||
english: Says Nanak, O fickle mind, no one has found Him through cleverness. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: e man piaariaa too sadaa sach samaale ||
english: O beloved mind, contemplate the True Lord forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਤੂ ਜਿ ਦੇਖਦਾ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: ehu kuta(n)b too j dekhadaa chalai naahee terai naale ||
english: This family which you see shall not go along with you.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਥਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: saath terai chalai naahee tis naal kiu chit laaeeai ||
english: They shall not go along with you, so why do you focus your attention on them?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਕੰਮੁ ਮੂਲੇ ਨ ਕੀਚੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: aisaa ka(n)m moole na keechai jit a(n)t pachhotaaeeai ||
english: Don't do anything that you will regret in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੂ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo kaa upades sun too hovai terai naale ||
english: Listen to the Teachings of the True Guru - these shall go along with you.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: kahai naanak man piaare too sadaa sach samaale ||11||
english: Says Nanak, O beloved mind, contemplate the True Lord forever. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: agam agocharaa teraa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: O inaccessible and unfathomable Lord, Your limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੋ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਨੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਹੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)to na paaiaa kinai teraa aapanaa aap too jaanahe ||
english: No one has found Your limits; only You Yourself know.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਏ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh khel teraa kiaa ko aakh vakhaanae ||
english: All living beings and creatures are Your play; how can anyone describe You?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਤ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aakhahi ta vekhahi sabh toohai jin jagat upaaiaa ||
english: You speak, and You gaze upon all; You created the Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: kahai naanak too sadaa aga(n)m hai teraa a(n)t na paaiaa ||12||
english: Says Nanak, You are forever inaccessible; Your limits cannot be found. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਖੋਜਦੇ ਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sur nar mun jan a(n)mrit khojade s a(n)mrit gur te paaiaa ||
english: The angelic beings and the silent sages search for the Ambrosial Nectar; this Amrit is obtained from the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paaiaa a(n)mrit gur kripaa keenee sachaa man vasaaiaa ||
english: This Amrit is obtained, when the Guru grants His Grace; He enshrines the True Lord within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਇਕਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਪਰਸਣਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh tudh upaae ik vekh parasan aaiaa ||
english: All living beings and creatures were created by You; only some come to see the Guru, and seek His blessing.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: lab lobh aha(n)kaar chookaa satiguroo bhalaa bhaaiaa ||
english: Their greed, avarice and egotism are dispelled, and the True Guru seems sweet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: kahai naanak jis no aap tuthaa tin a(n)mrit gur te paaiaa ||13||
english: Says Nanak, those with whom the Lord is pleased, obtain the Amrit, through the Guru. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਾਲ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa kee chaal niraalee ||
english: The lifestyle of the devotees is unique and distinct.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਲਾ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਭਗਤਾਹ ਕੇਰੀ ਬਿਖਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਣਾ ॥
transliteration: chaalaa niraalee bhagataah keree bikham maarag chalanaa ||
english: The devotees' lifestyle is unique and distinct; they follow the most difficult path.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਜਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੋਲਣਾ ॥
