transliteration: lab lobh aha(n)kaar taj trisanaa bahut naahee bolanaa ||
english: They renounce greed, avarice, egotism and desire; they do not talk too much.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖੰਨਿਅਹੁ ਤਿਖੀ ਵਾਲਹੁ ਨਿਕੀ ਏਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)niahu tikhee vaalahu nikee et maarag jaanaa ||
english: The path they take is sharper than a two-edged sword, and finer than a hair.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee jinee aap tajiaa har vaasanaa samaanee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, they shed their selfishness and conceit; their hopes are merged in the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚਾਲ ਭਗਤਾ ਜੁਗਹੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: kahai naanak chaal bhagataa jugahu jug niraalee ||14||
english: Says Nanak, the lifestyle of the devotees, in each and every age, is unique and distinct. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਇਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਚਲਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jiu too chalaaihi tiv chalah suaamee hor kiaa jaanaa gun tere ||
english: As You make me walk, so do I walk, O my Lord and Master; what else do I know of Your Glorious Virtues?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਵ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਇਹਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਹ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: jiv too chalaaihi tivai chalah jinaa maarag paavahe ||
english: As You cause them to walk, they walk - You have placed them on the Path.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਇਹਿ ਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jin naam laaihi s har har sadaa dhiaavahe ||
english: In Your Mercy, You attach them to the Naam; they meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਇਹਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਿ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: jis no kathaa sunaaihi aapanee s guraduaarai sukh paavahe ||
english: Those whom You cause to listen to Your sermon, find peace in the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: kahai naanak sache saahib jiu bhaavai tivai chalaavahe ||15||
english: Says Nanak, O my True Lord and Master, you make us walk according to Your Will. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: ehu sohilaa sabad suhaavaa ||
english: This song of praise is the Shabad, the most beautiful Word of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੋ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabado suhaavaa sadaa sohilaa satiguroo sunaaiaa ||
english: This beauteous Shabad is the everlasting song of praise, spoken by the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ehu tin kai ma(n)n vasiaa jin dhurahu likhiaa aaiaa ||
english: This is enshrined in the minds of those who are so pre-destined by the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਗਲਾ ਗਲੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ik phirahi ghanere karahi galaa galee kinai na paaiaa ||
english: Some wander around, babbling on and on, but none obtain Him by babbling.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: kahai naanak sabad sohilaa satiguroo sunaaiaa ||16||
english: Says Nanak, the Shabad, this song of praise, has been spoken by the True Guru. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਏ ਸੇ ਜਨਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pavit hoe se janaa jinee har dhiaaiaa ||
english: Those humble beings who meditate on the Lord become pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har dhiaaiaa pavit hoe guramukh jinee dhiaaiaa ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, they become pure; as Gurmukh, they meditate on Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਵਿਤੁ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: pavit maataa pitaa kuta(n)b sahit siu pavit sa(n)gat sabaaeeaa ||
english: They are pure, along with their mothers, fathers, family and friends; all their companions are pure as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਦੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਦੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kahade pavit sunade pavit se pavit jinee ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
english: Pure are those who speak, and pure are those who listen; those who enshrine it within their minds are pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: kahai naanak se pavit jinee guramukh har har dhiaaiaa ||17||
english: Says Nanak, pure and holy are those who, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: karamee sahaj na oopajai vin sahajai sahasaa na jaai ||
english: By religious rituals, intuitive poise is not found; without intuitive poise, skepticism does not depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਸਾ ਕਿਤੈ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nah jaai sahasaa kitai sa(n)jam rahe karam kamaae ||
english: Skepticism does not depart by contrived actions; everybody is tired of performing these rituals.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸੈ ਜੀਉ ਮਲੀਣੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਧੋਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sahasai jeeu maleen hai kit sa(n)jam dhotaa jaae ||
english: The soul is polluted by skepticism; how can it be cleansed?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੁ ਧੋਵਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)n dhovahu sabad laagahu har siu rahahu chit laai ||
english: Wash your mind by attaching it to the Shabad, and keep your consciousness focused on the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਜੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਇਹੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਇਵ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: kahai naanak gur parasaadee sahaj upajai ihu sahasaa iv jaai ||18||
english: Says Nanak, by Guru's Grace, intuitive poise is produced, and this skepticism is dispelled. ||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਹੁ ਮੈਲੇ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ॥
transliteration: jeeahu maile baaharahu niramal ||
english: Inwardly polluted, and outwardly pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਤ ਮੈਲੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: baaharahu niramal jeeahu ta maile tinee janam jooai haariaa ||
english: Those who are outwardly pure and yet polluted within, lose their lives in the gamble.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: eh tisanaa vadaa rog lagaa maran manahu visaariaa ||
english: They contract this terrible disease of desire, and in their minds, they forget about dying.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵੇਦਾ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਸੋ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: vedaa mahi naam utam so sunahi naahee phirahi jiu betaaliaa ||
english: In the Vedas, the ultimate objective is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; but they do not hear this, and they wander around like demons.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਕੂੜੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: kahai naanak jin sach tajiaa kooRe laage tinee janam jooai haariaa ||19||
english: Says Nanak, those who forsake Truth and cling to falsehood, lose their lives in the gamble. ||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ॥
transliteration: jeeahu niramal baaharahu niramal ||
english: Inwardly pure, and outwardly pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: baaharahu ta niramal jeeahu niramal satigur te karanee kamaanee ||
english: Those who are outwardly pure and also pure within, through the Guru, perform good deeds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: kooR kee soi pahuchai naahee manasaa sach samaanee ||
english: Not even an iota of falsehood touches them; their hopes are absorbed in the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਖਟਿਆ ਭਲੇ ਸੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: janam ratan jinee khatiaa bhale se vanajaare ||
english: Those who earn the jewel of this human life, are the most excellent of merchants.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨ ਮੰਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: kahai naanak jin ma(n)n niramal sadaa rahahi gur naale ||20||
english: Says Nanak, those whose minds are pure, abide with the Guru forever. ||20||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je ko sikh guroo setee sanamukh hovai ||
english: If a Sikh turns to the Guru with sincere faith, as sunmukh

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਵੈ ਤ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: hovai ta sanamukh sikh koee jeeahu rahai gur naale ||
english: if a Sikh turns to the Guru with sincere faith, as sunmukh, his soul abides with the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਆਏ ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੈ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gur ke charan hiradai dhiaae a(n)tar aatamai samaale ||
english: Within his heart, he meditates on the lotus feet of the Guru; deep within his soul, he contemplates Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛਡਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਪਰਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਏ ॥
transliteration: aap chhad sadaa rahai paranai gur bin avar na jaanai koe ||
english: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, he remains always on the side of the Guru; he does not know anyone except the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਏ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: kahai naanak sunahu sa(n)tahu so sikh sanamukh hoe ||21||
english: Says Nanak, listen, O Saints: such a Sikh turns toward the Guru with sincere faith, and becomes sunmukh. ||21||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je ko gur te vemukh hovai bin satigur mukat na paavai ||
english: One who turns away from the Guru, and becomes baymukh - without the True Guru, he shall not find liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਕੋਈ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੀਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: paavai mukat na hor thai koee puchhahu bibekeeaa jaae ||
english: He shall not find liberation anywhere else either; go and ask the wise ones about this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਜੂਨੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਆਵੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anek joonee bharam aavai vin satigur mukat na paae ||
english: He shall wander through countless incarnations; without the True Guru, he shall not find liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਲਾਗਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: phir mukat paae laag charanee satiguroo sabad sunaae ||
english: But liberation is attained, when one is attached to the feet of the True Guru, chanting the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: kahai naanak veechaar dekhahu vin satigur mukat na paae ||22||
english: Says Nanak, contemplate this and see, that without the True Guru, there is no liberation. ||22||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸਿਖ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aavahu sikh satiguroo ke piaariho gaavahu sachee baanee ||
english: Come, O beloved Sikhs of the True Guru, and sing the True Word of His Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਤ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: baanee ta gaavahu guroo keree baaneeaa sir baanee ||
english: Sing the Guru's Bani, the supreme Word of Words.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jin kau nadar karam hovai hiradai tinaa samaanee ||
english: Those who are blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace - their hearts are imbued with this Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਪਿਹੁ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: peevahu a(n)mrit sadaa rahahu har ra(n)g japihu saarigapaanee ||
english: Drink in this Ambrosial Nectar, and remain in the Lord's Love forever; meditate on the Lord, the Sustainer of the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਏਹ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: kahai naanak sadaa gaavahu eh sachee baanee ||23||
english: Says Nanak, sing this True Bani forever. ||23||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨਾ ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo binaa hor kachee hai baanee ||
english: Without the True Guru, other songs are false.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਤ ਕਚੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: baanee ta kachee satiguroo baajhahu hor kachee baanee ||
english: The songs are false without the True Guru; all other songs are false.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਦੇ ਕਚੇ ਸੁਣਦੇ ਕਚੇ ਕਚਂੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: kahade kache sunade kache kacha(n)ee aakh vakhaanee ||
english: The speakers are false, and the listeners are false; those who speak and recite are false.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har har nit karahi rasanaa kahiaa kachhoo na jaanee ||
english: They may continually chant, 'Har, Har' with their tongues, but they do not know what they are saying.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਪਏ ਰਵਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: chit jin kaa hir laiaa maaiaa bolan pae ravaanee ||
english: Their consciousness is lured by Maya; they are just reciting mechanically.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: kahai naanak satiguroo baajhahu hor kachee baanee ||24||
english: Says Nanak, without the True Guru, other songs are false. ||24||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਹੀਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad rata(n)n hai heere jit jaRaau ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is a jewel, studded with diamonds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੰਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਏਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabad ratan jit ma(n)n laagaa ehu hoaa samaau ||
english: The mind which is attached to this jewel, merges into the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabad setee man miliaa sachai laaiaa bhaau ||
english: One whose mind is attuned to the Shabad, enshrines love for the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape heeraa ratan aape jis no dei bujhaai ||
english: He Himself is the diamond, and He Himself is the jewel; one who is blessed, understands its value.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੜਾਉ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: kahai naanak sabad ratan hai heeraa jit jaRaau ||25||
english: Says Nanak, the Shabad is a jewel, studded with diamonds. ||25||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ ॥
transliteration: siv sakat aap upaai kai karataa aape hukam varataae ||
english: He Himself created Shiva and Shakti, mind and matter; the Creator subjects them to His Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hukam varataae aap vekhai guramukh kisai bujhaae ||
english: Enforcing His Order, He Himself sees all. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, come to know Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੋੜੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: toRe ba(n)dhan hovai mukat sabad ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: They break their bonds, and attain liberation; they enshrine the Shabad within their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jis no aap kare s hovai ekas siu liv laae ||
english: Those whom the Lord Himself makes Gurmukh, lovingly focus their consciousness on the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: kahai naanak aap karataa aape hukam bujhaae ||26||
english: Says Nanak, He Himself is the Creator; He Himself reveals the Hukam of His Command. ||26||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪ ਬੀਚਾਰਦੇ ਤਤੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: simrit saasatr pu(n)n paap beechaarade tatai saar na jaanee ||
english: The Simritees and the Shaastras discriminate between good and evil, but they do not know the true essence of reality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਤੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਤਤੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: tatai saar na jaanee guroo baajhahu tatai saar na jaanee ||
english: They do not know the true essence of reality without the Guru; they do not know the true essence of reality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਹੀ ਗੁਣੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੁਤਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: tihee gunee sa(n)saar bhram sutaa sutiaa rain vihaanee ||
english: The world is asleep in the three modes and doubt; it passes the night of its life sleeping.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te se jan jaage jinaa har man vasiaa bolahi a(n)mrit baanee ||
english: Those humble beings remain awake and aware, within whose minds, by Guru's Grace, the Lord abides; they chant the Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੋ ਤਤੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾਗਤ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: kahai naanak so tat paae jis no anadin har liv laagai jaagat rain vihaanee ||27||
english: Says Nanak, they alone obtain the essence of reality, who night and day remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord; they pass the night of their life awake and aware. ||27||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਕੇ ਉਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: maataa ke udar mahi pratipaal kare so kiu manahu visaareeai ||
english: He nourished us in the mother's womb; why forget Him from the mind?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਏਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਆਹਾਰੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: manahu kiu visaareeai evad daataa j agan mahi aahaar pahuchaavae ||
english: Why forget from the mind such a Great Giver, who gave us sustenance in the fire of the womb?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਹੁ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੀ ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪਣੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: os no kihu pohi na sakee jis nau aapanee liv laavae ||
english: Nothing can harm one, whom the Lord inspires to embrace His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਲਿਵ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: aapanee liv aape laae guramukh sadaa samaaleeai ||
english: He Himself is the love, and He Himself is the embrace; the Gurmukh contemplates Him forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: kahai naanak evad daataa so kiu manahu visaareeai ||28||
english: Says Nanak, why forget such a Great Giver from the mind? ||28||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaisee agan udar mahi taisee baahar maaiaa ||
english: As is the fire within the womb, so is Maya outside.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਭ ਇਕੋ ਜੇਹੀ ਕਰਤੈ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa agan sabh iko jehee karatai khel rachaaiaa ||
english: The fire of Maya is one and the same; the Creator has staged this play.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਰਿ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa tis bhaanaa taa ja(n)miaa paravaar bhalaa bhaaiaa ||
english: According to His Will, the child is born, and the family is very pleased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਿਵ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਲਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਮਰੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: liv chhuRakee lagee trisanaa maaiaa amar varataaiaa ||
english: Love for the Lord wears off, and the child becomes attached to desires; the script of Maya runs its course.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: eh maaiaa jit har visarai mohu upajai bhaau doojaa laaiaa ||
english: This is Maya, by which the Lord is forgotten; emotional attachment and love of duality well up.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਤਿਨੀ ਵਿਚੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: kahai naanak gur parasaadee jinaa liv laagee tinee viche maaiaa paaiaa ||29||
english: Says Nanak, by Guru's Grace, those who enshrine love for the Lord find Him, in the midst of Maya. ||29||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਮੁਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har aap amulak hai mul na paaiaa jaai ||
english: The Lord Himself is priceless; His worth cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਰਹੇ ਲੋਕ ਵਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mul na paaiaa jaai kisai vitahu rahe lok vilalaai ||
english: His worth cannot be estimated, even though people have grown weary of trying.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਉਪੀਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa satigur je milai tis no sir saupeeai vichahu aap jaai ||
english: If you meet such a True Guru, offer your head to Him; your selfishness and conceit will be eradicated from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: jis daa jeeu tis mil rahai har vasai man aai ||
english: Your soul belongs to Him; remain united with Him, and the Lord will come to dwell in your mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਮੁਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: har aap amulak hai bhaag tinaa ke naanakaa jin har palai paai ||30||
english: The Lord Himself is priceless; very fortunate are those, O Nanak, who attain to the Lord. ||30||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har raas meree man vanajaaraa ||
english: The Lord is my capital; my mind is the merchant.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਰਾਸਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har raas meree man vanajaaraa satigur te raas jaanee ||
english: The Lord is my capital, and my mind is the merchant; through the True Guru, I know my capital.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਿਹੁ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਖਟਿਹੁ ਦਿਹਾੜੀ ॥
transliteration: har har nit japihu jeeahu laahaa khatihu dihaaRee ||
english: Meditate continually on the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul, and you shall collect your profits daily.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ehu dhan tinaa miliaa jin har aape bhaanaa ||
english: This wealth is obtained by those who are pleasing to the Lord's Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: kahai naanak har raas meree man hoaa vanajaaraa ||31||
english: Says Nanak, the Lord is my capital, and my mind is the merchant. ||31||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਰਸਨਾ ਤੂ ਅਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: e rasanaa too an ras raach rahee teree piaas na jaai ||
english: O my tongue, you are engrossed in other tastes, but your thirsty desire is not quenched.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: piaas na jaai horat kitai jichar har ras palai na paai ||
english: Your thirst shall not be quenched by any means, until you attain the subtle essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇ ਪਲੈ ਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: har ras paai palai peeai har ras bahuR na trisanaa laagai aai ||
english: If you do obtain the subtle essence of the Lord, and drink in this essence of the Lord, you shall not be troubled by desire again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: ehu har ras karamee paaeeai satigur milai jis aai ||
english: This subtle essence of the Lord is obtained by good karma, when one comes to meet with the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਭਿ ਵੀਸਰੇ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩੨॥
transliteration: kahai naanak hor an ras sabh veesare jaa har vasai man aai ||32||
english: Says Nanak, all other tastes and essences are forgotten, when the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||32||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਖੀ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: e sareeraa meriaa har tum mahi jot rakhee taa too jag mahi aaiaa ||
english: O my body, the Lord infused His Light into you, and then you came into the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਖੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har jot rakhee tudh vich taa too jag mahi aaiaa ||
english: The Lord infused His Light into you, and then you came into the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਉਪਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har aape maataa aape pitaa jin jeeu upaai jagat dikhaaiaa ||
english: The Lord Himself is your mother, and He Himself is your father; He created the created beings, and revealed the world to them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਤਾ ਚਲਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਚਲਤੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee bujhiaa taa chalat hoaa chalat nadaree aaiaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, some understand, and then it's a show; it seems like just a show.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਰਚਿਆ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੩੩॥
transliteration: kahai naanak srisat kaa mool rachiaa jot raakhee taa too jag mahi aaiaa ||33||
english: Says Nanak, He laid the foundation of the Universe, and infused His Light, and then you came into the world. ||33||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗਮੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: man chaau bhaiaa prabh aagam suniaa ||
english: My mind has become joyful, hearing of God's coming.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਉ ਸਖੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਬਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har ma(n)gal gaau sakhee grihu ma(n)dar baniaa ||
english: Sing the songs of joy to welcome the Lord, O my companions; my household has become the Lord's Mansion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗਾਉ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਖੀਏ ਸੋਗੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਏ ॥
transliteration: har gaau ma(n)gal nit sakheee sog dookh na viaapae ||
english: Sing continually the songs of joy to welcome the Lord, O my companions, and sorrow and suffering will not afflict you.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਪਏ ॥
transliteration: gur charan laage din sabhaage aapanaa pir jaapae ||
english: Blessed is that day, when I am attached to the Guru's feet and meditate on my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
transliteration: anahat baanee gur sabad jaanee har naam har ras bhogo ||
english: I have come to know the unstruck sound current and the Word of the Guru's Shabad; I enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord, the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੋ ॥੩੪॥
transliteration: kahai naanak prabh aap miliaa karan kaaran jogo ||34||
english: Says Nanak, God Himself has met me; He is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||34||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇ ਕੈ ਕਿਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: e sareeraa meriaa is jag mahi aai kai kiaa tudh karam kamaaiaa ||
english: O my body, why have you come into this world? What actions have you committed?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: k karam kamaaiaa tudh sareeraa jaa too jag mahi aaiaa ||
english: And what actions have you committed, O my body, since you came into this world?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਿਆ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin har teraa rachan rachiaa so har man na vasaaiaa ||
english: The Lord who formed your form - you have not enshrined that Lord in your mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har ma(n)n vasiaa poorab likhiaa paaiaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Lord abides within the mind, and one's pre-ordained destiny is fulfilled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩੫॥
transliteration: kahai naanak ehu sareer paravaan hoaa jin satigur siu chit laaiaa ||35||
english: Says Nanak, this body is adorned and honored, when one's consciousness is focused on the True Guru. ||35||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਮੇਰਿਹੋ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: e netrahu meriho har tum mahi jot dharee har bin avar na dekhahu koee ||
english: O my eyes, the Lord has infused His Light into you; do not look upon any other than the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਦਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har bin avar na dekhahu koee nadaree har nihaaliaa ||
english: Do not look upon any other than the Lord; the Lord alone is worthy of beholding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਵਿਸੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਖਦੇ ਏਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ehu vis sa(n)saar tum dekhade ehu har kaa roop hai har roop nadaree aaiaa ||
english: This whole world which you see is the image of the Lord; only the image of the Lord is seen.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਜਾ ਵੇਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee bujhiaa jaa vekhaa har ik hai har bin avar na koee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I understand, and I see only the One Lord; there is no one except the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਹਿ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਅੰਧ ਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਦਿਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩੬॥
transliteration: kahai naanak ehi netr a(n)dh se satigur miliai dib drisat hoee ||36||
english: Says Nanak, these eyes were blind; but meeting the True Guru, they became all-seeing. ||36||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਹੁ ਮੇਰਿਹੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੁਨਣੈ ਨੋ ਪਠਾਏ ॥
transliteration: e sravanahu meriho saachai sunanai no pathaae ||
english: O my ears, you were created only to hear the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸੁਨਣੈ ਨੋ ਪਠਾਏ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਲਾਏ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸਤਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: saachai sunanai no pathaae sareer laae sunahu sat baanee ||
english: To hear the Truth, you were created and attached to the body; listen to the True Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jit sunee man tan hariaa hoaa rasanaa ras samaanee ||
english: Hearing it, the mind and body are rejuvenated, and the tongue is absorbed in Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਅਲਖ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sach alakh vidaanee taa kee gat kahee na jaae ||
english: The True Lord is unseen and wondrous; His state cannot be described.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੁਨਣੈ ਨੋ ਪਠਾਏ ॥੩੭॥
transliteration: kahai naanak a(n)mrit naam sunahu pavitr hovahu saachai sunanai no pathaae ||37||
english: Says Nanak, listen to the Ambrosial Naam and become holy; you were created only to hear the Truth. ||37||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਫਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਕੈ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਵਣੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu guphaa a(n)dar rakh kai vaajaa pavan vajaaiaa ||
english: The Lord placed the soul to the cave of the body, and blew the breath of life into the musical instrument of the body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਜਾਇਆ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਉਣ ਨਉ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕੀਏ ਦਸਵਾ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vajaaiaa vaajaa paun nau duaare paragat keee dasavaa gupat rakhaaiaa ||
english: He blew the breath of life into the musical instrument of the body, and revealed the nine doors; but He kept the Tenth Door hidden.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰੈ ਲਾਇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਇਕਨਾ ਦਸਵਾ ਦੁਆਰੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guraduaarai laai bhaavanee ikanaa dasavaa duaar dikhaaiaa ||
english: Through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, some are blessed with loving faith, and the Tenth Door is revealed to them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਅਨੇਕ ਰੂਪ ਨਾਉ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tah anek roop naau nav nidh tis daa a(n)t na jaaee paaiaa ||
english: There are many images of the Lord, and the nine treasures of the Naam; His limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਫਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਕੈ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਵਣੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੩੮॥
transliteration: kahai naanak har piaarai jeeu guphaa a(n)dar rakh kai vaajaa pavan vajaaiaa ||38||
english: Says Nanak, the Lord placed the soul to the cave of the body, and blew the breath of life into the musical instrument of the body. ||38||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: ehu saachaa sohilaa saachai ghar gaavahu ||
english: Sing this true song of praise in the true home of your soul.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਤ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: gaavahu ta sohilaa ghar saachai jithai sadaa sach dhiaavahe ||
english: Sing the song of praise in your true home; meditate there on the True Lord forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: sacho dhiaavahi jaa tudh bhaavahi guramukh jinaa bujhaavahe ||
english: They alone meditate on You, O True Lord, who are pleasing to Your Will; as Gurmukh, they understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: ihu sach sabhanaa kaa khasam hai jis bakhase so jan paavahe ||
english: This Truth is the Lord and Master of all; whoever is blessed, obtains it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥੩੯॥
transliteration: kahai naanak sach sohilaa sachai ghar gaavahe ||39||
english: Says Nanak, sing the true song of praise in the true home of your soul. ||39||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: anad sunahu vadabhaageeho sagal manorath poore ||
english: Listen to the song of bliss, O most fortunate ones; all your longings shall be fulfilled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਉਤਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham prabh paaiaa utare sagal visoore ||
english: I have obtained the Supreme Lord God, and all sorrows have been forgotten.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਉਤਰੇ ਸੁਣੀ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: dookh rog sa(n)taap utare sunee sachee baanee ||
english: Pain, illness and suffering have departed, listening to the True Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਭਏ ਸਰਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t saajan bhae sarase poore gur te jaanee ||
english: The Saints and their friends are in ecstasy, knowing the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਤੇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਹਤੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sunate puneet kahate pavit satigur rahiaa bharapoore ||
english: Pure are the listeners, and pure are the speakers; the True Guru is all-pervading and permeating.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥੪੦॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak gur charan laage vaaje anahad toore ||40||1||
english: Prays Nanak, touching the Guru's Feet, the unstruck sound current of the celestial bugles vibrates and resounds. ||40||1||

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਸਦੁ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee sad ||
english: Raamkalee, Sadd ~ The Call Of Death:

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jag daataa soi bhagat vachhal tihu loi jeeu ||
english: He is the Great Giver of the Universe, the Lover of His devotees, throughout the three worlds.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: gur sabad samaavae avar na jaanai koi jeeu ||
english: One who is merged in the Word of the Guru's Shabad does not know any other.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੋ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: avaro na jaanahi sabad gur kai ek naam dhiaavahe ||
english: Dwelling upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he does not know any other; he meditates on the One Name of the Lord.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਅੰਗਦ ਪਰਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
transliteration: parasaad naanak guroo a(n)gad param padavee paavahe ||
english: By the Grace of Guru Nanak and Guru Angad, Guru Amar Das obtained the supreme status.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਹਕਾਰਾ ਚਲਣਵਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aaiaa hakaaraa chalanavaaraa har raam naam samaaiaa ||
english: And when the call came for Him to depart, He merged in the Name of the Lord.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਅਟਲੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jag amar atal atol thaakur bhagat te har paaiaa ||1||
english: Through devotional worship in this world, the imperishable, immovable, immeasurable Lord is found. ||1||

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har bhaanaa gur bhaaiaa gur jaavai har prabh paas jeeu ||
english: The Guru gladly accepted the Lord's Will, and so the Guru easily reached the Lord God's Presence.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur kare har pahi benatee meree paij rakhahu aradaas jeeu ||
english: The True Guru prays to the Lord, "Please, save my honor. This is my prayer".

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਹ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
transliteration: paij raakhahu har janah keree har dehu naam nira(n)jano ||
english: Please save the honor of Your humble servant, O Lord; please bless him with Your Immaculate Name.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਬੇਲੀ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਖੰਜਨੋ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t chaladiaa hoi belee jamadoot kaal nikha(n)jano ||
english: At this time of final departure, it is our only help and support; it destroys death, and the Messenger of Death.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo kee benatee paaee har prabh sunee aradaas jeeu ||
english: The Lord God heard the prayer of the True Guru, and granted His request.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har dhaar kirapaa satigur milaaiaa dhan dhan kahai saabaas jeeu ||2||
english: The Lord showered His Mercy, and blended the True Guru with Himself; He said, "Blessed! Blessed! Wonderful!" ||2||

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਉ ਮੈ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: mere sikh sunahu put bhaaeeho merai har bhaanaa aau mai paas jeeu ||
english: Listen O my Sikhs, my children and Siblings of Destiny; it is my Lord's Will that I must now go to Him.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har bhaanaa gur bhaaiaa meraa har prabh kare saabaas jeeu ||
english: The Guru gladly accepted the Lord's Will, and my Lord God applauded Him.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: bhagat satigur purakh soee jis har prabh bhaanaa bhaavae ||
english: One who is pleased with the Lord God's Will is a devotee, the True Guru, the Primal Lord.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਲਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: aana(n)d anahad vajahi vaaje har aap gal melaavae ||
english: The unstruck sound current of bliss resounds and vibrates; the Lord hugs him close in His embrace.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਤੁਸੀ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: tusee put bhaaee paravaar meraa man vekhahu kar nirajaas jeeu ||
english: O my children, siblings and family, look carefully in your minds, and see.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhur likhiaa paravaanaa phirai naahee gur jaai har prabh paas jeeu ||3||
english: The pre-ordained death warrant cannot be avoided; the Guru is going to be with the Lord God. ||3||

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਬਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhaanai aapanai bahi paravaar sadaaiaa ||
english: The True Guru, in His Own Sweet Will, sat up and summoned His family.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਮਤ ਮੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਕੋਈ ਰੋਵਸੀ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mat mai pichhai koee rovasee so mai mool na bhaaiaa ||
english: Let no one weep for me after I am gone. That would not please me at all.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਮਿਤੁ ਪੈਝੈ ਮਿਤੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਤ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: mit paijhai mit bigasai jis mit kee paij bhaavae ||
english: When a friend receives a robe of honor, then his friends are pleased with his honor.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਤੁਸੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪੈਨਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: tusee veechaar dekhahu put bhaaee har satiguroo painaavae ||
english: Consider this and see, O my children and siblings; the Lord has given the True Guru the robe of supreme honor.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਹੋਦੈ ਬਹਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਟਿਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo paratakh hodai bahi raaj aap tikaaiaa ||
english: The True Guru Himself sat up, and appointed the successor to the Throne of Raja Yoga, the Yoga of Meditation and Success.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸਿਖ ਬੰਧਪ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sabh sikh ba(n)dhap put bhaaee raamadaas pairee paaiaa ||4||
english: All the Sikhs, relatives, children and siblings have fallen at the Feet of Guru Ram Das. ||4||

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਮੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਿਅਹੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)te satigur boliaa mai pichhai keeratan kariahu nirabaan jeeu ||
english: Finally, the True Guru said, "When I am gone, sing Kirtan in Praise of the Lord, in Nirvaanaa."

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਕੇਸੋ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸਦਿਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: keso gopaal pa(n)dit sadiahu har har kathaa paRahi puraan jeeu ||
english: Call in the long-haired scholarly Saints of the Lord, to read the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਬੇਬਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: har kathaa paReeai har naam suneeai bebaan har ra(n)g gur bhaavae ||
english: Read the sermon of the Lord, and listen to the Lord's Name; the Guru is pleased with love for the Lord.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਤਲਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਦੀਵਾ ਫੁਲ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: pi(n)d patal kiriaa deevaa phul har sar paavae ||
english: Do not bother with offering rice-balls on leaves, lighting lamps, and other rituals like floating the body out on the Ganges; instead, let my remains be given up to the Lord's Pool.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har bhaaiaa satigur boliaa har miliaa purakh sujaan jeeu ||
english: The Lord was pleased as the True Guru spoke; he was blended then with the all-knowing Primal Lord God.

author: Baba Sundar
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸੋਢੀ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: raamadaas sodhee tilak deeaa gurasabad sach neesaan jeeu ||5||
english: The Guru then blessed the Sodhi Ram Das with the ceremonial tilak mark, the insignia of the True Word of the Shabad. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਈ ਰਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh j boliaa gurasikhaa ma(n)n laee rajaai jeeu ||
english: And as the True Guru, the Primal Lord spoke, and the Gursikhs obeyed His Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਰੀ ਪੁਤੁ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: moharee put sanamukh hoiaa raamadaasai pairee paai jeeu ||
english: His son Mohri turned sunmukh, and become obedient to Him; he bowed, and touched Ram Das' feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਪਵੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੇਰੀ ਜਿਥੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh pavai pairee satiguroo keree jithai guroo aap rakhiaa ||
english: Then, everyone bowed and touched the feet of Ram Das, into whom the Guru infused His essence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਨਿਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਆਣਿ ਨਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: koee kar bakheelee nivai naahee phir satiguroo aan nivaaiaa ||
english: And any that did not bow then because of envy - later, the True Guru brought them around to bow in humility.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਦੀਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਰਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har gurahi bhaanaa deeee vadiaaee dhur likhiaa lekh rajaai jeeu ||
english: It pleased the Guru, the Lord, to bestow glorious greatness upon Him; such was the pre-ordained destiny of the Lord's Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥੧॥
transliteration: kahai su(n)dar sunahu sa(n)tahu sabh jagat pairee paai jeeu ||6||1||
english: Says Sundar, listen, O Saints: all the world fell at His feet. ||6||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨੜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਜਨੜਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਖਲੋਇਅੜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਜਨੜਾ ॥
transliteration: saajanaRaa meraa saajanaRaa nikat khaloiaRaa meraa saajanaRaa ||
english: Friend, my Friend - standing so near to me is my Friend!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਇਅੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ॥
transliteration: jaaneeaRaa har jaaneeaRaa nain aloiaRaa har jaaneeaRaa ||
english: Beloved, the Lord my Beloved - with my eyes, I have seen the Lord, my Beloved!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਇਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੋਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਗੂੜਾ ॥
transliteration: nain aloiaa ghat ghat soiaa at a(n)mrit pri gooRaa ||
english: With my eyes I have seen Him, sleeping upon the bed within each and every heart; my Beloved is the sweetest ambrosial nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਲਿ ਹੋਵੰਦਾ ਲਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੰਦਾ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੂੜਾ ॥
transliteration: naal hova(n)daa lahi na saka(n)daa suaau na jaanai mooRaa ||
english: He is with all, but he cannot be found; the fool does not know His taste.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਹੋਛੀ ਬਾਤਾ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਭਰਮ ਧੜਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mad maataa hochhee baataa milan na jaaee bharam dhaRaa ||
english: Intoxicated with the wine of Maya, the mortal babbles on about trivial affairs; giving in to the illusion, he cannot meet the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਖੜਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur bin naahee soojhai har saajan sabh kai nikat khaRaa ||1||
english: Says Nanak, without the Guru, he cannot understand the Lord, the Friend who is standing near everyone. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)daa mere gobi(n)daa praan adhaaraa mere gobi(n)daa ||
english: God, my God - the Support of the breath of life is my God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਦਾਨ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kirapaalaa mere kirapaalaa daan daataaraa mere kirapaalaa ||
english: Merciful Lord, my Merciful Lord - the Giver of gifts is my Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: daan daataaraa apar apaaraa ghat ghat a(n)tar sohaniaa ||
english: The Giver of gifts is infinite and unlimited; deep within each and every heart, He is so beautiful!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਦਾਸੀ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਬਲ ਪਸਾਰੀ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਲੈ ਮੋਹਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ik daasee dhaaree sabal pasaaree jee ja(n)t lai mohaniaa ||
english: He created Maya, His slave, so powerfully pervasive - she has enticed all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis no raakhai so sach bhaakhai gur kaa sabad beechaaraa ||
english: One whom the Lord saves, chants the True Name, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jo prabh kau bhaanaa tis hee kau prabh piaaraa ||2||
english: Says Nanak, one who is pleasing to God - God is very dear to him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਣੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਮਾਣੋ ॥
transliteration: maano prabh maano mere prabh kaa maano ||
english: I take pride, I take pride in God; I take pride in my God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੋ ॥
transliteration: jaano prabh jaano suaamee sughaR sujaano ||
english: Wise, God is wise; my Lord and Master is all-wise, and all-knowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ਸਦ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: sughaR sujaanaa sad paradhaanaa a(n)mrit har kaa naamaa ||
english: All-wise and all-knowing, and forever supreme; the Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਖਿ ਅਘਾਣੇ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਣੇ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: chaakh aghaane saarigapaane jin kai bhaag mathaanaa ||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny recorded upon their foreheads, taste it, and are satisfied with the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਮਾਣੋ ॥
transliteration: tin hee paaiaa tinahi dhiaaiaa sagal tisai kaa maano ||
english: They meditate on Him, and find Him; they place all their pride in Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਥਿਰੁ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਦੀਬਾਣੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak thir takhat nivaasee sach tisai deebaano ||3||
english: Says Nanak, He is seated on His eternal throne; True is His royal court. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਮੰਗਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)galaa har ma(n)galaa mere prabh kai suneeai ma(n)galaa ||
english: The song of joy, the Lord's song of joy; listen to the song of joy of my God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀਐ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ॥
transliteration: sohilaRaa prabh sohilaRaa anahad dhuneeai sohilaRaa ||
english: The wedding song, God's wedding song; the unstruck sound current of His wedding song resounds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਸਬਦ ਅਗਾਜੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
transliteration: anahad vaaje sabad agaaje nit nit jisahi vadhaaee ||
english: The unstruck sound current vibrates, and the Word of the Shabad resounds; there is continuous, continual rejoicing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: so prabh dhiaaeeai sabh kichh paaeeai marai na aavai jaaee ||
english: Meditating on that God, everything is obtained; He does not die, or come or go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੂਕੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਐ ॥
transliteration: chookee piaasaa pooran aasaa guramukh mil niraguneeai ||
english: Thirst is quenched, and hopes are fulfilled; the Gurmukh meets with the absolute, unmanifest Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak ghar prabh mere kai nit nit ma(n)gal suneeai ||4||1||
english: Says Nanak, in the Home of my God, the songs of joy are continuously, continually heard. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har har dhiaai manaa khin na visaareeai ||
english: Meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O mind; don't forget Him, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: raam raamaa raam ramaa ka(n)th ur dhaareeai ||
english: Enshrine the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, Raam, within your heart and throat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
transliteration: ur dhaar har har purakh pooran paarabraham nira(n)jano ||
english: Enshrine within your heart the Primal Lord, Har, Har, the all-pervading, supreme, immaculate Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ ਦੁਸਹ ਦੁਖ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨੋ ॥
transliteration: bhai door karataa paap harataa dusah dukh bhav kha(n)dano ||
english: He sends fear far away; He is the Destroyer of sin; He eradicates the unbearable pains of the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗਦੀਸ ਈਸ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਮਾਧੋ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jagadees ees goupaal maadho gun govi(n)d veechaareeai ||
english: Contemplate the Lord of the World, the Cherisher of the World, the Lord, the Virtuous Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak mil sa(n)g saadhoo dinas rain chitaareeai ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, remember the Lord, day and night. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal aadhaar jan kaa aasaraa ||
english: His lotus feet are the support and anchor of His humble servants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੁ ਮਿਲਖ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਨੰਤ ਧਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maal milakh bha(n)daar naam ana(n)t dharaa ||
english: He takes the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord, as his wealth, property and treasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਏਕ ਨਰਾਇਣਾ ॥
transliteration: naam narahar nidhaan jin kai ras bhog ek naraainaa ||
english: Those who have the treasure of the Lord's Name, enjoy the taste of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਅਨੰਤ ਬੀਠਲ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਇਣਾ ॥
transliteration: ras roop ra(n)g ana(n)t beethal saas saas dhiaainaa ||
english: They meditate on the Infinite Lord with each and every breath, as their pleasure, joy and beauty.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਰਣਾ ਨਾਮ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kilavikh haranaa naam punahacharanaa naam jam kee traas haraa ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Destroyer of sins, the only deed of redemption. The Naam drives out the fear of the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਸਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਹ ਆਸਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak raas jan kee charan kamalah aasaraa ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, the support of His lotus feet is the capital of His humble servant. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ ॥
transliteration: gun bea(n)t suaamee tere koi na jaanaee ||
english: Your Glorious Virtues are endless, O my Lord and Master; no one knows them all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਗਤ ਵਖਾਨਈ ॥
transliteration: dekh chalat daiaal sun bhagat vakhaanaee ||
english: Seeing and hearing of Your wondrous plays, O Merciful Lord, Your devotees narrate them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਪੁਰਖਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh tujh dhiaavahi purakhapat paramesaraa ||
english: All beings and creatures meditate on You, O Primal Transcendent Lord, Master of men.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਜਗਦੀਸਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab jaachik ek daataa karunaa mai jagadeesaraa ||
english: All beings are beggars; You are the One Giver, O Lord of the Universe, Embodiment of mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮਾਨਈ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)t sujaan soee jisahi prabh jee maanaee ||
english: He alone is holy, a Saint, a truly wise person, who is accepted by the Dear Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa soi tujhahi pachhaanaee ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, they alone realize You, unto whom You show Mercy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mohi niragun anaath saranee aaiaa ||
english: I am unworthy and without any master; I seek Your Sanctuary, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bal bal bal guradev jin naam driRaaiaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Divine Guru, who has implanted the Naam within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਸਰਬ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gur naam deeaa kusal theeaa sarab ichhaa pu(n)neeaa ||
english: The Guru blessed me with the Naam; happiness came, and all my desires were fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਨੇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਮਿਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jalane bujhaaee saa(n)t aaee mile chiree vichhu(n)niaa ||
english: The fire of desire has been quenched, and peace and tranquility have come; after such a long separation, I have met my Lord again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aana(n)d harakh sahaj saache mahaa ma(n)gal gun gaaiaa ||
english: I have found ecstasy, pleasure and true intuitive poise, singing the great glories, the song of bliss of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak naam prabh kaa gur poore te paaiaa ||4||2||
english: Prays Nanak, I have obtained the Name of God from the Perfect Guru. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਗਾਈਐ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: run jhuno sabad anaahad nit uth gaaeeai sa(n)tan kai ||
english: Rise early each morning, and with the Saints, sing the melodious harmony, the unstruck sound current of the Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਨ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: kilavikh sabh dokh binaasan har naam japeeai gur ma(n)tan kai ||
english: All sins and sufferings are erased, chanting the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instructions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਅਮਿਉ ਪੀਜੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ॥
transliteration: har naam leejai amiu peejai rain dinas araadheeai ||
english: Dwell upon the Lord's Name, and drink in the Nectar; day and night, worship and adore Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਲਗਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲਹ ਸਾਧੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jog daan anek kiriaa lag charan kamalah saadheeai ||
english: The merits of Yoga, charity and religious rituals are obtained by grasping His lotus feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਨ ਦੂਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
transliteration: bhaau bhagat daiaal mohan dookh sagale paraharai ||
english: Loving devotion to the merciful, enticing Lord takes away all pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਰਹਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak tarai saagar dhiaai suaamee naraharai ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, cross over the world-ocean, meditating on the Lord, your Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਭਗਤ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar gobi(n)d simaran bhagat gaavahi gun tere raam ||
english: Meditation on the Lord of the Universe is an ocean of peace; Your devotees sing Your Glorious Praises, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਾਏ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: anad ma(n)gal gur charanee laage paae sookh ghanere raam ||
english: Ecstasy, bliss and great happiness are obtained by grasping hold of the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਦੂਖ ਹਰਿਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sukh nidhaan miliaa dookh hariaa kripaa kar prabh raakhiaa ||
english: Meeting with the treasure of peace, their pains are taken away; granting His Grace, God protects them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har charan laagaa bhram bhau bhaagaa har naam rasanaa bhaakhiaa ||
english: Those who grasp the Lord's feet - their fears and doubts run away, and they chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har ek chitavai prabh ek gaavai har ek drisatee aaiaa ||
english: He thinks of the One Lord, and he sings of the One God; he gazes upon the One Lord alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak prabh karee kirapaa pooraa satigur paaiaa ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, God has granted His Grace, and I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: mil raheeai prabh saadh janaa mil har keeratan suneeai raam ||
english: Meet with the holy, humble servants of God; meeting with the Lord, listen to the Kirtan of His Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਮਾਧੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਨੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: daiaal prabhoo daamodar maadho a(n)t na paaeeai guneeai raam ||
english: God is the Merciful Master, the Lord of wealth; there is no end to His Virtues.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਹਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੋ ॥
transliteration: daiaal dukh har saran daataa sagal dokh nivaarano ||
english: The Merciful Lord is the Dispeller of pain, the Giver of Sanctuary, the Eradicator of all evil.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਸੋਗ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮ ਉਧਾਰਣੋ ॥
transliteration: moh sog vikaar bikhaRe japat naam udhaarano ||
english: Emotional attachment, sorrow, corruption and pain - chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is saved from these.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਭ ਰੇਣ ਥੀਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh jee tere prabhoo mere kar kirapaa sabh ren theevaa ||
english: All beings are Yours, O my God; bless me with Your Mercy, that I may become the dust under the feet of all men.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak prabh maiaa keejai naam teraa jap jeevaa ||3||
english: Prays Nanak, O God, be kind to me, that I may chant Your Name, and live. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਅਪਣੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: raakh leee prabh bhagat janaa apanee charanee laae raam ||
english: God saves His humble devotees, attaching them to His feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar apanaa prabh simarah eko naam dhiaae raam ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, they meditate in remembrance on their God; they meditae on the One Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਰੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਰਹੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: dhiaai so prabh tare bhavajal rahe aavan jaanaa ||
english: Meditating on that God, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and their comings and goings cease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਗਾ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sukh kaliaan keeratan prabh lagaa meethaa bhaanaa ||
english: They enjoy eternal peace and pleasure, singing the Kirtan of God's Praises; His Will seems so sweet to them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh ichh pu(n)nee aas pooree mile satigur pooriaa ||
english: All my desires are fulfilled, meeting with the Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸੂਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak prabh aap mele phir naahee dookh visooriaa ||4||3||
english: Prays Nanak, God has blended me with Himself; I shall never suffer pain or sorrow again. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Chhant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal saranaagatee anad ma(n)gal gun gaam ||
english: In the Sanctuary of His lotus feet, I sing His Glorious Praises in ecstasy and bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਣ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak prabh aaraadheeai bipat nivaaran raam ||1||
english: O Nanak, worship God in adoration, the Eradicator of misfortune. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: prabh bipat nivaarano tis bin avar na koi jeeu ||
english: God is the Eradicator of misfortune; there is none other than Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa har simareeai jal thal maheeal soi jeeu ||
english: Forever and ever, remember the Lord in meditation; He is permeating the water, the land and the sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal poor rahiaa ik nimakh manahu na veesarai ||
english: He is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky; do not forget Him from your mind, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: gur charan laage din sabhaage sarab gun jagadeesarai ||
english: Blessed was that day, when I grasped the Guru's feet; all virtues rest in the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kar sev sevak dinas rainee tis bhaavai so hoi jeeu ||
english: So serve Him day and night, O servant; whatever pleases Him, happens.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਤੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bal jaai naanak sukhah daate paragaas man tan hoi jeeu ||1||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice to the Giver of peace; his mind and body are enlightened. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਸੋਚ ॥
transliteration: har simarat man tan sukhee binasee duteeaa soch ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the mind and body find peace; the thought of duality is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਕੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸੰਕਟ ਮੋਚ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tek goupaal kee govi(n)d sa(n)kat moch ||1||
english: Nanak takes the support of the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe, the Destroyer of troubles. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਸੰਕਟ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bhai sa(n)kat kaate naaraain daiaal jeeu ||
english: The Merciful Lord has eradicated my fears and troubles.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਨੰਦ ਗਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har gun aana(n)d gaae prabh deenaa naath pratipaal jeeu ||
english: In ecstasy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; God is the Cherisher, the Master of the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਅਚੁਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਕੋ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: pratipaal achut purakh eko tisahi siu ra(n)g laagaa ||
english: The Cherishing Lord is imperishable, the One and only Primal Lord; I am imbued with His Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਚਰਨ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: kar charan masatak mel leene sadaa anadin jaagaa ||
english: When I placed my hands and forehead upon His Feet, He blended me with Himself; I became awake and aware forever, night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਤਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d grihu thaan tis kaa tan joban dhan maal jeeu ||
english: My soul, body, household and home belong to Him, along with my body, youth, wealth and property.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sad sadaa bal jaai naanak sarab jeeaa pratipaal jeeu ||2||
english: Forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him, who cherishes and nurtures all beings. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਵਖਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa ucharai har hare gun govi(n)d vakhiaan ||
english: My tongue chants the Name of the Lord, and chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਕੜੀ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਖੈ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak pakaRee tek ek paramesar rakhai nidaan ||1||
english: Nanak has grasped the sheltering support of the One Transcendent Lord, who shall save him in the end. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਖਕੋ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: so suaamee prabh rakhako a(n)chal taa kai laag jeeu ||
english: He is God, our Lord and Master, our Saving Grace. Grab hold of the hem of His robe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaj saadhoo sa(n)g daiaal dev man kee mat tiaag jeeu ||
english: Vibrate, and meditate on the Merciful Divine Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; renounce your intellectual mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਓਟ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਸ ਇਕ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ik ot keejai jeeu deejai aas ik dharaneedharai ||
english: Seek the Support of the One Lord, and surrender your soul to Him; place your hopes only in the Sustainer of the World.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)ge har naam ra(n)ge sa(n)saar saagar sabh tarai ||
english: Those who are imbued with the Lord's Name, in the Saadh Sangat, cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਛੂਟੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: janam maran bikaar chhoote phir na laagai daag jeeu ||
english: The corrupting sins of birth and death are eradicated, and no stain ever sticks to them again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਥਿਰੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bal jaai naanak purakh pooran thir jaa kaa sohaag jeeu ||3||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice to the Perfect Primal Lord; His marriage is eternal. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: dharam arath ar kaam mokh mukat padaarath naath ||
english: Righteous faith, wealth, fulfilment of desires and salvation; the Lord bestows these four blessings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਥ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sagal manorath pooriaa naanak likhiaa maath ||1||
english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny upon his forehead, O Nanak, has all his desires fulfilled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਇਛ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਰਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal ichh meree pu(n)neeaa miliaa nira(n)jan raai jeeu ||
english: All my desires are fulfilled, meeting with my Immaculate, Sovereign Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: anad bhaiaa vadabhaageeho grihi pragate prabh aai jeeu ||
english: I am in ecstasy, O very fortunate ones; the Dear Lord has become manifest in my own home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਾਲ ਆਏ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਏ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਣਾ ॥
transliteration: grihi laal aae purab kamaae taa kee upamaa kiaa ganaa ||
english: My Beloved has come to my home, because of my past actions; how can I count His Glories?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਭਣਾ ॥
transliteration: bea(n)t pooran sukh sahaj daataa kavan rasanaa gun bhanaa ||
english: The Lord, the Giver of peace and intuition, is infinite and perfect; with what tongue can I describe His Glorious Virtues?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aape milaae gahi ka(n)th laae tis binaa nahee jaai jeeu ||
english: He hugs me close in His embrace, and merges me into Himself; there is no place of rest other than Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: bal jaai naanak sadaa karate sabh mahi rahiaa samaai jeeu ||4||4||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Creator, who is contained in, and permeating all. ||4||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਣ ਝੁੰਝਨੜਾ ਗਾਉ ਸਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: ran jhu(n)jhanaRaa gaau sakhee har ek dhiaavahu ||
english: Sing the melodious harmonies, O my companions, and meditate on the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਖੀ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur tum sev sakhee man chi(n)diaRaa phal paavahu ||
english: Serve your True Guru, O my companions, and you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਰੁਤੀ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 rutee salok ||
english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Ruti ~ The Seasons. Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਾਛਉ ਸਾਧਹ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kar ba(n)dan prabh paarabraham baachhau saadhah dhoor ||
english: Bow to the Supreme Lord God, and seek the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aap nivaar har har bhajau naanak prabh bharapoor ||1||
english: Cast out your self-conceit, and vibrate, meditate, on the Lord, Har, Har. O Nanak, God is all-pervading. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਣ ਭੈ ਹਰਣ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kilavikh kaatan bhai haran sukh saagar har raai ||
english: He is the Eradicator of sins, the Destroyer of fear, the Ocean of peace, the Sovereign Lord King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੀਤ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: deen daiaal dukh bha(n)jano naanak neet dhiaai ||2||
english: Merciful to the meek, the Destroyer of pain: O Nanak, always meditate on Him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jas gaavahu vadabhaageeho kar kirapaa bhagava(n)t jeeu ||
english: Sing His Praises, O very fortunate ones, and the Dear Lord God shall bless you with His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹ ਮੂਰਤ ਘੜੀ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰਤ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: rutee maah moorat ghaRee gun ucharat sobhaava(n)t jeeu ||
english: Blessed and auspicious is that season, that month, that moment, that hour, when you chant the Lord's Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gun ra(n)g raate dha(n)n te jan jinee ik man dhiaaiaa ||
english: Blessed are those humble beings, who are imbued with love for His Praises, and who meditate single-mindedly on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saphal janam bhaiaa tin kaa jinee so prabh paaiaa ||
english: Their lives become fruitful, and they find that Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਪਾ ਹੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: pu(n)n daan na tul kiriaa har sarab paapaa ha(n)t jeeu ||
english: Donations to charities and religious rituals are not equal to meditation on the Lord, who destroys all sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਰਹੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak simar jeevaa janam maran raha(n)t jeeu ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, meditating in remembrance on Him, I live; birth and death are finished for me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੋ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: udam agam agocharo charan kamal namasakaar ||
english: Strive for the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord, and bow in humility to His lotus feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਸਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kathanee saa tudh bhaavasee naanak naam adhaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, that sermon alone is pleasing to You, Lord, which inspires us to take the Support of the Name. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਪਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t saran saajan parahu suaamee simar ana(n)t ||
english: Seek the Sanctuary of the Saints, O friends; meditate in remembrance on your infinite Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਕੇ ਤੇ ਹਰਿਆ ਥੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sooke te hariaa theeaa naanak jap bhagava(n)t ||2||
english: The dried branch shall blossom forth in its greenery again, O Nanak, meditating on the Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੁਤਿ ਸਰਸ ਬਸੰਤ ਮਾਹ ਚੇਤੁ ਵੈਸਾਖ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: rut saras basa(n)t maah chet vaisaakh sukh maas jeeu ||
english: The season of spring is delightful; the months of Chayt and Baisaakhi are the most pleasant months.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਹੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu naahu miliaa mauliaa man tan saas jeeu ||
english: I have obtained the Dear Lord as my Husband, and my mind, body and breath have blossomed forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ghar naahu nihachal anad sakheee charan kamal praphuliaa ||
english: The eternal, unchanging Lord has come into my home as my Husband, O my companions; dwelling upon His lotus feet, I blossom forth in bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਬੇਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਮੁਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar sughaR sujaan betaa gun govi(n)d amuliaa ||
english: The Lord of the Universe is beautiful, proficient, wise and all-knowing;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaag paaiaa dukh gavaaiaa bhaee pooran aas jeeu ||
english: His Virtues are priceless. By great good fortune, I have found Him; my pain is dispelled, and my hopes are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak saran teree mitee jam kee traas jeeu ||2||
english: Prays Nanak, I have entered Your Sanctuary, Lord, and my fear of death is eradicated. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮੁਈ ਕਰਤੀ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat bin bhram muee karatee karam anek ||
english: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one dies wandering around in confusion, performing all sorts of rituals.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਮਲ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਧੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਹਿ ਲੇਖ ॥੧॥
transliteration: komal ba(n)dhan baadheeaa naanak karamahi lekh ||1||
english: O Nanak, all are bound by the attractive bonds of Maya, and the karmic record of past actions. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਭਾਣੇ ਸੇ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਭੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: jo bhaane se meliaa vichhoRe bhee aap ||
english: Those who are pleasing to God are united with Him; He separates others from Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee jaa kaa vad parataap ||2||
english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; His greatness is glorious! ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰੀਖਮ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਜੇਠ ਅਖਾੜੈ ਘਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: greekham rut at gaakhaRee jeth akhaaRai ghaam jeeu ||
english: In the summer season, in the months of Jayt'h and Asaarh, the heat is terrible, intense and severe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ਦੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਕਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: prem bichhohu duhaaganee drisat na karee raam jeeu ||
english: The discarded bride is separated from His Love, and the Lord does not even look at her.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਰਤ ਹਾਵੈ ਮਹਾ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਮੁਠੀਆ ॥
transliteration: nah drisat aavai marat haavai mahaa gaarab mutheeaa ||
english: She does not see her Lord, and she dies with an aching sigh; she is defrauded and plundered by her great pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਬਾਝੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤੜਫੜਾਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੁਠੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jal baajh machhulee taRaphaRaavai sa(n)g maaiaa rutheeaa ||
english: She flails around, like a fish out of water; attached to Maya, she is alienated from the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਪਾਪ ਜੋਨੀ ਭੈ ਭੀਤ ਹੋਈ ਦੇਇ ਸਾਸਨ ਜਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: kar paap jonee bhai bheet hoee dei saasan jaam jeeu ||
english: She sins, and so she is fearful of reincarnation; the Messenger of Death will surely punish her.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak ot teree raakh pooran kaam jeeu ||3||
