english: Prays Nanak, take me under Your sheltering support, Lord, and protect me; You are the Fulfiller of desire. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੈ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saradhaa laagee sa(n)g preetamai ik til rahan na jaai ||
english: With loving faith, I am attached to my Beloved; I cannot survive without Him, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar rav rahe naanak sahaj subhaai ||1||
english: He is permeating and pervading my mind and body, O Nanak, with intuitive ease. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਸਾਜਨਹਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
transliteration: kar gahi leenee saajanahi janam janam ke meet ||
english: My Friend has taken me by the hand; He has been my best friend, lifetime after lifetime.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨਹ ਦਾਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਲਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਿਤ ਚੀਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: charanah daasee kar laee naanak prabh hit cheet ||2||
english: He has made me the slave of His feet; O Nanak, my consciousness is filled with love for God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੁਤਿ ਬਰਸੁ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ ਸਾਵਣ ਭਾਦਵੇ ਆਨੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: rut baras suheleeaa saavan bhaadave aana(n)d jeeu ||
english: The rainy season is beautiful; the months of Saawan and Bhaadon bring bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਣ ਉਨਵਿ ਵੁਠੇ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: ghan unav vuthe jal thal pooriaa makara(n)d jeeu ||
english: The clouds are low, and heavy with rain; the waters and the lands are filled with honey.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh poor rahiaa sarab thaaee har naam nav nidh grih bhare ||
english: God is all-pervading everywhere; the nine treasures of the Lord's Name fill the homes of all hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: simar suaamee a(n)tarajaamee kul samoohaa sabh tare ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord and Master, the Searcher of hearts, all one's ancestry is saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਨਹ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸਦ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: pri ra(n)g jaage nah chhidr laage kripaal sad bakhasi(n)d jeeu ||
english: No blemish sticks to that being who remains awake and aware in the Love of the Lord; the Merciful Lord is forever forgiving.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak har ka(n)t paaiaa sadaa man bhaava(n)d jeeu ||4||
english: Prays Nanak, I have found my Husband Lord, who is forever pleasing to my mind. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਉ ਕਬ ਪੇਖਉ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: aas piaasee mai phirau kab pekhau gopaal ||
english: Thirsty with desire, I wander around; when will I behold the Lord of the World?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hai koee saajan sa(n)t jan naanak prabh melanahaar ||1||
english: Is there any humble Saint, any friend, O Nanak, who can lead me to meet with God? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin milabe saa(n)t na oopajai til pal rahan na jaai ||
english: Without meeting Him, I have no peace or tranquility; I cannot survive for a moment, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਹ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har saadhah saranaagatee naanak aas pujaai ||2||
english: Entering the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy Saints, O Nanak, my desires are fulfilled. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੁਤਿ ਸਰਦ ਅਡੰਬਰੋ ਅਸੂ ਕਤਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: rut sarad ada(n)baro asoo katake har piaas jeeu ||
english: In the cool, autumn season, in the months of Assu and Katik, I am thirsty for the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜੰਤੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਫਿਰਤ ਕਬ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: khoja(n)tee darasan phirat kab mileeai gunataas jeeu ||
english: Searching for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I wander around wondering, when will I meet my Lord, the treasure of virtue?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਹ ਸੂਖ ਸਾਰੇ ਹਾਰ ਕੰਙਣ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bin ka(n)t piaare nah sookh saare haar ka(n)ngan dhrig banaa ||
english: Without my Beloved Husband Lord, I find no peace, and all my necklaces and bracelets become cursed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ਚਤੁਰਿ ਬੇਤੀ ਸਾਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਨਾ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar sujaan chatur betee saas bin jaise tanaa ||
english: So beautiful, so wise, so clever and knowing; still, without the breath, it is just a body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਉਤ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਅਲੋਕਨ ਮਨਿ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: eet ut dah dis alokan man milan kee prabh piaas jeeu ||
english: I look here and there, in the ten directions; my mind is so thirsty to meet God!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa melahu prabh gunataas jeeu ||5||
english: Prays Nanak, shower Your Mercy upon me; unite me with Yourself, O God, O treasure of virtue. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਣਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
transliteration: jalan bujhee seetal bhae man tan upajee saa(n)t ||
english: The fire of desire is cooled and quenched; my mind and body are filled with peace and tranquility.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak prabh pooran mile duteeaa binasee bhraa(n)t ||1||
english: O Nanak, I have met my Perfect God; the illusion of duality is dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਪਠਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saadh pathaae aap har ham tum te naahee door ||
english: The Lord Himself sent His Holy Saints, to tell us that He is not far away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਰਮਣ ਰਾਮ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak bhram bhai mit gae raman raam bharapoor ||2||
english: O Nanak, doubt and fear are dispelled, chanting the Name of the all-pervading Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੁਤਿ ਸਿਸੀਅਰ ਸੀਤਲ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਮੰਘਰ ਪੋਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: rut siseear seetal har pragate ma(n)ghar pohi jeeu ||
english: In the cold season of Maghar and Poh, the Lord reveals Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: jalan bujhee daras paaiaa binase maaiaa dhroh jeeu ||
english: My burning desires were quenched, when I obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; the fraudulent illusion of Maya is gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਜੂਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸੇਵਕਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh kaam poore mil hajoore har charan sevak seviaa ||
english: All my desires have been fulfilled, meeting the Lord face-to-face; I am His servant, I serve at His feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਰ ਡੋਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: haar dor seegaar sabh ras gun gaau alakh abheviaa ||
english: My necklaces, hair-ties, all decorations and adornments, are in singing the Glorious Praises of the unseen, mysterious Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜੋਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaau bhagat govi(n)d baa(n)chhat jam na saakai johi jeeu ||
english: I long for loving devotion to the Lord of the Universe, and so the Messenger of Death cannot even see me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਹ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak prabh aap melee tah na prem bichhoh jeeu ||6||
english: Prays Nanak, God has united me with Himself; I shall never suffer separation from my Beloved again. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਡੋਲਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਚੀਤ ॥
transliteration: har dhan paaiaa sohaaganee dolat naahee cheet ||
english: The happy soul bride has found the wealth of the Lord; her consciousness does not waver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sa(n)jogee naanakaa grihi pragate prabh meet ||1||
english: Joining together with the Saints, O Nanak, God, my Friend, has revealed Himself in my home. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਅਨੰਦ ਕੋਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨੇ ॥
transliteration: naad binod ana(n)d kod pri preetam sa(n)g bane ||
english: With her Beloved Husband Lord, she enjoys millions of melodies, pleasures and joys.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਭਨੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man baa(n)chhat phal paaiaa har naanak naam bhane ||2||
english: The fruits of the mind's desires are obtained, O Nanak, chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਮਕਰ ਰੁਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਤੀ ਮਾਘੁ ਫਗਣੁ ਗੁਣਵੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: himakar rut man bhaavatee maagh phagan gunava(n)t jeeu ||
english: The snowy winter season, the months of Maagh and Phagun, are pleasing and ennobling to the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਗਾਉ ਮੰਗਲੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sakhee sahelee gaau ma(n)galo grihi aae har ka(n)t jeeu ||
english: O my friends and companions, sing the songs of joy; my Husband Lord has come into my home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਾਲ ਆਏ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਸੇਜ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: grihi laal aae man dhiaae sej su(n)dar soheeaa ||
english: My Beloved has come into my home; I meditate on Him in my mind. The bed of my heart is beautifully adorned.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਭਏ ਹਰਿਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਮੋਹੀਆ ॥
transliteration: van trin tribhavan bhae hariaa dekh darasan moheeaa ||
english: The woods, the meadows and the three worlds have blossomed forth in their greenery; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I am fascinated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: mile suaamee ichh pu(n)nee man japiaa niramal ma(n)t jeeu ||
english: I have met my Lord and Master, and my desires are fulfilled; my mind chants His Immaculate Mantra.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਲੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਕੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak nit karahu raleeaa har mile sreedhar ka(n)t jeeu ||7||
english: Prays Nanak, I celebrate continuously; I have met my Husband Lord, the Lord of excellence. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sahaaee jee ke bhavajal taaranahaar ||
english: The Saints are the helpers, the support of the soul; they carry us cross the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh te ooche jaaneeahi naanak naam piaar ||1||
english: Know that they are the highest of all; O Nanak, they love the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਤਰੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਰੇ ਸੇ ਬੀਰ ॥
transliteration: jin jaaniaa seee tare se soore se beer ||
english: Those who know Him, cross over; they are the brave heroes, the heroic warriors.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਤੀਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak tin balihaaranai har jap utare teer ||2||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Lord, and cross over to the other shore. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: chha(n)t ||
english: Chhant:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਸਭ ਊਪਰੇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: charan biraajit sabh oopare mitiaa sagal kales jeeu ||
english: His feet are exalted above all. They eradicate all suffering.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaavan dukh hare har bhagat keeaa paraves jeeu ||
english: They destroy the pains of coming and going. They bring loving devotion to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬੀਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: har ra(n)g raate sahaj maate til na man te beesarai ||
english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, one is intoxicated with intuitive peace and poise, and does not forget the Lord from his mind, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰੇ ਚਰਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: taj aap saranee pare charanee sarab gun jagadeesarai ||
english: Shedding my self-conceit, I have entered the Sanctuary of His Feet; all virtues rest in the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: govi(n)d gun nidh sreera(n)g suaamee aad kau aades jeeu ||
english: I bow in humility to the Lord of the Universe, the treasure of virtue, the Lord of excellence, our Primal Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੋ ਇਕ ਵੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੧॥੬॥੮॥
transliteration: binava(n)t naanak maiaa dhaarahu jug jugo ik ves jeeu ||8||1||6||8||
english: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord; throughout the ages, You take the same form. ||8||1||6||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 dakhanee oa(n)kaar ||
english: Raamkalee, First Mehl, Dakhanee, Ongkaar:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਉਤਪਤਿ ॥
transliteration: oa(n)kaar brahamaa utapat ||
english: From Ongkaar, the One Universal Creator God, Brahma was created.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
transliteration: oa(n)kaar keeaa jin chit ||
english: He kept Ongkaar in his consciousness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਸੈਲ ਜੁਗ ਭਏ ॥
transliteration: oa(n)kaar sail jug bhae ||
english: From Ongkaar, the mountains and the ages were created.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਨਿਰਮਏ ॥
transliteration: oa(n)kaar bed niramae ||
english: Ongkaar created the Vedas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਰੇ ॥
transliteration: oa(n)kaar sabad udhare ||
english: Ongkaar saves the world through the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: oa(n)kaar guramukh tare ||
english: Ongkaar saves the Gurmukhs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਨਮ ਅਖਰ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: onam akhar sunahu beechaar ||
english: Listen to the Message of the Universal, Imperishable Creator Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਨਮ ਅਖਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: onam akhar tribhavan saar ||1||
english: The Universal, Imperishable Creator Lord is the essence of the three worlds. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਪਾਡੇ ਕਿਆ ਲਿਖਹੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sun paade kiaa likhahu ja(n)jaalaa ||
english: Listen, O Pandit, O religious scholar, why are you writing about worldly debates?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: likh raam naam guramukh gopaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As Gurmukh, write only the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਇਕ ਜੋਤੀ ॥
transliteration: sasai sabh jag sahaj upaaiaa teen bhavan ik jotee ||
english: Sassa: He created the entire universe with ease; His One Light pervades the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਲੈ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh vasat paraapat hovai chun lai maanak motee ||
english: Become Gurmukh, and obtain the real thing; gather the gems and pearls.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਮਝੈ ਸੂਝੈ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: samajhai soojhai paR paR boojhai a(n)t nira(n)tar saachaa ||
english: If one understands, realizes and comprehends what he reads and studies, in the end he shall realize that the True Lord dwells deep within his nucleus.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh dekhai saach samaale bin saache jag kaachaa ||2||
english: The Gurmukh sees and contemplates the True Lord; without the True Lord, the world is false. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਧੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਰੇ ਧਰਮਾ ਪੁਰਿ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dhadhai dharam dhare dharamaa pur gunakaaree man dheeraa ||
english: Dhadha: Those who enshrine Dharmic faith and dwell in the City of Dharma are worthy; their minds are steadfast and stable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਧੈ ਧੂਲਿ ਪੜੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dhadhai dhool paRai mukh masatak ka(n)chan bhae manooraa ||
english: Dhadha: If the dust of their feet touches one's face and forehead, he is transformed from iron into gold.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਤੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਚੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dhan dharaneedhar aap ajonee tol bol sach pooraa ||
english: Blessed is the Support of the Earth; He Himself is not born; His measure and speech are perfect and True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karate kee mit karataa jaanai kai jaanai gur sooraa ||3||
english: Only the Creator Himself knows His own extent; He alone knows the Brave Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਙਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਲੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ngiaan gavaaiaa doojaa bhaaiaa garab gale bikh khaaiaa ||
english: In love with duality, spiritual wisdom is lost; the mortal rots away in pride, and eats poison.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਸੁ ਗੀਤ ਬਾਦ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur ras geet baad nahee bhaavai suneeai gahir ga(n)bheer gavaaiaa ||
english: He thinks that the sublime essence of the Guru's song is useless, and he does not like to hear it. He loses the profound, unfathomable Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur sach kahiaa a(n)mrit lahiaa man tan saach sukhaaiaa ||
english: Through the Guru's Words of Truth, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained, and the mind and body find joy in the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aape guramukh aape devai aape a(n)mrit peeaaiaa ||4||
english: He Himself is the Gurmukh, and He Himself bestows the Ambrosial Nectar; He Himself leads us to drink it in. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: eko ek kahai sabh koee haumai garab viaapai ||
english: Everyone says that God is the One and only, but they are engrossed in egotism and pride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਇਉ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar ek pachhaanai iu ghar mahal sinjaapai ||
english: Realize that the One God is inside and outside; understand this, that the Mansion of His Presence is within the home of your heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਏਕੋ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
transliteration: prabh neRai har door na jaanahu eko srisat sabaaee ||
english: God is near at hand; do not think that God is far away. The One Lord permeates the entire universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: eka(n)kaar avar nahee doojaa naanak ek samaaee ||5||
english: There in One Universal Creator Lord; there is no other at all. O Nanak, merge into the One Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਅਫਰਿਓ ਤੁਲਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: is karate kau kiu gahi raakhau aphario tulio na jaaee ||
english: How can you keep the Creator under your control? He cannot be seized or measured.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਦੇਵਾਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa ke devaane praanee jhooth thagauree paaee ||
english: Maya has made the mortal insane; she has administered the poisonous drug of falsehood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੁਹਤਾਜਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ ਇਬ ਤਬ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
transliteration: lab lobh muhataaj vigoote ib tab phir pachhutaaee ||
english: Addicted to greed and avarice, the mortal is ruined, and then later, he regrets and repents.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵੈ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ek sarevai taa gat mit paavai aavan jaan rahaaee ||6||
english: So serve the One Lord, and attain the state of Salvation; your comings and goings shall cease. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਇਕੁ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: ek achaar ra(n)g ik roop ||
english: The One Lord is in all actions, colors and forms.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: paun paanee aganee asaroop ||
english: He manifests in many shapes through wind, water and fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਭਵਰੁ ਭਵੈ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: eko bhavar bhavai tihu loi ||
english: The One Soul wanders through the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੂਝੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: eko boojhai soojhai pat hoi ||
english: One who understands and comprehends the One Lord is honored.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲੇ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan le samasar rahai ||
english: One who gathers in spiritual wisdom and meditation, dwells in the state of balance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਲਹੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ek viralaa ko lahai ||
english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, attain the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis no dei kirapaa te sukh paae ||
english: They alone find peace, whom the Lord blesses with His Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guroo duaarai aakh sunaae ||7||
english: In the Gurdwara, the Guru's Door, they speak and hear of the Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਰਮ ਧੂਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ooram dhooram jot ujaalaa ||
english: His Light illuminates the ocean and the earth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: teen bhavan mahi gur gopaalaa ||
english: Throughout the three worlds, is the Guru, the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਗਵਿਆ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: oogaviaa asaroop dikhaavai ||
english: The Lord reveals His various forms;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apunai ghar aavai ||
english: granting His Grace, He enters the home of the heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਨਵਿ ਬਰਸੈ ਨੀਝਰ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: oonav barasai neejhar dhaaraa ||
english: The clouds hang low, and the rain is pouring down.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ootam sabad savaaranahaaraa ||
english: The Lord embellishes and exalts with the Sublime Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਏਕੇ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
transliteration: is eke kaa jaanai bheu ||
english: One who knows the mystery of the One God,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਉ ॥੮॥
transliteration: aape karataa aape deu ||8||
english: is Himself the Creator, Himself the Divine Lord. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਗਵੈ ਸੂਰੁ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ugavai soor asur sa(n)ghaarai ||
english: When the sun rises, the demons are slain;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਚਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: oochau dekh sabad beechaarai ||
english: the mortal looks upwards, and contemplates the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: oopar aad a(n)t tihu loi ||
english: The Lord is beyond the beginning and the end, beyond the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੈ ਕਥੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape karai kathai sunai soi ||
english: He Himself acts, speaks and listens.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: ohu bidhaataa man tan dei ||
english: He is the Architect of Destiny; He blesses us with mind and body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ohu bidhaataa man mukh soi ||
english: That Architect of Destiny is in my mind and mouth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: prabh jagajeevan avar na koi ||
english: God is the Life of the world; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate pat hoi ||9||
english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is honored. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਰਵੈ ਹਿਤਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: raajan raam ravai hitakaar ||
english: One who lovingly chants the Name of the Sovereign Lord King,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਲੂਝੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ran mahi loojhai manooaa maar ||
english: fights the battle and conquers his own mind;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨੰਤਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: raat dina(n)t rahai ra(n)g raataa ||
english: day and night, he remains imbued with the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: teen bhavan jug chaare jaataa ||
english: He is famous throughout the three worlds and the four ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jin jaataa so tis hee jehaa ||
english: One who knows the Lord, becomes like Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: at niramaail seejhas dehaa ||
english: He becomes absolutely immaculate, and his body is sanctified.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹਸੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਇਕ ਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: rahasee raam ridai ik bhaai ||
english: His heart is happy, in love with the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: a(n)tar sabad saach liv laai ||10||
english: He lovingly centers his attention deep within upon the True Word of the Shabad. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਰਹਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ros na keejai a(n)mrit peejai rahan nahee sa(n)saare ||
english: Don't be angry - drink in the Ambrosial Nectar; you shall not remain in this world forever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਇ ਰੰਕ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raaje raai ra(n)k nahee rahanaa aai jaai jug chaare ||
english: The ruling kings and the paupers shall not remain; they come and go, throughout the four ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹਣ ਕਹਣ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: rahan kahan te rahai na koee kis pahi karau bina(n)tee ||
english: Everyone says that they will remain, but none of them remain; unto whom should I offer my prayer?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੋਧਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਮਤੀ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: ek sabad raam naam nirodhar gur devai pat matee ||11||
english: The One Shabad, the Name of the Lord, will never fail you; the Guru grants honor and understanding. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਜ ਮਰੰਤੀ ਮਰਿ ਗਈ ਘੂਘਟੁ ਖੋਲਿ ਚਲੀ ॥
transliteration: laaj mara(n)tee mar gaee ghooghat khol chalee ||
english: My shyness and hesitation have died and gone, and I walk with my face unveiled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸੁ ਦਿਵਾਨੀ ਬਾਵਰੀ ਸਿਰ ਤੇ ਸੰਕ ਟਲੀ ॥
transliteration: saas divaanee baavaree sir te sa(n)k talee ||
english: The confusion and doubt from my crazy, insane mother-in-law has been removed from over my head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਬੁਲਾਈ ਰਲੀ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: prem bulaaee ralee siu man mahi sabad ana(n)d ||
english: My Beloved has summoned me with joyful caresses; my mind is filled with the bliss of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਿ ਰਤੀ ਲਾਲੀ ਭਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਚਿੰਦੁ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: laal ratee laalee bhaee guramukh bhaee nichi(n)d ||12||
english: Imbued with the Love of my Beloved, I have become Gurmukh, and carefree. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: laahaa naam ratan jap saar ||
english: Chant the jewel of the Naam, and earn the profit of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: lab lobh buraa aha(n)kaar ||
english: Greed, avarice, evil and egotism;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾੜੀ ਚਾੜੀ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: laaRee chaaRee laaitabaar ||
english: slander, inuendo and gossip;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhaa mugadh gavaar ||
english: the self-willed manmukh is blind, foolish and ignorant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹੇ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਿ ॥
transliteration: laahe kaaran aaiaa jag ||
english: For the sake of earning the profit of the Lord, the mortal comes into the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਮਜੂਰੁ ਗਇਆ ਠਗਾਇ ਠਗਿ ॥
transliteration: hoi majoor gaiaa thagaai thag ||
english: But he becomes a mere slave laborer, and is mugged by the mugger, Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: laahaa naam poo(n)jee vesaahu ||
english: One who earns the profit of the Naam, with the capital of faith,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਪਤਿ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak sachee pat sachaa paatisaahu ||13||
english: O Nanak, is truly honored by the True Supreme King. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ॥
transliteration: aai vigootaa jag jam pa(n)th ||
english: The world is ruined on the path of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਈ ਨ ਮੇਟਣ ਕੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
transliteration: aaee na metan ko samarath ||
english: No one has the power to erase Maya's influence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਥਿ ਸੈਲ ਨੀਚ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aath sail neech ghar hoi ||
english: If wealth visits the home of the lowliest clown,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਥਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aath dekh nivai jis doi ||
english: seeing that wealth, all pay their respects to him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਥਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਸਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aath hoi taa mugadh siaanaa ||
english: Even an idiot is thought of as clever, if he is rich.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagat bihoonaa jag bauraanaa ||
english: Without devotional worship, the world is insane.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi varatai eko soi ||
english: The One Lord is contained among all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: jis no kirapaa kare tis paragat hoi ||14||
english: He reveals Himself, unto those whom He blesses with His Grace. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jug jug thaap sadaa niravair ||
english: Throughout the ages, the Lord is eternally established; He has no vengeance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਨਹੀ ਧੰਧਾ ਧੈਰੁ ॥
transliteration: janam maran nahee dha(n)dhaa dhair ||
english: He is not subject to birth and death; He is not entangled in worldly affairs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai so aape aap ||
english: Whatever is seen, is the Lord Himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਘਟ ਥਾਪਿ ॥
transliteration: aap upaai aape ghat thaap ||
english: Creating Himself, He establishes Himself in the heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aap agochar dha(n)dhai loee ||
english: He Himself is unfathomable; He links people to their affairs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jog jugat jagajeevan soee ||
english: He is the Way of Yoga, the Life of the World.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਆਚਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kar aachaar sach sukh hoee ||
english: Living a righteous lifestyle, true peace is found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਵ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naam vihoonaa mukat kiv hoee ||15||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can anyone find liberation? ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਵੇਰੋਧੁ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai verodh sareer ||
english: Without the Name, even one's own body is an enemy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਮਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
transliteration: kiu na milahi kaatahi man peer ||
english: Why not meet the Lord, and take away the pain of your mind?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਊ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vaat vataaoo aavai jaai ||
english: The traveller comes and goes along the highway.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kiaa le aaiaa kiaa palai paai ||
english: What did he bring when he came, and what will he take away when he goes?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਤੋਟਾ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai totaa sabh thaai ||
english: Without the Name, one loses everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: laahaa milai jaa dei bujhaai ||
english: The profit is earned, when the Lord grants understanding.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਣਜੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਵਣਜੈ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: vanaj vaapaar vanajai vaapaaree ||
english: In merchandise and trade, the merchant is trading.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: vin naavai kaisee pat saaree ||16||
english: Without the Name, how can one find honor and nobility? ||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gun veechaare giaanee soi ||
english: One who contemplates the Lord's Virtues is spiritually wise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gun mahi giaan paraapat hoi ||
english: Through His Virtues, one receives spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gunadaataa viralaa sa(n)saar ||
english: How rare in this world, is the Giver of virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saachee karanee gur veechaar ||
english: The True way of life comes through contemplation of the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paai ||
english: The Lord is inaccessible and unfathomable. His worth cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਜਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: taa mileeai jaa lae milaai ||
english: They alone meet Him, whom the Lord causes to meet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: gunava(n)tee gun saare neet ||
english: The virtuous soul bride continually contemplates His Virtues.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮੀਤ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak guramat mileeai meet ||17||
english: O Nanak, following the Guru's Teachings, one meets the Lord, the true friend. ||17||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਗਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh kaaiaa kau gaalai ||
english: Unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger waste the body away,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕੰਚਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਾ ਢਾਲੈ ॥
transliteration: jiu ka(n)chan sohaagaa dhaalai ||
english: as gold is dissolved by borax.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਸਹੈ ਸੁ ਤਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kas kasavatee sahai s taau ||
english: The gold is touched to the touchstone, and tested by fire;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫ ਵੰਨੀ ਸਚੜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nadar saraaph va(n)nee sachaRaau ||
english: when its pure color shows through, it is pleasing to the eye of the assayer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤੁ ਪਸੂ ਅਹੰ ਕਾਲੁ ਕਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jagat pasoo aha(n) kaal kasaaee ||
english: The world is a beast, and arrogent Death is the butcher.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kar karatai karanee kar paaee ||
english: The created beings of the Creator receive the karma of their actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin keetee tin keemat paaee ||
english: He who created the world, knows its worth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: hor kiaa kaheeai kichh kahan na jaaee ||18||
english: What else can be said? There is nothing at all to say. ||18||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat a(n)mrit peeaa ||
english: Searching, searching, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: khimaa gahee man satagur deeaa ||
english: I have adopted the way of tolerance, and given my mind to the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਰਾ ਖਰਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kharaa kharaa aakhai sabh koi ||
english: Everyone calls himself true and genuine.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਰਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kharaa ratan jug chaare hoi ||
english: He alone is true, who obtains the jewel throughout the four ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਅੰਤ ਮੂਏ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: khaat peea(n)t mooe nahee jaaniaa ||
english: Eating and drinking, one dies, but still does not know.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੂਏ ਜਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi mooe jaa sabad pachhaaniaa ||
english: He dies in an instant, when he realizes the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਮਰਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: asathir cheet maran man maaniaa ||
english: His consciousness becomes permanently stable, and his mind accepts death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te naam pachhaaniaa ||19||
english: By Guru's Grace, he realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||19||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਗਨ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: gagan ga(n)bheer gagana(n)tar vaas ||
english: The Profound Lord dwells in the sky of the mind, the Tenth Gate;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavai sukh sahaj nivaas ||
english: singing His Glorious Praises, one dwells in intuitive poise and peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਇਆ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gaiaa na aavai aai na jaai ||
english: He does not go to come, or come to go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad rahai liv laai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, he remains lovingly focused on the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਗਨੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ॥
transliteration: gagan aga(n)m anaath ajonee ||
english: The Lord of the mind-sky is inaccessible, independent and beyond birth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਗੋਨੀ ॥
transliteration: asathir cheet samaadh sagonee ||
english: The most worthy Samaadhi is to keep the consciousness stable, focused on Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ॥
transliteration: har naam chet phir pavahi na joonee ||
english: Remembering the Lord's Name, one is not subject to reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ਹੋਰ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੀ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: guramat saar hor naam bihoonee ||20||
english: The Guru's Teachings are the most Excellent; all other ways lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||20||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਦਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ghar dar phir thaakee bahutere ||
english: Wandering to countless doorsteps and homes, I have grown weary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਅੰਤ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaat asa(n)kh a(n)t nahee mere ||
english: My incarnations are countless, without limit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਧੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kete maat pitaa sut dheeaa ||
english: I have had so many mothers and fathers, sons and daughters.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੂਆ ॥
transliteration: kete gur chele phun hooaa ||
english: I have had so many gurus and disciples.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੂਆ ॥
transliteration: kaache gur te mukat na hooaa ||
english: Through a false guru, liberation is not found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: ketee naar var ek samaal ||
english: There are so many brides of the One Husband Lord - consider this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh maran jeevan prabh naal ||
english: The Gurmukh dies, and lives with God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਢੂਢਿ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dah dis dhoodh gharai mahi paaiaa ||
english: Searching in the ten directions, I found Him within my own home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: mel bhaiaa satiguroo milaaiaa ||21||
english: I have met Him; the True Guru has led me to meet Him. ||21||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh gaavai guramukh bolai ||
english: The Gurmukh sings, and the Gurmukh speaks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋੁਲਾਵੈ ਤੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh tol toulaavai tolai ||
english: The Gurmukh evaluates the value of the Lord, and inspires others to evaluate Him as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh aavai jaai nisa(n)g ||
english: The Gurmukh comes and goes without fear.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਜਲਾਇ ਕਲੰਕੁ ॥
transliteration: parahar mail jalaai kala(n)k ||
english: His filth is taken away, and his stains are burnt off.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naad bed beechaar ||
english: The Gurmukh contemplates the sound current of the Naad for his Vedas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh majan chaj achaar ||
english: The Gurmukh's cleansing bath is the performance of good deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sabad a(n)mrit hai saar ||
english: For the Gurmukh, the Shabad is the most excellent Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh paavai paar ||22||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh crosses over. ||22||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਨ ਰਹਈ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)chal cheet na rahaee thaai ||
english: The fickle consciousness does not remain stable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੋਰੀ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਅੰਗੂਰੀ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: choree mirag a(n)gooree khaai ||
english: The deer secretly nibbles at the green sprouts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਚੀਤ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal ur dhaare cheet ||
english: One who enshrines the Lord's lotus feet in his heart and consciousness

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਚੇਤਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: chir jeevan chetan nit neet ||
english: lives long, always remembering the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਤ ਹੀ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: chi(n)tat hee deesai sabh koi ||
english: Everyone has worries and cares.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਤਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: chetahi ek tahee sukh hoi ||
english: He alone finds peace, who thinks of the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਰਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chit vasai raachai har naai ||
english: When the Lord dwells in the consciousness, and one is absorbed in the Lord's Name,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨੩॥
transliteration: mukat bhaiaa pat siu ghar jaai ||23||
english: one is liberated, and returns home with honor. ||23||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੀਜੈ ਦੇਹ ਖੁਲੈ ਇਕ ਗੰਢਿ ॥
transliteration: chheejai deh khulai ik ga(n)dh ||
english: The body falls apart, when one knot is untied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੇਆ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਜਗਿ ਹੰਢਿ ॥
transliteration: chheaa nit dekhahu jag ha(n)dh ||
english: Behold, the world is on the decline; it will be totally destroyed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੂਪ ਛਾਵ ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: dhoop chhaav je sam kar jaanai ||
english: Only one who looks alike upon sunshine and shade

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan kaat mukat ghar aanai ||
english: has his bonds shattered; he is liberated and returns home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛਾਇਆ ਛੂਛੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: chhaaiaa chhoochhee jagat bhulaanaa ||
english: Maya is empty and petty; she has defrauded the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਧੁਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: likhiaa kirat dhure paravaanaa ||
english: Such destiny is pre-ordained by past actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੀਜੈ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਜਰੂਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: chheejai joban jarooaa sir kaal ||
english: Youth is wasting away; old age and death hover above the head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਛੀਜੈ ਭਈ ਸਿਬਾਲੁ ॥੨੪॥
transliteration: kaaiaa chheejai bhaee sibaal ||24||
english: The body falls apart, like algae upon the water. ||24||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਪੈ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jaapai aap prabhoo tihu loi ||
english: God Himself appears throughout the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jug jug daataa avar na koi ||
english: Throughout the ages, He is the Great Giver; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakhahi raakh ||
english: As it pleases You, You protect and preserve us.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਸੁ ਜਾਚਉ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: jas jaachau devai pat saakh ||
english: I ask for the Lord's Praises, which bless me with honor and credit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jaagat jaag rahaa tudh bhaavaa ||
english: Remaining awake and aware, I am pleasing to You, O Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa too melahi taa tujhai samaavaa ||
english: When You unite me with Yourself, then I am merged in You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar japau jagadees ||
english: I chant Your Victorious Praises, O Life of the World.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਬੀਸ ਇਕੀਸ ॥੨੫॥
transliteration: guramat mileeai bees ikees ||25||
english: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, one is sure to merge in the One Lord. ||25||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝਖਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਗ ਸਿਉ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jhakh bolan kiaa jag siu vaad ||
english: Why do you speak such nonsense, and argue with the world?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਰਮਾਦੁ ॥
transliteration: jhoor marai dekhai paramaad ||
english: You shall die repenting, when you see your own insanity.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮੂਏ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਣ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: janam mooe nahee jeevan aasaa ||
english: He is born, only to die, but he does not wish to live.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਚਲੇ ਭਏ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aai chale bhae aas niraasaa ||
english: He comes hopeful, and then goes, without hope.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੁਰਿ ਝੁਰਿ ਝਖਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jhur jhur jhakh maatee ral jaai ||
english: Regretting, repenting and grieving, he is dust mixing with dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਚਾਂਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaal na chaa(n)pai har gun gaai ||
english: Death does not chew up one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paaee nav nidh har kai naai ||
english: The nine treasures are obtained through the Name of the Lord;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੨੬॥
transliteration: aape devai sahaj subhaai ||26||
english: the Lord bestows intuitive peace and poise. ||26||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਞਿਆਨੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: njiaano bolai aape boojhai ||
english: He speaks spiritual wisdom, and He Himself understands it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਮਝੈ ਆਪੇ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: aape samajhai aape soojhai ||
english: He Himself knows it, and He Himself comprehends it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa kahiaa a(n)k samaavai ||
english: One who takes the Words of the Guru into his very fiber,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਾਚੋ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: niramal sooche saacho bhaavai ||
english: is immaculate and holy, and is pleasing to the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਰਤਨੀ ਨਹੀ ਤੋਟ ॥
transliteration: gur saagar ratanee nahee tot ||
english: In the ocean of the Guru, there is no shortage of pearls.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਖੋਟ ॥
transliteration: laal padaarath saach akhot ||
english: The treasure of jewels is truly inexhaustible.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kahiaa saa kaar kamaavahu ||
english: Do those deeds which the Guru has ordained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਧਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kee karanee kaahe dhaavahu ||
english: Why are you chasing after the Guru's actions?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ॥੨੭॥
transliteration: naanak guramat saach samaavahu ||27||
english: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, merge in the True Lord. ||27||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੈ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਹੀ ॥
transliteration: tootai nehu k bolahi sahee ||
english: Love is broken, when one speaks in defiance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੈ ਬਾਹ ਦੁਹੂ ਦਿਸ ਗਹੀ ॥
transliteration: tootai baah duhoo dis gahee ||
english: The arm is broken, when it is pulled from both sides.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਟੂਟਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਗਈ ਬੁਰ ਬੋਲਿ ॥
transliteration: toot pareet gaee bur bol ||
english: Love breaks, when the speech goes sour.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਛਾਡੀ ਢੋਲਿ ॥
transliteration: duramat parahar chhaadee dhol ||
english: The Husband Lord abandons and leaves behind the evil-minded bride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੈ ਗੰਠਿ ਪੜੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tootai ga(n)th paRai veechaar ||
english: The broken knot is tied again, through contemplation and meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee ghar kaaraj saar ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one's affairs are resolved in one's own home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਾ ॥
transliteration: laahaa saach na aavai totaa ||
english: One who earns the profit of the True Name, will not lose it again;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੋਟਾ ॥੨੮॥
transliteration: tribhavan thaakur preetam motaa ||28||
english: the Lord and Master of the three worlds is your best friend. ||28||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: thaakahu manooaa raakhahu thaai ||
english: Control your mind, and keep it in its place.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਠਹਕਿ ਮੁਈ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: thahak muee avagun pachhutaai ||
english: The world is destroyed by conflict, regretting its sinful mistakes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਬਾਈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: thaakur ek sabaaee naar ||
english: There is one Husband Lord, and all are His brides.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bahute ves kare kooRiaar ||
english: The false bride wears many costumes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: par ghar jaatee thaak rahaaee ||
english: He stops her from going into the homes of others;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mahal bulaaee thaak na paaee ||
english: He summons her to the Mansion of His Presence, and no obstacles block her path.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sabad savaaree saach piaaree ||
english: She is embellished with the Word of the Shabad, and is loved by the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨੯॥
transliteration: saaee souhaagan thaakur dhaaree ||29||
english: She is the happy soul bride, who takes the Support of her Lord and Master. ||29||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡੋਲਤ ਡੋਲਤ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਫਾਟੇ ਚੀਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
transliteration: dolat dolat he sakhee phaate cheer seegaar ||
english: Wandering and roaming around, O my companion, your beautiful robes are torn.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡਾਹਪਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਡਰ ਬਿਣਠੀ ਡਾਰ ॥
transliteration: daahapan tan sukh nahee bin dar binathee daar ||
english: In jealousy, the body is not at peace; without the Fear of God, multitudes are ruined.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡਰਪਿ ਮੁਈ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਡੀਠੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: darap muee ghar aapanai deethee ka(n)t sujaan ||
english: One who remains dead within her own home, through the Fear of God, is looked upon with favor by her all-knowing Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: dar raakhiaa gur aapanai nirabhau naam vakhaan ||
english: She maintains fear of her Guru, and chants the Name of the Fearless Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡੂਗਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਤਿਖਾ ਘਣੀ ਜਬ ਦੇਖਾ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: doogar vaas tikhaa ghanee jab dekhaa nahee door ||
english: Living on the mountain, I suffer such great thirst; when I see Him, I know that He is not far away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tikhaa nivaaree sabad ma(n)n a(n)mrit peeaa bharapoor ||
english: My thirst is quenched, and I have accepted the Word of the Shabad. I drink my fill of the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: dehi dehi aakhai sabh koee jai bhaavai tai dei ||
english: Everyone says, "Give! Give!" As He pleases, He gives.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩੦॥
transliteration: guroo duaarai devasee tikhaa nivaarai soi ||30||
english: Through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Door, He gives, and quenches the thirst. ||30||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਢੰਢੋਲਤ ਢੂਢਤ ਹਉ ਫਿਰੀ ਢਹਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਨਿ ਕਰਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dholat dhoodhat hau phiree dhahi dhahi pavan karaar ||
english: Searching and seeking, I fell down and collapsed upon the bank of the river of life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਰੇ ਢਹਤੇ ਢਹਿ ਪਏ ਹਉਲੇ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bhaare dhahate dhahi pae haule nikase paar ||
english: Those who are heavy with sin sink down, but those who are light swim across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰ ਅਜਾਚੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: amar ajaachee har mile tin kai hau bal jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who meet the immortal and immeasurable Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਅਘੁਲੀਐ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tin kee dhooR aghuleeai sa(n)gat mel milaau ||
english: The dust of their feet brings emancipation; in their company, we are united in the Lord's Union.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man deeaa gur aapanai paaiaa niramal naau ||
english: I gave my mind to my Guru, and received the Immaculate Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin naam deeaa tis sevasaa tis balihaarai jaau ||
english: I serve the One who gave me the Naam; I am a sacrifice to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਢਾਹਸੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo usaare so dhaahasee tis bin avar na koi ||
english: He who builds, also demolishes; there is no other than Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਮੑਲਾ ਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee tis sa(n)mhlaa taa tan dookh na hoi ||31||
english: By Guru's Grace, I contemplate Him, and then my body does not suffer in pain. ||31||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਣਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਗਹੀ ਣਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: naa ko meraa kis gahee naa ko hoaa na hog ||
english: No one is mine - whose gown should I grasp and hold? No one ever was, and no one shall ever be mine.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaan vigucheeai dubidhaa viaapai rog ||
english: Coming and going, one is ruined, afflicted with the disease of dual-mindedness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਣਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਆਦਮੀ ਕਲਰ ਕੰਧ ਗਿਰੰਤਿ ॥
transliteration: naam vihoone aadamee kalar ka(n)dh gira(n)t ||
english: Those beings who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, collapse like pillars of salt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਜਾਇ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਅੰਤਿ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai kiu chhooteeai jaai rasaatal a(n)t ||
english: Without the Name, how can they find release? They fall into hell in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਵੈ ਅਖਰੀ ਅਗਣਤੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ganat ganaavai akharee aganat saachaa soi ||
english: Using a limited number of words, we describe the unlimited True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: agiaanee matiheen hai gur bin giaan na hoi ||
english: The ignorant lack understanding. Without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂਟੀ ਤੰਤੁ ਰਬਾਬ ਕੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ॥
transliteration: tootee ta(n)t rabaab kee vaajai nahee vijog ||
english: The separated soul is like the broken string of a guitar, which does not vibrate its sound.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੩੨॥
transliteration: vichhuRiaa melai prabhoo naanak kar sa(n)jog ||32||
english: God unites the separated souls with Himself, awakening their destiny. ||32||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਰਵਰੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਪੰਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਰਵਰਿ ਪੰਖੀ ਪੰਚ ॥
transliteration: taravar kaaiaa pa(n)kh man taravar pa(n)khee pa(n)ch ||
english: The body is the tree, and the mind is the bird; the birds in the tree are the five senses.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਸੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਫਾਸ ਨ ਰੰਚ ॥
transliteration: tat chugahi mil ekase tin kau phaas na ra(n)ch ||
english: They peck at the essence of reality, and merge with the One Lord. They are never trapped at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਡਹਿ ਤ ਬੇਗੁਲ ਬੇਗੁਲੇ ਤਾਕਹਿ ਚੋਗ ਘਣੀ ॥
transliteration: udahi ta begul begule taakahi chog ghanee ||
english: But the others fly away in a hurry, when they see the food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਖ ਤੁਟੇ ਫਾਹੀ ਪੜੀ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਭੀੜ ਬਣੀ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)kh tute phaahee paRee avagun bheeR banee ||
english: Their feathers are clipped, and they are caught in the noose; through their mistakes, they are caught in disaster.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਣੀ ॥
transliteration: bin saache kiu chhooteeai har gun karam manee ||
english: Without the True Lord, how can anyone find release? The jewel of the Lord's Glorious Praises comes by the karma of good actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਵਡਾ ਆਪਿ ਧਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aap chhadaae chhooteeai vadaa aap dhanee ||
english: When He Himself releases them, only then are they released. He Himself is the Great Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee chhooteeai kirapaa aap karei ||
english: By Guru's Grace, they are released, when He Himself grants His Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੩੩॥
transliteration: apanai haath vadaaeeaa jai bhaavai tai dei ||33||
english: Glorious greatness rests in His Hands. He blesses those with whom He is pleased. ||33||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਰ ਥਰ ਕੰਪੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਥਾਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: thar thar ka(n)pai jeeaRaa thaan vihoonaa hoi ||
english: The soul trembles and shakes, when it loses its mooring and support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਫੀਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: thaan maan sach ek hai kaaj na pheetai koi ||
english: Only the support of the True Lord brings honor and glory. Through it, one's works are never in vain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: thir naaraain thir guroo thir saachaa beechaar ||
english: The Lord is eternal and forever stable; the Guru is stable, and contemplation upon the True Lord is stable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥੁ ਤੂ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sur nar naathah naath too nidhaaraa aadhaar ||
english: O Lord and Master of angels, men and Yogic masters, You are the support of the unsupported.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰੀ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sarabe thaan thana(n)taree too daataa daataar ||
english: In all places and interspaces, You are the Giver, the Great Giver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah ek too a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: Wherever I look, there I see You, Lord; You have no end or limitation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa gurasabadee veechaar ||
english: You are pervading and permeating the places and interspaces; reflecting upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਵਡਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩੪॥
transliteration: anama(n)giaa daan devasee vadaa agam apaar ||34||
english: You give gifts even when they are not asked for; You are great, inaccessible and infinite. ||34||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: daiaa daan daiaal too kar kar dekhanahaar ||
english: O Merciful Lord, You are the embodiment of mercy; creating the Creation, You behold it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: daiaa karahi prabh mel laihi khin mahi dhaahi usaar ||
english: Please shower Your Mercy upon me, O God, and unite me with Yourself. In an instant, You destroy and rebuild.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂ ਬੀਨਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਦਾਨਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: daanaa too beenaa tuhee daanaa kai sir daan ||
english: You are all-wise and all-seeing; You are the Greatest Giver of all givers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਾਲਦ ਭੰਜਨ ਦੁਖ ਦਲਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩੫॥
transliteration: daalad bha(n)jan dukh dalan guramukh giaan dhiaan ||35||
english: He is the Eradicator of poverty, and the Destroyer of pain; the Gurmukh realizes spiritual wisdom and meditation. ||35||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਗਇਐ ਬਹਿ ਝੂਰੀਐ ਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਤੁ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: dhan gaiai bahi jhooreeai dhan mahi cheet gavaar ||
english: Losing his wealth, he cries out in anguish; the fool's consciousness is engrossed in wealth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: dhan viralee sach sa(n)chiaa niramal naam piaar ||
english: How rare are those who gather the wealth of Truth, and love the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਾ ਜਾਣ ਦੇਹਿ ਜੇ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਏਕ ॥
transliteration: dhan gaiaa taa jaan dehi je raachahi ra(n)g ek ||
english: If by losing your wealth, you may become absorbed in the Love of the One Lord, then just let it go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਉਪੀਐ ਭੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: man deejai sir saupeeai bhee karate kee tek ||
english: Dedicate your mind, and surrender your head; seek only the Support of the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa dhaavat rahi gae man mahi sabad ana(n)d ||
english: Worldly affairs and wanderings cease, when the mind is filled with the bliss of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਤੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਭਏ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: durajan te saajan bhae bhete gur govi(n)d ||
english: Even one's enemies become friends, meeting with the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਫਿਰਤੀ ਢੂਢਤੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ban ban phiratee dhoodhatee basat rahee ghar baar ||
english: Wandering from forest to forest searching, you will find that those things are within the home of your own heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥੩੬॥
transliteration: satigur melee mil rahee janam maran dukh nivaar ||36||
english: United by the True Guru, you shall remain united, and the pains of birth and death will be ended. ||36||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naanaa karat na chhooteeai vin gun jam pur jaahi ||
english: Through various rituals, one does not find release. Without virtue, one is sent to the City of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਏਹੁ ਨ ਓਹੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naa tis ehu na ohu hai avagun phir pachhutaahi ||
english: One will not have this world or the next; committing sinful mistakes, one comes to regret and repent in the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: naa tis giaan na dhiaan hai naa tis dharam dhiaan ||
english: He has neither spiritual wisdom or meditation; neither Dharmic faith mor meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਹਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai nirabhau kahaa kiaa jaanaa abhimaan ||
english: Without the Name, how can one be fearless? How can he understand egotistical pride?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਾਕਿ ਰਹੀ ਕਿਵ ਅਪੜਾ ਹਾਥ ਨਹੀ ਨਾ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: thaak rahee kiv apaRaa haath nahee naa paar ||
english: I am so tired - how can I get there? This ocean has no bottom or end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: naa saajan se ra(n)gule kis pahi karee pukaar ||
english: I have no loving companions, whom I can ask for help.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak priu priu je karee mele melanahaar ||
english: O Nanak, crying out, "Beloved, Beloved", we are united with the Uniter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੀ ਸੋ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੩੭॥
transliteration: jin vichhoRee so melasee gur kai het apaar ||37||
english: He who separated me, unites me again; my love for the Guru is infinite. ||37||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: paap buraa paapee kau piaaraa ||
english: Sin is bad, but it is dear to the sinner.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪਿ ਲਦੇ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: paap lade paape paasaaraa ||
english: He loads himself with sin, and expands his world through sin.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਪਾਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਆਪੁ ॥
transliteration: parahar paap pachhaanai aap ||
english: Sin is far away from one who understands himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: naa tis sog vijog sa(n)taap ||
english: He is not afflicted by sorrow or separation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕਿ ਪੜੰਤਉ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਬੰਚੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: narak paRa(n)tau kiu rahai kiu ba(n)chai jamakaal ||
english: How can one avoid falling into hell? How can he cheat the Messenger of Death?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਖੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: kiu aavan jaanaa veesarai jhooth buraa khai kaal ||
english: How can coming and going be forgotten? Falsehood is bad, and death is cruel.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੀ ਵੇੜਿਆ ਭੀ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: man ja(n)jaalee veRiaa bhee ja(n)jaalaa maahi ||
english: The mind is enveloped by entanglements, and into entanglements it falls.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਹਿ ॥੩੮॥
transliteration: vin naavai kiu chhooteeai paape pachahi pachaahi ||38||
english: Without the Name, how can anyone be saved? They rot away in sin. ||38||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਸੈ ਕਊਆ ॥
transliteration: phir phir phaahee phaasai kaooaa ||
english: Again and again, the crow falls into the trap.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਹੂਆ ॥
transliteration: phir pachhutaanaa ab kiaa hooaa ||
english: Then he regrets it, but what can he do now?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਾਥਾ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: phaathaa chog chugai nahee boojhai ||
english: Even though he is trapped, he pecks at the food; he does not understand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਆਖੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: satagur milai ta aakhee soojhai ||
english: If he meets the True Guru, then he sees with his eyes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਫਾਥੀ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jiu machhulee phaathee jam jaal ||
english: Like a fish, he is caught in the noose of death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: vin gur daate mukat na bhaal ||
english: Do not seek liberation from anyone else, except the Guru, the Great Giver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: phir phir aavai phir phir jaai ||
english: Over and over again, he comes; over and over again, he goes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik ra(n)g rachai rahai liv laai ||
english: Be absorbed in love for the One Lord, and remain lovingly focused on Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਵ ਛੂਟੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਾਸ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੯॥
transliteration: iv chhootai phir phaas na paai ||39||
english: In this way you shall be saved, and you shall not fall into the trap again. ||39||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੀਰਾ ਬੀਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਬੀਰ ਭਏ ਬੈਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: beeraa beeraa kar rahee beer bhae bairaai ||
english: She calls out, "Brother, O brother - stay, O brother!" But he becomes a stranger.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੀਰ ਚਲੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਬਹਿਣ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: beer chale ghar aapanai bahin birahi jal jaai ||
english: Her brother departs for his own home, and his sister burns with the pain of separation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੁਲ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੇਟੜੀ ਬਾਲੀ ਬਾਲੈ ਨੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: baabul kai ghar betaRee baalee baalai nehi ||
english: In this world, her father's home, the daughter, the innocent soul bride, loves her Young Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: je loRahi var kaamanee satigur sevahi tehi ||
english: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul bride, then serve the True Guru with love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਲੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੂਝਣਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: biralo giaanee boojhanau satigur saach milei ||
english: How rare are the spiritually wise, who meet the True Guru, and truly understand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: thaakur haath vadaaeeaa jai bhaavai tai dei ||
english: All glorious greatness rests in the Lord and Master's Hands. He grants them, when He is pleased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਬਿਰਲਉ ਬੀਚਾਰਸੀ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: baanee biralau beechaarasee je ko guramukh hoi ||
english: How rare are those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani; they become Gurmukh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪੦॥
transliteration: ih baanee mahaa purakh kee nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||40||
english: This is the Bani of the Supreme Being; through it, one dwells within the home of his inner being. ||40||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਨਿ ਭਨਿ ਘੜੀਐ ਘੜਿ ਘੜਿ ਭਜੈ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੈ ਉਸਰੇ ਢਾਹੈ ॥
transliteration: bhan bhan ghaReeai ghaR ghaR bhajai dhaahi usaarai usare dhaahai ||
english: Shattering and breaking apart, He creates and re-creates; creating, He shatters again. He builds up what He has demolished, and demolishes what He has built.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਖੈ ਭੀ ਭਰਿ ਪੋਖੈ ਸਮਰਥ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sar bhar sokhai bhee bhar pokhai samarath veparavaahai ||
english: He dries up the pools which are full, and fills the dried tanks again. He is all-powerful and independent.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਭਏ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: bharam bhulaane bhae divaane vin bhaagaa kiaa paaeeai ||
english: Deluded by doubt, they have gone insane; without destiny, what do they obtain?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਡੋਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਕੜੀ ਜਿਨ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: guramukh giaan doree prabh pakaRee jin khi(n)chai tin jaaeeai ||
english: The Gurmukhs know that God holds the string; wherever He pulls it, they must go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaai sadaa ra(n)g raate bahuR na pachhotaaeeai ||
english: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, are forever imbued with His Love; they never again feel regret.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਭੈ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: bhabhai bhaalahi guramukh boojhahi taa nij ghar vaasaa paaeeai ||
english: Bhabha: If someone seeks, and then becomes Gurmukh, then he comes to dwell in the home of his own heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਭੈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਵਿਖੜਾ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: bhabhai bhaujal maarag vikhaRaa aas niraasaa tareeai ||
english: Bhabha: The way of the terrifying world-ocean is treacherous. Remain free of hope, in the midst of hope, and you shall cross over.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੋ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਵ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੪੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee aapo cheenhai jeevatiaa iv mareeai ||41||
english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand himself; in this way, he remains dead while yet alive. ||41||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa maaiaa kar mue maaiaa kisai na saath ||
english: Crying out for the wealth and riches of Maya, they die; but Maya does not go along with them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਡੁਮਣੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਭੂਲੀ ਆਥਿ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)s chalai uth dumano maaiaa bhoolee aath ||
english: The soul-swan arises and departs, sad and depressed, leaving its wealth behind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਚਲਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: man jhoothaa jam johiaa avagun chalahi naal ||
english: The false mind is hunted by the Messenger of Death; it carries its faults along when it goes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਉਲਟੋ ਮਰੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: man mahi man ulato marai je gun hovahi naal ||
english: The mind turns inward, and merges with mind, when it is with virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: meree meree kar mue vin naavai dukh bhaal ||
english: Crying out, "Mine, mine!", they have died, but without the Name, they find only pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੜ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਕਹਾ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਜੀ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: gaR ma(n)dar mahalaa kahaa jiu baajee deebaan ||
english: So where are their forts, mansions, palaces and courts? They are like a short story.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak sache naam vin jhoothaa aavan jaan ||
english: O Nanak, without the True Name, the false just come and go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੪੨॥
transliteration: aape chatur saroop hai aape jaan sujaan ||42||
english: He Himself is clever and so very beautiful; He Himself is wise and all-knowing. ||42||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਇ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jo aavahi se jaahi phun aai gae pachhutaahi ||
english: Those who come, must go in the end; they come and go, regretting and repenting.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਵਧੈ ਉਤਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh medanee ghatai na vadhai utaahi ||
english: They will pass through 8.4 millions species; this number does not decrease or rise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: se jan ubare jin har bhaaiaa ||
english: They alone are saved, who love the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਮੁਆ ਵਿਗੂਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa muaa vigootee maaiaa ||
english: Their worldly entanglements are ended, and Maya is conquered.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਚਾਲਸੀ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai so chaalasee kis kau meet kareu ||
english: Whoever is seen, shall depart; who should I make my friend?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਸਮਪਉ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਉ ॥
transliteration: jeeu samapau aapanaa tan man aagai deu ||
english: I dedicate my soul, and place my body and mind in offering before Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਓਟ ॥
transliteration: asathir karataa too dhanee tis hee kee mai ot ||
english: You are eternally stable, O Creator, Lord and Master; I lean on Your Support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਚੋਟ ॥੪੩॥
transliteration: gun kee maaree hau muee sabad ratee man chot ||43||
english: Conquered by virtue, egotism is killed; imbued with the Word of the Shabad, the mind rejects the world. ||43||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਣਾ ਰਾਉ ਨ ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਤੁੰਗੁ ਫਕੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raanaa raau na ko rahai ra(n)g na tu(n)g phakeer ||
english: Neither the kings nor the nobles will remain; neither the rich nor the poor will remain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੰਧੈ ਧੀਰ ॥
transliteration: vaaree aapo aapanee koi na ba(n)dhai dheer ||
english: When one's turn comes, no one can stay here.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਹੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਭੀਹਾਵਲਾ ਸਰ ਡੂਗਰ ਅਸਗਾਹ ॥
transliteration: raahu buraa bheehaavalaa sar doogar asagaah ||
english: The path is difficult and treacherous; the pools and mountains are impassable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਝੁਰਿ ਮੁਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹ ॥
transliteration: mai tan avagan jhur muee vin gun kiu ghar jaah ||
english: My body is filled with faults; I am dying of grief. Without virtue, how can I enter my home?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਕਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਉ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guneeaa gun le prabh mile kiu tin milau piaar ||
english: The virtuous take virtue, and meet God; how can I meet them with love?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਥੀ ਰਹਾਂ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: tin hee jaisee thee rahaa(n) jap jap ridai muraar ||
english: If ony I could be like them, chanting and meditating within my heart on the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗੁਣੀ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਭੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: avagunee bharapoor hai gun bhee vasahi naal ||
english: He is overflowing with faults and demerits, but virtue dwells within him as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪੪॥
transliteration: vin satagur gun na jaapanee jichar sabad na kare beechaar ||44||
english: Without the True Guru, he does not see God's Virtues; he does not chant the Glorious Virtues of God. ||44||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਸਕਰੀਆ ਘਰ ਸੰਮਲੇ ਆਏ ਵਜਹੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: lasakareeaa ghar sa(n)male aae vajahu likhaai ||
english: God's soldiers take care of their homes; their pay is pre-ordained, before they come into the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਣੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaar kamaavahi sir dhanee laahaa palai paai ||
english: They serve their Supreme Lord and Master, and obtain the profit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਛੋਡੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: lab lobh buriaaeeaa chhode manahu visaar ||
english: They renounce greed, avarice and evil, and forget them from their minds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੜਿ ਦੋਹੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਕੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gaR dohee paatisaah kee kade na aavai haar ||
english: In the fortress of the body, they announce the victory of their Supreme King; they are never ever vanquished.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਸਉਹੇ ਉਤਰ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: chaakar kaheeai khasam kaa sauhe utar dei ||
english: One who calls himself a servant of his Lord and Master, and yet speaks defiantly to Him,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਜਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਖਤਿ ਨ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
transliteration: vajahu gavaae aapanaa takhat na baisahi sei ||
english: shall forfeit his pay, and not be seated upon the throne.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: preetam hath vadiaaeeaa jai bhaavai tai dei ||
english: Glorious greatness rests in the hands of my Beloved; He gives, according to the Pleasure of His Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪੫॥
transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai avar na koi karei ||45||
