gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man kaa jeeu pavan katheeale pavan kahaa ras khaaee ||
english: "The air is said to be the soul of the mind. But what does the air feed on?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਵਨ ਅਉਧੂ ਸਿਧ ਕੀ ਕਵਨ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: giaan kee mudraa kavan audhoo sidh kee kavan kamaaee ||
english: What is the way of the spiritual teacher, and the reclusive hermit? What is the occupation of the Siddha?"

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਉਧੂ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai ras na aavai audhoo haumai piaas na jaaee ||
english: Without the Shabad, the essence does not come, O hermit, and the thirst of egotism does not depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabad rate a(n)mrit ras paaiaa saache rahe aghaaee ||
english: Imbued with the Shabad, one finds the ambrosial essence, and remains fulfilled with the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੀਐ ਕਿਤੁ ਭੋਜਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ॥
transliteration: kavan budh jit asathir raheeai kit bhojan tripataasai ||
english: "What is that wisdom, by which one remains steady and stable? What food brings satisfaction?"

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਾਸੈ ॥੬੧॥
transliteration: naanak dukh sukh sam kar jaapai satigur te kaal na graasai ||61||
english: O Nanak, when one looks upon pain and pleasure alike, through the True Guru, then he is not consumed by Death. ||61||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਨ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਸਿ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g na raataa ras nahee maataa ||
english: If one is not imbued with the Lord's Love, nor intoxicated with His subtle essence,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bin gurasabadai jal bal taataa ||
english: without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is frustrated, and consumed by his own inner fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bi(n)d na raakhiaa sabad na bhaakhiaa ||
english: He does not preserve his semen and seed, and does not chant the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਵਨੁ ਨ ਸਾਧਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pavan na saadhiaa sach na araadhiaa ||
english: He does not control his breath; he does not worship and adore the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਲੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: akath kathaa le sam kar rahai ||
english: But one who speaks the Unspoken Speech, and remains balanced,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਕਉ ਲਹੈ ॥੬੨॥
transliteration: tau naanak aatam raam kau lahai ||62||
english: O Nanak, attains the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||62||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ra(n)ge raataa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one is attuned to the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit peeaa saache maataa ||
english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, he is intoxicated with the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gur veechaaree agan nivaaree ||
english: Contemplating the Guru, the fire within is put out.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਓ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: apiu peeo aatam sukh dhaaree ||
english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, the soul settles in peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sach araadhiaa guramukh tar taaree ||
english: Worshipping the True Lord in adoration, the Gurmukh crosses over the river of life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੬੩॥
transliteration: naanak boojhai ko veechaaree ||63||
english: O Nanak, after deep contemplation, this is understood. ||63||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਕਹਾ ਬਸੀਅਲੇ ਕਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਇਹੁ ਪਵਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ihu man maigal kahaa baseeale kahaa basai ihu pavanaa ||
english: "Where does this mind-elephant live? Where does the breath reside?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਉਧੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭਵਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kahaa basai s sabad audhoo taa kau chookai man kaa bhavanaa ||
english: Where should the Shabad reside, so that the wanderings of the mind may cease?"

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa satigur mele taa nij ghar vaasaa ihu man paae ||
english: When the Lord blesses one with His Glance of Grace, he leads him to the True Guru. Then, this mind dwells in its own home within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aapai aap khaai taa niramal hovai dhaavat varaj rahaae ||
english: When the individual consumes his egotism, he becomes immaculate, and his wandering mind is restrained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਆਤਮੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਿਉ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kiu mool pachhaanai aatam jaanai kiu sas ghar soor samaavai ||
english: "How can the root, the source of all be realized? How can the soul know itself? How can the sun enter into the house of the moon?"

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਵੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੬੪॥
transliteration: guramukh haumai vichahu khovai tau naanak sahaj samaavai ||64||
english: The Gurmukh eliminates egotism from within; then, O Nanak, the sun naturally enters into the home of the moon. ||64||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੀਅਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu man nihachal hiradai vaseeale guramukh mool pachhaan rahai ||
english: When the mind becomes steady and stable, it abides in the heart, and then the Gurmukh realizes the root, the source of all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਭਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
transliteration: naabh pavan ghar aasan baisai guramukh khojat tat lahai ||
english: The breath is seated in the home of the navel; the Gurmukh searches, and finds the essence of reality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਛੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
transliteration: s sabad nira(n)tar nij ghar aachhai tribhavan jot s sabad lahai ||
english: This Shabad permeates the nucleus of the self, deep within, in its own home; the Light of this Shabad pervades the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਵੈ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: khaavai dookh bhookh saache kee saache hee tripataas rahai ||
english: Hunger for the True Lord shall consume your pain, and through the True Lord, you shall be satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਕੋ ਅਰਥਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: anahad baanee guramukh jaanee biralo ko arathaavai ||
english: The Gurmukh knows the unstruck sound current of the Bani; how rare are those who understand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਖੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੬੫॥
transliteration: naanak aakhai sach subhaakhai sach rapai ra(n)g kabahoo na jaavai ||65||
english: Says Nanak, one who speaks the Truth is dyed in the color of Truth, which will never fade away. ||65||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਇਹੁ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਦੇਹ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਕੈਠੈ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa ihu hiradaa deh na hotee tau man kaithai rahataa ||
english: "When this heart and body did not exist, where did the mind reside?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲ ਅਸਥੰਭੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਤਾ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਵਨ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
transliteration: naabh kamal asatha(n)bh na hoto taa pavan kavan ghar sahataa ||
english: When there was no support of the navel lotus, then in which home did the breath reside?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: roop na hoto rekh na kaaee taa sabad kahaa liv laaee ||
english: When there was no form or shape, then how could anyone lovingly focus on the Shabad?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕੀ ਮੜੀ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: rakat bi(n)d kee maRee na hotee mit keemat nahee paaee ||
english: When there was no dungeon formed from egg and sperm, who could measure the Lord's value and extent?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਰਨੁ ਭੇਖੁ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪਸਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: varan bhekh asaroop na jaapee kiu kar jaapas saachaa ||
english: When color, dress and form could not be seen, how could the True Lord be known?"

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਇਬ ਤਬ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚਾ ॥੬੬॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate bairaagee ib tab saacho saachaa ||66||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are detached. Then and now, they see the Truest of the True. ||66||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦਾ ਦੇਹ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਅਉਧੂ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: hiradaa deh na hotee audhoo tau man su(n)n rahai bairaagee ||
english: When the heart and the body did not exist, O hermit, then the mind resided in the absolute, detached Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਸਥੰਭੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਸਤਉ ਪਵਨੁ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: naabh kamal asatha(n)bh na hoto taa nij ghar basatau pavan anaraagee ||
english: When there was no support of the lotus of the navel, the breath remained in its own home, attuned to the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਉ ਅਕੁਲੀਣਿ ਰਹਤਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: roop na rekhiaa jaat na hotee tau akuleen rahatau sabad s saar ||
english: When there was no form or shape or social class, then the Shabad, in its essence, resided in the unmanifest Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਉਨੁ ਗਗਨੁ ਜਬ ਤਬਹਿ ਨ ਹੋਤਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gaun gagan jab tabahi na hotau tribhavan jot aape nira(n)kaar ||
english: When the world and the sky did not even exist, the Light of the Formless Lord filled the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਰਨੁ ਭੇਖੁ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: varan bhekh asaroop s eko eko sabad vidaanee ||
english: Color, dress and form were contained in the One Lord; the Shabad was contained in the One, Wondrous Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੂਚਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੬੭॥
transliteration: saach binaa soochaa ko naahee naanak akath kahaanee ||67||
english: Without the True Name, no one can become pure; O Nanak, this is the Unspoken Speech. ||67||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kit kit bidh jag upajai purakhaa kit kit dukh binas jaaee ||
english: "How, in what way, was the world formed, O man? And what disaster will end it?"

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: haumai vich jag upajai purakhaa naam visariai dukh paaee ||
english: In egotism, the world was formed, O man; forgetting the Naam, it suffers and dies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s giaan tat beechaarai haumai sabad jalaae ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom; through the Shabad, he burns away his egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tan man niramal niramal baanee saachai rahai samaae ||
english: His body and mind become immaculate, through the Immaculate Bani of the Word. He remains absorbed in Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naame naam rahai bairaagee saach rakhiaa ur dhaare ||
english: Through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he remains detached; he enshrines the True Name in his heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੬੮॥
transliteration: naanak bin naavai jog kade na hovai dekhahu ridai beechaare ||68||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, Yoga is never attained; reflect upon this in your heart, and see. ||68||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saach sabad beechaarai koi ||
english: The Gurmukh is one who reflects upon the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sach baanee paragat hoi ||
english: The True Bani is revealed to the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh man bheejai viralaa boojhai koi ||
english: The mind of the Gurmukh is drenched with the Lord's Love, but how rare are those who understand this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||
english: The Gurmukh dwells in the home of the self, deep within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jogee jugat pachhaanai ||
english: The Gurmukh realizes the Way of Yoga.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੬੯॥
transliteration: guramukh naanak eko jaanai ||69||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh knows the One Lord alone. ||69||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve jog na hoee ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, Yoga is not attained;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur bhete mukat na koee ||
english: without meeting the True Guru, no one is liberated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur bhete naam paaiaa na jaai ||
english: Without meeting the True Guru, the Naam cannot be found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur bhete mahaa dukh paai ||
english: Without meeting the True Guru, one suffers in terrible pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਹਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur bhete mahaa garab gubaar ||
english: Without meeting the True Guru, there is only the deep darkness of egotistical pride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੭੦॥
transliteration: naanak bin gur muaa janam haar ||70||
english: O Nanak, without the True Guru, one dies, having lost the opportunity of this life. ||70||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh man jeetaa haumai maar ||
english: The Gurmukh conquers his mind by subduing his ego.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||
english: The Gurmukh enshrines Truth in his heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jag jeetaa jamakaal maar bidaar ||
english: The Gurmukh conquers the world; he knocks down the Messenger of Death, and kills it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh daragah na aavai haar ||
english: The Gurmukh does not lose in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh mel milaae sou jaanai ||
english: The Gurmukh is united in God's Union; he alone knows.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੭੧॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh sabad pachhaanai ||71||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Word of the Shabad. ||71||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੂ ਅਉਧੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabadai kaa nibeRaa sun too audhoo bin naavai jog na hoee ||
english: This is the essence of the Shabad - listen, you hermits and Yogis. Without the Name, there is no Yoga.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਤੇ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: naame raate anadin maate naamai te sukh hoee ||
english: Those who are attuned to the Name, remain intoxicated night and day; through the Name, they find peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naamai hee te sabh paragat hovai naame sojhee paaee ||
english: Through the Name, everything is revealed; through the Name, understanding is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai bhekh karahi bahutere sachai aap khuaaee ||
english: Without the Name, people wear all sorts of religious robes; the True Lord Himself has confused them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਉਧੂ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur te naam paaeeai audhoo jog jugat taa hoee ||
english: The Name is obtained only from the True Guru, O hermit, and then, the Way of Yoga is found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭੨॥
transliteration: kar beechaar man dekhahu naanak bin naavai mukat na hoee ||72||
english: Reflect upon this in your mind, and see; O Nanak, without the Name, there is no liberation. ||72||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: teree gat mit toohai jaanahi kiaa ko aakh vakhaanai ||
english: You alone know Your state and extent, Lord; What can anyone say about it?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: too aape gupataa aape paragat aape sabh ra(n)g maanai ||
english: You Yourself are hidden, and You Yourself are revealed. You Yourself enjoy all pleasures.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhik sidh guroo bahu chele khojat phirahi phuramaanai ||
english: The seekers, the Siddhas, the many gurus and disciples wander around searching for You, according to Your Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਇਹ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: maagahi naam paai ih bhikhiaa tere darasan kau kurabaanai ||
english: They beg for Your Name, and You bless them with this charity. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: abinaasee prabh khel rachaaiaa guramukh sojhee hoee ||
english: The eternal imperishable Lord God has staged this play; the Gurmukh understands it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭਿ ਜੁਗ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੭੩॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sabh jug aape varatai doojaa avar na koee ||73||1||
english: O Nanak, He extends Himself throughout the ages; there is no other than Him. ||73||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥ ਜੋਧੈ ਵੀਰੈ ਪੂਰਬਾਣੀ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee kee vaar mahalaa 3 || jodhai veerai poorabaanee kee dhunee ||
english: Vaar Of Raamkalee, Third Mehl, To Be Sung To The Tune Of 'Jodha And Veera Poorbaanee':

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਦਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur sahajai daa khet hai jis no laae bhaau ||
english: The True Guru is the field of intuitive wisdom. One who is inspired to love Him,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜੇ ਨਾਉ ਉਗਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naau beeje naau ugavai naame rahai samaai ||
english: plants the seed of the Name there. The Name sprouts up, and he remains absorbed in the Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਬੀਜੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai eho beej hai sahasaa gaiaa vilaai ||
english: But this egotism is the seed of skepticism; it has been uprooted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਨ ਉਗਵੈ ਜੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naa kichh beeje na ugavai jo bakhase so khaai ||
english: It is not planted there, and it does not sprout; whatever God grants us, we eat.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਭੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਅੰਭੁ ਰਲਿਆ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)bhai setee a(n)bh raliaa bahuR na nikasiaa jaai ||
english: When water mixes with water, it cannot be separated again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਹੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh chalat hai vekhahu lokaa aai ||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is wonderful; come, poeple, and see!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕੁ ਕਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: lok k vekhai bapuRaa jis no sojhee naahi ||
english: But what can the poor people see? They do not understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ ਸੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis vekhaale so vekhai jis vasiaa man maahi ||1||
english: He alone sees, whom the Lord causes to see; the Lord comes to dwell in his mind. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh dukh kaa khet hai dukh beeje dukh khaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is the field of sorrow and suffering. He plains sorrow, and eats sorrow.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh vich ja(n)mai dukh marai haumai karat vihaai ||
english: In sorrow he is born, and in sorrow he dies. Acting in egotism, his life passes away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaan na sujhaee a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamaai ||
english: He does not understand the coming and going of reincarnation; the blind man acts in blindness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਦਿਤੇ ਕਉ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jo devai tisai na jaanaee dite kau lapataai ||
english: He does not know the One who gives, but he is attached to what is given.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa avar na karanaa jaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, he acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. He cannot do anything else. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur miliai sadaa sukh jis no aape mele soi ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, everlasting peace is obtained. He Himself leads us to meet Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੈ ਏਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sukhai ehu bibek hai a(n)tar niramal hoi ||
english: This is the true meaning of peace, that one becomes immaculate within oneself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: agiaan kaa bhram kateeai giaan paraapat hoi ||
english: The doubt of ignorance is eradicated, and spiritual wisdom is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak eko nadaree aaiaa jah dekhaa tah soi ||3||
english: Nanak comes to gaze upon the One Lord alone; wherever he looks, there He is. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਬੈਸਣ ਕਉ ਜਾਂਈ ॥
transliteration: sachai takhat rachaaiaa baisan kau jaa(n)ee ||
english: The True Lord created His throne, upon which He sits.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap hai gur sabad sunaaee ||
english: He Himself is everything; this is what the Word of the Guru's Shabad says.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਸਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aape kudarat saajeean kar mahal saraaee ||
english: Through His almighty creative power, He created and fashioned the mansions and hotels.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਚਾਨਣੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)d sooraj dui chaanane pooree banat banaaee ||
english: He made the two lamps, the sun and the moon; He formed the perfect form.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape vekhai sune aap gur sabad dhiaaee ||1||
english: He Himself sees, and He Himself hears; meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਤੂ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: vaahu vaahu sache paatisaah too sachee naaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Waaho! Waaho! Hail, hail, O True King! True is Your Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਹਿਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਘਾਲਿਆ ਆਪੁ ਪੀਸਾਇ ਪੀਸਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer mahidee kar kai ghaaliaa aap peesaai peesaai ||
english: Kabeer, I have ground myself into henna paste.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੀਆ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਲਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tai sah baat na puchheeaa kabahoo na laaee paai ||1||
english: O my Husband Lord, You took no notice of me; You never applied me to Your feet. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਿਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak mahidee kar kai rakhiaa so sahu nadar karei ||
english: O Nanak, my Husband Lord keeps me like henna paste; He blesses me with His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪੀਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਘਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਲਾਇ ਲਏਇ ॥
transliteration: aape peesai aape ghasai aape hee laai laei ||
english: He Himself grinds me, and He Himself rubs me; He Himself applies me to His feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ihu piram piaalaa khasam kaa jai bhaavai tai dei ||2||
english: This is the cup of love of my Lord and Master; He gives it as He chooses. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵੇਕੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: vekee srisat upaaeean sabh hukam aavai jaai samaahee ||
english: You created the world with its variety; by the Hukam of Your Command, it comes, goes, and merges again in You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: aape vekh vigasadaa doojaa ko naahee ||
english: You Yourself see, and blossom forth; there is no one else at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu rakh too gur sabad bujhaahee ||
english: As it pleases You, You keep me. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I understand You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa teraa jor hai jiu bhaavai tivai chalaahee ||
english: You are the strength of all. As it pleases You, You lead us on.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡ ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tudh jevad mai naahi ko kis aakh sunaaee ||2||
english: There is no other as great as You; unto whom should I speak and talk? ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ ਫਾਵੀ ਹੋਈ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: bharam bhulaaee sabh jag phiree phaavee hoee bhaal ||
english: Deluded by doubt, I wandered over the whole world. Searching, I became frustrated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਦੇਵਈ ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: so sahu saa(n)t na devaee kiaa chalai tis naal ||
english: My Husband Lord has not blessed me with peace and tranquility; what will work with Him?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har dhiaaeeai a(n)tar rakheeai ur dhaar ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Lord; I enshrine Him deep within my heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ghar baithiaa sahu paaiaa jaa kirapaa keetee karataar ||1||
english: O Nanak, seated in his her own home, she finds her Husband Lord, when the Creator Lord grants His Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa dhaavat din gaiaa rain gavaaee soi ||
english: Chasing after worldly affairs, the day is wasted, and the night passes in sleep.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kooR bol bikh khaaiaa manamukh chaliaa roi ||
english: Speaking lies, one eats poison; the self-willed manmukh departs, crying out in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sirai upar jam da(n)d hai doojai bhaai pat khoi ||
english: The Mesenger of Death holds his club over the mortal's head; in the love of duality, he loses his honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: har naam kade na chetio phir aavan jaanaa hoi ||
english: He never even thinks of the Name of the Lord; over and over again, he comes and goes in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har man vasai jam da(n)d na laagai koi ||
english: But if, by Guru's Grace, the Lord's Name comes to dwell in his mind, then the Messenger of Death will not strike him down with his club.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sahaje mil rahai karam paraapat hoi ||2||
english: Then, O Nanak, he merges intuitively into the Lord, receiving His Grace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਦੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤੀ ॥
transliteration: ik aapanee siphatee laaian de satigur matee ||
english: Some are linked to His Praises, when the Lord blesses them with the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਨਾਉ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਤੀ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa no naau bakhasion asathir har satee ||
english: Some are blessed with the Name of the eternal, unchanging True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਗਤੀ ॥
transliteration: paun paanee baisa(n)taro hukam karahi bhagatee ||
english: Water, air and fire, by His Will, worship Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਨਾ ਨੋ ਭਉ ਅਗਲਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਤੀ ॥
transliteration: enaa no bhau agalaa pooree banat banatee ||
english: They are held in the Fear of God; He has formed the perfect form.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh iko hukam varatadaa ma(n)niai sukh paaee ||3||
english: The Hukam, the Command of the One Lord is all-pervasive; accepting it, peace is found. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਝੂਠਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kasautee raam kee jhoothaa tikai na koi ||
english: Kabeer, such is the touchstone of the Lord; the false cannot even touch it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਸੋ ਸਹੈ ਜੋ ਮਰਜੀਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam kasautee so sahai jo marajeevaa hoi ||1||
english: He alone passes this test of the Lord, who remains dead while yet alive. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kiu kar ihu man maareeai kiu kar miratak hoi ||
english: How can this mind be conquered? How can it be killed?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਮਾਨਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਛਡੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kahiaa sabad na maanaee haumai chhadai na koi ||
english: If one does not accept the Word of the Shabad, egotism does not depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੁਟੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee haumai chhutai jeevan mukat so hoi ||
english: By Guru's Grace, egotism is eradicated, and then, one is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jis no bakhase tis milai tis bighan na laagai koi ||2||
english: O Nanak, one whom the Lord forgives is united with Him, and then no obstacles block his way. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jeevat maranaa sabh ko kahai jeevan mukat kiu hoi ||
english: Everyone can say that they are dead while yet alive; how can they be liberated while yet alive?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਕਾ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਰੂ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏਇ ॥
transliteration: bhai kaa sa(n)jam je kare daaroo bhaau laaei ||
english: If someone restrains himself through the Fear of God, and takes the medicine of the Love of God,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin gun gaavai sukh sahaje bikh bhavajal naam tarei ||
english: night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. In celestial peace and poise, he crosses over the poisonous, terrifying world-ocean, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh paaeeai jaa kau nadar karei ||3||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord; he is blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: doojaa bhaau rachaaion trai gun varataaraa ||
english: God created the love of duality, and the three modes which pervade the universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਕਮਾਵਨਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes upaaian hukam kamaavan kaaraa ||
english: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, who act according to His Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਦੇ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit paRade jotakee naa boojhahi beechaaraa ||
english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers study their books, but they do not understand contemplation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh teraa khel hai sach sirajanahaaraa ||
english: Everything is Your play, O True Creator Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jis bhaavai tis bakhas laihi sach sabad samaaee ||4||
english: As it pleases You, You bless us with forgiveness, and merge us in the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਝੂਠਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: man kaa jhoothaa jhooth kamaavai ||
english: The man of false mind practices falsehood.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਫਿਰੈ ਤਪਾ ਸਦਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa no phirai tapaa sadaavai ||
english: He runs after Maya, and yet pretends to be a man of disciplined meditation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗਹੈ ॥
transliteration: bharame bhoolaa sabh teerath gahai ||
english: Deluded by doubt, he visits all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਤਪਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
transliteration: ohu tapaa kaise param gat lahai ||
english: How can such a man of disciplined meditation attain the supreme status?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ko sach kamaavai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one lives the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਤਪਾ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak so tapaa mokha(n)tar paavai ||1||
english: O Nanak, such a man of disciplined meditation attains liberation. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਤਪਾ ਜਿ ਇਹੁ ਤਪੁ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: so tapaa j ihu tap ghaale ||
english: He alone is a man of disciplined meditation, who practices this self-discipline.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur no milai sabad samaale ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, he contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਪੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee sevaa ihu tap paravaan ||
english: Serving the True Guru - this is the only acceptable disciplined meditation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਤਪਾ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak so tapaa daragahi paavai maan ||2||
english: O Nanak, such a man of disciplined meditation is honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਵਰਤਣਿ ॥
transliteration: raat dinas upaaian sa(n)saar kee varatan ||
english: He created the night and the day, for the activities of the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਆਨੇਰੁ ਬਿਨਾਸਣਿ ॥
transliteration: guramatee ghat chaananaa aaner binaasan ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, one's heart is illumined, and the darkness is dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ॥
transliteration: hukame hee sabh saajeean raviaa sabh van trin ||
english: By the Hukam of His Command, He creates everything; He pervades and permeates all the woods and meadows.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਣਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap hai guramukh sadaa har bhan ||
english: He Himself is everything; the Gurmukh constantly chants the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sabade hee sojhee paee sachai aap bujhaaee ||5||
english: Through the Shabad, understanding comes; the True Lord Himself inspires us to understand. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: abhiaagat ehi na aakheean jin ke chit mahi bharam ||
english: He is not called a renunciate, whose consciousness is filled with doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਦਿਤੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: tis dai ditai naanakaa teho jehaa dharam ||
english: Donations to him bring proportionate rewards.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਭੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭੂਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: abhai nira(n)jan param pad taa kaa bhookhaa hoi ||
english: He hungers for the supreme status of the Fearless, Immaculate Lord;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis kaa bhojan naanakaa viralaa paae koi ||1||
english: O Nanak, how rare are those who offer him this food. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜਿ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: abhiaagat ehi na aakheean j par ghar bhojan karen ||
english: They are not called renunciates, who take food in the homes of others.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਉਦਰੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਆਪਣੇ ਬਹਲੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: udarai kaaran aapane bahale bhekh karen ||
english: For the sake of their bellies, they wear various religious robes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਆਤਮ ਗਉਣੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: abhiaagat seee naanakaa j aatam gaun karen ||
english: They alone are renunciates, O Nanak, who enter into their own souls.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਲਿ ਲਹਨਿ ਸਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਰਹਣੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhaal lahan sahu aapanaa nij ghar rahan karen ||2||
english: They seek and find their Husband Lord; they dwell within the home of their own inner self. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਰੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਅਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)bar dharat vichhoRian vich sachaa asaraau ||
english: They sky and the earth are separate, but the True Lord supports them from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਸਭੋ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ghar dar sabho sach hai jis vich sachaa naau ||
english: True are all those homes and gates, within which the True Name is enshrined.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh sachaa hukam varatadaa guramukh sach samaau ||
english: The Hukam of the True Lord's Command is effective everywhere. The Gurmukh merges in the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਬਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
transliteration: sachaa aap takhat sachaa bahi sachaa kare niaau ||
english: He Himself is True, and True is His throne. Seated upon it, He administers true justice.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sabh sacho sach varatadaa guramukh alakh lakhaaee ||6||
english: The Truest of the True is all-pervading everywhere; the Gurmukh sees the unseen. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਾਇਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਨੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: rainaair maahi ana(n)t hai kooRee aavai jaai ||
english: In the world-ocean, the Infinite Lord abides. The false come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai chalai aapanai bahutee lahai sajaai ||
english: One who walks according to his own will, suffers terrible punishment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਾਇਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: rainaair mahi sabh kichh hai karamee palai paai ||
english: All things are in the world-ocean, but they are obtained only by the karma of good actions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak nau nidh paaeeai je chalai tisai rajaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, he alone obtains the nine treasures, who walks in the Will of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sahaje satigur na sevio vich haumai janam binaas ||
english: One who doesn't intuitively serve the True Guru, loses his life in egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਖਿਓ ਕਮਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa har ras na chakhio kamal na hoio paragaas ||
english: His tongue does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and his heart-lotus does not blossom forth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਧੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: bikh khaadhee manamukh muaa maaiaa mohi vinaas ||
english: The self-willed manmukh eats poison and dies; he is ruined by love and attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: ikas har ke naam vin dhrig jeevan dhrig vaas ||
english: Without the Name of the One Lord, his life is cursed, and his home is cursed as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa aape nadar kare prabh sachaa taa hovai daasan daas ||
english: When God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, then one becomes the slave of His slaves.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਪਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: taa anadin sevaa kare satiguroo kee kabahi na chhodai paas ||
english: And then, night and day, he serves the True Guru, and never leaves His side.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਉ ਵਿਚੇ ਗਿਰਹ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu jal mahi kamal alipato varatai tiu viche girah udaas ||
english: As the lotus flower floats unaffected in the water, so does he remain detached in his own household.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak kare karaaiaa sabh ko jiu bhaavai tiv har gunataas ||2||
english: O servant Nanak, the Lord acts, and inspires everyone to act, according to the Pleasure of His Will. He is the treasure of virtue. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਛਤੀਹ ਜੁਗ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਸਾ ਆਪੇ ਗਣਤ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: chhateeh jug gubaar saa aape ganat keenee ||
english: For thirty-six ages, there was utter darkness. Then, the Lord revealed Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: aape srisat sabh saajeean aap mat deenee ||
english: He Himself created the entire universe. He Himself blessed it with understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਾਜਿਅਨੁ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: simrit saasat saajian paap pu(n)n ganat ganeenee ||
english: He created the Simritees and the Shaastras; He calculates the accounts of virtue and vice.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jis bujhaae so bujhasee sachai sabad pateenee ||
english: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand and to be pleased with the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sabh aape aap varatadaa aape bakhas milaaee ||7||
english: He Himself is all-pervading; He Himself forgives, and unites with Himself. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੋ ਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਰਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੰਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu tan sabho rat hai rat bin ta(n)n na hoi ||
english: This body is all blood; without blood, the body cannot exist.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਹਿ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਣੈ ਤਿਨ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo sahi rate aapanai tin tan lobh rat na hoi ||
english: Those who are attuned to their Lord - their bodies are not filled with the blood of greed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhai paiai tan kheen hoi lobh rat vichahu jaai ||
english: In the Fear of God, the body becomes thin, and the blood of greed passes out of the body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jiu baisa(n)tar dhaat sudh hoi tiu har kaa bhau duramat mail gavaai ||
english: As fire purifies metal, so does the Fear of the Lord eradicate the filth of evil-mindedness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak te jan sohane jo rate har ra(n)g laai ||1||
english: O Nanak, beautiful are those humble beings, who are imbued with the Lord's Love. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਬਨਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee raam man vasiaa taa baniaa seegaar ||
english: In Raamkalee, I have enshrined the Lord in my mind; thus I have been embellished.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad kamal bigasiaa taa saupiaa bhagat bha(n)daar ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, my heart-lotus has blossomed forth; the Lord blessed me with the treasure of devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਾ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bharam gaiaa taa jaagiaa chookaa agiaan a(n)dhaar ||
english: My doubt was dispelled, and I woke up; the darkness of ignorance was dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਲਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tis no roop at agalaa jis har naal piaar ||
english: She who is in love with her Lord, is the most infinitely beautiful.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰਵੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ravai pir aapanaa sobhaava(n)tee naar ||
english: Such a beautiful, happy soul-bride enjoys her Husband Lord forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh seegaar na jaananee jaasan janam sabh haar ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know how to decorate themselves; wasting their whole lives, they depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: bin har bhagatee seegaar karahi nit ja(n)mahi hoi khuaar ||
english: Those who decorate themselves without devotional worship to the Lord, are continually reincarnated to suffer.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੈਸਾਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੋਭ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਅਗੈ ਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: saisaarai vich sobh na paainee agai j kare s jaanai karataar ||
english: They do not obtain respect in this world; the Creator Lord alone knows what will happen to them in the world hereafter.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak sachaa ek hai duhu vich hai sa(n)saar ||
english: O Nanak, the True Lord is the One and only; duality exists only in the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚੰਗੈ ਮੰਦੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੋ ਕਰਨਿ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: cha(n)gai ma(n)dai aap laaian so karan j aap karaae karataar ||2||
english: He Himself enjoins them to good and bad; they do only that which the Creator Lord causes them to do. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve saa(n)t na aavaee doojee naahee jaai ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, tranquility is not obtained. It cannot be found anywhere else.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: je bahuteraa locheeai vin karamaa paaiaa na jaai ||
english: No matter how much one may long for it, without the karma of good actions, it cannot be found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar lobh vikaar hai doojai bhaai khuaai ||
english: Those whose inner beings are filled with greed and corruption, are ruined through the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tin ja(n)man maran na chukaee haumai vich dukh paai ||
english: The cycle of birth and death is not ended, and filled with egotism, they suffer in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee satigur siu chit laaiaa so khaalee koee naahi ||
english: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru, do not remain unfulfilled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tin jam kee talab na hovaee naa oi dukh sahaahi ||
english: They are not summoned by the Messenger of Death, and they do not suffer in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh ubare sachai sabad samaahi ||3||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is saved, merging in the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aap alipat sadaa rahai hor dha(n)dhai sabh dhaavahi ||
english: He Himself remains unattached forever; all others run after worldly affairs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਚਲੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aap nihachal achal hai hor aavahi jaavahi ||
english: He Himself is eternal, unchanging and unmoving; the others continue coming and going in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa har dhiaaeeai guramukh sukh paavahi ||
english: Meditating on the Lord forever and ever, the Gurmukh finds peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa paaeeai sach siphat samaavahi ||
english: He dwells in the home of his own inner being, absorbed in the Praise of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: sachaa gahir ga(n)bheer hai gur sabad bujhaaee ||8||
english: The True Lord is profound and unfathomable; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is understood. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
transliteration: sachaa naam dhiaai too sabho varatai sach ||
english: Meditate on the True Name; the True Lord is all-pervading.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੋ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak hukamai jo bujhai so phal paae sach ||
english: O Nanak, one who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, obtains the fruit of Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
transliteration: kathanee badanee karataa phirai hukam na boojhai sach ||
english: One who merely mouths the words, does not understand the Hukam of the True Lord's Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak har kaa bhaanaa ma(n)ne so bhagat hoi vin ma(n)ne kach nikach ||1||
english: O Nanak, one who accepts the Will of the Lord is His devotee. Without accepting it, he is the falsest of the false. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bol na jaananee onaa a(n)dar kaam krodh aha(n)kaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know what they are saying. They are filled with sexual desire, anger and egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਥਾਉ ਕੁਥਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਉਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: oi thaau kuthaau na jaananee un a(n)tar lobh vikaar ||
english: They do not understand right places and wrong places; they are filled with greed and corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਆਇ ਬਹਿ ਗਲਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: oi aapanai suaai aai bahi galaa karahi onaa maare jam ja(n)daar ||
english: They come, and sit and talk for their own purposes. The Messenger of Death strikes them down.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਮਾਰਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: agai daragah lekhai ma(n)giai maar khuaar keechahi kooRiaar ||
english: Hereafter, they are called to account in the Court of the Lord; the false ones are struck down and humiliated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਉਤਰੈ ਕੋਈ ਕਢਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: eh kooRai kee mal kiu utarai koee kadhahu ihu veechaar ||
english: How can this filth of falsehood be washed off? Can anyone think about this, and find the way?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਏ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai taa naam diRaae sabh kilavikh katanahaar ||
english: If one meets with the True Guru, He implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord within; all his sins are destroyed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naam jape naamo aaraadhe tis jan kau karahu sabh namasakaar ||
english: Let all bow in humility to that humble being who chants the Naam, and worships the Naam in adoration.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਲੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਤਾਰੀਅਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mal kooRee naam utaareean jap naam hoaa sachiaar ||
english: The Naam washes off the filth of falsehood; chanting the Naam, one becomes truthful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਏਹਿ ਚਲਤ ਹਹਿ ਸੋ ਜੀਵਉ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak jis de ehi chalat hahi so jeevau devanahaar ||2||
english: O servant Nanak, wondrous are the plays of the Lord, the Giver of life. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: tudh jevad daataa naahi kis aakh sunaaeeai ||
english: You are the Great Giver; no other is as great as You. Unto whom should I speak and talk?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee paai jithahu haumai jaaeeai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I find You; You eradicate egotism from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਾਦਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: ras kas saadaa baaharaa sachee vadiaaeeai ||
english: You are beyond sweet and salty flavors; True is Your glorious greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jis no bakhase tis dei aap lae milaaeeai ||
english: You bless those whom You forgive, and unite them with Yourself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਪਿਆਈ ॥੯॥
transliteration: ghat a(n)tar a(n)mrit rakhion guramukh kisai piaaee ||9||
english: You have placed the Ambrosial Nectar deep within the heart; the Gurmukh drinks it in. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾਣੀਆ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਪੁਤ ਸਪੁਤ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: baabaaneeaa kahaaneeaa put saput karen ||
english: The stories of one's ancestors make the children good children.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: j satigur bhaavai s ma(n)n lain seee karam karen ||
english: They accept what is pleasing to the Will of the True Guru, and act accordingly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬਿਆਸ ਸੁਕ ਨਾਰਦ ਬਚਨ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: jaai puchhahu simrit saasat biaas suk naarad bachan sabh srisat karen ||
english: Go and consult the Simritees, the Shaastras, the writings of Vyaas, Suk Dayv, Naarad, and all those who preach to the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: sachai laae sach lage sadaa sach samaalen ||
english: Those, whom the True Lord attaches, are attached to the Truth; they contemplate the True Name forever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਏ ਜਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak aae se paravaan bhae j sagale kul taaren ||1||
english: O Nanak, their coming into the world is approved; they redeem all their ancestors. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਸਿਖ ਭੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: guroo jinaa kaa a(n)dhulaa sikh bhee a(n)dhe karam karen ||
english: The disciples whose teacher is blind, act blindly as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲਨਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਠੋ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: oi bhaanai chalan aapanai nit jhootho jhooth bolen ||
english: They walk according to their own wills, and continually speak falsehood and lies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: kooR kusat kamaavade par ni(n)daa sadaa karen ||
english: They practice falsehood and deception, and endlessly slander others.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੇਨਿ ॥
transliteration: oi aap dube par ni(n)dakaa sagale kul doben ||
english: Slandering others, they drown themselves, and drown all their generations as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਓਇ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੇ ਉਇ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jit oi laae tit lage ui bapuRe kiaa karen ||2||
english: O Nanak, whatever the Lord links them to, to that they are linked; what can the poor creatures do? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਦਾ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਕੀਤੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh nadaree a(n)dar rakhadaa jetee sisat sabh keetee ||
english: He keeps all under His Gaze; He created the entire Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੁਸਤਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਿਗੂਤੀ ॥
transliteration: ik kooR kusat laaian manamukh vigootee ||
english: He has linked some to falsehood and deception; these self-willed manmukhs are plundered.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sadaa dhiaaeeai a(n)dar har preetee ||
english: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Lord forever; their inner beings are filled with love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਵਾਤਿ ਸਿਪੀਤੀ ॥
transliteration: jin kau potai pu(n)n hai tinh vaat sipeetee ||
english: Those who have the treasure of virtue, chant the Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeeai sach siphat sanaaee ||10||
english: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, and the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਤੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: satee paap kar sat kamaahi ||
english: Men of charity gather wealth by committing sins, and then give it away in donations to charity.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਦੇਵਣ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur deekhiaa ghar devan jaahi ||
english: Their spiritual teachers go to their homes to instruct them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸਤਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਖਟਿਐ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: isataree purakhai khatiai bhaau ||
english: The woman loves the man only for his wealth;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਵੈ ਆਵਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaavai aavau bhaavai jaau ||
english: they come and go as they please.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saasat bed na maanai koi ||
english: No one obeys the Shaastras or the Vedas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੋ ਆਪੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aapo aapai poojaa hoi ||
english: Everyone worships himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਬਹੈ ਨਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: kaajee hoi kai bahai niaai ||
english: Becoming judges, they sit and administer justice.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫੇਰੇ ਤਸਬੀ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
transliteration: phere tasabee kare khudaai ||
english: They chant on their malas, and call upon God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਢੀ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਹਕੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: vadhee lai kai hak gavaae ||
english: They accept bribes, and block justice.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਪੁਛੈ ਤਾ ਪੜਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: je ko puchhai taa paR sunaae ||
english: If someone asks them, they read quotations from their books.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਰਕ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: turak ma(n)tr kan ridai samaahi ||
english: The Muslim scriptures are in their ears and in their hearts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਮੁਹਾਵਹਿ ਚਾੜੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: lok muhaavahi chaaRee khaahi ||
english: They plunder the people, and engage in gossip and flattery.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਕਾ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਸੁਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: chaukaa de kai suchaa hoi ||
english: They anoint their kitchens to try to become pure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa hi(n)doo vekhahu koi ||
english: Behold, such is the Hindu.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜਟਾ ਬਿਭੂਤ ॥
transliteration: jogee girahee jataa bibhoot ||
english: The Yogi, with matted hair and ashes on his body, has become a householder.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪੂਤ ॥
transliteration: aagai paachhai rovahi poot ||
english: The children weep in front of him and behind him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jog na paaiaa jugat gavaaee ||
english: He does not attain Yoga - he has lost his way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kit kaaran sir chhaaee paaee ||
english: Why does he apply ashes to his forehead?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਲਿ ਕਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak kal kaa ehu paravaan ||
english: O Nanak, this is the sign of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape aakhan aape jaan ||1||
english: everyone says that he himself knows. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hi(n)doo kai ghar hi(n)doo aavai ||
english: The Hindu comes to the house of a Hindu.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਤੁ ਜਨੇਊ ਪੜਿ ਗਲਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: soot janeoo paR gal paavai ||
english: He puts the sacred thread around his neck and reads the scriptures.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਤੁ ਪਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: soot paai kare buriaaee ||
english: He puts on the thread, but does evil deeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਤਾ ਧੋਤਾ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naataa dhotaa thaai na paaee ||
english: His cleansings and washings will not be approved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: musalamaan kare vadiaaee ||
english: The Muslim glorifies his own faith.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰੈ ਕੋ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: vin gur peerai ko thaai na paaee ||
english: Without the Guru or a spiritual teacher, no one is accepted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਹੁ ਦਸਾਇ ਓਥੈ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: raahu dasaai othai ko jaai ||
english: They may be shown the way, but only a few go there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: karanee baajhahu bhisat na paai ||
english: Without the karma of good actions, heaven is not attained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਦਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jogee kai ghar jugat dasaaee ||
english: The Way of Yoga is demonstrated in the Yogi's monastery.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕਨਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tit kaaran kan mu(n)draa paaee ||
english: They wear ear-rings to show the way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਪਾਇ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)draa paai phirai sa(n)saar ||
english: Wearing ear-rings, they wander around the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਕਿਥੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jithai kithai sirajanahaar ||
english: The Creator Lord is everywhere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਤੇ ਵਾਟਾਊ ॥
transliteration: jete jee tete vaataaoo ||
english: There are as many travellers as there are beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੀਰੀ ਆਈ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਕਾਊ ॥
transliteration: cheeree aaee dhil na kaaoo ||
english: When one's death warrant is issued, there is no delay.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਥੈ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: ethai jaanai s jaai sinjaanai ||
english: One who knows the Lord here, realizes Him there as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਫਕੜੁ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: hor phakaR hi(n)doo musalamaanai ||
english: Others, whether Hindu or Muslim, are just babbling.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa kaa dar lekhaa hoi ||
english: Everyone's account is read in the Court of the Lord;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਤਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: karanee baajhahu tarai na koi ||
english: without the karma of good actions, no one crosses over.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sacho sach vakhaanai koi ||
english: One who speaks the True Name of the True Lord,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗੈ ਪੁਛ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak agai puchh na hoi ||2||
english: O Nanak, is not called to account hereafter. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਗੜੁ ॥
transliteration: har kaa ma(n)dar aakheeai kaaiaa kot gaR ||
english: The fortress of the body is called the Mansion of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar laal javeharee guramukh har naam paR ||
english: The rubies and gems are found within it; the Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜੁ ॥
transliteration: har kaa ma(n)dar sareer at sohanaa har har naam diR ||
english: The body, the Mansion of the Lord, is very beautiful, when the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is implanted deep within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਤ ਕੜੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh aap khuaaian maaiaa moh nit kaR ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs ruin themselves; they boil continuously in attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: sabhanaa saahib ek hai poorai bhaag paaiaa jaaee ||11||
english: The One Lord is the Master of all. He is found only by perfect destiny. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਜੰਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naa sat dukheeaa naa sat sukheeaa naa sat paanee ja(n)t phirahi ||
english: There is no Truth in suffering, there is no Truth in comfort. There is no Truth in wandering like animals through the water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਮੂੰਡ ਮੁਡਾਈ ਕੇਸੀ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਪੜਿਆ ਦੇਸ ਫਿਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naa sat moo(n)d mudaaee kesee naa sat paRiaa des phirahi ||
english: There is no Truth in shaving one's head; there is no Truth is studying the scriptures or wandering in foreign lands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਰੁਖੀ ਬਿਰਖੀ ਪਥਰ ਆਪੁ ਤਛਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naa sat rukhee birakhee pathar aap tachhaavahi dukh sahahi ||
english: There is no Truth in trees, plants or stones, in mutilating oneself or suffering in pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਹਸਤੀ ਬਧੇ ਸੰਗਲ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਗਾਈ ਘਾਹੁ ਚਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naa sat hasatee badhe sa(n)gal naa sat gaaee ghaahu charahi ||
english: There is no Truth in binding elephants in chains; there is no Truth in grazing cows.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਜੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
transliteration: jis hath sidh devai je soee jis no dei tis aai milai ||
english: He alone grants it, whose hands hold spritual perfection; he alone receives it, unto whom it is given.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naanak taa kau milai vadaaee jis ghat bheetar sabad ravai ||
english: O Nanak, he alone is blessed with glorious greatness, whose heart is filled with the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਉ ਸਭਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਖੁਆਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh ghat mere hau sabhanaa a(n)dar jisahi khuaaee tis kaun kahai ||
english: God says, all hearts are mine, and I am in all hearts. Who can explain this to one who is confused?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਾ ਵਾਟੜੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jisahi dikhaalaa vaataRee tisahi bhulaavai kaun ||
english: Who can confuse that being, unto whom I have shown the Way?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਪੰਧ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jisahi bhulaaee pa(n)dh sir tisahi dikhaavai kaun ||1||
english: And who can show the Path to that being whom I have confused since the beginning of time? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜੋ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so girahee jo nigrahu karai ||
english: He alone is a householder, who restrains his passions

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam bheekhiaa karai ||
english: and begs for meditation, austerity and self-discipline.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pu(n)n daan kaa kare sareer ||
english: He gives donations to charity with his body;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਗੰਗਾ ਕਾ ਨੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: so girahee ga(n)gaa kaa neer ||
english: such a householder is as pure as the water of the Ganges.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲੈ ਈਸਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: bolai eesar sat saroop ||
english: Says Eeshar, the Lord is the embodiment of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: param ta(n)t mahi rekh na roop ||2||
english: The supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਅਉਧੂਤੀ ਜੋ ਧੂਪੈ ਆਪੁ ॥
transliteration: so audhootee jo dhoopai aap ||
english: He alone is a detached hermit, who burns away his self-conceit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
transliteration: bhikhiaa bhojan karai sa(n)taap ||
english: He begs for suffering as his food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਉਹਠ ਪਟਣ ਮਹਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: auhath patan mahi bheekhiaa karai ||
english: In the city of the heart, he begs for charity.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਅਉਧੂਤੀ ਸਿਵ ਪੁਰਿ ਚੜੈ ॥
transliteration: so audhootee siv pur chaRai ||
english: Such a renunciate ascends to the City of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲੈ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: bolai gorakh sat saroop ||
english: Says Gorakh, God is the embodiment of Truth;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: param ta(n)t mahi rekh na roop ||3||
english: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਜਿ ਪਾਲੇ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: so udaasee j paale udaas ||
english: He alone is an Udasi, a shaven-headed renunciate, who embraces renunciation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: aradh uradh kare nira(n)jan vaas ||
english: He sees the Immaculate Lord dwelling in both the upper and lower regions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੀ ਪਾਏ ਗੰਢਿ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)d sooraj kee paae ga(n)dh ||
english: He balances the sun and the moon energies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕਾ ਪੜੈ ਨ ਕੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: tis udaasee kaa paRai na ka(n)dh ||
english: The body-wall of such an Udasi does not collapse.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲੈ ਗੋਪੀ ਚੰਦੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: bolai gopee cha(n)d sat saroop ||
english: Says Gopi Chand, God is the embodiment of Truth;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: param ta(n)t mahi rekh na roop ||4||
english: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਜਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਖਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: so paakha(n)dee j kaaiaa pakhaale ||
english: He alone is a Paakhandi, who cleanses his body of filth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਜਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kee agan braham parajaale ||
english: The fire of his body illuminates God within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਝਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: supanai bi(n)d na deee jharanaa ||
english: He does not waste his energy in wet dreams.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਜਰਾ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: tis paakha(n)dee jaraa na maranaa ||
english: Such a Paakhandi does not grow old or die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲੈ ਚਰਪਟੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: bolai charapat sat saroop ||
english: Says Charpat, God is the embodiment of Truth;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: param ta(n)t mahi rekh na roop ||5||
english: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਉਲਟੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
transliteration: so bairaagee j ulate braham ||
english: He alone is a Bairaagi, who turns himself toward God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਗਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਪੈ ਥੰਮੁ ॥
transliteration: gagan ma(n)dal mahi ropai tha(n)m ||
english: In the Tenth Gate, the sky of the mind, he erects his pillar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਧਿਆਨਿ ॥
transliteration: ahinis a(n)tar rahai dhiaan ||
english: Night and day, he remains in deep inner meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਤ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: te bairaagee sat samaan ||
english: Such a Bairaagi is just like the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲੈ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: bolai bharathar sat saroop ||
english: Says Bhart'har, God is the embodiment of Truth;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: param ta(n)t mahi rekh na roop ||6||
english: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਮਰੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵੈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
transliteration: kiu marai ma(n)daa kiu jeevai jugat ||
english: How is evil eradicated? How can the true way of life be found?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੰਨ ਪੜਾਇ ਕਿਆ ਖਾਜੈ ਭੁਗਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)n paRaai kiaa khaajai bhugat ||
english: What is the use of piercing the ears, or begging for food?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਤਿ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aasat naasat eko naau ||
english: Throughout existence and non-existence, there is only the Name of the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਹਿਆਉ ॥
transliteration: kaun s akhar jit rahai hiaau ||
english: What is that Word, which holds the heart in its place?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੂਪ ਛਾਵ ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
transliteration: dhoop chhaav je sam kar sahai ||
english: When you look alike upon sunshine and shade,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ॥
transliteration: taa naanak aakhai gur ko kahai ||
english: says Nanak, then the Guru will speak to you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਵਰਤਾਰੇ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਪੂਤ ॥
transliteration: chhi varataare varatahi poot ||
english: The students follow the six systems.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਨਾ ਅਉਧੂਤ ॥
transliteration: naa sa(n)saaree naa audhoot ||
english: They are neither worldly people, nor detached renunciates.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: nira(n)kaar jo rahai samaai ||
english: One who remains absorbed in the Formless Lord

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kaahe bheekhiaa ma(n)gan jaai ||7||
english: - why should he go out begging? ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har ma(n)dar soee aakheeai jithahu har jaataa ||
english: That alone is said to be the Lord's temple, where the Lord is known.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: maanas deh gur bachanee paaiaa sabh aatam raam pachhaataa ||
english: In the human body, the Guru's Word is found, when one understands that the Lord, the Supreme Soul, is in all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਖੋਜੀਐ ਘਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: baahar mool na khojeeai ghar maahi bidhaataa ||
english: Don't look for Him outside your self. The Creator, the Architect of Destiny, is within the home of your own heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh har ma(n)dar kee saar na jaananee tinee janam gavaataa ||
english: The self-willed manmukh does not appreciate the value of the Lord's temple; they waste away and lose their lives.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: sabh mahi ik varatadaa gurasabadee paaiaa jaaee ||12||
english: The One Lord is pervading in all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He can be found. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਹਣਾ ॥
transliteration: moorakh hovai so sunai moorakh kaa kahanaa ||
english: Only a fool listens to the words of the fool.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਕੇ ਕਿਆ ਲਖਣ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: moorakh ke kiaa lakhan hai kiaa moorakh kaa karanaa ||
english: What are the signs of the fool? What does the fool do?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਓਹੁ ਜਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੇ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: moorakh ohu j mugadh hai aha(n)kaare maranaa ||
english: A fool is stupid; he dies of egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਤੁ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
transliteration: et kamaanai sadaa dukh dukh hee mahi rahanaa ||
english: His actions always bring him pain; he lives in pain.

author: Guru Nanak
