gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪਵੈ ਖੂਹਿ ਕਿਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: at piaaraa pavai khoohi kihu sa(n)jam karanaa ||
english: If someone's beloved friend falls into the pit, what can be used to pull him out?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਓਸੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hoi s kare veechaar os alipato rahanaa ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh contemplates the Lord, and remains detached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਭੀ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: har naam japai aap udharai os pichhai dubade bhee taranaa ||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name, he saves himself, and he carries across those who are drowning as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਸਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaavai so kare jo dei s sahanaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, he acts in accordance with the Will of God; he endures whatever he is given. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਿਖ ਸਹੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak aakhai re manaa suneeai sikh sahee ||
english: Says Nanak, listen, O mind, to the True Teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਰਬੁ ਮੰਗੇਸੀਆ ਬੈਠਾ ਕਢਿ ਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: lekhaa rab ma(n)geseeaa baithaa kadh vahee ||
english: Opening His ledger, God will call you to account.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਲਬਾ ਪਉਸਨਿ ਆਕੀਆ ਬਾਕੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਰਹੀ ॥
transliteration: talabaa pausan aakeeaa baakee jinaa rahee ||
english: Those rebels who have unpaid accounts shall be called out.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਫਰੇਸਤਾ ਹੋਸੀ ਆਇ ਤਈ ॥
transliteration: ajaraaeel pharesataa hosee aai taee ||
english: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, shall be appointed to punish them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਭੀੜੀ ਗਲੀ ਫਹੀ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaan na sujhaee bheeRee galee phahee ||
english: They will find no way to escape coming and going in reincarnation; they are trapped in the narrow path.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜ ਨਿਖੁਟੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਓੜਕਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kooR nikhute naanakaa oRak sach rahee ||2||
english: Falsehood will come to an end, O Nanak, and Truth will prevail in the end. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa sabh sareer hai har rav rahiaa sabh aapai ||
english: The body and everything belongs to the Lord; the Lord Himself is all-pervading.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: har kee keemat naa pavai kichh kahan na jaapai ||
english: The Lord's value cannot be estimated; nothing can be said about it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee saalaaheeai har bhagatee raapai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one praises the Lord, imbued with feelings of devotion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਗਵਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh man tan hariaa hoiaa aha(n)kaar gavaapai ||
english: The mind and body are totally rejuvenated, and egotism is eradicated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: sabh kichh har kaa khel hai guramukh kisai bujhaaee ||13||
english: Everything is the play of the Lord. The Gurmukh understands this. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹੰਸਰ ਦਾਨ ਦੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਰੋਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saha(n)sar daan de i(n)dr roaaiaa ||
english: Branded with a thousand marks of disgrace, Indra cried in shame.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਸ ਰਾਮੁ ਰੋਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paras raam rovai ghar aaiaa ||
english: Paras Raam returned home crying.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਰੋਵੈ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ajai s rovai bheekhiaa khaai ||
english: Ajai cried and wept, when he was made to eat the manure he had given, pretending it was charity.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aisee daragah milai sajaai ||
english: Such is the punishment received in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਿਕਾਲਾ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: rovai raam nikaalaa bhaiaa ||
english: Rama wept when he was sent into exile,

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਾ ਲਖਮਣੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: seetaa lakhaman vichhuR gaiaa ||
english: and separated from Sita and Lakhshman.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵੈ ਦਹਸਿਰੁ ਲੰਕ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: rovai dahasir la(n)k gavaai ||
english: The ten-headed Raawan, who stole away Sita with the beat of his tambourine,

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੀਤਾ ਆਦੀ ਡਉਰੂ ਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jin seetaa aadee dauroo vaai ||
english: Wept when he lost Sri Lanka.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਾਂਡਵ ਭਏ ਮਜੂਰ ॥
transliteration: rovahi paa(n)dav bhae majoor ||
english: The Paandavas once lived in the Presence of the Lord;

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਹਤ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jin kai suaamee rahat hadoor ||
english: They were made slaves, and wept.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵੈ ਜਨਮੇਜਾ ਖੁਇ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: rovai janamejaa khui gaiaa ||
english: Janmayjaa wept, that he had lost his way.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਏਕੀ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਪੀ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ekee kaaran paapee bhaiaa ||
english: One mistake, and he became a sinner.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਪੀਰ ॥
transliteration: rovahi sekh masaaik peer ||
english: The Shaykhs, Pirs and spiritual teachers weep;

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਮਤੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਭੀੜ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal mat laagai bheeR ||
english: at the very last instant, they suffer in agony.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੰਨ ਪੜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: rovahi raaje ka(n)n paRaai ||
english: The kings weep - their ears are cut;

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ghar ghar maagahi bheekhiaa jaai ||
english: they go begging from house to house.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: rovahi kirapan sa(n)chahi dhan jaai ||
english: The miser weeps; he has to leave behind the wealth he has gathered.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit rovahi giaan gavaai ||
english: The Pandit, the religious scholar, weeps when his learning is gone.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: baalee rovai naahi bhataar ||
english: The young woman weeps because she has no husband.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak dukheeaa sabh sa(n)saar ||
english: O Nanak, the whole world is suffering.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)ne naau soee jin jaai ||
english: He alone is victorious, who believes in the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਅਉਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: auree karam na lekhai laai ||1||
english: No other action is of any account. ||1||

author: Guru Angad
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ਸਭਿ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sabh kichh ma(n)niai avar kaaraa sabh baad ||
english: Meditation, austerity and everything come through belief in the Lord's Name. All other actions are useless.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak ma(n)niaa ma(n)neeai bujheeai gur parasaad ||2||
english: O Nanak, believe in the One who is worth believing in. By Guru's Grace, he is realized. ||2||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa ha(n)s dhur mel karatai likh paaiaa ||
english: The union of the body and the soul-swan was pre-ordained by the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi gupat varatadaa guramukh pragataaiaa ||
english: He is hidden, and yet pervading all. He is revealed to the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavai gun ucharai gun maahi samaaiaa ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and chanting His Praises, one merges in His Glories.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sachee baanee sach hai sach mel milaaiaa ||
english: True is the True Word of the Guru's Bani. One unites in Union with the True Lord.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap hai aape dei vadiaaee ||14||
english: He Himself is everything; He Himself grants glorious greatness. ||14||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਰਤਨਾ ਪਰਖਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak a(n)dhaa hoi kai ratanaa parakhan jaai ||
english: O Nanak, the blind man may go to appraise the jewels,

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਆਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ratanaa saar na jaanaee aavai aap lakhaai ||1||
english: but he will not know their value; he will return home after exposing his ignorance. ||1||

author: Guru Angad
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨਾ ਕੇਰੀ ਗੁਥਲੀ ਰਤਨੀ ਖੋਲੀ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: ratanaa keree guthalee ratanee kholee aai ||
english: The Jeweller has come, and opened up the bag of jewels.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਵਖਰ ਤੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਦੁਹਾ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vakhar tai vanajaariaa duhaa rahee samaai ||
english: The merchandise and the merchant are merged together.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣੁ ਪਲੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਾਣਕ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
transliteration: jin gun palai naanakaa maanak vanajahi sei ||
english: They alone purchase the gem, O Nanak, who have virtue in their purse.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਵਤਹਿ ਲੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ratanaa saar na jaananee a(n)dhe vatahi loi ||2||
english: Those who do not appreciate the value of the jewels, wander like blind men in the world. ||2||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ ਦਸਵੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਖੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: nau daravaaje kaaiaa kot hai dasavai gupat rakheejai ||
english: The fortress of the body has nine gates; the tenth gate is kept hidden.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਨ ਖੁਲਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਖੁਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: bajar kapaat na khulanee gur sabad khuleejai ||
english: The rigid door is not open; only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad can it be opened.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਜਦੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: anahad vaaje dhun vajade gur sabad suneejai ||
english: The unstruck sound current resounds and vibrates there. The Word of the Guru's Shabad is heard.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: tit ghat a(n)tar chaananaa kar bhagat mileejai ||
english: Deep within the nucleus of the heart, the Divine Light shines forth. Through devotional worship, one meets the Lord.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨ ਰਚਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: sabh mahi ek varatadaa jin aape rachan rachaaee ||15||
english: The One Lord is pervading and permeating all. He Himself created the creation. ||15||

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਕੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਦਸਿਐ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe kai raahi dasiai a(n)dhaa hoi s jaai ||
english: He is truly blind, who follows the way shown by the blind man.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hoi sujaakhaa naanakaa so kiu ujhaR paai ||
english: O Nanak, why should the one who can see, get lost?

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੋਇਣ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe ehi na aakheean jin mukh loin naahi ||
english: Do not call them blind, who have no eyes in their face.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਖਸਮਹੁ ਘੁਥੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe seee naanakaa khasamahu ghuthe jaahi ||1||
english: They alone are blind, O Nanak, who wander away from their Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Guru Angad
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਜੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saahib a(n)dhaa jo keeaa kare sujaakhaa hoi ||
english: One whom the Lord has made blind - the Lord can make him see again.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jehaa jaanai teho varatai je sau aakhai koi ||
english: He acts only as he knows, although he may be spoken to a hundred times.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਸੁ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਉ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: jithai s vasat na jaapaee aape varatau jaan ||
english: Where the real thing is not seen, self-conceit prevails there - know this well.

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਏ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak gaahak kiu lae sakai na vasat pachhaan ||2||
english: O Nanak, how can the purshaser purchase the real thing, if he cannot recognize it? ||2||

author: Guru Angad
transliteration: mah 2 ||
english: Second Mehl:

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਧਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਹੁਕਮਹੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: so kiu a(n)dhaa aakheeai j hukamahu a(n)dhaa hoi ||
english: How can someone be called blind, if he was made blind by the Lord's Command?

author: Guru Angad
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak hukam na bujhaee a(n)dhaa kaheeai soi ||3||
english: O Nanak, one who does not understand the Hukam of the Lord's Command should be called blind. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੜੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar gaR kot hai sabh disa(n)tar desaa ||
english: Deep within the body is the fortress of the Lord, and all lands and countries.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aape taaRee laaeean sabh mahi paravesaa ||
english: He Himself sits in primal, profound Samaadhi; He Himself is all-pervading.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਖੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aape srisat saajeean aap gupat rakhesaa ||
english: He Himself created the Universe, and He Himself remains hidden within it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਗਟੀਏਸਾ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te jaaniaa sach paragateeesaa ||
english: Serving the Guru, the Lord is known, and the Truth is revealed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: sabh kichh sacho sach hai gur sojhee paaee ||16||
english: He is True, the Truest of the True; the Guru has imparted this understanding. ||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਅਹਾੜੁ ਦਿਹੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਖੇਤ ॥
transliteration: saavan raat ahaaR dihu kaam krodh dui khet ||
english: Night is the summer season, and day is the winter season; sexual desire and anger are the two fields planted.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਦਰੋਗੁ ਬੀਉ ਹਾਲੀ ਰਾਹਕੁ ਹੇਤ ॥
transliteration: lab vatr darog beeu haalee raahak het ||
english: Greed prepares the soil, and the seed of falsehood is planted; attachment and love are the farmer and hired hand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਲੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਣ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਖਟੇ ਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hal beechaar vikaar man hukamee khate khaai ||
english: Contemplation is the plow, and corruption is the harvest; this is what one earns and eats, according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਅਉਤੁ ਜਣੇਦਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak lekhai ma(n)giai aut janedaa jaai ||1||
english: O Nanak, when one is called to give his account, he will be barren and infertile. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਭੁਇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਬਲੇਦ ॥
transliteration: bhau bhui pavit paanee sat sa(n)tokh baled ||
english: Make the Fear of God the farm, purity the water, truth and contentment the cows and bulls,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਲੁ ਹਲੇਮੀ ਹਾਲੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਚੇਤਾ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਵਖਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: hal halemee haalee chit chetaa vatr vakhat sa(n)jog ||
english: humility the plow, consciousness the plowman, remembrance the preparation of the soil, and union with the Lord the planting time.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਬੋਹਲ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਦਰੋਗ ॥
transliteration: naau beej bakhasees bohal duneeaa sagal darog ||
english: Let the Lord's Name be the seed, and His Forgiving Grace the harvest. Do this, and the whole world will seem false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree karam hoi jaavahi sagal vijog ||2||
english: O Nanak, if He bestows His Merciful Glance of Grace, then all your separation will be ended. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh mohu gubaar hai doojai bhaai bolai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is trapped in the darkness of emotional attachment; in the love of duality he speaks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai sadaa dukh hai nit neer virolai ||
english: The love of duality brings pain forever; he churns the water endlessly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaaeeai math tat kadholai ||
english: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he churns, and obtains the essence of reality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਧਾ ਟੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar paragaas ghat chaananaa har ladhaa tolai ||
english: The Divine Light illuminates his heart deep within; he seeks the Lord, and obtains Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: aape bharam bhulaaidaa kichh kahan na jaaee ||17||
english: He Himself deludes in doubt; no one can comment on this. ||17||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak chi(n)taa mat karahu chi(n)taa tis hee hei ||
english: O Nanak, don't be anxious; the Lord will take care of you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਰੋਜੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: jal mahi ja(n)t upaaian tinaa bh rojee dei ||
english: He created the creatures in water, and He gives them their nourishment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਹਟੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਰਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: othai hat na chalaee naa ko kiras karei ||
english: There are no stores open there, and no one farms there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਉਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: saudaa mool na hovaee naa ko lae na dei ||
english: No business is ever transacted there, and no one buys or sells.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਅ ਖਾਣਾ ਏਹੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: jeeaa kaa aahaar jee khaanaa ehu karei ||
english: Animals eat other animals; this is what the Lord has given them as food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਸਾਇਰਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: vich upaae saairaa tinaa bh saar karei ||
english: He created them in the oceans, and He provides for them as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak chi(n)taa mat karahu chi(n)taa tis hee hei ||1||
english: O Nanak, don't be anxious; the Lord will take care of you. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਝੀਵਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak ihu jeeu machhulee jheevar trisanaa kaal ||
english: O Nanak, this soul is the fish, and death is the hungry fisherman.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਪੜੈ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: manooaa a(n)dh na chetaee paRai achi(n)taa jaal ||
english: The blind man does not even think of this. And suddenly, the net is cast.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak chit achet hai chi(n)taa badhaa jaai ||
english: O Nanak, his consciousness is unconscious, and he departs, bound by anxiety.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nadar kare je aapanee taa aape lae milaai ||2||
english: But if the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then He unites the soul with Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: se jan saache sadaa sadaa jinee har ras peetaa ||
english: They are true, forever true, who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sachaa man vasai sach saudaa keetaa ||
english: The True Lord abides in the mind of the Gurmukh; He strikes the true bargain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਲੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh ghar hee maahi hai vadabhaagee leetaa ||
english: Everything is in the home of the self within; only the very fortunate obtain it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਗਈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar trisanaa mar gaee har gun gaaveetaa ||
english: The hunger within is conquered and overcome, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: aape mel milaaian aape dei bujhaaee ||18||
english: He Himself unites in His Union; He Himself blesses them with understanding. ||18||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਲਿ ਪਿੰਞਾਇਆ ਕਤਿ ਵੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vel pi(n)njaaiaa kat vunaaiaa ||
english: The cotton is ginned, woven and spun;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਟਿ ਕੁਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਖੁੰਬਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kat kut kar khu(n)b chaRaaiaa ||
english: the cloth is laid out, washed and bleached white.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੋਹਾ ਵਢੇ ਦਰਜੀ ਪਾੜੇ ਸੂਈ ਧਾਗਾ ਸੀਵੈ ॥
transliteration: lohaa vadhe darajee paaRe sooee dhaagaa seevai ||
english: The tailor cuts it with his scissors, and sews it with his thread.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਟੀ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸੀਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
transliteration: iu pat paatee siphatee seepai naanak jeevat jeevai ||
english: Thus, the torn and tattered honor is sewn up again, through the Lord's Praise, O Nanak, and one lives the true life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਪਾਟੈ ਸੂਈ ਧਾਗਾ ਗੰਢੈ ॥
transliteration: hoi puraanaa kapaR paatai sooee dhaagaa ga(n)dhai ||
english: Becoming worn, the cloth is torn; with needle and thread it is sewn up again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਹੁ ਪਖੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੰਢੈ ॥
transliteration: maahu pakh kihu chalai naahee ghaRee muhat kichh ha(n)dhai ||
english: It will not last for a month, or even a week. It barely lasts for an hour, or even a moment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੀਤਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਟੈ ॥
transliteration: sach puraanaa hovai naahee seetaa kade na paatai ||
english: But the Truth does not grow old; and when it is stitched, it is never torn again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਜਾਪੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saahib sacho sachaa tichar jaapee jaapai ||1||
english: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is the Truest of the True. While we meditate on Him, we see Him. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਕੀ ਕਾਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sach kee kaatee sach sabh saar ||
english: The knife is Truth, and its steel is totally True.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਾੜਤ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ghaaRat tis kee apar apaar ||
english: Its workmanship is incomparably beautiful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਸਾਣ ਰਖਾਈ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sabade saan rakhaaee laai ||
english: It is sharpened on the grindstone of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਥੇਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gun kee thekai vich samaai ||
english: It is placed in the scabbard of virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਕੁਠਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: tis daa kuthaa hovai sekh ||
english: If the Shaykh is killed with that,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੋਹੂ ਲਬੁ ਨਿਕਥਾ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: lohoo lab nikathaa vekh ||
english: then the blood of greed will spill out.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਲਗੈ ਹਕਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: hoi halaal lagai hak jaai ||
english: One who is slaughtered in this ritualistic way, will be attached to the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਦਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak dar deedaar samaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, at the Lord's door, he is absorbed into His Blessed Vision. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਮਰਿ ਕਟਾਰਾ ਬੰਕੁੜਾ ਬੰਕੇ ਕਾ ਅਸਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kamar kataaraa ba(n)kuRaa ba(n)ke kaa asavaar ||
english: A beautiful dagger hangs by your waist, and you ride such a beautiful horse.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਭਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: garab na keejai naanakaa mat sir aavai bhaar ||3||
english: But don't be too proud; O Nanak, you may fall head first to the ground. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
transliteration: so satasa(n)gat sabad milai jo guramukh chalai ||
english: They alone walk as Gurmukh, who receive the Shabad in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ॥
transliteration: sach dhiaain se sache jin har kharach dhan palai ||
english: Meditating on the True Lord, they become truthful; they carry in their robes the supplies of the Lord's wealth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਦੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਚਲੈ ॥
transliteration: bhagat sohan gun gaavade guramat achalai ||
english: The devotees look beautiful, singing the Praises of the Lord; following the Guru's Teachings, they become stable and unchanging.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਲੈ ॥
transliteration: ratan beechaar man vasiaa gur kai sabad bhalai ||
english: They enshrine the jewel of contemplation within their minds, and the most sublime Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: aape mel milaaidaa aape dei vadiaaee ||19||
english: He Himself unites in His Union; He Himself grants glorious greatness. ||19||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕੋਇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aasaa a(n)dar sabh ko koi niraasaa hoi ||
english: Everyone is filled with hope; hardly anyone is free of hope.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jo mar jeeviaa sahilaa aaiaa soi ||1||
english: O Nanak, blessed is the birth of one, who remains dead while yet alive. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਸਾ ਹਥਿ ਹੈ ਕੇਉ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naa kichh aasaa hath hai keu niraasaa hoi ||
english: Nothing is in the hands of hope. How can one become free of hope?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਏਹ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਜਾਂ ਭੋੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kiaa kare eh bapuRee jaa(n) bhoulaae soi ||2||
english: What can this poor being do? The Lord Himself creates confusion. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ॥
transliteration: dhrig jeevan sa(n)saar sache naam bin ||
english: Cursed is the life in this world, without the True Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh daataa daataar nihachal ehu dhan ||
english: God is the Great Giver of givers. His wealth is permanent and unchanging.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਨੁ ॥
transliteration: saas saas aaraadhe niramal soi jan ||
english: That humble being is immaculate, who worships the Lord with each and every breath.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਅਗਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਏਕੁ ਭਨੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee agam rasanaa ek bhan ||
english: With your tongue, vibrate the One Inaccessible Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: rav rahiaa sarabat naanak bal jaaee ||20||
english: He is all-pervading everywhere. Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||20||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰ ਹੰਸ ਧੁਰੇ ਹੀ ਮੇਲਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: saravar ha(n)s dhure hee melaa khasamai evai bhaanaa ||
english: The union between the lake of the True Guru, and the swan of the soul, was pre-ordained from the very beginning, by the Pleasure of the Lord's Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਮੋਤੀ ਸੋ ਹੰਸਾ ਕਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: saravar a(n)dar heeraa motee so ha(n)saa kaa khaanaa ||
english: The diamonds are in this lake; they are the food of the swans.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਗੁ ਨ ਰਹਈ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
transliteration: bagulaa kaag na rahaee saravar je hovai at siaanaa ||
english: The cranes and the ravens may be very wise, but they do not remain in this lake.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਨ ਪਇਓ ਓਥੈ ਓਨੑਾ ਹੋਰੋ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: onaa rijak na paio othai onhaa horo khaanaa ||
english: They do not find their food there; their food is different.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਸਚੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sach kamaanai sacho paaeeai kooRai kooRaa maanaa ||
english: Practicing Truth, the True Lord is found. False is the pride of the false.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੌ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰੇ ਪੈਯਾ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tin kau satigur miliaa jinaa dhure paiyaa paravaanaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, they alone meet the True Guru, who are so pre-destined by the Lord's Command. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਉਜਲਾ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: saahib meraa ujalaa je ko chit karei ||
english: My Lord and Master is immaculate, as are those who think of Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak soee seveeai sadaa sadaa jo dei ||
english: O Nanak, serve Him, who gives to you forever and ever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak soee seveeai jit seviai dukh jaai ||
english: O Nanak, serve Him; by serving Him, sorrow is dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: avagun va(n)njan gun ravahi man sukh vasai aai ||2||
english: Faults and demerits vanish, and virtues take their place; peace comes to dwell in the mind. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aape aap varatadaa aap taaRee laaeean ||
english: He Himself is all-pervading; He Himself is absorbed in the profound state of Samaadhi.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਉਪਦੇਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਤੀਆਈਅਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aape hee upadesadaa guramukh pateeaaeean ||
english: He Himself instructs; the Gurmukh is satisfied and fulfilled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ॥
transliteration: ik aape ujhaR paaian ik bhagatee laaian ||
english: Some, He causes to wander in the wilderness, while others are committed to His devotional worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jis aap bujhaae so bujhasee aape naai laaeean ||
english: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand; He Himself attaches mortals to His Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeeai sachee vadiaaee ||21||1|| sudh ||
english: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, true greatness is obtained. ||21||1|| Sudh||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee kee vaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Vaar Of Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਣੀਦਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਡੀਠੁ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa satigur suneedaa taiso hee mai deeth ||
english: As I have heard of the True Guru, so I have seen Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਬਸੀਠੁ ॥
transliteration: vichhuRiaa mele prabhoo har daragah kaa baseeth ||
english: He re-unites the separated ones with God; He is the Mediator at the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ਕਟੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: har naamo ma(n)tr driRaaidaa kate haumai rog ||
english: He implants the Mantra of the Lord's Name, and eradicates the illness of egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰੇ ਪਇਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak satigur tinaa milaaiaa jinaa dhure paiaa sa(n)jog ||1||
english: O Nanak, he alone meets the True Guru, who has such union pre-ordained. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਵੈਰੀ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ik sajan sabh sajanaa ik vairee sabh vaad ||
english: If the One Lord is my Friend, then all are my friends. If the One Lord is my enemy, then all fight with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai dekhaaliaa vin naavai sabh baad ||
english: The Perfect Guru has shown me that, without the Name, everything is useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਭਰਮਿਆ ਜੋ ਲਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: saakat durajan bharamiaa jo lage doojai saad ||
english: The faithless cynics and the evil people wander in reincarnation; they are attached to other tastes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak har prabh bujhiaa gur satigur kai parasaad ||2||
english: Servant Nanak has realized the Lord God, by the Grace of the Guru, the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਟਣਹਾਰੈ ਥਾਟੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਥਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: thatanahaarai thaat aape hee thatiaa ||
english: The Creator Lord created the Creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aape pooraa saahu aape hee khatiaa ||
english: He Himself is the perfect Banker; He Himself earns His profit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aape kar paasaar aape ra(n)g ratiaa ||
english: He Himself made the expansive Universe; He Himself is imbued with joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਅਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kudarat keem na paai alakh brahamatiaa ||
english: The value of God's almighty creative power cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: agam athaah bea(n)t parai paratiaa ||
english: He is inaccessible, unfathomable, endless, the farthest of the far.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵਡ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਜੀਰਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aape vad paatisaahu aap vajeeratiaa ||
english: He Himself is the greatest Emperor; He Himself is His own Prime Minister.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੀਮ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਟਿਆ ॥
transliteration: koi na jaanai keem kevad matiaa ||
english: No one knows His worth, or the greatness of His resting place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib aap guramukh paragatiaa ||1||
english: He Himself is our True Lord and Master. He reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਜਣ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: sun sajan preetam meriaa mai satigur dehu dikhaal ||
english: Listen, O my beloved friend: please show me the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: hau tis devaa man aapanaa nit hiradai rakhaa samaal ||
english: I dedicate my mind to Him; I keep Him continually enshrined within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ikas satigur baaharaa dhrig jeevan sa(n)saar ||
english: Without the One and Only True Guru, life in this world is cursed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak satigur tinaa milaaion jin sad hee varatai naal ||1||
english: O servant Nanak, they alone meet the True Guru, with whom He constantly abides. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: merai a(n)tar lochaa milan kee kiu paavaa prabh tohi ||
english: Deep within me is the longing to meet You; how can I find You, God?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
transliteration: koee aisaa sajan loR lahu jo mele preetam mohi ||
english: I will search for someone, some friend, who will unite me with my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai melaaiaa jat dekhaa tat soi ||
english: The Perfect Guru has united me with Him; wherever I look, there He is.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak so prabh seviaa tis jevad avar na koi ||2||
english: Servant Nanak serves that God; there is no other as great as He is. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: devanahaar daataar kit mukh saalaaheeai ||
english: He is the Great Giver, the Generous Lord; with what mouth can I praise Him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਖੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jis rakhai kirapaa dhaar rijak samaaheeai ||
english: In His Mercy, He protects, preserves and sustains us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਵਸਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਇਕ ਧਰ ॥
transliteration: koi na kis hee vas sabhanaa ik dhar ||
english: No one is under anyone else's control; He is the One Support of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਲੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਵਾਗਿ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰ ॥
transliteration: paale baalak vaag de kai aap kar ||
english: He cherishes all as His children, and reaches out with His hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਦਾ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: karadaa anad binod kichhoo na jaaneeai ||
english: He stages His joyous plays, which no one understands at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਧਾਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sarab dhaar samarath hau tis kurabaaneeai ||
english: The all-powerful Lord gives His Support to all; I am a sacrifice to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਾਈਐ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨੰਤੁ ਗਾਵਣ ਜੋਗਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gaaeeai raat dina(n)t gaavan jogiaa ||
english: Night and day, sing the Praises of the One who is worthy of being praised.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ਤਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo gur kee pairee paahi tinee har ras bhogiaa ||2||
english: Those who fall at the Guru's Feet, enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੀੜਹੁ ਮੋਕਲਾਈ ਕੀਤੀਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਰਖੇ ਕੁਟੰਬੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: bheeRahu mokalaaee keeteean sabh rakhe kuta(n)bai naal ||
english: He has widened the narrow path for me, and preserved my integrity, along with that of my family.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸਭਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: kaaraj aap savaarian so prabh sadaa sabhaal ||
english: He Himself has arranged and resolved my affairs. I dwell upon that God forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਲਹੁੜੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh maat pitaa ka(n)th laaidaa lahuRe baalak paal ||
english: God is my mother and father; He hugs me close in His embrace, and cherishes me, like His tiny baby.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: daiaal hoe sabh jee ja(n)tr har naanak nadar nihaal ||1||
english: All beings and creatures have become kind and compassionate to me. O Nanak, the Lord has blessed me with His Glance of Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਿ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੁਖਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਖ ॥
transliteration: vin tudh hor j ma(n)ganaa sir dukhaa kai dukh ||
english: To ask for any other than You, Lord, is the most miserable of miseries.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ॥
transliteration: dehi naam sa(n)tokheeaa utarai man kee bhukh ||
english: Please bless me with Your Name, and make me content; may the hunger of my mind be satisfied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਵਣੁ ਤਿਣੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਤਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਮਨੁਖ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur van tin hariaa keetiaa naanak kiaa manukh ||2||
english: The Guru has made the woods and meadows green again. O Nanak, is it any wonder that He blesses human beings as well? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so aisaa daataar manahu na veesarai ||
english: Such is that Great Giver; may I never forget Him from my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੜੀ ਨ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਚਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾ ਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ghaRee na muhat chasaa tis bin naa sarai ||
english: I cannot survive without Him, for an instant, for a moment, for a second.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਲੁਕਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar sa(n)g kiaa ko luk karai ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, He is with us; how can we hide anything from Him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਤਿ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਸੋ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jis pat rakhai aap so bhavajal tarai ||
english: One whose honor He Himself has preserved, crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: bhagat giaanee tapaa jis kirapaa karai ||
english: He alone is a devotee, a spiritual teacher, and a disciplined pratictioner of meditation, whom the Lord has so blessed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਲੁ ਧਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so pooraa paradhaan jis no bal dharai ||
english: He alone is perfect and renowned as supreme, whom the Lord has blessed with His power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਸੋਈ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jisahi jaraae aap soee ajar jarai ||
english: He alone endures the unendurable, whom the Lord inspires to endure it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਧਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis hee miliaa sach ma(n)tr gur man dharai ||3||
english: And he alone meets the True Lord, within whose mind the Guru's Mantra is implanted. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਰਾਗ ਸੁਰੰਗੜੇ ਆਲਾਪਤ ਸਭ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s raag sura(n)gaRe aalaapat sabh tikh jaai ||
english: Blessed are those beautiful Ragas which, when chanted, quench all thirst.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਜੰਤ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪਦੇ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s ja(n)t suhaavaRe jo guramukh japade naau ||
english: Blessed are those beautiful people who, as Gurmukh, chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jinee ik man ik araadhiaa tin sad balihaarai jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who single-mindedly worship and adore the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਹਮ ਬਾਛਦੇ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tin kee dhooR ham baachhade karamee palai paai ||
english: I yearn for the dust of their feet; by His Grace, it is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo rate ra(n)g govid kai hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who are imbued with love for the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਖਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aakhaa birathaa jee kee har sajan melahu raai ||
english: I tell them the state of my soul, and pray that I may be united with the Sovereign Lord King, my Friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai melaaiaa janam maran dukh jaai ||
english: The Perfect Guru has united me with Him, and the pains of birth and death have departed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak paaiaa agam roop anat na kaahoo jaai ||1||
english: Servant Nanak has found the inaccessible, infinitely beautiful Lord, and he will not go anywhere else. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਘੜੀ ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਪਲੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s velaa ghaRee dha(n)n dhan moorat pal saar ||
english: Blessed is that time, blessed is that hour, blessed is that second, excellent is that instant;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੜਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s dinas sa(n)jogaRaa jit dithaa gur darasaar ||
english: blessed is that day, and that opportunity, when I gazed upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man keeaa ichhaa pooreeaa har paaiaa agam apaar ||
english: The mind's desires are fulfilled, when the inaccessible, unfathomable Lord is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟਾ ਮੋਹੜਾ ਇਕੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: haumai tutaa mohaRaa ik sach naam aadhaar ||
english: Egotism and emotional attachment are eradicated, and one leans only on the Support of the True Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਗਾ ਸੇਵ ਹਰਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak lagaa sev har udhariaa sagal sa(n)saar ||2||
english: O servant Nanak, one who is committed to the Lord's service - the whole world is saved along with him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ॥
transliteration: siphat salaahan bhagat virale diteean ||
english: How rare are those who are blessed to praise the Lord, in devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਉਪੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਪੁਛ ਨ ਲੀਤੀਅਨੁ ॥
transliteration: saupe jis bha(n)daar phir puchh na leeteean ||
english: Those who are blessed with the Lord's treasures are not called to give their account again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jis no lagaa ra(n)g se ra(n)g ratiaa ||
english: Those who are imbued with His Love are absorbed in ecstasy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਇਕਾ ਉਨ ਭਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: onaa iko naam adhaar ikaa un bhatiaa ||
english: They take the Support of the One Name; the One Name is their only food.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਜਗੁ ਭੁੰਚੈ ਭੋਗਈ ॥
transliteration: onaa pichhai jag bhu(n)chai bhogaee ||
english: For their sake, the world eats and enjoys.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਬੁ ਓਨਾਹਾ ਜੋਗਈ ॥
transliteration: onaa piaaraa rab onaahaa jogaee ||
english: Their Beloved Lord belongs to them alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jis miliaa gur aai tin prabh jaaniaa ||
english: The Guru comes and meets them; they alone know God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree tin j khasamai bhaaniaa ||4||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who are pleasing to their Lord and Master. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: har ikasai naal mai dosatee har ikasai naal mai ra(n)g ||
english: My friendship is with the One Lord alone; I am in love with the One Lord alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੋ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: har iko meraa sajano har ikasai naal mai sa(n)g ||
english: The Lord is my only friend; my companionship is with the One Lord alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਗੋਸਟੇ ਮੁਹੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: har ikasai naal mai gosate muhu mailaa karai na bha(n)g ||
english: My conversation is with the One Lord alone; He never frowns, or turns His face away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਮੋੜੈ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jaanai birathaa jee kee kade na moRai ra(n)g ||
english: He alone knows the state of my soul; He never ignores my love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਸਲਤੀ ਭੰਨਣ ਘੜਨ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
transliteration: har iko meraa masalatee bha(n)nan ghaRan samarath ||
english: He is my only counselor, all-powerful to destroy and create.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਤਿਆ ਜਗ ਹਥੁ ॥
transliteration: har iko meraa daataar hai sir daatiaa jag hath ||
english: The Lord is my only Giver. He places His hand upon the heads of the generous in the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
transliteration: har ikasai dee mai tek hai jo sir sabhanaa samarath ||
english: I take the Support of the One Lord alone; He is all-powerful, over the heads of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਥੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur sa(n)t milaaiaa masatak dhar kai hath ||
english: The Saint, the True Guru, has united me with the Lord. He placed His hand on my forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
transliteration: vadaa saahib guroo milaaiaa jin taariaa sagal jagat ||
english: The Guru led me to meet the greatest Lord and Master; He saved the whole world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
transliteration: man keeaa ichhaa pooreeaa paaiaa dhur sa(n)jog ||
english: The desires of the mind are fulfilled; I have attained my pre-destined Union with God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak paaiaa sach naam sad hee bhoge bhog ||1||
english: Nanak has obtained the True Name; He enjoys the enjoyments forever. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukhaa keree dosatee maaiaa kaa sanaba(n)dh ||
english: Friendship with the self-willed manmukhs is an alliance with Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੇਖਦਿਆ ਹੀ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: vekhadiaa hee bhaj jaan kade na paain ba(n)dh ||
english: As we watch, they run away; they never stand firm.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਪੈਨਨਿ ਖਾਵਨੑੇ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਰਖਨਿ ਗੰਢੁ ॥
transliteration: jichar painan khaavanhe tichar rakhan ga(n)dh ||
english: As long as they get food and clothing, they stick around.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਗੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: jit din kichh na hovaee tit din bolan ga(n)dh ||
english: But on that day when they receive nothing, then they start to curse.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: jee kee saar na jaananee manamukh agiaanee a(n)dh ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are ignorant and blind; they do not know the secrets of the soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਚਿਕੜਿ ਪਥਰ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: kooRaa ga(n)dh na chalaee chikaR pathar ba(n)dh ||
english: The false bond does not last; it is like stones joined with mud.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਫਕੜੁ ਪਿਟਨਿ ਧੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe aap na jaananee phakaR pitan dha(n)dh ||
english: The blind do not understand themselves; they are engrossed in false worldly entanglements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹੰਧੁ ॥
transliteration: jhoothai mohi lapataaiaa hau hau karat biha(n)dh ||
english: Entangled in false attachments, they pass their lives in egotism and self-conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: kripaa kare jis aapanee dhur pooraa karam karei ||
english: But that being, whom the Lord has blessed with His Mercy from the very beginning, does perfect deeds, and accumulates good karma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak se jan ubare jo satigur saran pare ||2||
english: O servant Nanak, those humble beings alone are saved, who enter the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਸੇਈ ਸਚੁ ਹਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: jo rate deedaar seee sach haak ||
english: Those who are imbued with the Lord's Vision, speak the Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਭੈ ਤਿਨਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: jinee jaataa khasam kiu labhai tinaa khaak ||
english: How can I obtain the dust of those who realize their Lord and Master?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: man mailaa vekaar hovai sa(n)g paak ||
english: The mind, stained by corruption, becomes pure by associating with them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਸੈ ਸਚਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਲੈ ਭਰਮ ਤਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: disai sachaa mahal khulai bharam taak ||
english: One sees the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, when the door of doubt is opened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਧਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: jisahi dikhaale mahal tis na milai dhaak ||
english: That one, unto whom the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is revealed, is never pushed or shoved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਬਿੰਦਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਝਾਕੁ ॥
transliteration: man tan hoi nihaal bi(n)dak nadar jhaak ||
english: My mind and body are enraptured, when the Lord blesses me, even for an instant, with His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: nau nidh naam nidhaan gur kai sabad laag ||
english: The nine treasures, and the treasure of the Naam are obtained by commitment to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤ ਖਾਕੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: tisai milai sa(n)t khaak masatak jisai bhaag ||5||
english: He alone is blessed with the dust of the feet of the Saints, upon whose forehead such pre-ordained desiny is inscribed. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਣਾਖੀ ਕੂ ਸਚੁ ਵੈਣੁ ਸੁਣਾਈ ਜੋ ਤਉ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ॥
transliteration: haranaakhee koo sach vain sunaaee jo tau kare udhaaran ||
english: O deer-eyed bride, I speak the Truth, which shall save you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਛਬੀਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਤੈਡਾ ਮਨ ਸਾਧਾਰਣੁ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar bachan tum sunahu chhabeelee pir taidaa man saadhaaran ||
english: Listen to these beautiful words, O beauteous bride; your Beloved Lord is your mind's only support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਸੇਤੀ ਨੇਹੁ ਰਚਾਇਓ ਦਸਿ ਵਿਖਾ ਮੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ॥
transliteration: durajan setee nehu rachaaio das vikhaa mai kaaran ||
english: You have fallen in love with an evil person; tell me - show me why!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਣੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਝੂਣੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ॥
transliteration: oonee naahee jhoonee naahee naahee kisai vihoonee ||
english: I lack nothing, and I am not sad or depressed; I have no deficiency at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਛੈਲੁ ਛਬੀਲਾ ਛਡਿ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ॥
transliteration: pir chhail chhabeelaa chhad gavaaio duramat karam vihoonee ||
english: I abandoned and lost my fascinating and beautiful Husband Lord; in this evil-mindedness, I have lost my good fortune.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਭੁਲੀ ਨਾ ਹਉ ਚੁਕੀ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੋਸਾ ॥
transliteration: naa hau bhulee naa hau chukee naa mai naahee dosaa ||
english: I am not mistaken, and I am not confused; I have no egotism, and commit no offense.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਹਉ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਹਉ ਲਗੀ ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jit hau laaee tit hau lagee too sun sach sa(n)desaa ||
english: As You have linked me, so I am linked; listen to my true message.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਈ ਭਾਗਣਿ ਜੈ ਪਿਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saaee souhaagan saaee bhaagan jai pir kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: She alone is the blessed soul-bride, and she alone is fortunate, upon whom the Husband Lord has showered His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ਗਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pir augan tis ke sabh gavaae gal setee laai savaaree ||
english: Her Husband Lord takes away all her faults and mistakes; hugging her close in His embrace, He embellishes her.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਕਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: karamaheen dhan karai bina(n)tee kad naanak aavai vaaree ||
english: The unfortunate soul-bride makes this prayer: O Nanak, when will my turn come?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਇਕ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh suhaagan maanahi raleeaa ik devahu raat muraaree ||1||
english: All the blessed soul-brides celebrate and make merry; bless me as well with a night of bliss, O Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਡੋਲਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kaahe man too dolataa har manasaa pooranahaar ||
english: Why do you waver, O my mind? The Lord is the Fulfiller of hopes and desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh dhiaai too sabh dukh visaaranahaar ||
english: Meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being; He is the Destroyer of all pains.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਮਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: har naamaa aaraadh man sabh kilavikh jaahi vikaar ||
english: Worship and adore the Lord's Name, O my mind; all sins and corruption shall be washed away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin ra(n)g lagaa nira(n)kaar ||
english: Those who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny, are in love with the Formless Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਨੀ ਛਡਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਆਵੜਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: onee chhadiaa maaiaa suaavaRaa dhan sa(n)chiaa naam apaar ||
english: They abandon the tastes of Maya, and gather in the infinite wealth of the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਇਕਤੈ ਲਿਵੈ ਮੰਨੇਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: athe pahar ikatai livai ma(n)nen hukam apaar ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, they are lovingly absorbed in the One Lord; they surrender and accept the Will of the Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak ma(n)gai daan ik dehu daras man piaar ||2||
english: Servant Nanak begs for this one gift: please bless me, Lord, with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; my mind is in love with You. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ॥
transliteration: jis too aavahi chit tis no sadaa sukh ||
english: One who is conscious of You finds everlasting peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮ ਨਾਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
transliteration: jis too aavahi chit tis jam naahi dukh ||
english: One who is conscious of You does not suffer at the hands of the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿ ਕਾੜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jis too aavahi chit tis k kaaRiaa ||
english: One who is conscious of You is not anxious.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jis daa karataa mitr sabh kaaj savaariaa ||
english: One who has the Creator as his Friend - all his affairs are resolved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jis too aavahi chit so paravaan jan ||
english: One who is conscious of You is renowned and respected.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jis too aavahi chit bahutaa tis dhan ||
english: One who is conscious of You becomes very wealthy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੋ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jis too aavahi chit so vad paravaariaa ||
english: One who is conscious of You has a great family.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jis too aavahi chit tin kul udhaariaa ||6||
english: One who is conscious of You saves his ancestors. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਅੰਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਅੰਨਾ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)darahu a(n)naa baaharahu a(n)naa kooRee kooRee gaavai ||
english: Blind inwardly, and blind outwardly, he sings falsely, falsely.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਧੋਵੈ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬਣਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dehee dhovai chakr banaae maaiaa no bahu dhaavai ||
english: He washes his body, and draws ritual marks on it, and totally runs after wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar mail na utarai haumai phir phir aavai jaavai ||
english: But the filth of his egotism is not removed from within, and over and over again, he comes and goes in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਂਦ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਕਾਮਿ ਸੰਤਾਪਿਆ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nee(n)d viaapiaa kaam sa(n)taapiaa mukhahu har har kahaavai ||
english: Engulfed in sleep, and tormented by frustrated sexual desire, he chants the Lord's Name with his mouth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਸਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਮ ਹਉ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਤੁਹ ਕੁਟੇ ਕਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: baisano naam karam hau jugataa tuh kute kiaa phal paavai ||
english: He is called a Vaishnav, but he is bound to deeds of egotism; by threshing only husks, what rewards can be obtained?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਬਗੁ ਨ ਬਣਈ ਨਿਤ ਬੈਠਾ ਮਛੀ ਨੋ ਤਾਰ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)saa vich baithaa bag na banaee nit baithaa machhee no taar laavai ||
english: Sitting among the swans, the crane does not become one of them; sitting there, he keeps staring at the fish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਹੰਸ ਸਭਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਨਿ ਤਾ ਬਗਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੋੜੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa ha(n)s sabhaa veechaar kar dekhan taa bagaa naal joR kade na aavai ||
english: And when the gathering of swans looks and sees, they realize that they can never form an alliance with the crane.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੰਸਾ ਹੀਰਾ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੁਗਣਾ ਬਗੁ ਡਡਾ ਭਾਲਣ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ha(n)saa heeraa motee chuganaa bag dadaa bhaalan jaavai ||
english: The swans peck at the diamonds and pearls, while the crane chases after frogs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਡਰਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਮਤੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੰਞੁ ਲਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: udariaa vechaaraa bagulaa mat hovai ma(n)nj lakhaavai ||
english: The poor crane flies away, so that his secret will not be exposed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਦੋਸੁ ਦਿਚੈ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jit ko laaiaa tit hee laagaa kis dos dichai jaa har evai bhaavai ||
english: Whatever the Lord attaches one to, to that he is attached. Who is to blame, when the Lord wills it so?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur saravar ratanee bharapoore jis praapat so paavai ||
english: The True Guru is the lake, overflowing with pearls. One who meets the True Guru obtains them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਹੰਸ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਇਕਠੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੁਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sikh ha(n)s saravar ikathe hoe satigur kai hukamaavai ||
english: The Sikh-swans gather at the lake, according to the Will of the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਮਾਣਕ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ratan padaarath maanak saravar bharapoore khaai kharach rahe tot na aavai ||
english: The lake is filled with the wealth of these jewels and pearls; they are spent and consumed, but they never run out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰ ਹੰਸੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਰਤੇ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saravar ha(n)s door na hoee karate evai bhaavai ||
english: The swan never leaves the lake; such is the Pleasure of the Creator's Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak jis dai masatak bhaag dhur likhiaa so sikh guroo pahi aavai ||
english: O servant Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead - that Sikh comes to the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਭਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aap tariaa kuta(n)b sabh taare sabhaa srisat chhadaavai ||1||
english: He saves himself, and saves all his generations as well; he emancipates the whole world. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਆਖਾਏ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਰਾਹੀ ਕੋਰੜ ਮੋਠ ਜਿਨੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit aakhaae bahutee raahee koraR moth jinehaa ||
english: He is called a Pandit, a religious scholar, and yet he wanders along many pathways. He is as hard as uncooked beans.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਤਿਸਟਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar mohu nit bharam viaapiaa tisatas naahee dehaa ||
english: He is filled with attachment, and constantly engrossed in doubt; his body cannot hold still.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਜਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਜੋਹਾ ॥
transliteration: kooRee aavai kooRee jaavai maaiaa kee nit johaa ||
english: False is his coming, and false is his going; he is continually on the lookout for Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਤਾ ਛੋਹੋ ਆਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਰੋਹਾ ॥
transliteration: sach kahai taa chhoho aavai a(n)tar bahutaa rohaa ||
english: If someone speaks the truth, then he is aggravated; he is totally filled with anger.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਕੁਮੂੜਾ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੋਹਾ ॥
transliteration: viaapiaa duramat kubudh kumooRaa man laagaa tis mohaa ||
english: The evil fool is engrossed in evil-mindedness and false intellectualizations; his mind is attached to emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਗੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਠਗੁ ਰਲਿ ਆਇਆ ਸਾਥੁ ਭਿ ਇਕੋ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: thagai setee thag ral aaiaa saath bh iko jehaa ||
english: The deceiver abides with the five deceivers; it is a gathering of like minds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਵਿਚਦੋ ਕਢੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਘੜਿ ਆਇਆ ਲੋਹਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur saraaph nadaree vichado kadhai taa(n) ughaR aaiaa lohaa ||
english: And when the Jeweller, the True Guru, appraises him, then he is exposed as mere iron.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੇਰੀ ਥਾਈ ਰਲਾਇ ਰਲਾਇ ਦਿਤਾ ਉਘੜਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ ਅਗੈ ਆਇ ਖਲੋਹਾ ॥
transliteration: bahuteree thaaee ralaai ralaai ditaa ughaRiaa paRadaa agai aai khalohaa ||
english: Mixed and mingled with others, he was passed off as genuine in many places; but now, the veil has been lifted, and he stands naked before all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜੇ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਨੂਰਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਹਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee je saranee aavai phir manoorahu ka(n)chan hohaa ||
english: One who comes to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, shall be transformed from iron into gold.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਕਟੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਧੁ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur niravair putr satr samaane augan kate kare sudh dehaa ||
english: The True Guru has no anger or vengeance; He looks upon son and enemy alike. Removing faults and mistakes, He purifies the human body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: naanak jis dhur masatak hovai likhiaa tis satigur naal sanehaa ||
english: O Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, is in love with the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee satigur poore kee jis kirapaal hovai tis ridai vasehaa ||
english: The Word of the Perfect True Guru's Bani is Ambrosial Nectar; it dwells in the heart of one who is blessed by the Guru's Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਟੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਹਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa tis kaa kateeai sadaa sadaa sukh hohaa ||2||
english: His coming and going in reincarnation is ended; forever and ever, he is at peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਬੁਝਈ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaanaa ja(n)t so tudh bujhaee ||
english: He alone understands You, Lord, with whom You are pleased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਝਈ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaanaa ja(n)t s daragah sijhaee ||
english: He alone is approved in the Court of the Lord, with whom You are pleased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਈ ॥
transliteration: jis no teree nadar haumai tis gaee ||
english: Egotism is eradicated, when You bestow Your Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਕਲਮਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਖਈ ॥
transliteration: jis no too sa(n)tusat kalamal tis khaee ||
english: Sins are erased, when You are thoroughly pleased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਲਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸੋ ਭਈ ॥
transliteration: jis kai suaamee val nirabhau so bhaee ||
english: One who has the Lord Master on his side, becomes fearless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋ ਥਿਅਈ ॥
transliteration: jis no too kirapaal sachaa so thiaee ||
english: One who is blessed with Your Mercy, becomes truthful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਇਆ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਅਗਨਈ ॥
transliteration: jis no teree maiaa na pohai aganaee ||
english: One who is blessed with Your Kindness, is not touched by fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਲਈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tis no sadaa daiaal jin gur te mat laee ||7||
english: You are forever Merciful to those who are receptive to the Guru's Teachings. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa kirapaal aape bakhas lai ||
english: Please grant Your Grace, O Merciful Lord; please forgive me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਇ ਪੈ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa japee teraa naam satigur paai pai ||
english: Forever and ever, I chant Your Name; I fall at the feet of the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੁ ਦੂਖਾ ਨਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan a(n)tar vas dookhaa naas hoi ||
english: Please, dwell within my mind and body, and end my sufferings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਥ ਦੇਇ ਆਪਿ ਰਖੁ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਭਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: hath dei aap rakh viaapai bhau na koi ||
english: Please give me Your hand, and save me, that fear may not afflict me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਏਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gun gaavaa din rain etai ka(n)m laai ||
english: May I sing Your Glorious Praises day and night; please commit me to this task.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kai sa(n)g haumai rog jaai ||
english: Associating with the humble Saints, the disease of egotism is eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sarab nira(n)tar khasam eko rav rahiaa ||
english: The One Lord and Master is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sach sacho sach lahiaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have truly found the Truest of the True.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਅਪਣੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: daiaa karahu daiaal apanee siphat dehu ||
english: Please bless me with Your Kindness, O Kind Lord, and bless me with Your Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਏਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: darasan dekh nihaal naanak preet eh ||1||
english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I am in ecstasy; this is what Nanak loves. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਇਕਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: eko japeeai manai maahi ikas kee saranaai ||
english: Meditate on the One Lord within your mind, and enter the Sanctuary of the One Lord alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ikas siu kar pirahaRee doojee naahee jaai ||
english: Be in love with the One Lord; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: iko daataa ma(n)geeai sabh kichh palai paai ||
english: Beg from the One Lord, the Great Giver, and you will be blessed with everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: man tan saas giraas prabh iko ik dhiaai ||
english: In your mind and body, with each breath and morsel of food, meditate on the One and only Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan sach guramukh paaiaa jaai ||
english: The Gurmukh obtains the true treasure, the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee te sa(n)t jan jin man vuthaa aai ||
english: Very fortunate are those humble Saints, within whose minds the Lord has come to abide.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal rav rahiaa doojaa koee naahi ||
english: He is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naam dhiaaee naam ucharaa naanak khasam rajaai ||2||
english: Meditating on the Naam, and chanting the Naam, Nanak abides in the Will of his Lord and Master. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jis no too rakhavaalaa maare tis kaun ||
english: One who has You as his Saving Grace - who can kill him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਜਿਤਾ ਤਿਨੈ ਭੈਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jis no too rakhavaalaa jitaa tinai bhain ||
english: One who has You as his Saving Grace conquers the three worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jis no teraa a(n)g tis mukh ujalaa ||
english: One who has You on his side - his face is radiant and bright.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਹੂੰ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jis no teraa a(n)g s niramalee hoo(n) niramalaa ||
english: One who has You on his side, is the purest of the Pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ਪੁਛੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jis no teree nadar na lekhaa puchheeai ||
english: One who is blessed with Your Grace is not called to give his account.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਖੁਸੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਭੁੰਚੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jis no teree khusee tin nau nidh bhu(n)cheeai ||
english: One with whom You are pleased, obtains the nine treasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਲਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹਛੰਦਗੀ ॥
transliteration: jis no too prabh val tis kiaa muhachha(n)dagee ||
english: One who has You on his side, God - unto whom is he subservient?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਬੰਦਿਗੀ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jis no teree mihar s teree ba(n)digee ||8||
english: One who is blessed with Your Kind Mercy is dedicated to Your worship. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਾਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਿਹਾਵੇ ॥
transliteration: hohu kripaal suaamee mere sa(n)taa(n) sa(n)g vihaave ||
english: Be Merciful, O my Lord and Master, that I may pass my life in the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਸਿ ਜਮਿ ਜਮਿ ਮਰਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੁਕਨਿ ਹਾਵੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tudhahu bhule s jam jam marade tin kade na chukan haave ||1||
english: Those who forget You are born only to die and be reincarnated again; their sufferings will never end. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਘਟਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਘਟ ਘਾਟ ॥
transliteration: satigur simarahu aapanaa ghat avaghat ghat ghaat ||
english: Meditate in remembrance within your heart on the True Guru, whether you are on the most difficult path, on the mountain or by the river bank.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਤਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੰਧੈ ਵਾਟ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har har naam japa(n)tiaa koi na ba(n)dhai vaat ||2||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, no one shall block your way. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tithai too samarath jithai koi naahi ||
english: Where You are, Almighty Lord, there is no one else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਖ ਅਗਨੀ ਉਦਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: othai teree rakh aganee udar maahi ||
english: There, in the fire of the mother's womb, You protected us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sun kai jam ke doot naai terai chhad jaahi ||
english: Hearing Your Name, the Messenger of Death runs away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bhaujal bikham asagaahu gurasabadee paar paahi ||
english: The terrifying, treacherous, impassible world-ocean is crossed over, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੇਇ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jin kau lagee piaas a(n)mrit sei khaahi ||
english: Those who feel thirst for You, take in Your Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਏਹੋ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kal mahi eho pu(n)n gun govi(n)d gaahi ||
english: This is the only act of goodness in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਸੈ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sabhasai no kirapaal samhaale saahi saahi ||
