english: He is Merciful to all; He sustains us with each and every breath.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਜਿ ਆਵੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਹਿ ॥੯॥
transliteration: birathaa koi na jaai j aavai tudh aahi ||9||
english: Those who come to You with love and faith are never turned away empty-handed. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਇਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: doojaa tis na bujhaaihu paarabraham naam dehu aadhaar ||
english: Those whom You bless with the Support of Your Name, O Supreme Lord God, do not know any other.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar saahibo samarath sach daataar ||
english: Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord and Master, All-powerful True Great Giver:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: too nihachal niravair sach sachaa tudh darabaar ||
english: You are eternal and unchanging, without vengeance and True; True is the Darbaar of Your Court.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: keemat kahan na jaaeeai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
english: Your worth cannot be described; You have no end or limitation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਿ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: prabh chhod hor j ma(n)ganaa sabh bikhiaa ras chhaar ||
english: To forsake God, and ask for something else, is all corruption and ashes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਸੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਚਾ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: se sukheee sach saah se jin sachaa biuhaar ||
english: They alone find peace, and they are the true kings, whose dealings are true.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਲਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jinaa lagee preet prabh naam sahaj sukh saar ||
english: Those who are in love with God's Name, intuitively enjoy the essence of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਰੇਣਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ik aaraadhe sa(n)tan renaar ||1||
english: Nanak worships and adores the One Lord; he seeks the dust of the Saints. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anad sookh bisraam nit har kaa keeratan gaai ||
english: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, bliss, peace and rest are obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਛਾਡਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰਸਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: avar siaanap chhaad dehi naanak udharas naai ||2||
english: Forsake other clever tricks, O Nanak; only through the Name will you be saved. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਘਿਣਾਵਣੇ ॥
transliteration: naa too aavahi vas bahut ghinaavane ||
english: No one can bring You under control, by despising the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਾਵਣੇ ॥
transliteration: naa too aavahi vas bed paRaavane ||
english: No one can bring You under control, by studying the Vedas.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: naa too aavahi vas teerath naaeeai ||
english: No one can bring You under control, by bathing at the holy places.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: naa too aavahi vas dharatee dhaaeeai ||
english: No one can bring You under control, by wandering all over the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਸਿਆਣਪੈ ॥
transliteration: naa too aavahi vas kitai siaanapai ||
english: No one can bring You under control, by any clever tricks.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ॥
transliteration: naa too aavahi vas bahutaa daan de ||
english: No one can bring You under control, by giving huge donations to charities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko terai vas agam agocharaa ||
english: Everyone is under Your power, O inaccessible, unfathomable Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: too bhagataa kai vas bhagataa taan teraa ||10||
english: You are under the control of Your devotees; You are the strength of Your devotees. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੈਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aape vaid aap naaraain ||
english: The Lord Himself is the true physician.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹਿ ਵੈਦ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: ehi vaid jee kaa dukh laain ||
english: These physicians of the world only burden the soul with pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad a(n)mrit ras khaain ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar; it is so delicious to eat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਇਣ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jis man vasai tis ke sabh dookh mitaain ||1||
english: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with this Nectar - all his pains are dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਉਛਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: hukam uchhalai hukame rahai ||
english: By the Hukam of Lord's Command, they move about; by the Lord's Command, they remain still.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
transliteration: hukame dukh sukh sam kar sahai ||
english: By His Hukam, they endure pain and pleasure alike.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: hukame naam japai din raat ||
english: By His Hukam, they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak jis no hovai daat ||
english: O Nanak, he alone does so, who is blessed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hukam marai hukame hee jeevai ||
english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they die; by the Hukam of His Command, they live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਨਾਨੑਾ ਵਡਾ ਥੀਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hukame naanhaa vadaa theevai ||
english: By His Hukam, they become tiny, and huge.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
transliteration: hukame sog harakh aana(n)d ||
english: By His Hukam, they receive pain, happiness and bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਪੈ ਨਿਰੋਧਰ ਗੁਰਮੰਤ ॥
transliteration: hukame japai nirodhar gurama(n)t ||
english: By His Hukam, they chant the Guru's Mantra, which always works.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: hukame aavan jaan rahaae ||
english: By His Hukam, coming and going in reincarnation cease,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jaa kau bhagatee laae ||2||
english: O Nanak, when He links them to His devotional worship. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੇਵਦਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hau tis dhaadhee kurabaan j teraa sevadaar ||
english: I am a sacrifice to that musician who is Your servant, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ਜਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: hau tis dhaadhee balihaar j gaavai gun apaar ||
english: I am a sacrifice to that musician who sings the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਢਾਢੀ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਲੋੜੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: so dhaadhee dhan dha(n)n jis loRe nira(n)kaar ||
english: Blessed, blessed is that musician, for whom the Formless Lord Himself longs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਢਾਢੀ ਭਾਗਠੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਚਾ ਦੁਆਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: so dhaadhee bhaagath jis sachaa duaar baar ||
english: Very fortunate is that musician who comes to the gate of the Court of the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਕਲਾਣੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ohu dhaadhee tudh dhiaai kalaane din rainaar ||
english: That musician meditates on You, Lord, and praises You day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਦੇ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)gai a(n)mrit naam na aavai kade haar ||
english: He begs for the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, and will never be defeated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਪੜੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਦਾ ਲਿਵੈ ਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kapaR bhojan sach rahadaa livai dhaar ||
english: His clothes and his food are true, and he enshrines love for the Lord within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਢਾਢੀ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: so dhaadhee gunava(n)t jis no prabh piaar ||11||
english: Praiseworthy is that musician who loves God. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਮਿਉ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee amiu ras a(n)mrit har kaa naau ||
english: The Bani of the Guru's Word is Ambrosial Nectar; its taste is sweet. The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man tan hiradai simar har aath pahar gun gaau ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord in your mind, body and heart; twenty-four hours a day, sing His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
transliteration: upades sunahu tum gurasikhahu sachaa ihai suaau ||
english: Listen to these Teachings, O Sikhs of the Guru. This is the true purpose of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਇਹੁ ਭਾਉ ॥
transliteration: janam padaarath saphal hoi man mahi laaihu bhaau ||
english: This priceless human life will be made fruitful; embrace love for the Lord in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਪਤਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aanad ghanaa prabh japatiaa dukh jaai ||
english: Celestial peace and absolute bliss come when one meditates on God - suffering is dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam japat sukh oopajai daragah paaeeai thaau ||1||
english: O Nanak, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, peace wells up, and one obtains a place in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeeai gur pooraa mat dei ||
english: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is the Teaching imparted by the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਭਾਣੈ ਹੀ ਕਢਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai jap tap sa(n)jamo bhaanai hee kadh lei ||
english: In the Lord's Will, they practice meditation, austerity and self-discipline; in the Lord's Will, they are released.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai jon bhavaaeeai bhaanai bakhas karei ||
english: In the Lord's Will, they are made to wander in reincarnation; in the Lord's Will, they are forgiven.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੋਗੀਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai dukh sukh bhogeeai bhaanai karam karei ||
english: In the Lord's Will, pain and pleasure are experienced; in the Lord's Will, actions are performed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਮਿਟੀ ਸਾਜਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai mitee saaj kai bhaanai jot dharei ||
english: In the Lord's Will, clay is fashioned into form; in the Lord's Will, His Light is infused into it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਾਇਦਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਹਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai bhog bhogaaidaa bhaanai manahi karei ||
english: In the Lord's Will, enjoyments are enjoyed; in the Lord's Will, these enjoyments are denied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਉਤਾਰੇ ਭਾਣੈ ਧਰਣਿ ਪਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai narak surag autaare bhaanai dharan parei ||
english: In the Lord's Will, they are incarnated in heaven and hell; in the Lord's Will, they fall to the ground.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhaanai hee jis bhagatee laae naanak virale he ||2||
english: In the Lord's Will, they are committed to His devotional worship and Praise; O Nanak, how rare are these! ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
transliteration: vadiaaee sache naam kee hau jeevaa sun sune ||
english: Hearing, hearing of the glorious greatness of the True Name, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਖਣੇ ॥
transliteration: pasoo paret agiaan udhaare ik khane ||
english: Even ignorant beasts and goblins can be saved, in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: dinas rain teraa naau sadaa sad jaapeeai ||
english: Day and night, chant the Name, forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਵਿਕਰਾਲ ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa bhukh vikaraal naai terai dhraapeeai ||
english: The most horrible thirst and hunger is satisfied through Your Name, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
transliteration: rog sog dukh va(n)njai jis naau man vasai ||
english: Disease, sorrow and pain run away, when the Name dwells within the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਰਸੈ ॥
transliteration: tisahi paraapat laal jo gurasabadee rasai ||
english: He alone attains his Beloved, who loves the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)d brahama(n)d bea(n)t udhaaranahaariaa ||
english: The worlds and solar systems are saved by the Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: teree sobhaa tudh sache mere piaariaa ||12||
english: Your glory is Yours alone, O my Beloved True Lord. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਮੈ ਛਡਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਕਸੁੰਭੈ ਭੁਲੀ ॥
transliteration: mitr piaaraa naanak jee mai chhad gavaaiaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bhai bhulee ||
english: I abandoned and lost my Beloved Friend, O Nanak; I was fooled by the transitory color of the safflower, which fades away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਸਜਣ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਉਦੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਢੁ ਨ ਲਹਦੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tau sajan kee mai keem na paudee hau tudh bin adh na lahadee ||1||
english: I did not know Your value, O my Friend; without You, I am not worth even half a shell. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਸੁ ਵਿਰਾਇਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਉ ਸਸੁਰਾ ਵਾਦੀ ਜੇਠੋ ਪਉ ਪਉ ਲੂਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sas viraain naanak jeeu sasuraa vaadee jetho pau pau loohai ||
english: My mother-in-law is my enemy, O Nanak; my father-in-law is argumentative and my brother-in-law burns me at every step.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਭੇ ਭਸੁ ਪੁਣੇਦੇ ਵਤਨੁ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਸਜਣੁ ਤੂਹੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: habhe bhas punede vatan jaa mai sajan toohai ||2||
english: They can all just play in the dust, when You are my Friend, O Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਵੁਠਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੋ ॥
transliteration: jis too vuthaa chit tis darad nivaarano ||
english: You relieve the pains of those, within whose consciousness You dwell, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਵੁਠਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹਾਰਣੋ ॥
transliteration: jis too vuthaa chit tis kade na haarano ||
english: Those, within whose consciousness You dwell, never lose.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਤਾਰਣੋ ॥
transliteration: jis miliaa pooraa guroo s sarapar taarano ||
english: One who meets the Perfect Guru will surely be saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਣੋ ॥
transliteration: jis no laae sach tis sach samhaalano ||
english: One who is attached to Truth, contemplates Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਾਲਣੋ ॥
transliteration: jis aaiaa hath nidhaan s rahiaa bhaalano ||
english: One, into whose hands the treasure comes, stops searching.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਇਕੋ ਰੰਗੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋ ਜਾਨਣੋ ॥
transliteration: jis no iko ra(n)g bhagat so jaanano ||
english: He alone is known as a devotee, who loves the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਚਾਰਣੋ ॥
transliteration: ohu sabhanaa kee ren birahee chaarano ||
english: He is the dust under the feet of all; he is the lover of the Lord's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਾਰਣੋ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: sabh tere choj vidaan sabh teraa kaarano ||13||
english: Everything is Your wonderful play; the whole creation is Yours. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਮੈ ਹਭ ਵਞਾਈ ਛੋੜਿਆ ਹਭੁ ਕਿਝੁ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
transliteration: usatat ni(n)daa naanak jee mai habh vanjaaee chhoRiaa habh kijh tiaagee ||
english: I have totally discarded praise and slander, O Nanak; I have forsaken and abandoned everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਭੇ ਸਾਕ ਕੂੜਾਵੇ ਡਿਠੇ ਤਉ ਪਲੈ ਤੈਡੈ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: habhe saak kooRaave dithe tau palai taidai laagee ||1||
english: I have seen that all relationships are false, and so I have grasped hold of the hem of Your robe, Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਦੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਉ ਹਉ ਫਾਵੀ ਥੀਈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਸਾਵਰ ਪੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: phiradee phiradee naanak jeeu hau phaavee theeee bahut disaavar pa(n)dhaa ||
english: I wandered and wandered and went crazy, O Nanak, in countless foreign lands and pathways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਹਉ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈ ਲਧਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: taa hau sukh sukhaalee sutee jaa gur mil sajan mai ladhaa ||2||
english: But then, I slept in peace and comfort, when I met the Guru, and found my Friend. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਦੁਖ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਭੁਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sabhe dukh sa(n)taap jaa(n) tudhahu bhuleeai ||
english: When I forget You, I endure all pains and afflictions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੀਚਨਿ ਲਖ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਾਂ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਘੁਲੀਐ ॥
transliteration: je keechan lakh upaav taa(n) kahee na ghuleeai ||
english: Making thousands of efforts, they are still not eliminated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jis no visarai naau s niradhan kaa(n)dheeai ||
english: One who forgets the Name, is known as a poor person.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਸੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਹਾਂਢੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jis no visarai naau s jonee haa(n)dheeai ||
english: One who forgets the Name, wanders in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮੁ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੇ ॥
transliteration: jis khasam na aavai chit tis jam da(n)d de ||
english: One who does not remember his Lord and Master, is punished by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਰੋਗੀ ਸੇ ਗਣੇ ॥
transliteration: jis khasam na aavee chit rogee se gane ||
english: One who does not remember his Lord and Master, is judged to be a sick person.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੁ ਖਰੋ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jis khasam na aavee chit s kharo aha(n)kaareeaa ||
english: One who does not remember his Lord and Master, is egotistical and proud.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਗਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਆ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: soee duhelaa jag jin naau visaareeaa ||14||
english: One who forgets the Name is miserable in this world. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੈਡੀ ਬੰਦਸਿ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਡਿਠਾ ਤੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: taidee ba(n)das mai koi na dithaa too naanak man bhaanaa ||
english: I have not seen any other like You. You alone are pleasing to Nanak's mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਵਿਚੋਲੇ ਜੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ghol ghumaaee tis mitr vichole jai mil ka(n)t pachhaanaa ||1||
english: I am a dedicated, devoted sacrifice to that friend, that mediator, who leads me to recognize my Husband Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਜਾਂ ਤਉ ਧਿਰਿ ਜੁਲਦੇ ਸੀਸੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: paav suhaave jaa(n) tau dhir julade sees suhaavaa charanee ||
english: Beautiful are those feet which walk towards You; beautiful is that head which falls at Your Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਜਾਂ ਤਉ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਪਇਆ ਤਉ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mukh suhaavaa jaa(n) tau jas gaavai jeeu paiaa tau saranee ||2||
english: Beautiful is that mouth which sings Your Praises; beautiful is that soul which seeks Your Sanctuary. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਰੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mil naaree satasa(n)g ma(n)gal gaaveeaa ||
english: Meeting the Lord's brides, in the True Congregation, I sing the songs of joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਕਾ ਹੋਆ ਬੰਧਾਨੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਧਾਵੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ghar kaa hoaa ba(n)dhaan bahuR na dhaaveeaa ||
english: The home of my heart is now held steady, and I shall not go out wandering again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਠੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਸੋਇ ਕੂੜਾਵੀਆ ॥
transliteration: binathee duramat durat soi kooRaaveeaa ||
english: Evil-mindedness has been dispelled, along with sin and my bad reputation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਲਵੰਤਿ ਪਰਧਾਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਚਾਵੀਆ ॥
transliteration: seelava(n)t paradhaan ridai sachaaveeaa ||
english: I am well-known as being calm and good-natured; my heart is filled with Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕ ਰੀਤਾਵੀਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar ik ik reetaaveeaa ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, the One and only Lord is my way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਰਣ ਦਾਸਾਵੀਆ ॥
transliteration: man darasan kee piaas charan daasaaveeaa ||
english: My mind is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. I am a slave at His feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾ ਬਣੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਖਸਮਿ ਜਾਂ ਰਾਵੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sobhaa banee seegaar khasam jaa(n) raaveeaa ||
english: I am glorified and embellished, when my Lord and Master enjoys me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੀਆ ਆਇ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਜਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੀਆ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: mileeaa aai sa(n)jog jaa(n) tis bhaaveeaa ||15||
english: I meet Him through my blessed destiny, when it is pleasing to His Will. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੈਡੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਉ ਮੈ ਕੂ ਥੀਏ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: habh gun taide naanak jeeu mai koo theee mai niragun te kiaa hovai ||
english: All virtues are Yours, Dear Lord; You bestow them upon us. I am unworthy - what can I achieve, O Nanak?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਚਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਚੋਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tau jevad daataar na koee jaachak sadaa jaachovai ||1||
english: There is no other Giver as great as You. I am a beggar; I beg from You forever. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਛਿਜੰਦੜੀ ਊਣ ਮਝੂਣਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਜਣਿ ਜੀਉ ਧਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: deh chhija(n)daRee oon majhoonaa gur sajan jeeu dharaaiaa ||
english: My body was wasting away, and I was depressed. The Guru, my Friend, has encouraged and consoled me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਹੇਲੜਾ ਸੁਤਾ ਜਿਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: habhe sukh suhelaRaa sutaa jitaa jag sabaaiaa ||2||
english: I sleep in total peace and comfort; I have conquered the whole world. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਤਖਤੁ ॥
transliteration: vadaa teraa darabaar sachaa tudh takhat ||
english: The Darbaar of Your Court is glorious and great. Your holy throne is True.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਉਰੁ ਛਤੁ ॥
transliteration: sir saahaa paatisaahu nihachal chaur chhat ||
english: You are the Emperor over the heads of kings. Your canopy and chauree (fly-brush) are permanent and unchanging.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
transliteration: jo bhaavai paarabraham soee sach niaau ||
english: That alone is true justice, which is pleasing to the Will of the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: je bhaavai paarabraham nithaave milai thaau ||
english: Even the homeless receive a home, when it is pleasing to the Will of the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਗਲ ॥
transliteration: jo keenhee karataar saaee bhalee gal ||
english: Whatever the Creator Lord does, is a good thing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਾਹ ਮਲ ॥
transliteration: jinhee pachhaataa khasam se daragaah mal ||
english: Those who recognize their Lord and Master, are seated in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਫੇਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sahee teraa phuramaan kinai na phereeai ||
english: True is Your Command; no one can challenge it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੀਮ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੀਐ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: kaaran karan kareem kudarat tereeai ||16||
english: O Merciful Lord, Cause of causes, Your creative power is all-powerful. ||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੰਦੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਦੜੀ ਲਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: soi suna(n)daRee meraa tan man maulaa naam japa(n)daRee laalee ||
english: Hearing of You, my body and mind have blossomed forth; chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am flushed with life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਧਿ ਜੁਲੰਦੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਠੰਢਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pa(n)dh jula(n)daRee meraa a(n)dar tha(n)dhaa gur darasan dekh nihaalee ||1||
english: Walking on the Path, I have found cool tranquility deep within; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I am enraptured. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਠ ਮੰਝਾਹੂ ਮੈ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਧਾ ॥
transliteration: hath ma(n)jhaahoo mai maanak ladhaa ||
english: I have found the jewel within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਘਿਧਾ ਮੈ ਕੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: mul na ghidhaa mai koo satigur ditaa ||
english: I was not charged for it; the True Guru gave it to me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਢੂੰਢ ਵਞਾਈ ਥੀਆ ਥਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: dhoo(n)dh vanjaaee theeaa thitaa ||
english: My search has ended, and I have become stable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: janam padaarath naanak jitaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, I have conquered this priceless human life. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jis kai masatak karam hoi so sevaa laagaa ||
english: One who has such good karma inscribed upon his forehead, is committed to the Lord's service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਸੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jis gur mil kamal pragaasiaa so anadin jaagaa ||
english: One whose heart lotus blossoms forth upon meeting the Guru, remains awake and aware, night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਸਭੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: lagaa ra(n)g charanaarabi(n)d sabh bhram bhau bhaagaa ||
english: All doubt and fear run away from one who is in love with the Lord's lotus feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮੁ ਜਿਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਗੰਜਤ ਪਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: aatam jitaa guramatee aaga(n)jat paagaa ||
english: He conquers his soul, following the Guru's Teachings, and attains the Imperishable Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੋ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jisahi dhiaaiaa paarabraham so kal mahi taagaa ||
english: He alone keeps up in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, who meditates on the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat niramalaa athasath majanaagaa ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he is immaculate, as if he has bathed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jis prabh miliaa aapanaa so purakh sabhaagaa ||
english: He alone is a man of good fortune, who has met with God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਵਡ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak tis balihaaranai jis evad bhaagaa ||17||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice to such a one, whose destiny is so great! ||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਪਿਰੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਾਂ ਧਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) pir a(n)dar taa(n) dhan baahar ||
english: When the Husband Lord is within the heart, then Maya, the bride, goes outside.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਪਿਰੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤਾਂ ਧਨ ਮਾਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) pir baahar taa(n) dhan maahar ||
english: When one's Husband Lord is outside of oneself, then Maya, the bride, is supreme.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਫੇਰ ਫਿਰਾਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai bahu pher phiraahar ||
english: Without the Name, one wanders all around.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜਾਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur sa(n)g dikhaaiaa jaahar ||
english: The True Guru shows us that the Lord is with us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak sache sach samaahar ||1||
english: Servant Nanak merges in the Truest of the True. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਹਰ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਆਹਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aahar sabh karadaa phirai aahar ik na hoi ||
english: Making all sorts of efforts, they wander around; but they do not make even one effort.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਹਰਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak jit aahar jag udharai viralaa boojhai koi ||2||
english: O Nanak, how rare are those who understand the effort which saves the world. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਹੂ ਵਡਾ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਰਤਬਾ ॥
transliteration: vadee hoo vadaa apaar teraa maratabaa ||
english: The greatest of the great, infinite is Your dignity.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ ਅਨੇਕ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੑਿ ਕਰਤਬਾ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g para(n)g anek na jaapanhi karatabaa ||
english: Your colors and hues are so numerous; no one can know Your actions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jeeaa a(n)dar jeeu sabh kichh jaanalaa ||
english: You are the Soul within all souls; You alone know everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਘਰੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh terai vas teraa ghar bhalaa ||
english: Everything is under Your control; Your home is beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਵਧਾਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਘਰਿ ॥
transliteration: terai ghar aana(n)d vadhaaee tudh ghar ||
english: Your home is filled with bliss, which resonates and resounds throughout Your home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤਾ ਤੇਜੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਜਰਿ ॥
transliteration: maan mahataa tej aapanaa aap jar ||
english: Your honor, majesty and glory are Yours alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਜਤ ਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab kalaa bharapoor disai jat kataa ||
english: You are overflowing with all powers; wherever we look, there You are.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਬਿਨਵਤਾ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak daasan daas tudh aagai binavataa ||18||
english: Nanak, the slave of Your slaves, prays to You alone. ||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਤੜੇ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਪਾਰੀਏ ॥
transliteration: chhataRe baajaar sohan vich vapaareee ||
english: Your streets are covered with canopies; under them, the traders look beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਖਰੁ ਹਿਕੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਟੇ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vakhar hik apaar naanak khate so dhanee ||1||
english: O Nanak, he alone is truly a banker, who buys the infinite commodity. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਹਮਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਸ ਹੂ ਕੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeeraa hamaraa ko nahee ham kis hoo ke naahi ||
english: Kabeer, no one is mine, and I belong to no one.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin ihu rachan rachaaiaa tis hee maahi samaahi ||2||
english: I am absorbed in the One, who created this creation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲਿਉ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਫਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: saphaliu birakh suhaavaRaa har saphal a(n)mritaa ||
english: The Lord is the most beautiful fruit tree, bearing fruits of Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚੈ ਉਨੑ ਮਿਲਣ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਵੰਞੈ ਘਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: man lochai unh milan kau kiu va(n)njai ghitaa ||
english: My mind longs to meet Him; how can I ever find Him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਓਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਜਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: varanaa chihanaa baaharaa ohu agam ajitaa ||
english: He has no color or form; He is inaccessible and unconquerable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਖੋਲੑੈ ਭਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ohu piaaraa jee kaa jo kholhai bhitaa ||
english: I love Him with all my soul; He opens the door for me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਤੁਸਾੜੀਆ ਮੈ ਦਸਿਹੁ ਮਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sevaa karee tusaaReeaa mai dasihu mitaa ||
english: I shall serve you forever, if you tell me of my Friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਬਲੇ ਬਲਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kurabaanee va(n)njaa vaaranai bale bal kitaa ||
english: I am a sacrifice, a dedicated, devoted sacrifice to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸਨਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਲਾਇ ਚਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: dasan sa(n)t piaariaa sunahu laai chitaa ||
english: The Beloved Saints tell us, to listen with our consciousness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: jis likhiaa naanak daas tis naau a(n)mrit satigur ditaa ||19||
english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny, O slave Nanak, is blessed with the Ambrosial Name by the True Guru. ||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਤਸਕਰ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kabeer dharatee saadh kee tasakar baisahi gaahi ||
english: Kabeer, the earth belongs to the Holy, but the thieves have come and now sit among them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਭਾਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪਈ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਹੂ ਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dharatee bhaar na biaapaee un kau laahoo laahi ||1||
english: The earth does not feel their weight; even they profit. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਚਾਵਲ ਕਾਰਣੇ ਤੁਖ ਕਉ ਮੁਹਲੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kabeer chaaval kaarane tukh kau muhalee laai ||
english: Kabeer, for the sake of the rice, the husks are beaten and threshed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਕੁਸੰਗੀ ਬੈਸਤੇ ਤਬ ਪੂਛੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)g kusa(n)gee baisate tab poochhe dharam raai ||2||
english: When one sits in the company of evil people, then he will be called to account by the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਇਕਾਤੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aape hee vad paravaar aap ikaateeaa ||
english: He Himself has the greatest family; He Himself is all alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਤੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aapanee keemat aap aape hee jaateeaa ||
english: He alone knows His own worth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪੰਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap aap upa(n)niaa ||
english: He Himself, by Himself, created everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੰਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa keetaa aap aap vara(n)niaa ||
english: Only He Himself can describe His own creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਤੂ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s teraa thaan jithai too vuthaa ||
english: Blessed is Your place, where You dwell, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਤੂੰ ਡਿਠਾ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s tere bhagat jinhee sach too(n) dithaa ||
english: Blessed are Your devotees, who see You, O True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਇਆ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਧੁ ॥
transliteration: jis no teree daiaa salaahe soi tudh ||
english: He alone praises You, who is blessed by Your Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਧੁ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: jis gur bhete naanak niramal soee sudh ||20||
english: One who meets the Guru, O Nanak, is immaculate and sanctified. ||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਭੂਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਵਿਸੂਲਾ ਬਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa bhoom ra(n)gaavalee ma(n)jh visoolaa baag ||
english: Fareed, this world is beautiful, but there is a thorny garden within it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਰ ਪੀਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਚ ਨ ਲਾਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo nar peer nivaajiaa tinhaa a(n)ch na laag ||1||
english: Those who are blessed by their spiritual teacher are not even scratched. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਉਮਰ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਵੰਨੜੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
transliteration: phareedaa umar suhaavaRee sa(n)g suva(n)naRee deh ||
english: Fareed, blessed is the life, with such a beautiful body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਪਾਈਅਨੑਿ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੨॥
transliteration: virale keee paaeeanhi jinhaa piaare neh ||2||
english: How rare are those who are found to love their Beloved Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam daiaa dharam jis dehi s paae ||
english: He alone obtains meditation, austerities, self-discipline, compassion and Dharmic faith, whom the Lord so blesses.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਹਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: jis bujhaaihi agan aap so naam dhiaae ||
english: He alone meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, whose fire the Lord puts out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਇਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee agam purakh ik drisat dikhaae ||
english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Inaccessible Primal Lord, inspires us to look upon all with an impartial eye.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਆਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kai aasarai prabh siu ra(n)g laae ||
english: With the support of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one falls in love with God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣ ਕਟਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: augan kat mukh ujalaa har naam taraae ||
english: One's faults are eradicated, and one's face becomes radiant and bright; through the Lord's Name, one crosses over.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਕਟਿਓਨੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: janam maran bhau kation phir jon na paae ||
english: The fear of birth and death is removed, and he is not reincarnated again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿਅਨੁ ਲੜੁ ਆਪਿ ਫੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop te kaadhian laR aap phaRaae ||
english: God lifts him up and pulls him out of the deep, dark pit, and attaches him to the hem of His robe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਰਖੇ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak bakhas milaaian rakhe gal laae ||21||
english: O Nanak, God forgives him, and holds him close in His embrace. ||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਦੀ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਿ ॥
transliteration: muhabat jis khudaai dee rataa ra(n)g chalool ||
english: One who loves God is imbued with the deep crimson color of His love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਮੂਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak virale paaeeahi tis jan keem na mool ||1||
english: O Nanak, such a person is rarely found; the value of such a humble person can never be estimated. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਵਿਧਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਡਿਠੋਮਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar vidhaa sach naai baahar bhee sach dithom ||
english: The True Name has pierced the nucleus of my self deep within. Outside, I see the True Lord as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਿਆ ਹਭ ਥਾਇ ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰੋਮਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak raviaa habh thaai van trin tribhavan rom ||2||
english: O Nanak, He is pervading and permeating all places, the forests and the meadows, the three worlds, and every hair. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਤੋ ਰਚਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aape keeto rachan aape hee ratiaa ||
english: He Himself created the Universe; He Himself imbues it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਇਓ ਇਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਤਿਆ ॥
transliteration: aape hoio ik aape bahu bhatiaa ||
english: He Himself is One, and He Himself has numerous forms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਮੰਝਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape sabhanaa ma(n)jh aape baaharaa ||
english: He Himself is within all, and He Himself is beyond them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape jaanahi door aape hee jaaharaa ||
english: He Himself is known to be far away, and He Himself is right here.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਗਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: aape hovahi gupat aape paragateeai ||
english: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਤੇਰੀ ਥਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: keemat kisai na paai teree thateeai ||
english: No one can estimate the value of Your Creation, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਗਣਤੁ ਤੂੰ ॥
transliteration: gahir ga(n)bheer athaahu apaar aganat too(n) ||
english: You are deep and profound, unfathomable, infinite and invaluable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਰਤੈ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਤੂੰ ॥੨੨॥੧॥੨॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak varatai ik iko ik too(n) ||22||1||2|| sudh ||
english: O Nanak, the One Lord is all-pervading. You are the One and only. ||22||1||2|| Sudh||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਰਾਇ ਬਲਵੰਡਿ ਤਥਾ ਸਤੈ ਡੂਮਿ ਆਖੀ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee kee vaar raai balava(n)d tathaa satai doom aakhee ||
english: Vaar Of Raamkalee, Uttered By Satta And Balwand The Drummer:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਬੋਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਖੀਵਦੈ ॥
transliteration: naau karataa kaadar kare kiu bol hovai jokheevadai ||
english: One who chants the Name of the Almighty Creator - how can his words be judged?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇ ਗੁਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਭੈਣ ਭਰਾਵ ਹੈ ਪਾਰੰਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਪੜੀਵਦੈ ॥
transliteration: de gunaa sat bhain bharaav hai paara(n)gat daan paReevadai ||
english: His divine virtues are the true sisters and brothers; through them, the gift of supreme status is obtained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਨੀਵ ਦੈ ॥
transliteration: naanak raaj chalaaiaa sach kot sataanee neev dai ||
english: Nanak established the kingdom; He built the true fortress on the strongest foundations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਹਣੇ ਧਰਿਓਨੁ ਛਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਦੈ ॥
transliteration: lahane dharion chhat sir kar siphatee a(n)mrit peevadai ||
english: He installed the royal canopy over Lehna's head; chanting the Lord's Praises, He drank in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਤਮ ਦੇਵ ਦੀ ਖੜਗਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਪਰਾਕੁਇ ਜੀਅ ਦੈ ॥
transliteration: mat gur aatam dev dee khaRag jor paraakui jee dai ||
english: The Guru implanted the almighty sword of the Teachings to illuminate his soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕੀਈ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਥੀਵਦੈ ॥
transliteration: gur chele raharaas keeee naanak salaamat theevadai ||
english: The Guru bowed down to His disciple, while Nanak was still alive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਿ ਟਿਕਾ ਦਿਤੋਸੁ ਜੀਵਦੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sahi tikaa ditos jeevadai ||1||
english: The King, while still alive, applied the ceremonial mark to his forehead. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਹਣੇ ਦੀ ਫੇਰਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਦੋਹੀ ਖਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: lahane dee pheraaeeai naanakaa dohee khateeai ||
english: Nanak proclaimed Lehna's succession - he earned it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਓਹਾ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਾਇ ਸਹਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਫੇਰਿ ਪਲਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jot ohaa jugat saai sahi kaaiaa pher palateeai ||
english: They shared the One Light and the same way; the King just changed His body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਝੁਲੈ ਸੁ ਛਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੀ ਮਲਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਹਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jhulai s chhat nira(n)janee mal takhat baithaa gur hateeai ||
english: The immaculate canopy waves over Him, and He sits on the throne in the Guru's shop.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਸਿਲ ਜੋਗੁ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਚਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: karahi j gur phuramaaiaa sil jog aloonee chateeai ||
english: He does as the Guru commands; He tasted the tasteless stone of Yoga.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਲੰਗਰੁ ਚਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਖਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: la(n)gar chalai gur sabad har tot na aavee khateeai ||
english: The Langar - the Kitchen of the Guru's Shabad has been opened, and its supplies never run short.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਖਰਚੇ ਦਿਤਿ ਖਸੰਮ ਦੀ ਆਪ ਖਹਦੀ ਖੈਰਿ ਦਬਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kharache dit khasa(n)m dee aap khahadee khair dabateeai ||
english: Whatever His Master gave, He spent; He distributed it all to be eaten.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਖਸੰਮ ਦੀ ਨੂਰੁ ਅਰਸਹੁ ਕੁਰਸਹੁ ਝਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: hovai siphat khasa(n)m dee noor arasahu kurasahu jhateeai ||
english: The Praises of the Master were sung, and the Divine Light descended from the heavens to the earth.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਡਿਠੇ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਮਲੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਦੀ ਕਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: tudh dithe sache paatisaah mal janam janam dee kateeai ||
english: Gazing upon You, O True King, the filth of countless past lives is washed away.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਏਦੂ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਹਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sach j gur phuramaaiaa kiu edoo bolahu hateeai ||
english: The Guru gave the True Command; why should we hesitate to proclaim this?

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਕਉਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਲਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਰਹੁ ਕੰਨੑ ਮੁਰਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: putree kaul na paalio kar peerahu ka(n)nh murateeai ||
english: His sons did not obey His Word; they turned their backs on Him as Guru.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਦਿਲਿ ਖੋਟੈ ਆਕੀ ਫਿਰਨੑਿ ਬੰਨੑਿ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਚਾਇਨੑਿ ਛਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: dil khotai aakee phiranhi ba(n)nhi bhaar uchaainhi chhateeai ||
english: These evil-hearted ones became rebellious; they carry loads of sin on their backs.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਖੀ ਸੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਨੈ ਥਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jin aakhee soee kare jin keetee tinai thateeai ||
english: Whatever the Guru said, Lehna did, and so he was installed on the throne.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਹਾਰੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਉਵਟੀਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaun haare kin uvateeai ||2||
english: Who has lost, and who has won? ||2||

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਮੰਨਣਾ ਕੋ ਸਾਲੁ ਜਿਵਾਹੇ ਸਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: jin keetee so ma(n)nanaa ko saal jivaahe saalee ||
english: He who did the work, is accepted as Guru; so which is better - the thistle or the rice?

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਲੈ ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਦਲਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: dharam raai hai devataa lai galaa kare dalaalee ||
english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma considered the arguments and made the decision.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਾ ਬਾਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਰਹਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur aakhai sachaa kare saa baat hovai darahaalee ||
english: Whatever the True Guru says, the True Lord does; it comes to pass instantaneously.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਦੀ ਦੋਹੀ ਫਿਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਬੰਧਿ ਬਹਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: gur a(n)gad dee dohee phiree sach karatai ba(n)dh bahaalee ||
english: Guru Angad was proclaimed, and the True Creator confirmed it.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਲਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਲਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਸੈ ਡਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak kaaiaa palat kar mal takhat baithaa sai daalee ||
english: Nanak merely changed his body; He still sits on the throne, with hundreds of branches reaching out.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਦਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਉਮਤਿ ਖੜੀ ਮਸਕਲੈ ਹੋਇ ਜੰਗਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: dar seve umat khaRee masakalai hoi ja(n)gaalee ||
english: Standing at His door, His followers serve Him; by this service, their rust is scraped off.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ਖਸੰਮ ਦੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਚੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: dar daraves khasa(n)m dai naai sachai baanee laalee ||
english: He is the Dervish - the Saint, at the door of His Lord and Master; He loves the True Name, and the Bani of the Guru's Word.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਬਲਵੰਡ ਖੀਵੀ ਨੇਕ ਜਨ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਛਾਉ ਪਤ੍ਰਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: balava(n)d kheevee nek jan jis bahutee chhaau patraalee ||
english: Balwand says that Khivi, the Guru's wife, is a noble woman, who gives soothing, leafy shade to all.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਲੰਗਰਿ ਦਉਲਤਿ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਖੀਰਿ ਘਿਆਲੀ ॥
transliteration: la(n)gar daulat va(n)deeai ras a(n)mrit kheer ghiaalee ||
english: She distributes the bounty of the Guru's Langar; the kheer - the rice pudding and ghee, is like sweet ambrosia.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਥੀਏ ਪਰਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: gurasikhaa ke mukh ujale manamukh theee paraalee ||
english: The faces of the Guru's Sikhs are radiant and bright; the self-willed manmukhs are pale, like straw.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਪਏ ਕਬੂਲੁ ਖਸੰਮ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਾਂ ਘਾਲ ਮਰਦੀ ਘਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: pae kabool khasa(n)m naal jaa(n) ghaal maradee ghaalee ||
english: The Master gave His approval, when Angad exerted Himself heroically.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਖੀਵੀ ਸਹੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maataa kheevee sahu soi jin goi uthaalee ||3||
english: Such is the Husband of mother Khivi; He sustains the world. ||3||

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿਂਓ ਗੰਗ ਵਹਾਈਐ ਦੁਨਿਆਈ ਆਖੈ ਕਿ ਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
transliteration: hori(n)o ga(n)g vahaaeeai duniaaee aakhai k kion ||
english: It is as if the Guru made the Ganges flow in the opposite direction, and the world wonders: what has he done?

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਈਸਰਿ ਜਗਨਾਥਿ ਉਚਹਦੀ ਵੈਣੁ ਵਿਰਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak eesar jaganaath uchahadee vain virikion ||
english: Nanak, the Lord, the Lord of the World, spoke the words out loud.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਾਣਾ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਿ ਬਾਸਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਿੜਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
transliteration: maadhaanaa parabat kar netr baasak sabad riRakion ||
english: Making the mountain his churning stick, and the snake-king his churning string, He has churned the Word of the Shabad.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਚਉਦਹ ਰਤਨ ਨਿਕਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਚਿਲਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
transliteration: chaudah ratan nikaalian kar aavaa gaun chilakion ||
english: From it, He extracted the fourteen jewels, and illuminated the world.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅਹਿ ਵੇਖਾਲੀਅਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਐਵਡ ਪਿਡ ਠਿਣਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kudarat ahi vekhaaleean jin aivad pid thinakion ||
english: He revealed such creative power, and touched such greatness.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਲਹਣੇ ਧਰਿਓਨੁ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਸਮਾਨਿ ਕਿਆੜਾ ਛਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
transliteration: lahane dharion chhatr sir asamaan kiaaRaa chhikion ||
english: He raised the royal canopy to wave over the head of Lehna, and raised His glory to the skies.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਆਪੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
transliteration: jot samaanee jot maahi aap aapai setee mikion ||
english: His Light merged into the Light, and He blended Him into Himself.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖਾਂ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਾਂ ਘੋਖਿ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਉਮਤਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਜਿ ਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sikhaa(n) putraa(n) ghokh kai sabh umat vekhahu j kion ||
english: Guru Nanak tested His Sikhs and His sons, and everyone saw what happened.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਸੁਧੋਸੁ ਤਾਂ ਲਹਣਾ ਟਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jaa(n) sudhos taa(n) lahanaa tikion ||4||
english: When Lehna alone was found to be pure, then He was set on the throne. ||4||

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਫੇਰਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੁਆਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਖਾਡੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pher vasaaiaa pheruaan satigur khaadoor ||
english: Then, the True Guru, the son of Pheru, came to dwell at Khadoor.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਗਰੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam naal tudh hor much garoor ||
english: Meditation, austerities and self-discipline rest with You, while the others are filled with excessive pride.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਵਿਣਾਹੇ ਮਾਣਸਾ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: lab vinaahe maanasaa jiu paanee boor ||
english: Greed ruins mankind, like the green algae in the water.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਵਰ੍ਹਿਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਨੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: varhiai daragah guroo kee kudaratee noor ||
english: In the Guru's Court, the Divine Light shines in its creative power.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਤੂੰ ਓਹੁ ਠਰੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jit s haath na labhaee too(n) ohu tharoor ||
english: You are the cooling peace, whose depth cannot be found.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: nau nidh naam nidhaan hai tudh vich bharapoor ||
english: You are overflowing with the nine treasures, and the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਵੰਞੈ ਚੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa teree jo kare so va(n)njai choor ||
english: Whoever slanders You will be totally ruined and destroyed.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਨੇੜੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਮਾਤ ਲੋਕ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੁਝੈ ਦੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: neRai disai maat lok tudh sujhai door ||
english: People of the world can see only what is near at hand, but You can see far beyond.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਫੇਰਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੁਆਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਖਾਡੂਰੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: pher vasaaiaa pheruaan satigur khaadoor ||5||
english: Then the True Guru, the son of Pheru, came to dwell at Khadoor. ||5||

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: so tikaa so baihanaa soee deebaan ||
english: The same mark on the forehead, the same throne, and the same Royal Court.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਪਿਯੂ ਦਾਦੇ ਜੇਵਿਹਾ ਪੋਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: piyoo daade jevihaa potaa paravaan ||
english: Just like the father and grandfather, the son is approved.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਬਾਸਕੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੈ ਘਤਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਨੇਹੀ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jin baasak netrai ghatiaa kar nehee taan ||
english: He took the thousand-headed serpent as his churning string, and with the force of devotional love,

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਵਿਰੋਲਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਰੁ ਮਧਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jin samu(n)d viroliaa kar mer madhaan ||
english: he churned the ocean of the world with his churning stick, the Sumayr mountain.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਚਉਦਹ ਰਤਨ ਨਿਕਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਚਾਨਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: chaudah ratan nikaalian keeton chaanaan ||
english: He extracted the fourteen jewels, and brought forth the Divine Light.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਘੋੜਾ ਕੀਤੋ ਸਹਜ ਦਾ ਜਤੁ ਕੀਓ ਪਲਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: ghoRaa keeto sahaj daa jat keeo palaan ||
english: He made intuition his horse, and chastity his saddle.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਇਓ ਸਤ ਦਾ ਜਸ ਹੰਦਾ ਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: dhanakh chaRaaio sat daa jas ha(n)daa baan ||
english: He placed the arrow of the Lord's Praise in the bow of Truth.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੂ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਸਾ ਚੜਿਆ ਰੈ ਭਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: kal vich dhoo a(n)dhaar saa chaRiaa rai bhaan ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there was only pitch darkness. Then, He rose like the sun to illuminate the darkness.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਸਤਹੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਜਮਾਇਓ ਸਤਹੁ ਛਾਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: satahu khet jamaaio satahu chhaavaan ||
english: He farms the field of Truth, and spreads out the canopy of Truth.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਰਸੋਈ ਤੇਰੀਐ ਘਿਉ ਮੈਦਾ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: nit rasoee tereeai ghiu maidaa khaan ||
english: Your kitchen always has ghee and flour to eat.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾਂ ਸੁਝੀਓਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa(n) sujheeos man mahi sabad paravaan ||
english: You understand the four corners of the universe; in your mind, the Word of the Shabad is approved and supreme.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aavaa gaun nivaario kar nadar neesaan ||
english: You eliminate the comings and goings of reincarnation, and bestow the insignia of Your Glance of Grace.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਅਉਤਰਿਆ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਲੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: autariaa autaar lai so purakh sujaan ||
english: You are the Avataar, the Incarnation of the all-knowing Primal Lord.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਝਖੜਿ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਡੋਲਈ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਮੇਰਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jhakhaR vaau na dolaee parabat meraan ||
english: You are not pushed or shaken by the storm and the wind; you are like the Sumayr Mountain.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਜਾਣੀ ਹੂ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: jaanai birathaa jee kee jaanee hoo jaan ||
english: You know the inner state of the soul; You are the Knower of knowers.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਜਾਂ ਤੂ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: kiaa saalaahee sache paatisaah jaa(n) too sughaR sujaan ||
english: How can I praise You, O True Supreme King, when You are so wise and all-knowing?

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੁ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਸੋ ਸਤੇ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: daan j satigur bhaavasee so sate daan ||
english: Those blessings granted by the Pleasure of the True Guru - please bless Satta with those gifts.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੰਦਾ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਉਮਤਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak ha(n)daa chhatr sir umat hairaan ||
english: Seeing Nanak's canopy waving over Your head, everyone was astonished.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: so tikaa so baihanaa soee deebaan ||
english: The same mark on the forehead, the same throne, and the same Royal Court.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਪਿਯੂ ਦਾਦੇ ਜੇਵਿਹਾ ਪੋਤ੍ਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: piyoo daade jevihaa potraa paravaan ||6||
english: Just like the father and grandfather, the son is approved. ||6||

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਤਿਨੈ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n raamadaas gur jin siriaa tinai savaariaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed is Guru Raam Daas; He who created You, has also exalted You.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਕਰਾਮਾਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੈ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: pooree hoee karaamaat aap sirajanahaarai dhaariaa ||
english: Perfect is Your miracle; the Creator Lord Himself has installed You on the throne.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖੀ ਅਤੈ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sikhee atai sa(n)gatee paarabraham kar namasakaariaa ||
english: The Sikhs and all the Congregation recognize You as the Supreme Lord God, and bow down to You.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਅਟਲੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਤੂ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: atal athaahu atol too teraa a(n)t na paaraavaariaa ||
english: You are unchanging, unfathomable and immeasurable; You have no end or limitation.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਤੂੰ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jinhee too(n) seviaa bhaau kar se tudh paar utaariaa ||
english: Those who serve You with love - You carry them across.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਪਰਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: lab lobh kaam krodh mohu maar kadhe tudh saparavaariaa ||
english: Greed, envy, sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment - You have beaten them and driven them out.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੈਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)n s teraa thaan hai sach teraa paisakaariaa ||
english: Blessed is Your place, and True is Your magnificent glory.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੂ ਲਹਣਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਤੂ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak too lahanaa toohai gur amar too veechaariaa ||
english: You are Nanak, You are Angad, and You are Amar Daas; so do I recognize You.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਾਂ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur dithaa taa(n) man saadhaariaa ||7||
english: When I saw the Guru, then my mind was comforted and consoled. ||7||

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਗੇ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਆ ॥
transliteration: chaare jaage chahu jugee pa(n)chaain aape hoaa ||
english: The four Gurus enlightened the four ages; the Lord Himself assumed the fifth form.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿਓਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਥੰਮੑਿ ਖਲੋਆ ॥
transliteration: aapeenhai aap saajion aape hee tha(n)mhi khaloaa ||
english: He created Himself, and He Himself is the supporting pillar.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਟੀ ਕਲਮ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
transliteration: aape patee kalam aap aap likhanahaaraa hoaa ||
english: He Himself is the paper, He Himself is the pen, and He Himself is the writer.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਉਮਤਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh umat aavan jaavanee aape hee navaa niroaa ||
english: All His followers come and go; He alone is fresh and new.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਤਖਤਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਅਰਜਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਖਿਵੈ ਚੰਦੋਆ ॥
transliteration: takhat baithaa arajan guroo satigur kaa khivai cha(n)doaa ||
english: Guru Arjun sits on the throne; the royal canopy waves over the True Guru.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਉਗਵਣਹੁ ਤੈ ਆਥਵਣਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਚਕੀ ਕੀਅਨੁ ਲੋਆ ॥
transliteration: ugavanahu tai aathavanahu chahu chakee keean loaa ||
english: From east to west, He illuminates the four directions.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਪਇਆ ਮੋਆ ॥
transliteration: jinhee guroo na sevio manamukhaa paiaa moaa ||
english: Those self-willed manmukhs who do not serve the Guru die in shame.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਦੂਣੀ ਚਉਣੀ ਕਰਾਮਾਤਿ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਢੋਆ ॥
transliteration: doonee chaunee karaamaat sache kaa sachaa dhoaa ||
english: Your miracles increase two-fold, even four-fold; this is the True Lord's true blessing.

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਗੇ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: chaare jaage chahu jugee pa(n)chaain aape hoaa ||8||1||
english: The four Gurus enlightened the four ages; the Lord Himself assumed the fifth form. ||8||1||

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee baanee bhagataa kee || kabeer jeeu ||
english: Raamkalee, The Word Of The Devotees. Kabeer Jee:

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Satta and Balwand
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਲਾਲਨਿ ਲਾਹਨਿ ਮੇਲਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁੜੁ ਕੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kalaalan laahan melau gur kaa sabad guR keen re ||
english: Make your body the vat, and mix in the yeast. Let the Word of the Guru's Shabad be the molasses.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਸੁ ਦੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: trisanaa kaam krodh mad matasar kaat kaat kas deen re ||1||
english: Cut up desire, sexuality, anger, pride and envy, and let them be the fermenting bark. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਦੇਉ ਦਲਾਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: koee hai re sa(n)t sahaj sukh a(n)tar jaa kau jap tap deu dalaalee re ||
english: Is there any Saint, with intuitive peace and poise deep within, unto whom I might offer my meditation and austerities as payment?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਭਰਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਜੋ ਮਦੁ ਦੇਇ ਕਲਾਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ek boo(n)d bhar tan man devau jo mad dei kalaalee re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I dedicate my body and mind to whoever gives me even a drop of this wine from such a vat. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਵਨ ਚਤੁਰ ਦਸ ਭਾਠੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bhavan chatur das bhaathee keenhee braham agan tan jaaree re ||
english: I have made the fourteen worlds the furnace, and I have burnt my body with the fire of God.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਮਦਕ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਪੋਚਨਹਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mudraa madak sahaj dhun laagee sukhaman pochanahaaree re ||2||
english: My mudra - my hand-gesture, is the pipe; tuning into the celestial sound current within, the Shushmanaa - the central spinal channel, is my cooling pad. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਗਹਨੈ ਦੇਉ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: teerath barat nem such sa(n)jam rav sas gahanai deu re ||
english: Pilgrimages, fasting, vows, purifications, self-discipline, austerities and breath control through the sun and moon channels - all these I pledge.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਿਆਲ ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੇਉ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: surat piaal sudhaa ras a(n)mrit ehu mahaa ras peu re ||3||
english: My focused consciousness is the cup, and the Ambrosial Nectar is the pure juice. I drink in the supreme, sublime essence of this juice. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਝਰ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਇਹ ਰਸ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਾਤੋ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: nijhar dhaar chuai at niramal ih ras manooaa raato re ||
english: The pure stream constantly trickles forth, and my mind is intoxicated by this sublime essence.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸਗਲੇ ਮਦ ਛੂਛੇ ਇਹੈ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer sagale mad chhoochhe ihai mahaa ras saacho re ||4||1||
english: Says Kabeer, all other wines are trivial and tasteless; this is the only true, sublime essence. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਹੂਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਠੀ ਮਨ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guR kar giaan dhiaan kar mahooaa bhau bhaathee man dhaaraa ||
english: Make spiritual wisdom the molasses, meditation the flowers, and the Fear of God the fire enshrined in your mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਮਨ ਨਾਰੀ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਪੀਵੈ ਪੀਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sukhaman naaree sahaj samaanee peevai peevanahaaraa ||1||
english: The Shushmanaa, the central spinal channel, is intuitively balanced, and the drinker drinks in this wine. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਉਧੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: audhoo meraa man matavaaraa ||
english: O hermit Yogi, my mind is intoxicated.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਨਮਦ ਚਢਾ ਮਦਨ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਭਇਆ ਉਜਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: unamad chadhaa madan ras chaakhiaa tribhavan bhaiaa ujiaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When that wine rises up, one tastes the sublime essence of this juice, and sees across the three worlds. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਪੁਰ ਜੋਰਿ ਰਸਾਈ ਭਾਠੀ ਪੀਉ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: dui pur jor rasaaee bhaathee peeu mahaa ras bhaaree ||
english: Joining the two channels of the breath, I have lit the furnace, and I drink in the supreme, sublime essence.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਕੀਏ ਜਲੇਤਾ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਈ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaam krodh dui keee jaletaa chhoot gaee sa(n)saaree ||2||
english: I have burnt both sexual desire and anger, and I have been emancipated from the world. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੰਮਿਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: pragat pragaas giaan gur ga(n)mit satigur te sudh paaee ||
english: The light of spiritual wisdom enlightens me; meeting with the Guru, the True Guru, I have obtained this understanding.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਮਦ ਮਾਤਾ ਉਚਕਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥੨॥
transliteration: daas kabeer taas mad maataa uchak na kabahoo jaaee ||3||2||
english: Slave Kabeer is intoxicated with that wine, which never wears off. ||3||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੋ ਮੇਰੁ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਮੈ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: too(n) mero mer parabat suaamee ot gahee mai teree ||
english: You are my Sumayr Mountain, O my Lord and Master; I have grasped Your Support.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤੁਮ ਡੋਲਹੁ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਗਿਰਤੇ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naa tum dolahu naa ham girate rakh leenee har meree ||1||
english: You do not shake, and I do not fall. You have preserved my honor. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਤਬ ਜਬ ਕਬ ਤੁਹੀ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ab tab jab kab tuhee tuhee ||
english: Now and then, here and there, You, only You.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤੁਅ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham tu parasaad sukhee sad hee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Your Grace, I am forever in peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੋਰੇ ਭਰੋਸੇ ਮਗਹਰ ਬਸਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tore bharose magahar basio mere tan kee tapat bujhaaee ||
english: Relying upon You, I can live even in the cursed place of Magahar; You have put out the fire of my body.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਗਹਰ ਪਾਇਓ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਾਸੀ ਬਸੇ ਆਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pahile darasan magahar paaio phun kaasee base aaee ||2||
english: First, I obtained the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan in Magahar; then, I came to dwell at Benares. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਮਗਹਰੁ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਾਸੀ ਹਮ ਏਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa magahar taisee kaasee ham ekai kar jaanee ||
english: As is Magahar, so is Benares; I see them as one and the same.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਜਿਉ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਰਤੇ ਫੂਟਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ham niradhan jiu ihu dhan paaiaa marate phoot gumaanee ||3||
english: I am poor, but I have obtained this wealth of the Lord; the proud are bursting with pride, and die. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਚੁਭਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੂਲਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਢਨ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: karai gumaan chubhahi tis soolaa ko kaadhan kau naahee ||
english: One who takes pride in himself is stuck with thorns; no one can pull them out.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਚੋਭ ਕਉ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਲਾਤੇ ਨਰਕੇ ਘੋਰ ਪਚਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ajai s chobh kau bilal bilaate narake ghor pachaahee ||4||
english: Here, he cries bitterly, and hereafter, he burns in the most hideous hell. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਨਰਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਦੋਊ ਰਾਦੇ ॥
transliteration: kavan narak kiaa surag bichaaraa sa(n)tan dooo raade ||
english: What is hell, and what is heaven? The Saints reject them both.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਕਢਤੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ham kaahoo kee kaan na kadhate apane gur parasaade ||5||
english: I have no obligation to either of them, by the Grace of my Guru. ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਜਾਇ ਚਢੇ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਹੈ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ab tau jaai chadhe si(n)ghaasan mile hai saari(n)gapaanee ||
english: Now, I have mounted to the throne of the Lord; I have met the Lord, the Sustainer of the World.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਏਕ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੬॥੩॥
transliteration: raam kabeeraa ek bhae hai koi na sakai pachhaanee ||6||3||
english: The Lord and Kabeer have become one. No one can tell them apart. ||6||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਮਾਨਉ ਦੂਤਾ ਡਾਨਉ ਇਹ ਕੁਟਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa maanau dootaa daanau ih kutavaaree meree ||
english: I honor and obey the Saints, and punish the wicked; this is my duty as God's police officer.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਿਵਸ ਰੈਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਾਉ ਪਲੋਸਉ ਕੇਸ ਚਵਰ ਕਰਿ ਫੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: divas rain tere paau palosau kes chavar kar pheree ||1||
english: Day and night, I wash Your feet, Lord; I wave my hair as the chauree, to brush away the flies. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕੂਕਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ham kookar tere darabaar ||
english: I am a dog at Your Court, Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਉਕਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਬਦਨੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhaukahi aagai badan pasaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I open my snout and bark before it. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਹਮ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਅਬ ਤਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: poorab janam ham tumhre sevak ab tau mitiaa na jaaee ||
english: In my past life, I was Your servant; now, I cannot leave You.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਮਾਥੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tere duaarai dhun sahaj kee maathai mere dagaaee ||2||
english: The celestial sound current resounds at Your Door. Your insignia is stamped upon my forehead. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਾਗੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਸੁ ਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੂਝਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਗੇ ਭਗਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: daage hohi s ran mahi joojhahi bin daage bhag jaaee ||
english: Those who are branded with Your brand fight bravely in battle; those without Your brand run away.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਏ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhoo hoi s bhagat pachhaanai har lae khajaanai paaee ||3||
english: One who becomes a Holy person, appreciates the value of devotional worship to the Lord. The Lord places him in His treasury. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕੋਠਰੇ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਪਰਮ ਕੋਠੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kothare mahi kotharee param kothee beechaar ||
english: In the fortress is the chamber; by contemplative meditation it becomes the supreme chamber.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਉ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਬਸਤੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur deenee basat kabeer kau levahu basat samhaar ||4||
english: The Guru has blessed Kabeer with the commodity, saying, "Take this commodity; cherish it and keep it secure." ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਿ ਦੀਈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕਉ ਲੀਨੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kabeer deeee sa(n)saar kau leenee jis masatak bhaag ||
english: Kabeer gives it to the world, but he alone receives it, upon whose forehead such destiny is recorded.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਿਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ॥੫॥੪॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit ras jin paaiaa thir taa kaa sohaag ||5||4||
english: Permanent is the marriage, of one who receives this ambrosial essence. ||5||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਮੁਖ ਬੇਦੁ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨੁ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jih mukh bed gaaitree nikasai so kiu brahaman bisar karai ||
english: O Brahmin, how can you forget the One, from whose mouth the Vedas and the Gayitri prayer issured forth?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kai paai jagat sabh laagai so kiu pa(n)dit har na kahai ||1||
english: The whole world falls at His feet; why don't you chant the Name of that Lord, O Pandit? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਮੑਨ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਕਹਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaahe mere baamhn har na kahahi ||
english: Why, O my Brahmin, do you not chant the Lord's Name?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਪਾਡੇ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਭਰਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam na bolahi paade dojak bharahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If you don't chant the Lord's Name, O Pandit, you will only suffer in hell. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਘਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਹਠੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aapan ooch neech ghar bhojan hathe karam kar udar bharahi ||
english: You think that you are high, but you take food from the houses of the lowly; you fill up your belly by forcibly practicing your rituals.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਉਦਸ ਅਮਾਵਸ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਮਾਂਗਹਿ ਕਰ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਲੈ ਕੂਪਿ ਪਰਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chaudas amaavas rach rach maa(n)gahi kar deepak lai koop parahi ||2||
english: On the fourteenth day, and the night of the new moon, you go out begging; even though you hold the lamp in your hands, still, you fall into the pit. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਕਾਸੀਕ ਜੁਲਹਾ ਮੁਹਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਬਨਹਿ ॥
transliteration: too(n) brahaman mai kaaseek julahaa muhi tohi baraabaree kaise kai banahi ||
english: You are a Brahmin, and I am only a weaver from Benares. How can I compare to you?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਭਰੋਸੇ ਪਾਂਡੇ ਡੂਬਿ ਮਰਹਿ ॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: hamare raam naam kahi ubare bed bharose paa(n)de doob marahi ||3||5||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name, I have been saved; relying on the Vedas, O Brahmin, you shall drown and die. ||3||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੰਤ ਡਾਰ ਸਾਖਾ ਪੁਹਪ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਰਸ ਭਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: taravar ek ana(n)t daar saakhaa puhap patr ras bhareeaa ||
english: There is a single tree, with countless branches and twigs; its flowers and leaves are filled with its juice.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੀ ਬਾੜੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ih a(n)mrit kee baaRee hai re tin har poorai kareeaa ||1||
english: This world is a garden of Ambrosial Nectar. The Perfect Lord created it. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾਨੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਰੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jaanee jaanee re raajaa raam kee kahaanee ||
english: I have come to know the story of my Sovereign Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar jot raam paragaasaa guramukh biralai jaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: How rare is that Gurmukh who knows, and whose inner being is illumined by the Lord's Light. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪੁਹਪ ਰਸ ਬੀਧਾ ਬਾਰਹ ਲੇ ਉਰ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bhavar ek puhap ras beedhaa baarah le ur dhariaa ||
english: The bumble bee, addicted to the nectar of the twelve-petalled flowers, enshrines it in the heart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਹ ਮਧੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਝਕੋਰਿਆ ਆਕਾਸੇ ਫਰੁ ਫਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sorah madhe pavan jhakoriaa aakaase phar phariaa ||2||
english: He holds his breath suspended in the sixteen-petalled sky of the Akaashic Ethers, and beats his wings in esctasy. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਧਰਤੀ ਜਲਹਰੁ ਸੋਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sahaj su(n)n ik biravaa upajiaa dharatee jalahar sokhiaa ||
english: In the profound void of intuitive Samaadhi, the one tree rises up; it soaks up the water of desire from the ground.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ॥੩॥੬॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer hau taa kaa sevak jin ihu biravaa dekhiaa ||3||6||
english: Says Kabeer, I am the servant of those who have seen this celestial tree. ||3||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੋਨਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਝੋਲੀ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)draa mon daiaa kar jholee patr kaa karahu beechaar re ||
