english: Make silence your ear-rings, and compassion your wallet; let meditation be your begging bowl.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਅਉ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khi(n)thaa ihu tan seeau apanaa naam karau aadhaar re ||1||
english: Sew this body as your patched coat, and take the Lord's Name as your support. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: aisaa jog kamaavahu jogee ||
english: Practice such Yoga, O Yogi.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੋਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam guramukh bhogee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As Gurmukh, enjoy meditation, austerities and self-discipline. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਚਢਾਵਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸਿੰਗੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: budh bibhoot chadhaavau apunee si(n)gee surat milaaee ||
english: Apply the ashes of wisdom to your body; let your horn be your focused consciousness.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਫਿਰਉ ਤਨਿ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਬਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kar bairaag phirau tan nagaree man kee ki(n)guree bajaaee ||2||
english: Become detached, and wander through the city of your body; play the harp of your mind. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਲੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮ ਤਾੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch tat lai hiradai raakhahu rahai niraalam taaRee ||
english: Enshrine the five tatvas - the five elements, within your heart; let your deep meditative trance be undisturbed.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਬਾੜੀ ॥੩॥੭॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu dharam daiaa kar baaRee ||3||7||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: make righteousness and compassion your garden. ||3||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਾਜ ਸਿਰਜੇ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਵਨ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kavan kaaj siraje jag bheetar janam kavan phal paaiaa ||
english: For what purpose were you created and brought into the world? What rewards have you received in this life?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhav nidh taran taaran chi(n)taaman ik nimakh na ihu man laaiaa ||1||
english: God is the boat to carry you across the terrifying world-ocean; He is the Fulfiller of the mind's desires. You have not centered your mind on Him, even for an instant. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹਮ ਐਸੇ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ॥
transliteration: gobi(n)d ham aise aparaadhee ||
english: O Lord of the Universe, I am such a sinner!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਥਾ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jin prabh jeeu pi(n)d thaa deeaa tis kee bhaau bhagat nahee saadhee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God gave me body and soul, but I have not practiced loving devotional worship to Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਤੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰ ਅਪਬਾਦੁ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
transliteration: par dhan par tan par tee ni(n)daa par apabaad na chhootai ||
english: Others' wealth, others' bodies, others' wives, others' slander and others' fights - I have not given them up.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਹੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਪਰਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aavaa gavan hot hai phun phun ihu parasa(n)g na tootai ||2||
english: For the sake of these, coming and going in reincarnation happens over and over again, and this story never ends. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਘਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਹੋਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਕੀਨੑੋ ਮੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jih ghar kathaa hot har sa(n)tan ik nimakh na keenho mai pheraa ||
english: That house, in which the Saints speak of the Lord - I have not visited it, even for an instant.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੰਪਟ ਚੋਰ ਦੂਤ ਮਤਵਾਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: la(n)pat chor doot matavaare tin sa(n)g sadaa baseraa ||3||
english: Drunkards, thieves, and evil-doers - I constantly dwell with them. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਏ ਸੰਪੈ ਮੋ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh maaiaa mad matasar e sa(n)pai mo maahee ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, the wine of Maya, and envy - these are what I collect within myself.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਏ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: daiaa dharam ar gur kee sevaa e supana(n)tar naahee ||4||
english: Compassion, righteousness, and service to the Guru - these do not visit me, even in my dreams. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲ ਭੈ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: deen daiaal kripaal damodar bhagat bachhal bhai haaree ||
english: He is merciful to the meek, compassionate and benevolent, the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਭੀਰ ਜਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੮॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer bheer jan raakhahu har sevaa karau tumhaaree ||5||8||
english: Says Kabeer, please protect Your humble servant from disaster; O Lord, I serve only You. ||5||8||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jih simaran hoi mukat duaar ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, the door of liberation is found.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾਹਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jaahi baiku(n)th nahee sa(n)saar ||
english: You shall go to heaven, and not return to this earth.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਬਜਾਵਹਿ ਤੂਰ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau kai ghar bajaavahi toor ||
english: In the home of the Fearless Lord, the celestial trumpets resound.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਜਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਭਰਪੂਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anahad bajahi sadaa bharapoor ||1||
english: The unstruck sound current will vibrate and resonate forever. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aisaa simaran kar man maahi ||
english: Practice such meditative remembrance in your mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਤ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bin simaran mukat kat naahi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without this meditative remembrance, liberation will never be found. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਨਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jih simaran naahee nanakaar ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, you will meet with no obstruction.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਉਤਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mukat karai utarai bahu bhaar ||
english: You will be liberated, and the great load will be taken away.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: namasakaar kar hiradai maahi ||
english: Bow in humility within your heart,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਵਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: phir phir teraa aavan naahi ||2||
english: and you will not have to be reincarnated over and over again. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਕੇਲ ॥
transliteration: jih simaran karahi too kel ||
english: Remember Him in meditation, celebrate and be happy.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕੁ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੇਲ ॥
transliteration: deepak baa(n)dh dhario bin tel ||
english: God has placed His lamp deep within you, which burns without any oil.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਅਮਰਕੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: so deepak amarak sa(n)saar ||
english: That lamp makes the world immortal;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾਢੀਲੇ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaam krodh bikh kaadheele maar ||3||
english: it conquers and drives out the poisons of sexual desire and anger. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jih simaran teree gat hoi ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, you shall obtain salvation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਰਖੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: so simaran rakh ka(n)th paroi ||
english: Wear that meditative remembrance as your necklace.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: so simaran kar nahee raakh utaar ||
english: Practice that meditative remembrance, and never let it go.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee utarahi paar ||4||
english: By Guru's Grace, you shall cross over. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਹਿ ਕਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: jih simaran naahee tuhi kaan ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, you shall not be obligated to others.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਸੋਵਹਿ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਤਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)dar sovahi pata(n)bar taan ||
english: You shall sleep in your mansion, in blankets of silk.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: sej sukhaalee bigasai jeeu ||
english: Your soul shall blossom forth in happiness, on this comfortable bed.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਤੂ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪੀਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: so simaran too anadin peeu ||5||
english: So drink in this meditative remembrance, night and day. ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਾਇ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jih simaran teree jaai balaai ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, your troubles will depart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਪੋਹੈ ਨ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jih simaran tujh pohai na maai ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, Maya will not bother you.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: simar simar har har man gaaeeai ||
english: Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har, and sing His Praises in your mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ihu simaran satigur te paaeeai ||6||
english: This meditative remembrance is obtained from the True Guru. ||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa simar din raat ||
english: Forever and ever, remember Him, day and night,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: oothat baithat saas giraas ||
english: while standing up and sitting down, with every breath and morsel of food.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗੁ ਸੋਇ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
transliteration: jaag soi simaran ras bhog ||
english: While awake and asleep, enjoy the essence of this meditative remembrance.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har simaran paaeeai sa(n)jog ||7||
english: The Lord's meditative remembrance is obtained by good destiny. ||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਝੁ ਭਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jih simaran naahee tujh bhaar ||
english: Remembering Him in meditation, you shall not be loaded down.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: so simaran raam naam adhaar ||
english: Make this meditative remembrance of the Lord's Name your Support.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer jaa kaa nahee a(n)t ||
english: Says Kabeer, He has no limits;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਆਗੇ ਤੰਤੁ ਨ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੮॥੯॥
transliteration: tis ke aage ta(n)t na ma(n)t ||8||9||
english: no tantras or mantras can be used against Him. ||8||9||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee ghar 2 baanee kabeer jee kee ||
english: Raamkalee, Second House, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਚਿ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhach ba(n)dhan paaiaa ||
english: Maya, the Trapper, has sprung her trap.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਨਲੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mukatai gur anal bujhaaiaa ||
english: The Guru, the Liberated One, has put out the fire.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਨਖ ਸਿਖ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੀਨੑਾ ॥
transliteration: jab nakh sikh ihu man cheenhaa ||
english: When I came to understand this mind, from the tips of my toes to the crown of my head,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਨੑਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tab a(n)tar majan keenhaa ||1||
english: then I took my cleansing bath, deep within my self. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਵਨਪਤਿ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਖਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pavanapat unaman rahan kharaa ||
english: The mind, the master of the breath, abides in the state of supreme bliss.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nahee mirat na janam jaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: There is no death, no re-birth, and no aging for me now. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਲਟੀ ਲੇ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਹਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: ulatee le sakat sahaara(n) ||
english: Turning away from materialism, I have found intuitive support.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੈਸੀਲੇ ਗਗਨ ਮਝਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: paiseele gagan majhaara(n) ||
english: I have entered into the sky of the mind, and opened the Tenth Gate.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੇਧੀਅਲੇ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਭੁਅੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: bedheeale chakr bhua(n)gaa ||
english: The chakras of the coiled Kundalini energy have been opened,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭੇਟੀਅਲੇ ਰਾਇ ਨਿਸੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bheteeale raai nisa(n)gaa ||2||
english: and I have met my Sovereign Lord King without fear. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੂਕੀਅਲੇ ਮੋਹ ਮਇਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: chookeeale moh maiaasaa ||
english: My attachment to Maya has been eradicated;

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਸਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੂਰ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: sas keeno soor giraasaa ||
english: the moon energy has devoured the sun energy.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਕੁੰਭਕੁ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jab ku(n)bhak bharipur leenaa ||
english: When I was focused and merged into the all-pervading Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tah baaje anahad beenaa ||3||
english: then the unstruck sound current began to vibrate. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਕਤੈ ਬਕਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bakatai bak sabad sunaaiaa ||
english: The Speaker has spoken, and proclaimed the Word of the Shabad.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਤੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਬਸਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sunatai sun ma(n)n basaaiaa ||
english: The hearer has heard, and enshrined it in the mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: kar karataa utaras paara(n) ||
english: Chanting to the Creator, one crosses over.

author: Bhagat Kabir
transliteration: kahai kabeeraa saara(n) ||4||1||10||
english: Says Kabeer, this is the essence. ||4||1||10||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)d sooraj dui jot saroop ||
english: The moon and the sun are both the embodiment of light.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jotee a(n)tar braham anoop ||1||
english: Within their light, is God, the incomparable. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kar re giaanee braham beechaar ||
english: O spiritual teacher, contemplate God.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ਪਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jotee a(n)tar dhariaa pasaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In this light is contained the expanse of the created universe. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੀਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਹੀਰੇ ਕਰਉ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
transliteration: heeraa dekh heere karau aades ||
english: Gazing upon the diamond, I humbly salute this diamond.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਲੇਖੁ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: kahai kabeer nira(n)jan alekh ||2||2||11||
english: Says Kabeer, the Immaculate Lord is indescribable. ||2||2||11||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਹੁਸੀਆਰ ਬੇਦਾਰ ਜਾਗਤ ਮੁਸੀਅਤ ਹਉ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: duneeaa huseeaar bedaar jaagat museeat hau re bhaaee ||
english: People of the world, remain awake and aware. Even though you are awake, you are being robbed, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਗਮ ਹੁਸੀਆਰ ਪਹਰੂਆ ਦੇਖਤ ਜਮੁ ਲੇ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nigam huseeaar paharooaa dekhat jam le jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: While the Vedas stand guard watching, the Messenger of Death carries you away. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨੀੰਬੁ ਭਇਓ ਆਂਬੁ ਆਂਬੁ ਭਇਓ ਨੀੰਬਾ ਕੇਲਾ ਪਾਕਾ ਝਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: nee(n)b bhaio aa(n)b aa(n)b bhaio nee(n)baa kelaa paakaa jhaar ||
english: He thinks that the bitter nimm fruit is a mango, and the mango is a bitter nimm. He imagines the ripe banana on the thorny bush.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਲੀਏਰ ਫਲੁ ਸੇਬਰਿ ਪਾਕਾ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naaleeer phal sebar paakaa moorakh mugadh gavaar ||1||
english: He thinks that the ripe coconut hangs on the barren simmal tree; what a stupid, idiotic fool he is! ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਇਓ ਖਾਂਡੁ ਰੇਤੁ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਖਰਿਓ ਹਸਤੀੰ ਚੁਨਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har bhaio khaa(n)d ret mahi bikhario hasatee(n) chunio na jaaee ||
english: The Lord is like sugar, spilled onto the sand; the elephant cannot pick it up.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਮੀਰ ਕੁਲ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਾਂਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਚੀਟੀ ਹੋਇ ਚੁਨਿ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੨॥
transliteration: kahi kameer kul jaat paa(n)t taj cheetee hoi chun khaaee ||2||3||12||
english: Says Kabeer, give up your ancestry, social status and honor; be like the tiny ant - pick up and eat the sugar. ||2||3||12||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: baanee naamadeu jeeu kee raamakalee ghar 1 ||
english: The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, Raamkalee, First House:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਾਟੀਲੇ ਗੂਡੀ ਆਕਾਸ ਮਧੇ ਭਰਮੀਅਲੇ ॥
transliteration: aaneele kaagad kaateele goodee aakaas madhe bharameeale ||
english: The boy takes paper, cuts it and makes a kite, and flies it in the sky.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਊਆ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਡੋਰੀ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch janaa siu baat bataooaa cheet s doree raakheeale ||1||
english: Talking with his friends, he still keeps his attention on the kite string. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਬੇਧੀਅਲੇ ॥
transliteration: man raam naamaa bedheeale ||
english: My mind has been pierced by the Name of the Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਲਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਮਾਂਡੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaise kanik kalaa chit maa(n)deeale ||1|| rahaau ||
english: like the goldsmith, whose attention is held by his work. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਭਰਾਈਲੇ ਊਦਕ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਆਰਿ ਪੁਰੰਦਰੀਏ ॥
transliteration: aaneele ku(n)bh bharaaeele oodak raaj kuaar pura(n)dareee ||
english: The young girl in the city takes a pitcher, and fills it with water.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਕਰਤੀ ਹੈ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hasat binod beechaar karatee hai cheet s gaagar raakheeale ||2||
english: She laughs, and plays, and talks with her friends, but she keeps her attention focused on the pitcher of water. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਦੁਆਰ ਦਸ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਵਨ ਛਾਡੀਅਲੇ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)dar ek duaar das jaa ke gaoo charaavan chhaadeeale ||
english: The cow is let loose, out of the mansion of the ten gates, to graze in the field.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚ ਕੋਸ ਪਰ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਬਛਰਾ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paa(n)ch kos par gaoo charaavat cheet s bachharaa raakheeale ||3||
english: It grazes up to five miles away, but keeps its attention focused on its calf. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤਿਲੋਚਨ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਪਾਲਨ ਪਉਢੀਅਲੇ ॥
transliteration: kahat naamadeu sunahu tilochan baalak paalan paudheeale ||
english: Says Naam Dayv, listen, O Trilochan: the child is laid down in the cradle.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਬਿਰੂਧੀ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar kaaj biroodhee cheet s baarik raakheeale ||4||1||
english: Its mother is at work, inside and outside, but she holds her child in her thoughts. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਆਨੰਤਾ ਗੀਤ ਕਬਿਤ ਨ ਗਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan saasatr aana(n)taa geet kabit na gaavaugo ||
english: There are countless Vedas, Puraanas and Shaastras; I do not sing their songs and hymns.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੇਨੁ ਬਜਾਵਉਗੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: akha(n)d ma(n)dal nira(n)kaar mahi anahad ben bajaavaugo ||1||
english: In the imperishable realm of the Formless Lord, I play the flute of the unstruck sound current. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਗਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
transliteration: bairaagee raamahi gaavaugo ||
english: Becoming detached, I sing the Lord's Praises.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤੀਤ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਆਕੁਲ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabad ateet anaahad raataa aakul kai ghar jaaugo ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Imbued with the unattached, unstruck Word of the Shabad, I shall go to the home of the Lord, who has no ancestors. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਅਉਰੁ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਪਉਨੈ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਹਾਉਗੋ ॥
transliteration: iRaa pi(n)gulaa aur sukhamanaa paunai ba(n)dh rahaaugo ||
english: Then, I shall no longer control the breath through the energy channels of the Ida, Pingala and Shushmanaa.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਉਗੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: cha(n)d sooraj dui sam kar raakhau braham jot mil jaaugo ||2||
english: I look upon both the moon and the sun as the same, and I shall merge in the Light of God. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਪੈਸਉ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਨ ਸਤਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
transliteration: teerath dekh na jal mahi paisau jee ja(n)t na sataavaugo ||
english: I do not go to see sacred shrines of pilgrimage, or bathe in their waters; I do not bother any beings or creatures.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨੑਾਉਗੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: athasath teerath guroo dikhaae ghat hee bheetar nhaaugo ||3||
english: The Guru has shown me the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage within my own heart, where I now take my cleansing bath. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਭਲੋ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕਹਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch sahaaee jan kee sobhaa bhalo bhalo na kahaavaugo ||
english: I do not pay attention to anyone praising me, or calling me good and nice.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਉਗੋ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naamaa kahai chit har siu raataa su(n)n samaadh samaaugo ||4||2||
english: Says Naam Dayv, my consciousness is imbued with the Lord; I am absorbed in the profound state of Samaadhi. ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maai na hotee baap na hotaa karam na hotee kaaiaa ||
english: When there was no mother and no father, no karma and no human body,

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤੇ ਕਵਨੁ ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ham nahee hote tum nahee hote kavan kahaa(n) te aaiaa ||1||
english: when I was not and you were not, then who came from where? ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: raam koi na kis hee keraa ||
english: O Lord, no one belongs to anyone else.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਰਵਰਿ ਪੰਖਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaise taravar pa(n)kh baseraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: We are like birds perched on a tree. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਸੂਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਪਾਨੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)d na hotaa soor na hotaa paanee pavan milaaiaa ||
english: When there was no moon and no sun, then water and air were blended together.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਬੇਦੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saasat na hotaa bed na hotaa karam kahaa(n) te aaiaa ||2||
english: When there were no Shaastras and no Vedas, then where did karma come from? ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਖੇਚਰ ਭੂਚਰ ਤੁਲਸੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: khechar bhoochar tulasee maalaa gur parasaadee paaiaa ||
english: Control of the breath and positioning of the tongue, focusing at the third eye and wearing malas of tulsi beads, are all obtained through Guru's Grace.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥
transliteration: naamaa pranavai param tat hai satigur hoi lakhaaiaa ||3||3||
english: Naam Dayv prays, this is the supreme essence of reality; the True Guru has inspired this realization. ||3||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee ghar 2 ||
english: Raamkalee, Second House:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਾਨਾਰਸੀ ਤਪੁ ਕਰੈ ਉਲਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਰੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਦਹੈ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਲਪੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: baanaarasee tap karai ulat teerath marai agan dahai kaaiaa kalap keejai ||
english: Someone may practice austerities at Benares, or die upside-down at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage, or burn his body in fire, or rejuvenate his body to live almost forever;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਸੁਮੇਧ ਜਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਸੋਨਾ ਗਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: asumedh jag keejai sonaa garabh daan deejai raam naam sar taoo na poojai ||1||
english: he may perform the horse-sacrifice ceremony, or give donations of gold covered over, but none of these is equal to the worship of the Lord's Name. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਰੇ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਮਨ ਕਪਟੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: chhod chhod re paakha(n)dee man kapat na keejai ||
english: O hypocrite, renounce and abandon your hypocrisy; do not practice deception.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam nit nitahi leejai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Constantly, continually, chant the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੰਗਾ ਜਉ ਗੋਦਾਵਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁੰਭਿ ਜਉ ਕੇਦਾਰ ਨੑਾਈਐ ਗੋਮਤੀ ਸਹਸ ਗਊ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)gaa jau godaavar jaaeeai ku(n)bh jau kedaar nhaaeeai gomatee sahas gaoo daan keejai ||
english: Someone may go to the Ganges or the Godaavari, or to the Kumbha festival, or bathe at Kaydaar Naat'h, or make donations of thousands of cows at Gomti;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰੈ ਤਨੁ ਜਉ ਹਿਵਾਲੇ ਗਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kot jau teerath karai tan jau hivaale gaarai raam naam sar taoo na poojai ||2||
english: he may make millions of pilgrimages to sacred shrines, or freeze his body in the Himalayas; still, none of these is equal to the worship of the Lord's Name. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਸੁ ਦਾਨ ਗਜ ਦਾਨ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਨਾਰੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨ ਐਸੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: as daan gaj daan sihajaa naaree bhoom daan aiso daan nit nitahi keejai ||
english: Someone may give away horses and elephants, or women on their beds, or land; he may give such gifts over and over again.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਜਉ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਪ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aatam jau niramaail keejai aap baraabar ka(n)chan deejai raam naam sar taoo na poojai ||3||
english: He may purify his soul, and give away in charity his body weight in gold; none of these is equal to the worship of the Lord's Name. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਿ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੋਸੁ ਜਮਹਿ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨੑਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: manahi na keejai ros jamahi na deejai dos niramal nirabaan pad cheenhi leejai ||
english: Do not harbor anger in your mind, or blame the Messenger of Death; instead, realize the immaculate state of Nirvaanaa.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਸਰਥ ਰਾਇ ਨੰਦੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਚੰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਤਤੁ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jasarath raai na(n)d raajaa meraa raam cha(n)d pranavai naamaa tat ras a(n)mrit peejai ||4||4||
english: My Sovereign Lord King is Raam Chandra, the Son of the King Dasrat'h; prays Naam Dayv, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||4||4||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee baanee ravidaas jee kee ||
english: Raamkalee, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਨੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਅਨਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦਰਸੈ ॥
transliteration: paReeai guneeai naam sabh suneeai anabhau bhaau na darasai ||
english: They read and reflect upon all the Names of God; they listen, but they do not see the Lord, the embodiment of love and intuition.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਲੋਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹਿਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਉ ਪਾਰਸਹਿ ਨ ਪਰਸੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lohaa ka(n)chan hiran hoi kaise jau paarasahi na parasai ||1||
english: How can iron be transformed into gold, unless it touches the Philosopher's Stone? ||1||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵ ਸੰਸੈ ਗਾਂਠਿ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
transliteration: dev sa(n)sai gaa(n)th na chhootai ||
english: O Divine Lord, the knot of skepticism cannot be untied.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਇਨ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਲੂਟੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh maaiaa mad matasar in pa(n)chahu mil loote ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, Maya, intoxication and jealousy - these five have combined to plunder the world. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਡ ਕਬਿ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਹਮ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹਮ ਜੋਗੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥
transliteration: ham bad kab kuleen ham pa(n)dit ham jogee sa(n)niaasee ||
english: I am a great poet, of noble heritage; I am a Pandit, a religious scholar, a Yogi and a Sannyaasi;

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਨੀ ਸੂਰ ਹਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਹ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਨਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: giaanee gunee soor ham daate ih budh kabahi na naasee ||2||
english: I am a spiritual teacher, a warrior and a giver - such thinking never ends. ||2||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਭੈ ਨਹੀ ਸਮਝਸਿ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਉਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kahu ravidaas sabhai nahee samajhas bhool pare jaise baure ||
english: Says Ravi Daas, no one understands; they all run around, deluded like madmen.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਮੋਰੇ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: mohi adhaar naam naaraain jeevan praan dhan more ||3||1||
english: The Lord's Name is my only Support; He is my life, my breath of life, my wealth. ||3||1||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੇਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raamakalee baanee benee jeeu kee ||
english: Raamkalee, The Word Of Baynee Jee:

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਅਉਰ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ॥
transliteration: iRaa pi(n)gulaa aur sukhamanaa teen basahi ik thaaee ||
english: The energy channels of the Ida, Pingala and Shushmanaa: these three dwell in one place.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਬੇਣੀ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਤਹ ਪਿਰਾਗੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਥਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: benee sa(n)gam tah piraag man majan kare tithaaee ||1||
english: This is the true place of confluence of the three sacred rivers: this is where my mind takes its cleansing bath. ||1||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਤਹਾ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu tahaa nira(n)jan raam hai ||
english: O Saints, the Immaculate Lord dwells there;

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਮਿ ਚੀਨੈ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gur gam cheenai biralaa koi ||
english: how rare are those who go to the Guru, and understand this.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਤਹਾਂ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਮਈਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tahaa(n) nira(n)jan ramaeeaa hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The all-pervading immaculate Lord is there. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵ ਸਥਾਨੈ ਕਿਆ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: dev sathaanai kiaa neesaanee ||
english: What is the insignia of the Divine Lord's dwelling?

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਬਾਜੇ ਸਬਦ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: tah baaje sabad anaahad baanee ||
english: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates there.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਪਉਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: tah cha(n)d na sooraj paun na paanee ||
english: There is no moon or sun, no air or water there.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਸਾਖੀ ਜਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saakhee jaagee guramukh jaanee ||2||
english: The Gurmukh becomes aware, and knows the Teachings. ||2||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਉਪਜੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: upajai giaan duramat chheejai ||
english: Spiritual wisdom wells up, and evil-mindedness departs;

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਿ ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit ras gagana(n)tar bheejai ||
english: the nucleus of the mind sky is drenched with Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਏਸੁ ਕਲਾ ਜੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
transliteration: es kalaa jo jaanai bheu ||
english: One who knows the secret of this device,

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾਸੁ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhetai taas param guradeu ||3||
english: meets the Supreme Divine Guru. ||3||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਦਸਮ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਘਾਟੀ ॥
transliteration: dasam duaaraa agam apaaraa param purakh kee ghaatee ||
english: The Tenth Gate is the home of the inaccessible, infinite Supreme Lord.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਟੁ ਹਾਟ ਪਰਿ ਆਲਾ ਆਲੇ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਥਾਤੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: oopar haat haat par aalaa aale bheetar thaatee ||4||
english: Above the store is a niche, and within this niche is the commodity. ||4||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਸੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaagat rahai s kabahu na sovai ||
english: One who remains awake, never sleeps.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਤਿਲੋਕ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਪਲੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: teen tilok samaadh palovai ||
english: The three qualities and the three worlds vanish, in the state of Samaadhi.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਬੀਜ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਲੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: beej ma(n)tr lai hiradai rahai ||
english: He takes the Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra, and keeps it in his heart.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਉਲਟਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਮਹਿ ਗਹੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: manooaa ulat su(n)n mahi gahai ||5||
english: Turning his mind away from the world, he focuses on the cosmic void of the absolute Lord. ||5||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਅਲੀਆ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: jaagat rahai na aleeaa bhaakhai ||
english: He remains awake, and he does not lie.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਪਾਚਉ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਬਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: paachau i(n)dree bas kar raakhai ||
english: He keeps the five sensory organs under his control.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kee saakhee raakhai cheet ||
english: He cherishes in his consciousness the Guru's Teachings.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: man tan arapai krisan pareet ||6||
english: He dedicates his mind and body to the Lord's Love. ||6||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਪਲਵ ਸਾਖਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kar palav saakhaa beechaare ||
english: He considers his hands to be the leaves and branches of the tree.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: apanaa janam na jooai haare ||
english: He does not lose his life in the gamble.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਅਸੁਰ ਨਦੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੈ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
transliteration: asur nadee kaa ba(n)dhai mool ||
english: He plugs up the source of the river of evil tendencies.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਪਛਿਮ ਫੇਰਿ ਚੜਾਵੈ ਸੂਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pachhim pher chaRaavai soor ||
english: Turning away from the west, he makes the sun rise in the east.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ajar jarai s nijhar jharai ||
english: He bears the unbearable, and the drops trickle down within;

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਸਿਉ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਕਰੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jaga(n)naath siu gosat karai ||7||
english: then, he speaks with the Lord of the world. ||7||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਚਉਮੁਖ ਦੀਵਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
transliteration: chaumukh deevaa jot duaar ||
english: The four-sided lamp illuminates the Tenth Gate.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਪਲੂ ਅਨਤ ਮੂਲੁ ਬਿਚਕਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: paloo anat mool bichakaar ||
english: The Primal Lord is at the center of the countless leaves.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਰਹੈ ॥
transliteration: sarab kalaa le aape rahai ||
english: He Himself abides there with all His powers.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਰਤਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਹੈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: man maanak ratanaa mahi guhai ||8||
english: He weaves the jewels into the pearl of the mind. ||8||

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪਦਮੁ ਦੁਆਲੈ ਮਣੀ ॥
transliteration: masatak padam duaalai manee ||
english: The lotus is at the forehead, and the jewels surround it.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਣੀ ॥
transliteration: maahi nira(n)jan tribhavan dhanee ||
english: Within it is the Immaculate Lord, the Master of the three worlds.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲ ਬਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch sabad niramaail baaje ||
english: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, resound and vibrate their in their purity.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਢੁਲਕੇ ਚਵਰ ਸੰਖ ਘਨ ਗਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: dhulake chavar sa(n)kh ghan gaaje ||
english: The chauris - the fly brushes wave, and the conch shells blare like thunder.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
gurmukhi: ਦਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਦੈਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: dal mal daitahu guramukh giaan ||
english: The Gurmukh tramples the demons underfoot with his spiritual wisdom.

author: Bhagat Bēṇi
transliteration: benee jaachai teraa naam ||9||1||
english: Baynee longs for Your Name, Lord. ||9||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag nat naaraain mahalaa 4 ||
english: Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mere man jap ahinis naam hare ||
english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, day and night.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ ਸਭ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਧਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot kot dokh bahu keene sabh parahar paas dhare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Millions and millions of sins and mistakes, committed through countless lifetimes, shall all be put aside and sent away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਖਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahi aaraadhahi sevak bhaai khare ||
english: Those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and worship Him in adoration, and serve Him with love, are genuine.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kilabikh dokh gae sabh neekar jiu paanee mail hare ||1||
english: All their sins are erased, just as water washes off the dirt. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਨਰ ਨਰਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: khin khin nar naaraain gaavahi mukh bolahi nar narahare ||
english: That being, who sings the Lord's Praises each and every instant, chants with his mouth the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch dokh asaadh nagar mahi ik khin pal door kare ||2||
english: In a moment, in an instant, the Lord rids him of the five incurable diseases of the body-village. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee har naam dhiaavahi har ke bhagat hare ||
english: Very fortunate are those who meditate on the Lord's Name; they alone are the Lord's devotees.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚਉ ਮੈ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tin kee sa(n)gat dehi prabh jaachau mai mooR mugadh nisatare ||3||
english: I beg for the Sangat, the Congregation; O God, please bless me with them. I am a fool, and an idiot - please save me! ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kripaa kripaa dhaar jagajeevan rakh levahu saran pare ||
english: Shower me with Your Mercy and Grace, O Life of the World; save me, I seek Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak jan tumaree saranaaee har raakhahu laaj hare ||4||1||
english: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary; O Lord, please preserve my honor! ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
english: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਲੇ ॥
transliteration: raam jap jan raamai naam rale ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, His humble servants are blended with the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam naam japio gur bachanee har dhaaree har kripale ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name, following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਜਪਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲ ਸਲਲੇ ॥
transliteration: har har agam agochar suaamee jan jap mil salal salale ||
english: Our Lord and Master, Har, Har, is inaccessible and unfathomable. Meditating on Him, His humble servant merges with Him, like water with water.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਮ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t mil raam ras paaiaa ham jan kai bal balale ||1||
english: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to His humble servants. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨਿ ਗਾਇਓ ਸਭਿ ਦਾਲਦ ਦੁਖ ਦਲਲੇ ॥
transliteration: purakhotam har naam jan gaaio sabh daalad dukh dalale ||
english: The Lord's humble servant sings the Praises of the Name of the Supreme, Primal Soul, and all poverty and pain are destroyed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਪਰਲੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: vich dehee dokh asaadh pa(n)ch dhaatoo har keee khin parale ||2||
english: Within the body are the five evil and uncontrollable passions. The Lord destroys them in an instant. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਸਿ ਕਮਲੇ ॥
transliteration: har ke sa(n)t man preet lagaaee jiu dekhai sas kamale ||
english: The Lord's Saint loves the Lord in his mind, like the lotus flower gazing at the moon.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਨਵੈ ਘਨੁ ਘਨ ਘਨਿਹਰੁ ਗਰਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮੋਰ ਮੁਰਲੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: unavai ghan ghan ghanihar garajai man bigasai mor murale ||3||
english: The clouds hang low, the clouds tremble with thunder, and the mind dances joyfully like the peacock. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲੋਚ ਹਮ ਲਾਈ ਹਮ ਜੀਵਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥
transliteration: hamarai suaamee loch ham laaee ham jeevah dekh har mile ||
english: My Lord and Master has placed this yearning within me; I live by seeing and meeting my Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਅਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਅਨਦ ਭਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak har amal har laae har melahu anad bhale ||4||2||
english: Servant Nanak is addicted to the intoxication of the Lord; meeting with the Lord, he finds sublime bliss. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
english: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖੇ ॥
transliteration: mere man jap har har naam sakhe ||
english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, your only Friend.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪਖੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har naam dhiaaio ham satigur charan pakhe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Name of the Lord; I wash the Feet of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਰਖੇ ॥
transliteration: ootam jaga(n)naath jagadeesur ham paapee saran rakhe ||
english: The Exalted Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe, keeps a sinner like me in His Sanctuary

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tum vad purakh deen dukh bha(n)jan har deeo naam mukhe ||1||
english: You are the Greatest Being, Lord, Destroyer of the pains of the meek; You have placed Your Name in my mouth, Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਹਮ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖੇ ॥
transliteration: har gun ooch neech ham gaae gur satigur sa(n)g sakhe ||
english: I am lowly, but I sing the Lofty Praises of the Lord, meeting with the Guru, the True Guru, my Friend.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿੰਮੁ ਬਿਰਖਾ ਗੁਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਕੇ ਬਸਖੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu cha(n)dan sa(n)g basai ni(n)m birakhaa gun cha(n)dan ke basakhe ||2||
english: Like the bitter nimm tree, growing near the sandalwood tree, I am permeated with the fragrance of sandalwood. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਅਵਗਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਨਿਮਖੇ ॥
transliteration: hamare avagan bikhiaa bikhai ke bahu baar baar nimakhe ||
english: My faults and sins of corruption are countless; over and over again, I commit them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਨਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਥਰ ਭਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਖੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: avaganiaare paathar bhaare har taare sa(n)g janakhe ||3||
english: I am unworthy, I am a heavy stone sinking down; but the Lord has carried me across, in association with His humble servants. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਕ੍ਰਿਖੇ ॥
transliteration: jin kau tum har raakhahu suaamee sabh tin ke paap krikhe ||
english: Those whom You save, Lord - all their sins are destroyed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਦੁਸਟ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਰਣਖੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: jan naanak ke daiaal prabh suaamee tum dusat taare haranakhe ||4||3||
english: O Merciful God, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, You have carried across even evil villains like Harnaakhash. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
english: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
transliteration: mere man jap har har raam ra(n)ge ||
english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਜਨ ਪਗਿ ਲਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har kripaa karee jagadeesur har dhiaaio jan pag lage ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When the Lord of the Universe, Har, Har, granted His Grace, then I fell at the feet of the humble, and I meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਹਮ ਅਬ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਗੇ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke bhool chook ham ab aae prabh saranage ||
english: Mistaken and confused for so many past lives, I have now come and entered the Sanctuary of God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਵਡ ਪਾਪਗੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tum saranaagat pratipaalak suaamee ham raakhahu vad paapage ||1||
english: O my Lord and Master, You are the Cherisher of those who come to Your Sanctuary. I am such a great sinner - please save me! ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਗੇ ॥
transliteration: tumaree sa(n)gat har ko ko na udhario prabh keee patit pavage ||
english: Associating with You, Lord, who would not be saved? Only God sanctifies the sinners.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਛੀਪਾ ਦੁਸਟਾਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪੈਜ ਜਨਗੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gun gaavat chheepaa dusataario prabh raakhee paij janage ||2||
english: Naam Dayv, the calico printer, was driven out by the evil villains, as he sang Your Glorious Praises; O God, You protected the honor of Your humble servant. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਨਗੇ ॥
transliteration: jo tumare gun gaavahi suaamee hau bal bal bal tinage ||
english: Those who sing Your Glorious Praises, O my Lord and Master - I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਏ ਜਹ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰੀ ਜਨ ਪਗੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhavan bhavan pavitr sabh keee jah dhoor paree jan page ||3||
english: Those houses and homes are sanctified, upon which the dust of the feet of the humble settles. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡਗੇ ॥
transliteration: tumare gun prabh kahi na sakahi ham tum vad vad purakh vadage ||
english: I cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues, God; You are the greatest of the great, O Great Primal Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਸੇਵਹ ਤੁਮ ਜਨ ਪਗੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau daiaa prabh dhaarahu ham sevah tum jan page ||4||4||
english: Please shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, God; I serve at the feet of Yor humble servants. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
english: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨੇ ॥
transliteration: mere man jap har har naam mane ||
english: O my mind, believe in and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗੰਨਾਥਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਬਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaga(n)naath kirapaa prabh dhaaree mat guramat naam bane ||1|| rahaau ||
english: God, the Master of the Universe, has showered His Mercy upon me, and through the Guru's Teachings, my intellect has been molded by the Naam. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਓ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਨੇ ॥
transliteration: har jan har jas har har gaaio upades guroo gur sune ||
english: The Lord's humble servant sings the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, listening to the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਿਵ ਖੇਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਾਨਿ ਲੁਨੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kilabikh paap naam har kaate jiv khet krisaan lune ||1||
english: The Lord's Name cuts down all sins, like the farmer cutting down his crops. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੇ ॥
transliteration: tumaree upamaa tum hee prabh jaanahu ham kahi na sakahi har gune ||
english: You alone know Your Praises, God; I cannot even describe Your Glorious Virtues, Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤੁਮ ਤੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaise tum taise prabh tum hee gun jaanahu prabh apune ||2||
english: You are what You are, God; You alone know Your Glorious Virtues, God. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸ ਬੰਧ ਬਹੁ ਬੰਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਖੁਲ ਖੁਲਨੇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa phaas ba(n)dh bahu ba(n)dhe har japio khul khulane ||
english: The mortals are bound by the many bonds of Maya's noose. Meditating on the Lord, the knot is untied,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਤਦੂਐ ਬਾਂਧਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਖਨੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jiu jal ku(n)char tadooai baa(n)dhio har chetio mokh mukhane ||3||
english: like the elephant, which was caught in the water by the crococile; it remembered the Lord, and chanted the Lord's Name, and was released. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗਨੇ ॥
transliteration: suaamee paarabraham paramesar tum khojahu jug jugane ||
english: O my Lord and Master, Supreme Lord God, Transcendent Lord, throughout the ages, mortals search for You.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਥਾਹ ਪਾਈ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਡਨੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: tumaree thaah paaee nahee paavai jan naanak ke prabh vadane ||4||5||
english: Your extent cannot be estimated or known, O Great God of servant Nanak. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
english: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਵਣੇ ॥
transliteration: mere man kal keerat har pravane ||
english: O my mind, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is worthy and commendable.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰੀ ਲਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har daiaal daiaa prabh dhaaree lag satigur har japane ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When the Merciful Lord God shows kindness and compassion, then one falls at the feet of the True Guru, and meditates on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੁੜਣੇ ॥
transliteration: har tum vad agam agochar suaamee sabh dhiaavahi har ruRane ||
english: O my Lord and Master, You are great, inaccessible and unfathomable; all meditate on You, O Beautiful Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਵਡ ਕਟਾਖ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin kau tumhre vad kataakh hai te guramukh har simarane ||1||
english: Those whom You view with Your Great Eye of Grace, meditate on You, Lord, and become Gurmukh. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜੁਗਣੇ ॥
transliteration: ihu parapa(n)ch keeaa prabh suaamee sabh jagajeevan jugane ||
english: The expanse of this creation is Your work, O God, my Lord and Master, Life of the entire universe, united with all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਉਠਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਣੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu salalai salal uthahi bahu laharee mil salalai salal samane ||2||
english: Countless waves rise up from the water, and then they merge into the water again. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਆ ਸੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਨਹ ਜਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗਹਣੇ ॥
transliteration: jo prabh keeaa s tum hee jaanahu ham nah jaanee har gahane ||
english: You alone, God, know whatever You do. O Lord, I do not know.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਰਿਦ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਿਮਰਣੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ham baarik kau rid usatat dhaarahu ham karah prabhoo simarane ||3||
english: I am Your child; please enshrine Your Praises within my heart, God, so that I may remember You in meditation. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਜੋ ਸੇਵੈ ਸਭ ਫਲਣੇ ॥
transliteration: tum jal nidh har maan sarovar jo sevai sabh phalane ||
english: You are the treasure of water, O Lord, the Maansarovar Lake. Whoever serves You receives all fruitful rewards.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਣੇ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: jan naanak har har har har baa(n)chhai har devahu kar kripane ||4||6||
english: Servant Nanak longs for the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har; bless him, Lord, with Your Mercy. ||4||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
transliteration: nat naaraain mahalaa 4 paRataal ||
english: Nat Naaraayan, Fourth Mehl, Partaal:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵ ਸਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਘਾਲ ॥
transliteration: mere man sev saphal har ghaal ||
english: O my mind, serve the Lord, and receive the fruits of your rewards.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਰੇਨ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
transliteration: le gur pag ren ravaal ||
english: Receive the dust of the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਦਾਲਿਦ ਭੰਜਿ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਲ ॥
transliteration: sabh daalid bha(n)j dukh daal ||
english: All poverty will be eliminated, and your pains will disappear.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ho ho ho nadar nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord shall bless you with His Glance of Grace, and you shall be enraptured. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਲਾਲ ਲਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਲ ॥
transliteration: har kaa grihu har aap savaario har ra(n)g ra(n)g mahal bea(n)t laal laal har laal ||
english: The Lord Himself embellishes His household. The Lord's Mansion of Love is studded with countless jewels, the jewels of the Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਇਓ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਈ ਹੈ ਬਸੀਠੀ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖੇ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har aapanee kripaa karee aap grihi aaio ham har kee gur keeee hai baseethee ham har dekhe bhaee nihaal nihaal nihaal nihaal ||1||
english: The Lord Himself has granted His Grace, and He has come into my home.The Guru is my advocate before the Lord. Gazing upon the Lord, I have become blissful, blissful, blissful. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਵਤੇ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਨਦੋ ਆਨੰਦ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਵਤੇ ਸੁਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਲ ॥
transliteration: har aavate kee khabar gur paaee man tan aanado aana(n)d bhae har aavate sune mere laal har laal ||
english: From the Guru, I received news of the Lord's arrival. My mind and body became ecstatic and blissful, hearing of the arrival of the Lord, my Beloved Love, my Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਭਏ ਗਲਤਾਨ ਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
transliteration: jan naanak har har mile bhae galataan haal nihaal nihaal ||2||1||7||
english: Servant Nanak has met with the Lord, Har, Har; he is intoxicated, enraptured, enraptured. ||2||1||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
english: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਵੰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: man mil sa(n)tasa(n)gat subhava(n)tee ||
english: O mind, join the Society of the Saints, and become noble and exalted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਖਵੰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: sun akath kathaa sukhava(n)tee ||
english: Listen to the Unspoken Speech of the peace-giving Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹੰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh kilabikh paap laha(n)tee ||
english: All sins will be washed away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖੰਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ho ho ho likhat likha(n)tee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meet with the Lord, according to your pre-ordained destiny. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਲਜੁਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਥਾ ਭਜੰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: har keerat kalajug vich ootam mat guramat kathaa bhaja(n)tee ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is lofty and exalted. Following the Guru's Teachings, the intellect dwells on the sermon of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੀ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੰਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin jan sunee manee hai jin jan tis jan kai hau kurabaana(n)tee ||1||
english: I am a sacrifice to that person who listens and believes. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਸਭ ਭੂਖ ਲਹੰਤੀ ॥
transliteration: har akath kathaa kaa jin ras chaakhiaa tis jan sabh bhookh laha(n)tee ||
english: One who tastes the sublime essence of the Unspoken Speech of the Lord - all his hunger is satisfied.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਵੰਤੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak jan har kathaa sun tripate jap har har har hova(n)tee ||2||2||8||
english: Servant Nanak listens to the sermon of the Lord, and is satisfied; chanting the Lord's Name, Har, Har, Har, he has become like the Lord. ||2||2||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
english: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਆਨਿ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਲ ॥
transliteration: koee aan sunaavai har kee har gaal ||
english: If only someone would come and tell me the Lord's sermon.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਾਲ ॥
transliteration: tis kau hau bal bal baal ||
english: I would be a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹੈ ਭਲ ਭਾਲ ॥
transliteration: so har jan hai bhal bhaal ||
english: That humble servant of the Lord is the best of the best.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਮੇਲਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ho ho ho mel nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meeting with the Lord, you be enraptured. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਚਾਲ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਚਾਲ ॥
transliteration: har kaa maarag gur sa(n)t bataaio gur chaal dikhaaee har chaal ||
english: The Guru, the Saint, has shown me the Lord's Path. The Guru has shown me the way to walk on the Lord's Path.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਨਿਹਕਪਟ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਘਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kapat chukaavahu mere gurasikhahu nihakapat kamaavahu har kee har ghaal nihaal nihaal nihaal ||1||
english: Cast out deception from within yourself, O my Gursikhs, and without deception, serve the Lord. You shall be enraptured, enraptured, enraptured. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਏ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: te gur ke sikh mere har prabh bhaae jinaa har prabh jaanio meraa naal ||
english: Those Sikhs of the Guru, who realize that my Lord God is with them, are pleasing to my Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੩॥੯॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau mat har prabh deenee har dekh nikat hadoor nihaal nihaal nihaal nihaal ||2||3||9||
english: The Lord God has blessed servant Nanak with understanding; seeing his Lord hear at hand, his is enraptured, enraptured, enraptured, enraptured. ||2||3||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag nat naaraain mahalaa 5 ||
english: Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: raam hau kiaa jaanaa kiaa bhaavai ||
english: O Lord, how can I know what pleases You?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਸਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man piaas bahut darasaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Within my mind is such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਰੁਚ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: soee giaanee soee jan teraa jis oopar ruch aavai ||
english: He alone is a spiritual teacher, and he alone is Your humble servant, to whom You have given Your approval.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kripaa karahu jis purakh bidhaate so sadaa sadaa tudh dhiaavai ||1||
english: He alone meditates on You forever and ever, O Primal Lord, O Architect of Destiny, unto whom You grant Your Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਜੋਗ ਕਵਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨਾ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨੀ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kavan jog kavan giaan dhiaanaa kavan gunee reejhaavai ||
english: What sort of Yoga, what spiritual wisdom and meditation, and what virtues please You?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਜ ਭਗਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: soee jan soee nij bhagataa jis oopar ra(n)g laavai ||2||
english: He alone is a humble servant, and he alone is God's own devotee, with whom You are in love. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saaee mat saaee budh siaanap jit nimakh na prabh bisaraavai ||
english: That alone is intelligence, that alone is wisdom and cleverness, which inspires one to never forget God, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g lag ehu sukh paaio har gun sad hee gaavai ||3||
english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I have found this peace, singing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿਓ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਦਿਸਟਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dekhio acharaj mahaa ma(n)gal roop kichh aan nahee disataavai ||
english: I have seen the Wondrous Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss, and now, I see nothing else at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਰਚਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਲਾਹਿਓ ਤਹ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਹ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak morachaa gur laahio tah garabh jon kah aavai ||4||1||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has rubbed sway the rust; now how could I ever enter the womb of reincarnation again? ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: nat naaraain mahalaa 5 dupade ||
english: Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਲਾਹਨੋ ਮੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਦੀਓ ॥
transliteration: ulaahano mai kaahoo na deeo ||
english: I don't blame anyone else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੀਠ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਕੀਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man meeth tuhaaro keeo ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever You do is sweet to my mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਜੀਓ ॥
transliteration: aagiaa maan jaan sukh paaiaa sun sun naam tuhaaro jeeo ||
english: Understanding and obeying Your Order, I have found peace; hearing, listening to Your Name, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾਂ ਊਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: eehaa(n) oohaa har tum hee tum hee ihu gur te ma(n)tr driReeo ||1||
english: Here and hereafter, O Lord, You, only You. The Guru has implanted this Mantra within me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿ ਪਾਈ ਏਹ ਬਾਤਾ ਤਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਸਭ ਥੀਓ ॥
transliteration: jab te jaan paaee eh baataa tab kusal khem sabh theeo ||
english: Since I came to realize this, I have been blessed with total peace and pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਓ ਆਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਬੀਓ ॥੨॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak paragaasio aan naahee re beeo ||2||1||2||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, this has been revealed to Nanak, and now, there is no other for him at all. ||2||1||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 5 ||
english: Nat, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਈ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਧੀਰ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau bhaee tumaaree dheer ||
english: Whoever has You for support,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jam kee traas mitee sukh paaiaa nikasee haumai peer ||1|| rahaau ||
english: has the fear of death removed; peace is found, and the disease of egotism is taken away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਖੀਰ ॥
transliteration: tapat bujhaanee a(n)mrit baanee tripate jiu baarik kheer ||
english: The fire within is quenched, and one is satisfied through the Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani, as the baby is satisfied by milk.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਬੀਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maat pitaa saajan sa(n)t mere sa(n)t sahaaee beer ||1||
english: The Saints are my mother, father and friends. The Saints are my help and support, and my brothers. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੁਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਹੀਰੈ ਬੇਧੇ ਹੀਰ ॥
transliteration: khule bhram bheet mile gopaalaa heerai bedhe heer ||
english: The doors of doubt are thrown open, and I have met the Lord of the World; God's diamond has pierced the diamond of my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੨॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: bisam bhae naanak jas gaavat thaakur gunee gaheer ||2||2||3||
english: Nanak blossoms forth in ecstasy, singing the Lord's Praises; my Lord and Master is the ocean of virtue. ||2||2||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 5 ||
english: Nat, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਜਨੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: apanaa jan aapahi aap udhaario ||
english: He Himself saves His humble servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar jan kai sa(n)g basio man te naahi bisaario ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, He dwells with His humble servant; He never forgets him from His Mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਕੁਲੁ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: baran chihan naahee kichh pekhio daas kaa kul na bichaario ||
english: The Lord does not look at his color or form; He does not consider the ancestry of His slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa naam har deeo sahaj subhaai savaario ||1||
english: Granting His Grace, the Lord blesses him with His Name, and embellishes him with intuitive ease. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: mahaa bikham agan kaa saagar tis te paar utaario ||
english: The ocean of fire is treacherous and difficult, but he is carried across.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾਨੋ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੩॥੪॥
transliteration: pekh pekh naanak bigasaano punah punah balihaario ||2||3||4||
english: Seeing, seeing Him, Nanak blossoms forth, over and over again, a sacrifice to Him. ||2||3||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 5 ||
english: Nat, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਿਓ ॥
transliteration: har har man mahi naam kahio ||
english: One who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within his mind

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot apraadh mitahi khin bheetar taa kaa dukh na rahio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: - millions of sins are erased in an instant, and pain is relieved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਇਓ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਹਿਓ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat bhaio bairaagee saadhoo sa(n)g lahio ||
english: Seeking and searching, I have become detached; I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਗਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sagal tiaag ek liv laagee har har charan gahio ||1||
english: Renouncing everything, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord. I grab hold of the feet of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਇਓ ॥
transliteration: kahat mukat sunate nisataare jo jo saran paio ||
english: Whoever chants His Name is liberated; whoever listens to it is saved, as is anyone who seeks His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਓ ॥੨॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: simar simar suaamee prabh apunaa kahu naanak anad bhaio ||2||4||5||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God the Lord and Master, says Nanak, I am in ecstasy! ||2||4||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 5 ||
english: Nat, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਡੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal sa(n)g laagee doree ||
english: I am in love with Your Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar kar param gat moree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Lord, ocean of peace, please bless me with the supreme status. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਚਲਾ ਗਹਾਇਓ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਬੀਧੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਖੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)chalaa gahaaio jan apune kau man beedho prem kee khoree ||
english: He has inspired His humble servant to grasp the hem of His robe; his mind is pierced through with the intoxication of divine love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਜਾਲੀ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jas gaavat bhagat ras upajio maaiaa kee jaalee toree ||1||
english: Singing His Praises, love wells up within the devotee, and the trap of Maya is broken. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਆਨ ਨ ਪੇਖਉ ਹੋਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pooran poor rahe kirapaa nidh aan na pekhau horee ||
english: The Lord, the ocean of mercy, is all-pervading, permeating everywhere; I do not see any other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਓ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਥੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak mel leeo daas apunaa preet na kabahoo thoree ||2||5||6||
english: He has united slave Nanak with Himself; His Love never diminishes. ||2||5||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 5 ||
english: Nat, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: mere man jap jap har naaraain ||
english: O my mind, chant, and meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੇ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kabahoo na bisarahu man mere te aath pahar gun gaain ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I shall never forget Him from my mind; twenty-four hours a day, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo dhoor karau nit majan sabh kilabikh paap gavaain ||
english: I take my daily cleansing bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy, and I am rid of all my sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pooran poor rahe kirapaa nidh ghat ghat disat samaain ||1||
english: The Lord, the ocean of mercy, is all-pervading, permeating everywhere; He is seen to be contained in each and every heart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਪੂਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਲਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: jaap taap kot lakh poojaa har simaran tul na laain ||
english: Hundreds of thousands and millions of meditations, austerities and worships are not equal to remembering the Lord in meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣੁ ॥੨॥੬॥੭॥
transliteration: dui kar joR naanak daan maa(n)gai tere daasan daas dasaain ||2||6||7||
english: With his palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing, that he may become the slave of the slaves of Your slaves. ||2||6||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 5 ||
english: Nat, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: merai sarabas naam nidhaan ||
english: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is everything for me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa saadhoo sa(n)g milio satigur deeno daan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Granting His Grace, He has led me to join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; the True Guru has granted this gift. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ਗਾਉ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sukhadaataa dukh bha(n)janahaaraa gaau keeratan pooran giaan ||
english: Sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Lord, the Giver of peace, the Destroyer of pain; He shall bless you with perfect spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਮੂੜ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh kha(n)d kha(n)d keenhe binasio mooR abhimaan ||1||
english: Sexual desire, anger and greed shall be shattered and destroyed, and your foolish ego will be dispelled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kiaa gun tere aakh vakhaanaa prabh a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||
english: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I chant? O God, You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੮॥
transliteration: charan kamal saran sukh saagar naanak sad kurabaan ||2||7||8||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Lotus Feet, O Lord, ocean of peace; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||7||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 5 ||
english: Nat, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau vaar vaar jaau gur gopaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Guru, the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mohi niragun tum pooran daate deenaa naath daiaal ||1||
english: I am unworthy; You are the Perfect Giver. You are the Merciful Master of the meek. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: oothat baithat sovat jaagat jee praan dhan maal ||2||
english: While standing up and sitting down, while sleeping and awake, You are my soul, my breath of life, my wealth and property. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੩॥੮॥੯॥
transliteration: darasan piaas bahut man merai naanak daras nihaal ||3||8||9||
english: Within my mind there is such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. Nanak is enraptured with Your Glance of Grace. ||3||8||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: nat paRataal mahalaa 5 ||
english: Nat Partaal, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਊ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੋ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
transliteration: kooo hai mero saajan meet ||
english: Is there any friend or companion of mine,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: har naam sunaavai neet ||
english: who will constantly share the Lord's Name with me?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: binasai dukh bipareet ||
english: Will he rid me of my pains and evil tendencies?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh arapau man tan cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I would surrender my mind, body, consciousness and everything. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਪਨ ਕੀਤ ॥
transliteration: koee viralaa aapan keet ||
english: How rare is that one whom the Lord makes His own,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g charan kamal man seet ||
english: and whose mind is sewn into the Lord's Lotus Feet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa har jas deet ||1||
english: Granting His Grace, the Lord blesses him with His Praise. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤ ॥
transliteration: har bhaj janam padaarath jeet ||
english: Vibrating, meditating on the Lord, he is victorious in this precious human life,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: kot patit hohi puneet ||
english: and millions of sinners are sanctified.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਕੀਤ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੦॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak daas bal bal keet ||2||1||10||19||
english: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||2||1||10||19||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: nat asatapadeeaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Nat Ashtpadheeyaa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raam mere man tan naam adhaare ||
english: O Lord, Your Name is the support of my mind and body.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khin pal rahi na sakau bin sevaa mai guramat naam samhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I cannot survive for a moment, even for an instant, without serving You. Following the Guru's Teachings, I dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har har har har man dhiaavahu mai har har naam piaare ||
english: Within my mind, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har. The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is so dear to me.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: deen daiaal bhae prabh thaakur gur kai sabad savaare ||1||
