english: When God, my Lord and Master, became merciful to me the meek one, I was exalted by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਧਸੂਦਨ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਮਾਧੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: madhasoodan jagajeevan maadho mere thaakur agam apaare ||
english: Almighty Lord, Slayer of demons, Life of the World, my Lord and Master, inaccessible and infinite:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ik binau benatee karau gur aagai mai saadhoo charan pakhaare ||2||
english: I offer this one prayer to the Guru, to bless me, that I may wash the feet of the Holy. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sahas netr netr hai prabh kau prabh eko purakh niraare ||
english: The thousands of eyes are the eyes of God; the One God, the Primal Being, remains unattached.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sahas moorat eko prabh thaakur prabh eko guramat taare ||3||
english: The One God, our Lord and Master, has thousands of forms; God alone, through the Guru's Teachings, saves us. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਮੋਦਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramat naam damodar paaiaa har har naam ur dhaare ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have been blessed with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I have enshrined within my heart the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਬਨੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਜਿਉ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਗਟਕ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har har kathaa banee at meethee jiu goo(n)gaa gatak samhaare ||4||
english: The sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is so very sweet; like the mute, I taste its sweetness, but I cannot describe it at all. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦ ਚਖੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਅਤਿ ਫੀਕੇ ਲੋਭ ਬਿਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa saad chakhai bhaai doojai at pheeke lobh bikaare ||
english: The tongue savors the bland, insipid taste of the love of duality, greed and corruption.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਦ ਚਖਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਸਭ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jo guramukh saad chakhahi raam naamaa sabh an ras saad bisaare ||5||
english: The Gurmukh tastes the flavor of the Lord's Name, and all other tastes and flavors are forgotten. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਹਤਿਆ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramat raam naam dhan paaiaa sun kahatiaa paap nivaare ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained the wealth of the Lord's Name; hearing it, and chanting it, sins are eradicated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: dharam raai jam neR na aavai mere thaakur ke jan piaare ||6||
english: The Messenger of Death and the Righteous Judge of Dharma do not even approach the beloved servant of my Lord and Master. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saas saas saas hai jete mai guramat naam samhaare ||
english: With as many breaths as I have, I chant the Naam, under Guru's Instructions.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: saas saas jaai naamai bin so birathaa saas bikaare ||7||
english: Each and every breath which escapes me without the Naam - that breath is useless and corrupt. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kripaa kripaa kar deen prabh saranee mo kau har jan mel piaare ||
english: Please grant Your Grace; I am meek; I seek Your Sanctuary, God. Unite me with Your beloved, humble servants.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੇ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak daasan daas kahat hai ham daasan ke panihaare ||8||1||
english: Nanak, the slave of Your slaves, says, I am the water-carrier of Your slaves. ||8||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
english: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raam ham paathar niraguneeaare ||
english: O Lord, I am an unworthy stone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਹਮ ਪਾਹਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kripaa kripaa kar guroo milaae ham paahan sabad gur taare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Merciful Lord, in His Mercy, has led me to meet the Guru; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, this stone is carried across. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਮੈਲਾਗਰੁ ਮਲਗਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur naam driRaae at meethaa mailaagar malagaare ||
english: The True Guru has implanted within me the exceedingly sweet Naam, the Name of the Lord; it is like the most fragrant sandalwood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਜੀ ਹੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਸਕੀ ਮੁਸਕ ਗੰਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naamai surat vajee hai dah dis har musakee musak ga(n)dhaare ||1||
english: Through the Name, my awareness extends in the ten directions; the fragrance of the fragrant Lord permeates the air. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਥਾ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਮੀਠੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਨੀਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: teree niragun kathaa kathaa hai meethee gur neeke bachan samaare ||
english: Your unlimited sermon is the most sweet sermon; I contemplate the most Sublime Word of the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gaavat gaavat har gun gaae gun gaavat gur nisataare ||2||
english: Singing, singing, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; singing His Glorious Praises, the Guru saves me. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੰਕ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bibek guroo guroo samadarasee tis mileeai sa(n)k utaare ||
english: The Guru is wise and clear; the Guru looks upon all alike. Meeting with Him, doubt and skepticism are removed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur miliai param pad paaiaa hau satigur kai balihaare ||3||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, I have obtained the supreme status. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮੇ ਲੋਭੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਜਗਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d paakha(n)d kar kar bharame lobh paakha(n)d jag buriaare ||
english: Practicing hypocrisy and deception, people wander around in confusion. Greed and hypocrisy are evils in this world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਖੜਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: halat palat dukhadaaee hovahi jamakaal khaRaa sir maare ||4||
english: In this world and the next, they are miserable; the Messenger of Death hovers over their heads, and strikes them down. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਉਗਵੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਆਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ugavai dinas aal jaal samhaalai bikh maaiaa ke bisathaare ||
english: At the break of day, they take care of their affairs, and the poisonous entanglements of Maya.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਈ ਰੈਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aaee rain bhaiaa supana(n)tar bikh supanai bhee dukh saare ||5||
english: When night falls, they enter the land of dreams, and even in dreams, they take care of their corruptions and pains. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਰੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਲੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੇ ਖਲਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kalar khet lai kooR jamaaiaa sabh kooRai ke khalavaare ||
english: Taking a barren field, they plant falsehood; they shall harvest only falsehood.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਸਭਿ ਭੂਖ ਭੁਖਾਨੇ ਦਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saakat nar sabh bhookh bhukhaane dar thaadhe jam ja(n)daare ||6||
english: The materialistic people shall all remain hungry; the brutal Messenger of Death stands waiting at their door. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਜੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh karaj chaRiaa bikh bhaaree utarai sabad veechaare ||
english: The self-willed manmukh has accumulated a tremendous load of debt in sin; only by contemplating the Word of the Shabad, can this debt be paid off.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਕਰਜ ਕਰਜ ਕੇ ਮੰਗੀਏ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਪਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jitane karaj karaj ke ma(n)geee kar sevak pag lag vaare ||7||
english: As much debt and as many creditors as there are, the Lord makes them into servants, who fall at his feet. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਸਭਿ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਉਪਾਏ ਨਕਿ ਖੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਨਥਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaga(n)naath sabh ja(n)tr upaae nak kheenee sabh nathahaare ||
english: All the beings which the Lord of the Universe created - He puts the rings through their noses, and leads them all along.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਿਵ ਚਲੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak prabh khi(n)chai tiv chaleeai jiu bhaavai raam piaare ||8||2||
english: O Nanak, as God drives us on, so do we follow; it is all the Will of the Beloved Lord. ||8||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
english: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raam har a(n)mrit sar naavaare ||
english: The Lord has bathed me in the pool of Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਲਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur giaan majan hai neeko mil kalamal paap utaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The spiritual wisdom of the True Guru is the most excellent cleansing bath; bathing in it, all the filthy sins are washed away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਪੜਿ ਸੂਆ ਗਨਕ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)gat kaa gun bahut adhikaaee paR sooaa ganak udhaare ||
english: The virtues of the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, are so very great. Even the prostitute was saved, by teaching the parrot to speak the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਸਨ ਪਰਸ ਭਏ ਕੁਬਿਜਾ ਕਉ ਲੈ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: parasan paras bhae kubijaa kau lai baiku(n)th sidhaare ||1||
english: Krishna was pleased, and so he touched the hunch-back Kubija, and she was transported to the heavens. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਜਾਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਬੋਲਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ajaamal preet putr prat keenee kar naaraain bolaare ||
english: Ajaamal loved his son Naaraayan, and called out his name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mere thaakur kai man bhaai bhaavanee jamaka(n)kar maar bidaare ||2||
english: His loving devotion pleased my Lord and Master, who struck down and drove off the Messengers of Death. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਕਥੈ ਕਥਿ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੋ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maanukh kathai kath lok sunaavai jo bolai so na beechaare ||
english: The mortal speaks and by speaking, makes the people listen; but he does not reflect upon what he himself says.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਦਿੜਤਾ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat milai ta diRataa aavai har raam naam nisataare ||3||
english: But when he joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, he is confirmed in his faith, and he is saved by the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਤਬ ਲਗਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jab lag jeeu pi(n)d hai saabat tab lag kichh na samaare ||
english: As long as his soul and body are healthy and strong, he does not remember the Lord at all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਗਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਕਢਿ ਕੂਪੁ ਕਢੈ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jab ghar ma(n)dar aag lagaanee kadh koop kadhai panihaare ||4||
english: But when his home and mansion catch fire, then, he wants to dig the well to draw water. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saakat siu man mel na kareeahu jin har har naam bisaare ||
english: O mind, do not join with the faithless cynic, who has forgotten the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਛੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਡਸੀਐ ਤਜਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: saakat bachan bichhooaa jiu daseeai taj saakat parai paraare ||5||
english: The word of the faithless cynic stings like a scorpion; leave the faithless cynic far, far behind. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਲਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: lag lag preet bahu preet lagaaee lag saadhoo sa(n)g savaare ||
english: Fall in love, fall deeply in love with the Lord; clinging to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you will be exalted and embellished.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gur ke bachan sat sat kar maane mere thaakur bahut piaare ||6||
english: Those who accept the Word of the Guru as True, totally True, are very dear to my Lord and Master. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਪਰਚੂਨ ਕਮਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: poorab janam parachoon kamaae har har har naam piaare ||
english: Because of actions committed in past lives, one comes to love the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਸੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur prasaad a(n)mrit ras paaiaa ras gaavai ras veechaare ||7||
english: By Guru's Grace, you shall obtain the ambrosial essence; sing of this essence, and reflect upon this essence. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ ਲਾਲ ਗੁਲਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har roop ra(n)g sabh tere mere laalan laal gulaare ||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, all forms and colors are Yours; O my Beloved, my deep crimson ruby.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: jaisaa ra(n)g dehi so hovai kiaa naanak ja(n)t vichaare ||8||3||
english: Only that color which You impart, Lord, exists; O Nanak, what can the poor wretched being do? ||8||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
english: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raam gur saran prabhoo rakhavaare ||
english: In the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord God saves and protects us,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਤਦੂਐ ਪਕਰਿ ਚਲਾਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਊਪਰੁ ਕਢਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu ku(n)char tadooai pakar chalaaio kar oopar kadh nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: as He protected the elephant, when the crocodile seized it and pulled it into the water; He lifted him up and pulled him out. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh ke sevak bahut at neeke man saradhaa kar har dhaare ||
english: God's servants are sublime and exalted; they enshrine faith for Him in their minds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mere prabh saradhaa bhagat man bhaavai jan kee paij savaare ||1||
english: Faith and devotion are pleasing to my God's Mind; He saves the honor of His humble servants. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har sevak sevaa laagai sabh dekhai braham pasaare ||
english: The servant of the Lord, Har, Har, is committed to His service; He sees God pervading the entire expanse of the universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ek purakh ik nadaree aavai sabh ekaa nadar nihaare ||2||
english: He sees the One and only Primal Lord God, who blesses all with His Glance of Grace. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਸਭੁ ਚੇਰੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har prabh thaakur raviaa sabh thaaee sabh cheree jagat samaare ||
english: God, our Lord and Master, is permeating and pervading all places; He takes care of the whole world as His slave.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap daiaal daiaa daan devai vich paathar keere kaare ||3||
english: The Merciful Lord Himself mercifully gives His gifts, even to worms in stones. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮੁਸਕਾਈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਸਿੰਙ੍ਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar vaas bahut musakaaee bhram bhoolaa mirag si(n)nghaare ||
english: Within the deer is the heavy fragrance of musk, but he is confused and deluded, and he shakes his horns looking for it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਢੂਢਿ ਢੂਢਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ban ban dhoodh dhoodh phir thaakee gur poorai ghar nisataare ||4||
english: Wandering, rambling and roaming through the forests and woods, I exhausted myself, and then in my own home, the Perfect Guru saved me. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: baanee guroo guroo hai baanee vich baanee a(n)mrit saare ||
english: The Word, the Bani is Guru, and Guru is the Bani. Within the Bani, the Ambrosial Nectar is contained.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਹੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur baanee kahai sevak jan maanai paratakh guroo nisataare ||5||
english: If His humble servant believes, and acts according to the Words of the Guru's Bani, then the Guru, in person, emancipates him. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਖਾਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh hai braham braham hai pasariaa man beejiaa khaavaare ||
english: All is God, and God is the whole expanse; man eats what he has planted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਨ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਹਾਂਸੁ ਦੁਖਿਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਸਟਬੁਧੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਲੂਕੀ ਜਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jiu jan cha(n)drahaa(n)s dukhiaa dhrisatabudhee apunaa ghar lookee jaare ||6||
english: When Dhrishtabudhi tormented the humble devotee Chandrahaans, he only set his own house on fire. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਲੋਚੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਸ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: prabh kau jan a(n)tar rid lochai prabh jan ke saas nihaare ||
english: God's humble servant longs for Him within his heart; God watches over each breath of His humble servant.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਜਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਜਗੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: kripaa kripaa kar bhagat driRaae jan peechhai jag nisataare ||7||
english: Mercifully, mercifully, He implants devotion within his humble servant; for his sake, God saves the whole world. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aapan aap aap prabh thaakur prabh aape srisat savaare ||
english: God, our Lord and Master, is Himself by Himself; God Himself embellishes the universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak aape aap sabh varatai kar kripaa aap nisataare ||8||4||
english: O servant Nanak, He Himself is all-pervading; in His Mercy, He Himself emancipates all. ||8||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
english: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raam kar kirapaa lehu ubaare ||
english: Grant Your Grace, Lord, and save me,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪਕਰਿ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਦੁਸਟਾਂ ਆਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu pakar dropatee dusataa(n) aanee har har laaj nivaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: as You saved Dropadi from shame when she was seized and brought before the court by the evil villians. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jaachik jan tere ik maagau daan piaare ||
english: Bless me with Your Grace - I am just a humble beggar of Yours; I beg for a single blessing, O my Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur kee nit saradhaa laagee mo kau har gur mel savaare ||1||
english: I long constantly for the True Guru. Lead me to meet the Guru, O Lord, that I may be exalted and embellished. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਰਮ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਿਉ ਮਥੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਣੀ ਝੋਲ ਝੁਲਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saakat karam paanee jiu matheeai nit paanee jhol jhulaare ||
english: The actions of the faithless cynic are like the churning of water; he churns, constantly churning only water.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਢਿ ਮਾਖਨ ਕੇ ਗਟਕਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat param pad paaiaa kadh maakhan ke gatakaare ||2||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the supreme status is obtained; the butter is produced, and eaten with delight. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: nit nit kaaiaa majan keeaa nit mal mal deh savaare ||
english: He may constantly and continually wash his body; he may constantly rub, clean and polish his body.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਬਚਨ ਨ ਭਾਏ ਸਭ ਫੋਕਟ ਚਾਰ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mere satigur ke man bachan na bhaae sabh phokat chaar seegaare ||3||
english: But if the Word of my True Guru is not pleasing to his mind, then all his preparations and beautiful decorations are useless. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਟਕਿ ਮਟਕਿ ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: matak matak chal sakhee sahelee mere thaakur ke gun saare ||
english: Walk playfully and carefree, O my friends and companions; cherish the Glorious Virtues of my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramukh sevaa mere prabh bhaaee mai satigur alakh lakhaare ||4||
english: To serve, as Gurmukh, is pleasing to my God. Through the True Guru, the unknown is known. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭ ਨਾਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naaree purakh purakh sabh naaree sabh eko purakh muraare ||
english: Women and men, all the men and women, all came from the One Primal Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee ren man bhaaee mil har jan har nisataare ||5||
english: My mind loves the dust of the feet of the humble; the Lord emancipates those who meet with the Lord's humble servants. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਗਰ ਸਭ ਫਿਰਿਆ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਭਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: graam graam nagar sabh phiriaa rid a(n)tar har jan bhaare ||
english: From village to village, throughout all the cities I wandered; and then, inspired by the Lord's humble servants, I found Him deep within the nucleus of my heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਧਾ ਸਰਧਾ ਉਪਾਇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saradhaa saradhaa upaai milaae mo kau har gur gur nisataare ||6||
english: Faith and longing have welled up within me, and I have been blended with the Lord; the Guru, the Guru, has saved me. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਵਨ ਸੂਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਕਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: pavan soot sabh neekaa kariaa satigur sabad veechaare ||
english: The thread of my breath has been made totally sublime and pure; I contemplate the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੈਨਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: nij ghar jaai a(n)mrit ras peeaa bin nainaa jagat nihaare ||7||
english: I came back to the home of my own inner self; drinking in the ambrosial essence, I see the world, without my eyes. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਗੁਨ ਈਸ ਬਰਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਮੰਦਰ ਹਮ ਨਿਕ ਕੀਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tau gun ees baran nahee saakau tum ma(n)dar ham nik keere ||
english: I cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues, Lord; You are the temple, and I am just a tiny worm.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਮੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੮॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak kripaa karahu gur melahu mai raam japat man dheere ||8||5||
english: Bless Nanak with Your Mercy, and unite him with the Guru; meditating on my Lord, my mind is comforted and consoled. ||8||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
english: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mere man bhaj thaakur agam apaare ||
english: O my mind, vibrate, meditate on the inaccessible and infinite Lord and Master.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਬਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀਆਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ham paapee bahu niraguneeaare kar kirapaa gur nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am such a great sinner; I am so unworthy. And yet the Guru, in His Mercy, has saved me. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਪਾਏ ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saadhoo purakh saadh jan paae ik binau karau gur piaare ||
english: I have found the Holy Person, the Holy and humble servant of the Lord; I offer a prayer to Him, my Beloved Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam dhan poojee devahu sabh tisanaa bhookh nivaare ||1||
english: Please, bless me with the wealth, the capital of the Lord's Name, and take away all my hunger and thirst. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਚੈ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਮੀਨ ਇਕ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪਕਰਿ ਸਘਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: pachai pata(n)g mrig bhri(n)g ku(n)char meen ik i(n)dree pakar saghaare ||
english: The moth, the deer, the bumble bee, the elephant and the fish are ruined, each by the one passion that controls them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਸਬਲ ਹੈ ਦੇਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch bhoot sabal hai dehee gur satigur paap nivaare ||2||
english: The five powerful demons are in the body; the Guru, the True Guru turns out these sins. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਸੋਧਿ ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਨਾਰਦ ਬਚਨ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saasatr bed sodh sodh dekhe mun naarad bachan pukaare ||
english: I searched and searched through the Shaastras and the Vedas; Naarad the silent sage proclaimed these words as well.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam naam paRahu gat paavahu satasa(n)gat gur nisataare ||3||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name, salvation is attained; the Guru saves those in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਜਿਵ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਕਮਲੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: preetam preet lagee prabh keree jiv sooraj kamal nihaare ||
english: In love with the Beloved Lord God, one looks at Him as the lotus looks at the sun.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰ ਸੁਮੇਰ ਮੋਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਜਬ ਉਨਵੈ ਘਨ ਘਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: mer sumer mor bahu naachai jab unavai ghan ghanahaare ||4||
english: The peacock dances on the mountain, when the clouds hang low and heavy. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਹੁ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਸਭ ਡਾਲ ਫੂਲ ਬਿਸੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saakat kau a(n)mrit bahu si(n)chahu sabh daal phool bisukaare ||
english: The faithless cyinc may be totally drenched with ambrosial nectar, but even so, all his branches and flowers are filled with venom.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਛੇੜਿ ਛੇੜਿ ਕਢੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jiu jiu nivahi saakat nar setee chheR chheR kadhai bikh khaare ||5||
english: The more one bows down in humility before the faithless cyinc, the more he provokes, and stabs, and spits out his poison. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan sa(n)t saadh mil raheeai gun bolahi paraupakaare ||
english: Remain with the Holy man, the Saint of the Saints, who chants the Lord's Praises for the benefit of all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sa(n)tai sa(n)t milai man bigasai jiu jal mil kamal savaare ||6||
english: Meeting the Saint of Saints, the mind blossoms forth, like the lotus, exalted by obtaining the water. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਹਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਹਲਕਿਓ ਸਭਹਿ ਬਿਗਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: lobh lahar sabh suaan halak hai halakio sabhahi bigaare ||
english: The waves of greed are like mad dogs with rabies. Their madness ruins everything.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੈ ਦੀਬਾਨਿ ਖਬਰਿ ਹੋੁਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਖੜਗੁ ਲੈ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: mere thaakur kai deebaan khabar houee gur giaan khaRag lai maare ||7||
english: When the news reached the Court of my Lord and Master, the Guru took up the sword of spiritual wisdom, and killed them. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raakh raakh raakh prabh mere mai raakhahu kirapaa dhaare ||
english: Save me, save me, save me, O my God; shower me with Your Mercy, and save me!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: naanak mai dhar avar na kaaee mai satigur gur nisataare ||8||6|| chhakaa 1 ||
english: O Nanak, I have no other support; the Guru, the True Guru, has saved me. ||8||6|| First Set of Six Hymns||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: raag maalee gauRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Raag Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anik jatan kar rahe har a(n)t naahee paaiaa ||
english: Countless have tried, but none have found the Lord's limit.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har agam agam agaadh bodh aades har prabh raaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord is inaccessible, unapproachable and unfathomable; I humbly bow to the Lord God, my King. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਝਗਰਤੇ ਝਗਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu nit jhagarate jhagaraaiaa ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment bring continual conflict and strife.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਦੀਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ham raakh raakh deen tere har saran har prabh aaiaa ||1||
english: Save me, save me, I am your humble creature, O Lord; I have come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਲਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saranaagatee prabh paalate har bhagat vachhal naaiaa ||
english: You protect and preserve those who take to Your Sanctuary, God; You are called the Lover of Your devotees.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਨਾਖਿ ਪਕਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਓ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: prahilaad jan haranaakh pakariaa har raakh leeo taraaiaa ||2||
english: Prahlaad, Your humble servant, was caught by Harnaakhash; but You saved Him and carried him across, Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਣ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har chet re man mahal paavan sabh dookh bha(n)jan raaiaa ||
english: Remember the Lord, O mind, and rise up to the Mansion of His Presence; the Sovereign Lord is the Destroyer of pain.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhau janam maran nivaar thaakur har guramatee prabh paaiaa ||3||
english: Our Lord and Master takes away the fear of birth and death; following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord God is found. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਉ ਭਗਤ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har patit paavan naam suaamee bhau bhagat bha(n)jan gaaiaa ||
english: The Name of the Lord, our Lord and Master, is the Purifier of sinners; I sing of the Lord, the Destroyer of the fears of His devotees.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: har haar har ur dhaario jan naanak naam samaaiaa ||4||1||
english: One who wears the necklace of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in his heart, O servant Nanak, merges in the Naam. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jap man raam naam sukhadaataa ||
english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mil har saad aaiaa guramukh braham pachhaataa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and enjoys the sublime taste of the Lord, as Gurmukh, comes to realize God. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee gur darasan paaiaa gur miliai har prabh jaataa ||
english: By great good fortune, one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; meeting with the Guru, the Lord God is known.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: duramat mail gaee sabh neekar har a(n)mrit har sar naataa ||1||
english: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away, bathing in the Lord's ambrosial pool of nectar. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਪੂਛਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan saadh jinhee har prabh paaiaa tinh poochhau har kee baataa ||
english: Blessed, blessed are the Holy, who have found their Lord God; I ask them to tell me the stories of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਉ ਜੁਦਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paai lagau nit karau judareeaa har melahu karam bidhaataa ||2||
english: I fall at their feet, and always pray to them, to mercifully unite me with my Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲਿਲਾਟ ਲਿਖੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: lilaat likhe paaiaa gur saadhoo gur bachanee man tan raataa ||
english: Through the destiny written on my forehead, I have found the Holy Guru; my mind and body are imbued with the Guru's Word.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har prabh aai mile sukh paaiaa sabh kilavikh paap gavaataa ||3||
english: The Lord God has come to meet me; I have found peace, and I am rid of all the sins. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: raam rasaain jinh guramat paaiaa tinh kee ootam baataa ||
english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings find the Lord, the source of nectar; their words are sublime and exalted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚਰਨਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: tin kee pa(n)k paaeeai vadabhaagee jan naanak charan paraataa ||4||2||
english: By great good fortune, one is blessed with the dust of their feet; servant Nanak falls at their feet. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: sabh sidh saadhik mun janaa man bhaavanee har dhiaaio ||
english: All the Siddhas, seekers and silent sages, with their minds full of love, meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: apara(n)paro paarabraham suaamee har alakh guroo lakhaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Supreme Lord God, my Lord and Master, is limitless; the Guru has inspired me to know the unknowable Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਮਧਿਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: ham neech madhim karam keee nahee chetio har raaio ||
english: I am low, and I commit evil actions; I have not remembered my Sovereign Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਨਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਖਿਨੁ ਬੰਧ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har aan melio satiguroo khin ba(n)dh mukat karaaio ||1||
english: The Lord has led me to meet the True Guru; in an instant, He liberated me from bondage. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮਸਤਕੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: prabh masatake dhur leekhiaa guramatee har liv laaio ||
english: Such is the destiny God wrote on my forehead; following the Guru's Teachings, I enshrine love for the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਾਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch sabad daragah baajiaa har milio ma(n)gal gaaio ||2||
english: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate and resound in the Court of the Lord; meeting the Lord, I sing the songs of joy. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀਆਂ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan naam narahar ma(n)dabhaageeaa(n) nahee bhaaio ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Purifier of sinners; the unfortunate wretches do not like this.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਗਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਲੋਨੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਗਲਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: te garabh jonee gaaleeahi jiu lon jalahi galaaio ||3||
english: They rot away in the womb of reincarnation; they fall apart like salt in water. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: mat dehi har prabh agam thaakur gur charan man mai laaio ||
english: Please bless me with such understanding, O Inaccessible Lord God, my Lord and Master, that my mind may remain attached to the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਹਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: har raam naamai rahau laago jan naanak naam samaaio ||4||3||
english: Servant Nanak remains attached to the Name of the Lord; he is merged in the Naam. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa man raam naam ras laagaa ||
english: My mind is addicted to the juice of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kamal pragaas bhaiaa gur paaiaa har japio bhram bhau bhaagaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My heart-lotus has blossomed forth, and I have found the Guru. Meditating on the Lord, my doubts and fears have run away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਾਗੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੀਅਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੋਇਓ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: bhai bhaai bhagat laago meraa heearaa man soio guramat jaagaa ||
english: In the Fear of God, my heart is committed in loving devotion to Him; following the Guru's Teachings, my sleeping mind has awakened.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਖੀਨ ਭਏ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kilabikh kheen bhae saa(n)t aaee har ur dhaario vadabhaagaa ||1||
english: All my sins have been erased, and I have found peace and tranquility; I have enshrined the Lord within my heart, by great good fortune. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਕਚੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਕੁਸਮ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh ra(n)g kasu(n)bh hai kachooaa jiu kusam chaar din chaagaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is like the false color of the safflower, which fades away; its color lasts for only a few days.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ਡੰਡੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khin mahi binas jaai parataapai da(n)d dharam raai kaa laagaa ||2||
english: He perishes in an instant; he is tormented, and punished by the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਅਤਿ ਗੂੜੀ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਬਹੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat preet saadh at gooRee jiu ra(n)g majeeth bahu laagaa ||
english: The Lord's Love, found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is absolutely permanent, and colorfast.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਚੀਰ ਬਹੁ ਫਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kaapar cheer bahu phaare har ra(n)g na lahai sabhaagaa ||3||
english: The cloth of the body may be torn to shreds, but still, this beautiful color of the Lord's Love does not fade away. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਾਰ੍ਹਿਓ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਂਗਾ ॥
transliteration: har chaarhio ra(n)g milai gur sobhaa har ra(n)g chaloolai raa(n)gaa ||
english: Meeting with the Blessed Guru, one is dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, imbued with this deep crimson color.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jan naanak tin ke charan pakhaarai jo har charanee jan laagaa ||4||4||
english: Servant Nanak washes the feet of that humble being, who is attached to the feet of the Lord. ||4||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: mere man bhaj har har naam gupaalaa ||
english: O my mind, meditate, vibrate upon the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the World, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲੀਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: meraa man tan leen bhaiaa raam naamai mat guramat raam rasaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My mind and body are merged in the Lord's Name, and through the Guru's Teachings, my intellect is imbued with the Lord, the source of nectar. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਮਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: guramat naam dhiaaeeai har har man japeeai har japamaalaa ||
english: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Chant, and meditate, on the beads of the mala of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਬਨਮਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jinh kai masatak leekhiaa har miliaa har banamaalaa ||1||
english: Those who have such destiny inscribed upon their foreheads, meet with the Lord, adorned with garlands of flowers. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਚੂਕੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jinh har naam dhiaaiaa tinh chooke sarab ja(n)jaalaa ||
english: Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord - all their entanglements are ended.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tinh jam neR na aavaee gur raakhe har rakhavaalaa ||2||
english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach them; the Guru, the Savior Lord, saves them. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੂ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ham baarik kichhoo na jaanahoo har maat pitaa pratipaalaa ||
english: I am a child; I know nothing at all. The Lord cherishes me, as my mother and father.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਮੇਲਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kar maaiaa agan nit melate gur raakhe deen daiaalaa ||3||
english: I continually put my hands into the fire of Maya, but the Guru saves me; He is merciful to the meek. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਮੈਲੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇਆ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਹਰਿ ਜਸਿ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: bahu maile niramal hoiaa sabh kilabikh har jas jaalaa ||
english: I was filthy, but I have become immaculate. Singing the Lord's Praises, all sins have been burnt to ashes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: man anad bhaiaa gur paaiaa jan naanak sabad nihaalaa ||4||5||
english: My mind is in esctasy, having found the Guru; servant Nanak is enraptured through the Word of the Shabad. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟ ॥
transliteration: mere man har bhaj sabh kilabikh kaat ||
english: O my mind, meditate, vibrate on the Lord, and all sins will be eradicated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੀਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har ur dhaario gur poorai meraa sees keejai gur vaat ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Guru has enshried the Lord, Har, Har, within my heart; I place my head on the Guru's Path. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਕਟਿ ਕਾਟ ॥
transliteration: mere har prabh kee mai baat sunaavai tis man devau kat kaat ||
english: Whoever tells me the stories of my Lord God, I would cut my mind into slices, and dedicate it to him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਬਿਕਾਨੋ ਹਟਿ ਹਾਟ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har saajan melio gur poorai gur bachan bikaano hat haat ||1||
english: The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord, my Friend; I have sold myself at each and every store for the Guru's Word. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਕਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਗਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਦੀਓ ਅਧ ਕਾਟਿ ॥
transliteration: makar praag daan bahu keeaa sareer deeo adh kaat ||
english: One may give donations in charity at Prayaag, and cut the body in two at Benares,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਟਿ ਕਾਟ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin har naam ko mukat na paavai bahu ka(n)chan deejai kat kaat ||2||
english: but without the Lord's Name, no one attains liberation, even though one may give away huge amounts of gold. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਉਘਰੇ ਕਪਟ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
transliteration: har keerat guramat jas gaaio man ughare kapat kapaat ||
english: When one follows the Guru's Teachings, and sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, the doors of the mind, held shut by deception, are thrown open again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਫੋਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਲਜ ਭਾਨੀ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਾਟ ॥੩॥
transliteration: trikutee phor bharam bhau bhaagaa laj bhaanee matukee maat ||3||
english: The three qualities are shattered, doubt and fear run away, and the clay pot of public opinion is broken. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
transliteration: kalajug gur pooraa tin paaiaa jin dhur masatak likhe lilaat ||
english: They alone find the Perfect Guru in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is inscribed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਤਿਖਾਟ ॥੪॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: jan naanak ras a(n)mrit peeaa sabh laathee bhookh tikhaat ||4||6|| chhakaa 1 ||
english: Servant Nanak drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar; all his hunger and thirst are quenched. ||4||6|| Set of Six Hymns 1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਟਹਲ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: re man tahal har sukh saar ||
english: O mind, true peace comes from serving the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਟਹਲਾ ਝੂਠੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਕਰੈ ਜਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avar tahalaa jhootheeaa nit karai jam sir maar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Other services are false, and as punishment for them, the Messenger of Death bashes in one's head. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਗਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jinaa masatak leekhiaa te mile sa(n)gaar ||
english: They alone join the Sangat, the Congregation, upon whose forehead such destiny is inscribed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar bhaujal taariaa har sa(n)t purakh apaar ||1||
english: They are carried across the terrifying world-ocean by the Saints of the Infinite, Primal Lord God. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਤਜਿ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: nit charan sevahu saadh ke taj lobh moh bikaar ||
english: Serve forever at the feet of the Holy; renounce greed, emotional attachment and corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤਜਹੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਆਸੜੀ ਰਖੁ ਆਸ ਇਕ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabh tajahu doojee aasaRee rakh aas ik nira(n)kaar ||2||
english: Abandon all other hopes, and rest your hopes in the One Formless Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਾਕਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ik bharam bhoole saakataa bin gur a(n)dh a(n)dhaar ||
english: Some are faithless cynics, deluded by doubt; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਹੋਵਨਾ ਸੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਕੋ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dhur hovanaa s hoiaa ko na metanahaar ||3||
english: Whatever is pre-ordained, comes to pass; no one can erase it. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: agam roop gobi(n)d kaa anik naam apaar ||
english: The beauty of the Lord of the Universe is profound and unfathomable; the Names of the Infinite Lord are immunerable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n te jan naanakaa jin har naamaa ur dhaar ||4||1||
english: Blessed, blessed are those humble beings, O Nanak, who enshrine the Lord's Name in their hearts. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: raam naam kau namasakaar ||
english: I humbly bow to the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਹੋਵਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaas japat hovat udhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chanting it, one is saved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਧੰਧ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran mitahi dha(n)dh ||
english: Meditating on Him in remembrance, conflicts are ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਬੰਧ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran chhootahi ba(n)dh ||
english: Meditating on Him, one's bonds are untied.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਚਤੁਰ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran moorakh chatur ||
english: Meditating on Him, the fool becomes wise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕੁਲਹ ਉਧਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran kulah udhar ||1||
english: Meditating on Him, one's ancestors are saved. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਉ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran bhau dukh harai ||
english: Meditating on Him, fear and pain are taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਅਪਦਾ ਟਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran apadaa tarai ||
english: Meditating on Him, misfortune is avoided.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੁਚਤ ਪਾਪ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran muchat paap ||
english: Meditating on Him, sins are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran nahee sa(n)taap ||2||
english: Meditating on Him, agony is ended. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਰਿਦ ਬਿਗਾਸ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran rid bigaas ||
english: Meditating on Him, the heart blossoms forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਵਲਾ ਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran kavalaa daas ||
english: Meditating on Him, Maya becomes one's slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran nidh nidhaan ||
english: Meditating on Him, one is blessed with the treasures of wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤਰੇ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa kai simaran tare nidaan ||3||
english: Meditating on Him, one crosses over in the end. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan naam haree ||
english: The Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਭਗਤ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਕਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kot bhagat udhaar karee ||
english: It saves millions of devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਾ ਦੀਨੁ ਸਰਨ ॥
transliteration: har daas daasaa deen saran ||
english: I am meek; I seek the Sanctuary of the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਥਾ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak maathaa sa(n)t charan ||4||2||
english: Nanak lays his forehead on the feet of the Saints. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਸਹਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aiso sahaaee har ko naam ||
english: This is the sort of helper the Name of the Lord is.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਜੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat bhaj pooran kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one's affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਬੇੜੀ ਮਿਲਤ ॥
transliteration: boodat kau jaise beRee milat ||
english: It is like a boat to a drowning man.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝਤ ਦੀਪਕ ਮਿਲਤ ਤਿਲਤ ॥
transliteration: boojhat deepak milat tilat ||
english: It is like oil to the lamp whose flame is dying out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਤ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਿਲਤ ਨੀਰ ॥
transliteration: jalat aganee milat neer ||
english: It is like water poured on the burning fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਮੁਖਹਿ ਖੀਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaise baarik mukhahi kheer ||1||
english: It is like milk poured into the baby's mouth. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਸਖਾ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ॥
transliteration: jaise ran mahi sakhaa bhraat ||
english: As one's brother becomes a helper on the field of battle;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਭੂਖੇ ਭੋਜਨ ਮਾਤ ॥
transliteration: jaise bhookhe bhojan maat ||
english: as one's hunger is satisfied by food;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਿਰਖਹਿ ਬਰਸ ਮੇਘ ॥
transliteration: jaise kirakhahi baras megh ||
english: as the cloudburst saves the crops;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਲਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੇਂਘ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaise paalan saran se(n)gh ||2||
english: as one is protected in the tiger's lair;||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰੁੜ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਰਪ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
transliteration: garuR mukh nahee sarap traas ||
english: As with the magic spell of Garuda the eagle upon one's lips, one does not fear the snake;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਆ ਪਿੰਜਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਖਾਇ ਬਿਲਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sooaa pi(n)jar nahee khaai bilaas ||
english: as the cat cannot eat the parrot in its cage;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੋ ਆਂਡੋ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaiso aa(n)do hirade maahi ||
english: as the bird cherishes her eggs in her heart;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੋ ਦਾਨੋ ਚਕੀ ਦਰਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaiso daano chakee daraahi ||3||
english: as the grains are spared, by sticking to the central post of the mill;||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਓਪਮਾ ਥੋਰ ਕਹੀ ॥
transliteration: bahut opamaa thor kahee ||
english: Your Glory is so great; I can describe only a tiny bit of it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
transliteration: har agam agam agaadh tuhee ||
english: O Lord, You are inaccessible, unapproachable and unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਮੂਚੌ ਬਹੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: ooch moochau bahu apaar ||
english: You are lofty and high, utterly great and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੇ ਸਾਰ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: simarat naanak tare saar ||4||3||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, O Nanak, one is carried across. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੀ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸਫਲ ਕਾਜ ॥
transliteration: ihee hamaarai saphal kaaj ||
english: Please let my works be rewarding and fruitful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: apune daas kau lehu nivaaj ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please cherish and exalt Your slave. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤਹ ਮਾਥ ਮੋਰ ॥
transliteration: charan sa(n)tah maath mor ||
english: I lay my forehead on the feet of the Saints,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਰ ॥
transliteration: nain daras pekhau nis bhor ||
english: and with my eyes, I gaze upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਹਮਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ॥
transliteration: hasat hamare sa(n)t tahal ||
english: With my hands, I work for the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਬਹਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: praan man dhan sa(n)t bahal ||1||
english: I dedicate my breath of life, my mind and wealth to the Saints. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g mere man kee preet ||
english: My mind loves the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਗੁਨ ਬਸਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t gun basahi merai cheet ||
english: The Virtues of the Saints abide within my consciousness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨਹਿ ਮੀਠ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t aagiaa manahi meeth ||
english: The Will of the Saints is sweet to my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸੰਤ ਡੀਠ ॥੨॥
transliteration: meraa kamal bigasai sa(n)t deeth ||2||
english: Seeing the Saints, my heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g meraa hoi nivaas ||
english: I dwell in the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kee mohi bahut piaas ||
english: I have such a great thirst for the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਬਚਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਮੰਤ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t bachan mere manahi ma(n)t ||
english: The Words of the Saints are the Mantras of my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਹੰਤ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad mere bikhai ha(n)t ||3||
english: By the Grace of the Saints, my corruption is taken away. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਏਹਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: mukat jugat ehaa nidhaan ||
english: This way of liberation is my treasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
transliteration: prabh daiaal mohi devahu daan ||
english: O Merciful God, please bless me with this gift.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak kau prabh daiaa dhaar ||
english: O God, shower Your Mercy upon Nanak.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: charan sa(n)tan ke mere ride majhaar ||4||4||
english: I have enshrined the feet of the Saints within my heart. ||4||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh kai sa(n)gee naahee door ||
english: He is with all; He is not far away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਹਾਜਰਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavan haajaraa hajoor ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Cause of causes, ever-present here and now. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਤ ਜੀਓ ਜਾਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: sunat jeeo jaas naam ||
english: Hearing His Name, one comes to life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਓ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: dukh binase sukh keeo bisraam ||
english: Pain is dispelled; peace and tranquility come to dwell within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sagal nidh har har hare ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is all treasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mun jan taa kee sev kare ||1||
english: The silent sages serve Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai ghar sagale samaahi ||
english: Everything is contained in His home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jis te birathaa koi naahi ||
english: No one is turned away empty-handed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)tr kare pratipaal ||
english: He cherishes all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa sevahu kirapaal ||2||
english: Forever and ever, serve the Merciful Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa dharam jaa kai deebaan ||
english: Righteous justice is dispensed in His Court forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: bemuhataaj nahee kichh kaan ||
english: He is carefree, and owes allegiance to no one.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਨਾ ਆਪਨ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh karanaa aapan aap ||
english: He Himself, by Himself, does everything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: re man mere too taa kau jaap ||3||
english: O my mind, meditate on Him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kau hau balihaar ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jaas mil hovai udhaar ||
english: Joining them, I am saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨ ਤਨਹਿ ਰਾਤ ॥
transliteration: naam sa(n)g man tanahi raat ||
english: My mind and body are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak kau prabh karee daat ||4||5||
english: God has blessed Nanak with this gift. ||4||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 5 dupade ||
english: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har samarath kee saranaa ||
english: I seek the Sanctuary of the all-powerful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d dhan raas meree prabh ek kaaran karanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My soul, body, wealth and capital belong to the One God, the Cause of causes. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੀਵਣੈ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
transliteration: simar simar sadaa sukh paaeeai jeevanai kaa mool ||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I have found everlasting peace. He is the source of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤ ਠਾਈ ਸੂਖਮੋ ਅਸਥੂਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rav rahiaa sarabat thaaee sookhamo asathool ||1||
english: He is all-pervading, permeating all places; He is in subtle essence and manifest form. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤਜਿ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨਾ ਨਿਤਿ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aal jaal bikaar taj sabh har gunaa nit gaau ||
english: Abandon all your entanglements and corruption; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੬॥
transliteration: kar joR naanak daan maa(n)gai dehu apanaa naau ||2||1||6||
english: With palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing; please bless me with Your Name. ||2||1||6||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਮਰਥ ਦੇਵ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
transliteration: prabh samarath dev apaar ||
english: God is all-powerful, divine and infinite.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਚਲਿਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaun jaanai chalit tere kichh a(n)t naahee paar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Who knows Your wondrous plays? You have no end or limitation. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਖਿਨਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਦਾ ਘੜਿ ਭੰਨਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ik khinahi thaap uthaapadaa ghaR bha(n)n karanaihaar ||
english: In an instant, You establish and disestablish; You create and destroy, O Creator Lord.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤ ਕੀਨ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jet keen upaarajanaa prabh daan dei daataar ||1||
english: As many beings as You created, God, so many You bless with Your blessings. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਮੁਰਾਰ ॥
transliteration: har saran aaio daas teraa prabh ooch agam muraar ||
english: I have come to Your Sanctuary, Lord; I am Your slave, O Inaccessible Lord God.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਬਿਖਮ ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥੨॥੭॥
transliteration: kadh lehu bhaujal bikham te jan naanak sad balihaar ||2||2||7||
english: Lift me up and pull me out of the terrifying, treacherous world-ocean; servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||2||7||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
transliteration: man tan bas rahe gopaal ||
english: The Lord of the World abides in my mind and body.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਬਾਂਧਵ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: deen baa(n)dhav bhagat vachhal sadaa sadaa kripaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Friend of the meek, Lover of His devotees, forever and ever merciful. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aad a(n)te madh toohai prabh binaa naahee koi ||
english: In the beginning, in the end and in the middle, You alone exist, God; there is none other than You.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਮੰਡਲ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poor rahiaa sagal ma(n)dal ek suaamee soi ||1||
english: He is totally permeating and pervading all worlds; He is the One and only Lord and Master. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਰਸਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan har jas netr darasan rasan har gun gaau ||
english: With my ears I hear God's Praises, and with my eyes I behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; with my tongue I sing the Lord's Glorious Praises.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥੩॥੮॥੬॥੧੪॥
transliteration: balihaar jaae sadaa naanak dehu apanaa naau ||2||3||8||6||14||
english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You; please, bless me with Your Name. ||2||3||8||6||14||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: maalee gauRaa baanee bhagat naamadev jee kee ||
english: Maalee Gauraa, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਓ ਰਾਮ ਬੇਨੁ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n o raam ben baajai ||
english: Blessed, blessed is that flute which the Lord plays.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਰ ਮਧੁਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਗਾਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: madhur madhur dhun anahat gaajai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The sweet, sweet unstruck sound current sings forth. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਮੇਘਾ ਰੋਮਾਵਲੀ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan meghaa romaavalee ||
english: Blessed, blessed is the wool of the sheep;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਓਢੈ ਕਾਂਬਲੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhan dhan krisan odhai kaa(n)balee ||1||
english: blessed, blessed is the blanket worn by Krishna. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਤੂ ਮਾਤਾ ਦੇਵਕੀ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan too maataa devakee ||
english: Blessed, blessed are you, O mother Dayvakee;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਮਈਆ ਕਵਲਾਪਤੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jih grih ramaeeaa kavalaapatee ||2||
english: into your home the Lord was born. ||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਬਨ ਖੰਡ ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨਾ ॥
transliteration: dhan dhan ban kha(n)d bi(n)draabanaa ||
english: Blessed, blessed are the forests of Brindaaban;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਖੇਲੈ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਾਰਾਇਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jah khelai sree naaraainaa ||3||
english: the Supreme Lord plays there. ||3||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਬੇਨੁ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਗੋਧਨੁ ਚਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ben bajaavai godhan charai ||
english: He plays the flute, and herds the cows;

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਨਦ ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naame kaa suaamee aanad karai ||4||1||
english: Naam Dayv's Lord and Master plays happily. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੋ ਬਾਪੁ ਮਾਧਉ ਤੂ ਧਨੁ ਕੇਸੌ ਸਾਂਵਲੀਓ ਬੀਠੁਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mero baap maadhau too dhan kesau saa(n)valeeo beethulaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O my Father, Lord of wealth, blessed are You, long-haired, dark-skinned, my darling. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਧਰੇ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਤੇ ਆਏ ਗਜ ਹਸਤੀ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਉਧਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
transliteration: kar dhare chakr baiku(n)th te aae gaj hasatee ke praan udhaareeale ||
english: You hold the steel chakra in Your hand; You came down from Heaven, and saved the life of the elephant.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹਸਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਸਭਾ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਅੰਬਰ ਲੇਤ ਉਬਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: duhasaasan kee sabhaa dropatee a(n)bar let ubaareeale ||1||
english: In the court of Duhsaasan, You saved the honor of Dropati, when her clothes were being removed. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਗੋਤਮ ਨਾਰਿ ਅਹਲਿਆ ਤਾਰੀ ਪਾਵਨ ਕੇਤਕ ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gotam naar ahaliaa taaree paavan ketak taareeale ||
english: You saved Ahliyaa, the wife of Gautam; how many have You purified and carried across?

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਅਧਮੁ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤਉ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਿ ਆਈਅਲੇ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: aisaa adham ajaat naamadeu tau saranaagat aaeeale ||2||2||
english: Such a lowly outcaste as Naam Dayv has come seeking Your Sanctuary. ||2||2||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਸਭੈ ਘਟ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਰਾਮਾ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: sabhai ghat raam bolai raamaa bolai ||
english: Within all hearts, the Lord speaks, the Lord speaks.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam binaa ko bolai re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Who else speaks, other than the Lord? ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਏਕਲ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੁੰਜਰ ਚੀਟੀ ਭਾਜਨ ਹੈਂ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ekal maatee ku(n)jar cheetee bhaajan hai(n) bahu naanaa re ||
english: Out of the same clay, the elephant, the ant, and the many sorts of species are formed.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਾਵਰ ਜੰਗਮ ਕੀਟ ਪਤੰਗਮ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: asathaavar ja(n)gam keet pata(n)gam ghat ghat raam samaanaa re ||1||
english: In stationary life forms, moving beings, worms, moths and within each and every heart, the Lord is contained. ||1||

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਏਕਲ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਅਉਰ ਤਜਹੁ ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ekal chi(n)taa raakh ana(n)taa aur tajahu sabh aasaa re ||
english: Remember the One, Infinite Lord; abandon all other hopes.

author: Bhagat Namdev
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਕਾਮਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕੋ ਦਾਸਾ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: pranavai naamaa bhae nihakaamaa ko thaakur ko daasaa re ||2||3||
english: Naam Dayv prays, I have become dispassionate and detached; who is the Lord and Master, and who is the slave? ||2||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: raag maaroo mahalaa 1 ghar 1 chaupade ||
english: Raag Maaroo, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਾ ਸਦ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saajan tere charan kee hoi rahaa sad dhoor ||
english: O my Friend, I shall forever remain the dust of Your feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak saran tuhaareeaa pekhau sadaa hajoor ||1||
english: Nanak seeks Your protection, and beholds You ever-present, here and now. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ॥
transliteration: sabad ||
english: Shabad:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਛਹੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਦੜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
transliteration: pichhahu raatee sadaRaa naam khasam kaa lehi ||
english: Those who receive the call in the last hours of the night, chant the Name of their Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੇਮੇ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਸਰਾਇਚੇ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਰਥ ਪੀੜੇ ॥
transliteration: kheme chhatr saraaiche disan rath peeRe ||
english: Tents, canopies, pavilions and carriages are prepared and made ready for them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jinee teraa naam dhiaaiaa tin kau sad mile ||1||
english: You send out the call, Lord, to those who meditate on Your Name. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮੈ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
transliteration: baabaa mai karamaheen kooRiaar ||
english: Father, I am unfortunate, a fraud.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਧਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam na paaiaa teraa a(n)dhaa bharam bhoolaa man meraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have not found Your Name; my mind is blind and deluded by doubt. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਦ ਕੀਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਫੁੜੇ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: saad keete dukh paraphuRe poorab likhe maai ||
english: I have enjoyed the tastes, and now my pains have come to fruition; such is my pre-ordained destiny, O my mother.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਥੋੜੇ ਦੁਖ ਅਗਲੇ ਦੂਖੇ ਦੂਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sukh thoRe dukh agale dookhe dookh vihaai ||2||
english: Now my joys are few, and my pains are many. In utter agony, I pass my life. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
transliteration: vichhuRiaa kaa kiaa veechhuRai miliaa kaa kiaa mel ||
english: What separation could be worse than separation from the Lord? For those who are united with Him, what other union can there be?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਖੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saahib so saalaaheeai jin kar dekhiaa khel ||3||
english: Praise the Lord and Master, who, having created this play, beholds it. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲਾਵੜਾ ਇਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਭੋਗ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)jogee melaavaRaa in tan keete bhog ||
english: By good destiny, this union comes about; this body enjoys its pleasures.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੀ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: vijogee mil vichhuRe naanak bhee sa(n)jog ||4||1||
english: Those who have lost their destiny, suffer separation from this union. O Nanak, they may still be united once again! ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mil maat pitaa pi(n)d kamaaiaa ||
english: The union of the mother and father brings the body into being.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tin karatai lekh likhaaiaa ||
english: The Creator inscribes upon it the inscription of its destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਿਖੁ ਦਾਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: likh daat jot vadiaaee ||
english: According to this inscription, gifts, light and glorious greatness are received.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mil maaiaa surat gavaaee ||1||
english: Joining with Maya, the spiritual consciousness is lost. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਰਸਹਿ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: moorakh man kaahe karasahi maanaa ||
english: O foolish mind, why are you so proud?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: uth chalanaa khasamai bhaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall have to arise and depart when it pleases your Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਸਾਦ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: taj saad sahaj sukh hoee ||
english: Abandon the tastes of the world, and find intuitive peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਛਡਣੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ghar chhadane rahai na koee ||
english: All must abandon their worldly homes; no one remains here forever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਖਾਜੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਧਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: kichh khaajai kichh dhar jaaeeai ||
english: Eat some, and save the rest,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: je baahuR duneeaa aaeeai ||2||
english: if you are destined to return to the world again. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਜੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਟੁ ਹਢਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saj kaaiaa pat hadhaae ||
english: He adorns his body and ress in silk robes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: phuramaais bahut chalaae ||
english: He issues all sorts of commands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kar sej sukhaalee sovai ||
english: Preparing his comfortable bed, he sleeps.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਥੀ ਪਉਦੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hathee paudee kaahe rovai ||3||
english: When he falls into the hands of the Messenger of Death, what good does it do to cry out? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਘੁੰਮਣਵਾਣੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ghar ghu(n)manavaanee bhaaee ||
english: Household affairs are whirlpools of entanglements, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਪਥਰ ਤਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: paap pathar taran na jaaee ||
english: Sin is a stone which does not float.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਬੇੜਾ ਜੀਉ ਚੜਾਊ ॥
transliteration: bhau beRaa jeeu chaRaaoo ||
english: So let the Fear of God be the boat to carry your soul across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਾਹੂ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak devai kaahoo ||4||2||
english: Says Nanak, rare are those who are blessed with this Boat. ||4||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਲੇਖ ਪਏ ॥
transliteration: karanee kaagad man masavaanee buraa bhalaa dui lekh pae ||
english: Actions are the paper, and the mind is the ink; good and bad are both recorded upon it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਚਲੀਐ ਤਉ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu jiu kirat chalaae tiu chaleeai tau gun naahee a(n)t hare ||1||
english: As their past actions drive them, so are mortals driven. There is no end to Your Glorious Virtues, Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਵਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: chit chetas kee nahee baavariaa ||
english: Why do you not keep Him in your consciousness, you mad man?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bisarat tere gun galiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Forgetting the Lord, your own virtues shall rot away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਲੀ ਰੈਨਿ ਜਾਲੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਹੂਆ ਜੇਤੀ ਘੜੀ ਫਾਹੀ ਤੇਤੀ ॥
transliteration: jaalee rain jaal din hooaa jetee ghaRee phaahee tetee ||
english: The night is a net, and the day is a net; there are as many traps as there are moments.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਫਾਸਹਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ras ras chog chugahi nit phaasahi chhootas mooRe kavan gunee ||2||
