english: With relish and delight, you continually bite at the bait; you are trapped, you fool - how will you ever escape? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਆਰਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੋਹਾ ਪੰਚ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa aaran man vich lohaa pa(n)ch agan tit laag rahee ||
english: The body is a furnace, and the mind is the iron within it; the five fires are heating it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇਲੇ ਪਾਪ ਪੜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਲਿਆ ਸੰਨੑੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਭਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: koile paap paRe tis oopar man jaliaa sa(n)nhee chi(n)t bhaee ||3||
english: Sin is the charcoal placed upon it, which burns the mind; the tongs are anxiety and worry. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਇਆ ਮਨੂਰੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਨੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaiaa manoor ka(n)chan phir hovai je gur milai tinehaa ||
english: What was turned to slag is again transformed into gold, if one meets with the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਓਹੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਟਸਿ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: ek naam a(n)mrit ohu devai tau naanak trisatas dehaa ||4||3||
english: He blesses the mortal with the Ambrosial Name of the One Lord, and then, O Nanak, the body is held steady. ||4||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਮਲ ਮਝਾਰਿ ਬਸਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲ ਪਦਮਨਿ ਜਾਵਲ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bimal majhaar basas niramal jal padaman jaaval re ||
english: In the pure, immaculate waters, both the lotus and the slimy scum are found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਦਮਨਿ ਜਾਵਲ ਜਲ ਰਸ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੋਖ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: padaman jaaval jal ras sa(n)gat sa(n)g dokh nahee re ||1||
english: The lotus flower is with the scum and the water, but it remains untouched by any pollution. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਾਦਰ ਤੂ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: daadar too kabahi na jaanas re ||
english: You frog, you will never understand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਖਸਿ ਸਿਬਾਲੁ ਬਸਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਖਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bhakhas sibaal basas niramal jal a(n)mrit na lakhas re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You eat the dirt, while you dwell in the immaculate waters. You know nothing of the ambrosial nectar there. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਸੁ ਜਲ ਨਿਤ ਨ ਵਸਤ ਅਲੀਅਲ ਮੇਰ ਚਚਾ ਗੁਨ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bas jal nit na vasat aleeal mer chachaa gun re ||
english: You dwell continually in the water; the bumble bee does not dwell there, but it is intoxicated with its fragrance from afar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦ ਕੁਮੁਦਨੀ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਨਿਵਸਸਿ ਅਨਭਉ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: cha(n)d kumudanee doorahu nivasas anabhau kaaran re ||2||
english: Intuitively sensing the moon in the distance, the lotus bows its head. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਖੰਡੁ ਦੂਧਿ ਮਧੁ ਸੰਚਸਿ ਤੂ ਬਨ ਚਾਤੁਰ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit kha(n)d doodh madh sa(n)chas too ban chaatur re ||
english: The realms of nectar are irrigated with milk and honey; you think you are clever to live in the water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਸਿ ਪਿਸਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਉ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: apanaa aap too kabahu na chhodas pisan preet jiu re ||3||
english: You can never escape your own inner tendencies, like the love of the flea for blood. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਜਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਆਗਮ ਸਾਸ ਸੁਨੇ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit sa(n)g vasahi jan moorakh aagam saas sune ||
english: The fool may live with the Pandit, the religious scholar, and listen to the Vedas and the Shaastras.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਸਿ ਸੁਆਨ ਪੂਛਿ ਜਿਉ ਰੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: apanaa aap too kabahu na chhodas suaan poochh jiu re ||4||
english: You can never escape your own inner tendencies, like the crooked tail of the dog. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ik paakha(n)dee naam na raachahi ik har har charanee re ||
english: Some are hypocrites; they do not merge with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Some are absorbed in the Feet of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਰੇ ॥੫॥੪॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa paavas naanak rasanaa naam jap re ||5||4||
english: The mortals obtain what they are predestined to receive; O Nanak, with your tongue, chant the Naam. ||5||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
transliteration: salok ||
english: Salok:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਅਸੰਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥
transliteration: patit puneet asa(n)kh hohi har charanee man laag ||
english: Countless sinners are sanctified, attaching their minds to the Feet of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ॥੧॥
transliteration: athasath teerath naam prabh naanak jis masatak bhaag ||1||
english: The merits of the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage are found in God's Name, O Nanak, when such destiny is inscribed upon one's forehead. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ॥
transliteration: sabad ||
english: Shabad:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹੇਲੀ ॥
transliteration: sakhee sahelee garab gahelee ||
english: O friends and companions, so puffed up with pride,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਇਕ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sun sah kee ik baat suhelee ||1||
english: listen to this one joyous story of your Husband Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮੈ ਬੇਦਨ ਸਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਾ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo mai bedan saa kis aakhaa maaee ||
english: Who can I tell about my pain, O my mother?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਾਖਾ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har bin jeeu na rahai kaise raakhaa maaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive; how can I comfort it, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਖਰੀ ਰੰਞਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: hau dohaagan kharee ra(n)njaanee ||
english: I am a dejected, discarded bride, totally miserable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਇਆ ਸੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gaiaa s joban dhan pachhutaanee ||2||
english: I have lost my youth; I regret and repent. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too daanaa saahib sir meraa ||
english: You are my wise Lord and Master, above my head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਜਮਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਜਨੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khijamat karee jan ba(n)daa teraa ||3||
english: I serve You as Your humble slave. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਏਹੀ ॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak a(n)desaa ehee ||
english: Nanak humbly prays, this is my only concern:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਵਉ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: bin darasan kaise ravau sanehee ||4||5||
english: without the Blessed Vision of my Beloved, how can I enjoy Him? ||4||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਲ ਖਰੀਦੀ ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: mul khareedee laalaa golaa meraa naau sabhaagaa ||
english: I am Your slave, Your bonded servant, and so I am called fortunate.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਾਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kee bachanee haat bikaanaa jit laaiaa tit laagaa ||1||
english: I sold myself at Your store in exchange for the Guru's Word; whatever You link me to, to that I am linked. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tere laale kiaa chaturaaee ||
english: What cleverness can Your servant try with You?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saahib kaa hukam na karanaa jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O my Lord and Master, I cannot carry out the Hukam of Your Command. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾ ਲਾਲੀ ਪਿਉ ਲਾਲਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਾ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maa laalee piu laalaa meraa hau laale kaa jaaiaa ||
english: My mother is Your slave, and my father is Your slave; I am the child of Your slaves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੀ ਨਾਚੈ ਲਾਲਾ ਗਾਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: laalee naachai laalaa gaavai bhagat karau teree raaiaa ||2||
english: My slave mother dances, and my slave father sings; I practice devotional worship to You, O my Sovereign Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੀਅਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਣੀ ਆਣੀ ਮੀਰਾ ਖਾਹਿ ਤ ਪੀਸਣ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: peeahi ta paanee aanee meeraa khaahi ta peesan jaau ||
english: If You wish to drink, then I shall get water for You; if You wish to eat, I shall grind the corn for You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪੈਰ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਜਪਤ ਰਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pakhaa pheree pair malovaa japat rahaa teraa naau ||3||
english: I wave the fan over You, and wash Your feet, and continue to chant Your Name. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਾਲਾ ਬਖਸਿਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: loon haraamee naanak laalaa bakhasihi tudh vadiaaee ||
english: I have been untrue to myself, but Nanak is Your slave; please forgive him, by Your glorious greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: aad jugaad daiaapat daataa tudh vin mukat na paaee ||4||6||
english: Since the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You have been the merciful and generous Lord. Without You, liberation cannot be attained. ||4||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ ਭੂਤਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: koee aakhai bhootanaa ko kahai betaalaa ||
english: Some call him a ghost; some say that he is a demon.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ ਆਦਮੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: koee aakhai aadamee naanak vechaaraa ||1||
english: Some call him a mere mortal; O, poor Nanak! ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਇਆ ਦਿਵਾਨਾ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaiaa divaanaa saah kaa naanak bauraanaa ||
english: Crazy Nanak has gone insane, after his Lord, the King.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau har bin avar na jaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I know of none other than the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਭੈ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tau devaanaa jaaneeai jaa bhai devaanaa hoi ||
english: He alone is known to be insane, when he goes insane with the Fear of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ekee saahib baaharaa doojaa avar na jaanai koi ||2||
english: He recognizes none other than the One Lord and Master. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਏਕਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tau devaanaa jaaneeai jaa ekaa kaar kamaai ||
english: He alone is known to be insane, if he works for the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਦੂਜੀ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hukam pachhaanai khasam kaa doojee avar siaanap kaai ||3||
english: Recognizing the Hukam, the Command of his Lord and Master, what other cleverness is there? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tau devaanaa jaaneeai jaa saahib dhare piaar ||
english: He alone is known to be insane, when he falls in love with his Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: ma(n)daa jaanai aap kau avar bhalaa sa(n)saar ||4||7||
english: He sees himself as bad, and all the rest of the world as good. ||4||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ihu dhan sarab rahiaa bharapoor ||
english: This wealth is all-pervading, permeating all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: manamukh phirahi s jaanahi door ||1||
english: The self-willed manmukh wanders around, thinking that it is far away. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so dhan vakhar naam ridai hamaarai ||
english: That commodity, the wealth of the Naam, is within my heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis too dehi tisai nisataarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whoever You bless with it, is emancipated. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: na ihu dhan jalai na tasakar lai jaai ||
english: This wealth does not burn; it cannot be stolen by a thief.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਡੂਬੈ ਨ ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: na ihu dhan doobai na is dhan kau milai sajaai ||2||
english: This wealth does not drown, and its owner is never punished. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: is dhan kee dekhahu vadiaaee ||
english: Gaze upon the glorious greatness of this wealth,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sahaje maate anadin jaaee ||3||
english: and your nights and days will pass, imbued with celestial peace. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਬਾਤ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਨਰ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ik baat anoop sunahu nar bhaaee ||
english: Listen to this incomparably beautiful story, O my brothers, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: is dhan bin kahahu kinai param gat paaee ||4||
english: Tell me, without this wealth, who has ever obtained the supreme status? ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਕਥ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak akath kee kathaa sunaae ||
english: Nanak humbly prays, I proclaim the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥੮॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta ihu dhan paae ||5||8||
english: If one meets the True Guru, then this wealth is obtained. ||5||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰ ਸਰੁ ਸੋਸਿ ਲੈ ਸੋਮ ਸਰੁ ਪੋਖਿ ਲੈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਤੁ ਸੁ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: soor sar sos lai som sar pokh lai jugat kar marat s sanaba(n)dh keejai ||
english: Heat up the sun energy of the right nostril, and cool down the moon energy of the left nostril; practicing this breath-control, bring them into perfect balance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: meen kee chapal siu jugat man raakheeai udai nah ha(n)s nah ka(n)dh chheejai ||1||
english: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall will not crumble. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂੜੇ ਕਾਇਚੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾ ॥
transliteration: mooRe kaaiche bharam bhulaa ||
english: You fool, why are you deluded by doubt?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: nah cheeniaa paramaana(n)d bairaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You do not remember the detached Lord of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਜਰ ਗਹੁ ਜਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਅਮਰ ਗਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਤਉ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: ajar gahu jaar lai amar gahu maar lai bhraat taj chhod tau apiu peejai ||
english: Seize and burn the unbearable; seize and kill the imperishable; leave behind your doubts, and then, you shall drink in the Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: meen kee chapal siu jugat man raakheeai udai nah ha(n)s nah ka(n)dh chheejai ||2||
english: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall shall not crumble. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੋ ਰਵੈ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੋ ਮਨ ਪਵਨ ਸਿਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak jano ravai je har mano man pavan siu a(n)mrit peejai ||
english: Nanak humbly prays, if the Lord's humble servant dwells upon Him, in his mind of minds, with his every breath, then he drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੯॥
transliteration: meen kee chapal siu jugat man raakheeai udai nah ha(n)s nah ka(n)dh chheejai ||3||9||
english: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall shall not crumble. ||3||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੁਈ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਆ ਸਰੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਮੈ ਮਤੁ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa muee na man muaa sar laharee mai mat ||
english: Maya is not conquered, and the mind is not subdued; the waves of desire in the world-ocean are intoxicating wine.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਜਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਰਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: bohith jal sir tar tikai saachaa vakhar jit ||
english: The boat crosses over the water, carrying the true merchandise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਕੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਤੁ ॥
transliteration: maanak man mahi man maarasee sach na laagai kat ||
english: The jewel within the mind subdues the mind; attached to the Truth, it is not broken.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਤਖਤਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਗੁਣੀ ਭੈ ਪੰਚਾਇਣ ਰਤੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raajaa takhat tikai gunee bhai pa(n)chaain rat ||1||
english: The king is seated upon the throne, imbued with the Fear of God and the five qualities. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: baabaa saachaa saahib door na dekh ||
english: O Baba, do not see your True Lord and Master as being far away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab jot jagajeevanaa sir sir saachaa lekh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Light of all, the Life of the world; The True Lord writes His Inscription on each and every head. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰਿਖੀ ਮੁਨੀ ਸੰਕਰੁ ਇੰਦੁ ਤਪੈ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan rikhee munee sa(n)kar i(n)d tapai bhekhaaree ||
english: Brahma and Vishnu, the Rishis and the silent sages, Shiva and Indra, penitents and beggars

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਹੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਆਕੀ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਫਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maanai hukam sohai dar saachai aakee marahi aphaaree ||
english: - whoever obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, looks beautiful in the Court of the True Lord, while the stubborn rebels die.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੰਗਮ ਜੋਧ ਜਤੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)gam jodh jatee sa(n)niaasee gur poorai veechaaree ||
english: The wandering beggars, warriors, celibates and Sannyaasee hermits - through the Perfect Guru, consider this:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਫਲੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin sevaa phal kabahu na paavas sevaa karanee saaree ||2||
english: without selfless service, no one ever receives the fruits of their rewards. Serving the Lord is the most excellent action. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਧਨਿਆ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਗੁਰਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿੰਮਾਣਿਆ ਤੂ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: nidhaniaa dhan niguriaa gur ni(n)maaniaa too maan ||
english: You are the wealth of the poor, the Guru of the guru-less, the honor of the dishonored.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਕੜਿਆ ਨਿਤਾਣਿਆ ਤੂ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhulai maanak gur pakaRiaa nitaaniaa too taan ||
english: I am blind; I have grasped hold of the jewel, the Guru. You are the strength of the weak.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਪਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: hom japaa nahee jaaniaa guramatee saach pachhaan ||
english: He is not known through burnt offerings and ritual chanting; the True Lord is known through the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਝੂਠਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam binaa naahee dar dhoee jhoothaa aavan jaan ||3||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one finds shelter in the Court of the Lord; the false come and go in reincarnation. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: saachaa naam salaaheeai saache te tripat hoi ||
english: So praise the True Name, and through the True Name, you will find satisfaction.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: giaan ratan man maajeeai bahuR na mailaa hoi ||
english: When the mind is cleaned with the jewel of spiritual wisdom, it does not become dirty again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jab lag saahib man vasai tab lag bighan na hoi ||
english: As long as the Lord and Master dwells in the mind, no obstacles are encountered.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak sir de chhuteeai man tan saachaa soi ||4||10||
english: O Nanak, giving one's head, one is emancipated, and the mind and body become true. ||4||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: jogee jugat naam niramaail taa kai mail na raatee ||
english: The Yogi who is joined to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is pure; he is not stained by even a particle of dirt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਗਤਿ ਬੀਤੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: preetam naath sadaa sach sa(n)ge janam maran gat beetee ||1||
english: The True Lord, his Beloved, is always with him; the rounds of birth and death are ended for him. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਸਾਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: gusaaee teraa kahaa naam kaise jaatee ||
english: O Lord of the Universe, what is Your Name, and what is it like?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਉ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਛਉ ਬਾਤ ਨਿਰੰਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa tau bheetar mahal bulaavahi poochhau baat nira(n)tee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If You summon me into the Mansion of Your Presence, I will ask You, how I can become one with You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪੂਜੇ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: brahaman braham giaan isanaanee har gun pooje paatee ||
english: He alone is a Brahmin, who takes his cleansing bath in the spiritual wisdom of God, and whose leaf-offerings in worship are the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: eko naam ek naaraain tribhavan ekaa jotee ||2||
english: The One Name, the One Lord, and His One Light pervade the three worlds. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਡੰਡੀ ਇਹੁ ਘਟੁ ਛਾਬਾ ਤੋਲਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਜਾਚੀ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa da(n)dee ihu ghat chhaabaa tolau naam ajaachee ||
english: My tongue is the balance of the scale, and this heart of mine is the pan of the scale; I weigh the immeasurable Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਹਾਟੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਭਾਤੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: eko haat saahu sabhanaa sir vanajaare ik bhaatee ||3||
english: There is one store, and one banker above all; the merchants deal in the one commodity. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੋਵੈ ਸਿਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨਿਬੇੜੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: dovai sire satiguroo nibeRe so boojhai jis ek liv laagee jeeahu rahai nibharaatee ||
english: The True Guru saves us at both ends; he alone understands, who is lovingly focused on the One Lord; his inner being remains free of doubt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਏ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sabad vasaae bharam chukaae sadaa sevak din raatee ||4||
english: The Word of the Shabad abides within, and doubt is ended, for those who constantly serve, day and night. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਗਗਨ ਪਰਿ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅਗਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੁਨਿ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: oopar gagan gagan par gorakh taa kaa agam guroo pun vaasee ||
english: Above is the sky of the mind, and beyond this sky is the Lord, the Protector of the World; the Inaccessible Lord God; the Guru abides there as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥੫॥੧੧॥
transliteration: gur bachanee baahar ghar eko naanak bhaiaa udaasee ||5||11||
english: According to the Word of the Guru's Teachings, what is outside is the same as what is inside the home of the self. Nanak has become a detached renunciate. ||5||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
transliteration: raag maaroo mahalaa 1 ghar 5 ||
english: Raag Maaroo, First Mehl, Fifth House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ahinis jaagai need na sovai ||
english: Day and night, he remains awake and aware; he never sleeps or dreams.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਦਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so jaanai jis vedan hovai ||
english: He alone knows this, who feels the pain of separation from God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਨ ਲਗੇ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵੈਦੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prem ke kaan lage tan bheetar vaid k jaanai kaaree jeeu ||1||
english: My body is pierced through with the arrow of love. How can any physician know the cure? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis no saachaa siphatee laae ||
english: Rare is that one, who as Gurmukh,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh virale kisai bujhaae ||
english: Understands, and whom the True Lord links to His Praise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit kee saar soee jaanai j a(n)mrit kaa vaapaaree jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He alone appreciates the value of the Ambsosial Nectar, who deals in this Ambrosia. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਧਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਰਚਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pir setee dhan prem rachaae ||
english: The soul-bride is in love with her Husband Lord;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਥਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad tathaa chit laae ||
english: She focuses her consciousness on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sahaj setee dhan kharee suhelee trisanaa tikhaa nivaaree jeeu ||2||
english: The soul-bride is joyously embellished with intuitive ease; her hunger and thirst are taken away. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਤੋੜੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sahasaa toRe bharam chukaae ||
english: Tear down skepticism and dispel your doubt;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sahaje siphatee dhanakh chaRaae ||
english: with your intuition, draw the bow of the Praise of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਗਾਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad marai man maare su(n)dar jogaadhaaree jeeu ||3||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, conquer and subdue your mind; take the support of Yoga - Union with the beautiful Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲਿਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: haumai jaliaa manahu visaare ||
english: Burnt by egotism, one forgets the Lord from his mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਵਜਹਿ ਖੜਗ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jam pur vajahi khaRag karaare ||
english: In the City of Death, he is attacked with massive swords.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕੈ ਕਹਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਲਈ ਤੂ ਸਹੁ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਭਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ab kai kahiai naam na milaee too sahu jeeaRe bhaaree jeeu ||4||
english: Then, even if he asks for it, he will not receive the Lord's Name; O soul, you shall suffer terrible punishment. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਪਵਹਿ ਖਿਆਲੀ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mamataa pavahi khiaalee ||
english: You are distracted by thoughts of Maya and worldly attachment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਫਾਸਹਿਗਾ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: jam pur phaasahigaa jam jaalee ||
english: In the City of Death, you will be caught by the noose of the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੇਤ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: het ke ba(n)dhan toR na saakahi taa jam kare khuaaree jeeu ||5||
english: You cannot break free from the bondage of loving attachment, and so the Messenger of Death will torture you. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: naa hau karataa naa mai keeaa ||
english: I have done nothing; I am doing nothing now.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam satigur deeaa ||
english: The True Guru has blessed me with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥੧॥੧੨॥
transliteration: jis too dehi tisai kiaa chaaraa naanak saran tumaaree jeeu ||6||1||12||
english: What other efforts can anyone make, when You bestow Your blessing? Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||6||1||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਬੈਸਾਲਹਿ ਤਹ ਬੈਸਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਹ ਭੇਜਹਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jah baisaalahi tah baisaa suaamee jah bhejahi tah jaavaa ||
english: Wherever You seat me, there I sit, O my Lord and Master; wherever You send me, there I go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ਸਭੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਥਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh nagaree mahi eko raajaa sabhe pavit hahi thaavaa ||1||
english: In the entire village, there is only One King; all places are sacred. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਸਾ ਸਚ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: baabaa dehi vasaa sach gaavaa ||
english: O Baba, while I dwell in this body, let me sing Your True Praises,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa te sahaje sahaj samaavaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: that I may intuitively merge with You. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪਸ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਏਈ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: buraa bhalaa kichh aapas te jaaniaa eee sagal vikaaraa ||
english: He thinks that good and bad deeds come from himself; this is the source of all evil.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਆ ਵਰਤੈ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ihu phuramaaiaa khasam kaa hoaa varatai ihu sa(n)saaraa ||2||
english: Whatever happens in this world is only by the Order of our Lord and Master. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਧਾਤੁ ਸਬਲ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: i(n)dree dhaat sabal kaheeat hai i(n)dree kis te hoee ||
english: Sexual desires are so strong and compelling; where has this sexual desire come from?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੈ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਐਸਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape khel karai sabh karataa aisaa boojhai koee ||3||
english: The Creator Himself stages all the plays; how rare are those who realize this. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਤਦੇ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ek liv laagee dubidhaa tade binaasee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one is lovingly focused on the One Lord, and then, duality is ended.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaanaa so sat kar maaniaa kaatee jam kee phaasee ||4||
english: Whatever is in harmony with His Will, he accepts as True; the noose of Death is loosened from around his neck. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਕਵਨਾ ਜਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak lekhaa maagai kavanaa jaa chookaa man abhimaanaa ||
english: Prays Nanak, who can call him to account, when the egotistical pride of his mind has been silenced?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾਸੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਏ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੫॥੧॥
transliteration: taas taas dharam raai japat hai pae sache kee saranaa ||5||1||
english: Even the Righteous Judge of Dharma is intimidated and afraid of him; he has entered the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||5||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa naa theeai nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||
english: Coming and going in reincarnation no longer exist, when one dwells in the home of the self within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sach khajaanaa bakhasiaa aape jaanai soi ||1||
english: He bestowed the Blessing of His treasure of truth; only He Himself knows. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਚੇਤਿ ਤੂ ਮਨਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: e man har jeeu chet too manahu taj vikaar ||
english: O my mind, remember the Dear Lord, and abandon the corruption of your mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad dhiaai too sach lagee piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad; focus lovingly on the Truth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਥੁ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aithai naavahu bhuliaa phir hath kithaaoo na paai ||
english: One who forgets the Name in this world, shall not find any place of rest anywhere else.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਨੀ ਸਭਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਨਿ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jonee sabh bhavaaeean bisataa maahi samaai ||2||
english: He shall wander in all sorts of reincarnations, and rot away in manure. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee gur paaiaa poorab likhiaa maai ||
english: By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, according to my pre-ordained destiny, O my mother.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anadin sachee bhagat kar sachaa lae milaai ||3||
english: Night and day, I practice true devotional worship; I am united with the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aape srisat sabh saajeean aape nadar karei ||
english: He Himself fashioned the entire universe; He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam vadiaaeeaa jai bhaavai tai dei ||4||2||
english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glorious and great; as He pleases, He bestows His Blessings. ||4||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਬਖਸਾਇ ਜੀਉ ਅਬ ਤੂ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: pichhale gunah bakhasaai jeeu ab too maarag paai ||
english: Please forgive my past mistakes, O my Dear Lord; now, please place me on the Path.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har kee charanee laag rahaa vichahu aap gavaai ||1||
english: I remain attached to the Lord's Feet, and eradicate self-conceit from within. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: mere man guramukh naam har dhiaai ||
english: O my mind, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sadaa har charanee laag rahaa ik man ekai bhaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Remain attached forever to the Lord's Feet, single-mindedly, with love for the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਥੇਹੁ ਨ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naa mai jaat na pat hai naa mai thehu na thaau ||
english: I have no social status or honor; I have no place or home.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabad bhed bhram katiaa gur naam deeaa samajhaai ||2||
english: Pierced through by the Word of the Shabad, my doubts have been cut away. The Guru has inspired me to understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲਚ ਕਰਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ihu man laalach karadaa phirai laalach laagaa jaai ||
english: This mind wanders around, driven by greed, totally attached to greed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhai kooR viaapiaa jam pur chotaa khaai ||3||
english: He is engrossed in false pursuits; he shall endure beatings in the City of Death. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak sabh kichh aape aap hai doojaa naahee koi ||
english: O Nanak, God Himself Himself is all-in-all. There is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: bhagat khajaanaa bakhasion guramukhaa sukh hoi ||4||3||
english: He bestows the treasure of devotional worship, and the Gurmukhs abide in peace. ||4||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਟੋਲਿ ਲਹੁ ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sach rate se tol lahu se virale sa(n)saar ||
english: Seek and find those who are imbued with Truth; they are so rare in this world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tin miliaa mukh ujalaa jap naam muraar ||1||
english: Meeting with them, one's face becomes radiant and bright, chanting the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: baabaa saachaa saahib ridai samaal ||
english: O Baba, contemplate and cherish the True Lord and Master within your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਭਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur apanaa puchh dekh lehu vakhar bhaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Seek out and see, and ask your True Guru, and obtain the true commodity. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਦੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ik sachaa sabh sevadee dhur bhaag milaavaa hoi ||
english: All serve the One True Lord; through pre-ordained destiny, they meet Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh mile se na vichhuRahi paavahi sach soi ||2||
english: The Gurmukhs merge with Him, and will not be separated from Him again; they attain the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: ik bhagatee saar na jaananee manamukh bharam bhulaai ||
english: Some do not appreciate the value of devotional worship; the self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: onaa vich aap varatadaa karanaa kichhoo na jaai ||3||
english: They are fillled with self-conceit; they cannot accomplish anything. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਖਲੇ ਕੀਚੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jis naal jor na chalaee khale keechai aradaas ||
english: Stand and offer your prayer, to the One who cannot be moved by force.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh naam man vasai taa sun kare saabaas ||4||4||
english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within the mind of the Gurmukh; hearing his prayer, the Lord applauds him. ||4||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਤੇ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਕਰੇ ਮਨੂਰਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: maaroo te seetal kare manoorahu ka(n)chan hoi ||
english: He transforms the burning desert into a cool oasis; he transmutes rusted iron into gold.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so saachaa saalaaheeai tis jevad avar na koi ||1||
english: So praise the True Lord; there is none other as great as He is. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mere man anadin dhiaai har naau ||
english: O my mind, night and day, meditate on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਤੂ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur kai bachan araadh too anadin gun gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Teachings, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh eko jaaneeai jaa satigur dei bujhaai ||
english: As Gurmukh, one comes to know the One Lord, when the True Guru instructs him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਦੂ ਏਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so satigur saalaaheeai jidoo eh sojhee paai ||2||
english: Praise the True Guru, who imparts this understanding. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਨਿ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur chhod doojai lage kiaa karan agai jaai ||
english: Those who forsake the True Guru, and attach themselves to duality - what will they do when they go to the world hereafter?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jam pur badhe maareeahi bahutee milai sajaai ||3||
english: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, they will be beaten. They will be punished severely. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh veparavaahu hai naa tis til na tamaai ||
english: My God is independent and self-sufficient; he does not have even an iota of greed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak tis saranaaee bhaj pau aape bakhas milaai ||4||5||
english: O Nanak, run to His Sanctuary; granting His forgiveness, He merges us into Himself. ||4||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
english: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਕ ਜਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
transliteration: japio naam suk janak gur bachanee har har saran pare ||
english: Suk-deva and Janak meditated on the Naam; following the Guru's Teachings, they sought the Sanctuary of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਜਿ ਸੁਦਾਮੇ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: daalad bha(n)j sudaame milio bhagatee bhaai tare ||
english: God met Sudama and removed his poverty; through loving devotional worship, he crossed over.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਾਰਥੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal har naam kritaarath guramukh kripaa kare ||1||
english: God is the Lover of His devotees; the Lord's Name is fufilling; God showers His Mercy on the Gurmukhs. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਉਧਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mere man naam japat udhare ||
english: O my mind, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you will be saved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਬਿਦਰੁ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dhroo prahilaad bidar daasee sut guramukh naam tare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Dhroo, Prahlaad and Bidar the slave-girl's son, became Gurmukh, and through the Naam, crossed over. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਉਧਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kalajug naam pradhaan padaarath bhagat janaa udhare ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Naam is the supreme wealth; it saves the humble devotees.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਚਮਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naamaa jaideu kabeer trilochan sabh dokh gae chamare ||
english: All the faults of Naam Dayv, Jai Dayv, Kabeer, Trilochan and Ravi Daas the leather-worker were covered.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਟਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh naam lage se udhare sabh kilabikh paap tare ||2||
english: Those who become Gurmukh, and remain attached to the Naam, are saved; all their sins are washed off. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੋਖ ਪਰਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jo jo naam japai aparaadhee sabh tin ke dokh parahare ||
english: Whoever chants the Naam, all his sins and mistakes are taken away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਆ ਰਵਤ ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਨਰਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: besuaa ravat ajaamal udhario mukh bolai naaraain narahare ||
english: Ajaamal, who had sex with prostitites, was saved, by chanting the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਣਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਤੋੜਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam japat ugrasain gat paaee toR ba(n)dhan mukat kare ||3||
english: Chanting the Naam, Ugar Sain obtained salvation; his bonds were broken, and he was liberated. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jan kau aap anugrahu keeaa har a(n)geekaar kare ||
english: God Himself takes pity on His humble servants, and makes them His own.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਉਧਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sevak paij rakhai meraa govid saran pare udhare ||
english: My Lord of the Universe saves the honor of His servants; those who seek His Sanctuary are saved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਉਰ ਧਰਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jan naanak har kirapaa dhaaree ur dhario naam hare ||4||1||
english: The Lord has showered servant Nanak with His Mercy; he has enshrined the Lord's Name within his heart. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sidh samaadh japio liv laaee saadhik mun japiaa ||
english: The Siddhas in Samaadhi meditate on Him; they are lovingly focused on Him. The seekers and the silent sages meditate on Him as well.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਰਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jatee satee sa(n)tokhee dhiaaiaa mukh i(n)draadik raviaa ||
english: The celibates, the true and contented beings meditate on Him; Indra and the other gods chant His Name with their mouths.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਜਪਿਓ ਤੇ ਭਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saran pare japio te bhaae guramukh paar paiaa ||1||
english: Those who seek His Sanctuary meditate on Him; they become Gurmukh and swim across. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mere man naam japat tariaa ||
english: O my mind, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and cross over.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ ਬਾਲਮੀਕੁ ਬਟਵਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)naa jat baalameek batavaaraa guramukh paar paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Dhanna the farmer, and Balmik the highway robber, became Gurmukh, and crossed over. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬੇ ਜਪਿਓ ਰਿਖਿ ਬਪੁਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sur nar gan ga(n)dharabe japio rikh bapurai har gaaiaa ||
english: Angels, men, heavenly heralds and celestial singers meditate on Him; even the humble Rishis sing of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਦੇਵੀ ਜਪਿਓ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)kar brahamai devee japio mukh har har naam japiaa ||
english: Shiva, Brahma and the goddess Lakhshmi, meditate, and chant with their mouths the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har har naam jinaa man bheenaa te guramukh paar paiaa ||2||
english: Those whose minds are drenched with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, as Gurmukh, cross over. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤਿਆ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kot kot tetees dhiaaio har japatiaa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: Millions and millions, three hundred thirty million gods meditate on Him; there is no end to those who meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan simrit har japiaa mukh pa(n)dit har gaaiaa ||
english: The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees meditate on the Lord; the Pandits, the religious scholars, sing the Lord's Praises as well.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam rasaal jinaa man vasiaa te guramukh paar paiaa ||3||
english: Those whose minds are filled with the Naam, the source of nectar - as Gurmukh, they cross over. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਕਰਿ ਸਕਿਆ ॥
transliteration: anat tara(n)gee naam jin japiaa mai ganat na kar sakiaa ||
english: Those who chant the Naam in endless waves - I cannot even count their number.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਏ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gobid kripaa kare thaai paae jo har prabh man bhaaiaa ||
english: The Lord of the Universe bestows His Mercy, and those who are pleasing to the Mind of the Lord God, find their place.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: gur dhaar kripaa har naam driRaaio jan naanak naam laiaa ||4||2||
english: The Guru, granting His Grace, implants the Lord's Name within; servant Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 ghar 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam nidhaan lai guramat har pat paai ||
english: Take the treasure of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Follow the Guru's Teachings, and the Lord shall bless you with honor.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
transliteration: halat palat naal chaladaa har a(n)te lae chhadaai ||
english: Here and hereafter, the Lord goes with you; in the end, He shall deliver you.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਅਵਘਟ ਗਲੀਆ ਭੀੜੀਆ ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jithai avaghat galeeaa bheeReeaa tithai har har mukat karaai ||1||
english: Where the path is difficult and the street is narrow, there the Lord shall liberate you. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mere satiguraa mai har har naam driRaai ||
english: O my True Guru, implant within me the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪੋ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: meraa maat pitaa sut ba(n)dhapo mai har bin avar na maai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord is my mother, father, child and relative; I have none other than the Lord, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: mai har birahee har naam hai koee aan milaavai maai ||
english: I feel the pains of love and yearning for the Lord, and the Name of the Lord. If only someone would come and unite me with Him, O my mother.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਮੈ ਜੋਦੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: tis aagai mai jodaRee meraa preetam dei milaai ||
english: I bow in humble devotion to one who inspires me to meet with my Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: satigur purakh daiaal prabh har mele dhil na paai ||2||
english: The almighty and merciful True Guru unites me with the Lord God instantaneously. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jin har har naam na chetio se bhaagaheen mar jaai ||
english: Those who do not remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are most unfortunate, and are slaughtered.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: oi phir phir jon bhavaaeeahi mar ja(n)mahi aavai jaai ||
english: They wander in reincarnation, again and again; they die, and are re-born, and continue coming and going.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: oi jam dar badhe maareeahi har daragah milai sajaai ||3||
english: Bound and gagged at Death's Door, they are cruelly beaten, and punished in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: too prabh ham saranaagatee mo kau mel laihu har raai ||
english: O God, I seek Your Sanctuary; O my Sovereign Lord King, please unite me with Yourself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har dhaar kripaa jagajeevanaa gur satigur kee saranaai ||
english: O Lord, Life of the World, please shower me with Your Mercy; grant me the Sanctuary of the Guru, the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: har jeeu aap daiaal hoi jan naanak har melaai ||4||1||3||
english: The Dear Lord, becoming merciful, has blended servant Nanak with Himself. ||4||1||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਸਾਇਦਾ ਕੋ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: hau poo(n)jee naam dasaaidaa ko dase har dhan raas ||
english: I inquire about the commodity of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Is there anyone who can show me the wealth, the capital of the Lord?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਖਨ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: hau tis vitahu khan kha(n)neeai mai mele har prabh paas ||
english: I cut myself into pieces, and make myself a sacrifice to that one who leads me to meet my Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ ਕਿਉ ਸਜਣੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mai a(n)tar prem pira(n)m kaa kiu sajan milai milaas ||1||
english: I am filled with the Love of my Beloved; how can I meet my Friend, and merge with Him? ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: man piaariaa mitraa mai har har naam dhan raas ||
english: O my beloved friend, my mind, I take the wealth, the capital of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਧੀਰਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai naam driRaaiaa har dheerak har saabaas ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Naam within me; the Lord is my support - I celebrate the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: har har aap milaai gur mai dase har dhan raas ||
english: O my Guru, please unite me with the Lord, Har, Har; show me the wealth, the capital of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਜਨ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: bin gur prem na labhaee jan vekhahu man nirajaas ||
english: Without the Guru, love does not well up; see this, and know it in your mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har gur vich aap rakhiaa har mele gur saabaas ||2||
english: The Lord has installed Himself within the Guru; so praise the Guru, who unites us with the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: saagar bhagat bha(n)daar har poore satigur paas ||
english: The ocean, the treasure of devotional worship of the Lord, rests with the Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਖੋਲਿ ਦੇਇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur tuthaa khol dei mukh guramukh har paragaas ||
english: When it pleases the True Guru, He opens the treasure, and and the Gurmukhs are illuminated by the Lord's Light.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਗ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਤਿਖ ਮੁਈਆ ਕੰਧੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: manamukh bhaag vihooniaa tikh mueeaa ka(n)dhee paas ||3||
english: The unfortunate self-willed manmukhs die of thirst, on the very bank of the river. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: gur daataa daataar hai hau maagau daan gur paas ||
english: The Guru is the Great Giver; I beg for this gift from the Guru,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਡੜੀ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: chiree vichhu(n)naa mel prabh mai man tan vadaRee aas ||
english: that He may unite me with God, from whom I was separated for so long! This is the great hope of my mind and body.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: gur bhaavai sun benatee jan naanak kee aradaas ||4||2||4||
english: If it pleases You, O my Guru, please listen to my prayer; this is servant Nanak's prayer. ||4||2||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har har kathaa sunaai prabh guramat har ridai samaanee ||
english: O Lord God, please preach Your sermon to me. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is merged into my heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jap har har kathaa vadabhaageeaa har utam pad nirabaanee ||
english: Meditate on the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, O very fortunate ones; the Lord shall bless you with the most sublime status of Nirvaanaa.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukhaa man parateet hai gur poorai naam samaanee ||1||
english: The minds of the Gurmukhs are filled with faith; through the Perfect Guru, they merge in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: man mere mai har har kathaa man bhaanee ||
english: O my mind, the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਤ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har kathaa nit sadaa kar guramukh akath kahaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Continually and forever, speak the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har; as Gurmukh, speak the Unspoken Speech. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: mai man tan khoj dha(n)dholiaa kiu paaeeai akath kahaanee ||
english: I have searched through and through my mind and body; how can I attain this Unspoken Speech?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil paaiaa sun akath kathaa man bhaanee ||
english: Meeting with the humble Saints, I have found it; listening to the Unspoken Speech, my mind is pleased.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: merai man tan naam adhaar har mai mele purakh sujaanee ||2||
english: The Lord's Name is the Support of my mind and body; I am united with the all-knowing Primal Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gur purakhai purakh milaai prabh mil suratee surat samaanee ||
english: The Guru, the Primal Being, has united me with the Primal Lord God. My consciousness has merged into the supreme consciousness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: vadabhaagee gur seviaa har paaiaa sughaR sujaanee ||
english: By great good fortune, I serve the Guru, and I have found my Lord, all-wise and all-knowing.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਾਗ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: manamukh bhaag vihooniaa tin dukhee rain vihaanee ||3||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are very unfortunate; they pass their life-night in misery and pain. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ham jaachik deen prabh teriaa mukh deejai a(n)mrit baanee ||
english: I am just a meek beggar at Your Door, God; please, place the Ambrosial Word of Your Bani in my mouth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur meraa mitr prabh har melahu sughaR sujaanee ||
english: The True Guru is my friend; He unites me with my all-wise, all-knowing Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak saranaagatee kar kirapaa naam samaanee ||4||3||5||
english: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary; grant Your Grace, and merge me into Your Name. ||4||3||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਲਗਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: har bhaau lagaa bairaageeaa vadabhaagee har man raakh ||
english: Detached from the world, I am in love with the Lord; by great good fortune, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਊਪਜੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: mil sa(n)gat saradhaa oopajai gurasabadee har ras chaakh ||
english: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, faith has welled up within me; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I taste the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh man tan hariaa hoiaa gurabaanee har gun bhaakh ||1||
english: My mind and body have totally blossomed forth; through the Word of the Guru's Bani, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: man piaariaa mitraa har har naam ras chaakh ||
english: O my beloved mind, my friend, taste the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai har paaiaa halat palat pat raakh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, I have found the Lord, who saves my honor, here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: har har naam dhiaaeeai har keerat guramukh chaakh ||
english: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; as Gurmukh, taste the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: tan dharatee har beejeeai vich sa(n)gat har prabh raakh ||
english: Plant the seed of the Lord in the body-farm. The Lord God is enshrined within the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit har har naam hai gur poorai har ras chaakh ||2||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar. Through the Perfect Guru, taste the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬਹੁ ਲਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh trisanaa bhar rahe man aasaa dah dis bahu laakh ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are filled with hunger and thirst; their minds run around in the ten directions, hoping for great wealth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai dhrig jeevade vich bisataa manamukh raakh ||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, their life is cursed; the manmukhs are stuck in manure.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: oi aavahi jaahi bhavaaeeahi bahu jonee duraga(n)dh bhaakh ||3||
english: They come and go, and are consigned to wander through uncounted incarnations, eating stinking rot. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: traahi traahi saranaagatee har daiaa dhaar prabh raakh ||
english: Begging, imploring, I seek Your Sanctuary; Lord, shower me with Your Mercy, and save me, God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)gat melaap kar har naam milai pat saakh ||
english: Lead me to join the Society of the Saints, and bless me with the honor and glory of the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: har har naam dhan paaiaa jan naanak guramat bhaakh ||4||4||6||
english: I have obtained the wealth of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; servant Nanak chants the Lord's Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||4||4||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 ghar 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl, Fifth House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har har bhagat bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
english: Devotional worship to the Lord, Har, Har, is an overflowing treasure.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh raam kare nisataaraa ||
english: The Gurmukh is emancipated by the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis no kripaa kare meraa suaamee so har ke gun gaavai jeeu ||1||
english: One who is blessed by the Mercy of my Lord and Master sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: har har kripaa kare banavaalee ||
english: O Lord, Har, Har, take pity on me,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: har hiradai sadaa sadaa samaalee ||
english: that within my heart, I may dwell upon You, Lord, forever and ever.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu mere jeeaRe jap har har naam chhadaavai jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, you shall be emancipated. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar a(n)mrit har naau ||
english: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the ocean of peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)gat jan jaachai har dehu pasaau ||
english: The beggar begs for it; O Lord, please bless him, in Your kindness.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har sat sat sadaa har sat har sat merai man bhaavai jeeu ||2||
english: True, True is the Lord; the Lord is forever True; the True Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਵੇ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਸ੍ਰਵਹਿ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ॥
transliteration: nave chhidr sravahi apavitraa ||
english: The nine holes pour out filth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bol har naam pavitr sabh kitaa ||
english: Chanting the Lord's Name, they are all purified and sanctified.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je har suprasa(n)n hovai meraa suaamee har simarat mal lahi jaavai jeeu ||3||
english: When my Lord and Master is totally pleased, He leads the mortal to meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and then his filth is taken away. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu bikham hai bhaaree ||
english: Attachment to Maya is terribly treacherous.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kiu tareeai dutar sa(n)saaree ||
english: How can one cross over the difficult world-ocean?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: satigur bohith dei prabh saachaa jap har har paar la(n)ghaavai jeeu ||4||
english: The True Lord bestows the boat of the True Guru; meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, one is carried across. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: too sarabatr teraa sabh koee ||
english: You are everywhere; all are Yours.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jo too karahi soee prabh hoee ||
english: Whatever You do, God, that alone comes to pass.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧॥੭॥
transliteration: jan naanak gun gaavai bechaaraa har bhaavai har thaai paavai jeeu ||5||1||7||
english: Poor servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; as it pleases the Lord, He bestows His approval. ||5||1||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabh kilavikh kaatai har tere ||
english: The Lord shall eradicate all your sins.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har dhan raakhahu har dhan sa(n)chahu har chaladiaa naal sakhaaee jeeu ||1||
english: Treasure the Lord's wealth, and gather in the Lord's wealth; when you depart in the end, the Lord shall go along with you as your only friend and companion. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jis no kripaa kare so dhiaavai ||
english: He alone meditates on the Lord, unto whom He grants His Grace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nit har jap jaapai jap har sukh paavai ||
english: He continually chants the Lord's Chant; meditating on the Lord, one finds peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har ras aavai jap har har paar la(n)ghaaee jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the sublime essence of the Lord is obtained. Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, one is carried across. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau nira(n)kaar sat naam ||
english: The fearless, formless Lord - the Name is Truth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟੁ ਊਤਮ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: jag mahi sresat ootam kaam ||
english: To chant it is the most sublime and exalted activity in this world.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਤ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਠੇਹ ਮਾਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dusaman doot jamakaal theh maarau har sevak neR na jaaee jeeu ||2||
english: Doing so, the Messenger of Death, the evil enemy, is killed. Death does not even approach the Lord's servant. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jis upar har kaa man maaniaa ||
english: One whose mind is satisfied with the Lord

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: so sevak chahu jug chahu ku(n)t jaaniaa ||
english: that servant is known throughout the four ages, in all four directions.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਪੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਖਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je us kaa buraa kahai koee paapee tis jamaka(n)kar khaaee jeeu ||3||
english: If some sinner speaks evil of him, the Messenger of Death chews him up. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi ek nira(n)jan karataa ||
english: The One Pure Creator Lord is in all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਚਲਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh kar kar vekhai apane chalataa ||
english: He stages all His wondrous plays, and watches them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jis har raakhai tis kaun maarai jis karataa aap chhadaaee jeeu ||4||
english: Who can kill that person, whom the Lord has saved? The Creator Lord Himself delivers him. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਈ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hau anadin naam laee karataare ||
english: I chant the Name of the Creator Lord, night and day.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਗਤ ਸਭੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jin sevak bhagat sabhe nisataare ||
english: He saves all His servants and devotees.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਠ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਸਭਿ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੨॥੮॥
transliteration: das ath chaar ved sabh poochhahu jan naanak naam chhadaaee jeeu ||5||2||8||
english: Consult the eighteen Puraanas and the four Vedas; O servant Nanak, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, will deliver you. ||5||2||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਡਰਪੈ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: darapai dharat akaas nakhytraa sir oopar amar karaaraa ||
english: The earth, the Akaashic ethers and the stars abide in the Fear of God. The almighty Order of the Lord is over the heads of all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਡਰਪੈ ਡਰਪੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paun paanee baisa(n)tar darapai darapai i(n)dr bichaaraa ||1||
english: Wind, water and fire abide in the Fear of God; poor Indra abides in the Fear of God as well. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ekaa nirabhau baat sunee ||
english: I have heard one thing, that the One Lord alone is fearless.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: so sukheeaa so sadaa suhelaa jo gur mil gaai gunee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He alone is at peace, and he alone is embellished forever, who meets with the Guru, and sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਧਾਰ ਅਰੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਡਰਪਹਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਡਰਿ ਮੁਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dehadhaar ar devaa darapahi sidh saadhik dar muiaa ||
english: The embodied and the divine beings abide in the Fear of God. The Siddhas and seekers die in the Fear of God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਜੋਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh mar mar janame phir phir jonee joiaa ||2||
english: The 8.4 millions species of beings die, and die again, and are born over and over again. They are consigned to reincarnation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਸੁ ਸਾਤਕੁ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਡਰਪਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਰੂਪ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: raajas saatak taamas darapahi kete roop upaaiaa ||
english: Those who embody the energies of sattva-white light, raajas-red passion, and taamas-black darkness, abide in the Fear of God, along with the many created forms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਲ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਇਹ ਕਉਲਾ ਡਰਪੈ ਅਤਿ ਡਰਪੈ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: chhal bapuree ih kaulaa darapai at darapai dharam raaiaa ||3||
english: This miserable deceiver Maya abides in the Fear of God; the Righteous Judge of Dharma is utterly afraid of Him as well. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਡਰਹਿ ਬਿਆਪੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਡਰ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal samagree darahi biaapee bin dar karanaihaaraa ||
english: The entire expanse of the Universe is in the Fear of God; only the Creator Lord is without this Fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bhagatan kaa sa(n)gee bhagat sohahi darabaaraa ||4||1||
english: Says Nanak, God is the companion of His devotees; His devotees look beautiful in the Court of the Lord. ||4||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚ ਬਰਖ ਕੋ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਮਰ ਅਟਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: paa(n)ch barakh ko anaath dhroo baarik har simarat amar ataare ||
english: The five year old orphan boy Dhroo, by meditating in remembrance on the Lord, became stationary and permanent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਹੇਤਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਕਹਿਓ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: putr het naaraain kahio jamaka(n)kar maar bidaare ||1||
english: For the sake of his son, Ajaamal called out, "O Lord, Naaraayan", who struck down and killed the Messenger of Death. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਅਗਨਤ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mere thaakur kete aganat udhaare ||
english: My Lord and Master has saved many, countless beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਅਲਪ ਮਤਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mohi deen alap mat niragun pario saran duaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am meek, with little or no understanding, and unworthy; I seek protection at the Lord's Door. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲਮੀਕੁ ਸੁਪਚਾਰੋ ਤਰਿਓ ਬਧਿਕ ਤਰੇ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: baalameek supachaaro tario badhik tare bichaare ||
english: Baalmeek the outcaste was saved, and the poor hunter was saved as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿਓ ਗਜਪਤਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ek nimakh man maahi araadhio gajapat paar utaare ||2||
english: The elephant remembered the Lord in his mind for an instant, and so was carried across. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਨੀ ਰਖਿਆ ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੈ ਹਰਨਾਖਸ ਨਖਹਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: keenee rakhiaa bhagat prahilaadai haranaakhas nakhahi bidaare ||
english: He saved His devotee Prahlaad, and tore Harnaakhash with his nails.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਦਰੁ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਜਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bidar daasee sut bhaio puneetaa sagale kul ujaare ||3||
english: Bidar, the son of a slave-girl, was purified, and all his generations were redeemed. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਪਰਾਧ ਬਤਾਵਉ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kavan paraadh bataavau apune mithiaa moh maganaare ||
english: What sins of mine should I speak of? I am intoxicated with false emotional attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇਓ ਸਾਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਭੁਜਾ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: aaio saam naanak ot har kee leejai bhujaa pasaare ||4||2||
english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord; please, reach out and take me into Your embrace. ||4||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਤ ਨਵਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਏ ॥
transliteration: vit navit bhramio bahu bhaatee anik jatan kar dhaae ||
english: For the sake of riches, I wandered around in so many ways; I rushed around, making all sorts of efforts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਹਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਅਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jo jo karam keee hau haumai te te bhae ajaae ||1||
english: The deeds I did in egotism and pride, have all been done in vain. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਦਿਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: avar din kaahoo kaaj na laae ||
