english: Other days are of no use to me;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: so din mo kau deejai prabh jeeu jaa din har jas gaae ||1|| rahaau ||
english: please bless me with those days, O Dear God, on which I may sing the Lord's Praises. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr grih dekh pasaaraa is hee mahi urajhaae ||
english: Gazing upon children, spouse, household and possessions, one is entangled in these.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਚਾਖਿ ਭਏ ਉਦਮਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maaiaa mad chaakh bhae udamaate har har kabahu na gaae ||2||
english: Tasting the wine of Maya, one is intoxicated, and never sings of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਖੋਜੀ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ih bidh khojee bahu parakaaraa bin sa(n)tan nahee paae ||
english: In this way, I have examined lots of methods, but without the Saints, it is not found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਵਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਮਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਆਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tum daataar vade prabh sa(n)mrath maagan kau daan aae ||3||
english: You are the Great Giver, the great and almighty God; I have come to beg a gift from You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ਸਗਲਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤਾ ਦਾਸ ਰੇਣ ਸਰਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tiaagio sagalaa maan mahataa daas ren saranaae ||
english: Abandoning all pride and self-importance, I have sought the Sanctuary of the dust of the feet of the Lord's slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਏ ਏਕੈ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak har mil bhae ekai mahaa ana(n)d sukh paae ||4||3||
english: Says Nanak, meeting with the Lord, I have become one with Him; I have found supreme bliss and peace. ||4||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਥਾਨ ਧੀਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਕਵਨ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kavan thaan dheerio hai naamaa kavan basat aha(n)kaaraa ||
english: In what place is the Name established? Where does egotism dwell?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਚਿਹਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਛੋਹਿਓ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਗਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kavan chihan sun oopar chhohio mukh te sun kar gaaraa ||1||
english: What injury have you suffered, listening to abuse from someone else's mouth? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਇਓ ॥
transliteration: sunahu re too kaun kahaa te aaio ||
english: Listen: who are you, and where did you come from?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਤੀ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ਕੇਤੀਕ ਮੁਦਤਿ ਚਲਤੇ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: etee na jaanau keteek mudat chalate khabar na paaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You don't even know how long you will stay here; you have no hint of when you shall leave. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਨ ਸੀਲ ਪਵਨ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਖਿਮਾ ਨਿਭਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: sahan seel pavan ar paanee basudhaa khimaa nibharaate ||
english: Wind and water have patience and tolerance; the earth has compassion and forgiveness, no doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਇਓ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਵਨ ਦੁਰਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch tat mil bhaio sa(n)jogaa in mahi kavan duraate ||2||
english: The union of the five tattvas - the five elements - has brought you into being. Which of these is evil? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਨਾਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin rach rachiaa purakh bidhaatai naale haumai paaee ||
english: The Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, formed your form; He also burdened you with egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਉਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਓਹਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam maran us hee kau hai re ohaa aavai jaaee ||3||
english: He alone is born and dies; He alone comes and goes. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਰਚਨਾ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: baran chihan naahee kichh rachanaa mithiaa sagal pasaaraa ||
english: Nothing of the color and the form of the creation shall remain; the entire expanse is transitory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਬ ਖੇਲੁ ਉਝਾਰੈ ਤਬ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak jab khel ujhaarai tab ekai eka(n)kaaraa ||4||4||
english: Prays Nanak, when He brings His play to its close, then only the One, the One Lord remains. ||4||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ਬੀਓ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਘਾਲਿਓ ॥
transliteration: maan moh ar lobh vikaaraa beeo cheet na ghaalio ||
english: Pride, emotional attachment, greed and corruption are gone; I have not placed anything else, other than the Lord, within my consciousness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਣਜੇ ਲਾਦਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਾਲਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam ratan gunaa har banaje laad vakhar lai chaalio ||1||
english: I have purchased the jewel of the Naam and the Glorious Praises of the Lord; loading this merchandise, I have set out on my journey. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਓੜਕਿ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: sevak kee oRak nibahee preet ||
english: The love which the Lord's servant feels for the Lord lasts forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਅਪਨਾ ਚਲਤੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jeevat saahib sevio apanaa chalate raakhio cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: In my life, I served my Lord and Master, and as I depart, I keep Him enshrined in my consciousness. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਕੀਨੀ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੋਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: jaisee aagiaa keenee thaakur tis te mukh nahee morio ||
english: I have not turned my face away from my Lord and Master's Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਰਖਿਓ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਉਆਹੂ ਕਉ ਦਉਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sahaj ana(n)d rakhio grih bheetar uth uaahoo kau daurio ||2||
english: He fills my household with celestial peace and bliss; if He asks me to leave, I leave at once. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਭੂਖ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਓ ॥
transliteration: aagiaa mahi bhookh soee kar sookhaa sog harakh nahee jaanio ||
english: When I am under the Lord's Command, I find even hunger pleasurable; I know no difference between sorrow and joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਮਾਥੈ ਲੇ ਮਾਨਿਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jo jo hukam bhaio saahib kaa so maathai le maanio ||3||
english: Whatever the Command of my Lord and Master is, I bow my forehead and accept it. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਸਵਰੇ ਹਲਤ ਪਲਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaio kripaal thaakur sevak kau savare halat palaataa ||
english: The Lord and Master has become merciful to His servant; He has embellished both this world and the next.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਓਹੁ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: dha(n)n sevak saphal ohu aaiaa jin naanak khasam pachhaataa ||4||5||
english: Blessed is that servant, and fruitful is his birth; O Nanak, he realizes his Lord and Master. ||4||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੁਲਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭਈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈ ॥
transliteration: khuliaa karam kripaa bhaee thaakur keeratan har har gaaee ||
english: Good karma has dawned for me - my Lord and Master has become merciful. I sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਸਗਲੀ ਧਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sram thaakaa paae bisraamaa mit gaee sagalee dhaaee ||1||
english: My struggle is ended; I have found peace and tranquility. All my wanderings have ceased. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ab mohi jeevan padavee paaee ||
english: Now, I have obtained the state of eternal life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: cheet aaio man purakh bidhaataa sa(n)tan kee saranaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, has come into my conscious mind; I seek the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਨਿਵਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu nivaare nivare sagal bairaaee ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment are eradicated; all my enemies are eliminated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਜਰੁ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਭਇਓ ਦੂਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sad hajoor haajar hai naajar katahi na bhaio dooraaee ||2||
english: He is always ever-present, here and now, watching over me; He is never far away. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸੀਤਲ ਸਰਧਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਏ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sukh seetal saradhaa sabh pooree hoe sa(n)t sahaaee ||
english: In peace and cool tranquility, my faith has been totally fulfilled; the Saints are my Helpers and Support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paavan patit keee khin bheetar mahimaa kathan na jaaee ||3||
english: He has purified the sinners in an instant; I cannot express His Glorious Praises. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਖੋਏ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਚਰਣ ਓਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau bhae sagal bhai khoe gobid charan otaaee ||
english: I have become fearless; all fear has departed. The feet of the Lord of the Universe are my only Shelter.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak jas gaavai thaakur kaa rain dinas liv laaee ||4||6||
english: Nanak sings the Praises of his Lord and Master; night and day, he is lovingly focused on Him. ||4||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਗਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jo samarath sarab gun naaik tis kau kabahu na gaavas re ||
english: He is all-powerful, the Master of all virtues, but you never sing of Him!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਉਆ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਧਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chhod jaai khin bheetar taa kau uaa kau phir phir dhaavas re ||1||
english: You shall have to leave all this in an instant, but again and again, you chase after it. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਸਮਾਰਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: apune prabh kau kiu na samaaras re ||
english: Why do you not contemplate your God?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੈਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਸਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਜਾਰਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bairee sa(n)g ra(n)g ras rachiaa tis siu jeearaa jaaras re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are entangled in association with your enemies, and the enjoyment of pleasures; your soul is burning up with them! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਨਿਐ ਜਮੁ ਛੋਡੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai naam suniai jam chhodai taa kee saran na paavas re ||
english: Hearing His Name, the Messenger of Death will release you, and yet, you do not enter His Sanctuary!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਦੇਇ ਸਿਆਲ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਉ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਟਿਕਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaadh dei siaal bapure kau taa kee ot tikaavas re ||2||
english: Turn out this wretched jackal, and seek the Shelter of that God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਜਾਸੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਭਵ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jis kaa jaas sunat bhav tareeai taa siu ra(n)g na laavas re ||
english: Praising Him, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and yet, you have not fallen in love with Him!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥੋਰੀ ਬਾਤ ਅਲਪ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਕੀ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਟਕਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: thoree baat alap supane kee bahur bahur atakaavas re ||3||
english: This meager, short-lived dream, this thing - you are engrossed in it, over and over again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhaio prasaad kripaa nidh thaakur sa(n)tasa(n)g pat paaee ||
english: When our Lord and Master, the ocean of mercy, grants His Grace, one finds honor in the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਛੂਟਾ ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: kahu naanak trai gun bhram chhootaa jau prabh bhae sahaaee ||4||7||
english: Says Nanak, I am rid of the illusion of the three-phased Maya, when God becomes my help and support. ||4||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਦੁਲਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee sabh bidh jaanai tis te kahaa dulaario ||
english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything; what can anyone hide from Him?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਪਾਵ ਝਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hasat paav jhare khin bheetar agan sa(n)g lai jaario ||1||
english: Your hands and feet will fall off in an instant, when you are burnt in the fire. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂੜੇ ਤੈ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: mooRe tai man te raam bisaario ||
english: You fool, you have forgotten the Lord from your mind!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੂਣੁ ਖਾਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰੀ ਪੇਖਤ ਨੈਨ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: loon khaai karahi haraamakhoree pekhat nain bidaario ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You eat His salt, and then you are untrue to Him; before your very eyes, you shall be torn apart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਾਧ ਰੋਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਟਰਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਟਾਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: asaadh rog upajio tan bheetar tarat na kaahoo taario ||
english: The incurable disease has arisen in your body; it cannot be removed or overcome.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੮॥
transliteration: prabh bisarat mahaa dukh paaio ihu naanak tat beechaario ||2||8||
english: Forgetting God, one endures utter agony; this is the essence of reality which Nanak has realized. ||2||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੇ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal prabh raakhe cheet ||
english: I have enshrined the lotus feet of God within my consciousness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavah neetaa neet ||
english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, continually, continuously.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na kooo ||
english: There is none other than Him at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਊ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aad madh a(n)t hai sooo ||1||
english: He alone exists, in the beginning, in the middle, and in the end. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kee ot aape aap ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He Himself is the Shelter of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai vas hai sagal sa(n)saar ||
english: The entire universe is under His control.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape aap aap nira(n)kaar ||
english: He Himself, the Formless Lord, is Himself by Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਹਿਓ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak gahio saachaa soi ||
english: Nanak holds tight to that True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੯॥
transliteration: sukh paaiaa phir dookh na hoi ||2||9||
english: He has found peace, and shall never suffer pain again. ||2||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਤੁਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਅਗਿਆਨਥ ॥
transliteration: praan sukhadaataa jee sukhadaataa tum kaahe bisaario agiaanath ||
english: He is the Giver of peace to the breath of life, the Giver of life to the soul; how can you forget Him, you ignorant person?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਛਾ ਮਦੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਹੋਏ ਤੁਮ ਬਾਵਰ ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hochhaa mad chaakh hoe tum baavar dulabh janam akaarath ||1||
english: You taste the weak, insipid wine, and you have gone insane. You have uselessly wasted this precious human life. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਐਸੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਆਨਥ ॥
transliteration: re nar aisee karahi iaanath ||
english: O man, such is the foolishness you practice.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਸਾਰੰਗਧਰ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਤੂ ਭੂਲਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਨਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taj saara(n)gadhar bhram too bhoolaa mohi lapatio daasee sa(n)g saanath ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Renouncing the Lord, the Support of the earth, you wander, deluded by doubt; you are engrossed in emotional attachment, associating with Maya, the slave-girl. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵਥ ॥
transliteration: dharaneedhar tiaag neech kul sevahi hau hau karat bihaavath ||
english: Abandoning the Lord, the Support of the earth, you serve her of lowly ancestry, and you pass you life acting egotistically.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫੋਕਟ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਕਹਾਵਥ ॥੨॥
transliteration: phokat karam karahi agiaanee manamukh a(n)dh kahaavath ||2||
english: You do useless deeds, you ignorant person; this is why you are called a blind, self-willed manmukh. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਹੋਤਾ ਅਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਜੋ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਸੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਜਾਨਥ ॥
transliteration: sat hotaa asat kar maaniaa jo binasat so nihachal jaanath ||
english: That which is true, you believe to be untrue; what is transitory, you believe to be permanent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਕੀ ਕਉ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਪਕਰੀ ਐਸੇ ਭੂਲ ਭੁਲਾਨਥ ॥੩॥
transliteration: par kee kau apanee kar pakaree aise bhool bhulaanath ||3||
english: You grasp as your own, what belongs to others; in such delusions you are deluded. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ ਸਭ ਏਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਨਥ ॥
transliteration: khatree braahaman sood vais sabh ekai naam taraanath ||
english: The Kh'shaatriyas, Brahmins, Soodras and Vaishyas all cross over, through the Name of the One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਥ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
transliteration: gur naanak upades kahat hai jo sunai so paar paraanath ||4||1||10||
english: Guru Nanak speaks the Teachings; whoever listens to them is carried across. ||4||1||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਹਕਾਵਏ ਮਨੁਖਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gupat karataa sa(n)g so prabh dahakaavae manukhaai ||
english: You may act in secrecy, but God is still with you; you can only deceive other people.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਖੈ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਤਪਤ ਥੰਮ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bisaar har jeeu bikhai bhogahi tapat tha(n)m gal laai ||1||
english: Forgetting your Dear Lord, you enjoy corrupt pleasures, and so you shall have to embrace red-hot pillars. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਕਾਇ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: re nar kaai par grihi jaai ||
english: O man, why do you go out to the households of others?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਚਲ ਕਠੋਰ ਕਾਮਿ ਗਰਧਭ ਤੁਮ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kuchal kathor kaam garadhabh tum nahee sunio dharam raai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You filthy, heartless, lustful donkey! Haven't you heard of the Righteous Judge of Dharma? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਕਾਰ ਪਾਥਰ ਗਲਹਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਨਿੰਦ ਪੋਟ ਸਿਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bikaar paathar galahi baadhe ni(n)d pot siraai ||
english: The stone of corruption is tied around your neck, and the load of slander is on your head.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਮੁਦੁ ਲੰਘਨਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਰਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mahaa saagar samud la(n)ghanaa paar na paranaa jaai ||2||
english: You must cross over the vast open ocean, but you cannot cross over to the other side. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਰਖੇ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohi biaapio netr rakhe phiraai ||
english: You are engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment; you have turned your eyes away from the Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਸੁ ਉਠਾਵਨ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਮਿਲਈ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਤਰ ਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sees uthaavan na kabahoo milaee mahaa dutar maai ||3||
english: You cannot even raise your head above the water of the vast, impassable sea of Maya. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸਸੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅਲਿਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: soor mukataa sasee mukataa braham giaanee alipaai ||
english: The sun is liberated, and the moon is liberated; the God-realized being is pure and untouched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭਾਵਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: subhaavat jaise baisa(n)tar alipat sadaa niramalaai ||4||
english: His inner nature is like that of fire, untouched and forever immaculate. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਖੁਲਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਹਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jis karam khuliaa tis lahiaa paRadaa jin gur pahi ma(n)niaa subhaai ||
english: When good karma dawns, the wall of doubt is torn down. He lovingly accepts the Guru's Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਕਟ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥
transliteration: gur ma(n)tr avakhadh naam deenaa jan naanak sa(n)kat jon na paai ||5||2||
english: One who is blessed with the medicine of the GurMantra, the Name of the Lord, O servant Nanak, does not suffer the agonies of reincarnation. ||5||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇ ॥
transliteration: re nar in bidh paar paraai ||
english: O man, in this way, you shall cross over to the other side.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: dhiaai har jeeu hoi miratak tiaag doojaa bhaau || rahaau doojaa ||2||11||
english: Meditate on your Dear Lord, and be dead to the world; renounce your love of duality. ||Second Pause||2||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਢੂਢਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿ ਪਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
transliteration: baahar dhoodhan te chhoot pare gur ghar hee maahi dikhaaiaa thaa ||
english: I have quit searching outside; the Guru has shown me that God is within the home of my own heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਭਉ ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anabhau acharaj roop prabh pekhiaa meraa man chhod na katahoo jaaiaa thaa ||1||
english: I have seen God, fearless, of wondrous beauty; my mind shall never leave Him to go anywhere else. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਕੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
transliteration: maanak paaio re paaio har pooraa paaiaa thaa ||
english: I have found the jewel; I have found the Perfect Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mol amol na paaiaa jaaee kar kirapaa guroo divaaiaa thaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The invaluable value cannot be obtained; in His Mercy, the Guru bestows it. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
transliteration: adisat agochar paarabraham mil saadhoo akath kathaaiaa thaa ||
english: The Supreme Lord God is imperceptible and unfathomable; meeting the Holy Saint, I speak the Unspoken Speech.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਸਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਵਜਿਓ ਤਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੁਆਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anahad sabad dasam duaar vajio tah a(n)mrit naam chuaaiaa thaa ||2||
english: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds in the Tenth Gate; the Ambrosial Naam trickles down there. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੂਝੀ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
transliteration: tot naahee man trisanaa boojhee akhut bha(n)daar samaaiaa thaa ||
english: I lack nothing; the thirsty desires of my mind are satisfied. The inexhaustible treasure has entered into my being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਚਰਣ ਚਰਣ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਅਘੜੁ ਘੜਿਓ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: charan charan charan gur seve aghaR ghaRio ras paaiaa thaa ||3||
english: I serve the feet, the feet, the feet of the Guru, and manage the unmanageable. I have found the juice, the sublime essence. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਆਵਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਵਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਖੇਲਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
transliteration: sahaje aavaa sahaje jaavaa sahaje man khelaaiaa thaa ||
english: Intuitively I come, and intuively I go; my mind intuitively plays.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਇਆ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bharam gur khoiaa taa har mahalee mahal paaiaa thaa ||4||3||12||
english: Says Nanak, when the Guru drives out doubt, then the soul-bride enters the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||3||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jisahi saaj nivaajiaa tisahi siu ruch naahi ||
english: You feel no love for the One who created and embellished you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਰੂਤੀ ਆਨ ਬੋਈਐ ਫਲੁ ਨ ਫੂਲੈ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aan rootee aan boeeai phal na phoolai taahi ||1||
english: The seed, planted out season, does not germinate; it does not produce flower or fruit. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਬੀਜਣ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: re man vatr beejan naau ||
english: O mind, this is the time to plant the seed of the Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਇ ਖੇਤੀ ਲਾਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਭਲੋ ਸਮਉ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: boi khetee laai manooaa bhalo samau suaau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Focus your mind, and cultivate this crop; at the proper time, make this your purpose. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਇ ਖਹੜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: khoi khahaRaa bharam man kaa satigur saranee jaai ||
english: Eradicate the stubbornness and doubt of your mind, and go to the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: karam jis kau dhurahu likhiaa soee kaar kamaai ||2||
english: He alone does such deeds, who has such pre-ordained karma. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਿਉ ਘਾਲ ਪਾਈ ਥਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhaau laagaa gobid siu ghaal paaee thaai ||
english: He falls in love with the Lord of the Universe, and his efforts are approved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੇਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: khet merai ja(n)miaa nikhut na kabahoo jaai ||3||
english: My crop has germinated, and it shall never be used up. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੋ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: paaiaa amol padaaratho chhod na katahoo jaai ||
english: I have obtained the priceless wealth, which shall never leave me or go anywhere else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak sukh paaiaa tripat rahe aaghaai ||4||4||13||
english: Says Nanak, I have found peace; I am satisfied and fulfilled. ||4||4||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫੂਟੋ ਆਂਡਾ ਭਰਮ ਕਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: phooto aa(n)daa bharam kaa manahi bhaio paragaas ||
english: The egg of doubt has burst; my mind has been enlightened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੀ ਬੇਰੀ ਪਗਹ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਬੰਦਿ ਖਲਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaatee beree pagah te gur keenee ba(n)d khalaas ||1||
english: The Guru has shattered the shackles on my feet, and has set me free. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਿਓ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaan rahio ||
english: My coming and going in reincarnation is ended.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਪਤ ਕੜਾਹਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੀਤਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tapat kaRaahaa bujh gaiaa gur seetal naam deeo ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The boiling cauldron has cooled down; the Guru has blessed me with the cooling, soothing Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਏ ਨਿਗਹਾਰ ॥
transliteration: jab te saadhoo sa(n)g bhaiaa tau chhod gae nigahaar ||
english: Since I joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, those who were eyeing me have left.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਅਟਕ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀ ਤਉ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਕੋਟਵਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis kee atak tis te chhutee tau kahaa karai kotavaar ||2||
english: The one who tied me up, has released me; what can the Watchman of Death do to me now? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੂਕਾ ਭਾਰਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਏ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: chookaa bhaaraa karam kaa hoe nihakaramaa ||
english: The load of my karma has been removed, and I am now free of karma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਕੰਢੈ ਚੜੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saagar te ka(n)dhai chaRe gur keene dharamaa ||3||
english: I have crossed the world-ocean, and reached the other shore; the Guru has blessed me with this Dharma. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਬੈਠਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sach thaan sach baithakaa sach suaau banaaiaa ||
english: True is my place, and True is my seat; I have made Truth my life's purpose.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੪॥
transliteration: sach poo(n)jee sach vakharo naanak ghar paaiaa ||4||5||14||
english: True is my capital, and True is the merchandise, which Nanak has placed into the home of the heart. ||4||5||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਪੰਡਤ ਕਾਮਾਮਨ ਕਾ ਮਾਠਾ ॥
transliteration: bed pukaarai mukh te pa(n)dat kaamaaman kaa maathaa ||
english: The Pandit, the religious scholar, proclaims the Vedas, but he is slow to act on them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਇਕਾਂਤੀ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਲਪਨ ਗਾਠਾ ॥
transliteration: monee hoi baithaa ikaa(n)tee hiradai kalapan gaathaa ||
english: Another person on silence sits alone, but his heart is tied in knots of desire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਠਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hoi udaasee grihu taj chalio chhutakai naahee naathaa ||1||
english: Another becomes an Udaasi, a renunciate; he abandons his home and walks out on his family, but his wandering impulses do not leave him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਬਾਤ ਕਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jee kee kai pahi baat kahaa ||
english: Who can I tell about the state of my soul?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਐਸੋ ਕਹਾ ਲਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aap mukat mo kau prabh mele aiso kahaa lahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Where can I find such a person who is liberated, and who can unite me with my God? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਪਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਾਧੀ ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tapasee kar kai dehee saadhee manooaa dah dis dhaanaa ||
english: Someone may practice intensive meditation, and discipline his body, but his mind still runs around in ten directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਜੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: brahamachaar brahamachaj keenaa hiradai bhaiaa gumaanaa ||
english: The celibate practices celibacy, but his heart is filled with pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਉਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)niaasee hoi kai teerath bhramio us mahi krodh bigaanaa ||2||
english: The Sannyaasi wanders around at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, but his mindless anger is still within him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੂੰਘਰ ਬਾਧਿ ਭਏ ਰਾਮਦਾਸਾ ਰੋਟੀਅਨ ਕੇ ਓਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: ghoo(n)ghar baadh bhae raamadaasaa roteean ke opaavaa ||
english: The temple dancers tie bells around their ankles to earn their living.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਮ ਖਟ ਕੀਨੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: barat nem karam khat keene baahar bhekh dikhaavaa ||
english: Others go on fasts, take vows, perform the six rituals and wear religious robes for show.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਗ ਅਲਾਪੇ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: geet naad mukh raag alaape man nahee har har gaavaa ||3||
english: Some sing songs and melodies and hymns, but their minds do not sing of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਰਹਤ ਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: harakh sog lobh moh rahat hahi niramal har ke sa(n)taa ||
english: The Lord's Saints are immaculately pure; they are beyond pleasure and pain, beyond greed and attachment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਪਾਏ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਾ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tin kee dhooR paae man meraa jaa daiaa kare bhagava(n)taa ||
english: My mind obtains the dust of their feet, when the Lord God shows mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਉਤਰੀ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur pooraa miliaa taa(n) utaree man kee chi(n)taa ||4||
english: Says Nanak, I met the Perfect Guru, and then the anxiety of my mind was removed. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: meraa a(n)tarajaamee har raaiaa ||
english: My Sovereign Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਬਕਬਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੬॥੧੫॥
transliteration: sabh kichh jaanai mere jee kaa preetam bisar gae bakabaaiaa ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||6||15||
english: The Beloved of my soul knows everything; all trivial talk is forgotten. ||1||Second Pause||6||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਲਾਖ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kot laakh sarab ko raajaa jis hiradai naam tumaaraa ||
english: One who has Your Name in his heart is the king of all the hundreds of thousands and millions of beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਦੀਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kau naam na deeaa merai satigur se mar janamahi gaavaaraa ||1||
english: Those, whom my True Guru has not blessed with Your Name, are poor idiots, who die and are reborn. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
transliteration: mere satigur hee pat raakh ||
english: My True Guru protects and preserves my honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਰਲੀਐ ਖਾਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: cheet aavahi tab hee pat pooree bisarat raleeai khaak ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When You come to mind, Lord, then I obtain perfect honor. Forgetting You, I roll in the dust. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਭੋਗਣ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: roop ra(n)g khuseeaa man bhogan te te chhidr vikaaraa ||
english: The mind's pleasures of love and beauty bring just as many blames and sins.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਕਲਿਆਣਾ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har kaa naam nidhaan kaliaanaa sookh sahaj ihu saaraa ||2||
english: The Name of the Lord is the treasure of Emancipation; it is absolute peace and poise. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਦਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa ra(n)g bira(n)g khinai mahi jiu baadar kee chhaaiaa ||
english: The pleasures of Maya fade away in an instant, like the shade of a passing cloud.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਲਾਲ ਭਏ ਗੂੜੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: se laal bhae gooRai ra(n)g raate jin gur mil har har gaaiaa ||3||
english: They alone are dyed in the deep crimson of the Lord's Love, who meet the Guru, and sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ooch mooch apaar suaamee agam darabaaraa ||
english: My Lord and Master is lofty and exalted, grand and infinite. The Darbaar of His Court is inaccessible.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naamo vadiaaee sobhaa naanak khasam piaaraa ||4||7||16||
english: Through the Naam, glorious greatness and respect are obtained; O Nanak, my Lord and Master is my Beloved. ||4||7||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 4 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਉਤਪਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: oa(n)kaar utapaatee ||
english: The One Universal Creator Lord created the creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਆ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਭ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: keeaa dinas sabh raatee ||
english: He made all the days and the nights.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: van trin tribhavan paanee ||
english: The forests, meadows, three worlds, water,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਚਾਰੇ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: chaar bed chaare khaanee ||
english: the four Vedas, the four sources of creation,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਦੀਪ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਆ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)d deep sabh loaa ||
english: the countries, the continents and all the worlds,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਕਵਾਵੈ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek kavaavai te sabh hoaa ||1||
english: have all come from the One Word of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: karanaihaaraa boojhahu re ||
english: Hey - understand the Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸੂਝੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta soojhai re ||1|| rahaau ||
english: If you meet the True Guru, then you'll understand. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਆ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: trai gun keeaa pasaaraa ||
english: He formed the expanse of the entire universe from the three gunas, the three qualities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: narak surag avataaraa ||
english: People are incarnated in heaven and in hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: haumai aavai jaaee ||
english: In egotism, they come and go.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਟਿਕਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man tikan na paavai raaee ||
english: The mind cannot hold still, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: baajh guroo gubaaraa ||
english: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mil satigur nisataaraa ||2||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, one is emancipated. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: hau hau karam kamaane ||
english: All the deeds done in egotism,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਤੇ ਬੰਧ ਗਲਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: te te ba(n)dh galaane ||
english: are just chains around the neck.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: meree meree dhaaree ||
english: Harboring self-conceit and self-interest

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹਾ ਪੈਰਿ ਲੋਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ohaa pair lohaaree ||
english: is just like placing chains around one's ankles.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: so gur mil ek pachhaanai ||
english: He alone meets with the Guru, and realizes the One Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis hovai bhaag mathaanai ||3||
english: who has such destiny written on his forehead. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: so miliaa j har man bhaaiaa ||
english: He alone meets the Lord, who is pleasing to His Mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: so bhoolaa j prabhoo bhulaaiaa ||
english: He alone is deluded, who is deluded by God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਆਪਹੁ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: nah aapahu moorakh giaanee ||
english: No one, by himself, is ignorant or wise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: j karaavai s naam vakhaanee ||
english: He alone chants the Naam, whom the Lord inspires to do so.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: teraa a(n)t na paaraavaaraa ||
english: You have no end or limitation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੭॥
transliteration: jan naanak sad balihaaraa ||4||1||17||
english: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨੀਆ ॥
transliteration: mohanee mohi leee trai guneeaa ||
english: Maya, the enticer, has enticed the world of the three gunas, the three qualities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਭਿ ਵਿਆਪੀ ਝੂਠੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ॥
transliteration: lobh viaapee jhoothee duneeaa ||
english: The false world is engrossed in greed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਸੰਚੀ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਸਗਲ ਲੇ ਛਲੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: meree meree kar kai sa(n)chee a(n)t kee baar sagal le chhaleeaa ||1||
english: Crying out, "Mine, mine!" they collect possessions, but in the end, they are all deceived. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਦਇਅਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau nira(n)kaar daialeeaa ||
english: The Lord is fearless, formless and merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਲੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sagale pratipaleeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He is the Cherisher of all beings and creatures. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਗਡਹੈ ॥
transliteration: ekai sram kar gaadee gadahai ||
english: Some collect wealth, and bury it in the ground.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਦਾਮੁ ਨ ਛਡਹੈ ॥
transliteration: ekahi supanai daam na chhadahai ||
english: Some cannot abandon wealth, even in their dreams.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਕਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਥੈਲੀ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚੰਚਲਿ ਚਲੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raaj kamaai karee jin thailee taa kai sa(n)g na cha(n)chal chaleeaa ||2||
english: The king exercises his power, and fills his money-bags, but this fickle companion will not go along with him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪਿੰਡ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ekahi praan pi(n)d te piaaree ||
english: Some love this wealth even more than their body and breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਸੰਚੀ ਤਜਿ ਬਾਪ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ek sa(n)chee taj baap mahataaree ||
english: Some collect it, forsaking their fathers and mothers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਤੇ ਗੁਹਜੀ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਖਲੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sut meet bhraat te guhajee taa kai nikat na hoee khaleeaa ||3||
english: Some hide it from their children, friends and siblings, but it will not remain with them. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਅਉਧੂਤ ਬੈਠੇ ਲਾਇ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: hoi audhoot baithe laai taaree ||
english: Some become hermits, and sit in meditative trances.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jogee jatee pa(n)dit beechaaree ||
english: Some are Yogis, celibates, religious scholars and thinkers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਤੇ ਊਠਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਲੀਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: grihi maRee masaanee ban mahi basate ooth tinaa kai laagee paleeaa ||4||
english: Some dwell in homes, graveyards, cremation grounds and forests; but Maya still clings to them there. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: kaate ba(n)dhan thaakur jaa ke ||
english: When the Lord and Master releases one from his bonds,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸਿਓ ਜੀਅ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: har har naam basio jee taa kai ||
english: the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell in his soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਏ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਲੀਆ ॥੫॥੨॥੧੮॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g bhae jan mukate gat paaee naanak nadar nihaleeaa ||5||2||18||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, His humble servants are liberated; O Nanak, they are redeemed and enraptured by the Lord's Glance of Grace. ||5||2||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸੋਊ ॥
transliteration: simarahu ek nira(n)jan sooo ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the One Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
transliteration: jaa te birathaa jaat na kooo ||
english: No one is turned away from Him empty-handed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: maat garabh mahi jin pratipaariaa ||
english: He cherished and preserved you in your mother's womb;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d de saaj savaariaa ||
english: He blessed you with body and soul, and embellished you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਪੀਐ ॥
transliteration: soee bidhaataa khin khin japeeai ||
english: Each and every instant, meditate on that Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਢਕੀਐ ॥
transliteration: jis simarat avagun sabh dhakeeai ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, all faults and mistakes are covered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਉਰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal ur a(n)tar dhaarahu ||
english: Enshrine the Lord's lotus feet deep within the nucleus of your self.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਨ ਤੇ ਜੀਉ ਉਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
transliteration: bikhiaa ban te jeeu udhaarahu ||
english: Save your soul from the waters of corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਟਾ ॥
transliteration: karan palaah mitahi bilalaataa ||
english: Your cries and shrieks shall be ended;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਫਾਟਾ ॥
transliteration: jap govid bharam bhau phaataa ||
english: meditating on the Lord of the Universe, your doubts and fears shall be dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g viralaa ko paae ||
english: Rare is that being, who finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak taa kai bal bal jaae ||1||
english: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam man tan aadhaaraa ||
english: The Lord's Name is the support of my mind and body.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo simarai tis kaa nisataaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whoever meditates on Him is emancipated. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: mithiaa vasat sat kar maanee ||
english: He believes that the false thing is true.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਓ ਸਠ ਮੂੜ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: hit laaio sath mooR agiaanee ||
english: The ignorant fool falls in love with it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mad maataa ||
english: He is intoxicated with the wine of sexual desire, anger and greed;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kaudee badalai janam gavaataa ||
english: he loses this human life in exchance for a mere shell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਾਇਐ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: apanaa chhod paraaiai raataa ||
english: He abandons his own, and loves that of others.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mad man tan sa(n)g jaataa ||
english: His mind and body are permeated with the intoxication of Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਰਤ ਕਲੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: trisan na boojhai karat kalolaa ||
english: His thirsty desires are not quenched, although he indulges in pleasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਣੀ ਆਸ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: oonee aas mithiaa sabh bolaa ||
english: His hopes are not fulfilled, and all his words are false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਾਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aavat ikelaa jaat ikelaa ||
english: He comes alone, and he goes alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ham tum sa(n)g jhoothe sabh bolaa ||
english: False is all his talk of me and you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: paai thagauree aap bhulaaio ||
english: The Lord Himself administers the poisonous potion, to mislead and delude.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਟਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak kirat na jaai mitaaio ||2||
english: O Nanak, the the karma of past actions cannot be erased. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਭੂਤ ਅਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਤਾ ॥
transliteration: pas pa(n)khee bhoot ar pretaa ||
english: Beasts, birds, demons and ghosts

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਤ ਅਨੇਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bahu bidh jonee phirat anetaa ||
english: - in these many ways, the false wander in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ ਤਹ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jah jaano tah rahan na paavai ||
english: Wherever they go, they cannot remain there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: thaan bihoon uth uth phir dhaavai ||
english: They have no place of rest; they rise up again and again and run around.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan baasanaa bahut bisathaaraa ||
english: Their minds and bodies are filled with immense, expansive desires.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਮੂਠੋ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)mev mootho bechaaraa ||
english: The poor wretches are cheated by egotism.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਦੋਖ ਅਰੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: anik dokh ar bahut sajaaee ||
english: They are filled with countless sins, and are severely punished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: taa kee keemat kahan na jaaee ||
english: The extent of this cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: prabh bisarat narak mahi paaiaa ||
english: Forgetting God, they fall into hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਮਾਤ ਨ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਮੀਤ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tah maat na ba(n)dh na meet na jaaiaa ||
english: There are no mothers there, no siblings, no friends and no spouses.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: jis kau hot kripaal suaamee ||
english: Those humble beings, unto whom the Lord and Master becomes Merciful,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so jan naanak paaragaraamee ||3||
english: O Nanak, cross over. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhramat bhramat prabh saranee aaiaa ||
english: Rambling and roaming, wandering around, I came to seek the Sanctuary of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: deenaa naath jagat pit maaiaa ||
english: He is the Master of the meek, the father and mother of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਦਰਦ ਬਿਦਾਰਣ ॥
transliteration: prabh daiaal dukh darad bidaaran ||
english: The Merciful Lord God is the Destroyer of sorrow and suffering.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਣ ॥
transliteration: jis bhaavai tis hee nisataaran ||
english: He emancipates whoever He pleases.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop te kaadhanahaaraa ||
english: He lifts them up and pulls him out of the deep dark pit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: prem bhagat hovat nisataaraa ||
english: Emancipation comes through loving devotional worship.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਰੂਪ ਅਪਨਾ ਤਨੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saadh roop apanaa tan dhaariaa ||
english: The Holy Saint is the very embodiment of the Lord's form.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: mahaa agan te aap ubaariaa ||
english: He Himself saves us from the great fire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam is te kichh naahee ||
english: By myself, I cannot practice meditation, austerities, penance and self-discipline.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: aad a(n)t prabh agam agaahee ||
english: In the beginning and in the end, God is inaccessible and unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਮਾਗੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naam dehi maagai daas teraa ||
english: Please bless me with Your Name, Lord; Your slave begs only for this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੯॥
transliteration: har jeevan pad naanak prabh meraa ||4||3||19||
english: O Nanak, my Lord God is the Giver of the true state of life. ||4||3||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਤ ਕਉ ਡਹਕਾਵਹੁ ਲੋਗਾ ਮੋਹਨ ਦੀਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kat kau dahakaavahu logaa mohan deen kirapaaee ||1||
english: Why do you try to deceive others, O people of the world? The Fascinating Lord is Merciful to the meek. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਜਾਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aisee jaan paaee ||
english: This is what I have come to know.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰੋ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saran sooro gur daataa raakhai aap vadaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The brave and heroic Guru, the Generous Giver, gives Sanctuary and preserves our honor. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhagataa kaa aagiaakaaree sadaa sadaa sukhadaaee ||2||
english: He submits to the Will of His devotees; He is forever and ever the Giver of peace. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: apane kau kirapaa kareeahu ik naam dhiaaee ||3||
english: Please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may meditate on Your Name alone. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੀਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak deen naam maagai duteeaa bharam chukaaee ||4||4||20||
english: Nanak, the meek and humble, begs for the Naam, the Name of the Lord; it eradicates duality and doubt. ||4||4||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa thaakur at bhaaraa ||
english: My Lord and Master is utterly powerful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mohi sevak bechaaraa ||1||
english: I am just His poor servant. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: mohan laal meraa preetam man praanaa ||
english: My Enticing Beloved is very dear to my mind and my breath of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mo kau dehu daanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He blesses me with His gift. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਮੈ ਦੇਖੇ ਜੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sagale mai dekhe joee ||
english: I have seen and tested all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੀਜਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: beejau avar na koee ||2||
english: There is none other than Him. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jeean pratipaal samaahai ||
english: He sustains and nurtures all beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਹੋਸੀ ਆਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hai hosee aahe ||3||
english: He was, and shall always be. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: daiaa mohi keejai devaa ||
english: Please bless me with Your Mercy, O Divine Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: naanak laago sevaa ||4||5||21||
english: and link Nanak to Your service. ||4||5||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲੇ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: patit udhaaran taaran bal bal bale bal jaaeeai ||
english: The Redeemer of sinners, who carries us across; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aisaa koee bhetai sa(n)t jit har hare har dhiaaeeai ||1||
english: If only I could meet with such a Saint, who would inspire me to meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mo kau koi na jaanat kaheeat daas tumaaraa ||
english: No one knows me; I am called Your slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਓਟ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ehaa ot aadhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: This is my support and sustenance. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਧਾਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਨ ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab dhaaran pratipaaran ik binau deenaa ||
english: You support and cherish all; I am meek and humble - this is my only prayer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਜਲ ਹਮ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tumaree bidh tum hee jaanahu tum jal ham meenaa ||2||
english: You alone know Your Way; You are the water, and I am the fish. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਹਿ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਛੈ ॥
transliteration: pooran bisatheeran suaamee aahi aaio paachhai ||
english: O Perfect and Expansive Lord and Master, I follow You in love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੋ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਆਛੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sagalo bhoo ma(n)dal kha(n)dal prabh tum hee aachhai ||3||
english: O God, You are pervading all the worlds, solar systems and galaxies. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਟਲ ਅਖਇਓ ਦੇਵਾ ਮੋਹਨ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: atal akhaio devaa mohan alakh apaaraa ||
english: You are eternal and unchanging, imperishable, invisible and infinite, O divine fascinating Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੇਨੁ ਦਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੨॥
transliteration: daan paavau sa(n)taa sa(n)g naanak ren daasaaraa ||4||6||22||
english: Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Society of the Saints, and the dust of the feet of Your slaves. ||4||6||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਆਘਾਏ ਸੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tripat aaghaae sa(n)taa ||
english: The Saints are fulfilled and satisfied;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜਾਨੇ ਜਿਨ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gur jaane jin ma(n)taa ||
english: they know the Guru's Mantra and the Teachings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: taa kee kichh kahan na jaaee ||
english: They cannot even be described;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jaa kau naam badaaee ||1||
english: they are blessed with the glorious greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
transliteration: laal amolaa laalo ||
english: My Beloved is a priceless jewel.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲਾ ਨਾਮੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: agah atolaa naamo ||1|| rahaau ||
english: His Name is unattainable and immeasurable. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: avigat siu maaniaa maano ||
english: One whose mind is satisfied believing in the imperishable Lord God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੋ ॥
transliteration: guramukh tat giaano ||
english: becomes Gurmukh and attains the essence of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਤ ਸਗਲ ਧਿਆਨੋ ॥
transliteration: pekhat sagal dhiaano ||
english: He sees all in his meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿਓ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tajio man te abhimaano ||2||
english: He banishes egotistical pride from his mind. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਠਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: nihachal tin kaa thaanaa ||
english: Permanent is the place of those

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gur te mahal pachhaanaa ||
english: who, through the Guru, realize the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: anadin gur mil jaage ||
english: Meeting the Guru, they remain awake and aware night and day;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har kee sevaa laage ||3||
english: they are committed to the Lord's service. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pooran tripat aghaae ||
english: They are perfectly fulfilled and satisfied,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sahaj samaadh subhaae ||
english: intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har bha(n)daar haath aaiaa ||
english: The Lord's treasure comes into their hands;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੩॥
transliteration: naanak gur te paaiaa ||4||7||23||
english: O Nanak, through the Guru, they attain it. ||4||7||23||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 6 dupade ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House, Dho-Padhay:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: chhod sagal siaanapaa mil saadh tiaag gumaan ||
english: Abandon all your clever tricks; meet with the Holy, and renounce your egotistical pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਵਖਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: avar sabh kichh mithiaa rasanaa raam raam vakhaan ||1||
english: Everything else is false; with your tongue, chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: mere man karan sun har naam ||
english: O my mind, with your ears, listen to the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਅਘ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਵਨੁ ਬਪੁਰੋ ਜਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mitahi agh tere janam janam ke kavan bapuro jaam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The sins of your many past lifetimes shall be washed away; then, what can the wretched Messenger of Death do to you? ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਦੀਨ ਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: dookh deen na bhau biaapai milai sukh bisraam ||
english: Pain, poverty and fear shall not afflict you, and you shall find peace and pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੪॥
transliteration: gur prasaad naanak bakhaanai har bhajan tat giaan ||2||1||24||
english: By Guru's Grace, Nanak speaks; meditation on the Lord is the essence of spiritual wisdom. ||2||1||24||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਹੋਤ ਦੇਖੇ ਖੇਹ ॥
transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa se hot dekhe kheh ||
english: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord - I have seen them reduced to dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਤੂਟਤੇ ਏ ਨੇਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: putr mitr bilaas banitaa tootate e neh ||1||
english: The love of children and friends, and the pleasures of married life are torn apart. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਲੇਹ ॥
transliteration: mere man naam nit nit leh ||
english: O my mind, continually, continuously chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੂਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jalat naahee agan saagar sookh man tan deh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall not burn in the ocean of fire, and your mind and body shall be blessed with peace. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਖ ਛਾਇਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਪਵਨ ਝੂਲਤ ਮੇਹ ॥
transliteration: birakh chhaaiaa jaise binasat pavan jhoolat meh ||
english: Like the shade of a tree, these things shall pass away, like the clouds blown away by the wind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਆਵਤ ਏਹ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੫॥
transliteration: har bhagat driR mil saadh naanak terai kaam aavat eh ||2||2||25||
english: Meeting with the Holy, devotional worship to the Lord is implanted within; O Nanak, only this shall work for you. ||2||2||25||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੋ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: purakh pooran sukhah daataa sa(n)g basato neet ||
english: The perfect, primal Lord is the Giver of peace; He is always with you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਉਸਨ ਨ ਸੀਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: marai na aavai na jaai binasai biaapat usan na seet ||1||
english: He does not die, and he does not come or go in reincarnation. He does not perish, and He is not affected by heat or cold. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: mere man naam siu kar preet ||
english: O my mind, be in love with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਏਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: chet man mahi har har nidhaanaa eh niramal reet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Within the mind, think of the Lord, Har, Har, the treasure. This is the purest way of life. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੀਧਿ ॥
transliteration: kripaal daiaal gopaal gobid jo japai tis seedh ||
english: Whoever meditates on the merciful compassionate Lord, the Lord of the Universe, is successful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਵਲ ਨਵਤਨ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੀਧਿ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੬॥
transliteration: naval navatan chatur su(n)dar man naanak tis sa(n)g beedh ||2||3||26||
english: He is always new, fresh and young, clever and beautiful; Nanak's mind is pierced through with His Love. ||2||3||26||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਲਤ ਬੈਸਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: chalat baisat sovat jaagat gur ma(n)tr ridai chitaar ||
english: While walking and sitting, sleeping and waking, contemplate within your heart the GurMantra.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਭਜੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charan saran bhaj sa(n)g saadhoo bhav saagar utarahi paar ||1||
english: Run to the Lord's lotus feet, and join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and reach the other side. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: mere man naam hiradai dhaar ||
english: O my mind, enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਅਵਰ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar preet man tan laai har siu avar sagal visaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Love the Lord, and commit your mind and body to Him; forget everything else. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਤੂ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jeeu man tan praan prabh ke too aapan aap nivaar ||
english: Soul, mind, body and breath of life belong to God; eliminate your self-conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਜੁ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਆਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੭॥
transliteration: govid bhaj sabh suaarath poore naanak kabahu na haar ||2||4||27||
english: Meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe, and all your desires shall be fulfilled; O Nanak, you shall never be defeated. ||2||4||27||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਤਾਪੁ ਰੇਣ ਸਾਧੂ ਥੀਉ ॥
transliteration: taj aap binasee taap ren saadhoo theeu ||
english: Renounce your self-conceit, and the fever shall depart; become the dust of the feet of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tisahi paraapat naam teraa kar kripaa jis deeu ||1||
english: He alone receives Your Name, Lord, whom You bless with Your Mercy. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
transliteration: mere man naam a(n)mrit peeu ||
english: O my mind, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਸਾਦ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਹੋਛੇ ਅਮਰੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aan saad bisaar hochhe amar jug jug jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Abandon other bland, insipid tastes; become immortal, and live throughout the ages. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਇਕ ਰਸ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਮਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਲੀਉ ॥
transliteration: naam ik ras ra(n)g naamaa naam laagee leeu ||
english: Savor the essence of the One and only Naam; love the Naam, focus and attune yourself to the Naam.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਉ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੮॥
transliteration: meet saajan sakhaa ba(n)dhap har ek naanak keeu ||2||5||28||
english: Nanak has made the One Lord his only friend, companion and relative. ||2||5||28||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਉਦਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਲਗਨਿ ਦੇਤ ਨ ਸੇਕ ॥
transliteration: pratipaal maataa udar raakhai lagan det na sek ||
english: He nourishes and preserves mortals in the womb of the mother, so that the fiery heat does not hurt them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਈਹਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਬੂਝੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੧॥
transliteration: soee suaamee eehaa raakhai boojh budh bibek ||1||
english: That Lord and Master protects us here. Understand this in your mind. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
transliteration: mere man naam kee kar tek ||
english: O my mind, take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੂਝੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tisahi boojh jin too keeaa prabh karan kaaran ek ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Understand the One who created you; the One God is the Cause of causes. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਜਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਭੇਖ ॥
transliteration: chet man mahi taj siaanap chhod sagale bhekh ||
english: Remember the One Lord in your mind, renounce your clever tricks, and give up all your religious robes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੇ ਕਈ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੯॥
transliteration: simar har har sadaa naanak tare kaee anek ||2||6||29||
english: Meditating in remembrance forever on the Lord, Har, Har, O Nanak, countless beings have been saved. ||2||6||29||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan naam jaa ko anaath ko hai naath ||
english: His Name is the Purifier of sinners; He is the Master of the masterless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਤੁਲਹੋ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਮਾਥ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mahaa bhaujal maahi tulaho jaa ko likhio maath ||1||
english: In the vast and terrifying world-ocean, he is the raft for those who have such destiny inscribed on their foreheads. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡੂਬੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
transliteration: doobe naam bin ghan saath ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, huge numbers of companions have drowned.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran chit na aavai de kar raakhai haath ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Even if someone does not remember the Lord, the Cause of causes, still, the Lord reaches out with His hand, and saves him. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਾਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਾਥ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat gun uchaaran har naam a(n)mrit paath ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and take the Path of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮਾਧਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਗਾਥ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੦॥
transliteration: karahu kripaa muraar maadhau sun naanak jeevai gaath ||2||7||30||
english: Shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord; listening to Your sermon, Nanak lives. ||2||7||30||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
transliteration: maaroo a(n)julee mahalaa 5 ghar 7 ||
english: Maaroo, Anjulee ~ With Hands Cupped In Prayer, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਹੂਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)jog vijog dhurahu hee hooaa ||
english: Union and separation are ordained by the Primal Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch dhaat kar putalaa keeaa ||
english: The puppet is made from the five elements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੈ ਕੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਅੜੈ ਜੀ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saahai kai phuramaaiaRai jee dehee vich jeeu aai paiaa ||1||
english: By the Command of the Dear Lord King, the soul came and entered into the body. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ਭੜਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jithai agan bhakhai bhaRahaare ||
english: In that place, where the fire rages like an oven,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ooradh mukh mahaa gubaare ||
english: in that darkness where the body lies face down

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਓਥੈ ਖਸਮਿ ਛਡਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saas saas samaale soee othai khasam chhadaai laiaa ||2||
english: - there, one remembers his Lord and Master with each and every breath, and then he is rescued. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਰਭੈ ਨਿਕਲਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vichahu garabhai nikal aaiaa ||
english: Then, one comes out from within the womb,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਦੁਨੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: khasam visaar dunee chit laaiaa ||
english: and forgetting his Lord and Master, he attaches his consciousness to the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਜੋਨੀ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਕਿਤਹੀ ਥਾਇ ਭਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aavai jaai bhavaaeeai jonee rahan na kitahee thaai bhaiaa ||3||
english: He comes and goes, and wanders in reincarnation; he cannot remain anywhere. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਿ ਰਖਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: miharavaan rakh laian aape ||
english: The Merciful Lord Himself emancipates.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh tis ke thaape ||
english: He created and established all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਥਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
transliteration: janam padaarath jin chaliaa naanak aaiaa so paravaan thiaa ||4||1||31||
english: Those who depart after having been victorious in this priceless human life - O Nanak, their coming into the world is approved. ||4||1||31||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਵੈਦੋ ਨ ਵਾਈ ਭੈਣੋ ਨ ਭਾਈ ਏਕੋ ਸਹਾਈ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vaido na vaaee bhaino na bhaaee eko sahaaee raam he ||1||
english: The One Lord alone is our help and support; neither physician nor friend, nor sister nor brother can be this. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਜਿਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਮਲੋ ਧੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: keetaa jiso hovai paapaa(n) malo dhovai so simarahu paradhaan he ||2||
english: His actions alone come to pass; He washes off the filth of sins. Meditate in remembrance on that Supreme Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਵਾਸੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ghat ghate vaasee sarab nivaasee asathir jaa kaa thaan he ||3||
english: He abides in each and every heart, and dwells in all; His seat and place are eternal. ||3||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aavai na jaavai sa(n)ge samaavai pooran jaa kaa kaam he ||4||
english: He does not come or go, and He is always with us. His actions are perfect. ||4||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kaa raakhanahaaraa ||
english: He is the Savior and the Protector of His devotees.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t jeevahi jap praan adhaaraa ||
english: The Saints live by meditating on God, the support of the breath of life.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੫॥੨॥੩੨॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath suaamee naanak tis kurabaan he ||5||2||32||
english: The Almighty Lord and Master is the Cause of causes; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||5||2||32||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 9 ||
english: Maaroo, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har ko naam sadaa sukhadaaee ||
english: The Name of the Lord is forever the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਹੂ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau simar ajaamal udhario ganikaa hoo gat paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on it, Ajaamal was saved, and Ganika the prostitute was emancipated. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚਾਲੀ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਧਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)chaalee kau raaj sabhaa mahi raam naam sudh aaee ||
english: Dropadi the princess of Panchaala remembered the Lord's Name in the royal court.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦੂਖੁ ਹਰਿਓ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਪੈਜ ਬਢਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taa ko dookh hario karunaa mai apanee paij badhaaee ||1||
english: The Lord, the embodiment of mercy, removed her suffering; thus His own glory was increased. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਜਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਇਓ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਓ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jih nar jas kirapaa nidh gaaio taa kau bhaio sahaaee ||
english: That man, who sings the Praise of the Lord, the treasure of mercy, has the help and support of the Lord.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਇਹੀ ਭਰੋਸੈ ਗਹੀ ਆਨਿ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: kahu naanak mai ihee bharosai gahee aan saranaaee ||2||1||
english: Says Nanak, I have come to rely on this. I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 9 ||
english: Maaroo, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ab mai kahaa karau ree maaee ||
english: What should I do now, O mother?

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਖੋਇਆ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਨਾਹਿ ਕਨੑਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sagal janam bikhian siu khoiaa simario naahi kanhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have wasted my whole life in sin and corruption; I never remembered the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਜਬ ਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਿਹ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaal phaas jab gar mahi melee tih sudh sabh bisaraaee ||
