english: When Death places the noose around my neck, then I lose all my senses.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਯਾ ਸੰਕਟ ਮਹਿ ਕੋ ਅਬ ਹੋਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam bin yaa sa(n)kat mahi ko ab hot sahaaee ||1||
english: Now, in this disaster, other than the Name of the Lord, who will be my help and support? ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jo sa(n)pat apanee kar maanee chhin mahi bhaee paraaee ||
english: That wealth, which he believes to be his own, in an instant, belongs to another.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਯਹ ਸੋਚ ਰਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak yah soch rahee man har jas kabahoo na gaaee ||2||2||
english: Says Nanak, this still really bothers my mind - I never sang the Praises of the Lord. ||2||2||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 9 ||
english: Maaroo, Ninth Mehl:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮੈ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ॥
transliteration: maaee mai man ko maan na tiaagio ||
english: O my mother, I have not renounced the pride of my mind.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮਦਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਇਓ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa ke mad janam siraaio raam bhajan nahee laagio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have wasted my life intoxicated with Maya; I have not focused myself in meditation on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਡੰਡੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਤਬ ਸੋਵਤ ਤੈ ਜਾਗਿਓ ॥
transliteration: jam ko da(n)d pario sir oopar tab sovat tai jaagio ||
english: When Death's club falls on my head, then I will be wakened from my sleep.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਹੋਤ ਅਬ ਕੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ ਛੂਟਤ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਭਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kahaa hot ab kai pachhutaae chhootat naahin bhaagio ||1||
english: But what good will it do to repent at that time? I cannot escape by running away. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਜਬ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਨ ਅਨੁਰਾਗਿਓ ॥
transliteration: ih chi(n)taa upajee ghat mahi jab gur charanan anuraagio ||
english: When this anxiety arises in the heart, then, one comes to love the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸੁਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਬ ਹੂਆ ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਸ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਗਿਓ ॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: suphal janam naanak tab hooaa jau prabh jas mahi paagio ||2||3||
english: My life becomes fruitful, O Nanak, only when I am absorbed in the Praises of God. ||2||3||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo asatapadeeaa mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
english: Maaroo, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਥੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਹਾਰੇ ਮੁਨੀ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan kathe sune haare munee anekaa ||
english: Reciting and listening to the Vedas and the Puraanas, countless wise men have grown weary.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਭੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: athasath teerath bahu ghanaa bhram thaake bhekhaa ||
english: So many in their various religious robes have grown weary, wandering to the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਏਕਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saacho saahib niramalo man maanai ekaa ||1||
english: The True Lord and Master is immaculate and pure. The mind is satisfied only by the One Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਜਰਾਵਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: too ajaraavar amar too sabh chaalanahaaree ||
english: You are eternal; You do not grow old. All others pass away.

author: Guru Tegh Bahadur
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਭਾਇ ਲੈ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam rasaain bhaai lai parahar dukh bhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: One who lovingly focuses on the Naam, the source of nectar - his pains are taken away. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har paReeai har bujheeai guramatee naam udhaaraa ||
english: Study the Lord's Name, and understand the Lord's Name; follow the Guru's Teachings, and through the Naam, you shall be saved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai pooree mat hai poorai sabad beechaaraa ||
english: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru; contemplate the Perfect Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: athasath teerath har naam hai kilavikh kaatanahaaraa ||2||
english: The Lord's Name is the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and the Eradicator of sins. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ਜਲੁ ਮਥੈ ਤਤੁ ਲੋੜੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jal bilovai jal mathai tat loRai a(n)dh agiaanaa ||
english: The blind ignorant mortal stirs the water and churns the water, wishing to obtain butter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਦਧਿ ਮਥੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: guramatee dadh matheeai a(n)mrit paaeeai naam nidhaanaa ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, one churns the cream, and the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਪਸੂ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: manamukh tat na jaananee pasoo maahi samaanaa ||3||
english: The self-willed manmukh is a beast; he does not know the essence of reality that is contained within himself. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਰੀ ਮਰੁ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: haumai meraa maree mar mar ja(n)mai vaaro vaar ||
english: Dying in egotism and self-conceit, one dies, and dies again, only to be reincarnated over and over again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabade je marai phir marai na doojee vaar ||
english: But when he dies in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, then he does not die, ever again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramatee jagajeevan man vasai sabh kul udhaaranahaar ||4||
english: When he follows the Guru's Teachings, and enshrines the Lord, the Life of the World, within his mind, he redeems all his generations. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa vakhar naam hai sachaa vaapaaraa ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the true object, the true commodity.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: laahaa naam sa(n)saar hai guramatee veechaaraa ||
english: The Naam is the only true profit in this world. Follow the Guru's Teachings, and contemplate it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਨਿਤ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੈਸਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai kaar kamaavanee nit totaa saisaaraa ||5||
english: To work in the love of duality, brings constant loss in this world. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saachee sa(n)gat thaan sach sache ghar baaraa ||
english: True is one's association, true is one's place,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa bhojan bhaau sach sach naam adhaaraa ||
english: And true is one's hearth and home, when one has the support of the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sachee baanee sa(n)tokhiaa sachaa sabad veechaaraa ||6||
english: Contemplating the True Word of the Guru's Bani, and the True Word of the Shabad, one becomes content. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਘਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ras bhogan paatisaaheeaa dukh sukh sa(n)ghaaraa ||
english: Enjoying princely pleasures, one shall be destroyed in pain and pleasure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਟਾ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਈਐ ਗਲਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: motaa naau dharaaeeai gal augan bhaaraa ||
english: Adopting a name of greatness, one strings heavy sins around his neck.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: maanas daat na hovaee too daataa saaraa ||7||
english: Mankind cannot give gifts; You alone are the Giver of everything. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar too dhanee avigat apaaraa ||
english: You are inaccessible and unfathomable; O Lord, You are imperishable and infinite.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਦਰੁ ਜੋਈਐ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee dar joeeai mukate bha(n)daaraa ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, seeking at the Lord's Door, one finds the treasure of liberation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak mel na chookaee saache vaapaaraa ||8||1||
english: O Nanak, this union is not broken, if one deals in the merchandise of Truth. ||8||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਦੀਆ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਮੰਝਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bikh bohithaa laadiaa deeaa samu(n)d ma(n)jhaar ||
english: The boat is loaded with sin and corruption, and launched into the sea.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੰਧੀ ਦਿਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)dhee dis na aavaee naa uravaar na paar ||
english: The shore cannot be seen on this side, nor on the shore beyond.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੰਝੀ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਖੇਵਟੂ ਜਲੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਸਰਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: va(n)jhee haath na khevatoo jal saagar asaraal ||1||
english: There are no oars, nor any boatmen, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਜਗੁ ਫਾਥਾ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: baabaa jag phaathaa mahaa jaal ||
english: O Baba, the world is caught in the great noose.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ubare sachaa naam samaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, they are saved, contemplating the True Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਲੰਘਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo hai bohithaa sabad la(n)ghaavanahaar ||
english: The True Guru is the boat; the Word of the Shabad will carry them across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਪਵਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਕੋ ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਨਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tithai pavan na paavako naa jal naa aakaar ||
english: There is neither wind nor fire, neither water nor form there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tithai sachaa sach naai bhavajal taaranahaar ||2||
english: The True Name of the True Lord is there; it carries them across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੰਘੇ ਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਏ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh la(n)ghe se paar pae sache siu liv laai ||
english: The Gurmukhs reach the shore beyond, lovingly focusing on the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aavaa gaun nivaariaa jotee jot milaai ||
english: Their comings and goings are ended, and their light merges into the Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramatee sahaj oopajai sache rahai samaai ||3||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, intuitive peace wells up within them, and they remain merged in the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਪੁ ਪਿੜਾਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sap piRaaee paaeeai bikh a(n)tar man ros ||
english: The snake may be locked in a basket, but it is still poisonous, and the anger within its mind remains.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੀਜੈ ਦੋਸੁ ॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa paaeeai kis no deejai dos ||
english: One obtains what is pre-ordained; why does he blame others?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਰੜੁ ਜੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੰਤੋਸੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramukh gaaraR je sune ma(n)ne naau sa(n)tos ||4||
english: If one, as Gurmukh, hears and believes in the Name, the charm against poison, his mind becomes content. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਗਰਮਛੁ ਫਹਾਈਐ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਜਾਲੁ ਵਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: maagaramachh phahaaeeai ku(n)dee jaal vataai ||
english: The crocodile is caught by the hook and line;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਫਾਥਾ ਫਾਹੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਇ ॥
transliteration: duramat phaathaa phaaheeai phir phir pachhotaai ||
english: caught in the trap of evil-mindedness, he regrets and repents, again and again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maran na sujhaee kirat na metiaa jaai ||5||
english: He does not understand birth and death; the inscription of one's past actions cannot be erased. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਪਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: haumai bikh paai jagat upaaiaa sabad vasai bikh jaai ||
english: Injecting the poison of egotism, the world was created; with the Shabad enshrined within, the poison is eliminated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਰਾ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jaraa johi na sakaee sach rahai liv laai ||
english: Old age cannot torment one who remains lovingly absorbed in the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jeevan mukat so aakheeai jis vichahu haumai jaai ||6||
english: He alone is called Jivan-Mikta, liberated while yet alive, from within whom egotism is eradicated. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਤ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਨਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhai dhaavat jag baadhiaa naa boojhai veechaar ||
english: The world is chasing after worldly affairs; caught and bound, it does not understand contemplative meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maran visaariaa manamukh mugadh gavaar ||
english: The foolish, ignorant, self-willed manmukh has forgotten birth and death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare sachaa sabad veechaar ||7||
english: Those whom the Guru has protected are saved, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਟੁ ਪਿੰਜਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਬੋਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: soohat pi(n)jar prem kai bolai bolanahaar ||
english: In the cage of divine love, the parrot, speaks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਚੁਗੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਤ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: sach chugai a(n)mrit peeai udai ta ekaa vaar ||
english: It pecks at the Truth, and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar; it flies away, only once.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: gur miliai khasam pachhaaneeai kahu naanak mokh duaar ||8||2||
english: Meeting with the Guru, one recognizes his Lord and Master; says Nanak, he finds the gate of liberation. ||8||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਰੁ ਭਾਗੋ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sabad marai taa maar mar bhaago kis pahi jaau ||
english: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad conquers death; otherwise, where can you run?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਡਰਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਗੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis kai dar bhai bhaageeai a(n)mrit taa ko naau ||
english: Through the Fear of God, fear runs away; His Name is Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਹਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਬੀਜਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: maarahi raakhahi ek too beejau naahee thaau ||1||
english: You alone kill and protect; except for You, there is no place at all. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮੈ ਕੁਚੀਲੁ ਕਾਚਉ ਮਤਿਹੀਨ ॥
transliteration: baabaa mai kucheel kaachau matiheen ||
english: O Baba, I am filthy, shallow and totally without understanding.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਕੀਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa ko kachh nahee gur poorai pooree mat keen ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Naam, no one is anything; the Perfect Guru has made my intellect perfect. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਸੁਭਰ ਗੁਣ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avagan subhar gun nahee bin gun kiu ghar jaau ||
english: I am full of faults, and I have no virtue at all. Without virtues, how can I go home?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sahaj sabad sukh oopajai bin bhaagaa dhan naahi ||
english: Through the Word of the Shabad, intuitive peace wells up; without good destiny, the wealth is not obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jin kai naam na man vasai se baadhe dookh sahaahi ||2||
english: Those whose minds are not filled with the Naam are bound and gagged, and suffer in pain. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa se kit aae sa(n)saar ||
english: Those who have forgotten the Naam - why have they even come into the world?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਡੇ ਲਾਦੇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aagai paachhai sukh nahee gaade laade chhaar ||
english: Here and hereafter, they do not find any peace; they have loaded their carts with ashes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vichhuRiaa melaa nahee dookh ghano jam duaar ||3||
english: Those who are separated, do not meet with the Lord; they suffer in terrible pain at Death's Door. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਮੈ ਭੂਲੇ ਤੂ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: agai kiaa jaanaa naahi mai bhoole too samajhaai ||
english: I do not know what will happen in the world hereafter; I am so confused - please teach me, Lord!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜੋ ਦਸੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bhoole maarag jo dase tis kai laagau paai ||
english: I am confused; I would fall at the feet of one who shows me the Way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur bin daataa ko nahee keemat kahan na jaai ||4||
english: Without the Guru, there is no giver at all; His value cannot be described. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਾ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਠਾਇਓ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: saajan dekhaa taa gal milaa saach pathaaio lekh ||
english: If I see my friend, then I will embrace Him; I have sent Him the letter of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਮਾਣੈ ਧਨ ਖੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੀ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: mukh dhimaanai dhan khaRee guramukh aakhee dekh ||
english: His soul-bride stands waiting expectantly; as Gurmukh, I see Him with my eyes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੂ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: tudh bhaavai too man vasahi nadaree karam visekh ||5||
english: By the Pleasure of Your Will, You abide in my mind, and bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸੋ ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: bhookh piaaso je bhavai kiaa tis maagau dei ||
english: One who is wandering hungry and thirsty - what can he give, and what can anyone ask from him?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੀਜਉ ਸੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: beejau soojhai ko nahee man tan pooran dei ||
english: I cannot conceive of any other, who can bless my mind and body with perfection.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jin keeaa tin dekhiaa aap vadaaee dei ||6||
english: The One who created me takes care of me; He Himself blesses me with glory. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਗਰੀ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਨਵਤਨੋ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਲੀਲ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: nagaree naaik navatano baalak leel anoop ||
english: In the body-village is my Lord and Master, whose body is ever-new, Innocent and child-like, incomparably playful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਪੰਖਣੂ ਸਾਚਉ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
transliteration: naar na purakh na pa(n)khanoo saachau chatur saroop ||
english: He is neither a woman, nor a man, nor a bird; the True Lord is so wise and beautiful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਤੂ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਤੂ ਧੂਪੁ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai too deepak too dhoop ||7||
english: Whatever pleases Him, happens; You are the lamp, and You are the incense. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੀਤ ਸਾਦ ਚਾਖੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਬਾਦ ਸਾਦ ਤਨਿ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: geet saad chaakhe sune baad saad tan rog ||
english: He hears the songs and tastes the flavors, but these flavors are useless and insipid, and bring only disease to the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚਉ ਚਵੈ ਛੂਟੈ ਸੋਗ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: sach bhaavai saachau chavai chhootai sog vijog ||
english: One who loves the Truth and speaks the Truth, escapes from the sorrow of separation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai jo tis bhaavai s hog ||8||3||
english: Nanak does not forget the Naam; whatever happens is by the Lord's Will. ||8||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਲਾਲਚ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: saachee kaar kamaavanee hor laalach baad ||
english: Practice Truth - other greed and attachments are useless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ihu man saachai mohiaa jihavaa sach saad ||
english: The True Lord has fascinated this mind, and my tongue enjoys the taste of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin naavai ko ras nahee hor chalahi bikh laad ||1||
english: Without the Name, there is no juice; the others depart, loaded with poison. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਲਾਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਕੋ ਸੁਣਿ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa laalaa mere laal ko sun khasam hamaare ||
english: I am such a slave of Yours, O my Beloved Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਫੁਰਮਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਚਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu phuramaavahi tiu chalaa sach laal piaare ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I walk in harmony with Your Command, O my True, Sweet Beloved. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਲੇ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਗੋਲੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: anadin laale chaakaree gole sir meeraa ||
english: Night and day, the slave works for his overlord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur bachanee man vechiaa sabad man dheeraa ||
english: I have sold my mind for the Word of the Guru's Shabad; my mind is comforted and consoled by the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਕਾਟੈ ਮਨ ਪੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur poore saabaas hai kaatai man peeraa ||2||
english: The Perfect Guru is honored and celebrated; He has taken away the pains of my mind. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਧਣੀ ਕੋ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਵਡਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: laalaa golaa dhanee ko kiaa kahau vadiaaeeai ||
english: I am the servant and slave of my Master; what glorious greatness of His can I describe?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਧਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai bakhase pooraa dhanee sach kaar kamaaeeai ||
english: The Perfect Master, by the Pleasure of His Will, forgives, and then one practices Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਕਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: vichhuRiaa kau mel lae gur kau bal jaaeeai ||3||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who re-unites the separated ones. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ ਮਤਿ ਖਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਨੀਕੀ ॥
transliteration: laale gole mat kharee gur kee mat neekee ||
english: The intellect of His servant and slave is noble and true; it is made so by the Guru's intellect.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਤਿ ਫੀਕੀ ॥
transliteration: saachee surat suhaavanee manamukh mat pheekee ||
english: The intuition of those who are true is beautiful; the intellect of the self-willed manmukh is insipid.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਚੁ ਧੀਰਕ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: man tan teraa too prabhoo sach dheerak dhur kee ||4||
english: My mind and body belong to You, God; from the very beginning, Truth has been my only support. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਉਠਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saachai baisan uthanaa sach bhojan bhaakhiaa ||
english: In Truth I sit and stand; I eat and speak the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਸਚੈ ਵਿਤੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: chit sachai vito sachaa saachaa ras chaakhiaa ||
english: With Truth in my consciousness, I gather the wealth of Truth, and drink in the sublime essence of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: saachai ghar saachai rakhe gur bachan subhaakhiaa ||5||
english: In the home of Truth, the True Lord protects me; I speak the Words of the Guru's Teachings with love. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਆਲਸੁ ਘਣੋ ਫਾਥੇ ਓਜਾੜੀ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kau aalas ghano phaathe ojaaRee ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is very lazy; he is trapped in the wilderness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਾਥਾ ਚੁਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਚੋਗੜੀ ਲਗਿ ਬੰਧੁ ਵਿਗਾੜੀ ॥
transliteration: phaathaa chugai nit chogaRee lag ba(n)dh vigaaRee ||
english: He is drawn to the bait, and continually pecking at it, he is trapped; his link to the Lord is ruined.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਿਜ ਤਾੜੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee mukat hoi saache nij taaRee ||6||
english: By Guru's Grace, one is liberated, absorbed in the primal trance of Truth. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਤਿ ਲਾਲਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: anahat laalaa bedhiaa prabh het piaaree ||
english: His slave remains continually pierced through with love and affection for God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਉ ਝੂਠੇ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bin saache jeeu jal balau jhoothe vekaaree ||
english: Without the True Lord, the soul of the false, corrupt person is burnt to ashes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਦਿ ਕਾਰਾ ਸਭਿ ਛੋਡੀਆ ਸਾਚੀ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: baad kaaraa sabh chhodeeaa saachee tar taaree ||7||
english: Abandoning all evil actions, he crosses over in the boat of Truth. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa tinaa thaur na thaau ||
english: Those who have forgotten the Naam have no home, no place of rest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੈ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: laalai laalach tiaagiaa paaiaa har naau ||
english: The Lord's slave renounces greed and attachment, and obtains the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਬਖਸਹਿ ਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੮॥੪॥
transliteration: too bakhasahi taa mel laihi naanak bal jaau ||8||4||
english: If You forgive him, Lord, then He is united with You; Nanak is a sacrifice. ||8||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੈ ਗਾਰਬੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: laalai gaarab chhodiaa gur kai bhai sahaj subhaaee ||
english: The Lord's slave renounces his egotistical pride, through the Guru's Fear, intuitively and easily.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: laalai khasam pachhaaniaa vadee vadiaaee ||
english: The slave realizes his Lord and Master; glorious is his greatness!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਸਮਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khasam miliai sukh paaiaa keemat kahan na jaaee ||1||
english: Meeting with his Lord and Master, he finds peace; His value cannot be desribed. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: laalaa golaa khasam kaa khasamai vadiaaee ||
english: I am the slave and servant of my Lord and Master; all glory is to my Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ubare har kee saranaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I am saved, in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੇ ਨੋ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: laale no sir kaar hai dhur khasam phuramaaee ||
english: The slave has been given the most excellent task, by the Primal Command of the Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: laalai hukam pachhaaniaa sadaa rahai rajaaee ||
english: The slave realizes the Hukam of His Command, and submits to His Will forever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੀਰਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape meeraa bakhas lae vadee vadiaaee ||2||
english: The Lord King Himself grants forgiveness; how glorious is His greatness! ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aap sachaa sabh sach hai gur sabad bujhaaee ||
english: He Himself is True, and everything is True; this is revealed through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲੈਹਿ ਤੂ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: teree sevaa so kare jis no laihi too laaee ||
english: He alone serves You, whom You have enjoined to do so.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin sevaa kinai na paaiaa doojai bharam khuaaee ||3||
english: Without serving Him, no one finds Him; in duality and doubt, they are ruined. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: so kiu manahu visaareeai nit devai chaRai savaaiaa ||
english: How could we forget Him from our minds? The gifts which he bestows increase day by day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis daa saahu tinai vich paaiaa ||
english: Soul and body, all belong to Him; He infused the breath into us.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jaa kripaa kare taa seveeai sev sach samaaiaa ||4||
english: If he shows His Mercy, then we serve Him; serving Him, we merge in Truth. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਾ ਸੋ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: laalaa so jeevat marai mar vichahu aap gavaae ||
english: He alone is the Lord's slave, who remains dead while yet alive, and eradicates egotism from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan tootahi mukat hoi trisanaa agan bujhaae ||
english: His bonds are broken, the fire of his desire is quenched, and he is liberated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sabh mahi naam nidhaan hai guramukh ko paae ||5||
english: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within all, but how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, obtain it. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਲਾ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: laale vich gun kichh nahee laalaa avaganiaar ||
english: Within the Lord's slave, there is no virtue at all; the Lord's slave is totally unworthy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਤੂ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: tudh jevad daataa ko nahee too bakhasanahaar ||
english: There is no Giver as great as You, Lord; You alone are the Forgiver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਾਲਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਏਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: teraa hukam laalaa ma(n)ne eh karanee saar ||6||
english: Your slave obeys the Hukam of Your Command; this is the most excellent action. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur saagar a(n)mrit sar jo ichhe so phal paae ||
english: The Guru is the pool of nectar in the world-ocean; whatever one desires, that fruit is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naam padaarath amar hai hiradai ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: The treasure of the Naam brings immortality; enshrine it in your heart and mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur sevaa sadaa sukh hai jis no hukam manaae ||7||
english: Serving the Guru, eternal peace is obtained, by those whom the Lord inspires to obey the Hukam of His Command. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਸਭ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਟੀ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: suinaa rupaa sabh dhaat hai maatee ral jaaee ||
english: Gold and silver, and all metals, mix with dust in the end

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai naal na chalaee satigur boojh bujhaaee ||
english: Without the Name, nothing goes along with you; the True Guru has imparted this understanding.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੮॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate se niramale saachai rahe samaaee ||8||5||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are immaculate and pure; they remain merged in the Truth. ||8||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਹੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਫਾਟੇ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
transliteration: hukam bhaiaa rahanaa nahee dhur phaate cheerai ||
english: The Order is issued, and he cannot remain; the permit to stay has been torn up.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ehu man avagan baadhiaa sahu deh sareerai ||
english: This mind is tied to its faults; it suffers terrible pain in its body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਾਈਅਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਨਹ ਫਕੀਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: poorai gur bakhasaaeeahi sabh gunah phakeerai ||1||
english: The Perfect Guru forgives all the mistakes of the beggar at His Door. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਬੁਝੁ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kiu raheeai uth chalanaa bujh sabad beechaaraa ||
english: How can he stay here? He must get up and depart. Contemplate the Word of the Shabad, and understand this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jis too melahi so milai dhur hukam apaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He alone is united, whom You, O Lord, unite. Such is the Primal Command of the Infinite Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਜੋ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਖਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu too raakhahi tiu rahaa jo dehi s khaau ||
english: As You keep me, I remain; whatever You give me, I eat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਚਲਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jiu too chalaavahi tiu chalaa mukh a(n)mrit naau ||
english: As You lead me, I follow, with the Ambrosial Name in my mouth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mere thaakur hath vadiaaeeaa melahi man chaau ||2||
english: All glorious greatness rests in the hands of my Lord and Master; my mind yearns to unite with You. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: keetaa kiaa saalaaheeai kar dekhai soee ||
english: Why should anyone praise any other created being? That Lord acts and sees.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jin keeaa so man vasai mai avar na koee ||
english: The One who created me, abides within my mind; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: so saachaa saalaaheeai saachee pat hoee ||3||
english: So praise that True Lord, and you shall be blessed with true honor. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਪੜਿ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਈ ਬਹੁ ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)dit paR na pahuchaee bahu aal ja(n)jaalaa ||
english: The Pandit, the religious scholar, reads, but does not reach the Lord; he is totally entangled in worldly affairs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਦੁਇ ਸੰਗਮੇ ਖੁਧਿਆ ਜਮਕਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: paap pu(n)n dui sa(n)game khudhiaa jamakaalaa ||
english: He keeps the company of both virtue and vice, tormented by hunger and the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਭਉ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: vichhoRaa bhau veesarai pooraa rakhavaalaa ||4||
english: One who is protected by the Perfect Lord, forgets separation and fear. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin kee lekhai pat pavai se poore bhaaee ||
english: They alone are perfect, O Siblings of Destiny, whose honor is certified.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: poore pooree mat hai sachee vadiaaee ||
english: Perfect is the intellect of the Perfect Lord. True is His glorious greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਥਕਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: dede tot na aavaee lai lai thak paaee ||5||
english: His gifts never run short, although those who receive may grow weary of receiving. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਰ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਢੰਢੋਲੀਐ ਇਕੁ ਮਣੀਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: khaar samudr dha(n)dholeeai ik maneeaa paavai ||
english: Searching the salty sea, one finds the pearl.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dui din chaar suhaavanaa maatee tis khaavai ||
english: It looks beautiful for a few days, but in the end, it is eaten away by dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gur saagar sat seveeai de tot na aavai ||6||
english: If one serves the Guru, the ocean of Truth, the gifts one receives never run short. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਊਜਲੇ ਸਭ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: mere prabh bhaavan se oojale sabh mail bhareejai ||
english: They alone are pure, who are pleasing to my God; all others are soiled with filth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾ ਊਜਲੁ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਪਾਰਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: mailaa oojal taa theeai paaras sa(n)g bheejai ||
english: The filthy become pure, when they meet with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੰਨੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਲਾਲ ਕੀ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: va(n)nee saache laal kee kin keemat keejai ||7||
english: Who can estimate the value of the color of the true jewel? ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੇਖੀ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਹੀ ਦਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: bhekhee haath na labhaee teerath nahee daane ||
english: Wearing religious robes, the Lord is not obtained, nor is He obtained by giving donations at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਛਉ ਬੇਦ ਪੜੰਤਿਆ ਮੂਠੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: poochhau bed paRa(n)tiaa moothee vin maane ||
english: Go and ask the readers of the Vedas; without faith, the world is cheated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥੮॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak keemat so kare pooraa gur giaane ||8||6||
english: O Nanak, he alone values the jewel, who is blessed with the spiritual wisdom of the Perfect Guru. ||8||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲਹਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਗੂਚੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਹੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh lahar ghar taj vigoochai avaraa ke ghar herai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh, in a fit of passion, abandons his home, and is ruined; then, he spies on the homes of others.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਧਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਭੇਟੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: grih dharam gavaae satigur na bhetai duramat ghooman gherai ||
english: He neglects his household duties, and does not meet with the True Guru; he is caught in the whirlpool of evil-mindedness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਿਸੰਤਰੁ ਭਵੈ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਵਧੇਰੈ ॥
transliteration: disa(n)tar bhavai paath paR thaakaa trisanaa hoi vadherai ||
english: Wandering in foreign lands and reading scriptures, he grows weary, and his thirsty desires only increase.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੀ ਪਿੰਡੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਢੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaachee pi(n)dee sabad na cheenai udar bharai jaise dhorai ||1||
english: His perishable body does not remember the Word of the Shabad; like a beast, he fills his belly. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਐਸੀ ਰਵਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥
transliteration: baabaa aisee ravat ravai sa(n)niaasee ||
english: O Baba, this is the way of life of the Sannyaasi, the renunciate.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad ek liv laagee terai naam rate tripataasee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is to enshrine love for the One Lord. Imbued with Your Name, Lord, he remains satisfied and fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘੋਲੀ ਗੇਰੂ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ਵਸਤ੍ਰ ਭੇਖ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gholee geroo ra(n)g chaRaaiaa vasatr bhekh bhekhaaree ||
english: He dyes his robes with saffron dye, and wearing these robes, he goes out begging.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਪੜ ਫਾਰਿ ਬਨਾਈ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaapaR phaar banaaee khi(n)thaa jholee maaiaadhaaree ||
english: Tearing his robes, he makes a patched coat, and puts the money in his wallet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਗੈ ਜਗੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਪਤਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ghar ghar maagai jag parabodhai man a(n)dhai pat haaree ||
english: From house to house he goes begging, and tries to teach the world; but his mind is blind, and so he loses his honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bharam bhulaanaa sabad na cheenai jooai baajee haaree ||2||
english: He is deluded by doubt, and does not remember the Word of the Shabad. He loses his life in the gamble. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੂਅਰ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar agan na gur bin boojhai baahar pooar taapai ||
english: Without the Guru, the fire within is not quenched; and outside, the fire still burns.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa bin bhagat na hovee kiu kar cheenas aapai ||
english: Without serving the Guru, there is no devotional worship. How can anyone, by himself, know the Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa kar kar narak nivaasee a(n)tar aatam jaapai ||
english: Slandering others, one lives in hell; within him is hazy darkness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਚਹਿ ਕਿਉ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਪੈ ਪਾਪੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: athasath teerath bharam vigoochahi kiu mal dhopai paapai ||3||
english: Wandering to the eixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, he is ruined. How can the filth of sin be washed away? ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛਾਣੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਚੜਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: chhaanee khaak bibhoot chaRaaee maaiaa kaa mag johai ||
english: He sifts through the dust, and applies ashes to his body, but he is searching for the path of Maya's wealth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੇ ਤੇ ਛੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar ek na jaanai saach kahe te chhohai ||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, he does not know the One Lord; if someone tells him the Truth, he grows angry.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਓਹੈ ॥
transliteration: paath paRai mukh jhootho bolai nigure kee mat ohai ||
english: He reads the scriptures, but tells lies; such is the intellect of one who has no guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਈ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naam na japaee kiu sukh paavai bin naavai kiu sohai ||4||
english: Without chanting the Naam, how can he find peace? Without the Name, how can he look good? ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂੰਡੁ ਮੁਡਾਇ ਜਟਾ ਸਿਖ ਬਾਧੀ ਮੋਨਿ ਰਹੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: moo(n)d mudaai jataa sikh baadhee mon rahai abhimaanaa ||
english: Some shave their heads, some keep their hair in matted tangles; some keep it in braids, while some keep silent, filled with egotistical pride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਤ ਆਤਮ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: manooaa dolai dah dis dhaavai bin rat aatam giaanaa ||
english: Their minds waver and wander in ten directions, without loving devotion and enlightenment of the soul.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit chhod mahaa bikh peevai maaiaa kaa devaanaa ||
english: They abandon the Ambrosial Nectar, and drink the deadly poison, driven mad by Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਸੂਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kirat na mitaee hukam na boojhai pasooaa maahi samaanaa ||5||
english: Past actions cannot be erased; without understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they become beasts. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਕਮੰਡਲੁ ਕਾਪੜੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: haath kama(n)dal kaapaReeaa man trisanaa upajee bhaaree ||
english: With bowl in hand, wearing his patched coat, great desires well up in his mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਤਜਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: isatree taj kar kaam viaapiaa chit laaiaa par naaree ||
english: Abandoning his own wife, he is engrossed in sexual desire; his thoughts are on the wives of others.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਲੰਪਟੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sikh kare kar sabad na cheenai la(n)pat hai baajaaree ||
english: He teaches and preaches, but does not contemplate the Shabad; he is bought and sold on the street.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਭਰਾਤੀ ਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥੬॥
transliteration: a(n)tar bikh baahar nibharaatee taa jam kare khuaaree ||6||
english: With poison within, he pretends to be free of doubt; he is ruined and humiliated by the Messenger of Death. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: so sa(n)niaasee jo satigur sevai vichahu aap gavaae ||
english: He alone is a Sannyaasi, who serves the True Guru, and removes his self-conceit from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਕਰਈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: chhaadan bhojan kee aas na karaee achi(n)t milai so paae ||
english: He does not ask for clothes or food; without asking, he accepts whatever he receives.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਕੈ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਖਿਮਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bakai na bolai khimaa dhan sa(n)grahai taamas naam jalaae ||
english: He does not speak empty words; he gathers in the wealth of tolerance, and burns away his anger with the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
transliteration: dhan girahee sa(n)niaasee jogee j har charanee chit laae ||7||
english: Blessed is such a householder, Sannyaasi and Yogi, who focuses his consciousness on the Lord's feet. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਰਹੈ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aas niraas rahai sa(n)niaasee ekas siu liv laae ||
english: Amidst hope, the Sannyaasi remains unmoved by hope; he remains lovingly focused on the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਾਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har ras peevai taa saat aavai nij ghar taaRee laae ||
english: He drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord, and so finds peace and tranquility; in the home of his own being, he remains absorbed in the deep trance of meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manooaa na dolai guramukh boojhai dhaavat varaj rahaae ||
english: His mind does not waver; as Gurmukh, he understands. He restrains it from wandering out.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਖੋਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥
transliteration: grihu sareer guramatee khoje naam padaarath paae ||8||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, he searches the home of his body, and obtains the wealth of the Naam. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਸਰੇਸਟ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes saresat naam rate veechaaree ||
english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are exalted, imbued with contemplative meditation on the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਗਨ ਪਤਾਲੀ ਜੰਤਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: khaanee baanee gagan pataalee ja(n)taa jot tumaaree ||
english: The sources of creation, speech, the heavens and the underworld, all beings and creatures, are infused with Your Light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh sukh mukat naam dhun baanee sach naam ur dhaaree ||
english: All comforts and liberation are found in the Naam, and the vibrations of the Guru's Bani; I have enshrined the True Name within my heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੀ ਤਰੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੯॥੭॥
transliteration: naam binaa nahee chhootas naanak saachee tar too taaree ||9||7||
english: Without the Naam, no one is saved; O Nanak, with the Truth, cross over to the other side. ||9||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maat pitaa sa(n)jog upaae rakat bi(n)d mil pi(n)d kare ||
english: Through the union of mother and father, the fetus is formed. The egg and sperm join together to make the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਰਭ ਉਰਧਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tar garabh uradh liv laagee so prabh saare daat kare ||1||
english: Upside-down within the womb, it lovingly dwells on the Lord; God provides for it, and gives it nourishment there. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar bhavajal kiu tarai ||
english: How can he cross over the terrifying world-ocean?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਫਰਿਓ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰੁ ਟਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam nira(n)jan paaeeai aphario bhaar aphaar tarai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Gurmukh obtains the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unbearable load of sins is removed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਮੈ ਬਉਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਉ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: te gun visar gae aparaadhee mai bauraa kiaa karau hare ||
english: I have forgotten Your Virtues, Lord; I am insane - what can I do now?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਭੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too daataa daiaal sabhai sir ahinis daat samaar kare ||2||
english: You are the Merciful Giver, above the heads of all. Day and night, You give gifts, and take care of all. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲੈ ਜਗਿ ਜਨਮਿਆ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
transliteration: chaar padaarath lai jag janamiaa siv sakatee ghar vaas dhare ||
english: One is born to achieve the four great objectives of life. The spirit has taken up its home in the material world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਗੀ ਭੂਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਖਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: laagee bhookh maaiaa mag johai mukat padaarath mohi khare ||3||
english: Driven by hunger, it sees the path of Maya's riches; this emotional attachment takes away the treasure of liberation. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਢੂਢਤ ਥਾਕਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
transliteration: karan palaav kare nahee paavai it ut dhoodhat thaak pare ||
english: Weeping and wailing, he does not receive them; he searches here and there, and grows weary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਕੂੜ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar viaape kooR kuta(n)b siu preet kare ||4||
english: Engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism, he falls in love with his false relatives. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਵੈ ਭੋਗੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਕਾਲ ਘਰੇ ॥
transliteration: khaavai bhogai sun sun dekhai pahir dikhaavai kaal ghare ||
english: He eats and enjoys, listens and watches, and dresses up to show off in this house of death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਟਰੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bin gurasabad na aap pachhaanai bin har naam na kaal tare ||5||
english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he does not undersand himself. Without the Lord's Name, death cannot be avoided. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਛੀਨਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jetaa mohu haumai kar bhoole meree meree karate chheen khare ||
english: The more attachment and egotism delude and confuse him, the more he cries out, "Mine, mine!", and the more he loses out.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਹਸੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: tan dhan binasai sahasai sahasaa phir pachhutaavai mukh dhoor pare ||6||
english: His body and wealth pass away, and he is torn by skepticism and cynicism; in the end, he regrets and repents, when the dust falls on his face. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖਿਸਿਆ ਕਫੁ ਕੰਠੁ ਬਿਰੂਧੋ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਢਰੇ ॥
transliteration: biradh bhaiaa joban tan khisiaa kaph ka(n)th biroodho nainahu neer dhare ||
english: He grows old, his body and youth waste away, and his throat is plugged with mucous; water flows from his eyes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਰਹੇ ਕਰ ਕੰਪਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: charan rahe kar ka(n)pan laage saakat raam na ridai hare ||7||
english: He feet fail him, and his hands shake and tremble; the faithless cynic does not enshrine the Lord in his heart. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਈ ਕਾਲੀ ਹੂ ਧਉਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਖਿਓ ਘਰੇ ॥
transliteration: surat gaee kaalee hoo dhaule kisai na bhaavai rakhio ghare ||
english: His intellect fails him, his black hair turns white, and no one wants to keep him in their home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਮ ਐਸੇ ਦੋਖ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਰੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਖਰੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: bisarat naam aise dokh laagahi jam maar samaare narak khare ||8||
english: Forgetting the Naam, these are the stigmas which stick to him; the Messenger of Death beats him, and drags him to hell. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
transliteration: poorab janam ko lekh na mitaee janam marai kaa kau dos dhare ||
english: The record of one's past actions cannot be erased; who else is to blame for one's birth and death?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਦਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: bin gur baad jeevan hor maranaa bin gurasabadai janam jare ||9||
english: Without the Guru, life and death are pointless; without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, life just burns away. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰ ਭਏ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਫੋਕਟ ਕਰਮ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: khusee khuaar bhae ras bhogan phokat karam vikaar kare ||
english: The pleasures enjoyed in happiness bring ruin; acting in corruption is useless indulgence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਖੋਇਓ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਪਰੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naam bisaar lobh mool khoio sir dharam raai kaa da(n)d pare ||10||
english: Forgetting the Naam, and caught by greed, he betrays his own source; the club of the Righteous Judge of Dharma will strike him over the head. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh raam naam gun gaavahi jaa kau har prabh nadar kare ||
english: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name; the Lord God blesses them with His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: te niramal purakh apara(n)par poore te jag mahi gur govi(n)d hare ||11||
english: Those beings are pure, perfect unlimited and infinite; in this world, they are the embodiment of the Guru, the Lord of the Universe. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਾਰਹੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har simarahu gur bachan samaarahu sa(n)gat har jan bhaau kare ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord; meditate and contemplate the Guru's Word, and love to associate with the humble servants of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੨॥੮॥
transliteration: har jan gur paradhaan duaarai naanak tin jan kee ren hare ||12||8||
english: The Lord's humble servants are the embodiment of the Guru; they are supreme and respected in the Court of the Lord. Nanak seeks the dust of the feet of those humble servants of the Lord. ||12||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: maaroo kaaphee mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
english: Maaroo, Kaafee, First Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਉ ਵੰਞਉ ਡੁੰਮਣੀ ਕਿਤੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
transliteration: aavau va(n)njau du(n)manee kitee mitr kareu ||
english: The double-minded person comes and goes, and has numerous friends.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਵਾਢੀ ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰੇਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saa dhan dhoee na lahai vaadhee kiu dheereu ||1||
english: The soul-bride is separated from her Lord, and she has no place of rest; how can she be comforted? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈਡਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਆਪਨੜੇ ਪਿਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: maidaa man rataa aapanaRe pir naal ||
english: My mind is attuned to the Love of my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਕੀਤੀ ਹਿਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hau ghol ghumaaee kha(n)neeai keetee hik bhoree nadar nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to the Lord; if only He would bless me with His Glance of Grace, even for an instant! ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: peeeaRai dohaaganee saahuraRai kiu jaau ||
english: I am a rejected bride, abandoned in my parents' home; how can I go to my in-laws now?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗਲਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਮੁਠੜੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mai gal augan muthaRee bin pir jhoor maraau ||2||
english: I wear my faults around my neck; without my Husband Lord, I am grieving, and wasting away to death. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: peeeaRai pir sa(n)malaa saahuraRai ghar vaas ||
english: But if, in my parents' home, I remember my Husband Lord, then I will come to dwell in the home of my in-laws yet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵੰਧਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sukh sava(n)dh sohaaganee pir paaiaa gunataas ||3||
english: The happy soul-brides sleep in peace; they find their Husband Lord, the treasure of virtue. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਫੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਪਟ ਕੀ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
transliteration: leph nihaalee pat kee kaapaR a(n)g banaai ||
english: Their blankets and mattresses are made of silk, and so are the clothes on their bodies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਮੁਤੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਡੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: pir mutee dohaaganee tin dukhee rain vihaai ||4||
english: The Lord rejects the impure soul-brides. Their life-night passes in misery. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੀ ਚਖਉ ਸਾਡੜੇ ਕਿਤੀ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
transliteration: kitee chakhau saadaRe kitee ves kareu ||
english: I have tasted many flavors, and worn many robes,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਗਇਅਮੁ ਵਾਢੀ ਝੂਰੇਦੀ ਝੂਰੇਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: pir bin joban baad gaiam vaadhee jhooredee jhooreu ||5||
english: but without my Husband Lord, my youth is slipping away uselessly; I am separated from Him, and I cry out in pain. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੰਦਾ ਸਦੜਾ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sache sa(n)daa sadaRaa suneeai gur veechaar ||
english: I have heard the True Lord's message, contemplating the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sache sachaa baihanaa nadaree nadar piaar ||6||
english: True is the home of the True Lord; by His Gracious Grace, I love Him. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਚ ਕਾ ਡੇਖੈ ਡੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: giaanee a(n)jan sach kaa dekhai dekhanahaar ||
english: The spiritual teacher applies the ointment of Truth to his eyes, and sees God, the Seer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramukh boojhai jaaneeai haumai garab nivaar ||7||
english: The Gurmukh comes to know and understand; ego and pride are subdued. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਤਉ ਜੇਹੀਆ ਮੂ ਜੇਹੀਆ ਕਿਤੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: tau bhaavan tau jeheeaa moo jeheeaa kiteeaah ||
english: O Lord, You are pleased with those who are like Yourself; there are many more like me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੈ ਰਤੜੀਆਹ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak naahu na veechhuRai tin sachai rataReeaah ||8||1||9||
english: O Nanak, the Husband does not separate from those who are imbued with Truth. ||8||1||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਭੈਣਾ ਭਰਜਾਈਆ ਨਾ ਸੇ ਸਸੁੜੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: naa bhainaa bharajaaeeaa naa se sasuReeaah ||
english: Neither the sisters, nor the sisters-in-law, nor the mothers-in-law, shall remain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਕੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਹੀਆਹ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sachaa saak na tutaee gur mele saheeaah ||1||
english: The true relationship with the Lord cannot be broken; it was established by the Lord, O sister soul-brides. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane sad balihaarai jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever a sacrifice to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਏਤਾ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਲਿਮੁ ਦਿਤਮੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur bin etaa bhav thakee gur pir melim ditam milaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Wandering so far without the Guru, I grew weary; now, the Guru has united me in Union with my Husband Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫੁਫੀ ਨਾਨੀ ਮਾਸੀਆ ਦੇਰ ਜੇਠਾਨੜੀਆਹ ॥
transliteration: phuphee naanee maaseeaa der jethaanaReeaah ||
english: Aunts, uncles, grandparents and sisters-in-law

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਨਿ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਨਾ ਰਹਨਿ ਪੂਰ ਭਰੇ ਪਹੀਆਹ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aavan va(n)njan naa rahan poor bhare paheeaah ||2||
english: - they all come and go; they cannot remain. They are like boatloads of passengers embarking. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਮੇ ਤੈ ਮਾਮਾਣੀਆ ਭਾਇਰ ਬਾਪ ਨ ਮਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maame tai maamaaneeaa bhaair baap na maau ||
english: Uncles, aunts, and cousins of all sorts, cannot remain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਥ ਲਡੇ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਠੀਆ ਭੀੜ ਘਣੀ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saath lade tin naatheeaa bheeR ghanee dareeaau ||3||
english: The caravans are full, and great crowds of them are loading up at the riverbank. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੋ ਸਖੀ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
transliteration: saachau ra(n)g ra(n)gaavalo sakhee hamaaro ka(n)t ||
english: O sister-friends, my Husband Lord is dyed in the color of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੰਤੁ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sach vichhoRaa naa theeai so sahu ra(n)g rava(n)t ||4||
english: She who lovingly remembers her True Husband Lord is not separated from Him again. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਰੁਤੀ ਚੰਗੀਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sabhe rutee cha(n)geeaa jit sache siu nehu ||
english: All the seasons are good, in which the soul-bride falls in love with the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਤੀ ਨਿਸਿ ਡੇਹੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: saa dhan ka(n)t pachhaaniaa sukh sutee nis dehu ||5||
english: That soul-bride, who knows her Husband Lord, sleeps in peace, night and day. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤਣਿ ਕੂਕੇ ਪਾਤਣੀ ਵੰਞਹੁ ਧ੍ਰੁਕਿ ਵਿਲਾੜਿ ॥
transliteration: patan kooke paatanee va(n)njahu dhruk vilaaR ||
english: At the ferry, the ferryman announces, "O travellers, hurry up and cross over."

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵੰਦੜੇ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਚਾੜਿ ॥੬॥
transliteration: paar pava(n)daRe dith mai satigur bohith chaaR ||6||
english: I have seen them crossing over there, on the boat of the True Guru. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿਕਨੀ ਲਦਿਆ ਹਿਕਿ ਲਦਿ ਗਏ ਹਿਕਿ ਭਾਰੇ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: hikanee ladiaa hik lad gae hik bhaare bhar naal ||
english: Some are getting on board, and some have already set out; some are weighed down with their loads.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jinee sach vana(n)jiaa se sache prabh naal ||7||
english: Those who deal in Truth, remain with their True Lord God. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਮ ਚੰਗੇ ਆਖੀਅਹ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: naa ham cha(n)ge aakheeah buraa na disai koi ||
english: I am not called good, and I see none who are bad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਜੇਹੜਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak haumai maareeai sache jehaRaa soi ||8||2||10||
english: O Nanak, one who conquers and subdues his ego, becomes just like the True Lord. ||8||2||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
transliteration: naa jaanaa moorakh hai koee naa jaanaa siaanaa ||
english: I do not believe that anyone is foolish; I do not believe that anyone is clever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa saahib kai ra(n)ge raataa anadin naam vakhaanaa ||1||
english: Imbued forever with the Love of my Lord and Master, I chant His Name, night and day. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹਾ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: baabaa moorakh haa naavai bal jaau ||
english: O Baba, I am so foolish, but I am a sacrifice to the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: too karataa too daanaa beenaa terai naam taraau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are the Creator, You are wise and all-seeing. Through Your Name, we are carried across. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਉ ॥
transliteration: moorakh siaanaa ek hai ek jot dui naau ||
english: The same person is foolish and wise; the same light within has two names.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: moorakhaa sir moorakh hai j ma(n)ne naahee naau ||2||
english: The most foolish of the foolish are those who do not believe in the Name. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gur duaarai naau paaeeai bin satigur palai na paai ||
english: Through the Guru's Gate, the Gurdwara, the Name is obtained. Without the True Guru, it is not received.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai man vasai taa ahinis rahai liv laai ||3||
english: Through the Pleasure of the True Guru's Will, the Name comes to dwell in the mind, and then, night and day, one remains lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੰ ਰੰਗੰ ਰੂਪੰ ਮਾਲੰ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤੇ ਜੂਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: raaja(n) ra(n)ga(n) roopa(n) maala(n) joban te jooaaree ||
english: In power, pleasures, beauty, wealth and youth, one gambles his life away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਾਧੇ ਪਾਸੈ ਖੇਲਹਿ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਏਕਾ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
transliteration: hukamee baadhe paasai khelahi chaupaR ekaa saaree ||4||
english: Bound by the Hukam of God's Command, the dice are thrown; he is just a piece in the game of chess. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਨਾਉ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jag chatur siaanaa bharam bhulaanaa naau pa(n)dit paRahi gaavaaree ||
english: The world is clever and wise, but it is deluded by doubt, and forgets the Name; the Pandit, the religious scholar, studies the scriptures, but he is still a fool.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naau visaarahi bed samaalahi bikh bhoole lekhaaree ||5||
english: Forgetting the Name, he dwells upon the Vedas; he writes, but he is confused by his poisonous corruption. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਰ ਖੇਤੀ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੰਠੇ ਬਾਗਾ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਕਜਲੁ ਝਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kalar khetee taravar ka(n)the baagaa pahirahi kajal jharai ||
english: He is like the crop planted in the salty soil, or the tree growing on the river bank, or the white clothes sprinkled with dirt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਕੋਠੀ ਜੋ ਪੈਸੈ ਸੋ ਗਰਬਿ ਜਰੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ehu sa(n)saar tisai kee kothee jo paisai so garab jarai ||6||
english: This world is the house of desire; whoever enters it, is burnt down by egotistical pride. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਯਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਕਹਾ ਸਬਾਏ ਦੁਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: rayat raaje kahaa sabaae duhu a(n)tar so jaasee ||
english: Where are all the kings and their subjects? Those who are immersed in duality are destroyed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਰਹਸੀ ਅਲਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥੭॥੩॥੧੧॥
transliteration: kahat naanak gur sache kee pauRee rahasee alakh nivaasee ||7||3||11||
english: Says Nanak, these are the steps of the ladder, of the Teachings of the True Guru; only the Unseen Lord shall remain. ||7||3||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ghar 5 asatapadee ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl, Fifth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis no prem ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: One whose mind is filled with the Lord's Love,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saachai sabad sahaj subhaae ||
english: is intuitively exalted by the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਵੇਦਨ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ehaa vedan soee jaanai avar k jaanai kaaree jeeu ||1||
english: He alone knows the pain of this love; what does anyone else know about its cure? ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape mele aap milaae ||
english: He Himself unites in His Union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa piaar aape laae ||
english: He Himself inspires us with His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: prem kee saar soee jaanai jis no nadar tumaaree jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He alone appreciates the value of Your Love, upon whom You shower Your Grace, O Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਿਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dib drisat jaagai bharam chukaae ||
english: One whose spiritual vision is awakened - his doubt is driven out.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paae ||
english: By Guru's Grace, he obtains the supreme status.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so jogee ih jugat pachhaanai gur kai sabad beechaaree jeeu ||2||
english: He alone is a Yogi, who understands this way, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)jogee dhan pir melaa hovai ||
english: By good destiny, the soul-bride is united with her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramat vichahu duramat khovai ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, she eradicates her evil-mindedness from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਨਿਤ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ra(n)g siu nit raleeaa maanai apane ka(n)t piaaree jeeu ||3||
english: With love, she continually enjoys pleasure with Him; she becomes the beloved of her Husband Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਵੈਦੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur baajhahu vaid na koee ||
english: Other than the True Guru, there is no physician.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape aap nira(n)jan soee ||
english: He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਰੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
transliteration: satigur miliai marai ma(n)daa hovai giaan beechaaree jeeu ||4||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, evil is conquered, and spiritual wisdom is contemplated. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ehu sabad saar jis no laae ||
english: One who is committed to this most sublime Shabad

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh trisanaa bhukh gavaae ||
english: becomes Gurmukh, and is rid of thirst and hunger.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aapan leeaa kichhoo na paaeeai kar kirapaa kal dhaaree jeeu ||5||
english: By one's own efforts, nothing can be accomplished; the Lord, in His Mercy, bestows power. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਨਿਗਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: agam nigam satiguroo dikhaaiaa ||
english: The True Guru has revealed the essence of the Shaastras and the Vedas.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa apanai ghar aaiaa ||
english: In His Mercy, He has come into the home of my self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
transliteration: a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan jaataa jin kau nadar tumaaree jeeu ||6||
english: In the midst of Maya, the Immaculate Lord is known, by those upon whom You bestow Your Grace. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਤਤੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai so tat paae ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh, obtains the essence of reality;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa aap vichahu gavaae ||
english: he eradictes his self-conceit from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਧੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
transliteration: satigur baajhahu sabh dha(n)dh kamaavai vekhahu man veechaaree jeeu ||7||
english: Without the True Guru, all are entangled in worldly affairs; consider this in your mind, and see. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ik bhram bhoole phirahi aha(n)kaaree ||
english: Some are deluded by doubt; they strut around egotistically.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa guramukh haumai maaree ||
english: Some, as Gurmukh, subdue their egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
transliteration: sachai sabad rate bairaagee hor bharam bhule gaavaaree jeeu ||8||
english: Attuned to the True Word of the Shabad, they remain detached from the world. The other ignorant fools wander, confused and deluded by doubt. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jinee naam na paaiaa ||
english: Those who have not become Gurmukh, and who have not found the Naam, the Name of the Lord

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: manamukh birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||
english: those self-willed manmukhs waste their lives uselessly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥
transliteration: agai vin naavai ko belee naahee boojhai gur beechaaree jeeu ||9||
english: In the world hereafter, nothing except the Name will be of any assistance; this is understood by contemplating the Guru. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam sadaa sukhadaataa ||
english: The Ambrosial Naam is the Giver of peace forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai jug chaare jaataa ||
english: Throughout the four ages, it is known through the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
transliteration: jis too devahi soee paae naanak tat beechaaree jeeu ||10||1||
english: He alone receives it, unto whom You bestow it; this is the essence of reality which Nanak has realized. ||10||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 3 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਬ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh bhramate bhramate dulabh janam ab paaio ||1||
english: Wandering and roaming through 8.4 million incarnations, you have now been given this human life, so difficult to obtain. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ ਤੂ ਹੋਛੈ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ॥
transliteration: re mooRe too hochhai ras lapataaio ||
english: You fool! You are attached and clinging to such trivial pleasures!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit sa(n)g basat hai terai bikhiaa siu urajhaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar abides with you, but you are engrossed in sin and corruption. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਬਨਜਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਕਾਲਰੁ ਲਾਦਿ ਚਲਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ratan javehar banajan aaio kaalar laad chalaaio ||2||
english: You have come to trade in gems and jewels, but you have loaded only barren soil. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਹਨਾ ਬਸਨਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jih ghar mahi tudh rahanaa basanaa so ghar cheet na aaio ||3||
english: That home within which you live - you have not kept that home in your thoughts. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਟਲ ਅਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਤੁਝੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
transliteration: atal akha(n)d praan sukhadaaee ik nimakh nahee tujh gaaio ||4||
english: He is immovable, indestructible, the Giver of peace to the soul; and yet you do not sing His Praises, even for an instant. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jahaa jaanaa so thaan visaario ik nimakh nahee man laaio ||5||
english: You have forgotten that place where you must go; you have not attached your mind to the Lord, even for an instant. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ॥੬॥
transliteration: putr kalatr grih dekh samagree is hee mahi urajhaaio ||6||
english: Gazing upon your children, spouse, household and paraphernalia, you are entangled in them. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਓ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੈਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਓ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jit ko laaio tit hee laagaa taise karam kamaaio ||7||
english: As God links the mortals, so are they linked, and so are the deeds they do. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥੮॥੧॥
transliteration: jau bhaio kripaal taa saadhasa(n)g paaiaa jan naanak braham dhiaaio ||8||1||
english: When He becomes Merciful, then the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is found; servant Nanak meditates on God. ||8||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
transliteration: kar anugrahu raakh leeno bhaio saadhoo sa(n)g ||
