english: Granting His Grace, He has protected me; I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਾਰੈ ਮਿਸਟ ਗੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har naam ras rasanaa uchaarai misat gooRaa ra(n)g ||1||
english: My tongue lovingly chants the Lord's Name; this love is so sweet and intense! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਨ ਕੋ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: mere maan ko asathaan ||
english: He is the place of rest for my mind,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: meet saajan sakhaa ba(n)dhap a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: my friend, companion, associate and relative; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਗਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar jin upaaio saran prabh kee gahee ||
english: He created the world-ocean; I seek the Sanctuary of that God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur prasaadee prabh araadhe jamaka(n)kar kichh na kahee ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, I worship and adore God; the Messenger of Death can't say anything to me. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਤ ਰਿਦਾ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mokh mukat duaar jaa kai sa(n)t ridaa bha(n)daar ||
english: Emancipation and liberation are at His Door; He is the treasure in the hearts of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jee jugat sujaan suaamee sadaa raakhanahaar ||3||
english: The all-knowing Lord and Master shows us the true way of life; He is our Savior and Protector forever. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਕਲੇਸ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: dookh darad kales binasahi jis basai man maahi ||
english: Pain, suffering and troubles are eradicated, when the Lord abides in the mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨਰਕੁ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
transliteration: mirat narak asathaan bikhaRe bikh na pohai taahi ||4||
english: Death, hell and the most horrible dwelling of sin and corruption cannot even touch such a person. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਹ ॥
transliteration: ridh sidh nav nidh jaa kai a(n)mritaa paravaah ||
english: Wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures come from the Lord, as do the streams of Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aad a(n)te madh pooran ooch agam agaah ||5||
english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is perfect, lofty, unapproachable and unfathomable. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦੇਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਬੇਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik dev mun jan bed karahi uchaar ||
english: The Siddhas, seekers, angelic beings, silent sages, and the Vedas speak of Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਭੁੰਚਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
transliteration: simar suaamee sukh sahaj bhu(n)chahi nahee a(n)t paaraavaar ||6||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord and Master, celestial peace is enjoyed; He has no end or limitation. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਛਤ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਪਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
transliteration: anik praachhat mitahi khin mahi ridai jap bhagavaan ||
english: Countless sins are erased in an instant, meditating on the Benevolent Lord within the heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਨਾ ਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਪਾਵਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਨ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥੭॥
transliteration: paavanaa te mahaa paavan kot daan isanaan ||7||
english: Such a person becomes the purest of the pure, and is blessed with the merits of millions of donations to charity and cleansing baths. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਰਾਣ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: bal budh sudh paraan sarabas sa(n)tanaa kee raas ||
english: God is power, intellect, understanding, the breath of life, wealth, and everything for the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੮॥੨॥
transliteration: bisar naahee nimakh man te naanak kee aradaas ||8||2||
english: May I never forget Him from my mind, even for an instant - this is Nanak's prayer. ||8||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਸਤ੍ਰਿ ਤੀਖਣਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
transliteration: sasatr teekhan kaat daario man na keeno ros ||
english: The sharp tool cuts down the tree, but it does not feel anger in its mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੁ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਲੇ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਦੀਨੋ ਦੋਸੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaaj uaa ko le savaario til na deeno dos ||1||
english: It serves the purpose of the cutter, and does not blame him at all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: man mere raam rau nit neet ||
english: O my mind, continually, continuously, meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: daiaal dev kripaal gobi(n)d sun sa(n)tanaa kee reet ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord of the Universe is merciful, divine and compassionate. Listen - this is the way of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਤਲੈ ਉਗਾਹਿ ਬੈਸਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
transliteration: charan talai ugaahi baisio sram na rahio sareer ||
english: He plants his feet in the boat, and then sits down in it; the fatigue of his body is relieved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਖਿਨਹਿ ਉਤਰਿਓ ਤੀਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mahaa saagar nah viaapai khinahi utario teer ||2||
english: The great ocean does not even affect him; in an instant, he arrives on the other shore. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਅਗਰ ਕਪੂਰ ਲੇਪਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)dan agar kapoor lepan tis sa(n)ge nahee preet ||
english: Sandalwood, aloe, and camphor-paste - the earth does not love them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਖੋਦਿ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਮਨੀ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bisataa mootr khod til til man na manee bipareet ||3||
english: But it doesn't mind, if someone digs it up bit by bit, and applies manure and urine to it. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਲਗਨ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਛਤ੍ਰ ॥
transliteration: ooch neech bikaar sukrit sa(n)lagan sabh sukh chhatr ||
english: High and low, bad and good - the comforting canopy of the sky stretches evenly over all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਕਛੂ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਸਮਤ ॥੪॥
transliteration: mitr satr na kachhoo jaanai sarab jee samat ||4||
english: It knows nothing of friend and enemy; all beings are alike to it. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
transliteration: kar pragaas pracha(n)d pragatio a(n)dhakaar binaas ||
english: Blazing with its dazzling light, the sun rises, and dispels the darkness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਹ ਕਿਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਭਇਓ ਬਿਖਾਦੁ ॥੫॥
transliteration: pavitr apavitrah kiran laage man na bhaio bikhaad ||5||
english: Touching both the pure and the impure, it harbors no hatred to any. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੀਤ ਮੰਦ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਚਲਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: seet ma(n)d suga(n)dh chalio sarab thaan samaan ||
english: The cool and fragrant wind gently blows upon all places alike.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਸਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਹਾ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਸੰਕਾ ਮਾਨ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jahaa saa kichh tahaa laagio til na sa(n)kaa maan ||6||
english: Wherever anything is, it touches it there, and does not hesitate a bit. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭਾਇ ਅਭਾਇ ਜੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੀਤੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: subhaai abhaai j nikat aavai seet taa kaa jaai ||
english: Good or bad, whoever comes close to the fire - his cold is taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਪਰ ਕਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aap par kaa kachh na jaanai sadaa sahaj subhaai ||7||
english: It knows nothing of its own or others'; it is constant in the same quality. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਸਨਾਥ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਲਾਲ ॥
transliteration: charan saran sanaath ihu man ra(n)g raate laal ||
english: Whoever seeks the Sancuary of the feet of the Sublime Lord - his mind is attuned to the Love of the Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੮॥੩॥
transliteration: gopaal gun nit gaau naanak bhae prabh kirapaal ||8||3||
english: Constantly singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World, O Nanak, God becomes merciful to us. ||8||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 4 asatapadeeaa ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਦਨਾ ਚਾਦਨੁ ਆਂਗਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਦਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chaadanaa chaadan aa(n)gan prabh jeeu a(n)tar chaadanaa ||1||
english: Moonlight, moonlight - in the courtyard of the mind, let the moonlight of God shine down. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਰਾਧਨਾ ਅਰਾਧਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aaraadhanaa araadhan neekaa har har naam araadhanaa ||2||
english: Meditation, meditation - sublime is meditation on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਨਾ ਤਿਆਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tiaaganaa tiaagan neekaa kaam krodh lobh tiaaganaa ||3||
english: Renunciation, renunciation - noble is the renunciation of sexual desire, anger and greed. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਗਨਾ ਮਾਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਾਗਨਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: maaganaa maagan neekaa har jas gur te maaganaa ||4||
english: Begging, begging - it is noble to beg for the Lord's Praise from the Guru. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਨਾ ਜਾਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਗਨਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jaaganaa jaagan neekaa har keeratan mahi jaaganaa ||5||
english: Vigils, vigils - sublime is the vigil spent singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਾਗਨਾ ਲਾਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਨਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: laaganaa laagan neekaa gur charanee man laaganaa ||6||
english: Attachment, attachment - sublime is the attachment of the mind to the Guru's Feet. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਨਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ih bidh tisahi paraapate jaa kai masatak bhaaganaa ||7||
english: He alone is blessed with this way of life, upon whose forehead such destiny is recorded. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਗਨਾ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu naanak tis sabh kichh neekaa jo prabh kee saranaaganaa ||8||1||4||
english: Says Nanak, everything is sublime and noble, for one who enters the Sanctuary of God. ||8||1||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਆਉ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਾਵਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aau jee too aau hamaarai har jas sravan sunaavanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Please come, O please come into the home of my heart, that I may hear with my ears the Lord's Praises. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਵਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਾਵਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tudh aavat meraa man tan hariaa har jas tum sa(n)g gaavanaa ||1||
english: With your coming, my soul and body are rejuvenated, and I sing with you the Lord's Praises. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਾਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਵਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)t kripaa te hiradai vaasai doojaa bhaau mitaavanaa ||2||
english: By the Grace of the Saint, the Lord dwells within the heart, and the love of duality is eradicated. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਖ ਤਜਾਵਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhagat daiaa te budh paragaasai duramat dookh tajaavanaa ||3||
english: By the kindness of the devotee, the intellect is enlightened, and pain and evil-mindedness are eradicated. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਨਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: darasan bhetat hot puneetaa punarap garabh na paavanaa ||4||
english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, one is sanctified, and is no longer consigned to the womb of reincarnation. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਨਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: nau nidh ridh sidh paaee jo tumarai man bhaavanaa ||5||
english: The nine treasures, wealth and miraculous spiritual powers are obtained, by one who is pleasing to Your mind. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਜਾਵਨਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sa(n)t binaa mai thaau na koee avar na soojhai jaavanaa ||6||
english: Without the Saint, I have no place of rest at all; I cannot think of any other place to go. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਨਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: mohi niragun kau koi na raakhai sa(n)taa sa(n)g samaavanaa ||7||
english: I am unworthy; no one gives me sanctuary. But in the Society of the Saints, I merge in God. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵਨਾ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: kahu naanak gur chalat dikhaaiaa man madhe har har raavanaa ||8||2||5||
english: Says Nanak, the Guru has revealed this miracle; within my mind, I enjoy the Lord, Har, Har. ||8||2||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨਾ ਸਫਲ ਜੀਵਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jeevanaa saphal jeevan sun har jap jap sad jeevanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Fruitful is the life, the life of one who hears about the Lord, and chants and meditates on Him; he lives forever. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਘਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: peevanaa jit man aaghaavai naam a(n)mrit ras peevanaa ||1||
english: The real drink is that which satisfies the mind; this drink is the sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਵਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਵਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khaavanaa jit bhookh na laagai sa(n)tokh sadaa tripateevanaa ||2||
english: The real food is that which will never leave you hungry again; it will leave you contented and satisfied forever. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੈਨਣਾ ਰਖੁ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਗੇ ਨਹੀ ਥੀਵਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: painanaa rakh pat paramesur phir naage nahee theevanaa ||3||
english: The real clothes are those which protect your honor before the Transcendent Lord, and do not leave you naked ever again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੋਗਨਾ ਮਨ ਮਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਲੀਵਨਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: bhoganaa man madhe har ras sa(n)tasa(n)gat mahi leevanaa ||4||
english: The real enjoyment within the mind is to be absorbed in the sublime essence of the Lord, in the Society of the Saints. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਗੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੂਈ ਆਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੀਵਨਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bin taage bin sooee aanee man har bhagatee sa(n)g seevanaa ||5||
english: Sew devotional worship to the Lord into the mind, without any needle or thread. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਅਉਖੀਵਨਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: maatiaa har ras mahi raate tis bahuR na kabahoo aukheevanaa ||6||
english: Imbued and intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, this experience will never wear off again. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਓ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੀਵਨਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: milio tis sarab nidhaanaa prabh kripaal jis deevanaa ||7||
english: One is blessed with all treasures, when God, in His Mercy, gives them. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਰਣ ਸੰਤ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਨਾ ॥੮॥੩॥੬॥
transliteration: sukh naanak sa(n)tan kee sevaa charan sa(n)t dhoi peevanaa ||8||3||6||
english: O Nanak, service to the Saints beings peace; I drink in the wash water of the feet of the Saints. ||8||3||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਅੰਜੁਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 8 a(n)juleeaa ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Eighth House, Anjulees ~ With Hands Cupped In Prayer:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jis grihi bahut tisai grihi chi(n)taa ||
english: The household which is filled with abundance - that household suffers anxiety.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਥੋਰੀ ਸੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jis grihi thoree s phirai bhrama(n)taa ||
english: One whose household has little, wanders around searching for more.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੂ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਭਾਲੀਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: duhoo bivasathaa te jo mukataa soee suhelaa bhaaleeai ||1||
english: He alone is happy and at peace, who is liberated from both conditions. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਨਰਕੁ ਉਦਾਸ ਕਰੋਧਾ ॥
transliteration: grih raaj mahi narak udaas karodhaa ||
english: Householders and kings fall into hell, along with renunciates and angry men,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਸਭਿ ਸੋਧਾ ॥
transliteration: bahu bidh bed paath sabh sodhaa ||
english: and all those who study and recite the Vedas in so many ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ਅਲਿਪਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dehee mahi jo rahai alipataa tis jan kee pooran ghaaleeai ||2||
english: Perfect is the work of that humble servant, who remains unattached while in the body. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਤ ਸੂਤਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jaagat sootaa bharam vigootaa ||
english: The mortal sleeps, even while he is awake; he is being plundered by doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bin gur mukat na hoeeai meetaa ||
english: Without the Guru, liberation is not obtained, friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਟਹਿ ਹਉ ਬੰਧਨ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g tutahi hau ba(n)dhan eko ek nihaaleeai ||3||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the bonds of egotism are released, and one comes to behold the One and only Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਤ ਬੰਧਾ ਨਹ ਕਰੈ ਤ ਨਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: karam karai ta ba(n)dhaa nah karai ta ni(n)daa ||
english: Doing deeds, one is placed in bondage; but if he does not act, he is slandered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਮਨੁ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਚਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: moh magan man viaapiaa chi(n)daa ||
english: Intoxicated with emotional attachment, the mind is afflicted with anxiety.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਜਾਣੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਿਆਲੀਐ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur prasaad sukh dukh sam jaanai ghat ghat raam hiaaleeai ||4||
english: One who looks alike upon pleasure and pain, by Guru's Grace, sees the Lord in each and every heart. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)saarai mahi sahasaa biaapai ||
english: Within the world, one is afflicted by skepticism;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: akath kathaa agochar nahee jaapai ||
english: he does not know the imperceptible Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਓਹੁ ਬਾਲਕ ਵਾਗੀ ਪਾਲੀਐ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jisahi bujhaae soee boojhai ohu baalak vaagee paaleeai ||5||
english: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. The Lord cherishes him as His child. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਬਹੈ ਤਉ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: chhod bahai tau chhootai naahee ||
english: He may try to abandon Maya, but he is not released.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸੰਚੈ ਤਉ ਭਉ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jau sa(n)chai tau bhau man maahee ||
english: If he collects things, then his mind is afraid of losing them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਉਰੁ ਢਾਲੀਐ ॥੬॥
transliteration: is hee mahi jis kee pat raakhai tis saadhoo chaur dhaaleeai ||6||
english: I wave the fly-brush over that holy person, whose honor is protected in the midst of Maya. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jo sooraa tis hee hoi maranaa ||
english: He alone is a warrior hero, who remains dead to the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਭਾਗੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jo bhaagai tis jonee phiranaa ||
english: One who runs away will wander in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਵਰਤਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਲੀਐ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jo varataae soee bhal maanai bujh hukamai duramat jaaleeai ||7||
english: Whatever happens, accept that as good. Realize the Hukam of His Command, and your evil-mindedness will be burnt away. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jit jit laavahi tit tit laganaa ||
english: Whatever He links us to, to that we are linked.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਜਚਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kar vekhai apane jachanaa ||
english: He acts, and does, and watches over His Creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥੮॥੧॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak ke pooran sukhadaate too dehi ta naam samaaleeai ||8||1||7||
english: You are the Giver of peace, the Perfect Lord of Nanak; as You grant Your blessings, I dwell upon Your Name. ||8||1||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਖੈ ਹੇਠਿ ਸਭਿ ਜੰਤ ਇਕਠੇ ॥
transliteration: birakhai heth sabh ja(n)t ikathe ||
english: Beneath the tree, all beings have gathered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਤਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਮਿਠੇ ॥
transliteration: ik tate ik bolan mithe ||
english: Some are hot-headed, and some speak very sweetly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਸਤੁ ਉਦੋਤੁ ਭਇਆ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਅਉਧ ਵਿਹਾਣੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: asat udot bhaiaa uth chale jiu jiu audh vihaaneeaa ||1||
english: Sunset has come, and they rise up and depart; their days have run their course and expired. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇਦੜ ਸਰਪਰ ਮੁਠੇ ॥
transliteration: paap karedaR sarapar muthe ||
english: Those who committed sins are sure to be ruined.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਜਰਾਈਲਿ ਫੜੇ ਫੜਿ ਕੁਠੇ ॥
transliteration: ajaraaeel phaRe phaR kuthe ||
english: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, seizes and tortures them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੋਜਕਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਬਾਣੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: dojak paae sirajanahaarai lekhaa ma(n)gai baaneeaa ||2||
english: They are consigned to hell by the Creator Lord, and the Accountant calls them to give their account. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਭਈਆ ਬੇਬਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)g na koee bhaeeaa bebaa ||
english: No brothers or sisters can go with them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਞੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: maal joban dhan chhod vanjesaa ||
english: Leaving behind their property, youth and wealth, they march off.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਰੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਤੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਿਲ ਪੀੜੇ ਜਿਉ ਘਾਣੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: karan kareem na jaato karataa til peeRe jiu ghaaneeaa ||3||
english: They do not know the kind and compassionate Lord; they shall be crushed like sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੁਸਿ ਖੁਸਿ ਲੈਦਾ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: khus khus laidaa vasat paraaee ||
english: You happily, cheerfully steal the possessions of others,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਖੁਦਾਈ ॥
transliteration: vekhai sune terai naal khudaaee ||
english: but the Lord God is with you, watching and listening.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਲਬਿ ਪਇਆ ਖਾਤ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਗਲ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: duneeaa lab paiaa khaat a(n)dar agalee gal na jaaneeaa ||4||
english: Through worldly greed, you have fallen into the pit; you know nothing of the future. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮਿ ਜਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ॥
transliteration: jam jam marai marai phir ja(n)mai ||
english: You shall be born and born again, and die and die again, only to be reincarnated again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਜਾਇ ਪਇਆ ਦੇਸਿ ਲੰਮੈ ॥
transliteration: bahut sajaai paiaa des la(n)mai ||
english: You shall suffer terrible punishment, on your way to the land beyond.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹੈ ਪਰਾਣੀਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jin keetaa tisai na jaanee a(n)dhaa taa dukh sahai paraaneeaa ||5||
english: The mortal does not know the One who created him; he is blind, and so he shall suffer. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਲਕ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਮੁਠਾ ॥
transliteration: khaalak thaavahu bhulaa muthaa ||
english: Forgetting the Creator Lord, he is ruined.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਖੇਲੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਰੁਠ ਤੁਠਾ ॥
transliteration: duneeaa khel buraa ruth tuthaa ||
english: The drama of the world is bad; it brings sadness and then happiness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਦਕੁ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਸੰਤੁ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਵਤੈ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੀਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sidak sabooree sa(n)t na milio vatai aapan bhaaneeaa ||6||
english: One who does not meet the Saint does not have faith or contentment; he wanders just as he pleases. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਉਲਾ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: maulaa khel kare sabh aape ||
english: The Lord Himself stages all this drama.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਕਢੇ ਇਕਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: ik kadhe ik lahar viaape ||
english: Some, he lifts up, and some he throws into the waves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਨਚਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਨਚਨਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਿਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਣੀਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jiu nachaae tiu tiu nachan sir sir kirat vihaaneeaa ||7||
english: As He makes them dance, so do they dance. Everyone lives their lives according to their past actions. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: mihar kare taa khasam dhiaaee ||
english: When the Lord and Master grants His Grace, then we meditate on Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa sa(n)gat narak na paaee ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, one is not consigned to hell.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੀਤਾ ਨਿਤ ਵਖਾਣੀਆ ॥੮॥੨॥੮॥੧੨॥੨੦॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam daan naanak kau gun geetaa nit vakhaaneeaa ||8||2||8||12||20||
english: Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord; he continually sings the songs of Your Glories. ||8||2||8||12||20||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, Solahas, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: saachaa sach soee avar na koee ||
english: The True Lord is True; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jin sirajee tin hee phun goee ||
english: He who created, shall in the end destroy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹਣਾ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਕਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakhahu rahanaa tum siu kiaa mukaraaee he ||1||
english: As it pleases You, so You keep me, and so I remain; what excuse could I offer to You? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਖਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aap upaae aap khapaae ||
english: You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape sir sir dha(n)dhai laae ||
english: You yourself link each and every person to their tasks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape veechaaree gunakaaree aape maarag laaee he ||2||
english: You contemplate Yourself, You Yourself make us worthy; You Yourself place us on the Path. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aape daanaa aape beenaa ||
english: You Yourself are all-wise, You Yourself are all-knowing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਪਤੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aape aap upaai pateenaa ||
english: You Yourself created the Universe, and You are pleased.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape paun paanee baisa(n)tar aape mel milaaee he ||3||
english: You Yourself are the air, water and fire; You Yourself unite in Union. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਸਿ ਸੂਰਾ ਪੂਰੋ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape sas sooraa pooro pooraa ||
english: You Yourself are the moon, the sun, the most perfect of the perfect.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape giaan dhiaan gur sooraa ||
english: You Yourself are spiritual wisdom, meditation, and the Guru, the Warrior Hero.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kaal jaal jam johi na saakai saache siu liv laaee he ||4||
english: The Messenger of Death, and his noose of death, cannot touch one, who is lovingly focused on You, O True Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aape purakh aape hee naaree ||
english: You Yourself are the male, and You Yourself are the female.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਾਸਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aape paasaa aape saaree ||
english: You Yourself are the chess-board, and You Yourself are the chessman.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਿੜ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aape piR baadhee jag khelai aape keemat paaee he ||5||
english: You Yourself staged the drama in the arena of the world, and You Yourself evaluate the players. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਵਰੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਤਰਵਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape bhavar phul phal taravar ||
english: You Yourself are the bumble bee, the flower, the fruit and the tree.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਥਲੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape jal thal saagar saravar ||
english: You Yourself are the water, the desert, the ocean and the pool.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਛੁ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਣੀਕਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aape machh kachh karaneekar teraa roop na lakhanaa jaaee he ||6||
english: You Yourself are the great fish, the tortoise, the Cause of causes; Your form cannot be known. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aape dinas aape hee rainee ||
english: You Yourself are the day, and You Yourself are the night.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aap pateejai gur kee bainee ||
english: You Yourself are pleased by the Word of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aad jugaad anaahad anadin ghat ghat sabad rajaaee he ||7||
english: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the unstruck sound current resounds, night and day; in each and every heart, the Word of the Shabad, echoes Your Will. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਅਮੋਲੋ ॥
transliteration: aape ratan anoop amolo ||
english: You Yourself are the jewel, incomparably beautiful and priceless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੋ ॥
transliteration: aape parakhe pooraa tolo ||
english: You Yourself are the Assessor, the Perfect Weigher.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਸਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਲੈ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: aape kis hee kas bakhase aape de lai bhaaee he ||8||
english: You Yourself test and forgive. You Yourself give and take, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਧਨਖੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: aape dhanakh aape sarabaanaa ||
english: He Himself is the bow, and He Himself is the archer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
transliteration: aape sughaR saroop siaanaa ||
english: He Himself is all-wise, beautiful and all-knowing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਸੁਣਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: kahataa bakataa sunataa soee aape banat banaaee he ||9||
english: He is the speaker, the orator and the listener. He Himself made what is made. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: paun guroo paanee pit jaataa ||
english: Air is the Guru, and water is known to be the father.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਦਰ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: udar sa(n)jogee dharatee maataa ||
english: The womb of the great mother earth gives birth to all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: rain dinas dui daaee daaiaa jag khelai khelaaee he ||10||
english: Night and day are the two nurses, male and female; the world plays in this play. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aape machhulee aape jaalaa ||
english: You Yourself are the fish, and You Yourself are the net.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗਊ ਆਪੇ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aape gaoo aape rakhavaalaa ||
english: You Yourself are the cows, and You yourself are their keeper.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: sarab jeeaa jag jot tumaaree jaisee prabh phuramaaee he ||11||
english: Your Light fills all the beings of the world; they walk according to Your Command, O God. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: aape jogee aape bhogee ||
english: You Yourself are the Yogi, and You Yourself are the enjoyer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: aape raseeaa param sa(n)jogee ||
english: You Yourself are the reveller; You form the supreme Union.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: aape vebaanee nira(n)kaaree nirabhau taaRee laaee he ||12||
english: You Yourself are speechless, formless and fearless, absorbed in the primal ecstasy of deep meditation. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: khaanee baanee tujhahi samaanee ||
english: The sources of creation and speech are contained within You, Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai sabh aavan jaanee ||
english: All that is seen, is coming and going.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਸਾਹ ਸਚੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: seee saah sache vaapaaree satigur boojh bujhaaee he ||13||
english: They are the true bankers and traders, whom the True Guru has inspired to understand. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad bujhaae satigur pooraa ||
english: The Word of the Shabad is understood through the Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਰਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab kalaa saache bharapooraa ||
english: The True Lord is overflowing with all powers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਫਰਿਓ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: aphario veparavaahu sadaa too naa tis til na tamaaee he ||14||
english: You are beyond our grasp, and forever independent. You do not have even an iota of greed. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਭਏ ਦੇਵਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: kaal bikaal bhae devaane ||
english: Birth and death are meaningless, for those

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸਹਜ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
transliteration: sabad sahaj ras a(n)tar maane ||
english: who enjoy the sublime celestial essence of the Shabad within their minds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਵਰਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: aape mukat tripat varadaataa bhagat bhaai man bhaaee he ||15||
english: He Himself is the Giver of liberation, satisfaction and blessings, to those devotees who love Him in their minds. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aap niraalam gur gam giaanaa ||
english: He Himself is immaculate; by contact with the Guru, spiritual wisdom is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਤੁਝ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai tujh maahi samaanaa ||
english: Whatever is seen, shall merge into You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਚੈ ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak neech bhikhiaa dar jaachai mai deejai naam vadaaee he ||16||1||
english: Nanak, the lowly, begs for charity at Your Door; please, bless him with the glorious greatness of Your Name. ||16||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਉਲੁ ਅਕਾਸੰ ॥
transliteration: aape dharatee dhaul akaasa(n) ||
english: He Himself is the earth, the mythical bull which supports it and the Akaashic ethers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸੰ ॥
transliteration: aape saache gun paragaasa(n) ||
english: The True Lord Himself reveals His Glorious Virtues.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jatee satee sa(n)tokhee aape aape kaar kamaaee he ||1||
english: He Himself is celibate, chaste and contented; He Himself is the Doer of deeds. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: jis karanaa so kar kar vekhai ||
english: He who created the creation, beholds what He has created.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: koi na metai saache lekhai ||
english: No one can erase the Inscription of the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae aape aape de vadiaaee he ||2||
english: He Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes; He Himself is the One who bestows glorious greatness. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਚਾਲਹਿ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch chor cha(n)chal chit chaalahi ||
english: The five thieves cause the fickle consciousness to waver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਲਹਿ ॥
transliteration: par ghar johahi ghar nahee bhaalahi ||
english: It looks into the homes of others, but does not search its own home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੁ ਢਹੈ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaaiaa nagar dhahai dhahi dheree bin sabadai pat jaaee he ||3||
english: The body-village crumbles into dust; without the Word of the Shabad, one's honor is lost. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: gur te boojhai tribhavan soojhai ||
english: One who realizes the Lord through the Guru, comprehends the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੈ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: manasaa maar manai siu loojhai ||
english: He subdues his desires, and struggles with his mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਧ ਹੀ ਜੇਹੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jo tudh sevahi se tudh hee jehe nirabhau baal sakhaaee he ||4||
english: Those who serve You, become just like You; O Fearless Lord, You are their best friend from infancy. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aape surag machh paiaalaa ||
english: You Yourself are the heavenly realms, this world and the nether regions of the underworld.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aape jot saroopee baalaa ||
english: You Yourself are the embodiment of light, forever young.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਟਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jataa bikat bikaraal saroopee roop na rekhiaa kaaee he ||5||
english: With matted hair, and a horrible, dreadful form, still, You have no form or feature. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬੀ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bed katebee bhed na jaataa ||
english: The Vedas and the Bible do not know the mystery of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: naa tis maat pitaa sut bhraataa ||
english: He has no mother, father, child or brother.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਸੈਲ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਏ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sagale sail upaai samaae alakh na lakhanaa jaaee he ||6||
english: He created all the mountains, and levels them again; the Unseen Lord cannot be seen. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਮੀਤ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kar kar thaakee meet ghanere ||
english: I have grown weary of making so many friends.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਾਟੈ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: koi na kaatai avagun mere ||
english: No one can rid me of my sins and mistakes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sur nar naath saahib sabhanaa sir bhaai milai bhau jaaee he ||7||
english: God is the Supreme Lord and Master of all the angels and mortal beings; blessed with His Love, their fear is dispelled. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੇ ਚੂਕੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bhoole chooke maarag paavahi ||
english: He puts back on the Path those who have wandered and strayed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aap bhulaai toohai samajhaavahi ||
english: You Yourself make them stray, and You teach them again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: bin naavai mai avar na deesai naavahu gat mit paaee he ||8||
english: I cannot see anything except the Name. Through the Name comes salvation and merit. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੰਗਾ ਜਮੁਨਾ ਕੇਲ ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)gaa jamunaa kel kedaaraa ||
english: The Ganges, the Jamunaa where Krishna played, Kaydar Naat'h,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਸੀ ਕਾਂਤੀ ਪੁਰੀ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaasee kaa(n)tee puree duaaraa ||
english: Benares, Kanchivaram, Puri, Dwaarkaa,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੰਗਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੇਣੀ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: ga(n)gaa saagar benee sa(n)gam athasath a(n)k samaaee he ||9||
english: Ganga Saagar where the Ganges empties into the ocean, Trivaynee where the three rivers come together, and the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, are all merged in the Lord's Being. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aape sidh saadhik veechaaree ||
english: He Himself is the Siddha, the seeker, in meditative contemplation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਾਜਨੁ ਪੰਚਾ ਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aape raajan pa(n)chaa kaaree ||
english: He Himself is the King and the Council.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹੈ ਅਦਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: takhat bahai adalee prabh aape bharam bhed bhau jaaee he ||10||
english: God Himself, the wise Judge, sits on the throne; He takes away doubt, duality and fear. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਜੀ ਆਪੇ ਮੁਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aape kaajee aape mulaa ||
english: He Himself is the Qazi; He Himself is the Mullah.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਭੁਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aap abhul na kabahoo bhulaa ||
english: He Himself is infallible; He never makes mistakes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਹਰ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੋ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: aape mihar daiaapat daataa naa kisai ko bairaaee he ||11||
english: He Himself is the Giver of Grace, compassion and honor; He is no one's enemy. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jis bakhase tis de vadiaaee ||
english: Whoever He forgives, He blesses with glorious greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਸੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sabhasai daataa til na tamaaee ||
english: He is the Giver of all; He does not have even an iota of greed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: bharapur dhaar rahiaa nihakeval gupat pragat sabh thaaee he ||12||
english: The Immaculate Lord is all pervading, permeating everywhere, both hidden and manifest. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kiaa saalaahee agam apaarai ||
english: How can I praise the inaccessible, infinite Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਮੁਰਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: saache sirajanahaar muraarai ||
english: The True Creator Lord is the Enemy of ego.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jis no nadar kare tis mele mel milai melaaee he ||13||
english: He unites those whom He blesses with His Grace; uniting them in His Union, they are united. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes duaarai ||
english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva stand at His Door;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਭੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: oobhe sevahi alakh apaarai ||
english: they serve the unseen, infinite Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਸੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: hor ketee dar deesai bilalaadee mai ganat na aavai kaaee he ||14||
english: Millions of others can be seen crying at His door; I cannot even estimate their numbers. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: saachee keerat saachee baanee ||
english: True is the Kirtan of His Praise, and True is the Word of His Bani.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: hor na deesai bed puraanee ||
english: I can see no other in the Vedas and the Puraanas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਹੋਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: poo(n)jee saach sache gun gaavaa mai dhar hor na kaaee he ||15||
english: Truth is my capital; I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. I have no other support at all. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jug jug saachaa hai bhee hosee ||
english: In each and every age, the True Lord is, and shall always be.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਨ ਮਰਸੀ ॥
transliteration: kaun na mooaa kaun na marasee ||
english: Who has not died? Who shall not die?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak neech kahai bena(n)tee dar dekhahu liv laaee he ||16||2||
english: Nanak the lowly offers this prayer; see Him within your own self, and lovingly focus on the Lord. ||16||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਨੀ ਬੋਲੀ ॥
transliteration: doojee duramat a(n)nee bolee ||
english: In duality and evil-mindedness, the soul-bride is blind and deaf.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੀ ਕਚੀ ਚੋਲੀ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh kee kachee cholee ||
english: She wears the dress of sexual desire and anger.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਛੋਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ghar var sahaj na jaanai chhohar bin pir need na paaee he ||1||
english: Her Husband Lord is within the home of her own heart, but she does not know Him; without her Husband Lord, she cannot go to sleep. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲੈ ਭੜਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar agan jalai bhaRakaare ||
english: The great fire of desire blazes within her.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਤਕੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh take ku(n)daa chaare ||
english: The self-willed manmukh looks around in the four directions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੇ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve kiu sukh paaeeai saache haath vadaaee he ||2||
english: Without serving the True Guru, how can she find peace? Glorious greatness rests in the hands of the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar nivaare ||
english: Eradicating sexual desire, anger and egotism,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tasakar pa(n)ch sabad sa(n)ghaare ||
english: she destroys the five thieves through the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਲੈ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: giaan khaRag lai man siu loojhai manasaa manahi samaaee he ||3||
english: Taking up the sword of spiritual wisdom, she struggles with her mind, and hope and desire are smoothed over in her mind. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾ ਕੀ ਰਕਤੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਿਦੁ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maa kee rakat pitaa bid dhaaraa ||
english: From the union of the mother's egg and the father's sperm,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸੂਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: moorat soorat kar aapaaraa ||
english: the form of infinite beauty has been created.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jot daat jetee sabh teree too karataa sabh thaaee he ||4||
english: The blessings of light all come from You; You are the Creator Lord, pervading everywhere. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: tujh hee keeaa ja(n)man maranaa ||
english: You have created birth and death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਮਝ ਪੜੀ ਕਿਆ ਡਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gur te samajh paRee kiaa daranaa ||
english: Why should anyone fear, if they come to understand through the Guru?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: too daiaal daiaa kar dekhahi dukh darad sareerahu jaaee he ||5||
english: When You, O Merciful Lord, look with Your kindness, then pain and suffering leave the body. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਭਉ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nij ghar bais rahe bhau khaaiaa ||
english: One who sits in the home of his own self, eats his own fears.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤ ਰਾਖੇ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat raakhe thaak rahaaiaa ||
english: He quiets and holds his wandering mind still.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸ ਹਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kamal bigaas hare sar subhar aatam raam sakhaaee he ||6||
english: His heart-lotus blossoms forth in the overflowing green pool, and the Lord of his soul becomes his companion and helper. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: maran likhaai ma(n)dal mahi aae ||
english: With their death already ordained, mortals come into this world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਚਲਣਾ ਪਰਥਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kiu raheeai chalanaa parathaae ||
english: How can they remain here? They have to go to the world beyond.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੇ ਅਮਰਾ ਪੁਰਿ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sachaa amar sache amaraa pur so sach milai vadaaee he ||7||
english: True is the Lord's Command; the true ones dwell in the eternal city. The True Lord blesses them with glorious greatness. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aap upaaiaa jagat sabaaiaa ||
english: He Himself created the whole world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin siriaa tin dha(n)dhai laaiaa ||
english: The One who made it, assigns the tasks to it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: sachai oopar avar na deesai saache keemat paaee he ||8||
english: I cannot see any other above the True Lord. The True Lord does the appraisal. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਗੋਇਲੜਾ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aithai goilaRaa din chaare ||
english: In this green pasture, the mortal stays only a few days.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੇਲੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: khel tamaasaa dhu(n)dhookaare ||
english: He plays and frolics in utter darkness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲਿ ਗਏ ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭਖਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: baajee khel gae baajeegar jiu nis supanai bhakhalaaee he ||9||
english: The jugglers have staged their show, and left, like people mumbling in a dream. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਤਖਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: tin kau takhat milee vadiaaee ||
english: They alone are blessed with glorious greatness at the Lord's throne,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau man vasiaa liv laaee ||
english: who enshrine the fearless Lord in their minds, and lovingly center themselves on Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੀ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਪੁਰੀਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: kha(n)dee brahama(n)dee paataalee pureeee tribhavan taaRee laaee he ||10||
english: In the galaxies and solar systems, nether regions, celestial realms and the three worlds, the Lord is in the primal void of deep absorption. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਤਖਤੁ ਸਚਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: saachee nagaree takhat sachaavaa ||
english: True is the village, and true is the throne,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saach milai sukh paavaa ||
english: of those Gurmukhs who meet with the True Lord, and find peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਗਵਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: saache saachai takhat vadaaee haumai ganat gavaaee he ||11||
english: In Truth, seated upon the true throne, they are blessed with glorious greatness; their egotism is eradicated, along with the calculation of their account. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀਐ ਸਹਸਾ ਜੀਐ ॥
transliteration: ganat ganeeai sahasaa jeeai ||
english: Calculating its account, the soul becomes anxious.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਦੂਐ ਤੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kiu sukh paavai dooai teeai ||
english: How can one find peace, through duality and the three gunas - the three qualities?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: niramal ek nira(n)jan daataa gur poore te pat paaee he ||12||
english: The One Lord is immaculate and formless, the Great Giver; through the Perfect Guru, honor is obtained. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jug jug viralee guramukh jaataa ||
english: In each and every age, very rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: saachaa rav rahiaa man raataa ||
english: Their minds are imbued with the True, all-pervading Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: tis kee ot gahee sukh paaiaa man tan mail na kaaee he ||13||
english: Seeking His Shelter, they find peace, and their minds and bodies are not stained with filth. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਭ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: jeebh rasaain saachai raatee ||
english: Their tongues are imbued with the True Lord, the source of nectar;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਭਉ ਨ ਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: har prabh sa(n)gee bhau na bharaatee ||
english: abiding with the Lord God, they have no fear or doubt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ਰਜੇ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: sravan srot raje gurabaanee jotee jot milaaee he ||14||
english: Hearing the Word of the Guru's Bani, their ears are satisfied, and their light merges into the Light. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪੈਰ ਧਰੇ ਪਉ ਧਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: rakh rakh pair dhare pau dharanaa ||
english: Carefully, carefully, I place my feet upon the ground.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jat kat dekhau teree saranaa ||
english: Wherever I go, I behold Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: dukh sukh dehi toohai man bhaavahi tujh hee siu ban aaee he ||15||
english: Whether You grant me pain or pleasure, You are pleasing to my mind. I am in harmony with You. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal ko belee naahee ||
english: No one is anyone's companion or helper at the very last moment;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jaataa tudh saalaahee ||
english: as Gurmukh, I realize You and praise You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laaee he ||16||3||
english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, I am detached; in the home of my own self deep within, I am absorbed in the primal void of deep meditation. ||16||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aad jugaadee apar apaare ||
english: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You are infinite and incomparable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aad nira(n)jan khasam hamaare ||
english: You are my primal, immaculate Lord and Master.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saache jog jugat veechaaree saache taaRee laaee he ||1||
english: I contemplate the Way of Yoga, the Way of Union with the True Lord. I am truly absorbed in the primal void of deep meditation. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ketaRiaa jug dhu(n)dhookaarai ||
english: For so many ages, there was only pitch darkness;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: taaRee laaee sirajanahaarai ||
english: the Creator Lord was absorbed in the primal void.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sach naam sachee vadiaaee saachai takhat vadaaee he ||2||
english: There was the True Name, the glorious greatness of the Truth, and the glory of His true throne. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: satajug sat sa(n)tokh sareeraa ||
english: In the Golden Age of Truth, Truth and contentment filled the bodies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sat sat varatai gahir ga(n)bheeraa ||
english: Truth was pervasive, Truth, deep, profound and unfathomable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਖੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib sach parakhai saachai hukam chalaaee he ||3||
english: The True Lord appraises the mortals on the Touchstone of Truth, and issues His True Command. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokhee satigur pooraa ||
english: The Perfect True Guru is true and contented.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨੇ ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad mane so sooraa ||
english: He alone is a spiritual hero, who believes in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: saachee daragah saach nivaasaa maanai hukam rajaaee he ||4||
english: He alone obtains a true seat in the True Court of the Lord, who surrenders to the Command of the Commander. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: satajug saach kahai sabh koee ||
english: In the Golden Age of Truth, everyone spoke the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sach varatai saachaa soee ||
english: Truth was pervasive - the Lord was Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: man mukh saach bharam bhau bha(n)jan guramukh saach sakhaaee he ||5||
english: With Truth in their minds and mouths, mortals were rid of doubt and fear. Truth was the friend of the Gurmukhs. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਧਰਮ ਕਲਾ ਇਕ ਚੂਕੀ ॥
transliteration: tretai dharam kalaa ik chookee ||
english: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yoga, one power of Dharma was lost.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਚਰਣ ਇਕ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸੂਕੀ ॥
transliteration: teen charan ik dubidhaa sookee ||
english: Three feet remained; through duality, one was cut off.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਚੈ ਅਵਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s saach vakhaanai manamukh pachai avaaee he ||6||
english: Those who were Gurmukh spoke the Truth, while the self-willed manmukhs wasted away in vain. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੀਝੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kade na daragah seejhai ||
english: The manmukh never succeeds in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਰੀਝੈ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai kiu a(n)tar reejhai ||
english: Without the Word of the Shabad, how can one be pleased within?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਧੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: baadhe aavahi baadhe jaavahi sojhee boojh na kaaee he ||7||
english: In bondage they come, and in bondage they go; they understand and comprehend nothing. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਅਧੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: daiaa duaapur adhee hoee ||
english: In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, compassion was cut in half.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਚੀਨੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralaa cheenai koee ||
english: Only a few, as Gurmukh, remembered the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਪਗ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਰੇ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: dui pag dharam dhare dharaneedhar guramukh saach tithaaee he ||8||
english: Dharmic faith, which upholds and supports the earth, had only two feet; Truth was revealed to the Gurmukhs. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਥਾਏ ॥
transliteration: raaje dharam karahi parathaae ||
english: The kings acted righteously only out of self-interest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਬੰਧੇ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aasaa ba(n)dhe daan karaae ||
english: Tied to hopes of reward, they gave to charities.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਥਾਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na hoee thaake karam kamaaee he ||9||
english: Without the Lord's Name, liberation did not come, although they grew weary of performing rituals. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮੰਗਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam kar mukat ma(n)gaahee ||
english: Practicing religious rituals, they sought liberation,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: mukat padaarath sabad salaahee ||
english: but the treasure of liberation comes only by praising the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: bin gurasabadai mukat na hoee parapa(n)ch kar bharamaaee he ||10||
english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, liberation is not obtained; practicing hypocrisy, they wander around confused. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਛੋਡੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mamataa chhodee na jaaee ||
english: Love and attachment to Maya cannot be abandoned.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਛੂਟੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: se chhoote sach kaar kamaaee ||
english: They alone find release, who practice deeds of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: ahinis bhagat rate veechaaree thaakur siu ban aaee he ||11||
english: Day and night, the devotees remain imbued with contemplative meditation; they become just like their Lord and Master. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik jap tap kar kar teerath naavahi ||
english: Some chant and practice intensive meditation, and take cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jiu tudh bhaavai tivai chalaavahi ||
english: They walk as You will them to walk.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਅਪਤੀਜੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: hath nigrahi apateej na bheejai bin har gur kin pat paaee he ||12||
english: By stubborn rituals of self-suppression, the Lord is not pleased. No one has ever obtained honor, without the Lord, without the Guru. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਇਕ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: kalee kaal mahi ik kal raakhee ||
english: In the Iron Age, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only one power remains.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਭਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: bin gur poore kinai na bhaakhee ||
english: Without the Perfect Guru, no one has even described it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: manamukh kooR varatai varataaraa bin satigur bharam na jaaee he ||13||
english: The self-willed manmukhs have staged the show of falsehood. Without the True Guru, doubt does not depart. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur veparavaahu sira(n)daa ||
english: The True Guru is the Creator Lord, independent and carefree.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਮ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਛੰਦਾ ਬੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: naa jam kaan na chha(n)daa ba(n)daa ||
english: He does not fear death, and He is not dependent on mortal men.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: jo tis seve so abinaasee naa tis kaal sa(n)taaee he ||14||
english: Whoever serves Him becomes immortal and imperishable, and will not be tortured by death. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur mahi aap rakhiaa karataare ||
english: The Creator Lord has enshrined Himself within the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh kot asa(n)kh udhaare ||
english: The Gurmukh saves countless millions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: sarab jeeaa jagajeevan daataa nirabhau mail na kaaee he ||15||
english: The Life of the World is the Great Giver of all beings. The Fearless Lord has no filth at all. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sagale jaachahi gur bha(n)daaree ||
english: Everyone begs from the Guru, God's Treasurer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aap nira(n)jan alakh apaaree ||
english: He Himself is the immaculate, unknowable, infinite Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚੈ ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak saach kahai prabh jaachai mai deejai saach rajaaee he ||16||4||
english: Nanak speaks the Truth; he begs from God. Please bless me with the Truth, by Your Will. ||16||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saachai mele sabad milaae ||
english: The True Lord unites with those who are united with the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jaa tis bhaanaa sahaj samaae ||
english: When it pleases Him, we intuitively merge with Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tribhavan jot dharee paramesar avar na doojaa bhaaee he ||1||
english: The Light of the Transcendent Lord pervades the three worlds; there is no other at all, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jis ke chaakar tis kee sevaa ||
english: I am His servant; I serve Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad pateejai alakh abhevaa ||
english: He is unknowable and mysterious; He is pleased by the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhagataa kaa gunakaaree karataa bakhas lae vadiaaee he ||2||
english: The Creator is the Benefactor of His devotees. He forgives them - such is His greatness. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
transliteration: dede tot na aavai saache ||
english: The True Lord gives and gives; His blessings never run short.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਲੈ ਮੁਕਰਿ ਪਉਦੇ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
transliteration: lai lai mukar paude kaache ||
english: The false ones receive, and then deny having received.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਨ ਰੀਝਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mool na boojhahi saach na reejhahi doojai bharam bhulaaee he ||3||
english: They do not understand their origins, they are not pleased with the Truth, and so they wander in duality and doubt. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jaag rahe din raatee ||
english: The Gurmukhs remain awake and aware, day and night.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: saache kee liv guramat jaatee ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, they know the Love of the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਸੇ ਲੂਟੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: manamukh soi rahe se loote guramukh saabat bhaaee he ||4||
english: The self-willed manmukhs remain asleep, and are plundered. The Gurmukhs remain safe and sound, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੇ ਆਵੈ ਕੂੜੇ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kooRe aavai kooRe jaavai ||
english: The false come, and the false go;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kooRe raatee kooR kamaavai ||
english: imbued with falsehood, they practice only falsehood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sabad mile se daragah paidhe guramukh surat samaaee he ||5||
english: Those who are imbued with the Shabad are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord; the Gurmukhs focus their consciousness on Him. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਠਗੀ ਠਗਵਾੜੀ ॥
transliteration: kooR muthee thagee thagavaaRee ||
english: The false are cheated, and robbed by the robbers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਵਾੜੀ ਓਜਾੜਿ ਉਜਾੜੀ ॥
transliteration: jiu vaaRee ojaaR ujaaRee ||
english: The garden is laid waste, like the rough wilderness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naam binaa kichh saad na laagai har bisariai dukh paaee he ||6||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, nothing tastes sweet; forgetting the Lord, they suffer in sorrow. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਘਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhojan saach milai aaghaaee ||
english: Receiving the food of Truth, one is satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: naam ratan saachee vadiaaee ||
english: True is the glorious greatness of the jewel of the Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: cheenai aap pachhaanai soee jotee jot milaaee he ||7||
english: One who understands his own self, realizes the Lord. His light merges into the Light. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲੀ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naavahu bhulee chotaa khaae ||
english: Wandering from the Name, he endures beatings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bahut siaanap bharam na jaae ||
english: Even great cleverness does not dispel doubt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਚੇਤ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਅਜਗਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਲਦਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: pach pach mue achet na chetahi ajagar bhaar ladaaee he ||8||
english: The unconscious fool does not remain conscious of the Lord; he putrifies and rots away to death, carrying his heavy load of sin. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਦ ਬਿਰੋਧਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: bin baad birodhahi koee naahee ||
english: No one is free of conflict and strife.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: mai dekhaalihu tis saalaahee ||
english: Show me anyone who is, and I will praise him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: man tan arap milai jagajeevan har siu banat banaaee he ||9||
english: Dedicating mind and body to God, one meets the Lord, the Life of the World, and becomes just like Him. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh kee gat mit koi na paavai ||
english: No one knows the state and extent of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਵਡਾ ਕਹਾਇ ਵਡਾਈ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: je ko vadaa kahaai vadaaee khaavai ||
english: Whoever calls himself great, will be eaten by his greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਦਾਤੀ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: saache saahib tot na daatee sagalee tinahi upaaee he ||10||
english: There is no lack of gifts of our True Lord and Master. He created all. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: vadee vadiaaee veparavaahe ||
english: Great is the glorious greatness of the independent Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਮਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: aap upaae daan samaahe ||
english: He Himself created, and gives sustanance to all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: aap daiaal door nahee daataa miliaa sahaj rajaaee he ||11||
english: The Merciful Lord is not far away; the Great Giver spontaneously unites with Himself, by His Will. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸੋਗੀ ਇਕਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: ik sogee ik rog viaape ||
english: Some are sad, and some are afflicted with disease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh kare s aape aape ||
english: Whatever God does, He does by Himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਅਨਹਦਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: bhagat bhaau gur kee mat pooree anahad sabad lakhaaee he ||12||
english: Through loving devotion, and the Perfect Teachings of the Guru, the unstruck sound current of the Shabad is realized. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਨਾਗੇ ਭੂਖੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਭਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ik naage bhookhe bhavahi bhavaae ||
english: Some wander and roam around, hungry and naked.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਹਠੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ik hath kar marahi na keemat paae ||
english: Some act in stubbornness and die, but do not know the value of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਅਵਿਗਤ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: gat avigat kee saar na jaanai boojhai sabad kamaaee he ||13||
english: They do not know the difference between good and bad; this is understood only through the practice of the Word of the Shabad. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik teerath naavahi a(n)n na khaavahi ||
english: Some bathe at sacred shrines and refuse to eat.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਵਹਿ ਦੇਹ ਖਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik agan jalaavahi deh khapaavahi ||
english: Some torment their bodies in burning fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na hoee kit bidh paar la(n)ghaaee he ||14||
english: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not obtained; how can anyone cross over? ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਉਝੜਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramat chhodahi ujhaR jaaee ||
english: Abandoning the Guru's Teachings, some wander in the wilderness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh raam na japai avaaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are destitute; they do not meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਬੂਡਹਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: pach pach boodahi kooR kamaavahi kooR kaal bairaaee he ||15||
english: They are ruined, destroyed and drowned from practicing falsehood; death is the enemy of the false. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hukame aavai hukame jaavai ||
english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they come, and by the Hukam of His Command, they go.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: boojhai hukam so saach samaavai ||
english: One who realizes His Hukam, merges in the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak saach milai man bhaavai guramukh kaar kamaaee he ||16||5||
english: O Nanak, he merges in the True Lord, and his mind is pleased with the Lord. The Gurmukhs do His work. ||16||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa purakh bidhaataa ||
english: He Himself is the Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jin aape aap upaai pachhaataa ||
english: He evaluates those whom He Himself has created.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape satigur aape sevak aape srisat upaaee he ||1||
english: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the servant; He Himself created the Universe. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aape neRai naahee doore ||
english: He is near at hand, not far away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: boojhahi guramukh se jan poore ||
english: The Gurmukhs understand Him; perfect are those humble beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਏਹ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin kee sa(n)gat ahinis laahaa gur sa(n)gat eh vadaaee he ||2||
english: Associating with them night and day is profitable. This is the glorious greatness of associating with the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jug jug sa(n)t bhale prabh tere ||
english: Throughout the ages, Your Saints are holy and sublime, O God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavahi rasan rasere ||
english: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, savoring it with their tongues.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: usatat karahi parahar dukh daalad jin naahee chi(n)t paraaee he ||3||
english: They chant His Praises, and their pain and poverty are taken away; they are not afraid of anyone else. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਨ ਸੂਤੇ ਦੀਸਹਿ ॥
transliteration: oi jaagat rahahi na soote deesahi ||
english: They remain awake and aware, and do not appear to sleep.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਸਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)gat kul taare saach pareesahi ||
english: They serve up Truth, and so save their companions and relatives.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਓਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kalimal mail naahee te niramal oi rahahi bhagat liv laaee he ||4||
english: They are not stained with the filth of sins; they are immaculate and pure, and remain absorbed in loving devotional worship. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: boojhahu har jan satigur baanee ||
english: O humble servants of the Lord, understand the Word of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: ehu joban saas hai deh puraanee ||
english: This youth, breath and body shall pass away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aaj kaal mar jaaeeai praanee har jap jap ridai dhiaaee he ||5||
english: O mortal, you shall die today or tomorrow; chant, and meditate on the Lord within your heart. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕੂੜ ਕਬਾੜਾ ॥
transliteration: chhodahu praanee kooR kabaaRaa ||
english: O mortal, abandon falsehood and your worthless ways.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਉਛਾਹਾੜਾ ॥
