transliteration: kooR maare kaal uchhaahaaRaa ||
english: Death viciously kills the false beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜਿ ਪਚਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saakat kooR pachahi man haumai duhu maarag pachai pachaaee he ||6||
english: The faithless cynic is ruined through falsehood and his egotistical mind.On the path of duality, he rots away and decomposes. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿਹੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: chhodihu ni(n)daa taat paraaee ||
english: Abandon slander and envy of others.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਸਾਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: paR paR dajhahi saat na aaee ||
english: Reading and studying, they burn, and do not find tranquility.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਹੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat naam salaahahu aatam raam sakhaaee he ||7||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Lord, the Supreme Soul, shall be your helper and companion. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: chhodahu kaam krodh buriaaee ||
english: Abandon sexual desire, anger and wickedness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਧੰਧੁ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਲੰਪਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: haumai dha(n)dh chhodahu la(n)pataaee ||
english: Abandon your involvement in egotistical affairs and conflicts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹੁ ਇਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: satigur saran parahu taa ubarahu iu tareeai bhavajal bhaaee he ||8||
english: If you seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru, then you shall be saved. In this way you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਬਿਮਲ ਨਦੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਝੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aagai bimal nadee agan bikh jhelaa ||
english: In the hereafter, you shall have to cross over the fiery river of poisonous flames.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: tithai avar na koee jeeu ikelaa ||
english: No one else will be there; your soul shall be all alone.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੜ ਭੜ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੇ ਲਹਰੀ ਪੜਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: bhaR bhaR agan saagar de laharee paR dajhahi manamukh taaee he ||9||
english: The ocean of fire spits out waves of searing flames; the self-willed manmukhs fall into it, and are roasted there. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gur pahi mukat daan de bhaanai ||
english: Liberation comes from the Guru; He grants this blessing by the Pleasure of His Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jin paaiaa soee bidh jaanai ||
english: He alone knows the way, who obtains it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: jin paaiaa tin poochhahu bhaaee sukh satigur sev kamaaee he ||10||
english: So ask one who has obtained it, O Siblings of Destiny. Serve the True Guru, and find peace. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਰਝਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਬੇਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur bin urajh marahi bekaaraa ||
english: Without the Guru, he dies entangled in sin and corruption.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jam sir maare kare khuaaraa ||
english: The Messenger of Death smashes his head and humiliates him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਧੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਡੂਬਹਿ ਨਿੰਦ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: baadhe mukat naahee nar ni(n)dak doobahi ni(n)d paraaee he ||11||
english: The slanderous person is not freed of his bonds; he is drowned, slandering others. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ॥
transliteration: bolahu saach pachhaanahu a(n)dar ||
english: So speak the Truth, and realize the Lord deep within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਨੰਦਰਿ ॥
transliteration: door naahee dekhahu kar na(n)dar ||
english: He is not far away; look, and see Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਇਉ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: bighan naahee guramukh tar taaree iu bhavajal paar la(n)ghaaee he ||12||
english: No obstacles shall block your way; become Gurmukh, and cross over to the other side. This is the way to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: dehee a(n)dar naam nivaasee ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਹੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa hai abinaasee ||
english: The Creator Lord is eternal and imperishable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naa jeeu marai na maariaa jaaee kar dekhai sabad rajaaee he ||13||
english: The soul does not die, and it cannot be killed; God creates and watches over all. Through the Word of the Shabad, His Will is manifest. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ohu niramal hai naahee a(n)dhiaaraa ||
english: He is immaculate, and has no darkness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹੈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ohu aape takhat bahai sachiaaraa ||
english: The True Lord Himself sits upon His throne.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਆਈ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: saakat kooRe ba(n)dh bhavaaeeahi mar janamahi aaee jaaee he ||14||
english: The faithless cynics are bound and gagged, and forced to wander in reincarnation. They die, and are reborn, and continue coming and going. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur ke sevak satigur piaare ||
english: The Guru's servants are the Beloveds of the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਤਖਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: oi baisahi takhat s sabad veechaare ||
english: Contemplating the Shabad, they sit upon His throne.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: tat lahahi a(n)taragat jaanahi satasa(n)gat saach vadaaee he ||15||
english: They realize the essence of reality, and know the state of their inner being. This is the true glorious greatness of those who join the Sat Sangat. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਪਿਤਰਾ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aap tarai jan pitaraa taare ||
english: He Himself saves His humble servant, and saves his ancestors as well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)gat mukat s paar utaare ||
english: His companions are liberated; He carries them across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak tis kaa laalaa golaa jin guramukh har liv laaee he ||16||6||
english: Nanak is the servant and slave of that Gurmukh who lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Lord. ||16||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਵਰਤੇ ਗੁਬਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: kete jug varate gubaarai ||
english: For many ages, only darkness prevailed;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: taaRee laaee apar apaarai ||
english: the infinite, endless Lord was absorbed in the primal void.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhu(n)dhookaar niraalam baithaa naa tad dha(n)dh pasaaraa he ||1||
english: He sat alone and unaffected in absolute darkness; the world of conflict did not exist. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਛਤੀਹ ਤਿਨੈ ਵਰਤਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jug chhateeh tinai varataae ||
english: Thirty-six ages passed like this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jiu tis bhaanaa tivai chalaae ||
english: He causes all to happen by the Pleasure of His Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tisahi sareek na deesai koee aape apar apaaraa he ||2||
english: No rival of His can be seen. He Himself is infinite and endless. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤੇ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਚਤੁਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gupate boojhahu jug chatuaare ||
english: God is hidden throughout the four ages - understand this well.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat varatai udar majhaare ||
english: He pervades each and every heart, and is contained within the belly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕਾ ਏਕੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jug jug ekaa ekee varatai koee boojhai gur veechaaraa he ||3||
english: The One and Only Lord prevails throughout the ages. How rare are those who contemplate the Guru, and understand this. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਰਕਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: bi(n)d rakat mil pi(n)d sareeaa ||
english: From the union of the sperm and the egg, the body was formed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: paun paanee aganee mil jeeaa ||
english: From the union of air, water and fire, the living being is made.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਚੋਜ ਕਰੇ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ ਹੋਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aape choj kare ra(n)g mahalee hor maaiaa moh pasaaraa he ||4||
english: He Himself plays joyfully in the mansion of the body; all the rest is just attachment to Maya's expanse. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਧਿਆਨੀ ॥
transliteration: garabh ku(n)dal mahi uradh dhiaanee ||
english: Within the mother's womb, upside-down, the mortal meditated on God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: aape jaanai a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: saas saas sach naam samaale a(n)tar udar majhaaraa he ||5||
english: With each and every breath, he contemplated the True Name, deep within himself, within the womb. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲੈ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: chaar padaarath lai jag aaiaa ||
english: He came into the world to obtain the four great blessings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: siv sakatee ghar vaasaa paaiaa ||
english: He came to dwell in the home of the Shiva and Shakti, energy and matter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਪਿੜ ਹਾਰੇ ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ek visaare taa piR haare a(n)dhulai naam visaaraa he ||6||
english: But he forgot the One Lord, and he has lost the game. The blind person forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲਕੁ ਮਰੈ ਬਾਲਕ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ॥
transliteration: baalak marai baalak kee leelaa ||
english: The child dies in his childish games.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਬਾਲੁ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kahi kahi rovahi baal ra(n)geelaa ||
english: They cry and mourn, saying that he was such a playful child.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਸੋ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਲੀਆ ਭੂਲਾ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jis kaa saa so tin hee leeaa bhoolaa rovanahaaraa he ||7||
english: The Lord who owns him has taken him back. Those who weep and mourn are mistaken. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: bhar joban mar jaahi k keejai ||
english: What can they do, if he dies in his youth?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਰੋਵੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: meraa meraa kar roveejai ||
english: They cry out, "His is mine, he is mine!"

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਰੋਇ ਵਿਗੂਚਹਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: maaiaa kaaran roi vigoochahi dhrig jeevan sa(n)saaraa he ||8||
english: They cry for the sake of Maya, and are ruined; their lives in this world are cursed. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੀ ਹੂ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਉਲੇ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: kaalee hoo phun dhaule aae ||
english: Their black hair eventually turns grey.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਗਥੁ ਗਇਆ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai gath gaiaa gavaae ||
english: Without the Name, they lose their wealth, and then leave.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਮੂਠੇ ਰੋਇ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: duramat a(n)dhulaa binas binaasai moothe roi pookaaraa he ||9||
english: They are evil-minded and blind - they are totally ruined; they are plundered, and cry out in pain. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aap veechaar na rovai koee ||
english: One who understands himself, does not cry.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta sojhee hoee ||
english: When he meets the True Guru, then he understands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਨ ਖੂਲਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: bin gur bajar kapaat na khoolahi sabad milai nisataaraa he ||10||
english: Without the Guru, the heavy, hard doors are not opened. Obtaining the Word of the Shabad, one is emancipated. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: biradh bhaiaa tan chheejai dehee ||
english: The body grows old, and is beaten out of shape.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: raam na japaee a(n)t sanehee ||
english: But he does not meditate on the Lord, His only friend, even at the end.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naam visaar chalai muhi kaalai daragah jhooth khuaaraa he ||11||
english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he departs with his face blackened. The false are humiliated in the Court of the Lord. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੋ ॥
transliteration: naam visaar chalai kooRiaaro ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, the false ones depart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਪੜੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: aavat jaat paRai sir chhaaro ||
english: Coming and going, dust falls on their heads.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: saahuraRai ghar vaas na paae peeeaRai sir maaraa he ||12||
english: The soul-bride finds no home in her in-laws' home, the world hereafter; she suffers in agony in this world of her parents' home. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਜੈ ਪੈਝੈ ਰਲੀ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: khaajai paijhai ralee kareejai ||
english: She eats, dresses and plays joyfully,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਅਭ ਭਗਤੀ ਬਾਦਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: bin abh bhagatee baad mareejai ||
english: but without loving devotional worship of the Lord, she dies uselessly.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰ ਅਪਸਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: sar apasar kee saar na jaanai jam maare kiaa chaaraa he ||13||
english: One who does not distinguish between good and evil, is beaten by the Messenger of Death; how can anyone escape this? ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਿਰਤੀ ਨਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: paraviratee naravirat pachhaanai ||
english: One who realizes what he has to possess, and what he has to abandon,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sa(n)g sabad ghar jaanai ||
english: associating with the Guru, comes to know the Word of the Shabad, within the home of his own self.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਮੰਦਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਸਚਿ ਖਰਾ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: kis hee ma(n)daa aakh na chalai sach kharaa sachiaaraa he ||14||
english: Do not call anyone else bad; follow this way of life. Those who are true are judged to be genuine by the True Lord. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨਾ ਦਰਿ ਸਿਝੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: saach binaa dar sijhai na koee ||
english: Without Truth, no one succeeds in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਪੈਝੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: saach sabad paijhai pat hoee ||
english: Through the True Shabad, one is robed in honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: aape bakhas lae tis bhaavai haumai garab nivaaraa he ||15||
english: He forgives those with whom He is pleased; they silence their egotism and pride. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te hukam pachhaanai ||
english: One who realizes the Hukam of God's Command, by the Grace of the Guru,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jugah juga(n)tar kee bidh jaanai ||
english: comes to know the lifestyle of the ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak naam japahu tar taaree sach taare taaranahaaraa he ||16||1||7||
english: O Nanak, chant the Naam, and cross over to the other side. The True Lord will carry you across. ||16||1||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har saa meet naahee mai koee ||
english: I have no other friend like the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jin tan man deeaa surat samoee ||
english: He gave me body and mind, and infused consciousness into my being.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sarab jeeaa pratipaal samaale so a(n)tar daanaa beenaa he ||1||
english: He cherishes and cares for all beings; He is deep within, the wise, all-knowing Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਹਮ ਹੰਸ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur saravar ham ha(n)s piaare ||
english: The Guru is the sacred pool, and I am His beloved swan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saagar mahi ratan laal bahu saare ||
english: In the ocean, there are so many jewels and rubies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਤੀ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: motee maanak heeraa har jas gaavat man tan bheenaa he ||2||
english: The Lord's Praises are pearls, gems and diamonds. Singing His Praises, my mind and body are drenched with His Love. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹੁ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: har agam agaahu agaadh niraalaa ||
english: The Lord is inaccessible, inscrutable, unfathomable and unattached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)t na paaeeai gur gopaalaa ||
english: The Lord's limits cannot be found; the Guru is the Lord of the World.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਰੰਗਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur mat taare taaranahaaraa mel lae ra(n)g leenaa he ||3||
english: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, the Lord carries us across to the other side. He unites in His Union those who are colored by His Love. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur baajhahu mukat kinehee ||
english: Without the True Guru, how can anyone be liberated?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ohu aad jugaadee raam sanehee ||
english: He has been the Friend of the Lord, from the very beginning of time, and all throughout the ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਬਖਸੇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: daragah mukat kare kar kirapaa bakhase avagun keenaa he ||4||
english: By His Grace, He grants liberation in His Court; He forgives them for their sins. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur daataa mukat karaae ||
english: The True Guru, the Giver, grants liberation;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabh rog gavaae a(n)mrit ras paae ||
english: all diseases are eradicated, and one is blessed with the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਠਰੁ ਸੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jam jaagaat naahee kar laagai jis agan bujhee thar seenaa he ||5||
english: Death, the tax collector, does not impose any tax on one whose inner fire has been put out, whose heart is cool and tranquil. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa ha(n)s preet bahu dhaaree ||
english: The body has developed a great love for the soul-swan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਓਹ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ohu jogee purakh oh su(n)dar naaree ||
english: He is a Yogi, and she is a beautiful woman.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਗੈ ਚੋਜ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਤੈ ਮਤਾ ਨ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ahinis bhogai choj binodee uth chalatai mataa na keenaa he ||6||
english: Day and night, he enjoys her with delight, and then he arises and departs without consulting her. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: srisat upaai rahe prabh chhaajai ||
english: Creating the Universe, God remains diffused throughout it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: paun paanee baisa(n)tar gaajai ||
english: In the wind, water and fire, He vibrates and resounds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: manooaa dolai doot sa(n)gat mil so paae jo kichh keenaa he ||7||
english: The mind wavers, keeping company with evil passions; one obtains the rewards of his own actions. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਦੋਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: naam visaar dokh dukh saheeai ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, one suffers the misery of his evil ways.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਚਲਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: hukam bhaiaa chalanaa kiu raheeai ||
english: When the order to depart is issued, how can he remain here?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਗੋਤੇ ਖਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: narak koop mahi gote khaavai jiu jal te baahar meenaa he ||8||
english: He falls into the pit of hell, and suffers like a fish out of water. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਨਰਕ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਭੋਗਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: chauraaseeh narak saakat bhogaaeeai ||
english: The faithless cynic has to endure 8.4 million hellish incarnations.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਕੀਚੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: jaisaa keechai taiso paaeeai ||
english: As he acts, so does he suffer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: satigur baajhahu mukat na hoee kirat baadhaa gras deenaa he ||9||
english: Without the True Guru, there is no liberation. Bound and gagged by his own actions, he is helpless. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡੇ ਧਾਰ ਗਲੀ ਅਤਿ ਭੀੜੀ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)de dhaar galee at bheeRee ||
english: This path is very narrow, like the sharp edge of a sword.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਤਿਲ ਜਿਉ ਪੀੜੀ ॥
transliteration: lekhaa leejai til jiu peeRee ||
english: When his account is read, he shall be crushed like the sesame seed in the mill.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: maat pitaa kalatr sut belee naahee bin har ras mukat na keenaa he ||10||
english: Mother, father, spouse and child - none is anyone's friend in the end. Without the Lord's Love, no one is liberated. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਸਖੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਗ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: meet sakhe kete jag maahee ||
english: You may have many friends and companions in the world,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: bin gur paramesar koee naahee ||
english: but without the Guru, the Transcendent Lord Incarnate, there is no one at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa mukat paraain anadin keeratan keenaa he ||11||
english: Service to the Guru is the way to liberation. Night and day, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kooR chhod saache kau dhaavahu ||
english: Abandon falsehood, and pursue the Truth,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jo ichhahu soee phal paavahu ||
english: and you shall obtain the fruits of your desires.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਵਖਰ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: saach vakhar ke vaapaaree virale lai laahaa saudaa keenaa he ||12||
english: Very few are those who trade in the merchandise of Truth. Those who deal in it, obtain the true profit. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਲਹੁ ॥
transliteration: har har naam vakhar lai chalahu ||
english: Depart with the merchandise of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਹਲਹੁ ॥
transliteration: darasan paavahu sahaj mahalahu ||
english: and you shall intuitively obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, in the Mansion of His Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਇਉ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਚੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: guramukh khoj lahahi jan poore iu samadarasee cheenaa he ||13||
english: The Gurmukhs search for Him and find Him; they are the perfect humble beings. In this way, they see Him, who looks upon all alike. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: prabh bea(n)t guramat ko paavahi ||
english: God is endless; following the Guru's Teachings, some find Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad man kau samajhaavahi ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they instruct their minds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਇਉ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੈ ਲੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: satigur kee baanee sat sat kar maanahu iu aatam raamai leenaa he ||14||
english: Accept as True, Perfectly True, the Word of the True Guru's Bani. In this way, you shall merge in the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦ ਸਾਰਦ ਸੇਵਕ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naarad saarad sevak tere ||
english: Naarad and Saraswati are Your servants.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਵਡਹੁ ਵਡੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tribhavan sevak vadahu vadere ||
english: Your servants are the greatest of the great, throughout the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: sabh teree kudarat too sir sir daataa sabh tero kaaran keenaa he ||15||
english: Your creative power permeates all; You are the Great Giver of all. You created the whole creation. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਦਰਦੁ ਵਞਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ik dar sevahi darad vanjaae ||
english: Some serve at Your Door, and their sufferings are dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
transliteration: oi daragah paidhe satiguroo chhadaae ||
english: They are robed with honor in the Court of the Lord, and emancipated by the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੋੜੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਚਲਣਿ ਨ ਦੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: haumai ba(n)dhan satigur toRe chit cha(n)chal chalan na deenaa he ||16||
english: The True Guru breaks the bonds of egotism, and restrains the fickle consciousness. ||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਚੀਨਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur milahu cheenahu bidh saaee ||
english: Meet the True Guru, and search for the way,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jit prabh paavahu ganat na kaaee ||
english: by which you may find God, and not have to answer for your account.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੨॥੮॥
transliteration: haumai maar karahu gur sevaa jan naanak har ra(n)g bheenaa he ||17||2||8||
english: Subdue your egotism, and serve the Guru; O servant Nanak, you shall be drenched with the Lord's Love. ||17||2||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੁਰ ਸਘਾਰਣ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: asur saghaaran raam hamaaraa ||
english: My Lord is the Destroyer of demons.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat ramaeeaa raam piaaraa ||
english: My Beloved Lord is pervading each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਲੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਮੂਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naale alakh na lakheeai moole guramukh likh veechaaraa he ||1||
english: The unseen Lord is always with us, but He is not seen at all. The Gurmukh contemplates the record. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saadhoo saran tumaaree ||
english: The Holy Gurmukh seeks Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh paar utaaree ||
english: God grants His Grace, and carries him across to the other side.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਗਹਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: agan paanee saagar at gaharaa gur satigur paar utaaraa he ||2||
english: The ocean is very deep, filled with fiery water; the Guru, the True Guru, carries us across to the other side. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhule sojhee naahee ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukh does not understand.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: aavahi jaahi marahi mar jaahee ||
english: He comes and goes in reincarnation, dying, and dying again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਖੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa lekh na mitaee jam dar a(n)dh khuaaraa he ||3||
english: The primal inscription of destiny cannot be erased. The spiritually blind suffer terribly at Death's door. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik aavahi jaavahi ghar vaas na paavahi ||
english: Some come and go, and do not find a home in their own heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤ ਕੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kirat ke baadhe paap kamaavahi ||
english: Bound by their past actions, they commit sins.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਲੋਭੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: a(n)dhule sojhee boojh na kaaee lobh buraa aha(n)kaaraa he ||4||
english: The blind ones have no understanding, no wisdom; they are trapped and ruined by greed and egotism. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਸੀਗਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pir bin kiaa tis dhan seegaaraa ||
english: Without her Husband Lord, what good are the soul-bride's decorations?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਪਿਰ ਰਾਤੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: par pir raatee khasam visaaraa ||
english: She has forgotten her Lord and Master, and is infatuated with another's husband.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੇਸੁਆ ਪੂਤ ਬਾਪੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਤਿਉ ਫੋਕਟ ਕਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jiu besuaa poot baap ko kaheeai tiu phokat kaar vikaaraa he ||5||
english: Just as no one knows who is the father of the prostitute's son, such are the worthless, useless deeds that are done. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਪਿੰਜਰ ਮਹਿ ਦੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: pret pi(n)jar mahi dookh ghanere ||
english: The ghost, in the body-cage, suffers all sorts of afflictions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕਿ ਪਚਹਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: narak pachahi agiaan a(n)dhere ||
english: Those who are blind to spiritual wisdom, putrefy in hell.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: dharam raai kee baakee leejai jin har kaa naam visaaraa he ||6||
english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma collects the balance due on the account, of those who forget the Name of the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਤਪੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਝਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sooraj tapai agan bikh jhaalaa ||
english: The scorching sun blazes with flames of poison.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਤੁ ਪਸੂ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: apat pasoo manamukh betaalaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is dishonored, a beast, a demon.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਬੁਰਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa kooR kamaavahi rog buraa buriaaraa he ||7||
english: Trapped by hope and desire, he practices falsehood, and is afflicted by the terrible disease of corruption. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਰੁ ਕਲਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: masatak bhaar kalar sir bhaaraa ||
english: He carries the heavy load of sins on his forehead and head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਲੰਘਸਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kiu kar bhavajal la(n)ghas paaraa ||
english: How can he cross the terrifying world-ocean?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: satigur bohith aad jugaadee raam naam nisataaraa he ||8||
english: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, the True Guru has been the boat; through the Lord's Name, He carries us across. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਜਗਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: putr kalatr jag het piaaraa ||
english: The love of one's children and spouse is so sweet in this world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu pasariaa paasaaraa ||
english: The expansive expanse of the Universe is attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੋੜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: jam ke phaahe satigur toRe guramukh tat beechaaraa he ||9||
english: The True Guru snaps the noose of Death, for that Gurmukh who contemplates the essence of reality. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਰਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kooR muthee chaalai bahu raahee ||
english: Cheated by falsehood, the self-willed manmukh walks along many paths;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਦਾਝੈ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: manamukh daajhai paR paR bhaahee ||
english: he may be highly educated, but he burns in the fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam guroo vad daanaa naam japahu sukh saaraa he ||10||
english: The Guru is the Great Giver of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. Chanting the Naam, sublime peace is obtained. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur tuthaa sach driRaae ||
english: The True Guru, in His Mercy, implants Truth within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabh dukh mete maarag paae ||
english: All suffering is eradicated, and one is placed on the Path.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੰਡਾ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਗਡਈ ਮੂਲੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: ka(n)daa paai na gadaee moole jis satigur raakhanahaaraa he ||11||
english: Not even a thorn ever pierces the foot of one who has the True Guru as his Protector. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲੈ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: khehoo kheh ralai tan chheejai ||
english: Dust mixes with dust, when the body wastes away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਪਾਥਰੁ ਸੈਲੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh paathar sail na bheejai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is like a stone slab, which is impervious to water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: karan palaav kare bahutere narak surag avataaraa he ||12||
english: He cries out and weeps and wails; he is reincarnated into heaven and then hell. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa bikh bhuia(n)gam naale ||
english: They live with the poisonous snake of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਨਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਘਰ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਗਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: in dubidhaa ghar bahute gaale ||
english: This duality has ruined so many homes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: satigur baajhahu preet na upajai bhagat rate pateeaaraa he ||13||
english: Without the True Guru, love does not well up. Imbued with devotional worship, the soul is satisfied. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: saakat maaiaa kau bahu dhaavahi ||
english: The faithless cynics chase after Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naam visaar kahaa sukh paavahi ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, how can they find peace?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਖਪਹਿ ਖਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: trihu gun a(n)tar khapahi khapaavahi naahee paar utaaraa he ||14||
english: In the three qualities, they are destroyed; they cannot cross over to the other side. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂਕਰ ਸੂਕਰ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kookar sookar kaheeahi kooRiaaraa ||
english: The false are called pigs and dogs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਉਕਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਭਉ ਭਉ ਭਉਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhauk marahi bhau bhau bhauhaaraa ||
english: They bark themselves to death; they bark and bark and howl in fear.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: man tan jhoothe kooR kamaavahi duramat daragah haaraa he ||15||
english: False in mind and body, they practice falsehood; through their evil-mindedness, they lose out in the Court of the Lord. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਮਨੂਆ ਟੇਕੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta manooaa tekai ||
english: Meeting the True Guru, the mind is stabilized.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇਕੈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam de saran parekai ||
english: One who seeks His Sanctuary is blessed with the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: har dhan naam amolak devai har jas daragah piaaraa he ||16||
english: They are given the priceless wealth of the Lord's Name; singing His Praises, they are His beloveds in His court. ||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam saadhoo saranaaee ||
english: In the Sanctuary of the Holy, chant the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur bachanee gat mit paaee ||
english: Through the True Guru's Teachings, one comes to know His state and extent.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੩॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak har jap har man mere har mele melanahaaraa he ||17||3||9||
english: Nanak: chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; the Lord, the Uniter, shall unite you with Himself. ||17||3||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਗਧ ਇਆਨੇ ॥
transliteration: ghar rahu re man mugadh iaane ||
english: Remain in your own home, O my foolish and ignorant mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਧਿਆਨੇ ॥
transliteration: raam japahu a(n)taragat dhiaane ||
english: Meditate on the Lord - concentrate deep within your being and meditate on Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚ ਛੋਡਿ ਰਚਹੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਇਉ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: laalach chhod rachahu apara(n)par iu paavahu mukat duaaraa he ||1||
english: Renounce your greed, and merge with the infinite Lord. In this way, you shall find the door of liberation. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਿਐ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਣਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jis bisariai jam johan laagai ||
english: If you forget Him, the Messenger of Death will catch sight of you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਦੁਖਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਗੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh sukh jaahi dukhaa phun aagai ||
english: All peace will be gone, and you will suffer in pain in the world hereafter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਏਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam naam jap guramukh jeeaRe ehu param tat veechaaraa he ||2||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord as Gurmukh, O my soul; this is the supreme essence of contemplation. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: har har naam japahu ras meethaa ||
english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the sweetest essence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har ras a(n)tar deethaa ||
english: As Gurmukh, see the essence of the Lord deep within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਹਹੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਏਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ahinis raam rahahu ra(n)g raate ehu jap tap sa(n)jam saaraa he ||3||
english: Day and night, remain imbued with the Lord's Love. This is the essence of all chanting, deep meditation and self-discipline. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬੋਲਹੁ ॥
transliteration: raam naam gur bachanee bolahu ||
english: Speak the Guru's Word, and the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਟੋਲਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa mahi ihu ras tolahu ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, search for this essence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਗਰਭ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramat khoj lahahu ghar apanaa bahuR na garabh majhaaraa he ||4||
english: Follow the Guru's Teachings - seek and find the home of your own self, and you shall never be consigned to the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sach teerath naavahu har gun gaavahu ||
english: Bathe at the sacred shrine of Truth, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: tat veechaarahu har liv laavahu ||
english: Reflect upon the essence of reality, and lovingly focus your consciousness on the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: a(n)t kaal jam johi na saakai har bolahu raam piaaraa he ||5||
english: At the very last moment, the Messenger of Death will not be able to touch you, if you chant the Name of the Beloved Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur purakh daataa vad daanaa ||
english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, the Great Giver, is all-knowing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jis a(n)tar saach s sabad samaanaa ||
english: Whoever has Truth within himself, merges in the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਭੈ ਭਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jis kau satigur mel milaae tis chookaa jam bhai bhaaraa he ||6||
english: One whom the True Guru unites in Union, is rid of the overpowering fear of death. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch tat mil kaaiaa keenee ||
english: The body is formed from the union of the five elements.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਲੈ ਚੀਨੀ ॥
transliteration: tis mahi raam ratan lai cheenee ||
english: Know that the Lord's jewel is within it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aatam raam raam hai aatam har paaeeai sabad veechaaraa he ||7||
english: The soul is the Lord, and the Lord is the soul; contemplating the Shabad, the Lord is found. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh rahahu jan bhaaee ||
english: Abide in truth and contentment, O humble Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: khimaa gahahu satigur saranaaee ||
english: Hold tight to compassion and the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਪਰਾਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: aatam cheen paraatam cheenahu gur sa(n)gat ihu nisataaraa he ||8||
english: Know your soul, and know the Supreme Soul; associating with the Guru, you shall be emancipated. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜ ਕਪਟ ਮਹਿ ਟੇਕਾ ॥
transliteration: saakat kooR kapat mahi tekaa ||
english: The faithless cynics are stuck in falsehood and deceit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
transliteration: ahinis ni(n)daa karahi anekaa ||
english: Day and night, they slander many others.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਰਕ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: bin simaran aavahi phun jaavahi grabh jonee narak majhaaraa he ||9||
english: Without meditative remembrance, they come and then go, and are cast into the hellish womb of reincarnation. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ॥
transliteration: saakat jam kee kaan na chookai ||
english: The faithless cynic is not rid of his fear of death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਮੂਕੈ ॥
transliteration: jam kaa da(n)d na kabahoo mookai ||
english: The Messenger of Death's club is never taken away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਕੀ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਫਰਿਓ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: baakee dharam raai kee leejai sir aphario bhaar aphaaraa he ||10||
english: He has to answer to the Righteous Judge of Dharma for the account of his actions; the egotistical being carries the unbearable load. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bin gur saakat kahahu ko tariaa ||
english: Tell me: without the Guru, what faithless cynic has been saved?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai karataa bhavajal pariaa ||
english: Acting egotistically, he falls into the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: bin gur paar na paavai koee har japeeai paar utaaraa he ||11||
english: Without the Guru, no one is saved; meditating on the Lord, they are carried across to the other side. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur kee daat na metai koee ||
english: No one can erase the Guru's blessings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jis bakhase tis taare soee ||
english: The Lord carries across those whom He forgives.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh neR na aavai man so prabh apar apaaraa he ||12||
english: The pains of birth and death do not even approach those whose minds are filled with God, the infinite and endless. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਆਵਹੁ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: gur te bhoole aavahu jaavahu ||
english: Those who forget the Guru come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: janam marahu phun paap kamaavahu ||
english: They are born, only to die again, and continue committing sins.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਅਚੇਤ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: saakat mooR achet na chetahi dukh laagai taa raam pukaaraa he ||13||
english: The unconscious, foolish, faithless cynic does not remember the Lord; but when he is stricken with pain, then he cries out for the Lord. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ॥
transliteration: sukh dukh purab janam ke keee ||
english: Pleasure and pain are the consequences of the actions of past lives.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਦੀਏ ॥
transliteration: so jaanai jin daatai deee ||
english: The Giver, who blesses us with these - He alone knows.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਦੋਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸਹੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: kis kau dos dehi too praanee sahu apanaa keeaa karaaraa he ||14||
english: So who can you blame, O mortal being? The hardships you suffer are from your own actions. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa karadaa aaiaa ||
english: Practicing egotism and possessiveness, you have come into the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa ba(n)dh chalaaiaa ||
english: Hope and desire bind you and lead you on.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਚਾਲੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੇ ਛਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: meree meree karat kiaa le chaale bikh laade chhaar bikaaraa he ||15||
english: Indulging in egotism and self-conceit, what will you be able to carry with you, except the load of ashes from poison and corruption? ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har kee bhagat karahu jan bhaaee ||
english: Worship the Lord in devotion, O humble Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: akath kathahu man manahi samaaee ||
english: Speak the Unspoken Speech, and the mind will merge back into the Mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਠਿ ਚਲਤਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: uth chalataa thaak rakhahu ghar apunai dukh kaate kaatanahaaraa he ||16||
english: Restrain your restless mind within its own home, and the Lord, the Destroyer, shall destroy your pain. ||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਪਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: har gur poore kee ot paraatee ||
english: I seek the support of the Perfect Guru, the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har liv guramukh jaatee ||
english: The Gurmukh loves the Lord; the Gurmukh realizes the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak raam naam mat ootam har bakhase paar utaaraa he ||17||4||10||
english: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, the intellect is exalted; granting His forgiveness, the Lord carries him across to the other side. ||17||4||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saran pare guradev tumaaree ||
english: O Divine Guru, I have entered Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: too samarath daiaal muraaree ||
english: You are the Almighty Lord, the Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ਤੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tere choj na jaanai koee too pooraa purakh bidhaataa he ||1||
english: No one knows Your wondrous plays; You are the perfect Architect of Destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: too aad jugaad karahi pratipaalaa ||
english: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You cherish and sustain Your beings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat roop anoop daiaalaa ||
english: You are in each and every heart, O Merciful Lord of incomparable beauty.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu tudh bhaavai tivai chalaavahi sabh tero keeaa kamaataa he ||2||
english: As You will, You cause all to walk; everyone acts according to Your Command. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਭਲੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar jot bhalee jagajeevan ||
english: Deep within the nucleus of all, is the Light of the Life of the World.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨ ॥
transliteration: sabh ghat bhogai har ras peevan ||
english: The Lord enjoys the hearts of all, and drinks in their essence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape levai aape devai tihu loee jagat pit daataa he ||3||
english: He Himself gives, and He himself takes; He is the generous father of the beings of the three worlds. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jagat upaai khel rachaaiaa ||
english: Creating the world, He has set His play into motion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਵਣੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pavanai paanee aganee jeeu paaiaa ||
english: He placed the soul in the body of air, water and fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਸੋ ਦਸਵਾ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਹਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: dehee nagaree nau daravaaje so dasavaa gupat rahaataa he ||4||
english: The body-village has nine gates; the Tenth Gate remains hidden. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਨਦੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਅਸਰਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: chaar nadee aganee asaraalaa ||
english: There are four horrible rivers of fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: koee guramukh boojhai sabad niraalaa ||
english: How rare is that Gurmukh who understands this, and through the Word of the Shabad, remains unattached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਡੂਬਹਿ ਦਾਝਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: saakat duramat doobahi daajhahi gur raakhe har liv raataa he ||5||
english: The faithless cynics are drowned and burnt through their evil-mindedness. The Guru saves those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪੁ ਤੇਜੁ ਵਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਆਕਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: ap tej vaai prithamee aakaasaa ||
english: Water, fire, air, earth and ether

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: tin mahi pa(n)ch tat ghar vaasaa ||
english: in that house of the five elements, they dwell.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: satigur sabad rahahi ra(n)g raataa taj maaiaa haumai bhraataa he ||6||
english: Those who remain imbued with the Word of the True Guru's Shabad, renounce Maya, egotism and doubt. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu man bheejai sabad pateejai ||
english: This mind is drenched with the Shabad, and satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai kiaa tek tikeejai ||
english: Without the Name, what support can anyone have?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਮੁਹੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਇਨਿ ਸਾਕਤਿ ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: a(n)tar chor muhai ghar ma(n)dar in saakat doot na jaataa he ||7||
english: The temple of the body is being plundered by the thieves within, but this faithless cynic does not even recognize these demons. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁੰਦਰ ਦੂਤ ਭੂਤ ਭੀਹਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: du(n)dar doot bhoot bheehaale ||
english: They are argumentative demons, terrifying goblins.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਚੋਤਾਣਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: khi(n)chotaan karahi betaale ||
english: These demons stir up conflict and strife.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: sabad surat bin aavai jaavai pat khoee aavat jaataa he ||8||
english: Without awareness of the Shabad, one comes and goes in reincarnation; he loses his honor in this coming and going. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਲਰੁ ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮੈ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kooR kalar tan bhasamai dheree ||
english: The body of the false person is just a pile of barren dirt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai kaisee pat teree ||
english: Without the Name, what honor can you have?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਧੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਮਕੰਕਰਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: baadhe mukat naahee jug chaare jamaka(n)kar kaal paraataa he ||9||
english: Bound and gagged throughout the four ages, there is no liberation; the Messenger of Death keeps such a person under his gaze. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jam dar baadhe milahi sajaaee ||
english: At Death's door, he is tied up and punished;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tis aparaadhee gat nahee kaaee ||
english: such a sinner does not obtain salvation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਮੀਨੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: karan palaav kare bilalaavai jiu ku(n)dee meen paraataa he ||10||
english: He cries out in pain, like the fish pierced by the hook. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤੁ ਫਾਸੀ ਪੜੈ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: saakat phaasee paRai ikelaa ||
english: The faithless cynic is caught in the noose all alone.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jam vas keeaa a(n)dh duhelaa ||
english: The miserable spiritually blind person is caught in the power of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਚਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na soojhai aaj kaal pach jaataa he ||11||
english: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not known. He shall waste away, today or tomorrow. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur baajh na belee koee ||
english: Other than the True Guru, no one is your friend.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਰਾਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aithai othai raakhaa prabh soee ||
english: Here and hereafter, God is the Savior.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਇਉ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਮਿਲਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: raam naam devai kar kirapaa iu salalai salal milaataa he ||12||
english: He grants His Grace, and bestows the Lord's Name. He merges with Him, like water with water. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੇ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhoole sikh guroo samajhaae ||
english: The Guru instructs His wandering Sikhs;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਝੜਿ ਜਾਦੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ujhaR jaade maarag paae ||
english: if they go astray, He sets them on the right path.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: tis gur sev sadaa din raatee dukh bha(n)jan sa(n)g sakhaataa he ||13||
english: So serve the Guru, forever, day and night; He is the Destroyer of pain - He is with you as your companion. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kee bhagat karahi kiaa praanee ||
english: O mortal being, what devotional worship have you performed to the Guru?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਿ ਮਹੇਸਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: brahamai i(n)dr mahes na jaanee ||
english: Even Brahma, Indra and Shiva do not know it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: satigur alakh kahahu kiu lakheeai jis bakhase tisahi pachhaataa he ||14||
english: Tell me, how can the unknowable True Guru be known? He alone attains this realization, whom the Lord forgives. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar prem paraapat darasan ||
english: One who has love within, obtains the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁ ਪਰਸਨੁ ॥
transliteration: gurabaanee siu preet s parasan ||
english: One who enshrines love for the Word of the Guru's Bani, meets with Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਘਟਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: ahinis niramal jot sabaaee ghat deepak guramukh jaataa he ||15||
english: Day and night, the Gurmukh sees the immaculate Divine Light everywhere; this lamp illuminates his heart. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੋਜਨ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: bhojan giaan mahaa ras meethaa ||
english: The food of spiritual wisdom is the supremely sweet essence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: jin chaakhiaa tin darasan deethaa ||
english: Whoever tastes it, sees the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: darasan dekh mile bairaagee man manasaa maar samaataa he ||16||
english: Beholding His Darshan, the unattached one meets the Lord; subduing the mind's desires, he merges into the Lord. ||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi se paradhaanaa ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru are supreme and famous.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tin ghat ghat a(n)tar braham pachhaanaa ||
english: Deep within each and every heart, they recognize God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੫॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak har jas har jan kee sa(n)gat deejai jin satigur har prabh jaataa he ||17||5||11||
english: Please bless Nanak with the Lord's Praises, and the Sangat, the Congregation of the Lord's humble servants; through the True Guru, they know their Lord God. ||17||5||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saache saahib sirajanahaare ||
english: The True Lord is the Creator of the Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਧਰ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਧਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jin dhar chakr dhare veechaare ||
english: He established and contemplates the worldly sphere.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape karataa kar kar vekhai saachaa veparavaahaa he ||1||
english: He Himself created the creation, and beholds it; He is True and independent. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਕੀ ਵੇਕੀ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: vekee vekee ja(n)t upaae ||
english: He created the beings of different kinds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਪੰਦੀ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dui pa(n)dee dui raah chalaae ||
english: The two travellers have set out in two directions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur poore vin mukat na hoee sach naam jap laahaa he ||2||
english: Without the Perfect Guru, no one is liberated. Chanting the True Name, one profits. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੜਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਰੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: paRahi manamukh par bidh nahee jaanaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs read and study, but they do not know the way.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: naam na boojhahi bharam bhulaanaa ||
english: They do not understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they wander, deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਵਢੀ ਦੇਨਿ ਉਗਾਹੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: lai kai vadhee den ugaahee duramat kaa gal phaahaa he ||3||
english: They take bribes, and give false testimony; the noose of evil-mindedness is around their necks. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: simrit saasatr paRahi puraanaa ||
english: They read the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Puraanas;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: vaad vakhaanahi tat na jaanaa ||
english: they argue and debate, but do not know the essence of reality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: vin gur poore tat na paaeeai sach sooche sach raahaa he ||4||
english: Without the Perfect Guru, the essence of reality is not obtained. The true and pure beings walk the Path of Truth. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh saalaahe sun sun aakhai ||
english: All praise God and listen, and listen and speak.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: aape daanaa sach paraakhai ||
english: He Himself is wise, and He Himself judges the Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jin kau nadar kare prabh apanee guramukh sabad salaahaa he ||5||
english: Those whom God blesses with His Glance of Grace become Gurmukh, and praise the Word of the Shabad. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖੈ ਕੇਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sun sun aakhai ketee baanee ||
english: Many listen and listen, and speak the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਕੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sun kaheeai ko a(n)t na jaanee ||
english: Listening and speaking, no one knows His limits.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jaa kau alakh lakhaae aape akath kathaa budh taahaa he ||6||
english: He alone is wise, unto whom the unseen Lord reveals Himself; he speaks the Unspoken Speech. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੇ ਕਉ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਵਾਧਾਏ ॥
transliteration: janame kau vaajahi vaadhaae ||
english: At birth, the congratulations pour in;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਿਲੜੇ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sohilaRe agiaanee gaae ||
english: the ignorant sing songs of joy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਮਰਣਾ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jo janamai tis sarapar maranaa kirat paiaa sir saahaa he ||7||
english: Whoever is born, is sure to die, according to the destiny of past deeds inscribed upon his head by the Sovereign Lord King. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਏ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)jog vijog merai prabh keee ||
english: Union and separation were created by my God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਦੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ॥
transliteration: srisat upaai dukhaa sukh deee ||
english: Creating the Universe, He gave it pain and pleasure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਸਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: dukh sukh hee te bhae niraale guramukh seel sanaahaa he ||8||
english: The Gurmukhs remain unaffected by pain and pleasure; they wear the armor of humility. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੀਕੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: neeke saache ke vaapaaree ||
english: The noble people are traders in Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sach saudaa lai gur veechaaree ||
english: They purchase the true merchandise, contemplating the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: sachaa vakhar jis dhan palai sabad sachai omaahaa he ||9||
english: One who has the wealth of the true commodity in his lap, is blessed with the rapture of the True Shabad. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੀ ਸਉਦੀ ਤੋਟਾ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: kaachee saudee totaa aavai ||
english: The false dealings lead only to loss.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh vanaj kare prabh bhaavai ||
english: The trades of the Gurmukh are pleasing to God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: poo(n)jee saabat raas salaamat chookaa jam kaa phaahaa he ||10||
english: His stock is safe, and his capital is safe and sound. The noose of Death is cut away from around his neck. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko bolai aapan bhaanai ||
english: Everyone speaks as they please.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh doojai bol na jaanai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh, in duality, does not know how to speak.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਅੰਧਲੀ ਬੋਲੀ ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: a(n)dhule kee mat a(n)dhalee bolee aai gaiaa dukh taahaa he ||11||
english: The blind person has a blind and deaf intellect; coming and going in reincarnation, he suffers in pain. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: dukh mahi janamai dukh mahi maranaa ||
english: In pain he is born, and in pain he dies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: dookh na mitai bin gur kee saranaa ||
english: His pain is not relieved, without seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੂਖੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਜਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: dookhee upajai dookhee binasai kiaa lai aaiaa kiaa lai jaahaa he ||12||
english: In pain he is created, and in pain he perishes. What has he brought with himself? And what will he take away? ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachee karanee gur kee sirakaaraa ||
english: True are the actions of those who are under the Guru's influence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਮ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaan nahee jam dhaaraa ||
english: They do not come and go in reincarnation, and they are not subject to the laws of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡਾਲ ਛੋਡਿ ਤਤੁ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: daal chhod tat mool paraataa man saachaa omaahaa he ||13||
english: Whoever abandons the branches, and clings to the true root, enjoys true ecstasy within his mind. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: har ke log nahee jam maarai ||
english: Death cannot strike down the people of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਕਰਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: naa dukh dekhahi pa(n)th karaarai ||
english: They do not see pain on the most difficult path.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: raam naam ghat a(n)tar poojaa avar na doojaa kaahaa he ||14||
english: Deep within the nucleus of their hearts, they worship and adore the Lord's Name; there is nothing else at all for them. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓੜੁ ਨ ਕਥਨੈ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: oR na kathanai siphat sajaaee ||
english: There is no end to the Lord's sermon and Praise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jiu tudh bhaavahi rahahi rajaaee ||
english: As it pleases You, I remain under Your Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਨਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: daragah paidhe jaan suhele hukam sache paatisaahaa he ||15||
english: I am embellished with robes of honor in the Court of the Lord, by the Order of the True King. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਗੁਣ ਕਥਹਿ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kiaa kaheeai gun kathahi ghanere ||
english: How can I chant Your uncounted glories?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t na paavahi vade vadere ||
english: Even the greatest of the great do not know Your limits.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak saach milai pat raakhahu too sir saahaa paatisaahaa he ||16||6||12||
english: Please bless Nanak with the Truth, and preserve his honor; You are the supreme emperor above the heads of kings. ||16||6||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 dakhanee ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl, Dakhanee:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੁ ਨਗਰ ਗੜ ਅੰਦਰਿ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa nagar nagar gaR a(n)dar ||
english: Deep within the body-village is the fortress.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਵਾਸਾ ਪੁਰਿ ਗਗਨੰਦਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saachaa vaasaa pur gagana(n)dar ||
english: The dwelling of the True Lord is within the city of the Tenth Gate.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: asathir thaan sadaa niramaail aape aap upaaidaa ||1||
english: This place is permanent and forever immaculate. He Himself created it. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੋਟ ਛਜੇ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar kot chhaje hatanaale ||
english: Within the fortress are balconies and bazaars.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: aape levai vasat samaale ||
english: He Himself takes care of His merchandise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਜੜੇ ਜੜਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਖੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bajar kapaat jaRe jaR jaanai gurasabadee kholaaidaa ||2||
english: The hard and heavy doors of the Tenth Gate are closed and locked. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are thrown open. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕੋਟ ਗੁਫਾ ਘਰ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bheetar kot guphaa ghar jaaee ||
english: Within the fortress is the cave, the home of the self.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਘਰ ਥਾਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: nau ghar thaape hukam rajaaee ||
english: He established the nine gates of this house, by His Command and His Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਸਵੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੀ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dasavai purakh alekh apaaree aape alakh lakhaaidaa ||3||
english: In the Tenth Gate, the Primal Lord, the unknowable and infinite dwells; the unseen Lord reveals Himself. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਇਕ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: paun paanee aganee ik vaasaa ||
english: Within the body of air, water and fire, the One Lord dwells.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਤੋ ਖੇਲੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: aape keeto khel tamaasaa ||
english: He Himself stages His wondrous dramas and plays.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਲਦੀ ਜਲਿ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: baladee jal nivarai kirapaa te aape jal nidh paaidaa ||4||
english: By His Grace, water puts out the burning fire; He Himself stores it up in the watery ocean. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੀ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: dharat upaai dharee dharam saalaa ||
english: Creating the earth, He established it as the home of Dharma.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਤਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: utapat paralau aap niraalaa ||
english: Creating and destroying, He remains unattached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਵਣੈ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਕਲਾ ਖਿੰਚਿ ਢਾਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: pavanai khel keeaa sabh thaaee kalaa khi(n)ch dhaahaaidaa ||5||
english: He stages the play of the breath everywhere. Withdrawing His power, He lets the beings crumble. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮਾਲਣਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bhaar athaarah maalan teree ||
english: Your gardener is the vast vegetation of nature.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਰੁ ਢੁਲੈ ਪਵਣੈ ਲੈ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: chaur dhulai pavanai lai pheree ||
english: The wind blowing around is the chauree, the fly-brush, waving over You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਦੀਪਕ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: cha(n)d sooraj dui deepak raakhe sas ghar soor samaaidaa ||6||
english: The Lord placed the two lamps, the sun and the moon; the sun merges in the house of the moon. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਖੀ ਪੰਚ ਉਡਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)khee pa(n)ch udar nahee dhaavahi ||
english: The five birds do not fly wild.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: saphalio birakh a(n)mrit phal paavahi ||
english: The tree of life is fruitful, bearing the fruit of Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramukh sahaj ravai gun gaavai har ras chog chugaaidaa ||7||
english: The Gurmukh intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; he eats the food of the Lord's sublime essence. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝਿਲਮਿਲਿ ਝਿਲਕੈ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jhilamil jhilakai cha(n)d na taaraa ||
english: The dazzling light glitters, although neither the moon nor the stars are shining;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਨ ਬਿਜੁਲਿ ਗੈਣਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sooraj kiran na bijul gainaaraa ||
english: neither the sun's rays nor the lightning flashes across the sky.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥੀ ਕਥਉ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: akathee kathau chihan nahee koee poor rahiaa man bhaaidaa ||8||
english: I describe the indescribable state, which has no sign, where the all-pervading Lord is still pleasing to the mind. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਸਰੀ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜਿਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: pasaree kiran jot ujiaalaa ||
english: The rays of Divine Light have spread out their brilliant radiance.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kar dekhai aap daiaalaa ||
english: Having created the creation, the Merciful Lord Himself gazes upon it.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: anahad run jhunakaar sadaa dhun nirabhau kai ghar vaaidaa ||9||
english: The sweet, melodious, unstruck sound current vibrates continuously in the home of the fearless Lord. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: anahad vaajai bhram bhau bhaajai ||
english: When the unstruck sound current resounds, doubt and fear run away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛਾਜੈ ॥
transliteration: sagal biaap rahiaa prabh chhaajai ||
english: God is all-pervading, giving shade to all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: sabh teree too guramukh jaataa dar sohai gun gaaidaa ||10||
english: All belong to You; to the Gurmukhs, You are known. Singing Your Praises, they look beautiful in Your Court. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aad nira(n)jan niramal soee ||
english: He is the Primal Lord, immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: avar na jaanaa doojaa koee ||
english: I know of no other at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: eka(n)kaar vasai man bhaavai haumai garab gavaaidaa ||11||
english: The One Universal Creator Lord dwells within, and is pleasing to the mind of those who banishe egotism and pride. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit peeaa satigur deeaa ||
english: I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, given by the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਦੂਆ ਤੀਆ ॥
transliteration: avar na jaanaa dooaa teeaa ||
english: I do not know any other second or third.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਸੁ ਅਪਰ ਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: eko ek s apar para(n)par parakh khajaanai paaidaa ||12||
english: He is the One, Unique, Infinite and Endless Lord; He evaluates all beings and places some in His treasury. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan sach gahir ga(n)bheeraa ||
english: Spiritual wisdom and meditation on the True Lord are deep and profound.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: koi na jaanai teraa cheeraa ||
english: No one knows Your expanse.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jetee hai tetee tudh jaachai karam milai so paaidaa ||13||
english: All that are, beg from You; You are attained only by Your Grace. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam sach haath tumaarai ||
english: You hold karma and Dharma in Your hands, O True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: veparavaah akhut bha(n)daarai ||
english: O Independent Lord, Your treasures are inexhaustible.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: too daiaal kirapaal sadaa prabh aape mel milaaidaa ||14||
english: You are forever kind and compassionate, God. You unite in Your Union. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aape dekh dikhaavai aape ||
english: You Yourself see, and cause Yourself to be seen.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aape thaap uthaape aape ||
english: You Yourself establish, and You Yourself disestablish.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: aape joR vichhoRe karataa aape maar jeevaaidaa ||15||
english: The Creator Himself unites and separates; He Himself kills and rejuvenates. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jetee hai tetee tudh a(n)dar ||
english: As much as there is, is contained within You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਬਿਜ ਮੰਦਰਿ ॥
