transliteration: dekhahi aap bais bij ma(n)dar ||
english: You gaze upon Your creation, sitting within Your royal palace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak saach kahai bena(n)tee har darasan sukh paaidaa ||16||1||13||
english: Nanak offers this true prayer; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, I have found peace. ||16||1||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: darasan paavaa je tudh bhaavaa ||
english: If I am pleasing to You, Lord, then I obtain the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaai bhagat saache gun gaavaa ||
english: In loving devotional worship, O True Lord, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਤੂ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tudh bhaane too bhaavahi karate aape rasan rasaaidaa ||1||
english: By Your Will, O Creator Lord, You have become pleasing to me, and so sweet to my tongue. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਨਿ ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sohan bhagat prabhoo darabaare ||
english: The devotees look beautiful in the Darbaar, the Court of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mukat bhae har daas tumaare ||
english: Your slaves, Lord, are liberated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap gavaai terai ra(n)g raate anadin naam dhiaaidaa ||2||
english: Eradicating self-conceit, they are attuned to Your Love; night and day, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: eesar brahamaa devee devaa ||
english: Shiva, Brahma, gods and goddesses,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਤਪੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: i(n)dr tape mun teree sevaa ||
english: Indra, ascetics and silent sages serve You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਨਵਾਸੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jatee satee kete banavaasee a(n)t na koee paaidaa ||3||
english: Celibates, givers of charity and the many forest-dwellers have not found the Lord's limits. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਜਾਣਾਏ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: vin jaanaae koi na jaanai ||
english: No one knows You, unless You let them know You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh kare s aapan bhaanai ||
english: Whatever is done, is by Your Will.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਏ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਾਹ ਲਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jee upaae bhaanai saah lavaaidaa ||4||
english: You created the 8.4 million species of beings; by Your Will, they draw their breath. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so nihachau hovai ||
english: Whatever is pleasing to Your Will, undoubtedly comes to pass.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh aap ganaae rovai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh shows off, and comes to grief.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naavahu bhulaa thaur na paae aai jaai dukh paaidaa ||5||
english: Forgetting the Name, he finds no place of rest; coming and going in reincarnation, he suffers in pain. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਾਇਆ ਊਜਲ ਹੰਸਾ ॥
transliteration: niramal kaaiaa oojal ha(n)saa ||
english: Pure is the body, and immaculate is the swan-soul;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅੰਸਾ ॥
transliteration: tis vich naam nira(n)jan a(n)saa ||
english: within it is the immaculate essence of the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਵੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sagale dookh a(n)mrit kar peevai baahuR dookh na paaidaa ||6||
english: Such a being drinks in all his pains like Ambrosial Nectar; he never suffers sorrow again. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਸਾਦਹੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bahu saadahu dookh paraapat hovai ||
english: For his excessive indulgences, he receives only pain;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੋਗਹੁ ਰੋਗ ਸੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bhogahu rog s a(n)t vigovai ||
english: from his enjoyments, he contracts diseases, and in the end, he wastes away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਕਬਹੂ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਭਰਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: harakhahu sog na mitaee kabahoo vin bhaane bharamaaidaa ||7||
english: His pleasure can never erase his pain; without accepting the Lord's Will, he wanders lost and confused. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਭਵੈ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
transliteration: giaan vihoonee bhavai sabaaee ||
english: Without spiritual wisdom, they all just wander around.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saachaa rav rahiaa liv laaee ||
english: The True Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere, lovingly engaged.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: nirabhau sabad guroo sach jaataa jotee jot milaaidaa ||8||
english: The Fearless Lord is known through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru; one's light merges into the Light. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਟਲੁ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: atal adol atol muraare ||
english: He is the eternal, unchanging, immeasurable Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਾਹੇ ਫੇਰਿ ਉਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi dhaahe pher usaare ||
english: In an instant, He destroys, ang then reconstructs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: roop na rekhiaa mit nahee keemat sabad bhed pateeaaidaa ||9||
english: He has no form or shape, no limit or value. Pierced by the Shabad, one is satisfied. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ham daasan ke daas piaare ||
english: I am the slave of Your slaves, O my Beloved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਾਚ ਭਲੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saadhik saach bhale veechaare ||
english: The seekers of Truth and goodness contemplate You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: ma(n)ne naau soee jin jaasee aape saach driRaaidaa ||10||
english: Whoever believes in the Name, wins; He Himself implants Truth within. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਲੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: palai saach sache sachiaaraa ||
english: The Truest of the True has the Truth is His lap.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saache bhaavai sabad piaaraa ||
english: The True Lord is pleased with those who love the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਲਾ ਧਰਿ ਥਾਪੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: tribhavan saach kalaa dhar thaapee saache hee pateeaaidaa ||11||
english: Exerting His power, the Lord has established Truth throughout the three worlds; with Truth He is pleased. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: vadaa vadaa aakhai sabh koee ||
english: Everyone calls Him the greatest of the great.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur bin sojhee kinai na hoee ||
english: Without the Guru, no one understands Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਏ ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: saach milai so saache bhaae naa veechhuR dukh paaidaa ||12||
english: The True Lord is pleased with those who merge in Truth; they are not separated again, and they do not suffer. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਧਾਹੀ ਰੁੰਨੇ ॥
transliteration: dhurahu vichhu(n)ne dhaahee ru(n)ne ||
english: Separated from the Primal Lord, they loudly weep and wail.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਪੁੰਨੇ ॥
transliteration: mar mar janamahi muhalat pu(n)ne ||
english: They die and die, only to be reborn, when their time has passed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮੇਲਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jis bakhase tis de vadiaaee mel na pachhotaaidaa ||13||
english: He blesses those whom He forgives with glorious greatness; united with Him, they do not regret or repent. ||13 |

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa aape bhugataa ||
english: | He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aape tripataa aape mukataa ||
english: He Himself is satisfied, and He Himself is liberated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੀਸਰੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: aape mukat daan mukateesar mamataa mohu chukaaidaa ||14||
english: The Lord of liberation Himself grants liberation; He eradicates possessiveness and attachment. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: daanaa kai sir daan veechaaraa ||
english: I consider Your gifts to be the most wonderful gifts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath apaaraa ||
english: You are the Cause of causes, Almighty Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: kar kar vekhai keetaa apanaa karanee kaar karaaidaa ||15||
english: Creating the creation, You gaze upon what You have created; You cause all to do their deeds. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: se gun gaavahi saache bhaavahi ||
english: They alone sing Your Glorious Praises, who are pleasing to You, O True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਹਿ ਤੁਝ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tujh te upajahi tujh maahi samaavahi ||
english: They issue forth from You, and merge again into You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak saach kahai bena(n)tee mil saache sukh paaidaa ||16||2||14||
english: Nanak offers this true prayer; meeting with the True Lord, peace is obtained. ||16||2||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਰਬਦ ਨਰਬਦ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: arabad narabad dhu(n)dhookaaraa ||
english: For endless eons, there was only utter darkness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਣਿ ਨ ਗਗਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dharan na gaganaa hukam apaaraa ||
english: There was no earth or sky; there was only the infinite Command of His Hukam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਨ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naa din rain na cha(n)d na sooraj su(n)n samaadh lagaaidaa ||1||
english: There was no day or night, no moon or sun; God sat in primal, profound Samaadhi. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਾਣੀ ਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਉਣ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: khaanee na baanee paun na paanee ||
english: There were no sources of creation or powers of speech, no air or water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਪਤਿ ਖਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: opat khapat na aavan jaanee ||
english: There was no creation or destruction, no coming or going.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਸਪਤ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਦੀ ਨ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kha(n)d pataal sapat nahee saagar nadee na neer vahaaidaa ||2||
english: There were no continents, nether regions, seven seas, rivers or flowing water. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: naa tad surag machh paiaalaa ||
english: There were no heavenly realms, earth or nether regions of the underworld.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੋਜਕੁ ਭਿਸਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਖੈ ਕਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: dojak bhisat nahee khai kaalaa ||
english: There was no heaven or hell, no death or time.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਰਕੁ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: narak surag nahee ja(n)man maranaa naa ko aai na jaaidaa ||3||
english: There was no hell or heaven, no birth or death, no coming or going in reincarnation. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes na koee ||
english: There was no Brahma, Vishnu or Shiva.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: avar na deesai eko soee ||
english: No one was seen, except the One Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਨਮਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naar purakh nahee jaat na janamaa naa ko dukh sukh paaidaa ||4||
english: There was no female or male, no social class or caste of birth; no one experienced pain or pleasure. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਬਨਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: naa tad jatee satee banavaasee ||
english: There were no people of celibacy or charity; no one lived in the forests.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: naa tad sidh saadhik sukhavaasee ||
english: There were no Siddhas or seekers, no one living in peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਭੇਖੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jogee ja(n)gam bhekh na koee naa ko naath kahaaidaa ||5||
english: There were no Yogis, no wandering pilgrims, no religious robes; no one called himself the master. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਾ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam naa brat poojaa ||
english: There was no chanting or meditation, no self-discipline, fasting or worship.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: naa ko aakh vakhaanai doojaa ||
english: No one spoke or talked in duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aape aap upaai vigasai aape keemat paaidaa ||6||
english: He created Himself, and rejoiced; He evaluates Himself. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਤੁਲਸੀ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: naa such sa(n)jam tulasee maalaa ||
english: There was no purification, no self-restraint, no malas of basil seeds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੋਪੀ ਕਾਨੁ ਨ ਗਊ ਗੋੁਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: gopee kaan na gaoo gouaalaa ||
english: There were no Gopis, no Krishna, no cows or cowherds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ta(n)t ma(n)t paakha(n)d na koee naa ko va(n)s vajaaidaa ||7||
english: There were no tantras, no mantras and no hypocrisy; no one played the flute. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: karam dharam nahee maaiaa maakhee ||
english: There was no karma, no Dharma, no buzzing fly of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੀਸੈ ਆਖੀ ॥
transliteration: jaat janam nahee deesai aakhee ||
english: Social class and birth were not seen with any eyes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਥੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: mamataa jaal kaal nahee maathai naa ko kisai dhiaaidaa ||8||
english: There was no noose of attachment, no death inscribed upon the forehead; no one meditated on anything. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਜਿੰਦੋ ॥
transliteration: ni(n)d bi(n)d nahee jeeu na ji(n)do ||
english: There was no slander, no seed, no soul and no life.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਨਾ ਮਾਛਿੰਦੋ ॥
transliteration: naa tad gorakh naa maachhi(n)do ||
english: There was no Gorakh and no Maachhindra.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕੁਲ ਓਪਤਿ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: naa tad giaan dhiaan kul opat naa ko ganat ganaaidaa ||9||
english: There was no spiritual wisdom or meditation, no ancestry or creation, no reckoning of accounts. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਰਨ ਭੇਖ ਨਹੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: varan bhekh nahee brahaman khatree ||
english: There were no castes or social classes, no religious robes, no Brahmin or Kh'shaatriya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਉ ਨ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਗਊ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ॥
transliteration: deu na dehuraa gaoo gaaitree ||
english: There were no demi-gods or temples, no cows or Gaayatri prayer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਨਹੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੂਜਾ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: hom jag nahee teerath naavan naa ko poojaa laaidaa ||10||
english: There were no burnt offerings, no ceremonial feasts, no cleansing rituals at sacred shrines of pilgrimage; no one worshipped in adoration. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੁਲਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਜੀ ॥
transliteration: naa ko mulaa naa ko kaajee ||
english: There was no Mullah, there was no Qazi.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸੇਖੁ ਮਸਾਇਕੁ ਹਾਜੀ ॥
transliteration: naa ko sekh masaaik haajee ||
english: There was no Shaykh, or pilgrims to Mecca.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਈਅਤਿ ਰਾਉ ਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: raeeat raau na haumai duneeaa naa ko kahan kahaaidaa ||11||
english: There was no king or subjects, and no worldly egotism; no one spoke of himself. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ॥
transliteration: bhaau na bhagatee naa siv sakatee ||
english: There was no love or devotion, no Shiva or Shakti - no energy or matter.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਰਕਤੀ ॥
transliteration: saajan meet bi(n)d nahee rakatee ||
english: There were no friends or companions, no semen or blood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਏਹੋ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: aape saahu aape vanajaaraa saache eho bhaaidaa ||12||
english: He Himself is the banker, and He Himself is the merchant. Such is the Pleasure of the Will of the True Lord. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ॥
transliteration: bed kateb na si(n)mrit saasat ||
english: There were no Vedas, Korans or Bibles, no Simritees or Shaastras.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਉਦੈ ਨਹੀ ਆਸਤ ॥
transliteration: paath puraan udai nahee aasat ||
english: There was no recitation of the Puraanas, no sunrise or sunset.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: kahataa bakataa aap agochar aape alakh lakhaaidaa ||13||
english: The Unfathomable Lord Himself was the speaker and the preacher; the unseen Lord Himself saw everything. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa tis bhaanaa taa jagat upaaiaa ||
english: When He so willed, He created the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਕਲਾ ਆਡਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: baajh kalaa aadaan rahaaiaa ||
english: Without any supporting power, He sustained the universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes upaae maaiaa mohu vadhaaidaa ||14||
english: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva; He fostered enticement and attachment to Maya. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: virale kau gur sabad sunaaiaa ||
english: How rare is that person who listens to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar kar dekhai hukam sabaaiaa ||
english: He created the creation, and watches over it; the Hukam of His Command is over all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਅਰੰਭੇ ਗੁਪਤਹੁ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: kha(n)d brahama(n)d paataal ara(n)bhe gupatahu paragatee aaidaa ||15||
english: He formed the planets, solar systems and nether regions, and brought what was hidden to manifestation. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: taa kaa a(n)t na jaanai koee ||
english: No one knows His limits.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: poore gur te sojhee hoee ||
english: This understanding comes from the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak saach rate bisamaadee bisam bhae gun gaaidaa ||16||3||15||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Truth are wonderstruck; singing His Glorious Praises, they are filled with wonder. ||16||3||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aape aap upaai niraalaa ||
english: He Himself created the creation, remaining unattached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਕੀਓ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: saachaa thaan keeo daiaalaa ||
english: The Merciful Lord has established His True Home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਰਚਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paun paanee aganee kaa ba(n)dhan kaaiaa kot rachaaidaa ||1||
english: Binding together air, water and fire, He created the fortress of the body. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਘਰ ਥਾਪੇ ਥਾਪਣਹਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: nau ghar thaape thaapanahaarai ||
english: The Creator established the nine gates.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਸਵੈ ਵਾਸਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: dasavai vaasaa alakh apaarai ||
english: In the Tenth Gate, is the dwelling of the infinite, unseen Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਇਰ ਸਪਤ ਭਰੇ ਜਲਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saair sapat bhare jal niramal guramukh mail na laaidaa ||2||
english: The seven seas are overflowing with the Ambrosial Water; the Gurmukhs are not stained with filth. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
transliteration: rav sas deepak jot sabaaee ||
english: The lamps of the sun and the moon fill all with light.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: aape kar vekhai vadiaaee ||
english: Creating them, He beholds His own glorious greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jot saroop sadaa sukhadaataa sache sobhaa paaidaa ||3||
english: The Giver of peace is forever the embodiment of Light; from the True Lord, glory is obtained. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਹਾਟ ਪਟਣ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gaR mahi haat patan vaapaaraa ||
english: Within the fortress are the stores and markets; the business is transacted there.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: poorai tol tolai vanajaaraa ||
english: The Supreme Merchant weighs with the perfect weights.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aape ratan visaahe levai aape keemat paaidaa ||4||
english: He Himself buys the jewel, and He Himself appraises its value. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਪਾਵਣਹਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: keemat paaee paavanahaarai ||
english: The Appraiser appraises its value.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਪੂਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: veparavaah poore bha(n)daarai ||
english: The Independent Lord is overflowing with His treasures.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sarab kalaa le aape rahiaa guramukh kisai bujhaaidaa ||5||
english: He holds all powers, He is all-pervading; how few are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare pooraa gur bhetai ||
english: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, one meets the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਰੈ ਫੇਟੈ ॥
transliteration: jam ja(n)daar na maarai phetai ||
english: The tyrannical Messenger of Death cannot strike him then.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਬਿਗਸਿ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jiu jal a(n)tar kamal bigaasee aape bigas dhiaaidaa ||6||
english: He blossoms forth like the lotus flower in the water; he blossoms forth in joyful meditation. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵਰਖੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape varakhai a(n)mrit dhaaraa ||
english: He Himself rains down the Ambrosial Stream of jewels,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ratan javehar laal apaaraa ||
english: Diamonds, and rubies of priceless value.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta pooraa paaeeai prem padaarath paaidaa ||7||
english: When they meet the True Guru, then they find the Perfect Lord; they obtain the treasure of Love. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਹੈ ਅਮੋਲੋ ॥
transliteration: prem padaarath lahai amolo ||
english: Whoever receives the priceless treasure of Love

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਘਾਟਸਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੋ ॥
transliteration: kab hee na ghaatas pooraa tolo ||
english: - his weight never decreases; he has perfect weight.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚੋ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: sache kaa vaapaaree hovai sacho saudaa paaidaa ||8||
english: The trader of Truth becomes true, and obtains the merchandise. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saudaa viralaa ko paae ||
english: How rare are those who obtain the true merchandise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pooraa satigur milai milaae ||
english: Meeting the Perfect True Guru, one meets with the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: guramukh hoi s hukam pachhaanai maanai hukam samaaidaa ||9||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh realizes the Hukam of His command; surrendering to His Command, one merges in the Lord. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hukame aaiaa hukam samaaiaa ||
english: By His Command we come, and by His command we merge into Him again.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦੀਸੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hukame deesai jagat upaaiaa ||
english: By His Command, the world was formed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਲਾ ਰਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: hukame surag machh paiaalaa hukame kalaa rahaaidaa ||10||
english: By His Command, the heavens, this world and the nether regions were created; by His Command, His Power supports them. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਉਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: hukame dharatee dhaul sir bhaara(n) ||
english: The Hukam of His Command is the mythical bull which supports the burden of the earth on its head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਗੈਣਾਰੰ ॥
transliteration: hukame paun paanee gainaara(n) ||
english: By His Hukam, air, water and fire came into being.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: hukame siv sakatee ghar vaasaa hukame khel khelaaidaa ||11||
english: By His Hukam, one dwells in the house of matter and energy - Shiva and Shakti. By His Hukam, He plays His plays. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਡਾਣੇ ਆਗਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: hukame aadaane aagaasee ||
english: By the Hukam of His command, the sky is spread above.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: hukame jal thal tribhavan vaasee ||
english: By His Hukam, His creatures dwell in the water, on the land and throughout the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: hukame saas giraas sadaa phun hukame dekh dikhaaidaa ||12||
english: By His Hukam, we draw our breath and receive our food; by His Hukam, He watches over us, and inspires us to see. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਦਸ ਅਉਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: hukam upaae das autaaraa ||
english: By His Hukam, He created His ten incarnations,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਅਗਣਤ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dev daanav aganat apaaraa ||
english: and the uncounted and infinite gods and devils.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਝੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: maanai hukam s daragah paijhai saach milaai samaaidaa ||13||
english: Whoever obeys the Hukam of His Command, is robed with honor in the Court of the Lord; united with the Truth, He merges in the Lord. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜੁਗ ਛਤੀਹ ਗੁਦਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hukame jug chhateeh gudaare ||
english: By the Hukam of His Command, the thirty-six ages passed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hukame sidh saadhik veechaare ||
english: By His Hukam, the Siddhas and seekers contemplate Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਥਂੀ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: aap naath natha(n)ee sabh jaa kee bakhase mukat karaaidaa ||14||
english: The Lord Himself has brought all under His control. Whoever He forgives, is liberated. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਗੜੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kot gaRai mahi raajaa ||
english: In the strong fortress of the body with its beautiful doors,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸ ਭਲਾ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: neb khavaas bhalaa daravaajaa ||
english: Is the king, with his special assistants and ministers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਲਬਿ ਪਾਪਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: mithiaa lobh naahee ghar vaasaa lab paap pachhutaaidaa ||15||
english: Those gripped by falsehood and greed do not dwell in the celestial home; engrossed in greed and sin, they come to regret and repent. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh nagar mahi kaaree ||
english: Truth and contentment govern this body-village.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jat sat sa(n)jam saran muraaree ||
english: Chastity, truth and self-control are in the Sanctuary of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak sahaj milai jagajeevan gurasabadee pat paaidaa ||16||4||16||
english: O Nanak, one intuitively meets the Lord, the Life of the World; the Word of the Guru's Shabad brings honor. ||16||4||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਕਲਾ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: su(n)n kalaa apara(n)par dhaaree ||
english: In the Primal Void, the Infinite Lord assumed His Power.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aap niraalam apar apaaree ||
english: He Himself is unattached, infinite and incomparable.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਸੁੰਨੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape kudarat kar kar dekhai su(n)nahu su(n)n upaaidaa ||1||
english: He Himself exercised His Creative Power, and He gazes upon His creation; from the Primal Void, He formed the Void. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਸੁੰਨੈ ਤੇ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: paun paanee su(n)nai te saaje ||
english: From this Primal Void, He fashioned air and water.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: srisat upaai kaaiaa gaR raaje ||
english: He created the universe, and the king in the fortress of the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਸੁੰਨੇ ਕਲਾ ਰਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: agan paanee jeeu jot tumaaree su(n)ne kalaa rahaaidaa ||2||
english: Your Light pervades fire, water and souls; Your Power rests in the Primal Void. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: su(n)nahu brahamaa bisan mahes upaae ||
english: From this Primal Void, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva issued forth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨੇ ਵਰਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
transliteration: su(n)ne varate jug sabaae ||
english: This Primal Void is pervasive throughout all the ages.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਪਦ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: is pad veechaare so jan pooraa tis mileeai bharam chukaaidaa ||3||
english: That humble being who contemplates this state is perfect; meeting with him, doubt is dispelled. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਸਪਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: su(n)nahu sapat sarovar thaape ||
english: From this Primal Void, the seven seas were established.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: jin saaje veechaare aape ||
english: The One who created them, Himself contemplates them.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tit sat sar manooaa guramukh naavai phir baahuR jon na paaidaa ||4||
english: That human being who becomes Gurmukh, who bathes in the pool of Truth, is not cast into the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਗੈਣਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: su(n)nahu cha(n)d sooraj gainaare ||
english: From this Primal Void, came the moon, the sun and the earth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tis kee jot tribhavan saare ||
english: His Light pervades all the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਸੁੰਨੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: su(n)ne alakh apaar niraalam su(n)ne taaRee laaidaa ||5||
english: The Lord of this Primal Void is unseen, infinite and immaculate; He is absorbed in the Primal Trance of Deep Meditation. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: su(n)nahu dharat akaas upaae ||
english: From this Primal Void, the earth and the Akaashic Ethers were created.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਥੰਮਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bin tha(n)maa raakhe sach kal paae ||
english: He supports them without any visible support, by exercising His True Power.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਜਿ ਮੇਖੁਲੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: tribhavan saaj mekhulee maaiaa aap upaai khapaaidaa ||6||
english: He fashioned the three worlds, and the rope of Maya; He Himself creates and destroys. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਖਾਣੀ ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: su(n)nahu khaanee su(n)nahu baanee ||
english: From this Primal Void, came the four sources of creation, and the power of speech.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਉਪਜੀ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: su(n)nahu upajee su(n)n samaanee ||
english: They were created from the Void, and they will merge into the Void.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਤਭੁਜੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਦੇਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: utabhuj chalat keeaa sir karatai bisamaad sabad dekhaaidaa ||7||
english: The Supreme Creator created the play of Nature; through the Word of His Shabad, He stages His Wondrous Show. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਦੁਇ ਕੀਏ ॥
transliteration: su(n)nahu raat dinas dui keee ||
english: From this Primal Void, He made both night and day;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਪਤਿ ਖਪਤਿ ਸੁਖਾ ਦੁਖ ਦੀਏ ॥
transliteration: opat khapat sukhaa dukh deee ||
english: creation and destruction, pleasure and pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਅਮਰੁ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: sukh dukh hee te amar ateetaa guramukh nij ghar paaidaa ||8||
english: The Gurmukh is immortal, untouched by pleasure and pain. He obtains the home of his own inner being. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਮ ਵੇਦੁ ਰਿਗੁ ਜੁਜਰੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ ॥
transliteration: saam ved rig jujar atharaban ||
english: The Saam Veda, the Rig Veda, the Jujar Veda and the At'harva Veda

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ॥
transliteration: brahame mukh maaiaa hai trai gun ||
english: form the mouth of Brahma; they speak of the three gunas, the three qualities of Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋ ਤਿਉ ਬੋਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: taa kee keemat kahi na sakai ko tiu bole jiu bolaaidaa ||9||
english: None of them can describe His worth. We speak as He inspires us to speak. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਸਪਤ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: su(n)nahu sapat paataal upaae ||
english: From the Primal Void, He created the seven nether regions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਭਵਣ ਰਖੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: su(n)nahu bhavan rakhe liv laae ||
english: From the Primal Void, He established this world to lovingly dwell upon Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: aape kaaran keeaa apara(n)par sabh tero keeaa kamaaidaa ||10||
english: The Infinite Lord Himself created the creation. Everyone acts as You make them act, Lord. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਜ ਤਮ ਸਤ ਕਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: raj tam sat kal teree chhaaiaa ||
english: Your Power is diffused through the three gunas: raajas, taamas and satva.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: janam maran haumai dukh paaiaa ||
english: Through egotism, they suffer the pains of birth and death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣਿ ਚਉਥੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: jis no kripaa kare har guramukh gun chauthai mukat karaaidaa ||11||
english: Those blessed by His Grace become Gurmukh; they attain the fourth state, and are liberated. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਉਪਜੇ ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: su(n)nahu upaje das avataaraa ||
english: From the Primal Void, the ten incarnations welled up.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: srisat upaai keeaa paasaaraa ||
english: Creating the Universe, He made the expanse.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਸਾਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: dev daanav gan ga(n)dharab saaje sabh likhiaa karam kamaaidaa ||12||
english: He fashioned the demi-gods and demons, the heavenly heralds and celestial musicians; everyone acts according to their past karma. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮਝੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh samajhai rog na hoee ||
english: The Gurmukh understands, and does not suffer the disease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ih gur kee pauRee jaanai jan koee ||
english: How rare are those who understand this ladder of the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jugah juga(n)tar mukat paraain so mukat bhaiaa pat paaidaa ||13||
english: Throughout the ages, they are dedicated to liberation, and so they become liberated; thus they are honored. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch tat su(n)nahu paragaasaa ||
english: From the Primal Void, the five elements became manifest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਕਰਮ ਅਭਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: deh sa(n)jogee karam abhiaasaa ||
english: They joined to form the body, which engages in actions.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖੇ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: buraa bhalaa dui masatak leekhe paap pu(n)n beejaaidaa ||14||
english: Both bad and good are written on the forehead, the seeds of vice and virtue. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: ootam satigur purakh niraale ||
english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is sublime and detached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: sabad rate har ras matavaale ||
english: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, He is intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: ridh budh sidh giaan guroo te paaeeai poorai bhaag milaaidaa ||15||
english: Riches, intellect, miraculous spiritual powers and spiritual wisdom are obtained from the Guru; through perfect destiny, they are received. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਘਨੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: is man maaiaa kau nehu ghaneraa ||
english: This mind is so in love with Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: koee boojhahu giaanee karahu niberaa ||
english: Only a few are spiritually wise enough to understand and know this.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਨਰੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: aasaa manasaa haumai sahasaa nar lobhee kooR kamaaidaa ||16||
english: In hope and desire, egotism and skepticism, the greedy man acts falsely. ||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur te paae veechaaraa ||
english: From the True Guru, contemplative meditation is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਚੇ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: su(n)n samaadh sache ghar baaraa ||
english: And then, one dwells with the True Lord in His celestial home, the Primal State of Absorption in Deepest Samaadhi.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੭॥੫॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak niramal naad sabad dhun sach raamai naam samaaidaa ||17||5||17||
english: O Nanak, the immaculate sound current of the Naad, and the Music of the Shabad resound; one merges into the True Name of the Lord. ||17||5||17||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah deen daiaalaa ||
english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord, merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: aai na jaaee prabh kirapaalaa ||
english: God is compassionate; He does not come or go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeeaa a(n)dar jugat samaaee rahio niraalam raaiaa ||1||
english: He pervades all beings in His mysterious way; the Sovereign Lord remains detached. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jag tis kee chhaaiaa jis baap na maaiaa ||
english: The world is a reflection of Him; He has no father or mother.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੈਣ ਨ ਭਰਾਉ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naa tis bhain na bharaau kamaaiaa ||
english: He has not acquired any sister or brother.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਓਪਤਿ ਖਪਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਜਾਤੀ ਓਹੁ ਅਜਰਾਵਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naa tis opat khapat kul jaatee ohu ajaraavar man bhaaiaa ||2||
english: There is no creation or destruction for Him; He has no ancestry or social status. The Ageless Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: too akaal purakh naahee sir kaalaa ||
english: You are the Deathless Primal Being. Death does not hover over Your head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਗੰਮ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: too purakh alekh aga(n)m niraalaa ||
english: You are the unseen inaccessible and detached Primal Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤਿ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh sabad at seetal sahaj bhaai liv laaiaa ||3||
english: You are true and content; the Word of Your Shabad is cool and soothing. Through it, we are lovingly, intuitively attuned to You. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਵਰਤਾਇ ਚਉਥੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: trai varataai chauthai ghar vaasaa ||
english: The three qualities are pervasive; the Lord dwells in His home, the fourth state.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਲ ਕੀਏ ਇਕ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: kaal bikaal keee ik graasaa ||
english: He has made death and birth into a bite of food.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: niramal jot sarab jagajeevan gur anahad sabad dikhaaiaa ||4||
english: The immaculate Light is the Life of the whole world. The Guru reveals the unstruck melody of the Shabad. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ootam jan sa(n)t bhale har piaare ||
english: Sublime and good are those humble Saints, the Beloveds of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har ras maate paar utaare ||
english: They are intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, and are carried across to the other side.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੇਣ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak ren sa(n)t jan sa(n)gat har gur parasaadee paaiaa ||5||
english: Nanak is the dust of the Society of the Saints; by Guru's Grace, he finds the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜੀਅ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: too a(n)tarajaamee jee sabh tere ||
english: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. All beings belong to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਮ ਸੇਵਕ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: too daataa ham sevak tere ||
english: You are the Great Giver; I am Your slave.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam kripaa kar deejai gur giaan ratan deepaaiaa ||6||
english: Please be merciful and bless me with Your Ambrosial Naam, and the jewel, the lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch tat mil ihu tan keeaa ||
english: From the union of the five elements, this body was made.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਪਾਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aatam raam paae sukh theeaa ||
english: Finding the Lord, the Supreme Soul, peace is established.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: karam karatoot a(n)mrit phal laagaa har naam ratan man paaiaa ||7||
english: The good karma of past actions brings fruitful rewards, and man is blessed with the jewel of the Lord's Name. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naa tis bhookh piaas man maaniaa ||
english: His mind does not feel any hunger or thirst.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sarab nira(n)jan ghat ghat jaaniaa ||
english: He knows the Immaculate Lord to be everywhere, in each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਕੇਵਲ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit ras raataa keval bairaagee guramat bhaai subhaaiaa ||8||
english: Imbued with the Lord's Ambrosial essence, he becomes a pure, detached renunciate; he is lovingly absorbed in the Guru's Teachings. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: adhiaatam karam kare din raatee ||
english: Whoever does the deeds of the soul, day and night,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: niramal jot nira(n)tar jaatee ||
english: sees the immaculate Divine Light deep within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਬੇਣੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: sabad rasaal rasan ras rasanaa ben rasaal vajaaiaa ||9||
english: Enraptured with the delightful essence of the Shabad, the source of nectar, my tongue plays the sweet music of the flute. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੇਣੁ ਰਸਾਲ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ben rasaal vajaavai soee ||
english: He alone plays the sweet music of this flute,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee tribhavan sojhee hoee ||
english: who knows the three worlds.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak boojhahu ih bidh guramat har raam naam liv laaiaa ||10||
english: O Nanak, know this, through the Guru's Teachings, and lovingly focus yourself on the Lord's Name. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aise jan virale sa(n)saare ||
english: Rare are those beings in this world,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gurasabad veechaarahi rahahi niraare ||
english: who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and remain detached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: aap tarahi sa(n)gat kul taarahi tin saphal janam jag aaiaa ||11||
english: They save themselves, and save all their associates and ancestors; fruitful is their birth and coming into this world. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ghar dar ma(n)dar jaanai soee ||
english: He alone knows the home of his own heart, and the door to the temple,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jis poore gur te sojhee hoee ||
english: who obtains perfect understanding from the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜ ਮਹਲ ਮਹਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: kaaiaa gaR mahal mahalee prabh saachaa sach saachaa takhat rachaaiaa ||12||
english: In the body-fortress is the palace; God is the True Master of this Palace. The True Lord established His True Throne there. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰ ਦਸ ਹਾਟ ਦੀਵੇ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: chatur das haat deeve dui saakhee ||
english: The fourteen realms and the two lamps are the witnesses.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਪੰਚ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਚਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: sevak pa(n)ch naahee bikh chaakhee ||
english: The Lord's servants, the self-elect, do not taste the poison of corruption.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: a(n)tar vasat anoop niramolak gur miliai har dhan paaiaa ||13||
english: Deep within, is the priceless, incomparable commodity; meeting with the Guru, the wealth of the Lord is obtained. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹੈ ਤਖਤੈ ਕੀ ਲਾਇਕ ॥
transliteration: takhat bahai takhatai kee laaik ||
english: He alone sits on the throne, who is worthy of the throne.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਮਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਕ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch samaae guramat paaik ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, he subdues the five demons, and becomes the Lord's foot soldier.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: aad jugaadee hai bhee hosee sahasaa bharam chukaaiaa ||14||
english: He has existed from the very beginning of time and throughout the ages; He exists here and now, and will always exist. Meditating on Him, skepticism and doubt are dispelled. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਖਤਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: takhat salaam hovai din raatee ||
english: The Lord of the Throne is greeted and worshipped day and night.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: ihu saach vadaaee guramat liv jaatee ||
english: This true glorious greatness comes to those who love the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੧॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak raam japahu tar taaree har a(n)t sakhaaee paaiaa ||15||1||18||
english: O Nanak, meditate on the Lord, and swim across the river; they find the Lord, their best friend, in the end. ||15||1||18||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਰੇ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har dhan sa(n)chahu re jan bhaaee ||
english: Gather in the wealth of the Lord, O humble Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev rahahu saranaaee ||
english: Serve the True Guru, and remain in His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਸਕਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tasakar chor na laagai taa kau dhun upajai sabad jagaaiaa ||1||
english: This wealth cannot be stolen; the celestial melody of the Shabad wells up and keeps us awake and aware. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: too eka(n)kaar niraalam raajaa ||
english: You are the One Universal Creator, the Immaculate King.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: too aap savaarahi jan ke kaajaa ||
english: You Yourself arrange and resolve the affairs of Your humble servant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: amar adol apaar amolak har asathir thaan suhaaiaa ||2||
english: You are immortal, immovable, infinite and priceless; O Lord, Your place is beautiful and eternal. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਊਤਮ ਥਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: dehee nagaree ootam thaanaa ||
english: In the body-village, the most sublime place,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਲੋਕ ਵਸਹਿ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch lok vasahi paradhaanaa ||
english: the supremely noble people dwell.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: oopar eka(n)kaar niraalam su(n)n samaadh lagaaiaa ||3||
english: Above them is the Immaculate Lord, the One Universal Creator; they are lovingly absorbed in the profound, primal state of Samaadhi. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: dehee nagaree nau daravaaje ||
english: There are nine gates to the body-village;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੈ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: sir sir karanaihaarai saaje ||
english: the Creator Lord fashioned them for each and every person.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਸਵੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: dasavai purakh ateet niraalaa aape alakh lakhaaiaa ||4||
english: Within the Tenth Gate, dwells the Primal Lord, detached and unequalled. The unknowable reveals Himself. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਸਚੇ ਦੀਵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: purakh alekh sache deevaanaa ||
english: The Primal Lord cannot be held to account; True is His Celestial Court.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: hukam chalaae sach neesaanaa ||
english: The Hukam of His Command is in effect; True is His Insignia.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak khoj lahahu ghar apanaa har aatam raam naam paaiaa ||5||
english: O Nanak, search and examine your own home, and you shall find the Supreme Soul, and the Name of the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sarab nira(n)jan purakh sujaanaa ||
english: The Primal Lord is everywhere, immaculate and all-knowing.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਦਲੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: adal kare gur giaan samaanaa ||
english: He administers justice, and is absorbed in the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੈ ਗਰਦਨਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lai garadan maare haumai lobh chukaaiaa ||6||
english: He seizes sexual desire and anger by their necks, and kills them; He eradicates egotism and greed. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachai thaan vasai nira(n)kaaraa ||
english: In the True Place, the Formless Lord abides.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aap pachhaanai sabad veechaaraa ||
english: Whoever understands his own self, contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sachai mahal nivaas nira(n)tar aavan jaan chukaaiaa ||7||
english: He comes to abide deep within the True Mansion of His Presence, and his comings and goings are ended. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਪਉਣੁ ਉਡਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naa man chalai na paun udaavai ||
english: His mind does not waver, and he is not buffeted by the winds of desire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jogee sabad anaahad vaavai ||
english: Such a Yogi vibrates the unstruck sound current of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਾਇ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch sabad jhunakaar niraalam prabh aape vaai sunaaiaa ||8||
english: God Himself plays the pure music of the Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds to hear. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਬੈਰਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: bhau bairaagaa sahaj samaataa ||
english: In the Fear of God, in detachment, one intuitively merges into the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਅਨਹਦਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai tiaagee anahad raataa ||
english: Renouncing egotism, he is imbued with the unstruck sound current.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: a(n)jan saar nira(n)jan jaanai sarab nira(n)jan raaiaa ||9||
english: With the ointment of enlightenment, the Immaculate Lord is known; the Immaculate Lord King is pervading everywhere. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: dukh bhai bha(n)jan prabh abinaasee ||
english: God is eternal and imperishable; He is the Destroyer of pain and fear.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਕਟੇ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: rog kate kaatee jam phaasee ||
english: He cures the disease, and cuts away the noose of death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak har prabh so bhau bha(n)jan gur miliai har prabh paaiaa ||10||
english: O Nanak, the Lord God is the Destroyer of fear; meeting the Guru, the Lord God is found. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੈ ਕਵਲੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: kaalai kaval nira(n)jan jaanai ||
english: One who knows the Immaculate Lord chews up death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝੈ ਕਰਮੁ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: boojhai karam s sabad pachhaanai ||
english: One who understands karma, realizes the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਚੋਜੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: aape jaanai aap pachhaanai sabh tis kaa choj sabaaiaa ||11||
english: He Himself knows, and He Himself realizes. This whole world is all His play. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape saahu aape vanajaaraa ||
english: He Himself is the Banker, and He Himself is the Merchant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape parakhe parakhanahaaraa ||
english: The Appraiser Himself appraises.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: aape kas kasavatee laae aape keemat paaiaa ||12||
english: He Himself tests upon His Touchstone, and He Himself estimates the value. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aap daiaal daiaa prabh dhaaree ||
english: God Himself, the Merciful Lord, grants His Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat rav rahiaa banavaaree ||
english: The Gardener pervades and permeates each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: purakh ateet vasai nihakeval gur purakhai purakh milaaiaa ||13||
english: The pure, primal, detached Lord abides within all. The Guru, the Lord Incarnate, leads us to meet the Lord God. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: prabh daanaa beenaa garab gavaae ||
english: God is wise and all-knowing; He purges men of their pride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਮੇਟੈ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
transliteration: doojaa metai ek dikhaae ||
english: Eradicating duality, the One Lord reveals Himself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: aasaa maahi niraalam jonee akul nira(n)jan gaaiaa ||14||
english: Such a being remains unattached amidst hope, singing the Praise of the Immaculate Lord, who has no ancestry. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: haumai met sabad sukh hoee ||
english: Eradicating egotism, he obtains the peace of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aap veechaare giaanee soee ||
english: He alone is spiritually wise, who contemplates his own self.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੨॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak har jas har gun laahaa satasa(n)gat sach phal paaiaa ||15||2||19||
english: O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the true profit is obtained; in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the fruit of Truth is obtained. ||15||2||19||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਸਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sach kahahu sachai ghar rahanaa ||
english: Speak the Truth, and remain in the home of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jeevat marahu bhavajal jag taranaa ||
english: Remain dead while yet alive, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur bohith gur beRee tulahaa man har jap paar la(n)ghaaiaa ||1||
english: The Guru is the boat, the ship, the raft; meditating on the Lord in your mind, you shall be carried across to the other side. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਲੋਭ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa lobh binaasan ||
english: Eliminating egotism, possessiveness and greed,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਦਰ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਦਸਵੈ ਆਸਨੁ ॥
transliteration: nau dar mukate dasavai aasan ||
english: one is liberated from the nine gates, and obtains a place in the Tenth Gate.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: oopar parai parai apara(n)par jin aape aap upaaiaa ||2||
english: Lofty and high, the farthest of the far and infinite, He created Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: guramat levahu har liv tareeai ||
english: Receiving the Guru's Teachings, and lovingly attuned to the Lord, one crosses over.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਲੁ ਗਾਇ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਡਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: akal gaai jam te kiaa dareeai ||
english: Singing the Praises of the absolute Lord, why should anyone be afraid of death?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jat jat dekhau tat tat tum hee avar na duteeaa gaaiaa ||3||
english: Wherever I look, I see only You; I do not sing of any other at all. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sach har naam sach hai saranaa ||
english: True is the Lord's Name, and True is His Sanctuary.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਜਿਤੈ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: sach gurasabad jitai lag taranaa ||
english: True is the Word of the Guru's Shabad, grasping it, one is carries across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: akath kathai dekhai apara(n)par phun garabh na jonee jaaiaa ||4||
english: Speaking the Unspoken, one sees the Infinite Lord, and then, he does not have to enter the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sach bin sat sa(n)tokh na paavai ||
english: Without the Truth, no one finds sincerity or contentment.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: bin gur mukat na aavai jaavai ||
english: Without the Guru, no one is liberated; coming and going in reincarnation continue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: mool ma(n)tr har naam rasaain kahu naanak pooraa paaiaa ||5||
english: Chanting the Mool Mantra, and the Name of the Lord, the source of nectar, says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sach bin bhavajal jaai na tariaa ||
english: Without the Truth, the terrifying world-ocean cannot be crossed.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ehu samu(n)d athaahu mahaa bikh bhariaa ||
english: This ocean is vast and unfathomable; it is overflowing with the worst poison.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: rahai ateet guramat le oopar har nirabhau kai ghar paaiaa ||6||
english: One who receives the Guru's Teachings, and remains aloof and detached, obtains a place in the home of the Fearless Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੀ ਜਗ ਹਿਤ ਕੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jhoothee jag hit kee chaturaaee ||
english: False is the cleverness of loving attachment to the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bilam na laagai aavai jaaee ||
english: In no time at all, it comes and goes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਖਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naam visaar chalahi abhimaanee upajai binas khapaaiaa ||7||
english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the proud egotistical people depart; in creation and destruction they are wasted away. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਪਜਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਬੰਧੇ ॥
transliteration: upajahi binasahi ba(n)dhan ba(n)dhe ||
english: In creation and destruction, they are bound in bondage.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਗਲਿ ਫੰਧੇ ॥
transliteration: haumai maaiaa ke gal pha(n)dhe ||
english: The noose of egotism and Maya is around their necks.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jis raam naam naahee mat guramat so jam pur ba(n)dh chalaaiaa ||8||
english: Whoever does not accept the Guru's Teachings, and does not dwell upon the Lord's Name, is bound and bagged, and dragged into the City of Death. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: gur bin mokh mukat kiu paaeeai ||
english: Without the Guru, how can anyone be emancipated or liberated?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
transliteration: bin gur raam naam kiu dhiaaeeai ||
english: Without the Guru, how can anyone meditate on the Lord's Name?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਤਰਹੁ ਭਵ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: guramat lehu tarahu bhav dutar mukat bhae sukh paaiaa ||9||
english: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, cross over the arduous, terrifying world-ocean; you shall be emancipated, and find peace. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨਿ ਗੋਵਰਧਨ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramat krisan govaradhan dhaare ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, Krishna lifted up the mountain of Govardhan.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਇਰਿ ਪਾਹਣ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramat saair paahan taare ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, Rama floated stones across the ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: guramat lehu param pad paaeeai naanak gur bharam chukaaiaa ||10||
english: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, the supreme status is obtained; O Nanak, the Guru eradicates doubt. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਤਰਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: guramat lehu tarahu sach taaree ||
english: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, cross over to the other side through Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਚੀਨਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aatam cheenahu ridai muraaree ||
english: O soul, remember the Lord within your heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: jam ke phaahe kaatahi har jap akul nira(n)jan paaiaa ||11||
english: The noose of death is cut away, meditating on the Lord; you shall obtain the Immaculate Lord, who has no ancestry. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪੰਚ ਸਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramat pa(n)ch sakhe gur bhaaee ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Holy become one's friends and Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramat agan nivaar samaaee ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the inner fire is subdued and extinguished.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: man mukh naam japahu jagajeevan rid a(n)tar alakh lakhaaiaa ||12||
english: Chant the Naam with your mind and mouth; know the unknowable Lord, the Life of the World, deep within the nucleus of your heart. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh boojhai sabad pateejai ||
english: The Gurmukh understands, and is pleased with the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: usatat ni(n)daa kis kee keejai ||
english: Who does he praise or slander?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੀਨਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: cheenahu aap japahu jagadeesar har jaga(n)naath man bhaaiaa ||13||
english: Know yourself, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe; let your mind be pleased with the Lord, the Master of the Universe. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਿ ਖੰਡਿ ਸੋ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jo brahama(n)d kha(n)d so jaanahu ||
english: Know the One who pervades all the realms of the universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh boojhahu sabad pachhaanahu ||
english: As Gurmukh, understand and realize the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰਾ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: ghat ghat bhoge bhoganahaaraa rahai ateet sabaaiaa ||14||
english: The Enjoyer enjoys each and every heart, and yet He remains detached from all. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੂਚਾ ॥
transliteration: guramat bolahu har jas soochaa ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, chant the Pure Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਖੀ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਊਚਾ ॥
transliteration: guramat aakhee dekhahu oochaa ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, behold the lofty Lord with your eyes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੩॥੨੦॥
transliteration: sravanee naam sunai har baanee naanak har ra(n)g ra(n)gaaiaa ||15||3||20||
english: Whoever listens to the Lord's Name, and the Word of His Bani, O Nanak, is imbued with the color of the Lord's Love. ||15||3||20||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪਰਹਰੁ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh parahar par ni(n)daa ||
english: Leave behind sexual desire, anger and the slander of others.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਜਿ ਹੋਹੁ ਨਿਚਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: lab lobh taj hohu nichi(n)daa ||
english: Renounce greed and possessiveness, and become carefree.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਤੋੜਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhram kaa sa(n)gal toR niraalaa har a(n)tar har ras paaiaa ||1||
english: Break the chains of doubt, and remain unattached; you shall find the Lord, and the Lord's sublime essence, deep within yourself. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਦਾਮਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਚਮਕਿ ਚੰਦਾਇਣੁ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: nis daaman jiu chamak cha(n)daain dekhai ||
english: As one sees the flash of lightning in the night,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਪੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: ahinis jot nira(n)tar pekhai ||
english: see the Divine Light deep within your nucleus, day and night.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਸਰੂਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aana(n)d roop anoop saroopaa gur poorai dekhaaiaa ||2||
english: The Lord, the embodiment of bliss, incomparably beautiful, reveals the Perfect Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur milahu aape prabh taare ||
english: So meet with the True Guru, and God Himself will save you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਗੈਣਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sas ghar soor deepak gainaare ||
english: He placed the lamps of the sun and the moon in the home of the sky.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਭੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: dekh adisat rahahu liv laagee sabh tribhavan braham sabaaiaa ||3||
english: See the invisible Lord, and remain absorbed in loving devotion. God is all throughout the three worlds. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭਉ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit ras paae trisanaa bhau jaae ||
english: Obtaining the sublime ambrosial essence, desire and fear are dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਭਉ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anabhau pad paavai aap gavaae ||
english: The state of inspired illumination is obtained, and self-conceit is eradicated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਚੀ ਪਦਵੀ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: oochee padavee oocho oochaa niramal sabad kamaaiaa ||4||
english: The lofty and exalted state, the highest of the high is obtained, practicing the immaculate Word of the Shabad. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: adrisat agochar naam apaaraa ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the invisible and unfathomable Lord, is infinite.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: at ras meethaa naam piaaraa ||
english: The sublime essence of the Beloved Naam is utterly sweet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak kau jug jug har jas deejai har japeeai a(n)t na paaiaa ||5||
english: O Lord, please bless Nanak with Your Praise in each and every age; meditating on the Lord, I cannot find His limits. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar naam paraapat heeraa ||
english: With the Naam deep within the nucleus of the self, the jewel is obtained.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har japate man man te dheeraa ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, the mind is comforted and consoled by the mind itself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੁਘਟ ਘਟ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: dughat ghat bhau bha(n)jan paaeeai baahuR janam na jaaiaa ||6||
english: On that most difficult path, the Destroyer of fear is found, and one does not have to enter the womb of reincarnation again. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagat het gur sabad tara(n)gaa ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, inspiration for loving devotional worship wells up.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੰਗਾ ॥
transliteration: har jas naam padaarath ma(n)gaa ||
english: I beg for the treasure of the Naam, and the Lord's Praise.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: har bhaavai gur mel milaae har taare jagat sabaaiaa ||7||
english: When it pleases the Lord, He unites me in Union with the Guru; the Lord saves the whole world. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਵਾ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: jin jap japio satigur mat vaa ke ||
english: One who chants the Lord's Chant, attains the Wisdom of the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਪਗ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥
transliteration: jamaka(n)kar kaal sevak pag taa ke ||
english: The tyrant, the Messenger of Death, becomes a servant at his feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਜਗੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: ootam sa(n)gat gat mit ootam jag bhaujal paar taraaiaa ||8||
english: In the noble congregation of the Sangat, one's state and way of life become noble as well, and one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: ihu bhavajal jagat sabad gur tareeai ||
english: Through the Shabad, one crosses over this terrifying world-ocean.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kee dubidhaa a(n)tar jareeai ||
english: The duality within is burnt away from within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਬਾਣ ਲੇ ਜਮ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੈ ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch baan le jam kau maarai gagana(n)tar dhanakh chaRaaiaa ||9||
english: Taking up the five arrows of virtue, Death is killed, drawing the Bow of the Tenth Gate in the Mind's Sky. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: saakat nar sabad surat kiu paaeeai ||
english: How can the faithless cynics attain enlightened awareness of the Shabad?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਈਐ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: sabad surat bin aaeeai jaaeeai ||
english: Without awareness of the Shabad, they come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh mukat paraain har poorai bhaag milaaiaa ||10||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains the support of liberation; by perfect destiny, he meets the Lord. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau satigur hai rakhavaalaa ||
english: The Fearless True Guru is our Savior and Protector.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagat paraapat gur gopaalaa ||
english: Devotional worship is obtained through the Guru, the Lord of the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: dhun ana(n)d anaahad vaajai gur sabad nira(n)jan paaiaa ||11||
english: The blissful music of the unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Immaculate Lord is obtained. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸੋ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau so sir naahee lekhaa ||
english: He alone is fearless, who has no destiny written on His head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੇਖਾ ॥
transliteration: aap alekh kudarat hai dekhaa ||
english: God Himself is unseen; He reveals Himself through His wondrous creative power.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: aap ateet ajonee sa(n)bhau naanak guramat so paaiaa ||12||
english: He Himself is unattached, unborn and self-existent. O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, He is found. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kee gat satigur jaanai ||
english: The True Guru knows the state of one's inner being.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: so nirabhau gur sabad pachhaanai ||
english: He alone is fearless, who realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: a(n)tar dekh nira(n)tar boojhai anat na man dolaaiaa ||13||
english: He looks within his own inner being, and realizes the Lord within all; his mind does not waver at all. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸੋ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau so abh a(n)tar vasiaa ||
english: He alone is fearless, within whose being the Lord abides.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਰਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ahinis naam nira(n)jan rasiaa ||
english: Day and night, he is delighted with the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak har jas sa(n)gat paaeeai har sahaje sahaj milaaiaa ||14||
english: O Nanak, in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the Lord's Praise is obtained, and one easily, intuitively meets the Lord. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar so prabh jaanai ||
english: One who knows God, within the self and beyond,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਚਲਤੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ॥
transliteration: rahai alipat chalate ghar aanai ||
english: remains detached, and brings his wandering mind back to its home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਸਰਬ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੪॥੨੧॥
transliteration: oopar aad sarab tihu loee sach naanak a(n)mrit ras paaiaa ||15||4||21||
english: The True Primal Lord is over all the three worlds; O Nanak, His Ambrosial Nectar is obtained. ||15||4||21||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
english: Maaroo, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kudarat karanaihaar apaaraa ||
