english: The Creator Lord is infinite; His creative power is wondrous.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤੇ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਹੁ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: keete kaa naahee kihu chaaraa ||
english: Created beings have no power over Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦੇ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jee upaai rijak de aape sir sir hukam chalaaiaa ||1||
english: He formed the living beings, and He Himself sustains them; the Hukam of His Command controls each and every one. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hukam chalaai rahiaa bharapoore ||
english: The all-pervading Lord orchestrates all through His Hukam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਾਂ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kis neRai kis aakhaa(n) doore ||
english: Who is near, and who is far away?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਾਕੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gupat pragat har ghat ghat dekhahu varatai taak sabaaiaa ||2||
english: Behold the Lord, both hidden and manifest, in each and every heart; the unique Lord is permeating all. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis kau mele surat samaae ||
english: One whom the Lord unites with Himself, merges in conscious awareness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee har naam dhiaae ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, meditate on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭਰਮੁ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aanad roop anoop agochar gur miliai bharam jaaiaa ||3||
english: God is the embodiment of bliss, incomparably beautiful and unfathomable; meeting with the Guru, doubt is dispelled. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan dhan te naam piaaraa ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is more dear to me than my mind, body and wealth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਚਲਣਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t sakhaaee chalanavaaraa ||
english: In the end, when I must depart, it shall be my only help and support.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: moh pasaar nahee sa(n)g belee bin har gur kin sukh paaiaa ||4||
english: In this world of love and attachment, no one is anyone else's friend or companion; without the Lord, without the Guru, who has ever found peace? ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis kau nadar kare gur pooraa ||
english: He, unto whom the Perfect Guru grants His Grace,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad milaae guramat sooraa ||
english: is merged in the Word of the Shabad, through the Teachings of the brave, heroic Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak gur ke charan sarevahu jin bhoolaa maarag paaiaa ||5||
english: O Nanak, dwell upon, and serve at the Guru's feet; He places those who wander back on the Path. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa(n) har dhan jas piaaraa ||
english: The wealth of the Lord's Praise is very dear to the humble Saints.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramat paaiaa naam tumaaraa ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained Your Name, Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jaachik sev kare dar har kai har daragah jas gaaiaa ||6||
english: The beggar serves at the Lord's door, and in the Court of the Lord, sings His Praises. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta mahal bulaae ||
english: When one meets the True Guru, he is called into the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saachee daragah gat pat paae ||
english: In the True Court, he is blessed with salvation and honor.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਠਉਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਜਨਮ ਮਰੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: saakat thaur naahee har ma(n)dar janam marai dukh paaiaa ||7||
english: The faithless cynic has no place of rest in the Lord's palace; he suffers the pains of birth and death. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: sevahu satigur samu(n)d athaahaa ||
english: So serve the True Guru, the unfathomable ocean,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: paavahu naam ratan dhan laahaa ||
english: and you shall obtain the profit, the wealth, the jewel of the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: bikhiaa mal jaai a(n)mrit sar naavahu gur sar sa(n)tokh paaiaa ||8||
english: The filth of corruption is washed away, by bathing in the pool of Ambrosial Nectar. In the Guru's pool, contentment is obtained. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਕ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahu sa(n)k na keejai ||
english: So serve the Guru without hesitation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਰਹੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: aasaa maahi niraas raheejai ||
english: And in the midst of hope, remain unmoved by hope.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: sa(n)saa dookh binaasan sevahu phir baahuR rog na laaiaa ||9||
english: Serve the Eradicator of cynicism and suffering, and you shall never again be afflicted by the disease. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਡੀਆਏ ॥
transliteration: saache bhaavai tis vadeeaae ||
english: One who is pleasing to the True Lord is blessed with glorious greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਸੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kaun s doojaa tis samajhaae ||
english: Who else can teach him anything?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: har gur moorat ekaa varatai naanak har gur bhaaiaa ||10||
english: The Lord and the Guru are pervading in one form. O Nanak, the Lord loves the Guru. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਚਹਿ ਪੁਸਤਕ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: vaachahi pusatak ved puraanaa(n) ||
english: Some read scriptures, the Vedas and the Puraanas.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਬਹਿ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਸੁਨਾਵਹਿ ਕਾਨਾਂ ॥
transliteration: ik bahi sunahi sunaavahi kaanaa(n) ||
english: Some sit and listen, and read to others.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਜਗਰ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਖੁਲੑੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: ajagar kapat kahahu kiu khulhai bin satigur tat na paaiaa ||11||
english: Tell me, how can the heavy, rigid doors be opened? Without the True Guru, the essence of reality is not realized. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਲਗਾਵਹਿ ਭਸਮੈ ॥
transliteration: karahi bibhoot lagaavahi bhasamai ||
english: Some collect dust, and smear their bodies with ashes;

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ ਸੁ ਹਉਮੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar krodh cha(n)daal s haumai ||
english: but deep within them are the outcasts of anger and egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕੀਨੇ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d keene jog na paaeeai bin satigur alakh na paaiaa ||12||
english: Practicing hypocrisy, Yoga is not obtained; without the True Guru, the unseen Lord is not found. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਦਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: teerath varat nem karahi udiaanaa ||
english: Some make vows to visit sacred shrines of pilgrimage, keep fasts and live in the forest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਥਹਿ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jat sat sa(n)jam kathahi giaanaa ||
english: Some practice chastity, charity and self-discipline, and speak of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: raam naam bin kiu sukh paaeeai bin satigur bharam na jaaiaa ||13||
english: But without the Lord's Name, how can anyone find peace? Without the True Guru, doubt is not dispelled. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਉਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਭਾਠੀ ॥
transliteration: niulee karam bhuia(n)gam bhaathee ||
english: Inner cleansing techniques, channeling the energy to raise the Kundalini to the Tenth Gate,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੇਚਕ ਕੁੰਭਕ ਪੂਰਕ ਮਨ ਹਾਠੀ ॥
transliteration: rechak ku(n)bhak poorak man haathee ||
english: inhaling, exhaling and holding the breath by the force of the mind -

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡ ਧਰਮੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਉ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d dharam preet nahee har sau gurasabad mahaa ras paaiaa ||14||
english: by empty hypocritical practices, Dharmic love for the Lord is not produced. Only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the sublime, supreme essence obtained. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kudarat dekh rahe man maaniaa ||
english: Seeing the Lord's creative power, my mind remains satisfied.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee sabh braham pachhaaniaa ||
english: Through the Guru's Shabad, I have realized that all is God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੫॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak aatam raam sabaaiaa gur satigur alakh lakhaaiaa ||15||5||22||
english: O Nanak, the Lord, the Supreme Soul, is in all. The Guru, the True Guru, has inspired me to see the unseen Lord. ||15||5||22||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Solhay, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hukamee sahaje srisat upaaee ||
english: By the Hukam of His Command, He effortlessly created the Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਅਪਣੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: kar kar vekhai apanee vadiaaee ||
english: Creating the creation, He gazes upon His own greatness.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae aape hukame rahiaa samaaee he ||1||
english: He Himself acts, and inspires all to act; in His Will, He pervades and permeates all. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu jagat gubaaraa ||
english: The world is in the darkness of love and attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh boojhai ko veechaaraa ||
english: How rare is that Gurmukh who contemplates, and understands.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape nadar kare so paae aape mel milaaee he ||2||
english: He alone attains the Lord, unto whom He grants His Grace. He Himself unites in His Union. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: aape mele de vadiaaee ||
english: Uniting with Himself, He bestows glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee keemat paaee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to know the Lord's worth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: manamukh bahut phirai bilalaadee doojai bhaai khuaaee he ||3||
english: The self-willed manmukh wanders everywhere, weeping and wailing; he is utterly ruined by the love of duality. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: haumai maaiaa viche paaee ||
english: Egotism was instilled into the illusion of Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhoole pat gavaaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is deluded, and loses his honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਇ ਰਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai so naai raachai saachai rahiaa samaaee he ||4||
english: But one who becomes Gurmukh is absorbed in the Name; he remains immersed in the True Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur te giaan naam ratan paaiaa ||
english: Spiritual wisdom is obtained from the Guru, along with the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: manasaa maar man maahi samaaiaa ||
english: Desires are subdued, and one remains immersed in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aape khel kare sabh karataa aape dei bujhaaee he ||5||
english: The Creator Himself stages all His plays; He Himself bestows understanding. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur seve aap gavaae ||
english: One who serves the True Guru eradicates self-conceit.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mil preetam sabad sukh paae ||
english: Meeting with his Beloved, he finds peace through the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਤੇ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: a(n)tar piaar bhagatee raataa sahaj mate ban aaee he ||6||
english: Deep within his inner being, he is imbued with loving devotion; intuitively, he becomes one with the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: dookh nivaaran gur te jaataa ||
english: The Destroyer of pain is known through the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aap miliaa jagajeevan daataa ||
english: The Great Giver, the Life of the world, Himself has met me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਭਉ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jis no laae soee boojhai bhau bharam sareerahu jaaee he ||7||
english: He alone understands, whom the Lord joins with Himself. Fear and doubt are taken away from his body. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aape guramukh aape devai ||
english: He Himself is the Gurmukh, and He Himself bestows His blessings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad satigur sevai ||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, serve the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਰਾ ਜਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jaraa jam tis johi na saakai saache siu ban aaee he ||8||
english: Old age and death cannot even touch one who is in harmony with the True Lord. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa agan jalai sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The world is burning up in the fire of desire.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਖਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jal jal khapai bahut vikaaraa ||
english: It burns and burns, and is destroyed in all its corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕਬਹੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: manamukh thaur na paae kabahoo satigur boojh bujhaaee he ||9||
english: The self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest anywhere. The True Guru has imparted this understanding. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevan se vadabhaagee ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: saachai naam sadaa liv laagee ||
english: They remain lovingly focused on the True Name forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: a(n)tar naam raviaa nihakeval trisanaa sabad bujhaaee he ||10||
english: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, permeates the nucleus of their inner being; through the Shabad, their desires are quenched. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sachaa sabad sachee hai baanee ||
english: True is the Word of the Shabad, and True is the Bani of His Word.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralai kinai pachhaanee ||
english: How rare is that Gurmukh who realizes this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: sachai sabad rate bairaagee aavan jaan rahaaee he ||11||
english: Those who are imbued with the True Shabad are detached. Their comings and goings in reincarnation are ended. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabad bujhai so mail chukaae ||
english: One who realizes the Shabad is cleansed of impurities.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: niramal naam vasai man aae ||
english: The Immaculate Naam abides within his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: satigur apanaa sad hee sevahi haumai vichahu jaaee he ||12||
english: He serves his True Guru forever, and egotism is eradicated from within. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: gur te boojhai taa dar soojhai ||
english: If one comes to understand, through the Guru, then he comes to know the Lord's Door.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: naam vihoonaa kath kath loojhai ||
english: But without the Naam, one babbles and argues in vain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਗਵਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: satigur seve kee vadiaaee trisanaa bhookh gavaaee he ||13||
english: The glory of serving the True Guru is that it eradicates hunger and thirst. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: aape aap milai taa boojhai ||
english: When the Lord unites them with Himself, then they come to understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: giaan vihoonaa kichhoo na soojhai ||
english: Without spiritual wisdom, they understand nothing at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: gur kee daat sadaa man a(n)tar baanee sabad vajaaee he ||14||
english: One whose mind is filled with the Guru's gift forever - his inner being resounds with the Shabad, and the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa s karam kamaaiaa ||
english: He acts according to his pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: koi na metai dhur phuramaaiaa ||
english: No one can erase the Command of the Primal Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਵਾਸਾ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat mahi tin hee vaasaa jin kau dhur likh paaee he ||15||
english: They alone dwell in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: apanee nadar kare so paae ||
english: He alone finds the Lord, unto whom He grants His Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad taaRee chit laae ||
english: He links his consciousness to the deep meditative state of the True Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak daas kahai bena(n)tee bheekhiaa naam dar paaee he ||16||1||
english: Nanak, Your slave, offers this humble prayer; I stand at Your Door, begging for Your Name. ||16||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: eko ek varatai sabh soee ||
english: The One and only Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koee ||
english: How rare is that person, who as Gurmukh, understands this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: eko rav rahiaa sabh a(n)tar tis bin avar na koee he ||1||
english: The One Lord is permeating and pervading, deep within the nucleus of all. Without Him, there is no other at all. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jee upaae ||
english: He created the 8.4 millions species of beings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: giaanee dhiaanee aakh sunaae ||
english: The spiritual teachers and meditators proclaim this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੇ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਰ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabhanaa rijak samaahe aape keemat hor na hoee he ||2||
english: He Himself nourishes all; no one else can estimate His value. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu a(n)dh a(n)dhaaraa ||
english: Love and attachment to Maya are utter darkness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai meraa pasariaa paasaaraa ||
english: Egotism and possessiveness have spread throughout the expanse of the universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anadin jalat rahai din raatee gur bin saa(n)t na hoee he ||3||
english: Night and day, they burn, day and night; without the Guru, there is no peace or tranquility. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aape joR vichhoRe aape ||
english: He Himself unites, and He Himself separates.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aape thaap uthaape aape ||
english: He Himself establishes, and He Himself disestablishes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ਹੋਰਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sachaa hukam sachaa paasaaraa horan hukam na hoee he ||4||
english: True is the Hukam of His Command, and True is the expanse of His universe. No one else can issue any Command. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: aape laai lae so laagai ||
english: He alone is attached to the Lord, whom the Lord attaches to Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee jam kaa bhau bhaagai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the fear of death runs away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: a(n)tar sabad sadaa sukhadaataa guramukh boojhai koee he ||5||
english: The Shabad, the Giver of peace, dwells forever deep within the nucleus of the self. One who is Gurmukh understands. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape mele mel milaae ||
english: God Himself unites those united in His Union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: purab likhiaa so metanaa na jaae ||
english: Whatever is pre-ordained by destiny, cannot be erased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat kare din raatee guramukh sevaa hoee he ||6||
english: Night and day, His devotees worship Him, day and night; one who becomes Gurmukh serves Him. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh jaataa ||
english: Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is experienced.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aape aai miliaa sabhanaa kaa daataa ||
english: He Himself, the Giver of all, has come and met me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: haumai maar trisanaa agan nivaaree sabad cheen sukh hoee he ||7||
english: Subduing egotism, the fire of thirst has been extinguished; contemplating the Word of the Shabad, peace is found. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kuta(n)b mohu na boojhai ||
english: One who is attached to his body and family, does not understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤ ਆਖੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai ta aakhee soojhai ||
english: But one who becomes Gurmukh, sees the Lord with his eyes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: anadin naam ravai din raatee mil preetam sukh hoee he ||8||
english: Night and day, he chants the Naam, day and night; meeting with his Beloved, he finds peace. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਧਾਤੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਹੈ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh dhaat doojai hai laagaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukh wanders distracted, attached to duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਤ ਕੀ ਨ ਮੂਓ ਆਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: janamat kee na mooo aabhaagaa ||
english: That unfortunate wretch - why didn't he just die as soon as he was born?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: aavat jaat birathaa janam gavaaiaa bin gur mukat na hoee he ||9||
english: Coming and going, he wastes away his life in vain. Without the Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kusudh haumai mal laaee ||
english: That body which is stained with the filth of egotism is false and impure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: je sau dhovahi taa mail na jaaee ||
english: It may be washed a hundred times, but its filth is still not removed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਧੋਪੈ ਤਾ ਹਛੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: sabad dhopai taa hachhee hovai phir mailee mool na hoee he ||10||
english: But if it is washed with the Word of the Shabad, then it is truly cleansed, and it shall never be soiled again. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੰਘਾਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch doot kaaiaa sa(n)ghaarahi ||
english: The five demons destroy the body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mahi sabad na veechaarahi ||
english: He dies and dies again, only to be reincarnated; he does not contemplate the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: a(n)tar maaiaa moh gubaaraa jiu supanai sudh na hoee he ||11||
english: The darkness of emotional attachment to Maya is within his inner being; as if in a dream, he does not understand. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪੰਚਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਹੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: ik pa(n)chaa maar sabad hai laage ||
english: Some conquer the five demons, by being attached to the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur aai miliaa vadabhaage ||
english: They are blessed and very fortunate; the True Guru comes to meet them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਵਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: a(n)tar saach ravahi ra(n)g raate sahaj samaavai soee he ||12||
english: Within the nucleus of their inner being, they dwell upon the Truth; attuned to the Lord's Love, they intuitively merge in Him. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਾਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kee chaal guroo te jaapai ||
english: The Guru's Way is known through the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: pooraa sevak sabad sinjaapai ||
english: His perfect servant attains realization through the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: sadaa sabad ravai ghat a(n)tar rasanaa ras chaakhai sach soee he ||13||
english: Deep within his heart, he dwells forever upon the Shabad; he tastes the sublime essence of the True Lord with his tongue. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: haumai maare sabad nivaare ||
english: Egotism is conquered and subdued by the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam rakhai ur dhaare ||
english: I have enshrined the Name of the Lord within my heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਉ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: ekas bin hau hor na jaanaa sahaje hoi s hoee he ||14||
english: Other than the One Lord, I know nothing at all. Whatever will be, will automatically be. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਹਜੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur sahaj kinai nahee paaiaa ||
english: Without the True Guru, no one obtains intuitive wisdom.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh boojhai sach samaaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukh understands, and is immersed in the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: sachaa sev sabad sach raate haumai sabade khoee he ||15||
english: He serves the True Lord, and is attuned to the True Shabad. The Shabad banishes egotism. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aape gunadaataa beechaaree ||
english: He Himself is the Giver of virtue, the Contemplative Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh devahi pakee saaree ||
english: The Gurmukh is given the winning dice.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam samaavahi saachai saache te pat hoee he ||16||2||
english: O Nanak, immersed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one becomes true; from the True Lord, honor is obtained. ||16||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan saachaa eko daataa ||
english: One One True Lord is the Life of the World, the Great Giver.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te sabad pachhaataa ||
english: Serving the Guru, through the Word of the Shabad, He is realized.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਅਮਰੁ ਏਕਾ ਪਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: eko amar ekaa patisaahee jug jug sir kaar banaaee he ||1||
english: There is only One Command, and there is only One Supreme King. In each and every age, He links each to their tasks. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: so jan niramal jin aap pachhaataa ||
english: That humble being is immaculate, who knows his own self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aape aai miliaa sukhadaataa ||
english: The Lord, the Giver of peace, Himself comes and meets him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: rasanaa sabad ratee gun gaavai dar saachai pat paaee he ||2||
english: His tongue is imbued with the Shabad, and he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; he is honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam milai vadiaaee ||
english: The Gurmukh is blessed with the glorious greatness of the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਿੰਦਕਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh ni(n)dak pat gavaaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukh, the slanderer, loses his honor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naam rate param ha(n)s bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laaee he ||3||
english: Attuned to the Naam, the supreme soul-swans remain detached; in the home of the self, they remain absorbed in deep meditative trance. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad marai soee jan pooraa ||
english: That humble being who dies in the Shabad is perfect.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur aakh sunaae sooraa ||
english: The brave, heroic True Guru chants and proclaims this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar a(n)mrit sar saachaa man peevai bhaai subhaaee he ||4||
english: Deep within the body is the true pool of Ambrosial Nectar; the mind drinks it in with loving devotion. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: paR pa(n)dit avaraa samajhaae ||
english: The Pandit, the religious scholar, reads and instructs others,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਜਲਤੇ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ghar jalate kee khabar na paae ||
english: but he does not realize that his own home is on fire.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve naam na paaeeai paR thaake saa(n)t na aaee he ||5||
english: Without serving the True Guru, the Naam is not obtained. You can read until you are exhausted, but you shall not find peace and tranquility. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ik bhasam lagaai phirahi bhekhadhaaree ||
english: Some smear their bodies with ashes, and wander around in religious disguises.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਿਨਿ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai haumai kin maaree ||
english: Without the Word of the Shabad, who has ever subdued egotism?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੇਖਿ ਭਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: anadin jalat rahahi din raatee bharam bhekh bharamaaee he ||6||
english: Night and day, they continue burning, day and night; they are deluded and confused by their doubt and religious costumes. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: ik grih kuta(n)b mahi sadaa udaasee ||
english: Some, in the midst of their household and family, remain always unattached.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮੁਏ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: sabad mue har naam nivaasee ||
english: They die in the Shabad, and dwell in the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: anadin sadaa rahahi ra(n)g raate bhai bhaai bhagat chit laaee he ||7||
english: Night and day, they remain forever attuned to His Love; they focus their consciousness on loving devotion and the Fear of God. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਗੁਤਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh ni(n)daa kar kar vigutaa ||
english: The self-willed manmukh indulges in slander, and is ruined.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਭਉਕੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਕੁਤਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar lobh bhaukai jis kutaa ||
english: The dog of greed barks within him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jamakaal tis kade na chhodai a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaaee he ||8||
english: The Messenger of Death never leaves him, and in the end, he leaves, regretting and repenting. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad sachee pat hoee ||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, true honor is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai mukat na paavai koee ||
english: Without the Name, no one attains liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਐਸੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: bin satigur ko naau na paae prabh aisee banat banaaee he ||9||
english: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Name. Such is the making which God has made. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ik sidh saadhik bahut veechaaree ||
english: Some are Siddhas and seekers, and great contemplators.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ik ahinis naam rate nira(n)kaaree ||
english: Some remain imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, day and night.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: jis no aap milaae so boojhai bhagat bhaai bhau jaaee he ||10||
english: He alone understands, whom the Lord unites with Himself; through loving devotional worship, fear is dispelled. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ॥
transliteration: isanaan daan karahi nahee boojhahi ||
english: Some take cleansing baths and give donations to charities, but they do not understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੈ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ik manooaa maar manai siu loojhahi ||
english: Some struggle with their minds, and conquer and subdue their minds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: saachai sabad rate ik ra(n)gee saachai sabad milaaee he ||11||
english: Some are imbued with love for the True Word of the Shabad; they merge with the True Shabad. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਜੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: aape siraje de vadiaaee ||
english: He Himself creates and bestows glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਣੈ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aape bhaanai dei milaaee ||
english: By the Pleasure of His Will, He bestows union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਇਉ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: aape nadar kare man vasiaa merai prabh iu phuramaaee he ||12||
english: Bestowing His Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind; such is the Command ordained by my God. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi se jan saache ||
english: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੇਵਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sev na jaanan kaache ||
english: The false, self-willed manmukhs do not know how to serve the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: aape karataa kar kar vekhai jiu bhaavai tiu laaee he ||13||
english: The Creator Himself creates the creation and watches over it; he attaches all according to the Pleasure of His Will. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jug jug saachaa eko daataa ||
english: In each and every age, the True Lord is the one and only Giver.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag gurasabad pachhaataa ||
english: Through perfect destiny, one realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: sabad mile se vichhuRe naahee nadaree sahaj milaaee he ||14||
english: Those who are immersed in the Shabad are not separated again. By His Grace, they are intuitively immersed in the Lord. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai maaiaa mail kamaaiaa ||
english: Acting in egotism, they are stained with the filth of Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mahi doojaa bhaaiaa ||
english: They die and die again, only to be reborn in the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve mukat na hoee man dekhahu liv laaee he ||15||
english: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds liberation. O mind, tune into this, and see. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karasee ||
english: He does whatever He pleases.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
transliteration: aapahu hoaa naa kichh hosee ||
english: No one has done, or can do anything by himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee dar saachai pat paaee he ||16||3||
english: O Nanak, through the Name, one is blessed with glorious greatness, and obtains honor in the Court of the True Lord. ||16||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jo aaiaa so sabh ko jaasee ||
english: All who come shall have to depart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਾਧਾ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai baadhaa jam phaasee ||
english: In the love of duality, they are caught by the noose of the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: satigur raakhe se jan ubare saache saach samaaee he ||1||
english: Those humble beings who are protected by the True Guru, are saved. They merge into the Truest of the True. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa kar kar vekhai ||
english: The Creator Himself creates the creation, and watches over it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: jis no nadar kare soee jan lekhai ||
english: Thay alone are acceptable, upon whom He bestows His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh giaan tis sabh kichh soojhai agiaanee a(n)dh kamaaee he ||2||
english: The Gurmukh attains spiritual wisdom, and understands everything. The ignorant ones act blindly. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਹਸਾ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sahasaa boojh na paaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is cynical; he doesn't understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mai janam gavaaee ||
english: He dies and dies again, only to be reborn, and loses his life uselessly again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh naam rate sukh paaiaa sahaje saach samaaee he ||3||
english: The Gurmukh is imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he find peace, and is intuitively immersed in the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਤ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhai dhaavat man bhaiaa manooraa ||
english: Chasing after worldly affairs, the mind has become corroded and rusty.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: phir hovai ka(n)chan bhetai gur pooraa ||
english: But meeting with the Perfect Guru, it is transmuted into gold once again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aape bakhas lae sukh paae poorai sabad milaaee he ||4||
english: When the Lord Himself grants forgiveness, then peace is obtained; through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, one is united with Him. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਝੂਠੀ ਬੁਰੀ ਬੁਰਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: duramat jhoothee buree buriaar ||
english: The false and evil-minded are the most wicked of the wicked.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣਿਆਰੀ ਅਉਗਣਿਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: auganiaaree auganiaar ||
english: They are the most unworthy of the unworthy.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਚੀ ਮਤਿ ਫੀਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kachee mat pheekaa mukh bolai duramat naam na paaee he ||5||
english: With false intellect, and insipid words of mouth, evil-minded, they do not obtain the Naam. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣਿਆਰੀ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: auganiaaree ka(n)t na bhaavai ||
english: The unworthy soul-bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਜੂਠੀ ਜੂਠੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: man kee joothee jooth kamaavai ||
english: False-minded, her actions are false.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੂਰਖਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: pir kaa saau na jaanai moorakh bin gur boojh na paaee he ||6||
english: The foolish person does not know the excellence of her Husband Lord. Without the Guru, she does not understand at all. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਟੀ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: duramat khotee khot kamaavai ||
english: The evil-minded, wicked soul-bride practices wickedness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਰ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: seegaar kare pir khasam na bhaavai ||
english: She decorates herself, but her Husband Lord is not pleased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gunava(n)tee sadaa pir raavai satigur mel milaaee he ||7||
english: The virtuous soul-bride enjoys and ravishes her Husband Lord forever; the True Guru unites her in His Union. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: aape hukam kare sabh vekhai ||
english: God Himself issues the Hukam of His Command, and beholds all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
transliteration: ikanaa bakhas lae dhur lekhai ||
english: Some are forgiven, according to their pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: anadin naam rate sach paaiaa aape mel milaaee he ||8||
english: Night and day, they are imbued with the Naam, and they find the True Lord. He Himself unites them in His Union. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਧਾਤੁ ਮੋਹ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: haumai dhaat moh ras laaee ||
english: Egotism attaches them to the juice of emotional attachment, and makes them run around.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh liv saachee sahaj samaaee ||
english: The Gurmukh is intuitively immersed in the True Love of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: aape melai aape kar vekhai bin satigur boojh na paaee he ||9||
english: He Himself unites, He Himself acts, and beholds. Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: ik sabad veechaar sadaa jan jaage ||
english: Some contemplate the Word of the Shabad; these humble beings remain always awake and aware.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: ik maaiaa mohi soi rahe abhaage ||
english: Some are attached to the love of Maya; these unfortunate ones remain asleep.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae aape hor karanaa kichhoo na jaaee he ||10||
english: He Himself acts, and inspires all to act; no one else can do anything. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaal maar gur sabad nivaare ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, death is conquered and killed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam rakhai ur dhaare ||
english: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined within your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: satigur sevaa te sukh paaiaa har kai naam samaaee he ||11||
english: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained, and one merges in the Name of the Lord. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਫਿਰੈ ਦੇਵਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai phirai devaanee ||
english: In the love of duality, the world wanders around insane.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi dukh maahi samaanee ||
english: Immersed in love and attachment to Maya, it suffers in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਨਹ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: bahute bhekh karai nah paae bin satigur sukh na paaee he ||12||
english: Wearing all sorts of religious robes, He is not obtained. Without the True Guru, peace is not found. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kis no kaheeai jaa aap karaae ||
english: Who is to blame, when He Himself does everything?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jit bhaavai tit raahi chalaae ||
english: As He wills, so is the path we take.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: aape miharavaan sukhadaataa jiu bhaavai tivai chalaaee he ||13||
english: He Himself is the Merciful Giver of peace; as He wills, so do we follow. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa aape bhugataa ||
english: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਆਪੇ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aape sa(n)jam aape jugataa ||
english: He Himself is detached, and He Himself is attached.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: aape niramal miharavaan madhusoodan jis daa hukam na metiaa jaaee he ||14||
english: He Himself is immaculate, compassionate, the lover of nectar; the Hukam of His Command cannot be erased. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: se vadabhaagee jinee eko jaataa ||
english: Those who know the One Lord are very fortunate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat vas rahiaa jagajeevan daataa ||
english: He dwells in each and every heart, the Great Giver, the Life of the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਥੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: ik thai gupat paragat hai aape guramukh bhram bhau jaaee he ||15||
english: At the same time, He is both hidden and revealed. For the Gurmukh, doubt and fear are dispelled. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har jeeu eko jaataa ||
english: The Gurmukh knows the One, the Dear Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar naam sabad pachhaataa ||
english: Deep within the nucleus of his inner being, is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he realizes the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥
transliteration: jis too dehi soee jan paae naanak naam vadaaee he ||16||4||
english: He alone receives it, unto whom You give it. O Nanak, the Naam is glorious greatness. ||16||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sach saalaahee gahir ga(n)bheerai ||
english: I praise the true, profound and unfathomable Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੈ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag hai tis hee kai cheerai ||
english: All the world is in His power.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh ghat bhogavai sadaa din raatee aape sookh nivaasee he ||1||
english: He enjoys all hearts forever, day and night; He Himself dwells in peace. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee naaee ||
english: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ma(n)n vasaaee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I enshrine Him in my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape aai vasiaa ghat a(n)tar tootee jam kee phaasee he ||2||
english: He Himself has come to dwell deep within the nucleus of my heart; the noose of death has been snapped. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਤੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kis sevee tai kis saalaahee ||
english: Whom should I serve, and whom should I praise?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevee sabad saalaahee ||
english: I serve the True Guru, and praise the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sachai sabad sadaa mat ootam a(n)tar kamal pragaasee he ||3||
english: Through the True Shabad, the intellect is exalted and ennobled forever, and the lotus deep within blossoms forth. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਕਾਚੀ ਕਾਗਦ ਮਿਕਦਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dehee kaachee kaagad mikadaaraa ||
english: The body is frail and perishable, like paper.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੂੰਦ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਢਹਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: boo(n)d pavai binasai dhahat na laagai baaraa ||
english: When the drop of water falls upon it, it crumbles and dissolves instantaneously.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ka(n)chan kaaiaa guramukh boojhai jis a(n)tar naam nivaasee he ||4||
english: But the body of the Gurmukh, who understands, is like gold; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells deep within. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਚਉਕਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa chaukaa surat kee kaaraa ||
english: Pure is that kitchen, which is enclosed by spiritual awareness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har naam bhojan sach aadhaaraa ||
english: The Lord's Name is my food, and Truth is my support.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sadaa tripat pavitr hai paavan jit ghat har naam nivaasee he ||5||
english: Forever satisfied, sanctified and pure is that person, within whose heart the Lord's Name abides. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: hau tin balihaaree jo saachai laage ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who are attached to the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavahi anadin jaage ||
english: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and remain awake and aware night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸੂਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: saachaa sookh sadaa tin a(n)tar rasanaa har ras raasee he ||6||
english: True peace fills them forever, and their tongues savor the sublime essence of the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: har naam chetaa avar na poojaa ||
english: I remember the Lord's Name, and no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: eko sevee avar na doojaa ||
english: I serve the One Lord, and no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: poorai gur sabh sach dikhaaiaa sachai naam nivaasee he ||7||
english: The Perfect Guru has revealed the whole Truth to me; I dwell in the True Name. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhram bhram jonee phir phir aaiaa ||
english: Wandering, wandering in reincarnation, again and again, he comes into the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਾ ਖਸਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aap bhoolaa jaa khasam bhulaaiaa ||
english: He is deluded and confused, when the Lord and Master confuses him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਚੀਨੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: har jeeu milai taa guramukh boojhai cheenai sabad abinaasee he ||8||
english: He meets with the Dear Lord, when, as Gurmukh, he understands; he remembers the Shabad, the Word of the immortal, eternal Lord God. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਭਰੇ ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh bhare ham aparaadhee ||
english: I am a sinner, overflowing with sexual desire and anger.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ ਬੋਲਹ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧੀ ॥
transliteration: kiaa muhu lai bolah naa ham gun na sevaa saadhee ||
english: With what mouth should I speak? I have no virtue, and I have rendered no service.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਾਥਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: dubade paathar mel laihu tum aape saach naam abinaasee he ||9||
english: I am a sinking stone; please, Lord, unite me with Yourself. Your Name is eternal and imperishable. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗਾ ॥
transliteration: naa koee kare na karanai jogaa ||
english: No one does anything; no one is able to do anything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਇਗਾ ॥
transliteration: aape karahi karaavahi s hoigaa ||
english: That alone happens, which the Lord Himself does, and causes to be done.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: aape bakhas laihi sukh paae sad hee naam nivaasee he ||10||
english: Those whom He Himself forgives, find peace; they dwell forever in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਜਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ihu tan dharatee sabad beej apaaraa ||
english: This body is the earth, and the infinite Shabad is the seed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਵਣਜੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har saache setee vanaj vaapaaraa ||
english: Deal and trade with the True Name alone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: sach dhan ja(n)miaa tot na aavai a(n)tar naam nivaasee he ||11||
english: The True wealth increases; it is never exhausted, when the Naam dwells deep within. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ਨੋ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu avaganiaare no gun keejai ||
english: O Dear Lord, please bless me, the worthless sinner, with virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: aape bakhas laihi naam deejai ||
english: Forgive me, and bless me with Your Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਇਕਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai so pat paae ikat naam nivaasee he ||12||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh, is honored; he dwells in the Name of the One Lord alone. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar har dhan samajh na hoee ||
english: The wealth of the Lord is deep within one's inner being, but he does not realize it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee boojhai koee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai so dhan paae sad hee naam nivaasee he ||13||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh is blessed with this wealth; he lives forever in the Naam. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਲ ਵਾਉ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: anal vaau bharam bhulaaee ||
english: Fire and wind lead him into delusions of doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi sudh na kaaee ||
english: In love and attachment to Maya, he has no understanding at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhe kichhoo na soojhai guramat naam pragaasee he ||14||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukh sees nothing; through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is gloriously revealed. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੂਤੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh haumai maaiaa soote ||
english: The manmukhs are asleep in egotism and Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਘਰੁ ਨ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ ॥
transliteration: apanaa ghar na samaalahi a(n)t vigoote ||
english: They do not watch over their own homes, and are ruined in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੈ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: par ni(n)daa karahi bahu chi(n)taa jaalai dukhe dukh nivaasee he ||15||
english: They slander others, and burn in great anxiety; they dwell in pain and suffering. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aape karatai kaar karaaee ||
english: The Creator Himself has created the creation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aape guramukh dei bujhaaee ||
english: He blesses the Gurmukh with understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate man niramal naame naam nivaasee he ||16||5||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam - their minds become immaculate; they dwell in the Naam, and only the Naam. ||16||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: eko sevee sadaa thir saachaa ||
english: I serve the One Lord, who is eternal, stable and True.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: doojai laagaa sabh jag kaachaa ||
english: Attached to duality, the whole world is false.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramatee sadaa sach saalaahee saache hee saach pateejai he ||1||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I praise the True Lord forever, pleased with the Truest of the True. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਮੈ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tere gun bahute mai ek na jaataa ||
english: Your Glorious Virtues are so many, Lord; I do not know even one.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aape laai lae jagajeevan daataa ||
english: The Life of the world, the Great Giver, attaches us to himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape bakhase de vadiaaee guramat ihu man bheejai he ||2||
english: He Himself forgives, and bestows glorious greatness. Following the Guru's Teachings, this mind is delighted. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa lahar sabad nivaaree ||
english: The Word of the Shabad has subdued the waves of Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ihu man niramal haumai maaree ||
english: Egotism has been conquered, and this mind has become immaculate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sahaje gun gaavai ra(n)g raataa rasanaa raam raveejai he ||3||
english: I intuitively sing His Glorious Praises, imbued with the Lord's Love. My tongue chants and savors the Lord's Name. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: meree meree karat vihaanee ||
english: Crying out, "Mine, mine!" he spends his life.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਫਿਰੈ ਇਆਣੀ ॥
transliteration: manamukh na boojhai phirai iaanee ||
english: The self-willed manmukh does not understand; he wanders around in ignorance.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਆਰਜਾ ਛੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jamakaal ghaRee muhat nihaale anadin aarajaa chheejai he ||4||
english: The Messenger of Death watches over him every moment, every instant; night and day, his life is wasting away. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar lobh karai nahee boojhai ||
english: He practices greed within, and does not understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: sir oopar jamakaal na soojhai ||
english: He does not see the Messenger of Death hovering over his head.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਆਇਆ ਅੰਤਕਾਲਿ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aithai kamaanaa s agai aaiaa a(n)takaal kiaa keejai he ||5||
english: Whatever one does in this world, will come to face him in the hereafter; what can he do at that very last moment? ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jo sach laage tin saachee soi ||
english: Those who are attached to the Truth are true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਰੋਇ ॥
transliteration: doojai laage manamukh roi ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs, attached to duality, weep and wail.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: duhaa siriaa kaa khasam hai aape aape gun mahi bheejai he ||6||
english: He is the Lord and Master of both worlds; He Himself delights in virtue. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad sadaa jan sohai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, His humble servant is exalted forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
transliteration: naam rasaain ihu man mohai ||
english: This mind is enticed by the Naam, the source of nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: maaiaa moh mail pata(n)g na laagai guramatee har naam bheejai he ||7||
english: It is not stained at all by the dirt of attachment to Maya; through the Guru's Teachings, it is pleased and saturated with the Lord's Name. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa vich varatai ik soee ||
english: The One Lord is contained within all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee paragat hoee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਇ ਸਾਚੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: haumai maar sadaa sukh paaiaa naai saachai a(n)mrit peejai he ||8||
english: One who subdues his ego, finds lasting peace; he drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kilabikh dookh nivaaranahaaraa ||
english: God is the Destroyer of sin and pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh seviaa sabad veechaaraa ||
english: The Gurmukh serves Him, and contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap varatai guramukh tan man bheejai he ||9||
english: He Himself is pervading everything. The Gurmukh's body and mind are saturated and pleased. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa agan jalai sa(n)saare ||
english: The world is burning in the fire of Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh nivaarai sabad veechaare ||
english: The Gurmukh extinguishes this fire, by contemplating the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: a(n)tar saa(n)t sadaa sukh paaiaa guramatee naam leejai he ||10||
english: Deep within are peace and tranquility, and lasting peace is obtained. Following the Guru's Teachings, one is blessed with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: i(n)dr i(n)draasan baithe jam kaa bhau paavahi ||
english: Even Indra, seated upon his throne, is caught in the fear of death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jam na chhodai bahu karam kamaavahi ||
english: The Messenger of Death will not spare them, even though they try all sorts of things.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: satigur bhetai taa mukat paaeeai har har rasanaa peejai he ||11||
english: When one meets with the True Guru, one is liberated, drinking in and savoring the sublime essence of the Lord, Har, Har. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)tar bhagat na hoee ||
english: There is no devotion within the self-willed manmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat saa(n)t sukh hoee ||
english: Through devotional worship, the Gurmukh obtains peace and tranquility.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਵਨ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: pavitr paavan sadaa hai baanee guramat a(n)tar bheejai he ||12||
english: Forever pure and sanctified is the Word of the Guru's Bani; following the Guru's Teachings, one's inner being is drenched in it. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes veechaaree ||
english: I have considered Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਧਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: trai gun badhak mukat niraaree ||
english: They are bound by the three qualities - the three gunas; they are far away from liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਜਾਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: guramukh giaan eko hai jaataa anadin naam raveejai he ||13||
english: The Gurmukh knows the spiritual wisdom of the One Lord. Night and day, he chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bed paRahi har naam na boojhahi ||
english: He may read the Vedas, but he does not realize the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਲੂਝਹਿ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa kaaran paR paR loojhahi ||
english: For the sake of Maya, he reads and recites and argues.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: a(n)tar mail agiaanee a(n)dhaa kiu kar dutar tareejai he ||14||
english: The ignorant and blind person is filled with filth within. How can he cross over the impassable world-ocean? ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਬਾਦ ਸਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bed baad sabh aakh vakhaanahi ||
english: He voices all the controversies of the Vedas,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: na a(n)tar bheejai na sabad pachhaanahi ||
english: but his inner being is not saturated or satisfied, and he does not realize the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਬੇਦਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: pu(n)n paap sabh bed driRaaiaa guramukh a(n)mrit peejai he ||15||
english: The Vedas tell all about virtue and vice, but only the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape saachaa eko soee ||
english: The One True Lord is all by Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na koee ||
english: There is no one else except Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate man saachaa sacho sach raveejai he ||16||6||
english: O Nanak, true is the mind of one who is attuned to the Naam; he speaks Truth, and nothing but Truth. ||16||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sachai sachaa takhat rachaaiaa ||
english: The True Lord has established the Throne of Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਿਥੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nij ghar vasiaa tithai mohu na maaiaa ||
english: He dwells in His own home deep within the self, where there is no emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sad hee saach vasiaa ghat a(n)tar guramukh karanee saaree he ||1||
english: The True Lord dwells deep within the nucleus of the Gurmukh's heart forever; his actions are excellent. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saudaa sach vaapaaraa ||
english: True is his merchandise, and true is his trade.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨ ਤਿਥੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: na tithai bharam na doojaa pasaaraa ||
english: There is no doubt within him, and no expanse of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sachaa dhan khatiaa kade tot na aavai boojhai ko veechaaree he ||2||
english: He has earned the true wealth, which is never exhausted. How few are those who contemplate this, and understand. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: sachai laae se jan laage ||
english: They alone are attached to the True Name, whom the Lord Himself attaches.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar sabad masatak vadabhaage ||
english: The Word of the Shabad is deep within the nucleus of the self; good fortune is recorded upon their foreheads.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sachai sabad sadaa gun gaavahi sabad rate veechaaree he ||3||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they sing the True Praises of the Lord; they are attuned to contemplative meditation on the Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sacho sachaa sach saalaahee ||
english: I praise the True Lord, the Truest of the True.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: eko vekhaa doojaa naahee ||
english: I see the One Lord, and no other.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਊਚੋ ਊਚੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramat oocho oochee pauRee giaan ratan haumai maaree he ||4||
english: The Guru's Teachings are the ladder to reach the highest of the high. the jewel of spiritual wisdom conquers egotism. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabad jalaaiaa ||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya is burnt away by the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sach man vasiaa jaa tudh bhaaiaa ||
english: The True One comes to dwell in the mind, when it pleases You, O Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sache kee sabh sachee karanee haumai tikhaa nivaaree he ||5||
english: True are all the actions of the truthful; the thirst of egotism is subdued. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabh aape keenaa ||
english: All by Himself, God created emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralai kin hee cheenaa ||
english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s sach kamaavai saachee karanee saaree he ||6||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh practices Truth; true and excellent are his actions. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਜੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaar kamaaee jo mere prabh bhaaee ||
english: He does those deeds which are pleasing to my God;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: haumai trisanaa sabad bujhaaee ||
english: through the Shabad, he burns away egotism and the thirst of desire.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: guramat sad hee a(n)tar seetal haumai maar nivaaree he ||7||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, he remains forever cool and calm deep within; he conquers and subdues his ego. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sach lage tin sabh kichh bhaavai ||
english: Those who are attached to the Truth are pleased with everything.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabade sach suhaavai ||
english: They are embellished with the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: aithai saache se dar saache nadaree nadar savaaree he ||8||
english: Those who are true in this world, are true in the Court of the Lord. The Merciful Lord adorns them with His Mercy. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bin saache jo doojai laaiaa ||
english: Those who are attached to duality, and not the Truth,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa moh dukh sabaaiaa ||
english: are trapped in emotional attachment to Maya; they totally suffer in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: bin gur dukh sukh jaapai naahee maaiaa moh dukh bhaaree he ||9||
english: Without the Guru, they do not understand pain and pleasure; attached to Maya, they suffer in terrible pain. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saachaa sabad jinaa man bhaaiaa ||
english: Those whose minds are pleased with the True Word of the Shabad

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa tinee kamaaiaa ||
english: act according to pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: sacho sevahi sach dhiaavahi sach rate veechaaree he ||10||
english: They serve the True Lord, and meditate on the True Lord; they are imbued with contemplative meditation on the True Lord. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa meethee laagee ||
english: Service to the Guru seems sweet to them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧੀ ॥
transliteration: anadin sookh sahaj samaadhee ||
english: Night and day, they are intuitively immersed in celestial peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: har har karatiaa man niramal hoaa gur kee sev piaaree he ||11||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, their minds become immaculate; they love to serve the Guru. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: se jan sukheee satigur sache laae ||
english: Those humble beings are at peace, whom the True Guru attaches to the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape bhaane aap milaae ||
english: He Himself, in His Will, merges them into Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: satigur raakhe se jan ubare hor maaiaa moh khuaaree he ||12||
english: Those humble beings, whom the True Guru protects, are saved. The rest are ruined through emotional attachment to Maya. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saachaa sabad pachhaataa ||
english: The Gurmukh realizes the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: naa tis kuta(n)b naa tis maataa ||
english: He has no family, and he has no mother.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: eko ek raviaa sabh a(n)tar sabhanaa jeeaa kaa aadhaaree he ||13||
english: The One and Only Lord is pervading and permeating deep within the nucleus of all. He is the Support of all beings. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai meraa doojaa bhaaiaa ||
english: Egotism, possessiveness, and the love of duality

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kichh na chalai dhur khasam likh paaiaa ||
