english: - none of these shall go along with you; such is the pre-ordained will of our Lord and Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: gur saache te saach kamaavahi saachai dookh nivaaree he ||14||
english: Through the True Guru, practice Truth, and the True Lord shall take away your pains. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jaa too dehi sadaa sukh paae ||
english: If You so bless me, then I shall find lasting peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saachai sabade saach kamaae ||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, I live the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: a(n)dar saachaa man tan saachaa bhagat bhare bha(n)daaree he ||15||
english: The True Lord is within me, and my mind and body have become True. I am blessed with the overflowing treasure of devotional worship. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape vekhai hukam chalaae ||
english: He Himself watches, and issues His Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: apanaa bhaanaa aap karaae ||
english: He Himself inspires us to obey His Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate bairaagee man tan rasanaa naam savaaree he ||16||7||
english: O Nanak, only those who are attuned to the Naam are detached; their minds, bodies and tongues are embellished with the Naam. ||16||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਉਪੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aape aap upaai upa(n)naa ||
english: He Himself created Himself, and came into being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੁ ਪਰਛੰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi varatai ek parachha(n)naa ||
english: The One Lord is pervading in all, remaining hidden.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabhanaa saar kare jagajeevan jin apanaa aap pachhaataa he ||1||
english: The Lord, the Life of the world, takes care of all. Whoever knows his own self, realizes God. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jin brahamaa bisan mahes upaae ||
english: He who created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sir sir dha(n)dhai aape laae ||
english: links each and every being to its tasks.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis bhaavai tis aape mele jin guramukh eko jaataa he ||2||
english: He merges into Himself, whoever is pleasing to His Will. The Gurmukh knows the One Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aavaa gaun hai sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The world is coming and going in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਚਿਤੈ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu bahu chitai bikaaraa ||
english: Attached to Maya, it dwells on its many sins.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: thir saachaa saalaahee sad hee jin gur kaa sabad pachhaataa he ||3||
english: One who realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad, praises forever the eternal, unchanging True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਲਗੇ ਓਨੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ik mool lage onee sukh paaiaa ||
english: Some are attached to the root - they find peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਡਾਲੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: daalee laage tinee janam gavaaiaa ||
english: But those who are attached to the branches, waste their lives away uselessly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੇ ਜੋ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit phal tin jan kau laage jo bolahi a(n)mrit baataa he ||4||
english: Those humble beings, who chant the Name of the Ambrosial Lord, produce the ambrosial fruit. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਬੋਲਹ ਬੋਲ ॥
transliteration: ham gun naahee kiaa bolah bol ||
english: I have no virtues; what words should I speak?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਤੋਲਹਿ ਤੋਲ ॥
transliteration: too sabhanaa dekhahi tolahi tol ||
english: You see all, and weigh them on Your scale.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakhahi rahanaa guramukh eko jaataa he ||5||
english: By Your will, You preserve me, and so do I remain. The Gurmukh knows the One Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jaa tudh bhaanaa taa sachee kaarai laae ||
english: According to Your Will, You link me to my true tasks.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: avagan chhod gun maahi samaae ||
english: Renouncing vice, I am immersed in virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: gun mahi eko niramal saachaa gur kai sabad pachhaataa he ||6||
english: The One Immaculate True Lord abides in virtue; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah eko soee ||
english: Wherever I look, there I see Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: doojee duramat sabade khoee ||
english: Duality and evil-mindedness are destroyed through the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਅਪਣੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਦ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: ekas mahi prabh ek samaanaa apanai ra(n)g sad raataa he ||7||
english: The One Lord God is immersed in His Oneness. He is attuned forever to His own delight. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਮਲੁ ਹੈ ਕੁਮਲਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kamal hai kumalaanaa ||
english: The body-lotus is withering away,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਇਆਣਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh sabad na bujhai iaanaa ||
english: but the ignorant, self-willed manmukh does not understand the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਖੋਜੇ ਪਾਏ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee kaaiaa khoje paae jagajeevan daataa he ||8||
english: By Guru's Grace, he searches his body, and finds the Great Giver, the Life of the world. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟ ਗਹੀ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kot gahee ke paap nivaare ||
english: The Lord frees up the body-fortress, which was seized by sins,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa har jeeu raakhai ur dhaare ||
english: when one keeps the Dear Lord enshrined forever in the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: jo ichhe soee phal paae jiu ra(n)g majeethai raataa he ||9||
english: The fruits of his desires are obtained, and he is dyed in the permanent color of the Lord's Love. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਥੇ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh giaan kathe na hoee ||
english: The self-willed manmukh speaks of spiritual wisdom, but does not understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: phir phir aavai thaur na koee ||
english: Again and again, he comes into the world, but he finds no place of rest.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: guramukh giaan sadaa saalaahe jug jug eko jaataa he ||10||
english: The Gurmukh is spiritually wise, and praises the Lord forever. Throughout each and every age, the Gurmukh knows the One Lord. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kaar kare sabh dukh sabaae ||
english: All the deeds which the manmukh does bring pain - nothing but pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar sabad naahee kiu dar jaae ||
english: The Word of the Shabad is not within him; how can he go to the Court of the Lord?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: guramukh sabad vasai man saachaa sad seve sukhadaataa he ||11||
english: The True Shabad dwells deep within the mind of the Gurmukh; he serves the Giver of peace forever. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤੂ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa too sabhanee thaaee ||
english: Wherever I look, I see You, everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: poorai gur sabh sojhee paaee ||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, all this is known.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naamo naam dhiaaeeai sadaa sad ihu man naame raataa he ||12||
english: I meditate forever and ever on the Naam; this mind is imbued with the Naam. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naame raataa pavit sareeraa ||
english: Imbued with the Naam, the body is sanctified.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai doob mue bin neeraa ||
english: Without the Naam, they are drowned and die without water.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: aavahi jaavahi naam nahee boojhahi ikanaa guramukh sabad pachhaataa he ||13||
english: They come and go, but do not understand the Naam. Some, as Gurmukh, realize the Word of the Shabad. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: poorai satigur boojh bujhaaee ||
english: The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai mukat kinai na paaee ||
english: Without the Name, no one attains liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naame naam milai vadiaaee sahaj rahai ra(n)g raataa he ||14||
english: Through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is blessed with glorious greatness; he remains intuitively attuned to the Lord's Love. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੁ ਢਹੈ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa nagar dhahai dhahi dheree ||
english: The body-village crumbles and collapses into a pile of dust.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਨਹੀ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai chookai nahee pheree ||
english: Without the Shabad, the cycle of reincarnation is not brought to an end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: saach salaahe saach samaavai jin guramukh eko jaataa he ||15||
english: One who knows the One Lord, through the True Guru, praises the True Lord, and remains immersed in the True Lord. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis no nadar kare so paae ||
english: The True Word of the Shabad comes to dwell in the mind,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: saachaa sabad vasai man aae ||
english: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate nira(n)kaaree dar saachai saach pachhaataa he ||16||8||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, realize the True Lord in His True Court. ||16||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo solahe 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Solhay, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa sabh jis karanaa ||
english: O Creator, it is You Yourself who does all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh teree saranaa ||
english: All beings and creatures are under Your Protection.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape gupat varatai sabh a(n)tar gur kai sabad pachhaataa he ||1||
english: You are hidden, and yet permeating within all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are realized. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har ke bhagat bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
english: Devotion to the Lord is a treasure overflowing.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape bakhase sabad veechaaraa ||
english: He Himself blesses us with contemplative meditation on the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai soee karasahi sache siu man raataa he ||2||
english: You do whatever You please; my mind is attuned to the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲੋ ॥
transliteration: aape heeraa ratan amolo ||
english: You Yourself are the priceless diamond and jewel.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਤੋਲੇ ਤੋਲੋ ॥
transliteration: aape nadaree tole tolo ||
english: In Your Mercy, You weigh with Your scale.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh saran tumaaree kar kirapaa aap pachhaataa he ||3||
english: All beings and creatures are under Your protection. One who is blessed by Your Grace realizes his own self. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jis no nadar hovai dhur teree ||
english: One who receives Your Mercy, O Primal Lord,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੰਮੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: marai na ja(n)mai chookai pheree ||
english: does not die, and is not reborn; he is released from the cycle of reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: saache gun gaavai din raatee jug jug eko jaataa he ||4||
english: He sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, day and night, and, throughout the ages, he knows the One Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi sabh jagat upaaiaa ||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya wells up throughout the whole world,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਦੇਵ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan dev sabaaiaa ||
english: from Brahma, Vishnu and all the demi-gods.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਸੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaane se naam laage giaan matee pachhaataa he ||5||
english: Those who are pleasing to Your Will, are attached to the Naam; through spiritual wisdom and understanding, You are recognized. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: paap pu(n)n varatai sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The world is engrossed in vice and virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: harakh sog sabh dukh hai bhaaraa ||
english: Happiness and misery are totally loaded with pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai so sukh paae jin guramukh naam pachhaataa he ||6||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh finds peace; such a Gurmukh recognizes the Naam. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kirat na koee metanahaaraa ||
english: No one can erase the record of one's actions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabade mokh duaaraa ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one finds the door of salvation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa so phal paaiaa jin aap maar pachhaataa he ||7||
english: One who conquers self-conceit and recognizes the Lord, obtains the fruits of his pre-destined rewards. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi har siu chit na laagai ||
english: Emotionally attached to Maya, one's consciousness is not attached to the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਘਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai ghanaa dukh aagai ||
english: In the love of duality, he will suffer terrible agony in the world hereafter.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: manamukh bharam bhule bhekhadhaaree a(n)t kaal pachhutaataa he ||8||
english: The hypocritical, self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt; at the very last moment, they regret and repent. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har kai bhaanai har gun gaae ||
english: In accordance with the Lord's Will, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਦੂਖ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabh kilabikh kaate dookh sabaae ||
english: He is rid of all sins, and all suffering.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: har niramal niramal hai baanee har setee man raataa he ||9||
english: The Lord is immaculate, and immaculate is the Word of His Bani. My mind is imbued with the Lord. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis no nadar kare so gun nidh paae ||
english: One who is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, obtains the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: haumai meraa thaak rahaae ||
english: Egotism and possessiveness are brought to an end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: gun avagan kaa eko daataa guramukh viralee jaataa he ||10||
english: The One Lord is the only Giver of virtue and vice, merits and demerits; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh niramal at apaaraa ||
english: My God is immaculate, and utterly infinite.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape melai gur sabad veechaaraa ||
english: God unites with Himself, through contemplation of the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: aape bakhase sach driRaae man tan saachai raataa he ||11||
english: He Himself forgives, and implants the Truth. The mind and body are then attuned to the True Lord. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan mailaa vich jot apaaraa ||
english: Within the polluted mind and body is the Light of the Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramat boojhai kar veechaaraa ||
english: One who understands the Guru's Teachings, contemplates this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: haumai maar sadaa man niramal rasanaa sev sukhadaataa he ||12||
english: Conquering egotism, the mind becomes immaculate forever; with his tongue, he serves the Lord, the Giver of peace. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੜ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਹਟ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gaR kaaiaa a(n)dar bahu hat baajaaraa ||
english: In the fortress of the body there are many shops and bazaars;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tis vich naam hai at apaaraa ||
english: within them is the Naam, the Name of the utterly infinite Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad sadaa dar sohai haumai maar pachhaataa he ||13||
english: In His Court, one is embellished forever with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; he conquers egotism and realizes the Lord. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ratan amolak agam apaaraa ||
english: The jewel is priceless, inaccessible and infinite.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਵਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: keemat kavan kare vechaaraa ||
english: How can the poor wretch estimate its worth?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: gur kai sabade tol tolaae a(n)tar sabad pachhaataa he ||14||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is weighed, and so the Shabad is realized deep within. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: simrit saasatr bahut bisathaaraa ||
english: The great volumes of the Simritees and the Shaastras

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu pasariaa paasaaraa ||
english: Only extend the extension of attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਪੜਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: moorakh paRahi sabad na boojhahi guramukh viralai jaataa he ||15||
english: The fools read them, but do not understand the Word of the Shabad. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa kare karaae ||
english: The Creator Himself acts, and causes all to act.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sachee baanee sach driRaae ||
english: Through the True Word of His Bani, Truth is implanted deep within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee jug jug eko jaataa he ||16||9||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, one is blessed with glorious greatness, and throughout the ages, the One Lord is known. ||16||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: so sach sevihu sirajanahaaraa ||
english: Serve the True Creator Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabade dookh nivaaranahaaraa ||
english: The Word of the Shabad is the Destroyer of pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paaee aape agam athaahaa he ||1||
english: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; He cannot be evaluated. He Himself is inaccessible and immeasurable. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape sachaa sach varataae ||
english: The True Lord Himself makes Truth pervasive.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੈ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ik jan saachai aape laae ||
english: He attaches some humble beings to the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saacho sevahi saach kamaavahi naame sach samaahaa he ||2||
english: They serve the True Lord and practice Truth; through the Name, they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dhur bhagataa mele aap milaae ||
english: The Primal Lord unites His devotees in His Union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sachee bhagatee aape laae ||
english: He attaches them to true devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਜਨਮੈ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saachee baanee sadaa gun gaavai is janamai kaa laahaa he ||3||
english: One who sings forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord, through the True Word of His Bani, earns the profit of this life. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: guramukh vanaj karahi par aap pachhaanahi ||
english: The Gurmukh trades, and understands his own self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ekas bin ko avar na jaanahi ||
english: He knows no other than the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sachaa saahu sache vanajaare poo(n)jee naam visaahaa he ||4||
english: True is the banker, and True are His traders, who buy the merchandise of the Naam. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape saaje srisat upaae ||
english: He Himself fashions and creates the Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: virale kau gurasabad bujhaae ||
english: He inspires a few to realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi se jan saache kaate jam kaa phaahaa he ||5||
english: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true. He snaps the noose of death from around their necks. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੰਨੈ ਘੜੇ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: bha(n)nai ghaRe savaare saaje ||
english: He destroys, creates, embellishes and fashions all beings,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਜੰਤ ਪਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi doojai ja(n)t paaje ||
english: and attaches them to duality, attachment and Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਜੇਵੜਾ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: manamukh phirahi sadaa a(n)dh kamaavahi jam kaa jevaRaa gal phaahaa he ||6||
english: The self-willed manmukhs wander around forever, acting blindly. Death has strung his noose around their necks. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape bakhase gur sevaa laae ||
english: He Himself forgives, and enjoins us to serve the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramatee naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam comes to dwell within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਾਚਾ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: anadin naam dhiaae saachaa is jag mahi naamo laahaa he ||7||
english: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the True Lord, and earn the profit of the Naam in this world. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aape sachaa sachee naaee ||
english: He Himself is True, and True is His Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh devai ma(n)n vasaaee ||
english: The Gurmukh bestows it, and enshrines it within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jin man vasiaa se jan sohahi tin sir chookaa kaahaa he ||8||
english: Noble and exalted are those, within whose mind the Lord abides. Their heads are free of strife. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paaee ||
english: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be appraised.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ma(n)n vasaaee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, He dwells within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੰਗੈ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: sadaa sabad saalaahee gunadaataa lekhaa koi na ma(n)gai taahaa he ||9||
english: No one calls that person to account, who praises the Word of the Shabad, the Giver of virtue. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan rudr tis kee sevaa ||
english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva serve Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t na paavahi alakh abhevaa ||
english: Even they cannot find the limits of the unseen, unknowable Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਅਪਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: jin kau nadar karahi too apanee guramukh alakh lakhaahaa he ||10||
english: Those who are blessed by Your Glance of Grace, become Gurmukh, and comprehend the incomprehensible. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: poorai satigur sojhee paaee ||
english: The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: eko naam ma(n)n vasaaee ||
english: I have enshrined the Naam, the One Name, within my mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naam japee tai naam dhiaaee mahal paai gun gaahaa he ||11||
english: I chant the Naam, and meditate on the Naam. Singing His Glorious Praises, I enter the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sevak sevahi ma(n)n hukam apaaraa ||
english: The servant serves, and obeys the Command of the Infinite Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh hukam na jaanahi saaraa ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the value of the Lord's Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੰਨੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: hukame ma(n)ne hukame vadiaaee hukame veparavaahaa he ||12||
english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, one is exalted; by His Hukam, one is glorified; by His Hukam, one becomes carefree. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee hukam pachhaanai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one recognizes the Lord's Hukam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat raakhai ikat ghar aanai ||
english: The wandering mind is restrained, and brought back to the home of the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naame raataa sadaa bairaagee naam ratan man taahaa he ||13||
english: Imbued with the Naam, one remains forever detached; the jewel of the Naam rests within the mind. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag mahi varatai eko soee ||
english: The One Lord is pervasive throughout all the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee paragat hoee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: sabad salaahahi se jan niramal nij ghar vaasaa taahaa he ||14||
english: Those humble beings who praise the Shabad are immaculate; they dwell within the home of their own inner self. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sadaa bhagat teree saranaaee ||
english: The devotees abide forever in Your Sanctuary, Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paaee ||
english: You are inaccessible and unfathomable; Your value cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: jiu tudh bhaavahi tiu too raakhahi guramukh naam dhiaahaa he ||15||
english: As it pleases Your Will, You keep us; the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa tere gun gaavaa ||
english: Forever and ever, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sache saahib terai man bhaavaa ||
english: O my True Lord and Master, may I become pleasing to Your Mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak saach kahai bena(n)tee sach devahu sach samaahaa he ||16||1||10||
english: Nanak offers this true prayer: O Lord, please bless me with Truth, that I may merge in the Truth. ||16||1||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevan se vadabhaagee ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: anadin saach naam liv laagee ||
english: Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the True Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa sukhadaataa raviaa ghat a(n)tar sabad sachai omaahaa he ||1||
english: The Lord, the Giver of peace, abides forever deep within their hearts; they delight in the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa guroo milaae ||
english: When the Lord grants His Grace, one meets with the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: The Name of the Lord is enshrined within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har man vasiaa sadaa sukhadaataa sabade man omaahaa he ||2||
english: The Lord, the Giver of peace, abides forever within the mind; the mind is delighted with the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kripaa kare taa mel milaae ||
english: When the Lord bestows His Mercy, He unites in His Union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: haumai mamataa sabad jalaae ||
english: Egotism and attachment are burned away by the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sadaa mukat rahai ik ra(n)gee naahee kisai naal kaahaa he ||3||
english: In the Love of the One Lord, one remains liberated forever; he is not in conflict with anyone. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve ghor a(n)dhaaraa ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai koi na paavai paaraa ||
english: Without the Shabad, no one crosses over to the other side.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jo sabad raate mahaa bairaagee so sach sabade laahaa he ||4||
english: Those who are imbued with the Shabad, are very detached. They earn the profit of the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dukh sukh karatai dhur likh paaiaa ||
english: Pain and pleasure are pre-ordained by the Creator.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: doojaa bhaau aap varataaiaa ||
english: He Himself has caused the love of duality to be pervasive.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s alipato varatai manamukh kaa kiaa vesaahaa he ||5||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh remains detached; how can anyone trust the self-willed manmukh? ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: se manamukh jo sabad na pachhaanahi ||
english: Those who do not recognize the Shabad are manmukhs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭੈ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur ke bhai kee saar na jaanahi ||
english: They do not know the essence of the Fear of the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਮੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਏਗਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bhai bin kiu nirabhau sach paaeeai jam kaadh laegaa saahaa he ||6||
english: Without this Fear, how can anyone find the Fearless True Lord? The Messenger of Death will pull the breath out. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਫਰਿਓ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aphario jam maariaa na jaaee ||
english: The invulnerable Messenger of Death cannot be killed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabade neR na aaee ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad prevents him from approaching.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਤਾ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਭਾਗੈ ਮਤੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sabad sune taa doorahu bhaagai mat maare har jeeu veparavaahaa he ||7||
english: When he hears the Word of the Shabad, he runs far away. He is afraid that the self-sufficient Dear Lord will kill him. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਸਿਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu kee hai sabh sirakaaraa ||
english: The Dear Lord is the Ruler above all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ehu jam kiaa kare vichaaraa ||
english: What can this wretched Messenger of Death do?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਢਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: hukamee ba(n)daa hukam kamaavai hukame kadhadaa saahaa he ||8||
english: As slave to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the mortal acts according to His Hukam. According to His Hukam, he is deprived of his breath. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਕੀਆ ਅਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saachai keeaa akaaraa ||
english: The Gurmukh realizes that the True Lord created the creation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh pasariaa sabh paasaaraa ||
english: The Gurmukh knows that the Lord has expanded the entire expanse.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai so sach boojhai sabad sachai sukh taahaa he ||9||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands the True Lord. Through the True Word of the Shabad, he finds peace. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jaataa karam bidhaataa ||
english: The Gurmukh knows that the Lord is the Architect of karma.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jug chaare gur sabad pachhaataa ||
english: Throughout the four ages, he recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: guramukh marai na janamai guramukh guramukh sabad samaahaa he ||10||
english: The Gurmukh does not die, the Gurmukh is not reborn; the Gurmukh is immersed in the Shabad. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam sabad saalaahe ||
english: The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar veparavaahe ||
english: God is inaccessible, unfathomable and self-sufficient.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: ek naam jug chaar udhaare sabade naam visaahaa he ||11||
english: The Naam, the Name of the One Lord, saves and redeems throughout the four ages. Through the Shabad, one trades in the Naam. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saa(n)t sadaa sukh paae ||
english: The Gurmukh obtains eternal peace and tranqulity.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hiradai naam vasaae ||
english: The Gurmukh enshrines the Naam within his heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai so naam boojhai kaate duramat phaahaa he ||12||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh recognizes the Naam, and the noose of evil-mindedness is snapped. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh upajai saach samaavai ||
english: The Gurmukh wells up from, and then merges back into Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: naa mar ja(n)mai na joonee paavai ||
english: He does not die and take birth, and is not consigned to reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲੈਦੇ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: guramukh sadaa rahahi ra(n)g raate anadin laide laahaa he ||13||
english: The Gurmukh remains forever imbued with the color of the Lord's Love. Night and day, he earns a profit. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh bhagat sohahi darabaare ||
english: The Gurmukhs, the devotees, are exalted and beautified in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sachee baanee sabad savaare ||
english: They are embellished with the True Word of His Bani, and the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: anadin gun gaavai din raatee sahaj setee ghar jaahaa he ||14||
english: Night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night, and they intuitively go to their own home. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur pooraa sabad sunaae ||
english: The Perfect True Guru proclaims the Shabad;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat karahu liv laae ||
english: night and day, remain lovingly attuned to devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: har gun gaavahi sad hee niramal niramal gun paatisaahaa he ||15||
english: One who sings forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord, becomes immaculate; Immaculate are the Glorious Praises of the Sovereign Lord . ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gun kaa daataa sachaa soee ||
english: The True Lord is the Giver of virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koee ||
english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak jan naam salaahe bigasai so naam beparavaahaa he ||16||2||11||
english: Servant Nanak praises the Naam; he blossoms forth in the ecstasy of the Name of the self-sufficient Lord. ||16||2||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu sevihu agam apaaraa ||
english: Serve the Dear Lord, the inaccessible and infinite.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tis daa a(n)t na paaeeai paaraavaaraa ||
english: He has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਮਤਿ ਅਗਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaad raviaa ghat a(n)tar tit ghat mat agaahaa he ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, one who dwells upon the Lord deep within his heart - his heart is filled with infinite wisdom. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi varatai eko soee ||
english: The One Lord is pervading and permeating amidst all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee paragat hoee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sabhanaa pratipaal kare jagajeevan dedaa rijak sa(n)baahaa he ||2||
english: The Life of the world nurtures and cherishes all, giving sustenance to all. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: poorai satigur boojh bujhaaiaa ||
english: The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: hukame hee sabh jagat upaaiaa ||
english: By the Hukam of His Command, He created the entire Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hukam ma(n)ne soee sukh paae hukam sir saahaa paatisaahaa he ||3||
english: Whoever submits to His Command, finds peace; His Command is above the heads of kings and emperors. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa satigur sabad apaaraa ||
english: True is the True Guru. Infinite is the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tis dai sabad nisatarai sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Through His Shabad, the world is saved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਦੇਦਾ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aape karataa kar kar vekhai dedaa saas giraahaa he ||4||
english: The Creator Himself created the creation; He gazes upon it, and blesses it with breath and nourishment. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kot madhe kisahi bujhaae ||
english: Out of millions, only a few understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad rate ra(n)g laae ||
english: Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are colored in His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: har saalaahahi sadaa sukhadaataa har bakhase bhagat salaahaa he ||5||
english: They praise the Lord, the Giver of peace forever; the Lord forgives His devotees, and blesses them with His Praise. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi se jan saache ||
english: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਕਾਚਨਿ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
transliteration: jo mar ja(n)mahi kaachan kaache ||
english: The falsest of the false die, only to be reborn.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: agam agochar veparavaahaa bhagat vachhal athaahaa he ||6||
english: The inaccessible, unfathomable, self-sufficient, incomprehensible Lord is the Lover of His devotees. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur pooraa saach driRaae ||
english: The Perfect True Guru implants Truth within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad sadaa gun gaae ||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they sing His Glorious Praises forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਿਖਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gunadaataa varatai sabh a(n)tar sir sir likhadaa saahaa he ||7||
english: The Giver of virtue is pervading deep within the nucleus of all beings; He inscribes the time of destiny upon each and every person's head. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: sadaa hadoor guramukh jaapai ||
english: The Gurmukh knows that God is always ever-present.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: sabade sevai so jan dhraapai ||
english: That humble being who serves the Shabad, is comforted and fulfilled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: anadin sevahi sachee baanee sabad sachai omaahaa he ||8||
english: Night and day, he serves the True Word of the Guru's Bani; he delights in the True Word of the Shabad. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: agiaanee a(n)dhaa bahu karam driRaae ||
english: The ignorant and blind cling to all sorts of rituals.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manahath karam phir jonee paae ||
english: They stubborn-mindedly perform these rituals, and are consigned to reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਦੋਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: bikhiaa kaaran lab lobh kamaavahi duramat kaa doraahaa he ||9||
english: For the sake of poison, they act in greed and possessiveness, and evil-minded duality. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pooraa satigur bhagat driRaae ||
english: The Perfect True Guru implants devotional worship within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad har naam chit laae ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he lovingly centers his consciousness on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭੀਨੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: man tan har raviaa ghat a(n)tar man bheenai bhagat salaahaa he ||10||
english: The Lord pervades his mind, body and heart; deep within, his mind is drenched with devotional worship and praise of the Lord. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰਣੁ ॥
transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa asur sa(n)ghaaran ||
english: My True Lord God is the Destroyer of demons.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਣੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad bhagat nisataaran ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, His devotees are saved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa sad hee saachaa sir saahaa paatisaahaa he ||11||
english: My True Lord God is forever True. He is the Emperor over the heads of kings. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: se bhagat sache terai man bhaae ||
english: True are those devotees, who are pleasing to Your Mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: dar keeratan karahi gur sabad suhaae ||
english: They sing the Kirtan of His Praises at His Door; they are embellished and exalted by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵੇਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: saachee baanee anadin gaavahi niradhan kaa naam vesaahaa he ||12||
english: Night and day, they sing the True Word of His Bani. The Naam is the wealth of the poor. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jin aape mel vichhoRahi naahee ||
english: Those whom You unite, Lord, are never separated again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad sadaa saalaahee ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they praise You forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: sabhanaa sir too eko saahib sabade naam salaahaa he ||13||
english: You are the One Lord and Master over all. Through the Shabad, the Naam is praised. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai tudhuno koee na jaanee ||
english: Without the Shabad, no one knows You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਥੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: tudh aape kathee akath kahaanee ||
english: You Yourself speak the Unspoken Speech.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸੰਬਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: aape sabad sadaa gur daataa har naam jap sa(n)baahaa he ||14||
english: You Yourself are the Shabad forever, the Guru, the Great Giver; chanting the Lord's Name, You bestow Your treasure. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too aape karataa sirajanahaaraa ||
english: You Yourself are the Creator of the Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: teraa likhiaa koi na metanahaaraa ||
english: No one can erase what You have written.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਹਸਾ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: guramukh naam devahi too aape sahasaa ganat na taahaa he ||15||
english: You Yourself bless the Gurmukh with the Naam, who is no longer skeptical, and is not held to account. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਰਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat sache terai daravaare ||
english: Your true devotees stand at the Door of Your Court.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabade sevan bhaai piaare ||
english: They serve the Shabad with love and affection.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate bairaagee naame kaaraj sohaa he ||16||3||12||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam remain detached; through the Naam, their affairs are resolved. ||16||3||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਇਕੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: merai prabh saachai ik khel rachaaiaa ||
english: My True Lord God has staged a play.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੇਹਾ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: koi na kis hee jehaa upaaiaa ||
english: He has created no one like anyone else.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਫਰਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape pharak kare vekh vigasai sabh ras dehee maahaa he ||1||
english: He made them different, and he gazes upon them with pleasure; he placed all the flavors in the body. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੈ ਪਉਣੁ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: vaajai paun tai aap vajaae ||
english: You Yourself vibrate the beat of the breath.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: siv sakatee dehee mahi paae ||
english: Shiva and Shakti, energy and matter - You have placed them into the body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ulatee hovai giaan ratan sabad taahaa he ||2||
english: By Guru's Grace, one turns away from the world, and attains the jewel of spiritual wisdom, and the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dheraa chaanan aape keeaa ||
english: He Himself created darkness and light.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
transliteration: eko varatai avar na beeaa ||
english: He alone is pervasive; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee aap pachhaanai kamal bigasai budh taahaa he ||3||
english: One who realizes his own self - by Guru's Grace, the lotus of his mind blossoms forth. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: apanee gahan gat aape jaanai ||
english: Only He Himself knows His depth and extent.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: hor lok sun sun aakh vakhaanai ||
english: Other people can only listen and hear what is spoken and said.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: giaanee hovai s guramukh boojhai saachee siphat salaahaa he ||4||
english: One who is spiritually wise, understands himself as Gurmukh; he praises the True Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dehee a(n)dar vasat apaaraa ||
english: Deep within the body is the priceless object.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape kapat khulaavanahaaraa ||
english: He Himself opens the doors.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: guramukh sahaje a(n)mrit peevai trisanaa agan bujhaahaa he ||5||
english: The Gurmukh intuitively drings in the Ambrosial Nectar, and the fire of desire is quenched. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabh ras dehee a(n)dar paae ||
english: He placed all the flavors within the body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: virale kau gur sabad bujhaae ||
english: How rare are those who understand, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਜੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: a(n)dar khoje sabad saalaahe baahar kaahe jaahaa he ||6||
english: So search within yourself, and praise the Shabad. Why run around outside your self? ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਚਾਖੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vin chaakhe saad kisai na aaiaa ||
english: Without tasting, no one enjoys the flavor.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad a(n)mrit peeaaiaa ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਹੋਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit pee amaraa pad hoe gur kai sabad ras taahaa he ||7||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar is drunk, and the immoral status is obtained, when one obtains the sublime essence of the Guru's Shabad. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: aap pachhaanai so sabh gun jaanai ||
english: One who realizes himself, knows all virtues.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad har naam vakhaanai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he chants the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: anadin naam rataa din raatee maaiaa mohu chukaahaa he ||8||
english: Night and day, he remains imbued with the Naam, day and night; he is rid of emotional attachment to Maya. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te sabh kichh paae ||
english: Serving the Guru, all things are obtained;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: haumai meraa aap gavaae ||
english: egotism, possessiveness and self-conceit are taken away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: aape kripaa kare sukhadaataa gur kai sabade sohaa he ||9||
english: The Lord, the Giver of peace Himself grants His Grace; He exalts and adorns with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad a(n)mrit hai baanee ||
english: The Guru's Shabad is the Ambrosial Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: anadin har kaa naam vakhaanee ||
english: Night and day, chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਘਟੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: har har sachaa vasai ghat a(n)tar so ghat niramal taahaa he ||10||
english: That heart becomes immaculate, which is filled with the True Lord, Har, Har. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sevak sevahi sabad salaahahi ||
english: His servants serve, and praise His Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sadaa ra(n)g raate har gun gaavahi ||
english: Imbued forever with the color of His Love, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਪਰਮਲ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: aape bakhase sabad milaae paramal vaas man taahaa he ||11||
english: He Himself forgives, and unites them with the Shabad; the fragrance of sandalwood permeates their minds. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੇ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: sabade akath kathe saalaahe ||
english: Through the Shabad, they speak the Unspoken, and praise the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: mere prabh saache veparavaahe ||
english: My True Lord God is self-sufficient.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: aape gunadaataa sabad milaae sabadai kaa ras taahaa he ||12||
english: The Giver of virtue Himself unites them with the Shabad; they enjoy the sublime essence of the Shabad. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhoolaa thaur na paae ||
english: The confused, self-willed manmukhs find no place of rest.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa s karam kamaae ||
english: They do those deeds which they are pre-destined to do.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਖੋਜੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: bikhiaa raate bikhiaa khojai mar janamai dukh taahaa he ||13||
english: Imbued with poison, they search out poison, and suffer the pains of death and rebirth. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: aape aap aap saalaahe ||
english: He Himself praises Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: tere gun prabh tujh hee maahe ||
english: Your Glorious Virtues are within You alone, God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੀ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: too aap sachaa teree baanee sachee aape alakh athaahaa he ||14||
english: You Yourself are True, and True is the Word of Your Bani. You Yourself are invisible and unknowable. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bin gur daate koi na paae ||
english: Without the Guru, the Giver, no one finds the Lord,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਜੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: lakh kotee je karam kamaae ||
english: though one may make hundreds of thousands and millions of attempts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te ghat a(n)tar vasiaa sabade sach saalaahaa he ||15||
english: By Guru's Grace, He dwells deep within the heart; through the Shabad, praise the True Lord. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: se jan mile dhur aap milaae ||
english: They alone meet Him, whom the Lord unites with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
transliteration: saachee baanee sabad suhaae ||
english: They are adorned and exalted with the True Word of His Bani, and the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak jan gun gaavai nit saache gun gaavah gunee samaahaa he ||16||4||13||
english: Servant Nanak continually sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; singing His Glories, he is immersed in the Glorious Lord of Virtue. ||16||4||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: nihachal ek sadaa sach soee ||
english: The One Lord is eternal and unchanging, forever True.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: poore gur te sojhee hoee ||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, this understanding is obtained.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੀਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har ras bheene sadaa dhiaain guramat seel sa(n)naahaa he ||1||
english: Those who are drenched with the sublime essence of the Lord, meditate forever on Him; following the Guru's Teachings, they obtain the armor of humility. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar ra(n)g sadaa sachiaaraa ||
english: Deep within, they love the True Lord forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad har naam piaaraa ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they love the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nau nidh naam vasiaa ghat a(n)tar chhodiaa maaiaa kaa laahaa he ||2||
english: The Naam, the embodiment of the nine treasures, abides within their hearts; they renounce the profit of Maya. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਈਅਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੋਈ ॥
transliteration: raeeat raaje duramat doee ||
english: Both the king and his subjects are involved in evil-mindedness and duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve ek na hoee ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, they do not become one with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਤਿਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ek dhiaain sadaa sukh paain nihachal raaj tinaahaa he ||3||
english: Those who meditate on the One Lord find eternal peace. Their power is eternal and unfailing. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa rakhai na koee ||
english: No one can save them from coming and going.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maran tisai te hoee ||
english: Birth and death come from Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: guramukh saachaa sadaa dhiaavahu gat mukat tisai te paahaa he ||4||
english: The Gurmukh meditates forever on the True Lord. Emancipation and liberation are obtained from Him. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ॥
transliteration: sach sa(n)jam satiguroo duaarai ||
english: Truth and self-control are found through the Door of the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: haumai krodh sabad nivaarai ||
english: Egotism and anger are silenced through the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaeeai seel sa(n)tokh sabh taahaa he ||5||
english: Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is found; humility and contentment all come from Him. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai mohu upajai sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Out of egotism and attachment, the Universe welled up.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh jag binasai naam visaaraa ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all the world perishes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਗਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve naam na paaeeai naam sachaa jag laahaa he ||6||
english: Without serving the True Guru, the Naam is not obtained. The Naam is the True profit in this world. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sachaa amar sabad suhaaiaa ||
english: True is His Will, beauteous and pleasing through the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਾਜਾ ਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch sabad mil vaajaa vaaiaa ||
english: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate and resonate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sadaa kaaraj sach naam suhelaa bin sabadai kaaraj kehaa he ||7||
english: Through the True Name, one's actions are forever embellished. Without the Shabad, what can anyone do? ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਸੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi hasai khin mahi rovai ||
english: One instant, he laughs, and the next instant, he cries.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: doojee duramat kaaraj na hovai ||
english: Because of duality and evil-mindedness, his affairs are not resolved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: sa(n)jog vijog karatai likh paae kirat na chalai chalaahaa he ||8||
english: Union and separation are pre-ordained by the Creator. Actions already committed cannot be taken back. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jeevan mukat gurasabad kamaae ||
english: One who lives the Word of the Guru's Shabad becomes Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har siu sad hee rahai samaae ||
english: He remains forever immersed in the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te milai vadiaaee haumai rog na taahaa he ||9||
english: By Guru's Grace, one is blessed with glorious greatness; he is not afflicted by the disease of egotism. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਖਾਏ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ras kas khaae pi(n)d vadhaae ||
english: Eating tasty delicacies, he fattens up his body

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhekh karai gurasabad na kamaae ||
english: and wears religious robes, but he does not live to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: a(n)tar rog mahaa dukh bhaaree bisataa maahi samaahaa he ||10||
english: Deep with the nucleus of his being is the great disease; he suffers terrible pain, and eventually sinks into the manure. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bed paRahi paR baad vakhaanahi ||
english: He reads and studies the Vedas, and argues about them;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ghat mahi braham tis sabad na pachhaanahi ||
english: God is within his own heart, but he does not recognize the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s tat bilovai rasanaa har ras taahaa he ||11||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh churns the essence of reality; his tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਵਥੁ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: ghar vath chhodahi baahar dhaavahi ||
english: Those who forsake the object within their own hearts, wander outside.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhe saad na paavahi ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not taste the flavor of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਫੀਕੀ ਬੋਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: an ras raatee rasanaa pheekee bole har ras mool na taahaa he ||12||
english: Imbued with the taste of another, their tongues speak tasteless, insipid words. They never taste the sublime essence of the Lord. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੇਹੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਤਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: manamukh dehee bharam bhataaro ||
english: The self-willed manmukh has doubt as his spouse.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੋ ॥
transliteration: duramat marai nit hoi khuaaro ||
english: He dies of evil-mindedness, and suffers forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: kaam krodh man doojai laaiaa supanai sukh na taahaa he ||13||
english: His mind is attached to sexual desire, anger and duality, and he does not find peace, even in dreams. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਭਤਾਰੋ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)chan dehee sabad bhataaro ||
english: The body becomes golden, with the Word of the Shabad as its spouse.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhog bhoge har siu piaaro ||
english: Night and day, enjoy the enjoyments, and be in love with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੈਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਣਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: mahalaa a(n)dar gair mahal paae bhaanaa bujh samaahaa he ||14||
english: Deep within the mansion of the self, one finds the Lord, who transcends this mansion. Realizing His Will, we merge in Him. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape devai devanahaaraa ||
english: The Great Giver Himself gives.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tis aagai nahee kisai kaa chaaraa ||
english: No one has any power to stand against Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: aape bakhase sabad milaae tis daa sabad athaahaa he ||15||
english: He Himself forgives, and unites us with the Shabad; The Word of His Shabad is unfathomable. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh hai tis keraa ||
english: Body and soul, all belong to Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib thaakur meraa ||
english: The True Lord is my only Lord and Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak gurabaanee har paaiaa har jap jaap samaahaa he ||16||5||14||
english: O Nanak, through the Word of the Guru's Bani, I have found the Lord. Chanting the Lord's Chant, I merge in Him. ||16||5||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naad bed beechaar ||
english: The Gurmukh contemplates the sound current of the Naad instead of the Vedas.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਆਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh giaan dhiaan aapaar ||
english: The Gurmukh attains infinite spiritual wisdom and meditation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh kaar kare prabh bhaavai guramukh pooraa paaidaa ||1||
english: The Gurmukh acts in harmony with God's Will; the Gurmukh finds perfection. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਉਲਟਿ ਪਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh manooaa ulat paraavai ||
english: The mind of the Gurmukh turns away from the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh baanee naad vajaavai ||
english: The Gurmukh vibrates the Naad, the sound current of the Guru's Bani.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh sach rate bairaagee nij ghar vaasaa paaidaa ||2||
english: The Gurmukh, attuned to the Truth, remains detached, and dwells in the home of the self deep within. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kee saakhee a(n)mrit bhaakhee ||
english: I speak the Ambrosial Teachings of the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਖੀ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabade sach subhaakhee ||
english: I lovingly chant the Truth, through the True Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sadaa sach ra(n)g raataa man meraa sache sach samaaidaa ||3||
english: My mind remains forever imbued with the Love of the True Lord. I am immersed in the Truest of the True. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh man niramal sat sar naavai ||
english: Immaculate and pure is the mind of the Gurmukh, who bathes in the Pool of Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: mail na laagai sach samaavai ||
english: No filth attaches to him; he merges in the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sacho sach kamaavai sad hee sachee bhagat driRaaidaa ||4||
english: He truly practices Truth forever; true devotion is implanted within him. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਬੈਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sach bainee guramukh sach nainee ||
english: True is the speech of the Gurmukh; true are the eyes of the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sach kamaavai karanee ||
english: The Gurmukh practices and lives the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sad hee sach kahai din raatee avaraa sach kahaaidaa ||5||
english: He speaks the Truth forever, day and night, and inspires others to speak the Truth. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sachee ootam baanee ||
english: True and exalted is the speech of the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sacho sach vakhaanee ||
english: The Gurmukh speaks Truth, only Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: guramukh sad sevahi sacho sachaa guramukh sabad sunaaidaa ||6||
english: The Gurmukh serves the Truest of the True forever; the Gurmukh proclaims the Word of the Shabad. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s sojhee paae ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh understands.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: haumai maaiaa bharam gavaae ||
english: He rids himself of egotism, Maya and doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਊਤਮ ਊਚੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: gur kee pauRee ootam oochee dar sachai har gun gaaidaa ||7||
english: He ascends the sublime, exalted ladder of the Guru, and he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord at His True Door. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sach sa(n)jam karanee saar ||
english: The Gurmukh practices true self-control, and acts in excellence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh paae mokh duaar ||
english: The Gurmukh obtains the gate of salvation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: bhaai bhagat sadaa ra(n)g raataa aap gavaai samaaidaa ||8||
english: Through loving devotion, he remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love; eradicating self-conceit, he merges in the Lord. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai man khoj sunaae ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh examines his own mind, and instructs others.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sachai naam sadaa liv laae ||
english: He is lovingly attuned to the True Name forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਜੋ ਸਚੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karasee jo sache man bhaaidaa ||9||
english: They act in harmony with the Mind of the True Lord. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai satiguroo milaae ||
english: As it pleases His Will, He unites us with the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai taa ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: As it pleases His Will, He comes to dwell within the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: aapanai bhaanai sadaa ra(n)g raataa bhaanai ma(n)n vasaaidaa ||10||
english: As it pleases His Will, He imbues us with His Love; as it pleases His Will, He comes to dwell in the mind. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: manahath karam kare so chheejai ||
english: Those who act stubborn-mindedly are destroyed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: bahute bhekh kare nahee bheejai ||
english: Wearing all sorts of religious robes, they do not please the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: bikhiaa raate dukh kamaavahi dukhe dukh samaaidaa ||11||
english: Tinged by corruption, they earn only pain; they are immersed in pain. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s sukh kamaae ||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh earns peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: maran jeevan kee sojhee paae ||
