english: He comes to understand death and birth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਜੋ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: maran jeevan jo sam kar jaanai so mere prabh bhaaidaa ||12||
english: One who looks alike upon death and birth, is pleasing to my God. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: guramukh marahi s hahi paravaan ||
english: The Gurmukh, while remaining dead, is respected and approved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa sabad pachhaan ||
english: He realizes that coming and going are according to God's Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: marai na ja(n)mai naa dukh paae man hee manahi samaaidaa ||13||
english: He does not die, he is not reborn, and he does not suffer in pain; his mind merges in the Mind of God. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: se vadabhaagee jinee satigur paaiaa ||
english: Very fortunate are those who find the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai vichahu mohu chukaaiaa ||
english: They eradicate egotism and attachment from within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: man niramal phir mail na laagai dar sachai sobhaa paaidaa ||14||
english: Their minds are immaculate, and they are never again stained with filth. They are honored at the Door of the True Court. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae aape ||
english: He Himself acts, and inspires all to act.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ॥
transliteration: aape vekhai thaap uthaape ||
english: He Himself watches over all; He establishes and disestablishes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: guramukh sevaa mere prabh bhaavai sach sun lekhai paaidaa ||15||
english: The service of the Gurmukh is pleasing to my God; one who listens to the Truth is approved. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sacho sach kamaavai ||
english: The Gurmukh practices Truth, and only Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh niramal mail na laavai ||
english: The Gurmukh is immaculate; no filth attaches to him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate veechaaree naame naam samaaidaa ||16||1||15||
english: O Nanak, those who contemplate the Naam are imbued with it. They merge in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||1||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
transliteration: aape srisat hukam sabh saajee ||
english: He Himself fashioned the Universe, through the Hukam of His Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੀ ॥
transliteration: aape thaap uthaap nivaajee ||
english: He Himself establishes and disestablishes, and embellishes with grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape niaau kare sabh saachaa saache saach milaaidaa ||1||
english: The True Lord Himself administers all justice; through Truth, we merge in the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kot hai aakaaraa ||
english: The body takes the form of a fortress.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu pasariaa paasaaraa ||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya has expanded throughout its expanse.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਸਮੈ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin sabadai bhasamai kee dheree khehoo kheh ralaaidaa ||2||
english: Without the Word of the Shabad, the body is reduced to a pile of ashes; in the end, dust mingles with dust. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa ka(n)chan kot apaaraa ||
english: The body is the infinite fortress of gold;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis vich raviaa sabad apaaraa ||
english: it is permeated by the Infinite Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh gaavai sadaa gun saache mil preetam sukh paaidaa ||3||
english: The Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord forever; meeting his Beloved, he finds peace. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa har ma(n)dar har aap savaare ||
english: The body is the temple of the Lord; the Lord Himself embellishes it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tis vich har jeeu vasai muraare ||
english: The Dear Lord dwells within it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਣਜਨਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad vanajan vaapaaree nadaree aap milaaidaa ||4||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the merchants trade, and in His Grace, the Lord merges them with Himself. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੂਚਾ ਜਿ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: so soochaa j karodh nivaare ||
english: He alone is pure, who eradicates anger.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabade boojhai aap savaare ||
english: He realizes the Shabad, and reforms himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa aape ma(n)n vasaaidaa ||5||
english: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act; He Himself abides in the mind. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: niramal bhagat hai niraalee ||
english: Pure and unique is devotional worship.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧੋਵਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: man tan dhovahi sabad veechaaree ||
english: The mind and body are washed clean, contemplating the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: anadin sadaa rahai ra(n)g raataa kar kirapaa bhagat karaaidaa ||6||
english: One who remains forever imbued with His Love, night and day - in His Mercy, the Lord inspires him to perform devotional worship service. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: is man ma(n)dar mahi manooaa dhaavai ||
english: In this temple of the mind, the mind wanders around.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਲਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sukh palar tiaag mahaa dukh paavai ||
english: Discarding joy like straw, it suffers in terrible pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin satigur bhete thaur na paavai aape khel karaaidaa ||7||
english: Without meeting the True Guru, it finds no place of rest; He Himself has staged this play. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aap apara(n)par aap veechaaree ||
english: He Himself is infinite; He contemplates Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aape mele karanee saaree ||
english: He Himself bestows Union through actions of excellence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: kiaa ko kaar kare vechaaraa aape bakhas milaaidaa ||8||
english: What can the poor creatures do? Granting forgiveness, He unites them with Himself. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape satigur mele pooraa ||
english: The Perfect Lord Himself unites them with the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachai sabad mahaabal sooraa ||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, he makes them brave spiritual heroes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: aape mele de vadiaaee sache siu chit laaidaa ||9||
english: Uniting them with Himself, He bestows glorious greatness; He inspires them to focus their consciousness on the True Lord. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ghar hee a(n)dar saachaa soee ||
english: The True Lord is deep within the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koee ||
english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan vasiaa ghat a(n)tar rasanaa naam dhiaaidaa ||10||
english: The treasure of the Naam abides deep within their hearts; they meditate on the Naam with their tongues. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਿਸੰਤਰੁ ਭਵੈ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: disa(n)tar bhavai a(n)tar nahee bhaale ||
english: He wanders through foreign lands, but does not look within himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਧਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi badhaa jamakaale ||
english: Attached to Maya, he is bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: jam kee phaasee kabahoo na tootai doojai bhaai bharamaaidaa ||11||
english: The noose of death around his neck will never be untied; in the love of duality, he wanders in reincarnation. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam hor koee naahee ||
english: There is no real chanting, meditation, penance or self-control,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jab lag gur kaa sabad na kamaahee ||
english: as long as one does not live to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad miliaa sach paaiaa sache sach samaaidaa ||12||
english: Accepting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one obtains Truth; through Truth, one merges in the True Lord. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਸਬਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaam karodh sabal sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Sexual desire and anger are very powerful in the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bahu karam kamaavahi sabh dukh kaa pasaaraa ||
english: They lead to all sorts of actions, but these only add to all the pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi se sukh paavahi sachai sabad milaaidaa ||13||
english: Those who serve the True Guru find peace; they are united with the True Shabad. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਹੈ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ॥
transliteration: paun paanee hai baisa(n)tar ||
english: Air, water and fire make up the body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu varatai sabh a(n)tar ||
english: Emotional attachment to Maya rules deep within all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: jin keete jaa tisai pachhaanahi maaiaa mohu chukaaidaa ||14||
english: When one realizes the One who created him, emotional attachment to Maya is dispelled. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: ik maaiaa mohi garab viaape ||
english: Some are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya and pride.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
transliteration: haumai hoi rahe hai aape ||
english: They are self-conceited and egotistical.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੈ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: jamakaalai kee khabar na paaee a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaaidaa ||15||
english: They never think about the Messenger of Death; in the end, they leave, regretting and repenting. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਸੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jin upaae so bidh jaanai ||
english: He alone knows the Way, who created it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh devai sabad pachhaanai ||
english: The Gurmukh, who is blessed with the Shabad, realizes Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak daas kahai bena(n)tee sach naam chit laaidaa ||16||2||16||
english: Slave Nanak offers ths prayer; O Lord, let my consciousness be attached to the True Name. ||16||2||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aad jugaad daiaapat daataa ||
english: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, the Merciful Lord has been the Great Giver.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kai sabad pachhaataa ||
english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, He is realized.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tudhuno sevahi se tujhahi samaavahi too aape mel milaaidaa ||1||
english: Those who serve You are immersed in You. You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paaee ||
english: You are inaccessible and unfathomable; Your limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t teree saranaaee ||
english: All beings and creatures seek Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jiu tudh bhaavai tivai chalaavahi too aape maarag paaidaa ||2||
english: As is pleases Your Will, You guide us along; You Yourself place us on the Path. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: hai bhee saachaa hosee soee ||
english: The True Lord is, and shall always be.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape saaje avar na koee ||
english: He Himself creates - there is no other at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabhanaa saar kare sukhadaataa aape rijak pahuchaaidaa ||3||
english: The Giver of peace takes care of all; He Himself sustains them. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar alakh apaaraa ||
english: You are inaccessible, unfathomable, invisible and infinite;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: koi na jaanai teraa paravaaraa ||
english: no one knows Your extent.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aapanaa aap pachhaanahi aape guramatee aap bujhaaidaa ||4||
english: You Yourself realize Yourself. Through the Guru's Teachings, You reveal Yourself. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਾਲ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਲੋਅ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: paataal pureeaa lo aakaaraa ||
english: Your Almighty Command prevails throughout

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tis vich varatai hukam karaaraa ||
english: The nether worlds, realms and worlds of form.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਢਾਹੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: hukame saaje hukame dhaahe hukame mel milaaidaa ||5||
english: By the Hukam of Your Command, You create, and by Your Command, You destroy. By Your Command, You unite in Union. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: hukamai boojhai s hukam salaahe ||
english: One who realizes Your Command, praises Your Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar veparavaahe ||
english: You are Inaccessible, Unfathomable and Self-Sufficient.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jehee mat dehi so hovai too aape sabad bujhaaidaa ||6||
english: As is the understanding You give, so do I become. You Yourself reveal the Shabad. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਆਰਜਾ ਛਿਜਦੀ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anadin aarajaa chhijadee jaae ||
english: Night and day, the days of our lives wear away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਖੀ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: rain dinas dui saakhee aae ||
english: Night and day both bear witness to this loss.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਮੂੜਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਰੂਆਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dh na chetai mooRaa sir oopar kaal rooaaidaa ||7||
english: The blind, foolish, self-willed manmukh is not aware of this; death is hovering over his head. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: man tan seetal gur charanee laagaa ||
english: The mind and body are cooled and soothed, holding tight to the Guru's Feet.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar bharam gaiaa bhau bhaagaa ||
english: Doubt is eliminated from within, and fear runs away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d sache gun gaavahi sach baanee bolaaidaa ||8||
english: One is in bliss forever, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, and speaking the True Word of His Bani. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jin too jaataa karam bidhaataa ||
english: One who knows You as the Architect of Karma,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag gur sabad pachhaataa ||
english: has the good fortune of perfect destiny, and recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: jat pat sach sachaa sach soee haumai maar milaaidaa ||9||
english: The Lord, the Truest of the True, is his social class and honor. Conquering his ego, he is united with the Lord. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: man kathor doojai bhaai laagaa ||
english: The stubborn and insensitive mind is attached to the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਭਾਗਾ ॥
transliteration: bharame bhoolaa phirai abhaagaa ||
english: Deluded by doubt, the unfortunate wander around in confusion.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: karam hovai taa satigur seve sahaje hee sukh paaidaa ||10||
english: But if they are blessed by God's Grace, they serve the True Guru, and easily obtain peace. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh aap upaae ||
english: He Himself created the 8.4 million species of beings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: maanas janam gur bhagat driRaae ||
english: Only in this human life, is devotional worship to the Guru implanted within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: bin bhagatee bisataa vich vaasaa bisataa vich phir paaidaa ||11||
english: Without devotion, one lives in manure; he falls into manure again and again. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: karam hovai gur bhagat driRaae ||
english: If one is blessed with His Grace, devotional worship to the Guru is implanted within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: vin karamaa kiu paaiaa jaae ||
english: Without God's Grace, how can anyone find Him?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa jiu bhaavai tivai chalaaidaa ||12||
english: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act; as He wills, he leads us on. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: simrit saasat a(n)t na jaanai ||
english: The Simritees and the Shaastras do not know His limits.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: moorakh a(n)dhaa tat na pachhaanai ||
english: The blind fool does not recognize the essence of reality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa aape bharam bhulaaidaa ||13||
english: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act; He Himself deludes with doubt. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap karaae ||
english: He Himself causes everything to be done.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape sir sir dha(n)dhai laae ||
english: He Himself joins each and every person to his tasks.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: aape thaap uthaape vekhai guramukh aap bujhaaidaa ||14||
english: He Himself establishes and disestablishes, and watches over all; He reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib gahir ga(n)bheeraa ||
english: The True Lord and Master is profoundly deep and unfathomable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sadaa salaahee taa man dheeraa ||
english: Praising Him forever, the mind is comforted and consoled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paaee guramukh ma(n)n vasaaidaa ||15||
english: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be estimated. He dwells in the mind of the Gurmukh. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਹੋਰ ਧੰਧੈ ਲੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aap niraalam hor dha(n)dhai loee ||
english: He Himself is detached; all others are entangled in their affairs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee boojhai koee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੭॥
transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghat a(n)tar guramatee mel milaaidaa ||16||3||17||
english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell deep within the heart; through the Guru's Teachings, one is united in His Union. ||16||3||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਛਤੀਹ ਕੀਓ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jug chhateeh keeo gubaaraa ||
english: For thirty-six ages, utter darkness prevailed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too aape jaanahi sirajanahaaraa ||
english: Only You Yourself know this, O Creator Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hor kiaa ko kahai k aakh vakhaanai too aape keemat paaidaa ||1||
english: What can anyone else say? What can anyone explain? Only You Yourself can estimate Your worth. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: oa(n)kaar sabh srisat upaaee ||
english: The One Universal Creator created the entire Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sabh khel tamaasaa teree vadiaaee ||
english: All the plays and dramas are to Your glory and greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਕ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape vek kare sabh saachaa aape bha(n)n ghaRaaidaa ||2||
english: The True Lord Himself makes all distinctions; He Himself breaks and builds. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜੀਗਰਿ ਇਕ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: baajeegar ik baajee paaee ||
english: The Juggler has staged His juggling show.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: poore gur te nadaree aaee ||
english: Through the Perfect Guru, one comes to behold it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sadaa alipat rahai gurasabadee saache siu chit laaidaa ||3||
english: One who remains forever detached in the Word of the Guru's Shabad - his consciousness is attuned to the True Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਜਹਿ ਬਾਜੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: baajahi baaje dhun aakaaraa ||
english: The musical instruments of the body vibrate and resound.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਵਜਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aap vajaae vajaavanahaaraa ||
english: The Player Himself plays them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਵਹੈ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਵਣੈ ਸਭ ਵਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ghat ghat paun vahai ik ra(n)gee mil pavanai sabh vajaaidaa ||4||
english: The breath flows equally through the hearts of each and every being. Receiving the breath, all the instruments sing. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: karataa kare s nihachau hovai ||
english: Whatever the Creator does, surely comes to pass.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabade haumai khovai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, egotism is consumed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee kisai de vadiaaee naamo naam dhiaaidaa ||5||
english: By Guru's Grace, some are blessed with glorious greatness; they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: gur seve jevad hor laahaa naahee ||
english: There is no other profit as great as service to the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: naam ma(n)n vasai naamo saalaahee ||
english: The Naam abides within my mind, and I praise the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naamo naam sadaa sukhadaataa naamo laahaa paaidaa ||6||
english: The Naam is forever the Giver of peace. Through the Naam, we earn the profit. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai sabh dukh sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Without the Name, all the world suffers in misery.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਵਧਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bahu karam kamaavahi vadhahi vikaaraa ||
english: The more actions one does, the more the corruption increases.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naam na sevahi kiu sukh paaeeai bin naavai dukh paaidaa ||7||
english: Without serving the Naam, how can anyone find peace? Without the Naam, one suffers in pain. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aap kare tai aap karaae ||
english: He Himself acts, and inspires all to act.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee kisai bujhaae ||
english: By Guru's Grace, He reveals Himself to a few.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਹਿ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: guramukh hovahi se ba(n)dhan toRahi mukatee kai ghar paaidaa ||8||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh breaks his bonds, and attains the home of liberation. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਣਤ ਗਣੈ ਸੋ ਜਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ganat ganai so jalai sa(n)saaraa ||
english: One who calculates his accounts, burns in the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਚੁਕੈ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sahasaa mool na chukai vikaaraa ||
english: His skepticism and corruption are never dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਣਤ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s ganat chukaae sache sach samaaidaa ||9||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh abandons his calculations; through Truth, we merge in the True Lord. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: je sach dei ta paae koee ||
english: If God grants Truth, then we may attain it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee paragat hoee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, it is revealed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: sach naam saalaahe ra(n)g raataa gur kirapaa te sukh paaidaa ||10||
english: One who praises the True Name, and remains imbued with the Lord's Love, by Guru's Grace, finds peace. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam naam piaaraa ||
english: The Beloved Naam, the Name of the Lord, is chanting, meditation, penance and self-control.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kilavikh kaate kaatanahaaraa ||
english: God, the Destroyer, destroys sins.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: har kai naam tan man seetal hoaa sahaje sahaj samaaidaa ||11||
english: Through the Name of the Lord, the body and mind are cooled and soothed, and one is intuitively, easily absorbed into the Celestial Lord. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar lobh man mailai mal laae ||
english: With greed within them, their minds are filthy, and they spread filth around.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: maile karam kare dukh paae ||
english: They do filthy deeds, and suffer in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: kooRo kooR kare vaapaaraa kooR bol dukh paaidaa ||12||
english: They deal in falsehood, and nothing but falsehood; telling lies, they suffer in pain. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: niramal baanee ko ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: Rare is that person who enshrines the Immaculate Bani of the Guru's Word within his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sahasaa jaae ||
english: By Guru's Grace, his skepticism is removed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: gur kai bhaanai chalai din raatee naam chet sukh paaidaa ||13||
english: He walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, day and night; remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he finds peace. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aap sira(n)daa sachaa soee ||
english: The True Lord Himself is the Creator.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਏ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aap upaai khapaae soee ||
english: He Himself creates and destroys.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s sadaa salaahe mil saache sukh paaidaa ||14||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh, praises the Lord forever. Meeting the True Lord, he finds peace. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: anek jatan kare i(n)dree vas na hoee ||
english: Making countless efforts, sexual desire is not overcome.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਜਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kaam karodh jalai sabh koee ||
english: Everyone is burning in the fires of sexuality and anger.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: satigur seve man vas aavai man maare manahi samaaidaa ||15||
english: Serving the True Guru, one brings his mind under control; conquering his mind, he merges in the Mind of God. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: meraa teraa tudh aape keeaa ||
english: You Yourself created the sense of 'mine' and 'yours.'

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh tere ja(n)t tere sabh jeeaa ||
english: All creatures are Yours; You created all beings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੮॥
transliteration: naanak naam samaal sadaa too guramatee ma(n)n vasaaidaa ||16||4||18||
english: O Nanak, contemplate the Naam forever; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord abides in the mind. ||16||4||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu daataa agam athaahaa ||
english: The Dear Lord is the Giver, inaccessible and unfathomable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: os til na tamaai veparavaahaa ||
english: He does not have even an iota of greed; He is self-sufficient.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਪੜਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis no apaR na sakai koee aape mel milaaidaa ||1||
english: No one can reach up to Him; He Himself unites in His Union. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karai s nihachau hoee ||
english: Whatever He does, surely comes to pass.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tis bin daataa avar na koee ||
english: There is no other Giver, except for Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis no naam daan kare so paae gurasabadee melaaidaa ||2||
english: Whoever the Lord blesses with His gift, obtains it. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He unites him with Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਉਦਹ ਭਵਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: chaudah bhavan tere hatanaale ||
english: The fourteen worlds are Your markets.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur dikhaae a(n)tar naale ||
english: The True Guru reveals them, along with one's inner being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵੈ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਕੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naavai kaa vaapaaree hovai gurasabadee ko paaidaa ||3||
english: One who deals in the Name, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, obtains it. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur seviai sahaj ana(n)daa ||
english: Serving the True Guru, one obtains intuitive bliss.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਆਇ ਵੁਠਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: hiradai aai vuthaa govi(n)daa ||
english: The Lord of the Universe comes to dwell within the heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sahaje bhagat kare din raatee aape bhagat karaaidaa ||4||
english: He intuitively practices devotional worship day and night; God Himself practices devotional worship. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: satigur te vichhuRe tinee dukh paaiaa ||
english: Those who are separated from the True Guru, suffer in misery.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anadin maareeahi dukh sabaaiaa ||
english: Night and day, they are punished, and they suffer in total agony.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਥੇ ਕਾਲੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: mathe kaale mahal na paavahi dukh hee vich dukh paaidaa ||5||
english: Their faces are blackened, and they do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. They suffer in sorrow and agony. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevahi se vadabhaagee ||
english: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਸਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaj bhaai sachee liv laagee ||
english: They intuitively enshrine love for the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sacho sach kamaavahi sad hee sachai mel milaaidaa ||6||
english: They practice Truth, forever Truth; they are united in Union with the True Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਚਾ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis no sachaa dei s paae ||
english: He alone obtains the Truth, unto whom the True Lord gives it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar saach bharam chukaae ||
english: His inner being is filled with Truth, and his doubt is dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੈ ਕਾ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sach sachai kaa aape daataa jis devai so sach paaidaa ||7||
english: The True Lord Himself is the Giver of Truth; he alone obtains the Truth, unto whom He gives it. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa sabhanaa kaa soee ||
english: He Himself is the Creator of all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jis no aap bujhaae boojhai koee ||
english: Only one whom He instructs, understands Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: aape bakhase de vadiaaee aape mel milaaidaa ||8||
english: He Himself forgives, and grants glorious greatness. He himself unites in His Union. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਦਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: haumai karadiaa janam gavaaiaa ||
english: Acting egotistically, one loses his life.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aagai mohu na chookai maaiaa ||
english: Even in the world hereafter, emotioal attachment to Maya does not leave him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲੇਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਲ ਘਾਣੀ ਪੀੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: agai jamakaal lekhaa levai jiu til ghaanee peeRaaidaa ||9||
english: In the world hereafter, the Messenger of Death calls him to account, and crushes him like sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag gur sevaa hoee ||
english: By perfect destiny, one serves the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸੇਵੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare taa seve koee ||
english: If God grants His Grace, then one serves.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: jamakaal tis neR na aavai mahal sachai sukh paaidaa ||10||
english: The Messenger of Death cannot even approach him, and in the Mansion of the True Lord's Presence, he finds peace. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tin sukh paaiaa jo tudh bhaae ||
english: They alone find peace, who are pleasing to Your Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag gur sevaa laae ||
english: By perfect destiny, they are attached to the Guru's service.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: terai hath hai sabh vadiaaee jis devahi so paaidaa ||11||
english: All glorious greatness rests in Your Hands; he alone obtains it, unto whom You give it. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar paragaas guroo te paae ||
english: Through the Guru, one's inner being is enlightened and illumined.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naam padaarath ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: giaan ratan sadaa ghat chaanan agiaan a(n)dher gavaaidaa ||12||
english: The jewel of spiritual wisdom ever illumines the heart, and the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: agiaanee a(n)dhe doojai laage ||
english: The blind and ignorant are attached to duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਡੁਬਿ ਮੂਏ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: bin paanee dub mooe abhaage ||
english: The unfortunates are drowned without water, and die.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: chaladiaa ghar dar nadar na aavai jam dar baadhaa dukh paaidaa ||13||
english: When they depart from the world, they do not find the Lord's door and home; bound and gagged at Death's door, they suffer in pain. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur seve mukat na hoee ||
english: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds liberation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: giaanee dhiaanee poochhahu koee ||
english: Go ask any spiritual teacher or meditator.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: satigur seve tis milai vadiaaee dar sachai sobhaa paaidaa ||14||
english: Whoever serves the True Guru is blessed with glorious greatness, and honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: satigur no seve tis aap milaae ||
english: One who serves the True Guru, the Lord merges into Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mamataa kaat sach liv laae ||
english: Cutting away attachment, one lovingly focuses on the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: sadaa sach vanajahi vaapaaree naamo laahaa paaidaa ||15||
english: The merchants deal forever in Truth; they earn the profit of the Naam. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa ||
english: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sabad marai soee jan mukataa ||
english: He alone is liberated, who dies in the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੫॥੧੯॥
transliteration: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar naamo naam dhiaaidaa ||16||5||19||
english: O Nanak, the Naam dwells deep within the mind; meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||5||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh karanaa so kar paaiaa ||
english: Whatever You do, is done.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaane vich ko viralaa aaiaa ||
english: How rare are those who walk in harmony with the Lord's Will.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhaanaa ma(n)ne so sukh paae bhaane vich sukh paaidaa ||1||
english: One who surrenders to the Lord's Will finds peace; he finds peace in the Lord's Will. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh teraa bhaanaa bhaavai ||
english: Your Will is pleasing to the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sahaje hee sukh sach kamaavai ||
english: Practicing Truth, he intuitively finds peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੇ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਨਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bhaane no lochai bahuteree aapanaa bhaanaa aap manaaidaa ||2||
english: Many long to walk in harmony with the Lord's Will; He Himself inspires us to surrender to His Will. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: teraa bhaanaa ma(n)ne s milai tudh aae ||
english: One who surrenders to Your Will, meets with You, Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis bhaanaa bhaavai so tujhahi samaae ||
english: One who is pleased with Your Will is immersed in You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਭਾਣਾ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhaane vich vadee vadiaaee bhaanaa kisahi karaaidaa ||3||
english: Glorious greatness rests in God's Will; rare are those who accept it. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai taa guroo milaae ||
english: When it pleases His Will, He leads us to meet the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam padaarath paae ||
english: The Gurmukh finds the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਣਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tudh aapanai bhaanai sabh srisat upaaee jis no bhaanaa dehi tis bhaaidaa ||4||
english: By Your Will, You created the whole Universe; those whom You bless with Your favor are pleased with Your Will. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dh kare chaturaaee ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs practice cleverness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣਾ ਨ ਮੰਨੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhaanaa na ma(n)ne bahut dukh paaee ||
english: They do not surrender to the Lord's Will, and suffer terrible pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bharame bhoolaa aavai jaae ghar mahal na kabahoo paaidaa ||5||
english: Deluded by doubt, they come and go in reincarnation; they never find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur mele de vadiaaee ||
english: The True Guru brings Union, and grants glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee sevaa dhur phuramaaee ||
english: The Primal Lord ordained service to the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: satigur seve taa naam paae naame hee sukh paaidaa ||6||
english: Serving the True Guru, the Naam is obtained. Through the Naam, one finds peace. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh naavahu upajai naavahu chheejai ||
english: Everything wells up from the Naam, and through the Naam, perishes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te man tan bheejai ||
english: By Guru's Grace, the mind and body are pleased with the Naam.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਸਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਸ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: rasanaa naam dhiaae ras bheejai ras hee te ras paaidaa ||7||
english: Meditating on the Naam, the tongue is drenched with the Lord's sublime essence. Through this essence, the Essence is obtained. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mahalai a(n)dar mahal ko paae ||
english: Rare are those who find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within the mansion of their own body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad sach chit laae ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they lovingly focus their consciousness on the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jis no sach dei soee sach paae sache sach milaaidaa ||8||
english: Whoever the Lord blesses with Truth obtains Truth; he merges in Truth, and only Truth. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naam visaar man tan dukh paaiaa ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body suffer in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabh rog kamaaiaa ||
english: Attached to the love of Maya, he earns nothing but disease.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਨਰਕੇ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: bin naavai man tan hai kusatee narake vaasaa paaidaa ||9||
english: Without the Name, his mind and body are afflicted with leprosy, and he obtains his home in hell. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: naam rate tin niramal dehaa ||
english: Those who are imbued with the Naam - their bodies are immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੰਸਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: niramal ha(n)saa sadaa sukh nehaa ||
english: Their soul-swan is immaculate, and in the Lord's Love, they find eternal peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naam salaahi sadaa sukh paaiaa nij ghar vaasaa paaidaa ||10||
english: Praising the Naam, they find eternal peace, and dwell in the home of their own inner being. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh ko vanaj kare vaapaaraa ||
english: Everyone deals and trades.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai sabh totaa sa(n)saaraa ||
english: Without the Name, all the world loses.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਗੋ ਆਇਆ ਨਾਗੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naago aaiaa naago jaasee vin naavai dukh paaidaa ||11||
english: Naked they come, and naked they go; without the Name, they suffer in pain. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jis no naam dei so paae ||
english: He alone obtains the Naam, unto whom the Lord gives it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad har ma(n)n vasaae ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te naam vasiaa ghat a(n)tar naamo naam dhiaaidaa ||12||
english: By Guru's Grace, the Naam dwells deep within the heart, and one meditates upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਭ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: naavai no lochai jetee sabh aaee ||
english: Everyone who comes into the world, longs for the Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naau tinaa milai dhur purab kamaaee ||
english: They alone are blessed with the Name, whose past actions were so ordained by the Primal Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jinee naau paaiaa se vadabhaagee gur kai sabad milaaidaa ||13||
english: Those who obtain the Name are very fortunate. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are united with God. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kot at apaaraa ||
english: Utterly incomparable is the fortress of the body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tis vich bahi prabh kare veechaaraa ||
english: Within it, God sits in contemplation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੋ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: sachaa niaau sacho vaapaaraa nihachal vaasaa paaidaa ||14||
english: He administers true justice, and trades in Truth; through Him, one finds the eternal, unchanging dwelling. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਘਰ ਬੰਕੇ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar ghar ba(n)ke thaan suhaaiaa ||
english: Deep within the inner self are glorious homes and beautiful places.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਥਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh viralai kinai thaan paaiaa ||
english: But rare is that person who, as Gurmukh, finds these places.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: it saath nibahai saalaahe sache har sachaa ma(n)n vasaaidaa ||15||
english: If one stays in these places, and praises the True Lord, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਇਕ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: merai karatai ik banat banaaee ||
english: My Creator Lord has formed this formation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: is dehee vich sabh vath paaee ||
english: He has placed everything within this body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੬॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam vanajahi ra(n)g raate guramukh ko naam paaidaa ||16||6||20||
english: O Nanak, those who deal in the Naam are imbued with His Love. The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||6||20||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa ka(n)chan sabad veechaaraa ||
english: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, the body becomes golden.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tithai har vasai jis daa a(n)t na paaraavaaraa ||
english: The Lord abides there; He has no end or limitation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: anadin har sevihu sachee baanee har jeeu sabad milaaidaa ||1||
english: Night and day, serve the Lord, and chant the True Word of the Guru's Bani. Through the Shabad, meet the Dear Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har chetahi tin balihaarai jaau ||
english: I am a sacrifice to those who remember the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਿਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad tin mel milaau ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I unite in Union with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਲਾਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tin kee dhoor laaee mukh masatak satasa(n)gat bahi gun gaaidaa ||2||
english: I touch the dust of their feet to my face and forehead; sitting in the Society of the Saints, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: har ke gun gaavaa je har prabh bhaavaa ||
english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, as I am pleasing to the Lord God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar har naam sabad suhaavaa ||
english: With the Lord's Name deep within my inner being, I am adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gurabaanee chahu ku(n)dee suneeai saachai naam samaaidaa ||3||
english: The Word of the Guru's Bani is heard throughout the four corners of the world; through it, we merge in the True Name. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: so jan saachaa j a(n)tar bhaale ||
english: That humble being, who searches within himself,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad har nadar nihaale ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, sees the Lord with his eyes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: giaan a(n)jan paae gurasabadee nadaree nadar milaaidaa ||4||
english: Through the Guru's Shabad, he applies the ointment of spiritual wisdom to his eyes; the Gracious Lord, in His Grace, unites him with Himself. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: vadai bhaag ihu sareer paaiaa ||
english: By great good fortune, I obtained this body;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maanas janam sabad chit laaiaa ||
english: in this human life, I have focused my consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bin sabadai sabh a(n)dh a(n)dheraa guramukh kisahi bujhaaidaa ||5||
english: Without the Shabad, everything is enveloped in utter darkness; only the Gurmukh understands. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ik kit aae janam gavaae ||
english: Some merely waste away their lives - why have they even come into the world?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh laage doojai bhaae ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are attached to the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪਗਿ ਖਿਸਿਐ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: eh velaa phir haath na aavai pag khisiai pachhutaaidaa ||6||
english: This opportunity shall not into their hands again; their foot slips, and they come to regret and repent. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad pavitr sareeraa ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the body is sanctified.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tis vich vasai sach gunee gaheeraa ||
english: The True Lord, the ocean of virtue, dwells within it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sacho sach vekhai sabh thaaee sach sun ma(n)n vasaaidaa ||7||
english: One who sees the Truest of the True everywhere, hears the Truth, and enshrines it within his mind. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: haumai ganat gur sabad nivaare ||
english: Egotism and mental calculations are relieved through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu hiradai rakhahu ur dhaare ||
english: Keep the Dear Lord close, and enshrine Him in your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad sadaa saalaahe mil saache sukh paaidaa ||8||
english: One who praises the Lord forever, through the Guru's Shabad, meets with the True Lord, and finds peace. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਚੇਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਚੇਤਾਏ ॥
transliteration: so chete jis aap chetaae ||
english: He alone remembers the Lord, whom the Lord inspires to remember.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad vasai man aae ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: aape vekhai aape boojhai aapai aap samaaidaa ||9||
english: He Himself sees, and He Himself understands; He merges all into Himself. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jin man vich vath paaee soee jaanai ||
english: He alone knows, who has placed the object within his mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabade aap pachhaanai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he comes to understand himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: aap pachhaanai soee jan niramal baanee sabad sunaaidaa ||10||
english: That humble being who understands himself is immaculate. He proclaims the Guru's Bani, and the Word of the Shabad. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: eh kaaiaa pavit hai sareer ||
english: This body is sanctified and purified;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਚੇਤੈ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee chetai gunee gaheer ||
english: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it contemplates the Lord, the ocean of virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: anadin gun gaavai ra(n)g raataa gun kahi gunee samaaidaa ||11||
english: One who chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord night and day, and remains attuned to His Love, chants His Glorious Virtues, immersed in the Glorious Lord. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭ ਮੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ehu sareer sabh mool hai maaiaa ||
english: This body is the source of all Maya;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai bharam bhulaaiaa ||
english: in love with duality, it is deluded by doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: har na chetai sadaa dukh paae bin har chete dukh paaidaa ||12||
english: It does not remember the Lord, and suffers in eternal pain. Without remembering the Lord, it suffers in pain. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: j satigur seve so paravaan ||
english: One who serves the True Guru is approved and respected.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa ha(n)s niramal dar sachai jaan ||
english: His body and soul-swan are immaculate and pure; in the Court of the Lord, he is known to be true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸੋਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: har seve har ma(n)n vasaae sohai har gun gaaidaa ||13||
english: He serves the Lord, and enshrines the Lord in his mind; he is exalted, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: bin bhaagaa gur seviaa na jaai ||
english: Without good destiny, no one can serve the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bhoole mue bilalaai ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, and die weeping and wailing.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: jin kau nadar hovai gur keree har jeeu aap milaaidaa ||14||
english: Those who are blessed by the Guru's Glance of Grace - the Dear Lord unites them with Himself. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਪਕੇ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kot pake hatanaale ||
english: In the body fortress, are the solidly-constructed markets.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਵੈ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh levai vasat samaale ||
english: The Gurmukh purchases the object, and takes care of it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: har kaa naam dhiaai din raatee ootam padavee paaidaa ||15||
english: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, day and night, he attains the sublime, exalted status. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: aape sachaa hai sukhadaataa ||
english: The True Lord Himself is the Giver of peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kai sabad pachhaataa ||
english: Through the Shabad of the Perfect Guru, He is realized.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੭॥੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam salaahe saachaa poorai bhaag ko paaidaa ||16||7||21||
english: Nanak praises the Naam, the True Name of the Lord; through perfect destiny, He is found. ||16||7||21||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nira(n)kaar aakaar upaaiaa ||
english: The Formless Lord created the universe of form.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohu hukam banaaiaa ||
english: By the Hukam of His Command, He created attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aape khel kare sabh karataa sun saachaa ma(n)n vasaaidaa ||1||
english: The Creator Himself stages all the plays; hearing of the True Lord, enshrine Him in your mind. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਸੂਤਿ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa maaee trai gun parasoot jamaaiaa ||
english: Maya, the mother, gave birth to the three gunas, the three qualities,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: chaare bed brahame no phuramaaiaa ||
english: and proclaimed the four Vedas to Brahma.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਰ੍ਹੇ ਮਾਹ ਵਾਰ ਥਿਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: varhe maah vaar thitee kar is jag mahi sojhee paaidaa ||2||
english: Creating the years, months, days and dates, He infused intelligence into the world. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
transliteration: gur sevaa te karanee saar ||
english: Service to the Guru is the most excellent action.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰ ॥
transliteration: raam naam raakhahu ur dhaar ||
english: Enshrine the Lord's Name within your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਵਰਤੀ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਇਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gurabaanee varatee jag a(n)tar is baanee te har naam paaidaa ||3||
english: The Word of the Guru's Bani prevails throughout the world; through this Bani, the Lord's Name is obtained. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵੇਦੁ ਪੜੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਾਦ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: ved paRai anadin vaad samaale ||
english: He reads the Vedas, but he starts arguments night and day.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਬਧਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: naam na chetai badhaa jamakaale ||
english: He does not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he is bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai sadaa dukh paae trai gun bharam bhulaaidaa ||4||
english: In the love of duality, he suffers in pain forever; he is deluded by doubt, and confused by the three gunas. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: guramukh ekas siu liv laae ||
english: The Gurmukh is in love with the One Lord alone;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tribidh manasaa manahi samaae ||
english: he submerges in his mind the three-phased desire.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: saachai sabad sadaa hai mukataa maaiaa mohu chukaaidaa ||5||
english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, he is liberated forever; he renounces emotional attachment to Maya. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੇ ਹੁਣਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: jo dhur raate se hun raate ||
english: Those who are so pre-ordained to be imbued, are imbued with love for the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sahaje maate ||
english: By Guru's Grace, they are intuitively intoxicated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: satigur sev sadaa prabh paaiaa aapai aap milaaidaa ||6||
english: Serving the True Guru forever, they find God; He Himself unites them with Himself. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mohi bharam na paae ||
english: In attachment to Maya and doubt, the Lord is not found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਗਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai lagaa dukh paae ||
english: Attached to the love of duality, one suffers in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਜਾਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: soohaa ra(n)g din thoRe hovai is jaade bilam na laaidaa ||7||
english: The crimson color lasts for only a few days; all too soon, it fades away. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਰੰਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ehu man bhai bhaai ra(n)gaae ||
english: So color this mind in the Fear and the Love of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: it ra(n)g saache maahi samaae ||
english: Dyed in this color, one merges in the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: poorai bhaag ko ihu ra(n)g paae guramatee ra(n)g chaRaaidaa ||8||
english: By perfect destiny, some may obtain this color. Through the Guru's Teachings, this color is applied. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh bahut kare abhimaan ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs take great pride in themselves.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: daragah kab hee na paavai maan ||
english: In the Court of the Lord, they are never honored.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: doojai laage janam gavaaiaa bin boojhe dukh paaidaa ||9||
english: Attached to duality, they waste their lives; without understanding, they suffer in pain. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: merai prabh a(n)dar aap lukaaiaa ||
english: My God has hidden Himself deep within the self.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har milai milaaiaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, one is united in the Lord's Union.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: sachaa prabh sachaa vaapaaraa naam amolak paaidaa ||10||
english: God is True, and True is His trade, through which the priceless Naam is obtained. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: is kaaiaa kee keemat kinai na paaee ||
english: No one has found this body's value.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਇਹ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: merai thaakur ih banat banaaee ||
english: My Lord and Master has worked His handiwork.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਧੈ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: guramukh hovai s kaaiaa sodhai aapahi aap milaaidaa ||11||
english: One who becomes Gurmukh purifies his body, and then the Lord unites him with Himself. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੋਟਾ ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa vich totaa kaaiaa vich laahaa ||
english: Within the body, one loses, and within the body, one wins.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh khoje veparavaahaa ||
english: The Gurmukh seeks the self-sustaining Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: guramukh vanaj sadaa sukh paae sahaje sahaj milaaidaa ||12||
english: The Gurmukh trades, and finds peace forever; he intuitively merges in the Celestial Lord. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਚੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa mahal sache bha(n)daaraa ||
english: True is the Lord's Mansion, and True is His treasure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape devai devanahaaraa ||
english: The Great Giver Himself gives.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: guramukh saalaahe sukhadaate man mele keemat paaidaa ||13||
english: The Gurmukh praises the Giver of peace; his mind is united with the Lord, and he comes to know His worth. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa vich vasat keemat nahee paaee ||
english: Within the body is the object; its value cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh aape de vadiaaee ||
english: He Himself grants glorious greatness to the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਹਟੁ ਸੋਈ ਵਥੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: jis daa hat soee vath jaanai guramukh dei na pachhotaaidaa ||14||
english: He alone knows this object, to whom this store belongs; the Gurmukh is blessed with it, and does not come to regret. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu sabh mahi rahiaa samaaee ||
english: The Dear Lord is pervading and permeating all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee paaiaa jaaee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, He is found.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: aape mel milaae aape sabade sahaj samaaidaa ||15||
english: He Himself unites in His Union; through the Word of the Shabad, one intuitively merges with Him. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: aape sachaa sabad milaae ||
english: The True Lord Himself unites us in the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sabade vichahu bharam chukaae ||
english: Within the Shabad, doubt is driven out.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੮॥੨੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee naame hee sukh paaidaa ||16||8||22||
english: O Nanak, He blesses us with His Naam, and throgh the Naam, peace is found. ||16||8||22||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar veparavaahe ||
english: He is inaccessible, unfathomable and self-sustaining.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: aape miharavaan agam athaahe ||
english: He Himself is merciful, inaccessible and unlimited.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: apaR koi na sakai tis no gurasabadee melaaiaa ||1||
english: No one can reach up to Him; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is met. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tudhuno sevahi jo tudh bhaavahi ||
english: He alone serves You, who pleases You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabade sach samaavahi ||
english: Through the Guru's Shabad, he merges in the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anadin gun ravahi din raatee rasanaa har ras bhaaiaa ||2||
english: Night and day, he chants the Lord's Praises, day and night; his tongue savors and delights in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sabad marahi se maran savaarahi ||
english: Those who die in the Shabad - their death is exalted and glorified.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: har ke gun hiradai ur dhaarahi ||
english: They enshrine the Lord's Glories in their hearts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam saphal har charanee laage doojaa bhaau chukaaiaa ||3||
english: Holding tight to the Guru's feet, their lives becomes prosperous, and they are rid of the love of duality. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu mele aap milaae ||
english: The Dear Lord unites them in Union with Himself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabade aap gavaae ||
english: Through the Guru's Shabad, self-conceit is dispelled.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: anadin sadaa har bhagatee raate is jag mahi laahaa paaiaa ||4||
english: Those who remain attuned to devotional worship to the Lord, night and day, earn the profit in this world. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tere gun kahaa mai kahan na jaaee ||
english: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I describe? I cannot describe them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)t na paaraa keemat nahee paaee ||
english: You have no end or limitation. Your value cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: aape daiaa kare sukhadaataa gun mahi gunee samaaiaa ||5||
english: When the Giver of peace Himself bestows His Mercy, the virtuous are absorbed in virtue. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: is jag mahi mohu hai paasaaraa ||
english: In this world, emotional attachment is spread all over.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh agiaanee a(n)dh a(n)dhaaraa ||
english: The ignorant, self-willed manmukh is immersed in utter darkness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhai dhaavat janam gavaaiaa bin naavai dukh paaiaa ||6||
english: Chasing after worldly affairs, he wastes away his life in vain; without the Name, he suffers in pain. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: karam hovai taa satigur paae ||
english: If God grants His Grace, then one finds the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: haumai mail sabad jalaae ||
english: Through the Shabad, the filth of egotism is burned away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: man niramal giaan ratan chaanan agiaan a(n)dher gavaaiaa ||7||
english: The mind becomes immaculate, and the jewel of spiritual wisdom brings enlightenment; the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: tere naam anek keemat nahee paaee ||
english: Your Names are countless; Your value cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sach naam har hiradai vasaaee ||
english: I enshrine the Lord's True Name within my heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: keemat kaun kare prabh teree too aape sahaj samaaiaa ||8||
english: Who can estimate Your value, God? You are immersed and absorbed in Yourself. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naam amolak agam apaaraa ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless, inaccessible and infinite.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naa ko hoaa tolanahaaraa ||
english: No one can weigh it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: aape tole tol tolaae gurasabadee mel tolaaiaa ||9||
english: You Yourself weigh, and estimate all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You unite, when the weight is perfect. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: sevak sevahi karahi aradaas ||
english: Your servant serves, and offers this prayer.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਬਹਾਲਹਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: too aape mel bahaalahi paas ||
english: Please, let me sit near You, and unite me with Yourself.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa sukhadaataa poorai karam dhiaaiaa ||10||
english: You are the Giver of peace to all beings; by perfect karma, we meditate on You. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jat sat sa(n)jam j sach kamaavai ||
english: Chastity, truth and self-control come by practicing and living the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ihu man niramal j har gun gaavai ||
english: This mind becomes immaculate and pure, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: is bikh mahi a(n)mrit paraapat hovai har jeeu mere bhaaiaa ||11||
english: In this world of poison, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained, if it pleases my Dear Lord. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: jis no bujhaae soee boojhai ||
