english: He alone understands, whom God inspires to understand.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: har gun gaavai a(n)dar soojhai ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one's inner being is awakened.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: haumai meraa thaak rahaae sahaje hee sach paaiaa ||12||
english: Egotism and possessiveness are silenced and subdued, and one intuitively finds the True Lord. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਹੋਰ ਫਿਰੈ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bin karamaa hor phirai ghaneree ||
english: Without good karma, countless others wander around.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਚੁਕੈ ਨ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mai chukai na pheree ||
english: They die, and die again, only to be reborn; they cannot escape the cycle of reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਰਾਤਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: bikh kaa raataa bikh kamaavai sukh na kabahoo paaiaa ||13||
english: Imbued with poison, they practice poison and corruption, and they never find peace. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bahute bhekh kare bhekhadhaaree ||
english: Many disguise themselves with religious robes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bin sabadai haumai kinai na maaree ||
english: Without the Shabad, no one has conquered egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: jeevat marai taa mukat paae sachai naai samaaiaa ||14||
english: One who remains dead while yet alive is liberated, and merges in the True Name. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਤਨਹਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: agiaan trisanaa is tanahi jalaae ||
english: Spiritual ignorance and desire burn this human body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: tis dee boojhai j gurasabad kamaae ||
english: He alone puts out this fire, who practices and lives the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: tan man seetal krodh nivaare haumai maar samaaiaa ||15||
english: His body and mind are cooled and soothed, and his anger is silenced; conquering egotism, he merges in the Lord. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee vadiaaee ||
english: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His glorious greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee viralai paaee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, a rare few attain this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੨੩॥
transliteration: naanak ek kahai bena(n)tee naame naam samaaiaa ||16||1||23||
english: Nanak offers this one prayer: through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, may I merge in the Lord. ||16||1||23||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
english: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nadaree bhagataa laihu milaae ||
english: By Your Grace, please unite with Your devotees.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhagat salaahan sadaa liv laae ||
english: Your devotees ever praise You, lovingly focusing on You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tau saranaaee ubarahi karate aape mel milaaiaa ||1||
english: In Your Sanctuary, they are saved, O Creator Lord; You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: poorai sabad bhagat suhaaee ||
english: Sublime and exalted is devotion to the Perfect Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar sukh terai man bhaaee ||
english: Peace prevails within; they are pleasing to Your Mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man tan sachee bhagatee raataa sache siu chit laaiaa ||2||
english: One whose mind and body are imbued with true devotion, focuses his consciousness on the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਦ ਜਲੈ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: haumai vich sad jalai sareeraa ||
english: In egotism, the body is forever burning.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
transliteration: karam hovai bhete gur pooraa ||
english: When God grants His Grace, one meets the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: a(n)tar agiaan sabad bujhaae satigur te sukh paaiaa ||3||
english: The Shabad dispels the spiritual ignorance within, and through the True Guru, one finds peace. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamaae ||
english: The blind, self-willed manmukh acts blindly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਸੰਕਟ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bahu sa(n)kat jonee bharamaae ||
english: He is in terrible trouble, and wanders in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਜੇਵੜਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕਾਟੈ ਅੰਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jam kaa jevaRaa kade na kaatai a(n)te bahu dukh paaiaa ||4||
english: He can never snap the noose of Death, and in the end, he suffers in horrible pain. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa sabad nivaare ||
english: Through the Shabad, one's comings and goings in reincarnation are ended.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sach naam rakhai ur dhaare ||
english: He keeps the True Name enshrined within his heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad marai man maare haumai jaai samaaiaa ||5||
english: He dies in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and conquers his mind; stilling his egotism, he merges in the Lord. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੈ ਪਰਜ ਵਿਗੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanai paraj vigoee ||
english: Coming and going, the people of the world are wasting away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur thir koi na hoee ||
english: Without the True Guru, no one finds permanence and stability.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: a(n)tar jot sabad sukh vasiaa jotee jot milaaiaa ||6||
english: The Shabad shines its Light deep within the self, and one dwells in peace; one's light merges into the Light. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch doot chitavahi vikaaraa ||
english: The five demons think of evil and corruption.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਕਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa moh kaa ehu pasaaraa ||
english: The expanse is the manifestation of emotional attachment to Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੭॥
transliteration: satigur seve taa mukat hovai pa(n)ch doot vas aaiaa ||7||
english: Serving the True Guru, one is liberated, and the five demons are put under his control. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: baajh guroo hai mohu gubaaraa ||
english: Without the Guru, there is only the darkness of attachment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਡੁਬੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: phir phir dubai vaaro vaaraa ||
english: Over and over, time and time again, they are drowned.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
transliteration: satigur bhete sach driRaae sach naam man bhaaiaa ||8||
english: Meeting the True Guru, Truth is implanted within, and the True Name becomes pleasing to the mind. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਦਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦਰਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saachaa dar saachaa daravaaraa ||
english: True is His Door, and True is His Court, His Royal Darbaar.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sache sevahi sabad piaaraa ||
english: The true ones serve Him, through the Beloved Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
transliteration: sachee dhun sache gun gaavaa sache maahi samaaiaa ||9||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, in the true melody, I am immersed and absorbed in Truth. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੋ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gharai a(n)dar ko ghar paae ||
english: Deep within the home of the self, one finds the home of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabade sahaj subhaae ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one easily, intuitively finds it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: othai sog vijog na viaapai sahaje sahaj samaaiaa ||10||
english: There, one is not afflicted with sorrow or separation; merge into the Celestial Lord with intuitive ease. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: doojai bhaai dusataa kaa vaasaa ||
english: The evil people live in the love of duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਉਦੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: bhaude phirahi bahu moh piaasaa ||
english: They wander around, totally attached and thirsty.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੁਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: kusa(n)gat bahahi sadaa dukh paavahi dukho dukh kamaaiaa ||11||
english: They sit in evil gatherings, and suffer in pain forever; they earn pain, nothing but pain. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur baajhahu sa(n)gat na hoee ||
english: Without the True Guru, there is no Sangat, no Congregation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bin sabade paar na paae koee ||
english: Without the Shabad, no one can cross over to the other side.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: sahaje gun ravahi din raatee jotee jot milaaiaa ||12||
english: One who intuitively chants God's Glorious Praises day and night - his light merges into the Light. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa birakh pa(n)khee vich vaasaa ||
english: The body is the tree; the bird of the soul dwells within it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit chugahi gur sabad nivaasaa ||
english: It drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, resting in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਉਡਹਿ ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: udahi na moole na aavahi na jaahee nij ghar vaasaa paaiaa ||13||
english: It never flies away, and it does not come or go; it dwells within the home of its own self. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਧਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa sodhahi sabad veechaarahi ||
english: Purify the body, and contemplate the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: moh thagauree bharam nivaarahi ||
english: Remove the poisonous drug of emotional attachment, and eradicate doubt.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: aape kripaa kare sukhadaataa aape mel milaaiaa ||14||
english: The Giver of peace Himself bestows His Mercy, and unites us in Union with Himself. ||14||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨੇੜੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sad hee neRai door na jaanahu ||
english: He is always near at hand; He is never far away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਜੀਕਿ ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad najeek pachhaanahu ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, realize that He is very near.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਗਸੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: bigasai kamal kiran paragaasai paragat kar dekhaaiaa ||15||
english: Your heart-lotus shall blossom forth, and the ray of God's Divine Light shall illuminate your heart; He shall be revealed to You. ||15||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa sachaa soee ||
english: The True Lord is Himself the Creator.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape maar jeevaale avar na koee ||
english: He Himself kills, and gives life; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੨੪॥
transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee aap gavaai sukh paaiaa ||16||2||24||
english: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, glorious greatness is obtained. Eradicating self-conceit, peace is found. ||16||2||24||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maaroo, Solahas, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sachaa aap savaaranahaaraa ||
english: The Lord Lord Himself is the One who exalts and embellishes.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਨ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਬੀਜੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: avar na soojhas beejee kaaraa ||
english: Do not consider any other work.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh sach vasai ghat a(n)tar sahaje sach samaaee he ||1||
english: The True Lord abides deep within the heart of the Gurmukh, who intuitively merges in the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa sach vasai man maahee ||
english: The True Lord dwells within the minds of all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee sahaj samaahee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, they are intuitively absorbed in Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur gur karat sadaa sukh paaiaa gur charanee chit laaee he ||2||
english: Calling out, "Guru, Guru", I have found eternal peace; my consciousness is focused on the Guru's feet. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur hai giaan satigur hai poojaa ||
english: The True Guru is spiritual wisdom; the True Guru is worship and adoration.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur sevee avar na doojaa ||
english: I serve the True Guru, and no other.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: satigur te naam ratan dhan paaiaa satigur kee sevaa bhaaee he ||3||
english: From the True Guru, I have obtained the wealth, the jewel of the Naam. Service to the True Guru is pleasing to me. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: bin satigur jo doojai laage ||
english: Without the True Guru, those who are attached to duality

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: aavahi jaahi bhram marahi abhaage ||
english: come and go, and wander in reincarnation; these unfortunate ones die.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak tin kee phir gat hovai j guramukh rahahi saranaaee he ||4||
english: O Nanak, even after they are emancipated, those who become Gurmukh remain in the Guru's Sanctuary. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh preet sadaa hai saachee ||
english: The love of the Gurmukh is forever true.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਾਗਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਜਾਚੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur te maagau naam ajaachee ||
english: I beg for the invaluable Naam, the Name of the Lord, from the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: hohu daiaal kripaa kar har jeeu rakh levahu gur saranaaee he ||5||
english: O Dear Lord, please be kind, and grant Your Grace; please keep me in the Guru's Sanctuary. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਚੁਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit ras satiguroo chuaaiaa ||
english: The True Guru trickles the Ambrosial Nectar into my mouth.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਸਵੈ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dasavai duaar pragat hoi aaiaa ||
english: My Tenth Gate has been opened and revealed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਹਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: tah anahad sabad vajahi dhun baanee sahaje sahaj samaaee he ||6||
english: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds there, with the melody of the Guru's Bani; one is easily, intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਤੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin kau karatai dhur likh paaee ||
english: Those who are so pre-ordained by the Creator,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: anadin gur gur karat vihaaee ||
english: pass their nights and days calling on the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸੀਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin satigur ko seejhai naahee gur charanee chit laaee he ||7||
english: Without the True Guru, no one understands; focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: jis bhaavai tis aape dei ||
english: The Lord Himself blesses those with whom He is pleased.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam padaarath lei ||
english: The Gurmukh receives the wealth of the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: aape kripaa kare naam devai naanak naam samaaee he ||8||
english: When the Lord grants His Grace, He bestows the Naam; Nanak is immersed and absorbed in the Naam. ||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: giaan ratan man paragat bhaiaa ||
english: The jewel of spiritual wisdom is revealed within the mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naam padaarath sahaje laiaa ||
english: The wealth of the Naam is easily, intuitively received.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: eh vadiaaee gur te paaee satigur kau sad bal jaaee he ||9||
english: This glorious greatness is obtained from the Guru; I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਸੂਰੁ ਨਿਸਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pragatiaa soor nis mitiaa a(n)dhiaaraa ||
english: With the rising of the sun, the darkness of the night is dispelled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਰਤਨਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: agiaan mitiaa gur ratan apaaraa ||
english: Spiritual ignorance is eradicated, by the priceless jewel of the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: satigur giaan ratan at bhaaree karam milai sukh paaee he ||10||
english: The True Guru is the fantastically valuable jewel of spiritual wisdom; blessed by God's Mercy, peace is found. ||10||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam pragatee hai soi ||
english: The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, and his good reputation increases.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਛਾ ਲੋਇ ॥
transliteration: chahu jug niramal hachhaa loi ||
english: In all four ages he is considered to be pure and good.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naame naam rate sukh paaiaa naam rahiaa liv laaee he ||11||
english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he finds peace. He remains lovingly focused on the Naam. ||11||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam paraapat hovai ||
english: The Gurmukh receives the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sahaje jaagai sahaje sovai ||
english: In intuitive peace he wakes, and in intuitive peace he sleeps.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: guramukh naam samaai samaavai naanak naam dhiaaee he ||12||
english: The Gurmukh is immersed and absorbed in the Naam; Nanak meditates on the Naam. ||12||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: bhagataa mukh a(n)mrit hai baanee ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Guru's Bani is in the mouth of the devotees.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: guramukh har naam aakh vakhaanee ||
english: The Gurmukhs chant and repeat the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: har har karat sadaa man bigasai har charanee man laaee he ||13||
english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, their minds forever blossom forth; they focus their minds on the Lord's Feet. ||13||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ham moorakh agiaan giaan kichh naahee ||
english: I am foolish and ignorant; I have no wisdom at all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਮਝ ਪੜੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: satigur te samajh paRee man maahee ||
english: From the True Guru, I have obtained understanding in my mind.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: hohu daiaal kripaa kar har jeeu satigur kee sevaa laaee he ||14||
english: O Dear Lord, please be kind to me, and grant Your Grace; let me be committed to serving the True Guru. ||14||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jin satigur jaataa tin ek pachhaataa ||
english: Those who know the True Guru realize the One Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sarabe rav rahiaa sukhadaataa ||
english: The Giver of peace is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: aatam cheen param pad paaiaa sevaa surat samaaee he ||15||
english: Understanding my own soul, I have obtained the Supreme Status; my awareness is immersed in selfless service. ||15||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਦਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: jin kau aad milee vadiaaee ||
english: Those who are blessed with glorious greatness by the Primal Lord God

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: satigur man vasiaa liv laaee ||
english: are lovingly focused on the True Guru, who dwells within their minds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
transliteration: aap miliaa jagajeevan daataa naanak a(n)k samaaee he ||16||1||
english: The Giver of life to the world Himself meets them; O Nanak, they are absorbed in His Being. ||16||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 ||
english: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: har agam agochar sadaa abinaasee ||
english: The Lord is inaccessible and unfathomable; He is eternal and imperishable.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: sarabe rav rahiaa ghat vaasee ||
english: He dwells in the heart, and is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tis bin avar na koee daataa har tisahi sarevahu praanee he ||1||
english: There is no other Giver except Him; worship the Lord, O mortals. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau raakhai har raakhanahaaraa ||
english: No one can kill anyone

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਾਕਸਿ ਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: taa kau koi na saakas maaraa ||
english: Who is saved by the Savior Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: so aisaa har sevahu sa(n)tahu jaa kee ootam baanee he ||2||
english: So serve such a Lord, O Saints, whose Bani is exalted and sublime. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa jaapai kichh kithaaoo naahee ||
english: When it seems that a place is empty and void,

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: taa karataa bharapoor samaahee ||
english: there, the Creator Lord is permeating and pervading.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਕੇ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sooke te phun hariaa keeton har dhiaavahu choj vidaanee he ||3||
english: He causes the dried-up branch to blossom forth in greenery again; so meditate on the Lord - wondrous are His ways! ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੀਆ ਕੀ ਵੇਦਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jo jeeaa kee vedan jaanai ||
english: The One who knows the anguish of all beings

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: tis saahib kai hau kurabaanai ||
english: unto that Lord and Master, I am a sacrifice.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਜੋ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: tis aagai jan kar bena(n)tee jo sarab sukhaa kaa daanee he ||4||
english: Offer your prayers to the One who is the Giver of all peace and joy. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੀਐ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jo jeeai kee saar na jaanai ||
english: But one who does not know the state of the soul

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੀਐ ਅਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: tis siu kichh na kaheeai ajaanai ||
english: do not say anything to such an ignorant person.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਸਿਉ ਨਹ ਲੂਝੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: moorakh siu nah loojh paraanee har japeeai pad nirabaanee he ||5||
english: Do not argue with fools, O mortals. Meditate on the Lord, in the state of Nirvaanaa. ||5||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਚਿੰਤ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਹੈ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: naa kar chi(n)t chi(n)taa hai karate ||
english: Don't worry - let the Creator take care of it.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਜੰਤਾ ਸਭਤੈ ॥
transliteration: har devai jal thal ja(n)taa sabhatai ||
english: The Lord gives to all creatures in the water and on the land.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀਟ ਪਖਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: achi(n)t daan dei prabh meraa vich paathar keet pakhaanee he ||6||
english: My God bestows His blessings without being asked, even to worms in soil and stones. ||6||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naa kar aas meet sut bhaaee ||
english: Do not place your hopes in friends, children and siblings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਕਿਸੈ ਸਾਹ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naa kar aas kisai saah biuhaar kee paraaee ||
english: Do not place your hopes in kings or the business of others.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਾਰੰਗਪਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: bin har naavai ko belee naahee har japeeai saara(n)gapaanee he ||7||
english: Without the Lord's Name, no one will be your helper; so meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the world. ||7||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: anadin naam japahu banavaaree ||
english: Night and day, chant the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਥਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sabh aasaa manasaa poorai thaaree ||
english: All your hopes and desires shall be fulfilled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jan naanak naam japahu bhav kha(n)dan sukh sahaje rain vihaanee he ||8||
english: O servant Nanak, chant the Naam, the Name of the Destroyer of fear, and your life-night shall pass in intuitive peace and poise. ||8||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin har seviaa tin sukh paaiaa ||
english: Those who serve the Lord find peace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sahaje hee har naam samaaiaa ||
english: They are intuitively absorbed in the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਾਇ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: jo saran parai tis kee pat raakhai jaai poochhahu ved puraanee he ||9||
english: The Lord preserves the honor of those who seek His Sanctuary; go and consult the Vedas and the Puraanas. ||9||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jis har sevaa laae soee jan laagai ||
english: That humble being is attached to the Lord's service, whom the Lord so attaches.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad bharam bhau bhaagai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, doubt and fear are dispelled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਜਿਉ ਕਮਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: viche grih sadaa rahai udaasee jiu kamal rahai vich paanee he ||10||
english: In his own home, he remains unattached, like the lotus flower in the water. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: vich haumai sevaa thaai na paae ||
english: One who serves in egotism is not accepted or approved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: janam marai phir aavai jaae ||
english: Such a person is born, only to die again, and come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਤਪੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਈ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: so tap pooraa saaee sevaa jo har mere man bhaanee he ||11||
english: Perfect is that penance and that service, which is pleasing to the Mind of my Lord. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: hau kiaa gun tere aakhaa suaamee ||
english: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I chant, O my Lord and Master?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: too sarab jeeaa kaa a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all souls.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: hau maagau daan tujhai pahi karate har anadin naam vakhaanee he ||12||
english: I beg for blessings from You, O Creator Lord; I repeat Your Name night and day. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੋਰੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਬੋਲਣ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: kis hee jor aha(n)kaar bolan kaa ||
english: Some speak in egotistical power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੋਰੁ ਦੀਬਾਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: kis hee jor deebaan maaiaa kaa ||
english: Some have the power of authority and Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਟੇਕ ਧਰ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਤੂ ਕਰਤੇ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੈ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: mai har bin tek dhar avar na kaaee too karate raakh mai nimaanee he ||13||
english: I have no other Support at all, except the Lord. O Creator Lord, please save me, meek and dishonored. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: nimaane maan karahi tudh bhaavai ||
english: You bless the meek and dishonored with honor, as it pleases You, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hor ketee jhakh jhakh aavai jaavai ||
english: Many others argue in conflict, coming and going in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਪਖੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਊਪਰਿ ਗਲ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: jin kaa pakh karahi too suaamee tin kee oopar gal tudh aanee he ||14||
english: Those people, whose side You take, O Lord and Master, are elevated and successful. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har har naam jinee sadaa dhiaaiaa ||
english: Those who meditate forever on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tinee gur parasaad param pad paaiaa ||
english: by Guru's Grace, obtain the supreme status.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: jin har seviaa tin sukh paaiaa bin sevaa pachhotaanee he ||15||
english: Those who serve the Lord find peace; without serving Him, they regret and repent. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ॥
transliteration: too sabh mahi varatahi har jaga(n)naath ||
english: You are pervading all, O Lord of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
transliteration: so har japai jis gur masatak haath ||
english: He alone meditates on the Lord, upon whose forehead the Guru places His hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਸਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
transliteration: har kee saran paiaa har jaapee jan naanak daas dasaanee he ||16||2||
english: Entering the Sanctuary of the Lord, I meditate on the Lord; servant Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ||16||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਾ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kalaa upaai dharee jin dharanaa ||
english: He infused His power into the earth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਗਨੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਚਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gagan rahaaiaa hukame charanaa ||
english: He suspends the heavens upon the feet of His Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਈਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਧੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: agan upaai eedhan mahi baadhee so prabh raakhai bhaaee he ||1||
english: He created fire and locked it into wood. That God protects all, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕਉ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t kau rijak sa(n)baahe ||
english: He gives nourishment to all beings and creatures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਆਪਾਹੇ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath aapaahe ||
english: He Himself is the all-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khin mahi thaap uthaapanahaaraa soee teraa sahaaee he ||2||
english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; He is your help and support. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: maat garabh mahi jin pratipaaliaa ||
english: He cherished you in your mother's womb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saas graas hoi sa(n)g samaaliaa ||
english: With every breath and morsel of food, He is with you, and takes care of you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਵਡੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa japeeai so preetam vadee jis vadiaaee he ||3||
english: Forever and ever, meditate on that Beloved; Great is His glorious greatness! ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਕਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਕੀਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sulataan khaan kare khin keere ||
english: The sultans and nobles are reduced to dust in an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gareeb nivaaj kare prabh meere ||
english: God cherishes the poor, and makes them into rulers.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਰਣ ਸਰਬ ਸਧਾਰਣ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: garab nivaaran sarab sadhaaran kichh keemat kahee na jaaee he ||4||
english: He is the Destroyer of egotistical pride, the Support of all. His value cannot be estimated. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਤਿਵੰਤਾ ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: so pativa(n)taa so dhanava(n)taa ||
english: He alone is honorable, and he alone is wealthy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jis man vasiaa har bhagava(n)taa ||
english: within whose mind the Lord God abides.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: maat pitaa sut ba(n)dhap bhaaee jin ih srisat upaaee he ||5||
english: He alone is my mother, father, child, relative and sibling, who created this Universe. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਏ ਸਰਣਾ ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh aae saranaa bhau nahee karanaa ||
english: I have come to God's Sanctuary, and so I fear nothing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੈ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat nihachau hai taranaa ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am sure to be saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਸਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: man bach karam araadhe karataa tis naahee kade sajaaee he ||6||
english: One who adores the Creator in thought, word and deed, shall never be punished. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan man tan mahi raviaa ||
english: One whose mind and body are permeated with the Lord, the treasure of virtue,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਭਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: janam maran kee jon na bhaviaa ||
english: does not wander in birth, death and reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਕੀਆ ਸੁਖਿ ਡੇਰਾ ਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: dookh binaas keeaa sukh deraa jaa tripat rahe aaghaaee he ||7||
english: Pain vanishes and peace prevails, when one is satisfied and fulfilled. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: meet hamaaraa soee suaamee ||
english: My Lord and Master is my best friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is in all places and interspaces.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਣਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: simar simar pooran paramesur chi(n)taa ganat mitaaee he ||8||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Perfect Transcendent Lord, I am rid of all anxieties and calculations. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam kot lakh baahaa ||
english: One who has the Name of the Lord has hundreds of thousands and millions of arms.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਨੁ ਤਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: har jas keeratan sa(n)g dhan taahaa ||
english: The wealth of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is with him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਨਾ ਦੂਤ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: giaan khaRag kar kirapaa deenaa doot maare kar dhaaee he ||9||
english: In His Mercy, God has blessed me with the sword of spiritual wisdom; I have attacked and killed the demons. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥
transliteration: har kaa jaap japahu jap japane ||
english: Chant the Chant of the Lord, the Chant of Chants.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਤਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਵਸਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
transliteration: jeet aavahu vasahu ghar apane ||
english: Be a winner of the game of life and come to abide in your true home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਨਰਕ ਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh narak na dekhahu rasak rasak gun gaaee he ||10||
english: You shall not see the 8.4 million types of hell; sing His Glorious Praises and remain saturated with loving devotion||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)d brahama(n)d udhaaranahaaraa ||
english: He is the Savior of worlds and galaxies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ooch athaah aga(n)m apaaraa ||
english: He is lofty, unfathomable, inaccessible and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: jis no kripaa kare prabh apanee so jan tisahi dhiaaee he ||11||
english: That humble being, unto whom God grants His Grace, meditates on Him. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan toR leee prabh mole ||
english: God has broken my bonds, and claimed me as His own.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੇ ਘਰ ਗੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa keene ghar gole ||
english: In His Mercy, He has made me the slave of His home.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: anahad run jhunakaar sahaj dhun saachee kaar kamaaee he ||12||
english: The unstruck celestial sound current resounds and vibrates, when one performs acts of true service. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: man parateet banee prabh teree ||
english: O God, I have enshrined faith in You within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: binas gaee haumai mat meree ||
english: My egotistical intellect has been driven out.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਭ ਸੁਹਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeaa prabh apanai jag mahi sobh suhaaee he ||13||
english: God has made me His own, and now I have a glorious reputation in this world. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥
transliteration: jai jai kaar japahu jagadeesai ||
english: Proclaim His Glorious Victory, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਈਸੈ ॥
transliteration: bal bal jaaee prabh apune eesai ||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਏਕਾ ਜਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na deesai ekaa jagat sabaaee he ||14||
english: I do not see any other except Him. The One Lord pervades the whole world. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sat sat sat prabh jaataa ||
english: True, True, True is God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad sadaa man raataa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, my mind is attuned to Him forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਏਕੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: simar simar jeevahi jan tere eka(n)kaar samaaee he ||15||
english: Your humble servants live by meditating, meditating in remembrance on You, merging in You, O One Universal Creator. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bhagat janaa kaa preetam piaaraa ||
english: The Dear Lord is the Beloved of His humble devotees.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੈ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabhai udhaaran khasam hamaaraa ||
english: My Lord and Master is the Savior of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਸਭ ਇਛਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
transliteration: simar naam pu(n)nee sabh ichhaa jan naanak paij rakhaaee he ||16||1||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all desires are fulfilled. He has saved the honor of servant Nanak. ||16||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਲਪਟਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)gee jogee naar lapataanee ||
english: The body-bride is attached to the Yogi, the husband-soul.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: urajh rahee ra(n)g ras maanee ||
english: She is involved with him, enjoying pleasure and delights.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਭਏ ਇਕਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kirat sa(n)jogee bhae ikatraa karate bhog bilaasaa he ||1||
english: As a consequence of past actions, they have come together, enjoying pleasurable play. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਧਨ ਤਤੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: jo pir karai s dhan tat maanai ||
english: Whatever the husband does, the bride willingly accepts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਧਨਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ਰਖੈ ਸੰਗਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: pir dhanahi seegaar rakhai sa(n)gaanai ||
english: The husband adorns his bride, and keeps her with himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਤ੍ਰ ਵਸਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਦੇ ਧਨਹਿ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mil ekatr vasahi din raatee priu de dhanahi dilaasaa he ||2||
english: Joining together, they live in harmony day and night; the husband comforts his wife. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਮਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dhan maagai priu bahu bidh dhaavai ||
english: When the bride asks, the husband runs around in all sorts of ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਆਣਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo paavai so aan dikhaavai ||
english: Whatever he finds, he brings to show his bride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਕਉ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਧਨ ਰਹਤੀ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ek vasat kau pahuch na saakai dhan rahatee bhookh piaasaa he ||3||
english: But there is one thing he cannot reach, and so his bride remains hungry and thirsty. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨਉ ਦੋਊ ਕਰ ਜੋਰੈ ॥
transliteration: dhan karai binau dooo kar jorai ||
english: With her palms pressed together, the bride offers her prayer,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੁ ਵਸਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਮੋਰੈ ॥
transliteration: pri parades na jaahu vasahu ghar morai ||
english: "O my beloved, do not leave me and go to foreign lands; please stay here with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਬਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aisaa banaj karahu grih bheetar jit utarai bhookh piaasaa he ||4||
english: Do such business within our home, that my hunger and thirst may be relieved." ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: sagale karam dharam jug saadhaa ||
english: All sorts of religious rituals are performed in this age,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: bin har ras sukh til nahee laadhaa ||
english: but without the sublime essence of the Lord, not an iota of peace is found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਸੰਗੇ ਤਉ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਅਨੰਦ ਉਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: bhaee kripaa naanak satasa(n)ge tau dhan pir ana(n)d ulaasaa he ||5||
english: When the Lord becomes Merciful, O Nanak, then in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the bride and the husband enjoy ecstasy and bliss. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਅੰਧੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਚਪਲੁ ਸਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: dhan a(n)dhee pir chapal siaanaa ||
english: The body-bride is blind, and the groom is clever and wise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕਾ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch tat kaa rachan rachaanaa ||
english: The creation was created of the five elements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਆਏ ਹਹੁ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jis vakhar kau tum aae hahu so paaio satigur paasaa he ||6||
english: That merchandise, for which you have come into the world, is received only from the True Guru. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਕਹੈ ਤੂ ਵਸੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: dhan kahai too vas mai naale ||
english: The body-bride says, "Please live with me,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: pri sukhavaasee baal gupaale ||
english: O my beloved, peaceful, young lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝੈ ਬਿਨਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਵਚਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tujhai binaa hau kit hee na lekhai vachan dehi chhod na jaasaa he ||7||
english: Without you, I am of no account. Please give me your word, that you will not leave me". ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਹਉ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: pir kahiaa hau hukamee ba(n)daa ||
english: The soul-husband says, "I am the slave of my Commander.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਭਾਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਛੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: ohu bhaaro thaakur jis kaan na chha(n)daa ||
english: He is my Great Lord and Master, who is fearless and independent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਜਾ ਸਦੇ ਤ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jichar raakhai tichar tum sa(n)g rahanaa jaa sade ta ooth sidhaasaa he ||8||
english: As long as He wills, I will remain with you. When He summons me, I shall arise and depart." ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਚਨ ਕਹੇ ਧਨ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
transliteration: jau pri bachan kahe dhan saache ||
english: The husband speaks words of Truth to the bride,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸਮਝੈ ਚੰਚਲਿ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
transliteration: dhan kachhoo na samajhai cha(n)chal kaache ||
english: but the bride is restless and inexperienced, and she does not understand anything.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਓਹੁ ਬਾਤ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: bahur bahur pir hee sa(n)g maagai ohu baat jaanai kar haasaa he ||9||
english: Again and again, she begs her husband to stay; she thinks that he is just joking when he answers her. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਈ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aaee aagiaa pirahu bulaaiaa ||
english: The Order comes, and the husband-soul is called.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਧਨ ਪੁਛੀ ਨ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naa dhan puchhee na mataa pakaaiaa ||
english: He does not consult with his bride, and does not ask her opinion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਓ ਛੂਟਰਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਦੇਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਥਨ ਮੋਹਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: ooth sidhaaio chhootar maatee dekh naanak mithan mohaasaa he ||10||
english: He gets up and marches off, and the discarded body-bride mingles with dust. O Nanak, behold the illusion of emotional attachment and hope. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੋਭੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: re man lobhee sun man mere ||
english: O greedy mind - listen, O my mind!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਸਦੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sev din raat sadere ||
english: Serve the True Guru day and night forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਚਿ ਮੂਏ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਗਲਿ ਜਮ ਫਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: bin satigur pach mooe saakat nigure gal jam phaasaa he ||11||
english: Without the True Guru, the faithless cynics rot away and die. The noose of Death is around the necks of those who have no guru. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh aavai manamukh jaavai ||
english: The self-willed manmukh comes, and the self-willed manmukh goes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: manamukh phir phir chotaa khaavai ||
english: The manmukh suffers beatings again and again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਨਰਕ ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੋਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: jitane narak se manamukh bhogai guramukh lep na maasaa he ||12||
english: The manmukh endures as many hells as there are; the Gurmukh is not even touched by them. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਇ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh soi j har jeeu bhaaiaa ||
english: He alone is Gurmukh, who is pleasing to the Dear Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tis kaun mitaavai j prabh pahiraaiaa ||
english: Who can destroy anyone who is robed in honor by the Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਆਨੰਦੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਪਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਖਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d kare aana(n)dee jis sirapaau paiaa gal khaasaa he ||13||
english: The blissful one is forever in bliss; he is dressed in robes of honor. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur poore ||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਬਚਨ ਕੇ ਸੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: saran ke daate bachan ke soore ||
english: He is the Giver of Sanctuary, the Heroic Warrior who keeps His Word.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਨ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਜਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: aisaa prabh miliaa sukhadaataa vichhuR na kat hee jaasaa he ||14||
english: Such is the Lord God, the Giver of peace, whom I have met; He shall never leave me or go anywhere else. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gun nidhaan kichh keem na paaee ||
english: He is the treasure of virtue; His value cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat poor rahio sabh thaaee ||
english: He is perfectly permeating each and every heart, prevailing everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਉ ਰੇਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saran deen dukh bha(n)jan hau ren tere jo daasaa he ||15||1||2||
english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of the pains of the poor; I am the dust of the feet of Your slaves. ||15||1||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਅਨੰਦੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: karai ana(n)d ana(n)dee meraa ||
english: My Blissful Lord is forever in bliss.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਿਰ ਸਿਰਹਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat pooran sir sirahi niberaa ||
english: He fills each and every heart, and judges each and everyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਕੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sir saahaa kai sachaa saahib avar naahee ko doojaa he ||1||
english: The True Lord and Master is above the heads of all kings; there is none other than Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖਵੰਤ ਆਨੰਤ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: harakhava(n)t aana(n)t daiaalaa ||
english: He is joyful, blissful and merciful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਰਬ ਉਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: pragat rahio prabh sarab ujaalaa ||
english: God's Light is manifest everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: roop kare kar vekhai vigasai aape hee aap poojaa he ||2||
english: He creates forms, and gazing upon them, He enjoys them; He Himself worships Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape kudarat kare veechaaraa ||
english: He contemplates His own creative power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aape hee sach kare pasaaraa ||
english: The True Lord Himself creates the expanse of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਖਿਲਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਭੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape khel khilaavai din raatee aape sun sun bheejaa he ||3||
english: He Himself stages the play, day and night; He Himself listens, and hearing, rejoices. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਸਚੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: saachaa takhat sachee paatisaahee ||
english: True is His throne, and True is His kingdom.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਜੀਨਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: sach khajeenaa saachaa saahee ||
english: True is the treasure of the True Banker.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਵਰਤੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aape sach dhaario sabh saachaa sache sach varateejaa he ||4||
english: He Himself is True, and true is all that He has established. True is the prevailing Order of the True Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sach tapaavas sache keraa ||
english: True is the justice of the True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saachaa thaan sadaa prabh teraa ||
english: Your place is forever True, O God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਕੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sachee kudarat sachee baanee sach saahib sukh keejaa he ||5||
english: True is Your Creative Power, and True is the Word of Your Bani. True is the peace which You give, O my Lord and Master. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਵਡ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: eko aap toohai vad raajaa ||
english: You alone are the greatest king.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: hukam sache kai poore kaajaa ||
english: By the Hukam of Your Command, O True Lord, our affairs are fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਤੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar sabh kichh jaanai aape hee aap pateejaa he ||6||
english: Inwardly and outwardly, You know everything; You Yourself are pleased with Yourself. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਵਡ ਰਸੀਆ ਤੂ ਵਡ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: too vad raseeaa too vad bhogee ||
english: You are the great party-goer, You are the great enjoyer.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੀ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
transliteration: too nirabaan toohai hee jogee ||
english: You are detached in Nirvaanaa, You are the Yogi.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਅਮਿਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sarab sookh sahaj ghar terai amiu teree drisateejaa he ||7||
english: All celestial comforts are in Your home; Your Glance of Grace rains Nectar. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: teree daat tujhai te hovai ||
english: You alone give Your gifts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਭਸੈ ਜੰਤ ਲੋਐ ॥
transliteration: dehi daan sabhasai ja(n)t loai ||
english: You grant Your gifts unto all the beings of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: tot na aavai poor bha(n)daarai tripat rahe aagheejaa he ||8||
english: Your treasures are overflowing, and are never exhausted; through them, we remain satisfied and fulfilled. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਬਨਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jaachahi sidh saadhik banavaasee ||
english: The Siddhas, seekers and forest-dwellers beg from You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਹਿ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jaachahi jatee satee sukhavaasee ||
english: The celibates and abstainers, and those who abide in peace beg from You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
transliteration: ik daataar sagal hai jaachik dehi daan srisateejaa he ||9||
english: You alone are the Great Giver; all are beggars of You. You bless all the world with Your gifts. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਰੰਗ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: karahi bhagat ar ra(n)g apaaraa ||
english: Your devotees worship You with infinite love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi thaap uthaapanahaaraa ||
english: In an instant, You establish and disestablish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਾਰੋ ਤੋਲੁ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਭਗਤੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: bhaaro tol bea(n)t suaamee hukam ma(n)n bhagateejaa he ||10||
english: Your weight is so heavy, O my infinite Lord and Master. Your devotees surrender to the Hukam of Your Command. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jis dehi daras soee tudh jaanai ||
english: They alone know You, whom You bless with Your Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: ohu gur kai sabad sadaa ra(n)g maanai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enjoy Your Love forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਵੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: chatur saroop siaanaa soee jo man terai bhaaveejaa he ||11||
english: They alone are clever, handsome and wise, who are pleasing to Your Mind. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jis cheet aavahi so veparavaahaa ||
english: One who keeps You in his consciousness, becomes carefree and independent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: jis cheet aavahi so saachaa saahaa ||
english: One who keeps You in his consciousness, is the true king.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: jis cheet aavahi tis bhau kehaa avar kahaa kichh keejaa he ||12||
english: One who keeps You in his consciousness - what does he have to fear? And what else does he need to do? ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੂਝੀ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਠੰਢਾ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa boojhee a(n)tar tha(n)dhaa ||
english: Thirst and desire are quenched, and one's inner being is cooled and soothed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੈ ਤੂਟਾ ਗੰਢਾ ॥
transliteration: gur poorai lai tootaa ga(n)dhaa ||
english: The True Guru has mended the broken one.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ਅਮਿਉ ਝੋਲਿ ਝੋਲਿ ਪੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: surat sabad rid a(n)tar jaagee amiu jhol jhol peejaa he ||13||
english: Awareness of the Word of the Shabad has awakened within my heart. Shaking it and vibrating it, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
transliteration: marai naahee sad sad hee jeevai ||
english: I shall not die; I shall live forever and ever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਥੀਵੈ ॥
transliteration: amar bhaiaa abinaasee theevai ||
english: I have become immortal; I am eternal and imperishable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਭਰਮੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naa ko aavai naa ko jaavai gur door keeaa bharameejaa he ||14||
english: I do not come, and I do not go. The Guru has driven out my doubts. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kee pooree baanee ||
english: Perfect is the Word of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: poorai laagaa poore maahi samaanee ||
english: One who is attached to the Perfect Lord, is immersed in the Perfect Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਰੰਗਾ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਲੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: chaRai savaaiaa nit nit ra(n)gaa ghatai naahee toleejaa he ||15||
english: His love increases day by day, and when it is weighed, it does not decrease. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: baarahaa ka(n)chan sudh karaaiaa ||
english: When the gold is made one hundred percent pure,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫ ਵੰਨੀ ਸਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nadar saraaph va(n)nee sachaRaaiaa ||
english: its color is true to the jeweller's eye.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਰਾਫੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾਈਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: parakh khajaanai paaiaa saraaphee phir naahee taaeejaa he ||16||
english: Assaying it, it is placed in the treasury by God the Jeweller, and it is not melted down again. ||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam tumaaraa suaamee ||
english: Your Naam is Ambrosial Nectar, O my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: naanak daas sadaa kurabaanee ||
english: Nanak, Your slave, is forever a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g mahaa sukh paaiaa dekh darasan ihu man bheejaa he ||17||1||3||
english: In the Society of the Saints, I have found great peace; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, this mind is pleased and satisfied. ||17||1||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਸੋਲਹੇ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 solahe ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Solhas:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: gur gopaal gur govi(n)daa ||
english: The Guru is the Lord of the World, the Guru is the Master of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: gur daiaal sadaa bakhasi(n)daa ||
english: The Guru is merciful, and always forgiving.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਸਥਾਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur saasat simrit khat karamaa gur pavitr asathaanaa he ||1||
english: The Guru is the Shaastras, the Simritees and the six rituals. The Guru is the Holy Shrine. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur simarat sabh kilavikh naasahi ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Guru, all the sins are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਫਾਸਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur simarat jam sa(n)g na phaasahi ||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Guru, one is not strangled by the noose of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਾਟੇ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur simarat man niramal hovai gur kaate apamaanaa he ||2||
english: Meditating in remembrance on the Guru, the mind becomes immaculate; the Guru eliminates egotistical pride. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sevak narak na jaae ||
english: The Guru's servant is not consigned to hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sevak paarabraham dhiaae ||
english: The Guru's servant meditates on the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਦਾ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kaa sevak saadhasa(n)g paae gur karadaa nit jee daanaa he ||3||
english: The Guru's servant joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; the Guru ever gives the life of the soul. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: gur duaarai har keeratan suneeai ||
english: At the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: satigur bhet har jas mukh bhaneeai ||
english: Meeting with the True Guru, one chants the Lord's Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: kal kales mitaae satigur har daragah devai maanaa(n) he ||4||
english: The True Guru eradicates sorrow and suffering, and bestows honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar guroo dikhaaiaa ||
english: The Guru has revealed the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhoolaa maarag satigur paaiaa ||
english: The True Guru returns to the Path, those who have wandered away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gur sevak kau bighan na bhagatee har poor driRhaaiaa giaanaa(n) he ||5||
english: No obstacles stand in the way of devotion to the Lord, for one who serves the Guru. The Guru implants perfect spiritual wisdom. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ਸਭਨੀ ਠਾਂਈ ॥
transliteration: gur drisataaiaa sabhanee thaa(n)ee ||
english: The Guru has revealed the Lord everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jal thal poor rahiaa gosaaee ||
english: The Lord of the Universe is permeating and pervading the water and the land.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਊਨ ਸਭ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
transliteration: ooch oon sabh ek samaanaa(n) man laagaa sahaj dhiaanaa he ||6||
english: The high and the low are all the same to Him. Focus your mind's meditation intuitively on Him. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur miliai sabh trisan bujhaaee ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, all thirst is quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਹ ਜੋਹੈ ਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur miliai nah johai maaee ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, one is not watched by Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਪਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh deeaa gur poorai naam a(n)mrit pee paanaa(n) he ||7||
english: The Perfect Guru bestows truth and contentment; I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: gur kee baanee sabh maahi samaanee ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Bani is contained in all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aap sunee tai aap vakhaanee ||
english: He Himself hears it, and He Himself repeats it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਈ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਸਤ੍ਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਥਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jin jin japee teee sabh nisatre tin paaiaa nihachal thaanaa(n) he ||8||
english: Those who meditate on it, are all emancipated; they attain the eternal and unchanging home. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur kee mahimaa satigur jaanai ||
english: The Glory of the True Guru is known only to the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh kare s aapan bhaanai ||
english: Whatever He does, is according to the Pleasure of His Will.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੯॥੧॥੪॥
transliteration: saadhoo dhoor jaachahi jan tere naanak sad kurabaanaa(n) he ||9||1||4||
english: Your humble servants beg for the dust of the feet of the Holy; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||9||1||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aad nira(n)jan prabh nira(n)kaaraa ||
english: The Primal, Immaculate Lord God is formless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh mahi varatai aap niraaraa ||
english: The Detached Lord is Himself prevailing in all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਨੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਸਭ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: varan jaat chihan nahee koee sabh hukame srisat upaaidaa ||1||
english: He has no race or social class, no identifying mark. By the Hukam of His Will, He created the entire universe. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੋਨਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jon sabaaee ||
english: Out of all the 8.4 million species of beings,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: maanas kau prabh deeee vadiaaee ||
english: God blessed mankind with glory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਸੋ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: is pauRee te jo nar chookai so aai jaai dukh paaidaa ||2||
english: That human who misses this chance, shall suffer the pains of coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: keetaa hovai tis kiaa kaheeai ||
english: What should I say, to one who has been created.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam padaarath laheeai ||
english: The Gurmukh receives the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਭੂਲੈ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jis aap bhulaae soee bhoolai so boojhai jisahi bujhaaidaa ||3||
english: He alone is confused, whom the Lord Himself confuses. He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਾ ਨਗਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: harakh sog kaa nagar ihu keeaa ||
english: This body has been made the village of joy and sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: se ubare jo satigur saraneeaa ||
english: They alone are emancipated, who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਹਾ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: trihaa gunaa te rahai niraaraa so guramukh sobhaa paaidaa ||4||
english: One who remains untouched by the three qualities, the three gunas - such a Gurmukh is blessed with glory. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: anik karam keee bahutere ||
english: You can do anything, but whatever you do,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਪੈਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jo keejai so ba(n)dhan paire ||
english: Only serves to tie your feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਰੁਤਾ ਬੀਜੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਨਹੀ ਜੰਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kurutaa beej beeje nahee ja(n)mai sabh laahaa mool gavaaidaa ||5||
english: The seed which is planted out of season does not sprout, and all one's capital and profits are lost. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kalajug mahi keeratan paradhaanaa ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are most sublime and exalted.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh japeeai laai dhiaanaa ||
english: Become Gurmukh, chant and focus your meditation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: aap tarai sagale kul taare har daragah pat siu jaaidaa ||6||
english: You shall save yourself, and save all your generations as well. You shall go to the Court of the Lord with honor. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਦੀਪ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਆ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)d pataal deep sabh loaa ||
english: All the continents, nether worlds, islands and worlds

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh kaalai vas aap prabh keeaa ||
english: God Himself has made them all subject to death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਜੋ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: nihachal ek aap abinaasee so nihachal jo tisahi dhiaaidaa ||7||
english: The One Imperishable Lord Himself is unmoving and unchanging. Meditating on Him, one becomes unchanging. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa sevak so har jehaa ||
english: The Lord's servant becomes like the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
transliteration: bhed na jaanahu maanas dehaa ||
english: Do not think that, because of his human body, he is different.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਉਠਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jiu jal tara(n)g uthahi bahu bhaatee phir salalai salal samaaidaa ||8||
english: The waves of the water rise up in various ways, and then the water merges again in water. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ॥
transliteration: ik jaachik ma(n)gai daan duaarai ||
english: A beggar begs for charity at His Door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa prabh bhaavai taa kirapaa dhaarai ||
english: When God pleases, He takes pity on him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: dehu daras jit man tripataasai har keeratan man thaharaaidaa ||9||
english: Please bless me with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, to satisfy my mind, O Lord. Through the Kirtan of Your Praises, my mind is held steady. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੂੜੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: rooRo thaakur kitai vas na aavai ||
english: The Beauteous Lord and Master is not controlled in any way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har so kichh kare j har kiaa sa(n)taa bhaavai ||
english: The Lord does that which pleases the Saints of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਨਿ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇਨਿ ਦਰਿ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: keetaa loRan soee karaain dar pher na koee paaidaa ||10||
english: He does whatever they wish to be done; nothing blocks their way at His Door. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਅਉਘਟੁ ਆਇ ਬਨਤੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jithai aughat aai banat hai praanee ||
english: Wherever the mortal is confronted with difficulty,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: tithai har dhiaaeeai saari(n)gapaanee ||
english: there he should meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: jithai putr kalatr na belee koee tithai har aap chhadaaidaa ||11||
english: Where there are no children, spouse or friends, there the Lord Himself comes to the rescue. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: vadaa saahib agam athaahaa ||
english: The Great Lord and Master is inaccessible and unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: kiu mileeai prabh veparavaahaa ||
english: How can anyone meet with God, the self-suficient One?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਸੋ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: kaat silak jis maarag paae so vich sa(n)gat vaasaa paaidaa ||12||
english: Those who have had the noose cut away from around their necks, whom God has set back upon the Path, obtain a place in the Sangat, the Congregation. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: hukam boojhai so sevak kaheeai ||
english: One who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command is said to be His servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: buraa bhalaa dui samasar saheeai ||
english: He endures both bad and good equally.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: haumai jaai ta eko boojhai so guramukh sahaj samaaidaa ||13||
english: When egotism is silenced, then one comes to know the One Lord. Such a Gurmukh intuitively merges in the Lord. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke bhagat sadaa sukhavaasee ||
english: The devotees of the Lord dwell forever in peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਅਤੀਤ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: baal subhaai ateet udaasee ||
english: With a child-like, innocent nature, they remain detached, turning away from the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਜਿਉ ਪਿਤਾ ਪੂਤੁ ਲਾਡਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: anik ra(n)g karahi bahu bhaatee jiu pitaa poot laadaaidaa ||14||
english: They enjoy various pleasures in many ways; God caresses them, like a father caressing his son. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paaee ||
english: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਜਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: taa mileeai jaa lae milaaee ||
english: We meet Him, only when He causes us to meet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: guramukh pragat bhaiaa tin jan kau jin dhur masatak lekh likhaaidaa ||15||
english: The Lord is revealed to those humble Gurmukhs, who have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon their foreheads. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: too aape karataa kaaran karanaa ||
english: You Yourself are the Creator Lord, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੀ ਸਭ ਧਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: srisat upaai dharee sabh dharanaa ||
