english: You created the Universe, and You support the whole earth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੫॥
transliteration: jan naanak saran paiaa har duaarai har bhaavai laaj rakhaaidaa ||16||1||5||
english: Servant Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Door, O Lord; if it is Your Will, please preserve his honor. ||16||1||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਏਕੋ ਤੂਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai so eko toohai ||
english: Whatever is seen is You, O One Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: baanee teree sravan suneeai ||
english: What the ears hear is the Word of Your Bani.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਜਾਪਸਿ ਕਾਈ ਸਗਲ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਧਾਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: doojee avar na jaapas kaaee sagal tumaaree dhaaranaa ||1||
english: There is nothing else to be seen at all. You give support to all. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aap chitaare apanaa keeaa ||
english: You Yourself are conscious of Your Creation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
transliteration: aape aap aap prabh theeaa ||
english: You Yourself established Yourself, O God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਰਚਿਓਨੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap upaai rachion pasaaraa aape ghat ghat saaranaa ||2||
english: Creating Yourself, You formed the expanse of the Universe; You Yourself cherish and sustain each and every heart. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਵਡ ਦਰਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ik upaae vad daravaaree ||
english: You created some to hold great and royal courts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਇਕਿ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ik udaasee ik ghar baaree ||
english: Some turn away from the world in renunciation, and some maintain their households.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭੂਖੇ ਇਕਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਸਭਸੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ik bhookhe ik tripat aghaae sabhasai teraa paaranaa ||3||
english: Some are hungry and some are satisfied and satiated, but all lean on Your Support. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: aape sat sat sat saachaa ||
english: The True Lord Himself is True, True, True.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: ot pot bhagatan sa(n)g raachaa ||
english: He is woven into the essence of His devotees, through and through.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਸਾਰਣਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: aape gupat aape hai paragat apanaa aap pasaaranaa ||4||
english: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed. He Himself spreads Himself out. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਹੋਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa sad hovanahaaraa ||
english: Forever, forever and ever, He shall always exist.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: oochaa agam athaahu apaaraa ||
english: He is lofty, inaccessible, unfathomable and infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਣੇ ਭਰੇ ਭਰੇ ਭਰਿ ਊਣੇ ਏਹਿ ਚਲਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਣਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: oone bhare bhare bhar oone ehi chalat suaamee ke kaaranaa ||5||
english: He fills the empty, and empties out the filled; such are the plays and dramas of my Lord and Master. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: mukh saalaahee sache saahaa ||
english: With my mouth, I praise my True Lord King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਣੀ ਪੇਖਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: nainee pekhaa agam athaahaa ||
english: With my eyes, I behold the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰਣਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: karanee sun sun man tan hariaa mere saahib sagal udhaaranaa ||6||
english: Listening, listening with my ears, my mind and body are rejuvenated; my Lord and Master saves all. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kar vekhahi keetaa apanaa ||
english: He created the creation, and gazes upon what He has created.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਪਣਾ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t soee hai japanaa ||
english: All beings and creatures meditate on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਣਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: apanee kudarat aape jaanai nadaree nadar nihaalanaa ||7||
english: He Himself knows His creative power; He blesses with His Glance of Grace. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਜਹ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa jah baisahi prabh paase ||
english: Where the Saints gather together and sit, God dwells close at hand.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਹਰਿ ਚਲਤ ਤਮਾਸੇ ॥
transliteration: ana(n)d ma(n)gal har chalat tamaase ||
english: They abide in bliss and joy, beholding the Lord's wondrous play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਚਿਤਾਰਣਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: gun gaavahi anahad dhun baanee tah naanak daas chitaaranaa ||8||
english: They sing the Glories of the Lord, and the unstruck sound current of His Bani; O Nanak, His slaves remain conscious of Him. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa sabh chalat tumaaraa ||
english: Coming and going is all Your wondrous play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kar kar dekhai khel apaaraa ||
english: Creating the Creation, You gaze upon Your infinite play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਲਣਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: aap upaae upaavanahaaraa apanaa keeaa paalanaa ||9||
english: Creating the Creation, You Yourself cherish and nurture it. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sun sun jeevaa soi tumaaree ||
english: Listening, listening to Your Glory, I live.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa jaaee balihaaree ||
english: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: dui kar joR simarau din raatee mere suaamee agam apaaranaa ||10||
english: With my palms pressed together, I meditate in remembrance on You, day and night, O my inaccessible, infinite Lord and Master. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: tudh bin dooje kis saalaahee ||
english: Other than You, who else should I praise?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਜਪੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: eko ek japee man maahee ||
english: I meditate on the One and Only Lord within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਇਹ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਘਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: hukam boojh jan bhae nihaalaa ih bhagataa kee ghaalanaa ||11||
english: Realizing the Hukam of Your Will, Your humble servants are enraptured; this is the achievement of Your devotees. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: gur upades japeeai man saachaa ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I meditate on the True Lord within my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਚਾ ॥
transliteration: gur upades raam ra(n)g raachaa ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I am immersed in the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਤੁਟਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਇਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰਜਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: gur upades tutahi sabh ba(n)dhan ihu bharam mohu parajaalanaa ||12||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, all bonds are broken, and this doubt and emotional attachment are burnt away. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖ ਥਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jah raakhai soee sukh thaanaa ||
english: Wherever He keeps me, is my place of rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sahaje hoi soee bhal maanaa ||
english: Whatever naturally happens, I accept that as good.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਬੈਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਬੈਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਭਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: binase bair naahee ko bairee sabh eko hai bhaalanaa ||13||
english: Hatred is gone - I have no hatred at all; I see the One Lord in all. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਰ ਚੂਕੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dar chooke binase a(n)dhiaare ||
english: Fear has been removed, and darkness has been dispelled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: pragat bhae prabh purakh niraare ||
english: The all-powerful, primal, detached Lord God has been revealed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਘਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: aap chhod pae saranaaee jis kaa saa tis ghaalanaa ||14||
english: Forsaking self-conceit, I have entered His Sanctuary, and I work for Him. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਕੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aisaa ko vadabhaagee aaiaa ||
english: Rare are those few, very blessed people, who come into the world,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਿਨਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar jin khasam dhiaaiaa ||
english: and meditate on their Lord and Master, twenty-four hours a day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਧਾਰਣਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: tis jan kai sa(n)g tarai sabh koee so paravaar sadhaaranaa ||15||
english: Associating with such humble people, all are saved, and their families are saved as well. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਖਸਮ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: ih bakhasees khasam te paavaa ||
english: This is the blessing which I have received from my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਧਿਆਵਾ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar kar joR dhiaavaa ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, with my palms pressed together, I meditate on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੈ ਉਚਾਰਣਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੬॥
transliteration: naam japee naam sahaj samaavaa naam naanak milai uchaaranaa ||16||1||6||
english: I chant the Naam, and through the Naam, I intuitively merge into the Lord; O Nanak, may I be blessed with the Naam, and ever repeat it. ||16||1||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਭੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: soorat dekh na bhool gavaaraa ||
english: Do not be fooled by appearances, you fool.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਨ ਮੋਹਾਰਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mithan mohaaraa jhooth pasaaraa ||
english: This is a false attachment to the expanse of an illusion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jag mahi koee rahan na paae nihachal ek naaraainaa ||1||
english: No one can remain in this world; only the One Lord is permanent and unchanging. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਪਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur poore kee pau saranaaee ||
english: Seek the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mohu sog sabh bharam mitaaee ||
english: He shall eradicate all emotional attachment, sorrow and doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਗਾਇਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: eko ma(n)tr driRaae aukhadh sach naam rid gaainaa ||2||
english: He shall administer the medicine, the Mantra of the One Name. Sing the True Name within your heart. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਕਉ ਤਰਸਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jis naamai kau tarasahi bahu devaa ||
english: So many gods yearn for the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal bhagat jaa kee karade sevaa ||
english: All the devotees serve Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: anaathaa naath deen dukh bha(n)jan so gur poore te paainaa ||3||
english: He is the Master of the masterless, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor. His Name is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: hor duaaraa koi na soojhai ||
english: I cannot conceive of any other door.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: tribhavan dhaavai taa kichhoo na boojhai ||
english: One who wanders through the three worlds, understands nothing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਨਾਮ ਜਿਸੁ ਇਹੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: satigur saahu bha(n)daar naam jis ihu ratan tisai te paainaa ||4||
english: The True Guru is the banker, with the treasure of the Naam. This jewel is obtained from Him. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee dhoor kare puneetaa ||
english: The dust of His feet purifies.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sur nar dev na paavahi meetaa ||
english: Even the angelic beings and gods cannot obtain it, O friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਣਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sat purakh satigur paramesar jis bhetat paar paraainaa ||5||
english: The True Guru is the True Primal Being, the Transcendent Lord God; meeting with Him, one is carried across to the other side. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: paarajaat loRahi man piaare ||
english: O my beloved mind, if you wish for the 'tree of life';

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਸੋਹੀ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaamadhen sohee darabaare ||
english: if you wish for Kaamadhayna, the wish-fulfilling cow to adorn your court;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਰਸਾਇਣਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: tripat sa(n)tokh sevaa gur poore naam kamaai rasaainaa ||6||
english: if you wish to be satisfied and contented, then serve the Perfect Guru, and practice the Naam, the source of nectar. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad marahi pa(n)ch dhaatoo ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the five thieves of desire are conquered.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਤੂ ॥
transliteration: bhai paarabraham hovahi niramalaa too ||
english: In the Fear of the Supreme Lord God, you shall become immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਜਬ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਾ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਣਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: paaras jab bhetai gur pooraa taa paaras paras dikhaainaa ||7||
english: When one meets the Perfect Guru, the Philosopher's Stone, His touch reveals the Lord, the Philosopher's Stone. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਨਾਹੀ ਲਵੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: kaee baiku(n)th naahee lavai laage ||
english: Myriads of heavens do not equal the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਭੀ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤਿਆਗੇ ॥
transliteration: mukat bapuRee bhee giaanee tiaage ||
english: The spiritually wise forsake mere liberation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਣਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: eka(n)kaar satigur te paaeeai hau bal bal gur darasaainaa ||8||
english: The One Universal Creator Lord is found through the True Guru. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur kee sev na jaanai koee ||
english: No one knows how to serve the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: gur paarabraham agochar soee ||
english: The Guru is the unfathomable, Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਇਣਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: jis no laai lae so sevak jis vadabhaag mathaainaa ||9||
english: He alone is the Guru's servant, whom the Guru Himself links to His service, and upon whose forehead such blessed destiny is inscribed. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gur kee mahimaa bed na jaanahi ||
english: Even the Vedas do not know the Guru's Glory.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਛ ਮਾਤ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: tuchh maat sun sun vakhaanahi ||
english: They narrate only a tiny bit of what is heard.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: paarabraham apara(n)par satigur jis simarat man seetalaainaa ||10||
english: The True Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Incomparable One; meditating in remembrance on Him, the mind is cooled and soothed. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee soi sunee man jeevai ||
english: Hearing of Him, the mind comes to life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਠੰਢਾ ਥੀਵੈ ॥
transliteration: ridai vasai taa tha(n)dhaa theevai ||
english: When He dwells within the heart, one becomes peaceful and cool.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਲਾਏ ਤਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਥਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: gurumukhahu alaae taa sobhaa paae tis jam kai pa(n)th na paainaa ||11||
english: Chanting the Guru's Name with the mouth, one obtains glory, and does not have to walk on the Path of Death. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪੜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan kee saranaaee paRiaa ||
english: I have entered the Sanctuary of the Saints,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਧਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jeeu praan dhan aagai dhariaa ||
english: and placed before them my soul, my breath of life and wealth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਾਈ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਿਰਮਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: sevaa surat na jaanaa kaaee tum karahu daiaa kiramaainaa ||12||
english: I know nothing about service and awareness; please take pity upon this worm. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਰਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: niragun kau sa(n)g lehu ralaae ||
english: I am unworthy; please merge me into Yourself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਟਹਲੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi tahalai laae ||
english: Please bless me with Your Grace, and link me to Your service.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰਉ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: pakhaa pherau peesau sa(n)t aagai charan dhoi sukh paainaa ||13||
english: I wave the fan, and grind the corn for the Saints; washing their feet, I find peace. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bahut duaare bhram bhram aaiaa ||
english: After wandering around at so many doors, I have come to Yours, O Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tumaree kripaa te tum saranaaiaa ||
english: By Your Grace, I have entered Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa sa(n)tah sa(n)g raakhahu ehu naam daan devaainaa ||14||
english: Forever and ever, keep me in the Company of the Saints; please bless me with this Gift of Your Name. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bhae kripaal gusaaee mere ||
english: My World-Lord has become merciful,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: darasan paaiaa satigur poore ||
english: and I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Perfect True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੫॥੨॥੭॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj sadaa aana(n)daa naanak daas dasaainaa ||15||2||7||
english: I have found eternal peace, poise and bliss; Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||15||2||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰੈ ਧਰਤੀ ਅਰੁ ਆਕਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: simarai dharatee ar aakaasaa ||
english: The earth and the Akaashic ethers meditate in remembrance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: simarahi cha(n)d sooraj gunataasaa ||
english: The moon and the sun meditate in remembrance on You, O treasure of virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paun paanee baisa(n)tar simarahi simarai sagal upaarajanaa ||1||
english: Air, water and fire meditate in remembrance. All creation meditates in remembrance. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਖੰਡ ਦੀਪ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਆ ॥
transliteration: simarahi kha(n)d deep sabh loaa ||
english: All the continents, islands and worlds meditate in remembrance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਆ ॥
transliteration: simarahi paataal pureeaa sach soaa ||
english: The nether worlds and spheres meditate in remembrance on that True Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: simarahi khaanee simarahi baanee simarahi sagale har janaa ||2||
english: The sources of creation and speech meditate in remembrance; all the Lord's humble servants meditate in remembrance. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਬਿਸਨ ਮਹੇਸਾ ॥
transliteration: simarahi brahame bisan mahesaa ||
english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva meditate in remembrance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਕੋੜਿ ਤੇਤੀਸਾ ॥
transliteration: simarahi devate koR teteesaa ||
english: The three hundred thirty million gods meditate in remembrance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਜਖੵਿ ਦੈਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਅਗਨਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜਸੁ ਗਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: simarahi jakhy dait sabh simarahi aganat na jaaee jas ganaa ||3||
english: The titans and demons all meditate in remembrance; Your Praises are uncountable - they cannot be counted. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਸਭਿ ਭੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: simarahi pas pa(n)khee sabh bhootaa ||
english: All the beasts, birds and demons meditate in remembrance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਬਨ ਪਰਬਤ ਅਉਧੂਤਾ ॥
transliteration: simarahi ban parabat audhootaa ||
english: The forests, mountains and hermits meditate in remembrance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਤਾ ਬਲੀ ਸਾਖ ਸਭ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਮਨਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: lataa balee saakh sabh simarahi rav rahiaa suaamee sabh manaa ||4||
english: All the vines and branches meditate in remembrance; O my Lord and Master, You are permeating and pervading all minds. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਥੂਲ ਸੂਖਮ ਸਭਿ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: simarahi thool sookham sabh ja(n)taa ||
english: All beings, both subtle and gross, meditate in remembrance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: simarahi sidh saadhik har ma(n)taa ||
english: The Siddhas and seekers meditate in remembrance on the Lord's Mantra.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: gupat pragat simarahi prabh mere sagal bhavan kaa prabh dhanaa ||5||
english: Both the visible and the invisible meditate in remembrance on my God; God is the Master of all worlds. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਆਸਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: simarahi nar naaree aasaramaa ||
english: Men and women, throughout the four stages of life, meditate in remembrance on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਵਰਨਾ ॥
transliteration: simarahi jaat jot sabh varanaa ||
english: All social classes and souls of all races meditate in remembrance on You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਚਤੁਰ ਸਭਿ ਬੇਤੇ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਰੈਣੀ ਅਰੁ ਦਿਨਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: simarahi gunee chatur sabh bete simarahi rainee ar dinaa ||6||
english: All the virtuous, clever and wise people meditate in remembrance; night and day meditate in remembrance. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਘੜੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਪਲ ਨਿਮਖਾ ॥
transliteration: simarahi ghaRee moorat pal nimakhaa ||
english: Hours, minutes and seconds meditate in remembrance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਅਕਾਲੁ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੋਚਾ ॥
transliteration: simarai kaal akaal such sochaa ||
english: Death and life, and thoughts of purification, meditate in remembrance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਉਣ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: simarahi saun saasatr sa(n)jogaa alakh na lakheeai ik khinaa ||7||
english: The Shaastras, with their lucky signs and joinings, meditate in remembrance; the invisible cannot be seen, even for an instant. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: karan karaavanahaar suaamee ||
english: The Lord and Master is the Doer, the Cause of causes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: sagal ghataa ke a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸੋ ਜਿਨਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa jis bhagatee laavahu janam padaarath so jinaa ||8||
english: That person, whom You bless with Your Grace, and link to Your devotional service, wins this invaluable human life. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai man voothaa prabh apanaa ||
english: He, within whose mind God dwells,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
transliteration: poorai karam gur kaa jap japanaa ||
english: has perfect karma, and chants the Chant of the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਰੁਨਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: sarab nira(n)tar so prabh jaataa bahuR na jonee bharam runaa ||9||
english: One who realizes God pervading deep within all, does not wander crying in reincarnation again. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad vasai man jaa kai ||
english: Pain, sorrow and doubt run away from that one,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: dookh darad bhram taa kaa bhaagai ||
english: Within whose mind the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d naam ras anahad baanee sahaj dhunaa ||10||
english: Intuitive peace, poise and bliss come from the sublime essence of the Naam; the unstruck sound current of the Guru's Bani intuitively vibrates and resounds. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: so dhanava(n)taa jin prabh dhiaaiaa ||
english: He alone is wealthy, who meditates on God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਤਿਵੰਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: so pativa(n)taa jin saadhasa(n)g paaiaa ||
english: He alone is honorable, who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਸੋ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਨਾ ਛਿਨਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: paarabraham jaa kai man voothaa so poor kara(n)maa naa chhinaa ||11||
english: That person, within whose mind the Supreme Lord God abides, has perfect karma, and becomes famous. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jal thal maheeal suaamee soee ||
english: The Lord and Master is pervading the water, land and sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਹੀਐ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: avar na kaheeai doojaa koee ||
english: There is no other said to be so.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨਿ ਕਾਟਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: gur giaan a(n)jan kaatio bhram sagalaa avar na deesai ek binaa ||12||
english: The ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom has eradicated all doubts; except the One Lord, I do not see any other at all. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ooche te oochaa darabaaraa ||
english: The Lord's Court is the highest of the high.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kahan na jaaee a(n)t na paaraa ||
english: His limit and extent cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਮਿਨਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: gahir ga(n)bheer athaah suaamee atul na jaaee kiaa minaa ||13||
english: The Lord and Master is profoundly deep, unfathomable and unweighable; how can He be measured? ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: too karataa teraa sabh keeaa ||
english: You are the Creator; all is created by You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬੀਆ ॥
transliteration: tujh bin avar na koee beeaa ||
english: Without You, there is no other at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਤੁਮ ਤਨਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: aad madh a(n)t prabh toohai sagal pasaaraa tum tanaa ||14||
english: You alone, God, are in the beginning, the middle and the end. You are the root of the entire expanse. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮਦੂਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jamadoot tis nikat na aavai ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach that person

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har keeratan gaavai ||
english: who sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਜੋ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: sagal manorath taa ke pooran jo sravanee prabh kaa jas sunaa ||15||
english: All desires are fulfilled, for one who listens with his ears to the Praises of God. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too sabhanaa kaa sabh ko teraa ||
english: You belong to all, and all belong to You,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saache saahib gahir ga(n)bheeraa ||
english: O my true, deep and profound Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਮਨਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੮॥
transliteration: kahu naanak seee jan ootam jo bhaavahi suaamee tum manaa ||16||1||8||
english: Says Nanak, those humble beings are exalted, who are pleasing to Your Mind, O my Lord and Master. ||16||1||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: prabh samarath sarab sukh daanaa ||
english: God is the almighty Giver of all peace and joy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਹੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: simarau naam hohu miharavaanaa ||
english: Be merciful to me, that I may meditate in remembrance on Your Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜਨੁ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਜਾਚੰਗਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har daataa jee ja(n)t bhekhaaree jan baa(n)chhai jaacha(n)ganaa ||1||
english: The Lord is the Great Giver; all beings and creatures are beggars; His humble servants yearn to beg from Him. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਗਉ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: maagau jan dhoor param gat paavau ||
english: I beg for the dust of the feet of the humble, that I may be blessed with the supreme status,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਮਿਟਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kee mail mitaavau ||
english: and the filth of countless lifetimes may be erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਰਾਪੈ ਮੰਗਨਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: deeragh rog mitahi har aukhadh har niramal raapai ma(n)ganaa ||2||
english: The chronic diseases are cured by the medicine of the Lord's Name; I beg to be imbued with the Immaculate Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਉ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: sravanee sunau bimal jas suaamee ||
english: With my ears, I listen to the Pure Praises of my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਓਟ ਤਜਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: ekaa ot tajau bikh kaamee ||
english: With the Support of the One Lord, I have abandoned corruption, sexuality and desire.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਗਨਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: niv niv paai lagau daas tere kar sukrit naahee sa(n)ganaa ||3||
english: I humbly bow and fall at the feet of Your slaves; I do not hesitate to do good deeds. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa gun gaavai har tere ||
english: O Lord, with my tongue I sing Your Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕਮਾਤੇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mitahi kamaate avagun mere ||
english: The sins which I have committed are erased.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤਜਿ ਤੰਗਨਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: simar simar suaamee man jeevai pa(n)ch doot taj ta(n)ganaa ||4||
english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Lord and Master, my mind lives; I am rid of the five oppressive demons. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਪਿ ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਚਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal jap bohith chareeai ||
english: Meditating on Your lotus feet, I have come aboard Your boat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g mil saagar tareeai ||
english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I cross over the world-ocean.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਮਤ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਨੰਗਨਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: arachaa ba(n)dan har samat nivaasee baahuR jon na na(n)ganaa ||5||
english: My flower-offering and worship is to realize that the Lord is dwelling alike in all; I shall not be reincarnated naked again. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: daas daasan ko kar lehu goupaalaa ||
english: Please make me the slave of Your slaves, O Lord of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kripaa nidhaan deen daiaalaa ||
english: You are the treasure of Grace, merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਮਿਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭੰਗਨਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: sakhaa sahaaee pooran paramesur mil kade na hovee bha(n)ganaa ||6||
english: Meet with your companion and helper, the Perfect Transcendent Lord God; you shall never be separated from Him again. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਗੈ ॥
transliteration: man tan arap dharee har aagai ||
english: I dedicate my mind and body, and place them in offering before the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kaa soiaa jaagai ||
english: Asleep for countless lifetimes, I have awakened.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕੁ ਹਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੰਤਨਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: jis kaa saa soee pratipaalak hat tiaagee haumai ha(n)tanaa ||7||
english: He, to whom I belong, is my cherisher and nurturer. I have killed and discarded my murderous self-conceit. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: jal thal pooran a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is pervading the water and the land.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਅਛਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat raviaa achhal suaamee ||
english: The undeceivable Lord and Master is permeating each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਖੋਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਰਬੰਗਨਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: bharam bheet khoee gur poorai ek raviaa saraba(n)ganaa ||8||
english: The Perfect Guru has demolished the wall of doubt, and now I see the One Lord pervading everywhere. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
transliteration: jat kat pekhau prabh sukh saagar ||
english: Wherever I look, there I see God, the ocean of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਤਨਾਗਰ ॥
transliteration: har tot bha(n)daar naahee ratanaagar ||
english: The Lord's treasure is never exhausted; He is the storehouse of jewels.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਹ ਅਗਾਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪੰਗਨਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: agah agaah kichh mit nahee paaeeai so boojhai jis kirapa(n)ganaa ||9||
english: He cannot be seized; He is inaccessible, and His limits cannot be found. He is realized when the Lord bestows His Grace. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛਾਤੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਠੰਢਾ ॥
transliteration: chhaatee seetal man tan tha(n)dhaa ||
english: My heart is cooled, and my mind and body are calmed and soothed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਮਿਟਵੀ ਡੰਝਾ ॥
transliteration: janam maran kee mitavee da(n)jhaa ||
english: The craving for birth and death is quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਅਮਿਓ ਧਾਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: kar gahi kaadh leee prabh apunai amio dhaar drisata(n)ganaa ||10||
english: Grasping hold of my hand, He has lifted me up and out; He has blessed me with His Ambrosial Glance of Grace. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ॥
transliteration: eko ek raviaa sabh thaaee ||
english: The One and Only Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: tis bin doojaa koee naahee ||
english: There is none other than Him at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਭਰਮੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: aad madh a(n)t prabh raviaa trisan bujhee bharama(n)ganaa ||11||
english: God permeates the beginning, the middle and the end; He has subdued my desires and doubts. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: gur paramesar gur gobi(n)d ||
english: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Guru is the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਦ ਬਖਸੰਦੁ ॥
transliteration: gur karataa gur sad bakhasa(n)d ||
english: The Guru is the Creator, the Guru is forever forgiving.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਜਪਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: gur jap jaap japat phal paaiaa giaan deepak sa(n)t sa(n)ganaa ||12||
english: Meditating, chanting the Guru's Chant, I have obtained the fruits and rewards; in the Company of the Saints, I have been blessed with the lamp of spiritual wisdom. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪੇਖਾ ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: jo pekhaa so sabh kichh suaamee ||
english: Whatever I see, is my Lord and Master God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: jo sunanaa so prabh kee baanee ||
english: Whatever I hear, is the Bani of God's Word.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਕਰਾਇਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਤਹ ਤਨਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: jo keeno so tumahi karaaio saran sahaaee sa(n)tah tanaa ||13||
english: Whatever I do, You make me do; You are the Sanctuary, the help and support of the Saints, Your children. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਅਰਾਧੈ ॥
transliteration: jaachak jaachai tumahi araadhai ||
english: The beggar begs, and worships You in adoration.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਧੈ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan pooran prabh saadhai ||
english: You are the Purifier of the sinners, O Perfectly Holy Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਆਨ ਮੰਗਨ ਨਿਹਕਿੰਚਨਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: eko daan sarab sukh gun nidh aan ma(n)gan nihaki(n)chanaa ||14||
english: Please bless me with this one gift, O treasure of all bliss and virtue; I do not ask for anything else. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਪਾਤ੍ਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa paatr prabh karanaihaaraa ||
english: God is the Creator of the body-vessel.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਗੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: lagee laag sa(n)t sa(n)gaaraa ||
english: In the Society of the Saints, the dye is produced.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ਬਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: niramal soi banee har baanee man naam majeethai ra(n)ganaa ||15||
english: Through the Word of the Lord's Bani, one's reputation becomes immaculate, and the mind is colored by the dye of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਲਹ ਕਲਾ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਫਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: solah kalaa sa(n)pooran phaliaa ||
english: The sixteen powers, absolute perfection and fruitful rewards are obtained,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਤ ਕਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਚੜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: anat kalaa hoi thaakur chaRiaa ||
english: when the Lord and Master of infinite power is revealed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਭੁੰਚਨਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੯॥
transliteration: anad binod har naam sukh naanak a(n)mrit ras har bhu(n)chanaa ||16||2||9||
english: The Lord's Name is Nanak's bliss, play and peace; he drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord. ||16||2||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Solhas, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹਉ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: too saahib hau sevak keetaa ||
english: You are my Lord and Master; You have made me Your servant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh teraa deetaa ||
english: My soul and body are all gifts from You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਸਾੜਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: karan karaavan sabh toohai toohai hai naahee kichh asaaRaa ||1||
english: You are the Creator, the Cause of causes; nothing belongs to me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪਠਾਏ ਤਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: tumahi pathaae taa jag mahi aae ||
english: When You sent me, I came into the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: jo tudh bhaanaa se karam kamaae ||
english: Whatever is pleasing to Your Will, I do.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਆ ਤਾ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾੜਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tujh te baahar kichhoo na hoaa taa bhee naahee kichh kaaRaa ||2||
english: Without You, nothing is done, so I am not anxious at all. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਹਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਸੁਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: oohaa hukam tumaaraa suneeai ||
english: In the world hereafter, the Hukam of Your Command is heard.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: eehaa har jas teraa bhaneeai ||
english: In this world, I chant Your Praises, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਝਾੜਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aape lekh alekhai aape tum siu naahee kichh jhaaRaa ||3||
english: You Yourself write the account, and You Yourself erase it; no one can argue with You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਥਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: too pitaa sabh baarik thaare ||
english: You are our father; we are all Your children.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਖੇਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਖੇਲਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jiu khelaavahi tiu khelanahaare ||
english: We play as You cause us to play.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਝੜ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕੀਨਾ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਵੇਪਾੜਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ujhaR maarag sabh tum hee keenaa chalai naahee ko vepaaRaa ||4||
english: The wilderness and the path are all made by You. No one can take the wrong path. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਬੈਸਾਇ ਰਖੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅੰਤਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ik baisaai rakhe grih a(n)tar ||
english: Some remain seated within their homes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪਠਾਏ ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ॥
transliteration: ik pathaae des disa(n)tar ||
english: Some wander across the country and through foreign lands.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਘਾਸੁ ਇਕ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਰਾਜਾ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕੂੜਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: ik hee kau ghaas ik hee kau raajaa in mahi kaheeai kiaa kooRaa ||5||
english: Some are grass-cutters, and some are kings. Who among these can be called false? ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਨਰਕਾ ॥
transliteration: kavan s mukatee kavan s narakaa ||
english: Who is liberated, and who will land in hell?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੈਸਾਰੀ ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਭਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: kavan saisaaree kavan s bhagataa ||
english: Who is worldly, and who is a devotee?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਦਾਨਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਹੋਛਾ ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਜੜਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kavan s daanaa kavan s hochhaa kavan s surataa kavan jaRaa ||6||
english: Who is wise, and who is shallow? Who is aware, and who is ignorant? ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਨਰਕਾ ॥
transliteration: hukame mukatee hukame narakaa ||
english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, one is liberated, and by His Hukam, one falls into hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸੈਸਾਰੀ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਭਗਤਾ ॥
transliteration: hukam saisaaree hukame bhagataa ||
english: By His Hukam, one is worldly, and by His Hukam, one is a devotee.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੋਛਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਧੜਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: hukame hochhaa hukame daanaa doojaa naahee avar dhaRaa ||7||
english: By His Hukam, one is shallow, and by His Hukam, one is wise. There is no other side except His. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਅਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: saagar keenaa at tum bhaaraa ||
english: You made the ocean vast and huge.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਖੜੇ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ik khaRe rasaatal kar manamukh gaavaaraa ||
english: You made some into foolish self-willed manmukhs, and dragged them into hell.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਵਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੇੜਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: ikanaa paar la(n)ghaavahi aape satigur jin kaa sach beRaa ||8||
english: Some are carried across, in the ship of Truth of the True Guru. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਤਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kautak kaal ihu hukam pathaaiaa ||
english: You issue Your Command for this amazing thing, death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਓਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t opaai samaaiaa ||
english: You create all beings and creatures, and absorb them back into Yourself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਇਕੁ ਆਖਾੜਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: vekhai vigasai sabh ra(n)g maane rachan keenaa ik aakhaaRaa ||9||
english: You gaze in delight upon the one arena of the world, and enjoy all the pleasures. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਡੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
transliteration: vadaa saahib vadee naaee ||
english: Great is the Lord and Master, and Great is His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਡ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਵਡੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: vad daataar vadee jis jaaee ||
english: He is the Great Giver; Great is His place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਤੋਲਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਹਾੜਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: agam agochar bea(n)t atolaa hai naahee kichh aahaaRaa ||10||
english: He is inaccessible and unfathomable, infinite and unweighable. He cannot be measureed. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: keemat koi na jaanai doojaa ||
english: No one else knows His value.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: aape aap nira(n)jan poojaa ||
english: Only You Yourself, O Immaculate Lord, are equal to Yourself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਆਪਿ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਆਪਿ ਸਤਵੰਤਾ ਅਤਿ ਗਾੜਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: aap s giaanee aap dhiaanee aap satava(n)taa at gaaRaa ||11||
english: You Yourself are the spiritual teacher, You Yourself are the One who meditates. You Yourself are the great and immense Being of Truth. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ketaRiaa din gupat kahaaiaa ||
english: For so many days, You remained invisible.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ketaRiaa din su(n)n samaaiaa ||
english: For so many days, You were absorbed in silent absorption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਰਗਟੜਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: ketaRiaa din dhu(n)dhookaaraa aape karataa paragataRaa ||12||
english: For so many days, there was only pitch darkness, and then the Creator revealed Himself. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਕਤੀ ਸਬਲੁ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape sakatee sabal kahaaiaa ||
english: You Yourself are called the God of Supreme Power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੂਰਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aape sooraa amar chalaaiaa ||
english: You Yourself are the hero, exerting Your regal power.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਵ ਵਰਤਾਈਅਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਠਾਰੁ ਗੜਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: aape siv varataaeean a(n)tar aape seetal thaar gaRaa ||13||
english: You Yourself spread peace within; You are cool and icy calm. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: jisahi nivaaje guramukh saaje ||
english: One whom You bless and make Gurmukh

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: naam vasai tis anahad vaaje ||
english: the Naam abides within him, and the unstruck sound current vibrates for him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: tis hee sukh tis hee thakuraaee tisahi na aavai jam neRaa ||14||
english: He is peaceful, and he is the master of all; the Messenger of Death does not even approach him. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਾਗਦ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: keemat kaagad kahee na jaaee ||
english: His value cannot be described on paper.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bea(n)t gusaaee ||
english: Says Nanak, the Lord of the world is infinite.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਾਥਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਨੇਬੇੜਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: aad madh a(n)t prabh soee haath tisai kai nebeRaa ||15||
english: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, God exists. Judgement is in His Hands alone. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: tisahi sareek naahee re koee ||
english: No one is equal to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਬੁਤੈ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kis hee butai jabaab na hoee ||
english: No one can stand up against Him by any means.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਚੋਜ ਖੜਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak kaa prabh aape aape kar kar vekhai choj khaRaa ||16||1||10||
english: Nanak's God is Himself all-in-all. He creates and stages and watches His wondrous plays. ||16||1||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚੁਤ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: achut paarabraham paramesur a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: The Supreme Lord God is imperishable, the Transcendent Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: madhusoodan daamodar suaamee ||
english: He is the Slayer of demons, our Supreme Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਿਖੀਕੇਸ ਗੋਵਰਧਨ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੁਰਲੀ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: rikheekes govaradhan dhaaree muralee manohar har ra(n)gaa ||1||
english: The Supreme Rishi, the Master of the sensory organs, the uplifter of mountains, the joyful Lord playing His enticing flute. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਮਾਧਵ ਕ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਨ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mohan maadhav krisn muraare ||
english: The Enticer of Hearts, the Lord of wealth, Krishna, the Enemy of ego.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jagadeesur har jeeu asur sa(n)ghaare ||
english: The Lord of the Universe, the Dear Lord, the Destroyer of demons.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jagajeevan abinaasee thaakur ghat ghat vaasee hai sa(n)gaa ||2||
english: The Life of the World, our eternal and ever-stable Lord and Master dwells within each and every heart, and is always with us. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਣੀਧਰ ਈਸ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: dharaneedhar ees narasi(n)gh naaraain ||
english: The Support of the Earth, the man-lion, the Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾੜਾ ਅਗ੍ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮਿ ਧਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: daaRaa agre pritham dharaain ||
english: The Protector who tears apart demons with His teeth, the Upholder of the earth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਚੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: baavan roop keeaa tudh karate sabh hee setee hai cha(n)gaa ||3||
english: O Creator, You assumed the form of the pygmy to humble the demons; You are the Lord God of all. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਚੰਦ ਜਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sree raamacha(n)d jis roop na rekhiaa ||
english: You are the Great Raam Chand, who has no form or feature.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ਚਕ੍ਰਪਾਣਿ ਦਰਸਿ ਅਨੂਪਿਆ ॥
transliteration: banavaalee chakrapaan daras anoopiaa ||
english: Adorned with flowers, holding the chakra in Your hand, Your form is incomparably beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਹੈ ਮੰਗਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sahas netr moorat hai sahasaa ik daataa sabh hai ma(n)gaa ||4||
english: You have thousands of eyes, and thousands of forms. You alone are the Giver, and all are beggars of You. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਅਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal anaathah naathe ||
english: You are the Lover of Your devotees, the Master of the masterless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਪੀ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
transliteration: gopee naath sagal hai saathe ||
english: The Lord and Master of the milk-maids, You are the companion of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਗਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: baasudev nira(n)jan daate baran na saakau gun a(n)gaa ||5||
english: O Lord, Immacuate Great Giver, I cannot describe even an iota of Your Glorious Virtues. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕੰਦ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਲਖਮੀ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
transliteration: muka(n)d manohar lakhamee naaraain ||
english: Liberator, Enticing Lord, Lord of Lakshmi, Supreme Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਲਜਾ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਉਧਾਰਣ ॥
transliteration: dropatee lajaa nivaar udhaaran ||
english: Savior of Dropadi's honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਮਲਾਕੰਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਕੰਤੂਹਲ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ ਨਿਹਸੰਗਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: kamalaaka(n)t karahi ka(n)toohal anad binodee nihasa(n)gaa ||6||
english: Lord of Maya, miracle-worker, absorbed in delightful play, unattached. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸਨ ਆਜੂਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ॥
transliteration: amogh darasan aajoonee sa(n)bhau ||
english: The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; He is not born, He is self-existent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਉ ॥
transliteration: akaal moorat jis kade naahee khau ||
english: His form is undying; it is never destroyed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਲਗਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: abinaasee abigat agochar sabh kichh tujh hee hai lagaa ||7||
english: O imperishable, eternal, unfathomable Lord, everything is attached to You. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕੇ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: sreera(n)g baiku(n)th ke vaasee ||
english: The Lover of greatness, who dwells in heaven.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਛੁ ਕਛੁ ਕੂਰਮੁ ਆਗਿਆ ਅਉਤਰਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: machh kachh kooram aagiaa autaraasee ||
english: By the Pleasure of His Will, He took incarnation as the great fish and the tortoise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਸਵ ਚਲਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਇਗਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: kesav chalat karahi niraale keetaa loRahi so hoigaa ||8||
english: The Lord of beauteous hair, the Worker of miraculous deeds, whatever He wishes, comes to pass. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: niraahaaree niravair samaaiaa ||
english: He is beyond need of any sustenance, free of hate and all-pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਚਤੁਰਭੁਜੁ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhaar khel chaturabhuj kahaaiaa ||
english: He has staged His play; He is called the four-armed Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਲ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਰੂਪ ਬਣਾਵਹਿ ਬੇਣੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਭ ਮੋਹੈਗਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: saaval su(n)dar roop banaavahi ben sunat sabh mohaigaa ||9||
english: He assumed the beautiful form of the blue-skinned Krishna; hearing His flute, all are fascinated and enticed. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਨਮਾਲਾ ਬਿਭੂਖਨ ਕਮਲ ਨੈਨ ॥
transliteration: banamaalaa bibhookhan kamal nain ||
english: He is adorned with garlands of flowers, with lotus eyes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਮੁਕਟ ਬੈਨ ॥
transliteration: su(n)dar ku(n)dal mukat bain ||
english: His ear-rings, crown and flute are so beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਖ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਗਦਾ ਹੈ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਾ ਸਾਰਥੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: sa(n)kh chakr gadaa hai dhaaree mahaa saarathee satasa(n)gaa ||10||
english: He carries the conch, the chakra and the war club; He is the Great Charioteer, who stays with His Saints. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਤ ਪੀਤੰਬਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਣੀ ॥
transliteration: peet peeta(n)bar tribhavan dhanee ||
english: The Lord of yellow robes, the Master of the three worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jaga(n)naath gopaal mukh bhanee ||
english: The Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the world; with my mouth, I chant His Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸਰਬੰਗਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: saari(n)gadhar bhagavaan beethulaa mai ganat na aavai saraba(n)gaa ||11||
english: The Archer who draws the bow, the Beloved Lord God; I cannot count all His limbs. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਕੰਟਕੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: nihaka(n)tak nihakeval kaheeai ||
english: He is said to be free of anguish, and absolutely immaculate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨੰਜੈ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਹੈ ਮਹੀਐ ॥
transliteration: dhana(n)jai jal thal hai maheeai ||
english: The Lord of prosperity, pervading the water, the land and the sky.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤ ਲੋਕ ਪਇਆਲ ਸਮੀਪਤ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਥਾਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੈ ਅਭਗਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: mirat lok paiaal sameepat asathir thaan jis hai abhagaa ||12||
english: He is near this world and the nether regions of the underworld; His Place is permanent, ever-stable and imperishable. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ॥
transliteration: patit paavan dukh bhai bha(n)jan ||
english: The Purifier of sinners, the Destroyer of pain and fear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ਹੈ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨੁ ॥
transliteration: aha(n)kaar nivaaran hai bhav kha(n)dan ||
english: The Eliminator of egotism, the Eradicator of coming and going.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਤੋਖਿਤ ਦੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਗੁਣੇ ਨ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਭਿਗਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: bhagatee tokhit deen kripaalaa gune na kit hee hai bhigaa ||13||
english: He is pleased with devotional worship, and merciful to the meek; He cannot be appeased by any other qualities. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਛਲ ਅਡੋਲੋ ॥
transliteration: nira(n)kaar achhal adolo ||
english: The Formless Lord is undeceivable and unchanging.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਮਉਲੋ ॥
transliteration: jot saroopee sabh jag maulo ||
english: He is the Embodiment of Light; through Him, the whole world blossoms forth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪਹੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈਗਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: so milai jis aap milaae aapahu koi na paavaigaa ||14||
english: He alone unites with Him, whom He unites with Himself. No one can attain the Lord by himself. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੋਪੀ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aape gopee aape kaanaa ||
english: He Himself is the milk-maid, and He Himself is Krishna.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਵੈ ਬਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: aape gaoo charaavai baanaa ||
english: He Himself grazes the cows in the forest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਖਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: aap upaavahi aap khapaavahi tudh lep nahee ik til ra(n)gaa ||15||
english: You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy. Not even a particle of filth attaches to You. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਗੁਣ ਕਵਨ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: ek jeeh gun kavan bakhaanai ||
english: Which of Your Glorious Virtues can I chant with my one tongue?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਫਨੀ ਸੇਖ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
transliteration: sahas phanee sekh a(n)t na jaanai ||
english: Even the thousand-headed serpent does not know Your limit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਵਤਨ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਹਿ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: navatan naam japai din raatee ik gun naahee prabh kahi sa(n)gaa ||16||
english: One may chant new names for You day and night, but even so, O God, no one can describe even one of Your Glorious Virtues. ||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ot gahee jagat pit saranaaiaa ||
english: I have grasped the Support, and entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Father of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਇਆਨਕ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਦੁਤਰ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhai bhaiaanak jamadoot dutar hai maaiaa ||
english: The Messenger of Death is terrifying and horrendous, and sea of Maya is impassable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਇਛਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: hohu kripaal ichhaa kar raakhahu saadh sa(n)tan kai sa(n)g sa(n)gaa ||17||
english: Please be merciful, Lord, and save me, if it is Your Will; please lead me to join with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿਮਾਨ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਥੇਨਾ ॥
transliteration: drisatimaan hai sagal mithenaa ||
english: All that is seen is an illusion.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ik maagau daan gobid sa(n)t renaa ||
english: I beg for this one gift, for the dust of the feet of the Saints, O Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈਗਾ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: masatak laai param pad paavau jis praapat so paavaigaa ||18||
english: Applying it to my forehead, I obtain the supreme status; he alone obtains it, unto whom You give it. ||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: jin kau kripaa karee sukhadaate ||
english: Those, unto whom the Lord, the Giver of peace, grants His Mercy,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਲੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: tin saadhoo charan lai ridai paraate ||
english: grasp the feet of the Holy, and weave them into their hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਜੰਗਾ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: sagal naam nidhaan tin paaiaa anahad sabad man vaaja(n)gaa ||19||
english: They obtain all the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds within their minds. ||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਥੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਿਹਬਾ ॥
transliteration: kiratam naam kathe tere jihabaa ||
english: With my tongue I chant the Names given to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sat naam teraa paraa poorabalaa ||
english: 'Sat Naam' is Your perfect, primal Name.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: kahu naanak bhagat pae saranaaee dehu daras man ra(n)g lagaa ||20||
english: Says Nanak, Your devotees have entered Your Sanctuary. Please bestow the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; their minds are filled with love for You. ||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: teree gat mit toohai jaanahi ||
english: You alone know Your state and extent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਥਹਿ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
transliteration: too aape kathahi tai aap vakhaanahi ||
english: You Yourself speak, and You Yourself describe it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਦਾਸਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੨੧॥੨॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak daas daasan ko kareeahu har bhaavai daasaa raakh sa(n)gaa ||21||2||11||
english: Please make Nanak the slave of Your slaves, O Lord; as it pleases Your Will, please keep him with Your slaves. ||21||2||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਲਹ ਅਗਮ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਬੰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: alah agam khudaaee ba(n)de ||
english: O slave of the inaccessible Lord God Allah,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਖਿਆਲ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੇ ਧੰਧੇ ॥
transliteration: chhod khiaal duneeaa ke dha(n)dhe ||
english: forsake thoughts of worldly entanglements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਪੈ ਖਾਕ ਫਕੀਰ ਮੁਸਾਫਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ਕਬੂਲੁ ਦਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hoi pai khaak phakeer musaaphar ihu daraves kabool daraa ||1||
english: Become the dust of the feet of the humble fakeers, and consider yourself a traveller on this journey. O saintly dervish, you shall be approved in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਯਕੀਨ ਮੁਸਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sach nivaaj yakeen musalaa ||
english: Let Truth be your prayer, and faith your prayer-mat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਹੁ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: manasaa maar nivaarihu aasaa ||
english: Subdue your desires, and overcome your hopes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਾਣਾ ਕਲਮ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਪਾਕੁ ਖਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: deh maseet man maulaanaa kalam khudaaee paak kharaa ||2||
english: Let your body be the mosque, and your mind the priest. Let true purity be God's Word for you. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਾ ਸਰੀਅਤਿ ਲੇ ਕੰਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: saraa sareeat le ka(n)maavahu ||
english: Let your practice be to live the spiritual life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਰੀਕਤਿ ਤਰਕ ਖੋਜਿ ਟੋਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: tareekat tarak khoj tolaavahu ||
english: Let your spiritual cleansing be to renounce the world and seek God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਫਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਹੁ ਅਬਦਾਲਾ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਹਕੀਕਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maaraphat man maarahu abadaalaa milahu hakeekat jit phir na maraa ||3||
english: Let control of the mind be your spiritual wisdom, O holy man; meeting with God, you shall never die again. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ਕਤੇਬ ਦਿਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: kuraan kateb dil maahi kamaahee ||
english: Practice within your heart the teachings of the Koran and the Bible;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਉਰਾਤ ਰਖਹੁ ਬਦ ਰਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: das auraat rakhahu bad raahee ||
english: restrain the ten sensory organs from straying into evil.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਮਰਦ ਸਿਦਕਿ ਲੇ ਬਾਧਹੁ ਖੈਰਿ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਕਬੂਲ ਪਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch marad sidak le baadhahu khair sabooree kabool paraa ||4||
english: Tie up the five demons of desire with faith, charity and contentment, and you shall be acceptable. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਕਾ ਮਿਹਰ ਰੋਜਾ ਪੈ ਖਾਕਾ ॥
transliteration: makaa mihar rojaa pai khaakaa ||
english: Let compassion be your Mecca, and the dust of the feet of the holy your fast.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਿਸਤੁ ਪੀਰ ਲਫਜ ਕਮਾਇ ਅੰਦਾਜਾ ॥
transliteration: bhisat peer laphaj kamaai a(n)daajaa ||
english: Let Paradise be your practice of the Prophet's Word.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੂਰ ਨੂਰ ਮੁਸਕੁ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਅਲਹ ਆਲਾ ਹੁਜਰਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: hoor noor musak khudaaiaa ba(n)dagee alah aalaa hujaraa ||5||
english: God is the beauty, the light and the fragrance. Meditation on Allah is the secluded meditation chamber. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਾਜੀ ॥
transliteration: sach kamaavai soee kaajee ||
english: He alone is a Qazi, who practices the Truth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦਿਲੁ ਸੋਧੈ ਸੋਈ ਹਾਜੀ ॥
transliteration: jo dil sodhai soee haajee ||
english: He alone is a Haji, a pilgrim to Mecca, who purifies his heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੁਲਾ ਮਲਊਨ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸੋ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਧਰਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: so mulaa malaoon nivaarai so daraves jis siphat dharaa ||6||
english: He alone is a Mullah, who banishes evil; he alone is a saintly dervish, who takes the Support of the Lord's Praise. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਵਖਤ ਸਭੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sabhe vakhat sabhe kar velaa ||
english: Always, at every moment, remember God,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਲਕੁ ਯਾਦਿ ਦਿਲੈ ਮਹਿ ਮਉਲਾ ॥
transliteration: khaalak yaad dilai mahi maulaa ||
english: The Creator within your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਸਬੀ ਯਾਦਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਸ ਮਰਦਨੁ ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਬੰਧਾਨਿ ਬਰਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: tasabee yaad karahu das maradan su(n)nat seel ba(n)dhaan baraa ||7||
english: Let your meditation beads be the subjugation of the ten senses. Let good conduct and self-restraint be your circumcision. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਸਭ ਫਿਲਹਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: dil mahi jaanahu sabh philahaalaa ||
english: You must know in your heart that everything is temporary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਿਲਖਾਨਾ ਬਿਰਾਦਰ ਹਮੂ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: khilakhaanaa biraadar hamoo ja(n)jaalaa ||
english: Family, household and siblings are all entanglements.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਰ ਮਲਕ ਉਮਰੇ ਫਾਨਾਇਆ ਏਕ ਮੁਕਾਮ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਦਰਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: meer malak umare phaanaaiaa ek mukaam khudaai daraa ||8||
english: Kings, rulers and nobles are mortal and transitory; only God's Gate is the permanent place. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਵਲਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਸਾਬੂਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aval siphat doojee saabooree ||
english: First, is the Lord's Praise; second, contentment;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੀਜੈ ਹਲੇਮੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਖੈਰੀ ॥
transliteration: teejai halemee chauthai khairee ||
english: third, humility, and fourth, giving to charities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਜਵੈ ਪੰਜੇ ਇਕਤੁ ਮੁਕਾਮੈ ਏਹਿ ਪੰਜਿ ਵਖਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਪਰਪਰਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: pa(n)javai pa(n)je ikat mukaamai ehi pa(n)j vakhat tere aparaparaa ||9||
english: Fifth is to hold one's desires in restraint. These are the five most sublime daily prayers. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਜਾਨਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਉਦੀਫਾ ॥
transliteration: sagalee jaan karahu maudeephaa ||
english: Let your daily worship be the knowledge that God is everywhere.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਦ ਅਮਲ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਥਿ ਕੂਜਾ ॥
transliteration: bad amal chhod karahu hath koojaa ||
english: Let renunciation of evil actions be the water-jug you carry.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੁਦਾਇ ਏਕੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਬਾਂਗਾਂ ਬੁਰਗੂ ਬਰਖੁਰਦਾਰ ਖਰਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: khudaai ek bujh devahu baa(n)gaa(n) buragoo barakhuradaar kharaa ||10||
english: Let realization of the One Lord God be your call to prayer; be a good child of God - let this be your trumpet. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਕੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਬਖੋਰਹੁ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: hak halaal bakhorahu khaanaa ||
english: Let what is earned righteously be your blessed food.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਿਲ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਧੋਵਹੁ ਮੈਲਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: dil dareeaau dhovahu mailaanaa ||
english: Wash away pollution with the river of your heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਰੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਭਿਸਤੀ ਸੋਈ ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਨ ਦੋਜ ਠਰਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: peer pachhaanai bhisatee soee ajaraaeel na doj tharaa ||11||
english: One who realizes the Prophet attains heaven. Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death, does not cast him into hell. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਿਰਦਾਰ ਅਉਰਤ ਯਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa kiradaar aurat yakeenaa ||
english: Let good deeds be your body, and faith your bride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਮਾਣਿ ਹਕੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g tamaase maan hakeenaa ||
english: Play and enjoy the Lord's love and delight.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਪਾਕ ਪਾਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਹਦੀਸਾ ਸਾਬਤ ਸੂਰਤਿ ਦਸਤਾਰ ਸਿਰਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naapaak paak kar hadoor hadeesaa saabat soorat dasataar siraa ||12||
english: Purify what is impure, and let the Lord's Presence be your religious tradition. Let your total awareness be the turban on your head. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਮੋਮ ਦਿਲਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: musalamaan mom dil hovai ||
english: To be Muslim is to be kind-hearted,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਦਿਲ ਤੇ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kee mal dil te dhovai ||
english: and wash away pollution from within the heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਰੰਗ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਜਿਉ ਕੁਸਮ ਪਾਟੁ ਘਿਉ ਪਾਕੁ ਹਰਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: duneeaa ra(n)g na aavai neRai jiu kusam paat ghiu paak haraa ||13||
english: He does not even approach worldly pleasures; he is pure, like flowers, silk, ghee and the deer-skin. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਹਰ ਮਿਹਰ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau mihar mihar miharavaanaa ||
english: One who is blessed with the mercy and compassion of the Merciful Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਮਰਦੁ ਮਰਦੁ ਮਰਦਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: soee marad marad maradaanaa ||
english: is the manliest man among men.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੇਖੁ ਮਸਾਇਕੁ ਹਾਜੀ ਸੋ ਬੰਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਜਰਿ ਨਰਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: soee sekh masaaik haajee so ba(n)daa jis najar naraa ||14||
english: He alone is a Shaykh, a preacher, a Haji, and he alone is God's slave, who is blessed with God's Grace. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਾਦਰ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੀਮਾ ॥
transliteration: kudarat kaadar karan kareemaa ||
english: The Creator Lord has Creative Power; the Merciful Lord has Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਅਥਾਹ ਰਹੀਮਾ ॥
transliteration: siphat muhabat athaah raheemaa ||
english: The Praises and the Love of the Merciful Lord are unfathomable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਕੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ ਬੁਝਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਦਿ ਖਲਾਸ ਤਰਾ ॥੧੫॥੩॥੧੨॥
transliteration: hak hukam sach khudaaiaa bujh naanak ba(n)d khalaas taraa ||15||3||12||
english: Realize the True Hukam, the Command of the Lord, O Nanak; you shall be released from bondage, and carried across. ||15||3||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਭ ਊਚ ਬਿਰਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham sabh ooch biraaje ||
english: The Abode of the Supreme Lord God is above all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
transliteration: aape thaap uthaape saaje ||
english: He Himself establishes, establishes and creates.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਬਾਲ ਕਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh kee saran gahat sukh paaeeai kichh bhau na viaapai baal kaa ||1||
english: Holding tight to the Sanctuary of God, peace is found, and one is not afflicted by the fear of Maya. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: garabh agan mahi jinahi ubaariaa ||
english: He saved you from the fire of the womb,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਕਤ ਕਿਰਮ ਮਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਘਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: rakat kiram mahi nahee sa(n)ghaariaa ||
english: and did not destroy you, when you were an egg in your mother's ovary.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਮਾਲਕਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: apanaa simaran de pratipaaliaa ohu sagal ghataa kaa maalakaa ||2||
english: Blessing you with meditative remembrance upon Himself, He nurtured you and cherished you; He is the Master of all hearts. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal saranaaee aaiaa ||
english: I have come to the Sanctuary of His lotus feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g hai har jas gaaiaa ||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing the Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਲ ਕਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam maran sabh dookh nivaare jap har har bhau nahee kaal kaa ||3||
english: I have erased all the pains of birth and death; meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, I have no fear of death. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: samarath akath agochar devaa ||
english: God is all-powerful, indescribable, unfathomable and divine.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh taa kee sevaa ||
english: All beings and creatures serve Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰੀ ਪਾਲਕਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: a(n)daj jeraj setaj utabhuj bahu parakaaree paalakaa ||4||
english: In so many ways, He cherishes those born from eggs, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: tisahi paraapat hoi nidhaanaa ||
english: He alone obtains this wealth,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam ras a(n)tar maanaa ||
english: who savors and enjoys, deep within his mind, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਸਾਲਕਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kar gahi leene a(n)dh koop te virale keee saalakaa ||5||
english: Grasping hold of his arm, God lifts him up and pulls him out of the deep, dark pit. Such a devotee of the Lord is very rare. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aad a(n)t madh prabh soee ||
english: God exists in the beginning, in the middle and in the end.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa kare s hoee ||
english: Whatever the Creator Lord Himself does, comes to pass.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਤੇ ਦਾਲਿਦ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਘਾਲਕਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: bhram bhau mitiaa saadhasa(n)g te daalid na koee ghaalakaa ||6||
english: Doubt and fear are erased, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and then one is not afflicted by deadly pain. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਉ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: ootam baanee gaau goupaalaa ||
english: I sing the most Sublime Bani, the Word of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਮੰਗਹੁ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kee ma(n)gahu ravaalaa ||
english: I beg for the dust of the feet of the Saadh Sangat.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਸਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਨਿਬਾਸਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਲਮਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਜਾਲਕਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: baasan met nibaasan hoeeai kalamal sagale jaalakaa ||7||
english: Eradicating desire, I have become free of desire; I have burnt away all my sins. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਰੀਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)taa kee ih reet niraalee ||
english: This is the unique way of the Saints;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਨਾਲੀ ॥
transliteration: paarabraham kar dekhahi naalee ||
english: they behold the Supreme Lord God with them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਲਕਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: saas saas aaraadhan har har kiu simarat keejai aalakaa ||8||
english: With each and every breath, they worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har. How could anyone be too lazy to meditate on Him? ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: jah dekhaa tah a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: Wherever I look, there I see the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: nimakh na visarahu prabh mere suaamee ||
english: I never forget God, my Lord and Master, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਾ ਬਨਿ ਜਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਥਾਲਕਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: simar simar jeevahi tere daasaa ban jal pooran thaalakaa ||9||
english: Your slaves live by meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord; You are permeating the woods, the water and the land. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: tatee vaau na taa kau laagai ||
english: Even the hot wind does not touch one

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: simarat naam anadin jaagai ||
english: who remains awake in meditative remembrance, night and day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਤਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: anad binod kare har simaran tis maaiaa sa(n)g na taalakaa ||10||
english: He delights and enjoys meditative remembrance on the Lord; he has no attachment to Maya. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਦੂਖ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: rog sog dookh tis naahee ||
english: Disease, sorrow and pain do not affect him;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har keeratan gaahee ||
