english: he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਖਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: aapanaa naam dehi prabh preetam sun bena(n)tee khaalakaa ||11||
english: Please bless me with Your Name, O my Beloved Lord God; please listen to my prayer, O Creator. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: naam ratan teraa hai piaare ||
english: Your Name is a jewel, O my Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਾਸ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g rate terai daas apaare ||
english: Your slaves are imbued with Your Infinite Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਭਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: terai ra(n)g rate tudh jehe virale keee bhaalakaa ||12||
english: Those who are imbued with Your Love, become like You; it is so rare that they are found. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tin kee dhooR maa(n)gai man meraa ||
english: My mind longs for the dust of the feet of those

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jin visarahi naahee kaahoo beraa ||
english: who never forget the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: tin kai sa(n)g param pad paaee sadaa sa(n)gee har naalakaa ||13||
english: Associating with them, I obtain the supreme status; the Lord, my Companion, is always with me. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
transliteration: saajan meet piaaraa soee ||
english: He alone is my beloved friend and companion,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ek driRaae duramat khoee ||
english: who implants the Name of the One Lord within, and eradicates evil-mindedness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਜਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar tajaae tis jan kau upades niramaalakaa ||14||
english: Immaculate are the teachings of that humble servant of the Lord, who casts out sexual desire, anger and egotism. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tudh vin naahee koee meraa ||
english: Other than You, O Lord, no one is mine.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪਕੜਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਪੈਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur pakaRaae prabh ke pairaa ||
english: The Guru has led me to grasp the feet of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਖੰਡਿਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਅਨਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur poore jin kha(n)diaa bharam anaalakaa ||15||
english: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru, who has destroyed the illusion of duality. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: saas saas prabh bisarai naahee ||
english: With each and every breath, I never forget God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਉ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar har har kau dhiaaee ||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਵਡਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak sa(n)t terai ra(n)g raate too samarath vadaalakaa ||16||4||13||
english: O Nanak, the Saints are imbued with Your Love; You are the great and all-powerful Lord. ||16||4||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal hiradai nit dhaaree ||
english: I enshrine the Lord's lotus feet continually within my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gur pooraa khin khin namasakaaree ||
english: Each and every moment, I humbly bow to the Perfect Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਗੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tan man arap dharee sabh aagai jag mahi naam suhaavanaa ||1||
english: I dedicate my body, mind and everything, and place it in offering before the Lord. His Name is the most beautiful in this world. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: so thaakur kiu manahu visaare ||
english: Why forget the Lord and Master from your mind?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d de saaj savaare ||
english: He blessed you with body and soul, creating and embellishing you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਰਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saas garaas samaale karataa keetaa apanaa paavanaa ||2||
english: With every breath and morsel of food, the Creator takes care of His beings, who receive according to what they have done. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਊ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa te birathaa kooo naahee ||
english: No one returns empty-handed from Him;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: aath pahar har rakh man maahee ||
english: twenty-four hours a day, keep the Lord in your mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਜੁ ਅਚੁਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)g bhaj achut suaamee daragah sobhaa paavanaa ||3||
english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate and vibrate upon your imperishable Lord and Master, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਦਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
transliteration: chaar padaarath asat dasaa sidh ||
english: The four great blessings, and the eighteen miraculous spiritual powers,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan sahaj sukh nau nidh ||
english: are found in the treasure of the Naam, which brings celestial peace and poise, and the nine treasures.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਜੇ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਾਵਣਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: sarab kaliaan je man mahi chaahahi mil saadhoo suaamee raavanaa ||4||
english: If you yearn in your mind for all joys, then join the Saadh Sangat, and dwell upon your Lord and Master. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: saasat si(n)mrit bed vakhaanee ||
english: The Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas proclaim

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: janam padaarath jeet paraanee ||
english: that the mortal must be victorious in this priceless human life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰਹਰੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: kaam krodh ni(n)daa parahareeai har rasanaa naanak gaavanaa ||5||
english: Forsaking sexual desire, anger and slander, sing of the Lord with your tongue, O Nanak. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: jis roop na rekhiaa kul nahee jaatee ||
english: He has no form or shape, no ancestry or social class.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
transliteration: pooran poor rahiaa din raatee ||
english: The Perfect Lord is perfectly pervading day and night.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jo jo japai soee vadabhaagee bahuR na jonee paavanaa ||6||
english: Whoever meditates on Him is very fortunate; he is not consigned to reincarnation again. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jis no bisarai purakh bidhaataa ||
english: One who forgets the Primal Lord, the Architect of karma,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਤਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jalataa phirai rahai nit taataa ||
english: wanders around burning, and remains tormented.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣੈ ਕਉ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: akirataghanai kau rakhai na koee narak ghor mahi paavanaa ||7||
english: No one can save such an ungrateful person; he is thrown into the most horrible hell. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jeeu praan tan dhan jin saajiaa ||
english: He blessed you with your soul, the breath of life, your body and wealth;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ॥
transliteration: maat garabh mahi raakh nivaajiaa ||
english: He preserved and nurtured you in your mother's womb.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਨ ਰਾਤਾ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਿਰੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਣਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: tis siu preet chhaad an raataa kaahoo sirai na laavanaa ||8||
english: Forsaking His Love, you are imbued with another; you shall never achieve your goals like this. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dhaar anugrahu suaamee mere ||
english: Please shower me with Your Merciful Grace, O my Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਸਭਨ ਕੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ghat ghat vasahi sabhan kai nere ||
english: You dwell in each and every heart, and are near everyone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਥਿ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਕਛੂਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਣਾਇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਜਣਾਵਣਾ ॥੯॥
transliteration: haath hamaarai kachhooai naahee jis janaaihi tisai janaavanaa ||9||
english: Nothing is in my hands; he alone knows, whom You inspire to know. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa kai masatak dhur likh paaiaa ||
english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tis hee purakh na viaapai maaiaa ||
english: that person is not afflicted by Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਦੂਸਰ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak daas sadaa saranaaee doosar lavai na laavanaa ||10||
english: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary forever; there is no other equal to You. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆ ਦੂਖ ਸੂਖ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: aagiaa dookh sookh sabh keene ||
english: In His Will, He made all pain and pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਰਲੈ ਹੀ ਚੀਨੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam biralai hee cheene ||
english: How rare are those who remember the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਓਹੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: taa kee keemat kahan na jaaee jat kat ohee samaavanaa ||11||
english: His value cannot be described. He is prevailing everywhere. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਵਡ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: soee bhagat soee vad daataa ||
english: He is the devotee; He is the Great Giver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: soee pooran purakh bidhaataa ||
english: He is the Perfect Primal Lord, the Architect of karma.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: baal sahaaee soee teraa jo terai man bhaavanaa ||12||
english: He is your help and support, since infancy; He fulfills your mind's desires. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਦੂਖ ਸੂਖ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mirat dookh sookh likh paae ||
english: Death, pain and pleasure are ordained by the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਬਧਹਿ ਘਟਹਿ ਨ ਘਟਾਏ ॥
transliteration: til nahee badhahi ghatahi na ghataae ||
english: They do not increase or decrease by anyone's efforts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਹੋਇ ਜਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਹਿ ਕੈ ਆਪੁ ਵਞਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: soee hoi j karate bhaavai kahi kai aap vanjaavanaa ||13||
english: That alone happens, which is pleasing to the Creator; speaking of himself, the mortal ruins himself. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਕਾਢੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dh koop te seee kaadhe ||
english: He lifts us up and pulls us out of the deep dark pit;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਟੂਟੇ ਗਾਂਢੇ ॥
transliteration: janam janam ke toote gaa(n)dhe ||
english: He unites with Himself, those who were separated for so many incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: kirapaa dhaar rakhe kar apune mil saadhoo gobi(n)d dhiaavanaa ||14||
english: Showering them with His Mercy, He protects them with His own hands. Meeting with the Holy Saints, they meditate on the Lord of the Universe. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: teree keemat kahan na jaaee ||
english: Your worth cannot be described.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
transliteration: acharaj roop vadee vadiaaee ||
english: Wondrous is Your form, and Your glorious greatness.

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: bhagat daan ma(n)gai jan teraa naanak bal bal jaavanaa ||15||1||14||22||24||2||14||62||
english: Your humble servant begs for the gift of devotional worship. Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||15||1||14||22||24||2||14||62||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: maaroo vaar mahalaa 3 ||
english: Vaar Of Maaroo, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗਾਹਕ ਗੁਣੁ ਵੇਚੀਐ ਤਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਸਹਘੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: vin gaahak gun vecheeai tau gun sahagho jaai ||
english: If virtue is sold when there is no buyer, then it is sold very cheap.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਲਾਖ ਵਿਕਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gun kaa gaahak je milai tau gun laakh vikaai ||
english: But if one meets a buyer of virtue, then virtue sells for hundreds of thousands.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: gun te gun mil paaeeai je satigur maahi samaai ||
english: Meeting with a virtuous person, virtue is obtained, and one is immersed in the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੋੁਲਿ ਅਮੋੁਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਣਜਿ ਨ ਲੀਜੈ ਹਾਟਿ ॥
transliteration: moul amoul na paaeeai vanaj na leejai haat ||
english: Priceless virtues are not obtained for any price; they cannot be purchased in a store.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਟਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak pooraa tol hai kabahu na hovai ghaat ||1||
english: O Nanak, their weight is full and perfect; it never decreases at all. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਭਰਮਸਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
transliteration: naam vihoone bharamasahi aavahi jaavahi neet ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they wander around, continually coming and going in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਇਕਿ ਢੀਲਿਆ ਇਕਿ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
transliteration: ik baa(n)dhe ik dheeliaa ik sukheee har preet ||
english: Some are in bondage, and some are set free; some are happy in the Love of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sachaa ma(n)n lai sach karanee sach reet ||2||
english: O Nanak, believe in the True Lord, and practice Truth, through the lifestyle of Truth. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur te giaan paaiaa at khaRag karaaraa ||
english: From the Guru, I have obtained the supremely powerful sword of spiritual wisdom.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗੜੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: doojaa bhram gaR katiaa mohu lobh aha(n)kaaraa ||
english: I have cut down the fortress of duality and doubt, attachment, greed and egotism.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam man vasiaa gur sabad veechaaraa ||
english: The Name of the Lord abides within my mind; I contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sach sa(n)jam mat ootamaa har lagaa piaaraa ||
english: Through Truth, self-discipline and sublime understanding, the Lord has become very dear to me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh sacho sach varatadaa sach sirajanahaaraa ||1||
english: Truly, truly, the True Creator Lord is all-pervading. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਰਾਗਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦੇ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa raagaa vich jaaneeai bhaaee sabade kare piaar ||
english: Among the ragas, Kaydaaraa Raga is known as good, O Siblings of Destiny, if through it, one comes to love the Word of the Shabad,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਦੋ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: satasa(n)gat siu milado rahai sache dhare piaar ||
english: and if one remains in the Soceity of the Saints, and enshrines love for the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਲੁ ਕਟੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੁਲਾ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: vichahu mal kate aapanee kulaa kaa kare udhaar ||
english: Such a person washes away the pollution from within, and saves his generations as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਢੈ ਵਿਡਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gunaa kee raas sa(n)grahai avagan kadhai vidaar ||
english: He gathes in the capital of virtue, and destroys and drives out unvirtuous sins.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak miliaa so jaaneeai guroo na chhodai aapanaa doojai na dhare piaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, he alone is known as united, who does not forsake his Guru, and who does not love duality. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੇਖਉ ਡਰਿ ਮਰਉ ਭੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: saagar dekhau dar marau bhai terai dar naahi ||
english: Gazing upon the world-ocean, I am afraid of death; but if I live in the Fear of You, God, then I am not afraid.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad sa(n)tokheeaa naanak bigasaa naai ||2||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am content; O Nanak, I blossom forth in the Name. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 4 ||
english: Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚੜਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਚਾਲਸਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: chaR bohithai chaalasau saagar laharee dei ||
english: I get on board the boat and set out, but the ocean is churning with waves.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਠਾਕ ਨ ਸਚੈ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੀਰਕ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: thaak na sachai bohithai je gur dheerak dei ||
english: The boat of Truth encounters no obstruction, if the Guru gives encouragement.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਉਤਾਰੀਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tit dar jaai utaareeaa gur disai saavadhaan ||
english: He takes us across to the door on the other side, as the Guru keeps watch.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai daragah chalai maan ||3||
english: O Nanak, if I am blessed with His Grace, I shall go to His Court with honor. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਕੰਟਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਭੁੰਚਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: nihaka(n)tak raaj bhu(n)ch too guramukh sach kamaaee ||
english: Enjoy your kingdom of bliss; as Gurmukh, practice Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: sachai takhat baithaa niaau kar satasa(n)gat mel milaaee ||
english: Sitting upon the throne of Truth, the Lord administers justice; He unites us in Union with the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
transliteration: sachaa upades har jaapanaa har siu ban aaee ||
english: Meditating on the Lord, through the True Teachings, we become just like the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
transliteration: aithai sukhadaataa man vasai a(n)t hoi sakhaaee ||
english: If the Lord, the Giver of peace, abides in the mind, in this world, then in the end, He becomes our help and support.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਊਪਜੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: har siu preet oopajee gur sojhee paaee ||2||
english: Love for the Lord wells up, when the Guru imparts understanding. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਮੈ ਫਿਰੀ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhoolee bhoolee mai phiree paadhar kahai na koi ||
english: Confused and deluded, I wander around, but no one shows me the way.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਆਣਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: poochhahu jaai siaaniaa dukh kaatai meraa koi ||
english: I go and ask the clever people, if there is there anyone who can rid me of my pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਠਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur saachaa man vasai saajan ut hee thaai ||
english: If the True Guru abides within my mind, then I see the Lord, my best friend, there.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੀਐ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak man tripataaseeai siphatee saachai naai ||1||
english: O Nanak, my mind is satisfied and fulfilled, contemplating the Praises of the True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape karanee kaar aap aape kare rajaai ||
english: He Himself is the Doer, and He is the deed; He Himself issues the Command.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape kis hee bakhas lae aape kaar kamaai ||
english: He Himself forgives some, and He Himself does the deed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਲੀ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak chaanan gur mile dukh bikh jaalee naai ||2||
english: O Nanak, receiving the Divine Light from the Guru, suffering and corruption are burnt away, through the Name. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਿ ਨ ਭੁਲੁ ਤੂ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਰਖਾ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa vekh na bhul too manamukh moorakhaa ||
english: Don't be fooled by gazing at the riches of Maya, you foolish self-willed manmukh.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਲਖਾ ॥
transliteration: chaladiaa naal na chalaee sabh jhooth darab lakhaa ||
english: It shall not go along with you when you must depart; all the wealth you see is false.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਈ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਮ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਲਖਾ ॥
transliteration: agiaanee a(n)dh na boojhaee sir oopar jam khaRag kalakhaa ||
english: The blind and ignorant do not understand, that the sword of death is hanging over their heads.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਾ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee ubare jin har ras chakhaa ||
english: By Guru's Grace, those who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord are saved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap karaae kare aap aape har rakhaa ||3||
english: He Himself is the Doer, and He Himself is the Cause; the Lord Himself is our Saving Grace. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਭੈ ਕੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: jinaa gur nahee bhetiaa bhai kee naahee bi(n)d ||
english: Those who do not meet with the Guru, who have no Fear of God at all,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਚਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaavan dukh ghanaa kade na chookai chi(n)d ||
english: continue coming and going in reincarnation, and suffer terrible pain; their anxiety is never relieved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਪੜ ਜਿਵੈ ਪਛੋੜੀਐ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਘੜੀਆਲੁ ॥
transliteration: kaapaR jivai pachhoReeai ghaRee muhat ghaReeaal ||
english: They are beaten like clothes being washed on the rocks, and struck every hour like chimes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਰਹੁ ਨ ਚੁਕੈ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sache naam bin sirahu na chukai ja(n)jaal ||1||
english: O Nanak, without the True Name, these entanglements are not removed from hanging over one's head. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਢੂਢੀ ਸਜਣਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਬੁਰੀ ਜਗਤਿ ॥
transliteration: tribhavan dhoodhee sajanaa haumai buree jagat ||
english: I have searched throughout the three worlds, O my friend; egotism is bad for the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਝੁਰੁ ਹੀਅੜੇ ਸਚੁ ਚਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naa jhur heeaRe sach chau naanak sacho sach ||2||
english: Don't worry, O my soul; speak the Truth, O Nanak, the Truth, and only the Truth. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: guramukh aape bakhasion har naam samaane ||
english: The Lord Himself forgives the Gurmukhs; they are absorbed and immersed in the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: aape bhagatee laaion gur sabad neesaane ||
english: He Himself links them to devotional worship; they bear the Insignia of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: sanamukh sadaa sohane sachai dar jaane ||
english: Those who turn towards the Guru, as sunmukh, are beautiful. They are famous in the Court of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਪਛਾਣੇ ॥
transliteration: aithai othai mukat hai jin raam pachhaane ||
english: In this world, and in the world hereafter, they are liberated; they realize the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n se jan jin har seviaa tin hau kurabaane ||4||
english: Blessed, blessed are those humble beings who serve the Lord. I am a sacrifice to them. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲ ਕੁਚਜੀ ਮੜਵੜੀ ਕਾਲੀ ਮਨਹੁ ਕਸੁਧ ॥
transliteration: mahal kuchajee maRavaRee kaalee manahu kasudh ||
english: The rude, ill-mannered bride is encased in the body-tomb; she is blackened, and her mind is impure.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੁੰਧ ॥੧॥
transliteration: je gun hovan taa pir ravai naanak avagun mu(n)dh ||1||
english: She can enjoy her Husband Lord, only if she is virtuous. O Nanak, the soul-bride is unworthy, and without virtue. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਸੀਲ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: saach seel sach sa(n)jamee saa pooree paravaar ||
english: She has good conduct, true self-discipline, and a perfect family.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਦਾ ਭਲੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak ahinis sadaa bhalee pir kai het piaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, day and night, she is always good; she loves her Beloved Husband Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aapanaa aap pachhaaniaa naam nidhaan paaiaa ||
english: One who realizes his own self, is blessed with the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kirapaa kar kai aapanee gur sabad milaaiaa ||
english: Granting His Mercy, the Guru merges him in the Word of His Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur kee baanee niramalee har ras peeaaiaa ||
english: The Word of the Guru's Bani is immaculate and pure; through it, one drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har ras jinee chaakhiaa an ras thaak rahaaiaa ||
english: Those who taste the sublime essence of the Lord, forsake other flavors.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: har ras pee sadaa tripat bhae phir trisanaa bhukh gavaaiaa ||5||
english: Drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord, they remain satisfied forever; their hunger and thirst are quenched. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਖੁਸੀਏ ਧਨ ਰਾਵੀਏ ਧਨ ਉਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: pir khuseee dhan raaveee dhan ur naam seegaar ||
english: Her Husband Lord is pleased, and He enjoys His bride; the soul-bride adorns her heart with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨ ਆਗੈ ਖੜੀ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak dhan aagai khaRee sobhaava(n)tee naar ||1||
english: O Nanak, that bride who stands before Him, is the most noble and respected woman. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sasurai peeeai ka(n)t kee ka(n)t aga(n)m athaahu ||
english: In her father-in-law's home hereafter, and in her parents' home in this world, she belongs to her Husband Lord. Her Husband is inaccessible and unfathomable.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak dha(n)n souhaaganee jo bhaavahi veparavaah ||2||
english: O Nanak, she is the happy soul-bride, who is pleasing to her carefree, independent Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਖਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੋ ਬਹੈ ਜਿ ਤਖਤੈ ਲਾਇਕ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: takhat raajaa so bahai j takhatai laaik hoee ||
english: That king sits upon the throne, who is worthy of that throne.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਜੇ ਸੇਈ ॥
transliteration: jinee sach pachhaaniaa sach raaje seee ||
english: Those who realize the True Lord, they alone are the true kings.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹਿ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: ehi bhoopat raaje na aakheeahi doojai bhaai dukh hoee ||
english: These mere earthly rulers are not called kings; in the love of duality, they suffer.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਾਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: keetaa kiaa saalaaheeai jis jaade bilam na hoee ||
english: Why should someone praise someone else who is also created? They depart in no time at all.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: nihachal sachaa ek hai guramukh boojhai s nihachal hoee ||6||
english: The One True Lord is eternal and imperishable. One who, as Gurmukh, understands becomes eternal as well. ||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa kaa pir ek hai pir bin khaalee naahi ||
english: The One Lord is the Husband of all. No one is without the Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak se sohaaganee j satigur maahi samaahi ||1||
english: O Nanak, they are the pure soul-brides, who merge in the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਅਧਿਕ ਤਰੰਗ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥
transliteration: man ke adhik tara(n)g kiu dar saahib chhuteeai ||
english: The mind is churning with so many waves of desire. How can one be emancipated in the Court of the Lord?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਰਾਚੈ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੂੜੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
transliteration: je raachai sach ra(n)g gooRai ra(n)g apaar kai ||
english: Be absorbed in the Lord's True Love, and imbued with the deep color of the Lord's Infinite Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਜੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਗੈ ਸਚਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak gur parasaadee chhuteeai je chit lagai sach ||2||
english: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, one is emancipated, if the consciousness is attached to the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: har kaa naam amol hai kiu keemat keejai ||
english: The Name of the Lord is priceless. How can its value be estimated?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: aape srisat sabh saajeean aape varateejai ||
english: He Himself created the entire universe, and He Himself is pervading it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sadaa salaaheeai sach keemat keejai ||
english: The Gurmukhs praise the Lord forever, and through the Truth, they assess Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿਆ ਇਵ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee kamal bigaasiaa iv har ras peejai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the heart-lotus blossoms forth, and in this way, one drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਠਾਕਿਆ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਵੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa thaakiaa sukh sahaj saveejai ||7||
english: Coming and going in reincarnation ceases, and one sleeps in peace and poise. ||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮੈਲਾ ਨਾ ਧੁੰਧਲਾ ਨਾ ਭਗਵਾ ਨਾ ਕਚੁ ॥
transliteration: naa mailaa naa dhu(n)dhalaa naa bhagavaa naa kach ||
english: Neither dirty, nor dull, nor saffron, nor any color that fades.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਲੋ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਰਤਾ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak laalo laal hai sachai rataa sach ||1||
english: O Nanak, crimson - deep crimson is the color of one who is imbued with the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਵਣਸਪਤਿ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਭਵਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਭੈ ਖੰਡਿ ॥
transliteration: sahaj vanasapat phul phal bhavar vasai bhai kha(n)d ||
english: The bumble bee intuitively and fearlessly dwells among the vegetation, flowers and fruits.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕੋ ਫੁਲੁ ਭਿਰੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak taravar ek hai eko phul bhira(n)g ||2||
english: O Nanak, there is only one tree, one flower, and one bumble bee. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਲੂਝਹਿ ਮਨੈ ਸਿਉ ਸੇ ਸੂਰੇ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: jo jan loojhahi manai siu se soore paradhaanaa ||
english: Those humble beings who struggle with their minds are brave and distinguished heroes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har setee sadaa mil rahe jinee aap pachhaanaa ||
english: Those who realize their own selves, remain forever united with the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: giaaneeaa kaa ihu mahat hai man maahi samaanaa ||
english: This is the glory of the spiritual teachers, that they remain absorbed in their mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu kaa mahal paaiaa sach laai dhiaanaa ||
english: They attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and focus their meditation on the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਜਗੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਜਿਤਾਨਾ ॥੮॥
transliteration: jin gur parasaadee man jeetiaa jag tinahi jitaanaa ||8||
english: Those who conquer their own minds, by Guru's Grace, conquer the world. ||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਜਗਿ ਭਵਾ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਲੇਉ ॥
transliteration: jogee hovaa jag bhavaa ghar ghar bheekhiaa leu ||
english: If I were to become a Yogi, and wander around the world, begging from door to door,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਉਤਰੁ ਦੇਉ ॥
transliteration: daragah lekhaa ma(n)geeai kis kis utar deu ||
english: then, when I am summoned to the Court of the Lord, what answer could I give?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਮੜੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: bhikhiaa naam sa(n)tokh maRee sadaa sach hai naal ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the charity I beg for; contentment is my temple. The True Lord is always with me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੇਖੀ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਧੀਆ ਸਭ ਬਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: bhekhee haath na ladheeaa sabh badhee jamakaal ||
english: Nothing is obtained by wearing religious robes; all will be seized by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਲਾ ਝੂਠੀਆ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak galaa jhootheeaa sachaa naam samaal ||1||
english: O Nanak, talk is false; contemplate the True Name. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jit dar lekhaa ma(n)geeai so dar sevihu na koi ||
english: Through that door, you will be called to account; do not serve at that door.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aisaa satigur loR lahu jis jevad avar na koi ||
english: Seek and find such a True Guru, who has no equal in His greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tis saranaaee chhooteeai lekhaa ma(n)gai na koi ||
english: In His Sanctuary, one is released, and no one calls him to account.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸਚਾ ਓਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: sach driRaae sach driR sachaa ohu sabad dei ||
english: Truth is implanted within Him, and He implants Truth within others. He bestows the blessing of the True Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: hiradai jis dai sach hai tan man bhee sachaa hoi ||
english: One who has Truth within his heart - his body and mind are also true.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak sachai hukam ma(n)niai sachee vadiaaee dei ||
english: O Nanak, if one submits to the Hukam, the Command of the True Lord God, he is blessed with true glory and greatness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਸੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sache maahi samaavasee jis no nadar karei ||2||
english: He is immersed and merged in the True Lord, who blesses him with His Glance of Grace. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰੇ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: soore ehi na aakheeahi aha(n)kaar marahi dukh paavahi ||
english: They are not called heroes, who die of egotism, suffering in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਨੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਚਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhe aap na pachhaananee doojai pach jaavahi ||
english: The blind ones do not realize their own selves; in the love of duality, they rot.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਕਰੋਧ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝਦੇ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: at karodh siu loojhade agai pichhai dukh paavahi ||
english: They struggle with great anger; here and hereafter, they suffer in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਵੇਦ ਕੂਕਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu aha(n)kaar na bhaavaee ved kook sunaavahi ||
english: The Dear Lord is not pleased by egotism; the Vedas proclaim this clearly.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਸੇ ਵਿਗਤੀ ਗਏ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ॥੯॥
transliteration: aha(n)kaar mue se vigatee gae mar janamahi phir aavahi ||9||
english: Those who die of egotism, shall not find salvation. They die, and are reborn in reincarnation. ||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਗਉ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਊਜਲਾ ਲੋਹੇ ਨਾਵ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kaagau hoi na oojalaa lohe naav na paar ||
english: The crow does not become white, and an iron boat does not float across.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: piram padaarath ma(n)n lai dha(n)n savaaranahaar ||
english: One who puts his faith in the treasure of his Beloved Lord is blessed; he exalts and embellishes others as well.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਊਜਲਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: hukam pachhaanai oojalaa sir kaasat lohaa paar ||
english: One who realizes the Hukam of God's Command - his face is radiant and bright; he floats across, like iron upon wood.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਛੋਡੈ ਭੈ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: trisanaa chhodai bhai vasai naanak karanee saar ||1||
english: Forsake thirst and desire, and abide in the Fear of God; O Nanak, these are the most excellent actions. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਾਰਣ ਜੋ ਗਏ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: maaroo maaran jo gae maar na sakahi gavaar ||
english: The ignorant people who go to the desert to conquer their minds, are not able to conquer them.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak je ihu maareeai gurasabadee veechaar ||
english: O Nanak, if this mind is to be conquered, one must contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: ehu man maariaa naa marai je lochai sabh koi ||
english: This mind is not conquered by conquering it, even though everyone longs to do so.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak man hee kau man maarasee je satigur bhetai soi ||2||
english: O Nanak, the mind itself conquers the mind, if one meets with the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੋਵੈ ਤਰਫਾ ਉਪਾਈਓਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: dovai taraphaa upaaeeon vich sakat siv vaasaa ||
english: He created both sides; Shiva dwells within Shakti (the soul dwells within the material universe).

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਕਤੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: sakatee kinai na paaio phir janam binaasaa ||
english: Through the material universe of Shakti, no one has ever found the Lord; they continue to be born and die in reincarnation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਾਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: gur seviai saat paaeeai jap saas giraasaa ||
english: Serving the Guru, peace is found, meditating on the Lord with every breath and morsel of food.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: simrit saasat sodh dekh ootam har daasaa ||
english: Searching and looking through the Simritees and the Shaastras, I have found that the most sublime person is the slave of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam binaa ko thir nahee naame bal jaasaa ||10||
english: O Nanak, without the Naam, nothing is permanent and stable; I am a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੋਵਾ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਵੇਦ ਪੜਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: hovaa pa(n)dit jotakee ved paRaa mukh chaar ||
english: I might become a Pandit, a religious scholar, or an astrologer, and recite the four Vedas with my mouth;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਮਧੇ ਪੂਜੀਆ ਅਪਣੈ ਚਜਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: nav kha(n)d madhe poojeeaa apanai chaj veechaar ||
english: I might be worshipped throughout the nine regions of the earth for my wisdom and thought;

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਅਖਰੁ ਭੁਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਚਉਕੈ ਭਿਟੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mat sachaa akhar bhul jaai chaukai bhitai na koi ||
english: let me not forget the Word of Truth, that no one can touch my sacred cooking square.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੇ ਚਉਕੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jhoothe chauke naanakaa sachaa eko soi ||1||
english: Such cooking squares are false, O Nanak; only the One Lord is True. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: aap upaae kare aap aape nadar karei ||
english: He Himself creates and He Himself acts; He bestows His Glance of Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape de vadiaaeeaa kahu naanak sachaa soi ||2||
english: He Himself grants glorious greatness; says Nanak, He is the True Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕੰਟਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: ka(n)tak kaal ek hai hor ka(n)tak na soojhai ||
english: Only death is painful; I cannot conceive of anything else as painful.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਫਰਿਓ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: aphario jag mahi varatadaa paapee siu loojhai ||
english: It is unstoppable; it stalks and pervades the world, and fights with the sinners.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਦੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee har bhedeeai har jap har boojhai ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is immersed in the Lord. Meditating on the Lord, one comes to realize the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਜੋ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੂਝੈ ॥
transliteration: so har saranaaee chhuteeai jo man siu joojhai ||
english: He alone is emancipated in the Sanctuary of the Lord, who struggles with his own mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੀਝੈ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: man veechaar har jap kare har daragah seejhai ||11||
english: One who contemplates and meditates on the Lord in his mind, succeeds in the Court of the Lord. ||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚੁ ਕਬੂਲੁ ॥
transliteration: hukam rajaaee saakhatee daragah sach kabool ||
english: Submit to the Will of the Lord Commander; in His Court, only Truth is accepted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗਸੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਭੂਲੁ ॥
transliteration: saahib lekhaa ma(n)gasee duneeaa dekh na bhool ||
english: Your Lord and Master shall call you to account; do not go astray on beholding the world.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦਿਲ ਦਰਵਾਨੀ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਦਿਲੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: dil daravaanee jo kare daravesee dil raas ||
english: One who keeps watch over his heart, and keeps his heart pure, is a dervish, a saintly devotee.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸਕ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: isak muhabat naanakaa lekhaa karate paas ||1||
english: Love and affection, O Nanak, are in the accounts placed before the Creator. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਲਗਉ ਜੋਇ ਮਧੂਕੜਉ ਸਾਰੰਗਪਾਣਿ ਸਬਾਇ ॥
transliteration: alagau joi madhookaRau saara(n)gapaan sabaai ||
english: One who is unattached like the bumble bee, sees the Lord of the world everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਠਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: heerai heeraa bedhiaa naanak ka(n)th subhaai ||2||
english: The diamond of his mind is pierced through with the Diamond of the Lord's Name; O Nanak, his neck is embellished with it. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੁ ਵਿਆਪਦਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh kaal viaapadaa mohi maaiaa laage ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are afflicted by death; they cling to Maya in emotional attachment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾੜਸੀ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਠਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: khin mahi maar pachhaaRasee bhaai doojai thaage ||
english: In an instant, they are thrown to the ground and killed; in the love of duality, they are deluded.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: phir velaa hath na aavaee jam kaa da(n)d laage ||
english: This opportunity shall not come into their hands again; they are beaten by the Messenger of Death with his stick.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: tin jam da(n)d na lagaee jo har liv jaage ||
english: But Death's stick does not even strike those who remain awake and aware in the Love of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਛਡਾਵਣੀ ਸਭ ਤੁਧੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: sabh teree tudh chhadaavanee sabh tudhai laage ||12||
english: All are Yours, and cling to You; only You can save them. ||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਜੋਇ ਅਗਛਮੀ ਦੂਖੁ ਘਨੇਰੋ ਆਥਿ ॥
transliteration: sarabe joi agachhamee dookh ghanero aath ||
english: See the imperishable Lord everywhere; attachment to wealth brings only great pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲਰੁ ਲਾਦਸਿ ਸਰੁ ਲਾਘਣਉ ਲਾਭੁ ਨ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaalar laadas sar laaghanau laabh na poo(n)jee saath ||1||
english: Loaded with dust, you have to cross over the world-ocean; you are not carrying the profit and capital of the Name with you. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੂ ਅਖੁਟਉ ਦਰਬੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: poo(n)jee saachau naam too akhutau darab apaar ||
english: My capital is Your True Name, O Lord; this wealth is inexhaustible and infinite.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਉ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak vakhar niramalau dha(n)n saahu vaapaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, this merchandise is immaculate; blessed is the banker who trades in it. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਰਾਣਿ ਲੈ ਮੋਟਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮਾਣਿ ॥
transliteration: poorab preet piraan lai motau thaakur maan ||
english: Know and enjoy the primal, eternal Love of the Great Lord and Master.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਥੈ ਊਭੈ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਣੁ ਨਾਮਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maathai oobhai jam maarasee naanak melan naam ||3||
english: Blessed with the Naam, O Nanak, you shall strike down the Messenger of Death, and push his face to the ground. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਓਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: aape pi(n)d savaarion vich nav nidh naam ||
english: He Himself has embellished the body, and placed the nine treasures of the Naam within it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: ik aape bharam bhulaaian tin nihaphal kaam ||
english: He confuses some in doubt; fruitless are their actions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: ikanee guramukh bujhiaa har aatam raam ||
english: Some, as Gurmukh, realize their Lord, the Supreme Soul.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
transliteration: ikanee sun kai ma(n)niaa har ootam kaam ||
english: Some listen to the Lord, and obey Him; sublime and exalted are their actions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: a(n)tar har ra(n)g upajiaa gaaiaa har gun naam ||13||
english: Love for the Lord wells up deep within, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name. ||13||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੋਲਤਣਿ ਭੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੇਕੈ ਪਾਧਰ ਹੀਡੁ ॥
transliteration: bholatan bhai man vasai hekai paadhar heed ||
english: The Fear of God abides in the mind of the innocent; this is the straight path to the One Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਡਾਹਪਣਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਤੀਨੇ ਥਾਵ ਭਰੀਡੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: at daahapan dukh ghano teene thaav bhareed ||1||
english: Jealousy and envy bring terrible pain, and one is cursed throughout the three worlds. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਂਦਲੁ ਬੇਦਿ ਸਿ ਬਾਜਣੋ ਘਣੋ ਧੜੀਐ ਜੋਇ ॥
transliteration: maa(n)dal bed s baajano ghano dhaReeai joi ||
english: The drum of the Vedas vibrates, bringing dispute and divisiveness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਬੀਜਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam samaal too beejau avar na koi ||2||
english: O Nanak, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord; there is none except Him. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਹਾਥਾਲਾ ਦੇਖੀਐ ॥
transliteration: saagar gunee athaahu kin haathaalaa dekheeai ||
english: The world-ocean of the three qualities is unfathomably deep; how can its bottom be seen?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵਾ ॥
transliteration: vadaa veparavaahu satigur milai ta paar pavaa ||
english: If I meet with the great, self-sufficient True Guru, then I am carried across.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਝ ਭਰਿ ਦੁਖ ਬਦੁਖ ॥
transliteration: majh bhar dukh badukh ||
english: This ocean is filled up with pain and suffering.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਥੀ ਭੁਖ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak sache naam bin kisai na lathee bhukh ||3||
english: O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's hunger is appeased. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਭਾਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jinee a(n)dar bhaaliaa gur sabad suhaavai ||
english: Those who search their inner beings, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, are exalted and adorned.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛਨਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jo ichhan so paaide har naam dhiaavai ||
english: They obtain what they wish for, meditating on the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: jis no kripaa kare tis gur milai so har gun gaavai ||
english: One who is blessed by God's Grace, meets with the Guru; he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: dharam raai tin kaa mit hai jam mag na paavai ||
english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is his friend; he does not have to walk on the Path of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: har naam dhiaavahi dinas raat har naam samaavai ||14||
english: He meditates on the Lord's Name, day and night; he is absorbed and immersed in the Lord's Name. ||14||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣੀਐ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਮਿਰਤਿ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
transliteration: suneeai ek vakhaaneeai surag mirat paiaal ||
english: Listen to and speak the Name of the One Lord, who permeates the heavens, this world and the nether regions of the underworld.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: hukam na jaaee metiaa jo likhiaa so naal ||
english: The Hukam of His Command cannot be erased; whatever He has written, shall go with the mortal.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਮੂਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਆਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kaun mooaa kaun maarasee kaun aavai kaun jaai ||
english: Who has died, and who kills? Who comes and who goes?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਰਹਸੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaun rahasee naanakaa kis kee surat samaai ||1||
english: Who is enraptured, O Nanak, and whose consciousness merges in the Lord? ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮੁਆ ਮੈ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਪਉਣੁ ਵਹੈ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥
transliteration: hau muaa mai maariaa paun vahai dareeaau ||
english: In egotism, he dies; possessiveness kills him, and the breath flows out like a river.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਥਕੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਨਾਇ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa thakee naanakaa jaa man rataa naai ||
english: Desire is exhausted, O Nanak, only when the mind is imbued with the Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਇਣ ਰਤੇ ਲੋਇਣੀ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: loin rate loinee ka(n)nee surat samaai ||
english: His eyes are imbued with the eyes of the Lord, and his ears ring with celestial consciousness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੀਭ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਚੂਨੜੀ ਰਤੀ ਲਾਲ ਲਵਾਇ ॥
transliteration: jeebh rasaain choonaRee ratee laal lavaai ||
english: His tongue drinks in the sweet nectar, dyed crimson by chanting the Name of the Beloved Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਮੁਸਕਿ ਝਕੋਲਿਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)dar musak jhakoliaa keemat kahee na jaai ||2||
english: His inner being is drenched with the Lord's fragrance; his worth cannot be described. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
transliteration: is jug mahi naam nidhaan hai naamo naal chalai ||
english: In this age, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the treasure. Only the Naam goes along in the end.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟਈ ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿਉ ਪਲੈ ॥
transliteration: ehu akhut kade na nikhutaee khaai kharachiu palai ||
english: It is inexhaustible; it is never empty, no matter how much one may eat, consume or spend.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਜਮਕਲੈ ॥
transliteration: har jan neR na aavaee jamaka(n)kar jamakalai ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach the humble servant of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ॥
transliteration: se saah sache vanajaariaa jin har dhan palai ||
english: They alone are the true bankers and traders, who have the wealth of the Lord in their laps.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਘਲੈ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: har kirapaa te har paaeeai jaa aap har ghalai ||15||
english: By the Lord's Mercy, one finds the Lord, only when the Lord Himself sends for him. ||15||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਾਪਾਰੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਵਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਹਿ ਬਿਖ ਸਿਉ ਧਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: manamukh vaapaarai saar na jaananee bikh vihaajhahi bikh sa(n)grahahi bikh siu dharahi piaar ||
english: The self-willed manmukh does not appreciate the excellence of trading in Truth. He deals in poison, collects poison, and is in love with poison.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸਦਾਇਦੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
transliteration: baaharahu pa(n)dit sadaaide manahu moorakh gaavaar ||
english: Outwardly, they call themselves Pandits, religious scholars, but in their minds they are foolish and ignorant.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਨੀ ਵਾਦੀ ਧਰਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har siu chit na laainee vaadee dharan piaar ||
english: They do not focus their consciousness on the Lord; they love to engage in arguments.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਵਾਦਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਨਿ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: vaadaa keeaa karan kahaaneeaa kooR bol karahi aahaar ||
english: They speak to cause arguments, and earn their living by telling lies.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: jag mahi raam naam har niramalaa hor mailaa sabh aakaar ||
english: In this world, only the Lord's Name is immaculate and pure. All other objects of creation are polluted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak naam na chetanee hoi maile marahi gavaar ||1||
english: O Nanak, those who do not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are polluted; they die in ignorance. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh lagaa bin seviai hukam ma(n)ne dukh jaai ||
english: Without serving the Lord, he suffers in pain; accepting the Hukam of God's Command, pain is gone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੁਖੈ ਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: aape daataa sukhai daa aape dei sajaai ||
english: He Himself is the Giver of peace; He Himself awards punishment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak evai jaaneeai sabh kichh tisai rajaai ||2||
english: O Nanak, know this well; all that happens is according to His Will. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: har naam binaa jagat hai niradhan bin naavai tripat naahee ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, the world is poor. Without the Name, no one is satisfied.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: doojai bharam bhulaaiaa haumai dukh paahee ||
english: He is deluded by duality and doubt. In egotism, he suffers in pain.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੋਚਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: bin karamaa kichhoo na paaeeai je bahut lochaahee ||
english: Without good karma, he does not obtain anything, no matter how much he may wish for it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੰਮੈ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਛੁਟਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: aavai jaai ja(n)mai marai gur sabad chhutaahee ||
english: Coming and going in reincarnation, and birth and death are ended, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: aap karai kis aakheeai doojaa ko naahee ||16||
english: He Himself acts, so unto whom should we complain? There is no other at all. ||16||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਤੀ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: is jag mahi sa(n)tee dhan khatiaa jinaa satigur miliaa prabh aai ||
english: In this world, the Saints earn the wealth; they come to meet God through the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: satigur sach driRaaiaa is dhan kee keemat kahee na jaai ||
english: The True Guru implants the Truth within; the value of this wealth cannot be described.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਧਨਿ ਪਾਇਐ ਭੁਖ ਲਥੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: it dhan paaiai bhukh lathee sukh vasiaa man aai ||
english: Obtaining this wealth, hunger is relieved, and peace comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਨੑਾ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: ji(n)nhaa kau dhur likhiaa tinee paaiaa aai ||
english: Only those who have such pre-ordained destiny, come to receive this.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh jagat niradhan hai maaiaa no bilalaai ||
english: The world of the self-willed manmukh is poor, crying out for Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਫਿਰਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: anadin phiradaa sadaa rahai bhukh na kade jaai ||
english: Night and day, it wanders continually, and its hunger is never relieved.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਆਵਈ ਨਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: saa(n)t na kade aavaee nah sukh vasai man aai ||
english: It never finds calm tranquility, and peace never comes to dwell in its mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਚਿੰਤ ਚਿਤਵਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: sadaa chi(n)t chitavadaa rahai sahasaa kade na jaai ||
english: It is always plagued by anxiety, and its cynicism never departs.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਭਵੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: naanak vin satigur mat bhavee satigur no milai taa sabad kamaai ||
english: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the intellect is perverted; if one meets the True Guru, then one practices the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sadaa sadaa sukh mahi rahai sache maahi samaai ||1||
english: Forever and ever, he dwells in peace, and merges in the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: jin upaaee medanee soee saar karei ||
english: The One who created the world, takes care of it.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਭਾਇਰਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: eko simarahu bhaairahu tis bin avar na koi ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the One Lord, O Siblings of Destiny; there is none other than Him.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਾਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: khaanaa sabad cha(n)giaaeeaa jit khaadhai sadaa tripat hoi ||
english: So eat the food of the Shabad and goodness; eating it, you shall remain satisfied forever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੈਨਣੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਇ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਓਹੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: painan siphat sanaai hai sadaa sadaa ohu oojalaa mailaa kade na hoi ||
english: Dress yourself in the Praise of the Lord. Forever and ever, it is radiant and bright; it is never polluted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਥੋੜਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sahaje sach dhan khatiaa thoRaa kade na hoi ||
english: I have intuitively earned the true wealth, which never decreases.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਨੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dehee no sabad seegaar hai jit sadaa sadaa sukh hoi ||
english: The body is adorned with the Shabad, and is at peace forever and ever.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh bujheeai jis no aap vikhaale soi ||2||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Lord, who reveals Himself. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar jap tap sa(n)jamo gurasabadee jaapai ||
english: Deep within the self are meditation and austere self-discipline, when one realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: har har naam dhiaaeeai haumai agiaan gavaapai ||
english: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, egotism and ignorance are eliminated.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹੈ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar a(n)mrit bharapoor hai chaakhiaa saad jaapai ||
english: One's inner being is overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar; tasting it, the flavor is known.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: jin chaakhiaa se nirabhau bhae se har ras dhraapai ||
english: Those who taste it become fearless; they are satisfied with the sublime essence of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਪੀਆਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: har kirapaa dhaar peeaaiaa phir kaal na viaapai ||17||
english: Those who drink it in, by the Grace of the Lord, are never again afflicted by death. ||17||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਲੋਕੁ ਅਵਗਣਾ ਕੀ ਬੰਨੑੈ ਗੰਠੜੀ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਵਿਹਾਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: lok avaganaa kee ba(n)nhai ga(n)thaRee gun na vihaajhai koi ||
english: People tie up bundles of demerits; no one deals in virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: gun kaa gaahak naanakaa viralaa koee hoi ||
english: Rare is that person, O Nanak, who purchases virtue.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਈਅਨੑਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee gun paaeeanhi jis no nadar karei ||1||
english: By Guru's Grace, one is blessed with virtue, when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਹਹਿ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: gun avagun samaan hahi j aap keete karataar ||
english: Merits and demerits are the same; they are both created by the Creator.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak hukam ma(n)niai sukh paaeeai gurasabadee veechaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, one who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, finds peace, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar raajaa takhat hai aape kare niaau ||
english: The King sits on the throne within the self; He Himself administers justice.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਦਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gurasabadee dar jaaneeai a(n)dar mahal asaraau ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord's Court is known; within the self is the Sanctuary, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਖੋਟਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
transliteration: khare parakh khajaanai paaeean khotiaa naahee thaau ||
english: The coins are assayed, and the genuine coins are placed in His treasury, while the counterfeit ones find no place.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
transliteration: sabh sacho sach varatadaa sadaa sach niaau ||
english: The Truest of the True is all-pervading; His justice is forever True.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਉ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit kaa ras aaiaa man vasiaa naau ||18||
english: One comes to enjoy the Ambrosial essence, when the Name is enshrined in the mind. ||18||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
english: Salok, First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮੈ ਕਰੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਹਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: hau mai karee taa(n) too naahee too hovahi hau naahi ||
english: When one acts in egotism, then You are not there, Lord. Wherever You are, there is no ego.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੂਝਣਾ ਏਹ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: boojhahu giaanee boojhanaa eh akath kathaa man maahi ||
english: O spiritual teachers, understand this: the Unspoken Speech is in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਲਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bin gur tat na paaeeai alakh vasai sabh maahi ||
english: Without the Guru, the essence of reality is not found; the Invisible Lord dwells everywhere.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: satigur milai ta jaaneeai jaa(n) sabad vasai man maahi ||
english: One meets the True Guru, and then the Lord is known, when the Word of the Shabad comes to dwell in the mind.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: aap gaiaa bhram bhau gaiaa janam maran dukh jaahi ||
english: When self-conceit departs, doubt and fear also depart, and the pain of birth and death is removed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈਐ ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ ਤਰਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: guramat alakh lakhaaeeai ootam mat taraahi ||
english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Unseen Lord is seen; the intellect is exalted, and one is carried across.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹੰ ਹੰਸਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਤਿਸੈ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak soha(n) ha(n)saa jap jaapahu tribhavan tisai samaahi ||1||
english: O Nanak, chant the chant of 'Sohang hansaa' - 'He is me, and I am Him.' The three worlds are absorbed in Him. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਰਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man maanak jin parakhiaa gurasabadee veechaar ||
english: Some assay their mind-jewel, and contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਕਲਜੁਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: se jan virale jaaneeahi kalajug vich sa(n)saar ||
english: Only a few of those humble beings are known in this world, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਨੋ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aapai no aap mil rahiaa haumai dubidhaa maar ||
english: One's self remains blended with the Lord's Self, when egotism and duality are conquered.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate dutar tare bhaujal bikham sa(n)saar ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam cross over the difficult, treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਨੀ ਮੁਠੇ ਅਹੰਮਤੇ ॥
transliteration: manamukh a(n)dar na bhaalanee muthe aha(n)mate ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs do not search within their own selves; they are deluded by their egotistical pride.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾਂ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਿਖ ਤਤੇ ॥
transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa(n) bhav thake a(n)dar tikh tate ||
english: Wandering in the four directions, they grow weary, tormented by burning desire within.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਨ ਸੋਧਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ॥
transliteration: si(n)mrit saasat na sodhanee manamukh vigute ||
english: They do not study the Simritees and the Shaastras; the manmukhs waste away and are lost.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਤੇ ॥
transliteration: bin gur kinai na paaio har naam har sate ||
english: Without the Guru, no one finds the Naam, the Name of the True Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਤੇ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: tat giaan veechaariaa har jap har gate ||19||
english: One who contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom and meditates on the Lord is saved. ||19||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
english: Salok, Second Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਣੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: aape jaanai kare aap aape aanai raas ||
english: He Himself knows, He Himself acts, and He Himself does it right.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੈ ਅਗੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਖਲਿਇ ਕੀਚੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tisai agai naanakaa khalii keechai aradaas ||1||
english: So stand before Him, O Nanak, and offer your prayers. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 1 ||
english: First Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: jin keeaa tin dekhiaa aape jaanai soi ||
english: He who created the creation, watches over it; He Himself knows.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਾ ਘਰਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kis no kaheeai naanakaa jaa ghar varatai sabh koi ||2||
english: Unto whom should I speak, O Nanak, when everything is contained within the home of the heart? ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sabhe thok visaar iko mit kar ||
english: Forget everything, and be friends with the One Lord alone.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਪਾਪਾ ਦਹੈ ਹਰਿ ॥
transliteration: man tan hoi nihaal paapaa dahai har ||
english: Your mind and body shall be enraptured, and the Lord shall burn away your sins.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਚੁਕੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਮਰਿ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa chukai janam na jaahi mar ||
english: Your comings and goings in reincarnation shall cease; you shall not be reborn and die again.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਸੋਗਿ ਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਰਿ ॥
transliteration: sach naam aadhaar sog na mohi jar ||
english: The True Name shall be your Support, and you shall not burn in sorrow and attachment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਜਿ ਧਰਿ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: naanak naam nidhaan man mahi sa(n)j dhar ||20||
english: O Nanak, gather in the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your mind. ||20||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਦੰਮਾ ਦੰਮ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa manahu na veesarai maa(n)gai da(n)maa da(n)m ||
english: You do not forget Maya from your mind; you beg for it with each and every breath.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਕਰੰਮ ॥੧॥
transliteration: so prabh chit na aavaee naanak nahee kara(n)m ||1||
english: You do not even think of that God; O Nanak, it is not in your karma. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਕਿਆ ਲਪਟਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਧ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa saath na chalaee kiaa lapataavahi a(n)dh ||
english: Maya and its wealth shall not go along with you, so why do you cling to it - are you blind?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧ ॥੨॥
transliteration: gur ke charan dhiaai too tootahi maaiaa ba(n)dh ||2||
english: Meditate on the Guru's Feet, and the bonds of Maya shall be cut away from you. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਇਓਨੁ ਭਾਣੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai hukam manaaion bhaanai sukh paaiaa ||
english: By the Pleasure of His Will, the Lord inspires us to obey the Hukam of His Command; by the Pleasure of His Will, we find peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿਓਨੁ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaanai satigur melion bhaanai sach dhiaaiaa ||
english: By the Pleasure of His Will, He leads us to meet the True Guru; by the Pleasure of His Will, we meditate on the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੇ ਜੇਵਡ ਹੋਰ ਦਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bhaane jevad hor daat naahee sach aakh sunaaiaa ||
english: There is no other gift as great as the Pleasure of His Will; this Truth is spoken and proclaimed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin sach kamaaiaa ||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, practice and live the Truth.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: naanak tis saranaagatee jin jagat upaaiaa ||21||
english: Nanak has entered His Sanctuary; He created the world. ||21||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
english: Salok, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੈ ਕੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
