transliteration: jin kau a(n)dar giaan nahee bhai kee naahee bi(n)d ||
english: Those who do not have spiritual wisdom within, do not have even an iota of the Fear of God.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਇਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਰਣਾ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak muiaa kaa kiaa maaranaa j aap maare govi(n)d ||1||
english: O Nanak, why kill those who are already dead? The Lord of the Universe Himself has killed them. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
transliteration: mah 3 ||
english: Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਤ੍ਰੀ ਵਾਚਣੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: man kee patree vaachanee sukhee hoo sukh saar ||
english: To read the horoscope of the mind, is the most sublime joyful peace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਭਲਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: so braahaman bhalaa aakheeai j boojhai braham beechaar ||
english: He alone is called a good Brahmin, who understands God in contemplative meditation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਪੜੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: har saalaahe har paRai gur kai sabad veechaar ||
english: He praises the Lord, and reads of the Lord, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਓਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਕੁਲ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aaiaa ohu paravaan hai j kul kaa kare udhaar ||
english: Celebrated and approved is the coming into the world of such a person, who saves all his generations as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: agai jaat na puchheeai karanee sabad hai saar ||
english: Hereafter, no one is questioned about social status; excellent and sublime is the practice of the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਪੜਣਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: hor kooR paRanaa kooR kamaavanaa bikhiaa naal piaar ||
english: Other study is false, and other actions are false; such people are in love with poison.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dar sukh na hovaee manamukh janam khuaar ||
english: They do not find any peace within themselves; the self-willed manmukhs waste away their lives.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak naam rate se ubare gur kai het apaar ||2||
english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are saved; they have infinite love for the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਸਚਾ ॥
transliteration: aape kar kar vekhadaa aape sabh sachaa ||
english: He Himself creates the creation, and gazes upon it; He Himself is totally True.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਕਚਾ ॥
transliteration: jo hukam na boojhai khasam kaa soee nar kachaa ||
english: One who does not understand the Hukam, the Command of his Lord and Master, is false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ॥
transliteration: jit bhaavai tit laaidaa guramukh har sachaa ||
english: By the Pleasure of His Will, the True Lord joins the Gurmukh to Himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਰਚਾ ॥
transliteration: sabhanaa kaa saahib ek hai gurasabadee rachaa ||
english: He is the One Lord and Master of all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are blended with Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਦੇ ਜਚਾ ॥
transliteration: guramukh sadaa salaaheeai sabh tis de jachaa ||
english: The Gurmukhs praise Him forever; all are beggars of Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਨਚਾਇਦਾ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਨਚਾ ॥੨੨॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
transliteration: jiu naanak aap nachaaidaa tiv hee ko nachaa ||22||1|| sudh ||
english: O Nanak, as He Himself makes us dance, we dance. ||22||1|| Sudh||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: maaroo vaar mahalaa 5 ||
english: Vaar Of Maaroo, Fifth Mehl,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਚਉ ਸਜਣ ਮੈਡਿਆ ਡੇਈ ਸਿਸੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: too chau sajan maidiaa deee sis utaar ||
english: If You tell me to, O my Friend, I will cut off my head and give it to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਣ ਮਹਿੰਜੇ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਕਦਿ ਪਸੀ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nain mahi(n)je tarasade kad pasee deedaar ||1||
english: My eyes long for You; when will I see Your Vision? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੀਹੁ ਮਹਿੰਜਾ ਤਊ ਨਾਲਿ ਬਿਆ ਨੇਹ ਕੂੜਾਵੇ ਡੇਖੁ ॥
transliteration: neehu mahi(n)jaa taoo naal biaa neh kooRaave dekh ||
english: I am in love with You; I have seen that other love is false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਡਰਾਵਣੇ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਪਿਰੀ ਨ ਡੇਖੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kapaR bhog daraavane jichar piree na dekh ||2||
english: Even clothes and food are frightening to me, as long as I do not see my Beloved. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਠੀ ਝਾਲੂ ਕੰਤੜੇ ਹਉ ਪਸੀ ਤਉ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: uthee jhaaloo ka(n)taRe hau pasee tau deedaar ||
english: I rise early, O my Husband Lord, to behold Your Vision.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜਲੁ ਹਾਰੁ ਤਮੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਸੇ ਹਭਿ ਰਸ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kaajal haar tamol ras bin pase habh ras chhaar ||3||
english: Eye make-up, garlands of flowers, and the flavor of betel leaf, are all nothing but dust, without seeing You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: too sachaa saahib sach sach sabh dhaariaa ||
english: You are True, O my True Lord and Master; You uphold all that is true.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਤੋ ਥਾਟੁ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: guramukh keeto thaat siraj sa(n)saariaa ||
english: You created the world, making a place for the Gurmukhs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਹੋਏ ਬੇਦ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har aagiaa hoe bed paap pu(n)n veechaariaa ||
english: By the Will of the Lord, the Vedas came into being; they discriminate between sin and virtue.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes trai gun bisathaariaa ||
english: You created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, and the expanse of the three qualities.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਸਾਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: nav kha(n)d prithamee saaj har ra(n)g savaariaa ||
english: Creating the world of the nine regions, O Lord, You have embellished it with beauty.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੇਕੀ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਲ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: vekee ja(n)t upaai a(n)tar kal dhaariaa ||
english: Creating the beings of various kinds, You infused Your power into them.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: teraa a(n)t na jaanai koi sach sirajanahaariaa ||
english: No one knows Your limit, O True Creator Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too jaanahi sabh bidh aap guramukh nisataariaa ||1||
english: You Yourself know all ways and means; You Yourself save the Gurmukhs. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਸਾਡੜਾ ਹਿਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਾ ਵੇਛੋੜਿ ॥
transliteration: je too mitr asaadaRaa hik bhoree naa vechhoR ||
english: If You are my friend, then don't separate Yourself from me, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਮਹਿੰਜਾ ਤਉ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਦਿ ਪਸੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jeeu mahi(n)jaa tau mohiaa kad pasee jaanee tohi ||1||
english: My soul is fascinated and enticed by You; when will I see You, O my Love? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਤੂ ਜਲੁ ਭਾਹੜੀ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: durajan too jal bhaahaRee vichhoRe mar jaahi ||
english: Burn in the fire, you evil person; O separation, be dead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੰਤਾ ਤੂ ਸਉ ਸੇਜੜੀ ਮੈਡਾ ਹਭੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਉਲਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ka(n)taa too sau sejaRee maidaa habho dukh ulaahi ||2||
english: O my Husband Lord, please sleep upon my bed, that all my sufferings may be gone. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਜਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: durajan doojaa bhaau hai vechhoRaa haumai rog ||
english: The evil person is engrossed in the love of duality; through the disease of egotism, he suffers separation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਜਣੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sajan sachaa paatisaahu jis mil keechai bhog ||3||
english: The True Lord King is my friend; meeting with Him, I am so happy. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
transliteration: too agam daiaal bea(n)t teree keemat kahai kaun ||
english: You are inaccessible, merciful and infinite; who can estimate Your worth?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਿਰਜਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਤੂ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਸਗਲ ਭਉਣ ॥
transliteration: tudh sirajiaa sabh sa(n)saar too naaik sagal bhaun ||
english: You created the entire universe; You are the Master of all the worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਗਲ ਰਉਣ ॥
transliteration: teree kudarat koi na jaanai mere thaakur sagal raun ||
english: No one knows Your creative power, O my all-pervading Lord and Master.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤੂ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਜਗ ਉਧਰਣ ॥
transliteration: tudh apaR koi na sakai too abinaasee jag udharan ||
english: No one can equal You; You are imperishable and eternal, the Savior of the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਥਾਪੇ ਚਾਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਧਰਣ ॥
transliteration: tudh thaape chaare jug too karataa sagal dharan ||
english: You established the four ages; You are the Creator of all worlds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ॥
transliteration: tudh aavan jaanaa keeaa tudh lep na lagai trin ||
english: You created the comings and goings of reincarnation; not even a particle of filth sticks to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ॥
transliteration: jis hovahi aap daiaal tis laavahi satigur charan ||
english: As you are merciful, You attach us to the Feet of the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਲਭਹੀ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਣ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too horat upaai na labhahee abinaasee srisat karan ||2||
english: You cannot be found by any other efforts; You are the eternal, imperishable Creator of the Universe. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਵਤਹਿ ਅੰਙਣੇ ਹਭ ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: je too vatahi a(n)ngane habh dharat suhaavee hoi ||
english: If You come into my courtyard, all the earth becomes beautiful.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਕਸੁ ਕੰਤੈ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਮੈਡੀ ਵਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hikas ka(n)tai baaharee maidee vaat na puchhai koi ||1||
english: Other than the One Lord, my Husband, no one else cares for me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਭੇ ਟੋਲ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਸਹੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਅੰਙਣੁ ਮਲਿ ॥
transliteration: habhe tol suhaavane sahu baithaa a(n)ngan mal ||
english: All my adornments become beautiful, when You, O Lord, sit in my courtyard and make it Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਹੀ ਨ ਵੰਞੈ ਬਿਰਥੜਾ ਜੋ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਚਲਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pahee na va(n)njai birathaRaa jo ghar aavai chal ||2||
english: Then no traveller who comes to my home shall leave empty-handed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ਕੰਤ ਕੂ ਕੀਆ ਹਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sej vichhaaee ka(n)t koo keeaa habh seegaar ||
english: I have spread out my bed for You, O my Husband Lord, and applied all my decorations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਤੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਨ ਸਮਾਵਈ ਜੇ ਗਲਿ ਪਹਿਰਾ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: itee ma(n)jh na samaavaee je gal pahiraa haar ||3||
english: But even this is not pleasing to me, to wear a garland around my neck. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: too paarabraham paramesar jon na aavahee ||
english: O Supreme Lord God, O Transcendent Lord, You do not take birth.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਾਜਹਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: too hukamee saajahi srisat saaj samaavahee ||
english: By the Hukam of Your Command, You formed the Universe; forming it, You merge into it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: teraa roop na jaaee lakhiaa kiu tujhahi dhiaavahee ||
english: Your Form cannot be known; how can one meditate on You?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਦੇਖਾਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: too sabh mahi varatahi aap kudarat dekhaavahee ||
english: You are pervading and permeating all; You Yourself reveal Your creative potency.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: teree bhagat bhare bha(n)daar tot na aavahee ||
english: Your treasures of devotional worship are overflowing; they never decrease.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: ehi ratan javehar laal keem na paavahee ||
english: These gems, jewels and diamonds - their value cannot be estimated.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਵਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jis hovahi aap daiaal tis satigur sevaa laavahee ||
english: As You Yourself become merciful, Lord, You link us to the service of the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tis kade na aavai tot jo har gun gaavahee ||3||
english: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, never suffers any deficiency. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਮੂ ਪਸੀ ਹਠ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੀ ਮਹਿਜੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: jaa moo pasee hath mai piree mahijai naal ||
english: When I look within my being, I find that my Beloved is with me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਭੇ ਡੁਖ ਉਲਾਹਿਅਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: habhe dukh ulaahiam naanak nadar nihaal ||1||
english: All pains are relieved, O Nanak, when He bestows His Glance of Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੈਠਾ ਭਖੇ ਵਾਉ ਲੰਮੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਦਰੁ ਖੜਾ ॥
transliteration: naanak baithaa bhakhe vaau la(n)me sevahi dar khaRaa ||
english: Nanak sits, waiting for news of the Lord, and stands at the Lord's Door; serving Him for so long.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੀਏ ਤੂ ਜਾਣੁ ਮਹਿਜਾ ਸਾਉ ਜੋਈ ਸਾਈ ਮੁਹੁ ਖੜਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pireee too jaan mahijaa saau joee saaee muhu khaRaa ||2||
english: O my Beloved, only You know my objective; I stand, waiting to see the Lord's face. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਗਾਲਾਇਓ ਭੂਛ ਪਰ ਵੇਲਿ ਨ ਜੋਹੇ ਕੰਤ ਤੂ ॥
transliteration: kiaa gaalaaio bhoochh par vel na johe ka(n)t too ||
english: What should I say to you, you fool? Don't look at the vines of others - be a true husband.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਫੁਲਾ ਸੰਦੀ ਵਾੜਿ ਖਿੜਿਆ ਹਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਜਿਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak phulaa sa(n)dee vaaR khiRiaa habh sa(n)saar jiu ||3||
english: O Nanak, the entire world is blooming, like a garden of flowers. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sughaR sujaan saroop too sabh mahi varata(n)taa ||
english: You are Wise, all-knowing and beautiful; You are pervading and permeating all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਜੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: too aape thaakur sevako aape pooja(n)taa ||
english: You Yourself are the Lord and Master, and the servant; You worship and adore Yourself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਤਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: daanaa beenaa aap too aape satava(n)taa ||
english: You are all-wise and all-seeing; You Yourself are true and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jatee satee prabh niramalaa mere har bhagava(n)taa ||
english: The Immaculate Lord, my Lord God, is celibate and True.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਓ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh braham pasaar pasaario aape khela(n)taa ||
english: God spreads out the expanse of the entire universe, and He Himself plays in it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣੁ ਰਚਾਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਦੇਖੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: ihu aavaa gavan rachaaio kar choj dekha(n)taa ||
english: He created this coming and going of reincarnation; creating the wondrous play, He gazes upon it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
transliteration: tis baahuR garabh na paavahee jis devahi gur ma(n)taa ||
english: One who is blessed with the Guru's Teachings, is not consigned to the womb of reincarnation, ever again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਚਲਦੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਜੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: jiu aap chalaavahi tiu chalade kichh vas na ja(n)taa ||4||
english: All walk as He makes them walk; nothing is under the control of the created beings. ||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੁਰੀਏ ਕੁਰੀਏ ਵੈਦਿਆ ਤਲਿ ਗਾੜਾ ਮਹਰੇਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kureee kureee vaidiaa tal gaaRaa maharer ||
english: You are walking along the river-bank, but the land is giving way beneath you.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੇਖੇ ਛਿਟੜਿ ਥੀਵਦੋ ਜਾਮਿ ਖਿਸੰਦੋ ਪੇਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vekhe chhitaR theevado jaam khisa(n)do per ||1||
english: Watch out! Your foot might slip, and you'll fall in and die. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਚੁ ਵੈਦਿਓ ਤੂ ਆਘੂ ਆਘੇ ਸਲਵੇ ॥
transliteration: sach jaanai kach vaidio too aaghoo aaghe salave ||
english: You believe what is false and temporary to be true, and so you run on and on.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਤਸੜੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਨੈਣੂ ਬਿਆ ਢਲਿ ਪਬਣਿ ਜਿਉ ਜੁੰਮਿਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak aatasaRee ma(n)jh nainoo biaa dhal paban jiu ju(n)mio ||2||
english: O Nanak, like butter in the fire, it shall melt away; it shall fade away like the water-lily. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੋਰੇ ਭੋਰੇ ਰੂਹੜੇ ਸੇਵੇਦੇ ਆਲਕੁ ॥
transliteration: bhore bhore roohaRe sevede aalak ||
english: O my foolish and silly soul, why are you too lazy to serve?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਦਤਿ ਪਈ ਚਿਰਾਣੀਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਡੂ ਆਵੈ ਰੁਤਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: mudat paee chiraaneeaa phir kadoo aavai rut ||3||
english: Such a long time has passed. When will this opportunity come again? ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਤਿ ਤੂ ਵਰਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: tudh roop na rekhiaa jaat too varanaa baaharaa ||
english: You have no form or shape, no social class or race.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਤੂ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: e maanas jaanahi door too varatahi jaaharaa ||
english: These humans believe that You are far away; but You are quite obviously apparent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਾਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too sabh ghat bhogahi aap tudh lep na laaharaa ||
english: You enjoy Yourself in every heart, and no filth sticks to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਨੰਦੀ ਅਨੰਤ ਸਭ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too purakh ana(n)dee ana(n)t sabh jot samaaharaa ||
english: You are the blissful and infinite Primal Lord God; Your Light is all-pervading.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਹਿ ਦੇਵ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਨਰਹਰਾ ॥
transliteration: too sabh devaa mahi dev bidhaate naraharaa ||
english: Among all divine beings, You are the most divine, O Creator-architect, Rejuvenator of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਇਕ ਤੂ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਪਰਪਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kiaa aaraadhe jihavaa ik too abinaasee aparaparaa ||
english: How can my single tongue worship and adore You? You are the eternal, imperishable, infinite Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jis melahi satigur aap tis ke sabh kul taraa ||
english: One whom You Yourself unite with the True Guru - all his generations are saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਦੇ ਸੇਵ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sevak sabh karade sev dar naanak jan teraa ||5||
english: All Your servants serve You; Nanak is a humble servant at Your Door. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਡੜੜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਛਾਇਆ ਗਾਫਲ ਜਲਿਓਹੁ ਭਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: gahadaRaRaa trin chhaaiaa gaaphal jaliohu bhaahi ||
english: He builds a hut of straw, and the fool lights a fire in it.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਹੜੈ ਤਿਨ ਉਸਤਾਦ ਪਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jinaa bhaag mathaahaRai tin usataad panaahi ||1||
english: Only those who have such pre-ordained destiny on their foreheads, find Shelter with the Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੀਠਾ ਪਕਾ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਧਰਿਆ ਆਣਿ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ॥
transliteration: naanak peethaa pakaa saajiaa dhariaa aan maujood ||
english: O Nanak, he grinds the corn, cooks it and places it before himself.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਬੈਠਾ ਝਾਕੁ ਦਰੂਦ ॥੨॥
transliteration: baajhahu satigur aapane baithaa jhaak darood ||2||
english: But without his True Guru, he sits and waits for his food to be blessed. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੁਸਰੀਆ ਪਕਾਈਆ ਪਾਈਆ ਥਾਲੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: naanak bhusareeaa pakaaeeaa paaeeaa thaalai maahi ||
english: O Nanak, the loaves of bread are baked and placed on the plate.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਨਾਇਆ ਰਜਿ ਰਜਿ ਸੇਈ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jinee guroo manaaiaa raj raj seee khaahi ||3||
english: Those who obey their Guru, eat and are totally satisfied. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: tudh jag mahi khel rachaaiaa vich haumai paaeeaa ||
english: You have staged this play in the world, and infused egotism into all beings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਹਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ॥
transliteration: ek ma(n)dar pa(n)ch chor hahi nit karahi buriaaeeaa ||
english: In the one temple of the body are the five thieves, who continually misbehave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਨਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਸੇ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋੁਭਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: das naaree ik purakh kar dase saad loubhaaeeaa ||
english: The ten brides, the sensory organs were created, and the one husband, the self; the ten are engrossed in flavors and tastes.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮੋਹੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਭਰਮਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: en maaiaa mohanee moheeaa nit phirahi bharamaaeeaa ||
english: This Maya fascinates and entices them; they wander continually in doubt.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਾਠਾ ਦੋਵੈ ਕੀਤੀਓ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਵਰਤਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: haathaa dovai keeteeo siv sakat varataaeeaa ||
english: You created both sides, spirit and matter, Shiva and Shakti.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਅਗੈ ਸਕਤੀ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਏਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: siv agai sakatee haariaa evai har bhaaeeaa ||
english: Matter loses out to spirit; this is pleasing to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਜੋ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: ik vichahu hee tudh rakhiaa jo satasa(n)g milaaeeaa ||
english: You enshrined spirit within, which leads to merger with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਬਿੰਬੁ ਉਠਾਲਿਓ ਜਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈਆ ॥੬॥
transliteration: jal vichahu bi(n)b uthaalio jal maahi samaaeeaa ||6||
english: Within the bubble, You formed the bubble, which shall once again merge into the water. ||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਗਾਹਾ ਕੂ ਤ੍ਰਾਘਿ ਪਿਛਾ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਮੁਹਡੜਾ ॥
transliteration: aagaahaa koo traagh pichhaa pher na muhadaRaa ||
english: Look ahead; don't turn your face backwards.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਝਿ ਇਵੇਹਾ ਵਾਰ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਜਨਮੜਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sijh ivehaa vaar bahuR na hovee janamaRaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, be successful this time, and you shall not be reincarnated again. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਚਾਈਆ ਹਭ ਕਹੀ ਦਾ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
transliteration: sajan maidaa chaaeeaa habh kahee daa mit ||
english: My joyful friend is called the friend of all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਭੇ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਠਾਹੇ ਚਿਤੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: habhe jaanan aapanaa kahee na thaahe chit ||2||
english: All think of Him as their own; He never breaks anyone's heart. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਝੜਾ ਲਧਮੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਮਥੈ ਹੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਥਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gujhaRaa ladham laal mathai hee paragat thiaa ||
english: The hidden jewel has been found; it has appeared on my forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਪਿਰੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਵੁਠਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: soee suhaavaa thaan jithai pireee naanak jee too vuthiaa ||3||
english: Beautiful and exalted is that place, O Nanak, where You dwell, O my Dear Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੈ ਵਲਿ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹਛੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa too merai val hai taa kiaa muhachha(n)daa ||
english: When You are on my side, Lord, what do I need to worry about?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਨੋ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਜਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਬੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: tudh sabh kichh maino saupiaa jaa teraa ba(n)daa ||
english: You entrusted everything to me, when I became Your slave.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖਮੀ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਰਹੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: lakhamee tot na aavaee khaai kharach raha(n)daa ||
english: My wealth is inexhaustible, no matter how much I spend and consume.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸਭ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh medanee sabh sev kara(n)daa ||
english: The 8.4 million species of beings all work to serve me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਵੈਰੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਤਿਆ ਨਹ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: eh vairee mitr sabh keetiaa nah ma(n)gahi ma(n)daa ||
english: All these enemies have become my friends, and no one wishes me ill.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੁਛਈ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: lekhaa koi na puchhaee jaa har bakhasa(n)daa ||
english: No one calls me to account, since God is my forgiver.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
transliteration: ana(n)d bhaiaa sukh paaiaa mil gur govi(n)daa ||
english: I have become blissful, and I have found peace, meeting with the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਐ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sabhe kaaj savaariai jaa tudh bhaava(n)daa ||7||
english: All my affairs have been resolved, since You are pleased with me. ||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡੇਖਣ ਕੂ ਮੁਸਤਾਕੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਿਜੇਹਾ ਤਉ ਧਣੀ ॥
transliteration: dekhan koo musataak mukh kijehaa tau dhanee ||
english: I am so eager to see You, O Lord; what does Your face look like?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਦਾ ਕਿਤੈ ਹਾਲਿ ਜਾ ਡਿਠਮੁ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: phiradaa kitai haal jaa ditham taa man dhraapiaa ||1||
english: I wandered around in such a miserable state, but when I saw You, my mind was comforted and consoled. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦਰਦ ਘਣੇ ਵੇਦਨ ਜਾਣੇ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ॥
transliteration: dukheeaa darad ghane vedan jaane too dhanee ||
english: The miserable endure so much suffering and pain; You alone know their pain, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਣਾ ਲਖ ਭਵੇ ਪਿਰੀ ਡਿਖੰਦੋ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਸਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaanaa lakh bhave piree dikha(n)do taa jeevasaa ||2||
english: I may know hundreds of thousands of remedies, but I shall live only if I see my Husband Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਢਹਦੀ ਜਾਇ ਕਰਾਰਿ ਵਹਣਿ ਵਹੰਦੇ ਮੈ ਡਿਠਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dhahadee jaai karaar vahan vaha(n)de mai dithiaa ||
english: I have seen the river-bank washed away by the raging waters of the river.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਰਹੇ ਅਮਾਣ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: seee rahe amaan jinaa satigur bhetiaa ||3||
english: They alone remain intact, who meet with the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: jis jan teree bhukh hai tis dukh na viaapai ||
english: No pain afflicts that humble being who hungers for You, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਸੁ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: jin jan guramukh bujhiaa s chahu ku(n)dee jaapai ||
english: That humble Gurmukh who understands, is celebrated in the four directions.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਉਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੰਬਹਿ ਪਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: jo nar us kee saranee parai tis ka(n)bahi paapai ||
english: Sins run away from that man, who seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਧੂੜੀ ਨਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: janam janam kee mal utarai gur dhooRee naapai ||
english: The filth of countless incarnations is washed away, bathing in the dust of the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: jin har bhaanaa ma(n)niaa tis sog na sa(n)taapai ||
english: Whoever submits to the Lord's Will does not suffer in sorrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu too sabhanaa kaa mit hai sabh jaanahi aapai ||
english: O Dear Lord, You are the friend of all; all believe that You are theirs.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਨੈ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: aisee sobhaa janai kee jevad har parataapai ||
english: The glory of the Lord's humble servant is as great as the Glorious Radiance of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਨ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੮॥
transliteration: sabh a(n)tar jan varataaiaa har jan te jaapai ||8||
english: Among all, His humble servant is pre-eminent; through His humble servant, the Lord is known. ||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਹਉ ਗਈ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਭੀ ਰਵਿਆਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jinaa pichhai hau gaee se mai pichhai bhee raviaas ||
english: Those whom I followed, now follow me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਆਸੜੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਹਿਜੀ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jinaa kee mai aasaRee tinaa mahijee aas ||1||
english: Those in whom I placed my hopes, now place their hopes in me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਲੀ ਗਿਲੀ ਰੋਡੜੀ ਭਉਦੀ ਭਵਿ ਭਵਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: gilee gilee rodaRee bhaudee bhav bhav aai ||
english: The fly flies around, and comes to the wet lump of molasses.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬੈਠੇ ਸੇ ਫਾਥਿਆ ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jo baithe se phaathiaa ubare bhaag mathaai ||2||
english: Whoever sits on it, is caught; they alone are saved, who have good destiny on their foreheads. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਿਠਾ ਹਭ ਮਝਾਹਿ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: dithaa habh majhaahi khaalee koi na jaaneeai ||
english: I see Him within all. No one is without Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਖੀ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਹਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tai sakhee bhaag mathaahi jinee meraa sajan raaviaa ||3||
english: Good destiny is inscribed on the forehead of that companion, who who enjoys the Lord, my Friend. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਦਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਦਾ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: hau dhaadhee dar gun gaavadaa je har prabh bhaavai ||
english: I am a minstrel at His Door, singing His Glorious Praises, to please to my Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਥਿਰ ਥਾਵਰੀ ਹੋਰ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh meraa thir thaavaree hor aavai jaavai ||
english: My God is permanent and stable; others continue coming and going.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੰਗਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੋੁਸਾਈਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so ma(n)gaa daan gousaaeeaa jit bhukh lahi jaavai ||
english: I beg for that gift from the Lord of the World, which will satisfy my hunger.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh jeeu devahu darasan aapanaa jit dhaadhee tripataavai ||
english: O Dear Lord God, please bless Your minstrel with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, that I might be satisfied and fulfilled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਦਾਤਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਉ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: aradaas sunee daataar prabh dhaadhee kau mahal bulaavai ||
english: God, the Great Giver, hears the prayer, and summons the minstrel to the Mansion of His Presence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖਦਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਉ ਮੰਗਣੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh dekhadiaa dukh bhukh gaee dhaadhee kau ma(n)gan chit na aavai ||
english: Gazing upon God, the minstrel is rid of pain and hunger; he does not think to ask for anything else.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਲਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sabhe ichhaa pooreeaa lag prabh kai paavai ||
english: All desires are fulfilled, touching the feet of God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਵੇਦਾਵੈ ॥੯॥
transliteration: hau niragun dhaadhee bakhasion prabh purakh vedaavai ||9||
english: I am His humble, unworthy minstrel; the Primal Lord God has forgiven me. ||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਛੁਟੇ ਤਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਤੂ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ॥
transliteration: jaa chhute taa khaak too su(n)njee ka(n)t na jaanahee ||
english: When the soul leaves, you shall become dust, O vacant body; why do you not realize your Husband Lord?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਸੇਤੀ ਨੇਹੁ ਤੂ ਕੈ ਗੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਹੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: durajan setee nehu too kai gun har ra(n)g maanahee ||1||
english: You are in love with evil people; by what virtues will you enjoy the Lord's Love? ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਵਿਸਰੇ ਸਰੈ ਨ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
transliteration: naanak jis bin ghaRee na jeevanaa visare sarai na bi(n)d ||
english: O Nanak, without Him, you cannot survive, even for an instant; you cannot afford to forget Him, even for a moment.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਉ ਮਨ ਰੂਸੀਐ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tis siu kiu man rooseeai jisahi hamaaree chi(n)d ||2||
english: Why are you alienated from Him, O my mind? He takes care of you. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ॥
transliteration: rate ra(n)g paarabraham kai man tan at gulaal ||
english: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God, their minds and bodies are colored deep crimson.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਆਲੂਦਿਆ ਜਿਤੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਖਿਆਲੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak vin naavai aaloodiaa jitee hor khiaal ||3||
english: O Nanak, without the Name, other thoughts are polluted and corrupt. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pavaRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੈ ਕਾੜਾ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu jaa too meraa mitr hai taa kiaa mai kaaRaa ||
english: O Dear Lord, when You are my friend, what sorrow can afflict me?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਠਗੀ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾੜਾ ॥
transliteration: jinee thagee jag thagiaa se tudh maar nivaaRaa ||
english: You have beaten off and destroyed the cheats that cheat the world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਇਆ ਜਿਤਾ ਪਾਵਾੜਾ ॥
transliteration: gur bhaujal paar la(n)ghaaiaa jitaa paavaaRaa ||
english: The Guru has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean, and I have won the battle.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਦਾ ਵਡਾ ਆਖਾੜਾ ॥
transliteration: guramatee sabh ras bhogadaa vadaa aakhaaRaa ||
english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I enjoy all the pleasures in the great world-arena.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀਆ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਤੀਓ ਸਤਵੰਤਾ ਸਾੜਾ ॥
transliteration: sabh i(n)dreeaa vas kar diteeo satava(n)taa saaRaa ||
english: The True Lord has brought all my senses and organs under my control.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਅਨਿ ਤਿਤੈ ਲਗਦੀਆ ਨਹ ਖਿੰਜੋਤਾੜਾ ॥
transliteration: jit laaeean titai lagadeeaa nah khi(n)jotaaRaa ||
english: Wherever I join them, there they are joined; they do not struggle against me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛੀ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾੜਾ ॥
transliteration: jo ichhee so phal paaidaa gur a(n)dar vaaRaa ||
english: I obtain the fruits of my desires; the Guru has directed me within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਭਾਇਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਦਾ ਨੇੜਾ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: gur naanak tuthaa bhaairahu har vasadaa neRaa ||10||
english: When Guru Nanak is pleased, O Siblings of Destiny, the Lord is seen to be dwelling near at hand. ||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਮੂੰ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਹਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaa moo(n) aavahi chit too taa habhe sukh lahaau ||
english: When You come into my consciousness, then I obtain all peace and comfort.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਤਹਿਜਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak man hee ma(n)jh ra(n)gaavalaa piree tahijaa naau ||1||
english: Nanak: with Your Name within my mind, O my Husband Lord, I am filled with delight. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਏ ਹਭੇ ਹੀ ਛਾਰ ॥
transliteration: kapaR bhog vikaar e habhe hee chhaar ||
english: Enjoyment of clothes and corrupt pleasures - all these are nothing more than dust.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਕੁ ਲੋੁੜੇਦਾ ਤੰਨਿ ਖੇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਦੀਦਾਰ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khaak louRedaa ta(n)n khe jo rate deedaar ||2||
english: I long for the dust of the feet of those who are imbued with the Lord's Vision. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਤਕਹਿ ਬਿਆ ਪਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਹੀਅੜੇ ਹਿਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kiaa takahi biaa paas kar heeaRe hik adhaar ||
english: Why do you look in other directions? O my heart, take the Support of the Lord alone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥੀਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਭੀ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: theeu sa(n)tan kee ren jit labhee sukh daataar ||3||
english: Become the dust of the feet of the Saints, and find the Lord, the Giver of peace. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਲਗੈ ॥
transliteration: vin karamaa har jeeu na paaeeai bin satigur manooaa na lagai ||
english: Without good karma, the Dear Lord is not found; without the True Guru, the mind is not joined to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੁ ਧੀਰਾ ਕਲਿ ਅੰਦਰੇ ਇਹੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਤਗੈ ॥
transliteration: dharam dheeraa kal a(n)dare ihu paapee mool na tagai ||
english: Only the Dharma remains stable in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; these sinners will not last at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ॥
transliteration: ahi kar kare s ahi kar paae ik ghaRee muhat na lagai ||
english: Whatever one does with this hand, he obtains with the other hand, without a moment's delay.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਮੈ ਸੋਧਿਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਗੈ ॥
transliteration: chaare jug mai sodhiaa vin sa(n)gat aha(n)kaar na bhagai ||
english: I have examined the four ages, and without the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, egotism does not depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਛੁਟਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਸੰਗੈ ॥
transliteration: haumai mool na chhutaee vin saadhoo satasa(n)gai ||
english: Egotism is never eradicated without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਥਾਹ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਭੰਗੈ ॥
transliteration: tichar thaah na paavaee jichar saahib siu man bha(n)gai ||
english: As long as one's mind is torn away from his Lord and Master, he finds no place of rest.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਅਭਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jin jan guramukh seviaa tis ghar deebaan abhagai ||
english: That humble being, who, as Gurmukh, serves the Lord, has the Support of the Imperishable Lord in the home of his heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗੈ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: har kirapaa te sukh paaiaa gur satigur charanee lagai ||11||
english: By the Lord's Grace, peace is obtained, and one is attached to the feet of the Guru, the True Guru. ||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋੜੀਦੋ ਹਭ ਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਮੀਰਾ ਮੀਰੰਨ ਸਿਰਿ ॥
transliteration: loReedo habh jaai so meeraa meera(n)n sir ||
english: I have searched everywhere for the King over the heads of kings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਠ ਮੰਝਾਹੂ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਚਉਦੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hath ma(n)jhaahoo so dhanee chaudo mukh alaai ||1||
english: That Master is within my heart; I chant His Name with my mouth. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਿਕੂ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਉ ਡਿੰਨਾ ਧਣੀ ਅਪਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: maanikoo mohi maau di(n)naa dhanee apaahi ||
english: O my mother, the Master has blessed me with the jewel.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਆਉ ਮਹਿਜਾ ਠੰਢੜਾ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hiaau mahijaa tha(n)dhaRaa mukhahu sach alaai ||2||
english: My heart is cooled and soothed, chanting the True Name with my mouth. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂ ਥੀਆਊ ਸੇਜ ਨੈਣਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਵਿਛਾਵਣਾ ॥
transliteration: moo theeaaoo sej nainaa piree vichhaavanaa ||
english: I have become the bed for my Beloved Husband Lord; my eyes have become the sheets.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਡੇਖੈ ਹਿਕ ਵਾਰ ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਮਾ ਹੂ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: je dekhai hik vaar taa sukh keemaa hoo baahare ||3||
english: If You look at me, even for an instant, then I obtain peace beyond all price. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਣ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: man lochai har milan kau kiu darasan paaeeaa ||
english: My mind longs to meet the Lord; how can I obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਲਖ ਵਿੜਤੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਜੇ ਬਿੰਦ ਬੋੁਲਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: mai lakh viRate saahibaa je bi(n)d boulaaeeaa ||
english: I obtain hundreds of thousands, if my Lord and Master speaks to me, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨ ਸਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: mai chaare ku(n)daa bhaaleeaa tudh jevad na saaeeaa ||
english: I have searched in four directions; there is no other as great as You, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਦਸਿਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤਹੋ ਕਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: mai dasihu maarag sa(n)taho kiu prabhoo milaaeeaa ||
english: Show me the Path, O Saints. How can I meet God?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਹੁ ਇਤੁ ਪੰਥਿ ਜੁਲਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: man arapihu haumai tajahu it pa(n)th julaaeeaa ||
english: I dedicate my mind to Him, and renounce my ego. This is the Path which I shall take.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: nit sevihu saahib aapanaa satasa(n)g milaaeeaa ||
english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I serve my Lord and Master continually.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਆ ॥
transliteration: sabhe aasaa pooreeaa gur mahal bulaaeeaa ||
english: All my hopes are fulfilled; the Guru has ushered me into the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੋੁਸਾਈਆ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: tudh jevad hor na sujhaee mere mitr gousaaeeaa ||12||
english: I cannot conceive of any other as great as You, O my Friend, O Lord of the World. ||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂ ਥੀਆਊ ਤਖਤੁ ਪਿਰੀ ਮਹਿੰਜੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥
transliteration: moo theeaaoo takhat piree mahi(n)je paatisaah ||
english: I have become the throne for my Beloved Lord King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਵ ਮਿਲਾਵੇ ਕੋਲਿ ਕਵਲ ਜਿਵੈ ਬਿਗਸਾਵਦੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: paav milaave kol kaval jivai bigasaavado ||1||
english: If You place Your foot on me, I blossom forth like the lotus flower. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੀਆ ਸੰਦੜੀ ਭੁਖ ਮੂ ਲਾਵਣ ਥੀ ਵਿਥਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pireeaa sa(n)daRee bhukh moo laavan thee vitharaa ||
english: If my Beloved becomes hungry, I will become food, and place myself before Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੁ ਮਿਠਾਈ ਇਖ ਬੇਈ ਪੀੜੇ ਨਾ ਹੁਟੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaan mithaaee ikh beee peeRe naa hutai ||2||
english: I may be crushed, again and again, but like sugarcane, I do not stop yielding sweet juice. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਠਗਾ ਨੀਹੁ ਮਤ੍ਰੋੜਿ ਜਾਣੁ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬਾ ਨਗਰੀ ॥
transliteration: thagaa neehu matroR jaan ga(n)dhrabaa nagaree ||
english: Break off your love with the cheaters; realize that it is a mirage.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਘਟਾਊ ਡੂਇ ਇਸੁ ਪੰਧਾਣੂ ਘਰ ਘਣੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sukh ghataaoo dooi is pa(n)dhaanoo ghar ghane ||3||
english: Your pleasure lasts for only two moments; this traveller wanders through countless homes. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਨਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਲੇਖੰ ॥
transliteration: akal kalaa nah paaeeai prabh alakh alekha(n) ||
english: God is not found by intellectual devices; He is unknowable and unseen.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਭੇਖੰ ॥
transliteration: khat darasan bhramate phirahi nah mileeai bhekha(n) ||
english: The followers of the six orders wander and roam around wearing religious robes, but they do not meet God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਰਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਇਣਾ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੰ ॥
transliteration: varat karahi cha(n)draainaa se kitai na lekha(n) ||
english: They keep the lunar fasts, but they are of no account.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਾ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਪੇਖੰ ॥
transliteration: bed paRahi sa(n)pooranaa tat saar na pekha(n) ||
english: Those who read the Vedas in their entirety, still do not see the sublime essence of reality.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਲਕੁ ਕਢਹਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਲੇਖੰ ॥
transliteration: tilak kadhahi isanaan kar a(n)tar kaalekha(n) ||
english: They apply ceremonial marks to their foreheads, and take cleansing baths, but they are blackened within.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੇਖੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੀ ਸਿਖੰ ॥
transliteration: bhekhee prabhoo na labhaee vin sachee sikha(n) ||
english: They wear religious robes, but without the True Teachings, God is not found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੰ ॥
transliteration: bhoolaa maarag so pavai jis dhur masatak lekha(n) ||
english: One who had strayed, finds the Path again, if such pre-ordained destiny is written on his forehead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖੰ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: tin janam savaariaa aapanaa jin gur akhee dekha(n) ||13||
english: One who sees the Guru with his eyes, embellishes and exalts his human life. ||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਿਵਾਹੂ ਗਡਿ ਜੋ ਚਲਾਊ ਨ ਥੀਐ ॥
transliteration: so nivaahoo gad jo chalaaoo na theeai ||
english: Focus on that which will not pass away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰ ਕੂੜਾਵੀ ਛਡਿ ਸੰਮਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: kaar kooRaavee chhad sa(n)mal sach dhanee ||1||
english: Abandon your false actions, and meditate on the True Master. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਭ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਘਟਾਊ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: habh samaanee jot jiu jal ghataaoo cha(n)dramaa ||
english: God's Light is permeating all, like the moon reflected in the water.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਥੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: paragat theeaa aap naanak masatak likhiaa ||2||
english: He Himself is revealed, O Nanak, to one who has such destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਉ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mukh suhaave naam chau aath pahar gun gaau ||
english: One's face becomes beautiful, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and singing His Glorious Praises, twenty-four hours a day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak daragah ma(n)neeahi milee nithaave thaau ||3||
english: O Nanak, in the Court of the Lord, you shall be accepted; even the homeless find a home there. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰ ਭੇਖਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: baahar bhekh na paaeeai prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
english: By wearing religious robes outwardly, God, the Inner-knower is not found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਨਿਕਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: ikas har jeeu baaharee sabh phirai nikaamee ||
english: Without the One Dear Lord, all wander around aimlessly.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਨਿਤ ਗਰਬਿ ਫਿਰਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: man rataa kuta(n)b siu nit garab phiraamee ||
english: Their minds are imbued with attachment to family, and so they continually wander around, puffed up with pride.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਹਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬਹਿ ਦਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: phirahi gumaanee jag mahi kiaa garabahi daamee ||
english: The arrogant wander around the world; why are they so proud of their wealth?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਖਿਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਿਲਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: chaladiaa naal na chalaee khin jaai bilaamee ||
english: Their wealth shall not go with them when they depart; in an instant, it is gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਚਰਦੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਹੁਕਾਮੀ ॥
transliteration: bicharade phirahi sa(n)saar mahi har jee hukaamee ||
english: They wander around in the world, according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਖੁਲਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
transliteration: karam khulaa gur paaiaa har miliaa suaamee ||
english: When one's karma is activated, one finds the Guru, and through Him, the Lord and Master is found.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਮੀ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: jo jan har kaa sevako har tis kee kaamee ||14||
english: That humble being, who serves the Lord, has his affairs resolved by the Lord. ||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਲਾਏ ਹਭ ਮਰਣੁ ਪਛਾਣੰਦੋ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: mukhahu alaae habh maran pachhaana(n)do koi ||
english: All speak with their mouths, but rare are those one who realize death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਯਕੀਨਾ ਹਿਕ ਸਿਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak tinaa khaak jinaa yakeenaa hik siu ||1||
english: Nanak is the dust of the feet of those who have faith in the One Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੁ ਵਸੰਦੋ ਮੰਝਿ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਕੋ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
transliteration: jaan vasa(n)do ma(n)jh pachhaanoo ko hekaRo ||
english: Know that He dwells within all; rare are those who realize this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਤਨਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tai tan paRadaa naahi naanak jai gur bhetiaa ||2||
english: There is no obscuring veil on the body of that one, O Nanak, who meets the Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਤੜੀ ਕਾਂਢਕੁ ਆਹ ਪਾਵ ਧੋਵੰਦੋ ਪੀਵਸਾ ॥
transliteration: mataRee kaa(n)dhak aah paav dhova(n)do peevasaa ||
english: I drink in the water which has washed the feet of those who share the Teachings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਅਥਾਹ ਪਸਣ ਕੂ ਸਚਾ ਧਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: moo tan prem athaah pasan koo sachaa dhanee ||3||
english: My body is filled with infinite love to see my True Master. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਚਾ ॥
transliteration: nirabhau naam visaariaa naal maaiaa rachaa ||
english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord, he becomes attached to Maya.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਚਾ ॥
transliteration: aavai jaai bhavaaeeai bahu jonee nachaa ||
english: He comes and goes, and wanders, dancing in countless incarnations.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਚਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਖਿਸਕਿ ਜਾਇ ਬੋਲੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਚਾ ॥
transliteration: bachan kare tai khisak jaai bole sabh kachaa ||
english: He gives his word, but then backs out. All that he says is false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਥੋਥਾ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਸਭ ਖਚਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)darahu thothaa kooRiaar kooRee sabh khachaa ||
english: The false person is hollow within; he is totally engrossed in falsehood.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਲਚਾ ॥
transliteration: vair kare niravair naal jhoothe laalachaa ||
english: He tries to take vengeance upon the Lord, who bears no vengeance; such a person is trapped by falsehood and greed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਚਾ ॥
transliteration: maariaa sachai paatisaahi vekh dhur karamachaa ||
english: The True King, the Primal Lord God, kills him when He sees what he has done.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਮਦੂਤੀ ਹੈ ਹੇਰਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਚਾ ॥
transliteration: jamadootee hai heriaa dukh hee mahi pachaa ||
english: The Messenger of Death sees him, and he rots away in pain.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: hoaa tapaavas dharam kaa naanak dar sachaa ||15||
english: Even-handed justice is administered, O Nanak, in the Court of the True Lord. ||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਰਭਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
transliteration: parabhaate prabh naam jap gur ke charan dhiaai ||
english: In the early hours of the morning, chant the Name of God, and meditate on the Feet of the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: janam maran mal utarai sache ke gun gaai ||1||
english: The filth of birth and death is erased, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: deh a(n)dhaaree a(n)dh su(n)njee naam vihooneeaa ||
english: The body is dark, blind and empty, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ ਜੈ ਘਟਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saphal jana(n)m jai ghat vuthaa sach dhanee ||2||
english: O Nanak, fruitful is the birth of one, within whose heart the True Master dwells. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲੋਇਣ ਲੋਈ ਡਿਠ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਮੂ ਘਣੀ ॥
transliteration: loin loee dith piaas na bujhai moo ghanee ||
english: With my eyes, I have seen the Light; my great thirst for Him is not quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਅਖੜੀਆ ਬਿਅੰਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਡਿਸੰਦੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak se akhaReeaa bia(n)n jinee disa(n)do maa piree ||3||
english: O Nanak, these are not the eyes which can see my Beloved Husband Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jin jan guramukh seviaa tin sabh sukh paaee ||
english: That humble being, who, as Gurmukh, serves the Lord, obtains all peace and pleasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: ohu aap tariaa kuta(n)b siu sabh jagat taraaee ||
english: He Himself is saved, along with his family, and all the world is saved as well.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਸਭ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: on har naamaa dhan sa(n)chiaa sabh tikhaa bujhaaee ||
english: He collects the wealth of the Lord's Name, and all his thirst is quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਨਿ ਛਡੇ ਲਾਲਚ ਦੁਨੀ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
transliteration: on chhade laalach dunee ke a(n)tar liv laaee ||
english: He renounces worldly greed, and his inner being is lovingly attuned to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਘਰਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: os sadaa sadaa ghar ana(n)d hai har sakhaa sahaaee ||
english: Forever and ever, the home of his heart is filled with bliss; the Lord is his companion, help and support.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਨਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮ ਕੀਤਿਆ ਸਭ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: on vairee mitr sam keetiaa sabh naal subhaaee ||
english: He looks alike upon enemy and friend, and wishes well to all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਆ ਓਹੀ ਅਲੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: hoaa ohee al jag mahi gur giaan japaaee ||
english: He alone is fulfilled in this world, who meditates on the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: poorab likhiaa paaiaa har siu ban aaee ||16||
english: He obtains what is pre-ordained for him, according to the Lord. ||16||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਕਾਢੀਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: sach suhaavaa kaadheeai kooRai kooRee soi ||
english: The true person is said to be beautiful; false is the reputation of the false.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak virale jaaneeahi jin sach palai hoi ||1||
english: O Nanak, rare are those who have Truth in their laps. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਜਣ ਮੁਖੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਨਿਹਾਲਸਾ ॥
transliteration: sajan mukh anoop athe pahar nihaalasaa ||
english: The face of my friend, the Lord, is incomparably beautiful; I would watch Him, twenty-four hours a day.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤੜੀ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਡਿਠੁ ਤੈ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਹਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sutaRee so sahu dith tai supane hau kha(n)neeai ||2||
english: In sleep, I saw my Husband Lord; I am a sacrifice to that dream. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਜਣ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਖਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਾਵਣੁ ਥੋਥਰਾ ॥
transliteration: sajan sach parakh mukh alaavan thotharaa ||
english: O my friend, realize the True Lord. Just to talk about Him is useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੰਨ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਲਖਿ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਸੁ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ma(n)n majhaahoo lakh tudhahu door na s piree ||3||
english: See Him within your mind; your Beloved is not far away. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤਿ ਆਕਾਸੁ ਪਾਤਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: dharat aakaas paataal hai cha(n)d soor binaasee ||
english: The earth, the Akaashic ethers of the sky, the nether regions of the underworld, the moon and the sun shall pass away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ਉਮਰਾਵ ਖਾਨ ਢਾਹਿ ਡੇਰੇ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: baadisaah saah umaraav khaan dhaahi dere jaasee ||
english: Emperors, bankers, rulers and leaders shall depart, and their homes shall be demolished.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਤੁੰਗ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਤ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਿਧਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g tu(n)g gareeb masat sabh lok sidhaasee ||
english: The poor and the rich, the humble and the intoxicated, all these people shall pass away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕਾ ਸਭੇ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: kaajee sekh masaaikaa sabhe uth jaasee ||
english: The Qazis, Shaykhs and preachers shall all arise and depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਪੈਕਾਬਰ ਅਉਲੀਏ ਕੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: peer paikaabar auleee ko thir na rahaasee ||
english: The spiritual teachers, prophets and disciples - none of these shall remain permanently.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੋਜਾ ਬਾਗ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਕਤੇਬ ਵਿਣੁ ਬੁਝੇ ਸਭ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: rojaa baag nivaaj kateb vin bujhe sabh jaasee ||
english: Fasts, calls to prayer and sacred scriptures - without understanding, all these shall vanish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸਭ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh medanee sabh aavai jaasee ||
english: The 8.4 million species of beings of the earth shall all continue coming and going in reincarnation.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਏਕੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਬੰਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੧੭॥
transliteration: nihachal sach khudaai ek khudaai ba(n)daa abinaasee ||17||
english: The One True Lord God is eternal and unchanging. The Lord's slave is also eternal. ||17||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡਿਠੀ ਹਭ ਢੰਢੋਲਿ ਹਿਕਸੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: dithee habh dha(n)dhol hikas baajh na koi ||
english: I have seen and examined all; without the One Lord, there is none at all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਸਜਣ ਤੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਠੰਢਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aau sajan too mukh lag meraa tan man tha(n)dhaa hoi ||1||
english: Come, and show me Your face, O my friend, so that my body and mind may be cooled and soothed. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸਕੁ ਆਸਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਮੂ ਮਨਿ ਵਡੀ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: aasak aasaa baaharaa moo man vadee aas ||
english: The lover is without hope, but within my mind, there is great hope.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹਿਕੁ ਤੂ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗਈਆਸ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aas niraasaa hik too hau bal bal bal gaeeaas ||2||
english: In the midst of hope, only You, O Lord, remain free of hope; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਸੁਣੇ ਡੁਖੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਡਿਠੇ ਮਰਿਓਦਿ ॥
transliteration: vichhoRaa sune dukh vin dithe mariod ||
english: Even if I just hear of separation from You, I am in pain; without seeing You, O Lord, I die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਨਾ ਧੀਰੋਦਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: baajh piaare aapane birahee naa dheerod ||3||
english: Without her Beloved, the separated lover takes no comfort. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾਲਿਆ ਕੇਦਾਰੁ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਕਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: tat teerath dev devaaliaa kedaar mathuraa kaasee ||
english: River-banks, sacred shrines, idols, temples, and places of pilgrimage like Kaydarnaat'h, Mat'huraa and Benares,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸਾ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਸਣੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੈ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: kot teteesaa devate san i(n)drai jaasee ||
english: the three hundred thirty million gods, along with Indra, shall all pass away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਚਾਰਿ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸ ਸਮਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: simrit saasatr bed chaar khat daras samaasee ||
english: The Simritees, Shaastras, the four Vedas and the six systems of philosophy shall vanish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਗੀਤ ਕਵਿਤ ਕਵਤੇ ਭੀ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: pothee pa(n)dit geet kavit kavate bhee jaasee ||
english: Prayer books, Pandits, religious scholars, songs, poems and poets shall also depart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jatee satee sa(n)niaaseeaa sabh kaalai vaasee ||
english: Those who are celibate, truthful and charitiable, and the Sannyaasee hermits are all subject to death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਨਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਦਿਗੰਬਰਾ ਜਮੈ ਸਣੁ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: mun jogee diga(n)baraa jamai san jaasee ||
english: The silent sages, the Yogis and the nudists, along with the Messengers of Death, shall pass away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਵਿਣਸਣਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: jo deesai so vinasanaa sabh binas binaasee ||
english: Whatever is seen shall perish; all will dissolve and disappear.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਸੀ ॥੧੮॥
transliteration: thir paarabraham paramesaro sevak thir hosee ||18||
english: Only the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, is permanent. His servant becomes permanent as well. ||18||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Salok Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੈ ਨੰਗੇ ਨਹ ਨੰਗ ਭੁਖੇ ਲਖ ਨ ਭੁਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sai na(n)ge nah na(n)g bhukhe lakh na bhukhiaa ||
english: Hundreds of times naked does not make the person naked; tens of thousands of hungers do not make him hungry;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡੁਖੇ ਕੋੜਿ ਨ ਡੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਿਖੰਦੋ ਸੁਭ ਦਿਸਟਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dukhe koR na dukh naanak piree pikha(n)do subh disat ||1||
english: millions of pains do not cause him pain. O Nanak, the Husband Lord blesses him with his Glance of Grace. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਭੋਗ ਭੂਮਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਕੋ ਧਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sukh samoohaa bhog bhoom sabaaee ko dhanee ||
english: Even if one were to enjoy all pleasures, and be master of the entire earth,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਭੋ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak habho rog miratak naam vihooniaa ||2||
english: O Nanak, all of that is just a disease. Without the Naam, he is dead. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਕਸ ਕੂੰ ਤੂ ਆਹਿ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਭੀ ਹਿਕੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
transliteration: hikas koo(n) too aahi pachhaanoo bhee hik kar ||
english: Yearn for the One Lord, and make Him your friend.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸੜੀ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਪਰਥਾਈ ਲਜੀਵਦੋ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak aasaRee nibaahi maanukh parathaaee lajeevado ||3||
english: O Nanak, He alone fulfills your hopes; you should feel embarrassed, visiting other places. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਰਾਇਣੋ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: nihachal ek naraaino har agam agaadhaa ||
english: The One and only Lord is eternal, imperishable, inaccessible and incomprehensible.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: nihachal naam nidhaan hai jis simarat har laadhaa ||
english: The treasure of the Naam is eternal and imperishable. Meditating in remembrance on Him, the Lord is attained.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: nihachal keeratan gun gobi(n)d guramukh gaavaadhaa ||
english: The Kirtan of His Praises is eternal and imperishable; the Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਪੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਅਰਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: sach dharam tap nihachalo din rain araadhaa ||
english: Truth, righteousness, Dharma and intense meditation are eternal and imperishable. Day and night, worship the Lord in adoration.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਪੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੋ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: daiaa dharam tap nihachalo jis karam likhaadhaa ||
english: Compassion, righteousness, Dharma and intense meditation are eternal and imperishable; they alone obtain these, who have such pre-ordained destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਟਲੈ ਨ ਟਲਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: nihachal masatak lekh likhiaa so talai na talaadhaa ||
english: The inscription inscribed upon one's forehead is eternal and imperishable; it cannot be avoided by avoidance.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਬਚਨ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
transliteration: nihachal sa(n)gat saadh jan bachan nihachal gur saadhaa ||
english: The Congregation, the Company of the Holy, and the word of the humble, are eternal and imperishable. The Holy Guru is eternal and imperishable.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਰਾਧਾ ॥੧੯॥
transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin sadaa sadaa aaraadhaa ||19||
english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny worship and adore the Lord, forever and ever. ||19||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਡੁਬੰਦੋ ਆਪਿ ਸੋ ਤਰਾਏ ਕਿਨੑ ਖੇ ॥
transliteration: jo duba(n)do aap so taraae kinh khe ||
english: One who himself has drowned - how can he carry anyone else across?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਾਰੇਦੜੋ ਭੀ ਤਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰ ਸਿਉ ਰਤਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: taaredaRo bhee taar naanak pir siu ratiaa ||1||
english: One who is imbued with the Love of the Husband Lord - O Nanak, he himself is saved, and he saves others as well. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਕੋਇ ਕਥੰਨਿ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਣੰਦੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jithai koi katha(n)n naau suna(n)do maa piree ||
english: Wherever someone speaks and hears the Name of my Beloved Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੂੰ ਜੁਲਾਊਂ ਤਥਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਸੰਦੋ ਹਰਿਓ ਥੀਓਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: moo(n) julaaoo(n) tath naanak piree pasa(n)do hario theeos ||2||
english: that is where I go, O Nanak, to see Him, and blossom forth in bliss. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸਨੇਹ ॥
transliteration: meree meree kiaa karahi putr kalatr saneh ||
english: You are in love with your children and your wife; why do you keep calling them your own?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ਨਿਮੁਣੀਆਦੀ ਦੇਹ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak naam vihooneeaa nimuneeaadee deh ||3||
english: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the human body has no foundation. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨੀ ਦੇਖਉ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਥਾ ॥
transliteration: nainee dekhau gur darasano gur charanee mathaa ||
english: With my eyes, I gaze upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; I touch my forehead to the Guru's feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਲਦਾ ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਹਥਾ ॥
transliteration: pairee maarag gur chaladaa pakhaa pheree hathaa ||
english: With my feet I walk on the Guru's Path; with my hands, I wave the fan over Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਜਪੰਥਾ ॥
transliteration: akaal moorat ridai dhiaaidaa din rain japa(n)thaa ||
english: I meditate on Akaal Moorat, the undying form, within my heart; day and night, I meditate on Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਛਡਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਅਪਾਇਣੋ ਭਰਵਾਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਮਰਥਾ ॥
transliteration: mai chhadiaa sagal apaaino bharavaasai gur samarathaa ||
english: I have renounced all possessiveness, and have placed my faith in the all-powerful Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਭੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਥਾ ॥
transliteration: gur bakhasiaa naam nidhaan sabho dukh lathaa ||
english: The Guru has blessed me with the treasure of the Naam; I am rid of all sufferings.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੋਗਹੁ ਭੁੰਚਹੁ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਪਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਗਥਾ ॥
transliteration: bhogahu bhu(n)chahu bhaaeeho palai naam agathaa ||
english: Eat and enjoy the Naam, the Name of the indescribable Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਥਾ ॥
transliteration: naam daan isanaan diR sadaa karahu gur kathaa ||
english: Confirm your faith in the Naam, charity and self-purification; chant the Guru's sermon forever.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਲਥਾ ॥੨੦॥
transliteration: sahaj bhaiaa prabh paaiaa jam kaa bhau lathaa ||20||
english: Blessed with intuitive poise, I have found God; I am rid of the fear of the Messenger of Death. ||20||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਗੜੀਆ ਪਿਰੀਅੰਨਿ ਪੇਖੰਦੀਆ ਨਾ ਤਿਪੀਆ ॥
transliteration: lagaReeaa pireea(n)n pekha(n)deeaa naa tipeeaa ||
english: I am centered and focused on my Beloved, but I am not satisfied, even by seeing Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਭ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਬਿਆ ਨ ਡਿਠੋ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: habh majhaahoo so dhanee biaa na ditho koi ||1||
english: The Lord and Master is within all; I do not see any other. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਥੜੀਆ ਸੰਤਾਹ ਤੇ ਸੁਖਾਊ ਪੰਧੀਆ ॥
transliteration: kathaReeaa sa(n)taah te sukhaaoo pa(n)dheeaa ||
english: The sayings of the Saints are the paths of peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਧੜੀਆ ਤਿੰਨਾਹ ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥਾਹੜੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak ladhaReeaa ti(n)naah jinaa bhaag mathaahaRai ||2||
english: O Nanak, they alone obtain them, upon whose foreheads such destiny is written. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਡੂੰਗਰਿ ਜਲਾ ਥਲਾ ਭੂਮਿ ਬਨਾ ਫਲ ਕੰਦਰਾ ॥
transliteration: doo(n)gar jalaa thalaa bhoom banaa phal ka(n)daraa ||
english: He is totally permeating the mountains, oceans, deserts, lands, forests, orchards, caves,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ਆਕਾਸ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਹਭ ਘਟਾ ॥
transliteration: paataalaa aakaas pooran habh ghataa ||
english: the nether regions of the underworld, the Akaashic ethers of the skies, and all hearts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਓ ਇਕਤੁ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਤੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak pekh jeeo ikat soot paroteeaa ||3||
english: Nanak sees that they are all strung on the same thread. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ॥
transliteration: har jee maataa har jee pitaa har jeeu pratipaalak ||
english: The Dear Lord is my mother, the Dear Lord is my father; the Dear Lord cherishes and nurtures me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਬਾਲਕ ॥
transliteration: har jee meree saar kare ham har ke baalak ||
english: The Dear Lord takes care of me; I am the child of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਖਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਆਲਕ ॥
transliteration: sahaje sahaj khilaaidaa nahee karadaa aalak ||
english: Slowly and steadily, He feeds me; He never fails.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਚਿਤਾਰਦਾ ਗਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਾਇਕ ॥
transliteration: augan ko na chitaaradaa gal setee laaik ||
english: He does not remind me of my faults; He hugs me close in His embrace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਿ ਮੰਗਾਂ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਵਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਇਕ ॥
transliteration: muhi ma(n)gaa(n) soee devadaa har pitaa sukhadaaik ||
english: Whatever I ask for, He give me; the Lord is my peace-giving father.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਉਪਿਓਨੁ ਇਸੁ ਸਉਦੇ ਲਾਇਕ ॥
transliteration: giaan raas naam dhan saupion is saude laaik ||
english: He has blessed me with the capital, the wealth of spiritual wisdom; He has made me worthy of this merchandise.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਕ ॥
transliteration: saajhee gur naal bahaaliaa sarab sukh paaik ||
english: He has made me a partner with the Guru; I have obtained all peace and comforts.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਾਲਹੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਲਾਇਕ ॥੨੧॥
transliteration: mai naalahu kade na vichhuRai har pitaa sabhanaa galaa laaik ||21||
english: He is with me, and shall never separate from me; the Lord, my father, is potent to do everything. ||21||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok dakhane mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਚੜਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਤੋੜਿ ਢੂਢਿ ਸਜਣ ਸੰਤ ਪਕਿਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak kachaRiaa siu toR dhoodh sajan sa(n)t pakiaa ||
english: O Nanak, break away from the false, and seek out the Saints, your true friends.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜੀਵੰਦੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਓਇ ਮੁਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਛੋੜਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: oi jeeva(n)de vichhuRahi oi muiaa na jaahee chhoR ||1||
english: The false shall leave you, even while you are still alive; but the Saints shall not forsake you, even when you are dead. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਜੁਲੀਆ ਚਮਕੰਨਿ ਘੁਰਨੑਿ ਘਟਾ ਅਤਿ ਕਾਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: naanak bijuleeaa chamaka(n)n ghuranhi ghataa at kaaleeaa ||
english: O Nanak, the lightning flashes, and thunder echoes in the dark black clouds.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਰਸਨਿ ਮੇਘ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਮਿ ਪਿਰੀ ਸੁਹੰਦੀਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: barasan megh apaar naanak sa(n)gam piree suha(n)deeaa ||2||
english: The downpour from the clouds is heavy; O Nanak, the soul-brides are exalted and embellished with their Beloved. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਸੀਤਲ ਪਵਣ ਝੁਲਾਰਦੇ ॥
transliteration: jal thal neer bhare seetal pavan jhulaarade ||
english: The ponds and the lands are overflowing with water, and the cold wind is blowing.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜੜੀਆ ਸੋਇੰਨ ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੜੰਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: sejaReeaa soi(n)n heere laal jaRa(n)deeaa ||
english: Her bed is adorned with gold, diamonds and rubies;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਭਰ ਕਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੀ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਤਤੀਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: subhar kapaR bhog naanak piree vihoonee tateeaa ||3||
english: she is blessed with beautiful gowns and delicacies, O Nanak, but without her Beloved, she burns in agony. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਜੋ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: kaaran karatai jo keeaa soee hai karanaa ||
english: He does the dees which the Creator causes him to do.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਆ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਹਣਾ ॥
transliteration: je sau dhaavahi praaneeaa paavahi dhur lahanaa ||
