english: Even if you run in hundreds of directions, O mortal, you shall still receive what you are pre-destined to receive.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਭ ਧਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: bin karamaa kichhoo na labhaee je phirahi sabh dharanaa ||
english: Without good karma, you shall obtain nothing, even if you wander across the whole world.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਉ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਭੈ ਡਰੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: gur mil bhau govi(n)d kaa bhai dar door karanaa ||
english: Meeting with the Guru, you shall know the Fear of God, and other fears shall be taken away.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: bhai te bairaag oopajai har khojat phiranaa ||
english: Through the Fear of God, the attitude of detachment wells up, and one sets out in search of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਸਹਜੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat sahaj upajiaa phir janam na maranaa ||
english: Searching and searching, intuitive wisdom wells up, and then, one is not born to die again.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਿਆਇ ਕਮਾਇ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
transliteration: hiaai kamaai dhiaaiaa paaiaa saadh saranaa ||
english: Practicing meditation within my heart, I have found the Sanctuary of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੜਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੨੨॥
transliteration: bohith naanak deu gur jis har chaRaae tis bhaujal taranaa ||22||
english: Whoever the Lord places on the boat of Guru Nanak, is carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||22||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
english: Salok, Dakhanay Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਕਬੂਲਿ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਛਡਿ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: pahilaa maran kabool jeevan kee chhad aas ||
english: First, accept death, and give up any hope of life.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਤਉ ਆਉ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: hohu sabhanaa kee renukaa tau aau hamaarai paas ||1||
english: Become the dust of the feet of all, and then, you may come to me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੁਆ ਜੀਵੰਦਾ ਪੇਖੁ ਜੀਵੰਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: muaa jeeva(n)daa pekh jeeva(n)de mar jaan ||
english: See, that only one who has died, truly lives; one who is alive, consider him dead.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਇਕ ਸਿਉ ਤੇ ਮਾਣਸ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jinhaa muhabat ik siu te maanas paradhaan ||2||
english: Those who are in love with the One Lord, are the supreme people. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
transliteration: mah 5 ||
english: Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੀਰ ॥
transliteration: jis man vasai paarabraham nikat na aavai peer ||
english: Pain does not even approach that person, within whose mind God abides.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੁਖ ਤਿਖ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨੀਰ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bhukh tikh tis na viaapaee jam nahee aavai neer ||3||
english: Hunger and thirst do not affect him, and the Messenger of Death does not approach him. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
transliteration: pauRee ||
english: Pauree:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਅਡੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: keemat kahan na jaaeeai sach saah adolai ||
english: Your worth cannot be estimated, O True, Unmoving Lord God.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਤੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: sidh saadhik giaanee dhiaaneeaa kaun tudhuno tolai ||
english: The Siddhas, seekers, spiritual teachers and meditators - who among them can measure You?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭੰਨਣ ਘੜਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਓਪਤਿ ਸਭ ਪਰਲੈ ॥
transliteration: bha(n)nan ghaRan samarath hai opat sabh paralai ||
english: You are all-powerful, to form and break; You create and destroy all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਭ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath hai ghat ghat sabh bolai ||
english: You are all-powerful to act, and inspire all to act; You speak through each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੇ ਸਭਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਣਸੁ ਡੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: rijak samaahe sabhasai kiaa maanas dolai ||
english: You give sustanance to all; why should mankind waver?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਤੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਮੋਲੈ ॥
transliteration: gahir gabheer athaahu too gun giaan amolai ||
english: You are deep, profound and unfathomable; Your virtuous spiritual wisdom is priceless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਉਲੈ ॥
transliteration: soee ka(n)m kamaavanaa keeaa dhur maulai ||
english: They do the deeds which they are pre-ordained to do.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਧਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੈ ॥੨੩॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: tudhahu baahar kichh nahee naanak gun bolai ||23||1||2||
english: Without You, there is nothing at all; Nanak chants Your Glorious Praises. ||23||1||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag maaroo baanee kabeer jeeu kee ||
english: Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪਡੀਆ ਕਵਨ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: padeeaa kavan kumat tum laage ||
english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, in what foul thoughts are you engaged?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਹੁਗੇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਕਲ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਹੁ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: boodahuge paravaar sakal siu raam na japahu abhaage ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You shall be drowned, along with your family, if you do not meditate on the Lord, you unfortunate person. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਪੜੇ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਨੁ ਖਰ ਚੰਦਨ ਜਸ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: bed puraan paRe kaa kiaa gun khar cha(n)dan jas bhaaraa ||
english: What is the use of reading the Vedas and the Puraanas? It is like loading a donkey with sandalwood.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam kee gat nahee jaanee kaise utaras paaraa ||1||
english: You do not know the exalted state of the Lord's Name; how will you ever cross over? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਬਧਹੁ ਸੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਪਹੁ ਅਧਰਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jee badhahu s dharam kar thaapahu adharam kahahu kat bhaaee ||
english: You kill living beings, and call it a righteous action. Tell me, brother, what would you call an unrighteous action?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਮੁਨਿਵਰ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਪਹੁ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਸਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aapas kau munivar kar thaapahu kaa kau kahahu kasaaee ||2||
english: You call yourself the most excellent sage; then who would you call a butcher? ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਅੰਧੇ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਕਾਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man ke a(n)dhe aap na boojhahu kaahi bujhaavahu bhaaee ||
english: You are blind in your mind, and do not understand your own self; how can you make others understand, O brother?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬੇਚਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: maaiaa kaaran bidiaa bechahu janam abirathaa jaaee ||3||
english: For the sake of Maya and money, you sell knowledge; your life is totally worthless. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਆਸੁ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਕ ਕਉ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਈ ॥
transliteration: naarad bachan biaas kahat hai suk kau poochhahu jaaee ||
english: Naarad and Vyaasa say these things; go and ask Suk Dayv as well.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੈ ਰਮਿ ਛੂਟਹੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਬੂਡੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer raamai ram chhootahu naahi ta boode bhaaee ||4||1||
english: Says Kabeer, chanting the Lord's Name, you shall be saved; otherwise, you shall drown, brother. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਨਹਿ ਬਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਤਜਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
transliteration: banahi base kiu paaeeai jau lau manahu na tajahi bikaar ||
english: Living in the forest, how will you find Him? Not until you remove corruption from your mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਘਰੁ ਬਨੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jih ghar ban samasar keeaa te poore sa(n)saar ||1||
english: Those who look alike upon home and forest, are the most perfect people in the world. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: saar sukh paaeeai raamaa ||
english: You shall find real peace in the Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵਹੁ ਆਤਮੈ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)g ravahu aatamai raam ||1|| rahaau ||
english: if you lovingly dwell on the Lord within your being. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਟਾ ਭਸਮ ਲੇਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਹਾ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: jataa bhasam lepan keeaa kahaa guphaa mahi baas ||
english: What is the use of wearing matted hair, smearing the body with ashes, and living in a cave?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤੇ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਜਾਂ ਤੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: man jeete jag jeetiaa jaa(n) te bikhiaa te hoi udaas ||2||
english: Conquering the mind, one conquers the world, and then remains detached from corruption. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਭੈ ਕੋਈ ਟੁਕੁ ਚਾਹਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਡਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: a(n)jan dei sabhai koee tuk chaahan maahi bidaan ||
english: They all apply make-up to their eyes; there is little difference between their objectives.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਜਿਹ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਲੋਇਨ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: giaan a(n)jan jih paaiaa te loin paravaan ||3||
english: But those eyes, to which the ointment of spiritual wisdom is applied, are approved and supreme. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer ab jaaniaa gur giaan deeaa samajhaai ||
english: Says Kabeer, now I know my Lord; the Guru has blessed me with spiritual wisdom.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਅਬ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: a(n)taragat har bhetiaa ab meraa man katahoo na jaai ||4||2||
english: I have met the Lord, and I am emancipated within; now, my mind does not wander at all. ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਰੀ ਤਬ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਾਜ ॥
transliteration: ridh sidh jaa kau phuree tab kaahoo siu kiaa kaaj ||
english: You have riches and miraculous spiritual powers; so what business do you have with anyone else?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਕਹਨੇ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਮੈ ਬੋਲਤ ਹੀ ਬਡ ਲਾਜ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tere kahane kee gat kiaa kahau mai bolat hee bad laaj ||1||
english: What should I say about the reality of your talk? I am embarrassed even to speak to you. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਿਹ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: raam jih paaiaa raam ||
english: One who has found the Lord,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਨ ਬਾਰੈ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: te bhavahi na baarai baar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: does not wander from door to door. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਜਗੁ ਡਹਕੈ ਘਨਾ ਦਿਨ ਦੁਇ ਬਰਤਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
transliteration: jhoothaa jag dahakai ghanaa din dui baratan kee aas ||
english: The false world wanders all around, in hopes of finding wealth to use for a few days.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕੁ ਜਿਹ ਜਨ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਹਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਈ ਪਿਆਸ ॥੨॥
transliteration: raam udak jih jan peeaa tihi bahur na bhaee piaas ||2||
english: That humble being, who drinks in the Lord's water, never becomes thirsty again. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਿਹ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ॥
transliteration: gur prasaad jih boojhiaa aasaa te bhaiaa niraas ||
english: Whoever understands, by Guru's Grace, becomes free of hope in the midst of hope.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਜਉ ਆਤਮ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sabh sach nadaree aaiaa jau aatam bhaiaa udaas ||3||
english: One comes to see the Lord everywhere, when the soul becomes detached. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰ ਤਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: raam naam ras chaakhiaa har naamaa har taar ||
english: I have tasted the sublime essence of the Lord's Name; the Lord's Name carries everyone across.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer ka(n)chan bhaiaa bhram gaiaa samudrai paar ||4||3||
english: Says Kabeer, I have become like gold; doubt is dispelled, and I have crossed over the world-ocean. ||4||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਦਕ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਲਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਖਿਆ ਨਦੀ ਤਰੰਗ ਸਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
transliteration: udak samu(n)d salal kee saakhiaa nadee tara(n)g samaavahige ||
english: Like drops of water in the water of the ocean, and like waves in the stream, I merge in the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਹਿ ਸੁੰਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਪਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: su(n)nahi su(n)n miliaa samadarasee pavan roop hoi jaavahige ||1||
english: Merging my being into the Absolute Being of God, I have become impartial and transparent, like the air. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਹਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
transliteration: bahur ham kaahe aavahige ||
english: Why should I come into the world again?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaanaa hukam tisai kaa hukamai bujh samaavahige ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Coming and going is by the Hukam of His Command; realizing His Hukam, I shall merge in Him. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਚੂਕੈ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੁ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਐਸੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
transliteration: jab chookai pa(n)ch dhaat kee rachanaa aise bharam chukaavahige ||
english: When the body, formed of the five elements, perishes, then any such doubts shall end.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਭਏ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: darasan chhod bhae samadarasee eko naam dhiaavahige ||2||
english: Giving up the different schools of philosophy, I look upon all equally; I meditate only on the One Name. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਤ ਹਮ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਤੈਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
transliteration: jit ham laae tit hee laage taise karam kamaavahige ||
english: Whatever I am attached to, to that I am attached; such are the deeds I do.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਉ ਅਪਨੀ ਤੌ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har jee kripaa kare jau apanee tau gur ke sabad samaavahige ||3||
english: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, then I am merged in the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਹੁ ਮਰਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jeevat marahu marahu phun jeevahu punarap janam na hoee ||
english: Die while yet alive, and by so dying, be alive; thus you shall not be reborn again.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਸੁੰਨ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer jo naam samaane su(n)n rahiaa liv soee ||4||4||
english: Says Kabeer, whoever is absorbed in the Naam remains lovingly absorbed in the Primal, Absolute Lord. ||4||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਹਉ ਤਉ ਤੁਮ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: jau tumh mo kau door karat hau tau tum mukat bataavahu ||
english: If You keep me far away from You, then tell me, what is liberation?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਮਹਿ ਅਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਭਰਮਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ek anek hoi rahio sagal mahi ab kaise bharamaavahu ||1||
english: The One has many forms, and is contained within all; how can I be fooled now? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਤਾਰਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਲੈ ਜਈ ਹੈ ॥
transliteration: raam mo kau taar kahaa(n) lai jaee hai ||
english: O Lord, where will You take me, to save me?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੋਧਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹਾ ਦੇਉ ਕੈਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sodhau mukat kahaa deu kaisee kar prasaad mohi paaee hai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Tell me where, and what sort of liberation shall You give me? By Your Grace, I have already obtained it. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨੁ ਤਬੈ ਲਗੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: taaran taran tabai lag kaheeai jab lag tat na jaaniaa ||
english: People talk of salvation and being saved, as long as they do not understand the essence of reality.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਬਿਮਲ ਭਏ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: ab tau bimal bhae ghat hee mahi kahi kabeer man maaniaa ||2||5||
english: I have now become pure within my heart, says Kabeer, and my mind is pleased and appeased. ||2||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੜ ਕੋਟ ਕੀਏ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ਸੋ ਰਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jin gaR kot keee ka(n)chan ke chhod gaiaa so raavan ||1||
english: Raawan made castles and fortresses of gold, but he had to abandon them when he left. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਕੀਜਤੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kaahe keejat hai man bhaavan ||
english: Why do you act only to please your mind?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਕੇਸ ਤੇ ਪਕਰੈ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jab jam aai kes te pakarai tah har ko naam chhadaavan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: When Death comes and grabs you by the hair, then only the Name of the Lord will save you. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਅਕਾਲੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਕੀਨੑਾ ਇਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਬਧਾਵਨੁ ॥
transliteration: kaal akaal khasam kaa keenhaa ihu parapa(n)ch badhaavan ||
english: Death, and deathlessness are the creations of our Lord and Master; this show, this expanse, is only an entanglement.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇ ਅੰਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨੁ ॥੨॥੬॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer te a(n)te mukate jinh hiradai raam rasaain ||2||6||
english: Says Kabeer, those who have the sublime essence of the Lord in their hearts - in the end, they are liberated. ||2||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੀਉ ਧਰ ਮਹਤਉ ਬਸਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਕਿਰਸਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: dehee gaavaa jeeu dhar mahatau basahi pa(n)ch kirasaanaa ||
english: The body is a village, and the soul is the owner and farmer; the five farm-hands live there.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨੂ ਨਕਟੂ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੂ ਰਸਪਤਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: nainoo nakatoo sravanoo rasapat i(n)dree kahiaa na maanaa ||1||
english: The eyes, nose, ears, tongue and sensory organs of touch do not obey any order. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਅਬ ਨ ਬਸਉ ਇਹ ਗਾਉ ॥
transliteration: baabaa ab na basau ih gaau ||
english: O father, now I shall not live in this village.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਘਰੀ ਘਰੀ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਕਾਇਥੁ ਚੇਤੂ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gharee gharee kaa lekhaa maagai kaaith chetoo naau ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The accountants summoned Chitar and Gupat, the recording scribes of the conscious and the unconscious, to ask for an account of each and every moment. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਬਾਕੀ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: dharam raai jab lekhaa maagai baakee nikasee bhaaree ||
english: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma calls for my account, there shall be a very heavy balance against me.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਾਨਵਾ ਭਾਗਿ ਗਏ ਲੈ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਜੀਉ ਦਰਬਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch krisaanavaa bhaag gae lai baadhio jeeu darabaaree ||2||
english: The five farm-hands shall then run away, and the bailiff shall arrest the soul. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਖੇਤ ਹੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
transliteration: kahai kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu khet hee karahu niberaa ||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: settle your accounts in this farm.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਬਖਸਿ ਬੰਦੇ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥੭॥
transliteration: ab kee baar bakhas ba(n)de kau bahur na bhaujal pheraa ||3||7||
english: O Lord, please forgive Your slave now, in this life, so that he may not have to return again to this terrifying world-ocean. ||3||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag maaroo baanee kabeer jeeu kee ||
english: Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਨਭਉ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
transliteration: anabhau kinai na dekhiaa bairaageeaRe ||
english: No one has seen the Fearless Lord, O renunciate.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਅਨਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin bhai anabhau hoi vanaaha(n)bai ||1||
english: Without the Fear of God, how can the Fearless Lord be obtained? ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਹੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਤਾਂ ਭਉ ਪਵੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
transliteration: sahu hadoor dekhai taa(n) bhau pavai bairaageeaRe ||
english: If one sees the Presence of his Husband Lord near at hand, then he feels the Fear of God, O renunciate.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: hukamai boojhai ta nirabhau hoi vanaaha(n)bai ||2||
english: If he realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then he becomes fearless. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
transliteration: har paakha(n)d na keejaee bairaageeaRe ||
english: Don't practice hypocrisy with the Lord, O renunciate!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: paakha(n)d rataa sabh lok vanaaha(n)bai ||3||
english: The whole world is filled with hypocrisy. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਪਾਸੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
transliteration: trisanaa paas na chhodaee bairaageeaRe ||
english: Thirst and desire do not just go away, O renunciate.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲਿਆ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: mamataa jaaliaa pi(n)d vanaaha(n)bai ||4||
english: The body is burning in the fire of worldly love and attachment. ||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲਿ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਲਿਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
transliteration: chi(n)taa jaal tan jaaliaa bairaageeaRe ||
english: Anxiety is burned, and the body is burned, O renunciate,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੫॥
transliteration: je man miratak hoi vanaaha(n)bai ||5||
english: only if one lets his mind become dead. ||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
transliteration: satigur bin bairaag na hovaee bairaageeaRe ||
english: Without the True Guru, there can be no renunciation,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੬॥
transliteration: je lochai sabh koi vanaaha(n)bai ||6||
english: even though all the people may wish for it. ||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
transliteration: karam hovai satigur milai bairaageeaRe ||
english: When God grants His Grace, one meets the True Guru, O renunciate,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੭॥
transliteration: sahaje paavai soi vanaaha(n)bai ||7||
english: and automatically, intuitively finds that Lord. ||7||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer ik benatee bairaageeaRe ||
english: Says Kabeer, I offer this one prayer, O renunciate.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੮॥੧॥੮॥
transliteration: mo kau bhaujal paar utaar vanaaha(n)bai ||8||1||8||
english: Carry me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||8||1||8||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਨ ਕਉਨੁ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: raajan kaun tumaarai aavai ||
english: O king, who will come to you?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਭਾਉ ਬਿਦਰ ਕੋ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਓਹੁ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aiso bhaau bidar ko dekhio ohu gareeb mohi bhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I have seen such love from Bidur, that the poor man is pleasing to me. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਸਤੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਰਮ ਤੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: hasatee dekh bharam te bhoolaa sree bhagavaan na jaaniaa ||
english: Gazing upon your elephants, you have gone astray in doubt; you do not know the Great Lord God.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੋ ਦੂਧੁ ਬਿਦਰ ਕੋ ਪਾਨੑੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: tumaro doodh bidar ko paanho a(n)mrit kar mai maaniaa ||1||
english: I judge Bidur's water to be like ambrosial nectar, in comparison with your milk. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖੀਰ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਸਾਗੁ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kheer samaan saag mai paaiaa gun gaavat rain bihaanee ||
english: I find his rough vegetables to be like rice pudding; the night of my life passes singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੯॥
transliteration: kabeer ko thaakur anad binodee jaat na kaahoo kee maanee ||2||9||
english: Kabeer's Lord and Master is joyous and blissful; He does not care about anyone's social class. ||2||9||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
transliteration: salok kabeer ||
english: Salok, Kabeer:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗਗਨ ਦਮਾਮਾ ਬਾਜਿਓ ਪਰਿਓ ਨੀਸਾਨੈ ਘਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gagan damaamaa baajio pario neesaanai ghaau ||
english: The battle-drum beats in the sky of the mind; aim is taken, and the wound is inflicted.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖੇਤੁ ਜੁ ਮਾਂਡਿਓ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਅਬ ਜੂਝਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khet j maa(n)dio sooramaa ab joojhan ko daau ||1||
english: The spiritual warriors enter the field of battle; now is the time to fight! ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਾ ਸੋ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ਜੁ ਲਰੈ ਦੀਨ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ॥
transliteration: sooraa so pahichaaneeai j larai deen ke het ||
english: He alone is known as a spiritual hero, who fights in defense of religion.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਜਾ ਪੁਰਜਾ ਕਟਿ ਮਰੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਛਾਡੈ ਖੇਤੁ ॥੨॥੨॥
transliteration: purajaa purajaa kat marai kabahoo na chhaadai khet ||2||2||
english: He may be cut apart, piece by piece, but he never leaves the field of battle. ||2||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: kabeer kaa sabad raag maaroo baanee naamadeu jee kee ||
english: Shabad Of Kabeer, Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਚਾਰੈ ਸਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਦੂਲਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: chaar mukat chaarai sidh mil kai doolah prabh kee saran pario ||
english: I have obtained the four kinds of liberation, and the four miraculous spiritual powers, in the Sanctuary of God, my Husband Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਓ ਚਉਹੂੰ ਜੁਗ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਾਥੈ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਧਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mukat bhaio chauhoo(n) jug jaanio jas keerat maathai chhatr dhario ||1||
english: I am liberated, and famous throughout the four ages; the canopy of praise and fame waves over my head. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਤਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: raajaa raam japat ko ko na tario ||
english: Meditating on the Sovereign Lord God, who has not been saved?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਗਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur upades saadh kee sa(n)gat bhagat bhagat taa ko naam pario ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whoever follows the Guru's Teachings and joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is called the most devoted of the devotees. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਖ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਮਾਲਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਜਮੁ ਡਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)kh chakr maalaa tilak biraajit dekh prataap jam dario ||
english: He is adorned with the conch, the chakra, the mala and the ceremonial tilak mark on his forehead; gazing upon his radiant glory, the Messenger of Death is scared away.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਰਾਮ ਬਲ ਗਰਜਿਤ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਹਿਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
transliteration: nirabhau bhae raam bal garajit janam maran sa(n)taap hirio ||2||
english: He becomes fearless, and the power of the Lord thunders through him; the pains of birth and death are taken away. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਰੀਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਓ ਅਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਭਭੀਖਨ ਅਧਿਕ ਕਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: a(n)bareek kau deeo abhai pad raaj bhabheekhan adhik kario ||
english: The Lord blessed Ambreek with fearless dignity, and elevated Bhabhikhan to become king.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਦਈ ਸੁਦਾਮੈ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਅਟਲੁ ਅਜਹੂ ਨ ਟਰਿਓ ॥੩॥
transliteration: nau nidh thaakur daee sudaamai dhroo atal ajahoo na tario ||3||
english: Sudama's Lord and Master blessed him with the nine treasures; he made Dhroo permanent and unmoving; as the north star, he still hasn't moved. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਹੇਤਿ ਮਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਰੂਪ ਹੋਇ ਦੇਹ ਧਰਿਓ ॥
transliteration: bhagat het maario haranaakhas narasi(n)gh roop hoi deh dhario ||
english: For the sake of His devotee Prahlaad, God assumed the form of the man-lion, and killed Harnaakhash.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਸਿ ਕੇਸਵ ਅਜਹੂੰ ਬਲਿ ਕੇ ਦੁਆਰ ਖਰੋ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naamaa kahai bhagat bas kesav ajahoo(n) bal ke duaar kharo ||4||1||
english: Says Naam Dayv, the beautiful-haired Lord is in the power of His devotees; He is standing at Balraja's door, even now! ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
transliteration: maaroo kabeer jeeu ||
english: Maaroo, Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ਦੀਨੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: deen bisaario re divaane deen bisaario re ||
english: You have forgotten your religion, O madman; you have forgotten your religion.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੇਟੁ ਭਰਿਓ ਪਸੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਸੋਇਓ ਮਨੁਖੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: pet bhario pasooaa jiu soio manukh janam hai haario ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You fill your belly, and sleep like an animal; you have wasted and lost this human life. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਰਚਿਓ ਧੰਧੈ ਝੂਠ ॥
transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kabahoo nahee keenee rachio dha(n)dhai jhooth ||
english: You never joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. You are engrossed in false pursuits.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਨ ਸੂਕਰ ਬਾਇਸ ਜਿਵੈ ਭਟਕਤੁ ਚਾਲਿਓ ਊਠਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: suaan sookar baais jivai bhatakat chaalio ooth ||1||
english: You wander like a dog, a pig, a crow; soon, you shall have to get up and leave. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਦੀਰਘੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਉਰਨ ਕਉ ਲਗ ਮਾਤ ॥
transliteration: aapas kau deeragh kar jaanai auran kau lag maat ||
english: You believe that you yourself are great, and that others are small.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਬਾਚਾ ਕਰਮਨਾ ਮੈ ਦੇਖੇ ਦੋਜਕ ਜਾਤ ॥੨॥
transliteration: manasaa baachaa karamanaa mai dekhe dojak jaat ||2||
english: Those who are false in thought, word and deed, I have seen them going to hell. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੀ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੀ ਚਾਤੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਬੇਕਾਮ ॥
transliteration: kaamee krodhee chaaturee baajeegar bekaam ||
english: The lustful, the angry, the clever, the deceitful and the lazy

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਨੋ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਰਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: ni(n)daa karate janam siraano kabahoo na simario raam ||3||
english: waste their lives in slander, and never remember their Lord in meditation. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਹੀ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer chetai nahee moorakh mugadh gavaar ||
english: Says Kabeer, the fools, the idiots and the brutes do not remember the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam jaanio nahee kaise utaras paar ||4||1||
english: They do not know the Lord's Name; how can they be carried across? ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag maaroo baanee jaideu jeeu kee ||
english: Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Jai Dayv Jee:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਚੰਦ ਸਤ ਭੇਦਿਆ ਨਾਦ ਸਤ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਸੂਰ ਸਤ ਖੋੜਸਾ ਦਤੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: cha(n)d sat bhediaa naad sat pooriaa soor sat khoRasaa dat keeaa ||
english: The breath is drawn in through the left nostril; it is held in the central channel of the Sushmanaa, and exhaled through the right nostril, repeating the Lord's Name sixteen times.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਬਲ ਬਲੁ ਤੋੜਿਆ ਅਚਲ ਚਲੁ ਥਪਿਆ ਅਘੜੁ ਘੜਿਆ ਤਹਾ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: abal bal toRiaa achal chal thapiaa aghaR ghaRiaa tahaa apiu peeaa ||1||
english: I am powerless; my power has been broken. My unstable mind has been stabliized, and my unadorned soul has been adorned. I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਆਦਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਦਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: man aad gun aad vakhaaniaa ||
english: Within my mind, I chant the Name of the Primal Lord God, the Source of virtue.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੰਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: teree dubidhaa drisat sa(n)maaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: My vision, that You are I are separate, has melted away. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਰਧਿ ਕਉ ਅਰਧਿਆ ਸਰਧਿ ਕਉ ਸਰਧਿਆ ਸਲਲ ਕਉ ਸਲਲਿ ਸੰਮਾਨਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: aradh kau aradhiaa saradh kau saradhiaa salal kau salal sa(n)maan aaiaa ||
english: I worship the One who is worthy of being worshipped. I trust the One who is worthy of being trusted. Like water merging in water, I merge in the Lord.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਦਤਿ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਜੈਦੇਵ ਕਉ ਰੰਮਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: badat jaideu jaidev kau ra(n)miaa braham nirabaan liv leen paaiaa ||2||1||
english: Says Jai Dayv, I meditate and contemplate the Luminous, Triumphant Lord. I am lovingly absorbed in the Nirvaanaa of God. ||2||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥ ਮਾਰੂ ॥
transliteration: kabeer || maaroo ||
english: Kabeer, Maaroo:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰੁ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿਗਾ ਮਨ ॥
transliteration: raam simar pachhutaahigaa man ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord, or else you will regret it in the end, O mind.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: paapee jeearaa lobh karat hai aaj kaal uth jaahigaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O sinful soul, you act in greed, but today or tomorrow, you will have to get up and leave. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਹਿਗਾ ॥
transliteration: laalach laage janam gavaaiaa maaiaa bharam bhulaahigaa ||
english: Clinging to greed, you have wasted your life, deluded in the doubt of Maya.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਕਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਾਗਦ ਜਿਉ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dhan joban kaa garab na keejai kaagad jiu gal jaahigaa ||1||
english: Do not take pride in your wealth and youth; you shall crumble apart like dry paper. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਕੇਸ ਗਹਿ ਪਟਕੈ ਤਾ ਦਿਨ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਹਿਗਾ ॥
transliteration: jau jam aai kes gahi patakai taa din kichh na basaahigaa ||
english: When the Messenger of Death comes and grabs you by the hair, and knocks you down, on that day, you shall be powerless.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਭਜਨੁ ਦਇਆ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਤਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹਿਗਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: simaran bhajan daiaa nahee keenee tau mukh chotaa khaahigaa ||2||
english: You do not remember the Lord, or vibrate upon Him in meditation, and you do not practice compassion; you shall be beaten on your face. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਖੁ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ॥
transliteration: dharam raai jab lekhaa maagai kiaa mukh lai kai jaahigaa ||
english: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma calls for your account, what face will you show Him then?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਰਿ ਜਾਂਹਿਗਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu saadhasa(n)gat tar jaa(n)higaa ||3||1||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be saved. ||3||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag maaroo baanee ravidaas jeeu kee ||
english: Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਲਾਲ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: aisee laal tujh bin kaun karai ||
english: O Love, who else but You could do such a thing?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜੁ ਗੁਸਈਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਥੈ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਧਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gareeb nivaaj gusaeeaa meraa maathai chhatr dharai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Patron of the poor, Lord of the World, You have put the canopy of Your Grace over my head. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਛੋਤਿ ਜਗਤ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਪਰ ਤੁਹਂੀ ਢਰੈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kee chhot jagat kau laagai taa par tuha(n)ee dharai ||
english: Only You can grant Mercy to that person whose touch pollutes the world.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨੀਚਹ ਊਚ ਕਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਾਹੂ ਤੇ ਨ ਡਰੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: neechah ooch karai meraa gobi(n)d kaahoo te na darai ||1||
english: You exalt and elevate the lowly, O my Lord of the Universe; You are not afraid of anyone. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਸਧਨਾ ਸੈਨੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
transliteration: naamadev kabeer tilochan sadhanaa sain tarai ||
english: Naam Dayv, Kabeer, Trilochan, Sadhana and Sain crossed over.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇ ਸਭੈ ਸਰੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas sunahu re sa(n)tahu har jeeu te sabhai sarai ||2||1||
english: Says Ravi Daas, listen, O Saints, through the Dear Lord, all is accomplished. ||2||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ॥
transliteration: maaroo ||
english: Maaroo:

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਰਿਤਰੁ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਨ ਬਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagar suritar chi(n)taaman kaamadhen bas jaa ke re ||
english: The Lord is the ocean of peace; the miraculous tree of life, the jewel of miracles and the wish-fulfilling cow are all under His power.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਮਹਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: chaar padaarath asat mahaa sidh nav nidh kar tal taa kai ||1||
english: The four great blessings, the eight great miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures are in the palm of His hand. ||1||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਜਪਸਿ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
transliteration: har har har na japas rasanaa ||
english: Why don't you chant the Lord's Name, Har, Har, Har?

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਛਾਡਿ ਬਚਨ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: avar sabh chhaad bachan rachanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Abandon all other devices of words. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਖਿਆਨ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਉਤੀਸ ਅਛਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: naanaa khiaan puraan bed bidh chautees achhar maahee ||
english: The many epics, the Puraanas and the Vedas are all composed out of the letters of the alphabet.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਸ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਕਹਿਓ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: biaas beechaar kahio paramaarath raam naam sar naahee ||2||
english: After careful thought, Vyaasa spoke the supreme truth, that there is nothing equal to the Lord's Name. ||2||

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਹੋਇ ਬਡੇ ਭਾਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: sahaj samaadh upaadh rahat hoi bade bhaag liv laagee ||
english: In intuitive Samaadhi, their troubles are eliminated; the very fortunate ones lovingly focus on the Lord.

author: Bhagat Ravidas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਮਤਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਭੈ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੫॥
transliteration: kahi ravidaas udaas daas mat janam maran bhai bhaagee ||3||2||15||
english: Says Ravi Daas, the Lord's slave remains detached from the world; the fear of birth and death runs away from his mind. ||3||2||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹਾ ॥
transliteration: tukhaaree chha(n)t mahalaa 1 baarah maahaa ||
english: Tukhaari Chhant, First Mehl, Baarah Maahaa ~ The Twelve Months:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਿਰਤ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: too sun kirat kara(n)maa purab kamaaiaa ||
english: Listen: according to the karma of their past actions,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹੰਮਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਤੂ ਭਲਾ ॥
transliteration: sir sir sukh saha(n)maa dehi s too bhalaa ||
english: Each and every person experiences happiness or sorrow; whatever You give, Lord, is good.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਚਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
transliteration: har rachanaa teree kiaa gat meree har bin ghaRee na jeevaa ||
english: O Lord, the Created Universe is Yours; what is my condition? Without the Lord, I cannot survive, even for an instant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਾਝੁ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੇਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾਂ ॥
transliteration: pri baajh duhelee koi na belee guramukh a(n)mrit peevaa(n) ||
english: Without my Beloved, I am miserable; I have no friend at all. As Gurmukh, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਚਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਿ ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: rachanaa raach rahe nira(n)kaaree prabh man karam sukaramaa ||
english: The Formless Lord is contained in His Creation. To obey God is the best course of action.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak pa(n)th nihaale saa dhan too sun aatam raamaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, the soul-bride is gazing upon Your Path; please listen, O Supreme Soul. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਬੋਲੇ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਬਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: baabeehaa priu bole kokil baaneeaa ||
english: The rainbird cries out, "Pri-o! Beloved!", and the song-bird sings the Lord's Bani.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਚੋਲੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
transliteration: saa dhan sabh ras cholai a(n)k samaaneeaa ||
english: The soul-bride enjoys all the pleasures, and merges in the Being of her Beloved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har a(n)k samaanee jaa prabh bhaanee saa sohaagan naare ||
english: She merges into the Being of her Beloved, when she becomes pleasing to God; she is the happy, blessed soul-bride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਘਰ ਥਾਪਿ ਮਹਲ ਘਰੁ ਊਚਉ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: nav ghar thaap mahal ghar oochau nij ghar vaas muraare ||
english: Establishing the nine houses, and the Royal Mansion of the Tenth Gate above them, the Lord dwells in that home deep within the self.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sabh teree too meraa preetam nis baasur ra(n)g raavai ||
english: All are Yours, You are my Beloved; night and day, I celebrate Your Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਚਵੈ ਬਬੀਹਾ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak priu priu chavai babeehaa kokil sabad suhaavai ||2||
english: O Nanak, the rainbird cries out, "Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!" The song-bird is embellished with the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭਿੰਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
transliteration: too sun har ras bhi(n)ne preetam aapane ||
english: Please listen, O my Beloved Lord - I am drenched with Your Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਤ ਰਵੰਨੇ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਬੀਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: man tan ravat rava(n)ne ghaRee na beesarai ||
english: My mind and body are absorbed in dwelling on You; I cannot forget You, even for an instant.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਘੜੀ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kiu ghaRee bisaaree hau balihaaree hau jeevaa gun gaae ||
english: How could I forget You, even for an instant? I am a sacrifice to You; singing Your Glorious Praises, I live.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naa koee meraa hau kis keraa har bin rahan na jaae ||
english: No one is mine; unto whom do I belong? Without the Lord, I cannot survive.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸੇ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ot gahee har charan nivaase bhae pavitr sareeraa ||
english: I have grasped the Support of the Lord's Feet; dwelling there, my body has become immaculate.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੀਰਘ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak drisat deeragh sukh paavai gurasabadee man dheeraa ||3||
english: O Nanak, I have obtained profound insight, and found peace; my mind is comforted by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਰਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ॥
transliteration: barasai a(n)mrit dhaar boo(n)d suhaavanee ||
english: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down on us! Its drops are so delightful!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਣੀ ॥
transliteration: saajan mile sahaj subhaai har siu preet banee ||
english: Meeting the Guru, the Best Friend, with intuitive ease, the mortal falls in love with the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਧਨ ਊਭੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har ma(n)dar aavai jaa prabh bhaavai dhan oobhee gun saaree ||
english: The Lord comes into the temple of the body, when it pleases God's Will; the soul-bride rises up, and sings His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: ghar ghar ka(n)t ravai sohaagan hau kiu ka(n)t visaaree ||
english: In each and every home, the Husband Lord ravishes and enjoys the happy soul-brides; so why has He forgotten me?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਉਨਵਿ ਘਨ ਛਾਏ ਬਰਸੁ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: unav ghan chhaae baras subhaae man tan prem sukhaavai ||
english: The sky is overcast with heavy, low-hanging clouds; the rain is delightful, and my Beloved's Love is pleasing to my mind and body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਰਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak varasai a(n)mrit baanee kar kirapaa ghar aavai ||4||
english: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Nectar of Gurbani rains down; the Lord, in His Grace, has come into the home of my heart. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚੇਤੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਭਵਰ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੇ ॥
transliteration: chet basa(n)t bhalaa bhavar suhaavaRe ||
english: In the month of Chayt, the lovely spring has come, and the bumble bees hum with joy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਨ ਫੂਲੇ ਮੰਝ ਬਾਰਿ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜੈ ॥
transliteration: ban phoole ma(n)jh baar mai pir ghar baahuRai ||
english: The forest is blossoming in front of my door; if only my Beloved would return to my home!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਧਨ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: pir ghar nahee aavai dhan kiu sukh paavai birahi birodh tan chheejai ||
english: If her Husband Lord does not return home, how can the soul-bride find peace? Her body is wasting away with the sorrow of separation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੋਕਿਲ ਅੰਬਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਬੋਲੈ ਕਿਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਹੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: kokil a(n)b suhaavee bolai kiu dukh a(n)k saheejai ||
english: The beautiful song-bird sings, perched on the mango tree; but how can I endure the pain in the depths of my being?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਵਰੁ ਭਵੰਤਾ ਫੂਲੀ ਡਾਲੀ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: bhavar bhava(n)taa phoolee daalee kiu jeevaa mar maae ||
english: The bumble bee is buzzing around the flowering branches; but how can I survive? I am dying, O my mother!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚੇਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਧਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak chet sahaj sukh paavai je har var ghar dhan paae ||5||
english: O Nanak, in Chayt, peace is easily obtained, if the soul-bride obtains the Lord as her Husband, within the home of her own heart. ||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵੈਸਾਖੁ ਭਲਾ ਸਾਖਾ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: vaisaakh bhalaa saakhaa ves kare ||
english: Vaisakhi is so pleasant; the branches blossom with new leaves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: dhan dekhai har duaar aavahu daiaa kare ||
english: The soul-bride yearns to see the Lord at her door. Come, O Lord, and take pity on me!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਆਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੁਤਰ ਤਾਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਢੁ ਨ ਮੋਲੋ ॥
transliteration: ghar aau piaare dutar taare tudh bin adh na molo ||
english: Please come home, O my Beloved; carry me across the treacherous world-ocean. Without You, I am not worth even a shell.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਕਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾਂ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਢੋਲੋ ॥
transliteration: keemat kaun kare tudh bhaavaa(n) dekh dikhaavai dholo ||
english: Who can estimate my worth, if I am pleasing to You? I see You, and inspire others to see You, O my Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: door na jaanaa a(n)tar maanaa har kaa mahal pachhaanaa ||
english: I know that You are not far away; I believe that You are deep within me, and I realize Your Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੈਸਾਖੀਂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak vaisaakhee(n) prabh paavai surat sabad man maanaa ||6||
english: O Nanak, finding God in Vaisakhi, the consciousness is filled with the Word of the Shabad, and the mind comes to believe. ||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਹੁ ਜੇਠੁ ਭਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ॥
transliteration: maahu jeth bhalaa preetam kiu bisarai ||
english: The month of Jayt'h is so sublime. How could I forget my Beloved?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਥਲ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਸਰ ਭਾਰ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: thal taapahi sar bhaar saa dhan binau karai ||
english: The earth burns like a furnace, and the soul-bride offers her prayer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੇਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: dhan binau karedee gun saaredee gun saaree prabh bhaavaa ||
english: The bride offers her prayer, and sings His Glorious Praises; singing His Praises, she becomes pleasing to God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਆਵਣ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਆਵਾ ॥
transliteration: saachai mahal rahai bairaagee aavan dehi ta aavaa ||
english: The Unattached Lord dwells in His true mansion. If He allows me, then I will come to Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਨਿਤਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਮਹਲੀ ॥
transliteration: nimaanee nitaanee har bin kiu paavai sukh mahalee ||
english: The bride is dishonored and powerless; how will she find peace without her Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇਠਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੈਸੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਹਿਲੀ ॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak jeth jaanai tis jaisee karam milai gun gahilee ||7||
english: O Nanak, in Jayt'h, she who knows her Lord becomes just like Him; grasping virtue, she meets with the Merciful Lord. ||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਗਗਨਿ ਤਪੈ ॥
transliteration: aasaaR bhalaa sooraj gagan tapai ||
english: The month of Aasaarh is good; the sun blazes in the sky.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਦੂਖ ਸਹੈ ਸੋਖੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ॥
transliteration: dharatee dookh sahai sokhai agan bhakhai ||
english: The earth suffers in pain, parched and roasted in the fire.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਸੋਖੈ ਮਰੀਐ ਧੋਖੈ ਭੀ ਸੋ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: agan ras sokhai mareeai dhokhai bhee so kirat na haare ||
english: The fire dries up the moisture, and she dies in agony. But even then, the sun does not grow tired.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਥੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਛਾਇਆ ਧਨ ਤਾਕੈ ਟੀਡੁ ਲਵੈ ਮੰਝਿ ਬਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: rath phirai chhaaiaa dhan taakai teed lavai ma(n)jh baare ||
english: His chariot moves on, and the soul-bride seeks shade; the crickets are chirping in the forest.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਬਾਧਿ ਚਲੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: avagan baadh chalee dukh aagai sukh tis saach samaale ||
english: She ties up her bundle of faults and demerits, and suffers in the world hereafter. But dwelling on the True Lord, she finds peace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਮਰਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak jis no ihu man deeaa maran jeevan prabh naale ||8||
english: O Nanak, I have given this mind to Him; death and life rest with God. ||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਸਰਸ ਮਨਾ ਘਣ ਵਰਸਹਿ ਰੁਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: saavan saras manaa ghan varasahi rut aae ||
english: In Saawan, be happy, O my mind. The rainy season has come, and the clouds have burst into showers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਹੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਿਰ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਸਿਧਾਏ ॥
transliteration: mai man tan sahu bhaavai pir parades sidhaae ||
english: My mind and body are pleased by my Lord, but my Beloved has gone away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਮਰੀਐ ਹਾਵੈ ਦਾਮਨਿ ਚਮਕਿ ਡਰਾਏ ॥
transliteration: pir ghar nahee aavai mareeai haavai daaman chamak daraae ||
english: My Beloved has not come home, and I am dying of the sorrow of separation. The lightning flashes, and I am scared.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਇਕੇਲੀ ਖਰੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: sej ikelee kharee duhelee maran bhaiaa dukh maae ||
english: My bed is lonely, and I am suffering in agony. I am dying in pain, O my mother!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਦ ਭੂਖ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੀ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਤਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: har bin need bhookh kahu kaisee kaapaR tan na sukhaavae ||
english: Tell me - without the Lord, how can I sleep, or feel hungry? My clothes give no comfort to my body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਕੰਤੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak saa sohaagan ka(n)tee pir kai a(n)k samaavae ||9||
english: O Nanak, she alone is a happy soul-bride, who merges in the Being of her Beloved Husband Lord. ||9||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਾਦਉ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: bhaadau bharam bhulee bhar joban pachhutaanee ||
english: In Bhaadon, the young woman is confused by doubt; later, she regrets and repents.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਬਰਸ ਰੁਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jal thal neer bhare baras rute ra(n)g maanee ||
english: The lakes and fields are overflowing with water; the rainy season has come - the time to celebrate!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਰਸੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਕਾਲੀ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਾਲੀ ਦਾਦਰ ਮੋਰ ਲਵੰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: barasai nis kaalee kiu sukh baalee daadar mor lava(n)te ||
english: In the dark of night it rains; how can the young bride find peace? The frogs and peacocks send out their noisy calls.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਚਵੈ ਬਬੀਹਾ ਬੋਲੇ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਡਸੰਤੇ ॥
transliteration: priu priu chavai babeehaa bole bhuia(n)gam phirahi dasa(n)te ||
english: "Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!" cries the rainbird, while the snakes slither around, biting.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਛਰ ਡੰਗ ਸਾਇਰ ਭਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: machhar da(n)g saair bhar subhar bin har kiu sukh paaeeai ||
english: The mosquitoes bite and sting, and the ponds are filled to overflowing; without the Lord, how can she find peace?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਛਿ ਚਲਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਹ ਹੀ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak poochh chalau gur apune jah prabh tah hee jaaeeai ||10||
english: O Nanak, I will go and ask my Guru; wherever God is, there I will go. ||10||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਸੁਨਿ ਆਉ ਪਿਰਾ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਝੂਰਿ ਮੁਈ ॥
transliteration: asun aau piraa saa dhan jhoor muee ||
english: In Assu, come, my Beloved; the soul-bride is grieving to death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਈ ॥
transliteration: taa mileeai prabh mele doojai bhaai khuee ||
english: She can only meet Him, when God leads her to meet Him; she is ruined by the love of duality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਤਾ ਪਿਰ ਮੁਤੀ ਕੁਕਹ ਕਾਹ ਸਿ ਫੁਲੇ ॥
transliteration: jhooth vigutee taa pir mutee kukah kaah s phule ||
english: If she is plundered by falsehood, then her Beloved forsakes her. Then, the white flowers of old age blossom in my hair.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਘਾਮ ਪਿਛੈ ਰੁਤਿ ਜਾਡਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਤ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲੇ ॥
transliteration: aagai ghaam pichhai rut jaadaa dekh chalat man dole ||
english: Summer is now behind us, and the winter season is ahead. Gazing upon this play, my shaky mind wavers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਸਾਖ ਹਰੀ ਹਰੀਆਵਲ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਕੈ ਸੋ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
transliteration: dah dis saakh haree hareeaaval sahaj pakai so meethaa ||
english: In all ten directions, the branches are green and alive. That which ripens slowly, is sweet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਸੁਨਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak asun milahu piaare satigur bhae baseethaa ||11||
english: O Nanak, in Assu, please meet me, my Beloved. The True Guru has become my Advocate and Friend. ||11||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਤਕਿ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: katak kirat paiaa jo prabh bhaaiaa ||
english: In Katak, that alone comes to pass, which is pleasing to the Will of God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਬਲੈ ਤਤਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: deepak sahaj balai tat jalaaiaa ||
english: The lamp of intuition burns, lit by the essence of reality.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕ ਰਸ ਤੇਲੋ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਮੇਲੋ ਧਨ ਓਮਾਹੈ ਸਰਸੀ ॥
transliteration: deepak ras telo dhan pir melo dhan omaahai sarasee ||
english: Love is the oil in the lamp, which unites the soul-bride with her Lord. The bride is delighted, in ecstasy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਮਾਰੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਸੀਝੈ ਗੁਣਿ ਮਾਰੀ ਤਾ ਮਰਸੀ ॥
transliteration: avagan maaree marai na seejhai gun maaree taa marasee ||
english: One who dies in faults and demerits - her death is not successful. But one who dies in glorious virtue, really truly dies.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਦੇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਅਜਹੁ ਤਿਨਾੜੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
transliteration: naam bhagat de nij ghar baithe ajahu tinaaRee aasaa ||
english: Those who are blessed with devotional worship of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, sit in the home of their own inner being. They place their hopes in You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਕਪਟ ਦਰ ਖੋਲਹੁ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਖਟੁ ਮਾਸਾ ॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak milahu kapat dar kholahu ek ghaRee khat maasaa ||12||
english: Nanak: please open the shutters of Your Door, O Lord, and meet me. A single moment is like six months to me. ||12||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੰਘਰ ਮਾਹੁ ਭਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: ma(n)ghar maahu bhalaa har gun a(n)k samaavae ||
english: The month of Maghar is good, for those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and merge in His Being.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: gunava(n)tee gun ravai mai pir nihachal bhaavae ||
english: The virtuous wife utters His Glorious Praises; my Beloved Husband Lord is Eternal and Unchanging.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: nihachal chatur sujaan bidhaataa cha(n)chal jagat sabaaiaa ||
english: The Primal Lord is Unmoving and Unchanging, Clever and Wise; all the world is fickle.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੇ ਤਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: giaan dhiaan gun a(n)k samaane prabh bhaane taa bhaaiaa ||
english: By virtue of spiritual wisdom and meditation, she merges in His Being; she is pleasing to God, and He is pleasing to her.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਕਵਿਤ ਕਵੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: geet naad kavit kave sun raam naam dukh bhaagai ||
english: I have heard the songs and the music, and the poems of the poets; but only the Name of the Lord takes away my pain.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਅਭ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਿਰ ਆਗੈ ॥੧੩॥
transliteration: naanak saa dhan naah piaaree abh bhagatee pir aagai ||13||
english: O Nanak, that soul-bride is pleasing to her Husband Lord, who performs loving devotional worship before her Beloved. ||13||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੋਖਿ ਤੁਖਾਰੁ ਪੜੈ ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਰਸੁ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
transliteration: pokh tukhaar paRai van trin ras sokhai ||
english: In Poh, the snow falls, and the sap of the trees and the fields dries up.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਕੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਮੁਖੇ ॥
transliteration: aavat kee naahee man tan vasahi mukhe ||
english: Why have You not come? I keep You in my mind, body and mouth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: man tan rav rahiaa jagajeevan gurasabadee ra(n)g maanee ||
english: He is permeating and pervading my mind and body; He is the Life of the World. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I enjoy His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: a(n)daj jeraj setaj utabhuj ghat ghat jot samaanee ||
english: His Light fills all those born of eggs, born from the womb, born of sweat and born of the earth, each and every heart.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹੋ ॥
transliteration: darasan dehu daiaapat daate gat paavau mat deho ||
english: Grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Lord of Mercy and Compassion. O Great Giver, grant me understanding, that I might find salvation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੈ ਰਸਿ ਰਸੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਨੇਹੋ ॥੧੪॥
transliteration: naanak ra(n)g ravai ras raseeaa har siu preet saneho ||14||
english: O Nanak, the Lord enjoys, savors and ravishes the bride who is in love with Him. ||14||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਘਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਈ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: maagh puneet bhaee teerath a(n)tar jaaniaa ||
english: In Maagh, I become pure; I know that the sacred shrine of pilgrimage is within me.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਹਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: saajan sahaj mile gun gahi a(n)k samaaniaa ||
english: I have met my Friend with intuitive ease; I grasp His Glorious Virtues, and merge in His Being.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਕੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੰਕੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: preetam gun a(n)ke sun prabh ba(n)ke tudh bhaavaa sar naavaa ||
english: O my Beloved, Beauteous Lord God, please listen: I sing Your Glories, and merge in Your Being. If it is pleasing to Your Will, I bathe in the sacred pool within.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੰਗ ਜਮੁਨ ਤਹ ਬੇਣੀ ਸੰਗਮ ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥
transliteration: ga(n)g jamun tah benee sa(n)gam saat samu(n)d samaavaa ||
english: The Ganges, Jamunaa, the sacred meeting place of the three rivers, the seven seas,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: pu(n)n daan poojaa paramesur jug jug eko jaataa ||
english: Charity, donations, adoration and worship all rest in the Transcendent Lord God; throughout the ages, I realize the One.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਘਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਤਾ ॥੧੫॥
transliteration: naanak maagh mahaa ras har jap athasath teerath naataa ||15||
english: O Nanak, in Maagh, the most sublime essence is meditation on the Lord; this is the cleansing bath of the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||15||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਫਲਗੁਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਹਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: phalagun man rahasee prem subhaaiaa ||
english: In Phalgun, her mind is enraptured, pleased by the Love of her Beloved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: anadin rahas bhaiaa aap gavaaiaa ||
english: Night and day, she is enraptured, and her selfishness is gone.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਓ ॥
transliteration: man mohu chukaaiaa jaa tis bhaaiaa kar kirapaa ghar aao ||
english: Emotional attachment is eradicated from her mind, when it pleases Him; in His Mercy, He comes to my home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਮਹਲੀ ਲਹਾ ਨ ਥਾਓ ॥
transliteration: bahute ves karee pir baajhahu mahalee lahaa na thaao ||
english: I dress in various clothes, but without my Beloved, I shall not find a place in the Mansion of His Presence.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਾਰ ਡੋਰ ਰਸ ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਪਿਰਿ ਲੋੜੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: haar dor ras paat pata(n)bar pir loRee seegaaree ||
english: I have adorned myself with garlands of flowers, pearl necklaces, scented oils and silk robes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
transliteration: naanak mel laee gur apanai ghar var paaiaa naaree ||16||
english: O Nanak, the Guru has united me with Him. The soul-bride has found her Husband Lord, within the home of her own heart. ||16||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੇ ਦਸ ਮਾਹ ਰੁਤੀ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਭਲੇ ॥
transliteration: be das maah rutee thitee vaar bhale ||
english: The twelve months, the seasons, the weeks, the days, the hours, the minutes and the seconds are all sublime,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘੜੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਪਲ ਸਾਚੇ ਆਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥
transliteration: ghaRee moorat pal saache aae sahaj mile ||
english: When the True Lord comes and meets her with natural ease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: prabh mile piaare kaaraj saare karataa sabh bidh jaanai ||
english: God, my Beloved, has met me, and my affairs are all resolved. The Creator Lord knows all ways and means.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: jin seegaaree tisahi piaaree mel bhaiaa ra(n)g maanai ||
english: I am loved by the One who has embellished and exalted me; I have met Him, and I savor His Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੋ ॥
transliteration: ghar sej suhaavee jaa pir raavee guramukh masatak bhaago ||
english: The bed of my heart becomes beautiful, when my Husband Lord ravishes me. As Gurmukh, the destiny on my forehead has been awakened and activated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੋ ॥੧੭॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak ahinis raavai preetam har var thir sohaago ||17||1||
english: O Nanak, day and night, my Beloved enjoys me; with the Lord as my Husband, my Marriage is Eternal. ||17||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: tukhaaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Tukhaari, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਨੈਣ ਸਲੋਨੜੀਏ ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: pahilai paharai nain salonaReee rain a(n)dhiaaree raam ||
english: In the first watch of the dark night, O bride of splendored eyes,

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਖਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੁਈਏ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: vakhar raakh mueee aavai vaaree raam ||
english: protect your riches; your turn is coming soon.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਕਵਣੁ ਜਗਾਵੈ ਸੂਤੀ ਜਮ ਰਸੁ ਚੂਸਏ ॥
transliteration: vaaree aavai kavan jagaavai sootee jam ras choosae ||
english: When your turn comes, who will wake you? While you sleep, your juice shall be sucked out by the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧੇਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਪਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਚੋਰੁ ਪੜੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੂਸਏ ॥
transliteration: rain a(n)dheree kiaa pat teree chor paRai ghar moosae ||
english: The night is so dark; what will become of your honor? The thieves will break into your home and rob you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
transliteration: raakhanahaaraa agam apaaraa sun bena(n)tee mereeaa ||
english: O Saviour Lord, Inaccessible and Infinite, please hear my prayer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਸੂਝੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧੇਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak moorakh kabahi na chetai kiaa soojhai rain a(n)dhereeaa ||1||
english: O Nanak, the fool never remembers Him; what can he see in the dark of night? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਪਹਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਾਗੁ ਅਚੇਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: doojaa pahar bhaiaa jaag achetee raam ||
english: The second watch has begun; wake up, you unconscious being!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਖਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੁਈਏ ਖਾਜੈ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: vakhar raakh mueee khaajai khetee raam ||
english: Protect your riches, O mortal; your farm is being eaten.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਖੇਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਹੇਤੀ ਜਾਗਤ ਚੋਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: raakhahu khetee har gur hetee jaagat chor na laagai ||
english: Protect your crops, and love the Lord, the Guru. Stay awake and aware, and the thieves shall not rob you.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
transliteration: jam mag na jaavahu naa dukh paavahu jam kaa dar bhau bhaagai ||
english: You shall not have to go on the path of Death, and you shall not suffer in pain; your fear and terror of death shall run away.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਵਏ ॥
transliteration: rav sas deepak guramat duaarai man saachaa mukh dhiaavae ||
english: The lamps of the sun and the moon are lit by the Guru's Teachings, through His Door, meditating on the True Lord, in the mind and with the mouth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਅਜਹੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਕਿਵ ਦੂਜੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak moorakh ajahu na chetai kiv doojai sukh paavae ||2||
english: O Nanak, the fool still does not remember the Lord. How can he find peace in duality? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੀਜਾ ਪਹਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਨੀਦ ਵਿਆਪੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: teejaa pahar bhaiaa need viaapee raam ||
english: The third watch has begun, and sleep has set in.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਦੂਖਿ ਸੰਤਾਪੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa sut daaraa dookh sa(n)taapee raam ||
english: The mortal suffers in pain, from attachment to Maya, children and spouse.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਫਾਸੈ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa sut daaraa jagat piaaraa chog chugai nit phaasai ||
english: Maya, his children, his wife and the world are so dear to him; he bites the bait, and is caught.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਾਸੈ ॥
transliteration: naam dhiaavai taa sukh paavai guramat kaal na graasai ||
english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he shall find peace; following the Guru's Teachings, he shall not be seized by death.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਛੋਡੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੰਤਾਪੀ ॥
transliteration: ja(n)man maran kaal nahee chhodai vin naavai sa(n)taapee ||
english: He cannot escape from birth, dying and death; without the Name, he suffers.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੀਜੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਲੋਕਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak teejai tribidh lokaa maaiaa mohi viaapee ||3||
english: O Nanak, in the third watch of the three-phased Maya, the world is engrossed in attachment to Maya. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥਾ ਪਹਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਦਉਤੁ ਬਿਹਾਗੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: chauthaa pahar bhaiaa daut bihaagai raam ||
english: The fourth watch has begun, and the day is about to dawn.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਅੜਾ ਜੋੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: tin ghar raakhiaRaa jou anadin jaagai raam ||
english: Those who remain awake and aware, night and day, preserve and protect their homes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gur poochh jaage naam laage tinaa rain suheleeaa ||
english: The night is pleasant and peaceful, for those who remain awake; following the Guru's advice, they focus on the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਲੀਆ ॥
transliteration: gurasabad kamaavahi janam na aavahi tinaa har prabh beleeaa ||
english: Those who practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad are not reincarnated again; the Lord God is their Best Friend.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਕੰਪਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੰਪੈ ਨੈਣ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮ ਸੇ ॥
transliteration: kar ka(n)p charan sareer ka(n)pai nain a(n)dhule tan bhasam se ||
english: The hands shake, the feet and body totter, the vision goes dark, and the body turns to dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੇ ॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak dukheeaa jug chaare bin naam har ke man vase ||4||
english: O Nanak, people are miserable throughout the four ages, if the Name of the Lord does not abide in the mind. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੂਲੀ ਗੰਠਿ ਉਠੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: khoolee ga(n)th utho likhiaa aaiaa raam ||
english: The knot has been untied; rise up - the order has come!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸੁਖ ਠਾਕੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ras kas sukh thaake ba(n)dh chalaaiaa raam ||
english: Pleasures and comforts are gone; like a prisoner, you are driven on.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਨਾ ਸੁਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: ba(n)dh chalaaiaa jaa prabh bhaaiaa naa deesai naa suneeai ||
english: You shall be bound and gagged, when it pleases God; you will not see or hear it coming.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪਣ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਭਸੈ ਆਵੈ ਪਕੀ ਖੇਤੀ ਲੁਣੀਐ ॥
transliteration: aapan vaaree sabhasai aavai pakee khetee luneeai ||
english: Everyone will have their turn; the crop ripens, and then it is cut down.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘੜੀ ਚਸੇ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਹੁ ਜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: ghaRee chase kaa lekhaa leejai buraa bhalaa sahu jeeaa ||
english: The account is kept for every second, every instant; the soul suffers for the bad and the good.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥੫॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak sur nar sabad milaae tin prabh kaaran keeaa ||5||2||
english: O Nanak, the angelic beings are united with the Word of the Shabad; this is the way God made it. ||5||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: tukhaaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Tukhaari, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਾਰਾ ਚੜਿਆ ਲੰਮਾ ਕਿਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: taaraa chaRiaa la(n)maa kiu nadar nihaaliaa raam ||
english: The meteor shoots across the sky. How can it be seen with the eyes?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: sevak poor kara(n)maa satigur sabad dikhaaliaa raam ||
english: The True Guru reveals the Word of the Shabad to His servant who has such perfect karma.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: gur sabad dikhaaliaa sach samaaliaa ahinis dekh beechaariaa ||
english: The Guru reveals the Shabad; dwelling on the True Lord, day and night, he beholds and reflects on God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤ ਪੰਚ ਰਹੇ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: dhaavat pa(n)ch rahe ghar jaaniaa kaam krodh bikh maariaa ||
english: The five restless desires are restrained, and he knows the home of his own heart. He conquers sexual desire, anger and corruption.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਭਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਚੀਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar jot bhaee gur saakhee cheene raam kara(n)maa ||
english: His inner being is illuminated, by the Guru's Teachings; He beholds the Lord's play of karma.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਤੀਣੇ ਤਾਰਾ ਚੜਿਆ ਲੰਮਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak haumai maar pateene taaraa chaRiaa la(n)maa ||1||
english: O Nanak, killing his ego, he is satisfied; the meteor has shot across the sky. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਚੂਕੀ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: guramukh jaag rahe chookee abhimaanee raam ||
english: The Gurmukhs remain awake and aware; their egotistical pride is eradicated.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhor bhaiaa saach samaanee raam ||
english: Night and day, it is dawn for them; they merge in the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: saach samaanee guramukh man bhaanee guramukh saabat jaage ||
english: The Gurmukhs are merged in the True Lord; they are pleasing to His Mind. The Gurmukhs are intact, safe and sound, awake and awake.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
transliteration: saach naam a(n)mrit gur deeaa har charanee liv laage ||
english: The Guru blesses them with the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name; they are lovingly attuned to the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: pragatee jot jot mahi jaataa manamukh bharam bhulaanee ||
english: The Divine Light is revealed, and in that Light, they achieve realization; the self-willed manmukhs wander in doubt and confusion.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਜਾਗਤ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak bhor bhaiaa man maaniaa jaagat rain vihaanee ||2||
english: O Nanak, when the dawn breaks, their minds are satisfied; they pass their life-night awake and aware. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ਗੁਣੀ ਘਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: augan veesariaa gunee ghar keeaa raam ||
english: Forgetting faults and demerits, virtue and merit enter one's home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: eko rav rahiaa avar na beeaa raam ||
english: The One Lord is permeating everywhere; there is no other at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: rav rahiaa soee avar na koee man hee te man maaniaa ||
english: He is All-pervading; there is no other. The mind comes to believe, from the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਘਟੁ ਘਟੁ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jin jal thal tribhavan ghat ghat thaapiaa so prabh guramukh jaaniaa ||
english: The One who established the water, the land, the three worlds, each and every heart - that God is known by the Gurmukh.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: karan kaaran samarath apaaraa tribidh met samaaee ||
english: The Infinite, All-powerful Lord is the Creator, the Cause of causes; erasing the three-phased Maya, we merge in Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣਹ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਐਸੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak avagan gunah samaane aisee guramat paaee ||3||
english: O Nanak, then, demerits are dissolved by merits; such are the Guru's Teachings. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੋਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: aavan jaan rahe chookaa bholaa raam ||
english: My coming and going in reincarnation have ended; doubt and hesitation are gone.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਚੋਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: haumai maar mile saachaa cholaa raam ||
english: Conquering my ego, I have met the True Lord, and now I wear the robe of Truth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ਚੂਕੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
transliteration: haumai gur khoee paragat hoee chooke sog sa(n)taapai ||
english: The Guru has rid me of egotism; my sorrow and suffering are dispelled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਆਪੈ ॥
transliteration: jotee a(n)dar jot samaanee aap pachhaataa aapai ||
english: My might merges into the Light; I realize and understand my own self.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਣੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: peeeaRai ghar sabad pateenee saahuraRai pir bhaanee ||
english: In this world of my parents' home, I am satisfied with the Shabad; at my in-laws' home, in the world beyond, I shall be pleasing to my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਲੋਕਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak satigur mel milaaee chookee kaan lokaanee ||4||3||
english: O Nanak, the True Guru has united me in His Union; my dependence on people has ended. ||4||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: tukhaaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Tukhaari, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੋਲਾਵੜੈ ਭੁਲੀ ਭੁਲਿ ਭੁਲਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: bholaavaRai bhulee bhul bhul pachhotaanee ||
english: Deluded by doubt, misled and confused, the soul-bride later regrets and repents.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਅੜੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: pir chhodiaRee sutee pir kee saar na jaanee ||
english: Abandoning her Husband Lord, she sleeps, and does not appreciate His Worth.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਤੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਵਿਧਣ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: pir chhodee sutee avagan mutee tis dhan vidhan raate ||
english: Leaving her Husband Lord, she sleeps, and is plundered by her faults and demerits. The night is so painful for this bride.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਲਗੀ ਤਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar vigutee haumai lagee taate ||
english: Sexual desire, anger and egotism destroy her. She burns in egotism.

author: Guru Nanak
