gurmukhi: ਉਡਰਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਿਆ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਭਸਮੈ ਭਸਮ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: udar ha(n)s chaliaa phuramaaiaa bhasamai bhasam samaanee ||
english: When the soul-swan flies away, by the Command of the Lord, her dust mingles with dust.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਭੁਲਿ ਭੁਲਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak sache naam vihoonee bhul bhul pachhotaanee ||1||
english: O Nanak, without the True Name, she is confused and deluded, and so she regrets and repents. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਇਕ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: sun naah piaare ik bena(n)tee meree ||
english: Please listen, O my Beloved Husband Lord, to my one prayer.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਅੜਾ ਹਉ ਰੁਲਿ ਭਸਮੈ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: too nij ghar vasiaRaa hau rul bhasamai dheree ||
english: You dwell in the home of the self deep within, while I roll around like a dust-ball.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਅਪਨੇ ਨਾਹੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਚਾਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: bin apane naahai koi na chaahai kiaa kaheeai kiaa keejai ||
english: Without my Husband Lord, no one likes me at all; what can I say or do now?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam rasan ras rasanaa gurasabadee ras peejai ||
english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the sweetest nectar of nectars. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, with my tongue, I drink in this nectar.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸਾਥੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
transliteration: vin naavai ko sa(n)g na saathee aavai jaai ghaneree ||
english: Without the Name, no one has any friend or companion; millions come and go in reincarnation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak laahaa lai ghar jaaeeai saachee sach mat teree ||2||
english: Nanak: the profit is earned and the soul returns home. True, true are Your Teachings. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਦੇਸਿ ਵਿਦੇਸੀਅੜੇ ਸਾਨੇਹੜੇ ਦੇਦੀ ॥
transliteration: saajan des videseeaRe saanehaRe dedee ||
english: O Friend, You have travelled so far from Your homeland; I send my message of love to You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਜਣਾ ਮੁੰਧ ਨੈਣ ਭਰੇਦੀ ॥
transliteration: saar samaale tin sajanaa mu(n)dh nain bharedee ||
english: I cherish and remember that Friend; the eyes of this soul-bride are filled with tears.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਨੈਣ ਭਰੇਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇਦੀ ਕਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mu(n)dh nain bharedee gun saaredee kiu prabh milaa piaare ||
english: The eyes of the soul-bride are filled with tears; I dwell upon Your Glorious Virtues. How can I meet my Beloved Lord God?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਉ ਵਿਖੜਾ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: maarag pa(n)th na jaanau vikhaRaa kiu paaeeai pir paare ||
english: I do not know the treacherous path, the way to You. How can I find You and cross over, O my Husband Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
transliteration: satigurasabadee milai vichhu(n)nee tan man aagai raakhai ||
english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, the separated soul-bride meets with the Lord; I place my body and mind before You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਫਲਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak a(n)mrit birakh mahaa ras phaliaa mil preetam ras chaakhai ||3||
english: O Nanak, the ambrosial tree bears the most delicious fruits; meeting with my Beloved, I taste the sweet essence. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇੜੀਏ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: mahal bulaaiReee bilam na keejai ||
english: The Lord has called you to the Mansion of His Presence - do not delay!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਤੜੀਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
transliteration: anadin rataReee sahaj mileejai ||
english: Night and day, imbued with His Love, you shall meet with Him with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: sukh sahaj mileejai ros na keejai garab nivaar samaanee ||
english: In celestial peace and poise, you shall meet Him; do not harbor anger - subdue your proud self!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: saachai raatee milai milaaee manamukh aavan jaanee ||
english: Imbued with Truth, I am united in His Union, while the self-willed manmukhs continue coming and going.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਨਾਚੀ ਤਬ ਘੂਘਟੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਫੋੜਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jab naachee tab ghooghat kaisaa matukee phoR niraaree ||
english: When you dance, what veil covers you? Break the water pot, and be unattached.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak aapai aap pachhaanai guramukh tat beechaaree ||4||4||
english: O Nanak, realize your own self; as Gurmukh, contemplate the essence of reality. ||4||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: tukhaaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Tukhaari, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ਹਮ ਲਾਲਨ ਕੇ ਲਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: mere laal ra(n)geele ham laalan ke laale ||
english: O my Dear Beloved, I am the slave of Your slaves.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
transliteration: gur alakh lakhaaiaa avar na doojaa bhaale ||
english: The Guru has shown me the Invisible Lord, and now, I do not seek any other.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: gur alakh lakhaaiaa jaa tis bhaaiaa jaa prabh kirapaa dhaaree ||
english: The Guru showed me the Invisible Lord, when it pleased Him, and when God showered His Blessings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jagajeevan daataa purakh bidhaataa sahaj mile banavaaree ||
english: The Life of the World, the Great Giver, the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, the Lord of the woods - I have met Him with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਤਾਰਹਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
transliteration: nadar karahi too taarahi tareeai sach devahu deen daiaalaa ||
english: Bestow Your Glance of Grace and carry me across, to save me. Please bless me with the Truth, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak daasan daasaa too sarab jeeaa pratipaalaa ||1||
english: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of Your slaves. You are the Cherisher of all souls. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bharipur dhaar rahe at piaare ||
english: My Dear Beloved is enshrined throughout the Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਰੂਪਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sabade rav rahiaa gur roop muraare ||
english: The Shabad is pervading, through the Guru, the Embodiment of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰੂਪ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur roop muraare tribhavan dhaare taa kaa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
english: The Guru, the Embodiment of the Lord, is enshrined throughout the three worlds; His limits cannot be found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ra(n)gee jinasee ja(n)t upaae nit devai chaRai savaaiaa ||
english: He created the beings of various colors and kinds; His Blessings increase day by day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
transliteration: apara(n)par aape thaap uthaape tis bhaavai so hovai ||
english: The Infinite Lord Himself establishes and disestablishes; whatever pleases Him, happens.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੀਰਾ ਹੀਰੈ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਕੈ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੋਵੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak heeraa heerai bedhiaa gun kai haar parovai ||2||
english: O Nanak, the diamond of the mind is pierced through by the diamond of spiritual wisdom. The garland of virtue is strung. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੁਣਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਣੋ ॥
transliteration: gun gunahi samaane masatak naam neesaano ||
english: The virtuous person merges in the Virtuous Lord; his forehead bears the insignia of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੋ ॥
transliteration: sach saach samaaiaa chookaa aavan jaano ||
english: The true person merges in the True Lord; his comings and goings are over.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: sach saach pachhaataa saachai raataa saach milai man bhaavai ||
english: The true person realizes the True Lord, and is imbued with Truth. He meets the True Lord, and is pleasing to the Lord's Mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saache oopar avar na deesai saache saach samaavai ||
english: No one else is seen to be above the True Lord; the true person merges in the True Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਖੋਲਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mohan mohi leeaa man meraa ba(n)dhan khol niraare ||
english: The Fascinating Lord has fascinated my mind; releasing me from bondage, He has set me free.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak jotee jot samaanee jaa miliaa at piaare ||3||
english: O Nanak, my light merged into the Light, when I met my most Darling Beloved. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਘਰੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਥਾਨੋ ॥
transliteration: sach ghar khoj lahe saachaa gur thaano ||
english: By searching, the true home, the place of the True Guru is found.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੋ ॥
transliteration: manamukh nah paaeeai guramukh giaano ||
english: The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom, while the self-willed manmukh does not.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਨੋ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨੋ ਸਦ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: devai sach daano so paravaano sad daataa vad daanaa ||
english: Whoever the Lord has blessed with the gift of Truth is accepted; the Supremely Wise Lord is forever the Great Giver.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਚਿਰਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: amar ajonee asathir jaapai saachaa mahal chiraanaa ||
english: He is known to be Immortal, Unborn and Permanent; the True Mansion of His Presence is everlasting.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਦੋਤਿ ਉਚਾਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: dot uchaapat lekh na likheeai pragatee jot muraaree ||
english: The day-to-day account of deeds is not recorded for that person, who manifests the radiance of the Divine Light of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: naanak saachaa saachai raachaa guramukh tareeai taaree ||4||5||
english: O Nanak, the true person is absorbed in the True Lord; the Gurmukh crosses over to the other side. ||4||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: tukhaaree mahalaa 1 ||
english: Tukhaari, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਮਝੁ ਅਚੇਤ ਇਆਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: e man meriaa too samajh achet iaaniaa raam ||
english: O my ignorant, unconscious mind, reform yourself.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਛਡਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: e man meriaa chhad avagan gunee samaaniaa raam ||
english: O my mind, leave behind your faults and demerits, and be absorbed in virtue.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਸਾਦ ਲੁਭਾਣੇ ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: bahu saad lubhaane kirat kamaane vichhuRiaa nahee melaa ||
english: You are deluded by so many flavors and pleasures, and you act in such confusion. You are separated, and you will not meet your Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਜਮ ਡਰਿ ਮਰੀਐ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
transliteration: kiu dutar tareeai jam dar mareeai jam kaa pa(n)th duhelaa ||
english: How can the impassible world-ocean be crossed? The fear of the Messenger of Death is deadly. The path of Death is agonizingly painful.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਾਝ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤਾ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਰੁਧਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: man raam nahee jaataa saajh prabhaataa avaghat rudhaa kiaa kare ||
english: The mortal does not know the Lord in the evening, or in the morning; trapped on the treacherous path, what will he do then?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵੈ ਨਰਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ba(n)dhan baadhiaa in bidh chhootai guramukh sevai narahare ||1||
english: Bound in bondage, he is released only by this method: as Gurmukh, serve the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਛੋਡਿ ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: e man meriaa too chhod aal ja(n)jaalaa raam ||
english: O my mind, abandon your household entanglements.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: e man meriaa har sevahu purakh niraalaa raam ||
english: O my mind, serve the Lord, the Primal, Detached Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਜਿੰਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har simar eka(n)kaar saachaa sabh jagat ji(n)n upaaiaa ||
english: Meditate in remembrance on the One Universal Creator; the True Lord created the entire Universe.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਜਗਤਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: paun paanee agan baadhe gur khel jagat dikhaaiaa ||
english: The Guru controls the air, water and fire; He has staged the drama of the world.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਚਾਰਿ ਤੂ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਜਪ ਤਪੋ ॥
transliteration: aachaar too veechaar aape har naam sa(n)jam jap tapo ||
english: Reflect on your own self, and so practice good conduct; chant the Name of the Lord as your self-discipline and meditation.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਖਾ ਸੈਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sakhaa sain piaar preetam naam har kaa jap japo ||2||
english: The Name of the Lord is your Companion, Friend and Dear Beloved; chant it, and meditate on it. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੁ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਵਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: e man meriaa too thir rahu chot na khaavahee raam ||
english: O my mind, remain steady and stable, and you will not have to endure beatings.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: e man meriaa gun gaavahi sahaj samaavahee raam ||
english: O my mind, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, you shall merge into Him with intuitive ease.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇ ਰਸੀਅਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਹੇ ॥
transliteration: gun gaai raam rasaai raseeahi gur giaan a(n)jan saarahe ||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, be happy. Apply the ointment of spiritual wisdom to your eyes.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਕ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਘਾਰਹੇ ॥
transliteration: trai lok deepak sabad chaanan pa(n)ch doot sa(n)ghaarahe ||
english: The Word of the Shabad is the lamp which illuminates the three worlds; it slaughters the five demons.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਕਾਟਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਰਹਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰਏ ॥
transliteration: bhai kaat nirabhau tarahi dutar gur miliai kaaraj saarae ||
english: Quieting your fears, become fearless, and you shall cross over the impassible world ocean. Meeting the Guru, your affairs shall be resolved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: roop ra(n)g piaar har siu har aap kirapaa dhaarae ||3||
english: You shall find the joy and the beauty of the Lord's Love and Affection; the Lord Himself shall shower you with His Grace. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: e man meriaa too kiaa lai aaiaa kiaa lai jaaisee raam ||
english: O my mind, why did you come into the world? What will you take with you when you go?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤਾ ਛੁਟਸੀ ਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: e man meriaa taa chhutasee jaa bharam chukaaisee raam ||
english: O my mind, you shall be emancipated, when you eliminate your doubts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਖਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਾਉ ਪਛਾਣਹੇ ॥
transliteration: dhan sa(n)ch har har naam vakhar gur sabad bhaau pachhaanahe ||
english: So gather the wealth and capital of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall realize its value.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਹੇ ॥
transliteration: mail parahar sabad niramal mahal ghar sach jaanahe ||
english: Filth shall be taken away, through the Immaculate Word of the Shabad; you shall know the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, your true home.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਿਧਾਵਹਿ ਝੋਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੀ ਰਸੋ ॥
transliteration: pat naam paavahi ghar sidhaavahi jhol a(n)mrit pee raso ||
english: Through the Naam, you shall obtain honor, and come home. Eagerly drink in the Ambrosial Amrit.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੋ ॥੪॥
transliteration: har naam dhiaaeeai sabad ras paaeeai vadabhaag japeeai har jaso ||4||
english: Meditate on the Lord's Name, and you shall obtain the sublime essence of the Shabad; by great good fortune, chant the Praises of the Lord. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਉੜੀਆ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਚੜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: e man meriaa bin pauReeaa ma(n)dar kiu chaRai raam ||
english: O my mind, without a ladder, how will you climb up to the Temple of the Lord?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਅੰਬੜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: e man meriaa bin beRee paar na a(n)baRai raam ||
english: O my mind, without a boat, you shall not reach the other shore.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲੰਘਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: paar saajan apaar preetam gurasabad surat la(n)ghaavae ||
english: On that far shore is Your Beloved, Infinite Friend. Only your awareness of the Guru's Shabad will carry you across.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)gat karahi raleeaa phir na pachhotaavae ||
english: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and you shall enjoy ecstasy; you shall not regret or repent later on.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਓ ॥
transliteration: kar daiaa daan daiaal saachaa har naam sa(n)gat paavao ||
english: Be Merciful, O Merciful True Lord God: please give me the Blessing of the Lord's Name, and the Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਵਓ ॥੫॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai sunahu preetam gur sabad man samajhaavao ||5||6||
english: Nanak prays: please hear me, O my Beloved; instruct my mind through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||5||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: tukhaaree chha(n)t mahalaa 4 ||
english: Tukhaari Chhant, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar piree piaar kiu pir bin jeeveeai raam ||
english: My inner being is filled with love for my Beloved Husband Lord. How can I live without Him?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jab lag daras na hoi kiu a(n)mrit peeveeai raam ||
english: As long as I do not have the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, how can I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: kiu a(n)mrit peeveeai har bin jeeveeai tis bin rahan na jaae ||
english: How can I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar without the Lord? I cannot survive without Him.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
transliteration: anadin priu priu kare din raatee pir bin piaas na jaae ||
english: Night and day, I cry out, "Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!", day and night. Without my Husband Lord, my thirst is not quenched.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
transliteration: apanee kripaa karahu har piaare har har naam sad saariaa ||
english: Please, bless me with Your Grace, O my Beloved Lord, that I may dwell on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, forever.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad miliaa mai preetam hau satigur vitahu vaariaa ||1||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have met my Beloved; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਸਿ ਰਵਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jab dekhaa(n) pir piaaraa har gun ras ravaa raam ||
english: When I see my Beloved Husband Lord, I chant the Lord's Glorious Praises with love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਤ ਚਵਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: merai a(n)tar hoi vigaas priu priu sach nit chavaa raam ||
english: My inner being blossoms forth; I continually utter, "Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!"

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਚਵਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
transliteration: priu chavaa piaare sabad nisataare bin dekhe tripat na aavae ||
english: I speak of my Dear Beloved, and through the Shabad, I am saved. Unless I can see Him, I am not satisfied.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਏ ॥
transliteration: sabad seegaar hovai nit kaaman har har naam dhiaavae ||
english: That soul-bride who is ever adorned with the Shabad, meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: daiaa daan ma(n)gat jan deejai mai preetam dehu milaae ||
english: Please bless this beggar, Your humble servant, with the Gift of Mercy; please unite me with my Beloved.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੁਮਾਏ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anadin gur gopaal dhiaaee ham satigur vitahu ghumaae ||2||
english: Night and day, I meditate on the Guru, the Lord of the World; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਵ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: ham paathar gur naav bikh bhavajal taareeai raam ||
english: I am a stone in the Boat of the Guru. Please carry me across the terrifying ocean of poison.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮੈ ਮੂੜ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur devahu sabad subhaai mai mooR nisataareeai raam ||
english: O Guru, please, lovingly bless me with the Word of the Shabad. I am such a fool - please save me!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਤੂ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਵਡ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: ham mooR mugadh kichh mit nahee paaee too aga(n)m vad jaaniaa ||
english: I am a fool and an idiot; I know nothing of Your extent. You are known as Inaccessible and Great.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
transliteration: too aap daiaal daiaa kar melahi ham niragunee nimaaniaa ||
english: You Yourself are Merciful; please, mercifully bless me. I am unworthy and dishonored - please, unite me with Yourself!

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨਮ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮੇ ਹੁਣਿ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: anek janam paap kar bharame hun tau saranaagat aae ||
english: Through countless lifetimes, I wandered in sin; now, I have come seeking Your Sanctuary.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਮ ਲਾਗਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: daiaa karahu rakh levahu har jeeu ham laagah satigur paae ||3||
english: Take pity on me and save me, Dear Lord; I have grasped the Feet of the True Guru. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸ ਹਮ ਲੋਹ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: gur paaras ham loh mil ka(n)chan hoiaa raam ||
english: The Guru is the Philosopher's Stone; by His touch, iron is transformed into gold.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜੁ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
transliteration: jotee jot milaai kaaiaa gaR sohiaa raam ||
english: My light merges into the Light, and my body-fortress is so beautiful.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜੁ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: kaaiaa gaR sohiaa merai prabh mohiaa kiu saas giraas visaareeai ||
english: My body-fortress is so beautiful; I am fascinated by my God. How could I forget Him, for even a breath, or a morsel of food?

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਕੜਿਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: adrisat agochar pakaRiaa gurasabadee hau satigur kai balihaareeai ||
english: I have seized the Unseen and Unfathomable Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸੀਸੁ ਭੇਟ ਦੇਉ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: satigur aagai sees bhet deu je satigur saache bhaavai ||
english: I place my head in offering before the True Guru, if it truly pleases the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: aape daiaa karahu prabh daate naanak a(n)k samaavai ||4||1||
english: Take pity on me, O God, Great Giver, that Nanak may merge in Your Being. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: tukhaaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Tukhaari, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਅਪਰਪਰਾ ॥
transliteration: har har agam agaadh apara(n)par aparaparaa ||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Infinite, the Farthest of the Far.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jo tum dhiaavahi jagadees te jan bhau bikham taraa ||
english: Those who meditate on You, O Lord of the Universe - those humble beings cross over the terrifying, treacherous world-ocean.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਮ ਭਉ ਤਿਨ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: bikham bhau tin tariaa suhelaa jin har har naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, easily cross over the terrifying, treacherous world-ocean.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੋ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur vaak satigur jo bhaai chale tin har har aap milaaiaa ||
english: Those who lovingly walk in harmony with the Word of the Guru, the True Guru - the Lord, Har, Har, unites them with Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਣੀਧਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jotee jot mil jot samaanee har kripaa kar dharaneedharaa ||
english: The mortal's light meets the Light of God, and blends with that Divine Light when the Lord, the Support of the Earth, grants His Grace.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਅਪਰਪਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: har har agam agaadh apara(n)par aparaparaa ||1||
english: The Lord, Har, Har, is Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Infinite, the Farthest of the Far. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tum suaamee agam athaah too ghat ghat poor rahiaa ||
english: O my Lord and Master, You are Inaccessible and Unfathomable. You are totally pervading and permeating each and every heart.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: too alakh abheu aga(n)m gur satigur bachan lahiaa ||
english: You are Unseen, Unknowable and Unfathomable; You are found through the Word of the Guru, the True Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੇ ॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n te jan purakh poore jin gur sa(n)tasa(n)gat mil gun rave ||
english: Blessed, blessed are those humble, powerful and perfect people, who join the Guru's Sangat, the Society of the Saints, and chant His Glorious Praises.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਚਵੇ ॥
transliteration: bibek budh beechaar guramukh gur sabad khin khin har nit chave ||
english: With clear and precise understanding, the Gurmukhs contemplate the Guru's Shabad; each and every instant, they continually speak of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਬਹਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਜਾ ਖੜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jaa bahahi guramukh har naam bolahi jaa khaRe guramukh har har kahiaa ||
english: When the Gurmukh sits down, he chants the Lord's Name. When the Gurmukh stands up, he chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: tum suaamee agam athaah too ghat ghat poor rahiaa ||2||
english: O my Lord and Master, You are Inaccessible and Unfathomable. You are totally pervading and permeating each and every heart. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sevak jan sevahi te paravaan jin seviaa guramat hare ||
english: Those humble servants who serve are accepted. They serve the Lord, and follow the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
transliteration: tin ke kot sabh paap khin parahar har door kare ||
english: All their millions of sins are taken away in an instant; the Lord takes them far away.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tin ke paap dokh sabh binase jin man chit ik araadhiaa ||
english: All their sin and blame is washed away. They worship and adore the One Lord with their conscious minds.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤੈ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tin kaa janam saphalio sabh keeaa karatai jin gur bachanee sach bhaakhiaa ||
english: The Creator makes fruitful the lives of all those who, through the Guru's Word, chant the True Name.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਉ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: te dha(n)n jan vad purakh poore jo guramat har jap bhau bikham tare ||
english: Blessed are those humble beings, those great and perfect people, who follow the Guru's Teachings and meditate on the Lord; they cross over the terrifying and treacherous world-ocean.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: sevak jan sevahi te paravaan jin seviaa guramat hare ||3||
english: Those humble servants who serve are accepted. They follow the Guru's Teachings, and serve the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾ ॥
transliteration: too a(n)tarajaamee har aap jiu too chalaavahi piaare hau tivai chalaa ||
english: You Yourself, Lord, are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; as You make me walk, O my Beloved, so do I walk.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਉ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਾ ॥
transliteration: hamarai haath kichh naahi jaa too melahi taa hau aai milaa ||
english: Nothing is in my hands; when You unite me, then I come to be united.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਛੁਟਕਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin kau too har melahi suaamee sabh tin kaa lekhaa chhutak gaiaa ||
english: Those whom You unite with Yourself, O my Lord and Master - all their accounts are settled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਕਰਿਅਹੁ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tin kee ganat na kariahu ko bhaaee jo gur bachanee har mel laiaa ||
english: No one can go through the accounts of those, O Siblings of Destiny, who through the Word of the Guru's Teachings are united with the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਭਲਾ ॥
transliteration: naanak daiaal hoaa tin oopar jin gur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)niaa bhalaa ||
english: O Nanak, the Lord shows Mercy to those who accept the Guru's Will as good.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: too a(n)tarajaamee har aap jiu too chalaavahi piaare hau tivai chalaa ||4||2||
english: You Yourself, Lord, are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; as You make me walk, O my Beloved, so do I walk. ||4||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: tukhaaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Tukhaari, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਸਭ ਕਰਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
transliteration: too jagajeevan jagadees sabh karataa srisat naath ||
english: You are the Life of the World, the Lord of the Universe, our Lord and Master, the Creator of all the Universe.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਤੂ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਾਥੁ ॥
transliteration: tin too dhiaaiaa meraa raam jin kai dhur lekh maath ||
english: They alone meditate on You, O my Lord, who have such destiny recorded on their foreheads.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jin kau dhur har likhiaa suaamee tin har har naam araadhiaa ||
english: Those who are so pre-destined by their Lord and Master, worship and adore the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥
transliteration: tin ke paap ik nimakh sabh laathe jin gur bachanee har jaapiaa ||
english: All sins are erased in an instant, for those who meditate on the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਉ ਭਇਆ ਸਨਾਥੁ ॥
transliteration: dhan dha(n)n te jan jin har naam japiaa tin dekhe hau bhaiaa sanaath ||
english: Blessed, blessed are those humble beings who meditate on the Lord's Name. Seeing them, I am uplifted.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਸਭ ਕਰਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਾਥੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too jagajeevan jagadees sabh karataa srisat naath ||1||
english: You are the Life of the World, the Lord of the Universe, our Lord and Master, the Creator of all the Universe. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥
transliteration: too jal thal maheeal bharapoor sabh oopar saach dhanee ||
english: You are totally pervading the water, the land and the sky. O True Lord, You are the Master of all.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਘਣੀ ॥
transliteration: jin japiaa har man cheet har jap jap mukat ghanee ||
english: Those who meditate on the Lord in their conscious minds - all those who chant and meditate on the Lord are liberated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਊਜਲ ਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
transliteration: jin japiaa har te mukat praanee tin ke oojal mukh har duaar ||
english: Those mortal beings who meditate on the Lord are liberated; their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਰਖਨਹਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: oi halat palat jan bhae suhele har raakh leee rakhanahaar ||
english: Those humble beings are exalted in this world and the next; the Savior Lord saves them.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਬਣੀ ॥
transliteration: har sa(n)tasa(n)gat jan sunahu bhaaee guramukh har sevaa saphal banee ||
english: Listen to the Lord's Name in the Society of the Saints, O humble Siblings of Destiny. The Gurmukh's service to the Lord is fruitful.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: too jal thal maheeal bharapoor sabh oopar saach dhanee ||2||
english: You are totally pervading the water, the land and the sky. O True Lord, You are the Master of all. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: too thaan thana(n)tar har ek har eko ek raviaa ||
english: You are the One Lord, the One and Only Lord, pervading all places and interspaces.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: van trin tribhavan sabh srisat mukh har har naam chaviaa ||
english: The forests and fields, the three worlds and the entire Universe, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਚਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਗਣਤ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਏ ॥
transliteration: sabh chavahi har har naam karate asa(n)kh aganat har dhiaavae ||
english: All chant the Name of the Creator Lord, Har, Har; countless, uncountable beings meditate on the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
transliteration: so dha(n)n dhan har sa(n)t saadhoo jo har prabh karate bhaavae ||
english: Blessed, blessed are those Saints and Holy People of the Lord, who are pleasing to the Creator Lord God.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਫਲੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਚਵਿਆ ॥
transliteration: so saphal darasan dehu karate jis har hiradai naam sad chaviaa ||
english: O Creator, please bless me with the Fruitful Vision, the Darshan, of those who chant the Lord's Name in their hearts forever.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too thaan thana(n)tar har ek har eko ek raviaa ||3||
english: You are the One Lord, the One and Only Lord, pervading all places and interspaces. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਅਸੰਖ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਹਿ ॥
transliteration: teree bhagat bha(n)daar asa(n)kh jis too devahi mere suaamee tis milahi ||
english: The treasures of devotional worship to You are countless; he alone is blessed with them, O my Lord and Master, whom You bless.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਗੁਰ ਹਾਥੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਟਿਕਹਿ ॥
transliteration: jis kai masatak gur haath tis hiradai har gun tikahi ||
english: The Lord's Glorious Virtues abide within the heart of that person, whose forehead the Guru has touched.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਟਿਕਹਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਉ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: har gun hiradai tikahi tis kai jis a(n)tar bhau bhaavanee hoee ||
english: The Glorious Virtues of the Lord dwell in the heart of that person, whose inner being is filled with the Fear of God, and His Love.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਉਤਰਿਆ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: bin bhai kinai na prem paaiaa bin bhai paar na utariaa koee ||
english: Without the Fear of God, His Love is not obtained. Without the Fear of God, no one is carried across to the other side.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bhau bhaau preet naanak tisahi laagai jis too aapanee kirapaa karahi ||
english: O Nanak, he alone is blessed with the Fear of God, and God's Love and Affection, whom You, Lord, bless with Your Mercy.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਅਸੰਖ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਹਿ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: teree bhagat bha(n)daar asa(n)kh jis too devahi mere suaamee tis milahi ||4||3||
english: The treasures of devotional worship to You are countless; he alone is blessed with Them, O my Lord and Master, whom You bless. ||4||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
transliteration: tukhaaree mahalaa 4 ||
english: Tukhaari, Fourth Mehl:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਣੁ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਅਭੀਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: naavan purab abheech gur satigur daras bhaiaa ||
english: To receive the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Guru, the True Guru, is to truly bathe at the Abhaijit festival.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੀ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: duramat mail haree agiaan a(n)dher gaiaa ||
english: The filth of evil-mindedness is washed off, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: gur daras paaiaa agiaan gavaaiaa a(n)tar jot pragaasee ||
english: Blessed by the Guru's Darshan, spiritual ignorance is dispelled, and the Divine Light illuminates the inner being.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
transliteration: janam maran dukh khin mahi binase har paaiaa prabh abinaasee ||
english: The pains of birth and death vanish in an instant, and the Eternal, Imperishable Lord God is found.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੁਲਖੇਤਿ ਨਾਵਣਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har aap karatai purab keeaa satiguroo kulakhet naavan gaiaa ||
english: The Creator Lord God Himself created the festival, when the True Guru went to bathe at the festival in Kuruk-shaytra.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਣੁ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਅਭੀਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naavan purab abheech gur satigur daras bhaiaa ||1||
english: To receive the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Guru, the True Guru, is to truly bathe at the Abhaijit festival. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਖਾ ॥
transliteration: maarag pa(n)th chale gur satigur sa(n)g sikhaa ||
english: The Sikhs travelled with the Guru, the True Guru, on the path, along the road.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਣੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਵਿਖਾ ॥
transliteration: anadin bhagat banee khin khin nimakh vikhaa ||
english: Night and day, devotional worship services were held, each and every instant, with each step.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਵੇਖਣਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: har har bhagat banee prabh keree sabh lok vekhan aaiaa ||
english: Devotional worship services to the Lord God were held, and all the people came to see the Guru.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਦਰਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin daras satigur guroo keeaa tin aap har melaaiaa ||
english: Whoever was blessed with the Darshan of the Guru, the True Guru, the Lord united with Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਉਦਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀਆ ਸਭ ਲੋਕ ਉਧਰਣ ਅਰਥਾ ॥
transliteration: teerath udam satiguroo keeaa sabh lok udharan arathaa ||
english: The True Guru made the pilgrimage to the sacred shrines, for the sake of saving all the people.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਖਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: maarag pa(n)th chale gur satigur sa(n)g sikhaa ||2||
english: The Sikhs travelled with the Guru, the True Guru, on the path, along the road. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਆਏ ਕੁਲਖੇਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
transliteration: pratham aae kulakhet gur satigur purab hoaa ||
english: When the Guru, the True Guru, first arrived at Kuruk-shaytra, it was a very auspicious time.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਖਬਰਿ ਭਈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਆਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਆ ॥
transliteration: khabar bhaee sa(n)saar aae trai loaa ||
english: The news spread throughout the world, and the beings of the three worlds came.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਣਿ ਆਏ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸਭਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dekhan aae teen lok sur nar mun jan sabh aaiaa ||
english: The angelic beings and silent sages from all the three worlds came to see Him.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਪਰਸਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin parasiaa gur satiguroo pooraa tin ke kilavikh naas gavaaiaa ||
english: Those who are touched by the Guru, the True Guru - all their sins and mistakes were erased and dispelled.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਦਿਗੰਬਰ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਢੋਆ ॥
transliteration: jogee diga(n)bar sa(n)niaasee khat darasan kar gae gosat dhoaa ||
english: The Yogis, the nudists, the Sannyaasees and those of the six schools of philosophy spoke with Him, and then bowed and departed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਆਏ ਕੁਲਖੇਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਹੋਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: pratham aae kulakhet gur satigur purab hoaa ||3||
english: When the Guru, the True Guru, first arrived at Kuruk-shaytra, it was a very auspicious time. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਜਮੁਨ ਗਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
transliteration: duteeaa jamun gae gur har har japan keeaa ||
english: Second, the Guru went to the river Jamunaa, where He chanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਦੇ ਭੇਟ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਛੈ ਲੰਘਾਇ ਦੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jaagaatee mile de bhet gur pichhai la(n)ghaai deeaa ||
english: The tax collectors met the Guru and gave Him offerings; they did not impose the tax on His followers.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਛੁਟੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਿਛੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh chhutee satiguroo pichhai jin har har naam dhiaaiaa ||
english: All the True Guru's followers were excused from the tax; they meditated on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਜੋ ਪੰਥਿ ਚਾਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: gur bachan maarag jo pa(n)th chaale tin jam jaagaatee neR na aaiaa ||
english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who have walked on the path, and followed the Guru's Teachings.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਗਤੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਲਇਐ ਸਭਿ ਛੁਟਕਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh guroo guroo jagat bolai gur kai naai laiai sabh chhutak gaiaa ||
english: All the world said, "Guru! Guru! Guru!" Uttering the Guru's Name, they were all emancipated.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਜਮੁਨ ਗਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: duteeaa jamun gae gur har har japan keeaa ||4||
english: Second, the Guru went to the river Jamunaa, where He chanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਆਏ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਤਹ ਕਉਤਕੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: triteeaa aae surasaree tah kautak chalat bhaiaa ||
english: Third, He went to the Ganges, and a wonderful drama was played out there.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮੋਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤ ਕਿਨੈ ਆਢੁ ਨ ਦਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sabh mohee dekh darasan gur sa(n)t kinai aadh na daam laiaa ||
english: All were fascinated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Saintly Guru's Darshan; no tax at all was imposed upon anyone.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਆਢੁ ਦਾਮੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਇਆ ਨ ਬੋਲਕ ਜਾਗਾਤੀਆ ਮੋਹਣ ਮੁੰਦਣਿ ਪਈ ॥
transliteration: aadh daam kichh paiaa na bolak jaagaateeaa mohan mu(n)dan paee ||
english: No tax at all was collected, and the mouths of the tax collectors were sealed.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਕਿਆ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ਮਾਂਗਹ ਸਭ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਈ ॥
transliteration: bhaaee ham karah kiaa kis paas maa(n)gah sabh bhaag satigur pichhai paee ||
english: They said, "O brothers, what should we do? Who should we ask? Everyone is running after the True Guru."

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਾਤੀਆ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਭੰਨਿ ਬੋਲਕਾ ਸਭਿ ਉਠਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jaagaateeaa upaav siaanap kar veechaar dithaa bha(n)n bolakaa sabh uth gaiaa ||
english: The tax collectors were smart; they thought about it, and saw. They broke their cash-boxes and left.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਆਏ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਤਹ ਕਉਤਕੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੫॥
transliteration: triteeaa aae surasaree tah kautak chalat bhaiaa ||5||
english: Third, He went to the Ganges, and a wonderful drama was played out there. ||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਆਏ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਾ ਜਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ॥
transliteration: mil aae nagar mahaa janaa gur satigur ot gahee ||
english: The important men of the city met together, and sought the Protection of the Guru, the True Guru.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਸਹੀ ॥
transliteration: gur satigur gur govid puchh simrit keetaa sahee ||
english: The Guru, the True Guru, the Guru is the Lord of the Universe. Go ahead and consult the Simritees - they will confirm this.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਨੀ ਸਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੁਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਮਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: simrit saasatr sabhanee sahee keetaa suk prahilaad sreeraam kar gur govid dhiaaiaa ||
english: The Simritees and the Shaastras all confirm that Suk Dayv and Prahlaad meditated on the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, and knew Him as the Supreme Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਵਟਵਾਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਥਾਉ ਥੇਹੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dehee nagar kot pa(n)ch chor vatavaare tin kaa thaau thehu gavaaiaa ||
english: The five thieves and the highway robbers dwell in the fortress of the body-village; the Guru has destroyed their home and place.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਨ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਨਿਤ ਪੁੰਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਹੀ ॥
transliteration: keeratan puraan nit pu(n)n hovahi gur bachan naanak har bhagat lahee ||
english: The Puraanas continually praise the giving of charity, but devotional worship of the Lord is only obtained through the Word of Guru Nanak.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਆਏ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਾ ਜਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ॥੬॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: mil aae nagar mahaa janaa gur satigur ot gahee ||6||4||10||
english: The important men of the city met together, and sought the Protection of the Guru, the True Guru. ||6||4||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: tukhaaree chha(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Tukhaari Chhant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਲਾਲਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: ghol ghumaaee laalanaa gur man deenaa ||
english: O my Beloved, I am a sacrifice to You. Through the Guru, I have dedicated my mind to You.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sun sabad tumaaraa meraa man bheenaa ||
english: Hearing the Word of Your Shabad, my mind is enraptured.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ihu man bheenaa jiu jal meenaa laagaa ra(n)g muraaraa ||
english: This mind is enraptured, like the fish in the water; it is lovingly attached to the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: keemat kahee na jaaee thaakur teraa mahal apaaraa ||
english: Your Worth cannot be described, O my Lord and Master; Your Mansion is Incomparable and Unrivalled.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਇਕ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
transliteration: sagal gunaa ke daate suaamee binau sunahu ik deenaa ||
english: O Giver of all Virtue, O my Lord and Master, please hear the prayer of this humble person.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dehu daras naanak balihaaree jeeaRaa bal bal keenaa ||1||
english: Please bless Nanak with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ihu tan man teraa sabh gun tere ||
english: This body and mind are Yours; all virtues are Yours.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kha(n)neeai va(n)njaa darasan tere ||
english: I am a sacrifice, every little bit, to Your Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
transliteration: darasan tere sun prabh mere nimakh drisat pekh jeevaa ||
english: Please hear me, O my Lord God; I live only by seeing Your Vision, even if only for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨੀਜੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤ ਪੀਵਾ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit naam suneejai teraa kirapaa karahi ta peevaa ||
english: I have heard that Your Name is the most Ambrosial Nectar; please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may drink it in.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਬੂੰਦੇਰੇ ॥
transliteration: aas piaasee pir kai taaee jiu chaatrik boo(n)dere ||
english: My hopes and desires rest in You, O my Husband Lord; like the rainbird, I long for the rain-drop.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jeeaRaa balihaaree dehu daras prabh mere ||2||
english: Says Nanak, my soul is a sacrifice to You; please bless me with Your Darshan, O my Lord God. ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: too saachaa saahib saahu amitaa ||
english: You are my True Lord and Master, O Infinite King.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਿਤ ਚਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: too preetam piaaraa praan hit chitaa ||
english: You are my Dear Beloved, so dear to my life and consciousness.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਰੰਗ ਬਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
transliteration: praan sukhadaataa guramukh jaataa sagal ra(n)g ban aae ||
english: You bring peace to my soul; You are known to the Gurmukh. All are blessed by Your Love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂ ਫੁਰਮਾਏ ॥
transliteration: soee karam kamaavai praanee jehaa too phuramaae ||
english: The mortal does only those deeds which You ordain, Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਤਾ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau kripaa karee jagadeesur tin saadhasa(n)g man jitaa ||
english: One who is blessed by Your Grace, O Lord of the Universe, conquers his mind in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤਉ ਦਿਤਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: kahu naanak jeeaRaa balihaaree jeeu pi(n)d tau ditaa ||3||
english: Says Nanak, my soul is a sacrifice to You; You gave me my soul and body. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸਦਕਾ ॥
transliteration: niragun raakh leeaa sa(n)tan kaa sadakaa ||
english: I am unworthy, but He has saved me, for the sake of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਢਾਕਿ ਲੀਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਾਪੀ ਪੜਦਾ ॥
transliteration: satigur dhaak leeaa mohi paapee paRadaa ||
english: The True Guru has covered my faults; I am such a sinner.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਢਾਕਨਹਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: dhaakanahaare prabhoo hamaare jee praan sukhadaate ||
english: God has covered for me; He is the Giver of the soul, life and peace.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
transliteration: abinaasee abigat suaamee pooran purakh bidhaate ||
english: My Lord and Master is Eternal and Unchanging, Ever-present; He is the Perfect Creator, the Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਤੂ ਕਦ ਕਾ ॥
transliteration: usatat kahan na jaai tumaaree kaun kahai too kad kaa ||
english: Your Praise cannot be described; who can say where You are?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਕਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak daas taa kai balihaaree milai naam har nimakaa ||4||1||11||
english: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to the one who blesses him with the Lord's Name, even for an instant. ||4||1||11||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mere man raam naam nit gaaveeai re ||
english: O my mind, sing continually the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਲਖਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਖਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: agam agochar na jaaee har lakhiaa gur pooraa milai lakhaaveeai re || rahaau ||
english: The Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord cannot be seen; meeting with the Perfect Guru, He is seen. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: jis aape kirapaa kare meraa suaamee tis jan kau har liv laaveeai re ||
english: That person, upon whom my Lord and Master showers His Mercy - the Lord attunes that one to Himself.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sabh ko bhagat kare har keree har bhaavai so thaai paaveeai re ||1||
english: Everyone worships the Lord, but only that person who is pleasing to the Lord is accepted. ||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har har naam amolak har pahi har devai taa naam dhiaaveeai re ||
english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is priceless. It rests with the Lord. If the Lord bestows it, then we meditate on the Naam.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਭੁ ਛਡਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jis no naam dei meraa suaamee tis lekhaa sabh chhadaaveeai re ||2||
english: That person, whom my Lord and Master blesses with His Name - his entire account is forgiven. ||2||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: har naam araadhahi se dha(n)n jan kaheeahi tin masatak bhaag dhur likh paaveeai re ||
english: Those humble beings who worship and adore the Lord's Name, are said to be blessed. Such is the good destiny written on their foreheads.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਸੁਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਤ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: tin dekhe meraa man bigasai jiu sut mil maat gal laaveeai re ||3||
english: Gazing upon them, my mind blossoms forth, like the mother who meets with her son and hugs him close. ||3||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: ham baarik har pitaa prabh mere mo kau dehu matee jit har paaveeai re ||
english: I am a child, and You, O my Lord God, are my Father; please bless me with such understanding, that I may find the Lord.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਛੁਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਊ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: jiu bachhuraa dekh gaoo sukh maanai tiu naanak har gal laaveeai re ||4||1||
english: Like the cow, which is happy upon seeing her calf, O Lord, please hug Nanak close in Your Embrace. ||4||1||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fourth Mehl, First House:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: mere man har har gun kahu re ||
english: O my mind, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹੁ ਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: satiguroo ke charan dhoi dhoi poojahu in bidh meraa har prabh lahu re || rahaau ||
english: Wash the Feet of the True Guru, and worship them. In this way, you shall find my Lord God. ||Pause||

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਇਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਤੂ ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu abhimaan bikhai ras in sa(n)gat te too rahu re ||
english: Sexual desire, anger, greed, attachment, egotism and corrupt pleasures - stay away from these.

author: Guru Ramdas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਿਉ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਹੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat keejai har gosat saadhoo siu gosat har prem rasaain raam naam rasaain har raam naam raam ramahu re ||1||
english: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and speak with the Holy People about the Lord. The Love of the Lord is the healing remedy; the Name of the Lord is the healing remedy. Chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਜੋਰੁ ਤੂ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨਤਾ ਇਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਗਹੁ ਰੇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar kaa abhimaan jor too kichh kichh kichh jaanataa ihu door karahu aapan gahu re ||
english: So you think that the egotistical pride in power which you harbor deep within is everything. Let it go, and restrain your self-conceit.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: jan naanak kau har daiaal hohu suaamee har sa(n)tan kee dhoor kar hare ||2||1||2||
english: Please be kind to servant Nanak, O Lord, my Lord and Master; please make him the dust of the Feet of the Saints. ||2||1||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗ ਦੇਖੈ ਜਪਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: maaee sa(n)tasa(n)g jaagee || pri ra(n)g dekhai japatee naam nidhaanee || rahaau ||
english: O mother, I have awakened in the Society of the Saints. Seeing the Love of my Beloved, I chant His Name, the greatest treasure ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਲੋਚਨ ਤਾਰ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: darasan piaas lochan taar laagee ||
english: I am so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. my eyes are focused on Him;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰੀ ਤਿਆਸ ਬਿਡਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bisaree tiaas bidaanee ||1||
english: I have forgotten other thirsts. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹੈ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖਦਾਇਕ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਮਨੁ ਲਪਟਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: ab gur paaio hai sahaj sukhadaaik darasan pekhat man lapataanee ||
english: Now, I have found my Peace-giving Guru with ease; seeing His Darshan, my mind clings to Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਰਹਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥
transliteration: dekh damodar rahas man upajio naanak pri a(n)mrit baanee ||2||1||
english: Seeing my Lord, joy has welled up in my mind; O Nanak, the speech of my Beloved is so sweet! ||2||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: deen binau sun daiaal ||
english: Please listen to the prayers of the humble, O Merciful Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦਾਸ ਤੀਨਿ ਦੋਖੀ ਏਕ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch daas teen dokhee ek man anaath naath ||
english: The five thieves and the three dispositions torment my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੁ ਹੋ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raakh ho kirapaal || rahaau ||
english: O Merciful Lord, Master of the masterless, please save me from them. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
transliteration: anik jatan gavan karau ||
english: I make all sorts of efforts and go on pilgrimages;

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਉ ॥
transliteration: khat karam jugat dhiaan dharau ||
english: I perform the six rituals, and meditate in the right way.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਪਾਵ ਸਗਲ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਨਹ ਨਹ ਹੁਟਹਿ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥੧॥
transliteration: upaav sagal kar haario nah nah hutahi bikaraal ||1||
english: I am so tired of making all these efforts, but the horrible demons still do not leave me. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਪਤੇ ॥
transliteration: saran ba(n)dan karunaa pate ||
english: I seek Your Sanctuary, and bow to You, O Compassionate Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਹਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
transliteration: bhav haran har har har hare ||
english: You are the Destroyer of fear, O Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਤੂਹੀ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
transliteration: ek toohee deen daiaal ||
english: You alone are Merciful to the meek.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸਰੋ ॥
transliteration: prabh charan naanak aasaro ||
english: Nanak takes the Support of God's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਉਧਰੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
transliteration: udhare bhram moh saagar ||
english: I have been rescued from the ocean of doubt,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਲਗਿ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਪਗ ਪਾਲ ॥੨॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: lag sa(n)tanaa pag paal ||2||1||2||
english: holding tight to the feet and the robes of the Saints. ||2||1||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ghar 4 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨੀ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
transliteration: saranee aaio naath nidhaan ||
english: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Lord, O Supreme Treasure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam preet laagee man bheetar maagan kau har daan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is enshrined within my mind; I beg for the gift of Your Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਾਨ ॥
transliteration: sukhadaaee pooran paramesur kar kirapaa raakhahu maan ||
english: O Pefect Transcendent Lord, Giver of Peace, please grant Your Grace and save my honor.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dehu preet saadhoo sa(n)g suaamee har gun rasan bakhaan ||1||
english: Please bless me with such love, O my Lord and Master, that in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I may chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord with my tongue. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਥਾ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
transliteration: gopaal daiaal gobid damodar niramal kathaa giaan ||
english: O Lord of the World, Merciful Lord of the Universe, Your sermon and spiritual wisdom are immaculate and pure.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਗਹੁ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਿਆਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੩॥
transliteration: naanak kau har kai ra(n)g raagahu charan kamal sa(n)g dhiaan ||2||1||3||
english: Please attune Nanak to Your Love, O Lord, and focus his meditation on Your Lotus Feet. ||2||1||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
transliteration: har ke darasan ko man chaau ||
english: My mind yearns for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਅਪਨੋ ਨਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kar kirapaa satasa(n)g milaavahu tum devahu apano naau || rahaau ||
english: Please grant Your Grace, and unite me with the Society of the Saints; please bless me with Your Name. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਤ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਤਤ ਮਨਿ ਰਹਸਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karau sevaa sat purakh piaare jat suneeai tat man rahasaau ||
english: I serve my True Beloved Lord. Wherever I hear His Praise, there my mind is in ecstasy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਵਾਰੀ ਫੇਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਕਵਨੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਠਾਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: vaaree pheree sadaa ghumaaee kavan anoop tero thaau ||1||
english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever devoted to You. Your place is incomparably beautiful! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸਗਲਿਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sarab pratipaalahi sagal samaalahi sagaliaa teree chhaau ||
english: You cherish and nurture all; You take care of all, and Your shade covers all.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਉ ॥੨॥੨॥੪॥
transliteration: naanak ke prabh purakh bidhaate ghat ghat tujhahi dikhaau ||2||2||4||
english: You are the Primal Creator, the God of Nanak; I behold You in each and every heart. ||2||2||4||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
transliteration: pri kee preet piaaree ||
english: I love the Love of my Beloved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਗਨ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਆਸਾ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਤਾਰ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: magan manai mahi chitavau aasaa nainahu taar tuhaaree || rahaau ||
english: My mind is intoxicated with delight, and my consciousness is filled with hope; my eyes are drenched with Your Love. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਦਿਨ ਪਹਰ ਮੂਰਤ ਪਲ ਕੈਸੇ ਓਇ ਪਲ ਘਰੀ ਕਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: oi din pahar moorat pal kaise oi pal gharee kihaaree ||
english: Blessed is that day, that hour, minute and second when the heavy, rigid shutters are opened, and desire is quenched.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੂਲੇ ਕਪਟ ਧਪਟ ਬੁਝਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜੀਵਉ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khoole kapat dhapat bujh trisanaa jeevau pekh darasaaree ||1||
english: Seeing the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਤਨੁ ਉਪਾਉ ਕਿਨੇਹਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਉਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kaun s jatan upaau kinehaa sevaa kaun beechaaree ||
english: What is the method, what is the effort, and what is the service, which inspires me to contemplate You?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੫॥
transliteration: maan abhimaan mohu taj naanak sa(n)tah sa(n)g udhaaree ||2||3||5||
english: Abandon your egotistical pride and attachment; O Nanak, you shall be saved in the Society of the Saints. ||2||3||5||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: har har har gun gaavahu ||
english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿਦੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: karahu kripaa gopaal gobide apanaa naam japaavahu || rahaau ||
english: Have Mercy on me, O Life of the World, O Lord of the Universe, that I may chant Your Name. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਤੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: kaadh leee prabh aan bikhai te saadhasa(n)g man laavahu ||
english: Please lift me up, God, out of vice and corruption, and attach my mind to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਟਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhram bhau mohu katio gur bachanee apanaa daras dikhaavahu ||1||
english: Doubt, fear and attachment are eradicated from that person who follows the Guru's Teachings, and gazes on the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਤਜਾਵਹੁ ॥
transliteration: sabh kee ren hoi man meraa aha(n)budh tajaavahu ||
english: Let my mind become the dust of all; may I abandon my egotistical intellect.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: apanee bhagat dehi daiaalaa vadabhaagee naanak har paavahu ||2||4||6||
english: Please bless me with Your devotional worship, O Merciful Lord; by great good fortune, O Nanak, I have found the Lord. ||2||4||6||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਾਤ ॥
transliteration: har bin janam akaarath jaat ||
english: Without the Lord, life is useless.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਆਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਚਤ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਪਹਿਰਤ ਖਾਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: taj gopaal aan ra(n)g raachat mithiaa pahirat khaat || rahaau ||
english: Those who forsake the Lord, and become engrossed in other pleasures - false and useless are the clothes they wear, and the food they eat. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਸੁਖ ਭੋੁਗਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਨਿਬਹਤ ਮਾਤ ॥
transliteration: dhan joban sa(n)pai sukh bhougavai sa(n)g na nibahat maat ||
english: The pleasures of wealth, youth, property and comforts will not stay with you, O mother.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਬਾਵਰ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mrig trisanaa dekh rachio baavar drum chhaaiaa ra(n)g raat ||1||
english: Seeing the mirage, the madman is entangled in it; he is imbued with pleasures that pass away, like the shade of a tree. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਮਦ ਮੋਹਤ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੈ ਖਾਤ ॥
transliteration: maan moh mahaa mad mohat kaam krodh kai khaat ||
english: Totally intoxicated with the wine of pride and attachment, he has fallen into the pit of sexual desire and anger.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਤ ॥੨॥੫॥੭॥
transliteration: kar gahi lehu daas naanak kau prabh jeeu hoi sahaat ||2||5||7||
english: O Dear God, please be the Help and Support of servant Nanak; please take me by the hand, and uplift me. ||2||5||7||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਚਾਲਸਿ ਸਾਥ ॥
transliteration: har bin koi na chaalas saath ||
english: Nothing goes along with the mortal, except for the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਨਾਥਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: deenaa naath karunaapat suaamee anaathaa ke naath || rahaau ||
english: He is the Master of the meek, the Lord of Mercy, my Lord and Master, the Master of the masterless. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਭੋੁਗਵਤ ਨਹ ਨਿਬਹਤ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪਾਥ ॥
transliteration: sut sa(n)pat bikhiaa ras bhougavat nah nibahat jam kai paath ||
english: Children, possessions and the enjoyment of corrupt pleasures do not go along with the mortal on the path of Death.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗਾਉ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਉਧਰੁ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੇ ਖਾਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan gaau gun gobi(n)d udhar saagar ke khaat ||1||
english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the treasure of the Naam, and the Lord of the Universe, the mortal is carried across the deep ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥ ॥
transliteration: saran samarath akath agochar har simarat dukh laath ||
english: In the Sanctuary of the All-powerful, Indescribable, Unfathomable Lord, meditate in remembrance on Him, and your pains shall vanish.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਿਖਤ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਾਥ ॥੨॥੬॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak deen dhoor jan baa(n)chhat milai likhat dhur maath ||2||6||8||
english: Nanak longs for the dust of the feet of the Lord's humble servant; he shall obtain it only if such pre-ordained destiny is written on his forehead. ||2||6||8||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ghar 5 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹਰੀ ॥
transliteration: bisarat naahi man te haree ||
english: I do not forget the Lord in my mind.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਇਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਭਈ ਆਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: ab ih preet mahaa prabal bhaee aan bikhai jaree || rahaau ||
english: This love has now become very strong; it has burnt away other corruption. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਬੂੰਦ ਕਹਾ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੀਨ ਰਹਤ ਨ ਘਰੀ ॥
transliteration: boo(n)d kahaa tiaag chaatrik meen rahat na gharee ||
english: How can the rainbird forsake the rain-drop? The fish cannot survive without water, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਉਚਾਰੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਟੇਵ ਏਹ ਪਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: gun gopaal uchaar rasanaa tev eh paree ||1||
english: My tongue chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World; this has become part of my very nature. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਨਾਦ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਬੇਧਿ ਤੀਖਨ ਸਰੀ ॥
transliteration: mahaa naad kura(n)k mohio bedh teekhan saree ||
english: The deer is fascinated by the sound of the bell, and so it is shot with the sharp arrow.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਸਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਠਿ ਬਾਧਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੯॥
transliteration: prabh charan kamal rasaal naanak gaath baadh dharee ||2||1||9||
english: God's Lotus Feet are the Source of Nectar; O Nanak, I am tied to them by a knot. ||2||1||9||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਸਤ ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਖੋਰ ॥
transliteration: preetam basat rid mahi khor ||
english: My Beloved dwells in the cave of my heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਓਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bharam bheet nivaar thaakur gahi lehu apanee or ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Shatter the wall of doubt, O my Lord and Master; please grab hold of me, and lift me up towards Yourself. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਕ ਗਰਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਚਾਰਹੁ ਧੋਰ ॥
transliteration: adhik garat sa(n)saar saagar kar daiaa chaarahu dhor ||
english: The world-ocean is so vast and deep; please be kind, lift me up and place me on the shore.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਉਧਰਤੇ ਲੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g har charan bohith udharate lai mor ||1||
english: In the Society of the Saints, the Lord's Feet are the boat to carry us across. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਰ ॥
transliteration: garabh ku(n)t mahi jinahi dhaario nahee bikhai ban mahi hor ||
english: The One who placed you in the womb of your mother's belly - no one else shall save you in the wilderness of corruption.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਕਤ ਸਰਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਹੋਰ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੦॥
transliteration: har sakat saran samarath naanak aan nahee nihor ||2||2||10||
english: The power of the Lord's Sanctuary is all-powerful; Nanak does not rely on any other. ||2||2||10||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਬਖਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: rasanaa raam raam bakhaan ||
english: With your tongue, chant the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਉਚਾਰੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਭਏ ਕਲਮਲ ਹਾਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gun goupaal uchaar din rain bhae kalamal haan || rahaau ||
english: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night, your sins shall be eradicated. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਲਨਾ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਪਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰ ਪਰਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
transliteration: tiaag chalanaa sagal sa(n)pat kaal sir par jaan ||
english: You shall have to leave behind all your riches when you depart. Death is hanging over your head - know this well!

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਨ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਰੰਤ ਆਸਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mithan moh dura(n)t aasaa jhooth sarapar maan ||1||
english: Transitory attachments and evil hopes are false. Surely you must believe this! ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
transliteration: sat purakh akaal moorat ridai dhaarahu dhiaan ||
english: Within your heart, focus your meditation on the True Primal Being, Akaal Moorat, the Undying Form.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਲਾਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਇਹ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naam nidhaan laabh naanak basat ih paravaan ||2||3||11||
english: Only this profitable merchandise, the treasure of the Naam, O Nanak, shall be accepted. ||2||3||11||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam ko aadhaar ||
english: I take only the Support of the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਨ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kal kales na kachh biaapai sa(n)tasa(n)g biuhaar || rahaau ||
english: Suffering and conflict do not afflict me; I deal only with the Society of the Saints. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਨਹ ਉਪਜਤਉ ਬੇਕਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kar anugrahu aap raakhio nah upajatau bekaar ||
english: Showering His Mercy on me, the Lord Himself has saved me, and no evil thoughts arise within me.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਹਤ ਨਹ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jis paraapat hoi simarai tis dahat nah sa(n)saar ||1||
english: Whoever receives this Grace, contemplates Him in meditation; he is not burned by the fire of the world. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
