gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: sukh ma(n)gal aana(n)d har har prabh charan a(n)mrit saar ||
english: Peace, joy and bliss come from the Lord, Har, Har. God's Feet are sublime and excellent.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਨਾਗਤੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੨॥
transliteration: naanak daas saranaagatee tere sa(n)tanaa kee chhaar ||2||4||12||
english: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; he is the dust of the feet of Your Saints. ||2||4||12||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam bin dhrig srot ||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, one's ears are cursed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤਿਹ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨ ਹੋਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jeevan roop bisaar jeevahi tih kat jeevan hot || rahaau ||
english: Those who forget the Embodiment of Life - what is the point of their lives? ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਾਰ ਬਾਹਕ ਖੋਤ ॥
transliteration: khaat peet anek bi(n)jan jaise bhaar baahak khot ||
english: One who eats and drinks countless delicacies is no more than a donkey, a beast of burden.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਹਾ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਰਖ ਜੰਤੀ ਜੋਤ ॥੧॥
transliteration: aath pahar mahaa sram paaiaa jaise birakh ja(n)tee jot ||1||
english: Twenty-four hours a day, he endures terrible suffering, like the bull, chained to the oil-press. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਜਿ ਆਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੀ ਰੋਤ ॥
transliteration: taj goupaal j aan laage se bahu prakaaree rot ||
english: Forsaking the Life of the World, and attached to another, they weep and wail in so many ways.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਉ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਤ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੩॥
transliteration: kar jor naanak daan maagai har rakhau ka(n)th parot ||2||5||13||
english: With his palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this gift; O Lord, please keep me strung around Your Neck. ||2||5||13||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਧੂਰਿ ਲੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਲੀ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tah dhoor le mukh malee ||
english: I take the dust of the feet of the Saints and apply it to my face.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਾ ਅਚੁਤ ਸਦਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਹ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਆਪਹਿ ਕਲੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gunaa achut sadaa pooran nah dokh biaapahi kalee || rahaau ||
english: Hearing of the Imperishable, Eternally Perfect Lord, pain does not afflict me, even in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਰਬ ਪੂਰਨ ਈਤ ਊਤ ਨ ਹਲੀ ॥
transliteration: gur bachan kaaraj sarab pooran eet oot na halee ||
english: Through the Guru's Word, all affairs are resolved, and the mind is not tossed about here and there.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਸਰਬਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਜਲੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: prabh ek anik sarabat pooran bikhai agan na jalee ||1||
english: Whoever sees the One God to be pervading in all the many beings, does not burn in the fire of corruption. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪਨੋ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਰਲੀ ॥
transliteration: gahi bhujaa leeno daas apano jot jotee ralee ||
english: The Lord grasps His slave by the arm, and his light merges into the Light.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲੀ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੪॥
transliteration: prabh charan saran anaath aaio naanak har sa(n)g chalee ||2||6||14||
english: Nanak, the orphan, has come seeking the Sanctuary of God's Feet; O Lord, he walks with You. ||2||6||14||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਰੁਚੈ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam kee man ruchai ||
english: My mind is filled with yearning for the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਲਤ ਛਾਤੀ ਬੁਝੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kot saa(n)t ana(n)d pooran jalat chhaatee bujhai || rahaau ||
english: I am totally filled with tranquility and bliss; the burning desire within has been quenched. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰੇ ਮੁਚੈ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)t maarag chalat praanee patit udhare muchai ||
english: Walking on the path of the Saints, millions of mortal sinners have been saved.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਰੇਨੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਲਗੀ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੁਚੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: ren jan kee lagee masatak anik teerath suchai ||1||
english: One who applies the dust of the feet of the humble to his forehead, is purified, as if he has bathed at countless sacred shrines. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਧਿਆਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
transliteration: charan kamal dhiaan bheetar ghat ghatahi suaamee sujhai ||
english: Meditating on His Lotus Feet deep within, one realizes the Lord and Master in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਲੁਝੈ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੫॥
transliteration: saran dev apaar naanak bahur jam nahee lujhai ||2||7||15||
english: In the Sanctuary of the Divine, Infinite Lord, Nanak shall never again be tortured by the Messenger of Death. ||2||7||15||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
transliteration: kedaaraa chha(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
english: Kaydaaraa Chhant, Fifth Mehl:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: mil mere preetam piaariaa || rahaau ||
english: Please meet me, O my Dear Beloved. ||Pause||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: poor rahiaa sarabatr mai so purakh bidhaataa ||
english: He is All-pervading amongst all, the Architect of Destiny.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: maarag prabh kaa har keeaa sa(n)tan sa(n)g jaataa ||
english: The Lord God has created His Path, which is known in the Society of the Saints.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: sa(n)tan sa(n)g jaataa purakh bidhaataa ghat ghat nadar nihaaliaa ||
english: The Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is known in the Society of the Saints; You are seen in each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੰਨੈ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
transliteration: jo saranee aavai sarab sukh paavai til nahee bha(n)nai ghaaliaa ||
english: One who comes to His Sanctuary, finds absolute peace; not even a bit of his work goes unnoticed.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਏ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: har gun nidh gaae sahaj subhaae prem mahaa ras maataa ||
english: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue, is easily, naturally intoxicated with the supreme, sublime essence of divine love.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤੂ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaaee too pooran purakh bidhaataa ||1||
english: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; You are the Perfect Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||1||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਸੇ ਆਨ ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: har prem bhagat jan bedhiaa se aan kat jaahee ||
english: The Lord's humble servant is pierced through with loving devotion to Him; where else can he go?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਮੀਨੁ ਬਿਛੋਹਾ ਨਾ ਸਹੈ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: meen bichhohaa naa sahai jal bin mar paahee ||
english: The fish cannot endure separation, and without water, it will die.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਦੂਖ ਕਿਨਿ ਸਹੀਐ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਿਆਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har bin kiu raheeai dookh kin saheeai chaatrik boo(n)d piaasiaa ||
english: Without the Lord, how can I survive? How can I endure the pain? I am like the rainbird, thirsty for the rain-drop.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਬ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਚਕਵੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੂਰਜ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ॥
transliteration: kab rain bihaavai chakavee sukh paavai sooraj kiran pragaasiaa ||
english: "When will the night pass?," asks the chakvi bird. "I shall find peace only when the rays of the sun shine on me."

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੀ ॥
transliteration: har daras man laagaa dinas sabhaagaa anadin har gun gaahee ||
english: My mind is attached to the Blessed Vision of the Lord. Blessed are the nights and days, when I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord,

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਟਿਕਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak daas kahai bena(n)tee kat har bin praan tikaahee ||2||
english: Slave Nanak utters this prayer; without the Lord, how can the breath of life continue to flow through me? ||2||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਕਤ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: saas binaa jiu dehuree kat sobhaa paavai ||
english: Without the breath, how can the body obtain glory and fame?

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਦਰਸ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਟਿਕਣੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
transliteration: daras bihoonaa saadh jan khin tikan na aavai ||
english: Without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, the humble, holy person does not find peace, even for an instant.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੋ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਰਕੁ ਸੋ ਸਹਣਾ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har bin jo rahanaa narak so sahanaa charan kamal man bedhiaa ||
english: Those who are without the Lord suffer in hell; my mind is pierced through with the Lord's Feet.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿਕ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਨਿਖੇਧਿਆ ॥
transliteration: har rasik bairaagee naam liv laagee katahu na jaai nikhedhiaa ||
english: The Lord is both sensual and unattached; lovingly attune yourself to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. No one can ever deny Him.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲਣਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਅੰਕਿ ਨ ਮਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: har siu jaai milanaa saadhasa(n)g rahanaa so sukh a(n)k na maavai ||
english: Go and meet with the Lord, and dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; no one can contain that peace within his being.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: hohu kripaal naanak ke suaamee har charanah sa(n)g samaavai ||3||
english: Please be kind to me, O Lord and Master of Nanak, that I may merge in You. ||3||

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: khojat khojat prabh mile har karunaa dhaare ||
english: Searching and searching, I have met with my Lord God, who has showered me with His Mercy.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਮੈ ਨਹੀ ਦੋਖ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: niragun neech anaath mai nahee dokh beechaare ||
english: I am unworthy, a lowly orphan, but He does not even consider my faults.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਨਹੀ ਦੋਖ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ ਪਾਵਨ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬਖਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: nahee dokh beechaare pooran sukh saare paavan birad bakhaaniaa ||
english: He does not consider my faults; He has blessed me with Perfect Peace. It is said that it is His Way to purify us.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਅੰਚਲੋੁ ਗਹਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bhagat vachhal sun a(n)chalou gahiaa ghat ghat poor samaaniaa ||
english: Hearing that He is the Love of His devotees, I have grasped the hem of His robe. He is totally permeating each and every heart.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੋੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: sukh saagarou paaiaa sahaj subhaaiaa janam maran dukh haare ||
english: I have found the Lord, the Ocean of Peace, with intuitive ease; the pains of birth and death are gone.

author: Guru Arjan
gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: kar gahi leene naanak daas apane raam naam ur haare ||4||1||
english: Taking him by the hand, the Lord has saved Nanak, His slave; He has woven the garland of His Name into his heart. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag kedaaraa baanee kabeer jeeu kee ||
english: Raag Kaydaaraa, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ ਤਜਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
transliteration: usatat ni(n)daa dooo bibarajit tajahu maan abhimaanaa ||
english: Those who ignore both praise and slander, who reject egotistical pride and conceit,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੋਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤੇ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: lohaa ka(n)chan sam kar jaanahi te moorat bhagavaanaa ||1||
english: who look alike upon iron and gold - they are the very image of the Lord God. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਆਧੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: teraa jan ek aadh koee ||
english: Hardly anyone is a humble servant of Yours, O Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu bibarajit har pad cheenhai soee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Ignoring sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, such a person becomes aware of the Lord's Feet. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਜ ਗੁਣ ਤਮ ਗੁਣ ਸਤ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੀਐ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: raj gun tam gun sat gun kaheeai ih teree sabh maaiaa ||
english: Raajas, the quality of energy and activity; Taamas, the quality of darkness and inertia; and Satvas, the quality of purity and light, are all called the creations of Maya, Your illusion.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਹੀ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: chauthe pad kau jo nar cheenhai tinh hee param pad paaiaa ||2||
english: That man who realizes the fourth state - he alone obtains the supreme state. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਹਕਾਮਾ ॥
transliteration: teerath barat nem such sa(n)jam sadaa rahai nihakaamaa ||
english: Amidst pilgrimages, fasting, rituals, purification and self-discipline, he remains always without thought of reward.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: trisanaa ar maaiaa bhram chookaa chitavat aatam raamaa ||3||
english: Thirst and desire for Maya and doubt depart, remembering the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਅੰਧਕਾਰੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
transliteration: jih ma(n)dar deepak paragaasiaa a(n)dhakaar tah naasaa ||
english: When the temple is illuminated by the lamp, its darkness is dispelled.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: nirabhau poor rahe bhram bhaagaa kahi kabeer jan daasaa ||4||1||
english: The Fearless Lord is All-pervading. Doubt has run away, says Kabeer, the Lord's humble slave. ||4||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਬਨਜਿਆ ਕਾਂਸੀ ਤਾਂਬਾ ਕਿਨਹੀ ਲਉਗ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: kinahee banajiaa kaa(n)see taa(n)baa kinahee laug supaaree ||
english: Some deal in bronze and copper, some in cloves and betel nuts.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਬਨਜਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕਾ ਐਸੀ ਖੇਪ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sa(n)tahu banajiaa naam gobid kaa aisee khep hamaaree ||1||
english: The Saints deal in the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe. Such is my merchandise as well. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਆਪਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: har ke naam ke biaapaaree ||
english: I am a trader in the Name of the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਹੀਰਾ ਹਾਥਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਈ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: heeraa haath chaRiaa niramolak chhoot gaee sa(n)saaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The priceless diamond has come into my hands. I have left the world behind. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਲਾਏ ਤਉ ਸਚ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: saache laae tau sach laage saache ke biuhaaree ||
english: When the True Lord attached me, then I was attached to Truth. I am a trader of the True Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਕੇ ਭਾਰ ਚਲਾਏ ਪਹੁਚੇ ਜਾਇ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: saachee basat ke bhaar chalaae pahuche jaai bha(n)daaree ||2||
english: I have loaded the commodity of Truth; It has reached the Lord, the Treasurer. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਆਪੈ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: aapahi ratan javaahar maanik aapai hai paasaaree ||
english: He Himself is the pearl, the jewel, the ruby; He Himself is the jeweller.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਆਪ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਆਪਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aapai dah dis aap chalaavai nihachal hai biaapaaree ||3||
english: He Himself spreads out in the ten directions. The Merchant is Eternal and Unchanging. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਲੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪੈਡਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੋਨਿ ਭਰਿ ਡਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: man kar bail surat kar paidaa giaan gon bhar daaree ||
english: My mind is the bull, and meditation is the road; I have filled my packs with spiritual wisdom, and loaded them on the bull.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਖੇਪ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu nibahee khep hamaaree ||4||2||
english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: my merchandise has reached its destination! ||4||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੀ ਕਲਵਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਰਿ ਮੂਢ ਮਤਿ ਉਲਟੋ ਪਵਨੁ ਫਿਰਾਵਉ ॥
transliteration: ree kalavaar gavaar moodh mat ulato pavan phiraavau ||
english: You barbaric brute, with your primitive intellect - reverse your breath and turn it inward.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰ ਮੇਰ ਸਰ ਭਾਠੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਆਵਉ ॥੧॥
transliteration: man matavaar mer sar bhaathee a(n)mrit dhaar chuaavau ||1||
english: Let your mind be intoxicated with the stream of Ambrosial Nectar which trickles down from the furnace of the Tenth Gate. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਈਆ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਦੁਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bolahu bhaeeaa raam kee duhaaee ||
english: O Siblings of Destiny, call on the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਿਆਸ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: peevahu sa(n)t sadaa mat duralabh sahaje piaas bujhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Saints, drink in this wine forever; it is so difficult to obtain, and it quenches your thirst so easily. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਚਿ ਭਾਉ ਭਾਇ ਕੋਊ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: bhai bich bhaau bhaai kooo boojhahi har ras paavai bhaaee ||
english: In the Fear of God, is the Love of God. Only those few who understand His Love obtain the sublime essence of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਘਟ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪੀਆਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jete ghat a(n)mrit sabh hee mahi bhaavai tisahi peeaaee ||2||
english: As many hearts as there are - in all of them, is His Ambrosial Nectar; as He pleases, He causes them to drink it in. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਨਗਰੀ ਏਕੈ ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਬਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
transliteration: nagaree ekai nau daravaaje dhaavat baraj rahaaee ||
english: There are nine gates to the one city of the body; restrain your mind from escaping through them.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ ਦਸਵਾ ਦਰੁ ਖੂਲੑੈ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਖੀਵਾ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: trikutee chhootai dasavaa dar khoolhai taa man kheevaa bhaaee ||3||
english: When the knot of the three qualities is untied, then the Tenth Gate opens up, and the mind is intoxicated, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਭੈ ਪਦ ਪੂਰਿ ਤਾਪ ਤਹ ਨਾਸੇ ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: abhai pad poor taap tah naase kahi kabeer beechaaree ||
english: When the mortal fully realizes the state of fearless dignity, then his sufferings vanish; so says Kabeer after careful deliberation.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਉਬਟ ਚਲੰਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਖੋਂਦ ਖੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: ubat chala(n)te ihu mad paaiaa jaise kho(n)d khumaaree ||4||3||
english: Turning away from the world, I have obtained this wine, and I am intoxicated with it. ||4||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕੇ ਲੀਨੇ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਏਕੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: kaam krodh trisanaa ke leene gat nahee ekai jaanee ||
english: You are engrossed with unsatisfied sexual desire and unresolved anger; you do not know the State of the One Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਫੂਟੀ ਆਖੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਬੂਡਿ ਮੂਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: phootee aakhai kachhoo na soojhai bood mooe bin paanee ||1||
english: Your eyes are blinded, and you see nothing at all. You drown and die without water. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਲਤ ਕਤ ਟੇਢੇ ਟੇਢੇ ਟੇਢੇ ॥
transliteration: chalat kat tedhe tedhe tedhe ||
english: Why do you walk in that crooked, zig-zag way?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਸਤਿ ਚਰਮ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਮੂੰਦੇ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਬੇਢੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: asat charam bisataa ke moo(n)de duraga(n)dh hee ke bedhe ||1|| rahaau ||
english: You are nothing more than a bundle of bones, wrapped in skin, filled with manure; you give off such a rotten smell! ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨ ਜਪਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੂਲੇ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
transliteration: raam na japahu kavan bhram bhoole tum te kaal na doore ||
english: You do not meditate on the Lord. What doubts have confused and deluded you? Death is not far away from you!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: anik jatan kar ihu tan raakhahu rahai avasathaa poore ||2||
english: Making all sorts of efforts, you manage to preserve this body, but it shall only survive until its time is up. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: aapan keeaa kachhoo na hovai kiaa ko karai paraanee ||
english: By one's own efforts, nothing is done. What can the mere mortal accomplish?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai satigur bhetai eko naam bakhaanee ||3||
english: When it pleases the Lord, the mortal meets the True Guru, and chants the Name of the One Lord. ||3||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਬਲੂਆ ਕੇ ਘਰੂਆ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਤੇ ਫੁਲਵਤ ਦੇਹ ਅਇਆਨੇ ॥
transliteration: balooaa ke gharooaa mahi basate phulavat deh aiaane ||
english: You live in a house of sand, but you still puff up your body - you ignorant fool!

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਹ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਬੂਡੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਨੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: kahu kabeer jih raam na chetio boode bahut siaane ||4||4||
english: Says Kabeer, those who do not remember the Lord may be very clever, but they still drown. ||4||4||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਟੇਢੀ ਪਾਗ ਟੇਢੇ ਚਲੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਬੀਰੇ ਖਾਨ ॥
transliteration: tedhee paag tedhe chale laage beere khaan ||
english: Your turban is crooked, and you walk crooked; and now you have started chewing betel leaves.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਾਮੁ ਦੀਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhaau bhagat siu kaaj na kachhooai mero kaam deevaan ||1||
english: You have no use at all for loving devotional worship; you say you have business in court. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: raam bisaario hai abhimaan ||
english: In your egotistical pride, you have forgotten the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kanik kaamanee mahaa su(n)daree pekh pekh sach maan ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Gazing upon your gold, and your very beautiful wife, you believe that they are permanent. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਹਾ ਮਦ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਨਿ ॥
transliteration: laalach jhooth bikaar mahaa mad ih bidh audh bihaan ||
english: You are engrossed in greed, falsehood, corruption and great arrogance. Your life is passing away.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬੇਰ ਆਇ ਲਾਗੋ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੨॥੫॥
transliteration: kahi kabeer a(n)t kee ber aai laago kaal nidaan ||2||5||
english: Says Kabeer, at the very last moment, death will come and seize you, you fool! ||2||5||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਨ ਅਪਨੀ ਨਉਬਤਿ ਚਲੇ ਬਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: chaar din apanee naubat chale bajaai ||
english: The mortal beats the drum for a few days, and then he must depart.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਇਤਨਕੁ ਖਟੀਆ ਗਠੀਆ ਮਟੀਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਛੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: itanak khateeaa gatheeaa mateeaa sa(n)g na kachh lai jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: With so much wealth and cash and buried treasure, still, he cannot take anything with him. ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਦਿਹਰੀ ਬੈਠੀ ਮਿਹਰੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਲਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: diharee baithee miharee rovai duaarai lau sa(n)g maai ||
english: Sitting on the threshhold, his wife weeps and wails; his mother accompanies him to the outer gate.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਮਰਹਟ ਲਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: marahat lag sabh log kuta(n)b mil ha(n)s ikelaa jaai ||1||
english: All the people and relatives together go to the crematorium, but the swan-soul must go home all alone. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਵੈ ਸੁਤ ਵੈ ਬਿਤ ਵੈ ਪੁਰ ਪਾਟਨ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: vai sut vai bit vai pur paatan bahur na dekhai aai ||
english: Those children, that wealth, that city and town - he shall not come to see them again.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥੬॥
transliteration: kahat kabeer raam kee na simarahu janam akaarath jaai ||2||6||
english: Says Kabeer, why do you not meditate on the Lord? Your life is uselessly slipping away! ||2||6||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
transliteration: raag kedaaraa baanee ravidaas jeeu kee ||
english: Raag Kaydaaraa, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕੁਲ ਸੰਜੁਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: khat karam kul sa(n)jugat hai har bhagat hiradai naahi ||
english: One who performs the six religious rituals and comes from a good family, but who does not have devotion to the Lord in his heart,

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਕਥਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਪਚ ਤੁਲਿ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: charanaarabi(n)d na kathaa bhaavai supach tul samaan ||1||
english: one who does not appreciate talk of the Lord's Lotus Feet, is just like an outcaste, a pariah. ||1||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤਿ ਚੇਤ ਅਚੇਤ ॥
transliteration: re chit chet chet achet ||
english: Be conscious, be conscious, be conscious, O my unconscious mind.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਬਾਲਮੀਕਹਿ ਦੇਖ ॥
transliteration: kaahe na baalameekahi dekh ||
english: Why do you not look at Baalmeek?

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਤੇ ਕਿਹ ਪਦਹਿ ਅਮਰਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਸੇਖ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kis jaat te kih padahi amario raam bhagat bisekh ||1|| rahaau ||
english: From such a low social status, what a high status he obtained! Devotional worship to the Lord is sublime! ||1||Pause||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਨ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਜਾਤੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
transliteration: suaan satr ajaat sabh te krisn laavai het ||
english: The killer of dogs, the lowest of all, was lovingly embraced by Krishna.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਲੋਗੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਰਾਹੈ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ॥੨॥
transliteration: log bapuraa kiaa saraahai teen lok praves ||2||
english: See how the poor people praise him! His praise extends throughout the three worlds. ||2||

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਲੁਭਤੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਗਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: ajaamal pi(n)gulaa lubhat ku(n)char gae har kai paas ||
english: Ajaamal, Pingulaa, Lodhia and the elephant went to the Lord.

author: Bhagat Kabir
gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਤਰਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ॥੩॥੧॥
transliteration: aise duramat nisatare too kiu na tarahi ravidaas ||3||1||
english: Even such evil-minded beings were emancipated. Why should you not also be saved, O Ravi Daas? ||3||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
transliteration: raag bhairau mahalaa 1 ghar 1 chaupade ||
english: Raag Bhairao, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: tujh te baahar kichhoo na hoi ||
english: Without You, nothing happens.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: too kar kar dekhahi jaanahi soi ||1||
english: You create the creatures, and gazing on them, you know them. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
transliteration: kiaa kaheeai kichh kahee na jaai ||
english: What can I say? I cannot say anything.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਹੈ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh ahai sabh teree rajaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Whatever exists, is by Your Will. ||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
transliteration: jo kichh karanaa s terai paas ||
english: Whatever is to be done, rests with You.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕੀਚੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kis aagai keechai aradaas ||2||
english: Unto whom should I offer my prayer? ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
transliteration: aakhan sunanaa teree baanee ||
english: I speak and hear the Bani of Your Word.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
transliteration: too aape jaanahi sarab vidaanee ||3||
english: You Yourself know all Your Wondrous Play. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
transliteration: kare karaae jaanai aap ||
english: You Yourself act, and inspire all to act; only You Yourself know.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਖੈ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
transliteration: naanak dekhai thaap uthaap ||4||1||
english: Says Nanak, You, Lord, see, establish and disestablish. ||4||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: raag bhairau mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
english: Raag Bhairao, First Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad tare mun kete i(n)draadik brahamaad tare ||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, so many silent sages have been saved; Indra and Brahma have also been saved.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦਨ ਤਪਸੀ ਜਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: sanak sana(n)dan tapasee jan kete gur parasaadee paar pare ||1||
english: Sanak, Sanandan and many humble men of austerity, by Guru's Grace, have been carried across to the other side. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
transliteration: bhavajal bin sabadai kiu tareeai ||
english: Without the Word of the Shabad, how can anyone cross over the terrifying world-ocean?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗੁ ਰੋਗਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਡੁਬਿ ਡੁਬਿ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naam binaa jag rog biaapiaa dubidhaa dub dub mareeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the world is entangled in the disease of duality, and is drowned, drowned, and dies. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
transliteration: gur devaa gur alakh abhevaa tribhavan sojhee gur kee sevaa ||
english: The Guru is Divine; the Guru is Inscrutable and Mysterious. Serving the Guru, the three worlds are known and understood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aape daat karee gur daatai paaiaa alakh abhevaa ||2||
english: The Guru, the Giver, has Himself given me the Gift; I have obtained the Inscrutable, Mysterious Lord. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
transliteration: man raajaa man man te maaniaa manasaa manahi samaaee ||
english: The mind is the king; the mind is appeased and satisfied through the mind itself, and desire is stilled in the mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਓਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man jogee man binas biogee man samajhai gun gaaee ||3||
english: The mind is the Yogi, the mind wastes away in separation from the Lord; singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the mind is instructed and reformed. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: gur te man maariaa sabad veechaariaa te virale sa(n)saaraa ||
english: How very rare are those in this world who, through the Guru, subdue their minds, and contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
transliteration: naanak saahib bharipur leenaa saach sabad nisataaraa ||4||1||2||
english: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is All-pervading; through the True Word of the Shabad, we are emancipated. ||4||1||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 1 ||
english: Bhairao, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੈਨੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੀਨਾ ਜਰਿ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੋ ॥
transliteration: nainee drisat nahee tan heenaa jar jeetiaa sir kaalo ||
english: The eyes lose their sight, and the body withers away; old age overtakes the mortal, and death hangs over his head.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਿਉ ਛੋਡੈ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੋ ॥੧॥
transliteration: roop ra(n)g rahas nahee saachaa kiu chhodai jam jaalo ||1||
english: Beauty, loving attachment and the pleasures of life are not permanent. How can anyone escape from the noose of death? ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਓ ॥
transliteration: praanee har jap janam gaio ||
english: O mortal, meditate on the Lord - your life is passing away!

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: saach sabad bin kabahu na chhootas birathaa janam bhaio ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the True Word of the Shabad, you shall never be released, and your life shall be totally useless. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਹਉ ਮਮਤਾ ਕਠਿਨ ਪੀਰ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: tan mahi kaam krodh hau mamataa kathin peer at bhaaree ||
english: Within the body are sexual desire, anger, egotism and attachment. This pain is so great, and so difficult to endure.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh raam japahu ras rasanaa in bidh tar too taaree ||2||
english: As Gurmukh, chant the Lord's Name, and savor it with your tongue; in this way, you shall cross over to the other side. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਹਰੇ ਕਰਨ ਅਕਲਿ ਭਈ ਹੋਛੀ ਸਬਦ ਸਹਜੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਿਆ ॥
transliteration: bahare karan akal bhaee hochhee sabad sahaj nahee boojhiaa ||
english: Your ears are deaf, and your intellect is worthless, and still, you do not intuitively understand the Word of the Shabad.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: janam padaarath manamukh haariaa bin gur a(n)dh na soojhiaa ||3||
english: The self-willed manmukh wastes this priceless human life and loses it. Without the Guru, the blind person cannot see. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: rahai udaas aas niraasaa sahaj dhiaan bairaagee ||
english: Whoever remains detached and free of desire in the midst of desire - and whoever, unattached, intuitively meditates on the Celestial Lord

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
transliteration: pranavat naanak guramukh chhootas raam naam liv laagee ||4||2||3||
english: - prays Nanak, as Gurmukh, he is released. He is lovingly attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||||2||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 1 ||
english: Bhairao, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੂੰਡੀ ਚਾਲ ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਖਿਸਰੇ ਤੁਚਾ ਦੇਹ ਕੁਮਲਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: bhoo(n)dee chaal charan kar khisare tuchaa deh kumalaanee ||
english: His walk becomes weak and clumsy, his feet and hands shake, and the skin of his body is withered and wrinkled.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਧੁੰਧਿ ਕਰਨ ਭਏ ਬਹਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: netree dhu(n)dh karan bhae bahare manamukh naam na jaanee ||1||
english: His eyes are dim, his ears are deaf, and yet, the self-willed manmukh does not know the Naam. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਗਿ ਆਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)dhule kiaa paaiaa jag aai ||
english: O blind man, what have you obtained by coming into the world?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਲੇ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: raam ridai nahee gur kee sevaa chaale mool gavaai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Lord is not in your heart, and you do not serve the Guru. After wasting your capital, you shall have to depart. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਬ ਬੋਲੈ ਤਬ ਫੀਕੇ ॥
transliteration: jihavaa ra(n)g nahee har raatee jab bolai tab pheeke ||
english: Your tongue is not imbued with the Love of the Lord; whatever you say is tasteless and insipid.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਵਿਆਪਸਿ ਪਸੂ ਭਏ ਕਦੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਨੀਕੇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee ni(n)daa viaapas pasoo bhae kade hohi na neeke ||2||
english: You indulge in slander of the Saints; becoming a beast, you shall never be noble. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: a(n)mrit kaa ras viralee paaiaa satigur mel milaae ||
english: Only a few obtain the sublime essence of the Ambrosial Amrit, united in Union with the True Guru.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਬਦ ਭੇਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: jab lag sabad bhed nahee aaiaa tab lag kaal sa(n)taae ||3||
english: As long as the mortal does not come to understand the mystery of the Shabad, the Word of God, he shall continue to be tormented by death. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਏਕੋ ਦਰੁ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
transliteration: an ko dar ghar kabahoo na jaanas eko dar sachiaaraa ||
english: Whoever finds the door of the One True Lord, does not know any other house or door.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੪॥
transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paaiaa naanak kahai vichaaraa ||4||3||4||
english: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status; so says poor Nanak. ||4||3||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 1 ||
english: Bhairao, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੋਵਤ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: sagalee rain sovat gal phaahee dinas ja(n)jaal gavaaiaa ||
english: He spends the entire night in sleep; the noose is tied around his neck. His day is wasted in worldly entanglements.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਘੜੀ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
transliteration: khin pal ghaRee nahee prabh jaaniaa jin ihu jagat upaaiaa ||1||
english: He does not know God, who created this world, for a moment, for even an instant. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: man re kiu chhootas dukh bhaaree ||
english: O mortal, how will you escape this terrible disaster?

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਆਵਸਿ ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਜਾਵਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: kiaa le aavas kiaa le jaavas raam japahu gunakaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
english: What did you bring with you, and what will you take away? Meditate on the Lord, the Most Worthy and Generous Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਊਂਧਉ ਕਵਲੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਛੀ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
transliteration: oo(n)dhau kaval manamukh mat hochhee man a(n)dhai sir dha(n)dhaa ||
english: The heart-lotus of the self-willed manmukh is upside-down; his intellect is shallow; his mind is blind, and his head is entangled in worldly affairs.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਗਲਿ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: kaal bikaal sadaa sir terai bin naavai gal pha(n)dhaa ||2||
english: Death and re-birth constantly hang over your head; without the Name, your neck shall be caught in the noose. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡਗਰੀ ਚਾਲ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਫੁਨਿ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dagaree chaal netr phun a(n)dhule sabad surat nahee bhaaee ||
english: Your steps are unsteady, and your eyes are blind; you are not aware of the Word of the Shabad, O Sibling of Destiny.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਧੁਲਉ ਧੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: saasatr bed trai gun hai maaiaa a(n)dhulau dha(n)dh kamaaee ||3||
english: The Shaastras and the Vedas keep the mortal bound to the three modes of Maya, and so he performs his deeds blindly. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਖੋਇਓ ਮੂਲੁ ਲਾਭੁ ਕਹ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ॥
transliteration: khoio mool laabh kah paavas duramat giaan vihoone ||
english: He loses his capital - how can he earn any profit? The evil-minded person has no spiritual wisdom at all.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਣੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
transliteration: sabad beechaar raam ras chaakhiaa naanak saach pateene ||4||4||5||
english: Contemplating the Shabad, he drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; O Nanak, his faith is confirmed in the Truth. ||4||4||5||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 1 ||
english: Bhairao, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
transliteration: gur kai sa(n)g rahai din raatee raam rasan ra(n)g raataa ||
english: He remains with the Guru, day and night, and his tongue savors the savory taste of the Lord's Love.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਸਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਸਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: avar na jaanas sabad pachhaanas a(n)tar jaan pachhaataa ||1||
english: He does not know any other; he realizes the Word of the Shabad. He knows and realizes the Lord deep within his own being. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
transliteration: so jan aisaa mai man bhaavai ||
english: Such a humble person is pleasing to my mind.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: aap maar apara(n)par raataa gur kee kaar kamaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He conquers his self-conceit, and is imbued with the Infinite Lord. He serves the Guru. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੋ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar purakh nira(n)jan aad purakh aadeso ||
english: Deep within my being, and outside as well, is the Immaculate Lord God. I bow humbly before that Primal Lord God.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਸੋ ॥੨॥
transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar rav rahiaa sach veso ||2||
english: Deep within each and every heart, and amidst all, the Embodiment of Truth is permeating and pervading. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਈ ॥
transliteration: saach rate sach a(n)mrit jihavaa mithiaa mail na raaee ||
english: Those who are imbued with Truth - their tongues are tinged with Truth; they do not have even an iota of the filth of falsehood.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: niramal naam a(n)mrit ras chaakhiaa sabad rate pat paaee ||3||
english: They taste the sweet Ambrosial Nectar of the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; imbued with the Shabad, they are blessed with honor. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਣੀ ਗੁਣੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gunee gunee mil laahaa paavas guramukh naam vadaaee ||
english: The virtuous meet with the virtuous, and earn the profit; as Gurmukh, they obtain the glorious greatness of the Naam.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੫॥੬॥
transliteration: sagale dookh mitahi gur sevaa naanak naam sakhaaee ||4||5||6||
english: All sorrows are erased, by serving the Guru; O Nanak, the Naam is our only Friend and Companion. ||4||5||6||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 1 ||
english: Bhairao, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਰਬ ਧਨੁ ਧਾਰਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: hiradai naam sarab dhan dhaaran gur parasaadee paaeeai ||
english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the wealth and support of all; It is enshrined in the heart, by Guru's Grace.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਮਰ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਤੇ ਕਿਰਤਾਰਥ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
transliteration: amar padaarath te kirataarath sahaj dhiaan liv laaeeai ||1||
english: One who gathers this imperishable wealth is fulfilled, and through intuitive meditation, is lovingly focused on the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
transliteration: man re raam bhagat chit laaeeai ||
english: O mortal, focus your consciousness on devotional worship of the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh raam naam jap hiradai sahaj setee ghar jaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As Gurmukh, meditate on the Name of the Lord in your heart, and you shall return to your home with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਭਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
transliteration: bharam bhed bhau kabahu na chhootas aavat jaat na jaanee ||
english: Doubt, separation and fear are never eradicated, and the mortal continues coming and going in reincarnation, as long as he does not know the Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin har naam ko mukat na paavas doob mue bin paanee ||2||
english: Without the Name of the Lord, no one is liberated; they drown and die without water. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ ਸਗਲੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵਸਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਸਿ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: dha(n)dhaa karat sagalee pat khovas bharam na mitas gavaaraa ||
english: Busy with his worldly affairs, all honor is lost; the ignorant one is not rid of his doubts.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bin gurasabad mukat nahee kab hee a(n)dhule dha(n)dh pasaaraa ||3||
english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mortal is never liberated; he remains blindly entangled in the expanse of worldly affairs. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮੂਆ ॥
transliteration: akul nira(n)jan siu man maaniaa man hee te man mooaa ||
english: My mind is pleased and appeased with the Immaculate Lord, who has no ancestry. Through the mind itself, the mind is subdued.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਆ ॥੪॥੬॥੭॥
transliteration: a(n)tar baahar eko jaaniaa naanak avar na dooaa ||4||6||7||
english: Deep within my being, and outside as well, I know only the One Lord. O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||4||6||7||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 1 ||
english: Bhairao, First Mehl:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਗਨ ਹੋਮ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਖੀ ਨਿਤ ਦੂਖ ਸਹੈ ॥
transliteration: jagan hom pu(n)n tap poojaa deh dukhee nit dookh sahai ||
english: You may give feasts, make burnt offerings, donate to charity, perform austere penance and worship, and endure pain and suffering in the body.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na paavas mukat naam guramukh lahai ||1||
english: But without the Lord's Name, liberation is not obtained. As Gurmukh, obtain the Naam and liberation. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਜਗਿ ਜਨਮਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam bin birathe jag janamaa ||
english: Without the Lord's Name, birth into the world is useless.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਬੋਲੀ ਬੋਲੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਮਰਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: bikh khaavai bikh bolee bolai bin naavai nihaphal mar bhramanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Without the Name, the mortal eats poison and speaks poisonous words; he dies fruitlessly, and wanders in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਪੁਸਤਕ ਪਾਠ ਬਿਆਕਰਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਤਿਕਾਲ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: pusatak paath biaakaran vakhaanai sa(n)dhiaa karam tikaal karai ||
english: The mortal may read scriptures, study grammar and say his prayers three times a day.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਰਝਿ ਮਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin gurasabad mukat kahaa praanee raam naam bin urajh marai ||2||
english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, where is liberation, O mortal? Without the Lord's Name, the mortal is entangled and dies. ||2||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਡੰਡ ਕਮੰਡਲ ਸਿਖਾ ਸੂਤੁ ਧੋਤੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: da(n)d kama(n)dal sikhaa soot dhotee teerath gavan at bhraman karai ||
english: Walking sticks, begging bowls, hair tufts, sacred threads, loin cloths, pilgrimages to sacred shrines and wandering all around

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam naam bin saa(n)t na aavai jap har har naam s paar parai ||3||
english: - without the Lord's Name, peace and tranquility are not obtained. One who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, crosses over to the other side. ||3||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਟਾ ਮੁਕਟੁ ਤਨਿ ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਈ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਛੋਡਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਗਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jataa mukat tan bhasam lagaaee basatr chhod tan nagan bhaiaa ||
english: The mortal's hair may be matted and tangled upon his head, and he may smear his body with ashes; he may take off his clothes and go naked.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਿਰਤ ਕੈ ਬਾਂਧੈ ਭੇਖੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: raam naam bin tripat na aavai kirat kai baa(n)dhai bhekh bhaiaa ||4||
english: But without the Lord's Name, he is not satisfied; he wears religious robes, but he is bound by the karma of the actions he committed in past lives. ||4||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਕਤ੍ਰ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ॥
transliteration: jete jee ja(n)t jal thal maheeal jatr katr too sarab jeeaa ||
english: As many beings and creatures as there are in the water, on the land and in the sky - wherever they are, You are with them all, O Lord.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਝੋਲਿ ਪੀਆ ॥੫॥੭॥੮॥
transliteration: gur parasaad raakh le jan kau har ras naanak jhol peeaa ||5||7||8||
english: By Guru's Grace, please preserve Your humble servant; O Lord, Nanak stirs up this juice, and drinks it in. ||5||7||8||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
transliteration: raag bhairau mahalaa 3 chaupade ghar 1 ||
english: Raag Bhairao, Third Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਕਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: jaat kaa garab na kareeahu koee ||
english: No one should be proud of his social class and status.

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: braham bi(n)de so braahaman hoee ||1||
english: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows God. ||1||

author: Guru Nanak
gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਕਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: jaat kaa garab na kar moorakh gavaaraa ||
english: Do not be proud of your social class and status, you ignorant fool!

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਗਰਬ ਤੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: is garab te chalahi bahut vikaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: So much sin and corruption comes from this pride. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਵਰਨ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: chaare varan aakhai sabh koee ||
english: Everyone says that there are four castes, four social classes.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: braham bi(n)d te sabh opat hoee ||2||
english: They all emanate from the drop of God's Seed. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਏਕ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: maatee ek sagal sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The entire universe is made of the same clay.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਘੜੈ ਕੁਮੑਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: bahu bidh bhaa(n)de ghaRai kumhaaraa ||3||
english: The Potter has shaped it into all sorts of vessels. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਾ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch tat mil dehee kaa aakaaraa ||
english: The five elements join together, to make up the form of the human body.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਵਧਿ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ghat vadh ko karai beechaaraa ||4||
english: Who can say which is less, and which is more? ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਕਰਮ ਬੰਧੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
transliteration: kahat naanak ihu jeeu karam ba(n)dh hoee ||
english: Says Nanak, this soul is bound by its actions.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੧॥
transliteration: bin satigur bhete mukat na hoee ||5||1||
english: Without meeting the True Guru, it is not liberated. ||5||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
transliteration: jogee grihee pa(n)dit bhekhadhaaree ||
english: The Yogis, the householders, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the beggars in religious robes

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏ ਸੂਤੇ ਅਪਣੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
transliteration: e soote apanai aha(n)kaaree ||1||
english: - they are all asleep in egotism. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: maaiaa mad maataa rahiaa soi ||
english: They are asleep, intoxicated with the wine of Maya.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਮੂਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: jaagat rahai na moosai koi ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Only those who remain awake and aware are not robbed. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਾਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
transliteration: so jaagai jis satigur milai ||
english: One who has met the True Guru, remains awake and aware.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਓਹੁ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕਰੈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: pa(n)ch doot ohu vasagat karai ||2||
english: Such a person overpowers the five thieves. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਾਗੈ ਜੋ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
transliteration: so jaagai jo tat beechaarai ||
english: One who contemplates the essence of reality remains awake and aware.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮਰੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਨਹ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aap marai avaraa nah maarai ||3||
english: He kills his self-conceit, and does not kill anyone else. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਾਗੈ ਜੋ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
transliteration: so jaagai jo eko jaanai ||
english: One who knows the One Lord remains awake and aware.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪਰਕਿਰਤਿ ਛੋਡੈ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: parakirat chhodai tat pachhaanai ||4||
english: He abandons the service of others, and realizes the essence of reality. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: chahu varanaa vich jaagai koi ||
english: Of the four castes, whoever remains awake and aware

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਮੈ ਕਾਲੈ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥
transliteration: jamai kaalai te chhootai soi ||5||
english: is released from birth and death. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kahat naanak jan jaagai soi ||
english: Says Nanak, that humble being remains awake and aware,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥੨॥
transliteration: giaan a(n)jan jaa kee netree hoi ||6||2||
english: who applies the ointment of spiritual wisdom to his eyes. ||6||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਣੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
transliteration: jaa kau raakhai apanee saranaaee ||
english: Whoever the Lord keeps in His Sanctuary,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: saache laagai saachaa phal paaee ||1||
english: is attached to the Truth, and receives the fruit of Truth. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: re jan kai siu karahu pukaaraa ||
english: O mortal, unto whom will you complain?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੋਆ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: hukame hoaa hukame varataaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The Hukam of the Lord's Command is pervasive; by the Hukam of His Command, all things happen. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: ehu aakaar teraa hai dhaaraa ||
english: This Creation was established by You.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: khin mahi binasai karat na laagai baaraa ||2||
english: In an instant You destroy it, and You create it again without a moment's delay. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਇਕੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: kar prasaad ik khel dikhaaiaa ||
english: By His Grace, He has staged this Play.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kirapaa te param pad paaiaa ||3||
english: By the Guru's Merciful Grace, I have obtained the supreme status. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: kahat naanak maar jeevaale soi ||
english: Says Nanak, He alone kills and revives.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
transliteration: aisaa boojhahu bharam na bhoolahu koi ||4||3||
english: Understand this well - do not be confused by doubt. ||4||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: mai kaaman meraa ka(n)t karataar ||
english: I am the bride; the Creator is my Husband Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਕਰਾਏ ਤੇਹਾ ਕਰੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: jehaa karaae tehaa karee seegaar ||1||
english: As He inspires me, I adorn myself. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਕਰੇ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
transliteration: jaa(n) tis bhaavai taa(n) kare bhog ||
english: When it pleases Him, He enjoys me.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: tan man saache saahib jog ||1|| rahaau ||
english: I am joined, body and mind, to my True Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ॥
transliteration: usatat ni(n)daa kare kiaa koee ||
english: How can anyone praise or slander anyone else?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: jaa(n) aape varatai eko soee ||2||
english: The One Lord Himself is pervading and permeating all. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਿਰਮ ਕਸਾਈ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee piram kasaaee ||
english: By Guru's Grace, I am attracted by His Love.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਉਗੀ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
transliteration: milaugee daiaal pa(n)ch sabad vajaaee ||3||
english: I shall meet with my Merciful Lord, and vibrate the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥
transliteration: bhanat naanak kare kiaa koi ||
english: Prays Nanak, what can anyone do?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੪॥
transliteration: jis no aap milaavai soi ||4||4||
english: He alone meets with the Lord, whom the Lord Himself meets. ||4||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: so mun j man kee dubidhaa maare ||
english: He alone is a silent sage, who subdues his mind's duality.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: dubidhaa maar braham beechaare ||1||
english: Subduing his duality, he contemplates God. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: is man kau koee khojahu bhaaee ||
english: Let each person examine his own mind, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਖੋਜਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: man khojat naam nau nidh paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: Examine your mind, and you shall obtain the nine treasures of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: mool mohu kar karatai jagat upaaiaa ||
english: The Creator created the world, upon the foundation of worldly love and attachment.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਲਾਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੋੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: mamataa laai bharam bhoulaaiaa ||2||
english: Attaching it to possessiveness, He has led it into confusion with doubt. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਪਿੰਡ ਪਰਾਣਾ ॥
transliteration: is man te sabh pi(n)d paraanaa ||
english: From this Mind come all bodies, and the breath of life.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
transliteration: man kai veechaar hukam bujh samaanaa ||3||
english: By mental contemplation, the mortal realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and merges in Him. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
transliteration: karam hovai gur kirapaa karai ||
english: When the mortal has good karma, the Guru grants His Grace.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਰੈ ॥੪॥
transliteration: ihu man jaagai is man kee dubidhaa marai ||4||
english: Then this mind is awakened, and the duality of this mind is subdued. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
transliteration: man kaa subhaau sadaa bairaagee ||
english: It is the innate nature of the mind to remain forever detached.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਸੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥੫॥
transliteration: sabh mahi vasai ateet anaraagee ||5||
english: The Detached, Dispassionate Lord dwells within all. ||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
transliteration: kahat naanak jo jaanai bheu ||
english: Says Nanak, one who understands this mystery,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੬॥੫॥
transliteration: aad purakh nira(n)jan deu ||6||5||
english: becomes the embodiment of the Primal, Immaculate, Divine Lord God. ||6||5||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: raam naam jagat nisataaraa ||
english: The world is saved through Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bhavajal paar utaaranahaaraa ||1||
english: It carries the mortal across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaadee har naam samhaal ||
english: By Guru's Grace, dwell upon the Lord's Name.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: sad hee nibahai terai naal ||1|| rahaau ||
english: It shall stand by you forever. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: naam na chetahi manamukh gaavaaraa ||
english: The foolish self-willed manmukhs do not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: bin naavai kaise paavahi paaraa ||2||
english: Without the Name, how will they cross over? ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape daat kare daataar ||
english: The Lord, the Great Giver, Himself gives His Gifts.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੇ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: devanahaare kau jaikaar ||3||
english: Celebrate and praise the Great Giver! ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: nadar kare satiguroo milaae ||
english: Granting His Grace, the Lord unites the mortals with the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੪॥੬॥
transliteration: naanak hiradai naam vasaae ||4||6||
english: O Nanak, the Naam is enshrined within the heart. ||4||6||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਿਤਨੇ ਲੋਅ ॥
transliteration: naame udhare sabh jitane lo ||
english: All people are saved through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh jinaa paraapat hoi ||1||
english: Those who become Gurmukh are blessed to receive It. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu apanee kripaa karei ||
english: When the Dear Lord showers His Mercy,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naam vadiaaee dei ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He blesses the Gurmukh with the glorious greatness of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਿਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
transliteration: raam naam jin preet piaar ||
english: Those who love the Beloved Name of the Lord

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
transliteration: aap udhare sabh kul udhaaranahaar ||2||
english: save themselves, and save all their ancestors. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: bin naavai manamukh jam pur jaahi ||
english: Without the Name, the self-willed manmukhs go to the City of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅਉਖੇ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
transliteration: aukhe hovahi chotaa khaahi ||3||
english: They suffer in pain and endure beatings. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: aape karataa devai soi ||
english: When the Creator Himself gives,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੭॥
transliteration: naanak naam paraapat hoi ||4||7||
english: O Nanak, then the mortals receive the Naam. ||4||7||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
transliteration: govi(n)d preet sanakaadik udhaare ||
english: Love of the Lord of the Universe saved Sanak and his brother, the sons of Brahma.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: raam naam sabad beechaare ||1||
english: They contemplated the Word of the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu apanee kirapaa dhaar ||
english: O Dear Lord, please shower me with Your Mercy,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh naame lagai piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: that as Gurmukh, I may embrace love for Your Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: a(n)tar preet bhagat saachee hoi ||
english: Whoever has true loving devotional worship deep within his being

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: poorai gur melaavaa hoi ||2||
english: meets the Lord, through the Perfect Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
transliteration: nij ghar vasai sahaj subhaai ||
english: He naturally, intuitively dwells within the home of his own inner being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: guramukh naam vasai man aai ||3||
english: The Naam abides within the mind of the Gurmukh. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਵੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: aape vekhai vekhanahaar ||
english: The Lord, the Seer, Himself sees.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੮॥
transliteration: naanak naam rakhahu ur dhaar ||4||8||
english: O Nanak, enshrine the Naam within your heart. ||4||8||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kalajug mahi raam naam ur dhaar ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, enshrine the Lord's Name within your heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
transliteration: bin naavai maathai paavai chhaar ||1||
english: Without the Name, ashes will be blown in your face. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਲਭੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
transliteration: raam naam dulabh hai bhaaee ||
english: The Lord's Name is so difficult to obtain, O Siblings of Destiny.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: gur parasaad vasai man aaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: By Guru's Grace, it comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
transliteration: raam naam jan bhaalahi soi ||
english: That humble being who seeks the Lord's Name,

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
transliteration: poore gur te praapat hoi ||2||
english: receives it from the Perfect Guru. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
transliteration: har kaa bhaanaa ma(n)nahi se jan paravaan ||
english: Those humble beings who accept the Will of the Lord, are approved and accepted.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kai sabad naam neesaan ||3||
english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they bear the insignia of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਜੋ ਕਲ ਰਹਿਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
transliteration: so sevahu jo kal rahiaa dhaar ||
english: So serve the One, whose power supports the Universe.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੪॥੯॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh naam piaar ||4||9||
english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh loves the Naam. ||4||9||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
transliteration: kalajug mahi bahu karam kamaahi ||
english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, many rituals are performed.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਰੁਤਿ ਨ ਕਰਮ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
transliteration: naa rut na karam thaai paahi ||1||
english: But it is not the time for them, and so they are of no use. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
transliteration: kalajug mahi raam naam hai saar ||
english: In Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the most sublime.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: guramukh saachaa lagai piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
english: As Gurmukh, be lovingly attached to Truth. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: tan man khoj gharai mahi paaiaa ||
english: Searching my body and mind, I found Him within the home of my own heart.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh raam naam chit laaiaa ||2||
english: The Gurmukh centers his consciousness on the Lord's Name. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
transliteration: giaan a(n)jan satigur te hoi ||
english: The ointment of spiritual wisdom is obtained from the True Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥੩॥
transliteration: raam naam rav rahiaa tihu loi ||3||
english: The Lord's Name is pervading the three worlds. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਏਕੁ ਹੋਰ ਰੁਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: kalijug mahi har jeeu ek hor rut na kaaee ||
english: In Kali Yuga, it is the time for the One Dear Lord; it is not the time for anything else.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਜਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
transliteration: naanak guramukh hiradai raam naam lehu jamaaee ||4||10||
english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, let the Lord's Name grow within your heart. ||4||10||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ghar 2 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl, Second House:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਹਿ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
transliteration: dubidhaa manamukh rog viaape trisanaa jalahi adhikaaee ||
english: The self-willed manmukhs are afflicted with the disease of duality; they are burnt by the intense fire of desire.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥
transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mahi thaur na paavahi birathaa janam gavaaee ||1||
english: They die and die again, and are reborn; they find no place of rest. They waste their lives uselessly. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
transliteration: mere preetam kar kirapaa dehu bujhaaee ||
english: O my Beloved, grant Your Grace, and give me understanding.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: haumai rogee jagat upaaiaa bin sabadai rog na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
english: The world was created in the disease of egotism; without the Word of the Shabad, the disease is not cured. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਪੜਹਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
transliteration: si(n)mrit saasatr paRahi mun kete bin sabadai surat na paaee ||
english: There are so many silent sages, who read the Simritees and the Shaastras; without the Shabad, they have no clear awareness.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭੇ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਮਮਤਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੨॥
transliteration: trai gun sabhe rog viaape mamataa surat gavaaee ||2||
english: All those under the influence of the three qualities are afflicted with the disease; through possessiveness, they lose their awareness. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: ik aape kaadh lae prabh aape gur sevaa prabh laae ||
english: O God, you save some, and you enjoin others to serve the Guru.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੋ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥੩॥
transliteration: har kaa naam nidhaano paaiaa sukh vasiaa man aae ||3||
english: They obtain the treasure of the Name of the Lord; peace comes to abide within their minds. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੀ ਪਦਵੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: chauthee padavee guramukh varatahi tin nij ghar vaasaa paaiaa ||
english: The Gurmukhs dwell in the fourth state; they obtain a dwelling in the home of their own inner being.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
transliteration: poorai satigur kirapaa keenee vichahu aap gavaaiaa ||4||
english: The Perfect True Guru shows His Mercy to them; they eradicate their self-conceit from within. ||4||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਏਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: ekas kee sir kaar ek jin brahamaa bisan rudr upaaiaa ||
english: Everyone must serve the One Lord, who created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੧॥
transliteration: naanak nihachal saachaa eko naa ohu marai na jaaiaa ||5||1||11||
english: O Nanak, the One True Lord is permanent and stable. He does not die, and He is not born. ||5||1||11||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੀ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: manamukh dubidhaa sadaa hai rogee rogee sagal sa(n)saaraa ||
english: The self-willed manmukh is afflicted with the disease of duality forever; the entire universe is diseased.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
transliteration: guramukh boojhahi rog gavaavahi gurasabadee veechaaraa ||1||
english: The Gurmukh understands, and is cured of the disease, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥
transliteration: har jeeu satasa(n)gat melaai ||
english: O Dear Lord, please let me join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: naanak tis no dei vadiaaee jo raam naam chit laai ||1|| rahaau ||
english: O Nanak, the Lord blesses with glorious greatness, those who focus their consciousness on the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਕਾਲਿ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
transliteration: mamataa kaal sabh rog viaape tin jam kee hai sir kaaraa ||
english: Death takes all those who are afflicted with the disease of possessiveness. They are subject to the Messenger of Death.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
transliteration: guramukh praanee jam neR na aavai jin har raakhiaa ur dhaaraa ||2||
english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach that mortal who, as Gurmukh, enshrines the Lord within his heart. ||2||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥
transliteration: jin har kaa naam na guramukh jaataa se jag mahi kaahe aaiaa ||
english: One who does not know the Lord's Name, and who does not become Gurmukh - why did he even come into the world?

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
transliteration: gur kee sevaa kade na keenee birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||3||
english: He never serves the Guru; he wastes his life uselessly. ||3||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: naanak se poore vadabhaagee satigur sevaa laae ||
english: O Nanak, those whom the True Guru enjoins to His service, have perfect good fortune.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨॥
transliteration: jo ichhahi soee phal paavahi gurabaanee sukh paae ||4||2||12||
english: They obtain the fruits of their desires, and find peace in the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||4||2||12||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
english: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
transliteration: dukh vich ja(n)mai dukh marai dukh vich kaar kamaai ||
english: In pain he is born, in pain he dies, and in pain he does his deeds.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
transliteration: garabh jonee vich kade na nikalai bisataa maahi samaai ||1||
english: He is never released from the womb of reincarnation; he rots away in manure. ||1||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
transliteration: dhrig dhrig manamukh janam gavaaiaa ||
english: Cursed, cursed is the self-willed manmukh, who wastes his life away.

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
transliteration: poore gur kee sev na keenee har kaa naam na bhaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
english: He does not serve the Perfect Guru; he does not love the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

author: Guru Amardas
gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਏ ॥
transliteration: gur kaa sabad sabh rog gavaae jis no har jeeu laae ||
